`CMakeLists.txt`:

```txt
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)

if(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_C_COMPILER)
    find_program(RUNTIME_CLANG clang REQUIRED)
    set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER ${RUNTIME_CLANG})
endif()
if(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER)
    find_program(RUNTIME_CLANGXX clang++ REQUIRED)
    set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER ${RUNTIME_CLANGXX})
endif()

project(acl VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE RelWithDebInfo CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()

add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)

option(RUNTIME_HARDENED "Build the runtime with exploit mitigations" ON)

if(RUNTIME_HARDENED)
    add_compile_options(
        -fstack-protector-strong
        -fstack-clash-protection
        $<$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>:-D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=3>)
    add_link_options(-Wl,-z,relro -Wl,-z,now -Wl,-z,noexecstack -Wl,-z,separate-code)
    set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
endif()

if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/.toolchain/aosp/master-art")
    set(RUNTIME_DEFAULT_AOSP_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/.toolchain/aosp/master-art")
else()
    set(RUNTIME_DEFAULT_AOSP_DIR "$ENV{HOME}/aosp/master-art")

    set(RUNTIME_DEFAULT_SDK_DIR "$ENV{HOME}/Android/Sdk")
```

`README.md`:

```md
# Android-Compatibility-Layer
A translation layer for Android on Linux. Run Android Apps and Games on Linux

## Introduction

ACL (Android Compatibility Layer) runs an APK directly on the Linux system without using virtual machines, containers or Android system images.

```
acl myapp.apk
```

Usually an Android app is divided into two parts. Dex and Native code. ACL treats them as follows:
- Dex bytecode runs on a ART build from AOSP source code.
- ARM64 native libraries are translated ahead of time to x86_64 by LLVM or ran directly using JIT

The Android framework itself is reimplemented on Linux. This includes using wayland for windows, handling for Vulkan and GLES, FreeType and HarfBuzz for text, SQLite for storage and PipeWire for audio.

## Disclaimer

This project is still in a very early stage and app support is still very limited. If you find an app that isn't supported, please open a Github issue and I'll do my best to support it.

## Supported

- x86-64 Linux with only Wayland support for now
- Vulkan or OpenGL ES driver
- `arm64-v8a` and `x86_64` APKs

## What is different here?

Most of the other projects I've seen either boot a full Android image in a container (Waydroid, Anbox) and still need a native bridge for ARM code.

This project does it differently:

- Java and Kotlin code is never translated as dex is ran by x86_64 ART directly on the system
- ARM64 code is recompiled ahead of time. This is done with the help of LLVM.
- Graphics go straight to the host gpu rather than being emulated.

## Why it's faster for gaming

Most Android games are mostly native code. Emulating this code is slow, especially emulation of ARM64 on x86_64. That's why we

- The entire native library is translated to x86_64. That means it can run natively on linux without any soft of translation.
- No memory access slowdown
- Native graphics

## Features

- Install and run apks
- Split apks and multidex support
- Activity lifecycle, back state, intents, saved instance state, fragments, services, broadcasts, alarms, jobs
- Canvas, Paint, Path, Region, Bitmap
- SufaceView, NativeActivity
- SQLite, Handler/Looper/MessageQueue
- Audio
- Touch

## What's missing

- SystemUI
- No binder, IPC
- No rotation
- No camera, sensors, gps, telephony, bluetooth, nfc, vibration
- No WebView, no MediaCodec, no hardware view decode
- No 32 bit arm support
- No multi window
- No permission UI
- LLVM sometimes crashes on big libraries

Still early. Expect bugs.

## Security

Since all the code runs on the host system, there are several security measures in place. Those include:

- seccomp
- landlock
- private pid namespace
- private network namespace

You can turn off sandboxing with `--no-sandbox` but it's not recommended for untrusted apps.

## Building and Installation

### Release bundle

```
tar xzf acl-0.1.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
cd acl-0.1.0-linux-x86_64
./bin/acl myapp.apk
```

It includes the Android runtime, `framework.jar`, the framework resources, fonts, the linker and everything else it needs.

### From source

Needs clang, CMake 3.28+, Ninja, LLVM 19+ with headers, FreeType, HarfBuzz, SQLite, libpng, libjpeg,
libwebp, Wayland, libxkbcommon.

```
./tools/setup-host.sh                      # AOSP host ART + SDK into .toolchain/
cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
```

`setup-host.sh` clones a reduced AOSP manifest and builds host ART. `--check`
reports what is present; phases (`packages`, `aosp`, `art`, `sdk`, `env`) can run individually.

`build/src/acl` finds `.toolchain/` and `build/java/framework.jar` by walking up
from itself.

```
cmake --build build --target dist
cmake --build build --target bundle
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
```

`dist` is not part of the default build, it copies ~350 MB each time.

## Running it

| Command | |
|---|---|
| `acl app.apk` | Run an APK from a path |
| `acl --install app.apk` | Copy into the data root, record it, exit |
| `acl --launch com.example.app` | Run an installed package with its persistent data |
| `acl --uninstall com.example.app` | Forget a package and delete its data |
| `acl --list` | Print what is installed |

**Translation**: `--aot` (default), `--jit`, `--cache-root DIR`, `--linker PATH`

**Window**: `--portrait` (default, 1080x2400), `--landscape`, `--window WxH`, `--density N`,
`--fullscreen`, `--decorated`, `--no-vsync`, `--fps`

**Storage**: `--data-root DIR` (default `~/.local/share/acl`), `--abi NAME`, `--keep-data`

**Permissions**: `--network`, `--no-sandbox`

**Debugging**: `--verbose`, `--quiet`, `--strict`, `--trace AREAS`, `--log FILE`,
`--frame-dump FILE`, `--guest-frame-dump FILE`, `--max-frames N`, `--guest-env K=V`

**Overrides** (a bundle finds these itself): `--host-root`, `--framework-jar`, `--framework-res`,
`--font-dir`, `--guest-shim`

## Credits

ACL would not be possible without:

- [AOSP](https://source.android.com): ART, `libandroidfw`, the framework sources and the arm64
  native bridge stubs
- [LLVM](https://llvm.org): the translation backend and `lld`
- [FreeType](https://freetype.org) and [HarfBuzz](https://harfbuzz.github.io) text
- [Roboto](https://github.com/googlefonts/roboto): the bundled fonts
- [Android Translation Layer](https://gitlab.com/android_translation_layer/android_translation_layer): the inspiration for all of this

## License

This project is licensed under MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

A release bundle redistributes third-party components under their own terms. See [NOTICE](NOTICE).

## Contact & Support

- [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/reveny/Android-Compatibility-Layer/issues)
- Email: contact@reveny.me
- Telegram Contact: https://t.me/revenyy
- Telegram Group: https://t.me/reveny1
```

`cmake/WaylandProtocols.cmake`:

```cmake
function(runtime_add_wayland_protocol target xmlPath basename)
    set(headerPath ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wayland-generated/${basename}-client-protocol.h)
    set(sourcePath ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wayland-generated/${basename}-protocol.c)

    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${headerPath}
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wayland-generated
        COMMAND ${RUNTIME_WAYLAND_SCANNER} client-header ${xmlPath} ${headerPath}
        DEPENDS ${xmlPath}
        COMMENT "wayland-scanner client-header ${basename}"
        VERBATIM
    )

    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${sourcePath}
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wayland-generated
        COMMAND ${RUNTIME_WAYLAND_SCANNER} private-code ${xmlPath} ${sourcePath}
        DEPENDS ${xmlPath}
        COMMENT "wayland-scanner private-code ${basename}"
        VERBATIM
    )

    target_sources(${target} PRIVATE ${headerPath} ${sourcePath})
    target_include_directories(${target} PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wayland-generated)
endfunction()
```

```java
package android.accessibilityservice;

import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.content.pm.ResolveInfo;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public class AccessibilityServiceInfo implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int CAPABILITY_CAN_RETRIEVE_WINDOW_CONTENT = 1;
    public static final int CAPABILITY_CAN_REQUEST_TOUCH_EXPLORATION = 2;
    public static final int CAPABILITY_CAN_REQUEST_ENHANCED_WEB_ACCESSIBILITY = 4;
    public static final int CAPABILITY_CAN_REQUEST_FILTER_KEY_EVENTS = 8;
    public static final int CAPABILITY_CAN_CONTROL_MAGNIFICATION = 16;
    public static final int CAPABILITY_CAN_PERFORM_GESTURES = 32;
    public static final int CAPABILITY_CAN_REQUEST_FINGERPRINT_GESTURES = 64;
    public static final int CAPABILITY_CAN_TAKE_SCREENSHOT = 128;
    public static final int DEFAULT = 1;
    public static final int FEEDBACK_ALL_MASK = -1;
    public static final int FEEDBACK_SPOKEN = 1;
    public static final int FEEDBACK_HAPTIC = 2;
    public static final int FEEDBACK_AUDIBLE = 4;
    public static final int FEEDBACK_VISUAL = 8;
    public static final int FEEDBACK_GENERIC = 16;
    public static final int FEEDBACK_BRAILLE = 32;
    public static final int FLAG_INCLUDE_NOT_IMPORTANT_VIEWS = 2;
    public static final int FLAG_REQUEST_TOUCH_EXPLORATION_MODE = 4;
    public static final int FLAG_REQUEST_ENHANCED_WEB_ACCESSIBILITY = 8;
    public static final int FLAG_REPORT_VIEW_IDS = 16;
    public static final int FLAG_REQUEST_FILTER_KEY_EVENTS = 32;
    public static final int FLAG_RETRIEVE_INTERACTIVE_WINDOWS = 64;
    public static final int FLAG_ENABLE_ACCESSIBILITY_VOLUME = 128;
    public static final int FLAG_REQUEST_ACCESSIBILITY_BUTTON = 256;
    public static final int FLAG_REQUEST_FINGERPRINT_GESTURES = 512;
    public static final int FLAG_REQUEST_SHORTCUT_WARNING_DIALOG_SPOKEN_FEEDBACK = 1024;
    public static final int FLAG_SERVICE_HANDLES_DOUBLE_TAP = 2048;
    public static final int FLAG_REQUEST_MULTI_FINGER_GESTURES = 4096;
    public static final int FLAG_REQUEST_2_FINGER_PASSTHROUGH = 8192;
    public static final int FLAG_SEND_MOTION_EVENTS = 16384;
    public static final int FLAG_INPUT_METHOD_EDITOR = 32768;

    public int eventTypes;
    public String[] packageNames;
    public int feedbackType;
    public long notificationTimeout;
    public int flags;

    private String mId;
    private ResolveInfo mResolveInfo;
    private String mSettingsActivityName;
    private String mTileServiceName;
    private int mCapabilities;
    private int mMotionEventSources;
    private String mDescription;
    private int mNonInteractiveUiTimeout;
    private int mInteractiveUiTimeout;
    private boolean mIsAccessibilityTool;

    public AccessibilityServiceInfo()
    {
    }

    public String getId()
    {
        return mId;
    }

    public ResolveInfo getResolveInfo()
    {
        return mResolveInfo;
    }

    public String getSettingsActivityName()
    {
        return mSettingsActivityName;
    }

    public String getTileServiceName()
    {
        return mTileServiceName;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public boolean getCanRetrieveWindowContent()
    {
        return (mCapabilities & CAPABILITY_CAN_RETRIEVE_WINDOW_CONTENT) != 0;
    }

    {
        return mCapabilities;
    }

    {
        return mMotionEventSources;
    }

    {
        mMotionEventSources = motionEventSources;
    }

    public CharSequence loadSummary(PackageManager packageManager)
    {
        return null;
    }

    public CharSequence loadIntro(PackageManager packageManager)
    {
        return null;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public String getDescription()
    {
        return mDescription;
    }

    public String loadDescription(PackageManager packageManager)
    {
        return mDescription;
    }

    public void setNonInteractiveUiTimeoutMillis(int timeout)
    {
        mNonInteractiveUiTimeout = timeout;
    }

    {
        return mNonInteractiveUiTimeout;
    }

    {
        mInteractiveUiTimeout = timeout;
    }

    public int getInteractiveUiTimeoutMillis()
    {
        return mInteractiveUiTimeout;
    }

    public boolean isAccessibilityTool()
    {
        return mIsAccessibilityTool;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int parcelFlags)
    {
        parcel.writeInt(eventTypes);
        writeStrings(parcel, packageNames);
        parcel.writeInt(feedbackType);
        parcel.writeLong(notificationTimeout);
        parcel.writeInt(flags);
        parcel.writeString(mId);
        parcel.writeString(mSettingsActivityName);
        parcel.writeString(mTileServiceName);
        parcel.writeInt(mCapabilities);
        parcel.writeInt(mMotionEventSources);
        parcel.writeString(mDescription);
        parcel.writeInt(mNonInteractiveUiTimeout);
        parcel.writeInt(mInteractiveUiTimeout);
        parcel.writeInt(mIsAccessibilityTool ? 1 : 0);
    }

    private static void writeStrings(Parcel parcel, String[] values)
    {
        if (values == null)
        {
            parcel.writeInt(-1);
            return;
        }

        parcel.writeInt(values.length);
        for (String value : values)
        {
            parcel.writeString(value);
        }
    }

    private static String[] readStrings(Parcel parcel)
    {
        int count = parcel.readInt();
        if (count < 0) return null;

        String[] values = new String[count];
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            values[index] = parcel.readString();
        }
        return values;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return 31 + (mId == null ? 0 : mId.hashCode());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof AccessibilityServiceInfo)) return false;

        AccessibilityServiceInfo info = (AccessibilityServiceInfo)other;
        return mId == null ? info.mId == null : mId.equals(info.mId);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        builder.append("eventTypes: ").append(eventTypes);
        builder.append(", packageNames: ").append(packageNames == null ? "null" : java.util.Arrays.toString(packageNames));
        builder.append(", feedbackTypes: ").append(feedbackTypeToString(feedbackType));
        builder.append(", notificationTimeout: ").append(notificationTimeout);
        builder.append(", flags: ").append(flags);
        builder.append(", id: ").append(mId);
        builder.append(", capabilities: ").append(mCapabilities);
        return builder.toString();
    }

    public static String feedbackTypeToString(int feedbackType)
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        builder.append('[');

        while (feedbackType != 0)
        {
            int feedbackTypeFlag = 1 << Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(feedbackType);
            feedbackType &= ~feedbackTypeFlag;

            if (builder.length() > 1) builder.append(", ");

            switch (feedbackTypeFlag)
            {
                case FEEDBACK_AUDIBLE:
                    builder.append("FEEDBACK_AUDIBLE");
                    break;
                case FEEDBACK_HAPTIC:
                    builder.append("FEEDBACK_HAPTIC");
                    break;
                case FEEDBACK_GENERIC:
                    builder.append("FEEDBACK_GENERIC");
                    break;
                case FEEDBACK_SPOKEN:
                    builder.append("FEEDBACK_SPOKEN");
                    break;
                case FEEDBACK_VISUAL:
                    builder.append("FEEDBACK_VISUAL");
                    break;
                case FEEDBACK_BRAILLE:
                    builder.append("FEEDBACK_BRAILLE");
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
        }

        builder.append(']');
        return builder.toString();
    }

    public static String flagToString(int flag)
    {
        switch (flag)
        {
            case DEFAULT:
                return "DEFAULT";
            case FLAG_INCLUDE_NOT_IMPORTANT_VIEWS:
                return "FLAG_INCLUDE_NOT_IMPORTANT_VIEWS";
            case FLAG_REQUEST_TOUCH_EXPLORATION_MODE:
                return "FLAG_REQUEST_TOUCH_EXPLORATION_MODE";
            case FLAG_REQUEST_ENHANCED_WEB_ACCESSIBILITY:
                return "FLAG_REQUEST_ENHANCED_WEB_ACCESSIBILITY";
            case FLAG_REPORT_VIEW_IDS:
                return "FLAG_REPORT_VIEW_IDS";
            case FLAG_REQUEST_FILTER_KEY_EVENTS:
                return "FLAG_REQUEST_FILTER_KEY_EVENTS";
            case FLAG_RETRIEVE_INTERACTIVE_WINDOWS:
                return "FLAG_RETRIEVE_INTERACTIVE_WINDOWS";
            case FLAG_ENABLE_ACCESSIBILITY_VOLUME:
                return "FLAG_ENABLE_ACCESSIBILITY_VOLUME";
            case FLAG_REQUEST_ACCESSIBILITY_BUTTON:
                return "FLAG_REQUEST_ACCESSIBILITY_BUTTON";
            case FLAG_REQUEST_FINGERPRINT_GESTURES:
                return "FLAG_REQUEST_FINGERPRINT_GESTURES";
            case FLAG_REQUEST_SHORTCUT_WARNING_DIALOG_SPOKEN_FEEDBACK:
                return "FLAG_REQUEST_SHORTCUT_WARNING_DIALOG_SPOKEN_FEEDBACK";
            case FLAG_SERVICE_HANDLES_DOUBLE_TAP:
                return "FLAG_SERVICE_HANDLES_DOUBLE_TAP";
            case FLAG_REQUEST_MULTI_FINGER_GESTURES:
                return "FLAG_REQUEST_MULTI_FINGER_GESTURES";
            case FLAG_REQUEST_2_FINGER_PASSTHROUGH:
                return "FLAG_REQUEST_2_FINGER_PASSTHROUGH";
            case FLAG_SEND_MOTION_EVENTS:
                return "FLAG_SEND_MOTION_EVENTS";
            case FLAG_INPUT_METHOD_EDITOR:
                return "FLAG_INPUT_METHOD_EDITOR";
            default:
                return null;
        }
    }

    public static String capabilityToString(int capability)
    {
        switch (capability)
        {
            case CAPABILITY_CAN_RETRIEVE_WINDOW_CONTENT:
                return "CAPABILITY_CAN_RETRIEVE_WINDOW_CONTENT";
            case CAPABILITY_CAN_REQUEST_TOUCH_EXPLORATION:
                return "CAPABILITY_CAN_REQUEST_TOUCH_EXPLORATION";
            case CAPABILITY_CAN_REQUEST_ENHANCED_WEB_ACCESSIBILITY:
                return "CAPABILITY_CAN_REQUEST_ENHANCED_WEB_ACCESSIBILITY";
            case CAPABILITY_CAN_REQUEST_FILTER_KEY_EVENTS:
                return "CAPABILITY_CAN_REQUEST_FILTER_KEY_EVENTS";
            case CAPABILITY_CAN_CONTROL_MAGNIFICATION:
                return "CAPABILITY_CAN_CONTROL_MAGNIFICATION";
            case CAPABILITY_CAN_PERFORM_GESTURES:
                return "CAPABILITY_CAN_PERFORM_GESTURES";
            case CAPABILITY_CAN_REQUEST_FINGERPRINT_GESTURES:
                return "CAPABILITY_CAN_REQUEST_FINGERPRINT_GESTURES";
            case CAPABILITY_CAN_TAKE_SCREENSHOT:
                return "CAPABILITY_CAN_TAKE_SCREENSHOT";
            default:
                return "UNKNOWN";
        }
    }

    public static final Creator<AccessibilityServiceInfo> CREATOR = new Creator<AccessibilityServiceInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public AccessibilityServiceInfo createFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
        {
            AccessibilityServiceInfo info = new AccessibilityServiceInfo();
            info.eventTypes = parcel.readInt();
            info.packageNames = readStrings(parcel);
            info.feedbackType = parcel.readInt();
            info.notificationTimeout = parcel.readLong();
            info.flags = parcel.readInt();
            info.mId = parcel.readString();
            info.mSettingsActivityName = parcel.readString();
            info.mTileServiceName = parcel.readString();
            info.mCapabilities = parcel.readInt();
            info.mMotionEventSources = parcel.readInt();
            info.mDescription = parcel.readString();
            info.mNonInteractiveUiTimeout = parcel.readInt();
            info.mInteractiveUiTimeout = parcel.readInt();
            info.mIsAccessibilityTool = parcel.readInt() != 0;
            return info;
        }

        @Override
        public AccessibilityServiceInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new AccessibilityServiceInfo[size];
        }
    };
}
```

```java
import android.content.Context;

public abstract class AbstractAccountAuthenticator

    public static final String KEY_CUSTOM_TOKEN_EXPIRY = "android.accounts.expiry";

    private final Context mContext;
    private final android.os.Binder mBinder = new android.os.Binder("android.accounts.IAccountAuthenticator");

    public AbstractAccountAuthenticator(Context context)

        mContext = context;
    }

        return mBinder;
    }

    public abstract Bundle editProperties(AccountAuthenticatorResponse response, String accountType);

    public abstract String getAuthTokenLabel(String authTokenType);

    public abstract Bundle updateCredentials(AccountAuthenticatorResponse response, Account account, String authTokenType,
                                             Bundle options) throws NetworkErrorException;

    public abstract Bundle hasFeatures(AccountAuthenticatorResponse response, Account account, String[] features)
        throws NetworkErrorException;

    public Bundle getAccountRemovalAllowed(AccountAuthenticatorResponse response, Account account) throws NetworkErrorException
    {

        result.putBoolean(AccountManager.KEY_BOOLEAN_RESULT, true);
        return result;
    }

    public Bundle getAccountCredentialsForCloning(AccountAuthenticatorResponse response, Account account)
        throws NetworkErrorException
    {
        Bundle result = new Bundle();
        result.putBoolean(AccountManager.KEY_BOOLEAN_RESULT, false);
        return result;
    }

    public Bundle addAccountFromCredentials(AccountAuthenticatorResponse response, Account account, Bundle accountCredentials)
        throws NetworkErrorException
    {
        Bundle result = new Bundle();
        result.putBoolean(AccountManager.KEY_BOOLEAN_RESULT, false);
        return result;
    }

    public Bundle startAddAccountSession(AccountAuthenticatorResponse response, String accountType, String authTokenType,
                                         String[] requiredFeatures, Bundle options) throws NetworkErrorException
    {
        Bundle sessionBundle = new Bundle();
        sessionBundle.putString(AccountManager.KEY_ACCOUNT_TYPE, accountType);
        sessionBundle.putString("authTokenType", authTokenType);
        sessionBundle.putStringArray("requiredFeatures", requiredFeatures);
        sessionBundle.putBundle("options", options);

        Bundle result = new Bundle();
        result.putBundle(AccountManager.KEY_ACCOUNT_SESSION_BUNDLE, sessionBundle);
        return result;
    }

    public Bundle startUpdateCredentialsSession(AccountAuthenticatorResponse response, Account account, String authTokenType,
                                                Bundle options) throws NetworkErrorException
    {
        Bundle sessionBundle = new Bundle();
        sessionBundle.putString(AccountManager.KEY_ACCOUNT_NAME, account == null ? null : account.name);
        sessionBundle.putString(AccountManager.KEY_ACCOUNT_TYPE, account == null ? null : account.type);
        sessionBundle.putString("authTokenType", authTokenType);
        sessionBundle.putBundle("options", options);

        Bundle result = new Bundle();
        result.putBundle(AccountManager.KEY_ACCOUNT_SESSION_BUNDLE, sessionBundle);
        return result;
    }

    public Bundle finishSession(AccountAuthenticatorResponse response, String accountType, Bundle sessionBundle)
        throws NetworkErrorException
    {
        Bundle result = new Bundle();
        result.putInt(AccountManager.KEY_ERROR_CODE, AccountManager.ERROR_CODE_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION);
        result.putString(AccountManager.KEY_ERROR_MESSAGE, "finishSession is not supported by " + accountType);
        return result;
    }

    public Bundle isCredentialsUpdateSuggested(AccountAuthenticatorResponse response, Account account, String statusToken)
        throws NetworkErrorException
    {
        Bundle result = new Bundle();
        result.putBoolean(AccountManager.KEY_BOOLEAN_RESULT, false);
        return result;
    }
}
```

`java/android/accounts/Account.java`:

```java
package android.accounts;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public class Account implements Parcelable
{
    public final String name;
    public final String type;

    public Account(String name, String type)
    {
        if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the account name must not be empty: " + name);
        if (type == null || type.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the account type must not be empty: " + type);

        this.name = name;
        this.type = type;
    }

    public Account(Parcel source)
    {
        this.name = source.readString();
        this.type = source.readString();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (other == this) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof Account)) return false;

        Account account = (Account)other;
        return name.equals(account.name) && type.equals(account.type);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        int result = 17;
        result = 31 * result + name.hashCode();
        result = 31 * result + type.hashCode();
        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(name);
        dest.writeString(type);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Account {name=" + name + ", type=" + type + "}";
    }

    public static final Creator<Account> CREATOR = new Creator<Account>()
    {
        @Override
        public Account createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new Account(source);
        }

        @Override
        public Account[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Account[size];
        }
    };
}
```

```java
    public AccountManagerFuture<Bundle> editProperties(String accountType, Activity activity, AccountManagerCallback<Bundle> callback,
                                                       Handler handler)
    {
        if (accountType == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("accountType is null");

        return fail(noAuthenticator(accountType), callback, handler);
    }

    public AccountManagerFuture<Bundle> getAuthTokenByFeatures(String accountType, String authTokenType, String[] features,
                                                               Activity activity, Bundle addAccountOptions, Bundle getAuthTokenOptions,
                                                               AccountManagerCallback<Bundle> callback, Handler handler)
    {
        if (accountType == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("account type is null");
        if (authTokenType == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("authTokenType is null");

        return fail(noAuthenticator(accountType), callback, handler);
    }

    public static Intent newChooseAccountIntent(Account selectedAccount, ArrayList<Account> allowableAccounts,
                                                String[] allowableAccountTypes, boolean alwaysPromptForAccount,
                                                String descriptionOverrideText, String addAccountAuthTokenType,
                                                String[] addAccountRequiredFeatures, Bundle addAccountOptions)
    {
        return newChooseAccountIntent(selectedAccount, (List<Account>)allowableAccounts, allowableAccountTypes, descriptionOverrideText,
                                      addAccountAuthTokenType, addAccountRequiredFeatures, addAccountOptions);
    }

    public static Intent newChooseAccountIntent(Account selectedAccount, List<Account> allowableAccounts, String[] allowableAccountTypes,
                                                String descriptionOverrideText, String addAccountAuthTokenType,
                                                String[] addAccountRequiredFeatures, Bundle addAccountOptions)
    {
        Bundle extras = new Bundle();
        extras.putParcelableArrayList("allowableAccounts", allowableAccounts == null ? null : new ArrayList<>(allowableAccounts));
        extras.putStringArray("allowableAccountTypes", allowableAccountTypes);
        extras.putBundle("addAccountOptions", addAccountOptions);
        extras.putParcelable("selectedAccount", selectedAccount);
        extras.putString("descriptionTextOverride", descriptionOverrideText);
        extras.putString("authTokenType", addAccountAuthTokenType);
        extras.putStringArray("addAccountRequiredFeatures", addAccountRequiredFeatures);

        Intent intent = new Intent();
        intent.setClassName("android", "android.accounts.ChooseTypeAndAccountActivity");
        intent.putExtras(extras);
        return intent;
    }

    public void addOnAccountsUpdatedListener(OnAccountsUpdateListener listener, Handler handler, boolean updateImmediately)
    {
        addOnAccountsUpdatedListener(listener, handler, updateImmediately, null);
    }

    public void addOnAccountsUpdatedListener(final OnAccountsUpdateListener listener, Handler handler, boolean updateImmediately,
                                             String[] accountTypes)
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the listener is null");

        synchronized (mListeners)
        {
            if (mListeners.containsKey(listener)) throw new IllegalStateException("this listener is already added");

            mListeners.put(listener, handler);
        }

        if (!updateImmediately) return;

        post(handler, new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                listener.onAccountsUpdated(NO_ACCOUNTS);
            }
        });
    }

    public void removeOnAccountsUpdatedListener(OnAccountsUpdateListener listener)
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener is null");

        synchronized (mListeners)
        {
            if (mListeners.remove(listener) == null) Log.e(TAG, "the listener was not previously added");
        }
    }

    public AccountManagerFuture<Bundle> startAddAccountSession(String accountType, String authTokenType, String[] requiredFeatures,
                                                               Bundle options, Activity activity, AccountManagerCallback<Bundle> callback,
                                                               Handler handler)
    {
        if (accountType == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("accountType is null");

        return fail(noAuthenticator(accountType), callback, handler);
    }

    public AccountManagerFuture<Bundle> startUpdateCredentialsSession(Account account, String authTokenType, Bundle options,
                                                                      Activity activity, AccountManagerCallback<Bundle> callback,
                                                                      Handler handler)
    {
        requireAccount(account);
        return fail(noAuthenticator(account.type), callback, handler);
    }

    public AccountManagerFuture<Bundle> finishSession(Bundle sessionBundle, Activity activity, AccountManagerCallback<Bundle> callback,
                                                      Handler handler)
    {
        if (sessionBundle == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("sessionBundle is null");

        return fail(new AuthenticatorException("the account session cannot be finished without an authenticator"), callback, handler);
    }

    public AccountManagerFuture<Boolean> isCredentialsUpdateSuggested(Account account, String statusToken,
                                                                      AccountManagerCallback<Boolean> callback, Handler handler)
    {
        requireAccount(account);
        return succeed(Boolean.FALSE, callback, handler);
    }

    private static void requireAccount(Account account)
    {
        if (account == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("account is null");
    }

    private static AuthenticatorException noAuthenticator(String accountType)
    {
        return new AuthenticatorException("no authenticator is registered for the account type " + accountType);
    }

    private static void post(Handler handler, Runnable runnable)
    {
        if (handler != null)
        {
            handler.post(runnable);
            return;
        }

        Looper main = Looper.getMainLooper();
        if (main != null) new Handler(main).post(runnable);
        else runnable.run();
    }

    private static <V> AccountManagerFuture<V> succeed(V value, AccountManagerCallback<V> callback, Handler handler)
    {
        return deliver(new Outcome<>(value, null), callback, handler);
    }

    private static <V> AccountManagerFuture<V> fail(AccountsException failure, AccountManagerCallback<V> callback, Handler handler)
    {
        return deliver(new Outcome<V>(null, failure), callback, handler);
    }

    private static <V> AccountManagerFuture<V> deliver(final Outcome<V> outcome, final AccountManagerCallback<V> callback,
                                                       Handler handler)
    {
        if (callback == null) return outcome;

        post(handler, new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                callback.run(outcome);
            }
        });

        return outcome;
    }

    private static final class Outcome<V> implements AccountManagerFuture<V>
    {
        private final V mValue;
        private final AccountsException mFailure;

        Outcome(V value, AccountsException failure)
        {
            mValue = value;
            mFailure = failure;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean cancel(boolean mayInterruptIfRunning)
        {
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isCancelled()
        {
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isDone()
        {
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public V getResult() throws AuthenticatorException, java.io.IOException, OperationCanceledException
        {
            if (mFailure instanceof AuthenticatorException) throw (AuthenticatorException)mFailure;
            if (mFailure instanceof OperationCanceledException) throw (OperationCanceledException)mFailure;
            if (mFailure != null) throw new AuthenticatorException(mFailure);

            return mValue;
        }

        @Override
        public V getResult(long timeout, TimeUnit unit) throws AuthenticatorException, java.io.IOException, OperationCanceledException
        {
            return getResult();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.accounts;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public class AuthenticatorDescription implements Parcelable
{
    public final String type;
    public final int labelId;
    public final int iconId;
    public final int smallIconId;
    public final int accountPreferencesId;
    public final String packageName;
    public final boolean customTokens;

    public AuthenticatorDescription(String type, String packageName, int labelId, int iconId, int smallIconId, int prefId,
                                    boolean customTokens)
    {
        if (type == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("type cannot be null");
        if (packageName == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("packageName cannot be null");

        this.type = type;
        this.packageName = packageName;
        this.labelId = labelId;
        this.iconId = iconId;
        this.smallIconId = smallIconId;
        this.accountPreferencesId = prefId;
        this.customTokens = customTokens;
    }

    public AuthenticatorDescription(String type, String packageName, int labelId, int iconId, int smallIconId, int prefId)
    {
        this(type, packageName, labelId, iconId, smallIconId, prefId, false);
    }

    private AuthenticatorDescription(String type)
    {
        this.type = type;
        this.packageName = null;
        this.labelId = 0;
        this.iconId = 0;
        this.smallIconId = 0;
        this.accountPreferencesId = 0;
        this.customTokens = false;
    }

    private AuthenticatorDescription(Parcel source)
    {
        this.type = source.readString();
        this.packageName = source.readString();
        this.labelId = source.readInt();
        this.iconId = source.readInt();
        this.smallIconId = source.readInt();
        this.accountPreferencesId = source.readInt();
        this.customTokens = source.readInt() == 1;
    }

    public static AuthenticatorDescription newKey(String type)
    {
        if (type == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("type cannot be null");

        return new AuthenticatorDescription(type);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return type.hashCode();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (other == this) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof AuthenticatorDescription)) return false;

        return type.equals(((AuthenticatorDescription)other).type);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "AuthenticatorDescription {type=" + type + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(type);
        dest.writeString(packageName);
        dest.writeInt(labelId);
        dest.writeInt(iconId);
        dest.writeInt(smallIconId);
        dest.writeInt(accountPreferencesId);
        dest.writeInt(customTokens ? 1 : 0);
    }

    public static final Creator<AuthenticatorDescription> CREATOR = new Creator<AuthenticatorDescription>()
    {
        @Override
        public AuthenticatorDescription createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new AuthenticatorDescription(source);
        }

        @Override

            return new AuthenticatorDescription[size];
        }
```

```java
package android.animation;

import java.util.ArrayList;

public abstract class Animator implements Cloneable
{
    public static final long DURATION_INFINITE = -1;

    private ArrayList<AnimatorListener> mListeners = new ArrayList<>();
    private ArrayList<AnimatorPauseListener> mPauseListeners = new ArrayList<>();
    private boolean mPaused;
    private int mChangingConfigurations;

    public void start()
    {
    }

    public void cancel()
    {
    }

    public void end()
    {
    }

    public abstract boolean isRunning();

    public boolean isStarted()
    {
        return isRunning();
    }

    public abstract Animator setDuration(long duration);

    public abstract long getDuration();

    public abstract void setStartDelay(long delay);

    public abstract long getStartDelay();

    public abstract void setInterpolator(TimeInterpolator interpolator);

    public TimeInterpolator getInterpolator()
    {
        return null;
    }

    public long getTotalDuration()
    {
        long duration = getDuration();
        if (duration == DURATION_INFINITE) return DURATION_INFINITE;

        return getStartDelay() + duration;
    }

    public void addListener(AnimatorListener listener)
    {
        if (listener != null) mListeners.add(listener);
    }

    public void removeListener(AnimatorListener listener)
    {
        mListeners.remove(listener);
    }

    public ArrayList<AnimatorListener> getListeners()
    {
        return mListeners;
    }

    public void addPauseListener(AnimatorPauseListener listener)
    {
        if (listener != null) mPauseListeners.add(listener);
    }

    public void removePauseListener(AnimatorPauseListener listener)
    {
        mPauseListeners.remove(listener);
    }

    public void removeAllListeners()
    {
        mListeners.clear();
        mPauseListeners.clear();
    }

    public void setTarget(Object target)
    {
    }

    public void setupStartValues()
    {
    }

    public void setupEndValues()
    {
    }

    public boolean isPaused()
    {
        return mPaused;
    }

    public void pause()
    {
        if (!isStarted() || mPaused) return;

        mPaused = true;
        notifyPause();
    }

    public void resume()
    {
        if (!mPaused) return;

        mPaused = false;
        notifyResume();
    }

    boolean isPausedInternal()
    {
        return mPaused;
    }

    void clearPaused()
    {
        mPaused = false;
    }

    public int getChangingConfigurations()
    {
        return mChangingConfigurations;
    }

    public void setChangingConfigurations(int configs)
    {
        mChangingConfigurations = configs;
    }

    public void appendChangingConfigurations(int configs)
    {
        mChangingConfigurations |= configs;
    }

    public boolean canReverse()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void reverse()
    {
        throw new IllegalStateException("Reverse is not supported");
    }

    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public Animator clone()
    {
        try
        {
            Animator copy = (Animator)super.clone();
            copy.mListeners = (ArrayList<AnimatorListener>)mListeners.clone();
            copy.mPauseListeners = (ArrayList<AnimatorPauseListener>)mPauseListeners.clone();
            copy.mPaused = false;

            return copy;
        }
        catch (CloneNotSupportedException failure)
        {
            throw new AssertionError(failure);
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private ArrayList<AnimatorListener> listenerSnapshot()
    {
        return mListeners.isEmpty() ? null : (ArrayList<AnimatorListener>)mListeners.clone();
    }

    protected void notifyStart()
    {
        notifyStart(false);
    }

    void notifyStart(boolean isReverse)
    {
        ArrayList<AnimatorListener> listeners = listenerSnapshot();
        if (listeners == null) return;

        for (int index = 0; index < listeners.size(); index++) listeners.get(index).onAnimationStart(this, isReverse);
    }

    protected void notifyEnd()
    {
        notifyEnd(false);
    }

    void notifyEnd(boolean isReverse)
    {
        ArrayList<AnimatorListener> listeners = listenerSnapshot();
        if (listeners == null) return;

        for (int index = 0; index < listeners.size(); index++) listeners.get(index).onAnimationEnd(this, isReverse);
    }

    protected void notifyCancel()
    {
        ArrayList<AnimatorListener> listeners = listenerSnapshot();
        if (listeners == null) return;

        for (int index = 0; index < listeners.size(); index++) listeners.get(index).onAnimationCancel(this);
    }

    protected void notifyRepeat()
    {
        ArrayList<AnimatorListener> listeners = listenerSnapshot();
        if (listeners == null) return;

        for (int index = 0; index < listeners.size(); index++) listeners.get(index).onAnimationRepeat(this);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    void notifyPause()
    {
        if (mPauseListeners.isEmpty()) return;

        ArrayList<AnimatorPauseListener> listeners = (ArrayList<AnimatorPauseListener>)mPauseListeners.clone();
        for (int index = 0; index < listeners.size(); index++) listeners.get(index).onAnimationPause(this);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    void notifyResume()
    {
        if (mPauseListeners.isEmpty()) return;

        ArrayList<AnimatorPauseListener> listeners = (ArrayList<AnimatorPauseListener>)mPauseListeners.clone();
        for (int index = 0; index < listeners.size(); index++) listeners.get(index).onAnimationResume(this);
    }

    public interface AnimatorListener
    {
        default void onAnimationStart(Animator animation, boolean isReverse)
        {
            onAnimationStart(animation);
        }

        default void onAnimationEnd(Animator animation, boolean isReverse)
        {
            onAnimationEnd(animation);
        }

        void onAnimationStart(Animator animation);

        void onAnimationEnd(Animator animation);

        void onAnimationCancel(Animator animation);

        void onAnimationRepeat(Animator animation);
    }

    public interface AnimatorPauseListener
    {
        void onAnimationPause(Animator animation);

        void onAnimationResume(Animator animation);
    }
}
```

`java/android/animation/AnimatorInflater.java`:

```java
package android.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.content.res.XmlBlock;
import android.content.res.XmlResourceParser;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.util.Log;
import android.util.PathParser;
import android.util.TypedValue;
import android.util.Xml;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;
import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public class AnimatorInflater
{
    private static final String TAG = "AnimatorInflater";
    private static final String ANDROID_NAMESPACE = "http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android";

    private static final int TOGETHER = 0;
    private static final int SEQUENTIALLY = 1;

    private static final int VALUE_TYPE_FLOAT = 0;
    private static final int VALUE_TYPE_INT = 1;
    private static final int VALUE_TYPE_PATH = 2;
    private static final int VALUE_TYPE_COLOR = 3;
    private static final int VALUE_TYPE_UNDEFINED = 4;

    public AnimatorInflater()
    {
    }

    public static Animator loadAnimator(Context context, int id) throws Resources.NotFoundException
    {
        if (context == null) return null;

        return loadAnimator(context.getResources(), context.getTheme(), id);
    }

    public static Animator loadAnimator(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme, int id) throws Resources.NotFoundException
    {
        if (resources == null) return null;

        XmlResourceParser parser = null;

        try
        {
            parser = resources.getAnimation(id);
            if (parser == null) return null;

            return createAnimatorFromXml(resources, theme, parser);
        }
        catch (XmlPullParserException | IOException | RuntimeException failure)
        {
            if (failure instanceof Resources.NotFoundException) throw (Resources.NotFoundException)failure;

            Resources.NotFoundException wrapped = new Resources.NotFoundException("Can't load animation resource ID #0x" + Integer.toHexString(id));
            wrapped.initCause(failure);
            throw wrapped;
        }
        finally
        {
            if (parser != null) parser.close();
        }
    }

    public static StateListAnimator loadStateListAnimator(Context context, int id) throws Resources.NotFoundException
    {
        Resources resources = context.getResources();
        XmlResourceParser parser = null;

        try
        {
            parser = resources.getAnimation(id);
            if (parser == null) return null;

            return createStateListAnimatorFromXml(context, resources, context.getTheme(), parser);
        }
        catch (XmlPullParserException | IOException | RuntimeException failure)
        {
            if (failure instanceof Resources.NotFoundException) throw (Resources.NotFoundException)failure;

            Resources.NotFoundException wrapped = new Resources.NotFoundException("Can't load state list animator resource ID #0x" +
                                                                                  Integer.toHexString(id));
            wrapped.initCause(failure);
            throw wrapped;
        }
        finally
        {
            if (parser != null) parser.close();
        }
    }

    private static boolean advanceToStart(XmlPullParser parser) throws XmlPullParserException, IOException
    {
        int event = parser.getEventType();

        while (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG && event != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT) event = parser.next();

        return event == XmlPullParser.START_TAG;
    }

    private static StateListAnimator createStateListAnimatorFromXml(Context context, Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme,
                                                                    XmlPullParser parser) throws XmlPullParserException, IOException
    {
        StateListAnimator stateListAnimator = new StateListAnimator();

        if (!advanceToStart(parser)) return stateListAnimator;

        int depth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= depth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            if (!"item".equals(parser.getName()))
            {
                skipElement(parser);
                continue;
            }

            AttributeSet attributes = Xml.asAttributeSet(parser);
            int[] states = readStateSet(attributes);
            int animatorId = attributes.getAttributeResourceValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "animator", 0);
            Animator animator = null;

            if (animatorId != 0)
            {
                animator = loadAnimator(resources, theme, animatorId);
                skipElement(parser);
            }
            else
            {
                int itemDepth = parser.getDepth();

                while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
                {
                    if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= itemDepth) break;
                    if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

                    Animator child = parseElement(resources, theme, parser);
                    if (animator == null) animator = child;
                }
            }

            if (animator == null) throw new Resources.NotFoundException("animation state item must have a valid animation");

            stateListAnimator.addState(states, animator);
        }

        return stateListAnimator;
    }

    private static int[] readStateSet(AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        ArrayList<Integer> collected = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int index = 0; index < attributes.getAttributeCount(); index++)
        {
            int name = attributes.getAttributeNameResource(index);
            if (name == 0) continue;

            if (attributes instanceof XmlBlock.Parser)
            {
                int[] packed = ((XmlBlock.Parser)attributes).getAttributeTypedValue(index);
                if (packed == null || packed[0] != TypedValue.TYPE_INT_BOOLEAN) continue;
            }
            else
            {
                String value = attributes.getAttributeValue(index);
                if (!"true".equals(value) && !"false".equals(value)) continue;
            }

            collected.add(attributes.getAttributeBooleanValue(index, false) ? name : -name);
        }

        int[] states = new int[collected.size()];
        for (int index = 0; index < states.length; index++) states[index] = collected.get(index);

        return states;
    }

    private static Animator createAnimatorFromXml(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme, XmlPullParser parser)
        throws XmlPullParserException, IOException
    {
        if (!advanceToStart(parser)) return null;

        return parseElement(resources, theme, parser);
    }

    private static void skipElement(XmlPullParser parser) throws XmlPullParserException, IOException
    {
        int depth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= depth) return;
        }
    }

    private static Animator parseElement(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme, XmlPullParser parser)
        throws XmlPullParserException, IOException
    {
        String name = parser.getName();
        AttributeSet attributes = Xml.asAttributeSet(parser);

        if ("set".equals(name)) return parseSet(resources, theme, parser, attributes);

        if ("objectAnimator".equals(name) || "animator".equals(name))
        {
            return parseValueAnimator(resources, theme, parser, attributes, "objectAnimator".equals(name));
        }

        Log.w(TAG, "Unknown animator name: " + name);
        skipElement(parser);

        return null;
    }

    private static AnimatorSet parseSet(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes)
        throws XmlPullParserException, IOException
    {
        AnimatorSet set = new AnimatorSet();
        int ordering = integer(attributes, "ordering", TOGETHER);
        ArrayList<Animator> children = new ArrayList<>();

        int depth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= depth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            Animator child = parseElement(resources, theme, parser);
            if (child != null) children.add(child);
        }

        if (!children.isEmpty())
        {
            Animator[] array = children.toArray(new Animator[0]);

            if (ordering == TOGETHER) set.playTogether(array);
            else set.playSequentially(array);
        }

        return set;
    }

    private static ValueAnimator parseValueAnimator(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme, XmlPullParser parser,
                                                    AttributeSet attributes, boolean isObjectAnimator)
        throws XmlPullParserException, IOException
    {
        ValueAnimator animator = isObjectAnimator ? new ObjectAnimator() : new ValueAnimator();

        animator.setDuration(Math.max(0, integer(attributes, "duration", 300)));
        animator.setStartDelay(Math.max(0, integer(attributes, "startOffset", 0)));
        animator.setRepeatCount(integer(attributes, "repeatCount", 0));
        animator.setRepeatMode(integer(attributes, "repeatMode", ValueAnimator.RESTART));

        TimeInterpolator interpolator = interpolator(resources, theme, attributes);
        if (interpolator != null) animator.setInterpolator(interpolator);

        int valueType = integer(attributes, "valueType", VALUE_TYPE_UNDEFINED);
        String propertyName = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "propertyName");

        if (isObjectAnimator)
        {
            ObjectAnimator objectAnimator = (ObjectAnimator)animator;
            String pathData = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "pathData");

            if (pathData != null)
            {
                String xName = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "propertyXName");
                String yName = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "propertyYName");

                if (valueType == VALUE_TYPE_PATH || valueType == VALUE_TYPE_UNDEFINED) valueType = VALUE_TYPE_FLOAT;

                if (xName == null && yName == null)
                {
                    throw new XmlPullParserException(attributes.getPositionDescription() +
                                                     " propertyXName or propertyYName is needed for PathData");
                }

                Path path = PathParser.createPathFromPathData(pathData);
                float error = 0.5f * resources.getDisplayMetrics().density;
                PathKeyframes keyframes = KeyframeSet.ofPath(path, error);
                ArrayList<PropertyValuesHolder> holders = new ArrayList<>();

                if (xName != null)
                {
                    holders.add(valueType == VALUE_TYPE_FLOAT ? PropertyValuesHolder.ofXFloat(xName, null, keyframes, true)
                                                               : PropertyValuesHolder.ofXInt(xName, null, keyframes, true));
                }

                if (yName != null)
                {
                    holders.add(valueType == VALUE_TYPE_FLOAT ? PropertyValuesHolder.ofXFloat(yName, null, keyframes, false)
                                                               : PropertyValuesHolder.ofXInt(yName, null, keyframes, false));
                }

                objectAnimator.setValues(holders.toArray(new PropertyValuesHolder[0]));
            }
            else
            {
                PropertyValuesHolder holder = valuesHolder(resources, theme, attributes, valueType, propertyName);
                if (holder != null) objectAnimator.setValues(holder);

                objectAnimator.setPropertyName(propertyName);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            PropertyValuesHolder holder = valuesHolder(resources, theme, attributes, valueType, "");
            if (holder != null) animator.setValues(holder);
        }

        ArrayList<PropertyValuesHolder> children = new ArrayList<>();
        int depth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= depth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            if (!"propertyValuesHolder".equals(parser.getName()))
            {
                skipElement(parser);
                continue;
            }

            PropertyValuesHolder holder = parsePropertyValuesHolder(resources, theme, parser);
            if (holder != null) children.add(holder);
        }

        if (!children.isEmpty()) animator.setValues(children.toArray(new PropertyValuesHolder[0]));

        return animator;
    }

    private static PropertyValuesHolder parsePropertyValuesHolder(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme, XmlPullParser parser)
        throws XmlPullParserException, IOException
    {
        AttributeSet attributes = Xml.asAttributeSet(parser);
        String propertyName = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "propertyName");
        int valueType = integer(attributes, "valueType", VALUE_TYPE_UNDEFINED);

        ArrayList<Keyframe> keyframes = new ArrayList<>();
        int depth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= depth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            if (!"keyframe".equals(parser.getName()))
            {
                skipElement(parser);
                continue;
            }

            AttributeSet keyframeAttributes = Xml.asAttributeSet(parser);

            if (valueType == VALUE_TYPE_UNDEFINED)
            {
                TypedValue value = typedValue(resources, theme, keyframeAttributes, "value");
                valueType = value != null && isColorType(value.type) ? VALUE_TYPE_COLOR : VALUE_TYPE_FLOAT;
            }

            Keyframe keyframe = parseKeyframe(resources, theme, keyframeAttributes, valueType);
            if (keyframe != null) keyframes.add(keyframe);

            skipElement(parser);
        }

        if (keyframes.isEmpty()) return valuesHolder(resources, theme, attributes, valueType, propertyName);

        int count = keyframes.size();
        Keyframe firstKeyframe = keyframes.get(0);
        Keyframe lastKeyframe = keyframes.get(count - 1);

        float endFraction = lastKeyframe.getFraction();

        if (endFraction < 1)
        {
            if (endFraction < 0)
            {
                lastKeyframe.setFraction(1);
            }
            else
            {
                keyframes.add(createNewKeyframe(lastKeyframe, 1));
                count++;
            }
        }

        float startFraction = firstKeyframe.getFraction();

        if (startFraction != 0)
        {
            if (startFraction < 0)
            {
                firstKeyframe.setFraction(0);
            }
            else
            {
                keyframes.add(0, createNewKeyframe(firstKeyframe, 0));
                count++;
            }
        }

        Keyframe[] array = keyframes.toArray(new Keyframe[0]);

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            Keyframe keyframe = array[index];
            if (keyframe.getFraction() >= 0) continue;

            if (index == 0)
            {
                keyframe.setFraction(0);
            }
            else if (index == count - 1)
            {
                keyframe.setFraction(1);
            }
            else
            {
                int startIndex = index;
                int endIndex = index;

                for (int inner = startIndex + 1; inner < count - 1; inner++)
                {
                    if (array[inner].getFraction() >= 0) break;
                    endIndex = inner;
                }

                float gap = array[endIndex + 1].getFraction() - array[startIndex - 1].getFraction();
                distributeKeyframes(array, gap, startIndex, endIndex);
            }
        }

        PropertyValuesHolder holder = PropertyValuesHolder.ofKeyframe(propertyName, array);
        if (valueType == VALUE_TYPE_COLOR) holder.setEvaluator(ArgbEvaluator.getInstance());

        return holder;
    }

    private static Keyframe createNewKeyframe(Keyframe sample, float fraction)
    {
        if (sample.getType() == float.class) return Keyframe.ofFloat(fraction);
        if (sample.getType() == int.class) return Keyframe.ofInt(fraction);

        return Keyframe.ofObject(fraction);
    }

    private static void distributeKeyframes(Keyframe[] keyframes, float gap, int startIndex, int endIndex)
    {
        int count = endIndex - startIndex + 2;
        float increment = gap / count;

        for (int index = startIndex; index <= endIndex; index++) keyframes[index].setFraction(keyframes[index - 1].getFraction() + increment);
    }

    private static Keyframe parseKeyframe(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme, AttributeSet attributes, int valueType)
    {
        float fraction = floatAttribute(resources, theme, attributes, "fraction", -1);
        TypedValue value = typedValue(resources, theme, attributes, "value");
        boolean hasValue = value != null;

        Keyframe keyframe;

        if (valueType == VALUE_TYPE_INT || valueType == VALUE_TYPE_COLOR)
        {
            keyframe = hasValue ? Keyframe.ofInt(fraction, intValue(resources, value, valueType == VALUE_TYPE_COLOR)) : Keyframe.ofInt(fraction);
        }
        else
        {
            keyframe = hasValue ? Keyframe.ofFloat(fraction, floatValue(resources, value)) : Keyframe.ofFloat(fraction);
        }

        TimeInterpolator interpolator = interpolator(resources, theme, attributes);
        if (interpolator != null) keyframe.setInterpolator(interpolator);

        return keyframe;
    }

    private static PropertyValuesHolder valuesHolder(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme, AttributeSet attributes, int valueType,
                                                     String propertyName)
    {
        TypedValue from = typedValue(resources, theme, attributes, "valueFrom");
        TypedValue to = typedValue(resources, theme, attributes, "valueTo");

        boolean hasFrom = from != null && from.type != TypedValue.TYPE_NULL;
        boolean hasTo = to != null && to.type != TypedValue.TYPE_NULL;

        if (!hasFrom && !hasTo) return null;

        if (valueType == VALUE_TYPE_UNDEFINED)
        {
            if ((hasFrom && isColorType(from.type)) || (hasTo && isColorType(to.type))) valueType = VALUE_TYPE_COLOR;
            else valueType = VALUE_TYPE_FLOAT;
        }

        if (valueType == VALUE_TYPE_PATH)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "path morphing for " + propertyName + " is not supported; the animator will not change the path");
            return null;
        }

        PropertyValuesHolder holder;

        if (valueType == VALUE_TYPE_FLOAT)
        {
            if (hasFrom && hasTo) holder = PropertyValuesHolder.ofFloat(propertyName, floatValue(resources, from), floatValue(resources, to));
            else if (hasFrom) holder = PropertyValuesHolder.ofFloat(propertyName, floatValue(resources, from));
            else holder = PropertyValuesHolder.ofFloat(propertyName, floatValue(resources, to));

            return holder;
        }

        boolean color = valueType == VALUE_TYPE_COLOR;

        if (hasFrom && hasTo)
        {
            holder = PropertyValuesHolder.ofInt(propertyName, intValue(resources, from, color), intValue(resources, to, color));
        }
        else if (hasFrom)
        {
            holder = PropertyValuesHolder.ofInt(propertyName, intValue(resources, from, color));
        }
        else
        {
            holder = PropertyValuesHolder.ofInt(propertyName, intValue(resources, to, color));
        }

        if (color) holder.setEvaluator(ArgbEvaluator.getInstance());

        return holder;
    }

    private static boolean isColorType(int type)
    {
        return type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_COLOR_INT && type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_COLOR_INT;
    }

    private static float floatValue(Resources resources, TypedValue value)
    {
        switch (value.type)
        {
            case TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT:
                return Float.intBitsToFloat(value.data);

            case TypedValue.TYPE_DIMENSION:
                return TypedValue.complexToDimension(value.data, resources.getDisplayMetrics());

            case TypedValue.TYPE_FRACTION:
                return TypedValue.complexToFraction(value.data, 1, 1);

            case TypedValue.TYPE_STRING:
                return parseNumber(value.string == null ? null : value.string.toString(), 0);

            default:
                return value.data;
        }
    }

    private static int intValue(Resources resources, TypedValue value, boolean color)
    {
        if (color && isColorType(value.type)) return value.data;

        switch (value.type)
        {
            case TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT:
            case TypedValue.TYPE_DIMENSION:
            case TypedValue.TYPE_FRACTION:
            case TypedValue.TYPE_STRING:
                return (int)floatValue(resources, value);

            default:
                return value.data;
        }
    }

    private static float floatAttribute(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme, AttributeSet attributes, String name, float fallback)
    {
        TypedValue value = typedValue(resources, theme, attributes, name);

        return value == null ? fallback : floatValue(resources, value);
    }

    private static int integer(AttributeSet attributes, String name, int fallback)
    {
        if (attributes instanceof XmlBlock.Parser)
        {
            int[] packed = ((XmlBlock.Parser)attributes).getAttributeTypedValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);

            if (packed != null && packed[0] >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && packed[0] <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return packed[1];
            if (packed != null && packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT) return (int)Float.intBitsToFloat(packed[1]);
        }

        String text = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
        if (text == null) return fallback;

        switch (text)
        {
            case "infinite": return ValueAnimator.INFINITE;
            case "restart": return ValueAnimator.RESTART;
            case "reverse": return ValueAnimator.REVERSE;
            case "together": return TOGETHER;
            case "sequentially": return SEQUENTIALLY;
            case "floatType": return VALUE_TYPE_FLOAT;
            case "intType": return VALUE_TYPE_INT;
            case "pathType": return VALUE_TYPE_PATH;
            case "colorType": return VALUE_TYPE_COLOR;
            default: break;
        }

        try
        {
            return Integer.decode(text);
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException failure)
        {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    private static TimeInterpolator interpolator(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        int id = attributes.getAttributeResourceValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "interpolator", 0);
        if (id == 0) return null;

        try
        {
            return android.view.animation.AnimationUtils.loadInterpolator(resources, theme, id);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException failure)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "could not load interpolator 0x" + Integer.toHexString(id) + ": " + failure);
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static TypedValue typedValue(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme, AttributeSet attributes, String name)
    {
        TypedValue value = new TypedValue();

        if (attributes instanceof XmlBlock.Parser)
        {
            int[] packed = ((XmlBlock.Parser)attributes).getAttributeTypedValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
            if (packed == null) return null;

            value.type = packed[0];
            value.data = packed[1];

            if (value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING) value.string = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);

            if (value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_ATTRIBUTE && theme != null)
            {
                TypedValue resolved = new TypedValue();
                if (!theme.resolveAttribute(value.data, resolved, true)) return null;

                return resolved;
            }

            if (value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_REFERENCE)
            {
                if (value.data == 0) return null;

                try
                {
                    TypedValue resolved = new TypedValue();
                    resources.getValue(value.data, resolved, true);

                    return resolved;
                }
                catch (Resources.NotFoundException failure)
                {
                    return null;
                }
            }

            return value;
        }

        String text = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
        if (text == null) return null;

        if (text.startsWith("#"))
        {
            value.type = TypedValue.TYPE_INT_COLOR_ARGB8;
            value.data = parseColor(text);
        }
        else if (text.indexOf('.') >= 0 || !Character.isDigit(text.charAt(text.length() - 1)))
        {
            value.type = TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT;
            value.data = Float.floatToIntBits(parseNumber(text, 0));
        }
        else
        {
            value.type = TypedValue.TYPE_INT_DEC;
            value.data = (int)parseNumber(text, 0);
        }

        return value;
    }

    private static int parseColor(String text)
    {
        String digits = text.substring(1);

        try
        {
            if (digits.length() == 6) return 0xFF000000 | (int)Long.parseLong(digits, 16);
            if (digits.length() == 8) return (int)Long.parseLong(digits, 16);

            if (digits.length() == 3 || digits.length() == 4)
            {
                int value = 0;

                for (int index = 0; index < digits.length(); index++)
                {
                    int nibble = Character.digit(digits.charAt(index), 16);
                    value = (value << 8) | (nibble << 4) | nibble;
                }

                return digits.length() == 3 ? 0xFF000000 | value : value;
            }
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException failure)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        return 0;
    }

    private static float parseNumber(String text, float fallback)
    {
        if (text == null) return fallback;

        int end = text.length();

        while (end > 0)
        {
            char character = text.charAt(end - 1);
            if ((character >= '0' && character <= '9') || character == '.') break;
            end--;
        }

        if (end == 0) return fallback;

        try
        {
            return Float.parseFloat(text.substring(0, end));
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException failure)
        {
            return fallback;
        }
    }
}
```
