`java/android/animation/AnimatorSet.java`:

```java
package android.animation;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;

public final class AnimatorSet extends Animator
{
    private static final int RULE_WITH = 0;
    private static final int RULE_AFTER = 1;

    private ArrayList<Node> mNodes = new ArrayList<>();
    private HashMap<Animator, Node> mNodeMap = new HashMap<>();

    private long mDuration = -1;
    private long mStartDelay;
    private TimeInterpolator mInterpolator;

    private boolean mStarted;
    private boolean mTerminated;
    private boolean mReversing;
    private long mStartedAtNanos = -1;
    private long mSeekPlayTime = -1;
    private ValueAnimator mDelayAnimator;
    private ChildListener mChildListener = new ChildListener();

    public AnimatorSet()
    {
    }

    public void playTogether(Animator... items)
    {
        if (items == null || items.length == 0) return;

        Builder builder = play(items[0]);
        for (int index = 1; index < items.length; index++) builder.with(items[index]);
    }

    public void playTogether(Collection<Animator> items)
    {
        if (items == null || items.isEmpty()) return;

        Builder builder = null;

        for (Animator animator : items)
        {
            if (builder == null) builder = play(animator);
            else builder.with(animator);
        }
    }

    public void playSequentially(Animator... items)
    {
        if (items == null || items.length == 0) return;

        if (items.length == 1)
        {
            play(items[0]);
            return;
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < items.length - 1; index++) play(items[index]).before(items[index + 1]);
    }

    public void playSequentially(List<Animator> items)
    {
        if (items == null || items.isEmpty()) return;

        if (items.size() == 1)
        {
            play(items.get(0));
            return;
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < items.size() - 1; index++) play(items.get(index)).before(items.get(index + 1));
    }

    public ArrayList<Animator> getChildAnimations()
    {
        ArrayList<Animator> children = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int index = 0; index < mNodes.size(); index++)
        {
            Node node = mNodes.get(index);
            if (!node.mInternal) children.add(node.mAnimation);
        }

        return children;
    }

    @Override
    public void setTarget(Object target)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mNodes.size(); index++)
        {
            Animator animation = mNodes.get(index).mAnimation;

            if (animation instanceof AnimatorSet) animation.setTarget(target);
            else if (animation instanceof ObjectAnimator) animation.setTarget(target);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int getChangingConfigurations()
    {
        int configurations = super.getChangingConfigurations();

        for (int index = 0; index < mNodes.size(); index++) configurations |= mNodes.get(index).mAnimation.getChangingConfigurations();

        return configurations;
    }

    @Override
    public void setInterpolator(TimeInterpolator interpolator)
    {
        mInterpolator = interpolator;
    }

    @Override
    public TimeInterpolator getInterpolator()
    {
        return mInterpolator;
    }

    public Builder play(Animator animation)
    {
        if (animation == null) return null;

        return new Builder(animation);
    }

    private Node getNodeForAnimation(Animator animation)
    {
        Node node = mNodeMap.get(animation);

        if (node == null)
        {
            node = new Node(animation);
            mNodeMap.put(animation, node);
            mNodes.add(node);
        }

        return node;
    }

    @Override
    public void cancel()
    {
        if (!isStarted()) return;

        mTerminated = true;

        if (mDelayAnimator != null) mDelayAnimator.cancel();

        ArrayList<Node> nodes = new ArrayList<>(mNodes);

        for (int index = 0; index < nodes.size(); index++)
        {
            Node node = nodes.get(index);
            if (node.mStarted && !node.mEnded) node.mAnimation.cancel();
        }

        notifyCancel();
        finish();
    }

    @Override
    public void end()
    {
        if (!isStarted()) return;

        mTerminated = true;

        if (mDelayAnimator != null) mDelayAnimator.cancel();

        ArrayList<Node> ordered = sortedNodes(mReversing);

        for (int index = 0; index < ordered.size(); index++)
        {
            Node node = ordered.get(index);
            if (node.mEnded) continue;

            if (!node.mStarted)
            {
                node.mStarted = true;
                prepare(node);
                node.mAnimation.start();
            }

            node.mAnimation.end();
            node.mEnded = true;
        }

        finish();
    }

    private void finish()
    {
        boolean reversing = mReversing;

        for (int index = 0; index < mNodes.size(); index++) mNodes.get(index).mAnimation.removeListener(mChildListener);

        mStarted = false;
        mStartedAtNanos = -1;
        mReversing = false;
        clearPaused();

        notifyEnd(reversing);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isRunning()
    {
        return mStarted && mDelayAnimator == null;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isStarted()
    {
        return mStarted;
    }

    @Override
    public long getStartDelay()
    {
        return mStartDelay;
    }

    @Override
    public void setStartDelay(long startDelay)
    {
        if (startDelay < 0) startDelay = 0;

        mStartDelay = startDelay;
    }

    @Override
    public long getDuration()
    {
        return mDuration;
    }

    @Override
    public AnimatorSet setDuration(long duration)
    {
        if (duration < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be a value of zero or greater");

        mDuration = duration;
        return this;
    }

    @Override
    public void setupStartValues()
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mNodes.size(); index++) mNodes.get(index).mAnimation.setupStartValues();
    }

    @Override
    public void setupEndValues()
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mNodes.size(); index++) mNodes.get(index).mAnimation.setupEndValues();
    }

    @Override
    public void pause()
    {
        boolean previouslyPaused = isPaused();
        super.pause();

        if (previouslyPaused || !isPaused()) return;

        if (mDelayAnimator != null) mDelayAnimator.pause();

        for (int index = 0; index < mNodes.size(); index++)
        {
            Node node = mNodes.get(index);
            if (node.mStarted && !node.mEnded) node.mAnimation.pause();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void resume()
    {
        boolean previouslyPaused = isPaused();
        super.resume();

        if (!previouslyPaused || isPaused()) return;

        if (mDelayAnimator != null) mDelayAnimator.resume();

        for (int index = 0; index < mNodes.size(); index++)
        {
            Node node = mNodes.get(index);
            if (node.mStarted && !node.mEnded) node.mAnimation.resume();
        }
    }

    public void setCurrentPlayTime(long playTime)
    {
        if (mReversing && getTotalDuration() == DURATION_INFINITE)
        {
            throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Error: Cannot seek in reverse in an infinite AnimatorSet");
        }

        if ((getTotalDuration() != DURATION_INFINITE && playTime > getTotalDuration() - mStartDelay) || playTime < 0)
        {
            throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Error: Play time should always be in between 0 and duration.");
        }

        HashMap<Node, Long> startTimes = computeStartTimes();
        ArrayList<Node> ordered = sortedNodes(false);

        for (int index = 0; index < ordered.size(); index++)
        {
            Node node = ordered.get(index);
            Animator animation = node.mAnimation;
            prepare(node);

            Long start = startTimes.get(node);
            long local = start == null || start == DURATION_INFINITE ? -1 : playTime - start;

            long childDuration = animation.getTotalDuration() == DURATION_INFINITE ? Long.MAX_VALUE
                                                                                    : animation.getTotalDuration() - animation.getStartDelay();
            long clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(local - animation.getStartDelay(), childDuration));

            if (animation instanceof ValueAnimator) ((ValueAnimator)animation).setCurrentPlayTime(clamped);
            else if (animation instanceof AnimatorSet && local >= 0) ((AnimatorSet)animation).setCurrentPlayTime(clamped);
        }

        mSeekPlayTime = playTime;
    }

    public long getCurrentPlayTime()
    {
        if (mStarted && mStartedAtNanos >= 0)
        {
            long elapsed = (System.nanoTime() - mStartedAtNanos) / 1000000L;
            float scale = ValueAnimator.getDurationScale();
            if (scale > 0) elapsed = (long)(elapsed / scale);

            return Math.max(0, elapsed - mStartDelay);
        }

        return mSeekPlayTime < 0 ? 0 : mSeekPlayTime;
    }

    @Override
    public void start()
    {
        start(false);
    }

    private void start(boolean inReverse)
    {
        if (mStarted) return;

        mStarted = true;
        mTerminated = false;
        mReversing = inReverse;
        mStartedAtNanos = System.nanoTime();
        mSeekPlayTime = -1;
        clearPaused();

        for (int index = 0; index < mNodes.size(); index++)
        {
            Node node = mNodes.get(index);
            node.mStarted = false;
            node.mEnded = false;
            prepare(node);
        }

        notifyStart(inReverse);

        if (mStartDelay > 0 && !inReverse)
        {
            mDelayAnimator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0.0f, 1.0f);
            mDelayAnimator.setDuration(mStartDelay);
            mDelayAnimator.setInterpolator(null);
            mDelayAnimator.addListener(new AnimatorListenerAdapter()
            {
                @Override
                public void onAnimationEnd(Animator animation)
                {
                    if (mDelayAnimator != animation) return;

                    mDelayAnimator = null;
                    if (!mTerminated && mStarted) startReadyNodes();
                }
            });
            mDelayAnimator.start();
            return;
        }

        startReadyNodes();
    }

    private void prepare(Node node)
    {
        Animator animation = node.mAnimation;

        if (!node.mInternal)
        {
            if (mDuration >= 0) animation.setDuration(mDuration);
            if (mInterpolator != null) animation.setInterpolator(mInterpolator);
        }

        animation.removeListener(mChildListener);
        animation.addListener(mChildListener);
    }

    private boolean isReady(Node node)
    {
        if (!mReversing)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < node.mDependencies.size(); index++)
            {
                Dependency dependency = node.mDependencies.get(index);

                if (dependency.mRule == RULE_WITH && !dependency.mNode.mStarted) return false;
                if (dependency.mRule == RULE_AFTER && !dependency.mNode.mEnded) return false;
            }

            return true;
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < mNodes.size(); index++)
        {
            Node other = mNodes.get(index);

            for (int inner = 0; inner < other.mDependencies.size(); inner++)
            {
                Dependency dependency = other.mDependencies.get(inner);
                if (dependency.mNode != node) continue;

                if (dependency.mRule == RULE_WITH && !other.mStarted) return false;
                if (dependency.mRule == RULE_AFTER && !other.mEnded) return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private void startReadyNodes()
    {
        boolean progressed = true;

        while (progressed && !mTerminated && mStarted)
        {
            progressed = false;

            for (int index = 0; index < mNodes.size(); index++)
            {
                Node node = mNodes.get(index);
                if (node.mStarted || !isReady(node)) continue;

                node.mStarted = true;
                progressed = true;

                if (mReversing && node.mAnimation.canReverse()) node.mAnimation.reverse();
                else node.mAnimation.start();

                if (mTerminated || !mStarted) return;
            }
        }

        checkFinished();
    }

    private void checkFinished()
    {
        if (mTerminated || !mStarted || mDelayAnimator != null) return;

        for (int index = 0; index < mNodes.size(); index++)
        {
            if (!mNodes.get(index).mEnded) return;
        }

        finish();
    }

    private void childEnded(Animator animation)
    {
        if (mTerminated || !mStarted) return;

        Node node = mNodeMap.get(animation);
        if (node == null || node.mEnded) return;

        node.mStarted = true;
        node.mEnded = true;

        startReadyNodes();
    }

    private HashMap<Node, Long> computeStartTimes()
    {
        HashMap<Node, Long> startTimes = new HashMap<>();
        ArrayList<Node> ordered = sortedNodes(false);

        for (int index = 0; index < ordered.size(); index++)
        {
            Node node = ordered.get(index);
            long start = 0;

            for (int inner = 0; inner < node.mDependencies.size(); inner++)
            {
                Dependency dependency = node.mDependencies.get(inner);
                Long dependencyStart = startTimes.get(dependency.mNode);

                if (dependencyStart == null || dependencyStart == DURATION_INFINITE)
                {
                    start = DURATION_INFINITE;
                    break;
                }

                long candidate = dependencyStart;

                if (dependency.mRule == RULE_AFTER)
                {
                    long total = durationOf(dependency.mNode.mAnimation);

                    if (total == DURATION_INFINITE)
                    {
                        start = DURATION_INFINITE;
                        break;
                    }

                    candidate += total;
                }

                start = Math.max(start, candidate);
            }

            startTimes.put(node, start);
        }

        return startTimes;
    }

    private long durationOf(Animator animation)
    {
        if (mDuration >= 0 && !(animation instanceof AnimatorSet))
        {
            if (animation instanceof ValueAnimator && ((ValueAnimator)animation).getRepeatCount() == ValueAnimator.INFINITE)
            {
                return DURATION_INFINITE;
            }

            int repeats = animation instanceof ValueAnimator ? ((ValueAnimator)animation).getRepeatCount() + 1 : 1;
            return animation.getStartDelay() + mDuration * repeats;
        }

        return animation.getTotalDuration();
    }

    private ArrayList<Node> sortedNodes(boolean reverse)
    {
        ArrayList<Node> sorted = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Node> remaining = new ArrayList<>(mNodes);

        while (!remaining.isEmpty())
        {
            boolean progressed = false;

            for (int index = 0; index < remaining.size(); index++)
            {
                Node node = remaining.get(index);
                boolean ready = true;

                for (int inner = 0; inner < node.mDependencies.size(); inner++)
                {
                    if (!sorted.contains(node.mDependencies.get(inner).mNode))
                    {
                        ready = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (!ready) continue;

                sorted.add(node);
                remaining.remove(index);
                index--;
                progressed = true;
            }

            if (!progressed)
            {
                sorted.addAll(remaining);
                break;
            }
        }

        if (reverse) java.util.Collections.reverse(sorted);

        return sorted;
    }

    @Override
    public long getTotalDuration()
    {
        HashMap<Node, Long> startTimes = computeStartTimes();
        long longest = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index < mNodes.size(); index++)
        {
            Node node = mNodes.get(index);
            Long start = startTimes.get(node);
            if (start == null || start == DURATION_INFINITE) return DURATION_INFINITE;

            long total = durationOf(node.mAnimation);
            if (total == DURATION_INFINITE) return DURATION_INFINITE;

            longest = Math.max(longest, start + total);
        }

        return mStartDelay + longest;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canReverse()
    {
        return getTotalDuration() != DURATION_INFINITE;
    }

    @Override
    public void reverse()
    {
        if (isStarted())
        {
            boolean reversing = !mReversing;
            end();
            start(reversing);
            return;
        }

        start(true);
    }

    boolean isReversing()
    {
        return mReversing;
    }

    @Override
    public AnimatorSet clone()
    {
        AnimatorSet copy = (AnimatorSet)super.clone();
        int count = mNodes.size();

        copy.mStarted = false;
        copy.mTerminated = false;
        copy.mReversing = false;
        copy.mStartedAtNanos = -1;
        copy.mSeekPlayTime = -1;
        copy.mDelayAnimator = null;
        copy.mChildListener = copy.new ChildListener();
        copy.mNodes = new ArrayList<>(count);
        copy.mNodeMap = new HashMap<>();

        HashMap<Node, Node> clonesMap = new HashMap<>(count);

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            Node node = mNodes.get(index);
            Animator animation = node.mAnimation.clone();
            animation.removeListener(mChildListener);

            Node clone = new Node(animation);
            clone.mInternal = node.mInternal;
            clonesMap.put(node, clone);
            copy.mNodes.add(clone);
            copy.mNodeMap.put(animation, clone);
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            Node node = mNodes.get(index);
            Node clone = clonesMap.get(node);

            for (int inner = 0; inner < node.mDependencies.size(); inner++)
            {
                Dependency dependency = node.mDependencies.get(inner);
                clone.mDependencies.add(new Dependency(clonesMap.get(dependency.mNode), dependency.mRule));
            }
        }

        return copy;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder("AnimatorSet@" + Integer.toHexString(hashCode()) + "{");

        for (int index = 0; index < mNodes.size(); index++) builder.append("\n    ").append(mNodes.get(index).mAnimation.toString());

        return builder.append("\n}").toString();
    }

    private final class ChildListener implements AnimatorListener
    {
        @Override
        public void onAnimationStart(Animator animation)
        {
        }

        @Override
        public void onAnimationEnd(Animator animation)
        {
            childEnded(animation);
        }

        @Override
        public void onAnimationCancel(Animator animation)
        {
        }

        @Override
        public void onAnimationRepeat(Animator animation)
        {
        }
    }

    private static final class Dependency
    {
        final Node mNode;
        final int mRule;

        Dependency(Node node, int rule)
        {
            mNode = node;
            mRule = rule;
        }
    }

    private static final class Node
    {
        final Animator mAnimation;
        final ArrayList<Dependency> mDependencies = new ArrayList<>();
        boolean mInternal;
        boolean mStarted;
        boolean mEnded;

        Node(Animator animation)
        {
            mAnimation = animation;
        }

        void addDependency(Node node, int rule)
        {
            if (node == this) return;

            for (int index = 0; index < mDependencies.size(); index++)
            {
                Dependency existing = mDependencies.get(index);
                if (existing.mNode == node && existing.mRule == rule) return;
            }

            mDependencies.add(new Dependency(node, rule));
        }
    }

    public class Builder
    {
        private final Node mCurrentNode;

        Builder(Animator anim)
        {
            mCurrentNode = getNodeForAnimation(anim);
        }

        public Builder with(Animator anim)
        {
            Node node = getNodeForAnimation(anim);
            node.addDependency(mCurrentNode, RULE_WITH);

            return this;
        }

        public Builder before(Animator anim)
        {
            Node node = getNodeForAnimation(anim);
            node.addDependency(mCurrentNode, RULE_AFTER);

            return this;
        }

        public Builder after(Animator anim)
        {
            Node node = getNodeForAnimation(anim);
            mCurrentNode.addDependency(node, RULE_AFTER);

            return this;
        }

        public Builder after(long delay)
        {
            ValueAnimator animator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0.0f, 1.0f);
            animator.setDuration(delay);

            Node node = getNodeForAnimation(animator);
            node.mInternal = true;
            mCurrentNode.addDependency(node, RULE_AFTER);

            return this;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/animation/ArgbEvaluator.java`:

```java
package android.animation;

public class ArgbEvaluator implements TypeEvaluator<Object>
{
    private static final ArgbEvaluator INSTANCE = new ArgbEvaluator();

    public static ArgbEvaluator getInstance()
    {
        return INSTANCE;
    }

    @Override
    public Object evaluate(float fraction, Object startValue, Object endValue)
    {
        int start = startValue instanceof Integer ? ((Integer)startValue).intValue() : 0;
        int end = endValue instanceof Integer ? ((Integer)endValue).intValue() : 0;

        int startAlpha = (start >> 24) & 0xFF;
        int startRed = (start >> 16) & 0xFF;
        int startGreen = (start >> 8) & 0xFF;
        int startBlue = start & 0xFF;

        int endAlpha = (end >> 24) & 0xFF;
        int endRed = (end >> 16) & 0xFF;
        int endGreen = (end >> 8) & 0xFF;
        int endBlue = end & 0xFF;

        int alpha = startAlpha + (int)(fraction * (endAlpha - startAlpha));
        int red = startRed + (int)(fraction * (endRed - startRed));
        int green = startGreen + (int)(fraction * (endGreen - startGreen));
        int blue = startBlue + (int)(fraction * (endBlue - startBlue));

        return Integer.valueOf((alpha << 24) | (red << 16) | (green << 8) | blue);
    }
}
```

`java/android/animation/BidirectionalTypeConverter.java`:

```java
package android.animation;

public abstract class BidirectionalTypeConverter<T, V> extends TypeConverter<T, V>
{
    private BidirectionalTypeConverter<V, T> mInvertedConverter;

    public BidirectionalTypeConverter(Class<T> fromClass, Class<V> toClass)
    {
        super(fromClass, toClass);
    }

    public abstract T convertBack(V value);

    public BidirectionalTypeConverter<V, T> invert()
    {
        if (mInvertedConverter == null) mInvertedConverter = new InvertedConverter<>(this);

        return mInvertedConverter;
    }

    private static final class InvertedConverter<From, To> extends BidirectionalTypeConverter<From, To>
    {
        private final BidirectionalTypeConverter<To, From> mConverter;

        InvertedConverter(BidirectionalTypeConverter<To, From> converter)
        {
            super(converter.getTargetType(), converter.getSourceType());
            mConverter = converter;
        }

        @Override
        public From convertBack(To value)
        {
            return mConverter.convert(value);
        }

        @Override
        public To convert(From value)
        {
            return mConverter.convertBack(value);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/animation/FloatArrayEvaluator.java`:

```java
package android.animation;

public class FloatArrayEvaluator implements TypeEvaluator<float[]>
{
    private float[] mArray;

    public FloatArrayEvaluator()
    {
    }

    public FloatArrayEvaluator(float[] reuseArray)
    {
        mArray = reuseArray;
    }

    @Override
    public float[] evaluate(float fraction, float[] startValue, float[] endValue)
    {
        float[] array = mArray;
        if (array == null) array = new float[startValue.length];

        for (int index = 0; index < array.length; index++)
        {
            float start = startValue[index];
            float end = endValue[index];
            array[index] = start + (fraction * (end - start));
        }

        return array;
    }
}
```

`java/android/animation/Keyframe.java`:

```java
package android.animation;

public abstract class Keyframe implements Cloneable
{
    float mFraction;
    Class mValueType;
    boolean mHasValue;
    boolean mValueWasSetOnStart;

    private TimeInterpolator mInterpolator;

    public static Keyframe ofInt(float fraction, int value)
    {
        return new IntKeyframe(fraction, value);
    }

    public static Keyframe ofInt(float fraction)
    {
        return new IntKeyframe(fraction);
    }

    public static Keyframe ofFloat(float fraction, float value)
    {
        return new FloatKeyframe(fraction, value);
    }

    public static Keyframe ofFloat(float fraction)
    {
        return new FloatKeyframe(fraction);
    }

    public static Keyframe ofObject(float fraction, Object value)
    {
        return new ObjectKeyframe(fraction, value);
    }

    public static Keyframe ofObject(float fraction)
    {
        return new ObjectKeyframe(fraction, null);
    }

    public boolean hasValue()
    {
        return mHasValue;
    }

    boolean valueWasSetOnStart()
    {
        return mValueWasSetOnStart;
    }

    void setValueWasSetOnStart(boolean valueWasSetOnStart)
    {
        mValueWasSetOnStart = valueWasSetOnStart;
    }

    public abstract Object getValue();

    public abstract void setValue(Object value);

    public float getFraction()
    {
        return mFraction;
    }

    public void setFraction(float fraction)
    {
        mFraction = fraction;
    }

    public TimeInterpolator getInterpolator()
    {
        return mInterpolator;
    }

    public void setInterpolator(TimeInterpolator interpolator)
    {
        mInterpolator = interpolator;
    }

    public Class getType()
    {
        return mValueType;
    }

    @Override
    public abstract Keyframe clone();

    static class ObjectKeyframe extends Keyframe
    {
        Object mValue;

        ObjectKeyframe(float fraction, Object value)
        {
            mFraction = fraction;
            mValue = value;
            mHasValue = value != null;
            mValueType = mHasValue ? value.getClass() : Object.class;
        }

        @Override
        public Object getValue()
        {
            return mValue;
        }

        @Override
        public void setValue(Object value)
        {
            mValue = value;
            mHasValue = value != null;
        }

        @Override
        public ObjectKeyframe clone()
        {
            ObjectKeyframe copy = new ObjectKeyframe(getFraction(), hasValue() ? mValue : null);
            copy.mValueWasSetOnStart = mValueWasSetOnStart;
            copy.setInterpolator(getInterpolator());

            return copy;
        }
    }

    static class IntKeyframe extends Keyframe
    {
        int mValue;

        IntKeyframe(float fraction, int value)
        {
            mFraction = fraction;
            mValue = value;
            mValueType = int.class;
            mHasValue = true;
        }

        IntKeyframe(float fraction)
        {
            mFraction = fraction;
            mValueType = int.class;
        }

        public int getIntValue()
        {
            return mValue;
        }

        @Override
        public Object getValue()
        {
            return mValue;
        }

        @Override
        public void setValue(Object value)
        {
            if (value != null && (value instanceof Number))
            {
                mValue = ((Number)value).intValue();
                mHasValue = true;
            }
        }

        @Override
        public IntKeyframe clone()
        {
            IntKeyframe copy = mHasValue ? new IntKeyframe(getFraction(), mValue) : new IntKeyframe(getFraction());
            copy.setInterpolator(getInterpolator());
            copy.mValueWasSetOnStart = mValueWasSetOnStart;

            return copy;
        }
    }

    static class FloatKeyframe extends Keyframe
    {
        float mValue;

        FloatKeyframe(float fraction, float value)
        {
            mFraction = fraction;
            mValue = value;
            mValueType = float.class;
            mHasValue = true;
        }

        FloatKeyframe(float fraction)
        {
            mFraction = fraction;
            mValueType = float.class;
        }

        public float getFloatValue()
        {
            return mValue;
        }

        @Override
        public Object getValue()
        {
            return mValue;
        }

        @Override
        public void setValue(Object value)
        {
            if (value != null && (value instanceof Number))
            {
                mValue = ((Number)value).floatValue();
                mHasValue = true;
            }
        }

        @Override
        public FloatKeyframe clone()
        {
            FloatKeyframe copy = mHasValue ? new FloatKeyframe(getFraction(), mValue) : new FloatKeyframe(getFraction());
            copy.setInterpolator(getInterpolator());
            copy.mValueWasSetOnStart = mValueWasSetOnStart;

            return copy;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/animation/KeyframeSet.java`:

```java
package android.animation;

import android.graphics.Path;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

class KeyframeSet implements Keyframes
{
    int mNumKeyframes;
    Keyframe mFirstKeyframe;
    Keyframe mLastKeyframe;
    TimeInterpolator mInterpolator;
    List<Keyframe> mKeyframes;
    TypeEvaluator mEvaluator;

    KeyframeSet(Keyframe... keyframes)
    {
        mNumKeyframes = keyframes.length;
        mKeyframes = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(keyframes));
        mFirstKeyframe = keyframes[0];
        mLastKeyframe = keyframes[mNumKeyframes - 1];
        mInterpolator = mLastKeyframe.getInterpolator();
    }

    @Override
    public List<Keyframe> getKeyframes()
    {
        return mKeyframes;
    }

    static KeyframeSet ofInt(int... values)
    {
        int count = values.length;
        Keyframe[] keyframes = new Keyframe[Math.max(count, 2)];

        if (count == 1)
        {
            keyframes[0] = Keyframe.ofInt(0.0f);
            keyframes[1] = Keyframe.ofInt(1.0f, values[0]);
        }
        else
        {
            keyframes[0] = Keyframe.ofInt(0.0f, values[0]);
            for (int index = 1; index < count; index++) keyframes[index] = Keyframe.ofInt((float)index / (count - 1), values[index]);
        }

        return new KeyframeSet(keyframes);
    }

    static KeyframeSet ofFloat(float... values)
    {
        int count = values.length;
        Keyframe[] keyframes = new Keyframe[Math.max(count, 2)];

        if (count == 1)
        {
            keyframes[0] = Keyframe.ofFloat(0.0f);
            keyframes[1] = Keyframe.ofFloat(1.0f, values[0]);

            if (Float.isNaN(values[0])) android.util.Log.w("Animator", "Bad value (NaN) in float animator");
        }
        else
        {
            keyframes[0] = Keyframe.ofFloat(0.0f, values[0]);

            for (int index = 1; index < count; index++)
            {
                keyframes[index] = Keyframe.ofFloat((float)index / (count - 1), values[index]);
                if (Float.isNaN(values[index])) android.util.Log.w("Animator", "Bad value (NaN) in float animator");
            }
        }

        return new KeyframeSet(keyframes);
    }

    static KeyframeSet ofKeyframe(Keyframe... keyframes)
    {
        int count = keyframes.length;
        boolean hasFloat = false;
        boolean hasInt = false;
        boolean hasOther = false;

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            if (keyframes[index] instanceof Keyframe.FloatKeyframe) hasFloat = true;
            else if (keyframes[index] instanceof Keyframe.IntKeyframe) hasInt = true;
            else hasOther = true;
        }

        if (hasFloat && !hasInt && !hasOther) return new KeyframeSet(keyframes);
        if (hasInt && !hasFloat && !hasOther) return new KeyframeSet(keyframes);

        if (hasFloat && hasInt && !hasOther)
        {
            Keyframe[] floats = new Keyframe[count];

            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                Keyframe keyframe = keyframes[index];

                if (keyframe instanceof Keyframe.IntKeyframe && keyframe.hasValue())
                {
                    Keyframe converted = Keyframe.ofFloat(keyframe.getFraction(), ((Keyframe.IntKeyframe)keyframe).getIntValue());
                    converted.setInterpolator(keyframe.getInterpolator());
                    floats[index] = converted;
                }
                else if (keyframe instanceof Keyframe.IntKeyframe)
                {
                    Keyframe converted = Keyframe.ofFloat(keyframe.getFraction());
                    converted.setInterpolator(keyframe.getInterpolator());
                    floats[index] = converted;
                }
                else
                {
                    floats[index] = keyframe;
                }
            }

            return new KeyframeSet(floats);
        }

        return new KeyframeSet(keyframes);
    }

    static KeyframeSet ofObject(Object... values)
    {
        int count = values.length;
        Keyframe[] keyframes = new Keyframe[Math.max(count, 2)];

        if (count == 1)
        {
            keyframes[0] = Keyframe.ofObject(0.0f);
            keyframes[1] = Keyframe.ofObject(1.0f, values[0]);
        }
        else
        {
            keyframes[0] = Keyframe.ofObject(0.0f, values[0]);
            for (int index = 1; index < count; index++) keyframes[index] = Keyframe.ofObject((float)index / (count - 1), values[index]);
        }

        return new KeyframeSet(keyframes);
    }

    static PathKeyframes ofPath(Path path)
    {
        return new PathKeyframes(path);
    }

    static PathKeyframes ofPath(Path path, float error)
    {
        return new PathKeyframes(path, error);
    }

    @Override
    public void setEvaluator(TypeEvaluator evaluator)
    {
        mEvaluator = evaluator;
    }

    @Override
    public Class getType()
    {
        return mFirstKeyframe.getType();
    }

    @Override
    public KeyframeSet clone()
    {
        int count = mKeyframes.size();
        Keyframe[] copies = new Keyframe[count];

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) copies[index] = mKeyframes.get(index).clone();

        KeyframeSet copy = new KeyframeSet(copies);
        copy.mEvaluator = mEvaluator;

        return copy;
    }

    @Override
    public Object getValue(float fraction)
    {
        if (mNumKeyframes == 2)
        {
            if (mInterpolator != null) fraction = mInterpolator.getInterpolation(fraction);

            return evaluate(fraction, mFirstKeyframe, mLastKeyframe);
        }

        if (fraction <= 0.0f)
        {
            Keyframe next = mKeyframes.get(1);
            TimeInterpolator interpolator = next.getInterpolator();
            if (interpolator != null) fraction = interpolator.getInterpolation(fraction);

            float previousFraction = mFirstKeyframe.getFraction();
            float intervalFraction = (fraction - previousFraction) / (next.getFraction() - previousFraction);

            return evaluate(intervalFraction, mFirstKeyframe, next);
        }

        if (fraction >= 1.0f)
        {
            Keyframe previous = mKeyframes.get(mNumKeyframes - 2);
            TimeInterpolator interpolator = mLastKeyframe.getInterpolator();
            if (interpolator != null) fraction = interpolator.getInterpolation(fraction);

            float previousFraction = previous.getFraction();
            float intervalFraction = (fraction - previousFraction) / (mLastKeyframe.getFraction() - previousFraction);

            return evaluate(intervalFraction, previous, mLastKeyframe);
        }

        Keyframe previous = mFirstKeyframe;

        for (int index = 1; index < mNumKeyframes; index++)
        {
            Keyframe next = mKeyframes.get(index);

            if (fraction < next.getFraction())
            {
                TimeInterpolator interpolator = next.getInterpolator();
                float previousFraction = previous.getFraction();
                float intervalFraction = (fraction - previousFraction) / (next.getFraction() - previousFraction);

                if (interpolator != null) intervalFraction = interpolator.getInterpolation(intervalFraction);

                return evaluate(intervalFraction, previous, next);
            }

            previous = next;
        }

        return mLastKeyframe.getValue();
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private Object evaluate(float fraction, Keyframe start, Keyframe end)
    {
        if (mEvaluator != null) return mEvaluator.evaluate(fraction, start.getValue(), end.getValue());

        if (start instanceof Keyframe.FloatKeyframe && end instanceof Keyframe.FloatKeyframe)
        {
            float from = ((Keyframe.FloatKeyframe)start).getFloatValue();
            float to = ((Keyframe.FloatKeyframe)end).getFloatValue();

            return from + fraction * (to - from);
        }

        if (start instanceof Keyframe.IntKeyframe && end instanceof Keyframe.IntKeyframe)
        {
            int from = ((Keyframe.IntKeyframe)start).getIntValue();
            int to = ((Keyframe.IntKeyframe)end).getIntValue();

            return from + (int)(fraction * (to - from));
        }

        return fraction < 1.0f ? start.getValue() : end.getValue();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(" ");

        for (int index = 0; index < mNumKeyframes; index++) builder.append(mKeyframes.get(index).getValue()).append("  ");

        return builder.toString();
    }
}
```

```java
package android.animation;

import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class LayoutTransition
{
    public static final int CHANGE_APPEARING = 0;
    public static final int CHANGE_DISAPPEARING = 1;
    public static final int APPEARING = 2;
    public static final int DISAPPEARING = 3;
    public static final int CHANGING = 4;

    private static final int TRANSITION_TYPE_COUNT = 5;
    private static final long DEFAULT_DURATION = 300;

    private final List<TransitionListener> mListeners = new ArrayList<>();
    private final boolean[] mEnabled = {true, true, true, true, false};
    private final long[] mDurations = {DEFAULT_DURATION, DEFAULT_DURATION, DEFAULT_DURATION, DEFAULT_DURATION, DEFAULT_DURATION};
    private final long[] mStartDelays = {0, DEFAULT_DURATION, DEFAULT_DURATION, 0, 0};
    private final long[] mStaggers = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0};
    private final Animator[] mAnimators = new Animator[TRANSITION_TYPE_COUNT];
    private final TimeInterpolator[] mInterpolators = new TimeInterpolator[TRANSITION_TYPE_COUNT];

    private boolean mAnimateParentHierarchy = true;

    public LayoutTransition()
    {
    }

    private static boolean isValid(int transitionType)
    {
        return transitionType >= 0 && transitionType < TRANSITION_TYPE_COUNT;
    }

    public void setDuration(long duration)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < TRANSITION_TYPE_COUNT; index++) mDurations[index] = duration;
    }

    public void setDuration(int transitionType, long duration)
    {
        if (isValid(transitionType)) mDurations[transitionType] = duration;
    }

    public long getDuration(int transitionType)
    {
        return isValid(transitionType) ? mDurations[transitionType] : 0;
    }

    public void setStartDelay(int transitionType, long delay)
    {
        if (isValid(transitionType)) mStartDelays[transitionType] = delay;
    }

    public long getStartDelay(int transitionType)
    {
        return isValid(transitionType) ? mStartDelays[transitionType] : 0;
    }

    public void enableTransitionType(int transitionType)
    {
        if (isValid(transitionType)) mEnabled[transitionType] = true;
    }

    public void disableTransitionType(int transitionType)
    {
        if (isValid(transitionType)) mEnabled[transitionType] = false;
    }

    public boolean isTransitionTypeEnabled(int transitionType)
    {
        return isValid(transitionType) && mEnabled[transitionType];
    }

    public void setAnimator(int transitionType, Animator animator)
    {
        if (isValid(transitionType)) mAnimators[transitionType] = animator;
    }

    public Animator getAnimator(int transitionType)
    {
        return isValid(transitionType) ? mAnimators[transitionType] : null;
    }

    public void setInterpolator(int transitionType, TimeInterpolator interpolator)
    {
        if (isValid(transitionType)) mInterpolators[transitionType] = interpolator;
    }

    public TimeInterpolator getInterpolator(int transitionType)
    {
        return isValid(transitionType) ? mInterpolators[transitionType] : null;
    }

    public void setStagger(int transitionType, long duration)
    {
        if (isValid(transitionType)) mStaggers[transitionType] = duration;
    }

    public long getStagger(int transitionType)
    {
        return isValid(transitionType) ? mStaggers[transitionType] : 0;
    }

    public void setAnimateParentHierarchy(boolean animateParentHierarchy)
    {
        mAnimateParentHierarchy = animateParentHierarchy;
    }

    boolean isAnimateParentHierarchy()
    {
        return mAnimateParentHierarchy;
    }

    public boolean isRunning()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isChangingLayout()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void showChild(ViewGroup parent, View child)
    {
        showChild(parent, child, View.GONE);
    }

    public void showChild(ViewGroup parent, View child, int oldVisibility)
    {
        notifyInstant(parent, child, APPEARING);
    }

    public void hideChild(ViewGroup parent, View child)
    {
        hideChild(parent, child, View.GONE);
    }

    public void hideChild(ViewGroup parent, View child, int newVisibility)
    {
        notifyInstant(parent, child, DISAPPEARING);
    }

    public void addChild(ViewGroup parent, View child)
    {
        notifyInstant(parent, child, APPEARING);
    }

    public void removeChild(ViewGroup parent, View child)
    {
        notifyInstant(parent, child, DISAPPEARING);
    }

    private void notifyInstant(ViewGroup parent, View child, int transitionType)
    {
        if (!isTransitionTypeEnabled(transitionType) || mListeners.isEmpty()) return;

        ArrayList<TransitionListener> listeners = new ArrayList<>(mListeners);

        for (TransitionListener listener : listeners) listener.startTransition(this, parent, child, transitionType);
        for (TransitionListener listener : listeners) listener.endTransition(this, parent, child, transitionType);
    }

    public void addTransitionListener(TransitionListener listener)
    {
        if (listener != null) mListeners.add(listener);
    }

    public void removeTransitionListener(TransitionListener listener)
    {
        mListeners.remove(listener);
    }

    public List<TransitionListener> getTransitionListeners()
    {
        return mListeners;
    }

    public interface TransitionListener
    {
        void startTransition(LayoutTransition transition, ViewGroup container, View view, int transitionType);

        void endTransition(LayoutTransition transition, ViewGroup container, View view, int transitionType);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.animation;

import android.graphics.Path;
import android.graphics.PointF;
import android.util.Property;

import java.util.ArrayList;

public final class ObjectAnimator extends ValueAnimator
{
    private static final ArrayList<ObjectAnimator> sStartedAnimators = new ArrayList<>();

    private Object mTarget;
    private String mPropertyName;
    private Property mProperty;
    private boolean mAutoCancel;

    public ObjectAnimator()

    }

    private ObjectAnimator(Object target, String propertyName)
    {
        setTarget(target);
        setPropertyName(propertyName);
    }

    private <T> ObjectAnimator(T target, Property<T, ?> property)
    {
        setTarget(target);
        setProperty(property);
    }

    public static ObjectAnimator ofInt(Object target, String propertyName, int... values)

    public static ObjectAnimator ofPropertyValuesHolder(Object target, PropertyValuesHolder... values)
    {
        ObjectAnimator animator = new ObjectAnimator();
        animator.setTarget(target);
        animator.setValues(values);

        return animator;
    }

    public void setPropertyName(String propertyName)
    {
        if (mValues != null)
        {
            PropertyValuesHolder holder = mValues[0];
            String oldName = holder.getPropertyName();
            holder.setPropertyName(propertyName);
            mValuesMap.remove(oldName);
            mValuesMap.put(propertyName, holder);
        }

        mPropertyName = propertyName;
        mInitialized = false;
    }

    public void setProperty(Property property)
    {
        if (mValues != null)
        {
            PropertyValuesHolder holder = mValues[0];
            String oldName = holder.getPropertyName();
            holder.setProperty(property);
            mValuesMap.remove(oldName);
            mValuesMap.put(mPropertyName, holder);
        }

        if (mProperty != null) mPropertyName = property.getName();

        mProperty = property;
        mInitialized = false;
    }

    public Property getProperty()
    {
        return mProperty;
    }

    public String getPropertyName()
    {
        if (mPropertyName != null) return mPropertyName;
        if (mProperty != null) return mProperty.getName();

        if (mValues != null && mValues.length > 0)
        {
            StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();

            for (int index = 0; index < mValues.length; index++)
            {
                if (index > 0) builder.append(',');
                builder.append(mValues[index].getPropertyName());
            }

            return builder.toString();
        }

        return null;
    }

    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public void setIntValues(int... values)
    {
        if (mValues == null || mValues.length == 0)
        {
            if (mProperty != null) setValues(PropertyValuesHolder.ofInt(mProperty, values));
            else setValues(PropertyValuesHolder.ofInt(mPropertyName, values));

            return;
        }

        super.setIntValues(values);
    }

    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public void setFloatValues(float... values)
    {
        if (mValues == null || mValues.length == 0)
        {
            if (mProperty != null) setValues(PropertyValuesHolder.ofFloat(mProperty, values));
            else setValues(PropertyValuesHolder.ofFloat(mPropertyName, values));

            return;
        }

        super.setFloatValues(values);
    }

    @Override
    public void setObjectValues(Object... values)
    {
        if (mValues == null || mValues.length == 0)
        {
            if (mProperty != null) setValues(PropertyValuesHolder.ofObject(mProperty, (TypeEvaluator)null, values));
            else setValues(PropertyValuesHolder.ofObject(mPropertyName, (TypeEvaluator)null, values));

            return;
        }

        super.setObjectValues(values);
    }

    public void setAutoCancel(boolean cancel)
    {
        mAutoCancel = cancel;
    }

    private boolean hasSameTargetAndProperties(ObjectAnimator other)
    {
        PropertyValuesHolder[] theirValues = other.getValues();

        if (other.getTarget() != getTarget() || mValues == null || theirValues == null) return false;
        if (mValues.length != theirValues.length) return false;

        for (int index = 0; index < mValues.length; index++)
        {
            PropertyValuesHolder mine = mValues[index];
            PropertyValuesHolder theirs = theirValues[index];

            if (mine.getPropertyName() == null || !mine.getPropertyName().equals(theirs.getPropertyName())) return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void start()
    {
        ArrayList<ObjectAnimator> started;

        synchronized (sStartedAnimators)
        {
            for (int index = sStartedAnimators.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
            {
                if (!sStartedAnimators.get(index).isStarted()) sStartedAnimators.remove(index);
            }

            started = new ArrayList<>(sStartedAnimators);
        }

        if (mAutoCancel)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < started.size(); index++)
            {
                ObjectAnimator other = started.get(index);
                if (other != this && other.isStarted() && hasSameTargetAndProperties(other)) other.cancel();
            }
        }

        super.start();

        if (isStarted())
        {
            synchronized (sStartedAnimators)
            {
                if (!sStartedAnimators.contains(this)) sStartedAnimators.add(this);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    void initAnimation()
    {
        if (!mInitialized)
        {
            Object target = getTarget();

            if (target != null && mValues != null)
            {
                for (int index = 0; index < mValues.length; index++) mValues[index].setupSetterAndGetter(target);
            }

            super.initAnimation();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public ObjectAnimator setDuration(long duration)
    {
        super.setDuration(duration);
        return this;
    }

    public Object getTarget()
    {
        return mTarget;
    }

    @Override
    public void setTarget(Object target)
    {
        if (mTarget == target) return;

        if (isStarted()) cancel();

        mTarget = target;
        mInitialized = false;
    }

    @Override
    public void setupStartValues()
    {
        initAnimation();

        Object target = getTarget();
        if (target == null || mValues == null) return;

        for (int index = 0; index < mValues.length; index++) mValues[index].setupStartValue(target);
    }

    @Override
    public void setupEndValues()
    {
        initAnimation();

        Object target = getTarget();
        if (target == null || mValues == null) return;

        for (int index = 0; index < mValues.length; index++) mValues[index].setupEndValue(target);
    }

    @Override
    void animateValue(float fraction)
    {
        Object target = getTarget();

        super.animateValue(fraction);

        if (target == null || mValues == null) return;

        for (int index = 0; index < mValues.length; index++) mValues[index].setAnimatedValue(target);
    }

    @Override
    public ObjectAnimator clone()
    {
        return (ObjectAnimator)super.clone();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder("ObjectAnimator@" + Integer.toHexString(hashCode()) + ", target " + getTarget());

        if (mValues != null)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < mValues.length; index++) builder.append("\n    ").append(mValues[index].toString());
        }

        return builder.toString();
    }
}
```

`java/android/animation/PathKeyframes.java`:

```java
package android.animation;

import android.graphics.Path;
import android.graphics.PointF;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

class PathKeyframes implements Keyframes
{
    private static final int FRACTION_OFFSET = 0;
    private static final int X_OFFSET = 1;
    private static final int Y_OFFSET = 2;
    private static final int NUM_COMPONENTS = 3;
    private static final float DEFAULT_ERROR = 0.5f;

    private static final ArrayList<Keyframe> EMPTY_KEYFRAMES = new ArrayList<>();

    private final PointF mTempPointF = new PointF();
    private final float[] mKeyframeData;

    PathKeyframes(Path path)
    {
        this(path, DEFAULT_ERROR);
    }

    PathKeyframes(Path path, float error)
    {
        if (path == null || path.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("The path must not be null or empty");

        mKeyframeData = path.approximate(error);
    }

    @Override
    public List<Keyframe> getKeyframes()
    {
        return EMPTY_KEYFRAMES;
    }

    @Override
    public Object getValue(float fraction)
    {
        int numPoints = mKeyframeData.length / NUM_COMPONENTS;

        if (fraction < 0.0f) return interpolateInRange(fraction, 0, 1);
        if (fraction > 1.0f) return interpolateInRange(fraction, numPoints - 2, numPoints - 1);
        if (fraction == 0.0f) return pointForIndex(0);
        if (fraction == 1.0f) return pointForIndex(numPoints - 1);

        int low = 0;
        int high = numPoints - 1;

        while (low <= high)
        {
            int middle = (low + high) / 2;
            float middleFraction = mKeyframeData[(middle * NUM_COMPONENTS) + FRACTION_OFFSET];

            if (fraction < middleFraction) high = middle - 1;
            else if (fraction > middleFraction) low = middle + 1;
            else return pointForIndex(middle);
        }

        return interpolateInRange(fraction, high, low);
    }

    private PointF interpolateInRange(float fraction, int startIndex, int endIndex)
    {
        int startBase = startIndex * NUM_COMPONENTS;
        int endBase = endIndex * NUM_COMPONENTS;

        float startFraction = mKeyframeData[startBase + FRACTION_OFFSET];
        float endFraction = mKeyframeData[endBase + FRACTION_OFFSET];

        float span = endFraction - startFraction;
        float intervalFraction = span == 0.0f ? 0.0f : (fraction - startFraction) / span;

        float startX = mKeyframeData[startBase + X_OFFSET];
        float endX = mKeyframeData[endBase + X_OFFSET];
        float startY = mKeyframeData[startBase + Y_OFFSET];
        float endY = mKeyframeData[endBase + Y_OFFSET];

        mTempPointF.set(startX + intervalFraction * (endX - startX), startY + intervalFraction * (endY - startY));
        return mTempPointF;
    }

    private PointF pointForIndex(int index)
    {
        int base = index * NUM_COMPONENTS;
        mTempPointF.set(mKeyframeData[base + X_OFFSET], mKeyframeData[base + Y_OFFSET]);

        return mTempPointF;
    }

    @Override
    public void setEvaluator(TypeEvaluator evaluator)
    {
    }

    @Override
    public Class getType()
    {
        return PointF.class;
    }

    @Override
    public PathKeyframes clone()
    {
        return this;
    }

    Keyframes createXFloatKeyframes()
    {
        return new FloatKeyframesBase()
        {
            @Override
            public float getFloatValue(float fraction)
            {
                PointF point = (PointF)PathKeyframes.this.getValue(fraction);
                return point.x;
            }
        };
    }

    Keyframes createYFloatKeyframes()
    {
        return new FloatKeyframesBase()
        {
            @Override
            public float getFloatValue(float fraction)
            {
                PointF point = (PointF)PathKeyframes.this.getValue(fraction);
                return point.y;
            }
        };
    }

    Keyframes createXIntKeyframes()

        return new IntKeyframesBase()

            @Override

            {
                PointF point = (PointF)PathKeyframes.this.getValue(fraction);

    }

    private abstract static class SimpleKeyframes implements Keyframes
    {
        @Override

        {
        }

        @Override

        {

            return this;
        }
    }

    abstract static class IntKeyframesBase extends SimpleKeyframes
    {
        abstract int getIntValue(float fraction);

        @Override

        {
            return Integer.class;
        }

    {
        abstract float getFloatValue(float fraction);

        @Override
        public Class getType()
        {
            return Float.class;
        }

        @Override
        public Object getValue(float fraction)
        {
            return getFloatValue(fraction);

    }
```

`java/android/animation/PointFEvaluator.java`:

```java
package android.animation;

import android.graphics.PointF;

public class PointFEvaluator implements TypeEvaluator<PointF>
{
    private PointF mPoint;

    public PointFEvaluator()
    {
    }

    public PointFEvaluator(PointF reuse)
    {
        mPoint = reuse;
    }

    @Override
    public PointF evaluate(float fraction, PointF startValue, PointF endValue)
    {
        float x = startValue.x + (fraction * (endValue.x - startValue.x));
        float y = startValue.y + (fraction * (endValue.y - startValue.y));

        if (mPoint == null) return new PointF(x, y);

        mPoint.set(x, y);
        return mPoint;
    }
}
```

```java
    public void setIntValues(int... values)

    public void setKeyframes(Keyframe... values)
    {
        int count = values.length;
        Keyframe[] keyframes = new Keyframe[Math.max(count, 2)];
        mValueType = values[0].getType();

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) keyframes[index] = values[index];

        if (count < 2) keyframes[1] = values[0];

        KeyframeSet set = KeyframeSet.ofKeyframe(keyframes);
        mKeyframes = set;
        mValueType = set.getType();

        if (mEvaluator != null) mKeyframes.setEvaluator(mEvaluator);
    }

    public void setObjectValues(Object... values)
    {
        mValueType = values[0] == null ? Object.class : values[0].getClass();
        mKeyframes = KeyframeSet.ofObject(values);

        if (mEvaluator != null) mKeyframes.setEvaluator(mEvaluator);

    void init()
    {
        if (mEvaluator == null)
        {
            if (mValueType == Integer.class) mEvaluator = sIntEvaluator;
            else if (mValueType == Float.class) mEvaluator = sFloatEvaluator;
        }

        if (mEvaluator != null && mKeyframes != null) mKeyframes.setEvaluator(mEvaluator);
    }

    void calculateValue(float fraction)
    {
        if (mKeyframes == null) return;

        Object value = mKeyframes.getValue(fraction);
        mAnimatedValue = mConverter == null ? value : convert(value);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private Object convert(Object value)
    {
        return mConverter.convert(value);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private Object convertBack(Object value)
    {
        if (mConverter == null) return value;

        if (!(mConverter instanceof BidirectionalTypeConverter))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Converter " + mConverter.getClass().getName() + " must be a BidirectionalTypeConverter");
        }

        return ((BidirectionalTypeConverter)mConverter).convertBack(value);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    void setupSetterAndGetter(Object target)
    {
        if (target == null || mKeyframes == null) return;

        if (mProperty != null)
        {
            try
            {
                Object testValue = null;
                List<Keyframe> keyframes = mKeyframes.getKeyframes();

                for (int index = 0; index < keyframes.size(); index++)
                {
                    Keyframe keyframe = keyframes.get(index);

                    if (!keyframe.hasValue() || keyframe.valueWasSetOnStart())
                    {
                        if (testValue == null) testValue = convertBack(mProperty.get(target));

                        keyframe.setValue(testValue);
                        keyframe.setValueWasSetOnStart(true);
                    }
                }

                return;
            }
            catch (ClassCastException failure)
            {
                Log.w(TAG, "No such property (" + mProperty.getName() + ") on target object " + target + ". Trying reflection instead");
                mProperty = null;
            }
        }

        if (mPropertyName == null) return;

        Class targetClass = target.getClass();

        if (mMultiDimension == MULTI_NONE && mSetter == null) setupSetter(targetClass);

        List<Keyframe> keyframes = mKeyframes.getKeyframes();

        for (int index = 0; index < keyframes.size(); index++)
        {
            Keyframe keyframe = keyframes.get(index);
            if (keyframe.hasValue() && !keyframe.valueWasSetOnStart()) continue;

            if (mGetter == null) setupGetter(targetClass);
            if (mGetter == null) return;

            try
            {
                keyframe.setValue(convertBack(mGetter.invoke(target)));
                keyframe.setValueWasSetOnStart(true);
            }
            catch (IllegalAccessException | InvocationTargetException failure)
            {
                Log.e(TAG, failure.toString());
            }
        }
    }

    void setupStartValue(Object target)
    {
        List<Keyframe> keyframes = mKeyframes == null ? null : mKeyframes.getKeyframes();
        if (keyframes != null && !keyframes.isEmpty()) setupValue(target, keyframes.get(0));
    }

    void setupEndValue(Object target)
    {
        List<Keyframe> keyframes = mKeyframes == null ? null : mKeyframes.getKeyframes();
        if (keyframes != null && !keyframes.isEmpty()) setupValue(target, keyframes.get(keyframes.size() - 1));
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private void setupValue(Object target, Keyframe keyframe)
    {
        if (target == null) return;

        if (mProperty != null)
        {
            keyframe.setValue(convertBack(mProperty.get(target)));
            return;
        }

        if (mPropertyName == null) return;

        try
        {
            if (mGetter == null) setupGetter(target.getClass());
            if (mGetter == null) return;

            keyframe.setValue(convertBack(mGetter.invoke(target)));
        }
        catch (IllegalAccessException | InvocationTargetException failure)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, failure.toString());
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    void setAnimatedValue(Object target)
    {
        if (target == null) return;

        if (mProperty != null)
        {
            mProperty.set(target, getAnimatedValue());
            return;
        }

        if (mMultiDimension != MULTI_NONE)
        {
            setMultiValue(target);
            return;
        }

        if (mSetter == null) return;

        try
        {
            mSetter.invoke(target, coerce(mSetter.getParameterTypes()[0], getAnimatedValue()));
        }
        catch (IllegalAccessException | InvocationTargetException | IllegalArgumentException failure)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, failure.toString());
        }
    }

    private void setMultiValue(Object target)
    {
        Object value = getAnimatedValue();
        if (value == null || mPropertyName == null) return;

        int length = value instanceof float[] ? ((float[])value).length : value instanceof int[] ? ((int[])value).length : 0;
        if (length == 0) return;

        if (!mMultiSetterResolved)
        {
            mMultiSetterResolved = true;
            mSetter = findMultiSetter(target.getClass(), length);
        }

        if (mSetter == null) return;

        Class[] parameters = mSetter.getParameterTypes();
        Object[] arguments = new Object[parameters.length];

        for (int index = 0; index < parameters.length; index++)
        {
            Number component = value instanceof float[] ? (Number)((float[])value)[index] : (Number)((int[])value)[index];
            arguments[index] = coerce(parameters[index], component);
        }

        try
        {
            mSetter.invoke(target, arguments);
        }
        catch (IllegalAccessException | InvocationTargetException | IllegalArgumentException failure)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, failure.toString());
        }
    }

    private Method findMultiSetter(Class targetClass, int parameterCount)
    {
        String name = getMethodName("set", mPropertyName);
        Class wanted = mMultiDimension == MULTI_INT ? int.class : float.class;
        Method fallback = null;

        for (Method method : targetClass.getMethods())
        {
            if (!method.getName().equals(name)) continue;

            Class[] parameters = method.getParameterTypes();
            if (parameters.length != parameterCount) continue;

            boolean exact = true;
            boolean numeric = true;

            for (Class parameter : parameters)
            {
                if (parameter != wanted) exact = false;
                if (parameter != int.class && parameter != float.class && parameter != double.class) numeric = false;
            }

            if (exact) return method;
            if (numeric && fallback == null) fallback = method;
        }

        if (fallback == null) Log.w(TAG, "Method " + name + " with " + parameterCount + " parameters not found on target class " + targetClass);

        return fallback;
    }

    private static Object coerce(Class type, Object value)
    {
        if (!(value instanceof Number)) return value;

        Number number = (Number)value;

        if (type == float.class || type == Float.class) return number.floatValue();
        if (type == int.class || type == Integer.class) return number.intValue();
        if (type == double.class || type == Double.class) return number.doubleValue();
        if (type == long.class || type == Long.class) return number.longValue();
        if (type == short.class || type == Short.class) return number.shortValue();
        if (type == byte.class || type == Byte.class) return number.byteValue();

        return value;
    }

    static String getMethodName(String prefix, String propertyName)
    {
        if (propertyName == null || propertyName.length() == 0) return prefix;

        char firstLetter = Character.toUpperCase(propertyName.charAt(0));
        return prefix + firstLetter + propertyName.substring(1);
    }

    private void setupSetter(Class targetClass)
    {
        Class propertyType = mConverter == null ? mValueType : mConverter.getTargetType();
        mSetter = getPropertyFunction(targetClass, "set", propertyType);
    }

    private void setupGetter(Class targetClass)
    {
        mGetter = getPropertyFunction(targetClass, "get", null);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private Method getPropertyFunction(Class targetClass, String prefix, Class valueType)
    {
        String methodName = getMethodName(prefix, mPropertyName);

        if (valueType == null)
        {
            try
            {
                return targetClass.getMethod(methodName);
            }
            catch (NoSuchMethodException failure)
            {
                Log.w(TAG, "Method " + methodName + "() not found on target class " + targetClass);
                return null;
            }
        }

        Class[] variants;

        if (valueType == Float.class || valueType == float.class) variants = FLOAT_VARIANTS;
        else if (valueType == Integer.class || valueType == int.class) variants = INTEGER_VARIANTS;
        else if (valueType == Double.class || valueType == double.class) variants = DOUBLE_VARIANTS;
        else variants = new Class[] {valueType};

        for (Class variant : variants)
        {
            try
            {
                Method method = targetClass.getMethod(methodName, variant);
                if (mConverter == null) mValueType = variant;

                return method;
            }
            catch (NoSuchMethodException failure)
            {
                continue;
            }
        }

        if (!variants[0].isPrimitive())
        {
            for (Method method : targetClass.getMethods())
            {
                if (!method.getName().equals(methodName) || method.getParameterTypes().length != 1) continue;
                if (method.getParameterTypes()[0].isAssignableFrom(valueType)) return method;
            }
        }

        Log.w(TAG, "Method " + methodName + "() with type " + valueType + " not found on target class " + targetClass);
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public PropertyValuesHolder clone()
    {
        try
        {
            PropertyValuesHolder copy = (PropertyValuesHolder)super.clone();
            copy.mPropertyName = mPropertyName;
            copy.mProperty = mProperty;
            copy.mKeyframes = mKeyframes == null ? null : mKeyframes.clone();
            copy.mEvaluator = mEvaluator;

            return copy;
        }
        catch (CloneNotSupportedException failure)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mPropertyName + ": " + mKeyframes;
    }

    private static final class PointToFloatArrayConverter extends TypeConverter<PointF, float[]>
    {
        PointToFloatArrayConverter()
        {
            super(PointF.class, float[].class);
        }

        @Override
        public float[] convert(PointF value)
        {
            return new float[] {value.x, value.y};
        }
    }

    private static final class PointToIntArrayConverter extends TypeConverter<PointF, int[]>
    {
        PointToIntArrayConverter()
        {
            super(PointF.class, int[].class);
        }

        @Override
        public int[] convert(PointF value)
        {
            return new int[] {Math.round(value.x), Math.round(value.y)};
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/animation/RectEvaluator.java`:

```java
package android.animation;

import android.graphics.Rect;

public class RectEvaluator implements TypeEvaluator<Rect>
{
    private Rect mReuse;

    public RectEvaluator()
    {
    }

    public RectEvaluator(Rect reuse)
    {
        mReuse = reuse;
    }

    @Override
    public Rect evaluate(float fraction, Rect startValue, Rect endValue)
    {
        if (startValue == null || endValue == null) return endValue;

        int left = startValue.left + (int)((endValue.left - startValue.left) * fraction);
        int top = startValue.top + (int)((endValue.top - startValue.top) * fraction);
        int right = startValue.right + (int)((endValue.right - startValue.right) * fraction);
        int bottom = startValue.bottom + (int)((endValue.bottom - startValue.bottom) * fraction);

        if (mReuse == null) return new Rect(left, top, right, bottom);

        mReuse.set(left, top, right, bottom);
        return mReuse;
    }
}
```

`java/android/animation/StateListAnimator.java`:

```java
package android.animation;

import android.util.StateSet;
import android.view.View;
import java.lang.ref.WeakReference;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public class StateListAnimator implements Cloneable
{
    private ArrayList<Tuple> mTuples = new ArrayList<>();
    private Tuple mLastMatch;
    private Animator mRunningAnimator;
    private WeakReference<View> mViewRef;
    private int mChangingConfigurations;

    private Animator.AnimatorListener mAnimatorListener = createListener();

    public StateListAnimator()
    {
    }

    private Animator.AnimatorListener createListener()
    {
        return new AnimatorListenerAdapter()
        {
            @Override
            public void onAnimationEnd(Animator animation)
            {
                animation.setTarget(null);
                if (mRunningAnimator == animation) mRunningAnimator = null;
            }
        };
    }

    public void addState(int[] specs, Animator animator)
    {
        Tuple tuple = new Tuple(specs, animator);
        animator.addListener(mAnimatorListener);
        mTuples.add(tuple);
    }

    public Animator getRunningAnimator()
    {
        return mRunningAnimator;
    }

    public View getTarget()
    {
        return mViewRef == null ? null : mViewRef.get();
    }

    public void setTarget(View view)
    {
        View current = getTarget();
        if (current == view) return;

        if (current != null) clearTarget();
        if (view != null) mViewRef = new WeakReference<>(view);
    }

    private void clearTarget()
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mTuples.size(); index++)
        {
            mTuples.get(index).mAnimator.setTarget(null);
        }

        mViewRef = null;
        mLastMatch = null;
        mRunningAnimator = null;
    }

    public void setState(int[] state)
    {
        Tuple match = null;

        for (int index = 0; index < mTuples.size(); index++)
        {
            Tuple tuple = mTuples.get(index);
            if (StateSet.stateSetMatches(tuple.mSpecs, state))
            {
                match = tuple;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (match == mLastMatch) return;

        if (mLastMatch != null) cancel();

        mLastMatch = match;

        if (match != null) start(match);
    }

    private void start(Tuple match)
    {
        match.mAnimator.setTarget(getTarget());
        mRunningAnimator = match.mAnimator;
        mRunningAnimator.start();
    }

    private void cancel()
    {
        if (mRunningAnimator == null) return;

        mRunningAnimator.cancel();
        mRunningAnimator = null;
    }

    public void jumpToCurrentState()
    {
        if (mRunningAnimator != null) mRunningAnimator.end();
    }

    public int getChangingConfigurations()
    {
        return mChangingConfigurations;
    }

    public void setChangingConfigurations(int configs)
    {
        mChangingConfigurations = configs;
    }

    public void appendChangingConfigurations(int configs)
    {
        mChangingConfigurations |= configs;
    }

    @Override
    public StateListAnimator clone()
    {
        try
        {
            StateListAnimator clone = (StateListAnimator)super.clone();
            clone.mTuples = new ArrayList<>(mTuples.size());
            clone.mLastMatch = null;
            clone.mRunningAnimator = null;
            clone.mViewRef = null;
            clone.mAnimatorListener = clone.createListener();

            for (int index = 0; index < mTuples.size(); index++)
            {
                Tuple tuple = mTuples.get(index);
                clone.addState(tuple.mSpecs, tuple.mAnimator);
            }

            return clone;
        }
        catch (CloneNotSupportedException exception)
        {
            throw new AssertionError("cannot clone state list animator", exception);
        }
    }

    public ArrayList<Tuple> getTuples()
    {
        return mTuples;
    }

    public static class Tuple
    {
        final int[] mSpecs;
        final Animator mAnimator;

        Tuple(int[] specs, Animator animator)
        {
            mSpecs = specs;
            mAnimator = animator;
        }

        public int[] getSpecs()
        {
            return mSpecs;
        }

        public Animator getAnimator()
        {
            return mAnimator;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/animation/ValueAnimator.java`:
