```java
package android.animation;

import android.view.Choreographer;
import android.view.animation.AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;

public class ValueAnimator extends Animator
{
    public static final int RESTART = 1;
    public static final int REVERSE = 2;
    public static final int INFINITE = -1;

    private static final TimeInterpolator sDefaultInterpolator = new AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator();
    private static final ArrayList<DurationScaleChangeListener> sDurationScaleListeners = new ArrayList<>();

    private static float sDurationScale = 1.0f;
    private static long sFrameDelay = 10;

    PropertyValuesHolder[] mValues;
    HashMap<String, PropertyValuesHolder> mValuesMap;
    boolean mInitialized;

    private ArrayList<AnimatorUpdateListener> mUpdateListeners = new ArrayList<>();
    private Choreographer.FrameCallback mFrameCallback = createFrameCallback();
    private Choreographer mChoreographer;

    private long mDuration = 300;
    private long mStartDelay;
    private int mRepeatCount;
    private int mRepeatMode = RESTART;
    private TimeInterpolator mInterpolator = sDefaultInterpolator;

    private long mStartTime = -1;
    private long mLastFrameTime = -1;
    private long mPauseNanos = -1;
    private float mSeekFraction = -1;
    private float mOverallFraction;
    private float mCurrentFraction;
    private boolean mStarted;
    private boolean mRunning;
    private boolean mReversing;
    private boolean mCallbackPosted;

    public ValueAnimator()
    {
    }

    public static ValueAnimator ofInt(int... values)
    {
        ValueAnimator animator = new ValueAnimator();
        animator.setIntValues(values);

        return animator;
    }

    public static ValueAnimator ofArgb(int... values)
    {
        ValueAnimator animator = new ValueAnimator();
        animator.setIntValues(values);
        animator.setEvaluator(ArgbEvaluator.getInstance());

        return animator;
    }

    public static ValueAnimator ofFloat(float... values)
    {
        ValueAnimator animator = new ValueAnimator();
        animator.setFloatValues(values);

        return animator;
    }

    public static ValueAnimator ofPropertyValuesHolder(PropertyValuesHolder... values)
    {
        ValueAnimator animator = new ValueAnimator();
        animator.setValues(values);

        return animator;
    }

    public static ValueAnimator ofObject(TypeEvaluator evaluator, Object... values)
    {
        ValueAnimator animator = new ValueAnimator();
        animator.setObjectValues(values);
        animator.setEvaluator(evaluator);

        return animator;
    }

    public static float getDurationScale()
    {
        return sDurationScale;
    }

    public static void setDurationScale(float scale)
    {
        sDurationScale = scale;

        ArrayList<DurationScaleChangeListener> listeners;

        synchronized (sDurationScaleListeners)
        {
            listeners = new ArrayList<>(sDurationScaleListeners);
        }

        for (DurationScaleChangeListener listener : listeners) listener.onChanged(scale);
    }

    public static boolean registerDurationScaleChangeListener(DurationScaleChangeListener listener)
    {
        if (listener == null) return false;

        synchronized (sDurationScaleListeners)
        {
            if (sDurationScaleListeners.contains(listener)) return false;

            return sDurationScaleListeners.add(listener);
        }
    }

    public static boolean unregisterDurationScaleChangeListener(DurationScaleChangeListener listener)
    {
        synchronized (sDurationScaleListeners)
        {
            return sDurationScaleListeners.remove(listener);
        }
    }

    public static boolean areAnimatorsEnabled()
    {
        return !(sDurationScale == 0);
    }

    public static long getFrameDelay()
    {
        return sFrameDelay;
    }

    public static void setFrameDelay(long frameDelay)
    {
        sFrameDelay = frameDelay;
    }

    public void setIntValues(int... values)
    {
        if (values == null || values.length == 0) return;

        if (mValues == null || mValues.length == 0) setValues(PropertyValuesHolder.ofInt("", values));
        else mValues[0].setIntValues(values);

        mInitialized = false;
    }

    public void setFloatValues(float... values)
    {
        if (values == null || values.length == 0) return;

        if (mValues == null || mValues.length == 0) setValues(PropertyValuesHolder.ofFloat("", values));
        else mValues[0].setFloatValues(values);

        mInitialized = false;
    }

    public void setObjectValues(Object... values)
    {
        if (values == null || values.length == 0) return;

        if (mValues == null || mValues.length == 0) setValues(PropertyValuesHolder.ofObject("", (TypeEvaluator)null, values));
        else mValues[0].setObjectValues(values);

        mInitialized = false;
    }

    public void setValues(PropertyValuesHolder... values)
    {
        int count = values == null ? 0 : values.length;
        mValues = values;
        mValuesMap = new HashMap<>(count);

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            PropertyValuesHolder holder = values[index];
            mValuesMap.put(holder.getPropertyName(), holder);
        }

        mInitialized = false;
    }

    public PropertyValuesHolder[] getValues()
    {
        return mValues;
    }

    void initAnimation()
    {
        if (mInitialized) return;

        if (mValues != null)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < mValues.length; index++) mValues[index].init();
        }

        mInitialized = true;
    }

    @Override
    public ValueAnimator setDuration(long duration)
    {
        if (duration < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Animators cannot have negative duration: " + duration);

        mDuration = duration;
        return this;
    }

    private long getScaledDuration()
    {
        return (long)(mDuration * sDurationScale);
    }

    @Override
    public long getDuration()
    {
        return mDuration;
    }

    @Override
    public long getTotalDuration()
    {
        if (mRepeatCount == INFINITE) return DURATION_INFINITE;

        return mStartDelay + (mDuration * (mRepeatCount + 1));
    }

    public void setCurrentPlayTime(long playTime)
    {
        float fraction = mDuration > 0 ? (float)playTime / mDuration : 1;
        setCurrentFraction(fraction);
    }

    public void setCurrentFraction(float fraction)
    {
        initAnimation();
        fraction = clampFraction(fraction);

        if (mLastFrameTime >= 0)
        {
            long seekTime = (long)(getScaledDuration() * fraction);
            mStartTime = mLastFrameTime - seekTime;
            mSeekFraction = -1;
        }
        else
        {
            mSeekFraction = fraction;
        }

        mOverallFraction = fraction;
        float currentIterationFraction = getCurrentIterationFraction(fraction, mReversing);
        animateValue(currentIterationFraction);
    }

    private int getCurrentIteration(float fraction)
    {
        fraction = clampFraction(fraction);
        double iteration = Math.floor(fraction);
        if (fraction == iteration && fraction > 0) iteration--;

        return (int)iteration;
    }

    private float getCurrentIterationFraction(float fraction, boolean inReverse)
    {
        fraction = clampFraction(fraction);
        int iteration = getCurrentIteration(fraction);
        float currentFraction = fraction - iteration;

        return shouldPlayBackward(iteration, inReverse) ? 1.0f - currentFraction : currentFraction;
    }

    private float clampFraction(float fraction)
    {
        if (fraction < 0) return 0;
        if (mRepeatCount != INFINITE) return Math.min(fraction, mRepeatCount + 1);

        return fraction;
    }

    private boolean shouldPlayBackward(int iteration, boolean inReverse)
    {
        if (iteration > 0 && mRepeatMode == REVERSE && (iteration < (mRepeatCount + 1) || mRepeatCount == INFINITE))
        {
            if (inReverse) return (iteration % 2) == 0;

            return (iteration % 2) != 0;
        }

        return inReverse;
    }

    public long getCurrentPlayTime()
    {
        if (!mInitialized || (!mStarted && mSeekFraction < 0)) return 0;
        if (mSeekFraction >= 0) return (long)(mDuration * mSeekFraction);
        if (mStartTime < 0 || mLastFrameTime < 0) return 0;

        float durationScale = sDurationScale == 0 ? 1 : sDurationScale;
        return (long)((mLastFrameTime - mStartTime) / durationScale);
    }

    @Override
    public long getStartDelay()
    {
        return mStartDelay;
    }

    @Override
    public void setStartDelay(long startDelay)
    {
        if (startDelay < 0)
        {
            android.util.Log.w("ValueAnimator", "Start delay should always be non-negative");
            startDelay = 0;
        }

        mStartDelay = startDelay;
    }

    public Object getAnimatedValue()
    {
        if (mValues != null && mValues.length > 0) return mValues[0].getAnimatedValue();

        return null;
    }

    public Object getAnimatedValue(String propertyName)
    {
        PropertyValuesHolder holder = mValuesMap == null ? null : mValuesMap.get(propertyName);

        return holder != null ? holder.getAnimatedValue() : null;
    }

    public void setRepeatCount(int value)
    {
        mRepeatCount = value;
    }

    public int getRepeatCount()
    {
        return mRepeatCount;
    }

    public void setRepeatMode(int value)
    {
        mRepeatMode = value;
    }

    public int getRepeatMode()
    {
        return mRepeatMode;
    }

    public void addUpdateListener(AnimatorUpdateListener listener)
    {
        if (listener != null) mUpdateListeners.add(listener);
    }

    public void removeAllUpdateListeners()
    {
        mUpdateListeners.clear();
    }

    public void removeUpdateListener(AnimatorUpdateListener listener)
    {
        mUpdateListeners.remove(listener);
    }

    @Override
    public void setInterpolator(TimeInterpolator value)
    {
        mInterpolator = value != null ? value : new LinearInterpolator();
    }

    @Override
    public TimeInterpolator getInterpolator()
    {
        return mInterpolator;
    }

    public void setEvaluator(TypeEvaluator value)
    {
        if (value != null && mValues != null && mValues.length > 0) mValues[0].setEvaluator(value);
    }

    @Override
    public void start()
    {
        start(false);
    }

    private void start(boolean playBackwards)
    {
        mReversing = playBackwards;

        if (playBackwards && mSeekFraction != -1 && mSeekFraction != 0)
        {
            if (mRepeatCount == INFINITE)
            {
                float fraction = (float)(mSeekFraction - Math.floor(mSeekFraction));
                mSeekFraction = 1 - fraction;
            }
            else
            {
                mSeekFraction = 1 + mRepeatCount - mSeekFraction;
            }
        }

        mStarted = true;
        clearPaused();
        mRunning = false;
        mStartTime = -1;
        mLastFrameTime = -1;
        mPauseNanos = -1;

        postFrame();

        if (mStartDelay == 0 || mSeekFraction >= 0 || mReversing)
        {
            startAnimation();

            if (mSeekFraction == -1) setCurrentPlayTime(0);
            else setCurrentFraction(mSeekFraction);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void cancel()
    {
        if (!mStarted && !mRunning) return;

        if (!mRunning) notifyStart(mReversing);
        notifyCancel();

        endAnimation();
    }

    @Override
    public void end()
    {
        if (!mRunning)
        {
            startAnimation();
            mStarted = true;
        }
        else if (!mInitialized)
        {
            initAnimation();
        }

        animateValue(shouldPlayBackward(mRepeatCount, mReversing) ? 0.0f : 1.0f);
        endAnimation();
    }

    @Override
    public void resume()
    {
        if (isPaused())
        {
            if (mPauseNanos >= 0 && mStartTime >= 0)
            {
                mStartTime += (System.nanoTime() - mPauseNanos) / 1000000L;
            }

            mPauseNanos = -1;
            postFrame();
        }

        super.resume();
    }

    @Override
    public void pause()
    {
        boolean previouslyPaused = isPaused();
        super.pause();

        if (!previouslyPaused && isPaused())
        {
            mPauseNanos = System.nanoTime();
            removeFrame();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isRunning()
    {
        return mRunning;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isStarted()
    {
        return mStarted;
    }

    @Override
    public void reverse()
    {
        if (mStarted && mLastFrameTime >= 0)
        {
            long currentTime = mLastFrameTime;
            long currentPlayTime = currentTime - mStartTime;
            long timeLeft = getScaledDuration() - currentPlayTime;
            mStartTime = currentTime - timeLeft;
            mReversing = !mReversing;
        }
        else if (mStarted)
        {
            mReversing = !mReversing;
            end();
        }
        else
        {
            start(true);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canReverse()
    {
        return true;
    }

    private void endAnimation()
    {
        removeFrame();

        boolean notify = mStarted || mRunning;

        mRunning = false;
        mStarted = false;
        mStartTime = -1;
        mLastFrameTime = -1;
        mPauseNanos = -1;
        mSeekFraction = -1;
        clearPaused();

        if (notify) notifyEnd(mReversing);

        mReversing = false;
    }

    private void startAnimation()
    {
        initAnimation();
        mRunning = true;

        if (mSeekFraction >= 0) mOverallFraction = mSeekFraction;
        else mOverallFraction = 0.0f;

        notifyStart(mReversing);
    }

    private void postFrame()
    {
        if (mCallbackPosted) return;

        if (mChoreographer == null) mChoreographer = Choreographer.getInstance();

        mCallbackPosted = true;
        mChoreographer.postFrameCallback(mFrameCallback);
    }

    private void removeFrame()
    {
        if (!mCallbackPosted) return;

        mCallbackPosted = false;
        if (mChoreographer != null) mChoreographer.removeFrameCallback(mFrameCallback);
    }

    private Choreographer.FrameCallback createFrameCallback()
    {
        return new Choreographer.FrameCallback()
        {
            @Override
            public void doFrame(long frameTimeNanos)
            {
                mCallbackPosted = false;
                doAnimationFrame(frameTimeNanos / 1000000L);
            }
        };
    }

    private void doAnimationFrame(long frameTime)
    {
        if (!mStarted || isPaused()) return;

        if (mStartTime < 0)
        {
            mStartTime = mReversing ? frameTime : frameTime + (long)(mStartDelay * sDurationScale);
        }

        if (!mRunning)
        {
            if (mStartTime > frameTime && mSeekFraction == -1)
            {
                postFrame();
                return;
            }

            startAnimation();
        }

        mLastFrameTime = frameTime;

        if (mSeekFraction >= 0)
        {
            mStartTime = frameTime - (long)(getScaledDuration() * mSeekFraction);
            mSeekFraction = -1;
        }

        long currentTime = Math.max(frameTime, mStartTime);
        boolean finished = animateBasedOnTime(currentTime);

        if (finished)
        {
            endAnimation();
            return;
        }

        if (mStarted) postFrame();
    }

    private boolean animateBasedOnTime(long currentTime)
    {
        boolean done = false;

        if (mRunning)
        {
            long scaledDuration = getScaledDuration();
            float fraction = scaledDuration > 0 ? (float)(currentTime - mStartTime) / scaledDuration : 1.0f;
            float lastFraction = mOverallFraction;
            boolean newIteration = (int)fraction > (int)lastFraction;
            boolean lastIterationFinished = (fraction >= mRepeatCount + 1) && (mRepeatCount != INFINITE);

            if (scaledDuration == 0)
            {
                done = true;
            }
            else if (newIteration && !lastIterationFinished)
            {
                notifyRepeat();
            }
            else if (lastIterationFinished)
            {
                done = true;
            }

            mOverallFraction = clampFraction(fraction);
            float currentIterationFraction = getCurrentIterationFraction(mOverallFraction, mReversing);
            animateValue(currentIterationFraction);
        }

        return done;
    }

    public float getAnimatedFraction()
    {
        return mCurrentFraction;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    void animateValue(float fraction)
    {
        fraction = mInterpolator.getInterpolation(fraction);
        mCurrentFraction = fraction;

        if (mValues != null)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < mValues.length; index++) mValues[index].calculateValue(fraction);
        }

        if (mUpdateListeners.isEmpty()) return;

        ArrayList<AnimatorUpdateListener> listeners = (ArrayList<AnimatorUpdateListener>)mUpdateListeners.clone();
        for (int index = 0; index < listeners.size(); index++) listeners.get(index).onAnimationUpdate(this);
    }

    @Override
    public ValueAnimator clone()
    {
        ValueAnimator copy = (ValueAnimator)super.clone();
        copy.mUpdateListeners = new ArrayList<>(mUpdateListeners);
        copy.mFrameCallback = copy.createFrameCallback();
        copy.mChoreographer = null;
        copy.mCallbackPosted = false;
        copy.mSeekFraction = -1;
        copy.mReversing = false;
        copy.mInitialized = false;
        copy.mStarted = false;
        copy.mRunning = false;
        copy.mStartTime = -1;
        copy.mLastFrameTime = -1;
        copy.mPauseNanos = -1;
        copy.mOverallFraction = 0;
        copy.mCurrentFraction = 0;

        PropertyValuesHolder[] values = mValues;

        if (values != null)
        {
            int count = values.length;
            copy.mValues = new PropertyValuesHolder[count];
            copy.mValuesMap = new HashMap<>(count);

            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                PropertyValuesHolder holder = values[index].clone();
                copy.mValues[index] = holder;
                copy.mValuesMap.put(holder.getPropertyName(), holder);
            }
        }

        return copy;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder("ValueAnimator@" + Integer.toHexString(hashCode()));

        if (mValues != null)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < mValues.length; index++) builder.append("\n    ").append(mValues[index].toString());
        }

        return builder.toString();
    }

    public interface AnimatorUpdateListener
    {
        void onAnimationUpdate(ValueAnimator animation);
    }

    public interface DurationScaleChangeListener
    {
        void onChanged(float scale);
    }
}
```

`java/android/app/ActionBar.java`:

```java
package android.app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.SpinnerAdapter;

public abstract class ActionBar
{

    public static class LayoutParams extends ViewGroup.MarginLayoutParams
    {
        private static StyleableSet sGravityStyleable;

        public int gravity = Gravity.NO_GRAVITY;

        public LayoutParams(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
        {
            super(context, attributes);

            if (attributes == null) return;

            if (sGravityStyleable == null) sGravityStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "layout_gravity");
            if (sGravityStyleable.isEmpty()) return;

            android.content.res.TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sGravityStyleable.attributes(), 0, 0);
            gravity = array.getInt(0, Gravity.NO_GRAVITY);
            array.recycle();
        }

        public LayoutParams(int width, int height)
        {
            super(width, height);
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL | Gravity.START;
        }

        public LayoutParams(int width, int height, int gravity)
        {
            super(width, height);
            this.gravity = gravity;
        }

        public LayoutParams(int gravity)
        {
            this(WRAP_CONTENT, MATCH_PARENT, gravity);
        }

        public LayoutParams(LayoutParams source)
        {
            super(source);
            gravity = source.gravity;
        }

        public LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams source)
        {
            super(source);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    public boolean dispatchGenericMotionEvent(android.view.MotionEvent event)
    {
        android.view.View decor = getWindow() == null ? null : getWindow().getDecorView();
        if (decor != null && decor.dispatchGenericMotionEvent(event)) return true;

    public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(android.view.MotionEvent event)
    {
        boolean traced = android.view.View.TRACE_INPUT;
        boolean consumedByView = getWindow() != null && getWindow().superDispatchTouchEvent(event);

        if (consumedByView)
        {
            if (traced) android.util.Log.i("Activity", "the view hierarchy consumed action " + event.getActionMasked());
            return true;
        }

        boolean handled = onTouchEvent(event);

        if (traced)
        {
            android.util.Log.i("Activity", "onTouchEvent(" + event.getActionMasked() + ") on "
                                               + getClass().getName() + " returned " + handled);
        }

        return handled;
    }

    public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(android.view.KeyEvent event)
    {
        if (android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager.getInstance().dispatchKeyEvent(event)) return true;

        if (getWindow() != null && getWindow().superDispatchKeyEvent(event)) return true;

        if (event.getAction() == android.view.KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) return onKeyDown(event.getKeyCode(), event);
        if (event.getAction() == android.view.KeyEvent.ACTION_UP) return onKeyUp(event.getKeyCode(), event);

        return false;
    }

    private RuntimeActionBar mActionBar;

    private boolean mActionBarResolved;

    public ActionBar getActionBar()

    public void setActionBar(android.widget.Toolbar toolbar)
    {
        mActionBarResolved = true;
        if (mActionBarOwnedByDecor) detachDecorActionBar();

        mActionBar = toolbar == null ? null : new RuntimeActionBar(toolbar, getTitle(), this);
        scheduleOptionsMenu();
    }

    private boolean themeFlag(String name)
    {
        int attribute = getResources().getIdentifier(name, "attr", "android");
        if (attribute == 0) return false;

        android.util.TypedValue value = new android.util.TypedValue();
        if (!getTheme().resolveAttribute(attribute, value, true)) return false;

        return value.type == android.util.TypedValue.TYPE_INT_BOOLEAN && value.data != 0;
    }

    private void initWindowDecorActionBar()
    {
        if (mActionBarResolved || mWindow == null) return;
        mActionBarResolved = true;

        if (mWindow.hasFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE) || themeFlag("windowNoTitle")) return;
        if (!mWindow.hasFeature(Window.FEATURE_ACTION_BAR) && !themeFlag("windowActionBar")) return;
        if (!(mWindow.getDecorView() instanceof android.view.DecorView)) return;

        mActionBar = new RuntimeActionBar(this, this);
        mActionBar.setTitle(getTitle());
        ((android.view.DecorView)mWindow.getDecorView()).setActionBarView(mActionBar.getView());
        mActionBarOwnedByDecor = true;

        scheduleOptionsMenu();
    }

    private void detachDecorActionBar()
    {
        if (mWindow != null && mWindow.getDecorView() instanceof android.view.DecorView)
        {
            ((android.view.DecorView)mWindow.getDecorView()).setActionBarView(null);
        }

        mActionBarOwnedByDecor = false;
    }

    private void scheduleOptionsMenu()
    {
        View decor = mWindow == null ? null : mWindow.getDecorView();
        if (decor == null || mActionBar == null) return;

        decor.post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                if (mActionBar != null) mActionBar.invalidateOptionsMenu();
            }
        });
    }

    public void registerScreenCaptureCallback(java.util.concurrent.Executor executor, ScreenCaptureCallback callback)
    {
        if (executor == null || callback == null) throw new NullPointerException("executor and callback must not be null");

        synchronized (mScreenCaptureCallbacks)
        {
            mScreenCaptureCallbacks.add(new ScreenCaptureRegistration(executor, callback));
        }
    }

    public void unregisterScreenCaptureCallback(ScreenCaptureCallback callback)
    {
        synchronized (mScreenCaptureCallbacks)
        {
            for (int index = mScreenCaptureCallbacks.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
            {
                if (mScreenCaptureCallbacks.get(index).mCallback == callback) mScreenCaptureCallbacks.remove(index);
            }
        }
    }

    void dispatchScreenCaptured()
    {
        java.util.ArrayList<ScreenCaptureRegistration> registrations;
        synchronized (mScreenCaptureCallbacks)
        {
            registrations = new java.util.ArrayList<>(mScreenCaptureCallbacks);
        }

        for (final ScreenCaptureRegistration registration : registrations)
        {
            registration.mExecutor.execute(new Runnable()
            {
                @Override
                public void run()
                {
                    registration.mCallback.onScreenCaptured();
                }
            });
        }
    }

    public android.view.DragAndDropPermissions requestDragAndDropPermissions(android.view.DragEvent event)
    {
        if (event == null || event.getClipData() == null) return null;

        android.os.Parcel parcel = android.os.Parcel.obtain();
        try
        {
            parcel.writeBoolean(true);
            parcel.setDataPosition(0);
            return android.view.DragAndDropPermissions.CREATOR.createFromParcel(parcel);
        }
        finally
        {
            parcel.recycle();
        }
    }

    public void startActivityFromFragment(Fragment fragment, android.content.Intent intent, int requestCode, Bundle options)
    {

        {
            startActivity(intent, options);
            return;

        startActivityForResult(intent, fragmentRequestCode(fragment, requestCode), options);
    }

    private int fragmentRequestCode(Fragment fragment, int requestCode)
    {
        int code = FRAGMENT_REQUEST_BASE + (mNextFragmentRequest++ & 0xffff);
        mFragmentRequests.put(code, new FragmentRequest(fragment, requestCode));
        return code;
    }

    void startIntentSenderFromFragment(Fragment fragment, android.content.IntentSender sender, int requestCode, android.content.Intent fillIn,
                                       int flagsMask, int flagsValues) throws android.content.IntentSender.SendIntentException
    {
        startIntentSenderInternal(sender, requestCode < 0 ? -1 : fragmentRequestCode(fragment, requestCode), fillIn, flagsMask, flagsValues);
    }

        startIntentSenderInternal(intent, -1, fillInIntent, flagsMask, flagsValues);
    }

    public void startIntentSender(android.content.IntentSender intent, android.content.Intent fillInIntent, int flagsMask, int flagsValues,
                                  int extraFlags, Bundle options) throws android.content.IntentSender.SendIntentException
    {
        startIntentSenderInternal(intent, -1, fillInIntent, flagsMask, flagsValues);
    }

    private void startIntentSenderInternal(android.content.IntentSender sender, int requestCode, android.content.Intent fillIn, int flagsMask,
                                           int flagsValues) throws android.content.IntentSender.SendIntentException
    {
        if (sender == null) throw new android.content.IntentSender.SendIntentException("the IntentSender is null");

        PendingIntent pending = sender.getPendingIntent();

        if (pending != null && pending.isActivity() && pending.getIntent() != null)
        {
            android.content.Intent launch = new android.content.Intent(pending.getIntent());
            if (fillIn != null) launch.fillIn(fillIn, 0);
            launch.setFlags((launch.getFlags() & ~flagsMask) | (flagsValues & flagsMask));

            runtime.Activities.start(launch, requestCode);
            return;
        }

        sender.sendIntent(this, 0, fillIn, null, null);
    }

    {

    }

    private void requestPermissionsFor(final Fragment fragment, final String[] permissions, final int requestCode)
    {
        if (permissions == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("permissions must not be null");

        final String[] requested = permissions.clone();
        final int[] results = new int[requested.length];

        for (int index = 0; index < requested.length; index++)
        {
            results[index] = runtime.Permissions.check(requested[index]);

            if (results[index] == android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) continue;
            if (!runtime.Permissions.isDeclared(requested[index]))
            {
                android.util.Log.w("Activity", requested[index] + " was requested but the manifest does not declare it, so it stays denied");
                continue;
            }

            runtime.Permissions.deny(requested[index]);
        }

        new android.os.Handler(android.os.Looper.getMainLooper()).post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                if (fragment != null) fragment.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, requested, results);
                else onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, requested, results);
            }
        });
    }

    public boolean shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale(String permission)
    {
        return runtime.Permissions.isDeclared(permission) && runtime.Permissions.wasRefused(permission);
    }

    public void registerActivityLifecycleCallbacks(Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks callback)
    {
        if (callback == null) return;

        synchronized (mLifecycleCallbacks)
        {
            mLifecycleCallbacks.add(callback);
        }
    }

    public void unregisterActivityLifecycleCallbacks(Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks callback)
    {
        synchronized (mLifecycleCallbacks)
        {
            mLifecycleCallbacks.remove(callback);
        }
    }

    private Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks[] collectLifecycleCallbacks()
    {
        java.util.ArrayList<Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks> collected = new java.util.ArrayList<>();

        synchronized (mLifecycleCallbacks)
        {
            collected.addAll(mLifecycleCallbacks);
        }

        Application application = getApplication();
        if (application != null)
        {
            for (Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks callback : application.collectActivityLifecycleCallbacks())
            {
                collected.add(callback);
            }
        }

        return collected.toArray(new Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks[0]);
    }

    void dispatchLifecycleCreated(android.os.Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
        mFragmentManager.dispatchCreate();
        mFragmentManager.dispatchActivityCreated();

        for (Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks callback : collectLifecycleCallbacks())
        {
            callback.onActivityPreCreated(this, savedInstanceState);
            callback.onActivityCreated(this, savedInstanceState);
            callback.onActivityPostCreated(this, savedInstanceState);
        }
    }

    void dispatchLifecycleSaveInstanceState(android.os.Bundle outState)
    {
        for (Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks callback : collectLifecycleCallbacks())
        {
            callback.onActivitySaveInstanceState(this, outState);
        }
    }

    void dispatchLifecycleStarted()
    {
        mFragmentManager.dispatchStart();
        mLoadersStarted = true;
        if (mLoaderManager != null) mLoaderManager.doStart();

        for (Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks callback : collectLifecycleCallbacks())
        {
            callback.onActivityPreStarted(this);
            callback.onActivityStarted(this);
            callback.onActivityPostStarted(this);
        }
    }

    void dispatchLifecycleResumed()
    {
        mFragmentManager.dispatchResume();

        for (Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks callback : collectLifecycleCallbacks())
        {
            callback.onActivityPreResumed(this);
            callback.onActivityResumed(this);
            callback.onActivityPostResumed(this);
        }
    }

    void dispatchLifecyclePaused()
    {
        mFragmentManager.dispatchPause();

        for (Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks callback : collectLifecycleCallbacks())
        {
            callback.onActivityPrePaused(this);
            callback.onActivityPaused(this);
            callback.onActivityPostPaused(this);
        }
    }

    void dispatchLifecycleStopped()
    {
        mFragmentManager.dispatchStop();
        mLoadersStarted = false;
        if (mLoaderManager != null) mLoaderManager.doStop();

        for (Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks callback : collectLifecycleCallbacks())
        {
            callback.onActivityPreStopped(this);
            callback.onActivityStopped(this);
            callback.onActivityPostStopped(this);
        }
    }

    void dispatchLifecycleDestroyed()
    {
        mFragmentManager.dispatchDestroy();
        mFragmentRequests.clear();

        if (mLoaderManager != null)
        {
            mLoaderManager.doDestroy();
            mLoaderManager = null;
        }

        for (Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks callback : collectLifecycleCallbacks())
        {
            callback.onActivityPreDestroyed(this);
            callback.onActivityDestroyed(this);
            callback.onActivityPostDestroyed(this);
        }
    }

    private final java.util.ArrayList<Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks> mLifecycleCallbacks =
        new java.util.ArrayList<>();
}
```

```java
package android.app;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class ActivityManager
{
    public static final int RECENT_WITH_EXCLUDED = 0x0001;

    private static byte[] sProcessStateSummary;

    private final android.content.Context mContext;

    public ActivityManager(android.content.Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public List<RunningAppProcessInfo> getRunningAppProcesses()
    {
        RunningAppProcessInfo running = new RunningAppProcessInfo();
        running.pid = android.os.Process.myPid();
        running.uid = android.os.Process.myUid();
        running.processName = mContext == null ? "" : mContext.getPackageName();
        running.importance = RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_FOREGROUND;
        running.pkgList = new String[] {running.processName};

        List<RunningAppProcessInfo> processes = new ArrayList<>();
        processes.add(running);
        return processes;
    }

    public List<ApplicationExitInfo> getHistoricalProcessExitReasons(String packageName, int pid, int maxNum)
    {
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public List<ApplicationStartInfo> getHistoricalProcessStartReasons(int maxNum)
    {
        List<ApplicationStartInfo> reasons = new ArrayList<>();
        if (maxNum >= 0) reasons.add(ApplicationStartInfo.current());
        return reasons;
    }

    public void addStartInfoTimestamp(int key, long timestampNs)
    {
        if (key < ApplicationStartInfo.START_TIMESTAMP_RESERVED_RANGE_DEVELOPER_START
            || key > ApplicationStartInfo.START_TIMESTAMP_RESERVED_RANGE_DEVELOPER)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("key " + key + " is outside the developer timestamp range");
        }

        ApplicationStartInfo.recordTimestamp(key, timestampNs);
    }

    public void addApplicationStartInfoCompletionListener(java.util.concurrent.Executor executor,
                                                          final java.util.function.Consumer<ApplicationStartInfo> listener)
    {
        if (executor == null || listener == null) throw new NullPointerException();

        final ApplicationStartInfo info = ApplicationStartInfo.current();
        executor.execute(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                listener.accept(info);
            }
        });
    }

    public void removeApplicationStartInfoCompletionListener(java.util.function.Consumer<ApplicationStartInfo> listener)
    {
    }

    public void setProcessStateSummary(byte[] state)
    {
        if (state != null && state.length > 128) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the process state summary is limited to 128 bytes");

        synchronized (ActivityManager.class)
        {
            sProcessStateSummary = state == null ? null : state.clone();
        }
    }

    public List<ProcessErrorStateInfo> getProcessesInErrorState()
    {
        return null;
    }

    public void getMemoryInfo(MemoryInfo out)
    {
        if (out == null) return;

        out.availMem = Runtime.getRuntime().freeMemory();
        out.totalMem = Runtime.getRuntime().maxMemory();
        out.advertisedMem = out.totalMem;
        out.threshold = out.totalMem / 16;
        out.lowMemory = false;
    }

    public android.os.Debug.MemoryInfo[] getProcessMemoryInfo(int[] pids)
    {
        int count = pids == null ? 0 : pids.length;
        android.os.Debug.MemoryInfo[] infos = new android.os.Debug.MemoryInfo[count];

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            infos[index] = new android.os.Debug.MemoryInfo();
            if (pids[index] == android.os.Process.myPid()) android.os.Debug.getMemoryInfo(infos[index]);
        }

        return infos;
    }

    public android.content.pm.ConfigurationInfo getDeviceConfigurationInfo()
    {
        android.content.pm.ConfigurationInfo info = new android.content.pm.ConfigurationInfo();
        info.reqGlEsVersion = packVersion(runtime.PlatformConfig.GL_ES_VERSION);
        return info;
    }

    private static int packVersion(String version)
    {
        int dot = version == null ? -1 : version.indexOf('.');
        if (dot <= 0) return android.content.pm.ConfigurationInfo.GL_ES_VERSION_UNDEFINED;

        try
        {
            int major = Integer.parseInt(version.substring(0, dot));
            int minor = Integer.parseInt(version.substring(dot + 1));
            return (major << 16) | (minor & 0xffff);
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
        {
            return android.content.pm.ConfigurationInfo.GL_ES_VERSION_UNDEFINED;
        }
    }

        return (int)(Runtime.getRuntime().maxMemory() >> 20);
```

```java
    public void update(ActivityOptions otherOptions)
    {
        if (otherOptions == null) return;

        if (otherOptions.mPackageName != null) mPackageName = otherOptions.mPackageName;
        if (otherOptions.mLaunchBounds != null) mLaunchBounds = otherOptions.mLaunchBounds;
        if (otherOptions.mAnimationType != ANIM_NONE)
        {
            mAnimationType = otherOptions.mAnimationType;
            mCustomEnterResId = otherOptions.mCustomEnterResId;
            mCustomExitResId = otherOptions.mCustomExitResId;
            mCustomBackgroundColor = otherOptions.mCustomBackgroundColor;
            mStartX = otherOptions.mStartX;
            mStartY = otherOptions.mStartY;
            mWidth = otherOptions.mWidth;
            mHeight = otherOptions.mHeight;
        }
        if (otherOptions.mUsageTimeReport != null) mUsageTimeReport = otherOptions.mUsageTimeReport;
    }

    public Bundle toBundle()
    {
        Bundle bundle = new Bundle();

        if (mPackageName != null) bundle.putString(KEY_PACKAGE_NAME, mPackageName);
        if (mLaunchBounds != null) bundle.putParcelable(KEY_LAUNCH_BOUNDS, mLaunchBounds);
        if (mAnimationType != ANIM_NONE) bundle.putInt(KEY_ANIM_TYPE, mAnimationType);

        if (mAnimationType == ANIM_CUSTOM)
        {
            bundle.putInt(KEY_ANIM_ENTER_RES_ID, mCustomEnterResId);
            bundle.putInt(KEY_ANIM_EXIT_RES_ID, mCustomExitResId);
            bundle.putInt(KEY_ANIM_BACKGROUND_COLOR, mCustomBackgroundColor);
        }
        else if (mAnimationType == ANIM_SCALE_UP || mAnimationType == ANIM_CLIP_REVEAL || mAnimationType == ANIM_THUMBNAIL_SCALE_UP)
        {
            bundle.putInt(KEY_ANIM_START_X, mStartX);
            bundle.putInt(KEY_ANIM_START_Y, mStartY);
            bundle.putInt(KEY_ANIM_WIDTH, mWidth);
            bundle.putInt(KEY_ANIM_HEIGHT, mHeight);
        }

        if (mLaunchDisplayId != INVALID_DISPLAY) bundle.putInt(KEY_LAUNCH_DISPLAY_ID, mLaunchDisplayId);
        if (mLockTaskMode) bundle.putBoolean(KEY_LOCK_TASK_MODE, true);
        if (mSplashScreenStyle != 0) bundle.putInt(KEY_SPLASH_SCREEN_STYLE, mSplashScreenStyle);
        if (mTaskLaunchBehind) bundle.putBoolean(KEY_TASK_LAUNCH_BEHIND, true);
        if (mShareIdentity) bundle.putBoolean(KEY_SHARE_IDENTITY, true);
        if (mAllowPassThroughOnTouchOutside) bundle.putBoolean(KEY_ALLOW_PASS_THROUGH_ON_TOUCH_OUTSIDE, true);

        if (mPendingIntentBackgroundStartMode != MODE_BACKGROUND_ACTIVITY_START_SYSTEM_DEFINED)
        {
            bundle.putInt(KEY_PENDING_INTENT_BACKGROUND_START_MODE, mPendingIntentBackgroundStartMode);
        }

        if (mPendingIntentCreatorBackgroundStartMode != MODE_BACKGROUND_ACTIVITY_START_SYSTEM_DEFINED)
        {
            bundle.putInt(KEY_PENDING_INTENT_CREATOR_BACKGROUND_START_MODE, mPendingIntentCreatorBackgroundStartMode);
        }

        if (mAppVerificationBundle != null) bundle.putBundle("android:activity.appVerificationBundle", mAppVerificationBundle);

        return bundle;
    }
```

```java
import android.content.ComponentName;

public final class ActivityThread
{
    public static final String TAG = "ActivityThread";

    public static final class ActivityClientRecord
    {
        public IBinder token;
        public Activity activity;
        public android.content.Intent intent;
        public String embeddedID;
        public Bundle state;
        public boolean paused;
        public boolean stopped;
        public boolean hideForNow;
        public android.content.pm.ActivityInfo activityInfo;

        ActivityClientRecord(IBinder token, Activity activity)
        {
            this.token = token;
            this.activity = activity;
            this.intent = activity.getIntent();
            this.paused = true;
        }

        public boolean isPaused()
        {
            return paused;
        }

        public boolean isStopped()
        {
            return stopped;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "ActivityRecord{" + Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(this)) + " token=" + token + " "
                   + (activity == null ? "no component name" : activity.getClass().getName()) + "}";
        }
    }

    final class H extends Handler
    {
        H(Looper looper)
        {
            super(looper);
        }
    }

    private final class ApplicationThread extends IApplicationThread.Stub
    {
    }

    private static volatile ActivityThread sCurrentActivityThread;
    private static volatile IPackageManager sPackageManager;

    final ApplicationThread mAppThread = new ApplicationThread();
    final Looper mLooper;
    final H mH;
    final ArrayMap<IBinder, ActivityClientRecord> mActivities = new ArrayMap<>();
    final ArrayList<Application> mAllApplications = new ArrayList<>();
    final ResourcesManager mResourcesManager = ResourcesManager.getInstance();
    final Instrumentation mInstrumentation = new Instrumentation();

    Application mInitialApplication;
    ContextImpl mSystemContext;
    Configuration mConfiguration;

    private final ArrayMap<Activity, IBinder> mTokens = new ArrayMap<>();
    private ContextImpl mBaseContext;

    private ActivityThread()
    {
        Looper main = Looper.getMainLooper();
        mLooper = main == null ? Looper.myLooper() : main;
        mH = new H(mLooper);
    }

    public static ActivityThread currentActivityThread()
    {
        ActivityThread thread = sCurrentActivityThread;
        if (thread != null) return thread;

        synchronized (ActivityThread.class)
        {
            if (sCurrentActivityThread == null) sCurrentActivityThread = new ActivityThread();
            return sCurrentActivityThread;
        }
    }

    public static void attachRuntime(ContextImpl base)
    {
        ActivityThread thread = currentActivityThread();
        ApplicationStartInfo.recordTimestamp(ApplicationStartInfo.START_TIMESTAMP_BIND_APPLICATION,
                                             android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos());

        synchronized (thread)
        {
            thread.mBaseContext = base;
            thread.mSystemContext = base;
            thread.mConfiguration = base.getResources().getConfiguration();
        }

        ResourcesManager.getInstance().attach(base.getResources());
        ServiceManager.addService("package", new PackageManagerBinder(base));
    }

        return false;
    }

        return currentActivityThread().getApplication();
    }

    {
        IPackageManager manager = sPackageManager;
        if (manager != null) return manager;

        manager = IPackageManager.Stub.asInterface(ServiceManager.getService("package"));
        sPackageManager = manager;
        return manager;
    }

    {
        return currentActivityThread();
    }

    public Application getApplication()
    {
        Application application = runtime.Bootstrap.getApplication();

        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (application != null && mInitialApplication != application)
            {
                mInitialApplication = application;
                if (!mAllApplications.contains(application)) mAllApplications.add(application);
            }

            return mInitialApplication;
        }
    }

        return info == null || info.processName == null ? base.getPackageName() : info.processName;
    }

    public boolean isProfiling()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public String getProfileFilePath()
    {
        return null;
    }

    public int getIntCoreSetting(String key, int defaultValue)
    {
        return defaultValue;
    }

    public String getStringCoreSetting(String key, String defaultValue)
    {
        return defaultValue;
    }

    public Bundle getCoreSettings()
    {
        return new Bundle();
    }

    public final Activity getActivity(IBinder token)
    {
        synchronized (mActivities)
        {
            ActivityClientRecord record = mActivities.get(token);
            return record == null ? null : record.activity;
        }
    }

    public ActivityClientRecord getActivityClient(IBinder token)
    {
        synchronized (mActivities)
        {
            return mActivities.get(token);
        }
    }

    public final Context getContextForActivity(IBinder token)
    {
        return getActivity(token);
    }

    public Handler getMainThreadHandler()
    {
        return mH;
    }

    void activityCreated(Activity activity)
    {
        synchronized (mActivities)
        {
            if (mTokens.containsKey(activity)) return;

            IBinder token = new Binder(activity.getClass().getName());
            mTokens.put(activity, token);
            mActivities.put(token, new ActivityClientRecord(token, activity));
        }
    }

    void activityStateChanged(Activity activity, boolean paused, boolean stopped)
    {
        synchronized (mActivities)
        {
            IBinder token = mTokens.get(activity);
            ActivityClientRecord record = token == null ? null : mActivities.get(token);
            if (record == null) return;

            record.paused = paused;
            record.stopped = stopped;
        }
    }

    void activityDestroyed(Activity activity)
    {
        synchronized (mActivities)
        {
            IBinder token = mTokens.remove(activity);
            if (token != null) mActivities.remove(token);
        }
    }

    IBinder tokenOf(Activity activity)
    {
        synchronized (mActivities)
        {
            return mTokens.get(activity);
        }
    }

    private static final class HandlerExecutor implements java.util.concurrent.Executor
    {
        private final Handler mHandler;

        HandlerExecutor(Handler handler)
        {
            mHandler = handler;
        }

        @Override
        public void execute(Runnable command)
        {
            if (!mHandler.post(command)) throw new java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException(mHandler + " is shutting down");
        }
    }
```

`java/android/app/AlarmManager.java`:

```java
package android.app;

import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.util.Log;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;

public class AlarmManager
{
    public static final int RTC_WAKEUP = 0;
    public static final int RTC = 1;
    public static final int ELAPSED_REALTIME_WAKEUP = 2;
    public static final int ELAPSED_REALTIME = 3;

    public static final long INTERVAL_FIFTEEN_MINUTES = 15 * 60 * 1000L;
    public static final long INTERVAL_HALF_HOUR = 2 * INTERVAL_FIFTEEN_MINUTES;
    public static final long INTERVAL_HOUR = 2 * INTERVAL_HALF_HOUR;
    public static final long INTERVAL_HALF_DAY = 12 * INTERVAL_HOUR;
    public static final long INTERVAL_DAY = 2 * INTERVAL_HALF_DAY;

    public static final String ACTION_NEXT_ALARM_CLOCK_CHANGED = "android.app.action.NEXT_ALARM_CLOCK_CHANGED";
    public static final String ACTION_SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM_PERMISSION_STATE_CHANGED =
            "android.app.action.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM_PERMISSION_STATE_CHANGED";

    private static final String TAG = "AlarmManager";

    public interface OnAlarmListener
    {
        void onAlarm();
    }

    public static final class AlarmClockInfo implements Parcelable
    {
        public static final Creator<AlarmClockInfo> CREATOR = new Creator<AlarmClockInfo>()
        {
            @Override
            public AlarmClockInfo createFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
            {
                long triggerTime = parcel.readLong();
                return new AlarmClockInfo(triggerTime, PendingIntent.readPendingIntentOrNullFromParcel(parcel));
            }

            @Override
            public AlarmClockInfo[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new AlarmClockInfo[size];
            }
        };

        private final long mTriggerTime;
        private final PendingIntent mShowIntent;

        public AlarmClockInfo(long triggerTime, PendingIntent showIntent)
        {
            mTriggerTime = triggerTime;
            mShowIntent = showIntent;
        }

        public long getTriggerTime()
        {
            return mTriggerTime;
        }

        public PendingIntent getShowIntent()
        {
            return mShowIntent;
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
        {
            destination.writeLong(mTriggerTime);
            PendingIntent.writePendingIntentOrNullToParcel(mShowIntent, destination);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "AlarmClockInfo{triggerTime=" + mTriggerTime + ", showIntent=" + mShowIntent + "}";
        }
    }

    private static final class Alarm
    {
        Runnable fire;
        Handler handler;
        AlarmClockInfo clock;
    }

    private static final Map<Object, Alarm> sScheduled = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    AlarmManager()
    {
    }

    private static Handler mainHandler()
    {
        Looper main = Looper.getMainLooper();
        return main == null ? null : new Handler(main);
    }

    public void set(int type, long triggerAtMillis, PendingIntent operation)
    {
        schedule(type, triggerAtMillis, 0, operation, null, null);
    }

    public void set(int type, long triggerAtMillis, String tag, OnAlarmListener listener, Handler targetHandler)
    {
        schedule(type, triggerAtMillis, 0, listener, targetHandler, null);
    }

    public void setExact(int type, long triggerAtMillis, PendingIntent operation)
    {
        schedule(type, triggerAtMillis, 0, operation, null, null);
    }

    public void setExact(int type, long triggerAtMillis, String tag, OnAlarmListener listener, Handler targetHandler)
    {
        schedule(type, triggerAtMillis, 0, listener, targetHandler, null);
    }

    public void setExactAndAllowWhileIdle(int type, long triggerAtMillis, PendingIntent operation)
    {
        schedule(type, triggerAtMillis, 0, operation, null, null);
    }

    public void setAndAllowWhileIdle(int type, long triggerAtMillis, PendingIntent operation)
    {
        schedule(type, triggerAtMillis, 0, operation, null, null);
    }

    public void setWindow(int type, long windowStartMillis, long windowLengthMillis, PendingIntent operation)
    {
        schedule(type, windowStartMillis, 0, operation, null, null);
    }

    public void setWindow(int type, long windowStartMillis, long windowLengthMillis, String tag, OnAlarmListener listener,
                          Handler targetHandler)
    {
        schedule(type, windowStartMillis, 0, listener, targetHandler, null);
    }

    public void setWindow(int type, long windowStartMillis, long windowLengthMillis, String tag, final Executor executor,
                          final OnAlarmListener listener)
    {
        if (executor == null) throw new NullPointerException("executor");

        schedule(type, windowStartMillis, 0, listener, new Handler(mainLooper()), executor);
    }

    public void setRepeating(int type, long triggerAtMillis, long intervalMillis, PendingIntent operation)
    {
        schedule(type, triggerAtMillis, Math.max(intervalMillis, 60000L), operation, null, null);
    }

    public void setInexactRepeating(int type, long triggerAtMillis, long intervalMillis, PendingIntent operation)
    {
        schedule(type, triggerAtMillis, Math.max(intervalMillis, 60000L), operation, null, null);
    }

    public void setAlarmClock(AlarmClockInfo info, PendingIntent operation)
    {
        if (info == null) throw new NullPointerException("info");

        Alarm alarm = schedule(RTC_WAKEUP, info.getTriggerTime(), 0, operation, null, null);
        if (alarm != null) alarm.clock = info;
    }

    public AlarmClockInfo getNextAlarmClock()
    {
        AlarmClockInfo next = null;

        synchronized (sScheduled)
        {
            for (Alarm alarm : sScheduled.values())
            {
                if (alarm.clock == null) continue;
                if (next == null || alarm.clock.getTriggerTime() < next.getTriggerTime()) next = alarm.clock;
            }
        }

        return next;
    }

    public void cancel(PendingIntent operation)
    {
        if (operation == null) throw new NullPointerException("cancel() called with a null PendingIntent");

        remove(operation);
    }

    public void cancel(OnAlarmListener listener)
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new NullPointerException("cancel() called with a null OnAlarmListener");

        remove(listener);
    }

    public void cancelAll()
    {
        List<Object> keys;
        synchronized (sScheduled)
        {
            keys = new ArrayList<>(sScheduled.keySet());
        }

        for (Object key : keys) remove(key);
    }

    public boolean canScheduleExactAlarms()
    {
        return true;
    }

    public void setTime(long millis)
    {
        throw new SecurityException("setTime requires android.permission.SET_TIME, which this application does not hold");
    }

    public void setTimeZone(String timeZone)
    {
        throw new SecurityException("setTimeZone requires android.permission.SET_TIME_ZONE, which this application does not hold");
    }

    private static Looper mainLooper()
    {
        Looper main = Looper.getMainLooper();
        return main == null ? Looper.myLooper() : main;
    }

    private void remove(Object key)
    {
        Alarm alarm;
        synchronized (sScheduled)
        {
            alarm = sScheduled.remove(key);
        }

        if (alarm == null) return;

        alarm.handler.removeCallbacks(alarm.fire);
        Log.i(TAG, "cancelled the alarm for " + key);
    }

    private Alarm schedule(int type, long triggerAtMillis, final long intervalMillis, final Object target, Handler targetHandler,
                           final Executor executor)
    {
        if (target == null) throw new NullPointerException("an alarm needs a PendingIntent or an OnAlarmListener");

        final Handler handler = targetHandler != null ? targetHandler : mainHandler();
        if (handler == null)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "no main looper, so the alarm for " + target + " cannot be scheduled");
            return null;
        }

        long delay = delayFor(type, triggerAtMillis);
        final Alarm alarm = new Alarm();
        alarm.handler = handler;

        alarm.fire = new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                Log.i(TAG, "the alarm for " + target + " fired");

                boolean repeating = intervalMillis > 0;
                if (!repeating)
                {
                    synchronized (sScheduled)
                    {
                        if (sScheduled.get(target) == alarm) sScheduled.remove(target);
                    }
                }

                deliver(target, executor);

                if (repeating) handler.postDelayed(this, intervalMillis);
            }
        };

        Alarm previous;
        synchronized (sScheduled)
        {
            previous = sScheduled.put(target, alarm);
        }

        if (previous != null) previous.handler.removeCallbacks(previous.fire);

        handler.postDelayed(alarm.fire, delay);
        Log.i(TAG, "an alarm for " + target + " will fire in " + delay + "ms"
                       + (intervalMillis > 0 ? ", then every " + intervalMillis + "ms" : ""));

        return alarm;
    }

    private static void deliver(Object target, Executor executor)
    {
        if (target instanceof PendingIntent)
        {
            ((PendingIntent)target).send();
            return;
        }

        final OnAlarmListener listener = (OnAlarmListener)target;
        if (executor == null)
        {
            listener.onAlarm();
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                listener.onAlarm();
            }
        });
    }

    private static long delayFor(int type, long triggerAtMillis)
    {
        long now = type == RTC || type == RTC_WAKEUP ? System.currentTimeMillis() : SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        long delay = triggerAtMillis - now;

        return delay < 0 ? 0 : delay;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.DialogInterface;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.util.TypedValue;

public class AlertDialog extends Dialog implements DialogInterface
{
    public static final int THEME_TRADITIONAL = 1;
    public static final int THEME_HOLO_DARK = 2;
    public static final int THEME_HOLO_LIGHT = 3;
    public static final int THEME_DEVICE_DEFAULT_DARK = 4;
    public static final int THEME_DEVICE_DEFAULT_LIGHT = 5;

    private static final int PADDING_DP = 24;
    private static final int BUTTON_GAP_DP = 8;
    private static final float TITLE_SIZE_SP = 20f;
    private static final float MESSAGE_SIZE_SP = 16f;

    private CharSequence mTitle;
    private CharSequence mMessage;
    private Drawable mIcon;
    private View mView;
    private CharSequence[] mItems;
    private boolean[] mCheckedItems;
    private int mCheckedItem = -1;
    private int mChoiceMode;
    private DialogInterface.OnClickListener mItemListener;
    private DialogInterface.OnMultiChoiceClickListener mMultiChoiceListener;
    private ListAdapter mAdapter;
    private ListView mListView;
    private AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener mOnItemSelectedListener;

    private final CharSequence[] mButtonText = new CharSequence[3];
    private final DialogInterface.OnClickListener[] mButtonListeners = new DialogInterface.OnClickListener[3];
    private final Button[] mButtons = new Button[3];

    private TextView mMessageView;
    private TextView mTitleView;

    protected AlertDialog(Context context)
    {
        this(context, 0);
    }

    protected AlertDialog(Context context, boolean cancelable, OnCancelListener cancelListener)
    {
        this(context, 0);
        setCancelable(cancelable);
        setOnCancelListener(cancelListener);
    }

    protected AlertDialog(Context context, int themeResId)
    {
        super(context, resolveAlertTheme(context, themeResId));
    }

    private static int resolveAlertTheme(Context context, int themeResId)
    {
        if (themeResId >= 0x01000000) return themeResId;

        int attribute = context.getResources().getIdentifier("alertDialogTheme", "attr", "android");
        if (attribute == 0) return 0;

        TypedValue value = new TypedValue();
        return context.getTheme().resolveAttribute(attribute, value, true) ? value.resourceId : 0;
    }

    private static int slot(int whichButton)
    {
        switch (whichButton)
        {
            case BUTTON_POSITIVE: return 0;
            case BUTTON_NEGATIVE: return 1;
            case BUTTON_NEUTRAL: return 2;
            default: throw new IllegalArgumentException("Button does not exist");
        }
    }

    private int pixels(float dp)
    {
        return Math.round(dp * getContext().getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }

    public Button getButton(int whichButton)
    {
        return mButtons[slot(whichButton)];
    }

    @Override
    public void setTitle(CharSequence title)
    {
        super.setTitle(title);
        mTitle = title;
        if (mTitleView != null) mTitleView.setText(title);
    }

    public void setCustomTitle(View customTitleView)
    {
        mView = customTitleView;
    }

    public void setMessage(CharSequence message)
    {
        mMessage = message;
        if (mMessageView != null) mMessageView.setText(message);
    }

    public CharSequence getMessage()
    {
        return mMessage;
    }

    public void setView(View view)
    {
        mView = view;
    }

    public void setView(View view, int viewSpacingLeft, int viewSpacingTop, int viewSpacingRight, int viewSpacingBottom)
    {
        mView = view;
        if (view != null) view.setPadding(viewSpacingLeft, viewSpacingTop, viewSpacingRight, viewSpacingBottom);
    }

    public void setButton(int whichButton, CharSequence text, DialogInterface.OnClickListener listener)
    {
        int index = slot(whichButton);
        mButtonText[index] = text;
        mButtonListeners[index] = listener;
    }

    public void setButton(int whichButton, CharSequence text, android.os.Message message)
    {
        final android.os.Message pending = message;
        setButton(whichButton, text, pending == null ? null : new DialogInterface.OnClickListener()
        {
            @Override
            public void onClick(DialogInterface dialog, int which)
            {
                android.os.Message.obtain(pending).sendToTarget();
            }
        });
    }

    public void setButton(int whichButton, CharSequence text, Drawable icon, DialogInterface.OnClickListener listener)
    {
        setButton(whichButton, text, listener);
    }

    public void setIcon(int resId)
    {
        mIcon = resId == 0 ? null : getContext().getResources().getDrawable(resId);
    }

    public void setIcon(Drawable icon)
    {
        mIcon = icon;
    }

    public void setIconAttribute(int attrId)
    {
    }

    public void setInverseBackgroundForced(boolean forceInverseBackground)
    {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onKeyDown(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        return super.onKeyDown(keyCode, event);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onKeyUp(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        return super.onKeyUp(keyCode, event);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        Context context = getContext();
        int padding = pixels(PADDING_DP);

        LinearLayout panel = new LinearLayout(context);
        panel.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        panel.setPadding(padding, padding, padding, pixels(BUTTON_GAP_DP));

        if (mTitle != null && mTitle.length() > 0)
        {
            mTitleView = new TextView(context);
            mTitleView.setText(mTitle);
            mTitleView.setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, TITLE_SIZE_SP);
            mTitleView.setPadding(0, 0, 0, pixels(BUTTON_GAP_DP * 2));
            panel.addView(mTitleView, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        }

        if (mMessage != null)
        {
            ScrollView scroller = new ScrollView(context);
            mMessageView = new TextView(context);
            mMessageView.setText(mMessage);
            mMessageView.setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, MESSAGE_SIZE_SP);
            scroller.addView(mMessageView, new ViewGroup.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
            panel.addView(scroller, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        }

        if (mItems != null || mAdapter != null)
        {
            panel.addView(buildList(context), new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                                                                            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        }

        if (mView != null)
        {
            ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = mView.getLayoutParams();
            if (params == null) params = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            panel.addView(mView, params);
        }

        LinearLayout buttons = new LinearLayout(context);
        buttons.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        buttons.setGravity(Gravity.END | Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        buttons.setPadding(0, pixels(BUTTON_GAP_DP * 2), 0, 0);

        int[] order = {BUTTON_NEUTRAL, BUTTON_NEGATIVE, BUTTON_POSITIVE};
        boolean anyButton = false;

        for (final int which : order)
        {
            int index = slot(which);
            if (mButtonText[index] == null) continue;

            Button button = new Button(context);
            button.setText(mButtonText[index]);

            final DialogInterface.OnClickListener listener = mButtonListeners[index];
            button.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener()
            {
                @Override
                public void onClick(View view)
                {
                    if (listener != null) listener.onClick(AlertDialog.this, which);
                    dismiss();
                }
            });

            mButtons[index] = button;
            buttons.addView(button, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
            anyButton = true;
        }

        if (anyButton) panel.addView(buttons, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        setContentView(panel, new ViewGroup.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
    }

    public ListView getListView()
    {
        return mListView;
    }

    private View buildList(final Context context)
    {
        final ListAdapter adapter = mAdapter != null ? mAdapter : new BaseAdapter()
        {
            @Override
            public int getCount()
            {
                return mItems == null ? 0 : mItems.length;
            }

            @Override
            public Object getItem(int position)
            {
                return mItems[position];
            }

            @Override
            public long getItemId(int position)
            {
                return position;
            }

            @Override
            public View getView(int position, View convertView, ViewGroup parent)
            {
                TextView row = convertView instanceof TextView ? (TextView)convertView : null;

                if (row == null)
                {
                    row = new TextView(context);
                    row.setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, MESSAGE_SIZE_SP);
                    row.setPadding(0, pixels(BUTTON_GAP_DP + 4), 0, pixels(BUTTON_GAP_DP + 4));
                }

                row.setText(describeItem(position));
                return row;
            }
        };

        mListView = new ListView(context);
        mListView.setAdapter(adapter);
        mListView.setOnItemClickListener(new AdapterView.OnItemClickListener()
        {
            @Override
            public void onItemClick(AdapterView<?> parent, View view, int position, long id)
            {
                onItemClicked(position);
                if (adapter instanceof BaseAdapter) ((BaseAdapter)adapter).notifyDataSetChanged();
            }
        });

        if (mOnItemSelectedListener != null) mListView.setOnItemSelectedListener(mOnItemSelectedListener);

        if (mAdapter != null && mChoiceMode == 1)
        {
            mListView.setChoiceMode(ListView.CHOICE_MODE_SINGLE);
            if (mCheckedItem >= 0) mListView.setItemChecked(mCheckedItem, true);
        }

        return mListView;
    }

    private CharSequence describeItem(int index)
    {
        if (mChoiceMode == 1) return (index == mCheckedItem ? "◉  " : "○  ") + mItems[index];
        if (mChoiceMode == 2) return (mCheckedItems != null && mCheckedItems[index] ? "☑  " : "☐  ") + mItems[index];

        return mItems[index];
    }

    private void onItemClicked(int position)
    {
        if (mChoiceMode == 2)
        {
            if (mCheckedItems == null) mCheckedItems = new boolean[mItems.length];
            mCheckedItems[position] = !mCheckedItems[position];
            if (mMultiChoiceListener != null) mMultiChoiceListener.onClick(this, position, mCheckedItems[position]);
            return;
        }

        if (mChoiceMode == 1) mCheckedItem = position;
        if (mItemListener != null) mItemListener.onClick(this, position);
        if (mChoiceMode == 0) dismiss();
    }

    public static class Builder
    {

        {
            return this;
        }

        public AlertDialog create()
        {
            AlertDialog dialog = new AlertDialog(mContext, mTheme);

            dialog.setTitle(mTitle);
            if (mCustomTitle != null) dialog.setCustomTitle(mCustomTitle);
            dialog.setMessage(mMessage);
            if (mIcon != null) dialog.setIcon(mIcon);
            if (mIconId != 0) dialog.setIcon(mIconId);

            for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++)
            {
                if (mButtonText[index] == null) continue;

                int which = index == 0 ? BUTTON_POSITIVE : index == 1 ? BUTTON_NEGATIVE : BUTTON_NEUTRAL;
                dialog.setButton(which, mButtonText[index], mButtonListeners[index]);
            }

            dialog.mItems = mItems;
            dialog.mCheckedItems = mCheckedItems;
            dialog.mCheckedItem = mCheckedItem;
            dialog.mChoiceMode = mChoiceMode;
            dialog.mItemListener = mItemListener;
            dialog.mMultiChoiceListener = mMultiChoiceListener;
            dialog.mAdapter = mAdapter;
            dialog.mOnItemSelectedListener = mOnItemSelectedListener;

            if (mView != null) dialog.setView(mView);
            else if (mViewLayoutResId != 0) dialog.setView(android.view.LayoutInflater.from(dialog.getContext()).inflate(mViewLayoutResId, null));

            dialog.setCancelable(mCancelable);
            if (mCancelable) dialog.setCanceledOnTouchOutside(true);
            dialog.setOnCancelListener(mCancelListener);
            dialog.setOnDismissListener(mDismissListener);
            if (mKeyListener != null) dialog.setOnKeyListener(mKeyListener);
            return dialog;
        }

        public AlertDialog show()
        {
            AlertDialog dialog = create();
            dialog.show();
            return dialog;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.app;

import android.content.BroadcastReceiver;
import android.content.ContentProvider;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;

public class AppComponentFactory
{
    public static final AppComponentFactory DEFAULT = new AppComponentFactory();

    public ClassLoader instantiateClassLoader(ClassLoader cl, ApplicationInfo aInfo)
    {
        return cl;
    }

    public Application instantiateApplication(ClassLoader cl, String className)
            throws ClassNotFoundException, IllegalAccessException, InstantiationException
    {
        return (Application)cl.loadClass(className).newInstance();
    }

    public Activity instantiateActivity(ClassLoader cl, String className, Intent intent)
            throws ClassNotFoundException, IllegalAccessException, InstantiationException
    {
        return (Activity)cl.loadClass(className).newInstance();
    }

    public BroadcastReceiver instantiateReceiver(ClassLoader cl, String className, Intent intent)
            throws ClassNotFoundException, IllegalAccessException, InstantiationException
    {
        return (BroadcastReceiver)cl.loadClass(className).newInstance();
    }

    public Service instantiateService(ClassLoader cl, String className, Intent intent)
            throws ClassNotFoundException, IllegalAccessException, InstantiationException
    {
        return (Service)cl.loadClass(className).newInstance();
    }

    public ContentProvider instantiateProvider(ClassLoader cl, String className)
            throws ClassNotFoundException, IllegalAccessException, InstantiationException
    {
        return (ContentProvider)cl.loadClass(className).newInstance();
    }
}
```

```java
    private final Context mContext;

    public static String permissionToOp(String permission)

    public void startWatchingMode(String op, String packageName, OnOpChangedListener callback)
    {
        startWatchingMode(op, packageName, 0, callback);
    }

    public void startWatchingMode(String op, String packageName, int flags, OnOpChangedListener callback)
    {
        if (callback == null) return;

        synchronized (mModeWatchers)
        {
            if (!mModeWatchers.contains(callback)) mModeWatchers.add(callback);
        }
    }

    public void stopWatchingMode(OnOpChangedListener callback)
    {
        synchronized (mModeWatchers)
        {
            mModeWatchers.remove(callback);
        }
    }

    public void startWatchingActive(String[] ops, Executor executor, OnOpActiveChangedListener callback)
    {
        if (ops == null || executor == null || callback == null) throw new NullPointerException("ops, executor and callback are required");

        synchronized (mActiveWatchers)
        {
            mActiveWatchers.put(callback, new ActiveWatcher(ops, executor));
        }
    }

    public void stopWatchingActive(OnOpActiveChangedListener callback)
    {
        synchronized (mActiveWatchers)
        {
            mActiveWatchers.remove(callback);
        }
    }
```
