```java
        finishOp(op, proxiedUid, proxiedPackageName, proxiedAttributionTag);
    }

    public boolean isOpActive(String op, int uid, String packageName)
    {
        String prefix = op + "|" + uid + "|" + packageName + "|";

        synchronized (mActiveOps)
        {
            for (String active : mActiveOps)
            {
                if (active.startsWith(prefix)) return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public void setOnOpNotedCallback(Executor asyncExecutor, OnOpNotedCallback callback)
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (callback != null && mNotedCallback != null) throw new IllegalStateException("A callback is already registered");

            mNotedExecutor = asyncExecutor;
            mNotedCallback = callback;
        }
    }

    private boolean isOwnPackage(String packageName)
    {
        return packageName == null || mContext == null || packageName.equals(mContext.getPackageName());
    }

    private int modeFor(String op, String packageName)
    {
        if (op == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown operation string: null");
        if (!isOwnPackage(packageName)) return MODE_ERRORED;
        if (OPSTR_MOCK_LOCATION.equals(op)) return MODE_ERRORED;

        String permission = PERMISSION_BY_OP.get(op);
        if (permission == null) return MODE_ALLOWED;
        if (runtime.Permissions.check(permission) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) return MODE_ALLOWED;

        for (String special : SPECIAL_ACCESS_OPS)
        {
            if (special.equals(op)) return MODE_DEFAULT;
        }

        return MODE_IGNORED;
    }

    private static int enforce(String op, int mode)
    {
        if (mode == MODE_ERRORED) throw new SecurityException("Operation " + op + " is not allowed for this package");

        return mode;
    }

    private void dispatchSelfNoted(String op, String attributionTag)
    {
        final OnOpNotedCallback callback;
        final Executor executor;

        synchronized (this)
        {
            callback = mNotedCallback;
            executor = mNotedExecutor;
        }

        if (callback == null || !PERMISSION_BY_OP.containsKey(op)) return;

        final SyncNotedAppOp noted = new SyncNotedAppOp(op, attributionTag);
        if (executor == null)
        {
            callback.onSelfNoted(noted);
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                callback.onSelfNoted(noted);
            }
        });
    }

    private void setActive(final String op, final int uid, final String packageName, String attributionTag, final boolean active)
    {
        if (op == null) return;

        String key = op + "|" + uid + "|" + packageName + "|" + attributionTag;
        boolean changed;

        synchronized (mActiveOps)
        {
            changed = active ? mActiveOps.add(key) : mActiveOps.remove(key);
        }

        if (!changed) return;

        List<Map.Entry<OnOpActiveChangedListener, ActiveWatcher>> watchers;
        synchronized (mActiveWatchers)
        {
            watchers = new ArrayList<>(mActiveWatchers.entrySet());
        }

        for (Map.Entry<OnOpActiveChangedListener, ActiveWatcher> entry : watchers)
        {
            if (!entry.getValue().watches(op)) continue;

            final OnOpActiveChangedListener listener = entry.getKey();
            entry.getValue().mExecutor.execute(new Runnable()
            {
                @Override
                public void run()
                {
                    listener.onOpActiveChanged(op, uid, packageName, active);
                }
            });
        }
    }

    private static final class ActiveWatcher
    {
        final String[] mOps;
        final Executor mExecutor;

        ActiveWatcher(String[] ops, Executor executor)
        {
            mOps = ops.clone();
            mExecutor = executor;
        }

        boolean watches(String op)
        {
            for (String watched : mOps)
            {
                if (op.equals(watched)) return true;
            }

            return false;
        }
    }

    public interface OnOpChangedListener
    {
        void onOpChanged(String op, String packageName);
    }

    public interface OnOpActiveChangedListener
    {
        void onOpActiveChanged(String op, int uid, String packageName, boolean active);
    }

    public abstract static class OnOpNotedCallback
    {
        public OnOpNotedCallback()
        {
        }

        public abstract void onNoted(SyncNotedAppOp op);

        public abstract void onSelfNoted(SyncNotedAppOp op);

        public abstract void onAsyncNoted(AsyncNotedAppOp asyncOp);
    }
}
```

```java
public final class ApplicationStartInfo implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int STARTUP_STATE_STARTED = 0;
    public static final int STARTUP_STATE_ERROR = 1;
    public static final int STARTUP_STATE_FIRST_FRAME_DRAWN = 2;

    public static final int START_REASON_ALARM = 0;
    public static final int START_REASON_BACKUP = 1;
    public static final int START_REASON_BOOT_COMPLETE = 2;
    public static final int START_REASON_BROADCAST = 3;
    public static final int START_REASON_CONTENT_PROVIDER = 4;

    public static final int START_COMPONENT_CONTENT_PROVIDER = 3;
    public static final int START_COMPONENT_SERVICE = 4;
    public static final int START_COMPONENT_OTHER = 5;

    public static final int START_TIMESTAMP_FORK = 1;
    public static final int START_TIMESTAMP_APPLICATION_ONCREATE = 2;
    public static final int START_TIMESTAMP_BIND_APPLICATION = 3;
    public static final int START_TIMESTAMP_FIRST_FRAME = 4;
    public static final int START_TIMESTAMP_FULLY_DRAWN = 5;
    public static final int START_TIMESTAMP_INITIAL_RENDERTHREAD_FRAME = 6;
    public static final int START_TIMESTAMP_SURFACEFLINGER_COMPOSITION_COMPLETE = 7;
    public static final int START_TIMESTAMP_RESERVED_RANGE_SYSTEM = 20;
    public static final int START_TIMESTAMP_RESERVED_RANGE_DEVELOPER_START = 21;
    public static final int START_TIMESTAMP_RESERVED_RANGE_DEVELOPER = 30;

    public static final Creator<ApplicationStartInfo> CREATOR = new Creator<ApplicationStartInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public ApplicationStartInfo createFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
        {
            ApplicationStartInfo info = new ApplicationStartInfo();

            info.mStartupState = parcel.readInt();
            info.mPid = parcel.readInt();
            info.mRealUid = parcel.readInt();
            info.mPackageUid = parcel.readInt();
            info.mDefiningUid = parcel.readInt();
            info.mProcessName = parcel.readString();
            info.mReason = parcel.readInt();
            info.mStartType = parcel.readInt();
            info.mLaunchMode = parcel.readInt();
            info.mStartComponent = parcel.readInt();
            info.mWasForceStopped = parcel.readBoolean();

            int count = parcel.readInt();
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                int key = parcel.readInt();
                info.mTimestamps.put(key, parcel.readLong());
            }

            if (parcel.readBoolean()) info.mIntent = Intent.CREATOR.createFromParcel(parcel);

            return info;
        }

            return new ApplicationStartInfo[size];
        }

    private static ApplicationStartInfo sCurrent;

    private int mStartupState = STARTUP_STATE_STARTED;
    private int mPid;
    private int mRealUid;
    private int mPackageUid;
    private int mDefiningUid;
    private String mProcessName;
    private int mReason = START_REASON_LAUNCHER;
    private int mStartType = START_TYPE_COLD;
    private int mLaunchMode = LAUNCH_MODE_STANDARD;
    private int mStartComponent = START_COMPONENT_ACTIVITY;
    private boolean mWasForceStopped;
    private Intent mIntent;
    private final Map<Integer, Long> mTimestamps = new TreeMap<>();

    ApplicationStartInfo()
    {
    }

    static ApplicationStartInfo current()
    {
        synchronized (ApplicationStartInfo.class)
        {
            if (sCurrent == null)
            {
                ApplicationStartInfo info = new ApplicationStartInfo();
                info.mPid = android.os.Process.myPid();
                info.mRealUid = android.os.Process.myUid();
                info.mPackageUid = info.mRealUid;
                info.mDefiningUid = info.mRealUid;
                info.mProcessName = android.os.Process.myProcessName();
                info.mTimestamps.put(START_TIMESTAMP_LAUNCH, android.os.Process.getStartRequestedElapsedRealtime() * 1000000L);
                info.mTimestamps.put(START_TIMESTAMP_FORK, android.os.Process.getStartElapsedRealtime() * 1000000L);
                sCurrent = info;
            }

            return sCurrent;
        }
    }

    static void recordTimestamp(int key, long timestampNanos)
    {
        ApplicationStartInfo info = current();

        synchronized (ApplicationStartInfo.class)
        {
            info.mTimestamps.put(key, timestampNanos);
            if (key == START_TIMESTAMP_FIRST_FRAME) info.mStartupState = STARTUP_STATE_FIRST_FRAME_DRAWN;
        }
    }

    static void recordIntent(Intent intent)
    {
        ApplicationStartInfo info = current();

        synchronized (ApplicationStartInfo.class)
        {
            info.mIntent = intent;
        }
    }

        return mIntent;

    {

        {
            return Collections.unmodifiableMap(new TreeMap<>(mTimestamps));
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeInt(mStartupState);
        destination.writeInt(mPid);
        destination.writeInt(mRealUid);
        destination.writeInt(mPackageUid);
        destination.writeInt(mDefiningUid);
        destination.writeString(mProcessName);
        destination.writeInt(mReason);
        destination.writeInt(mStartType);
        destination.writeInt(mLaunchMode);
        destination.writeInt(mStartComponent);
        destination.writeBoolean(mWasForceStopped);

        Map<Integer, Long> timestamps = getStartupTimestamps();
        destination.writeInt(timestamps.size());
        for (Map.Entry<Integer, Long> entry : timestamps.entrySet())
        {
            destination.writeInt(entry.getKey());
            destination.writeLong(entry.getValue());
        }

        destination.writeBoolean(mIntent != null);
        if (mIntent != null) mIntent.writeToParcel(destination, flags);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof ApplicationStartInfo)) return false;

        ApplicationStartInfo info = (ApplicationStartInfo)other;
        return mPid == info.mPid && mRealUid == info.mRealUid && mPackageUid == info.mPackageUid
               && mDefiningUid == info.mDefiningUid && mReason == info.mReason && mStartupState == info.mStartupState
               && mStartType == info.mStartType && mLaunchMode == info.mLaunchMode && mStartComponent == info.mStartComponent
               && mWasForceStopped == info.mWasForceStopped && Objects.equals(mProcessName, info.mProcessName)
               && getStartupTimestamps().equals(info.getStartupTimestamps());
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mPid, mRealUid, mPackageUid, mDefiningUid, mReason, mStartupState, mStartType, mLaunchMode,
                            mProcessName, mStartComponent);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "ApplicationStartInfo(pid=" + mPid + " realUid=" + mRealUid + " packageUid=" + mPackageUid + " definingUid="
               + mDefiningUid + " process=" + mProcessName + " startupState=" + mStartupState + " reason=" + mReason
               + " startType=" + mStartType + " launchMode=" + mLaunchMode + " startComponent=" + mStartComponent
               + " timestamps=" + getStartupTimestamps() + ")";
    }
```

```java
        mAttributionTag = attributionTag;

    }

               + ", message = " + mMessage + ", time = " + mTime + " }";
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof AsyncNotedAppOp)) return false;

        AsyncNotedAppOp that = (AsyncNotedAppOp)other;
        return Objects.equals(mOp, that.mOp) && mNotingUid == that.mNotingUid && Objects.equals(mAttributionTag, that.mAttributionTag)
               && Objects.equals(mMessage, that.mMessage) && mTime == that.mTime;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mOp, mNotingUid, mAttributionTag, mMessage, mTime);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mOp);
        dest.writeInt(mNotingUid);
        dest.writeString(mAttributionTag);
        dest.writeString(mMessage);
        dest.writeLong(mTime);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.app;

import android.os.Bundle;

public class BroadcastOptions
{
    public static final int DEFERRAL_POLICY_DEFAULT = 0;
    public static final int DEFERRAL_POLICY_NONE = 1;
    public static final int DEFERRAL_POLICY_UNTIL_ACTIVE = 2;

    public static final int DELIVERY_GROUP_POLICY_ALL = 0;
    public static final int DELIVERY_GROUP_POLICY_MOST_RECENT = 1;

    private static final String KEY_SHARE_IDENTITY = "android:broadcast.shareIdentity";
    private static final String KEY_DEFERRAL_POLICY = "android:broadcast.deferralPolicy";
    private static final String KEY_DELIVERY_GROUP_POLICY = "android:broadcast.deliveryGroupPolicy";
    private static final String KEY_DELIVERY_GROUP_NAMESPACE = "android:broadcast.deliveryGroupMatchingNamespace";
    private static final String KEY_DELIVERY_GROUP_KEY = "android:broadcast.deliveryGroupMatchingKey";

    private boolean mShareIdentity;
    private int mDeferralPolicy = DEFERRAL_POLICY_DEFAULT;
    private int mDeliveryGroupPolicy = DELIVERY_GROUP_POLICY_ALL;
    private String mDeliveryGroupNamespace;
    private String mDeliveryGroupKey;

    private BroadcastOptions()
    {
    }

    public static BroadcastOptions makeBasic()
    {
        return new BroadcastOptions();
    }

    public static BroadcastOptions fromBundle(Bundle options)
    {
        BroadcastOptions result = new BroadcastOptions();
        if (options == null) return result;

        result.mShareIdentity = options.getBoolean(KEY_SHARE_IDENTITY, false);
        result.mDeferralPolicy = options.getInt(KEY_DEFERRAL_POLICY, DEFERRAL_POLICY_DEFAULT);
        result.mDeliveryGroupPolicy = options.getInt(KEY_DELIVERY_GROUP_POLICY, DELIVERY_GROUP_POLICY_ALL);
        result.mDeliveryGroupNamespace = options.getString(KEY_DELIVERY_GROUP_NAMESPACE);
        result.mDeliveryGroupKey = options.getString(KEY_DELIVERY_GROUP_KEY);
        return result;
    }

    public BroadcastOptions setShareIdentityEnabled(boolean shareIdentityEnabled)
    {
        mShareIdentity = shareIdentityEnabled;
        return this;
    }

    public boolean isShareIdentityEnabled()
    {
        return mShareIdentity;
    }

    public BroadcastOptions setDeferralPolicy(int deferralPolicy)
    {
        mDeferralPolicy = deferralPolicy;
        return this;
    }

    public int getDeferralPolicy()
    {
        return mDeferralPolicy;
    }

    public void clearDeferralPolicy()
    {
        mDeferralPolicy = DEFERRAL_POLICY_DEFAULT;
    }

    public BroadcastOptions setDeliveryGroupPolicy(int policy)
    {
        mDeliveryGroupPolicy = policy;
        return this;
    }

    public int getDeliveryGroupPolicy()
    {
        return mDeliveryGroupPolicy;
    }

    public void clearDeliveryGroupPolicy()
    {
        mDeliveryGroupPolicy = DELIVERY_GROUP_POLICY_ALL;
    }

    public BroadcastOptions setDeliveryGroupMatchingKey(String namespace, String key)
    {
        if (namespace == null || key == null) throw new NullPointerException("namespace and key must not be null");

        mDeliveryGroupNamespace = namespace;
        mDeliveryGroupKey = key;
        return this;
    }

    public String getDeliveryGroupMatchingKey()
    {
        if (mDeliveryGroupNamespace == null || mDeliveryGroupKey == null) return null;

        return mDeliveryGroupNamespace + ":" + mDeliveryGroupKey;
    }

    public void clearDeliveryGroupMatchingKey()
    {
        mDeliveryGroupNamespace = null;
        mDeliveryGroupKey = null;
    }

    public Bundle toBundle()
    {
        Bundle bundle = new Bundle();

        if (mShareIdentity) bundle.putBoolean(KEY_SHARE_IDENTITY, true);
        if (mDeferralPolicy != DEFERRAL_POLICY_DEFAULT) bundle.putInt(KEY_DEFERRAL_POLICY, mDeferralPolicy);
        if (mDeliveryGroupPolicy != DELIVERY_GROUP_POLICY_ALL) bundle.putInt(KEY_DELIVERY_GROUP_POLICY, mDeliveryGroupPolicy);

        if (mDeliveryGroupNamespace != null)
        {
            bundle.putString(KEY_DELIVERY_GROUP_NAMESPACE, mDeliveryGroupNamespace);
            bundle.putString(KEY_DELIVERY_GROUP_KEY, mDeliveryGroupKey);
        }

        return bundle;
    }
}
```

```java
    public Object getSystemService(String name)
    {
        if (Context.LAYOUT_INFLATER_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {

            return mInflater;

        if (Context.WINDOW_SERVICE.equals(name))

            return mWindowManager;

        if (Context.LOCALE_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            if (mLocaleManager == null) mLocaleManager = new LocaleManager();
            return mLocaleManager;
        }

        if (Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            return android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager.getInstance();
        }

        if (Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            if (mNotificationManager == null) mNotificationManager = new NotificationManager();
            return mNotificationManager;
        }

        if (Context.ALARM_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            if (mAlarmManager == null) mAlarmManager = new AlarmManager();
            return mAlarmManager;
        }

        if (Context.JOB_SCHEDULER_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            return runtime.Jobs.instance();
        }

        if (Context.AUTOFILL_MANAGER_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            if (mAutofillManager == null) mAutofillManager = new android.view.autofill.AutofillManager();
            return mAutofillManager;
        }

        if ("phone".equals(name))
        {
            if (mTelephonyManager == null) mTelephonyManager = new android.telephony.TelephonyManager();
            return mTelephonyManager;
        }

        if ("sensor".equals(name))
        {
            if (mSensorManager == null) mSensorManager = new android.hardware.SensorManager();
            return mSensorManager;
        }

        if ("clipboard".equals(name))
        {
            if (mClipboardManager == null) mClipboardManager = new android.content.ClipboardManager();
            return mClipboardManager;
        }

        if ("audio".equals(name))
        {
            if (mAudioManager == null) mAudioManager = new android.media.AudioManager();
            return mAudioManager;
        }

        if ("vibrator".equals(name))
        {
            if (mVibrator == null) mVibrator = new android.os.Vibrator();
            return mVibrator;
        }

        if ("power".equals(name))
        {
            if (mPowerManager == null) mPowerManager = new android.os.PowerManager();
            return mPowerManager;
        }

        if (Context.ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            return android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityManager.getInstance();
        }

        if ("captioning".equals(name))
        {
            return android.view.accessibility.CaptioningManager.getInstance();
        }

        if (Context.ACTIVITY_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            if (mActivityManager == null) mActivityManager = new ActivityManager(this);
            return mActivityManager;
        }

        if (Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            if (mConnectivityManager == null) mConnectivityManager = new android.net.ConnectivityManager();
            return mConnectivityManager;
        }

        if (Context.DISPLAY_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            if (mDisplayManager == null) mDisplayManager = new android.hardware.display.DisplayManager(this);
            return mDisplayManager;
        }

        if (Context.USER_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            if (mUserManager == null) mUserManager = new android.os.UserManager(this);
            return mUserManager;
        }

        if (Context.LAUNCHER_APPS_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            if (mLauncherApps == null) mLauncherApps = new android.content.pm.LauncherApps(this);
            return mLauncherApps;
        }

        if (Context.SHORTCUT_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            if (mShortcutManager == null) mShortcutManager = new android.content.pm.ShortcutManager(this);
            return mShortcutManager;
        }

        if (Context.WALLPAPER_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            if (mWallpaperManager == null) mWallpaperManager = android.app.WallpaperManager.getInstance(this);
            return mWallpaperManager;
        }

        if (Context.APPWIDGET_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            if (mAppWidgetManager == null) mAppWidgetManager = android.appwidget.AppWidgetManager.getInstance(this);
            return mAppWidgetManager;
        }

        if (Context.SEARCH_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            if (mSearchManager == null) mSearchManager = new android.app.SearchManager(this);
            return mSearchManager;
        }

        synchronized (mServices)
        {
            Object cached = mServices.get(name);
            if (cached != null) return cached;

            Object created = createService(name);
            if (created != null)
            {
                mServices.put(name, created);
                return created;
            }
        }

        runtime.Strict.unimplemented("android.content.Context.getSystemService(" + name + ")");
        return null;
    }

    private Object createService(String name)
    {
        if (name == null) return null;

        switch (name)
        {
            case Context.APP_OPS_SERVICE: return new AppOpsManager(this);
            case Context.CAMERA_SERVICE: return new android.hardware.camera2.CameraManager(this);
            case Context.MEDIA_SESSION_SERVICE: return new android.media.session.MediaSessionManager(this);

            case Context.MEDIA_PROJECTION_SERVICE: return new android.media.projection.MediaProjectionManager(this);
            case Context.TV_INPUT_SERVICE: return new android.media.tv.TvInputManager(this);
            case Context.TELEPHONY_SUBSCRIPTION_SERVICE: return new android.telephony.SubscriptionManager(this);
            case Context.TELECOM_SERVICE: return new android.telecom.TelecomManager(this);
            case Context.CONSUMER_IR_SERVICE: return new android.hardware.ConsumerIrManager(this);
            case Context.INPUT_SERVICE: return new android.hardware.input.InputManager(this);
            case Context.USB_SERVICE: return new android.hardware.usb.UsbManager(this);
            case Context.BIOMETRIC_SERVICE: return new android.hardware.biometrics.BiometricManager(this);
            case Context.FINGERPRINT_SERVICE: return new android.hardware.fingerprint.FingerprintManager(this);
            case Context.NFC_SERVICE: return new android.nfc.NfcManager(this);
            case Context.PRINT_SERVICE: return new android.print.PrintManager(this);
            case Context.CAPTIONING_SERVICE: return android.view.accessibility.CaptioningManager.getInstance();
            case Context.CONTENT_CAPTURE_MANAGER_SERVICE: return android.view.contentcapture.ContentCaptureManager.getInstance();
            case Context.TEXT_CLASSIFICATION_SERVICE: return android.view.textclassifier.TextClassificationManager.getInstance();
            case Context.UI_MODE_SERVICE: return new UiModeManager(this);

            case Context.STORAGE_STATS_SERVICE: return new android.app.usage.StorageStatsManager(this);
            case Context.NETWORK_STATS_SERVICE: return new android.app.usage.NetworkStatsManager(this);
            case Context.ACCOUNT_SERVICE: return new android.accounts.AccountManager(this);
            case Context.LOCATION_SERVICE: return new android.location.LocationManager(this);
            case Context.BATTERY_SERVICE: return new android.os.BatteryManager(this);
            case Context.STORAGE_SERVICE: return new android.os.storage.StorageManager(this);
            case Context.VIBRATOR_MANAGER_SERVICE: return new android.os.VibratorManager(this);
            case Context.PERFORMANCE_HINT_SERVICE: return new android.os.PerformanceHintManager(this);
            case Context.DROPBOX_SERVICE: return new android.os.DropBoxManager(this);
            case Context.WIFI_SERVICE: return new android.net.wifi.WifiManager(this);
            case Context.WIFI_P2P_SERVICE: return new android.net.wifi.p2p.WifiP2pManager(this);
            case Context.NSD_SERVICE: return new android.net.nsd.NsdManager(this);
            case Context.BLUETOOTH_SERVICE: return new android.bluetooth.BluetoothManager(this);
            case Context.RESTRICTIONS_SERVICE: return new android.content.RestrictionsManager(this);

            case Context.SYSTEM_HEALTH_SERVICE: return new android.os.health.SystemHealthManager();
            case Context.POWER_WHITELIST_MANAGER: return new android.os.PowerWhitelistManager(this);
            case Context.POWER_EXEMPTION_SERVICE: return new android.os.PowerExemptionManager(this);

    @Override
    public java.io.FileOutputStream openFileOutput(String name, int mode) throws java.io.FileNotFoundException
    {

    }

    @Override
    public boolean deleteFile(String name)
    {
        return getFileStreamPath(name).delete();
    }

    @Override
    public java.io.File getFileStreamPath(String name)
    {
        if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("file name must not be empty");
        if (name.indexOf(java.io.File.separatorChar) >= 0)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("File " + name + " contains a path separator");
        }

        return new java.io.File(getFilesDir(), name);
    }

    @Override
    public String[] fileList()
    {
        String[] names = getFilesDir().list();
        return names == null ? new String[0] : names;
    }

    @Override
    public java.io.File getDatabasePath(String name)
    {
        return new java.io.File(ensureDir(new java.io.File(mDataDir, "databases")), name);
    }

    private static java.io.File ensureDir(java.io.File dir)
    {
        if (!dir.exists() && !dir.mkdirs())
        {
            android.util.Log.w("ContextImpl", "could not create " + dir);
        }
        return dir;
    }
}
```

`java/android/app/Dialog.java`:

```java
package android.app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.DialogInterface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.Message;
import android.util.TypedValue;
import android.view.ActionMode;
import android.view.ContextMenu;
import android.view.ContextThemeWrapper;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.Menu;
import android.view.MenuItem;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.RuntimeWindow;
import android.view.SearchEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.Window;
import android.view.WindowManager;
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityEvent;

public class Dialog implements DialogInterface, Window.Callback, KeyEvent.Callback, View.OnCreateContextMenuListener
{
    private static final String TAG = "Dialog";
    private static final float DEFAULT_DIM_AMOUNT = 0.6f;
    private static final float DEFAULT_MINIMUM_WIDTH_FRACTION = 0.65f;
    private static final String SAVED_SHOWING = "android:dialogShowing";

    private final Context mContext;
    private final Window mWindow;
    private final WindowManager mWindowManager;
    private final Handler mHandler;
    private final KeyEvent.DispatcherState mKeyDispatchState = new KeyEvent.DispatcherState();
    private final android.window.RuntimeBackDispatcher mBackDispatcher = new android.window.RuntimeBackDispatcher();

    private View mDecor;
    private Activity mOwnerActivity;
    private boolean mCreated;
    private boolean mShowing;
    private boolean mCanceled;
    private boolean mCancelable = true;
    private int mVolumeControlStream = -1;

    private OnCancelListener mCancelListener;
    private OnDismissListener mDismissListener;
    private OnShowListener mShowListener;
    private OnKeyListener mOnKeyListener;
    private Message mCancelMessage;
    private Message mDismissMessage;
    private ActionMode mActionMode;

    public Dialog(Context context)
    {
        this(context, 0, true);
    }

    public Dialog(Context context, int themeResId)
    {
        this(context, themeResId, true);
    }

    Dialog(Context context, int themeResId, boolean createContextThemeWrapper)
    {
        if (createContextThemeWrapper)
        {
            if (themeResId == 0) themeResId = resolveDialogTheme(context);
            mContext = themeResId == 0 ? context : new ContextThemeWrapper(context, themeResId);
        }
        else
        {
            mContext = context;
        }

        mWindowManager = (WindowManager)context.getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE);
        mHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

        mWindow = new RuntimeWindow(mContext);
        mWindow.setCallback(this);
        applyWindowTheme();

        if (context instanceof Activity) mOwnerActivity = (Activity)context;
    }

    protected Dialog(Context context, boolean cancelable, OnCancelListener cancelListener)
    {
        this(context);
        mCancelable = cancelable;
        setOnCancelListener(cancelListener);
    }

    protected Dialog(Context context, boolean cancelable, Message cancelCallback)
    {
        this(context);
        mCancelable = cancelable;
        mCancelMessage = cancelCallback;
    }

    private static int resolveDialogTheme(Context context)
    {
        int attribute = context.getResources().getIdentifier("dialogTheme", "attr", "android");
        if (attribute == 0) return 0;

        TypedValue value = new TypedValue();
        return context.getTheme().resolveAttribute(attribute, value, true) ? value.resourceId : 0;
    }

    private TypedValue themeValue(String name)
    {
        int attribute = mContext.getResources().getIdentifier(name, "attr", "android");
        if (attribute == 0) return null;

        TypedValue value = new TypedValue();
        return mContext.getTheme().resolveAttribute(attribute, value, true) ? value : null;
    }

    private void applyWindowTheme()
    {
        WindowManager.LayoutParams attributes = mWindow.getAttributes();
        attributes.width = ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        attributes.height = ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        attributes.gravity = android.view.Gravity.CENTER;
        attributes.type = WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_APPLICATION;

        TypedValue dimEnabled = themeValue("backgroundDimEnabled");
        boolean dim = dimEnabled == null || dimEnabled.type != TypedValue.TYPE_INT_BOOLEAN || dimEnabled.data != 0;
        if (dim) attributes.flags |= WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_DIM_BEHIND;

        TypedValue dimAmount = themeValue("backgroundDimAmount");
        attributes.dimAmount = dimAmount != null && dimAmount.type == TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT ? dimAmount.getFloat() : DEFAULT_DIM_AMOUNT;

        TypedValue closeOutside = themeValue("windowCloseOnTouchOutside");
        if (closeOutside != null && closeOutside.type == TypedValue.TYPE_INT_BOOLEAN) mWindow.setCloseOnTouchOutside(closeOutside.data != 0);

        int screenWidth = mContext.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().widthPixels;
        int screenHeight = mContext.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().heightPixels;
        boolean portrait = screenWidth < screenHeight;

        TypedValue minimum = themeValue(portrait ? "windowMinWidthMinor" : "windowMinWidthMajor");
        float minimumWidth = screenWidth * DEFAULT_MINIMUM_WIDTH_FRACTION;

        if (minimum != null && minimum.type == TypedValue.TYPE_FRACTION) minimumWidth = minimum.getFraction(screenWidth, screenWidth);
        else if (minimum != null && minimum.type == TypedValue.TYPE_DIMENSION) minimumWidth = minimum.getDimension(mContext.getResources().getDisplayMetrics());

        mWindow.getDecorView().setMinimumWidth(Math.round(minimumWidth));

        TypedValue background = themeValue("windowBackground");
        if (background != null && background.resourceId != 0)
        {
            try
            {
                mWindow.setBackgroundDrawable(mContext.getResources().getDrawable(background.resourceId, mContext.getTheme()));
            }
            catch (RuntimeException unusable)
            {
                android.util.Log.w(TAG, "the dialog theme's window background could not be loaded", unusable);
            }
        }
    }

    public final Context getContext()
    {
        return mContext;
    }

    public final void setOwnerActivity(Activity activity)
    {
        mOwnerActivity = activity;
    }

    public final Activity getOwnerActivity()
    {
        return mOwnerActivity;
    }

    public boolean isShowing()
    {
        return mDecor != null && mShowing && mDecor.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE;
    }

    public void create()
    {
        if (!mCreated) dispatchOnCreate(null);
    }

    public void show()
    {
        if (mShowing)
        {
            if (mDecor != null) mDecor.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            return;
        }

        mCanceled = false;

        if (!mCreated) dispatchOnCreate(null);

        onStart();

        mDecor = mWindow.getDecorView();

        WindowManager.LayoutParams attributes = new WindowManager.LayoutParams();
        attributes.copyFrom(mWindow.getAttributes());

        try
        {
            mWindowManager.addView(mDecor, attributes);
            mShowing = true;
        }
        catch (RuntimeException failure)
        {
            android.util.Log.e(TAG, "the dialog window could not be added", failure);
            mDecor = null;
            return;
        }

        if (mShowListener != null)
        {
            final OnShowListener listener = mShowListener;
            mHandler.post(new Runnable()
            {
                @Override
                public void run()
                {
                    listener.onShow(Dialog.this);
                }
            });
        }
    }

    public void hide()
    {
        if (mDecor != null) mDecor.setVisibility(View.GONE);
    }

    @Override
    public void dismiss()
    {
        if (Looper.myLooper() == mHandler.getLooper())
        {
            dismissDialog();
            return;
        }

        mHandler.post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                dismissDialog();
            }
        });
    }

    void dismissDialog()
    {
        if (mDecor == null || !mShowing) return;

        try
        {
            mWindowManager.removeViewImmediate(mDecor);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (mActionMode != null) mActionMode.finish();

            mDecor = null;
            mWindow.closeAllPanels();
            onStop();
            mShowing = false;

            if (mDismissMessage != null) Message.obtain(mDismissMessage).sendToTarget();
            if (mDismissListener != null) mDismissListener.onDismiss(this);
        }
    }

    void dispatchOnCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
        if (mCreated) return;

        onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        mCreated = true;
    }

    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
    }

    protected void onStart()
    {
    }

    protected void onStop()
    {
    }

    public Bundle onSaveInstanceState()
    {
        Bundle state = new Bundle();
        state.putBoolean(SAVED_SHOWING, mShowing);
        return state;
    }

    public void onRestoreInstanceState(Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
        if (savedInstanceState == null) return;

        dispatchOnCreate(savedInstanceState);
        if (savedInstanceState.getBoolean(SAVED_SHOWING)) show();
    }

    public Window getWindow()
    {
        return mWindow;
    }

    public View getCurrentFocus()
    {
        return mWindow.getCurrentFocus();
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public <T extends View> T findViewById(int id)

        return (T)mWindow.findViewById(id);
    }

    public final <T extends View> T requireViewById(int id)
    {
        T view = findViewById(id);
        if (view == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ID does not reference a View inside this Dialog");
        return view;
    }

    public boolean onKeyDown(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE)
        {
            event.startTracking();
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean onKeyLongPress(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)

        return false;
    }

    public boolean onKeyUp(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        if ((keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE) && event.isTracking() && !event.isCanceled())
        {
            onBackPressed();
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }
```

`java/android/app/DialogFragment.java`:

```java
package android.app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.DialogInterface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.Window;
import android.view.WindowManager;

import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.PrintWriter;

public class DialogFragment extends Fragment implements DialogInterface.OnCancelListener, DialogInterface.OnDismissListener
{
    public static final int STYLE_NORMAL = 0;
    public static final int STYLE_NO_TITLE = 1;
    public static final int STYLE_NO_FRAME = 2;
    public static final int STYLE_NO_INPUT = 3;

    private static final String SAVED_DIALOG_STATE_TAG = "android:savedDialogState";
    private static final String SAVED_STYLE = "android:style";
    private static final String SAVED_THEME = "android:theme";
    private static final String SAVED_CANCELABLE = "android:cancelable";
    private static final String SAVED_SHOWS_DIALOG = "android:showsDialog";
    private static final String SAVED_BACK_STACK_ID = "android:backStackId";

    int mStyle = STYLE_NORMAL;
    int mTheme;
    boolean mCancelable = true;
    boolean mShowsDialog = true;
    int mBackStackId = -1;

    Dialog mDialog;
    boolean mViewDestroyed;
    boolean mDismissed;
    boolean mShownByMe;

    public DialogFragment()
    {
    }

    public void setStyle(int style, int theme)
    {
        mStyle = style;
        if (theme != 0) mTheme = theme;
    }

    public void show(FragmentManager manager, String tag)
    {
        mDismissed = false;
        mShownByMe = true;

        FragmentTransaction transaction = manager.beginTransaction();
        transaction.add(this, tag);
        transaction.commit();
    }

    public int show(FragmentTransaction transaction, String tag)
    {
        mDismissed = false;
        mShownByMe = true;

        transaction.add(this, tag);
        mViewDestroyed = false;
        mBackStackId = transaction.commit();
        return mBackStackId;
    }

    public void dismiss()
    {
        dismissInternal(false);
    }

    public void dismissAllowingStateLoss()
    {
        dismissInternal(true);
    }

    void dismissInternal(boolean allowStateLoss)
    {
        if (mDismissed) return;

        mDismissed = true;
        mShownByMe = false;

        if (mDialog != null)
        {
            mDialog.dismiss();
            mDialog = null;
        }

        mViewDestroyed = true;

        FragmentManager manager = getFragmentManager();
        if (manager == null) return;

        if (mBackStackId >= 0)
        {
            manager.popBackStack(mBackStackId, FragmentManager.POP_BACK_STACK_INCLUSIVE);
            mBackStackId = -1;
            return;
        }

        FragmentTransaction transaction = manager.beginTransaction();
        transaction.remove(this);

        if (allowStateLoss) transaction.commitAllowingStateLoss();
        else transaction.commit();
    }

    public Dialog getDialog()
    {
        return mDialog;
    }

    public int getTheme()
    {
        return mTheme;
    }

    public void setCancelable(boolean cancelable)
    {
        mCancelable = cancelable;
        if (mDialog != null) mDialog.setCancelable(cancelable);
    }

    public boolean isCancelable()
    {
        return mCancelable;
    }

    public void setShowsDialog(boolean showsDialog)
    {
        mShowsDialog = showsDialog;
    }

    public boolean getShowsDialog()
    {
        return mShowsDialog;
    }

    @Override
    public void onAttach(Context context)
    {
        super.onAttach(context);

        if (!mShownByMe) mDismissed = false;
    }

    @Override
    public void onDetach()
    {
        super.onDetach();

        if (!mShownByMe && !mDismissed) mDismissed = true;
    }

    @Override
    public void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        mShowsDialog = mContainerId == 0;

        if (savedInstanceState != null)
        {
            mStyle = savedInstanceState.getInt(SAVED_STYLE, STYLE_NORMAL);
            mTheme = savedInstanceState.getInt(SAVED_THEME, 0);
            mCancelable = savedInstanceState.getBoolean(SAVED_CANCELABLE, true);
            mShowsDialog = savedInstanceState.getBoolean(SAVED_SHOWS_DIALOG, mShowsDialog);
            mBackStackId = savedInstanceState.getInt(SAVED_BACK_STACK_ID, -1);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public LayoutInflater onGetLayoutInflater(Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
        if (!mShowsDialog) return super.onGetLayoutInflater(savedInstanceState);

        mDialog = onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState);

        if (mDialog == null) return super.onGetLayoutInflater(savedInstanceState);

        switch (mStyle)
        {
            case STYLE_NO_INPUT:
                if (mDialog.getWindow() != null)
                {
                    mDialog.getWindow().addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE
                                                 | WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE);
                }
                mDialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
                break;

            case STYLE_NO_FRAME:
            case STYLE_NO_TITLE:
                mDialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
                break;

            default:
                break;
        }

        return (LayoutInflater)mDialog.getContext().getSystemService(Context.LAYOUT_INFLATER_SERVICE);
    }

    public Dialog onCreateDialog(Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
        return new Dialog(getActivity(), getTheme());
    }

    @Override
    public void onCancel(DialogInterface dialog)
    {
    }

    @Override
    public void onDismiss(DialogInterface dialog)
    {
        if (!mViewDestroyed) dismissInternal(true);
    }

    @Override
    public void onActivityCreated(Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
        super.onActivityCreated(savedInstanceState);

        if (!mShowsDialog || mDialog == null) return;

        View view = getView();
        if (view != null)
        {
            if (view.getParent() != null) throw new IllegalStateException("DialogFragment can not be attached to a container view");

            mDialog.setContentView(view);
        }

        Activity activity = getActivity();
        if (activity != null) mDialog.setOwnerActivity(activity);

        mDialog.setCancelable(mCancelable);
        mDialog.setOnCancelListener(this);
        mDialog.setOnDismissListener(this);

        if (savedInstanceState != null)
        {
            Bundle dialogState = savedInstanceState.getBundle(SAVED_DIALOG_STATE_TAG);
            if (dialogState != null) mDialog.onRestoreInstanceState(dialogState);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onStart()
    {
        super.onStart();

        if (mDialog != null)
        {
            mViewDestroyed = false;
            mDialog.show();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onSaveInstanceState(Bundle outState)
    {
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState);

        if (mDialog != null)
        {
            Bundle dialogState = mDialog.onSaveInstanceState();
            if (dialogState != null) outState.putBundle(SAVED_DIALOG_STATE_TAG, dialogState);
        }

        if (mStyle != STYLE_NORMAL) outState.putInt(SAVED_STYLE, mStyle);
        if (mTheme != 0) outState.putInt(SAVED_THEME, mTheme);
        if (!mCancelable) outState.putBoolean(SAVED_CANCELABLE, mCancelable);
        if (!mShowsDialog) outState.putBoolean(SAVED_SHOWS_DIALOG, mShowsDialog);
        if (mBackStackId != -1) outState.putInt(SAVED_BACK_STACK_ID, mBackStackId);
    }

    @Override
    public void onStop()
    {
        super.onStop();

        if (mDialog != null) mDialog.hide();
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroyView()
    {
        super.onDestroyView();

        if (mDialog != null)
        {
            mViewDestroyed = true;
            mDialog.dismiss();
            mDialog = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void dump(String prefix, FileDescriptor fd, PrintWriter writer, String[] args)
    {
        super.dump(prefix, fd, writer, args);

        writer.print(prefix);
        writer.println("DialogFragment:");
        writer.print(prefix);
        writer.print("  mStyle=");
        writer.print(mStyle);
        writer.print(" mTheme=0x");
        writer.println(Integer.toHexString(mTheme));
        writer.print(prefix);
        writer.print("  mCancelable=");
        writer.print(mCancelable);
        writer.print(" mShowsDialog=");
        writer.print(mShowsDialog);
        writer.print(" mBackStackId=");
        writer.println(mBackStackId);
        writer.print(prefix);
        writer.print("  mDialog=");
        writer.println(mDialog);
        writer.print(prefix);
        writer.print("  mViewDestroyed=");
        writer.print(mViewDestroyed);
        writer.print(" mDismissed=");
        writer.print(mDismissed);
        writer.print(" mShownByMe=");
        writer.println(mShownByMe);
    }
}
```

```java
        COLUMN_ID, COLUMN_TITLE, COLUMN_DESCRIPTION, COLUMN_URI, COLUMN_MEDIA_TYPE, COLUMN_TOTAL_SIZE_BYTES, COLUMN_LOCAL_URI,
        COLUMN_LOCAL_FILENAME, COLUMN_STATUS, COLUMN_REASON, COLUMN_BYTES_DOWNLOADED_SO_FAR, COLUMN_LAST_MODIFIED_TIMESTAMP,
        COLUMN_MEDIAPROVIDER_URI,
    };

    private static final Map<Long, Download> sDownloads = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private static long sNextId = 1;

    private final Context mContext;

    public DownloadManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public long enqueue(Request request)
    {
        if (request == null) throw new NullPointerException("request must not be null");

        final Download download = new Download();
        download.mTitle = request.mTitle == null ? "" : request.mTitle.toString();
        download.mDescription = request.mDescription == null ? "" : request.mDescription.toString();
        download.mUri = request.mUri.toString();
        download.mMediaType = request.mMimeType;
        download.mDestination = request.mDestinationUri;
        download.mStatus = STATUS_PENDING;
        download.mModified = System.currentTimeMillis();

        synchronized (sDownloads)
        {
            download.mId = sNextId++;
            sDownloads.put(download.mId, download);
        }

        Log.i(TAG, "download " + download.mId + " of " + download.mUri + " was queued, but there is no network to fetch it");

        Runnable fail = new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                synchronized (sDownloads)
                {
                    if (!sDownloads.containsKey(download.mId)) return;

                    download.mStatus = STATUS_FAILED;
                    download.mReason = ERROR_HTTP_DATA_ERROR;
                    download.mModified = System.currentTimeMillis();
                }

                Log.w(TAG, "download " + download.mId + " failed because the network is unreachable");
                announceCompletion(download.mId);
            }
        };

        Looper main = Looper.getMainLooper();
        if (main != null) new Handler(main).post(fail);
        else fail.run();

        return download.mId;
    }

    public int remove(long... ids)
    {
        if (ids == null || ids.length == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("input param 'ids' can't be null");

        int removed = 0;

        synchronized (sDownloads)
        {
            for (long id : ids)
            {
                if (sDownloads.remove(id) != null) removed++;
            }
        }

        return removed;
    }

    public Cursor query(Query query)
    {
        MatrixCursor cursor = new MatrixCursor(COLUMNS);
        List<Download> downloads;

        synchronized (sDownloads)
        {
            downloads = new ArrayList<>(sDownloads.values());
        }

        for (Download download : downloads)
        {
            if (query != null && !query.matches(download)) continue;

            String localUri = download.mStatus == STATUS_SUCCESSFUL && download.mDestination != null ? download.mDestination.toString() : null;
            String localFile = download.mStatus == STATUS_SUCCESSFUL && download.mDestination != null ? download.mDestination.getPath() : null;

            cursor.addRow(new Object[] {
                download.mId, download.mTitle, download.mDescription, download.mUri, download.mMediaType, download.mTotalBytes,
                localUri, localFile, download.mStatus, download.mReason, download.mBytesSoFar, download.mModified, null,
            });
        }

        return cursor;
    }

    public ParcelFileDescriptor openDownloadedFile(long id) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        File file = completedFile(id);
        if (file == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("download " + id + " has not completed");

        return ParcelFileDescriptor.open(file, MODE_READ_ONLY);
    }

    public Uri getUriForDownloadedFile(long id)
    {
        File file = completedFile(id);
        return file == null ? null : Uri.fromFile(file);
    }

    public String getMimeTypeForDownloadedFile(long id)
    {
        synchronized (sDownloads)
        {
            Download download = sDownloads.get(id);
            return download == null ? null : download.mMediaType;
        }
    }

        return null;
    }

        return null;
    }

    public long addCompletedDownload(String title, String description, boolean isMediaScannerScannable, String mimeType, String path,
                                     long length, boolean showNotification)
    {
        return addCompletedDownload(title, description, isMediaScannerScannable, mimeType, path, length, showNotification, null, null);
    }

    public long addCompletedDownload(String title, String description, boolean isMediaScannerScannable, String mimeType, String path,
                                     long length, boolean showNotification, Uri uri, Uri referer)
    {
        if (title == null || title.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("title can't be null or empty");
        if (description == null || description.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("description can't be null or empty");
        if (mimeType == null || mimeType.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("mimeType can't be null or empty");
        if (path == null || path.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("path can't be null or empty");
        if (length < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid value for param: totalBytes");

        Download download = new Download();
        download.mTitle = title;
        download.mDescription = description;
        download.mUri = uri == null ? "" : uri.toString();
        download.mMediaType = mimeType;
        download.mDestination = Uri.fromFile(new File(path));
        download.mStatus = STATUS_SUCCESSFUL;
        download.mTotalBytes = length;
        download.mBytesSoFar = length;
        download.mModified = System.currentTimeMillis();

        synchronized (sDownloads)
        {
            download.mId = sNextId++;
            sDownloads.put(download.mId, download);
        }

        return download.mId;
    }

    private File completedFile(long id)
    {
        synchronized (sDownloads)
        {
            Download download = sDownloads.get(id);
            if (download == null || download.mStatus != STATUS_SUCCESSFUL || download.mDestination == null) return null;

            String path = download.mDestination.getPath();
            return path == null ? null : new File(path);
        }
    }

    private void announceCompletion(long id)
    {
        if (mContext == null) return;

        Intent intent = new Intent(ACTION_DOWNLOAD_COMPLETE);
        intent.setPackage(mContext.getPackageName());
        intent.putExtra(EXTRA_DOWNLOAD_ID, id);

        try
        {
            mContext.sendBroadcast(intent);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException undelivered)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "the completion of download " + id + " could not be broadcast", undelivered);
        }
    }

    private static final class Download
    {
        long mId;
        String mTitle;
        String mDescription;
        String mUri;
        String mMediaType;
        Uri mDestination;
        int mStatus;
        int mReason;
        long mTotalBytes = -1;
        long mBytesSoFar;
        long mModified;
    }

    public static class Request
    {
        public static final int NETWORK_MOBILE = 1;
        public static final int NETWORK_WIFI = 2;

        public static final int VISIBILITY_VISIBLE = 0;
        public static final int VISIBILITY_VISIBLE_NOTIFY_COMPLETED = 1;
        public static final int VISIBILITY_HIDDEN = 2;
        public static final int VISIBILITY_VISIBLE_NOTIFY_ONLY_COMPLETION = 3;

        private final Uri mUri;
        private final List<Pair<String, String>> mRequestHeaders = new ArrayList<>();
        private Uri mDestinationUri;
        private CharSequence mTitle;
        private CharSequence mDescription;
        private String mMimeType;
        private int mNotificationVisibility = VISIBILITY_VISIBLE;
        private int mAllowedNetworkTypes = ~0;
        private boolean mRoamingAllowed = true;
        private boolean mMeteredAllowed = true;
        private boolean mRequiresCharging;
        private boolean mRequiresDeviceIdle;
        private boolean mVisibleInDownloadsUi = true;
        private boolean mScannable;

        public Request(Uri uri)
        {
            if (uri == null) throw new NullPointerException();

            String scheme = uri.getScheme();
            if (scheme == null || (!scheme.equals("http") && !scheme.equals("https")))
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Can only download HTTP/HTTPS URIs: " + uri);
            }

            mUri = uri;
        }

        public Request setDestinationUri(Uri uri)
        {
            mDestinationUri = uri;
            return this;
        }

        public Request setDestinationInExternalFilesDir(Context context, String dirType, String subPath)
        {
            File base = context.getExternalFilesDir(dirType);
            if (base == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to get external storage files directory");

            mDestinationUri = Uri.fromFile(subPath == null ? base : new File(base, subPath));
            return this;
        }

        public Request setDestinationInExternalPublicDir(String dirType, String subPath)
        {
            File base = android.os.Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(dirType);
            if (base == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to get external storage public directory");
            if (!base.exists() && !base.mkdirs()) throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to create directory: " + base.getAbsolutePath());

            mDestinationUri = Uri.fromFile(subPath == null ? base : new File(base, subPath));
            return this;
        }

        public void allowScanningByMediaScanner()
        {
            mScannable = true;
        }

        public Request addRequestHeader(String header, String value)
        {
            if (header == null) throw new NullPointerException("header cannot be null");
            if (header.contains(":")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("header may not contain ':'");

            mRequestHeaders.add(Pair.create(header, value == null ? "" : value));
            return this;
        }

        public Request setTitle(CharSequence title)
        {
            mTitle = title;
            return this;
        }

        public Request setDescription(CharSequence description)
        {
            mDescription = description;
            return this;
        }

        public Request setMimeType(String mimeType)
        {
            mMimeType = mimeType;
            return this;
        }

        public Request setShowRunningNotification(boolean show)
        {
            return setNotificationVisibility(show ? VISIBILITY_VISIBLE : VISIBILITY_HIDDEN);
        }

        public Request setNotificationVisibility(int visibility)
        {
            mNotificationVisibility = visibility;
            return this;
        }

        public Request setAllowedNetworkTypes(int flags)
        {
            mAllowedNetworkTypes = flags;
            return this;
        }

        public Request setAllowedOverRoaming(boolean allowed)
        {
            mRoamingAllowed = allowed;
            return this;
        }

        public Request setAllowedOverMetered(boolean allow)
        {
            mMeteredAllowed = allow;
            return this;
        }

        public Request setRequiresCharging(boolean requiresCharging)
        {
            mRequiresCharging = requiresCharging;
            return this;
        }

        public Request setRequiresDeviceIdle(boolean requiresDeviceIdle)
        {
            mRequiresDeviceIdle = requiresDeviceIdle;
            return this;
        }

        public Request setVisibleInDownloadsUi(boolean isVisible)
        {
            mVisibleInDownloadsUi = isVisible;
            return this;
        }
    }

    public static class Query
    {
        private long[] mIds;
        private Integer mStatusFlags;

        public Query()
        {
        }

        public Query setFilterById(long... ids)
        {
            mIds = ids;
            return this;
        }

        public Query setFilterByStatus(int flags)
        {
            mStatusFlags = flags;
            return this;
        }

        boolean matches(Download download)
        {
            if (mStatusFlags != null && (mStatusFlags & download.mStatus) == 0) return false;
            if (mIds == null) return true;

            for (long id : mIds)
            {
                if (id == download.mId) return true;
            }

            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    public static Fragment instantiate(Context context, String className, Bundle arguments)
    {
        try
        {
            ClassLoader loader = context == null ? Fragment.class.getClassLoader() : context.getClassLoader();
            Class<?> type = loader.loadClass(className);

            if (!Fragment.class.isAssignableFrom(type))
            {
                throw new InstantiationException("Trying to instantiate a class " + className + " that is not a Fragment",
                                                 new ClassCastException());
            }

            Fragment fragment = (Fragment)type.getConstructor().newInstance();

            if (arguments != null)
            {
                arguments.setClassLoader(fragment.getClass().getClassLoader());
                fragment.setArguments(arguments);
            }

            return fragment;
        }
        catch (ReflectiveOperationException failure)
        {
            throw new InstantiationException("Unable to instantiate fragment " + className
                                                 + ": make sure class name exists, is public, and has an empty constructor that is public",
                                             failure);
        }
    }

        writer.print(mDetached);
        writer.print(" mMenuVisible=");
        writer.print(mMenuVisible);

        writer.print("mRetainInstance=");
        writer.print(mRetainInstance);
        writer.print(" mUserVisibleHint=");
        writer.println(mUserVisibleHint);

        if (mArguments != null)
        {
            writer.print(prefix);
            writer.print("mArguments=");
            writer.println(mArguments);
        }

        if (mTarget != null)
        {
            writer.print(prefix);
            writer.print("mTarget=");
            writer.print(mTarget);
            writer.print(" mTargetRequestCode=");
            writer.println(mTargetRequestCode);
        }

        if (mView != null)
        {
            writer.print(prefix);
            writer.print("mView=");
            writer.println(mView);
        }

        if (mLoaderManager != null)
        {
            writer.print(prefix);
            writer.println("Loader Manager:");
            mLoaderManager.dump(prefix + "  ", fd, writer, args);
        }

        if (mChildFragmentManager != null)
        {
            writer.print(prefix);
            writer.println("Child " + mChildFragmentManager + ":");
            mChildFragmentManager.dump(prefix + "  ", fd, writer, args);
        }
    }

    SharedElementCallback enterSharedElementCallback()
    {
        return mEnterSharedElementCallback;
```

```java
package android.app;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class GameState implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int MODE_UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final int MODE_NONE = 1;
    public static final int MODE_GAMEPLAY_INTERRUPTIBLE = 2;
    public static final int MODE_GAMEPLAY_UNINTERRUPTIBLE = 3;
    public static final int MODE_CONTENT = 4;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<GameState> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<GameState>()
    {
        @Override
        public GameState createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new GameState(source.readInt() != 0, source.readInt(), source.readInt(), source.readInt());
        }

        @Override
        public GameState[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new GameState[size];
        }
    };

    private final boolean mIsLoading;
    private final int mMode;
    private final int mLabel;
    private final int mQuality;

    public GameState(boolean isLoading, int mode)
    {
        this(isLoading, mode, -1, -1);
    }

    public GameState(boolean isLoading, int mode, int label, int quality)
    {
        mIsLoading = isLoading;
        mMode = mode;
        mLabel = label;
        mQuality = quality;
    }

    public boolean isLoading()
    {
        return mIsLoading;
    }

    public int getMode()
    {
        return mMode;
    }

    public int getLabel()
    {
        return mLabel;
    }

    public int getQuality()
    {
        return mQuality;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mIsLoading ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeInt(mMode);
        dest.writeInt(mLabel);
        dest.writeInt(mQuality);
    }
}
```

`java/android/app/GrammaticalInflectionManager.java`:

```java
package android.app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.content.res.Configuration;
import android.util.Log;

public class GrammaticalInflectionManager
{
    private static final String TAG = "GrammaticalInflection";
    private static final String PREFERENCES = "android.app.grammatical_inflection";
    private static final String KEY_GENDER = "requested_gender";

    private final Context mContext;

    GrammaticalInflectionManager()
    {
        this(null);
    }

    GrammaticalInflectionManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    private SharedPreferences preferences()
    {
        return mContext == null ? null : mContext.getSharedPreferences(PREFERENCES, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
    }

    public int getApplicationGrammaticalGender()
    {
        SharedPreferences preferences = preferences();
        int requested = preferences == null ? Configuration.GRAMMATICAL_GENDER_NOT_SPECIFIED
                                            : preferences.getInt(KEY_GENDER, Configuration.GRAMMATICAL_GENDER_NOT_SPECIFIED);

        if (requested != Configuration.GRAMMATICAL_GENDER_NOT_SPECIFIED) return requested;

        return mContext == null ? Configuration.GRAMMATICAL_GENDER_NOT_SPECIFIED
                                : mContext.getResources().getConfiguration().getGrammaticalGender();
    }

    public void setRequestedApplicationGrammaticalGender(int grammaticalGender)
    {
        if (grammaticalGender < Configuration.GRAMMATICAL_GENDER_NOT_SPECIFIED || grammaticalGender > Configuration.GRAMMATICAL_GENDER_MASCULINE)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown grammatical gender");
        }

        SharedPreferences preferences = preferences();
        if (preferences != null) preferences.edit().putInt(KEY_GENDER, grammaticalGender).apply();

        Log.i(TAG, "the application asked for grammatical gender " + grammaticalGender);
    }

    public int getSystemGrammaticalGender()
    {
        return Configuration.GRAMMATICAL_GENDER_NOT_SPECIFIED;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.app;

import android.os.Binder;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.IInterface;

public interface IApplicationThread extends IInterface
{
    String DESCRIPTOR = "android.app.IApplicationThread";

    abstract class Stub extends Binder implements IApplicationThread
    {
        public Stub()
        {
            attachInterface(this, DESCRIPTOR);
        }

        public static IApplicationThread asInterface(IBinder binder)
        {
            if (binder == null) return null;

            IInterface local = binder.queryLocalInterface(DESCRIPTOR);
            return local instanceof IApplicationThread ? (IApplicationThread)local : null;
        }

        @Override
        public IBinder asBinder()
        {
            return this;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/app/Instrumentation.java`:

```java
package android.app;

import android.os.Bundle;

public class Instrumentation
{
    public void callApplicationOnCreate(Application application)
    {
        ApplicationStartInfo.recordTimestamp(ApplicationStartInfo.START_TIMESTAMP_APPLICATION_ONCREATE,
                                             android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos());
        application.onCreate();
    }

    public void callActivityOnCreate(Activity activity, Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
        ActivityThread.currentActivityThread().activityCreated(activity);
        activity.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        activity.dispatchLifecycleCreated(savedInstanceState);
    }

    public void callActivityOnPostCreate(Activity activity, Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
        activity.onPostCreate(savedInstanceState);
    }

    public void callActivityOnRestoreInstanceState(Activity activity, Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
        if (savedInstanceState == null) return;

        activity.onRestoreInstanceState(savedInstanceState);
    }

    public void callActivityOnSaveInstanceState(Activity activity, Bundle outState)
    {
        activity.onSaveInstanceState(outState);
        activity.dispatchLifecycleSaveInstanceState(outState);
    }

    public void callActivityOnNewIntent(Activity activity, android.content.Intent intent)
    {
        activity.setIntent(intent);
        activity.onNewIntent(intent);
    }

    public void callActivityOnStart(Activity activity)
    {
        activity.onStart();
        activity.mStarted = true;
        activity.dispatchLifecycleStarted();
        ActivityThread.currentActivityThread().activityStateChanged(activity, true, false);
    }

    public void callActivityOnResume(Activity activity)
    {
        activity.onResume();
        activity.mResumed = true;
        activity.dispatchLifecycleResumed();
        ActivityThread.currentActivityThread().activityStateChanged(activity, false, false);
    }

    public void callActivityOnPause(Activity activity)
    {
        if (!activity.mResumed) return;

        activity.mResumed = false;
        activity.dispatchLifecyclePaused();
        activity.onPause();
        ActivityThread.currentActivityThread().activityStateChanged(activity, true, false);
    }

    public void callActivityOnStop(Activity activity)
    {
        if (!activity.mStarted) return;

        activity.mStarted = false;
        activity.dispatchLifecycleStopped();
        activity.onStop();
        ActivityThread.currentActivityThread().activityStateChanged(activity, true, true);
    }

    public void callActivityOnDestroy(Activity activity)
    {
        activity.dispatchLifecycleDestroyed();
        activity.onDestroy();
        ActivityThread.currentActivityThread().activityDestroyed(activity);
    }
}
```

`java/android/app/IntentService.java`:

```java
package android.app;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.HandlerThread;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.Message;

@Deprecated
public abstract class IntentService extends Service
{
    private final String mName;
    private volatile Looper mServiceLooper;
    private volatile ServiceHandler mServiceHandler;
    private boolean mRedelivery;

    private final class ServiceHandler extends Handler
    {
        ServiceHandler(Looper looper)
        {
            super(looper);
        }

        @Override
        public void handleMessage(Message message)
        {
            onHandleIntent((Intent)message.obj);
            stopSelf(message.arg1);
        }
    }

    public IntentService(String name)
    {
        super();
        mName = name;
    }

    public void setIntentRedelivery(boolean enabled)
    {
        mRedelivery = enabled;
    }

    @Override
    public void onCreate()
    {
        super.onCreate();

        HandlerThread thread = new HandlerThread("IntentService[" + mName + "]");
        thread.start();

        mServiceLooper = thread.getLooper();
        mServiceHandler = new ServiceHandler(mServiceLooper);
    }

    @Override
    public void onStart(Intent intent, int startId)
    {
        Message message = mServiceHandler.obtainMessage();
        message.arg1 = startId;
        message.obj = intent;
        mServiceHandler.sendMessage(message);
    }

    @Override
    public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId)
    {
        onStart(intent, startId);
        return mRedelivery ? START_REDELIVER_INTENT : START_NOT_STICKY;
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy()
    {
        mServiceLooper.quit();
    }

    @Override
    public IBinder onBind(Intent intent)
    {
        return null;
    }

    protected abstract void onHandleIntent(Intent intent);
}
```

```java
package android.app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;

public class KeyguardManager
{
    private final Context mContext;
    private final Map<KeyguardLockedStateListener, Executor> mLockedStateListeners = new HashMap<>();

    public KeyguardManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public Intent createConfirmDeviceCredentialIntent(CharSequence title, CharSequence description)
    {
        return null;
    }

    public KeyguardLock newKeyguardLock(String tag)
    {
        return new KeyguardLock(tag);
    }

    public boolean isKeyguardLocked()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isKeyguardSecure()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean inKeyguardRestrictedInputMode()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isDeviceLocked()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isDeviceSecure()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void requestDismissKeyguard(Activity activity, final KeyguardDismissCallback callback)
    {
        if (callback == null) return;

        android.os.Looper main = android.os.Looper.getMainLooper();
        if (main == null)
        {
            callback.onDismissSucceeded();
            return;
        }

        new android.os.Handler(main).post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                callback.onDismissSucceeded();
            }
        });
    }

    public void exitKeyguardSecurely(OnKeyguardExitResult callback)
    {
        if (callback != null) callback.onKeyguardExitResult(true);
    }

    public void addKeyguardLockedStateListener(Executor executor, KeyguardLockedStateListener listener)
    {
        if (executor == null || listener == null) throw new NullPointerException("executor and listener are required");

        synchronized (mLockedStateListeners)
        {
            mLockedStateListeners.put(listener, executor);
        }
    }

    public void removeKeyguardLockedStateListener(KeyguardLockedStateListener listener)
    {
        synchronized (mLockedStateListeners)
        {
            mLockedStateListeners.remove(listener);
        }
    }

    public class KeyguardLock
    {
        private final String mTag;

        KeyguardLock(String tag)
        {
            mTag = tag;
        }

        public void disableKeyguard()
        {
        }

        public void reenableKeyguard()
        {
        }
    }

    public abstract static class KeyguardDismissCallback
    {
        public KeyguardDismissCallback()
        {
        }

        public void onDismissError()
        {
        }

        public void onDismissSucceeded()
        {
        }

        public void onDismissCancelled()
        {
        }
    }

    public interface OnKeyguardExitResult
    {
        void onKeyguardExitResult(boolean success);
    }

    public interface KeyguardLockedStateListener
    {
        void onKeyguardLockedStateChanged(boolean isKeyguardLocked);
    }
}
```

```java
import android.content.Loader;

import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.PrintWriter;

public abstract class LoaderManager
{
    static boolean sDebug;

    public interface LoaderCallbacks<D>
    {
        Loader<D> onCreateLoader(int id, Bundle args);

        void onLoadFinished(Loader<D> loader, D data);

        void onLoaderReset(Loader<D> loader);
    }

    public LoaderManager()
    {
    }

    public abstract <D> Loader<D> initLoader(int id, Bundle args, LoaderCallbacks<D> callback);

    public abstract <D> Loader<D> restartLoader(int id, Bundle args, LoaderCallbacks<D> callback);

    public abstract void destroyLoader(int id);

    public abstract <D> Loader<D> getLoader(int id);

    public abstract void dump(String prefix, FileDescriptor fd, PrintWriter writer, String[] args);

    public static void enableDebugLogging(boolean enabled)
    {
        sDebug = enabled;
    }
}
```
