`java/android/app/PendingIntent.java`:

```java
package android.app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.IntentSender;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class PendingIntent implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int FLAG_ONE_SHOT = 1 << 30;
    public static final int FLAG_NO_CREATE = 1 << 29;
    public static final int FLAG_CANCEL_CURRENT = 1 << 28;
    public static final int FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT = 1 << 27;
    public static final int FLAG_IMMUTABLE = 1 << 26;
    public static final int FLAG_MUTABLE = 1 << 25;
    public static final int FLAG_ALLOW_UNSAFE_IMPLICIT_INTENT = 1 << 24;

    static final int TARGET_ACTIVITY = 0;
    static final int TARGET_SERVICE = 1;
    static final int TARGET_BROADCAST = 2;
    static final int TARGET_FOREGROUND_SERVICE = 3;

    private static final String TAG = "PendingIntent";

    private static final Map<Key, PendingIntent> sActive = new HashMap<>();

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<PendingIntent> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<PendingIntent>()
    {
        @Override
        public PendingIntent createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return (PendingIntent)source.readValue(null);
        }

        @Override
        public PendingIntent[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new PendingIntent[size];
        }
    };

    private final Context mContext;
    private final int mRequestCode;
    private final Intent[] mIntents;
    private final int mTarget;
    private final int mFlags;
    private final Bundle mOptions;
    private final Key mKey;

    private boolean mCancelled;

    public static class CanceledException extends android.util.AndroidException
    {
        public CanceledException()
        {
        }

        public CanceledException(String name)
        {
            super(name);
        }

        public CanceledException(Exception cause)
        {
            super(cause);
        }
    }

    public interface OnFinished
    {
        void onSendFinished(PendingIntent pendingIntent, Intent intent, int resultCode, String resultData, Bundle resultExtras);
    }

    private PendingIntent(Context context, int requestCode, Intent[] intents, int target, int flags, Bundle options, Key key)
    {
        mContext = context;
        mRequestCode = requestCode;
        mIntents = new Intent[intents.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < intents.length; index++)
        {
            mIntents[index] = intents[index] == null ? null : new Intent(intents[index]);
        }
        mTarget = target;
        mFlags = flags;
        mOptions = options;
        mKey = key;
    }

    private static PendingIntent obtain(Context context, int requestCode, Intent[] intents, int target, int flags, Bundle options)
    {
        Intent primary = intents.length == 0 ? null : intents[intents.length - 1];
        Key key = new Key(target, requestCode, primary);

        synchronized (sActive)
        {
            PendingIntent existing = sActive.get(key);

            if (existing != null && (flags & FLAG_CANCEL_CURRENT) != 0)
            {
                existing.mCancelled = true;
                sActive.remove(key);
                existing = null;
            }

            if ((flags & FLAG_NO_CREATE) != 0) return existing;

            if (existing != null)
            {
                if ((flags & FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT) != 0)
                {
                    for (int index = 0; index < intents.length && index < existing.mIntents.length; index++)
                    {
                        if (intents[index] != null && existing.mIntents[index] != null)
                        {
                            existing.mIntents[index].replaceExtras(intents[index]);
                        }
                    }
                }

                return existing;
            }

            PendingIntent created = new PendingIntent(context, requestCode, intents, target, flags, options, key);
            sActive.put(key, created);
            return created;
        }
    }

    public static PendingIntent getActivity(Context context, int requestCode, Intent intent, int flags)
    {
        return getActivity(context, requestCode, intent, flags, null);
    }

    public static PendingIntent getActivity(Context context, int requestCode, Intent intent, int flags, Bundle options)
    {
        return obtain(context, requestCode, new Intent[] {intent}, TARGET_ACTIVITY, flags, options);
    }

    public static PendingIntent getActivities(Context context, int requestCode, Intent[] intents, int flags)
    {
        return getActivities(context, requestCode, intents, flags, null);
    }

    public static PendingIntent getActivities(Context context, int requestCode, Intent[] intents, int flags, Bundle options)
    {
        return obtain(context, requestCode, intents, TARGET_ACTIVITY, flags, options);
    }

    public static PendingIntent getService(Context context, int requestCode, Intent intent, int flags)
    {
        return obtain(context, requestCode, new Intent[] {intent}, TARGET_SERVICE, flags, null);
    }

    public static PendingIntent getForegroundService(Context context, int requestCode, Intent intent, int flags)
    {
        return obtain(context, requestCode, new Intent[] {intent}, TARGET_FOREGROUND_SERVICE, flags, null);
    }

    public static PendingIntent getBroadcast(Context context, int requestCode, Intent intent, int flags)
    {
        return obtain(context, requestCode, new Intent[] {intent}, TARGET_BROADCAST, flags, null);
    }

    public int getRequestCode()
    {
        return mRequestCode;
    }

    public Intent getIntent()
    {
        return mIntents.length == 0 ? null : mIntents[mIntents.length - 1];
    }

    public IntentSender getIntentSender()
    {
        return new IntentSender(this);
    }

    public void cancel()
    {
        mCancelled = true;

        synchronized (sActive)
        {
            if (sActive.get(mKey) == this) sActive.remove(mKey);
        }
    }

    public void send()
    {
        try
        {
            send(null, 0, null, null, null, null, null);
        }
        catch (CanceledException cancelled)
        {
            android.util.Log.w(TAG, "a cancelled pending intent was sent and did nothing: " + getIntent());
        }
    }

    public void send(int code)
    {
        try
        {
            send(null, code, null, null, null, null, null);
        }
        catch (CanceledException cancelled)
        {
            android.util.Log.w(TAG, "a cancelled pending intent was sent and did nothing: " + getIntent());
        }
    }

    public void send(Bundle options) throws CanceledException
    {
        send(null, 0, null, null, null, null, options);
    }

    public void send(int code, OnFinished onFinished, Handler handler) throws CanceledException
    {
        send(null, code, null, onFinished, handler, null, null);
    }

    public void send(Context context, int code, Intent intent) throws CanceledException
    {
        send(context, code, intent, null, null, null, null);
    }

    public void send(Context context, int code, Intent intent, OnFinished onFinished, Handler handler) throws CanceledException
    {
        send(context, code, intent, onFinished, handler, null, null);
    }

    public void send(Context context, int code, Intent intent, OnFinished onFinished, Handler handler, String requiredPermission)
        throws CanceledException
    {
        send(context, code, intent, onFinished, handler, requiredPermission, null);
    }

    public void send(Context context, int code, Intent intent, final OnFinished onFinished, Handler handler, String requiredPermission,
                     Bundle options) throws CanceledException
    {
        if (mCancelled) throw new CanceledException("the pending intent was cancelled");

        Intent primary = getIntent();
        if (primary == null) return;

        final Intent sent = new Intent(primary);
        if (intent != null && (mFlags & FLAG_IMMUTABLE) == 0) sent.fillIn(intent, 0);

        if (mTarget == TARGET_ACTIVITY)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < mIntents.length - 1; index++)
            {
                if (mIntents[index] != null) runtime.Activities.start(new Intent(mIntents[index]), -1);
            }

            runtime.Activities.start(sent, -1);
        }
        else if (mTarget == TARGET_SERVICE || mTarget == TARGET_FOREGROUND_SERVICE)
        {
            runtime.Services.start(sent);
        }
        else
        {
            runtime.Broadcasts.send(sent, null, false);
        }

        if ((mFlags & FLAG_ONE_SHOT) != 0) cancel();

        if (onFinished == null) return;

        final int resultCode = code;
        Runnable finished = new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                onFinished.onSendFinished(PendingIntent.this, sent, resultCode, null, null);
            }
        };

        if (handler != null) handler.post(finished);
        else finished.run();
    }

    public String getTargetPackage()
    {
        return getCreatorPackage();
    }

    public String getCreatorPackage()
    {
        return mContext == null ? null : mContext.getPackageName();
    }

    public int getCreatorUid()
    {
        return android.os.Process.myUid();
    }

    public android.os.UserHandle getCreatorUserHandle()
    {
        return android.os.Process.myUserHandle();
    }

    public boolean isActivity()
    {
        return mTarget == TARGET_ACTIVITY;
    }

    public boolean isForegroundService()
    {
        return mTarget == TARGET_FOREGROUND_SERVICE;
    }

    public boolean isService()
    {
        return mTarget == TARGET_SERVICE;
    }

    public boolean isBroadcast()
    {
        return mTarget == TARGET_BROADCAST;
    }

    public boolean isImmutable()
    {
        return (mFlags & FLAG_IMMUTABLE) != 0;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeValue(this);
    }

    public static void writePendingIntentOrNullToParcel(PendingIntent sender, Parcel out)
    {
        out.writeValue(sender);
    }

    public static PendingIntent readPendingIntentOrNullFromParcel(Parcel in)
    {
        Object value = in.readValue(null);
        return value instanceof PendingIntent ? (PendingIntent)value : null;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "PendingIntent{" + Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(this)) + ": " + describeTarget() + " " + getIntent() + "}";
    }

    private String describeTarget()
    {
        if (mTarget == TARGET_ACTIVITY) return "activity";
        if (mTarget == TARGET_SERVICE) return "service";
        if (mTarget == TARGET_FOREGROUND_SERVICE) return "foreground service";

        return "broadcast";
    }

    private static final class Key
    {
        private final int mTarget;
        private final int mRequestCode;
        private final Intent.FilterComparison mIntent;

        Key(int target, int requestCode, Intent intent)
        {
            mTarget = target;
            mRequestCode = requestCode;
            mIntent = intent == null ? null : new Intent.FilterComparison(new Intent(intent));
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object other)
        {
            if (!(other instanceof Key)) return false;

            Key compared = (Key)other;
            return mTarget == compared.mTarget && mRequestCode == compared.mRequestCode && Objects.equals(mIntent, compared.mIntent);
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return Objects.hash(mTarget, mRequestCode, mIntent);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
        parcel.writeValue(mName);
        parcel.writeValue(mUri);
        parcel.writeValue(mKey);
        parcel.writeValue(Boolean.valueOf(mBot));
        parcel.writeValue(Boolean.valueOf(mImportant));
    }

    public static final Creator<Person> CREATOR = new Creator<Person>()
    {
        @Override
        public Person createFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
        {
            Person person = new Person();

            person.mName = (CharSequence)parcel.readValue(null);
            person.mUri = (String)parcel.readValue(null);
            person.mKey = (String)parcel.readValue(null);
            person.mBot = Boolean.TRUE.equals(parcel.readValue(null));
            person.mImportant = Boolean.TRUE.equals(parcel.readValue(null));

            return person;
        }

        @Override
        public Person[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Person[size];
        }
    };
```

```java
package android.app;

import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.Objects;

public final class PictureInPictureParams implements Parcelable
{
    private Rational mAspectRatio;
    private Rational mExpandedAspectRatio;
    private List<RemoteAction> mActions;
    private RemoteAction mCloseAction;
    private Rect mSourceRectHint;
    private boolean mAutoEnterEnabled;
    private boolean mSeamlessResizeEnabled = true;
    private CharSequence mTitle;
    private CharSequence mSubtitle;

    PictureInPictureParams()
    {
    }

    public Rational getAspectRatio()
    {
        return mAspectRatio;
    }

    public Rational getExpandedAspectRatio()
    {
        return mExpandedAspectRatio;
    }

    public List<RemoteAction> getActions()
    {
        return mActions == null ? new ArrayList<RemoteAction>() : mActions;
    }

    public RemoteAction getCloseAction()
    {
        return mCloseAction;
    }

    public Rect getSourceRectHint()
    {
        return mSourceRectHint;
    }

    public boolean isAutoEnterEnabled()
    {
        return mAutoEnterEnabled;
    }

    public boolean isSeamlessResizeEnabled()
    {
        return mSeamlessResizeEnabled;
    }

    public CharSequence getTitle()
    {
        return mTitle;
    }

    public CharSequence getSubtitle()
    {
        return mSubtitle;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof PictureInPictureParams)) return false;

        PictureInPictureParams that = (PictureInPictureParams)other;

        return mAutoEnterEnabled == that.mAutoEnterEnabled && mSeamlessResizeEnabled == that.mSeamlessResizeEnabled
               && Objects.equals(mAspectRatio, that.mAspectRatio) && Objects.equals(mExpandedAspectRatio, that.mExpandedAspectRatio)
               && Objects.equals(mActions, that.mActions) && Objects.equals(mCloseAction, that.mCloseAction)
               && Objects.equals(mSourceRectHint, that.mSourceRectHint) && Objects.equals(mTitle, that.mTitle)
               && Objects.equals(mSubtitle, that.mSubtitle);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mAspectRatio, mExpandedAspectRatio, mActions, mCloseAction, mSourceRectHint, mAutoEnterEnabled,
                            mSeamlessResizeEnabled, mTitle, mSubtitle);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "PictureInPictureParams( aspectRatio=" + mAspectRatio + " expandedAspectRatio=" + mExpandedAspectRatio
               + " sourceRectHint=" + mSourceRectHint + " hasSetActions=" + (mActions != null) + " hasSetCloseAction="
               + (mCloseAction != null) + " isAutoPipEnabled=" + mAutoEnterEnabled + " isSeamlessResizeEnabled="
               + mSeamlessResizeEnabled + " title=" + mTitle + " subtitle=" + mSubtitle + ")";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        writeRational(parcel, mAspectRatio);
        writeRational(parcel, mExpandedAspectRatio);
        parcel.writeInt(mActions == null ? -1 : mActions.size());
        if (mActions != null)
        {
            for (RemoteAction action : mActions) action.writeToParcel(parcel, flags);
        }

        parcel.writeBoolean(mCloseAction != null);
        if (mCloseAction != null) mCloseAction.writeToParcel(parcel, flags);

        parcel.writeBoolean(mSourceRectHint != null);
        if (mSourceRectHint != null) mSourceRectHint.writeToParcel(parcel, flags);

        parcel.writeBoolean(mAutoEnterEnabled);
        parcel.writeBoolean(mSeamlessResizeEnabled);
        parcel.writeValue(mTitle);
        parcel.writeValue(mSubtitle);
    }

    private static void writeRational(Parcel parcel, Rational value)
    {
        parcel.writeBoolean(value != null);
        if (value == null) return;

        parcel.writeInt(value.getNumerator());
        parcel.writeInt(value.getDenominator());
    }

    private static Rational readRational(Parcel parcel)
    {
        if (!parcel.readBoolean()) return null;

        int numerator = parcel.readInt();
        return new Rational(numerator, parcel.readInt());
    }

    public static final Creator<PictureInPictureParams> CREATOR = new Creator<PictureInPictureParams>()
    {
        @Override
        public PictureInPictureParams createFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
        {
            PictureInPictureParams params = new PictureInPictureParams();

            params.mAspectRatio = readRational(parcel);
            params.mExpandedAspectRatio = readRational(parcel);

            int actionCount = parcel.readInt();
            if (actionCount >= 0)
            {
                params.mActions = new ArrayList<>(actionCount);
                for (int index = 0; index < actionCount; index++) params.mActions.add(RemoteAction.CREATOR.createFromParcel(parcel));
            }

            if (parcel.readBoolean()) params.mCloseAction = RemoteAction.CREATOR.createFromParcel(parcel);
            if (parcel.readBoolean()) params.mSourceRectHint = Rect.CREATOR.createFromParcel(parcel);

            params.mAutoEnterEnabled = parcel.readBoolean();
            params.mSeamlessResizeEnabled = parcel.readBoolean();
            params.mTitle = (CharSequence)parcel.readValue(null);
            params.mSubtitle = (CharSequence)parcel.readValue(null);

            return params;
        }

        @Override
        public PictureInPictureParams[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new PictureInPictureParams[size];
        }
    };

    public static class Builder
    {
        private Rational mAspectRatio;
        private Rational mExpandedAspectRatio;
        private List<RemoteAction> mActions;
        private RemoteAction mCloseAction;
        private Rect mSourceRectHint;
        private boolean mAutoEnterEnabled;
        private boolean mSeamlessResizeEnabled = true;
        private CharSequence mTitle;
        private CharSequence mSubtitle;

        }

        public Builder(PictureInPictureParams original)
        {
            mAspectRatio = original.mAspectRatio;
            mExpandedAspectRatio = original.mExpandedAspectRatio;
            mActions = original.mActions == null ? null : new ArrayList<>(original.mActions);
            mCloseAction = original.mCloseAction;
            mSourceRectHint = original.mSourceRectHint == null ? null : new Rect(original.mSourceRectHint);
            mAutoEnterEnabled = original.mAutoEnterEnabled;
            mSeamlessResizeEnabled = original.mSeamlessResizeEnabled;
            mTitle = original.mTitle;
            mSubtitle = original.mSubtitle;
        }

            mAspectRatio = aspectRatio;
            return this;

        public Builder setExpandedAspectRatio(Rational expandedAspectRatio)
```

```java
package android.app;

import android.os.Parcel;

public final class PictureInPictureUiState implements Parcelable
{
    private boolean mStashed;
    private boolean mTransitioningToPip;

    PictureInPictureUiState()
    {
    }

    PictureInPictureUiState(boolean stashed, boolean transitioningToPip)
    {
        mStashed = stashed;
        mTransitioningToPip = transitioningToPip;
    }

    public boolean isStashed()
    {
        return mStashed;
    }

    public boolean isTransitioningToPip()
    {
        return mTransitioningToPip;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof PictureInPictureUiState)) return false;

        PictureInPictureUiState that = (PictureInPictureUiState)other;
        return mStashed == that.mStashed && mTransitioningToPip == that.mTransitioningToPip;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return (mStashed ? 1 : 0) * 31 + (mTransitioningToPip ? 1 : 0);

    }
```

`java/android/app/ProgressDialog.java`:

```java
package android.app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.DialogInterface;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.text.SpannableString;
import android.text.Spanned;
import android.text.style.StyleSpan;
import android.util.TypedValue;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.text.NumberFormat;

public class ProgressDialog extends AlertDialog
{
    public static final int STYLE_SPINNER = 0;
    public static final int STYLE_HORIZONTAL = 1;

    private static final float MESSAGE_SIZE_SP = 16f;

    private ProgressBar mProgress;
    private TextView mMessageView;
    private TextView mProgressNumber;
    private TextView mProgressPercent;

    private int mProgressStyle = STYLE_SPINNER;
    private String mProgressNumberFormat = "%1d/%2d";
    private NumberFormat mProgressPercentFormat;

    private int mMax;
    private int mProgressVal;
    private int mSecondaryProgressVal;
    private int mIncrementBy;
    private int mIncrementSecondaryBy;
    private Drawable mProgressDrawable;
    private Drawable mIndeterminateDrawable;
    private CharSequence mMessage;
    private boolean mIndeterminate;

    private final Handler mViewUpdateHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private final Runnable mUpdateNumbers = new Runnable()
    {
        @Override
        public void run()
        {
            updateNumbers();
        }
    };

    public ProgressDialog(Context context)
    {
        super(context);
        initFormats();
    }

    public ProgressDialog(Context context, int theme)
    {
        super(context, theme);
        initFormats();
    }

    private void initFormats()
    {
        mProgressPercentFormat = NumberFormat.getPercentInstance();
        mProgressPercentFormat.setMaximumFractionDigits(0);
    }

    public static ProgressDialog show(Context context, CharSequence title, CharSequence message)
    {
        return show(context, title, message, false);
    }

    public static ProgressDialog show(Context context, CharSequence title, CharSequence message, boolean indeterminate)
    {
        return show(context, title, message, indeterminate, false, null);
    }

    public static ProgressDialog show(Context context, CharSequence title, CharSequence message, boolean indeterminate, boolean cancelable)
    {
        return show(context, title, message, indeterminate, cancelable, null);
    }

    public static ProgressDialog show(Context context, CharSequence title, CharSequence message, boolean indeterminate, boolean cancelable,
                                      DialogInterface.OnCancelListener cancelListener)
    {
        ProgressDialog dialog = new ProgressDialog(context);
        dialog.setTitle(title);
        dialog.setMessage(message);
        dialog.setIndeterminate(indeterminate);
        dialog.setCancelable(cancelable);
        dialog.setOnCancelListener(cancelListener);
        dialog.show();
        return dialog;
    }

    private int pixels(float dp)
    {
        return Math.round(dp * getContext().getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
        Context context = getContext();

        int horizontalStyle = context.getResources().getIdentifier("progressBarStyleHorizontal", "attr", "android");

        if (mProgressStyle == STYLE_HORIZONTAL)
        {
            LinearLayout column = new LinearLayout(context);
            column.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);

            mMessageView = new TextView(context);
            mMessageView.setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, MESSAGE_SIZE_SP);
            column.addView(mMessageView, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

            mProgress = new ProgressBar(context, null, horizontalStyle);
            mProgress.setIndeterminate(false);
            column.addView(mProgress, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, pixels(16)));

            LinearLayout numbers = new LinearLayout(context);
            numbers.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);

            mProgressPercent = new TextView(context);
            numbers.addView(mProgressPercent, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));

            mProgressNumber = new TextView(context);
            mProgressNumber.setGravity(Gravity.END);
            numbers.addView(mProgressNumber, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));

            column.addView(numbers, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
            setView(column);
        }
        else
        {
            LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(context);
            row.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
            row.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);

            mProgress = new ProgressBar(context);
            row.addView(mProgress, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

            mMessageView = new TextView(context);
            mMessageView.setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, MESSAGE_SIZE_SP);
            mMessageView.setPadding(pixels(16), 0, 0, 0);
            row.addView(mMessageView, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

            setView(row);
        }

        if (mMax > 0) setMax(mMax);
        if (mProgressVal > 0) mProgress.setProgress(mProgressVal);
        if (mSecondaryProgressVal > 0) setSecondaryProgress(mSecondaryProgressVal);
        if (mIncrementBy > 0) incrementProgressBy(mIncrementBy);
        if (mIncrementSecondaryBy > 0) incrementSecondaryProgressBy(mIncrementSecondaryBy);
        if (mProgressDrawable != null) setProgressDrawable(mProgressDrawable);
        if (mIndeterminateDrawable != null) setIndeterminateDrawable(mIndeterminateDrawable);
        if (mMessage != null) setMessage(mMessage);
        setIndeterminate(mIndeterminate);

        updateNumbers();
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
    }

    @Override
    public void onStart()
    {
        super.onStart();
        updateNumbers();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onStop()
    {
        super.onStop();
        mViewUpdateHandler.removeCallbacks(mUpdateNumbers);
    }

    public void setProgress(int value)
    {
        if (mProgress != null)
        {
            mProgress.setProgress(value);
            onProgressChanged();
            return;
        }

        mProgressVal = value;
    }

    public void setSecondaryProgress(int secondaryProgress)
    {
        if (mProgress != null)
        {
            mProgress.setSecondaryProgress(secondaryProgress);
            onProgressChanged();
            return;
        }

        mSecondaryProgressVal = secondaryProgress;
    }

    public int getProgress()
    {
        return mProgress != null ? mProgress.getProgress() : mProgressVal;
    }

    public int getSecondaryProgress()
    {
        return mProgress != null ? mProgress.getSecondaryProgress() : mSecondaryProgressVal;
    }

    public int getMax()
    {
        return mProgress != null ? mProgress.getMax() : mMax;
    }

    public void setMax(int max)
    {
        if (mProgress != null)
        {
            mProgress.setMax(max);
            onProgressChanged();
            return;
        }

        mMax = max;
    }

    public void incrementProgressBy(int diff)
    {
        if (mProgress != null)
        {
            mProgress.incrementProgressBy(diff);
            onProgressChanged();
            return;
        }

        mIncrementBy += diff;
    }

    public void incrementSecondaryProgressBy(int diff)
    {
        if (mProgress != null)
        {
            mProgress.setSecondaryProgress(mProgress.getSecondaryProgress() + diff);
            onProgressChanged();
            return;
        }

        mIncrementSecondaryBy += diff;
    }

    public void setProgressDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        if (mProgress != null) mProgress.setProgressDrawable(drawable);
        else mProgressDrawable = drawable;
    }

    public void setIndeterminateDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        if (mProgress != null) mProgress.setIndeterminateDrawable(drawable);
        else mIndeterminateDrawable = drawable;
    }

    public void setIndeterminate(boolean indeterminate)
    {
        if (mProgress != null) mProgress.setIndeterminate(indeterminate);
        else mIndeterminate = indeterminate;

        mIndeterminate = indeterminate;
        updateNumbers();
    }

    public boolean isIndeterminate()
    {
        return mProgress != null ? mProgress.isIndeterminate() : mIndeterminate;
    }

    @Override
    public void setMessage(CharSequence message)
    {
        mMessage = message;
        if (mMessageView != null) mMessageView.setText(message);
    }

    public void setProgressStyle(int style)
    {
        mProgressStyle = style;
    }

    public void setProgressNumberFormat(String format)
    {
        mProgressNumberFormat = format;
        onProgressChanged();
    }

    public void setProgressPercentFormat(NumberFormat format)
    {
        mProgressPercentFormat = format;
        onProgressChanged();
    }

    private void onProgressChanged()
    {
        if (mProgressStyle != STYLE_HORIZONTAL) return;

        mViewUpdateHandler.removeCallbacks(mUpdateNumbers);
        mViewUpdateHandler.post(mUpdateNumbers);
    }

    private void updateNumbers()
    {
        if (mProgress == null || mProgressStyle != STYLE_HORIZONTAL) return;

        boolean hidden = mProgress.isIndeterminate();
        int progress = mProgress.getProgress();
        int max = mProgress.getMax();

        if (mProgressNumber != null)
        {
            if (mProgressNumberFormat != null && !hidden)
            {
                mProgressNumber.setText(String.format(mProgressNumberFormat, progress, max));
                mProgressNumber.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            }
            else
            {
                mProgressNumber.setText("");
                mProgressNumber.setVisibility(hidden ? View.GONE : View.VISIBLE);
            }
        }

        if (mProgressPercent != null)
        {
            if (mProgressPercentFormat != null && !hidden && max > 0)
            {
                double percent = (double)progress / (double)max;
                SpannableString text = new SpannableString(mProgressPercentFormat.format(percent));
                text.setSpan(new StyleSpan(android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD), 0, text.length(), Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE);
                mProgressPercent.setText(text);
                mProgressPercent.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            }
            else
            {
                mProgressPercent.setText("");
                mProgressPercent.setVisibility(hidden ? View.GONE : View.VISIBLE);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/app/RemoteAction.java`:

```java
package android.app;

import android.graphics.drawable.Icon;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.text.TextUtils;

import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class RemoteAction implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<RemoteAction> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<RemoteAction>()
    {
        @Override
        public RemoteAction createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            Icon icon = Icon.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            String title = source.readString();
            String contentDescription = source.readString();
            RemoteAction action = new RemoteAction(icon, title, contentDescription, null);
            action.mEnabled = source.readInt() != 0;
            action.mShouldShowIcon = source.readInt() != 0;
            return action;
        }

        @Override
        public RemoteAction[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new RemoteAction[size];
        }
    };

    private final Icon mIcon;
    private final CharSequence mTitle;
    private final CharSequence mContentDescription;
    private final PendingIntent mActionIntent;
    private boolean mEnabled;
    private boolean mShouldShowIcon;

    public RemoteAction(Icon icon, CharSequence title, CharSequence contentDescription, PendingIntent intent)
    {
        if (icon == null || title == null || contentDescription == null)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected icon, title, and content description to be non-null");
        }

        mIcon = icon;
        mTitle = title;
        mContentDescription = contentDescription;
        mActionIntent = intent;
        mEnabled = true;
        mShouldShowIcon = true;
    }

    public void setEnabled(boolean enabled)
    {
        mEnabled = enabled;
    }

    public boolean isEnabled()
    {
        return mEnabled;
    }

    public void setShouldShowIcon(boolean shouldShowIcon)
    {
        mShouldShowIcon = shouldShowIcon;
    }

    public boolean shouldShowIcon()
    {
        return mShouldShowIcon;
    }

    public Icon getIcon()
    {
        return mIcon;
    }

    public CharSequence getTitle()
    {
        return mTitle;
    }

    public CharSequence getContentDescription()
    {
        return mContentDescription;
    }

    public PendingIntent getActionIntent()
    {
        return mActionIntent;
    }

    @Override
    public RemoteAction clone()
    {
        RemoteAction action = new RemoteAction(mIcon, mTitle, mContentDescription, mActionIntent);
        action.setEnabled(mEnabled);
        action.setShouldShowIcon(mShouldShowIcon);
        return action;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof RemoteAction)) return false;

        RemoteAction that = (RemoteAction)other;
        return Objects.equals(mIcon, that.mIcon) && TextUtils.equals(mTitle, that.mTitle)
               && TextUtils.equals(mContentDescription, that.mContentDescription) && Objects.equals(mActionIntent, that.mActionIntent)
               && mEnabled == that.mEnabled && mShouldShowIcon == that.mShouldShowIcon;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mIcon, mTitle == null ? null : mTitle.toString(),
                            mContentDescription == null ? null : mContentDescription.toString(), mActionIntent, mEnabled, mShouldShowIcon);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        mIcon.writeToParcel(dest, 0);
        dest.writeString(mTitle.toString());
        dest.writeString(mContentDescription.toString());
        dest.writeInt(mEnabled ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeInt(mShouldShowIcon ? 1 : 0);
    }

    public void dump(String prefix, PrintWriter writer)
    {
        writer.print(prefix);
        writer.print("title=" + mTitle);
        writer.print(" enabled=" + mEnabled);
        writer.print(" contentDescription=" + mContentDescription);
        writer.print(" icon=" + mIcon);
        writer.print(" action=" + mActionIntent);
        writer.print(" shouldShowIcon=" + mShouldShowIcon);
        writer.println();
    }
}
```

`java/android/app/RemoteInput.java`:

```java
package android.app;

import android.content.ClipData;
import android.content.ClipDescription;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

public final class RemoteInput implements Parcelable
{
    public static final String EXTRA_RESULTS_DATA = "android.remoteinput.resultsData";
    public static final String RESULTS_CLIP_LABEL = "android.remoteinput.results";

    public static final int SOURCE_FREE_FORM_INPUT = 0;
    public static final int SOURCE_CHOICE = 1;

    public static final int EDIT_CHOICES_BEFORE_SENDING_AUTO = 0;
    public static final int EDIT_CHOICES_BEFORE_SENDING_DISABLED = 1;
    public static final int EDIT_CHOICES_BEFORE_SENDING_ENABLED = 2;

    private static final String EXTRA_DATA_TYPE_RESULTS_DATA = "android.remoteinput.dataTypeResultsData";
    private static final String EXTRA_RESULTS_SOURCE = "android.remoteinput.resultsSource";
    private static final int FLAG_DISALLOW_FREE_FORM_INPUT = 0x1;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<RemoteInput> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<RemoteInput>()
    {
        @Override
        public RemoteInput createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            RemoteInput input = new RemoteInput();
            input.mResultKey = source.readString();
            input.mLabel = (CharSequence)source.readValue(null);
            input.mChoices = (CharSequence[])source.readValue(null);
            input.mFlags = source.readInt();
            input.mEditChoicesBeforeSending = source.readInt();
            Bundle extras = source.readBundle();
            input.mExtras = extras == null ? new Bundle() : extras;

            String[] types = source.createStringArray();
            if (types != null)
            {
                for (String type : types) input.mAllowedDataTypes.add(type);
            }

            return input;
        }

        @Override
        public RemoteInput[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new RemoteInput[size];
        }
    };

    private String mResultKey;
    private CharSequence mLabel;
    private CharSequence[] mChoices;
    private int mFlags;
    private int mEditChoicesBeforeSending;
    private Bundle mExtras = new Bundle();
    private final Set<String> mAllowedDataTypes = new LinkedHashSet<>();

    RemoteInput()
    {
    }

    public String getResultKey()
    {
        return mResultKey;
    }

    public CharSequence getLabel()
    {
        return mLabel;
    }

    public CharSequence[] getChoices()
    {
        return mChoices;
    }

    public Set<String> getAllowedDataTypes()
    {
        return mAllowedDataTypes;
    }

    public boolean isDataOnly()
    {
        return !getAllowFreeFormInput() && (mChoices == null || mChoices.length == 0) && !mAllowedDataTypes.isEmpty();
    }

    public boolean getAllowFreeFormInput()
    {
        return (mFlags & FLAG_DISALLOW_FREE_FORM_INPUT) == 0;
    }

    public int getEditChoicesBeforeSending()
    {
        return mEditChoicesBeforeSending;
    }

    public Bundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    private static Intent getClipDataIntentFromIntent(Intent intent)
    {
        ClipData clipData = intent.getClipData();
        if (clipData == null) return null;

        ClipDescription description = clipData.getDescription();
        if (!description.hasMimeType(ClipDescription.MIMETYPE_TEXT_INTENT)) return null;
        if (description.getLabel() == null || !RESULTS_CLIP_LABEL.contentEquals(description.getLabel())) return null;

        return clipData.getItemAt(0).getIntent();
    }

    private static String getExtraResultsKeyForData(String mimeType)
    {
        return EXTRA_DATA_TYPE_RESULTS_DATA + mimeType;
    }

    public static Map<String, Uri> getDataResultsFromIntent(Intent intent, String remoteInputResultKey)
    {
        Intent clipDataIntent = getClipDataIntentFromIntent(intent);
        if (clipDataIntent == null || clipDataIntent.getExtras() == null) return null;

        Map<String, Uri> results = new HashMap<>();
        Bundle extras = clipDataIntent.getExtras();

        for (String key : extras.keySet())
        {
            if (!key.startsWith(EXTRA_DATA_TYPE_RESULTS_DATA)) continue;

            String mimeType = key.substring(EXTRA_DATA_TYPE_RESULTS_DATA.length());
            if (mimeType.isEmpty()) continue;

            Bundle bundle = clipDataIntent.getBundleExtra(key);
            String uriString = bundle == null ? null : bundle.getString(remoteInputResultKey);
            if (uriString == null || uriString.isEmpty()) continue;

            results.put(mimeType, Uri.parse(uriString));
        }

        return results.isEmpty() ? null : results;
    }

    public static Bundle getResultsFromIntent(Intent intent)
    {
        Intent clipDataIntent = getClipDataIntentFromIntent(intent);
        if (clipDataIntent == null) return null;

        return clipDataIntent.getBundleExtra(EXTRA_RESULTS_DATA);
    }

    public static void addResultsToIntent(RemoteInput[] remoteInputs, Intent intent, Bundle results)
    {
        Intent clipDataIntent = getClipDataIntentFromIntent(intent);
        if (clipDataIntent == null) clipDataIntent = new Intent();

        Bundle resultsBundle = clipDataIntent.getBundleExtra(EXTRA_RESULTS_DATA);
        if (resultsBundle == null) resultsBundle = new Bundle();

        for (RemoteInput remoteInput : remoteInputs)
        {
            Object result = results.get(remoteInput.getResultKey());
            if (result instanceof CharSequence) resultsBundle.putCharSequence(remoteInput.getResultKey(), (CharSequence)result);
        }

        clipDataIntent.putExtra(EXTRA_RESULTS_DATA, resultsBundle);
        intent.setClipData(ClipData.newIntent(RESULTS_CLIP_LABEL, clipDataIntent));
    }

    public static void addDataResultToIntent(RemoteInput remoteInput, Intent intent, Map<String, Uri> results)
    {
        Intent clipDataIntent = getClipDataIntentFromIntent(intent);
        if (clipDataIntent == null) clipDataIntent = new Intent();

        for (Map.Entry<String, Uri> entry : results.entrySet())
        {
            String mimeType = entry.getKey();
            Uri uri = entry.getValue();
            if (mimeType == null) continue;

            Bundle resultsBundle = clipDataIntent.getBundleExtra(getExtraResultsKeyForData(mimeType));
            if (resultsBundle == null) resultsBundle = new Bundle();

            resultsBundle.putString(remoteInput.getResultKey(), uri == null ? null : uri.toString());
            clipDataIntent.putExtra(getExtraResultsKeyForData(mimeType), resultsBundle);
        }

        intent.setClipData(ClipData.newIntent(RESULTS_CLIP_LABEL, clipDataIntent));
    }

    public static void setResultsSource(Intent intent, int source)
    {
        Intent clipDataIntent = getClipDataIntentFromIntent(intent);
        if (clipDataIntent == null) clipDataIntent = new Intent();

        clipDataIntent.putExtra(EXTRA_RESULTS_SOURCE, source);
        intent.setClipData(ClipData.newIntent(RESULTS_CLIP_LABEL, clipDataIntent));
    }

    public static int getResultsSource(Intent intent)
    {
        Intent clipDataIntent = getClipDataIntentFromIntent(intent);
        if (clipDataIntent == null) return SOURCE_FREE_FORM_INPUT;

        return clipDataIntent.getExtras() == null ? SOURCE_FREE_FORM_INPUT
                                                  : clipDataIntent.getIntExtra(EXTRA_RESULTS_SOURCE, SOURCE_FREE_FORM_INPUT);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        parcel.writeString(mResultKey);
        parcel.writeValue(mLabel);
        parcel.writeValue(mChoices == null ? null : mChoices.clone());
        parcel.writeInt(mFlags);
        parcel.writeInt(mEditChoicesBeforeSending);
        parcel.writeBundle(mExtras);
        parcel.writeStringArray(mAllowedDataTypes.toArray(new String[0]));
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final String mResultKey;
        private final Set<String> mAllowedDataTypes = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        private final Bundle mExtras = new Bundle();
        private CharSequence mLabel;
        private CharSequence[] mChoices;
        private int mFlags;
        private int mEditChoicesBeforeSending = EDIT_CHOICES_BEFORE_SENDING_AUTO;

        public Builder(String resultKey)
        {
            if (resultKey == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Result key can't be null");

            mResultKey = resultKey;
        }

        public Builder setLabel(CharSequence label)
        {
            mLabel = label;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setChoices(CharSequence[] choices)
        {
            mChoices = choices == null ? null : choices.clone();
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setAllowDataType(String mimeType, boolean doAllow)
        {
            if (doAllow) mAllowedDataTypes.add(mimeType);
            else mAllowedDataTypes.remove(mimeType);

            return this;
        }

        public Builder setAllowFreeFormInput(boolean allowFreeFormTextInput)
        {
            if (allowFreeFormTextInput) mFlags &= ~FLAG_DISALLOW_FREE_FORM_INPUT;
            else mFlags |= FLAG_DISALLOW_FREE_FORM_INPUT;

            return this;
        }

        public Builder setEditChoicesBeforeSending(int editChoicesBeforeSending)
        {
            if (editChoicesBeforeSending != EDIT_CHOICES_BEFORE_SENDING_AUTO
                && editChoicesBeforeSending != EDIT_CHOICES_BEFORE_SENDING_DISABLED
                && editChoicesBeforeSending != EDIT_CHOICES_BEFORE_SENDING_ENABLED)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid value: " + editChoicesBeforeSending);
            }

            mEditChoicesBeforeSending = editChoicesBeforeSending;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder addExtras(Bundle extras)
        {
            if (extras != null) mExtras.putAll(extras);
            return this;
        }

        public Bundle getExtras()
        {
            return mExtras;
        }

        public RemoteInput build()
        {
            if (mEditChoicesBeforeSending == EDIT_CHOICES_BEFORE_SENDING_ENABLED
                && (mFlags & FLAG_DISALLOW_FREE_FORM_INPUT) != 0)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("setEditChoicesBeforeSending requires setAllowFreeFormInput");
            }

            RemoteInput input = new RemoteInput();
            input.mResultKey = mResultKey;
            input.mLabel = mLabel;
            input.mChoices = mChoices;
            input.mFlags = mFlags;
            input.mEditChoicesBeforeSending = mEditChoicesBeforeSending;
            input.mExtras = mExtras;
            input.mAllowedDataTypes.addAll(mAllowedDataTypes);
            return input;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/app/ResourcesManager.java`:

```java
package android.app;

import android.content.res.Configuration;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.util.DisplayMetrics;
import android.util.Log;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class ResourcesManager
{
    private static final String TAG = "ResourcesManager";

    private static ResourcesManager sResourcesManager;

    private Resources mResources;
    private final List<String> mLibraryAssets = new ArrayList<>();

    public static ResourcesManager getInstance()
    {
        synchronized (ResourcesManager.class)
        {
            if (sResourcesManager == null) sResourcesManager = new ResourcesManager();
            return sResourcesManager;
        }
    }

    synchronized void attach(Resources resources)
    {
        mResources = resources;
    }

    public synchronized Configuration getConfiguration()
    {
        return mResources == null ? Resources.getSystem().getConfiguration() : mResources.getConfiguration();
    }

    public synchronized DisplayMetrics getDisplayMetrics()
    {
        return mResources == null ? Resources.getSystem().getDisplayMetrics() : mResources.getDisplayMetrics();
    }

    public synchronized boolean applyConfigurationToResources(Configuration configuration, Object compatibility)
    {
        if (configuration == null || mResources == null) return false;

        mResources.updateConfiguration(configuration, mResources.getDisplayMetrics());
        return true;
    }

    public void appendLibAssetForMainAssetPath(String assetPath, String libraryAsset)
    {
        appendLibAssetsForMainAssetPath(assetPath, new String[] {libraryAsset});
    }

    public synchronized void appendLibAssetsForMainAssetPath(String assetPath, String[] libraryAssets)
    {
        if (libraryAssets == null) return;

        for (String asset : libraryAssets)
        {
            if (asset == null || mLibraryAssets.contains(asset)) continue;

            mLibraryAssets.add(asset);
            Log.i(TAG, "shared library asset " + asset + " noted for " + assetPath + "; its resources are not loaded into this package");
        }
    }

    public synchronized void invalidatePath(String path)
    {
        mLibraryAssets.remove(path);
    }

    public boolean isSameResourcesOverrideConfig(android.os.IBinder activityToken, Configuration overrideConfiguration)
    {
        return overrideConfiguration == null || overrideConfiguration.equals(getConfiguration());
    }
}
```

`java/android/app/RuntimeActionBar.java`:

```java
package android.app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.DialogInterface;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.ColorFilter;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.graphics.PixelFormat;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.graphics.drawable.ColorDrawable;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.Menu;
import android.view.MenuItem;
import android.view.RuntimeMenu;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.Window;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.SpinnerAdapter;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toolbar;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class RuntimeActionBar extends ActionBar
{
    private static final int HOME_ITEM_ID = 0x0102002c;
    private static final int DEFAULT_PRIMARY = 0xFF3F51B5;

    private final Context mContext;
    private final Window.Callback mCallback;
    private final Toolbar mToolbar;
    private final LinearLayout mContainer;
    private final float mDensity;
    private final int mAccentColor;
    private final int mTextColor;
    private LinearLayout mTabStrip;

    private int mDisplayOptions = DISPLAY_SHOW_TITLE | DISPLAY_SHOW_HOME;
    private CharSequence mTitle;
    private CharSequence mSubtitle;
    private Drawable mIcon;
    private Drawable mLogo;
    private Drawable mUpIndicator;
    private CharSequence mHomeDescription;
    private View mCustomView;
    private View mListNavigationView;
    private boolean mHomeButtonEnabled;
    private boolean mShowing = true;
    private boolean mHideOnContentScroll;
    private int mHideOffset;
    private float mElevation;

    private int mNavigationMode = NAVIGATION_MODE_STANDARD;
    private final List<TabImpl> mTabs = new ArrayList<>();
    private TabImpl mSelectedTab;
    private int mSavedTabPosition = Tab.INVALID_POSITION;
    private SpinnerAdapter mNavigationAdapter;
    private OnNavigationListener mNavigationListener;
    private int mSelectedNavigationIndex = -1;

    private final List<OnMenuVisibilityListener> mMenuVisibilityListeners = new ArrayList<>();
    private boolean mLastMenuVisibility;

    public RuntimeActionBar(Context context, Window.Callback callback)
    {
        mContext = context;
        mCallback = callback;
        mDensity = context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        mAccentColor = themeColor(context, "colorAccent", 0xFFFF4081);
        mTextColor = themeColor(context, "textColorPrimary", 0xDE000000);

        mToolbar = new Toolbar(context);
        mToolbar.setBackgroundColor(themeColor(context, "colorPrimary", DEFAULT_PRIMARY));

        mContainer = new LinearLayout(context);
        mContainer.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        int matchParent = ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT;
        mContainer.addView(mToolbar, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(matchParent, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        attachToolbar();
    }

    public RuntimeActionBar(Toolbar toolbar, CharSequence title, Window.Callback callback)
    {
        mContext = toolbar.getContext();
        mCallback = callback;
        mDensity = mContext.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        mAccentColor = themeColor(mContext, "colorAccent", 0xFFFF4081);
        mTextColor = themeColor(mContext, "textColorPrimary", 0xDE000000);
        mToolbar = toolbar;
        mContainer = null;
        mTitle = toolbar.getTitle() != null ? toolbar.getTitle() : title;
        mSubtitle = toolbar.getSubtitle();

        if (toolbar.getNavigationIcon() != null) mDisplayOptions |= DISPLAY_HOME_AS_UP;

        attachToolbar();
    }

    private static int themeColor(Context context, String name, int fallback)
    {
        int identifier = context.getResources().getIdentifier(name, "attr", "android");
        if (identifier == 0) return fallback;

        try
        {
            TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(new int[] {identifier});
            boolean present = array.hasValue(0);
            int color = array.getColor(0, fallback);
            array.recycle();

            return present ? color : fallback;
        }
        catch (RuntimeException unresolved)
        {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    private int dp(int value)
    {
        return (int)(value * mDensity + 0.5f);
    }

    private void attachToolbar()
    {
        mToolbar.setOnMenuItemClickListener(new Toolbar.OnMenuItemClickListener()
        {
            @Override
            public boolean onMenuItemClick(MenuItem item)
            {
                return mCallback != null && mCallback.onMenuItemSelected(Window.FEATURE_OPTIONS_PANEL, item);
            }
        });

        mToolbar.setNavigationOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener()
        {
            @Override
            public void onClick(View view)
            {
                dispatchHomeSelected();
            }
        });

        updateToolbar();
    }

    public View getView()
    {
        return mContainer != null ? mContainer : mToolbar;
    }

    public Toolbar getToolbar()
    {
        return mToolbar;
    }

    public Menu getMenu()
    {
        return mToolbar.getMenu();
    }

    public void invalidateOptionsMenu()
    {
        Menu menu = mToolbar.getMenu();
        menu.clear();

        if (mCallback != null && mCallback.onCreatePanelMenu(Window.FEATURE_OPTIONS_PANEL, menu))
        {
            mCallback.onPreparePanel(Window.FEATURE_OPTIONS_PANEL, null, menu);
        }

        mToolbar.requestLayout();
        mToolbar.invalidate();
    }

    public boolean openOptionsMenu()
    {
        boolean shown = mToolbar.showOverflowMenu();
        if (shown) dispatchMenuVisibilityChanged(true);

        return shown;
    }

    public boolean closeOptionsMenu()
    {
        boolean hidden = mToolbar.hideOverflowMenu();
        if (hidden) dispatchMenuVisibilityChanged(false);

        return hidden;
    }

    public void dispatchMenuVisibilityChanged(boolean isVisible)
    {
        if (isVisible == mLastMenuVisibility) return;

        mLastMenuVisibility = isVisible;

        for (OnMenuVisibilityListener listener : new ArrayList<>(mMenuVisibilityListeners)) listener.onMenuVisibilityChanged(isVisible);
    }

    private boolean dispatchHomeSelected()
    {
        if (mCallback == null) return false;

        RuntimeMenu menu = new RuntimeMenu(mContext);
        MenuItem home = menu.add(0, HOME_ITEM_ID, 0, mTitle);

        return mCallback.onMenuItemSelected(Window.FEATURE_OPTIONS_PANEL, home);
    }

    private void updateToolbar()
    {
        boolean showTitle = (mDisplayOptions & DISPLAY_SHOW_TITLE) != 0;

        mToolbar.setTitle(showTitle ? mTitle : null);
        mToolbar.setSubtitle(showTitle ? mSubtitle : null);

        if ((mDisplayOptions & DISPLAY_HOME_AS_UP) != 0)
        {
            mToolbar.setNavigationIcon(mUpIndicator != null ? mUpIndicator : new UpIndicatorDrawable(mTextColor, mDensity));
            mToolbar.setNavigationContentDescription(mHomeDescription != null ? mHomeDescription : "Navigate up");
        }
        else
        {
            mToolbar.setNavigationIcon(null);
        }

        if ((mDisplayOptions & DISPLAY_SHOW_HOME) != 0)
        {
            Drawable home = (mDisplayOptions & DISPLAY_USE_LOGO) != 0 && mLogo != null ? mLogo : mIcon;
            mToolbar.setLogo(home);
        }
        else
        {
            mToolbar.setLogo(null);
        }

        boolean showCustom = (mDisplayOptions & DISPLAY_SHOW_CUSTOM) != 0 && mCustomView != null;
        attachToToolbar(mCustomView, showCustom);
        attachToToolbar(mListNavigationView, mNavigationMode == NAVIGATION_MODE_LIST && mListNavigationView != null);

        if (mTabStrip != null) mTabStrip.setVisibility(mNavigationMode == NAVIGATION_MODE_TABS ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
    }

    private void attachToToolbar(View view, boolean attach)
    {
        if (view == null) return;

        if (attach)
        {
            if (view.getParent() == mToolbar) return;
            if (view.getParent() instanceof ViewGroup) ((ViewGroup)view.getParent()).removeView(view);

            ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = view.getLayoutParams();
            if (!(params instanceof ActionBar.LayoutParams))
            {
                params = new Toolbar.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT);
            }

            mToolbar.addView(view, params);
            return;
        }

        if (view.getParent() == mToolbar) mToolbar.removeView(view);
    }

    @Override
    public void setCustomView(View view)
    {
        if (view != null && !(view.getLayoutParams() instanceof ActionBar.LayoutParams))
        {
            view.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT));
        }

        replaceCustomView(view);
    }

    @Override
    public void setCustomView(View view, LayoutParams layoutParams)
    {
        if (view != null) view.setLayoutParams(layoutParams);

        replaceCustomView(view);
    }

    @Override
    public void setCustomView(int resId)
    {
        setCustomView(LayoutInflater.from(getThemedContext()).inflate(resId, mToolbar, false));
    }

    private void replaceCustomView(View view)
    {
        if (mCustomView != null && mCustomView.getParent() == mToolbar) mToolbar.removeView(mCustomView);

        mCustomView = view;
        updateToolbar();
    }

    @Override
    public void setIcon(int resId)
    {
        setIcon(resId == 0 ? null : mContext.getResources().getDrawable(resId));
    }

    @Override
    public void setIcon(Drawable icon)
    {
        mIcon = icon;
        updateToolbar();
    }

    @Override
    public void setLogo(int resId)
    {
        setLogo(resId == 0 ? null : mContext.getResources().getDrawable(resId));
    }

    @Override
    public void setLogo(Drawable logo)
    {
        mLogo = logo;
        updateToolbar();
    }

    @Override
    public void setListNavigationCallbacks(SpinnerAdapter adapter, OnNavigationListener callback)
    {
        mNavigationAdapter = adapter;
        mNavigationListener = callback;

        if (mSelectedNavigationIndex < 0 && adapter != null && adapter.getCount() > 0) mSelectedNavigationIndex = 0;

        refreshListNavigationView();
    }

    private void refreshListNavigationView()
    {
        if (mListNavigationView != null && mListNavigationView.getParent() == mToolbar) mToolbar.removeView(mListNavigationView);

        mListNavigationView = null;

        if (mNavigationAdapter != null && mSelectedNavigationIndex >= 0 && mSelectedNavigationIndex < mNavigationAdapter.getCount())
        {
            View selected = mNavigationAdapter.getView(mSelectedNavigationIndex, null, mToolbar);
            selected.setClickable(true);
            selected.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener()
            {
                @Override
                public void onClick(View view)
                {
                    showNavigationList();
                }
            });

            mListNavigationView = selected;
        }

        updateToolbar();
    }

    private void showNavigationList()
    {
        if (mNavigationAdapter == null) return;

        int count = mNavigationAdapter.getCount();
        CharSequence[] labels = new CharSequence[count];

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            Object item = mNavigationAdapter.getItem(index);
            labels[index] = item == null ? "" : item.toString();
        }

        try
        {
            new AlertDialog.Builder(mContext).setItems(labels, new DialogInterface.OnClickListener()
            {
                @Override
                public void onClick(DialogInterface dialog, int which)
                {
                    dialog.dismiss();
                    setSelectedNavigationItem(which);
                }
            }).show();
        }
        catch (RuntimeException unavailable)
        {
            android.util.Log.w("ActionBar", "list navigation could not be shown", unavailable);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setSelectedNavigationItem(int position)
    {
        if (mNavigationMode == NAVIGATION_MODE_TABS)
        {
            selectTab(mTabs.get(position));
            return;
        }

        if (mNavigationMode != NAVIGATION_MODE_LIST)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("setSelectedNavigationIndex not valid for current navigation mode");
        }

        if (mNavigationAdapter == null || position < 0 || position >= mNavigationAdapter.getCount()) return;

        mSelectedNavigationIndex = position;
        refreshListNavigationView();

        if (mNavigationListener != null) mNavigationListener.onNavigationItemSelected(position, mNavigationAdapter.getItemId(position));
    }

    @Override
    public int getSelectedNavigationIndex()
    {
        if (mNavigationMode == NAVIGATION_MODE_TABS) return mSelectedTab != null ? mSelectedTab.getPosition() : -1;
        if (mNavigationMode == NAVIGATION_MODE_LIST) return mSelectedNavigationIndex;

        return -1;
    }

    @Override
    public int getNavigationItemCount()
    {
        if (mNavigationMode == NAVIGATION_MODE_TABS) return mTabs.size();
        if (mNavigationMode == NAVIGATION_MODE_LIST) return mNavigationAdapter != null ? mNavigationAdapter.getCount() : 0;

        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void setTitle(CharSequence title)
    {
        mTitle = title;
        updateToolbar();
    }

    @Override
    public void setTitle(int resId)
    {
        setTitle(resId == 0 ? null : mContext.getText(resId));
    }

    @Override

        updateToolbar();

        mDisplayOptions = options;
        updateToolbar();
    }

    @Override
    public void setDisplayOptions(int options, int mask)
    {
        setDisplayOptions((options & mask) | (mDisplayOptions & ~mask));
    }

    @Override

        setDisplayOptions(useLogo ? DISPLAY_USE_LOGO : 0, DISPLAY_USE_LOGO);

    {
        return mNavigationMode;
    }

    @Override
    public void setNavigationMode(int mode)
    {
        int oldMode = mNavigationMode;
        if (oldMode == mode) return;

        if (oldMode == NAVIGATION_MODE_TABS)
        {
            mSavedTabPosition = getSelectedNavigationIndex();
            selectTab(null);
        }

        mNavigationMode = mode;

        if (mode == NAVIGATION_MODE_TABS)
        {
            ensureTabStrip();

            if (mSavedTabPosition != Tab.INVALID_POSITION && mSavedTabPosition < mTabs.size())
            {
                setSelectedNavigationItem(mSavedTabPosition);
                mSavedTabPosition = Tab.INVALID_POSITION;
            }
            else if (mSelectedTab == null && !mTabs.isEmpty())
            {
                selectTab(mTabs.get(0));
            }
        }

        updateToolbar();
    }

    @Override
    public int getDisplayOptions()
    {
        return mDisplayOptions;
    }

    @Override
    public Tab newTab()
    {
        return new TabImpl();
    }

    @Override
    public void addTab(Tab tab)
    {
        addTab(tab, mTabs.isEmpty());
    }

    @Override
    public void addTab(Tab tab, boolean setSelected)
    {
        addTab(tab, mTabs.size(), setSelected);
    }

    @Override
    public void addTab(Tab tab, int position)
    {
        addTab(tab, position, mTabs.isEmpty());
    }

    @Override
    public void addTab(Tab tab, int position, boolean setSelected)
    {
        TabImpl implementation = (TabImpl)tab;
        if (implementation.mCallback == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Action Bar Tab must have a Callback");

        mTabs.add(position, implementation);
        renumberTabs();
        rebuildTabStrip();

        if (setSelected) selectTab(tab);
    }

    @Override
    public void removeTab(Tab tab)
    {
        removeTabAt(tab.getPosition());
    }

    @Override
    public void removeTabAt(int position)
    {
        if (position < 0 || position >= mTabs.size()) return;

        int selectedPosition = mSelectedTab != null ? mSelectedTab.getPosition() : mSavedTabPosition;
        TabImpl removed = mTabs.remove(position);
        removed.setPosition(Tab.INVALID_POSITION);

        renumberTabs();
        rebuildTabStrip();

        if (selectedPosition == position) selectTab(mTabs.isEmpty() ? null : mTabs.get(Math.max(0, position - 1)));
    }

    @Override
    public void removeAllTabs()
    {
        if (mSelectedTab != null) selectTab(null);

        for (TabImpl tab : mTabs) tab.setPosition(Tab.INVALID_POSITION);

        mTabs.clear();
        mSavedTabPosition = Tab.INVALID_POSITION;
        rebuildTabStrip();
    }

    @Override
    public void selectTab(Tab tab)
    {
        if (mNavigationMode != NAVIGATION_MODE_TABS)
        {
            mSavedTabPosition = tab != null ? tab.getPosition() : Tab.INVALID_POSITION;
            return;
        }

        FragmentTransaction transaction = beginTransaction();

        if (mSelectedTab == tab)
        {
            if (mSelectedTab != null) mSelectedTab.mCallback.onTabReselected(mSelectedTab, transaction);
        }
        else
        {
            if (mSelectedTab != null) mSelectedTab.mCallback.onTabUnselected(mSelectedTab, transaction);

            mSelectedTab = (TabImpl)tab;

            if (mSelectedTab != null) mSelectedTab.mCallback.onTabSelected(mSelectedTab, transaction);
        }

        commit(transaction);
        rebuildTabStrip();
    }

    private FragmentTransaction beginTransaction()
    {
        if (!(mContext instanceof Activity)) return null;

        try
        {
            FragmentManager manager = ((Activity)mContext).getFragmentManager();
            return manager == null ? null : manager.beginTransaction();
        }
        catch (RuntimeException unavailable)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static void commit(FragmentTransaction transaction)
    {
        if (transaction == null) return;

        try
        {
            transaction.commit();
        }
        catch (RuntimeException failed)
        {
            android.util.Log.w("ActionBar", "tab fragment transaction failed", failed);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public Tab getSelectedTab()
    {
        return mSelectedTab;
    }

    @Override
    public Tab getTabAt(int index)
    {
        return mTabs.get(index);
    }

    @Override
    public int getTabCount()
    {
        return mTabs.size();
    }

    private void renumberTabs()
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mTabs.size(); index++) mTabs.get(index).setPosition(index);
    }

    private void ensureTabStrip()
    {
        if (mTabStrip != null || mContainer == null) return;

        mTabStrip = new LinearLayout(mContext);
        mTabStrip.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        mTabStrip.setBackground(mToolbar.getBackground() != null ? mToolbar.getBackground() : new ColorDrawable(DEFAULT_PRIMARY));
        mContainer.addView(mTabStrip, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(48)));

        rebuildTabStrip();
    }

    private void rebuildTabStrip()
    {
        if (mTabStrip == null) return;

        mTabStrip.removeAllViews();

        for (final TabImpl tab : mTabs)
        {
            View view = tab.getCustomView();

            if (view == null)
            {
                TextView label = new TextView(mContext);
                label.setText(tab.getText());
                label.setPadding(dp(12), dp(14), dp(12), dp(14));
                label.setTextColor(tab == mSelectedTab ? mAccentColor : mTextColor);
                label.setContentDescription(tab.getContentDescription());
                view = label;
            }
            else if (view.getParent() instanceof ViewGroup)
            {
                ((ViewGroup)view.getParent()).removeView(view);
            }

            view.setClickable(true);
            view.setSelected(tab == mSelectedTab);
            view.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener()
            {
                @Override
                public void onClick(View clicked)
                {
                    tab.select();
                }
            });

            mTabStrip.addView(view, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 1f));
        }
    }

    @Override

    {
        return mContainer != null ? mContainer.getHeight() : mToolbar.getHeight();
    }

    private static final class UpIndicatorDrawable extends Drawable
    {
        private final Paint mPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
        private final Path mPath = new Path();
        private final float mDensity;

        UpIndicatorDrawable(int color, float density)
        {
            mDensity = density;
            mPaint.setColor(color);
            mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
            mPaint.setStrokeWidth(2 * density);
            mPaint.setStrokeCap(Paint.Cap.SQUARE);
        }

        @Override
        public void draw(Canvas canvas)
        {
            Rect bounds = getBounds();
            float centreX = bounds.exactCenterX();
            float centreY = bounds.exactCenterY();
            float half = 8 * mDensity;

            mPath.reset();
            mPath.moveTo(centreX + half, centreY);
            mPath.lineTo(centreX - half, centreY);
            mPath.moveTo(centreX - half + 7 * mDensity, centreY - 7 * mDensity);
            mPath.lineTo(centreX - half, centreY);
            mPath.lineTo(centreX - half + 7 * mDensity, centreY + 7 * mDensity);

            canvas.drawPath(mPath, mPaint);
        }

        @Override
        public void setAlpha(int alpha)
        {
            mPaint.setAlpha(alpha);
        }

        @Override
        public void setColorFilter(ColorFilter colorFilter)
        {
            mPaint.setColorFilter(colorFilter);
        }

        @Override
        public int getOpacity()
        {
            return PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;
        }

        @Override
        public int getIntrinsicWidth()
        {
            return (int)(24 * mDensity);
        }

        @Override
        public int getIntrinsicHeight()
        {
            return (int)(24 * mDensity);
        }
    }
}
```
