```java
    public void triggerSearch(String query, ComponentName launchActivity, Bundle appSearchData)
    {
        if (query == null || query.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("query cannot be empty");
        if (mContext == null || launchActivity == null) return;

        Intent intent = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEARCH);
        intent.setComponent(launchActivity);
        intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
        intent.putExtra(QUERY, query);
        if (appSearchData != null) intent.putExtra(APP_DATA, appSearchData);

        mContext.startActivity(intent);
    }

    }
```

```java
import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public final class SearchableInfo implements Parcelable
{
    private static final String TAG = "SearchableInfo";
    private static final String ANDROID_NAMESPACE = "http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android";
    private static final String MD_LABEL_SEARCHABLE = "android.app.searchable";
    private static final String MD_XML_ELEMENT_SEARCHABLE = "searchable";

    private static final int SEARCH_MODE_QUERY_REWRITE_FROM_DATA = 0x10;
    private static final int SEARCH_MODE_QUERY_REWRITE_FROM_TEXT = 0x20;
    private static final int VOICE_SEARCH_SHOW_BUTTON = 1;
    private static final int VOICE_SEARCH_LAUNCH_WEB_SEARCH = 2;
    private static final int VOICE_SEARCH_LAUNCH_RECOGNIZER = 4;

    private int mLabelId;
    private ComponentName mSearchActivity;
    private int mHintId;
    private int mSearchMode;
    private int mSearchButtonText;
    private int mSearchInputType = InputType.TYPE_CLASS_TEXT | InputType.TYPE_TEXT_VARIATION_NORMAL;
    private int mSearchImeOptions = EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_GO;
    private boolean mIncludeInGlobalSearch;
    private boolean mQueryAfterZeroResults;
    private boolean mAutoUrlDetect;
    private int mSettingsDescriptionId;
    private String mSuggestAuthority;
    private String mSuggestPath;
    private String mSuggestSelection;
    private String mSuggestIntentAction;
    private String mSuggestIntentData;

    private int mVoiceLanguageModeId;
    private int mVoicePromptTextId;
    private int mVoiceLanguageId;
    private int mVoiceMaxResults;
    private String mSuggestProviderPackage;

    SearchableInfo()
    {
    }

    static SearchableInfo getActivityMetaData(Context context, ComponentName component)
    {
        PackageManager packageManager = context.getPackageManager();

        ActivityInfo activity;
        try
        {
            activity = packageManager.getActivityInfo(component, PackageManager.GET_META_DATA);
        }
        catch (PackageManager.NameNotFoundException missing)
        {
            return null;
        }

        XmlResourceParser parser = activity.loadXmlMetaData(packageManager, MD_LABEL_SEARCHABLE);
        if (parser == null) return null;

        try
        {
            int type;
            while ((type = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
            {
                if (type != XmlPullParser.START_TAG || !MD_XML_ELEMENT_SEARCHABLE.equals(parser.getName())) continue;

                SearchableInfo info = new SearchableInfo();
                info.read(Xml.asAttributeSet(parser), component, context.getPackageName());
                return info.mLabelId == 0 ? null : info;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "could not read searchable metadata of " + component.flattenToShortString(), failure);
        }
        finally
        {
            parser.close();
        }

        return null;
    }

    private void read(AttributeSet attributes, ComponentName component, String packageName)
    {
        mSearchActivity = component;
        mLabelId = attributes.getAttributeResourceValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "label", 0);
        mHintId = attributes.getAttributeResourceValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "hint", 0);
        mSearchMode = attributes.getAttributeIntValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "searchMode", 0);
        mSearchButtonText = attributes.getAttributeResourceValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "searchButtonText", 0);
        mSearchInputType = attributes.getAttributeIntValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "inputType", mSearchInputType);
        mSearchImeOptions = attributes.getAttributeIntValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "imeOptions", mSearchImeOptions);
        mIncludeInGlobalSearch = attributes.getAttributeBooleanValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "includeInGlobalSearch", false);
        mQueryAfterZeroResults = attributes.getAttributeBooleanValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "queryAfterZeroResults", false);
        mAutoUrlDetect = attributes.getAttributeBooleanValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "autoUrlDetect", false);
        mSettingsDescriptionId = attributes.getAttributeResourceValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "searchSettingsDescription", 0);
        mSuggestAuthority = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "searchSuggestAuthority");
        mSuggestPath = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "searchSuggestPath");
        mSuggestSelection = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "searchSuggestSelection");
        mSuggestIntentAction = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "searchSuggestIntentAction");
        mSuggestIntentData = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "searchSuggestIntentData");
        mSuggestThreshold = attributes.getAttributeIntValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "searchSuggestThreshold", 0);
        mVoiceSearchMode = attributes.getAttributeIntValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "voiceSearchMode", 0);
        mVoiceLanguageModeId = attributes.getAttributeResourceValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "voiceLanguageModel", 0);
        mVoicePromptTextId = attributes.getAttributeResourceValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "voicePromptText", 0);
        mVoiceLanguageId = attributes.getAttributeResourceValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "voiceLanguage", 0);
        mVoiceMaxResults = attributes.getAttributeIntValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "voiceMaxResults", 0);

        if (mSuggestAuthority != null) mSuggestProviderPackage = packageName;
    }

        dest.writeInt(mAutoUrlDetect ? 1 : 0);

        dest.writeString(mSuggestAuthority);
        dest.writeString(mSuggestPath);

        dest.writeString(mSuggestIntentAction);
        dest.writeString(mSuggestIntentData);

        dest.writeInt(mVoiceSearchMode);
        dest.writeInt(mVoiceLanguageModeId);
        dest.writeInt(mVoicePromptTextId);
        dest.writeInt(mVoiceLanguageId);
        dest.writeInt(mVoiceMaxResults);
    }

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<SearchableInfo> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<SearchableInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public SearchableInfo createFromParcel(Parcel in)
        {
            SearchableInfo info = new SearchableInfo();

            info.mLabelId = in.readInt();
            String activity = in.readString();
            info.mSearchActivity = activity == null ? null : ComponentName.unflattenFromString(activity);
            info.mHintId = in.readInt();
            info.mSearchMode = in.readInt();
            info.mSearchButtonText = in.readInt();
            info.mSearchInputType = in.readInt();
            info.mSearchImeOptions = in.readInt();
            info.mIncludeInGlobalSearch = in.readInt() != 0;
            info.mQueryAfterZeroResults = in.readInt() != 0;
            info.mAutoUrlDetect = in.readInt() != 0;
            info.mSettingsDescriptionId = in.readInt();
            info.mSuggestAuthority = in.readString();
            info.mSuggestPath = in.readString();
            info.mSuggestSelection = in.readString();
            info.mSuggestIntentAction = in.readString();
            info.mSuggestIntentData = in.readString();
            info.mSuggestThreshold = in.readInt();
            info.mSuggestProviderPackage = in.readString();
            info.mVoiceSearchMode = in.readInt();
            info.mVoiceLanguageModeId = in.readInt();
            info.mVoicePromptTextId = in.readInt();
            info.mVoiceLanguageId = in.readInt();
            info.mVoiceMaxResults = in.readInt();

            return info;
        }

        @Override
        public SearchableInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new SearchableInfo[size];
        }
    };
```

`java/android/app/Service.java`:

```java
package android.app;

import android.content.ComponentCallbacks2;
import android.content.ContextWrapper;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo;
import android.content.res.Configuration;
import android.os.IBinder;

import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.PrintWriter;

public abstract class Service extends ContextWrapper implements ComponentCallbacks2
{
    public static final int START_CONTINUATION_MASK = 0xf;
    public static final int START_STICKY_COMPATIBILITY = 0;
    public static final int START_STICKY = 1;
    public static final int START_NOT_STICKY = 2;
    public static final int START_REDELIVER_INTENT = 3;

    public static final int START_FLAG_REDELIVERY = 0x0001;
    public static final int START_FLAG_RETRY = 0x0002;

    public static final int STOP_FOREGROUND_LEGACY = 0;
    public static final int STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE = 1 << 0;
    public static final int STOP_FOREGROUND_DETACH = 1 << 1;

    private Application mApplication;
    private int mForegroundId;
    private Notification mForegroundNotification;
    private int mForegroundServiceType;

    public Service()
    {
        super(null);
    }

    public final void attach(android.content.Context context, Application application)
    {
        attachBaseContext(context);
        mApplication = application;
    }

    public final Application getApplication()
    {
        return mApplication;
    }

    public void onCreate()
    {
    }

    public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId)
    {
        onStart(intent, startId);
        return START_STICKY;
    }

    public void onStart(Intent intent, int startId)
    {
    }

    public abstract IBinder onBind(Intent intent);

    public boolean onUnbind(Intent intent)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void onRebind(Intent intent)
    {
    }

    public void onTaskRemoved(Intent rootIntent)
    {
    }

    public void onLowMemory()
    {
    }

    public void onTrimMemory(int level)
    {
    }

    public void onDestroy()
    {
    }

    public final void stopSelf()
    {
        runtime.Services.stopSelf(this, -1);
    }

    public final void stopSelf(int startId)
    {
        runtime.Services.stopSelf(this, startId);
    }

    public final boolean stopSelfResult(int startId)
    {
        return runtime.Services.stopSelf(this, startId);
    }

    public void onConfigurationChanged(Configuration newConfiguration)
    {
    }

    public void onTimeout(int startId)
    {
    }

    public void onTimeout(int startId, int foregroundServiceType)
    {
    }

    protected void dump(FileDescriptor descriptor, PrintWriter writer, String[] arguments)
    {
        writer.println("nothing to dump.");
    }

    public final void startForeground(int id, Notification notification)
    {
        startForeground(id, notification, ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MANIFEST);
    }

    public final void startForeground(int id, Notification notification, int foregroundServiceType)
    {
        if (notification == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null notification");

        if (mForegroundId != 0 && mForegroundId != id) runtime.NotificationStore.cancel(null, mForegroundId);

        notification.flags |= Notification.FLAG_FOREGROUND_SERVICE | Notification.FLAG_NO_CLEAR;

        mForegroundId = id;
        mForegroundNotification = notification;
        mForegroundServiceType = foregroundServiceType == ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MANIFEST ? 0
                                                                                                         : foregroundServiceType;

        runtime.Services.startForeground(this, id, notification);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public final void stopForeground(boolean removeNotification)
    {
        stopForeground(removeNotification ? STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE : STOP_FOREGROUND_LEGACY);
    }

    public final void stopForeground(int notificationBehavior)
    {
        int id = mForegroundId;
        Notification notification = mForegroundNotification;

        mForegroundId = 0;
        mForegroundNotification = null;
        mForegroundServiceType = 0;

        runtime.Services.stopForeground(this, (notificationBehavior & STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE) != 0);

        if (id == 0) return;

        if ((notificationBehavior & STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE) != 0)
        {
            runtime.NotificationStore.cancel(null, id);
            return;
        }

        if (notification != null)
        {
            notification.flags &= ~(Notification.FLAG_FOREGROUND_SERVICE | Notification.FLAG_NO_CLEAR);
            if ((notificationBehavior & STOP_FOREGROUND_DETACH) == 0 && runtime.NotificationStore.find(null, id) != null)
            {
                runtime.NotificationStore.post(null, id, notification);
            }
        }
    }

    public final int getForegroundServiceType()
    {
        return mForegroundServiceType;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Configuration;

import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;

public class UiModeManager
{
    public static String ACTION_ENTER_CAR_MODE = "android.app.action.ENTER_CAR_MODE";
    public static String ACTION_ENTER_DESK_MODE = "android.app.action.ENTER_DESK_MODE";
    public static String ACTION_EXIT_CAR_MODE = "android.app.action.EXIT_CAR_MODE";
    public static String ACTION_EXIT_DESK_MODE = "android.app.action.EXIT_DESK_MODE";

    public static final int DISABLE_CAR_MODE_GO_HOME = 1;
    public static final int ENABLE_CAR_MODE_ALLOW_SLEEP = 2;
    public static final int ENABLE_CAR_MODE_GO_CAR_HOME = 1;

    public static final int MODE_NIGHT_AUTO = 0;
    public static final int MODE_NIGHT_NO = 1;
    public static final int MODE_NIGHT_YES = 2;
    public static final int MODE_NIGHT_CUSTOM = 3;

    private static final int MODE_NIGHT_UNSET = -1;

    private final Context mContext;
    private final Map<ContrastChangeListener, Executor> mContrastListeners = new HashMap<>();
    private int mNightMode = MODE_NIGHT_UNSET;
    private LocalTime mCustomNightStart = LocalTime.of(22, 0);
    private LocalTime mCustomNightEnd = LocalTime.of(6, 0);

    public UiModeManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public void enableCarMode(int flags)
    {
    }

    public void disableCarMode(int flags)
    {
    }

    public int getCurrentModeType()
    {
        int type = configurationUiMode() & Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_MASK;
        return type == Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_UNDEFINED ? Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_NORMAL : type;
    }

    public void setNightMode(int mode)
    {
        mNightMode = mode;
    }

    public void setApplicationNightMode(int mode)
    {
        mNightMode = mode;
    }

    public int getNightMode()
    {
        if (mNightMode != MODE_NIGHT_UNSET) return mNightMode;

        int night = configurationUiMode() & Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_MASK;
        return night == Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_YES ? MODE_NIGHT_YES : MODE_NIGHT_NO;
    }

    public LocalTime getCustomNightModeStart()
    {
        return mCustomNightStart;
    }

    public void setCustomNightModeStart(LocalTime time)
    {
        if (time != null) mCustomNightStart = time;
    }

    public LocalTime getCustomNightModeEnd()
    {
        return mCustomNightEnd;
    }

    public void setCustomNightModeEnd(LocalTime time)
    {
        if (time != null) mCustomNightEnd = time;
    }

    public float getContrast()
    {
        return 0.0f;
    }

    public void addContrastChangeListener(Executor executor, ContrastChangeListener listener)
    {
        if (executor == null || listener == null) throw new NullPointerException("executor and listener are required");

        synchronized (mContrastListeners)
        {
            mContrastListeners.put(listener, executor);
        }
    }

    public void removeContrastChangeListener(ContrastChangeListener listener)
    {
        synchronized (mContrastListeners)
        {
            mContrastListeners.remove(listener);
        }
    }

    private int configurationUiMode()
    {
        if (mContext == null || mContext.getResources() == null) return Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_NORMAL | Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_NO;

        Configuration configuration = mContext.getResources().getConfiguration();
        return configuration == null ? Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_NORMAL | Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_NO : configuration.uiMode;
    }

    public interface ContrastChangeListener
    {
        void onContrastChanged(float contrast);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.app;

import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class WallpaperColors implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int HINT_SUPPORTS_DARK_TEXT = 1 << 0;
    public static final int HINT_SUPPORTS_DARK_THEME = 1 << 1;

    private final Color mPrimary;
    private final Color mSecondary;
    private final Color mTertiary;
    private final int mHints;

    public WallpaperColors(Color primary, Color secondary, Color tertiary)
    {
        this(primary, secondary, tertiary, 0);
    }

    public WallpaperColors(Color primary, Color secondary, Color tertiary, int hints)
    {
        if (primary == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the primary colour is required");

        mPrimary = primary;
        mSecondary = secondary;
        mTertiary = tertiary;
        mHints = hints;
    }

    public static WallpaperColors fromBitmap(Bitmap bitmap)
    {
        if (bitmap == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the bitmap is required");

        return new WallpaperColors(Color.valueOf(Color.BLACK), null, null, 0);
    }

    public static WallpaperColors fromDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        if (drawable == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the drawable is required");

        return new WallpaperColors(Color.valueOf(Color.BLACK), null, null, 0);
    }

    public Color getPrimaryColor()
    {
        return mPrimary;
    }

    public Color getSecondaryColor()
    {
        return mSecondary;
    }

    public Color getTertiaryColor()
    {
        return mTertiary;
    }

    public int getColorHints()
    {
        return mHints;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        parcel.writeValue(Integer.valueOf(mPrimary.toArgb()));
        parcel.writeValue(mSecondary == null ? null : Integer.valueOf(mSecondary.toArgb()));
        parcel.writeValue(mTertiary == null ? null : Integer.valueOf(mTertiary.toArgb()));
        parcel.writeValue(Integer.valueOf(mHints));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof WallpaperColors)) return false;

        WallpaperColors colors = (WallpaperColors)other;

        return mHints == colors.mHints && mPrimary.equals(colors.mPrimary);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mPrimary.hashCode() * 31 + mHints;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "WallpaperColors(" + mPrimary + ", hints=" + mHints + ")";
    }

    public static final Creator<WallpaperColors> CREATOR = new Creator<WallpaperColors>()
    {
        @Override
        public WallpaperColors createFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
        {
            Color primary = readColour(parcel);
            Color secondary = readColour(parcel);
            Color tertiary = readColour(parcel);

            Object hints = parcel.readValue(null);

            return new WallpaperColors(primary == null ? Color.valueOf(Color.BLACK) : primary, secondary, tertiary,
                                       hints instanceof Integer ? ((Integer)hints).intValue() : 0);
        }

        private Color readColour(Parcel parcel)
        {
            Object value = parcel.readValue(null);

            return value instanceof Integer ? Color.valueOf(((Integer)value).intValue()) : null;
        }

        @Override
        public WallpaperColors[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new WallpaperColors[size];
        }
    };
}

```

`java/android/app/assist/AssistContent.java`:

```java
package android.app.assist;

import android.content.ClipData;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public class AssistContent implements Parcelable
{
    public static final String EXTRA_APP_FUNCTION_DATA = "android.app.assist.extra.APP_FUNCTION_DATA";

    private boolean mIsAppProvidedIntent;
    private boolean mIsAppProvidedWebUri;
    private Intent mIntent;
    private String mStructuredData;
    private ClipData mClipData;
    private Uri mUri;
    private Uri mSessionTransferUri;
    private final Bundle mExtras;

    public AssistContent()
    {
        mExtras = new Bundle();
    }

    AssistContent(Parcel in)
    {
        if (in.readInt() != 0) mIntent = Intent.CREATOR.createFromParcel(in);
        if (in.readInt() != 0) mClipData = ClipData.CREATOR.createFromParcel(in);
        if (in.readInt() != 0) mUri = Uri.CREATOR.createFromParcel(in);
        if (in.readInt() != 0) mStructuredData = in.readString();
        if (in.readInt() != 0) mSessionTransferUri = Uri.CREATOR.createFromParcel(in);

        mIsAppProvidedIntent = in.readInt() == 1;
        Bundle extras = in.readBundle();
        mExtras = extras != null ? extras : new Bundle();
        mIsAppProvidedWebUri = in.readInt() == 1;
    }

    public void setDefaultIntent(Intent intent)
    {
        mIntent = intent;
        mIsAppProvidedIntent = false;
        mUri = null;

        if (intent != null && Intent.ACTION_VIEW.equals(intent.getAction()))
        {
            Uri uri = intent.getData();

            if (uri != null && ("http".equals(uri.getScheme()) || "https".equals(uri.getScheme()))) mUri = uri;
        }
    }

    public void setIntent(Intent intent)
    {
        mIsAppProvidedIntent = true;
        mIntent = intent;
    }

    public Intent getIntent()
    {
        return mIntent;
    }

    public boolean isAppProvidedIntent()
    {
        return mIsAppProvidedIntent;
    }

    public void setClipData(ClipData clip)
    {
        mClipData = clip;
    }

    public ClipData getClipData()
    {
        return mClipData;
    }

    public void setStructuredData(String structuredData)
    {
        mStructuredData = structuredData;
    }

    public String getStructuredData()
    {
        return mStructuredData;
    }

    public void setWebUri(Uri uri)
    {
        mIsAppProvidedWebUri = true;
        mUri = uri;
    }

    public Uri getWebUri()
    {
        return mUri;
    }

    public boolean isAppProvidedWebUri()
    {
        return mIsAppProvidedWebUri;
    }

    public void setSessionTransferUri(Uri uri)
    {
        mSessionTransferUri = uri;
    }

    public Uri getSessionTransferUri()
    {
        return mSessionTransferUri;
    }

    public Bundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        writeOptional(dest, mIntent, flags);
        writeOptional(dest, mClipData, flags);
        writeOptional(dest, mUri, flags);

        dest.writeInt(mStructuredData != null ? 1 : 0);
        if (mStructuredData != null) dest.writeString(mStructuredData);

        writeOptional(dest, mSessionTransferUri, flags);

        dest.writeInt(mIsAppProvidedIntent ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeBundle(mExtras);
        dest.writeInt(mIsAppProvidedWebUri ? 1 : 0);
    }

    private static void writeOptional(Parcel dest, Parcelable value, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(value != null ? 1 : 0);
        if (value != null) value.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
    }

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<AssistContent> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<AssistContent>()
    {
        @Override
        public AssistContent createFromParcel(Parcel in)
        {
            return new AssistContent(in);
        }

        @Override
        public AssistContent[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new AssistContent[size];
        }
    };
}
```

`java/android/app/backup/BackupAgentHelper.java`:

```java
package android.app.backup;

import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;
import android.util.Log;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.TreeMap;

public class BackupAgentHelper extends BackupAgent
{
    private static final String TAG = "BackupAgentHelper";

    private final Map<String, BackupHelper> mHelpers = new TreeMap<>();

    public BackupAgentHelper()
    {
        super();
    }

    @Override
    public void onBackup(ParcelFileDescriptor oldState, BackupDataOutput data, ParcelFileDescriptor newState) throws IOException
    {
        for (Map.Entry<String, BackupHelper> entry : mHelpers.entrySet())
        {
            data.setKeyPrefix(entry.getKey());
            try
            {
                entry.getValue().performBackup(oldState, data, newState);
            }
            finally
            {
                data.setKeyPrefix(null);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onRestore(BackupDataInput data, int appVersionCode, ParcelFileDescriptor newState) throws IOException
    {
        BackupDataInputStream stream = new BackupDataInputStream(data);

        while (data.readNextHeader())
        {
            String key = data.getKey();
            int separator = key.indexOf(':');
            BackupHelper helper = separator < 0 ? null : mHelpers.get(key.substring(0, separator));

            if (helper == null)
            {
                Log.w(TAG, "no helper restores the backup entity " + key);
                data.skipEntityData();
                continue;
            }

            stream.key = key.substring(separator + 1);
            stream.dataSize = data.getDataSize();
            helper.restoreEntity(stream);
            data.skipEntityData();
        }

        for (BackupHelper helper : mHelpers.values()) helper.writeNewStateDescription(newState);
    }

    public void addHelper(String keyPrefix, BackupHelper helper)
    {
        if (keyPrefix == null || helper == null) throw new NullPointerException();

        mHelpers.put(keyPrefix, helper);
    }
}
```

`java/android/app/backup/BackupDataInput.java`:

```java
package android.app.backup;

import java.io.DataInputStream;
import java.io.EOFException;
import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

public class BackupDataInput
{
    private final DataInputStream mInput;
    private String mKey;
    private int mDataSize = -1;
    private int mRemaining;

    BackupDataInput(FileDescriptor descriptor)
    {
        this(new FileInputStream(descriptor));
    }

    BackupDataInput(InputStream input)
    {
        mInput = new DataInputStream(input);
    }

    public boolean readNextHeader() throws IOException
    {
        if (mRemaining > 0) skipEntityData();

        int magic;
        try
        {
            magic = mInput.readInt();
        }
        catch (EOFException end)
        {
            mKey = null;
            mDataSize = -1;
            return false;
        }

        if (magic != BackupDataOutput.ENTITY_MAGIC) throw new IOException("malformed backup data: bad entity header 0x" + Integer.toHexString(magic));

        byte[] key = new byte[mInput.readInt()];
        mInput.readFully(key);
        mKey = new String(key, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        mDataSize = mInput.readInt();
        mRemaining = mDataSize < 0 ? 0 : mDataSize;
        return true;
    }

    public String getKey()
    {
        if (mKey == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Entity header not read");
        return mKey;
    }

    public int getDataSize()
    {
        if (mKey == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Entity header not read");
        return mDataSize;
    }

    public int readEntityData(byte[] data, int offset, int size) throws IOException
    {
        if (mKey == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Entity header not read");
        if (mRemaining == 0) return 0;

        int read = mInput.read(data, offset, Math.min(size, mRemaining));
        if (read < 0) throw new IOException("the backup data ended inside an entity");

        mRemaining -= read;
        return read;
    }

    public void skipEntityData() throws IOException
    {
        if (mKey == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Entity header not read");

        while (mRemaining > 0)
        {
            int skipped = (int)mInput.skip(mRemaining);
            if (skipped <= 0)
            {
                if (mInput.read() < 0) throw new IOException("the backup data ended inside an entity");
                skipped = 1;
            }

            mRemaining -= skipped;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/app/backup/BackupDataInputStream.java`:

```java
package android.app.backup;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;

public class BackupDataInputStream extends InputStream
{
    private final BackupDataInput mData;
    private final byte[] mOneByte = new byte[1];

    String key;
    int dataSize;

    BackupDataInputStream(BackupDataInput data)
    {
        mData = data;
    }

    @Override
    public int read() throws IOException
    {
        int read = mData.readEntityData(mOneByte, 0, 1);
        return read <= 0 ? -1 : mOneByte[0] & 0xff;
    }

    @Override
    public int read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size) throws IOException
    {
        int read = mData.readEntityData(buffer, offset, size);
        return read <= 0 && size > 0 ? -1 : read;
    }

    @Override
    public int read(byte[] buffer) throws IOException
    {
        return read(buffer, 0, buffer.length);
    }

    public String getKey()
    {
        return key;
    }

    public int size()
    {
        return dataSize;
    }
}
```

`java/android/app/backup/BackupDataOutput.java`:

```java
package android.app.backup;

import java.io.DataOutputStream;
import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

public class BackupDataOutput
{
    static final int ENTITY_MAGIC = 0x44617461;

    private final DataOutputStream mOutput;
    private final long mQuota;
    private final int mTransportFlags;
    private String mKeyPrefix;
    private int mPendingBytes = -1;

    BackupDataOutput(FileDescriptor descriptor, long quota, int transportFlags)
    {
        this(new FileOutputStream(descriptor), quota, transportFlags);
    }

    BackupDataOutput(OutputStream output, long quota, int transportFlags)
    {
        mOutput = new DataOutputStream(output);
        mQuota = quota;
        mTransportFlags = transportFlags;
    }

    void setKeyPrefix(String keyPrefix)
    {
        mKeyPrefix = keyPrefix;
    }

    public long getQuota()
    {
        return mQuota;
    }

    public int getTransportFlags()
    {
        return mTransportFlags;
    }

    public int writeEntityHeader(String key, int dataSize) throws IOException
    {
        if (key == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("key");
        if (mPendingBytes > 0) throw new IOException("the previous entity still expects " + mPendingBytes + " byte(s)");

        String fullKey = mKeyPrefix == null ? key : mKeyPrefix + ":" + key;
        byte[] keyBytes = fullKey.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

        mOutput.writeInt(ENTITY_MAGIC);
        mOutput.writeInt(keyBytes.length);
        mOutput.write(keyBytes);
        mOutput.writeInt(dataSize);
        mOutput.flush();

        mPendingBytes = dataSize < 0 ? 0 : dataSize;
        return 12 + keyBytes.length;
    }

    public int writeEntityData(byte[] data, int size) throws IOException
    {
        if (mPendingBytes < 0) throw new IOException("writeEntityHeader must be called before writeEntityData");
        if (size > mPendingBytes) throw new IOException("the entity data is " + (size - mPendingBytes) + " byte(s) longer than its header said");

        mOutput.write(data, 0, size);
        mOutput.flush();
        mPendingBytes -= size;
        return size;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.app.backup;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;

import java.io.File;

public class FileBackupHelper implements BackupHelper
{
    private final Context mContext;
    private final String[] mFiles;

    public FileBackupHelper(Context context, String... files)
    {
        mContext = context;
        mFiles = files == null ? new String[0] : files.clone();
    }

    private File[] files()
    {
        File directory = mContext.getFilesDir();
        File[] files = new File[mFiles.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < mFiles.length; index++) files[index] = new File(directory, mFiles[index]);
        return files;
    }

    @Override
    public void performBackup(ParcelFileDescriptor oldState, BackupDataOutput data, ParcelFileDescriptor newState)
    {
        FileBackups.performBackup(oldState, data, newState, files(), mFiles);
    }

    @Override
    public void restoreEntity(BackupDataInputStream data)
    {
        String key = data.getKey();
        for (String name : mFiles)
        {
            if (name.equals(key))
            {
                FileBackups.restoreEntity(data, new File(mContext.getFilesDir(), name));
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void writeNewStateDescription(ParcelFileDescriptor newState)
    {
        FileBackups.writeNewStateDescription(newState, files(), mFiles);
    }
}
```

`java/android/app/backup/FileBackups.java`:

```java
package android.app.backup;

import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;
import android.util.Log;

import java.io.DataInputStream;
import java.io.DataOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

final class FileBackups
{
    private static final String TAG = "FileBackups";
    private static final int STATE_MAGIC = 0x46696c65;

    private FileBackups()
    {
    }

    static void performBackup(ParcelFileDescriptor oldState, BackupDataOutput data, ParcelFileDescriptor newState, File[] files,
                              String[] keys)
    {
        Map<String, long[]> previous = readState(oldState);
        Map<String, long[]> current = new HashMap<>();

        for (int index = 0; index < files.length; index++)
        {
            File file = files[index];
            String key = keys[index];
            if (!file.isFile()) continue;

            long[] stamp = new long[] {file.length(), file.lastModified()};
            current.put(key, stamp);

            long[] old = previous.get(key);
            if (old != null && old[0] == stamp[0] && old[1] == stamp[1]) continue;

            try
            {
                byte[] bytes = Files.readAllBytes(file.toPath());
                data.writeEntityHeader(key, bytes.length);
                data.writeEntityData(bytes, bytes.length);
            }
            catch (IOException failure)
            {
                Log.w(TAG, "could not back up " + file, failure);
            }
        }

        for (String key : previous.keySet())
        {
            if (current.containsKey(key)) continue;

            try
            {
                data.writeEntityHeader(key, -1);
            }
            catch (IOException failure)
            {
                Log.w(TAG, "could not record the deletion of " + key, failure);
            }
        }

        writeState(newState, current);
    }

    static void restoreEntity(BackupDataInputStream data, File destination)
    {
        if (data.size() < 0)
        {
            destination.delete();
            return;
        }

        File parent = destination.getParentFile();
        if (parent != null) parent.mkdirs();

        try (FileOutputStream output = new FileOutputStream(destination))
        {
            byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
            int read;
            while ((read = data.read(buffer, 0, buffer.length)) > 0) output.write(buffer, 0, read);
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "could not restore " + destination, failure);
        }
    }

    static void writeNewStateDescription(ParcelFileDescriptor newState, File[] files, String[] keys)
    {
        Map<String, long[]> current = new HashMap<>();
        for (int index = 0; index < files.length; index++)
        {
            if (files[index].isFile()) current.put(keys[index], new long[] {files[index].length(), files[index].lastModified()});
        }

        writeState(newState, current);
    }

    private static Map<String, long[]> readState(ParcelFileDescriptor state)
    {
        Map<String, long[]> result = new HashMap<>();
        if (state == null) return result;

        try
        {
            InputStream stream = new FileInputStream(state.getFileDescriptor());
            DataInputStream input = new DataInputStream(stream);
            if (input.readInt() != STATE_MAGIC) return result;

            int count = input.readInt();
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                String key = input.readUTF();
                long size = input.readLong();
                result.put(key, new long[] {size, input.readLong()});
            }
        }
        catch (IOException unreadable)
        {
            result.clear();
        }

        return result;
    }

    private static void writeState(ParcelFileDescriptor state, Map<String, long[]> stamps)
    {
        if (state == null) return;

        try
        {
            DataOutputStream output = new DataOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(state.getFileDescriptor()));
            output.writeInt(STATE_MAGIC);
            output.writeInt(stamps.size());
            for (Map.Entry<String, long[]> entry : stamps.entrySet())
            {
                output.writeUTF(entry.getKey());
                output.writeLong(entry.getValue()[0]);
                output.writeLong(entry.getValue()[1]);
            }
            output.flush();
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "could not write the backup state", failure);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.app.backup;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;

import java.io.File;

public class SharedPreferencesBackupHelper implements BackupHelper
{
    private final Context mContext;
    private final String[] mPreferences;

    public SharedPreferencesBackupHelper(Context context, String... prefGroups)
    {
        mContext = context;
        mPreferences = prefGroups == null ? new String[0] : prefGroups.clone();
    }

    private File fileFor(String name)
    {
        return new File(new File(mContext.getDataDir(), "shared_prefs"), name + ".xml");
    }

    private File[] files()
    {
        File[] files = new File[mPreferences.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < mPreferences.length; index++) files[index] = fileFor(mPreferences[index]);
        return files;
    }

    @Override
    public void performBackup(ParcelFileDescriptor oldState, BackupDataOutput data, ParcelFileDescriptor newState)
    {
        FileBackups.performBackup(oldState, data, newState, files(), mPreferences);
    }

    @Override
    public void restoreEntity(BackupDataInputStream data)
    {
        String key = data.getKey();
        for (String name : mPreferences)
        {
            if (name.equals(key))
            {
                FileBackups.restoreEntity(data, fileFor(name));
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void writeNewStateDescription(ParcelFileDescriptor newState)
    {
        FileBackups.writeNewStateDescription(newState, files(), mPreferences);
    }
}
```

```java
import android.net.Uri;

import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Objects;

public class JobInfo implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int NETWORK_TYPE_NONE = 0;
    public static final int NETWORK_TYPE_ANY = 1;
    public static final int NETWORK_TYPE_UNMETERED = 2;
    public static final int NETWORK_TYPE_NOT_ROAMING = 3;
    public static final int NETWORK_TYPE_CELLULAR = 4;
    public static final int NETWORK_TYPE_METERED = 4;
    public static final int NETWORK_BYTES_UNKNOWN = -1;

    public static final long MAX_BACKOFF_DELAY_MILLIS = 18000000L;

    public static final int BACKOFF_POLICY_EXPONENTIAL = 1;

    public static final int PRIORITY_LOW = 200;
    public static final int PRIORITY_DEFAULT = 300;
    public static final int PRIORITY_HIGH = 400;
    public static final int PRIORITY_MAX = 500;

    private static final long MIN_FLEX_MILLIS = 5L * 60L * 1000L;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<JobInfo> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<JobInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public JobInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            JobInfo job = new JobInfo(source.readInt(), ComponentName.readFromParcel(source));
            job.mExtras = source.readPersistableBundle();
            job.mTransientExtras = source.readBundle();
            job.mMinimumLatencyMillis = source.readLong();
            job.mOverrideDeadlineMillis = source.readLong();
            job.mIntervalMillis = source.readLong();
            job.mFlexMillis = source.readLong();
            job.mPeriodic = source.readInt() != 0;
            job.mPersisted = source.readInt() != 0;
            job.mNetworkType = source.readInt();
            job.mConstraintFlags = source.readInt();
            job.mInitialBackoffMillis = source.readLong();
            job.mBackoffPolicy = source.readInt();
            job.mPriority = source.readInt();
            job.mFlags = source.readInt();
            job.mTriggerContentUpdateDelay = source.readLong();
            job.mTriggerContentMaxDelay = source.readLong();
            job.mEstimatedDownloadBytes = source.readLong();
            job.mEstimatedUploadBytes = source.readLong();
            job.mMinimumChunkBytes = source.readLong();
            job.mTraceTag = source.readString();
            int count = source.readInt();
            if (count >= 0)
            {
                job.mTriggerContentUris = new TriggerContentUri[count];
                for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
                {
                    job.mTriggerContentUris[index] = TriggerContentUri.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
                }
            }
            if (source.readInt() != 0)
            {
                job.mClipData = ClipData.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
                job.mClipGrantFlags = source.readInt();
            }
            return job;
        }

        @Override
        public JobInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new JobInfo[size];
        }
    };

    private static final int CONSTRAINT_CHARGING = 1;
    private static final int CONSTRAINT_IDLE = 1 << 1;
    private static final int CONSTRAINT_BATTERY_NOT_LOW = 1 << 2;
    private static final int CONSTRAINT_STORAGE_NOT_LOW = 1 << 3;

    private static final int FLAG_IMPORTANT_WHILE_FOREGROUND = 1;
    private static final int FLAG_PREFETCH = 1 << 1;
    private static final int FLAG_EXPEDITED = 1 << 2;
    private static final int FLAG_USER_INITIATED = 1 << 3;

    private final ComponentName mService;

    private long mOverrideDeadlineMillis = -1;
    private long mIntervalMillis;
    private long mFlexMillis;
    private boolean mPeriodic;
    private boolean mPersisted;
    private int mNetworkType = NETWORK_TYPE_NONE;
    private NetworkRequest mNetworkRequest;
    private int mConstraintFlags;
    private long mInitialBackoffMillis = DEFAULT_INITIAL_BACKOFF_MILLIS;
    private int mBackoffPolicy = BACKOFF_POLICY_EXPONENTIAL;
    private int mPriority = PRIORITY_DEFAULT;
    private int mFlags;
    private TriggerContentUri[] mTriggerContentUris;
    private long mTriggerContentUpdateDelay = -1;
    private long mTriggerContentMaxDelay = -1;
    private long mEstimatedDownloadBytes = NETWORK_BYTES_UNKNOWN;
    private long mEstimatedUploadBytes = NETWORK_BYTES_UNKNOWN;
    private long mMinimumChunkBytes = NETWORK_BYTES_UNKNOWN;
    private String mTraceTag;

    JobInfo(int id, ComponentName service)
    {
        mId = id;
        mService = service;
    }

    public static final long getMinPeriodMillis()
    {
        return MIN_PERIOD_MILLIS;
    }

    public static final long getMinFlexMillis()
    {
        return MIN_FLEX_MILLIS;
    }

    public int getId()
    {
        return mId;
    }

    public PersistableBundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    public Bundle getTransientExtras()
    {
        return mTransientExtras;
    }

    public ClipData getClipData()

    }

        return mClipGrantFlags;
    }

    public ComponentName getService()

        return mService;
    }

    public int getPriority()

        return mPriority;
    }

    public boolean isRequireCharging()
    {
        return (mConstraintFlags & CONSTRAINT_CHARGING) != 0;
    }

    {
        return (mConstraintFlags & CONSTRAINT_BATTERY_NOT_LOW) != 0;
    }

    {
        return (mConstraintFlags & CONSTRAINT_IDLE) != 0;
    }

    public boolean isRequireStorageNotLow()
    {
        return (mConstraintFlags & CONSTRAINT_STORAGE_NOT_LOW) != 0;
    }

    public TriggerContentUri[] getTriggerContentUris()
    {
        return mTriggerContentUris;
    }

    {
        return mTriggerContentUpdateDelay;
    }

        return mTriggerContentMaxDelay;
    }

    {
        return mNetworkType;
    }

        return mNetworkRequest;

        return mEstimatedDownloadBytes;

        return mEstimatedUploadBytes;

        return mMinimumChunkBytes;
    }

    {
        return mMinimumLatencyMillis;
    }

    {
        return mOverrideDeadlineMillis;
    }

    public boolean isPeriodic()
    {
        return mPeriodic;
    }

    public boolean isPersisted()
    {
        return mPersisted;
    }

    {
        return mIntervalMillis;
    }

    {
        return mFlexMillis;
    }

    {
        return mInitialBackoffMillis;
    }

    {
        return mBackoffPolicy;
    }

    public boolean isExpedited()
    {
        return (mFlags & FLAG_EXPEDITED) != 0;
    }

    public boolean isUserInitiated()
    {
        return (mFlags & FLAG_USER_INITIATED) != 0;
    }

    {
        return (mFlags & FLAG_IMPORTANT_WHILE_FOREGROUND) != 0;

        return (mFlags & FLAG_PREFETCH) != 0;

    {
        return mTraceTag;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof JobInfo)) return false;

        JobInfo job = (JobInfo)other;
        return mId == job.mId && Objects.equals(mService, job.mService) && mMinimumLatencyMillis == job.mMinimumLatencyMillis
               && mOverrideDeadlineMillis == job.mOverrideDeadlineMillis && mIntervalMillis == job.mIntervalMillis
               && mFlexMillis == job.mFlexMillis && mPeriodic == job.mPeriodic && mPersisted == job.mPersisted
               && mNetworkType == job.mNetworkType && mConstraintFlags == job.mConstraintFlags
               && mInitialBackoffMillis == job.mInitialBackoffMillis && mBackoffPolicy == job.mBackoffPolicy
               && mPriority == job.mPriority && mFlags == job.mFlags && Arrays.equals(mTriggerContentUris, job.mTriggerContentUris)
               && mTriggerContentUpdateDelay == job.mTriggerContentUpdateDelay
               && mTriggerContentMaxDelay == job.mTriggerContentMaxDelay && Objects.equals(mTraceTag, job.mTraceTag);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mId, mService, mMinimumLatencyMillis, mOverrideDeadlineMillis, mIntervalMillis, mPeriodic, mNetworkType,
                            mConstraintFlags, mFlags, mPriority);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeInt(mId);
        ComponentName.writeToParcel(mService, destination);
        destination.writePersistableBundle(mExtras);
        destination.writeBundle(mTransientExtras);
        destination.writeLong(mMinimumLatencyMillis);
        destination.writeLong(mOverrideDeadlineMillis);
        destination.writeLong(mIntervalMillis);
        destination.writeLong(mFlexMillis);
        destination.writeInt(mPeriodic ? 1 : 0);
        destination.writeInt(mPersisted ? 1 : 0);
        destination.writeInt(mNetworkType);
        destination.writeInt(mConstraintFlags);
        destination.writeLong(mInitialBackoffMillis);
        destination.writeInt(mBackoffPolicy);
        destination.writeInt(mPriority);
        destination.writeInt(mFlags);
        destination.writeLong(mTriggerContentUpdateDelay);
        destination.writeLong(mTriggerContentMaxDelay);
        destination.writeLong(mEstimatedDownloadBytes);
        destination.writeLong(mEstimatedUploadBytes);
        destination.writeLong(mMinimumChunkBytes);
        destination.writeString(mTraceTag);
        if (mTriggerContentUris == null)
        {
            destination.writeInt(-1);
        }
        else
        {
            destination.writeInt(mTriggerContentUris.length);
            for (TriggerContentUri uri : mTriggerContentUris) uri.writeToParcel(destination, flags);
        }
        if (mClipData == null)
        {
            destination.writeInt(0);
        }
        else
        {
            destination.writeInt(1);
            mClipData.writeToParcel(destination, flags);
            destination.writeInt(mClipGrantFlags);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "(job:" + mId + "/" + (mService == null ? "null" : mService.flattenToShortString()) + ")";
    }

    public static final class TriggerContentUri implements Parcelable
    {
        public static final int FLAG_NOTIFY_FOR_DESCENDANTS = 1;

        public static final Parcelable.Creator<TriggerContentUri> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<TriggerContentUri>()
        {
            @Override
            public TriggerContentUri createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                Uri uri = Uri.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
                return new TriggerContentUri(uri, source.readInt());
            }

            @Override
            public TriggerContentUri[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new TriggerContentUri[size];
            }
        };

        private final Uri mUri;
        private final int mFlags;

        public TriggerContentUri(Uri uri, int flags)
        {
            mUri = Objects.requireNonNull(uri);
            mFlags = flags;
        }

        public Uri getUri()
        {
            return mUri;
        }

        public int getFlags()
        {
            return mFlags;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object other)
        {
            if (!(other instanceof TriggerContentUri)) return false;

            TriggerContentUri uri = (TriggerContentUri)other;
            return mUri.equals(uri.mUri) && mFlags == uri.mFlags;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return mUri.hashCode() ^ mFlags;
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
        {
            mUri.writeToParcel(destination, flags);
            destination.writeInt(mFlags);
        }
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final JobInfo mJob;
        private final ArrayList<TriggerContentUri> mTriggerContentUris = new ArrayList<>();
        private boolean mBackoffCriteriaSet;

        public Builder(int jobId, ComponentName jobService)
        {
            mJob = new JobInfo(jobId, jobService);
        }

        public Builder setPriority(int priority)
        {
            if (priority < PRIORITY_MIN || priority > PRIORITY_MAX) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid priority value");
            mJob.mPriority = priority;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setExtras(PersistableBundle extras)
        {
            mJob.mExtras = extras == null ? PersistableBundle.EMPTY : extras;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setTransientExtras(Bundle extras)
        {
            mJob.mTransientExtras = extras == null ? Bundle.EMPTY : extras;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setClipData(ClipData clip, int grantFlags)
        {
            mJob.mClipData = clip;
            mJob.mClipGrantFlags = grantFlags;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setRequiredNetworkType(int networkType)
        {
            mJob.mNetworkType = networkType;
            mJob.mNetworkRequest = null;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setRequiredNetwork(NetworkRequest networkRequest)
        {
            mJob.mNetworkRequest = networkRequest;
            mJob.mNetworkType = networkRequest == null ? NETWORK_TYPE_NONE : NETWORK_TYPE_ANY;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setEstimatedNetworkBytes(long downloadBytes, long uploadBytes)
        {
            mJob.mEstimatedDownloadBytes = downloadBytes;
            mJob.mEstimatedUploadBytes = uploadBytes;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setMinimumNetworkChunkBytes(long chunkSizeBytes)
        {
            if (chunkSizeBytes != NETWORK_BYTES_UNKNOWN && chunkSizeBytes <= 0)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Minimum chunk size must be positive");
            }
            mJob.mMinimumChunkBytes = chunkSizeBytes;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setRequiresCharging(boolean requiresCharging)
        {
            setConstraint(CONSTRAINT_CHARGING, requiresCharging);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setRequiresBatteryNotLow(boolean batteryNotLow)
        {
            setConstraint(CONSTRAINT_BATTERY_NOT_LOW, batteryNotLow);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setRequiresDeviceIdle(boolean requiresDeviceIdle)
        {
            setConstraint(CONSTRAINT_IDLE, requiresDeviceIdle);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setRequiresStorageNotLow(boolean storageNotLow)
        {
            setConstraint(CONSTRAINT_STORAGE_NOT_LOW, storageNotLow);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder addTriggerContentUri(TriggerContentUri uri)
        {
            mTriggerContentUris.add(Objects.requireNonNull(uri));
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setTriggerContentUpdateDelay(long durationMs)
        {
            mJob.mTriggerContentUpdateDelay = durationMs;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setTriggerContentMaxDelay(long durationMs)
        {
            mJob.mTriggerContentMaxDelay = durationMs;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setPeriodic(long intervalMillis)
        {
            return setPeriodic(intervalMillis, intervalMillis);
        }

        public Builder setPeriodic(long intervalMillis, long flexMillis)
        {
            long interval = Math.max(intervalMillis, MIN_PERIOD_MILLIS);
            long flex = Math.min(Math.max(flexMillis, Math.max(MIN_FLEX_MILLIS, interval / 20)), interval);
            mJob.mPeriodic = true;
            mJob.mIntervalMillis = interval;
            mJob.mFlexMillis = flex;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setMinimumLatency(long minLatencyMillis)
        {
            mJob.mMinimumLatencyMillis = minLatencyMillis;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setOverrideDeadline(long maxExecutionDelayMillis)
        {
            mJob.mOverrideDeadlineMillis = maxExecutionDelayMillis;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setBackoffCriteria(long initialBackoffMillis, int backoffPolicy)
        {
            mBackoffCriteriaSet = true;
            mJob.mInitialBackoffMillis = Math.min(Math.max(initialBackoffMillis, 10000L), MAX_BACKOFF_DELAY_MILLIS);
            mJob.mBackoffPolicy = backoffPolicy;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setExpedited(boolean expedited)
        {
            setFlag(FLAG_EXPEDITED, expedited);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setUserInitiated(boolean userInitiated)
        {
            setFlag(FLAG_USER_INITIATED, userInitiated);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setImportantWhileForeground(boolean importantWhileForeground)
        {
            setFlag(FLAG_IMPORTANT_WHILE_FOREGROUND, importantWhileForeground);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setPrefetch(boolean prefetch)
        {
            setFlag(FLAG_PREFETCH, prefetch);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setPersisted(boolean isPersisted)
        {
            mJob.mPersisted = isPersisted;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setTraceTag(String traceTag)
        {
            mJob.mTraceTag = traceTag;
            return this;
        }

        public JobInfo build()
        {
            if (mJob.mPeriodic && (mJob.mMinimumLatencyMillis > 0 || mJob.mOverrideDeadlineMillis >= 0))
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Can't call setMinimumLatency() or setOverrideDeadline() on a periodic job.");
            }
            if (mJob.mPeriodic && !mTriggerContentUris.isEmpty())
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Can't call addTriggerContentUri() on a periodic job");
            }
            if (mJob.isExpedited() && (mJob.mPeriodic || mJob.mMinimumLatencyMillis > 0 || mJob.isRequireDeviceIdle()
                                       || mJob.isRequireCharging() || mJob.isRequireBatteryNotLow()
                                       || mJob.isRequireStorageNotLow() || !mTriggerContentUris.isEmpty()))
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("An expedited job can only have network and storage-not-low constraints");
            }
            if (mBackoffCriteriaSet && mJob.isRequireDeviceIdle())
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("An idle mode job will not respect any back-off policy, so calling "
                                                   + "setBackoffCriteria with setRequiresDeviceIdle is an error.");
            }

            JobInfo job = new JobInfo(mJob.mId, mJob.mService);
            job.mExtras = mJob.mExtras;
            job.mTransientExtras = mJob.mTransientExtras;
            job.mClipData = mJob.mClipData;
            job.mClipGrantFlags = mJob.mClipGrantFlags;
            job.mMinimumLatencyMillis = mJob.mMinimumLatencyMillis;
            job.mOverrideDeadlineMillis = mJob.mOverrideDeadlineMillis;
            job.mIntervalMillis = mJob.mIntervalMillis;
            job.mFlexMillis = mJob.mFlexMillis;
            job.mPeriodic = mJob.mPeriodic;
            job.mPersisted = mJob.mPersisted;
            job.mNetworkType = mJob.mNetworkType;
            job.mNetworkRequest = mJob.mNetworkRequest;
            job.mConstraintFlags = mJob.mConstraintFlags;
            job.mInitialBackoffMillis = mJob.mInitialBackoffMillis;
            job.mBackoffPolicy = mJob.mBackoffPolicy;
            job.mPriority = mJob.mPriority;
            job.mFlags = mJob.mFlags;
            job.mTriggerContentUris =
                    mTriggerContentUris.isEmpty() ? null : mTriggerContentUris.toArray(new TriggerContentUri[0]);
            job.mTriggerContentUpdateDelay = mJob.mTriggerContentUpdateDelay;
            job.mTriggerContentMaxDelay = mJob.mTriggerContentMaxDelay;
            job.mEstimatedDownloadBytes = mJob.mEstimatedDownloadBytes;
            job.mEstimatedUploadBytes = mJob.mEstimatedUploadBytes;
            job.mMinimumChunkBytes = mJob.mMinimumChunkBytes;
            job.mTraceTag = mJob.mTraceTag;
            return job;
        }

        private void setConstraint(int flag, boolean enabled)
        {
            mJob.mConstraintFlags = enabled ? mJob.mConstraintFlags | flag : mJob.mConstraintFlags & ~flag;
        }

        private void setFlag(int flag, boolean enabled)
        {
            mJob.mFlags = enabled ? mJob.mFlags | flag : mJob.mFlags & ~flag;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class JobParameters implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int STOP_REASON_UNDEFINED = 0;
    public static final int STOP_REASON_CANCELLED_BY_APP = 1;
    public static final int STOP_REASON_PREEMPT = 2;
    public static final int STOP_REASON_TIMEOUT = 3;

    public static final int STOP_REASON_CONSTRAINT_BATTERY_NOT_LOW = 5;

    public static final int STOP_REASON_CONSTRAINT_CONNECTIVITY = 7;
    public static final int STOP_REASON_CONSTRAINT_DEVICE_IDLE = 8;
    public static final int STOP_REASON_CONSTRAINT_STORAGE_NOT_LOW = 9;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<JobParameters> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<JobParameters>()
    {
        @Override
        public JobParameters createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            JobParameters parameters = new JobParameters(source.readInt(), source.readString(), source.readPersistableBundle(),
                                                         source.readBundle(), null, null, null, false, false, false);
            parameters.mStopReason = source.readInt();
            parameters.mStopped = source.readInt() != 0;
            return parameters;
        }

        @Override
        public JobParameters[] newArray(int size)

            return new JobParameters[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mJobId;
    private final String mJobNamespace;

    private final Bundle mTransientExtras;
    private final ClipData mClipData;

    private final Uri[] mTriggeredContentUris;
    private final String[] mTriggeredContentAuthorities;

    private final boolean mOverrideDeadlineExpired;
    private final boolean mExpedited;
    private final boolean mUserInitiated;

    public JobParameters(int jobId, Bundle transientExtras)

    public JobParameters(int jobId, String jobNamespace, PersistableBundle extras, Bundle transientExtras, Uri[] triggeredContentUris,
                         String[] triggeredContentAuthorities, Network network, boolean overrideDeadlineExpired, boolean expedited,
                         boolean userInitiated)
    {
        this(jobId, jobNamespace, extras, transientExtras, null, 0, triggeredContentUris, triggeredContentAuthorities, network,
             overrideDeadlineExpired, expedited, userInitiated);
    }

    public JobParameters(int jobId, String jobNamespace, PersistableBundle extras, Bundle transientExtras, ClipData clipData,
                         int clipGrantFlags, Uri[] triggeredContentUris, String[] triggeredContentAuthorities, Network network,
                         boolean overrideDeadlineExpired, boolean expedited, boolean userInitiated)
    {
        mJobId = jobId;
        mJobNamespace = jobNamespace;
        mExtras = extras == null ? PersistableBundle.EMPTY : extras;
        mTransientExtras = transientExtras == null ? Bundle.EMPTY : transientExtras;
        mClipData = clipData;
        mClipGrantFlags = clipGrantFlags;
        mTriggeredContentUris = triggeredContentUris;
        mTriggeredContentAuthorities = triggeredContentAuthorities;
        mNetwork = network;
        mOverrideDeadlineExpired = overrideDeadlineExpired;
        mExpedited = expedited;
        mUserInitiated = userInitiated;
    }

        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Given work is not active: " + work);
        }
    }

        destination.writeBundle(mTransientExtras);
```

```java
    {
        return false;
```

`java/android/app/job/JobService.java`:

```java
package android.app.job;

import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.IBinder;

public abstract class JobService extends Service
{
    public static final String PERMISSION_BIND = "android.permission.BIND_JOB_SERVICE";

    public static final int JOB_END_NOTIFICATION_POLICY_DETACH = 0;
    public static final int JOB_END_NOTIFICATION_POLICY_REMOVE = 1;

    private JobServiceEngine mEngine;

    public JobService()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public final IBinder onBind(Intent intent)
    {
        if (mEngine == null)
        {
            mEngine = new JobServiceEngine(this)
            {
                @Override
                public boolean onStartJob(JobParameters params)
                {
                    return JobService.this.onStartJob(params);
                }

                @Override
                public boolean onStopJob(JobParameters params)
                {
                    return JobService.this.onStopJob(params);
                }

                @Override
                public void onNetworkChanged(JobParameters params)
                {
                    JobService.this.onNetworkChanged(params);
                }
            };
        }

        return mEngine.getBinder();
    }

    public final void jobFinished(JobParameters params, boolean wantsReschedule)
    {
        runtime.Jobs.finished(params, wantsReschedule);
    }

    public abstract boolean onStartJob(JobParameters params);

    public abstract boolean onStopJob(JobParameters params);

    public void onNetworkChanged(JobParameters params)
    {
```

```java
package android.app.job;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.os.PersistableBundle;

public final class JobWorkItem implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<JobWorkItem> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<JobWorkItem>()
    {
        @Override
        public JobWorkItem createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            Intent intent = source.readInt() != 0 ? Intent.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source) : null;
            JobWorkItem item = new JobWorkItem(intent, source.readLong(), source.readLong(), source.readLong());
            item.mExtras = source.readPersistableBundle();
            item.mDeliveryCount = source.readInt();
            item.mWorkId = source.readInt();
            return item;
        }

        @Override
        public JobWorkItem[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new JobWorkItem[size];
        }
    };

    private final Intent mIntent;
    private final long mNetworkDownloadBytes;
    private final long mNetworkUploadBytes;
    private final long mMinimumChunkBytes;
    private PersistableBundle mExtras = PersistableBundle.EMPTY;
    private int mDeliveryCount;
    private int mWorkId;

    public JobWorkItem(Intent intent)
    {
        this(intent, JobInfo.NETWORK_BYTES_UNKNOWN, JobInfo.NETWORK_BYTES_UNKNOWN, JobInfo.NETWORK_BYTES_UNKNOWN);
    }

    public JobWorkItem(Intent intent, long downloadBytes, long uploadBytes)
    {
        this(intent, downloadBytes, uploadBytes, JobInfo.NETWORK_BYTES_UNKNOWN);
    }

    public JobWorkItem(Intent intent, long downloadBytes, long uploadBytes, long minimumChunkBytes)
    {
        mIntent = intent;
        mNetworkDownloadBytes = downloadBytes;
        mNetworkUploadBytes = uploadBytes;
        mMinimumChunkBytes = minimumChunkBytes;
    }

    public Intent getIntent()
    {
        return mIntent;
    }

    public PersistableBundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    public long getEstimatedNetworkDownloadBytes()
    {
        return mNetworkDownloadBytes;
    }

    public long getEstimatedNetworkUploadBytes()
    {
        return mNetworkUploadBytes;
    }

    public long getMinimumNetworkChunkBytes()
    {
        return mMinimumChunkBytes;
    }

    public int getDeliveryCount()
    {
        return mDeliveryCount;
    }

    public void bumpDeliveryCount()
    {
        mDeliveryCount++;
    }

    public int getWorkId()
    {
        return mWorkId;
    }

    public void setWorkId(int workId)
    {
        mWorkId = workId;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "JobWorkItem{id=" + mWorkId + " intent=" + mIntent + " dcount=" + mDeliveryCount + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        if (mIntent == null)
        {
            destination.writeInt(0);
        }
        else
        {
            destination.writeInt(1);
            mIntent.writeToParcel(destination, flags);
        }
        destination.writeLong(mNetworkDownloadBytes);
        destination.writeLong(mNetworkUploadBytes);
        destination.writeLong(mMinimumChunkBytes);
        destination.writePersistableBundle(mExtras);
        destination.writeInt(mDeliveryCount);
        destination.writeInt(mWorkId);
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private Intent mIntent;
        private long mDownloadBytes = JobInfo.NETWORK_BYTES_UNKNOWN;
        private long mUploadBytes = JobInfo.NETWORK_BYTES_UNKNOWN;
        private long mMinimumChunkBytes = JobInfo.NETWORK_BYTES_UNKNOWN;
        private PersistableBundle mExtras = PersistableBundle.EMPTY;

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public Builder setIntent(Intent intent)
        {
            mIntent = intent;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setExtras(PersistableBundle extras)
        {
            if (extras == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("extras cannot be null");
            mExtras = extras;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setEstimatedNetworkBytes(long downloadBytes, long uploadBytes)
        {
            mDownloadBytes = downloadBytes;
            mUploadBytes = uploadBytes;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setMinimumNetworkChunkBytes(long chunkSizeBytes)
        {
            mMinimumChunkBytes = chunkSizeBytes;
            return this;
        }

        public JobWorkItem build()
        {
            JobWorkItem item = new JobWorkItem(mIntent, mDownloadBytes, mUploadBytes, mMinimumChunkBytes);
            item.mExtras = mExtras;
            return item;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.app.usage;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class EventStats implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<EventStats> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<EventStats>()
    {
        @Override
        public EventStats createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            EventStats stats = new EventStats();
            stats.mEventType = source.readInt();
            stats.mBeginTimeStamp = source.readLong();
            stats.mEndTimeStamp = source.readLong();
            stats.mLastEventTime = source.readLong();
            stats.mTotalTime = source.readLong();
            stats.mCount = source.readInt();
            return stats;
        }

        @Override
        public EventStats[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new EventStats[size];
        }
    };

    private int mEventType;
    private long mBeginTimeStamp;
    private long mEndTimeStamp;
    private long mLastEventTime;
    private long mTotalTime;
    private int mCount;

    EventStats()
    {
    }

    public EventStats(EventStats stats)
    {
        mEventType = stats.mEventType;
        mBeginTimeStamp = stats.mBeginTimeStamp;
        mEndTimeStamp = stats.mEndTimeStamp;
        mLastEventTime = stats.mLastEventTime;
        mTotalTime = stats.mTotalTime;
        mCount = stats.mCount;
    }

    public int getEventType()
    {
        return mEventType;
    }

    public long getFirstTimeStamp()
    {
        return mBeginTimeStamp;
    }

    public long getLastTimeStamp()
    {
        return mEndTimeStamp;
    }

    public long getLastEventTime()
    {
        return mLastEventTime;
    }

    public int getCount()
    {
        return mCount;
    }

    public long getTotalTime()
    {
        return mTotalTime;
    }

    public void add(EventStats right)
    {
        if (mEventType != right.mEventType)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Can't merge EventStats for event #" + mEventType + " with EventStats for event #"
                                               + right.mEventType);
        }

        if (right.mBeginTimeStamp > mBeginTimeStamp) mLastEventTime = Math.max(mLastEventTime, right.mLastEventTime);

        mBeginTimeStamp = Math.min(mBeginTimeStamp, right.mBeginTimeStamp);
        mEndTimeStamp = Math.max(mEndTimeStamp, right.mEndTimeStamp);
        mTotalTime += right.mTotalTime;
        mCount += right.mCount;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mEventType);
        dest.writeLong(mBeginTimeStamp);
        dest.writeLong(mEndTimeStamp);
        dest.writeLong(mLastEventTime);
        dest.writeLong(mTotalTime);
        dest.writeInt(mCount);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.app.usage;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.RemoteException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class NetworkStatsManager
{
    private final Context mContext;
    private final List<UsageCallback> mCallbacks = new ArrayList<>();

    public NetworkStatsManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public NetworkStats.Bucket querySummaryForDevice(int networkType, String subscriberId, long startTime, long endTime)
        throws SecurityException, RemoteException
    {
        return NetworkStats.Bucket.empty(NetworkStats.Bucket.UID_ALL, startTime, endTime);
    }

    public NetworkStats.Bucket querySummaryForUser(int networkType, String subscriberId, long startTime, long endTime)
        throws SecurityException, RemoteException
    {
        return NetworkStats.Bucket.empty(NetworkStats.Bucket.UID_ALL, startTime, endTime);
    }

    public NetworkStats querySummary(int networkType, String subscriberId, long startTime, long endTime)
        throws SecurityException, RemoteException
    {
        return new NetworkStats();
    }

    public NetworkStats queryDetailsForUid(int networkType, String subscriberId, long startTime, long endTime, int uid)
        throws SecurityException
    {
        return new NetworkStats();
    }

    public NetworkStats queryDetailsForUidTag(int networkType, String subscriberId, long startTime, long endTime, int uid, int tag)
        throws SecurityException
    {
        return new NetworkStats();
    }

    public NetworkStats queryDetailsForUidTagState(int networkType, String subscriberId, long startTime, long endTime, int uid, int tag,
                                                   int state) throws SecurityException
    {
        return new NetworkStats();
    }

    public NetworkStats queryDetails(int networkType, String subscriberId, long startTime, long endTime)
        throws SecurityException, RemoteException
    {
        return new NetworkStats();
    }

    public void registerUsageCallback(int networkType, String subscriberId, long thresholdBytes, UsageCallback callback)
    {
        registerUsageCallback(networkType, subscriberId, thresholdBytes, callback, null);
    }

    public void registerUsageCallback(int networkType, String subscriberId, long thresholdBytes, UsageCallback callback, Handler handler)
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new NullPointerException("UsageCallback cannot be null");

        synchronized (mCallbacks)
        {
            if (!mCallbacks.contains(callback)) mCallbacks.add(callback);
        }
    }

    public void unregisterUsageCallback(UsageCallback callback)
    {
        synchronized (mCallbacks)
        {
            mCallbacks.remove(callback);
        }
    }

    public abstract static class UsageCallback
    {
        public UsageCallback()
        {
        }

        public abstract void onThresholdReached(int networkType, String subscriberId);
    }
}
```

`java/android/app/usage/StorageStatsManager.java`:

```java
package android.app.usage;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.os.UserHandle;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.UUID;

public class StorageStatsManager
{
    private final Context mContext;

    public StorageStatsManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public long getTotalBytes(UUID storageUuid) throws IOException
    {
        return volume().getTotalSpace();
    }

    public long getFreeBytes(UUID storageUuid) throws IOException
    {
        return volume().getUsableSpace();
    }

    public StorageStats queryStatsForPackage(UUID storageUuid, String packageName, UserHandle user)
        throws IOException, PackageManager.NameNotFoundException
    {
        if (packageName == null || !packageName.equals(mContext.getPackageName())) throw new PackageManager.NameNotFoundException(packageName);

        return ownStats();
    }

    public StorageStats queryStatsForUid(UUID storageUuid, int uid) throws IOException
    {
        return ownStats();
    }

    public StorageStats queryStatsForUser(UUID storageUuid, UserHandle user) throws IOException
    {
        return ownStats();
    }

    public ExternalStorageStats queryExternalStatsForUser(UUID storageUuid, UserHandle user) throws IOException
    {
        File external = mContext.getExternalFilesDir(null);
        File externalRoot = external == null ? null : external.getParentFile();
        long total = sizeOf(externalRoot) + sizeOf(mContext.getExternalCacheDir());
        return new ExternalStorageStats(total, 0, 0, 0, total);
    }

    private File volume()
    {
        File data = mContext.getDataDir();
        return data == null ? new File("/") : data;
    }

    private StorageStats ownStats()
    {
        String codePath = mContext.getPackageCodePath();
        long appBytes = codePath == null ? 0 : new File(codePath).length();
        long cacheBytes = sizeOf(mContext.getCacheDir()) + sizeOf(mContext.getCodeCacheDir());
        long externalCacheBytes = sizeOf(mContext.getExternalCacheDir());
        long dataBytes = sizeOf(mContext.getDataDir());
        return new StorageStats(appBytes, dataBytes, cacheBytes, externalCacheBytes);
    }

    private static long sizeOf(File file)
    {
        if (file == null || !file.exists()) return 0;
        if (!file.isDirectory()) return file.length();

        File[] children = file.listFiles();
        if (children == null) return 0;

        long total = 0;
        for (File child : children)
        {
            if (java.nio.file.Files.isSymbolicLink(child.toPath())) continue;

            total += sizeOf(child);
        }

        return total;
    }
}
```
