```java
package android.content;

import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class ClipData implements Parcelable
{
    static final String[] MIMETYPES_TEXT_PLAIN = new String[] {ClipDescription.MIMETYPE_TEXT_PLAIN};
    static final String[] MIMETYPES_TEXT_HTML = new String[] {ClipDescription.MIMETYPE_TEXT_HTML};
    static final String[] MIMETYPES_TEXT_URILIST = new String[] {ClipDescription.MIMETYPE_TEXT_URILIST};
    static final String[] MIMETYPES_TEXT_INTENT = new String[] {ClipDescription.MIMETYPE_TEXT_INTENT};

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<ClipData> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ClipData>()
    {
        @Override
        public ClipData createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            ClipDescription description = ClipDescription.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            int count = source.readInt();
            ClipData clip = new ClipData(description, (Item)null);

            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                CharSequence text = source.readString();
                String htmlText = source.readString();
                Intent intent = (Intent)source.readValue(null);
                Uri uri = (Uri)source.readValue(null);
                clip.mItems.add(new Item(text, htmlText, intent, uri));
            }

            return clip;
        }

        @Override
        public ClipData[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ClipData[size];
        }
    };

    private final ClipDescription mDescription;
    private final List<Item> mItems = new ArrayList<>();

    public static class Item
    {
        private final CharSequence mText;
        private final String mHtmlText;
        private final Intent mIntent;
        private final Uri mUri;
        private android.view.textclassifier.TextLinks mTextLinks;

        public Item(CharSequence text)
        {
            this(text, null, null, null);
        }

        public Item(CharSequence text, String htmlText)
        {
            this(text, htmlText, null, null);
        }

        public Item(Intent intent)
        {
            this(null, null, intent, null);
        }

        public Item(Uri uri)
        {
            this(null, null, null, uri);
        }

        public Item(CharSequence text, Intent intent, Uri uri)
        {
            this(text, null, intent, uri);
        }

        public Item(CharSequence text, String htmlText, Intent intent, Uri uri)
        {
            if (htmlText != null && text == null)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Plain text must be supplied if HTML text is supplied");
            }

            mText = text;
            mHtmlText = htmlText;
            mIntent = intent;
            mUri = uri;
        }

        public CharSequence getText()
        {
            return mText;
        }

        public String getHtmlText()
        {
            return mHtmlText;
        }

        public Intent getIntent()
        {
            return mIntent;
        }

        public Uri getUri()
        {
            return mUri;
        }

        public android.view.textclassifier.TextLinks getTextLinks()
        {
            return mTextLinks;
        }

        public void setTextLinks(android.view.textclassifier.TextLinks textLinks)
        {
            mTextLinks = textLinks;
        }

        public CharSequence coerceToText(Context context)
        {
            if (mText != null) return mText;
            if (mUri != null) return readUriText(context);
            if (mIntent != null) return mIntent.toUri(Intent.URI_INTENT_SCHEME);

            return "";
        }

        public CharSequence coerceToStyledText(Context context)
        {
            return coerceToText(context);
        }

        public String coerceToHtmlText(Context context)
        {
            if (mHtmlText != null) return mHtmlText;

            CharSequence text = coerceToText(context);
            return text == null ? null : escapeHtml(text.toString());
        }

        private CharSequence readUriText(Context context)
        {
            if (context != null && ContentResolver.SCHEME_CONTENT.equals(mUri.getScheme()))
            {
                try (java.io.InputStream stream = context.getContentResolver().openInputStream(mUri))
                {
                    java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream contents = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
                    byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
                    int read;

                    while ((read = stream.read(buffer)) > 0) contents.write(buffer, 0, read);

                    return new String(contents.toByteArray(), java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                }
                catch (java.io.IOException | RuntimeException unreadable)
                {
                    android.util.Log.w("ClipData", "the clip uri " + mUri + " could not be read", unreadable);
                }
            }

            return mUri.toString();
        }

        private static String escapeHtml(String text)
        {
            StringBuilder escaped = new StringBuilder(text.length());

            for (int index = 0; index < text.length(); index++)
            {
                char character = text.charAt(index);

                if (character == '<') escaped.append("&lt;");
                else if (character == '>') escaped.append("&gt;");
                else if (character == '&') escaped.append("&amp;");
                else if (character == '\n') escaped.append("<br>");
                else escaped.append(character);
            }

            return escaped.toString();
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            StringBuilder described = new StringBuilder("ClipData.Item { ");
            if (mHtmlText != null) described.append("H:").append(mHtmlText);
            else if (mText != null) described.append("T:").append(mText);
            else if (mUri != null) described.append("U:").append(mUri);
            else if (mIntent != null) described.append("I:").append(mIntent.toShortString(true, true, true, true));
            else described.append("NULL");

            return described.append(" }").toString();
        }
    }

    public ClipData(CharSequence label, String[] mimeTypes, Item item)
    {
        mDescription = new ClipDescription(label, mimeTypes);
        if (item == null) throw new NullPointerException("item is null");

        mItems.add(item);
    }

    public ClipData(ClipDescription description, Item item)
    {
        mDescription = description;
        if (item != null) mItems.add(item);
    }

    public ClipData(ClipData other)
    {
        mDescription = other.mDescription;
        mItems.addAll(other.mItems);
    }

    public static ClipData newPlainText(CharSequence label, CharSequence text)
    {
        return new ClipData(label, MIMETYPES_TEXT_PLAIN, new Item(text));
    }

    public static ClipData newHtmlText(CharSequence label, CharSequence text, String htmlText)
    {
        return new ClipData(label, MIMETYPES_TEXT_HTML, new Item(text, htmlText));
    }

    public static ClipData newIntent(CharSequence label, Intent intent)
    {
        return new ClipData(label, MIMETYPES_TEXT_INTENT, new Item(intent));
    }

    public static ClipData newUri(ContentResolver resolver, CharSequence label, Uri uri)
    {
        Item item = new Item(uri);
        String[] mimeTypes = null;

        if (ContentResolver.SCHEME_CONTENT.equals(uri.getScheme()) && resolver != null)
        {
            String realType = resolver.getType(uri);
            String[] streamTypes = resolver.getStreamTypes(uri, "*/*");

            List<String> collected = new ArrayList<>();
            if (realType != null) collected.add(realType);

            if (streamTypes != null)
            {
                for (String streamType : streamTypes)
                {
                    if (!collected.contains(streamType)) collected.add(streamType);
                }
            }

            if (!collected.isEmpty()) mimeTypes = collected.toArray(new String[0]);
        }

        if (mimeTypes == null) mimeTypes = MIMETYPES_TEXT_URILIST;

        return new ClipData(label, mimeTypes, item);
    }

    public static ClipData newRawUri(CharSequence label, Uri uri)
    {
        return new ClipData(label, MIMETYPES_TEXT_URILIST, new Item(uri));
    }

    public ClipDescription getDescription()
    {
        return mDescription;
    }

    public CharSequence getLabel()
    {
        return mDescription == null ? null : mDescription.getLabel();
    }

    public void addItem(Item item)
    {
        if (item == null) throw new NullPointerException("item is null");

        mItems.add(item);
    }

    public void addItem(ContentResolver resolver, Item item)
    {
        addItem(item);
    }

    public int getItemCount()
    {
        return mItems.size();
    }

    public Item getItemAt(int index)
    {
        return mItems.get(index);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder described = new StringBuilder("ClipData { ");
        described.append(mDescription);

        for (Item item : mItems)
        {
            described.append(' ').append(item);
        }

        return described.append(" }").toString();
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        mDescription.writeToParcel(destination, flags);
        destination.writeInt(mItems.size());

        for (Item item : mItems)
        {
            destination.writeString(item.mText == null ? null : item.mText.toString());
            destination.writeString(item.mHtmlText);
            destination.writeValue(item.mIntent);
            destination.writeValue(item.mUri);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/content/ClipDescription.java`:

```java
package android.content;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.os.PersistableBundle;

import java.util.ArrayList;

public class ClipDescription implements Parcelable
{
    public static final String MIMETYPE_TEXT_PLAIN = "text/plain";
    public static final String MIMETYPE_TEXT_HTML = "text/html";
    public static final String MIMETYPE_TEXT_URILIST = "text/uri-list";
    public static final String MIMETYPE_TEXT_INTENT = "text/vnd.android.intent";
    public static final String MIMETYPE_UNKNOWN = "application/octet-stream";
    public static final String EXTRA_IS_SENSITIVE = "android.content.extra.IS_SENSITIVE";
    public static final String EXTRA_IS_REMOTE_DEVICE = "android.content.extra.IS_REMOTE_DEVICE";

    public static final int CLASSIFICATION_NOT_COMPLETE = 1;
    public static final int CLASSIFICATION_NOT_PERFORMED = 2;
    public static final int CLASSIFICATION_COMPLETE = 3;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<ClipDescription> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ClipDescription>()
    {
        @Override
        public ClipDescription createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            CharSequence label = source.readString();
            int count = source.readInt();
            String[] mimeTypes = new String[Math.max(count, 0)];

            for (int index = 0; index < mimeTypes.length; index++)
            {
                mimeTypes[index] = source.readString();
            }

            ClipDescription description = new ClipDescription(label, mimeTypes);
            description.mTimestamp = source.readLong();
            return description;
        }

        @Override
        public ClipDescription[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ClipDescription[size];
        }
    };

    private final CharSequence mLabel;
    private final String[] mMimeTypes;
    private PersistableBundle mExtras;
    private long mTimestamp;

    public ClipDescription(CharSequence label, String[] mimeTypes)
    {
        if (mimeTypes == null) throw new NullPointerException("mimeTypes is null");

        mLabel = label;
        mMimeTypes = mimeTypes;
        mTimestamp = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
    }

    public ClipDescription(ClipDescription other)
    {
        mLabel = other.mLabel;
        mMimeTypes = other.mMimeTypes.clone();
        mExtras = other.mExtras;
        mTimestamp = other.mTimestamp;
    }

    public static boolean compareMimeTypes(String concreteType, String desiredType)
    {
        int typeLength = desiredType.length();
        if (typeLength == 3 && desiredType.equals("*/*")) return true;

        int slashPosition = desiredType.indexOf('/');
        if (slashPosition > 0)
        {
            if (typeLength == slashPosition + 2 && desiredType.charAt(slashPosition + 1) == '*')
            {
                if (desiredType.regionMatches(0, concreteType, 0, slashPosition + 1)) return true;
            }
            else if (desiredType.equals(concreteType))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public long getTimestamp()
    {
        return mTimestamp;
    }

    public CharSequence getLabel()
    {
        return mLabel;
    }

    public boolean hasMimeType(String mimeType)
    {
        for (String candidate : mMimeTypes)
        {
            if (candidate != null && compareMimeTypes(candidate, mimeType)) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public String[] filterMimeTypes(String mimeType)
    {
        ArrayList<String> array = null;

        for (String candidate : mMimeTypes)
        {
            if (!compareMimeTypes(candidate, mimeType)) continue;

            if (array == null) array = new ArrayList<>();
            array.add(candidate);
        }

        return array == null ? null : array.toArray(new String[0]);
    }

    public int getMimeTypeCount()
    {
        return mMimeTypes.length;
    }

    public String getMimeType(int index)
    {
        return mMimeTypes[index];
    }

    public PersistableBundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    public void setExtras(PersistableBundle extras)
    {
        mExtras = extras == null ? null : new PersistableBundle(extras);
    }

    public boolean isStyledText()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public float getConfidenceScore(String entityType)
    {
        throw new IllegalStateException("getConfidenceScore() invoked before classification happened");
    }

    public int getClassificationStatus()
    {
        return CLASSIFICATION_NOT_PERFORMED;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder described = new StringBuilder("ClipDescription { ");
        for (int index = 0; index < mMimeTypes.length; index++)
        {
            if (index > 0) described.append(' ');
            described.append(mMimeTypes[index]);
        }

        if (mLabel != null) described.append(" \"").append(mLabel).append('"');
        return described.append(" }").toString();
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeString(mLabel == null ? null : mLabel.toString());
        destination.writeInt(mMimeTypes.length);

        for (String mimeType : mMimeTypes)
        {
            destination.writeString(mimeType);
        }

        destination.writeLong(mTimestamp);
    }
}
```

`java/android/content/ClipboardManager.java`:

```java
package android.content;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class ClipboardManager extends android.text.ClipboardManager
{
    private ClipData mPrimary;
    private final List<OnPrimaryClipChangedListener> mListeners = new ArrayList<>();

    public interface OnPrimaryClipChangedListener
    {
        void onPrimaryClipChanged();
    }

    public void setPrimaryClip(ClipData clip)
    {
        mPrimary = clip;

        for (OnPrimaryClipChangedListener listener : new ArrayList<>(mListeners)) listener.onPrimaryClipChanged();
    }

    public ClipData getPrimaryClip()
    {
        return mPrimary;
    }

    public boolean hasPrimaryClip()
    {
        return mPrimary != null;
    }

    public ClipDescription getPrimaryClipDescription()
    {
        return mPrimary == null ? null : mPrimary.getDescription();
    }

    public void clearPrimaryClip()
    {
        setPrimaryClip(null);
    }

    public CharSequence getText()
    {
        if (mPrimary == null || mPrimary.getItemCount() == 0) return null;

        return mPrimary.getItemAt(0).getText();
    }

    public void setText(CharSequence text)
    {
        setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("", text));
    }

    public boolean hasText()
    {
        CharSequence text = getText();
        return text != null && text.length() > 0;
    }

    public void addPrimaryClipChangedListener(OnPrimaryClipChangedListener listener)
    {
        if (listener != null && !mListeners.contains(listener)) mListeners.add(listener);
    }

    public void removePrimaryClipChangedListener(OnPrimaryClipChangedListener listener)
    {
        mListeners.remove(listener);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.content;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class ComponentName implements Parcelable, Cloneable, Comparable<ComponentName>
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<ComponentName> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ComponentName>()
    {
        @Override
        public ComponentName createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new ComponentName(source);
        }

        @Override
        public ComponentName[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ComponentName[size];
        }
    };

    private final String mPackage;
    private final String mClass;

    public ComponentName(String packageName, String className)
    {
        mPackage = packageName;
        mClass = className;
    }

    public ComponentName(Context context, String className)
    {
        mPackage = context == null ? "" : context.getPackageName();
        mClass = className;
    }

    public ComponentName(Context context, Class<?> subject)
    {
        mPackage = context == null ? "" : context.getPackageName();
        mClass = subject.getName();
    }

    public ComponentName(Parcel source)
    {
        String packageName = source.readString();
        String className = source.readString();

        mPackage = packageName == null ? "" : packageName;
        mClass = className == null ? "" : className;
    }

    public static ComponentName createRelative(String packageName, String className)
    {
        if (className == null || className.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("class name cannot be empty");

        String fullName = className.charAt(0) == '.' ? packageName + className : className;
        return new ComponentName(packageName, fullName);
    }

    public static ComponentName createRelative(Context packageContext, String className)
    {
        return createRelative(packageContext.getPackageName(), className);
    }

    @Override
    public ComponentName clone()
    {
        return new ComponentName(mPackage, mClass);
    }

    public String getPackageName()
    {
        return mPackage;
    }

    public String getClassName()
    {
        return mClass;
    }

    public String getShortClassName()
    {
        if (mClass == null || mPackage == null) return mClass;
        if (!mClass.startsWith(mPackage)) return mClass;

        int at = mPackage.length();
        if (at < mClass.length() && mClass.charAt(at) == '.') return mClass.substring(at);

        return mClass;
    }

    public String flattenToString()
    {
        return mPackage + "/" + mClass;
    }

    public String flattenToShortString()
    {
        return mPackage + "/" + getShortClassName();
    }

    public static ComponentName unflattenFromString(String text)
    {
        if (text == null) return null;

        int separator = text.indexOf('/');
        if (separator < 0 || separator + 1 >= text.length()) return null;

        String packageName = text.substring(0, separator);
        String className = text.substring(separator + 1);
        if (className.length() > 0 && className.charAt(0) == '.') className = packageName + className;

        return new ComponentName(packageName, className);
    }

    public String toShortString()
    {
        return "{" + mPackage + "/" + mClass + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "ComponentInfo{" + mPackage + "/" + mClass + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof ComponentName)) return false;

        ComponentName compared = (ComponentName)other;
        return java.util.Objects.equals(mPackage, compared.mPackage) && java.util.Objects.equals(mClass, compared.mClass);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return (mPackage == null ? 0 : mPackage.hashCode()) + (mClass == null ? 0 : mClass.hashCode());
    }

    @Override
    public int compareTo(ComponentName other)
    {
        int compared = String.valueOf(mPackage).compareTo(String.valueOf(other.mPackage));
        if (compared != 0) return compared;

        return String.valueOf(mClass).compareTo(String.valueOf(other.mClass));
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeString(mPackage);
        destination.writeString(mClass);
    }

    public static void writeToParcel(ComponentName component, Parcel destination)
    {
        if (component != null)
        {
            component.writeToParcel(destination, 0);
            return;
        }

        destination.writeString(null);
    }

    public static ComponentName readFromParcel(Parcel source)
    {
        String packageName = source.readString();
        if (packageName == null) return null;

        String className = source.readString();
        return new ComponentName(packageName, className == null ? "" : className);
    }
}
```

```java
    protected final ParcelFileDescriptor openFileHelper(Uri uri, String mode) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        Cursor cursor = query(uri, new String[] {"_data"}, null, null, null);
        int count = cursor != null ? cursor.getCount() : 0;

        if (count != 1)
        {
            if (cursor != null) cursor.close();
            if (count == 0) throw new FileNotFoundException("No entry for " + uri);
            throw new FileNotFoundException("Multiple items at " + uri);
        }

        cursor.moveToFirst();
        int column = cursor.getColumnIndex("_data");
        String path = column >= 0 ? cursor.getString(column) : null;
        cursor.close();

        if (path == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("Column _data not found.");

        return ParcelFileDescriptor.open(new File(path), ParcelFileDescriptor.parseMode(mode));
    }

    public <T> ParcelFileDescriptor openPipeHelper(Uri uri, String mimeType, Bundle opts, T args, PipeDataWriter<T> func)
        throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        try
        {
            ParcelFileDescriptor[] pipe = ParcelFileDescriptor.createPipe();
            Thread writer = new Thread(() ->
            {
                func.writeDataToPipe(pipe[1], uri, mimeType, opts, args);

                try
                {
                    pipe[1].close();
                }
                catch (java.io.IOException ignored)
                {
                }
            }, "ContentProvider pipe");

            writer.start();
            return pipe[0];
        }
        catch (java.io.IOException failure)
        {
            throw new FileNotFoundException("failure making pipe");
        }
    }

    public int bulkInsert(Uri uri, ContentValues[] values)
    {
        if (values == null) return 0;

        int inserted = 0;
        for (ContentValues value : values)
        {
            if (insert(uri, value) != null) inserted++;
        }

        return inserted;
    }

    public ContentProviderResult[] applyBatch(ArrayList<ContentProviderOperation> operations) throws OperationApplicationException
    {
        int count = operations.size();
        ContentProviderResult[] results = new ContentProviderResult[count];

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            results[index] = operations.get(index).apply(this, results, index);

        return results;
    }

        throws OperationApplicationException

        return applyBatch(operations);
    }

        return null;

        return call(method, arg, extras);
    }
```

`java/android/content/ContentProviderOperation.java`:

```java
package android.content;

import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;

public class ContentProviderOperation implements Parcelable
{
    static final int TYPE_INSERT = 1;
    static final int TYPE_UPDATE = 2;
    static final int TYPE_DELETE = 3;
    static final int TYPE_ASSERT = 4;
    static final int TYPE_CALL = 5;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<ContentProviderOperation> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ContentProviderOperation>()
    {
        @Override
        public ContentProviderOperation createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return (ContentProviderOperation)source.readValue(null);
        }

        @Override
        public ContentProviderOperation[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ContentProviderOperation[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mType;
    private final Uri mUri;
    private final String mMethod;
    private final String mArg;
    private final Map<String, Object> mValues;
    private final Map<String, Object> mExtras;
    private final String mSelection;
    private final Object[] mSelectionArgs;
    private final Integer mExpectedCount;
    private final boolean mYieldAllowed;
    private final boolean mExceptionAllowed;

    private ContentProviderOperation(Builder builder)
    {
        mType = builder.mType;
        mUri = builder.mUri;
        mMethod = builder.mMethod;
        mArg = builder.mArg;
        mValues = builder.mValues;
        mExtras = builder.mExtras;
        mSelection = builder.mSelection;
        mSelectionArgs = builder.mSelectionArgs;
        mExpectedCount = builder.mExpectedCount;
        mYieldAllowed = builder.mYieldAllowed;
        mExceptionAllowed = builder.mExceptionAllowed;
    }

    public static Builder newInsert(Uri uri)
    {
        return new Builder(TYPE_INSERT, uri);
    }

    public static Builder newUpdate(Uri uri)
    {
        return new Builder(TYPE_UPDATE, uri);
    }

    public static Builder newDelete(Uri uri)
    {
        return new Builder(TYPE_DELETE, uri);
    }

    public static Builder newAssertQuery(Uri uri)
    {
        return new Builder(TYPE_ASSERT, uri);
    }

    public static Builder newCall(Uri uri, String method, String arg)
    {
        return new Builder(TYPE_CALL, uri, method, arg);
    }

    public Uri getUri()
    {
        return mUri;
    }

    public boolean isYieldAllowed()
    {
        return mYieldAllowed;
    }

    public boolean isExceptionAllowed()
    {
        return mExceptionAllowed;
    }

    public boolean isInsert()
    {
        return mType == TYPE_INSERT;
    }

    public boolean isDelete()
    {
        return mType == TYPE_DELETE;
    }

    public boolean isUpdate()
    {
        return mType == TYPE_UPDATE;
    }

    public boolean isAssertQuery()
    {
        return mType == TYPE_ASSERT;
    }

    public boolean isCall()
    {
        return mType == TYPE_CALL;
    }

    public boolean isWriteOperation()
    {
        return mType == TYPE_DELETE || mType == TYPE_INSERT || mType == TYPE_UPDATE;
    }

    public boolean isReadOperation()
    {
        return mType == TYPE_ASSERT;
    }

    public ContentProviderResult apply(ContentProvider provider, ContentProviderResult[] backRefs, int numBackRefs)
        throws OperationApplicationException
    {
        if (!mExceptionAllowed) return applyInternal(provider, backRefs, numBackRefs);

        try
        {
            return applyInternal(provider, backRefs, numBackRefs);
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            return new ContentProviderResult(failure);
        }
    }

    private ContentProviderResult applyInternal(ContentProvider provider, ContentProviderResult[] backRefs, int numBackRefs)
        throws OperationApplicationException
    {
        ContentValues values = resolveValueBackReferences(backRefs, numBackRefs);
        Bundle extras = resolveExtrasBackReferences(backRefs, numBackRefs);
        String[] selectionArgs = resolveSelectionArgsBackReferences(backRefs, numBackRefs);

        if (mType == TYPE_INSERT)
        {
            Uri newUri = provider.insert(mUri, values);
            if (newUri == null) throw new OperationApplicationException("Insert into " + mUri + " returned no result");

            return new ContentProviderResult(newUri);
        }

        if (mType == TYPE_CALL) return new ContentProviderResult(provider.call(mMethod, mArg, extras));

        int numRows;

        if (mType == TYPE_DELETE)
        {
            numRows = provider.delete(mUri, mSelection, selectionArgs);
        }
        else if (mType == TYPE_UPDATE)
        {
            numRows = provider.update(mUri, values, mSelection, selectionArgs);
        }
        else if (mType == TYPE_ASSERT)
        {
            String[] projection = null;
            if (values != null && values.size() > 0) projection = values.keySet().toArray(new String[0]);

            Cursor cursor = provider.query(mUri, projection, mSelection, selectionArgs, null);
            if (cursor == null) throw new OperationApplicationException("Query on " + mUri + " returned no cursor");

            try
            {
                numRows = cursor.getCount();
                if (projection != null)
                {
                    while (cursor.moveToNext())
                    {
                        for (int index = 0; index < projection.length; index++)
                        {
                            String cursorValue = cursor.getString(index);
                            String expectedValue = values.getAsString(projection[index]);
                            if (!Objects.equals(cursorValue, expectedValue))
                            {
                                throw new OperationApplicationException("Found value " + cursorValue + " when expected " + expectedValue
                                                                        + " for column " + projection[index]);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                cursor.close();
            }
        }
        else
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("bad type, " + mType);
        }

        if (mExpectedCount != null && mExpectedCount != numRows)
        {
            throw new OperationApplicationException("Expected " + mExpectedCount + " rows but actual " + numRows);
        }

        return new ContentProviderResult(numRows);
    }

    public ContentValues resolveValueBackReferences(ContentProviderResult[] backRefs, int numBackRefs)
    {
        if (mValues == null) return null;

        ContentValues values = new ContentValues();
        for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : mValues.entrySet())
        {
            Object value = entry.getValue();
            if (value instanceof BackReference) value = ((BackReference)value).resolve(backRefs, numBackRefs);
            values.putObject(entry.getKey(), value);
        }

        return values;
    }

    public Bundle resolveExtrasBackReferences(ContentProviderResult[] backRefs, int numBackRefs)
    {
        if (mExtras == null) return null;

        Bundle extras = new Bundle();
        for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : mExtras.entrySet())
        {
            Object value = entry.getValue();
            if (value instanceof BackReference) value = ((BackReference)value).resolve(backRefs, numBackRefs);
            putBundleValue(extras, entry.getKey(), value);
        }

        return extras;
    }

    public String[] resolveSelectionArgsBackReferences(ContentProviderResult[] backRefs, int numBackRefs)
    {
        if (mSelectionArgs == null) return null;

        String[] selectionArgs = new String[mSelectionArgs.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < mSelectionArgs.length; index++)
        {
            Object value = mSelectionArgs[index];
            if (value instanceof BackReference) value = ((BackReference)value).resolve(backRefs, numBackRefs);
            selectionArgs[index] = value == null ? null : String.valueOf(value);
        }

        return selectionArgs;
    }

    private static void putBundleValue(Bundle bundle, String key, Object value)
    {
        if (value == null) bundle.putString(key, null);
        else if (value instanceof String) bundle.putString(key, (String)value);
        else if (value instanceof Integer) bundle.putInt(key, (Integer)value);
        else if (value instanceof Long) bundle.putLong(key, (Long)value);
        else if (value instanceof Boolean) bundle.putBoolean(key, (Boolean)value);
        else if (value instanceof Double) bundle.putDouble(key, (Double)value);
        else if (value instanceof Float) bundle.putFloat(key, (Float)value);
        else if (value instanceof byte[]) bundle.putByteArray(key, (byte[])value);
        else if (value instanceof Bundle) bundle.putBundle(key, (Bundle)value);
        else if (value instanceof Parcelable) bundle.putParcelable(key, (Parcelable)value);
        else if (value instanceof CharSequence) bundle.putCharSequence(key, (CharSequence)value);
        else if (value instanceof java.io.Serializable) bundle.putSerializable(key, (java.io.Serializable)value);
        else throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported type " + value.getClass());
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder described = new StringBuilder("ContentProviderOperation(");
        described.append("type=").append(mType).append(' ');
        if (mUri != null) described.append("uri=").append(mUri).append(' ');
        if (mValues != null) described.append("values=").append(mValues).append(' ');
        if (mSelection != null) described.append("selection=").append(mSelection).append(' ');
        if (mExpectedCount != null) described.append("expectedCount=").append(mExpectedCount).append(' ');
        if (mYieldAllowed) described.append("yieldAllowed ");
        if (mExceptionAllowed) described.append("exceptionAllowed ");

        described.setLength(described.length() - 1);
        return described.append(')').toString();
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeValue(this);
    }

    static final class BackReference
    {
        private final int mFromIndex;
        private final String mFromKey;

        BackReference(int fromIndex, String fromKey)
        {
            mFromIndex = fromIndex;
            mFromKey = fromKey;
        }

        Object resolve(ContentProviderResult[] backRefs, int numBackRefs)
        {
            if (mFromIndex >= numBackRefs)
            {
                throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException("asked for back ref " + mFromIndex + " but there are only " + numBackRefs
                                                         + " back refs");
            }

            ContentProviderResult backRef = backRefs[mFromIndex];
            if (backRef.extras != null) return backRef.extras.get(mFromKey);
            if (backRef.uri != null) return ContentUris.parseId(backRef.uri);

            return (long)backRef.count;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "BackReference(" + mFromIndex + (mFromKey == null ? "" : ", " + mFromKey) + ")";
        }
    }

    public static class Builder
    {
        private final int mType;
        private final Uri mUri;
        private final String mMethod;
        private final String mArg;
        private Map<String, Object> mValues;
        private Map<String, Object> mExtras;
        private String mSelection;
        private Object[] mSelectionArgs;
        private Integer mExpectedCount;
        private boolean mYieldAllowed;
        private boolean mExceptionAllowed;

        private Builder(int type, Uri uri)
        {
            this(type, uri, null, null);
        }

        private Builder(int type, Uri uri, String method, String arg)
        {
            mType = type;
            mUri = Objects.requireNonNull(uri);
            mMethod = method;
            mArg = arg;
        }

        public ContentProviderOperation build()
        {
            if (mType == TYPE_UPDATE && (mValues == null || mValues.isEmpty()))
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Empty values");
            }

            if (mType == TYPE_ASSERT && (mValues == null || mValues.isEmpty()) && mExpectedCount == null)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Empty values");
            }

            return new ContentProviderOperation(this);
        }

        private void ensureValues()
        {
            if (mType != TYPE_INSERT && mType != TYPE_UPDATE && mType != TYPE_ASSERT)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("only inserts, updates, and asserts can have values");
            }

            if (mValues == null) mValues = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        }

        private void ensureExtras()
        {
            if (mExtras == null) mExtras = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        }

        public Builder withValues(ContentValues values)
        {
            ensureValues();
            for (String key : values.keySet())
            {
                mValues.put(key, values.get(key));
            }

            return this;
        }

        public Builder withValue(String key, Object value)
        {
            ensureValues();
            mValues.put(key, value);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder withValueBackReferences(ContentValues backReferences)
        {
            ensureValues();
            for (String key : backReferences.keySet())
            {
                mValues.put(key, new BackReference(backReferences.getAsInteger(key), null));
            }

            return this;
        }

        public Builder withValueBackReference(String key, int previousResult)
        {
            return withValueBackReference(key, previousResult, null);
        }

        public Builder withValueBackReference(String key, int fromIndex, String fromKey)
        {
            ensureValues();
            mValues.put(key, new BackReference(fromIndex, fromKey));
            return this;
        }

        public Builder withExtras(Bundle extras)
        {
            ensureExtras();
            for (String key : extras.keySet())
            {
                mExtras.put(key, extras.get(key));
            }

            return this;
        }

        public Builder withExtra(String key, Object value)
        {
            ensureExtras();
            mExtras.put(key, value);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder withExtraBackReference(String key, int previousResult)
        {
            return withExtraBackReference(key, previousResult, null);
        }

        public Builder withExtraBackReference(String key, int fromIndex, String fromKey)
        {
            ensureExtras();
            mExtras.put(key, new BackReference(fromIndex, fromKey));
            return this;
        }

        public Builder withSelection(String selection, String[] selectionArgs)
        {
            if (mType != TYPE_UPDATE && mType != TYPE_DELETE && mType != TYPE_ASSERT)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("only updates, deletes, and asserts can have selections");
            }

            mSelection = selection;
            mSelectionArgs = selectionArgs == null ? null : selectionArgs.clone();
            return this;
        }

        public Builder withSelectionBackReference(int index, int previousResult)
        {
            return withSelectionBackReference(index, previousResult, null);
        }

        public Builder withSelectionBackReference(int index, int fromIndex, String fromKey)
        {
            if (mType != TYPE_UPDATE && mType != TYPE_DELETE && mType != TYPE_ASSERT)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("only updates, deletes, and asserts can have selection back-references");
            }

            if (mSelectionArgs == null) mSelectionArgs = new Object[index + 1];
            if (mSelectionArgs.length <= index) mSelectionArgs = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(mSelectionArgs, index + 1);

            mSelectionArgs[index] = new BackReference(fromIndex, fromKey);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder withExpectedCount(int count)
        {
            if (mType != TYPE_UPDATE && mType != TYPE_DELETE && mType != TYPE_ASSERT)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("only updates, deletes, and asserts can have expected counts");
            }

            mExpectedCount = count;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder withYieldAllowed(boolean yieldAllowed)
        {
            mYieldAllowed = yieldAllowed;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder withExceptionAllowed(boolean exceptionAllowed)
        {
            mExceptionAllowed = exceptionAllowed;
            return this;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.content;

import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public class ContentProviderResult implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<ContentProviderResult> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ContentProviderResult>()
    {
        @Override
        public ContentProviderResult createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new ContentProviderResult(source);
        }

        @Override
        public ContentProviderResult[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ContentProviderResult[size];
        }
    };

    public final Uri uri;
    public final Integer count;
    public final Bundle extras;
    public final Throwable exception;

    public ContentProviderResult(Uri uri)
    {
        this(uri, null, null, null);
    }

    public ContentProviderResult(int count)
    {
        this(null, count, null, null);
    }

    public ContentProviderResult(Bundle extras)
    {
        this(null, null, extras, null);
    }

    public ContentProviderResult(Throwable exception)
    {
        this(null, null, null, exception);
    }

    public ContentProviderResult(Parcel source)
    {
        uri = (Uri)source.readValue(null);
        count = (Integer)source.readValue(null);
        extras = source.readBundle();
        exception = (Throwable)source.readValue(null);
    }

    private ContentProviderResult(Uri uri, Integer count, Bundle extras, Throwable exception)
    {
        this.uri = uri;
        this.count = count;
        this.extras = extras;
        this.exception = exception;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeValue(uri);
        destination.writeValue(count);
        destination.writeBundle(extras);
        destination.writeValue(exception);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder described = new StringBuilder("ContentProviderResult(");
        if (uri != null) described.append("uri=").append(uri).append(' ');
        if (count != null) described.append("count=").append(count).append(' ');
        if (extras != null) described.append("extras=").append(extras).append(' ');
        if (exception != null) described.append("exception=").append(exception).append(' ');

        if (described.charAt(described.length() - 1) == ' ') described.setLength(described.length() - 1);
        return described.append(')').toString();
    }
}
```

```java
    private static final String TAG = "ContentResolver";

    private static final Map<String, ContentProvider> sProviders = new HashMap<>();

    public static void addProvider(String authority, ContentProvider provider)
    {
        if (authority == null || provider == null) return;

        synchronized (sProviders)
        {
            for (String single : authority.split(";"))
            {
                String trimmed = single.trim();
                if (!trimmed.isEmpty()) sProviders.put(trimmed, provider);
            }
        }
    }

    public static ContentProvider findProvider(String authority)
    {
        if (authority == null) return null;

        synchronized (sProviders)
        {
            return sProviders.get(authority);
        }
    }

    private ContentProvider providerFor(Uri uri)
    {
        if (mWrappedProvider != null) return mWrappedProvider;

        return uri == null ? null : findProvider(uri.getAuthority());
    }

    private ContentProvider providerForAuthority(String authority)
    {
        if (mWrappedProvider != null) return mWrappedProvider;

        return findProvider(authority);
    }

    public final void registerContentObserver(Uri uri, boolean notifyForDescendants, ContentObserver observer)
    {
        if (observer == null) throw new NullPointerException("observer");

        synchronized (sObservers)
        {
            sObservers.add(new Registration(uri == null ? "" : uri.toString(), notifyForDescendants, observer));
        }
    }

    public final void unregisterContentObserver(ContentObserver observer)
    {
        if (observer == null) throw new NullPointerException("observer");

        synchronized (sObservers)
        {
            for (int index = sObservers.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
            {
                if (sObservers.get(index).observer == observer) sObservers.remove(index);
            }
        }
    }

    public final String getType(Uri uri)
    {
        ContentProvider provider = providerFor(uri);
        return provider == null ? null : provider.getType(uri);

    public final java.io.InputStream openInputStream(Uri uri) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        if (uri == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("no uri");

        String scheme = uri.getScheme();

        if (SCHEME_ANDROID_RESOURCE.equals(scheme))
        {
            try
            {
                return mContext.getResources().openRawResource(resourceIdFor(uri));
            }
            catch (android.content.res.Resources.NotFoundException missing)
            {
                throw new FileNotFoundException("Resource does not exist: " + uri);
            }
        }

        if (SCHEME_FILE.equals(scheme)) return new java.io.FileInputStream(uri.getPath());

        AssetFileDescriptor descriptor = openAssetFileDescriptor(uri, "r", null);
        if (descriptor == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("the provider returned nothing for " + uri);

        try
        {
            return descriptor.createInputStream();
        }
        catch (java.io.IOException unreadable)
        {
            throw new FileNotFoundException("Unable to create stream for " + uri);
        }
    }

    private int resourceIdFor(Uri uri) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        List<String> path = uri.getPathSegments();
        String authority = uri.getAuthority();

        if (path.size() == 1)
        {
            try
            {
                return Integer.parseInt(path.get(0));
            }
            catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
            {
                throw new FileNotFoundException("Single path segment is not a resource ID: " + uri);
            }
        }

        if (path.size() == 2)
        {
            int resourceId = mContext.getResources().getIdentifier(path.get(1), path.get(0), authority);
            if (resourceId == 0) throw new FileNotFoundException("No resource found for: " + uri);

            return resourceId;
        }

        throw new FileNotFoundException("More than two path segments: " + uri);
    }

    public final java.io.OutputStream openOutputStream(Uri uri) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        return openOutputStream(uri, "w");
    }

    public final java.io.OutputStream openOutputStream(Uri uri, String mode) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        if (uri == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("no uri");

        if (SCHEME_FILE.equals(uri.getScheme()))
        {
            return new java.io.FileOutputStream(uri.getPath(), mode != null && mode.contains("a"));
        }

        AssetFileDescriptor descriptor = openAssetFileDescriptor(uri, mode, null);
        if (descriptor == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("the provider returned nothing for " + uri);

        try
        {
            return descriptor.createOutputStream();
        }
        catch (java.io.IOException unwritable)
        {
            throw new FileNotFoundException("Unable to create stream for " + uri);
        }
    }

    public final ParcelFileDescriptor openFileDescriptor(Uri uri, String mode, CancellationSignal cancellationSignal)
        throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        AssetFileDescriptor descriptor = openAssetFileDescriptor(uri, mode, cancellationSignal);
        if (descriptor == null) return null;

        if (descriptor.getDeclaredLength() >= 0 || descriptor.getStartOffset() != 0)
        {
            throw new FileNotFoundException("Not a whole file");
        }

        return descriptor.getParcelFileDescriptor();
    }

    public final AssetFileDescriptor openAssetFile(Uri uri, String mode, CancellationSignal signal) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        return openAssetFileDescriptor(uri, mode, signal);
    }

    public final AssetFileDescriptor openAssetFileDescriptor(Uri uri, String mode) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        return openAssetFileDescriptor(uri, mode, null);
    }

    public final AssetFileDescriptor openAssetFileDescriptor(Uri uri, String mode, CancellationSignal cancellationSignal)
        throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        if (uri == null) throw new NullPointerException("uri");
        if (mode == null) throw new NullPointerException("mode");

        String scheme = uri.getScheme();

        if (SCHEME_ANDROID_RESOURCE.equals(scheme))
        {
            if (!"r".equals(mode)) throw new FileNotFoundException("Can't write resources: " + uri);

            try
            {
                return mContext.getResources().openRawResourceFd(resourceIdFor(uri));
            }
            catch (android.content.res.Resources.NotFoundException missing)
            {
                throw new FileNotFoundException("Resource does not exist: " + uri);
            }
        }

        if (SCHEME_FILE.equals(scheme))
        {
            ParcelFileDescriptor descriptor = ParcelFileDescriptor.open(new File(uri.getPath()), ParcelFileDescriptor.parseMode(mode));
            return new AssetFileDescriptor(descriptor, 0, AssetFileDescriptor.UNKNOWN_LENGTH);
        }

        ContentProvider provider = providerFor(uri);
        if (provider == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("No content provider: " + uri);

        return ProviderCalls.openAssetFile(provider, uri, mode, cancellationSignal);
    }

    public final AssetFileDescriptor openTypedAssetFile(Uri uri, String mimeTypeFilter, Bundle options, CancellationSignal signal)
        throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        return openTypedAssetFileDescriptor(uri, mimeTypeFilter, options, signal);
    }

    public final AssetFileDescriptor openTypedAssetFileDescriptor(Uri uri, String mimeType, Bundle options) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        return openTypedAssetFileDescriptor(uri, mimeType, options, null);
    }

    public final AssetFileDescriptor openTypedAssetFileDescriptor(Uri uri, String mimeType, Bundle options,
                                                                  CancellationSignal cancellationSignal) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        if (uri == null) throw new NullPointerException("uri");
        if (mimeType == null) throw new NullPointerException("mimeType");

        ContentProvider provider = providerFor(uri);
        if (provider == null)
        {
            if (SCHEME_FILE.equals(uri.getScheme()) || SCHEME_ANDROID_RESOURCE.equals(uri.getScheme()))
            {
                return openAssetFileDescriptor(uri, "r", cancellationSignal);
            }

            throw new FileNotFoundException("No content provider: " + uri);
        }

        return ProviderCalls.openTypedAssetFile(provider, uri, mimeType, options, cancellationSignal);
    }

    public final Uri insert(Uri uri, ContentValues values)
    {
        return insert(uri, values, null);
    }

    public final Uri insert(Uri uri, ContentValues values, Bundle extras)
    {
        ContentProvider provider = providerFor(uri);
        if (provider == null) return missingProvider(uri, null);

        Uri inserted = ProviderCalls.insert(provider, uri, values, extras);
        if (inserted != null) notifyChange(inserted, null, NOTIFY_INSERT);

        return inserted;
    }

    public ContentProviderResult[] applyBatch(String authority, ArrayList<ContentProviderOperation> operations)
        throws OperationApplicationException, android.os.RemoteException
    {
        if (authority == null) throw new NullPointerException("authority");
        if (operations == null) throw new NullPointerException("operations");

        ContentProvider provider = providerForAuthority(authority);
        if (provider == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown authority " + authority);

        return ProviderCalls.applyBatch(provider, authority, operations);
    }

    public final int bulkInsert(Uri uri, ContentValues[] values)
    {
        ContentProvider provider = providerFor(uri);
        if (provider == null) return missingProvider(uri, 0);

        int inserted = provider.bulkInsert(uri, values);
        if (inserted != 0) notifyChange(uri, null, NOTIFY_INSERT);

        return inserted;
    }

    public final int delete(Uri uri, String selection, String[] selectionArgs)
    {
        ContentProvider provider = providerFor(uri);
        if (provider == null) return missingProvider(uri, 0);

        int removed = provider.delete(uri, selection, selectionArgs);
        if (removed != 0) notifyChange(uri, null, NOTIFY_DELETE);

        return removed;
    }

    public final int delete(Uri uri, Bundle extras)
    {
        ContentProvider provider = providerFor(uri);
        if (provider == null) return missingProvider(uri, 0);

        int removed = ProviderCalls.delete(provider, uri, extras);
        if (removed != 0) notifyChange(uri, null, NOTIFY_DELETE);

        return removed;
    }

    public final int update(Uri uri, ContentValues values, String selection, String[] selectionArgs)
    {
        ContentProvider provider = providerFor(uri);
        if (provider == null) return missingProvider(uri, 0);

        int changed = provider.update(uri, values, selection, selectionArgs);
        if (changed != 0) notifyChange(uri, null, NOTIFY_UPDATE);

        return changed;
    }

    public final int update(Uri uri, ContentValues values, Bundle extras)
    {
        ContentProvider provider = providerFor(uri);
        if (provider == null) return missingProvider(uri, 0);

        int changed = ProviderCalls.update(provider, uri, values, extras);
        if (changed != 0) notifyChange(uri, null, NOTIFY_UPDATE);

        return changed;
    }

    public final Bundle call(Uri uri, String method, String argument, Bundle extras)
    {
        if (uri == null) throw new NullPointerException("uri");

        return call(uri.getAuthority(), method, argument, extras);
    }

    public final Bundle call(String authority, String method, String argument, Bundle extras)
    {
        if (authority == null) throw new NullPointerException("authority");
        if (method == null) throw new NullPointerException("method");

        ContentProvider provider = providerForAuthority(authority);
        if (provider == null) return missingProvider(authority, null);

        return ProviderCalls.call(provider, authority, method, argument, extras);
    }

    private static <T> T missingProvider(Object target, T fallback)
    {
        android.util.Log.w(TAG, "no content provider is installed for " + target);
        return fallback;
    }

    public final ContentProviderClient acquireContentProviderClient(Uri uri)
    {
        ContentProvider provider = providerFor(uri);
        return provider == null ? null : new ContentProviderClient(this, provider, uri.getAuthority(), true);
    }

    public final ContentProviderClient acquireContentProviderClient(String name)
    {
        ContentProvider provider = providerForAuthority(name);
        return provider == null ? null : new ContentProviderClient(this, provider, name, true);
    }

    public final ContentProviderClient acquireUnstableContentProviderClient(Uri uri)
    {
        ContentProvider provider = providerFor(uri);
        return provider == null ? null : new ContentProviderClient(this, provider, uri.getAuthority(), false);
    }

    public final ContentProviderClient acquireUnstableContentProviderClient(String name)
    {
        ContentProvider provider = providerForAuthority(name);
        return provider == null ? null : new ContentProviderClient(this, provider, name, false);
    }

    public void notifyChange(Uri uri, ContentObserver observer)
    {
        notifyChange(uri, observer, 0);
    }

    public void notifyChange(Uri uri, ContentObserver observer, boolean syncToNetwork)
    {
        notifyChange(uri, observer, syncToNetwork ? NOTIFY_SYNC_TO_NETWORK : 0);
    }

    public void notifyChange(Uri uri, ContentObserver observer, int flags)
    {
        dispatchChange(uri, observer, flags);
    }

    public void notifyChange(Collection<Uri> uris, ContentObserver observer, int flags)
    {
        for (Uri uri : uris)
        {
            dispatchChange(uri, observer, flags);
        }
    }

    public static void dispatchChange(Uri uri, ContentObserver from, int flags)
    {
        String changed = uri == null ? "" : uri.toString();

        List<Registration> matched = new ArrayList<>();
        synchronized (sObservers)
        {
            for (Registration registration : sObservers)
            {
                if (registration.matches(changed)) matched.add(registration);
            }
        }

        for (Registration registration : matched)
        {
            boolean self = registration.observer == from;
            if (self && !registration.observer.deliverSelfNotifications()) continue;

            registration.observer.dispatchChange(self, uri, flags);
        }
    }

    public void takePersistableUriPermission(Uri uri, int modeFlags)
    {
        android.util.Log.i(TAG, "persisting the uri permission for " + uri + " has no effect in a single-app sandbox");
    }

    {
    }

    }

    }

        validateSyncExtrasBundle(extras);
    }

    }

    }

    {
    }

    {
        return new Object();
    }

    public static void removeStatusChangeListener(Object handle)
    {
    }

    public static void validateSyncExtrasBundle(Bundle extras)
    {
        if (extras == null) return;

        for (String key : extras.keySet())
        {
            Object value = extras.get(key);
            if (value == null || value instanceof Long || value instanceof Integer || value instanceof Boolean || value instanceof Float
                || value instanceof Double || value instanceof String || value instanceof Byte || value instanceof Short
                || value instanceof Character)
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (value.getClass().getName().equals("android.accounts.Account")) continue;

            throw new IllegalArgumentException("unexpected value type: " + value.getClass().getName());
        }
    }

    public android.graphics.Bitmap loadThumbnail(Uri uri, android.util.Size size, CancellationSignal signal) throws java.io.IOException
    {
        if (uri == null) throw new NullPointerException("uri");
        if (size == null) throw new NullPointerException("size");

        AssetFileDescriptor descriptor = openTypedAssetFileDescriptor(uri, "image/*", null, signal);
        if (descriptor == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("no thumbnail for " + uri);

        android.graphics.Bitmap decoded;
        try (java.io.InputStream stream = descriptor.createInputStream())
        {
            decoded = android.graphics.BitmapFactory.decodeStream(stream);
        }

        if (decoded == null) throw new java.io.IOException("the thumbnail for " + uri + " did not decode");

        int width = decoded.getWidth();
        int height = decoded.getHeight();
        if (width <= size.getWidth() && height <= size.getHeight()) return decoded;

        float scale = Math.min((float)size.getWidth() / width, (float)size.getHeight() / height);
        int scaledWidth = Math.max(1, Math.round(width * scale));
        int scaledHeight = Math.max(1, Math.round(height * scale));
        return android.graphics.Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(decoded, scaledWidth, scaledHeight, true);
    }

    public final Context getContext()
    {
        return mContext;
    }

    private static final class Registration
    {
        final String uri;
        final boolean descendants;
        final ContentObserver observer;

        Registration(String uri, boolean descendants, ContentObserver observer)
        {
            this.uri = uri;
            this.descendants = descendants;
            this.observer = observer;
        }

        boolean matches(String changed)
        {
            if (uri.isEmpty() || changed.equals(uri)) return true;
            if (!descendants) return false;

            return changed.startsWith(uri) && (uri.endsWith("/") || changed.charAt(uri.length()) == '/');
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/content/ContentUris.java`:

```java
package android.content;

import android.net.Uri;

import java.util.List;

public class ContentUris
{
    public ContentUris()
    {
    }

    public static long parseId(Uri contentUri)
    {
        String last = contentUri.getLastPathSegment();
        return last == null ? -1 : Long.parseLong(last);
    }

    public static Uri.Builder appendId(Uri.Builder builder, long id)
    {
        return builder.appendEncodedPath(String.valueOf(id));
    }

    public static Uri withAppendedId(Uri contentUri, long id)
    {
        return appendId(contentUri.buildUpon(), id).build();
    }

    public static Uri removeId(Uri contentUri)
    {
        String last = contentUri.getLastPathSegment();
        if (last == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("No path segments to remove");

        Long.parseLong(last);

        List<String> segments = contentUri.getPathSegments();
        Uri.Builder builder = contentUri.buildUpon();
        builder.path(null);

        for (int index = 0; index < segments.size() - 1; index++)
        {
            builder.appendPath(segments.get(index));
        }

        return builder.build();
    }
}
```

```java
package android.content;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

public final class ContentValues implements android.os.Parcelable
{
    public static final String TAG = "ContentValues";

    public static final android.os.Parcelable.Creator<ContentValues> CREATOR = new android.os.Parcelable.Creator<ContentValues>()
    {
        @Override
        public ContentValues createFromParcel(android.os.Parcel source)
        {
            ContentValues values = new ContentValues();
            int count = source.readInt();

            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                String key = source.readString();
                values.mValues.put(key, source.readValue(null));
            }

            return values;
        }

        @Override
        public ContentValues[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ContentValues[size];
        }
    };

    private final Map<String, Object> mValues;

    public ContentValues()
    {
        mValues = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    }

    public ContentValues(int size)
    {
        if (size < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Initial size must be non-negative");

        mValues = new LinkedHashMap<>(size);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(android.os.Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeInt(mValues.size());

        for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : mValues.entrySet())
        {
            destination.writeString(entry.getKey());
            destination.writeValue(entry.getValue());
        }
    }

    public ContentValues(ContentValues from)
    {
        mValues = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (from != null) mValues.putAll(from.mValues);
    }

    public void put(String key, String value)
    {
        mValues.put(key, value);
    }

    public void put(String key, Byte value)
    {
        mValues.put(key, value);
    }

    public void put(String key, Short value)
    {
        mValues.put(key, value);
    }

    public void put(String key, Integer value)
    {
        mValues.put(key, value);
    }

    public void put(String key, Long value)
    {
        mValues.put(key, value);
    }

    public void put(String key, Float value)
    {
        mValues.put(key, value);
    }

    public void put(String key, Double value)
    {
        mValues.put(key, value);
    }

    public void put(String key, Boolean value)
    {
        mValues.put(key, value);
    }

    public void put(String key, byte[] value)
    {
        mValues.put(key, value);
    }

    public void putObject(String key, Object value)
    {
        mValues.put(key, value);
    }

    public void putNull(String key)
    {
        mValues.put(key, null);
    }

    public void putAll(ContentValues other)
    {
        if (other != null) mValues.putAll(other.mValues);
    }

    public Object get(String key)
    {
        return mValues.get(key);
    }

    public String getAsString(String key)
    {
        Object value = mValues.get(key);
        return value == null ? null : value.toString();
    }

    public Long getAsLong(String key)
    {
        Object value = mValues.get(key);
        if (value instanceof Number) return ((Number)value).longValue();
        if (value instanceof String) return Long.valueOf((String)value);

        return null;
    }

    public Integer getAsInteger(String key)
    {
        Object value = mValues.get(key);
        if (value instanceof Number) return ((Number)value).intValue();
        if (value instanceof String) return Integer.valueOf((String)value);

        return null;
    }

    public Short getAsShort(String key)
    {
        Object value = mValues.get(key);
        if (value instanceof Number) return ((Number)value).shortValue();

        return null;
    }

    public Byte getAsByte(String key)
    {
        Object value = mValues.get(key);
        if (value instanceof Number) return ((Number)value).byteValue();

        return null;
    }

    public Float getAsFloat(String key)
    {
        Object value = mValues.get(key);
        if (value instanceof Number) return ((Number)value).floatValue();

        return null;
    }

    public Double getAsDouble(String key)
    {
        Object value = mValues.get(key);
        if (value instanceof Number) return ((Number)value).doubleValue();

        return null;
    }

    public Boolean getAsBoolean(String key)
    {
        Object value = mValues.get(key);
        if (value instanceof Boolean) return (Boolean)value;
        if (value instanceof Number) return ((Number)value).intValue() != 0;
        if (value instanceof String) return Boolean.valueOf((String)value);

        return null;
    }

    public byte[] getAsByteArray(String key)
    {
        Object value = mValues.get(key);
        return value instanceof byte[] ? (byte[])value : null;
    }

    public boolean containsKey(String key)
    {
        return mValues.containsKey(key);
    }

    public void remove(String key)
    {
        mValues.remove(key);
    }

    public void clear()
    {
        mValues.clear();
    }

    public Set<String> keySet()
    {
        return mValues.keySet();
    }

    public Set<Map.Entry<String, Object>> valueSet()
    {
        return mValues.entrySet();
    }

    public int size()
    {
        return mValues.size();
    }

    public boolean isEmpty()
    {
        return mValues.isEmpty();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mValues.toString();
    }
}
```

```java
        return deleted;
    }
```

`java/android/content/CursorLoader.java`:

```java
package android.content;

import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.CancellationSignal;
import android.os.OperationCanceledException;

import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.Arrays;

public class CursorLoader extends AsyncTaskLoader<Cursor>
{
    final ForceLoadContentObserver mObserver;

    Uri mUri;
    String[] mProjection;
    String mSelection;
    String[] mSelectionArgs;
    String mSortOrder;

    Cursor mCursor;
    CancellationSignal mCancellationSignal;

    public CursorLoader(Context context)
    {
        super(context);
        mObserver = new ForceLoadContentObserver();
    }

    public CursorLoader(Context context, Uri uri, String[] projection, String selection, String[] selectionArgs, String sortOrder)
    {
        super(context);
        mObserver = new ForceLoadContentObserver();
        mUri = uri;
        mProjection = projection;
        mSelection = selection;
        mSelectionArgs = selectionArgs;
        mSortOrder = sortOrder;
    }

    @Override
    public Cursor loadInBackground()
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (isLoadInBackgroundCanceled()) throw new OperationCanceledException();

            mCancellationSignal = new CancellationSignal();
        }

        try
        {
            Cursor cursor = getContext().getContentResolver().query(mUri, mProjection, mSelection, mSelectionArgs, mSortOrder,
                                                                   mCancellationSignal);

            if (cursor != null)
            {
                try
                {
                    cursor.getCount();
                    cursor.registerContentObserver(mObserver);
                }
                catch (RuntimeException failure)
                {
                    cursor.close();
                    throw failure;
                }
            }

            return cursor;
        }
        finally
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                mCancellationSignal = null;
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void cancelLoadInBackground()
    {
        super.cancelLoadInBackground();

        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mCancellationSignal != null) mCancellationSignal.cancel();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void deliverResult(Cursor cursor)
    {
        if (isReset())
        {
            if (cursor != null) cursor.close();
            return;
        }

        Cursor previous = mCursor;
        mCursor = cursor;

        if (isStarted()) super.deliverResult(cursor);

        if (previous != null && previous != cursor && !previous.isClosed()) previous.close();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onStartLoading()
    {
        if (mCursor != null) deliverResult(mCursor);

        if (takeContentChanged() || mCursor == null) forceLoad();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onStopLoading()
    {
        cancelLoad();
    }

    @Override
    public void onCanceled(Cursor cursor)
    {
        if (cursor != null && !cursor.isClosed()) cursor.close();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onReset()
    {
        super.onReset();

        onStopLoading();

        if (mCursor != null && !mCursor.isClosed()) mCursor.close();
        mCursor = null;
    }

    public Uri getUri()
    {
        return mUri;
    }

    public void setUri(Uri uri)
    {
        mUri = uri;
    }

    public String[] getProjection()
    {
        return mProjection;
    }

    public void setProjection(String[] projection)
    {
        mProjection = projection;
    }

    public String getSelection()
    {
        return mSelection;
    }

    public void setSelection(String selection)
    {
        mSelection = selection;
    }

    public String[] getSelectionArgs()
    {
        return mSelectionArgs;
    }

    public void setSelectionArgs(String[] selectionArgs)
    {
        mSelectionArgs = selectionArgs;
    }

    public String getSortOrder()
    {
        return mSortOrder;
    }

    public void setSortOrder(String sortOrder)
    {
        mSortOrder = sortOrder;
    }

    @Override
    public void dump(String prefix, FileDescriptor fd, PrintWriter writer, String[] args)
    {
        super.dump(prefix, fd, writer, args);

        writer.print(prefix);
        writer.print("mUri=");
        writer.println(mUri);
        writer.print(prefix);
        writer.print("mProjection=");
        writer.println(Arrays.toString(mProjection));
        writer.print(prefix);
        writer.print("mSelection=");
        writer.println(mSelection);
        writer.print(prefix);
        writer.print("mSelectionArgs=");
        writer.println(Arrays.toString(mSelectionArgs));
        writer.print(prefix);
        writer.print("mSortOrder=");
        writer.println(mSortOrder);
        writer.print(prefix);
        writer.print("mCursor=");
        writer.println(mCursor);
    }
}
```

```java
public interface DialogInterface
{
    int BUTTON_POSITIVE = -1;
    int BUTTON_NEGATIVE = -2;
    int BUTTON_NEUTRAL = -3;
    @Deprecated
    int BUTTON1 = BUTTON_POSITIVE;
    @Deprecated
    int BUTTON2 = BUTTON_NEGATIVE;
    @Deprecated
    int BUTTON3 = BUTTON_NEUTRAL;

    void cancel();

    void dismiss();

    interface OnShowListener
    {
        void onShow(DialogInterface dialog);
    }

    interface OnMultiChoiceClickListener
    {
        void onClick(DialogInterface dialog, int which, boolean isChecked);
    }

    interface OnClickListener
    {
        void onClick(DialogInterface dialog, int which);
    }

    interface OnCancelListener
    {
        void onCancel(DialogInterface dialog);
    }

    interface OnDismissListener
    {
        void onDismiss(DialogInterface dialog);
    }

    interface OnKeyListener
    {
        boolean onKey(DialogInterface dialog, int keyCode, android.view.KeyEvent event);
    }
}
```
