```java
    private static final int IMMUTABLE_FLAGS = FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION | FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION
                                               | FLAG_GRANT_PERSISTABLE_URI_PERMISSION | FLAG_GRANT_PREFIX_URI_PERMISSION;

    private static final String ANDROID_NAMESPACE = "http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android";

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<Intent> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<Intent>()
    {
        @Override
        public Intent createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            Intent intent = new Intent();
            intent.readFromParcel(source);
            return intent;
        }

        @Override
        public Intent[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Intent[size];
        }
    };

    private String mAction;
    private Uri mData;
    private String mType;
    private String mIdentifier;
    private String mPackage;
    private ComponentName mComponent;
    private int mFlags;
    private LinkedHashSet<String> mCategories;
    private Bundle mExtras;
    private android.graphics.Rect mSourceBounds;
    private Intent mSelector;
    private ClipData mClipData;

    public Intent()
    {
    }

    public Intent(Intent other)
    {
        mAction = other.mAction;
        mData = other.mData;
        mType = other.mType;
        mIdentifier = other.mIdentifier;
        mPackage = other.mPackage;
        mComponent = other.mComponent;
        mFlags = other.mFlags;
        if (other.mCategories != null) mCategories = new LinkedHashSet<>(other.mCategories);
        if (other.mExtras != null) mExtras = new Bundle(other.mExtras);
        if (other.mSourceBounds != null) mSourceBounds = new android.graphics.Rect(other.mSourceBounds);
        if (other.mSelector != null) mSelector = new Intent(other.mSelector);
        mClipData = other.mClipData;
    }

    public Intent(String action)
    {
        setAction(action);
    }

    public Intent(String action, Uri uri)
    {
        setAction(action);
        mData = uri;
    }

    public Intent(Context packageContext, Class<?> target)
    {
        mComponent = new ComponentName(packageContext == null ? "" : packageContext.getPackageName(), target.getName());
    }

    public Intent(String action, Uri uri, Context packageContext, Class<?> target)
    {
        setAction(action);
        mData = uri;
        mComponent = new ComponentName(packageContext == null ? "" : packageContext.getPackageName(), target.getName());
    }

    public static Intent createChooser(Intent target, CharSequence title)
    {
        return createChooser(target, title, null);
    }

    public static Intent createChooser(Intent target, CharSequence title, IntentSender sender)
    {
        Intent intent = new Intent(ACTION_CHOOSER);
        intent.putExtra(EXTRA_INTENT, target);
        if (title != null) intent.putExtra(EXTRA_TITLE, title);
        if (sender != null) intent.putExtra(EXTRA_CHOSEN_COMPONENT_INTENT_SENDER, sender);

        if (target != null)
        {
            int permissionGrants = target.getFlags() & IMMUTABLE_FLAGS;
            if (target.getClipData() != null) intent.setClipData(target.getClipData());
            if (permissionGrants != 0) intent.addFlags(permissionGrants);
        }

        return intent;
    }

    @Override
    public Object clone()
    {
        return new Intent(this);
    }

    public Intent cloneFilter()
    {
        Intent filter = new Intent();
        filter.mAction = mAction;
        filter.mData = mData;
        filter.mType = mType;
        filter.mIdentifier = mIdentifier;
        filter.mPackage = mPackage;
        filter.mComponent = mComponent;
        if (mCategories != null) filter.mCategories = new LinkedHashSet<>(mCategories);
        return filter;
    }

    public static Intent makeMainActivity(ComponentName mainActivity)
    {
        Intent intent = new Intent(ACTION_MAIN);
        intent.setComponent(mainActivity);
        intent.addCategory(CATEGORY_LAUNCHER);
        return intent;
    }

    public static Intent makeMainSelectorActivity(String selectorAction, String selectorCategory)
    {
        Intent intent = new Intent(ACTION_MAIN);
        intent.addCategory(CATEGORY_LAUNCHER);

        Intent selector = new Intent();
        selector.setAction(selectorAction);
        selector.addCategory(selectorCategory);
        intent.setSelector(selector);
        return intent;
    }

    public static Intent makeRestartActivityTask(ComponentName mainActivity)
    {
        Intent intent = makeMainActivity(mainActivity);
        intent.addFlags(FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK | FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
        return intent;
    }

    public static Intent getIntent(String uri) throws URISyntaxException
    {
        return parseUri(uri, 0);
    }

    public static Intent getIntentOld(String uri) throws URISyntaxException
    {
        return new Intent(ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(uri));
    }

    public static Intent parseUri(String uri, int flags) throws URISyntaxException
    {
        int index = 0;

        try
        {
            boolean androidApp = uri.startsWith("android-app:");

            if ((flags & (URI_INTENT_SCHEME | URI_ANDROID_APP_SCHEME)) != 0)
            {
                if (!uri.startsWith("intent:") && !androidApp)
                {
                    Intent intent = new Intent(ACTION_VIEW);
                    intent.setData(Uri.parse(uri));
                    return intent;
                }
            }

            index = uri.lastIndexOf("#");
            if (index == -1)
            {
                if (!androidApp) return new Intent(ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(uri));
            }
            else if (!uri.startsWith("#Intent;", index))
            {
                if (!androidApp) return getIntentOld(uri);
                index = -1;
            }

            Intent intent = new Intent(ACTION_VIEW);
            Intent baseIntent = intent;
            boolean explicitAction = false;
            boolean inSelector = false;
            String scheme = null;
            String data;

            if (index >= 0)
            {
                data = uri.substring(0, index);
                index += 8;
            }
            else
            {
                data = uri;
            }

            while (index >= 0 && !uri.startsWith("end", index))
            {
                int equals = uri.indexOf('=', index);
                if (equals < 0) equals = index - 1;
                int semicolon = uri.indexOf(';', index);
                String value = equals < semicolon ? Uri.decode(uri.substring(equals + 1, semicolon)) : "";

                if (uri.startsWith("action=", index))
                {
                    intent.setAction(value);
                    if (!inSelector) explicitAction = true;
                }
                else if (uri.startsWith("category=", index))
                {
                    intent.addCategory(value);
                }
                else if (uri.startsWith("type=", index))
                {
                    intent.mType = value;
                }
                else if (uri.startsWith("identifier=", index))
                {
                    intent.mIdentifier = value;
                }
                else if (uri.startsWith("launchFlags=", index))
                {
                    intent.mFlags = Integer.decode(value);
                    if ((flags & URI_ALLOW_UNSAFE) == 0) intent.mFlags &= ~IMMUTABLE_FLAGS;
                }
                else if (uri.startsWith("package=", index))
                {
                    intent.mPackage = value;
                }
                else if (uri.startsWith("component=", index))
                {
                    intent.mComponent = ComponentName.unflattenFromString(value);
                }
                else if (uri.startsWith("scheme=", index))
                {
                    if (inSelector) intent.mData = Uri.parse(value + ":");
                    else scheme = value;
                }
                else if (uri.startsWith("sourceBounds=", index))
                {
                    intent.mSourceBounds = android.graphics.Rect.unflattenFromString(value);
                }
                else if (semicolon == (index + 3) && uri.startsWith("SEL", index))
                {
                    intent = new Intent();
                    inSelector = true;
                }
                else
                {
                    String key = Uri.decode(uri.substring(index + 2, equals));
                    if (intent.mExtras == null) intent.mExtras = new Bundle();
                    Bundle extras = intent.mExtras;

                    if (uri.startsWith("S.", index)) extras.putString(key, value);
                    else if (uri.startsWith("B.", index)) extras.putBoolean(key, Boolean.parseBoolean(value));
                    else if (uri.startsWith("b.", index)) extras.putByte(key, Byte.parseByte(value));
                    else if (uri.startsWith("c.", index)) extras.putChar(key, value.charAt(0));
                    else if (uri.startsWith("d.", index)) extras.putDouble(key, Double.parseDouble(value));
                    else if (uri.startsWith("f.", index)) extras.putFloat(key, Float.parseFloat(value));
                    else if (uri.startsWith("i.", index)) extras.putInt(key, Integer.parseInt(value));
                    else if (uri.startsWith("l.", index)) extras.putLong(key, Long.parseLong(value));
                    else if (uri.startsWith("s.", index)) extras.putShort(key, Short.parseShort(value));
                    else throw new URISyntaxException(uri, "unknown EXTRA type", index);
                }

                index = semicolon + 1;
            }

            if (inSelector)
            {
                if (baseIntent.mPackage == null) baseIntent.setSelector(intent);
                intent = baseIntent;
            }

            if (data != null)
            {
                if (data.startsWith("intent:"))
                {
                    data = data.substring(7);
                    if (scheme != null) data = scheme + ':' + data;
                }
                else if (data.startsWith("android-app:"))
                {
                    data = parseAndroidAppData(intent, data, explicitAction);
                }

                if (data.length() > 0) intent.mData = Uri.parse(data);
            }

            return intent;
        }
        catch (IndexOutOfBoundsException malformed)
        {
            throw new URISyntaxException(uri, "illegal Intent URI format", index);
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
        {
            throw new URISyntaxException(uri, "illegal Intent URI number", index);
        }
    }

    private static String parseAndroidAppData(Intent intent, String data, boolean explicitAction)
    {
        if (data.length() < 14 || data.charAt(12) != '/' || data.charAt(13) != '/') return "";

        int end = data.indexOf('/', 14);
        if (end < 0)
        {
            intent.mPackage = data.substring(14);
            if (!explicitAction) intent.setAction(ACTION_MAIN);
            return "";
        }

        String scheme = null;
        String authority = null;
        intent.mPackage = data.substring(14, end);

        if ((end + 1) < data.length())
        {
            int newEnd = data.indexOf('/', end + 1);
            if (newEnd >= 0)
            {
                scheme = data.substring(end + 1, newEnd);
                end = newEnd;

                if (end < data.length() && (newEnd = data.indexOf('/', end + 1)) >= 0)
                {
                    authority = data.substring(end + 1, newEnd);
                    end = newEnd;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                scheme = data.substring(end + 1);
            }
        }

        if (scheme == null)
        {
            if (!explicitAction) intent.setAction(ACTION_MAIN);
            return "";
        }

        if (authority == null) return scheme + ":";

        return scheme + "://" + authority + data.substring(end);
    }

    public static Intent parseIntent(android.content.res.Resources resources, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser parser,
                                     android.util.AttributeSet attrs)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        Intent intent = new Intent();
        intent.setAction(attrs.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "action"));

        String data = attrs.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "data");
        String mimeType = attrs.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "mimeType");
        intent.setDataAndType(data != null ? Uri.parse(data) : null, mimeType);
        intent.setIdentifier(attrs.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "identifier"));

        String packageName = attrs.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "targetPackage");
        String className = attrs.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "targetClass");
        if (packageName != null && className != null) intent.setComponent(new ComponentName(packageName, className));

        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int type;

        while ((type = parser.next()) != org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT
               && (type != org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser.END_TAG || parser.getDepth() > outerDepth))
        {
            if (type != org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            String nodeName = parser.getName();
            if ("categories".equals(nodeName))
            {
                String category = attrs.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "name");
                if (category != null) intent.addCategory(category);
            }
            else if ("extra".equals(nodeName))
            {
                String name = attrs.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "name");
                String value = attrs.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "value");
                if (name != null) intent.putExtra(name, value);
            }

            skipCurrentTag(parser);
        }

        return intent;
    }

    private static void skipCurrentTag(org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser parser)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int type;

        while ((type = parser.next()) != org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT
               && (type != org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser.END_TAG || parser.getDepth() > outerDepth))
        {
        }
    }

    public static String normalizeMimeType(String type)
    {
        if (type == null) return null;

        type = type.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        int semicolon = type.indexOf(';');
        if (semicolon != -1) type = type.substring(0, semicolon);

        return type;
    }

    public String resolveType(ContentResolver resolver)
    {
        if (mType != null) return mType;
        if (mData != null && ContentResolver.SCHEME_CONTENT.equals(mData.getScheme())) return resolver.getType(mData);

        return null;
    }

    public String resolveTypeIfNeeded(ContentResolver resolver)
    {
        if (mComponent != null) return mType;

        return resolveType(resolver);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public <T> T[] getParcelableArrayExtra(String name, Class<T> type)
    {
        Parcelable[] array = getParcelableArrayExtra(name);
        if (array == null) return null;

        T[] typed = (T[])java.lang.reflect.Array.newInstance(type, array.length);
        for (int index = 0; index < array.length; index++)
        {
            if (array[index] != null && !type.isInstance(array[index])) return null;
            typed[index] = type.cast(array[index]);
        }

        return typed;
    }

    public ComponentName resolveActivity(android.content.pm.PackageManager packageManager)
    {
        if (mComponent != null) return mComponent;

        android.content.pm.ResolveInfo info = packageManager.resolveActivity(this, android.content.pm.PackageManager.MATCH_DEFAULT_ONLY);
        if (info == null || info.activityInfo == null) return null;

        String packageName = info.activityInfo.applicationInfo != null ? info.activityInfo.applicationInfo.packageName
                                                                      : info.activityInfo.packageName;
        return new ComponentName(packageName, info.activityInfo.name);
    }

    public android.content.pm.ActivityInfo resolveActivityInfo(android.content.pm.PackageManager packageManager, int flags)
    {
        if (mComponent != null)
        {
            try
            {
                return packageManager.getActivityInfo(mComponent, flags);
            }
            catch (android.content.pm.PackageManager.NameNotFoundException missing)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        android.content.pm.ResolveInfo info =
            packageManager.resolveActivity(this, android.content.pm.PackageManager.MATCH_DEFAULT_ONLY | flags);
        return info == null ? null : info.activityInfo;
    }

    public int fillIn(Intent other, int flags)
    {
        int changes = 0;

        if (other.mAction != null && (mAction == null || (flags & FILL_IN_ACTION) != 0))
        {
            mAction = other.mAction;
            changes |= FILL_IN_ACTION;
        }

        if ((other.mData != null || other.mType != null)
            && ((mData == null && mType == null) || (flags & FILL_IN_DATA) != 0))
        {
            mData = other.mData;
            mType = other.mType;
            changes |= FILL_IN_DATA;
        }

        if (other.mIdentifier != null && (mIdentifier == null || (flags & FILL_IN_IDENTIFIER) != 0))
        {
            mIdentifier = other.mIdentifier;
            changes |= FILL_IN_IDENTIFIER;
        }

        if (other.mCategories != null && (mCategories == null || (flags & FILL_IN_CATEGORIES) != 0))
        {
            mCategories = new LinkedHashSet<>(other.mCategories);
            changes |= FILL_IN_CATEGORIES;
        }

        if (other.mPackage != null && (mPackage == null || (flags & FILL_IN_PACKAGE) != 0))
        {
            if (mSelector == null)
            {
                mPackage = other.mPackage;
                changes |= FILL_IN_PACKAGE;
            }
        }

        if (other.mSelector != null && (flags & FILL_IN_SELECTOR) != 0)
        {
            if (mPackage == null)
            {
                mSelector = new Intent(other.mSelector);
                mPackage = null;
                changes |= FILL_IN_SELECTOR;
            }
        }

        if (other.mClipData != null && (mClipData == null || (flags & FILL_IN_CLIP_DATA) != 0))
        {
            mClipData = other.mClipData;
            changes |= FILL_IN_CLIP_DATA;
        }

        if (other.mComponent != null && (flags & FILL_IN_COMPONENT) != 0)
        {
            mComponent = other.mComponent;
            changes |= FILL_IN_COMPONENT;
        }

        mFlags |= other.mFlags;

        if (other.mSourceBounds != null && (mSourceBounds == null || (flags & FILL_IN_SOURCE_BOUNDS) != 0))
        {
            mSourceBounds = new android.graphics.Rect(other.mSourceBounds);
            changes |= FILL_IN_SOURCE_BOUNDS;
        }

        if (mExtras == null)
        {
            if (other.mExtras != null) mExtras = new Bundle(other.mExtras);
        }
        else if (other.mExtras != null)
        {
            Bundle merged = new Bundle(other.mExtras);
            merged.putAll(mExtras);
            mExtras = merged;
        }

        return changes;
    }

    public boolean filterEquals(Intent other)
    {
        if (other == null) return false;
        if (!Objects.equals(mAction, other.mAction)) return false;
        if (!Objects.equals(mData, other.mData)) return false;
        if (!Objects.equals(mType, other.mType)) return false;
        if (!Objects.equals(mIdentifier, other.mIdentifier)) return false;
        if (!Objects.equals(mPackage, other.mPackage)) return false;
        if (!Objects.equals(mComponent, other.mComponent)) return false;

        return Objects.equals(mCategories, other.mCategories);
    }

    public int filterHashCode()
    {
        int code = 0;
        if (mAction != null) code += mAction.hashCode();
        if (mData != null) code += mData.hashCode();
        if (mType != null) code += mType.hashCode();
        if (mIdentifier != null) code += mIdentifier.hashCode();
        if (mPackage != null) code += mPackage.hashCode();
        if (mComponent != null) code += mComponent.hashCode();
        if (mCategories != null) code += mCategories.hashCode();
        return code;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder described = new StringBuilder(128);
        described.append("Intent { ");
        toShortString(described, true, true, true, false);
        described.append(" }");
        return described.toString();
    }

    public String toShortString(boolean secure, boolean component, boolean extras, boolean clip)
    {
        StringBuilder described = new StringBuilder(128);
        toShortString(described, secure, component, extras, clip);
        return described.toString();
    }

    private void toShortString(StringBuilder described, boolean secure, boolean component, boolean extras, boolean clip)
    {
        boolean first = true;

        if (mAction != null)
        {
            described.append("act=").append(mAction);
            first = false;
        }

        if (mCategories != null)
        {
            if (!first) described.append(' ');
            first = false;
            described.append("cat=[");

            boolean firstCategory = true;
            for (String category : mCategories)
            {
                if (!firstCategory) described.append(',');
                described.append(category);
                firstCategory = false;
            }

            described.append(']');
        }

        if (mData != null)
        {
            if (!first) described.append(' ');
            first = false;
            described.append("dat=").append(secure ? safeData() : mData.toString());
        }

        if (mType != null)
        {
            if (!first) described.append(' ');
            first = false;
            described.append("typ=").append(mType);
        }

        if (mIdentifier != null)
        {
            if (!first) described.append(' ');
            first = false;
            described.append("id=").append(mIdentifier);
        }

        if (mFlags != 0)
        {
            if (!first) described.append(' ');
            first = false;
            described.append("flg=0x").append(Integer.toHexString(mFlags));
        }

        if (mPackage != null)
        {
            if (!first) described.append(' ');
            first = false;
            described.append("pkg=").append(mPackage);
        }

        if (component && mComponent != null)
        {
            if (!first) described.append(' ');
            first = false;
            described.append("cmp=").append(mComponent.flattenToShortString());
        }

        if (mSourceBounds != null)
        {
            if (!first) described.append(' ');
            first = false;
            described.append("bnds=").append(mSourceBounds.toShortString());
        }

        if (mClipData != null)
        {
            if (!first) described.append(' ');
            first = false;
            described.append(clip ? "clip={" + mClipData + "}" : "(has clip)");
        }

        if (extras && mExtras != null)
        {
            if (!first) described.append(' ');
            first = false;
            described.append("(has extras)");
        }

        if (mSelector != null)
        {
            if (!first) described.append(' ');
            described.append("sel=");
            mSelector.toShortString(described, secure, component, extras, clip);
        }
    }

    private String safeData()
    {
        String scheme = mData.getScheme();
        if (scheme == null) return "";
        if ("http".equals(scheme) || "https".equals(scheme) || "content".equals(scheme) || "file".equals(scheme))
        {
            String host = mData.getHost();
            return scheme + "://" + (host == null ? "" : host) + "/...";
        }

        return scheme + ":...";
    }

    @Deprecated
    public String toURI()
    {
        return toUri(0);
    }

    public String toUri(int flags)
    {
        StringBuilder uri = new StringBuilder(128);

        if ((flags & URI_ANDROID_APP_SCHEME) != 0)
        {
            if (mPackage == null)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Intent must include an explicit package name to build an android-app: " + this);
            }

            uri.append("android-app://").append(mPackage);
            String scheme = null;

            if (mData != null)
            {
                scheme = mData.getScheme();
                if (scheme != null)
                {
                    uri.append('/').append(scheme);
                    String authority = mData.getEncodedAuthority();

                    if (authority != null)
                    {
                        uri.append('/').append(authority);
                        String path = mData.getEncodedPath();
                        if (path != null) uri.append(path);
                        String query = mData.getEncodedQuery();
                        if (query != null) uri.append('?').append(query);
                        String fragment = mData.getEncodedFragment();
                        if (fragment != null) uri.append('#').append(fragment);
                    }
                }
            }

            toUriFragment(uri, null, scheme == null ? ACTION_MAIN : ACTION_VIEW, mPackage, flags);
            return uri.toString();
        }

        String scheme = null;

        if (mData != null)
        {
            String data = mData.toString();

            if ((flags & URI_INTENT_SCHEME) != 0)
            {
                for (int index = 0; index < data.length(); index++)
                {
                    char character = data.charAt(index);
                    if ((character >= 'a' && character <= 'z') || (character >= 'A' && character <= 'Z')
                        || (character >= '0' && character <= '9') || character == '.' || character == '-' || character == '+')
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (character == ':' && index > 0)
                    {
                        scheme = data.substring(0, index);
                        uri.append("intent:");
                        data = data.substring(index + 1);
                    }

                    break;
                }
            }

            uri.append(data);
        }
        else if ((flags & URI_INTENT_SCHEME) != 0)
        {
            uri.append("intent:");
        }

        toUriFragment(uri, scheme, ACTION_VIEW, null, flags);
        return uri.toString();
    }

    private void toUriFragment(StringBuilder uri, String scheme, String defaultAction, String defaultPackage, int flags)
    {
        StringBuilder fragment = new StringBuilder(128);
        toUriInner(fragment, scheme, defaultAction, defaultPackage, flags);

        if (mSelector != null)
        {
            fragment.append("SEL;");
            mSelector.toUriInner(fragment, mSelector.mData != null ? mSelector.mData.getScheme() : null, null, null, flags);
        }

        if (fragment.length() > 0)
        {
            uri.append("#Intent;");
            uri.append(fragment);
            uri.append("end");
        }
    }

    private void toUriInner(StringBuilder uri, String scheme, String defaultAction, String defaultPackage, int flags)
    {
        if (scheme != null) uri.append("scheme=").append(Uri.encode(scheme)).append(';');
        if (mAction != null && !mAction.equals(defaultAction)) uri.append("action=").append(Uri.encode(mAction)).append(';');

        if (mCategories != null)
        {
            for (String category : mCategories)
            {
                uri.append("category=").append(Uri.encode(category)).append(';');
            }
        }

        if (mType != null) uri.append("type=").append(Uri.encode(mType, "/")).append(';');
        if (mIdentifier != null) uri.append("identifier=").append(Uri.encode(mIdentifier, "/")).append(';');
        if (mFlags != 0) uri.append("launchFlags=0x").append(Integer.toHexString(mFlags)).append(';');
        if (mPackage != null && !mPackage.equals(defaultPackage)) uri.append("package=").append(Uri.encode(mPackage)).append(';');
        if (mComponent != null) uri.append("component=").append(Uri.encode(mComponent.flattenToShortString(), "/")).append(';');
        if (mSourceBounds != null) uri.append("sourceBounds=").append(Uri.encode(mSourceBounds.flattenToString())).append(';');

        if (mExtras == null) return;

        for (String key : mExtras.keySet())
        {
            Object value = mExtras.get(key);
            char entryType = value instanceof String ? 'S'
                           : value instanceof Boolean ? 'B'
                           : value instanceof Byte ? 'b'
                           : value instanceof Character ? 'c'
                           : value instanceof Double ? 'd'
                           : value instanceof Float ? 'f'
                           : value instanceof Integer ? 'i'
                           : value instanceof Long ? 'l'
                           : value instanceof Short ? 's'
                           : '\0';

            if (entryType == '\0') continue;

            uri.append(entryType).append('.').append(Uri.encode(key)).append('=').append(Uri.encode(value.toString())).append(';');
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return mExtras != null && mExtras.hasFileDescriptors() ? Parcelable.CONTENTS_FILE_DESCRIPTOR : 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeString(mAction);
        destination.writeValue(mData);
        destination.writeString(mType);
        destination.writeString(mIdentifier);
        destination.writeInt(mFlags);
        destination.writeString(mPackage);
        destination.writeValue(mComponent);
        destination.writeValue(mSourceBounds == null ? null : new android.graphics.Rect(mSourceBounds));
        destination.writeValue(mCategories == null ? null : new ArrayList<>(mCategories));
        destination.writeValue(mSelector == null ? null : new Intent(mSelector));
        destination.writeValue(mClipData);
        destination.writeBundle(mExtras == null ? null : new Bundle(mExtras));
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public void readFromParcel(Parcel source)
    {
        setAction(source.readString());
        mData = (Uri)source.readValue(null);
        mType = source.readString();
        mIdentifier = source.readString();
        mFlags = source.readInt();
        mPackage = source.readString();
        mComponent = (ComponentName)source.readValue(null);
        mSourceBounds = (android.graphics.Rect)source.readValue(null);

        Object categories = source.readValue(null);
        mCategories = categories == null ? null : new LinkedHashSet<>((ArrayList<String>)categories);

        mSelector = (Intent)source.readValue(null);
        mClipData = (ClipData)source.readValue(null);
        mExtras = source.readBundle();
    }

    private Bundle ensureExtras()
    {
        if (mExtras == null) mExtras = new Bundle();

        return mExtras;
    }

    public static final class FilterComparison
    {
        private final Intent mIntent;
        private final int mHashCode;

        public FilterComparison(Intent intent)
        {
            mIntent = intent;
            mHashCode = intent.filterHashCode();
        }

        public Intent getIntent()
        {
            return mIntent;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object other)
        {
            if (!(other instanceof FilterComparison)) return false;

            return mIntent.filterEquals(((FilterComparison)other).mIntent);
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return mHashCode;
        }
    }

    public static class ShortcutIconResource implements Parcelable
    {
        public static final Parcelable.Creator<ShortcutIconResource> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ShortcutIconResource>()
        {
            @Override
            public ShortcutIconResource createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                ShortcutIconResource icon = new ShortcutIconResource();
                icon.packageName = source.readString();
                icon.resourceName = source.readString();
                return icon;
            }

            @Override
            public ShortcutIconResource[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new ShortcutIconResource[size];
            }
        };

        public String packageName;
        public String resourceName;

        public ShortcutIconResource()
        {
        }

        public static ShortcutIconResource fromContext(Context context, int resourceId)
        {
            ShortcutIconResource icon = new ShortcutIconResource();
            icon.packageName = context.getPackageName();
            icon.resourceName = context.getResources().getResourceName(resourceId);
            return icon;
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
        {
            destination.writeString(packageName);
            destination.writeString(resourceName);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return resourceName;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.content;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.List;

public class IntentFilter
{
    private final List<String> mActions = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> mCategories = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> mSchemes = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> mTypes = new ArrayList<>();

    private int mPriority;

    public IntentFilter()
    {
    }

    public IntentFilter(String action)
    {
        addAction(action);
    }

    public IntentFilter(String action, String dataType)
    {
        addAction(action);
        addDataType(dataType);
    }

    public final void addAction(String action)
    {
        if (action != null && !mActions.contains(action)) mActions.add(action);
    }

    public final int countActions()
    {
        return mActions.size();
    }

    {
        return mActions.get(index);
    }

    private final java.util.ArrayList<AuthorityEntry> mDataAuthorities = new java.util.ArrayList<>();

    public final void addDataAuthority(String host, String port)
    {
        if (host == null) return;
        if (port != null) port = port.intern();

        mDataAuthorities.add(new AuthorityEntry(host.intern(), port));
    }

    public final boolean hasDataAuthority(android.net.Uri data)
    {
        for (AuthorityEntry authority : mDataAuthorities)
        {
            if (authority.match(data) >= 0) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    }

    public void readFromXml(org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser parser) throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int type;

        while ((type = parser.next()) != org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT
               && (type != org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser.END_TAG || parser.getDepth() > outerDepth))
        {
            if (type != org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            String tag = parser.getName();
            String name = parser.getAttributeValue(null, "name");

            if ("action".equals(tag))
            {
                if (name != null) addAction(name);
            }
            else if ("cat".equals(tag))
            {
                if (name != null) addCategory(name);
            }
            else if ("type".equals(tag))
            {
                if (name != null) addDataType(name);
            }
            else if ("scheme".equals(tag))
            {
                if (name != null) addDataScheme(name);
            }
            else if ("auth".equals(tag))
            {
                String host = parser.getAttributeValue(null, "host");
                if (host != null) addDataAuthority(host, parser.getAttributeValue(null, "port"));
            }
            else if ("path".equals(tag) || "ssp".equals(tag))
            {
                String literal = parser.getAttributeValue(null, "literal");
                String prefix = parser.getAttributeValue(null, "prefix");
                String glob = parser.getAttributeValue(null, "sglob");
                String value = literal != null ? literal : prefix != null ? prefix : glob;
                int matchType = literal != null ? 0 : prefix != null ? 1 : 2;

                if (value != null && "path".equals(tag)) addDataPath(value, matchType);
                else if (value != null) addDataSchemeSpecificPart(value, matchType);
            }

            skipCurrentTag(parser);
        }
    }

    private static void skipCurrentTag(org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser parser)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int type;

        while ((type = parser.next()) != org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT
               && (type != org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser.END_TAG || parser.getDepth() > outerDepth))
        {
        }
    }

    public static final class AuthorityEntry
    {
        private final String mOrigHost;
        private final String mHost;
        private final boolean mWild;
        private final int mPort;

        public AuthorityEntry(String host, String port)
        {
            mOrigHost = host;
            mWild = host.length() > 0 && host.charAt(0) == '*';
            mHost = mWild ? host.substring(1).intern() : host;
            mPort = port != null ? Integer.parseInt(port) : -1;
        }

        public String getHost()
        {
            return mOrigHost;
        }

        public int getPort()
        {
            return mPort;
        }

        public int match(android.net.Uri data)
        {
            String host = data.getHost();
            if (host == null) return NO_MATCH_DATA;

            if (mWild)
            {
                if (host.length() < mHost.length()) return NO_MATCH_DATA;
                host = host.substring(host.length() - mHost.length());
            }

            if (host.compareToIgnoreCase(mHost) != 0) return NO_MATCH_DATA;
            if (mPort >= 0 && mPort != data.getPort()) return NO_MATCH_DATA;

            return mPort >= 0 ? MATCH_CATEGORY_PORT : MATCH_CATEGORY_HOST;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object other)
        {
            if (!(other instanceof AuthorityEntry)) return false;

            AuthorityEntry compared = (AuthorityEntry)other;
            return mWild == compared.mWild && mHost.equals(compared.mHost) && mPort == compared.mPort;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return mHost.hashCode() * 31 + mPort;
        }
    }

    public final void addDataType(String type)
    {
        if (type != null && !mTypes.contains(type)) mTypes.add(type);
    }

    public final boolean hasDataType(String type)
    {
        return type != null && mTypes.contains(type);
    }

    public final void setPriority(int priority)
    {
        mPriority = priority;
    }

    public final int getPriority()
    {
        return mPriority;
    }

    public final boolean matchAction(String action)
    {
        return hasAction(action);
    }

    public final int countCategories()
    {
        return mCategories.size();
    }

    public final String getCategory(int index)
    {
        return mCategories.get(index);
    }

    public final Iterator<String> categoriesIterator()
    {
        return mCategories.iterator();
    }

    public final int countDataSchemes()
    {
        return mSchemes.size();
    }

    public final String getDataScheme(int index)
    {
        return mSchemes.get(index);
    }

    public final int countDataTypes()
    {
        return mTypes.size();
    }

    public final String getDataType(int index)
    {
        return mTypes.get(index);
    }

    public final int match(String action, String type, String scheme, android.net.Uri data, java.util.Set<String> categories,
                           String logTag)
    {
        if (!mActions.isEmpty() && (action == null || !mActions.contains(action))) return NO_MATCH_ACTION;

        if (!mCategories.isEmpty() || categories != null)
        {
            if (categories != null)
            {
                for (String category : categories)
                {
                    if (android.content.Intent.CATEGORY_DEFAULT.equals(category)) continue;
                    if (!mCategories.contains(category)) return NO_MATCH_CATEGORY;
                }
            }
        }

        if (!mSchemes.isEmpty())
        {
            String candidate = scheme != null ? scheme : (data != null ? data.getScheme() : null);
            if (candidate == null || !mSchemes.contains(candidate)) return NO_MATCH_DATA;
        }

        if (!mTypes.isEmpty())
        {
            if (type == null) return NO_MATCH_TYPE;
            if (!matchesType(type)) return NO_MATCH_TYPE;
        }

        return MATCH_CATEGORY_EMPTY + mPriority;
    }

    public final int match(ContentResolver resolver, Intent intent, boolean resolve, String logTag)
    {
        if (intent == null) return NO_MATCH_ACTION;

        return match(intent.getAction(), intent.getType(), intent.getScheme(), intent.getData(), intent.getCategories(), logTag);
    }

    private boolean matchesType(String type)
    {
        for (String candidate : mTypes)
        {
            if (candidate.equals(type)) return true;
            if (!candidate.endsWith("/*")) continue;

            String prefix = candidate.substring(0, candidate.length() - 1);
            if (type.startsWith(prefix)) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public static final int NO_MATCH_ACTION = -3;
    public static final int NO_MATCH_CATEGORY = -4;
    public static final int NO_MATCH_DATA = -2;
    public static final int NO_MATCH_TYPE = -1;
    public static final int MATCH_CATEGORY_EMPTY = 0x00100000;
    public static final int MATCH_CATEGORY_SCHEME = 0x00200000;
    public static final int MATCH_CATEGORY_HOST = 0x00300000;
    public static final int MATCH_CATEGORY_PORT = 0x00400000;
    public static final int MATCH_CATEGORY_PATH = 0x00500000;
    public static final int MATCH_CATEGORY_SCHEME_SPECIFIC_PART = 0x00580000;
    public static final int MATCH_CATEGORY_TYPE = 0x00600000;
    public static final int MATCH_CATEGORY_MASK = 0x0fff0000;
    public static final int MATCH_ADJUSTMENT_MASK = 0x0000ffff;
    public static final int MATCH_ADJUSTMENT_NORMAL = 0x8000;
    public static final int SYSTEM_HIGH_PRIORITY = 1000;
    public static final int SYSTEM_LOW_PRIORITY = -1000;
}
```

`java/android/content/IntentSender.java`:

```java
package android.content;

import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public class IntentSender implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<IntentSender> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<IntentSender>()
    {
        @Override
        public IntentSender createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return readIntentSenderOrNullFromParcel(source);
        }

        @Override
        public IntentSender[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new IntentSender[size];
        }
    };

    private final PendingIntent mPendingIntent;

    public IntentSender(PendingIntent pendingIntent)
    {
        mPendingIntent = pendingIntent;
    }

    public static class SendIntentException extends android.util.AndroidException
    {
        public SendIntentException()
        {
        }

        public SendIntentException(String name)
        {
            super(name);
        }

        public SendIntentException(Exception cause)
        {
            super(cause);
        }
    }

    public interface OnFinished
    {
        void onSendFinished(IntentSender intentSender, Intent intent, int resultCode, String resultData, Bundle resultExtras);
    }

    public void sendIntent(Context context, int code, Intent intent, OnFinished onFinished, Handler handler) throws SendIntentException
    {
        sendIntent(context, code, intent, onFinished, handler, null);
    }

    public void sendIntent(Context context, int code, Intent intent, final OnFinished onFinished, Handler handler,
                           String requiredPermission) throws SendIntentException
    {
        PendingIntent.OnFinished finished = null;
        if (onFinished != null)
        {
            finished = new PendingIntent.OnFinished()
            {
                @Override
                public void onSendFinished(PendingIntent pendingIntent, Intent sent, int resultCode, String resultData,
                                           Bundle resultExtras)
                {
                    onFinished.onSendFinished(IntentSender.this, sent, resultCode, resultData, resultExtras);
                }
            };
        }

        try
        {
            mPendingIntent.send(context, code, intent, finished, handler, requiredPermission, null);
        }
        catch (PendingIntent.CanceledException cancelled)
        {
            throw new SendIntentException(cancelled);
        }
    }

    public PendingIntent getPendingIntent()
    {
        return mPendingIntent;
    }

    public String getTargetPackage()
    {
        return mPendingIntent.getTargetPackage();
    }

    public String getCreatorPackage()
    {
        return mPendingIntent.getCreatorPackage();
    }

    public int getCreatorUid()
    {
        return mPendingIntent.getCreatorUid();
    }

    public android.os.UserHandle getCreatorUserHandle()
    {
        return mPendingIntent.getCreatorUserHandle();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        return other instanceof IntentSender && ((IntentSender)other).mPendingIntent == mPendingIntent;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return System.identityHashCode(mPendingIntent);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "IntentSender{" + Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(this)) + ": " + mPendingIntent + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeValue(mPendingIntent);
    }

    public static void writeIntentSenderOrNullToParcel(IntentSender sender, Parcel out)
    {
        out.writeValue(sender == null ? null : sender.mPendingIntent);
    }

    public static IntentSender readIntentSenderOrNullFromParcel(Parcel in)
    {
        Object value = in.readValue(null);
        return value instanceof PendingIntent ? new IntentSender((PendingIntent)value) : null;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.content;

import android.database.ContentObserver;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;

import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.PrintWriter;

public class Loader<D>
{
    int mId;
    OnLoadCompleteListener<D> mListener;
    OnLoadCanceledListener<D> mOnLoadCanceledListener;
    Context mContext;
    boolean mStarted;
    boolean mAbandoned;
    boolean mReset = true;
    boolean mContentChanged;
    boolean mProcessingChange;

    public final class ForceLoadContentObserver extends ContentObserver
    {
        public ForceLoadContentObserver()
        {
            super(new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()));
        }

        @Override
        public boolean deliverSelfNotifications()
        {
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public void onChange(boolean selfChange)
        {
            onContentChanged();
        }
    }

    public interface OnLoadCompleteListener<D>
    {
        void onLoadComplete(Loader<D> loader, D data);
    }

    public interface OnLoadCanceledListener<D>
    {
        void onLoadCanceled(Loader<D> loader);
    }

    public Loader(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context.getApplicationContext() != null ? context.getApplicationContext() : context;
    }

    public void deliverResult(D data)
    {
        if (mListener != null) mListener.onLoadComplete(this, data);
    }

    public void deliverCancellation()
    {
        if (mOnLoadCanceledListener != null) mOnLoadCanceledListener.onLoadCanceled(this);
    }

    public Context getContext()
    {
        return mContext;
    }

    public int getId()
    {
        return mId;
    }

    public void registerListener(int id, OnLoadCompleteListener<D> listener)
    {
        if (mListener != null) throw new IllegalStateException("There is already a listener registered");

        mListener = listener;
        mId = id;
    }

    public void unregisterListener(OnLoadCompleteListener<D> listener)
    {
        if (mListener == null) throw new IllegalStateException("No listener register");
        if (mListener != listener) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Attempting to unregister the wrong listener");

        mListener = null;
    }

    public void registerOnLoadCanceledListener(OnLoadCanceledListener<D> listener)
    {
        if (mOnLoadCanceledListener != null) throw new IllegalStateException("There is already a listener registered");

        mOnLoadCanceledListener = listener;
    }

    public void unregisterOnLoadCanceledListener(OnLoadCanceledListener<D> listener)
    {
        if (mOnLoadCanceledListener == null) throw new IllegalStateException("No listener register");
        if (mOnLoadCanceledListener != listener) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Attempting to unregister the wrong listener");

        mOnLoadCanceledListener = null;
    }

    public boolean isStarted()
    {
        return mStarted;
    }

    public boolean isAbandoned()
    {
        return mAbandoned;
    }

    public boolean isReset()
    {
        return mReset;
    }

    public final void startLoading()
    {
        mStarted = true;
        mReset = false;
        mAbandoned = false;
        onStartLoading();
    }

    protected void onStartLoading()
    {
    }

    public boolean cancelLoad()
    {
        return onCancelLoad();
    }

    protected boolean onCancelLoad()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void forceLoad()
    {
        onForceLoad();
    }

    protected void onForceLoad()
    {
    }

    public void stopLoading()
    {
        mStarted = false;
        onStopLoading();
    }

    protected void onStopLoading()
    {
    }

    public void abandon()
    {
        mAbandoned = true;
        onAbandon();
    }

    protected void onAbandon()
    {
    }

    public void reset()
    {
        onReset();
        mReset = true;
        mStarted = false;
        mAbandoned = false;
        mContentChanged = false;
        mProcessingChange = false;
    }

    protected void onReset()
    {
    }

    public boolean takeContentChanged()
    {
        boolean changed = mContentChanged;
        mContentChanged = false;
        mProcessingChange |= changed;
        return changed;
    }

    public void commitContentChanged()
    {
        mProcessingChange = false;
    }

    public void rollbackContentChanged()
    {
        if (mProcessingChange) onContentChanged();
    }

    public void onContentChanged()
    {
        if (mStarted)
        {
            forceLoad();
            return;
        }

        mContentChanged = true;
    }

    public String dataToString(D data)
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(64);

        if (data == null)
        {
            builder.append("null");
            return builder.toString();
        }

        builder.append(data.getClass().getSimpleName()).append("{").append(Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(data)))
            .append("}");

        return builder.toString();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return getClass().getSimpleName() + "{" + Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(this)) + " id=" + mId + "}";
    }

    public void dump(String prefix, FileDescriptor fd, PrintWriter writer, String[] args)
    {
        writer.print(prefix);
        writer.print("mId=");
        writer.print(mId);
        writer.print(" mListener=");
        writer.println(mListener);

        if (mStarted || mContentChanged || mProcessingChange)
        {
            writer.print(prefix);
            writer.print("mStarted=");
            writer.print(mStarted);
            writer.print(" mContentChanged=");
            writer.print(mContentChanged);
            writer.print(" mProcessingChange=");
            writer.println(mProcessingChange);
        }

        if (mAbandoned || mReset)
        {
            writer.print(prefix);
            writer.print("mAbandoned=");
            writer.print(mAbandoned);
            writer.print(" mReset=");
            writer.println(mReset);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/content/ProviderCalls.java`:

```java
package android.content;

import android.content.res.AssetFileDescriptor;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.CancellationSignal;
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;

import java.io.FileNotFoundException;
import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException;
import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

final class ProviderCalls
{
    private static final Object NOT_DECLARED = new Object();
    private static final Map<String, Object> sMethods = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private ProviderCalls()
    {
    }

    private static Method find(ContentProvider provider, String name, Class<?>... types)
    {
        StringBuilder key = new StringBuilder(provider.getClass().getName()).append('#').append(name);
        for (Class<?> type : types) key.append(',').append(type.getName());

        String signature = key.toString();
        Object cached = sMethods.get(signature);
        if (cached == null)
        {
            try
            {
                cached = provider.getClass().getMethod(name, types);
            }
            catch (NoSuchMethodException missing)
            {
                cached = NOT_DECLARED;
            }

            sMethods.put(signature, cached);
        }

        return cached == NOT_DECLARED ? null : (Method)cached;
    }

    private static Object invoke(Method method, ContentProvider provider, Object... arguments) throws Exception
    {
        try
        {
            return method.invoke(provider, arguments);
        }
        catch (InvocationTargetException thrown)
        {
            Throwable cause = thrown.getCause();
            if (cause instanceof Exception) throw (Exception)cause;
            if (cause instanceof Error) throw (Error)cause;

            throw new RuntimeException(cause);
        }
    }

    private static RuntimeException unchecked(Exception failure)
    {
        if (failure instanceof RuntimeException) return (RuntimeException)failure;

        return new RuntimeException(failure);
    }

    static Cursor query(ContentProvider provider, Uri uri, String[] projection, Bundle queryArgs, CancellationSignal signal)
    {
        Method bundled = find(provider, "query", Uri.class, String[].class, Bundle.class, CancellationSignal.class);

        try
        {
            if (bundled != null) return (Cursor)invoke(bundled, provider, uri, projection, queryArgs, signal);
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            throw unchecked(failure);
        }

        String selection = queryArgs == null ? null : queryArgs.getString(ContentResolver.QUERY_ARG_SQL_SELECTION);
        String[] selectionArgs = queryArgs == null ? null : queryArgs.getStringArray(ContentResolver.QUERY_ARG_SQL_SELECTION_ARGS);
        return query(provider, uri, projection, selection, selectionArgs, sortOrder(queryArgs), signal);
    }

    static Cursor query(ContentProvider provider, Uri uri, String[] projection, String selection, String[] selectionArgs, String sortOrder,
                        CancellationSignal signal)
    {
        if (signal != null) signal.throwIfCanceled();

        Method signalled = find(provider, "query", Uri.class, String[].class, String.class, String[].class, String.class,
                                CancellationSignal.class);

        try
        {
            if (signalled != null)
            {
                return (Cursor)invoke(signalled, provider, uri, projection, selection, selectionArgs, sortOrder, signal);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            throw unchecked(failure);
        }

        return provider.query(uri, projection, selection, selectionArgs, sortOrder);
    }

    private static String sortOrder(Bundle queryArgs)
    {
        if (queryArgs == null) return null;

        String sortOrder = queryArgs.getString(ContentResolver.QUERY_ARG_SQL_SORT_ORDER);
        if (sortOrder != null) return sortOrder;

        String[] columns = queryArgs.getStringArray(ContentResolver.QUERY_ARG_SORT_COLUMNS);
        if (columns == null || columns.length == 0) return null;

        StringBuilder clause = new StringBuilder(String.join(", ", columns));
        int direction = queryArgs.getInt(ContentResolver.QUERY_ARG_SORT_DIRECTION, -1);
        if (direction == ContentResolver.QUERY_SORT_DIRECTION_ASCENDING) clause.append(" ASC");
        else if (direction == ContentResolver.QUERY_SORT_DIRECTION_DESCENDING) clause.append(" DESC");

        return clause.toString();
    }

        return provider.update(uri, values, selection, selectionArgs);
    }

    static ParcelFileDescriptor openFile(ContentProvider provider, Uri uri, String mode, CancellationSignal signal)
        throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        if (signal != null) signal.throwIfCanceled();

        Method signalled = find(provider, "openFile", Uri.class, String.class, CancellationSignal.class);

        try
        {
            if (signalled != null) return (ParcelFileDescriptor)invoke(signalled, provider, uri, mode, signal);
        }
        catch (FileNotFoundException | RuntimeException failure)
        {
            throw failure;
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            throw unchecked(failure);
        }

        return provider.openFile(uri, mode);
    }

    static AssetFileDescriptor openAssetFile(ContentProvider provider, Uri uri, String mode, CancellationSignal signal)
        throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        Method signalled = find(provider, "openAssetFile", Uri.class, String.class, CancellationSignal.class);
        Method plain = find(provider, "openAssetFile", Uri.class, String.class);

        try
        {
            if (signalled != null) return (AssetFileDescriptor)invoke(signalled, provider, uri, mode, signal);
            if (plain != null) return (AssetFileDescriptor)invoke(plain, provider, uri, mode);
        }
        catch (FileNotFoundException | RuntimeException failure)
        {
            throw failure;
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            throw unchecked(failure);
        }

        ParcelFileDescriptor descriptor = openFile(provider, uri, mode, signal);
        return descriptor == null ? null : new AssetFileDescriptor(descriptor, 0, AssetFileDescriptor.UNKNOWN_LENGTH);
    }

    static AssetFileDescriptor openTypedAssetFile(ContentProvider provider, Uri uri, String mimeTypeFilter, Bundle options,
                                                  CancellationSignal signal) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        Method signalled = find(provider, "openTypedAssetFile", Uri.class, String.class, Bundle.class, CancellationSignal.class);
        Method plain = find(provider, "openTypedAssetFile", Uri.class, String.class, Bundle.class);

        try
        {
            if (signalled != null) return (AssetFileDescriptor)invoke(signalled, provider, uri, mimeTypeFilter, options, signal);
            if (plain != null) return (AssetFileDescriptor)invoke(plain, provider, uri, mimeTypeFilter, options);
        }
        catch (FileNotFoundException | RuntimeException failure)
        {
            throw failure;
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            throw unchecked(failure);
        }

        if ("*/*".equals(mimeTypeFilter)) return openAssetFile(provider, uri, "r", signal);

        String baseType = provider.getType(uri);
        if (baseType != null && ClipDescription.compareMimeTypes(baseType, mimeTypeFilter))
        {
            return openAssetFile(provider, uri, "r", signal);
        }

        throw new FileNotFoundException("Can't open " + uri + " as type " + mimeTypeFilter);
    }

    static ContentProviderResult[] applyBatch(ContentProvider provider, String authority, ArrayList<ContentProviderOperation> operations)
        throws OperationApplicationException
    {
        Method authorized = find(provider, "applyBatch", String.class, ArrayList.class);
        Method plain = find(provider, "applyBatch", ArrayList.class);

        try
        {
            if (authorized != null) return (ContentProviderResult[])invoke(authorized, provider, authority, operations);
            if (plain != null) return (ContentProviderResult[])invoke(plain, provider, operations);
        }
        catch (OperationApplicationException | RuntimeException failure)
        {
            throw failure;
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            throw unchecked(failure);
        }

        int count = operations.size();
        ContentProviderResult[] results = new ContentProviderResult[count];

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            results[index] = operations.get(index).apply(provider, results, index);
        }

        return results;
    }
}
```

```java
        mCurrentValue = source.readString();
        mCurrentValues = (String[])source.readValue(null);
        mRestrictions = (RestrictionEntry[])source.readValue(null);

    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (other == this) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof RestrictionEntry)) return false;

        RestrictionEntry compared = (RestrictionEntry)other;
        if (mType != compared.mType || !Objects.equals(mKey, compared.mKey)) return false;
        if (mCurrentValues == null && compared.mCurrentValues == null && mRestrictions == null && compared.mRestrictions == null)
        {
            return Objects.equals(mCurrentValue, compared.mCurrentValue);
        }

        return Arrays.equals(mCurrentValues, compared.mCurrentValues) && Arrays.equals(mRestrictions, compared.mRestrictions);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        int result = 17;
        result = 31 * result + (mKey == null ? 0 : mKey.hashCode());
        if (mCurrentValue != null) result = 31 * result + mCurrentValue.hashCode();
        else if (mCurrentValues != null) result = 31 * result + Arrays.hashCode(mCurrentValues);
        else if (mRestrictions != null) result = 31 * result + Arrays.hashCode(mRestrictions);

        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeInt(mType);
        destination.writeString(mKey);
        destination.writeString(mTitle);
        destination.writeString(mDescription);
        destination.writeValue(mChoiceEntries);
        destination.writeValue(mChoiceValues);
        destination.writeString(mCurrentValue);
        destination.writeValue(mCurrentValues);
        destination.writeValue(mRestrictions);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "RestrictionEntry{mType=" + mType + ", mKey='" + mKey + "', mTitle='" + mTitle + "', mDescription='" + mDescription
            + "', mChoiceEntries=" + Arrays.toString(mChoiceEntries) + ", mChoiceValues=" + Arrays.toString(mChoiceValues)
            + ", mCurrentValue='" + mCurrentValue + "', mCurrentValues=" + Arrays.toString(mCurrentValues) + ", mRestrictions="
            + Arrays.toString(mRestrictions) + "}";
    }
```

```java
package android.content;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.PersistableBundle;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class RestrictionsManager
{
    public static final String ACTION_PERMISSION_RESPONSE_RECEIVED = "android.content.action.PERMISSION_RESPONSE_RECEIVED";
    public static final String ACTION_REQUEST_LOCAL_APPROVAL = "android.content.action.REQUEST_LOCAL_APPROVAL";
    public static final String ACTION_REQUEST_PERMISSION = "android.content.action.REQUEST_PERMISSION";
    public static final String EXTRA_PACKAGE_NAME = "android.content.extra.PACKAGE_NAME";
    public static final String EXTRA_REQUEST_BUNDLE = "android.content.extra.REQUEST_BUNDLE";
    public static final String EXTRA_REQUEST_ID = "android.content.extra.REQUEST_ID";
    public static final String EXTRA_REQUEST_TYPE = "android.content.extra.REQUEST_TYPE";
    public static final String EXTRA_RESPONSE_BUNDLE = "android.content.extra.RESPONSE_BUNDLE";
    public static final String META_DATA_APP_RESTRICTIONS = "android.content.APP_RESTRICTIONS";
    public static final String REQUEST_KEY_APPROVE_LABEL = "android.request.approve_label";
    public static final String REQUEST_KEY_DATA = "android.request.data";
    public static final String REQUEST_KEY_DENY_LABEL = "android.request.deny_label";
    public static final String REQUEST_KEY_ICON = "android.request.icon";
    public static final String REQUEST_KEY_ID = "android.request.id";
    public static final String REQUEST_KEY_MESSAGE = "android.request.mesg";
    public static final String REQUEST_KEY_NEW_REQUEST = "android.request.new_request";
    public static final String REQUEST_KEY_TITLE = "android.request.title";
    public static final String REQUEST_TYPE_APPROVAL = "android.request.type.approval";
    public static final String RESPONSE_KEY_ERROR_CODE = "android.response.errorcode";
    public static final String RESPONSE_KEY_MESSAGE = "android.response.msg";
    public static final String RESPONSE_KEY_RESPONSE_TIMESTAMP = "android.response.timestamp";
    public static final String RESPONSE_KEY_RESULT = "android.response.result";

    public static final int RESULT_APPROVED = 1;
    public static final int RESULT_DENIED = 2;
    public static final int RESULT_NO_RESPONSE = 3;
    public static final int RESULT_UNKNOWN_REQUEST = 4;
    public static final int RESULT_ERROR = 5;
    public static final int RESULT_ERROR_BAD_REQUEST = 1;
    public static final int RESULT_ERROR_NETWORK = 2;
    public static final int RESULT_ERROR_INTERNAL = 3;

    private final Context mContext;

    public RestrictionsManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public Bundle getApplicationRestrictions()
    {
        return new Bundle();
    }

    public List<Bundle> getApplicationRestrictionsPerAdmin()
    {
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public boolean hasRestrictionsProvider()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void requestPermission(String requestType, String requestId, PersistableBundle request)
    {
        if (requestType == null) throw new NullPointerException("requestType cannot be null");
        if (requestId == null) throw new NullPointerException("requestId cannot be null");
        if (request == null) throw new NullPointerException("request cannot be null");

        throw new IllegalStateException("there is no restrictions provider on this device");
    }

    public Intent createLocalApprovalIntent()
    {
        return null;
    }

    public void notifyPermissionResponse(String packageName, PersistableBundle response)
    {
        if (packageName == null) throw new NullPointerException("packageName cannot be null");
        if (response == null) throw new NullPointerException("request cannot be null");
    }

    public List<RestrictionEntry> getManifestRestrictions(String packageName)
    {
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public static Bundle convertRestrictionsToBundle(List<RestrictionEntry> entries)
    {
        Bundle bundle = new Bundle();

        for (RestrictionEntry entry : entries)
        {
            addRestrictionToBundle(bundle, entry);
        }

        return bundle;
    }

    private static Bundle addRestrictionToBundle(Bundle bundle, RestrictionEntry entry)
    {
        switch (entry.getType())
        {
            case RestrictionEntry.TYPE_BOOLEAN:
                bundle.putBoolean(entry.getKey(), entry.getSelectedState());
                break;
            case RestrictionEntry.TYPE_CHOICE:
            case RestrictionEntry.TYPE_MULTI_SELECT:
                bundle.putStringArray(entry.getKey(), entry.getAllSelectedStrings());
                break;
            case RestrictionEntry.TYPE_INTEGER:
                bundle.putInt(entry.getKey(), entry.getIntValue());
                break;
            case RestrictionEntry.TYPE_STRING:
            case RestrictionEntry.TYPE_NULL:
                bundle.putString(entry.getKey(), entry.getSelectedString());
                break;
            case RestrictionEntry.TYPE_BUNDLE:
                RestrictionEntry[] restrictions = entry.getRestrictions();
                Bundle childBundle = new Bundle();
                if (restrictions != null)
                {
                    for (RestrictionEntry child : restrictions) addRestrictionToBundle(childBundle, child);
                }
                bundle.putBundle(entry.getKey(), childBundle);
                break;
            case RestrictionEntry.TYPE_BUNDLE_ARRAY:
                RestrictionEntry[] bundleRestrictions = entry.getRestrictions();
                Bundle[] bundles = new Bundle[bundleRestrictions == null ? 0 : bundleRestrictions.length];
                for (int index = 0; index < bundles.length; index++)
                {
                    RestrictionEntry[] children = bundleRestrictions[index].getRestrictions();
                    bundles[index] = new Bundle();
                    if (children != null)
                    {
                        for (RestrictionEntry child : children) addRestrictionToBundle(bundles[index], child);
                    }
                }
                bundle.putParcelableArray(entry.getKey(), bundles);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported restrictionEntry type: " + entry.getType());
        }

        return bundle;
    }
}
```

`java/android/content/UriMatcher.java`:

```java
package android.content;

import android.net.Uri;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class UriMatcher
{
    public static final int NO_MATCH = -1;

    private static final int EXACT = 0;
    private static final int NUMBER = 1;
    private static final int TEXT = 2;

    private int mCode;
    private final int mWhich;
    private final String mText;
    private final ArrayList<UriMatcher> mChildren;

    public UriMatcher(int code)
    {
        mCode = code;
        mWhich = -1;
        mChildren = new ArrayList<>();
        mText = null;
    }

    private UriMatcher(int which, String text)
    {
        mCode = NO_MATCH;
        mWhich = which;
        mChildren = new ArrayList<>();
        mText = text;
    }

    public void addURI(String authority, String path, int code)
    {
        if (code < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("code " + code + " is invalid: it must be positive");

        String[] tokens = null;
        if (path != null)
        {
            String newPath = path;
            if (path.length() > 1 && path.charAt(0) == '/') newPath = path.substring(1);
            tokens = newPath.split("/");
        }

        int numTokens = tokens != null ? tokens.length : 0;
        UriMatcher node = this;

        for (int index = -1; index < numTokens; index++)
        {
            String token = index < 0 ? authority : tokens[index];
            ArrayList<UriMatcher> children = node.mChildren;
            int numChildren = children.size();
            UriMatcher child;
            int childIndex;

            for (childIndex = 0; childIndex < numChildren; childIndex++)
            {
                child = children.get(childIndex);
                if (token.equals(child.mText))
                {
                    node = child;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (childIndex == numChildren)
            {
                child = createChild(token);
                node.mChildren.add(child);
                node = child;
            }
        }

        node.mCode = code;
    }

    private static UriMatcher createChild(String token)
    {
        switch (token)
        {
            case "#":
                return new UriMatcher(NUMBER, "#");
            case "*":
                return new UriMatcher(TEXT, "*");
            default:
                return new UriMatcher(EXACT, token);
        }
    }

    public int match(Uri uri)
    {
        List<String> pathSegments = uri.getPathSegments();
        int length = pathSegments.size();

        UriMatcher node = this;

        if (length == 0 && uri.getAuthority() == null) return mCode;

        for (int index = -1; index < length; index++)
        {
            String part = index < 0 ? uri.getAuthority() : pathSegments.get(index);
            ArrayList<UriMatcher> list = node.mChildren;
            if (list == null) break;

            node = null;
            int listSize = list.size();

            for (int childIndex = 0; childIndex < listSize; childIndex++)
            {
                UriMatcher candidate = list.get(childIndex);

                matching:
                switch (candidate.mWhich)
                {
                    case EXACT:
                        if (candidate.mText.equals(part)) node = candidate;
                        break;
                    case NUMBER:
                        int partLength = part.length();
                        for (int position = 0; position < partLength; position++)
                        {
                            char character = part.charAt(position);
                            if (character < '0' || character > '9') break matching;
                        }
                        node = candidate;
                        break;
                    case TEXT:
                        node = candidate;
                        break;
                    default:
                        break;
                }

                if (node != null) break;
            }

            if (node == null) return NO_MATCH;
        }

        return node.mCode;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.content;

import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class UriPermission implements Parcelable
{
    public static final long INVALID_TIME = Long.MIN_VALUE;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<UriPermission> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<UriPermission>()
    {
        @Override
        public UriPermission createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new UriPermission((Uri)source.readValue(null), source.readInt(), source.readLong());
        }

        @Override
        public UriPermission[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new UriPermission[size];
        }
    };

    private final Uri mUri;
    private final int mModeFlags;
    private final long mPersistedTime;

    UriPermission(Uri uri, int modeFlags, long persistedTime)
    {
        mUri = uri;
        mModeFlags = modeFlags;
        mPersistedTime = persistedTime;
    }

    public Uri getUri()
    {
        return mUri;
    }

    public boolean isReadPermission()
    {
        return (mModeFlags & Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION) != 0;
    }

    public boolean isWritePermission()
    {
        return (mModeFlags & Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION) != 0;
    }

    public long getPersistedTime()
    {
        return mPersistedTime;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "UriPermission {uri=" + mUri + ", modeFlags=" + mModeFlags + ", persistedTime=" + mPersistedTime + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeValue(mUri);
        destination.writeInt(mModeFlags);
        destination.writeLong(mPersistedTime);
    }
}
```

```java
        reqKeyboardType = source.reqKeyboardType;
        reqNavigation = source.reqNavigation;
        reqInputFeatures = source.reqInputFeatures;
        reqGlEsVersion = source.reqGlEsVersion;
    }

    {
        return ((reqGlEsVersion & 0xffff0000) >> 16) + "." + (reqGlEsVersion & 0xffff);
    }
```

```java
    public int reqGlEsVersion;
    public int flags;

    public FeatureInfo()
    {
    }

    public FeatureInfo(FeatureInfo original)
    {
        if (original == null) return;

        name = original.name;
        version = original.version;
        reqGlEsVersion = original.reqGlEsVersion;
        flags = original.flags;
    }

    public String getGlEsVersion()
    {
        int major = (reqGlEsVersion & 0xffff0000) >> 16;
        int minor = reqGlEsVersion & 0x0000ffff;
        return major + "." + minor;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int parcelableFlags)
    {
        dest.writeValue(this);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        String identity = Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(this));
        String described = name != null ? name + " v=" + version : "glEsVers=" + getGlEsVersion();

        return "FeatureInfo{" + identity + " " + described + " fl=0x" + Integer.toHexString(flags) + "}";
    }
}
```
