```java
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.UserHandle;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class LauncherApps
{
    public static abstract class Callback
    {
        public abstract void onPackageRemoved(String packageName, UserHandle user);

        public abstract void onPackageAdded(String packageName, UserHandle user);

        public abstract void onPackageChanged(String packageName, UserHandle user);

        public abstract void onPackagesAvailable(String[] packageNames, UserHandle user, boolean replacing);

        public abstract void onPackagesUnavailable(String[] packageNames, UserHandle user, boolean replacing);

        public void onPackagesSuspended(String[] packageNames, UserHandle user)
        {
        }

        public void onPackagesUnsuspended(String[] packageNames, UserHandle user)
        {
        }

        public void onShortcutsChanged(String packageName, List<ShortcutInfo> shortcuts, UserHandle user)
        {
        }
    }

    private static final String TAG = "LauncherApps";

    private final Context mContext;
    private final List<Callback> mCallbacks = new ArrayList<>();

    public LauncherApps(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public List<LauncherActivityInfo> getActivityList(String packageName, UserHandle user)
    {
        List<LauncherActivityInfo> activities = new ArrayList<>();
        PackageManager packageManager = mContext == null ? null : mContext.getPackageManager();
        if (packageManager == null) return activities;

        for (runtime.Packages.Entry entry : runtime.Packages.installed())
        {
            if (packageName != null && !packageName.equals(entry.packageName)) continue;

            ApplicationInfo info = PackageManager.describeInstalled(entry);
            ComponentName component = new ComponentName(entry.packageName, PackageManager.LAUNCH_ALIAS);

            activities.add(new LauncherActivityInfo(packageManager, component, info, entry.label, android.os.Process.myUserHandle()));
        }

        return activities;
    }

    public LauncherActivityInfo resolveActivity(Intent intent, UserHandle user)
    {
        if (intent == null || intent.getComponent() == null) return null;

        List<LauncherActivityInfo> activities = getActivityList(intent.getComponent().getPackageName(), user);
        return activities.isEmpty() ? null : activities.get(0);
    }

    public void startMainActivity(ComponentName component, UserHandle user, Rect sourceBounds, Bundle options)
    {
        if (component == null) return;

        Intent intent = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN);
        intent.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER);
        intent.setComponent(component);
        intent.setPackage(component.getPackageName());
        intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);

        if (mContext != null) mContext.startActivity(intent);
    }

    public boolean isPackageEnabled(String packageName, UserHandle user)
    {
        return runtime.Packages.find(packageName) != null;
    }

    public boolean isActivityEnabled(ComponentName component, UserHandle user)
    {
        return component != null && isPackageEnabled(component.getPackageName(), user);
    }

    public ApplicationInfo getApplicationInfo(String packageName, int flags, UserHandle user) throws PackageManager.NameNotFoundException
    {
        runtime.Packages.Entry entry = runtime.Packages.find(packageName);
        if (entry == null) throw new PackageManager.NameNotFoundException(packageName);

        return PackageManager.describeInstalled(entry);
    }

    public List<UserHandle> getProfiles()
    {
        List<UserHandle> profiles = new ArrayList<>();
        profiles.add(android.os.Process.myUserHandle());
        return profiles;
    }

    public boolean hasShortcutHostPermission()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public static class ShortcutQuery
    {
        public static final int FLAG_MATCH_DYNAMIC = 1 << 0;
        public static final int FLAG_MATCH_PINNED = 1 << 1;
        public static final int FLAG_MATCH_MANIFEST = 1 << 3;
        public static final int FLAG_MATCH_CACHED = 1 << 4;
        public static final int FLAG_GET_KEY_FIELDS_ONLY = 1 << 2;
        public static final int FLAG_MATCH_PINNED_BY_ANY_LAUNCHER = 1 << 10;

        private long mChangedSince;
        private String mPackage;
        private List<String> mShortcutIds;

            return this;

            return this;

            return this;

            return this;

        return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
    }

    {
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public void registerCallback(Callback callback)
    {
        registerCallback(callback, null);
    }

    {
        if (callback == null || mCallbacks.contains(callback)) return;
```

```java
package android.content.pm;

import android.os.Bundle;

public class PackageItemInfo
{
    public String name;
    public String packageName;
    public Bundle metaData;
    public int labelRes;
    public int icon;
    public int logo;
    public int banner;
    public CharSequence nonLocalizedLabel;

    public PackageItemInfo()
    {
    }

    public PackageItemInfo(PackageItemInfo original)
    {
        if (original == null) return;

        name = original.name;
        packageName = original.packageName;
        metaData = original.metaData;
        labelRes = original.labelRes;
        icon = original.icon;
        logo = original.logo;
        banner = original.banner;
        nonLocalizedLabel = original.nonLocalizedLabel;
    }

    protected PackageItemInfo(android.os.Parcel source)
    {
        this(source == null ? null : castOrNull(source.readValue(null)));
    }

    private static PackageItemInfo castOrNull(Object value)
    {
        return value instanceof PackageItemInfo ? (PackageItemInfo)value : null;
    }

    public CharSequence loadLabel(PackageManager packageManager)
    {
        if (nonLocalizedLabel != null) return nonLocalizedLabel;

        if (labelRes != 0 && packageManager != null)
        {
            CharSequence label = packageManager.getText(packageName, labelRes, null);
            if (label != null) return label.toString().trim();
        }

        if (name != null) return name;

        return packageName;
    }

    public android.graphics.drawable.Drawable loadIcon(PackageManager packageManager)
    {
        if (packageManager == null) return null;

        if (icon != 0)
        {
            android.graphics.drawable.Drawable drawable = packageManager.getDrawable(packageName, icon, null);
            if (drawable != null) return drawable;
        }

        return packageManager.getDefaultActivityIcon();
    }

    public android.graphics.drawable.Drawable loadUnbadgedIcon(PackageManager packageManager)
    {
        return loadIcon(packageManager);
    }

    public android.graphics.drawable.Drawable loadBanner(PackageManager packageManager)
    {
        if (packageManager == null || banner == 0) return null;

        return packageManager.getDrawable(packageName, banner, null);
    }

    public android.graphics.drawable.Drawable loadLogo(PackageManager packageManager)
    {
        if (packageManager == null || logo == 0) return null;

        return packageManager.getDrawable(packageName, logo, null);
    }

    public android.content.res.XmlResourceParser loadXmlMetaData(PackageManager packageManager, String name)
    {
        if (metaData == null || packageManager == null) return null;

        int resourceId = metaData.getInt(name);
        if (resourceId == 0) return null;

        return packageManager.getXml(packageName, resourceId, null);
    }

    public void writeToParcel(android.os.Parcel dest, int parcelableFlags)
    {
        dest.writeValue(this);
    }
}
```

```java
    public PackageInfo getPackageInfo(String packageName, int flags) throws NameNotFoundException
    {
        if (packageName != null && !packageName.equals(mApplicationInfo.packageName))
        {
            throw new NameNotFoundException(packageName);
        }

        PackageInfo info = new PackageInfo();
        info.packageName = mApplicationInfo.packageName;
        info.applicationInfo = mApplicationInfo;
        long code = runtime.Bootstrap.nativeVersionCode();
        String name = runtime.Bootstrap.nativeVersionName();

        info.versionName = name != null && !name.isEmpty() ? name : null;
        info.versionCode = (int)code;
        info.longVersionCode = code;
        info.firstInstallTime = 0L;
        info.lastUpdateTime = 0L;
        info.splitNames = mApplicationInfo.splitNames;

        info.requestedPermissions = runtime.Permissions.declared();
        info.requestedPermissionsFlags = new int[info.requestedPermissions.length];

        for (int index = 0; index < info.requestedPermissions.length; index++)
        {
            boolean granted = runtime.Permissions.check(info.requestedPermissions[index]) == PERMISSION_GRANTED;
            info.requestedPermissionsFlags[index] = granted ? PackageInfo.REQUESTED_PERMISSION_GRANTED : 0;
        }

        Signature[] signatures = signatures();

        if ((flags & GET_SIGNATURES) != 0) info.signatures = signatures;
        if ((flags & GET_SIGNING_CERTIFICATES) != 0) info.signingInfo = new SigningInfo(signatures, signatures.length > 1);

        if ((flags & GET_ACTIVITIES) != 0) info.activities = mActivities.toArray(new ActivityInfo[0]);
        if ((flags & GET_PROVIDERS) != 0) info.providers = mProviders.toArray(new ProviderInfo[0]);

        if ((flags & GET_SERVICES) != 0)
        {
            List<ServiceInfo> services = new ArrayList<>();
            for (runtime.Components.Record record : runtime.Components.declared(runtime.Components.SERVICE))
            {
                services.add(describeService(record, flags));
            }
            info.services = services.toArray(new ServiceInfo[0]);
        }

        if ((flags & GET_RECEIVERS) != 0)
        {
            List<ActivityInfo> receivers = new ArrayList<>();
            for (runtime.Components.Record record : runtime.Components.declared(runtime.Components.RECEIVER))
            {
                receivers.add(describeReceiver(record, flags));
            }
            info.receivers = receivers.toArray(new ActivityInfo[0]);
        }

        if ((flags & GET_CONFIGURATIONS) != 0) info.reqFeatures = new FeatureInfo[0];

        return info;
    }

    private static Signature[] signatures()
    {
        if (sSignatures != null) return sSignatures;

        int count = runtime.Bootstrap.nativeSignatureCount();
        Signature[] signatures = new Signature[Math.max(count, 0)];

        for (int index = 0; index < signatures.length; index++)
        {
            signatures[index] = new Signature(runtime.Bootstrap.nativeSignatureAt(index));
        }

        sSignatures = signatures;

        return signatures;
    }

    private static Signature[] sSignatures;

    static ApplicationInfo describeInstalled(runtime.Packages.Entry entry)
    {
        ApplicationInfo info = new ApplicationInfo();
        info.packageName = entry.packageName;
        info.name = entry.label;
        info.sourceDir = entry.archivePath;
        info.publicSourceDir = entry.archivePath;
        info.dataDir = null;
        info.targetSdkVersion = entry.targetSdkVersion;
        info.enabled = true;
        info.flags = ApplicationInfo.FLAG_INSTALLED;
        return info;
    }

    public java.util.List<PackageInfo> getInstalledPackages(int flags)
    {
        java.util.List<PackageInfo> packages = new java.util.ArrayList<>();

        try
        {
            packages.add(getPackageInfo(mApplicationInfo.packageName, flags));
        }
        catch (NameNotFoundException impossible)
        {
            android.util.Log.w(TAG, "this package cannot describe itself", impossible);
        }

        for (runtime.Packages.Entry entry : runtime.Packages.installed())
        {
            if (entry.packageName.equals(mApplicationInfo.packageName)) continue;

            PackageInfo info = new PackageInfo();
            info.packageName = entry.packageName;
            info.applicationInfo = describeInstalled(entry);
            packages.add(info);
        }

        return packages;
    }

    public java.util.List<PackageInfo> getPackagesHoldingPermissions(String[] permissions, int flags)
    {
        java.util.List<PackageInfo> holders = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        if (permissions == null) return holders;

        for (String permission : permissions)
        {
            if (runtime.Permissions.check(permission) != PERMISSION_GRANTED) continue;

            try
            {
                holders.add(getPackageInfo(mApplicationInfo.packageName, flags));
            }
            catch (NameNotFoundException impossible)
            {
                android.util.Log.w(TAG, "this package cannot describe itself", impossible);
            }

            break;
        }

        return holders;
    }

    public int checkSignatures(String firstPackage, String secondPackage)
    {
        boolean firstKnown = isSelf(firstPackage) || runtime.Packages.find(firstPackage) != null;
        boolean secondKnown = isSelf(secondPackage) || runtime.Packages.find(secondPackage) != null;
        if (!firstKnown || !secondKnown) return SIGNATURE_UNKNOWN_PACKAGE;

        if (isSelf(firstPackage) && isSelf(secondPackage)) return signatures().length == 0 ? SIGNATURE_NEITHER_SIGNED : SIGNATURE_MATCH;

        return SIGNATURE_NO_MATCH;
    }

    public int checkSignatures(int firstUid, int secondUid)
    {
        String[] first = getPackagesForUid(firstUid);
        String[] second = getPackagesForUid(secondUid);
        if (first == null || second == null) return SIGNATURE_UNKNOWN_PACKAGE;

        return checkSignatures(first[0], second[0]);
    }

    public boolean hasSigningCertificate(String packageName, byte[] certificate, int type)
    {
        if (!isSelf(packageName) || certificate == null) return false;

        for (Signature signature : signatures())
        {
            byte[] encoded = signature.toByteArray();

            if (type == CERT_INPUT_RAW_X509 && java.util.Arrays.equals(encoded, certificate)) return true;
            if (type == CERT_INPUT_SHA256 && java.util.Arrays.equals(digest("SHA-256", encoded), certificate)) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean hasSigningCertificate(int uid, byte[] certificate, int type)
    {
        String[] packages = getPackagesForUid(uid);
        return packages != null && hasSigningCertificate(packages[0], certificate, type);
    }

    private static byte[] digest(String algorithm, byte[] data)
    {
        try
        {
            return java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance(algorithm).digest(data);
        }
        catch (java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException missing)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public void requestChecksums(String packageName, boolean includeSplits, int required,
                                 List<java.security.cert.Certificate> trustedInstallers, OnChecksumsReadyListener onChecksumsReadyListener)
            throws java.security.cert.CertificateEncodingException, NameNotFoundException
    {
        if (onChecksumsReadyListener == null) throw new NullPointerException("onChecksumsReadyListener");
        if (!isSelf(packageName)) throw new NameNotFoundException(packageName);

        final List<ApkChecksum> checksums = new ArrayList<>();
        checksumFile(checksums, null, mApplicationInfo.sourceDir, required);

        if (includeSplits && mApplicationInfo.splitSourceDirs != null)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < mApplicationInfo.splitSourceDirs.length; index++)
            {
                String splitName = mApplicationInfo.splitNames == null ? null : mApplicationInfo.splitNames[index];
                checksumFile(checksums, splitName, mApplicationInfo.splitSourceDirs[index], required);
            }
        }

        final OnChecksumsReadyListener listener = onChecksumsReadyListener;
        android.os.Looper main = android.os.Looper.getMainLooper();

        if (main == null)
        {
            listener.onChecksumsReady(checksums);
            return;
        }

        new android.os.Handler(main).post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                listener.onChecksumsReady(checksums);
            }
        });
    }

    private static final int[] CHECKSUM_TYPES = {2, 4, 8, 16};
    private static final String[] CHECKSUM_ALGORITHMS = {"MD5", "SHA-1", "SHA-256", "SHA-512"};

    private static void checksumFile(List<ApkChecksum> checksums, String splitName, String path, int required)
    {
        if (path == null) return;

        for (int index = 0; index < CHECKSUM_TYPES.length; index++)
        {
            if ((required & CHECKSUM_TYPES[index]) == 0) continue;

            try (java.io.InputStream input = new java.io.FileInputStream(path))
            {
                java.security.MessageDigest digest = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance(CHECKSUM_ALGORITHMS[index]);
                byte[] buffer = new byte[64 * 1024];
                int read;

                while ((read = input.read(buffer)) > 0) digest.update(buffer, 0, read);

                checksums.add(new ApkChecksum(splitName, CHECKSUM_TYPES[index], digest.digest()));
            }
            catch (java.io.IOException | java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException unreadable)
            {
                android.util.Log.w(TAG, "could not checksum " + path, unreadable);
            }
        }
    }

    private android.graphics.drawable.Drawable loadInstalledIcon(String packageName)
    {
        runtime.Packages.Entry entry = runtime.Packages.find(packageName);
        if (entry == null || entry.iconPath == null || entry.iconPath.isEmpty()) return null;

        try
        {
            android.graphics.Bitmap bitmap = android.graphics.BitmapFactory.decodeFile(entry.iconPath);
            if (bitmap == null) return null;

            return new android.graphics.drawable.BitmapDrawable(null, bitmap);
        }
        catch (Throwable unreadable)
        {
            android.util.Log.w(TAG, "the icon for " + packageName + " did not decode", unreadable);
            return null;
        }
    }

    public PermissionInfo getPermissionInfo(String permissionName, int flags) throws NameNotFoundException
    {
        if (permissionName == null) throw new NameNotFoundException("null");

        boolean platform = permissionName.startsWith("android.permission.");
        if (!platform && !runtime.Permissions.isDeclared(permissionName)) throw new NameNotFoundException(permissionName);

        PermissionInfo info = new PermissionInfo();
        info.name = permissionName;
        info.packageName = platform ? SYSTEM_PACKAGE : mApplicationInfo.packageName;
        info.protectionLevel = runtime.Permissions.isDangerous(permissionName) ? PermissionInfo.PROTECTION_DANGEROUS
                                                                               : PermissionInfo.PROTECTION_NORMAL;
        info.flags = PermissionInfo.FLAG_INSTALLED;

        return info;
    }

    public ProviderInfo resolveContentProvider(String authority, int flags)
    {
        if (authority == null) return null;

        for (ProviderInfo provider : mProviders)
        {
            if (provider.authority == null) continue;

            for (String declared : provider.authority.split(";"))
            {
                if (authority.equals(declared)) return provider;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    public ProviderInfo resolveContentProvider(String authority, ComponentInfoFlags flags)
    {
        return resolveContentProvider(authority, flags == null ? 0 : (int)flags.getValue());
    }

    public java.util.List<ResolveInfo> queryIntentContentProviders(android.content.Intent intent, int flags)
    {
        java.util.List<ResolveInfo> matches = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        if (intent == null) return matches;

        ComponentName component = intent.getComponent();
        String targetPackage = component != null ? component.getPackageName() : intent.getPackage();
        if (targetPackage != null && !isSelf(targetPackage)) return matches;

        for (ProviderInfo provider : mProviders)
        {
            if (component == null || !provider.name.equals(component.getClassName())) continue;

            ResolveInfo resolved = new ResolveInfo();
            resolved.providerInfo = provider;
            matches.add(resolved);
        }

        return matches;
    }

    public java.util.List<ResolveInfo> queryIntentContentProviders(android.content.Intent intent, ResolveInfoFlags flags)
    {
        return queryIntentContentProviders(intent, flags == null ? 0 : (int)flags.getValue());

    public ProviderInfo getProviderInfo(ComponentName component, int flags) throws NameNotFoundException

        for (ProviderInfo provider : mProviders)

            if (provider.name.equals(component.getClassName())) return provider;
        }
        throw new NameNotFoundException(component.getClassName());

    private ServiceInfo describeService(runtime.Components.Record record, int flags)
    {
        ServiceInfo service = new ServiceInfo();
        service.name = record.className;
        service.packageName = mApplicationInfo.packageName;
        service.applicationInfo = mApplicationInfo;
        service.processName = mApplicationInfo.processName;

        if ((flags & GET_META_DATA) != 0) service.metaData = record.metaData;

        return service;
    }

    private ActivityInfo describeReceiver(runtime.Components.Record record, int flags)
    {
        ActivityInfo receiver = new ActivityInfo();
        receiver.name = record.className;
        receiver.packageName = mApplicationInfo.packageName;
        receiver.applicationInfo = mApplicationInfo;
        receiver.processName = mApplicationInfo.processName;

        if ((flags & GET_META_DATA) != 0) receiver.metaData = record.metaData;

        return receiver;
    }

    public ServiceInfo getServiceInfo(ComponentName component, int flags) throws NameNotFoundException
    {
        for (runtime.Components.Record record : runtime.Components.declared(runtime.Components.SERVICE))
        {
            if (record.className.equals(component.getClassName())) return describeService(record, flags);
        }

        throw new NameNotFoundException(component.getClassName());
    }

    public ServiceInfo getServiceInfo(ComponentName component, ComponentInfoFlags flags) throws NameNotFoundException
    {
        return getServiceInfo(component, flags == null ? 0 : (int)flags.getValue());
    }

    public ActivityInfo getReceiverInfo(ComponentName component, int flags) throws NameNotFoundException
    {
        for (runtime.Components.Record record : runtime.Components.declared(runtime.Components.RECEIVER))
        {
            if (record.className.equals(component.getClassName())) return describeReceiver(record, flags);
        }

        throw new NameNotFoundException(component.getClassName());
    }

    public ActivityInfo getActivityInfo(ComponentName component, int flags) throws NameNotFoundException
    {
        for (ActivityInfo activity : mActivities)
        {
            if (activity.name.equals(component.getClassName())) return activity;
        }

        for (runtime.Components.Record record : runtime.Components.declared(runtime.Components.ACTIVITY))
        {
            if (!record.className.equals(component.getClassName())) continue;

            ActivityInfo activity = describeReceiver(record, flags);
            activity.theme = mApplicationInfo.theme;
            return activity;
        }

        throw new NameNotFoundException(component.getClassName());
    }

    public ActivityInfo getActivityInfo(ComponentName component, ComponentInfoFlags flags) throws NameNotFoundException
    {
        return getActivityInfo(component, flags == null ? 0 : (int)flags.getValue());
    }

    private final java.util.Map<String, Integer> mComponentState = new java.util.HashMap<>();

    public void setComponentEnabledSetting(ComponentName component, int newState, int flags)
    {
        if (component == null) return;

        mComponentState.put(component.flattenToString(), newState);
        android.util.Log.i(TAG, "component " + component.getClassName() + " set to state " + newState);
    }

    public void setComponentEnabledSettings(List<ComponentEnabledSetting> settings)
    {
        if (settings == null) return;

        for (ComponentEnabledSetting setting : settings)
        {
            setComponentEnabledSetting(setting.getComponentName(), setting.getEnabledState(), setting.getEnabledFlags());
        }
    }

    public int getComponentEnabledSetting(ComponentName component)
    {
        if (component == null) return COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE_DEFAULT;

        Integer state = mComponentState.get(component.flattenToString());
        return state == null ? COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE_DEFAULT : state;
    }

    public java.util.List<ResolveInfo> queryIntentActivities(android.content.Intent intent, int flags)
    {
        java.util.List<ResolveInfo> matches = resolveAll(runtime.Components.ACTIVITY, intent);

        if (!isLauncherQuery(intent)) return matches;

        for (runtime.Packages.Entry entry : runtime.Packages.installed())
        {
            if (mApplicationInfo != null && entry.packageName.equals(mApplicationInfo.packageName)) continue;

            ResolveInfo resolved = new ResolveInfo();
            resolved.activityInfo = new ActivityInfo();
            resolved.activityInfo.name = LAUNCH_ALIAS;
            resolved.activityInfo.packageName = entry.packageName;
            resolved.activityInfo.applicationInfo = describeInstalled(entry);
            matches.add(resolved);
        }

        return matches;
    }

    public java.util.List<ResolveInfo> queryIntentActivities(android.content.Intent intent, ResolveInfoFlags flags)
    {
        return queryIntentActivities(intent, flags == null ? 0 : (int)flags.getValue());
    }

    public java.util.List<ResolveInfo> queryIntentActivityOptions(ComponentName caller, android.content.Intent[] specifics,
                                                                   android.content.Intent intent, int flags)
    {
        java.util.List<ResolveInfo> results = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        java.util.Set<String> seen = new java.util.HashSet<>();

        if (specifics != null)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < specifics.length; index++)
            {
                android.content.Intent specific = specifics[index];
                if (specific == null) continue;

                ResolveInfo resolved = resolveActivity(specific, flags);
                if (resolved == null || resolved.activityInfo == null) continue;

                String key = resolved.activityInfo.packageName + "/" + resolved.activityInfo.name;
                if (caller != null && key.equals(caller.getPackageName() + "/" + caller.getClassName())) continue;
                if (!seen.add(key)) continue;

                resolved.specificIndex = index;
                results.add(resolved);
            }
        }

        for (ResolveInfo resolved : queryIntentActivities(intent, flags))
        {
            if (resolved.activityInfo == null) continue;

            String key = resolved.activityInfo.packageName + "/" + resolved.activityInfo.name;
            if (caller != null && key.equals(caller.getPackageName() + "/" + caller.getClassName())) continue;
            if (!seen.add(key)) continue;

            results.add(resolved);
        }

        return results;
    }

    static final String LAUNCH_ALIAS = "android.intent.action.MAIN";

    private static boolean isLauncherQuery(android.content.Intent intent)
    {
        if (intent == null) return false;
        if (!android.content.Intent.ACTION_MAIN.equals(intent.getAction())) return false;

        java.util.Set<String> categories = intent.getCategories();
        return categories != null && categories.contains(android.content.Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER);
    }

    public ResolveInfo resolveActivity(android.content.Intent intent, int flags)
    {
        java.util.List<ResolveInfo> matches = queryIntentActivities(intent, flags);
        return matches.isEmpty() ? null : matches.get(0);
    }

    public ResolveInfo resolveActivity(android.content.Intent intent, ResolveInfoFlags flags)
    {
        return resolveActivity(intent, flags == null ? 0 : (int)flags.getValue());
    }

    public ResolveInfo resolveService(android.content.Intent intent, int flags)
    {
        java.util.List<ResolveInfo> matches = queryIntentServices(intent, flags);
        return matches.isEmpty() ? null : matches.get(0);
    }

    public ResolveInfo resolveService(android.content.Intent intent, ResolveInfoFlags flags)
    {
        return resolveService(intent, flags == null ? 0 : (int)flags.getValue());
    }

    public android.content.Intent getLaunchIntentForPackage(String packageName)
    {
        if (packageName == null || packageName.isEmpty()) return null;

        if (isSelf(packageName))
        {
            android.content.Intent main = new android.content.Intent(android.content.Intent.ACTION_MAIN);
            main.addCategory(android.content.Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER);
            main.setPackage(packageName);

            for (ResolveInfo resolved : resolveAll(runtime.Components.ACTIVITY, main))
            {
                if (resolved.activityInfo == null) continue;

                android.content.Intent intent = new android.content.Intent(android.content.Intent.ACTION_MAIN);
                intent.addCategory(android.content.Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER);
                intent.setClassName(packageName, resolved.activityInfo.name);
                intent.addFlags(android.content.Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
                return intent;
            }
        }

        if (runtime.Packages.find(packageName) == null) return null;

        android.content.Intent intent = new android.content.Intent(android.content.Intent.ACTION_MAIN);
        intent.addCategory(android.content.Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER);
        intent.setComponent(new ComponentName(packageName, LAUNCH_ALIAS));
        intent.setPackage(packageName);
        intent.addFlags(android.content.Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);

        return intent;
    }

    public android.content.Intent getLeanbackLaunchIntentForPackage(String packageName)
    {
        return null;
    }

    private ActivityInfo declaredActivity(String className)
    {
        for (ActivityInfo activity : mActivities)
        {
            if (activity.name != null && activity.name.equals(className)) return activity;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private java.util.List<ResolveInfo> resolveAll(int kind, android.content.Intent intent)
    {
        java.util.List<ResolveInfo> matches = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        String packageName = mApplicationInfo == null ? null : mApplicationInfo.packageName;

        if (intent != null)
        {
            String targetPackage = intent.getComponent() != null ? intent.getComponent().getPackageName() : intent.getPackage();
            if (targetPackage != null && packageName != null && !targetPackage.equals(packageName)) return matches;
        }

        for (runtime.Components.Record record : runtime.Components.resolveAll(kind, intent))
        {
            ResolveInfo resolved = new ResolveInfo();

            if (kind == runtime.Components.SERVICE)
            {
                resolved.serviceInfo = new ServiceInfo();
                resolved.serviceInfo.name = record.className;
                resolved.serviceInfo.packageName = packageName;
                resolved.serviceInfo.applicationInfo = mApplicationInfo;
            }
            else if (kind == runtime.Components.ACTIVITY)
            {
                ActivityInfo declared = declaredActivity(record.className);

                if (declared != null)
                {
                    resolved.activityInfo = declared;
                }
                else
                {
                    resolved.activityInfo = new ActivityInfo();
                    resolved.activityInfo.name = record.className;
                    resolved.activityInfo.packageName = packageName;
                    resolved.activityInfo.applicationInfo = mApplicationInfo;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                resolved.activityInfo = new ActivityInfo();
                resolved.activityInfo.name = record.className;
                resolved.activityInfo.packageName = packageName;
                resolved.activityInfo.applicationInfo = mApplicationInfo;
            }

            if (record.filters != null && record.filters.length > 0)
            {
                resolved.filter = record.filters[0];
                resolved.priority = record.filters[0].getPriority();
                resolved.isDefault = record.filters[0].hasCategory(android.content.Intent.CATEGORY_DEFAULT);
            }

            matches.add(resolved);
        }

        return matches;
    }

    private static final String[] PRESENT_FEATURES = {
        FEATURE_TOUCHSCREEN, FEATURE_TOUCHSCREEN_MULTITOUCH, FEATURE_TOUCHSCREEN_MULTITOUCH_DISTINCT,
        FEATURE_FAKETOUCH, FEATURE_SCREEN_PORTRAIT, FEATURE_SCREEN_LANDSCAPE, FEATURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT, FEATURE_INPUT_METHODS,

    };

    public boolean hasSystemFeature(String name)
    {
        if (name == null) return false;

        for (String present : PRESENT_FEATURES)
        {
            if (present.equals(name)) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean hasSystemFeature(String name, int version)
    {
        return hasSystemFeature(name);
    }

    public FeatureInfo[] getSystemAvailableFeatures()
    {
        FeatureInfo[] features = new FeatureInfo[PRESENT_FEATURES.length + 1];

        for (int index = 0; index < PRESENT_FEATURES.length; index++)
        {
            FeatureInfo feature = new FeatureInfo();
            feature.name = PRESENT_FEATURES[index];
            features[index] = feature;
        }

        FeatureInfo graphics = new FeatureInfo();
        graphics.reqGlEsVersion = packGlEsVersion(runtime.PlatformConfig.GL_ES_VERSION);
        features[PRESENT_FEATURES.length] = graphics;

        return features;
    }

    private static int packGlEsVersion(String version)
    {
        int dot = version == null ? -1 : version.indexOf('.');
        if (dot <= 0) return FeatureInfo.GL_ES_VERSION_UNDEFINED;

        try
        {
            int major = Integer.parseInt(version.substring(0, dot));
            int minor = Integer.parseInt(version.substring(dot + 1));
            return (major << 16) | (minor & 0xffff);
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
        {
            return FeatureInfo.GL_ES_VERSION_UNDEFINED;
        }
    }

    {
        return new String[0];
    }
```

```java
package android.content.pm;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public class PackageStats implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<PackageStats> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<PackageStats>()
    {
        @Override
        public PackageStats createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new PackageStats(source);
        }

        @Override
        public PackageStats[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new PackageStats[size];
        }
    };

    public String packageName;
    public long codeSize;
    public long dataSize;
    public long cacheSize;
    public long externalCodeSize;
    public long externalDataSize;
    public long externalCacheSize;
    public long externalMediaSize;
    public long externalObbSize;

    public PackageStats(String packageName)
    {
        this.packageName = packageName;
    }

    public PackageStats(Parcel source)
    {
        Object value = source == null ? null : source.readValue(null);
        if (value instanceof PackageStats) copyFrom((PackageStats)value);
    }

    public PackageStats(PackageStats original)
    {
        if (original != null) copyFrom(original);
    }

    private void copyFrom(PackageStats original)
    {
        packageName = original.packageName;
        codeSize = original.codeSize;
        dataSize = original.dataSize;
        cacheSize = original.cacheSize;
        externalCodeSize = original.externalCodeSize;
        externalDataSize = original.externalDataSize;
        externalCacheSize = original.externalCacheSize;
        externalMediaSize = original.externalMediaSize;
        externalObbSize = original.externalObbSize;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "PackageStats{" + Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(this)) + " " + packageName + " code=" + codeSize + ",data="
               + dataSize + ",cache=" + cacheSize + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int parcelableFlags)
    {
        dest.writeValue(new PackageStats(this));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof PackageStats)) return false;

        PackageStats stats = (PackageStats)other;
        return java.util.Objects.equals(packageName, stats.packageName) && codeSize == stats.codeSize && dataSize == stats.dataSize
               && cacheSize == stats.cacheSize && externalCodeSize == stats.externalCodeSize
               && externalDataSize == stats.externalDataSize && externalCacheSize == stats.externalCacheSize
               && externalMediaSize == stats.externalMediaSize && externalObbSize == stats.externalObbSize;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return java.util.Objects.hash(packageName, codeSize, dataSize, cacheSize, externalCodeSize, externalDataSize, externalCacheSize,
                                      externalMediaSize, externalObbSize);
    }
}
```

```java
    public static final int PROTECTION_FLAG_PRIVILEGED = 0x10;
    public static final int PROTECTION_FLAG_SYSTEM = 0x10;
    public static final int PROTECTION_FLAG_DEVELOPMENT = 0x20;
    public static final int PROTECTION_FLAG_APPOP = 0x40;
    public static final int PROTECTION_FLAG_PRE23 = 0x80;
    public static final int PROTECTION_FLAG_INSTALLER = 0x100;
    public static final int PROTECTION_FLAG_VERIFIER = 0x200;
    public static final int PROTECTION_FLAG_PREINSTALLED = 0x400;
    public static final int PROTECTION_FLAG_SETUP = 0x800;
    public static final int PROTECTION_FLAG_INSTANT = 0x1000;
    public static final int PROTECTION_FLAG_RUNTIME_ONLY = 0x2000;
    public static final int PROTECTION_MASK_BASE = 0xf;
    public static final int PROTECTION_MASK_FLAGS = 0xfff0;

    public static final int FLAG_COSTS_MONEY = 1 << 0;
    public static final int FLAG_HARD_RESTRICTED = 1 << 2;
    public static final int FLAG_SOFT_RESTRICTED = 1 << 3;
    public static final int FLAG_IMMUTABLY_RESTRICTED = 1 << 4;
    public static final int FLAG_INSTALLED = 1 << 30;

            return value instanceof PermissionInfo ? new PermissionInfo((PermissionInfo)value) : new PermissionInfo();

            return new PermissionInfo[size];
        }
    };

    public CharSequence nonLocalizedDescription;

    {
    }

    {
        super(original);
        if (original == null) return;

        protectionLevel = original.protectionLevel;
        group = original.group;
        flags = original.flags;
        descriptionRes = original.descriptionRes;
        nonLocalizedDescription = original.nonLocalizedDescription;
    }

    public CharSequence loadDescription(PackageManager packageManager)
    {
        if (nonLocalizedDescription != null) return nonLocalizedDescription;
        if (descriptionRes == 0 || packageManager == null) return null;

        return packageManager.getText(packageName, descriptionRes, null);
    }

    {

        dest.writeValue(this);
    }

    {
        return "PermissionInfo{" + Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(this)) + " " + name + "}";
    }
```

```java
        serviceInfo = original.serviceInfo;
        providerInfo = original.providerInfo;
        filter = original.filter;
        priority = original.priority;
        preferredOrder = original.preferredOrder;
        match = original.match;
        specificIndex = original.specificIndex;
        isDefault = original.isDefault;
        labelRes = original.labelRes;
        nonLocalizedLabel = original.nonLocalizedLabel;
        icon = original.icon;
        resolvePackageName = original.resolvePackageName;
        isInstantAppAvailable = original.isInstantAppAvailable;
    }

    private ComponentInfo getComponentInfo()
    {
        if (activityInfo != null) return activityInfo;
        if (serviceInfo != null) return serviceInfo;

        return providerInfo;
    }

    public CharSequence loadLabel(PackageManager packageManager)
    {
        if (nonLocalizedLabel != null) return nonLocalizedLabel;

        if (labelRes != 0 && packageManager != null)
        {
            ComponentInfo component = getComponentInfo();
            String packageName = resolvePackageName != null ? resolvePackageName : component == null ? null : component.packageName;
            CharSequence label = packageManager.getText(packageName, labelRes, null);
            if (label != null) return label.toString().trim();
        }

        ComponentInfo component = getComponentInfo();
        if (component == null) return null;
        if (packageManager == null) return component.name;

        CharSequence label = component.loadLabel(packageManager);
        return label == null ? null : label.toString().trim();
    }

    public android.graphics.drawable.Drawable loadIcon(PackageManager packageManager)
    {
        if (icon != 0 && packageManager != null)
        {
            ComponentInfo component = getComponentInfo();
            String packageName = resolvePackageName != null ? resolvePackageName : component == null ? null : component.packageName;
            android.graphics.drawable.Drawable drawable = packageManager.getDrawable(packageName, icon, null);
            if (drawable != null) return drawable;
        }

        ComponentInfo component = getComponentInfo();
        if (component != null) return component.loadIcon(packageManager);

        return packageManager == null ? null : packageManager.getDefaultActivityIcon();
    }

    public final int getIconResource()
    {
        if (icon != 0) return icon;

        ComponentInfo component = getComponentInfo();
        return component == null ? 0 : component.getIconResource();
    }

    public boolean isCrossProfileIntentForwarderActivity()
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int parcelableFlags)
    {
        dest.writeValue(this);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        ComponentInfo component = getComponentInfo();
        return "ResolveInfo{" + Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(this)) + " "
               + (component == null ? null : component.packageName + "/" + component.name) + " m=0x" + Integer.toHexString(match) + "}";
    }
```

```java
        mForegroundServiceType = original.mForegroundServiceType;
    }

    public int getForegroundServiceType()
    {
        return mForegroundServiceType;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int parcelableFlags)

    }
```

```java
package android.content.pm;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class ShortcutManager
{
    public static final int FLAG_MATCH_MANIFEST = 1;
    public static final int FLAG_MATCH_DYNAMIC = 2;
    public static final int FLAG_MATCH_PINNED = 4;
    public static final int FLAG_MATCH_CACHED = 8;

    private static final int MAX_SHORTCUTS_PER_ACTIVITY = 15;
    private static final int ICON_SIZE_DP = 48;

    private static final Map<String, ShortcutInfo> sShortcuts = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    private final android.content.Context mContext;

    public ShortcutManager(android.content.Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public List<ShortcutInfo> getDynamicShortcuts()
    {
        return getShortcuts(FLAG_MATCH_DYNAMIC);
    }

    public List<ShortcutInfo> getManifestShortcuts()
    {
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public List<ShortcutInfo> getPinnedShortcuts()
    {
        return getShortcuts(FLAG_MATCH_PINNED);
    }

    public List<ShortcutInfo> getShortcuts(int matchFlags)
    {
        List<ShortcutInfo> matches = new ArrayList<>();

        synchronized (sShortcuts)
        {
            for (ShortcutInfo shortcut : sShortcuts.values())
            {
                boolean dynamic = (matchFlags & FLAG_MATCH_DYNAMIC) != 0 && shortcut.isDynamic();
                boolean pinned = (matchFlags & FLAG_MATCH_PINNED) != 0 && shortcut.isPinned();
                if (dynamic || pinned) matches.add(shortcut);
            }
        }

        return matches;
    }

    public boolean setDynamicShortcuts(List<ShortcutInfo> shortcuts)
    {
        if (shortcuts != null && shortcuts.size() > MAX_SHORTCUTS_PER_ACTIVITY)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Max number of dynamic shortcuts exceeded");
        }

        removeAllDynamicShortcuts();
        return addDynamicShortcuts(shortcuts);
    }

    public boolean addDynamicShortcuts(List<ShortcutInfo> shortcuts)
    {
        if (shortcuts == null) return true;

        synchronized (sShortcuts)
        {
            for (ShortcutInfo shortcut : shortcuts)
            {
                if (shortcut == null) continue;

                shortcut.setDynamic(true);
                sShortcuts.put(shortcut.getId(), shortcut);
            }

            trimDynamic();
        }

        return true;
    }

    public void pushDynamicShortcut(ShortcutInfo shortcut)
    {
        if (shortcut == null) throw new NullPointerException("shortcut cannot be null");

        synchronized (sShortcuts)
        {
            sShortcuts.remove(shortcut.getId());
            shortcut.setDynamic(true);
            sShortcuts.put(shortcut.getId(), shortcut);
            trimDynamic();
        }
    }

    private void trimDynamic()
    {
        int dynamic = 0;
        for (ShortcutInfo shortcut : sShortcuts.values())
        {
            if (shortcut.isDynamic()) dynamic++;
        }

        java.util.Iterator<ShortcutInfo> iterator = sShortcuts.values().iterator();

        while (dynamic > MAX_SHORTCUTS_PER_ACTIVITY && iterator.hasNext())
        {
            ShortcutInfo shortcut = iterator.next();
            if (!shortcut.isDynamic()) continue;

            iterator.remove();
            dynamic--;
        }
    }

    public void removeDynamicShortcuts(List<String> shortcutIds)
    {
        if (shortcutIds == null) throw new NullPointerException("shortcutIds cannot be null");

        synchronized (sShortcuts)
        {
            for (String id : shortcutIds)
            {
                ShortcutInfo shortcut = sShortcuts.get(id);
                if (shortcut == null || !shortcut.isDynamic()) continue;

                if (shortcut.isPinned()) shortcut.setDynamic(false);
                else sShortcuts.remove(id);
            }
        }
    }

    public void removeAllDynamicShortcuts()
    {
        synchronized (sShortcuts)
        {
            java.util.Iterator<ShortcutInfo> iterator = sShortcuts.values().iterator();

            while (iterator.hasNext())
            {
                ShortcutInfo shortcut = iterator.next();
                if (!shortcut.isDynamic()) continue;

                if (shortcut.isPinned()) shortcut.setDynamic(false);
                else iterator.remove();
            }
        }
    }

    public void removeLongLivedShortcuts(List<String> shortcutIds)
    {
        if (shortcutIds == null) throw new NullPointerException("shortcutIds cannot be null");

        synchronized (sShortcuts)
        {
            for (String id : shortcutIds) sShortcuts.remove(id);
        }
    }

    public boolean updateShortcuts(List<ShortcutInfo> shortcuts)
    {
        if (shortcuts == null) return true;

        synchronized (sShortcuts)
        {
            for (ShortcutInfo update : shortcuts)
            {
                if (update == null) continue;

                ShortcutInfo existing = sShortcuts.get(update.getId());
                if (existing != null) existing.copyNonNullFieldsFrom(update);
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    public void disableShortcuts(List<String> shortcutIds)
    {
        disableShortcuts(shortcutIds, null);
    }

    public void disableShortcuts(List<String> shortcutIds, CharSequence disabledMessage)
    {
        if (shortcutIds == null) throw new NullPointerException("shortcutIds cannot be null");

        synchronized (sShortcuts)
        {
            for (String id : shortcutIds)
            {
                ShortcutInfo shortcut = sShortcuts.get(id);
                if (shortcut == null) continue;

                if (shortcut.isPinned())
                {
                    shortcut.setDynamic(false);
                    shortcut.setEnabled(false, disabledMessage);
                }
                else
                {
                    sShortcuts.remove(id);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public void enableShortcuts(List<String> shortcutIds)
    {
        if (shortcutIds == null) throw new NullPointerException("shortcutIds cannot be null");

        synchronized (sShortcuts)
        {
            for (String id : shortcutIds)
            {
                ShortcutInfo shortcut = sShortcuts.get(id);
                if (shortcut != null) shortcut.setEnabled(true, null);
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean isRequestPinShortcutSupported()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean requestPinShortcut(ShortcutInfo shortcut, android.content.IntentSender resultIntent)
    {
        if (shortcut == null) throw new NullPointerException("shortcut cannot be null");

        return false;
    }

    public android.content.Intent createShortcutResultIntent(ShortcutInfo shortcut)
    {
        if (shortcut == null) throw new NullPointerException("shortcut cannot be null");

        return null;
    }

    public int getMaxShortcutCountPerActivity()
    {
        return MAX_SHORTCUTS_PER_ACTIVITY;
    }

    public boolean isRateLimitingActive()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public int getIconMaxWidth()
    {
        return iconMaxSize();
    }

    public int getIconMaxHeight()
    {
        return iconMaxSize();
    }

    private int iconMaxSize()
    {
        float density = mContext == null ? 1f : mContext.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        return (int)(ICON_SIZE_DP * density + 0.5f);
    }

    public void reportShortcutUsed(String shortcutId)
    {
    }
}
```

`java/android/content/pm/Signature.java`:

```java
package android.content.pm;

import java.util.Arrays;

public class Signature implements android.os.Parcelable
{
    private static final char[] HEX = "0123456789abcdef".toCharArray();

    private final byte[] mSignature;
    private int mHashCode;
    private boolean mHaveHashCode;
    private String mStringRef;

    public Signature(byte[] signature)
    {
        mSignature = signature == null ? new byte[0] : signature.clone();
    }

    public Signature(String text)
    {
        mSignature = fromChars(text);
    }

    public byte[] toByteArray()
    {
        return mSignature.clone();
    }

    public char[] toChars()
    {
        return toChars(null, null);
    }

    public char[] toChars(char[] existing, int[] outLength)
    {
        byte[] signature = mSignature;
        int wanted = signature.length * 2;
        char[] text = existing != null && existing.length >= wanted ? existing : new char[wanted];

        for (int index = 0; index < signature.length; index++)
        {
            int value = signature[index] & 0xff;
            text[index * 2] = HEX[value >> 4];
            text[index * 2 + 1] = HEX[value & 0x0f];
        }

        if (outLength != null && outLength.length > 0) outLength[0] = wanted;

        return text;
    }

    public String toCharsString()
    {
        String cached = mStringRef;
        if (cached != null) return cached;

        cached = new String(toChars());
        mStringRef = cached;

        return cached;
    }

    public byte[] toByteArrayNoCopy()
    {
        return mSignature;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof Signature)) return false;

        return Arrays.equals(mSignature, ((Signature)other).mSignature);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        if (mHaveHashCode) return mHashCode;

        mHashCode = Arrays.hashCode(mSignature);
        mHaveHashCode = true;

        return mHashCode;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return toCharsString();
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(android.os.Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeValue(mSignature);
    }

    private static byte[] fromChars(String text)
    {
        if (text == null || (text.length() & 1) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("bad signature text");

        byte[] bytes = new byte[text.length() / 2];

        for (int index = 0; index < bytes.length; index++)
        {
            bytes[index] = (byte)Integer.parseInt(text.substring(index * 2, index * 2 + 2), 16);
        }

        return bytes;
    }
}
```

```java
public final class SigningInfo

        mApkContentsSigners = new Signature[0];

    {
        Signature[] copy = signers == null ? new Signature[0] : signers.clone();

        mApkContentsSigners = copy;
        mSigningCertificateHistory = hasMultipleSigners ? new Signature[0] : copy;
        mHasMultipleSigners = hasMultipleSigners;
    }

    public boolean hasMultipleSigners()

        return !mHasMultipleSigners && mSigningCertificateHistory.length > 1;

    {
        return mApkContentsSigners.clone();

    public Signature[] getSigningCertificateHistory()

        return mSigningCertificateHistory.clone();
```

`java/android/content/res/AssetFileDescriptor.java`:

```java
package android.content.res;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import java.io.Closeable;
import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;

public class AssetFileDescriptor implements Parcelable, Closeable
{
    public static final long UNKNOWN_LENGTH = -1;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<AssetFileDescriptor> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<AssetFileDescriptor>()
    {
        @Override
        public AssetFileDescriptor createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            ParcelFileDescriptor descriptor = ParcelFileDescriptor.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            long startOffset = source.readLong();
            long length = source.readLong();
            Bundle extras = source.readInt() != 0 ? source.readBundle() : null;
            return new AssetFileDescriptor(descriptor, startOffset, length, extras);
        }

        @Override
        public AssetFileDescriptor[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new AssetFileDescriptor[size];
        }
    };

    private final ParcelFileDescriptor mDescriptor;
    private final long mStartOffset;
    private final long mLength;
    private final Bundle mExtras;

    public AssetFileDescriptor(ParcelFileDescriptor descriptor, long startOffset, long length)
    {
        this(descriptor, startOffset, length, null);
    }

    public AssetFileDescriptor(ParcelFileDescriptor descriptor, long startOffset, long length, Bundle extras)
    {
        if (descriptor == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("fd must not be null");
        if (length < 0 && startOffset != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("startOffset must be 0 when using UNKNOWN_LENGTH");

        mDescriptor = descriptor;
        mStartOffset = startOffset;
        mLength = length;
        mExtras = extras;
    }

    public ParcelFileDescriptor getParcelFileDescriptor()
    {
        return mDescriptor;
    }

    public FileDescriptor getFileDescriptor()
    {
        return mDescriptor.getFileDescriptor();
    }

    public Bundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    public long getStartOffset()
    {
        return mStartOffset;
    }

    public long getLength()
    {
        if (mLength >= 0) return mLength;

        long total = mDescriptor.getStatSize();
        if (total < 0) return UNKNOWN_LENGTH;
        return total - mStartOffset;
    }

    public long getDeclaredLength()
    {
        return mLength;
    }

    public FileInputStream createInputStream() throws IOException
    {
        return new AutoCloseInputStream(this);
    }

    public FileOutputStream createOutputStream() throws IOException
    {
        return new AutoCloseOutputStream(this);
    }

    @Override
    public void close() throws IOException
    {
        mDescriptor.close();
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return mDescriptor.describeContents();
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        mDescriptor.writeToParcel(destination, flags);
        destination.writeLong(mStartOffset);
        destination.writeLong(mLength);
        if (mExtras != null)
        {
            destination.writeInt(1);
            destination.writeBundle(mExtras);
        }
        else
        {
            destination.writeInt(0);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "{AssetFileDescriptor: " + mDescriptor + " start=" + mStartOffset + " len=" + mLength + "}";
    }

    public static class AutoCloseInputStream extends ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream
    {
        private long mRemaining;

        public AutoCloseInputStream(AssetFileDescriptor owner) throws IOException
        {
            super(owner.getParcelFileDescriptor());

            long length = owner.getDeclaredLength();
            mRemaining = length < 0 ? Long.MAX_VALUE : length;

            long skipped = 0;
            while (skipped < owner.getStartOffset())
            {
                long step = super.skip(owner.getStartOffset() - skipped);
                if (step <= 0) throw new IOException("could not seek to " + owner.getStartOffset());
                skipped += step;
            }
        }

        @Override
        public int read() throws IOException
        {
            if (mRemaining <= 0) return -1;

            int value = super.read();
            if (value >= 0) mRemaining -= 1;
            return value;
        }

        @Override
        public int read(byte[] buffer) throws IOException
        {
            return read(buffer, 0, buffer.length);
        }

        @Override
        public int read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) throws IOException
        {
            if (mRemaining <= 0) return -1;
            if (count > mRemaining) count = (int)mRemaining;

            int got = super.read(buffer, offset, count);
            if (got > 0) mRemaining -= got;
            return got;
        }

        @Override
        public long skip(long count) throws IOException
        {
            if (count <= 0) return 0;
            if (count > mRemaining) count = mRemaining;

            long stepped = super.skip(count);
            if (stepped > 0) mRemaining -= stepped;
            return stepped;
        }

        @Override
        public int available() throws IOException
        {
            long known = Math.min(mRemaining, super.available());
            return known > Integer.MAX_VALUE ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : (int)known;
        }
    }

    public static class AutoCloseOutputStream extends ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseOutputStream
    {
        public AutoCloseOutputStream(AssetFileDescriptor owner) throws IOException
        {
            super(owner.getParcelFileDescriptor());

            if (owner.getStartOffset() > 0) throw new IOException("cannot write to an asset at a non-zero offset");
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/content/res/AssetManager.java`:

```java
package android.content.res;

import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;
import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.FileNotFoundException;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;

public final class AssetManager implements AutoCloseable
{
    public static final int ACCESS_UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final int ACCESS_RANDOM = 1;
    public static final int ACCESS_STREAMING = 2;
    public static final int ACCESS_BUFFER = 3;

    private final Resources mResources;
    private final long mHandle;

    AssetManager()
    {
        this(null, 0);
    }

    AssetManager(Resources resources, long handle)
    {
        mResources = resources;
        mHandle = handle;
    }

    long getHandle()
    {
        return mHandle;
    }

    public XmlResourceParser openXmlResourceParser(String fileName) throws IOException
    {
        return openXmlResourceParser(0, fileName);
    }

    public XmlResourceParser openXmlResourceParser(int cookie, String fileName) throws IOException
    {
        try (InputStream stream = openNonAsset(fileName))
        {
            return CompiledXmlParser.fromStream(stream);
        }
    }

    public String[] getLocales()
    {
        android.os.LocaleList locales = android.os.LocaleList.getDefault();
        String[] tags = new String[locales.size()];

        for (int index = 0; index < tags.length; index++) tags[index] = locales.get(index).toLanguageTag();

        return tags;
    }

    public String[] list(String path) throws IOException
    {
        String[] names = Resources.nativeAssetList(mHandle, path == null ? "" : path);
        return names == null ? new String[0] : names;
    }

    public InputStream open(String fileName) throws IOException
    {
        return open(fileName, ACCESS_STREAMING);
    }

    public InputStream open(String fileName, int accessMode) throws IOException
    {
        if (fileName == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("null");

        long asset = Resources.nativeAssetOpen(mHandle, fileName);
        if (asset == 0) throw new FileNotFoundException(fileName);

        return new AssetInputStream(asset);
    }

    public AssetFileDescriptor openFd(String fileName) throws IOException
    {
        if (fileName == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("null");
        return descriptorFor(fileName, Resources.nativeAssetOpen(mHandle, fileName));
    }

    public InputStream openNonAsset(String fileName) throws IOException
    {
        if (fileName == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("null");

        long asset = Resources.nativeAssetOpenNonAsset(mHandle, fileName);
        if (asset == 0) throw new FileNotFoundException(fileName);

        return new AssetInputStream(asset);
    }

    public AssetFileDescriptor openNonAssetFd(String fileName) throws IOException
    {
        return openNonAssetFd(0, fileName);
    }

    public AssetFileDescriptor openNonAssetFd(int cookie, String fileName) throws IOException
    {
        if (fileName == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("null");
        return descriptorFor(fileName, Resources.nativeAssetOpenNonAsset(mHandle, fileName));
    }

    private AssetFileDescriptor descriptorFor(String fileName, long asset) throws IOException
    {
        if (asset == 0) throw new FileNotFoundException(fileName);

        long[] extent = new long[3];
        FileDescriptor descriptor;
        try
        {
            descriptor = Resources.nativeAssetOpenFd(asset, extent);
        }
        finally
        {
            Resources.nativeAssetClose(asset);
        }

        if (descriptor == null) throw new FileNotFoundException(fileName + " is compressed in the archive, so it has no file descriptor");

        return new AssetFileDescriptor(new ParcelFileDescriptor(descriptor, (int)extent[0]), extent[1], extent[2]);
    }

    public void close()
    {
    }

    public final class AssetInputStream extends InputStream
    {
        private long mAsset;
        private final long mLength;
        private long mConsumed;

        AssetInputStream(long asset)
        {
            mAsset = asset;
            mLength = Resources.nativeAssetLength(asset);
        }

        @Override
        public int read() throws IOException
        {
            byte[] single = new byte[1];
            int got = read(single, 0, 1);
            return got <= 0 ? -1 : single[0] & 0xFF;
        }

        @Override
        public int read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) throws IOException
        {
            if (mAsset == 0) throw new IOException("asset stream is closed");
            if (buffer == null) throw new NullPointerException("buffer");
            if (offset < 0 || count < 0 || offset > buffer.length || count > buffer.length - offset) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
            if (count == 0) return 0;

            int got = Resources.nativeAssetRead(mAsset, buffer, offset, count);
            if (got == -2) throw new IOException("could not read the asset - the archive entry may be corrupt");
            if (got < 0) return -1;

            mConsumed += got;
            return got;
        }

        @Override
        public int available() throws IOException
        {
            if (mAsset == 0) return 0;
            long remaining = mLength - mConsumed;
            return remaining < 0 ? 0 : (int)Math.min(remaining, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        }

        @Override
        public void close()
        {
            if (mAsset == 0) return;

            Resources.nativeAssetClose(mAsset);
            mAsset = 0;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/content/res/ColorStateList.java`:

```java
package android.content.res;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.util.StateSet;
import android.util.TypedValue;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;
import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;

public class ColorStateList implements Parcelable
{
    private static final int DEFAULT_COLOR = 0xFFFF0000;
    private static final int STATE_FOCUSED = 0x0101009c;
    private static final int[][] EMPTY = new int[][] {new int[0]};

    private final int[][] mStateSpecs;
    private final int[] mColors;
    private final int mDefaultColor;
    private final boolean mIsOpaque;

    public ColorStateList(int[][] states, int[] colors)
    {
        mStateSpecs = states;
        mColors = colors;

        int defaultColor = colors.length > 0 ? colors[0] : DEFAULT_COLOR;
        for (int index = 0; index < states.length && index < colors.length; index++)
        {
            if (states[index].length == 0)
            {
                defaultColor = colors[index];
                break;
            }
        }

        mDefaultColor = defaultColor;

        boolean opaque = colors.length > 0;
        for (int color : colors)
        {
            if ((color >>> 24) != 0xFF) opaque = false;
        }

        mIsOpaque = opaque;
    }

    public static ColorStateList valueOf(int color)
    {
        return new ColorStateList(EMPTY, new int[] {color});
    }

    public static ColorStateList createFromXml(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser) throws XmlPullParserException, IOException
    {
        return createFromXml(resources, parser, null);
    }

    public static ColorStateList createFromXml(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws XmlPullParserException, IOException
    {
        int event;
        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.START_TAG && event != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
        }

        if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) throw new XmlPullParserException("No start tag found");

        return createFromXmlInner(resources, parser, theme);
    }

    static ColorStateList createFromXmlInner(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws XmlPullParserException, IOException
    {
        if (!"selector".equals(parser.getName()))
        {
            throw new XmlPullParserException(parser.getPositionDescription() + ": invalid color state list tag " + parser.getName());
        }

        ArrayList<int[]> states = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Integer> colors = new ArrayList<>();

        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= outerDepth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG || parser.getDepth() > outerDepth + 1) continue;
            if (!"item".equals(parser.getName())) continue;

            ArrayList<Integer> state = new ArrayList<>();
            int color = DEFAULT_COLOR;
            float alpha = 1.0f;

            for (int index = 0; index < parser.getAttributeCount(); index++)
            {
                String name = parser.getAttributeName(index);
                int[] typed = typedValueOf(parser, index);

                if ("color".equals(name))
                {
                    color = resolveColor(resources, theme, typed, parser.getAttributeValue(index), color);
                    continue;
                }

                if ("alpha".equals(name))
                {
                    alpha = resolveFloat(theme, typed, parser.getAttributeValue(index), alpha);
                    continue;
                }

                int nameResource = parser instanceof XmlResourceParser ? ((XmlResourceParser)parser).getAttributeNameResource(index) : 0;
                if (nameResource == 0 || !isBoolean(typed, parser.getAttributeValue(index))) continue;

                boolean wanted = typed != null ? typed[1] != 0 : "true".equals(parser.getAttributeValue(index));
                state.add(wanted ? nameResource : -nameResource);
            }

            int[] stateSpec = new int[state.size()];
            for (int index = 0; index < stateSpec.length; index++) stateSpec[index] = state.get(index);

            states.add(stateSpec);
            colors.add(modulateAlpha(color, alpha));
        }

        int[][] stateArray = states.toArray(new int[0][]);
        int[] colorArray = new int[colors.size()];
        for (int index = 0; index < colorArray.length; index++) colorArray[index] = colors.get(index);

        return new ColorStateList(stateArray, colorArray);
    }

    private static int[] typedValueOf(XmlPullParser parser, int index)
    {
        if (parser instanceof XmlBlock.Parser) return ((XmlBlock.Parser)parser).getAttributeTypedValue(index);
        return null;
    }

    private static boolean isBoolean(int[] typed, String text)
    {
        if (typed != null) return typed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_INT_BOOLEAN;
        return "true".equals(text) || "false".equals(text);
    }

    private static boolean isColorType(int type)
    {
        return type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_COLOR_INT && type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_COLOR_INT;
    }

    private static int colorOfResource(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme, int resourceId, int fallback)
    {
        if (resources == null || resourceId == 0) return fallback;

        try
        {
            ColorStateList nested = resources.getColorStateList(resourceId, theme);
            return nested != null ? nested.getDefaultColor() : fallback;
        }
        catch (RuntimeException unresolved)
        {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    private static int resolveColor(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme, int[] typed, String text, int fallback)
    {
        if (typed == null)
        {
            if (text == null || !text.startsWith("#")) return fallback;

            try
            {
                return android.graphics.Color.parseColor(text);
            }
            catch (IllegalArgumentException malformed)
            {
                return fallback;
            }
        }

        int type = typed[0];
        int data = typed[1];

        if (isColorType(type)) return data;
        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_REFERENCE) return colorOfResource(resources, theme, data, fallback);

        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_ATTRIBUTE && theme != null)
        {
            TypedValue value = new TypedValue();
            if (!theme.resolveAttribute(data, value, true)) return fallback;
            if (isColorType(value.type)) return value.data;

            return colorOfResource(resources, theme, value.resourceId, fallback);
        }

        return fallback;
    }

    private static float resolveFloat(Resources.Theme theme, int[] typed, String text, float fallback)
    {
        if (typed == null)
        {
            try
            {
                return text == null ? fallback : Float.parseFloat(text);
            }
            catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
            {
                return fallback;
            }
        }

        if (typed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT) return Float.intBitsToFloat(typed[1]);

        if (typed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_ATTRIBUTE && theme != null)
        {
            TypedValue value = new TypedValue();
            if (theme.resolveAttribute(typed[1], value, true) && value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT)
            {
                return Float.intBitsToFloat(value.data);
            }
        }

        return fallback;
    }

    private static int modulateAlpha(int color, float alpha)
    {
        if (alpha >= 1.0f) return color;

        int base = color >>> 24;
        int scaled = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(base * alpha)));
        return (color & 0x00FFFFFF) | (scaled << 24);
    }

    public int getDefaultColor()
    {
        return mDefaultColor;
    }

    public int getColorForState(int[] stateSet, int defaultColor)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mStateSpecs.length && index < mColors.length; index++)
        {
            if (StateSet.stateSetMatches(mStateSpecs[index], stateSet)) return mColors[index];
        }

        return defaultColor;
    }

    public boolean isStateful()
    {
        return mStateSpecs.length >= 1 && mStateSpecs[0].length > 0;
    }

    public boolean hasFocusStateSpecified()
    {
        for (int[] spec : mStateSpecs)
        {
            for (int state : spec)
            {
                if (state == STATE_FOCUSED || state == -STATE_FOCUSED) return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean isOpaque()
    {
        return mIsOpaque;
    }

    public ColorStateList withAlpha(int alpha)
    {
        int[] colors = new int[mColors.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < colors.length; index++) colors[index] = (mColors[index] & 0x00FFFFFF) | (alpha << 24);

        return new ColorStateList(mStateSpecs, colors);
    }

    public ColorStateList withLStar(float lStar)
    {
        return this;
    }

    public int getChangingConfigurations()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public boolean canApplyTheme()
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "ColorStateList{mStateSpecs=" + Arrays.deepToString(mStateSpecs) + "mColors=" + Arrays.toString(mColors) +
               "mDefaultColor=" + mDefaultColor + '}';
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeInt(mStateSpecs.length);
        for (int[] spec : mStateSpecs) destination.writeIntArray(spec);
        destination.writeIntArray(mColors);
    }

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<ColorStateList> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ColorStateList>()
    {
        @Override
        public ColorStateList createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int count = source.readInt();
            int[][] specs = new int[count][];
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) specs[index] = source.createIntArray();

            return new ColorStateList(specs, source.createIntArray());
        }

        @Override
        public ColorStateList[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ColorStateList[size];
        }
    };
}
```
