`java/android/content/res/CompiledXmlParser.java`:

```java
package android.content.res;

import android.util.TypedValue;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException;

final class CompiledXmlParser implements XmlResourceParser
{
    private static final int CHUNK_STRING_POOL = 0x0001;
    private static final int CHUNK_XML = 0x0003;
    private static final int CHUNK_START_NAMESPACE = 0x0100;
    private static final int CHUNK_END_NAMESPACE = 0x0101;
    private static final int CHUNK_START_ELEMENT = 0x0102;
    private static final int CHUNK_END_ELEMENT = 0x0103;
    private static final int CHUNK_CDATA = 0x0104;
    private static final int CHUNK_RESOURCE_MAP = 0x0180;
    private static final int UTF8_FLAG = 1 << 8;
    private static final int NO_INDEX = -1;
    private static final int ATTRIBUTE_ENTRY_SIZE = 20;

    private final ByteBuffer mBuffer;
    private final ArrayList<String> mPrefixes = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<String> mUris = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<Integer> mNamespaceCounts = new ArrayList<>();
    private String[] mStrings = new String[0];
    private int[] mResourceIds = new int[0];
    private int mCursor;
    private int mEnd;
    private int mEventType = START_DOCUMENT;
    private int mDepth;
    private int mLineNumber = -1;
    private boolean mPendingEndDepth;
    private boolean mClosed;

    private int mNamespaceIndex = NO_INDEX;
    private int mNameIndex = NO_INDEX;
    private String mText;
    private int mAttributeOffset;
    private int mAttributeSize;
    private int mAttributeCount;
    private int mIdIndex;
    private int mClassIndex;
    private int mStyleIndex;

    CompiledXmlParser(byte[] data) throws IOException
    {
        mBuffer = ByteBuffer.wrap(data).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);

        if (data.length < 8 || (mBuffer.getShort(0) & 0xffff) != CHUNK_XML) throw new IOException("not a compiled XML file");

        int headerSize = mBuffer.getShort(2) & 0xffff;
        mEnd = Math.min(data.length, mBuffer.getInt(4));
        mCursor = headerSize;

        while (mCursor + 8 <= mEnd)
        {
            int type = mBuffer.getShort(mCursor) & 0xffff;
            int size = mBuffer.getInt(mCursor + 4);
            if (size < 8) throw new IOException("corrupt compiled XML chunk");

            if (type == CHUNK_STRING_POOL)
            {
                readStringPool(mCursor);
            }
            else if (type == CHUNK_RESOURCE_MAP)
            {
                int chunkHeader = mBuffer.getShort(mCursor + 2) & 0xffff;
                int count = (size - chunkHeader) / 4;
                mResourceIds = new int[count];
                for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) mResourceIds[index] = mBuffer.getInt(mCursor + chunkHeader + index * 4);
            }
            else if (type >= CHUNK_START_NAMESPACE && type <= CHUNK_CDATA)
            {
                break;
            }

            mCursor += size;
        }

        mNamespaceCounts.add(0);
    }

    static CompiledXmlParser fromStream(InputStream stream) throws IOException
    {
        ByteArrayOutputStream bytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] chunk = new byte[16384];
        int got;

        while ((got = stream.read(chunk)) > 0) bytes.write(chunk, 0, got);

        return new CompiledXmlParser(bytes.toByteArray());
    }

    private void readStringPool(int start)
    {
        int headerSize = mBuffer.getShort(start + 2) & 0xffff;
        int stringCount = mBuffer.getInt(start + 8);
        int flags = mBuffer.getInt(start + 16);
        int stringsStart = mBuffer.getInt(start + 20);
        boolean utf8 = (flags & UTF8_FLAG) != 0;

        mStrings = new String[stringCount];

        for (int index = 0; index < stringCount; index++)
        {
            int offset = start + stringsStart + mBuffer.getInt(start + headerSize + index * 4);
            mStrings[index] = utf8 ? readUtf8(offset) : readUtf16(offset);
        }
    }

    private String readUtf8(int offset)
    {
        int position = offset;
        int first = mBuffer.get(position++) & 0xff;
        if ((first & 0x80) != 0) position++;

        int length = mBuffer.get(position++) & 0xff;
        if ((length & 0x80) != 0) length = ((length & 0x7f) << 8) | (mBuffer.get(position++) & 0xff);

        return new String(mBuffer.array(), position, length, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    private String readUtf16(int offset)
    {
        int position = offset;
        int length = mBuffer.getShort(position) & 0xffff;
        position += 2;

        if ((length & 0x8000) != 0)
        {
            length = ((length & 0x7fff) << 16) | (mBuffer.getShort(position) & 0xffff);
            position += 2;
        }

        char[] characters = new char[length];
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) characters[index] = mBuffer.getChar(position + index * 2);
        return new String(characters);
    }

    private String stringAt(int index)
    {
        if (index < 0 || index >= mStrings.length) return null;
        return mStrings[index];
    }

    @Override
    public int next() throws XmlPullParserException
    {
        if (mClosed) throw new XmlPullParserException("the parser is closed");

        if (mPendingEndDepth)
        {
            mDepth--;
            mNamespaceCounts.remove(mNamespaceCounts.size() - 1);
            mPendingEndDepth = false;
        }

        if (mEventType == END_DOCUMENT) return END_DOCUMENT;

        while (mCursor + 8 <= mEnd)
        {
            int chunk = mCursor;
            int type = mBuffer.getShort(chunk) & 0xffff;
            int headerSize = mBuffer.getShort(chunk + 2) & 0xffff;
            int size = mBuffer.getInt(chunk + 4);
            if (size < 8) break;

            mCursor += size;

            if (type < CHUNK_START_NAMESPACE || type > CHUNK_CDATA) continue;

            mLineNumber = mBuffer.getInt(chunk + 8);
            int extension = chunk + headerSize;

            if (type == CHUNK_START_NAMESPACE)
            {
                mPrefixes.add(stringAt(mBuffer.getInt(extension)));
                mUris.add(stringAt(mBuffer.getInt(extension + 4)));
                continue;
            }

            if (type == CHUNK_END_NAMESPACE) continue;

            if (type == CHUNK_START_ELEMENT)
            {
                mNamespaceIndex = mBuffer.getInt(extension);
                mNameIndex = mBuffer.getInt(extension + 4);
                mAttributeOffset = extension + (mBuffer.getShort(extension + 8) & 0xffff);
                mAttributeSize = mBuffer.getShort(extension + 10) & 0xffff;
                if (mAttributeSize == 0) mAttributeSize = ATTRIBUTE_ENTRY_SIZE;
                mAttributeCount = mBuffer.getShort(extension + 12) & 0xffff;
                mIdIndex = mBuffer.getShort(extension + 14) & 0xffff;
                mClassIndex = mBuffer.getShort(extension + 16) & 0xffff;
                mStyleIndex = mBuffer.getShort(extension + 18) & 0xffff;
                mText = null;
                mDepth++;
                mNamespaceCounts.add(mPrefixes.size());
                mEventType = START_TAG;
                return mEventType;
            }

            if (type == CHUNK_END_ELEMENT)
            {
                mNamespaceIndex = mBuffer.getInt(extension);
                mNameIndex = mBuffer.getInt(extension + 4);
                mAttributeCount = 0;
                mText = null;
                mPendingEndDepth = true;
                mEventType = END_TAG;
                return mEventType;
            }

            mText = stringAt(mBuffer.getInt(extension));
            mAttributeCount = 0;
            mEventType = TEXT;
            return mEventType;
        }

        mEventType = END_DOCUMENT;
        return mEventType;
    }

    @Override
    public int nextToken() throws XmlPullParserException
    {
        return next();
    }

    @Override
    public int nextTag() throws XmlPullParserException
    {
        int event = next();
        if (event == TEXT && isWhitespace()) event = next();
        if (event != START_TAG && event != END_TAG) throw new XmlPullParserException("expected start or end tag " + getPositionDescription());
        return event;
    }

    @Override
    public String nextText() throws XmlPullParserException
    {
        if (getEventType() != START_TAG) throw new XmlPullParserException("parser must be on START_TAG to read next text");

        int event = next();
        if (event == TEXT)
        {
            String result = getText();
            event = next();
            if (event != END_TAG) throw new XmlPullParserException("event TEXT must be immediately followed by END_TAG");
            return result;
        }
        if (event == END_TAG) return "";

        throw new XmlPullParserException("parser must be on START_TAG or TEXT to read text");
    }

    @Override
    public void require(int type, String namespace, String name) throws XmlPullParserException
    {
        if (type != getEventType() || (namespace != null && !namespace.equals(getNamespace()))
            || (name != null && !name.equals(getName())))
        {
            throw new XmlPullParserException("expected " + TYPES[type] + " " + getPositionDescription());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int getEventType()
    {
        return mEventType;
    }

    @Override
    public int getDepth()
    {
        return mDepth;
    }

    @Override
    public String getName()
    {
        if (mEventType != START_TAG && mEventType != END_TAG) return null;
        return stringAt(mNameIndex);
    }

    @Override
    public String getText()
    {
        return mEventType == TEXT ? mText : null;
    }

    @Override
    public char[] getTextCharacters(int[] holderForStartAndLength)
    {
        String text = getText();
        if (text == null) return null;

        char[] characters = text.toCharArray();
        if (holderForStartAndLength != null && holderForStartAndLength.length >= 2)
        {
            holderForStartAndLength[0] = 0;
            holderForStartAndLength[1] = characters.length;
        }
        return characters;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLineNumber()
    {
        return mLineNumber;
    }

    @Override
    public int getColumnNumber()
    {
        return -1;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isWhitespace()
    {
        return mText != null && mText.trim().isEmpty();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isEmptyElementTag()
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public String getNamespace()
    {
        String namespace = stringAt(mNamespaceIndex);
        return namespace == null ? NO_NAMESPACE : namespace;
    }

    @Override
    public String getNamespace(String prefix)
    {
        for (int index = mPrefixes.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            if (java.util.Objects.equals(prefix, mPrefixes.get(index))) return mUris.get(index);
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public int getNamespaceCount(int depth)
    {
        if (depth < 0 || depth >= mNamespaceCounts.size()) return mPrefixes.size();
        return mNamespaceCounts.get(depth);
    }

    @Override
    public String getNamespacePrefix(int position)
    {
        return position >= 0 && position < mPrefixes.size() ? mPrefixes.get(position) : null;
    }

    @Override
    public String getNamespaceUri(int position)
    {
        return position >= 0 && position < mUris.size() ? mUris.get(position) : null;
    }

    @Override
    public String getPrefix()
    {
        String namespace = stringAt(mNamespaceIndex);
        if (namespace == null) return null;

        for (int index = mUris.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            if (namespace.equals(mUris.get(index))) return mPrefixes.get(index);
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public String getInputEncoding()

        return null;
    }

        throw new XmlPullParserException("setFeature is not supported on a compiled resource");

        return FEATURE_PROCESS_NAMESPACES.equals(name) || FEATURE_REPORT_NAMESPACE_ATTRIBUTES.equals(name);

        mClosed = true;

    private int attributeBase(int index)
    {
        if (index < 0 || index >= mAttributeCount) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("attribute " + index);
        return mAttributeOffset + index * mAttributeSize;
    }

    private int attributeNameIndex(int index)
    {
        return mBuffer.getInt(attributeBase(index) + 4);
    }

    private int attributeType(int index)
    {
        return mBuffer.get(attributeBase(index) + 15) & 0xff;
    }

    private int attributeData(int index)
    {
        return mBuffer.getInt(attributeBase(index) + 16);
    }

    private int indexOfAttribute(String namespace, String name)
    {
        if (name == null) return -1;

        for (int index = 0; index < mAttributeCount; index++)
        {
            if (!name.equals(getAttributeName(index))) continue;
            if (namespace == null || namespace.equals(getAttributeNamespace(index))) return index;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private int indexOfResource(int resourceId)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mAttributeCount; index++)
        {
            if (getAttributeNameResource(index) == resourceId) return index;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    @Override
    public int getAttributeCount()
    {
        return mEventType == START_TAG ? mAttributeCount : -1;
    }

    @Override
    public String getAttributeName(int index)
    {
        return stringAt(attributeNameIndex(index));
    }

    @Override
    public String getAttributeNamespace(int index)
    {
        String namespace = stringAt(mBuffer.getInt(attributeBase(index)));
        return namespace == null ? NO_NAMESPACE : namespace;
    }

    @Override
    public String getAttributePrefix(int index)
    {
        String namespace = stringAt(mBuffer.getInt(attributeBase(index)));
        if (namespace == null) return null;

        for (int position = mUris.size() - 1; position >= 0; position--)
        {
            if (namespace.equals(mUris.get(position))) return mPrefixes.get(position);
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public String getAttributeType(int index)
    {
        return "CDATA";
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAttributeDefault(int index)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public String getAttributeValue(int index)
    {
        int raw = mBuffer.getInt(attributeBase(index) + 8);
        if (raw >= 0) return stringAt(raw);

        int type = attributeType(index);
        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING) return stringAt(attributeData(index));
        return TypedValue.coerceToString(type, attributeData(index));
    }

    @Override
    public String getAttributeValue(String namespace, String name)
    {
        int index = indexOfAttribute(namespace, name);
        return index < 0 ? null : getAttributeValue(index);
    }

    @Override
    public String getPositionDescription()
    {
        return "Binary XML file line #" + getLineNumber();
    }

    @Override
    public int getAttributeNameResource(int index)
    {
        int nameIndex = attributeNameIndex(index);
        return nameIndex >= 0 && nameIndex < mResourceIds.length ? mResourceIds[nameIndex] : 0;
    }

    @Override
    public int getAttributeListValue(int index, String[] options, int defaultValue)
    {
        int type = attributeType(index);
        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING)
        {
            String value = stringAt(attributeData(index));
            if (options != null && value != null)
            {
                for (int position = 0; position < options.length; position++)
                {
                    if (value.equals(options[position])) return position;
                }
            }
            return defaultValue;
        }
        if (type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return attributeData(index);
        return defaultValue;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean getAttributeBooleanValue(int index, boolean defaultValue)
    {
        int type = attributeType(index);
        if (type < TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT || type > TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return defaultValue;
        return attributeData(index) != 0;
    }

    @Override
    public int getAttributeResourceValue(int index, int defaultValue)
    {
        if (attributeType(index) != TypedValue.TYPE_REFERENCE) return defaultValue;
        return attributeData(index);
    }

    @Override
    public int getAttributeIntValue(int index, int defaultValue)
    {
        int type = attributeType(index);
        if (type < TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT || type > TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return defaultValue;
        return attributeData(index);
    }

    @Override
    public int getAttributeUnsignedIntValue(int index, int defaultValue)
    {
        return getAttributeIntValue(index, defaultValue);
    }

    @Override
    public float getAttributeFloatValue(int index, float defaultValue)
    {
        if (attributeType(index) != TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT) return defaultValue;
        return Float.intBitsToFloat(attributeData(index));
    }

    @Override
    public int getAttributeListValue(String namespace, String attribute, String[] options, int defaultValue)
    {
        int index = indexOfAttribute(namespace, attribute);
        return index < 0 ? defaultValue : getAttributeListValue(index, options, defaultValue);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean getAttributeBooleanValue(String namespace, String attribute, boolean defaultValue)
    {
        int index = indexOfAttribute(namespace, attribute);
        return index < 0 ? defaultValue : getAttributeBooleanValue(index, defaultValue);
    }

    @Override
    public int getAttributeResourceValue(String namespace, String attribute, int defaultValue)
    {
        int index = indexOfAttribute(namespace, attribute);
        return index < 0 ? defaultValue : getAttributeResourceValue(index, defaultValue);
    }

    @Override
    public int getAttributeIntValue(String namespace, String attribute, int defaultValue)
    {
        int index = indexOfAttribute(namespace, attribute);
        return index < 0 ? defaultValue : getAttributeIntValue(index, defaultValue);
    }

    @Override
    public int getAttributeUnsignedIntValue(String namespace, String attribute, int defaultValue)
    {
        return getAttributeIntValue(namespace, attribute, defaultValue);
    }

    @Override
    public float getAttributeFloatValue(String namespace, String attribute, float defaultValue)
    {
        int index = indexOfAttribute(namespace, attribute);
        return index < 0 ? defaultValue : getAttributeFloatValue(index, defaultValue);
    }

    @Override
    public String getIdAttribute()
    {
        return mIdIndex > 0 && mIdIndex <= mAttributeCount ? getAttributeValue(mIdIndex - 1) : null;
    }

    @Override
    public String getClassAttribute()
    {
        return mClassIndex > 0 && mClassIndex <= mAttributeCount ? getAttributeValue(mClassIndex - 1) : null;
    }

    @Override
    public int getIdAttributeResourceValue(int defaultValue)
    {
        return mIdIndex > 0 && mIdIndex <= mAttributeCount ? getAttributeResourceValue(mIdIndex - 1, defaultValue) : defaultValue;
    }

    @Override
    public int getStyleAttribute()
    {
        if (mStyleIndex > 0 && mStyleIndex <= mAttributeCount) return attributeData(mStyleIndex - 1);

        int index = indexOfResource(0x01010000);
        return index < 0 ? 0 : getAttributeResourceValue(index, 0);
    }
}
```

```java
    public int updateFrom(Configuration source)
    {
        if (source == null) return 0;

        int changes = diff(source);

        if (source.fontScale > 0) fontScale = source.fontScale;
        if (source.mcc != 0) mcc = source.mcc;
        if (source.mnc != 0) mnc = source.mnc;
        if (source.mLocaleList != null && !source.mLocaleList.isEmpty())
        {
            mLocaleList = source.mLocaleList;
            locale = source.locale;
        }
        if (source.mGrammaticalGender != GRAMMATICAL_GENDER_NOT_SPECIFIED) mGrammaticalGender = source.mGrammaticalGender;
        if (source.touchscreen != TOUCHSCREEN_UNDEFINED) touchscreen = source.touchscreen;
        if (source.keyboard != KEYBOARD_UNDEFINED) keyboard = source.keyboard;
        if (source.keyboardHidden != KEYBOARDHIDDEN_UNDEFINED) keyboardHidden = source.keyboardHidden;
        if (source.hardKeyboardHidden != KEYBOARDHIDDEN_UNDEFINED) hardKeyboardHidden = source.hardKeyboardHidden;
        if (source.navigation != NAVIGATION_UNDEFINED) navigation = source.navigation;
        if (source.navigationHidden != NAVIGATIONHIDDEN_UNDEFINED) navigationHidden = source.navigationHidden;
        if (source.orientation != ORIENTATION_UNDEFINED) orientation = source.orientation;
        if (source.screenLayout != SCREENLAYOUT_UNDEFINED) screenLayout = source.screenLayout;
        if (source.colorMode != COLOR_MODE_UNDEFINED) colorMode = source.colorMode;
        if (source.uiMode != UI_MODE_TYPE_UNDEFINED) uiMode = source.uiMode;
        if (source.screenWidthDp != SCREEN_WIDTH_DP_UNDEFINED) screenWidthDp = source.screenWidthDp;
        if (source.screenHeightDp != SCREEN_HEIGHT_DP_UNDEFINED) screenHeightDp = source.screenHeightDp;
        if (source.smallestScreenWidthDp != SMALLEST_SCREEN_WIDTH_DP_UNDEFINED) smallestScreenWidthDp = source.smallestScreenWidthDp;
        if (source.densityDpi != DENSITY_DPI_UNDEFINED) densityDpi = source.densityDpi;
        if (source.fontWeightAdjustment != FONT_WEIGHT_ADJUSTMENT_UNDEFINED) fontWeightAdjustment = source.fontWeightAdjustment;

        return changes;
    }

    public int diff(Configuration other)
    {
        if (other == null) return 0;

        int changes = 0;

        if (other.fontScale > 0 && fontScale != other.fontScale) changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_FONT_SCALE;
        if (other.mcc != 0 && mcc != other.mcc) changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_MCC;
        if (other.mnc != 0 && mnc != other.mnc) changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_MNC;
        if (other.mLocaleList != null && !other.mLocaleList.isEmpty() && !mLocaleList.equals(other.mLocaleList))
        {
            changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_LOCALE | ActivityInfo.CONFIG_LAYOUT_DIRECTION;
        }
        if (other.touchscreen != TOUCHSCREEN_UNDEFINED && touchscreen != other.touchscreen) changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_TOUCHSCREEN;
        if (other.keyboard != KEYBOARD_UNDEFINED && keyboard != other.keyboard) changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_KEYBOARD;
        if (other.keyboardHidden != KEYBOARDHIDDEN_UNDEFINED && keyboardHidden != other.keyboardHidden)
        {
            changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_KEYBOARD_HIDDEN;
        }
        if (other.hardKeyboardHidden != KEYBOARDHIDDEN_UNDEFINED && hardKeyboardHidden != other.hardKeyboardHidden)
        {
            changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_KEYBOARD_HIDDEN;
        }
        if (other.navigation != NAVIGATION_UNDEFINED && navigation != other.navigation) changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_NAVIGATION;
        if (other.navigationHidden != NAVIGATIONHIDDEN_UNDEFINED && navigationHidden != other.navigationHidden)
        {
            changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_KEYBOARD_HIDDEN;
        }
        if (other.orientation != ORIENTATION_UNDEFINED && orientation != other.orientation) changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_ORIENTATION;
        if (other.screenLayout != SCREENLAYOUT_UNDEFINED && screenLayout != other.screenLayout)
        {
            changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_SCREEN_LAYOUT;
            if ((screenLayout & SCREENLAYOUT_LAYOUTDIR_MASK) != (other.screenLayout & SCREENLAYOUT_LAYOUTDIR_MASK))
            {
                changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_LAYOUT_DIRECTION;
            }
        }
        if (other.colorMode != COLOR_MODE_UNDEFINED && colorMode != other.colorMode) changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_COLOR_MODE;
        if (other.uiMode != UI_MODE_TYPE_UNDEFINED && uiMode != other.uiMode) changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_UI_MODE;
        if (other.screenWidthDp != SCREEN_WIDTH_DP_UNDEFINED && screenWidthDp != other.screenWidthDp) changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_SCREEN_SIZE;
        if (other.screenHeightDp != SCREEN_HEIGHT_DP_UNDEFINED && screenHeightDp != other.screenHeightDp) changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_SCREEN_SIZE;
        if (other.smallestScreenWidthDp != SMALLEST_SCREEN_WIDTH_DP_UNDEFINED && smallestScreenWidthDp != other.smallestScreenWidthDp)
        {
            changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_SMALLEST_SCREEN_SIZE;
        }
        if (other.densityDpi != DENSITY_DPI_UNDEFINED && densityDpi != other.densityDpi) changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_DENSITY;
        if (other.fontWeightAdjustment != FONT_WEIGHT_ADJUSTMENT_UNDEFINED && fontWeightAdjustment != other.fontWeightAdjustment)
        {
            changes |= ActivityInfo.CONFIG_FONT_WEIGHT_ADJUSTMENT;
        }

        return changes;
    }

    public static boolean needNewResources(int configChanges, int interestingChanges)
    {
        interestingChanges = interestingChanges | ActivityInfo.CONFIG_FONT_SCALE | ActivityInfo.CONFIG_FONT_WEIGHT_ADJUSTMENT;
        return (configChanges & interestingChanges) != 0;
    }

    public static Configuration generateDelta(Configuration base, Configuration change)
    {
        Configuration delta = new Configuration();
        delta.fontScale = 0;
        delta.mLocaleList = LocaleList.getEmptyLocaleList();
        delta.locale = null;
        delta.densityDpi = DENSITY_DPI_UNDEFINED;
        delta.screenLayout = SCREENLAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
        delta.orientation = ORIENTATION_UNDEFINED;
        delta.uiMode = UI_MODE_TYPE_UNDEFINED;
        delta.touchscreen = TOUCHSCREEN_UNDEFINED;
        delta.keyboard = KEYBOARD_UNDEFINED;
        delta.keyboardHidden = KEYBOARDHIDDEN_UNDEFINED;
        delta.hardKeyboardHidden = HARDKEYBOARDHIDDEN_UNDEFINED;
        delta.navigation = NAVIGATION_UNDEFINED;

        if (base.fontScale != change.fontScale) delta.fontScale = change.fontScale;
        if (base.mcc != change.mcc) delta.mcc = change.mcc;
        if (base.mnc != change.mnc) delta.mnc = change.mnc;
        if (!base.mLocaleList.equals(change.mLocaleList))
        {
            delta.mLocaleList = change.mLocaleList;
            delta.locale = change.locale;
        }
        if (base.mGrammaticalGender != change.mGrammaticalGender) delta.mGrammaticalGender = change.mGrammaticalGender;
        if (base.touchscreen != change.touchscreen) delta.touchscreen = change.touchscreen;
        if (base.keyboard != change.keyboard) delta.keyboard = change.keyboard;
        if (base.keyboardHidden != change.keyboardHidden) delta.keyboardHidden = change.keyboardHidden;
        if (base.hardKeyboardHidden != change.hardKeyboardHidden) delta.hardKeyboardHidden = change.hardKeyboardHidden;
        if (base.navigation != change.navigation) delta.navigation = change.navigation;
        if (base.navigationHidden != change.navigationHidden) delta.navigationHidden = change.navigationHidden;
        if (base.orientation != change.orientation) delta.orientation = change.orientation;
        if (base.screenLayout != change.screenLayout) delta.screenLayout = change.screenLayout;
        if (base.colorMode != change.colorMode) delta.colorMode = change.colorMode;
        if (base.uiMode != change.uiMode) delta.uiMode = change.uiMode;
        if (base.screenWidthDp != change.screenWidthDp) delta.screenWidthDp = change.screenWidthDp;
        if (base.screenHeightDp != change.screenHeightDp) delta.screenHeightDp = change.screenHeightDp;
        if (base.smallestScreenWidthDp != change.smallestScreenWidthDp) delta.smallestScreenWidthDp = change.smallestScreenWidthDp;
        if (base.densityDpi != change.densityDpi) delta.densityDpi = change.densityDpi;
        if (base.fontWeightAdjustment != change.fontWeightAdjustment) delta.fontWeightAdjustment = change.fontWeightAdjustment;

        return delta;
    }

    public LocaleList getLocales()
    {
        return mLocaleList;
    }

    public void setLocales(LocaleList locales)
    {
        if (locales == null || locales.isEmpty()) return;

        mLocaleList = locales;
        locale = locales.get(0);
        setLayoutDirection(locale);
    }

    public void setLocale(Locale value)
    {
        setLocales(value == null ? LocaleList.getEmptyLocaleList() : new LocaleList(value));
    }

    public int getGrammaticalGender()
    {
        return mGrammaticalGender;
    }

    public int getLayoutDirection()
    {
        return (screenLayout & SCREENLAYOUT_LAYOUTDIR_MASK) == SCREENLAYOUT_LAYOUTDIR_RTL ? 1 : 0;
    }

    public void setLayoutDirection(Locale value)
    {
        int layoutDirection = 1 + android.text.TextUtils.getLayoutDirectionFromLocale(value);
        screenLayout = (screenLayout & ~SCREENLAYOUT_LAYOUTDIR_MASK) | (layoutDirection << SCREENLAYOUT_LAYOUTDIR_SHIFT);
    }

    public boolean isLayoutSizeAtLeast(int size)
    {
        int current = screenLayout & SCREENLAYOUT_SIZE_MASK;
        if (current == SCREENLAYOUT_SIZE_UNDEFINED) return false;
        return current >= size;
    }

    public boolean isNightModeActive()
    {
        return (uiMode & UI_MODE_NIGHT_MASK) == UI_MODE_NIGHT_YES;
    }

    public boolean isScreenRound()
    {
        return (screenLayout & SCREENLAYOUT_ROUND_MASK) == SCREENLAYOUT_ROUND_YES;
    }

    public boolean isScreenWideColorGamut()
    {
        return (colorMode & COLOR_MODE_WIDE_COLOR_GAMUT_MASK) == COLOR_MODE_WIDE_COLOR_GAMUT_YES;
    }

    public boolean isScreenHdr()
    {
        return (colorMode & COLOR_MODE_HDR_MASK) == COLOR_MODE_HDR_YES;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeFloat(fontScale);
        destination.writeInt(mcc);
        destination.writeInt(mnc);
        destination.writeString(mLocaleList == null ? "" : mLocaleList.toLanguageTags());
        destination.writeInt(mGrammaticalGender);
        destination.writeInt(touchscreen);
        destination.writeInt(keyboard);
        destination.writeInt(keyboardHidden);
        destination.writeInt(hardKeyboardHidden);
        destination.writeInt(navigation);
        destination.writeInt(navigationHidden);
        destination.writeInt(orientation);
        destination.writeInt(screenLayout);
        destination.writeInt(colorMode);
        destination.writeInt(uiMode);
        destination.writeInt(screenWidthDp);
        destination.writeInt(screenHeightDp);
        destination.writeInt(smallestScreenWidthDp);
        destination.writeInt(densityDpi);
        destination.writeInt(fontWeightAdjustment);
    }

    public void readFromParcel(Parcel source)
    {
        fontScale = source.readFloat();
        mcc = source.readInt();
        mnc = source.readInt();
        String tags = source.readString();
        mLocaleList = tags == null || tags.isEmpty() ? LocaleList.getEmptyLocaleList() : LocaleList.forLanguageTags(tags);
        locale = mLocaleList.isEmpty() ? null : mLocaleList.get(0);
        mGrammaticalGender = source.readInt();
        touchscreen = source.readInt();
        keyboard = source.readInt();
        keyboardHidden = source.readInt();
        hardKeyboardHidden = source.readInt();
        navigation = source.readInt();
        navigationHidden = source.readInt();
        orientation = source.readInt();
        screenLayout = source.readInt();
        colorMode = source.readInt();
        uiMode = source.readInt();
        screenWidthDp = source.readInt();
        screenHeightDp = source.readInt();
        smallestScreenWidthDp = source.readInt();
        densityDpi = source.readInt();
        fontWeightAdjustment = source.readInt();
    }

    @Override
    public int compareTo(Configuration that)
    {
        float scaleDifference = fontScale - that.fontScale;
        if (scaleDifference != 0) return scaleDifference < 0 ? -1 : 1;

        int[] mine = comparableFields();
        int[] theirs = that.comparableFields();

        for (int index = 0; index < mine.length; index++)
        {
            if (mine[index] != theirs[index]) return mine[index] < theirs[index] ? -1 : 1;
        }

        String myTags = mLocaleList == null ? "" : mLocaleList.toLanguageTags();
        String theirTags = that.mLocaleList == null ? "" : that.mLocaleList.toLanguageTags();
        return myTags.compareTo(theirTags);
    }

    private int[] comparableFields()
    {
        return new int[] {mcc, mnc, mGrammaticalGender, touchscreen, keyboard, keyboardHidden, hardKeyboardHidden, navigation,
                          navigationHidden, orientation, screenLayout, colorMode, uiMode, screenWidthDp, screenHeightDp,
                          smallestScreenWidthDp, densityDpi, fontWeightAdjustment};
    }

    public boolean equals(Configuration other)
    {
        if (other == null) return false;
        if (other == this) return true;

        return fontScale == other.fontScale && mcc == other.mcc && mnc == other.mnc && densityDpi == other.densityDpi
                && screenWidthDp == other.screenWidthDp && screenHeightDp == other.screenHeightDp
                && smallestScreenWidthDp == other.smallestScreenWidthDp && screenLayout == other.screenLayout
                && orientation == other.orientation && uiMode == other.uiMode && colorMode == other.colorMode
                && touchscreen == other.touchscreen && keyboard == other.keyboard && keyboardHidden == other.keyboardHidden
                && hardKeyboardHidden == other.hardKeyboardHidden && navigation == other.navigation
                && navigationHidden == other.navigationHidden && fontWeightAdjustment == other.fontWeightAdjustment
                && mGrammaticalGender == other.mGrammaticalGender && java.util.Objects.equals(locale, other.locale);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        return other instanceof Configuration && equals((Configuration)other);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        int result = Float.floatToIntBits(fontScale);
        result = result * 31 + densityDpi;
        result = result * 31 + screenWidthDp;
        result = result * 31 + screenHeightDp;
        result = result * 31 + screenLayout;
        result = result * 31 + orientation;
        result = result * 31 + uiMode;
        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Configuration{" + screenWidthDp + "x" + screenHeightDp + "dp density=" + densityDpi + " locale=" + locale + "}";
    }
}
```

`java/android/content/res/QuantityRules.java`:

```java
package android.content.res;

import java.util.Locale;

final class QuantityRules
{
    static final int OTHER = 0;
    static final int ZERO = 1;
    static final int ONE = 2;
    static final int TWO = 3;
    static final int FEW = 4;
    static final int MANY = 5;

    private static final int[] NONE = {};
    private static final int[] ONE_ONLY = {ONE};
    private static final int[] ONE_FEW = {ONE, FEW};
    private static final int[] ONE_TWO = {ONE, TWO};
    private static final int[] ONE_FEW_MANY = {ONE, FEW, MANY};
    private static final int[] ONE_MANY = {ONE, MANY};
    private static final int[] ALL = {ZERO, ONE, TWO, FEW, MANY};

    private QuantityRules()
    {
    }

    static int[] categoriesFor(Locale locale)
    {
        String language = locale == null ? "en" : locale.getLanguage();

        switch (language)
        {
            case "ja":
            case "ko":
            case "zh":
            case "vi":
            case "th":
            case "id":
            case "in":
            case "ms":
            case "my":
            case "lo":
            case "km":
                return NONE;
            case "ru":
            case "uk":
            case "be":
            case "pl":
            case "lt":
            case "cs":
            case "sk":
                return ONE_FEW_MANY;
            case "ro":
            case "hr":
            case "sr":
            case "bs":
                return ONE_FEW;
            case "he":
            case "iw":
                return ONE_TWO;
            case "ar":
            case "cy":
                return ALL;
            case "fr":
            case "it":
            case "es":
            case "pt":
                return ONE_MANY;
            default:
                return ONE_ONLY;
        }
    }

    static int categoryOf(Locale locale, int quantity)
    {
        String language = locale == null ? "en" : locale.getLanguage();
        int absolute = Math.abs(quantity);
        int lastDigit = absolute % 10;
        int lastTwo = absolute % 100;

        switch (language)
        {
            case "ja":
            case "ko":
            case "zh":
            case "vi":
            case "th":
            case "id":
            case "in":
            case "ms":
            case "my":
            case "lo":
            case "km":
                return OTHER;
            case "ru":
            case "uk":
            case "be":
                if (lastDigit == 1 && lastTwo != 11) return ONE;
                if (lastDigit >= 2 && lastDigit <= 4 && (lastTwo < 12 || lastTwo > 14)) return FEW;
                return MANY;
            case "pl":
                if (absolute == 1) return ONE;
                if (lastDigit >= 2 && lastDigit <= 4 && (lastTwo < 12 || lastTwo > 14)) return FEW;
                return MANY;
            case "lt":
                if (lastDigit == 1 && (lastTwo < 11 || lastTwo > 19)) return ONE;
                if (lastDigit >= 2 && (lastTwo < 11 || lastTwo > 19)) return FEW;
                return OTHER;
            case "cs":
            case "sk":
                if (absolute == 1) return ONE;
                if (absolute >= 2 && absolute <= 4) return FEW;
                return OTHER;
            case "ro":
                if (absolute == 1) return ONE;
                if (absolute == 0 || (lastTwo >= 2 && lastTwo <= 19)) return FEW;
                return OTHER;
            case "hr":
            case "sr":
            case "bs":
                if (lastDigit == 1 && lastTwo != 11) return ONE;
                if (lastDigit >= 2 && lastDigit <= 4 && (lastTwo < 12 || lastTwo > 14)) return FEW;
                return OTHER;
            case "he":
            case "iw":
                if (absolute == 1) return ONE;
                if (absolute == 2) return TWO;
                return OTHER;
            case "ar":
                if (absolute == 0) return ZERO;
                if (absolute == 1) return ONE;
                if (absolute == 2) return TWO;
                if (lastTwo >= 3 && lastTwo <= 10) return FEW;
                if (lastTwo >= 11) return MANY;
                return OTHER;
            case "cy":
                if (absolute == 0) return ZERO;
                if (absolute == 1) return ONE;
                if (absolute == 2) return TWO;
                if (absolute == 3) return FEW;
                if (absolute == 6) return MANY;
                return OTHER;
            case "fr":
                if (absolute == 0 || absolute == 1) return ONE;
                if (absolute != 0 && absolute % 1000000 == 0) return MANY;
                return OTHER;
            case "pt":
                if (absolute == 0 || absolute == 1) return ONE;
                if (absolute != 0 && absolute % 1000000 == 0) return MANY;
                return OTHER;
            case "it":
            case "es":
                if (absolute == 1) return ONE;
                if (absolute != 0 && absolute % 1000000 == 0) return MANY;
                return OTHER;
            case "hi":
            case "bn":
            case "fa":
            case "am":
            case "zu":
                return absolute <= 1 ? ONE : OTHER;
            default:
                return absolute == 1 ? ONE : OTHER;
        }
    }

    static int entryIndex(Locale locale, int quantity, int entryCount)
    {
        if (entryCount <= 1) return 0;

        int category = categoryOf(locale, quantity);
        if (category == OTHER) return 0;

        int[] categories = categoriesFor(locale);
        if (categories.length + 1 != entryCount)
        {
            if (entryCount == 2 && category == ONE) return 1;
            return 0;
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < categories.length; index++)
        {
            if (categories[index] == category) return index + 1;
        }

        return 0;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.content.res;

import android.content.res.loader.ResourcesLoader;
import android.graphics.drawable.ColorDrawable;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException;

public class Resources
{
    private final long mAssetsHandle;
    private final Configuration mConfiguration = new Configuration();
    private final DisplayMetrics mMetrics = new DisplayMetrics();
    private final AssetManager mAssets;
    private final java.util.ArrayList<Theme> mLiveThemes = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
    private final java.util.ArrayList<ResourcesLoader> mLoaders = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
    private ResourcesImpl mResourcesImpl;
    private ClassLoader mClassLoader = ClassLoader.getSystemClassLoader();

    public static final int ID_NULL = 0;
    private static final int ANDROID_NAME = 0x01010003;
    private static final int ANDROID_VALUE = 0x01010024;
    private static final int ANDROID_FONT = 0x01010532;
    private static final String ANDROID_NAMESPACE = "http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android";

    private static Resources sSystem;

    public Resources(long assetsHandle)
    {
        mAssetsHandle = assetsHandle;
        mAssets = new AssetManager(this, assetsHandle);
        mResourcesImpl = new ResourcesImpl(mAssets, mMetrics, mConfiguration);

        if (sSystem == null && assetsHandle != 0) sSystem = this;
    }

    public Resources(AssetManager assets, DisplayMetrics metrics, Configuration config)
    {
        mAssets = assets == null ? new AssetManager(this, 0) : assets;
        mAssetsHandle = mAssets.getHandle();
        mResourcesImpl = new ResourcesImpl(mAssets, mMetrics, mConfiguration);

        if (config != null) mConfiguration.setTo(config);
        if (metrics != null) mMetrics.setTo(metrics);
    }

    ResourcesImpl getImpl()

    void setImpl(ResourcesImpl impl)
    {
        if (impl == null || impl == mResourcesImpl) return;

        mConfiguration.setTo(impl.getConfiguration());
        mMetrics.setTo(impl.getDisplayMetrics());
        mResourcesImpl = impl;
    }

    public static int getAttributeSetSourceResId(AttributeSet set)

        return ID_NULL;

    public final void flushLayoutCache()

    }

    }

    public void addLoaders(ResourcesLoader... loaders)
    {
        if (loaders == null) return;

        synchronized (mLoaders)
        {
            for (ResourcesLoader loader : loaders)
            {
                if (loader != null && !mLoaders.contains(loader)) mLoaders.add(loader);
            }
        }
    }

    public void removeLoaders(ResourcesLoader... loaders)
    {
        if (loaders == null) return;

        synchronized (mLoaders)
        {
            for (ResourcesLoader loader : loaders) mLoaders.remove(loader);
        }
    }

    java.util.List<ResourcesLoader> getLoaders()
    {
        synchronized (mLoaders)
        {
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>(mLoaders);
        }
    }

    public static Resources getSystem()
    {
        if (sSystem == null) sSystem = new Resources(0);

        return sSystem;
    }

    public AssetManager getAssets()
    {
        return mAssets;
    }

    public Configuration getConfiguration()
    {
        return mConfiguration;
    }

    public DisplayMetrics getDisplayMetrics()
    {
        return mMetrics;
    }

    public void updateMetrics(int widthPixels, int heightPixels, int densityDpi)
    {
        mMetrics.widthPixels = widthPixels;
        mMetrics.heightPixels = heightPixels;
        mMetrics.densityDpi = densityDpi;
        mMetrics.density = densityDpi / (float)DisplayMetrics.DENSITY_DEFAULT;
        mMetrics.scaledDensity = mMetrics.density;
        mMetrics.xdpi = densityDpi;
        mMetrics.ydpi = densityDpi;

        mConfiguration.densityDpi = densityDpi;
        mConfiguration.screenWidthDp = (int)(widthPixels / mMetrics.density);
        mConfiguration.screenHeightDp = (int)(heightPixels / mMetrics.density);
        mConfiguration.orientation =
            widthPixels > heightPixels ? Configuration.ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE : Configuration.ORIENTATION_PORTRAIT;
    }

    public void updateConfiguration(Configuration configuration, DisplayMetrics metrics)
    {
        if (configuration != null) mConfiguration.setTo(configuration);
        if (metrics != null) mMetrics.setTo(metrics);
    }

    public Resources withConfiguration(Configuration overrideConfiguration)
    {
        Resources copy = new Resources(mAssetsHandle);
        copy.mMetrics.setTo(mMetrics);
        copy.mConfiguration.setTo(mConfiguration);
        if (overrideConfiguration != null) copy.mConfiguration.setTo(overrideConfiguration);
        return copy;
    }

    public final Theme newTheme()
    {
        Theme theme = new Theme(this);
        mLiveThemes.add(theme);
        return theme;
    }

    public void releaseThemes()
    {
        for (Theme theme : mLiveThemes)
        {
            theme.destroy();
        }
        mLiveThemes.clear();
    }

    public String getString(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException
    {
        return getText(resourceId).toString();
    }

    public String getString(int resourceId, Object... formatArgs) throws NotFoundException
    {
        return String.format(getString(resourceId), formatArgs);
    }

    public CharSequence getText(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException
    {
        String value = nativeGetString(mAssetsHandle, resourceId);
        if (value == null) throw new NotFoundException("String resource ID #0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));
        return value;
    }

    public CharSequence getText(int resourceId, CharSequence defaultValue)
    {
        String value = resourceId != 0 ? nativeGetString(mAssetsHandle, resourceId) : null;
        return value != null ? value : defaultValue;
    }

    public CharSequence getQuantityText(int resourceId, int quantity) throws NotFoundException
    {
        int count = nativeGetArraySize(mAssetsHandle, resourceId);
        if (count <= 0) throw new NotFoundException("Plural resource ID #0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));

        java.util.Locale locale = mConfiguration.getLocales().isEmpty() ? mConfiguration.locale : mConfiguration.getLocales().get(0);
        int index = QuantityRules.entryIndex(locale, quantity, count);
        int[] packed = nativeGetArrayEntry(mAssetsHandle, resourceId, index);
        if (packed == null && index != 0) packed = nativeGetArrayEntry(mAssetsHandle, resourceId, 0);
        if (packed == null)
        {
            throw new NotFoundException("Plural resource ID #0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId) + " quantity=" + quantity);
        }

        String value;
        if (packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING && packed[2] != 0) value = getStringOrNull(packed[2]);
        else if (packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING) value = nativeGetPooledString(mAssetsHandle, 0, packed[1]);
        else value = TypedValue.coerceToString(packed[0], packed[1]);

        if (value == null)
        {
            throw new NotFoundException("Plural resource ID #0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId) + " quantity=" + quantity);
        }
        return value;
    }

    public String getQuantityString(int resourceId, int quantity, Object... formatArgs) throws NotFoundException
    {
        String raw = getQuantityText(resourceId, quantity).toString();
        return String.format(mConfiguration.locale == null ? java.util.Locale.getDefault() : mConfiguration.locale, raw, formatArgs);
    }

    public String getQuantityString(int resourceId, int quantity) throws NotFoundException
    {
        return getQuantityText(resourceId, quantity).toString();
    }

    public TypedArray obtainTypedArray(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException
    {
        int count = nativeGetArraySize(mAssetsHandle, resourceId);
        if (count < 0) throw new NotFoundException("Array resource ID #0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));

        int[] attributes = new int[count];
        int[] data = new int[count * TypedArray.STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES];
        int[] indices = new int[count + 1];
        String[] strings = new String[count];

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            int[] packed = nativeGetArrayEntry(mAssetsHandle, resourceId, index);
            if (packed == null) continue;

            int base = index * TypedArray.STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES;
            data[base + TypedArray.STYLE_TYPE] = packed[0];
            data[base + TypedArray.STYLE_DATA] = packed[1];
            data[base + TypedArray.STYLE_RESOURCE_ID] = packed[2];

            if (packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING)
            {
                strings[index] = packed[2] != 0 ? getStringOrNull(packed[2]) : nativeGetPooledString(mAssetsHandle, 0, packed[1]);
            }

            if (packed[0] != TypedValue.TYPE_NULL) indices[++indices[0]] = index;
        }

        TypedArray array = new TypedArray(this);
        array.bind(attributes, data, indices, null);
        array.bindStrings(strings);
        return array;
    }

    String getStringOrNull(int resourceId)
    {
        return nativeGetString(mAssetsHandle, resourceId);
    }

    String getStringForCookie(int stringIndex, int cookie)
    {
        return nativeGetPooledString(mAssetsHandle, cookie - 1, stringIndex);
    }

    public int getIdentifier(String name, String defType, String defPackage)

    }

        String name = getResourceName(resourceId);
        int colon = name.indexOf(':');
        int slash = name.indexOf('/');

        if (slash < 0) return "";

    }

    public String getResourceEntryName(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException
    {
        String name = getResourceName(resourceId);

    public int getColor(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException
    {
        TypedValue value = new TypedValue();
        if (!fetchValue(resourceId, value)) throw new NotFoundException("Color 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));
        if (isColorStateListFile(value)) return getColorStateList(resourceId, null).getDefaultColor();
        return value.data;
    }

    public int getColor(int resourceId, Theme theme) throws NotFoundException
    {
        TypedValue value = new TypedValue();
        if (!fetchValue(resourceId, value)) throw new NotFoundException("Color 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));
        if (isColorStateListFile(value)) return getColorStateList(resourceId, theme).getDefaultColor();
        return value.data;
    }

    public ColorStateList getColorStateList(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException
    {
        return getColorStateList(resourceId, null);
    }

    public ColorStateList getColorStateList(int resourceId, Theme theme) throws NotFoundException
    {
        TypedValue value = new TypedValue();
        if (!fetchValue(resourceId, value)) throw new NotFoundException("Color state list 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));

        if (value.type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_COLOR_INT && value.type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_COLOR_INT)
        {
            return ColorStateList.valueOf(value.data);
        }

        String path = value.string == null ? null : value.string.toString();
        if (path == null || !path.endsWith(".xml"))
        {
            throw new NotFoundException("Resource 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId) + " is not a color or color state list");
        }

        XmlResourceParser parser = null;
        try
        {
            parser = getXml(resourceId);
            return ColorStateList.createFromXml(this, parser, theme);
        }
        catch (org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException | java.io.IOException failure)
        {
            NotFoundException missing = new NotFoundException("File " + path + " from color state list resource ID #0x" +
                                                              Integer.toHexString(resourceId));
            missing.initCause(failure);
            throw missing;
        }
        finally
        {
            if (parser != null) parser.close();
        }
    }

    private boolean isColorStateListFile(TypedValue value)
    {
        return value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING && value.string != null && value.string.toString().endsWith(".xml");
    }

    public int getInteger(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException
    {
        TypedValue value = new TypedValue();
        if (!fetchValue(resourceId, value)) throw new NotFoundException("Integer 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));
        return value.data;
    }

    public boolean getBoolean(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException
    {
        return getInteger(resourceId) != 0;
    }

    public float getFloat(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException
    {
        TypedValue value = new TypedValue();
        if (!fetchValue(resourceId, value)) throw new NotFoundException("Float 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));

        if (value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT) return Float.intBitsToFloat(value.data);

        return value.data;
    }

    public float getDimension(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException
    {
        TypedValue value = new TypedValue();
        if (!fetchValue(resourceId, value)) throw new NotFoundException("Dimension 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));
        return TypedValue.complexToDimension(value.data, mMetrics);
    }

    public Drawable getDrawable(int resourceId)
    {
        TypedValue value = new TypedValue();
        if (!fetchValue(resourceId, value)) return null;

        if (value.type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_COLOR_INT && value.type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_COLOR_INT)
        {
            return new ColorDrawable(value.data);
        }

        String path = value.string == null ? null : value.string.toString();

        if (path != null && path.endsWith(".xml"))
        {
            XmlResourceParser parser = null;

            try
            {
                parser = getXml(resourceId);
                return Drawable.createFromXml(this, parser);
            }
            catch (Exception failure)
            {
                android.util.Log.w("Resources", "cannot inflate drawable 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId) + ": "
                                                + failure);
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                if (parser != null) parser.close();
            }
        }

        if (path != null && path.endsWith(".9.png"))
        {
            try (java.io.InputStream stream = getAssets().openNonAsset(path))
            {
                Drawable patch = Drawable.createFromResourceStream(this, value, stream, path);
                if (patch != null) return patch;
            }
            catch (Exception failure)
            {
                android.util.Log.w("Resources", "cannot read nine-patch " + path + ": " + failure);
            }
        }

        if (path != null)
        {
            android.graphics.Bitmap bitmap = getBitmap(resourceId);
            if (bitmap != null) return new android.graphics.drawable.BitmapDrawable(this, bitmap);
        }

        runtime.Strict.unimplemented("Resources.getDrawable type 0x" + Integer.toHexString(value.type)
                                     + " for 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));
        return null;
    }

    public java.io.InputStream openRawResource(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException
    {
        return openRawResource(resourceId, new TypedValue());
    }

    public java.io.InputStream openRawResource(int resourceId, TypedValue value) throws NotFoundException
    {
        if (!fetchValue(resourceId, value) || value.string == null)
        {
            throw new NotFoundException("no raw resource 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));
        }

        String path = value.string.toString();

        try
        {
            return getAssets().openNonAsset(path);
        }
        catch (java.io.IOException failure)
        {
            throw new NotFoundException("cannot read " + path + ": " + failure);
        }
    }

    public AssetFileDescriptor openRawResourceFd(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException

        }
    }

    public android.graphics.Bitmap getBitmap(int resourceId)
    {
        TypedValue value = new TypedValue();
        if (!fetchValue(resourceId, value) || value.string == null) return null;

        String path = value.string.toString();

        try (java.io.InputStream stream = getAssets().openNonAsset(path))
        {
            return android.graphics.BitmapFactory.decodeStream(stream);
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            android.util.Log.w("Resources", "cannot read image " + path + ": " + failure);
            return null;
        }
    }

    public float getFraction(int resourceId, int base, int pbase)

    public android.graphics.Movie getMovie(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException

            }
        }
    }

    public android.graphics.Typeface getFont(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException
    {
        TypedValue value = new TypedValue();
        if (!fetchValue(resourceId, value) || value.string == null)
        {
            throw new NotFoundException("Font resource ID #0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));
        }

        String path = value.string.toString();

        if (!path.endsWith(".xml"))
        {
            android.graphics.Typeface typeface = new android.graphics.Typeface.Builder(getAssets(), path, false, 0).build();
            if (typeface != null) return typeface;
            throw new NotFoundException("Font resource ID #0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId) + " could not be retrieved.");
        }

        int fontResource = 0;
        XmlResourceParser parser = null;

        try
        {
            parser = getXml(resourceId);
            int type;
            while ((type = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
            {
                if (type != XmlPullParser.START_TAG || !"font".equals(parser.getName())) continue;

                int candidate = 0;
                for (int index = 0; index < parser.getAttributeCount(); index++)
                {
                    if (parser.getAttributeNameResource(index) == ANDROID_FONT || "font".equals(parser.getAttributeName(index)))
                    {
                        candidate = parser.getAttributeResourceValue(index, 0);
                        if (candidate != 0) break;
                    }
                }

                if (candidate == 0) continue;

                String weight = parser.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "fontWeight");
                String style = parser.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "fontStyle");
                boolean regular = (weight == null || "400".equals(weight)) && (style == null || "0".equals(style) || "normal".equals(style));
                if (fontResource == 0 || regular) fontResource = candidate;
                if (regular) break;
            }
        }
        catch (XmlPullParserException | java.io.IOException failure)
        {
            NotFoundException missing = new NotFoundException("Font resource ID #0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));
            missing.initCause(failure);
            throw missing;
        }
        finally
        {
            if (parser != null) parser.close();
        }

        if (fontResource == 0 || fontResource == resourceId)
        {
            throw new NotFoundException("Font resource ID #0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId) + " could not be retrieved.");
        }

        return getFont(fontResource);
    }

    public void parseBundleExtras(XmlResourceParser parser, Bundle outBundle) throws XmlPullParserException, java.io.IOException
    {
        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int type;

        while ((type = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT && (type != XmlPullParser.END_TAG || parser.getDepth() > outerDepth))
        {
            if (type == XmlPullParser.END_TAG || type == XmlPullParser.TEXT) continue;

            if ("extra".equals(parser.getName())) parseBundleExtra("extra", parser, outBundle);

            skipCurrentTag(parser);
        }
    }

    private static void skipCurrentTag(XmlPullParser parser) throws XmlPullParserException, java.io.IOException
    {
        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int type;

        while ((type = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT && (type != XmlPullParser.END_TAG || parser.getDepth() > outerDepth))
        {
        }
    }

    public void parseBundleExtra(String tagName, AttributeSet attrs, Bundle outBundle) throws XmlPullParserException
    {
        TypedArray array = obtainAttributes(attrs, new int[] {ANDROID_NAME, ANDROID_VALUE});

        try
        {
            String name = array.getString(0);
            if (name == null) name = attrs.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "name");
            if (name == null)
            {
                throw new XmlPullParserException("<" + tagName + "> requires an android:name attribute at " + attrs.getPositionDescription());
            }

            TypedValue value = array.peekValue(1);
            if (value == null)
            {
                throw new XmlPullParserException("<" + tagName + "> requires an android:value or android:resource attribute at "
                                                 + attrs.getPositionDescription());
            }

            if (value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING)
            {
                outBundle.putCharSequence(name, value.string);
            }
            else if (value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_INT_BOOLEAN)
            {
                outBundle.putBoolean(name, value.data != 0);
            }
            else if (value.type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && value.type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT)
            {
                outBundle.putInt(name, value.data);
            }
            else if (value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT)
            {
                outBundle.putFloat(name, value.getFloat());
            }
            else
            {
                throw new XmlPullParserException("<" + tagName + "> only supports string, integer, float, color, and boolean at "
                                                 + attrs.getPositionDescription());
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            array.recycle();
        }
    }

    public void getValue(int resourceId, TypedValue outValue, boolean resolveRefs) throws NotFoundException
    {
        if (fetchValue(resourceId, outValue)) return;
        throw new NotFoundException("Resource ID #0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));
    }

    public void getValue(String name, TypedValue outValue, boolean resolveRefs) throws NotFoundException
    {
        getValue(getIdentifier(name, null, null), outValue, resolveRefs);
    }

    public void getValueForDensity(int resourceId, int density, TypedValue outValue, boolean resolveRefs) throws NotFoundException

        getValue(resourceId, outValue, resolveRefs);
    }

    private boolean fetchValue(int resourceId, TypedValue outValue)
    {
        int[] packed = nativeGetResourceValue(mAssetsHandle, resourceId);
        if (packed == null) return false;

        outValue.type = packed[0];
        outValue.data = packed[1];
        outValue.resourceId = packed[2];
        if (outValue.type == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING) outValue.string = getStringOrNull(resourceId);
        return true;
    }

    public String[] getStringArray(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException
    {
        CharSequence[] text = getTextArray(resourceId);
        String[] values = new String[text.length];

        for (int index = 0; index < text.length; index++) values[index] = text[index] == null ? null : text[index].toString();

        return values;
    }

    public CharSequence[] getTextArray(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException
    {
        int count = nativeGetArraySize(mAssetsHandle, resourceId);
        if (count < 0) throw new NotFoundException("Array 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));

        CharSequence[] values = new CharSequence[count];

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            int[] packed = nativeGetArrayEntry(mAssetsHandle, resourceId, index);
            if (packed == null) continue;

            if (packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING && packed[2] != 0) values[index] = getStringOrNull(packed[2]);
            else if (packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING) values[index] = nativeGetPooledString(mAssetsHandle, 0, packed[1]);
            else values[index] = Integer.toString(packed[1]);
        }

        return values;
    }

    public int[] getIntArray(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException
    {
        int count = nativeGetArraySize(mAssetsHandle, resourceId);
        if (count < 0) throw new NotFoundException("Array 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));

        int[] values = new int[count];

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            int[] packed = nativeGetArrayEntry(mAssetsHandle, resourceId, index);
            if (packed != null) values[index] = packed[1];
        }

        return values;
    }

    private static native int nativeGetArraySize(long assetsHandle, int resourceId);

    private static native int[] nativeGetArrayEntry(long assetsHandle, int resourceId, int index);

    public XmlResourceParser getLayout(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException

        if (handle == 0) throw new NotFoundException("Layout 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId));
        return new XmlBlock.Parser(this, handle);
    }

    XmlResourceParser openXmlBuffer(byte[] data)

        return handle == 0 ? null : new XmlBlock.Parser(this, handle);

    public TypedArray obtainAttributes(AttributeSet set, int[] attributes)
    {
        TypedArray array = new TypedArray(this);
        XmlBlock.Parser parser = set instanceof XmlBlock.Parser ? (XmlBlock.Parser)set : null;
        long xmlHandle = parser == null ? 0 : parser.getHandle();

        int[] data = new int[attributes.length * TypedArray.STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES];
        int[] indices = new int[attributes.length + 1];

        nativeObtainNoTheme(mAssetsHandle, xmlHandle, attributes, data, indices);
        array.bind(attributes, data, indices, parser);
        return array;
    }

    public static class NotFoundException extends RuntimeException
    {
        public NotFoundException()
        {
        }

        public NotFoundException(String message)
        {
            super(message);
        }

        public NotFoundException(String message, Exception cause)
        {
            super(message, cause);
        }
    }

    public final class Theme
    {
        private final Resources mOwner;
        private final java.util.ArrayList<int[]> mAppliedStyles = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        private long mHandle;

        Theme(Resources owner)
        {
            mOwner = owner;
            mHandle = nativeCreateTheme(owner.mAssetsHandle);
        }

        public Resources getResources()
        {
            return mOwner;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object other)
        {
            if (this == other) return true;
            if (!(other instanceof Theme)) return false;

            Theme that = (Theme)other;
            if (mOwner != that.mOwner || mAppliedStyles.size() != that.mAppliedStyles.size()) return false;

            for (int index = 0; index < mAppliedStyles.size(); index++)
            {
                if (!java.util.Arrays.equals(mAppliedStyles.get(index), that.mAppliedStyles.get(index))) return false;
            }

            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            int hash = System.identityHashCode(mOwner);
            for (int[] style : mAppliedStyles) hash = 31 * hash + java.util.Arrays.hashCode(style);

            return hash;
        }

        long getHandle()
        {
            return mHandle;
        }

        public void applyStyle(int resourceId, boolean force)
        {
            if (mHandle == 0) return;
            nativeApplyStyle(mHandle, resourceId, force);
            mAppliedStyles.add(new int[] {resourceId, force ? 1 : 0});
        }

        public void setTo(Theme other)
        {
            if (other == null || mHandle == 0 || other.mHandle == 0) return;
            nativeSetTo(mHandle, other.mHandle);

            mAppliedStyles.clear();
            mAppliedStyles.addAll(other.mAppliedStyles);
        }

        public void rebase()
        {
            if (mHandle == 0) return;

            nativeClearTheme(mHandle);
            for (int[] applied : mAppliedStyles)
            {
                nativeApplyStyle(mHandle, applied[0], applied[1] != 0);
            }
        }

        public void release()
        {
            mOwner.mLiveThemes.remove(this);
            destroy();
        }

        void destroy()
        {
            if (mHandle == 0) return;

            nativeDestroyTheme(mHandle);
            mHandle = 0;
            mAppliedStyles.clear();
        }

        public boolean resolveAttribute(int attributeId, TypedValue outValue, boolean resolveRefs)
        {
            if (mHandle == 0) return false;

            int[] packed = nativeResolveAttribute(mHandle, attributeId);
            if (packed == null) return false;

            outValue.type = packed[0];
            outValue.data = packed[1];
            outValue.resourceId = packed[2];
            if (outValue.type == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING) outValue.string = mOwner.getStringOrNull(outValue.resourceId);
            return true;
        }

        public TypedArray obtainStyledAttributes(int[] attributes)
        {
            return obtainStyledAttributes(null, attributes, 0, 0);
        }

        public TypedArray obtainStyledAttributes(int resourceId, int[] attributes)
        {
            return obtainStyledAttributes(null, attributes, 0, resourceId);
        }

        public TypedArray obtainStyledAttributes(AttributeSet set, int[] attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
        {
            TypedArray array = new TypedArray(mOwner, this);

            int[] data = new int[attributes.length * TypedArray.STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES];
            int[] indices = new int[attributes.length + 1];

            XmlBlock.Parser parser = set instanceof XmlBlock.Parser ? (XmlBlock.Parser)set : null;
            long xmlHandle = parser == null ? 0 : parser.getHandle();
            nativeObtainStyled(mHandle, xmlHandle, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes, attributes, data, indices);

            array.bind(attributes, data, indices, parser);
            return array;
        }

        public Drawable getDrawable(int resourceId) throws NotFoundException
        {
            return mOwner.getDrawable(resourceId, this);
        }

        public int getChangingConfigurations()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        public void dump(int priority, String tag, String prefix)
        {
            android.util.Log.println(priority, tag, prefix + toString());
        }

        public int getExplicitStyle(AttributeSet set)
        {
            return set == null ? ID_NULL : set.getStyleAttribute();
        }

        public int[] getAttributeResolutionStack(int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes, int explicitStyleRes)
        {
            return new int[0];
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            StringBuilder styles = new StringBuilder();
            for (int[] applied : mAppliedStyles)
            {
                if (styles.length() > 0) styles.append(", ");
                styles.append("0x").append(Integer.toHexString(applied[0]));
            }
            return "Theme{" + styles + "}";
        }
    }

    private static native long nativeCreateTheme(long assetsHandle);

    private static native void nativeApplyStyle(long themeHandle, int resourceId, boolean force);

    private static native void nativeSetTo(long targetHandle, long sourceHandle);

    static native long nativeAssetOpen(long assetsHandle, String path);

    static native long nativeAssetOpenNonAsset(long assetsHandle, String path);

    static native java.io.FileDescriptor nativeAssetOpenFd(long assetHandle, long[] outDescriptorOffsetLength);

    static native long nativeAssetLength(long assetHandle);

    static native int nativeAssetRead(long assetHandle, byte[] buffer, int offset, int count);

    static native void nativeAssetClose(long assetHandle);

    static native String[] nativeAssetList(long assetsHandle, String directory);

    private static native void nativeClearTheme(long themeHandle);

    private static native void nativeDestroyTheme(long themeHandle);

    private static native int[] nativeResolveAttribute(long themeHandle, int attributeId);

    private static native void nativeObtainStyled(long themeHandle, long xmlHandle, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes, int[] attributes,
                                                  int[] outValues, int[] outIndices);
}
```

```java
    }
```
