`java/android/content/res/TypedArray.java`:

```java
package android.content.res;

import android.util.DisplayMetrics;
import android.util.TypedValue;

public class TypedArray implements AutoCloseable
{
    static final int STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES = 7;
    static final int STYLE_TYPE = 0;
    static final int STYLE_DATA = 1;
    static final int STYLE_ASSET_COOKIE = 2;
    static final int STYLE_RESOURCE_ID = 3;
    static final int STYLE_CHANGING_CONFIGURATIONS = 4;
    static final int STYLE_DENSITY = 5;
    static final int STYLE_SOURCE_RESOURCE_ID = 6;

    private final Resources mResources;
    private int[] mData;
    private int[] mIndices;
    private int[] mAttributes;
    private XmlBlock.Parser mParser;
    private int mLength;
    private boolean mRecycled;
    private Resources.Theme mTheme;
    private String[] mStrings;

    TypedArray(Resources resources)
    {
        mResources = resources;
    }

    TypedArray(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        mResources = resources;
        mTheme = theme;
    }

    void bind(int[] attributes, int[] data, int[] indices, XmlBlock.Parser parser)
    {
        mAttributes = attributes;
        mData = data;
        mIndices = indices;
        mParser = parser;
        mLength = attributes.length;
        mRecycled = false;
        mStrings = null;
    }

    void bindStrings(String[] strings)
    {
        mStrings = strings;
    }

    public Resources getResources()
    {
        return mResources;
    }

    public int length()
    {
        return mLength;
    }

    public int getIndexCount()
    {
        return mIndices == null ? 0 : mIndices[0];
    }

    public int getIndex(int at)
    {
        return mIndices[at + 1];
    }

    public boolean hasValue(int index)
    {
        return typeAt(index) != TypedValue.TYPE_NULL;
    }

    public boolean hasValueOrEmpty(int index)
    {
        return hasValue(index);
    }

    public int getType(int index)
    {
        return typeAt(index);
    }

    public int getResourceId(int index, int defaultValue)
    {
        if (!inRange(index)) return defaultValue;

        int resourceId = mData[index * STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES + STYLE_RESOURCE_ID];
        return resourceId != 0 ? resourceId : defaultValue;
    }

    public boolean getBoolean(int index, boolean defaultValue)
    {
        int type = typeAt(index);
        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_NULL) return defaultValue;
        if (type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return dataAt(index) != 0;
        return defaultValue;
    }

    public int getInt(int index, int defaultValue)
    {
        int type = typeAt(index);
        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_NULL) return defaultValue;
        if (type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return dataAt(index);
        return defaultValue;
    }

    public int getInteger(int index, int defaultValue)
    {
        return getInt(index, defaultValue);
    }

    public float getFloat(int index, float defaultValue)
    {
        int type = typeAt(index);
        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT) return Float.intBitsToFloat(dataAt(index));
        if (type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return dataAt(index);
        return defaultValue;
    }

    public int getColor(int index, int defaultValue)
    {
        int type = typeAt(index);
        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_NULL) return defaultValue;
        if (type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return dataAt(index);

        int resourceId = mData[index * STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES + STYLE_RESOURCE_ID];
        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING && resourceId != 0)
        {
            ColorStateList colors = mResources.getColorStateList(resourceId, mTheme);
            return colors != null ? colors.getDefaultColor() : defaultValue;
        }

        return defaultValue;
    }

    public ColorStateList getColorStateList(int index)
    {
        int type = typeAt(index);
        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_NULL) return null;
        if (type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_COLOR_INT && type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_COLOR_INT)
        {
            return ColorStateList.valueOf(dataAt(index));
        }

        int resourceId = mData[index * STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES + STYLE_RESOURCE_ID];
        if (resourceId != 0) return mResources.getColorStateList(resourceId, mTheme);

        runtime.Strict.unimplemented("TypedArray.getColorStateList type 0x" + Integer.toHexString(type));
        return null;
    }

    public float getDimension(int index, float defaultValue)
    {
        if (typeAt(index) != TypedValue.TYPE_DIMENSION) return defaultValue;
        return TypedValue.complexToDimension(dataAt(index), metrics());
    }

    public int getDimensionPixelOffset(int index, int defaultValue)
    {
        if (typeAt(index) != TypedValue.TYPE_DIMENSION) return defaultValue;
        return TypedValue.complexToDimensionPixelOffset(dataAt(index), metrics());
    }

    public int getDimensionPixelSize(int index, int defaultValue)
    {
        if (typeAt(index) != TypedValue.TYPE_DIMENSION) return defaultValue;
        return TypedValue.complexToDimensionPixelSize(dataAt(index), metrics());
    }

    public int getLayoutDimension(int index, String name)
    {
        int type = typeAt(index);
        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_DIMENSION) return TypedValue.complexToDimensionPixelSize(dataAt(index), metrics());
        if (type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return dataAt(index);

        throw new RuntimeException("You must supply a " + name + " attribute.");
    }

    public int getLayoutDimension(int index, int defaultValue)
    {
        int type = typeAt(index);
        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_DIMENSION) return TypedValue.complexToDimensionPixelSize(dataAt(index), metrics());
        if (type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return dataAt(index);
        return defaultValue;
    }

    public float getFraction(int index, int base, int pbase, float defaultValue)
    {
        if (typeAt(index) != TypedValue.TYPE_FRACTION) return defaultValue;
        return TypedValue.complexToFraction(dataAt(index), base, pbase);
    }

    public String getString(int index)
    {
        if (!inRange(index)) return null;
        if (mStrings != null && index < mStrings.length && mStrings[index] != null) return mStrings[index];

        int type = typeAt(index);
        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_NULL) return null;

        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING)
        {
            int cookie = cookieAt(index);
            if (cookie < 0) return mParser == null ? null : mParser.getPooledString(dataAt(index));
            return mResources.getStringForCookie(dataAt(index), cookie);
        }

        int resourceId = mData[index * STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES + STYLE_RESOURCE_ID];
        if (resourceId != 0) return mResources.getStringOrNull(resourceId);

        return TypedValue.coerceToString(type, dataAt(index));
    }

    public String getNonResourceString(int index)
    {
        return getString(index);
    }

    public CharSequence getText(int index)
    {
        return getString(index);
    }

    public CharSequence[] getTextArray(int index)
    {
        String value = getString(index);
        return value == null ? new CharSequence[0] : new CharSequence[] {value};
    }

    public android.graphics.drawable.Drawable getDrawable(int index)
    {
        int type = typeAt(index);
        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_NULL) return null;
        if (type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_COLOR_INT && type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_COLOR_INT)
        {
            return new android.graphics.drawable.ColorDrawable(dataAt(index));
        }

        int resourceId = mData[index * STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES + STYLE_RESOURCE_ID];
        return resourceId == 0 ? null : mResources.getDrawable(resourceId);
    }

    public android.graphics.Typeface getFont(int index)
    {
        int resourceId = inRange(index) ? mData[index * STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES + STYLE_RESOURCE_ID] : 0;
        if (resourceId == 0) return android.graphics.Typeface.DEFAULT;

        try
        {
            return mResources.getFont(resourceId);
        }
        catch (Resources.NotFoundException failure)
        {
            return android.graphics.Typeface.DEFAULT;
        }
    }

    public int getSourceResourceId(int index, int defaultValue)
    {
        if (!inRange(index)) return defaultValue;

        int resourceId = mData[index * STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES + STYLE_SOURCE_RESOURCE_ID];
        return resourceId != 0 ? resourceId : defaultValue;
    }

    public boolean getValue(int index, TypedValue outValue)
    {
        if (!inRange(index)) return false;

        int base = index * STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES;
        outValue.type = mData[base + STYLE_TYPE];
        outValue.data = mData[base + STYLE_DATA];
        outValue.assetCookie = mData[base + STYLE_ASSET_COOKIE];
        outValue.resourceId = mData[base + STYLE_RESOURCE_ID];
        outValue.changingConfigurations = mData[base + STYLE_CHANGING_CONFIGURATIONS];
        outValue.density = mData[base + STYLE_DENSITY];
        outValue.sourceResourceId = mData[base + STYLE_SOURCE_RESOURCE_ID];

        if (outValue.type == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING) outValue.string = getString(index);
        return outValue.type != TypedValue.TYPE_NULL;
    }

    public TypedValue peekValue(int index)
    {
        TypedValue value = new TypedValue();
        return getValue(index, value) ? value : null;
    }

    public int getChangingConfigurations()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public String getPositionDescription()
    {
        return "<internal>";
    }

    public void recycle()
    {
        mRecycled = true;
    }

    @Override
    public void close()
    {
        recycle();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mData == null ? "TypedArray{}" : java.util.Arrays.toString(mData);
    }

    boolean isRecycled()
    {
        return mRecycled;
    }

    private DisplayMetrics metrics()
    {
        return mResources.getDisplayMetrics();
    }

    private int defaultTextColor()
    {
        return 0xFF000000;
    }

    private boolean inRange(int index)
    {
        return mData != null && index >= 0 && index < mLength;
    }

    private int typeAt(int index)
    {
        if (!inRange(index)) return TypedValue.TYPE_NULL;
        return mData[index * STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES + STYLE_TYPE];
    }

    private int dataAt(int index)
    {
        return mData[index * STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES + STYLE_DATA];
    }

    private int cookieAt(int index)
    {
        return mData[index * STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES + STYLE_ASSET_COOKIE];
    }
}
```

```java
public final class XmlBlock implements AutoCloseable
{
    private final byte[] mData;
    private final java.util.ArrayList<Parser> mParsers = new java.util.ArrayList<>();

    public XmlBlock(byte[] data)
    {
        mData = data;
    }

    public XmlResourceParser newParser()
    {
        android.app.Application application = android.app.ActivityThread.currentApplication();
        Resources resources = application != null ? application.getResources() : Resources.getSystem();

        XmlResourceParser parser = resources.openXmlBuffer(mData);
        if (parser instanceof Parser) mParsers.add((Parser)parser);
        return parser;
    }

    @Override
    public void close()
    {
        for (Parser parser : mParsers) parser.close();
        mParsers.clear();
    }
```

`java/android/content/res/loader/ResourcesLoader.java`:

```java
package android.content.res.loader;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

public class ResourcesLoader
{
    private final Object mLock = new Object();
    private final ArrayList<ResourcesProvider> mProviders = new ArrayList<>();

    public ResourcesLoader()
    {
    }

    public List<ResourcesProvider> getProviders()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            return Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(mProviders));
        }
    }

    public void addProvider(ResourcesProvider resourcesProvider)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (resourcesProvider == null || mProviders.contains(resourcesProvider)) return;
            mProviders.add(resourcesProvider);
        }
    }

    public void removeProvider(ResourcesProvider resourcesProvider)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            mProviders.remove(resourcesProvider);
        }
    }

    public void setProviders(List<ResourcesProvider> resourcesProviders)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            mProviders.clear();
            if (resourcesProviders == null) return;

            for (ResourcesProvider provider : resourcesProviders)
            {
                if (provider != null && !mProviders.contains(provider)) mProviders.add(provider);
            }
        }
    }

    public void clearProviders()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            mProviders.clear();
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/content/res/loader/ResourcesProvider.java`:

```java
package android.content.res.loader;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;
import java.io.Closeable;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;

public class ResourcesProvider implements AutoCloseable, Closeable
{
    private final AssetsProvider mAssetsProvider;
    private final ParcelFileDescriptor mDescriptor;
    private final String mPath;
    private boolean mOpen = true;

    ResourcesProvider()
    {
        this(null, null, null);
    }

    private ResourcesProvider(AssetsProvider assetsProvider, ParcelFileDescriptor descriptor, String path)
    {
        mAssetsProvider = assetsProvider;
        mDescriptor = descriptor;
        mPath = path;
    }

    public static ResourcesProvider empty(AssetsProvider assetsProvider)
    {
        return new ResourcesProvider(assetsProvider, null, null);
    }

    public static ResourcesProvider loadFromApk(ParcelFileDescriptor fileDescriptor) throws IOException
    {
        return loadFromApk(fileDescriptor, null);
    }

    public static ResourcesProvider loadFromApk(ParcelFileDescriptor fileDescriptor, AssetsProvider assetsProvider) throws IOException
    {
        if (fileDescriptor == null) throw new NullPointerException("fileDescriptor");
        return new ResourcesProvider(assetsProvider, fileDescriptor.dup(), null);
    }

    public static ResourcesProvider loadFromTable(ParcelFileDescriptor fileDescriptor, AssetsProvider assetsProvider) throws IOException
    {
        if (fileDescriptor == null) throw new NullPointerException("fileDescriptor");
        return new ResourcesProvider(assetsProvider, fileDescriptor.dup(), null);
    }

    public static ResourcesProvider loadFromSplit(Context context, String splitName) throws IOException
    {
        if (context == null || splitName == null) throw new NullPointerException();
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("split '" + splitName + "' is not installed");
    }

    public static ResourcesProvider loadFromDirectory(String path, AssetsProvider assetsProvider) throws IOException
    {
        if (path == null) throw new NullPointerException("path");
        if (!new File(path).isDirectory()) throw new IOException("failed to load resources from " + path);
        return new ResourcesProvider(assetsProvider, null, path);
    }

    @Override
    public void close()
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (!mOpen) return;
            mOpen = false;
        }

        if (mDescriptor == null) return;

        try
        {
            mDescriptor.close();
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            android.util.Log.w("ResourcesProvider", "failed to close the provider descriptor: " + failure);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        try
        {
            close();
        }
        finally
        {
            super.finalize();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "ResourcesProvider{" + (mPath != null ? mPath : mDescriptor) + "}";
    }
}
```

`java/android/database/AbstractCursor.java`:

```java
package android.database;

import android.content.ContentResolver;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

public abstract class AbstractCursor implements CrossProcessCursor
{
    protected int mPos = -1;
    protected boolean mClosed;
    protected ContentResolver mContentResolver;

    private final Object mSelfObserverLock = new Object();
    private final List<ContentObserver> mContentObservers = new ArrayList<>();
    private final DataSetObservable mDataSetObservable = new DataSetObservable();

    private ContentObserver mSelfObserver;
    private boolean mSelfObserverRegistered;
    private List<Uri> mNotifyUris;
    private Bundle mExtras = Bundle.EMPTY;

    public static class SelfContentObserver extends ContentObserver
    {
        private final java.lang.ref.WeakReference<AbstractCursor> mCursor;

        public SelfContentObserver(AbstractCursor cursor)
        {
            super(null);
            mCursor = new java.lang.ref.WeakReference<>(cursor);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean deliverSelfNotifications()
        {
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public void onChange(boolean selfChange)
        {
            AbstractCursor cursor = mCursor.get();
            if (cursor != null) cursor.onChange(false);
        }
    }

    public AbstractCursor()
    {
    }

    public abstract int getCount();

    public abstract String[] getColumnNames();

    public abstract String getString(int column);

    public abstract short getShort(int column);

    public abstract int getInt(int column);

    public abstract long getLong(int column);

    public abstract float getFloat(int column);

    public abstract double getDouble(int column);

    public abstract boolean isNull(int column);

    public int getType(int column)
    {
        return FIELD_TYPE_STRING;
    }

    public byte[] getBlob(int column)
    {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("getBlob is not supported");
    }

    public CursorWindow getWindow()
    {
        return null;
    }

    public int getColumnCount()
    {
        return getColumnNames().length;
    }

    public void deactivate()
    {
        onDeactivateOrClose();
    }

    protected void onDeactivateOrClose()
    {
        synchronized (mSelfObserverLock)
        {
            if (mSelfObserver != null && mSelfObserverRegistered && mContentResolver != null)
            {
                mContentResolver.unregisterContentObserver(mSelfObserver);
                mSelfObserverRegistered = false;
            }
        }

        mDataSetObservable.notifyInvalidated();
    }

    @Deprecated
    public boolean requery()
    {
        synchronized (mSelfObserverLock)
        {
            if (mSelfObserver != null && !mSelfObserverRegistered && mContentResolver != null && mNotifyUris != null)
            {
                for (Uri uri : mNotifyUris) mContentResolver.registerContentObserver(uri, true, mSelfObserver);
                mSelfObserverRegistered = true;
            }
        }

        mDataSetObservable.notifyChanged();
        return true;
    }

    public boolean isClosed()
    {
        return mClosed;
    }

    public void close()
    {
        mClosed = true;

        synchronized (mContentObservers)
        {
            mContentObservers.clear();
        }

        onDeactivateOrClose();
    }

    public boolean onMove(int oldPosition, int newPosition)
    {
        return true;
    }

    public void copyStringToBuffer(int columnIndex, CharArrayBuffer buffer)
    {
        if (buffer == null) return;
        buffer.copyFrom(getString(columnIndex));
    }

    public final int getPosition()
    {
        return mPos;
    }

    public final boolean moveToPosition(int position)
    {
        final int count = getCount();

        if (position >= count)
        {
            mPos = count;
            return false;
        }

        if (position < 0)
        {
            mPos = -1;
            return false;
        }

        if (position == mPos) return true;

        boolean result = onMove(mPos, position);
        mPos = result ? position : -1;
        return result;
    }

    public void fillWindow(int position, CursorWindow window)
    {
        if (window == null || position < 0 || position >= getCount()) return;

        final int oldPosition = mPos;
        final int columnCount = getColumnCount();

        window.acquireReference();

        try
        {
            window.clear();
            window.setStartPosition(position);
            window.setNumColumns(columnCount);

            if (moveToPosition(position))
            {
                do
                {
                    if (!window.allocRow()) break;

                    int row = mPos;

                    for (int column = 0; column < columnCount; column++)
                    {
                        switch (getType(column))
                        {
                            case FIELD_TYPE_NULL: window.putNull(row, column); break;
                            case FIELD_TYPE_INTEGER: window.putLong(getLong(column), row, column); break;
                            case FIELD_TYPE_FLOAT: window.putDouble(getDouble(column), row, column); break;
                            case FIELD_TYPE_BLOB: window.putBlob(getBlob(column), row, column); break;
                            default: window.putString(getString(column), row, column); break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                while (moveToNext());
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            window.releaseReference();
        }

        moveToPosition(oldPosition);
    }

    public final boolean move(int offset)
    {
        return moveToPosition(mPos + offset);
    }

    public final boolean moveToFirst()
    {
        return moveToPosition(0);
    }

    public final boolean moveToLast()
    {
        return moveToPosition(getCount() - 1);
    }

    public final boolean moveToNext()
    {
        return moveToPosition(mPos + 1);
    }

    public final boolean moveToPrevious()
    {
        return moveToPosition(mPos - 1);
    }

    public final boolean isFirst()
    {
        return mPos == 0 && getCount() != 0;
    }

    public final boolean isLast()
    {
        int count = getCount();
        return mPos == count - 1 && count != 0;
    }

    public final boolean isBeforeFirst()
    {
        return getCount() == 0 || mPos == -1;
    }

    public final boolean isAfterLast()
    {
        return getCount() == 0 || mPos == getCount();
    }

    public int getColumnIndex(String columnName)
    {
        if (columnName == null) return -1;

        final int periodIndex = columnName.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (periodIndex != -1) columnName = columnName.substring(periodIndex + 1);

        String[] columnNames = getColumnNames();
        for (int index = 0; index < columnNames.length; index++)
        {
            if (columnNames[index].equalsIgnoreCase(columnName)) return index;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public int getColumnIndexOrThrow(String columnName)
    {
        final int index = getColumnIndex(columnName);
        if (index < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("column '" + columnName + "' does not exist");

        return index;
    }

    public String getColumnName(int columnIndex)
    {
        return getColumnNames()[columnIndex];
    }

    public void registerContentObserver(ContentObserver observer)
    {
        if (observer == null) return;

        synchronized (mContentObservers)
        {
            if (mContentObservers.contains(observer)) throw new IllegalStateException("Observer " + observer + " is already registered.");
            mContentObservers.add(observer);
        }
    }

    public void unregisterContentObserver(ContentObserver observer)
    {
        if (mClosed) return;

        synchronized (mContentObservers)
        {
            mContentObservers.remove(observer);
        }
    }

    public void registerDataSetObserver(DataSetObserver observer)
    {
        mDataSetObservable.registerObserver(observer);
    }

    public void unregisterDataSetObserver(DataSetObserver observer)
    {
        mDataSetObservable.unregisterObserver(observer);
    }

    protected void onChange(boolean selfChange)
    {
        List<ContentObserver> observers;

        synchronized (mContentObservers)
        {
            observers = new ArrayList<>(mContentObservers);
        }

        for (ContentObserver observer : observers)
        {
            if (!selfChange || observer.deliverSelfNotifications()) observer.dispatchChange(selfChange, null);
        }
    }

    public void setNotificationUri(ContentResolver resolver, Uri notifyUri)
    {
        setNotificationUris(resolver, notifyUri == null ? null : Collections.singletonList(notifyUri));
    }

    public void setNotificationUris(ContentResolver resolver, List<Uri> notifyUris)
    {
        synchronized (mSelfObserverLock)
        {
            if (mSelfObserver != null && mSelfObserverRegistered && mContentResolver != null)
            {
                mContentResolver.unregisterContentObserver(mSelfObserver);
            }

            mNotifyUris = notifyUris == null ? null : new ArrayList<>(notifyUris);
            mContentResolver = resolver;
            mSelfObserverRegistered = false;

            if (resolver == null || mNotifyUris == null) return;

            if (mSelfObserver == null) mSelfObserver = new SelfContentObserver(this);

            for (Uri uri : mNotifyUris) resolver.registerContentObserver(uri, true, mSelfObserver);
            mSelfObserverRegistered = true;
        }
    }

    public Uri getNotificationUri()
    {
        synchronized (mSelfObserverLock)
        {
            return mNotifyUris == null || mNotifyUris.isEmpty() ? null : mNotifyUris.get(0);
        }
    }

    public List<Uri> getNotificationUris()
    {
        synchronized (mSelfObserverLock)
        {
            return mNotifyUris;
        }
    }

    public boolean getWantsAllOnMoveCalls()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void setExtras(Bundle extras)
    {
        mExtras = extras == null ? Bundle.EMPTY : extras;
    }

    public Bundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    public Bundle respond(Bundle extras)
    {
        return Bundle.EMPTY;
    }

    @Deprecated
    protected boolean isFieldUpdated(int columnIndex)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Deprecated
    protected Object getUpdatedField(int columnIndex)
    {
        return null;
    }

    protected void checkPosition()
    {
        if (mPos == -1 || getCount() == mPos) throw new CursorIndexOutOfBoundsException(mPos, getCount());
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize()
    {
    }
}
```

```java
public abstract class AbstractWindowedCursor extends AbstractCursor

    protected CursorWindow mWindow;

        return mWindow.getString(mPos, columnIndex);
    }

    @Override
    public void copyStringToBuffer(int columnIndex, CharArrayBuffer buffer)

        checkPosition();
        mWindow.copyStringToBuffer(mPos, columnIndex, buffer);
    }

    @Override
    public short getShort(int columnIndex)
    {
        checkPosition();
        return mWindow.getShort(mPos, columnIndex);
    }

    @Override
    public int getInt(int columnIndex)
    {
        checkPosition();
        return mWindow.getInt(mPos, columnIndex);
    }

    @Override
    public long getLong(int columnIndex)
    {
        checkPosition();
        return mWindow.getLong(mPos, columnIndex);
    }

    @Override
    public float getFloat(int columnIndex)
    {
        checkPosition();
        return mWindow.getFloat(mPos, columnIndex);
    }

    @Override
    public double getDouble(int columnIndex)
    {
        checkPosition();
        return mWindow.getDouble(mPos, columnIndex);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isNull(int columnIndex)
    {
        checkPosition();
        return mWindow.getType(mPos, columnIndex) == FIELD_TYPE_NULL;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public boolean isBlob(int columnIndex)
    {
        return getType(columnIndex) == FIELD_TYPE_BLOB;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public boolean isString(int columnIndex)
    {
        return getType(columnIndex) == FIELD_TYPE_STRING;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public boolean isLong(int columnIndex)
    {
        return getType(columnIndex) == FIELD_TYPE_INTEGER;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public boolean isFloat(int columnIndex)
    {
        return getType(columnIndex) == FIELD_TYPE_FLOAT;
    }

    @Override
    public int getType(int columnIndex)
    {
        checkPosition();
        return mWindow.getType(mPos, columnIndex);
    }

    @Override
    protected void checkPosition()
    {
        super.checkPosition();
        if (mWindow == null) throw new StaleDataException("Attempting to access a closed CursorWindow.");
    }

    @Override
    public CursorWindow getWindow()
    {
        return mWindow;
    }

    public void setWindow(CursorWindow window)
    {
        if (window == mWindow) return;

        closeWindow();
        mWindow = window;
    }

    public boolean hasWindow()
    {
        return mWindow != null;
    }

    protected void closeWindow()
    {
        if (mWindow == null) return;

        mWindow.close();
        mWindow = null;
    }

    @Override
    public void close()
    {
        super.close();
        closeWindow();
    }
}
```

`java/android/database/CharArrayBuffer.java`:

```java
package android.database;

public final class CharArrayBuffer
{
    public char[] data;
    public int sizeCopied;

    public CharArrayBuffer(int size)
    {
        data = new char[size];
    }

    public CharArrayBuffer(char[] buffer)
    {
        data = buffer;
    }

    void copyFrom(String value)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            sizeCopied = 0;
            return;
        }

        if (data == null || data.length < value.length()) data = new char[value.length()];

        value.getChars(0, value.length(), data, 0);
        sizeCopied = value.length();
    }
}
```

`java/android/database/ContentObserver.java`:

```java
package android.database;

import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Handler;

public abstract class ContentObserver
{
    private final Handler mHandler;

    public ContentObserver(Handler handler)
    {
        mHandler = handler;
    }

    public boolean deliverSelfNotifications()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void onChange(boolean selfChange)
    {
    }

    public void onChange(boolean selfChange, Uri uri)
    {
        onChange(selfChange);
    }

    public void onChange(boolean selfChange, Uri uri, int flags)
    {
        onChange(selfChange, uri);
    }

    public final void dispatchChange(boolean selfChange)
    {
        dispatchChange(selfChange, null);
    }

    public final void dispatchChange(boolean selfChange, Uri uri)
    {
        dispatchChange(selfChange, uri, 0);
    }

    public final void dispatchChange(final boolean selfChange, final Uri uri, final int flags)
    {
        if (mHandler == null)
        {
            onChange(selfChange, uri, flags);
            return;
        }

        mHandler.post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                onChange(selfChange, uri, flags);
            }
        });
    }
}
```

`java/android/database/CursorWindow.java`:

```java
package android.database;

import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteClosable;
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteException;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class CursorWindow extends SQLiteClosable implements Parcelable
{
    private static final long DEFAULT_WINDOW_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<CursorWindow> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<CursorWindow>()
    {
        @Override
        public CursorWindow createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return newFromParcel(source);
        }

        @Override
        public CursorWindow[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new CursorWindow[size];
        }
    };

    private final String mName;
    private final List<Object[]> mRows = new ArrayList<>();
    private int mColumnCount;
    private int mStartPosition;

    public CursorWindow(String name)
    {
        this(name, DEFAULT_WINDOW_BYTES);
    }

    public CursorWindow(String name, long windowSizeBytes)
    {
        mName = name == null || name.isEmpty() ? "<unnamed>" : name;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public CursorWindow(boolean localWindow)
    {
        this((String)null);
    }

    public static CursorWindow newFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
    {
        Object value = parcel == null ? null : parcel.readValue(null);
        return value instanceof CursorWindow ? (CursorWindow)value : new CursorWindow((String)null);
    }

    public synchronized void clear()
    {
        mRows.clear();
        mStartPosition = 0;
    }

    public int getStartPosition()
    {
        return mStartPosition;
    }

    public void setStartPosition(int position)
    {
        mStartPosition = position;
    }

    public synchronized int getNumRows()
    {
        return mRows.size();
    }

    public synchronized boolean setNumColumns(int columnCount)
    {
        if (!mRows.isEmpty() && columnCount != mColumnCount) return false;

        mColumnCount = columnCount;
        return true;
    }

    public synchronized boolean allocRow()
    {
        mRows.add(new Object[mColumnCount]);
        return true;
    }

    public synchronized void freeLastRow()
    {
        if (!mRows.isEmpty()) mRows.remove(mRows.size() - 1);
    }

    private synchronized Object valueAt(int row, int column)
    {
        int index = row - mStartPosition;
        if (index < 0 || index >= mRows.size() || column < 0 || column >= mColumnCount)
            throw new IllegalStateException("row " + row + " column " + column + " is outside the window " + mName);

        return mRows.get(index)[column];
    }

    private synchronized boolean store(Object value, int row, int column)
    {
        int index = row - mStartPosition;
        if (index < 0 || index >= mRows.size() || column < 0 || column >= mColumnCount) return false;

        mRows.get(index)[column] = value;
        return true;
    }

    public int getType(int row, int column)
    {
        Object value = valueAt(row, column);

        if (value == null) return Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_NULL;
        if (value instanceof byte[]) return Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_BLOB;
        if (value instanceof Double) return Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_FLOAT;
        if (value instanceof Long) return Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_INTEGER;

        return Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_STRING;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public boolean isNull(int row, int column)
    {
        return getType(row, column) == Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_NULL;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public boolean isBlob(int row, int column)
    {
        int type = getType(row, column);
        return type == Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_BLOB || type == Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_NULL;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public boolean isLong(int row, int column)
    {
        return getType(row, column) == Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_INTEGER;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public boolean isFloat(int row, int column)
    {
        return getType(row, column) == Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_FLOAT;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public boolean isString(int row, int column)
    {
        int type = getType(row, column);
        return type == Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_STRING || type == Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_NULL;
    }

    public byte[] getBlob(int row, int column)
    {
        Object value = valueAt(row, column);
        if (value == null || value instanceof byte[]) return (byte[])value;
        if (value instanceof String) return ((String)value).getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

        throw new SQLiteException("unable to convert " + value.getClass().getSimpleName() + " to a blob");
    }

    public String getString(int row, int column)
    {
        Object value = valueAt(row, column);
        if (value == null || value instanceof String) return (String)value;
        if (value instanceof byte[]) throw new SQLiteException("unable to convert a blob to a string");

        return value.toString();
    }

    public void copyStringToBuffer(int row, int column, CharArrayBuffer buffer)
    {
        if (buffer == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the CharArrayBuffer must not be null");
        buffer.copyFrom(getString(row, column));
    }

    public long getLong(int row, int column)
    {
        Object value = valueAt(row, column);
        if (value == null) return 0L;
        if (value instanceof Number) return ((Number)value).longValue();
        if (value instanceof String) return parseLong((String)value);

        throw new SQLiteException("unable to convert a blob to a long");
    }

    public double getDouble(int row, int column)
    {
        Object value = valueAt(row, column);
        if (value == null) return 0.0;
        if (value instanceof Number) return ((Number)value).doubleValue();
        if (value instanceof String) return parseDouble((String)value);

        throw new SQLiteException("unable to convert a blob to a double");
    }

    public short getShort(int row, int column)
    {
        return (short)getLong(row, column);
    }

    public int getInt(int row, int column)
    {
        return (int)getLong(row, column);
    }

    public float getFloat(int row, int column)
    {
        return (float)getDouble(row, column);
    }

    public boolean putBlob(byte[] value, int row, int column)
    {
        return store(value == null ? null : value.clone(), row, column);
    }

    public boolean putString(String value, int row, int column)
    {
        return store(value, row, column);
    }

    public boolean putLong(long value, int row, int column)
    {
        return store(Long.valueOf(value), row, column);
    }

    public boolean putDouble(double value, int row, int column)
    {
        return store(Double.valueOf(value), row, column);
    }

    public boolean putNull(int row, int column)
    {
        return store(null, row, column);
    }

    private static long parseLong(String text)
    {
        try
        {
            return Long.parseLong(text.trim());
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
        {
            return (long)parseDouble(text);
        }
    }

    private static double parseDouble(String text)
    {
        try
        {
            return Double.parseDouble(text.trim());
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
        {
            return 0.0;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeValue(this);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onAllReferencesReleased()
    {
        clear();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mName + " {" + getNumRows() + " rows}";
    }
}
```

```java
package android.database;

public class DataSetObservable extends Observable<DataSetObserver>
{
    public void notifyChanged()
    {
        synchronized (mObservers)
        {
            for (int index = mObservers.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--) mObservers.get(index).onChanged();
        }
    }

    public void notifyInvalidated()
    {
        synchronized (mObservers)
        {
            for (int index = mObservers.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--) mObservers.get(index).onInvalidated();
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/database/DatabaseUtils.java`:

```java
package android.database;

import android.content.ContentValues;
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase;
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteProgram;
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteStatement;

public class DatabaseUtils
{
    private DatabaseUtils()
    {
    }

    public static void appendEscapedSQLString(StringBuilder into, String value)
    {
        if (into == null) return;

        into.append('\'');

        if (value != null)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < value.length(); index++)
            {
                char letter = value.charAt(index);

                if (letter == '\'') into.append('\'');

                into.append(letter);
            }
        }

        into.append('\'');
    }

    public static String sqlEscapeString(String value)
    {
        StringBuilder escaped = new StringBuilder();
        appendEscapedSQLString(escaped, value);

        return escaped.toString();
    }

    public static void appendValueToSql(StringBuilder into, Object value)
    {
        if (into == null) return;

        if (value == null) into.append("NULL");
        else if (value instanceof Boolean) into.append(((Boolean)value).booleanValue() ? '1' : '0');
        else if (value instanceof Number) into.append(value.toString());
        else appendEscapedSQLString(into, value.toString());
    }

    public static long queryNumEntries(SQLiteDatabase database, String table)
    {
        return queryNumEntries(database, table, null, null);
    }

    public static long queryNumEntries(SQLiteDatabase database, String table, String selection)
    {
        return queryNumEntries(database, table, selection, null);
    }

    public static long queryNumEntries(SQLiteDatabase database, String table, String selection, String[] selectionArgs)
    {
        if (database == null || table == null) return 0;

        String where = selection == null || selection.isEmpty() ? "" : " where " + selection;
        Cursor cursor = database.rawQuery("select count(*) from " + table + where, selectionArgs);

        if (cursor == null) return 0;

        try
        {
            return cursor.moveToFirst() ? cursor.getLong(0) : 0;
        }
        finally
        {
            cursor.close();
        }
    }

    public static long longForQuery(SQLiteDatabase database, String query, String[] selectionArgs)
    {
        if (database == null) return 0;

        Cursor cursor = database.rawQuery(query, selectionArgs);

        if (cursor == null) return 0;

        try
        {
            return cursor.moveToFirst() ? cursor.getLong(0) : 0;
        }
        finally
        {
            cursor.close();
        }
    }

    public static long longForQuery(SQLiteStatement statement, String[] selectionArgs)
    {
        if (statement == null) return 0;

        bindAllArgsAsStrings(statement, selectionArgs);

        return statement.simpleQueryForLong();
    }

    public static String stringForQuery(SQLiteStatement statement, String[] selectionArgs)
    {
        if (statement == null) return null;

        bindAllArgsAsStrings(statement, selectionArgs);

        return statement.simpleQueryForString();
    }

    public static void bindAllArgsAsStrings(SQLiteProgram program, String[] selectionArgs)
    {
        if (program == null || selectionArgs == null) return;

        for (int index = selectionArgs.length; index != 0; index--)
        {
            program.bindString(index, selectionArgs[index - 1]);
        }
    }

    public static String stringForQuery(SQLiteDatabase database, String query, String[] selectionArgs)
    {
        if (database == null) return null;

        Cursor cursor = database.rawQuery(query, selectionArgs);

        if (cursor == null) return null;

        try
        {
            return cursor.moveToFirst() ? cursor.getString(0) : null;
        }
        finally
        {
            cursor.close();
        }
    }

    public static int getSqlStatementType(String sql)
    {
        if (sql == null) return STATEMENT_OTHER;

        String trimmed = sql.trim();

        if (trimmed.length() < 3) return STATEMENT_OTHER;

        String prefix = trimmed.substring(0, 3).toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.US);

        if (prefix.equals("SEL")) return STATEMENT_SELECT;
        if (prefix.equals("INS") || prefix.equals("UPD") || prefix.equals("REP") || prefix.equals("DEL"))
        {
            return STATEMENT_UPDATE;
        }
        if (prefix.equals("ATT")) return STATEMENT_ATTACH;
        if (prefix.equals("COM") || prefix.equals("END")) return STATEMENT_COMMIT;
        if (prefix.equals("ROL")) return STATEMENT_ABORT;
        if (prefix.equals("BEG")) return STATEMENT_BEGIN;
        if (prefix.equals("PRA")) return STATEMENT_PRAGMA;
        if (prefix.equals("CRE") || prefix.equals("DRO") || prefix.equals("ALT")) return STATEMENT_DDL;

        return STATEMENT_OTHER;
    }

    public static final int STATEMENT_SELECT = 1;
    public static final int STATEMENT_UPDATE = 2;
    public static final int STATEMENT_ATTACH = 3;
    public static final int STATEMENT_BEGIN = 4;
    public static final int STATEMENT_COMMIT = 5;
    public static final int STATEMENT_ABORT = 6;
    public static final int STATEMENT_PRAGMA = 7;
    public static final int STATEMENT_DDL = 8;
    public static final int STATEMENT_UNPREPARED = 9;
    public static final int STATEMENT_OTHER = 99;

    public static void bindObjectToProgram(SQLiteProgram program, int index, Object value)
    {
        if (program == null) return;

        if (value == null) program.bindNull(index);
        else if (value instanceof Double || value instanceof Float) program.bindDouble(index, ((Number)value).doubleValue());
        else if (value instanceof Number) program.bindLong(index, ((Number)value).longValue());
        else if (value instanceof byte[]) program.bindBlob(index, (byte[])value);
        else if (value instanceof Boolean) program.bindLong(index, ((Boolean)value).booleanValue() ? 1 : 0);
        else program.bindString(index, value.toString());
    }

    public static void cursorRowToContentValues(Cursor cursor, ContentValues values)
    {
        if (cursor == null || values == null) return;

        String[] columns = cursor.getColumnNames();

        for (int index = 0; index < columns.length; index++)
        {
            values.put(columns[index], cursor.getString(index));
        }
    }

    public static void cursorStringToContentValues(Cursor cursor, String column, ContentValues values)
    {
        if (cursor == null || values == null) return;

        values.put(column, cursor.getString(cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(column)));
    }

    public static void cursorIntToContentValues(Cursor cursor, String column, ContentValues values)
    {
        if (cursor == null || values == null) return;

        int index = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(column);

        if (cursor.isNull(index)) values.put(column, (Integer)null);
        else values.put(column, Integer.valueOf(cursor.getInt(index)));
    }

    public static void cursorLongToContentValues(Cursor cursor, String column, ContentValues values)
    {
        if (cursor == null || values == null) return;

        int index = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(column);

        if (cursor.isNull(index)) values.put(column, (Long)null);
        else values.put(column, Long.valueOf(cursor.getLong(index)));
    }
}
```

`java/android/database/DefaultDatabaseErrorHandler.java`:

```java
package android.database;

import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase;
import android.util.Log;
import android.util.Pair;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.List;

public final class DefaultDatabaseErrorHandler implements DatabaseErrorHandler
{
    private static final String TAG = "DefaultDatabaseErrorHandler";

    public DefaultDatabaseErrorHandler()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public void onCorruption(SQLiteDatabase database)
    {
        Log.e(TAG, "Corruption reported by sqlite on database: " + database.getPath());

        if (!database.isOpen())
        {
            deleteDatabaseFile(database.getPath());
            return;
        }

        List<Pair<String, String>> attachedDbs = null;
        try
        {
            try
            {
                attachedDbs = database.getAttachedDbs();
            }
            catch (RuntimeException ignored)
            {
            }

            try
            {
                database.close();
            }
            catch (RuntimeException ignored)
            {
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            if (attachedDbs != null)
            {
                for (Pair<String, String> attached : attachedDbs) deleteDatabaseFile(attached.second);
            }
            else
            {
                deleteDatabaseFile(database.getPath());
            }
        }
    }

    private void deleteDatabaseFile(String fileName)
    {
        if (fileName == null || ":memory:".equalsIgnoreCase(fileName) || fileName.trim().isEmpty()) return;

        Log.e(TAG, "deleting the database file: " + fileName);

        try
        {
            SQLiteDatabase.deleteDatabase(new File(fileName));
        }
        catch (RuntimeException failure)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "delete failed: " + failure.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/database/MatrixCursor.java`:

```java
package android.database;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class MatrixCursor extends AbstractCursor
{
    private final String[] mColumns;
    private final List<Object[]> mRows = new ArrayList<>();

    public MatrixCursor(String[] columnNames)
    {
        mColumns = columnNames == null ? new String[0] : columnNames;
    }

    public MatrixCursor(String[] columnNames, int initialCapacity)
    {
        this(columnNames);
    }

    public void addRow(Object[] values)
    {
        if (values == null) return;
        if (values.length != mColumns.length)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("columnNames.length = " + mColumns.length + ", columnValues.length = " + values.length);

        mRows.add(values.clone());
    }

    public void addRow(Iterable<?> values)
    {
        if (values == null) return;

        Object[] row = new Object[mColumns.length];
        int index = 0;

        for (Object value : values)
        {
            if (index >= mColumns.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("columnValues.size() > columnNames.length");
            row[index++] = value;
        }

        if (index != mColumns.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("columnValues.size() < columnNames.length");

        mRows.add(row);
    }

    public RowBuilder newRow()
    {
        Object[] row = new Object[mColumns.length];
        mRows.add(row);

        return new RowBuilder(row, mColumns);
    }

    public class RowBuilder
    {
        private final Object[] mRow;
        private final String[] mNames;
        private int mIndex;

        RowBuilder(Object[] row, String[] names)
        {
            mRow = row;
            mNames = names;
        }

        public RowBuilder add(Object value)
        {
            if (mIndex >= mRow.length) throw new CursorIndexOutOfBoundsException("No more columns left.");

            mRow[mIndex++] = value;
            return this;
        }

        public RowBuilder add(String columnName, Object value)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < mNames.length; index++)
            {
                if (mNames[index].equals(columnName)) mRow[index] = value;
            }

            return this;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int getCount()
    {
        return mRows.size();
    }

    @Override
    public String[] getColumnNames()
    {
        return mColumns;
    }

    @Override
    public String getString(int columnIndex)
    {
        Object value = valueAt(columnIndex);
        return value == null ? null : value.toString();
    }

    @Override
    public short getShort(int columnIndex)
    {
        Object value = valueAt(columnIndex);
        if (value == null) return 0;
        if (value instanceof Number) return ((Number)value).shortValue();

        return Short.parseShort(value.toString());
    }

    @Override
    public int getInt(int columnIndex)
    {
        Object value = valueAt(columnIndex);
        if (value == null) return 0;
        if (value instanceof Number) return ((Number)value).intValue();

        return Integer.parseInt(value.toString());
    }

    @Override
    public long getLong(int columnIndex)
    {
        Object value = valueAt(columnIndex);
        if (value == null) return 0L;
        if (value instanceof Number) return ((Number)value).longValue();

        return Long.parseLong(value.toString());
    }

    @Override
    public float getFloat(int columnIndex)
    {
        Object value = valueAt(columnIndex);
        if (value == null) return 0f;
        if (value instanceof Number) return ((Number)value).floatValue();

        return Float.parseFloat(value.toString());
    }

    @Override
    public double getDouble(int columnIndex)
    {
        Object value = valueAt(columnIndex);
        if (value == null) return 0d;
        if (value instanceof Number) return ((Number)value).doubleValue();

        return Double.parseDouble(value.toString());
    }

    @Override
    public byte[] getBlob(int columnIndex)
    {
        Object value = valueAt(columnIndex);
        return value instanceof byte[] ? (byte[])value : null;
    }

    @Override
    public int getType(int columnIndex)
    {
        Object value = valueAt(columnIndex);

        if (value == null) return FIELD_TYPE_NULL;
        if (value instanceof byte[]) return FIELD_TYPE_BLOB;
        if (value instanceof Float || value instanceof Double) return FIELD_TYPE_FLOAT;
        if (value instanceof Number) return FIELD_TYPE_INTEGER;

        return FIELD_TYPE_STRING;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isNull(int columnIndex)
    {
        return valueAt(columnIndex) == null;
    }

    private Object valueAt(int columnIndex)
    {
        if (columnIndex < 0 || columnIndex >= mColumns.length)
            throw new CursorIndexOutOfBoundsException("Requested column: " + columnIndex + ", # of columns: " + mColumns.length);
        if (mPos < 0) throw new CursorIndexOutOfBoundsException("Before first row.");
        if (mPos >= mRows.size()) throw new CursorIndexOutOfBoundsException("After last row.");

        return mRows.get(mPos)[columnIndex];
    }
}
```

`java/android/database/Observable.java`:

```java
package android.database;

import java.util.ArrayList;

public abstract class Observable<T>
{
    protected final ArrayList<T> mObservers = new ArrayList<T>();

    public void registerObserver(T observer)
    {
        if (observer == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the observer is required");

        synchronized (mObservers)
        {
            if (mObservers.contains(observer))
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException("observer " + observer + " is already registered");
            }

            mObservers.add(observer);
        }
    }

    public void unregisterObserver(T observer)
    {
        if (observer == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the observer is required");

        synchronized (mObservers)
        {
            int index = mObservers.indexOf(observer);

            if (index == -1) throw new IllegalStateException("observer " + observer + " was not registered");

            mObservers.remove(index);
        }
    }

    public void unregisterAll()
    {
        synchronized (mObservers)
        {
            mObservers.clear();
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/database/sqlite/SQLiteClosable.java`:

```java
package android.database.sqlite;

import java.io.Closeable;

public abstract class SQLiteClosable implements Closeable
{
    private int mReferenceCount = 1;

    public SQLiteClosable()
    {
    }

    protected abstract void onAllReferencesReleased();

    @Deprecated
    protected void onAllReferencesReleasedFromContainer()
    {
        onAllReferencesReleased();
    }

    public void acquireReference()
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mReferenceCount <= 0) throw new IllegalStateException("attempt to re-open an already-closed object: " + this);
            mReferenceCount++;
        }
    }

    public void releaseReference()
    {
        boolean released;

        synchronized (this)
        {
            released = --mReferenceCount == 0;
        }

        if (released) onAllReferencesReleased();
    }

    @Deprecated
    public void releaseReferenceFromContainer()
    {
        boolean released;

        synchronized (this)
        {
            released = --mReferenceCount == 0;
        }

        if (released) onAllReferencesReleasedFromContainer();
    }

    public void close()
    {
        releaseReference();
    }
}
```

`java/android/database/sqlite/SQLiteCursor.java`:

```java
package android.database.sqlite;

import android.database.AbstractWindowedCursor;
import android.database.CursorWindow;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class SQLiteCursor extends AbstractWindowedCursor
{
    private static final int NO_COUNT = -1;

    private final String mEditTable;
    private final String[] mColumns;
    private final SQLiteQuery mQuery;
    private final SQLiteCursorDriver mDriver;
    private int mCount = NO_COUNT;
    private Map<String, Integer> mColumnNameMap;

    @Deprecated
    public SQLiteCursor(SQLiteDatabase database, SQLiteCursorDriver driver, String editTable, SQLiteQuery query)
    {
        this(driver, editTable, query);
    }

    public SQLiteCursor(SQLiteCursorDriver driver, String editTable, SQLiteQuery query)
    {
        if (query == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("query object cannot be null");

        mDriver = driver;
        mEditTable = editTable;
        mQuery = query;
        mColumns = query.getColumnNames();
    }

    public SQLiteDatabase getDatabase()
    {
        return mQuery.getDatabase();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onMove(int oldPosition, int newPosition)
    {
        if (mWindow == null || newPosition < mWindow.getStartPosition()
            || newPosition >= mWindow.getStartPosition() + mWindow.getNumRows())
        {
            fillWindow();
        }

        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public int getCount()
    {
        if (mCount == NO_COUNT) fillWindow();
        return mCount;
    }

    private void fillWindow()
    {
        if (mWindow == null) mWindow = new CursorWindow(mEditTable == null ? mQuery.toString() : mEditTable);
        mCount = mQuery.fillWindow(mWindow);
    }

    @Override
    public int getColumnIndex(String columnName)
    {
        if (mColumnNameMap == null)
        {
            Map<String, Integer> map = new HashMap<>();
            for (int index = 0; index < mColumns.length; index++) map.put(mColumns[index], index);
            mColumnNameMap = map;
        }

        if (columnName == null) return -1;

        final int periodIndex = columnName.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (periodIndex != -1) columnName = columnName.substring(periodIndex + 1);

        Integer index = mColumnNameMap.get(columnName);
        if (index != null) return index;

        return super.getColumnIndex(columnName);
    }

    @Override
    public String[] getColumnNames()
    {
        return mColumns;
    }

    @Override
    public void deactivate()
    {
        super.deactivate();
        mDriver.cursorDeactivated();
    }

    @Override
    public void close()
    {
        super.close();

        synchronized (this)
        {
            mQuery.close();
            mDriver.cursorClosed();
        }
    }

    @Deprecated
    @Override
    public boolean requery()
    {
        if (isClosed()) return false;

        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (!mQuery.getDatabase().isOpen()) return false;

            if (mWindow != null) mWindow.clear();
            mPos = -1;
            mCount = NO_COUNT;

            mDriver.cursorRequeried(this);
        }

        try
        {
            return super.requery();
        }
        catch (IllegalStateException failure)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setWindow(CursorWindow window)
    {
        super.setWindow(window);
        mCount = NO_COUNT;
    }

    public void setSelectionArguments(String[] selectionArgs)
    {
        mDriver.setBindArguments(selectionArgs);
    }

    public void setFillWindowForwardOnly(boolean fillWindowForwardOnly)
    {
    }
}

```

`java/android/database/sqlite/SQLiteDatabase.java`:

```java
package android.database.sqlite;

import android.content.ContentValues;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.database.DatabaseErrorHandler;
import android.database.DefaultDatabaseErrorHandler;
import android.database.SQLException;
import android.os.CancellationSignal;
import android.util.Log;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import runtime.Sqlite;

public final class SQLiteDatabase extends SQLiteClosable
{
    private static final String TAG = "SQLiteDatabase";

    public static final int OPEN_READWRITE = 0x00000000;
    public static final int OPEN_READONLY = 0x00000001;
    public static final int CREATE_IF_NECESSARY = 0x10000000;
    public static final int NO_LOCALIZED_COLLATORS = 0x00000010;
    public static final int ENABLE_WRITE_AHEAD_LOGGING = 0x20000000;

    public static final int CONFLICT_NONE = 0;
    public static final int CONFLICT_ROLLBACK = 1;
    public static final int CONFLICT_ABORT = 2;
    public static final int CONFLICT_FAIL = 3;
    public static final int CONFLICT_IGNORE = 4;
    public static final int CONFLICT_REPLACE = 5;

    public static final int MAX_SQL_CACHE_SIZE = 100;
    public static final int SQLITE_MAX_LIKE_PATTERN_LENGTH = 50000;

    public static final String JOURNAL_MODE_DELETE = "DELETE";
    public static final String JOURNAL_MODE_MEMORY = "MEMORY";
    public static final String JOURNAL_MODE_OFF = "OFF";
    public static final String JOURNAL_MODE_PERSIST = "PERSIST";
    public static final String JOURNAL_MODE_TRUNCATE = "TRUNCATE";
    public static final String JOURNAL_MODE_WAL = "WAL";

    public static final String SYNC_MODE_EXTRA = "EXTRA";
    public static final String SYNC_MODE_FULL = "FULL";
    public static final String SYNC_MODE_NORMAL = "NORMAL";
    public static final String SYNC_MODE_OFF = "OFF";

    private static final String MEMORY_DB_PATH = ":memory:";

    private static final String[] CONFLICT_CLAUSE = {"", " OR ROLLBACK", " OR ABORT", " OR FAIL", " OR IGNORE", " OR REPLACE"};

    private final String mPath;
    private final CursorFactory mCursorFactory;
    private final DatabaseErrorHandler mErrorHandler;
    private final boolean mReadOnly;
    private long mHandle;
    private boolean mWriteAheadLogging;
    private final ArrayDeque<Transaction> mTransactions = new ArrayDeque<>();

    public interface CursorFactory
    {
        Cursor newCursor(SQLiteDatabase database, SQLiteCursorDriver masterQuery, String editTable, SQLiteQuery query);
    }

    private static final class Transaction
    {
        final SQLiteTransactionListener mListener;
        boolean mMarkedSuccessful;
        boolean mChildFailed;

        Transaction(SQLiteTransactionListener listener)
        {
            mListener = listener;
        }
    }

    private SQLiteDatabase(String path, long handle, CursorFactory factory, DatabaseErrorHandler errorHandler, boolean readOnly)
    {
        mPath = path;
        mHandle = handle;
        mCursorFactory = factory;
        mErrorHandler = errorHandler == null ? new DefaultDatabaseErrorHandler() : errorHandler;
        mReadOnly = readOnly;
    }

    public static SQLiteDatabase openDatabase(String path, CursorFactory factory, int flags)
    {
        return openDatabase(path, factory, flags, null);
    }

    public static SQLiteDatabase openDatabase(String path, CursorFactory factory, int flags, DatabaseErrorHandler errorHandler)
    {
        boolean readOnly = (flags & OPEN_READONLY) != 0;
        boolean memory = MEMORY_DB_PATH.equalsIgnoreCase(path);

        if (!readOnly && !memory && (flags & CREATE_IF_NECESSARY) == 0 && !new File(path).exists())
        {
            throw new SQLiteCantOpenDatabaseException("unable to open database file: " + path);
        }

        long handle = Sqlite.nativeOpen(path, readOnly);

        if (handle == 0) throw new SQLiteCantOpenDatabaseException("unable to open database file: " + path);

        SQLiteDatabase database = new SQLiteDatabase(path, handle, factory, errorHandler, readOnly);
        if (!readOnly && !memory && (flags & ENABLE_WRITE_AHEAD_LOGGING) != 0) database.enableWriteAheadLogging();

        return database;
    }

    public static SQLiteDatabase openDatabase(File path, OpenParams openParams)
    {
        if (openParams == null) return openDatabase(path.getPath(), null, CREATE_IF_NECESSARY, null);

        SQLiteDatabase database = openDatabase(path.getPath(), openParams.getCursorFactory(), openParams.getOpenFlags(),
            openParams.getErrorHandler());
        database.applyOpenParams(openParams);

        return database;
    }

    public static SQLiteDatabase createInMemory(OpenParams openParams)
    {
        if (openParams == null) return create(null);

        SQLiteDatabase database = openDatabase(MEMORY_DB_PATH, openParams.getCursorFactory(),
            openParams.getOpenFlags() | CREATE_IF_NECESSARY, openParams.getErrorHandler());
        database.applyOpenParams(openParams);

        return database;
    }

    private void applyOpenParams(OpenParams openParams)
    {
        if (mReadOnly) return;

        if (openParams.mJournalMode != null) execSQL("PRAGMA journal_mode=" + openParams.mJournalMode);
        if (openParams.mSynchronousMode != null) execSQL("PRAGMA synchronous=" + openParams.mSynchronousMode);
    }

    public static final class OpenParams
    {
        private final int mOpenFlags;
        private final CursorFactory mCursorFactory;
        private final DatabaseErrorHandler mErrorHandler;
        private final int mLookasideSlotSize;
        private final int mLookasideSlotCount;
        private final long mIdleConnectionTimeout;
        private final String mJournalMode;
        private final String mSynchronousMode;

        private OpenParams(int openFlags, CursorFactory cursorFactory, DatabaseErrorHandler errorHandler,
                           int lookasideSlotSize, int lookasideSlotCount, long idleConnectionTimeout, String journalMode,
                           String synchronousMode)
        {
            mOpenFlags = openFlags;
            mCursorFactory = cursorFactory;
            mErrorHandler = errorHandler;
            mLookasideSlotSize = lookasideSlotSize;
            mLookasideSlotCount = lookasideSlotCount;
            mIdleConnectionTimeout = idleConnectionTimeout;
            mJournalMode = journalMode;
            mSynchronousMode = synchronousMode;
        }

        public int getOpenFlags()
        {
            return mOpenFlags;
        }

        public CursorFactory getCursorFactory()
        {
            return mCursorFactory;
        }

        public DatabaseErrorHandler getErrorHandler()
        {
            return mErrorHandler;
        }

        public int getLookasideSlotSize()
        {
            return mLookasideSlotSize;
        }

        public int getLookasideSlotCount()
        {
            return mLookasideSlotCount;
        }

        public long getIdleConnectionTimeout()
        {
            return mIdleConnectionTimeout;
        }

        public String getJournalMode()
        {
            return mJournalMode;
        }

        public String getSynchronousMode()
        {
            return mSynchronousMode;
        }

        public Builder toBuilder()
        {
            return new Builder(this);
        }

        public static final class Builder
        {
            private int mOpenFlags = CREATE_IF_NECESSARY;
            private CursorFactory mCursorFactory;
            private DatabaseErrorHandler mErrorHandler;
            private int mLookasideSlotSize = -1;
            private int mLookasideSlotCount = -1;
            private long mIdleConnectionTimeout = -1;
            private String mJournalMode;
            private String mSynchronousMode;

            public Builder()
            {
            }

            public Builder(OpenParams source)
            {
                if (source == null) return;

                mOpenFlags = source.mOpenFlags;
                mCursorFactory = source.mCursorFactory;
                mErrorHandler = source.mErrorHandler;
                mLookasideSlotSize = source.mLookasideSlotSize;
                mLookasideSlotCount = source.mLookasideSlotCount;
                mIdleConnectionTimeout = source.mIdleConnectionTimeout;
                mJournalMode = source.mJournalMode;
                mSynchronousMode = source.mSynchronousMode;
            }

            public Builder addOpenFlags(int flags)
            {
                mOpenFlags |= flags;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder removeOpenFlags(int flags)
            {
                mOpenFlags &= ~flags;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setOpenFlags(int flags)
            {
                mOpenFlags = flags;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setCursorFactory(CursorFactory factory)
            {
                mCursorFactory = factory;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setErrorHandler(DatabaseErrorHandler errorHandler)
            {
                mErrorHandler = errorHandler;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setLookasideConfig(int slotSize, int slotCount)
            {
                mLookasideSlotSize = slotSize;
                mLookasideSlotCount = slotCount;
                return this;
            }

            @Deprecated
            public Builder setIdleConnectionTimeout(long idleConnectionTimeoutMs)
            {
                mIdleConnectionTimeout = idleConnectionTimeoutMs;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setJournalMode(String journalMode)
            {
                mJournalMode = journalMode;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setSynchronousMode(String syncMode)
            {
                mSynchronousMode = syncMode;
                return this;
            }

            public OpenParams build()
            {
                return new OpenParams(mOpenFlags, mCursorFactory, mErrorHandler, mLookasideSlotSize, mLookasideSlotCount,
                    mIdleConnectionTimeout, mJournalMode, mSynchronousMode);
            }
        }
    }

    public static boolean deleteDatabase(File file)
    {
        if (file == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("file must not be null");

        boolean deleted = file.delete();
        deleted |= new File(file.getPath() + "-journal").delete();
        deleted |= new File(file.getPath() + "-shm").delete();
        deleted |= new File(file.getPath() + "-wal").delete();

        File directory = file.getParentFile();
        if (directory != null)
        {
            final String prefix = file.getName() + "-mj";
            File[] files = directory.listFiles((candidate) -> candidate.getName().startsWith(prefix));
            if (files != null)
            {
                for (File masterJournal : files) deleted |= masterJournal.delete();
            }
        }

        return deleted;
    }

    public static String findEditTable(String tables)
    {
        if (tables == null || tables.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid tables");

        int spacePosition = tables.indexOf(' ');
        int commaPosition = tables.indexOf(',');

        if (spacePosition > 0 && (spacePosition < commaPosition || commaPosition < 0)) return tables.substring(0, spacePosition);
        if (commaPosition > 0 && (commaPosition < spacePosition || spacePosition < 0)) return tables.substring(0, commaPosition);

        return tables;
    }

    public String getPath()
    {
        return mPath;
    }

    public boolean isOpen()
    {
        return mHandle != 0;
    }

    public boolean isReadOnly()
    {
        return mReadOnly;
    }

    public boolean isInMemoryDatabase()
    {
        return MEMORY_DB_PATH.equalsIgnoreCase(mPath);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onAllReferencesReleased()
    {
        if (mHandle == 0) return;

        Sqlite.nativeClose(mHandle);
        mHandle = 0;
    }

    public void execSQL(String sql) throws SQLException
    {
        checkOpen();

        int outcome = Sqlite.nativeExec(mHandle, sql);
        if (outcome != 0) throw failure(sql);
    }

    public void execSQL(String sql, Object[] bindArgs) throws SQLException
    {
        if (bindArgs == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Empty bindArgs");

        if (bindArgs.length == 0)
        {
            execSQL(sql);
            return;
        }

        SQLiteStatement statement = compileStatement(sql);
        try
        {
            statement.bindAll(bindArgs);
            statement.execute();
        }
        finally
        {
            statement.close();
        }
    }

    public void execPerConnectionSQL(String sql, Object[] bindArgs) throws SQLException
    {
        if (sql == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("sql must not be null");

        if (bindArgs == null || bindArgs.length == 0) execSQL(sql);
        else execSQL(sql, bindArgs);
    }

    public SQLiteStatement compileStatement(String sql) throws SQLException
    {
        return new SQLiteStatement(this, prepare(sql), sql);
    }

    SQLiteQuery compileQuery(String sql, CancellationSignal cancellationSignal)
    {
        if (cancellationSignal != null) cancellationSignal.throwIfCanceled();

        return new SQLiteQuery(this, sql, prepare(sql), cancellationSignal);
    }

    public void validateSql(String sql, CancellationSignal cancellationSignal)
    {
        if (cancellationSignal != null) cancellationSignal.throwIfCanceled();

        Sqlite.nativeFinalize(prepare(sql));
    }

    private long prepare(String sql)
    {
        checkOpen();

        long prepared = Sqlite.nativePrepare(mHandle, sql);
        if (prepared == 0) throw failure(sql);

        return prepared;
    }

    public Cursor rawQueryWithFactory(CursorFactory factory, String sql, String[] selectionArgs, String editTable,
                                      CancellationSignal cancellationSignal)
    {
        checkOpen();

        SQLiteCursorDriver driver = new SQLiteDirectCursorDriver(this, sql, editTable, cancellationSignal);
        return driver.query(factory != null ? factory : mCursorFactory, selectionArgs);
    }

                                   String[] selectionArgs, String groupBy, String having, String orderBy, String limit)
```
