```java
    public long insert(String table, String nullColumnHack, ContentValues values)
    {
        try
        {
            return insertWithOnConflict(table, nullColumnHack, values, CONFLICT_NONE);
        }
        catch (SQLException failure)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error inserting " + values, failure);
            return -1;
        }
    }

    public long insertOrThrow(String table, String nullColumnHack, ContentValues values) throws SQLException
    {
        return insertWithOnConflict(table, nullColumnHack, values, CONFLICT_NONE);
    }

    public long replace(String table, String nullColumnHack, ContentValues values)
    {
        try
        {
            return insertWithOnConflict(table, nullColumnHack, values, CONFLICT_REPLACE);
        }
        catch (SQLException failure)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error inserting " + values, failure);
            return -1;
        }
    }

    public long replaceOrThrow(String table, String nullColumnHack, ContentValues values) throws SQLException
    {
        return insertWithOnConflict(table, nullColumnHack, values, CONFLICT_REPLACE);
    }

    public long insertWithOnConflict(String table, String nullColumnHack, ContentValues values, int conflictAlgorithm)
    {
        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder("INSERT");
        sql.append(CONFLICT_CLAUSE[conflictAlgorithm]).append(" INTO ").append(table).append('(');

        List<Object> arguments = new ArrayList<>();
        StringBuilder placeholders = new StringBuilder();

        if (values == null || values.isEmpty())
        {
            sql.append(nullColumnHack == null ? "rowid" : nullColumnHack);
            placeholders.append("NULL");
        }
        else
        {
            boolean first = true;
            for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : values.valueSet())
            {
                if (!first)
                {
                    sql.append(',');
                    placeholders.append(',');
                }

                sql.append(entry.getKey());
                placeholders.append('?');
                arguments.add(entry.getValue());
                first = false;
            }
        }

        sql.append(") VALUES(").append(placeholders).append(')');

        SQLiteStatement statement = compileStatement(sql.toString());
        try
        {
            statement.bindAll(arguments.toArray());
            return statement.executeInsert();
        }
        finally
        {
            statement.close();
        }
    }

    public int update(String table, ContentValues values, String whereClause, String[] whereArgs)
    {
        return updateWithOnConflict(table, values, whereClause, whereArgs, CONFLICT_NONE);
    }

    public int updateWithOnConflict(String table, ContentValues values, String whereClause, String[] whereArgs,
                                    int conflictAlgorithm)
    {
        if (values == null || values.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Empty values");

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder("UPDATE");
        sql.append(CONFLICT_CLAUSE[conflictAlgorithm]).append(' ').append(table).append(" SET ");

        List<Object> arguments = new ArrayList<>();

        boolean first = true;
        for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : values.valueSet())
        {
            if (!first) sql.append(',');

            sql.append(entry.getKey()).append("=?");
            arguments.add(entry.getValue());
            first = false;
        }

        if (whereArgs != null)
        {
            for (String argument : whereArgs) arguments.add(argument);
        }

        if (whereClause != null && !whereClause.isEmpty()) sql.append(" WHERE ").append(whereClause);

        SQLiteStatement statement = compileStatement(sql.toString());
        try
        {
            statement.bindAll(arguments.toArray());
            return statement.executeUpdateDelete();
        }
        finally
        {
            statement.close();
        }
    }

    public int delete(String table, String whereClause, String[] whereArgs)
    {
        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder("DELETE FROM ").append(table);
        if (whereClause != null && !whereClause.isEmpty()) sql.append(" WHERE ").append(whereClause);

        SQLiteStatement statement = compileStatement(sql.toString());
        try
        {
            statement.bindAll(whereArgs);
            return statement.executeUpdateDelete();
        }
        finally
        {
            statement.close();
        }
    }

    private void beginTransaction(SQLiteTransactionListener listener, String beginSql)
    {
        checkOpen();

        boolean outermost = mTransactions.isEmpty();
        if (outermost) execSQL(beginSql);

        try
        {
            if (listener != null) listener.onBegin();
        }
        catch (RuntimeException failure)
        {
            if (outermost) execSQL("ROLLBACK");
            throw failure;
        }

        mTransactions.push(new Transaction(listener));
    }

    public void setTransactionSuccessful()
    {
        Transaction transaction = mTransactions.peek();
        if (transaction == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot perform this operation because there is no current transaction.");
        if (transaction.mMarkedSuccessful)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot perform this operation because the transaction has already been marked successful.");
        }

        transaction.mMarkedSuccessful = true;
    }

    public void endTransaction()
    {
        Transaction transaction = mTransactions.peek();
        if (transaction == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot perform this operation because there is no current transaction.");

        boolean successful = transaction.mMarkedSuccessful && !transaction.mChildFailed;
        RuntimeException listenerFailure = null;

        if (transaction.mListener != null)
        {
            try
            {
                if (successful) transaction.mListener.onCommit();
                else transaction.mListener.onRollback();
            }
            catch (RuntimeException failure)
            {
                listenerFailure = failure;
                successful = false;
            }
        }

        mTransactions.pop();

        Transaction parent = mTransactions.peek();
        if (parent != null)
        {
            if (!successful) parent.mChildFailed = true;
        }
        else if (isOpen())
        {
            execSQL(successful ? "COMMIT" : "ROLLBACK");
        }

        if (listenerFailure != null) throw listenerFailure;
    }

    public boolean inTransaction()
    {
        return !mTransactions.isEmpty();
    }

    public boolean isDbLockedByCurrentThread()
    {
        return !mTransactions.isEmpty();
    }

    public long setMaximumSize(long numBytes)
    {
        long pageSize = getPageSize();
        long numPages = numBytes / pageSize;
        if ((numBytes % pageSize) != 0) numPages++;

        long newPageCount = longForQuery("PRAGMA max_page_count = " + numPages);
        return newPageCount * pageSize;
    }

    public void setForeignKeyConstraintsEnabled(boolean enable)
    {
        if (inTransaction()) throw new IllegalStateException("Foreign key constraints may not be changed while in a transaction");

        execSQL("PRAGMA foreign_keys=" + (enable ? "ON" : "OFF"));
    }

    public boolean enableWriteAheadLogging()
    {
        if (mReadOnly || isInMemoryDatabase()) return false;
        if (inTransaction()) throw new IllegalStateException("Write Ahead Logging (WAL) mode cannot be enabled or disabled while there are transactions in progress.");

        String mode = stringForQuery("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL");
        mWriteAheadLogging = "wal".equalsIgnoreCase(mode);

        return mWriteAheadLogging;
    }

    public void disableWriteAheadLogging()
    {
        if (!mWriteAheadLogging) return;
        if (inTransaction()) throw new IllegalStateException("Write Ahead Logging (WAL) mode cannot be enabled or disabled while there are transactions in progress.");

        stringForQuery("PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE");
        mWriteAheadLogging = false;
    }

    public boolean isWriteAheadLoggingEnabled()
    {
        return mWriteAheadLogging;
    }

    public void setLocale(java.util.Locale locale)
    {
        if (locale == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("locale must not be null.");
    }

    public void setMaxSqlCacheSize(int cacheSize)
    {
        if (cacheSize > MAX_SQL_CACHE_SIZE || cacheSize < 0)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("expected value between 0 and " + MAX_SQL_CACHE_SIZE);
        }
    }

    public List<android.util.Pair<String, String>> getAttachedDbs()
    {
        if (!isOpen()) return null;

        List<android.util.Pair<String, String>> attached = new ArrayList<>();

        Cursor cursor = rawQuery("PRAGMA database_list", null);
        try
        {
            while (cursor.moveToNext()) attached.add(new android.util.Pair<>(cursor.getString(1), cursor.getString(2)));
        }
        finally
        {
            cursor.close();
        }

        if (attached.isEmpty()) attached.add(new android.util.Pair<>("main", mPath));

        return attached;
    }

    public boolean isDatabaseIntegrityOk()
    {
        return "ok".equalsIgnoreCase(stringForQuery("PRAGMA integrity_check(1)"));
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "SQLiteDatabase: " + mPath;
    }

    long handle()
    {
        return mHandle;
    }

    String describeFailure(String sql)
    {
        String message = Sqlite.nativeErrorMessage(mHandle);
        return sql == null ? message : message + " (while running: " + sql + ")";
    }

    SQLiteException failure(String sql)
    {
        int code = mHandle == 0 ? 21 : Sqlite.nativeErrorCode(mHandle);
        String message = mHandle == 0 ? "the database is closed" : describeFailure(sql);
        message = message + " (code " + code + ")";

        switch (code & 0xff)
        {
            case 3: return new SQLiteAccessPermException(message);
            case 4: return new SQLiteAbortException(message);
            case 5: return new SQLiteDatabaseLockedException(message);
            case 6: return new SQLiteTableLockedException(message);
            case 8: return new SQLiteReadOnlyDatabaseException(message);
            case 10: return new SQLiteDiskIOException(message);
            case 11:
            case 26:
                return corruption(message);
            case 13: return new SQLiteFullException(message);
            case 14: return new SQLiteCantOpenDatabaseException(message);
            case 18: return new SQLiteBlobTooBigException(message);
            case 19: return new SQLiteConstraintException(message);
            case 101: return new SQLiteDoneException(message);
            default: return new SQLiteException(message);
        }
    }

    private SQLiteException corruption(String message)
    {
        SQLiteDatabaseCorruptException exception = new SQLiteDatabaseCorruptException(message);

        try
        {
            mErrorHandler.onCorruption(this);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException failure)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "the corruption handler failed: " + failure.getMessage());
        }

        return exception;
    }

    private void checkOpen()
    {
        if (mHandle == 0) throw new IllegalStateException("attempt to re-open an already-closed object: " + this);
    }

    private long longForQuery(String sql)
    {
        SQLiteStatement statement = compileStatement(sql);
        try
        {
            return statement.simpleQueryForLong();
        }
        finally
        {
            statement.close();
        }
    }

    private String stringForQuery(String sql)
    {
        SQLiteStatement statement = compileStatement(sql);
        try
        {
            return statement.simpleQueryForString();
        }
        finally
        {
            statement.close();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.database.sqlite;

import android.database.Cursor;
import android.os.CancellationSignal;

final class SQLiteDirectCursorDriver implements SQLiteCursorDriver
{
    private final SQLiteDatabase mDatabase;
    private final String mEditTable;
    private final String mSql;
    private final CancellationSignal mCancellationSignal;
    private SQLiteQuery mQuery;

    SQLiteDirectCursorDriver(SQLiteDatabase database, String sql, String editTable, CancellationSignal cancellationSignal)
    {
        mDatabase = database;
        mEditTable = editTable;
        mSql = sql;
        mCancellationSignal = cancellationSignal;
    }

    @Override
    public Cursor query(SQLiteDatabase.CursorFactory factory, String[] selectionArgs)
    {
        SQLiteQuery query = mDatabase.compileQuery(mSql, mCancellationSignal);

        try
        {
            query.bindAllArgsAsStrings(selectionArgs);

            Cursor cursor = factory == null ? new SQLiteCursor(this, mEditTable, query) : factory.newCursor(mDatabase, this, mEditTable, query);
            mQuery = query;

            return cursor;
        }
        catch (RuntimeException failure)
        {
            query.close();
            throw failure;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void cursorClosed()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public void setBindArguments(String[] bindArgs)
    {
        if (mQuery == null) return;

        mQuery.clearBindings();
        mQuery.bindAllArgsAsStrings(bindArgs);
    }

    @Override
    public void cursorDeactivated()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public void cursorRequeried(Cursor cursor)
    {
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "SQLiteDirectCursorDriver: " + mSql;
    }
}
```

`java/android/database/sqlite/SQLiteOpenHelper.java`:

```java
package android.database.sqlite;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.Log;

public abstract class SQLiteOpenHelper
{
    private static final String TAG = "SQLiteOpenHelper";

    private final Context mContext;
    private final String mName;
    private final SQLiteDatabase.CursorFactory mFactory;
    private final int mVersion;

    private SQLiteDatabase mDatabase;
    private boolean mOpening;

    public SQLiteOpenHelper(Context context, String name, SQLiteDatabase.CursorFactory factory, int version)
    {
        mContext = context;
        mName = name;
        mFactory = factory;
        mVersion = version;
    }

    public SQLiteOpenHelper(Context context, String name, SQLiteDatabase.CursorFactory factory, int version,
                            android.database.DatabaseErrorHandler errorHandler)
    {
        this(context, name, factory, version);
    }

    public String getDatabaseName()
    {
        return mName;
    }

    private SQLiteDatabase.OpenParams mOpenParams;

    public void setOpenParams(SQLiteDatabase.OpenParams openParams)
    {
        mOpenParams = openParams;
    }

    public SQLiteDatabase.OpenParams getOpenParams()
    {
        return mOpenParams;
    }

    public void setLookasideConfig(int slotSize, int slotCount)
    {
    }

    public void setWriteAheadLoggingEnabled(boolean enabled)
    {
    }

    public synchronized SQLiteDatabase getWritableDatabase()
    {
        if (mDatabase != null && mDatabase.isOpen()) return mDatabase;
        if (mOpening) throw new IllegalStateException("getWritableDatabase called recursively");

        mOpening = true;
        try
        {
            mDatabase = open();
            return mDatabase;
        }
        finally
        {
            mOpening = false;
        }
    }

    public synchronized SQLiteDatabase getReadableDatabase()
    {
        return getWritableDatabase();
    }

    public synchronized void close()
    {
        if (mDatabase == null) return;

        mDatabase.close();
        mDatabase = null;
    }

    public void onConfigure(SQLiteDatabase database)
    {
    }

    public abstract void onCreate(SQLiteDatabase database);

    public abstract void onUpgrade(SQLiteDatabase database, int oldVersion, int newVersion);

    public void onDowngrade(SQLiteDatabase database, int oldVersion, int newVersion)
    {
        throw new SQLiteException("cannot downgrade " + mName + " from " + oldVersion + " to " + newVersion);
    }

    public void onOpen(SQLiteDatabase database)
    {
    }

    private SQLiteDatabase open()
    {
        String path = mName == null ? ":memory:" : databasePath();

        SQLiteDatabase database = SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(path, mFactory, SQLiteDatabase.CREATE_IF_NECESSARY);

        onConfigure(database);

        int version = database.getVersion();

        if (version != mVersion)
        {
            database.beginTransaction();
            try
            {
                if (version == 0)
                {
                    Log.i(TAG, "creating " + mName + " at version " + mVersion);
                    onCreate(database);
                }
                else if (version > mVersion)
                {
                    onDowngrade(database, version, mVersion);
                }
                else
                {
                    Log.i(TAG, "upgrading " + mName + " from " + version + " to " + mVersion);
                    onUpgrade(database, version, mVersion);
                }

                database.setVersion(mVersion);
                database.setTransactionSuccessful();
            }
            finally
            {
                database.endTransaction();
            }
        }

        onOpen(database);
        return database;
    }

    private String databasePath()
    {
        java.io.File file = mContext == null ? new java.io.File(mName) : mContext.getDatabasePath(mName);
        java.io.File parent = file.getParentFile();

        if (parent != null && !parent.exists()) parent.mkdirs();

        return file.getPath();
    }
}
```

`java/android/database/sqlite/SQLiteProgram.java`:

```java
package android.database.sqlite;

import java.util.Arrays;

import runtime.Sqlite;

public abstract class SQLiteProgram extends SQLiteClosable
{
    private static final Object UNBOUND = new Object();

    final SQLiteDatabase mDatabase;
    long mStatement;
    private Object[] mBindArgs;

    SQLiteProgram(SQLiteDatabase database, long statement)
    {
        mDatabase = database;
        mStatement = statement;

        int parameters = Sqlite.nativeParameterCount(statement);
        mBindArgs = new Object[Math.max(parameters, 0)];
        Arrays.fill(mBindArgs, UNBOUND);
    }

    public void bindNull(int index)
    {
        record(index, null);
        Sqlite.nativeBindNull(mStatement, index);
    }

    public void bindLong(int index, long value)
    {
        record(index, Long.valueOf(value));
        Sqlite.nativeBindLong(mStatement, index, value);
    }

    public void bindDouble(int index, double value)
    {
        record(index, Double.valueOf(value));
        Sqlite.nativeBindDouble(mStatement, index, value);
    }

    public void bindString(int index, String value)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            bindNull(index);
            return;
        }

        record(index, value);
        Sqlite.nativeBindString(mStatement, index, value);
    }

    public void bindBlob(int index, byte[] value)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            bindNull(index);
            return;
        }

        record(index, value);
        Sqlite.nativeBindBlob(mStatement, index, value);
    }

    public void bindAllArgsAsStrings(String[] arguments)
    {
        if (arguments == null) return;

        for (int index = arguments.length; index != 0; index--) bindString(index, arguments[index - 1]);
    }

    public void clearBindings()
    {
        Arrays.fill(mBindArgs, UNBOUND);
        Sqlite.nativeReset(mStatement);
    }

    public final int getUniqueId()
    {
        return -1;
    }

    SQLiteDatabase getDatabase()
    {
        return mDatabase;
    }

    final void bindAll(Object[] arguments)
    {
        if (arguments == null) return;

        for (int index = 0; index < arguments.length; index++)
        {
            Object value = arguments[index];
            int at = index + 1;

            if (value == null) bindNull(at);
            else if (value instanceof byte[]) bindBlob(at, (byte[])value);
            else if (value instanceof Float || value instanceof Double) bindDouble(at, ((Number)value).doubleValue());
            else if (value instanceof Boolean) bindLong(at, ((Boolean)value) ? 1 : 0);
            else if (value instanceof Number) bindLong(at, ((Number)value).longValue());
            else bindString(at, value.toString());
        }
    }

    final void rebind()
    {
        checkOpen();
        Sqlite.nativeReset(mStatement);

        for (int index = 0; index < mBindArgs.length; index++)
        {
            Object value = mBindArgs[index];
            int at = index + 1;

            if (value == UNBOUND) continue;

            if (value == null) Sqlite.nativeBindNull(mStatement, at);
            else if (value instanceof byte[]) Sqlite.nativeBindBlob(mStatement, at, (byte[])value);
            else if (value instanceof Double) Sqlite.nativeBindDouble(mStatement, at, (Double)value);
            else if (value instanceof Long) Sqlite.nativeBindLong(mStatement, at, (Long)value);
            else Sqlite.nativeBindString(mStatement, at, (String)value);
        }
    }

    final void checkOpen()
    {
        if (mStatement == 0) throw new IllegalStateException("the program has already been closed");
    }

    private void record(int index, Object value)
    {
        checkOpen();

        if (index < 1 || index > mBindArgs.length)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot bind argument at index " + index + " because the index is out of range.  "
                + "The statement has " + mBindArgs.length + " parameters.");
        }

        mBindArgs[index - 1] = value;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onAllReferencesReleased()
    {
        if (mStatement == 0) return;

        Sqlite.nativeFinalize(mStatement);
        mStatement = 0;
    }
}
```

`java/android/database/sqlite/SQLiteQuery.java`:

```java
package android.database.sqlite;

import android.database.CursorWindow;
import android.os.CancellationSignal;

import runtime.Sqlite;

public final class SQLiteQuery extends SQLiteProgram
{
    private final String mSql;
    private final CancellationSignal mCancellationSignal;

    SQLiteQuery(SQLiteDatabase database, String sql, long statement, CancellationSignal cancellationSignal)
    {
        super(database, statement);
        mSql = sql;
        mCancellationSignal = cancellationSignal;
    }

    String[] getColumnNames()
    {
        checkOpen();

        int columns = Sqlite.nativeColumnCount(mStatement);
        String[] names = new String[columns];

        for (int index = 0; index < columns; index++) names[index] = Sqlite.nativeColumnName(mStatement, index);

        return names;
    }

    int fillWindow(CursorWindow window)
    {
        if (mCancellationSignal != null) mCancellationSignal.throwIfCanceled();

        rebind();

        int columns = Sqlite.nativeColumnCount(mStatement);

        window.acquireReference();
        try
        {
            window.clear();
            window.setStartPosition(0);
            window.setNumColumns(columns);

            int rows = 0;
            for (;;)
            {
                int outcome = Sqlite.nativeStep(mStatement);
                if (outcome == Sqlite.STEP_DONE) break;

                if (outcome == Sqlite.STEP_ERROR)
                {
                    SQLiteException failure = mDatabase.failure(mSql);
                    window.clear();
                    throw failure;
                }

                if (mCancellationSignal != null && (rows & 255) == 0) mCancellationSignal.throwIfCanceled();

                window.allocRow();
                for (int column = 0; column < columns; column++) put(window, rows, column);
                rows++;
            }

            return rows;
        }
        finally
        {
            Sqlite.nativeReset(mStatement);
            window.releaseReference();
        }
    }

    private void put(CursorWindow window, int row, int column)
    {
        switch (Sqlite.nativeColumnType(mStatement, column))
        {
            case Sqlite.TYPE_INTEGER:
                window.putLong(Sqlite.nativeColumnLong(mStatement, column), row, column);
                break;
            case Sqlite.TYPE_FLOAT:
                window.putDouble(Sqlite.nativeColumnDouble(mStatement, column), row, column);
                break;
            case Sqlite.TYPE_BLOB:
                window.putBlob(Sqlite.nativeColumnBlob(mStatement, column), row, column);
                break;
            case Sqlite.TYPE_NULL:
                window.putNull(row, column);
                break;
            default:
                window.putString(Sqlite.nativeColumnString(mStatement, column), row, column);
                break;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "SQLiteQuery: " + mSql;
    }
}
```

`java/android/database/sqlite/SQLiteQueryBuilder.java`:

```java
package android.database.sqlite;

import android.database.Cursor;
import android.os.CancellationSignal;

import java.util.Map;

public class SQLiteQueryBuilder
{
    private String mTables = "";
    private StringBuilder mWhereClause;
    private Map<String, String> mProjectionMap;
    private boolean mDistinct;
    private boolean mStrict;
    private SQLiteDatabase.CursorFactory mFactory;

    public void setTables(String tables)
    {
        mTables = tables == null ? "" : tables;
    }

    public String getTables()
    {
        return mTables;
    }

    public void setDistinct(boolean distinct)
    {
        mDistinct = distinct;
    }

    public boolean isDistinct()
    {
        return mDistinct;
    }

    public void setProjectionMap(Map<String, String> projectionMap)
    {
        mProjectionMap = projectionMap;
    }

    public Map<String, String> getProjectionMap()
    {
        return mProjectionMap;
    }

    public void setCursorFactory(SQLiteDatabase.CursorFactory factory)
    {
        mFactory = factory;
    }

    public SQLiteDatabase.CursorFactory getCursorFactory()
    {
        return mFactory;
    }

    public void setStrict(boolean strict)
    {
        mStrict = strict;
    }

    public boolean isStrict()
    {
        return mStrict;
    }

    public void appendWhere(CharSequence clause)
    {
        if (clause == null) return;

        if (mWhereClause == null) mWhereClause = new StringBuilder(clause.length() + 16);

        mWhereClause.append(clause);
    }

    public void appendWhereEscapeString(String clause)
    {
        if (clause == null) return;

        if (mWhereClause == null) mWhereClause = new StringBuilder(clause.length() + 16);

        android.database.DatabaseUtils.appendEscapedSQLString(mWhereClause, clause);
    }

    public void appendWhereStandalone(CharSequence clause)
    {
        if (clause == null) return;

        if (mWhereClause == null) mWhereClause = new StringBuilder(clause.length() + 16);

        if (mWhereClause.length() > 0) mWhereClause.append(" AND ");

        mWhereClause.append('(').append(clause).append(')');
    }

    public String getWhere()
    {
        return mWhereClause == null ? null : mWhereClause.toString();
    }

    public Cursor query(SQLiteDatabase database, String[] projection, String selection, String[] selectionArgs, String groupBy,
                        String having, String sortOrder)
    {
        return query(database, projection, selection, selectionArgs, groupBy, having, sortOrder, null, null);
    }

    public Cursor query(SQLiteDatabase database, String[] projection, String selection, String[] selectionArgs, String groupBy,
                        String having, String sortOrder, String limit)
    {
        return query(database, projection, selection, selectionArgs, groupBy, having, sortOrder, limit, null);
    }

    public Cursor query(SQLiteDatabase database, String[] projection, String selection, String[] selectionArgs, String groupBy,
                        String having, String sortOrder, String limit, CancellationSignal cancellationSignal)
    {
        if (database == null || mTables.isEmpty()) return null;

        String sql = buildQuery(projection, selection, groupBy, having, sortOrder, limit);

        return database.rawQueryWithFactory(mFactory, sql, selectionArgs, SQLiteDatabase.findEditTable(mTables), cancellationSignal);
    }

    public String buildQuery(String[] projection, String selection, String groupBy, String having, String sortOrder,
                             String limit)
    {
        StringBuilder query = new StringBuilder(120);

        query.append("SELECT ");
        if (mDistinct) query.append("DISTINCT ");

        appendColumns(query, mapColumns(projection));

        query.append(" FROM ").append(mTables);

        String where = combinedWhere(selection);
        if (where != null && !where.isEmpty()) query.append(" WHERE ").append(where);

        if (groupBy != null && !groupBy.isEmpty()) query.append(" GROUP BY ").append(groupBy);
        if (having != null && !having.isEmpty()) query.append(" HAVING ").append(having);
        if (sortOrder != null && !sortOrder.isEmpty()) query.append(" ORDER BY ").append(sortOrder);
        if (limit != null && !limit.isEmpty()) query.append(" LIMIT ").append(limit);

        return query.toString();
    }

    private String combinedWhere(String selection)
    {
        boolean hasBuilt = mWhereClause != null && mWhereClause.length() > 0;
        boolean hasSelection = selection != null && !selection.isEmpty();

        if (hasBuilt && hasSelection) return "(" + mWhereClause + ") AND (" + selection + ")";
        if (hasBuilt) return mWhereClause.toString();
        if (hasSelection) return selection;

        return null;
    }

    private String[] mapColumns(String[] projection)
    {
        if (projection == null || mProjectionMap == null) return projection;

        String[] mapped = new String[projection.length];

        for (int index = 0; index < projection.length; index++)
        {
            String replacement = mProjectionMap.get(projection[index]);
            mapped[index] = replacement != null ? replacement : projection[index];
        }

        return mapped;
    }

    private static void appendColumns(StringBuilder query, String[] columns)
    {
        if (columns == null || columns.length == 0)
        {
            query.append('*');
            return;
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < columns.length; index++)
        {
            if (index > 0) query.append(", ");

            query.append(columns[index]);
        }
    }

    public static String buildQueryString(boolean distinct, String tables, String[] columns, String where, String groupBy,
                                          String having, String orderBy, String limit)
    {
        StringBuilder query = new StringBuilder(120);

        query.append("SELECT ");
        if (distinct) query.append("DISTINCT ");

        appendColumns(query, columns);

        query.append(" FROM ").append(tables);

        if (where != null && !where.isEmpty()) query.append(" WHERE ").append(where);
        if (groupBy != null && !groupBy.isEmpty()) query.append(" GROUP BY ").append(groupBy);
        if (having != null && !having.isEmpty()) query.append(" HAVING ").append(having);
        if (orderBy != null && !orderBy.isEmpty()) query.append(" ORDER BY ").append(orderBy);
        if (limit != null && !limit.isEmpty()) query.append(" LIMIT ").append(limit);

        return query.toString();
    }
}
```

`java/android/database/sqlite/SQLiteStatement.java`:

```java
package android.database.sqlite;

import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;

import runtime.Sqlite;

public final class SQLiteStatement extends SQLiteProgram
{
    private final String mSql;

    SQLiteStatement(SQLiteDatabase database, long statement)
    {
        this(database, statement, null);
    }

    SQLiteStatement(SQLiteDatabase database, long statement, String sql)
    {
        super(database, statement);
        mSql = sql;
    }

    public void execute()
    {
        step();
    }

    public long executeInsert()
    {
        step();
        return Sqlite.nativeChanges(mDatabase.handle()) > 0 ? Sqlite.nativeLastInsertRowId(mDatabase.handle()) : -1;
    }

    public int executeUpdateDelete()
    {
        step();
        return Sqlite.nativeChanges(mDatabase.handle());
    }

    public long simpleQueryForLong()
    {
        stepForRow();

        long value = Sqlite.nativeColumnLong(mStatement, 0);
        Sqlite.nativeReset(mStatement);

        return value;
    }

    public String simpleQueryForString()
    {
        stepForRow();

        String value = Sqlite.nativeColumnType(mStatement, 0) == Sqlite.TYPE_NULL ? null : Sqlite.nativeColumnString(mStatement, 0);
        Sqlite.nativeReset(mStatement);

        return value;
    }

    public ParcelFileDescriptor simpleQueryForBlobFileDescriptor()
    {
        stepForRow();

        byte[] value = Sqlite.nativeColumnType(mStatement, 0) == Sqlite.TYPE_NULL ? null : Sqlite.nativeColumnBlob(mStatement, 0);
        Sqlite.nativeReset(mStatement);

        if (value == null) return null;

        try
        {
            File file = File.createTempFile("sqlite-blob", null);
            try (FileOutputStream output = new FileOutputStream(file))
            {
                output.write(value);
            }

            ParcelFileDescriptor descriptor = ParcelFileDescriptor.open(file, ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_READ_ONLY);
            file.delete();

            return descriptor;
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            throw new SQLiteException("unable to expose the blob as a file descriptor", failure);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "SQLiteProgram: " + mSql;
    }

    private void stepForRow()
    {
        rebind();

        int outcome = Sqlite.nativeStep(mStatement);
        if (outcome == Sqlite.STEP_ERROR)
        {
            SQLiteException failure = mDatabase.failure(null);
            Sqlite.nativeReset(mStatement);
            throw failure;
        }

        if (outcome != Sqlite.STEP_ROW)
        {
            Sqlite.nativeReset(mStatement);
            throw new SQLiteDoneException("the statement returned no rows");
        }
    }

    private void step()
    {
        rebind();

        int outcome = Sqlite.nativeStep(mStatement);
        if (outcome == Sqlite.STEP_ERROR)
        {
            SQLiteException failure = mDatabase.failure(null);
            Sqlite.nativeReset(mStatement);
            throw failure;
        }

        Sqlite.nativeReset(mStatement);
    }
}
```

`java/android/drm/DrmErrorEvent.java`:

```java
package android.drm;

    public static final int TYPE_PROCESS_DRM_INFO_FAILED = 2006;
    public static final int TYPE_REMOVE_ALL_RIGHTS_FAILED = 2007;
    public static final int TYPE_RIGHTS_NOT_INSTALLED = 2001;
    public static final int TYPE_RIGHTS_RENEWAL_NOT_ALLOWED = 2002;

        checkTypeValidity(type);
```

```java
public class DrmEvent

    public static final String DRM_INFO_STATUS_OBJECT = "drm_info_status_object";
    public static final int TYPE_ALL_RIGHTS_REMOVED = 1001;
    public static final int TYPE_DRM_INFO_PROCESSED = 1002;

    private final int mUniqueId;
    private final int mType;
    private final String mMessage;
    private final HashMap<String, Object> mAttributes = new HashMap<>();

    protected DrmEvent(int uniqueId, int type, String message)
    {
        mUniqueId = uniqueId;
        mType = type;
        mMessage = message == null ? "" : message;
    }

    protected DrmEvent(int uniqueId, int type, String message, HashMap<String, Object> attributes)

        this(uniqueId, type, message);

        if (attributes != null) mAttributes.putAll(attributes);
```

```java
package android.drm;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Iterator;

public class DrmInfo
{
    private final int mInfoType;
    private final String mMimeType;
    private final HashMap<String, Object> mAttributes = new HashMap<>();
    private byte[] mData;

    public DrmInfo(int infoType, byte[] data, String mimeType)
    {
        mInfoType = infoType;
        mMimeType = mimeType;
        mData = data;

        if (!isValid()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("infoType: " + infoType + ", mimeType: " + mimeType + ", data: " + data);
    }

    public DrmInfo(int infoType, String path, String mimeType)
    {
        mInfoType = infoType;
        mMimeType = mimeType;

        try
        {
            mData = Files.readAllBytes(new File(path).toPath());
        }
        catch (IOException exception)
        {
            mData = null;
        }

        if (!isValid()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("infoType: " + infoType + ", mimeType: " + mimeType + ", path: " + path);
    }

    boolean isValid()
    {
        return mMimeType != null && !mMimeType.isEmpty() && mData != null && mData.length > 0
            && mInfoType >= DrmInfoRequest.TYPE_REGISTRATION_INFO && mInfoType <= DrmInfoRequest.TYPE_RIGHTS_ACQUISITION_PROGRESS_INFO;
    }

    public Object get(String key)
    {
        return mAttributes.get(key);
    }

    public byte[] getData()
    {
        return mData;
    }

    public int getInfoType()
    {
        return mInfoType;
    }

    public String getMimeType()
    {
        return mMimeType;
    }

    public Iterator<Object> iterator()
    {
        return mAttributes.values().iterator();
    }

    public Iterator<String> keyIterator()
    {
        return mAttributes.keySet().iterator();
    }

    public void put(String key, Object value)
    {
        mAttributes.put(key, value);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.drm;

import java.util.HashMap;

public class DrmInfoEvent extends DrmEvent
{
    public static final int TYPE_ACCOUNT_ALREADY_REGISTERED = 5;
    public static final int TYPE_ALREADY_REGISTERED_BY_ANOTHER_ACCOUNT = 1;
    public static final int TYPE_REMOVE_RIGHTS = 2;
    public static final int TYPE_RIGHTS_INSTALLED = 3;
    public static final int TYPE_RIGHTS_REMOVED = 6;
    public static final int TYPE_WAIT_FOR_RIGHTS = 4;

    public DrmInfoEvent(int uniqueId, int type, String message)
    {
        super(uniqueId, type, message);
        checkTypeValidity(type);
    }

    public DrmInfoEvent(int uniqueId, int type, String message, HashMap<String, Object> attributes)
    {
        super(uniqueId, type, message, attributes);
        checkTypeValidity(type);
    }

    private static void checkTypeValidity(int type)
    {
        boolean infoType = type >= TYPE_ALREADY_REGISTERED_BY_ANOTHER_ACCOUNT && type <= TYPE_RIGHTS_REMOVED;
        boolean eventType = type == TYPE_ALL_RIGHTS_REMOVED || type == TYPE_DRM_INFO_PROCESSED;

        if (!infoType && !eventType) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported type: " + type);
    }
}
```

`java/android/drm/DrmInfoStatus.java`:

```java
package android.drm;

public class DrmInfoStatus
{
    public static final int STATUS_ERROR = 2;
    public static final int STATUS_OK = 1;
    public final ProcessedData data;
    public final int infoType;
    public final String mimeType;
    public final int statusCode;

    public DrmInfoStatus(int statusCode, int infoType, ProcessedData data, String mimeType)
    {
        if (infoType < DrmInfoRequest.TYPE_REGISTRATION_INFO || infoType > DrmInfoRequest.TYPE_RIGHTS_ACQUISITION_PROGRESS_INFO)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("infoType: " + infoType);
        }

        if (statusCode != STATUS_OK && statusCode != STATUS_ERROR)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported status code: " + statusCode);
        }

        if (mimeType == null || mimeType.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("mimeType is null or an empty string");

        this.statusCode = statusCode;
        this.infoType = infoType;
        this.data = data;
        this.mimeType = mimeType;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.drm;

import android.content.ContentValues;
import android.content.Context;
import android.net.Uri;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collection;

public class DrmManagerClient implements AutoCloseable
{
    public static final int ERROR_NONE = 0;
    public static final int ERROR_UNKNOWN = -2000;

    private static final int INVALID_SESSION = -1;

    private final Context mContext;
    private OnInfoListener mOnInfoListener;
    private OnEventListener mOnEventListener;
    private OnErrorListener mOnErrorListener;
    private boolean mClosed;

    public DrmManagerClient(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    private static String convertUriToPath(Uri uri)
    {
        if (uri == null || Uri.EMPTY.equals(uri)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Given uri is not valid");

        String scheme = uri.getScheme();
        if (scheme == null || scheme.equals("file")) return uri.getPath();

        return uri.toString();
    }

    private static void checkPath(String path)
    {
        if (path == null || path.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Given path is invalid/null");
    }

    private static boolean isValidAction(int action)
    {
        return action >= DrmStore.Action.DEFAULT && action <= DrmStore.Action.DISPLAY;
    }

    public DrmInfo acquireDrmInfo(DrmInfoRequest drmInfoRequest)
    {
        if (drmInfoRequest == null || !drmInfoRequest.isValid())
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Given drmInfoRequest is invalid/null");
        }

        return null;
    }

    public int acquireRights(DrmInfoRequest drmInfoRequest)
    {
        DrmInfo drmInfo = acquireDrmInfo(drmInfoRequest);
        if (drmInfo == null) return ERROR_UNKNOWN;

        return processDrmInfo(drmInfo);
    }

    public boolean canHandle(Uri uri, String mimeType)
    {
        if ((uri == null || Uri.EMPTY.equals(uri)) && (mimeType == null || mimeType.isEmpty()))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Uri or the mimetype should be non null");
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean canHandle(String path, String mimeType)
    {
        if ((path == null || path.isEmpty()) && (mimeType == null || mimeType.isEmpty()))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Path or the mimetype should be non null");
        }

        return false;
    }

    public int checkRightsStatus(Uri content)
    {
        return checkRightsStatus(convertUriToPath(content), DrmStore.Action.DEFAULT);
    }

    public int checkRightsStatus(Uri content, int action)
    {
        return checkRightsStatus(convertUriToPath(content), action);
    }

    public int checkRightsStatus(String path)
    {
        return checkRightsStatus(path, DrmStore.Action.DEFAULT);
    }

    public int checkRightsStatus(String path, int action)
    {
        checkPath(path);
        if (!isValidAction(action)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Given path or action is not valid");

        return DrmStore.RightsStatus.RIGHTS_INVALID;
    }

    public void close()
    {
        mClosed = true;
        mOnInfoListener = null;
        mOnEventListener = null;
        mOnErrorListener = null;
    }

    public DrmConvertedStatus closeConvertSession(int convertId)
    {
        return new DrmConvertedStatus(DrmConvertedStatus.STATUS_ERROR, null, 0);
    }

    public DrmConvertedStatus convertData(int convertId, byte[] inputData)
    {
        if (inputData == null || inputData.length <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Given inputData should be non null");

        return new DrmConvertedStatus(DrmConvertedStatus.STATUS_ERROR, null, 0);
    }

    public String[] getAvailableDrmEngines()
    {
        return new String[0];
    }

    public Collection<DrmSupportInfo> getAvailableDrmSupportInfo()
    {
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public ContentValues getConstraints(Uri uri, int action)
    {
        return getConstraints(convertUriToPath(uri), action);
    }

    public ContentValues getConstraints(String path, int action)
    {
        checkPath(path);
        if (!isValidAction(action)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Given usage or path is invalid/null");

        return null;
    }

    public int getDrmObjectType(Uri uri, String mimeType)
    {
        if ((uri == null || Uri.EMPTY.equals(uri)) && (mimeType == null || mimeType.isEmpty()))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Given uri or mimetype is null");
        }

        return DrmStore.DrmObjectType.UNKNOWN;
    }

    public int getDrmObjectType(String path, String mimeType)
    {
        if ((path == null || path.isEmpty()) && (mimeType == null || mimeType.isEmpty()))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Path or the mimetype should be non null");
        }

        return DrmStore.DrmObjectType.UNKNOWN;
    }

    public ContentValues getMetadata(Uri uri)
    {
        return getMetadata(convertUriToPath(uri));
    }

    public ContentValues getMetadata(String path)
    {
        checkPath(path);
        return null;
    }

    public String getOriginalMimeType(Uri uri)
    {
        return getOriginalMimeType(convertUriToPath(uri));
    }

    public String getOriginalMimeType(String path)
    {
        checkPath(path);
        return null;
    }

    public int openConvertSession(String mimeType)
    {
        if (mimeType == null || mimeType.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Path or the mimeType should be non null");

        return INVALID_SESSION;
    }

    public int processDrmInfo(DrmInfo drmInfo)
    {
        if (drmInfo == null || !drmInfo.isValid()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Given drmInfo is invalid/null");

        return ERROR_UNKNOWN;
    }

    public void release()
    {
        close();
    }

    public int removeAllRights()
    {
        return ERROR_UNKNOWN;
    }

    public int removeRights(Uri uri)
    {
        return removeRights(convertUriToPath(uri));
    }

    public int removeRights(String path)
    {
        checkPath(path);
        return ERROR_UNKNOWN;
    }

    public int saveRights(DrmRights drmRights, String rightsPath, String contentPath) throws IOException
    {
        if (drmRights == null || !drmRights.isValid()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Given drmRights or contentPath is not valid");

        return ERROR_UNKNOWN;
    }

    public synchronized void setOnErrorListener(DrmManagerClient.OnErrorListener errorListener)
    {
        mOnErrorListener = errorListener;
    }

    public synchronized void setOnEventListener(DrmManagerClient.OnEventListener eventListener)
    {
        mOnEventListener = eventListener;
    }

    public synchronized void setOnInfoListener(DrmManagerClient.OnInfoListener infoListener)
    {
        mOnInfoListener = infoListener;
    }

    public interface OnInfoListener
    {
        void onInfo(DrmManagerClient client, DrmInfoEvent event);
    }

    public interface OnEventListener
    {
        void onEvent(DrmManagerClient client, DrmEvent event);
    }

    public interface OnErrorListener
    {
        void onError(DrmManagerClient client, DrmErrorEvent event);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.drm;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;

public class DrmRights
{
    private static final String NO_USER = "_NO_USER";

    private byte[] mData;
    private String mMimeType;
    private String mAccountId;
    private String mSubscriptionId;

    public DrmRights(ProcessedData data, String mimeType)
    {
        if (data == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("data is null");

        mData = data.getData();
        mAccountId = data.getAccountId();
        mSubscriptionId = data.getSubscriptionId();
        mMimeType = mimeType;

        if (!isValid()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("mimeType: " + mimeType + ", data: " + mData);
    }

    public DrmRights(File rightsFile, String mimeType)
    {
        instantiate(rightsFile, mimeType);
    }

    public DrmRights(String rightsFilePath, String mimeType)
    {
        this(new File(rightsFilePath), mimeType);
    }

    public DrmRights(String rightsFilePath, String mimeType, String accountId)
    {
        this(new File(rightsFilePath), mimeType);
        mAccountId = accountId;
    }

    public DrmRights(String rightsFilePath, String mimeType, String accountId, String subscriptionId)
    {
        this(new File(rightsFilePath), mimeType);
        mAccountId = accountId;
        mSubscriptionId = subscriptionId;
    }

    private void instantiate(File rightsFile, String mimeType)
    {
        try
        {
            mData = Files.readAllBytes(rightsFile.toPath());
        }
        catch (IOException exception)
        {
            mData = null;
        }

        mMimeType = mimeType;
        mAccountId = NO_USER;
        mSubscriptionId = "";

        if (!isValid()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("mimeType: " + mimeType + ", data: " + mData);
    }

    boolean isValid()
    {
        return mMimeType != null && !mMimeType.isEmpty() && mData != null && mData.length > 0;
    }

    public String getAccountId()
    {
        return mAccountId;
    }

    public byte[] getData()
    {
        return mData;
    }

    public String getMimeType()
    {
        return mMimeType;
    }

    public String getSubscriptionId()
    {
        return mSubscriptionId;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.drm;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Iterator;

public class DrmSupportInfo
{
    private final ArrayList<String> mFileSuffixList = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<String> mMimeTypeList = new ArrayList<>();
    private String mDescription = "";

    public DrmSupportInfo()
    {
    }

    public void addFileSuffix(String fileSuffix)
    {
        if (fileSuffix == null || fileSuffix.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("fileSuffix is null or empty");

        mFileSuffixList.add(fileSuffix);
    }

    public void addMimeType(String mimeType)
    {
        if (mimeType == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("mimeType is null");
        if (mimeType.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("mimeType is an empty string");

        mMimeTypeList.add(mimeType);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        if (!(object instanceof DrmSupportInfo)) return false;

        DrmSupportInfo other = (DrmSupportInfo)object;
        return mFileSuffixList.equals(other.mFileSuffixList) && mMimeTypeList.equals(other.mMimeTypeList)
            && mDescription.equals(other.mDescription);
    }

    public String getDescriprition()
    {
        return mDescription;
    }

    public String getDescription()
    {
        return mDescription;
    }

    public Iterator<String> getFileSuffixIterator()
    {
        return mFileSuffixList.iterator();
    }

    public Iterator<String> getMimeTypeIterator()
    {
        return mMimeTypeList.iterator();
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mFileSuffixList.hashCode() + mMimeTypeList.hashCode() + mDescription.hashCode();
    }

    public void setDescription(String description)
    {
        if (description == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("description is null");
        if (description.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("description is an empty string");

        mDescription = description;
    }
}
```

`java/android/gesture/Gesture.java`:

```java
package android.gesture;

import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.graphics.RectF;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

public class Gesture implements Parcelable
{
    private static final long GESTURE_ID_BASE = System.currentTimeMillis();
    private static final int BITMAP_RENDERING_WIDTH = 2;
    private static final boolean BITMAP_RENDERING_ANTIALIAS = true;
    private static final boolean BITMAP_RENDERING_DITHER = true;
    private static final AtomicInteger sGestureCount = new AtomicInteger(0);

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<Gesture> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<Gesture>()
    {
        @Override
        public Gesture createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            long identifier = source.readLong();
            int strokeCount = source.readInt();
            Gesture gesture = new Gesture();
            gesture.mGestureId = identifier;

            for (int strokeIndex = 0; strokeIndex < strokeCount; strokeIndex++)
            {
                int pointCount = source.readInt();
                ArrayList<GesturePoint> points = new ArrayList<>(pointCount);
                for (int pointIndex = 0; pointIndex < pointCount; pointIndex++)
                {
                    float x = source.readFloat();
                    float y = source.readFloat();
                    long time = source.readLong();
                    points.add(new GesturePoint(x, y, time));
                }
                gesture.addStroke(new GestureStroke(points));
            }

            return gesture;
        }

        @Override
        public Gesture[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Gesture[size];
        }
    };

    private final RectF mBoundingBox = new RectF();
    private final ArrayList<GestureStroke> mStrokes = new ArrayList<>();
    private long mGestureId;

    public Gesture()
    {
        mGestureId = GESTURE_ID_BASE + sGestureCount.incrementAndGet();
    }

    @Override
    public Object clone()
    {
        Gesture gesture = new Gesture();
        gesture.mBoundingBox.set(mBoundingBox);
        for (GestureStroke stroke : mStrokes) gesture.mStrokes.add((GestureStroke)stroke.clone());
        return gesture;
    }

    public ArrayList<GestureStroke> getStrokes()
    {
        return mStrokes;
    }

    public int getStrokesCount()
    {
        return mStrokes.size();
    }

    public void addStroke(GestureStroke stroke)
    {
        mStrokes.add(stroke);
        if (mStrokes.size() == 1) mBoundingBox.set(stroke.boundingBox);
        else mBoundingBox.union(stroke.boundingBox);
    }

    public float getLength()
    {
        float length = 0;
        for (GestureStroke stroke : mStrokes) length += stroke.length;
        return length;
    }

    public RectF getBoundingBox()
    {
        return mBoundingBox;
    }

    public Path toPath()
    {
        return toPath(null);
    }

    public Path toPath(Path path)
    {
        if (path == null) path = new Path();
        for (GestureStroke stroke : mStrokes) path.addPath(stroke.getPath());
        return path;
    }

    public Path toPath(int width, int height, int edge, int numSample)
    {
        return toPath(null, width, height, edge, numSample);
    }

    public Path toPath(Path path, int width, int height, int edge, int numSample)
    {
        if (path == null) path = new Path();
        for (GestureStroke stroke : mStrokes) path.addPath(stroke.toPath(width - 2 * edge, height - 2 * edge, numSample));
        return path;
    }

    public long getID()
    {
        return mGestureId;
    }

    public Bitmap toBitmap(int width, int height, int edge, int numSample, int color)
    {
        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas(bitmap);
        canvas.translate(edge, edge);

        Paint paint = strokePaint(color);
        for (GestureStroke stroke : mStrokes) canvas.drawPath(stroke.toPath(width - 2 * edge, height - 2 * edge, numSample), paint);

        return bitmap;
    }

    public Bitmap toBitmap(int width, int height, int inset, int color)
    {
        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas(bitmap);
        Paint paint = strokePaint(color);

        Path path = toPath();
        RectF bounds = new RectF();
        path.computeBounds(bounds, true);

        float scaleX = bounds.width() == 0 ? 1 : (width - 2 * inset) / bounds.width();
        float scaleY = bounds.height() == 0 ? 1 : (height - 2 * inset) / bounds.height();
        float scale = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY);
        paint.setStrokeWidth(2.0f / scale);

        path.offset(-bounds.left + (width - bounds.width() * scale) / 2.0f, -bounds.top + (height - bounds.height() * scale) / 2.0f);
        canvas.translate(inset, inset);
        canvas.scale(scale, scale);
        canvas.drawPath(path, paint);

        return bitmap;
    }

    private static Paint strokePaint(int color)
    {
        Paint paint = new Paint();
        paint.setAntiAlias(BITMAP_RENDERING_ANTIALIAS);
        paint.setDither(BITMAP_RENDERING_DITHER);
        paint.setColor(color);
        paint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        paint.setStrokeJoin(Paint.Join.ROUND);
        paint.setStrokeCap(Paint.Cap.ROUND);
        paint.setStrokeWidth(BITMAP_RENDERING_WIDTH);
        return paint;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
    {
        out.writeLong(mGestureId);
        out.writeInt(mStrokes.size());

        for (GestureStroke stroke : mStrokes)
        {
            int pointCount = stroke.points.length / 2;
            out.writeInt(pointCount);
            for (int index = 0; index < pointCount; index++)
            {
                out.writeFloat(stroke.points[index * 2]);
                out.writeFloat(stroke.points[index * 2 + 1]);
                out.writeLong(stroke.timestampAt(index));
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }
}
```

```java
        setCurrentColor(mCertainGestureColor);
        mCurrentGesture = gesture;

        Path path = mCurrentGesture.toPath();
        RectF bounds = new RectF();
        path.computeBounds(bounds, true);

        mPath.rewind();
        mPath.addPath(path, -bounds.left + (getWidth() - bounds.width()) / 2.0f, -bounds.top + (getHeight() - bounds.height()) / 2.0f);

        mResetGesture = true;
        invalidate();

        if (mOnGesturePerformedListeners.size() <= 0) mHandleGestureActions = false;

        mOnGesturingListeners.add(listener);

    private void setCurrentColor(int color)
    {
        mCurrentColor = color;
        if (mFadingHasStarted) setPaintAlpha((int)(255 * mFadingAlpha));
        else setPaintAlpha(255);
        invalidate();
    }

    public Paint getGesturePaint()
    {
        return mGesturePaint;
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        super.draw(canvas);

        if (mCurrentGesture != null && mGestureVisible) canvas.drawPath(mPath, mGesturePaint);
    }

    private void setPaintAlpha(int alpha)
    {
        alpha += alpha >> 7;
        int baseAlpha = mCurrentColor >>> 24;
        int useAlpha = baseAlpha * alpha >> 8;
        mGesturePaint.setColor((mCurrentColor << 8 >>> 8) | (useAlpha << 24));
    }

    public void clear(boolean animated)
    {
        clear(animated, false, true);
    }

    private void clear(boolean animated, boolean fireActionPerformed, boolean immediate)
    {
        setPaintAlpha(255);
        removeCallbacks(mFadingOut);
        mResetGesture = false;
        mFadingOut.mFireActionPerformed = fireActionPerformed;
        mFadingOut.mResetMultipleStrokes = false;

        if (animated && mCurrentGesture != null)
        {
            mFadingAlpha = 1.0f;
            mIsFadingOut = true;
            mFadingHasStarted = false;
            mFadingStart = SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + mFadeOffset;

            postDelayed(mFadingOut, mFadeOffset);
            return;
        }

        mFadingAlpha = 1.0f;
        mIsFadingOut = false;
        mFadingHasStarted = false;

        if (immediate)
        {
            mCurrentGesture = null;
            mPath.rewind();
            invalidate();
        }
        else if (fireActionPerformed)
        {
            postDelayed(mFadingOut, mFadeOffset);
        }
        else if (mGestureStrokeType == GESTURE_STROKE_TYPE_MULTIPLE)
        {
            mFadingOut.mResetMultipleStrokes = true;
            postDelayed(mFadingOut, mFadeOffset);
        }
        else
        {
            mCurrentGesture = null;
            mPath.rewind();
            invalidate();
        }
    }

    public void cancelClearAnimation()
    {
        setPaintAlpha(255);
        mIsFadingOut = false;
        mFadingHasStarted = false;
        removeCallbacks(mFadingOut);
        mPath.rewind();
        mCurrentGesture = null;
    }

    public void cancelGesture()
    {
        mIsListeningForGestures = false;

        if (mCurrentGesture != null) mCurrentGesture.addStroke(new GestureStroke(mStrokeBuffer));

        long now = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        MotionEvent event = MotionEvent.obtain(now, now, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0);

        ArrayList<OnGestureListener> listeners = new ArrayList<>(mOnGestureListeners);
        for (OnGestureListener listener : listeners) listener.onGestureCancelled(this, event);

        event.recycle();

        clear(false);
        mIsGesturing = false;
        mPreviousWasGesturing = false;
        mStrokeBuffer.clear();

        ArrayList<OnGesturingListener> gesturing = new ArrayList<>(mOnGesturingListeners);
        for (OnGesturingListener listener : gesturing) listener.onGesturingEnded(this);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow()
    {
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
        cancelClearAnimation();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (!isEnabled()) return super.dispatchTouchEvent(event);

        boolean cancelDispatch = (mIsGesturing || (mCurrentGesture != null && mCurrentGesture.getStrokesCount() > 0
                                                   && mPreviousWasGesturing))
            && mInterceptEvents;

        processEvent(event);

        if (cancelDispatch) event.setAction(MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL);

        super.dispatchTouchEvent(event);
        return true;
    }

    private boolean processEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        switch (event.getAction())
        {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                touchDown(event);
                invalidate();
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE:
                if (!mIsListeningForGestures) return false;
                touchMove(event);
                invalidate();
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                if (!mIsListeningForGestures) return false;
                touchUp(event, false);
                invalidate();
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                if (!mIsListeningForGestures) return false;
                touchUp(event, true);
                invalidate();
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    private void touchDown(MotionEvent event)
    {
        mIsListeningForGestures = true;

        float x = event.getX();
        float y = event.getY();

        mX = x;
        mY = y;

        mTotalLength = 0;
        mIsGesturing = false;

        if (mGestureStrokeType == GESTURE_STROKE_TYPE_SINGLE || mResetGesture)
        {
            if (mHandleGestureActions) setCurrentColor(mUncertainGestureColor);
            mResetGesture = false;
            mCurrentGesture = null;
            mPath.rewind();
        }
        else if (mCurrentGesture == null || mCurrentGesture.getStrokesCount() == 0)
        {
            if (mHandleGestureActions) setCurrentColor(mUncertainGestureColor);
        }

        if (mFadingHasStarted)
        {
            cancelClearAnimation();
        }
        else if (mIsFadingOut)
        {
            setPaintAlpha(255);
            mIsFadingOut = false;
            mFadingHasStarted = false;
            removeCallbacks(mFadingOut);
        }

        if (mCurrentGesture == null) mCurrentGesture = new Gesture();

        mStrokeBuffer.add(new GesturePoint(x, y, event.getEventTime()));
        mPath.moveTo(x, y);

        ArrayList<OnGestureListener> listeners = new ArrayList<>(mOnGestureListeners);
        for (OnGestureListener listener : listeners) listener.onGestureStarted(this, event);
    }

    private void touchMove(MotionEvent event)
    {
        float x = event.getX();
        float y = event.getY();

        float previousX = mX;
        float previousY = mY;

        float dx = Math.abs(x - previousX);
        float dy = Math.abs(y - previousY);

        if (dx >= TOUCH_TOLERANCE || dy >= TOUCH_TOLERANCE)
        {
            float controlX = (x + previousX) / 2;
            float controlY = (y + previousY) / 2;
            mPath.quadTo(previousX, previousY, controlX, controlY);

            mX = x;
            mY = y;

            mStrokeBuffer.add(new GesturePoint(x, y, event.getEventTime()));

            if (mHandleGestureActions && !mIsGesturing)
            {
                mTotalLength += (float)Math.hypot(dx, dy);

                if (mTotalLength > mGestureStrokeLengthThreshold)
                {
                    float[] coordinates = new float[mStrokeBuffer.size() * 2];
                    for (int index = 0; index < mStrokeBuffer.size(); index++)
                    {
                        coordinates[index * 2] = mStrokeBuffer.get(index).x;
                        coordinates[index * 2 + 1] = mStrokeBuffer.get(index).y;
                    }

                    OrientedBoundingBox box = GestureStroke.computeOrientedBoundingBox(coordinates);

                    float angle = Math.abs(box.orientation);
                    if (angle > 90) angle = 180 - angle;

                    boolean oriented = mOrientation == ORIENTATION_VERTICAL ? angle < mGestureStrokeAngleThreshold
                                                                            : angle > mGestureStrokeAngleThreshold;

                    if (box.squareness > mGestureStrokeSquarenessTreshold || oriented)
                    {
                        mIsGesturing = true;
                        setCurrentColor(mCertainGestureColor);

                        ArrayList<OnGesturingListener> gesturing = new ArrayList<>(mOnGesturingListeners);
                        for (OnGesturingListener listener : gesturing) listener.onGesturingStarted(this);
                    }
                }
            }

            ArrayList<OnGestureListener> listeners = new ArrayList<>(mOnGestureListeners);
            for (OnGestureListener listener : listeners) listener.onGesture(this, event);
        }
    }

    private void touchUp(MotionEvent event, boolean cancel)
    {
        mIsListeningForGestures = false;

        if (mCurrentGesture != null)
        {
            mCurrentGesture.addStroke(new GestureStroke(mStrokeBuffer));

            if (!cancel)
            {
                ArrayList<OnGestureListener> listeners = new ArrayList<>(mOnGestureListeners);
                for (OnGestureListener listener : listeners) listener.onGestureEnded(this, event);

                clear(mHandleGestureActions && mFadeEnabled, mHandleGestureActions && mIsGesturing, false);
            }
            else
            {
                cancelGesture(event);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            cancelGesture(event);
        }

        mStrokeBuffer.clear();
        mPreviousWasGesturing = mIsGesturing;
        mIsGesturing = false;

        ArrayList<OnGesturingListener> gesturing = new ArrayList<>(mOnGesturingListeners);
        for (OnGesturingListener listener : gesturing) listener.onGesturingEnded(this);
    }

    private void cancelGesture(MotionEvent event)
    {
        ArrayList<OnGestureListener> listeners = new ArrayList<>(mOnGestureListeners);
        for (OnGestureListener listener : listeners) listener.onGestureCancelled(this, event);

        clear(false);
    }

    private void fireOnGesturePerformed()
    {
        Gesture gesture = mCurrentGesture;
        ArrayList<OnGesturePerformedListener> listeners = new ArrayList<>(mOnGesturePerformedListeners);
        for (OnGesturePerformedListener listener : listeners) listener.onGesturePerformed(this, gesture);
    }

    private static float accelerateDecelerate(float input)
    {
        return (float)(Math.cos((input + 1) * Math.PI) / 2.0) + 0.5f;
    }

    private final class FadeOutRunnable implements Runnable
    {
        boolean mFireActionPerformed;
        boolean mResetMultipleStrokes;

        @Override
        public void run()
        {
            if (mIsFadingOut)
            {
                long now = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
                long duration = now - mFadingStart;

                if (duration > mFadeDuration)
                {
                    if (mFireActionPerformed) fireOnGesturePerformed();

                    mPreviousWasGesturing = false;
                    mIsFadingOut = false;
                    mFadingHasStarted = false;
                    mPath.rewind();
                    mCurrentGesture = null;
                    setPaintAlpha(255);
                }
                else
                {
                    mFadingHasStarted = true;
                    float interpolatedTime = Math.max(0.0f, Math.min(1.0f, duration / (float)mFadeDuration));
                    mFadingAlpha = 1.0f - accelerateDecelerate(interpolatedTime);
                    setPaintAlpha((int)(255 * mFadingAlpha));
                    postDelayed(this, FADE_ANIMATION_RATE);
                }
            }
            else if (mResetMultipleStrokes)
            {
                mResetGesture = true;
            }
            else
            {
                fireOnGesturePerformed();

                mFadingHasStarted = false;
                mPath.rewind();
                mCurrentGesture = null;
                mPreviousWasGesturing = false;
                setPaintAlpha(255);
            }

            invalidate();
        }
    }

    public interface OnGesturingListener
    {
        void onGesturingStarted(GestureOverlayView overlay);

        void onGesturingEnded(GestureOverlayView overlay);
    }

    public interface OnGestureListener
    {
        void onGestureStarted(GestureOverlayView overlay, MotionEvent event);

        void onGesture(GestureOverlayView overlay, MotionEvent event);

        void onGestureEnded(GestureOverlayView overlay, MotionEvent event);

        void onGestureCancelled(GestureOverlayView overlay, MotionEvent event);
    }

    public interface OnGesturePerformedListener
    {
        void onGesturePerformed(GestureOverlayView overlay, Gesture gesture);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.gesture;

public class GesturePoint
{
    public final float x;
    public final float y;
    public final long timestamp;

    public GesturePoint(float x, float y, long t)
    {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        timestamp = t;
    }

    @Override
    public Object clone()
    {
        return new GesturePoint(x, y, timestamp);
    }
}
```

`java/android/gesture/GestureStroke.java`:

```java
package android.gesture;

import android.graphics.Path;
import android.graphics.RectF;

import java.util.ArrayList;

public class GestureStroke
{
    private static final float TOUCH_TOLERANCE = 3;

    public final RectF boundingBox;
    public final float length;
    public final float[] points;

    private final long[] mTimestamps;
    private Path mCachedPath;

    public GestureStroke(ArrayList<GesturePoint> points)
    {
        int count = points.size();
        float[] coordinates = new float[count * 2];
        long[] times = new long[count];
        RectF box = null;
        float total = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            GesturePoint point = points.get(index);
            coordinates[index * 2] = point.x;
            coordinates[index * 2 + 1] = point.y;
            times[index] = point.timestamp;

            if (box == null)
            {
                box = new RectF(point.x, point.y, point.x, point.y);
            }
            else
            {
                box.union(point.x, point.y);
                float dx = point.x - coordinates[(index - 1) * 2];
                float dy = point.y - coordinates[(index - 1) * 2 + 1];
                total += (float)Math.hypot(dx, dy);
            }
        }

        this.points = coordinates;
        mTimestamps = times;
        boundingBox = box == null ? new RectF() : box;
        length = total;
    }

    private GestureStroke(RectF box, float length, float[] points, long[] timestamps)
    {
        boundingBox = new RectF(box);
        this.length = length;
        this.points = points.clone();
        mTimestamps = timestamps.clone();
    }

    @Override
    public Object clone()
    {
        return new GestureStroke(boundingBox, length, points, mTimestamps);
    }

    long timestampAt(int index)
    {
        return mTimestamps[index];
    }

    public Path getPath()
    {
        if (mCachedPath == null) mCachedPath = buildPath();
        return mCachedPath;
    }

    private Path buildPath()
    {
        Path path = new Path();
        int count = points.length / 2;
        if (count == 0) return path;

        float lastX = points[0];
        float lastY = points[1];
        path.moveTo(lastX, lastY);

        for (int index = 1; index < count; index++)
        {
            float x = points[index * 2];
            float y = points[index * 2 + 1];
            float dx = Math.abs(x - lastX);
            float dy = Math.abs(y - lastY);

            if (dx >= TOUCH_TOLERANCE || dy >= TOUCH_TOLERANCE)
            {
                path.quadTo(lastX, lastY, (x + lastX) / 2, (y + lastY) / 2);
                lastX = x;
                lastY = y;
            }
        }

        return path;
    }

    public Path toPath(float width, float height, int numSample)
    {
        Path path = new Path();
        int count = points.length / 2;
        if (count == 0 || numSample <= 0) return path;

        float[] sampled = sample(Math.max(2, numSample));
        float scale = Math.min(boundingBox.width() == 0 ? 1 : width / boundingBox.width(),
                               boundingBox.height() == 0 ? 1 : height / boundingBox.height());

        float lastX = 0;
        float lastY = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index < sampled.length; index += 2)
        {
            float x = (sampled[index] - boundingBox.left) * scale;
            float y = (sampled[index + 1] - boundingBox.top) * scale;

            if (index == 0)
            {
                path.moveTo(x, y);
                lastX = x;
                lastY = y;
                continue;
            }

            float dx = Math.abs(x - lastX);
            float dy = Math.abs(y - lastY);
            if (dx >= TOUCH_TOLERANCE || dy >= TOUCH_TOLERANCE)
            {
                path.quadTo(lastX, lastY, (x + lastX) / 2, (y + lastY) / 2);
                lastX = x;
                lastY = y;
            }
        }

        return path;
    }

    private float[] sample(int numSample)
    {
        float[] result = new float[numSample * 2];
        int count = points.length / 2;

        if (count == 1 || length == 0)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < numSample; index++)
            {
                result[index * 2] = points[0];
                result[index * 2 + 1] = points[1];
            }
            return result;
        }

        float step = length / (numSample - 1);
        int segment = 0;
        float segmentStart = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index < numSample; index++)
        {
            float target = Math.min(length, index * step);

            while (segment < count - 2)
            {
                float segmentLength = segmentLength(segment);
                if (segmentStart + segmentLength >= target) break;
                segmentStart += segmentLength;
                segment++;
            }

            float segmentLength = segmentLength(segment);
            float fraction = segmentLength == 0 ? 0 : (target - segmentStart) / segmentLength;
            float startX = points[segment * 2];
            float startY = points[segment * 2 + 1];
            result[index * 2] = startX + (points[segment * 2 + 2] - startX) * fraction;
            result[index * 2 + 1] = startY + (points[segment * 2 + 3] - startY) * fraction;
        }

        return result;
    }

    private float segmentLength(int segment)
    {
        return (float)Math.hypot(points[segment * 2 + 2] - points[segment * 2], points[segment * 2 + 3] - points[segment * 2 + 1]);
    }

    public void clearPath()
    {
        mCachedPath = null;
    }

    public OrientedBoundingBox computeOrientedBoundingBox()
    {
        return computeOrientedBoundingBox(points);
    }

    static OrientedBoundingBox computeOrientedBoundingBox(float[] coordinates)
    {
        int count = coordinates.length / 2;
        if (count == 0) return new OrientedBoundingBox(0, 0, 0, 0, 0);

        float centreX = 0;
        float centreY = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            centreX += coordinates[index * 2];
            centreY += coordinates[index * 2 + 1];
        }
        centreX /= count;
        centreY /= count;

        double xx = 0;
        double xy = 0;
        double yy = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            double dx = coordinates[index * 2] - centreX;
            double dy = coordinates[index * 2 + 1] - centreY;
            xx += dx * dx;
            xy += dx * dy;
            yy += dy * dy;
        }

        double angle = xy == 0 && xx >= yy ? 0 : 0.5 * Math.atan2(2 * xy, xx - yy);
        double cosine = Math.cos(-angle);
        double sine = Math.sin(-angle);

        float minX = Float.MAX_VALUE;
        float minY = Float.MAX_VALUE;
        float maxX = -Float.MAX_VALUE;
        float maxY = -Float.MAX_VALUE;

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            double dx = coordinates[index * 2] - centreX;
            double dy = coordinates[index * 2 + 1] - centreY;
            float x = (float)(dx * cosine - dy * sine);
            float y = (float)(dx * sine + dy * cosine);
            minX = Math.min(minX, x);
            minY = Math.min(minY, y);
            maxX = Math.max(maxX, x);
            maxY = Math.max(maxY, y);
        }

        return new OrientedBoundingBox((float)Math.toDegrees(angle), centreX, centreY, maxX - minX, maxY - minY);
    }
}
```
