```java
package android.graphics;

import android.content.ContentResolver;
import android.content.res.AssetFileDescriptor;
import android.content.res.AssetManager;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.drawable.AnimatedImageDrawable;
import android.graphics.drawable.BitmapDrawable;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.util.Size;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.util.concurrent.Callable;

public final class ImageDecoder implements AutoCloseable
{
    public static final int ALLOCATOR_DEFAULT = 0;
    public static final int ALLOCATOR_SOFTWARE = 1;
    public static final int ALLOCATOR_SHARED_MEMORY = 2;
    public static final int ALLOCATOR_HARDWARE = 3;

    public static final int MEMORY_POLICY_LOW_RAM = 0;
    public static final int MEMORY_POLICY_DEFAULT = 1;

    private final Source mSource;
    private final byte[] mData;
    private final ImageInfo mInfo;

    private int mTargetWidth;
    private int mTargetHeight;
    private int mSampleSize = 1;
    private int mAllocator = ALLOCATOR_DEFAULT;
    private boolean mUnpremultipliedRequired;
    private boolean mMutableRequired;
    private boolean mDecodeAsAlphaMask;
    private int mMemoryPolicy = MEMORY_POLICY_DEFAULT;
    private PostProcessor mPostProcessor;
    private OnPartialImageListener mPartialImageListener;
    private Rect mCrop;
    private ColorSpace mTargetColorSpace;
    private boolean mClosed;

    private ImageDecoder(Source source, byte[] data, ImageInfo info)
    {
        mSource = source;
        mData = data;
        mInfo = info;
        mTargetWidth = info.mWidth;
        mTargetHeight = info.mHeight;
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        try
        {
            close();
        }
        finally
        {
            super.finalize();
        }
    }

    public static boolean isMimeTypeSupported(String mimeType)
    {
        if (mimeType == null) throw new NullPointerException("mimeType");

        switch (mimeType.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US))
        {
            case "image/png":
            case "image/jpeg":
            case "image/webp":
            case "image/gif":
            case "image/bmp":
            case "image/x-ico":
            case "image/vnd.wap.wbmp":
                return true;

            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    public static Source createSource(Resources resources, int resourceId)
    {
        return new ResourceSource(resources, resourceId);
    }

    public static Source createSource(ContentResolver resolver, Uri uri)
    {
        return new ContentResolverSource(resolver, uri);
    }

    public static Source createSource(AssetManager assets, String fileName)
    {
        return new AssetSource(assets, fileName);
    }

    public static Source createSource(byte[] data, int offset, int length) throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
    {
        if (data == null) throw new NullPointerException("null byte[] in createSource!");
        if (offset < 0 || length < 0 || offset >= data.length || offset + length > data.length)
        {
            throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException("invalid offset/length!");
        }

        return new ByteArraySource(data, offset, length);
    }

    public static Source createSource(byte[] data)
    {
        return createSource(data, 0, data.length);
    }

    public static Source createSource(ByteBuffer buffer)
    {
        return new ByteBufferSource(buffer);
    }

    public static Source createSource(File file)
    {
        return new FileSource(file);
    }

    public static Source createSource(Callable<AssetFileDescriptor> callable)
    {
        return new CallableSource(callable);
    }

    public void setTargetSize(int width, int height)
    {
        if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Dimensions must be positive! provided " + width + "x" + height);

        mTargetWidth = width;
        mTargetHeight = height;
    }

    public void setTargetSampleSize(int sampleSize)
    {
        if (sampleSize <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("sampleSize must be positive! provided " + sampleSize);

        mSampleSize = sampleSize;
        mTargetWidth = Math.max(1, (mInfo.mWidth + sampleSize - 1) / sampleSize);
        mTargetHeight = Math.max(1, (mInfo.mHeight + sampleSize - 1) / sampleSize);
    }

    public void setAllocator(int allocator)
    {
        if (allocator < ALLOCATOR_DEFAULT || allocator > ALLOCATOR_HARDWARE)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid allocator " + allocator);
        }

        mAllocator = allocator;
    }

    public int getAllocator()
    {
        return mAllocator;
    }

    public void setUnpremultipliedRequired(boolean unpremultipliedRequired)
    {
        mUnpremultipliedRequired = unpremultipliedRequired;
    }

    public boolean isUnpremultipliedRequired()
    {
        return mUnpremultipliedRequired;
    }

    public void setPostProcessor(PostProcessor postProcessor)
    {
        mPostProcessor = postProcessor;
    }

    public PostProcessor getPostProcessor()
    {
        return mPostProcessor;
    }

    public void setOnPartialImageListener(OnPartialImageListener listener)
    {
        mPartialImageListener = listener;
    }

    public OnPartialImageListener getOnPartialImageListener()
    {
        return mPartialImageListener;
    }

    public void setCrop(Rect subset)
    {
        mCrop = subset == null ? null : new Rect(subset);
    }

    public Rect getCrop()
    {
        return mCrop;
    }

    public void setMutableRequired(boolean mutable)
    {
        mMutableRequired = mutable;
    }

    public boolean isMutableRequired()
    {
        return mMutableRequired;
    }

    public void setMemorySizePolicy(int policy)
    {
        mMemoryPolicy = policy;
    }

    public int getMemorySizePolicy()
    {
        return mMemoryPolicy;
    }

    public void setDecodeAsAlphaMaskEnabled(boolean enabled)
    {
        mDecodeAsAlphaMask = enabled;
    }

    public boolean isDecodeAsAlphaMaskEnabled()
    {
        return mDecodeAsAlphaMask;
    }

    public void setTargetColorSpace(ColorSpace colorSpace)
    {
        mTargetColorSpace = colorSpace;
    }

    @Override
    public void close()
    {
        mClosed = true;
    }

    public static Drawable decodeDrawable(Source source, OnHeaderDecodedListener listener) throws IOException
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener cannot be null! Use decodeDrawable(Source)");

        return decodeDrawableImpl(source, listener);
    }

    public static Drawable decodeDrawable(Source source) throws IOException
    {
        return decodeDrawableImpl(source, null);
    }

    public static Bitmap decodeBitmap(Source source, OnHeaderDecodedListener listener) throws IOException
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener cannot be null! Use decodeBitmap(Source)");

        return decodeBitmapImpl(source, listener);
    }

    public static Bitmap decodeBitmap(Source source) throws IOException
    {
        return decodeBitmapImpl(source, null);
    }

    private static Drawable decodeDrawableImpl(Source source, OnHeaderDecodedListener listener) throws IOException
    {
        ImageDecoder decoder = open(source, listener);

        try
        {
            Bitmap bitmap = decoder.decode();
            Resources resources = source.resources();

            if (decoder.mInfo.isAnimated()) return new AnimatedImageDrawable(resources, bitmap);

            return new BitmapDrawable(resources, bitmap);
        }
        finally
        {
            decoder.close();
        }
    }

    private static Bitmap decodeBitmapImpl(Source source, OnHeaderDecodedListener listener) throws IOException
    {
        ImageDecoder decoder = open(source, listener);

        try
        {
            return decoder.decode();
        }
        finally
        {
            decoder.close();
        }
    }

    private static ImageDecoder open(Source source, OnHeaderDecodedListener listener) throws IOException
    {
        if (source == null) throw new NullPointerException("source");

        byte[] data = source.read();
        if (data == null || data.length == 0)
        {
            throw new DecodeException(DecodeException.SOURCE_INCOMPLETE, "empty image source", source);
        }

        BitmapFactory.Options bounds = new BitmapFactory.Options();
        bounds.inJustDecodeBounds = true;
        BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(data, 0, data.length, bounds);

        if (bounds.outWidth <= 0 || bounds.outHeight <= 0)
        {
            throw new DecodeException(DecodeException.SOURCE_MALFORMED_DATA, "Failed to create image decoder: input contained an error",
                                      source);
        }

        String mimeType = mimeTypeOf(data);
        ImageInfo info = new ImageInfo(bounds.outWidth, bounds.outHeight, mimeType, isAnimated(data, mimeType));
        ImageDecoder decoder = new ImageDecoder(source, data, info);

        if (listener != null) listener.onHeaderDecoded(decoder, info, source);

        return decoder;
    }

    private Bitmap decode() throws IOException
    {
        if (mClosed) throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot use closed ImageDecoder!");

        Bitmap decoded = BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(mData, 0, mData.length);

        if (decoded == null)
        {
            DecodeException failure = new DecodeException(DecodeException.SOURCE_MALFORMED_DATA, "Failed to decode image", mSource);
            if (mPartialImageListener != null) mPartialImageListener.onPartialImage(failure);

            throw failure;
        }

        Bitmap result = decoded;

        if (mTargetWidth != decoded.getWidth() || mTargetHeight != decoded.getHeight())
        {
            result = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(decoded, mTargetWidth, mTargetHeight, true);
        }

        if (mCrop != null)
        {
            Rect crop = new Rect(mCrop);

            if (crop.left < 0 || crop.top < 0 || crop.right > mTargetWidth || crop.bottom > mTargetHeight || crop.isEmpty())
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Subset " + crop + " must be contained within the scaled image dimensions "
                                                + mTargetWidth + "x" + mTargetHeight);
            }

            Bitmap cropped = Bitmap.createBitmap(crop.width(), crop.height(), Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
            Canvas canvas = new Canvas(cropped);
            canvas.drawBitmap(result, crop, new Rect(0, 0, crop.width(), crop.height()), null);
            result = cropped;
        }

        if (!result.isMutable() && (mMutableRequired || mPostProcessor != null))
        {
            result = result.copy(result.getConfig(), true);
        }

        if (mPostProcessor != null)
        {
            Canvas canvas = new Canvas(result);
            mPostProcessor.onPostProcess(canvas);
        }

        return result;
    }

    private static String mimeTypeOf(byte[] data)
    {
        int length = data.length;

        if (length >= 8 && (data[0] & 0xFF) == 0x89 && data[1] == 'P' && data[2] == 'N' && data[3] == 'G') return "image/png";
        if (length >= 3 && (data[0] & 0xFF) == 0xFF && (data[1] & 0xFF) == 0xD8) return "image/jpeg";
        if (length >= 12 && data[0] == 'R' && data[1] == 'I' && data[2] == 'F' && data[3] == 'F' && data[8] == 'W') return "image/webp";
        if (length >= 6 && data[0] == 'G' && data[1] == 'I' && data[2] == 'F') return "image/gif";
        if (length >= 2 && data[0] == 'B' && data[1] == 'M') return "image/bmp";
        if (length >= 12 && data[4] == 'f' && data[5] == 't' && data[6] == 'y' && data[7] == 'p') return "image/heif";

        return "";
    }

    private static boolean isAnimated(byte[] data, String mimeType)
    {
        if ("image/gif".equals(mimeType)) return countGifFrames(data) > 1;
        if ("image/webp".equals(mimeType)) return contains(data, new byte[] {'A', 'N', 'I', 'M'});
        if ("image/png".equals(mimeType)) return contains(data, new byte[] {'a', 'c', 'T', 'L'});

        return false;
    }

    private static int countGifFrames(byte[] data)
    {
        int frames = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index + 2 < data.length; index++)
        {
            if ((data[index] & 0xFF) == 0x21 && (data[index + 1] & 0xFF) == 0xF9 && (data[index + 2] & 0xFF) == 0x04)
            {
                frames++;
                if (frames > 1) return frames;
            }
        }

        return frames;
    }

    private static boolean contains(byte[] data, byte[] pattern)
    {
        int limit = Math.min(data.length, 4096) - pattern.length;

        for (int index = 0; index <= limit; index++)
        {
            boolean matched = true;

            for (int offset = 0; offset < pattern.length && matched; offset++)
            {
                if (data[index + offset] != pattern[offset]) matched = false;
            }

            if (matched) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private static byte[] readFully(InputStream stream) throws IOException
    {
        if (stream == null) return null;

        try
        {
            ByteArrayOutputStream collected = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            byte[] chunk = new byte[16384];

            int read;
            while ((read = stream.read(chunk)) > 0) collected.write(chunk, 0, read);

            return collected.toByteArray();
        }
        finally
        {
            stream.close();
        }
    }

    public abstract static class Source
    {
        Source()
        {
        }

        abstract byte[] read() throws IOException;

        Resources resources()
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static final class ByteArraySource extends Source
    {
        private final byte[] mData;
        private final int mOffset;
        private final int mLength;

        ByteArraySource(byte[] data, int offset, int length)
        {
            mData = data;
            mOffset = offset;
            mLength = length;
        }

        @Override
        byte[] read()
        {
            if (mOffset == 0 && mLength == mData.length) return mData;

            byte[] copy = new byte[mLength];
            System.arraycopy(mData, mOffset, copy, 0, mLength);
            return copy;
        }
    }

    private static final class ByteBufferSource extends Source
    {
        private final ByteBuffer mBuffer;

        ByteBufferSource(ByteBuffer buffer)
        {
            mBuffer = buffer;
        }

        @Override
        byte[] read()
        {
            ByteBuffer view = mBuffer.slice();
            byte[] data = new byte[view.remaining()];
            view.get(data);
            return data;
        }
    }

    private static final class FileSource extends Source
    {
        private final File mFile;

        FileSource(File file)
        {
            mFile = file;
        }

        @Override
        byte[] read() throws IOException
        {
            return readFully(new FileInputStream(mFile));
        }
    }

    private static final class AssetSource extends Source
    {
        private final AssetManager mAssets;
        private final String mFileName;

        AssetSource(AssetManager assets, String fileName)
        {
            mAssets = assets;
            mFileName = fileName;
        }

        @Override
        byte[] read() throws IOException
        {
            return readFully(mAssets.open(mFileName));
        }
    }

    private static final class ResourceSource extends Source
    {
        private final Resources mResources;
        private final int mResourceId;

        ResourceSource(Resources resources, int resourceId)
        {
            mResources = resources;
            mResourceId = resourceId;
        }

        @Override
        byte[] read() throws IOException
        {
            return readFully(mResources.openRawResource(mResourceId));
        }

        @Override
        Resources resources()
        {
            return mResources;
        }
    }

    private static final class ContentResolverSource extends Source
    {
        private final ContentResolver mResolver;
        private final Uri mUri;

        ContentResolverSource(ContentResolver resolver, Uri uri)
        {
            mResolver = resolver;
            mUri = uri;
        }

        @Override
        byte[] read() throws IOException
        {
            InputStream stream = mResolver.openInputStream(mUri);
            if (stream == null) throw new java.io.FileNotFoundException(mUri.toString());

            return readFully(stream);
        }
    }

    private static final class CallableSource extends Source
    {
        private final Callable<AssetFileDescriptor> mCallable;

        CallableSource(Callable<AssetFileDescriptor> callable)
        {
            mCallable = callable;
        }

        @Override
        byte[] read() throws IOException
        {
            AssetFileDescriptor descriptor;

            try
            {
                descriptor = mCallable.call();
            }
            catch (IOException failure)
            {
                throw failure;
            }
            catch (Exception failure)
            {
                throw new IOException(failure);
            }

            if (descriptor == null) throw new java.io.FileNotFoundException("null AssetFileDescriptor");

            return readFully(descriptor.createInputStream());
        }
    }

    public static class ImageInfo
    {
        private final int mWidth;
        private final int mHeight;
        private final String mMimeType;
        private final boolean mAnimated;

        ImageInfo(int width, int height, String mimeType, boolean animated)
        {
            mWidth = width;
            mHeight = height;
            mMimeType = mimeType;
            mAnimated = animated;
        }

        public Size getSize()
        {
            return new Size(mWidth, mHeight);
        }

        public String getMimeType()
        {
            return mMimeType;
        }

        public boolean isAnimated()
        {
            return mAnimated;
        }

        public ColorSpace getColorSpace()
        {
            return ColorSpace.get(ColorSpace.Named.SRGB);
        }
    }

    public interface OnHeaderDecodedListener
    {
        void onHeaderDecoded(ImageDecoder decoder, ImageInfo info, Source source);
    }

    public interface OnPartialImageListener
    {
        boolean onPartialImage(DecodeException exception);
    }

    public static final class DecodeException extends IOException
    {
        public static final int SOURCE_EXCEPTION = 1;
        public static final int SOURCE_INCOMPLETE = 2;
        public static final int SOURCE_MALFORMED_DATA = 3;

        private final int mError;
        private final transient Source mSource;

        DecodeException(int error, String message, Source source)
        {
            super(message);
            mError = error;
            mSource = source;
        }

        DecodeException(int error, String message, Throwable cause, Source source)
        {
            super(message, cause);
            mError = error;
            mSource = source;
        }

        public int getError()
        {
            return mError;
        }

        public Source getSource()
        {
            return mSource;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics;

public final class Insets implements android.os.Parcelable
{
    public static final Insets NONE = new Insets(0, 0, 0, 0);

    public static final android.os.Parcelable.Creator<Insets> CREATOR = new android.os.Parcelable.Creator<Insets>()
    {
        @Override
        public Insets createFromParcel(android.os.Parcel source)
        {
            return of(source.readInt(), source.readInt(), source.readInt(), source.readInt());
        }

        @Override
        public Insets[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Insets[size];
        }
    };

    public final int left;
    public final int top;
    public final int right;
    public final int bottom;

    private Insets(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        this.left = left;
        this.top = top;
        this.right = right;
        this.bottom = bottom;
    }

    public static Insets of(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        if (left == 0 && top == 0 && right == 0 && bottom == 0) return NONE;
        return new Insets(left, top, right, bottom);
    }

    public static Insets of(Rect rect)
    {
        return rect == null ? NONE : of(rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom);
    }

    public Rect toRect()
    {
        return new Rect(left, top, right, bottom);
    }

    public static Insets add(Insets first, Insets second)
    {
        return of(first.left + second.left, first.top + second.top, first.right + second.right, first.bottom + second.bottom);
    }

    public static Insets max(Insets first, Insets second)
    {
        return of(Math.max(first.left, second.left), Math.max(first.top, second.top), Math.max(first.right, second.right),
                  Math.max(first.bottom, second.bottom));
    }

    public static Insets min(Insets first, Insets second)
    {
        return of(Math.min(first.left, second.left), Math.min(first.top, second.top), Math.min(first.right, second.right),
                  Math.min(first.bottom, second.bottom));
    }

    public static Insets subtract(Insets first, Insets second)
    {
        return of(first.left - second.left, first.top - second.top, first.right - second.right, first.bottom - second.bottom);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(android.os.Parcel out, int flags)
    {
        out.writeInt(left);
        out.writeInt(top);
        out.writeInt(right);
        out.writeInt(bottom);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof Insets)) return false;

        Insets that = (Insets)other;
        return left == that.left && top == that.top && right == that.right && bottom == that.bottom;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return ((left * 31 + top) * 31 + right) * 31 + bottom;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Insets{left=" + left + ", top=" + top + ", right=" + right + ", bottom=" + bottom + "}";
    }
}
```

`java/android/graphics/Interpolator.java`:

```java
package android.graphics;

public class Interpolator
{
    private static final float[] LINEAR_BLEND = {1.0f / 3, 1.0f / 3, 2.0f / 3, 2.0f / 3};

    private int mValueCount;
    private int mFrameCount;
    private int[] mTimes;
    private float[][] mValues;
    private float[][] mBlends;
    private float mRepeat = 1;
    private boolean mMirror;

    public Interpolator(int valueCount)
    {
        this(valueCount, 2);
    }

    public Interpolator(int valueCount, int frameCount)
    {
        reset(valueCount, frameCount);
    }

    public void reset(int valueCount)
    {
        reset(valueCount, 2);
    }

    public void reset(int valueCount, int frameCount)
    {
        mValueCount = valueCount;
        mFrameCount = frameCount;
        mTimes = new int[frameCount];
        mValues = new float[frameCount][valueCount];
        mBlends = new float[frameCount][];
        mRepeat = 1;
        mMirror = false;

        for (int index = 0; index < frameCount; index++) mBlends[index] = LINEAR_BLEND;
    }

    public final int getKeyFrameCount()
    {
        return mFrameCount;
    }

    public final int getValueCount()
    {
        return mValueCount;
    }

    public void setKeyFrame(int index, int msec, float[] values)
    {
        setKeyFrame(index, msec, values, null);
    }

    public void setKeyFrame(int index, int msec, float[] values, float[] blend)
    {
        if (index < 0 || index >= mFrameCount) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
        if (values.length < mValueCount) throw new ArrayStoreException();
        if (blend != null && blend.length < 4) throw new ArrayStoreException();

        mTimes[index] = msec;
        System.arraycopy(values, 0, mValues[index], 0, mValueCount);
        mBlends[index] = blend == null ? LINEAR_BLEND : blend.clone();
    }

    public void setRepeatMirror(float repeatCount, boolean mirror)
    {
        if (repeatCount < 0) return;

        mRepeat = repeatCount;
        mMirror = mirror;
    }

    public Result timeToValues(float[] values)
    {
        return timeToValues((int)android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis(), values);
    }

    public Result timeToValues(int msec, float[] values)
    {
        if (values != null && values.length < mValueCount) throw new ArrayStoreException();
        if (mFrameCount == 0) return Result.FREEZE_START;

        Result result = Result.NORMAL;
        int time = msec;

        if (mRepeat != 1)
        {
            int startTime = mTimes[0];
            int totalTime = mTimes[mFrameCount - 1] - startTime;
            int offsetTime = time - startTime;
            int endTime = (int)Math.floor(mRepeat * totalTime);

            if (offsetTime >= endTime)
            {
                float fraction = mRepeat - (float)Math.floor(mRepeat);
                offsetTime = fraction == 0 && mRepeat > 0 ? totalTime : (int)Math.floor(fraction * totalTime);
                result = Result.FREEZE_END;
            }
            else if (totalTime > 0)
            {
                int period = mMirror ? totalTime * 2 : totalTime;
                offsetTime = offsetTime % period;
                if (offsetTime > totalTime) offsetTime = totalTime * 2 - offsetTime;
            }

            time = offsetTime + startTime;
        }

        int index = search(time);
        boolean exact = true;

        if (index < 0)
        {
            index = ~index;

            if (index == 0)
            {
                result = Result.FREEZE_START;
            }
            else if (index == mFrameCount)
            {
                index -= 1;
                result = Result.FREEZE_END;
            }
            else
            {
                exact = false;
            }
        }

        if (values == null) return result;

        if (exact)
        {
            System.arraycopy(mValues[index], 0, values, 0, mValueCount);
            return result;
        }

        int previousTime = mTimes[index - 1];
        float fraction = (time - previousTime) / (float)(mTimes[index] - previousTime);
        float[] blend = mBlends[index - 1];
        float eased = cubic(fraction, blend[0], blend[1], blend[2], blend[3]);

        float[] previous = mValues[index - 1];
        float[] next = mValues[index];

        for (int value = 0; value < mValueCount; value++)
        {
            values[value] = previous[value] + (next[value] - previous[value]) * eased;
        }

        return result;
    }

    private int search(int time)
    {
        int low = 0;
        int high = mFrameCount - 1;

        while (low <= high)
        {
            int middle = (low + high) >>> 1;

            if (mTimes[middle] < time) low = middle + 1;
            else if (mTimes[middle] > time) high = middle - 1;
            else return middle;
        }

        return ~low;
    }

    private static float cubic(float x, float firstX, float firstY, float secondX, float secondY)
    {
        float low = 0;
        float high = 1;
        float t = x;

        for (int iteration = 0; iteration < 24; iteration++)
        {
            t = (low + high) * 0.5f;
            float estimate = bezier(t, firstX, secondX);

            if (estimate < x) low = t;
            else high = t;
        }

        return bezier(t, firstY, secondY);
    }

    private static float bezier(float t, float first, float second)
    {
        float inverse = 1 - t;
        return 3 * inverse * inverse * t * first + 3 * inverse * t * t * second + t * t * t;
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        super.finalize();
    }

    public enum Result
    {
        NORMAL,
        FREEZE_START,
        FREEZE_END
    }
}
```

`java/android/graphics/LightingColorFilter.java`:

```java
package android.graphics;

public class LightingColorFilter extends ColorFilter
{
    private final int mMultiply;
    private final int mAdd;

    public LightingColorFilter(int multiply, int add)
    {
        mMultiply = multiply;
        mAdd = add;
    }

    public int getColorMultiply()
    {
        return mMultiply;
    }

    public int getColorAdd()
    {
        return mAdd;
    }

    @Override
    int apply(int source)
    {
        int red = Math.min(255, Color.red(source) * Color.red(mMultiply) / 255 + Color.red(mAdd));
        int green = Math.min(255, Color.green(source) * Color.green(mMultiply) / 255 + Color.green(mAdd));
        int blue = Math.min(255, Color.blue(source) * Color.blue(mMultiply) / 255 + Color.blue(mAdd));

        return Color.argb(Color.alpha(source), red, green, blue);
    }

    @Override
    boolean tintsImages()
    {
        return (mMultiply & 0x00FFFFFF) == 0;
    }

    @Override
    int imageTint()
    {
        return 0xFF000000 | (mAdd & 0x00FFFFFF);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics;

public class LinearGradient extends Shader
{
    private final float mStartX;
    private final float mStartY;
    private final float mEndX;
    private final float mEndY;
    private final int[] mColors;
    private final float[] mPositions;
    private final int mTileMode;

    public LinearGradient(float startX, float startY, float endX, float endY, int[] colors, float[] positions,
                          TileMode tileMode)
    {
        if (colors == null || colors.length < 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException("needs at least two colors");

        mStartX = startX;
        mStartY = startY;
        mEndX = endX;
        mEndY = endY;
        mColors = colors.clone();
        mPositions = positions == null ? evenPositions(colors.length) : positions.clone();
        mTileMode = tileModeId(tileMode);
    }

    public LinearGradient(float startX, float startY, float endX, float endY, int startColor, int endColor,
                          TileMode tileMode)

    }

                          TileMode tileMode)

        this(startX, startY, endX, endY, argbColors(colors), positions, tileMode);
    }

                          TileMode tileMode)
    {
        this(startX, startY, endX, endY, new long[] {startColor, endColor}, null, tileMode);
    }
```

`java/android/graphics/Matrix.java`:

```java
package android.graphics;

public class Matrix
{
    public static final int MSCALE_X = 0;
    public static final int MSKEW_X = 1;
    public static final int MTRANS_X = 2;
    public static final int MSKEW_Y = 3;
    public static final int MSCALE_Y = 4;
    public static final int MTRANS_Y = 5;
    public static final int MPERSP_0 = 6;
    public static final int MPERSP_1 = 7;
    public static final int MPERSP_2 = 8;

    public static final Matrix IDENTITY_MATRIX = new Matrix();

    private static final float DEGREES_TO_RADIANS = (float) (Math.PI / 180.0);
    private static final float NEARLY_ZERO = 1.0f / (1 << 12);

    private final float[] mValues = new float[9];

    public Matrix()
    {
        reset();
    }

    public Matrix(Matrix source)
    {
        set(source);
    }

    public void reset()
    {
        mValues[MSCALE_X] = 1;
        mValues[MSKEW_X] = 0;
        mValues[MTRANS_X] = 0;
        mValues[MSKEW_Y] = 0;
        mValues[MSCALE_Y] = 1;
        mValues[MTRANS_Y] = 0;
        mValues[MPERSP_0] = 0;
        mValues[MPERSP_1] = 0;
        mValues[MPERSP_2] = 1;
    }

    public void set(Matrix source)
    {
        if (source == null) reset();
        else System.arraycopy(source.mValues, 0, mValues, 0, mValues.length);
    }

    public void getValues(float[] values)
    {
        if (values != null) System.arraycopy(mValues, 0, values, 0, Math.min(values.length, mValues.length));
    }

    public void setValues(float[] values)
    {
        if (values != null) System.arraycopy(values, 0, mValues, 0, Math.min(values.length, mValues.length));
    }

    public boolean isIdentity()
    {
        return mValues[MSCALE_X] == 1 && mValues[MSCALE_Y] == 1 && mValues[MPERSP_2] == 1 && mValues[MSKEW_X] == 0
               && mValues[MSKEW_Y] == 0 && mValues[MTRANS_X] == 0 && mValues[MTRANS_Y] == 0 && mValues[MPERSP_0] == 0
               && mValues[MPERSP_1] == 0;
    }

    public boolean isAffine()
    {
        return mValues[MPERSP_0] == 0 && mValues[MPERSP_1] == 0 && mValues[MPERSP_2] == 1;
    }

    public boolean rectStaysRect()
    {
        if (!isAffine()) return false;

        boolean axisAligned = NearlyZero(mValues[MSKEW_X]) && NearlyZero(mValues[MSKEW_Y]);
        boolean quarterTurned = NearlyZero(mValues[MSCALE_X]) && NearlyZero(mValues[MSCALE_Y]);

        return axisAligned || quarterTurned;
    }

    private static boolean NearlyZero(float value)
    {
        return Math.abs(value) < NEARLY_ZERO;
    }

    private static void Multiply(float[] first, float[] second, float[] into)
    {
        float scaleX = first[MSCALE_X] * second[MSCALE_X] + first[MSKEW_X] * second[MSKEW_Y] + first[MTRANS_X] * second[MPERSP_0];
        float skewX = first[MSCALE_X] * second[MSKEW_X] + first[MSKEW_X] * second[MSCALE_Y] + first[MTRANS_X] * second[MPERSP_1];
        float translateX = first[MSCALE_X] * second[MTRANS_X] + first[MSKEW_X] * second[MTRANS_Y] + first[MTRANS_X] * second[MPERSP_2];

        float skewY = first[MSKEW_Y] * second[MSCALE_X] + first[MSCALE_Y] * second[MSKEW_Y] + first[MTRANS_Y] * second[MPERSP_0];
        float scaleY = first[MSKEW_Y] * second[MSKEW_X] + first[MSCALE_Y] * second[MSCALE_Y] + first[MTRANS_Y] * second[MPERSP_1];
        float translateY = first[MSKEW_Y] * second[MTRANS_X] + first[MSCALE_Y] * second[MTRANS_Y] + first[MTRANS_Y] * second[MPERSP_2];

        float perspectiveX = first[MPERSP_0] * second[MSCALE_X] + first[MPERSP_1] * second[MSKEW_Y] + first[MPERSP_2] * second[MPERSP_0];
        float perspectiveY = first[MPERSP_0] * second[MSKEW_X] + first[MPERSP_1] * second[MSCALE_Y] + first[MPERSP_2] * second[MPERSP_1];
        float perspectiveW = first[MPERSP_0] * second[MTRANS_X] + first[MPERSP_1] * second[MTRANS_Y] + first[MPERSP_2] * second[MPERSP_2];

        into[MSCALE_X] = scaleX;
        into[MSKEW_X] = skewX;
        into[MTRANS_X] = translateX;
        into[MSKEW_Y] = skewY;
        into[MSCALE_Y] = scaleY;
        into[MTRANS_Y] = translateY;
        into[MPERSP_0] = perspectiveX;
        into[MPERSP_1] = perspectiveY;
        into[MPERSP_2] = perspectiveW;
    }

    public boolean setConcat(Matrix first, Matrix second)
    {
        if (first == null || second == null) return false;

        Multiply(first.mValues, second.mValues, mValues);
        return true;
    }

    public boolean preConcat(Matrix other)
    {
        if (other == null) return false;

        Multiply(mValues, other.mValues, mValues);
        return true;
    }

    public boolean postConcat(Matrix other)
    {
        if (other == null) return false;

        Multiply(other.mValues, mValues, mValues);
        return true;
    }

    public void setTranslate(float dx, float dy)
    {
        reset();
        mValues[MTRANS_X] = dx;
        mValues[MTRANS_Y] = dy;
    }

    public void setScale(float sx, float sy)
    {
        reset();
        mValues[MSCALE_X] = sx;
        mValues[MSCALE_Y] = sy;
    }

    public void setScale(float sx, float sy, float pivotX, float pivotY)
    {
        reset();
        mValues[MSCALE_X] = sx;
        mValues[MSCALE_Y] = sy;
        mValues[MTRANS_X] = pivotX - sx * pivotX;
        mValues[MTRANS_Y] = pivotY - sy * pivotY;
    }

    public void setRotate(float degrees)
    {
        float radians = degrees * DEGREES_TO_RADIANS;

        setSinCos((float) Math.sin(radians), (float) Math.cos(radians));
    }

    public void setRotate(float degrees, float pivotX, float pivotY)
    {
        setRotate(degrees);
        mValues[MTRANS_X] = pivotX - mValues[MSCALE_X] * pivotX - mValues[MSKEW_X] * pivotY;
        mValues[MTRANS_Y] = pivotY - mValues[MSKEW_Y] * pivotX - mValues[MSCALE_Y] * pivotY;
    }

    public void setSkew(float kx, float ky)
    {
        reset();
        mValues[MSKEW_X] = kx;
        mValues[MSKEW_Y] = ky;
    }

    public void setSkew(float kx, float ky, float pivotX, float pivotY)
    {
        setSkew(kx, ky);
        mValues[MTRANS_X] = -kx * pivotY;
        mValues[MTRANS_Y] = -ky * pivotX;
    }

    public void setSinCos(float sinValue, float cosValue)
    {
        reset();
        mValues[MSCALE_X] = cosValue;
        mValues[MSKEW_X] = -sinValue;
        mValues[MSKEW_Y] = sinValue;
        mValues[MSCALE_Y] = cosValue;
    }

    public void setSinCos(float sinValue, float cosValue, float pivotX, float pivotY)
    {
        setSinCos(sinValue, cosValue);
        mValues[MTRANS_X] = pivotX - cosValue * pivotX + sinValue * pivotY;
        mValues[MTRANS_Y] = pivotY - sinValue * pivotX - cosValue * pivotY;
    }

    private boolean preOperation(Matrix operation)
    {
        Multiply(mValues, operation.mValues, mValues);
        return true;
    }

    private boolean postOperation(Matrix operation)
    {
        Multiply(operation.mValues, mValues, mValues);
        return true;
    }

    public boolean preTranslate(float dx, float dy)
    {
        Matrix step = new Matrix();
        step.setTranslate(dx, dy);

        return preOperation(step);
    }

    public boolean postTranslate(float dx, float dy)
    {
        Matrix step = new Matrix();
        step.setTranslate(dx, dy);

        return postOperation(step);
    }

    public boolean preScale(float sx, float sy)
    {
        Matrix step = new Matrix();
        step.setScale(sx, sy);

        return preOperation(step);
    }

    public boolean preScale(float sx, float sy, float pivotX, float pivotY)
    {
        Matrix step = new Matrix();
        step.setScale(sx, sy, pivotX, pivotY);

        return preOperation(step);
    }

    public boolean postScale(float sx, float sy)
    {
        Matrix step = new Matrix();
        step.setScale(sx, sy);

        return postOperation(step);
    }

    public boolean postScale(float sx, float sy, float pivotX, float pivotY)
    {
        Matrix step = new Matrix();
        step.setScale(sx, sy, pivotX, pivotY);

        return postOperation(step);
    }

    public boolean preRotate(float degrees)
    {
        Matrix step = new Matrix();
        step.setRotate(degrees);

        return preOperation(step);
    }

    public boolean preRotate(float degrees, float pivotX, float pivotY)
    {
        Matrix step = new Matrix();
        step.setRotate(degrees, pivotX, pivotY);

        return preOperation(step);
    }

    public boolean postRotate(float degrees)
    {
        Matrix step = new Matrix();
        step.setRotate(degrees);

        return postOperation(step);
    }

    public boolean postRotate(float degrees, float pivotX, float pivotY)
    {
        Matrix step = new Matrix();
        step.setRotate(degrees, pivotX, pivotY);

        return postOperation(step);
    }

    public boolean preSkew(float kx, float ky)
    {
        Matrix step = new Matrix();
        step.setSkew(kx, ky);

        return preOperation(step);
    }

    public boolean preSkew(float kx, float ky, float pivotX, float pivotY)
    {
        Matrix step = new Matrix();
        step.setSkew(kx, ky, pivotX, pivotY);

        return preOperation(step);
    }

    public boolean postSkew(float kx, float ky)
    {
        Matrix step = new Matrix();
        step.setSkew(kx, ky);

        return postOperation(step);
    }

    public boolean postSkew(float kx, float ky, float pivotX, float pivotY)
    {
        Matrix step = new Matrix();
        step.setSkew(kx, ky, pivotX, pivotY);

        return postOperation(step);
    }

    public boolean invert(Matrix inverse)
    {
        if (inverse == null) return false;

        float scaleX = mValues[MSCALE_X];
        float skewX = mValues[MSKEW_X];
        float translateX = mValues[MTRANS_X];
        float skewY = mValues[MSKEW_Y];
        float scaleY = mValues[MSCALE_Y];
        float translateY = mValues[MTRANS_Y];
        float perspectiveX = mValues[MPERSP_0];
        float perspectiveY = mValues[MPERSP_1];
        float perspectiveW = mValues[MPERSP_2];

        float cofactorA = scaleY * perspectiveW - translateY * perspectiveY;
        float cofactorB = translateY * perspectiveX - skewY * perspectiveW;
        float cofactorC = skewY * perspectiveY - scaleY * perspectiveX;

        float determinant = scaleX * cofactorA + skewX * cofactorB + translateX * cofactorC;
        if (determinant == 0 || Float.isNaN(determinant) || Float.isInfinite(determinant)) return false;

        float reciprocal = 1.0f / determinant;

        float[] result = new float[9];
        result[MSCALE_X] = cofactorA * reciprocal;
        result[MSKEW_X] = (translateX * perspectiveY - skewX * perspectiveW) * reciprocal;
        result[MTRANS_X] = (skewX * translateY - translateX * scaleY) * reciprocal;
        result[MSKEW_Y] = cofactorB * reciprocal;
        result[MSCALE_Y] = (scaleX * perspectiveW - translateX * perspectiveX) * reciprocal;
        result[MTRANS_Y] = (translateX * skewY - scaleX * translateY) * reciprocal;
        result[MPERSP_0] = cofactorC * reciprocal;
        result[MPERSP_1] = (skewX * perspectiveX - scaleX * perspectiveY) * reciprocal;
        result[MPERSP_2] = (scaleX * scaleY - skewX * skewY) * reciprocal;

        System.arraycopy(result, 0, inverse.mValues, 0, result.length);
        return true;
    }

    public void mapPoints(float[] points)
    {
        if (points != null) mapPoints(points, 0, points, 0, points.length / 2);
    }

    public void mapPoints(float[] destination, float[] source)
    {
        if (destination == null || source == null) return;

        mapPoints(destination, 0, source, 0, Math.min(destination.length, source.length) / 2);
    }

    public void mapPoints(float[] destination, int destinationIndex, float[] source, int sourceIndex, int pointCount)
    {
        if (destination == null || source == null) return;

        for (int index = 0; index < pointCount; index++)
        {
            float x = source[sourceIndex + index * 2];
            float y = source[sourceIndex + index * 2 + 1];

            float mappedX = mValues[MSCALE_X] * x + mValues[MSKEW_X] * y + mValues[MTRANS_X];
            float mappedY = mValues[MSKEW_Y] * x + mValues[MSCALE_Y] * y + mValues[MTRANS_Y];
            float mappedW = mValues[MPERSP_0] * x + mValues[MPERSP_1] * y + mValues[MPERSP_2];

            if (mappedW != 0 && mappedW != 1)
            {
                mappedX /= mappedW;
                mappedY /= mappedW;
            }

            destination[destinationIndex + index * 2] = mappedX;
            destination[destinationIndex + index * 2 + 1] = mappedY;
        }
    }

    public void mapVectors(float[] vectors)
    {
        if (vectors != null) mapVectors(vectors, 0, vectors, 0, vectors.length / 2);
    }

    public void mapVectors(float[] destination, float[] source)
    {
        if (destination == null || source == null) return;

        mapVectors(destination, 0, source, 0, Math.min(destination.length, source.length) / 2);
    }

    public String toShortString()
    {
        return "[" + mValues[MSCALE_X] + ", " + mValues[MSKEW_X] + ", " + mValues[MTRANS_X] + "]["
               + mValues[MSKEW_Y] + ", " + mValues[MSCALE_Y] + ", " + mValues[MTRANS_Y] + "]["
               + mValues[MPERSP_0] + ", " + mValues[MPERSP_1] + ", " + mValues[MPERSP_2] + "]";
    }

    public final void dump(java.io.PrintWriter writer)
    {
        if (writer != null) writer.print(toShortString());
    }

    public void mapVectors(float[] destination, int destinationIndex, float[] source, int sourceIndex, int vectorCount)
    {
        if (destination == null || source == null) return;

        for (int index = 0; index < vectorCount; index++)
        {
            float x = source[sourceIndex + index * 2];
            float y = source[sourceIndex + index * 2 + 1];

            destination[destinationIndex + index * 2] = mValues[MSCALE_X] * x + mValues[MSKEW_X] * y;
            destination[destinationIndex + index * 2 + 1] = mValues[MSKEW_Y] * x + mValues[MSCALE_Y] * y;
        }
    }

    public boolean mapRect(RectF rect)
    {
        return mapRect(rect, rect);
    }

    public boolean mapRect(RectF destination, RectF source)
    {
        if (destination == null || source == null) return false;

        float[] corners = {source.left, source.top, source.right, source.top,
                           source.right, source.bottom, source.left, source.bottom};
        mapPoints(corners);

        float left = corners[0];
        float top = corners[1];
        float right = corners[0];
        float bottom = corners[1];

        for (int index = 2; index < corners.length; index += 2)
        {
            left = Math.min(left, corners[index]);
            right = Math.max(right, corners[index]);
            top = Math.min(top, corners[index + 1]);
            bottom = Math.max(bottom, corners[index + 1]);
        }

        destination.set(left, top, right, bottom);
        return rectStaysRect();
    }

    public float mapRadius(float radius)
    {
        float[] vectors = {radius, 0, 0, radius};
        mapVectors(vectors);

        float first = (float) Math.hypot(vectors[0], vectors[1]);
        float second = (float) Math.hypot(vectors[2], vectors[3]);

        return (float) Math.sqrt(first * second);
    }

    public boolean setPolyToPoly(float[] source, int sourceIndex, float[] destination, int destinationIndex, int pointCount)
    {
        if (pointCount < 0 || pointCount > 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        if (sourceIndex < 0 || sourceIndex + pointCount * 2 > source.length) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException();
        if (destinationIndex < 0 || destinationIndex + pointCount * 2 > destination.length) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException();

        if (pointCount == 0)
        {
            reset();
            return true;
        }

        Matrix sourceBasis = polyBasis(source, sourceIndex, pointCount);
        Matrix destinationBasis = polyBasis(destination, destinationIndex, pointCount);
        if (sourceBasis == null || destinationBasis == null) return false;

        Matrix inverse = new Matrix();
        if (!sourceBasis.invert(inverse)) return false;

        return setConcat(destinationBasis, inverse);
    }

    private static Matrix polyBasis(float[] points, int offset, int count)
    {
        float x0 = points[offset];
        float y0 = points[offset + 1];
        float[] values;

        if (count == 1)
        {
            values = new float[] {1, 0, x0, 0, 1, y0, 0, 0, 1};
        }
        else if (count == 2)
        {
            float dx = points[offset + 2] - x0;
            float dy = points[offset + 3] - y0;
            values = new float[] {dx, -dy, x0, dy, dx, y0, 0, 0, 1};
        }
        else if (count == 3)
        {
            values = new float[] {points[offset + 2] - x0, points[offset + 4] - x0, x0, points[offset + 3] - y0,
                                  points[offset + 5] - y0, y0, 0, 0, 1};
        }
        else
        {
            float x1 = points[offset + 2];
            float y1 = points[offset + 3];
            float x2 = points[offset + 4];
            float y2 = points[offset + 5];
            float x3 = points[offset + 6];
            float y3 = points[offset + 7];
            float sumX = x0 - x1 + x2 - x3;
            float sumY = y0 - y1 + y2 - y3;

            if (NearlyZero(sumX) && NearlyZero(sumY))
            {
                values = new float[] {x1 - x0, x3 - x0, x0, y1 - y0, y3 - y0, y0, 0, 0, 1};
            }
            else
            {
                float deltaX1 = x1 - x2;
                float deltaX2 = x3 - x2;
                float deltaY1 = y1 - y2;
                float deltaY2 = y3 - y2;
                float determinant = deltaX1 * deltaY2 - deltaX2 * deltaY1;
                if (determinant == 0) return null;

                float perspectiveX = (sumX * deltaY2 - deltaX2 * sumY) / determinant;
                float perspectiveY = (deltaX1 * sumY - sumX * deltaY1) / determinant;
                values = new float[] {x1 - x0 + perspectiveX * x1, x3 - x0 + perspectiveY * x3, x0, y1 - y0 + perspectiveX * y1,
                                      y3 - y0 + perspectiveY * y3, y0, perspectiveX, perspectiveY, 1};
            }
        }

        Matrix basis = new Matrix();
        basis.setValues(values);
        return basis;
    }

    public boolean setRectToRect(RectF source, RectF destination, ScaleToFit fit)
    {
        if (source == null || destination == null) return false;

        if (source.isEmpty())
        {
            reset();
            return false;
        }

        if (destination.isEmpty())
        {
            setScale(0, 0);
            return true;
        }

        float scaleX = destination.width() / source.width();
        float scaleY = destination.height() / source.height();
        float translateX = destination.left - source.left * scaleX;
        float translateY = destination.top - source.top * scaleY;

        if (fit != null && fit != ScaleToFit.FILL)
        {
            float uniform = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY);
            float spareX = destination.width() - source.width() * uniform;
            float spareY = destination.height() - source.height() * uniform;

            float offsetX = fit == ScaleToFit.START ? 0 : (fit == ScaleToFit.END ? spareX : spareX * 0.5f);
            float offsetY = fit == ScaleToFit.START ? 0 : (fit == ScaleToFit.END ? spareY : spareY * 0.5f);

            scaleX = uniform;
            scaleY = uniform;
            translateX = destination.left - source.left * uniform + offsetX;
            translateY = destination.top - source.top * uniform + offsetY;
        }

        reset();
        mValues[MSCALE_X] = scaleX;
        mValues[MSCALE_Y] = scaleY;
        mValues[MTRANS_X] = translateX;
        mValues[MTRANS_Y] = translateY;

        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof Matrix)) return false;

        return java.util.Arrays.equals(mValues, ((Matrix) other).mValues);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return java.util.Arrays.hashCode(mValues);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Matrix{" + java.util.Arrays.toString(mValues) + "}";
    }

    public enum ScaleToFit
    {
        FILL,
        START,
        CENTER,
        END
    }
}
```

`java/android/graphics/Mesh.java`:

```java
package android.graphics;

import java.nio.Buffer;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.nio.FloatBuffer;
import java.nio.ShortBuffer;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class Mesh
{
    public static final int TRIANGLES = 0;
    public static final int TRIANGLE_STRIP = 1;

    private final MeshSpecification mSpecification;
    private final int mMode;
    private final Buffer mVertexBuffer;
    private final int mVertexCount;
    private final ShortBuffer mIndexBuffer;
    private final RectF mBounds;
    private final Map<String, float[]> mFloatUniforms = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, int[]> mIntUniforms = new HashMap<>();

    public Mesh(MeshSpecification meshSpec, int mode, Buffer vertexBuffer, int vertexCount, RectF bounds)
    {
        this(meshSpec, mode, vertexBuffer, vertexCount, null, bounds);
    }

    public Mesh(MeshSpecification meshSpec, int mode, Buffer vertexBuffer, int vertexCount, ShortBuffer indexBuffer, RectF bounds)
    {
        if (meshSpec == null || vertexBuffer == null || bounds == null) throw new NullPointerException("Mesh arguments must not be null");
        if (mode != TRIANGLES && mode != TRIANGLE_STRIP) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid value passed in for mode parameter");
        if (vertexCount < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("vertexCount must not be negative");

        mSpecification = meshSpec;
        mMode = mode;
        mVertexBuffer = vertexBuffer;
        mVertexCount = vertexCount;
        mIndexBuffer = indexBuffer;
        mBounds = new RectF(bounds);
    }

    public void setColorUniform(String uniformName, int color)
    {
        setFloatUniform(uniformName, Color.red(color) / 255.0f, Color.green(color) / 255.0f, Color.blue(color) / 255.0f,
                        Color.alpha(color) / 255.0f);
    }

    public void setColorUniform(String uniformName, long color)
    {
        setFloatUniform(uniformName, Color.red(color), Color.green(color), Color.blue(color), Color.alpha(color));
    }

    public void setColorUniform(String uniformName, Color color)
    {
        if (color == null) throw new NullPointerException("The color parameter must not be null");

        setFloatUniform(uniformName, color.red(), color.green(), color.blue(), color.alpha());
    }

    public void setFloatUniform(String uniformName, float value)
    {
        setFloatUniform(uniformName, new float[] {value});
    }

    public void setFloatUniform(String uniformName, float value1, float value2)
    {
        setFloatUniform(uniformName, new float[] {value1, value2});
    }

    public void setFloatUniform(String uniformName, float value1, float value2, float value3)
    {
        setFloatUniform(uniformName, new float[] {value1, value2, value3});
    }

    public void setFloatUniform(String uniformName, float value1, float value2, float value3, float value4)
    {
        setFloatUniform(uniformName, new float[] {value1, value2, value3, value4});
    }

    public void setFloatUniform(String uniformName, float[] values)
    {
        if (uniformName == null) throw new NullPointerException("The uniformName parameter must not be null");
        if (values == null) throw new NullPointerException("The uniform values parameter must not be null");

        mFloatUniforms.put(uniformName, values.clone());
    }

    public void setIntUniform(String uniformName, int value)
    {
        setIntUniform(uniformName, new int[] {value});
    }

    public void setIntUniform(String uniformName, int value1, int value2)
    {
        setIntUniform(uniformName, new int[] {value1, value2});
    }

    public void setIntUniform(String uniformName, int value1, int value2, int value3)
    {
        setIntUniform(uniformName, new int[] {value1, value2, value3});
    }

    public void setIntUniform(String uniformName, int value1, int value2, int value3, int value4)
    {
        setIntUniform(uniformName, new int[] {value1, value2, value3, value4});
    }

    public void setIntUniform(String uniformName, int[] values)
    {
        if (uniformName == null) throw new NullPointerException("The uniformName parameter must not be null");
        if (values == null) throw new NullPointerException("The uniform values parameter must not be null");

        mIntUniforms.put(uniformName, values.clone());
    }

    RectF bounds()
    {
        return mBounds;
    }

    Path trianglePath()
    {
        MeshSpecification.Attribute position = mSpecification.positionAttribute();
        if (position == null || mVertexCount <= 0) return null;

        float[] vertices = readPositions(position.getOffset());
        if (vertices == null) return null;

        int[] order;
        if (mIndexBuffer != null)
        {
            ShortBuffer indices = mIndexBuffer.duplicate();
            indices.rewind();
            order = new int[indices.remaining()];
            for (int index = 0; index < order.length; index++) order[index] = indices.get() & 0xFFFF;
        }
        else
        {
            order = new int[mVertexCount];
            for (int index = 0; index < order.length; index++) order[index] = index;
        }

        Path path = new Path();
        int triangles = mMode == TRIANGLES ? order.length / 3 : Math.max(0, order.length - 2);

        for (int triangle = 0; triangle < triangles; triangle++)
        {
            int first = mMode == TRIANGLES ? order[triangle * 3] : order[triangle];
            int second = mMode == TRIANGLES ? order[triangle * 3 + 1] : order[triangle + 1];
            int third = mMode == TRIANGLES ? order[triangle * 3 + 2] : order[triangle + 2];

            if (first >= mVertexCount || second >= mVertexCount || third >= mVertexCount) continue;

            path.moveTo(vertices[first * 2], vertices[first * 2 + 1]);
            path.lineTo(vertices[second * 2], vertices[second * 2 + 1]);
            path.lineTo(vertices[third * 2], vertices[third * 2 + 1]);
            path.close();
        }

        return path;
    }

    private float[] readPositions(int offset)
    {
        int stride = mSpecification.vertexStride();
        float[] vertices = new float[mVertexCount * 2];

        if (mVertexBuffer instanceof ByteBuffer)
        {
            ByteBuffer bytes = ((ByteBuffer) mVertexBuffer).duplicate().order(ByteOrder.nativeOrder());
            int base = bytes.position();

            for (int vertex = 0; vertex < mVertexCount; vertex++)
            {
                int at = base + vertex * stride + offset;
                if (at + 8 > bytes.limit()) return null;

                vertices[vertex * 2] = bytes.getFloat(at);
                vertices[vertex * 2 + 1] = bytes.getFloat(at + 4);
            }

            return vertices;
        }

        if (mVertexBuffer instanceof FloatBuffer)
        {
            FloatBuffer floats = ((FloatBuffer) mVertexBuffer).duplicate();
            int base = floats.position();
            int floatStride = stride / 4;
            int floatOffset = offset / 4;

            for (int vertex = 0; vertex < mVertexCount; vertex++)
            {
                int at = base + vertex * floatStride + floatOffset;
                if (at + 2 > floats.limit()) return null;

                vertices[vertex * 2] = floats.get(at);
                vertices[vertex * 2 + 1] = floats.get(at + 1);
            }

            return vertices;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

`java/android/graphics/MeshSpecification.java`:

```java
package android.graphics;

public class MeshSpecification
{
    public static final int ALPHA_TYPE_UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final int ALPHA_TYPE_OPAQUE = 1;
    public static final int ALPHA_TYPE_PREMULTIPLIED = 2;
    public static final int ALPHA_TYPE_UNPREMULTIPLIED = 3;

    public static final int TYPE_FLOAT = 0;
    public static final int TYPE_FLOAT2 = 1;
    public static final int TYPE_FLOAT3 = 2;
    public static final int TYPE_FLOAT4 = 3;
    public static final int TYPE_UBYTE4 = 4;

    private static final int MAXIMUM_ATTRIBUTES = 8;
    private static final int MAXIMUM_VARYINGS = 6;
    private static final int MAXIMUM_STRIDE = 1024;

    private Attribute[] mAttributes;
    private int mVertexStride;
    private Varying[] mVaryings;
    private String mVertexShader;
    private String mFragmentShader;
    private ColorSpace mColorSpace;
    private int mAlphaType;

    MeshSpecification()
    {
    }

    public static class Attribute
    {
        private final int mType;
        private final int mOffset;
        private final String mName;

        public Attribute(int type, int offset, String name)
        {
            if (name == null) throw new NullPointerException("name must not be null");

            mType = type;
            mOffset = offset;
            mName = name;
        }

        public int getType()
        {
            return mType;
        }

        public int getOffset()
        {
            return mOffset;
        }

        public String getName()
        {
            return mName;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "Attribute{mType=" + mType + ", mOffset=" + mOffset + ", mName='" + mName + "'}";
        }
    }

    public static class Varying
    {
        private final int mType;
        private final String mName;

        public Varying(int type, String name)
        {
            if (name == null) throw new NullPointerException("name must not be null");

            mType = type;
            mName = name;
        }

        public int getType()
        {
            return mType;
        }

        public String getName()
        {
            return mName;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "Varying{mType=" + mType + ", mName='" + mName + "'}";
        }
    }

    public static MeshSpecification make(Attribute[] attributes, int vertexStride, Varying[] varyings, String vertexShader,
                                         String fragmentShader)
    {
        return make(attributes, vertexStride, varyings, vertexShader, fragmentShader, ColorSpace.get(ColorSpace.Named.SRGB),
                    ALPHA_TYPE_PREMULTIPLIED);
    }

    public static MeshSpecification make(Attribute[] attributes, int vertexStride, Varying[] varyings, String vertexShader,
                                         String fragmentShader, ColorSpace colorSpace)
    {
        return make(attributes, vertexStride, varyings, vertexShader, fragmentShader, colorSpace, ALPHA_TYPE_PREMULTIPLIED);
    }

    public static MeshSpecification make(Attribute[] attributes, int vertexStride, Varying[] varyings, String vertexShader,
                                         String fragmentShader, ColorSpace colorSpace, int alphaType)
    {
        if (attributes == null || varyings == null || vertexShader == null || fragmentShader == null || colorSpace == null)
        {
            throw new NullPointerException("MeshSpecification arguments must not be null");
        }

        if (attributes.length == 0 || attributes.length > MAXIMUM_ATTRIBUTES)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("A mesh specification needs between 1 and 8 attributes");
        }

        if (varyings.length > MAXIMUM_VARYINGS) throw new IllegalArgumentException("A mesh specification allows at most 6 varyings");
        if (vertexStride <= 0 || vertexStride > MAXIMUM_STRIDE || vertexStride % 4 != 0)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("vertexStride must be a positive multiple of 4 no larger than 1024");
        }

        if (alphaType < ALPHA_TYPE_UNKNOWN || alphaType > ALPHA_TYPE_UNPREMULTIPLIED)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown alpha type " + alphaType);
        }

        MeshSpecification specification = new MeshSpecification();
        specification.mAttributes = attributes.clone();
        specification.mVertexStride = vertexStride;
        specification.mVaryings = varyings.clone();
        specification.mVertexShader = vertexShader;
        specification.mFragmentShader = fragmentShader;
        specification.mColorSpace = colorSpace;
        specification.mAlphaType = alphaType;

        return specification;
    }

    int vertexStride()
    {
        return mVertexStride;
    }

    Attribute positionAttribute()
    {
        Attribute fallback = null;

        for (Attribute attribute : mAttributes)
        {
            if (attribute.getType() != TYPE_FLOAT2) continue;
            if (attribute.getName().contains("osition")) return attribute;
            if (fallback == null) fallback = attribute;
        }

        return fallback;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;

public class Movie
{
    private final Bitmap mFrame;
    private int mTime;

    private Movie(Bitmap frame)
    {
        mFrame = frame;
    }

    public int width()
    {
        return mFrame.getWidth();
    }

    public int height()
    {
        return mFrame.getHeight();
    }

    public boolean isOpaque()
    {
        return !mFrame.hasAlpha();
    }

    public int duration()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public boolean setTime(int relativeMilliseconds)
    {
        mTime = relativeMilliseconds;
        return true;
    }

    public void draw(Canvas canvas, float x, float y, Paint paint)
    {
        if (canvas != null) canvas.drawBitmap(mFrame, x, y, paint);
    }

    public void draw(Canvas canvas, float x, float y)
    {
        draw(canvas, x, y, null);
    }

    public static Movie decodeStream(InputStream stream)
    {
        if (stream == null) return null;

        try
        {
            ByteArrayOutputStream collected = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            byte[] chunk = new byte[8192];

            int read;
            while ((read = stream.read(chunk)) > 0) collected.write(chunk, 0, read);

            byte[] data = collected.toByteArray();
            return decodeByteArray(data, 0, data.length);
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static Movie decodeByteArray(byte[] data, int offset, int length)
    {
        if (data == null) throw new NullPointerException();
        if (offset < 0 || length < 0 || offset + length > data.length) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException();

        Bitmap frame = BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(data, offset, length);
        return frame == null ? null : new Movie(frame);
    }

    public static Movie decodeFile(String path)
    {
        try (InputStream stream = new FileInputStream(path))
        {
            return decodeStream(stream);
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        super.finalize();
    }
}
```

`java/android/graphics/NinePatch.java`:

```java
package android.graphics;

public class NinePatch
{
    private static final int HEADER_SIZE = 32;

    private final Bitmap mBitmap;
    private final String mName;
    private final int[] mHorizontalDivs;
    private final int[] mVerticalDivs;
    private Paint mPaint;

    public NinePatch(Bitmap bitmap, byte[] chunk)
    {
        this(bitmap, chunk, null);
    }

    public NinePatch(Bitmap bitmap, byte[] chunk, String srcName)
    {
        mBitmap = bitmap;
        mName = srcName;

        int[][] divs = parse(chunk);
        mHorizontalDivs = divs == null ? new int[0] : divs[0];
        mVerticalDivs = divs == null ? new int[0] : divs[1];
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        super.finalize();
    }

    public String getName()
    {
        return mName;
    }

    public Paint getPaint()
    {
        return mPaint;
    }

    public void setPaint(Paint paint)
    {
        mPaint = paint;
    }

    public Bitmap getBitmap()
    {
        return mBitmap;
    }

    public void draw(Canvas canvas, RectF location)
    {
        if (location == null) return;

        drawInto(canvas, location.left, location.top, location.right, location.bottom, mPaint);
    }

    public void draw(Canvas canvas, Rect location)
    {
        draw(canvas, location, mPaint);
    }

    public void draw(Canvas canvas, Rect location, Paint paint)
    {
        if (location == null) return;

        drawInto(canvas, location.left, location.top, location.right, location.bottom, paint);
    }

    public int getDensity()
    {
        return mBitmap.getDensity();
    }

    public int getWidth()
    {
        return mBitmap.getWidth();
    }

    public int getHeight()
    {
        return mBitmap.getHeight();
    }

    public final boolean hasAlpha()
    {
        return mBitmap.hasAlpha();
    }

    public final Region getTransparentRegion(Rect bounds)
    {
        return null;
    }

    public static boolean isNinePatchChunk(byte[] chunk)
    {
        return parse(chunk) != null;
    }

    void drawInto(Canvas canvas, float left, float top, float right, float bottom, Paint paint)
    {
        if (canvas == null || mBitmap == null || right <= left || bottom <= top) return;

        int width = mBitmap.getWidth();
        int height = mBitmap.getHeight();

        float[] sourceX = edges(mHorizontalDivs, width);
        float[] sourceY = edges(mVerticalDivs, height);
        float[] destinationX = stretch(sourceX, mHorizontalDivs, left, right);
        float[] destinationY = stretch(sourceY, mVerticalDivs, top, bottom);

        Rect source = new Rect();
        RectF destination = new RectF();

        for (int row = 0; row + 1 < sourceY.length; row++)
        {
            for (int column = 0; column + 1 < sourceX.length; column++)
            {
                if (sourceX[column + 1] <= sourceX[column] || sourceY[row + 1] <= sourceY[row]) continue;
                if (destinationX[column + 1] <= destinationX[column] || destinationY[row + 1] <= destinationY[row]) continue;

                source.set((int)sourceX[column], (int)sourceY[row], (int)sourceX[column + 1], (int)sourceY[row + 1]);
                destination.set(destinationX[column], destinationY[row], destinationX[column + 1], destinationY[row + 1]);
                canvas.drawBitmap(mBitmap, source, destination, paint);
            }
        }
    }

    private static float[] edges(int[] divs, int size)
    {
        float[] edges = new float[divs.length + 2];
        edges[0] = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index < divs.length; index++) edges[index + 1] = Math.max(0, Math.min(size, divs[index]));

        edges[edges.length - 1] = size;
        return edges;
    }

    private static float[] stretch(float[] source, int[] divs, float start, float end)
    {
        float fixed = 0;
        float stretchable = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index + 1 < source.length; index++)
        {
            float span = source[index + 1] - source[index];

            if ((index & 1) == 1) stretchable += span;
            else fixed += span;
        }

        float available = end - start;
        float fixedScale = fixed > available && fixed > 0 ? available / fixed : 1;
        float remaining = Math.max(0, available - fixed * fixedScale);
        float stretchScale = stretchable > 0 ? remaining / stretchable : 0;

        if (stretchable == 0 && fixed > 0) fixedScale = available / fixed;

        float[] out = new float[source.length];
        out[0] = start;

        for (int index = 0; index + 1 < source.length; index++)
        {
            float span = source[index + 1] - source[index];
            out[index + 1] = out[index] + span * ((index & 1) == 1 ? stretchScale : fixedScale);
        }

        out[out.length - 1] = end;
        return out;
    }

    private static int[][] parse(byte[] chunk)
    {
        if (chunk == null || chunk.length < HEADER_SIZE) return null;

        int horizontalCount = chunk[1] & 0xFF;
        int verticalCount = chunk[2] & 0xFF;
        int colourCount = chunk[3] & 0xFF;

        if ((horizontalCount & 1) != 0 || (verticalCount & 1) != 0) return null;
        if (chunk.length < HEADER_SIZE + (horizontalCount + verticalCount + colourCount) * 4) return null;

        boolean littleEndian = looksLittleEndian(chunk, horizontalCount + verticalCount);

        int[] horizontal = new int[horizontalCount];
        int[] vertical = new int[verticalCount];

        for (int index = 0; index < horizontalCount; index++) horizontal[index] = readInt(chunk, HEADER_SIZE + index * 4, littleEndian);

        for (int index = 0; index < verticalCount; index++)
        {
            vertical[index] = readInt(chunk, HEADER_SIZE + (horizontalCount + index) * 4, littleEndian);
        }

        if (!ascending(horizontal) || !ascending(vertical)) return null;

        return new int[][] {horizontal, vertical};
    }

    private static boolean looksLittleEndian(byte[] chunk, int count)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            int little = readInt(chunk, HEADER_SIZE + index * 4, true);
            if (little < 0 || little > 0xFFFF) return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static int readInt(byte[] data, int offset, boolean littleEndian)
    {
        int first = data[offset] & 0xFF;
        int second = data[offset + 1] & 0xFF;
        int third = data[offset + 2] & 0xFF;
        int fourth = data[offset + 3] & 0xFF;

        if (littleEndian) return first | (second << 8) | (third << 16) | (fourth << 24);

        return (first << 24) | (second << 16) | (third << 8) | fourth;
    }

    private static boolean ascending(int[] values)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < values.length; index++)
        {
            if (values[index] < 0) return false;
            if (index > 0 && values[index] < values[index - 1]) return false;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics;

public final class Outline
{
    public final Rect mRect = new Rect();
    public float mRadius;
    public float mAlpha = 1.0f;
    public Path mPath;

    private boolean mEmpty = true;

    public Outline()
    {
    }

    public Outline(Outline source)
    {
        set(source);
    }

    public void set(Outline source)
    {
        if (source == null) return;

        mRect.set(source.mRect);
        mRadius = source.mRadius;
        mAlpha = source.mAlpha;
        mEmpty = source.mEmpty;
        mPath = source.mPath == null ? null : new Path(source.mPath);
    }

    public void setEmpty()
    {
        mEmpty = true;
        mPath = null;
        mRect.setEmpty();
        mRadius = 0;
    }

    public boolean isEmpty()
    {
        return mEmpty;
    }

    public void setRect(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        setRoundRect(left, top, right, bottom, 0);
    }

    public void setRect(Rect rect)
    {
        if (rect == null) setEmpty();
        else setRect(rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom);
    }

    public void setRoundRect(int left, int top, int right, int bottom, float radius)
    {
        mRect.set(left, top, right, bottom);
        mRadius = radius;
        mPath = null;
        mEmpty = right <= left || bottom <= top;
    }

    public void setRoundRect(Rect rect, float radius)
    {
        if (rect == null) setEmpty();
        else setRoundRect(rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom, radius);
    }

    public void setOval(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        setRoundRect(left, top, right, bottom, Math.min(right - left, bottom - top) / 2.0f);
    }

    public void setOval(Rect rect)
    {
        if (rect == null) setEmpty();
        else setOval(rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom);
    }

    public void setPath(Path path)
    {
        if (path == null || path.isEmpty())
        {
            setEmpty();
            return;
        }

        if (mPath == null) mPath = new Path();
        mPath.set(path);

        RectF bounds = new RectF();
        path.computeBounds(bounds, true);

        mRect.set((int) Math.floor(bounds.left), (int) Math.floor(bounds.top), (int) Math.ceil(bounds.right),
                  (int) Math.ceil(bounds.bottom));
        mRadius = 0;
        mEmpty = false;
    }

    public void setConvexPath(Path convexPath)
    {
        setPath(convexPath);
    }

    public void offset(int dx, int dy)
    {
        mRect.offset(dx, dy);
        if (mPath != null) mPath.offset(dx, dy);
    }

    public void setAlpha(float alpha)
    {
        mAlpha = alpha;
    }

    public float getAlpha()
    {
        return mAlpha;
    }

    public float getRadius()
    {
        return mRadius;
    }

    public boolean getRect(Rect out)
    {
        if (mEmpty || out == null || mPath != null) return false;

        out.set(mRect);
        return true;
    }

    public boolean canClip()
    {
        return !mEmpty;
    }
}
```

```java
public class Paint
{
    public static final int ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG = 0x01;
    public static final int FILTER_BITMAP_FLAG = 0x02;
    public static final int DITHER_FLAG = 0x04;
    public static final int UNDERLINE_TEXT_FLAG = 0x08;
    public static final int STRIKE_THRU_TEXT_FLAG = 0x10;
    public static final int FAKE_BOLD_TEXT_FLAG = 0x20;
    public static final int LINEAR_TEXT_FLAG = 0x40;

    private final float[] mMetricsScratch = new float[5];
    private final int[] mBoundsScratch = new int[4];

    }

    public Paint(int flags)
    {
        mFlags = flags;
    }

    public Paint(Paint from)
    {

    }

    public void set(Paint from)
    {
        if (from == null) return;

        mColor = from.mColor;
        mTextSize = from.mTextSize;
        mTextScaleX = from.mTextScaleX;
        mTextSkewX = from.mTextSkewX;
        mLetterSpacing = from.mLetterSpacing;
        mStrokeWidth = from.mStrokeWidth;
        mStrokeMiter = from.mStrokeMiter;
        mStyle = from.mStyle;
        mStrokeCap = from.mStrokeCap;
        mStrokeJoin = from.mStrokeJoin;
        mTextAlign = from.mTextAlign;
        mTypeface = from.mTypeface;
        mFontFeatureSettings = from.mFontFeatureSettings;
        mShader = from.mShader;
        mColorFilter = from.mColorFilter;
        mBlendMode = from.mBlendMode;
        mMaskFilter = from.mMaskFilter;
        mPathEffect = from.mPathEffect;
        mTextLocale = from.mTextLocale;
        mHinting = from.mHinting;
        mElegantTextHeight = from.mElegantTextHeight;
        mShadowRadius = from.mShadowRadius;
        mShadowDx = from.mShadowDx;
        mShadowDy = from.mShadowDy;
        mShadowColor = from.mShadowColor;
        mWordSpacing = from.mWordSpacing;
        mFontVariationSettings = from.mFontVariationSettings;
        mStartHyphenEdit = from.mStartHyphenEdit;
        mEndHyphenEdit = from.mEndHyphenEdit;
        mStyleId = 0;
    }

    public static final int CURSOR_AFTER = 0;
    public static final int CURSOR_AT_OR_AFTER = 1;
    public static final int CURSOR_BEFORE = 2;
    public static final int CURSOR_AT_OR_BEFORE = 3;
    public static final int CURSOR_AT = 4;

    public static final int START_HYPHEN_EDIT_NO_EDIT = 0;
    public static final int START_HYPHEN_EDIT_INSERT_HYPHEN = 1;
    public static final int START_HYPHEN_EDIT_INSERT_ZWJ = 2;

    public static final int END_HYPHEN_EDIT_NO_EDIT = 0;
    public static final int END_HYPHEN_EDIT_REPLACE_WITH_HYPHEN = 1;
    public static final int END_HYPHEN_EDIT_INSERT_HYPHEN = 2;
    public static final int END_HYPHEN_EDIT_INSERT_ARMENIAN_HYPHEN = 3;
    public static final int END_HYPHEN_EDIT_INSERT_MAQAF = 4;
    public static final int END_HYPHEN_EDIT_INSERT_UCAS_HYPHEN = 5;
    public static final int END_HYPHEN_EDIT_INSERT_ZWJ_AND_HYPHEN = 6;

    private static final float UNDERLINE_POSITION_RATIO = 1.0f / 9.0f;
    private static final float DECORATION_THICKNESS_RATIO = 1.0f / 18.0f;
    private static final float STRIKE_THRU_POSITION_RATIO = -0.27f;

    private float mWordSpacing;
    private String mFontVariationSettings;
    private int mStartHyphenEdit;
    private int mEndHyphenEdit;

    public boolean isLinearText()
    {
        return (mFlags & LINEAR_TEXT_FLAG) != 0;
    }

    }

    public float getUnderlinePosition()
    {
        return mTextSize * UNDERLINE_POSITION_RATIO;
    }

    public float getUnderlineThickness()
```
