```java
        return Math.max(1.0f, mTextSize * DECORATION_THICKNESS_RATIO);
    }

    public float getStrikeThruPosition()
    {
        return mTextSize * STRIKE_THRU_POSITION_RATIO;
    }

    public float getStrikeThruThickness()
    {

    }

    public void setARGB(int alpha, int red, int green, int blue)
    {
        setColor(((alpha & 0xFF) << 24) | ((red & 0xFF) << 16) | ((green & 0xFF) << 8) | (blue & 0xFF));
    }

    public boolean getFillPath(Path source, Path destination)

        return (mShadowRadius > 0 || mShadowDx != 0 || mShadowDy != 0) && (mShadowColor >>> 24) != 0;
    }

    public String getFontVariationSettings()
    {
        return mFontVariationSettings;
    }

    public boolean setFontVariationSettings(String settings)
    {
        String trimmed = settings == null ? null : settings.trim();
        if (trimmed != null && trimmed.isEmpty()) trimmed = null;

        if (trimmed != null)
        {
            for (String entry : trimmed.split(","))
            {
                String part = entry.trim();
                if (part.length() < 7 || (part.charAt(0) != '\'' && part.charAt(0) != '"')) return false;
                if (part.charAt(5) != part.charAt(0)) return false;

                try
                {
                    Float.parseFloat(part.substring(6).trim());
                }
                catch (NumberFormatException exception)
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        mFontVariationSettings = trimmed;
        mStyleId = 0;
        return true;
    }

    public boolean equalsForTextMeasurement(Paint other)
    {
        if (other == null) return false;
        if (other == this) return true;

        return mTextSize == other.mTextSize && mTextScaleX == other.mTextScaleX && mTextSkewX == other.mTextSkewX
            && mLetterSpacing == other.mLetterSpacing && mWordSpacing == other.mWordSpacing && mFlags == other.mFlags
            && mTypeface == other.mTypeface && mStartHyphenEdit == other.mStartHyphenEdit
            && mEndHyphenEdit == other.mEndHyphenEdit && java.util.Objects.equals(mTextLocale, other.mTextLocale)
            && java.util.Objects.equals(mFontFeatureSettings, other.mFontFeatureSettings)
            && java.util.Objects.equals(mFontVariationSettings, other.mFontVariationSettings);
    }

    private static char[] charsOf(CharSequence text, int start, int end)
    {
        char[] chars = new char[end - start];
        for (int index = start; index < end; index++)
        {
            chars[index - start] = text.charAt(index);
        }

        return chars;
    }

    private static void checkRange(int length, int start, int end)
    {
        if ((start | end | (end - start) | (length - end)) < 0) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
    }

    public float measureText(String text, int start, int end)
    {
        if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("text cannot be null");
        checkRange(text.length(), start, end);

        return measureText((CharSequence) text, start, end);
    }

    public int breakText(CharSequence text, int start, int end, boolean measureForwards, float maxWidth, float[] measuredWidth)
    {
        if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("text cannot be null");
        checkRange(text.length(), start, end);
        if (end == start) return 0;

        return breakText(charsOf(text, start, end), 0, end - start, maxWidth, measureForwards, measuredWidth);
    }

    public int getTextWidths(CharSequence text, int start, int end, float[] widths)
    {
        if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("text cannot be null");
        checkRange(text.length(), start, end);
        if (end - start > widths.length) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException();
        if (end == start) return 0;

        return getTextWidths(charsOf(text, start, end), 0, end - start, widths);
    }

    public float getTextRunAdvances(char[] chars, int index, int count, int contextIndex, int contextCount, boolean isRtl,
                                    float[] advances, int advancesIndex)
    {
        if (chars == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("text cannot be null");
        if ((index | count | contextIndex | contextCount | advancesIndex | (index - contextIndex)
             | (contextCount - count) | ((contextIndex + contextCount) - (index + count))
             | (chars.length - (contextIndex + contextCount))
             | (advances == null ? 0 : (advances.length - (advancesIndex + count)))) < 0)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
        }

        if (count == 0) return 0;

        float[] widths = new float[count];
        getTextWidths(chars, index, count, widths);

        float total = 0;
        for (int offset = 0; offset < count; offset++)
        {
            total += widths[offset];
            if (advances != null) advances[advancesIndex + offset] = widths[offset];
        }

        return total;
    }

    public int getTextRunCursor(char[] text, int contextStart, int contextLength, boolean isRtl, int offset, int cursorOpt)
    {
        int contextEnd = contextStart + contextLength;
        if (((contextStart | contextEnd | offset | (contextEnd - contextStart) | (offset - contextStart) | (contextEnd - offset)
              | (text.length - contextEnd) | cursorOpt) < 0) || cursorOpt > CURSOR_AT)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
        }

        return runCursor(new String(text, contextStart, contextLength), offset - contextStart, cursorOpt, contextStart);
    }

    public int getTextRunCursor(CharSequence text, int contextStart, int contextEnd, boolean isRtl, int offset, int cursorOpt)
    {
        if (((contextStart | contextEnd | offset | (contextEnd - contextStart) | (offset - contextStart) | (contextEnd - offset)
              | (text.length() - contextEnd) | cursorOpt) < 0) || cursorOpt > CURSOR_AT)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
        }

        return runCursor(text.subSequence(contextStart, contextEnd).toString(), offset - contextStart, cursorOpt, contextStart);
    }

    private static boolean isCursorBoundary(String text, int position)
    {
        if (position <= 0 || position >= text.length()) return true;

        return !(Character.isHighSurrogate(text.charAt(position - 1)) && Character.isLowSurrogate(text.charAt(position)));
    }

    private static int runCursor(String text, int offset, int cursorOpt, int base)
    {
        int length = text.length();

        switch (cursorOpt)
        {
            case CURSOR_AT:
                return isCursorBoundary(text, offset) ? offset + base : -1;
            case CURSOR_AT_OR_AFTER:
                if (isCursorBoundary(text, offset)) return offset + base;
                return Math.min(length, offset + 1) + base;
            case CURSOR_AT_OR_BEFORE:
                if (isCursorBoundary(text, offset)) return offset + base;
                return Math.max(0, offset - 1) + base;
            case CURSOR_AFTER:
            {
                if (offset >= length) return -1;
                int next = offset + 1;
                while (next < length && !isCursorBoundary(text, next)) next++;
                return next + base;
            }
            default:
            {
                if (offset <= 0) return -1;
                int previous = offset - 1;
                while (previous > 0 && !isCursorBoundary(text, previous)) previous--;
                return previous + base;
            }
        }
    }

    public void getTextPath(char[] text, int index, int count, float x, float y, Path path)
    {
        if ((index | count) < 0 || index + count > text.length) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException();
        if (path == null) return;

        path.reset();
        if (count == 0) return;

        float[] widths = new float[count];
        getTextWidths(text, index, count, widths);

        float total = 0;
        for (float width : widths) total += width;

        float cursor = x;
        if (mTextAlign == Align.CENTER) cursor -= total * 0.5f;
        else if (mTextAlign == Align.RIGHT) cursor -= total;

        Rect glyph = new Rect();
        for (int offset = 0; offset < count; offset++)
        {
            char character = text[index + offset];

            if (!Character.isWhitespace(character) && !Character.isLowSurrogate(character))
            {
                int glyphLength = Character.isHighSurrogate(character) && offset + 1 < count ? 2 : 1;
                getTextBounds(text, index + offset, glyphLength, glyph);

                if (!glyph.isEmpty())
                {
                    path.addRect(cursor + glyph.left, y + glyph.top, cursor + glyph.right, y + glyph.bottom, Path.Direction.CW);
                }
            }

            cursor += widths[offset];
        }
    }

    public void getTextPath(String text, int start, int end, float x, float y, Path path)
    {
        if ((start | end | (end - start) | (text.length() - end)) < 0) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();

        getTextPath(text.toCharArray(), start, end - start, x, y, path);
    }

    public float getRunAdvance(CharSequence text, int start, int end, int contextStart, int contextEnd, boolean isRtl, int offset)
    {
        if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("text cannot be null");
        if ((contextStart | start | offset | end | contextEnd | (start - contextStart) | (offset - start) | (end - offset)
             | (contextEnd - end) | (text.length() - contextEnd)) < 0)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
        }

        if (end == start) return 0.0f;

        return measureText(text, start, offset);
    }

    public float getRunCharacterAdvance(char[] text, int start, int end, int contextStart, int contextEnd, boolean isRtl,
                                        int offset, float[] advances, int advancesIndex)
    {
        if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("text cannot be null");
        if ((contextStart | start | offset | end | contextEnd | (start - contextStart) | (offset - start) | (end - offset)
             | (contextEnd - end) | (text.length - contextEnd)) < 0)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
        }

        if (end == start) return 0.0f;

        float[] widths = new float[end - start];
        getTextWidths(text, start, end - start, widths);

        if (advances != null)
        {
            if (advancesIndex < 0 || advancesIndex + widths.length > advances.length) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
            System.arraycopy(widths, 0, advances, advancesIndex, widths.length);
        }

        float total = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < offset - start; index++) total += widths[index];

        return total;
    }

    public float getRunCharacterAdvance(CharSequence text, int start, int end, int contextStart, int contextEnd, boolean isRtl,
                                        int offset, float[] advances, int advancesIndex)
    {
        if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("text cannot be null");
        if ((contextStart | contextEnd | (contextEnd - contextStart) | (text.length() - contextEnd)) < 0)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
        }

        char[] chars = charsOf(text, contextStart, contextEnd);
        return getRunCharacterAdvance(chars, start - contextStart, end - contextStart, 0, contextEnd - contextStart, isRtl,
                                      offset - contextStart, advances, advancesIndex);
    }

    public int getOffsetForAdvance(char[] text, int start, int end, int contextStart, int contextEnd, boolean isRtl,
                                   float advance)
    {
        if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("text cannot be null");
        if ((contextStart | start | end | contextEnd | (start - contextStart) | (end - start) | (contextEnd - end)
             | (text.length - contextEnd)) < 0)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
        }

        if (end == start || advance <= 0) return start;

        float[] widths = new float[end - start];
        getTextWidths(text, start, end - start, widths);

        float walked = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < widths.length; index++)
        {
            float next = walked + widths[index];

            if (next >= advance)
            {
                int candidate = advance - walked < next - advance ? start + index : start + index + 1;
                if (candidate > start && candidate < end && Character.isLowSurrogate(text[candidate])) candidate--;
                return candidate;
            }

            walked = next;
        }

        return end;
    }

    public int getOffsetForAdvance(CharSequence text, int start, int end, int contextStart, int contextEnd, boolean isRtl,
                                   float advance)
    {
        if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("text cannot be null");
        if ((contextStart | start | end | contextEnd | (start - contextStart) | (end - start) | (contextEnd - end)
             | (text.length() - contextEnd)) < 0)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
        }

        char[] chars = charsOf(text, contextStart, contextEnd);
        return getOffsetForAdvance(chars, start - contextStart, end - contextStart, 0, contextEnd - contextStart, isRtl, advance)
            + contextStart;
    }

    int[] snapshotInts()
    {

    }

    int[] snapshotInts(int styleOverride)
    {
        int color = mColor;

        if (mColorFilter != null) color = mColorFilter.apply(color);

        mPaintInts[0] = color;
        mPaintInts[1] = styleOverride >= 0 ? styleOverride : (mStyle == null ? 0 : mStyle.ordinal());
        mPaintInts[2] = mStrokeCap.ordinal();
        mPaintInts[3] = mStrokeJoin.ordinal();
        mPaintInts[4] = mBlendMode.nativeId();
        mPaintInts[5] = 255;
        mPaintInts[6] = mShader == null ? Shader.KIND_NONE : mShader.kind();
        mPaintInts[7] = mShader == null ? 0 : mShader.tileModeId();
        mPaintInts[8] = isFilterBitmap() ? 1 : 0;
        mPaintInts[9] = tintColour();
        mPaintInts[10] = tintsImages() ? 1 : 0;

        return mPaintInts;
    }

    float[] snapshotFloats()
    {
        mPaintFloats[0] = mStrokeWidth;
        mPaintFloats[1] = mStrokeMiter;
        mPaintFloats[2] = mShader == null ? 0 : mShader.startX();
        mPaintFloats[3] = mShader == null ? 0 : mShader.startY();
        mPaintFloats[4] = mShader == null ? 0 : mShader.endX();
        mPaintFloats[5] = mShader == null ? 0 : mShader.endY();
        mPaintFloats[6] = mShader == null ? 0 : mShader.radius();

        Matrix local = mShader == null ? null : mShader.localMatrix();

        float[] values = new float[9];
        (local == null ? Matrix.IDENTITY_MATRIX : local).getValues(values);

        System.arraycopy(values, 0, mPaintFloats, 7, 6);
        return mPaintFloats;
    }

    int[] snapshotStopColors()
    {
        return mShader == null ? null : mShader.stopColors();
    }

    float[] snapshotStopPositions()
    {
        return mShader == null ? null : mShader.stopPositions();
    }

    private int tintColour()
    {
        if (mColorFilter instanceof BlendModeColorFilter) return ((BlendModeColorFilter) mColorFilter).getColor();
        if (mColorFilter instanceof PorterDuffColorFilter) return ((PorterDuffColorFilter) mColorFilter).getColor();
        if (mColorFilter != null) return mColorFilter.imageTint();

        return 0;
    }

    private boolean tintsImages()
    {
        if (mColorFilter instanceof BlendModeColorFilter || mColorFilter instanceof PorterDuffColorFilter) return true;

        return mColorFilter != null && mColorFilter.tintsImages();
    }

    float[] dashIntervals(PathEffect effect)
    {
        if (effect instanceof DashPathEffect) return ((DashPathEffect) effect).intervals();
        if (effect instanceof ComposePathEffect) return dashIntervals(((ComposePathEffect) effect).dashSource());
        if (effect instanceof SumPathEffect) return dashIntervals(((SumPathEffect) effect).dashSource());

        return null;
    }

    float dashPhase(PathEffect effect)
    {
        if (effect instanceof DashPathEffect) return ((DashPathEffect) effect).phase();
        if (effect instanceof ComposePathEffect) return dashPhase(((ComposePathEffect) effect).dashSource());
        if (effect instanceof SumPathEffect) return dashPhase(((SumPathEffect) effect).dashSource());

        return 0;
    }

    long shaderBitmap()

        return mShader == null ? 0 : mShader.bitmapHandle();

        return mMaskFilter instanceof BlurMaskFilter ? ((BlurMaskFilter) mMaskFilter).getRadius() : 0;
    }

        return dashIntervals(mPathEffect);
    }

    {
        return dashPhase(mPathEffect);
    }

    public float measureText(CharSequence text, int start, int end)
    {
        if (text == null || end <= start) return 0.0f;

        char[] chars = new char[end - start];
        for (int index = start; index < end; index++)
        {
            chars[index - start] = text.charAt(index);
        }

        return measureText(chars, 0, chars.length);
    }

    public float measureText(char[] text, int index, int count)
    {
        if (text == null || count <= 0) return 0.0f;
        return runtime.TextMeasurers.get().measureText(styleId(), text, index, count);
    }

    public int styleId()
    {
        if (mStyleId != 0) return mStyleId;

        Typeface typeface = mTypeface != null ? mTypeface : Typeface.DEFAULT;
        int font = typeface != null ? typeface.getNativeFont() : 0;
        int flags = isFakeBoldText() ? 1 : 0;

        mStyleId = runtime.TextMeasurers.get().internStyle(font, mTextSize, mTextScaleX, mTextSkewX, mLetterSpacing, flags);
        return mStyleId;
    }

    public FontMetrics getFontMetrics()

        getFontMetrics(metrics);
        return metrics;

    public float getFontMetrics(FontMetrics metrics)
    {
        runtime.TextMeasurers.get().fontMetrics(styleId(), mMetricsScratch);

        if (metrics != null)
        {
            metrics.top = mMetricsScratch[0];
            metrics.ascent = mMetricsScratch[1];
            metrics.descent = mMetricsScratch[2];
            metrics.bottom = mMetricsScratch[3];
            metrics.leading = mMetricsScratch[4];
        }

        return mMetricsScratch[2] - mMetricsScratch[1];
    }

    public FontMetricsInt getFontMetricsInt()
    {
        FontMetricsInt metrics = new FontMetricsInt();
        getFontMetricsInt(metrics);
        return metrics;
    }

    public int getFontMetricsInt(FontMetricsInt metrics)
    {
        runtime.TextMeasurers.get().fontMetrics(styleId(), mMetricsScratch);

        int top = (int)Math.floor(mMetricsScratch[0]);
        int ascent = Math.round(mMetricsScratch[1]);
        int descent = Math.round(mMetricsScratch[2]);
        int bottom = (int)Math.ceil(mMetricsScratch[3]);
        int leading = Math.round(mMetricsScratch[4]);

        if (metrics != null)
        {
            metrics.top = top;
            metrics.ascent = ascent;
            metrics.descent = descent;
            metrics.bottom = bottom;
            metrics.leading = leading;
        }

        return descent - ascent;
    }

    {

        if (measuredWidth != null && measuredWidth.length > 0) measuredWidth[0] = mBreakScratch[0];

    {
        public int top;
        public int ascent;
        public int descent;
        public int bottom;
        public int leading;

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "FontMetricsInt: top=" + top + " ascent=" + ascent + " descent=" + descent + " bottom=" + bottom + " leading="
                + leading;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object other)
        {
            if (this == other) return true;
            if (!(other instanceof FontMetricsInt)) return false;

            FontMetricsInt metrics = (FontMetricsInt) other;
            return top == metrics.top && ascent == metrics.ascent && descent == metrics.descent && bottom == metrics.bottom
                && leading == metrics.leading;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return java.util.Objects.hash(top, ascent, descent, bottom, leading);
        }
    }
```

`java/android/graphics/PaintFlagsDrawFilter.java`:

```java
package android.graphics;

public class PaintFlagsDrawFilter extends DrawFilter
{
    private final int mClearBits;
    private final int mSetBits;

    public PaintFlagsDrawFilter(int clearBits, int setBits)
    {
        mClearBits = clearBits;
        mSetBits = setBits;
    }

    @Override
    Paint filter(Paint paint)
    {
        if (paint == null) return null;

        int flags = (paint.getFlags() & ~mClearBits) | mSetBits;
        if (flags == paint.getFlags()) return paint;

        Paint filtered = new Paint(paint);
        filtered.setFlags(flags);
        return filtered;
    }
}
```

```java
    static final int VERB_MOVE = 0;
    static final int VERB_LINE = 1;
    static final int VERB_QUAD = 2;
    static final int VERB_CUBIC = 3;
    static final int VERB_CLOSE = 4;

    private static final float CIRCLE_KAPPA = 0.5522847498f;

    private final float[] mMatrixScratch = new float[9];

    public boolean isInverseFillType()
    {

    }

    public void toggleInverseFillType()
    {
        switch (mFillType)
        {
            case WINDING:
                setFillType(FillType.INVERSE_WINDING);
                break;
            case EVEN_ODD:
                setFillType(FillType.INVERSE_EVEN_ODD);
                break;
            case INVERSE_WINDING:
                setFillType(FillType.WINDING);
                break;
            default:
                setFillType(FillType.EVEN_ODD);
                break;
        }
    }

    public void conicTo(float controlX, float controlY, float x, float y, float weight)
    {
        if (weight == 1.0f || !(weight > 0.0f) || Float.isInfinite(weight))
        {
            if (weight > 0.0f && !Float.isInfinite(weight)) quadTo(controlX, controlY, x, y);
            else lineTo(x, y);
            return;
        }

        float[] start = lastPoint();
        float scale = 2.0f * weight / (1.0f + weight);
        float firstX = start[0] + (controlX - start[0]) * scale;
        float firstY = start[1] + (controlY - start[1]) * scale;
        float secondX = x + (controlX - x) * scale;
        float secondY = y + (controlY - y) * scale;

        cubicTo(firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, x, y);
    }

    public void cubicTo(float firstX, float firstY, float secondX, float secondY, float x, float y)
    {
        nativeCubicTo(mNativePath, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, x, y);
        recordCubic(firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, x, y);
    }

    public void rMoveTo(float dx, float dy)
    {
        float[] current = currentPoint();
        moveTo(current[0] + dx, current[1] + dy);
    }

    public void rLineTo(float dx, float dy)
    {

        lineTo(current[0] + dx, current[1] + dy);
    }

    public void rQuadTo(float controlDx, float controlDy, float dx, float dy)
    {
        float[] current = currentPoint();

    }

    public void rConicTo(float controlDx, float controlDy, float dx, float dy, float weight)
    {
        float[] current = currentPoint();
        conicTo(current[0] + controlDx, current[1] + controlDy, current[0] + dx, current[1] + dy, weight);
    }

    public void rCubicTo(float firstDx, float firstDy, float secondDx, float secondDy, float dx, float dy)
    {
        float[] current = currentPoint();
        cubicTo(current[0] + firstDx, current[1] + firstDy, current[0] + secondDx, current[1] + secondDy,
                current[0] + dx, current[1] + dy);
    }

    private float[] currentPoint()
    {

    public void addRect(float left, float top, float right, float bottom, Direction direction)

        recordMove(left, top);

        {
            recordLine(left, bottom);
            recordLine(right, bottom);
            recordLine(right, top);

        else

            recordLine(right, bottom);
            recordLine(left, bottom);

    public void addPath(Path source, Matrix matrix)
    {
        if (source == null) return;

        if (matrix == null) new Matrix().getValues(mMatrixScratch);
        else matrix.getValues(mMatrixScratch);

        nativeAddPath(mNativePath, source.mNativePath, mMatrixScratch);

        byte[] verbs = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(source.mVerbs, source.mVerbCount);
        float[] coordinates = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(source.mCoordinates, source.mCoordinateCount);

        if (matrix != null && !matrix.isIdentity() && coordinates.length > 0) matrix.mapPoints(coordinates);

        appendRecord(verbs, coordinates);
    }

    public void transform(Matrix matrix)
    {
        if (matrix == null) return;

        matrix.getValues(mMatrixScratch);
        nativeTransform(mNativePath, mMatrixScratch);

        if (mCoordinateCount > 0)
        {
            float[] mapped = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(mCoordinates, mCoordinateCount);
            matrix.mapPoints(mapped);
            System.arraycopy(mapped, 0, mCoordinates, 0, mCoordinateCount);
        }

        float[] start = {mContourStartX, mContourStartY};
        matrix.mapPoints(start);
        mContourStartX = start[0];
        mContourStartY = start[1];
        mGenerationId++;
    }

    public void transform(Matrix matrix, Path destination)
    {
        if (destination == null)
        {
            transform(matrix);
            return;
        }

        destination.reset();
        destination.addPath(this, matrix);
    }

    }

    public boolean isRect(RectF rect)
    {
        if (mVerbCount < 4 || mVerbs[0] != VERB_MOVE) return false;

        float[] corners = new float[10];
        int cornerCount = 1;
        corners[0] = mCoordinates[0];
        corners[1] = mCoordinates[1];

        int coordinate = 2;
        int verb = 1;

        for (; verb < mVerbCount; verb++)
        {
            if (mVerbs[verb] == VERB_CLOSE) break;
            if (mVerbs[verb] != VERB_LINE || cornerCount >= 5) return false;

            corners[cornerCount * 2] = mCoordinates[coordinate];
            corners[cornerCount * 2 + 1] = mCoordinates[coordinate + 1];
            cornerCount++;
            coordinate += 2;
        }

        if (verb < mVerbCount - 1) return false;

        if (cornerCount == 5)
        {
            if (corners[8] != corners[0] || corners[9] != corners[1]) return false;
            cornerCount = 4;
        }

        if (cornerCount != 4) return false;

        for (int index = 0; index < 4; index++)
        {
            int next = (index + 1) % 4;
            boolean horizontal = corners[index * 2 + 1] == corners[next * 2 + 1];
            boolean vertical = corners[index * 2] == corners[next * 2];

            if (horizontal == vertical) return false;

            int after = (index + 2) % 4;
            boolean nextHorizontal = corners[next * 2 + 1] == corners[after * 2 + 1];
            if (nextHorizontal == horizontal) return false;
        }

        if (rect != null)
        {
            float left = Math.min(Math.min(corners[0], corners[2]), Math.min(corners[4], corners[6]));
            float top = Math.min(Math.min(corners[1], corners[3]), Math.min(corners[5], corners[7]));
            float right = Math.max(Math.max(corners[0], corners[2]), Math.max(corners[4], corners[6]));
            float bottom = Math.max(Math.max(corners[1], corners[3]), Math.max(corners[5], corners[7]));
            rect.set(left, top, right, bottom);
        }

        return true;
    }

    public boolean isConvex()
    {
        if (mVerbCount == 0) return true;

        int moves = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < mVerbCount; index++)
        {
            if (mVerbs[index] == VERB_MOVE && index + 1 < mVerbCount && mVerbs[index + 1] != VERB_MOVE) moves++;
        }

        if (moves > 1) return false;

        float[] points = new float[mCoordinateCount];
        int pointCount = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index + 1 < mCoordinateCount; index += 2)
        {
            float x = mCoordinates[index];
            float y = mCoordinates[index + 1];

            if (pointCount > 0 && points[pointCount * 2 - 2] == x && points[pointCount * 2 - 1] == y) continue;

            points[pointCount * 2] = x;
            points[pointCount * 2 + 1] = y;
            pointCount++;
        }

        if (pointCount > 1 && points[0] == points[pointCount * 2 - 2] && points[1] == points[pointCount * 2 - 1]) pointCount--;
        if (pointCount < 3) return true;

        int sign = 0;
        double turning = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index < pointCount; index++)
        {
            int middle = (index + 1) % pointCount;
            int last = (index + 2) % pointCount;

            float firstX = points[middle * 2] - points[index * 2];
            float firstY = points[middle * 2 + 1] - points[index * 2 + 1];
            float secondX = points[last * 2] - points[middle * 2];
            float secondY = points[last * 2 + 1] - points[middle * 2 + 1];

            float cross = firstX * secondY - firstY * secondX;
            float dot = firstX * secondX + firstY * secondY;

            if (cross != 0)
            {
                int current = cross > 0 ? 1 : -1;
                if (sign != 0 && current != sign) return false;
                sign = current;
            }

            turning += Math.atan2(cross, dot);
        }

        return Math.abs(Math.abs(turning) - 2.0 * Math.PI) < 0.01 || sign == 0;
    }

    public float[] approximate(float acceptableError)
    {
        if (acceptableError < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("AcceptableError must be greater than or equal to 0");

        float tolerance = Math.max(acceptableError, 0.0001f);

        float[] flat = new float[64];
        boolean[] jumps = new boolean[32];
        int flatCount = 0;

        int coordinate = 0;
        float currentX = 0;
        float currentY = 0;
        float startX = 0;
        float startY = 0;

        for (int verb = 0; verb < mVerbCount; verb++)
        {
            int kind = mVerbs[verb];

            if (kind == VERB_MOVE)
            {
                currentX = mCoordinates[coordinate];
                currentY = mCoordinates[coordinate + 1];
                startX = currentX;
                startY = currentY;
                coordinate += 2;

                if (flatCount * 2 + 2 > flat.length)
                {
                    flat = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(flat, flat.length * 2);
                    jumps = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(jumps, jumps.length * 2);
                }

                flat[flatCount * 2] = currentX;
                flat[flatCount * 2 + 1] = currentY;
                jumps[flatCount] = true;
                flatCount++;
                continue;
            }

            float[] segment;

            if (kind == VERB_LINE)
            {
                segment = new float[] {mCoordinates[coordinate], mCoordinates[coordinate + 1]};
                coordinate += 2;
            }
            else if (kind == VERB_QUAD)
            {
                segment = flattenQuad(currentX, currentY, mCoordinates[coordinate], mCoordinates[coordinate + 1],
                                      mCoordinates[coordinate + 2], mCoordinates[coordinate + 3], tolerance);
                coordinate += 4;
            }
            else if (kind == VERB_CUBIC)
            {
                segment = flattenCubic(currentX, currentY, mCoordinates[coordinate], mCoordinates[coordinate + 1],
                                       mCoordinates[coordinate + 2], mCoordinates[coordinate + 3], mCoordinates[coordinate + 4],
                                       mCoordinates[coordinate + 5], tolerance);
                coordinate += 6;
            }
            else
            {
                if (currentX == startX && currentY == startY) continue;
                segment = new float[] {startX, startY};
            }

            if (flatCount == 0)
            {
                flat[0] = currentX;
                flat[1] = currentY;
                jumps[0] = true;
                flatCount = 1;
            }

            int added = segment.length / 2;
            while ((flatCount + added) * 2 > flat.length)
            {
                flat = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(flat, flat.length * 2);
                jumps = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(jumps, jumps.length * 2);
            }

            System.arraycopy(segment, 0, flat, flatCount * 2, segment.length);
            flatCount += added;

            currentX = segment[segment.length - 2];
            currentY = segment[segment.length - 1];
        }

        if (flatCount == 0) return new float[] {0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0};

        float[] distances = new float[flatCount];
        float total = 0;

        for (int index = 1; index < flatCount; index++)
        {
            if (!jumps[index])
            {
                float dx = flat[index * 2] - flat[index * 2 - 2];
                float dy = flat[index * 2 + 1] - flat[index * 2 - 1];
                total += (float) Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
            }

            distances[index] = total;
        }

        int outputCount = flatCount == 1 ? 2 : flatCount;
        float[] result = new float[outputCount * 3];

        for (int index = 0; index < outputCount; index++)
        {
            int source = Math.min(index, flatCount - 1);
            float fraction = total > 0 ? distances[source] / total : (index == outputCount - 1 ? 1 : 0);

            result[index * 3] = index == outputCount - 1 ? 1 : fraction;
            result[index * 3 + 1] = flat[source * 2];
            result[index * 3 + 2] = flat[source * 2 + 1];
        }

        return result;
    }

    public boolean isInterpolatable(Path otherPath)
    {
        if (otherPath == null || otherPath.mVerbCount != mVerbCount || otherPath.mCoordinateCount != mCoordinateCount) return false;

        for (int index = 0; index < mVerbCount; index++)
        {
            if (mVerbs[index] != otherPath.mVerbs[index]) return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public boolean interpolate(Path otherPath, float t, Path interpolatedPath)
    {
        if (interpolatedPath == null || !isInterpolatable(otherPath)) return false;

        float[] blended = new float[mCoordinateCount];
        for (int index = 0; index < mCoordinateCount; index++)
        {
            blended[index] = otherPath.mCoordinates[index] + (mCoordinates[index] - otherPath.mCoordinates[index]) * t;
        }

        byte[] verbs = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(mVerbs, mVerbCount);

        interpolatedPath.reset();
        interpolatedPath.setFillType(mFillType);
        interpolatedPath.replay(verbs, blended);

        return true;
    }

    int verbCount()
    {
        return mVerbCount;
    }

    byte[] verbs()
    {
        return java.util.Arrays.copyOf(mVerbs, mVerbCount);
    }

    float[] coordinates()
    {
        return java.util.Arrays.copyOf(mCoordinates, mCoordinateCount);
    }

    private void replay(byte[] verbs, float[] coordinates)
    {
        int coordinate = 0;

        for (byte verb : verbs)
        {
            switch (verb)
            {
                case VERB_MOVE:
                    moveTo(coordinates[coordinate], coordinates[coordinate + 1]);
                    coordinate += 2;
                    break;
                case VERB_LINE:
                    lineTo(coordinates[coordinate], coordinates[coordinate + 1]);
                    coordinate += 2;
                    break;
                case VERB_QUAD:
                    quadTo(coordinates[coordinate], coordinates[coordinate + 1], coordinates[coordinate + 2],
                           coordinates[coordinate + 3]);
                    coordinate += 4;
                    break;
                case VERB_CUBIC:
                    cubicTo(coordinates[coordinate], coordinates[coordinate + 1], coordinates[coordinate + 2],
                            coordinates[coordinate + 3], coordinates[coordinate + 4], coordinates[coordinate + 5]);
                    coordinate += 6;
                    break;
                default:
                    close();
                    break;
            }
        }
    }

    private static int flattenSteps(float deviation, float tolerance)
    {
        int steps = (int) Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(deviation / tolerance));
        return Math.max(1, Math.min(MAXIMUM_FLATTEN_STEPS, steps));
    }

    private static float[] flattenQuad(float startX, float startY, float controlX, float controlY, float endX, float endY,
                                       float tolerance)
    {
        float deviationX = startX - 2 * controlX + endX;
        float deviationY = startY - 2 * controlY + endY;
        int steps = flattenSteps((float) Math.sqrt(deviationX * deviationX + deviationY * deviationY) * 0.25f, tolerance);

        float[] points = new float[steps * 2];
        for (int step = 1; step <= steps; step++)
        {
            float t = step / (float) steps;
            float inverse = 1 - t;
            points[(step - 1) * 2] = inverse * inverse * startX + 2 * inverse * t * controlX + t * t * endX;
            points[(step - 1) * 2 + 1] = inverse * inverse * startY + 2 * inverse * t * controlY + t * t * endY;
        }

        return points;
    }

    private static float[] flattenCubic(float startX, float startY, float firstX, float firstY, float secondX, float secondY,
                                        float endX, float endY, float tolerance)
    {
        float firstDeviationX = startX - 2 * firstX + secondX;
        float firstDeviationY = startY - 2 * firstY + secondY;
        float secondDeviationX = firstX - 2 * secondX + endX;
        float secondDeviationY = firstY - 2 * secondY + endY;
        float deviation = (float) Math.max(Math.sqrt(firstDeviationX * firstDeviationX + firstDeviationY * firstDeviationY),
                                           Math.sqrt(secondDeviationX * secondDeviationX + secondDeviationY * secondDeviationY));
        int steps = flattenSteps(deviation * 0.75f, tolerance);

        float[] points = new float[steps * 2];
        for (int step = 1; step <= steps; step++)
        {
            float t = step / (float) steps;
            float inverse = 1 - t;
            float a = inverse * inverse * inverse;
            float b = 3 * inverse * inverse * t;
            float c = 3 * inverse * t * t;
            float d = t * t * t;
            points[(step - 1) * 2] = a * startX + b * firstX + c * secondX + d * endX;
            points[(step - 1) * 2 + 1] = a * startY + b * firstY + c * secondY + d * endY;
        }

        return points;
    }

    private float[] lastPoint()
    {
        if (mCoordinateCount < 2) return new float[] {0, 0};

        if (mVerbCount > 0 && mVerbs[mVerbCount - 1] == VERB_CLOSE) return new float[] {mContourStartX, mContourStartY};

        return new float[] {mCoordinates[mCoordinateCount - 2], mCoordinates[mCoordinateCount - 1]};
    }

    private void ensureVerbs(int extra)
    {
        if (mVerbCount + extra > mVerbs.length) mVerbs = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(mVerbs, Math.max(mVerbs.length * 2, mVerbCount + extra));
    }

    private void ensureCoordinates(int extra)
    {
        if (mCoordinateCount + extra > mCoordinates.length)
        {
            mCoordinates = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(mCoordinates, Math.max(mCoordinates.length * 2, mCoordinateCount + extra));
        }
    }

    private void pushVerb(int verb)
    {
        ensureVerbs(1);
        mVerbs[mVerbCount++] = (byte) verb;
        mGenerationId++;
    }

    private void pushPoint(float x, float y)
    {
        ensureCoordinates(2);
        mCoordinates[mCoordinateCount++] = x;
        mCoordinates[mCoordinateCount++] = y;
    }

    private void ensureContour()
    {
        if (mContourOpen) return;

        float[] start = lastPoint();
        recordMove(start[0], start[1]);
    }

    private void recordMove(float x, float y)
    {
        pushVerb(VERB_MOVE);
        pushPoint(x, y);
        mContourStartX = x;
        mContourStartY = y;
        mContourOpen = true;
    }

    private void recordLine(float x, float y)
    {
        ensureContour();
        pushVerb(VERB_LINE);
        pushPoint(x, y);
    }

    private void recordQuad(float controlX, float controlY, float x, float y)
    {
        ensureContour();
        pushVerb(VERB_QUAD);
        pushPoint(controlX, controlY);
        pushPoint(x, y);
    }

    private void recordCubic(float firstX, float firstY, float secondX, float secondY, float x, float y)
    {
        ensureContour();
        pushVerb(VERB_CUBIC);
        pushPoint(firstX, firstY);
        pushPoint(secondX, secondY);
        pushPoint(x, y);
    }

    private void recordClose()
    {
        if (!mContourOpen) return;

        pushVerb(VERB_CLOSE);
        mContourOpen = false;
    }

    private void recordOval(float left, float top, float right, float bottom)
    {
        float centreX = (left + right) * 0.5f;
        float centreY = (top + bottom) * 0.5f;
        float radiusX = (right - left) * 0.5f;
        float radiusY = (bottom - top) * 0.5f;
        float handleX = radiusX * CIRCLE_KAPPA;
        float handleY = radiusY * CIRCLE_KAPPA;

        recordMove(right, centreY);
        recordCubic(right, centreY + handleY, centreX + handleX, bottom, centreX, bottom);
        recordCubic(centreX - handleX, bottom, left, centreY + handleY, left, centreY);
        recordCubic(left, centreY - handleY, centreX - handleX, top, centreX, top);
        recordCubic(centreX + handleX, top, right, centreY - handleY, right, centreY);
        recordClose();
    }

    private void recordRoundRect(float left, float top, float right, float bottom, float radiusX, float radiusY)
    {
        float width = Math.abs(right - left);
        float height = Math.abs(bottom - top);
        float rx = Math.max(0, Math.min(radiusX, width * 0.5f));
        float ry = Math.max(0, Math.min(radiusY, height * 0.5f));

        if (rx <= 0 || ry <= 0)
        {
            recordMove(left, top);
            recordLine(right, top);
            recordLine(right, bottom);
            recordLine(left, bottom);
            recordClose();
            return;
        }

        float handleX = rx * (1 - CIRCLE_KAPPA);
        float handleY = ry * (1 - CIRCLE_KAPPA);

        recordMove(left + rx, top);
        recordLine(right - rx, top);
        recordCubic(right - handleX, top, right, top + handleY, right, top + ry);
        recordLine(right, bottom - ry);
        recordCubic(right, bottom - handleY, right - handleX, bottom, right - rx, bottom);
        recordLine(left + rx, bottom);
        recordCubic(left + handleX, bottom, left, bottom - handleY, left, bottom - ry);
        recordLine(left, top + ry);
        recordCubic(left, top + handleY, left + handleX, top, left + rx, top);
        recordClose();
    }

    private void recordArc(float left, float top, float right, float bottom, float startAngle, float sweepAngle,
                           boolean forceMoveTo)
    {
        float centreX = (left + right) * 0.5f;
        float centreY = (top + bottom) * 0.5f;
        float radiusX = (right - left) * 0.5f;
        float radiusY = (bottom - top) * 0.5f;

        float sweep = Math.max(-360, Math.min(360, sweepAngle));
        double start = Math.toRadians(startAngle);
        float startX = centreX + radiusX * (float) Math.cos(start);
        float startY = centreY + radiusY * (float) Math.sin(start);

        if (forceMoveTo || !mContourOpen) recordMove(startX, startY);
        else recordLine(startX, startY);

        int segments = Math.max(1, (int) Math.ceil(Math.abs(sweep) / 90.0f));
        double step = Math.toRadians(sweep) / segments;
        double handle = 4.0 / 3.0 * Math.tan(step / 4.0);

        double angle = start;
        for (int segment = 0; segment < segments; segment++)
        {
            double next = angle + step;
            double cosStart = Math.cos(angle);
            double sinStart = Math.sin(angle);
            double cosEnd = Math.cos(next);
            double sinEnd = Math.sin(next);

            recordCubic((float) (centreX + radiusX * (cosStart - handle * sinStart)),
                        (float) (centreY + radiusY * (sinStart + handle * cosStart)),
                        (float) (centreX + radiusX * (cosEnd + handle * sinEnd)),
                        (float) (centreY + radiusY * (sinEnd - handle * cosEnd)), (float) (centreX + radiusX * cosEnd),
                        (float) (centreY + radiusY * sinEnd));

            angle = next;
        }
    }

    private void appendRecord(byte[] verbs, float[] coordinates)
    {
        int coordinate = 0;

        for (byte verb : verbs)
        {
            switch (verb)
            {
                case VERB_MOVE:
                    recordMove(coordinates[coordinate], coordinates[coordinate + 1]);
                    coordinate += 2;
                    break;
                case VERB_LINE:
                    recordLine(coordinates[coordinate], coordinates[coordinate + 1]);
                    coordinate += 2;
                    break;
                case VERB_QUAD:
                    recordQuad(coordinates[coordinate], coordinates[coordinate + 1], coordinates[coordinate + 2],
                               coordinates[coordinate + 3]);
                    coordinate += 4;
                    break;
                case VERB_CUBIC:
                    recordCubic(coordinates[coordinate], coordinates[coordinate + 1], coordinates[coordinate + 2],
                                coordinates[coordinate + 3], coordinates[coordinate + 4], coordinates[coordinate + 5]);
                    coordinate += 6;
                    break;
                default:
                    recordClose();
                    break;
            }
        }
    }

    public void dispose()
    {
        if (mNativePath == 0) return;

        nativeDestroy(mNativePath);
        mNativePath = 0;
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        try
        {
            dispose();
        }
        finally
        {
            super.finalize();
        }
    }

    public enum FillType
    {
        WINDING,
        EVEN_ODD,
        INVERSE_WINDING,
        INVERSE_EVEN_ODD
    }

    public enum Direction
    {
        CW,
        CCW
    }

    public enum Op
    {
        DIFFERENCE,
        INTERSECT,
        UNION,
        XOR,
        REVERSE_DIFFERENCE
    }

    public boolean op(Path other, Op operation)
    {
        return op(this, other, operation);
    }

    public boolean op(Path first, Path second, Op operation)
    {
        if (first == null || second == null) return false;

        RectF left = new RectF();
        RectF right = new RectF();

        first.computeBounds(left, true);
        second.computeBounds(right, true);

        RectF result = new RectF();

        if (operation == Op.INTERSECT)
        {
            result.set(Math.max(left.left, right.left), Math.max(left.top, right.top), Math.min(left.right, right.right),
                       Math.min(left.bottom, right.bottom));

            if (result.right <= result.left || result.bottom <= result.top)
            {
                reset();
                return true;
            }
        }
        else if (operation == Op.REVERSE_DIFFERENCE)
        {
            result.set(right);
        }
        else if (operation == Op.DIFFERENCE)
        {
            result.set(left);
        }
        else
        {
            result.set(Math.min(left.left, right.left), Math.min(left.top, right.top), Math.max(left.right, right.right),
                       Math.max(left.bottom, right.bottom));
        }

        reset();

        if (result.right > result.left && result.bottom > result.top) addRect(result, Direction.CW);

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class PathDashPathEffect extends PathEffect

    private final Path mShape;
    private final float mAdvance;

    public PathDashPathEffect(Path shape, float advance, float phase, Style style)
    {
        if (advance <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("PathDashPathEffect: advance must be > 0");

        mShape = shape == null ? new Path() : new Path(shape);
        mAdvance = advance;
        mPhase = phase;
        mStyle = style == null ? Style.TRANSLATE : style;

    }

        MORPH
    }
```

`java/android/graphics/PathIterator.java`:

```java
package android.graphics;

import java.util.ConcurrentModificationException;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;

public class PathIterator implements Iterator<PathIterator.Segment>
{
    public static final int VERB_MOVE = 0;
    public static final int VERB_LINE = 1;
    public static final int VERB_QUAD = 2;
    public static final int VERB_CONIC = 3;
    public static final int VERB_CUBIC = 4;
    public static final int VERB_CLOSE = 5;
    public static final int VERB_DONE = 6;

    private static final int POINT_ARRAY_SIZE = 8;

    private final Path mPath;
    private final int mGenerationId;
    private final byte[] mVerbs;
    private final float[] mCoordinates;
    private int mVerbIndex;
    private int mCoordinateIndex;
    private float mCurrentX;
    private float mCurrentY;
    private float mStartX;
    private float mStartY;

    PathIterator()
    {
        this(new Path());
    }

    PathIterator(Path path)
    {
        mPath = path;
        mGenerationId = path.getGenerationId();
        mVerbs = path.verbs();
        mCoordinates = path.coordinates();
    }

    public int next(float[] points, int offset)
    {
        if (points.length < offset + POINT_ARRAY_SIZE) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException("points must hold at least 8 entries");
        checkUnmodified();
        if (mVerbIndex >= mVerbs.length) return VERB_DONE;

        int verb = mVerbs[mVerbIndex++];

        switch (verb)
        {
            case Path.VERB_MOVE:
                mCurrentX = mCoordinates[mCoordinateIndex++];
                mCurrentY = mCoordinates[mCoordinateIndex++];
                mStartX = mCurrentX;
                mStartY = mCurrentY;
                points[offset] = mCurrentX;
                points[offset + 1] = mCurrentY;
                return VERB_MOVE;
            case Path.VERB_LINE:
                return emit(points, offset, 1, VERB_LINE);
            case Path.VERB_QUAD:
                return emit(points, offset, 2, VERB_QUAD);
            case Path.VERB_CUBIC:
                return emit(points, offset, 3, VERB_CUBIC);
            default:
                points[offset] = mCurrentX;
                points[offset + 1] = mCurrentY;
                points[offset + 2] = mStartX;
                points[offset + 3] = mStartY;
                mCurrentX = mStartX;
                mCurrentY = mStartY;
                return VERB_CLOSE;
        }
    }

    private void checkUnmodified()
    {
        if (mPath.getGenerationId() != mGenerationId) throw new ConcurrentModificationException("Iterator cannot be used on modified Path");
    }

    private int emit(float[] points, int offset, int count, int verb)
    {
        points[offset] = mCurrentX;
        points[offset + 1] = mCurrentY;

        for (int point = 0; point < count; point++)
        {
            points[offset + 2 + point * 2] = mCoordinates[mCoordinateIndex++];
            points[offset + 3 + point * 2] = mCoordinates[mCoordinateIndex++];
        }

        mCurrentX = points[offset + count * 2];
        mCurrentY = points[offset + count * 2 + 1];
        return verb;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasNext()
    {
        return mVerbIndex < mVerbs.length;
    }

    public int peek()
    {
        checkUnmodified();
        if (mVerbIndex >= mVerbs.length) return VERB_DONE;

        switch (mVerbs[mVerbIndex])
        {
            case Path.VERB_MOVE:
                return VERB_MOVE;
            case Path.VERB_LINE:
                return VERB_LINE;
            case Path.VERB_QUAD:
                return VERB_QUAD;
            case Path.VERB_CUBIC:
                return VERB_CUBIC;
            default:
                return VERB_CLOSE;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public Segment next()
    {
        float[] points = new float[POINT_ARRAY_SIZE];
        int verb = next(points, 0);

        if (verb == VERB_DONE) throw new NoSuchElementException("No more path segments to iterate");

        return new Segment(verb, points, 0.0f);
    }

    public static class Segment
    {
        private final int mVerb;
        private final float[] mPoints;
        private final float mConicWeight;

        Segment()
        {
            this(VERB_DONE, new float[POINT_ARRAY_SIZE], 0.0f);
        }

        Segment(int verb, float[] points, float conicWeight)
        {
            mVerb = verb;
            mPoints = points;
            mConicWeight = conicWeight;
        }

        public int getVerb()
        {
            return mVerb;
        }

        public float[] getPoints()
        {
            return mPoints;
        }

        public float getConicWeight()
        {
            return mConicWeight;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/graphics/PathMeasure.java`:

```java
package android.graphics;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class PathMeasure
{
    public static final int POSITION_MATRIX_FLAG = 1;
    public static final int TANGENT_MATRIX_FLAG = 2;

    private static final int CURVE_STEPS = 16;

    private final List<Contour> mContours = new ArrayList<>();
    private int mContourIndex;

    public PathMeasure()
    {
    }

    public PathMeasure(Path path, boolean forceClosed)
    {
        setPath(path, forceClosed);
    }

    public void setPath(Path path, boolean forceClosed)
    {
        mContours.clear();
        mContourIndex = 0;

        if (path == null) return;

        byte[] verbs = path.verbs();
        float[] coordinates = path.coordinates();

        ContourBuilder builder = new ContourBuilder(forceClosed);
        int coordinate = 0;

        for (byte verb : verbs)
        {
            switch (verb)
            {
                case Path.VERB_MOVE:
                    builder.finish(mContours, false);
                    builder.moveTo(coordinates[coordinate], coordinates[coordinate + 1]);
                    coordinate += 2;
                    break;
                case Path.VERB_LINE:
                    builder.lineTo(coordinates[coordinate], coordinates[coordinate + 1]);
                    coordinate += 2;
                    break;
                case Path.VERB_QUAD:
                    builder.quadTo(coordinates[coordinate], coordinates[coordinate + 1], coordinates[coordinate + 2],
                                   coordinates[coordinate + 3]);
                    coordinate += 4;
                    break;
                case Path.VERB_CUBIC:
                    builder.cubicTo(coordinates[coordinate], coordinates[coordinate + 1], coordinates[coordinate + 2],
                                    coordinates[coordinate + 3], coordinates[coordinate + 4], coordinates[coordinate + 5]);
                    coordinate += 6;
                    break;
                default:
                    builder.finish(mContours, true);
                    break;
            }
        }

        builder.finish(mContours, false);
    }

    public float getLength()
    {
        Contour contour = currentContour();
        return contour == null ? 0.0f : contour.mLength;
    }

    public boolean isClosed()
    {
        Contour contour = currentContour();
        return contour != null && contour.mClosed;
    }

    public boolean nextContour()
    {
        if (mContourIndex >= mContours.size()) return false;

        mContourIndex++;
        return mContourIndex < mContours.size();
    }

    public boolean getPosTan(float distance, float[] position, float[] tangent)
    {
        Contour contour = currentContour();
        if (contour == null) return false;

        if (position != null && position.length < 2) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException();
        if (tangent != null && tangent.length < 2) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException();

        float[] point = new float[4];
        contour.sample(distance, point);

        if (position != null)
        {
            position[0] = point[0];
            position[1] = point[1];
        }

        if (tangent != null)
        {
            tangent[0] = point[2];
            tangent[1] = point[3];
        }

        return true;
    }

    public boolean getSegment(float startD, float stopD, Path into, boolean startWithMoveTo)
    {
        Contour contour = currentContour();
        if (contour == null || into == null) return false;

        float start = Math.max(0.0f, startD);
        float stop = Math.min(contour.mLength, stopD);
        if (start > stop || contour.mLength <= 0.0f) return false;

        float[] point = new float[4];
        contour.sample(start, point);

        if (startWithMoveTo) into.moveTo(point[0], point[1]);
        else into.lineTo(point[0], point[1]);

        for (int index = 1; index < contour.mCount - 1; index++)
        {
            float travelled = contour.mDistances[index];
            if (travelled <= start) continue;
            if (travelled >= stop) break;

            into.lineTo(contour.mPoints[index * 2], contour.mPoints[index * 2 + 1]);
        }

        contour.sample(stop, point);
        into.lineTo(point[0], point[1]);

        return true;
    }

    public boolean getMatrix(float distance, Matrix matrix, int flags)
    {
        Contour contour = currentContour();
        if (contour == null || matrix == null) return false;

        float[] point = new float[4];
        contour.sample(distance, point);

        matrix.reset();

        if ((flags & TANGENT_MATRIX_FLAG) != 0) matrix.setSinCos(point[3], point[2]);
        if ((flags & POSITION_MATRIX_FLAG) != 0) matrix.postTranslate(point[0], point[1]);

        return true;
    }

    private Contour currentContour()
    {
        if (mContourIndex >= mContours.size()) return null;

        return mContours.get(mContourIndex);
    }

    private static final class Contour
    {
        final float[] mPoints;
        final float[] mDistances;
        final int mCount;
        final float mLength;
        final boolean mClosed;

        Contour(float[] points, int count, boolean closed)
        {
            mPoints = points;
            mCount = count;
            mClosed = closed;
            mDistances = new float[count];

            float length = 0.0f;
            for (int index = 1; index < count; index++)
            {
                float deltaX = points[index * 2] - points[index * 2 - 2];
                float deltaY = points[index * 2 + 1] - points[index * 2 - 1];
                length += (float) Math.sqrt(deltaX * deltaX + deltaY * deltaY);
                mDistances[index] = length;
            }

            mLength = length;
        }

        void sample(float distance, float[] out)
        {
            float clamped = Math.max(0.0f, Math.min(distance, mLength));

            int segment = 1;
            while (segment < mCount - 1 && mDistances[segment] < clamped) segment++;

            if (mCount < 2)
            {
                out[0] = mPoints[0];
                out[1] = mPoints[1];
                out[2] = 1.0f;
                out[3] = 0.0f;
                return;
            }

            while (segment > 1 && mDistances[segment] - mDistances[segment - 1] <= 0.0f && mDistances[segment - 1] >= clamped)
            {
                segment--;
            }

            float startX = mPoints[segment * 2 - 2];
            float startY = mPoints[segment * 2 - 1];
            float endX = mPoints[segment * 2];
            float endY = mPoints[segment * 2 + 1];
            float span = mDistances[segment] - mDistances[segment - 1];
            float fraction = span <= 0.0f ? 0.0f : (clamped - mDistances[segment - 1]) / span;

            out[0] = startX + (endX - startX) * fraction;
            out[1] = startY + (endY - startY) * fraction;

            float deltaX = endX - startX;
            float deltaY = endY - startY;
            float magnitude = (float) Math.sqrt(deltaX * deltaX + deltaY * deltaY);

            if (magnitude > 0.0f)
            {
                out[2] = deltaX / magnitude;
                out[3] = deltaY / magnitude;
            }
            else
            {
                out[2] = 1.0f;
                out[3] = 0.0f;
            }
        }
    }

    private static final class ContourBuilder
    {
        private final boolean mForceClosed;
        private float[] mPoints = new float[32];
        private int mCount;
        private float mStartX;
        private float mStartY;
        private float mLastX;
        private float mLastY;

        ContourBuilder(boolean forceClosed)
        {
            mForceClosed = forceClosed;
        }

        void moveTo(float x, float y)
        {
            mStartX = x;
            mStartY = y;
            mLastX = x;
            mLastY = y;
            mCount = 0;
            append(x, y);
        }

        void lineTo(float x, float y)
        {
            ensureStarted();
            append(x, y);
        }

        void quadTo(float controlX, float controlY, float endX, float endY)
        {
            ensureStarted();

            float startX = mLastX;
            float startY = mLastY;

            for (int step = 1; step <= CURVE_STEPS; step++)
            {
                float t = step / (float) CURVE_STEPS;
                float inverse = 1.0f - t;
                append(inverse * inverse * startX + 2 * inverse * t * controlX + t * t * endX,
                       inverse * inverse * startY + 2 * inverse * t * controlY + t * t * endY);
            }
        }

        void cubicTo(float firstX, float firstY, float secondX, float secondY, float endX, float endY)
        {
            ensureStarted();

            float startX = mLastX;
            float startY = mLastY;

            for (int step = 1; step <= CURVE_STEPS; step++)
            {
                float t = step / (float) CURVE_STEPS;
                float inverse = 1.0f - t;
                float a = inverse * inverse * inverse;
                float b = 3 * inverse * inverse * t;
                float c = 3 * inverse * t * t;
                float d = t * t * t;
                append(a * startX + b * firstX + c * secondX + d * endX, a * startY + b * firstY + c * secondY + d * endY);
            }
        }

        void finish(List<Contour> contours, boolean closed)
        {
            if (mCount > 1)
            {
                boolean isClosed = closed || mForceClosed;
                if (isClosed && (mLastX != mStartX || mLastY != mStartY)) append(mStartX, mStartY);

                contours.add(new Contour(java.util.Arrays.copyOf(mPoints, mCount * 2), mCount, isClosed));
            }

            mCount = 0;
            mLastX = mStartX;
            mLastY = mStartY;
        }

        private void ensureStarted()
        {
            if (mCount == 0)
            {
                mStartX = mLastX;
                mStartY = mLastY;
                append(mLastX, mLastY);
            }
        }

        private void append(float x, float y)
        {
            if (mCount * 2 + 2 > mPoints.length) mPoints = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(mPoints, mPoints.length * 2);

            mPoints[mCount * 2] = x;
            mPoints[mCount * 2 + 1] = y;
            mCount++;
            mLastX = x;
            mLastY = y;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics;

public class Picture
{
    private Bitmap mRecorded;
    private Canvas mRecording;
    private int mWidth;
    private int mHeight;

    public Picture()
    {
    }

    public Picture(Picture source)
    {
        if (source == null) return;

        mWidth = source.mWidth;
        mHeight = source.mHeight;
        mRecorded = source.mRecorded;
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        super.finalize();
    }

    public Canvas beginRecording(int width, int height)
    {
        mWidth = Math.max(0, width);
        mHeight = Math.max(0, height);

        mRecorded = Bitmap.createBitmap(Math.max(1, mWidth), Math.max(1, mHeight), Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        mRecording = new Canvas(mRecorded);

        return mRecording;
    }

    public void endRecording()
    {
        mRecording = null;
    }

    public int getWidth()
    {
        return mWidth;
    }

    public int getHeight()
    {
        return mHeight;
    }

    public boolean requiresHardwareAcceleration()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        if (canvas == null || mRecorded == null) return;

        canvas.drawBitmap(mRecorded, 0.0f, 0.0f, null);
    }

    Bitmap recorded()
    {
        return mRecorded;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public void writeToStream(java.io.OutputStream stream)
    {
        if (stream == null) throw new NullPointerException();

        try
        {
            java.io.DataOutputStream output = new java.io.DataOutputStream(stream);
            output.writeInt(STREAM_MAGIC);
            output.writeInt(mWidth);
            output.writeInt(mHeight);
            output.writeBoolean(mRecorded != null);
            output.flush();

            if (mRecorded != null && !mRecorded.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, stream)) throw new RuntimeException();
        }
        catch (java.io.IOException failure)
        {
            throw new RuntimeException(failure);
        }
    }

    @Deprecated
    public static Picture createFromStream(java.io.InputStream stream)
    {
        try
        {
            java.io.DataInputStream input = new java.io.DataInputStream(stream);
            if (input.readInt() != STREAM_MAGIC) return new Picture();

            Picture picture = new Picture();
            picture.mWidth = input.readInt();
            picture.mHeight = input.readInt();
            if (input.readBoolean()) picture.mRecorded = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(input, null, null);

            return picture;
        }
        catch (java.io.IOException failure)
        {
            return new Picture();
        }
    }

    private static final int STREAM_MAGIC = 0x41434C50;
}
```

```java
package android.graphics;

public class PixelFormat
{
    public static final int UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final int TRANSLUCENT = -3;
    public static final int TRANSPARENT = -2;
    public static final int OPAQUE = -1;
    public static final int RGBA_8888 = 1;
    public static final int RGBX_8888 = 2;
    public static final int RGB_888 = 3;
    public static final int RGB_565 = 4;
    public static final int RGBA_5551 = 6;
    public static final int RGBA_4444 = 7;
    public static final int A_8 = 8;
    public static final int L_8 = 9;
    public static final int LA_88 = 10;
    public static final int RGB_332 = 11;
    public static final int YCbCr_422_SP = 16;
    public static final int YCbCr_420_SP = 17;
    public static final int YCbCr_422_I = 20;
    public static final int RGBA_F16 = 22;
    public static final int RGBA_1010102 = 43;
    public static final int JPEG = 256;

    public int bytesPerPixel;
    public int bitsPerPixel;

    public PixelFormat()
    {
    }

    public static void getPixelFormatInfo(int format, PixelFormat info)
    {
        switch (format)
        {
            case RGBA_8888:
            case RGBX_8888:
            case RGBA_1010102:
                info.bitsPerPixel = 32;
                info.bytesPerPixel = 4;
                break;
            case RGB_888:
                info.bitsPerPixel = 24;
                info.bytesPerPixel = 3;
                break;
            case RGB_565:
            case RGBA_5551:
            case RGBA_4444:
            case LA_88:
                info.bitsPerPixel = 16;
                info.bytesPerPixel = 2;
                break;
            case A_8:
            case L_8:
            case RGB_332:
                info.bitsPerPixel = 8;
                info.bytesPerPixel = 1;
                break;
            case YCbCr_422_SP:
            case YCbCr_422_I:
                info.bitsPerPixel = 16;
                info.bytesPerPixel = 1;
                break;
            case YCbCr_420_SP:
                info.bitsPerPixel = 12;
                info.bytesPerPixel = 1;
                break;
            case RGBA_F16:
                info.bitsPerPixel = 64;
                info.bytesPerPixel = 8;
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("unknown pixel format " + format);
        }
    }

    public static boolean formatHasAlpha(int format)
    {
        switch (format)
        {
            case A_8:
            case LA_88:
            case RGBA_4444:
            case RGBA_5551:
            case RGBA_8888:
            case RGBA_F16:
            case RGBA_1010102:
            case TRANSLUCENT:
            case TRANSPARENT:
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class Point implements Parcelable

    {

        {
            Point point = new Point();
            point.readFromParcel(source);
            return point;
        }

        @Override
        public Point[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Point[size];
        }
    };

    public int x;
    public int y;

    public Point()
    {
    }

    public Point(int x, int y)
    {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
    }

    {
        x = source.x;
        y = source.y;
    }

    {
        x = newX;
        y = newY;
    }

    public final void negate()
    {
        x = -x;
        y = -y;
    }

    public final void offset(int deltaX, int deltaY)
    {
        x += deltaX;
        y += deltaY;
    }

    {
        return x == otherX && y == otherY;
    }

    {

        if (!(other instanceof Point)) return false;

        Point point = (Point)other;

    }

    public int hashCode()
    {
        return 31 * x + y;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Point(" + x + ", " + y + ")";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

        out.writeInt(y);
```

```java
package android.graphics;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public class PointF implements Parcelable
{
    public float x;
    public float y;

    public PointF()
    {
    }

    public PointF(float x, float y)
    {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
    }

    public PointF(Point point)
    {
        if (point == null) return;

        x = point.x;
        y = point.y;
    }

    public PointF(PointF point)
    {
        if (point == null) return;

        x = point.x;
        y = point.y;
    }

    public final void set(float x, float y)
    {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
    }

    public final void set(PointF point)
    {
        if (point == null) return;

        x = point.x;
        y = point.y;
    }

    public final void negate()
    {
        x = -x;
        y = -y;
    }

    public final void offset(float dx, float dy)
    {
        x += dx;
        y += dy;
    }

    public final boolean equals(float x, float y)
    {
        return this.x == x && this.y == y;
    }

    public final float length()
    {
        return length(x, y);
    }

    public static float length(float x, float y)
    {
        return (float)Math.hypot(x, y);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof PointF)) return false;

        PointF point = (PointF)other;

        return Float.compare(x, point.x) == 0 && Float.compare(y, point.y) == 0;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Float.floatToIntBits(x) * 31 + Float.floatToIntBits(y);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "PointF(" + x + ", " + y + ")";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        parcel.writeValue(Float.valueOf(x));
        parcel.writeValue(Float.valueOf(y));
    }

    public void readFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
    {
        Object first = parcel.readValue(null);
        Object second = parcel.readValue(null);

        if (first instanceof Float) x = ((Float)first).floatValue();
        if (second instanceof Float) y = ((Float)second).floatValue();
    }

    public static final Creator<PointF> CREATOR = new Creator<PointF>()
    {
        @Override
        public PointF createFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
        {
            PointF point = new PointF();
            point.readFromParcel(parcel);

            return point;
        }

        @Override
        public PointF[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new PointF[size];
        }
    };
}
```

```java
package android.graphics;

public class PorterDuff
{
    public PorterDuff()
    {
    }

    public enum Mode
    {
        CLEAR(0),
        SRC(1),
        DST(2),
        SRC_OVER(3),
        DST_OVER(4),
        SRC_IN(5),
        DST_IN(6),
        SRC_OUT(7),
        DST_OUT(8),
        SRC_ATOP(9),
        DST_ATOP(10),
        XOR(11),
        DARKEN(16),
        LIGHTEN(17),
        MULTIPLY(13),
        SCREEN(14),
        ADD(12),
        OVERLAY(15);

        public final int nativeInt;

        Mode(int nativeInt)
        {
            this.nativeInt = nativeInt;
        }
    }

    public static int modeToInt(Mode mode)
    {
        return mode.nativeInt;
    }

    public static Mode intToMode(int value)
    {
        for (Mode mode : Mode.values())
        {
            if (mode.nativeInt == value) return mode;
        }

        return Mode.CLEAR;
    }
}
```

`java/android/graphics/PorterDuffColorFilter.java`:

```java
package android.graphics;

public class PorterDuffColorFilter extends ColorFilter
{
    private final int mColor;
    private final PorterDuff.Mode mMode;

    public PorterDuffColorFilter(int color, PorterDuff.Mode mode)
    {
        mColor = color;
        mMode = mode == null ? PorterDuff.Mode.SRC_IN : mode;
    }

    public int getColor()
    {
        return mColor;
    }

    public PorterDuff.Mode getMode()
    {
        return mMode;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof PorterDuffColorFilter)) return false;

        PorterDuffColorFilter that = (PorterDuffColorFilter)other;
        return mColor == that.mColor && mMode == that.mMode;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return 31 * mMode.hashCode() + mColor;
    }

    int apply(int source)
    {
        switch (mMode)
        {
            case SRC:
            case SRC_IN:
            case SRC_ATOP:
                return (source & 0xFF000000) | (mColor & 0x00FFFFFF);

            case MULTIPLY:
                return Color.argb(Color.alpha(source), Color.red(source) * Color.red(mColor) / 255,
                                  Color.green(source) * Color.green(mColor) / 255,
                                  Color.blue(source) * Color.blue(mColor) / 255);

            case DST:
            case DST_IN:
            case DST_ATOP:
                return source;

            default:
                return mColor;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics;

public class PorterDuffXfermode extends Xfermode
{

    {
        mMode = mode;
    }

    public PorterDuff.Mode getMode()
```

```java
package android.graphics;

public class RadialGradient extends Shader
{
    private final float mCentreX;
    private final float mCentreY;
    private final float mRadius;
    private final int[] mColors;
    private final float[] mPositions;
    private final int mTileMode;

    public RadialGradient(float centreX, float centreY, float radius, int[] colors, float[] positions, TileMode tileMode)
    {
        if (colors == null || colors.length < 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException("needs at least two colors");
        if (radius <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("radius must be positive");

        mCentreX = centreX;
        mCentreY = centreY;
        mRadius = radius;
        mColors = colors.clone();
        mPositions = positions == null ? evenPositions(colors.length) : positions.clone();
        mTileMode = tileModeId(tileMode);
    }

    public RadialGradient(float centreX, float centreY, float radius, int centreColor, int edgeColor, TileMode tileMode)
    {
        this(centreX, centreY, radius, new int[] {centreColor, edgeColor}, null, tileMode);
    }

    public RadialGradient(float centreX, float centreY, float radius, long[] colors, float[] positions, TileMode tileMode)
    {
        this(centreX, centreY, radius, argbColors(colors), positions, tileMode);
    }

    public RadialGradient(float startX, float startY, float startRadius, float endX, float endY, float endRadius, long[] colors,
                          float[] positions, TileMode tileMode)
    {
        this(endX, endY, endRadius, argbColors(colors), positions, tileMode);
    }

    public RadialGradient(float centreX, float centreY, float radius, long centreColor, long edgeColor, TileMode tileMode)
    {
        this(centreX, centreY, radius, new long[] {centreColor, edgeColor}, null, tileMode);
    }

    @Override
    int kind()
    {
        return KIND_RADIAL;
    }

    @Override
    int tileModeId()
    {
        return mTileMode;
    }

    @Override
    float startX()
    {
        return mCentreX;
    }

    @Override
    float startY()
    {
        return mCentreY;
    }

    @Override
    float radius()
    {
        return mRadius;
    }

    @Override
    int[] stopColors()
    {
        return mColors;
    }

    @Override
    float[] stopPositions()
    {
        return mPositions;
    }
}
```

```java
    }

    {
        mDisplayList.clear();
        mRecordedWidth = width;
        mRecordedHeight = height;
        mSaveCount = 1;
    }

        return false;
    }

    public void enableZ()
    {
    }

    public void disableZ()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public int save()
    {
        mDisplayList.record(target -> target.save());
        return mSaveCount++;
    }

    @Override
    public void restore()
    {
        if (mSaveCount <= 1) return;

        mSaveCount--;
        mDisplayList.record(target -> target.restore());
    }
```
