`java/android/graphics/Rect.java`:

```java
package android.graphics;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class Rect implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<Rect> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<Rect>()
    {
        @Override
        public Rect createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            Rect rect = new Rect();
            rect.readFromParcel(source);
            return rect;
        }

        @Override
        public Rect[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Rect[size];
        }
    };

    public int left;
    public int top;
    public int right;
    public int bottom;

    public Rect()
    {
    }

    public Rect(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        this.left = left;
        this.top = top;
        this.right = right;
        this.bottom = bottom;
    }

    public Rect(Rect source)
    {
        if (source != null) set(source);
    }

    public void set(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        this.left = left;
        this.top = top;
        this.right = right;
        this.bottom = bottom;
    }

    public void set(Rect source)
    {
        set(source.left, source.top, source.right, source.bottom);
    }

    public void setEmpty()
    {
        left = 0;
        top = 0;
        right = 0;
        bottom = 0;
    }

    public boolean isEmpty()
    {
        return left >= right || top >= bottom;
    }

    public int width()
    {
        return right - left;
    }

    public int height()
    {
        return bottom - top;
    }

    public int centerX()
    {
        return (left + right) >> 1;
    }

    public int centerY()
    {
        return (top + bottom) >> 1;
    }

    public float exactCenterX()
    {
        return (left + right) * 0.5f;
    }

    public float exactCenterY()
    {
        return (top + bottom) * 0.5f;
    }

    public void offset(int dx, int dy)
    {
        left += dx;
        top += dy;
        right += dx;
        bottom += dy;
    }

    public void offsetTo(int newLeft, int newTop)
    {
        right += newLeft - left;
        bottom += newTop - top;
        left = newLeft;
        top = newTop;
    }

    public void inset(int dx, int dy)
    {
        left += dx;
        top += dy;
        right -= dx;
        bottom -= dy;
    }

    public void inset(Insets insets)
    {
        inset(insets.left, insets.top, insets.right, insets.bottom);
    }

    public void inset(int insetLeft, int insetTop, int insetRight, int insetBottom)
    {
        left += insetLeft;
        top += insetTop;
        right -= insetRight;
        bottom -= insetBottom;
    }

    public boolean contains(int x, int y)
    {
        return left < right && top < bottom && x >= left && x < right && y >= top && y < bottom;
    }

    public boolean contains(int otherLeft, int otherTop, int otherRight, int otherBottom)
    {
        return left < right && top < bottom && left <= otherLeft && top <= otherTop && right >= otherRight && bottom >= otherBottom;
    }

    public boolean contains(Rect other)
    {
        return contains(other.left, other.top, other.right, other.bottom);
    }

    public boolean intersect(int otherLeft, int otherTop, int otherRight, int otherBottom)
    {
        if (left >= otherRight || otherLeft >= right || top >= otherBottom || otherTop >= bottom) return false;

        if (left < otherLeft) left = otherLeft;
        if (top < otherTop) top = otherTop;
        if (right > otherRight) right = otherRight;
        if (bottom > otherBottom) bottom = otherBottom;
        return true;
    }

    public boolean intersect(Rect other)
    {
        return intersect(other.left, other.top, other.right, other.bottom);
    }

    public boolean setIntersect(Rect first, Rect second)
    {
        if (first.left >= second.right || second.left >= first.right || first.top >= second.bottom || second.top >= first.bottom)
            return false;

        left = Math.max(first.left, second.left);
        top = Math.max(first.top, second.top);
        right = Math.min(first.right, second.right);
        bottom = Math.min(first.bottom, second.bottom);
        return true;
    }

    public boolean intersects(int otherLeft, int otherTop, int otherRight, int otherBottom)
    {
        return left < otherRight && otherLeft < right && top < otherBottom && otherTop < bottom;
    }

    public static boolean intersects(Rect first, Rect second)
    {
        return first.left < second.right && second.left < first.right && first.top < second.bottom && second.top < first.bottom;
    }

    public void union(int otherLeft, int otherTop, int otherRight, int otherBottom)
    {
        if (otherLeft >= otherRight || otherTop >= otherBottom) return;

        if (left < right && top < bottom)
        {
            if (left > otherLeft) left = otherLeft;
            if (top > otherTop) top = otherTop;
            if (right < otherRight) right = otherRight;
            if (bottom < otherBottom) bottom = otherBottom;
            return;
        }

        set(otherLeft, otherTop, otherRight, otherBottom);
    }

    public void union(Rect other)
    {
        union(other.left, other.top, other.right, other.bottom);
    }

    public void union(int x, int y)
    {
        if (x < left) left = x;
        else if (x > right) right = x;

        if (y < top) top = y;
        else if (y > bottom) bottom = y;
    }

    public void sort()
    {
        if (left > right)
        {
            int swap = left;
            left = right;
            right = swap;
        }

        if (top > bottom)
        {
            int swap = top;
            top = bottom;
            bottom = swap;
        }
    }

    public String toShortString()
    {
        return "[" + left + "," + top + "][" + right + "," + bottom + "]";
    }

    public String flattenToString()
    {
        return left + " " + top + " " + right + " " + bottom;
    }

    public static Rect unflattenFromString(String text)
    {
        if (text == null) return null;

        String[] parts = text.trim().split(" ");
        if (parts.length != 4) return null;

        try
        {
            return new Rect(Integer.parseInt(parts[0]), Integer.parseInt(parts[1]), Integer.parseInt(parts[2]), Integer.parseInt(parts[3]));
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
    {
        out.writeInt(left);
        out.writeInt(top);
        out.writeInt(right);
        out.writeInt(bottom);
    }

    public void readFromParcel(Parcel in)
    {
        left = in.readInt();
        top = in.readInt();
        right = in.readInt();
        bottom = in.readInt();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof Rect)) return false;

        Rect that = (Rect)other;
        return left == that.left && top == that.top && right == that.right && bottom == that.bottom;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return ((left * 31 + top) * 31 + right) * 31 + bottom;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Rect(" + left + ", " + top + " - " + right + ", " + bottom + ")";
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class Region implements android.os.Parcelable
{
    public enum Op
    {
        DIFFERENCE(0),
        INTERSECT(1),
        UNION(2),
        XOR(3),
        REVERSE_DIFFERENCE(4),
        REPLACE(5);

        public final int nativeInt;

        Op(int nativeInt)
        {
            this.nativeInt = nativeInt;
        }
    }

    private final List<Rect> mParts = new ArrayList<>();

    public Region()
    {
    }

    public Region(Region region)
    {
        setTo(region);
    }

    public Region(Rect rect)
    {
        if (rect != null) addPart(rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom);
    }

    public Region(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        addPart(left, top, right, bottom);
    }

    Rect[] parts()
    {
        return mParts.toArray(new Rect[0]);
    }

    private void addPart(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        if (right <= left || bottom <= top) return;

        mParts.add(new Rect(left, top, right, bottom));
    }

    private void setTo(Region region)
    {
        mParts.clear();

        if (region == null) return;

        for (Rect part : region.mParts) mParts.add(new Rect(part));
    }

    public void setEmpty()
    {
        mParts.clear();
    }

    public boolean set(Region region)
    {
        setTo(region);
        return !mParts.isEmpty();
    }

    public boolean set(Rect rect)
    {
        mParts.clear();

        if (rect != null) addPart(rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom);

        return !mParts.isEmpty();
    }

    public boolean set(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        mParts.clear();
        addPart(left, top, right, bottom);

        return !mParts.isEmpty();
    }

    public boolean setPath(Path path, Region clip)
    {
        mParts.clear();

        if (path == null) return false;

        RectF bounds = new RectF();
        path.computeBounds(bounds, true);

        addPart((int)Math.floor(bounds.left), (int)Math.floor(bounds.top), (int)Math.ceil(bounds.right),
                (int)Math.ceil(bounds.bottom));

        if (clip != null) op(clip, Op.INTERSECT);

        return !mParts.isEmpty();
    }

    public boolean isEmpty()
    {
        return mParts.isEmpty();
    }

    public boolean isRect()
    {
        return mParts.size() == 1;
    }

    public boolean isComplex()
    {
        return mParts.size() > 1;
    }

    public Rect getBounds()
    {
        Rect bounds = new Rect();
        getBounds(bounds);

        return bounds;
    }

    public boolean getBounds(Rect into)
    {
        if (into == null) return !mParts.isEmpty();

        if (mParts.isEmpty())
        {
            into.setEmpty();
            return false;
        }

        Rect first = mParts.get(0);
        into.set(first.left, first.top, first.right, first.bottom);

        for (int index = 1; index < mParts.size(); index++)
        {
            Rect part = mParts.get(index);

            if (part.left < into.left) into.left = part.left;
            if (part.top < into.top) into.top = part.top;
            if (part.right > into.right) into.right = part.right;
            if (part.bottom > into.bottom) into.bottom = part.bottom;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public Path getBoundaryPath()
    {
        Path path = new Path();

        for (Rect part : mParts) path.addRect(part.left, part.top, part.right, part.bottom, Path.Direction.CW);

        return path;
    }

    public boolean getBoundaryPath(Path into)
    {
        if (into == null) return !mParts.isEmpty();

        into.reset();

        for (Rect part : mParts) into.addRect(part.left, part.top, part.right, part.bottom, Path.Direction.CW);

        return !mParts.isEmpty();
    }

    public boolean contains(int x, int y)
    {
        for (Rect part : mParts)
        {
            if (x >= part.left && x < part.right && y >= part.top && y < part.bottom) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean quickContains(Rect rect)
    {
        return rect != null && quickContains(rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom);
    }

    public boolean quickContains(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        for (Rect part : mParts)
        {
            if (left >= part.left && top >= part.top && right <= part.right && bottom <= part.bottom) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean quickReject(Rect rect)
    {
        return rect == null || quickReject(rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom);
    }

    public boolean quickReject(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        for (Rect part : mParts)
        {
            if (intersects(part, left, top, right, bottom)) return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public boolean quickReject(Region region)
    {
        if (region == null) return true;

        for (Rect part : region.mParts)
        {
            if (!quickReject(part)) return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public void translate(int dx, int dy)
    {
        translate(dx, dy, this);
    }

    public void translate(int dx, int dy, Region into)
    {
        if (into == null) return;

        List<Rect> moved = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Rect part : mParts) moved.add(new Rect(part.left + dx, part.top + dy, part.right + dx, part.bottom + dy));

        into.mParts.clear();
        into.mParts.addAll(moved);
    }

    public boolean union(Rect rect)
    {
        return op(rect, Op.UNION);
    }

    public boolean op(Rect rect, Op operation)
    {
        Region other = new Region(rect);
        return op(other, operation);
    }

    public boolean op(int left, int top, int right, int bottom, Op operation)
    {
        return op(new Region(left, top, right, bottom), operation);
    }

    public boolean op(Region region, Op operation)
    {
        return op(this, region, operation);
    }

    public boolean op(Rect rect, Region region, Op operation)
    {
        return op(new Region(rect), region, operation);
    }

    public boolean op(Region first, Region second, Op operation)
    {
        List<Rect> left = copyOf(first);
        List<Rect> right = copyOf(second);
        List<Rect> result;

        if (operation == Op.REPLACE)
        {
            result = right;
        }
        else if (operation == Op.UNION)
        {
            result = left;
            for (Rect part : right) subtractInto(result, part, result);
            result.addAll(right);
        }
        else if (operation == Op.INTERSECT)
        {
            result = new ArrayList<>();

            for (Rect a : left)
            {
                for (Rect b : right)
                {
                    if (!intersects(a, b.left, b.top, b.right, b.bottom)) continue;

                    result.add(new Rect(Math.max(a.left, b.left), Math.max(a.top, b.top), Math.min(a.right, b.right),
                                        Math.min(a.bottom, b.bottom)));
                }
            }
        }
        else if (operation == Op.DIFFERENCE)
        {
            result = left;
            for (Rect part : right) subtractInto(result, part, result);
        }
        else if (operation == Op.REVERSE_DIFFERENCE)
        {
            result = right;
            for (Rect part : left) subtractInto(result, part, result);
        }
        else
        {
            List<Rect> onlyLeft = copyOf(first);
            for (Rect part : right) subtractInto(onlyLeft, part, onlyLeft);

            List<Rect> onlyRight = copyOf(second);
            for (Rect part : left) subtractInto(onlyRight, part, onlyRight);

            result = onlyLeft;
            result.addAll(onlyRight);
        }

        mParts.clear();
        for (Rect part : result)
        {
            if (part.right > part.left && part.bottom > part.top) mParts.add(part);
        }

        return !mParts.isEmpty();
    }

    private static List<Rect> copyOf(Region region)
    {
        List<Rect> copy = new ArrayList<>();

        if (region != null)
        {
            for (Rect part : region.mParts) copy.add(new Rect(part));
        }

        return copy;
    }

    private static void subtractInto(List<Rect> parts, Rect cut, List<Rect> into)
    {
        List<Rect> kept = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Rect part : parts)
        {
            if (!intersects(part, cut.left, cut.top, cut.right, cut.bottom))
            {
                kept.add(part);
                continue;
            }

            if (part.top < cut.top) kept.add(new Rect(part.left, part.top, part.right, cut.top));
            if (part.bottom > cut.bottom) kept.add(new Rect(part.left, cut.bottom, part.right, part.bottom));

            int top = Math.max(part.top, cut.top);
            int bottom = Math.min(part.bottom, cut.bottom);

            if (bottom > top)
            {
                if (part.left < cut.left) kept.add(new Rect(part.left, top, cut.left, bottom));
                if (part.right > cut.right) kept.add(new Rect(cut.right, top, part.right, bottom));
            }
        }

        into.clear();
        into.addAll(kept);
    }

    private static boolean intersects(Rect part, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        return part.left < right && left < part.right && part.top < bottom && top < part.bottom;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Region(" + getBounds() + (isComplex() ? " and " + (mParts.size() - 1) + " more" : "") + ")";
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof Region)) return false;
        if (other == this) return true;

        Region region = (Region) other;
        Region difference = new Region();

        return !difference.op(this, region, Op.XOR);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return getBounds().hashCode();
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        super.finalize();
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(android.os.Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeInt(mParts.size());

        for (Rect part : mParts)
        {
            destination.writeInt(part.left);
            destination.writeInt(part.top);
            destination.writeInt(part.right);
            destination.writeInt(part.bottom);
        }
    }

    public static final android.os.Parcelable.Creator<Region> CREATOR = new android.os.Parcelable.Creator<Region>()
    {
        @Override
        public Region createFromParcel(android.os.Parcel source)
        {
            Region region = new Region();
            int count = source.readInt();

            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                region.addPart(source.readInt(), source.readInt(), source.readInt(), source.readInt());
            }

            return region;
        }

        @Override
        public Region[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Region[size];
        }
    };
}
```

`java/android/graphics/RegionIterator.java`:

```java
package android.graphics;

public class RegionIterator
{
    private final Rect[] mParts;
    private int mIndex;

    public RegionIterator(Region region)
    {
        mParts = region == null ? new Rect[0] : region.parts();
    }

    public final boolean next(Rect into)
    {
        if (into == null || mIndex >= mParts.length) return false;

        into.set(mParts[mIndex]);
        mIndex++;

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics;

public final class RenderEffect
{
    static final int KIND_OFFSET = 0;
    static final int KIND_BLUR = 1;
    static final int KIND_BITMAP = 2;
    static final int KIND_COLOR_FILTER = 3;
    static final int KIND_BLEND_MODE = 4;
    static final int KIND_CHAIN = 5;
    static final int KIND_SHADER = 6;
    static final int KIND_RUNTIME_SHADER = 7;

    final int kind;
    final float first;
    final float second;
    final RenderEffect input;
    final RenderEffect other;
    final Object payload;

    RenderEffect()
    {
        this(KIND_OFFSET, 0f, 0f, null, null, null);
    }

    private RenderEffect(int kind, float first, float second, RenderEffect input, RenderEffect other, Object payload)
    {
        this.kind = kind;
        this.first = first;
        this.second = second;
        this.input = input;
        this.other = other;
        this.payload = payload;
    }

    public static RenderEffect createOffsetEffect(float offsetX, float offsetY)
    {
        return new RenderEffect(KIND_OFFSET, offsetX, offsetY, null, null, null);
    }

    public static RenderEffect createOffsetEffect(float offsetX, float offsetY, RenderEffect input)
    {
        return new RenderEffect(KIND_OFFSET, offsetX, offsetY, input, null, null);
    }

    public static RenderEffect createBlurEffect(float radiusX, float radiusY, RenderEffect inputEffect, Shader.TileMode edgeTreatment)
    {
        return new RenderEffect(KIND_BLUR, radiusX, radiusY, inputEffect, null, edgeTreatment);
    }

    public static RenderEffect createBlurEffect(float radiusX, float radiusY, Shader.TileMode edgeTreatment)
    {
        return new RenderEffect(KIND_BLUR, radiusX, radiusY, null, null, edgeTreatment);
    }

    public static RenderEffect createBitmapEffect(Bitmap bitmap)
    {
        return new RenderEffect(KIND_BITMAP, 0f, 0f, null, null, bitmap);
    }

    public static RenderEffect createBitmapEffect(Bitmap bitmap, Rect src, Rect dst)
    {
        return new RenderEffect(KIND_BITMAP, 0f, 0f, null, null, bitmap);
    }

    public static RenderEffect createColorFilterEffect(ColorFilter colorFilter, RenderEffect renderEffect)
    {
        return new RenderEffect(KIND_COLOR_FILTER, 0f, 0f, renderEffect, null, colorFilter);
    }

    public static RenderEffect createColorFilterEffect(ColorFilter colorFilter)
    {
        return new RenderEffect(KIND_COLOR_FILTER, 0f, 0f, null, null, colorFilter);

    public static RenderEffect createBlendModeEffect(RenderEffect dst, RenderEffect src, BlendMode blendMode)
    {
        return new RenderEffect(KIND_BLEND_MODE, 0f, 0f, dst, src, blendMode);
    }

    public static RenderEffect createChainEffect(RenderEffect outer, RenderEffect inner)
    {
        return new RenderEffect(KIND_CHAIN, 0f, 0f, inner, outer, null);
    }

    public static RenderEffect createShaderEffect(Shader shader)
    {
        return new RenderEffect(KIND_SHADER, 0f, 0f, null, null, shader);
    }

    public static RenderEffect createRuntimeShaderEffect(RuntimeShader shader, String uniformShaderName)
    {
        if (shader == null) throw new NullPointerException("The shader parameter must not be null");
        if (uniformShaderName == null) throw new NullPointerException("The uniformShaderName parameter must not be null");

        return new RenderEffect(KIND_RUNTIME_SHADER, 0f, 0f, null, null, shader);
    }
```

```java
    public boolean setPosition(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        if (mLeft == left && mTop == top && mRight == right && mBottom == bottom) return false;

        mLeft = left;
        mTop = top;
        mRight = right;
        mBottom = bottom;

        if (!mPivotExplicit)
        {
            mPivotX = (right - left) * 0.5f;
            mPivotY = (bottom - top) * 0.5f;
        }

        return true;
    }

    }

        mBottom += offset;

        return offset != 0;
    }

    private RenderEffect mRenderEffect;

    {
        if (mRenderEffect == renderEffect) return false;

        mRenderEffect = renderEffect;
        return true;
    }

    public RenderEffect getRenderEffect()
    {
        return mRenderEffect;
    }

    public boolean getUseCompositingLayer()
    {
        return mUseCompositingLayer;
    }

    public boolean setProjectBackwards(boolean value)
    {
        return true;
    }

    public boolean setProjectionReceiver(boolean value)
    {
        return true;
    }

    public boolean setRenderEffect(Object effect)
    {
        return true;
    }

    public boolean setClipRect(Rect rect)
    {
        return true;
    }

    public boolean hasIdentityMatrix()
    {
        return mTranslationX == 0 && mTranslationY == 0 && mScaleX == 1 && mScaleY == 1 && mRotationZ == 0;
    }

    public void getMatrix(Matrix into)
    {
        if (into == null) return;

        into.reset();
        into.postTranslate(-mPivotX, -mPivotY);

        if (mScaleX != 1 || mScaleY != 1) into.postScale(mScaleX, mScaleY);
        if (mRotationZ != 0) into.postRotate(mRotationZ);

        into.postTranslate(mPivotX + mTranslationX, mPivotY + mTranslationY);
    }

    public void getInverseMatrix(Matrix into)
    {
        if (into == null) return;

        Matrix forward = new Matrix();
        getMatrix(forward);

        if (!forward.invert(into)) into.reset();
    }

    void drawInto(Canvas target)
    {
        if (!mHasDisplayList || mAlpha <= 0) return;

        int saveCount = target.save();
        target.translate(mLeft, mTop);

        Matrix transform = new Matrix();
        getMatrix(transform);

        if (!transform.isIdentity()) target.concat(transform);

        if (mClipToOutline && mOutline.canClip()) clipToOutline(target);
        else if (mClipToBounds) target.clipRect(0, 0, getWidth(), getHeight());

        if (mAlpha < 1.0f) target.saveLayerAlpha(0, 0, getWidth(), getHeight(), Math.round(mAlpha * 255));

        mDisplayList.replay(target);

        target.restoreToCount(saveCount);
    }

    private void clipToOutline(Canvas target)
    {
        Rect bounds = new Rect();
        if (!mOutline.getRect(bounds)) return;

        Path shape = new Path();
        float radius = mOutline.getRadius();

        if (radius > 0)
        {
            shape.addRoundRect(bounds.left, bounds.top, bounds.right, bounds.bottom, radius, radius, Path.Direction.CW);
        }
        else
        {
            shape.addRect(bounds.left, bounds.top, bounds.right, bounds.bottom, Path.Direction.CW);
        }

        target.clipPath(shape);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "RenderNode{" + mName + "}";
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class RuntimeShader extends Shader
{
    private final String mShaderSource;
    private final Map<String, float[]> mFloatUniforms = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, int[]> mIntUniforms = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, Shader> mInputShaders = new HashMap<>();

    public RuntimeShader(String shader)
    {
        if (shader == null) throw new NullPointerException("RuntimeShader requires a non-null AGSL string");

        mShaderSource = shader;
    }

    String source()
    {
        return mShaderSource;
    }

    private static void requireName(String uniformName)
    {
        if (uniformName == null) throw new NullPointerException("The uniformName parameter must not be null");
    }

    public void setColorUniform(String uniformName, int color)
    {
        setFloatUniform(uniformName, Color.red(color) / 255.0f, Color.green(color) / 255.0f, Color.blue(color) / 255.0f,
                        Color.alpha(color) / 255.0f);
    }

    public void setColorUniform(String uniformName, long color)

        setFloatUniform(uniformName, Color.red(color), Color.green(color), Color.blue(color), Color.alpha(color));
    }

    }

        setFloatUniform(uniformName, new float[] {value1, value2, value3, value4});
    }

    public void setFloatUniform(String uniformName, float[] values)
    {
        requireName(uniformName);
        if (values == null) throw new NullPointerException("The uniform values parameter must not be null");

        mFloatUniforms.put(uniformName, values.clone());
    }

    public void setIntUniform(String uniformName, int value)
    {
        setIntUniform(uniformName, new int[] {value});
    }

        setIntUniform(uniformName, new int[] {value1, value2});
    }

    public void setIntUniform(String uniformName, int value1, int value2, int value3)

    }

    public void setIntUniform(String uniformName, int value1, int value2, int value3, int value4)

        setIntUniform(uniformName, new int[] {value1, value2, value3, value4});
    }

    public void setIntUniform(String uniformName, int[] values)
    {
        requireName(uniformName);
        if (values == null) throw new NullPointerException("The uniform values parameter must not be null");

        mIntUniforms.put(uniformName, values.clone());
    }

    public void setInputShader(String shaderName, Shader shader)
    {
        if (shaderName == null) throw new NullPointerException("The shaderName parameter must not be null");
        if (shader == null) throw new NullPointerException("The shader parameter must not be null");

        mInputShaders.put(shaderName, shader);
    }

    public void setInputBuffer(String shaderName, BitmapShader shader)
    {
        setInputShader(shaderName, shader);
    }

    @Override
    int kind()
    {
        Shader first = firstBitmapInput();
        return first == null ? KIND_NONE : first.kind();
    }

    @Override
    long bitmapHandle()
    {
        Shader first = firstBitmapInput();
        return first == null ? 0 : first.bitmapHandle();
    }

    @Override
    int tileModeId()
    {
        Shader first = firstBitmapInput();
        return first == null ? 0 : first.tileModeId();
    }

    @Override
    Matrix localMatrix()
    {
        Shader first = firstBitmapInput();
        Matrix own = super.localMatrix();

        if (first == null || first.localMatrix() == null) return own;
        if (own == null) return first.localMatrix();

        Matrix combined = new Matrix(first.localMatrix());
        combined.postConcat(own);
        return combined;
    }

    private Shader firstBitmapInput()
    {
        for (Shader input : mInputShaders.values())
        {
            if (input instanceof BitmapShader) return input;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics;

public class Shader
{
    static final int KIND_NONE = 0;
    static final int KIND_LINEAR = 1;
    static final int KIND_RADIAL = 2;

        return true;

        mLocalMatrix = matrix == null ? null : new Matrix(matrix);
    }

    Matrix localMatrix()

        return mLocalMatrix;
    }

    int kind()
    {
        return KIND_NONE;
    }

    int tileModeId()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    float startX()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    float startY()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    float endX()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    float endY()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    float radius()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    int[] stopColors()
    {
        return null;
    }

    float[] stopPositions()
    {
        return null;
    }

    long bitmapHandle()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    static int tileModeId(TileMode mode)
    {
        if (mode == TileMode.REPEAT) return 1;
        if (mode == TileMode.MIRROR) return 2;

        return 0;
    }

    static float[] evenPositions(int count)
    {
        float[] positions = new float[count];

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            positions[index] = count == 1 ? 0 : index / (float) (count - 1);
        }

        return positions;
    }

    static int[] argbColors(long[] colors)
    {
        if (colors == null) throw new NullPointerException("colors must not be null");

        int[] converted = new int[colors.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < colors.length; index++) converted[index] = Color.toArgb(colors[index]);

        return converted;
    }

    public enum TileMode
    {
        CLAMP,
        REPEAT,
        MIRROR,
        DECAL
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics;

public class SurfaceTexture
{
    private final boolean mSingleBufferMode;

    private OnFrameAvailableListener mListener;
    private android.os.Handler mHandler;
    private int mTextureName;
    private boolean mAttached;
    private boolean mReleased;
    private int mDefaultWidth;
    private int mDefaultHeight;
    private long mTimestamp;

    public SurfaceTexture(int textureName)
    {
        this(textureName, false);
    }

    public SurfaceTexture(int textureName, boolean singleBufferMode)
    {
        mTextureName = textureName;
        mSingleBufferMode = singleBufferMode;
        mAttached = true;
    }

    public SurfaceTexture(boolean singleBufferMode)
    {
        mSingleBufferMode = singleBufferMode;
        mAttached = false;
    }

    public void setOnFrameAvailableListener(OnFrameAvailableListener listener)
    {
        setOnFrameAvailableListener(listener, null);
    }

    public void setOnFrameAvailableListener(OnFrameAvailableListener listener, android.os.Handler handler)
    {
        mListener = listener;
        mHandler = handler;
    }

    public void setDefaultBufferSize(int width, int height)
    {
        mDefaultWidth = width;
        mDefaultHeight = height;
    }

    public void updateTexImage()
    {
        if (mReleased) throw new IllegalStateException("SurfaceTexture has been released");
        if (!mAttached) throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to update texture contents (see logcat for details)");

        mTimestamp = System.nanoTime();
    }

    public void releaseTexImage()
    {
        if (mReleased) throw new IllegalStateException("SurfaceTexture has been released");
    }

    public void detachFromGLContext()
    {
        if (!mAttached) throw new RuntimeException("Error during detachFromGLContext (see logcat for details)");

        mAttached = false;
    }

    public void attachToGLContext(int textureName)
    {
        if (mAttached) throw new RuntimeException("Error during attachToGLContext (see logcat for details)");

        mTextureName = textureName;
        mAttached = true;
    }

    public void getTransformMatrix(float[] matrix)
    {
        if (matrix.length != 16) throw new IllegalArgumentException();

        java.util.Arrays.fill(matrix, 0);
        matrix[0] = matrix[5] = matrix[10] = matrix[15] = 1;
    }

    public long getTimestamp()
    {
        return mTimestamp;
    }

    public int getDataSpace()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public void release()
    {
        mReleased = true;
        mListener = null;
        mHandler = null;
    }

    public boolean isReleased()
    {
        return mReleased;
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        try
        {
            release();
        }
        finally
        {
            super.finalize();
        }
    }

    void postFrameAvailable()
    {
        final OnFrameAvailableListener listener = mListener;
        if (listener == null) return;

        if (mHandler == null)
        {
            listener.onFrameAvailable(this);
            return;
        }

        mHandler.post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                listener.onFrameAvailable(SurfaceTexture.this);
            }
        });
    }

    public interface OnFrameAvailableListener
    {
        void onFrameAvailable(SurfaceTexture surfaceTexture);
    }

    public static class OutOfResourcesException extends Exception
    {
        public OutOfResourcesException()
        {
        }

        public OutOfResourcesException(String name)
        {
            super(name);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/graphics/Typeface.java`:

```java
package android.graphics;

public class Typeface
{
    public static final int NORMAL = 0;
    public static final int BOLD = 1;
    public static final int ITALIC = 2;
    public static final int BOLD_ITALIC = 3;

    private static final int WEIGHT_NORMAL = 400;
    private static final int WEIGHT_BOLD = 700;

    private static final android.util.LruCache<String, Typeface> sDynamicTypefaceCache = new android.util.LruCache<>(16);
    private static final Object sDynamicCacheLock = new Object();

    private static final android.util.LongSparseArray<android.util.SparseArray<Typeface>> sStyledTypefaceCache =
        new android.util.LongSparseArray<>(3);
    private static final Object sStyledCacheLock = new Object();

    private static final android.util.LongSparseArray<android.util.SparseArray<Typeface>> sWeightTypefaceCache =
        new android.util.LongSparseArray<>(3);
    private static final Object sWeightCacheLock = new Object();

    public static final Typeface DEFAULT = create("sans-serif", NORMAL);
    public static final Typeface DEFAULT_BOLD = create("sans-serif", BOLD);
    public static final Typeface SANS_SERIF = create("sans-serif", NORMAL);
    public static final Typeface SERIF = create("serif", NORMAL);
    public static final Typeface MONOSPACE = create("monospace", NORMAL);

    private final String mFamily;
    private final int mStyle;
    private final int mWeight;
    private final boolean mItalic;
    private final int mNativeFont;
    private final byte[] mFontData;

    private Typeface(String family, int style, int weight, boolean italic, int nativeFont)
    {
        this(family, style, weight, italic, nativeFont, null);
    }

    private Typeface(String family, int style, int weight, boolean italic, int nativeFont, byte[] fontData)
    {
        mFamily = family;
        mStyle = style;
        mWeight = weight;
        mItalic = italic;
        mNativeFont = nativeFont;
        mFontData = fontData;
    }

    private Typeface derive(int style, int weight, boolean italic)
    {
        if (mFontData == null) return build(mFamily, style, weight, italic);

        int font = loadFontData(mFontData, weight, italic);
        return new Typeface(mFamily, style, weight, italic, font == 0 ? mNativeFont : font, mFontData);
    }

    private static int loadFontData(byte[] data, int weight, boolean italic)
    {
        if (data == null || data.length == 0) return 0;

        try
        {
            return nativeLoadFromMemory(data, weight, italic);
        }
        catch (UnsatisfiedLinkError missing)
        {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public int getNativeFont()
    {
        return mNativeFont;
    }

    public String getFamily()
    {
        return mFamily;
    }

    public int getStyle()
    {
        return mStyle;
    }

    public final boolean isBold()
    {
        return (mStyle & BOLD) != 0;
    }

    public final boolean isItalic()
    {
        return mItalic;
    }

    public int getWeight()
    {
        return mWeight;
    }

    public static Typeface defaultFromStyle(int style)
    {
        return create("sans-serif", style);
    }

    public static Typeface create(Typeface family, int style)
    {
        if ((style & ~BOLD_ITALIC) != 0) style = NORMAL;
        if (family == null) family = DEFAULT;
        if (family == null) return create("sans-serif", style);
        if (family.mStyle == style) return family;

        synchronized (sStyledCacheLock)
        {
            android.util.SparseArray<Typeface> styles = sStyledTypefaceCache.get(family.mNativeFont);

            if (styles == null)
            {
                styles = new android.util.SparseArray<>(4);
                sStyledTypefaceCache.put(family.mNativeFont, styles);
            }

            Typeface cached = styles.get(style);
            if (cached != null && cached.mFamily.equals(family.mFamily)) return cached;

            int weight = (style & BOLD) != 0 ? WEIGHT_BOLD : WEIGHT_NORMAL;
            Typeface created = family.derive(style, weight, (style & ITALIC) != 0);
            styles.put(style, created);

            return created;
        }
    }

    public static Typeface create(Typeface family, int weight, boolean italic)
    {
        if (weight < 1 || weight > 1000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("weight is out of range of [1, 1000] (too big)");
        if (family == null) family = DEFAULT;

        String name = family == null ? "sans-serif" : family.mFamily;
        int style = (weight >= WEIGHT_BOLD ? BOLD : NORMAL) | (italic ? ITALIC : NORMAL);
        if (family == null) return build(name, style, weight, italic);

        int key = (weight << 1) | (italic ? 1 : 0);

        synchronized (sWeightCacheLock)
        {
            android.util.SparseArray<Typeface> variants = sWeightTypefaceCache.get(family.mNativeFont);

            if (variants == null)
            {
                variants = new android.util.SparseArray<>(4);
                sWeightTypefaceCache.put(family.mNativeFont, variants);
            }

            Typeface cached = variants.get(key);
            if (cached != null && cached.mFamily.equals(name)) return cached;

            Typeface created = family.derive(style, weight, italic);
            variants.put(key, created);

            return created;
        }
    }

    public static Typeface create(String familyName, int style)
    {
        int weight = (style & BOLD) != 0 ? WEIGHT_BOLD : WEIGHT_NORMAL;
        boolean italic = (style & ITALIC) != 0;
        return build(familyName, style, weight, italic);
    }

    private static Typeface build(String familyName, int style, int weight, boolean italic)
    {
        String family = familyName == null || familyName.isEmpty() ? "sans-serif" : familyName;
        int font = runtime.TextMeasurers.get().resolveFamily(family, weight, italic);
        return new Typeface(family, style, weight, italic, font);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof Typeface)) return false;

        Typeface typeface = (Typeface)other;
        return mStyle == typeface.mStyle && mWeight == typeface.mWeight && mItalic == typeface.mItalic
               && mFamily.equals(typeface.mFamily);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mFamily.hashCode() * 31 + mStyle * 7 + mWeight + (mItalic ? 1 : 0);
    }

    public static final class CustomFallbackBuilder
    {
        private static final int SLANT_MISMATCH_PENALTY = 1000;

        private int mWeight = 400;
        private boolean mItalic;
        private String mSystemFallback = "sans-serif";
        private final android.graphics.fonts.FontFamily mFamily;

        public CustomFallbackBuilder(android.graphics.fonts.FontFamily family)
        {
            java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(family, "family can not be null");
            mFamily = family;
        }

        public static int getMaxCustomFallbackCount()
        {
            return 64;
        }

        public CustomFallbackBuilder addCustomFallback(android.graphics.fonts.FontFamily family)
        {
            return this;
        }

        public CustomFallbackBuilder setSystemFallback(String familyName)
        {
            if (familyName != null) mSystemFallback = familyName;
            return this;
        }

        public CustomFallbackBuilder setStyle(android.graphics.fonts.FontStyle style)
        {
            if (style == null) return this;

            mWeight = style.getWeight();
            mItalic = style.getSlant() == android.graphics.fonts.FontStyle.FONT_SLANT_ITALIC;

            return this;
        }

        public Typeface build()
        {
            android.graphics.fonts.Font chosen = closestFont();
            if (chosen == null) return Typeface.create(mSystemFallback, mItalic ? Typeface.ITALIC : Typeface.NORMAL);

            return new Builder(chosen).setWeight(mWeight).setItalic(mItalic).setFallback(mSystemFallback).build();
        }

        private android.graphics.fonts.Font closestFont()
        {
            android.graphics.fonts.Font chosen = null;
            int bestScore = Integer.MAX_VALUE;

            for (int index = 0; index < mFamily.getSize(); index++)
            {
                android.graphics.fonts.Font font = mFamily.getFont(index);
                if (font == null || font.getStyle() == null) continue;

                boolean italic = font.getStyle().getSlant() == android.graphics.fonts.FontStyle.FONT_SLANT_ITALIC;
                int score = Math.abs(font.getStyle().getWeight() - mWeight) + (italic == mItalic ? 0 : SLANT_MISMATCH_PENALTY);

                if (score >= bestScore) continue;

                bestScore = score;
                chosen = font;
            }

            return chosen;
        }
    }

    public final String getSystemFontFamilyName()
    {
        return mFamily;
    }

    public static Typeface createFromAsset(android.content.res.AssetManager manager, String path)
    {
        if (path == null) throw new NullPointerException();

        String key = "asset:" + path;

        synchronized (sDynamicCacheLock)
        {
            Typeface cached = sDynamicTypefaceCache.get(key);
            if (cached != null) return cached;

            Typeface created = new Builder(manager, path).build();
            sDynamicTypefaceCache.put(key, created);

            return created;
        }
    }

    public static Typeface createFromFile(java.io.File file)
    {
        if (file == null) throw new NullPointerException();

        return new Builder(file).build();
    }

    public static Typeface createFromFile(String path)
    {
        if (path == null) throw new NullPointerException();

        return createFromFile(new java.io.File(path));
    }

    private static int weightFromName(String name)
    {
        if (name == null) return WEIGHT_NORMAL;

        String lower = name.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
        if (lower.contains("thin") || lower.contains("hairline")) return 100;
        if (lower.contains("extralight") || lower.contains("ultralight")) return 200;
        if (lower.contains("semibold") || lower.contains("demibold")) return 600;
        if (lower.contains("extrabold") || lower.contains("ultrabold")) return 800;
        if (lower.contains("black") || lower.contains("heavy")) return 900;
        if (lower.contains("light")) return 300;
        if (lower.contains("medium")) return 500;
        if (lower.contains("bold")) return WEIGHT_BOLD;
        return WEIGHT_NORMAL;
    }

    private static boolean italicFromName(String name)
    {
        if (name == null) return false;

        String lower = name.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
        return lower.contains("italic") || lower.contains("oblique");
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private String mFamily = "sans-serif";
        private int mWeight = WEIGHT_NORMAL;
        private boolean mItalic;
        private String mFontVariationSettings;
        private String mSource;
        private byte[] mData;

        public Builder(java.io.File path)
        {
            this(path == null ? null : path.getName());
            if (path == null) return;

            mSource = path.getPath();
            mData = readFile(path);
        }

        public Builder(java.io.FileDescriptor descriptor)
        {
            if (descriptor == null) return;

            mSource = "fd/" + System.identityHashCode(descriptor);

            try
            {
                mData = readStream(new java.io.FileInputStream(descriptor), false);
            }
            catch (java.io.IOException failure)
            {
                mData = null;
            }
        }

        public Builder(String path)
        {
            if (path == null) return;

            mWeight = weightFromName(path);
            mItalic = italicFromName(path);

            if (mSource != null) return;

            java.io.File file = new java.io.File(path);
            if (!file.isFile()) return;

            mSource = file.getPath();
            mData = readFile(file);
        }

        public Builder(android.content.res.AssetManager assets, String path)
        {
            this(assets, path, true, 0);
        }

        public Builder(android.content.res.AssetManager assets, String path, boolean isAsset, int cookie)
        {
            if (path == null) return;

            mWeight = weightFromName(path);
            mItalic = italicFromName(path);
            mSource = (isAsset ? "asset:" : "res:") + path;

            if (assets == null) return;

            try
            {
                mData = readStream(isAsset ? assets.open(path) : assets.openNonAsset(path), true);
            }
            catch (java.io.IOException failure)
            {
                mData = null;
            }
        }

        public Builder(android.graphics.fonts.Font font)
        {
            if (font == null || font.getStyle() == null) return;

            mWeight = font.getStyle().getWeight();
            mItalic = font.getStyle().getSlant() == android.graphics.fonts.FontStyle.FONT_SLANT_ITALIC;

            java.io.File file = font.getFile();
            if (file != null)
            {
                mSource = file.getPath();
                mData = readFile(file);
                return;
            }

            java.nio.ByteBuffer buffer = font.getBuffer();
            if (buffer == null || buffer.remaining() == 0) return;

            byte[] data = new byte[buffer.remaining()];
            buffer.duplicate().get(data);

            mSource = "font/" + font.getSourceIdentifier();
            mData = data;
        }

        private static byte[] readFile(java.io.File file)
        {
            try
            {
                return readStream(new java.io.FileInputStream(file), true);
            }
            catch (java.io.IOException failure)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static byte[] readStream(java.io.InputStream stream, boolean close) throws java.io.IOException
        {
            try
            {
                java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream collected = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
                byte[] chunk = new byte[16384];

                int read;
                while ((read = stream.read(chunk)) > 0) collected.write(chunk, 0, read);

                return collected.toByteArray();
            }
            finally
            {
                if (close) stream.close();
            }
        }

        public Builder setWeight(int weight)
        {
            mWeight = weight;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setFontVariationSettings(android.graphics.fonts.FontVariationAxis[] axes)
        {
            mFontVariationSettings = android.graphics.fonts.FontVariationAxis.toFontVariationSettings(axes);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setItalic(boolean italic)
        {
            mItalic = italic;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setFallback(String familyName)
        {
            if (familyName != null) mFamily = familyName;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setTtcIndex(int index)
        {
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setFontVariationSettings(String settings)
        {
            android.graphics.fonts.FontVariationAxis.fromFontVariationSettings(settings);
            mFontVariationSettings = settings;
            return this;
        }

        public Typeface build()
        {
            int style = (mWeight >= WEIGHT_BOLD ? BOLD : NORMAL) | (mItalic ? ITALIC : NORMAL);
            int font = loadFontData(mData, mWeight, mItalic);

            if (font != 0) return new Typeface(mSource, style, mWeight, mItalic, font, mData);

            return Typeface.build(mFamily, style, mWeight, mItalic);
        }
    }

    public static native int nativeResolveFamily(String familyName, int weight, boolean italic);

    public static native int nativeWeight(int font);

    public static native boolean nativeIsItalic(int font);

    private static native int nativeLoadFromMemory(byte[] data, int weight, boolean italic);
}
```

`java/android/graphics/YuvImage.java`:

```java
package android.graphics;

import java.io.OutputStream;

public class YuvImage
{
    private final byte[] mData;
    private final int mFormat;
    private final int[] mStrides;
    private final int mWidth;
    private final int mHeight;
    private final ColorSpace mColorSpace;

    public YuvImage(byte[] yuv, int format, int width, int height, int[] strides)
    {
        this(yuv, format, width, height, strides, ColorSpace.get(ColorSpace.Named.SRGB));
    }

    public YuvImage(byte[] yuv, int format, int width, int height, int[] strides, ColorSpace colorSpace)
    {
        if (format != ImageFormat.NV21 && format != ImageFormat.YUY2 && format != ImageFormat.YCBCR_P010
            && format != ImageFormat.YUV_420_888)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("only supports the following ImageFormat:NV21, YUY2, YCBCR_P010 and YUV_420_888");
        }

        if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("width and height must large than 0");
        if (yuv == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("yuv cannot be null");
        if (colorSpace == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ColorSpace cannot be null");

        mStrides = strides == null ? calculateStrides(width, format) : strides;
        mData = yuv;
        mFormat = format;
        mWidth = width;
        mHeight = height;
        mColorSpace = colorSpace;
    }

    public boolean compressToJpeg(Rect rectangle, int quality, OutputStream stream)
    {
        if (mFormat != ImageFormat.NV21 && mFormat != ImageFormat.YUY2)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only ImageFormat.NV21 and ImageFormat.YUY2 are supported.");

        Rect wholeImage = new Rect(0, 0, mWidth, mHeight);
        if (!wholeImage.contains(rectangle)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("rectangle is not inside the image");
        if (quality < 0 || quality > 100) throw new IllegalArgumentException("quality must be 0..100");
        if (stream == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("stream cannot be null");

        int left = rectangle.left & ~1;
        int top = rectangle.top & ~1;
        int width = Math.max(1, rectangle.right - left);
        int height = Math.max(1, rectangle.bottom - top);

        int[] pixels = new int[width * height];

        for (int row = 0; row < height; row++)
        {
            int y = top + row;

            for (int column = 0; column < width; column++)
            {
                int x = left + column;
                int luma;
                int blue;
                int red;

                if (mFormat == ImageFormat.NV21)
                {
                    luma = mData[y * mStrides[0] + x] & 0xFF;
                    int chroma = mStrides[0] * mHeight + (y >> 1) * mStrides[1] + (x & ~1);
                    red = (mData[chroma] & 0xFF) - 128;
                    blue = (mData[chroma + 1] & 0xFF) - 128;
                }
                else
                {
                    int pair = y * mStrides[0] + (x & ~1) * 2;
                    luma = mData[pair + ((x & 1) == 0 ? 0 : 2)] & 0xFF;
                    blue = (mData[pair + 1] & 0xFF) - 128;
                    red = (mData[pair + 3] & 0xFF) - 128;
                }

                pixels[row * width + column] = toArgb(luma, blue, red);
            }
        }

        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(pixels, width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);

        try
        {
            return bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, quality, stream);
        }
        finally
        {
            bitmap.recycle();
        }
    }

    public boolean compressToJpegR(YuvImage sdr, int quality, OutputStream stream)
    {
        if (sdr == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SDR input cannot be null");
        if (mData.length == 0 || sdr.getYuvData().length == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Input images cannot be empty");
        if (mFormat != ImageFormat.YCBCR_P010 || sdr.getYuvFormat() != ImageFormat.YUV_420_888)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("only support ImageFormat.YCBCR_P010 and ImageFormat.YUV_420_888");
        if (sdr.getWidth() != mWidth || sdr.getHeight() != mHeight) throw new IllegalArgumentException("HDR and SDR resolution mismatch");
        if (quality < 0 || quality > 100) throw new IllegalArgumentException("quality must be 0..100");
        if (stream == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("stream cannot be null");

        int[] pixels = new int[mWidth * mHeight];
        byte[] data = sdr.mData;
        int lumaStride = sdr.mStrides[0];
        int chromaStride = sdr.mStrides.length > 1 ? sdr.mStrides[1] : mWidth >> 1;
        int lumaSize = lumaStride * mHeight;
        int chromaSize = chromaStride * ((mHeight + 1) >> 1);

        for (int y = 0; y < mHeight; y++)
        {
            for (int x = 0; x < mWidth; x++)
            {
                int luma = data[y * lumaStride + x] & 0xFF;
                int chroma = (y >> 1) * chromaStride + (x >> 1);
                int blue = lumaSize + chroma < data.length ? (data[lumaSize + chroma] & 0xFF) - 128 : 0;
                int red = lumaSize + chromaSize + chroma < data.length ? (data[lumaSize + chromaSize + chroma] & 0xFF) - 128 : 0;
                pixels[y * mWidth + x] = toArgb(luma, blue, red);
            }
        }

        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(pixels, mWidth, mHeight, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);

        try
        {
            return bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, quality, stream);
        }
        finally
        {
            bitmap.recycle();
        }
    }

    private static int toArgb(int luma, int blue, int red)
    {
        float y = luma;
        int r = clamp(Math.round(y + 1.402f * red));
        int g = clamp(Math.round(y - 0.344136f * blue - 0.714136f * red));
        int b = clamp(Math.round(y + 1.772f * blue));
        return 0xFF000000 | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
    }

    private static int clamp(int value)
    {
        return value < 0 ? 0 : value > 255 ? 255 : value;
    }

    public byte[] getYuvData()
    {
        return mData;
    }

    public int getYuvFormat()
    {
        return mFormat;
    }

    public int[] getStrides()
    {
        return mStrides;
    }

    public int getWidth()
    {
        return mWidth;
    }

    public int getHeight()
    {
        return mHeight;
    }

    public ColorSpace getColorSpace()
    {
        return mColorSpace;
    }

    private static int[] calculateStrides(int width, int format)
    {
        if (format == ImageFormat.NV21) return new int[] {width, width};
        if (format == ImageFormat.YCBCR_P010) return new int[] {width * 2, width * 2};
        if (format == ImageFormat.YUV_420_888) return new int[] {width, (width + 1) / 2, (width + 1) / 2};

        return new int[] {width * 2};
    }
}
```

`java/android/graphics/drawable/AdaptiveIconDrawable.java`:

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.BlendMode;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.ColorFilter;
import android.graphics.Outline;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.graphics.PixelFormat;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.graphics.Region;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class AdaptiveIconDrawable extends Drawable implements Drawable.Callback
{
    private static final float EXTRA_INSET_PERCENTAGE = 1 / 4f;
    private static final float DEFAULT_VIEW_PORT_SCALE = 1f / (1 + 2 * EXTRA_INSET_PERCENTAGE);
    private static final float MASK_CORNER_FRACTION = 0.25f;

    private final Path mMask = new Path();
    private final Rect mLayerBounds = new Rect();
    private final Rect mHotspotBounds = new Rect();

    private Drawable mBackground;
    private Drawable mForeground;
    private Drawable mMonochrome;
    private int mOpacityOverride = PixelFormat.UNKNOWN;
    private boolean mAutoMirrored;
    private boolean mHasHotspotBounds;
    private boolean mMutated;

    AdaptiveIconDrawable()
    {
    }

    public AdaptiveIconDrawable(Drawable backgroundDrawable, Drawable foregroundDrawable)
    {
        this(backgroundDrawable, foregroundDrawable, null);
    }

    public AdaptiveIconDrawable(Drawable backgroundDrawable, Drawable foregroundDrawable, Drawable monochromeDrawable)
    {
        mBackground = attach(backgroundDrawable);
        mForeground = attach(foregroundDrawable);
        mMonochrome = attach(monochromeDrawable);
    }

    private Drawable attach(Drawable drawable)
    {
        if (drawable == null) return null;

        drawable.setCallback(this);
        drawable.setVisible(isVisible(), true);
        drawable.setState(getState());
        drawable.setLevel(getLevel());
        drawable.setLayoutDirection(getLayoutDirection());
        if (!mLayerBounds.isEmpty()) drawable.setBounds(mLayerBounds);
        return drawable;
    }

    private void forEach(java.util.function.Consumer<Drawable> action)
    {
        if (mBackground != null) action.accept(mBackground);
        if (mForeground != null) action.accept(mForeground);
        if (mMonochrome != null) action.accept(mMonochrome);
    }

    public static float getExtraInsetFraction()
    {
        return EXTRA_INSET_PERCENTAGE;
    }

    public Path getIconMask()
    {
        buildMask(getBounds());
        return mMask;
    }

    public Drawable getForeground()
    {
        return mForeground;
    }

    public Drawable getBackground()
    {
        return mBackground;
    }

    public Drawable getMonochrome()
    {
        return mMonochrome;
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        super.inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);

        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= outerDepth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            String name = parser.getName();

            if (!"background".equals(name) && !"foreground".equals(name) && !"monochrome".equals(name))
            {
                DrawableInflater.skipElement(parser);
                continue;
            }

            Drawable layer = DrawableInflater.itemDrawable(resources, parser, attributes, theme);

            if ("background".equals(name)) mBackground = attach(layer);
            else if ("foreground".equals(name)) mForeground = attach(layer);
            else mMonochrome = attach(layer);
        }

        updateLayerBounds(getBounds());
    }

    private void buildMask(Rect bounds)
    {
        mMask.reset();

        float radius = Math.min(bounds.width(), bounds.height()) * MASK_CORNER_FRACTION;
        mMask.addRoundRect(bounds.left, bounds.top, bounds.right, bounds.bottom, radius, radius, Path.Direction.CW);
    }

    private void updateLayerBounds(Rect bounds)
    {
        if (bounds.isEmpty()) return;

        int centreX = bounds.centerX();
        int centreY = bounds.centerY();
        int halfWidth = (int) (bounds.width() / (DEFAULT_VIEW_PORT_SCALE * 2));
        int halfHeight = (int) (bounds.height() / (DEFAULT_VIEW_PORT_SCALE * 2));

        mLayerBounds.set(centreX - halfWidth, centreY - halfHeight, centreX + halfWidth, centreY + halfHeight);

        forEach(layer -> layer.setBounds(mLayerBounds));
        buildMask(bounds);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onBoundsChange(Rect bounds)
    {
        if (bounds.isEmpty()) return;

        updateLayerBounds(bounds);
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        if (bounds.width() <= 0 || bounds.height() <= 0) return;

        if (mLayerBounds.isEmpty()) updateLayerBounds(bounds);
        buildMask(bounds);

        int saveCount = canvas.save();
        canvas.clipPath(mMask);

        if (mBackground != null) mBackground.draw(canvas);
        if (mForeground != null) mForeground.draw(canvas);

        canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
    }

    @Override
    public void invalidateSelf()
    {
        super.invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public void getOutline(Outline outline)
    {
        buildMask(getBounds());
        outline.setPath(mMask);
    }

    @Override
    public Region getTransparentRegion()
    {
        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        if (bounds.isEmpty()) return null;

        buildMask(bounds);

        Region transparent = new Region(bounds);
        Region opaque = new Region();
        opaque.setPath(mMask, new Region(bounds));
        transparent.op(opaque, Region.Op.DIFFERENCE);
        return transparent;
    }

    @Override
    public void applyTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        super.applyTheme(theme);

        forEach(layer ->
        {
            if (layer.canApplyTheme()) layer.applyTheme(theme);
        });
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canApplyTheme()
    {
        return mBackground != null && mBackground.canApplyTheme() || mForeground != null && mForeground.canApplyTheme()
               || mMonochrome != null && mMonochrome.canApplyTheme() || super.canApplyTheme();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isProjected()
    {
        if (super.isProjected()) return true;

        return mBackground != null && mBackground.isProjected() || mForeground != null && mForeground.isProjected();
    }

    @Override
    public void invalidateDrawable(Drawable who)
    {
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public void scheduleDrawable(Drawable who, Runnable what, long when)
    {
        scheduleSelf(what, when);
    }

    @Override
    public void unscheduleDrawable(Drawable who, Runnable what)
    {
        unscheduleSelf(what);
    }

    @Override
    public int getChangingConfigurations()
    {
        int configurations = super.getChangingConfigurations();
        if (mBackground != null) configurations |= mBackground.getChangingConfigurations();
        if (mForeground != null) configurations |= mForeground.getChangingConfigurations();
        if (mMonochrome != null) configurations |= mMonochrome.getChangingConfigurations();
        return configurations;
    }

    @Override
    public void setHotspot(float x, float y)
    {
        forEach(layer -> layer.setHotspot(x, y));
    }

    @Override
    public void setHotspotBounds(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        mHotspotBounds.set(left, top, right, bottom);
        mHasHotspotBounds = true;
        forEach(layer -> layer.setHotspotBounds(left, top, right, bottom));
    }

    @Override
    public void getHotspotBounds(Rect outRect)
    {
        if (mHasHotspotBounds) outRect.set(mHotspotBounds);
        else super.getHotspotBounds(outRect);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean setVisible(boolean visible, boolean restart)
    {
        boolean changed = super.setVisible(visible, restart);
        forEach(layer -> layer.setVisible(visible, restart));
        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    public void setDither(boolean dither)
    {
        forEach(layer -> layer.setDither(dither));
    }

    @Override
    public void setAlpha(int alpha)
    {
        super.setAlpha(alpha);
        forEach(layer -> layer.setAlpha(alpha));
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public int getAlpha()
    {
        return super.getAlpha();
    }

    @Override
    public void setColorFilter(ColorFilter filter)
    {
        super.setColorFilter(filter);
        forEach(layer -> layer.setColorFilter(filter));
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintList(ColorStateList tint)
    {
        forEach(layer -> layer.setTintList(tint));
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintBlendMode(BlendMode blendMode)
    {
        forEach(layer -> layer.setTintBlendMode(blendMode));
    }

    public void setOpacity(int opacity)
    {
        mOpacityOverride = opacity;
    }

    @Override
    public int getOpacity()
    {
        return mOpacityOverride != PixelFormat.UNKNOWN ? mOpacityOverride : PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;
    }

    @Override
    public void setAutoMirrored(boolean mirrored)
    {
        mAutoMirrored = mirrored;
        forEach(layer -> layer.setAutoMirrored(mirrored));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAutoMirrored()
    {
        return mAutoMirrored;
    }

    @Override
    public void jumpToCurrentState()
    {
        forEach(Drawable::jumpToCurrentState);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isStateful()
    {
        return mBackground != null && mBackground.isStateful() || mForeground != null && mForeground.isStateful();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasFocusStateSpecified()
    {
        return mBackground != null && mBackground.hasFocusStateSpecified()
               || mForeground != null && mForeground.hasFocusStateSpecified();
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onStateChange(int[] stateSet)
    {
        boolean changed = false;

        if (mBackground != null && mBackground.isStateful() && mBackground.setState(stateSet)) changed = true;
        if (mForeground != null && mForeground.isStateful() && mForeground.setState(stateSet)) changed = true;
        if (mMonochrome != null && mMonochrome.isStateful() && mMonochrome.setState(stateSet)) changed = true;

        if (changed) invalidateSelf();
        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onLevelChange(int level)
    {
        boolean changed = false;

        if (mBackground != null && mBackground.setLevel(level)) changed = true;
        if (mForeground != null && mForeground.setLevel(level)) changed = true;
        if (mMonochrome != null && mMonochrome.setLevel(level)) changed = true;

        if (changed) invalidateSelf();
        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onLayoutDirectionChanged(int layoutDirection)
    {
        boolean changed = false;

        if (mBackground != null && mBackground.setLayoutDirection(layoutDirection)) changed = true;
        if (mForeground != null && mForeground.setLayoutDirection(layoutDirection)) changed = true;
        if (mMonochrome != null && mMonochrome.setLayoutDirection(layoutDirection)) changed = true;

        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicWidth()
    {
        int widest = Math.max(mBackground == null ? -1 : mBackground.getIntrinsicWidth(),
                              mForeground == null ? -1 : mForeground.getIntrinsicWidth());
        return widest < 0 ? -1 : (int) (widest * DEFAULT_VIEW_PORT_SCALE);
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicHeight()
    {
        int tallest = Math.max(mBackground == null ? -1 : mBackground.getIntrinsicHeight(),
                               mForeground == null ? -1 : mForeground.getIntrinsicHeight());
        return tallest < 0 ? -1 : (int) (tallest * DEFAULT_VIEW_PORT_SCALE);
    }

    @Override
    public ConstantState getConstantState()
    {
        ConstantState background = stateOf(mBackground);
        ConstantState foreground = stateOf(mForeground);
        ConstantState monochrome = stateOf(mMonochrome);

        if (mBackground != null && background == null) return null;
        if (mForeground != null && foreground == null) return null;
        if (mMonochrome != null && monochrome == null) return null;

        return new LayerState(background, foreground, monochrome, mOpacityOverride, mAutoMirrored, getChangingConfigurations());
    }

    private static ConstantState stateOf(Drawable drawable)
    {
        return drawable == null ? null : drawable.getConstantState();
    }

    @Override
    public Drawable mutate()
    {
        if (!mMutated && super.mutate() == this)
        {
            forEach(Drawable::mutate);
            mMutated = true;
        }

        return this;
    }

    private static final class LayerState extends ConstantState
    {
        private final ConstantState mBackground;
        private final ConstantState mForeground;
        private final ConstantState mMonochrome;
        private final int mOpacityOverride;
        private final boolean mAutoMirrored;
        private final int mChangingConfigurations;

        LayerState(ConstantState background, ConstantState foreground, ConstantState monochrome, int opacityOverride,
                   boolean autoMirrored, int changingConfigurations)
        {
            mBackground = background;
            mForeground = foreground;
            mMonochrome = monochrome;
            mOpacityOverride = opacityOverride;
            mAutoMirrored = autoMirrored;
            mChangingConfigurations = changingConfigurations;
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable()
        {
            return newDrawable(null, null);
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable(Resources resources)
        {
            return newDrawable(resources, null);
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme)
        {
            AdaptiveIconDrawable drawable = new AdaptiveIconDrawable(create(mBackground, resources, theme),
                                                                     create(mForeground, resources, theme),
                                                                     create(mMonochrome, resources, theme));
            drawable.mOpacityOverride = mOpacityOverride;
            drawable.mAutoMirrored = mAutoMirrored;
            drawable.setChangingConfigurations(mChangingConfigurations);
            return drawable;
        }

        private static Drawable create(ConstantState state, Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme)
        {
            return state == null ? null : state.newDrawable(resources, theme);
        }

        @Override
        public int getChangingConfigurations()
        {
            return mChangingConfigurations;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean canApplyTheme()
        {
            return mBackground != null && mBackground.canApplyTheme() || mForeground != null && mForeground.canApplyTheme()
                   || mMonochrome != null && mMonochrome.canApplyTheme();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.ColorFilter;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.PixelFormat;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.graphics.RectF;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

import java.util.ArrayList;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class AnimatedImageDrawable extends Drawable implements Animatable2
{
    public static final int REPEAT_INFINITE = -1;

    private final ArrayList<AnimationCallback> mCallbacks = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Paint mPaint = new Paint(Paint.FILTER_BITMAP_FLAG);

    private Bitmap mFrame;
    private int mRepeatCount = REPEAT_INFINITE;
    private boolean mRunning;
    private boolean mAutoMirrored;

    public AnimatedImageDrawable()
    {
    }

    public AnimatedImageDrawable(Resources resources, Bitmap frame)
    {
        mFrame = frame;
    }

    public void setRepeatCount(int repeatCount)
    {
        if (repeatCount < REPEAT_INFINITE) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid value passed to setRepeatCount" + repeatCount);

        mRepeatCount = repeatCount;
    }

    public int getRepeatCount()
    {
        return mRepeatCount;
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        int source = DrawableInflater.reference(attributes, "src", 0);
        if (source != 0) mFrame = resources.getBitmap(source);

        mRepeatCount = DrawableInflater.integer(attributes, "repeatCount", mRepeatCount);
        mAutoMirrored = DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "autoMirrored", false);

        boolean autoStart = DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "autoStart", false);
        if (autoStart) start();
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicWidth()
    {
        return mFrame == null ? -1 : mFrame.getWidth();
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicHeight()
    {
        return mFrame == null ? -1 : mFrame.getHeight();
    }

    @Override

    {
        if (mFrame == null) return;

        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        if (bounds.isEmpty()) return;

        mPaint.setAlpha(getAlpha());
        mPaint.setColorFilter(getColorFilter());
        canvas.drawBitmap(mFrame, null, new RectF(bounds), mPaint);
    }

    @Override
    public void setAlpha(int alpha)
    {
        if (alpha < 0 || alpha > 255) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Alpha must be between 0 and 255! provided " + alpha);

        super.setAlpha(alpha);
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    }

        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public ColorFilter getColorFilter()
    {
        return super.getColorFilter();
    }

    @Override

    }

    @Override

    {
        mAutoMirrored = mirrored;
    }

    @Override
    public final boolean isAutoMirrored()
    {
        return mAutoMirrored;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onLayoutDirectionChanged(int layoutDirection)
    {
        return mAutoMirrored;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isRunning()
    {
        return mRunning;
    }

    @Override
    public void start()
    {
        if (mRunning) return;

        mRunning = true;
        for (AnimationCallback callback : new ArrayList<>(mCallbacks)) callback.onAnimationStart(this);

        if (mRepeatCount == REPEAT_INFINITE) return;

        android.os.Looper looper = android.os.Looper.myLooper();
        new android.os.Handler(looper != null ? looper : android.os.Looper.getMainLooper()).post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                stop();
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void stop()
    {
        if (!mRunning) return;

        mRunning = false;
        for (AnimationCallback callback : new ArrayList<>(mCallbacks)) callback.onAnimationEnd(this);
    }

    @Override
    public void registerAnimationCallback(AnimationCallback callback)
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new NullPointerException("callback");
        if (!mCallbacks.contains(callback)) mCallbacks.add(callback);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean unregisterAnimationCallback(AnimationCallback callback)
    {
        return mCallbacks.remove(callback);
    }

    @Override
    public void clearAnimationCallbacks()
    {
        mCallbacks.clear();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onBoundsChange(Rect bounds)
    {
        invalidateSelf();
    }
}
```
