`java/android/graphics/drawable/AnimatedStateListDrawable.java`:

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

import java.util.ArrayList;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class AnimatedStateListDrawable extends StateListDrawable
{
    private static final long DEFAULT_TRANSITION_MILLIS = 300;
    private static final int ATTRIBUTE_ID = 0x010100d0;
    private static final int ATTRIBUTE_DRAWABLE = 0x01010199;

    private final Drawable.Callback mForwarder = new Forwarder();

    private final Runnable mFinisher = new Runnable()
    {
        @Override
        public void run()
        {
            endTransition();
        }
    };

    private final Animatable2.AnimationCallback mTransitionCallback = new Animatable2.AnimationCallback()
    {
        @Override
        public void onAnimationEnd(Drawable drawable)
        {
            if (drawable == mActiveTransition) endTransition();
        }
    };

    private Drawable mActiveTransition;
    private Handler mHandler;
    private AnimatedStateListState mAnimatedState;
    private boolean mMutated;

    public AnimatedStateListDrawable()
    {
        this(null, null);
    }

    private AnimatedStateListDrawable(AnimatedStateListState state, Resources resources)
    {
        super(null);

        AnimatedStateListState created = new AnimatedStateListState(state, this, resources);
        setConstantState(created);
        onStateChange(getState());
        jumpToCurrentState();
    }

    @Override
    public void addState(int[] stateSet, Drawable drawable)
    {
        addState(stateSet, drawable, 0);
    }

    public void addState(int[] stateSet, Drawable drawable, int id)
    {
        if (drawable == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Drawable must not be null");

        mAnimatedState.addStateSet(stateSet == null ? android.util.StateSet.WILD_CARD : stateSet, drawable, id);
        onStateChange(getState());
    }

    public <T extends Drawable & Animatable> void addTransition(int fromId, int toId, T transition, boolean reversible)
    {
        if (transition == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Transition drawable must not be null");

        mAnimatedState.mTransitions.add(new Transition(fromId, toId, transition, reversible));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isStateful()
    {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onStateChange(int[] stateSet)
    {
        if (mAnimatedState == null) return super.onStateChange(stateSet);

        int previous = idAt(getCurrentIndex());
        boolean changed = super.onStateChange(stateSet);
        int next = idAt(getCurrentIndex());

        if (previous != next && previous != 0 && next != 0) beginTransition(previous, next);

        return changed;
    }

    private int idAt(int index)
    {
        if (mAnimatedState == null || index < 0 || index >= mAnimatedState.getChildCount()) return 0;

        return mAnimatedState.mStateIds[index];
    }

    @Override
    public void applyTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        super.applyTheme(theme);
    }

    @Override
    public Drawable mutate()
    {
        if (!mMutated && super.mutate() == this)
        {
            mAnimatedState.mStateIds = mAnimatedState.mStateIds.clone();

            for (Transition transition : mAnimatedState.mTransitions) transition.drawable.mutate();

            mMutated = true;
        }

        return this;
    }

    @Override
    protected void setConstantState(DrawableContainerState state)
    {
        super.setConstantState(state);

        if (state instanceof AnimatedStateListState) mAnimatedState = (AnimatedStateListState) state;
    }

    private static final class AnimatedStateListState extends StateListState
    {
        private int[] mStateIds;
        private ArrayList<Transition> mTransitions = new ArrayList<>();

        AnimatedStateListState(AnimatedStateListState original, AnimatedStateListDrawable owner, Resources resources)
        {
            super(original, owner, resources);

            mStateIds = new int[mDrawables.length];

            if (original == null) return;

            System.arraycopy(original.mStateIds, 0, mStateIds, 0, Math.min(original.mStateIds.length, mStateIds.length));

            for (Transition transition : original.mTransitions)
            {
                ConstantState state = transition.drawable.getConstantState();
                Drawable copy = state == null ? transition.drawable : state.newDrawable(resources);
                mTransitions.add(new Transition(transition.fromId, transition.toId, copy, transition.reversible));
            }
        }

        int addStateSet(int[] stateSet, Drawable drawable, int id)
        {
            int position = addStateSet(stateSet, drawable);
            mStateIds[position] = id;
            return position;
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable()
        {
            return new AnimatedStateListDrawable(this, null);
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable(Resources resources)
        {
            return new AnimatedStateListDrawable(this, resources);
        }

        @Override
        public void growArray(int oldSize, int newSize)
        {
            super.growArray(oldSize, newSize);

            int[] grown = new int[newSize];
            System.arraycopy(mStateIds, 0, grown, 0, Math.min(oldSize, mStateIds.length));
            mStateIds = grown;
        }
    }

    private void beginTransition(int fromId, int toId)
    {
        endTransition();

        for (Transition transition : mAnimatedState.mTransitions)
        {
            if (transition.fromId != fromId || transition.toId != toId) continue;

            Drawable drawable = transition.drawable;
            drawable.setCallback(mForwarder);
            drawable.setBounds(getBounds());
            drawable.setAlpha(getAlpha());
            drawable.setVisible(isVisible(), true);

            mActiveTransition = drawable;

            if (drawable instanceof Animatable2) ((Animatable2) drawable).registerAnimationCallback(mTransitionCallback);

            ((Animatable) drawable).start();

            if (!(drawable instanceof Animatable2)) handler().postDelayed(mFinisher, durationOf(drawable));

            invalidateSelf();
            return;
        }
    }

    private void endTransition()
    {
        Drawable active = mActiveTransition;
        if (active == null) return;

        mActiveTransition = null;
        handler().removeCallbacks(mFinisher);

        if (active instanceof Animatable2) ((Animatable2) active).unregisterAnimationCallback(mTransitionCallback);
        if (((Animatable) active).isRunning()) ((Animatable) active).stop();

        invalidateSelf();
    }

    private static long durationOf(Drawable drawable)
    {
        if (!(drawable instanceof AnimationDrawable)) return DEFAULT_TRANSITION_MILLIS;

        AnimationDrawable frames = (AnimationDrawable) drawable;
        long total = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index < frames.getNumberOfFrames(); index++) total += frames.getDuration(index);

        return total;
    }

    private Handler handler()
    {
        if (mHandler == null)
        {
            Looper looper = Looper.myLooper();
            mHandler = new Handler(looper != null ? looper : Looper.getMainLooper());
        }

        return mHandler;
    }

    @Override
    public void jumpToCurrentState()
    {
        super.jumpToCurrentState();
        endTransition();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean setVisible(boolean visible, boolean restart)
    {
        boolean changed = super.setVisible(visible, restart);
        if (mActiveTransition != null && (changed || restart)) mActiveTransition.setVisible(visible, restart);

        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        if (mActiveTransition == null)
        {
            super.draw(canvas);
            return;
        }

        mActiveTransition.setBounds(getBounds());
        mActiveTransition.draw(canvas);
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= outerDepth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            String name = parser.getName();

            if ("item".equals(name))
            {
                int id = DrawableInflater.reference(attributes, "id", 0);
                int[] stateSet = readItemStateSet(attributes);
                Drawable drawable = DrawableInflater.itemDrawable(resources, parser, attributes, theme);

                if (drawable != null) addState(stateSet, drawable, id);
                continue;
            }

            if ("transition".equals(name))
            {
                int fromId = DrawableInflater.reference(attributes, "fromId", 0);
                int toId = DrawableInflater.reference(attributes, "toId", 0);
                boolean reversible = DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "reversible", false);
                Drawable drawable = DrawableInflater.itemDrawable(resources, parser, attributes, theme);

                if (drawable instanceof Animatable)
                {
                    mAnimatedState.mTransitions.add(new Transition(fromId, toId, drawable, reversible));
                }
                continue;
            }

            DrawableInflater.skipElement(parser);
        }

        onStateChange(getState());
    }

    private static int[] readItemStateSet(AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        ArrayList<Integer> collected = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int index = 0; index < attributes.getAttributeCount(); index++)
        {
            int name = attributes.getAttributeNameResource(index);
            if (name == 0 || name == ATTRIBUTE_ID || name == ATTRIBUTE_DRAWABLE) continue;

            String value = attributes.getAttributeValue(index);
            if (!"true".equals(value) && !"false".equals(value) && !isBoolean(attributes, index)) continue;

            collected.add(attributes.getAttributeBooleanValue(index, false) ? name : -name);
        }

        int[] stateSet = new int[collected.size()];
        for (int index = 0; index < stateSet.length; index++) stateSet[index] = collected.get(index);

        return stateSet;
    }

    private static boolean isBoolean(AttributeSet attributes, int index)
    {
        if (!(attributes instanceof android.content.res.XmlBlock.Parser)) return false;

        int[] packed = ((android.content.res.XmlBlock.Parser) attributes).getAttributeTypedValue(index);
        return packed != null && packed[0] == android.util.TypedValue.TYPE_INT_BOOLEAN;
    }

    private static final class Transition
    {
        final int fromId;
        final int toId;
        final Drawable drawable;
        final boolean reversible;

        Transition(int fromId, int toId, Drawable drawable, boolean reversible)
        {
            this.fromId = fromId;
            this.toId = toId;
            this.drawable = drawable;
            this.reversible = reversible;
        }
    }

    private final class Forwarder implements Drawable.Callback
    {
        @Override
        public void invalidateDrawable(Drawable who)
        {
            invalidateSelf();
        }

        @Override
        public void scheduleDrawable(Drawable who, Runnable what, long when)
        {
            scheduleSelf(what, when);
        }

        @Override
        public void unscheduleDrawable(Drawable who, Runnable what)
        {
            unscheduleSelf(what);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
import android.animation.AnimatorSet;
import android.animation.ValueAnimator;

public class AnimatedVectorDrawable extends Drawable implements Animatable2
{
    private static final long UNKNOWN_DURATION = -2;

    private final ArrayList<Integer> mTargetAnimations = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<String> mTargetNames = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Drawable.Callback mForwarder = new Forwarder();

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        mResources = resources;
        mTheme = theme;

        int reference = DrawableInflater.reference(attributes, "drawable", 0);
        if (reference != 0) setVector(resources.getDrawable(reference));

        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= outerDepth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            if ("target".equals(parser.getName()))
            {
                mTargetNames.add(DrawableInflater.text(attributes, "name"));
                mTargetAnimations.add(DrawableInflater.reference(attributes, "animation", 0));
                DrawableInflater.skipElement(parser);
                continue;
            }

            Drawable child = DrawableInflater.inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);
            if (child != null) setVector(child);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canApplyTheme()
    {
        return mVector != null && mVector.canApplyTheme();
    }

    @Override
    public void applyTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        if (mVector != null) mVector.applyTheme(theme);
    }

    private void setVector(Drawable vector)
    {
        if (mVector != null) mVector.setCallback(null);

        mVector = vector;
        if (vector == null) return;

        vector.setCallback(mForwarder);
        vector.setBounds(getBounds());
        vector.setState(getState());
        vector.setLevel(getLevel());
        if (super.getAlpha() != 255) vector.setAlpha(super.getAlpha());
        if (super.getColorFilter() != null) vector.setColorFilter(super.getColorFilter());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isRunning()
    {
        return mRunning;
    }

    public void reset()
    {
        if (!mRunning) return;

        mRunning = false;
        handler().removeCallbacks(mFinisher);
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public void start()
    {
        if (mRunning) return;

        mRunning = true;
        long duration = totalDuration();

        for (AnimationCallback callback : new ArrayList<>(mCallbacks)) callback.onAnimationStart(this);

        if (duration >= 0) handler().postDelayed(mFinisher, duration);

        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public void stop()
    {
        if (!mRunning) return;

        handler().removeCallbacks(mFinisher);
        finish();
    }

    private void finish()
    {
        if (!mRunning) return;

        mRunning = false;
        invalidateSelf();

        for (AnimationCallback callback : new ArrayList<>(mCallbacks)) callback.onAnimationEnd(this);
    }

    private Handler handler()
    {
        if (mHandler == null)
        {
            Looper looper = Looper.myLooper();
            mHandler = new Handler(looper != null ? looper : Looper.getMainLooper());
        }

        return mHandler;
    }

    private long totalDuration()
    {
        if (mTotalDuration != UNKNOWN_DURATION) return mTotalDuration;

        long longest = 0;

        for (int animation : mTargetAnimations)
        {
            if (animation == 0 || mResources == null) continue;

            try
            {
                Animator animator = AnimatorInflater.loadAnimator(mResources, mTheme, animation);
                long duration = durationOf(animator);

                if (duration < 0)
                {
                    longest = -1;
                    break;
                }

                longest = Math.max(longest, duration);
            }
            catch (RuntimeException failure)
            {
                continue;
            }
        }

        mTotalDuration = longest;
        return longest;
    }

    private static long durationOf(Animator animator)
    {
        if (animator == null) return 0;

        if (animator instanceof AnimatorSet)
        {
            long longest = 0;

            for (Animator child : ((AnimatorSet) animator).getChildAnimations())
            {
                long duration = durationOf(child);
                if (duration < 0) return -1;

                longest = Math.max(longest, duration);
            }

            return animator.getStartDelay() + longest;
        }

        if (animator instanceof ValueAnimator)
        {
            ValueAnimator value = (ValueAnimator) animator;
            if (value.getRepeatCount() == ValueAnimator.INFINITE) return -1;

            return value.getStartDelay() + value.getDuration() * (value.getRepeatCount() + 1);
        }

        long total = animator.getTotalDuration();
        return total < 0 ? -1 : animator.getStartDelay() + total;
    }

    @Override
    public void registerAnimationCallback(AnimationCallback callback)
    {
        if (callback != null && !mCallbacks.contains(callback)) mCallbacks.add(callback);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean unregisterAnimationCallback(AnimationCallback callback)
    {
        return mCallbacks.remove(callback);
    }

    @Override
    public void clearAnimationCallbacks()
    {
        mCallbacks.clear();
    }

    private final class Forwarder implements Drawable.Callback
    {
        @Override
        public void invalidateDrawable(Drawable who)
        {
            invalidateSelf();
        }

        @Override
        public void scheduleDrawable(Drawable who, Runnable what, long when)
        {
            scheduleSelf(what, when);
        }

        @Override
        public void unscheduleDrawable(Drawable who, Runnable what)
        {
            unscheduleSelf(what);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class AnimationDrawable extends DrawableContainer implements Runnable, Animatable
{
    private AnimationState mAnimationState;
    private int mCurrentFrame = 0;
    private boolean mRunning;
    private boolean mAnimating;
    private boolean mMutated;

    public AnimationDrawable()
    {
        this(null, null);
    }

    private AnimationDrawable(AnimationState state, Resources resources)
    {
        setConstantState(new AnimationState(state, this, resources));
        if (state != null) setFrame(0, true, false);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean setVisible(boolean visible, boolean restart)
    {
        boolean changed = super.setVisible(visible, restart);

        if (visible)
        {
            if (restart || changed)
            {
                boolean startFromZero = restart || (!mRunning && !mAnimationState.mOneShot) || mCurrentFrame >= getChildCount();
                setFrame(startFromZero ? 0 : mCurrentFrame, true, mAnimating);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            unscheduleSelf(this);
        }

        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    public void start()
    {
        mAnimating = true;

        if (!isRunning()) setFrame(0, false, getChildCount() > 1 || !mAnimationState.mOneShot);
    }

    @Override
    public void stop()
    {
        mAnimating = false;

        if (isRunning())
        {
            mCurrentFrame = 0;
            unscheduleSelf(this);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isRunning()
    {
        return mRunning;
    }

    @Override
    public void run()
    {
        nextFrame(false);
    }

    @Override
    public void unscheduleSelf(Runnable what)
    {
        mRunning = false;
        super.unscheduleSelf(what);
    }

    public int getNumberOfFrames()
    {
        return getChildCount();
    }

    public Drawable getFrame(int index)
    {
        return getChild(index);
    }

    public int getDuration(int index)
    {
        return index < 0 || index >= getChildCount() ? 0 : mAnimationState.mDurations[index];
    }

    public boolean isOneShot()
    {
        return mAnimationState.mOneShot;
    }

    public void setOneShot(boolean oneShot)
    {
        mAnimationState.mOneShot = oneShot;
    }

    public void addFrame(Drawable frame, int duration)
    {
        if (frame == null) throw new NullPointerException("frame");

        mAnimationState.addFrame(frame, duration);

        if (getCurrentIndex() < 0) setFrame(0, true, false);
    }

    private void nextFrame(boolean unschedule)
    {
        int next = mCurrentFrame + 1;
        int frameCount = getChildCount();
        boolean oneShot = mAnimationState.mOneShot;
        boolean lastFrame = oneShot && next >= frameCount - 1;

        if (!oneShot && next >= frameCount) next = 0;

        setFrame(next, unschedule, !lastFrame);
    }

    private void setFrame(int frame, boolean unschedule, boolean animate)
    {
        if (frame >= getChildCount()) return;

        mAnimating = animate;
        mCurrentFrame = frame;
        selectDrawable(frame);

        if (unschedule || animate) unscheduleSelf(this);

        if (animate)
        {
            mCurrentFrame = frame;
            mRunning = true;
            scheduleSelf(this, SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + mAnimationState.mDurations[frame]);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        mAnimationState.mOneShot = DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "oneshot", false);
        mAnimationState.setVariablePadding(DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "variablePadding", false));

        boolean visible = DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "visible", true);
        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= outerDepth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            if (!"item".equals(parser.getName()))
            {
                DrawableInflater.skipElement(parser);
                continue;
            }

            int duration = DrawableInflater.integer(attributes, "duration", -1);
            if (duration < 0) throw new org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException("<item> tag requires a 'duration' attribute");

            Drawable frame = DrawableInflater.itemDrawable(resources, parser, attributes, theme);
            if (frame == null) throw new org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException("<item> tag requires a 'drawable' attribute");

            mAnimationState.addFrame(frame, duration);
        }

        setFrame(0, true, false);
        super.setVisible(visible, true);
    }

    @Override
    public Drawable mutate()
    {
        if (!mMutated && super.mutate() == this)
        {
            mAnimationState.mutate();
            mMutated = true;
        }

        return this;
    }

    @Override
    protected void setConstantState(DrawableContainerState state)
    {
        super.setConstantState(state);

        if (state instanceof AnimationState) mAnimationState = (AnimationState) state;
    }

    private static final class AnimationState extends DrawableContainerState
    {
        private int[] mDurations;
        private boolean mOneShot;

        AnimationState(AnimationState original, AnimationDrawable owner, Resources resources)
        {
            super(original, owner, resources);

            mDurations = new int[mDrawables.length];

            if (original != null)
            {
                System.arraycopy(original.mDurations, 0, mDurations, 0, Math.min(original.mDurations.length, mDurations.length));
                mOneShot = original.mOneShot;
            }
        }

        void mutate()
        {
            mDurations = mDurations.clone();
        }

        void addFrame(Drawable frame, int duration)
        {
            int position = addChild(frame);
            mDurations[position] = duration;
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable()
        {
            return new AnimationDrawable(this, null);
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable(Resources resources)
        {
            return new AnimationDrawable(this, resources);
        }

        @Override
        public void growArray(int oldSize, int newSize)
        {
            super.growArray(oldSize, newSize);

            int[] grown = new int[newSize];
            System.arraycopy(mDurations, 0, grown, 0, Math.min(oldSize, mDurations.length));
            mDurations = grown;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    {

        if (resources != null) mTargetDensity = resources.getDisplayMetrics().densityDpi;

        int source = DrawableInflater.reference(attributes, "src", 0);
        if (source != 0) mBitmap = resources.getBitmap(source);

        int tileMode = DrawableInflater.enumeration(attributes, "tileMode", TILE_NAMES, -1);

        if (tileMode == 0) setTileModeXY(Shader.TileMode.CLAMP, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP);
        else if (tileMode == 1) setTileModeXY(Shader.TileMode.REPEAT, Shader.TileMode.REPEAT);
        else if (tileMode == 2) setTileModeXY(Shader.TileMode.MIRROR, Shader.TileMode.MIRROR);

        mGravity = DrawableInflater.gravity(attributes, "gravity", mGravity);
        mMipMap = DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "mipMap", mMipMap);
        mAutoMirrored = DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "autoMirrored", mAutoMirrored);
        mPaint.setFilterBitmap(DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "filter", true));
        mPaint.setAntiAlias(DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "antialias", true));
        mPaint.setDither(DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "dither", true));

        int alpha = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "alpha", 1.0f) * 255);
        mPaint.setAlpha(alpha);

        android.content.res.ColorStateList tint = DrawableInflater.colorStateList(resources, attributes, "tint");
        mTintBlendMode = DrawableInflater.tintMode(attributes, "tintMode", mTintBlendMode);
        if (tint != null) mTint = tint;
        mTintFilter = tintFilterFor(mTint, mTintBlendMode, getState());
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        if (mBitmap == null) return;

        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        if (bounds.width() <= 0 || bounds.height() <= 0) return;

        ColorFilter filter = mPaint.getColorFilter();
        boolean tinted = filter == null && mTintFilter != null;
        if (tinted) mPaint.setColorFilter(mTintFilter);

        Bitmap bitmap = filtered(mBitmap, filter);
        if (bitmap != mBitmap) mPaint.setColorFilter(null);

        if (mTileX != null || mTileY != null)
        {
            Shader.TileMode x = mTileX == null ? Shader.TileMode.CLAMP : mTileX;
            Shader.TileMode y = mTileY == null ? Shader.TileMode.CLAMP : mTileY;

            mPaint.setShader(new BitmapShader(bitmap, x, y));
            mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);

            canvas.drawRect(bounds.left, bounds.top, bounds.right, bounds.bottom, mPaint);
            mPaint.setShader(null);
        }
        else
        {
            if (mGravity == Gravity.FILL) mDestination.set(bounds);
            else Gravity.apply(mGravity, bitmap.getWidth(), bitmap.getHeight(), bounds, mDestination, getLayoutDirection());

            canvas.drawBitmap(bitmap, null, new RectF(mDestination), mPaint);
        }

        if (bitmap != mBitmap || tinted) mPaint.setColorFilter(filter);
    }

    static final class BitmapState extends ConstantState
    {
        final Bitmap mBitmap;
        final Paint mPaint;
        final Shader.TileMode mTileX;
        final Shader.TileMode mTileY;
        final int mGravity;
        final int mTargetDensity;
        final boolean mMipMap;
        final boolean mAutoMirrored;
        final android.content.res.ColorStateList mTint;
        final android.graphics.BlendMode mTintBlendMode;
        final int mChangingConfigurations;

        BitmapState(BitmapDrawable source)
        {
            mBitmap = source.mBitmap;
            mPaint = new Paint(source.mPaint);
            mTileX = source.mTileX;
            mTileY = source.mTileY;
            mGravity = source.mGravity;
            mTargetDensity = source.mTargetDensity;
            mMipMap = source.mMipMap;
            mAutoMirrored = source.mAutoMirrored;
            mTint = source.mTint;
            mTintBlendMode = source.mTintBlendMode;
            mChangingConfigurations = source.getChangingConfigurations();
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable()
        {
            return newDrawable(null);
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable(Resources resources)
        {
            BitmapDrawable drawable = new BitmapDrawable();
            drawable.mBitmap = mBitmap;
            drawable.mPaint.set(mPaint);
            drawable.mTileX = mTileX;
            drawable.mTileY = mTileY;
            drawable.mGravity = mGravity;
            drawable.mTargetDensity = resources != null ? resources.getDisplayMetrics().densityDpi : mTargetDensity;
            drawable.mMipMap = mMipMap;
            drawable.mAutoMirrored = mAutoMirrored;
            drawable.mTint = mTint;
            drawable.mTintBlendMode = mTintBlendMode;
            drawable.mTintFilter = tintFilterFor(mTint, mTintBlendMode, drawable.getState());
            drawable.setChangingConfigurations(mChangingConfigurations);
            if (mPaint.getColorFilter() != null) drawable.setColorFilter(mPaint.getColorFilter());
            drawable.setAlpha(mPaint.getAlpha());
            return drawable;
        }

        @Override
        public int getChangingConfigurations()
        {
            return mChangingConfigurations;
        }
    }

    private Bitmap filtered(Bitmap source, ColorFilter filter)
    {
        float[] matrix = matrixOf(filter);
        if (matrix == null) return source;

        if (mFiltered != null && mFilteredSource == source && mFilteredBy == filter) return mFiltered;

        int width = source.getWidth();
        int height = source.getHeight();
        if ((long)width * height > MAXIMUM_FILTERED_PIXELS) return source;

        int[] pixels = new int[width * height];
        source.getPixels(pixels, 0, width, 0, 0, width, height);

        Bitmap result = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);

        for (int index = 0; index < pixels.length; index++)
        {
            int pixel = pixels[index];
            if (pixel == 0 && matrix[19] <= 0) continue;

            pixels[index] = transform(matrix, pixel);
        }

        result.setPixels(pixels, 0, width, 0, 0, width, height);

        mFilteredSource = source;
        mFilteredBy = filter;
        mFiltered = result;
        return result;
    }

    private static float[] matrixOf(ColorFilter filter)
    {
        if (filter instanceof ColorMatrixColorFilter)
        {
            ColorMatrix matrix = new ColorMatrix();
            ((ColorMatrixColorFilter) filter).getColorMatrix(matrix);
            return matrix.getArray();
        }

        if (filter instanceof LightingColorFilter)
        {
            LightingColorFilter lighting = (LightingColorFilter) filter;
            int multiply = lighting.getColorMultiply();
            int add = lighting.getColorAdd();

            float[] matrix = new float[20];
            matrix[0] = ((multiply >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255.0f;
            matrix[6] = ((multiply >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255.0f;
            matrix[12] = (multiply & 0xFF) / 255.0f;
            matrix[18] = 1;
            matrix[4] = (add >> 16) & 0xFF;
            matrix[9] = (add >> 8) & 0xFF;
            matrix[14] = add & 0xFF;
            return matrix;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static int transform(float[] matrix, int color)
    {
        float red = (color >> 16) & 0xFF;
        float green = (color >> 8) & 0xFF;
        float blue = color & 0xFF;
        float alpha = (color >>> 24) & 0xFF;

        int outRed = clamp(matrix[0] * red + matrix[1] * green + matrix[2] * blue + matrix[3] * alpha + matrix[4]);
        int outGreen = clamp(matrix[5] * red + matrix[6] * green + matrix[7] * blue + matrix[8] * alpha + matrix[9]);
        int outBlue = clamp(matrix[10] * red + matrix[11] * green + matrix[12] * blue + matrix[13] * alpha + matrix[14]);
        int outAlpha = clamp(matrix[15] * red + matrix[16] * green + matrix[17] * blue + matrix[18] * alpha + matrix[19]);

        return (outAlpha << 24) | (outRed << 16) | (outGreen << 8) | outBlue;
    }

    private static int clamp(float value)
    {
        int rounded = Math.round(value);
        return rounded < 0 ? 0 : (rounded > 255 ? 255 : rounded);
    }
}
```

`java/android/graphics/drawable/ClipDrawable.java`:

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.PixelFormat;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.Gravity;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class ClipDrawable extends DrawableWrapper
{
    public static final int HORIZONTAL = 1;
    public static final int VERTICAL = 2;

    private static final int MAX_LEVEL = 10000;

    private final Rect mClipRect = new Rect();

    private int mOrientation = HORIZONTAL;
    private int mGravity = Gravity.LEFT;

    ClipDrawable()
    {
    }

    public ClipDrawable(Drawable drawable, int gravity, int orientation)
    {
        super(drawable);
        mGravity = gravity;
        mOrientation = orientation;
    }

    @Override
    public void applyTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        super.applyTheme(theme);
    }

    @Override
    DrawableWrapper copyWrapper()
    {
        return new ClipDrawable(null, mGravity, mOrientation);
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onLevelChange(int level)
    {
        Drawable inner = getDrawable();
        if (inner != null) inner.setLevel(level);

        invalidateSelf();
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public int getOpacity()
    {
        Drawable inner = getDrawable();
        if (inner == null || getLevel() == 0) return PixelFormat.TRANSPARENT;

        int opacity = inner.getOpacity();
        if (opacity == PixelFormat.TRANSPARENT || getLevel() >= MAX_LEVEL) return opacity;

        return PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        Drawable inner = getDrawable();
        if (inner == null || getLevel() == 0) return;

        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        int level = getLevel();
        int width = bounds.width();
        int height = bounds.height();

        if ((mOrientation & HORIZONTAL) != 0) width -= width * (MAX_LEVEL - level) / MAX_LEVEL;
        if ((mOrientation & VERTICAL) != 0) height -= height * (MAX_LEVEL - level) / MAX_LEVEL;

        Gravity.apply(mGravity, width, height, bounds, mClipRect, getLayoutDirection());

        if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;

        int saveCount = canvas.save();
        canvas.clipRect(mClipRect);
        inner.setAlpha(getAlpha());
        inner.draw(canvas);
        canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        mOrientation = DrawableInflater.integer(attributes, "clipOrientation", mOrientation);

        String orientation = DrawableInflater.text(attributes, "clipOrientation");
        if ("vertical".equals(orientation)) mOrientation = VERTICAL;
        else if ("horizontal".equals(orientation)) mOrientation = HORIZONTAL;

        mGravity = DrawableInflater.gravity(attributes, "gravity", mGravity);

        int reference = DrawableInflater.reference(attributes, "drawable", 0);
        if (reference != 0) setDrawable(resources.getDrawable(reference));

        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= outerDepth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            Drawable child = DrawableInflater.inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);
            if (child != null) setDrawable(child);
        }

        Drawable inner = getDrawable();
        if (inner != null) inner.setLevel(getLevel());
    }
}
```

`java/android/graphics/drawable/ColorDrawable.java`:

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.BlendMode;
import android.graphics.BlendModeColorFilter;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.ColorFilter;
import android.graphics.Outline;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.PixelFormat;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class ColorDrawable extends Drawable
{
    private final Paint mPaint = new Paint();

    private int mBaseColor;
    private int mUseColor;
    private ColorStateList mTint;
    private BlendMode mTintBlendMode = BlendMode.SRC_IN;
    private ColorFilter mTintFilter;

    public ColorDrawable()
    {
        this(0);
    }

    public ColorDrawable(int color)
    {
        mBaseColor = color;
        mUseColor = color;
    }

    public int getColor()
    {
        return mUseColor;
    }

    public void setColor(int color)
    {
        if (mBaseColor == color && mUseColor == color) return;

        mBaseColor = color;
        mUseColor = color;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public int getAlpha()
    {
        return mUseColor >>> 24;
    }

    @Override
    public void setAlpha(int alpha)
    {
        super.setAlpha(alpha);

        int clamped = alpha < 0 ? 0 : (alpha > 255 ? 255 : alpha);
        int baseAlpha = mBaseColor >>> 24;
        int useAlpha = baseAlpha * (clamped + (clamped >> 7)) >> 8;
        int useColor = (mBaseColor << 8 >>> 8) | (useAlpha << 24);

        if (mUseColor == useColor) return;

        mUseColor = useColor;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public void setColorFilter(ColorFilter filter)
    {
        super.setColorFilter(filter);
        mPaint.setColorFilter(filter);
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public ColorFilter getColorFilter()
    {
        return mPaint.getColorFilter();
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintList(ColorStateList tint)
    {
        mTint = tint;
        mTintFilter = tintFilter();
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintBlendMode(BlendMode blendMode)
    {
        mTintBlendMode = blendMode == null ? BlendMode.SRC_IN : blendMode;
        mTintFilter = tintFilter();
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    private ColorFilter tintFilter()
    {
        if (mTint == null) return null;

        return new BlendModeColorFilter(mTint.getColorForState(getState(), mTint.getDefaultColor()), mTintBlendMode);
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onStateChange(int[] stateSet)
    {
        if (mTint == null) return false;

        mTintFilter = tintFilter();
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isStateful()
    {
        return mTint != null && mTint.isStateful();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasFocusStateSpecified()
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        ColorFilter filter = mPaint.getColorFilter();
        if ((mUseColor >>> 24) == 0 && filter == null && mTintFilter == null) return;

        if (filter == null) mPaint.setColorFilter(mTintFilter);

        mPaint.setColor(mUseColor);
        canvas.drawRect(getBounds(), mPaint);
        mPaint.setColorFilter(filter);
    }

    @Override
    public int getOpacity()
    {
        if (mTintFilter != null || mPaint.getColorFilter() != null) return PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;

        int alpha = mUseColor >>> 24;
        if (alpha == 255) return PixelFormat.OPAQUE;
        if (alpha == 0) return PixelFormat.TRANSPARENT;

        return PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;
    }

    @Override
    public void getOutline(Outline outline)
    {
        outline.setRect(getBounds());
        outline.setAlpha(getAlpha() / 255.0f);
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        mBaseColor = DrawableInflater.color(resources, attributes, "color", mBaseColor);
        mUseColor = mBaseColor;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canApplyTheme()
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public void applyTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
    }

    @Override
    public int getChangingConfigurations()
    {
        return super.getChangingConfigurations();
    }

    @Override
    public Drawable mutate()
    {
        return this;
    }

    @Override
    public ConstantState getConstantState()
    {
        return new ColorState(this);
    }

    static final class ColorState extends ConstantState
    {
        final int mBaseColor;
        final int mUseColor;
        final ColorStateList mTint;
        final BlendMode mTintBlendMode;
        final int mChangingConfigurations;

        ColorState(ColorDrawable source)
        {
            mBaseColor = source.mBaseColor;
            mUseColor = source.mUseColor;
            mTint = source.mTint;
            mTintBlendMode = source.mTintBlendMode;
            mChangingConfigurations = source.getChangingConfigurations();
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable()
        {
            ColorDrawable drawable = new ColorDrawable(mBaseColor);
            drawable.mUseColor = mUseColor;
            drawable.mTint = mTint;
            drawable.mTintBlendMode = mTintBlendMode;
            drawable.mTintFilter = drawable.tintFilter();
            drawable.setChangingConfigurations(mChangingConfigurations);
            return drawable;
        }

        @Override
        public int getChangingConfigurations()
        {
            return mChangingConfigurations;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.BlendMode;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.ColorFilter;
import android.graphics.Rect;

public class ColorStateListDrawable extends Drawable implements Drawable.Callback
{
    private final ColorDrawable mColorDrawable = new ColorDrawable();
    private ColorStateList mColor;
    private ColorStateList mTint;
    private BlendMode mTintBlendMode;
    private int mAlpha = -1;
    private boolean mMutated;

    public ColorStateListDrawable()
    {
        this(ColorStateList.valueOf(0));
    }

    public ColorStateListDrawable(ColorStateList colorStateList)
    {
        mColorDrawable.setCallback(this);
        mColor = colorStateList == null ? ColorStateList.valueOf(0) : colorStateList;
        onStateChange(getState());
    }

    @Override

    }

        return mColorDrawable;
    }

        super.applyTheme(theme);
        onStateChange(getState());
    }

        return super.canApplyTheme() || mColor.canApplyTheme();
    }

    @Override
    public void setAlpha(int alpha)
    {
        mAlpha = alpha;
        onStateChange(getState());
    }

    public void clearAlpha()
    {
        mAlpha = -1;
        onStateChange(getState());
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintList(ColorStateList tint)
    {
        mTint = tint;
        mColorDrawable.setTintList(tint);
        onStateChange(getState());
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintBlendMode(BlendMode blendMode)
    {
        mTintBlendMode = blendMode;
        mColorDrawable.setTintBlendMode(blendMode);
        onStateChange(getState());
    }

    @Override
    public ColorFilter getColorFilter()
    {
        return mColorDrawable.getColorFilter();
    }

    @Override
    public void setColorFilter(ColorFilter colorFilter)
    {
        mColorDrawable.setColorFilter(colorFilter);
    }

    @Override
    public int getOpacity()
    {
        return mColorDrawable.getOpacity();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onBoundsChange(Rect bounds)
    {
        super.onBoundsChange(bounds);
        mColorDrawable.setBounds(bounds);
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onStateChange(int[] state)
    {
        int color = mColor.getColorForState(state, mColor.getDefaultColor());
        if (mAlpha != -1) color = (color & 0xffffff) | (mAlpha << 24);

        mColorDrawable.setState(state);

        if (color == mColorDrawable.getColor()) return mTint != null && mTint.isStateful();

        mColorDrawable.setColor(color);
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void invalidateDrawable(Drawable who)
    {
        if (who == mColorDrawable && getCallback() != null) getCallback().invalidateDrawable(this);
    }

    @Override
    public void scheduleDrawable(Drawable who, Runnable what, long when)
    {
        if (who == mColorDrawable && getCallback() != null) getCallback().scheduleDrawable(this, what, when);
    }

    @Override
    public void unscheduleDrawable(Drawable who, Runnable what)
    {
        if (who == mColorDrawable && getCallback() != null) getCallback().unscheduleDrawable(this, what);
    }

    @Override
    public ConstantState getConstantState()
    {
        final ColorStateList color = mColor;
        final ColorStateList tint = mTint;
        final BlendMode blendMode = mTintBlendMode;
        final int alpha = mAlpha;
        final int changing = getChangingConfigurations();

        return new ConstantState()
        {
            @Override
            public Drawable newDrawable()
            {
                ColorStateListDrawable copy = new ColorStateListDrawable(color);
                if (tint != null) copy.setTintList(tint);
                if (blendMode != null) copy.setTintBlendMode(blendMode);
                if (alpha != -1) copy.setAlpha(alpha);
                return copy;
            }

            @Override
            public int getChangingConfigurations()
            {
                return changing;
            }
        };
    }

    public ColorStateList getColorStateList()
    {
        return mColor;
    }

    @Override
    public int getChangingConfigurations()
    {
        return super.getChangingConfigurations() | mColor.getChangingConfigurations();
    }

    @Override
    public Drawable mutate()
    {
        if (!mMutated && super.mutate() == this)
        {
            mColorDrawable.mutate();
            mMutated = true;
        }
        return this;
    }

    public void setColorStateList(ColorStateList colorStateList)
    {
        mColor = colorStateList == null ? ColorStateList.valueOf(0) : colorStateList;
        onStateChange(getState());
        invalidateSelf();
    }
}
```

```java
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException

        while ((event = parser.next()) != org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser.START_TAG
               && event != org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
        }

        if (event != org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser.START_TAG) return null;

        return createFromXmlInner(resources, parser, (android.util.AttributeSet) parser, theme);
    }

        return bitmap == null ? null : new BitmapDrawable(bitmap);

    {
        android.graphics.Bitmap bitmap = android.graphics.BitmapFactory.decodeStream(stream);
        return bitmap == null ? null : new BitmapDrawable(bitmap);
    }

    public static Drawable createFromResourceStream(android.content.res.Resources resources, android.util.TypedValue value,
                                                    java.io.InputStream stream, String name)
    {
        return createFromResourceStream(resources, value, stream, name, null);
    }

    public static Drawable createFromResourceStream(android.content.res.Resources resources, android.util.TypedValue value,
                                                    java.io.InputStream stream, String name,
                                                    android.graphics.BitmapFactory.Options options)
    {
        if (stream == null) return null;

        byte[] data;
        try
        {
            java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream collected = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
            byte[] buffer = new byte[16384];
            int got;
            while ((got = stream.read(buffer)) > 0) collected.write(buffer, 0, got);
            data = collected.toByteArray();
        }
        catch (java.io.IOException failure)
        {
            return null;
        }

        android.graphics.Bitmap bitmap = android.graphics.BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(data, 0, data.length, options);
        if (bitmap == null) return null;

        byte[] chunk = NinePatchDrawable.extractChunk(data);
        if (chunk != null && android.graphics.NinePatch.isNinePatchChunk(chunk))
        {
            return new NinePatchDrawable(resources, bitmap, chunk, null, name);
        }

        return new BitmapDrawable(resources, bitmap);
    }

    {
        public ConstantState()
        {
        }

        public abstract Drawable newDrawable();

        public Drawable newDrawable(android.content.res.Resources resources)
        {
            return newDrawable();
        }

        public Drawable newDrawable(android.content.res.Resources resources, android.content.res.Resources.Theme theme)
        {
            return newDrawable(resources);
        }

        public abstract int getChangingConfigurations();

        public boolean canApplyTheme()
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
```

`java/android/graphics/drawable/DrawableContainer.java`:

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Insets;
import android.graphics.Outline;
import android.graphics.PixelFormat;
import android.graphics.Rect;

public class DrawableContainer extends Drawable implements Drawable.Callback
{
    private DrawableContainerState mDrawableContainerState;
    private boolean mExplicitState;
    private Drawable mCurrent;
    private int mCurrentIndex = -1;
    private boolean mAutoMirrored;
    private final Rect mHotspotBounds = new Rect();
    private boolean mHasHotspotBounds;
    private boolean mMutated;

    public DrawableContainer()
    {
    }

    private DrawableContainerState containerState()
    {
        if (mDrawableContainerState == null) mDrawableContainerState = new ContainerState(this);
        return mDrawableContainerState;
    }

    int addChild(Drawable drawable)
    {
        return containerState().addChild(drawable);
    }

    int getChildCount()
    {
        return containerState().getChildCount();
    }

    Drawable getChild(int index)
    {
        return containerState().getChild(index);
    }

    int getCurrentIndex()
    {
        return mCurrentIndex;
    }

    public boolean selectDrawable(int index)
    {
        if (index == mCurrentIndex) return false;

        Drawable wanted = index >= 0 && index < getChildCount() ? getChild(index) : null;

        if (mCurrent != null) mCurrent.setVisible(false, false);

        mCurrent = wanted;
        mCurrentIndex = wanted == null ? -1 : index;

        if (mCurrent != null)
        {
            mCurrent.setVisible(isVisible(), true);
            mCurrent.setAlpha(getAlpha());
            mCurrent.setState(getState());
            mCurrent.setLevel(getLevel());
            mCurrent.setLayoutDirection(getLayoutDirection());
            if (getColorFilter() != null) mCurrent.setColorFilter(getColorFilter());
            mCurrent.setBounds(getBounds());
            if (mHasHotspotBounds)
            {
                mCurrent.setHotspotBounds(mHotspotBounds.left, mHotspotBounds.top, mHotspotBounds.right, mHotspotBounds.bottom);
            }
        }

        invalidateSelf();
        return true;
    }

    @Override

    {
        return mCurrent;
    }

    @Override

    {
        if (mCurrent == null) return;

        mCurrent.setAlpha(getAlpha());
        mCurrent.draw(canvas);

            return (constant.left | constant.top | constant.bottom | constant.right) != 0;
        }

        return mCurrent != null ? mCurrent.getPadding(padding) : super.getPadding(padding);
    }

    @Override
    public int getAlpha()

        return super.getAlpha();
    }

    @Override
    public void setDither(boolean dither)

        if (mCurrent != null) mCurrent.setDither(dither);

    @Override
    public void setColorFilter(android.graphics.ColorFilter filter)
    {
        super.setColorFilter(filter);

    @Override
    protected boolean onLevelChange(int level)

    @Override

        if (state.isConstantSize()) return state.getConstantWidth();
        return mCurrent == null ? -1 : mCurrent.getIntrinsicWidth();

    @Override

        return null;

    @Override
    public Drawable mutate()

            DrawableContainerState state = containerState();
            for (int index = 0; index < state.getChildCount(); index++) state.getChild(index).mutate();
            mMutated = true;

        return this;

    protected void setConstantState(DrawableContainerState state)
    {
        mDrawableContainerState = state;
        mExplicitState = state != null;

        if (mCurrentIndex >= 0)
        {
            mCurrent = state == null ? null : state.getChild(mCurrentIndex);
            if (mCurrent == null) mCurrentIndex = -1;
        }

        if (state == null) return;

        state.mOwner = this;
        for (int index = 0; index < state.getChildCount(); index++) state.mDrawables[index].setCallback(this);
    }

    private static final class ContainerState extends DrawableContainerState
    {
        ContainerState(DrawableContainer owner)
        {
            super(null, owner, null);
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable()
        {
            DrawableContainer copy = new DrawableContainer();
            for (int index = 0; index < getChildCount(); index++)
            {
                Drawable child = getChild(index);
                ConstantState childState = child.getConstantState();
                copy.addChild(childState != null ? childState.newDrawable() : child);
            }
            return copy;
        }
    }

    public abstract static class DrawableContainerState extends ConstantState
    {
        DrawableContainer mOwner;
        Drawable[] mDrawables;
        int mNumChildren;
        int mChangingConfigurations;
        int mChildrenChangingConfigurations;
        boolean mVariablePadding;
        Rect mConstantPadding;
        boolean mConstantSize;
        boolean mComputedConstantSize;
        int mConstantWidth;
        int mConstantHeight;
        int mConstantMinimumWidth;
        int mConstantMinimumHeight;
        int mEnterFadeDuration;
        int mExitFadeDuration;

        DrawableContainerState()
        {
            this(null, null, null);
        }

        DrawableContainerState(DrawableContainerState original, DrawableContainer owner, Resources resources)
        {
            mOwner = owner;

            if (original == null)
            {
                mDrawables = new Drawable[10];
                return;
            }

            mChangingConfigurations = original.mChangingConfigurations;
            mChildrenChangingConfigurations = original.mChildrenChangingConfigurations;
            mVariablePadding = original.mVariablePadding;
            mConstantSize = original.mConstantSize;
            mEnterFadeDuration = original.mEnterFadeDuration;
            mExitFadeDuration = original.mExitFadeDuration;
            mDrawables = new Drawable[Math.max(10, original.mDrawables.length)];
            mNumChildren = original.mNumChildren;

            for (int index = 0; index < mNumChildren; index++)
            {
                Drawable child = original.mDrawables[index];
                ConstantState childState = child.getConstantState();
                Drawable copy = childState != null ? childState.newDrawable(resources) : child;
                if (owner != null) copy.setCallback(owner);
                mDrawables[index] = copy;
            }
        }

        @Override
        public int getChangingConfigurations()
        {
            return mChangingConfigurations | mChildrenChangingConfigurations;
        }

        public final int addChild(Drawable drawable)
        {
            int position = mNumChildren;
            if (position >= mDrawables.length) growArray(position, position + 10);

            if (mOwner != null)
            {
                drawable.setVisible(mOwner.isVisible(), true);
                drawable.setCallback(mOwner);
            }
            else
            {
                drawable.setVisible(false, true);
            }

            mDrawables[position] = drawable;
            mNumChildren++;
            mChildrenChangingConfigurations |= drawable.getChangingConfigurations();
            mComputedConstantSize = false;
            mConstantPadding = null;

            return position;
        }

        public final int getChildCount()
        {
            return mNumChildren;
        }

        public final Drawable[] getChildren()
        {
            return mDrawables;
        }

        public final Drawable getChild(int index)
        {
            return index < 0 || index >= mNumChildren ? null : mDrawables[index];
        }

        @Override
        public boolean canApplyTheme()
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < mNumChildren; index++)
            {
                if (mDrawables[index].canApplyTheme()) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        public final void setVariablePadding(boolean variable)
        {
            mVariablePadding = variable;
            mConstantPadding = null;
        }

        public final Rect getConstantPadding()
        {
            if (mVariablePadding || mNumChildren == 0) return null;
            if (mConstantPadding != null) return mConstantPadding;

            Rect result = null;
            Rect candidate = new Rect();

            for (int index = 0; index < mNumChildren; index++)
            {
                if (!mDrawables[index].getPadding(candidate)) continue;

                if (result == null) result = new Rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
                if (candidate.left > result.left) result.left = candidate.left;
                if (candidate.top > result.top) result.top = candidate.top;
                if (candidate.right > result.right) result.right = candidate.right;
                if (candidate.bottom > result.bottom) result.bottom = candidate.bottom;
            }

            mConstantPadding = result;
            return result;
        }

        public final void setConstantSize(boolean constant)
        {
            mConstantSize = constant;
        }

        public final boolean isConstantSize()
        {
            return mConstantSize;
        }

        public final int getConstantWidth()
        {
            if (!mComputedConstantSize) computeConstantSize();
            return mConstantWidth;
        }

        public final int getConstantHeight()
        {
            if (!mComputedConstantSize) computeConstantSize();
            return mConstantHeight;
        }

        public final int getConstantMinimumWidth()
        {
            if (!mComputedConstantSize) computeConstantSize();
            return mConstantMinimumWidth;
        }

        public final int getConstantMinimumHeight()
        {
            if (!mComputedConstantSize) computeConstantSize();
            return mConstantMinimumHeight;
        }

        protected void computeConstantSize()
        {
            mComputedConstantSize = true;
            mConstantWidth = -1;
            mConstantHeight = -1;
            mConstantMinimumWidth = 0;
            mConstantMinimumHeight = 0;

            for (int index = 0; index < mNumChildren; index++)
            {
                Drawable child = mDrawables[index];
                mConstantWidth = Math.max(mConstantWidth, child.getIntrinsicWidth());
                mConstantHeight = Math.max(mConstantHeight, child.getIntrinsicHeight());
                mConstantMinimumWidth = Math.max(mConstantMinimumWidth, child.getMinimumWidth());
                mConstantMinimumHeight = Math.max(mConstantMinimumHeight, child.getMinimumHeight());
            }
        }

        public final void setEnterFadeDuration(int duration)
        {
            mEnterFadeDuration = duration;
        }

        public final int getEnterFadeDuration()
        {
            return mEnterFadeDuration;
        }

        public final void setExitFadeDuration(int duration)
        {
            mExitFadeDuration = duration;
        }

        public final int getExitFadeDuration()
        {
            return mExitFadeDuration;
        }

        public final int getOpacity()
        {
            if (mNumChildren == 0) return PixelFormat.TRANSPARENT;

            int opacity = mDrawables[0].getOpacity();
            for (int index = 1; index < mNumChildren; index++) opacity = Drawable.resolveOpacity(opacity, mDrawables[index].getOpacity());
            return opacity;
        }

        public final boolean isStateful()
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < mNumChildren; index++)
            {
                if (mDrawables[index].isStateful()) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        public void growArray(int oldSize, int newSize)
        {
            Drawable[] grown = new Drawable[newSize];
            System.arraycopy(mDrawables, 0, grown, 0, Math.min(oldSize, mDrawables.length));
            mDrawables = grown;
        }

        public synchronized boolean canConstantState()
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < mNumChildren; index++)
            {
                if (mDrawables[index].getConstantState() == null) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/graphics/drawable/DrawableInflater.java`:

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.content.res.XmlBlock;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.util.TypedValue;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class DrawableInflater
{
    public static final String ANDROID_NAMESPACE = "http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android";

    public static Drawable inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        return inflate(resources, parser, attributes, null);
    }

    public static Drawable inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        String name = parser.getName();
        if (name == null) return null;

        Drawable drawable = forTag(name);
        if (drawable == null) drawable = forClass(name, attributes);
        if (drawable == null) return null;

        drawable.inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);
        return drawable;
    }

    public static Drawable forTag(String name)
    {
        switch (name)
        {
            case "vector": return new VectorDrawable();
            case "animated-vector": return new AnimatedVectorDrawable();
            case "shape": return new GradientDrawable();
            case "color": return new ColorDrawable(0);
            case "bitmap": return new BitmapDrawable();
            case "nine-patch": return new NinePatchDrawable();
            case "layer-list": return new LayerDrawable();
            case "transition": return new TransitionDrawable();
            case "inset": return new InsetDrawable();
            case "clip": return new ClipDrawable();
            case "scale": return new ScaleDrawable();
            case "rotate": return new RotateDrawable();
            case "level-list": return new LevelListDrawable();
            case "selector": return new StateListDrawable();
            case "animated-selector": return new AnimatedStateListDrawable();
            case "animation-list": return new AnimationDrawable();
            case "animated-image": return new AnimatedImageDrawable();
            case "ripple": return new RippleDrawable();
            case "adaptive-icon": return new AdaptiveIconDrawable();
            default: return null;
        }
    }

    private static Drawable forClass(String name, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        String className = "drawable".equals(name) && attributes != null ? attributes.getAttributeValue(null, "class") : name;
        if (className == null || className.indexOf('.') < 0) return null;

        try
        {
            ClassLoader loader = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
            if (loader == null) loader = DrawableInflater.class.getClassLoader();

            Class<?> type = Class.forName(className, true, loader);
            if (!Drawable.class.isAssignableFrom(type)) return null;

            return (Drawable) type.getDeclaredConstructor().newInstance();
        }
        catch (ReflectiveOperationException | LinkageError failure)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    static Drawable itemDrawable(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        Drawable drawable = null;

        int reference = reference(attributes, "drawable", 0);
        if (reference != 0) drawable = resources.getDrawable(reference);

        int itemDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= itemDepth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            Drawable child = inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);
            if (child != null) drawable = child;
        }

        return drawable;
    }

    static void skipElement(XmlPullParser parser) throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        int depth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= depth) return;
        }
    }

    static float fraction(AttributeSet attributes, String name, float fallback)
    {
        int[] packed = typedValue(attributes, name);

        if (packed != null)
        {
            if (packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_FRACTION) return TypedValue.complexToFraction(packed[1], 1, 1);
            if (packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT) return Float.intBitsToFloat(packed[1]);
        }

        String text = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
        if (text == null) return fallback;

        float value = parseNumber(text, fallback);
        return text.endsWith("%") || text.endsWith("%p") ? value / 100 : value;
    }

    static boolean isFraction(AttributeSet attributes, String name)
    {
        int[] packed = typedValue(attributes, name);
        if (packed != null) return packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_FRACTION;

        String text = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
        return text != null && text.indexOf('%') >= 0;
    }

    static int gravity(AttributeSet attributes, String name, int fallback)
    {
        int[] packed = typedValue(attributes, name);
        if (packed != null && packed[0] >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && packed[0] <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return packed[1];

        String text = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
        if (text == null) return fallback;

        int result = 0;

        for (String part : text.split("\\|"))
        {
            switch (part.trim())
            {
                case "top": result |= android.view.Gravity.TOP; break;
                case "bottom": result |= android.view.Gravity.BOTTOM; break;
                case "left": result |= android.view.Gravity.LEFT; break;
                case "right": result |= android.view.Gravity.RIGHT; break;
                case "start": result |= android.view.Gravity.START; break;
                case "end": result |= android.view.Gravity.END; break;
                case "center_vertical": result |= android.view.Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL; break;
                case "center_horizontal": result |= android.view.Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL; break;
                case "center": result |= android.view.Gravity.CENTER; break;
                case "fill_vertical": result |= android.view.Gravity.FILL_VERTICAL; break;
                case "fill_horizontal": result |= android.view.Gravity.FILL_HORIZONTAL; break;
                case "fill": result |= android.view.Gravity.FILL; break;
                case "clip_vertical": result |= android.view.Gravity.CLIP_VERTICAL; break;
                case "clip_horizontal": result |= android.view.Gravity.CLIP_HORIZONTAL; break;
                default: break;
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    static int[] typedValue(AttributeSet attributes, String name)
    {
        if (!(attributes instanceof XmlBlock.Parser)) return null;

        return ((XmlBlock.Parser) attributes).getAttributeTypedValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
    }

    static float dimension(Resources resources, AttributeSet attributes, String name, float fallback)
    {
        int[] packed = typedValue(attributes, name);

        if (packed != null && packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_DIMENSION)
        {
            return TypedValue.complexToDimension(packed[1], resources.getDisplayMetrics());
        }

        return dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, name, fallback);
    }

    static float dimensionOrFloat(Resources resources, AttributeSet attributes, String name, float fallback)
    {
        int[] packed = typedValue(attributes, name);

        if (packed != null)
        {
            switch (packed[0])
            {
                case TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT:
                    return Float.intBitsToFloat(packed[1]);

                case TypedValue.TYPE_DIMENSION:
                    return TypedValue.complexToDimension(packed[1], resources.getDisplayMetrics());

                case TypedValue.TYPE_INT_DEC:
                case TypedValue.TYPE_INT_HEX:
                    return packed[1];

                case TypedValue.TYPE_REFERENCE:
                    return packed[1] == 0 ? fallback : resources.getDimension(packed[1]);

                default:
                    break;
            }
        }

        String text = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
        if (text == null) return fallback;

        return parseNumber(text, fallback);
    }

    static float parseNumber(String text, float fallback)
    {
        int end = text.length();
        while (end > 0 && !isNumeric(text.charAt(end - 1))) end--;

        if (end == 0) return fallback;

        try
        {
            return Float.parseFloat(text.substring(0, end));
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException failure)
        {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    private static boolean isNumeric(char value)
    {
        return (value >= '0' && value <= '9') || value == '.' || value == '-' || value == '+';
    }

    static int color(Resources resources, AttributeSet attributes, String name, int fallback)
    {
        int[] packed = typedValue(attributes, name);

        if (packed != null)
        {
            if (packed[0] >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_COLOR_INT && packed[0] <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_COLOR_INT) return packed[1];

            if (packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_REFERENCE && packed[1] != 0)
            {
                try
                {
                    return resources.getColor(packed[1]);
                }
                catch (RuntimeException failure)
                {
                    return fallback;
                }
            }
        }

        String text = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
        if (text == null || !text.startsWith("#")) return fallback;

        return parseColor(text, fallback);
    }

    static int parseColor(String text, int fallback)
    {
        String digits = text.substring(1);

        try
        {
            if (digits.length() == 6) return 0xFF000000 | (int) Long.parseLong(digits, 16);
            if (digits.length() == 8) return (int) Long.parseLong(digits, 16);

            if (digits.length() == 3 || digits.length() == 4)
            {
                int value = 0;
                for (int index = 0; index < digits.length(); index++)
                {
                    int nibble = Character.digit(digits.charAt(index), 16);
                    if (nibble < 0) return fallback;

                    value = (value << 8) | (nibble << 4) | nibble;
                }

                return digits.length() == 3 ? 0xFF000000 | value : value;
            }
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException failure)
        {
            return fallback;
        }

        return fallback;
    }

    static int integer(AttributeSet attributes, String name, int fallback)
    {
        int[] packed = typedValue(attributes, name);
        if (packed != null && packed[0] >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && packed[0] <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return packed[1];

        String text = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
        if (text == null) return fallback;

        try
        {
            return Integer.parseInt(text);
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException failure)
        {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    static boolean flag(AttributeSet attributes, String name, boolean fallback)
    {
        int[] packed = typedValue(attributes, name);
        if (packed != null && packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_INT_BOOLEAN) return packed[1] != 0;

        String text = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
        if (text == null) return fallback;

        return "true".equals(text);
    }

    static String text(AttributeSet attributes, String name)
    {
        return attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
    }

    static int enumeration(AttributeSet attributes, String name, String[] labels, int fallback)
    {
        int[] packed = typedValue(attributes, name);

        if (packed != null && packed[0] >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && packed[0] <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT)
        {
            return packed[1];
        }

        String value = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
        if (value == null || labels == null) return fallback;

        for (int index = 0; index < labels.length; index++)
        {
            if (labels[index].equals(value)) return index;
        }

        return fallback;
    }

    static android.content.res.ColorStateList colorStateList(Resources resources, AttributeSet attributes, String name)
    {
        int[] packed = typedValue(attributes, name);

        if (packed != null)
        {
            if (packed[0] >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_COLOR_INT && packed[0] <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_COLOR_INT)
            {
                return android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(packed[1]);
            }

            if (packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_REFERENCE && packed[1] != 0 && resources != null)
            {
                try
                {
                    return resources.getColorStateList(packed[1]);
                }
                catch (RuntimeException failure)
                {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }

        String text = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
        if (text == null || !text.startsWith("#")) return null;

        return android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(parseColor(text, 0));
    }

    static android.graphics.BlendMode tintMode(AttributeSet attributes, String name, android.graphics.BlendMode fallback)
    {
        int value = integer(attributes, name, -1);

        if (value < 0)
        {
            String text = text(attributes, name);
            if (text == null) return fallback;

            switch (text)
            {
                case "src_over": value = 3; break;
                case "src_in": value = 5; break;
                case "src_atop": value = 9; break;
                case "multiply": value = 14; break;
                case "screen": value = 15; break;
                case "add": value = 16; break;
                default: return fallback;
            }
        }

        switch (value)
        {
            case 3: return android.graphics.BlendMode.SRC_OVER;
            case 5: return android.graphics.BlendMode.SRC_IN;
            case 9: return android.graphics.BlendMode.SRC_ATOP;
            case 14: return android.graphics.BlendMode.MODULATE;
            case 15: return android.graphics.BlendMode.SCREEN;
            case 16: return android.graphics.BlendMode.PLUS;
            default: return fallback;
        }
    }

    static int reference(AttributeSet attributes, String name, int fallback)
    {
        int[] packed = typedValue(attributes, name);
        if (packed != null && packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_REFERENCE) return packed[1];

        return fallback;
    }
}
```
