```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.ColorFilter;
import android.graphics.Insets;
import android.graphics.Outline;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public abstract class DrawableWrapper extends Drawable implements Drawable.Callback
{
    private Drawable mDrawable;
    private boolean mMutated;

    DrawableWrapper()
    {
    }

    public DrawableWrapper(Drawable drawable)
    {
        setDrawable(drawable);
    }

    public void setDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.setCallback(null);

        mDrawable = drawable;

        if (drawable == null) return;

        drawable.setCallback(this);
        drawable.setVisible(isVisible(), true);
        drawable.setState(getState());
        drawable.setLevel(getLevel());
        drawable.setBounds(getBounds());
        drawable.setLayoutDirection(getLayoutDirection());
    }

    public Drawable getDrawable()
    {
        return mDrawable;
    }

    DrawableWrapper copyWrapper()
    {
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        super.inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);
        inflateChild(resources, parser, attributes, theme);
    }

    void inflateChild(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        int reference = DrawableInflater.reference(attributes, "drawable", 0);
        if (reference != 0 && resources != null) setDrawable(resources.getDrawable(reference, theme));

        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= outerDepth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            Drawable child = DrawableInflater.inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);
            if (child != null) setDrawable(child);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void applyTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        super.applyTheme(theme);
        if (mDrawable != null && mDrawable.canApplyTheme()) mDrawable.applyTheme(theme);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canApplyTheme()
    {
        return mDrawable != null && mDrawable.canApplyTheme() || super.canApplyTheme();
    }

    @Override
    public void invalidateDrawable(Drawable who)
    {
        Callback callback = getCallback();
        if (callback != null) callback.invalidateDrawable(this);
    }

    @Override
    public void scheduleDrawable(Drawable who, Runnable what, long when)
    {
        Callback callback = getCallback();
        if (callback != null) callback.scheduleDrawable(this, what, when);
    }

    @Override
    public void unscheduleDrawable(Drawable who, Runnable what)
    {
        Callback callback = getCallback();
        if (callback != null) callback.unscheduleDrawable(this, what);
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.draw(canvas);
    }

    @Override
    public int getChangingConfigurations()
    {
        return super.getChangingConfigurations() | (mDrawable != null ? mDrawable.getChangingConfigurations() : 0);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean getPadding(Rect padding)
    {
        return mDrawable != null ? mDrawable.getPadding(padding) : super.getPadding(padding);
    }

    @Override
    public Insets getOpticalInsets()
    {
        return mDrawable != null ? mDrawable.getOpticalInsets() : Insets.NONE;
    }

    @Override
    public void setHotspot(float x, float y)
    {
        if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.setHotspot(x, y);
    }

    @Override
    public void setHotspotBounds(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.setHotspotBounds(left, top, right, bottom);
    }

    @Override
    public void getHotspotBounds(Rect outRect)
    {
        if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.getHotspotBounds(outRect);
        else outRect.set(getBounds());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean setVisible(boolean visible, boolean restart)
    {
        boolean changed = super.setVisible(visible, restart);
        if (mDrawable != null && mDrawable.setVisible(visible, restart)) changed = true;

        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    public void setAlpha(int alpha)
    {
        super.setAlpha(alpha);
        if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.setAlpha(alpha);
    }

    @Override
    public int getAlpha()
    {
        return mDrawable != null ? mDrawable.getAlpha() : super.getAlpha();
    }

    @Override
    public void setColorFilter(ColorFilter filter)
    {
        super.setColorFilter(filter);
        if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.setColorFilter(filter);
    }

    @Override
    public ColorFilter getColorFilter()
    {
        return mDrawable != null ? mDrawable.getColorFilter() : super.getColorFilter();
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onLevelChange(int level)
    {
        return mDrawable != null && mDrawable.setLevel(level);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onLayoutDirectionChanged(int layoutDirection)
    {
        return mDrawable != null && mDrawable.setLayoutDirection(layoutDirection);
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintList(android.content.res.ColorStateList tint)
    {
        if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.setTintList(tint);
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintBlendMode(android.graphics.BlendMode blendMode)
    {
        if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.setTintBlendMode(blendMode);
    }

    @Override
    public int getOpacity()
    {
        return mDrawable != null ? mDrawable.getOpacity() : super.getOpacity();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isStateful()
    {
        return mDrawable != null && mDrawable.isStateful();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasFocusStateSpecified()
    {
        return mDrawable != null && mDrawable.hasFocusStateSpecified();
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onStateChange(int[] stateSet)
    {
        if (mDrawable == null || !mDrawable.isStateful()) return false;

        boolean changed = mDrawable.setState(stateSet);
        if (changed) onBoundsChange(getBounds());

        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    public void jumpToCurrentState()
    {
        if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.jumpToCurrentState();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onBoundsChange(Rect bounds)
    {
        if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.setBounds(bounds);
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicWidth()
    {
        return mDrawable != null ? mDrawable.getIntrinsicWidth() : -1;
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicHeight()
    {
        return mDrawable != null ? mDrawable.getIntrinsicHeight() : -1;
    }

    @Override
    public void getOutline(Outline outline)
    {
        if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.getOutline(outline);
        else super.getOutline(outline);
    }

    @Override
    public ConstantState getConstantState()
    {
        ConstantState child = null;

        if (mDrawable != null)
        {
            child = mDrawable.getConstantState();
            if (child == null) return null;
        }

        DrawableWrapper template = copyWrapper();
        if (template == null) return null;

        return new WrapperState(template, child, getChangingConfigurations());
    }

    @Override
    public Drawable mutate()
    {
        if (!mMutated && super.mutate() == this)
        {
            if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.mutate();
            mMutated = true;
        }

        return this;
    }

    private static final class WrapperState extends ConstantState
    {
        private final DrawableWrapper mTemplate;
        private final ConstantState mChild;
        private final int mChangingConfigurations;

        WrapperState(DrawableWrapper template, ConstantState child, int changingConfigurations)
        {
            mTemplate = template;
            mChild = child;
            mChangingConfigurations = changingConfigurations;
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable()
        {
            return newDrawable(null, null);
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable(Resources resources)
        {
            return newDrawable(resources, null);
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme)
        {
            DrawableWrapper copy = mTemplate.copyWrapper();
            copy.setChangingConfigurations(mChangingConfigurations);
            if (mChild != null) copy.setDrawable(mChild.newDrawable(resources, theme));
            return copy;
        }

        @Override
        public int getChangingConfigurations()
        {
            return mChangingConfigurations;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean canApplyTheme()
        {
            return mChild != null && mChild.canApplyTheme();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    @Override

        if (mAlpha == 255 && mColorFilter == null && mTintFilter == null && isOpaqueContent()) return PixelFormat.OPAQUE;

    private boolean isOpaqueContent()
    {
        if (mShape != RECTANGLE || mRadius > 0 || mCornerRadii != null) return false;
        if (mStrokeWidth > 0 && mStrokeColors != null && !mStrokeColors.isOpaque()) return false;

        return isOpaqueFill();
    }

    private boolean isOpaqueFill()
    {
        if (mGradientColors != null)
        {
            for (int color : mGradientColors)
            {
                if ((color >>> 24) != 0xFF) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        return mSolidColors != null && mSolidColors.isOpaque();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onBoundsChange(Rect bounds)
    {
        super.onBoundsChange(bounds);
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onLevelChange(int level)
    {
        super.onLevelChange(level);
        invalidateSelf();
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        super.inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);

        mShape = DrawableInflater.enumeration(attributes, "shape", SHAPE_NAMES, RECTANGLE);
        mDither = DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "dither", false);

        if (mShape == RING)
        {
            mInnerRadius = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "innerRadius", -1));
            mInnerRadiusRatio = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "innerRadiusRatio", DEFAULT_INNER_RADIUS_RATIO);
            mThickness = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "thickness", -1));
            mThicknessRatio = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "thicknessRatio", DEFAULT_THICKNESS_RATIO);
            mUseLevelForShape = DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "useLevel", true);
        }

        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= outerDepth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            String name = parser.getName();

            if ("solid".equals(name))
            {
                mSolidColors = colorList(resources, attributes, "color", 0);
            }
            else if ("stroke".equals(name))
            {
                mStrokeWidth = DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "width", 0);
                mStrokeColors = colorList(resources, attributes, "color", 0);
                mStrokeDashWidth = DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "dashWidth", 0);
                mStrokeDashGap = DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "dashGap", 0);
            }
            else if ("corners".equals(name))
            {
                readCorners(resources, attributes);
            }
            else if ("gradient".equals(name))
            {
                readGradient(resources, attributes);
            }
            else if ("size".equals(name))
            {
                mIntrinsicWidth = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "width", -1));
                mIntrinsicHeight = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "height", -1));
            }
            else if ("padding".equals(name))
            {
                mPadding = new Rect(Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "left", 0)),
                                    Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "top", 0)),
                                    Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "right", 0)),
                                    Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "bottom", 0)));
            }
        }
    }

    private static ColorStateList colorList(Resources resources, AttributeSet attributes, String name, int fallback)
    {
        int[] packed = DrawableInflater.typedValue(attributes, name);

        if (packed != null && packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_REFERENCE && packed[1] != 0)
        {
            try
            {
                return resources.getColorStateList(packed[1]);
            }
            catch (RuntimeException failure)
            {
                return ColorStateList.valueOf(fallback);
            }
        }

        return ColorStateList.valueOf(DrawableInflater.color(resources, attributes, name, fallback));
    }

    private void readCorners(Resources resources, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        float all = DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "radius", 0);

        float topLeft = DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "topLeftRadius", all);
        float topRight = DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "topRightRadius", all);
        float bottomRight = DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "bottomRightRadius", all);
        float bottomLeft = DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "bottomLeftRadius", all);

        if (topLeft == topRight && topRight == bottomRight && bottomRight == bottomLeft)
        {
            mRadius = all;
            mCornerRadii = null;
            return;
        }

        mCornerRadii = new float[] {topLeft, topLeft, topRight, topRight, bottomRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft, bottomLeft};
    }

    private void readGradient(Resources resources, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        int start = DrawableInflater.color(resources, attributes, "startColor", 0);
        boolean hasCentre = DrawableInflater.text(attributes, "centerColor") != null;
        int centre = DrawableInflater.color(resources, attributes, "centerColor", 0);
        int end = DrawableInflater.color(resources, attributes, "endColor", 0);

        mCenterX = gradientCentre(attributes, "centerX");
        mCenterY = gradientCentre(attributes, "centerY");

        if (hasCentre)
        {
            mGradientColors = new int[] {start, centre, end};
            mPositions = new float[] {0.0f, mCenterX != 0.5f ? mCenterX : mCenterY, 1.0f};
        }
        else
        {
            mGradientColors = new int[] {start, end};
            mPositions = null;
        }

        mGradientKind = DrawableInflater.enumeration(attributes, "type", GRADIENT_NAMES, LINEAR_GRADIENT);
        mUseLevel = DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "useLevel", false);

        mGradientRadiusFraction = DrawableInflater.isFraction(attributes, "gradientRadius");
        if (mGradientRadiusFraction)
        {
            mGradientRadius = DrawableInflater.fraction(attributes, "gradientRadius", 0.5f);
        }
        else
        {
            mGradientRadius = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "gradientRadius", 0);
        }

        int angle = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "angle", 0));
        mOrientation = orientationForAngle(angle);
    }

    private static float gradientCentre(AttributeSet attributes, String name)
    {
        return DrawableInflater.fraction(attributes, name, 0.5f);
    }

    private static Orientation orientationForAngle(int angle)
    {
        int normalised = ((angle % 360) + 360) % 360;

        switch (normalised / 45)
        {
            case 1: return Orientation.BL_TR;
            case 2: return Orientation.BOTTOM_TOP;
            case 3: return Orientation.BR_TL;
            case 4: return Orientation.RIGHT_LEFT;
            case 5: return Orientation.TR_BL;
            case 6: return Orientation.TOP_BOTTOM;
            case 7: return Orientation.TL_BR;
            default: return Orientation.LEFT_RIGHT;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void applyTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        super.applyTheme(theme);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canApplyTheme()
    {
        return (mSolidColors != null && mSolidColors.canApplyTheme()) || (mStrokeColors != null && mStrokeColors.canApplyTheme())
            || (mTint != null && mTint.canApplyTheme()) || super.canApplyTheme();
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicWidth()
    {
        return mIntrinsicWidth;
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicHeight()
    {
        return mIntrinsicHeight;
    }

    @Override
    public Insets getOpticalInsets()
    {
        return Insets.NONE;
    }

    @Override
    public ConstantState getConstantState()
    {
        final GradientDrawable snapshot = new GradientDrawable(this);
        final int changing = getChangingConfigurations();

        return new ConstantState()
        {
            @Override
            public Drawable newDrawable()
            {
                return new GradientDrawable(snapshot);
            }

            @Override
            public int getChangingConfigurations()
            {
                return changing;
            }
        };
    }

    @Override
    public void getOutline(Outline outline)
    {
        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        outline.setAlpha(isOpaqueFill() ? mAlpha / 255.0f : 0.0f);

        switch (mShape)
        {
            case RECTANGLE:
                if (mCornerRadii != null)
                {
                    buildPath(bounds);
                    outline.setConvexPath(mPath);
                    return;
                }

                float radius = Math.min(mRadius, Math.min(bounds.width(), bounds.height()) * 0.5f);
                outline.setRoundRect(bounds, radius);
                return;
            case OVAL:
                outline.setOval(bounds);
                return;
            case LINE:
                float halfStroke = mStrokeWidth * 0.5f;
                float centreY = bounds.centerY();
                int top = (int)Math.floor(centreY - halfStroke);
                int bottom = (int)Math.ceil(centreY + halfStroke);
                outline.setRect(bounds.left, top, bounds.right, bottom);
                return;
            default:
                return;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public Drawable mutate()
    {
        if (!mMutated && super.mutate() == this)
        {
            mCornerRadii = mCornerRadii == null ? null : mCornerRadii.clone();
            mGradientColors = mGradientColors == null ? null : mGradientColors.clone();
            mPositions = mPositions == null ? null : mPositions.clone();
            mMutated = true;
        }
        return this;
    }

    private float levelFraction()
    {
        return getLevel() / 10000.0f;
    }

    private Shader buildShader(Rect bounds)
    {
        if (mGradientColors == null || mGradientColors.length < 2) return null;

        float[] positions = mPositions != null && mPositions.length == mGradientColors.length ? mPositions : null;

        if (mGradientKind == RADIAL_GRADIENT)
        {
            float radius = mGradientRadius;
            if (mGradientRadiusFraction) radius = radius * Math.min(bounds.width(), bounds.height());
            else if (radius <= 0) radius = Math.min(bounds.width(), bounds.height()) * 0.5f;
            if (mUseLevel) radius *= levelFraction();
            if (radius <= 0) radius = 0.001f;

            float x = bounds.left + bounds.width() * mCenterX;
            float y = bounds.top + bounds.height() * mCenterY;
            return new RadialGradient(x, y, radius, mGradientColors, positions, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP);
        }

        if (mGradientKind == SWEEP_GRADIENT)
        {
            float x = bounds.left + bounds.width() * mCenterX;
            float y = bounds.top + bounds.height() * mCenterY;
            return new SweepGradient(x, y, mGradientColors, positions);
        }

        float startX = bounds.left;
        float startY = bounds.top;
        float endX = bounds.right;
        float endY = bounds.top;
        float level = mUseLevel ? levelFraction() : 1.0f;

        switch (mOrientation)
        {
            case TOP_BOTTOM: endX = startX; endY = bounds.top + bounds.height() * level; break;
            case BOTTOM_TOP: startY = bounds.bottom; endX = startX; endY = bounds.bottom - bounds.height() * level; break;
            case RIGHT_LEFT: startX = bounds.right; endX = bounds.right - bounds.width() * level; break;
            case TL_BR: endX = bounds.left + bounds.width() * level; endY = bounds.top + bounds.height() * level; break;
            case BR_TL:
                startX = bounds.right;
                startY = bounds.bottom;
                endX = bounds.right - bounds.width() * level;
                endY = bounds.bottom - bounds.height() * level;
                break;
            case TR_BL: startX = bounds.right; endX = bounds.right - bounds.width() * level; endY = bounds.top + bounds.height() * level; break;
            case BL_TR: startY = bounds.bottom; endX = bounds.left + bounds.width() * level; endY = bounds.bottom - bounds.height() * level; break;
            default: endX = bounds.left + bounds.width() * level; break;
        }

        return new LinearGradient(startX, startY, endX, endY, mGradientColors, positions, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP);
    }

    private void buildPath(Rect bounds)
    {
        mPath.reset();

        float inset = mStrokeWidth > 0 ? mStrokeWidth * 0.5f : 0;
        mRect.set(bounds.left + inset, bounds.top + inset, bounds.right - inset, bounds.bottom - inset);

        if (mShape == OVAL)
        {
            mPath.addOval(mRect, Path.Direction.CW);
            return;
        }

        if (mShape == LINE)
        {
            float middle = mRect.centerY();
            mPath.moveTo(mRect.left, middle);
            mPath.lineTo(mRect.right, middle);
            return;
        }

        if (mShape == RING)
        {
            buildRing(bounds);
            return;
        }

        if (mCornerRadii != null)
        {
            mPath.addRoundRect(mRect, mCornerRadii, Path.Direction.CW);
            return;
        }

        if (mRadius > 0)
        {
            float radius = Math.min(mRadius, Math.min(mRect.width(), mRect.height()) * 0.5f);
            mPath.addRoundRect(mRect, radius, radius, Path.Direction.CW);
            return;
        }

        mPath.addRect(mRect, Path.Direction.CW);
    }

    private void buildRing(Rect bounds)
    {
        float thickness = mThickness != -1 ? mThickness : bounds.width() / mThicknessRatio;
        float innerRadius = mInnerRadius != -1 ? mInnerRadius : bounds.width() / mInnerRadiusRatio;
        float sweep = mUseLevelForShape ? 360.0f * levelFraction() : 360.0f;
        float centreX = bounds.exactCenterX();
        float centreY = bounds.exactCenterY();

        RectF inner = new RectF(centreX - innerRadius, centreY - innerRadius, centreX + innerRadius, centreY + innerRadius);
        float outerRadius = innerRadius + thickness;
        RectF outer = new RectF(centreX - outerRadius, centreY - outerRadius, centreX + outerRadius, centreY + outerRadius);

        if (sweep >= 360.0f || sweep <= -360.0f)
        {
            mPath.addOval(outer, Path.Direction.CW);
            mPath.addOval(inner, Path.Direction.CCW);
            mPath.setFillType(Path.FillType.EVEN_ODD);
            return;
        }

        mPath.setFillType(Path.FillType.WINDING);
        mPath.moveTo(centreX + innerRadius, centreY);
        mPath.lineTo(centreX + outerRadius, centreY);
        mPath.arcTo(outer, 0.0f, sweep, false);
        mPath.arcTo(inner, sweep, -sweep, false);
        mPath.close();
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        if (bounds.width() <= 0 || bounds.height() <= 0) return;

        buildPath(bounds);

        ColorFilter filter = mColorFilter != null ? mColorFilter : mTintFilter;
        mPaint.setColorFilter(filter);
        mStrokePaint.setColorFilter(filter);

        Shader shader = buildShader(bounds);
        int[] state = getState();

        if (shader != null || mSolidColors != null)
        {
            mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
            mPaint.setShader(shader);
            mPaint.setColor(shader == null ? withAlpha(mSolidColors.getColorForState(state, mSolidColors.getDefaultColor())) : 0xFF000000);
            if (shader != null) mPaint.setAlpha(mAlpha);

            if (mShape != LINE) canvas.drawPath(mPath, mPaint);
            mPaint.setShader(null);
        }

        if (mStrokeWidth > 0 && mStrokeColors != null)
        {
            int strokeColor = mStrokeColors.getColorForState(state, mStrokeColors.getDefaultColor());
            if (strokeColor == 0) return;

            mStrokePaint.setStrokeWidth(mStrokeWidth);
            mStrokePaint.setColor(withAlpha(strokeColor));
            mStrokePaint.setPathEffect(mStrokeDashWidth > 0 ? new DashPathEffect(new float[] {mStrokeDashWidth, mStrokeDashGap}, 0) : null);

            canvas.drawPath(mPath, mStrokePaint);
        }
    }

    private int withAlpha(int color)
    {
        int alpha = ((color >>> 24) & 0xFF) * mAlpha / 255;
        return (alpha << 24) | (color & 0x00FFFFFF);
    }

    public enum Orientation
    {
        TOP_BOTTOM,
        TR_BL,
        RIGHT_LEFT,
        BR_TL,
        BOTTOM_TOP,
        BL_TR,
        LEFT_RIGHT,
        TL_BR
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class Icon implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int TYPE_BITMAP = 1;
    public static final int TYPE_RESOURCE = 2;
    public static final int TYPE_DATA = 3;
    public static final int TYPE_URI = 4;
    public static final int TYPE_ADAPTIVE_BITMAP = 5;
    public static final int TYPE_URI_ADAPTIVE_BITMAP = 6;

    private int mType;
    private Bitmap mBitmap;
    private String mPackageName;
    private int mResourceId;
    private String mUri;
    private byte[] mData;
    private int mDataOffset;
    private int mDataLength;
    private android.content.res.ColorStateList mTintList;
    private android.graphics.BlendMode mTintBlendMode;

    private Icon(int type)
    {
        mType = type;
    }

    public int getType()
    {
        return mType;
    }

    public Bitmap getBitmap()
    {
        if (mType != TYPE_BITMAP && mType != TYPE_ADAPTIVE_BITMAP)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("called getBitmap() on " + this);
        }

        return mBitmap;
    }

    public int getResId()
    {
        if (mType != TYPE_RESOURCE) throw new IllegalStateException("called getResId() on " + this);

        return mResourceId;
    }

    public String getResPackage()
    {
        if (mType != TYPE_RESOURCE) throw new IllegalStateException("called getResPackage() on " + this);

        return mPackageName;
    }

    public Uri getUri()
    {
        if (mType != TYPE_URI && mType != TYPE_URI_ADAPTIVE_BITMAP)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("called getUri() on " + this);
        }

        return Uri.parse(mUri);
    }

    public Icon setTint(int tint)
    {
        return setTintList(android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(tint));
    }

    public Icon setTintList(android.content.res.ColorStateList tintList)
    {
        mTintList = tintList;
        return this;
    }

    public android.content.res.ColorStateList getTintList()
    {
        return mTintList;
    }

    public Icon setTintMode(android.graphics.PorterDuff.Mode mode)
    {
        mTintBlendMode = blendModeOf(mode);
        return this;
    }

    private static android.graphics.BlendMode blendModeOf(android.graphics.PorterDuff.Mode mode)
    {
        if (mode == null) return null;
        if (mode == android.graphics.PorterDuff.Mode.ADD) return android.graphics.BlendMode.PLUS;
        if (mode == android.graphics.PorterDuff.Mode.MULTIPLY) return android.graphics.BlendMode.MODULATE;

        return android.graphics.BlendMode.valueOf(mode.name());
    }

    public Icon setTintBlendMode(android.graphics.BlendMode blendMode)
    {
        mTintBlendMode = blendMode;
        return this;
    }

    public Drawable loadDrawable(Context context)
    {
        Drawable drawable = buildDrawable(context);

        if (drawable != null && mTintList != null) drawable.setTintList(mTintList);
        if (drawable != null && mTintBlendMode != null) drawable.setTintBlendMode(mTintBlendMode);

        return drawable;
    }

    private Drawable buildDrawable(Context context)
    {
        if (mType == TYPE_BITMAP || mType == TYPE_ADAPTIVE_BITMAP)
        {
            if (mBitmap == null) return null;

            Resources resources = context == null ? null : context.getResources();
            BitmapDrawable bitmap = new BitmapDrawable(resources, mBitmap);

            if (mType == TYPE_BITMAP) return bitmap;

            return new AdaptiveIconDrawable(null, bitmap);
        }

        if (mType == TYPE_RESOURCE)
        {
            if (context == null) return null;

            if (mPackageName == null || mPackageName.equals(context.getPackageName()))
            {
                return context.getResources().getDrawable(mResourceId, context.getTheme());
            }

            try
            {
                Context other = context.createPackageContext(mPackageName, 0);
                return other.getResources().getDrawable(mResourceId, other.getTheme());
            }
            catch (Exception failure)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        if (mType == TYPE_DATA)
        {
            if (mData == null) return null;

            Bitmap decoded = android.graphics.BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(mData, mDataOffset, mDataLength);
            if (decoded == null) return null;

            return new BitmapDrawable(context == null ? null : context.getResources(), decoded);
        }

        if (mType == TYPE_URI || mType == TYPE_URI_ADAPTIVE_BITMAP)
        {
            Bitmap decoded = decodeUri(context);
            if (decoded == null) return null;

            BitmapDrawable bitmap = new BitmapDrawable(context == null ? null : context.getResources(), decoded);
            return mType == TYPE_URI ? bitmap : new AdaptiveIconDrawable(null, bitmap);
        }

        return null;
    }

    private Bitmap decodeUri(Context context)
    {
        if (mUri == null) return null;

        Uri uri = Uri.parse(mUri);
        String scheme = uri.getScheme();

        if (scheme == null || "file".equals(scheme))
        {
            String path = scheme == null ? mUri : uri.getPath();
            return android.graphics.BitmapFactory.decodeFile(path);
        }

        if (context == null) return null;

        try (java.io.InputStream stream = context.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri))
        {
            return stream == null ? null : android.graphics.BitmapFactory.decodeStream(stream);
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public void loadDrawableAsync(Context context, android.os.Message andThen)
    {
        andThen.obj = loadDrawable(context);
        andThen.sendToTarget();
    }

    public void loadDrawableAsync(Context context, OnDrawableLoadedListener listener, android.os.Handler handler)
    {
        final Drawable drawable = loadDrawable(context);

        if (listener == null) return;

        if (handler == null)
        {
            listener.onDrawableLoaded(drawable);
            return;
        }

        handler.post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                listener.onDrawableLoaded(drawable);
            }
        });
    }

    public interface OnDrawableLoadedListener
    {
        void onDrawableLoaded(Drawable drawable);
    }

    public static Icon createWithBitmap(Bitmap bitmap)
    {
        if (bitmap == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("bitmap must not be null");

        Icon icon = new Icon(TYPE_BITMAP);
        icon.mBitmap = bitmap;

        return icon;
    }

    public static Icon createWithAdaptiveBitmap(Bitmap bitmap)
    {
        if (bitmap == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("bitmap must not be null");

        Icon icon = new Icon(TYPE_ADAPTIVE_BITMAP);
        icon.mBitmap = bitmap;

        return icon;
    }

    public static Icon createWithResource(Context context, int resourceId)
    {
        if (context == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("context must not be null");

        return createWithResource(context.getPackageName(), resourceId);
    }

    public static Icon createWithResource(Resources resources, int resourceId)
    {
        Icon icon = new Icon(TYPE_RESOURCE);
        icon.mResourceId = resourceId;

        return icon;
    }

    public static Icon createWithResource(String packageName, int resourceId)
    {
        Icon icon = new Icon(TYPE_RESOURCE);
        icon.mPackageName = packageName;
        icon.mResourceId = resourceId;

        return icon;
    }

    public static Icon createWithFilePath(String path)
    {
        if (path == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Path must not be null.");

        Icon icon = new Icon(TYPE_URI);
        icon.mUri = path;

        return icon;
    }

    public static Icon createWithContentUri(String uri)
    {
        Icon icon = new Icon(TYPE_URI);
        icon.mUri = uri;

        return icon;
    }

    public static Icon createWithContentUri(Uri uri)
    {
        return createWithContentUri(uri == null ? null : uri.toString());
    }

    public static Icon createWithAdaptiveBitmapContentUri(String uri)
    {
        Icon icon = new Icon(TYPE_URI_ADAPTIVE_BITMAP);
        icon.mUri = uri;

        return icon;
    }

    public static Icon createWithAdaptiveBitmapContentUri(Uri uri)
    {
        return createWithAdaptiveBitmapContentUri(uri == null ? null : uri.toString());
    }

    public static Icon createWithData(byte[] data, int offset, int length)
    {
        Icon icon = new Icon(TYPE_DATA);
        icon.mData = data;
        icon.mDataOffset = offset;
        icon.mDataLength = length;

        return icon;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Icon(typ=" + mType + ")";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        parcel.writeValue(Integer.valueOf(mType));
        parcel.writeValue(mPackageName);
        parcel.writeValue(Integer.valueOf(mResourceId));
        parcel.writeValue(mUri);
    }

    public static final Creator<Icon> CREATOR = new Creator<Icon>()
    {
        @Override
        public Icon createFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
        {
            Object type = parcel.readValue(null);
            Icon icon = new Icon(type instanceof Integer ? ((Integer)type).intValue() : TYPE_RESOURCE);

            icon.mPackageName = (String)parcel.readValue(null);

            Object resourceId = parcel.readValue(null);
            icon.mResourceId = resourceId instanceof Integer ? ((Integer)resourceId).intValue() : 0;

            icon.mUri = (String)parcel.readValue(null);

            return icon;
        }

        @Override
        public Icon[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Icon[size];
        }
    };
}
```

`java/android/graphics/drawable/InsetDrawable.java`:

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class InsetDrawable extends DrawableWrapper
{
    private int mLeft;
    private int mTop;
    private int mRight;
    private int mBottom;
    private float mLeftFraction;
    private float mTopFraction;
    private float mRightFraction;
    private float mBottomFraction;

    public InsetDrawable()
    {
    }

    public InsetDrawable(Drawable inner, int inset)
    {
        this(inner, inset, inset, inset, inset);
    }

    public InsetDrawable(Drawable inner, float inset)
    {
        this(inner, inset, inset, inset, inset);
    }

    public InsetDrawable(Drawable inner, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        super(inner);
        mLeft = left;
        mTop = top;
        mRight = right;
        mBottom = bottom;
    }

    public InsetDrawable(Drawable inner, float left, float top, float right, float bottom)
    {
        super(inner);
        mLeftFraction = left;
        mTopFraction = top;
        mRightFraction = right;
        mBottomFraction = bottom;
    }

    private int left(Rect bounds)
    {
        return mLeft + Math.round(bounds.width() * mLeftFraction);
    }

    private int top(Rect bounds)
    {
        return mTop + Math.round(bounds.height() * mTopFraction);
    }

    private int right(Rect bounds)
    {
        return mRight + Math.round(bounds.width() * mRightFraction);
    }

    private int bottom(Rect bounds)
    {
        return mBottom + Math.round(bounds.height() * mBottomFraction);
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicWidth()
    {
        Drawable inner = getDrawable();
        if (inner == null) return -1;

        int width = inner.getIntrinsicWidth();
        if (width < 0) return -1;

        float fractions = mLeftFraction + mRightFraction;
        return fractions >= 1f ? -1 : Math.round((width + mLeft + mRight) / (1f - fractions));
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicHeight()
    {
        Drawable inner = getDrawable();
        if (inner == null) return -1;

        int height = inner.getIntrinsicHeight();
        if (height < 0) return -1;

        float fractions = mTopFraction + mBottomFraction;
        return fractions >= 1f ? -1 : Math.round((height + mTop + mBottom) / (1f - fractions));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean getPadding(Rect padding)
    {
        if (padding == null) return false;

        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        Rect inner = new Rect();
        boolean innerPadded = getDrawable() != null && getDrawable().getPadding(inner);

        padding.set(left(bounds) + inner.left, top(bounds) + inner.top, right(bounds) + inner.right, bottom(bounds) + inner.bottom);
        return innerPadded || padding.left != 0 || padding.top != 0 || padding.right != 0 || padding.bottom != 0;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onBoundsChange(Rect bounds)
    {
        Drawable inner = getDrawable();
        if (inner == null) return;

        inner.setBounds(bounds.left + left(bounds), bounds.top + top(bounds), bounds.right - right(bounds),
                        bounds.bottom - bottom(bounds));
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        boolean allFraction = DrawableInflater.isFraction(attributes, "inset");
        int all = allFraction ? 0 : Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "inset", 0));
        float allPart = allFraction ? DrawableInflater.fraction(attributes, "inset", 0) : 0;

        mLeft = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "insetLeft", all));
        mTop = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "insetTop", all));
        mRight = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "insetRight", all));
        mBottom = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "insetBottom", all));
        mLeftFraction = side(attributes, "insetLeft", allPart);
        mTopFraction = side(attributes, "insetTop", allPart);
        mRightFraction = side(attributes, "insetRight", allPart);
        mBottomFraction = side(attributes, "insetBottom", allPart);

        if (DrawableInflater.isFraction(attributes, "insetLeft")) mLeft = 0;
        if (DrawableInflater.isFraction(attributes, "insetTop")) mTop = 0;
        if (DrawableInflater.isFraction(attributes, "insetRight")) mRight = 0;
        if (DrawableInflater.isFraction(attributes, "insetBottom")) mBottom = 0;

        inflateChild(resources, parser, attributes, theme);
    }

    private static float side(AttributeSet attributes, String name, float fallback)
    {
        if (DrawableInflater.isFraction(attributes, name)) return DrawableInflater.fraction(attributes, name, fallback);
        if (DrawableInflater.text(attributes, name) != null) return 0;

        return fallback;
    }

    @Override
    public void applyTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        super.applyTheme(theme);
    }

    @Override
    public android.graphics.Insets getOpticalInsets()
    {
        android.graphics.Insets inner = super.getOpticalInsets();
        Rect bounds = getBounds();

        return android.graphics.Insets.of(inner.left + left(bounds), inner.top + top(bounds), inner.right + right(bounds),
                                          inner.bottom + bottom(bounds));
    }

    @Override
    public int getOpacity()
    {
        Drawable inner = getDrawable();
        if (inner == null) return android.graphics.PixelFormat.TRANSPARENT;

        int opacity = inner.getOpacity();
        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        boolean inset = left(bounds) > 0 || top(bounds) > 0 || right(bounds) > 0 || bottom(bounds) > 0;

        if (opacity == android.graphics.PixelFormat.OPAQUE && inset) return android.graphics.PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;

        return opacity;
    }

    @Override
    public void getOutline(android.graphics.Outline outline)
    {
        super.getOutline(outline);
    }

    @Override
    DrawableWrapper copyWrapper()
    {
        InsetDrawable copy = new InsetDrawable();
        copy.mLeft = mLeft;
        copy.mTop = mTop;
        copy.mRight = mRight;
        copy.mBottom = mBottom;
        copy.mLeftFraction = mLeftFraction;
        copy.mTopFraction = mTopFraction;
        copy.mRightFraction = mRightFraction;
        copy.mBottomFraction = mBottomFraction;
        return copy;
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        Drawable inner = getDrawable();
        if (inner == null) return;

        onBoundsChange(getBounds());
        inner.setAlpha(getAlpha());
        inner.draw(canvas);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.ColorFilter;
import android.graphics.Outline;
import android.graphics.PixelFormat;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.Gravity;

import java.util.ArrayList;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class LayerDrawable extends Drawable implements Drawable.Callback
{
    public static final int PADDING_MODE_NEST = 0;
    public static final int PADDING_MODE_STACK = 1;
    public static final int INSET_UNDEFINED = Integer.MIN_VALUE;

    private static final String[] PADDING_MODE_NAMES = {"nest", "stack"};

    private final ArrayList<Layer> mLayers = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Rect mContainer = new Rect();
    private final Rect mLayerBounds = new Rect();
    private final Rect mChildPadding = new Rect();

    private int mPaddingMode = PADDING_MODE_NEST;
    private int mPaddingLeft = -1;
    private int mPaddingTop = -1;
    private int mPaddingRight = -1;
    private int mPaddingBottom = -1;
    private int mPaddingStart = -1;
    private int mPaddingEnd = -1;
    private int mOpacityOverride = PixelFormat.UNKNOWN;
    private boolean mAutoMirrored;
    private boolean mMutated;
    private Rect mHotspotBounds;

    public LayerDrawable()
    {
    }

    public LayerDrawable(Drawable[] layers)
    {
        if (layers == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("layers must be non-null");

        for (Drawable layer : layers)
        {
            if (layer != null) addLayer(layer);
        }
    }

    public int addLayer(Drawable drawable)
    {
        Layer layer = new Layer(drawable);
        attach(drawable);
        mLayers.add(layer);

        layoutLayers();
        return mLayers.size() - 1;
    }

    private void attach(Drawable drawable)
    {
        if (drawable == null) return;

        drawable.setCallback(this);
        drawable.setLayoutDirection(getLayoutDirection());
        drawable.setLevel(getLevel());
        drawable.setVisible(isVisible(), true);
        drawable.setState(getState());
        if (getAlpha() != 255) drawable.setAlpha(getAlpha());
        if (getColorFilter() != null) drawable.setColorFilter(getColorFilter());
    }

    public Drawable findDrawableByLayerId(int id)
    {
        for (int index = mLayers.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            Layer layer = mLayers.get(index);
            if (layer.id == id) return layer.drawable;
        }

        return null;
    }

    public void setId(int index, int id)
    {
        layer(index).id = id;
    }

    public int getId(int index)
    {
        return index < 0 || index >= mLayers.size() ? 0 : mLayers.get(index).id;
    }

    public int getNumberOfLayers()
    {
        return mLayers.size();
    }

    public boolean setDrawableByLayerId(int id, Drawable drawable)
    {
        int index = findIndexByLayerId(id);
        if (index < 0) return false;

        setDrawable(index, drawable);
        return true;
    }

    public int findIndexByLayerId(int id)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mLayers.size(); index++)
        {
            if (mLayers.get(index).id == id) return index;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public void setDrawable(int index, Drawable drawable)
    {
        Layer layer = layer(index);

        if (layer.drawable != null) layer.drawable.setCallback(null);

        attach(drawable);
        layer.drawable = drawable;

        layoutLayers();
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    public Drawable getDrawable(int index)
    {
        return index < 0 || index >= mLayers.size() ? null : mLayers.get(index).drawable;
    }

    public void setLayerSize(int index, int width, int height)
    {
        Layer layer = layer(index);
        layer.width = width;
        layer.height = height;
    }

    public void setLayerWidth(int index, int width)
    {
        layer(index).width = width;
    }

    public int getLayerWidth(int index)
    {
        return layer(index).width;
    }

    public void setLayerHeight(int index, int height)
    {
        layer(index).height = height;
    }

    public int getLayerHeight(int index)
    {
        return layer(index).height;
    }

    public void setLayerGravity(int index, int gravity)
    {
        layer(index).gravity = gravity;
    }

    public int getLayerGravity(int index)
    {
        return layer(index).gravity;
    }

    public void setLayerInset(int index, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        setInsets(index, left, top, right, bottom, INSET_UNDEFINED, INSET_UNDEFINED);
    }

    public void setLayerInsetRelative(int index, int start, int top, int end, int bottom)
    {
        setInsets(index, 0, top, 0, bottom, start, end);
    }

    private void setInsets(int index, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int start, int end)
    {
        Layer layer = layer(index);
        layer.left = left;
        layer.top = top;
        layer.right = right;
        layer.bottom = bottom;
        layer.start = start;
        layer.end = end;
    }

    public void setLayerInsetLeft(int index, int left)
    {
        layer(index).left = left;
    }

    public int getLayerInsetLeft(int index)
    {
        return layer(index).left;
    }

    public void setLayerInsetRight(int index, int right)
    {
        layer(index).right = right;
    }

    public int getLayerInsetRight(int index)
    {
        return layer(index).right;
    }

    public void setLayerInsetTop(int index, int top)
    {
        layer(index).top = top;
    }

    public int getLayerInsetTop(int index)
    {
        return layer(index).top;
    }

    public void setLayerInsetBottom(int index, int bottom)
    {
        layer(index).bottom = bottom;
    }

    public int getLayerInsetBottom(int index)
    {
        return layer(index).bottom;
    }

    public void setLayerInsetStart(int index, int start)
    {
        layer(index).start = start;
    }

    public int getLayerInsetStart(int index)
    {
        return layer(index).start;
    }

    public void setLayerInsetEnd(int index, int end)
    {
        layer(index).end = end;
    }

    public int getLayerInsetEnd(int index)
    {
        return layer(index).end;
    }

    public void setPaddingMode(int mode)
    {
        if (mode != PADDING_MODE_NEST && mode != PADDING_MODE_STACK)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Padding mode must be PADDING_MODE_NEST or PADDING_MODE_STACK");
        }

        mPaddingMode = mode;
    }

    public int getPaddingMode()
    {
        return mPaddingMode;
    }

    public void setPadding(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        mPaddingLeft = left;
        mPaddingTop = top;
        mPaddingRight = right;
        mPaddingBottom = bottom;
        mPaddingStart = -1;
        mPaddingEnd = -1;
    }

    public void setPaddingRelative(int start, int top, int end, int bottom)
    {
        mPaddingStart = start;
        mPaddingTop = top;
        mPaddingEnd = end;
        mPaddingBottom = bottom;
        mPaddingLeft = -1;
        mPaddingRight = -1;
    }

    public int getLeftPadding()
    {
        return mPaddingLeft;
    }

    public int getRightPadding()
    {
        return mPaddingRight;
    }

    public int getStartPadding()
    {
        return mPaddingStart;
    }

    public int getEndPadding()
    {
        return mPaddingEnd;
    }

    public int getTopPadding()
    {
        return mPaddingTop;
    }

    public int getBottomPadding()
    {
        return mPaddingBottom;
    }

    public void setOpacity(int opacity)
    {
        mOpacityOverride = opacity;
    }

    @Override
    public int getOpacity()
    {
        if (mOpacityOverride != PixelFormat.UNKNOWN) return mOpacityOverride;

        int opacity = PixelFormat.TRANSPARENT;

        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null && layer.drawable.isVisible()) opacity = resolveOpacity(opacity, layer.drawable.getOpacity());
        }

        return opacity;
    }

    @Override
    public void invalidateDrawable(Drawable who)
    {
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public void scheduleDrawable(Drawable who, Runnable what, long when)
    {
        scheduleSelf(what, when);
    }

    @Override
    public void unscheduleDrawable(Drawable who, Runnable what)
    {
        unscheduleSelf(what);
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        layoutLayers();

        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null) layer.drawable.draw(canvas);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean getPadding(Rect padding)
    {
        computePadding(padding, mLayers.size());

        boolean rightToLeft = getLayoutDirection() == 1;
        int start = rightToLeft ? mPaddingEnd : mPaddingStart;
        int end = rightToLeft ? mPaddingStart : mPaddingEnd;

        if (start >= 0) padding.left = start;
        else if (mPaddingLeft >= 0) padding.left = mPaddingLeft;

        if (end >= 0) padding.right = end;
        else if (mPaddingRight >= 0) padding.right = mPaddingRight;

        if (mPaddingTop >= 0) padding.top = mPaddingTop;
        if (mPaddingBottom >= 0) padding.bottom = mPaddingBottom;

        return padding.left != 0 || padding.top != 0 || padding.right != 0 || padding.bottom != 0;
    }

    private void computePadding(Rect padding, int count)
    {
        padding.set(0, 0, 0, 0);

        for (int index = 0; index < count && index < mLayers.size(); index++)
        {
            Drawable drawable = mLayers.get(index).drawable;
            if (drawable == null) continue;

            mChildPadding.set(0, 0, 0, 0);
            drawable.getPadding(mChildPadding);

            if (mPaddingMode == PADDING_MODE_NEST)
            {
                padding.left += mChildPadding.left;
                padding.top += mChildPadding.top;
                padding.right += mChildPadding.right;
                padding.bottom += mChildPadding.bottom;
            }
            else
            {
                padding.left = Math.max(padding.left, mChildPadding.left);
                padding.top = Math.max(padding.top, mChildPadding.top);
                padding.right = Math.max(padding.right, mChildPadding.right);
                padding.bottom = Math.max(padding.bottom, mChildPadding.bottom);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void getOutline(Outline outline)
    {
        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable == null) continue;

            layer.drawable.getOutline(outline);
            if (!outline.isEmpty()) return;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setHotspot(float x, float y)
    {
        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null) layer.drawable.setHotspot(x, y);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setHotspotBounds(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        if (mHotspotBounds == null) mHotspotBounds = new Rect(left, top, right, bottom);
        else mHotspotBounds.set(left, top, right, bottom);

        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null) layer.drawable.setHotspotBounds(left, top, right, bottom);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean setVisible(boolean visible, boolean restart)
    {
        boolean changed = super.setVisible(visible, restart);

        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null) layer.drawable.setVisible(visible, restart);
        }

        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    public void setDither(boolean dither)
    {
        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null) layer.drawable.setDither(dither);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setAlpha(int alpha)
    {
        super.setAlpha(alpha);

        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null) layer.drawable.setAlpha(alpha);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setColorFilter(ColorFilter filter)
    {
        super.setColorFilter(filter);

        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null) layer.drawable.setColorFilter(filter);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintList(android.content.res.ColorStateList tint)
    {
        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null) layer.drawable.setTintList(tint);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintBlendMode(android.graphics.BlendMode blendMode)
    {
        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null) layer.drawable.setTintBlendMode(blendMode);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setAutoMirrored(boolean mirrored)
    {
        mAutoMirrored = mirrored;

        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null) layer.drawable.setAutoMirrored(mirrored);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAutoMirrored()
    {
        return mAutoMirrored;
    }

    @Override
    public void jumpToCurrentState()
    {
        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null) layer.drawable.jumpToCurrentState();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isStateful()
    {
        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null && layer.drawable.isStateful()) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasFocusStateSpecified()
    {
        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null && layer.drawable.hasFocusStateSpecified()) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onStateChange(int[] stateSet)
    {
        boolean changed = false;

        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null && layer.drawable.isStateful() && layer.drawable.setState(stateSet)) changed = true;
        }

        if (changed) layoutLayers();
        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onLevelChange(int level)
    {
        boolean changed = false;

        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null && layer.drawable.setLevel(level)) changed = true;
        }

        if (changed) layoutLayers();
        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onLayoutDirectionChanged(int layoutDirection)
    {
        boolean changed = false;

        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null && layer.drawable.setLayoutDirection(layoutDirection)) changed = true;
        }

        layoutLayers();
        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onBoundsChange(Rect bounds)
    {
        layoutLayers();
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicWidth()
    {
        int widest = -1;
        int paddingLeft = 0;
        int paddingRight = 0;
        boolean nest = mPaddingMode == PADDING_MODE_NEST;
        boolean rightToLeft = getLayoutDirection() == 1;

        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable == null) continue;

            int minimum = layer.width < 0 ? layer.drawable.getIntrinsicWidth() : layer.width;
            int width = minimum < 0 ? -1 : minimum + layer.resolvedLeft(rightToLeft) + layer.resolvedRight(rightToLeft) + paddingLeft
                                           + paddingRight;
            if (width > widest) widest = width;

            if (nest)
            {
                mChildPadding.set(0, 0, 0, 0);
                layer.drawable.getPadding(mChildPadding);
                paddingLeft += mChildPadding.left;
                paddingRight += mChildPadding.right;
            }
        }

        return widest;
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicHeight()
    {
        int tallest = -1;
        int paddingTop = 0;
        int paddingBottom = 0;
        boolean nest = mPaddingMode == PADDING_MODE_NEST;

        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable == null) continue;

            int minimum = layer.height < 0 ? layer.drawable.getIntrinsicHeight() : layer.height;
            int height = minimum < 0 ? -1 : minimum + layer.top + layer.bottom + paddingTop + paddingBottom;
            if (height > tallest) tallest = height;

            if (nest)
            {
                mChildPadding.set(0, 0, 0, 0);
                layer.drawable.getPadding(mChildPadding);
                paddingTop += mChildPadding.top;
                paddingBottom += mChildPadding.bottom;
            }
        }

        return tallest;
    }

    @Override
    public Drawable mutate()
    {
        if (!mMutated && super.mutate() == this)
        {
            for (Layer layer : mLayers)
            {
                if (layer.drawable != null) layer.drawable.mutate();
            }

            mMutated = true;
        }

        return this;
    }

    @Override
    public int getAlpha()
    {
        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null) return layer.drawable.getAlpha();
        }

        return super.getAlpha();
    }

    @Override
    public int getChangingConfigurations()
    {
        int configurations = super.getChangingConfigurations();

        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null) configurations |= layer.drawable.getChangingConfigurations();
        }

        return configurations;
    }

    @Override
    public void applyTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        super.applyTheme(theme);

        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null && layer.drawable.canApplyTheme()) layer.drawable.applyTheme(theme);
        }

        layoutLayers();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canApplyTheme()
    {
        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null && layer.drawable.canApplyTheme()) return true;
        }

        return super.canApplyTheme();
    }

    @Override
    public void getHotspotBounds(Rect outRect)
    {
        if (mHotspotBounds != null) outRect.set(mHotspotBounds);
        else super.getHotspotBounds(outRect);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isProjected()
    {
        if (super.isProjected()) return true;

        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            if (layer.drawable != null && layer.drawable.isProjected()) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    LayerDrawable createCopy()
    {
        return new LayerDrawable();
    }

    void copyConfigurationTo(LayerDrawable copy)
    {
        copy.mPaddingMode = mPaddingMode;
        copy.mPaddingLeft = mPaddingLeft;
        copy.mPaddingTop = mPaddingTop;
        copy.mPaddingRight = mPaddingRight;
        copy.mPaddingBottom = mPaddingBottom;
        copy.mPaddingStart = mPaddingStart;
        copy.mPaddingEnd = mPaddingEnd;
        copy.mOpacityOverride = mOpacityOverride;
        copy.mAutoMirrored = mAutoMirrored;
    }

    @Override
    public ConstantState getConstantState()
    {
        ConstantState[] children = new ConstantState[mLayers.size()];

        for (int index = 0; index < children.length; index++)
        {
            Drawable drawable = mLayers.get(index).drawable;
            if (drawable == null) continue;

            children[index] = drawable.getConstantState();
            if (children[index] == null) return null;
        }

        LayerDrawable template = createCopy();
        copyConfigurationTo(template);

        Layer[] layers = new Layer[children.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < layers.length; index++) layers[index] = mLayers.get(index).copyWithout();

        return new LayerState(template, layers, children, getChangingConfigurations());
    }

    private static final class LayerState extends ConstantState
    {
        private final LayerDrawable mTemplate;
        private final Layer[] mLayers;
        private final ConstantState[] mChildren;
        private final int mChangingConfigurations;

        LayerState(LayerDrawable template, Layer[] layers, ConstantState[] children, int changingConfigurations)
        {
            mTemplate = template;
            mLayers = layers;
            mChildren = children;
            mChangingConfigurations = changingConfigurations;
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable()
        {
            return newDrawable(null, null);
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable(Resources resources)
        {
            return newDrawable(resources, null);
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme)
        {
            LayerDrawable copy = mTemplate.createCopy();
            mTemplate.copyConfigurationTo(copy);
            copy.setChangingConfigurations(mChangingConfigurations);

            for (int index = 0; index < mLayers.length; index++)
            {
                Layer layer = mLayers[index].copyWithout();
                layer.drawable = mChildren[index] == null ? null : mChildren[index].newDrawable(resources, theme);
                copy.attach(layer.drawable);
                copy.mLayers.add(layer);
            }

            copy.layoutLayers();
            return copy;
        }

        @Override
        public int getChangingConfigurations()
        {
            return mChangingConfigurations;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean canApplyTheme()
        {
            for (ConstantState child : mChildren)
            {
                if (child != null && child.canApplyTheme()) return true;
            }

            return false;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        super.inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);

        int opacity = DrawableInflater.enumeration(attributes, "opacity", null, PixelFormat.UNKNOWN);
        if (opacity != PixelFormat.UNKNOWN) mOpacityOverride = opacity;

        mPaddingMode = DrawableInflater.enumeration(attributes, "paddingMode", PADDING_MODE_NAMES, mPaddingMode);
        mAutoMirrored = DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "autoMirrored", false);
        mPaddingLeft = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "paddingLeft", mPaddingLeft));
        mPaddingTop = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "paddingTop", mPaddingTop));
        mPaddingRight = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "paddingRight", mPaddingRight));
        mPaddingBottom = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "paddingBottom", mPaddingBottom));
        mPaddingStart = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "paddingStart", mPaddingStart));
        mPaddingEnd = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "paddingEnd", mPaddingEnd));

        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= outerDepth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            if (!"item".equals(parser.getName()))
            {
                DrawableInflater.skipElement(parser);
                continue;
            }

            Layer layer = new Layer(null);
            layer.id = DrawableInflater.reference(attributes, "id", 0);
            layer.left = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "left", 0));
            layer.top = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "top", 0));
            layer.right = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "right", 0));
            layer.bottom = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "bottom", 0));
            layer.start = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "start", INSET_UNDEFINED));
            layer.end = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "end", INSET_UNDEFINED));
            layer.width = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "width", -1));
            layer.height = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "height", -1));
            layer.gravity = DrawableInflater.gravity(attributes, "gravity", Gravity.NO_GRAVITY);

            layer.drawable = DrawableInflater.itemDrawable(resources, parser, attributes, theme);

            if (layer.drawable == null) continue;

            attach(layer.drawable);
            mLayers.add(layer);
        }

        layoutLayers();
    }

    void layoutLayers()
    {
        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        boolean nest = mPaddingMode == PADDING_MODE_NEST;
        boolean rightToLeft = getLayoutDirection() == 1;

        int paddingLeft = 0;
        int paddingTop = 0;
        int paddingRight = 0;
        int paddingBottom = 0;

        for (Layer layer : mLayers)
        {
            Drawable drawable = layer.drawable;
            if (drawable == null) continue;

            mContainer.set(bounds.left + layer.resolvedLeft(rightToLeft) + paddingLeft, bounds.top + layer.top + paddingTop,
                           bounds.right - layer.resolvedRight(rightToLeft) - paddingRight,
                           bounds.bottom - layer.bottom - paddingBottom);

            int intrinsicWidth = drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
            int intrinsicHeight = drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();
            int gravity = resolveGravity(layer.gravity, layer.width, layer.height, intrinsicWidth, intrinsicHeight);
            int width = layer.width < 0 ? intrinsicWidth : layer.width;
            int height = layer.height < 0 ? intrinsicHeight : layer.height;

            Gravity.apply(gravity, width, height, mContainer, mLayerBounds, getLayoutDirection());

            Rect current = drawable.getBounds();

            if (!current.equals(mLayerBounds))
            {
                drawable.setBounds(mLayerBounds.left, mLayerBounds.top, mLayerBounds.right, mLayerBounds.bottom);
            }

            if (nest)
            {
                mChildPadding.set(0, 0, 0, 0);
                drawable.getPadding(mChildPadding);
                paddingLeft += mChildPadding.left;
                paddingTop += mChildPadding.top;
                paddingRight += mChildPadding.right;
                paddingBottom += mChildPadding.bottom;
            }
        }
    }

    private static int resolveGravity(int gravity, int width, int height, int intrinsicWidth, int intrinsicHeight)
    {
        int resolved = gravity;

        if (!Gravity.isHorizontal(resolved)) resolved |= width < 0 ? Gravity.FILL_HORIZONTAL : Gravity.LEFT;
        if (!Gravity.isVertical(resolved)) resolved |= height < 0 ? Gravity.FILL_VERTICAL : Gravity.TOP;

        if (width < 0 && intrinsicWidth < 0) resolved |= Gravity.FILL_HORIZONTAL;
        if (height < 0 && intrinsicHeight < 0) resolved |= Gravity.FILL_VERTICAL;

        return resolved;
    }

    private Layer layer(int index)
    {
        if (index < 0 || index >= mLayers.size()) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("layer " + index);

        return mLayers.get(index);
    }

    private static final class Layer
    {
        Drawable drawable;
        int id;
        int left;
        int top;
        int right;
        int bottom;
        int start = INSET_UNDEFINED;
        int end = INSET_UNDEFINED;
        int width = -1;
        int height = -1;
        int gravity = Gravity.NO_GRAVITY;

        Layer(Drawable drawable)
        {
            this.drawable = drawable;
        }

        Layer copyWithout()
        {
            Layer copy = new Layer(null);
            copy.id = id;
            copy.left = left;
            copy.top = top;
            copy.right = right;
            copy.bottom = bottom;
            copy.start = start;
            copy.end = end;
            copy.width = width;
            copy.height = height;
            copy.gravity = gravity;
            return copy;
        }

        int resolvedLeft(boolean rightToLeft)
        {
            int relative = rightToLeft ? end : start;
            return relative != INSET_UNDEFINED ? relative : left;
        }

        int resolvedRight(boolean rightToLeft)
        {
            int relative = rightToLeft ? start : end;
            return relative != INSET_UNDEFINED ? relative : right;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class LevelListDrawable extends DrawableContainer
{
    private LevelListState mLevelListState;
    private boolean mMutated;

    public LevelListDrawable()
    {
        this(null, null);
    }

    private LevelListDrawable(LevelListState state, Resources resources)
    {
        setConstantState(new LevelListState(state, this, resources));
        onLevelChange(getLevel());
    }

    public void addLevel(int low, int high, Drawable drawable)
    {
        if (drawable == null) return;

        mLevelListState.addLevel(low, high, drawable);
        onLevelChange(getLevel());
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onLevelChange(int level)
    {
        if (selectDrawable(mLevelListState.indexOfLevel(level))) return true;

        return super.onLevelChange(level);
    }

    @Override
    public Drawable mutate()
    {
        if (!mMutated && super.mutate() == this)
        {
            mLevelListState.mutate();
            mMutated = true;
        }

        return this;
    }

    @Override
    protected void setConstantState(DrawableContainerState state)
    {
        super.setConstantState(state);

        if (state instanceof LevelListState) mLevelListState = (LevelListState) state;
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        super.inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);

        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= outerDepth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            if (!"item".equals(parser.getName()))
            {
                DrawableInflater.skipElement(parser);
                continue;
            }

            int low = DrawableInflater.integer(attributes, "minLevel", 0);
            int high = DrawableInflater.integer(attributes, "maxLevel", 0);

            Drawable drawable = DrawableInflater.itemDrawable(resources, parser, attributes, theme);
            if (drawable == null) continue;

            mLevelListState.addLevel(low, high, drawable);
        }

        onLevelChange(getLevel());
    }

    private static final class LevelListState extends DrawableContainerState
    {
        private int[] mLows;
        private int[] mHighs;

        LevelListState(LevelListState original, LevelListDrawable owner, Resources resources)
        {
            super(original, owner, resources);

            mLows = new int[mDrawables.length];
            mHighs = new int[mDrawables.length];

            if (original != null)
            {
                System.arraycopy(original.mLows, 0, mLows, 0, Math.min(original.mLows.length, mLows.length));
                System.arraycopy(original.mHighs, 0, mHighs, 0, Math.min(original.mHighs.length, mHighs.length));
            }
        }

        void mutate()
        {
            mLows = mLows.clone();
            mHighs = mHighs.clone();
        }

        void addLevel(int low, int high, Drawable drawable)
        {
            int position = addChild(drawable);
            mLows[position] = low;
            mHighs[position] = high;
        }

        int indexOfLevel(int level)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < mNumChildren; index++)
            {
                if (level >= mLows[index] && level <= mHighs[index]) return index;
            }

            return -1;
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable()
        {
            return new LevelListDrawable(this, null);
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable(Resources resources)
        {
            return new LevelListDrawable(this, resources);
        }

        @Override
        public void growArray(int oldSize, int newSize)
        {
            super.growArray(oldSize, newSize);

            int[] lows = new int[newSize];
            int[] highs = new int[newSize];
            System.arraycopy(mLows, 0, lows, 0, Math.min(oldSize, mLows.length));
            System.arraycopy(mHighs, 0, highs, 0, Math.min(oldSize, mHighs.length));
            mLows = lows;
            mHighs = highs;
        }
    }
}
```
