`java/android/graphics/drawable/NinePatchDrawable.java`:

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory;
import android.graphics.BlendMode;
import android.graphics.BlendModeColorFilter;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.ColorFilter;
import android.graphics.Insets;
import android.graphics.NinePatch;
import android.graphics.Outline;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.PixelFormat;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.graphics.Region;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.util.DisplayMetrics;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;
import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException;

public class NinePatchDrawable extends Drawable
{
    private static final int CHUNK_HEADER_SIZE = 32;
    private static final int PNG_SIGNATURE_SIZE = 8;

    private NinePatch mNinePatch;
    private Rect mPadding;
    private Insets mOpticalInsets = Insets.NONE;
    private Paint mPaint;
    private int mTargetDensity = DisplayMetrics.DENSITY_DEFAULT;
    private int mBitmapWidth = -1;
    private int mBitmapHeight = -1;
    private boolean mAutoMirrored;
    private boolean mDither;
    private boolean mFilterBitmap = true;
    private ColorStateList mTint;
    private BlendMode mTintBlendMode = BlendMode.SRC_IN;
    private ColorFilter mTintFilter;
    private boolean mMutated;

    NinePatchDrawable()
    {
    }

    public NinePatchDrawable(Bitmap bitmap, byte[] chunk, Rect padding, String srcName)
    {
        this(new NinePatch(bitmap, chunk, srcName), padding != null ? padding : paddingFromChunk(chunk), null);
    }

    public NinePatchDrawable(Resources resources, Bitmap bitmap, byte[] chunk, Rect padding, String srcName)
    {
        this(new NinePatch(bitmap, chunk, srcName), padding != null ? padding : paddingFromChunk(chunk), resources);
    }

    public NinePatchDrawable(NinePatch patch)
    {
        this(patch, null, null);
    }

    public NinePatchDrawable(Resources resources, NinePatch patch)
    {
        this(patch, null, resources);
    }

    private NinePatchDrawable(NinePatch patch, Rect padding, Resources resources)
    {
        mNinePatch = patch;
        mPadding = padding == null ? null : new Rect(padding);
        if (resources != null) mTargetDensity = resources.getDisplayMetrics().densityDpi;
        computeBitmapSize();
    }

    static byte[] extractChunk(byte[] png)
    {
        if (png == null || png.length < PNG_SIGNATURE_SIZE + 12) return null;
        if ((png[0] & 0xFF) != 0x89 || png[1] != 'P' || png[2] != 'N' || png[3] != 'G') return null;

        int offset = PNG_SIGNATURE_SIZE;

        while (offset + 12 <= png.length)
        {
            int length = ((png[offset] & 0xFF) << 24) | ((png[offset + 1] & 0xFF) << 16) | ((png[offset + 2] & 0xFF) << 8)
                | (png[offset + 3] & 0xFF);
            if (length < 0 || offset + 12 + length > png.length) return null;

            if (png[offset + 4] == 'n' && png[offset + 5] == 'p' && png[offset + 6] == 'T' && png[offset + 7] == 'c')
            {
                byte[] chunk = new byte[length];
                System.arraycopy(png, offset + 8, chunk, 0, length);
                return chunk;
            }

            if (png[offset + 4] == 'I' && png[offset + 5] == 'D' && png[offset + 6] == 'A' && png[offset + 7] == 'T') return null;

            offset += 12 + length;
        }

        return null;
    }

    static Rect paddingFromChunk(byte[] chunk)
    {
        if (chunk == null || chunk.length < CHUNK_HEADER_SIZE) return null;

        boolean littleEndian = true;
        for (int index = 0; index < 4; index++)
        {
            int value = readInt(chunk, 12 + index * 4, true);
            if (value < -1 || value > 0xFFFF) littleEndian = false;
        }

        int left = readInt(chunk, 12, littleEndian);
        int right = readInt(chunk, 16, littleEndian);
        int top = readInt(chunk, 20, littleEndian);
        int bottom = readInt(chunk, 24, littleEndian);

        if (left < 0 || right < 0 || top < 0 || bottom < 0) return null;
        return new Rect(left, top, right, bottom);
    }

    private static int readInt(byte[] data, int offset, boolean littleEndian)
    {
        int first = data[offset] & 0xFF;
        int second = data[offset + 1] & 0xFF;
        int third = data[offset + 2] & 0xFF;
        int fourth = data[offset + 3] & 0xFF;

        if (littleEndian) return first | (second << 8) | (third << 16) | (fourth << 24);
        return (first << 24) | (second << 16) | (third << 8) | fourth;
    }

    private void computeBitmapSize()
    {
        if (mNinePatch == null || mNinePatch.getBitmap() == null)
        {
            mBitmapWidth = -1;
            mBitmapHeight = -1;
            return;
        }

        int sourceDensity = mNinePatch.getDensity();
        mBitmapWidth = scale(mNinePatch.getWidth(), sourceDensity);
        mBitmapHeight = scale(mNinePatch.getHeight(), sourceDensity);
    }

    private int scale(int size, int sourceDensity)
    {
        if (sourceDensity <= 0 || mTargetDensity <= 0 || sourceDensity == mTargetDensity) return size;
        return (size * mTargetDensity + (sourceDensity >> 1)) / sourceDensity;
    }

    private Rect scaledPadding()
    {
        if (mPadding == null || mNinePatch == null) return mPadding;

        int sourceDensity = mNinePatch.getDensity();
        if (sourceDensity <= 0 || sourceDensity == mTargetDensity) return mPadding;

        return new Rect(scale(mPadding.left, sourceDensity), scale(mPadding.top, sourceDensity), scale(mPadding.right, sourceDensity),
                        scale(mPadding.bottom, sourceDensity));
    }

    public void setTargetDensity(Canvas canvas)
    {
        setTargetDensity(canvas.getDensity());
    }

    public void setTargetDensity(DisplayMetrics metrics)
    {
        setTargetDensity(metrics.densityDpi);
    }

    public void setTargetDensity(int density)
    {
        if (density == 0) density = DisplayMetrics.DENSITY_DEFAULT;
        if (mTargetDensity == density) return;

        mTargetDensity = density;
        computeBitmapSize();
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        if (mNinePatch == null) return;

        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        Paint paint = getPaint();
        ColorFilter previous = paint.getColorFilter();
        boolean tinted = previous == null && mTintFilter != null;
        if (tinted) paint.setColorFilter(mTintFilter);

        boolean mirrored = needsMirroring();
        int saved = -1;
        if (mirrored)
        {
            saved = canvas.save();
            canvas.translate(bounds.right + bounds.left, 0);
            canvas.scale(-1.0f, 1.0f);
        }

        mNinePatch.draw(canvas, bounds, paint);

        if (saved >= 0) canvas.restoreToCount(saved);
        if (tinted) paint.setColorFilter(previous);
    }

    private boolean needsMirroring()
    {
        return mAutoMirrored && getLayoutDirection() == 1;
    }

    @Override
    public int getChangingConfigurations()
    {
        return super.getChangingConfigurations();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean getPadding(Rect padding)
    {
        Rect scaled = scaledPadding();
        if (scaled == null) return super.getPadding(padding);

        padding.set(scaled);
        if (needsMirroring())
        {
            int left = padding.right;
            padding.right = padding.left;
            padding.left = left;
        }
        return (padding.left | padding.top | padding.right | padding.bottom) != 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void getOutline(Outline outline)
    {
        super.getOutline(outline);
    }

    @Override
    public Insets getOpticalInsets()
    {
        return mOpticalInsets;
    }

    @Override
    public void setAlpha(int alpha)
    {
        if (mPaint == null && alpha == 0xFF) return;

        getPaint().setAlpha(alpha);
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public int getAlpha()
    {
        return mPaint == null ? 0xFF : mPaint.getAlpha();
    }

    @Override
    public void setColorFilter(ColorFilter colorFilter)
    {
        if (mPaint == null && colorFilter == null) return;

        getPaint().setColorFilter(colorFilter);
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public ColorFilter getColorFilter()
    {
        return mPaint == null ? null : mPaint.getColorFilter();
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintList(ColorStateList tint)
    {
        mTint = tint;
        mTintFilter = tintFilter();
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintBlendMode(BlendMode blendMode)
    {
        mTintBlendMode = blendMode == null ? BlendMode.SRC_IN : blendMode;
        mTintFilter = tintFilter();
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    private ColorFilter tintFilter()
    {
        if (mTint == null) return null;
        return new BlendModeColorFilter(mTint.getColorForState(getState(), mTint.getDefaultColor()), mTintBlendMode);
    }

    @Override
    public void setDither(boolean dither)
    {
        if (mPaint == null && !dither) return;

        mDither = dither;
        getPaint().setDither(dither);
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public void setAutoMirrored(boolean mirrored)
    {
        mAutoMirrored = mirrored;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAutoMirrored()
    {
        return mAutoMirrored;
    }

    @Override
    public void setFilterBitmap(boolean filter)
    {
        mFilterBitmap = filter;
        getPaint().setFilterBitmap(filter);
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isFilterBitmap()
    {
        return mFilterBitmap;
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, XmlPullParserException
    {
        super.inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);

        int source = DrawableInflater.reference(attributes, "src", 0);
        if (source == 0) throw new XmlPullParserException(parser.getPositionDescription() + ": <nine-patch> requires a valid src attribute");

        byte[] data;
        try (java.io.InputStream stream = resources.openRawResource(source))
        {
            data = readAll(stream);
        }

        Bitmap bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(data, 0, data.length);
        if (bitmap == null) throw new XmlPullParserException(parser.getPositionDescription() + ": <nine-patch> requires a valid src attribute");

        byte[] chunk = extractChunk(data);
        mNinePatch = new NinePatch(bitmap, chunk, null);
        mPadding = paddingFromChunk(chunk);
        mTargetDensity = resources.getDisplayMetrics().densityDpi;
        mDither = DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "dither", false);
        mAutoMirrored = DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "autoMirrored", false);
        getPaint().setDither(mDither);

        int alphaPercent = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "alpha", 1.0f) * 255);
        if (alphaPercent != 255) getPaint().setAlpha(Math.max(0, Math.min(255, alphaPercent)));

        computeBitmapSize();
    }

    private static byte[] readAll(java.io.InputStream stream) throws java.io.IOException
    {
        java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream collected = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] chunk = new byte[16384];
        int got;

        while ((got = stream.read(chunk)) > 0) collected.write(chunk, 0, got);

        return collected.toByteArray();
    }

    @Override
    public void applyTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        super.applyTheme(theme);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canApplyTheme()
    {
        return mTint != null && mTint.canApplyTheme();
    }

    public Paint getPaint()
    {
        if (mPaint == null)
        {
            mPaint = new Paint();
            mPaint.setDither(mDither);
            mPaint.setFilterBitmap(mFilterBitmap);
        }
        return mPaint;
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicWidth()
    {
        return mBitmapWidth;
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicHeight()
    {
        return mBitmapHeight;
    }

    @Override
    public int getOpacity()
    {
        if (mNinePatch == null || mNinePatch.hasAlpha() || (mPaint != null && mPaint.getAlpha() < 255)) return PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;
        return PixelFormat.OPAQUE;
    }

    @Override
    public Region getTransparentRegion()
    {
        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        return mNinePatch == null ? null : mNinePatch.getTransparentRegion(bounds);
    }

    @Override
    public ConstantState getConstantState()
    {
        final NinePatch patch = mNinePatch;
        final Rect padding = mPadding == null ? null : new Rect(mPadding);
        final ColorStateList tint = mTint;
        final BlendMode blendMode = mTintBlendMode;
        final boolean autoMirrored = mAutoMirrored;
        final boolean dither = mDither;
        final int alpha = getAlpha();
        final int changing = getChangingConfigurations();

        return new ConstantState()
        {
            @Override
            public Drawable newDrawable()
            {
                return newDrawable(null);
            }

            @Override
            public Drawable newDrawable(Resources resources)
            {
                NinePatchDrawable copy = new NinePatchDrawable(patch, padding, resources);
                copy.mTint = tint;
                copy.mTintBlendMode = blendMode;
                copy.mTintFilter = copy.tintFilter();
                copy.mAutoMirrored = autoMirrored;
                copy.mDither = dither;
                if (alpha != 0xFF) copy.getPaint().setAlpha(alpha);
                return copy;
            }

            @Override
            public int getChangingConfigurations()
            {
                return changing;
            }
        };
    }

    @Override
    public Drawable mutate()
    {
        if (!mMutated && super.mutate() == this)
        {
            if (mPadding != null) mPadding = new Rect(mPadding);
            if (mPaint != null) mPaint = new Paint(mPaint);
            mMutated = true;
        }
        return this;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onStateChange(int[] stateSet)
    {
        if (mTint == null) return false;

        mTintFilter = tintFilter();
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isStateful()
    {
        return mTint != null && mTint.isStateful();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasFocusStateSpecified()
    {
        return mTint != null && mTint.hasFocusStateSpecified();
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.drawable.shapes.RoundRectShape;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class PaintDrawable extends ShapeDrawable
{
    public PaintDrawable()
    {
    }

    public PaintDrawable(int color)
    {
        getPaint().setColor(color);
    }

    public void setCornerRadius(float radius)
    {
        float[] radii = null;

        if (radius > 0)
        {
            radii = new float[8];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(radii, radius);
        }

        setCornerRadii(radii);
    }

    public void setCornerRadii(float[] radii)
    {
        if (radii == null)
        {
            if (getShape() != null) setShape(null);
        }
        else
        {
            setShape(new RoundRectShape(radii, null, null));
        }

        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean inflateTag(String name, Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        if (!"corners".equals(name)) return super.inflateTag(name, resources, parser, attributes);

        float radius = DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "radius", 0);
        setCornerRadius(radius);

        float topLeft = DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "topLeftRadius", radius);
        float topRight = DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "topRightRadius", radius);
        float bottomLeft = DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "bottomLeftRadius", radius);
        float bottomRight = DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "bottomRightRadius", radius);

        if (topLeft != radius || topRight != radius || bottomLeft != radius || bottomRight != radius)
        {
            setCornerRadii(new float[] {topLeft, topLeft, topRight, topRight, bottomRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft, bottomLeft});
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

`java/android/graphics/drawable/RippleDrawable.java`:

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Outline;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.graphics.PixelFormat;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class RippleDrawable extends LayerDrawable
{
    public static final int RADIUS_AUTO = -1;

    private static final int MASK_LAYER_ID = 0x0102002e;
    private static final int PRESSED_STATE = 0x010100a7;
    private static final int ENABLED_STATE = 0x0101009e;
    private static final int FOCUSED_STATE = 0x0101009c;
    private static final int HOVERED_STATE = 0x01010367;
    private static final int MAXIMUM_RIPPLE_ALPHA = 80;
    private static final int DEFAULT_EFFECT_COLOR = 0x8DFFFFFF;

    private final Paint mPaint = new Paint();
    private final Path mPath = new Path();
    private final Rect mHotspotBounds = new Rect();

    private ColorStateList mColor = ColorStateList.valueOf(0x40FFFFFF);
    private ColorStateList mEffectColor = ColorStateList.valueOf(DEFAULT_EFFECT_COLOR);
    private float mHotspotX = Float.NaN;
    private float mHotspotY = Float.NaN;
    private boolean mHasHotspotBounds;
    private int mRadius = RADIUS_AUTO;
    private boolean mPressed;
    private boolean mFocused;
    private boolean mHovered;

    public RippleDrawable()
    {
        mPaint.setAntiAlias(true);
    }

    public RippleDrawable(ColorStateList color, Drawable content, Drawable mask)
    {
        this();

        if (color == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("RippleDrawable requires a non-null color");

        if (content != null) addLayer(content);

        if (mask != null)
        {
            int index = addLayer(mask);
            setId(index, MASK_LAYER_ID);
        }

        setPaddingMode(PADDING_MODE_STACK);
        mColor = color;
    }

    public void setColor(ColorStateList color)
    {
        if (color == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("color cannot be null");

        mColor = color;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    public void setRippleColor(int color)
    {
        setColor(ColorStateList.valueOf(color));
    }

    public void setEffectColor(ColorStateList color)
    {
        if (color == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("color cannot be null");

        mEffectColor = color;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    public ColorStateList getEffectColor()
    {
        return mEffectColor;
    }

    public void setRadius(int radius)
    {
        mRadius = radius;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    public int getRadius()
    {
        return mRadius;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean setDrawableByLayerId(int id, Drawable drawable)
    {
        if (super.setDrawableByLayerId(id, drawable)) return true;
        if (id != MASK_LAYER_ID || drawable == null) return false;

        int index = addLayer(drawable);
        setId(index, MASK_LAYER_ID);
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void setPaddingMode(int mode)
    {
        super.setPaddingMode(mode);
    }

    @Override
    public void jumpToCurrentState()
    {
        super.jumpToCurrentState();
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public int getOpacity()
    {
        return PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onStateChange(int[] stateSet)
    {
        boolean changed = super.onStateChange(stateSet);

        boolean enabled = false;
        boolean pressed = false;
        boolean focused = false;
        boolean hovered = false;

        if (stateSet != null)
        {
            for (int state : stateSet)
            {
                if (state == ENABLED_STATE) enabled = true;
                else if (state == PRESSED_STATE) pressed = true;
                else if (state == FOCUSED_STATE) focused = true;
                else if (state == HOVERED_STATE) hovered = true;
            }
        }

        boolean wantPressed = enabled && pressed;
        boolean wantFocused = enabled && focused;
        boolean wantHovered = enabled && hovered;

        if (wantPressed != mPressed || wantFocused != mFocused || wantHovered != mHovered)
        {
            mPressed = wantPressed;
            mFocused = wantFocused;
            mHovered = wantHovered;
            changed = true;
            invalidateSelf();
        }

        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onBoundsChange(Rect bounds)
    {
        super.onBoundsChange(bounds);
        if (!mHasHotspotBounds) mHotspotBounds.set(bounds);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean setVisible(boolean visible, boolean restart)
    {
        boolean changed = super.setVisible(visible, restart);

        if (!visible && mPressed)
        {
            mPressed = false;
            changed = true;
        }

        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isProjected()
    {
        if (isBounded()) return false;

        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        Rect hotspot = mHasHotspotBounds ? mHotspotBounds : bounds;

        if (mRadius != RADIUS_AUTO && mRadius <= hotspot.width() / 2 && mRadius <= hotspot.height() / 2
            && (bounds.equals(hotspot) || bounds.contains(hotspot)))
        {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private boolean isBounded()
    {
        return getNumberOfLayers() > 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isStateful()
    {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasFocusStateSpecified()
    {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        ColorStateList color = DrawableInflater.colorStateList(resources, attributes, "color");
        if (color != null) mColor = color;

        ColorStateList effect = DrawableInflater.colorStateList(resources, attributes, "effectColor");
        if (effect != null) mEffectColor = effect;

        mRadius = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "radius", mRadius));

        super.inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);
    }

    @Override
    public void applyTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        super.applyTheme(theme);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canApplyTheme()
    {
        return super.canApplyTheme();
    }

    @Override
    public void setHotspot(float x, float y)
    {
        mHotspotX = x;
        mHotspotY = y;
        super.setHotspot(x, y);
    }

    @Override
    public void setHotspotBounds(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        mHasHotspotBounds = true;
        mHotspotBounds.set(left, top, right, bottom);
        super.setHotspotBounds(left, top, right, bottom);
    }

    @Override
    public void getHotspotBounds(Rect outRect)
    {
        outRect.set(mHasHotspotBounds ? mHotspotBounds : getBounds());
    }

    @Override
    public void getOutline(Outline outline)
    {
        Drawable mask = findDrawableByLayerId(MASK_LAYER_ID);

        if (mask != null)
        {
            mask.getOutline(outline);
            return;
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < getNumberOfLayers(); index++)
        {
            Drawable layer = getDrawable(index);
            if (layer == null) continue;

            layer.getOutline(outline);
            if (!outline.isEmpty()) return;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        layoutLayers();

        for (int index = 0; index < getNumberOfLayers(); index++)
        {
            if (getId(index) == MASK_LAYER_ID) continue;

            Drawable layer = getDrawable(index);
            if (layer != null) layer.draw(canvas);
        }

        if (!mPressed && !mFocused && !mHovered) return;

        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        if (bounds.width() <= 0 || bounds.height() <= 0) return;

        int color = mColor.getColorForState(getState(), mColor.getDefaultColor());
        int baseAlpha = (color >>> 24) & 0xFF;
        int alpha = mPressed ? Math.min(MAXIMUM_RIPPLE_ALPHA, baseAlpha) : Math.min(MAXIMUM_RIPPLE_ALPHA, baseAlpha) / 2;
        alpha = alpha * getRootAlpha() / 255;
        if (alpha <= 0) return;

        int saveCount = canvas.save();

        Drawable mask = findDrawableByLayerId(MASK_LAYER_ID);
        mPath.reset();

        if (mask instanceof GradientDrawable || mask instanceof ShapeDrawable)
        {
            Outline outline = new Outline();
            mask.getOutline(outline);
            Rect rounded = new Rect();

            if (outline.getRect(rounded) && outline.getRadius() > 0)
            {
                float radius = outline.getRadius();
                mPath.addRoundRect(rounded.left, rounded.top, rounded.right, rounded.bottom, radius, radius, Path.Direction.CW);
            }
            else if (!outline.isEmpty() && outline.getRect(rounded))
            {
                mPath.addRect(rounded.left, rounded.top, rounded.right, rounded.bottom, Path.Direction.CW);
            }
        }

        if (mPath.isEmpty()) mPath.addRect(bounds.left, bounds.top, bounds.right, bounds.bottom, Path.Direction.CW);
        if (isBounded()) canvas.clipPath(mPath);

        mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
        mPaint.setColor((alpha << 24) | (color & 0x00FFFFFF));

        if (mPressed)
        {
            float centreX = Float.isNaN(mHotspotX) ? bounds.centerX() : mHotspotX;
            float centreY = Float.isNaN(mHotspotY) ? bounds.centerY() : mHotspotY;
            float radius = mRadius > 0 ? mRadius : (float) Math.hypot(bounds.width(), bounds.height()) * 0.5f;

            canvas.drawCircle(centreX, centreY, radius, mPaint);
        }
        else if (isBounded())
        {
            canvas.drawRect(bounds.left, bounds.top, bounds.right, bounds.bottom, mPaint);
        }
        else
        {
            float radius = mRadius > 0 ? mRadius : Math.min(bounds.width(), bounds.height()) * 0.5f;
            canvas.drawCircle(bounds.exactCenterX(), bounds.exactCenterY(), radius, mPaint);
        }

        canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
    }

    private int getRootAlpha()
    {
        return super.getAlpha();
    }

    @Override
    public void invalidateSelf()
    {
        super.invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public Rect getDirtyBounds()
    {
        if (isBounded()) return getBounds();

        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        int radius = mRadius > 0 ? mRadius : (int) Math.ceil(Math.hypot(bounds.width(), bounds.height()) * 0.5);
        int centreX = Float.isNaN(mHotspotX) ? bounds.centerX() : (int) mHotspotX;
        int centreY = Float.isNaN(mHotspotY) ? bounds.centerY() : (int) mHotspotY;

        Rect dirty = new Rect(bounds);
        dirty.union(centreX - radius, centreY - radius, centreX + radius, centreY + radius);
        return dirty;
    }

    @Override
    public ConstantState getConstantState()
    {
        return super.getConstantState();
    }

    @Override
    public Drawable mutate()
    {
        return super.mutate();
    }

    @Override
    LayerDrawable createCopy()
    {
        return new RippleDrawable();
    }

    @Override
    void copyConfigurationTo(LayerDrawable copy)
    {
        super.copyConfigurationTo(copy);

        if (!(copy instanceof RippleDrawable)) return;

        RippleDrawable ripple = (RippleDrawable) copy;
        ripple.mColor = mColor;
        ripple.mEffectColor = mEffectColor;
        ripple.mRadius = mRadius;
    }
}
```

`java/android/graphics/drawable/RotateDrawable.java`:

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class RotateDrawable extends DrawableWrapper
{
    private static final float MAX_LEVEL = 10000.0f;

    private float mFromDegrees = 0.0f;
    private float mToDegrees = 360.0f;
    private float mCurrentDegrees = 0.0f;
    private float mPivotX = 0.5f;
    private float mPivotY = 0.5f;
    private boolean mPivotXRelative = true;
    private boolean mPivotYRelative = true;

    public RotateDrawable()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        Drawable inner = getDrawable();
        if (inner == null) return;

        Rect bounds = inner.getBounds();
        int width = bounds.right - bounds.left;
        int height = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;

        float pivotX = mPivotXRelative ? width * mPivotX : mPivotX;
        float pivotY = mPivotYRelative ? height * mPivotY : mPivotY;

        int saveCount = canvas.save();
        canvas.rotate(mCurrentDegrees, pivotX + bounds.left, pivotY + bounds.top);
        inner.setAlpha(getAlpha());
        inner.draw(canvas);
        canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
    }

    @Override
    public void applyTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        super.applyTheme(theme);
    }

    @Override
    DrawableWrapper copyWrapper()
    {
        RotateDrawable copy = new RotateDrawable();
        copy.mFromDegrees = mFromDegrees;
        copy.mToDegrees = mToDegrees;
        copy.mCurrentDegrees = mCurrentDegrees;
        copy.mPivotX = mPivotX;
        copy.mPivotY = mPivotY;
        copy.mPivotXRelative = mPivotXRelative;
        copy.mPivotYRelative = mPivotYRelative;
        return copy;
    }

    public void setFromDegrees(float fromDegrees)
    {
        if (mFromDegrees == fromDegrees) return;

        mFromDegrees = fromDegrees;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    public float getFromDegrees()
    {
        return mFromDegrees;
    }

    public void setToDegrees(float toDegrees)
    {
        if (mToDegrees == toDegrees) return;

        mToDegrees = toDegrees;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    public float getToDegrees()
    {
        return mToDegrees;
    }

    public void setPivotX(float pivotX)
    {
        if (mPivotX == pivotX) return;

        mPivotX = pivotX;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    public float getPivotX()
    {
        return mPivotX;
    }

    public void setPivotXRelative(boolean relative)
    {
        if (mPivotXRelative == relative) return;

        mPivotXRelative = relative;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    public boolean isPivotXRelative()
    {
        return mPivotXRelative;
    }

    public void setPivotY(float pivotY)
    {
        if (mPivotY == pivotY) return;

        mPivotY = pivotY;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    public float getPivotY()
    {
        return mPivotY;
    }

    public void setPivotYRelative(boolean relative)
    {
        if (mPivotYRelative == relative) return;

        mPivotYRelative = relative;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    public boolean isPivotYRelative()
    {
        return mPivotYRelative;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onLevelChange(int level)
    {
        Drawable inner = getDrawable();
        if (inner != null) inner.setLevel(level);

        float value = level / MAX_LEVEL;
        mCurrentDegrees = mFromDegrees + (mToDegrees - mFromDegrees) * value;

        invalidateSelf();
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        if (DrawableInflater.text(attributes, "pivotX") != null)
        {
            mPivotXRelative = DrawableInflater.isFraction(attributes, "pivotX");
            mPivotX = mPivotXRelative ? DrawableInflater.fraction(attributes, "pivotX", mPivotX)
                                      : DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "pivotX", mPivotX);
        }

        if (DrawableInflater.text(attributes, "pivotY") != null)
        {
            mPivotYRelative = DrawableInflater.isFraction(attributes, "pivotY");
            mPivotY = mPivotYRelative ? DrawableInflater.fraction(attributes, "pivotY", mPivotY)
                                      : DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "pivotY", mPivotY);
        }

        mFromDegrees = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "fromDegrees", mFromDegrees);
        mToDegrees = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "toDegrees", mToDegrees);
        mCurrentDegrees = mFromDegrees;

        int reference = DrawableInflater.reference(attributes, "drawable", 0);
        if (reference != 0) setDrawable(resources.getDrawable(reference));

        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= outerDepth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            Drawable child = DrawableInflater.inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);
            if (child != null) setDrawable(child);
        }

        onLevelChange(getLevel());
    }
}
```

`java/android/graphics/drawable/ScaleDrawable.java`:

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.PixelFormat;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.Gravity;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class ScaleDrawable extends DrawableWrapper
{
    private static final int MAX_LEVEL = 10000;

    private final Rect mScaledRect = new Rect();

    private float mScaleWidth = -1;
    private float mScaleHeight = -1;
    private int mGravity = Gravity.LEFT;
    private boolean mUseIntrinsicSizeAsMinimum;

    ScaleDrawable()
    {
    }

    public ScaleDrawable(Drawable drawable, int gravity, float scaleWidth, float scaleHeight)
    {
        super(drawable);
        mGravity = gravity;
        mScaleWidth = scaleWidth;
        mScaleHeight = scaleHeight;
    }

    @Override
    public void applyTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        super.applyTheme(theme);
    }

    @Override
    DrawableWrapper copyWrapper()
    {
        ScaleDrawable copy = new ScaleDrawable(null, mGravity, mScaleWidth, mScaleHeight);
        copy.mUseIntrinsicSizeAsMinimum = mUseIntrinsicSizeAsMinimum;
        return copy;
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        Drawable inner = getDrawable();
        if (inner == null || inner.getLevel() == 0) return;

        onBoundsChange(getBounds());
        inner.setAlpha(getAlpha());
        inner.draw(canvas);
    }

    @Override
    public int getOpacity()
    {
        Drawable inner = getDrawable();
        if (inner == null || inner.getLevel() == 0) return PixelFormat.TRANSPARENT;

        int opacity = inner.getOpacity();
        if (opacity == PixelFormat.OPAQUE && inner.getLevel() < MAX_LEVEL) return PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;

        return opacity;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onLevelChange(int level)
    {
        Drawable inner = getDrawable();
        if (inner != null) inner.setLevel(level);

        onBoundsChange(getBounds());
        invalidateSelf();
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onBoundsChange(Rect bounds)
    {
        Drawable inner = getDrawable();
        if (inner == null) return;

        int level = getLevel();
        int width = bounds.width();
        int height = bounds.height();

        if (mScaleWidth > 0)
        {
            int intrinsic = mUseIntrinsicSizeAsMinimum ? Math.max(0, inner.getIntrinsicWidth()) : 0;
            width -= (int)((width - intrinsic) * (MAX_LEVEL - level) * mScaleWidth / MAX_LEVEL);
        }

        if (mScaleHeight > 0)
        {
            int intrinsic = mUseIntrinsicSizeAsMinimum ? Math.max(0, inner.getIntrinsicHeight()) : 0;
            height -= (int)((height - intrinsic) * (MAX_LEVEL - level) * mScaleHeight / MAX_LEVEL);
        }

        Gravity.apply(mGravity, width, height, bounds, mScaledRect, getLayoutDirection());

        if (width > 0 && height > 0) inner.setBounds(mScaledRect.left, mScaledRect.top, mScaledRect.right, mScaledRect.bottom);
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        mScaleWidth = percent(attributes, "scaleWidth", mScaleWidth);
        mScaleHeight = percent(attributes, "scaleHeight", mScaleHeight);
        mGravity = DrawableInflater.gravity(attributes, "scaleGravity", mGravity);
        mUseIntrinsicSizeAsMinimum = DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "useIntrinsicSizeAsMinimum", false);

        int initialLevel = DrawableInflater.integer(attributes, "level", -1);

        int reference = DrawableInflater.reference(attributes, "drawable", 0);
        if (reference != 0) setDrawable(resources.getDrawable(reference));

        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= outerDepth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            Drawable child = DrawableInflater.inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);
            if (child != null) setDrawable(child);
        }

        if (initialLevel >= 0) setLevel(initialLevel);
        else if (getDrawable() != null) getDrawable().setLevel(getLevel());
    }

    private static float percent(AttributeSet attributes, String name, float fallback)
    {
        String text = DrawableInflater.text(attributes, name);
        if (text == null) return fallback;

        if (!text.endsWith("%")) return DrawableInflater.fraction(attributes, name, fallback);

        try
        {
            return Float.parseFloat(text.substring(0, text.length() - 1)) / 100;
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException failure)
        {
            return fallback;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.ColorStateList;

public class ShapeDrawable extends Drawable
{
    private final Paint mPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);

    private Shape mShape;
    private Rect mPadding;
    private int mIntrinsicWidth;
    private int mIntrinsicHeight;
    private int mAlpha = 255;
    private ShaderFactory mShaderFactory;
    private ColorStateList mTint;
    private BlendMode mTintBlendMode = BlendMode.SRC_IN;
    private ColorFilter mTintFilter;

        this(null);
    }

    public ShapeDrawable(Shape shape)

        mShape = shape;
    }

    }

        return mPaint;

    {
        if ((left | top | right | bottom) == 0)
        {
            mPadding = null;
        }
        else
        {
            if (mPadding == null) mPadding = new Rect();
            mPadding.set(left, top, right, bottom);
        }

        invalidateSelf();
    }

    public void setPadding(Rect padding)
    {
        if (padding == null)
        {
            mPadding = null;
        }
        else
        {
            if (mPadding == null) mPadding = new Rect();
            mPadding.set(padding);
        }

        invalidateSelf();

    }

    @Override

    {
        return mIntrinsicHeight;
    }

    @Override

    {
        if (mPadding == null) return super.getPadding(padding);

        padding.set(mPadding);
        return true;
    }

    protected void onDraw(Shape shape, Canvas canvas, Paint paint)
    {
        shape.draw(canvas, paint);
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        Paint paint = mPaint;
        int previousAlpha = paint.getAlpha();

        paint.setAlpha(modulateAlpha(previousAlpha, mAlpha));

        if (paint.getAlpha() != 0 || paint.getXfermode() != null || paint.getShadowLayerRadius() > 0)
        {
            boolean clearFilter = false;

            if (mTintFilter != null && paint.getColorFilter() == null)
            {
                paint.setColorFilter(mTintFilter);
                clearFilter = true;
            }

            if (mShape != null)
            {
                int saveCount = canvas.save();
                canvas.translate(bounds.left, bounds.top);
                onDraw(mShape, canvas, paint);
                canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
            }
            else
            {
                canvas.drawRect(bounds, paint);
            }

            if (clearFilter) paint.setColorFilter(null);
        }

        paint.setAlpha(previousAlpha);
    }

    private static int modulateAlpha(int paintAlpha, int alpha)
    {
        int scale = alpha + (alpha >>> 7);
        return paintAlpha * scale >>> 8;
    }

    @Override
    public void setAlpha(int alpha)
    {
        mAlpha = alpha;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public int getAlpha()
    {
        return mAlpha;
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintList(ColorStateList tint)
    {
        mTint = tint;
        mTintFilter = updateTintFilter();
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintBlendMode(BlendMode blendMode)
    {
        mTintBlendMode = blendMode == null ? BlendMode.SRC_IN : blendMode;
        mTintFilter = updateTintFilter();
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintMode(android.graphics.PorterDuff.Mode tintMode)
    {
        if (tintMode == null) return;

        setTintBlendMode(BlendMode.valueOf(tintMode == android.graphics.PorterDuff.Mode.ADD ? "PLUS" : tintMode.name()));
    }

    private ColorFilter updateTintFilter()
    {
        if (mTint == null) return null;

        return new BlendModeColorFilter(mTint.getColorForState(getState(), mTint.getDefaultColor()), mTintBlendMode);
    }

    @Override
    public void setColorFilter(ColorFilter filter)
    {
        super.setColorFilter(filter);
        mPaint.setColorFilter(filter);
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public ColorFilter getColorFilter()
    {
        return mPaint.getColorFilter();
    }

    @Override
    public int getOpacity()
    {
        if (mShape != null) return PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;
        if (mPaint.getXfermode() != null) return PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;

        int alpha = mPaint.getAlpha();
        if (alpha == 0) return PixelFormat.TRANSPARENT;
        if (alpha == 255) return PixelFormat.OPAQUE;

        return PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;
    }

    @Override
    public void setDither(boolean dither)
    {
        mPaint.setDither(dither);
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onBoundsChange(Rect bounds)
    {
        super.onBoundsChange(bounds);
        updateShape();
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onStateChange(int[] stateSet)
    {
        if (mTint == null) return false;

        mTintFilter = updateTintFilter();
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isStateful()
    {
        return mTint != null && mTint.isStateful();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasFocusStateSpecified()
    {
        return false;
    }

    protected boolean inflateTag(String name, Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        if (!"padding".equals(name)) return false;

        setPadding(Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "left", 0)),
                   Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "top", 0)),
                   Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "right", 0)),
                   Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "bottom", 0)));
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        mPaint.setColor(DrawableInflater.color(resources, attributes, "color", mPaint.getColor()));
        mPaint.setDither(DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "dither", mPaint.isDither()));
        mIntrinsicWidth = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "width", mIntrinsicWidth));
        mIntrinsicHeight = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "height", mIntrinsicHeight));

        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= outerDepth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            String name = parser.getName();

            if (!inflateTag(name, resources, parser, attributes))
            {
                android.util.Log.w("drawable", "Unknown element: " + name + " for ShapeDrawable " + this);
            }

            DrawableInflater.skipElement(parser);
        }

        updateShape();
    }

    @Override
    public void applyTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
    }

    @Override
    public void getOutline(Outline outline)
    {
        if (mShape == null) return;

        mShape.getOutline(outline);
        outline.setAlpha(getAlpha() / 255.0f);
    }

    @Override
    public int getChangingConfigurations()
    {
        return super.getChangingConfigurations();
    }

    @Override
    public ConstantState getConstantState()
    {
        return new ShapeState(this);
    }

    @Override
    public Drawable mutate()
    {
        return this;
    }

    private void updateShape()
    {
        if (mShape != null)
        {
            Rect bounds = getBounds();
            int width = bounds.width();
            int height = bounds.height();

            mShape.resize(width, height);
            if (mShaderFactory != null) mPaint.setShader(mShaderFactory.resize(width, height));
        }

        invalidateSelf();
    }

    private static final class ShapeState extends ConstantState
    {
        private final Shape mShape;
        private final Paint mPaint;
        private final Rect mPadding;
        private final int mIntrinsicWidth;
        private final int mIntrinsicHeight;
        private final int mAlpha;
        private final ShaderFactory mShaderFactory;
        private final ColorStateList mTint;
        private final BlendMode mTintBlendMode;
        private final boolean mPaintDrawable;
        private final int mChangingConfigurations;

        ShapeState(ShapeDrawable source)
        {
            Shape shape = source.mShape;

            try
            {
                shape = shape == null ? null : shape.clone();
            }
            catch (CloneNotSupportedException failure)
            {
                shape = source.mShape;
            }

            mShape = shape;
            mPaint = new Paint(source.mPaint);
            mPadding = source.mPadding == null ? null : new Rect(source.mPadding);
            mIntrinsicWidth = source.mIntrinsicWidth;
            mIntrinsicHeight = source.mIntrinsicHeight;
            mAlpha = source.mAlpha;
            mShaderFactory = source.mShaderFactory;
            mTint = source.mTint;
            mTintBlendMode = source.mTintBlendMode;
            mPaintDrawable = source.getClass() == PaintDrawable.class;
            mChangingConfigurations = source.getChangingConfigurations();
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable()
        {
            ShapeDrawable drawable = mPaintDrawable ? new PaintDrawable() : new ShapeDrawable();
            drawable.mShape = copyOf(mShape);
            drawable.setChangingConfigurations(mChangingConfigurations);
            drawable.mPaint.set(mPaint);
            drawable.mPadding = mPadding == null ? null : new Rect(mPadding);
            drawable.mIntrinsicWidth = mIntrinsicWidth;
            drawable.mIntrinsicHeight = mIntrinsicHeight;
            drawable.mAlpha = mAlpha;
            drawable.mShaderFactory = mShaderFactory;
            drawable.mTint = mTint;
            drawable.mTintBlendMode = mTintBlendMode;
            drawable.mTintFilter = drawable.updateTintFilter();
            return drawable;
        }

        @Override
        public int getChangingConfigurations()
        {
            return mChangingConfigurations;
        }

        private static Shape copyOf(Shape shape)
        {
            if (shape == null) return null;

            try
            {
                return shape.clone();
            }
            catch (CloneNotSupportedException failure)
            {
                return shape;
            }
        }
    }

    public abstract static class ShaderFactory
    {
        public ShaderFactory()
        {
        }

        public abstract Shader resize(int width, int height);
    }
```

`java/android/graphics/drawable/StateListDrawable.java`:

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.util.StateSet;

import java.util.ArrayList;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class StateListDrawable extends DrawableContainer
{
    private StateListState mStateListState;
    private boolean mMutated;

    public StateListDrawable()
    {
        this(null, null);
    }

    StateListDrawable(StateListState state)
    {
        if (state != null) setConstantState(state);
    }

    private StateListDrawable(StateListState state, Resources resources)
    {
        setConstantState(new StateListState(state, this, resources));
        onStateChange(getState());
    }

    public void addState(int[] stateSet, Drawable drawable)
    {
        if (drawable == null) return;

        mStateListState.addStateSet(stateSet == null ? StateSet.WILD_CARD : stateSet, drawable);
        onStateChange(getState());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isStateful()
    {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasFocusStateSpecified()
    {
        return mStateListState.hasFocusStateSpecified();
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onStateChange(int[] stateSet)
    {
        boolean changed = super.onStateChange(stateSet);

        int index = mStateListState.indexOfStateSet(stateSet);
        if (index < 0) index = mStateListState.indexOfStateSet(StateSet.WILD_CARD);

        return selectDrawable(index) || changed;
    }

    public int getStateCount()
    {
        return mStateListState.getChildCount();
    }

    public int[] getStateSet(int index)
    {
        return index < 0 || index >= mStateListState.getChildCount() ? null : mStateListState.mStateSets[index];
    }

    public Drawable getStateDrawable(int index)
    {
        return mStateListState.getChild(index);
    }

    public int findStateDrawableIndex(int[] stateSet)
    {
        return mStateListState.indexOfStateSet(stateSet);
    }

    @Override
    public Drawable mutate()
    {
        if (!mMutated && super.mutate() == this)
        {
            mStateListState.mutate();
            mMutated = true;
        }

        return this;
    }

    @Override
    public void applyTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        super.applyTheme(theme);
        onStateChange(getState());
    }

    @Override
    protected void setConstantState(DrawableContainerState state)
    {
        super.setConstantState(state);

        if (state instanceof StateListState) mStateListState = (StateListState) state;
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        super.inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);

        mStateListState.setVariablePadding(DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "variablePadding", false));
        mStateListState.setConstantSize(DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "constantSize", false));
        mStateListState.setEnterFadeDuration(DrawableInflater.integer(attributes, "enterFadeDuration", 0));
        mStateListState.setExitFadeDuration(DrawableInflater.integer(attributes, "exitFadeDuration", 0));
        setDither(DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "dither", true));
        setAutoMirrored(DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "autoMirrored", false));

        int outerDepth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= outerDepth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;
            if (!"item".equals(parser.getName())) continue;

            int[] stateSet = readStateSet(attributes);
            Drawable drawable = null;

            int reference = DrawableInflater.reference(attributes, "drawable", 0);
            if (reference != 0) drawable = resources.getDrawable(reference, theme);

            int itemDepth = parser.getDepth();
            while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
            {
                if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= itemDepth) break;
                if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

                Drawable child = DrawableInflater.inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);
                if (child != null) drawable = child;
            }

            if (drawable == null) continue;

            mStateListState.addStateSet(stateSet, drawable);
        }

        onStateChange(getState());
    }

    static int[] readStateSet(AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        ArrayList<Integer> collected = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int index = 0; index < attributes.getAttributeCount(); index++)
        {
            int name = attributes.getAttributeNameResource(index);
            if (name == 0) continue;

            if (!isBoolean(attributes, index)) continue;

            boolean wanted = attributes.getAttributeBooleanValue(index, false);
            collected.add(wanted ? name : -name);
        }

        int[] stateSet = new int[collected.size()];
        for (int index = 0; index < stateSet.length; index++) stateSet[index] = collected.get(index);

        return stateSet;
    }

    private static boolean isBoolean(AttributeSet attributes, int index)
    {
        if (attributes instanceof android.content.res.XmlBlock.Parser)
        {
            int[] packed = ((android.content.res.XmlBlock.Parser) attributes).getAttributeTypedValue(index);
            return packed != null && packed[0] == android.util.TypedValue.TYPE_INT_BOOLEAN;
        }

        String value = attributes.getAttributeValue(index);
        return "true".equals(value) || "false".equals(value);
    }

    static class StateListState extends DrawableContainerState
    {
        private static final int FOCUSED_STATE = 0x0101009c;

        int[][] mStateSets;

        StateListState(StateListState original, StateListDrawable owner, Resources resources)
        {
            super(original, owner, resources);

            if (original != null)
            {
                mStateSets = new int[mDrawables.length][];
                for (int index = 0; index < original.mNumChildren && index < original.mStateSets.length; index++)
                {
                    mStateSets[index] = original.mStateSets[index];
                }
            }
            else
            {
                mStateSets = new int[mDrawables.length][];
            }
        }

        void mutate()
        {
            int[][] copies = new int[mStateSets.length][];

            for (int index = 0; index < mStateSets.length; index++)
            {
                copies[index] = mStateSets[index] == null ? null : mStateSets[index].clone();
            }

            mStateSets = copies;
        }

        int addStateSet(int[] stateSet, Drawable drawable)
        {
            int position = addChild(drawable);
            mStateSets[position] = stateSet;
            return position;
        }

        int indexOfStateSet(int[] stateSet)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < mNumChildren; index++)
            {
                if (StateSet.stateSetMatches(mStateSets[index], stateSet)) return index;
            }

            return -1;
        }

        boolean hasFocusStateSpecified()
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < mNumChildren; index++)
            {
                int[] stateSet = mStateSets[index];
                if (stateSet == null) continue;

                for (int state : stateSet)
                {
                    if (state == FOCUSED_STATE) return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable()
        {
            return new StateListDrawable(this, null);
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable(Resources resources)
        {
            return new StateListDrawable(this, resources);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean canApplyTheme()
        {
            return super.canApplyTheme();
        }

        @Override
        public void growArray(int oldSize, int newSize)
        {
            super.growArray(oldSize, newSize);

            int[][] grown = new int[newSize][];
            System.arraycopy(mStateSets, 0, grown, 0, Math.min(oldSize, mStateSets.length));
            mStateSets = grown;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/graphics/drawable/TransitionDrawable.java`:

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.os.SystemClock;

public class TransitionDrawable extends LayerDrawable implements Drawable.Callback
{
    private static final int TRANSITION_STARTING = 0;
    private static final int TRANSITION_RUNNING = 1;
    private static final int TRANSITION_NONE = 2;

    private int mTransitionState = TRANSITION_NONE;
    private boolean mReverse;
    private long mStartTimeMillis;
    private int mFrom;
    private int mTo;
    private int mDuration;
    private int mOriginalDuration;
    private int mAlpha = 0;
    private boolean mCrossFade;

    TransitionDrawable()
    {
    }

    public TransitionDrawable(Drawable[] layers)
    {
        super(layers);
    }

    @Override
    LayerDrawable createCopy()
    {
        return new TransitionDrawable();
    }

    @Override
    void copyConfigurationTo(LayerDrawable copy)
    {
        super.copyConfigurationTo(copy);
        if (copy instanceof TransitionDrawable) ((TransitionDrawable) copy).mCrossFade = mCrossFade;
    }

    public void startTransition(int durationMillis)
    {
        mFrom = 0;
        mTo = 255;
        mAlpha = 0;
        mDuration = mOriginalDuration = durationMillis;
        mReverse = false;
        mTransitionState = TRANSITION_STARTING;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    public void resetTransition()
    {
        mAlpha = 0;
        mTransitionState = TRANSITION_NONE;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    public void reverseTransition(int duration)
    {
        long time = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();

        if (time - mStartTimeMillis > mDuration)
        {
            if (mTo == 0)
            {
                mFrom = 0;
                mTo = 255;
                mAlpha = 0;
                mReverse = false;
            }
            else
            {
                mFrom = 255;
                mTo = 0;
                mAlpha = 255;
                mReverse = true;
            }

            mDuration = mOriginalDuration = duration;
            mTransitionState = TRANSITION_STARTING;
            invalidateSelf();
            return;
        }

        mReverse = !mReverse;
        mFrom = mAlpha;
        mTo = mReverse ? 0 : 255;
        mDuration = (int)(mReverse ? time - mStartTimeMillis : mOriginalDuration - (time - mStartTimeMillis));
        mTransitionState = TRANSITION_STARTING;
    }

    public void setCrossFadeEnabled(boolean enabled)
    {
        mCrossFade = enabled;
    }

    public boolean isCrossFadeEnabled()
    {
        return mCrossFade;
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        boolean done = true;

        switch (mTransitionState)
        {
            case TRANSITION_STARTING:
                mStartTimeMillis = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
                done = false;
                mTransitionState = TRANSITION_RUNNING;
                break;

            case TRANSITION_RUNNING:
                if (mStartTimeMillis >= 0)
                {
                    float normalized = mDuration <= 0 ? 1.0f : (float)(SystemClock.uptimeMillis() - mStartTimeMillis) / mDuration;
                    done = normalized >= 1.0f;
                    normalized = Math.min(normalized, 1.0f);
                    mAlpha = (int)(mFrom + (mTo - mFrom) * normalized);
                }
                break;

            default:
                break;
        }

        layoutLayers();

        Drawable first = getDrawable(0);
        Drawable second = getDrawable(1);
        int alpha = mAlpha;

        if (done)
        {
            if (first != null && (!mCrossFade || alpha == 0)) first.draw(canvas);
            if (second != null && alpha == 0xFF) second.draw(canvas);
            return;
        }

        if (first != null)
        {
            if (mCrossFade) first.setAlpha(255 - alpha);
            first.draw(canvas);
            if (mCrossFade) first.setAlpha(0xFF);
        }

        if (second != null && alpha > 0)
        {
            second.setAlpha(alpha);
            second.draw(canvas);
            second.setAlpha(0xFF);
        }

        invalidateSelf();
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics.drawable;

import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.BlendMode;

public class VectorDrawable extends Drawable
{
    private static final String[] FILL_TYPE_NAMES = {"nonZero", "evenOdd"};

    private final Paint mPaint = new Paint();

    private Group mRoot = new Group();
    private int mResourceId;
    private float mViewportWidth;
    private float mViewportHeight;
    private int mIntrinsicWidth;
    private int mIntrinsicHeight;
    private int mRootAlpha = 255;
    private boolean mAutoMirrored;
    private Insets mOpticalInsets = Insets.NONE;
    private ColorStateList mTint;
    private BlendMode mTintBlendMode = BlendMode.SRC_IN;
    private int mTintColor;
    private ColorFilter mColorFilter;

    }

    public VectorDrawable(int resourceId)
    {
        mResourceId = resourceId;
        mPaint.setAntiAlias(true);
    }

    public int getResourceId()
    {
        return mResourceId;
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicWidth()
    {
        return mIntrinsicWidth;
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicHeight()
    {
        return mIntrinsicHeight;
    }

    @Override
    public Insets getOpticalInsets()
    {
        return mOpticalInsets;
    }

    @Override
    public int getAlpha()
    {
        return mRootAlpha;
    }

    @Override
    public void setAlpha(int alpha)
    {
        if (mRootAlpha == alpha) return;

        mRootAlpha = alpha;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public void setColorFilter(ColorFilter filter)
    {
        mColorFilter = filter;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public ColorFilter getColorFilter()
    {
        return mColorFilter;
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintList(ColorStateList tint)
    {
        mTint = tint;
        updateTintColor(getState());
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public void setTintBlendMode(BlendMode blendMode)
    {
        mTintBlendMode = blendMode == null ? BlendMode.SRC_IN : blendMode;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    private void updateTintColor(int[] stateSet)
    {
        if (mTint != null) mTintColor = mTint.getColorForState(stateSet, mTint.getDefaultColor());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isStateful()
    {
        return mTint != null && mTint.isStateful();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasFocusStateSpecified()
    {
        return hasFocusState(mTint);
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onStateChange(int[] stateSet)
    {
        if (mTint == null || !mTint.isStateful()) return false;

        int previous = mTintColor;
        updateTintColor(stateSet);

        if (previous == mTintColor) return false;

        invalidateSelf();
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public int getOpacity()
    {
        return mRootAlpha == 0 ? PixelFormat.TRANSPARENT : PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canApplyTheme()
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public void applyTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        super.applyTheme(theme);
    }

    @Override
    public int getChangingConfigurations()
    {
        return super.getChangingConfigurations();
    }

    @Override
    public void setAutoMirrored(boolean mirrored)
    {
        if (mAutoMirrored == mirrored) return;

        mAutoMirrored = mirrored;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAutoMirrored()
    {
        return mAutoMirrored;
    }

    public boolean isEmpty()
    {
        return mRoot.children.isEmpty();
    }

    @Override
    public Drawable mutate()
    {
        mMutated = true;
        return this;
    }

    @Override
    public ConstantState getConstantState()
    {
        return new VectorState(this);
    }

    @Override
    public void inflate(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Resources.Theme theme)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        super.inflate(resources, parser, attributes, theme);
        readVector(resources, parser, attributes);
    }

    void readVector(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes) throws java.io.IOException,
        org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        mRoot = new Group();
        mViewportWidth = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "viewportWidth", 0);
        mViewportHeight = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "viewportHeight", 0);
        mIntrinsicWidth = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "width", 0));
        mIntrinsicHeight = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "height", 0));
        mAutoMirrored = DrawableInflater.flag(attributes, "autoMirrored", mAutoMirrored);

        float alpha = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "alpha", mRootAlpha / 255.0f);
        mRootAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(alpha * 255)));

        ColorStateList tint = DrawableInflater.colorStateList(resources, attributes, "tint");
        if (tint != null) mTint = tint;
        mTintBlendMode = DrawableInflater.tintMode(attributes, "tintMode", mTintBlendMode);
        updateTintColor(getState());

        int insetLeft = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "opticalInsetLeft", 0));
        int insetTop = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "opticalInsetTop", 0));
        int insetRight = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "opticalInsetRight", 0));
        int insetBottom = Math.round(DrawableInflater.dimension(resources, attributes, "opticalInsetBottom", 0));
        mOpticalInsets = Insets.of(insetLeft, insetTop, insetRight, insetBottom);

        readChildren(resources, parser, attributes, mRoot, parser.getDepth());

        if (mIntrinsicWidth <= 0) mIntrinsicWidth = Math.round(mViewportWidth);
        if (mIntrinsicHeight <= 0) mIntrinsicHeight = Math.round(mViewportHeight);
    }

    private void readChildren(Resources resources, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Group into, int outerDepth)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException
    {
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= outerDepth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            String name = parser.getName();

            if ("path".equals(name))
            {
                Shape shape = readShape(resources, attributes);
                if (shape != null) into.children.add(shape);
            }
            else if ("clip-path".equals(name))
            {
                String data = attributes.getAttributeValue(DrawableInflater.ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "pathData");
                Path clip = data == null ? null : PathParser.createPathFromPathData(data);

                if (clip != null) into.clip = clip;
            }
            else if ("group".equals(name))
            {
                Group group = readGroup(resources, attributes);
                into.children.add(group);
                readChildren(resources, parser, attributes, group, parser.getDepth());
            }
        }
    }

    private Group readGroup(Resources resources, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        Group group = new Group();

        float pivotX = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "pivotX", 0);
        float pivotY = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "pivotY", 0);
        float rotation = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "rotation", 0);
        float scaleX = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "scaleX", 1);
        float scaleY = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "scaleY", 1);
        float translateX = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "translateX", 0);
        float translateY = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "translateY", 0);

        group.transform.postTranslate(-pivotX, -pivotY);
        group.transform.postScale(scaleX, scaleY);
        group.transform.postRotate(rotation);
        group.transform.postTranslate(pivotX + translateX, pivotY + translateY);

        return group;
    }

    private Shape readShape(Resources resources, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        String data = attributes.getAttributeValue(DrawableInflater.ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "pathData");
        if (data == null) return null;

        Path path = PathParser.createPathFromPathData(data);
        if (path == null) return null;

        Shape shape = new Shape();
        shape.path = path;
        shape.fillColor = DrawableInflater.color(resources, attributes, "fillColor", 0);
        shape.strokeColor = DrawableInflater.color(resources, attributes, "strokeColor", 0);
        shape.strokeWidth = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "strokeWidth", 0);
        shape.fillAlpha = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "fillAlpha", 1);
        shape.strokeAlpha = DrawableInflater.dimensionOrFloat(resources, attributes, "strokeAlpha", 1);

        shape.evenOdd = DrawableInflater.enumeration(attributes, "fillType", FILL_TYPE_NAMES, 0) == 1;

        return shape;
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        if (mRoot.children.isEmpty()) return;

        Rect bounds = getBounds();
        if (bounds.width() <= 0 || bounds.height() <= 0) return;
        if (mViewportWidth <= 0 || mViewportHeight <= 0) return;

        int saveCount = canvas.save();
        canvas.translate(bounds.left, bounds.top);

        if (mAutoMirrored && getLayoutDirection() == 1)
        {
            canvas.translate(bounds.width(), 0);
            canvas.scale(-1.0f, 1.0f);
        }

        canvas.scale(bounds.width() / mViewportWidth, bounds.height() / mViewportHeight);

        ColorFilter filter = mColorFilter;
        boolean replaceColor = filter == null && mTint != null && mTintBlendMode == BlendMode.SRC_IN;
        if (filter == null && mTint != null && !replaceColor) filter = tintFilterFor(mTint, mTintBlendMode, getState());

        mPaint.setColorFilter(filter);
        drawGroup(canvas, mRoot, replaceColor);
        canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
    }

    private void drawGroup(Canvas canvas, Group group, boolean replaceColor)
    {
        int saveCount = canvas.save();

        if (!group.transform.isIdentity()) canvas.concat(group.transform);
        if (group.clip != null) canvas.clipPath(group.clip);

        for (int index = 0; index < group.children.size(); index++)
        {
            Object child = group.children.get(index);

            if (child instanceof Group) drawGroup(canvas, (Group) child, replaceColor);
            else drawShape(canvas, (Shape) child, replaceColor);
        }

        canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
    }

    private void drawShape(Canvas canvas, Shape shape, boolean replaceColor)
    {
        float alpha = mRootAlpha / 255.0f;

        if (shape.fillColor != 0)
        {
            mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
            mPaint.setColor(scaleAlpha(tinted(shape.fillColor, replaceColor), shape.fillAlpha * alpha));
            shape.path.setFillType(shape.evenOdd ? Path.FillType.EVEN_ODD : Path.FillType.WINDING);

            canvas.drawPath(shape.path, mPaint);
        }

        if (shape.strokeColor != 0 && shape.strokeWidth > 0)
        {
            mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
            mPaint.setStrokeWidth(shape.strokeWidth);
            mPaint.setColor(scaleAlpha(tinted(shape.strokeColor, replaceColor), shape.strokeAlpha * alpha));

            canvas.drawPath(shape.path, mPaint);
        }
    }

    private int tinted(int color, boolean replaceColor)
    {
        if (!replaceColor) return color;

        int alpha = ((color >>> 24) * (mTintColor >>> 24) + 127) / 255;
        return (alpha << 24) | (mTintColor & 0x00FFFFFF);
    }

    private static int scaleAlpha(int color, float amount)
    {
        int alpha = Math.round(((color >>> 24) & 0xFF) * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, amount)));
        return (alpha << 24) | (color & 0x00FFFFFF);
    }

    private static final class VectorState extends ConstantState
    {
        private final Group mRoot;
        private final int mResourceId;
        private final float mViewportWidth;
        private final float mViewportHeight;
        private final int mIntrinsicWidth;
        private final int mIntrinsicHeight;
        private final int mRootAlpha;
        private final boolean mAutoMirrored;
        private final Insets mOpticalInsets;
        private final ColorStateList mTint;
        private final BlendMode mTintBlendMode;
        private final int mChangingConfigurations;

        VectorState(VectorDrawable source)
        {
            mRoot = source.mRoot;
            mResourceId = source.mResourceId;
            mViewportWidth = source.mViewportWidth;
            mViewportHeight = source.mViewportHeight;
            mIntrinsicWidth = source.mIntrinsicWidth;
            mIntrinsicHeight = source.mIntrinsicHeight;
            mRootAlpha = source.mRootAlpha;
            mAutoMirrored = source.mAutoMirrored;
            mOpticalInsets = source.mOpticalInsets;
            mTint = source.mTint;
            mTintBlendMode = source.mTintBlendMode;
            mChangingConfigurations = source.getChangingConfigurations();
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable newDrawable()
        {
            VectorDrawable drawable = new VectorDrawable(mResourceId);
            drawable.mRoot = mRoot;
            drawable.mViewportWidth = mViewportWidth;
            drawable.mViewportHeight = mViewportHeight;
            drawable.mIntrinsicWidth = mIntrinsicWidth;
            drawable.mIntrinsicHeight = mIntrinsicHeight;
            drawable.mRootAlpha = mRootAlpha;
            drawable.mAutoMirrored = mAutoMirrored;
            drawable.mOpticalInsets = mOpticalInsets;
            drawable.mTint = mTint;
            drawable.mTintBlendMode = mTintBlendMode;
            drawable.updateTintColor(drawable.getState());
            drawable.setChangingConfigurations(mChangingConfigurations);
            return drawable;
        }

        @Override
        public int getChangingConfigurations()
        {
            return mChangingConfigurations;
        }
    }

    private static final class Group
    {
        final ArrayList<Object> children = new ArrayList<>();
        final Matrix transform = new Matrix();
        Path clip;
    }

    private static final class Shape
    {
        Path path;
        int fillColor;
        int strokeColor;
        float strokeWidth;
        float fillAlpha = 1;
        float strokeAlpha = 1;
        boolean evenOdd;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.graphics.drawable.shapes;

import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Path;

public class PathShape extends Shape
{
    private final float mStandardWidth;
    private final float mStandardHeight;

    private Path mPath;
    private float mScaleX = 1;
    private float mScaleY = 1;

    public PathShape(Path path, float stdWidth, float stdHeight)
    {
        mPath = path;
        mStandardWidth = stdWidth;
        mStandardHeight = stdHeight;
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas, Paint paint)
    {
        int saveCount = canvas.save();
        canvas.scale(mScaleX, mScaleY);
        canvas.drawPath(mPath, paint);
        canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResize(float width, float height)
    {
        mScaleX = mStandardWidth == 0 ? 1 : width / mStandardWidth;
        mScaleY = mStandardHeight == 0 ? 1 : height / mStandardHeight;
    }

    @Override
    public PathShape clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException
    {
        PathShape shape = (PathShape) super.clone();
        shape.mPath = new Path(mPath);
        return shape;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!super.equals(other)) return false;

        PathShape shape = (PathShape) other;
        return Float.compare(shape.mStandardWidth, mStandardWidth) == 0 && Float.compare(shape.mStandardHeight, mStandardHeight) == 0
               && Float.compare(shape.mScaleX, mScaleX) == 0 && Float.compare(shape.mScaleY, mScaleY) == 0
               && mPath == shape.mPath;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        int result = super.hashCode();
        result = 31 * result + Float.floatToIntBits(mStandardWidth);
        result = 31 * result + Float.floatToIntBits(mStandardHeight);
        result = 31 * result + Float.floatToIntBits(mScaleX);
        return 31 * result + Float.floatToIntBits(mScaleY);
    }
}
```
