`java/android/hardware/SyncFence.java`:

```java
package android.hardware;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.time.Duration;

public final class SyncFence implements AutoCloseable, Parcelable
{
    public static final long SIGNAL_TIME_INVALID = -1L;
    public static final long SIGNAL_TIME_PENDING = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<SyncFence> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<SyncFence>()
    {
        @Override
        public SyncFence createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            boolean valid = source.readBoolean();
            long signalTime = source.readLong();
            return new SyncFence(valid, signalTime);
        }

        @Override
        public SyncFence[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new SyncFence[size];
        }
    };

    private final Object mLock = new Object();
    private boolean mValid;
    private long mSignalTime;

    SyncFence(boolean valid, long signalTime)
    {
        mValid = valid;
        mSignalTime = signalTime;
    }

    public SyncFence(SyncFence other)
    {
        synchronized (other.mLock)
        {
            mValid = other.mValid;
            mSignalTime = other.mSignalTime;
            other.mValid = false;
        }
    }

    public boolean isValid()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            return mValid;
        }
    }

    public boolean await(Duration timeout)
    {
        if (timeout == null) throw new NullPointerException("timeout");
        if (timeout.isNegative()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("timeout must not be negative");

        return true;
    }

    public boolean awaitForever()
    {
        return true;
    }

    public long getSignalTime()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            return mValid ? mSignalTime : SIGNAL_TIME_INVALID;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void close()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            mValid = false;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return Parcelable.CONTENTS_FILE_DESCRIPTOR;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            dest.writeBoolean(mValid);
            dest.writeLong(mSignalTime);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
import android.content.Context;

public class BiometricManager

    public static final int BIOMETRIC_SUCCESS = 0;
    public static final int BIOMETRIC_ERROR_HW_UNAVAILABLE = 1;
    public static final int BIOMETRIC_ERROR_NONE_ENROLLED = 11;
    public static final int BIOMETRIC_ERROR_NO_HARDWARE = 12;
    public static final int BIOMETRIC_ERROR_SECURITY_UPDATE_REQUIRED = 15;
    public static final int BIOMETRIC_ERROR_IDENTITY_CHECK_NOT_ACTIVE = 20;
    public static final int BIOMETRIC_ERROR_NOT_ENABLED_FOR_APPS = 21;

    public static final long BIOMETRIC_NO_AUTHENTICATION = -1L;

    public BiometricManager(Context context)
    {
    }

    @Deprecated
    public int canAuthenticate()
    {
        return canAuthenticate(Authenticators.BIOMETRIC_WEAK);
    }

    public int canAuthenticate(int authenticators)
    {
        if ((authenticators & Authenticators.DEVICE_CREDENTIAL) != 0) return BIOMETRIC_ERROR_NONE_ENROLLED;
        if ((authenticators & Authenticators.IDENTITY_CHECK) != 0) return BIOMETRIC_ERROR_IDENTITY_CHECK_NOT_ACTIVE;
        return BIOMETRIC_ERROR_NO_HARDWARE;
    }

    public long getLastAuthenticationTime(int authenticators)
    {
        if (authenticators == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("authenticators must not be empty");
        return BIOMETRIC_NO_AUTHENTICATION;
    }

    public Strings getStrings(int authenticators)
    {
        return new Strings(authenticators);
    }

    public interface Authenticators
    {
        int BIOMETRIC_STRONG = 0x000F;
        int BIOMETRIC_WEAK = 0x00FF;
        int DEVICE_CREDENTIAL = 1 << 15;
        int IDENTITY_CHECK = 1 << 16;
    }

    public static class Strings
    {
        private final int mAuthenticators;

        Strings(int authenticators)
        {
            mAuthenticators = authenticators;
        }

        public CharSequence getButtonLabel()
        {
            if ((mAuthenticators & Authenticators.DEVICE_CREDENTIAL) != 0) return "Use screen lock";
            return null;
        }

        public CharSequence getPromptMessage()
        {
            if ((mAuthenticators & Authenticators.DEVICE_CREDENTIAL) != 0) return "Enter your screen lock to continue";
            return null;
        }

        public CharSequence getSettingName()
        {
            if ((mAuthenticators & Authenticators.DEVICE_CREDENTIAL) != 0) return "Use screen lock";
            return null;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    private final PromptContentView mContentView;

    private BiometricPrompt(Builder builder)
    {
        mContext = builder.mContext;
        mTitle = builder.mTitle;
        mSubtitle = builder.mSubtitle;
        mDescription = builder.mDescription;
        mNegativeButtonText = builder.mNegativeButtonText;
        mNegativeButtonExecutor = builder.mNegativeButtonExecutor;
        mNegativeButtonListener = builder.mNegativeButtonListener;
        mConfirmationRequired = builder.mConfirmationRequired;
        mAllowedAuthenticators = builder.mAllowedAuthenticators;
        mLogoBitmap = builder.mLogoBitmap;
        mLogoRes = builder.mLogoRes;
        mLogoDescription = builder.mLogoDescription;
        mContentView = builder.mContentView;
    }

    public CharSequence getTitle()
    {
        return mTitle;
    }

    public CharSequence getSubtitle()
    {
        return mSubtitle;
    }

    public CharSequence getDescription()
    {
        return mDescription;
    }

    public CharSequence getNegativeButtonText()
    {
        return mNegativeButtonText;
    }

    public boolean isConfirmationRequired()
    {
        return mConfirmationRequired;
    }

    public int getAllowedAuthenticators()
    {
        return mAllowedAuthenticators;
    }

    public Bitmap getLogoBitmap()
    {
        return mLogoBitmap;
    }

    public int getLogoRes()
    {
        return mLogoRes;
    }

    public String getLogoDescription()
    {
        return mLogoDescription;
    }

    public PromptContentView getContentView()
    {
        return mContentView;
    }

    public void authenticate(CryptoObject crypto, CancellationSignal cancel, Executor executor, AuthenticationCallback callback)
    {
        if (crypto == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Must supply a crypto object");
        authenticateInternal(cancel, executor, callback);
    }

    public void authenticate(CancellationSignal cancel, Executor executor, AuthenticationCallback callback)
    {
        authenticateInternal(cancel, executor, callback);
    }

    private void authenticateInternal(CancellationSignal cancel, Executor executor, AuthenticationCallback callback)
    {
        if (cancel == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Must supply a cancellation signal");
        if (executor == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Must supply an executor");
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Must supply a callback");
        if (cancel.isCanceled()) return;

        final boolean credentialAllowed = (mAllowedAuthenticators & BiometricManager.Authenticators.DEVICE_CREDENTIAL) != 0;
        final int error = credentialAllowed ? BIOMETRIC_ERROR_NO_DEVICE_CREDENTIAL : BIOMETRIC_ERROR_HW_NOT_PRESENT;
        final CharSequence message = credentialAllowed
            ? "No PIN, pattern, or password set"
            : "This device does not have a biometric sensor";

        executor.execute(() ->
        {
            if (!cancel.isCanceled()) callback.onAuthenticationError(error, message);
        });
    }

    public abstract static class AuthenticationCallback
    {
        public AuthenticationCallback()
        {
        }

        public void onAuthenticationError(int errorCode, CharSequence errString)
        {
        }

        public void onAuthenticationHelp(int helpCode, CharSequence helpString)
        {
        }

        public void onAuthenticationSucceeded(AuthenticationResult result)
        {
        }

        public void onAuthenticationFailed()
        {
        }
    }

    public static class AuthenticationResult
    {
        private final CryptoObject mCryptoObject;
        private final int mAuthenticationType;

        AuthenticationResult()
        {
            this(null, AUTHENTICATION_RESULT_TYPE_BIOMETRIC);
        }

        AuthenticationResult(CryptoObject crypto, int authenticationType)
        {
            mCryptoObject = crypto;
            mAuthenticationType = authenticationType;
        }

        public CryptoObject getCryptoObject()
        {
            return mCryptoObject;
        }

        public int getAuthenticationType()
        {
            return mAuthenticationType;
        }
    }

    public static final class CryptoObject
    {
        private final Object mCrypto;
        private final long mOperationHandle;

        public CryptoObject(Signature signature)
        {
            mCrypto = signature;
            mOperationHandle = 0;
        }

        public CryptoObject(Cipher cipher)
        {
            mCrypto = cipher;
            mOperationHandle = 0;
        }

        public CryptoObject(Mac mac)
        {
            mCrypto = mac;
            mOperationHandle = 0;
        }

        @Deprecated
        public CryptoObject(IdentityCredential credential)
        {
            mCrypto = credential;
            mOperationHandle = 0;
        }

        public CryptoObject(PresentationSession session)
        {
            mCrypto = session;
            mOperationHandle = 0;
        }

        public CryptoObject(long operationHandle)
        {
            mCrypto = null;
            mOperationHandle = operationHandle;
        }

        public Signature getSignature()
        {
            return mCrypto instanceof Signature ? (Signature)mCrypto : null;
        }

        public Cipher getCipher()
        {
            return mCrypto instanceof Cipher ? (Cipher)mCrypto : null;
        }

        public Mac getMac()
        {
            return mCrypto instanceof Mac ? (Mac)mCrypto : null;
        }

        @Deprecated
        public IdentityCredential getIdentityCredential()
        {
            return mCrypto instanceof IdentityCredential ? (IdentityCredential)mCrypto : null;
        }

        public PresentationSession getPresentationSession()
        {
            return mCrypto instanceof PresentationSession ? (PresentationSession)mCrypto : null;
        }

        public long getOperationHandle()
        {
            return mOperationHandle;
        }
    }

    public static class Builder
    {
        private final Context mContext;
        private CharSequence mTitle;
        private CharSequence mSubtitle;
        private CharSequence mDescription;
        private CharSequence mNegativeButtonText;
        private Executor mNegativeButtonExecutor;
        private DialogInterface.OnClickListener mNegativeButtonListener;
        private boolean mConfirmationRequired = true;
        private int mAllowedAuthenticators;
        private Bitmap mLogoBitmap;
        private int mLogoRes;
        private String mLogoDescription;
        private PromptContentView mContentView;

        public Builder(Context context)
        {
            mContext = context;
        }

        public Builder setTitle(CharSequence title)
        {
            mTitle = title;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setSubtitle(CharSequence subtitle)
        {
            mSubtitle = subtitle;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setDescription(CharSequence description)
        {
            mDescription = description;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setLogoRes(int logoRes)
        {
            if (mLogoBitmap != null) throw new IllegalStateException("Exclusively one of logo resource or logo bitmap can be set");
            mLogoRes = logoRes;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setLogoBitmap(Bitmap logoBitmap)
        {
            if (mLogoRes != 0) throw new IllegalStateException("Exclusively one of logo resource or logo bitmap can be set");
            mLogoBitmap = logoBitmap;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setLogoDescription(String logoDescription)
        {
            if (logoDescription == null || logoDescription.isEmpty())
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Logo description passed in can not be null or empty");
            }
            mLogoDescription = logoDescription;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setContentView(PromptContentView view)
        {
            mContentView = view;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setNegativeButton(CharSequence text, Executor executor, DialogInterface.OnClickListener listener)
        {
            if (text == null || text.length() == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Text must be set and non-empty");
            if (executor == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Executor must not be null");
            if (listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Listener must not be null");

            mNegativeButtonText = text;
            mNegativeButtonExecutor = executor;
            mNegativeButtonListener = listener;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setConfirmationRequired(boolean requireConfirmation)
        {
            mConfirmationRequired = requireConfirmation;
            return this;
        }

        @Deprecated
        public Builder setDeviceCredentialAllowed(boolean allowed)
        {
            if (allowed) mAllowedAuthenticators |= BiometricManager.Authenticators.DEVICE_CREDENTIAL;
            else mAllowedAuthenticators &= ~BiometricManager.Authenticators.DEVICE_CREDENTIAL;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setAllowedAuthenticators(int authenticators)
        {
            mAllowedAuthenticators = authenticators;
            return this;
        }

        public BiometricPrompt build()
        {
            final boolean credentialAllowed = (mAllowedAuthenticators & BiometricManager.Authenticators.DEVICE_CREDENTIAL) != 0;

            if (mTitle == null || mTitle.length() == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Title must be set and non-empty");
            if (mNegativeButtonText == null && !credentialAllowed)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Negative text must be set and non-empty");
            }
            if (mNegativeButtonText != null && credentialAllowed)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Can't have both negative button behavior and device credential enabled");
            }

            return new BiometricPrompt(this);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/hardware/camera2/CameraAccessException.java`:

```java
package android.hardware.camera2;

import android.util.AndroidException;

public class CameraAccessException extends AndroidException
{
    public static final int CAMERA_DISABLED = 1;
    public static final int CAMERA_DISCONNECTED = 2;
    public static final int CAMERA_ERROR = 3;
    public static final int CAMERA_IN_USE = 4;
    public static final int MAX_CAMERAS_IN_USE = 5;

    private final int mReason;

    public CameraAccessException(int problem)
    {
        super(getDefaultMessage(problem));
        mReason = problem;
    }

    public CameraAccessException(int problem, String message)
    {
        super(getCombinedMessage(problem, message));
        mReason = problem;
    }

    public CameraAccessException(int problem, String message, Throwable cause)
    {
        super(getCombinedMessage(problem, message), cause);
        mReason = problem;
    }

    public CameraAccessException(int problem, Throwable cause)
    {
        super(getDefaultMessage(problem), cause);
        mReason = problem;
    }

    public final int getReason()
    {
        return mReason;
    }

    private static String getCombinedMessage(int problem, String message)
    {
        String problemString = getProblemString(problem);
        return String.format("%s (%d): %s", problemString, problem, message);
    }

    private static String getProblemString(int problem)
    {
        switch (problem)
        {
            case CAMERA_IN_USE: return "CAMERA_IN_USE";
            case MAX_CAMERAS_IN_USE: return "MAX_CAMERAS_IN_USE";
            case CAMERA_DISCONNECTED: return "CAMERA_DISCONNECTED";
            case CAMERA_DISABLED: return "CAMERA_DISABLED";
            case CAMERA_ERROR: return "CAMERA_ERROR";
            default: return "<UNKNOWN ERROR>";
        }
    }

    private static String getDefaultMessage(int problem)
    {
        switch (problem)
        {
            case CAMERA_IN_USE: return "The camera device is in use already";
            case MAX_CAMERAS_IN_USE:
                return "The system-wide limit for number of open cameras has been reached, and more camera devices cannot be opened "
                        + "until previous instances are closed.";
            case CAMERA_DISCONNECTED:
                return "The camera device is removable and has been disconnected from the Android device, or the camera service has "
                        + "shut down the connection due to a higher-priority access request for the camera device.";
            case CAMERA_DISABLED: return "The camera is disabled due to a device policy, and cannot be opened.";
            case CAMERA_ERROR: return "The camera device is currently in the error state; no further calls to it will succeed.";
            default: return null;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    private final Set<String> mPhysicalCameraIds;

    CameraCharacteristics(Map<Key<?>, Object> values, Set<String> physicalCameraIds)
    {
        super(values);
        mPhysicalCameraIds = Collections.unmodifiableSet(physicalCameraIds);
    }

    public <T> T get(Key<T> key)
    {
        return getValue(key);
    }

    @Override
    public List<Key<?>> getKeys()
    {
        return super.getKeys();
    }

    public List<CaptureRequest.Key<?>> getAvailableCaptureRequestKeys()
    {
        return Collections.emptyList();
    }

    public List<CaptureResult.Key<?>> getAvailableCaptureResultKeys()
    {
        return Collections.emptyList();
    }

    {
        return null;
    }

    }

    {
        return null;
    }

    public List<CameraCharacteristics.Key<?>> getKeysNeedingPermission()
    {
        return Collections.emptyList();
    }

    public Set<String> getPhysicalCameraIds()
    {
        return mPhysicalCameraIds;
    }

    public RecommendedStreamConfigurationMap getRecommendedStreamConfigurationMap(int usecase)
    {
        if (usecase < RecommendedStreamConfigurationMap.USECASE_PREVIEW || usecase > RecommendedStreamConfigurationMap.USECASE_10BIT_OUTPUT)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid use case: " + usecase);
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static final class Key<T>
    {
        private final String mName;
        private final Class<T> mType;

        public Key(String name, Class<T> type)
        {
            if (name == null) throw new NullPointerException("Key needs a valid name");
            if (type == null) throw new NullPointerException("Type needs to be non-null");
            mName = name;
            mType = type;
        }

        Key(String name)
        {
            mName = name;
            mType = null;
        }

        public String getName()
        {
            return mName;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object other)
        {
            return other instanceof Key && ((Key<?>)other).mName.equals(mName);
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return mName.hashCode();
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "CameraCharacteristics.Key(" + mName + ")";
        }
    }
```

```java
    public static final class StillCaptureLatency
    {
        private final long mCaptureLatency;
        private final long mProcessingLatency;

        public StillCaptureLatency(long captureLatency, long processingLatency)
        {
            mCaptureLatency = captureLatency;
            mProcessingLatency = processingLatency;
        }

        public long getCaptureLatency()
        {
            return mCaptureLatency;
        }

        public long getProcessingLatency()
        {
            return mProcessingLatency;

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object other)
        {
            if (this == other) return true;
            if (!(other instanceof StillCaptureLatency)) return false;

            StillCaptureLatency latency = (StillCaptureLatency)other;
            return mCaptureLatency == latency.mCaptureLatency && mProcessingLatency == latency.mProcessingLatency;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return Objects.hash(mCaptureLatency, mProcessingLatency);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "StillCaptureLatency(processingLatency:" + mProcessingLatency + ", captureLatency: " + mCaptureLatency + ")";
        }
    }
```

```java
package android.hardware.camera2;

import android.content.Context;
import android.hardware.camera2.params.SessionConfiguration;
import android.os.Handler;

import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;

public final class CameraManager
{
    private final Context mContext;
    private final Map<AvailabilityCallback, Object> mAvailabilityCallbacks = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final Map<TorchCallback, Object> mTorchCallbacks = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    public CameraManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public String[] getCameraIdList() throws CameraAccessException
    {
        return new String[0];
    }

    public Set<Set<String>> getConcurrentCameraIds() throws CameraAccessException
    {
        return Collections.emptySet();
    }

    public boolean isConcurrentSessionConfigurationSupported(Map<String, SessionConfiguration> cameraIdAndSessionConfig)
            throws CameraAccessException
    {
        if (cameraIdAndSessionConfig == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("cameraIdAndSessionConfig was null");
        if (cameraIdAndSessionConfig.isEmpty()) return false;
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Camera ids " + cameraIdAndSessionConfig.keySet() + " are not concurrent capable");
    }

    public CameraCharacteristics getCameraCharacteristics(String cameraId) throws CameraAccessException
    {
        throw unknownCamera(cameraId);
    }

    public CameraExtensionCharacteristics getCameraExtensionCharacteristics(String cameraId) throws CameraAccessException
    {
        throw unknownCamera(cameraId);
    }

    public CameraDevice.CameraDeviceSetup getCameraDeviceSetup(String cameraId) throws CameraAccessException
    {
        throw unknownCamera(cameraId);
    }

    public boolean isCameraDeviceSetupSupported(String cameraId) throws CameraAccessException
    {
        throw unknownCamera(cameraId);
    }

    public void openCamera(String cameraId, CameraDevice.StateCallback callback, Handler handler) throws CameraAccessException
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("callback was null");
        throw unknownCamera(cameraId);
    }

    public void openCamera(String cameraId, Executor executor, CameraDevice.StateCallback callback) throws CameraAccessException
    {
        if (executor == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("executor was null");
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("callback was null");
        throw unknownCamera(cameraId);
    }

    public void setTorchMode(String cameraId, boolean enabled) throws CameraAccessException
    {
        throw unknownCamera(cameraId);
    }

    public void turnOnTorchWithStrengthLevel(String cameraId, int torchStrength) throws CameraAccessException
    {
        throw unknownCamera(cameraId);
    }

    public int getTorchStrengthLevel(String cameraId) throws CameraAccessException
    {
        throw unknownCamera(cameraId);
    }

    public void registerAvailabilityCallback(AvailabilityCallback callback, Handler handler)
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("callback was null");
        synchronized (mAvailabilityCallbacks)
        {
            mAvailabilityCallbacks.put(callback, handler);
        }
    }

    public void registerAvailabilityCallback(Executor executor, AvailabilityCallback callback)
    {
        if (executor == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("executor was null");
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("callback was null");
        synchronized (mAvailabilityCallbacks)
        {
            mAvailabilityCallbacks.put(callback, executor);
        }
    }

    public void unregisterAvailabilityCallback(AvailabilityCallback callback)
    {
        synchronized (mAvailabilityCallbacks)
        {
            mAvailabilityCallbacks.remove(callback);
        }
    }

    public void registerTorchCallback(TorchCallback callback, Handler handler)
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("callback was null");
        synchronized (mTorchCallbacks)
        {
            mTorchCallbacks.put(callback, handler);
        }
    }

    public void registerTorchCallback(Executor executor, TorchCallback callback)
    {
        if (executor == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("executor was null");
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("callback was null");
        synchronized (mTorchCallbacks)
        {
            mTorchCallbacks.put(callback, executor);
        }
    }

    public void unregisterTorchCallback(TorchCallback callback)
    {
        synchronized (mTorchCallbacks)
        {
            mTorchCallbacks.remove(callback);
        }
    }

    private static IllegalArgumentException unknownCamera(String cameraId)
    {
        if (cameraId == null) return new IllegalArgumentException("cameraId was null");
        return new IllegalArgumentException("Camera id " + cameraId + " does not match any currently connected camera device");
    }

    public abstract static class AvailabilityCallback
    {
        public AvailabilityCallback()
        {
        }

        public void onCameraAvailable(String cameraId)
        {
        }

        public void onCameraUnavailable(String cameraId)
        {
        }

        public void onCameraAccessPrioritiesChanged()
        {
        }

        public void onPhysicalCameraAvailable(String cameraId, String physicalCameraId)
        {
        }

        public void onPhysicalCameraUnavailable(String cameraId, String physicalCameraId)
        {
        }
    }

    public abstract static class TorchCallback
    {
        public TorchCallback()
        {
        }

        public void onTorchModeUnavailable(String cameraId)
        {
        }

        public void onTorchModeChanged(String cameraId, boolean enabled)
        {
        }

        public void onTorchStrengthLevelChanged(String cameraId, int newStrengthLevel)
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    final Map<TKey, Object> mValues;

    CameraMetadata()
    {
        mValues = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    }

    CameraMetadata(Map<TKey, Object> values)
    {
        mValues = new LinkedHashMap<>(values);
    }

    public List<TKey> getKeys()
    {
        return Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(mValues.keySet()));
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    <T> T getValue(TKey key)
    {
        if (key == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("key must not be null");
        return (T)mValues.get(key);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.hardware.camera2;

public abstract class CameraOfflineSession extends CameraCaptureSession
{
    public CameraOfflineSession()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public abstract void close();

    public abstract static class CameraOfflineSessionCallback
    {
        public static final int STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR = 0;

        public CameraOfflineSessionCallback()
        {
        }

        public abstract void onReady(CameraOfflineSession session);

        public abstract void onSwitchFailed(CameraOfflineSession session);

        public abstract void onIdle(CameraOfflineSession session);

        public abstract void onError(CameraOfflineSession session, int status);

        public abstract void onClosed(CameraOfflineSession session);
    }
}
```

`java/android/hardware/camera2/CaptureFailure.java`:

```java
package android.hardware.camera2;

public class CaptureFailure
{
    public static final int REASON_ERROR = 0;
    public static final int REASON_FLUSHED = 1;

    private final CaptureRequest mRequest;
    private final int mReason;
    private final boolean mWasImageCaptured;
    private final int mSequenceId;
    private final long mFrameNumber;
    private final String mPhysicalCameraId;

    CaptureFailure(CaptureRequest request, int reason, boolean wasImageCaptured, int sequenceId, long frameNumber,
            String physicalCameraId)
    {
        mRequest = request;
        mReason = reason;
        mWasImageCaptured = wasImageCaptured;
        mSequenceId = sequenceId;
        mFrameNumber = frameNumber;
        mPhysicalCameraId = physicalCameraId;
    }

    public CaptureRequest getRequest()
    {
        return mRequest;
    }

    public long getFrameNumber()
    {
        return mFrameNumber;
    }

    public int getReason()
    {
        return mReason;
    }

    public boolean wasImageCaptured()
    {
        return mWasImageCaptured;
    }

    public int getSequenceId()
    {
        return mSequenceId;
    }

    public String getPhysicalCameraId()
    {
        return mPhysicalCameraId;
    }
}
```

```java
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<CaptureRequest> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<CaptureRequest>()
    {
        @Override
        public CaptureRequest createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            boolean reprocess = source.readInt() != 0;
            String cameraId = source.readString();
            return new CaptureRequest(new LinkedHashMap<>(), new LinkedHashSet<>(), null, reprocess, cameraId, new HashMap<>());
        }

        @Override
        public CaptureRequest[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new CaptureRequest[size];
        }
    };

    private final Set<Surface> mTargets;
    private final Object mTag;
    private final boolean mReprocess;
    private final String mLogicalCameraId;
    private final Map<String, Map<Key<?>, Object>> mPhysicalValues;

    CaptureRequest(Map<Key<?>, Object> values, Set<Surface> targets, Object tag, boolean reprocess, String logicalCameraId,
            Map<String, Map<Key<?>, Object>> physicalValues)
    {
        super(values);
        mTargets = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new LinkedHashSet<>(targets));
        mTag = tag;
        mReprocess = reprocess;
        mLogicalCameraId = logicalCameraId;
        mPhysicalValues = physicalValues;
    }

    public <T> T get(Key<T> key)
    {
        return getValue(key);
    }

    @Override
    public List<Key<?>> getKeys()
    {
        return super.getKeys();
    }

    public Object getTag()
    {
        return mTag;
    }

    public boolean isReprocess()
    {
        return mReprocess;
    }

    Set<Surface> getTargets()
    {
        return mTargets;
    }

    String getLogicalCameraId()
    {
        return mLogicalCameraId;
    }

    Map<String, Map<Key<?>, Object>> getPhysicalValues()
    {
        return mPhysicalValues;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof CaptureRequest)) return false;

        CaptureRequest request = (CaptureRequest)other;
        return mReprocess == request.mReprocess && Objects.equals(mLogicalCameraId, request.mLogicalCameraId)
                && mTargets.equals(request.mTargets) && mValues.equals(request.mValues);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mValues.keySet(), mTargets, mReprocess, mLogicalCameraId);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mReprocess ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeString(mLogicalCameraId);
    }

    public static final class Key<T>
    {
        private final String mName;
        private final Class<T> mType;

        public Key(String name, Class<T> type)
        {
            if (name == null) throw new NullPointerException("Key needs a valid name");
            if (type == null) throw new NullPointerException("Type needs to be non-null");
            mName = name;
            mType = type;
        }

        Key(String name)
        {
            mName = name;
            mType = null;
        }

        public String getName()
        {
            return mName;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object other)
        {
            return other instanceof Key && ((Key<?>)other).mName.equals(mName);
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return mName.hashCode();
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "CaptureRequest.Key(" + mName + ")";
        }
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final Map<Key<?>, Object> mValues;
        private final Set<Surface> mTargets = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        private final Map<String, Map<Key<?>, Object>> mPhysicalValues = new HashMap<>();
        private final boolean mReprocess;
        private final String mLogicalCameraId;
        private Object mTag;

        Builder(Map<Key<?>, Object> values, boolean reprocess, String logicalCameraId, Set<String> physicalCameraIds)
        {
            mValues = new LinkedHashMap<>(values);
            mReprocess = reprocess;
            mLogicalCameraId = logicalCameraId;
            if (physicalCameraIds != null)
            {
                for (String physicalCameraId : physicalCameraIds)
                {
                    mPhysicalValues.put(physicalCameraId, new LinkedHashMap<>(values));
                }
            }
        }

        public void addTarget(Surface outputTarget)
        {
            if (outputTarget == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("outputTarget must not be null");
            mTargets.add(outputTarget);
        }

        public void removeTarget(Surface outputTarget)
        {
            mTargets.remove(outputTarget);
        }

        public <T> void set(Key<T> key, T value)
        {
            if (key == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("key must not be null");
            if (value == null)
            {
                mValues.remove(key);
            }
            else
            {
                mValues.put(key, value);
            }
        }

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        public <T> T get(Key<T> key)
        {
            if (key == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("key must not be null");
            return (T)mValues.get(key);
        }

        public <T> Builder setPhysicalCameraKey(Key<T> key, T value, String physicalCameraId)
        {
            Map<Key<?>, Object> values = mPhysicalValues.get(physicalCameraId);
            if (values == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Physical camera id: " + physicalCameraId + " is not valid!");
            if (value == null)
            {
                values.remove(key);
            }
            else
            {
                values.put(key, value);
            }
            return this;
        }

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        public <T> T getPhysicalCameraKey(Key<T> key, String physicalCameraId)
        {
            Map<Key<?>, Object> values = mPhysicalValues.get(physicalCameraId);
            if (values == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Physical camera id: " + physicalCameraId + " is not valid!");
            return (T)values.get(key);
        }

        public void setTag(Object tag)
        {
            mTag = tag;
        }

        public CaptureRequest build()
        {
            Map<String, Map<Key<?>, Object>> physicalValues = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<String, Map<Key<?>, Object>> entry : mPhysicalValues.entrySet())
            {
                physicalValues.put(entry.getKey(), new LinkedHashMap<>(entry.getValue()));
            }
            return new CaptureRequest(mValues, mTargets, mTag, mReprocess, mLogicalCameraId, physicalValues);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    }

        private final Class<T> mType;

        {
            if (name == null) throw new NullPointerException("Key needs a valid name");
            if (type == null) throw new NullPointerException("Type needs to be non-null");
            mName = name;
            mType = type;

            mName = name;
            mType = null;
```

```java
package android.hardware.camera2.params;

import java.util.Arrays;

public final class BlackLevelPattern
{
    public static final int COUNT = 4;

    private final int[] mCfaOffsets;

    public BlackLevelPattern(int[] offsets)
    {
        if (offsets == null) throw new NullPointerException("Null offsets array passed to constructor");
        if (offsets.length < COUNT) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid offsets array length");
        mCfaOffsets = Arrays.copyOf(offsets, COUNT);
    }

    public int getOffsetForIndex(int column, int row)
    {
        if (row < 0 || column < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("column, row arguments must be positive");
        return mCfaOffsets[((row & 1) << 1) | (column & 1)];
    }

    public void copyTo(int[] destination, int offset)
    {
        if (destination == null) throw new NullPointerException("destination must not be null");
        if (offset < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Null offset passed to copyTo");
        if (destination.length - offset < COUNT) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException("destination too small to fit elements");
        System.arraycopy(mCfaOffsets, 0, destination, offset, COUNT);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        return other instanceof BlackLevelPattern && Arrays.equals(((BlackLevelPattern)other).mCfaOffsets, mCfaOffsets);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Arrays.hashCode(mCfaOffsets);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return String.format("BlackLevelPattern([%d, %d], [%d, %d])", mCfaOffsets[0], mCfaOffsets[1], mCfaOffsets[2], mCfaOffsets[3]);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.hardware.camera2.params;

import android.util.Range;
import android.util.Size;

import java.util.Objects;

public final class Capability
{
    private final int mMode;
    private final Size mMaxStreamingSize;
    private final Range<Float> mZoomRatioRange;

    public Capability(int mode, Size maxStreamingSize, Range<Float> zoomRatioRange)
    {
        if (maxStreamingSize.getWidth() < 0 || maxStreamingSize.getHeight() < 0)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxStreamingSize must be non-negative");
        }
        if (zoomRatioRange.getLower() > zoomRatioRange.getUpper() || zoomRatioRange.getLower() <= 0)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("zoomRatioRange must be valid");
        }
        mMode = mode;
        mMaxStreamingSize = maxStreamingSize;
        mZoomRatioRange = zoomRatioRange;
    }

    public int getMode()
    {
        return mMode;
    }

    public Size getMaxStreamingSize()
    {
        return mMaxStreamingSize;
    }

    public Range<Float> getZoomRatioRange()
    {
        return mZoomRatioRange;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof Capability)) return false;

        Capability capability = (Capability)other;
        return mMode == capability.mMode && mMaxStreamingSize.equals(capability.mMaxStreamingSize)
                && mZoomRatioRange.equals(capability.mZoomRatioRange);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mMode, mMaxStreamingSize, mZoomRatioRange);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return String.format("(mode:%d, maxStreamingSize:%d x %d, zoomRatio: %f-%f)", mMode, mMaxStreamingSize.getWidth(),
                mMaxStreamingSize.getHeight(), mZoomRatioRange.getLower(), mZoomRatioRange.getUpper());
    }
}
```

`java/android/hardware/camera2/params/ColorSpaceProfiles.java`:

```java
package android.hardware.camera2.params;

import android.graphics.ColorSpace;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

public final class ColorSpaceProfiles
{
    public static final int UNSPECIFIED = -1;

    private final Map<ColorSpace.Named, Map<Integer, Set<Long>>> mProfileMap = new HashMap<>();

    public ColorSpaceProfiles(long[] elements)
    {
        if ((elements.length % 3) != 0)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Color space profile map length " + elements.length + " is not divisible by 3!");
        }

        ColorSpace.Named[] named = ColorSpace.Named.values();
        for (int index = 0; index < elements.length; index += 3)
        {
            int colorSpace = (int)elements[index];
            if (colorSpace < 0 || colorSpace >= named.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown color space " + colorSpace);

            int imageFormat = (int)elements[index + 1];
            long dynamicRangeProfileBitmap = elements[index + 2];

            Set<Long> profiles = new HashSet<>();
            for (long profile = DynamicRangeProfiles.STANDARD; profile < DynamicRangeProfiles.PUBLIC_MAX; profile <<= 1)
            {
                if ((dynamicRangeProfileBitmap & profile) != 0) profiles.add(profile);
            }

            Map<Integer, Set<Long>> formats = mProfileMap.get(named[colorSpace]);
            if (formats == null)
            {
                formats = new HashMap<>();
                mProfileMap.put(named[colorSpace], formats);
            }
            Set<Long> existing = formats.get(imageFormat);
            if (existing == null)
            {
                formats.put(imageFormat, profiles);
            }
            else
            {
                existing.addAll(profiles);
            }
        }
    }

    public Set<ColorSpace.Named> getSupportedColorSpaces(int imageFormat)
    {
        Set<ColorSpace.Named> colorSpaces = new HashSet<>();
        for (Map.Entry<ColorSpace.Named, Map<Integer, Set<Long>>> entry : mProfileMap.entrySet())
        {
            if (imageFormat == UNSPECIFIED || entry.getValue().containsKey(imageFormat)) colorSpaces.add(entry.getKey());
        }
        return colorSpaces;
    }

    public Set<Integer> getSupportedImageFormatsForColorSpace(ColorSpace.Named colorSpace)
    {
        Map<Integer, Set<Long>> formats = mProfileMap.get(colorSpace);
        return formats == null ? new HashSet<Integer>() : new HashSet<>(formats.keySet());
    }

    public Set<Long> getSupportedDynamicRangeProfiles(ColorSpace.Named colorSpace, int imageFormat)
    {
        Set<Long> profiles = new HashSet<>();
        Map<Integer, Set<Long>> formats = mProfileMap.get(colorSpace);
        if (formats == null) return profiles;

        for (Map.Entry<Integer, Set<Long>> entry : formats.entrySet())
        {
            if (imageFormat == UNSPECIFIED || entry.getKey() == imageFormat) profiles.addAll(entry.getValue());
        }
        return profiles;
    }

    public Set<ColorSpace.Named> getSupportedColorSpacesForDynamicRange(int imageFormat, long dynamicRangeProfile)
    {
        Set<ColorSpace.Named> colorSpaces = new HashSet<>();
        for (Map.Entry<ColorSpace.Named, Map<Integer, Set<Long>>> entry : mProfileMap.entrySet())
        {
            for (Map.Entry<Integer, Set<Long>> format : entry.getValue().entrySet())
            {
                if ((imageFormat == UNSPECIFIED || format.getKey() == imageFormat) && format.getValue().contains(dynamicRangeProfile))
                {
                    colorSpaces.add(entry.getKey());
                }
            }
        }
        return colorSpaces;
    }
}
```

`java/android/hardware/camera2/params/ColorSpaceTransform.java`:

```java
package android.hardware.camera2.params;

import android.util.Rational;

import java.util.Arrays;

public final class ColorSpaceTransform
{
    private static final int ROWS = 3;
    private static final int COLUMNS = 3;
    private static final int COUNT = ROWS * COLUMNS;
    private static final int RATIONAL_SIZE = 2;
    private static final int OFFSET_NUMERATOR = 0;
    private static final int OFFSET_DENOMINATOR = 1;

    private final int[] mElements;

    public ColorSpaceTransform(Rational[] elements)
    {
        if (elements == null) throw new NullPointerException("elements must not be null");
        if (elements.length != COUNT) throw new IllegalArgumentException("elements must be " + COUNT + " length");

        mElements = new int[COUNT * RATIONAL_SIZE];
        for (int index = 0; index < elements.length; ++index)
        {
            if (elements[index] == null) throw new NullPointerException("element[" + index + "] must not be null");
            mElements[index * RATIONAL_SIZE + OFFSET_NUMERATOR] = elements[index].getNumerator();
            mElements[index * RATIONAL_SIZE + OFFSET_DENOMINATOR] = elements[index].getDenominator();
        }
    }

    public ColorSpaceTransform(int[] elements)
    {
        if (elements == null) throw new NullPointerException("elements must not be null");
        if (elements.length != COUNT * RATIONAL_SIZE)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("elements must be " + COUNT * RATIONAL_SIZE + " length");
        }
        mElements = Arrays.copyOf(elements, elements.length);
    }

    public Rational getElement(int column, int row)
    {
        if (column < 0 || column >= COLUMNS) throw new IllegalArgumentException("column out of range");
        if (row < 0 || row >= ROWS) throw new IllegalArgumentException("row out of range");

        int index = (row * COLUMNS + column) * RATIONAL_SIZE;
        return new Rational(mElements[index + OFFSET_NUMERATOR], mElements[index + OFFSET_DENOMINATOR]);
    }

    public void copyElements(Rational[] destination, int offset)
    {
        if (offset < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset must not be negative");
        if (destination == null) throw new NullPointerException("destination must not be null");
        if (destination.length - offset < COUNT) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException("destination too small to fit elements");

        for (int index = 0, element = 0; index < COUNT; ++index, element += RATIONAL_SIZE)
        {
            destination[index + offset] = new Rational(mElements[element + OFFSET_NUMERATOR], mElements[element + OFFSET_DENOMINATOR]);
        }
    }

    public void copyElements(int[] destination, int offset)
    {
        if (offset < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset must not be negative");
        if (destination == null) throw new NullPointerException("destination must not be null");
        if (destination.length - offset < COUNT * RATIONAL_SIZE)
        {
            throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException("destination too small to fit elements");
        }
        System.arraycopy(mElements, 0, destination, offset, COUNT * RATIONAL_SIZE);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof ColorSpaceTransform)) return false;

        ColorSpaceTransform transform = (ColorSpaceTransform)other;
        for (int index = 0, element = 0; index < COUNT; ++index, element += RATIONAL_SIZE)
        {
            Rational mine = new Rational(mElements[element + OFFSET_NUMERATOR], mElements[element + OFFSET_DENOMINATOR]);
            Rational theirs = new Rational(transform.mElements[element + OFFSET_NUMERATOR],
                    transform.mElements[element + OFFSET_DENOMINATOR]);
            if (!mine.equals(theirs)) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Arrays.hashCode(mElements);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder("ColorSpace Transform");
        builder.append("(");
        for (int row = 0; row < ROWS; ++row)
        {
            builder.append("[");
            for (int column = 0; column < COLUMNS; ++column)
            {
                int index = (row * COLUMNS + column) * RATIONAL_SIZE;
                builder.append(mElements[index + OFFSET_NUMERATOR]).append("/").append(mElements[index + OFFSET_DENOMINATOR]);
                if (column < COLUMNS - 1) builder.append(", ");
            }
            builder.append("]");
            if (row < ROWS - 1) builder.append(", ");
        }
        builder.append(")");
        return builder.toString();
    }
}
```

```java
public final class DeviceStateSensorOrientationMap

    public static final long NORMAL = 0;
    public static final long FOLDED = 1 << 2;

    private final Map<Long, Integer> mDeviceStateOrientationMap = new HashMap<>();

    DeviceStateSensorOrientationMap(long[] elements)
    {
        if (elements == null) throw new NullPointerException("elements must not be null");
        if ((elements.length % 2) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Device state sensor orientation map length must be even");

        for (int index = 0; index < elements.length; index += 2)
        {
            if ((elements[index + 1] % 90) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sensor orientation not divisible by 90");
            mDeviceStateOrientationMap.put(elements[index], (int)elements[index + 1]);
        }
    }

        if (orientation == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid device state: " + deviceState);
        return orientation;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        return other instanceof DeviceStateSensorOrientationMap
                && ((DeviceStateSensorOrientationMap)other).mDeviceStateOrientationMap.equals(mDeviceStateOrientationMap);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mDeviceStateOrientationMap.hashCode();
    }
}
```

`java/android/hardware/camera2/params/DynamicRangeProfiles.java`:

```java
package android.hardware.camera2.params;

import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

public final class DynamicRangeProfiles
{
    public static final long STANDARD = 0x1;
    public static final long HLG10 = 0x2;
    public static final long HDR10 = 0x4;
    public static final long HDR10_PLUS = 0x8;
    public static final long DOLBY_VISION_10B_HDR_REF = 0x10;
    public static final long DOLBY_VISION_10B_HDR_REF_PO = 0x20;
    public static final long DOLBY_VISION_10B_HDR_OEM = 0x40;
    public static final long DOLBY_VISION_10B_HDR_OEM_PO = 0x80;
    public static final long DOLBY_VISION_8B_HDR_REF = 0x100;
    public static final long DOLBY_VISION_8B_HDR_REF_PO = 0x200;
    public static final long DOLBY_VISION_8B_HDR_OEM = 0x400;
    public static final long DOLBY_VISION_8B_HDR_OEM_PO = 0x800;
    public static final long PUBLIC_MAX = 0x1000;

    private final Map<Long, Set<Long>> mProfileMap = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<Long, Boolean> mLookaheadLatencyMap = new HashMap<>();

    public DynamicRangeProfiles(long[] elements)
    {
        if ((elements.length % 3) != 0)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Dynamic range profile map length " + elements.length + " is not a multiple of 3!");
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < elements.length; index += 3)
        {
            checkProfileValue(elements[index]);
            if (elements[index] == STANDARD)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Dynamic range profile map must not include a STANDARD profile entry!");
            }

            Set<Long> profiles = new HashSet<>();
            if (elements[index + 1] == 0)
            {
                profiles.add(elements[index]);
            }
            else
            {
                for (long profile = STANDARD; profile < PUBLIC_MAX; profile <<= 1)
                {
                    if ((elements[index + 1] & profile) != 0) profiles.add(profile);
                }
            }

            mProfileMap.put(elements[index], profiles);
            mLookaheadLatencyMap.put(elements[index], elements[index + 2] != 0);
        }

        Set<Long> standardConstraints = new HashSet<>();
        standardConstraints.add(STANDARD);
        for (Long profile : mProfileMap.keySet())
        {
            if (mProfileMap.get(profile).isEmpty() || mProfileMap.get(profile).contains(STANDARD)) standardConstraints.add(profile);
        }
        mProfileMap.put(STANDARD, standardConstraints);
        mLookaheadLatencyMap.put(STANDARD, false);
    }

    private static void checkProfileValue(long profile)
    {
        if (profile == STANDARD || profile == HLG10 || profile == HDR10 || profile == HDR10_PLUS || profile == DOLBY_VISION_10B_HDR_REF
                || profile == DOLBY_VISION_10B_HDR_REF_PO || profile == DOLBY_VISION_10B_HDR_OEM || profile == DOLBY_VISION_10B_HDR_OEM_PO
                || profile == DOLBY_VISION_8B_HDR_REF || profile == DOLBY_VISION_8B_HDR_REF_PO || profile == DOLBY_VISION_8B_HDR_OEM
                || profile == DOLBY_VISION_8B_HDR_OEM_PO)
        {
            return;
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown profile " + profile);
    }

    public Set<Long> getSupportedProfiles()
    {
        return Collections.unmodifiableSet(mProfileMap.keySet());
    }

    public Set<Long> getProfileCaptureRequestConstraints(long profile)
    {
        Set<Long> constraints = mProfileMap.get(profile);
        if (constraints == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported profile!");
        return Collections.unmodifiableSet(constraints);
    }

    public boolean isExtraLatencyPresent(long profile)
    {
        Boolean latency = mLookaheadLatencyMap.get(profile);
        if (latency == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported profile!");
        return latency;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.hardware.camera2.params;

import android.graphics.Point;
import android.graphics.Rect;

public final class Face
{
    public static final int ID_UNSUPPORTED = -1;
    public static final int SCORE_MIN = 1;
    public static final int SCORE_MAX = 100;

    private Rect mBounds;
    private int mScore;
    private int mId = ID_UNSUPPORTED;
    private Point mLeftEye;
    private Point mRightEye;
    private Point mMouth;

    private Face()
    {
    }

    public Rect getBounds()
    {
        return mBounds;
    }

    public int getScore()
    {
        return mScore;
    }

    public int getId()
    {
        return mId;
    }

    public Point getLeftEyePosition()
    {
        return mLeftEye;
    }

    public Point getRightEyePosition()
    {
        return mRightEye;
    }

    public Point getMouthPosition()
    {
        return mMouth;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return String.format("{ bounds: %s, score: %s, id: %d, leftEyePosition: %s, rightEyePosition: %s, mouthPosition: %s }",
                mBounds, mScore, mId, mLeftEye, mRightEye, mMouth);
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private static final long FIELD_BOUNDS = 1 << 1;
        private static final long FIELD_SCORE = 1 << 2;
        private static final long FIELD_BUILT = 1 << 0;

        private long mBuilderFieldsSet;
        private Rect mBounds;
        private int mScore;
        private int mId = ID_UNSUPPORTED;
        private Point mLeftEye;
        private Point mRightEye;
        private Point mMouth;

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public Builder(Face current)
        {
            if (current == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Null current face");
            mBounds = current.mBounds;
            mScore = current.mScore;
            mId = current.mId;
            mLeftEye = current.mLeftEye;
            mRightEye = current.mRightEye;
            mMouth = current.mMouth;
            mBuilderFieldsSet = FIELD_BOUNDS | FIELD_SCORE;
        }

        public Builder setBounds(Rect bounds)
        {
            checkNotUsed();
            mBuilderFieldsSet |= FIELD_BOUNDS;
            mBounds = bounds;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setScore(int score)
        {
            checkNotUsed();
            if (score < SCORE_MIN || score > SCORE_MAX) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Confidence out of range");
            mBuilderFieldsSet |= FIELD_SCORE;
            mScore = score;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setId(int id)
        {
            checkNotUsed();
            mId = id;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setLeftEyePosition(Point leftEyePosition)
        {
            checkNotUsed();
            mLeftEye = leftEyePosition;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setRightEyePosition(Point rightEyePosition)
        {
            checkNotUsed();
            mRightEye = rightEyePosition;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setMouthPosition(Point mouthPosition)
        {
            checkNotUsed();
            mMouth = mouthPosition;
            return this;
        }

        public Face build()
        {
            checkNotUsed();
            if ((mBuilderFieldsSet & FIELD_BOUNDS) == 0) throw new IllegalStateException("Field \"bounds\" must be set");
            if ((mBuilderFieldsSet & FIELD_SCORE) == 0) throw new IllegalStateException("Field \"score\" must be set");
            if (mId == ID_UNSUPPORTED && (mLeftEye != null || mRightEye != null || mMouth != null))
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("ID must be set if position is set");
            }
            if (mId != ID_UNSUPPORTED && mId < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Id out of range");

            mBuilderFieldsSet |= FIELD_BUILT;

            Face face = new Face();
            face.mBounds = mBounds;
            face.mScore = mScore;
            face.mId = mId;
            face.mLeftEye = mLeftEye;
            face.mRightEye = mRightEye;
            face.mMouth = mMouth;
            return face;
        }

        private void checkNotUsed()
        {
            if ((mBuilderFieldsSet & FIELD_BUILT) != 0)
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException("This Builder should not be reused. Use a new Builder instance instead");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/hardware/camera2/params/InputConfiguration.java`:

```java
package android.hardware.camera2.params;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class InputConfiguration
{
    private final int mWidth;
    private final int mHeight;
    private final int mFormat;
    private final boolean mIsMultiResolution;
    private final List<MultiResolutionStreamInfo> mMultiResolutionInputs = new ArrayList<>();

    public InputConfiguration(int width, int height, int format)
    {
        mWidth = width;
        mHeight = height;
        mFormat = format;
        mIsMultiResolution = false;
    }

    public InputConfiguration(Collection<MultiResolutionStreamInfo> multiResolutionInputs, int format)
    {
        if (multiResolutionInputs == null || multiResolutionInputs.isEmpty())
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Input multi-resolution stream info must not be empty");
        }

        int maxWidth = 0;
        int maxHeight = 0;
        for (MultiResolutionStreamInfo info : multiResolutionInputs)
        {
            if (mMultiResolutionInputs.contains(info)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate stream info");
            mMultiResolutionInputs.add(info);
            if ((long)info.getWidth() * info.getHeight() > (long)maxWidth * maxHeight)
            {
                maxWidth = info.getWidth();
                maxHeight = info.getHeight();
            }
        }
        mWidth = maxWidth;
        mHeight = maxHeight;
        mFormat = format;
        mIsMultiResolution = true;
    }

    public int getWidth()
    {
        return mWidth;
    }

    public int getHeight()
    {
        return mHeight;
    }

    public int getFormat()
    {
        return mFormat;
    }

    public boolean isMultiResolution()
    {
        return mIsMultiResolution;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof InputConfiguration)) return false;

        InputConfiguration configuration = (InputConfiguration)other;
        return configuration.mWidth == mWidth && configuration.mHeight == mHeight && configuration.mFormat == mFormat
                && configuration.mIsMultiResolution == mIsMultiResolution
                && configuration.mMultiResolutionInputs.equals(mMultiResolutionInputs);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mWidth, mHeight, mFormat, mIsMultiResolution);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return String.format("InputConfiguration(w:%d, h:%d, format:%d, isMultiResolution %b)", mWidth, mHeight, mFormat,
                mIsMultiResolution);
    }
}
```

`java/android/hardware/camera2/params/LensShadingMap.java`:

```java
package android.hardware.camera2.params;

import java.util.Arrays;

public final class LensShadingMap
{
    public static final float MINIMUM_GAIN_FACTOR = 1.0f;

    private final int mRows;
    private final int mColumns;
    private final float[] mElements;

    LensShadingMap(float[] elements, int rows, int columns)
    {
        if (rows <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("rows must be positive");
        if (columns <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("columns must be positive");
        if (elements == null) throw new NullPointerException("elements must not be null");
        if (elements.length != rows * columns * RggbChannelVector.COUNT)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("elements must be " + rows * columns * RggbChannelVector.COUNT + " length");
        }
        mRows = rows;
        mColumns = columns;
        mElements = elements;
    }

    public int getRowCount()
    {
        return mRows;
    }

    public int getColumnCount()
    {
        return mColumns;
    }

    public int getGainFactorCount()
    {
        return mRows * mColumns * RggbChannelVector.COUNT;
    }

    public float getGainFactor(int colorChannel, int column, int row)
    {
        if (colorChannel < 0 || colorChannel >= RggbChannelVector.COUNT) throw new IllegalArgumentException("colorChannel out of range");
        if (column < 0 || column >= mColumns) throw new IllegalArgumentException("column out of range");
        if (row < 0 || row >= mRows) throw new IllegalArgumentException("row out of range");

        return mElements[colorChannel + (row * mColumns + column) * RggbChannelVector.COUNT];
    }

    public RggbChannelVector getGainFactorVector(int column, int row)
    {
        if (column < 0 || column >= mColumns) throw new IllegalArgumentException("column out of range");
        if (row < 0 || row >= mRows) throw new IllegalArgumentException("row out of range");

        int offset = (row * mColumns + column) * RggbChannelVector.COUNT;
        return new RggbChannelVector(mElements[offset + RggbChannelVector.RED], mElements[offset + RggbChannelVector.GREEN_EVEN],
                mElements[offset + RggbChannelVector.GREEN_ODD], mElements[offset + RggbChannelVector.BLUE]);
    }

    public void copyGainFactors(float[] destination, int offset)
    {
        if (offset < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset must not be negative");
        if (destination == null) throw new NullPointerException("destination must not be null");
        if (destination.length + offset < getGainFactorCount())
        {
            throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException("destination too small to fit elements");
        }
        System.arraycopy(mElements, 0, destination, offset, getGainFactorCount());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof LensShadingMap)) return false;

        LensShadingMap map = (LensShadingMap)other;
        return mRows == map.mRows && mColumns == map.mColumns && Arrays.equals(mElements, map.mElements);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return 31 * (31 * mRows + mColumns) + Arrays.hashCode(mElements);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "LensShadingMap{rows=" + mRows + ", columns=" + mColumns + ", gains=" + Arrays.toString(mElements) + "}";
    }
}
```

```java
package android.hardware.camera2.params;

import android.graphics.Point;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.util.Size;

public final class MeteringRectangle
{
    public static final int METERING_WEIGHT_MIN = 0;
    public static final int METERING_WEIGHT_MAX = 1000;
    public static final int METERING_WEIGHT_DONT_CARE = 0;

    private final int mX;
    private final int mY;
    private final int mWidth;
    private final int mHeight;
    private final int mWeight;

    public MeteringRectangle(int x, int y, int width, int height, int meteringWeight)
    {
        mX = checkNonNegative(x, "x");
        mY = checkNonNegative(y, "y");
        mWidth = checkNonNegative(width, "width");
        mHeight = checkNonNegative(height, "height");
        mWeight = checkWeight(meteringWeight);
    }

    public MeteringRectangle(Point xy, Size dimensions, int meteringWeight)
    {
        if (xy == null) throw new NullPointerException("xy must not be null");
        if (dimensions == null) throw new NullPointerException("dimensions must not be null");
        mX = checkNonNegative(xy.x, "x");
        mY = checkNonNegative(xy.y, "y");
        mWidth = checkNonNegative(dimensions.getWidth(), "width");
        mHeight = checkNonNegative(dimensions.getHeight(), "height");
        mWeight = checkWeight(meteringWeight);
    }

    public MeteringRectangle(Rect rect, int meteringWeight)
    {
        if (rect == null) throw new NullPointerException("rect must not be null");
        mX = checkNonNegative(rect.left, "rect.left");
        mY = checkNonNegative(rect.top, "rect.top");
        mWidth = checkNonNegative(rect.width(), "rect.width");
        mHeight = checkNonNegative(rect.height(), "rect.height");
        mWeight = checkWeight(meteringWeight);
    }

    private static int checkNonNegative(int value, String name)
    {
        if (value < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " must not be negative");
        return value;
    }

    private static int checkWeight(int weight)
    {
        if (weight < METERING_WEIGHT_MIN || weight > METERING_WEIGHT_MAX)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("meteringWeight is out of range [" + METERING_WEIGHT_MIN + ", " + METERING_WEIGHT_MAX + "]");
        }
        return weight;
    }

    public int getX()
    {
        return mX;
    }

    public int getY()
    {
        return mY;
    }

    public int getWidth()
    {
        return mWidth;
    }

    public int getHeight()
    {
        return mHeight;
    }

    public int getMeteringWeight()
    {
        return mWeight;
    }

    public Point getUpperLeftPoint()
    {
        return new Point(mX, mY);
    }

    public Size getSize()
    {
        return new Size(mWidth, mHeight);
    }

    public Rect getRect()
    {
        return new Rect(mX, mY, mX + mWidth, mY + mHeight);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        return other instanceof MeteringRectangle && equals((MeteringRectangle)other);
    }

    public boolean equals(MeteringRectangle other)
    {
        if (other == null) return false;
        return mX == other.mX && mY == other.mY && mWidth == other.mWidth && mHeight == other.mHeight && mWeight == other.mWeight;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        int hash = mX;
        hash = 31 * hash + mY;
        hash = 31 * hash + mWidth;
        hash = 31 * hash + mHeight;
        return 31 * hash + mWeight;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return String.format("(x:%d, y:%d, w:%d, h:%d, wt:%d)", mX, mY, mWidth, mHeight, mWeight);
    }
}
```

`java/android/hardware/camera2/params/MultiResolutionStreamConfigurationMap.java`:

```java
package android.hardware.camera2.params;

import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public final class MultiResolutionStreamConfigurationMap
{
    private final Map<Integer, List<MultiResolutionStreamInfo>> mMultiResolutionOutputConfigs;
    private final Map<Integer, List<MultiResolutionStreamInfo>> mMultiResolutionInputConfigs;

    MultiResolutionStreamConfigurationMap(Map<Integer, List<MultiResolutionStreamInfo>> outputs,
            Map<Integer, List<MultiResolutionStreamInfo>> inputs)
    {
        mMultiResolutionOutputConfigs = outputs == null ? new HashMap<>() : new HashMap<>(outputs);
        mMultiResolutionInputConfigs = inputs == null ? new HashMap<>() : new HashMap<>(inputs);
    }

    public int[] getOutputFormats()
    {
        return toArray(mMultiResolutionOutputConfigs);
    }

    public int[] getInputFormats()
    {
        return toArray(mMultiResolutionInputConfigs);
    }

    public Collection<MultiResolutionStreamInfo> getOutputInfo(int format)
    {
        List<MultiResolutionStreamInfo> infos = mMultiResolutionOutputConfigs.get(format);
        if (infos == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("format " + format + " is not supported");
        return Collections.unmodifiableCollection(infos);
    }

    public Collection<MultiResolutionStreamInfo> getInputInfo(int format)
    {
        List<MultiResolutionStreamInfo> infos = mMultiResolutionInputConfigs.get(format);
        if (infos == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("format " + format + " is not supported");
        return Collections.unmodifiableCollection(infos);
    }

    private static int[] toArray(Map<Integer, List<MultiResolutionStreamInfo>> configs)
    {
        int[] formats = new int[configs.size()];
        int index = 0;
        for (Integer format : configs.keySet())
        {
            formats[index++] = format;
        }
        return formats;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof MultiResolutionStreamConfigurationMap)) return false;

        MultiResolutionStreamConfigurationMap map = (MultiResolutionStreamConfigurationMap)other;
        return mMultiResolutionOutputConfigs.equals(map.mMultiResolutionOutputConfigs)
                && mMultiResolutionInputConfigs.equals(map.mMultiResolutionInputConfigs);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return 31 * mMultiResolutionOutputConfigs.hashCode() + mMultiResolutionInputConfigs.hashCode();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "MultiResolutionStreamConfigurationMap(Outputs(" + mMultiResolutionOutputConfigs + "), Inputs("
                + mMultiResolutionInputConfigs + "))";
    }
}
```

```java
import android.hardware.camera2.CameraMetadata;

import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.Collections;

public final class OutputConfiguration implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int SURFACE_GROUP_ID_NONE = -1;

    public static final int MIRROR_MODE_AUTO = 0;
    public static final int MIRROR_MODE_NONE = 1;

    public static final int MIRROR_MODE_V = 3;

    private final ArrayList<Integer> mSensorPixelModesUsed = new ArrayList<>();

    private final long mUsage;

    private long mStreamUseCase = CameraMetadata.SCALER_AVAILABLE_STREAM_USE_CASES_DEFAULT;

    }

    public OutputConfiguration(int surfaceGroupId, Surface surface)
    {
```
