```java
        mSurfaces.add(surface);
        mSurfaceGroupId = surfaceGroupId;
        mSurfaceType = SURFACE_TYPE_UNKNOWN;
        mConfiguredSize = null;
        mConfiguredFormat = 0;
        mIsDeferredConfig = false;
        mUsage = 0;
    }

    public <T> OutputConfiguration(Size surfaceSize, Class<T> klass)
    {
        if (surfaceSize == null) throw new NullPointerException("surfaceSize must not be null");
        if (klass == null) throw new NullPointerException("klass must not be null");

        if ("android.graphics.SurfaceTexture".equals(klass.getName()))
        {
            mSurfaceType = SURFACE_TYPE_SURFACE_TEXTURE;
        }
        else if ("android.view.SurfaceHolder".equals(klass.getName()))
        {
            mSurfaceType = SURFACE_TYPE_SURFACE_VIEW;
        }
        else
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown surface source class type");
        }

        if (surfaceSize.getWidth() == 0 || surfaceSize.getHeight() == 0)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Surface size needs to be non-zero");
        }

        mSurfaceGroupId = SURFACE_GROUP_ID_NONE;
        mConfiguredSize = surfaceSize;
        mConfiguredFormat = 0x22;
        mIsDeferredConfig = true;
        mUsage = 0;
    }

    public OutputConfiguration(int format, Size surfaceSize)
    {
        this(SURFACE_GROUP_ID_NONE, format, surfaceSize, 0);
    }

    public OutputConfiguration(int surfaceGroupId, int format, Size surfaceSize)
    {
        this(surfaceGroupId, format, surfaceSize, 0);
    }

    public OutputConfiguration(int format, Size surfaceSize, long usage)
    {
        this(SURFACE_GROUP_ID_NONE, format, surfaceSize, usage);
    }

    public OutputConfiguration(int surfaceGroupId, int format, Size surfaceSize, long usage)
    {
        if (surfaceSize == null) throw new NullPointerException("surfaceSize must not be null");
        if (surfaceSize.getWidth() == 0 || surfaceSize.getHeight() == 0)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Surface size needs to be non-zero");
        }
        mSurfaceGroupId = surfaceGroupId;
        mSurfaceType = SURFACE_TYPE_IMAGE_READER;
        mConfiguredSize = surfaceSize;
        mConfiguredFormat = format;
        mIsDeferredConfig = true;
        mUsage = usage;
    }

    private OutputConfiguration(Parcel source)
    {
        mSurfaceGroupId = source.readInt();
        mSurfaceType = source.readInt();
        int width = source.readInt();
        int height = source.readInt();
        mConfiguredSize = width > 0 && height > 0 ? new Size(width, height) : null;
        mConfiguredFormat = source.readInt();
        mIsDeferredConfig = source.readInt() != 0;
        mUsage = source.readLong();
        mIsShared = source.readInt() != 0;
        mPhysicalCameraId = source.readString();
        mDynamicRangeProfile = source.readLong();
        mStreamUseCase = source.readLong();
        mTimestampBase = source.readInt();
        mMirrorMode = source.readInt();
        mReadoutTimestampEnabled = source.readInt() != 0;
    }

    public static List<OutputConfiguration> createInstancesForMultiResolutionOutput(Collection<MultiResolutionStreamInfo> streams,
            int format)
    {
        if (streams == null || streams.size() <= 1)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("The number of multi-resolution streams must be at least 2");
        }

        int groupId;
        synchronized (OutputConfiguration.class)
        {
            groupId = sNextMultiResolutionGroupId++;
        }

        List<OutputConfiguration> configurations = new ArrayList<>();
        for (MultiResolutionStreamInfo stream : streams)
        {
            OutputConfiguration configuration = new OutputConfiguration(groupId, format, new Size(stream.getWidth(), stream.getHeight()));
            configuration.setPhysicalCameraId(stream.getPhysicalCameraId());
            configurations.add(configuration);
        }
        return configurations;
    }

    public void enableSurfaceSharing()
    {
        mIsShared = true;
    }

    public void setPhysicalCameraId(String physicalCameraId)
    {
        mPhysicalCameraId = physicalCameraId;
    }

    public void addSensorPixelModeUsed(int sensorPixelModeUsed)
    {
        if (sensorPixelModeUsed != CameraMetadata.SENSOR_PIXEL_MODE_DEFAULT
                && sensorPixelModeUsed != CameraMetadata.SENSOR_PIXEL_MODE_MAXIMUM_RESOLUTION)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not a valid sensor pixel mode " + sensorPixelModeUsed);
        }
        if (mSensorPixelModesUsed.contains(sensorPixelModeUsed)) return;
        mSensorPixelModesUsed.add(sensorPixelModeUsed);
    }

    public void removeSensorPixelModeUsed(int sensorPixelModeUsed)
    {
        if (!mSensorPixelModesUsed.remove(Integer.valueOf(sensorPixelModeUsed)))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("sensorPixelMode " + sensorPixelModeUsed + "is not part of this output configuration");
        }
    }

    public void addSurface(Surface surface)
    {
        if (surface == null) throw new NullPointerException("Surface must not be null");
        if (mSurfaces.contains(surface)) throw new IllegalStateException("Surface is already added!");
        if (mSurfaces.size() == 1 && !mIsShared) throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot have 2 surfaces for a non-sharing configuration");
        if (mSurfaces.size() + 1 > MAX_SURFACES_COUNT) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exceeds maximum number of surfaces");
        mSurfaces.add(surface);
    }

    public void removeSurface(Surface surface)
    {
        if (getSurface() == surface) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot remove surface associated with this output configuration");
        if (!mSurfaces.remove(surface)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Surface is not part of this output configuration");
        mSurfaceMirrorModes.remove(surface);
    }

    public void setTimestampBase(int timestampBase)
    {
        if (timestampBase < TIMESTAMP_BASE_DEFAULT || timestampBase > TIMESTAMP_BASE_CHOREOGRAPHER_SYNCED)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not a valid timestamp base value " + timestampBase);
        }
        mTimestampBase = timestampBase;
    }

    public int getTimestampBase()
    {
        return mTimestampBase;
    }

    public void setMirrorMode(int mirrorMode)
    {
        checkMirrorMode(mirrorMode);
        mMirrorMode = mirrorMode;
    }

    public void setMirrorMode(Surface surface, int mirrorMode)
    {
        if (surface == null) throw new NullPointerException("Surface must not be null");
        checkMirrorMode(mirrorMode);
        if (!mSurfaces.contains(surface)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Surface not part of the OutputConfiguration");
        mSurfaceMirrorModes.put(surface, mirrorMode);
    }

    private static void checkMirrorMode(int mirrorMode)
    {
        if (mirrorMode < MIRROR_MODE_AUTO || mirrorMode > MIRROR_MODE_V)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not a valid mirror mode " + mirrorMode);
        }
    }

    public int getMirrorMode()
    {
        return mMirrorMode;
    }

    public int getMirrorMode(Surface surface)
    {
        if (surface == null) throw new NullPointerException("Surface must not be null");
        if (!mSurfaces.contains(surface)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Surface not part of the OutputConfiguration");
        Integer mode = mSurfaceMirrorModes.get(surface);
        return mode == null ? mMirrorMode : mode;
    }

    public void setReadoutTimestampEnabled(boolean on)
    {
        mReadoutTimestampEnabled = on;
    }

    public boolean isReadoutTimestampEnabled()
    {
        return mReadoutTimestampEnabled;
    }

    public void setDynamicRangeProfile(long profile)
    {
        mDynamicRangeProfile = profile;
    }

    public long getDynamicRangeProfile()
    {
        return mDynamicRangeProfile;
    }

    public void setStreamUseCase(long streamUseCase)
    {
        if (streamUseCase < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not a valid stream use case value " + streamUseCase);
        mStreamUseCase = streamUseCase;
    }

    public long getStreamUseCase()
    {
        return mStreamUseCase;
    }

    public int getMaxSharedSurfaceCount()
    {
        return MAX_SURFACES_COUNT;
    }

    public Surface getSurface()
    {
        return mSurfaces.isEmpty() ? null : mSurfaces.get(0);
    }

    public List<Surface> getSurfaces()
    {
        return Collections.unmodifiableList(mSurfaces);
    }

    public int getSurfaceGroupId()
    {
        return mSurfaceGroupId;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        if (dest == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dest must not be null");
        dest.writeInt(mSurfaceGroupId);
        dest.writeInt(mSurfaceType);
        dest.writeInt(mConfiguredSize == null ? 0 : mConfiguredSize.getWidth());
        dest.writeInt(mConfiguredSize == null ? 0 : mConfiguredSize.getHeight());
        dest.writeInt(mConfiguredFormat);
        dest.writeInt(mIsDeferredConfig ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeLong(mUsage);
        dest.writeInt(mIsShared ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeString(mPhysicalCameraId);
        dest.writeLong(mDynamicRangeProfile);
        dest.writeLong(mStreamUseCase);
        dest.writeInt(mTimestampBase);
        dest.writeInt(mMirrorMode);
        dest.writeInt(mReadoutTimestampEnabled ? 1 : 0);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof OutputConfiguration)) return false;

        OutputConfiguration configuration = (OutputConfiguration)other;
        return mSurfaceGroupId == configuration.mSurfaceGroupId && mSurfaceType == configuration.mSurfaceType
                && mConfiguredFormat == configuration.mConfiguredFormat && mIsDeferredConfig == configuration.mIsDeferredConfig
                && mIsShared == configuration.mIsShared && mUsage == configuration.mUsage
                && mDynamicRangeProfile == configuration.mDynamicRangeProfile && mStreamUseCase == configuration.mStreamUseCase
                && mTimestampBase == configuration.mTimestampBase && mMirrorMode == configuration.mMirrorMode
                && mReadoutTimestampEnabled == configuration.mReadoutTimestampEnabled
                && Objects.equals(mConfiguredSize, configuration.mConfiguredSize)
                && Objects.equals(mPhysicalCameraId, configuration.mPhysicalCameraId)
                && mSurfaces.equals(configuration.mSurfaces) && mSensorPixelModesUsed.equals(configuration.mSensorPixelModesUsed);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mSurfaceGroupId, mSurfaceType, mConfiguredSize, mConfiguredFormat, mIsDeferredConfig, mIsShared, mUsage,
                mPhysicalCameraId, mDynamicRangeProfile, mStreamUseCase, mTimestampBase, mMirrorMode, mReadoutTimestampEnabled, mSurfaces);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.hardware.camera2.params;

public final class RggbChannelVector
{
    public static final int COUNT = 4;
    public static final int RED = 0;
    public static final int GREEN_EVEN = 1;
    public static final int GREEN_ODD = 2;
    public static final int BLUE = 3;

    private final float mRed;
    private final float mGreenEven;
    private final float mGreenOdd;
    private final float mBlue;

    public RggbChannelVector(float red, float greenEven, float greenOdd, float blue)
    {
        mRed = checkFinite(red, "red");
        mGreenEven = checkFinite(greenEven, "greenEven");
        mGreenOdd = checkFinite(greenOdd, "greenOdd");
        mBlue = checkFinite(blue, "blue");
    }

    private static float checkFinite(float value, String name)
    {
        if (Float.isNaN(value)) throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " must not be NaN");
        if (Float.isInfinite(value)) throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " must not be infinite");
        return value;
    }

    public float getRed()
    {
        return mRed;
    }

    public float getGreenEven()
    {
        return mGreenEven;
    }

    public float getGreenOdd()
    {
        return mGreenOdd;
    }

    public float getBlue()
    {
        return mBlue;
    }

    public float getComponent(int colorChannel)
    {
        if (colorChannel < 0 || colorChannel >= COUNT) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Color channel out of range");

        switch (colorChannel)
        {
            case RED: return mRed;
            case GREEN_EVEN: return mGreenEven;
            case GREEN_ODD: return mGreenOdd;
            default: return mBlue;
        }
    }

    public void copyTo(float[] destination, int offset)
    {
        if (destination == null) throw new NullPointerException("destination must not be null");
        if (destination.length - offset < COUNT) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException("destination too small to fit elements");

        destination[offset + RED] = mRed;
        destination[offset + GREEN_EVEN] = mGreenEven;
        destination[offset + GREEN_ODD] = mGreenOdd;
        destination[offset + BLUE] = mBlue;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof RggbChannelVector)) return false;

        RggbChannelVector vector = (RggbChannelVector)other;
        return mRed == vector.mRed && mGreenEven == vector.mGreenEven && mGreenOdd == vector.mGreenOdd && mBlue == vector.mBlue;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Float.floatToIntBits(mRed) ^ Float.floatToIntBits(mGreenEven) ^ Float.floatToIntBits(mGreenOdd)
                ^ Float.floatToIntBits(mBlue);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "RggbChannelVector{R:" + mRed + ", G_even:" + mGreenEven + ", G_odd:" + mGreenOdd + ", B:" + mBlue + "}";
    }
}
```

```java
package android.hardware.camera2.params;

import android.graphics.ColorSpace;
import android.hardware.camera2.CameraCaptureSession;
import android.hardware.camera2.CaptureRequest;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;

public final class SessionConfiguration implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int SESSION_REGULAR = 0;
    public static final int SESSION_HIGH_SPEED = 1;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<SessionConfiguration> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<SessionConfiguration>()
    {
        @Override
        public SessionConfiguration createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int sessionType = source.readInt();
            int count = source.readInt();
            List<OutputConfiguration> outputs = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int index = 0; index < count; ++index)
            {
                outputs.add(OutputConfiguration.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source));
            }
            SessionConfiguration configuration = new SessionConfiguration(sessionType, outputs);
            int colorSpace = source.readInt();
            if (colorSpace >= 0) configuration.setColorSpace(ColorSpace.Named.values()[colorSpace]);
            return configuration;
        }

        @Override
        public SessionConfiguration[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new SessionConfiguration[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mSessionType;
    private final List<OutputConfiguration> mOutputConfigurations;
    private CameraCaptureSession.StateCallback mStateCallback;
    private Executor mExecutor;
    private InputConfiguration mInputConfig;
    private CaptureRequest mSessionParameters;
    private ColorSpace.Named mColorSpace;

    public SessionConfiguration(int sessionType, List<OutputConfiguration> outputs)
    {
        mSessionType = sessionType;
        mOutputConfigurations = outputs;
    }

    public SessionConfiguration(int sessionType, List<OutputConfiguration> outputs, Executor executor,
            CameraCaptureSession.StateCallback callback)
    {
        mSessionType = sessionType;
        mOutputConfigurations = outputs;
        mStateCallback = callback;
        mExecutor = executor;
    }

    public int getSessionType()
    {
        return mSessionType;
    }

    public List<OutputConfiguration> getOutputConfigurations()
    {
        return mOutputConfigurations;
    }

    public CameraCaptureSession.StateCallback getStateCallback()
    {
        return mStateCallback;
    }

    public Executor getExecutor()
    {
        return mExecutor;
    }

    public void setStateCallback(Executor executor, CameraCaptureSession.StateCallback callback)
    {
        mExecutor = executor;
        mStateCallback = callback;
    }

    public void setInputConfiguration(InputConfiguration input)
    {
        if (mSessionType == SESSION_HIGH_SPEED)
        {
            throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Method not supported for high speed session types");
        }
        mInputConfig = input;
    }

    public InputConfiguration getInputConfiguration()
    {
        return mInputConfig;
    }

    public void setSessionParameters(CaptureRequest params)
    {
        mSessionParameters = params;
    }

    public CaptureRequest getSessionParameters()
    {
        return mSessionParameters;
    }

    public void setColorSpace(ColorSpace.Named colorSpace)
    {
        mColorSpace = colorSpace;
    }

    public void clearColorSpace()
    {
        mColorSpace = null;
    }

    public ColorSpace getColorSpace()
    {
        return mColorSpace == null ? null : ColorSpace.get(mColorSpace);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        if (dest == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dest must not be null");
        dest.writeInt(mSessionType);
        dest.writeInt(mOutputConfigurations == null ? 0 : mOutputConfigurations.size());
        if (mOutputConfigurations != null)
        {
            for (OutputConfiguration output : mOutputConfigurations)
            {
                output.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
            }
        }
        dest.writeInt(mColorSpace == null ? -1 : mColorSpace.ordinal());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof SessionConfiguration)) return false;

        SessionConfiguration configuration = (SessionConfiguration)other;
        return mSessionType == configuration.mSessionType && mColorSpace == configuration.mColorSpace
                && Objects.equals(mInputConfig, configuration.mInputConfig)
                && Objects.equals(mOutputConfigurations, configuration.mOutputConfigurations);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mOutputConfigurations, mInputConfig, mSessionType, mColorSpace);
    }
}
```

`java/android/hardware/camera2/params/StreamConfigurationMap.java`:

```java
package android.hardware.camera2.params;

import android.util.Range;
import android.util.Size;
import android.view.Surface;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public final class StreamConfigurationMap
{
    private static final String[] SUPPORTED_OUTPUT_CLASSES = {
        "android.media.ImageReader",
        "android.media.MediaRecorder",
        "android.media.MediaCodec",
        "android.renderscript.Allocation",
        "android.view.SurfaceHolder",
        "android.graphics.SurfaceTexture"
    };

    private final Map<Integer, List<Size>> mOutputSizes;
    private final Map<Integer, List<Size>> mInputSizes;
    private final Map<Integer, int[]> mInputOutputFormats;
    private final Map<Size, List<Range<Integer>>> mHighSpeedVideoConfigurations;

    StreamConfigurationMap()
    {
        mOutputSizes = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        mInputSizes = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        mInputOutputFormats = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        mHighSpeedVideoConfigurations = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    }

    public int[] getOutputFormats()
    {
        return toFormats(mOutputSizes);
    }

    public int[] getValidOutputFormatsForInput(int inputFormat)
    {
        int[] formats = mInputOutputFormats.get(inputFormat);
        return formats == null ? new int[0] : Arrays.copyOf(formats, formats.length);
    }

    public int[] getInputFormats()
    {
        return toFormats(mInputSizes);
    }

    public Size[] getInputSizes(int format)
    {
        List<Size> sizes = mInputSizes.get(format);
        return sizes == null ? null : sizes.toArray(new Size[0]);
    }

    public boolean isOutputSupportedFor(int format)
    {
        return mOutputSizes.containsKey(format);
    }

    public static <T> boolean isOutputSupportedFor(Class<T> klass)
    {
        if (klass == null) throw new NullPointerException("klass must not be null");

        for (Class<?> current = klass; current != null; current = current.getSuperclass())
        {
            if (isSupportedClassName(current.getName())) return true;
            for (Class<?> implemented : current.getInterfaces())
            {
                if (isSupportedClassName(implemented.getName())) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean isSupportedClassName(String name)
    {
        for (String supported : SUPPORTED_OUTPUT_CLASSES)
        {
            if (supported.equals(name)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isOutputSupportedFor(Surface surface)
    {
        if (surface == null) throw new NullPointerException("surface must not be null");
        return false;
    }

    public Size[] getHighSpeedVideoSizes()
    {
        return mHighSpeedVideoConfigurations.keySet().toArray(new Size[0]);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public Range<Integer>[] getHighSpeedVideoFpsRangesFor(Size size)
    {
        List<Range<Integer>> ranges = mHighSpeedVideoConfigurations.get(size);
        if (ranges == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException(String.format("Size %s does not support high speed video recording", size));
        return ranges.toArray(new Range[0]);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public Range<Integer>[] getHighSpeedVideoFpsRanges()
    {
        List<Range<Integer>> ranges = new ArrayList<>();
        for (List<Range<Integer>> sizeRanges : mHighSpeedVideoConfigurations.values())
        {
            for (Range<Integer> range : sizeRanges)
            {
                if (!ranges.contains(range)) ranges.add(range);
            }
        }
        return ranges.toArray(new Range[0]);
    }

    public Size[] getHighSpeedVideoSizesFor(Range<Integer> fpsRange)
    {
        List<Size> sizes = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Map.Entry<Size, List<Range<Integer>>> entry : mHighSpeedVideoConfigurations.entrySet())
        {
            if (entry.getValue().contains(fpsRange)) sizes.add(entry.getKey());
        }
        if (sizes.isEmpty())
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(String.format("FpsRange %s does not support high speed video recording", fpsRange));
        }
        return sizes.toArray(new Size[0]);
    }

    public Size[] getHighResolutionOutputSizes(int format)
    {
        return mOutputSizes.containsKey(format) ? new Size[0] : null;
    }

    public long getOutputMinFrameDuration(int format, Size size)
    {
        checkOutput(format, size);
        return 0;
    }

    public <T> long getOutputMinFrameDuration(Class<T> klass, Size size)
    {
        if (!isOutputSupportedFor(klass)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("klass was not supported");
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("size was not supported");
    }

    public long getOutputStallDuration(int format, Size size)
    {
        checkOutput(format, size);
        return 0;
    }

    public <T> long getOutputStallDuration(Class<T> klass, Size size)
    {
        if (!isOutputSupportedFor(klass)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("klass was not supported");
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("size was not supported");
    }

    public <T> Size[] getOutputSizes(Class<T> klass)
    {
        if (!isOutputSupportedFor(klass)) return null;
        return new Size[0];
    }

    public Size[] getOutputSizes(int format)
    {
        List<Size> sizes = mOutputSizes.get(format);
        return sizes == null ? null : sizes.toArray(new Size[0]);
    }

    private void checkOutput(int format, Size size)
    {
        if (size == null) throw new NullPointerException("size must not be null");
        List<Size> sizes = mOutputSizes.get(format);
        if (sizes == null)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(String.format("format %x is not supported by this stream configuration map", format));
        }
        if (!sizes.contains(size)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("size was not supported");
    }

    private static int[] toFormats(Map<Integer, List<Size>> sizes)
    {
        int[] formats = new int[sizes.size()];
        int index = 0;
        for (Integer format : sizes.keySet())
        {
            formats[index++] = format;
        }
        return formats;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof StreamConfigurationMap)) return false;

        StreamConfigurationMap map = (StreamConfigurationMap)other;
        return mOutputSizes.equals(map.mOutputSizes) && mInputSizes.equals(map.mInputSizes)
                && mHighSpeedVideoConfigurations.equals(map.mHighSpeedVideoConfigurations);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return 31 * (31 * mOutputSizes.hashCode() + mInputSizes.hashCode()) + mHighSpeedVideoConfigurations.hashCode();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "StreamConfiguration(Outputs(" + mOutputSizes + "), Inputs(" + mInputSizes + "), ValidOutputFormatsForInput("
                + mInputOutputFormats.keySet() + "), HighSpeedVideoConfigurations(" + mHighSpeedVideoConfigurations + "))";
    }
}
```

`java/android/hardware/camera2/params/TonemapCurve.java`:

```java
package android.hardware.camera2.params;

import android.graphics.PointF;

import java.util.Arrays;

public final class TonemapCurve
{
    public static final float LEVEL_BLACK = 0.0f;
    public static final float LEVEL_WHITE = 1.0f;
    public static final int POINT_SIZE = 2;
    public static final int CHANNEL_RED = 0;
    public static final int CHANNEL_GREEN = 1;
    public static final int CHANNEL_BLUE = 2;

    private static final int OFFSET_POINT_IN = 0;
    private static final int OFFSET_POINT_OUT = 1;
    private static final int TONEMAP_MIN_CURVE_POINTS = 2;
    private static final int MIN_CURVE_LENGTH = TONEMAP_MIN_CURVE_POINTS * POINT_SIZE;

    private final float[] mRed;
    private final float[] mGreen;
    private final float[] mBlue;

    public TonemapCurve(float[] red, float[] green, float[] blue)
    {
        if (red == null) throw new NullPointerException("red must not be null");
        if (green == null) throw new NullPointerException("green must not be null");
        if (blue == null) throw new NullPointerException("blue must not be null");

        checkCurve(red, "red");
        checkCurve(green, "green");
        checkCurve(blue, "blue");

        mRed = Arrays.copyOf(red, red.length);
        mGreen = Arrays.copyOf(green, green.length);
        mBlue = Arrays.copyOf(blue, blue.length);
    }

    private static void checkCurve(float[] curve, String name)
    {
        if (curve.length % POINT_SIZE != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " array length must be divisible by " + POINT_SIZE);
        if (curve.length < MIN_CURVE_LENGTH)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " array length must be at least " + MIN_CURVE_LENGTH);
        }
        for (float value : curve)
        {
            if (value < LEVEL_BLACK || value > LEVEL_WHITE) throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " values must be in [0.0, 1.0]");
        }
    }

    private float[] getCurve(int colorChannel)
    {
        switch (colorChannel)
        {
            case CHANNEL_RED: return mRed;
            case CHANNEL_GREEN: return mGreen;
            case CHANNEL_BLUE: return mBlue;
            default: throw new IllegalArgumentException("colorChannel out of range");
        }
    }

    public int getPointCount(int colorChannel)
    {
        return getCurve(colorChannel).length / POINT_SIZE;
    }

    public PointF getPoint(int colorChannel, int index)
    {
        float[] curve = getCurve(colorChannel);
        if (index < 0 || index >= curve.length / POINT_SIZE) throw new IllegalArgumentException("index out of range");

        return new PointF(curve[index * POINT_SIZE + OFFSET_POINT_IN], curve[index * POINT_SIZE + OFFSET_POINT_OUT]);
    }

    public void copyColorCurve(int colorChannel, float[] destination, int offset)
    {
        if (offset < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset must not be negative");
        if (destination == null) throw new NullPointerException("destination must not be null");

        float[] curve = getCurve(colorChannel);
        if (destination.length + offset < curve.length) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException("destination too small to fit elements");
        System.arraycopy(curve, 0, destination, offset, curve.length);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof TonemapCurve)) return false;

        TonemapCurve curve = (TonemapCurve)other;
        return Arrays.equals(mRed, curve.mRed) && Arrays.equals(mGreen, curve.mGreen) && Arrays.equals(mBlue, curve.mBlue);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return 31 * (31 * Arrays.hashCode(mRed) + Arrays.hashCode(mGreen)) + Arrays.hashCode(mBlue);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "TonemapCurve{R:" + curveToString(mRed) + ", G:" + curveToString(mGreen) + ", B:" + curveToString(mBlue) + "}";
    }

    private static String curveToString(float[] curve)
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder("[");
        for (int index = 0; index < curve.length; index += POINT_SIZE)
        {
            if (index > 0) builder.append(", ");
            builder.append("(").append(curve[index]).append(", ").append(curve[index + 1]).append(")");
        }
        return builder.append("]").toString();
    }
}
```

`java/android/hardware/display/DisplayManager.java`:

```java
package android.hardware.display;

import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.Display;
import android.view.Surface;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;

public final class DisplayManager
{
    public static final String DISPLAY_CATEGORY_PRESENTATION = "android.hardware.display.category.PRESENTATION";

    public static final long EVENT_TYPE_DISPLAY_ADDED = 1L;
    public static final long EVENT_TYPE_DISPLAY_REMOVED = 2L;
    public static final long EVENT_TYPE_DISPLAY_CHANGED = 4L;
    public static final long EVENT_TYPE_DISPLAY_REFRESH_RATE = 8L;
    public static final long EVENT_TYPE_DISPLAY_STATE = 16L;

    public static final int MATCH_CONTENT_FRAMERATE_UNKNOWN = -1;
    public static final int MATCH_CONTENT_FRAMERATE_NEVER = 0;
    public static final int MATCH_CONTENT_FRAMERATE_SEAMLESSS_ONLY = 1;
    public static final int MATCH_CONTENT_FRAMERATE_ALWAYS = 2;

    public static final int VIRTUAL_DISPLAY_FLAG_PUBLIC = 1;
    public static final int VIRTUAL_DISPLAY_FLAG_PRESENTATION = 2;
    public static final int VIRTUAL_DISPLAY_FLAG_SECURE = 4;
    public static final int VIRTUAL_DISPLAY_FLAG_OWN_CONTENT_ONLY = 8;
    public static final int VIRTUAL_DISPLAY_FLAG_AUTO_MIRROR = 16;

    public interface DisplayListener
    {
        void onDisplayAdded(int displayId);

        void onDisplayRemoved(int displayId);

        void onDisplayChanged(int displayId);
    }

    private static final List<VirtualDisplay> sVirtualDisplays = new ArrayList<>();
    private static final List<ListenerRecord> sListeners = new ArrayList<>();
    private static int sNextVirtualDisplayId = 2;

    private final android.content.Context mContext;

    private Display mDisplay;

    public DisplayManager(android.content.Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public Display getDisplay(int displayId)
    {
        if (displayId != Display.DEFAULT_DISPLAY)
        {
            synchronized (sVirtualDisplays)
            {
                for (VirtualDisplay virtualDisplay : sVirtualDisplays)
                {
                    if (virtualDisplay.getDisplay().getDisplayId() == displayId) return virtualDisplay.getDisplay();
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        if (mDisplay == null)
        {
            runtime.WindowBridge bridge = runtime.WindowBridge.get();

            int width = bridge == null ? 1280 : bridge.getWidth();
            int height = bridge == null ? 720 : bridge.getHeight();
            int densityDpi = android.util.DisplayMetrics.DENSITY_DEFAULT;

            if (mContext != null && mContext.getResources() != null)
            {
                densityDpi = mContext.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().densityDpi;
            }

            mDisplay = new Display(Display.DEFAULT_DISPLAY, "acl", width, height, densityDpi);
        }

        return mDisplay;
    }

    public Display[] getDisplays()
    {
        return getDisplays(null);
    }

    public Display[] getDisplays(String category)
    {
        boolean presentation = DISPLAY_CATEGORY_PRESENTATION.equals(category);
        List<Display> displays = new ArrayList<>();

        Display display = getDisplay(Display.DEFAULT_DISPLAY);
        if (display != null && !presentation) displays.add(display);

        synchronized (sVirtualDisplays)
        {
            for (VirtualDisplay virtualDisplay : sVirtualDisplays)
            {
                if (presentation && (virtualDisplay.getFlags() & VIRTUAL_DISPLAY_FLAG_PRESENTATION) == 0) continue;
                displays.add(virtualDisplay.getDisplay());
            }
        }

        return displays.toArray(new Display[0]);
    }

    public VirtualDisplay createVirtualDisplay(String name, int width, int height, int densityDpi, Surface surface, int flags)
    {
        return createVirtualDisplay(name, width, height, densityDpi, surface, flags, null, null);
    }

    public VirtualDisplay createVirtualDisplay(String name, int width, int height, int densityDpi, Surface surface, int flags,
        VirtualDisplay.Callback callback, Handler handler)
    {
        if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("name must be non-null and non-empty");
        if (width <= 0 || height <= 0 || densityDpi <= 0)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("width, height, and densityDpi must be greater than 0");
        }

        VirtualDisplay virtualDisplay;
        synchronized (sVirtualDisplays)
        {
            Display display = new Display(sNextVirtualDisplayId++, name, width, height, densityDpi);
            virtualDisplay = new VirtualDisplay(this, display, surface, flags, callback, handler);
            sVirtualDisplays.add(virtualDisplay);
        }

        notifyListeners(virtualDisplay.getDisplay().getDisplayId(), EVENT_TYPE_DISPLAY_ADDED);
        return virtualDisplay;
    }

    void onVirtualDisplayChanged(VirtualDisplay virtualDisplay)
    {
        notifyListeners(virtualDisplay.getDisplay().getDisplayId(), EVENT_TYPE_DISPLAY_CHANGED);
    }

    void onVirtualDisplayReleased(VirtualDisplay virtualDisplay)
    {
        synchronized (sVirtualDisplays)
        {
            sVirtualDisplays.remove(virtualDisplay);
        }

        notifyListeners(virtualDisplay.getDisplay().getDisplayId(), EVENT_TYPE_DISPLAY_REMOVED);
    }

    private static void notifyListeners(int displayId, long eventType)
    {
        List<ListenerRecord> records;
        synchronized (sListeners)
        {
            records = new ArrayList<>(sListeners);
        }

        for (ListenerRecord record : records)
        {
            if ((record.mEventMask & eventType) == 0) continue;

            Runnable notification = () ->
            {
                if (eventType == EVENT_TYPE_DISPLAY_ADDED) record.mListener.onDisplayAdded(displayId);
                else if (eventType == EVENT_TYPE_DISPLAY_REMOVED) record.mListener.onDisplayRemoved(displayId);
                else record.mListener.onDisplayChanged(displayId);
            };

            if (record.mExecutor != null) record.mExecutor.execute(notification);
            else if (record.mHandler != null) record.mHandler.post(notification);
            else new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post(notification);
        }
    }

    public int getMatchContentFrameRateUserPreference()
    {
        return MATCH_CONTENT_FRAMERATE_SEAMLESSS_ONLY;
    }

    public void registerDisplayListener(DisplayListener listener, Handler handler)
    {
        registerListener(listener, handler, null, EVENT_TYPE_DISPLAY_ADDED | EVENT_TYPE_DISPLAY_REMOVED | EVENT_TYPE_DISPLAY_CHANGED);
    }

    public void registerDisplayListener(Executor executor, long eventFilter, DisplayListener listener)
    {
        if (executor == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("executor must not be null");
        registerListener(listener, null, executor, eventFilter);
    }

    private void registerListener(DisplayListener listener, Handler handler, Executor executor, long eventMask)
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener must not be null");

        synchronized (sListeners)
        {
            for (ListenerRecord record : sListeners) if (record.mListener == listener) return;
            sListeners.add(new ListenerRecord(listener, handler, executor, eventMask));
        }
    }

    public void unregisterDisplayListener(DisplayListener listener)
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener must not be null");

        synchronized (sListeners)
        {
            for (int index = sListeners.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
            {
                if (sListeners.get(index).mListener == listener) sListeners.remove(index);
            }
        }
    }

    private static final class ListenerRecord
    {
        final DisplayListener mListener;
        final Handler mHandler;
        final Executor mExecutor;
        final long mEventMask;

        ListenerRecord(DisplayListener listener, Handler handler, Executor executor, long eventMask)
        {
            mListener = listener;
            mHandler = handler;
            mExecutor = executor;
            mEventMask = eventMask;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/hardware/display/VirtualDisplay.java`:

```java
package android.hardware.display;

import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.Display;
import android.view.Surface;

public final class VirtualDisplay
{
    private static final int CALLBACK_PAUSED = 0;
    private static final int CALLBACK_RESUMED = 1;
    private static final int CALLBACK_STOPPED = 2;

    private final DisplayManager mDisplayManager;
    private final int mFlags;
    private final Callback mCallback;
    private final Handler mHandler;
    private Display mDisplay;
    private Surface mSurface;
    private boolean mReleased;
    private int mRotation;

    VirtualDisplay(DisplayManager displayManager, Display display, Surface surface, int flags, Callback callback, Handler handler)
    {
        mDisplayManager = displayManager;
        mDisplay = display;
        mSurface = surface;
        mFlags = flags;
        mCallback = callback;
        mHandler = handler != null ? handler : new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

        if (surface != null) dispatch(CALLBACK_RESUMED);
    }

    private void dispatch(int event)
    {
        if (mCallback == null) return;

        mHandler.post(() ->
        {
            if (event == CALLBACK_PAUSED) mCallback.onPaused();
            else if (event == CALLBACK_RESUMED) mCallback.onResumed();
            else mCallback.onStopped();
        });
    }

    public Display getDisplay()
    {
        return mDisplay;
    }

    public Surface getSurface()
    {
        return mSurface;
    }

    public void setSurface(Surface surface)
    {
        if (mReleased || surface == mSurface) return;

        boolean hadSurface = mSurface != null;
        mSurface = surface;
        if (hadSurface && surface == null) dispatch(CALLBACK_PAUSED);
        else if (!hadSurface && surface != null) dispatch(CALLBACK_RESUMED);
    }

    public void resize(int width, int height, int densityDpi)
    {
        if (mReleased) return;

        mDisplay = new Display(mDisplay.getDisplayId(), mDisplay.getName(), width, height, densityDpi);
        mDisplayManager.onVirtualDisplayChanged(this);
    }

    public void setRotation(int rotation)
    {
        mRotation = rotation;
    }

    int getFlags()
    {
        return mFlags;
    }

    public void release()
    {
        if (mReleased) return;

        mReleased = true;
        mDisplayManager.onVirtualDisplayReleased(this);
        dispatch(CALLBACK_STOPPED);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "VirtualDisplay{display=" + mDisplay.getDisplayId() + ", name=" + mDisplay.getName() + ", surface=" + mSurface
            + ", rotation=" + mRotation + "}";
    }

    public abstract static class Callback
    {
        public Callback()
        {
        }

        public void onPaused()
        {
        }

        public void onResumed()
        {
        }

        public void onStopped()
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.hardware.usb;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.Objects;

public class UsbAccessory implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<UsbAccessory> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<UsbAccessory>()
    {
        @Override
        public UsbAccessory createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            String manufacturer = source.readString();
            String model = source.readString();
            String description = source.readString();
            String version = source.readString();
            String uri = source.readString();
            String serial = source.readString();
            return new UsbAccessory(manufacturer, model, description, version, uri, serial);
        }

        @Override
        public UsbAccessory[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new UsbAccessory[size];
        }
```

```java
package android.hardware.usb;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public class UsbConfiguration implements Parcelable
{
    private static final int ATTR_SELF_POWERED = 1 << 6;
    private static final int ATTR_REMOTE_WAKEUP = 1 << 5;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<UsbConfiguration> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<UsbConfiguration>()
    {
        @Override
        public UsbConfiguration createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int id = source.readInt();
            String name = source.readString();
            int attributes = source.readInt();
            int maxPower = source.readInt();
            int count = source.readInt();
            UsbInterface[] interfaces = new UsbInterface[count];
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) interfaces[index] = UsbInterface.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            return new UsbConfiguration(id, name, attributes, maxPower, interfaces);
        }

        @Override
        public UsbConfiguration[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new UsbConfiguration[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mId;
    private final String mName;
    private final int mAttributes;
    private final int mMaxPower;
    private final UsbInterface[] mInterfaces;

    UsbConfiguration(int id, String name, int attributes, int maxPower, UsbInterface[] interfaces)
    {
        mId = id;
        mName = name;
        mAttributes = attributes;
        mMaxPower = maxPower;
        mInterfaces = interfaces == null ? new UsbInterface[0] : interfaces;
    }

    public int getId()
    {
        return mId;
    }

    public String getName()
    {
        return mName;
    }

    public boolean isSelfPowered()
    {
        return (mAttributes & ATTR_SELF_POWERED) != 0;
    }

    public boolean isRemoteWakeup()
    {
        return (mAttributes & ATTR_REMOTE_WAKEUP) != 0;
    }

    public int getMaxPower()
    {
        return mMaxPower * 2;
    }

    public int getInterfaceCount()
    {
        return mInterfaces.length;
    }

    public UsbInterface getInterface(int index)
    {
        return mInterfaces[index];
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "UsbConfiguration[mId=" + mId + ",mName=" + mName + ",mAttributes=" + mAttributes + ",mMaxPower=" + mMaxPower
            + ",mInterfaces=" + mInterfaces.length + "]";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mId);
        dest.writeString(mName);
        dest.writeInt(mAttributes);
        dest.writeInt(mMaxPower);
        dest.writeInt(mInterfaces.length);
        for (UsbInterface usbInterface : mInterfaces) usbInterface.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.hardware.usb;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class UsbDevice implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<UsbDevice> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<UsbDevice>()
    {
        @Override
        public UsbDevice createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            String name = source.readString();
            int vendorId = source.readInt();
            int productId = source.readInt();
            int deviceClass = source.readInt();
            int subclass = source.readInt();
            int protocol = source.readInt();
            String manufacturerName = source.readString();
            String productName = source.readString();
            String version = source.readString();
            String serialNumber = source.readString();
            int count = source.readInt();
            UsbConfiguration[] configurations = new UsbConfiguration[count];
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) configurations[index] = UsbConfiguration.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            return new UsbDevice(name, vendorId, productId, deviceClass, subclass, protocol, manufacturerName, productName, version,
                serialNumber, configurations);
        }

        @Override
        public UsbDevice[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new UsbDevice[size];
        }
    };

    private final String mName;
    private final int mVendorId;
    private final int mProductId;
    private final int mClass;
    private final int mSubclass;
    private final int mProtocol;
    private final String mManufacturerName;
    private final String mProductName;
    private final String mVersion;
    private final String mSerialNumber;
    private final UsbConfiguration[] mConfigurations;
    private final UsbInterface[] mInterfaces;

    UsbDevice(String name, int vendorId, int productId, int deviceClass, int subclass, int protocol, String manufacturerName,
        String productName, String version, String serialNumber, UsbConfiguration[] configurations)
    {
        mName = name;
        mVendorId = vendorId;
        mProductId = productId;
        mClass = deviceClass;
        mSubclass = subclass;
        mProtocol = protocol;
        mManufacturerName = manufacturerName;
        mProductName = productName;
        mVersion = version;
        mSerialNumber = serialNumber;
        mConfigurations = configurations == null ? new UsbConfiguration[0] : configurations;

        List<UsbInterface> interfaces = new ArrayList<>();
        for (UsbConfiguration configuration : mConfigurations)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < configuration.getInterfaceCount(); index++) interfaces.add(configuration.getInterface(index));
        }
        mInterfaces = interfaces.toArray(new UsbInterface[0]);
    }

    public String getDeviceName()
    {
        return mName;
    }

    public String getManufacturerName()
    {
        return mManufacturerName;
    }

    public String getProductName()
    {
        return mProductName;
    }

    public String getVersion()
    {
        return mVersion;
    }

    public String getSerialNumber()
    {
        return mSerialNumber;
    }

    public int getDeviceId()
    {
        return getDeviceId(mName);
    }

    public int getVendorId()
    {
        return mVendorId;
    }

    public int getProductId()
    {
        return mProductId;
    }

    public int getDeviceClass()
    {
        return mClass;
    }

    public int getDeviceSubclass()
    {
        return mSubclass;
    }

    public int getDeviceProtocol()
    {
        return mProtocol;
    }

    public int getConfigurationCount()
    {
        return mConfigurations.length;
    }

    public UsbConfiguration getConfiguration(int index)
    {
        return mConfigurations[index];
    }

    public int getInterfaceCount()
    {
        return mInterfaces.length;
    }

    public UsbInterface getInterface(int index)
    {
        return mInterfaces[index];
    }

    public static int getDeviceId(String name)
    {
        if (name == null || !name.startsWith("/dev/bus/usb/")) return -1;

        String[] parts = name.substring("/dev/bus/usb/".length()).split("/");
        if (parts.length != 2) return -1;

        try
        {
            return Integer.parseInt(parts[0]) * 1000 + Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException exception)
        {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    public static String getDeviceName(int id)
    {
        return String.format("/dev/bus/usb/%03d/%03d", id / 1000, id % 1000);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (other instanceof UsbDevice) return ((UsbDevice)other).mName.equals(mName);
        if (other instanceof String) return other.equals(mName);
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mName.hashCode();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "UsbDevice[mName=" + mName + ",mVendorId=" + mVendorId + ",mProductId=" + mProductId + ",mClass=" + mClass
            + ",mSubclass=" + mSubclass + ",mProtocol=" + mProtocol + ",mManufacturerName=" + mManufacturerName + ",mProductName="
            + mProductName + ",mVersion=" + mVersion + ",mSerialNumber=" + mSerialNumber + "]";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mName);
        dest.writeInt(mVendorId);
        dest.writeInt(mProductId);
        dest.writeInt(mClass);
        dest.writeInt(mSubclass);
        dest.writeInt(mProtocol);
        dest.writeString(mManufacturerName);
        dest.writeString(mProductName);
        dest.writeString(mVersion);
        dest.writeString(mSerialNumber);
        dest.writeInt(mConfigurations.length);
        for (UsbConfiguration configuration : mConfigurations) configuration.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
    }
}
```

```java
public class UsbInterface implements Parcelable

    {
        @Override

        {
            int id = source.readInt();
            int alternateSetting = source.readInt();

            int interfaceClass = source.readInt();
            int subclass = source.readInt();
            int protocol = source.readInt();
            int count = source.readInt();

            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) endpoints[index] = UsbEndpoint.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);

    {
```

```java
    public static final String ACTION_USB_ACCESSORY_ATTACHED = "android.hardware.usb.action.USB_ACCESSORY_ATTACHED";
    public static final String ACTION_USB_ACCESSORY_DETACHED = "android.hardware.usb.action.USB_ACCESSORY_DETACHED";
    public static final String EXTRA_DEVICE = "device";
    public static final String EXTRA_ACCESSORY = "accessory";
    public static final String EXTRA_PERMISSION_GRANTED = "permission";

    private final Context mContext;

        mContext = context;
    }

        return null;

    {
        if (accessory == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("accessory cannot be null");
        return null;
    }

    public boolean hasPermission(UsbDevice device)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean hasPermission(UsbAccessory accessory)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void requestPermission(UsbDevice device, PendingIntent pendingIntent)
    {
        Intent extras = new Intent();
        extras.putExtra(EXTRA_DEVICE, device);
        extras.putExtra(EXTRA_PERMISSION_GRANTED, false);
        sendPermissionResult(pendingIntent, extras);
    }

    public void requestPermission(UsbAccessory accessory, PendingIntent pendingIntent)
    {
        Intent extras = new Intent();
        extras.putExtra(EXTRA_ACCESSORY, accessory);
        extras.putExtra(EXTRA_PERMISSION_GRANTED, false);
        sendPermissionResult(pendingIntent, extras);
    }

    private void sendPermissionResult(PendingIntent pendingIntent, Intent extras)
    {
        if (pendingIntent == null) return;

        try
        {
            pendingIntent.send(mContext, 0, extras);
        }
        catch (PendingIntent.CanceledException exception)
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```java
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.ComponentCallbacks;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.res.Configuration;

public abstract class AbstractInputMethodService extends Service implements KeyEvent.Callback
{

    public abstract class AbstractInputMethodImpl implements InputMethod
    {
        public AbstractInputMethodImpl()
        {
        }

        @Override
        public void createSession(SessionCallback callback)
        {
            if (callback != null) callback.sessionCreated(onCreateInputMethodSessionInterface());
        }

        @Override
        public void setSessionEnabled(InputMethodSession session, boolean enabled)
        {
            if (session instanceof AbstractInputMethodSessionImpl) ((AbstractInputMethodSessionImpl)session).setEnabled(enabled);
        }

        @Override
        public void revokeSession(InputMethodSession session)
        {
            if (session instanceof AbstractInputMethodSessionImpl) ((AbstractInputMethodSessionImpl)session).revokeSelf();
        }
    }

    public abstract class AbstractInputMethodSessionImpl implements InputMethodSession
    {
        private boolean mEnabled = true;
        private boolean mRevoked;

        public AbstractInputMethodSessionImpl()
        {
        }

        public boolean isEnabled()
        {
            return mEnabled;
        }

        public boolean isRevoked()
        {
            return mRevoked;
        }

        public void setEnabled(boolean enabled)
        {
            if (!mRevoked) mEnabled = enabled;
        }

        public void revokeSelf()
        {
            mRevoked = true;
            mEnabled = false;
        }

        @Override
        public void dispatchKeyEvent(int seq, KeyEvent event, EventCallback callback)
        {
            boolean handled = event.dispatch(AbstractInputMethodService.this, mDispatcherState, this);
            if (callback != null) callback.finishedEvent(seq, handled);
        }

        @Override
        public void dispatchTrackballEvent(int seq, MotionEvent event, EventCallback callback)
        {
            boolean handled = onTrackballEvent(event);
            if (callback != null) callback.finishedEvent(seq, handled);
        }

        @Override
        public void dispatchGenericMotionEvent(int seq, MotionEvent event, EventCallback callback)
        {
            boolean handled = onGenericMotionEvent(event);
            if (callback != null) callback.finishedEvent(seq, handled);
        }

        public boolean onShouldVerifyKeyEvent(KeyEvent event)
        {
            return AbstractInputMethodService.this.onShouldVerifyKeyEvent(event);
        }
    }

    public KeyEvent.DispatcherState getKeyDispatcherState()
    {
        return mDispatcherState;
    }

    public abstract AbstractInputMethodImpl onCreateInputMethodInterface();

    public abstract AbstractInputMethodSessionImpl onCreateInputMethodSessionInterface();

    InputMethod inputMethod()
    {
        if (mInputMethod == null) mInputMethod = onCreateInputMethodInterface();
        return mInputMethod;
    }

    @Override
    protected void dump(FileDescriptor descriptor, PrintWriter writer, String[] arguments)
    {
    }

    @Override
    public final IBinder onBind(Intent intent)
    {
        inputMethod();
        if (mBinder == null) mBinder = new android.os.Binder();
        return mBinder;
    }

    public boolean onTrackballEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean onGenericMotionEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean onShouldVerifyKeyEvent(KeyEvent event)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public Object getSystemService(String name)
    {
        return super.getSystemService(name);
    }

    @Override
    public void onConfigurationChanged(Configuration newConfiguration)
    {
        super.onConfigurationChanged(newConfiguration);
    }

    @Override
    public void onLowMemory()
    {
        super.onLowMemory();
    }

    @Override
    public void onTrimMemory(int level)
    {
        super.onTrimMemory(level);
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy()
    {
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    @Override
    public void registerComponentCallbacks(ComponentCallbacks callback)
    {
        super.registerComponentCallbacks(callback);
    }

    @Override
    public void unregisterComponentCallbacks(ComponentCallbacks callback)
    {
        super.unregisterComponentCallbacks(callback);
    }
}
```

```java
    public static final int BACK_DISPOSITION_WILL_NOT_DISMISS = 1;
    public static final int BACK_DISPOSITION_WILL_DISMISS = 2;
    public static final int BACK_DISPOSITION_ADJUST_NOTHING = 3;

    private static final String TAG = "InputMethodService";
    private static final Duration STYLUS_HANDWRITING_IDLE_TIMEOUT = Duration.ofSeconds(10);
    private static final Duration STYLUS_HANDWRITING_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MAX = Duration.ofMinutes(3);

    public static final class Insets

    public class InputMethodImpl extends AbstractInputMethodImpl
    {
        public InputMethodImpl()
        {
        }

        @Override
        public void attachToken(IBinder token)
        {
            if (mToken != null) throw new IllegalStateException("attachToken() must be called at most once");

            mToken = token;
        }

        @Override
        public void bindInput(InputBinding binding)
        {
            mInputBinding = binding;
            mInputConnection = binding == null ? null : binding.getConnection();
            onBindInput();
        }

        @Override
        public void unbindInput()
        {
            onUnbindInput();
            mInputBinding = null;
            mInputConnection = null;
        }

        @Override
        public void startInput(InputConnection inputConnection, EditorInfo editorInfo)
        {
            doStartInput(inputConnection, editorInfo, false);
        }

        @Override
        public void restartInput(InputConnection inputConnection, EditorInfo editorInfo)
        {
            doStartInput(inputConnection, editorInfo, true);
        }

        @Override
        public void showSoftInput(int flags, ResultReceiver resultReceiver)
        {
            boolean wasVisible = isInputViewShown();
            if (dispatchOnShowInputRequested(flags, false)) showWindow(true);

            if (resultReceiver == null) return;

            boolean visible = isInputViewShown();
            int result = visible ? (wasVisible ? InputMethodManager.RESULT_UNCHANGED_SHOWN : InputMethodManager.RESULT_SHOWN)
                                 : (wasVisible ? InputMethodManager.RESULT_HIDDEN : InputMethodManager.RESULT_UNCHANGED_HIDDEN);
            resultReceiver.send(result, null);
        }

        @Override
        public void hideSoftInput(int flags, ResultReceiver resultReceiver)
        {
            boolean wasVisible = isInputViewShown();
            mShowInputRequested = false;
            hideWindow();

            if (resultReceiver != null)
            {
                resultReceiver.send(wasVisible ? InputMethodManager.RESULT_HIDDEN : InputMethodManager.RESULT_UNCHANGED_HIDDEN, null);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void changeInputMethodSubtype(InputMethodSubtype subtype)
        {
            onCurrentInputMethodSubtypeChanged(subtype);
        }
    }

        public InputMethodSessionImpl()

    @Override
    public void onCreate()
    {
        super.onCreate();

        mWindow = new Dialog(this, mTheme);
        mRootView = new LinearLayout(this);
        mRootView.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);

        mExtractFrame = new FrameLayout(this);
        mExtractFrame.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        mCandidatesFrame = new FrameLayout(this);
        mCandidatesVisibility = getCandidatesHiddenVisibility();
        mCandidatesFrame.setVisibility(mCandidatesVisibility);
        mInputFrame = new FrameLayout(this);
        mInputFrame.setVisibility(View.GONE);

        LinearLayout.LayoutParams fill = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f);
        mRootView.addView(mExtractFrame, fill);
        mRootView.addView(mCandidatesFrame, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                                                                           ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        mRootView.addView(mInputFrame, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                                                                      ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        mWindow.setContentView(mRootView);
        Window window = mWindow.getWindow();
        if (window != null) window.setGravity(Gravity.BOTTOM);

        initViews();
    }

    private void initViews()
    {
        mInitialized = false;
        mViewsCreated = false;
        mShowInputRequested = false;
        mExtractView = null;
        mCandidatesView = null;
        mInputView = null;
        mExtractFrame.removeAllViews();
        mCandidatesFrame.removeAllViews();
        mInputFrame.removeAllViews();
    }

    private void initialize()
    {
        if (mInitialized) return;

        mInitialized = true;
        onInitializeInterface();
    }

    public void onInitializeInterface()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy()
    {
        hideWindow();
        if (mWindow != null) mWindow.dismiss();
        mWindow = null;
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    @Override
    public void onConfigurationChanged(Configuration newConfiguration)
    {
        super.onConfigurationChanged(newConfiguration);

        if (mWindow == null) return;

        boolean visible = mWindowVisible;
        boolean showingInput = mShowInputRequested;
        boolean candidatesVisible = mCandidatesVisibility == View.VISIBLE;
        EditorInfo editorInfo = mInputEditorInfo;

        finishViews(false);
        initViews();

        if (!visible) return;

        if (showingInput)
        {
            if (onShowInputRequested(0, true)) showWindow(true);
            else hideWindow();
        }
        else if (candidatesVisible)
        {
            showWindow(false);
        }
        else
        {
            hideWindow();
        }

        if (editorInfo != null && mInputStarted) onUpdateExtractingVisibility(editorInfo);
    }

    public void setBackDisposition(int disposition)
    {
        if (disposition == mBackDisposition) return;

        if (disposition < BACK_DISPOSITION_DEFAULT || disposition > BACK_DISPOSITION_ADJUST_NOTHING)
        {
            android.util.Log.e(TAG, "invalid back disposition value (" + disposition + ") specified");
            return;

    public void updateFullscreenMode()
    {
        boolean fullscreen = mShowInputRequested && onEvaluateFullscreenMode();
        boolean changed = mIsFullscreen != fullscreen || !mViewsCreated;

        if (changed)
        {
            mIsFullscreen = fullscreen;

            if (fullscreen && mExtractView == null)
            {
                View extract = onCreateExtractTextView();
                if (extract != null) setExtractView(extract);
            }
        }

        if (mWindow != null && mWindow.getWindow() != null)
        {
            onConfigureWindow(mWindow.getWindow(), fullscreen, !mShowInputRequested);
        }

        if (changed && mInputEditorInfo != null) onUpdateExtractingVisibility(mInputEditorInfo);
    }

    public void onConfigureWindow(Window window, boolean isFullscreen, boolean isCandidatesOnly)
    {
        int height = isFullscreen ? ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT : ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        window.setLayout(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, height);
    }

    public boolean isFullscreenMode()
    {
        return mIsFullscreen;
    }

    public boolean onEvaluateFullscreenMode()
    {
        Configuration configuration = getResources().getConfiguration();
        if (configuration.orientation != Configuration.ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE) return false;
        if (mInputEditorInfo != null && (mInputEditorInfo.imeOptions & EditorInfo.IME_FLAG_NO_FULLSCREEN) != 0) return false;

        return true;
    }

    public void setExtractViewShown(boolean shown)
    {
        if (mExtractViewShown == shown) return;

        mExtractViewShown = shown;
        if (mExtractFrame != null) mExtractFrame.setVisibility(shown && mIsFullscreen ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
    }

    public boolean isExtractViewShown()
    {
        return mIsFullscreen && mExtractViewShown;
    }

    public void onComputeInsets(Insets outInsets)
    {
        if (mRootView == null || !mWindowVisible)
        {
            int height = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().heightPixels;
            outInsets.contentTopInsets = height;
            outInsets.visibleTopInsets = height;
            outInsets.touchableInsets = Insets.TOUCHABLE_INSETS_FRAME;
            outInsets.touchableRegion.setEmpty();
            return;
        }

        int[] location = new int[2];
        View top = isInputViewShown() ? mInputFrame : mCandidatesFrame;
        top.getLocationInWindow(location);

        outInsets.contentTopInsets = isFullscreenMode() ? mRootView.getHeight() : location[1];

        if (mCandidatesFrame.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE)
        {
            mCandidatesFrame.getLocationInWindow(location);
        }

        outInsets.visibleTopInsets = location[1];
        outInsets.touchableInsets = Insets.TOUCHABLE_INSETS_VISIBLE;
        outInsets.touchableRegion.setEmpty();
    }

    public void updateInputViewShown()
    {
        boolean shown = mShowInputRequested && onEvaluateInputViewShown();
        if (mIsInputViewShown == shown || !mWindowVisible) return;

        mIsInputViewShown = shown;
        mInputFrame.setVisibility(shown ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);

        if (mInputView != null) return;

        initialize();
        View view = onCreateInputView();
        if (view != null) setInputView(view);
    }

    public boolean isShowInputRequested()
    {
        return mShowInputRequested;
    }

    public boolean isInputViewShown()
    {
        return mWindowVisible && mIsInputViewShown;
    }

    public boolean onEvaluateInputViewShown()
    {
        Configuration configuration = getResources().getConfiguration();
        return configuration.keyboard == Configuration.KEYBOARD_NOKEYS
               || configuration.hardKeyboardHidden == Configuration.HARDKEYBOARDHIDDEN_YES;
    }

    public void setCandidatesViewShown(boolean shown)
    {
        updateCandidatesVisibility(shown);

        if (mShowInputRequested || mWindowVisible == shown) return;

        if (shown) showWindow(false);
        else hideWindow();

    private void updateCandidatesVisibility(boolean shown)
    {
        int visibility = shown ? View.VISIBLE : getCandidatesHiddenVisibility();
        if (mCandidatesVisibility == visibility) return;

        mCandidatesVisibility = visibility;
        if (mCandidatesFrame != null) mCandidatesFrame.setVisibility(visibility);
    }
```
