```java
    private boolean dispatchOnShowInputRequested(int flags, boolean configChange)
    {
        boolean result = onShowInputRequested(flags, configChange);
        mShowInputRequested = result;
        return result;
    }

    public boolean onShowInputRequested(int flags, boolean configChange)
    {
        if (!onEvaluateInputViewShown()) return false;
        if ((flags & InputMethod.SHOW_EXPLICIT) != 0) return true;
        if (!configChange && onEvaluateFullscreenMode() && !isInputViewShown()) return false;

        Configuration configuration = getResources().getConfiguration();
        return configChange || configuration.keyboard == Configuration.KEYBOARD_NOKEYS;
    }

    public void showWindow(boolean showInput)
    {
        if (mInShowWindow || mWindow == null) return;

        mInShowWindow = true;

        try
        {
            boolean wasVisible = mWindowVisible;
            mWindowVisible = true;

            if (!mShowInputRequested && mInputStarted && showInput) mShowInputRequested = true;

            initialize();
            updateFullscreenMode();
            updateInputViewShown();

            if (!mViewsCreated)
            {
                mViewsCreated = true;
                initialize();
                View candidates = onCreateCandidatesView();
                if (candidates != null) setCandidatesView(candidates);
            }

            if (mShowInputRequested)
            {
                if (!mInputViewStarted)
                {
                    mInputViewStarted = true;
                    onStartInputView(mInputEditorInfo, false);
                }
            }
            else if (!mCandidatesViewStarted)
            {
                mCandidatesViewStarted = true;
                onStartCandidatesView(mInputEditorInfo, false);
            }

            if (!wasVisible)
            {
                onWindowShown();
                mWindow.show();
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            mInShowWindow = false;
        }
    }

    public void hideWindow()
    {
        finishViews(false);

        if (!mWindowVisible) return;

        if (mWindow != null) mWindow.hide();
        mWindowVisible = false;
        mIsInputViewShown = false;
        if (mInputFrame != null) mInputFrame.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        onWindowHidden();
    }

    private void finishViews(boolean finishingInput)
    {
        if (mInputViewStarted) onFinishInputView(finishingInput);
        else if (mCandidatesViewStarted) onFinishCandidatesView(finishingInput);

        mInputViewStarted = false;
        mCandidatesViewStarted = false;
    }

    public void onWindowShown()
    {
    }

    public void onWindowHidden()
    {
    }

    private void doFinishInput()
    {
        finishViews(true);

        if (mInputStarted) onFinishInput();

        mInputStarted = false;
        mStartedInputConnection = null;
    }

    private void doStartInput(InputConnection connection, EditorInfo attribute, boolean restarting)
    {
        if (!restarting && mInputStarted) doFinishInput();

        mInputStarted = true;
        mStartedInputConnection = connection;
        mInputEditorInfo = attribute;

        initialize();
        onStartInput(attribute, restarting);

        if (!mWindowVisible) return;

        if (mShowInputRequested)
        {
            mInputViewStarted = true;
            onStartInputView(mInputEditorInfo, restarting);
        }
        else if (mCandidatesVisibility == View.VISIBLE)
        {
            mCandidatesViewStarted = true;
            onStartCandidatesView(mInputEditorInfo, restarting);
        }
    }

    public void onAppPrivateCommand(String action, Bundle data)
    {
    }

    protected void onCurrentInputMethodSubtypeChanged(InputMethodSubtype newSubtype)
    {
    }

    @Deprecated
    public int getInputMethodWindowRecommendedHeight()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onKeyDown(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        if (event.getKeyCode() != KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK) return false;
        if (!handleBack(false)) return false;

        event.startTracking();
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onKeyLongPress(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onKeyMultiple(int keyCode, int count, KeyEvent event)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onKeyUp(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        if (event.getKeyCode() != KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK) return false;
        if (!event.isTracking() || event.isCanceled()) return false;

        return handleBack(true);
    }

    private boolean handleBack(boolean doIt)
    {
        if (!mWindowVisible) return false;
        if (mBackDisposition == BACK_DISPOSITION_WILL_NOT_DISMISS) return false;

        if (isInputViewShown() || mCandidatesVisibility == View.VISIBLE)
        {
            if (doIt)
            {
                if (isInputViewShown()) requestHideSelf(0);
                else setCandidatesViewShown(false);
            }

            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onTrackballEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onGenericMotionEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onShouldVerifyKeyEvent(KeyEvent event)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void sendDownUpKeyEvents(int keyEventCode)
    {
        InputConnection connection = getCurrentInputConnection();
        if (connection == null) return;

        long eventTime = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        int flags = KeyEvent.FLAG_SOFT_KEYBOARD | KeyEvent.FLAG_KEEP_TOUCH_MODE;
        connection.sendKeyEvent(new KeyEvent(eventTime, eventTime, KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN, keyEventCode, 0, 0,
                                             KeyCharacterMap.VIRTUAL_KEYBOARD, 0, flags));
        connection.sendKeyEvent(new KeyEvent(eventTime, SystemClock.uptimeMillis(), KeyEvent.ACTION_UP, keyEventCode, 0, 0,
                                             KeyCharacterMap.VIRTUAL_KEYBOARD, 0, flags));
    }

    public boolean sendDefaultEditorAction(boolean fromEnterKey)
    {
        EditorInfo info = getCurrentInputEditorInfo();
        if (info == null) return false;
        if (fromEnterKey && (info.imeOptions & EditorInfo.IME_FLAG_NO_ENTER_ACTION) != 0) return false;

        int action = info.imeOptions & EditorInfo.IME_MASK_ACTION;
        if (action == EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_NONE) return false;

        InputConnection connection = getCurrentInputConnection();
        if (connection != null) connection.performEditorAction(action);
        return true;
    }

    public void sendKeyChar(char charCode)
    {
        if (charCode == '\n')
        {
            if (!sendDefaultEditorAction(true)) sendDownUpKeyEvents(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER);
            return;
        }

        if (charCode >= '0' && charCode <= '9')
        {
            sendDownUpKeyEvents(charCode - '0' + KeyEvent.KEYCODE_0);
            return;
        }

        InputConnection connection = getCurrentInputConnection();
        if (connection != null) connection.commitText(String.valueOf(charCode), 1);
    }

    public void onExtractedSelectionChanged(int start, int end)
    {
        InputConnection connection = getCurrentInputConnection();
        if (connection != null) connection.setSelection(start, end);
    }

    public void onExtractedTextClicked()
    {
        if (mInputEditorInfo == null) return;

        if (isExtractViewShown() && isFullscreenMode()) setCandidatesViewShown(false);
    }

    public void onExtractedCursorMovement(int dx, int dy)
    {
        if (dy != 0 && isExtractViewShown()) setCandidatesViewShown(false);
    }

    public boolean onExtractTextContextMenuItem(int id)
    {
        InputConnection connection = getCurrentInputConnection();
        if (connection != null) connection.performContextMenuAction(id);
        return true;
    }

    public CharSequence getTextForImeAction(int imeOptions)
    {
        switch (imeOptions & EditorInfo.IME_MASK_ACTION)
        {
            case EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_NONE:
                return null;
            case EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_GO:
                return "Go";
            case EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_SEARCH:
                return "Search";
            case EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_SEND:
                return "Send";
            case EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_NEXT:
                return "Next";
            case EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_DONE:
                return "Done";
            case EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_PREVIOUS:
                return "Previous";
            default:
                return "Execute";
        }
    }

    public void onUpdateExtractingVisibility(EditorInfo editorInfo)
    {
        if (editorInfo.inputType == InputType.TYPE_NULL || (editorInfo.imeOptions & EditorInfo.IME_FLAG_NO_EXTRACT_UI) != 0)
        {
            setExtractViewShown(false);
            return;
        }

        setExtractViewShown(true);
    }

    public void onUpdateExtractingViews(EditorInfo editorInfo)
    {
        if (!isExtractViewShown()) return;

        onUpdateExtractingVisibility(editorInfo);
    }

    public void onExtractingInputChanged(EditorInfo editorInfo)
    {
        if (editorInfo.inputType == InputType.TYPE_NULL) requestHideSelf(InputMethodManager.HIDE_NOT_ALWAYS);
    }

    @Override
    public Object getSystemService(String name)
    {
        return super.getSystemService(name);
    }

    @Override
    protected void dump(FileDescriptor descriptor, PrintWriter writer, String[] arguments)
    {
        writer.println("Input method service state for " + this + ":");
        writer.println("  mViewsCreated=" + mViewsCreated + " mWindowVisible=" + mWindowVisible);
        writer.println("  mInputStarted=" + mInputStarted + " mInputViewStarted=" + mInputViewStarted
                       + " mCandidatesViewStarted=" + mCandidatesViewStarted);
        writer.println("  mInputEditorInfo=" + mInputEditorInfo);
        writer.println("  mShowInputRequested=" + mShowInputRequested + " mIsInputViewShown=" + mIsInputViewShown
                       + " mIsFullscreen=" + mIsFullscreen);
        writer.println("  mCandidatesVisibility=" + mCandidatesVisibility + " mBackDisposition=" + mBackDisposition
                       + " mStatusIcon=" + mStatusIcon);
        writer.println("  mExtractViewShown=" + mExtractViewShown + " mHandwritingRegion=" + mHandwritingRegion);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.location;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;

public class Address implements Parcelable
{
    private Locale mLocale;
    private String mFeatureName;
    private HashMap<Integer, String> mAddressLines;
    private int mMaxAddressLineIndex = -1;
    private String mAdminArea;
    private String mSubAdminArea;
    private String mLocality;
    private String mSubLocality;
    private String mThoroughfare;
    private String mSubThoroughfare;
    private String mPremises;
    private String mPostalCode;
    private String mCountryCode;
    private String mCountryName;
    private double mLatitude;
    private double mLongitude;
    private boolean mHasLatitude;
    private boolean mHasLongitude;
    private String mPhone;
    private String mUrl;
    private Bundle mExtras;

    public Address(Locale locale)
    {
        mLocale = locale;
    }

    public Locale getLocale()
    {
        return mLocale;
    }

    public int getMaxAddressLineIndex()
    {
        return mMaxAddressLineIndex;
    }

    public String getAddressLine(int index)
    {
        if (index < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("index = " + index + " < 0");

        return mAddressLines == null ? null : mAddressLines.get(index);
    }

    public void setAddressLine(int index, String line)
    {
        if (index < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("index = " + index + " < 0");

        if (mAddressLines == null) mAddressLines = new HashMap<>();
        mAddressLines.put(index, line);

        if (line == null)
        {
            mMaxAddressLineIndex = -1;
            for (Map.Entry<Integer, String> entry : mAddressLines.entrySet())
            {
                if (entry.getValue() != null) mMaxAddressLineIndex = Math.max(mMaxAddressLineIndex, entry.getKey());
            }
        }
        else
        {
            mMaxAddressLineIndex = Math.max(mMaxAddressLineIndex, index);
        }
    }

    public String getFeatureName()
    {
        return mFeatureName;
    }

    public void setFeatureName(String featureName)
    {
        mFeatureName = featureName;
    }

    public String getAdminArea()
    {
        return mAdminArea;
    }

    public void setAdminArea(String adminArea)
    {
        mAdminArea = adminArea;
    }

    public String getSubAdminArea()
    {
        return mSubAdminArea;
    }

    public void setSubAdminArea(String subAdminArea)
    {
        mSubAdminArea = subAdminArea;
    }

    public String getLocality()
    {
        return mLocality;
    }

    public void setLocality(String locality)
    {
        mLocality = locality;
    }

    public String getSubLocality()
    {
        return mSubLocality;
    }

        mSubLocality = subLocality;

        return mThoroughfare;

        mThoroughfare = thoroughfare;

        return mSubThoroughfare;

    public void setSubThoroughfare(String subThoroughfare)
    {
        mSubThoroughfare = subThoroughfare;
    }

    public String getPremises()
    {
        return mPremises;
    }

    public void setPremises(String premises)
    {
        mPremises = premises;
    }

    public String getPostalCode()
    {
        return mPostalCode;
    }

    public void setPostalCode(String postalCode)
    {
        mPostalCode = postalCode;
    }

    public String getCountryCode()

        return mCountryCode;
    }

    public void setCountryCode(String countryCode)
    {
        mCountryCode = countryCode;
    }

    public String getCountryName()

        return mCountryName;
    }

    public void setCountryName(String countryName)
    {
        mCountryName = countryName;
    }

    public boolean hasLatitude()
    {
        return mHasLatitude;
    }

    public double getLatitude()
    {
        if (!mHasLatitude) throw new IllegalStateException();

        return mLatitude;
    }

    public void setLatitude(double latitude)
    {
        mLatitude = latitude;
        mHasLatitude = true;
    }

    {

        mUrl = url;

    {
        mExtras = extras == null ? null : new Bundle(extras);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        builder.append("Address[addressLines=[");

        for (int index = 0; index <= mMaxAddressLineIndex; index++)
        {
            if (index > 0) builder.append(',');
            builder.append(index).append(':');

            String line = mAddressLines.get(index);
            if (line == null) builder.append("null");
            else builder.append('"').append(line).append('"');
        }

        builder.append(']');
        builder.append(",feature=").append(mFeatureName);
        builder.append(",admin=").append(mAdminArea);
        builder.append(",sub-admin=").append(mSubAdminArea);
        builder.append(",locality=").append(mLocality);
        builder.append(",thoroughfare=").append(mThoroughfare);
        builder.append(",postalCode=").append(mPostalCode);
        builder.append(",countryCode=").append(mCountryCode);
        builder.append(",countryName=").append(mCountryName);
        builder.append(",hasLatitude=").append(mHasLatitude);
        builder.append(",latitude=").append(mLatitude);
        builder.append(",hasLongitude=").append(mHasLongitude);
        builder.append(",longitude=").append(mLongitude);
        builder.append(",phone=").append(mPhone);
        builder.append(",url=").append(mUrl);
        builder.append(",extras=").append(mExtras);
        builder.append(']');
        return builder.toString();
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        parcel.writeString(mLocale.getLanguage());
        parcel.writeString(mLocale.getCountry());

        int count = mMaxAddressLineIndex + 1;
        parcel.writeInt(count);

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            parcel.writeString(mAddressLines.get(index));
        }

        parcel.writeString(mFeatureName);
        parcel.writeString(mAdminArea);
        parcel.writeString(mSubAdminArea);
        parcel.writeString(mLocality);
        parcel.writeString(mSubLocality);
        parcel.writeString(mThoroughfare);
        parcel.writeString(mSubThoroughfare);
        parcel.writeString(mPremises);
        parcel.writeString(mPostalCode);
        parcel.writeString(mCountryCode);
        parcel.writeString(mCountryName);
        parcel.writeInt(mHasLatitude ? 1 : 0);
        parcel.writeLong(Double.doubleToRawLongBits(mLatitude));
        parcel.writeInt(mHasLongitude ? 1 : 0);
        parcel.writeLong(Double.doubleToRawLongBits(mLongitude));
        parcel.writeString(mPhone);
        parcel.writeString(mUrl);
        parcel.writeBundle(mExtras);
    }

    public static final Creator<Address> CREATOR = new Creator<Address>()
    {
        @Override
        public Address createFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
        {
            String language = parcel.readString();
            String country = parcel.readString();
            Locale locale = country.length() > 0 ? new Locale(language, country) : new Locale(language);
            Address address = new Address(locale);

            int count = parcel.readInt();
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                address.setAddressLine(index, parcel.readString());
            }

            address.mFeatureName = parcel.readString();
            address.mAdminArea = parcel.readString();
            address.mSubAdminArea = parcel.readString();
            address.mLocality = parcel.readString();
            address.mSubLocality = parcel.readString();
            address.mThoroughfare = parcel.readString();
            address.mSubThoroughfare = parcel.readString();
            address.mPremises = parcel.readString();
            address.mPostalCode = parcel.readString();
            address.mCountryCode = parcel.readString();
            address.mCountryName = parcel.readString();
            address.mHasLatitude = parcel.readInt() != 0;
            address.mLatitude = Double.longBitsToDouble(parcel.readLong());
            address.mHasLongitude = parcel.readInt() != 0;
            address.mLongitude = Double.longBitsToDouble(parcel.readLong());
            address.mPhone = parcel.readString();
            address.mUrl = parcel.readString();
            address.mExtras = parcel.readBundle();
            return address;
        }

        @Override
        public Address[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Address[size];
        }
    };
}
```

```java
package android.location;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public class Criteria implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int NO_REQUIREMENT = 0;
    public static final int POWER_LOW = 1;
    public static final int POWER_MEDIUM = 2;
    public static final int POWER_HIGH = 3;
    public static final int ACCURACY_FINE = 1;
    public static final int ACCURACY_COARSE = 2;
    public static final int ACCURACY_LOW = 1;
    public static final int ACCURACY_MEDIUM = 2;
    public static final int ACCURACY_HIGH = 3;

    private int mHorizontalAccuracy = NO_REQUIREMENT;
    private int mVerticalAccuracy = NO_REQUIREMENT;
    private int mSpeedAccuracy = NO_REQUIREMENT;
    private int mBearingAccuracy = NO_REQUIREMENT;
    private int mPowerRequirement = NO_REQUIREMENT;
    private boolean mAltitudeRequired;
    private boolean mBearingRequired;
    private boolean mSpeedRequired;
    private boolean mCostAllowed;

    public Criteria()
    {
    }

    public Criteria(Criteria criteria)
    {
        mHorizontalAccuracy = criteria.mHorizontalAccuracy;
        mVerticalAccuracy = criteria.mVerticalAccuracy;
        mSpeedAccuracy = criteria.mSpeedAccuracy;
        mBearingAccuracy = criteria.mBearingAccuracy;
        mPowerRequirement = criteria.mPowerRequirement;
        mAltitudeRequired = criteria.mAltitudeRequired;
        mBearingRequired = criteria.mBearingRequired;
        mSpeedRequired = criteria.mSpeedRequired;
        mCostAllowed = criteria.mCostAllowed;
    }

    public void setHorizontalAccuracy(int accuracy)
    {
        if (accuracy < NO_REQUIREMENT || accuracy > ACCURACY_HIGH) throw new IllegalArgumentException("accuracy=" + accuracy);

        mHorizontalAccuracy = accuracy;
    }

    public int getHorizontalAccuracy()
    {
        return mHorizontalAccuracy;
    }

    public void setVerticalAccuracy(int accuracy)
    {
        if (accuracy < NO_REQUIREMENT || accuracy > ACCURACY_HIGH) throw new IllegalArgumentException("accuracy=" + accuracy);

        mVerticalAccuracy = accuracy;
    }

    public int getVerticalAccuracy()
    {
        return mVerticalAccuracy;
    }

    public void setSpeedAccuracy(int accuracy)
    {
        if (accuracy < NO_REQUIREMENT || accuracy > ACCURACY_HIGH) throw new IllegalArgumentException("accuracy=" + accuracy);

        mSpeedAccuracy = accuracy;
    }

    public int getSpeedAccuracy()
    {
        return mSpeedAccuracy;
    }

    public void setBearingAccuracy(int accuracy)
    {
        if (accuracy < NO_REQUIREMENT || accuracy > ACCURACY_HIGH) throw new IllegalArgumentException("accuracy=" + accuracy);

        mBearingAccuracy = accuracy;
    }

    public int getBearingAccuracy()
    {
        return mBearingAccuracy;
    }

    public void setAccuracy(int accuracy)
    {
        if (accuracy < NO_REQUIREMENT || accuracy > ACCURACY_COARSE) throw new IllegalArgumentException("accuracy=" + accuracy);

        if (accuracy == ACCURACY_FINE) mHorizontalAccuracy = ACCURACY_HIGH;
        else mHorizontalAccuracy = ACCURACY_LOW;
    }

    public int getAccuracy()
    {
        if (mHorizontalAccuracy >= ACCURACY_HIGH) return ACCURACY_FINE;

        return ACCURACY_COARSE;
    }

    public void setPowerRequirement(int level)
    {
        if (level < NO_REQUIREMENT || level > POWER_HIGH) throw new IllegalArgumentException("level=" + level);

        mPowerRequirement = level;
    }

    public int getPowerRequirement()
    {
        return mPowerRequirement;
    }

    public void setCostAllowed(boolean costAllowed)
    {
        mCostAllowed = costAllowed;
    }

    public boolean isCostAllowed()
    {
        return mCostAllowed;
    }

    public void setAltitudeRequired(boolean altitudeRequired)
    {
        mAltitudeRequired = altitudeRequired;
    }

    public boolean isAltitudeRequired()
    {
        return mAltitudeRequired;
    }

    public void setSpeedRequired(boolean speedRequired)
    {
        mSpeedRequired = speedRequired;
    }

    public boolean isSpeedRequired()
    {
        return mSpeedRequired;
    }

    public void setBearingRequired(boolean bearingRequired)
    {
        mBearingRequired = bearingRequired;
    }

    public boolean isBearingRequired()
    {
        return mBearingRequired;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        parcel.writeInt(mHorizontalAccuracy);
        parcel.writeInt(mVerticalAccuracy);
        parcel.writeInt(mSpeedAccuracy);
        parcel.writeInt(mBearingAccuracy);
        parcel.writeInt(mPowerRequirement);
        parcel.writeInt(mAltitudeRequired ? 1 : 0);
        parcel.writeInt(mBearingRequired ? 1 : 0);
        parcel.writeInt(mSpeedRequired ? 1 : 0);
        parcel.writeInt(mCostAllowed ? 1 : 0);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Criteria[power=" + mPowerRequirement + ", accuracy=" + mHorizontalAccuracy + "]";
    }

    public static final Creator<Criteria> CREATOR = new Creator<Criteria>()
    {
        @Override
        public Criteria createFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
        {
            Criteria criteria = new Criteria();
            criteria.mHorizontalAccuracy = parcel.readInt();
            criteria.mVerticalAccuracy = parcel.readInt();
            criteria.mSpeedAccuracy = parcel.readInt();
            criteria.mBearingAccuracy = parcel.readInt();
            criteria.mPowerRequirement = parcel.readInt();
            criteria.mAltitudeRequired = parcel.readInt() != 0;
            criteria.mBearingRequired = parcel.readInt() != 0;
            criteria.mSpeedRequired = parcel.readInt() != 0;
            criteria.mCostAllowed = parcel.readInt() != 0;
            return criteria;
        }

        @Override
        public Criteria[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Criteria[size];
        }
    };
```

```java
package android.location;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

public final class Geocoder
{
    private final Context mContext;
    private final Locale mLocale;

    public Geocoder(Context context)
    {
        this(context, Locale.getDefault());
    }

    public Geocoder(Context context, Locale locale)
    {
        if (locale == null) throw new NullPointerException("locale");

        mContext = context;
        mLocale = locale;
    }

    public interface GeocodeListener
    {
        void onGeocode(List<Address> addresses);

        default void onError(String errorMessage)
        {
        }
    }

    public static boolean isPresent()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public List<Address> getFromLocation(double latitude, double longitude, int maxResults) throws IOException
    {
        checkLatitude(latitude);
        checkLongitude(longitude);

        throw new IOException("Service not Available");
    }

    public void getFromLocation(double latitude, double longitude, int maxResults, GeocodeListener listener)
    {
        checkLatitude(latitude);
        checkLongitude(longitude);

        listener.onError("Service not Available");
    }

    public List<Address> getFromLocationName(String locationName, int maxResults) throws IOException
    {
        if (locationName == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("locationName == null");

        throw new IOException("Service not Available");
    }

    public void getFromLocationName(String locationName, int maxResults, GeocodeListener listener)
    {
        if (locationName == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("locationName == null");

        listener.onError("Service not Available");
    }

    public List<Address> getFromLocationName(String locationName, int maxResults, double lowerLeftLatitude, double lowerLeftLongitude,
                                             double upperRightLatitude, double upperRightLongitude) throws IOException
    {
        return getFromLocationName(locationName, maxResults);
    }

    public void getFromLocationName(String locationName, int maxResults, double lowerLeftLatitude, double lowerLeftLongitude,
                                    double upperRightLatitude, double upperRightLongitude, GeocodeListener listener)
    {
        getFromLocationName(locationName, maxResults, listener);
    }

    private static void checkLatitude(double latitude)
    {
        if (latitude < -90.0 || latitude > 90.0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("latitude == " + latitude);
    }

    private static void checkLongitude(double longitude)
    {
        if (longitude < -180.0 || longitude > 180.0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("longitude == " + longitude);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.location;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class GnssMeasurementsEvent implements Parcelable
{
    private final boolean mHasIsFullTracking;
    private final boolean mIsFullTracking;

    private GnssMeasurementsEvent(boolean hasIsFullTracking, boolean isFullTracking)
    {
        mHasIsFullTracking = hasIsFullTracking;
        mIsFullTracking = isFullTracking;
    }

    public abstract static class Callback
    {
        public static final int STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED = 0;
        public static final int STATUS_READY = 1;
        public static final int STATUS_LOCATION_DISABLED = 2;
        public static final int STATUS_NOT_ALLOWED = 3;

        public void onGnssMeasurementsReceived(GnssMeasurementsEvent eventArgs)
        {
        }

        public void onStatusChanged(int status)
        {
        }
    }

    public boolean isFullTracking()
    {
        return mIsFullTracking;
    }

    public boolean hasIsFullTracking()
    {
        return mHasIsFullTracking;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        parcel.writeInt(mHasIsFullTracking ? 1 : 0);
        parcel.writeInt(mIsFullTracking ? 1 : 0);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "GnssMeasurementsEvent[measurements=[]" + (mHasIsFullTracking ? ", isFullTracking=" + mIsFullTracking : "") + "]";
    }

    public static final Creator<GnssMeasurementsEvent> CREATOR = new Creator<GnssMeasurementsEvent>()
    {
        @Override
        public GnssMeasurementsEvent createFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
        {
            return new GnssMeasurementsEvent(parcel.readInt() != 0, parcel.readInt() != 0);
        }

        @Override
        public GnssMeasurementsEvent[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new GnssMeasurementsEvent[size];
        }
    };
}
```

`java/android/location/GnssStatus.java`:

```java
package android.location;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class GnssStatus implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int CONSTELLATION_UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final int CONSTELLATION_GPS = 1;
    public static final int CONSTELLATION_SBAS = 2;
    public static final int CONSTELLATION_GLONASS = 3;
    public static final int CONSTELLATION_QZSS = 4;
    public static final int CONSTELLATION_BEIDOU = 5;
    public static final int CONSTELLATION_GALILEO = 6;
    public static final int CONSTELLATION_IRNSS = 7;

    private static final int SVID_FLAGS_HAS_EPHEMERIS_DATA = 1 << 0;
    private static final int SVID_FLAGS_HAS_ALMANAC_DATA = 1 << 1;
    private static final int SVID_FLAGS_USED_IN_FIX = 1 << 2;
    private static final int SVID_FLAGS_HAS_CARRIER_FREQUENCY = 1 << 3;
    private static final int SVID_FLAGS_HAS_BASEBAND_CN0 = 1 << 4;
    private static final int SVID_SHIFT_WIDTH = 12;
    private static final int CONSTELLATION_TYPE_SHIFT_WIDTH = 8;
    private static final int CONSTELLATION_TYPE_MASK = 0xf;

    private final int mSvCount;
    private final int[] mSvidWithFlags;
    private final float[] mCn0DbHzs;
    private final float[] mElevations;
    private final float[] mAzimuths;
    private final float[] mCarrierFrequencies;
    private final float[] mBasebandCn0DbHzs;

    private GnssStatus(int svCount, int[] svidWithFlags, float[] cn0DbHzs, float[] elevations, float[] azimuths,
                       float[] carrierFrequencies, float[] basebandCn0DbHzs)
    {
        mSvCount = svCount;
        mSvidWithFlags = svidWithFlags;
        mCn0DbHzs = cn0DbHzs;
        mElevations = elevations;
        mAzimuths = azimuths;
        mCarrierFrequencies = carrierFrequencies;
        mBasebandCn0DbHzs = basebandCn0DbHzs;
    }

    static GnssStatus empty()
    {
        return new GnssStatus(0, new int[0], new float[0], new float[0], new float[0], new float[0], new float[0]);
    }

    public abstract static class Callback
    {
        public void onStarted()
        {
        }

        public void onStopped()
        {
        }

        public void onFirstFix(int ttffMillis)
        {
        }

        public void onSatelliteStatusChanged(GnssStatus status)
        {
        }
    }

    public int getSatelliteCount()
    {
        return mSvCount;
    }

    public int getConstellationType(int satelliteIndex)
    {
        return (mSvidWithFlags[satelliteIndex] >> CONSTELLATION_TYPE_SHIFT_WIDTH) & CONSTELLATION_TYPE_MASK;
    }

    public int getSvid(int satelliteIndex)
    {
        return mSvidWithFlags[satelliteIndex] >> SVID_SHIFT_WIDTH;
    }

    public float getCn0DbHz(int satelliteIndex)
    {
        return mCn0DbHzs[satelliteIndex];
    }

    public float getElevationDegrees(int satelliteIndex)
    {
        return mElevations[satelliteIndex];
    }

    public float getAzimuthDegrees(int satelliteIndex)
    {
        return mAzimuths[satelliteIndex];
    }

    public boolean hasEphemerisData(int satelliteIndex)
    {
        return (mSvidWithFlags[satelliteIndex] & SVID_FLAGS_HAS_EPHEMERIS_DATA) != 0;
    }

    public boolean hasAlmanacData(int satelliteIndex)
    {
        return (mSvidWithFlags[satelliteIndex] & SVID_FLAGS_HAS_ALMANAC_DATA) != 0;
    }

    public boolean usedInFix(int satelliteIndex)
    {
        return (mSvidWithFlags[satelliteIndex] & SVID_FLAGS_USED_IN_FIX) != 0;
    }

    public boolean hasCarrierFrequencyHz(int satelliteIndex)
    {
        return (mSvidWithFlags[satelliteIndex] & SVID_FLAGS_HAS_CARRIER_FREQUENCY) != 0;
    }

    public float getCarrierFrequencyHz(int satelliteIndex)
    {
        return mCarrierFrequencies[satelliteIndex];
    }

    public boolean hasBasebandCn0DbHz(int satelliteIndex)
    {
        return (mSvidWithFlags[satelliteIndex] & SVID_FLAGS_HAS_BASEBAND_CN0) != 0;
    }

    public float getBasebandCn0DbHz(int satelliteIndex)
    {
        return mBasebandCn0DbHzs[satelliteIndex];
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof GnssStatus)) return false;

        GnssStatus status = (GnssStatus)other;
        return mSvCount == status.mSvCount && java.util.Arrays.equals(mSvidWithFlags, status.mSvidWithFlags)
            && java.util.Arrays.equals(mCn0DbHzs, status.mCn0DbHzs) && java.util.Arrays.equals(mElevations, status.mElevations)
            && java.util.Arrays.equals(mAzimuths, status.mAzimuths)
            && java.util.Arrays.equals(mCarrierFrequencies, status.mCarrierFrequencies)
            && java.util.Arrays.equals(mBasebandCn0DbHzs, status.mBasebandCn0DbHzs);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return 31 * mSvCount + java.util.Arrays.hashCode(mSvidWithFlags);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        parcel.writeInt(mSvCount);

        for (int index = 0; index < mSvCount; index++)
        {
            parcel.writeInt(mSvidWithFlags[index]);
            parcel.writeFloat(mCn0DbHzs[index]);
            parcel.writeFloat(mElevations[index]);
            parcel.writeFloat(mAzimuths[index]);
            parcel.writeFloat(mCarrierFrequencies[index]);
            parcel.writeFloat(mBasebandCn0DbHzs[index]);
        }
    }

    public static final Creator<GnssStatus> CREATOR = new Creator<GnssStatus>()
    {
        @Override
        public GnssStatus createFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
        {
            int count = parcel.readInt();
            int[] svidWithFlags = new int[count];
            float[] cn0DbHzs = new float[count];
            float[] elevations = new float[count];
            float[] azimuths = new float[count];
            float[] carrierFrequencies = new float[count];
            float[] basebandCn0DbHzs = new float[count];

            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                svidWithFlags[index] = parcel.readInt();
                cn0DbHzs[index] = parcel.readFloat();
                elevations[index] = parcel.readFloat();
                azimuths[index] = parcel.readFloat();
                carrierFrequencies[index] = parcel.readFloat();
                basebandCn0DbHzs[index] = parcel.readFloat();
            }

            return new GnssStatus(count, svidWithFlags, cn0DbHzs, elevations, azimuths, carrierFrequencies, basebandCn0DbHzs);
        }

        @Override
        public GnssStatus[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new GnssStatus[size];
        }
    };
}
```

`java/android/location/GpsStatus.java`:

```java
package android.location;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class GpsStatus
{
    public static final int GPS_EVENT_STARTED = 1;
    public static final int GPS_EVENT_STOPPED = 2;
    public static final int GPS_EVENT_FIRST_FIX = 3;
    public static final int GPS_EVENT_SATELLITE_STATUS = 4;

    private static final int MAX_SATELLITES = 255;
    private static final int GLONASS_SVID_OFFSET = 64;
    private static final int BEIDOU_SVID_OFFSET = 200;
    private static final int SBAS_SVID_OFFSET = -87;

    private final List<GpsSatellite> mSatellites = new ArrayList<>();
    private int mTimeToFirstFix;

    private GpsStatus()
    {
    }

    public interface Listener
    {
        void onGpsStatusChanged(int event);
    }

    public interface NmeaListener
    {
        void onNmeaReceived(long timestamp, String nmea);
    }

    public static GpsStatus create(GnssStatus gnssStatus, int timeToFirstFix)
    {
        GpsStatus status = new GpsStatus();
        status.setStatus(gnssStatus, timeToFirstFix);
        return status;
    }

    static GpsStatus createEmpty()
    {
        return new GpsStatus();
    }

    void setStatus(GnssStatus gnssStatus, int timeToFirstFix)
    {
        mSatellites.clear();
        mTimeToFirstFix = timeToFirstFix;

        for (int index = 0; index < gnssStatus.getSatelliteCount(); index++)
        {
            int prn = gnssStatus.getSvid(index);
            int type = gnssStatus.getConstellationType(index);

            if (type == GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GLONASS) prn += GLONASS_SVID_OFFSET;
            else if (type == GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_BEIDOU) prn += BEIDOU_SVID_OFFSET;
            else if (type == GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_SBAS) prn += SBAS_SVID_OFFSET;
            else if (type != GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GPS && type != GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_QZSS) continue;

            if (prn <= 0 || prn > MAX_SATELLITES) continue;

            GpsSatellite satellite = new GpsSatellite(prn);
            satellite.mValid = true;
            satellite.mSnr = gnssStatus.getCn0DbHz(index);
            satellite.mElevation = gnssStatus.getElevationDegrees(index);
            satellite.mAzimuth = gnssStatus.getAzimuthDegrees(index);
            satellite.mHasEphemeris = gnssStatus.hasEphemerisData(index);
            satellite.mHasAlmanac = gnssStatus.hasAlmanacData(index);
            satellite.mUsedInFix = gnssStatus.usedInFix(index);
            mSatellites.add(satellite);
        }
    }

    public int getTimeToFirstFix()
    {
        return mTimeToFirstFix;
    }

    public Iterable<GpsSatellite> getSatellites()
    {
        return new ArrayList<>(mSatellites);
    }

    public int getMaxSatellites()
    {
        return mSatellites.size();
    }
}
```

```java
    private static final int HAS_SPEED_MASK = 1 << 1;

        mLongitudeDegrees = 0;

        mAltitudeMeters = 0;
        mAltitudeAccuracyMeters = 0;
        mSpeedMetersPerSecond = 0;
        mSpeedAccuracyMetersPerSecond = 0;

        mBearingAccuracyDegrees = 0;
        mMslAltitudeMeters = 0;
        mMslAltitudeAccuracyMeters = 0;
        mExtras = null;

    public float distanceTo(Location destination)
    {
        float[] results = new float[3];
        computeDistanceAndBearing(mLatitudeDegrees, mLongitudeDegrees, destination.mLatitudeDegrees, destination.mLongitudeDegrees,
                                  results);
        return results[0];
    }

                                  results);

    {
        mSpeedMetersPerSecond = speedMetersPerSecond;
        mFieldsMask |= HAS_SPEED_MASK;
    }

    {
        return (mFieldsMask & HAS_SPEED_MASK) != 0;

    public void setBearing(float bearingDegrees)
    {
        if (Float.isNaN(bearingDegrees) || Float.isInfinite(bearingDegrees)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid bearing");

        float modBearing = bearingDegrees % 360f + 0f;
        if (modBearing < 0) modBearing += 360f;

        mBearingDegrees = modBearing;
        mFieldsMask |= HAS_BEARING_MASK;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof Location)) return false;

        Location location = (Location)other;
        return mTimeMs == location.mTimeMs && mElapsedRealtimeNs == location.mElapsedRealtimeNs
            && mFieldsMask == location.mFieldsMask && Double.compare(location.mLatitudeDegrees, mLatitudeDegrees) == 0
            && Double.compare(location.mLongitudeDegrees, mLongitudeDegrees) == 0
            && (!hasAltitude() || Double.compare(location.mAltitudeMeters, mAltitudeMeters) == 0)
            && (!hasSpeed() || Float.compare(location.mSpeedMetersPerSecond, mSpeedMetersPerSecond) == 0)
            && (!hasBearing() || Float.compare(location.mBearingDegrees, mBearingDegrees) == 0)
            && (!hasAccuracy() || Float.compare(location.mHorizontalAccuracyMeters, mHorizontalAccuracyMeters) == 0)
            && (!hasVerticalAccuracy() || Float.compare(location.mAltitudeAccuracyMeters, mAltitudeAccuracyMeters) == 0)
            && (!hasSpeedAccuracy() || Float.compare(location.mSpeedAccuracyMetersPerSecond, mSpeedAccuracyMetersPerSecond) == 0)
            && (!hasBearingAccuracy() || Float.compare(location.mBearingAccuracyDegrees, mBearingAccuracyDegrees) == 0)
            && (!hasMslAltitude() || Double.compare(location.mMslAltitudeMeters, mMslAltitudeMeters) == 0)
            && java.util.Objects.equals(mProvider, location.mProvider);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        builder.append("Location[");
        builder.append(mProvider);
        builder.append(" ").append(String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.6f,%.6f", mLatitudeDegrees, mLongitudeDegrees));
        if (hasAccuracy()) builder.append(" hAcc=").append(mHorizontalAccuracyMeters);
        builder.append(" et=").append(mElapsedRealtimeNs / 1000000L).append("ms");
        if (hasAltitude()) builder.append(" alt=").append(mAltitudeMeters);
        if (hasVerticalAccuracy()) builder.append(" vAcc=").append(mAltitudeAccuracyMeters);
        if (hasMslAltitude()) builder.append(" mslAlt=").append(mMslAltitudeMeters);
        if (hasSpeed()) builder.append(" vel=").append(mSpeedMetersPerSecond);
        if (hasSpeedAccuracy()) builder.append(" sAcc=").append(mSpeedAccuracyMetersPerSecond);
        if (hasBearing()) builder.append(" bear=").append(mBearingDegrees);
        if (hasBearingAccuracy()) builder.append(" bAcc=").append(mBearingAccuracyDegrees);
        if (isMock()) builder.append(" mock");
        if (mExtras != null) builder.append(" {").append(mExtras).append('}');
        builder.append(']');
        return builder.toString();
    }

    private static Location readFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
    {
        Location location = new Location(parcel.readString());
        location.mFieldsMask = parcel.readInt();
        location.mTimeMs = parcel.readLong();
        location.mElapsedRealtimeNs = parcel.readLong();
        location.mElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNs = Double.longBitsToDouble(parcel.readLong());
        location.mLatitudeDegrees = Double.longBitsToDouble(parcel.readLong());
        location.mLongitudeDegrees = Double.longBitsToDouble(parcel.readLong());
        location.mHorizontalAccuracyMeters = parcel.readFloat();
        location.mAltitudeMeters = Double.longBitsToDouble(parcel.readLong());
        location.mAltitudeAccuracyMeters = parcel.readFloat();
        location.mSpeedMetersPerSecond = parcel.readFloat();
        location.mSpeedAccuracyMetersPerSecond = parcel.readFloat();
        location.mBearingDegrees = parcel.readFloat();
        location.mBearingAccuracyDegrees = parcel.readFloat();
        location.mMslAltitudeMeters = Double.longBitsToDouble(parcel.readLong());
        location.mMslAltitudeAccuracyMeters = parcel.readFloat();
        location.mExtras = parcel.readBundle();
        return location;
    }

    public static String convert(double coordinate, int outputType)
    {
        if (coordinate < -180.0 || coordinate > 180.0 || Double.isNaN(coordinate))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("coordinate=" + coordinate);
        }

        if (outputType != FORMAT_DEGREES && outputType != FORMAT_MINUTES && outputType != FORMAT_SECONDS)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("outputType=" + outputType);
        }

        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();

        if (coordinate < 0)
        {
            builder.append('-');
            coordinate = -coordinate;
        }

        DecimalFormat format = new DecimalFormat("###.#####");

        if (outputType == FORMAT_MINUTES || outputType == FORMAT_SECONDS)
        {
            int degrees = (int)Math.floor(coordinate);
            builder.append(degrees);
            builder.append(':');
            coordinate -= degrees;
            coordinate *= 60.0;

            if (outputType == FORMAT_SECONDS)
            {
                int minutes = (int)Math.floor(coordinate);
                builder.append(minutes);
                builder.append(':');
                coordinate -= minutes;
                coordinate *= 60.0;
            }
        }

        builder.append(format.format(coordinate));
        return builder.toString();
    }

    public static double convert(String coordinate)
    {
        if (coordinate == null) throw new NullPointerException("coordinate");

        boolean negative = false;

        if (coordinate.charAt(0) == '-')
        {
            coordinate = coordinate.substring(1);
            negative = true;
        }

        StringTokenizer tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(coordinate, ":");
        int tokens = tokenizer.countTokens();
        if (tokens < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("coordinate=" + coordinate);

        try
        {
            String degrees = tokenizer.nextToken();
            double value;

            if (tokens == 1)
            {
                value = Double.parseDouble(degrees);
                return negative ? -value : value;
            }

            String minutes = tokenizer.nextToken();
            int degreesValue = Integer.parseInt(degrees);
            double minutesValue;
            double secondsValue = 0.0;
            boolean secondsPresent = false;

            if (tokenizer.hasMoreTokens())
            {
                minutesValue = Integer.parseInt(minutes);
                String seconds = tokenizer.nextToken();
                secondsValue = Double.parseDouble(seconds);
                secondsPresent = true;
            }
            else
            {
                minutesValue = Double.parseDouble(minutes);
            }

            boolean isNegative180 = negative && degreesValue == 180 && minutesValue == 0 && secondsValue == 0;

            if (degreesValue < 0.0 || (degreesValue > 179 && !isNegative180))
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("coordinate=" + coordinate);
            }

            if (minutesValue < 0 || minutesValue >= 60 || (secondsPresent && minutesValue > 59))
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("coordinate=" + coordinate);
            }

            if (secondsValue < 0 || secondsValue >= 60) throw new IllegalArgumentException("coordinate=" + coordinate);

            value = degreesValue * 3600.0 + minutesValue * 60.0 + secondsValue;
            value /= 3600.0;
            return negative ? -value : value;
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("coordinate=" + coordinate);
        }
    }

    public static void distanceBetween(double startLatitude, double startLongitude, double endLatitude, double endLongitude,
                                       float[] results)
    {
        if (results == null || results.length < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("results is null or has length < 1");

        float[] computed = new float[3];
        computeDistanceAndBearing(startLatitude, startLongitude, endLatitude, endLongitude, computed);

        results[0] = computed[0];
        if (results.length > 1) results[1] = computed[1];
        if (results.length > 2) results[2] = computed[2];
    }

    private static void computeDistanceAndBearing(double lat1, double lon1, double lat2, double lon2, float[] results)
    {
        int maxIterations = 20;

        lat1 *= Math.PI / 180.0;
        lat2 *= Math.PI / 180.0;
        lon1 *= Math.PI / 180.0;
        lon2 *= Math.PI / 180.0;

        double a = 6378137.0;
        double b = 6356752.3142;
        double f = (a - b) / a;
        double aSqMinusBSqOverBSq = (a * a - b * b) / (b * b);

        double l = lon2 - lon1;
        double aA = 0.0;
        double u1 = Math.atan((1.0 - f) * Math.tan(lat1));
        double u2 = Math.atan((1.0 - f) * Math.tan(lat2));

        double cosU1 = Math.cos(u1);
        double cosU2 = Math.cos(u2);
        double sinU1 = Math.sin(u1);
        double sinU2 = Math.sin(u2);
        double cosU1cosU2 = cosU1 * cosU2;
        double sinU1sinU2 = sinU1 * sinU2;

        double sigma = 0.0;
        double deltaSigma = 0.0;
        double cosSqAlpha;
        double cos2SM;
        double cosSigma;
        double sinSigma;
        double cosLambda = 0.0;
        double sinLambda = 0.0;

        double lambda = l;

        for (int iteration = 0; iteration < maxIterations; iteration++)
        {
            double lambdaOrig = lambda;
            cosLambda = Math.cos(lambda);
            sinLambda = Math.sin(lambda);
            double t1 = cosU2 * sinLambda;
            double t2 = cosU1 * sinU2 - sinU1 * cosU2 * cosLambda;
            double sinSqSigma = t1 * t1 + t2 * t2;
            sinSigma = Math.sqrt(sinSqSigma);
            cosSigma = sinU1sinU2 + cosU1cosU2 * cosLambda;
            sigma = Math.atan2(sinSigma, cosSigma);
            double sinAlpha = (sinSigma == 0) ? 0.0 : cosU1cosU2 * sinLambda / sinSigma;
            cosSqAlpha = 1.0 - sinAlpha * sinAlpha;
            cos2SM = (cosSqAlpha == 0) ? 0.0 : cosSigma - 2.0 * sinU1sinU2 / cosSqAlpha;

            double uSquared = cosSqAlpha * aSqMinusBSqOverBSq;
            aA = 1 + (uSquared / 16384.0) * (4096.0 + uSquared * (-768 + uSquared * (320.0 - 175.0 * uSquared)));
            double bB = (uSquared / 1024.0) * (256.0 + uSquared * (-128.0 + uSquared * (74.0 - 47.0 * uSquared)));
            double cC = (f / 16.0) * cosSqAlpha * (4.0 + f * (4.0 - 3.0 * cosSqAlpha));
            double cos2SMSq = cos2SM * cos2SM;
            deltaSigma = bB * sinSigma
                * (cos2SM + (bB / 4.0)
                   * (cosSigma * (-1.0 + 2.0 * cos2SMSq) - (bB / 6.0) * cos2SM * (-3.0 + 4.0 * sinSigma * sinSigma)
                      * (-3.0 + 4.0 * cos2SMSq)));

            lambda = l + (1.0 - cC) * f * sinAlpha * (sigma + cC * sinSigma * (cos2SM + cC * cosSigma * (-1.0 + 2.0 * cos2SM * cos2SM)));

            double delta = (lambda - lambdaOrig) / lambda;
            if (Math.abs(delta) < 1.0e-12) break;
        }

        results[0] = (float)(b * aA * (sigma - deltaSigma));

        float initialBearing = (float)Math.atan2(cosU2 * sinLambda, cosU1 * sinU2 - sinU1 * cosU2 * cosLambda);
        initialBearing = (float)(initialBearing * (180.0 / Math.PI));
        results[1] = initialBearing;

        float finalBearing = (float)Math.atan2(cosU1 * sinLambda, -sinU1 * cosU2 + cosU1 * sinU2 * cosLambda);
        results[2] = (float)(finalBearing * (180.0 / Math.PI));
    }
}
```

```java
package android.location;

import android.os.Bundle;

public interface LocationListener

    default void onLocationChanged(List<Location> locations)
    {
        int size = locations.size();
        for (int index = 0; index < size; index++)
        {
            onLocationChanged(locations.get(index));
        }
    }

    default void onFlushComplete(int requestCode)
    {
    }

    {
    }

    {
    }

    }
```
```java
}

    public void requestFlush(String provider, final LocationListener listener, final int requestCode)
    {
        if (provider == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid null provider");
        if (listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid null listener");

        synchronized (mListeners)
        {
            if (!mListeners.containsKey(listener)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("unregistered listener cannot be flushed");
        }

        executorFor(null).execute(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                listener.onFlushComplete(requestCode);
            }
        });
    }

    public List<String> getProviders(Criteria criteria, boolean enabledOnly)
    {
        if (criteria == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid null criteria");
        if (enabledOnly) return new ArrayList<>();

        List<String> matches = new ArrayList<>();

        for (String name : PROVIDERS)
        {
            LocationProvider provider = getProvider(name);
            if (provider != null && provider.meetsCriteria(criteria)) matches.add(name);
        }

        return matches;
    }

    public String getBestProvider(Criteria criteria, boolean enabledOnly)
    {
        if (criteria == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid null criteria");
        if (enabledOnly) return null;

        if (criteria.getAccuracy() == Criteria.ACCURACY_FINE) return GPS_PROVIDER;
        if (criteria.getPowerRequirement() == Criteria.POWER_HIGH) return GPS_PROVIDER;

        return NETWORK_PROVIDER;
    }

    public LocationProvider getProvider(String provider)
    {
        if (provider == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid null provider");

        if (GPS_PROVIDER.equals(provider))
        {
            return new LocationProvider(provider, false, true, false, Criteria.POWER_HIGH, Criteria.ACCURACY_FINE);
        }

        if (NETWORK_PROVIDER.equals(provider))
        {
            return new LocationProvider(provider, true, false, true, Criteria.POWER_LOW, Criteria.ACCURACY_COARSE);
        }

        if (FUSED_PROVIDER.equals(provider))
        {
            return new LocationProvider(provider, false, false, false, Criteria.POWER_LOW, Criteria.ACCURACY_FINE);
        }

        if (PASSIVE_PROVIDER.equals(provider))
        {
            return new LocationProvider(provider, false, false, false, Criteria.POWER_LOW, Criteria.ACCURACY_COARSE);
        }

        return null;
    }

    public boolean sendExtraCommand(String provider, String command, Bundle extras)
    {
        if (provider == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid null provider");
        if (command == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid null command");

        return false;
    }

    public void addTestProvider(String provider, boolean requiresNetwork, boolean requiresSatellite, boolean requiresCell,
                                boolean hasMonetaryCost, boolean supportsAltitude, boolean supportsSpeed, boolean supportsBearing,
                                int powerUsage, int accuracy)

        throw new SecurityException(mContext.getPackageName() + " is not the selected mock location app");

    {
        return addStatusCallback(listener);

    {

    {

    public boolean registerGnssMeasurementsCallback(GnssMeasurementsEvent.Callback callback)
    {
        return registerGnssMeasurementsCallback(executorFor(null), callback);
    }

    public boolean registerGnssMeasurementsCallback(GnssMeasurementsEvent.Callback callback, Handler handler)
    {
        return registerGnssMeasurementsCallback(executorFor(handler == null ? null : handler.getLooper()), callback);
    }

    public boolean registerGnssMeasurementsCallback(Executor executor, final GnssMeasurementsEvent.Callback callback)
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid null callback");

        executor.execute(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                callback.onStatusChanged(GnssMeasurementsEvent.Callback.STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED);
            }
        });

        return addStatusCallback(callback);
    }

    public void unregisterGnssMeasurementsCallback(GnssMeasurementsEvent.Callback callback)
    {
        removeStatusCallback(callback);
    }

    private boolean addStatusCallback(Object callback)
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid null callback");

        enforceFineLocationPermission();

        synchronized (mStatusCallbacks)
        {
            if (!mStatusCallbacks.contains(callback)) mStatusCallbacks.add(callback);
        }

        return true;
    }

    private void removeStatusCallback(Object callback)
    {
        synchronized (mStatusCallbacks)
        {
            mStatusCallbacks.remove(callback);
        }
    }

    private void register(final String provider, final LocationListener listener, Executor executor)
    {
        if (provider == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid null provider");
        if (listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid null listener");
        if (executor == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid null executor");

        enforceLocationPermission();

        synchronized (mListeners)
        {
            mListeners.put(listener, provider);
        }

        Log.i(TAG, "a listener is registered for the disabled " + provider + " provider");

        executor.execute(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                boolean registered;
                synchronized (mListeners)
                {
                    registered = mListeners.containsKey(listener);
                }

                if (registered) listener.onProviderDisabled(provider);
            }
        });
    }

    private void register(String provider, PendingIntent pendingIntent)
    {
        if (provider == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid null provider");
        if (pendingIntent == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid null pending intent");

        enforceLocationPermission();

        synchronized (mPendingIntents)
        {
            if (!mPendingIntents.contains(pendingIntent)) mPendingIntents.add(pendingIntent);
        }
    }

    private Executor executorFor(Looper looper)
    {
        Looper target = looper != null ? looper : Looper.myLooper();
        if (target == null) target = Looper.getMainLooper();

        if (target == null)
        {
            return new Executor()
            {
                @Override
                public void execute(Runnable command)
                {
                    command.run();
                }
            };
        }

        final Handler handler = new Handler(target);
        return new Executor()
        {
            @Override
            public void execute(Runnable command)
            {
                handler.post(command);
            }
        };
    }

    private static boolean granted(String permission)
    {
        return runtime.Permissions.check(permission) == android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;
    }

    private static void enforceLocationPermission()
    {
        if (granted("android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION")) return;
        if (granted("android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION")) return;

        throw new SecurityException("uid " + android.os.Process.myUid() + " does not have android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION"
                                    + " or android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.");
    }

    private static void enforceFineLocationPermission()
    {
        if (granted("android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION")) return;

        throw new SecurityException("uid " + android.os.Process.myUid() + " does not have android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.");
    }
}
```

```java
package android.location;

public class LocationProvider
{
    public static final int OUT_OF_SERVICE = 0;
    public static final int TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE = 1;
    public static final int AVAILABLE = 2;

    private final String mName;
    private final boolean mRequiresNetwork;
    private final boolean mRequiresSatellite;
    private final boolean mRequiresCell;
    private final int mPowerRequirement;
    private final int mAccuracy;

    LocationProvider(String name, boolean requiresNetwork, boolean requiresSatellite, boolean requiresCell, int powerRequirement,
                     int accuracy)
    {
        mName = name;
        mRequiresNetwork = requiresNetwork;
        mRequiresSatellite = requiresSatellite;
        mRequiresCell = requiresCell;
        mPowerRequirement = powerRequirement;
        mAccuracy = accuracy;
    }

    public String getName()
    {
        return mName;
    }

    public boolean meetsCriteria(Criteria criteria)
    {
        if (criteria.getAccuracy() != Criteria.NO_REQUIREMENT && criteria.getAccuracy() < mAccuracy) return false;
        if (criteria.getPowerRequirement() != Criteria.NO_REQUIREMENT && criteria.getPowerRequirement() < mPowerRequirement) return false;
        if (criteria.isAltitudeRequired() && !supportsAltitude()) return false;
        if (criteria.isSpeedRequired() && !supportsSpeed()) return false;
        if (criteria.isBearingRequired() && !supportsBearing()) return false;
        if (!criteria.isCostAllowed() && hasMonetaryCost()) return false;

        return true;
    }

    public boolean requiresNetwork()
    {
        return mRequiresNetwork;
    }

    public boolean requiresSatellite()
    {
        return mRequiresSatellite;
    }

    public boolean requiresCell()
    {
        return mRequiresCell;
    }

    public boolean hasMonetaryCost()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean supportsAltitude()
    {
        return mRequiresSatellite;
    }

    public boolean supportsSpeed()
    {
        return mRequiresSatellite;
    }

    public boolean supportsBearing()
    {
        return mRequiresSatellite;
    }

    public int getPowerRequirement()
    {
        return mPowerRequirement;
    }

    public int getAccuracy()
    {
        return mAccuracy;
    }
}
```

`java/android/location/LocationRequest.java`:

```java
package android.location;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class LocationRequest implements Parcelable
{
    public static final long PASSIVE_INTERVAL = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    public static final int QUALITY_HIGH_ACCURACY = 100;
    public static final int QUALITY_BALANCED_POWER_ACCURACY = 102;
    public static final int QUALITY_LOW_POWER = 104;

    private static final long IMPLICIT_MIN_UPDATE_INTERVAL = -1;
    private static final double IMPLICIT_MIN_UPDATE_INTERVAL_FACTOR = 1D / 6D;

    private final int mQuality;
    private final long mIntervalMillis;
    private final long mDurationMillis;
    private final int mMaxUpdates;
    private final long mMinUpdateIntervalMillis;
    private final float mMinUpdateDistanceMeters;
    private final long mMaxUpdateDelayMillis;

    private LocationRequest(int quality, long intervalMillis, long durationMillis, int maxUpdates, long minUpdateIntervalMillis,
                            float minUpdateDistanceMeters, long maxUpdateDelayMillis)
    {
        mQuality = quality;
        mIntervalMillis = intervalMillis;
        mDurationMillis = durationMillis;
        mMaxUpdates = maxUpdates;
        mMinUpdateIntervalMillis = minUpdateIntervalMillis;
        mMinUpdateDistanceMeters = minUpdateDistanceMeters;
        mMaxUpdateDelayMillis = maxUpdateDelayMillis;
    }

    public int getQuality()
    {
        return mQuality;
    }

    public long getIntervalMillis()
    {
        return mIntervalMillis;
    }

    public long getDurationMillis()
    {
        return mDurationMillis;
    }

    public int getMaxUpdates()
    {
        return mMaxUpdates;
    }

    public long getMinUpdateIntervalMillis()
    {
        if (mMinUpdateIntervalMillis == IMPLICIT_MIN_UPDATE_INTERVAL)
        {
            return (long)(mIntervalMillis * IMPLICIT_MIN_UPDATE_INTERVAL_FACTOR);
        }

        return Math.min(mMinUpdateIntervalMillis, mIntervalMillis);
    }

    public float getMinUpdateDistanceMeters()
    {
        return mMinUpdateDistanceMeters;
    }

    public long getMaxUpdateDelayMillis()
    {
        return mMaxUpdateDelayMillis;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        parcel.writeInt(mQuality);
        parcel.writeLong(mIntervalMillis);
        parcel.writeLong(mDurationMillis);
        parcel.writeInt(mMaxUpdates);
        parcel.writeLong(mMinUpdateIntervalMillis);
        parcel.writeFloat(mMinUpdateDistanceMeters);
        parcel.writeLong(mMaxUpdateDelayMillis);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof LocationRequest)) return false;

        LocationRequest request = (LocationRequest)other;
        return mQuality == request.mQuality && mIntervalMillis == request.mIntervalMillis && mDurationMillis == request.mDurationMillis
            && mMaxUpdates == request.mMaxUpdates && mMinUpdateIntervalMillis == request.mMinUpdateIntervalMillis
            && Float.compare(request.mMinUpdateDistanceMeters, mMinUpdateDistanceMeters) == 0
            && mMaxUpdateDelayMillis == request.mMaxUpdateDelayMillis;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return java.util.Objects.hash(mQuality, mIntervalMillis, mMinUpdateIntervalMillis);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder("Request[");
        builder.append(mIntervalMillis == PASSIVE_INTERVAL ? "PASSIVE" : "@" + mIntervalMillis + "ms");
        builder.append(" quality=").append(mQuality);
        if (mDurationMillis != Long.MAX_VALUE) builder.append(", duration=").append(mDurationMillis).append("ms");
        if (mMaxUpdates != Integer.MAX_VALUE) builder.append(", maxUpdates=").append(mMaxUpdates);
        if (mMinUpdateDistanceMeters > 0) builder.append(", minUpdateDistance=").append(mMinUpdateDistanceMeters);
        builder.append(']');
        return builder.toString();
    }

    public static final Creator<LocationRequest> CREATOR = new Creator<LocationRequest>()
    {
        @Override
        public LocationRequest createFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
        {
            return new LocationRequest(parcel.readInt(), parcel.readLong(), parcel.readLong(), parcel.readInt(), parcel.readLong(),
                                       parcel.readFloat(), parcel.readLong());
        }

        @Override
        public LocationRequest[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new LocationRequest[size];
        }
    };

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private long mIntervalMillis;
        private int mQuality;
        private long mDurationMillis;
        private int mMaxUpdates;
        private long mMinUpdateIntervalMillis;
        private float mMinUpdateDistanceMeters;
        private long mMaxUpdateDelayMillis;

        public Builder(long intervalMillis)
        {
            setIntervalMillis(intervalMillis);
            mQuality = QUALITY_BALANCED_POWER_ACCURACY;
            mDurationMillis = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            mMaxUpdates = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            mMinUpdateIntervalMillis = IMPLICIT_MIN_UPDATE_INTERVAL;
            mMinUpdateDistanceMeters = 0;
            mMaxUpdateDelayMillis = 0;
        }

        public Builder(LocationRequest request)
        {
            mIntervalMillis = request.mIntervalMillis;
            mQuality = request.mQuality;
            mDurationMillis = request.mDurationMillis;
            mMaxUpdates = request.mMaxUpdates;
            mMinUpdateIntervalMillis = request.mMinUpdateIntervalMillis;
            mMinUpdateDistanceMeters = request.mMinUpdateDistanceMeters;
            mMaxUpdateDelayMillis = request.mMaxUpdateDelayMillis;
        }

        public Builder setIntervalMillis(long intervalMillis)
        {
            if (intervalMillis < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("intervalMillis must be greater than or equal to 0");

            mIntervalMillis = intervalMillis;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setQuality(int quality)
        {
            if (quality != QUALITY_HIGH_ACCURACY && quality != QUALITY_BALANCED_POWER_ACCURACY && quality != QUALITY_LOW_POWER)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("quality must be a defined QUALITY constant, not " + quality);
            }

            mQuality = quality;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setDurationMillis(long durationMillis)
        {
            if (durationMillis <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("durationMillis must be greater than 0");

            mDurationMillis = durationMillis;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setMaxUpdates(int maxUpdates)
        {
            if (maxUpdates <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxUpdates must be greater than 0");

            mMaxUpdates = maxUpdates;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setMinUpdateIntervalMillis(long minUpdateIntervalMillis)
        {
            if (minUpdateIntervalMillis < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("minUpdateIntervalMillis must be at least 0");

            mMinUpdateIntervalMillis = minUpdateIntervalMillis;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder clearMinUpdateIntervalMillis()
        {
            mMinUpdateIntervalMillis = IMPLICIT_MIN_UPDATE_INTERVAL;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setMinUpdateDistanceMeters(float minUpdateDistanceMeters)
        {
            if (minUpdateDistanceMeters < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("minUpdateDistanceMeters must be at least 0");

            mMinUpdateDistanceMeters = minUpdateDistanceMeters;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setMaxUpdateDelayMillis(long maxUpdateDelayMillis)
        {
            if (maxUpdateDelayMillis < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxUpdateDelayMillis must be greater than or equal to 0");

            mMaxUpdateDelayMillis = maxUpdateDelayMillis;
            return this;
        }

        public LocationRequest build()
        {
            if (mIntervalMillis == PASSIVE_INTERVAL && mMinUpdateIntervalMillis == IMPLICIT_MIN_UPDATE_INTERVAL)
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException("passive location requests must have an explicit minimum update interval");
            }

            return new LocationRequest(mQuality, mIntervalMillis, mDurationMillis, mMaxUpdates, mMinUpdateIntervalMillis,
                                       mMinUpdateDistanceMeters, mMaxUpdateDelayMillis);
        }
    }
}
```
