```java
package android.media;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.Objects;

public final class AudioAttributes implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int ALLOW_CAPTURE_BY_ALL = 1;
    public static final int ALLOW_CAPTURE_BY_NONE = 3;
    public static final int ALLOW_CAPTURE_BY_SYSTEM = 2;
    public static final int CONTENT_TYPE_MOVIE = 3;
    public static final int CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC = 2;
    public static final int CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION = 4;
    public static final int CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH = 1;
    public static final int CONTENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final int FLAG_AUDIBILITY_ENFORCED = 1;
    public static final int FLAG_HW_AV_SYNC = 16;
    public static final int FLAG_LOW_LATENCY = 256;
    public static final int SPATIALIZATION_BEHAVIOR_AUTO = 0;
    public static final int SPATIALIZATION_BEHAVIOR_NEVER = 1;
    public static final int USAGE_ALARM = 4;
    public static final int USAGE_ASSISTANCE_ACCESSIBILITY = 11;
    public static final int USAGE_ASSISTANCE_NAVIGATION_GUIDANCE = 12;
    public static final int USAGE_ASSISTANCE_SONIFICATION = 13;
    public static final int USAGE_ASSISTANT = 16;
    public static final int USAGE_GAME = 14;
    public static final int USAGE_MEDIA = 1;
    public static final int USAGE_NOTIFICATION = 5;
    public static final int USAGE_NOTIFICATION_COMMUNICATION_DELAYED = 9;
    public static final int USAGE_NOTIFICATION_COMMUNICATION_INSTANT = 8;
    public static final int USAGE_NOTIFICATION_COMMUNICATION_REQUEST = 7;
    public static final int USAGE_NOTIFICATION_EVENT = 10;
    public static final int USAGE_NOTIFICATION_RINGTONE = 6;
    public static final int USAGE_UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final int USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION = 2;
    public static final int USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION_SIGNALLING = 3;

    private static final int FLAG_SCO = 4;
    private static final int FLAG_BEACON = 8;
    private static final int FLAG_NO_MEDIA_PROJECTION = 1024;
    private static final int FLAG_NO_SYSTEM_CAPTURE = 4096;
    private static final int FLAG_MUTE_HAPTIC = 2048;
    private static final int FLAG_CONTENT_SPATIALIZED = 16384;
    private static final int FLAG_NEVER_SPATIALIZE = 32768;
    private static final int PUBLIC_FLAGS = FLAG_AUDIBILITY_ENFORCED | FLAG_HW_AV_SYNC | FLAG_LOW_LATENCY;
    private static final int STREAM_UNSET = -1;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<AudioAttributes> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<AudioAttributes>()
    {
        @Override
        public AudioAttributes createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            AudioAttributes attributes = new AudioAttributes();
            attributes.mUsage = source.readInt();
            attributes.mContentType = source.readInt();
            attributes.mFlags = source.readInt();
            attributes.mLegacyStreamType = source.readInt();
            return attributes;
        }

        @Override
        public AudioAttributes[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new AudioAttributes[size];
        }
    };

    private int mUsage = USAGE_UNKNOWN;
    private int mContentType = CONTENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN;
    private int mFlags;
    private int mLegacyStreamType = STREAM_UNSET;

    private AudioAttributes()
    {
    }

    public boolean areHapticChannelsMuted()
    {
        return (mFlags & FLAG_MUTE_HAPTIC) != 0;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        if (this == object) return true;
        if (!(object instanceof AudioAttributes)) return false;

        AudioAttributes other = (AudioAttributes)object;
        return mUsage == other.mUsage && mContentType == other.mContentType && mFlags == other.mFlags
            && mLegacyStreamType == other.mLegacyStreamType;
    }

    public int getAllowedCapturePolicy()
    {
        if ((mFlags & FLAG_NO_SYSTEM_CAPTURE) != 0) return ALLOW_CAPTURE_BY_NONE;
        if ((mFlags & FLAG_NO_MEDIA_PROJECTION) != 0) return ALLOW_CAPTURE_BY_SYSTEM;

        return ALLOW_CAPTURE_BY_ALL;
    }

    public int getContentType()
    {
        return mContentType;
    }

    public int getFlags()
    {
        return mFlags & PUBLIC_FLAGS;
    }

    public int getSpatializationBehavior()
    {
        return (mFlags & FLAG_NEVER_SPATIALIZE) != 0 ? SPATIALIZATION_BEHAVIOR_NEVER : SPATIALIZATION_BEHAVIOR_AUTO;
    }

    public int getUsage()
    {
        return mUsage;
    }

    public int getVolumeControlStream()
    {
        if (mLegacyStreamType != STREAM_UNSET) return mLegacyStreamType;

        return toLegacyStreamType(mUsage, mFlags);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mUsage, mContentType, mFlags, mLegacyStreamType);
    }

    public boolean isContentSpatialized()
    {
        return (mFlags & FLAG_CONTENT_SPATIALIZED) != 0;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "AudioAttributes: usage=" + usageToString(mUsage) + " content=" + mContentType + " flags=0x"
            + Integer.toHexString(mFlags).toUpperCase();
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        parcel.writeInt(mUsage);
        parcel.writeInt(mContentType);
        parcel.writeInt(mFlags);
        parcel.writeInt(mLegacyStreamType);
    }

    public static String usageToString(int usage)
    {
        switch (usage)
        {
            case USAGE_UNKNOWN:
                return "USAGE_UNKNOWN";
            case USAGE_MEDIA:
                return "USAGE_MEDIA";
            case USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION:
                return "USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION";
            case USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION_SIGNALLING:
                return "USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION_SIGNALLING";
            case USAGE_ALARM:
                return "USAGE_ALARM";
            case USAGE_NOTIFICATION:
                return "USAGE_NOTIFICATION";
            case USAGE_NOTIFICATION_RINGTONE:
                return "USAGE_NOTIFICATION_RINGTONE";
            case USAGE_NOTIFICATION_COMMUNICATION_REQUEST:
                return "USAGE_NOTIFICATION_COMMUNICATION_REQUEST";
            case USAGE_NOTIFICATION_COMMUNICATION_INSTANT:
                return "USAGE_NOTIFICATION_COMMUNICATION_INSTANT";
            case USAGE_NOTIFICATION_COMMUNICATION_DELAYED:
                return "USAGE_NOTIFICATION_COMMUNICATION_DELAYED";
            case USAGE_NOTIFICATION_EVENT:
                return "USAGE_NOTIFICATION_EVENT";
            case USAGE_ASSISTANCE_ACCESSIBILITY:
                return "USAGE_ASSISTANCE_ACCESSIBILITY";
            case USAGE_ASSISTANCE_NAVIGATION_GUIDANCE:
                return "USAGE_ASSISTANCE_NAVIGATION_GUIDANCE";
            case USAGE_ASSISTANCE_SONIFICATION:
                return "USAGE_ASSISTANCE_SONIFICATION";
            case USAGE_GAME:
                return "USAGE_GAME";
            case USAGE_ASSISTANT:
                return "USAGE_ASSISTANT";
            default:
                return "unknown usage " + usage;
        }
    }

    static boolean isValidUsage(int usage)
    {
        return (usage >= USAGE_UNKNOWN && usage <= USAGE_GAME) || usage == USAGE_ASSISTANT;
    }

    static int toLegacyStreamType(int usage, int flags)
    {
        if ((flags & FLAG_AUDIBILITY_ENFORCED) != 0) return 7;
        if ((flags & FLAG_SCO) != 0) return 6;
        if ((flags & FLAG_BEACON) != 0) return 9;

        switch (usage)
        {
            case USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION:
                return AudioManager.STREAM_VOICE_CALL;
            case USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION_SIGNALLING:
                return AudioManager.STREAM_DTMF;
            case USAGE_ALARM:
                return AudioManager.STREAM_ALARM;
            case USAGE_NOTIFICATION_RINGTONE:
                return AudioManager.STREAM_RING;
            case USAGE_NOTIFICATION:
            case USAGE_NOTIFICATION_COMMUNICATION_REQUEST:
            case USAGE_NOTIFICATION_COMMUNICATION_INSTANT:
            case USAGE_NOTIFICATION_COMMUNICATION_DELAYED:
            case USAGE_NOTIFICATION_EVENT:
                return AudioManager.STREAM_NOTIFICATION;
            case USAGE_ASSISTANCE_ACCESSIBILITY:
                return AudioManager.STREAM_ACCESSIBILITY;
            case USAGE_ASSISTANCE_SONIFICATION:
                return AudioManager.STREAM_SYSTEM;
            default:
                return AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC;
        }
    }

    public static class Builder
    {
        private int mUsage = USAGE_UNKNOWN;
        private int mContentType = CONTENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN;
        private int mFlags;
        private int mLegacyStreamType = STREAM_UNSET;

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public Builder(AudioAttributes attributes)
        {
            mUsage = attributes.mUsage;
            mContentType = attributes.mContentType;
            mFlags = attributes.mFlags;
            mLegacyStreamType = attributes.mLegacyStreamType;
        }

        public AudioAttributes build()
        {
            AudioAttributes attributes = new AudioAttributes();
            attributes.mUsage = mUsage;
            attributes.mContentType = mContentType;
            attributes.mFlags = mFlags;
            attributes.mLegacyStreamType = mLegacyStreamType;
            return attributes;
        }

        public Builder setAllowedCapturePolicy(int capturePolicy)
        {
            mFlags &= ~(FLAG_NO_MEDIA_PROJECTION | FLAG_NO_SYSTEM_CAPTURE);

            switch (capturePolicy)
            {
                case ALLOW_CAPTURE_BY_NONE:
                    mFlags |= FLAG_NO_MEDIA_PROJECTION | FLAG_NO_SYSTEM_CAPTURE;
                    break;
                case ALLOW_CAPTURE_BY_SYSTEM:
                    mFlags |= FLAG_NO_MEDIA_PROJECTION;
                    break;
                case ALLOW_CAPTURE_BY_ALL:
                    break;
                default:
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown allow playback capture policy");
            }

            return this;
        }

        public Builder setContentType(int contentType)
        {
            if (contentType >= CONTENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN && contentType <= CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION)
            {
                mContentType = contentType;
            }
            else
            {
                mContentType = CONTENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN;
            }

            return this;
        }

        public Builder setFlags(int flags)
        {
            mFlags |= flags & PUBLIC_FLAGS;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setHapticChannelsMuted(boolean muted)
        {
            if (muted)
            {
                mFlags |= FLAG_MUTE_HAPTIC;
            }
            else
            {
                mFlags &= ~FLAG_MUTE_HAPTIC;
            }

            return this;
        }

        public Builder setIsContentSpatialized(boolean isSpatialized)
        {
            if (isSpatialized)
            {
                mFlags |= FLAG_CONTENT_SPATIALIZED;
            }
            else
            {
                mFlags &= ~FLAG_CONTENT_SPATIALIZED;
            }

            return this;
        }

        public Builder setLegacyStreamType(int streamType)
        {
            switch (streamType)
            {
                case AudioManager.STREAM_VOICE_CALL:
                    mContentType = CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH;
                    mUsage = USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION;
                    break;
                case 7:
                    mFlags |= FLAG_AUDIBILITY_ENFORCED;
                    mContentType = CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION;
                    mUsage = USAGE_ASSISTANCE_SONIFICATION;
                    break;
                case AudioManager.STREAM_SYSTEM:
                    mContentType = CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION;
                    mUsage = USAGE_ASSISTANCE_SONIFICATION;
                    break;
                case AudioManager.STREAM_RING:
                    mContentType = CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION;
                    mUsage = USAGE_NOTIFICATION_RINGTONE;
                    break;
                case AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC:
                    mContentType = CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC;
                    mUsage = USAGE_MEDIA;
                    break;
                case AudioManager.STREAM_ALARM:
                    mContentType = CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION;
                    mUsage = USAGE_ALARM;
                    break;
                case AudioManager.STREAM_NOTIFICATION:
                    mContentType = CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION;
                    mUsage = USAGE_NOTIFICATION;
                    break;
                case 6:
                    mContentType = CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH;
                    mUsage = USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION;
                    mFlags |= FLAG_SCO;
                    break;
                case AudioManager.STREAM_DTMF:
                    mContentType = CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION;
                    mUsage = USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION_SIGNALLING;
                    break;
                case 9:
                    mContentType = CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION;
                    mUsage = USAGE_ASSISTANCE_ACCESSIBILITY;
                    mFlags |= FLAG_BEACON;
                    break;
                case AudioManager.STREAM_ACCESSIBILITY:
                    mContentType = CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH;
                    mUsage = USAGE_ASSISTANCE_ACCESSIBILITY;
                    break;
                default:
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid stream type " + streamType + " for AudioAttributes");
            }

            mLegacyStreamType = streamType;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setSpatializationBehavior(int behavior)
        {
            if (behavior == SPATIALIZATION_BEHAVIOR_NEVER)
            {
                mFlags |= FLAG_NEVER_SPATIALIZE;
            }
            else if (behavior == SPATIALIZATION_BEHAVIOR_AUTO)
            {
                mFlags &= ~FLAG_NEVER_SPATIALIZE;
            }
            else
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid spatialization behavior " + behavior);
            }

            return this;
        }

        public Builder setUsage(int usage)
        {
            mUsage = isValidUsage(usage) ? usage : USAGE_UNKNOWN;
            return this;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/media/AudioDescriptor.java`:

```java
package android.media;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Objects;

public class AudioDescriptor implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int STANDARD_EDID = 1;
    public static final int STANDARD_NONE = 0;
    public static final int STANDARD_SADB = 2;
    public static final int STANDARD_VSADB = 3;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<AudioDescriptor> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<AudioDescriptor>()
    {
        @Override
        public AudioDescriptor createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int standard = source.readInt();
            int encapsulationType = source.readInt();
            byte[] descriptor = source.createByteArray();
            return new AudioDescriptor(standard, encapsulationType, descriptor);
        }

        @Override
        public AudioDescriptor[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new AudioDescriptor[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mStandard;
    private final int mEncapsulationType;
    private final byte[] mDescriptor;

    AudioDescriptor(int standard, int encapsulationType, byte[] descriptor)
    {
        mStandard = standard;
        mEncapsulationType = encapsulationType;
        mDescriptor = descriptor == null ? new byte[0] : descriptor;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        if (this == object) return true;
        if (!(object instanceof AudioDescriptor)) return false;

        AudioDescriptor other = (AudioDescriptor)object;
        return mStandard == other.mStandard && mEncapsulationType == other.mEncapsulationType
            && Arrays.equals(mDescriptor, other.mDescriptor);
    }

    public byte[] getDescriptor()
    {
        return mDescriptor;
    }

    public int getEncapsulationType()
    {
        return mEncapsulationType;
    }

    public int getStandard()
    {
        return mStandard;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mStandard, mEncapsulationType, Arrays.hashCode(mDescriptor));
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "{standard=" + mStandard + ", encapsulation type=" + mEncapsulationType + ", descriptor length="
            + mDescriptor.length + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        parcel.writeInt(mStandard);
        parcel.writeInt(mEncapsulationType);
        parcel.writeByteArray(mDescriptor);
    }
}
```

```java
    private static final int[] INPUT_SAMPLE_RATES = {8000, 16000, 44100, 48000};

    private static final int[] INPUT_CHANNEL_MASKS = {AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_MONO, AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_STEREO};

    {

    }

    AudioDeviceInfo(int id, int type, boolean sink, String address, CharSequence productName)
    {
        mId = id;
        mType = type;
        mSink = sink;
        mAddress = address == null ? "" : address;
        mProductName = productName == null ? "" : productName;
    }

    private static boolean isInputType(int type)
    {
        switch (type)
        {
            case TYPE_BUILTIN_MIC:
            case TYPE_FM_TUNER:
            case TYPE_TV_TUNER:
            case TYPE_TELEPHONY:
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    @Override

    {

        if (!(object instanceof AudioDeviceInfo)) return false;

        return mId == ((AudioDeviceInfo)object).mId;
    }

        return mAddress;
    }

    public List<AudioDescriptor> getAudioDescriptors()

        return Collections.emptyList();
    }

    public List<AudioProfile> getAudioProfiles()
    {
        List<AudioProfile> profiles = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int encoding : ENCODINGS)
        {
            profiles.add(new AudioProfile(encoding, getSampleRates(), getChannelMasks(), getChannelIndexMasks(),
                AudioProfile.AUDIO_ENCAPSULATION_TYPE_NONE));
        }

        return profiles;
    }

    public int[] getChannelCounts()
    {
        return CHANNEL_COUNTS.clone();
    }

    public int[] getChannelIndexMasks()
    {
        return CHANNEL_INDEX_MASKS.clone();
    }

    public int[] getChannelMasks()
    {
        return mSink ? OUTPUT_CHANNEL_MASKS.clone() : INPUT_CHANNEL_MASKS.clone();
    }

    public int[] getEncapsulationMetadataTypes()
    {
        return new int[0];
    }

    public int[] getEncapsulationModes()
    {
        return new int[0];
    }

    public int[] getEncodings()
    {
        return ENCODINGS.clone();
    }

    {
        return mId;
    }

    public CharSequence getProductName()
    {
        return mProductName;
    }

    public int[] getSampleRates()
    {
        return mSink ? OUTPUT_SAMPLE_RATES.clone() : INPUT_SAMPLE_RATES.clone();
    }

    public int getSpeakerLayoutChannelMask()
    {
        return mSink && mType == TYPE_BUILTIN_SPEAKER ? AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_STEREO : AudioFormat.CHANNEL_INVALID;
    }

    public int getType()
    {
        return mType;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mId;
    }

    public boolean isSink()
    {
        return mSink;
    }

    public boolean isSource()
    {
        return !mSink;
    }
```

`java/android/media/AudioFocusRequest.java`:

```java
package android.media;

import android.os.Handler;

public final class AudioFocusRequest
{
    private static final AudioAttributes DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTES =
        new AudioAttributes.Builder().setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA).build();

    private final AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener mListener;
    private final Handler mHandler;
    private final AudioAttributes mAttributes;
    private final int mFocusGain;
    private final boolean mAcceptsDelayedFocusGain;
    private final boolean mPausesWhenDucked;
    private final boolean mForceDucking;

    private AudioFocusRequest(AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener listener, Handler handler, AudioAttributes attributes,
        int focusGain, boolean acceptsDelayedFocusGain, boolean pausesWhenDucked, boolean forceDucking)
    {
        mListener = listener;
        mHandler = handler;
        mAttributes = attributes;
        mFocusGain = focusGain;
        mAcceptsDelayedFocusGain = acceptsDelayedFocusGain;
        mPausesWhenDucked = pausesWhenDucked;
        mForceDucking = forceDucking;
    }

    static boolean isValidFocusGain(int focusGain)
    {
        return focusGain >= AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN && focusGain <= AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_EXCLUSIVE;
    }

    public boolean acceptsDelayedFocusGain()
    {
        return mAcceptsDelayedFocusGain;
    }

    public AudioAttributes getAudioAttributes()
    {
        return mAttributes;
    }

    public int getFocusGain()
    {
        return mFocusGain;
    }

    public boolean willPauseWhenDucked()
    {
        return mPausesWhenDucked;
    }

    AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener getOnAudioFocusChangeListener()
    {
        return mListener;
    }

    Handler getOnAudioFocusChangeListenerHandler()
    {
        return mHandler;
    }

    boolean forcesDucking()
    {
        return mForceDucking;
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener mListener;
        private Handler mHandler;
        private AudioAttributes mAttributes = DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTES;
        private int mFocusGain;
        private boolean mAcceptsDelayedFocusGain;
        private boolean mPausesWhenDucked;
        private boolean mForceDucking;

        public Builder(AudioFocusRequest request)
        {
            if (request == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Illegal null AudioFocusRequest");

            mListener = request.mListener;
            mHandler = request.mHandler;
            mAttributes = request.mAttributes;
            mFocusGain = request.mFocusGain;
            mAcceptsDelayedFocusGain = request.mAcceptsDelayedFocusGain;
            mPausesWhenDucked = request.mPausesWhenDucked;
            mForceDucking = request.mForceDucking;
        }

        public Builder(int focusGain)
        {
            setFocusGain(focusGain);
        }

        public AudioFocusRequest build()
        {
            if ((mAcceptsDelayedFocusGain || mPausesWhenDucked) && mListener == null)
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Can't use delayed focus or pause on duck without a listener");
            }

            return new AudioFocusRequest(mListener, mHandler, mAttributes, mFocusGain, mAcceptsDelayedFocusGain,
                mPausesWhenDucked, mForceDucking);
        }

        public Builder setAcceptsDelayedFocusGain(boolean acceptsDelayedFocusGain)
        {
            mAcceptsDelayedFocusGain = acceptsDelayedFocusGain;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setAudioAttributes(AudioAttributes attributes)
        {
            if (attributes == null) throw new NullPointerException("Illegal null AudioAttributes");

            mAttributes = attributes;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setFocusGain(int focusGain)
        {
            if (!isValidFocusGain(focusGain)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Illegal audio focus gain type " + focusGain);

            mFocusGain = focusGain;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setForceDucking(boolean forceDucking)
        {
            mForceDucking = forceDucking;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setOnAudioFocusChangeListener(AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener listener)
        {
            if (listener == null) throw new NullPointerException("Illegal null focus listener");

            mListener = listener;
            mHandler = null;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setOnAudioFocusChangeListener(AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener listener, Handler handler)
        {
            if (listener == null || handler == null) throw new NullPointerException("Illegal null focus listener or handler");

            mListener = listener;
            mHandler = handler;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setWillPauseWhenDucked(boolean pauseOnDuck)
        {
            mPausesWhenDucked = pauseOnDuck;
            return this;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    public static final int ENCODING_IAMF_BASE_PROFILE_FLAC = 39;
    public static final int ENCODING_IAMF_BASE_PROFILE_OPUS = 37;
    public static final int ENCODING_IAMF_BASE_PROFILE_PCM = 40;
    public static final int ENCODING_IAMF_SIMPLE_PROFILE_AAC = 34;
    public static final int ENCODING_IAMF_SIMPLE_PROFILE_FLAC = 35;
    public static final int ENCODING_IAMF_SIMPLE_PROFILE_OPUS = 33;
    public static final int ENCODING_IAMF_SIMPLE_PROFILE_PCM = 36;
    public static final int ENCODING_IEC61937 = 13;
    public static final int ENCODING_INVALID = 0;
    public static final int ENCODING_MP3 = 9;
    public static final int ENCODING_MPEGH_BL_L3 = 23;
    public static final int ENCODING_MPEGH_BL_L4 = 24;
    public static final int ENCODING_MPEGH_LC_L3 = 25;
    public static final int ENCODING_MPEGH_LC_L4 = 26;
    public static final int ENCODING_OPUS = 20;
    public static final int ENCODING_PCM_16BIT = 2;
    public static final int ENCODING_PCM_24BIT_PACKED = 21;
    public static final int ENCODING_PCM_32BIT = 22;
    public static final int ENCODING_PCM_8BIT = 3;
    public static final int ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT = 4;
    public static final int SAMPLE_RATE_UNSPECIFIED = 0;

    public static final int SAMPLE_RATE_HZ_MIN = 4000;
    public static final int SAMPLE_RATE_HZ_MAX = 1600000;

    private static final int PROPERTY_ENCODING = 1;
    private static final int PROPERTY_SAMPLE_RATE = 2;
    private static final int PROPERTY_CHANNEL_MASK = 4;
    private static final int PROPERTY_CHANNEL_INDEX_MASK = 8;
    private static final int CHANNEL_COUNT_MAX = 30;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<AudioFormat> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<AudioFormat>()
    {
        @Override
        public AudioFormat createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int propertySetMask = source.readInt();
            int encoding = source.readInt();
            int sampleRate = source.readInt();
            int channelMask = source.readInt();
            int channelIndexMask = source.readInt();
            return new AudioFormat(propertySetMask, encoding, sampleRate, channelMask, channelIndexMask);
        }

        @Override
        public AudioFormat[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new AudioFormat[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mPropertySetMask;
    private final int mEncoding;
    private final int mSampleRate;
    private final int mChannelMask;
    private final int mChannelIndexMask;
    private final int mChannelCount;
    private final int mFrameSizeInBytes;

    private AudioFormat(int propertySetMask, int encoding, int sampleRate, int channelMask, int channelIndexMask)
    {
        mPropertySetMask = propertySetMask;
        mEncoding = (propertySetMask & PROPERTY_ENCODING) != 0 ? encoding : ENCODING_INVALID;
        mSampleRate = (propertySetMask & PROPERTY_SAMPLE_RATE) != 0 ? sampleRate : SAMPLE_RATE_UNSPECIFIED;
        mChannelMask = (propertySetMask & PROPERTY_CHANNEL_MASK) != 0 ? channelMask : CHANNEL_INVALID;
        mChannelIndexMask = (propertySetMask & PROPERTY_CHANNEL_INDEX_MASK) != 0 ? channelIndexMask : 0;

        int count = 0;
        if (mChannelIndexMask != 0)
        {
            count = Integer.bitCount(mChannelIndexMask);
        }
        else if (mChannelMask != CHANNEL_INVALID)
        {
            count = Integer.bitCount(mChannelMask);
        }

        mChannelCount = count;
        mFrameSizeInBytes = isEncodingLinearFrames(mEncoding) && count > 0 ? count * getBytesPerSample(mEncoding) : 1;
    }

    public static int getBytesPerSample(int encoding)
    {
        switch (encoding)
        {
            case ENCODING_PCM_8BIT:
                return 1;
            case ENCODING_PCM_16BIT:
            case ENCODING_IEC61937:
            case ENCODING_DEFAULT:
                return 2;
            case ENCODING_PCM_24BIT_PACKED:
                return 3;
            case ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT:
            case ENCODING_PCM_32BIT:
                return 4;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bad audio format " + encoding);
        }
    }

    public static boolean isValidEncoding(int encoding)
    {
        return (encoding >= ENCODING_DEFAULT && encoding <= ENCODING_DSD)
            || (encoding >= ENCODING_IAMF_SIMPLE_PROFILE_OPUS && encoding <= ENCODING_IAMF_BASE_ENHANCED_PROFILE_PCM);
    }

    public static boolean isEncodingLinearPcm(int encoding)
    {
        switch (encoding)
        {
            case ENCODING_PCM_8BIT:
            case ENCODING_PCM_16BIT:
            case ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT:
            case ENCODING_PCM_24BIT_PACKED:
            case ENCODING_PCM_32BIT:
            case ENCODING_DEFAULT:
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    public static boolean isEncodingLinearFrames(int encoding)
    {
        return isEncodingLinearPcm(encoding) || encoding == ENCODING_IEC61937;
    }

    public static int channelCountFromOutChannelMask(int mask)
    {
        return Integer.bitCount(mask);
    }

    public static int channelCountFromInChannelMask(int mask)
    {
        return Integer.bitCount(mask);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        if (this == object) return true;
        if (!(object instanceof AudioFormat)) return false;

        AudioFormat other = (AudioFormat)object;
        return mPropertySetMask == other.mPropertySetMask && mEncoding == other.mEncoding && mSampleRate == other.mSampleRate
            && mChannelMask == other.mChannelMask && mChannelIndexMask == other.mChannelIndexMask;
    }

    public int getChannelCount()
    {
        return mChannelCount;
    }

    public int getChannelIndexMask()
    {
        return mChannelIndexMask;
    }

    public int getChannelMask()
    {
        return mChannelMask;
    }

    public int getEncoding()
    {
        return mEncoding;
    }

    public int getFrameSizeInBytes()
    {
        return mFrameSizeInBytes;
    }

    public int getSampleRate()
    {
        return mSampleRate;
    }

    public int getPropertySetMask()
    {
        return mPropertySetMask;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mPropertySetMask, mSampleRate, mEncoding, mChannelMask, mChannelIndexMask);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "AudioFormat: props=" + mPropertySetMask + " enc=" + mEncoding + " chan=0x" + Integer.toHexString(mChannelMask)
            .toUpperCase() + " chan_index=0x" + Integer.toHexString(mChannelIndexMask).toUpperCase() + " rate=" + mSampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        parcel.writeInt(mPropertySetMask);
        parcel.writeInt(mEncoding);
        parcel.writeInt(mSampleRate);
        parcel.writeInt(mChannelMask);
        parcel.writeInt(mChannelIndexMask);
    }

    public static class Builder
    {
        private int mPropertySetMask;
        private int mEncoding = ENCODING_INVALID;
        private int mSampleRate = SAMPLE_RATE_UNSPECIFIED;
        private int mChannelMask = CHANNEL_INVALID;
        private int mChannelIndexMask;

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public Builder(AudioFormat format)
        {
            mPropertySetMask = format.mPropertySetMask;
            mEncoding = format.mEncoding;
            mSampleRate = format.mSampleRate;
            mChannelMask = format.mChannelMask;
            mChannelIndexMask = format.mChannelIndexMask;
        }

        public AudioFormat build()
        {
            return new AudioFormat(mPropertySetMask, mEncoding, mSampleRate, mChannelMask, mChannelIndexMask);
        }

        public Builder setChannelIndexMask(int channelIndexMask)
        {
            if (channelIndexMask == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid zero channel index mask");

            int count = Integer.bitCount(channelIndexMask);
            if (count > CHANNEL_COUNT_MAX)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Channel index mask " + channelIndexMask + " has too many channels");
            }

            if (mChannelMask != CHANNEL_INVALID && Integer.bitCount(mChannelMask) != count)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mismatched channel count for index mask " + channelIndexMask);
            }

            mChannelIndexMask = channelIndexMask;
            mPropertySetMask |= PROPERTY_CHANNEL_INDEX_MASK;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setChannelMask(int channelMask)
        {
            if (channelMask == CHANNEL_INVALID) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid zero channel mask");

            if (mChannelIndexMask != 0 && Integer.bitCount(channelMask) != Integer.bitCount(mChannelIndexMask))
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mismatched channel count for mask " + Integer.toHexString(channelMask));
            }

            mChannelMask = channelMask;
            mPropertySetMask |= PROPERTY_CHANNEL_MASK;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setEncoding(int encoding) throws IllegalArgumentException
        {
            if (!isValidEncoding(encoding)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid encoding " + encoding);

            mEncoding = encoding == ENCODING_DEFAULT ? ENCODING_PCM_16BIT : encoding;
            mPropertySetMask |= PROPERTY_ENCODING;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setSampleRate(int sampleRate) throws IllegalArgumentException
        {
            if ((sampleRate < SAMPLE_RATE_HZ_MIN || sampleRate > SAMPLE_RATE_HZ_MAX) && sampleRate != SAMPLE_RATE_UNSPECIFIED)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid sample rate " + sampleRate);
            }

            mSampleRate = sampleRate;
            mPropertySetMask |= PROPERTY_SAMPLE_RATE;
            return this;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    static int registerActivePlayer(Object player, AudioAttributes attributes, int sessionId)
    {
        List<AudioPlaybackConfiguration> snapshot;
        int playerId = sNextPlayerId.getAndIncrement();

        synchronized (sLock)
        {
            sActivePlayers.put(player, new AudioPlaybackConfiguration(playerId, sessionId, attributes, BUILTIN_SPEAKER));
            snapshot = new ArrayList<>(sActivePlayers.values());
        }

        dispatchPlaybackConfigurations(snapshot);
        return playerId;
    }

    static void unregisterActivePlayer(Object player)
    {
        List<AudioPlaybackConfiguration> snapshot;

        synchronized (sLock)
        {
            if (sActivePlayers.remove(player) == null) return;

            snapshot = new ArrayList<>(sActivePlayers.values());
        }

        dispatchPlaybackConfigurations(snapshot);
    }

    private static void dispatchPlaybackConfigurations(List<AudioPlaybackConfiguration> snapshot)
    {
        for (CallbackEntry<AudioPlaybackCallback> entry : sPlaybackCallbacks)
        {
            post(entry.mHandler, () -> entry.mCallback.onPlaybackConfigChanged(new ArrayList<>(snapshot)));
        }
    }

    private static void post(Handler handler, Runnable action)
    {
        if (handler != null)
        {
            handler.post(action);
            return;
        }

        Looper mainLooper = Looper.getMainLooper();
        if (mainLooper != null)
        {
            new Handler(mainLooper).post(action);
        }
        else
        {
            action.run();
        }
    }

        if (streamType < 0 || streamType >= STREAM_COUNT) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bad stream type " + streamType);

    private static AudioDeviceInfo[] devicesFor(int flags)
    {
        List<AudioDeviceInfo> devices = new ArrayList<>();

        if ((flags & GET_DEVICES_OUTPUTS) != 0) devices.add(BUILTIN_SPEAKER);
        if ((flags & GET_DEVICES_INPUTS) != 0) devices.add(BUILTIN_MIC);

        return devices.toArray(new AudioDeviceInfo[0]);
    }

    public int abandonAudioFocus(OnAudioFocusChangeListener listener)
    {

    }

    public int abandonAudioFocusRequest(AudioFocusRequest focusRequest)
    {
        if (focusRequest == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Illegal null AudioFocusRequest");

        abandonFocus(focusKey(focusRequest));
        return AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED;
    }

    private static Object focusKey(AudioFocusRequest request)
    {
        OnAudioFocusChangeListener listener = request.getOnAudioFocusChangeListener();
        return listener != null ? listener : request;
    }

    private static void abandonFocus(Object key)
    {
        FocusOwner regained = null;

        synchronized (sLock)
        {
            int index = indexOfFocusOwner(key);
            if (index < 0) return;

            boolean wasTop = index == sFocusStack.size() - 1;
            sFocusStack.remove(index);

            if (wasTop && !sFocusStack.isEmpty())
            {
                FocusOwner top = sFocusStack.get(sFocusStack.size() - 1);
                if (top.mLoss != AUDIOFOCUS_NONE)
                {
                    top.mLoss = AUDIOFOCUS_NONE;
                    regained = top;
                }
            }
        }

        if (regained != null) dispatchFocusChange(regained, AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN);
    }

    private static int indexOfFocusOwner(Object key)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < sFocusStack.size(); index++)
        {
            if (sFocusStack.get(index).mKey == key) return index;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    private static void dispatchFocusChange(FocusOwner owner, int focusChange)
    {
        OnAudioFocusChangeListener listener = owner.mRequest.getOnAudioFocusChangeListener();
        if (listener == null) return;

        post(owner.mRequest.getOnAudioFocusChangeListenerHandler(), () -> listener.onAudioFocusChange(focusChange));
    }

    private static int grantFocus(Object key, AudioFocusRequest request)
    {
        List<FocusOwner> losers = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> losses = new ArrayList<>();
        int gain = request.getFocusGain();

        synchronized (sLock)
        {
            int existing = indexOfFocusOwner(key);
            if (existing >= 0) sFocusStack.remove(existing);

            if (gain == AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN)
            {
                for (FocusOwner owner : sFocusStack)
                {
                    if (owner.mLoss != AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS)
                    {
                        losers.add(owner);
                        losses.add(AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS);
                    }
                }

                sFocusStack.clear();
            }
            else if (!sFocusStack.isEmpty())
            {
                FocusOwner top = sFocusStack.get(sFocusStack.size() - 1);
                int loss = gain == AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_MAY_DUCK ? AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT_CAN_DUCK : AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT;

                if (top.mLoss == AUDIOFOCUS_NONE)
                {
                    top.mLoss = loss;

                    boolean notify = loss != AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT_CAN_DUCK || top.mRequest.willPauseWhenDucked()
                        || request.forcesDucking();
                    if (notify)
                    {
                        losers.add(top);
                        losses.add(loss);
                    }
                }
            }

            sFocusStack.add(new FocusOwner(key, request));
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < losers.size(); index++)
        {
            dispatchFocusChange(losers.get(index), losses.get(index));
        }

        return AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED;
    }

    private static <T> void addExecutorListener(List<ExecutorEntry<T>> listeners, Executor executor, T listener, String caller)
    {
        Objects.requireNonNull(executor, "Executor must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(listener, "Listener must not be null");

        synchronized (listeners)
        {
            for (ExecutorEntry<T> entry : listeners)
            {
                if (entry.mListener == listener)
                {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("attempt to call " + caller + "() on a previously registered listener");
                }
            }

            listeners.add(new ExecutorEntry<>(listener, executor));
        }
    }

    private static <T> void removeExecutorListener(List<ExecutorEntry<T>> listeners, T listener, String caller)
    {
        Objects.requireNonNull(listener, "Listener must not be null");

        synchronized (listeners)
        {
            for (ExecutorEntry<T> entry : listeners)
            {
                if (entry.mListener == listener)
                {
                    listeners.remove(entry);
                    return;
                }
            }
        }

        throw new IllegalArgumentException("attempt to call " + caller + "() on an unregistered listener");
    }

    public void adjustStreamVolume(int streamType, int direction, int flags)
    {
        checkStreamType(streamType);

        synchronized (sLock)
        {
            switch (direction)
            {
                case ADJUST_RAISE:
                    sStreamMuted[streamType] = false;
                    sStreamVolume[streamType] = Math.min(MAX_STREAM_VOLUME[streamType], sStreamVolume[streamType] + 1);
                    break;
                case ADJUST_LOWER:
                    sStreamVolume[streamType] = Math.max(MIN_STREAM_VOLUME[streamType], sStreamVolume[streamType] - 1);
                    break;
                case ADJUST_SAME:
                    break;
                case ADJUST_MUTE:
                    sStreamMuted[streamType] = true;
                    break;
                case ADJUST_UNMUTE:
                    sStreamMuted[streamType] = false;
                    break;
                case ADJUST_TOGGLE_MUTE:
                    sStreamMuted[streamType] = !sStreamMuted[streamType];
                    break;
                default:
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bad direction " + direction);
            }
        }
    }

    public float getStreamVolumeDb(int streamType, int index, int deviceType)
    {
        checkStreamType(streamType);

        if (index < MIN_STREAM_VOLUME[streamType] || index > MAX_STREAM_VOLUME[streamType])
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid stream volume index " + index);
        }

        if (index == 0) return Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;

        float fraction = (float)index / MAX_STREAM_VOLUME[streamType];
        return -58.0f * (1.0f - fraction) * (1.0f - fraction);
    }

    public int requestAudioFocus(OnAudioFocusChangeListener listener, int streamType, int durationHint)
    {
        if (!AudioFocusRequest.isValidFocusGain(durationHint))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid duration hint, audio focus request denied");
        }

        AudioAttributes attributes = new AudioAttributes.Builder().setLegacyStreamType(streamType).build();
        AudioFocusRequest.Builder builder = new AudioFocusRequest.Builder(durationHint).setAudioAttributes(attributes);
        if (listener != null) builder.setOnAudioFocusChangeListener(listener);

        AudioFocusRequest request = builder.build();
        return grantFocus(listener != null ? listener : request, request);
    }
```

`java/android/media/AudioMetadata.java`:

```java
package android.media;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class AudioMetadata
{
    private AudioMetadata()
    {
    }

    public static AudioMetadataMap createMap()
    {
        return new BaseMap();
    }

    public static <T> Key<T> createKey(String name, Class<T> valueClass)
    {
        return new BaseKey<>(name, valueClass);
    }

    public interface Key<T>
    {
        String getName();

        Class<T> getValueClass();
    }

    public static class Format
    {
        public static final Key<Boolean> KEY_ATMOS_PRESENT = createKey("atmos-present", Boolean.class);
        public static final Key<Integer> KEY_AUDIO_ENCODING = createKey("audio-encoding", Integer.class);
        public static final Key<Integer> KEY_BIT_RATE = createKey("bitrate", Integer.class);
        public static final Key<Integer> KEY_BIT_WIDTH = createKey("bit-width", Integer.class);
        public static final Key<Integer> KEY_CHANNEL_MASK = createKey("channel-mask", Integer.class);
        public static final Key<String> KEY_MIME = createKey("mime", String.class);
        public static final Key<Integer> KEY_PRESENTATION_CONTENT_CLASSIFIER =
            createKey("presentation-content-classifier", Integer.class);
        public static final Key<Integer> KEY_PRESENTATION_ID = createKey("presentation-id", Integer.class);
        public static final Key<String> KEY_PRESENTATION_LANGUAGE = createKey("presentation-language", String.class);
        public static final Key<Integer> KEY_PROGRAM_ID = createKey("program-id", Integer.class);
        public static final Key<Integer> KEY_SAMPLE_RATE = createKey("sample-rate", Integer.class);

        private Format()
        {
        }
    }

    private static final class BaseKey<T> implements Key<T>
    {
        private final String mName;
        private final Class<T> mValueClass;

        BaseKey(String name, Class<T> valueClass)
        {
            mName = Objects.requireNonNull(name);
            mValueClass = Objects.requireNonNull(valueClass);
        }

        @Override
        public String getName()
        {
            return mName;
        }

        @Override
        public Class<T> getValueClass()
        {
            return mValueClass;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object object)
        {
            if (this == object) return true;
            if (!(object instanceof BaseKey)) return false;

            BaseKey<?> other = (BaseKey<?>)object;
            return mName.equals(other.mName) && mValueClass.equals(other.mValueClass);
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return Objects.hash(mName, mValueClass);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "Key{" + mName + ", " + mValueClass.getName() + "}";
        }
    }

    private static final class BaseMap implements AudioMetadataMap
    {
        private final Map<String, Object> mValues = new HashMap<>();
        private final Map<String, Key<?>> mKeys = new HashMap<>();

        @Override
        public <T> boolean containsKey(Key<T> key)
        {
            Key<?> stored = mKeys.get(key.getName());
            return stored != null && stored.getValueClass() == key.getValueClass();
        }

        @Override
        public AudioMetadataMap dup()
        {
            BaseMap copy = new BaseMap();
            copy.mValues.putAll(mValues);
            copy.mKeys.putAll(mKeys);
            return copy;
        }

        @Override
        public <T> T get(Key<T> key)
        {
            if (!containsKey(key)) return null;

            return key.getValueClass().cast(mValues.get(key.getName()));
        }

        @Override
        public int size()
        {
            return mValues.size();
        }

        @Override
        public <T> T remove(Key<T> key)
        {
            if (!containsKey(key)) return null;

            mKeys.remove(key.getName());
            return key.getValueClass().cast(mValues.remove(key.getName()));
        }

        @Override
        public <T> T set(Key<T> key, T value)
        {
            Objects.requireNonNull(value);

            if (!key.getValueClass().isInstance(value))
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Value class " + value.getClass() + " does not match " + key);
            }

            T previous = get(key);
            mKeys.put(key.getName(), key);
            mValues.put(key.getName(), value);
            return previous;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object object)
        {
            if (this == object) return true;
            if (!(object instanceof BaseMap)) return false;

            return mValues.equals(((BaseMap)object).mValues);
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return mValues.hashCode();
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return mValues.toString();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.media;

import android.media.projection.MediaProjection;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class AudioPlaybackCaptureConfiguration
{
    private final MediaProjection mProjection;
    private final int[] mMatchingUsages;
    private final int[] mExcludeUsages;
    private final int[] mMatchingUids;
    private final int[] mExcludeUids;

    private AudioPlaybackCaptureConfiguration(MediaProjection projection, int[] matchingUsages, int[] excludeUsages,
        int[] matchingUids, int[] excludeUids)
    {
        mProjection = projection;
        mMatchingUsages = matchingUsages;
        mExcludeUsages = excludeUsages;
        mMatchingUids = matchingUids;
        mExcludeUids = excludeUids;
    }

    public int[] getExcludeUids()
    {
        return mExcludeUids.clone();
    }

    public int[] getExcludeUsages()
    {
        return mExcludeUsages.clone();
    }

    public int[] getMatchingUids()
    {
        return mMatchingUids.clone();
    }

    public int[] getMatchingUsages()
    {
        return mMatchingUsages.clone();
    }

    public MediaProjection getMediaProjection()
    {
        return mProjection;
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private static final int RULE_NONE = 0;
        private static final int RULE_MATCH = 1;
        private static final int RULE_EXCLUDE = 2;

        private final MediaProjection mProjection;
        private final List<Integer> mMatchingUsages = new ArrayList<>();
        private final List<Integer> mExcludeUsages = new ArrayList<>();
        private final List<Integer> mMatchingUids = new ArrayList<>();
        private final List<Integer> mExcludeUids = new ArrayList<>();
        private int mUsageRule = RULE_NONE;
        private int mUidRule = RULE_NONE;

        public Builder(MediaProjection projection)
        {
            mProjection = Objects.requireNonNull(projection);
        }

        public Builder addMatchingUid(int uid)
        {
            if (mUidRule == RULE_EXCLUDE) throw new IllegalStateException("Inclusive and exclusive uid rules cannot be combined");

            mUidRule = RULE_MATCH;
            if (!mMatchingUids.contains(uid)) mMatchingUids.add(uid);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder addMatchingUsage(int usage)
        {
            if (mUsageRule == RULE_EXCLUDE)
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Inclusive and exclusive usage rules cannot be combined");
            }

            if (!AudioAttributes.isValidUsage(usage)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid usage " + usage);

            mUsageRule = RULE_MATCH;
            if (!mMatchingUsages.contains(usage)) mMatchingUsages.add(usage);
            return this;
        }

        public AudioPlaybackCaptureConfiguration build()
        {
            return new AudioPlaybackCaptureConfiguration(mProjection, toArray(mMatchingUsages), toArray(mExcludeUsages),
                toArray(mMatchingUids), toArray(mExcludeUids));
        }

        public Builder excludeUid(int uid)
        {
            if (mUidRule == RULE_MATCH) throw new IllegalStateException("Inclusive and exclusive uid rules cannot be combined");

            mUidRule = RULE_EXCLUDE;
            if (!mExcludeUids.contains(uid)) mExcludeUids.add(uid);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder excludeUsage(int usage)
        {
            if (mUsageRule == RULE_MATCH)
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Inclusive and exclusive usage rules cannot be combined");
            }

            if (!AudioAttributes.isValidUsage(usage)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid usage " + usage);

            mUsageRule = RULE_EXCLUDE;
            if (!mExcludeUsages.contains(usage)) mExcludeUsages.add(usage);
            return this;
        }

        private static int[] toArray(List<Integer> values)
        {
            int[] result = new int[values.size()];

            for (int index = 0; index < result.length; index++)
            {
                result[index] = values.get(index);
            }

            return result;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    public static final int MASTERED_FOR_HEADPHONE = 4;

        {

            int programId = source.readInt();
            String languageTag = source.readString();
            Locale locale = languageTag == null ? null : Locale.forLanguageTag(languageTag);
            int masteringIndication = source.readInt();
            boolean audioDescription = source.readBoolean();
            boolean spokenSubtitles = source.readBoolean();
            boolean dialogueEnhancement = source.readBoolean();
            int labelCount = source.readInt();
            Map<Locale, String> labels = new HashMap<>();

            for (int index = 0; index < labelCount; index++)

                Locale labelLocale = Locale.forLanguageTag(source.readString());
                labels.put(labelLocale, source.readString());
            }

            return new AudioPresentation(presentationId, programId, locale, masteringIndication, audioDescription,
                spokenSubtitles, dialogueEnhancement, labels);
        }

        return mPresentationId == other.mPresentationId && mProgramId == other.mProgramId
            && Objects.equals(mLocale, other.mLocale) && mMasteringIndication == other.mMasteringIndication
            && mAudioDescriptionAvailable == other.mAudioDescriptionAvailable
```

```java
import android.content.Context;
import android.media.metrics.LogSessionId;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.PersistableBundle;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;

public class AudioRecord implements AudioRecordingMonitor, AudioRouting, MicrophoneDirection
{
    public static final int ERROR = -1;
    public static final int ERROR_BAD_VALUE = -2;
    public static final int ERROR_DEAD_OBJECT = -6;
    public static final int ERROR_INVALID_OPERATION = -3;
    public static final int READ_BLOCKING = 0;
    public static final int READ_NON_BLOCKING = 1;
    public static final int RECORDSTATE_RECORDING = 3;
    public static final int RECORDSTATE_STOPPED = 1;
    public static final int STATE_INITIALIZED = 1;
    public static final int STATE_UNINITIALIZED = 0;
    public static final int SUCCESS = 0;

    private static final int SAMPLE_RATE_MIN = 4000;
    private static final int SAMPLE_RATE_MAX = 192000;
    private static final int DEFAULT_SAMPLE_RATE = 48000;
    private static final int AUDIO_SOURCE_MAX = 10;
    private static final long NANOS_PER_SECOND = 1000000000L;

    private final Object mLock = new Object();
    private final int mAudioSource;
    private final int mSampleRate;
    private final int mChannelMask;
    private final int mChannelIndexMask;
    private final int mChannelCount;
    private final int mEncoding;
    private final int mFrameSize;
    private final int mBufferFrames;
    private final int mSessionId;
    private final boolean mPrivacySensitive;
    private final Looper mInitializationLooper;

    private int mState = STATE_UNINITIALIZED;
    private int mRecordingState = RECORDSTATE_STOPPED;
    private long mStartNanos;
    private long mFramesConsumed;
    private long mFramesCapturedBase;
    private int mMarkerPosition;
    private boolean mMarkerReached;
    private int mPeriodFrames;
    private long mNextPeriodFrame;
    private LogSessionId mLogSessionId = LogSessionId.LOG_SESSION_ID_NONE;
    private AudioDeviceInfo mPreferredDevice;
    private OnRecordPositionUpdateListener mPositionListener;
    private Handler mPositionHandler;
    private Thread mNotifierThread;
    private final Map<AudioRouting.OnRoutingChangedListener, Handler> mRoutingListeners = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<AudioManager.AudioRecordingCallback, Executor> mRecordingCallbacks = new HashMap<>();

    public AudioRecord(int audioSource, int sampleRateInHz, int channelConfig, int audioFormat, int bufferSizeInBytes)
        throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        this(audioSource, legacyFormat(sampleRateInHz, channelConfig, audioFormat), bufferSizeInBytes, false);
    }

    private AudioRecord(int audioSource, AudioFormat format, int bufferSizeInBytes, boolean privacySensitive)
    {
        if (audioSource == MediaRecorder.AudioSource.DEFAULT) audioSource = MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC;
        if (audioSource < MediaRecorder.AudioSource.DEFAULT || audioSource > AUDIO_SOURCE_MAX)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid audio source " + audioSource);
        }

        int sampleRate = format.getSampleRate();
        if (sampleRate == AudioFormat.SAMPLE_RATE_UNSPECIFIED) sampleRate = DEFAULT_SAMPLE_RATE;
        if (sampleRate < SAMPLE_RATE_MIN || sampleRate > SAMPLE_RATE_MAX)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(sampleRate + "Hz is not a supported sample rate.");
        }

        int encoding = format.getEncoding();
        if (encoding == AudioFormat.ENCODING_DEFAULT || encoding == AudioFormat.ENCODING_INVALID)
        {
            encoding = AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT;
        }

        if (!AudioTrack.isPcm(encoding)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported sample encoding " + encoding);

        int channelMask = format.getChannelMask();
        int channelIndexMask = format.getChannelIndexMask();
        int channelCount;

        if (channelIndexMask != 0)
        {
            channelCount = Integer.bitCount(channelIndexMask);
        }
        else
        {
            if (channelMask == AudioFormat.CHANNEL_INVALID || channelMask == AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_DEFAULT)
            {
                channelMask = AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_MONO;
            }

            channelCount = Integer.bitCount(channelMask);
        }

        if (channelCount <= 0 || channelCount > 30) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported channel configuration.");

        int frameSize = channelCount * AudioTrack.bytesPerSample(encoding);
        if (bufferSizeInBytes < 1 || bufferSizeInBytes % frameSize != 0)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid audio buffer size " + bufferSizeInBytes);
        }

        mAudioSource = audioSource;
        mSampleRate = sampleRate;
        mChannelMask = channelMask;
        mChannelIndexMask = channelIndexMask;
        mChannelCount = channelCount;
        mEncoding = encoding;
        mFrameSize = frameSize;
        mBufferFrames = bufferSizeInBytes / frameSize;
        mSessionId = AudioTrack.newAudioSessionId();
        mPrivacySensitive = privacySensitive;

        Looper looper = Looper.myLooper();
        mInitializationLooper = looper != null ? looper : Looper.getMainLooper();
        mState = STATE_INITIALIZED;
    }

    private static int inputChannelCount(int channelConfig)
    {
        switch (channelConfig)
        {
            case AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_DEFAULT:
            case AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_MONO:
            case AudioFormat.CHANNEL_CONFIGURATION_MONO:
                return 1;
            case AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_STEREO:
            case AudioFormat.CHANNEL_CONFIGURATION_STEREO:
            case AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_FRONT | AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_BACK:
                return 2;
            default:
                return 0;
        }
    }

    private static AudioFormat legacyFormat(int sampleRate, int channelConfig, int encoding)
    {
        int channels = inputChannelCount(channelConfig);
        if (channels == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported channel configuration.");

        int channelMask;
        if (channels == 1)
        {
            channelMask = AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_MONO;
        }
        else if (channelConfig == (AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_FRONT | AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_BACK))
        {
            channelMask = channelConfig;
        }
        else
        {
            channelMask = AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_STEREO;
        }

        if (encoding == AudioFormat.ENCODING_DEFAULT) encoding = AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT;
        if (!AudioTrack.isPcm(encoding)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported sample encoding " + encoding);
        if (sampleRate < SAMPLE_RATE_MIN || sampleRate > SAMPLE_RATE_MAX)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(sampleRate + "Hz is not a supported sample rate.");
        }

        return new AudioFormat.Builder().setSampleRate(sampleRate).setChannelMask(channelMask).setEncoding(encoding).build();
    }

    @Deprecated

        synchronized (mRoutingListeners)
        {
            mRoutingListeners.put(listener, handler != null ? handler : new Handler(mInitializationLooper));
        }

    public static int getMinBufferSize(int sampleRateInHz, int channelConfig, int audioFormat)
    {
        int channels = inputChannelCount(channelConfig);
        if (channels == 0) return ERROR_BAD_VALUE;
        if (!AudioTrack.isPcm(audioFormat)) return ERROR_BAD_VALUE;
        if (sampleRateInHz < SAMPLE_RATE_MIN || sampleRateInHz > SAMPLE_RATE_MAX) return ERROR_BAD_VALUE;

        return AudioTrack.minimumFrames(sampleRateInHz) * channels * AudioTrack.bytesPerSample(audioFormat);
    }

    public int getTimestamp(AudioTimestamp outTimestamp, int timebase)
    {
        if (outTimestamp == null || (timebase != AudioTimestamp.TIMEBASE_BOOTTIME && timebase != AudioTimestamp.TIMEBASE_MONOTONIC))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        }

        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mState != STATE_INITIALIZED || mRecordingState != RECORDSTATE_RECORDING) return ERROR_INVALID_OPERATION;

            long now = System.nanoTime();
            outTimestamp.framePosition = capturedFramesLocked(now);
            outTimestamp.nanoTime = now;
            return SUCCESS;
        }

    public int read(byte[] audioData, int offsetInBytes, int sizeInBytes, int readMode)
    {
        if (mState != STATE_INITIALIZED || mEncoding == AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT) return ERROR_INVALID_OPERATION;
        if (readMode != READ_BLOCKING && readMode != READ_NON_BLOCKING) return ERROR_BAD_VALUE;
        if (audioData == null || offsetInBytes < 0 || sizeInBytes < 0 || offsetInBytes + sizeInBytes < 0
            || offsetInBytes + sizeInBytes > audioData.length)
        {
            return ERROR_BAD_VALUE;
        }

        int bytes = readFrames(sizeInBytes / mFrameSize, readMode == READ_BLOCKING) * mFrameSize;
        if (bytes < 0) return bytes;

        byte silence = mEncoding == AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_8BIT ? (byte)0x80 : 0;
        Arrays.fill(audioData, offsetInBytes, offsetInBytes + bytes, silence);
        return bytes;
    }

    public int read(float[] audioData, int offsetInFloats, int sizeInFloats, int readMode)
    {
        if (mState != STATE_INITIALIZED || mEncoding != AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT) return ERROR_INVALID_OPERATION;
        if (readMode != READ_BLOCKING && readMode != READ_NON_BLOCKING) return ERROR_BAD_VALUE;
        if (audioData == null || offsetInFloats < 0 || sizeInFloats < 0 || offsetInFloats + sizeInFloats < 0
            || offsetInFloats + sizeInFloats > audioData.length)
        {
            return ERROR_BAD_VALUE;
        }

        int frames = readFrames(sizeInFloats / mChannelCount, readMode == READ_BLOCKING);
        if (frames < 0) return frames;

        int count = frames * mChannelCount;
        Arrays.fill(audioData, offsetInFloats, offsetInFloats + count, 0.0f);
        return count;
    }

    public int read(ByteBuffer audioBuffer, int sizeInBytes)
    {
        return read(audioBuffer, sizeInBytes, READ_BLOCKING);
    }

    public int read(ByteBuffer audioBuffer, int sizeInBytes, int readMode)
    {
        if (mState != STATE_INITIALIZED) return ERROR_INVALID_OPERATION;
        if (readMode != READ_BLOCKING && readMode != READ_NON_BLOCKING) return ERROR_BAD_VALUE;
        if (audioBuffer == null || sizeInBytes < 0) return ERROR_BAD_VALUE;

        int limit = Math.min(sizeInBytes, audioBuffer.capacity());
        int bytes = readFrames(limit / mFrameSize, readMode == READ_BLOCKING) * mFrameSize;
        if (bytes < 0) return bytes;

        byte silence = mEncoding == AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_8BIT ? (byte)0x80 : 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < bytes; index++)
        {
            audioBuffer.put(index, silence);
        }

        return bytes;
    }

    public int read(short[] audioData, int offsetInShorts, int sizeInShorts)
    {
        return read(audioData, offsetInShorts, sizeInShorts, READ_BLOCKING);
    }

    public int read(short[] audioData, int offsetInShorts, int sizeInShorts, int readMode)
    {
        if (mState != STATE_INITIALIZED || mEncoding == AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT) return ERROR_INVALID_OPERATION;
        if (readMode != READ_BLOCKING && readMode != READ_NON_BLOCKING) return ERROR_BAD_VALUE;
        if (audioData == null || offsetInShorts < 0 || sizeInShorts < 0 || offsetInShorts + sizeInShorts < 0
            || offsetInShorts + sizeInShorts > audioData.length)
        {
            return ERROR_BAD_VALUE;
        }

        int bytes = readFrames(sizeInShorts * 2 / mFrameSize, readMode == READ_BLOCKING) * mFrameSize;
        if (bytes < 0) return bytes;

        int count = bytes / 2;
        Arrays.fill(audioData, offsetInShorts, offsetInShorts + count, (short)0);
        return count;
    }

    private int readFrames(int frames, boolean blocking)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            int done = 0;

            while (done < frames)
            {
                if (mState != STATE_INITIALIZED) return done > 0 ? done : ERROR_DEAD_OBJECT;
                if (mRecordingState != RECORDSTATE_RECORDING) break;

                long now = System.nanoTime();
                long available = capturedFramesLocked(now) - mFramesConsumed;

                if (available > mBufferFrames)
                {
                    mFramesConsumed += available - mBufferFrames;
                    available = mBufferFrames;
                }

                if (available > 0)
                {
                    long chunk = Math.min(available, frames - done);
                    mFramesConsumed += chunk;
                    done += (int)chunk;
                    continue;
                }

                if (!blocking) break;

                long needed = Math.max(1, Math.min(frames - done, mBufferFrames / 4));
                long waitNanos = needed * NANOS_PER_SECOND / mSampleRate;

                try
                {
                    mLock.wait(Math.max(1, waitNanos / 1000000L), (int)(waitNanos % 1000000L));
                }
                catch (InterruptedException exception)
                {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                    break;
                }
            }

            return done;
        }
    }

    private long capturedFramesLocked(long now)
    {
        if (mRecordingState != RECORDSTATE_RECORDING) return mFramesCapturedBase;
        return mFramesCapturedBase + (now - mStartNanos) * mSampleRate / NANOS_PER_SECOND;
    }

    @Override
    public void registerAudioRecordingCallback(Executor executor, AudioManager.AudioRecordingCallback callback)
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Illegal null AudioRecordingCallback");
        if (executor == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Illegal null Executor");

        synchronized (mRecordingCallbacks)
        {
            if (mRecordingCallbacks.containsKey(callback)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("AudioRecordingCallback already registered");
            mRecordingCallbacks.put(callback, executor);
        }
    }

    public void release()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mRecordingState == RECORDSTATE_RECORDING) mFramesCapturedBase = capturedFramesLocked(System.nanoTime());

            mRecordingState = RECORDSTATE_STOPPED;
            mState = STATE_UNINITIALIZED;
            mPositionListener = null;
            mLock.notifyAll();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize()
    {
        release();
    }

    public int setNotificationMarkerPosition(int markerInFrames)

            mMarkerReached = markerInFrames <= 0 || capturedFramesLocked(System.nanoTime()) >= markerInFrames;
            mLock.notifyAll();

    public int setPositionNotificationPeriod(int periodInFrames)

            mPeriodFrames = Math.max(0, periodInFrames);
            long captured = capturedFramesLocked(System.nanoTime());
            mNextPeriodFrame = mPeriodFrames == 0 ? 0 : (captured / mPeriodFrames + 1) * mPeriodFrames;
            mLock.notifyAll();
            return SUCCESS;
        }

    public void setRecordPositionUpdateListener(AudioRecord.OnRecordPositionUpdateListener listener, Handler handler)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            mPositionListener = listener;

            if (listener == null)
            {
                mPositionHandler = null;
            }
            else if (handler != null)
            {
                mPositionHandler = handler;
            }
            else
            {
                mPositionHandler = mInitializationLooper == null ? null : new Handler(mInitializationLooper);
            }

            mLock.notifyAll();
            ensureNotifierLocked();
        }
    }

    public void startRecording() throws IllegalStateException
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mState != STATE_INITIALIZED) throw new IllegalStateException("startRecording() called on an uninitialized AudioRecord.");
            if (mRecordingState == RECORDSTATE_RECORDING) return;

            mStartNanos = System.nanoTime();
            mFramesCapturedBase = 0;
            mFramesConsumed = 0;
            mMarkerReached = mMarkerPosition <= 0;
            mNextPeriodFrame = mPeriodFrames;
            mRecordingState = RECORDSTATE_RECORDING;
            mLock.notifyAll();
            ensureNotifierLocked();
        }
    }

    public void startRecording(MediaSyncEvent syncEvent) throws IllegalStateException
    {
        if (syncEvent == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Illegal null MediaSyncEvent");
        startRecording();
    }

    public void stop() throws IllegalStateException
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mState != STATE_INITIALIZED) throw new IllegalStateException("stop() called on an uninitialized AudioRecord.");
            if (mRecordingState != RECORDSTATE_RECORDING) return;

            mFramesCapturedBase = capturedFramesLocked(System.nanoTime());
            mRecordingState = RECORDSTATE_STOPPED;
            mLock.notifyAll();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void unregisterAudioRecordingCallback(AudioManager.AudioRecordingCallback callback)
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Illegal null AudioRecordingCallback argument");

        synchronized (mRecordingCallbacks)
        {
            if (mRecordingCallbacks.remove(callback) == null)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("AudioRecordingCallback was not registered");
            }
        }
    }

    private void ensureNotifierLocked()
    {
        if (mNotifierThread != null || mPositionListener == null || mState != STATE_INITIALIZED) return;

        mNotifierThread = new Thread(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                runNotifier();
            }
        }, "AudioRecordPosition");
        mNotifierThread.setDaemon(true);
        mNotifierThread.start();
    }

    private void runNotifier()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            try
            {
                while (mState == STATE_INITIALIZED && mPositionListener != null)
                {
                    if (mRecordingState != RECORDSTATE_RECORDING)
                    {
                        mLock.wait(100);
                        continue;
                    }

                    long captured = capturedFramesLocked(System.nanoTime());
                    final OnRecordPositionUpdateListener listener = mPositionListener;
                    Handler handler = mPositionHandler;

                    if (mMarkerPosition > 0 && !mMarkerReached && captured >= mMarkerPosition)
                    {
                        mMarkerReached = true;
                        dispatch(handler, new Runnable()
                        {
                            @Override
                            public void run()
                            {
                                listener.onMarkerReached(AudioRecord.this);
                            }
                        });
                    }

                    if (mPeriodFrames > 0 && captured >= mNextPeriodFrame)
                    {
                        mNextPeriodFrame = (captured / mPeriodFrames + 1) * mPeriodFrames;
                        dispatch(handler, new Runnable()
                        {
                            @Override
                            public void run()
                            {
                                listener.onPeriodicNotification(AudioRecord.this);
                            }
                        });
                    }

                    long target = Long.MAX_VALUE;
                    if (mMarkerPosition > 0 && !mMarkerReached) target = mMarkerPosition;
                    if (mPeriodFrames > 0) target = Math.min(target, mNextPeriodFrame);

                    long waitNanos = target == Long.MAX_VALUE ? 100000000L
                        : Math.max(1, target - captured) * NANOS_PER_SECOND / mSampleRate;
                    waitNanos = Math.max(1000000L, Math.min(waitNanos, 100000000L));
                    mLock.wait(waitNanos / 1000000L, (int)(waitNanos % 1000000L));
                }
            }
            catch (InterruptedException exception)
            {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            }
            finally
            {
                mNotifierThread = null;
            }
        }
    }

    private static void dispatch(Handler handler, Runnable runnable)
    {
        if (handler != null)
        {
            handler.post(runnable);
        }
        else
        {
            runnable.run();
        }
    }

    @Deprecated
    public interface OnRoutingChangedListener extends AudioRouting.OnRoutingChangedListener
    {
        void onRoutingChanged(AudioRecord audioRecord);

        @Override
        default void onRoutingChanged(AudioRouting router)
        {
            if (router instanceof AudioRecord) onRoutingChanged((AudioRecord)router);
        }
    }

    public interface OnRecordPositionUpdateListener
    {
        void onMarkerReached(AudioRecord recorder);

        void onPeriodicNotification(AudioRecord recorder);
    }
```
