`java/android/media/MediaCodecInfo.java`:

```java
package android.media;

import android.util.Range;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;

public final class MediaCodecInfo
{
    public static final int SECURITY_MODEL_MEMORY_SAFE = 1;
    public static final int SECURITY_MODEL_SANDBOXED = 0;

    static final int FLAG_IS_ENCODER = 1;
    static final int FLAG_IS_VENDOR = 2;
    static final int FLAG_IS_SOFTWARE_ONLY = 4;
    static final int FLAG_IS_HARDWARE_ACCELERATED = 8;

    private final String mName;
    private final String mCanonicalName;
    private final int mFlags;
    private final int mSecurityModel;
    private final CodecCapabilities[] mCapabilities;

    MediaCodecInfo(String name, String canonicalName, int flags, int securityModel, CodecCapabilities[] capabilities)
    {
        mName = name;
        mCanonicalName = canonicalName;
        mFlags = flags;
        mSecurityModel = securityModel;
        mCapabilities = capabilities.clone();
    }

    public String getCanonicalName()
    {
        return mCanonicalName;
    }

    public MediaCodecInfo.CodecCapabilities getCapabilitiesForType(String type)
    {
        for (CodecCapabilities capabilities : mCapabilities)
        {
            if (capabilities.getMimeType().equalsIgnoreCase(type)) return capabilities;
        }

        throw new IllegalArgumentException("codec does not support type");
    }

    public String getName()
    {
        return mName;
    }

    public int getSecurityModel()
    {
        return mSecurityModel;
    }

    public String[] getSupportedTypes()
    {
        String[] types = new String[mCapabilities.length];

        for (int index = 0; index < types.length; index++)
        {
            types[index] = mCapabilities[index].getMimeType();
        }

        Arrays.sort(types);
        return types;
    }

    public boolean isAlias()
    {
        return !mName.equals(mCanonicalName);
    }

    public boolean isEncoder()
    {
        return (mFlags & FLAG_IS_ENCODER) != 0;
    }

    public boolean isHardwareAccelerated()
    {
        return (mFlags & FLAG_IS_HARDWARE_ACCELERATED) != 0;
    }

    public boolean isSoftwareOnly()
    {
        return (mFlags & FLAG_IS_SOFTWARE_ONLY) != 0;
    }

    public boolean isVendor()
    {
        return (mFlags & FLAG_IS_VENDOR) != 0;
    }

    private static int alignUp(int value, int alignment)
    {
        return (value + alignment - 1) / alignment * alignment;
    }

    public static final class VideoCapabilities
    {
        private final Range<Integer> mWidthRange;
        private final Range<Integer> mHeightRange;
        private final int mWidthAlignment;
        private final int mHeightAlignment;
        private final Range<Integer> mFrameRateRange;
        private final Range<Integer> mBitrateRange;
        private final long mMaxPixelsPerSecond;
        private final long mMaxPixels;
        private final List<PerformancePoint> mPerformancePoints;

        VideoCapabilities(Range<Integer> widthRange, Range<Integer> heightRange, int widthAlignment, int heightAlignment,
            Range<Integer> frameRateRange, Range<Integer> bitrateRange, long maxPixels, long maxPixelsPerSecond,
            List<PerformancePoint> performancePoints)
        {
            mWidthRange = widthRange;
            mHeightRange = heightRange;
            mWidthAlignment = widthAlignment;
            mHeightAlignment = heightAlignment;
            mFrameRateRange = frameRateRange;
            mBitrateRange = bitrateRange;
            mMaxPixels = maxPixels;
            mMaxPixelsPerSecond = maxPixelsPerSecond;
            mPerformancePoints = Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(performancePoints));
        }

        public boolean areSizeAndRateSupported(int width, int height, double frameRate)
        {
            if (!isSizeSupported(width, height)) return false;

            Range<Double> rates = getSupportedFrameRatesFor(width, height);
            return frameRate >= rates.getLower() && frameRate <= rates.getUpper();
        }

        public Range<Double> getAchievableFrameRatesFor(int width, int height)
        {
            if (!isSizeSupported(width, height)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("unsupported size");

            return null;
        }

        public Range<Integer> getBitrateRange()
        {
            return mBitrateRange;
        }

        public int getHeightAlignment()
        {
            return mHeightAlignment;
        }

        public Range<Integer> getSupportedFrameRates()
        {
            return mFrameRateRange;
        }

        public Range<Double> getSupportedFrameRatesFor(int width, int height)
        {
            if (!isSizeSupported(width, height)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("unsupported size");

            long pixels = (long)alignUp(width, mWidthAlignment) * alignUp(height, mHeightAlignment);
            double upper = Math.min(mFrameRateRange.getUpper(), (double)mMaxPixelsPerSecond / pixels);
            return Range.create(Math.min((double)mFrameRateRange.getLower(), upper), upper);
        }

        public Range<Integer> getSupportedHeights()
        {
            return mHeightRange;
        }

        public Range<Integer> getSupportedHeightsFor(int width)
        {
            if (!mWidthRange.contains(width) || width % mWidthAlignment != 0)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("unsupported width");
            }

            int upper = (int)Math.min(mHeightRange.getUpper(), mMaxPixels / alignUp(width, mWidthAlignment));
            upper = upper / mHeightAlignment * mHeightAlignment;
            return Range.create(mHeightRange.getLower(), Math.max(mHeightRange.getLower(), upper));
        }

        public List<MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint> getSupportedPerformancePoints()
        {
            return mPerformancePoints;
        }

        public Range<Integer> getSupportedWidths()
        {
            return mWidthRange;
        }

        public Range<Integer> getSupportedWidthsFor(int height)
        {
            if (!mHeightRange.contains(height) || height % mHeightAlignment != 0)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("unsupported height");
            }

            int upper = (int)Math.min(mWidthRange.getUpper(), mMaxPixels / alignUp(height, mHeightAlignment));
            upper = upper / mWidthAlignment * mWidthAlignment;
            return Range.create(mWidthRange.getLower(), Math.max(mWidthRange.getLower(), upper));
        }

        public int getWidthAlignment()
        {
            return mWidthAlignment;
        }

        public boolean isSizeSupported(int width, int height)
        {
            if (!mWidthRange.contains(width) || !mHeightRange.contains(height)) return false;
            if (width % mWidthAlignment != 0 || height % mHeightAlignment != 0) return false;

            return (long)width * height <= mMaxPixels;
        }

        public static final class PerformancePoint
        {
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint FHD_100 = new PerformancePoint(1920, 1080, 100);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint FHD_120 = new PerformancePoint(1920, 1080, 120);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint FHD_200 = new PerformancePoint(1920, 1080, 200);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint FHD_24 = new PerformancePoint(1920, 1080, 24);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint FHD_240 = new PerformancePoint(1920, 1080, 240);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint FHD_25 = new PerformancePoint(1920, 1080, 25);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint FHD_30 = new PerformancePoint(1920, 1080, 30);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint FHD_50 = new PerformancePoint(1920, 1080, 50);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint FHD_60 = new PerformancePoint(1920, 1080, 60);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint HD_100 = new PerformancePoint(1280, 720, 100);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint HD_120 = new PerformancePoint(1280, 720, 120);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint HD_200 = new PerformancePoint(1280, 720, 200);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint HD_24 = new PerformancePoint(1280, 720, 24);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint HD_240 = new PerformancePoint(1280, 720, 240);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint HD_25 = new PerformancePoint(1280, 720, 25);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint HD_30 = new PerformancePoint(1280, 720, 30);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint HD_50 = new PerformancePoint(1280, 720, 50);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint HD_60 = new PerformancePoint(1280, 720, 60);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint SD_24 = new PerformancePoint(720, 480, 24);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint SD_25 = new PerformancePoint(720, 576, 25);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint SD_30 = new PerformancePoint(720, 480, 30);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint SD_48 = new PerformancePoint(720, 480, 48);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint SD_50 = new PerformancePoint(720, 576, 50);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint SD_60 = new PerformancePoint(720, 480, 60);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint UHD_100 = new PerformancePoint(3840, 2160, 100);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint UHD_120 = new PerformancePoint(3840, 2160, 120);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint UHD_200 = new PerformancePoint(3840, 2160, 200);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint UHD_24 = new PerformancePoint(3840, 2160, 24);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint UHD_240 = new PerformancePoint(3840, 2160, 240);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint UHD_25 = new PerformancePoint(3840, 2160, 25);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint UHD_30 = new PerformancePoint(3840, 2160, 30);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint UHD_50 = new PerformancePoint(3840, 2160, 50);
            public static final MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint UHD_60 = new PerformancePoint(3840, 2160, 60);

            private static final int BLOCK_SIZE = 16;

            private final int mWidth;
            private final int mHeight;
            private final int mFrameRate;

            public PerformancePoint(int width, int height, int frameRate)
            {
                if (width <= 0 || height <= 0 || frameRate <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid performance point");

                mWidth = width;
                mHeight = height;
                mFrameRate = frameRate;
            }

            private long getMacroBlocks()
            {
                return (long)((mWidth + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE) * ((mHeight + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE);
            }

            private int getMaxDimensionBlocks()
            {
                return (Math.max(mWidth, mHeight) + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE;
            }

            public boolean covers(MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities.PerformancePoint other)
            {
                return getMacroBlocks() >= other.getMacroBlocks() && getMaxDimensionBlocks() >= other.getMaxDimensionBlocks()
                    && getMacroBlocks() * mFrameRate >= other.getMacroBlocks() * other.mFrameRate && mFrameRate >= other.mFrameRate;
            }

            public boolean covers(MediaFormat format)
            {
                Number rate = format.getNumber(MediaFormat.KEY_FRAME_RATE, 0);
                int frameRate = (int)Math.ceil(rate.doubleValue());
                int width = format.getInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_WIDTH, 0);
                int height = format.getInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_HEIGHT, 0);
                if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return false;

                return covers(new PerformancePoint(width, height, Math.max(1, frameRate)));
            }

            @Override
            public boolean equals(Object object)
            {
                if (!(object instanceof PerformancePoint)) return false;

                PerformancePoint other = (PerformancePoint)object;
                return getMacroBlocks() == other.getMacroBlocks() && getMaxDimensionBlocks() == other.getMaxDimensionBlocks()
                    && mFrameRate == other.mFrameRate;
            }

            @Override
            public int hashCode()
            {
                return Objects.hash(getMacroBlocks(), getMaxDimensionBlocks(), mFrameRate);
            }

            @Override
            public String toString()
            {
                return "PerformancePoint(" + mWidth + "x" + mHeight + "@" + mFrameRate + ")";
            }
        }
    }

        public int level;
        public int profile;

        public CodecProfileLevel()
        {
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object object)
        {
            if (!(object instanceof CodecProfileLevel)) return false;

            CodecProfileLevel other = (CodecProfileLevel)object;
            return other.profile == profile && other.level == level;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return Long.hashCode(((long)profile << Integer.SIZE) | level);
        }
    }

        private String mMimeType;
        private int mMaxSupportedInstances;
        private final Set<String> mFeaturesSupported = new HashSet<>();
        private final Set<String> mFeaturesRequired = new HashSet<>();
        private MediaFormat mDefaultFormat = new MediaFormat();
        private AudioCapabilities mAudioCapabilities;
        private VideoCapabilities mVideoCapabilities;
        private EncoderCapabilities mEncoderCapabilities;

        public CodecCapabilities()
        {
            colorFormats = new int[0];
            profileLevels = new CodecProfileLevel[0];
        }

        CodecCapabilities(String mimeType, CodecProfileLevel[] levels, int[] formats, Set<String> supported, Set<String> required,
            MediaFormat defaultFormat, AudioCapabilities audio, VideoCapabilities video, EncoderCapabilities encoder, int maxInstances)
        {
            mMimeType = mimeType;
            profileLevels = levels.clone();
            colorFormats = formats.clone();
            mFeaturesSupported.addAll(supported);
            mFeaturesSupported.addAll(required);
            mFeaturesRequired.addAll(required);
            mDefaultFormat = new MediaFormat(defaultFormat);
            mAudioCapabilities = audio;
            mVideoCapabilities = video;
            mEncoderCapabilities = encoder;
            mMaxSupportedInstances = maxInstances;
        }

        public static MediaCodecInfo.CodecCapabilities createFromProfileLevel(String mime, int profile, int level)
        {
            if (mime == null) return null;

            CodecProfileLevel profileLevel = new CodecProfileLevel();
            profileLevel.profile = profile;
            profileLevel.level = level;

            MediaFormat defaultFormat = new MediaFormat();
            defaultFormat.setString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME, mime);

            String lower = mime.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            AudioCapabilities audio = null;
            VideoCapabilities video = null;
            int[] formats = new int[0];

            if (lower.startsWith("audio/"))
            {
                audio = new AudioCapabilities(Range.create(1, 510000000), new Range[] {Range.create(8000, 96000)}, 8);
            }
            else if (lower.startsWith("video/") || lower.startsWith("image/"))
            {
                video = new VideoCapabilities(Range.create(2, 4096), Range.create(2, 4096), 2, 2, Range.create(0, 960),
                    Range.create(1, 500000000), 4096L * 2304L, 4096L * 2304L * 60L, new ArrayList<>());
                formats = new int[] {COLOR_FormatYUV420Flexible};
            }
            else
            {
                return null;
            }

            return new CodecCapabilities(mime, new CodecProfileLevel[] {profileLevel}, formats, new HashSet<>(), new HashSet<>(),
                defaultFormat, audio, video, null, 1);
        }

        public MediaCodecInfo.AudioCapabilities getAudioCapabilities()
        {
            return mAudioCapabilities;
        }

        public MediaFormat getDefaultFormat()
        {
            return mDefaultFormat;
        }

        public MediaCodecInfo.EncoderCapabilities getEncoderCapabilities()
        {
            return mEncoderCapabilities;
        }

        public int getMaxSupportedInstances()
        {
            return mMaxSupportedInstances;
        }

        public String getMimeType()
        {
            return mMimeType;
        }

        public MediaCodecInfo.VideoCapabilities getVideoCapabilities()
        {
            return mVideoCapabilities;
        }

        public boolean isFeatureRequired(String name)
        {
            return mFeaturesRequired.contains(name);
        }

        public boolean isFeatureSupported(String name)
        {
            return mFeaturesSupported.contains(name);
        }

        public boolean isFormatSupported(MediaFormat format)
        {
            String mime = format.getString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME);
            if (mime != null && mMimeType != null && !mMimeType.equalsIgnoreCase(mime)) return false;

            for (String feature : format.getFeatures())
            {
                boolean enabled = format.getFeatureEnabled(feature);
                if (enabled && !isFeatureSupported(feature)) return false;
                if (!enabled && isFeatureRequired(feature)) return false;
            }

            if (mAudioCapabilities != null)
            {
                int sampleRate = format.getInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_SAMPLE_RATE, 0);
                int channelCount = format.getInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_CHANNEL_COUNT, 0);
                if (sampleRate != 0 && !mAudioCapabilities.isSampleRateSupported(sampleRate)) return false;
                if (channelCount != 0 && (channelCount < mAudioCapabilities.getMinInputChannelCount()
                    || channelCount > mAudioCapabilities.getMaxInputChannelCount())) return false;
            }

            if (mVideoCapabilities != null)
            {
                int width = format.getInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_WIDTH, 0);
                int height = format.getInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_HEIGHT, 0);
                if (width != 0 && height != 0 && !mVideoCapabilities.isSizeSupported(width, height)) return false;

                Number frameRate = format.getNumber(MediaFormat.KEY_FRAME_RATE, null);
                if (frameRate != null && width != 0 && height != 0
                    && !mVideoCapabilities.areSizeAndRateSupported(width, height, frameRate.doubleValue())) return false;
            }

            if (format.containsKey(MediaFormat.KEY_PROFILE) && profileLevels.length > 0)
            {
                int profile = format.getInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_PROFILE);
                boolean found = false;

                for (CodecProfileLevel level : profileLevels)
                {
                    if (level.profile == profile) found = true;
                }

                if (!found) return false;
            }

            return true;
        }
    }

    public static final class AudioCapabilities
    {
        private final Range<Integer> mBitrateRange;
        private final Range<Integer>[] mSampleRateRanges;
        private final int mMaxInputChannelCount;

        AudioCapabilities(Range<Integer> bitrateRange, Range<Integer>[] sampleRateRanges, int maxInputChannelCount)
        {
            mBitrateRange = bitrateRange;
            mSampleRateRanges = sampleRateRanges.clone();
            mMaxInputChannelCount = maxInputChannelCount;
        }

        public Range<Integer> getBitrateRange()
        {
            return mBitrateRange;
        }

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        public Range<Integer>[] getInputChannelCountRanges()
        {
            return new Range[] {Range.create(1, mMaxInputChannelCount)};
        }

        public int getMaxInputChannelCount()
        {
            return mMaxInputChannelCount;
        }

        public int getMinInputChannelCount()
        {
            return 1;
        }

        public Range<Integer>[] getSupportedSampleRateRanges()
        {
            return mSampleRateRanges.clone();
        }

        public int[] getSupportedSampleRates()
        {
            for (Range<Integer> range : mSampleRateRanges)
            {
                if (!range.getLower().equals(range.getUpper())) return null;
            }

            int[] rates = new int[mSampleRateRanges.length];

            for (int index = 0; index < rates.length; index++)
            {
                rates[index] = mSampleRateRanges[index].getLower();
            }

            return rates;
        }

        public boolean isSampleRateSupported(int sampleRate)
        {
            for (Range<Integer> range : mSampleRateRanges)
            {
                if (range.contains(sampleRate)) return true;
            }

            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/media/MediaCodecList.java`:

```java
package android.media;

public final class MediaCodecList
{
    public static final int ALL_CODECS = 1;
    public static final int REGULAR_CODECS = 0;

    private static final MediaCodecInfo[] CODEC_INFOS = new MediaCodecInfo[0];

    private final int mKind;

    public MediaCodecList(int kind)
    {
        mKind = kind;
    }

    public String findDecoderForFormat(MediaFormat format)
    {
        return findCodecForFormat(false, format);
    }

    public String findEncoderForFormat(MediaFormat format)
    {
        return findCodecForFormat(true, format);
    }

    public static int getCodecCount()
    {
        return CODEC_INFOS.length;
    }

    public static MediaCodecInfo getCodecInfoAt(int index)
    {
        if (index < 0 || index >= CODEC_INFOS.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException();

        return CODEC_INFOS[index];
    }

    public MediaCodecInfo[] getCodecInfos()
    {
        return CODEC_INFOS.clone();
    }

    private String findCodecForFormat(boolean encoder, MediaFormat format)
    {
        String mime = format.getString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME);
        if (mime == null) return null;

        for (MediaCodecInfo info : CODEC_INFOS)
        {
            if (info.isEncoder() != encoder) continue;

            for (String type : info.getSupportedTypes())
            {
                if (type.equalsIgnoreCase(mime) && info.getCapabilitiesForType(type).isFormatSupported(format))
                {
                    return info.getName();
                }
            }
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

`java/android/media/MediaDescription.java`:

```java
package android.media;

import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.text.TextUtils;

import java.util.Objects;

public class MediaDescription implements Parcelable
{
    public static final long BT_FOLDER_TYPE_ALBUMS = 2L;
    public static final long BT_FOLDER_TYPE_ARTISTS = 3L;
    public static final long BT_FOLDER_TYPE_GENRES = 4L;
    public static final long BT_FOLDER_TYPE_MIXED = 0L;
    public static final long BT_FOLDER_TYPE_PLAYLISTS = 5L;
    public static final long BT_FOLDER_TYPE_TITLES = 1L;
    public static final long BT_FOLDER_TYPE_YEARS = 6L;
    public static final String EXTRA_BT_FOLDER_TYPE = "android.media.extra.BT_FOLDER_TYPE";

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<MediaDescription> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<MediaDescription>()
    {
        @Override
        public MediaDescription createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new MediaDescription(source);
        }

        @Override
        public MediaDescription[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new MediaDescription[size];
        }
    };

    private final String mMediaId;
    private final CharSequence mTitle;
    private final CharSequence mSubtitle;
    private final CharSequence mDescription;
    private final Bitmap mIcon;
    private final Uri mIconUri;
    private final Bundle mExtras;
    private final Uri mMediaUri;

    private MediaDescription(String mediaId, CharSequence title, CharSequence subtitle, CharSequence description, Bitmap icon,
            Uri iconUri, Bundle extras, Uri mediaUri)
    {
        mMediaId = mediaId;
        mTitle = title;
        mSubtitle = subtitle;
        mDescription = description;
        mIcon = icon;
        mIconUri = iconUri;
        mExtras = extras;
        mMediaUri = mediaUri;
    }

    private MediaDescription(Parcel source)
    {
        mMediaId = source.readString();
        mTitle = TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
        mSubtitle = TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
        mDescription = TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
        mIcon = source.readTypedObject(Bitmap.CREATOR);
        mIconUri = source.readTypedObject(Uri.CREATOR);
        mExtras = source.readBundle();
        mMediaUri = source.readTypedObject(Uri.CREATOR);
    }

    public String getMediaId()
    {
        return mMediaId;
    }

    public CharSequence getTitle()
    {
        return mTitle;
    }

    public CharSequence getSubtitle()
    {
        return mSubtitle;
    }

    public CharSequence getDescription()
    {
        return mDescription;
    }

    public Bitmap getIconBitmap()
    {
        return mIcon;
    }

    public Uri getIconUri()
    {
        return mIconUri;
    }

    public Bundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    public Uri getMediaUri()
    {
        return mMediaUri;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mMediaId);
        TextUtils.writeToParcel(mTitle, dest, 0);
        TextUtils.writeToParcel(mSubtitle, dest, 0);
        TextUtils.writeToParcel(mDescription, dest, 0);
        dest.writeTypedObject(mIcon, flags);
        dest.writeTypedObject(mIconUri, flags);
        dest.writeBundle(mExtras);
        dest.writeTypedObject(mMediaUri, flags);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        if (object == this) return true;
        if (!(object instanceof MediaDescription)) return false;

        MediaDescription other = (MediaDescription)object;

        return Objects.equals(mMediaId, other.mMediaId) && TextUtils.equals(mTitle, other.mTitle)
                && TextUtils.equals(mSubtitle, other.mSubtitle) && TextUtils.equals(mDescription, other.mDescription)
                && Objects.equals(mIconUri, other.mIconUri) && Objects.equals(mMediaUri, other.mMediaUri);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mMediaId, String.valueOf(mTitle), String.valueOf(mSubtitle), mIconUri, mMediaUri);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mTitle + ", " + mSubtitle + ", " + mDescription;
    }

    public static class Builder
    {
        private String mMediaId;
        private CharSequence mTitle;
        private CharSequence mSubtitle;
        private CharSequence mDescription;
        private Bitmap mIcon;
        private Uri mIconUri;
        private Bundle mExtras;
        private Uri mMediaUri;

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public Builder setMediaId(String mediaId)
        {
            mMediaId = mediaId;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setTitle(CharSequence title)
        {
            mTitle = title;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setSubtitle(CharSequence subtitle)
        {
            mSubtitle = subtitle;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setDescription(CharSequence description)
        {
            mDescription = description;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setIconBitmap(Bitmap icon)
        {
            mIcon = icon;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setIconUri(Uri iconUri)
        {
            mIconUri = iconUri;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setExtras(Bundle extras)
        {
            mExtras = extras;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setMediaUri(Uri mediaUri)
        {
            mMediaUri = mediaUri;
            return this;
        }

        public MediaDescription build()
        {
            return new MediaDescription(mMediaId, mTitle, mSubtitle, mDescription, mIcon, mIconUri, mExtras, mMediaUri);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    public static final class MediaDrmStateException extends IllegalStateException implements MediaDrmThrowable
    {
        private final int mErrorCode;
        private final String mDiagnosticInfo;

        MediaDrmStateException(int errorCode, String detailMessage)
        {
            super(detailMessage);
            mErrorCode = errorCode;
            mDiagnosticInfo = "android.media.MediaDrm.error_" + (errorCode < 0 ? "neg_" : "") + Math.abs(errorCode);
        }

        public String getDiagnosticInfo()
        {
            return mDiagnosticInfo;
        }

        public int getErrorCode()
        {
            return mErrorCode;
        }

        public int getErrorContext()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        public int getOemError()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        public int getVendorError()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        public boolean isTransient()
        {
            return mErrorCode == ErrorCodes.ERROR_SESSION_NOT_OPENED || mErrorCode == ErrorCodes.ERROR_RESOURCE_CONTENTION;
        }
    }
```

```java
package android.media;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.AssetFileDescriptor;
import android.media.metrics.LogSessionId;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.PersistableBundle;

import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

public final class MediaExtractor
{
    public static final int SAMPLE_FLAG_ENCRYPTED = 2;
    public static final int SAMPLE_FLAG_PARTIAL_FRAME = 4;
    public static final int SAMPLE_FLAG_SYNC = 1;
    public static final int SEEK_TO_CLOSEST_SYNC = 2;
    public static final int SEEK_TO_NEXT_SYNC = 1;
    public static final int SEEK_TO_PREVIOUS_SYNC = 0;

    private final List<MediaFormat> mTracks = new ArrayList<>();
    private LogSessionId mLogSessionId = LogSessionId.LOG_SESSION_ID_NONE;
    private boolean mReleased;

    public MediaExtractor()
    {
    }

    private void checkNotReleased()
    {
        if (mReleased) throw new IllegalStateException("MediaExtractor is released");
    }

    private void checkTrack(int index)
    {
        checkNotReleased();

        if (index < 0 || index >= mTracks.size()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("track index " + index + " is out of range");
    }

    private IOException noExtractor()
    {
        checkNotReleased();
        return new IOException("Failed to instantiate extractor.");
    }

    public boolean advance()
    {
        checkNotReleased();
        return false;
    }

    public List<AudioPresentation> getAudioPresentations(int trackIndex)
    {
        checkTrack(trackIndex);
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public long getCachedDuration()
    {
        checkNotReleased();
        return -1;
    }

    public MediaExtractor.CasInfo getCasInfo(int index)
    {
        checkTrack(index);
        return null;
    }

    public DrmInitData getDrmInitData()
    {
        checkNotReleased();
        return null;
    }

    public LogSessionId getLogSessionId()
    {
        return mLogSessionId;
    }

    public PersistableBundle getMetrics()
    {
        PersistableBundle metrics = new PersistableBundle();
        metrics.putInt(MetricsConstants.TRACKS, mTracks.size());
        return metrics;
    }

    public Map<UUID, byte[]> getPsshInfo()
    {
        checkNotReleased();
        return null;
    }

    public boolean getSampleCryptoInfo(MediaCodec.CryptoInfo info)
    {
        checkNotReleased();
        return false;
    }

    public int getSampleFlags()
    {
        checkNotReleased();
        return -1;
    }

    public long getSampleSize()
    {
        checkNotReleased();
        return -1;
    }

    public long getSampleTime()
    {
        checkNotReleased();
        return -1;
    }

    public int getSampleTrackIndex()
    {
        checkNotReleased();
        return -1;
    }

    public int getTrackCount()
    {
        checkNotReleased();
        return mTracks.size();
    }

    public MediaFormat getTrackFormat(int index)
    {
        checkTrack(index);
        return new MediaFormat(mTracks.get(index));
    }

    public boolean hasCacheReachedEndOfStream()
    {
        checkNotReleased();
        return true;
    }

    public int readSampleData(ByteBuffer byteBuf, int offset)
    {
        checkNotReleased();
        return -1;
    }

    public void release()
    {
        mReleased = true;
        mTracks.clear();
    }

    public void seekTo(long timeUs, int mode)
    {
        checkNotReleased();
    }

    public void selectTrack(int index)
    {
        checkTrack(index);
    }

    public void setDataSource(Context context, Uri uri, Map<String, String> headers) throws IOException
    {
        if (context == null || uri == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("context and uri must not be null");

        throw noExtractor();
    }

    public void setDataSource(AssetFileDescriptor afd) throws IOException, IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException
    {
        if (afd == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("afd must not be null");

        throw noExtractor();
    }

    public void setDataSource(MediaDataSource dataSource) throws IOException
    {
        if (dataSource == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dataSource must not be null");

        throw noExtractor();
    }

    public void setDataSource(FileDescriptor fd) throws IOException
    {
        setDataSource(fd, 0, 0x7ffffffffffffffL);
    }

    public void setDataSource(FileDescriptor fd, long offset, long length) throws IOException
    {
        if (fd == null || !fd.valid()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid file descriptor");

        throw noExtractor();
    }

    public void setDataSource(String path) throws IOException
    {
        setDataSource(path, (Map<String, String>)null);
    }

    public void setDataSource(String path, Map<String, String> headers) throws IOException
    {
        if (path == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("path must not be null");

        throw noExtractor();
    }

    public void setLogSessionId(LogSessionId logSessionId)
    {
        if (logSessionId == null) throw new NullPointerException("logSessionId must not be null");

        mLogSessionId = logSessionId;
    }

    public void setMediaCas(MediaCas mediaCas)
    {
        checkNotReleased();
    }

    public void unselectTrack(int index)
    {
        checkTrack(index);
    }

    public static final class MetricsConstants
    {
        public static final String FORMAT = "android.media.mediaextractor.fmt";
        public static final String MIME_TYPE = "android.media.mediaextractor.mime";
        public static final String TRACKS = "android.media.mediaextractor.ntrk";

        MetricsConstants()
        {
        }
    }

    public static final class CasInfo
    {
        private final int mSystemId;
        private final MediaCas.Session mSession;
        private final byte[] mPrivateData;

        CasInfo(int systemId, MediaCas.Session session, byte[] privateData)
        {
            mSystemId = systemId;
            mSession = session;
            mPrivateData = privateData;
        }

        public byte[] getPrivateData()
        {
            return mPrivateData;
        }

        public MediaCas.Session getSession()
        {
            return mSession;
        }

        public int getSystemId()
        {
            return mSystemId;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    public static MediaFormat createAudioFormat(String mime, int sampleRate, int channelCount)
    {
        MediaFormat format = new MediaFormat();
        format.setString(KEY_MIME, mime);
        format.setInteger(KEY_SAMPLE_RATE, sampleRate);
        format.setInteger(KEY_CHANNEL_COUNT, channelCount);
        return format;
    }

    public static MediaFormat createSubtitleFormat(String mime, String language)

    public int getValueTypeForKey(String name)
    {
        Object value = mMap.get(name);

        if (value == null) return TYPE_NULL;
        if (value instanceof Integer) return TYPE_INTEGER;
        if (value instanceof Long) return TYPE_LONG;
        if (value instanceof Float) return TYPE_FLOAT;
        if (value instanceof String) return TYPE_STRING;
        if (value instanceof ByteBuffer) return TYPE_BYTE_BUFFER;

        throw new RuntimeException("invalid value for key");
    }

    {

    private final class KeySet extends AbstractSet<String>
    {
        private final boolean mFeatures;

        KeySet(boolean features)
        {
            mFeatures = features;
        }

        private boolean accepts(String key)
        {
            return key.startsWith(FEATURE_PREFIX) == mFeatures;
        }

        private String expose(String key)
        {
            return mFeatures ? key.substring(FEATURE_PREFIX.length()) : key;
        }

        private String internal(String key)
        {
            return mFeatures ? FEATURE_PREFIX + key : key;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean contains(Object object)
        {
            if (!(object instanceof String)) return false;

            String key = internal((String)object);
            return accepts(key) && mMap.containsKey(key);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean remove(Object object)
        {
            if (!contains(object)) return false;

            mMap.remove(internal((String)object));
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public int size()
        {
            int count = 0;

            for (String key : mMap.keySet())
            {
                if (accepts(key)) count++;
            }

            return count;
        }

        @Override
        public Iterator<String> iterator()
        {
            Iterator<String> keys = mMap.keySet().iterator();

            return new Iterator<String>()
            {
                private String mNext = advance();

                private String advance()
                {
                    while (keys.hasNext())
                    {
                        String key = keys.next();
                        if (accepts(key)) return key;
                    }

                    return null;
                }

                @Override
                public boolean hasNext()
                {
                    return mNext != null;
                }

                @Override
                public String next()
                {
                    if (mNext == null) throw new NoSuchElementException();

                    String key = mNext;
                    mNext = advance();
                    return expose(key);
                }
            };
        }
    }

    public static final class QpOffsetRect
    {
        private final Rect mContour;
        private int mQpOffset;

        public QpOffsetRect(Rect contour, int qpOffset)
        {
            mContour = new Rect(contour);
            mQpOffset = qpOffset;
        }

        public String flattenToString()
        {
            return String.format(Locale.US, "%d,%d-%d,%d=%d", mContour.top, mContour.left, mContour.bottom, mContour.right,
                mQpOffset);
        }

        public static String flattenToString(List<MediaFormat.QpOffsetRect> rects)
        {
            StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();

            for (int index = 0; index < rects.size(); index++)
            {
                if (index > 0) builder.append(';');
                builder.append(rects.get(index).flattenToString());
            }

            return builder.toString();
        }

        public void set(Rect contour, int qpOffset)
        {
            mContour.set(contour);
            mQpOffset = qpOffset;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    public MediaDescription getDescription()
    {
        if (mDescription != null) return mDescription;

        String mediaId = getString(METADATA_KEY_MEDIA_ID);
        CharSequence[] text = new CharSequence[3];
        Bitmap icon = null;
        Uri iconUri = null;

        CharSequence displayText = getText(METADATA_KEY_DISPLAY_TITLE);

        if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(displayText))
        {
            text[0] = displayText;
            text[1] = getText(METADATA_KEY_DISPLAY_SUBTITLE);
            text[2] = getText(METADATA_KEY_DISPLAY_DESCRIPTION);
        }
        else
        {
            int textIndex = 0;
            int keyIndex = 0;

            while (textIndex < text.length && keyIndex < PREFERRED_DESCRIPTION_ORDER.length)
            {
                CharSequence next = getText(PREFERRED_DESCRIPTION_ORDER[keyIndex++]);
                if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(next)) text[textIndex++] = next;
            }
        }

        for (String key : PREFERRED_BITMAP_ORDER)
        {
            Bitmap next = getBitmap(key);

            if (next != null)
            {
                icon = next;
                break;
            }
        }

        for (String key : PREFERRED_URI_ORDER)
        {
            String next = getString(key);

            if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(next))
            {
                iconUri = Uri.parse(next);
                break;
            }
        }

        Uri mediaUri = null;
        String mediaUriText = getString(METADATA_KEY_MEDIA_URI);
        if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(mediaUriText)) mediaUri = Uri.parse(mediaUriText);

        MediaDescription.Builder builder = new MediaDescription.Builder();
        builder.setMediaId(mediaId);
        builder.setTitle(text[0]);
        builder.setSubtitle(text[1]);
        builder.setDescription(text[2]);
        builder.setIconBitmap(icon);
        builder.setIconUri(iconUri);
        builder.setMediaUri(mediaUri);

        if (mBundle.containsKey(METADATA_KEY_BT_FOLDER_TYPE))
        {
            Bundle extras = new Bundle();
            extras.putLong(MediaDescription.EXTRA_BT_FOLDER_TYPE, getLong(METADATA_KEY_BT_FOLDER_TYPE));
            builder.setExtras(extras);
        }

        mDescription = builder.build();
        return mDescription;
    }

    @Override

    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override

    {
        dest.writeBundle(mBundle);

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        if (object == this) return true;
        if (!(object instanceof MediaMetadata)) return false;

        MediaMetadata other = (MediaMetadata)object;

        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : METADATA_KEYS_TYPE.entrySet())
        {
            String key = entry.getKey();

            switch (entry.getValue())
            {
                case METADATA_TYPE_TEXT:
                    if (!Objects.equals(getString(key), other.getString(key))) return false;
                    break;
                case METADATA_TYPE_LONG:
                    if (getLong(key) != other.getLong(key)) return false;
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        int hashCode = 17;

        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : METADATA_KEYS_TYPE.entrySet())
        {
            String key = entry.getKey();

            switch (entry.getValue())
            {
                case METADATA_TYPE_TEXT:
                    hashCode = 31 * hashCode + Objects.hashCode(getString(key));
                    break;
                case METADATA_TYPE_LONG:
                    hashCode = 31 * hashCode + Long.hashCode(getLong(key));
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
        }

        return hashCode;
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final Bundle mBundle;
        private int mBitmapDimensionLimit = Integer.MAX_VALUE;

        public Builder()
        {
            mBundle = new Bundle();
        }

        public Builder(MediaMetadata source)
        {
            mBundle = new Bundle(source.mBundle);
            mBitmapDimensionLimit = source.mBitmapDimensionLimit;
        }

        public Builder putText(String key, CharSequence value)
        {
            checkType(key, METADATA_TYPE_TEXT, "CharSequence");
            mBundle.putCharSequence(key, value);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder putString(String key, String value)
        {
            checkType(key, METADATA_TYPE_TEXT, "String");
            mBundle.putCharSequence(key, value);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder putLong(String key, long value)
        {
            checkType(key, METADATA_TYPE_LONG, "long");
            mBundle.putLong(key, value);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder putRating(String key, Rating value)
        {
            checkType(key, METADATA_TYPE_RATING, "Rating");
            mBundle.putParcelable(key, value);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder putBitmap(String key, Bitmap value)
        {
            checkType(key, METADATA_TYPE_BITMAP, "Bitmap");
            mBundle.putParcelable(key, value);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setBitmapDimensionLimit(int bitmapDimensionLimit)
        {
            mBitmapDimensionLimit = bitmapDimensionLimit > 0 ? bitmapDimensionLimit : Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            return this;
        }

        public MediaMetadata build()
        {
            if (mBitmapDimensionLimit != Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            {
                for (String key : new java.util.ArrayList<>(mBundle.keySet()))
                {
                    Object value = mBundle.get(key);

                    if (value instanceof Bitmap)
                    {
                        mBundle.putParcelable(key, scaleBitmap((Bitmap)value, mBitmapDimensionLimit));
                    }
                }
            }

            return new MediaMetadata(mBundle, mBitmapDimensionLimit);
        }

        private static void checkType(String key, int type, String typeName)
        {
            Integer expected = METADATA_KEYS_TYPE.get(key);

            if (expected != null && expected != type)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("The " + key + " key cannot be used to put a " + typeName);
            }
        }

        private static Bitmap scaleBitmap(Bitmap bitmap, int maxDimension)
        {
            int width = bitmap.getWidth();
            int height = bitmap.getHeight();

            if (width <= maxDimension && height <= maxDimension) return bitmap;

            float scale = Math.min((float)maxDimension / width, (float)maxDimension / height);
            int scaledWidth = Math.max(1, Math.round(width * scale));
            int scaledHeight = Math.max(1, Math.round(height * scale));

            return Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(bitmap, scaledWidth, scaledHeight, true);
        }
    }
```

`java/android/media/MediaMetadataEditor.java`:

```java
package android.media;

import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.os.Bundle;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public abstract class MediaMetadataEditor
{
    public static final int BITMAP_KEY_ARTWORK = 100;
    public static final int RATING_KEY_BY_OTHERS = 101;
    public static final int RATING_KEY_BY_USER = 0x10000001;

    static final int KEY_EDITABLE_MASK = 0x1FFFFFFF;

    private static final int[] LONG_KEYS = {0, 8, 9, 14};
    private static final int[] STRING_KEYS = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 11, 13, 15};

    final Bundle mEditorMetadata = new Bundle();
    final List<Integer> mEditableKeys = new ArrayList<>();
    Bitmap mEditorArtwork;
    boolean mMetadataChanged;
    boolean mArtworkChanged;
    boolean mApplied;

    MediaMetadataEditor()
    {
    }

    public abstract void apply();

    public synchronized void addEditableKey(int key)
    {
        if (mApplied) return;

        if (key != RATING_KEY_BY_USER) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid type 'int' for key " + key);

        if (!mEditableKeys.contains(key)) mEditableKeys.add(key);

        mMetadataChanged = true;
    }

    public synchronized void removeEditableKeys()
    {
        if (mApplied) return;

        if (!mEditableKeys.isEmpty())
        {
            mEditableKeys.clear();
            mMetadataChanged = true;
        }
    }

    public synchronized int[] getEditableKeys()
    {
        if (mEditableKeys.isEmpty()) return null;

        int[] keys = new int[mEditableKeys.size()];
        for (int index = 0; index < keys.length; index++) keys[index] = mEditableKeys.get(index);

        return keys;
    }

    public synchronized MediaMetadataEditor putString(int key, String value) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (mApplied) return this;

        if (!contains(STRING_KEYS, key)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid type 'String' for key " + key);

        mEditorMetadata.putString(String.valueOf(key), value);
        mMetadataChanged = true;
        return this;
    }

    public synchronized MediaMetadataEditor putLong(int key, long value) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (mApplied) return this;

        if (!contains(LONG_KEYS, key)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid type 'long' for key " + key);

        mEditorMetadata.putLong(String.valueOf(key), value);
        mMetadataChanged = true;
        return this;
    }

    public synchronized MediaMetadataEditor putBitmap(int key, Bitmap bitmap) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (mApplied) return this;

        if (key != BITMAP_KEY_ARTWORK) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid type 'Bitmap' for key " + key);

        mEditorArtwork = bitmap;
        mArtworkChanged = true;
        return this;
    }

    public synchronized MediaMetadataEditor putObject(int key, Object value) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (mApplied) return this;

        if (key == RATING_KEY_BY_OTHERS || key == RATING_KEY_BY_USER)
        {
            if (value != null && !(value instanceof Rating))
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not a non-null Rating Object for key " + key);
            }

            mEditorMetadata.putParcelable(String.valueOf(key), (Rating)value);
            mMetadataChanged = true;
            return this;
        }

        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid key " + key);
    }

    public synchronized long getLong(int key, long defaultValue) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (!contains(LONG_KEYS, key)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid type 'long' for key " + key);

        return mEditorMetadata.getLong(String.valueOf(key), defaultValue);
    }

    public synchronized String getString(int key, String defaultValue) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (!contains(STRING_KEYS, key)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid type 'String' for key " + key);

        return mEditorMetadata.getString(String.valueOf(key), defaultValue);
    }

    public synchronized Bitmap getBitmap(int key, Bitmap defaultValue) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (key != BITMAP_KEY_ARTWORK) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid type 'Bitmap' for key " + key);

        return mEditorArtwork != null ? mEditorArtwork : defaultValue;
    }

    public synchronized Object getObject(int key, Object defaultValue) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (key == RATING_KEY_BY_OTHERS || key == RATING_KEY_BY_USER)
        {
            Object value = mEditorMetadata.getParcelable(String.valueOf(key));
            return value != null ? value : defaultValue;
        }

        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid key " + key);
    }

    public synchronized void clear()
    {
        if (mApplied) return;

        mEditorMetadata.clear();
        mEditorArtwork = null;
        mMetadataChanged = true;
        mArtworkChanged = true;
    }

    MediaMetadata toMediaMetadata()
    {
        MediaMetadata.Builder builder = new MediaMetadata.Builder();

        putMetadataString(builder, 1, MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_ALBUM);
        putMetadataString(builder, 2, MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_ARTIST);
        putMetadataString(builder, 3, MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_AUTHOR);
        putMetadataString(builder, 4, MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_COMPOSER);
        putMetadataString(builder, 5, MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_DATE);
        putMetadataString(builder, 6, MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_GENRE);
        putMetadataString(builder, 7, MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_TITLE);
        putMetadataString(builder, 11, MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_WRITER);
        putMetadataString(builder, 13, MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_ALBUM_ARTIST);
        putMetadataString(builder, 15, MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_COMPILATION);
        putMetadataLong(builder, 0, MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_TRACK_NUMBER);
        putMetadataLong(builder, 8, MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_YEAR);
        putMetadataLong(builder, 9, MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_DURATION);
        putMetadataLong(builder, 14, MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_DISC_NUMBER);

        Rating rating = mEditorMetadata.getParcelable(String.valueOf(RATING_KEY_BY_OTHERS));
        if (rating != null) builder.putRating(MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_RATING, rating);

        Rating userRating = mEditorMetadata.getParcelable(String.valueOf(RATING_KEY_BY_USER));
        if (userRating != null) builder.putRating(MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_USER_RATING, userRating);

        if (mEditorArtwork != null) builder.putBitmap(MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_ART, mEditorArtwork);

        return builder.build();
    }

    private void putMetadataString(MediaMetadata.Builder builder, int key, String metadataKey)
    {
        String name = String.valueOf(key);
        if (mEditorMetadata.containsKey(name)) builder.putString(metadataKey, mEditorMetadata.getString(name));
    }

    private void putMetadataLong(MediaMetadata.Builder builder, int key, String metadataKey)
    {
        String name = String.valueOf(key);
        if (mEditorMetadata.containsKey(name)) builder.putLong(metadataKey, mEditorMetadata.getLong(name));
    }

    private static boolean contains(int[] keys, int key)
    {
        for (int candidate : keys)
        {
            if (candidate == key) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }
}
```

```java
    public List<Bitmap> getFramesAtIndex(int frameIndex, int numFrames, MediaMetadataRetriever.BitmapParams params)
    {
        if (!"yes".equals(mMetadata.get(METADATA_KEY_HAS_VIDEO)))
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Does not contain video or image sequences");
        }

        String frameCount = mMetadata.get(METADATA_KEY_VIDEO_FRAME_COUNT);
        int count = frameCount == null ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(frameCount);

        if (frameIndex < 0 || numFrames < 1 || frameIndex >= count || frameIndex > count - numFrames)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid frameIndex or numFrames: " + frameIndex + ", " + numFrames);
        }

        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public Bitmap getScaledFrameAtTime(long timeUs, int option, int dstWidth, int dstHeight)

        if (dstWidth <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid width: " + dstWidth);
        if (dstHeight <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid height: " + dstHeight);

        return null;

    public void release() throws IOException
    {
        mData = null;
        mDataComplete = false;
        mMetadata.clear();
    }

    public void setDataSource(Context context, Uri uri) throws IllegalArgumentException, SecurityException
    {
        if (uri == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null uri");

        String scheme = uri.getScheme();

        if (scheme == null || ContentResolver.SCHEME_FILE.equals(scheme))
        {
            setDataSource(uri.getPath());
            return;
        }

        if (context == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null context");

        try (InputStream stream = context.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri))
        {
            if (stream == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unable to open " + uri);

            load(stream);
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(failure);
        }
    }

    public void setDataSource(MediaDataSource dataSource) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (dataSource == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null MediaDataSource");

        try
        {
            long size = dataSource.getSize();
            int length = (int)Math.min(size < 0 ? MAX_BUFFERED_BYTES : size, MAX_BUFFERED_BYTES);
            ByteArrayOutputStream output = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            byte[] chunk = new byte[64 * 1024];
            long position = 0;

            while (position < length)
            {
                int read = dataSource.readAt(position, chunk, 0, (int)Math.min(chunk.length, length - position));

                if (read <= 0) break;

                output.write(chunk, 0, read);
                position += read;
            }

            accept(output.toByteArray(), size >= 0 && size <= MAX_BUFFERED_BYTES);
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(failure);
        }
    }

    public void setDataSource(FileDescriptor fileDescriptor) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        setDataSource(fileDescriptor, 0, 0x7ffffffffffffffL);
    }

    public void setDataSource(FileDescriptor fileDescriptor, long offset, long length) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (fileDescriptor == null || !fileDescriptor.valid()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid file descriptor");
        if (offset < 0 || length < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid offset or length");

        try
        {
            FileChannel channel = new FileInputStream(fileDescriptor).getChannel();
            long available = Math.max(0, channel.size() - offset);
            long wanted = Math.min(available, length);
            int toRead = (int)Math.min(wanted, MAX_BUFFERED_BYTES);
            ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(toRead);
            long position = offset;

            while (buffer.hasRemaining())
            {
                int read = channel.read(buffer, position);

                if (read <= 0) break;

                position += read;
            }

            byte[] data = new byte[buffer.position()];
            buffer.flip();
            buffer.get(data);
            accept(data, wanted <= MAX_BUFFERED_BYTES);
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(failure);
        }
    }

    public void setDataSource(String path) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (path == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null path");

        Uri uri = Uri.parse(path);
        String scheme = uri.getScheme();

        if (scheme != null && !ContentResolver.SCHEME_FILE.equals(scheme))
        {
            if ("http".equals(scheme) || "https".equals(scheme))
            {
                setDataSource(path, new HashMap<String, String>());
                return;
            }

            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported data source: " + path);
        }

        File file = new File(scheme == null ? path : uri.getPath());

        if (!file.isFile()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("File not found: " + path);

        try (RandomAccessFile input = new RandomAccessFile(file, "r"))
        {
            long size = input.length();
            byte[] data = new byte[(int)Math.min(size, MAX_BUFFERED_BYTES)];
            input.readFully(data);
            accept(data, size <= MAX_BUFFERED_BYTES);
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(failure);
        }
    }

    public void setDataSource(String uri, Map<String, String> headers) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (uri == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null uri");

        try
        {
            java.net.URLConnection connection = new java.net.URL(uri).openConnection();

            if (headers != null)
            {
                for (Map.Entry<String, String> header : headers.entrySet())
                {
                    connection.setRequestProperty(header.getKey(), header.getValue());
                }
            }

            try (InputStream stream = connection.getInputStream())
            {
                load(stream);
            }
        }
        catch (IOException | RuntimeException failure)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(failure);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        try
        {
            release();
        }
        finally
        {
            super.finalize();
        }
    }

    private void load(InputStream stream) throws IOException
    {
        ByteArrayOutputStream output = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] chunk = new byte[64 * 1024];
        boolean complete = true;

        while (true)
        {
            int read = stream.read(chunk);

            if (read < 0) break;

            output.write(chunk, 0, read);

            if (output.size() >= MAX_BUFFERED_BYTES)
            {
                complete = stream.read() < 0;
                break;
            }
        }

        accept(output.toByteArray(), complete);
    }

    private void accept(byte[] data, boolean complete)
    {
        mMetadata.clear();
        mData = data;
        mDataComplete = complete;

        String mimeType = sniffMimeType(data);

        if (mimeType == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unrecognized media format");

        mMetadata.put(METADATA_KEY_MIMETYPE, mimeType);

        if (mimeType.startsWith("image/"))
        {
            describeImage(data);
        }
        else if (mimeType.equals("audio/x-wav"))
        {
            describeWave(data);
        }
        else if (mimeType.startsWith("audio/"))
        {
            mMetadata.put(METADATA_KEY_HAS_AUDIO, "yes");
        }
    }

    private void describeImage(byte[] data)
    {
        BitmapFactory.Options bounds = new BitmapFactory.Options();
        bounds.inJustDecodeBounds = true;
        BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(data, 0, data.length, bounds);

        if (bounds.outWidth <= 0 || bounds.outHeight <= 0) return;

        mMetadata.put(METADATA_KEY_HAS_IMAGE, "yes");
        mMetadata.put(METADATA_KEY_IMAGE_COUNT, "1");
        mMetadata.put(METADATA_KEY_IMAGE_PRIMARY, "0");
        mMetadata.put(METADATA_KEY_IMAGE_WIDTH, String.valueOf(bounds.outWidth));
        mMetadata.put(METADATA_KEY_IMAGE_HEIGHT, String.valueOf(bounds.outHeight));

        int rotation = 0;

        try
        {
            rotation = new ExifInterface(new java.io.ByteArrayInputStream(data)).getRotationDegrees();
        }
        catch (IOException | RuntimeException ignored)
        {
            rotation = 0;
        }

        mMetadata.put(METADATA_KEY_IMAGE_ROTATION, String.valueOf(rotation));
    }

    private void describeWave(byte[] data)
    {
        int position = 12;
        int channels = 0;
        int sampleRate = 0;
        int byteRate = 0;
        int bitsPerSample = 0;
        long dataLength = -1;

        while (position + 8 <= data.length)
        {
            String id = new String(data, position, 4, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
            long chunkLength = readLittleInt(data, position + 4) & 0xffffffffL;
            int body = position + 8;

            if (id.equals("fmt ") && body + 16 <= data.length)
            {
                channels = readLittleShort(data, body + 2);
                sampleRate = readLittleInt(data, body + 4);
                byteRate = readLittleInt(data, body + 8);
                bitsPerSample = readLittleShort(data, body + 14);
            }
            else if (id.equals("data"))
            {
                dataLength = chunkLength;
                break;
            }

            position = (int)Math.min(Integer.MAX_VALUE, body + chunkLength + (chunkLength & 1));
        }

        mMetadata.put(METADATA_KEY_HAS_AUDIO, "yes");
        mMetadata.put(METADATA_KEY_NUM_TRACKS, "1");

        if (sampleRate > 0) mMetadata.put(METADATA_KEY_SAMPLERATE, String.valueOf(sampleRate));
        if (bitsPerSample > 0) mMetadata.put(METADATA_KEY_BITS_PER_SAMPLE, String.valueOf(bitsPerSample));
        if (byteRate > 0) mMetadata.put(METADATA_KEY_BITRATE, String.valueOf(byteRate * 8L));

        if (byteRate > 0 && dataLength >= 0)
        {
            mMetadata.put(METADATA_KEY_DURATION, String.valueOf(dataLength * 1000L / byteRate));
        }
        else if (channels > 0 && sampleRate > 0 && bitsPerSample > 0 && dataLength >= 0)
        {
            long frameBytes = (long)channels * bitsPerSample / 8;
            mMetadata.put(METADATA_KEY_DURATION, String.valueOf(dataLength * 1000L / (frameBytes * sampleRate)));
        }
    }

    private Bitmap decodeStillImage(MediaMetadataRetriever.BitmapParams params)
    {
        if (mData == null || !mDataComplete) return null;

        BitmapFactory.Options options = new BitmapFactory.Options();

        if (params != null && params.getPreferredConfig() != null) options.inPreferredConfig = params.getPreferredConfig();

        Bitmap bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(mData, 0, mData.length, options);

        if (bitmap != null && params != null) params.setActualConfig(bitmap.getConfig());

        return bitmap;
    }

    private static void checkOption(int option)
    {
        if (option < OPTION_PREVIOUS_SYNC || option > OPTION_CLOSEST) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported option: " + option);
    }

    private static int readLittleInt(byte[] data, int offset)
    {
        return (data[offset] & 0xff) | (data[offset + 1] & 0xff) << 8 | (data[offset + 2] & 0xff) << 16 | (data[offset + 3] & 0xff) << 24;
    }

    private static int readLittleShort(byte[] data, int offset)
    {
        return (data[offset] & 0xff) | (data[offset + 1] & 0xff) << 8;
    }

    private static boolean matches(byte[] data, int offset, String ascii)
    {
        if (data.length < offset + ascii.length()) return false;

        for (int index = 0; index < ascii.length(); index++)
        {
            if (data[offset + index] != (byte)ascii.charAt(index)) return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static String sniffMimeType(byte[] data)
    {
        if (data == null || data.length < 4) return null;

        int first = data[0] & 0xff;
        int second = data[1] & 0xff;

        if (first == 0xff && second == 0xd8) return "image/jpeg";
        if (first == 0x89 && matches(data, 1, "PNG")) return "image/png";
        if (matches(data, 0, "GIF8")) return "image/gif";
        if (matches(data, 0, "BM")) return "image/bmp";
        if (matches(data, 0, "RIFF") && matches(data, 8, "WEBP")) return "image/webp";
        if (matches(data, 0, "RIFF") && matches(data, 8, "WAVE")) return "audio/x-wav";
        if (matches(data, 0, "RIFF") && matches(data, 8, "AVI ")) return "video/avi";
        if (matches(data, 4, "ftyp"))
        {
            if (matches(data, 8, "heic") || matches(data, 8, "heix") || matches(data, 8, "mif1") || matches(data, 8, "msf1"))
            {
                return "image/heif";
            }

            if (matches(data, 8, "avif")) return "image/avif";
            if (matches(data, 8, "M4A ")) return "audio/mp4";
            if (matches(data, 8, "3gp")) return "video/3gpp";

            return "video/mp4";
        }
        if (matches(data, 0, "OggS")) return "audio/ogg";
        if (matches(data, 0, "fLaC")) return "audio/flac";
        if (matches(data, 0, "ID3")) return "audio/mpeg";
        if (matches(data, 0, "#!AMR")) return "audio/amr";
        if (first == 0x1a && second == 0x45 && (data[2] & 0xff) == 0xdf && (data[3] & 0xff) == 0xa3) return "video/webm";
        if (first == 0xff && (second & 0xf6) == 0xf0) return "audio/mp4a-latm";
        if (first == 0xff && (second & 0xe0) == 0xe0) return "audio/mpeg";
        if (first == 0x47 && data.length > 188 && (data[188] & 0xff) == 0x47) return "video/mp2ts";

        return null;
    }

    public static final class BitmapParams
    {
        private Bitmap.Config mPreferredConfig = Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888;
        private Bitmap.Config mActualConfig = Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888;

        public BitmapParams()
        {
        }

        public Bitmap.Config getActualConfig()
        {
            return mActualConfig;
        }

        public Bitmap.Config getPreferredConfig()
        {
            return mPreferredConfig;
        }

        public void setPreferredConfig(Bitmap.Config config)
        {
            if (config == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("preferred config can't be null");

            mPreferredConfig = config;
        }

        void setActualConfig(Bitmap.Config config)
        {
            mActualConfig = config;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/media/MediaMuxer.java`:

```java
package android.media;

import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class MediaMuxer
{
    private static final int MUXER_STATE_INITIALIZED = 0;
    private static final int MUXER_STATE_STARTED = 1;
    private static final int MUXER_STATE_STOPPED = 2;
    private static final int MUXER_STATE_RELEASED = 3;

    private final int mFormat;
    private final List<MediaFormat> mTracks = new ArrayList<>();
    private RandomAccessFile mFile;
    private int mState = MUXER_STATE_INITIALIZED;
    private int mOrientationHint;
    private float mLatitude;
    private float mLongitude;

    public MediaMuxer(FileDescriptor fd, int format) throws IOException
    {
        if (fd == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("fd must not be null");
        if (!fd.valid()) throw new IOException("Muxer output file descriptor is not valid");

        checkFormat(format);
        mFormat = format;
    }

    public MediaMuxer(String path, int format) throws IOException
    {
        if (path == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("path must not be null");

        checkFormat(format);
        mFormat = format;
        mFile = new RandomAccessFile(path, "rw");
        mFile.setLength(0);
    }

    private static void checkFormat(int format)
    {
        if (format < OutputFormat.MUXER_OUTPUT_MPEG_4 || format > OutputFormat.MUXER_OUTPUT_OGG)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("format: " + format + " is invalid");
        }
    }

    public int addTrack(MediaFormat format)
    {
        if (format == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("format must not be null.");
        if (mState != MUXER_STATE_INITIALIZED) throw new IllegalStateException("Muxer is not initialized.");

        String mime = format.getString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME);
        if (mime == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Track format must contain a mime type");

        mTracks.add(new MediaFormat(format));
        return mTracks.size() - 1;
    }

    public void release()
    {
        if (mFile != null)
        {
            try
            {
                mFile.close();
            }
            catch (IOException ignored)
            {
            }

            mFile = null;
        }

        mState = MUXER_STATE_RELEASED;
    }

    public void setLocation(float latitude, float longitude)
    {
        if (latitude < -90 || latitude > 90 || longitude < -180 || longitude > 180)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Location is out of range");
        }

        if (mState != MUXER_STATE_INITIALIZED) throw new IllegalStateException("Can't set location due to wrong state.");

        mLatitude = latitude;
        mLongitude = longitude;
    }

    public void setOrientationHint(int degrees)
    {
        if (degrees != 0 && degrees != 90 && degrees != 180 && degrees != 270)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported angle: " + degrees);
        }

        if (mState != MUXER_STATE_INITIALIZED) throw new IllegalStateException("Can't set rotation degrees due to wrong state.");

        mOrientationHint = degrees;
    }

    public void start()
    {
        if (mState != MUXER_STATE_INITIALIZED) throw new IllegalStateException("Can't start due to wrong state.");
        if (mTracks.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to start the muxer: no tracks were added");

        throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to start the muxer: no container writer is available for output format " + mFormat);
    }

    public void stop()
    {
        if (mState != MUXER_STATE_STARTED) throw new IllegalStateException("Can't stop due to wrong state.");

        mState = MUXER_STATE_STOPPED;
    }

    public void writeSampleData(int trackIndex, ByteBuffer byteBuf, MediaCodec.BufferInfo bufferInfo)
    {
        if (trackIndex < 0 || trackIndex >= mTracks.size()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("trackIndex is invalid");
        if (byteBuf == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("byteBuffer must not be null");
        if (bufferInfo == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("bufferInfo must not be null");
        if (bufferInfo.size < 0 || bufferInfo.offset < 0 || bufferInfo.offset + bufferInfo.size > byteBuf.capacity())
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("bufferInfo must specify a valid buffer offset and size");
        }

        if (mState != MUXER_STATE_STARTED) throw new IllegalStateException("Can't write, muxer is not started");
    }

    public static final class OutputFormat
    {
        public static final int MUXER_OUTPUT_3GPP = 2;
        public static final int MUXER_OUTPUT_HEIF = 3;
        public static final int MUXER_OUTPUT_MPEG_4 = 0;
        public static final int MUXER_OUTPUT_OGG = 4;
        public static final int MUXER_OUTPUT_WEBM = 1;

        OutputFormat()
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    private MediaParser(OutputConsumer outputConsumer, String[] parserNamesPool)
    {
        mOutputConsumer = outputConsumer;
        mParserNamesPool = parserNamesPool;

    public boolean advance(MediaParser.SeekableInputReader seekableInputReader) throws IOException
    {
        if (seekableInputReader == null) throw new NullPointerException("seekableInputReader must not be null");
        if (mReleased) throw new IllegalStateException("MediaParser is released");

        if (seekableInputReader.getLength() == 0) return false;

        throw new UnrecognizedInputFormatException("None of the available parsers ( " + String.join(", ", mParserNamesPool)
            + ") could read the stream.");
    }

    public static MediaParser create(MediaParser.OutputConsumer outputConsumer, String... parserNames)
    {
        if (outputConsumer == null) throw new NullPointerException("outputConsumer must not be null");

        for (String name : parserNames)
        {
            if (!KNOWN_PARSER_NAMES.contains(name)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid parser name: " + name);
        }

        String[] pool = parserNames.length == 0 ? getParserNames(new MediaFormat()).toArray(new String[0]) : parserNames.clone();
        return new MediaParser(outputConsumer, pool);
    }

    public static MediaParser createByName(String name, MediaParser.OutputConsumer outputConsumer)
    {
        if (outputConsumer == null) throw new NullPointerException("outputConsumer must not be null");

        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Parser " + name + " is not available on this device");
    }

    public LogSessionId getLogSessionId()
    {
        return mLogSessionId;
    }

    {
        return PARSER_NAME_UNKNOWN;
    }

    public static List<String> getParserNames(MediaFormat mediaFormat)
    {
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public void release()
    {
        mReleased = true;
    }

    public void seek(MediaParser.SeekPoint seekPoint)
    {
        if (seekPoint == null) throw new NullPointerException("seekPoint must not be null");
    }

    public void setLogSessionId(LogSessionId logSessionId)
    {
        if (logSessionId == null) throw new NullPointerException("logSessionId must not be null");

        mLogSessionId = logSessionId;
    }

    public MediaParser setParameter(String parameterName, Object value)
    {
        if (!KNOWN_PARAMETERS.contains(parameterName)) return this;

        boolean stringParameter = PARAMETER_TS_MODE.equals(parameterName);
        if (stringParameter && !(value instanceof String)) throw new IllegalArgumentException(parameterName + " expects a String");
        if (!stringParameter && !(value instanceof Boolean)) throw new IllegalArgumentException(parameterName + " expects a Boolean");

        mParameters.put(parameterName, value);
        return this;
    }

    public boolean supportsParameter(String parameterName)
    {
        return KNOWN_PARAMETERS.contains(parameterName);
    }

            super(message);
        }
    }
```
