```java
    public static final class SeekPoint
    {
        public static final MediaParser.SeekPoint START = new SeekPoint(0, 0);
        public final long position;
        public final long timeMicros;

        SeekPoint(long timeMicros, long position)
        {
            this.timeMicros = timeMicros;
            this.position = position;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object object)
        {
            if (this == object) return true;
            if (!(object instanceof SeekPoint)) return false;

            SeekPoint other = (SeekPoint)object;
            return timeMicros == other.timeMicros && position == other.position;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return 31 * (int)timeMicros + (int)position;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "SeekPoint{timeMicros=" + timeMicros + ", position=" + position + "}";
        }
    }

    public static final class SeekMap
    {
        public static final int UNKNOWN_DURATION = -2147483648;

        public long getDurationMicros()
        {
            return mDurationMicros;
        }

        public Pair<MediaParser.SeekPoint, MediaParser.SeekPoint> getSeekPoints(long timeMicros)
        {
            return new Pair<>(SeekPoint.START, SeekPoint.START);
        }

        public boolean isSeekable()
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

            super(message);
        }
```

```java
    public MediaPlayer()
    {

        if (looper == null) looper = Looper.getMainLooper();

        mEventHandler = looper == null ? null : new Handler(looper);
        mAudioSessionId = AudioTrack.newAudioSessionId();
        mAudioAttributes = new AudioAttributes.Builder().setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA).build();

        this();

    @Override

    {
        if (listener == null) return;

        synchronized (mRoutingListeners)
        {
            mRoutingListeners.put(listener, handler != null ? handler : mEventHandler);
        }
    }

    public void addTimedTextSource(Context context, Uri uri, String mimeType)
        throws IOException, IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException
    {
        checkTimedTextMime(mimeType);
        if (context == null || uri == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("context and uri must not be null");
        checkTimedTextState();
    }

    public void addTimedTextSource(String path, String mimeType) throws IOException, IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException
    {
        checkTimedTextMime(mimeType);

        File file = new File(path);
        if (!file.exists()) throw new IOException(path);
        checkTimedTextState();
    }

    private static void checkTimedTextMime(String mimeType)
    {
        if (!MEDIA_MIMETYPE_TEXT_SUBRIP.equals(mimeType))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Illegal mimeType for timed text source: " + mimeType);
        }
    }

    private void checkTimedTextState()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mState != STATE_IDLE && mState != STATE_INITIALIZED)
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException("addTimedTextSource called in state " + mState);
            }
        }
    }

    public void attachAuxEffect(int effectId)

            if (mState == STATE_IDLE || mState == STATE_ERROR || mState == STATE_END) postErrorLocked(INVALID_OPERATION, 0);
        }
    }

    public static MediaPlayer create(Context context, Uri uri)

    }

    public static MediaPlayer create(Context context, Uri uri, SurfaceHolder holder, AudioAttributes audioAttributes, int audioSessionId)
    {
        MediaPlayer player = new MediaPlayer();

        try
        {
            if (audioAttributes != null) player.setAudioAttributes(audioAttributes);
            if (audioSessionId != AudioManager.AUDIO_SESSION_ID_GENERATE) player.setAudioSessionId(audioSessionId);
            player.setDataSource(context, uri);
            if (holder != null) player.setDisplay(holder);
            player.prepare();
            return player;
        }
        catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException | SecurityException exception)
        {
            player.release();
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static MediaPlayer create(Context context, int resid)
    {
        return create(context, resid, null, AudioManager.AUDIO_SESSION_ID_GENERATE);
    }

    public static MediaPlayer create(Context context, int resid, AudioAttributes audioAttributes, int audioSessionId)
    {
        AssetFileDescriptor descriptor;

        try
        {
            descriptor = context.getResources().openRawResourceFd(resid);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception)
        {
            return null;
        }

        if (descriptor == null) return null;

        MediaPlayer player = new MediaPlayer();

        try
        {
            if (audioAttributes != null) player.setAudioAttributes(audioAttributes);
            if (audioSessionId != AudioManager.AUDIO_SESSION_ID_GENERATE) player.setAudioSessionId(audioSessionId);
            player.setDataSource(descriptor);
            player.prepare();
            return player;
        }
        catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException | SecurityException exception)
        {
            player.release();
            return null;
        }
        finally
        {
            try
            {
                descriptor.close();
            }
            catch (IOException exception)
            {
            }
        }
    }

    public void setDataSource(Context context, Uri uri, Map<String, String> headers, List<HttpCookie> cookies) throws IOException
    {
        if (context == null) throw new NullPointerException("context param can not be null.");
        if (uri == null) throw new NullPointerException("uri param can not be null.");

        String scheme = uri.getScheme();

        if (scheme == null || ContentResolver.SCHEME_FILE.equals(scheme))
        {
            setDataSource(uri.getPath());
            return;
        }

        if (ContentResolver.SCHEME_CONTENT.equals(scheme) || ContentResolver.SCHEME_ANDROID_RESOURCE.equals(scheme))
        {
            AssetFileDescriptor descriptor = null;

            try
            {
                descriptor = context.getContentResolver().openAssetFileDescriptor(uri, "r");
            }
            catch (IOException | RuntimeException exception)
            {
                descriptor = null;
            }

            if (descriptor != null)
            {
                try
                {
                    setDataSource(descriptor);
                    return;
                }
                finally
                {
                    descriptor.close();
                }
            }
        }

        setInitializedSource();
    }

    public void setDataSource(AssetFileDescriptor descriptor) throws IOException, IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException
    {
        if (descriptor == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("afd must not be null");

        setDataSource(descriptor.getFileDescriptor(), descriptor.getStartOffset(),
            descriptor.getDeclaredLength() < 0 ? 0x7ffffffffffffffL : descriptor.getDeclaredLength());
    }

    public void setDataSource(MediaDataSource dataSource) throws IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException
    {
        if (dataSource == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dataSource must not be null");
        setInitializedSource();
    }

    public void setDataSource(FileDescriptor descriptor) throws IOException, IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException
    {
        setDataSource(descriptor, 0, 0x7ffffffffffffffL);
    }

    public void setDataSource(FileDescriptor descriptor, long offset, long length)
        throws IOException, IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException
    {
        if (descriptor == null || !descriptor.valid()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid file descriptor");
        if (offset < 0 || length < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid offset or length");
        setInitializedSource();
    }

    public void setDataSource(String path) throws IOException, IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException, SecurityException
    {
        if (path == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("path must not be null");

        Uri uri = Uri.parse(path);
        String scheme = uri.getScheme();

        if (scheme == null || ContentResolver.SCHEME_FILE.equals(scheme))
        {
            File file = new File(scheme == null ? path : uri.getPath());
            if (!file.exists()) throw new IOException("setDataSource failed.");
            if (!file.canRead()) throw new IOException("setDataSource failed.: status=0x80000000");
        }

        setInitializedSource();
    }

    private void setInitializedSource()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)

            mState = STATE_INITIALIZED;
        }
    }

    public void setPlaybackParams(PlaybackParams params)
    {
        if (params == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("params must not be null");

        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mState == STATE_IDLE || mState == STATE_END) throw new IllegalStateException("setPlaybackParams called in state " + mState);

            float speed = params.speedOrDefault();
            if (speed < 0.0f) throw new IllegalArgumentException("speed must not be negative");

            PlaybackParams merged = new PlaybackParams().setSpeed(speed);
            try
            {
                merged.setPitch(params.getPitch());
            }
            catch (IllegalStateException exception)
            {
                merged.setPitch(mPlaybackParams.getPitch());
            }

            try
            {
                merged.setAudioFallbackMode(params.getAudioFallbackMode());
            }
            catch (IllegalStateException exception)
            {
                merged.setAudioFallbackMode(mPlaybackParams.getAudioFallbackMode());
            }

            mPlaybackParams = merged;
        }
    }

    private void invalidOperation()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mState == STATE_END) throw new IllegalStateException("MediaPlayer has been released");
            postErrorLocked(INVALID_OPERATION, 0);
        }
    }

    private void postErrorLocked(final int what, final int extra)
    {
        if (mState == STATE_END) return;

        mState = STATE_ERROR;

        Runnable notify = new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                OnErrorListener errorListener;
                OnCompletionListener completionListener;

                synchronized (mLock)
                {
                    if (mState != STATE_ERROR) return;
                    errorListener = mOnErrorListener;
                    completionListener = mOnCompletionListener;
                }

                boolean handled = errorListener != null && errorListener.onError(MediaPlayer.this, what, extra);
                if (!handled && completionListener != null) completionListener.onCompletion(MediaPlayer.this);
            }
        };

        if (mEventHandler != null)
        {
            mEventHandler.post(notify);
        }
        else
        {
            Thread thread = new Thread(notify, "MediaPlayerEvent");
            thread.setDaemon(true);
            thread.start();
        }
    }

    public static class TrackInfo implements Parcelable
    {
        public static final int MEDIA_TRACK_TYPE_AUDIO = 2;
        public static final int MEDIA_TRACK_TYPE_METADATA = 5;
        public static final int MEDIA_TRACK_TYPE_SUBTITLE = 4;
        public static final int MEDIA_TRACK_TYPE_TIMEDTEXT = 3;
        public static final int MEDIA_TRACK_TYPE_UNKNOWN = 0;
        public static final int MEDIA_TRACK_TYPE_VIDEO = 1;

        static final Parcelable.Creator<TrackInfo> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<TrackInfo>()
        {
            @Override
            public TrackInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                int trackType = source.readInt();
                String mime = source.readString();
                String language = source.readString();
                return new TrackInfo(trackType, mime, language);
            }

            @Override
            public TrackInfo[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new TrackInfo[size];
            }
        };

        private final int mTrackType;
        private final String mMime;
        private final String mLanguage;

        TrackInfo(int trackType, String mime, String language)
        {
            mTrackType = trackType;
            mMime = mime;
            mLanguage = language == null ? "und" : language;
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        public MediaFormat getFormat()
        {
            if (mTrackType != MEDIA_TRACK_TYPE_TIMEDTEXT && mTrackType != MEDIA_TRACK_TYPE_SUBTITLE) return null;
            return MediaFormat.createSubtitleFormat(mMime, mLanguage);
        }

        public String getLanguage()
        {
            return mLanguage;
        }

        public int getTrackType()
        {
            return mTrackType;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            String type;

            switch (mTrackType)
            {
                case MEDIA_TRACK_TYPE_VIDEO:
                    type = "VIDEO";
                    break;
                case MEDIA_TRACK_TYPE_AUDIO:
                    type = "AUDIO";
                    break;
                case MEDIA_TRACK_TYPE_TIMEDTEXT:
                    type = "TIMEDTEXT";
                    break;
                case MEDIA_TRACK_TYPE_SUBTITLE:
                    type = "SUBTITLE";
                    break;
                case MEDIA_TRACK_TYPE_METADATA:
                    type = "METADATA";
                    break;
                default:
                    type = "UNKNOWN";
                    break;
            }

            return getClass().getName() + '{' + type + ", " + mMime + ", " + mLanguage + "}";
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
        {
            destination.writeInt(mTrackType);
            destination.writeString(mMime);
            destination.writeString(mLanguage);
        }
    }
```

```java
    public void addOnRoutingChangedListener(AudioRouting.OnRoutingChangedListener listener, Handler handler)
    {
        if (listener == null) return;

        Looper looper = Looper.myLooper() != null ? Looper.myLooper() : Looper.getMainLooper();
        synchronized (mRoutingListeners)
        {
            mRoutingListeners.put(listener, handler != null ? handler : new Handler(looper));
        }
    }

    public List<MicrophoneInfo> getActiveMicrophones() throws IOException
    {
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    @Override
    public AudioRecordingConfiguration getActiveRecordingConfiguration()
    {
        return null;
    }

    public static final int getAudioSourceMax()
    {
        return AudioSource.VOICE_PERFORMANCE;

        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            return mLogSessionId;
        }

        synchronized (mLock)

            checkRecordingLocked("getMaxAmplitude");
            return 0;

    public PersistableBundle getMetrics()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            PersistableBundle bundle = new PersistableBundle();
            bundle.putInt(MetricsConstants.AUDIO_BITRATE, mAudioBitRate);
            bundle.putInt(MetricsConstants.AUDIO_CHANNELS, mAudioChannels);
            bundle.putInt(MetricsConstants.AUDIO_SAMPLERATE, mAudioSamplingRate);
            bundle.putInt(MetricsConstants.VIDEO_BITRATE, mVideoBitRate);
            bundle.putInt(MetricsConstants.FRAMERATE, mVideoFrameRate);
            bundle.putInt(MetricsConstants.WIDTH, mVideoWidth);
            bundle.putInt(MetricsConstants.HEIGHT, mVideoHeight);
            bundle.putInt(MetricsConstants.ROTATION, mOrientationHint);
            bundle.putDouble(MetricsConstants.CAPTURE_FPS, mCaptureRate);
            bundle.putInt(MetricsConstants.CAPTURE_FPS_ENABLE, mCaptureRate > 0 ? 1 : 0);
            return bundle;
        }
    }

    public Surface getSurface()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mState != STATE_PREPARED && mState != STATE_RECORDING && mState != STATE_PAUSED)
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException("getSurface called in an invalid state");
            }

            throw new IllegalStateException("No surface is available for the configured video source");
        }
    }

    public boolean isPrivacySensitive()
    {

        }
    }

    public void pause() throws IllegalStateException
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mState != STATE_RECORDING) throw new IllegalStateException("pause called in an invalid state");
            mState = STATE_PAUSED;
        }
    }

    public void prepare() throws IOException, IllegalStateException
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mState != STATE_CONFIGURED) throw new IllegalStateException("prepare called in an invalid state");
            if (mOutput == null) throw new IllegalStateException("No output file specified");
            if (mAudioSource >= 0 && mAudioEncoder < 0) throw new IllegalStateException("Audio encoder not set");
            if (mVideoSource >= 0 && mVideoEncoder < 0) throw new IllegalStateException("Video encoder not set");

            mState = STATE_ERROR;
            throw new IOException("prepare failed: no media encoder is available");
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void registerAudioRecordingCallback(Executor executor, AudioManager.AudioRecordingCallback callback)
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Illegal null AudioRecordingCallback");
        if (executor == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Illegal null Executor");

        synchronized (mRecordingCallbacks)
        {
            if (mRecordingCallbacks.containsKey(callback)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("AudioRecordingCallback already registered");
            mRecordingCallbacks.put(callback, executor);
        }
    }

    public void release()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            clearConfigurationLocked();
            mState = STATE_RELEASED;
            mOnErrorListener = null;
            mOnInfoListener = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize()
    {
        release();
    }

    @Override

    {
        synchronized (mRoutingListeners)
        {
            mRoutingListeners.remove(listener);
        }
    }

            if (mAudioSource < 0) throw new IllegalStateException("setAudioEncoder called before setAudioSource");
            mAudioEncoder = audioEncoder;

    public void setAudioSource(int audioSource) throws IllegalStateException
    {

    public void setLocation(float latitude, float longitude)

        if (longitude < -180 || longitude > 180) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Longitude: " + longitude + " out of range");

            mVideoWidth = width;
            mVideoHeight = height;
        }

    public void setVideoSource(int videoSource) throws IllegalStateException
    {
        synchronized (mLock)

                throw new IllegalStateException("setVideoSource called in an invalid state");
            }

            if (videoSource < VideoSource.DEFAULT || videoSource > VideoSource.SURFACE)

    public void start() throws IllegalStateException
    {
        synchronized (mLock)

            mState = STATE_RECORDING;
        }
    }

    public void stop() throws IllegalStateException
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mState != STATE_RECORDING && mState != STATE_PAUSED) throw new IllegalStateException("stop called in an invalid state");
            mState = STATE_INITIAL;
            clearConfigurationLocked();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void unregisterAudioRecordingCallback(AudioManager.AudioRecordingCallback callback)
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Illegal null AudioRecordingCallback argument");

        synchronized (mRecordingCallbacks)
        {
            if (mRecordingCallbacks.remove(callback) == null)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("AudioRecordingCallback was not registered");
            }
        }
    }

    private void checkRecordingLocked(String operation)
    {
        if (mState != STATE_RECORDING && mState != STATE_PAUSED)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException(operation + " called in an invalid state");
        }
    }

    private void checkConfigurableLocked(String operation)
    {
        if (mState != STATE_CONFIGURED && mState != STATE_INITIALIZED)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException(operation + " called in an invalid state");
        }
    }

    private void clearConfigurationLocked()
    {
        mAudioSource = -1;
        mVideoSource = -1;
        mOutputFormat = -1;
        mAudioEncoder = -1;
        mVideoEncoder = -1;
        mAudioChannels = 0;
        mAudioSamplingRate = 0;
        mAudioBitRate = 0;
        mVideoBitRate = 0;
        mVideoFrameRate = 0;
        mVideoWidth = 0;
        mVideoHeight = 0;
        mOrientationHint = 0;
        mCaptureRate = 0;
        mOutput = null;
        mInputSurface = null;
    }
```

```java
    {
        mId = builder.mId;
        mName = builder.mName;
        mFeatures = Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(builder.mFeatures));
        mType = builder.mType;

    private MediaRoute2Info(Parcel source)
    {
        mId = source.readString();
        mName = TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
        mFeatures = Collections.unmodifiableList(source.createStringArrayList());
        mType = source.readInt();
        mIsSystem = source.readBoolean();
        mIconUri = source.readTypedObject(Uri.CREATOR);
        mDescription = TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
        mConnectionState = source.readInt();
        mClientPackageName = source.readString();
        mVolumeHandling = source.readInt();
        mVolumeMax = source.readInt();
        mVolume = source.readInt();
        mExtras = source.readBundle();
        mDeduplicationIds = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new LinkedHashSet<>(source.createStringArrayList()));
        mSuitabilityStatus = source.readInt();
        mIsVisibilityRestricted = source.readBoolean();
        mAllowedPackages = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new LinkedHashSet<>(source.createStringArrayList()));
    }

            mDeduplicationIds = new LinkedHashSet<>(routeInfo.mDeduplicationIds);
            mSuitabilityStatus = routeInfo.mSuitabilityStatus;
            mIsVisibilityRestricted = routeInfo.mIsVisibilityRestricted;
            mAllowedPackages = new LinkedHashSet<>(routeInfo.mAllowedPackages);
        }

        public Builder addFeature(String feature)

            mFeatures.add(feature);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder addFeatures(Collection<String> features)
        {
            if (features == null) throw new NullPointerException("features must not be null");

            mDeduplicationIds = new LinkedHashSet<>(id);

            mAllowedPackages = new LinkedHashSet<>();

            return this;
        }

        {
            if (mFeatures.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("features must not be empty!");

            return new MediaRoute2Info(this);
        }
```

`java/android/media/MediaRouter.java`:

```java
package android.media;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.view.Display;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class MediaRouter
{
    public static final int CALLBACK_FLAG_PERFORM_ACTIVE_SCAN = 1;
    public static final int CALLBACK_FLAG_UNFILTERED_EVENTS = 2;
    public static final int ROUTE_TYPE_LIVE_AUDIO = 1;
    public static final int ROUTE_TYPE_LIVE_VIDEO = 2;
    public static final int ROUTE_TYPE_USER = 0x800000;

    private static final int DEFAULT_ROUTE_TYPES = ROUTE_TYPE_LIVE_AUDIO | ROUTE_TYPE_LIVE_VIDEO;

    private final Context mContext;
    private final Object mLock = new Object();
    private final List<RouteInfo> mRoutes = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<RouteCategory> mCategories = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<CallbackRecord> mCallbacks = new ArrayList<>();
    private final RouteCategory mSystemCategory;
    private final RouteInfo mDefaultAudioVideo;

    private RouteInfo mSelectedRoute;

    public MediaRouter(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;

        mSystemCategory = new RouteCategory("System", DEFAULT_ROUTE_TYPES, false);
        mSystemCategory.mIsSystem = true;
        mSystemCategory.mRouter = this;

        mDefaultAudioVideo = new RouteInfo(mSystemCategory);
        mDefaultAudioVideo.mRouter = this;
        mDefaultAudioVideo.mName = "Device speaker";
        mDefaultAudioVideo.mSupportedTypes = DEFAULT_ROUTE_TYPES;
        mDefaultAudioVideo.mDeviceType = RouteInfo.DEVICE_TYPE_SPEAKER;
        mDefaultAudioVideo.mPlaybackType = RouteInfo.PLAYBACK_TYPE_LOCAL;
        mDefaultAudioVideo.mVolumeHandling = RouteInfo.PLAYBACK_VOLUME_VARIABLE;
        mDefaultAudioVideo.mPlaybackStream = AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC;
        mDefaultAudioVideo.mIsSystemDefault = true;

        mCategories.add(mSystemCategory);
        mRoutes.add(mDefaultAudioVideo);
        mSelectedRoute = mDefaultAudioVideo;
    }

    Context getContext()
    {
        return mContext;
    }

    AudioManager getAudioManager()
    {
        if (mContext == null) return null;

        Object service = mContext.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
        return service instanceof AudioManager ? (AudioManager)service : null;
    }

    public RouteInfo getDefaultRoute()
    {
        return mDefaultAudioVideo;
    }

    public RouteInfo getSelectedRoute(int type)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mSelectedRoute != null && (mSelectedRoute.mSupportedTypes & type) != 0) return mSelectedRoute;
        }

        if (type == ROUTE_TYPE_USER) return null;

        return mDefaultAudioVideo;
    }

    public void addCallback(int types, Callback callback)
    {
        addCallback(types, callback, 0);
    }

    public void addCallback(int types, Callback callback, int flags)
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("callback must not be null");

        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            for (CallbackRecord record : mCallbacks)
            {
                if (record.mCallback == callback)
                {
                    record.mTypes |= types;
                    record.mFlags |= flags;
                    return;
                }
            }

            mCallbacks.add(new CallbackRecord(callback, types, flags));
        }
    }

    public void removeCallback(Callback callback)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            mCallbacks.removeIf(record -> record.mCallback == callback);
        }
    }

    public void selectRoute(int types, RouteInfo route)
    {
        if (route == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Route cannot be null.");

        RouteInfo oldRoute;

        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            oldRoute = mSelectedRoute;
            if (oldRoute == route) return;
            mSelectedRoute = route;
        }

        int oldTypes = oldRoute == null ? 0 : oldRoute.mSupportedTypes & types;

        if (oldRoute != null)
        {
            for (CallbackRecord record : callbacks())
            {
                if (record.filterRouteEvent(oldRoute)) record.mCallback.onRouteUnselected(this, oldTypes, oldRoute);
            }
        }

        for (CallbackRecord record : callbacks())
        {
            if (record.filterRouteEvent(route)) record.mCallback.onRouteSelected(this, types & route.mSupportedTypes, route);
        }
    }

    public void addUserRoute(UserRouteInfo info)
    {
        addRouteInternal(info);
    }

    public void clearUserRoutes()
    {
        List<RouteInfo> userRoutes = new ArrayList<>();

        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            for (RouteInfo route : mRoutes)
            {
                if (route instanceof UserRouteInfo || route instanceof RouteGroup) userRoutes.add(route);
            }
        }

        for (RouteInfo route : userRoutes) removeRouteInternal(route);
    }

    public void removeUserRoute(UserRouteInfo info)
    {
        removeRouteInternal(info);
    }

    public RouteCategory createRouteCategory(CharSequence name, boolean isGroupable)
    {
        RouteCategory category = new RouteCategory(name, ROUTE_TYPE_USER, isGroupable);
        category.mRouter = this;
        return category;
    }

    public RouteCategory createRouteCategory(int nameResId, boolean isGroupable)
    {
        RouteCategory category = new RouteCategory(nameResId, ROUTE_TYPE_USER, isGroupable);
        category.mRouter = this;
        return category;
    }

    public UserRouteInfo createUserRoute(RouteCategory category)
    {
        UserRouteInfo route = new UserRouteInfo(category);
        route.mRouter = this;
        return route;
    }

    public int getCategoryCount()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            return mCategories.size();
        }
    }

    public RouteCategory getCategoryAt(int index)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            return mCategories.get(index);
        }
    }

    public int getRouteCount()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            return mRoutes.size();
        }
    }

    public RouteInfo getRouteAt(int index)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            return mRoutes.get(index);
        }
    }

    void addRouteInternal(RouteInfo info)
    {
        if (info == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Route cannot be null.");

        RouteCategory category = info.getCategory();
        info.mRouter = this;

        if (category != null && category.isGroupable() && !(info instanceof RouteGroup))
        {
            RouteGroup group = new RouteGroup(category);
            group.mRouter = this;
            group.mSupportedTypes = info.mSupportedTypes;

            synchronized (mLock)
            {
                if (!mCategories.contains(category)) mCategories.add(category);
                mRoutes.add(group);
            }

            dispatchRouteAdded(group);
            group.addRoute(info);
            return;
        }

        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mRoutes.contains(info)) return;
            if (category != null && !mCategories.contains(category)) mCategories.add(category);
            mRoutes.add(info);
        }

        dispatchRouteAdded(info);
    }

    void removeRouteInternal(RouteInfo info)
    {
        RouteGroup group = info.getGroup();

        if (group != null)
        {
            group.removeRoute(info);
            return;
        }

        boolean removed;
        boolean wasSelected;

        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            removed = mRoutes.remove(info);
            wasSelected = mSelectedRoute == info;
            RouteCategory category = info.getCategory();
            boolean categoryInUse = false;

            for (RouteInfo route : mRoutes)
            {
                if (route.getCategory() == category) categoryInUse = true;
            }

            if (!categoryInUse && category != mSystemCategory) mCategories.remove(category);
        }

        if (!removed) return;

        if (wasSelected) selectRoute(DEFAULT_ROUTE_TYPES, mDefaultAudioVideo);

        for (CallbackRecord record : callbacks())
        {
            if (record.filterRouteEvent(info)) record.mCallback.onRouteRemoved(this, info);
        }
    }

    void dispatchRouteAdded(RouteInfo info)
    {
        for (CallbackRecord record : callbacks())
        {
            if (record.filterRouteEvent(info)) record.mCallback.onRouteAdded(this, info);
        }
    }

    void dispatchRouteChanged(RouteInfo info)
    {
        for (CallbackRecord record : callbacks())
        {
            if (record.filterRouteEvent(info)) record.mCallback.onRouteChanged(this, info);
        }
    }

    void dispatchRouteVolumeChanged(RouteInfo info)
    {
        for (CallbackRecord record : callbacks())
        {
            if (record.filterRouteEvent(info)) record.mCallback.onRouteVolumeChanged(this, info);
        }
    }

    void dispatchRouteGrouped(RouteInfo info, RouteGroup group, int index)
    {
        for (CallbackRecord record : callbacks())
        {
            if (record.filterRouteEvent(group)) record.mCallback.onRouteGrouped(this, info, group, index);
        }
    }

    void dispatchRouteUngrouped(RouteInfo info, RouteGroup group)
    {
        for (CallbackRecord record : callbacks())
        {
            if (record.filterRouteEvent(group)) record.mCallback.onRouteUngrouped(this, info, group);
        }
    }

    boolean containsRoute(RouteInfo info)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            return mRoutes.contains(info);
        }
    }

    List<RouteInfo> routesSnapshot()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            return new ArrayList<>(mRoutes);
        }
    }

    private List<CallbackRecord> callbacks()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            return new ArrayList<>(mCallbacks);
        }
    }

    private static final class CallbackRecord
    {
        final Callback mCallback;
        int mTypes;
        int mFlags;

        CallbackRecord(Callback callback, int types, int flags)
        {
            mCallback = callback;
            mTypes = types;
            mFlags = flags;
        }

        boolean filterRouteEvent(RouteInfo route)
        {
            return (mFlags & CALLBACK_FLAG_UNFILTERED_EVENTS) != 0 || (mTypes & route.mSupportedTypes) != 0;
        }
    }

    public static class RouteInfo
    {
        public static final int DEVICE_TYPE_BLUETOOTH = 3;
        public static final int DEVICE_TYPE_SPEAKER = 2;
        public static final int DEVICE_TYPE_TV = 1;
        public static final int DEVICE_TYPE_UNKNOWN = 0;
        public static final int PLAYBACK_TYPE_LOCAL = 0;
        public static final int PLAYBACK_TYPE_REMOTE = 1;
        public static final int PLAYBACK_VOLUME_FIXED = 0;
        public static final int PLAYBACK_VOLUME_VARIABLE = 1;

        final RouteCategory mCategory;

        MediaRouter mRouter;
        CharSequence mName;
        int mNameResId;
        CharSequence mDescription;
        CharSequence mStatus;
        RouteGroup mGroup;
        int mSupportedTypes;
        int mDeviceType = DEVICE_TYPE_UNKNOWN;
        int mPlaybackType = PLAYBACK_TYPE_LOCAL;
        int mVolumeMax = 15;
        int mVolume = 15;

        boolean mIsSystemDefault;
        VolumeCallback mVolumeCallback;

        RouteInfo(RouteCategory category)
        {
            mCategory = category;
        }

        public CharSequence getName()
        {
            return getName(mRouter == null ? null : mRouter.getContext());
        }

            if (mNameResId != 0)
            {
                Resources resources = context != null ? context.getResources() : Resources.getSystem();

                if (resources != null)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        return resources.getText(mNameResId);
                    }
                    catch (Resources.NotFoundException exception)
                    {
                        return mName;
                    }
                }
            }

            return mName;
        }

        public CharSequence getDescription()

            return mDescription;
        }

        public CharSequence getStatus()
        {
            return mStatus;
        }

            return mSupportedTypes;

        public int getDeviceType()

            return mDeviceType;
        }

        public RouteCategory getCategory()

            return mCategory;
        }

        public RouteGroup getGroup()

            return mGroup;
        }

        public Drawable getIconDrawable()
        {
            return mIcon;
        }

        public void setTag(Object tag)

            mTag = tag;
            routeUpdated();
        }

        public Object getTag()
        {
            return mTag;
        }

        public int getPlaybackType()
        {
            return mPlaybackType;
        }

        public int getPlaybackStream()

            return mPlaybackStream;
        }

        public int getVolume()
        {
            if (mIsSystemDefault && mRouter != null)
            {
                AudioManager audioManager = mRouter.getAudioManager();
                if (audioManager != null) return audioManager.getStreamVolume(mPlaybackStream);
            }

            return mVolume;
        }

        public void requestSetVolume(int volume)
        {
            if (mIsSystemDefault && mRouter != null)
            {
                AudioManager audioManager = mRouter.getAudioManager();

                if (audioManager != null)
                {
                    audioManager.setStreamVolume(mPlaybackStream, volume, 0);
                    mRouter.dispatchRouteVolumeChanged(this);
                }
            }
        }

        public void requestUpdateVolume(int direction)
        {
            if (mIsSystemDefault)
            {
                int volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(getVolume() + direction, getVolumeMax()));
                requestSetVolume(volume);
            }
        }

        public int getVolumeMax()
        {
            if (mIsSystemDefault && mRouter != null)
            {
                AudioManager audioManager = mRouter.getAudioManager();
                if (audioManager != null) return audioManager.getStreamMaxVolume(mPlaybackStream);
            }

            return mVolumeMax;
        }

        public int getVolumeHandling()
        {
            return mVolumeHandling;
        }

        public Display getPresentationDisplay()
        {
            return null;
        }

            return mEnabled;
        }

        public boolean isConnecting()
        {
            return mConnecting;
        }

        void routeUpdated()
        {
            if (mRouter != null && mRouter.containsRoute(this)) mRouter.dispatchRouteChanged(this);
            if (mGroup != null) mGroup.memberUpdated();
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return getClass().getSimpleName() + "{ name=" + getName() + ", description=" + getDescription() + ", status="
                    + getStatus() + ", category=" + getCategory() + ", supportedTypes=" + mSupportedTypes
                    + ", presentationDisplay=null }";
        }

    public static class UserRouteInfo extends RouteInfo
    {
        private RemoteControlClient mRemoteControlClient;

        UserRouteInfo(RouteCategory category)
        {
            super(category);
            mSupportedTypes = ROUTE_TYPE_USER;
            mPlaybackType = PLAYBACK_TYPE_REMOTE;
            mVolumeHandling = PLAYBACK_VOLUME_FIXED;
        }

        public void setName(CharSequence name)
        {
            mNameResId = 0;
            mName = name;
            routeUpdated();
        }

        public void setName(int resId)
        {
            mNameResId = resId;
            mName = null;
            routeUpdated();
        }

        public void setDescription(CharSequence description)
        {
            mDescription = description;
            routeUpdated();
        }

        public void setStatus(CharSequence status)
        {
            mStatus = status;
            routeUpdated();
        }

        public void setRemoteControlClient(RemoteControlClient remoteControlClient)
        {
            mRemoteControlClient = remoteControlClient;
        }

        public RemoteControlClient getRemoteControlClient()
        {
            return mRemoteControlClient;
        }

        public void setIconDrawable(Drawable icon)
        {
            mIcon = icon;
        }

        public void setIconResource(int resId)
        {
            Context context = mRouter == null ? null : mRouter.getContext();
            Resources resources = context != null ? context.getResources() : null;
            setIconDrawable(resources == null ? null : resources.getDrawable(resId));
        }

        public void setVolumeCallback(VolumeCallback volumeCallback)
        {
            mVolumeCallback = volumeCallback;
        }

        public void setPlaybackType(int type)
        {
            if (mPlaybackType != type) mPlaybackType = type;
        }

        public void setVolumeHandling(int volumeHandling)
        {
            if (mVolumeHandling != volumeHandling) mVolumeHandling = volumeHandling;
        }

        public void setVolume(int volume)
        {
            volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(volume, getVolumeMax()));

            if (mVolume != volume)
            {
                mVolume = volume;
                if (mRouter != null) mRouter.dispatchRouteVolumeChanged(this);
                if (mGroup != null) mGroup.memberVolumeChanged(this);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void requestSetVolume(int volume)
        {
            if (mVolumeHandling == PLAYBACK_VOLUME_VARIABLE && mVolumeCallback != null)
            {
                mVolumeCallback.onVolumeSetRequest(this, volume);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void requestUpdateVolume(int direction)
        {
            if (mVolumeHandling == PLAYBACK_VOLUME_VARIABLE && mVolumeCallback != null)
            {
                mVolumeCallback.onVolumeUpdateRequest(this, direction);
            }
        }

        public void setVolumeMax(int volumeMax)
        {
            if (mVolumeMax != volumeMax) mVolumeMax = volumeMax;
        }

        public void setPlaybackStream(int stream)
        {
            if (mPlaybackStream != stream) mPlaybackStream = stream;
        }
    }

    public static class RouteGroup extends RouteInfo
    {
        private final List<RouteInfo> mRoutes = new ArrayList<>();

        RouteGroup(RouteCategory category)
        {
            super(category);
            mGroup = this;
            mVolumeHandling = PLAYBACK_VOLUME_FIXED;
        }

        @Override
        public CharSequence getName(Context context)
        {
            if (mName != null || mNameResId != 0) return super.getName(context);

            StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();

            for (RouteInfo route : mRoutes)
            {
                if (builder.length() > 0) builder.append(", ");
                builder.append(route.getName(context));
            }

            return builder.toString();
        }

        public void addRoute(RouteInfo route)
        {
            addRoute(route, mRoutes.size());
        }

        public void addRoute(RouteInfo route, int insertAt)
        {
            if (route.getGroup() != null && route.getGroup() != this)
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Route " + route + " is already part of a group.");
            }

            if (route.getCategory() != mCategory)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Route cannot be added to a group with a different category.");
            }

            mRoutes.add(insertAt, route);
            route.mGroup = this;
            route.mRouter = mRouter;
            mSupportedTypes |= route.mSupportedTypes;

            if (mRouter != null) mRouter.dispatchRouteGrouped(route, this, insertAt);

            routeUpdated();
        }

        public void removeRoute(RouteInfo route)
        {
            if (route.getGroup() != this)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Route " + route + " is not a member of this group.");
            }

            mRoutes.remove(route);
            route.mGroup = null;

            if (mRouter != null) mRouter.dispatchRouteUngrouped(route, this);

            if (mRoutes.isEmpty() && mRouter != null)
            {
                mRouter.removeRouteInternal(this);
                return;
            }

            routeUpdated();
        }

        public void removeRoute(int index)
        {
            removeRoute(mRoutes.get(index));
        }

        public int getRouteCount()
        {
            return mRoutes.size();
        }

        public RouteInfo getRouteAt(int index)
        {
            return mRoutes.get(index);
        }

        public void setIconDrawable(Drawable icon)
        {
            mIcon = icon;
        }

        public void setIconResource(int resId)
        {
            Context context = mRouter == null ? null : mRouter.getContext();
            Resources resources = context != null ? context.getResources() : null;
            setIconDrawable(resources == null ? null : resources.getDrawable(resId));
        }

        @Override
        public void requestSetVolume(int volume)
        {
            int maxVolume = getVolumeMax();
            if (maxVolume == 0) return;

            float scaledVolume = (float)volume / maxVolume;

            for (RouteInfo route : mRoutes)
            {
                route.requestSetVolume((int)(scaledVolume * route.getVolumeMax()));
            }

            if (volume != mVolume)
            {
                mVolume = volume;
                if (mRouter != null) mRouter.dispatchRouteVolumeChanged(this);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void requestUpdateVolume(int direction)
        {
            int maxVolume = getVolumeMax();
            if (maxVolume == 0) return;

            for (RouteInfo route : mRoutes) route.requestUpdateVolume(direction);

            int volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(mVolume + direction, maxVolume));

            if (volume != mVolume)
            {
                mVolume = volume;
                if (mRouter != null) mRouter.dispatchRouteVolumeChanged(this);
            }
        }

        void memberUpdated()
        {
            int maxVolume = 0;

            for (RouteInfo route : mRoutes)
            {
                if (route.getPlaybackType() == PLAYBACK_TYPE_REMOTE) mPlaybackType = PLAYBACK_TYPE_REMOTE;
                if (route.getVolumeHandling() == PLAYBACK_VOLUME_VARIABLE) mVolumeHandling = PLAYBACK_VOLUME_VARIABLE;
                maxVolume = Math.max(maxVolume, route.getVolumeMax());
            }

            mVolumeMax = maxVolume;

            if (mRouter != null && mRouter.containsRoute(this)) mRouter.dispatchRouteChanged(this);
        }

        void memberVolumeChanged(RouteInfo info)
        {
            int volume = 0;

            for (RouteInfo route : mRoutes) volume = Math.max(volume, route.getVolume());

            if (volume != mVolume)
            {
                mVolume = volume;
                if (mRouter != null) mRouter.dispatchRouteVolumeChanged(this);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(super.toString());
            builder.append('[');

            for (int index = 0; index < mRoutes.size(); index++)
            {
                if (index > 0) builder.append(", ");
                builder.append(mRoutes.get(index));
            }

            builder.append(']');
            return builder.toString();
        }
    }

    public static class RouteCategory
    {
        final int mTypes;
        final boolean mGroupable;

        MediaRouter mRouter;
        CharSequence mName;
        int mNameResId;
        boolean mIsSystem;

        RouteCategory(CharSequence name, int types, boolean groupable)
        {
            mName = name;
            mTypes = types;
            mGroupable = groupable;
        }

        RouteCategory(int nameResId, int types, boolean groupable)
        {
            mNameResId = nameResId;
            mTypes = types;
            mGroupable = groupable;
        }

        public CharSequence getName()
        {
            return getName(mRouter == null ? null : mRouter.getContext());
        }

        public CharSequence getName(Context context)
        {
            if (mNameResId != 0)
            {
                Resources resources = context != null ? context.getResources() : Resources.getSystem();

                if (resources != null)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        return resources.getText(mNameResId);
                    }
                    catch (Resources.NotFoundException exception)
                    {
                        return mName;
                    }
                }
            }

            return mName;
        }

        public List<RouteInfo> getRoutes(List<RouteInfo> out)
        {
            if (out == null) out = new ArrayList<>();
            else out.clear();

            if (mRouter == null) return out;

            for (RouteInfo route : mRouter.routesSnapshot())
            {
                if (route.mCategory == this) out.add(route);
            }

            return out;
        }

        public int getSupportedTypes()
        {
            return mTypes;
        }

        public boolean isGroupable()
        {
            return mGroupable;
        }

        boolean isSystem()
        {
            return mIsSystem;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "RouteCategory{ name=" + getName() + " types=" + mTypes + " groupable=" + mGroupable + " }";
        }
    }
```

```java
    private AudioManager audioManager()

        Object service = mContext.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);

    {
        AudioManager audioManager = audioManager();
        int volume = audioManager == null ? 0 : audioManager.getStreamVolume(AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC);
        int volumeMax = audioManager == null ? 15 : audioManager.getStreamMaxVolume(AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC);
        return MediaRoute2Info.createDeviceSpeakerRoute(volume, volumeMax);
    }

        synchronized (mLock)

            mRouteCallbacks.removeIf(record -> record.mCallback == routeCallback);
            mRouteCallbacks.add(new RouteCallbackRecord(executor, routeCallback, preference));
        }

    public void setRouteListingPreference(RouteListingPreference routeListingPreference)

        synchronized (mLock)

            if (Objects.equals(mRouteListingPreference, routeListingPreference)) return;
```

`java/android/media/MediaScannerConnection.java`:

```java
package android.media;

import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.ServiceConnection;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Looper;

public class MediaScannerConnection implements ServiceConnection
{
    private final Context mContext;
    private final MediaScannerConnectionClient mClient;
    private final Handler mHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private boolean mConnected;
    private boolean mConnecting;

    public MediaScannerConnection(Context context, MediaScannerConnection.MediaScannerConnectionClient client)
    {
        mContext = context;
        mClient = client;
    }

    public void connect()
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mConnected || mConnecting) return;

            mConnecting = true;
        }

        mHandler.post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                onServiceConnected(new ComponentName("com.android.providers.media", "com.android.providers.media.MediaScannerService"),
                    null);
            }
        });
    }

    public void disconnect()
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            mConnecting = false;
            mConnected = false;
        }
    }

    public synchronized boolean isConnected()
    {
        return mConnected;
    }

    public void onServiceConnected(ComponentName className, IBinder service)
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (!mConnecting) return;

            mConnecting = false;
            mConnected = true;
        }

        if (mClient != null) mClient.onMediaScannerConnected();
    }

    public void onServiceDisconnected(ComponentName className)
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            mConnected = false;
        }
    }

    public static void scanFile(Context context, String[] paths, String[] mimeTypes,
        MediaScannerConnection.OnScanCompletedListener callback)
    {
        if (paths == null) return;

        final String[] pending = paths.clone();
        final OnScanCompletedListener listener = callback;

        new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                if (listener == null) return;

                for (String path : pending)
                {
                    listener.onScanCompleted(path, null);
                }
            }
        });
    }

    public void scanFile(String path, String mimeType)
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (!mConnected) throw new IllegalStateException("not connected to MediaScannerService");
        }

        final String scannedPath = path;

        mHandler.post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                if (mClient != null) mClient.onScanCompleted(scannedPath, null);
            }
        });
    }

    public interface OnScanCompletedListener
    {
        void onScanCompleted(String path, Uri uri);
    }

    public interface MediaScannerConnectionClient extends MediaScannerConnection.OnScanCompletedListener
    {
        void onMediaScannerConnected();
    }
}
```

```java
import android.os.Parcel;

public class MediaSyncEvent implements Parcelable

    public static final int SYNC_EVENT_NONE = 0;
    public static final int SYNC_EVENT_PRESENTATION_COMPLETE = 1;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<MediaSyncEvent> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<MediaSyncEvent>()
    {
        @Override
        public MediaSyncEvent createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            MediaSyncEvent event = new MediaSyncEvent(source.readInt());
            event.mAudioSessionId = source.readInt();
            return event;
        }

        @Override
        public MediaSyncEvent[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new MediaSyncEvent[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mType;
    private int mAudioSessionId;

    private MediaSyncEvent(int type)
    {
        mType = type;
    }

    public static MediaSyncEvent createEvent(int type) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (type != SYNC_EVENT_NONE && type != SYNC_EVENT_PRESENTATION_COMPLETE)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(type + " is not a valid MediaSyncEvent type.");
        }

        return new MediaSyncEvent(type);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        if (this == object) return true;
        if (!(object instanceof MediaSyncEvent)) return false;

        MediaSyncEvent other = (MediaSyncEvent)object;
        return mType == other.mType && mAudioSessionId == other.mAudioSessionId;
    }

    public int getAudioSessionId()
    {
        return mAudioSessionId;
    }

    public int getType()
    {
        return mType;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return java.util.Objects.hash(mType, mAudioSessionId);
    }

    public MediaSyncEvent setAudioSessionId(int audioSessionId) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (audioSessionId <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException(audioSessionId + " is not a valid session ID.");
        mAudioSessionId = audioSessionId;
        return this;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "MediaSyncEvent: type=" + (mType == SYNC_EVENT_NONE ? "NONE" : "PRESENTATION_COMPLETE")
            + " session=" + mAudioSessionId;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeInt(mType);
        destination.writeInt(mAudioSessionId);
    }
```

```java
package android.media;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class PlaybackParams implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int AUDIO_FALLBACK_MODE_DEFAULT = 0;
    public static final int AUDIO_FALLBACK_MODE_FAIL = 2;
    public static final int AUDIO_FALLBACK_MODE_MUTE = 1;

    private static final int SET_SPEED = 1;
    private static final int SET_PITCH = 2;
    private static final int SET_AUDIO_FALLBACK_MODE = 4;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<PlaybackParams> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<PlaybackParams>()
    {
        @Override
        public PlaybackParams createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            PlaybackParams params = new PlaybackParams();
            params.mSet = source.readInt();
            params.mSpeed = source.readFloat();
            params.mPitch = source.readFloat();
            params.mAudioFallbackMode = source.readInt();
            return params;
        }

        @Override
        public PlaybackParams[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new PlaybackParams[size];
        }
    };

    private int mSet;
    private float mSpeed = 1.0f;
    private float mPitch = 1.0f;
    private int mAudioFallbackMode = AUDIO_FALLBACK_MODE_DEFAULT;

    public PlaybackParams()
    {
    }

    public PlaybackParams allowDefaults()
    {
        mSet |= SET_SPEED | SET_PITCH | SET_AUDIO_FALLBACK_MODE;
        return this;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public int getAudioFallbackMode()
    {
        if ((mSet & SET_AUDIO_FALLBACK_MODE) == 0) throw new IllegalStateException("audio fallback mode not set");
        return mAudioFallbackMode;
    }

    public float getPitch()
    {
        if ((mSet & SET_PITCH) == 0) throw new IllegalStateException("pitch not set");
        return mPitch;
    }

    public float getSpeed()
    {
        if ((mSet & SET_SPEED) == 0) throw new IllegalStateException("speed not set");
        return mSpeed;
    }

    public PlaybackParams setAudioFallbackMode(int audioFallbackMode)
    {
        mAudioFallbackMode = audioFallbackMode;
        mSet |= SET_AUDIO_FALLBACK_MODE;
        return this;
    }

    public PlaybackParams setPitch(float pitch)
    {
        if (pitch < 0.0f) throw new IllegalArgumentException("pitch must not be negative");
        mPitch = pitch;
        mSet |= SET_PITCH;
        return this;
    }

    public PlaybackParams setSpeed(float speed)
    {
        mSpeed = speed;
        mSet |= SET_SPEED;
        return this;
    }

    float speedOrDefault()
    {
        return (mSet & SET_SPEED) == 0 ? 1.0f : mSpeed;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeInt(mSet);
        destination.writeFloat(mSpeed);
        destination.writeFloat(mPitch);
        destination.writeInt(mAudioFallbackMode);
    }
}
```

`java/android/media/Rating.java`:

```java
package android.media;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class Rating implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int RATING_3_STARS = 3;
    public static final int RATING_4_STARS = 4;
    public static final int RATING_5_STARS = 5;
    public static final int RATING_HEART = 1;
    public static final int RATING_NONE = 0;
    public static final int RATING_PERCENTAGE = 6;
    public static final int RATING_THUMB_UP_DOWN = 2;

    private static final float RATING_NOT_RATED = -1.0f;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<Rating> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<Rating>()
    {
        @Override
        public Rating createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new Rating(source.readInt(), source.readFloat());
        }

        @Override
        public Rating[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Rating[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mRatingStyle;
    private final float mRatingValue;

    private Rating(int ratingStyle, float ratingValue)
    {
        mRatingStyle = ratingStyle;
        mRatingValue = ratingValue;
    }

    public static Rating newUnratedRating(int ratingStyle)
    {
        switch (ratingStyle)
        {
            case RATING_HEART:
            case RATING_THUMB_UP_DOWN:
            case RATING_3_STARS:
            case RATING_4_STARS:
            case RATING_5_STARS:
            case RATING_PERCENTAGE:
                return new Rating(ratingStyle, RATING_NOT_RATED);
            default:
                return null;
        }
    }

    public static Rating newHeartRating(boolean hasHeart)
    {
        return new Rating(RATING_HEART, hasHeart ? 1.0f : 0.0f);
    }

    public static Rating newThumbRating(boolean thumbIsUp)
    {
        return new Rating(RATING_THUMB_UP_DOWN, thumbIsUp ? 1.0f : 0.0f);
    }

    public static Rating newStarRating(int starRatingStyle, float starRating)
    {
        float maxRating;

        switch (starRatingStyle)
        {
            case RATING_3_STARS:
                maxRating = 3.0f;
                break;
            case RATING_4_STARS:
                maxRating = 4.0f;
                break;
            case RATING_5_STARS:
                maxRating = 5.0f;
                break;
            default:
                return null;
        }

        if (starRating < 0.0f || starRating > maxRating) return null;

        return new Rating(starRatingStyle, starRating);
    }

    public static Rating newPercentageRating(float percent)
    {
        if (percent < 0.0f || percent > 100.0f) return null;

        return new Rating(RATING_PERCENTAGE, percent);
    }

    public boolean isRated()
    {
        return mRatingValue >= 0.0f;
    }

    public int getRatingStyle()
    {
        return mRatingStyle;
    }

    public boolean hasHeart()
    {
        return mRatingStyle == RATING_HEART && mRatingValue == 1.0f;
    }

    public boolean isThumbUp()
    {
        return mRatingStyle == RATING_THUMB_UP_DOWN && mRatingValue == 1.0f;
    }

    public float getStarRating()
    {
        switch (mRatingStyle)
        {
            case RATING_3_STARS:
            case RATING_4_STARS:
            case RATING_5_STARS:
                return isRated() ? mRatingValue : -1.0f;
            default:
                return -1.0f;
        }
    }

    public float getPercentRating()
    {
        if (mRatingStyle != RATING_PERCENTAGE || !isRated()) return -1.0f;

        return mRatingValue;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return mRatingStyle;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mRatingStyle);
        dest.writeFloat(mRatingValue);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Rating:style=" + mRatingStyle + " rating=" + (mRatingValue < 0.0f ? "unrated" : String.valueOf(mRatingValue));
    }
}
```

`java/android/media/RemoteControlClient.java`:

```java
package android.media;

import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.media.session.MediaSession;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.SystemClock;

public class RemoteControlClient
{
    public static final int FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_FAST_FORWARD = 64;
    public static final int FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_NEXT = 128;
    public static final int FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_PAUSE = 16;
    public static final int FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_PLAY = 4;
    public static final int FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_PLAY_PAUSE = 8;
    public static final int FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_POSITION_UPDATE = 256;
    public static final int FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_PREVIOUS = 1;
    public static final int FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_RATING = 512;
    public static final int FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_REWIND = 2;
    public static final int FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_STOP = 32;
    public static final int PLAYSTATE_BUFFERING = 8;
    public static final int PLAYSTATE_ERROR = 9;
    public static final int PLAYSTATE_FAST_FORWARDING = 4;
    public static final int PLAYSTATE_PAUSED = 2;
    public static final int PLAYSTATE_PLAYING = 3;
    public static final int PLAYSTATE_REWINDING = 5;
    public static final int PLAYSTATE_SKIPPING_BACKWARDS = 7;
    public static final int PLAYSTATE_SKIPPING_FORWARDS = 6;
    public static final int PLAYSTATE_STOPPED = 1;

    private static final long POSITION_INVALID = -1;
    private static final float PLAYBACK_SPEED_1X = 1.0f;

    private final Object mCacheLock = new Object();
    private final PendingIntent mRcMediaIntent;
    private final Looper mLooper;

    private int mPlaybackState = PLAYSTATE_STOPPED;
    private long mPlaybackStateChangeTimeMs;
    private long mPlaybackPositionMs = POSITION_INVALID;
    private float mPlaybackSpeed = PLAYBACK_SPEED_1X;
    private int mTransportControlFlags;
    private Bundle mMetadata = new Bundle();
    private Bitmap mOriginalArtwork;
    private MediaMetadata mMediaMetadata;
    private MediaSession mSession;
    private OnPlaybackPositionUpdateListener mPositionUpdateListener;
    private OnGetPlaybackPositionListener mPositionProvider;
    private OnMetadataUpdateListener mMetadataUpdateListener;

    public RemoteControlClient(PendingIntent mediaButtonIntent)
    {
        this(mediaButtonIntent, Looper.myLooper() != null ? Looper.myLooper() : Looper.getMainLooper());
    }

    public RemoteControlClient(PendingIntent mediaButtonIntent, Looper looper)
    {
        mRcMediaIntent = mediaButtonIntent;
        mLooper = looper;
    }

    public MetadataEditor editMetadata(boolean startEmpty)
    {
        MetadataEditor editor = new MetadataEditor();

        synchronized (mCacheLock)
        {
            if (!startEmpty)
            {
                editor.mEditorMetadata.putAll(mMetadata);
                editor.mEditorArtwork = mOriginalArtwork;
            }
        }

        editor.mMetadataChanged = startEmpty;
        editor.mArtworkChanged = startEmpty;
        return editor;
    }

    public void setPlaybackState(int state)
    {
        setPlaybackState(state, POSITION_INVALID, PLAYBACK_SPEED_1X);
    }

    public void setPlaybackState(int state, long timeInMs, float playbackSpeed)
    {
        synchronized (mCacheLock)
        {
            if (mPlaybackState != state || mPlaybackPositionMs != timeInMs || mPlaybackSpeed != playbackSpeed)
            {
                mPlaybackState = state;
                mPlaybackPositionMs = timeInMs;
                mPlaybackSpeed = playbackSpeed;
                mPlaybackStateChangeTimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            }
        }
    }

    public void setTransportControlFlags(int transportControlFlags)
    {
        synchronized (mCacheLock)
        {
            mTransportControlFlags = transportControlFlags;
        }
    }

    public void setMetadataUpdateListener(OnMetadataUpdateListener listener)
    {
        synchronized (mCacheLock)
        {
            mMetadataUpdateListener = listener;
        }
    }

    public void setPlaybackPositionUpdateListener(OnPlaybackPositionUpdateListener listener)
    {
        synchronized (mCacheLock)
        {
            mPositionUpdateListener = listener;
        }
    }

    public void setOnGetPlaybackPositionListener(OnGetPlaybackPositionListener listener)
    {
        synchronized (mCacheLock)
        {
            mPositionProvider = listener;
        }
    }

    public MediaSession getMediaSession()
    {
        return mSession;
    }

    PendingIntent getRcMediaIntent()
    {
        return mRcMediaIntent;
    }

    Looper getLooper()
    {
        return mLooper;
    }

    int getPlaybackState()
    {
        synchronized (mCacheLock)
        {
            return mPlaybackState;
        }
    }

    long getPlaybackPosition()
    {
        OnGetPlaybackPositionListener provider;

        synchronized (mCacheLock)
        {
            provider = mPositionProvider;
        }

        if (provider != null) return provider.onGetPlaybackPosition();

        synchronized (mCacheLock)
        {
            if (mPlaybackPositionMs < 0 || mPlaybackState != PLAYSTATE_PLAYING) return mPlaybackPositionMs;

            long elapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - mPlaybackStateChangeTimeMs;
            return mPlaybackPositionMs + (long)(elapsed * mPlaybackSpeed);
        }
    }

    int getTransportControlFlags()
    {
        synchronized (mCacheLock)
        {
            return mTransportControlFlags;
        }
    }

    MediaMetadata getMediaMetadata()
    {
        synchronized (mCacheLock)
        {
            return mMediaMetadata;
        }
    }

    void dispatchPlaybackPositionUpdate(long newPositionMs)
    {
        OnPlaybackPositionUpdateListener listener;

        synchronized (mCacheLock)
        {
            listener = mPositionUpdateListener;
        }

        if (listener != null) listener.onPlaybackPositionUpdate(newPositionMs);
    }

    void dispatchMetadataUpdate(int key, Object newValue)
    {
        OnMetadataUpdateListener listener;

        synchronized (mCacheLock)
        {
            listener = mMetadataUpdateListener;
        }

        if (listener != null) listener.onMetadataUpdate(key, newValue);
    }

    public interface OnPlaybackPositionUpdateListener
    {
        void onPlaybackPositionUpdate(long newPositionMs);
    }

    public interface OnMetadataUpdateListener
    {
        void onMetadataUpdate(int key, Object newValue);
    }

    public interface OnGetPlaybackPositionListener
    {
        long onGetPlaybackPosition();
    }

    public class MetadataEditor extends MediaMetadataEditor
    {
        public static final int BITMAP_KEY_ARTWORK = 100;

        private MetadataEditor()
        {
        }

        @Override
        public Object clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException
        {
            throw new CloneNotSupportedException();
        }

        @Override
        public synchronized MetadataEditor putString(int key, String value) throws IllegalArgumentException
        {
            super.putString(key, value);
            return this;
        }

        @Override
        public synchronized MetadataEditor putLong(int key, long value) throws IllegalArgumentException
        {
            super.putLong(key, value);
            return this;
        }

        @Override
        public synchronized MetadataEditor putBitmap(int key, Bitmap bitmap) throws IllegalArgumentException
        {
            super.putBitmap(key, bitmap);
            return this;
        }

        @Override
        public synchronized MetadataEditor putObject(int key, Object object) throws IllegalArgumentException
        {
            super.putObject(key, object);
            return this;
        }

        @Override
        public synchronized void clear()
        {
            super.clear();
        }

        @Override
        public synchronized void apply()
        {
            if (mApplied) return;

            synchronized (mCacheLock)
            {
                mMetadata = new Bundle(mEditorMetadata);
                mOriginalArtwork = mEditorArtwork;
                mMediaMetadata = toMediaMetadata();
            }

            if (mSession != null && (mMetadataChanged || mArtworkChanged)) mSession.setMetadata(mMediaMetadata);

            mApplied = true;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/media/RemoteController.java`:

```java
package android.media;

import android.content.Context;
import android.media.session.MediaController;
import android.media.session.MediaSessionManager;
import android.media.session.PlaybackState;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.view.KeyEvent;

import java.util.List;

public final class RemoteController
{
    public static final int POSITION_SYNCHRONIZATION_CHECK = 1;
    public static final int POSITION_SYNCHRONIZATION_NONE = 0;

    private final Context mContext;
    private final OnClientUpdateListener mOnClientUpdateListener;
    private final Handler mHandler;
    private final MediaSessionManager mSessionManager;

    private int mArtworkWidth = -1;
    private int mArtworkHeight = -1;
    private int mSynchronizationMode = POSITION_SYNCHRONIZATION_NONE;

    public RemoteController(Context context, OnClientUpdateListener updateListener) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        this(context, updateListener, null);
    }

    public RemoteController(Context context, OnClientUpdateListener updateListener, Looper looper) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (context == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid null Context");
        if (updateListener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid null OnClientUpdateListener");

        if (looper == null)
        {
            looper = Looper.myLooper();
            if (looper == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Calling thread not associated with a looper");
        }

        mContext = context;
        mOnClientUpdateListener = updateListener;
        mHandler = new Handler(looper);
        mSessionManager = new MediaSessionManager(context);
    }

    private MediaController currentController()
    {
        List<MediaController> controllers = mSessionManager.getActiveSessions(null);
        return controllers.isEmpty() ? null : controllers.get(0);
    }

    public long getEstimatedMediaPosition()
    {
        MediaController controller = currentController();
        if (controller == null) return -1;

        PlaybackState state = controller.getPlaybackState();
        if (state == null) return -1;

        long position = state.getPosition();
        if (position < 0 || state.getState() != PlaybackState.STATE_PLAYING) return position;

        long elapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - state.getLastPositionUpdateTime();
        return position + (long)(elapsed * state.getPlaybackSpeed());
    }

    public boolean sendMediaKeyEvent(KeyEvent keyEvent) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (keyEvent == null || !KeyEvent.isMediaSessionKey(keyEvent.getKeyCode()))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("not a media key event");
        }

        MediaController controller = currentController();
        return controller != null && controller.dispatchMediaButtonEvent(keyEvent);
    }

    public boolean seekTo(long ms) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (ms < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("illegal negative time value");

        MediaController controller = currentController();
        if (controller == null) return false;

        controller.getTransportControls().seekTo(ms);
        return true;
    }

    public boolean setArtworkConfiguration(int width, int height) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid dimensions");

        mArtworkWidth = width;
        mArtworkHeight = height;
        return true;
    }

    public boolean clearArtworkConfiguration()
    {
        mArtworkWidth = -1;
        mArtworkHeight = -1;
        return true;
    }

    public boolean setSynchronizationMode(int sync) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (sync != POSITION_SYNCHRONIZATION_NONE && sync != POSITION_SYNCHRONIZATION_CHECK)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown synchronization mode " + sync);
        }

        mSynchronizationMode = sync;
        return true;
    }

    public MetadataEditor editMetadata()
    {
        MetadataEditor editor = new MetadataEditor();
        editor.mEditableKeys.add(MediaMetadataEditor.RATING_KEY_BY_USER);
        return editor;
    }

    Context getContext()
    {
        return mContext;
    }

    OnClientUpdateListener getUpdateListener()
    {
        return mOnClientUpdateListener;
    }

    Handler getHandler()
    {
        return mHandler;
    }

    public interface OnClientUpdateListener
    {
        void onClientChange(boolean clearing);

        void onClientPlaybackStateUpdate(int state);

        void onClientPlaybackStateUpdate(int state, long stateChangeTimeMs, long currentPosMs, float speed);

        void onClientTransportControlUpdate(int transportControlFlags);

        void onClientMetadataUpdate(MetadataEditor metadataEditor);
    }

    public class MetadataEditor extends MediaMetadataEditor
    {
        MetadataEditor()
        {
        }

        @Override
        public synchronized void apply()
        {
            if (!mMetadataChanged) return;

            mMetadataChanged = false;

            Object rating = mEditorMetadata.getParcelable(String.valueOf(MediaMetadataEditor.RATING_KEY_BY_USER));
            if (!(rating instanceof Rating)) return;

            MediaController controller = currentController();
            if (controller != null) controller.getTransportControls().setRating((Rating)rating);
        }
    }
}
```
