```java
package android.media;

import android.content.Context;
import android.net.Uri;

public class Ringtone
{
    private final Uri mUri;
    private AudioAttributes mAudioAttributes = new AudioAttributes.Builder()
        .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_NOTIFICATION_RINGTONE)
        .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION)
        .build();
    private float mVolume = 1.0f;
    private boolean mLooping;
    private boolean mPlaying;
    private boolean mHapticGeneratorEnabled;

    Ringtone(Uri uri)
    {
        mUri = uri;
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize()
    {
        stop();
    }

    public AudioAttributes getAudioAttributes()
    {
        return mAudioAttributes;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public int getStreamType()
    {
        return mAudioAttributes.getVolumeControlStream();
    }

    public String getTitle(Context context)
    {
        if (mUri == null) return "Silent";
        if (RingtoneManager.isDefault(mUri)) return "Default ringtone";

        String segment = mUri.getLastPathSegment();
        return segment == null || segment.isEmpty() ? "Unknown ringtone" : segment;
    }

    public float getVolume()
    {
        return mVolume;
    }

    public boolean isHapticGeneratorEnabled()
    {
        return mHapticGeneratorEnabled;
    }

    public boolean isLooping()
    {
        return mLooping;
    }

    public synchronized boolean isPlaying()
    {
        return mPlaying;
    }

    public synchronized void play()
    {
        mPlaying = mUri != null;
    }

    public void setAudioAttributes(AudioAttributes attributes) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (attributes == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid null AudioAttributes for Ringtone");
        mAudioAttributes = attributes;
    }

    public boolean setHapticGeneratorEnabled(boolean enabled)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void setLooping(boolean looping)
    {
        mLooping = looping;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public void setStreamType(int streamType)
    {
        setAudioAttributes(new AudioAttributes.Builder().setLegacyStreamType(streamType).build());
    }

    public void setVolume(float volume)
    {
        mVolume = Math.max(0.0f, Math.min(1.0f, volume));
    }

    public synchronized void stop()
    {
        mPlaying = false;
    }

    Uri getUri()
    {
        return mUri;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.media;

import android.app.Activity;

    public static final int TITLE_COLUMN_INDEX = 1;

    public static final int TYPE_ALL = 7;
    public static final int TYPE_NOTIFICATION = 2;
    public static final int TYPE_RINGTONE = 1;
    public static final int URI_COLUMN_INDEX = 2;

    private boolean mIncludeDrm;
    private boolean mStopPreviousRingtone = true;

    {
        mContext = activity;
    }

    public RingtoneManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public static Uri getActualDefaultRingtoneUri(Context context, int type)
    {
        String setting = settingForType(type);
        if (setting == null || context == null) return null;

        String value = Settings.System.getString(context.getContentResolver(), setting);
        return value == null ? null : Uri.parse(value);
    }

    public Cursor getCursor()
    {
        return new MatrixCursor(COLUMNS);
    }

    public static int getDefaultType(Uri defaultRingtoneUri)
    {
        if (defaultRingtoneUri == null) return -1;
        if (defaultRingtoneUri.equals(Settings.System.DEFAULT_RINGTONE_URI)) return TYPE_RINGTONE;
        if (defaultRingtoneUri.equals(Settings.System.DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_URI)) return TYPE_NOTIFICATION;
        if (defaultRingtoneUri.equals(Settings.System.DEFAULT_ALARM_ALERT_URI)) return TYPE_ALARM;
        return -1;
    }

    public static Uri getDefaultUri(int type)
    {
        if ((type & TYPE_RINGTONE) != 0) return Settings.System.DEFAULT_RINGTONE_URI;
        if ((type & TYPE_NOTIFICATION) != 0) return Settings.System.DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_URI;
        if ((type & TYPE_ALARM) != 0) return Settings.System.DEFAULT_ALARM_ALERT_URI;
        return null;
    }

    public boolean getIncludeDrm()
    {
        return mIncludeDrm;
    }

    public static Ringtone getRingtone(Context context, Uri ringtoneUri)
    {
        return new Ringtone(ringtoneUri);
    }

    public Ringtone getRingtone(int position)
    {
        if (mStopPreviousRingtone && mPreviousRingtone != null) mPreviousRingtone.stop();

        Uri uri = getRingtoneUri(position);
        if (uri == null) return null;

        mPreviousRingtone = new Ringtone(uri);
        return mPreviousRingtone;
    }

    public int getRingtonePosition(Uri ringtoneUri)
    {
        return -1;
    }

    public Uri getRingtoneUri(int position)
    {
        return null;
    }

    public boolean getStopPreviousRingtone()
    {
        return mStopPreviousRingtone;
    }

    public static Uri getValidRingtoneUri(Context context)
    {
        return null;
    }

    public static boolean hasHapticChannels(Context context, Uri ringtoneUri)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public static boolean hasHapticChannels(Uri ringtoneUri)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean hasHapticChannels(int position)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public int inferStreamType()
    {
        switch (mType)
        {
            case TYPE_ALARM:
                return AudioManager.STREAM_ALARM;
            case TYPE_NOTIFICATION:
                return AudioManager.STREAM_NOTIFICATION;
            default:
                return AudioManager.STREAM_RING;
        }
    }

    public static boolean isDefault(Uri ringtoneUri)
    {
        return getDefaultType(ringtoneUri) != -1;
    }

    public static AssetFileDescriptor openDefaultRingtoneUri(Context context, Uri uri) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        int type = getDefaultType(uri);
        Uri actual = getActualDefaultRingtoneUri(context, type);
        if (actual == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("No default ringtone set for " + uri);

        return context.getContentResolver().openAssetFileDescriptor(actual, "r");
    }

    public static void setActualDefaultRingtoneUri(Context context, int type, Uri ringtoneUri)
    {
        String setting = settingForType(type);
        if (setting == null || context == null) return;

        Settings.System.putString(context.getContentResolver(), setting, ringtoneUri == null ? null : ringtoneUri.toString());
    }

    public void setIncludeDrm(boolean includeDrm)
    {
        mIncludeDrm = includeDrm;
    }

    public void setStopPreviousRingtone(boolean stopPreviousRingtone)
    {
        mStopPreviousRingtone = stopPreviousRingtone;
    }

    public void setType(int type)
    {
        mType = type;
    }

    public void stopPreviousRingtone()
    {
        if (mPreviousRingtone != null) mPreviousRingtone.stop();
    }

    private static String settingForType(int type)
    {
        if ((type & TYPE_RINGTONE) != 0) return Settings.System.RINGTONE;
        if ((type & TYPE_NOTIFICATION) != 0) return Settings.System.NOTIFICATION_SOUND;
        if ((type & TYPE_ALARM) != 0) return Settings.System.ALARM_ALERT;
        return null;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.media;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class RouteDiscoveryPreference implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<RouteDiscoveryPreference> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<RouteDiscoveryPreference>()
    {
        @Override
        public RouteDiscoveryPreference createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            List<String> features = source.createStringArrayList();
            boolean activeScan = source.readBoolean();
            return new RouteDiscoveryPreference(features, activeScan);
        }

        @Override
        public RouteDiscoveryPreference[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new RouteDiscoveryPreference[size];
        }
    };

    static final RouteDiscoveryPreference EMPTY = new RouteDiscoveryPreference(new ArrayList<>(), false);

    private final List<String> mPreferredFeatures;
    private final boolean mShouldPerformActiveScan;

    private RouteDiscoveryPreference(List<String> preferredFeatures, boolean shouldPerformActiveScan)
    {
        mPreferredFeatures = Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(preferredFeatures));
        mShouldPerformActiveScan = shouldPerformActiveScan;
    }

    public List<String> getPreferredFeatures()
    {
        return mPreferredFeatures;
    }

    public boolean shouldPerformActiveScan()
    {
        return mShouldPerformActiveScan;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeStringList(mPreferredFeatures);
        dest.writeBoolean(mShouldPerformActiveScan);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        if (object == this) return true;
        if (!(object instanceof RouteDiscoveryPreference)) return false;

        RouteDiscoveryPreference other = (RouteDiscoveryPreference)object;

        return new HashSet<>(mPreferredFeatures).equals(new HashSet<>(other.mPreferredFeatures))
                && mShouldPerformActiveScan == other.mShouldPerformActiveScan;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(new HashSet<>(mPreferredFeatures), mShouldPerformActiveScan);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "RouteDiscoveryRequest{ preferredFeatures={" + String.join(", ", mPreferredFeatures) + "}, activeScan="
                + mShouldPerformActiveScan + " }";
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private List<String> mPreferredFeatures;
        private boolean mActiveScan;

        public Builder(List<String> preferredFeatures, boolean activeScan)
        {
            if (preferredFeatures == null) throw new NullPointerException("preferredFeatures must not be null");

            mPreferredFeatures = new ArrayList<>();

            for (String feature : preferredFeatures)
            {
                if (feature != null && !feature.isEmpty()) mPreferredFeatures.add(feature);
            }

            mActiveScan = activeScan;
        }

        public Builder(RouteDiscoveryPreference preference)
        {
            if (preference == null) throw new NullPointerException("preference must not be null");

            mPreferredFeatures = new ArrayList<>(preference.getPreferredFeatures());
            mActiveScan = preference.shouldPerformActiveScan();
        }

        public Builder setPreferredFeatures(List<String> preferredFeatures)
        {
            if (preferredFeatures == null) throw new NullPointerException("preferredFeatures must not be null");

            mPreferredFeatures = new ArrayList<>();

            for (String feature : preferredFeatures)
            {
                if (feature != null && !feature.isEmpty()) mPreferredFeatures.add(feature);
            }

            return this;
        }

        public Builder setShouldPerformActiveScan(boolean activeScan)
        {
            mActiveScan = activeScan;
            return this;
        }

        public RouteDiscoveryPreference build()
        {
            return new RouteDiscoveryPreference(mPreferredFeatures, mActiveScan);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.media;

import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.text.TextUtils;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;

public final class RouteListingPreference implements Parcelable
{
    public static final String ACTION_TRANSFER_MEDIA = "android.media.action.TRANSFER_MEDIA";
    public static final String EXTRA_ROUTE_ID = "android.media.extra.ROUTE_ID";

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<RouteListingPreference> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<RouteListingPreference>()
    {
        @Override
        public RouteListingPreference createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            List<Item> items = source.createTypedArrayList(Item.CREATOR);
            boolean useSystemOrdering = source.readBoolean();
            ComponentName linkedItemComponentName = source.readTypedObject(ComponentName.CREATOR);
            return new RouteListingPreference(items, useSystemOrdering, linkedItemComponentName);
        }

        @Override
        public RouteListingPreference[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new RouteListingPreference[size];
        }
    };

    private final List<Item> mItems;
    private final boolean mUseSystemOrdering;
    private final ComponentName mLinkedItemComponentName;

    private RouteListingPreference(List<Item> items, boolean useSystemOrdering, ComponentName linkedItemComponentName)
    {
        mItems = Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(items == null ? new ArrayList<>() : items));
        mUseSystemOrdering = useSystemOrdering;
        mLinkedItemComponentName = linkedItemComponentName;
    }

    public List<Item> getItems()
    {
        return mItems;
    }

    public boolean getUseSystemOrdering()
    {
        return mUseSystemOrdering;
    }

    public ComponentName getLinkedItemComponentName()
    {
        return mLinkedItemComponentName;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeTypedList(mItems, flags);
        dest.writeBoolean(mUseSystemOrdering);
        dest.writeTypedObject(mLinkedItemComponentName, flags);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        if (object == this) return true;
        if (!(object instanceof RouteListingPreference)) return false;

        RouteListingPreference other = (RouteListingPreference)object;

        return mItems.equals(other.mItems) && mUseSystemOrdering == other.mUseSystemOrdering
                && Objects.equals(mLinkedItemComponentName, other.mLinkedItemComponentName);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mItems, mUseSystemOrdering, mLinkedItemComponentName);
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private List<Item> mItems = new ArrayList<>();
        private boolean mUseSystemOrdering = true;
        private ComponentName mLinkedItemComponentName;

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public Builder setItems(List<Item> items)
        {
            if (items == null) throw new NullPointerException("items must not be null");

            mItems = new ArrayList<>(items);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setUseSystemOrdering(boolean useSystemOrdering)
        {
            mUseSystemOrdering = useSystemOrdering;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setLinkedItemComponentName(ComponentName linkedItemComponentName)
        {
            mLinkedItemComponentName = linkedItemComponentName;
            return this;
        }

        public RouteListingPreference build()
        {
            Set<String> routeIds = new HashSet<>();

            for (Item item : mItems)
            {
                if (!routeIds.add(item.getRouteId()))
                {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Each Item must have a unique route id");
                }
            }

            return new RouteListingPreference(mItems, mUseSystemOrdering, mLinkedItemComponentName);
        }
    }

    public static final class Item implements Parcelable
    {
        public static final int FLAG_ONGOING_SESSION = 1;
        public static final int FLAG_ONGOING_SESSION_MANAGED = 2;
        public static final int FLAG_SUGGESTED = 4;
        public static final int SELECTION_BEHAVIOR_GO_TO_APP = 2;
        public static final int SELECTION_BEHAVIOR_NONE = 0;
        public static final int SELECTION_BEHAVIOR_TRANSFER = 1;
        public static final int SUBTEXT_AD_ROUTING_DISALLOWED = 4;
        public static final int SUBTEXT_CUSTOM = 10000;
        public static final int SUBTEXT_DEVICE_LOW_POWER = 5;
        public static final int SUBTEXT_DOWNLOADED_CONTENT_ROUTING_DISALLOWED = 3;
        public static final int SUBTEXT_ERROR_UNKNOWN = 1;
        public static final int SUBTEXT_NONE = 0;
        public static final int SUBTEXT_SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED = 2;
        public static final int SUBTEXT_TRACK_UNSUPPORTED = 7;
        public static final int SUBTEXT_UNAUTHORIZED = 6;

        public static final Parcelable.Creator<Item> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<Item>()
        {
            @Override
            public Item createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                String routeId = source.readString();
                int selectionBehavior = source.readInt();
                int flags = source.readInt();
                int subText = source.readInt();
                CharSequence customSubtextMessage = TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
                return new Item(routeId, selectionBehavior, flags, subText, customSubtextMessage);
            }

            @Override
            public Item[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new Item[size];
            }
        };

        private final String mRouteId;
        private final int mSelectionBehavior;
        private final int mFlags;
        private final int mSubText;
        private final CharSequence mCustomSubtextMessage;

        private Item(String routeId, int selectionBehavior, int flags, int subText, CharSequence customSubtextMessage)
        {
            mRouteId = routeId;
            mSelectionBehavior = selectionBehavior;
            mFlags = flags;
            mSubText = subText;
            mCustomSubtextMessage = customSubtextMessage;
        }

        public String getRouteId()
        {
            return mRouteId;
        }

        public int getSelectionBehavior()
        {
            return mSelectionBehavior;
        }

        public int getFlags()
        {
            return mFlags;
        }

        public int getSubText()
        {
            return mSubText;
        }

        public CharSequence getCustomSubtextMessage()
        {
            return mCustomSubtextMessage;
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
        {
            dest.writeString(mRouteId);
            dest.writeInt(mSelectionBehavior);
            dest.writeInt(mFlags);
            dest.writeInt(mSubText);
            TextUtils.writeToParcel(mCustomSubtextMessage, dest, flags);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object object)
        {
            if (object == this) return true;
            if (!(object instanceof Item)) return false;

            Item other = (Item)object;

            return Objects.equals(mRouteId, other.mRouteId) && mSelectionBehavior == other.mSelectionBehavior
                    && mFlags == other.mFlags && mSubText == other.mSubText
                    && TextUtils.equals(mCustomSubtextMessage, other.mCustomSubtextMessage);
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return Objects.hash(mRouteId, mSelectionBehavior, mFlags, mSubText, String.valueOf(mCustomSubtextMessage));
        }

        public static final class Builder
        {
            private final String mRouteId;
            private int mSelectionBehavior = SELECTION_BEHAVIOR_TRANSFER;
            private int mFlags;
            private int mSubText = SUBTEXT_NONE;
            private CharSequence mCustomSubtextMessage;

            public Builder(String routeId)
            {
                if (TextUtils.isEmpty(routeId)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("routeId must not be empty");

                mRouteId = routeId;
            }

            public Builder setSelectionBehavior(int selectionBehavior)
            {
                mSelectionBehavior = selectionBehavior;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setFlags(int flags)
            {
                mFlags = flags;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setSubText(int subText)
            {
                mSubText = subText;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setCustomSubtextMessage(CharSequence customSubtextMessage)
            {
                mCustomSubtextMessage = customSubtextMessage;
                return this;
            }

            public Item build()
            {
                if (mSubText == SUBTEXT_CUSTOM && mCustomSubtextMessage == null)
                {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("The custom subtext message cannot be null if subtext is SUBTEXT_CUSTOM");
                }

                return new Item(mRouteId, mSelectionBehavior, mFlags, mSubText, mCustomSubtextMessage);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/media/Session2Token.java`:

```java
package android.media;

import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.os.Process;

import java.util.Objects;

public final class Session2Token implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int TYPE_SESSION = 0;
    public static final int TYPE_SESSION_SERVICE = 1;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<Session2Token> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<Session2Token>()
    {
        @Override
        public Session2Token createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int uid = source.readInt();
            int type = source.readInt();
            String packageName = source.readString();
            String serviceName = source.readString();
            Bundle extras = source.readBundle();
            return new Session2Token(uid, type, packageName, serviceName, extras);
        }

        @Override
        public Session2Token[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Session2Token[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mUid;
    private final int mType;
    private final String mPackageName;
    private final String mServiceName;
    private final Bundle mExtras;

    public Session2Token(Context context, ComponentName serviceComponent)
    {
        if (context == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("context shouldn't be null");
        if (serviceComponent == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("serviceComponent shouldn't be null");

        ApplicationInfo info = context.getPackageName().equals(serviceComponent.getPackageName()) ? context.getApplicationInfo() : null;

        mUid = info != null ? info.uid : Process.myUid();
        mType = TYPE_SESSION_SERVICE;
        mPackageName = serviceComponent.getPackageName();
        mServiceName = serviceComponent.getClassName();
        mExtras = Bundle.EMPTY;
    }

    Session2Token(int uid, int type, String packageName, String serviceName, Bundle extras)
    {
        mUid = uid;
        mType = type;
        mPackageName = packageName;
        mServiceName = serviceName;
        mExtras = extras == null ? Bundle.EMPTY : extras;
    }

    public String getPackageName()
    {
        return mPackageName;
    }

    public String getServiceName()
    {
        return mServiceName;
    }

    public int getUid()
    {
        return mUid;
    }

    public int getType()
    {
        return mType;
    }

    public Bundle getExtras()
    {
        return new Bundle(mExtras);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mUid);
        dest.writeInt(mType);
        dest.writeString(mPackageName);
        dest.writeString(mServiceName);
        dest.writeBundle(mExtras);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        if (object == this) return true;
        if (!(object instanceof Session2Token)) return false;

        Session2Token other = (Session2Token)object;

        return mUid == other.mUid && mType == other.mType && Objects.equals(mPackageName, other.mPackageName)
                && Objects.equals(mServiceName, other.mServiceName);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mType, mUid, mPackageName, mServiceName);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Session2Token {pkg=" + mPackageName + " type=" + mType + " service=" + mServiceName + "}";
    }
}
```

`java/android/media/SoundPool.java`:

```java
package android.media;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.AssetFileDescriptor;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

public class SoundPool
{
    private static final int LOAD_STATUS_OK = 0;
    private static final int LOAD_STATUS_ERROR = 1;

    public interface OnLoadCompleteListener
    {
        void onLoadComplete(SoundPool soundPool, int sampleId, int status);
    }

    private static final class Stream
    {
        final int mStreamId;
        final int mSampleId;
        int mPriority;
        int mLoop;
        float mLeftVolume;
        float mRightVolume;
        float mRate;
        boolean mPaused;
        boolean mAutoPaused;

        Stream(int streamId, int sampleId)
        {
            mStreamId = streamId;
            mSampleId = sampleId;
        }
    }

    private final Object mLock = new Object();
    private final int mMaxStreams;
    private final AudioAttributes mAudioAttributes;
    private final Set<Integer> mSamples = new HashSet<>();
    private final Map<Integer, Stream> mStreams = new HashMap<>();
    private final Handler mHandler;
    private OnLoadCompleteListener mOnLoadCompleteListener;
    private int mNextSampleId = 1;
    private int mNextStreamId = 1;
    private boolean mReleased;

    @Deprecated
    public SoundPool(int maxStreams, int streamType, int sourceQuality)
    {
        this(maxStreams, new AudioAttributes.Builder().setLegacyStreamType(streamType).build());
    }

    private SoundPool(int maxStreams, AudioAttributes attributes)
    {
        mMaxStreams = maxStreams;
        mAudioAttributes = attributes;

        Looper looper = Looper.myLooper();
        if (looper == null) looper = Looper.getMainLooper();
        mHandler = looper == null ? null : new Handler(looper);
    }

    public final void autoPause()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            for (Stream stream : mStreams.values())
            {
                if (!stream.mPaused)
                {
                    stream.mPaused = true;
                    stream.mAutoPaused = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public final void autoResume()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            for (Stream stream : mStreams.values())
            {
                if (stream.mAutoPaused)
                {
                    stream.mPaused = false;
                    stream.mAutoPaused = false;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public int load(Context context, int resourceId, int priority)
    {
        boolean readable = false;
        InputStream input = context.getResources().openRawResource(resourceId);

        try
        {
            readable = input.read() >= 0;
        }
        catch (java.io.IOException exception)
        {
            readable = false;
        }
        finally
        {
            closeQuietly(input);
        }

        return enqueueLoad(readable);
    }

    public int load(AssetFileDescriptor descriptor, int priority)
    {
        if (descriptor == null) return 0;

        long length = descriptor.getLength();
        if (length < 0 && length != AssetFileDescriptor.UNKNOWN_LENGTH) throw new IllegalArgumentException("no length for fd");

        return enqueueLoad(descriptor.getFileDescriptor() != null && descriptor.getFileDescriptor().valid());
    }

    public int load(FileDescriptor descriptor, long offset, long length, int priority)
    {
        return enqueueLoad(descriptor != null && descriptor.valid() && offset >= 0 && length != 0);
    }

    public int load(String path, int priority)
    {
        if (path == null) return 0;

        File file = new File(path);
        if (!file.isFile() || !file.canRead()) return 0;

        return enqueueLoad(file.length() > 0);
    }

    public final void pause(int streamId)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            Stream stream = mStreams.get(streamId);
            if (stream != null)
            {
                stream.mPaused = true;
                stream.mAutoPaused = false;
            }
        }
    }

    public final int play(int soundId, float leftVolume, float rightVolume, int priority, int loop, float rate)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mReleased || !mSamples.contains(soundId)) return 0;

            if (mMaxStreams > 0 && mStreams.size() >= mMaxStreams && !evictStreamBelow(priority)) return 0;

            Stream stream = new Stream(mNextStreamId++, soundId);
            stream.mPriority = priority;
            stream.mLoop = loop;
            stream.mLeftVolume = clampVolume(leftVolume);
            stream.mRightVolume = clampVolume(rightVolume);
            stream.mRate = clampRate(rate);
            mStreams.put(stream.mStreamId, stream);
            return stream.mStreamId;
        }
    }

    public final void release()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            mReleased = true;
            mStreams.clear();
            mSamples.clear();
            mOnLoadCompleteListener = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize()
    {
        release();
    }

    public final void resume(int streamId)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            Stream stream = mStreams.get(streamId);
            if (stream != null)
            {
                stream.mPaused = false;
                stream.mAutoPaused = false;
            }
        }
    }

    public final void setLoop(int streamId, int loop)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            Stream stream = mStreams.get(streamId);
            if (stream != null) stream.mLoop = loop;
        }
    }

    public void setOnLoadCompleteListener(SoundPool.OnLoadCompleteListener listener)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            mOnLoadCompleteListener = listener;
        }
    }

    public final void setPriority(int streamId, int priority)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            Stream stream = mStreams.get(streamId);
            if (stream != null) stream.mPriority = priority;
        }
    }

    public final void setRate(int streamId, float rate)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            Stream stream = mStreams.get(streamId);
            if (stream != null) stream.mRate = clampRate(rate);
        }
    }

    public final void setVolume(int streamId, float leftVolume, float rightVolume)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            Stream stream = mStreams.get(streamId);
            if (stream != null)
            {
                stream.mLeftVolume = clampVolume(leftVolume);
                stream.mRightVolume = clampVolume(rightVolume);
            }
        }
    }

    public final void stop(int streamId)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            mStreams.remove(streamId);
        }
    }

    public final boolean unload(int soundId)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (!mSamples.remove(soundId)) return false;

            Iterator<Stream> iterator = mStreams.values().iterator();
            while (iterator.hasNext())
            {
                if (iterator.next().mSampleId == soundId) iterator.remove();
            }

            return true;
        }
    }

    private int enqueueLoad(boolean readable)
    {
        final int sampleId;
        final int status = readable ? LOAD_STATUS_OK : LOAD_STATUS_ERROR;

        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mReleased) return 0;

            sampleId = mNextSampleId++;
            if (readable) mSamples.add(sampleId);
        }

        Runnable notify = new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                OnLoadCompleteListener listener;

                synchronized (mLock)
                {
                    listener = mOnLoadCompleteListener;
                }

                if (listener != null) listener.onLoadComplete(SoundPool.this, sampleId, status);
            }
        };

        if (mHandler != null)
        {
            mHandler.post(notify);
        }
        else
        {
            Thread thread = new Thread(notify, "SoundPoolLoader");
            thread.setDaemon(true);
            thread.start();
        }

        return sampleId;
    }

    private boolean evictStreamBelow(int priority)
    {
        Stream victim = null;

        for (Stream stream : mStreams.values())
        {
            if (stream.mPriority > priority) continue;
            if (victim == null || stream.mPriority < victim.mPriority
                || (stream.mPriority == victim.mPriority && stream.mStreamId < victim.mStreamId))
            {
                victim = stream;
            }
        }

        if (victim == null) return false;

        mStreams.remove(victim.mStreamId);
        return true;
    }

    private static float clampVolume(float volume)
    {
        return Math.max(0.0f, Math.min(1.0f, volume));
    }

    private static float clampRate(float rate)
    {
        return Math.max(0.5f, Math.min(2.0f, rate));
    }

    private static void closeQuietly(InputStream input)
    {
        try
        {
            input.close();
        }
        catch (java.io.IOException exception)
        {
        }
    }

    public static class Builder
    {
        private int mMaxStreams = 1;
        private AudioAttributes mAudioAttributes;

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public SoundPool build()
        {
            AudioAttributes attributes = mAudioAttributes;
            if (attributes == null) attributes = new AudioAttributes.Builder().setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA).build();

            return new SoundPool(mMaxStreams, attributes);
        }

        public SoundPool.Builder setAudioAttributes(AudioAttributes attributes) throws IllegalArgumentException
        {
            if (attributes == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid null AudioAttributes");
            mAudioAttributes = attributes;
            return this;
        }

        public SoundPool.Builder setAudioSessionId(int sessionId)
        {
            if (sessionId != AudioManager.AUDIO_SESSION_ID_GENERATE && sessionId <= 0)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid audio session ID " + sessionId);
            }

            return this;
        }

        public SoundPool.Builder setContext(Context context)
        {
            return this;
        }

        public SoundPool.Builder setMaxStreams(int maxStreams) throws IllegalArgumentException
        {
            if (maxStreams <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Strictly positive value required for max streams");
            mMaxStreams = maxStreams;
            return this;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.media;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;

public class Spatializer
{
    public static final int SPATIALIZER_IMMERSIVE_LEVEL_MULTICHANNEL = 1;
    public static final int SPATIALIZER_IMMERSIVE_LEVEL_NONE = 0;
    public static final int SPATIALIZER_IMMERSIVE_LEVEL_OTHER = -1;

    private final List<OnHeadTrackerAvailableListener> mHeadTrackerListeners = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    private final List<OnSpatializerStateChangedListener> mStateListeners = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();

    Spatializer()
    {
    }

    public void addOnHeadTrackerAvailableListener(Executor executor, OnHeadTrackerAvailableListener listener)
    {
        Objects.requireNonNull(executor);
        Objects.requireNonNull(listener);

        if (!mHeadTrackerListeners.contains(listener)) mHeadTrackerListeners.add(listener);
    }

    public void addOnSpatializerStateChangedListener(Executor executor, OnSpatializerStateChangedListener listener)
    {
        Objects.requireNonNull(executor);
        Objects.requireNonNull(listener);

        if (!mStateListeners.contains(listener)) mStateListeners.add(listener);
    }

    public boolean canBeSpatialized(AudioAttributes attributes, AudioFormat format)
    {
        Objects.requireNonNull(attributes);
        Objects.requireNonNull(format);

        return false;
    }

    public int getImmersiveAudioLevel()
    {
        return SPATIALIZER_IMMERSIVE_LEVEL_NONE;
    }

    public List<Integer> getSpatializedChannelMasks()
    {
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public boolean isAvailable()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isEnabled()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isHeadTrackerAvailable()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void removeOnHeadTrackerAvailableListener(OnHeadTrackerAvailableListener listener)
    {
        mHeadTrackerListeners.remove(listener);
    }

    public void removeOnSpatializerStateChangedListener(OnSpatializerStateChangedListener listener)
    {
        mStateListeners.remove(listener);
    }

    public interface OnSpatializerStateChangedListener
    {
        void onSpatializerAvailableChanged(Spatializer spatializer, boolean available);

        void onSpatializerEnabledChanged(Spatializer spatializer, boolean enabled);
    }

    public interface OnHeadTrackerAvailableListener
```

```java
package android.media;

public final class SyncParams
{
    public static final int AUDIO_ADJUST_MODE_DEFAULT = 0;
    public static final int AUDIO_ADJUST_MODE_RESAMPLE = 2;
    public static final int AUDIO_ADJUST_MODE_STRETCH = 1;
    public static final int SYNC_SOURCE_AUDIO = 2;
    public static final int SYNC_SOURCE_DEFAULT = 0;
    public static final int SYNC_SOURCE_SYSTEM_CLOCK = 1;
    public static final int SYNC_SOURCE_VSYNC = 3;

    private static final int SET_SYNC_SOURCE = 1;
    private static final int SET_AUDIO_ADJUST_MODE = 2;
    private static final int SET_TOLERANCE = 4;
    private static final int SET_FRAME_RATE = 8;

    private int mSet;
    private int mSyncSource = SYNC_SOURCE_DEFAULT;
    private int mAudioAdjustMode = AUDIO_ADJUST_MODE_DEFAULT;
    private float mTolerance;
    private float mFrameRate;

    public SyncParams()
    {
    }

    public SyncParams allowDefaults()
    {
        mSet |= SET_SYNC_SOURCE | SET_AUDIO_ADJUST_MODE | SET_TOLERANCE;
        return this;
    }

    public int getAudioAdjustMode()
    {
        if ((mSet & SET_AUDIO_ADJUST_MODE) == 0) throw new IllegalStateException("audio adjust mode not set");
        return mAudioAdjustMode;
    }

    public float getFrameRate()
    {
        if ((mSet & SET_FRAME_RATE) == 0) throw new IllegalStateException("frame rate not set");
        return mFrameRate;
    }

    public int getSyncSource()
    {
        if ((mSet & SET_SYNC_SOURCE) == 0) throw new IllegalStateException("sync source not set");
        return mSyncSource;
    }

    public float getTolerance()
    {
        if ((mSet & SET_TOLERANCE) == 0) throw new IllegalStateException("tolerance not set");
        return mTolerance;
    }

    public SyncParams setAudioAdjustMode(int audioAdjustMode)
    {
        mAudioAdjustMode = audioAdjustMode;
        mSet |= SET_AUDIO_ADJUST_MODE;
        return this;
    }

    public SyncParams setFrameRate(float frameRate)
    {
        mFrameRate = frameRate;
        mSet |= SET_FRAME_RATE;
        return this;
    }

    public SyncParams setSyncSource(int syncSource)
    {
        mSyncSource = syncSource;
        mSet |= SET_SYNC_SOURCE;
        return this;
    }

    public SyncParams setTolerance(float tolerance)
    {
        if (tolerance < 0.0f || tolerance >= 1.0f) throw new IllegalArgumentException("tolerance must be in [0, 1)");
        mTolerance = tolerance;
        mSet |= SET_TOLERANCE;
        return this;
    }
```

`java/android/media/ThumbnailUtils.java`:

```java
package android.media;

import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory;
import android.graphics.Matrix;
import android.os.CancellationSignal;
import android.util.Size;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;

public class ThumbnailUtils
{
    public static final int OPTIONS_RECYCLE_INPUT = 2;

    private static final int MINI_KIND = 1;
    private static final int MICRO_KIND = 3;
    private static final int MINI_WIDTH = 512;
    private static final int MINI_HEIGHT = 384;
    private static final int MICRO_SIZE = 96;
    private static final String[] FOLDER_ART_NAMES = {"albumart.jpg", "albumart.png", "cover.jpg", "cover.png", "folder.jpg",
        "folder.png", "front.jpg", "front.png"};

    public ThumbnailUtils()
    {
    }

    public static Bitmap createAudioThumbnail(File file, Size size, CancellationSignal signal) throws IOException
    {
        checkCanceled(signal);

        if (file == null) throw new NullPointerException("file");
        if (size == null) throw new NullPointerException("size");

        File directory = file.getParentFile();
        File[] siblings = directory == null ? null : directory.listFiles();

        if (siblings != null)
        {
            for (String name : FOLDER_ART_NAMES)
            {
                for (File sibling : siblings)
                {
                    checkCanceled(signal);

                    if (sibling.isFile() && sibling.getName().equalsIgnoreCase(name))
                    {
                        Bitmap art = decodeScaled(sibling.getAbsolutePath(), size.getWidth(), size.getHeight());

                        if (art != null) return art;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        throw new IOException("No album art found");
    }

    public static Bitmap createAudioThumbnail(String filePath, int kind)
    {
        try
        {
            return createAudioThumbnail(new File(filePath), sizeForKind(kind), null);
        }
        catch (IOException | RuntimeException failure)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static Bitmap createImageThumbnail(File file, Size size, CancellationSignal signal) throws IOException
    {
        checkCanceled(signal);

        if (file == null) throw new NullPointerException("file");
        if (size == null) throw new NullPointerException("size");
        if (!file.isFile()) throw new IOException("File not found: " + file);

        Bitmap bitmap = decodeScaled(file.getAbsolutePath(), size.getWidth(), size.getHeight());

        checkCanceled(signal);

        if (bitmap == null) throw new IOException("Failed to decode image: " + file);

        int rotation = 0;

        try
        {
            rotation = new ExifInterface(file).getRotationDegrees();
        }
        catch (IOException | RuntimeException ignored)
        {
            rotation = 0;
        }

        if (rotation != 0)
        {
            Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
            matrix.postRotate(rotation);
            Bitmap rotated = Bitmap.createBitmap(bitmap, 0, 0, bitmap.getWidth(), bitmap.getHeight(), matrix, true);

            if (rotated != null && rotated != bitmap)
            {
                bitmap.recycle();
                bitmap = rotated;
            }
        }

        return bitmap;
    }

    public static Bitmap createImageThumbnail(String filePath, int kind)
    {
        if (filePath == null) return null;

        try
        {
            Bitmap bitmap = createImageThumbnail(new File(filePath), sizeForKind(kind), null);

            if (kind == MICRO_KIND) return extractThumbnail(bitmap, MICRO_SIZE, MICRO_SIZE, OPTIONS_RECYCLE_INPUT);

            return bitmap;
        }
        catch (IOException | RuntimeException failure)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static Bitmap createVideoThumbnail(File file, Size size, CancellationSignal signal) throws IOException
    {
        checkCanceled(signal);

        if (file == null) throw new NullPointerException("file");
        if (size == null) throw new NullPointerException("size");

        throw new IOException("No video decoder is available for " + file);
    }

    public static Bitmap createVideoThumbnail(String filePath, int kind)
    {
        return null;
    }

    public static Bitmap extractThumbnail(Bitmap source, int width, int height)
    {
        return extractThumbnail(source, width, height, 0);
    }

    public static Bitmap extractThumbnail(Bitmap source, int width, int height, int options)
    {
        if (source == null) return null;
        if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return null;

        int sourceWidth = source.getWidth();
        int sourceHeight = source.getHeight();

        if (sourceWidth <= 0 || sourceHeight <= 0) return null;

        float scale = Math.max((float)width / sourceWidth, (float)height / sourceHeight);
        int scaledWidth = Math.max(width, Math.round(sourceWidth * scale));
        int scaledHeight = Math.max(height, Math.round(sourceHeight * scale));

        Bitmap scaled = scaledWidth == sourceWidth && scaledHeight == sourceHeight
            ? source : Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(source, scaledWidth, scaledHeight, true);

        int left = (scaledWidth - width) / 2;
        int top = (scaledHeight - height) / 2;
        Bitmap result = left == 0 && top == 0 && scaledWidth == width && scaledHeight == height
            ? scaled : Bitmap.createBitmap(scaled, left, top, width, height);

        if (scaled != source && scaled != result) scaled.recycle();

        if ((options & OPTIONS_RECYCLE_INPUT) != 0 && result != source) source.recycle();

        return result;
    }

    private static Size sizeForKind(int kind)
    {
        if (kind == MICRO_KIND) return new Size(MICRO_SIZE, MICRO_SIZE);

        return new Size(MINI_WIDTH, MINI_HEIGHT);
    }

    private static void checkCanceled(CancellationSignal signal)
    {
        if (signal != null) signal.throwIfCanceled();
    }

    private static Bitmap decodeScaled(String path, int maxWidth, int maxHeight)
    {
        BitmapFactory.Options bounds = new BitmapFactory.Options();
        bounds.inJustDecodeBounds = true;
        BitmapFactory.decodeFile(path, bounds);

        if (bounds.outWidth <= 0 || bounds.outHeight <= 0) return null;

        int sampleSize = 1;

        while (bounds.outWidth / (sampleSize * 2) >= maxWidth && bounds.outHeight / (sampleSize * 2) >= maxHeight)
        {
            sampleSize *= 2;
        }

        BitmapFactory.Options options = new BitmapFactory.Options();
        options.inSampleSize = sampleSize;
        Bitmap decoded = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(path, options);

        if (decoded == null) return null;

        int width = decoded.getWidth();
        int height = decoded.getHeight();

        if (width <= maxWidth && height <= maxHeight) return decoded;

        float scale = Math.min((float)maxWidth / width, (float)maxHeight / height);
        int targetWidth = Math.max(1, Math.round(width * scale));
        int targetHeight = Math.max(1, Math.round(height * scale));
        Bitmap scaled = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(decoded, targetWidth, targetHeight, true);

        if (scaled != decoded) decoded.recycle();

        return scaled;
    }
}
```

`java/android/media/VolumeShaper.java`:

```java
package android.media;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.os.SystemClock;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class VolumeShaper implements AutoCloseable
{
    private Configuration mConfiguration;
    private boolean mReversed;
    private boolean mRunning;
    private boolean mClosed;
    private float mPosition;
    private long mStartTimeMillis;

    VolumeShaper(Configuration configuration)
    {
        mConfiguration = Objects.requireNonNull(configuration);
    }

    public synchronized void apply(Operation operation)
    {
        Objects.requireNonNull(operation);

        if (mClosed) throw new IllegalStateException("VolumeShaper is closed");

        mPosition = currentPosition();
        mReversed = operation.isReverse();
        mRunning = true;
        mStartTimeMillis = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void close()
    {
        mPosition = currentPosition();
        mRunning = false;
        mClosed = true;
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize()
    {
        close();
    }

    public synchronized float getVolume()
    {
        return mConfiguration.volumeAt(currentPosition());
    }

    public synchronized void replace(Configuration configuration, Operation operation, boolean join)
    {
        Objects.requireNonNull(configuration);
        Objects.requireNonNull(operation);

        if (mClosed) throw new IllegalStateException("VolumeShaper is closed");

        float currentVolume = getVolume();
        mConfiguration = configuration;
        mPosition = join ? configuration.positionForVolume(currentVolume) : 0.0f;
        mReversed = operation.isReverse();
        mRunning = true;
        mStartTimeMillis = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
    }

    private float currentPosition()
    {
        if (!mRunning) return mPosition;

        long duration = Math.max(1, mConfiguration.getDuration());
        float elapsed = (SystemClock.uptimeMillis() - mStartTimeMillis) / (float)duration;
        float position = mReversed ? mPosition - elapsed : mPosition + elapsed;

        return Math.max(0.0f, Math.min(1.0f, position));
    }

    public static final class Operation implements Parcelable
    {
        private static final int FLAG_REVERSE = 1;

        public static final Operation PLAY = new Operation(0);
        public static final Operation REVERSE = new Operation(FLAG_REVERSE);

        public static final Parcelable.Creator<Operation> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<Operation>()
        {
            @Override
            public Operation createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                return new Operation(source.readInt());
            }

            @Override
            public Operation[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new Operation[size];
            }
        };

        private final int mFlags;

        Operation(int flags)
        {
            mFlags = flags;
        }

        boolean isReverse()
        {
            return (mFlags & FLAG_REVERSE) != 0;
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object object)
        {
            if (this == object) return true;
            if (!(object instanceof Operation)) return false;

            return mFlags == ((Operation)object).mFlags;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return Integer.hashCode(mFlags);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "VolumeShaper.Operation{ mFlags = 0x" + Integer.toHexString(mFlags).toUpperCase() + " }";
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
        {
            parcel.writeInt(mFlags);
        }
    }

    public static final class Configuration implements Parcelable
    {
        public static final int INTERPOLATOR_TYPE_CUBIC = 2;
        public static final int INTERPOLATOR_TYPE_CUBIC_MONOTONIC = 3;
        public static final int INTERPOLATOR_TYPE_LINEAR = 1;
        public static final int INTERPOLATOR_TYPE_STEP = 0;

        private static final int MAXIMUM_CURVE_POINTS = 16;
        private static final long DEFAULT_DURATION_MILLIS = 1000;

        public static final Configuration LINEAR_RAMP =
            new Configuration(INTERPOLATOR_TYPE_LINEAR, DEFAULT_DURATION_MILLIS, new float[] {0.0f, 1.0f}, new float[] {0.0f, 1.0f});
        public static final Configuration CUBIC_RAMP =
            new Configuration(INTERPOLATOR_TYPE_CUBIC, DEFAULT_DURATION_MILLIS, new float[] {0.0f, 1.0f}, new float[] {0.0f, 1.0f});
        public static final Configuration SINE_RAMP;
        public static final Configuration SCURVE_RAMP;

        static
        {
            float[] times = new float[MAXIMUM_CURVE_POINTS];
            float[] sineVolumes = new float[MAXIMUM_CURVE_POINTS];
            float[] scurveVolumes = new float[MAXIMUM_CURVE_POINTS];

            for (int index = 0; index < MAXIMUM_CURVE_POINTS; index++)
            {
                times[index] = (float)index / (MAXIMUM_CURVE_POINTS - 1);
                float sine = (float)Math.sin(times[index] * Math.PI / 2.0);
                sineVolumes[index] = sine;
                scurveVolumes[index] = sine * sine;
            }

            SINE_RAMP = new Configuration(INTERPOLATOR_TYPE_CUBIC, DEFAULT_DURATION_MILLIS, times, sineVolumes);
            SCURVE_RAMP = new Configuration(INTERPOLATOR_TYPE_CUBIC, DEFAULT_DURATION_MILLIS, times, scurveVolumes);
        }

        public static final Parcelable.Creator<Configuration> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<Configuration>()
        {
            @Override
            public Configuration createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                int interpolatorType = source.readInt();
                long durationMillis = source.readLong();
                float[] times = source.createFloatArray();
                float[] volumes = source.createFloatArray();
                return new Configuration(interpolatorType, durationMillis, times, volumes);
            }

            @Override
            public Configuration[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new Configuration[size];
            }
        };

        private final int mInterpolatorType;
        private final long mDurationMillis;
        private final float[] mTimes;
        private final float[] mVolumes;

        private Configuration(int interpolatorType, long durationMillis, float[] times, float[] volumes)
        {
            mInterpolatorType = interpolatorType;
            mDurationMillis = durationMillis;
            mTimes = times;
            mVolumes = volumes;
        }

        public static int getMaximumCurvePoints()
        {
            return MAXIMUM_CURVE_POINTS;
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object object)
        {
            if (this == object) return true;
            if (!(object instanceof Configuration)) return false;

            Configuration other = (Configuration)object;
            return mInterpolatorType == other.mInterpolatorType && mDurationMillis == other.mDurationMillis
                && Arrays.equals(mTimes, other.mTimes) && Arrays.equals(mVolumes, other.mVolumes);
        }

        public long getDuration()
        {
            return mDurationMillis;
        }

        public int getInterpolatorType()
        {
            return mInterpolatorType;
        }

        public float[] getTimes()
        {
            return mTimes.clone();
        }

        public float[] getVolumes()
        {
            return mVolumes.clone();
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return Objects.hash(mInterpolatorType, mDurationMillis, Arrays.hashCode(mTimes), Arrays.hashCode(mVolumes));
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "VolumeShaper.Configuration{ mInterpolatorType = " + mInterpolatorType + ", mDurationMs = " + mDurationMillis
                + ", mTimes[] = " + Arrays.toString(mTimes) + ", mVolumes[] = " + Arrays.toString(mVolumes) + " }";
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
        {
            parcel.writeInt(mInterpolatorType);
            parcel.writeLong(mDurationMillis);
            parcel.writeFloatArray(mTimes);
            parcel.writeFloatArray(mVolumes);
        }

        float volumeAt(float position)
        {
            int last = mTimes.length - 1;

            if (position <= mTimes[0]) return mVolumes[0];
            if (position >= mTimes[last]) return mVolumes[last];

            int segment = 0;
            while (segment < last - 1 && position >= mTimes[segment + 1])
            {
                segment++;
            }

            float startTime = mTimes[segment];
            float endTime = mTimes[segment + 1];
            float startVolume = mVolumes[segment];
            float endVolume = mVolumes[segment + 1];
            float width = endTime - startTime;
            float fraction = (position - startTime) / width;

            switch (mInterpolatorType)
            {
                case INTERPOLATOR_TYPE_STEP:
                    return startVolume;
                case INTERPOLATOR_TYPE_LINEAR:
                    return startVolume + (endVolume - startVolume) * fraction;
                default:
                    float startSlope = slopeAt(segment) * width;
                    float endSlope = slopeAt(segment + 1) * width;
                    float square = fraction * fraction;
                    float cube = square * fraction;
                    float value = (2 * cube - 3 * square + 1) * startVolume + (cube - 2 * square + fraction) * startSlope
                        + (-2 * cube + 3 * square) * endVolume + (cube - square) * endSlope;

                    if (mInterpolatorType == INTERPOLATOR_TYPE_CUBIC_MONOTONIC)
                    {
                        value = Math.max(Math.min(startVolume, endVolume), Math.min(Math.max(startVolume, endVolume), value));
                    }

                    return value;
            }
        }

        private float slopeAt(int index)
        {
            int last = mTimes.length - 1;

            if (last < 1) return 0.0f;

            if (index == 0) return (mVolumes[1] - mVolumes[0]) / (mTimes[1] - mTimes[0]);
            if (index == last) return (mVolumes[last] - mVolumes[last - 1]) / (mTimes[last] - mTimes[last - 1]);

            float before = (mVolumes[index] - mVolumes[index - 1]) / (mTimes[index] - mTimes[index - 1]);
            float after = (mVolumes[index + 1] - mVolumes[index]) / (mTimes[index + 1] - mTimes[index]);

            if (mInterpolatorType == INTERPOLATOR_TYPE_CUBIC_MONOTONIC && before * after <= 0) return 0.0f;

            return (before + after) / 2.0f;
        }

        float positionForVolume(float volume)
        {
            int last = mTimes.length - 1;
            float bestPosition = 0.0f;
            float bestDistance = Float.MAX_VALUE;

            for (int step = 0; step <= 100; step++)
            {
                float position = mTimes[0] + (mTimes[last] - mTimes[0]) * step / 100.0f;
                float distance = Math.abs(volumeAt(position) - volume);

                if (distance < bestDistance)
                {
                    bestDistance = distance;
                    bestPosition = position;
                }
            }

            return bestPosition;
        }

        public static final class Builder
        {
            private int mInterpolatorType = INTERPOLATOR_TYPE_CUBIC;
            private long mDurationMillis = DEFAULT_DURATION_MILLIS;
            private float[] mTimes;
            private float[] mVolumes;

            public Builder()
            {
            }

            public Builder(Configuration configuration)
            {
                mInterpolatorType = configuration.mInterpolatorType;
                mDurationMillis = configuration.mDurationMillis;
                mTimes = configuration.mTimes.clone();
                mVolumes = configuration.mVolumes.clone();
            }

            public Configuration build()
            {
                checkCurveForErrorsAndThrowException(mTimes, mVolumes);
                return new Configuration(mInterpolatorType, mDurationMillis, mTimes.clone(), mVolumes.clone());
            }

            public Builder invertVolumes()
            {
                checkCurveForErrorsAndThrowException(mTimes, mVolumes);

                float minimum = mVolumes[0];
                float maximum = mVolumes[0];

                for (float volume : mVolumes)
                {
                    minimum = Math.min(minimum, volume);
                    maximum = Math.max(maximum, volume);
                }

                for (int index = 0; index < mVolumes.length; index++)
                {
                    mVolumes[index] = maximum + minimum - mVolumes[index];
                }

                return this;
            }

            public Builder reflectTimes()
            {
                checkCurveForErrorsAndThrowException(mTimes, mVolumes);

                int length = mTimes.length;
                float[] times = new float[length];
                float[] volumes = new float[length];

                for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
                {
                    times[index] = 1.0f - mTimes[length - 1 - index];
                    volumes[index] = mVolumes[length - 1 - index];
                }

                mTimes = times;
                mVolumes = volumes;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder scaleToEndVolume(float volume)
            {
                checkCurveForErrorsAndThrowException(mTimes, mVolumes);
                checkVolume(volume);

                int last = mVolumes.length - 1;
                float startVolume = mVolumes[0];
                float endVolume = mVolumes[last];

                if (startVolume == endVolume)
                {
                    float offset = volume - startVolume;
                    for (int index = 0; index <= last; index++)
                    {
                        mVolumes[index] = mVolumes[index] + offset * mTimes[index];
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    float scale = (volume - startVolume) / (endVolume - startVolume);
                    for (int index = 0; index <= last; index++)
                    {
                        mVolumes[index] = scale * (mVolumes[index] - startVolume) + startVolume;
                    }
                }

                clampVolumes();
                return this;
            }

            public Builder scaleToStartVolume(float volume)
            {
                checkCurveForErrorsAndThrowException(mTimes, mVolumes);
                checkVolume(volume);

                int last = mVolumes.length - 1;
                float startVolume = mVolumes[0];
                float endVolume = mVolumes[last];

                if (startVolume == endVolume)
                {
                    float offset = volume - startVolume;
                    for (int index = 0; index <= last; index++)
                    {
                        mVolumes[index] = mVolumes[index] + offset * (1.0f - mTimes[index]);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    float scale = (volume - endVolume) / (startVolume - endVolume);
                    for (int index = 0; index <= last; index++)
                    {
                        mVolumes[index] = scale * (mVolumes[index] - endVolume) + endVolume;
                    }
                }

                clampVolumes();
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setCurve(float[] times, float[] volumes)
            {
                checkCurveForErrorsAndThrowException(times, volumes);

                mTimes = times.clone();
                mVolumes = volumes.clone();
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setDuration(long durationMillis)
            {
                if (durationMillis <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration: " + durationMillis + " not positive");

                mDurationMillis = durationMillis;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setInterpolatorType(int interpolatorType)
            {
                if (interpolatorType < INTERPOLATOR_TYPE_STEP || interpolatorType > INTERPOLATOR_TYPE_CUBIC_MONOTONIC)
                {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid interpolatorType: " + interpolatorType);
                }

                mInterpolatorType = interpolatorType;
                return this;
            }

            private void clampVolumes()
            {
                for (int index = 0; index < mVolumes.length; index++)
                {
                    mVolumes[index] = Math.max(0.0f, Math.min(1.0f, mVolumes[index]));
                }
            }

            private static void checkVolume(float volume)
            {
                if (!(volume >= 0.0f && volume <= 1.0f)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("volume out of range: " + volume);
            }

            private static void checkCurveForErrorsAndThrowException(float[] times, float[] volumes)
            {
                if (times == null) throw new IllegalStateException("times array must be non-null");
                if (volumes == null) throw new IllegalStateException("volumes array must be non-null");
                if (times.length != volumes.length) throw new IllegalStateException("array length must match");
                if (times.length < 2) throw new IllegalStateException("array length must be at least 2");
                if (times.length > MAXIMUM_CURVE_POINTS)
                {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("array length must be no larger than " + MAXIMUM_CURVE_POINTS);
                }

                if (times[0] != 0.0f) throw new IllegalStateException("times must start at 0.f");
                if (times[times.length - 1] != 1.0f) throw new IllegalStateException("times must end at 1.f");

                for (int index = 1; index < times.length; index++)
                {
                    if (!(times[index] > times[index - 1])) throw new IllegalStateException("times not monotonic increasing");
                }

                for (float volume : volumes)
                {
                    if (!(volume >= 0.0f && volume <= 1.0f)) throw new IllegalStateException("volumes out of range");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
        }
    }

    public static final class Mbc extends DynamicsProcessing.BandStage
    {
        private final MbcBand[] mBands;

        public Mbc(DynamicsProcessing.Mbc mbc)
        {

            {
                mBands[band] = new MbcBand(true, defaultCutoff(band, mBands.length), DEFAULT_MBC_ATTACK_TIME, DEFAULT_MBC_RELEASE_TIME,
                    DEFAULT_MBC_RATIO, DEFAULT_MBC_THRESHOLD, DEFAULT_MBC_KNEE_WIDTH, DEFAULT_MBC_NOISE_GATE_THRESHOLD,
                    DEFAULT_MBC_EXPANDER_RATIO, DEFAULT_MBC_PRE_GAIN, DEFAULT_MBC_POST_GAIN);
            }

    public static final class Eq extends DynamicsProcessing.BandStage
    {
        private final EqBand[] mBands;

        public Eq(DynamicsProcessing.Eq eq)
        {
            super(eq.isInUse(), eq.isEnabled(), eq.getBandCount());
            mBands = new EqBand[getBandCount()];
            for (int band = 0; band < mBands.length; band++)
            {
                mBands[band] = new EqBand(eq.mBands[band]);
            }
        }

        public Eq(boolean inUse, boolean enabled, int bandCount)
        {
            super(inUse, enabled, bandCount);
            mBands = new EqBand[getBandCount()];
            for (int band = 0; band < mBands.length; band++)
            {
                mBands[band] = new EqBand(true, defaultCutoff(band, mBands.length), DEFAULT_EQ_GAIN);
            }
        }

        public DynamicsProcessing.EqBand getBand(int band)
        {
            checkBand(band, mBands.length);
            return mBands[band];
        }

        public void setBand(int band, DynamicsProcessing.EqBand bandCfg)
        {
            checkBand(band, mBands.length);
            mBands[band] = new EqBand(bandCfg);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(super.toString());
            for (int band = 0; band < mBands.length; band++)
            {
                builder.append(" band: ").append(band).append('\n').append(mBands[band]);
            }

            return builder.toString();
        }
    }

    private static void checkBand(int band, int bandCount)
    {
        if (band < 0 || band >= bandCount)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("band index " + band + " out of bounds. Max band count " + bandCount);
        }
    }

        public static final class Builder
        {
            private final int mVariant;

            public Builder(int variant, int channelCount, boolean preEqInUse, int preEqBandCount, boolean mbcInUse, int mbcBandCount,
                boolean postEqInUse, int postEqBandCount, boolean limiterInUse)
            {

                    mChannels[channel] = new Channel(DEFAULT_INPUT_GAIN, preEqInUse, preEqBandCount, mbcInUse, mbcBandCount,
                        postEqInUse, postEqBandCount, limiterInUse);

    public static final class Channel
    {
        private float mInputGain;
        private Eq mPreEq;
        private Mbc mMbc;
        private Eq mPostEq;
        private Limiter mLimiter;

        public Channel(DynamicsProcessing.Channel channel)
        {
            mInputGain = channel.mInputGain;
            mPreEq = new Eq(channel.mPreEq);
            mMbc = new Mbc(channel.mMbc);
            mPostEq = new Eq(channel.mPostEq);
            mLimiter = new Limiter(channel.mLimiter);
        }

        public Channel(float inputGain, boolean preEqInUse, int preEqBandCount, boolean mbcInUse, int mbcBandCount,
            boolean postEqInUse, int postEqBandCount, boolean limiterInUse)
        {
            mInputGain = inputGain;
            mPreEq = new Eq(preEqInUse, true, preEqBandCount);
            mMbc = new Mbc(mbcInUse, true, mbcBandCount);
            mPostEq = new Eq(postEqInUse, true, postEqBandCount);
            mLimiter = new Limiter(limiterInUse, true, DEFAULT_LINK_GROUP, DEFAULT_LIMITER_ATTACK_TIME, DEFAULT_LIMITER_RELEASE_TIME,
                DEFAULT_LIMITER_RATIO, DEFAULT_LIMITER_THRESHOLD, DEFAULT_LIMITER_POST_GAIN);
        }

        public float getInputGain()
        {
            return mInputGain;
        }

        public DynamicsProcessing.Limiter getLimiter()
        {
            return mLimiter;
        }

        public DynamicsProcessing.Mbc getMbc()
        {
            return mMbc;
        }

        public DynamicsProcessing.MbcBand getMbcBand(int band)
        {
            return mMbc.getBand(band);
        }

        public DynamicsProcessing.Eq getPostEq()
        {
            return mPostEq;
        }

        public DynamicsProcessing.EqBand getPostEqBand(int band)
        {
            return mPostEq.getBand(band);
        }

        public DynamicsProcessing.Eq getPreEq()
        {
            return mPreEq;
        }

        public DynamicsProcessing.EqBand getPreEqBand(int band)
        {
            return mPreEq.getBand(band);
        }

        public void setInputGain(float inputGain)
        {
            mInputGain = inputGain;
        }

        public void setLimiter(DynamicsProcessing.Limiter limiter)
        {
            if (limiter.isInUse() != mLimiter.isInUse()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Limiter inUse changed");
            mLimiter = new Limiter(limiter);
        }

        public void setMbc(DynamicsProcessing.Mbc mbc)
        {
            if (mbc.getBandCount() != mMbc.getBandCount())
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("MbcBandCount changed from " + mMbc.getBandCount() + " to " + mbc.getBandCount());
            }

            mMbc = new Mbc(mbc);
        }

        public void setMbcBand(int band, DynamicsProcessing.MbcBand mbcBand)
        {
            mMbc.setBand(band, mbcBand);
        }

        public void setPostEq(DynamicsProcessing.Eq postEq)
        {
            if (postEq.getBandCount() != mPostEq.getBandCount())
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("PostEqBandCount changed from " + mPostEq.getBandCount() + " to "
                    + postEq.getBandCount());
            }

            mPostEq = new Eq(postEq);
        }

        public void setPostEqBand(int band, DynamicsProcessing.EqBand postEqBand)
        {
            mPostEq.setBand(band, postEqBand);
        }

        public void setPreEq(DynamicsProcessing.Eq preEq)
        {
            if (preEq.getBandCount() != mPreEq.getBandCount())
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("PreEqBandCount changed from " + mPreEq.getBandCount() + " to "
                    + preEq.getBandCount());
            }

            mPreEq = new Eq(preEq);
        }

        public void setPreEqBand(int band, DynamicsProcessing.EqBand preEqBand)
        {
            mPreEq.setBand(band, preEqBand);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return String.format(" InputGain: %f\n", mInputGain) + "-->PreEq\n" + mPreEq + "-->MBC\n" + mMbc + "-->PostEq\n" + mPostEq
                + "-->Limiter\n" + mLimiter;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class LoudnessEnhancer extends AudioEffect
{
    public static final int PARAM_TARGET_GAIN_MB = 0;

    private int mTargetGainMillibels;

    public LoudnessEnhancer(int audioSession)
        throws IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException, RuntimeException, UnsupportedOperationException
    {
        super(EFFECT_TYPE_LOUDNESS_ENHANCER, EFFECT_TYPE_NULL, 0, audioSession);
    }

    public float getTargetGain() throws IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException, UnsupportedOperationException
    {
        checkState("getTargetGain()");
        return mTargetGainMillibels;
    }

    public void setTargetGain(int gainmB) throws IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException, UnsupportedOperationException
    {
        checkState("setTargetGain()");
        mTargetGainMillibels = gainmB;
    }
}
```
