`java/android/media/browse/MediaBrowser.java`:

```java
package android.media.browse;

import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.ServiceConnection;
import android.media.MediaDescription;
import android.media.session.MediaSession;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.IInterface;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.os.Process;
import android.service.media.MediaBrowserService;
import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.util.Log;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.function.Supplier;

public final class MediaBrowser
{
    public static final String EXTRA_PAGE = "android.media.browse.extra.PAGE";
    public static final String EXTRA_PAGE_SIZE = "android.media.browse.extra.PAGE_SIZE";

    private static final String TAG = "MediaBrowser";
    private static final String SERVICE_DESCRIPTOR = "android.service.media.IMediaBrowserService";

    private static final int CONNECT_STATE_DISCONNECTING = 0;
    private static final int CONNECT_STATE_DISCONNECTED = 1;
    private static final int CONNECT_STATE_CONNECTING = 2;
    private static final int CONNECT_STATE_CONNECTED = 3;
    private static final int CONNECT_STATE_SUSPENDED = 4;

    private final Context mContext;
    private final ComponentName mServiceComponent;
    private final ConnectionCallback mCallback;
    private final Bundle mRootHints;
    private final Handler mHandler;
    private final Map<String, List<SubscriptionRecord>> mSubscriptions = new HashMap<>();

    private volatile int mState = CONNECT_STATE_DISCONNECTED;
    private ServiceConnection mServiceConnection;
    private MediaBrowserService mService;
    private String mRootId;
    private MediaSession.Token mMediaSessionToken;
    private Bundle mExtras;

    public MediaBrowser(Context context, ComponentName serviceComponent, ConnectionCallback callback, Bundle rootHints)
    {
        if (context == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("context must not be null");
        if (serviceComponent == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("service component must not be null");
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("connection callback must not be null");

        mContext = context;
        mServiceComponent = serviceComponent;
        mCallback = callback;
        mRootHints = rootHints == null ? null : new Bundle(rootHints);

        Looper looper = Looper.myLooper();
        mHandler = new Handler(looper != null ? looper : Looper.getMainLooper());
    }

    public void connect()
    {
        if (mState != CONNECT_STATE_DISCONNECTING && mState != CONNECT_STATE_DISCONNECTED)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("connect() called while neither disconnecting nor disconnected (state="
                    + stateName(mState) + ")");
        }

        mState = CONNECT_STATE_CONNECTING;
        mHandler.post(this::bindToService);
    }

    public void disconnect()
    {
        mState = CONNECT_STATE_DISCONNECTING;

        mHandler.post(() ->
        {
            if (mService != null) mService.disconnectBrowser(mContext.getPackageName(), Process.myUid());

            int state = mState;
            forceCloseConnection();
            if (state != CONNECT_STATE_DISCONNECTING) mState = state;
        });
    }

    public boolean isConnected()
    {
        return mState == CONNECT_STATE_CONNECTED;
    }

    public ComponentName getServiceComponent()
    {
        if (!isConnected()) throw new IllegalStateException("getServiceComponent() called while not connected (state=" + mState + ")");

        return mServiceComponent;
    }

    public String getRoot()
    {
        if (!isConnected()) throw new IllegalStateException("getRoot() called while not connected (state=" + stateName(mState) + ")");

        return mRootId;
    }

    public Bundle getExtras()
    {
        if (!isConnected()) throw new IllegalStateException("getExtras() called while not connected (state=" + stateName(mState) + ")");

        return mExtras;
    }

    public MediaSession.Token getSessionToken()
    {
        if (!isConnected()) throw new IllegalStateException("getSessionToken() called while not connected (state=" + mState + ")");

        return mMediaSessionToken;
    }

    public void subscribe(String parentId, SubscriptionCallback callback)
    {
        subscribeInternal(parentId, null, callback);
    }

    public void subscribe(String parentId, Bundle options, SubscriptionCallback callback)
    {
        if (options == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("options cannot be null");

        subscribeInternal(parentId, new Bundle(options), callback);
    }

    public void unsubscribe(String parentId)
    {
        unsubscribeInternal(parentId, null);
    }

    public void unsubscribe(String parentId, SubscriptionCallback callback)
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("callback cannot be null");

        unsubscribeInternal(parentId, callback);
    }

    public void getItem(String mediaId, ItemCallback cb)
    {
        if (TextUtils.isEmpty(mediaId)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("mediaId cannot be empty.");
        if (cb == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("cb cannot be null.");

        MediaBrowserService service = mService;

        if (mState != CONNECT_STATE_CONNECTED || service == null)
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "Not connected, unable to retrieve the MediaItem.");
            mHandler.post(() -> cb.onError(mediaId));
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            service.loadItemForBrowser(mContext.getPackageName(), Process.myUid(), mediaId, item -> mHandler.post(() ->
            {
                if (item == null) cb.onError(mediaId);
                else cb.onItemLoaded(item);
            }));
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception)
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "Remote error getting media item.", exception);
            mHandler.post(() -> cb.onError(mediaId));
        }
    }

    private void subscribeInternal(String parentId, Bundle options, SubscriptionCallback callback)
    {
        if (TextUtils.isEmpty(parentId)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("parentId cannot be empty.");
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("callback cannot be null");

        SubscriptionRecord record = new SubscriptionRecord(parentId, options, callback);

        synchronized (mSubscriptions)
        {
            List<SubscriptionRecord> records = mSubscriptions.get(parentId);

            if (records == null)
            {
                records = new ArrayList<>();
                mSubscriptions.put(parentId, records);
            }

            for (int index = records.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
            {
                if (Objects.equals(bundleKey(records.get(index).mOptions), bundleKey(options))) records.remove(index);
            }

            records.add(record);
        }

        if (isConnected()) sendSubscription(record);
    }

    private void unsubscribeInternal(String parentId, SubscriptionCallback callback)
    {
        if (TextUtils.isEmpty(parentId)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("parentId cannot be empty.");

        List<SubscriptionRecord> remaining = new ArrayList<>();

        synchronized (mSubscriptions)
        {
            List<SubscriptionRecord> records = mSubscriptions.get(parentId);
            if (records == null) return;

            if (callback == null) records.clear();
            else records.removeIf(record -> record.mCallback == callback);

            remaining.addAll(records);
            if (records.isEmpty()) mSubscriptions.remove(parentId);
        }

        MediaBrowserService service = mService;

        if (isConnected() && service != null)
        {
            service.unsubscribeBrowser(mContext.getPackageName(), Process.myUid(), parentId);

            for (SubscriptionRecord record : remaining) sendSubscription(record);
        }
    }

    private void sendSubscription(SubscriptionRecord record)
    {
        MediaBrowserService service = mService;
        if (service == null) return;

        try
        {
            service.subscribeBrowser(mContext.getPackageName(), Process.myUid(), record.mParentId, record.mOptions,
                    items -> mHandler.post(() -> deliverChildren(record, items)));
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception)
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "subscribe failed for id=" + record.mParentId, exception);
            mHandler.post(() -> deliverChildren(record, null));
        }
    }

    private void deliverChildren(SubscriptionRecord record, List<MediaItem> items)
    {
        synchronized (mSubscriptions)
        {
            List<SubscriptionRecord> records = mSubscriptions.get(record.mParentId);
            if (records == null || !records.contains(record)) return;
        }

        if (items == null)
        {
            if (record.mOptions == null) record.mCallback.onError(record.mParentId);
            else record.mCallback.onError(record.mParentId, record.mOptions);
            return;
        }

        List<MediaItem> copy = new ArrayList<>(items);

        if (record.mOptions == null) record.mCallback.onChildrenLoaded(record.mParentId, copy);
        else record.mCallback.onChildrenLoaded(record.mParentId, copy, record.mOptions);
    }

    private void bindToService()
    {
        if (mState != CONNECT_STATE_CONNECTING) return;

        Intent intent = new Intent(MediaBrowserService.SERVICE_INTERFACE);
        intent.setComponent(mServiceComponent);

        ServiceConnection connection = new ServiceConnection()
        {
            @Override
            public void onServiceConnected(ComponentName name, IBinder binder)
            {
                if (mServiceConnection != this || mState != CONNECT_STATE_CONNECTING) return;

                MediaBrowserService service = resolveService(binder);

                if (service == null)
                {
                    failConnection();
                    return;
                }

                MediaBrowserService.BrowserRoot root;

                try
                {
                    root = service.connectBrowser(mContext.getPackageName(), Process.myPid(), Process.myUid(), mRootHints);
                }
                catch (RuntimeException exception)
                {
                    Log.w(TAG, "onGetRoot threw for " + mServiceComponent, exception);
                    root = null;
                }

                if (root == null)
                {
                    failConnection();
                    return;
                }

                mService = service;
                mRootId = root.getRootId();
                mExtras = root.getExtras();
                mMediaSessionToken = service.getSessionToken();
                mState = CONNECT_STATE_CONNECTED;
                mCallback.onConnected();

                List<SubscriptionRecord> records = new ArrayList<>();

                synchronized (mSubscriptions)
                {
                    for (List<SubscriptionRecord> list : mSubscriptions.values()) records.addAll(list);
                }

                for (SubscriptionRecord record : records) sendSubscription(record);
            }

            @Override
            public void onServiceDisconnected(ComponentName name)
            {
                if (mServiceConnection != this) return;

                mService = null;
                mState = CONNECT_STATE_SUSPENDED;
                mCallback.onConnectionSuspended();
            }

            @Override
            public void onNullBinding(ComponentName name)
            {
                if (mServiceConnection != this) return;

                failConnection();
            }
        };

        mServiceConnection = connection;
        boolean bound;

        try
        {
            bound = mContext.bindService(intent, connection, Context.BIND_AUTO_CREATE);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed binding to service " + mServiceComponent, exception);
            bound = false;
        }

        if (!bound) failConnection();
    }

    private static MediaBrowserService resolveService(IBinder binder)
    {
        if (binder == null) return null;

        IInterface local = binder.queryLocalInterface(SERVICE_DESCRIPTOR);
        if (!(local instanceof Supplier)) return null;

        Object service = ((Supplier<?>)local).get();
        return service instanceof MediaBrowserService ? (MediaBrowserService)service : null;
    }

    private void failConnection()
    {
        forceCloseConnection();
        mCallback.onConnectionFailed();
    }

    private void forceCloseConnection()
    {
        ServiceConnection connection = mServiceConnection;
        mServiceConnection = null;

        if (connection != null)
        {
            try
            {
                mContext.unbindService(connection);
            }
            catch (RuntimeException exception)
            {
                Log.w(TAG, "unbindService failed", exception);
            }
        }

        mState = CONNECT_STATE_DISCONNECTED;
        mService = null;
        mRootId = null;
        mExtras = null;
        mMediaSessionToken = null;
    }

    private static String bundleKey(Bundle options)
    {
        if (options == null) return null;

        return options.getInt(EXTRA_PAGE, -1) + ":" + options.getInt(EXTRA_PAGE_SIZE, -1);
    }

    private static String stateName(int state)
    {
        switch (state)
        {
            case CONNECT_STATE_DISCONNECTING:
                return "CONNECT_STATE_DISCONNECTING";
            case CONNECT_STATE_DISCONNECTED:
                return "CONNECT_STATE_DISCONNECTED";
            case CONNECT_STATE_CONNECTING:
                return "CONNECT_STATE_CONNECTING";
            case CONNECT_STATE_CONNECTED:
                return "CONNECT_STATE_CONNECTED";
            case CONNECT_STATE_SUSPENDED:
                return "CONNECT_STATE_SUSPENDED";
            default:
                return "UNKNOWN/" + state;
        }
    }

    private static final class SubscriptionRecord
    {
        final String mParentId;
        final Bundle mOptions;
        final SubscriptionCallback mCallback;

        SubscriptionRecord(String parentId, Bundle options, SubscriptionCallback callback)
        {
            mParentId = parentId;
            mOptions = options;
            mCallback = callback;
        }
    }

    public static class MediaItem implements Parcelable
    {
        public static final int FLAG_BROWSABLE = 1;
        public static final int FLAG_PLAYABLE = 2;

        public static final Parcelable.Creator<MediaItem> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<MediaItem>()
        {
            @Override
            public MediaItem createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                int flags = source.readInt();
                MediaDescription description = MediaDescription.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
                return new MediaItem(description, flags);
            }

            @Override
            public MediaItem[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new MediaItem[size];
            }
        };

        private final int mFlags;
        private final MediaDescription mDescription;

        public MediaItem(MediaDescription description, int flags)
        {
            if (description == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("description cannot be null");
            if (TextUtils.isEmpty(description.getMediaId()))
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("description must have a non-empty media id");
            }

            mFlags = flags;
            mDescription = description;
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
        {
            out.writeInt(mFlags);
            mDescription.writeToParcel(out, flags);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "MediaItem{mFlags=" + mFlags + ", mDescription=" + mDescription + '}';
        }

        public int getFlags()
        {
            return mFlags;
        }

        public boolean isBrowsable()
        {
            return (mFlags & FLAG_BROWSABLE) != 0;
        }

        public boolean isPlayable()
        {
            return (mFlags & FLAG_PLAYABLE) != 0;
        }

        public MediaDescription getDescription()
        {
            return mDescription;
        }

        public String getMediaId()
        {
            return mDescription.getMediaId();
        }
    }

    public static class ConnectionCallback
    {
        public ConnectionCallback()
        {
        }

        public void onConnected()
        {
        }

        public void onConnectionSuspended()
        {
        }

        public void onConnectionFailed()
        {
        }
    }

    public abstract static class SubscriptionCallback
    {
        public SubscriptionCallback()
        {
        }

        public void onChildrenLoaded(String parentId, List<MediaItem> children)
        {
        }

        public void onChildrenLoaded(String parentId, List<MediaItem> children, Bundle options)
        {
        }

        public void onError(String parentId)
        {
        }

        public void onError(String parentId, Bundle options)
        {
        }
    }

    public abstract static class ItemCallback
    {
        public ItemCallback()
        {
        }

        public void onItemLoaded(MediaItem item)
        {
        }

        public void onError(String mediaId)
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public final class EditingEndedEvent extends Event implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int ERROR_CODE_AUDIO_PROCESSING_FAILED = 18;
    public static final int ERROR_CODE_DECODER_INIT_FAILED = 11;
    public static final int ERROR_CODE_DECODING_FAILED = 12;
    public static final int ERROR_CODE_DECODING_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED = 13;

    public static final int ERROR_CODE_ENCODING_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED = 16;

    public static final int ERROR_CODE_IO_FILE_NOT_FOUND = 7;
    public static final int ERROR_CODE_IO_NETWORK_CONNECTION_FAILED = 4;
    public static final int ERROR_CODE_IO_NETWORK_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT = 5;
    public static final int ERROR_CODE_IO_NO_PERMISSION = 8;

            Builder builder = new Builder(source.readInt());
            builder.mFinalProgressPercent = source.readFloat();
            builder.mErrorCode = source.readInt();
            builder.mTimeSinceCreatedMillis = source.readLong();
            builder.mExporterName = source.readString();
            builder.mMuxerName = source.readString();
            builder.mOperationTypes = source.readLong();
            builder.mInputMediaItemInfos.addAll(source.createTypedArrayList(MediaItemInfo.CREATOR));
            builder.mOutputMediaItemInfo = source.readTypedObject(MediaItemInfo.CREATOR);
            builder.mMetricsBundle = source.readBundle();
            return builder.build();
        }

        }

    private final MediaItemInfo mOutputMediaItemInfo;

    {
        super(builder.mTimeSinceCreatedMillis, builder.mMetricsBundle);
        mFinalState = builder.mFinalState;
        mFinalProgressPercent = builder.mFinalProgressPercent;
        mErrorCode = builder.mErrorCode;
        mExporterName = builder.mExporterName;
        mMuxerName = builder.mMuxerName;
        mOperationTypes = builder.mOperationTypes;
        mInputMediaItemInfos = new ArrayList<>(builder.mInputMediaItemInfos);
        mOutputMediaItemInfo = builder.mOutputMediaItemInfo;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        if (this == object) return true;
        if (!(object instanceof EditingEndedEvent)) return false;

        EditingEndedEvent other = (EditingEndedEvent)object;
        return mFinalState == other.mFinalState && Float.compare(mFinalProgressPercent, other.mFinalProgressPercent) == 0
            && mErrorCode == other.mErrorCode && getTimeSinceCreatedMillis() == other.getTimeSinceCreatedMillis()
            && Objects.equals(mExporterName, other.mExporterName) && Objects.equals(mMuxerName, other.mMuxerName)
            && mOperationTypes == other.mOperationTypes && mInputMediaItemInfos.equals(other.mInputMediaItemInfos)
            && Objects.equals(mOutputMediaItemInfo, other.mOutputMediaItemInfo);
    }

            mOperationTypes, mInputMediaItemInfos, mOutputMediaItemInfo);

            + ", errorCode = " + mErrorCode + ", timeSinceCreatedMillis = " + getTimeSinceCreatedMillis() + ", exporterName = "
            + mExporterName + ", muxerName = " + mMuxerName + ", operationTypes = " + mOperationTypes
            + ", inputMediaItemInfos = " + mInputMediaItemInfos + ", outputMediaItemInfo = " + mOutputMediaItemInfo + " }";

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final int mFinalState;
        private float mFinalProgressPercent = PROGRESS_PERCENT_UNKNOWN;
        private int mErrorCode = ERROR_CODE_NONE;
        private long mTimeSinceCreatedMillis = TIME_SINCE_CREATED_UNKNOWN;
        private String mExporterName;
        private String mMuxerName;
        private long mOperationTypes;
        private final List<MediaItemInfo> mInputMediaItemInfos = new ArrayList<>();
        private MediaItemInfo mOutputMediaItemInfo;
        private Bundle mMetricsBundle = new Bundle();

        public Builder(int finalState)
        {
            mFinalState = finalState;
        }

        public Builder addInputMediaItemInfo(MediaItemInfo mediaItemInfo)
        {
            mInputMediaItemInfos.add(Objects.requireNonNull(mediaItemInfo));
            return this;
        }
```

`java/android/media/metrics/MediaMetricsManager.java`:

```java
package android.media.metrics;

import android.content.Context;

import java.security.SecureRandom;

public final class MediaMetricsManager
{
    public static final long INVALID_TIMESTAMP = -1L;

    private static final SecureRandom sRandom = new SecureRandom();

    private final Context mContext;

    public MediaMetricsManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    static String newSessionId()
    {
        byte[] bytes = new byte[12];

        synchronized (sRandom)
        {
            sRandom.nextBytes(bytes);
        }

        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(bytes.length * 2);

        for (byte value : bytes)
        {
            builder.append(Character.forDigit((value >> 4) & 0xF, 16));
            builder.append(Character.forDigit(value & 0xF, 16));
        }

        return builder.toString();
    }

    public BundleSession createBundleSession()
    {
        return new BundleSession(newSessionId());
    }

    public EditingSession createEditingSession()
    {
        return new EditingSession(newSessionId());
    }

    public PlaybackSession createPlaybackSession()
    {
        return new PlaybackSession(newSessionId());
    }

    public RecordingSession createRecordingSession()
    {
        return new RecordingSession(newSessionId());
    }

    public TranscodingSession createTranscodingSession()
    {
        return new TranscodingSession(newSessionId());
    }

    public void releaseSessionId(String sessionId)
    {
    }
}
```

```java
package android.media.metrics;

public final class PlaybackSession implements AutoCloseable
{
    private final String mId;
    private final LogSessionId mSessionId;
    private boolean mClosed;

    PlaybackSession(String id)
    {
        mId = id;
        mSessionId = new LogSessionId(id);
    }

    @Override
    public void close()
    {
        mClosed = true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        if (this == object) return true;
        if (!(object instanceof PlaybackSession)) return false;

        return mId.equals(((PlaybackSession)object).mId);
    }

    public LogSessionId getSessionId()
    {
        return mSessionId;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mId.hashCode();
    }

    public void reportNetworkEvent(NetworkEvent networkEvent)
    {
        requireEvent(networkEvent);
    }

    public void reportPlaybackErrorEvent(PlaybackErrorEvent playbackErrorEvent)
    {
        requireEvent(playbackErrorEvent);
    }

    public void reportPlaybackMetrics(PlaybackMetrics playbackMetrics)
    {
        requireEvent(playbackMetrics);
    }

    public void reportPlaybackStateEvent(PlaybackStateEvent playbackStateEvent)
    {
        requireEvent(playbackStateEvent);
    }

    public void reportTrackChangeEvent(TrackChangeEvent trackChangeEvent)
    {
        requireEvent(trackChangeEvent);
    }

    private static void requireEvent(Object event)
    {
        if (event == null) throw new NullPointerException("event must not be null");
    }
}
```

```java
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeInt(mTrackType);
        destination.writeInt(mTrackState);
        destination.writeInt(mTrackChangeReason);
        destination.writeString(mContainerMimeType);
        destination.writeString(mSampleMimeType);
        destination.writeString(mCodecName);
        destination.writeInt(mBitrate);
        destination.writeLong(getTimeSinceCreatedMillis());
        destination.writeString(mLanguage);
        destination.writeString(mLanguageRegion);
        destination.writeInt(mChannelCount);
        destination.writeInt(mAudioSampleRate);
        destination.writeInt(mWidth);
        destination.writeInt(mHeight);
        destination.writeFloat(mVideoFrameRate);
        destination.writeBundle(getMetricsBundle());
    }

    public static final class Builder

        private Bundle mMetricsBundle = new Bundle();

        public Builder(int trackType)

                throw new IllegalArgumentException("track type must be one of TRACK_TYPE_AUDIO, TRACK_TYPE_VIDEO, TRACK_TYPE_TEXT.");
            }

            mTrackType = trackType;
        }

        public TrackChangeEvent build()
```

`java/android/media/midi/MidiDevice.java`:

```java
package android.media.midi;

import java.io.Closeable;
import java.io.IOException;

public final class MidiDevice implements Closeable
{
    private final MidiDeviceInfo mDeviceInfo;
    private final MidiOutputPort[] mOutputPorts;
    private boolean mClosed;

    MidiDevice(MidiDeviceInfo deviceInfo)
    {
        mDeviceInfo = deviceInfo;
        mOutputPorts = new MidiOutputPort[deviceInfo.getOutputPortCount()];

        for (int index = 0; index < mOutputPorts.length; index++)
        {
            mOutputPorts[index] = new MidiOutputPort(index);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void close() throws IOException
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mClosed) return;

            mClosed = true;
        }

        for (MidiOutputPort port : mOutputPorts)
        {
            port.close();
        }
    }

    public MidiConnection connectPorts(MidiInputPort inputPort, int outputPortNumber)
    {
        if (outputPortNumber < 0 || outputPortNumber >= mDeviceInfo.getOutputPortCount())
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("outputPortNumber out of range");
        }

        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mClosed) return null;
        }

        MidiOutputPort outputPort = mOutputPorts[outputPortNumber];
        outputPort.connect(inputPort);
        return new MidiConnection(outputPort, inputPort);
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        try
        {
            close();
        }
        finally
        {
            super.finalize();
        }
    }

    public MidiDeviceInfo getInfo()
    {
        return mDeviceInfo;
    }

    public MidiInputPort openInputPort(int portNumber)
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mClosed) return null;
        }

        if (portNumber < 0 || portNumber >= mDeviceInfo.getInputPortCount()) return null;

        return new MidiInputPort(portNumber, null);
    }

    public MidiOutputPort openOutputPort(int portNumber)
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mClosed) return null;
        }

        if (portNumber < 0 || portNumber >= mOutputPorts.length) return null;

        return mOutputPorts[portNumber];
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "MidiDevice: " + mDeviceInfo.toString();
    }

    public class MidiConnection implements Closeable
    {
        private final MidiOutputPort mOutputPort;
        private final MidiInputPort mInputPort;
        private boolean mConnectionClosed;

        MidiConnection(MidiOutputPort outputPort, MidiInputPort inputPort)
        {
            mOutputPort = outputPort;
            mInputPort = inputPort;
        }

        @Override
        public void close() throws IOException
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                if (mConnectionClosed) return;

                mConnectionClosed = true;
            }

            mOutputPort.disconnect(mInputPort);
        }

        @Override
        protected void finalize() throws Throwable
        {
            try
            {
                close();
            }
            finally
            {
                super.finalize();
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
import android.os.Bundle;

public final class MidiDeviceInfo implements Parcelable
{
    public static final String PROPERTY_BLUETOOTH_DEVICE = "bluetooth_device";
    public static final String PROPERTY_MANUFACTURER = "manufacturer";
    public static final String PROPERTY_NAME = "name";
    public static final String PROPERTY_PRODUCT = "product";
    public static final String PROPERTY_SERIAL_NUMBER = "serial_number";
    public static final String PROPERTY_USB_DEVICE = "usb_device";
    public static final String PROPERTY_VERSION = "version";
    public static final int PROTOCOL_UMP_MIDI_1_0_UP_TO_128_BITS = 3;
    public static final int PROTOCOL_UMP_MIDI_1_0_UP_TO_128_BITS_AND_JRTS = 4;
    public static final int PROTOCOL_UMP_MIDI_1_0_UP_TO_64_BITS = 1;
    public static final int PROTOCOL_UMP_MIDI_1_0_UP_TO_64_BITS_AND_JRTS = 2;
    public static final int PROTOCOL_UMP_MIDI_2_0 = 17;
    public static final int PROTOCOL_UMP_MIDI_2_0_AND_JRTS = 18;
    public static final int PROTOCOL_UMP_USE_MIDI_CI = 0;
    public static final int PROTOCOL_UNKNOWN = -1;
    public static final int TYPE_BLUETOOTH = 3;
    public static final int TYPE_USB = 1;
    public static final int TYPE_VIRTUAL = 2;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<MidiDeviceInfo> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<MidiDeviceInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public MidiDeviceInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int type = source.readInt();
            int id = source.readInt();
            int inputPortCount = source.readInt();
            int outputPortCount = source.readInt();
            String[] inputPortNames = source.createStringArray();
            String[] outputPortNames = source.createStringArray();
            boolean isPrivate = source.readInt() != 0;
            int defaultProtocol = source.readInt();
            Bundle properties = source.readBundle();
            return new MidiDeviceInfo(type, id, inputPortCount, outputPortCount, inputPortNames, outputPortNames, properties, isPrivate,
                defaultProtocol);
        }

        @Override
        public MidiDeviceInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new MidiDeviceInfo[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mType;
    private final int mId;
    private final int mInputPortCount;
    private final int mOutputPortCount;
    private final String[] mInputPortNames;
    private final String[] mOutputPortNames;
    private final Bundle mProperties;
    private final boolean mIsPrivate;
    private final int mDefaultProtocol;

    MidiDeviceInfo(int type, int id, int inputPortCount, int outputPortCount, String[] inputPortNames, String[] outputPortNames,
        Bundle properties, boolean isPrivate, int defaultProtocol)
    {
        mType = type;
        mId = id;
        mInputPortCount = inputPortCount;
        mOutputPortCount = outputPortCount;
        mInputPortNames = portNames(inputPortNames, inputPortCount);
        mOutputPortNames = portNames(outputPortNames, outputPortCount);
        mProperties = properties == null ? new Bundle() : properties;
        mIsPrivate = isPrivate;
        mDefaultProtocol = defaultProtocol;
    }

    private static String[] portNames(String[] names, int count)
    {
        String[] result = new String[count];

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            result[index] = names != null && index < names.length && names[index] != null ? names[index] : "";
        }

        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        return object instanceof MidiDeviceInfo && ((MidiDeviceInfo)object).mId == mId;
    }

    public int getDefaultProtocol()
    {
        return mDefaultProtocol;
    }

    public int getId()
    {
        return mId;
    }

    public int getInputPortCount()
    {
        return mInputPortCount;
    }

    public int getOutputPortCount()
    {
        return mOutputPortCount;
    }

    public PortInfo[] getPorts()
    {
        PortInfo[] ports = new PortInfo[mInputPortCount + mOutputPortCount];
        int index = 0;

        for (int port = 0; port < mInputPortCount; port++)
        {
            ports[index++] = new PortInfo(PortInfo.TYPE_INPUT, port, mInputPortNames[port]);
        }

        for (int port = 0; port < mOutputPortCount; port++)
        {
            ports[index++] = new PortInfo(PortInfo.TYPE_OUTPUT, port, mOutputPortNames[port]);
        }

        return ports;
    }

    public Bundle getProperties()
    {
        return mProperties;
    }

    public int getType()
    {
        return mType;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mId;
    }

    public boolean isPrivate()
    {
        return mIsPrivate;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "MidiDeviceInfo[mType=" + mType + ",mInputPortCount=" + mInputPortCount + ",mOutputPortCount=" + mOutputPortCount
            + ",mProperties=" + mProperties + ",mIsPrivate=" + mIsPrivate + ",mDefaultProtocol=" + mDefaultProtocol + "]";
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeInt(mType);
        destination.writeInt(mId);
        destination.writeInt(mInputPortCount);
        destination.writeInt(mOutputPortCount);
        destination.writeStringArray(mInputPortNames);
        destination.writeStringArray(mOutputPortNames);
        destination.writeInt(mIsPrivate ? 1 : 0);
        destination.writeInt(mDefaultProtocol);
        destination.writeBundle(mProperties);
    }

    public static final class PortInfo
    {
        public static final int TYPE_INPUT = 1;
        public static final int TYPE_OUTPUT = 2;

        private final int mPortType;
        private final int mPortNumber;
        private final String mName;

        PortInfo(int type, int portNumber, String name)
        {
            mPortType = type;
            mPortNumber = portNumber;
            mName = name == null ? "" : name;
        }

        public String getName()
        {
            return mName;
        }

        public int getPortNumber()
        {
            return mPortNumber;
        }

        public int getType()
        {
            return mPortType;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/media/midi/MidiInputPort.java`:

```java
package android.media.midi;

import java.io.Closeable;
import java.io.IOException;

public final class MidiInputPort extends MidiReceiver implements Closeable
{
    private static final int MAX_PACKET_DATA_SIZE = 1015;

    private final int mPortNumber;
    private final MidiReceiver mTarget;
    private boolean mClosed;

    MidiInputPort(int portNumber, MidiReceiver target)
    {
        super(MAX_PACKET_DATA_SIZE);
        mPortNumber = portNumber;
        mTarget = target;
    }

    @Override
    public void close() throws IOException
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            mClosed = true;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        try
        {
            close();
        }
        finally
        {
            super.finalize();
        }
    }

    public int getPortNumber()
    {
        return mPortNumber;
    }

    @Override
    public void onFlush() throws IOException
    {
        MidiReceiver target = checkOpen();

        if (target != null) target.flush();
    }

    @Override
    public void onSend(byte[] message, int offset, int count, long timestamp) throws IOException
    {
        if (offset < 0 || count < 0 || offset + count > message.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset or count out of range");
        if (count > MAX_PACKET_DATA_SIZE) throw new IllegalArgumentException("count exceeds max message size");

        MidiReceiver target = checkOpen();

        if (target != null) target.send(message, offset, count, timestamp);
    }

    private synchronized MidiReceiver checkOpen() throws IOException
    {
        if (mClosed) throw new IOException("MidiInputPort is closed");

        return mTarget;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.media.midi;

import android.bluetooth.BluetoothDevice;
import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;

import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;

public final class MidiManager
{
    public static final int TRANSPORT_MIDI_BYTE_STREAM = 1;
    public static final int TRANSPORT_UNIVERSAL_MIDI_PACKETS = 2;

    private final Context mContext;
    private final Map<DeviceCallback, Executor> mDeviceCallbacks = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public MidiManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public MidiDeviceInfo[] getDevices()
    {
        return new MidiDeviceInfo[0];
    }

    public Set<MidiDeviceInfo> getDevicesForTransport(int transport)
    {
        return Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<MidiDeviceInfo>());
    }

    public void openBluetoothDevice(BluetoothDevice bluetoothDevice, OnDeviceOpenedListener listener, Handler handler)
    {
        reportOpenFailure(listener, handler);
    }

    public void openDevice(MidiDeviceInfo deviceInfo, OnDeviceOpenedListener listener, Handler handler)
    {
        reportOpenFailure(listener, handler);
    }

    private static void reportOpenFailure(final OnDeviceOpenedListener listener, Handler handler)
    {
        if (listener == null) return;

        Handler target = handler != null ? handler : new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
        target.post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                listener.onDeviceOpened(null);
            }
        });
    }

    public void registerDeviceCallback(DeviceCallback callback, Handler handler)
    {
        if (callback == null) return;

        final Handler target = handler != null ? handler : new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
        mDeviceCallbacks.put(callback, new Executor()
        {
            @Override
            public void execute(Runnable command)
            {
                target.post(command);
            }
        });
    }

    public void registerDeviceCallback(int transport, Executor executor, DeviceCallback callback)
    {
        if (executor == null) throw new NullPointerException("executor must not be null");
        if (callback == null) throw new NullPointerException("callback must not be null");

        mDeviceCallbacks.put(callback, executor);
    }

    public void unregisterDeviceCallback(DeviceCallback callback)
    {
        if (callback != null) mDeviceCallbacks.remove(callback);
    }

    public interface OnDeviceOpenedListener
    {
        void onDeviceOpened(MidiDevice device);
    }

    public static class DeviceCallback
    {
        public DeviceCallback()
        {
        }

        public void onDeviceAdded(MidiDeviceInfo device)
        {
        }

        public void onDeviceRemoved(MidiDeviceInfo device)
        {
        }

        public void onDeviceStatusChanged(MidiDeviceStatus status)
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.media.midi;

import java.io.Closeable;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;

public final class MidiOutputPort extends MidiSender implements Closeable
{
    private final int mPortNumber;
    private final CopyOnWriteArrayList<MidiReceiver> mReceivers = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    private volatile boolean mClosed;

    MidiOutputPort(int portNumber)
    {
        mPortNumber = portNumber;
    }

    @Override
    public void close() throws IOException
    {
        mClosed = true;
        mReceivers.clear();
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        try
        {
            close();
        }
        finally
        {
            super.finalize();
        }
    }

    public int getPortNumber()
    {
        return mPortNumber;
    }

    @Override
    public void onConnect(MidiReceiver receiver)
    {
        if (!mClosed) mReceivers.addIfAbsent(receiver);
    }

    @Override
    public void onDisconnect(MidiReceiver receiver)
    {
        mReceivers.remove(receiver);
    }

    void dispatch(byte[] message, int offset, int count, long timestamp) throws IOException
    {
        for (MidiReceiver receiver : mReceivers)
        {
            receiver.send(message, offset, count, timestamp);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/media/midi/MidiReceiver.java`:

```java
package android.media.midi;

import java.io.IOException;

public abstract class MidiReceiver
{
    private final int mMaxMessageSize;

    public MidiReceiver()
    {
        mMaxMessageSize = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    }

    public MidiReceiver(int maxMessageSize)
    {
        mMaxMessageSize = maxMessageSize;
    }

    public void flush() throws IOException
    {
        onFlush();
    }

    public final int getMaxMessageSize()
    {
        return mMaxMessageSize;
    }

    public void onFlush() throws IOException
    {
    }

    public abstract void onSend(byte[] message, int offset, int count, long timestamp) throws IOException;

    public void send(byte[] message, int offset, int count) throws IOException
    {
        send(message, offset, count, System.nanoTime());
    }

    public void send(byte[] message, int offset, int count, long timestamp) throws IOException
    {
        int messageSize = getMaxMessageSize();

        while (count > 0)
        {
            int length = count > messageSize ? messageSize : count;
            onSend(message, offset, length, timestamp);
            offset += length;
            count -= length;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/media/projection/MediaProjection.java`:

```java
package android.media.projection;

import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

public final class MediaProjection
{
    private final Map<Callback, Handler> mCallbacks = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private boolean mStopped;

    MediaProjection()
    {
    }

    public void registerCallback(Callback callback, Handler handler)
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new NullPointerException("callback must not be null");

        mCallbacks.put(callback, handler != null ? handler : new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()));
    }

    public void stop()
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mStopped) return;

            mStopped = true;
        }

        for (Map.Entry<Callback, Handler> entry : mCallbacks.entrySet())
        {
            final Callback callback = entry.getKey();
            entry.getValue().post(new Runnable()
            {
                @Override
                public void run()
                {
                    callback.onStop();
                }
            });
        }
    }

    public void unregisterCallback(Callback callback)
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new NullPointerException("callback must not be null");

        mCallbacks.remove(callback);
    }

    public abstract static class Callback
    {
        public Callback()
        {
        }

        public void onCapturedContentResize(int width, int height)
        {
        }

        public void onCapturedContentVisibilityChanged(boolean isVisible)
        {
        }

        public void onStop()
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.media.projection;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class MediaProjectionConfig implements Parcelable
{
    private static final int CAPTURE_REGION_USER_CHOICE = 0;
    private static final int CAPTURE_REGION_FIXED_DISPLAY = 1;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<MediaProjectionConfig> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<MediaProjectionConfig>()
    {
        @Override
        public MediaProjectionConfig createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int displayToCapture = source.readInt();
            int regionToCapture = source.readInt();
            return new MediaProjectionConfig(displayToCapture, regionToCapture);
        }

        @Override
        public MediaProjectionConfig[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new MediaProjectionConfig[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mDisplayToCapture;
    private final int mRegionToCapture;

    private MediaProjectionConfig(int displayToCapture, int regionToCapture)
    {
        mDisplayToCapture = displayToCapture;
        mRegionToCapture = regionToCapture;
    }

    public static MediaProjectionConfig createConfigForDefaultDisplay()
    {
        return new MediaProjectionConfig(0, CAPTURE_REGION_FIXED_DISPLAY);
    }

    public static MediaProjectionConfig createConfigForUserChoice()
    {
        return new MediaProjectionConfig(0, CAPTURE_REGION_USER_CHOICE);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        if (this == object) return true;
        if (!(object instanceof MediaProjectionConfig)) return false;

        MediaProjectionConfig other = (MediaProjectionConfig)object;
        return mDisplayToCapture == other.mDisplayToCapture && mRegionToCapture == other.mRegionToCapture;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return 31 * mDisplayToCapture + mRegionToCapture;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "MediaProjectionConfig { displayToCapture = " + mDisplayToCapture + ", regionToCapture = "
            + (mRegionToCapture == CAPTURE_REGION_FIXED_DISPLAY ? "CAPTURE_REGION_FIXED_DISPLAY" : "CAPTURE_REGION_USER_CHOICE") + " }";
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeInt(mDisplayToCapture);
        destination.writeInt(mRegionToCapture);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.media.projection;

import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;

public final class MediaProjectionManager
{
    private static final String EXTRA_MEDIA_PROJECTION = "android.media.projection.extra.EXTRA_MEDIA_PROJECTION";
    private static final String EXTRA_MEDIA_PROJECTION_CONFIG = "android.media.projection.extra.EXTRA_MEDIA_PROJECTION_CONFIG";
    private static final int RESULT_OK = -1;

    private final Context mContext;

    public MediaProjectionManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public Intent createScreenCaptureIntent()
    {
        Intent intent = new Intent();
        intent.setComponent(new ComponentName("com.android.systemui",
            "com.android.systemui.mediaprojection.permission.MediaProjectionPermissionActivity"));
        return intent;
    }

    public Intent createScreenCaptureIntent(MediaProjectionConfig config)
    {
        if (config == null) throw new NullPointerException("config must not be null");

        Intent intent = createScreenCaptureIntent();
        intent.putExtra(EXTRA_MEDIA_PROJECTION_CONFIG, config);
        return intent;
    }

    public MediaProjection getMediaProjection(int resultCode, Intent resultData)
    {
        if (resultData == null) throw new NullPointerException("resultData must not be null");
        if (resultCode != RESULT_OK) return null;
        if (!resultData.hasExtra(EXTRA_MEDIA_PROJECTION)) return null;

        return new MediaProjection();
    }
}
```

```java
            case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_PAUSE:
            case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_PLAY_PAUSE:
```

`java/android/media/session/MediaSession.java`:

```java
package android.media.session;

import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.media.AudioAttributes;
import android.media.MediaDescription;
import android.media.MediaMetadata;
import android.media.Rating;
import android.media.VolumeProvider;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.os.Process;
import android.os.ResultReceiver;
import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.view.KeyEvent;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class MediaSession
{
    public static final int FLAG_HANDLES_MEDIA_BUTTONS = 1;
    public static final int FLAG_HANDLES_TRANSPORT_CONTROLS = 2;

    private static final Map<Integer, MediaSession> SESSIONS = new HashMap<>();
    private static final List<MediaSession> ACTIVE_SESSIONS = new ArrayList<>();
    private static int sNextSessionId = 1;

    private final Object mLock = new Object();
    private final Context mContext;
    private final String mTag;
    private final Bundle mSessionInfo;
    private final Token mSessionToken;
    private final MediaController mController;
    private final List<ControllerCallbackRecord> mControllerCallbacks = new ArrayList<>();

    private Callback mCallback;
    private Handler mCallbackHandler;
    private boolean mActive;
    private boolean mReleased;
    private int mFlags;
    private int mRatingType = Rating.RATING_NONE;
    private MediaMetadata mMetadata;
    private PlaybackState mPlaybackState;
    private List<QueueItem> mQueue;
    private CharSequence mQueueTitle;
    private Bundle mExtras;
    private PendingIntent mSessionActivity;
    private PendingIntent mMediaButtonReceiver;
    private ComponentName mMediaButtonBroadcastReceiver;
    private AudioAttributes mAudioAttributes;
    private VolumeProvider mVolumeProvider;
    private MediaSessionManager.RemoteUserInfo mCurrentControllerInfo;

    public MediaSession(Context context, String tag)
    {
        this(context, tag, null);
    }

    public MediaSession(Context context, String tag, Bundle sessionInfo)
    {
        if (context == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("context cannot be null.");
        if (TextUtils.isEmpty(tag)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("tag cannot be null or empty");

        mContext = context;
        mTag = tag;
        mSessionInfo = sessionInfo == null ? new Bundle() : new Bundle(sessionInfo);
        mAudioAttributes = new AudioAttributes.Builder().setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA).build();

        int id;

        synchronized (SESSIONS)
        {
            id = sNextSessionId++;
            SESSIONS.put(id, this);
        }

        mSessionToken = new Token(id, context.getPackageName());
        mController = new MediaController(context, mSessionToken);
    }

    static MediaSession findSession(int id)
    {
        synchronized (SESSIONS)
        {
            return SESSIONS.get(id);
        }
    }

    static List<MediaSession> getActiveSessionsSnapshot()
    {
        synchronized (SESSIONS)
        {
            return new ArrayList<>(ACTIVE_SESSIONS);
        }
    }

    public void setCallback(Callback callback)
    {
        setCallback(callback, null);
    }

    public void setCallback(Callback callback, Handler handler)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mCallback != null) mCallback.mSession = null;

            if (callback == null)
            {
                mCallback = null;
                mCallbackHandler = null;
                return;
            }

            if (handler == null)
            {
                Looper looper = Looper.myLooper();
                handler = new Handler(looper != null ? looper : Looper.getMainLooper());
            }

            callback.mSession = this;
            mCallback = callback;
            mCallbackHandler = handler;
        }
    }

    public void setSessionActivity(PendingIntent pendingIntent)
    {
        mSessionActivity = pendingIntent;
    }

    public void setMediaButtonReceiver(PendingIntent mediaButtonIntent)
    {
        mMediaButtonReceiver = mediaButtonIntent;
    }

    public void setMediaButtonBroadcastReceiver(ComponentName broadcastReceiver)
    {
        mMediaButtonBroadcastReceiver = broadcastReceiver;
    }

    public void setFlags(int flags)
    {
        mFlags = flags;
    }

    public void setPlaybackToLocal(AudioAttributes attributes)
    {
        if (attributes == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Attributes cannot be null for local playback.");

        mAudioAttributes = attributes;
        mVolumeProvider = null;
        notifyAudioInfoChanged();
    }

    public void setPlaybackToRemote(VolumeProvider volumeProvider)
    {
        if (volumeProvider == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("volumeProvider may not be null!");

        mVolumeProvider = volumeProvider;
        notifyAudioInfoChanged();
    }

    public void setActive(boolean active)
    {
        if (mActive == active) return;

        mActive = active;

        synchronized (SESSIONS)
        {
            ACTIVE_SESSIONS.remove(this);
            if (active && !mReleased) ACTIVE_SESSIONS.add(0, this);
        }

        MediaSessionManager.dispatchActiveSessionsChanged();
    }

    public boolean isActive()
    {
        return mActive;
    }

    public void sendSessionEvent(String event, Bundle extras)
    {
        if (TextUtils.isEmpty(event)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("event cannot be null or empty");

        for (ControllerCallbackRecord record : controllerCallbacks())
        {
            record.post(() -> record.mCallback.onSessionEvent(event, extras));
        }
    }

    public void release()
    {
        if (mReleased) return;

        mReleased = true;
        boolean wasActive = mActive;
        mActive = false;

        synchronized (SESSIONS)
        {
            SESSIONS.remove(mSessionToken.mId);
            ACTIVE_SESSIONS.remove(this);
        }

        for (ControllerCallbackRecord record : controllerCallbacks())
        {
            record.post(() -> record.mCallback.onSessionDestroyed());
        }

        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            mControllerCallbacks.clear();
            if (mCallback != null) mCallback.mSession = null;
            mCallback = null;
            mCallbackHandler = null;
        }

        if (wasActive) MediaSessionManager.dispatchActiveSessionsChanged();
    }

    public Token getSessionToken()
    {
        return mSessionToken;
    }

    public MediaController getController()
    {
        return mController;
    }

    public void setPlaybackState(PlaybackState state)
    {
        mPlaybackState = state;

        for (ControllerCallbackRecord record : controllerCallbacks())
        {
            record.post(() -> record.mCallback.onPlaybackStateChanged(state));
        }
    }

    public void setMetadata(MediaMetadata metadata)
    {
        mMetadata = metadata;

        for (ControllerCallbackRecord record : controllerCallbacks())
        {
            record.post(() -> record.mCallback.onMetadataChanged(metadata));
        }
    }

    public void setQueue(List<QueueItem> queue)
    {
        mQueue = queue == null ? null : new ArrayList<>(queue);
        List<QueueItem> snapshot = mQueue == null ? null : new ArrayList<>(mQueue);

        for (ControllerCallbackRecord record : controllerCallbacks())
        {
            record.post(() -> record.mCallback.onQueueChanged(snapshot));
        }
    }

    public void setQueueTitle(CharSequence title)
    {
        mQueueTitle = title;

        for (ControllerCallbackRecord record : controllerCallbacks())
        {
            record.post(() -> record.mCallback.onQueueTitleChanged(title));
        }
    }

    public void setRatingType(int type)
    {
        mRatingType = type;
    }

    public void setExtras(Bundle extras)
    {
        mExtras = extras;

        for (ControllerCallbackRecord record : controllerCallbacks())
        {
            record.post(() -> record.mCallback.onExtrasChanged(extras));
        }
    }

    public MediaSessionManager.RemoteUserInfo getCurrentControllerInfo()
    {
        MediaSessionManager.RemoteUserInfo info = mCurrentControllerInfo;

        if (info == null)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("This should be called inside of MediaSession.Callback methods");
        }

        return info;
    }

    void addControllerCallback(MediaController.Callback callback, Handler handler)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            for (ControllerCallbackRecord record : mControllerCallbacks)
            {
                if (record.mCallback == callback) return;
            }

            mControllerCallbacks.add(new ControllerCallbackRecord(callback, handler));
        }
    }

    boolean removeControllerCallback(MediaController.Callback callback)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < mControllerCallbacks.size(); index++)
            {
                if (mControllerCallbacks.get(index).mCallback == callback)
                {
                    mControllerCallbacks.remove(index);
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }
    }

    void notifyAudioInfoChanged()
    {
        MediaController.PlaybackInfo info = mController.getPlaybackInfo();

        for (ControllerCallbackRecord record : controllerCallbacks())
        {
            record.post(() -> record.mCallback.onAudioInfoChanged(info));
        }
    }

    boolean dispatchToCallback(String packageName, CallbackAction action)
    {
        Callback callback;
        Handler handler;

        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            callback = mCallback;
            handler = mCallbackHandler;
        }

        if (callback == null || handler == null || mReleased) return false;

        MediaSessionManager.RemoteUserInfo info = new MediaSessionManager.RemoteUserInfo(packageName, Process.myPid(),
                Process.myUid());

        handler.post(() ->
        {
            MediaSessionManager.RemoteUserInfo previous = mCurrentControllerInfo;
            mCurrentControllerInfo = info;

            try
            {
                action.run(callback);
            }
            finally
            {
                mCurrentControllerInfo = previous;
            }
        });

        return true;
    }

    private List<ControllerCallbackRecord> controllerCallbacks()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            return new ArrayList<>(mControllerCallbacks);
        }
    }

    interface CallbackAction
    {
        void run(Callback callback);
    }

    private static final class ControllerCallbackRecord
    {
        final MediaController.Callback mCallback;
        final Handler mHandler;

        ControllerCallbackRecord(MediaController.Callback callback, Handler handler)
        {
            mCallback = callback;
            mHandler = handler;
        }

        void post(Runnable runnable)
        {
            mHandler.post(runnable);
        }
    }

    public abstract static class Callback
    {
        MediaSession mSession;

        public Callback()
        {
        }

        public void onCommand(String command, Bundle args, ResultReceiver cb)
        {
        }

        public boolean onMediaButtonEvent(Intent mediaButtonIntent)
        {
            MediaSession session = mSession;

            if (session == null || mediaButtonIntent == null) return false;
            if (!Intent.ACTION_MEDIA_BUTTON.equals(mediaButtonIntent.getAction())) return false;

            KeyEvent keyEvent = mediaButtonIntent.getParcelableExtra(Intent.EXTRA_KEY_EVENT);

            if (keyEvent == null || keyEvent.getAction() != KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) return false;

            PlaybackState state = session.getPlaybackState();
            long validActions = state == null ? 0 : state.getActions();

            switch (keyEvent.getKeyCode())
            {
                case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_PLAY:
                    onPlay();
                    return true;
                case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_PAUSE:
                    onPause();
                    return true;
                case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_NEXT:
                    if ((validActions & PlaybackState.ACTION_SKIP_TO_NEXT) == 0) return false;
                    onSkipToNext();
                    return true;
                case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_PREVIOUS:
                    if ((validActions & PlaybackState.ACTION_SKIP_TO_PREVIOUS) == 0) return false;
                    onSkipToPrevious();
                    return true;
                case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_STOP:
                    if ((validActions & PlaybackState.ACTION_STOP) == 0) return false;
                    onStop();
                    return true;
                case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_FAST_FORWARD:
                    if ((validActions & PlaybackState.ACTION_FAST_FORWARD) == 0) return false;
                    onFastForward();
                    return true;
                case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_REWIND:
                    if ((validActions & PlaybackState.ACTION_REWIND) == 0) return false;
                    onRewind();
                    return true;
                case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_PLAY_PAUSE:
                case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_HEADSETHOOK:
                    if (keyEvent.getRepeatCount() > 0) return true;
                    if (state != null && state.isActive()) onPause();
                    else onPlay();
                    return true;
                default:
                    return false;
            }
        }

        public void onPrepare()
        {
        }

        public void onPrepareFromMediaId(String mediaId, Bundle extras)
        {
        }

        public void onPrepareFromSearch(String query, Bundle extras)
        {
        }

        public void onPrepareFromUri(Uri uri, Bundle extras)
        {
        }

        public void onPlay()
        {
        }

        public void onPlayFromSearch(String query, Bundle extras)
        {
        }

        public void onPlayFromMediaId(String mediaId, Bundle extras)
        {
        }

        public void onPlayFromUri(Uri uri, Bundle extras)
        {
        }

        public void onSkipToQueueItem(long id)
        {
        }

        public void onPause()
        {
        }

        public void onSkipToNext()

        }
```

```java
package android.media.session;

import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.media.Session2Token;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;

public final class MediaSessionManager
{
    private static final List<ActiveSessionsListenerRecord> ACTIVE_SESSIONS_LISTENERS = new ArrayList<>();
    private static final List<MediaKeyEventListenerRecord> MEDIA_KEY_EVENT_LISTENERS = new ArrayList<>();
    private static final List<Session2TokensListenerRecord> SESSION2_TOKENS_LISTENERS = new ArrayList<>();
    private static final List<Session2Token> SESSION2_TOKENS = new ArrayList<>();
    private static MediaSession.Token sMediaKeyEventSession;

    private final Context mContext;

    public MediaSessionManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public List<MediaController> getActiveSessions(ComponentName notificationListener)
    {
        List<MediaController> controllers = new ArrayList<>();

        for (MediaSession session : MediaSession.getActiveSessionsSnapshot())
        {
            controllers.add(new MediaController(mContext, session.getSessionToken()));
        }

        return controllers;
    }

    public List<Session2Token> getSession2Tokens()
    {
        synchronized (SESSION2_TOKENS)
        {
            return new ArrayList<>(SESSION2_TOKENS);
        }
    }

    public void notifySession2Created(Session2Token token)
    {
        if (token == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("token shouldn't be null");
        if (token.getType() != Session2Token.TYPE_SESSION) throw new IllegalArgumentException("token's type should be TYPE_SESSION");

        List<Session2Token> snapshot;

        synchronized (SESSION2_TOKENS)
        {
            if (SESSION2_TOKENS.contains(token)) return;
            SESSION2_TOKENS.add(0, token);
            snapshot = new ArrayList<>(SESSION2_TOKENS);
        }

        List<Session2TokensListenerRecord> records;

        synchronized (SESSION2_TOKENS_LISTENERS)
        {
            records = new ArrayList<>(SESSION2_TOKENS_LISTENERS);
        }

        for (Session2TokensListenerRecord record : records)
        {
            record.mHandler.post(() -> record.mListener.onSession2TokensChanged(new ArrayList<>(snapshot)));
        }
    }

    public boolean isTrustedForMediaControl(RemoteUserInfo userInfo)
    {
        if (userInfo == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("userInfo may not be null");

        return mContext != null && Objects.equals(mContext.getPackageName(), userInfo.getPackageName());
    }

    public void addOnActiveSessionsChangedListener(OnActiveSessionsChangedListener sessionListener, ComponentName notificationListener)
    {
        addOnActiveSessionsChangedListener(sessionListener, notificationListener, null);
    }

    public void addOnActiveSessionsChangedListener(OnActiveSessionsChangedListener sessionListener, ComponentName notificationListener,
            Handler handler)
    {
        if (sessionListener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener may not be null");

        synchronized (ACTIVE_SESSIONS_LISTENERS)
        {
            for (ActiveSessionsListenerRecord record : ACTIVE_SESSIONS_LISTENERS)
            {
                if (record.mListener == sessionListener) return;
            }

            ACTIVE_SESSIONS_LISTENERS.add(new ActiveSessionsListenerRecord(sessionListener, handlerOrDefault(handler), mContext));
        }
    }

    public void removeOnActiveSessionsChangedListener(OnActiveSessionsChangedListener sessionListener)
    {
        if (sessionListener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener may not be null");

        synchronized (ACTIVE_SESSIONS_LISTENERS)
        {
            ACTIVE_SESSIONS_LISTENERS.removeIf(record -> record.mListener == sessionListener);
        }
    }

    public void addOnSession2TokensChangedListener(OnSession2TokensChangedListener listener)
    {
        addOnSession2TokensChangedListener(listener, null);
    }

    public void addOnSession2TokensChangedListener(OnSession2TokensChangedListener listener, Handler handler)
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener shouldn't be null");

        synchronized (SESSION2_TOKENS_LISTENERS)
        {
            for (Session2TokensListenerRecord record : SESSION2_TOKENS_LISTENERS)
            {
                if (record.mListener == listener) return;
            }

            SESSION2_TOKENS_LISTENERS.add(new Session2TokensListenerRecord(listener, handlerOrDefault(handler)));
        }
    }

    public void removeOnSession2TokensChangedListener(OnSession2TokensChangedListener listener)
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener shouldn't be null");

        synchronized (SESSION2_TOKENS_LISTENERS)
        {
            SESSION2_TOKENS_LISTENERS.removeIf(record -> record.mListener == listener);
        }
    }

    public MediaSession.Token getMediaKeyEventSession()
    {
        synchronized (MEDIA_KEY_EVENT_LISTENERS)
        {
            return sMediaKeyEventSession;
        }
    }

    public String getMediaKeyEventSessionPackageName()
    {
        MediaSession.Token token = getMediaKeyEventSession();
        return token == null || token.mPackageName == null ? "" : token.mPackageName;
    }

    public void addOnMediaKeyEventSessionChangedListener(Executor executor, OnMediaKeyEventSessionChangedListener listener)
    {
        if (executor == null) throw new NullPointerException("executor shouldn't be null");
        if (listener == null) throw new NullPointerException("listener shouldn't be null");

        synchronized (MEDIA_KEY_EVENT_LISTENERS)
        {
            for (MediaKeyEventListenerRecord record : MEDIA_KEY_EVENT_LISTENERS)
            {
                if (record.mListener == listener) return;
            }

            MEDIA_KEY_EVENT_LISTENERS.add(new MediaKeyEventListenerRecord(listener, executor));
        }
    }

    public void removeOnMediaKeyEventSessionChangedListener(OnMediaKeyEventSessionChangedListener listener)
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new NullPointerException("listener shouldn't be null");

        synchronized (MEDIA_KEY_EVENT_LISTENERS)
        {
            MEDIA_KEY_EVENT_LISTENERS.removeIf(record -> record.mListener == listener);
        }
    }

    static void dispatchActiveSessionsChanged()
    {
        List<MediaSession> sessions = MediaSession.getActiveSessionsSnapshot();
        List<ActiveSessionsListenerRecord> records;

        synchronized (ACTIVE_SESSIONS_LISTENERS)
        {
            records = new ArrayList<>(ACTIVE_SESSIONS_LISTENERS);
        }

        for (ActiveSessionsListenerRecord record : records)
        {
            List<MediaController> controllers = new ArrayList<>();

            for (MediaSession session : sessions)
            {
                controllers.add(new MediaController(record.mContext, session.getSessionToken()));
            }

            record.mHandler.post(() -> record.mListener.onActiveSessionsChanged(controllers));
        }

        MediaSession.Token mediaKeyToken = null;

        for (MediaSession session : sessions)
        {
            if ((session.getFlags() & MediaSession.FLAG_HANDLES_MEDIA_BUTTONS) != 0 || mediaKeyToken == null)
            {
                mediaKeyToken = session.getSessionToken();
                if ((session.getFlags() & MediaSession.FLAG_HANDLES_MEDIA_BUTTONS) != 0) break;
            }
        }

        List<MediaKeyEventListenerRecord> keyRecords;

        synchronized (MEDIA_KEY_EVENT_LISTENERS)
        {
            if (Objects.equals(sMediaKeyEventSession, mediaKeyToken)) return;

            sMediaKeyEventSession = mediaKeyToken;
            keyRecords = new ArrayList<>(MEDIA_KEY_EVENT_LISTENERS);
        }

        MediaSession.Token token = mediaKeyToken;
        String packageName = token == null || token.mPackageName == null ? "" : token.mPackageName;

        for (MediaKeyEventListenerRecord record : keyRecords)
        {
            record.mExecutor.execute(() -> record.mListener.onMediaKeyEventSessionChanged(packageName, token));
        }
    }

    private static Handler handlerOrDefault(Handler handler)
    {
        if (handler != null) return handler;

        Looper looper = Looper.myLooper();
        return new Handler(looper != null ? looper : Looper.getMainLooper());
    }

    private static final class ActiveSessionsListenerRecord
    {
        final OnActiveSessionsChangedListener mListener;
        final Handler mHandler;
        final Context mContext;

        ActiveSessionsListenerRecord(OnActiveSessionsChangedListener listener, Handler handler, Context context)
        {
            mListener = listener;
            mHandler = handler;
            mContext = context;
        }
    }

    private static final class MediaKeyEventListenerRecord
    {
        final OnMediaKeyEventSessionChangedListener mListener;
        final Executor mExecutor;

        MediaKeyEventListenerRecord(OnMediaKeyEventSessionChangedListener listener, Executor executor)
        {
            mListener = listener;
            mExecutor = executor;
        }
    }

    private static final class Session2TokensListenerRecord
    {
        final OnSession2TokensChangedListener mListener;
        final Handler mHandler;

        Session2TokensListenerRecord(OnSession2TokensChangedListener listener, Handler handler)
        {
            mListener = listener;
            mHandler = handler;
        }
    }

    public static final class RemoteUserInfo
    {
        private final String mPackageName;
        private final int mPid;
        private final int mUid;

        public RemoteUserInfo(String packageName, int pid, int uid)
        {
            mPackageName = packageName;
            mPid = pid;
            mUid = uid;
        }

        public String getPackageName()
        {
            return mPackageName;
        }

        public int getPid()
        {
            return mPid;
        }

        public int getUid()
        {
            return mUid;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object object)
        {
            if (object == this) return true;
            if (!(object instanceof RemoteUserInfo)) return false;

            RemoteUserInfo other = (RemoteUserInfo)object;

            return Objects.equals(mPackageName, other.mPackageName) && mPid == other.mPid && mUid == other.mUid;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return Objects.hash(mPackageName, mPid, mUid);
        }
    }

    public interface OnActiveSessionsChangedListener
    {
        void onActiveSessionsChanged(List<MediaController> controllers);
    }

    public interface OnSession2TokensChangedListener
    {
        void onSession2TokensChanged(List<Session2Token> tokens);
    }

    public interface OnMediaKeyEventSessionChangedListener
    {
        void onMediaKeyEventSessionChanged(String packageName, MediaSession.Token sessionToken);
    }
}
```

```java
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.text.TextUtils;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class PlaybackState implements Parcelable
{
    public static final long ACTION_FAST_FORWARD = 64L;
    public static final long ACTION_PAUSE = 2L;
    public static final long ACTION_PLAY = 4L;
    public static final long ACTION_PLAY_FROM_MEDIA_ID = 1024L;
    public static final long ACTION_PLAY_FROM_SEARCH = 2048L;
    public static final long ACTION_PLAY_FROM_URI = 8192L;
    public static final long ACTION_PLAY_PAUSE = 512L;
    public static final long ACTION_PREPARE = 16384L;
    public static final long ACTION_PREPARE_FROM_MEDIA_ID = 32768L;
    public static final long ACTION_PREPARE_FROM_SEARCH = 65536L;
    public static final long ACTION_PREPARE_FROM_URI = 131072L;
    public static final long ACTION_REWIND = 8L;
    public static final long ACTION_SEEK_TO = 256L;
    public static final long ACTION_SET_PLAYBACK_SPEED = 4194304L;
    public static final long ACTION_SET_RATING = 128L;
    public static final long ACTION_SKIP_TO_NEXT = 32L;
    public static final long ACTION_SKIP_TO_PREVIOUS = 16L;
    public static final long ACTION_SKIP_TO_QUEUE_ITEM = 4096L;
    public static final long ACTION_STOP = 1L;
    public static final long PLAYBACK_POSITION_UNKNOWN = -1L;
    public static final int STATE_BUFFERING = 6;
    public static final int STATE_CONNECTING = 8;
    public static final int STATE_ERROR = 7;
    public static final int STATE_FAST_FORWARDING = 4;
    public static final int STATE_NONE = 0;
    public static final int STATE_PAUSED = 2;
    public static final int STATE_PLAYING = 3;
    public static final int STATE_REWINDING = 5;
    public static final int STATE_SKIPPING_TO_NEXT = 10;
    public static final int STATE_SKIPPING_TO_PREVIOUS = 9;
    public static final int STATE_SKIPPING_TO_QUEUE_ITEM = 11;
    public static final int STATE_STOPPED = 1;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<PlaybackState> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<PlaybackState>()
    {
        @Override

        }

    private final int mState;
    private final long mPosition;
    private final long mBufferedPosition;

    private final List<CustomAction> mCustomActions;
    private final CharSequence mErrorMessage;
    private final long mUpdateTime;
    private final long mActiveItemId;

    private PlaybackState(int state, long position, long updateTime, float speed, long bufferedPosition, long actions,
            List<CustomAction> customActions, long activeItemId, CharSequence errorMessage, Bundle extras)
    {
        mState = state;
        mPosition = position;
        mSpeed = speed;
        mUpdateTime = updateTime;
        mBufferedPosition = bufferedPosition;
        mActions = actions;
        mCustomActions = new ArrayList<>(customActions);
        mActiveItemId = activeItemId;
        mErrorMessage = errorMessage;
        mExtras = extras;
    }

    private PlaybackState(Parcel source)
    {
        mState = source.readInt();
        mPosition = source.readLong();
        mSpeed = source.readFloat();
        mUpdateTime = source.readLong();
        mBufferedPosition = source.readLong();
        mActions = source.readLong();
        List<CustomAction> customActions = source.createTypedArrayList(CustomAction.CREATOR);
        mCustomActions = customActions == null ? new ArrayList<>() : customActions;
        mActiveItemId = source.readLong();
        mErrorMessage = TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
        mExtras = source.readBundle();
    }

    public int getState()
    {
        return mState;
    }

    public long getPosition()
    {
        return mPosition;
    }

    public long getBufferedPosition()
    {
        return mBufferedPosition;
    }

    public float getPlaybackSpeed()
    {
        return mSpeed;
    }

    public long getActions()

        return mActions;
    }

        return mErrorMessage;
    }

    public long getLastPositionUpdateTime()
    {
        return mUpdateTime;
    }
```
