```java
    {
        return mActiveItemId;
    }

    public Bundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    public boolean isActive()
    {
        switch (mState)
        {
            case STATE_FAST_FORWARDING:
            case STATE_REWINDING:
            case STATE_SKIPPING_TO_PREVIOUS:
            case STATE_SKIPPING_TO_NEXT:
            case STATE_SKIPPING_TO_QUEUE_ITEM:
            case STATE_BUFFERING:
            case STATE_CONNECTING:
            case STATE_PLAYING:
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

        return 0;

    {

        dest.writeLong(mPosition);
        dest.writeFloat(mSpeed);
        dest.writeLong(mUpdateTime);
        dest.writeLong(mBufferedPosition);
        dest.writeLong(mActions);
        dest.writeTypedList(mCustomActions);
        dest.writeLong(mActiveItemId);
        TextUtils.writeToParcel(mErrorMessage, dest, 0);
        dest.writeBundle(mExtras);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "PlaybackState {state=" + mState + ", position=" + mPosition + ", buffered position=" + mBufferedPosition
                + ", speed=" + mSpeed + ", updated=" + mUpdateTime + ", actions=" + mActions + ", custom actions="
                + mCustomActions + ", active item id=" + mActiveItemId + ", error=" + mErrorMessage + "}";
    }

    public static final class CustomAction implements Parcelable
    {
        public static final Parcelable.Creator<CustomAction> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<CustomAction>()
        {
            @Override
            public CustomAction createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                String action = source.readString();
                CharSequence name = TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
                int icon = source.readInt();
                Bundle extras = source.readBundle();
                return new CustomAction(action, name, icon, extras);
            }

            @Override
            public CustomAction[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new CustomAction[size];
            }
        };

        private final String mAction;
        private final CharSequence mName;
        private final int mIcon;
        private final Bundle mExtras;

        private CustomAction(String action, CharSequence name, int icon, Bundle extras)
        {
            mAction = action;
            mName = name;
            mIcon = icon;
            mExtras = extras;
        }

        public String getAction()
        {
            return mAction;
        }

        public CharSequence getName()
        {
            return mName;
        }

        public int getIcon()
        {
            return mIcon;
        }

        public Bundle getExtras()
        {
            return mExtras;
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
        {
            dest.writeString(mAction);
            TextUtils.writeToParcel(mName, dest, flags);
            dest.writeInt(mIcon);
            dest.writeBundle(mExtras);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "Action:mName='" + mName + ", mIcon=" + mIcon + ", mExtras=" + mExtras;
        }

        public static final class Builder
        {
            private final String mAction;
            private final CharSequence mName;
            private final int mIcon;
            private Bundle mExtras;

            public Builder(String action, CharSequence name, int icon)
            {
                if (TextUtils.isEmpty(action))
                {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("You must specify an action to build a CustomAction");
                }

                if (TextUtils.isEmpty(name))
                {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("You must specify a name to build a CustomAction");
                }

                if (icon == 0)
                {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("You must specify an icon resource id to build a CustomAction");
                }

                mAction = action;
                mName = name;
                mIcon = icon;
            }

            public Builder setExtras(Bundle extras)
            {
                mExtras = extras;
                return this;
            }

            public CustomAction build()
            {
                return new CustomAction(mAction, mName, mIcon, mExtras);
            }
        }
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final List<CustomAction> mCustomActions = new ArrayList<>();

        private int mState;
        private long mPosition;
        private long mBufferedPosition;
        private float mSpeed;
        private long mActions;
        private CharSequence mErrorMessage;
        private long mUpdateTime;
        private long mActiveItemId = MediaSession.QueueItem.UNKNOWN_ID;
        private Bundle mExtras;

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public Builder(PlaybackState from)
        {
            if (from == null) return;

            mState = from.mState;
            mPosition = from.mPosition;
            mBufferedPosition = from.mBufferedPosition;
            mSpeed = from.mSpeed;
            mActions = from.mActions;
            mCustomActions.addAll(from.mCustomActions);
            mErrorMessage = from.mErrorMessage;
            mUpdateTime = from.mUpdateTime;
            mActiveItemId = from.mActiveItemId;
            mExtras = from.mExtras;
        }

        public Builder setState(int state, long position, float playbackSpeed, long updateTime)
        {
            mState = state;
            mPosition = position;
            mUpdateTime = updateTime;
            mSpeed = playbackSpeed;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setState(int state, long position, float playbackSpeed)
        {
            return setState(state, position, playbackSpeed, SystemClock.elapsedRealtime());
        }

        public Builder setActions(long actions)
        {
            mActions = actions;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder addCustomAction(String action, String name, int icon)
        {
            return addCustomAction(new CustomAction(action, name, icon, null));
        }

        public Builder addCustomAction(CustomAction customAction)
        {
            if (customAction == null)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("You may not add a null CustomAction to PlaybackState.");
            }

            mCustomActions.add(customAction);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setBufferedPosition(long bufferedPosition)
        {
            mBufferedPosition = bufferedPosition;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setActiveQueueItemId(long id)
        {
            mActiveItemId = id;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setErrorMessage(CharSequence error)
        {
            mErrorMessage = error;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setExtras(Bundle extras)
        {
            mExtras = extras;
            return this;
        }

        public PlaybackState build()
        {
            return new PlaybackState(mState, mPosition, mUpdateTime, mSpeed, mBufferedPosition, mActions, mCustomActions,
                    mActiveItemId, mErrorMessage, mExtras);
        }
    }
```

`java/android/media/tv/TvContentRating.java`:

```java
package android.media.tv;

import android.text.TextUtils;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class TvContentRating
{
    private static final String DELIMITER = "/";

    public static final TvContentRating UNRATED = new TvContentRating("null", "null", "null", null);

    private final String mDomain;
    private final String mRatingSystem;
    private final String mRating;
    private final String[] mSubRatings;
    private final int mHashCode;

    private TvContentRating(String domain, String ratingSystem, String rating, String[] subRatings)
    {
        mDomain = domain;
        mRatingSystem = ratingSystem;
        mRating = rating;

        if (subRatings == null || subRatings.length == 0)
        {
            mSubRatings = null;
        }
        else
        {
            mSubRatings = subRatings.clone();
            Arrays.sort(mSubRatings);
        }

        mHashCode = 31 * Objects.hash(mDomain, mRating) + Arrays.hashCode(mSubRatings);
    }

    public boolean contains(TvContentRating rating)
    {
        if (rating == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("rating cannot be null");
        if (!rating.getMainRating().equals(mRating)) return false;
        if (!rating.getDomain().equals(mDomain) || !rating.getRatingSystem().equals(mRatingSystem)) return false;

        List<String> subRatings = getSubRatings();
        List<String> otherSubRatings = rating.getSubRatings();

        if (subRatings == null && otherSubRatings == null) return true;
        if (subRatings == null) return false;
        if (otherSubRatings == null) return true;

        return subRatings.containsAll(otherSubRatings);
    }

    public static TvContentRating createRating(String domain, String ratingSystem, String rating, String... subRatings)
    {
        if (TextUtils.isEmpty(domain)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("domain cannot be empty");
        if (TextUtils.isEmpty(ratingSystem)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ratingSystem cannot be empty");
        if (TextUtils.isEmpty(rating)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("rating cannot be empty");

        return new TvContentRating(domain, ratingSystem, rating, subRatings);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        if (this == object) return true;
        if (!(object instanceof TvContentRating)) return false;

        TvContentRating other = (TvContentRating)object;
        return mHashCode == other.mHashCode && mDomain.equals(other.mDomain) && mRatingSystem.equals(other.mRatingSystem)
            && mRating.equals(other.mRating) && Arrays.equals(mSubRatings, other.mSubRatings);
    }

    public String flattenToString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        builder.append(mDomain).append(DELIMITER).append(mRatingSystem).append(DELIMITER).append(mRating);

        if (mSubRatings != null)
        {
            for (String subRating : mSubRatings)
            {
                builder.append(DELIMITER).append(subRating);
            }
        }

        return builder.toString();
    }

    public String getDomain()
    {
        return mDomain;
    }

    public String getMainRating()
    {
        return mRating;
    }

    public String getRatingSystem()
    {
        return mRatingSystem;
    }

    public List<String> getSubRatings()
    {
        if (mSubRatings == null) return null;

        return Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(mSubRatings)));
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mHashCode;
    }

    public static TvContentRating unflattenFromString(String ratingString)
    {
        if (TextUtils.isEmpty(ratingString)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ratingString cannot be empty");

        String[] strings = ratingString.split(DELIMITER);

        if (strings.length < 3) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid rating string: " + ratingString);
        if (strings.length == 3) return new TvContentRating(strings[0], strings[1], strings[2], null);

        String[] subRatings = Arrays.copyOfRange(strings, 3, strings.length);
        return new TvContentRating(strings[0], strings[1], strings[2], subRatings);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.media.tv;

import android.content.ComponentName;

{

        intent.putExtra(EXTRA_INPUT_ID, mId);

        return 0;

        return false;

    }

    {
        return null;
    }

        return mService.loadIcon(context.getPackageManager());

        return mService.loadLabel(context.getPackageManager());

    {
        return "TvInputInfo{id=" + mId + ", pkg=" + mService.packageName + ", service=" + mService.name + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        mService.writeToParcel(destination, flags);
        destination.writeString(mId);
        destination.writeInt(mType);
        destination.writeString(mParentId);
        destination.writeString(mSetupActivity);
        destination.writeInt(mCanRecord ? 1 : 0);
        destination.writeInt(mCanPauseRecording ? 1 : 0);
        destination.writeInt(mTunerCount);
        destination.writeBundle(mExtras);
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final Context mContext;
        private final ComponentName mComponent;
        private Boolean mCanRecord;
        private Boolean mCanPauseRecording;
        private Integer mTunerCount;
        private Bundle mExtras;

        public Builder(Context context, ComponentName component)
        {
            if (context == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("context cannot be null.");
            if (component == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("component cannot be null.");

            mContext = context;
            mComponent = component;
        }

        public TvInputInfo build()
        {
            ServiceInfo service;

            try
            {
                service = mContext.getPackageManager().getServiceInfo(mComponent, PackageManager.GET_META_DATA);
            }
            catch (PackageManager.NameNotFoundException exception)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid component. Can't find the service.");
            }

            if (service.packageName == null) service.packageName = mComponent.getPackageName();
            if (service.name == null) service.name = mComponent.getClassName();

            String id = new ComponentName(service.packageName, service.name).flattenToShortString();
            boolean canRecord = mCanRecord != null && mCanRecord;
            boolean canPauseRecording = mCanPauseRecording != null ? mCanPauseRecording : canRecord;
            int tunerCount = mTunerCount != null ? mTunerCount : 1;
            return new TvInputInfo(service, id, TYPE_TUNER, null, null, canRecord, canPauseRecording, tunerCount, mExtras);
        }

        public Builder setCanPauseRecording(boolean canPauseRecording)
        {
            mCanPauseRecording = canPauseRecording;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setCanRecord(boolean canRecord)
        {
            mCanRecord = canRecord;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setExtras(Bundle extras)
        {
            mExtras = extras;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setTunerCount(int tunerCount)
        {
            mTunerCount = tunerCount;
            return this;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    public void unregisterNetworkCallback(NetworkCallback networkCallback)
    {
        if (networkCallback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null NetworkCallback");

        Runnable timeout;
        synchronized (mCallbacks)
        {
            if (!mCallbacks.containsKey(networkCallback)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("NetworkCallback was not registered");

            timeout = mCallbacks.remove(networkCallback);
        }

        if (timeout != null) mainHandler().removeCallbacks(timeout);
    }

    private void registerCallback(NetworkCallback networkCallback, Handler handler, int timeoutMs, NetworkRequest request)
    {
        if (networkCallback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null NetworkCallback");

        synchronized (mCallbacks)
        {
            if (mCallbacks.containsKey(networkCallback)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("NetworkCallback was already registered");

            Runnable timeout = null;
            if (timeoutMs > 0)
            {
                final Handler target = handler == null ? mainHandler() : handler;
                timeout = new Runnable()
                {
                    @Override
                    public void run()
                    {
                        synchronized (mCallbacks)
                        {
                            if (mCallbacks.get(networkCallback) != this) return;
                            mCallbacks.remove(networkCallback);
                        }

                        networkCallback.onUnavailable();
                    }
                };

                target.postDelayed(timeout, timeoutMs);
            }

            mCallbacks.put(networkCallback, timeout);
        }
    }

    private Handler mainHandler()
    {
        synchronized (mCallbacks)
        {
            if (mMainHandler == null) mMainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
            return mMainHandler;
        }
    }

    private static void checkTimeout(int timeoutMs)
    {
        if (timeoutMs <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("timeoutMs must be strictly positive.");
    }

    private static void checkPendingIntent(PendingIntent intent)
    {
        if (intent == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("PendingIntent cannot be null.");
    }

    public static class NetworkCallback
    {
        public static final int FLAG_INCLUDE_LOCATION_INFO = 1;

        public NetworkCallback()
        {
            this(0);
        }

        public NetworkCallback(int flags)
        {
            if ((flags & ~FLAG_INCLUDE_LOCATION_INFO) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid flags");
        }

        public void onAvailable(Network network)
        {
        }

        public void onLosing(Network network, int maxMsToLive)
        {
        }

        public void onLost(Network network)
        {
        }

        public void onUnavailable()
        {
        }

        public void onCapabilitiesChanged(Network network, NetworkCapabilities networkCapabilities)
        {
        }

        public void onLinkPropertiesChanged(Network network, LinkProperties linkProperties)
        {
        }

        public void onBlockedStatusChanged(Network network, boolean blocked)
        {
        }

        public void onReserved(NetworkCapabilities networkCapabilities)
        {
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/net/DhcpInfo.java`:

```java
package android.net;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public class DhcpInfo implements Parcelable
{
    public int ipAddress;
    public int gateway;
    public int netmask;
    public int dns1;
    public int dns2;
    public int serverAddress;
    public int leaseDuration;

    public DhcpInfo()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        builder.append("ipaddr ");
        appendAddress(builder, ipAddress);
        builder.append(" gateway ");
        appendAddress(builder, gateway);
        builder.append(" netmask ");
        appendAddress(builder, netmask);
        builder.append(" dns1 ");
        appendAddress(builder, dns1);
        builder.append(" dns2 ");
        appendAddress(builder, dns2);
        builder.append(" DHCP server ");
        appendAddress(builder, serverAddress);
        builder.append(" lease ").append(leaseDuration).append(" seconds");
        return builder.toString();
    }

    private static void appendAddress(StringBuilder builder, int address)
    {
        builder.append(address & 0xff).append('.');
        builder.append((address >>> 8) & 0xff).append('.');
        builder.append((address >>> 16) & 0xff).append('.');
        builder.append((address >>> 24) & 0xff);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(ipAddress);
        dest.writeInt(gateway);
        dest.writeInt(netmask);
        dest.writeInt(dns1);
        dest.writeInt(dns2);
        dest.writeInt(serverAddress);
        dest.writeInt(leaseDuration);
    }

    public static final Creator<DhcpInfo> CREATOR = new Creator<DhcpInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public DhcpInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            DhcpInfo info = new DhcpInfo();
            info.ipAddress = source.readInt();
            info.gateway = source.readInt();
            info.netmask = source.readInt();
            info.dns1 = source.readInt();
            info.dns2 = source.readInt();
            info.serverAddress = source.readInt();
            info.leaseDuration = source.readInt();
            return info;
        }

        @Override
        public DhcpInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new DhcpInfo[size];
        }
    };
}
```

`java/android/net/IpPrefix.java`:

```java
package android.net;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.UnknownHostException;
import java.util.Arrays;

public final class IpPrefix implements Parcelable
{
    private final byte[] mAddress;
    private final int mPrefixLength;

    public IpPrefix(InetAddress address, int prefixLength)
    {
        this(address.getAddress(), prefixLength);
    }

    IpPrefix(byte[] address, int prefixLength)
    {
        mAddress = address.clone();
        mPrefixLength = prefixLength;

        if (mAddress.length != 4 && mAddress.length != 16)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("IpPrefix has " + mAddress.length + " bytes which is neither 4 nor 16");
        }

        if (prefixLength < 0 || prefixLength > mAddress.length * 8)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("IpPrefix with " + mAddress.length + " bytes has invalid prefix length " + prefixLength);
        }

        maskRawAddress(mAddress, prefixLength);
    }

    private static void maskRawAddress(byte[] address, int prefixLength)
    {
        int offset = prefixLength / 8;
        int remainder = prefixLength % 8;
        if (offset >= address.length) return;

        byte mask = (byte)(0xFF << (8 - remainder));
        address[offset] = (byte)(address[offset] & mask);

        for (int index = offset + 1; index < address.length; index++)
        {
            address[index] = 0;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof IpPrefix)) return false;

        IpPrefix prefix = (IpPrefix)other;
        return Arrays.equals(mAddress, prefix.mAddress) && mPrefixLength == prefix.mPrefixLength;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Arrays.hashCode(mAddress) + 11 * mPrefixLength;
    }

    public InetAddress getAddress()
    {
        try
        {
            return InetAddress.getByAddress(mAddress);
        }
        catch (UnknownHostException impossible)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public byte[] getRawAddress()
    {
        return mAddress.clone();
    }

    public int getPrefixLength()
    {
        return mPrefixLength;
    }

    public boolean contains(InetAddress address)
    {
        byte[] raw = address == null ? null : address.getAddress();
        if (raw == null || raw.length != mAddress.length) return false;

        maskRawAddress(raw, mPrefixLength);
        return Arrays.equals(mAddress, raw);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        InetAddress address = getAddress();
        return (address == null ? "?" : address.getHostAddress()) + "/" + mPrefixLength;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mAddress.length);
        for (byte value : mAddress)
        {
            dest.writeInt(value);
        }
        dest.writeInt(mPrefixLength);
    }

    public static final Creator<IpPrefix> CREATOR = new Creator<IpPrefix>()
    {
        @Override
        public IpPrefix createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            byte[] address = new byte[source.readInt()];
            for (int index = 0; index < address.length; index++)
            {
                address[index] = (byte)source.readInt();
            }
            return new IpPrefix(address, source.readInt());
        }

        @Override
        public IpPrefix[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new IpPrefix[size];
        }
    };
}
```

`java/android/net/LinkAddress.java`:

```java
package android.net;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.net.Inet4Address;
import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.UnknownHostException;

public class LinkAddress implements Parcelable
{
    private static final int RT_SCOPE_UNIVERSE = 0;
    private static final int RT_SCOPE_LINK = 253;
    private static final int RT_SCOPE_HOST = 254;

    private final InetAddress mAddress;
    private final int mPrefixLength;
    private final int mFlags;
    private final int mScope;

    LinkAddress(InetAddress address, int prefixLength, int flags, int scope)
    {
        if (address == null || prefixLength < 0 || (address instanceof Inet4Address && prefixLength > 32) || prefixLength > 128)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("bad LinkAddress params " + address + "/" + prefixLength);
        }

        mAddress = address;
        mPrefixLength = prefixLength;
        mFlags = flags;
        mScope = scope;
    }

    LinkAddress(InetAddress address, int prefixLength)
    {
        this(address, prefixLength, 0, scopeForUnicastAddress(address));
    }

    private static int scopeForUnicastAddress(InetAddress address)
    {
        if (address.isAnyLocalAddress()) return RT_SCOPE_HOST;
        if (address.isLoopbackAddress() || address.isLinkLocalAddress()) return RT_SCOPE_LINK;

        return RT_SCOPE_UNIVERSE;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mAddress.getHostAddress() + "/" + mPrefixLength;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof LinkAddress)) return false;

        LinkAddress address = (LinkAddress)other;
        return mAddress.equals(address.mAddress) && mPrefixLength == address.mPrefixLength && mFlags == address.mFlags
            && mScope == address.mScope;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mAddress.hashCode() + 11 * mPrefixLength + 19 * mFlags + 43 * mScope;
    }

    public InetAddress getAddress()
    {
        return mAddress;
    }

    public int getPrefixLength()
    {
        return mPrefixLength;
    }

    public int getFlags()
    {
        return mFlags;
    }

    public int getScope()
    {
        return mScope;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        byte[] raw = mAddress.getAddress();
        dest.writeInt(raw.length);
        for (byte value : raw)
        {
            dest.writeInt(value);
        }
        dest.writeInt(mPrefixLength);
        dest.writeInt(mFlags);
        dest.writeInt(mScope);
    }

    public static final Creator<LinkAddress> CREATOR = new Creator<LinkAddress>()
    {
        @Override
        public LinkAddress createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            byte[] raw = new byte[source.readInt()];
            for (int index = 0; index < raw.length; index++)
            {
                raw[index] = (byte)source.readInt();
            }

            InetAddress address;
            try
            {
                address = InetAddress.getByAddress(raw);
            }
            catch (UnknownHostException malformed)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(malformed);
            }

            int prefixLength = source.readInt();
            int flags = source.readInt();
            int scope = source.readInt();
            return new LinkAddress(address, prefixLength, flags, scope);
        }

        @Override
        public LinkAddress[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new LinkAddress[size];
        }
    };
}
```

```java
package android.net;

public final class LinkProperties implements Parcelable

    private final List<InetAddress> mDnsServers = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<RouteInfo> mRoutes = new ArrayList<>();

    private IpPrefix mNat64Prefix;
    private Inet4Address mDhcpServerAddress;

    }

        mInterfaceName = interfaceName;
    }

        return mInterfaceName;
    }

        return Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(mLinkAddresses));
    }

    public void setLinkAddresses(Collection<LinkAddress> addresses)
    {

        for (LinkAddress address : addresses)
        {
            if (address != null && !mLinkAddresses.contains(address)) mLinkAddresses.add(address);
        }
    }

    public void setDnsServers(Collection<InetAddress> dnsServers)
    {
        mDnsServers.clear();
        for (InetAddress server : dnsServers)
        {
            if (server != null && !mDnsServers.contains(server)) mDnsServers.add(server);
        }
    }

    }

        return mDomains;
    }

    public void setMtu(int mtu)

        mMtu = mtu;
    }

    {
        return mMtu;
    }

    public boolean addRoute(RouteInfo route)
    {
        if (route == null) throw new NullPointerException("route");

        if (mRoutes.contains(route)) return false;

        mRoutes.add(route);
        return true;
    }

    public List<RouteInfo> getRoutes()
    {
        return Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(mRoutes));
    }

    public void setHttpProxy(ProxyInfo proxy)
    {
        mHttpProxy = proxy;
    }

    public ProxyInfo getHttpProxy()
    {
        return mHttpProxy;
    }

    public IpPrefix getNat64Prefix()
    {
        return mNat64Prefix;
    }

    public void setNat64Prefix(IpPrefix prefix)
    {
        if (prefix != null && prefix.getPrefixLength() != 96)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only 96-bit prefixes are supported: " + prefix);
        }

        mNat64Prefix = prefix;
    }

    public Inet4Address getDhcpServerAddress()
    {
        return mDhcpServerAddress;
    }

    public void setDhcpServerAddress(Inet4Address serverAddress)
    {
        mDhcpServerAddress = serverAddress;
    }

    public boolean isPrivateDnsActive()
    {
        return mUsePrivateDns;
    }

    public String getPrivateDnsServerName()
    {
        return mPrivateDnsServerName;
    }

    public boolean isWakeOnLanSupported()
    {
        return mWakeOnLanSupported;
    }

    public void clear()
    {
        mInterfaceName = null;
        mLinkAddresses.clear();
        mDnsServers.clear();
        mRoutes.clear();
        mDomains = null;
        mHttpProxy = null;
        mMtu = 0;
        mNat64Prefix = null;
        mDhcpServerAddress = null;
        mPrivateDnsServerName = null;
        mUsePrivateDns = false;
        mWakeOnLanSupported = false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof LinkProperties)) return false;

        LinkProperties that = (LinkProperties)other;
        return Objects.equals(mInterfaceName, that.mInterfaceName) && mLinkAddresses.equals(that.mLinkAddresses)
            && mDnsServers.equals(that.mDnsServers) && mRoutes.equals(that.mRoutes) && Objects.equals(mDomains, that.mDomains)
            && Objects.equals(mHttpProxy, that.mHttpProxy) && mMtu == that.mMtu && Objects.equals(mNat64Prefix, that.mNat64Prefix)
            && Objects.equals(mDhcpServerAddress, that.mDhcpServerAddress)
            && Objects.equals(mPrivateDnsServerName, that.mPrivateDnsServerName) && mUsePrivateDns == that.mUsePrivateDns
            && mWakeOnLanSupported == that.mWakeOnLanSupported;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mInterfaceName, mLinkAddresses, mDnsServers, mRoutes, mDomains, mHttpProxy, mMtu, mNat64Prefix,
            mDhcpServerAddress, mPrivateDnsServerName, mUsePrivateDns, mWakeOnLanSupported);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder("{");

        if (mInterfaceName != null) builder.append(" InterfaceName: ").append(mInterfaceName);
        builder.append(" LinkAddresses: ").append(mLinkAddresses);
        builder.append(" DnsAddresses: ").append(mDnsServers);
        if (mUsePrivateDns) builder.append(" UsePrivateDns: true");
        if (mPrivateDnsServerName != null) builder.append(" PrivateDnsServerName: ").append(mPrivateDnsServerName);
        if (mDomains != null) builder.append(" Domains: ").append(mDomains);
        if (mMtu != 0) builder.append(" MTU: ").append(mMtu);
        if (mWakeOnLanSupported) builder.append(" WakeOnLanSupported: true");
        if (mDhcpServerAddress != null) builder.append(" ServerAddress: ").append(mDhcpServerAddress);
        builder.append(" Routes: ").append(mRoutes);
        if (mHttpProxy != null) builder.append(" HttpProxy: ").append(mHttpProxy);
        if (mNat64Prefix != null) builder.append(" Nat64Prefix: ").append(mNat64Prefix);

        return builder.append('}').toString();
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mInterfaceName);
        dest.writeTypedList(mLinkAddresses);

        dest.writeInt(mDnsServers.size());
        for (InetAddress server : mDnsServers) dest.writeByteArray(server.getAddress());

        dest.writeTypedList(mRoutes);
        dest.writeString(mDomains);
        dest.writeInt(mMtu);
        dest.writeParcelable(mHttpProxy, flags);
        dest.writeParcelable(mNat64Prefix, flags);
        dest.writeByteArray(mDhcpServerAddress == null ? null : mDhcpServerAddress.getAddress());
        dest.writeString(mPrivateDnsServerName);
        dest.writeBoolean(mUsePrivateDns);
        dest.writeBoolean(mWakeOnLanSupported);
    }

    public static final Creator<LinkProperties> CREATOR = new Creator<LinkProperties>()
    {
        @Override
        public LinkProperties createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            LinkProperties properties = new LinkProperties();
            properties.mInterfaceName = source.readString();

            List<LinkAddress> addresses = source.createTypedArrayList(LinkAddress.CREATOR);
            if (addresses != null) properties.mLinkAddresses.addAll(addresses);

            int servers = source.readInt();
            for (int index = 0; index < servers; index++)
            {
                InetAddress server = addressOf(source.createByteArray());
                if (server != null) properties.mDnsServers.add(server);
            }

            List<RouteInfo> routes = source.createTypedArrayList(RouteInfo.CREATOR);
            if (routes != null) properties.mRoutes.addAll(routes);

            properties.mDomains = source.readString();
            properties.mMtu = source.readInt();
            properties.mHttpProxy = source.readParcelable(ProxyInfo.class.getClassLoader());
            properties.mNat64Prefix = source.readParcelable(IpPrefix.class.getClassLoader());

            InetAddress dhcpServer = addressOf(source.createByteArray());
            properties.mDhcpServerAddress = dhcpServer instanceof Inet4Address ? (Inet4Address)dhcpServer : null;

            properties.mPrivateDnsServerName = source.readString();
            properties.mUsePrivateDns = source.readBoolean();
            properties.mWakeOnLanSupported = source.readBoolean();

            return properties;
        }

        @Override
        public LinkProperties[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new LinkProperties[size];
        }
    };

    private static InetAddress addressOf(byte[] raw)
    {
        if (raw == null) return null;

        try
        {
            return InetAddress.getByAddress(raw);
        }
        catch (java.net.UnknownHostException malformed)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.net;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.DatagramSocket;
import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.Proxy;
import java.net.Socket;
import java.net.URL;
import java.net.URLConnection;
import java.net.UnknownHostException;

import javax.net.SocketFactory;

public class Network implements Parcelable
{
    private static final long HANDLE_MAGIC = 0xcafedL;
    private static final int HANDLE_MAGIC_SIZE = 32;

    private final int mHandle;

    public Network(int handle)
    {
        mHandle = handle;
    }

    public static Network fromNetworkHandle(long networkHandle)
    {
        if (networkHandle == 0)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Network.fromNetworkHandle refusing to instantiate NETID_UNSET Network.");
        }

        if ((networkHandle & ((1L << HANDLE_MAGIC_SIZE) - 1)) != HANDLE_MAGIC || networkHandle < 0)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Value passed to fromNetworkHandle() is not a network handle.");
        }

        return new Network((int)(networkHandle >> HANDLE_MAGIC_SIZE));
    }

    public long getNetworkHandle()
    {
        if (mHandle == 0) return 0L;

        return (((long)mHandle) << HANDLE_MAGIC_SIZE) | HANDLE_MAGIC;
    }

    public InetAddress[] getAllByName(String host) throws UnknownHostException
    {
        return InetAddress.getAllByName(host);
    }

    public InetAddress getByName(String host) throws UnknownHostException
    {
        return InetAddress.getByName(host);
    }

    public SocketFactory getSocketFactory()
    {
        return SocketFactory.getDefault();
    }

    public URLConnection openConnection(URL url) throws IOException
    {
        return url.openConnection();
    }

    public URLConnection openConnection(URL url, Proxy proxy) throws IOException
    {
        if (proxy == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("proxy is null");

        return url.openConnection(proxy);
    }

    public void bindSocket(DatagramSocket socket) throws IOException
    {
    }

    public void bindSocket(Socket socket) throws IOException
    {
        if (socket.isConnected()) throw new java.net.SocketException("Socket is connected");
    }

    public void bindSocket(FileDescriptor fd) throws IOException
    {
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mHandle);
    }

    public static final Creator<Network> CREATOR = new Creator<Network>()
    {
        @Override
        public Network createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new Network(source.readInt());
        }

        @Override
        public Network[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Network[size];
        }
    };

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        return other instanceof Network && ((Network)other).mHandle == mHandle;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mHandle * 11;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return Integer.toString(mHandle);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.net;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;

public final class NetworkCapabilities implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int TRANSPORT_CELLULAR = 0;
    public static final int TRANSPORT_WIFI = 1;
    public static final int TRANSPORT_BLUETOOTH = 2;
    public static final int TRANSPORT_ETHERNET = 3;
    public static final int TRANSPORT_VPN = 4;
    public static final int TRANSPORT_WIFI_AWARE = 5;
    public static final int TRANSPORT_LOWPAN = 6;
    public static final int TRANSPORT_USB = 8;
    public static final int TRANSPORT_THREAD = 9;
    public static final int TRANSPORT_SATELLITE = 10;

    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_MMS = 0;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_SUPL = 1;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_DUN = 2;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_FOTA = 3;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_IMS = 4;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_CBS = 5;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_WIFI_P2P = 6;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_IA = 7;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_RCS = 8;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_XCAP = 9;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_EIMS = 10;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_NOT_METERED = 11;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET = 12;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_NOT_RESTRICTED = 13;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_TRUSTED = 14;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_NOT_VPN = 15;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED = 16;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_CAPTIVE_PORTAL = 17;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_NOT_ROAMING = 18;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_FOREGROUND = 19;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_NOT_CONGESTED = 20;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_NOT_SUSPENDED = 21;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_MCX = 23;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_TEMPORARILY_NOT_METERED = 25;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_ENTERPRISE = 29;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_HEAD_UNIT = 32;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_MMTEL = 33;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_PRIORITIZE_LATENCY = 34;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_PRIORITIZE_BANDWIDTH = 35;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_LOCAL_NETWORK = 36;
    public static final int NET_CAPABILITY_NOT_BANDWIDTH_CONSTRAINED = 37;

    public static final int NET_ENTERPRISE_ID_1 = 1;
    public static final int NET_ENTERPRISE_ID_2 = 2;
    public static final int NET_ENTERPRISE_ID_3 = 3;
    public static final int NET_ENTERPRISE_ID_4 = 4;
    public static final int NET_ENTERPRISE_ID_5 = 5;

    public static final int SIGNAL_STRENGTH_UNSPECIFIED = Integer.MIN_VALUE;

    private static final int MAX_CAPABILITY = NET_CAPABILITY_NOT_BANDWIDTH_CONSTRAINED;
    private static final int MAX_TRANSPORT = TRANSPORT_SATELLITE;

    private static final long DEFAULT_CAPABILITIES = (1L << NET_CAPABILITY_NOT_RESTRICTED) | (1L << NET_CAPABILITY_TRUSTED)
        | (1L << NET_CAPABILITY_NOT_VPN);

    private long mTransports;
    private long mCapabilities;
    private int mLinkUpBandwidthKbps;
    private int mLinkDownBandwidthKbps;
    private int mSignalStrength = SIGNAL_STRENGTH_UNSPECIFIED;
    private int mOwnerUid = -1;
    private NetworkSpecifier mNetworkSpecifier;
    private TransportInfo mTransportInfo;
    private Set<Integer> mSubscriptionIds = new HashSet<>();
    private int[] mEnterpriseIds = new int[0];

    public NetworkCapabilities()
    {
        mCapabilities = DEFAULT_CAPABILITIES;
    }

    public NetworkCapabilities(NetworkCapabilities source)
    {
        if (source == null) return;

        mTransports = source.mTransports;
        mCapabilities = source.mCapabilities;
        mLinkUpBandwidthKbps = source.mLinkUpBandwidthKbps;
        mLinkDownBandwidthKbps = source.mLinkDownBandwidthKbps;
        mSignalStrength = source.mSignalStrength;
        mOwnerUid = source.mOwnerUid;
        mNetworkSpecifier = source.mNetworkSpecifier;
        mTransportInfo = source.mTransportInfo;
        mSubscriptionIds = new HashSet<>(source.mSubscriptionIds);
        mEnterpriseIds = source.mEnterpriseIds.clone();
    }

    NetworkCapabilities(int transports, int capabilities)
    {
        mTransports = transports & 0xffffffffL;
        mCapabilities = capabilities & 0xffffffffL;
    }

    public boolean hasTransport(int transport)
    {
        return transport >= 0 && transport <= MAX_TRANSPORT && (mTransports & (1L << transport)) != 0;
    }

    public boolean hasCapability(int capability)
    {
        return capability >= 0 && capability <= MAX_CAPABILITY && (mCapabilities & (1L << capability)) != 0;
    }

    public int[] getCapabilities()
    {
        return bitsOf(mCapabilities);
    }

    int[] getTransportTypes()
    {
        return bitsOf(mTransports);
    }

    public boolean hasEnterpriseId(int enterpriseId)
    {
        for (int candidate : mEnterpriseIds)
        {
            if (candidate == enterpriseId) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public int[] getEnterpriseIds()
    {
        return mEnterpriseIds.clone();
    }

    public int getLinkDownstreamBandwidthKbps()
    {
        return mLinkDownBandwidthKbps;
    }

    public int getLinkUpstreamBandwidthKbps()
    {
        return mLinkUpBandwidthKbps;
    }

    public NetworkSpecifier getNetworkSpecifier()
    {
        return mNetworkSpecifier;
    }

    public TransportInfo getTransportInfo()
    {
        return mTransportInfo;
    }

    public int getSignalStrength()
    {
        return mSignalStrength;
    }

    public int getOwnerUid()
    {
        return mOwnerUid;
    }

    public Set<Integer> getSubscriptionIds()
    {
        return Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(mSubscriptionIds));
    }

    NetworkCapabilities addTransportType(int transport)
    {
        checkTransport(transport);
        mTransports |= 1L << transport;
        return this;
    }

    NetworkCapabilities removeTransportType(int transport)
    {
        checkTransport(transport);
        mTransports &= ~(1L << transport);
        return this;
    }

    NetworkCapabilities addCapability(int capability)
    {
        checkCapability(capability);
        mCapabilities |= 1L << capability;
        return this;
    }

    NetworkCapabilities removeCapability(int capability)
    {
        checkCapability(capability);
        mCapabilities &= ~(1L << capability);
        return this;
    }

    void clearCapabilities()
    {
        mCapabilities = 0;
    }

    void setNetworkSpecifier(NetworkSpecifier networkSpecifier)
    {
        mNetworkSpecifier = networkSpecifier;
    }

    void setSubscriptionIds(Set<Integer> subscriptionIds)
    {
        mSubscriptionIds = new HashSet<>(subscriptionIds);
    }

    boolean satisfiedByNetworkCapabilities(NetworkCapabilities other)
    {
        if (other == null) return false;
        if ((other.mCapabilities & mCapabilities) != mCapabilities) return false;
        if (mTransports != 0 && (other.mTransports & mTransports) == 0) return false;
        if (mSignalStrength != SIGNAL_STRENGTH_UNSPECIFIED && other.mSignalStrength < mSignalStrength) return false;
        if (!mSubscriptionIds.isEmpty() && !other.mSubscriptionIds.containsAll(mSubscriptionIds)) return false;

        if (mNetworkSpecifier != null)
        {
            if (other.mNetworkSpecifier == null) return false;
            if (!mNetworkSpecifier.equals(other.mNetworkSpecifier) && !other.mNetworkSpecifier.canBeSatisfiedBy(mNetworkSpecifier))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static void checkTransport(int transport)
    {
        if (transport < 0 || transport > MAX_TRANSPORT) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid TransportType " + transport);
    }

    private static void checkCapability(int capability)
    {
        if (capability < 0 || capability > MAX_CAPABILITY)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("NetworkCapability " + capability + " out of range");
        }
    }

    private static int[] bitsOf(long mask)
    {
        int[] bits = new int[Long.bitCount(mask)];
        int count = 0;

        for (int bit = 0; bit < 64; bit++)
        {
            if ((mask & (1L << bit)) != 0) bits[count++] = bit;
        }

        return bits;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof NetworkCapabilities)) return false;

        NetworkCapabilities that = (NetworkCapabilities)other;
        return mTransports == that.mTransports && mCapabilities == that.mCapabilities
            && mLinkUpBandwidthKbps == that.mLinkUpBandwidthKbps && mLinkDownBandwidthKbps == that.mLinkDownBandwidthKbps
            && mSignalStrength == that.mSignalStrength && mOwnerUid == that.mOwnerUid
            && Objects.equals(mNetworkSpecifier, that.mNetworkSpecifier) && Objects.equals(mTransportInfo, that.mTransportInfo)
            && mSubscriptionIds.equals(that.mSubscriptionIds) && java.util.Arrays.equals(mEnterpriseIds, that.mEnterpriseIds);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mTransports, mCapabilities, mLinkUpBandwidthKbps, mLinkDownBandwidthKbps, mSignalStrength, mOwnerUid,
            mNetworkSpecifier, mTransportInfo, mSubscriptionIds) * 31 + java.util.Arrays.hashCode(mEnterpriseIds);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder("[");

        int[] transports = getTransportTypes();
        if (transports.length > 0)
        {
            builder.append(" Transports: ");
            for (int index = 0; index < transports.length; index++)
            {
                if (index != 0) builder.append('|');
                builder.append(transportName(transports[index]));
            }
        }

        int[] capabilities = getCapabilities();
        if (capabilities.length > 0)
        {
            builder.append(" Capabilities: ");
            for (int index = 0; index < capabilities.length; index++)
            {
                if (index != 0) builder.append('&');
                builder.append(capabilityName(capabilities[index]));
            }
        }

        if (mLinkUpBandwidthKbps > 0) builder.append(" LinkUpBandwidth>=").append(mLinkUpBandwidthKbps).append("Kbps");
        if (mLinkDownBandwidthKbps > 0) builder.append(" LinkDnBandwidth>=").append(mLinkDownBandwidthKbps).append("Kbps");
        if (mNetworkSpecifier != null) builder.append(" Specifier: <").append(mNetworkSpecifier).append('>');
        if (mTransportInfo != null) builder.append(" TransportInfo: <").append(mTransportInfo).append('>');
        if (mSignalStrength != SIGNAL_STRENGTH_UNSPECIFIED) builder.append(" SignalStrength: ").append(mSignalStrength);
        if (mOwnerUid != -1) builder.append(" OwnerUid: ").append(mOwnerUid);
        if (!mSubscriptionIds.isEmpty()) builder.append(" SubscriptionIds: ").append(mSubscriptionIds);

        return builder.append(']').toString();
    }

    private static String transportName(int transport)
    {
        switch (transport)
        {
            case TRANSPORT_CELLULAR: return "CELLULAR";
            case TRANSPORT_WIFI: return "WIFI";
            case TRANSPORT_BLUETOOTH: return "BLUETOOTH";
            case TRANSPORT_ETHERNET: return "ETHERNET";
            case TRANSPORT_VPN: return "VPN";
            case TRANSPORT_WIFI_AWARE: return "WIFI_AWARE";
            case TRANSPORT_LOWPAN: return "LOWPAN";
            case 7: return "TEST";
            case TRANSPORT_USB: return "USB";
            case TRANSPORT_THREAD: return "THREAD";
            case TRANSPORT_SATELLITE: return "SATELLITE";
            default: return Integer.toString(transport);
        }
    }

    private static String capabilityName(int capability)
    {
        switch (capability)
        {
            case NET_CAPABILITY_MMS: return "MMS";
            case NET_CAPABILITY_SUPL: return "SUPL";
            case NET_CAPABILITY_DUN: return "DUN";
            case NET_CAPABILITY_FOTA: return "FOTA";
            case NET_CAPABILITY_IMS: return "IMS";

        return 0;
    }

        dest.writeLong(mCapabilities);

        {

            capabilities.mTransports = source.readLong();
            capabilities.mCapabilities = source.readLong();
            capabilities.mLinkUpBandwidthKbps = source.readInt();
            capabilities.mLinkDownBandwidthKbps = source.readInt();
            capabilities.mSignalStrength = source.readInt();
            capabilities.mOwnerUid = source.readInt();

            int[] subscriptionIds = source.createIntArray();
            if (subscriptionIds != null)
            {
                for (int subscriptionId : subscriptionIds) capabilities.mSubscriptionIds.add(subscriptionId);
            }

            int[] enterpriseIds = source.createIntArray();
            capabilities.mEnterpriseIds = enterpriseIds == null ? new int[0] : enterpriseIds;

            return capabilities;
        }

        public NetworkCapabilities[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new NetworkCapabilities[size];
```

```java
package android.net;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.EnumMap;

public class NetworkInfo implements Parcelable
{
    public enum State
    {
        CONNECTING,
        CONNECTED,
        SUSPENDED,
        DISCONNECTING,
        DISCONNECTED,
        UNKNOWN
    }

    public enum DetailedState
    {
        IDLE,
        SCANNING,
        CONNECTING,
        AUTHENTICATING,
        OBTAINING_IPADDR,
        CONNECTED,
        SUSPENDED,
        DISCONNECTING,
        DISCONNECTED,
        FAILED,
        BLOCKED,
        VERIFYING_POOR_LINK,
        CAPTIVE_PORTAL_CHECK
    }

    private static final EnumMap<DetailedState, State> STATE_MAP = new EnumMap<>(DetailedState.class);

    static
    {
        STATE_MAP.put(DetailedState.IDLE, State.DISCONNECTED);
        STATE_MAP.put(DetailedState.SCANNING, State.DISCONNECTED);
        STATE_MAP.put(DetailedState.CONNECTING, State.CONNECTING);
        STATE_MAP.put(DetailedState.AUTHENTICATING, State.CONNECTING);
        STATE_MAP.put(DetailedState.OBTAINING_IPADDR, State.CONNECTING);
        STATE_MAP.put(DetailedState.VERIFYING_POOR_LINK, State.CONNECTING);
        STATE_MAP.put(DetailedState.CAPTIVE_PORTAL_CHECK, State.CONNECTING);
        STATE_MAP.put(DetailedState.CONNECTED, State.CONNECTED);
        STATE_MAP.put(DetailedState.SUSPENDED, State.SUSPENDED);
        STATE_MAP.put(DetailedState.DISCONNECTING, State.DISCONNECTING);
        STATE_MAP.put(DetailedState.DISCONNECTED, State.DISCONNECTED);
        STATE_MAP.put(DetailedState.FAILED, State.DISCONNECTED);
        STATE_MAP.put(DetailedState.BLOCKED, State.DISCONNECTED);
    }

    private final int mNetworkType;
    private final int mSubtype;
    private final String mTypeName;
    private final String mSubtypeName;
    private State mState = State.UNKNOWN;
    private DetailedState mDetailedState = DetailedState.IDLE;
    private String mReason;
    private String mExtraInfo;
    private boolean mIsFailover;
    private boolean mIsAvailable;
    private boolean mIsRoaming;

    public NetworkInfo(int type, int subtype, String typeName, String subtypeName)
    {
        if (!ConnectivityManager.isNetworkTypeValid(type) && type != -1)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid network type: " + type);
        }

        mNetworkType = type;
        mSubtype = subtype;
        mTypeName = typeName;
        mSubtypeName = subtypeName;
    }

    public synchronized int getType()
    {
        return mNetworkType;
    }

    public synchronized int getSubtype()
    {
        return mSubtype;
    }

    public synchronized String getTypeName()
    {
        return mTypeName;
    }

    public synchronized String getSubtypeName()
    {
        return mSubtypeName;
    }

    public synchronized boolean isConnectedOrConnecting()
    {
        return mState == State.CONNECTED || mState == State.CONNECTING;
    }

    public synchronized boolean isConnected()
    {
        return mState == State.CONNECTED;
    }

    public synchronized boolean isAvailable()
    {
        return mIsAvailable;
    }

    public synchronized boolean isFailover()
    {
        return mIsFailover;
    }

    public synchronized boolean isRoaming()
    {
        return mIsRoaming;
    }

    public synchronized State getState()
    {
        return mState;
    }

    public synchronized DetailedState getDetailedState()
    {
        return mDetailedState;
    }

    public synchronized void setDetailedState(DetailedState detailedState, String reason, String extraInfo)
    {
        mDetailedState = detailedState;
        mState = STATE_MAP.get(detailedState);
        mReason = reason;
        mExtraInfo = extraInfo;
    }

    public synchronized String getReason()
    {
        return mReason;
    }

    public synchronized String getExtraInfo()
    {
        return mExtraInfo;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized String toString()
    {
        return "[type: " + mTypeName + "[" + mSubtypeName + "], state: " + mState + "/" + mDetailedState + ", reason: "
            + (mReason == null ? "(unspecified)" : mReason) + ", extra: " + (mExtraInfo == null ? "(none)" : mExtraInfo)
            + ", failover: " + mIsFailover + ", available: " + mIsAvailable + ", roaming: " + mIsRoaming + "]";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mNetworkType);
        dest.writeInt(mSubtype);
        dest.writeString(mTypeName);
        dest.writeString(mSubtypeName);
        dest.writeString(mState.name());
        dest.writeString(mDetailedState.name());
        dest.writeInt(mIsFailover ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeInt(mIsAvailable ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeInt(mIsRoaming ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeString(mReason);
        dest.writeString(mExtraInfo);
    }

    public static final Creator<NetworkInfo> CREATOR = new Creator<NetworkInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public NetworkInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            NetworkInfo info = new NetworkInfo(source.readInt(), source.readInt(), source.readString(), source.readString());
            info.mState = State.valueOf(source.readString());
            info.mDetailedState = DetailedState.valueOf(source.readString());
            info.mIsFailover = source.readInt() != 0;
            info.mIsAvailable = source.readInt() != 0;
            info.mIsRoaming = source.readInt() != 0;
            info.mReason = source.readString();
            info.mExtraInfo = source.readString();

            return info;
        }

        @Override
        public NetworkInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new NetworkInfo[size];
        }
```

```java
package android.net;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Objects;

public class ProxyInfo implements Parcelable
{
    private final String mHost;
    private final int mPort;
    private final String mExclusionList;
    private final String[] mParsedExclusionList;
    private final Uri mPacFileUrl;

    private ProxyInfo(String host, int port, String exclusionList, Uri pacFileUrl)
    {
        mHost = host;
        mPort = port;
        mExclusionList = exclusionList == null ? "" : exclusionList.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        mParsedExclusionList = mExclusionList.isEmpty() ? new String[0] : mExclusionList.split(",");
        mPacFileUrl = pacFileUrl == null ? Uri.EMPTY : pacFileUrl;
    }

    public ProxyInfo(ProxyInfo source)
    {
        this(source == null ? null : source.mHost, source == null ? 0 : source.mPort, source == null ? null : source.mExclusionList,
             source == null ? null : source.mPacFileUrl);
    }

    public static ProxyInfo buildDirectProxy(String host, int port)
    {
        return new ProxyInfo(host, port, null, null);
    }

    public static ProxyInfo buildDirectProxy(String host, int port, List<String> exclList)
    {
        String joined = exclList == null ? null : String.join(",", exclList);
        return new ProxyInfo(host, port, joined, null);
    }

    public static ProxyInfo buildPacProxy(Uri pacUri)
    {
        return new ProxyInfo("localhost", -1, null, pacUri);
    }

    public static ProxyInfo buildPacProxy(Uri pacUrl, int localProxyPort)
    {
        return new ProxyInfo("localhost", localProxyPort, null, pacUrl);
    }

    public Uri getPacFileUrl()
    {
        return mPacFileUrl;
    }

    public String getHost()
    {
        return mHost;
    }

    public int getPort()
    {
        return mPort;
    }

    public String[] getExclusionList()
    {
        return mParsedExclusionList.clone();
    }

    public boolean isValid()
    {
        if (!Uri.EMPTY.equals(mPacFileUrl)) return true;

        return mHost != null && !mHost.isEmpty() && mPort > 0 && mPort <= 65535;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();

        if (!Uri.EMPTY.equals(mPacFileUrl))
        {
            builder.append("PAC Script: ").append(mPacFileUrl);
        }

        if (mHost != null)
        {
            builder.append("[").append(mHost).append("] ").append(mPort);
            if (!mExclusionList.isEmpty()) builder.append(" xl=").append(mExclusionList);
        }
        else
        {
            builder.append("[ProxyProperties.mHost == null]");
        }

        return builder.toString();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof ProxyInfo)) return false;

        ProxyInfo proxy = (ProxyInfo)other;
        return Objects.equals(mHost, proxy.mHost) && mPort == proxy.mPort && mExclusionList.equals(proxy.mExclusionList)
            && mPacFileUrl.equals(proxy.mPacFileUrl);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mHost, mPort, mExclusionList) + Arrays.hashCode(mParsedExclusionList);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mHost);
        dest.writeInt(mPort);
        dest.writeString(mExclusionList);
        dest.writeString(Uri.EMPTY.equals(mPacFileUrl) ? null : mPacFileUrl.toString());
    }

    public static final Creator<ProxyInfo> CREATOR = new Creator<ProxyInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public ProxyInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            String host = source.readString();
            int port = source.readInt();
            String exclusionList = source.readString();
            String pac = source.readString();
            return new ProxyInfo(host, port, exclusionList, pac == null ? null : Uri.parse(pac));
        }

        @Override
        public ProxyInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ProxyInfo[size];
        }
    };
}
```

```java
package android.net;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.UnknownHostException;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class RouteInfo implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int RTN_UNICAST = 1;
    public static final int RTN_UNREACHABLE = 7;
    public static final int RTN_THROW = 9;

    private final IpPrefix mDestination;
    private final InetAddress mGateway;
    private final String mInterface;
    private final int mType;

    RouteInfo(IpPrefix destination, InetAddress gateway, String interfaceName, int type)
    {
        mDestination = destination;
        mGateway = gateway;
        mInterface = interfaceName;
        mType = type;
    }

    public IpPrefix getDestination()
    {
        return mDestination;
    }

    public InetAddress getGateway()
    {
        return mGateway;
    }

    public String getInterface()
    {
        return mInterface;
    }

    public int getType()
    {
        return mType;
    }

    public boolean isDefaultRoute()
    {
        return mType == RTN_UNICAST && mDestination.getPrefixLength() == 0;
    }

    public boolean hasGateway()
    {
        return mGateway != null && !mGateway.isAnyLocalAddress();
    }

    public boolean matches(InetAddress destination)
    {
        return mDestination.contains(destination);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        String value = mDestination == null ? "" : mDestination.toString();

        if (mType == RTN_UNREACHABLE) value += " unreachable";
        else if (mType == RTN_THROW) value += " throw";
        else
        {
            value += " ->";
            if (mGateway != null) value += " " + mGateway.getHostAddress();
            if (mInterface != null) value += " " + mInterface;
        }

        return value;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof RouteInfo)) return false;

        RouteInfo route = (RouteInfo)other;
        return Objects.equals(mDestination, route.mDestination) && Objects.equals(mGateway, route.mGateway)
            && Objects.equals(mInterface, route.mInterface) && mType == route.mType;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return (mDestination == null ? 0 : mDestination.hashCode() * 41) + (mGateway == null ? 0 : mGateway.hashCode() * 47)
            + (mInterface == null ? 0 : mInterface.hashCode() * 67) + mType * 71;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeParcelable(mDestination, flags);
        dest.writeString(mGateway == null ? null : mGateway.getHostAddress());
        dest.writeString(mInterface);
        dest.writeInt(mType);
    }

    public static final Creator<RouteInfo> CREATOR = new Creator<RouteInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public RouteInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            IpPrefix destination = source.readParcelable(IpPrefix.class.getClassLoader());
            String gatewayText = source.readString();
            InetAddress gateway = null;

            try
            {
                if (gatewayText != null) gateway = InetAddress.getByName(gatewayText);
            }
            catch (UnknownHostException malformed)
            {
                gateway = null;
            }

            return new RouteInfo(destination, gateway, source.readString(), source.readInt());
        }

        @Override
        public RouteInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new RouteInfo[size];
        }
    };
}
```

`java/android/net/Uri.java`:

```java
package android.net;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;

public class Uri implements Parcelable, Comparable<Uri>
{
    public static final Uri EMPTY = new Uri(null, null, null, "", null, null);

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<Uri> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<Uri>()
    {
        @Override
        public Uri createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            String text = source.readString();
            return text == null ? null : parse(text);
        }

        @Override
        public Uri[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Uri[size];
        }
    };

    private static final char[] HEX_DIGITS = "0123456789ABCDEF".toCharArray();
    private static final String DEFAULT_ENCODING_ALLOWED = "_-!.~'()*";

    private final String mText;
    private final String mScheme;
    private final String mEncodedOpaquePart;
    private final String mEncodedAuthority;
    private final String mEncodedPath;
    private final String mEncodedQuery;
    private final String mEncodedFragment;

    private Uri(String text)
    {
        mText = text;

        int schemeSeparator = findSchemeSeparator(text);
        mScheme = schemeSeparator < 0 ? null : text.substring(0, schemeSeparator);

        int fragmentSeparator = text.indexOf('#', schemeSeparator < 0 ? 0 : schemeSeparator);
        mEncodedFragment = fragmentSeparator < 0 ? null : text.substring(fragmentSeparator + 1);

        String schemeSpecific = text.substring(schemeSeparator + 1, fragmentSeparator < 0 ? text.length() : fragmentSeparator);

        boolean hierarchical = schemeSeparator < 0 || schemeSpecific.startsWith("/");
        if (!hierarchical)
        {
            mEncodedOpaquePart = schemeSpecific;
            mEncodedAuthority = null;
            mEncodedPath = null;
            mEncodedQuery = null;
            return;
        }

        mEncodedOpaquePart = null;

        int querySeparator = schemeSpecific.indexOf('?');
        mEncodedQuery = querySeparator < 0 ? null : schemeSpecific.substring(querySeparator + 1);

        String rest = querySeparator < 0 ? schemeSpecific : schemeSpecific.substring(0, querySeparator);
        if (rest.startsWith("//"))
        {
            int slash = rest.indexOf('/', 2);
            mEncodedAuthority = slash < 0 ? rest.substring(2) : rest.substring(2, slash);
            mEncodedPath = slash < 0 ? "" : rest.substring(slash);
        }
        else
        {
            mEncodedAuthority = null;
            mEncodedPath = rest;
        }
    }

    private Uri(String scheme, String encodedOpaquePart, String encodedAuthority, String encodedPath, String encodedQuery,
                String encodedFragment)
    {
        mScheme = scheme;
        mEncodedOpaquePart = encodedOpaquePart;
        mEncodedAuthority = encodedOpaquePart != null ? null : encodedAuthority;
        mEncodedPath = encodedOpaquePart != null ? null : (encodedPath == null ? "" : encodedPath);
        mEncodedQuery = encodedOpaquePart != null ? null : encodedQuery;
        mEncodedFragment = encodedFragment;

        StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
        if (mScheme != null) text.append(mScheme).append(':');
        text.append(encodedSchemeSpecificPart());
        if (mEncodedFragment != null) text.append('#').append(mEncodedFragment);
        mText = text.toString();
    }

    private static int findSchemeSeparator(String text)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < text.length(); index++)
        {
            char character = text.charAt(index);
            if (character == ':') return index;
            if (character == '/' || character == '?' || character == '#') return -1;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    private String encodedSchemeSpecificPart()
    {
        if (mEncodedOpaquePart != null) return mEncodedOpaquePart;

        StringBuilder schemeSpecific = new StringBuilder();
        if (mEncodedAuthority != null) schemeSpecific.append("//").append(mEncodedAuthority);
        if (mEncodedPath != null) schemeSpecific.append(mEncodedPath);
        if (mEncodedQuery != null) schemeSpecific.append('?').append(mEncodedQuery);
        return schemeSpecific.toString();
    }

    public static Uri parse(String text)
    {
        if (text == null) throw new NullPointerException("uriString");
        return new Uri(text);
    }

    public static Uri fromFile(File file)
    {
        if (file == null) throw new NullPointerException("file");
        return new Uri("file", null, "", encode(file.getAbsolutePath(), "/"), null, null);
    }

    public static Uri fromParts(String scheme, String schemeSpecificPart, String fragment)
    {
        if (scheme == null) throw new NullPointerException("scheme");
        if (schemeSpecificPart == null) throw new NullPointerException("ssp");

        return new Uri(scheme, encode(schemeSpecificPart), null, null, null, encode(fragment));
    }

    public static Uri withAppendedPath(Uri baseUri, String pathSegment)
    {
        return baseUri.buildUpon().appendEncodedPath(pathSegment).build();
    }

    public static void writeToParcel(Parcel out, Uri uri)
    {
        out.writeString(uri == null ? null : uri.toString());
    }

    public static String encode(String text)
    {
        return encode(text, null);
    }

    public static String encode(String text, String allow)
    {
        if (text == null) return null;

        StringBuilder encoded = null;
        int length = text.length();
        int current = 0;

        while (current < length)
        {
            int nextToEncode = current;
            while (nextToEncode < length && isAllowed(text.charAt(nextToEncode), allow)) nextToEncode++;

            if (nextToEncode == length)
            {
                if (current == 0) return text;
                encoded.append(text, current, length);
                return encoded.toString();
            }

            if (encoded == null) encoded = new StringBuilder();
            if (nextToEncode > current) encoded.append(text, current, nextToEncode);

            current = nextToEncode;
            int nextAllowed = current + 1;
            while (nextAllowed < length && !isAllowed(text.charAt(nextAllowed), allow)) nextAllowed++;

            byte[] bytes = text.substring(current, nextAllowed).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            for (byte value : bytes)
            {
                encoded.append('%');
                encoded.append(HEX_DIGITS[(value & 0xf0) >> 4]);
                encoded.append(HEX_DIGITS[value & 0xf]);
            }

            current = nextAllowed;
        }

        return encoded == null ? text : encoded.toString();
    }

    private static boolean isAllowed(char character, String allow)
    {
        if (character >= 'A' && character <= 'Z') return true;
        if (character >= 'a' && character <= 'z') return true;
        if (character >= '0' && character <= '9') return true;
        if (DEFAULT_ENCODING_ALLOWED.indexOf(character) != -1) return true;

        return allow != null && allow.indexOf(character) != -1;
    }

    public static String decode(String text)
    {
        return decode(text, false);
    }

    private static String decode(String text, boolean convertPlus)
    {
        if (text == null) return null;
        if (text.indexOf('%') < 0 && (!convertPlus || text.indexOf('+') < 0)) return text;

        StringBuilder decoded = new StringBuilder(text.length());
        ByteArrayOutputStream bytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        int index = 0;

        while (index < text.length())
        {
            char character = text.charAt(index);

            if (character == '%' && index + 2 < text.length() && hexValue(text.charAt(index + 1)) >= 0
                && hexValue(text.charAt(index + 2)) >= 0)
            {
                bytes.write((hexValue(text.charAt(index + 1)) << 4) | hexValue(text.charAt(index + 2)));
                index += 3;
                continue;
            }

            if (bytes.size() > 0)
            {
                decoded.append(new String(bytes.toByteArray(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
                bytes.reset();
            }

            decoded.append(convertPlus && character == '+' ? ' ' : character);
            index++;
        }

        if (bytes.size() > 0) decoded.append(new String(bytes.toByteArray(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));

        return decoded.toString();
    }

    private static int hexValue(char character)
    {
        if (character >= '0' && character <= '9') return character - '0';
        if (character >= 'a' && character <= 'f') return character - 'a' + 10;
        if (character >= 'A' && character <= 'F') return character - 'A' + 10;

        return -1;
    }

    public boolean isHierarchical()
    {
        return mEncodedOpaquePart == null;
    }

    public boolean isOpaque()
    {
        return !isHierarchical();
    }

    public boolean isRelative()
    {
        return mScheme == null;
    }

    public boolean isAbsolute()
    {
        return !isRelative();
    }

    public String getScheme()
    {
        return mScheme;
    }

    public String getSchemeSpecificPart()
    {
        return decode(getEncodedSchemeSpecificPart());
    }

    public String getEncodedSchemeSpecificPart()
    {
        return encodedSchemeSpecificPart();
    }

    public String getAuthority()
    {
        return decode(mEncodedAuthority);
    }

    public String getEncodedAuthority()
    {
        return mEncodedAuthority;
    }

    public String getEncodedUserInfo()
    {
        if (mEncodedAuthority == null) return null;

        int end = mEncodedAuthority.lastIndexOf('@');
        return end < 0 ? null : mEncodedAuthority.substring(0, end);
    }

    public String getUserInfo()
    {
        return decode(getEncodedUserInfo());
    }

    private int portSeparator()
    {
        if (mEncodedAuthority == null || mEncodedAuthority.endsWith("]")) return -1;

        int colon = mEncodedAuthority.lastIndexOf(':');
        int userInfoSeparator = mEncodedAuthority.lastIndexOf('@');
        return colon > userInfoSeparator ? colon : -1;
    }

    public String getHost()
    {
        if (mEncodedAuthority == null) return null;

        int userInfoSeparator = mEncodedAuthority.lastIndexOf('@');
        int portSeparator = portSeparator();
        String encodedHost = portSeparator < 0 ? mEncodedAuthority.substring(userInfoSeparator + 1)
                                               : mEncodedAuthority.substring(userInfoSeparator + 1, portSeparator);
        return decode(encodedHost);
    }

    public int getPort()
    {
        int portSeparator = portSeparator();
        if (portSeparator < 0) return -1;

        try
        {
            return Integer.parseInt(decode(mEncodedAuthority.substring(portSeparator + 1)));
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
        {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    public String getPath()
    {
        return decode(mEncodedPath);
    }

    public String getEncodedPath()
    {
        return mEncodedPath;
    }

    public String getQuery()
    {
        return decode(mEncodedQuery);
    }
```
