```java
        return mEncodedQuery;
    }

    public String getFragment()
    {
        return decode(mEncodedFragment);
    }

    public String getEncodedFragment()
    {
        return mEncodedFragment;
    }

    public List<String> getPathSegments()
    {
        if (mEncodedPath == null) return Collections.emptyList();

        List<String> segments = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String segment : mEncodedPath.split("/"))
        {
            if (!segment.isEmpty()) segments.add(decode(segment));
        }

        return Collections.unmodifiableList(segments);
    }

    public String getLastPathSegment()
    {
        List<String> segments = getPathSegments();
        return segments.isEmpty() ? null : segments.get(segments.size() - 1);
    }

    public Set<String> getQueryParameterNames()
    {
        if (isOpaque()) throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This isn't a hierarchical URI.");
        if (mEncodedQuery == null) return Collections.emptySet();

        Set<String> names = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        int start = 0;

        do
        {
            int next = mEncodedQuery.indexOf('&', start);
            int end = next == -1 ? mEncodedQuery.length() : next;

            int separator = mEncodedQuery.indexOf('=', start);
            if (separator > end || separator == -1) separator = end;

            names.add(decode(mEncodedQuery.substring(start, separator)));
            start = end + 1;
        }
        while (start < mEncodedQuery.length());

        return Collections.unmodifiableSet(names);
    }

    public List<String> getQueryParameters(String key)
    {
        if (isOpaque()) throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This isn't a hierarchical URI.");
        if (key == null) throw new NullPointerException("key");
        if (mEncodedQuery == null) return Collections.emptyList();

        String encodedKey = encode(key, null);
        List<String> values = new ArrayList<>();
        int start = 0;

        do
        {
            int next = mEncodedQuery.indexOf('&', start);
            int end = next != -1 ? next : mEncodedQuery.length();

            int separator = mEncodedQuery.indexOf('=', start);
            if (separator > end || separator == -1) separator = end;

            if (separator - start == encodedKey.length() && mEncodedQuery.regionMatches(start, encodedKey, 0, encodedKey.length()))
            {
                values.add(separator == end ? "" : decode(mEncodedQuery.substring(separator + 1, end), true));
            }

            start = end + 1;
        }
        while (start < mEncodedQuery.length());

        return Collections.unmodifiableList(values);
    }

    public String getQueryParameter(String key)
    {
        if (isOpaque()) throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This isn't a hierarchical URI.");
        if (key == null) throw new NullPointerException("key");
        if (mEncodedQuery == null) return null;

        String encodedKey = encode(key, null);
        int length = mEncodedQuery.length();
        int start = 0;

        do
        {
            int nextAmpersand = mEncodedQuery.indexOf('&', start);
            int end = nextAmpersand != -1 ? nextAmpersand : length;

            int separator = mEncodedQuery.indexOf('=', start);
            if (separator > end || separator == -1) separator = end;

            if (separator - start == encodedKey.length() && mEncodedQuery.regionMatches(start, encodedKey, 0, encodedKey.length()))
            {
                return separator == end ? "" : decode(mEncodedQuery.substring(separator + 1, end), true);
            }

            if (nextAmpersand == -1) break;
            start = nextAmpersand + 1;
        }
        while (true);

        return null;
    }

    public boolean getBooleanQueryParameter(String key, boolean defaultValue)
    {
        String flag = getQueryParameter(key);
        if (flag == null) return defaultValue;

        flag = flag.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return !"false".equals(flag) && !"0".equals(flag);
    }

    public Builder buildUpon()
    {
        if (isOpaque())
        {
            return new Builder().scheme(mScheme).encodedOpaquePart(mEncodedOpaquePart).encodedFragment(mEncodedFragment);
        }

        return new Builder().scheme(mScheme).encodedAuthority(mEncodedAuthority).encodedPath(mEncodedPath)
                   .encodedQuery(mEncodedQuery).encodedFragment(mEncodedFragment);
    }

    public Uri normalizeScheme()
    {
        if (mScheme == null) return this;

        String lowered = mScheme.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (lowered.equals(mScheme)) return this;

        return buildUpon().scheme(lowered).build();
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeString(mText);
    }

    @Override
    public int compareTo(Uri other)
    {
        return mText.compareTo(other.mText);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        return other instanceof Uri && ((Uri)other).mText.equals(mText);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mText.hashCode();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mText;
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private String mScheme;
        private String mOpaquePart;
        private String mAuthority;
        private String mPath;
        private String mQuery;
        private String mFragment;

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public Builder scheme(String scheme)
        {
            mScheme = scheme;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder opaquePart(String opaquePart)
        {
            mOpaquePart = encode(opaquePart);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder encodedOpaquePart(String opaquePart)
        {
            mOpaquePart = opaquePart;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder authority(String authority)
        {
            mOpaquePart = null;
            mAuthority = encode(authority);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder encodedAuthority(String authority)
        {
            mOpaquePart = null;
            mAuthority = authority;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder path(String path)
        {
            mOpaquePart = null;
            mPath = encode(path, "/");
            return this;
        }

        public Builder encodedPath(String path)
        {
            mOpaquePart = null;
            mPath = path;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder appendPath(String newSegment)
        {
            return appendEncodedPath(encode(newSegment));
        }

        public Builder appendEncodedPath(String newSegment)
        {
            mOpaquePart = null;

            String oldPath = mPath == null ? "" : mPath;
            if (oldPath.isEmpty()) mPath = "/" + newSegment;
            else if (oldPath.charAt(oldPath.length() - 1) == '/') mPath = oldPath + newSegment;
            else mPath = oldPath + "/" + newSegment;

            return this;
        }

        public Builder query(String query)
        {
            mOpaquePart = null;
            mQuery = encode(query);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder encodedQuery(String query)
        {
            mOpaquePart = null;
            mQuery = query;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder fragment(String fragment)
        {
            mFragment = encode(fragment);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder encodedFragment(String fragment)
        {
            mFragment = fragment;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder appendQueryParameter(String key, String value)
        {
            mOpaquePart = null;

            String encodedParameter = encode(key, null) + "=" + encode(value, null);
            mQuery = mQuery == null ? encodedParameter : mQuery + "&" + encodedParameter;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder clearQuery()
        {
            mQuery = null;
            return this;
        }

        public Uri build()
        {
            if (mOpaquePart != null)
            {
                if (mScheme == null) throw new UnsupportedOperationException("An opaque URI must have a scheme.");
                return new Uri(mScheme, mOpaquePart, null, null, null, mFragment);
            }

            String path = mPath == null ? "" : mPath;
            if ((mScheme != null || mAuthority != null) && !path.isEmpty() && !path.startsWith("/")) path = "/" + path;

            return new Uri(mScheme, null, mAuthority, path, mQuery, mFragment);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return build().toString();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.net;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class UrlQuerySanitizer
{
    public class ParameterValuePair
    {
        public String mParameter;
        public String mValue;

        public ParameterValuePair(String parameter, String value)
        {
            mParameter = parameter;
            mValue = value;
        }
    }

    public interface ValueSanitizer
    {
        String sanitize(String value);
    }

    public static class IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer implements ValueSanitizer
    {
        public static final int SPACE_OK = 1 << 0;
        public static final int OTHER_WHITESPACE_OK = 1 << 1;
        public static final int NON_7_BIT_ASCII_OK = 1 << 2;
        public static final int DQUOTE_OK = 1 << 3;
        public static final int SQUOTE_OK = 1 << 4;
        public static final int LT_OK = 1 << 5;
        public static final int GT_OK = 1 << 6;
        public static final int AMP_OK = 1 << 7;
        public static final int PCT_OK = 1 << 8;
        public static final int NUL_OK = 1 << 9;
        public static final int SCRIPT_URL_OK = 1 << 10;
        public static final int ALL_OK = 0x7ff;
        public static final int ALL_WHITESPACE_OK = SPACE_OK | OTHER_WHITESPACE_OK;
        public static final int ALL_ILLEGAL = 0;
        public static final int ALL_BUT_NUL_LEGAL = ALL_OK & ~NUL_OK;
        public static final int ALL_BUT_WHITESPACE_LEGAL = ALL_OK & ~ALL_WHITESPACE_OK;
        public static final int URL_LEGAL = NON_7_BIT_ASCII_OK | DQUOTE_OK | SQUOTE_OK | AMP_OK | PCT_OK;
        public static final int URL_AND_SPACE_LEGAL = URL_LEGAL | SPACE_OK;
        public static final int AMP_LEGAL = AMP_OK;
        public static final int AMP_AND_SPACE_LEGAL = AMP_OK | SPACE_OK;
        public static final int SPACE_LEGAL = SPACE_OK;
        public static final int ALL_BUT_NUL_AND_ANGLE_BRACKETS_LEGAL = ALL_OK & ~(NUL_OK | LT_OK | GT_OK);

        private static final String JAVASCRIPT_PREFIX = "javascript:";
        private static final String VBSCRIPT_PREFIX = "vbscript:";
        private static final int MIN_SCRIPT_PREFIX_LENGTH = Math.min(JAVASCRIPT_PREFIX.length(), VBSCRIPT_PREFIX.length());

        private final int mFlags;

        public IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer(int flags)
        {
            mFlags = flags;
        }

        @Override
        public String sanitize(String value)
        {
            if (value == null) return null;

            int length = value.length();

            if ((mFlags & SCRIPT_URL_OK) == 0 && length >= MIN_SCRIPT_PREFIX_LENGTH)
            {
                String asLower = value.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                if (asLower.startsWith(JAVASCRIPT_PREFIX) || asLower.startsWith(VBSCRIPT_PREFIX)) return "";
            }

            if ((mFlags & ALL_WHITESPACE_OK) == 0)
            {
                value = trimWhitespace(value);
                length = value.length();
            }

            StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(length);

            for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
            {
                char character = value.charAt(index);
                if (!characterIsLegal(character))
                {
                    if ((mFlags & SPACE_OK) != 0) character = ' ';
                    else character = '_';
                }
                builder.append(character);
            }

            return builder.toString();
        }

        private String trimWhitespace(String value)
        {
            int start = 0;
            int last = value.length() - 1;
            int end = last;

            while (start <= end && isWhitespace(value.charAt(start)))
            {
                start++;
            }

            while (end >= start && isWhitespace(value.charAt(end)))
            {
                end--;
            }

            if (start == 0 && end == last) return value;

            return value.substring(start, end + 1);
        }

        private boolean isWhitespace(char character)
        {
            switch (character)
            {
                case ' ':
                case '\t':
                case '\f':
                case '\n':
                case '\r':
                case 11:
                    return true;
                default:
                    return false;
            }
        }

        private boolean characterIsLegal(char character)
        {
            switch (character)
            {
                case ' ':
                    return (mFlags & SPACE_OK) != 0;
                case '\t':
                case '\f':
                case '\n':
                case '\r':
                case 11:
                    return (mFlags & OTHER_WHITESPACE_OK) != 0;
                case '\"':
                    return (mFlags & DQUOTE_OK) != 0;
                case '\'':
                    return (mFlags & SQUOTE_OK) != 0;
                case '<':
                    return (mFlags & LT_OK) != 0;
                case '>':
                    return (mFlags & GT_OK) != 0;
                case '&':
                    return (mFlags & AMP_OK) != 0;
                case '%':
                    return (mFlags & PCT_OK) != 0;
                case '\0':
                    return (mFlags & NUL_OK) != 0;
                default:
                    return (character >= 32 && character < 127) || ((character >= 128) && ((mFlags & NON_7_BIT_ASCII_OK) != 0));
            }
        }
    }

    private static final ValueSanitizer ALL_ILLEGAL = new IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer(IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer.ALL_ILLEGAL);
    private static final ValueSanitizer ALL_BUT_NUL_LEGAL =
        new IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer(IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer.ALL_BUT_NUL_LEGAL);
    private static final ValueSanitizer ALL_BUT_WHITESPACE_LEGAL =
        new IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer(IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer.ALL_BUT_WHITESPACE_LEGAL);
    private static final ValueSanitizer URL_LEGAL = new IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer(IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer.URL_LEGAL);
    private static final ValueSanitizer URL_AND_SPACE_LEGAL =
        new IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer(IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer.URL_AND_SPACE_LEGAL);
    private static final ValueSanitizer AMP_LEGAL = new IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer(IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer.AMP_LEGAL);
    private static final ValueSanitizer AMP_AND_SPACE_LEGAL =
        new IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer(IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer.AMP_AND_SPACE_LEGAL);
    private static final ValueSanitizer SPACE_LEGAL = new IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer(IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer.SPACE_LEGAL);
    private static final ValueSanitizer ALL_BUT_NUL_AND_ANGLE_BRACKETS_LEGAL =
        new IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer(IllegalCharacterValueSanitizer.ALL_BUT_NUL_AND_ANGLE_BRACKETS_LEGAL);

    private final HashMap<String, ValueSanitizer> mSanitizers = new HashMap<>();
    private final HashMap<String, String> mEntries = new HashMap<>();
    private final ArrayList<ParameterValuePair> mEntriesList = new ArrayList<>();
    private boolean mAllowUnregisteredParamaters;
    private boolean mPreferFirstRepeatedParameter;
    private ValueSanitizer mUnregisteredParameterValueSanitizer = getAllIllegal();

    public UrlQuerySanitizer()
    {
    }

    public UrlQuerySanitizer(String url)
    {
        setAllowUnregisteredParamaters(true);
        parseUrl(url);
    }

    public ValueSanitizer getUnregisteredParameterValueSanitizer()
    {
        return mUnregisteredParameterValueSanitizer;
    }

    public void setUnregisteredParameterValueSanitizer(ValueSanitizer sanitizer)
    {
        mUnregisteredParameterValueSanitizer = sanitizer;
    }

    public static final ValueSanitizer getAllIllegal()
    {
        return ALL_ILLEGAL;
    }

    public static final ValueSanitizer getAllButNulLegal()
    {
        return ALL_BUT_NUL_LEGAL;
    }

    public static final ValueSanitizer getAllButWhitespaceLegal()
    {
        return ALL_BUT_WHITESPACE_LEGAL;
    }

    public static final ValueSanitizer getUrlLegal()
    {
        return URL_LEGAL;
    }

    public static final ValueSanitizer getUrlAndSpaceLegal()
    {
        return URL_AND_SPACE_LEGAL;
    }

    public static final ValueSanitizer getAmpLegal()

        return AMP_LEGAL;
    }

    public static final ValueSanitizer getAmpAndSpaceLegal()
    {
        return AMP_AND_SPACE_LEGAL;
    }

    public static final ValueSanitizer getSpaceLegal()
    {
        return SPACE_LEGAL;
    }

    public static final ValueSanitizer getAllButNulAndAngleBracketsLegal()
    {
        return ALL_BUT_NUL_AND_ANGLE_BRACKETS_LEGAL;
    }

    public void parseUrl(String url)
    {
        int queryIndex = url.indexOf('?');
        String query;

        if (queryIndex >= 0) query = url.substring(queryIndex + 1);
        else query = "";

        parseQuery(query);
    }

    public void parseQuery(String query)
    {
        clear();

        StringTokenizer tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(query, "&");

        while (tokenizer.hasMoreElements())
        {
            String attributeValuePair = tokenizer.nextToken();

            if (attributeValuePair.length() > 0)
            {
                int assignmentIndex = attributeValuePair.indexOf('=');

                if (assignmentIndex < 0)
                {
                    parseEntry(attributeValuePair, "");
                }
                else
                {
                    parseEntry(attributeValuePair.substring(0, assignmentIndex), attributeValuePair.substring(assignmentIndex + 1));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public Set<String> getParameterSet()
    {
        return mEntries.keySet();
    }

    public List<ParameterValuePair> getParameterList()
    {
        return mEntriesList;
    }

    public boolean hasParameter(String parameter)
    {
        return mEntries.containsKey(parameter);
    }

    public String getValue(String parameter)
    {
        return mEntries.get(parameter);
    }

    public void registerParameter(String parameter, ValueSanitizer valueSanitizer)
    {
        if (valueSanitizer == null) mSanitizers.remove(parameter);

        mSanitizers.put(parameter, valueSanitizer);
    }

    public void registerParameters(String[] parameters, ValueSanitizer valueSanitizer)
    {
        for (String parameter : parameters)
        {
            mSanitizers.put(parameter, valueSanitizer);
        }
    }

    public void setAllowUnregisteredParamaters(boolean allowUnregisteredParamaters)
    {
        mAllowUnregisteredParamaters = allowUnregisteredParamaters;
    }

    public boolean getAllowUnregisteredParamaters()
    {
        return mAllowUnregisteredParamaters;
    }

    public void setPreferFirstRepeatedParameter(boolean preferFirstRepeatedParameter)
    {
        mPreferFirstRepeatedParameter = preferFirstRepeatedParameter;
    }

    public boolean getPreferFirstRepeatedParameter()
    {
        return mPreferFirstRepeatedParameter;
    }

    protected void parseEntry(String parameter, String value)
    {
        String unescapedParameter = unescape(parameter);
        ValueSanitizer valueSanitizer = getEffectiveValueSanitizer(unescapedParameter);

        if (valueSanitizer == null) return;

        String unescapedValue = unescape(value);
        String sanitizedValue = valueSanitizer.sanitize(unescapedValue);
        addSanitizedEntry(unescapedParameter, sanitizedValue);
    }

    protected void addSanitizedEntry(String parameter, String value)
    {
        mEntriesList.add(new ParameterValuePair(parameter, value));

        if (mPreferFirstRepeatedParameter && mEntries.containsKey(parameter)) return;

        mEntries.put(parameter, value);
    }

    public ValueSanitizer getValueSanitizer(String parameter)
    {
        return mSanitizers.get(parameter);
    }

    public ValueSanitizer getEffectiveValueSanitizer(String parameter)
    {
        ValueSanitizer sanitizer = getValueSanitizer(parameter);

        if (sanitizer == null && mAllowUnregisteredParamaters) sanitizer = getUnregisteredParameterValueSanitizer();

        return sanitizer;
    }

    public String unescape(String string)
    {
        int firstEscape = -1;

        for (int index = 0; index < string.length(); index++)
        {
            char character = string.charAt(index);
            if (character == '+' || character == '%')
            {
                firstEscape = index;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (firstEscape == -1) return string;

        int length = string.length();
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(length);
        builder.append(string, 0, firstEscape);

        for (int index = firstEscape; index < length; index++)
        {
            char character = string.charAt(index);

            if (character == '+')
            {
                character = ' ';
            }
            else if (character == '%' && index + 2 < length)
            {
                char first = string.charAt(index + 1);
                char second = string.charAt(index + 2);

                if (isHexDigit(first) && isHexDigit(second))
                {
                    character = (char)(decodeHexDigit(first) * 16 + decodeHexDigit(second));
                    index += 2;
                }
            }

            builder.append(character);
        }

        return builder.toString();
    }

    protected boolean isHexDigit(char character)
    {
        return decodeHexDigit(character) >= 0;
    }

    protected int decodeHexDigit(char character)
    {
        if (character >= '0' && character <= '9') return character - '0';
        if (character >= 'A' && character <= 'F') return character - 'A' + 10;
        if (character >= 'a' && character <= 'f') return character - 'a' + 10;

        return -1;
    }

    protected void clear()
    {
        mEntries.clear();
        mEntriesList.clear();
    }
}
```

`java/android/net/http/SslCertificate.java`:

```java
package android.net.http;

import android.os.Bundle;
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.security.cert.CertificateEncodingException;
import java.security.cert.CertificateFactory;
import java.security.cert.X509Certificate;
import java.text.ParseException;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

public class SslCertificate
{
    private static final String ISO_8601_DATE_FORMAT = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ssZ";
    private static final String ISSUED_TO = "issued-to";
    private static final String ISSUED_BY = "issued-by";
    private static final String VALID_NOT_BEFORE = "valid-not-before";
    private static final String VALID_NOT_AFTER = "valid-not-after";
    private static final String X509_CERTIFICATE = "x509-certificate";

    private final DName mIssuedTo;
    private final DName mIssuedBy;
    private final Date mValidNotBefore;
    private final Date mValidNotAfter;
    private final X509Certificate mX509Certificate;

    @Deprecated
    public SslCertificate(String issuedTo, String issuedBy, String validNotBefore, String validNotAfter)
    {
        this(issuedTo, issuedBy, parseDate(validNotBefore), parseDate(validNotAfter), null);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public SslCertificate(String issuedTo, String issuedBy, Date validNotBefore, Date validNotAfter)
    {
        this(issuedTo, issuedBy, validNotBefore, validNotAfter, null);
    }

    public SslCertificate(X509Certificate certificate)
    {
        this(certificate.getSubjectDN().getName(), certificate.getIssuerDN().getName(), certificate.getNotBefore(),
            certificate.getNotAfter(), certificate);
    }

    private SslCertificate(String issuedTo, String issuedBy, Date validNotBefore, Date validNotAfter, X509Certificate certificate)
    {
        mIssuedTo = new DName(issuedTo);
        mIssuedBy = new DName(issuedBy);
        mValidNotBefore = cloneDate(validNotBefore);
        mValidNotAfter = cloneDate(validNotAfter);
        mX509Certificate = certificate;
    }

    public static Bundle saveState(SslCertificate certificate)
    {
        if (certificate == null) return null;
        Bundle bundle = new Bundle();
        bundle.putString(ISSUED_TO, certificate.getIssuedTo().getDName());
        bundle.putString(ISSUED_BY, certificate.getIssuedBy().getDName());
        bundle.putString(VALID_NOT_BEFORE, certificate.getValidNotBefore());
        bundle.putString(VALID_NOT_AFTER, certificate.getValidNotAfter());
        X509Certificate x509Certificate = certificate.mX509Certificate;
        if (x509Certificate != null)
        {
            try
            {
                bundle.putByteArray(X509_CERTIFICATE, x509Certificate.getEncoded());
            }
            catch (CertificateEncodingException ignored)
            {
            }
        }
        return bundle;
    }

    public static SslCertificate restoreState(Bundle bundle)
    {
        if (bundle == null) return null;
        X509Certificate x509Certificate = null;
        byte[] bytes = bundle.getByteArray(X509_CERTIFICATE);
        if (bytes != null)
        {
            try
            {
                CertificateFactory factory = CertificateFactory.getInstance("X.509");
                x509Certificate = (X509Certificate)factory.generateCertificate(new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes));
            }
            catch (Exception ignored)
            {
            }
        }
        return new SslCertificate(bundle.getString(ISSUED_TO), bundle.getString(ISSUED_BY),
            parseDate(bundle.getString(VALID_NOT_BEFORE)), parseDate(bundle.getString(VALID_NOT_AFTER)), x509Certificate);
    }

    public Date getValidNotBeforeDate()
    {
        return cloneDate(mValidNotBefore);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public String getValidNotBefore()
    {
        return formatDate(mValidNotBefore);
    }

    public Date getValidNotAfterDate()
    {
        return cloneDate(mValidNotAfter);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public String getValidNotAfter()
    {
        return formatDate(mValidNotAfter);
    }

    public DName getIssuedTo()
    {
        return mIssuedTo;
    }

    public DName getIssuedBy()
    {
        return mIssuedBy;
    }

    public X509Certificate getX509Certificate()
    {
        return mX509Certificate;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Issued to: " + mIssuedTo.getDName() + ";\n" + "Issued by: " + mIssuedBy.getDName() + ";\n";
    }

    private static Date parseDate(String string)
    {
        if (string == null) return null;
        try
        {
            return new SimpleDateFormat(ISO_8601_DATE_FORMAT, Locale.US).parse(string);
        }
        catch (ParseException exception)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static String formatDate(Date date)
    {
        if (date == null) return "";
        return new SimpleDateFormat(ISO_8601_DATE_FORMAT, Locale.US).format(date);
    }

    private static Date cloneDate(Date date)
    {
        if (date == null) return null;
        return (Date)date.clone();
    }

    public class DName
    {
        private String mDName;
        private String mCName;
        private String mOName;
        private String mUName;

        public DName(String dName)
        {
            if (dName == null) return;
            mDName = dName;
            for (String component : splitComponents(dName))
            {
                int equals = component.indexOf('=');
                if (equals <= 0) continue;
                String key = component.substring(0, equals).trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
                String value = unescape(component.substring(equals + 1).trim());
                if (("CN".equals(key) || "2.5.4.3".equals(key)) && mCName == null) mCName = value;
                if (("O".equals(key) || "2.5.4.10".equals(key)) && mOName == null) mOName = value;
                if (("OU".equals(key) || "2.5.4.11".equals(key)) && mUName == null) mUName = value;
            }
        }

        public String getDName()
        {
            return mDName != null ? mDName : "";
        }

        public String getCName()
        {
            return mCName != null ? mCName : "";
        }

        public String getOName()
        {
            return mOName != null ? mOName : "";
        }

        public String getUName()
        {
            return mUName != null ? mUName : "";
        }

        private List<String> splitComponents(String name)
        {
            List<String> components = new ArrayList<>();
            StringBuilder current = new StringBuilder();
            boolean quoted = false;
            for (int index = 0; index < name.length(); index++)
            {
                char character = name.charAt(index);
                if (character == '\\' && index + 1 < name.length())
                {
                    current.append(character).append(name.charAt(++index));
                    continue;
                }
                if (character == '"') quoted = !quoted;
                if (!quoted && (character == ',' || character == ';' || character == '+'))
                {
                    components.add(current.toString());
                    current.setLength(0);
                    continue;
                }
                current.append(character);
            }
            if (current.length() > 0) components.add(current.toString());
            return components;
        }

        private String unescape(String value)
        {
            if (value.length() >= 2 && value.startsWith("\"") && value.endsWith("\""))
            {
                value = value.substring(1, value.length() - 1);
            }
            StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(value.length());
            for (int index = 0; index < value.length(); index++)
            {
                char character = value.charAt(index);
                if (character == '\\' && index + 1 < value.length()) character = value.charAt(++index);
                builder.append(character);
            }
            return builder.toString();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.net.http;

import java.security.cert.X509Certificate;

public class SslError
{
    public static final int SSL_NOTYETVALID = 0;
    public static final int SSL_EXPIRED = 1;
    public static final int SSL_IDMISMATCH = 2;
    public static final int SSL_UNTRUSTED = 3;
    public static final int SSL_DATE_INVALID = 4;
    public static final int SSL_INVALID = 5;
    @Deprecated
    public static final int SSL_MAX_ERROR = 6;

    private int mErrors;
    private final SslCertificate mCertificate;
    private final String mUrl;

    @Deprecated
    public SslError(int error, SslCertificate certificate)
    {
        this(error, certificate, "");
    }

    @Deprecated
    public SslError(int error, X509Certificate certificate)
    {
        this(error, certificate, "");
    }

    public SslError(int error, SslCertificate certificate, String url)
    {
        if (certificate == null) throw new NullPointerException("certificate is null");
        if (url == null) throw new NullPointerException("url is null");
        addError(error);
        mCertificate = certificate;
        mUrl = url;
    }

    public SslError(int error, X509Certificate certificate, String url)
    {
        this(error, new SslCertificate(certificate), url);
    }

    public SslCertificate getCertificate()
    {
        return mCertificate;
    }

    public String getUrl()
    {
        return mUrl;
    }

    public boolean addError(int error)
    {
        boolean valid = error >= 0 && error < SSL_MAX_ERROR;
        if (valid) mErrors |= 1 << error;
        return valid;
    }

    public boolean hasError(int error)
    {
        if (error < 0 || error >= SSL_MAX_ERROR) return false;
        return (mErrors & (1 << error)) != 0;
    }

    public int getPrimaryError()
    {
        for (int error = SSL_MAX_ERROR - 1; error >= 0; error--)
        {
            if ((mErrors & (1 << error)) != 0) return error;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "primary error: " + getPrimaryError() + " certificate: " + getCertificate() + " on URL: " + getUrl();
    }
}
```

`java/android/net/nsd/NsdManager.java`:

```java
package android.net.nsd;

import android.content.Context;
import android.net.Network;
import android.net.NetworkRequest;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;

public final class NsdManager
{
    public static final String ACTION_NSD_STATE_CHANGED = "android.net.nsd.STATE_CHANGED";
    public static final String EXTRA_NSD_STATE = "nsd_state";
    public static final int FAILURE_INTERNAL_ERROR = 0;
    public static final int FAILURE_ALREADY_ACTIVE = 3;
    public static final int FAILURE_MAX_LIMIT = 4;
    public static final int FAILURE_OPERATION_NOT_RUNNING = 5;
    public static final int FAILURE_BAD_PARAMETERS = 6;
    public static final int NSD_STATE_DISABLED = 1;
    public static final int NSD_STATE_ENABLED = 2;
    public static final int PROTOCOL_DNS_SD = 1;

    private final Context mContext;
    private final Map<DiscoveryListener, String> mActiveListeners = new HashMap<>();

    public NsdManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public interface RegistrationListener
    {
        void onRegistrationFailed(NsdServiceInfo serviceInfo, int errorCode);

        void onUnregistrationFailed(NsdServiceInfo serviceInfo, int errorCode);

        void onServiceRegistered(NsdServiceInfo serviceInfo);

        void onServiceUnregistered(NsdServiceInfo serviceInfo);
    }

    public interface DiscoveryListener
    {
        void onStartDiscoveryFailed(String serviceType, int errorCode);

        void onStopDiscoveryFailed(String serviceType, int errorCode);

        void onDiscoveryStarted(String serviceType);

        void onDiscoveryStopped(String serviceType);

        void onServiceFound(NsdServiceInfo serviceInfo);

        void onServiceLost(NsdServiceInfo serviceInfo);
    }

    public interface ResolveListener
    {
        void onResolveFailed(NsdServiceInfo serviceInfo, int errorCode);

        void onServiceResolved(NsdServiceInfo serviceInfo);

        default void onResolutionStopped(NsdServiceInfo serviceInfo)
        {
        }

        default void onStopResolutionFailed(NsdServiceInfo serviceInfo, int errorCode)
        {
        }
    }

    public void registerService(NsdServiceInfo serviceInfo, int protocolType, RegistrationListener listener)
    {
        registerService(serviceInfo, protocolType, mainExecutor(), listener);
    }

    public void registerService(final NsdServiceInfo serviceInfo, int protocolType, Executor executor,
                                final RegistrationListener listener)
    {
        checkProtocol(protocolType);
        if (serviceInfo == null || listener == null || executor == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null argument");

        executor.execute(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                listener.onRegistrationFailed(serviceInfo, FAILURE_INTERNAL_ERROR);
            }
        });
    }

    public void unregisterService(RegistrationListener listener)
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener cannot be null");

        throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener not registered");
    }

    public void discoverServices(String serviceType, int protocolType, DiscoveryListener listener)
    {
        discoverServices(serviceType, protocolType, (Network)null, mainExecutor(), listener);
    }

    public void discoverServices(final String serviceType, int protocolType, Network network, Executor executor,
                                 final DiscoveryListener listener)
    {
        if (serviceType == null || serviceType.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Service type cannot be empty");
        if (listener == null || executor == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null argument");

        checkProtocol(protocolType);

        synchronized (mActiveListeners)
        {
            if (mActiveListeners.containsKey(listener)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener already in use");

            mActiveListeners.put(listener, serviceType);
        }

        executor.execute(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                listener.onDiscoveryStarted(serviceType);
            }
        });
    }

    public void discoverServices(String serviceType, int protocolType, NetworkRequest networkRequest, Executor executor,
                                 DiscoveryListener listener)
    {
        discoverServices(serviceType, protocolType, (Network)null, executor, listener);
    }

    public void stopServiceDiscovery(final DiscoveryListener listener)
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener cannot be null");

        final String serviceType;
        synchronized (mActiveListeners)
        {
            if (!mActiveListeners.containsKey(listener)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener not registered");

            serviceType = mActiveListeners.remove(listener);
        }

        mainExecutor().execute(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                listener.onDiscoveryStopped(serviceType);
            }
        });
    }

    @Deprecated
    public void resolveService(NsdServiceInfo serviceInfo, ResolveListener listener)
    {
        resolveService(serviceInfo, mainExecutor(), listener);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public void resolveService(final NsdServiceInfo serviceInfo, Executor executor, final ResolveListener listener)
    {
        if (serviceInfo == null || listener == null || executor == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null argument");

        executor.execute(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                listener.onResolveFailed(serviceInfo, FAILURE_INTERNAL_ERROR);
            }
        });
    }

    public void stopServiceResolution(ResolveListener listener)
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener cannot be null");

        throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener not registered");
    }

    private static void checkProtocol(int protocolType)
    {
        if (protocolType != PROTOCOL_DNS_SD) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported protocol");
    }

    private static Executor mainExecutor()
    {
        Looper main = Looper.getMainLooper();

        if (main == null)
        {
            return new Executor()
            {
                @Override
                public void execute(Runnable command)
                {
                    command.run();
                }
            };
        }

        final Handler handler = new Handler(main);
        return new Executor()
        {
            @Override
            public void execute(Runnable command)
            {
                handler.post(command);
            }
        };
    }
}
```

```java
package android.net.nsd;

import android.net.Network;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.UnknownHostException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public final class NsdServiceInfo implements Parcelable
{
    private String mServiceName;
    private String mServiceType;
    private final LinkedHashMap<String, byte[]> mAttributes = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final List<InetAddress> mHostAddresses = new ArrayList<>();
    private int mPort;
    private Network mNetwork;

    public NsdServiceInfo()
    {
    }

    public String getServiceName()
    {
        return mServiceName;
    }

    public void setServiceName(String serviceName)
    {
        mServiceName = serviceName;
    }

    public String getServiceType()
    {
        return mServiceType;
    }

    public void setServiceType(String serviceType)
    {
        mServiceType = serviceType;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public InetAddress getHost()
    {
        return mHostAddresses.isEmpty() ? null : mHostAddresses.get(0);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public void setHost(InetAddress host)
    {
        mHostAddresses.clear();
        if (host != null) mHostAddresses.add(host);
    }

    public int getPort()
    {
        return mPort;
    }

    public void setPort(int port)
    {
        mPort = port;
    }

    public List<InetAddress> getHostAddresses()
    {
        return new ArrayList<>(mHostAddresses);
    }

    public void setHostAddresses(List<InetAddress> addresses)
    {
        mHostAddresses.clear();
        mHostAddresses.addAll(addresses);
    }

    public void setAttribute(String key, String value)
    {
        if (key == null || key.isEmpty() || key.indexOf('=') >= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid attribute key " + key);
        if (key.length() > 9) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Key lengths > 9 are discouraged: " + key);

        byte[] bytes = value == null ? null : value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        mAttributes.put(key, bytes);
    }

    public void removeAttribute(String key)
    {
        mAttributes.remove(key);
    }

    public Map<String, byte[]> getAttributes()
    {
        return Collections.unmodifiableMap(mAttributes);
    }

    public Network getNetwork()
    {
        return mNetwork;
    }

    public void setNetwork(Network network)
    {
        mNetwork = network;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        builder.append("name: ").append(mServiceName);
        builder.append(", type: ").append(mServiceType);
        builder.append(", hostAddresses: ").append(mHostAddresses);
        builder.append(", port: ").append(mPort);
        builder.append(", network: ").append(mNetwork);
        return builder.toString();
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mServiceName);
        dest.writeString(mServiceType);
        dest.writeInt(mPort);
        dest.writeInt(mHostAddresses.size());

        for (InetAddress address : mHostAddresses)
        {
            dest.writeString(address.getHostAddress());
        }

        dest.writeInt(mAttributes.size());

        for (Map.Entry<String, byte[]> entry : mAttributes.entrySet())
        {
            dest.writeString(entry.getKey());
            dest.writeString(entry.getValue() == null ? null : new String(entry.getValue(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        }
    }

    public static final Creator<NsdServiceInfo> CREATOR = new Creator<NsdServiceInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public NsdServiceInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            NsdServiceInfo info = new NsdServiceInfo();
            info.mServiceName = source.readString();
            info.mServiceType = source.readString();
            info.mPort = source.readInt();

            int addressCount = source.readInt();
            for (int index = 0; index < addressCount; index++)
            {
                String address = source.readString();

                try
                {
                    info.mHostAddresses.add(InetAddress.getByName(address));
                }
                catch (UnknownHostException malformed)
                {
                    android.util.Log.w("NsdServiceInfo", "dropped the unparsable address " + address);
                }
            }

            int attributeCount = source.readInt();
            for (int index = 0; index < attributeCount; index++)
            {
                String key = source.readString();
                String value = source.readString();
                info.mAttributes.put(key, value == null ? null : value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            }

            return info;
        }

        @Override
        public NsdServiceInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new NsdServiceInfo[size];
        }
    };
}
```

```java
    public static int convertChannelToFrequencyMhzIfSupported(int channel, int band)
    {
        if (band == WIFI_BAND_24_GHZ)
        {
            if (channel == 14) return 2484;
            if (channel >= 1 && channel <= 13) return 2407 + channel * 5;

            return UNSPECIFIED;
        }

        if (band == WIFI_BAND_5_GHZ)
        {
            if (channel >= 32 && channel <= 177) return 5000 + channel * 5;

            return UNSPECIFIED;
        }

        if (band == WIFI_BAND_6_GHZ)
        {
            if (channel == 2) return 5935;
            if (channel >= 1 && channel <= 233) return 5950 + channel * 5;

            return UNSPECIFIED;
        }

        if (band == WIFI_BAND_60_GHZ)
        {
            if (channel >= 1 && channel <= 6) return 58320 + (channel - 1) * 2160;

            return UNSPECIFIED;
        }

        return UNSPECIFIED;
    }

    public static int convertFrequencyMhzToChannelIfSupported(int frequencyMhz)
    {
        if (frequencyMhz == 2484) return 14;
        if (frequencyMhz >= 2412 && frequencyMhz <= 2472) return (frequencyMhz - 2407) / 5;
        if (frequencyMhz >= 5160 && frequencyMhz <= 5885) return (frequencyMhz - 5000) / 5;
        if (frequencyMhz == 5935) return 2;
        if (frequencyMhz >= 5955 && frequencyMhz <= 7115) return (frequencyMhz - 5950) / 5;
        if (frequencyMhz >= 58320 && frequencyMhz <= 70200) return (frequencyMhz - 58320) / 2160 + 1;

        return UNSPECIFIED;
    }

    public List<InformationElement> getInformationElements()
    {
        return new ArrayList<>(mInformationElements);
    }

    public int[] getSecurityTypes()
    {
        return new int[0];
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "SSID: " + (SSID == null ? WifiManager.UNKNOWN_SSID : SSID) + ", BSSID: " + (BSSID == null ? "<none>" : BSSID)
            + ", capabilities: " + (capabilities == null ? "<none>" : capabilities) + ", level: " + level + ", frequency: " + frequency
            + ", timestamp: " + timestamp;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(SSID);
        dest.writeString(BSSID);
        dest.writeString(capabilities);
        dest.writeInt(level);
        dest.writeInt(frequency);
        dest.writeLong(timestamp);
        dest.writeInt(channelWidth);
        dest.writeInt(centerFreq0);
        dest.writeInt(centerFreq1);
        dest.writeString(operatorFriendlyName == null ? null : operatorFriendlyName.toString());
        dest.writeString(venueName == null ? null : venueName.toString());
        dest.writeInt(mWifiStandard);
        dest.writeInt(mIs80211mcResponder ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeInt(mIsPasspointNetwork ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeInt(mInformationElements.size());

        for (InformationElement element : mInformationElements)
        {
            element.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        }
    }

    public static final Creator<ScanResult> CREATOR = new Creator<ScanResult>()
    {
        @Override
        public ScanResult createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            ScanResult result = new ScanResult();
            result.SSID = source.readString();
            result.BSSID = source.readString();
            result.capabilities = source.readString();
            result.level = source.readInt();
            result.frequency = source.readInt();
            result.timestamp = source.readLong();
            result.channelWidth = source.readInt();
            result.centerFreq0 = source.readInt();
            result.centerFreq1 = source.readInt();
            result.operatorFriendlyName = source.readString();
            result.venueName = source.readString();
            result.mWifiStandard = source.readInt();
            result.mIs80211mcResponder = source.readInt() != 0;
            result.mIsPasspointNetwork = source.readInt() != 0;

            int count = source.readInt();
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                result.mInformationElements.add(InformationElement.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source));
            }

            return result;
        }

        @Override
        public ScanResult[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ScanResult[size];
        }
    };

    public static class InformationElement implements Parcelable
    {
        private final int mId;
        private final int mIdExt;
        private final byte[] mBytes;

        public InformationElement(int id, int idExt, byte[] bytes)
        {
            mId = id;
            mIdExt = idExt;
            mBytes = bytes == null ? new byte[0] : bytes.clone();
        }

        public InformationElement(InformationElement source)
        {
            this(source.mId, source.mIdExt, source.mBytes);
        }

        public int getId()
        {
            return mId;
        }

        public int getIdExt()
        {
            return mIdExt;
        }

        public ByteBuffer getBytes()
        {
            return ByteBuffer.wrap(mBytes).asReadOnlyBuffer();
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
        {
            dest.writeInt(mId);
            dest.writeInt(mIdExt);
            dest.writeInt(mBytes.length);

            for (byte value : mBytes)
            {
                dest.writeInt(value);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object other)
        {
            if (this == other) return true;
            if (!(other instanceof InformationElement)) return false;

            InformationElement element = (InformationElement)other;
            return mId == element.mId && mIdExt == element.mIdExt && Arrays.equals(mBytes, element.mBytes);
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return 31 * (31 * mId + mIdExt) + Arrays.hashCode(mBytes);
        }

        public static final Creator<InformationElement> CREATOR = new Creator<InformationElement>()
        {
            @Override
            public InformationElement createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                int id = source.readInt();
                int idExt = source.readInt();
                byte[] bytes = new byte[source.readInt()];

                for (int index = 0; index < bytes.length; index++)
                {
                    bytes[index] = (byte)source.readInt();
                }

                return new InformationElement(id, idExt, bytes);
            }

            @Override
            public InformationElement[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new InformationElement[size];
            }
        };
    }
}
```

```java
package android.net.wifi;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public enum SupplicantState implements Parcelable
{
    DISCONNECTED,
    INTERFACE_DISABLED,
    INACTIVE,
    SCANNING,
    AUTHENTICATING,
    ASSOCIATING,
    ASSOCIATED,
    FOUR_WAY_HANDSHAKE,
    GROUP_HANDSHAKE,
    COMPLETED,
    DORMANT,
    UNINITIALIZED,
    INVALID;

    public static boolean isValidState(SupplicantState state)
    {
        return state != UNINITIALIZED && state != INVALID;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(name());
    }

    public static final Creator<SupplicantState> CREATOR = new Creator<SupplicantState>()
    {
        @Override
        public SupplicantState createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return SupplicantState.valueOf(source.readString());
        }

        @Override
        public SupplicantState[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new SupplicantState[size];
        }
    };
}
```

```java
    private static <T> void deliver(Executor executor, final Consumer<T> callback, final T value)
    {
        if (executor == null || callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("executor and callback must not be null");

        executor.execute(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                callback.accept(value);
            }
        });
    }

    public class WifiLock
    {
        private final String mTag;
        private final int mLockType;
        private int mRefCount;
        private boolean mRefCounted = true;
        private boolean mHeld;
        private WorkSource mWorkSource;

        private WifiLock(int lockType, String tag)
        {
            mTag = tag;
            mLockType = lockType;
        }

        public void acquire()
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                if (mRefCounted ? (++mRefCount == 1) : (!mHeld)) mHeld = true;
            }
        }

        public void release()
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                if (mRefCounted ? (--mRefCount == 0) : (mHeld))
                {
                    mHeld = false;
                }

                if (mRefCount < 0) throw new RuntimeException("WifiLock under-locked " + mTag);
            }
        }

        public void setReferenceCounted(boolean refCounted)
        {
            mRefCounted = refCounted;
        }

        public boolean isHeld()
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                return mHeld;
            }
        }

        public void setWorkSource(WorkSource workSource)
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                mWorkSource = workSource;
            }
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                return "WifiLock{ " + mTag + " type=" + mLockType + " refcounted=" + mRefCounted + " held=" + mHeld + " refcount="
                    + mRefCount + " }";
            }
        }
    }

    public class MulticastLock
    {
        private final String mTag;
        private int mRefCount;
        private boolean mRefCounted = true;
        private boolean mHeld;

        private MulticastLock(String tag)
        {
            mTag = tag;
        }

        public void acquire()
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                if (mRefCounted ? (++mRefCount == 1) : (!mHeld)) mHeld = true;
            }
        }

        public void release()
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                if (mRefCounted ? (--mRefCount == 0) : (mHeld))
                {
                    mHeld = false;
                }

                if (mRefCount < 0) throw new RuntimeException("MulticastLock under-locked " + mTag);
            }
        }

        public void setReferenceCounted(boolean refCounted)
        {
            mRefCounted = refCounted;
        }

        public boolean isHeld()
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                return mHeld;
            }
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                return "MulticastLock{ " + mTag + "; refcounted=" + mRefCounted + "; held=" + mHeld + "; refcount=" + mRefCount + " }";
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.net.wifi.p2p;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public class WifiP2pGroup implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int NETWORK_ID_TEMPORARY = -1;
    public static final int NETWORK_ID_PERSISTENT = -2;

    private String mNetworkName;
    private boolean mIsGroupOwner;
    private String mPassphrase;
    private String mInterface;
    private int mNetworkId = NETWORK_ID_TEMPORARY;
    private int mFrequency;

    public WifiP2pGroup()
    {
    }

    public WifiP2pGroup(WifiP2pGroup source)
    {
        if (source == null) return;

        mNetworkName = source.mNetworkName;
        mIsGroupOwner = source.mIsGroupOwner;
        mPassphrase = source.mPassphrase;
        mInterface = source.mInterface;
        mNetworkId = source.mNetworkId;
        mFrequency = source.mFrequency;
    }

    public String getNetworkName()
    {
        return mNetworkName;
    }

    public boolean isGroupOwner()
    {
        return mIsGroupOwner;
    }

    public String getPassphrase()
    {
        return mPassphrase;
    }

    public String getInterface()
    {
        return mInterface;
    }

    public int getNetworkId()
    {
        return mNetworkId;
    }

    public int getFrequency()
    {
        return mFrequency;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "network: " + mNetworkName + "\n isGO: " + mIsGroupOwner + "\n interface: " + mInterface + "\n networkId: " + mNetworkId
            + "\n frequency: " + mFrequency;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mNetworkName);
        dest.writeInt(mIsGroupOwner ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeString(mPassphrase);
        dest.writeString(mInterface);
        dest.writeInt(mNetworkId);
        dest.writeInt(mFrequency);
    }

    public static final Creator<WifiP2pGroup> CREATOR = new Creator<WifiP2pGroup>()
    {
        @Override
        public WifiP2pGroup createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            WifiP2pGroup group = new WifiP2pGroup();
            group.mNetworkName = source.readString();
            group.mIsGroupOwner = source.readInt() != 0;
            group.mPassphrase = source.readString();
            group.mInterface = source.readString();
            group.mNetworkId = source.readInt();
            group.mFrequency = source.readInt();
            return group;
        }

        @Override
        public WifiP2pGroup[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new WifiP2pGroup[size];
        }
    };
}
```

```java
package android.nfc;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class AvailableNfcAntenna implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<AvailableNfcAntenna> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<AvailableNfcAntenna>()
    {
        @Override
        public AvailableNfcAntenna createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int locationX = source.readInt();
            int locationY = source.readInt();
            return new AvailableNfcAntenna(locationX, locationY);
        }

        @Override
        public AvailableNfcAntenna[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new AvailableNfcAntenna[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mLocationX;
    private final int mLocationY;

    public AvailableNfcAntenna(int locationX, int locationY)
    {
        mLocationX = locationX;
        mLocationY = locationY;
    }

    public int getLocationX()
    {
        return mLocationX;
    }

    public int getLocationY()
    {
        return mLocationY;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof AvailableNfcAntenna)) return false;

        AvailableNfcAntenna antenna = (AvailableNfcAntenna)other;
        return mLocationX == antenna.mLocationX && mLocationY == antenna.mLocationY;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return 31 * mLocationX + mLocationY;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "AvailableNfcAntenna x: " + mLocationX + " y: " + mLocationY;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mLocationX);
        dest.writeInt(mLocationY);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.nfc;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

public final class NfcAntennaInfo implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<NfcAntennaInfo> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<NfcAntennaInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public NfcAntennaInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int deviceWidth = source.readInt();
            int deviceHeight = source.readInt();
            boolean deviceFoldable = source.readBoolean();
            int count = source.readInt();
            List<AvailableNfcAntenna> antennas = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) antennas.add(AvailableNfcAntenna.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source));
            return new NfcAntennaInfo(deviceWidth, deviceHeight, deviceFoldable, antennas);
        }

        @Override
        public NfcAntennaInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new NfcAntennaInfo[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mDeviceWidth;
    private final int mDeviceHeight;
    private final boolean mDeviceFoldable;
    private final List<AvailableNfcAntenna> mAvailableNfcAntennas;

    public NfcAntennaInfo(int deviceWidth, int deviceHeight, boolean deviceFoldable, List<AvailableNfcAntenna> availableNfcAntennas)
    {
        mDeviceWidth = deviceWidth;
        mDeviceHeight = deviceHeight;
        mDeviceFoldable = deviceFoldable;
        mAvailableNfcAntennas = availableNfcAntennas == null ? new ArrayList<>() : new ArrayList<>(availableNfcAntennas);
    }

    public int getDeviceWidth()
    {
        return mDeviceWidth;
    }

    public int getDeviceHeight()
    {
        return mDeviceHeight;
    }

    public boolean isDeviceFoldable()
    {
        return mDeviceFoldable;
    }

    public List<AvailableNfcAntenna> getAvailableNfcAntennas()
    {
        return Collections.unmodifiableList(mAvailableNfcAntennas);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mDeviceWidth);
        dest.writeInt(mDeviceHeight);
        dest.writeBoolean(mDeviceFoldable);
        dest.writeInt(mAvailableNfcAntennas.size());
        for (AvailableNfcAntenna antenna : mAvailableNfcAntennas) antenna.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
    }
}
```

```java
        public Tag createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            byte[] id = source.createByteArray();
            int count = source.readInt();
            String[] techList = new String[Math.max(0, count)];
            for (int index = 0; index < techList.length; index++) techList[index] = source.readString();
            return new Tag(id, techList);
        }

        @Override
        public Tag[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Tag[size];
        }
    };

    private final byte[] mId;
    private final String[] mTechList;

    Tag(byte[] id, String[] techList)
    {
        mId = id == null ? new byte[0] : id;
        mTechList = techList == null ? new String[0] : techList;
    }

    public byte[] getId()
    {
        return mId;
    }

    public String[] getTechList()
    {
        return mTechList;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "TAG: Tech " + Arrays.toString(mTechList);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeByteArray(mId);
        dest.writeInt(mTechList.length);
        for (String tech : mTechList) dest.writeString(tech);
    }
}
```

```java
    public static boolean eglInitialize(EGLDisplay display, int[] major, int majorOffset, int[] minor, int minorOffset)

    {
        RuntimeEglBridge.checkOutput(numConfig, numConfigOffset, 1, "numConfig");
        if (configs != null) RuntimeEglBridge.checkOutput(configs, configsOffset, configSize, "configs");

        javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGLConfig[] found = configs == null ? null : RuntimeEglBridge.configArray(configSize);
        int[] count = new int[1];
        if (!RuntimeEglBridge.EGL.eglGetConfigs(RuntimeEglBridge.display(display), found, configSize, count)) return false;

        numConfig[numConfigOffset] = count[0];
        if (configs != null)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < count[0]; index++) configs[configsOffset + index] = RuntimeEglBridge.wrap(found[index]);
        }
        return true;
```

```java
    {
        RuntimeEglBridge.checkOutput(value, offset, 1, "value");
        if (sync == null) return false;

        switch (attribute)
        {
            case EGL_SYNC_STATUS:
                value[offset] = EGL_SIGNALED;
                return true;
            case EGL_SYNC_TYPE:
                value[offset] = EGL_SYNC_FENCE;
                return true;
            case EGL_SYNC_CONDITION:
                value[offset] = EGL_SYNC_PRIOR_COMMANDS_COMPLETE;
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }
```

```java
package android.opengl;
```

```java
package android.opengl;

import android.hardware.SyncFence;
import android.os.Parcel;

public class EGLExt
{
    public static final int EGL_CONTEXT_MAJOR_VERSION_KHR = 0x3098;
    public static final int EGL_CONTEXT_MINOR_VERSION_KHR = 0x30FB;
    public static final int EGL_CONTEXT_FLAGS_KHR = 0x30FC;
    public static final int EGL_OPENGL_ES3_BIT_KHR = 0x0040;
    public static final int EGL_RECORDABLE_ANDROID = 0x3142;
    public static final int EGL_SYNC_NATIVE_FENCE_ANDROID = 0x3144;
    public static final int EGL_SYNC_NATIVE_FENCE_FD_ANDROID = 0x3145;
    public static final int EGL_SYNC_NATIVE_FENCE_SIGNALED_ANDROID = 0x3146;
    public static final int EGL_NO_NATIVE_FENCE_FD_ANDROID = -1;

    public EGLExt()
    {
    }

    public static boolean eglPresentationTimeANDROID(EGLDisplay display, EGLSurface surface, long time)
    {
        return RuntimeEglBridge.surface(surface) != null;
    }

    public static SyncFence eglDupNativeFenceFDANDROID(EGLDisplay display, EGLSync sync)
    {
        Parcel parcel = Parcel.obtain();
        try
        {
            parcel.writeBoolean(false);
            parcel.writeLong(SyncFence.SIGNAL_TIME_INVALID);
            parcel.setDataPosition(0);
            return SyncFence.CREATOR.createFromParcel(parcel);
        }
        finally
        {
            parcel.recycle();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.opengl;

public abstract class EGLObjectHandle
{
    private final long mHandle;

    @Deprecated
    protected EGLObjectHandle(int handle)
    {
        mHandle = handle;
    }

    protected EGLObjectHandle(long handle)
    {
        mHandle = handle;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public int getHandle()
    {
        if ((mHandle & 0xFFFFFFFFL) != mHandle) throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
        return (int) mHandle;
    }

    public long getNativeHandle()
    {
        return mHandle;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        int result = 17;
        result = 31 * result + (int) (mHandle ^ (mHandle >>> 32));
        return result;
    }
}
```
