`java/android/opengl/Matrix.java`:

```java
package android.opengl;

public class Matrix
{
    private static final ThreadLocal<float[]> sTemporary = new ThreadLocal<float[]>()
    {
        @Override
        protected float[] initialValue()
        {
            return new float[32];
        }
    };

    @Deprecated
    public Matrix()
    {
    }

    private static void checkMatrix(float[] matrix, int offset, String name)
    {
        if (matrix == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " == null");
        if (offset < 0 || offset + 16 > matrix.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " offset out of bounds");
    }

    private static void checkVector(float[] vector, int offset, String name)
    {
        if (vector == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " == null");
        if (offset < 0 || offset + 4 > vector.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " offset out of bounds");
    }

    public static void multiplyMM(float[] result, int resultOffset, float[] lhs, int lhsOffset, float[] rhs, int rhsOffset)
    {
        checkMatrix(result, resultOffset, "result");
        checkMatrix(lhs, lhsOffset, "lhs");
        checkMatrix(rhs, rhsOffset, "rhs");

        float[] product = sTemporary.get();
        for (int column = 0; column < 4; column++)
        {
            float right0 = rhs[rhsOffset + column * 4];
            float right1 = rhs[rhsOffset + column * 4 + 1];
            float right2 = rhs[rhsOffset + column * 4 + 2];
            float right3 = rhs[rhsOffset + column * 4 + 3];
            for (int row = 0; row < 4; row++)
            {
                product[column * 4 + row] = lhs[lhsOffset + row] * right0 + lhs[lhsOffset + 4 + row] * right1
                        + lhs[lhsOffset + 8 + row] * right2 + lhs[lhsOffset + 12 + row] * right3;
            }
        }
        System.arraycopy(product, 0, result, resultOffset, 16);
    }

    public static void multiplyMV(float[] resultVec, int resultVecOffset, float[] lhsMat, int lhsMatOffset, float[] rhsVec,
            int rhsVecOffset)
    {
        checkVector(resultVec, resultVecOffset, "resultVec");
        checkMatrix(lhsMat, lhsMatOffset, "lhsMat");
        checkVector(rhsVec, rhsVecOffset, "rhsVec");

        float x = rhsVec[rhsVecOffset];
        float y = rhsVec[rhsVecOffset + 1];
        float z = rhsVec[rhsVecOffset + 2];
        float w = rhsVec[rhsVecOffset + 3];
        float[] product = sTemporary.get();
        for (int row = 0; row < 4; row++)
        {
            product[row] = lhsMat[lhsMatOffset + row] * x + lhsMat[lhsMatOffset + 4 + row] * y + lhsMat[lhsMatOffset + 8 + row] * z
                    + lhsMat[lhsMatOffset + 12 + row] * w;
        }
        System.arraycopy(product, 0, resultVec, resultVecOffset, 4);
    }

    public static void transposeM(float[] mTrans, int mTransOffset, float[] m, int mOffset)
    {
        float[] transposed = sTemporary.get();
        for (int row = 0; row < 4; row++)
        {
            for (int column = 0; column < 4; column++) transposed[row + column * 4] = m[mOffset + row * 4 + column];
        }
        System.arraycopy(transposed, 0, mTrans, mTransOffset, 16);
    }

    public static boolean invertM(float[] mInv, int mInvOffset, float[] m, int mOffset)
    {
        float m0 = m[mOffset];
        float m1 = m[mOffset + 1];
        float m2 = m[mOffset + 2];
        float m3 = m[mOffset + 3];
        float m4 = m[mOffset + 4];
        float m5 = m[mOffset + 5];
        float m6 = m[mOffset + 6];
        float m7 = m[mOffset + 7];
        float m8 = m[mOffset + 8];
        float m9 = m[mOffset + 9];
        float m10 = m[mOffset + 10];
        float m11 = m[mOffset + 11];
        float m12 = m[mOffset + 12];
        float m13 = m[mOffset + 13];
        float m14 = m[mOffset + 14];
        float m15 = m[mOffset + 15];

        float[] inverse = sTemporary.get();
        inverse[0] = m5 * m10 * m15 - m5 * m11 * m14 - m9 * m6 * m15 + m9 * m7 * m14 + m13 * m6 * m11 - m13 * m7 * m10;
        inverse[4] = -m4 * m10 * m15 + m4 * m11 * m14 + m8 * m6 * m15 - m8 * m7 * m14 - m12 * m6 * m11 + m12 * m7 * m10;
        inverse[8] = m4 * m9 * m15 - m4 * m11 * m13 - m8 * m5 * m15 + m8 * m7 * m13 + m12 * m5 * m11 - m12 * m7 * m9;
        inverse[12] = -m4 * m9 * m14 + m4 * m10 * m13 + m8 * m5 * m14 - m8 * m6 * m13 - m12 * m5 * m10 + m12 * m6 * m9;
        inverse[1] = -m1 * m10 * m15 + m1 * m11 * m14 + m9 * m2 * m15 - m9 * m3 * m14 - m13 * m2 * m11 + m13 * m3 * m10;
        inverse[5] = m0 * m10 * m15 - m0 * m11 * m14 - m8 * m2 * m15 + m8 * m3 * m14 + m12 * m2 * m11 - m12 * m3 * m10;
        inverse[9] = -m0 * m9 * m15 + m0 * m11 * m13 + m8 * m1 * m15 - m8 * m3 * m13 - m12 * m1 * m11 + m12 * m3 * m9;
        inverse[13] = m0 * m9 * m14 - m0 * m10 * m13 - m8 * m1 * m14 + m8 * m2 * m13 + m12 * m1 * m10 - m12 * m2 * m9;
        inverse[2] = m1 * m6 * m15 - m1 * m7 * m14 - m5 * m2 * m15 + m5 * m3 * m14 + m13 * m2 * m7 - m13 * m3 * m6;
        inverse[6] = -m0 * m6 * m15 + m0 * m7 * m14 + m4 * m2 * m15 - m4 * m3 * m14 - m12 * m2 * m7 + m12 * m3 * m6;
        inverse[10] = m0 * m5 * m15 - m0 * m7 * m13 - m4 * m1 * m15 + m4 * m3 * m13 + m12 * m1 * m7 - m12 * m3 * m5;
        inverse[14] = -m0 * m5 * m14 + m0 * m6 * m13 + m4 * m1 * m14 - m4 * m2 * m13 - m12 * m1 * m6 + m12 * m2 * m5;
        inverse[3] = -m1 * m6 * m11 + m1 * m7 * m10 + m5 * m2 * m11 - m5 * m3 * m10 - m9 * m2 * m7 + m9 * m3 * m6;
        inverse[7] = m0 * m6 * m11 - m0 * m7 * m10 - m4 * m2 * m11 + m4 * m3 * m10 + m8 * m2 * m7 - m8 * m3 * m6;
        inverse[11] = -m0 * m5 * m11 + m0 * m7 * m9 + m4 * m1 * m11 - m4 * m3 * m9 - m8 * m1 * m7 + m8 * m3 * m5;
        inverse[15] = m0 * m5 * m10 - m0 * m6 * m9 - m4 * m1 * m10 + m4 * m2 * m9 + m8 * m1 * m6 - m8 * m2 * m5;

        float determinant = m0 * inverse[0] + m1 * inverse[4] + m2 * inverse[8] + m3 * inverse[12];
        if (determinant == 0.0f) return false;

        float reciprocal = 1.0f / determinant;
        for (int index = 0; index < 16; index++) mInv[mInvOffset + index] = inverse[index] * reciprocal;
        return true;
    }

    public static void orthoM(float[] m, int mOffset, float left, float right, float bottom, float top, float near, float far)
    {
        if (left == right) throw new IllegalArgumentException("left == right");
        if (bottom == top) throw new IllegalArgumentException("bottom == top");
        if (near == far) throw new IllegalArgumentException("near == far");

        float reciprocalWidth = 1.0f / (right - left);
        float reciprocalHeight = 1.0f / (top - bottom);
        float reciprocalDepth = 1.0f / (far - near);

        clear(m, mOffset);
        m[mOffset] = 2.0f * reciprocalWidth;
        m[mOffset + 5] = 2.0f * reciprocalHeight;
        m[mOffset + 10] = -2.0f * reciprocalDepth;
        m[mOffset + 12] = -(right + left) * reciprocalWidth;
        m[mOffset + 13] = -(top + bottom) * reciprocalHeight;
        m[mOffset + 14] = -(far + near) * reciprocalDepth;
        m[mOffset + 15] = 1.0f;
    }

    public static void frustumM(float[] m, int offset, float left, float right, float bottom, float top, float near, float far)
    {
        if (left == right) throw new IllegalArgumentException("left == right");
        if (top == bottom) throw new IllegalArgumentException("top == bottom");
        if (near == far) throw new IllegalArgumentException("near == far");
        if (near <= 0.0f) throw new IllegalArgumentException("near <= 0.0f");
        if (far <= 0.0f) throw new IllegalArgumentException("far <= 0.0f");

        float reciprocalWidth = 1.0f / (right - left);
        float reciprocalHeight = 1.0f / (top - bottom);
        float reciprocalDepth = 1.0f / (near - far);

        clear(m, offset);
        m[offset] = 2.0f * (near * reciprocalWidth);
        m[offset + 5] = 2.0f * (near * reciprocalHeight);
        m[offset + 8] = (right + left) * reciprocalWidth;
        m[offset + 9] = (top + bottom) * reciprocalHeight;
        m[offset + 10] = (far + near) * reciprocalDepth;
        m[offset + 11] = -1.0f;
        m[offset + 14] = 2.0f * (far * near * reciprocalDepth);
    }

    public static void perspectiveM(float[] m, int offset, float fovy, float aspect, float zNear, float zFar)
    {
        float focal = 1.0f / (float) Math.tan(fovy * (Math.PI / 360.0));
        float rangeReciprocal = 1.0f / (zNear - zFar);

        clear(m, offset);
        m[offset] = focal / aspect;
        m[offset + 5] = focal;
        m[offset + 10] = (zFar + zNear) * rangeReciprocal;
        m[offset + 11] = -1.0f;
        m[offset + 14] = 2.0f * zFar * zNear * rangeReciprocal;
    }

    public static float length(float x, float y, float z)
    {
        return (float) Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z);
    }

    public static void setIdentityM(float[] sm, int smOffset)
    {
        clear(sm, smOffset);
        for (int index = 0; index < 16; index += 5) sm[smOffset + index] = 1.0f;
    }

    public static void scaleM(float[] sm, int smOffset, float[] m, int mOffset, float x, float y, float z)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < 4; index++)
        {
            sm[smOffset + index] = m[mOffset + index] * x;
            sm[smOffset + 4 + index] = m[mOffset + 4 + index] * y;
            sm[smOffset + 8 + index] = m[mOffset + 8 + index] * z;
            sm[smOffset + 12 + index] = m[mOffset + 12 + index];
        }
    }

    public static void scaleM(float[] m, int mOffset, float x, float y, float z)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < 4; index++)
        {
            m[mOffset + index] *= x;
            m[mOffset + 4 + index] *= y;
            m[mOffset + 8 + index] *= z;
        }
    }

    public static void translateM(float[] tm, int tmOffset, float[] m, int mOffset, float x, float y, float z)
    {
        float[] translated = sTemporary.get();
        for (int index = 0; index < 12; index++) translated[index] = m[mOffset + index];
        for (int index = 0; index < 4; index++)
        {
            translated[12 + index] = m[mOffset + index] * x + m[mOffset + 4 + index] * y + m[mOffset + 8 + index] * z
                    + m[mOffset + 12 + index];
        }
        System.arraycopy(translated, 0, tm, tmOffset, 16);
    }

    public static void translateM(float[] m, int mOffset, float x, float y, float z)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < 4; index++)
        {
            m[mOffset + 12 + index] += m[mOffset + index] * x + m[mOffset + 4 + index] * y + m[mOffset + 8 + index] * z;
        }
    }

    public static void rotateM(float[] rm, int rmOffset, float[] m, int mOffset, float a, float x, float y, float z)
    {
        float[] rotation = new float[16];
        setRotateM(rotation, 0, a, x, y, z);
        multiplyMM(rm, rmOffset, m, mOffset, rotation, 0);
    }

    public static void rotateM(float[] m, int mOffset, float a, float x, float y, float z)
    {
        float[] rotation = new float[16];
        setRotateM(rotation, 0, a, x, y, z);
        multiplyMM(m, mOffset, m, mOffset, rotation, 0);
    }

    public static void setRotateM(float[] rm, int rmOffset, float a, float x, float y, float z)
    {
        rm[rmOffset + 3] = 0.0f;
        rm[rmOffset + 7] = 0.0f;
        rm[rmOffset + 11] = 0.0f;
        rm[rmOffset + 12] = 0.0f;
        rm[rmOffset + 13] = 0.0f;
        rm[rmOffset + 14] = 0.0f;
        rm[rmOffset + 15] = 1.0f;

        double radians = a * (Math.PI / 180.0);
        float sine = (float) Math.sin(radians);
        float cosine = (float) Math.cos(radians);

        if (x == 1.0f && y == 0.0f && z == 0.0f)
        {
            rm[rmOffset] = 1.0f;
            rm[rmOffset + 1] = 0.0f;
            rm[rmOffset + 2] = 0.0f;
            rm[rmOffset + 4] = 0.0f;
            rm[rmOffset + 5] = cosine;
            rm[rmOffset + 6] = sine;
            rm[rmOffset + 8] = 0.0f;
            rm[rmOffset + 9] = -sine;
            rm[rmOffset + 10] = cosine;
        }
        else if (x == 0.0f && y == 1.0f && z == 0.0f)
        {
            rm[rmOffset] = cosine;
            rm[rmOffset + 1] = 0.0f;
            rm[rmOffset + 2] = -sine;
            rm[rmOffset + 4] = 0.0f;
            rm[rmOffset + 5] = 1.0f;
            rm[rmOffset + 6] = 0.0f;
            rm[rmOffset + 8] = sine;
            rm[rmOffset + 9] = 0.0f;
            rm[rmOffset + 10] = cosine;
        }
        else if (x == 0.0f && y == 0.0f && z == 1.0f)
        {
            rm[rmOffset] = cosine;
            rm[rmOffset + 1] = sine;
            rm[rmOffset + 2] = 0.0f;
            rm[rmOffset + 4] = -sine;
            rm[rmOffset + 5] = cosine;
            rm[rmOffset + 6] = 0.0f;
            rm[rmOffset + 8] = 0.0f;
            rm[rmOffset + 9] = 0.0f;
            rm[rmOffset + 10] = 1.0f;
        }
        else
        {
            float length = length(x, y, z);
            if (length != 1.0f)
            {
                float reciprocal = 1.0f / length;
                x *= reciprocal;
                y *= reciprocal;
                z *= reciprocal;
            }

            float inverseCosine = 1.0f - cosine;
            float xy = x * y;
            float yz = y * z;
            float zx = z * x;
            float xSine = x * sine;
            float ySine = y * sine;
            float zSine = z * sine;

            rm[rmOffset] = x * x * inverseCosine + cosine;
            rm[rmOffset + 4] = xy * inverseCosine - zSine;
            rm[rmOffset + 8] = zx * inverseCosine + ySine;
            rm[rmOffset + 1] = xy * inverseCosine + zSine;
            rm[rmOffset + 5] = y * y * inverseCosine + cosine;
            rm[rmOffset + 9] = yz * inverseCosine - xSine;
            rm[rmOffset + 2] = zx * inverseCosine - ySine;
            rm[rmOffset + 6] = yz * inverseCosine + xSine;
            rm[rmOffset + 10] = z * z * inverseCosine + cosine;
        }
    }

    @Deprecated
    public static void setRotateEulerM(float[] rm, int rmOffset, float x, float y, float z)
    {
        double scale = Math.PI / 180.0;
        float cosineX = (float) Math.cos(x * scale);
        float sineX = (float) Math.sin(x * scale);
        float cosineY = (float) Math.cos(y * scale);
        float sineY = (float) Math.sin(y * scale);
        float cosineZ = (float) Math.cos(z * scale);
        float sineZ = (float) Math.sin(z * scale);
        float cosineXSineY = cosineX * sineY;
        float sineXSineY = sineX * sineY;

        rm[rmOffset] = cosineY * cosineZ;
        rm[rmOffset + 1] = -cosineY * sineZ;
        rm[rmOffset + 2] = sineY;
        rm[rmOffset + 3] = 0.0f;

        rm[rmOffset + 4] = cosineXSineY * cosineZ + cosineX * sineZ;
        rm[rmOffset + 5] = -cosineXSineY * sineZ + cosineX * cosineZ;
        rm[rmOffset + 6] = -sineX * cosineY;
        rm[rmOffset + 7] = 0.0f;

        rm[rmOffset + 8] = -sineXSineY * cosineZ + sineX * sineZ;
        rm[rmOffset + 9] = sineXSineY * sineZ + sineX * cosineZ;
        rm[rmOffset + 10] = cosineX * cosineY;
        rm[rmOffset + 11] = 0.0f;

        rm[rmOffset + 12] = 0.0f;
        rm[rmOffset + 13] = 0.0f;
        rm[rmOffset + 14] = 0.0f;
        rm[rmOffset + 15] = 1.0f;
    }

    public static void setRotateEulerM2(float[] rm, int rmOffset, float x, float y, float z)
    {
        if (rm == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("rm == null");
        if (rmOffset < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("rmOffset < 0");
        if (rm.length < rmOffset + 16) throw new IllegalArgumentException("rm.length < rmOffset + 16");

        double scale = Math.PI / 180.0;
        float cosineX = (float) Math.cos(x * scale);
        float sineX = (float) Math.sin(x * scale);
        float cosineY = (float) Math.cos(y * scale);
        float sineY = (float) Math.sin(y * scale);
        float cosineZ = (float) Math.cos(z * scale);
        float sineZ = (float) Math.sin(z * scale);
        float cosineXSineY = cosineX * sineY;
        float sineXSineY = sineX * sineY;

        rm[rmOffset] = cosineY * cosineZ;
        rm[rmOffset + 1] = cosineY * sineZ;
        rm[rmOffset + 2] = -sineY;
        rm[rmOffset + 3] = 0.0f;

        rm[rmOffset + 4] = sineXSineY * cosineZ - cosineX * sineZ;
        rm[rmOffset + 5] = sineXSineY * sineZ + cosineX * cosineZ;
        rm[rmOffset + 6] = sineX * cosineY;
        rm[rmOffset + 7] = 0.0f;

        rm[rmOffset + 8] = cosineXSineY * cosineZ + sineX * sineZ;
        rm[rmOffset + 9] = cosineXSineY * sineZ - sineX * cosineZ;
        rm[rmOffset + 10] = cosineX * cosineY;
        rm[rmOffset + 11] = 0.0f;

        rm[rmOffset + 12] = 0.0f;
        rm[rmOffset + 13] = 0.0f;
        rm[rmOffset + 14] = 0.0f;
        rm[rmOffset + 15] = 1.0f;
    }

    public static void setLookAtM(float[] rm, int rmOffset, float eyeX, float eyeY, float eyeZ, float centerX, float centerY,
            float centerZ, float upX, float upY, float upZ)
    {
        float forwardX = centerX - eyeX;
        float forwardY = centerY - eyeY;
        float forwardZ = centerZ - eyeZ;

        float reciprocalForward = 1.0f / length(forwardX, forwardY, forwardZ);
        forwardX *= reciprocalForward;
        forwardY *= reciprocalForward;
        forwardZ *= reciprocalForward;

        float sideX = forwardY * upZ - forwardZ * upY;
        float sideY = forwardZ * upX - forwardX * upZ;
        float sideZ = forwardX * upY - forwardY * upX;

        float reciprocalSide = 1.0f / length(sideX, sideY, sideZ);
        sideX *= reciprocalSide;
        sideY *= reciprocalSide;
        sideZ *= reciprocalSide;

        float upwardX = sideY * forwardZ - sideZ * forwardY;
        float upwardY = sideZ * forwardX - sideX * forwardZ;
        float upwardZ = sideX * forwardY - sideY * forwardX;

        rm[rmOffset] = sideX;
        rm[rmOffset + 1] = upwardX;
        rm[rmOffset + 2] = -forwardX;
        rm[rmOffset + 3] = 0.0f;

        rm[rmOffset + 4] = sideY;
        rm[rmOffset + 5] = upwardY;
        rm[rmOffset + 6] = -forwardY;
        rm[rmOffset + 7] = 0.0f;

        rm[rmOffset + 8] = sideZ;
        rm[rmOffset + 9] = upwardZ;
        rm[rmOffset + 10] = -forwardZ;
        rm[rmOffset + 11] = 0.0f;

        rm[rmOffset + 12] = 0.0f;
        rm[rmOffset + 13] = 0.0f;
        rm[rmOffset + 14] = 0.0f;
        rm[rmOffset + 15] = 1.0f;

        translateM(rm, rmOffset, -eyeX, -eyeY, -eyeZ);
    }

    private static void clear(float[] m, int offset)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < 16; index++) m[offset + index] = 0.0f;
    }
}
```

`java/android/opengl/RuntimeEglBridge.java`:

```java
package android.opengl;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.IdentityHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

import javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGL10;

final class RuntimeEglBridge
{
    static final EGL10 EGL = (EGL10) javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGLContext.getEGL();

    private static final Map<Long, Object> sObjects = new HashMap<>();
    private static final Map<Object, Long> sHandles = new IdentityHashMap<>();

    private static long sNextHandle = 1;

    private RuntimeEglBridge()
    {
    }

    static synchronized long handle(Object object)
    {
        if (object == null) return 0;

        Long handle = sHandles.get(object);
        if (handle == null)
        {
            handle = sNextHandle++;
            sHandles.put(object, handle);
            sObjects.put(handle, object);
        }
        return handle;
    }

    static synchronized long newHandle()
    {
        return sNextHandle++;
    }

    static synchronized void forget(EGLObjectHandle handle)
    {
        if (handle == null) return;

        Object object = sObjects.remove(handle.getNativeHandle());
        if (object != null) sHandles.remove(object);
    }

    static synchronized Object resolve(EGLObjectHandle handle)
    {
        if (handle == null) return null;
        return sObjects.get(handle.getNativeHandle());
    }

    static javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGLDisplay display(EGLDisplay display)
    {
        return (javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGLDisplay) resolve(display);
    }

    static javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGLConfig config(EGLConfig config)
    {
        return (javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGLConfig) resolve(config);
    }

    static javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGLContext context(EGLContext context)
    {
        return (javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGLContext) resolve(context);
    }

    static javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGLSurface surface(EGLSurface surface)
    {
        return (javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGLSurface) resolve(surface);
    }

    static EGLDisplay wrap(javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGLDisplay display)
    {
        return display == null ? EGL14.EGL_NO_DISPLAY : new EGLDisplay(handle(display));
    }

    static EGLConfig wrap(javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGLConfig config)
    {
        return config == null ? null : new EGLConfig(handle(config));
    }

    static EGLContext wrap(javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGLContext context)
    {
        return context == null ? EGL14.EGL_NO_CONTEXT : new EGLContext(handle(context));
    }

    static EGLSurface wrap(javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGLSurface surface)
    {
        return surface == null ? EGL14.EGL_NO_SURFACE : new EGLSurface(handle(surface));
    }

    static javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGLConfig[] configArray(int size)
    {
        return new javax.microedition.khronos.egl.EGLConfig[size];
    }

    static int[] attributes(int[] list, int offset)
    {
        if (list == null) return null;
        if (offset < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset < 0");
        if (list.length - offset < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("length - offset < 1");

        int length = list.length - offset;
        int[] copy = new int[length];
        System.arraycopy(list, offset, copy, 0, length);
        return copy;
    }

    static void checkOutput(Object array, int offset, int needed, String name)
    {
        if (array == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " == null");
        if (offset < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + "Offset < 0");
        if (java.lang.reflect.Array.getLength(array) - offset < needed)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("length - " + name + "Offset < " + needed + " < needed");
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    private static int parse(String[] parts, int index, int fallback)
    {
        if (index >= parts.length) return fallback;

        try
        {
            return Integer.parseInt(parts[index].trim());
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException exception)
        {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    static synchronized void generateNames(int count, IntBuffer names)
    {
        if (names == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("buffer == null");
        if (names.remaining() < count) throw new IllegalArgumentException("remaining() < n < needed");

        int position = names.position();
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) names.put(position + index, sNextName++);
    }

    private static String shadingLanguageVersion()
    {

        int major = parse(version, 0, 3);
        int minor = parse(version, 1, 0);
        if (major < 3) return "1.00";
        return major + "." + minor + "0";
    }

    static synchronized void getIntegers(int pname, int[] params, int offset)
    {
        if (params == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("params == null");
        if (offset < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset < 0");

        int[] values = integers(pname);
        int count = Math.min(values.length, params.length - offset);
        System.arraycopy(values, 0, params, offset, Math.max(count, 0));
    }

    static synchronized void getIntegers(int pname, IntBuffer params)

        int[] values = integers(pname);
        int position = params.position();
        int count = Math.min(values.length, params.remaining());
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) params.put(position + index, values[index]);
    }

    static synchronized void getFloats(int pname, float[] params, int offset)

        if (offset < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset < 0");

    static synchronized void getFloats(int pname, FloatBuffer params)

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) params.put(position + index, values[index]);
    }

    static synchronized void getBooleans(int pname, boolean[] params, int offset)
    {
        if (params == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("params == null");
        if (offset < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset < 0");

        if (!sIntegers.containsKey(pname) && !sFloats.containsKey(pname))
        {
            if (offset < params.length) params[offset] = sEnabled.contains(pname);
            return;
        }

        int[] values = integers(pname);
        int count = Math.min(values.length, params.length - offset);
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) params[offset + index] = values[index] != 0;
    }

    static synchronized void getLongs(int pname, long[] params, int offset)
    {
        if (params == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("params == null");
        if (offset < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset < 0");

        long[] values = longs(pname);
        int count = Math.min(values.length, params.length - offset);
        System.arraycopy(values, 0, params, offset, Math.max(count, 0));
    }

    static synchronized void getLongs(int pname, LongBuffer params)
    {
        if (params == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("params == null");

        long[] values = longs(pname);
        int position = params.position();
        int count = Math.min(values.length, params.remaining());
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) params.put(position + index, values[index]);
    }

    private static int[] integers(int pname)
    {
        int[] values = sIntegers.get(pname);
        if (values != null) return values;

        float[] floats = sFloats.get(pname);
        if (floats != null)
        {
            int[] converted = new int[floats.length];
            for (int index = 0; index < floats.length; index++) converted[index] = Math.round(floats[index]);
            return converted;
        }

        return new int[] {sEnabled.contains(pname) ? 1 : 0};
    }

    private static float[] floats(int pname)
    {
        float[] values = sFloats.get(pname);
        if (values != null) return values;

        int[] integers = integers(pname);
        float[] converted = new float[integers.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < integers.length; index++) converted[index] = integers[index];
        return converted;
    }

    private static long[] longs(int pname)
    {
        if (pname == MAX_SERVER_WAIT_TIMEOUT) return new long[] {Long.MAX_VALUE};

        int[] integers = integers(pname);
        long[] converted = new long[integers.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < integers.length; index++) converted[index] = integers[index];
        return converted;
    }

    static synchronized int getShaderParameter(int shader, int pname)
    {
        switch (pname)
        {
            case SHADER_TYPE:
                Integer type = sShaderTypes.get(shader);
                return type == null ? 0 : type;
            case COMPILE_STATUS:
                return 1;
            case SHADER_SOURCE_LENGTH:
                String source = sShaderSources.get(shader);
                return source == null ? 0 : source.length() + 1;
            default:
                return 0;
        }
    }

    static int getProgramParameter(int program, int pname)
    {
        switch (pname)
        {
            case LINK_STATUS:
            case VALIDATE_STATUS:
                return 1;
            default:
                return 0;
        }
    }

    static synchronized void setShaderSource(int shader, String source)
    {
        sShaderSources.put(shader, source);
    }

    static synchronized String getShaderSource(int shader)
    {
        String source = sShaderSources.get(shader);
        return source == null ? "" : source;
    }

    static synchronized int location(int program, String name)
    {
        if (name == null || name.startsWith("gl_")) return -1;

        Map<String, Integer> locations = sLocations.get(program);
        if (locations == null)
        {
            locations = new HashMap<>();
            sLocations.put(program, locations);
        }

        Integer location = locations.get(name);
        if (location == null)
        {
            location = locations.size();
            locations.put(name, location);
        }

        return location;
    }

    static synchronized boolean isEnabled(int capability)
    {
        return sEnabled.contains(capability);
    }

    static synchronized void setEnabled(int capability, boolean enabled)
    {
        if (enabled) sEnabled.add(capability);
        else sEnabled.remove(capability);
    }

    static synchronized void setViewport(int x, int y, int width, int height)

        put(VIEWPORT, x, y, width, height);
    }

    static synchronized void setScissor(int x, int y, int width, int height)

        sFloats.put(COLOR_CLEAR_VALUE, new float[] {red, green, blue, alpha});

    static synchronized void setClearColor(int red, int green, int blue, int alpha)
    {
        setClearColor(red / 65536.0f, green / 65536.0f, blue / 65536.0f, alpha / 65536.0f);
    }

    static synchronized void bindBuffer(int target, int buffer)
    {
        if (target == ARRAY_BUFFER) put(ARRAY_BUFFER_BINDING, buffer);
        else if (target == ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER) put(ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER_BINDING, buffer);
    }

    static synchronized void bindFramebuffer(int target, int framebuffer)
    {
        if (target != READ_FRAMEBUFFER) put(FRAMEBUFFER_BINDING, framebuffer);
        put(READ_FRAMEBUFFER_BINDING, framebuffer);
    }

    static synchronized void bindRenderbuffer(int target, int renderbuffer)
    {
        put(RENDERBUFFER_BINDING, renderbuffer);
    }

    static synchronized void bindTexture(int target, int texture)
    {
        if (target == TEXTURE_2D) put(TEXTURE_BINDING_2D, texture);
        else if (target == TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP) put(TEXTURE_BINDING_CUBE_MAP, texture);
    }

    static synchronized void useProgram(int program)
    {
        put(CURRENT_PROGRAM, program);
    }

    static synchronized void activeTexture(int texture)
    {
        put(ACTIVE_TEXTURE, texture);
    }

    static synchronized void bindVertexArray(int array)
    {
        put(VERTEX_ARRAY_BINDING, array);
    }

    static Buffer mapBuffer(int length)
    {
        return ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(Math.max(length, 0)).order(ByteOrder.nativeOrder());
    }

    static void getShaderPrecisionFormat(int precisionType, int[] range, int rangeOffset, int[] precision, int precisionOffset)
    {
        boolean floating = precisionType == LOW_FLOAT || precisionType == MEDIUM_FLOAT || precisionType == HIGH_FLOAT;
        range[rangeOffset] = floating ? 127 : 31;
        range[rangeOffset + 1] = floating ? 127 : 30;
        precision[precisionOffset] = floating ? 23 : 0;
    }

    static void getShaderPrecisionFormat(int precisionType, IntBuffer range, IntBuffer precision)
    {
        int[] rangeValues = new int[2];
        int[] precisionValues = new int[1];
        getShaderPrecisionFormat(precisionType, rangeValues, 0, precisionValues, 0);
        range.put(range.position(), rangeValues[0]);
        range.put(range.position() + 1, rangeValues[1]);
        precision.put(precision.position(), precisionValues[0]);
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/AsyncTask.java`:

```java
package android.os;

import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.concurrent.Callable;
import java.util.concurrent.CancellationException;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;
import java.util.concurrent.FutureTask;
import java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue;
import java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionHandler;
import java.util.concurrent.SynchronousQueue;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadFactory;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

public abstract class AsyncTask<Params, Progress, Result>
{
    private static final String LOG_TAG = "AsyncTask";

    private static final int CORE_POOL_SIZE = 1;
    private static final int MAXIMUM_POOL_SIZE = 20;
    private static final int BACKUP_POOL_SIZE = 5;
    private static final int KEEP_ALIVE_SECONDS = 3;

    private static final ThreadFactory THREAD_FACTORY = new ThreadFactory()
    {
        private final AtomicInteger mCount = new AtomicInteger(1);

        @Override
        public Thread newThread(Runnable runnable)
        {
            return new Thread(runnable, "AsyncTask #" + mCount.getAndIncrement());
        }
    };

    private static ThreadPoolExecutor sBackupExecutor;
    private static LinkedBlockingQueue<Runnable> sBackupExecutorQueue;

    private static final RejectedExecutionHandler RUN_ON_SERIAL_POLICY = new RejectedExecutionHandler()
    {
        @Override
        public void rejectedExecution(Runnable runnable, ThreadPoolExecutor executor)
        {
            android.util.Log.w(LOG_TAG, "Exceeded ThreadPoolExecutor pool size");

            synchronized (this)
            {
                if (sBackupExecutor == null)
                {
                    sBackupExecutorQueue = new LinkedBlockingQueue<Runnable>();
                    sBackupExecutor = new ThreadPoolExecutor(BACKUP_POOL_SIZE, BACKUP_POOL_SIZE, KEEP_ALIVE_SECONDS, TimeUnit.SECONDS,
                                                             sBackupExecutorQueue, THREAD_FACTORY);
                    sBackupExecutor.allowCoreThreadTimeOut(true);
                }
            }
            sBackupExecutor.execute(runnable);
        }
    };

    public static final Executor THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR;

    static
    {
        ThreadPoolExecutor threadPoolExecutor = new ThreadPoolExecutor(CORE_POOL_SIZE, MAXIMUM_POOL_SIZE, KEEP_ALIVE_SECONDS, TimeUnit.SECONDS,
                                                                       new SynchronousQueue<Runnable>(), THREAD_FACTORY);
        threadPoolExecutor.setRejectedExecutionHandler(RUN_ON_SERIAL_POLICY);
        THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR = threadPoolExecutor;
    }

    public static final Executor SERIAL_EXECUTOR = new SerialExecutor();

    private static final int MESSAGE_POST_RESULT = 0x1;
    private static final int MESSAGE_POST_PROGRESS = 0x2;

    private static volatile Executor sDefaultExecutor = SERIAL_EXECUTOR;
    private static InternalHandler sHandler;

    private final WorkerRunnable<Params, Result> mWorker;
    private final FutureTask<Result> mFuture;
    private final Handler mHandler;

    private volatile Status mStatus = Status.PENDING;

    private final AtomicBoolean mCancelled = new AtomicBoolean();
    private final AtomicBoolean mTaskInvoked = new AtomicBoolean();

    private static class SerialExecutor implements Executor
    {
        final ArrayDeque<Runnable> mTasks = new ArrayDeque<Runnable>();
        Runnable mActive;

        @Override
        public synchronized void execute(final Runnable runnable)
        {
            mTasks.offer(new Runnable()
            {
                @Override
                public void run()
                {
                    try
                    {
                        runnable.run();
                    }
                    finally
                    {
                        scheduleNext();
                    }
                }
            });

            if (mActive == null) scheduleNext();
        }

        protected synchronized void scheduleNext()
        {
            if ((mActive = mTasks.poll()) != null) THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR.execute(mActive);
        }
    }

    public enum Status
    {
        PENDING,
        RUNNING,
        FINISHED,
    }

    private static Handler getMainHandler()
    {
        synchronized (AsyncTask.class)
        {
            if (sHandler == null) sHandler = new InternalHandler(Looper.getMainLooper());
            return sHandler;
        }
    }

    private Handler getHandler()
    {
        return mHandler;
    }

    public static void setDefaultExecutor(Executor executor)
    {
        sDefaultExecutor = executor;
    }

    public AsyncTask()
    {
        this((Looper)null);
    }

    public AsyncTask(Handler handler)
    {
        this(handler != null ? handler.getLooper() : null);
    }

    public AsyncTask(Looper callbackLooper)
    {
        mHandler = callbackLooper == null || callbackLooper == Looper.getMainLooper() ? getMainHandler() : new Handler(callbackLooper);

        mWorker = new WorkerRunnable<Params, Result>()
        {
            @Override
            public Result call() throws Exception
            {
                mTaskInvoked.set(true);
                Result result = null;
                try
                {
                    Process.setThreadPriority(Process.THREAD_PRIORITY_BACKGROUND);
                    result = doInBackground(mParams);
                    Binder.flushPendingCommands();
                }
                catch (Throwable throwable)
                {
                    mCancelled.set(true);
                    throw throwable;
                }
                finally
                {
                    postResult(result);
                }
                return result;
            }
        };

        mFuture = new FutureTask<Result>(mWorker)
        {
            @Override
            protected void done()
            {
                try
                {
                    postResultIfNotInvoked(get());
                }
                catch (InterruptedException interrupted)
                {
                    android.util.Log.w(LOG_TAG, interrupted);
                }
                catch (ExecutionException failure)
                {
                    throw new RuntimeException("An error occurred while executing doInBackground()", failure.getCause());
                }
                catch (CancellationException cancelled)
                {
                    postResultIfNotInvoked(null);
                }
            }
        };
    }

    private void postResultIfNotInvoked(Result result)
    {
        final boolean wasTaskInvoked = mTaskInvoked.get();
        if (!wasTaskInvoked) postResult(result);
    }

    private Result postResult(Result result)
    {
        Message message = getHandler().obtainMessage(MESSAGE_POST_RESULT, new AsyncTaskResult<Result>(this, result));
        message.sendToTarget();
        return result;
    }

    public final Status getStatus()
    {
        return mStatus;
    }

    protected abstract Result doInBackground(Params... params);

    protected void onPreExecute()
    {
    }

    protected void onPostExecute(Result result)
    {
    }

    protected void onProgressUpdate(Progress... values)
    {
    }

    protected void onCancelled(Result result)
    {
        onCancelled();
    }

    protected void onCancelled()
    {
    }

    public final boolean isCancelled()
    {
        return mCancelled.get();
    }

    public final boolean cancel(boolean mayInterruptIfRunning)
    {
        mCancelled.set(true);
        return mFuture.cancel(mayInterruptIfRunning);
    }

    public final Result get() throws InterruptedException, ExecutionException
    {
        return mFuture.get();
    }

    public final Result get(long timeout, TimeUnit unit) throws InterruptedException, ExecutionException, TimeoutException
    {
        return mFuture.get(timeout, unit);
    }

    @SafeVarargs
    public final AsyncTask<Params, Progress, Result> execute(Params... params)
    {
        return executeOnExecutor(sDefaultExecutor, params);
    }

    @SafeVarargs
    public final AsyncTask<Params, Progress, Result> executeOnExecutor(Executor executor, Params... params)
    {
        if (mStatus != Status.PENDING)
        {
            switch (mStatus)
            {
                case RUNNING:
                    throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot execute task: the task is already running.");
                case FINISHED:
                    throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot execute task: the task has already been executed "
                                                    + "(a task can be executed only once)");
                default:
                    break;
            }
        }

        mStatus = Status.RUNNING;

        onPreExecute();

        mWorker.mParams = params;
        executor.execute(mFuture);

        return this;
    }

    public static void execute(Runnable runnable)
    {
        sDefaultExecutor.execute(runnable);
    }

    @SafeVarargs
    protected final void publishProgress(Progress... values)
    {
        if (!isCancelled())
        {
            getHandler().obtainMessage(MESSAGE_POST_PROGRESS, new AsyncTaskResult<Progress>(this, values)).sendToTarget();
        }
    }

    private void finish(Result result)
    {
        if (isCancelled()) onCancelled(result);
        else onPostExecute(result);

        mStatus = Status.FINISHED;
    }

    private static class InternalHandler extends Handler
    {
        InternalHandler(Looper looper)
        {
            super(looper);
        }

        @SuppressWarnings({"unchecked", "rawtypes"})
        @Override
        public void handleMessage(Message message)
        {
            AsyncTaskResult<?> result = (AsyncTaskResult<?>)message.obj;
            switch (message.what)
            {
                case MESSAGE_POST_RESULT:
                    result.mTask.finish(result.mData[0]);
                    break;
                case MESSAGE_POST_PROGRESS:
                    result.mTask.onProgressUpdate(result.mData);
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
        }
    }

    private abstract static class WorkerRunnable<Params, Result> implements Callable<Result>
    {
        Params[] mParams;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings({"rawtypes"})
    private static class AsyncTaskResult<Data>
    {
        final AsyncTask mTask;
        final Data[] mData;

        @SafeVarargs
        AsyncTaskResult(AsyncTask task, Data... data)
        {
            mTask = task;
            mData = data;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.os;

public class Binder implements IBinder
{
    private String mDescriptor;
    private IInterface mOwner;

    public Binder()
    {
    }

    public Binder(String descriptor)
    {
        mDescriptor = descriptor;
    }

    public void attachInterface(IInterface owner, String descriptor)
    {
        mOwner = owner;
        mDescriptor = descriptor;
    }

    public IInterface queryLocalInterface(String descriptor)
    {
        return descriptor != null && descriptor.equals(mDescriptor) ? mOwner : null;
    }

    protected boolean onTransact(int code, Parcel data, Parcel reply, int flags)
    {
        if (code == INTERFACE_TRANSACTION)
        {
            if (reply != null) reply.writeString(getInterfaceDescriptor());
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public final boolean transact(int code, Parcel data, Parcel reply, int flags)
    {
        if (data != null) data.setDataPosition(0);

        boolean handled = onTransact(code, data, reply, flags);
        if (reply != null) reply.setDataPosition(0);

        return handled;
    }

    public void linkToDeath(DeathRecipient recipient, int flags)
    {
    }

    public boolean unlinkToDeath(DeathRecipient recipient, int flags)
    {
        return true;
    }

    public void dump(java.io.FileDescriptor target, String[] arguments)
    {
    }

    @Override
    public String getInterfaceDescriptor()
    {
        return mDescriptor;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean pingBinder()
    {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isBinderAlive()
    {
        return true;
    }

    public static final int getCallingPid()
    {
        return android.os.Process.myPid();
    }

    public static final int getCallingUid()
    {
        return android.os.Process.myUid();
    }

    public static final int getCallingUidOrThrow()
    {
        return android.os.Process.myUid();
    }

    public static final UserHandle getCallingUserHandle()
    {
        return android.os.Process.myUserHandle();
    }

    public static final long clearCallingIdentity()
    {
        return ((long)getCallingUid() << 32) | (getCallingPid() & 0xffffffffL);
    }

    public static final void restoreCallingIdentity(long token)
    {
    }

    public static final void flushPendingCommands()
    {
    }

    public static final void joinThreadPool()
    {
    }

    public void dumpAsync(final java.io.FileDescriptor target, final String[] arguments)
    {
        Thread worker = new Thread(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                dump(target, arguments);
            }
        }, "Binder.dumpAsync");
        worker.start();
    }
}
```

```java
public final class Bundle extends BaseBundle implements Cloneable, Parcelable
{
    public static final Bundle EMPTY = new Bundle(true);

    {
        @Override
        public Bundle createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            Bundle bundle = new Bundle();
            if (source != null) source.readBundleBody(bundle.mMap, null);
            return bundle;
        }

        @Override
        public Bundle[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Bundle[size];
        }
    };

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public <T> T[] getParcelableArray(String key, Class<T> type)
    {
        Object value = mMap.get(key);
        if (!(value instanceof Object[]) || type == null) return null;

        Object[] source = (Object[])value;
        T[] result = (T[])java.lang.reflect.Array.newInstance(type, source.length);
        for (int index = 0; index < source.length; index++)
        {
            if (source[index] != null && !type.isInstance(source[index])) return null;
            result[index] = (T)source[index];
        }
        return result;
    }
```

`java/android/os/CancellationSignal.java`:

```java
package android.os;

public final class CancellationSignal
{
    private boolean mCancelled;
    private OnCancelListener mListener;

    public interface OnCancelListener
    {
        void onCancel();
    }

    public boolean isCanceled()
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            return mCancelled;
        }
    }

    public void throwIfCanceled()
    {
        if (isCanceled()) throw new OperationCanceledException();
    }

    public void cancel()
    {
        OnCancelListener listener;

        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mCancelled) return;

            mCancelled = true;
            listener = mListener;
        }

        if (listener != null) listener.onCancel();
    }

    public void setOnCancelListener(OnCancelListener listener)
    {
        boolean alreadyCancelled;

        synchronized (this)
        {
            mListener = listener;
            alreadyCancelled = mCancelled;
        }

        if (alreadyCancelled && listener != null) listener.onCancel();
    }
}
```

```java
package android.os;

import android.util.SparseArray;

public abstract class CombinedVibration implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<CombinedVibration> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<CombinedVibration>()
    {
        @Override
        public CombinedVibration createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new Mono(VibrationEffect.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source));
        }

        @Override
        public CombinedVibration[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new CombinedVibration[size];
        }
    };

    CombinedVibration()
    {
    }

    public static CombinedVibration createParallel(VibrationEffect effect)
    {
        if (effect == null) throw new NullPointerException("effect");
        return new Mono(effect);
    }

    public static ParallelCombination startParallel()
    {
        return new ParallelCombination();
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    static final class Mono extends CombinedVibration
    {
        private final VibrationEffect mEffect;

        Mono(VibrationEffect effect)
        {
            mEffect = effect;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
        {
            mEffect.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        }
    }

    static final class Stereo extends CombinedVibration
    {
        private final SparseArray<VibrationEffect> mEffects;

        Stereo(SparseArray<VibrationEffect> effects)
        {
            mEffects = effects;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
        {
            if (mEffects.size() == 0) return;
            mEffects.valueAt(0).writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        }
    }

    public static final class ParallelCombination
    {
        private final SparseArray<VibrationEffect> mEffects = new SparseArray<>();

        ParallelCombination()
        {
        }

        public ParallelCombination addVibrator(int vibratorId, VibrationEffect effect)
        {
            mEffects.put(vibratorId, effect);
            return this;
        }

        public CombinedVibration combine()
        {
            if (mEffects.size() == 0) throw new IllegalStateException("Combination must have at least one element to combine.");
            return new Stereo(mEffects.clone());
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/ConditionVariable.java`:

```java
package android.os;

public class ConditionVariable
{
    private volatile boolean mCondition;

    public ConditionVariable()
    {
        mCondition = false;
    }

    public ConditionVariable(boolean state)
    {
        mCondition = state;
    }

    public void open()
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            boolean old = mCondition;
            mCondition = true;
            if (!old) notifyAll();
        }
    }

    public void close()
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            mCondition = false;
        }
    }

    public void block()
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            while (!mCondition)
            {
                try
                {
                    wait();
                }
                catch (InterruptedException ignored)
                {
                    continue;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean block(long timeoutMillis)
    {
        if (timeoutMillis == 0)
        {
            block();
            return true;
        }

        synchronized (this)
        {
            long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            long end = now + timeoutMillis;
            while (!mCondition && now < end)
            {
                try
                {
                    wait(end - now);
                }
                catch (InterruptedException ignored)
                {
                    now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
                    continue;
                }
                now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            }
            return mCondition;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/CountDownTimer.java`:

```java
package android.os;

public abstract class CountDownTimer
{
    private static final int MSG = 1;

    private final long mMillisInFuture;
    private final long mCountdownInterval;
    private long mStopTimeInFuture;
    private boolean mCancelled = false;

    public CountDownTimer(long millisInFuture, long countDownInterval)
    {
        mMillisInFuture = millisInFuture;
        mCountdownInterval = countDownInterval;
    }

    public final synchronized void cancel()
    {
        mCancelled = true;
        mHandler.removeMessages(MSG);
    }

    public final synchronized CountDownTimer start()
    {
        mCancelled = false;
        if (mMillisInFuture <= 0)
        {
            onFinish();
            return this;
        }

        mStopTimeInFuture = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + mMillisInFuture;
        mHandler.sendMessage(mHandler.obtainMessage(MSG));
        return this;
    }

    public abstract void onTick(long millisUntilFinished);

    public abstract void onFinish();

    private final Handler mHandler = new Handler()
    {
        @Override
        public void handleMessage(Message message)
        {
            synchronized (CountDownTimer.this)
            {
                if (mCancelled) return;

                final long millisLeft = mStopTimeInFuture - SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();

                if (millisLeft <= 0)
                {
                    onFinish();
                }
                else
                {
                    long lastTickStart = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
                    onTick(millisLeft);

                    long lastTickDuration = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - lastTickStart;
                    long delay;

                    if (millisLeft < mCountdownInterval)
                    {
                        delay = millisLeft - lastTickDuration;
                        if (delay < 0) delay = 0;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        delay = mCountdownInterval - lastTickDuration;
                        while (delay < 0) delay += mCountdownInterval;
                    }

                    sendMessageDelayed(obtainMessage(MSG), delay);
                }
            }
        }
    };
}
```

```java
        Map<String, Long> status = readKilobytes(STATUS_FILE);
        Map<String, Long> rollup = readKilobytes(ROLLUP_FILE);

        int javaHeap = (int)(javaHeapUsedBytes() / 1024L);
        int anonymous = (int)value(status, "RssAnon", 0L);
        int file = (int)value(status, "RssFile", 0L);
        int shared = (int)value(status, "RssShmem", 0L);
        int nativeHeap = Math.max(0, anonymous - javaHeap);

        info.dalvikPss = javaHeap;
        info.dalvikPrivateDirty = javaHeap;
        info.dalvikSharedDirty = 0;
        info.nativePss = nativeHeap;
        info.nativePrivateDirty = nativeHeap;
        info.nativeSharedDirty = 0;

        long totalPss = value(rollup, "Pss", -1L);
        int other = totalPss >= 0 ? (int)Math.max(0L, totalPss - javaHeap - nativeHeap) : file + shared;

        info.otherPss = other;
        info.otherPrivateDirty = (int)value(rollup, "Private_Dirty", 0L) > anonymous
                                     ? (int)value(rollup, "Private_Dirty", 0L) - anonymous
                                     : 0;
        info.otherSharedDirty = (int)value(rollup, "Shared_Dirty", 0L);
        info.mPrivateClean = (int)value(rollup, "Private_Clean", 0L);
        info.mSharedClean = (int)value(rollup, "Shared_Clean", 0L);
        info.mSwappedOut = (int)value(status, "VmSwap", 0L);
        info.mStack = (int)value(status, "VmStk", 0L);
        info.mCode = (int)value(status, "VmExe", 0L) + (int)value(status, "VmLib", 0L);
    }

    public static long getPss()
    {
        Map<String, Long> rollup = readKilobytes(ROLLUP_FILE);
        long pss = value(rollup, "Pss", -1L);
        if (pss >= 0) return pss;

        return Math.max(0L, statusKilobytes("VmRSS"));
    }

    public static int setAllocationLimit(int limit)
    {
        return -1;
    }

    public static int setGlobalAllocationLimit(int limit)
    {
        return -1;
    }

    public static void printLoadedClasses(int flags)
    {
    }

    public static int getLoadedClassCount()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public static void dumpHprofData(String fileName) throws IOException
    {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("heap dumps are not supported on this runtime");
    }

    public static int getBinderSentTransactions()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public static int getBinderReceivedTransactions()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public static int getBinderLocalObjectCount()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public static int getBinderProxyObjectCount()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public static int getBinderDeathObjectCount()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public static boolean dumpService(String name, FileDescriptor descriptor, String[] arguments)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public static void attachJvmtiAgent(String library, String options, ClassLoader classLoader) throws IOException
    {
        throw new IOException("agent attachment is not supported on this runtime");
    }

    private static long javaHeapUsedBytes()
    {
        Runtime runtime = Runtime.getRuntime();
        return runtime.totalMemory() - runtime.freeMemory();
    }

    private static long statusKilobytes(String key)
    {
        return value(readKilobytes(STATUS_FILE), key, -1L);
    }

    private static long value(Map<String, Long> values, String key, long fallback)
    {
        Long value = values.get(key);
        return value == null ? fallback : value;
    }

    private static Map<String, Long> readKilobytes(String path)
    {
        Map<String, Long> values = new HashMap<>();

        try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(path)))
        {
            String line;
            while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null)
            {
                int colon = line.indexOf(':');
                if (colon <= 0) continue;

                String rest = line.substring(colon + 1).trim();
                if (!rest.endsWith("kB")) continue;

                try
                {
                    values.put(line.substring(0, colon).trim(), Long.parseLong(rest.substring(0, rest.length() - 2).trim()));
                }
                catch (NumberFormatException ignored)
                {
                    continue;
                }
            }
        }
        catch (IOException unreadable)
        {
            return values;
        }

        return values;
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/DropBoxManager.java`:

```java
package android.os;

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.Closeable;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream;

public class DropBoxManager
{
    public static final String ACTION_DROPBOX_ENTRY_ADDED = "android.intent.action.DROPBOX_ENTRY_ADDED";
    public static final String EXTRA_TAG = "tag";
    public static final String EXTRA_TIME = "time";
    public static final String EXTRA_DROPPED_COUNT = "android.os.extra.DROPPED_COUNT";

    public static final int IS_EMPTY = 1;
    public static final int IS_TEXT = 2;
    public static final int IS_GZIPPED = 4;

    private static final int MAX_ENTRIES = 64;
    private static final List<Entry> sEntries = new ArrayList<>();
    private static long sLastTime;

    protected DropBoxManager()
    {
    }

    public DropBoxManager(android.content.Context context)
    {
    }

    public void addText(String tag, String data)
    {
        if (tag == null || data == null) throw new NullPointerException("tag and data are required");
        store(new Entry(tag, nextTime(), data));
    }

    public void addData(String tag, byte[] data, int flags)
    {
        if (tag == null) throw new NullPointerException("tag");
        if ((flags & IS_EMPTY) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bad flags: " + flags);
        store(new Entry(tag, nextTime(), data, flags));
    }

    public void addFile(String tag, File file, int flags) throws IOException
    {
        if (tag == null || file == null) throw new NullPointerException("tag and file are required");
        if ((flags & IS_EMPTY) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bad flags: " + flags);
        store(new Entry(tag, nextTime(), file, flags));
    }

    public boolean isTagEnabled(String tag)
    {
        return true;
    }

    public Entry getNextEntry(String tag, long msec)
    {
        synchronized (sEntries)
        {
            for (Entry entry : sEntries)
            {
                if (entry.mTimeMillis <= msec) continue;
                if (tag != null && !tag.equals(entry.mTag)) continue;

                return new Entry(entry.mTag, entry.mTimeMillis, entry.mData, entry.mFlags);
            }
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static long nextTime()
    {
        synchronized (sEntries)
        {
            long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
            sLastTime = now <= sLastTime ? sLastTime + 1 : now;
            return sLastTime;
        }
    }

    private static void store(Entry entry)
    {
        synchronized (sEntries)
        {
            sEntries.add(entry);
            while (sEntries.size() > MAX_ENTRIES) sEntries.remove(0);
        }
    }

    public static class Entry implements Parcelable, Closeable
    {
        public static final Parcelable.Creator<Entry> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<Entry>()
        {
            @Override
            public Entry createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                String tag = source.readString();
                long millis = source.readLong();
                int flags = source.readInt();
                return new Entry(tag, millis, source.createByteArray(), flags);
            }

            @Override
            public Entry[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new Entry[size];
            }
        };

        private final String mTag;
        private final long mTimeMillis;
        private final byte[] mData;
        private final int mFlags;

        public Entry(String tag, long millis)
        {
            if (tag == null) throw new NullPointerException("tag == null");

            mTag = tag;
            mTimeMillis = millis;
            mData = null;
            mFlags = IS_EMPTY;
        }

        public Entry(String tag, long millis, String text)
        {
            if (tag == null) throw new NullPointerException("tag == null");
            if (text == null) throw new NullPointerException("text == null");

            mTag = tag;
            mTimeMillis = millis;
            mData = text.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            mFlags = IS_TEXT;
        }

        public Entry(String tag, long millis, byte[] data, int flags)
        {
            if (tag == null) throw new NullPointerException("tag == null");
            if (((flags & IS_EMPTY) != 0) != (data == null)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bad flags: " + flags);

            mTag = tag;
            mTimeMillis = millis;
            mData = data == null ? null : data.clone();
            mFlags = flags;
        }

        public Entry(String tag, long millis, ParcelFileDescriptor data, int flags)
        {
            this(tag, millis, readAll(data), flags);
        }

        public Entry(String tag, long millis, File data, int flags) throws IOException
        {
            this(tag, millis, readFile(data), flags);
        }

        private static byte[] readAll(ParcelFileDescriptor descriptor)
        {
            if (descriptor == null) return null;

            try (InputStream input = new ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(descriptor))
            {
                return readStream(input);
            }
            catch (IOException unreadable)
            {
                return new byte[0];
            }
        }

        private static byte[] readFile(File file) throws IOException
        {
            try (InputStream input = new FileInputStream(file))
            {
                return readStream(input);
            }
        }

        private static byte[] readStream(InputStream input) throws IOException
        {
            java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream output = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
            byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
            int count;
            while ((count = input.read(buffer)) > 0) output.write(buffer, 0, count);
            return output.toByteArray();
        }

        @Override
        public void close()
        {
        }

        public String getTag()
        {
            return mTag;
        }

        public long getTimeMillis()
        {
            return mTimeMillis;
        }

        public int getFlags()
        {
            return mFlags & ~IS_GZIPPED;
        }

        public String getText(int maxBytes)
        {
            if ((mFlags & IS_TEXT) == 0 || mData == null) return null;

            try (InputStream input = getInputStream())
            {
                if (input == null) return null;

                byte[] buffer = new byte[Math.max(0, maxBytes)];
                int total = 0;
                while (total < buffer.length)
                {
                    int count = input.read(buffer, total, buffer.length - total);
                    if (count < 0) break;
                    total += count;
                }
                return new String(buffer, 0, total, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            }
            catch (IOException unreadable)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        public InputStream getInputStream() throws IOException
        {
            if (mData == null) return null;

            InputStream input = new ByteArrayInputStream(mData);
            return (mFlags & IS_GZIPPED) != 0 ? new GZIPInputStream(input) : input;
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
        {
            dest.writeString(mTag);
            dest.writeLong(mTimeMillis);
            dest.writeInt(mFlags);
            dest.writeByteArray(mData);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/FileObserver.java`:

```java
package android.os;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;

public abstract class FileObserver
{
    public static final int ACCESS = 0x00000001;
    public static final int MODIFY = 0x00000002;
    public static final int ATTRIB = 0x00000004;
    public static final int CLOSE_WRITE = 0x00000008;
    public static final int CLOSE_NOWRITE = 0x00000010;
    public static final int OPEN = 0x00000020;
    public static final int MOVED_FROM = 0x00000040;
    public static final int MOVED_TO = 0x00000080;
    public static final int CREATE = 0x00000100;
    public static final int DELETE = 0x00000200;
    public static final int DELETE_SELF = 0x00000400;
    public static final int MOVE_SELF = 0x00000800;
    public static final int ALL_EVENTS = ACCESS | MODIFY | ATTRIB | CLOSE_WRITE | CLOSE_NOWRITE | OPEN | MOVED_FROM | MOVED_TO | DELETE
                                         | CREATE | DELETE_SELF | MOVE_SELF;

    private static final String TAG = "FileObserver";
    private static final long POLL_INTERVAL_MILLIS = 1000L;

    private static final CopyOnWriteArrayList<FileObserver> sActive = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    private static Thread sPoller;

    private final List<File> mFiles;
    private final int mMask;
    private final Map<File, Map<String, long[]>> mSnapshots = new HashMap<>();

    public FileObserver(String path)
    {
        this(new File(path));
    }

    public FileObserver(File file)
    {
        this(Collections.singletonList(file));
    }

    public FileObserver(List<File> files)
    {
        this(files, ALL_EVENTS);
    }

    public FileObserver(String path, int mask)
    {
        this(new File(path), mask);
    }

    public FileObserver(File file, int mask)
    {
        this(Collections.singletonList(file), mask);
    }

    public FileObserver(List<File> files, int mask)
    {
        mFiles = new ArrayList<>(files);
        mMask = mask;
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize()
    {
        stopWatching();
    }

    public void startWatching()
    {
        synchronized (mSnapshots)
        {
            mSnapshots.clear();
            for (File file : mFiles) mSnapshots.put(file, snapshot(file));
        }

        if (!sActive.addIfAbsent(this)) return;

        synchronized (FileObserver.class)
        {
            if (sPoller != null) return;

            sPoller = new Thread(new Runnable()
            {
                @Override
                public void run()
                {
                    poll();
                }
            }, TAG);
            sPoller.setDaemon(true);
            sPoller.start();
        }
    }

    public void stopWatching()
    {
        sActive.remove(this);
    }

    public abstract void onEvent(int event, String path);

    private static void poll()
    {
        for (;;)
        {
            try
            {
                Thread.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_MILLIS);
            }
            catch (InterruptedException interrupted)
            {
                synchronized (FileObserver.class)
                {
                    sPoller = null;
                }
                return;
            }

            for (FileObserver observer : sActive)
            {
                try
                {
                    observer.check();
                }
                catch (Throwable failure)
                {
                    android.util.Log.e(TAG, "an observer threw while handling a file event", failure);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void check()
    {
        for (File file : mFiles)
        {
            Map<String, long[]> previous;
            Map<String, long[]> current = snapshot(file);

            synchronized (mSnapshots)
            {
                previous = mSnapshots.put(file, current);
            }

            if (previous == null) continue;

            for (Map.Entry<String, long[]> entry : previous.entrySet())
            {
                String name = entry.getKey();
                long[] now = current.get(name);

                if (now == null)
                {
                    dispatch(name.isEmpty() ? DELETE_SELF : DELETE, name.isEmpty() ? null : name);
                    continue;
                }

                long[] before = entry.getValue();
                if (before[0] != now[0] || before[1] != now[1])
                {
                    dispatch(MODIFY, name.isEmpty() ? null : name);
                    dispatch(CLOSE_WRITE, name.isEmpty() ? null : name);
                }
            }

            for (String name : current.keySet())
            {
                if (!previous.containsKey(name)) dispatch(CREATE, name.isEmpty() ? null : name);
            }
        }
    }

    private void dispatch(int event, String path)
    {
        if ((mMask & event) != 0) onEvent(event, path);
    }

    private static Map<String, long[]> snapshot(File file)
    {
        Map<String, long[]> entries = new HashMap<>();
        if (!file.exists()) return entries;

        entries.put("", new long[] {file.isDirectory() ? 0L : file.lastModified(), file.isDirectory() ? 0L : file.length()});

        if (!file.isDirectory()) return entries;

        File[] children = file.listFiles();
        if (children == null) return entries;

        for (File child : children) entries.put(child.getName(), new long[] {child.lastModified(), child.length()});
        return entries;
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/FileUtils.java`:

```java
package android.os;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;

public final class FileUtils
{
    private static final int BUFFER_BYTES = 8192;

    private FileUtils()
    {
    }

    public static long copy(InputStream from, OutputStream to) throws IOException
    {
        return copy(from, to, null, null, null);
    }

    public static long copy(InputStream from, OutputStream to, CancellationSignal signal, java.util.concurrent.Executor executor,
                            ProgressListener listener) throws IOException
    {
        if (from == null || to == null) return 0;

        byte[] buffer = new byte[BUFFER_BYTES];
        long total = 0;

        while (true)
        {
            if (signal != null) signal.throwIfCanceled();

            int read = from.read(buffer);
            if (read < 0) break;

            to.write(buffer, 0, read);
            total += read;

            if (listener != null) listener.onProgress(total);
        }

        return total;
    }

    public static long copy(File from, File to) throws IOException
    {
        try (InputStream in = new FileInputStream(from); OutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(to))
        {
            return copy(in, out);
        }
    }

    public static boolean contains(File directory, File file)
    {
        if (directory == null || file == null) return false;

        String directoryPath = directory.getAbsolutePath();
        String filePath = file.getAbsolutePath();

        if (directoryPath.equals(filePath)) return true;

        if (!directoryPath.endsWith("/")) directoryPath = directoryPath + "/";

        return filePath.startsWith(directoryPath);
    }

    public static boolean deleteContents(File directory)
    {
        if (directory == null) return true;

        File[] entries = directory.listFiles();
        boolean removed = true;

        if (entries == null) return true;

        for (File entry : entries)
        {
            if (entry.isDirectory()) removed &= deleteContents(entry);

            if (!entry.delete()) removed = false;
        }

        return removed;
    }

    public static boolean deleteContentsAndDir(File directory)
    {
        return deleteContents(directory) && (directory == null || directory.delete());
    }

    public interface ProgressListener
    {
        void onProgress(long progress);
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/Handler.java`:
