```java
package android.os;

public class Handler
{
    private final Looper mLooper;
    private final MessageQueue mQueue;
    private final Callback mCallback;

    public Handler()
    {
        this(null, null);
    }

    public Handler(Callback callback)
    {
        this(null, callback);
    }

    public Handler(Looper looper)
    {
        this(looper, null);
    }

    public Handler(Looper looper, Callback callback)
    {
        Looper resolved = looper;
        if (resolved == null)
        {
            resolved = Looper.myLooper();
            if (resolved == null)
            {
                throw new RuntimeException("Can't create handler inside thread " + Thread.currentThread()
                        + " that has not called Looper.prepare()");
            }
        }

        mLooper = resolved;
        mQueue = resolved.mQueue;
        mCallback = callback;
    }

    public static Handler createAsync(Looper looper)
    {
        return new Handler(looper);
    }

    public static Handler createAsync(Looper looper, Callback callback)
    {
        return new Handler(looper, callback);
    }

    public String getMessageName(Message message)
    {
        if (message.callback != null) return message.callback.getClass().getName();
        return "0x" + Integer.toHexString(message.what);
    }

    public final Looper getLooper()
    {
        return mLooper;
    }

    public void handleMessage(Message message)
    {
    }

    public void dispatchMessage(Message message)
    {
        if (message.callback != null)
        {
            message.callback.run();
            return;
        }

        if (mCallback != null && mCallback.handleMessage(message)) return;

        handleMessage(message);
    }

    public final boolean post(Runnable runnable)
    {
        return sendMessageDelayed(Message.obtain(this, runnable), 0);
    }

    public final boolean postDelayed(Runnable runnable, long delayMillis)
    {
        return sendMessageDelayed(Message.obtain(this, runnable), delayMillis);
    }

    public final boolean postAtTime(Runnable runnable, long uptimeMillis)
    {
        return sendMessageAtTime(Message.obtain(this, runnable), uptimeMillis);
    }

    public final boolean postAtTime(Runnable runnable, Object token, long uptimeMillis)
    {
        Message message = Message.obtain(this, runnable);
        message.obj = token;
        return sendMessageAtTime(message, uptimeMillis);
    }

    public final boolean postDelayed(Runnable runnable, Object token, long delayMillis)
    {
        Message message = Message.obtain(this, runnable);
        message.obj = token;
        return sendMessageDelayed(message, delayMillis);
    }

    public final boolean postAtFrontOfQueue(Runnable runnable)
    {
        return sendMessageAtTime(Message.obtain(this, runnable), 0);
    }

    public final boolean sendEmptyMessageAtTime(int what, long uptimeMillis)
    {
        return sendMessageAtTime(Message.obtain(this, what), uptimeMillis);
    }

    public final boolean sendMessageAtFrontOfQueue(Message message)
    {
        message.target = this;
        return mQueue.enqueueMessage(message, 0);
    }

    public final boolean hasMessages(int what)
    {
        return mQueue.hasMessages(this, null, null, true, what);
    }

    public final boolean hasMessages(int what, Object token)
    {
        return mQueue.hasMessages(this, null, token, true, what);
    }

    public final boolean hasCallbacks(Runnable runnable)
    {
        return runnable != null && mQueue.hasMessages(this, runnable, null, false, 0);
    }

    public final boolean hasMessagesOrCallbacks()
    {
        return mQueue.hasMessages(this, null, null, false, 0);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Handler (" + getClass().getName() + ") {" + Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(this)) + "}";
    }

    public final Message obtainMessage()
    {
        return Message.obtain(this);
    }

    public final Message obtainMessage(int what)
    {
        return Message.obtain(this, what);
    }

    public final Message obtainMessage(int what, Object object)
    {
        return Message.obtain(this, what, object);
    }

    public final Message obtainMessage(int what, int arg1, int arg2)
    {
        return Message.obtain(this, what, arg1, arg2);
    }

    public final Message obtainMessage(int what, int arg1, int arg2, Object object)
    {
        return Message.obtain(this, what, arg1, arg2, object);
    }

    public final boolean sendMessage(Message message)
    {
        return sendMessageDelayed(message, 0);
    }

    public final boolean sendEmptyMessage(int what)
    {
        return sendEmptyMessageDelayed(what, 0);
    }

    public final boolean sendEmptyMessageDelayed(int what, long delayMillis)
    {
        return sendMessageDelayed(Message.obtain(this, what), delayMillis);
    }

    public final boolean sendMessageDelayed(Message message, long delayMillis)
    {
        long delay = delayMillis < 0 ? 0 : delayMillis;
        return sendMessageAtTime(message, SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + delay);
    }

    public boolean sendMessageAtTime(Message message, long uptimeMillis)
    {
        message.target = this;
        return mQueue.enqueueMessage(message, uptimeMillis);
    }

    public final void removeCallbacks(Runnable runnable)
    {
        mQueue.removeCallbacksAndMessages(this, runnable, null);
    }

    public final void removeCallbacks(Runnable runnable, Object token)
    {
        mQueue.removeCallbacksAndMessages(this, runnable, token);
    }

    public final void removeCallbacksAndMessages(Object token)
    {
        mQueue.removeCallbacksAndMessages(this, null, token);
    }

    public final void removeMessages(int what)
    {
        mQueue.removeMessages(this, what, null);
    }

    public final void removeMessages(int what, Object token)
    {
        mQueue.removeMessages(this, what, token);
    }

    public interface Callback
    {
        boolean handleMessage(Message message);
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/HandlerThread.java`:

```java
package android.os;

public class HandlerThread extends Thread
{
    private final int mPriority;
    private Looper mLooper;
    private int mThreadId = -1;

    public HandlerThread(String name)
    {
        this(name, Process.THREAD_PRIORITY_DEFAULT);
    }

    public HandlerThread(String name, int priority)
    {
        super(name);
        mPriority = priority;
    }

    protected void onLooperPrepared()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public void run()
    {
        mThreadId = Process.myTid();
        Looper.prepare();

        synchronized (this)
        {
            mLooper = Looper.myLooper();
            notifyAll();
        }

        Process.setThreadPriority(mPriority);
        onLooperPrepared();
        Looper.loop();

        mThreadId = -1;
    }

    public Looper getLooper()
    {
        if (!isAlive()) return null;

        synchronized (this)
        {
            while (isAlive() && mLooper == null)
            {
                try
                {
                    wait();
                }
                catch (InterruptedException interrupted)
                {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }

        return mLooper;
    }

    public boolean quit()
    {
        Looper looper = getLooper();
        if (looper == null) return false;

        looper.quit();
        return true;
    }

    public boolean quitSafely()
    {
        return quit();
    }

    public int getThreadId()
    {
        return mThreadId;
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/LocaleList.java`:

```java
package android.os;

import java.util.Locale;

public final class LocaleList
{
    private static final LocaleList EMPTY = new LocaleList();
    private static LocaleList sDefault = new LocaleList(Locale.US);

    private final Locale[] mList;

    public LocaleList(Locale... list)
    {
        mList = list == null ? new Locale[0] : list.clone();
    }

    public Locale get(int index)
    {
        return index >= 0 && index < mList.length ? mList[index] : null;
    }

    public boolean isEmpty()
    {
        return mList.length == 0;
    }

    public int size()
    {
        return mList.length;
    }

    public int indexOf(Locale locale)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mList.length; index++)
        {
            if (mList[index].equals(locale)) return index;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    public static LocaleList getEmptyLocaleList()
    {
        return EMPTY;
    }

    public static LocaleList getDefault()
    {
        return sDefault;
    }

    public static LocaleList getAdjustedDefault()
    {
        return sDefault;
    }

    public static void setDefault(LocaleList locales)
    {
        if (locales == null || locales.isEmpty()) return;

        sDefault = locales;
        Locale.setDefault(locales.get(0));
    }

    public String toLanguageTags()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        for (int index = 0; index < mList.length; index++)
        {
            if (index > 0) builder.append(',');
            builder.append(mList[index].toLanguageTag());
        }
        return builder.toString();
    }

    public static boolean matchesLanguageAndScript(Locale supported, Locale desired)
    {
        if (supported == null || desired == null) return false;
        if (supported.equals(desired)) return true;
        if (!supported.getLanguage().equals(desired.getLanguage())) return false;

        return likelyScript(supported).equals(likelyScript(desired));
    }

    private static String likelyScript(Locale locale)
    {
        String script = locale.getScript();
        if (!script.isEmpty()) return script;

        String language = locale.getLanguage();
        String country = locale.getCountry();

        if ("zh".equals(language))
        {
            return "TW".equals(country) || "HK".equals(country) || "MO".equals(country) ? "Hant" : "Hans";
        }
        if ("sr".equals(language)) return "Cyrl";
        if ("ru".equals(language) || "uk".equals(language) || "bg".equals(language) || "be".equals(language)) return "Cyrl";
        if ("ar".equals(language) || "fa".equals(language) || "ur".equals(language)) return "Arab";
        if ("ja".equals(language)) return "Jpan";
        if ("ko".equals(language)) return "Kore";
        if ("el".equals(language)) return "Grek";
        if ("he".equals(language) || "iw".equals(language) || "yi".equals(language)) return "Hebr";
        if ("hi".equals(language) || "mr".equals(language) || "ne".equals(language)) return "Deva";
        if ("th".equals(language)) return "Thai";
        return "Latn";
    }

    public Locale getFirstMatch(String[] supportedLocales)
    {
        if (supportedLocales == null || supportedLocales.length == 0) return mList.length == 0 ? null : mList[0];

        Locale[] supported = new Locale[supportedLocales.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < supportedLocales.length; index++)
        {
            supported[index] = Locale.forLanguageTag(supportedLocales[index]);
        }

        for (Locale desired : mList)
        {
            for (Locale candidate : supported)
            {
                if (candidate.equals(desired)) return candidate;
            }

            for (Locale candidate : supported)
            {
                if (matchesLanguageAndScript(candidate, desired)) return candidate;
            }
        }

        return supported[0];
    }

    public static LocaleList forLanguageTags(String tags)
    {
        if (tags == null || tags.isEmpty()) return EMPTY;

        String[] parts = tags.split(",");
        Locale[] locales = new Locale[parts.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < parts.length; index++)
        {
            locales[index] = Locale.forLanguageTag(parts[index]);
        }
        return new LocaleList(locales);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof LocaleList)) return false;

        return java.util.Arrays.equals(mList, ((LocaleList)other).mList);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return java.util.Arrays.hashCode(mList);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "LocaleList[" + toLanguageTags() + "]";
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/Looper.java`:

```java
package android.os;

public final class Looper
{
    private static final ThreadLocal<Looper> THREAD_LOOPER = new ThreadLocal<>();
    private static Looper sMainLooper;

    final MessageQueue mQueue;
    final Thread mThread;
    private volatile android.util.Printer mLogging;

    private Looper(boolean quitAllowed)
    {
        mQueue = new MessageQueue(quitAllowed);
        mThread = Thread.currentThread();
    }

    public static void prepare()
    {
        prepare(true);
    }

    private static void prepare(boolean quitAllowed)
    {
        if (THREAD_LOOPER.get() != null) throw new RuntimeException("Only one Looper may be created per thread");
        THREAD_LOOPER.set(new Looper(quitAllowed));
    }

    public static void prepareMainLooper()
    {
        prepare(false);
        synchronized (Looper.class)
        {
            if (sMainLooper != null) throw new IllegalStateException("The main Looper has already been prepared");
            sMainLooper = myLooper();
        }
    }

    public static Looper getMainLooper()
    {
        synchronized (Looper.class)
        {
            return sMainLooper;
        }
    }

    public static Looper myLooper()
    {
        return THREAD_LOOPER.get();
    }

    public static MessageQueue myQueue()
    {
        Looper looper = myLooper();
        if (looper == null) throw new IllegalStateException("No Looper on this thread");
        return looper.mQueue;
    }

    public static void loop()
    {
        Looper looper = myLooper();
        if (looper == null) throw new RuntimeException("No Looper; Looper.prepare() wasn't called on this thread");

        for (;;)
        {
            Message message = looper.mQueue.next();
            if (message == null) return;

            android.util.Printer logging = looper.mLogging;
            if (logging != null)
            {
                logging.println(">>>>> Dispatching to " + message.target + " " + message.callback + ": " + message.what);
            }

            message.target.dispatchMessage(message);

            if (logging != null) logging.println("<<<<< Finished to " + message.target + " " + message.callback);

            message.recycleUnchecked();
        }
    }

    public void setMessageLogging(android.util.Printer printer)
    {
        mLogging = printer;
    }

    public void dump(android.util.Printer printer, String prefix)
    {
        printer.println(prefix + toString());
        printer.println(prefix + "  (MessageQueue idle=" + mQueue.isIdle() + ")");
    }

    public MessageQueue getQueue()
    {
        return mQueue;
    }

    public Thread getThread()
    {
        return mThread;
    }

    public boolean isCurrentThread()
    {
        return Thread.currentThread() == mThread;
    }

    public static void quitMainLooper()
    {
        Looper main = getMainLooper();
        if (main != null) main.mQueue.forceQuit(true);
    }

    public void quit()
    {
        mQueue.quit(false);
    }

    public void quitSafely()
    {
        mQueue.quit(true);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Looper{" + mThread.getName() + '}';
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/MemoryFile.java`:

```java
package android.os;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;

public class MemoryFile
{
    private final String mName;
    private byte[] mData;
    private boolean mAllowPurging = false;

    public MemoryFile(String name, int length) throws IOException
    {
        if (length < 0) throw new IOException("Invalid length: " + length);

        mName = name;
        mData = new byte[length];
    }

    public void close()
    {
        mData = null;
    }

    public int length()
    {
        return mData == null ? 0 : mData.length;
    }

    public boolean isPurgingAllowed()
    {
        return mAllowPurging;
    }

    public synchronized boolean allowPurging(boolean allowPurging) throws IOException
    {
        boolean oldValue = mAllowPurging;
        mAllowPurging = allowPurging;
        return oldValue;
    }

    public InputStream getInputStream()
    {
        return new MemoryInputStream();
    }

    public OutputStream getOutputStream()
    {
        return new MemoryOutputStream();
    }

    public int readBytes(byte[] buffer, int srcOffset, int destOffset, int count) throws IOException
    {
        byte[] data = checkOpen();
        if (destOffset < 0 || destOffset > buffer.length || count < 0 || count > buffer.length - destOffset || srcOffset < 0
            || srcOffset > data.length || count > data.length - srcOffset)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
        }

        System.arraycopy(data, srcOffset, buffer, destOffset, count);
        return count;
    }

    public void writeBytes(byte[] buffer, int srcOffset, int destOffset, int count) throws IOException
    {
        byte[] data = checkOpen();
        if (srcOffset < 0 || srcOffset > buffer.length || count < 0 || count > buffer.length - srcOffset || destOffset < 0
            || destOffset > data.length || count > data.length - destOffset)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
        }

        System.arraycopy(buffer, srcOffset, data, destOffset, count);
    }

    private byte[] checkOpen() throws IOException
    {
        byte[] data = mData;
        if (data == null) throw new IOException("MemoryFile " + mName + " is closed");
        return data;
    }

    private class MemoryInputStream extends InputStream
    {
        private int mMark = 0;
        private int mOffset = 0;
        private byte[] mSingleByte;

        @Override
        public int available() throws IOException
        {
            if (mOffset >= length()) return 0;
            return length() - mOffset;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean markSupported()
        {
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public void mark(int readLimit)
        {
            mMark = mOffset;
        }

        @Override
        public void reset() throws IOException
        {
            mOffset = mMark;
        }

        @Override
        public int read() throws IOException
        {
            if (mSingleByte == null) mSingleByte = new byte[1];

            int result = read(mSingleByte, 0, 1);
            if (result != 1) return -1;
            return mSingleByte[0] & 0xff;
        }

        @Override
        public int read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) throws IOException
        {
            if (offset < 0 || count < 0 || offset + count > buffer.length) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();

            count = Math.min(count, available());
            if (count < 1) return -1;

            int result = readBytes(buffer, mOffset, offset, count);
            if (result > 0) mOffset += result;
            return result;
        }

        @Override
        public long skip(long n) throws IOException
        {
            if (mOffset + n > length()) n = length() - mOffset;
            mOffset += (int)n;
            return n;
        }
    }

    private class MemoryOutputStream extends OutputStream
    {
        private int mOffset = 0;
        private byte[] mSingleByte;

        @Override
        public void write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) throws IOException
        {
            writeBytes(buffer, offset, mOffset, count);
            mOffset += count;
        }

        @Override
        public void write(int oneByte) throws IOException
        {
            if (mSingleByte == null) mSingleByte = new byte[1];

            mSingleByte[0] = (byte)oneByte;
            write(mSingleByte, 0, 1);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/Message.java`:

```java
package android.os;

public final class Message implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<Message> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<Message>()
    {
        @Override
        public Message createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            Message message = Message.obtain();
            message.what = source.readInt();
            message.arg1 = source.readInt();
            message.arg2 = source.readInt();
            message.obj = source.readValue(null);
            message.when = source.readLong();
            message.mData = source.readBundle();
            message.replyTo = Messenger.readMessengerOrNullFromParcel(source);
            message.sendingUid = source.readInt();
            return message;
        }

        @Override
        public Message[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Message[size];
        }
    };

    private static final Object POOL_LOCK = new Object();
    private static final int MAX_POOL_SIZE = 50;

    private static Message sPool;
    private static int sPoolSize;

    public int what;
    public int arg1;
    public int arg2;
    public Object obj;
    public Messenger replyTo;
    public int sendingUid = -1;

    Handler target;
    Runnable callback;
    long when;
    Message next;
    boolean inUse;

    public Message()
    {
    }

    public static Message obtain()
    {
        synchronized (POOL_LOCK)
        {
            if (sPool != null)
            {
                Message message = sPool;
                sPool = message.next;
                message.next = null;
                message.inUse = false;
                sPoolSize--;
                return message;
            }
        }
        return new Message();
    }

    public boolean isInUse()
    {
        return inUse;
    }

    public static Message obtain(Handler target)
    {
        Message message = obtain();
        message.target = target;
        return message;
    }

    public static Message obtain(Handler target, int what)
    {
        Message message = obtain(target);
        message.what = what;
        return message;
    }

    public static Message obtain(Handler target, Runnable callback)
    {
        Message message = obtain(target);
        message.callback = callback;
        return message;
    }

    public static Message obtain(Handler target, int what, Object object)
    {
        Message message = obtain(target, what);
        message.obj = object;
        return message;
    }

    public static Message obtain(Handler target, int what, int arg1, int arg2)
    {
        Message message = obtain(target, what);
        message.arg1 = arg1;
        message.arg2 = arg2;
        return message;
    }

    public static Message obtain(Handler target, int what, int arg1, int arg2, Object object)
    {
        Message message = obtain(target, what, arg1, arg2);
        message.obj = object;
        return message;
    }

    public static Message obtain(Message other)
    {
        Message message = obtain();

        if (other == null) return message;

        message.what = other.what;
        message.arg1 = other.arg1;
        message.arg2 = other.arg2;
        message.obj = other.obj;
        message.callback = other.callback;
        message.replyTo = other.replyTo;
        message.sendingUid = other.sendingUid;
        if (other.mData != null) message.mData = new Bundle(other.mData);
        message.setTarget(other.getTarget());

        return message;
    }

    public Handler getTarget()
    {
        return target;
    }

    private Bundle mData;

    public void setData(Bundle data)
    {
        mData = data;
    }

    public Bundle getData()
    {
        if (mData == null) mData = new Bundle();

        return mData;
    }

    public Bundle peekData()
    {
        return mData;
    }

    private boolean mAsynchronous;

    public void setAsynchronous(boolean asynchronous)
    {
        mAsynchronous = asynchronous;
    }

    public boolean isAsynchronous()
    {
        return mAsynchronous;
    }

    public void setTarget(Handler target)
    {
        this.target = target;
    }

    public Runnable getCallback()
    {
        return callback;
    }

    public long getWhen()
    {
        return when;
    }

    public void sendToTarget()
    {
        target.sendMessage(this);
    }

    public void recycle()
    {
        if (inUse) throw new IllegalStateException("This message cannot be recycled because it is still in use.");
        recycleUnchecked();
    }

    void recycleUnchecked()
    {
        what = 0;
        arg1 = 0;
        arg2 = 0;
        obj = null;
        target = null;
        callback = null;
        replyTo = null;
        sendingUid = -1;
        mData = null;
        mAsynchronous = false;
        when = 0;
        next = null;
        inUse = true;

        synchronized (POOL_LOCK)
        {
            if (sPoolSize >= MAX_POOL_SIZE) return;
            next = sPool;
            sPool = this;
            sPoolSize++;
        }
    }

    public void copyFrom(Message other)
    {
        what = other.what;
        arg1 = other.arg1;
        arg2 = other.arg2;
        obj = other.obj;
        replyTo = other.replyTo;
        sendingUid = other.sendingUid;
        mData = other.mData == null ? null : new Bundle(other.mData);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        if (callback != null) throw new RuntimeException("Can't marshal callbacks across processes.");

        dest.writeInt(what);
        dest.writeInt(arg1);
        dest.writeInt(arg2);
        dest.writeValue(obj);
        dest.writeLong(when);
        dest.writeBundle(mData);
        Messenger.writeMessengerOrNullToParcel(replyTo, dest);
        dest.writeInt(sendingUid);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Message{what=" + what + " when=" + when + '}';
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/MessageQueue.java`:

```java
package android.os;

public final class MessageQueue
{
    private final boolean mQuitAllowed;
    private Message mMessages;
    private boolean mQuitting;
    private runtime.Poller mPoller;
    private boolean mBlocked;
    private boolean mPendingWake;

    MessageQueue(boolean quitAllowed)
    {
        mQuitAllowed = quitAllowed;
    }

    public void setPoller(runtime.Poller poller)
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            mPoller = poller;
        }
    }

    public boolean isIdle()
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            return mMessages == null || SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < mMessages.when;
        }
    }

    public interface IdleHandler
    {
        boolean queueIdle();
    }

    private final java.util.ArrayList<IdleHandler> mIdleHandlers = new java.util.ArrayList<>();

    public void addIdleHandler(IdleHandler handler)
    {
        if (handler == null) throw new NullPointerException("the idle handler is required");

        synchronized (this)
        {
            mIdleHandlers.add(handler);
        }
    }

    public void removeIdleHandler(IdleHandler handler)
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            mIdleHandlers.remove(handler);
        }
    }

    private void runIdleHandlers()
    {
        IdleHandler[] pending;

        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mIdleHandlers.isEmpty()) return;

            pending = mIdleHandlers.toArray(new IdleHandler[0]);
        }

        for (IdleHandler handler : pending)
        {
            boolean keep;

            try
            {
                keep = handler.queueIdle();
            }
            catch (Throwable failure)
            {
                android.util.Log.e("MessageQueue", "an idle handler threw", failure);
                keep = false;
            }

            if (!keep) removeIdleHandler(handler);
        }
    }

    boolean enqueueMessage(Message message, long when)
    {
        if (message.target == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Message must have a target");
        if (message.isInUse()) throw new IllegalStateException(message + " This message is already in use.");

        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mQuitting)
            {
                message.recycleUnchecked();
                return false;
            }

            message.inUse = true;
            message.when = when;

            Message cursor = mMessages;
            if (cursor == null || when < cursor.when)
            {
                message.next = cursor;
                mMessages = message;
            }
            else
            {
                Message previous;
                do
                {
                    previous = cursor;
                    cursor = cursor.next;
                }
                while (cursor != null && when >= cursor.when);

                message.next = cursor;
                previous.next = message;
            }

            wakeLocked();
            return true;
        }
    }

    private void wakeLocked()
    {
        mPendingWake = true;
        notifyAll();

        if (mPoller != null && mBlocked) mPoller.wake();
    }

    Message next()
    {
        for (;;)
        {
            long waitMillis;
            runtime.Poller poller;
            boolean idle;

            synchronized (this)
            {
                long now = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
                if (mMessages != null && now >= mMessages.when)
                {
                    Message message = mMessages;
                    mMessages = message.next;
                    message.next = null;
                    message.inUse = true;
                    return message;
                }

                if (mQuitting) return null;

                waitMillis = mMessages == null ? -1 : mMessages.when - now;
                poller = mPoller;
                idle = !mIdleHandlers.isEmpty();

                if (poller == null && !idle)
                {
                    awaitLocked(waitMillis);
                    continue;
                }

                mPendingWake = false;
                mBlocked = true;
            }

            if (idle)
            {
                runIdleHandlers();

                synchronized (this)
                {
                    mBlocked = false;
                }

                continue;
            }

            poller.poll(waitMillis);

            synchronized (this)
            {
                mBlocked = false;
            }
        }
    }

    private void awaitLocked(long waitMillis)
    {
        if (mPendingWake)
        {
            mPendingWake = false;
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            wait(waitMillis < 0 ? 0 : waitMillis);
        }
        catch (InterruptedException interrupted)
        {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            mPendingWake = false;
            throw new IllegalStateException("looper thread interrupted while waiting for messages", interrupted);
        }

        mPendingWake = false;
    }

    boolean hasMessages(Handler handler, Runnable callback, Object token, boolean matchWhat, int what)
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            for (Message cursor = mMessages; cursor != null; cursor = cursor.next)
            {
                if (matches(cursor, handler, callback, token, matchWhat, what)) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
    }

    void removeCallbacksAndMessages(Handler handler, Runnable callback, Object token)
    {
        remove(handler, callback, token, false, 0);
    }

    void removeMessages(Handler handler, int what, Object token)
    {
        remove(handler, null, token, true, what);
    }

    private void remove(Handler handler, Runnable callback, Object token, boolean matchWhat, int what)
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            while (mMessages != null && matches(mMessages, handler, callback, token, matchWhat, what))
            {
                Message removed = mMessages;
                mMessages = removed.next;
                removed.recycleUnchecked();
            }

            Message cursor = mMessages;
            while (cursor != null)
            {
                Message following = cursor.next;
                if (following != null && matches(following, handler, callback, token, matchWhat, what))
                {
                    cursor.next = following.next;
                    following.recycleUnchecked();
                    continue;
                }
                cursor = following;
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean matches(Message message, Handler handler, Runnable callback, Object token, boolean matchWhat, int what)
    {
        if (message.target != handler) return false;
        if (callback != null && message.callback != callback) return false;
        if (token != null && message.obj != token) return false;
        if (matchWhat && message.what != what) return false;
        return true;
    }

    void quit(boolean flush)
    {
        if (!mQuitAllowed) throw new IllegalStateException("Main thread not allowed to quit");
        forceQuit(flush);
    }

    void forceQuit(boolean flush)
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mQuitting) return;
            mQuitting = true;

            if (flush)
            {
                removeFutureMessages(SystemClock.uptimeMillis());
            }
            else
            {
                removeAllMessages();
            }

            wakeLocked();
        }
    }

    private void removeAllMessages()
    {
        while (mMessages != null)
        {
            Message removed = mMessages;
            mMessages = removed.next;
            removed.recycleUnchecked();
        }
    }

    private void removeFutureMessages(long now)
    {
        while (mMessages != null && mMessages.when > now)
        {
            Message removed = mMessages;
            mMessages = removed.next;
            removed.recycleUnchecked();
        }

        Message cursor = mMessages;
        while (cursor != null)
        {
            Message following = cursor.next;
            if (following != null && following.when > now)
            {
                cursor.next = following.next;
                following.recycleUnchecked();
                continue;
            }
            cursor = following;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/Messenger.java`:

```java
package android.os;

public final class Messenger implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<Messenger> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<Messenger>()
    {
        @Override
        public Messenger createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return readMessengerOrNullFromParcel(source);
        }

        @Override
        public Messenger[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Messenger[size];
        }
    };

    private static final class HandlerBinder extends Binder
    {
        final Handler handler;

        HandlerBinder(Handler handler)
        {
            this.handler = handler;
        }
    }

    private final IBinder mTarget;

    public Messenger(Handler target)
    {
        mTarget = new HandlerBinder(target);
    }

    public Messenger(IBinder target)
    {
        mTarget = target;
    }

    public void send(Message message) throws RemoteException
    {
        if (!(mTarget instanceof HandlerBinder)) throw new DeadObjectException("the messenger's target lives in another process");

        Handler handler = ((HandlerBinder)mTarget).handler;
        if (handler == null || !handler.sendMessage(message)) throw new DeadObjectException("the messenger's handler is gone");
    }

    public IBinder getBinder()
    {
        return mTarget;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        return other instanceof Messenger && mTarget.equals(((Messenger)other).mTarget);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mTarget.hashCode();
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
    {
        out.writeValue(this);
    }

    public static void writeMessengerOrNullToParcel(Messenger messenger, Parcel out)
    {
        out.writeValue(messenger);
    }

    public static Messenger readMessengerOrNullFromParcel(Parcel in)
    {
        Object value = in == null ? null : in.readValue(null);
        return value instanceof Messenger ? (Messenger)value : null;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.os;

import android.util.ArrayMap;
import android.util.SparseArray;
import android.util.SparseBooleanArray;

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.ObjectInputStream;
import java.io.ObjectOutputStream;
import java.io.ObjectStreamClass;
import java.io.Serializable;
import java.lang.reflect.Array;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.function.IntFunction;

public final class Parcel
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<String> STRING_CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<String>()
    {
        @Override
        public String createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return source.readString();
        }

        @Override
        public String[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new String[size];
        }
    };

    private static final String TAG = "Parcel";

    private static final int EX_SECURITY = -1;
    private static final int EX_BAD_PARCELABLE = -2;
    private static final int EX_ILLEGAL_ARGUMENT = -3;
    private static final int EX_NULL_POINTER = -4;
    private static final int EX_ILLEGAL_STATE = -5;
    private static final int EX_NETWORK_MAIN_THREAD = -6;
    private static final int EX_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION = -7;
    private static final int EX_PARCELABLE = -9;
    private static final int EX_HAS_NOTED_APPOPS_REPLY_HEADER = -127;
    private static final int EX_HAS_STRICTMODE_REPLY_HEADER = -128;

    private static final int VAL_NULL = -1;
    private static final int VAL_STRING = 0;
    private static final int VAL_INTEGER = 1;
    private static final int VAL_MAP = 2;
    private static final int VAL_BUNDLE = 3;
    private static final int VAL_PARCELABLE = 4;
    private static final int VAL_SHORT = 5;
    private static final int VAL_LONG = 6;
    private static final int VAL_FLOAT = 7;
    private static final int VAL_DOUBLE = 8;
    private static final int VAL_BOOLEAN = 9;
    private static final int VAL_CHARSEQUENCE = 10;
    private static final int VAL_LIST = 11;
    private static final int VAL_SPARSEARRAY = 12;
    private static final int VAL_BYTEARRAY = 13;
    private static final int VAL_STRINGARRAY = 14;
    private static final int VAL_IBINDER = 15;
    private static final int VAL_PARCELABLEARRAY = 16;
    private static final int VAL_OBJECTARRAY = 17;
    private static final int VAL_INTARRAY = 18;
    private static final int VAL_LONGARRAY = 19;
    private static final int VAL_BYTE = 20;
    private static final int VAL_SERIALIZABLE = 21;
    private static final int VAL_SPARSEBOOLEANARRAY = 22;
    private static final int VAL_BOOLEANARRAY = 23;
    private static final int VAL_CHARSEQUENCEARRAY = 24;
    private static final int VAL_PERSISTABLEBUNDLE = 25;
    private static final int VAL_SIZE = 26;
    private static final int VAL_SIZEF = 27;
    private static final int VAL_DOUBLEARRAY = 28;
    private static final int VAL_CHAR = 29;
    private static final int VAL_SHORTARRAY = 30;
    private static final int VAL_CHARARRAY = 31;
    private static final int VAL_FLOATARRAY = 32;
    private static final int VAL_LOCAL_OBJECT = 0x41434c00;

    private static final int LOCAL_OBJECT = 0xac1a0b1e;
    private static final int BUNDLE_MAGIC = 0x4c444e42;
    private static final int INTERFACE_HEADER = 0x53595354;

    private byte[] mData = new byte[64];
    private int mSize;
    private int mPosition;
    private final ArrayList<Object> mObjects = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<Integer> mObjectOffsets = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<Object> mFlattening = new ArrayList<>();
    private ClassLoader mClassLoader;
    private boolean mSaidObjectsAreLocal;

    private Parcel()
    {
    }

    public static Parcel obtain()
    {
        return new Parcel();
    }

    public static Parcel obtain(IBinder binder)
    {
        return new Parcel();
    }

    public void recycle()
    {
        mData = new byte[64];
        mSize = 0;
        mPosition = 0;
        mObjects.clear();
        mObjectOffsets.clear();
        mFlattening.clear();
        mClassLoader = null;
    }

    public void setPropagateAllowBlocking()
    {
    }

    public int dataPosition()
    {
        return mPosition;
    }

    public void setDataPosition(int position)
    {
        if (position < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the data position cannot be negative: " + position);
        mPosition = position;
    }

    public int dataSize()
    {
        return mSize;
    }

    public int dataAvail()
    {
        int available = mSize - mPosition;
        return available < 0 ? 0 : available;
    }

    public int dataCapacity()
    {
        return mData.length;
    }

    public void setDataSize(int size)
    {
        int target = size < 0 ? 0 : size;
        ensureCapacity(target);

        if (target > mSize) Arrays.fill(mData, mSize, target, (byte)0);
        mSize = target;
        if (mPosition > target) mPosition = target;

        for (int index = mObjectOffsets.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            if (mObjectOffsets.get(index) + 4 > target) mObjectOffsets.remove(index);
        }
    }

    public void setDataCapacity(int size)
    {
        if (size > mData.length) ensureCapacity(size);
    }

    public boolean hasFileDescriptors()
    {
        return hasFileDescriptors(0, mSize);
    }

    public boolean hasFileDescriptors(int offset, int length)
    {
        for (int offsetIndex = 0; offsetIndex < mObjectOffsets.size(); offsetIndex++)
        {
            int at = mObjectOffsets.get(offsetIndex);
            if (at < offset || at >= offset + length) continue;

            Object value = objectAt(at);
            if (value instanceof FileDescriptor || value instanceof ParcelFileDescriptor) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public void appendFrom(Parcel parcel, int offset, int length)
    {
        if (parcel == null) return;
        if (offset < 0 || length < 0 || offset + length > parcel.mSize)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("appendFrom range " + offset + "+" + length + " exceeds " + parcel.mSize);
        }

        int destination = mPosition;
        ensureCapacity(destination + length);
        System.arraycopy(parcel.mData, offset, mData, destination, length);
        mPosition = destination + length;
        if (mPosition > mSize) mSize = mPosition;

        for (int offsetIndex = 0; offsetIndex < parcel.mObjectOffsets.size(); offsetIndex++)
        {
            int at = parcel.mObjectOffsets.get(offsetIndex);
            if (at < offset || at + 4 > offset + length) continue;

            int handle = parcel.peekIntAt(at);
            if (handle < 0 || handle >= parcel.mObjects.size()) continue;

            int moved = destination + (at - offset);
            int copy = mObjects.size();
            mObjects.add(parcel.mObjects.get(handle));
            putIntAt(moved, copy);
            mObjectOffsets.add(moved);
        }
    }

    public void writeInterfaceToken(String interfaceName)
    {
        writeInt(0);
        writeInt(-1);
        writeInt(INTERFACE_HEADER);
        writeString(interfaceName);
    }

    public void enforceInterface(String interfaceName)
    {
        readInt();
        readInt();
        int header = readInt();
        String actual = readString();

        if (header != INTERFACE_HEADER || (interfaceName == null ? actual != null : !interfaceName.equals(actual)))
        {
            throw new SecurityException("Binder invocation to an incorrect interface");
        }
    }

    public void enforceNoDataAvail()
    {
        int available = dataAvail();
        if (available > 0) throw new BadParcelableException("Parcel data not fully consumed, unread size: " + available);
    }

    public void writeInt(int value)
    {
        int at = reserve(4);
        putIntAt(at, value);
    }

    public int readInt()
    {
        if (mPosition < 0 || mPosition + 4 > mSize) return 0;

        int value = peekIntAt(mPosition);
        mPosition += 4;
        return value;
    }

    public void writeLong(long value)
    {
        int at = reserve(8);
        putIntAt(at, (int)value);
        putIntAt(at + 4, (int)(value >>> 32));
    }

    public long readLong()
    {
        if (mPosition < 0 || mPosition + 8 > mSize) return 0L;

        long low = peekIntAt(mPosition) & 0xffffffffL;
        long high = peekIntAt(mPosition + 4) & 0xffffffffL;
        mPosition += 8;
        return (high << 32) | low;
    }

    public void writeFloat(float value)
    {
        writeInt(Float.floatToRawIntBits(value));
    }

    public float readFloat()
    {
        return Float.intBitsToFloat(readInt());
    }

    public void writeDouble(double value)
    {
        writeLong(Double.doubleToRawLongBits(value));
    }

    public double readDouble()
    {
        return Double.longBitsToDouble(readLong());
    }

    public void writeBoolean(boolean value)
    {
        writeInt(value ? 1 : 0);
    }

    public boolean readBoolean()
    {
        return readInt() != 0;
    }

    public void writeByte(byte value)
    {
        writeInt(value);
    }

    public byte readByte()
    {
        return (byte)(readInt() & 0xff);
    }

    public void writeString(String value)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            writeInt(-1);
            return;
        }

        int length = value.length();
        writeInt(length);

        int at = reserve(padded((length + 1) * 2));
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
        {
            char character = value.charAt(index);
            mData[at + index * 2] = (byte)character;
            mData[at + index * 2 + 1] = (byte)(character >>> 8);
        }
    }

    public String readString()
    {
        int start = mPosition;
        int length = readInt();
        if (length < 0) return null;

        int bytes = padded((length + 1) * 2);
        if (length > mSize || mPosition + bytes > mSize)
        {
            mPosition = start;
            return null;
        }

        char[] characters = new char[length];
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
        {
            int low = mData[mPosition + index * 2] & 0xff;
            int high = mData[mPosition + index * 2 + 1] & 0xff;
            characters[index] = (char)(low | (high << 8));
        }

        mPosition += bytes;
        return new String(characters);
    }

    public void writeStrongBinder(IBinder value)
    {
        writeLocal(value);
    }

    public void writeStrongInterface(IInterface value)
    {
        writeStrongBinder(value == null ? null : value.asBinder());
    }

    public IBinder readStrongBinder()
    {
        Object value = readLocal();
        return value instanceof IBinder ? (IBinder)value : null;
    }

    public void writeFileDescriptor(FileDescriptor value)
    {
        writeLocal(value);
    }

    public ParcelFileDescriptor readFileDescriptor()
    {
        Object value = readLocal();
        if (value instanceof ParcelFileDescriptor) return (ParcelFileDescriptor)value;
        if (!(value instanceof FileDescriptor)) return null;

        try
        {
            return ParcelFileDescriptor.dup((FileDescriptor)value);
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            android.util.Log.w(TAG, "could not duplicate a file descriptor read from a parcel", failure);
            return null;
        }
    }

    public void writeByteArray(byte[] value)
    {
        writeByteArray(value, 0, value == null ? 0 : value.length);
    }

    public void writeByteArray(byte[] value, int offset, int length)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            writeInt(-1);
            return;
        }

        if (offset < 0 || length < 0 || offset + length > value.length) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException();

        writeInt(length);
        int at = reserve(padded(length));
        System.arraycopy(value, offset, mData, at, length);
    }

    public void writeBlob(byte[] value)
    {
        writeByteArray(value);
    }

    public void writeBlob(byte[] value, int offset, int length)
    {
        writeByteArray(value, offset, length);
    }

    public byte[] createByteArray()
    {
        int start = mPosition;
        int length = readInt();
        if (length < 0) return null;

        if (mPosition + padded(length) > mSize)
        {
            mPosition = start;
            return null;
        }

        byte[] value = Arrays.copyOfRange(mData, mPosition, mPosition + length);
        mPosition += padded(length);
        return value;
    }

    public byte[] readBlob()
    {
        return createByteArray();
    }

    public void readByteArray(byte[] destination)
    {
        copyInto(createByteArray(), destination);
    }

    public void writeBooleanArray(boolean[] value)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            writeInt(-1);
            return;
        }

        writeInt(value.length);
        for (boolean item : value) writeInt(item ? 1 : 0);
    }

    public boolean[] createBooleanArray()
    {
        int length = readArrayLength(4);
        if (length < 0) return null;

        boolean[] value = new boolean[length];
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) value[index] = readInt() != 0;
        return value;
    }

    public void readBooleanArray(boolean[] destination)
    {
        copyInto(createBooleanArray(), destination);
    }

    public void writeCharArray(char[] value)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            writeInt(-1);
            return;
        }

        writeInt(value.length);
        for (char item : value) writeInt(item);
    }

    public char[] createCharArray()
    {
        int length = readArrayLength(4);
        if (length < 0) return null;

        char[] value = new char[length];
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) value[index] = (char)readInt();
        return value;
    }

    public void readCharArray(char[] destination)
    {
        copyInto(createCharArray(), destination);
    }

    public void writeIntArray(int[] value)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            writeInt(-1);
            return;
        }

        writeInt(value.length);
        for (int item : value) writeInt(item);
    }

    public int[] createIntArray()
    {
        int length = readArrayLength(4);
        if (length < 0) return null;

        int[] value = new int[length];
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) value[index] = readInt();
        return value;
    }

    public void readIntArray(int[] destination)
    {
        copyInto(createIntArray(), destination);
    }

    public void writeLongArray(long[] value)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            writeInt(-1);
            return;
        }

        writeInt(value.length);
        for (long item : value) writeLong(item);
    }

    public long[] createLongArray()
    {
        int length = readArrayLength(8);
        if (length < 0) return null;

        long[] value = new long[length];
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) value[index] = readLong();
        return value;
    }

    }

    public <T> void readTypedArray(T[] destination, Parcelable.Creator<T> creator)
    {
        int length = readInt();
        if (destination == null || length != destination.length) throw new RuntimeException("bad array lengths");

        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) destination[index] = readTypedObject(creator);
    }

    public <T extends Parcelable> void writeTypedObject(T value, int flags)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            writeInt(0);
            return;
        }

        if (isFlattening(value))
        {
            writeLocal(value);
            return;
        }

        writeInt(1);
        flatten(value, flags);
    }

    public <T> T readTypedObject(Parcelable.Creator<T> creator)
    {
        int marker = peekInt();
        if (marker == LOCAL_OBJECT) return cast(readLocal());

        if (readInt() == 0) return null;
        return creator == null ? null : this.<T>cast(create(creator, mClassLoader));
    }

    public <T extends Parcelable> void writeTypedArrayMap(ArrayMap<String, T> value, int flags)
    {
        if (value == null)

            writeInt(-1);
            return;
        }

        writeInt(value.size());
        for (int index = 0; index < value.size(); index++)
        {
            writeString(value.keyAt(index));
            writeTypedObject(value.valueAt(index), flags);
        }
    }

        }
        return value;
    }

    {

        {

        return bundle;
    }

    public void writeMap(Map value)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            writeInt(-1);
            return;
        }

        writeInt(value.size());
        for (Object entry : value.entrySet())
        {
            writeValue(((Map.Entry<?, ?>)entry).getKey());
            writeValue(((Map.Entry<?, ?>)entry).getValue());
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public void readMap(Map outVal, ClassLoader loader)
    {
        int length = readArrayLength(8);
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
        {
            Object key = readValue(loader);
            Object value = readValue(loader);
            if (outVal != null) outVal.put(key, value);
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")

        readMap((Map)outVal, loader);
    }
```
