```java
    }

    public void writeParcelable(Parcelable value, int flags)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            writeString(null);
            return;
        }

        if (isFlattening(value))
        {
            writeLocal(value);
            return;
        }

        writeString(value.getClass().getName());
        flatten(value, flags);
    }

    public void writeParcelableCreator(Parcelable value)
    {
        writeString(value.getClass().getName());
    }

    public <T extends Parcelable> T readParcelable(ClassLoader loader)
    {
        Object value = readParcelableValue(loader);
        return value instanceof Parcelable ? this.<T>cast(value) : null;
    }

    public <T> T readParcelable(ClassLoader loader, Class<T> type)
    {
        Object value = readParcelableValue(loader);
        if (value == null) return null;
        if (type != null && !type.isInstance(value))
        {
            throw new BadParcelableException("Parcelable creator for " + value.getClass().getName() + " is not a subclass of " + type);
        }

        return cast(value);
    }

    public Parcelable.Creator<?> readParcelableCreator(ClassLoader loader)
    {
        if (peekInt() == LOCAL_OBJECT)
        {
            final Object instance = readLocal();
            if (instance == null) return null;

            return new Parcelable.Creator<Object>()
            {
                @Override
                public Object createFromParcel(Parcel source)
                {
                    return instance;
                }

                @Override
                public Object[] newArray(int size)
                {
                    return (Object[])Array.newInstance(instance.getClass(), size);
                }
            };
        }

        String className = readString();
        if (className == null) return null;

        return creatorFor(className, loader == null ? mClassLoader : loader);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public <T> Parcelable.Creator<T> readParcelableCreator(ClassLoader loader, Class<T> type)
    {
        return (Parcelable.Creator<T>)readParcelableCreator(loader);
    }

    public <T extends Parcelable> void writeParcelableArray(T[] value, int flags)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            writeInt(-1);
            return;
        }

        writeInt(value.length);
        for (T item : value) writeParcelable(item, flags);
    }

    public Parcelable[] readParcelableArray(ClassLoader loader)
    {
        int length = readArrayLength(4);
        if (length < 0) return null;

        Parcelable[] value = new Parcelable[length];
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) value[index] = readParcelable(loader);
        return value;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public <T> T[] readParcelableArray(ClassLoader loader, Class<T> type)
    {
        int length = readArrayLength(4);
        if (length < 0) return null;

        T[] value = (T[])Array.newInstance(type, length);
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) value[index] = readParcelable(loader, type);
        return value;
    }

    public void writeSerializable(Serializable value)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            writeString(null);
            return;
        }

        byte[] payload;
        try
        {
            ByteArrayOutputStream serialized = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            ObjectOutputStream stream = new ObjectOutputStream(serialized);
            stream.writeObject(value);
            stream.flush();
            payload = serialized.toByteArray();
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            android.util.Log.w(TAG, "a " + value.getClass().getName() + " could not be serialized and is kept by reference", failure);
            writeLocal(value);
            return;
        }

        writeString(value.getClass().getName());
        writeByteArray(payload);
    }

    public Serializable readSerializable()
    {
        Object value = readSerializableValue(mClassLoader);
        return value instanceof Serializable ? (Serializable)value : null;
    }

    public <T> T readSerializable(ClassLoader loader, Class<T> type)
    {
        Object value = readSerializableValue(loader);
        return type != null && type.isInstance(value) ? type.cast(value) : null;
    }

    public void writeValue(Object value)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_NULL);
        }
        else if (value instanceof String)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_STRING);
            writeString((String)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof Integer)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_INTEGER);
            writeInt((Integer)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof Map)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_MAP);
            writeMap((Map)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof Bundle)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_BUNDLE);
            writeBundle((Bundle)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof PersistableBundle)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_PERSISTABLEBUNDLE);
            writePersistableBundle((PersistableBundle)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof ParcelFileDescriptor || value instanceof FileDescriptor || isFlattening(value))
        {
            writeInt(VAL_LOCAL_OBJECT);
            writeLocal(value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof Parcelable)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_PARCELABLE);
            writeParcelable((Parcelable)value, 0);
        }
        else if (value instanceof Short)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_SHORT);
            writeInt((Short)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof Long)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_LONG);
            writeLong((Long)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof Float)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_FLOAT);
            writeFloat((Float)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof Double)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_DOUBLE);
            writeDouble((Double)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof Boolean)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_BOOLEAN);
            writeInt((Boolean)value ? 1 : 0);
        }
        else if (value instanceof CharSequence)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_CHARSEQUENCE);
            writeCharSequence((CharSequence)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof List)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_LIST);
            writeList((List)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof SparseArray)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_SPARSEARRAY);
            writeSparseArray((SparseArray<?>)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof boolean[])
        {
            writeInt(VAL_BOOLEANARRAY);
            writeBooleanArray((boolean[])value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof byte[])
        {
            writeInt(VAL_BYTEARRAY);
            writeByteArray((byte[])value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof String[])
        {
            writeInt(VAL_STRINGARRAY);
            writeStringArray((String[])value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof CharSequence[])
        {
            CharSequence[] array = (CharSequence[])value;
            writeInt(VAL_CHARSEQUENCEARRAY);
            writeInt(array.length);
            for (CharSequence item : array) writeCharSequence(item);
        }
        else if (value instanceof IBinder)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_IBINDER);
            writeStrongBinder((IBinder)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof Parcelable[])
        {
            writeInt(VAL_PARCELABLEARRAY);
            writeParcelableArray((Parcelable[])value, 0);
        }
        else if (value instanceof int[])
        {
            writeInt(VAL_INTARRAY);
            writeIntArray((int[])value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof long[])
        {
            writeInt(VAL_LONGARRAY);
            writeLongArray((long[])value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof Byte)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_BYTE);
            writeInt((Byte)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof android.util.Size)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_SIZE);
            writeSize((android.util.Size)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof android.util.SizeF)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_SIZEF);
            writeSizeF((android.util.SizeF)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof double[])
        {
            writeInt(VAL_DOUBLEARRAY);
            writeDoubleArray((double[])value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof Character)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_CHAR);
            writeInt((Character)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof short[])
        {
            short[] array = (short[])value;
            writeInt(VAL_SHORTARRAY);
            writeInt(array.length);
            for (short item : array) writeInt(item);
        }
        else if (value instanceof char[])
        {
            writeInt(VAL_CHARARRAY);
            writeCharArray((char[])value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof float[])
        {
            writeInt(VAL_FLOATARRAY);
            writeFloatArray((float[])value);
        }
        else if (value.getClass() == Object[].class)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_OBJECTARRAY);
            writeArray((Object[])value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof SparseBooleanArray)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_SPARSEBOOLEANARRAY);
            writeSparseBooleanArray((SparseBooleanArray)value);
        }
        else if (value instanceof Serializable)
        {
            writeInt(VAL_SERIALIZABLE);
            writeSerializable((Serializable)value);
        }
        else
        {
            writeInt(VAL_LOCAL_OBJECT);
            writeLocal(value);
        }
    }

    public Object readValue(ClassLoader loader)
    {
        ClassLoader effective = loader == null ? mClassLoader : loader;
        int type = readInt();

        switch (type)
        {
            case VAL_NULL:
                return null;
            case VAL_STRING:
                return readString();
            case VAL_INTEGER:
                return readInt();
            case VAL_MAP:
                return readHashMap(effective);
            case VAL_BUNDLE:
                return readBundle(effective);
            case VAL_PERSISTABLEBUNDLE:
                return readPersistableBundle(effective);
            case VAL_PARCELABLE:
                return readParcelableValue(effective);
            case VAL_SHORT:
                return (short)readInt();
            case VAL_LONG:
                return readLong();
            case VAL_FLOAT:
                return readFloat();
            case VAL_DOUBLE:
                return readDouble();
            case VAL_BOOLEAN:
                return readInt() != 0;
            case VAL_CHARSEQUENCE:
                return readCharSequence();
            case VAL_LIST:
                return readArrayList(effective);
            case VAL_SPARSEARRAY:
                return readSparseArray(effective);
            case VAL_BOOLEANARRAY:
                return createBooleanArray();
            case VAL_BYTEARRAY:
                return createByteArray();
            case VAL_STRINGARRAY:
                return createStringArray();
            case VAL_CHARSEQUENCEARRAY:
            {
                int length = readArrayLength(4);
                if (length < 0) return null;

                CharSequence[] array = new CharSequence[length];
                for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) array[index] = readCharSequence();
                return array;
            }
            case VAL_IBINDER:
                return readStrongBinder();
            case VAL_PARCELABLEARRAY:
                return readParcelableArray(effective);
            case VAL_INTARRAY:
                return createIntArray();
            case VAL_LONGARRAY:
                return createLongArray();
            case VAL_BYTE:
                return (byte)readInt();
            case VAL_SIZE:
                return readSize();
            case VAL_SIZEF:
                return readSizeF();
            case VAL_DOUBLEARRAY:
                return createDoubleArray();
            case VAL_CHAR:
                return (char)readInt();
            case VAL_SHORTARRAY:
            {
                int length = readArrayLength(4);
                if (length < 0) return null;

                short[] array = new short[length];
                for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) array[index] = (short)readInt();
                return array;
            }
            case VAL_CHARARRAY:
                return createCharArray();
            case VAL_FLOATARRAY:
                return createFloatArray();
            case VAL_OBJECTARRAY:
                return readArray(effective);
            case VAL_SPARSEBOOLEANARRAY:
                return readSparseBooleanArray();
            case VAL_SERIALIZABLE:
                return readSerializableValue(effective);
            case VAL_LOCAL_OBJECT:
                return readLocal();
            default:
                throw new BadParcelableException("Parcel " + this + ": Unmarshalling unknown type code " + type + " at offset "
                                                 + (mPosition - 4));
        }
    }

    public void writeException(Exception exception)
    {
        int code = 0;
        if (exception instanceof Parcelable && exception.getClass().getClassLoader() != Parcel.class.getClassLoader())
        {
            code = EX_PARCELABLE;
        }
        else if (exception instanceof SecurityException) code = EX_SECURITY;
        else if (exception instanceof BadParcelableException) code = EX_BAD_PARCELABLE;
        else if (exception instanceof IllegalArgumentException) code = EX_ILLEGAL_ARGUMENT;
        else if (exception instanceof NullPointerException) code = EX_NULL_POINTER;
        else if (exception instanceof IllegalStateException) code = EX_ILLEGAL_STATE;
        else if (exception instanceof NetworkOnMainThreadException) code = EX_NETWORK_MAIN_THREAD;
        else if (exception instanceof UnsupportedOperationException) code = EX_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION;

        if (code == 0)
        {
            if (exception instanceof RuntimeException) throw (RuntimeException)exception;
            throw new RuntimeException(exception);
        }

        writeInt(code);
        writeString(exception.getMessage());
        writeInt(0);

        if (code == EX_PARCELABLE)
        {
            int sizeAt = dataPosition();
            writeInt(0);
            writeParcelable((Parcelable)exception, Parcelable.PARCELABLE_WRITE_RETURN_VALUE);
            int end = dataPosition();
            setDataPosition(sizeAt);
            writeInt(end - sizeAt - 4);
            setDataPosition(end);
        }
    }

    public void writeNoException()
    {
        writeInt(0);
    }

    public void readException()
    {
        int code = readExceptionCode();
        if (code == 0) return;

        String message = readString();
        int header = readInt();
        if (header > 0) setDataPosition(dataPosition() + header);

        readException(code, message);
    }

    public void readException(int code, String message)
    {
        switch (code)
        {
            case EX_PARCELABLE:
            {
                if (readInt() > 0)
                {
                    Object thrown = readParcelable(Parcelable.class.getClassLoader());
                    if (thrown instanceof RuntimeException) throw (RuntimeException)thrown;
                    if (thrown instanceof Throwable) throw new RuntimeException((Throwable)thrown);
                }

                throw new RuntimeException(message);
            }
            case EX_SECURITY:
                throw new SecurityException(message);
            case EX_BAD_PARCELABLE:
                throw new BadParcelableException(message);
            case EX_ILLEGAL_ARGUMENT:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(message);
            case EX_NULL_POINTER:
                throw new NullPointerException(message);
            case EX_ILLEGAL_STATE:
                throw new IllegalStateException(message);
            case EX_NETWORK_MAIN_THREAD:
                throw new NetworkOnMainThreadException();
            case EX_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION:
                throw new UnsupportedOperationException(message);
            default:
                throw new RuntimeException("Unknown exception code: " + code + " msg " + message);
        }
    }

    public byte[] marshall()
    {
        if (!mObjects.isEmpty() && !mSaidObjectsAreLocal)
        {
            mSaidObjectsAreLocal = true;
            android.util.Log.w(TAG, "marshalling a parcel that holds " + mObjects.size()
                                        + " binder, descriptor or unflattened object(s); they read back as null elsewhere");
        }

        return Arrays.copyOf(mData, mSize);
    }

    public void unmarshall(byte[] data, int offset, int length)
    {
        mObjects.clear();
        mObjectOffsets.clear();

        int count = data == null || length < 0 ? 0 : length;
        mData = new byte[Math.max(64, padded(count))];
        if (count > 0) System.arraycopy(data, offset, mData, 0, count);
        mSize = count;
        mPosition = count;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "android.os.Parcel@" + Integer.toHexString(hashCode()) + "{size=" + mSize + ", position=" + mPosition + ", objects="
               + mObjects.size() + "}";
    }

    void writeBundleBody(BaseBundle bundle)
    {
        Map<String, Object> map = bundle.mMap;
        if (map.isEmpty())
        {
            writeInt(0);
            return;
        }

        int lengthAt = dataPosition();
        writeInt(0);
        writeInt(BUNDLE_MAGIC);

        int start = dataPosition();
        writeInt(map.size());
        for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : map.entrySet())
        {
            writeString(entry.getKey());
            writeValue(entry.getValue());
        }

        int end = dataPosition();
        setDataPosition(lengthAt);
        writeInt(end - start);
        setDataPosition(end);
    }

    void readBundleBody(Map<String, Object> into, ClassLoader loader)
    {
        int length = readInt();
        if (length <= 0) return;

        int magic = readInt();
        if (magic != BUNDLE_MAGIC)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Bad magic number for Bundle: 0x" + Integer.toHexString(magic));
        }

        int start = dataPosition();
        int count = readInt();
        for (int index = 0; index < count && dataAvail() > 0; index++)
        {
            String key = readString();
            into.put(key, readValue(loader));
        }

        setDataPosition(start + length);
    }

    private void writeCharSequence(CharSequence value)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            writeInt(1);
            writeString(null);
            return;
        }

        if (value instanceof android.text.Spanned)
        {
            writeLocal(value);
            return;
        }

        writeInt(1);
        writeString(value.toString());
    }

    private CharSequence readCharSequence()
    {
        if (peekInt() == LOCAL_OBJECT)
        {
            Object value = readLocal();
            return value instanceof CharSequence ? (CharSequence)value : null;
        }

        readInt();
        return readString();
    }

    private Object readParcelableValue(ClassLoader loader)
    {
        ClassLoader effective = loader == null ? mClassLoader : loader;

        if (peekInt() == LOCAL_OBJECT) return readLocal();

        String className = readString();
        if (className == null) return null;

        return create(creatorFor(className, effective), effective);
    }

    private Object readSerializableValue(ClassLoader loader)
    {
        if (peekInt() == LOCAL_OBJECT) return readLocal();

        String className = readString();
        if (className == null) return null;

        byte[] payload = createByteArray();
        if (payload == null) return null;

        final ClassLoader effective = loader(loader == null ? mClassLoader : loader);
        try
        {
            ObjectInputStream stream = new ObjectInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(payload))
            {
                @Override
                protected Class<?> resolveClass(ObjectStreamClass description) throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException
                {
                    try
                    {
                        return Class.forName(description.getName(), false, effective);
                    }
                    catch (ClassNotFoundException missing)
                    {
                        return super.resolveClass(description);
                    }
                }
            };

            return stream.readObject();
        }
        catch (IOException | ClassNotFoundException failure)
        {
            throw new BadParcelableException("Parcelable encountered " + failure.getClass().getSimpleName()
                                             + " reading a Serializable object (name = " + className + ")");
        }
    }

    private Object create(Parcelable.Creator<?> creator, ClassLoader loader)
    {
        if (creator instanceof Parcelable.ClassLoaderCreator)
        {
            return ((Parcelable.ClassLoaderCreator<?>)creator).createFromParcel(this, loader(loader));
        }

        return creator.createFromParcel(this);
    }

    private void flatten(Parcelable value, int flags)
    {
        mFlattening.add(value);
        try
        {
            value.writeToParcel(this, flags);
        }
        finally
        {
            mFlattening.remove(mFlattening.size() - 1);
        }
    }

    private boolean isFlattening(Object value)
    {
        for (int index = mFlattening.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            if (mFlattening.get(index) == value) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private void writeLocal(Object value)
    {
        writeInt(LOCAL_OBJECT);
        if (value == null)
        {
            writeInt(-1);
            return;
        }

        int handle = mObjects.size();
        mObjects.add(value);
        mObjectOffsets.add(dataPosition());
        writeInt(handle);
    }

    private Object readLocal()
    {
        int marker = readInt();
        int handle = readInt();
        if (marker != LOCAL_OBJECT || handle < 0 || handle >= mObjects.size()) return null;

        return mObjects.get(handle);
    }

    private Object objectAt(int offset)
    {
        int handle = peekIntAt(offset);
        return handle >= 0 && handle < mObjects.size() ? mObjects.get(handle) : null;
    }

    private <T> void writeFixedArray(T value, int flags, int depth, int[] dimensions)
    {
        if (depth >= dimensions.length) throw new BadParcelableException("Array has more dimensions than expected: " + dimensions.length);
        if (value == null) throw new BadParcelableException("Non-null array shouldn't have a null array.");

        int length = Array.getLength(value);
        if (length != dimensions[depth])
        {
            throw new BadParcelableException("bad length: expected " + dimensions[depth] + ", but got " + length);
        }

        Class<?> component = value.getClass().getComponentType();
        if (component.isArray() == (depth + 1 == dimensions.length))
        {
            throw new BadParcelableException("Array dimensions mismatch: expected " + dimensions.length);
        }

        if (component == boolean.class) writeBooleanArray((boolean[])value);
        else if (component == byte.class) writeByteArray((byte[])value);
        else if (component == char.class) writeCharArray((char[])value);
        else if (component == int.class) writeIntArray((int[])value);
        else if (component == long.class) writeLongArray((long[])value);
        else if (component == float.class) writeFloatArray((float[])value);
        else if (component == double.class) writeDoubleArray((double[])value);
        else if (component == String.class) writeStringArray((String[])value);
        else if (component == IBinder.class) writeBinderArray((IBinder[])value);
        else if (IInterface.class.isAssignableFrom(component)) writeInterfaceArray((IInterface[])value);
        else if (Parcelable.class.isAssignableFrom(component)) writeTypedArray((Parcelable[])value, flags);
        else if (component.isArray())
        {
            writeInt(length);
            for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) writeFixedArray(Array.get(value, index), flags, depth + 1, dimensions);
        }
        else
        {
            throw new BadParcelableException("Fixed-size array of " + component + " is not supported");
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private <T> T createFixedArray(Class<T> type, Parcelable.Creator<?> creator, Function<IBinder, ?> asInterface, int[] dimensions)
    {
        if (peekInt() < 0)
        {
            readInt();
            return null;
        }

        return (T)createFixedArray(type, creator, asInterface, 0, dimensions);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private Object createFixedArray(Class<?> type, Parcelable.Creator<?> creator, Function<IBinder, ?> asInterface, int depth,
                                    int[] dimensions)
    {
        Class<?> component = type.getComponentType();
        Object value;

        if (component == boolean.class) value = createBooleanArray();
        else if (component == byte.class) value = createByteArray();
        else if (component == char.class) value = createCharArray();
        else if (component == int.class) value = createIntArray();
        else if (component == long.class) value = createLongArray();
        else if (component == float.class) value = createFloatArray();
        else if (component == double.class) value = createDoubleArray();
        else if (component == String.class) value = createStringArray();
        else if (component == IBinder.class) value = createBinderArray();
        else if (component.isArray())
        {
            int length = readInt();
            value = Array.newInstance(component, Math.max(length, 0));
            for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
            {
                Array.set(value, index, createFixedArray(component, creator, asInterface, depth + 1, dimensions));
            }
        }
        else if (IInterface.class.isAssignableFrom(component) && asInterface != null)
        {
            int length = readInt();
            value = Array.newInstance(component, Math.max(length, 0));
            for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) Array.set(value, index, asInterface.apply(readStrongBinder()));
        }
        else if (Parcelable.class.isAssignableFrom(component) && creator != null)
        {
            int length = readInt();
            value = Array.newInstance(component, Math.max(length, 0));
            for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) Array.set(value, index, readTypedObject(creator));
        }
        else
        {
            throw new BadParcelableException("Fixed-size array of " + component + " cannot be created");
        }

        int length = value == null ? -1 : Array.getLength(value);
        if (depth < dimensions.length && length != dimensions[depth])
        {
            throw new BadParcelableException("Bad length: expected " + dimensions[depth] + ", but got " + length);
        }

        return value;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private void readFixedArray(Object destination, Parcelable.Creator<?> creator, Function<IBinder, ?> asInterface)
    {
        Object value = createFixedArray(destination.getClass(), creator, asInterface, 0, new int[] {Array.getLength(destination)});
        copyFixed(value, destination);
    }

    private static void copyFixed(Object source, Object destination)
    {
        int length = Array.getLength(destination);
        if (source == null || Array.getLength(source) != length) throw new BadParcelableException("bad array lengths");

        if (!destination.getClass().getComponentType().isArray())
        {
            System.arraycopy(source, 0, destination, 0, length);
            return;
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) copyFixed(Array.get(source, index), Array.get(destination, index));
    }

    private static Parcelable.Creator<?> creatorFor(String className, ClassLoader loader)
    {
        Class<?> type = findClass(className, loader);
        if (type == null) throw new BadParcelableException("ClassNotFoundException when unmarshalling: " + className);

        try
        {
            java.lang.reflect.Field field = type.getField("CREATOR");
            Object creator = field.get(null);
            if (creator instanceof Parcelable.Creator) return (Parcelable.Creator<?>)creator;
        }
        catch (NoSuchFieldException | IllegalAccessException missing)
        {
            throw new BadParcelableException("Parcelable protocol requires a Parcelable.Creator object called CREATOR on class "
                                             + className);
        }

        throw new BadParcelableException("Parcelable protocol requires a Parcelable.Creator object called CREATOR on class "
                                         + className);
    }

    private static Class<?> findClass(String className, ClassLoader loader)
    {
        try
        {
            return Class.forName(className, false, loader(loader));
        }
        catch (ClassNotFoundException missing)
        {
            try
            {
                return Class.forName(className);
            }
            catch (ClassNotFoundException absent)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }
    }

    private static ClassLoader loader(ClassLoader preferred)
    {
        if (preferred != null) return preferred;

        ClassLoader context = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
        return context != null ? context : Parcel.class.getClassLoader();
    }

    private int readExceptionCode()
    {
        int code = readInt();

        if (code == EX_HAS_NOTED_APPOPS_REPLY_HEADER)
        {
            int header = readInt();
            if (header > 0) setDataPosition(dataPosition() + header);
            code = readInt();
        }

        if (code == EX_HAS_STRICTMODE_REPLY_HEADER)
        {
            int header = readInt();
            if (header > 0) setDataPosition(dataPosition() + header);
            code = 0;
        }

        return code;
    }

    private int readArrayLength(int elementBytes)
    {
        int start = mPosition;
        int length = readInt();
        if (length < 0) return -1;

        if ((long)length * elementBytes > dataAvail() + 4L)
        {
            mPosition = start + 4;
            throw new BadParcelableException("array length " + length + " exceeds the " + dataAvail() + " bytes left in the parcel");
        }

        return length;
    }

    private int peekInt()
    {
        if (mPosition < 0 || mPosition + 4 > mSize) return 0;
        return peekIntAt(mPosition);
    }

    private int peekIntAt(int offset)
    {
        return (mData[offset] & 0xff) | ((mData[offset + 1] & 0xff) << 8) | ((mData[offset + 2] & 0xff) << 16)
               | ((mData[offset + 3] & 0xff) << 24);
    }

    private void putIntAt(int offset, int value)
    {
        mData[offset] = (byte)value;
        mData[offset + 1] = (byte)(value >>> 8);
        mData[offset + 2] = (byte)(value >>> 16);
        mData[offset + 3] = (byte)(value >>> 24);
    }

    private int reserve(int bytes)
    {
        int at = mPosition;
        int end = at + bytes;
        ensureCapacity(end);

        if (at > mSize) Arrays.fill(mData, mSize, at, (byte)0);
        Arrays.fill(mData, at, end, (byte)0);

        mPosition = end;
        if (end > mSize) mSize = end;
        return at;
    }

    private void ensureCapacity(int size)
    {
        if (size <= mData.length) return;

        int capacity = Math.max(size, mData.length * 3 / 2 + 16);
        mData = Arrays.copyOf(mData, capacity);
    }

    private static int padded(int length)
    {
        return (length + 3) & ~3;
    }

    private static void copyInto(Object source, Object destination)
    {
        if (destination == null) return;

        int length = source == null ? -1 : Array.getLength(source);
        if (length != Array.getLength(destination)) throw new RuntimeException("bad array lengths");

        System.arraycopy(source, 0, destination, 0, length);
    }

    private static <T> void replaceContents(List<T> destination, List<T> source)
    {
        if (destination == null) return;

        destination.clear();
        if (source != null) destination.addAll(source);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private <T> T cast(Object value)
    {
        return (T)value;
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/ParcelFileDescriptor.java`:

```java
package android.os;

import java.io.Closeable;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileNotFoundException;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

public class ParcelFileDescriptor implements Parcelable, Closeable
{
    public static final int MODE_WORLD_READABLE = 0x00000001;
    public static final int MODE_WORLD_WRITEABLE = 0x00000002;
    public static final int MODE_READ_ONLY = 0x10000000;
    public static final int MODE_WRITE_ONLY = 0x20000000;
    public static final int MODE_READ_WRITE = 0x30000000;
    public static final int MODE_CREATE = 0x08000000;
    public static final int MODE_TRUNCATE = 0x04000000;
    public static final int MODE_APPEND = 0x02000000;

    private static final int MODE_ACCESS_MASK = 0x30000000;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<ParcelFileDescriptor> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ParcelFileDescriptor>()
    {
        @Override
        public ParcelFileDescriptor createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            Object value = source.readValue(null);
            return value instanceof ParcelFileDescriptor ? (ParcelFileDescriptor)value : null;
        }

        @Override
        public ParcelFileDescriptor[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ParcelFileDescriptor[size];
        }
    };

    private final ParcelFileDescriptor mWrapped;
    private final FileDescriptor mDescriptor;
    private int mFd;
    private Closeable mResource;
    private OnCloseListener mCloseListener;
    private Handler mCloseHandler;

    public interface OnCloseListener
    {
        void onClose(IOException exception);
    }

    public static class FileDescriptorDetachedException extends IOException
    {
        public FileDescriptorDetachedException()
        {
            super("Remote side is detached");
        }
    }

    public ParcelFileDescriptor(FileDescriptor descriptor, int fd)
    {
        mWrapped = null;
        mDescriptor = descriptor;
        mFd = fd;
    }

    public ParcelFileDescriptor(ParcelFileDescriptor wrapped)
    {
        mWrapped = wrapped;
        mDescriptor = null;
        mFd = -1;
    }

    private ParcelFileDescriptor(FileDescriptor descriptor, Closeable resource)
    {
        mWrapped = null;
        mDescriptor = descriptor;
        mResource = resource;
        mFd = descriptorInt(descriptor);
    }

    public static ParcelFileDescriptor open(File file, int mode) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        if (file == null) throw new NullPointerException("file");

        int access = mode & MODE_ACCESS_MASK;
        if (access == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Must specify MODE_READ_ONLY, MODE_WRITE_ONLY, or MODE_READ_WRITE");

        if ((mode & MODE_CREATE) == 0 && !file.exists()) throw new FileNotFoundException(file + ": open failed: ENOENT");

        try
        {
            if (access == MODE_READ_ONLY)
            {
                FileInputStream stream = new FileInputStream(file);
                return new ParcelFileDescriptor(stream.getFD(), stream);
            }

            if (access == MODE_WRITE_ONLY && (mode & MODE_TRUNCATE) != 0)
            {
                FileOutputStream stream = new FileOutputStream(file, false);
                return new ParcelFileDescriptor(stream.getFD(), stream);
            }

            if (access == MODE_WRITE_ONLY && (mode & MODE_APPEND) != 0)
            {
                FileOutputStream stream = new FileOutputStream(file, true);
                return new ParcelFileDescriptor(stream.getFD(), stream);
            }

            RandomAccessFile random = new RandomAccessFile(file, "rw");
            if ((mode & MODE_TRUNCATE) != 0) random.setLength(0);
            if ((mode & MODE_APPEND) != 0) random.seek(random.length());
            return new ParcelFileDescriptor(random.getFD(), random);
        }
        catch (FileNotFoundException missing)
        {
            throw missing;
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            FileNotFoundException wrapped = new FileNotFoundException(file + ": open failed: " + failure.getMessage());
            wrapped.initCause(failure);
            throw wrapped;
        }
    }

    public static ParcelFileDescriptor open(File file, int mode, Handler handler, OnCloseListener listener) throws IOException
    {
        if (handler == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Handler must not be null");
        if (listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Listener must not be null");

        ParcelFileDescriptor descriptor = open(file, mode);
        descriptor.mCloseHandler = handler;
        descriptor.mCloseListener = listener;
        return descriptor;
    }

    public static ParcelFileDescriptor wrap(ParcelFileDescriptor descriptor, Handler handler, OnCloseListener listener)
        throws IOException
    {
        ParcelFileDescriptor duplicate = descriptor.dup();
        duplicate.mCloseHandler = handler;
        duplicate.mCloseListener = listener;
        return duplicate;
    }

    public static ParcelFileDescriptor dup(FileDescriptor original) throws IOException
    {
        return fromFd(descriptorInt(original));
    }

    public ParcelFileDescriptor dup() throws IOException
    {
        return fromFd(getFd());
    }

    public static ParcelFileDescriptor fromFd(int fd) throws IOException
    {
        if (fd < 0) throw new IOException("invalid file descriptor " + fd);

        File path = new File("/proc/self/fd/" + fd);
        try
        {
            RandomAccessFile random = new RandomAccessFile(path, "rw");
            return new ParcelFileDescriptor(random.getFD(), random);
        }
        catch (IOException readOnly)
        {
            if (path.canRead())
            {
                FileInputStream stream = new FileInputStream(path);
                return new ParcelFileDescriptor(stream.getFD(), stream);
            }

            FileOutputStream stream = new FileOutputStream(path, true);
            return new ParcelFileDescriptor(stream.getFD(), stream);
        }
    }

    public static ParcelFileDescriptor adoptFd(int fd)
    {
        FileDescriptor descriptor = new FileDescriptor();
        setDescriptorInt(descriptor, fd);
        return new ParcelFileDescriptor(descriptor, fd);
    }

    public static ParcelFileDescriptor fromSocket(java.net.Socket socket)
    {
        return null;
    }

    public static ParcelFileDescriptor fromDatagramSocket(java.net.DatagramSocket socket)
    {
        return null;
    }

    public static ParcelFileDescriptor[] createPipe() throws IOException
    {
        java.nio.channels.Pipe pipe = java.nio.channels.Pipe.open();
        FileDescriptor source = channelDescriptor(pipe.source());
        FileDescriptor sink = channelDescriptor(pipe.sink());

        if (source == null || sink == null)
        {
            pipe.source().close();
            pipe.sink().close();
            throw new IOException("pipes are not available on this runtime");
        }

        pipe.source().configureBlocking(true);
        pipe.sink().configureBlocking(true);

        return new ParcelFileDescriptor[] {new ParcelFileDescriptor(source, pipe.source()), new ParcelFileDescriptor(sink, pipe.sink())};
    }

    public static ParcelFileDescriptor[] createReliablePipe() throws IOException
    {
        return createPipe();
    }

    public static ParcelFileDescriptor[] createSocketPair() throws IOException
    {
        throw new IOException("socket pairs are not available on this runtime");
    }

    public static ParcelFileDescriptor[] createReliableSocketPair() throws IOException
    {
        return createSocketPair();
    }

    public static int parseMode(String mode)
    {
        if ("r".equals(mode)) return MODE_READ_ONLY;
        if ("w".equals(mode) || "wt".equals(mode)) return MODE_WRITE_ONLY | MODE_CREATE | MODE_TRUNCATE;
        if ("wa".equals(mode)) return MODE_WRITE_ONLY | MODE_CREATE | MODE_APPEND;
        if ("rw".equals(mode)) return MODE_READ_WRITE | MODE_CREATE;
        if ("rwt".equals(mode)) return MODE_READ_WRITE | MODE_CREATE | MODE_TRUNCATE;

        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bad mode: " + mode);
    }

    public FileDescriptor getFileDescriptor()
    {
        if (mWrapped != null) return mWrapped.getFileDescriptor();
        return mDescriptor;
    }

    public int getFd()
    {
        if (mWrapped != null) return mWrapped.getFd();
        if (mFd < 0 && mDescriptor != null && mResource != null) return descriptorInt(mDescriptor);
        return mFd;
    }

    public long getStatSize()
    {
        if (mWrapped != null) return mWrapped.getStatSize();

        try
        {
            if (mResource instanceof RandomAccessFile) return ((RandomAccessFile)mResource).length();
        }
        catch (IOException unreadable)
        {
            return -1;
        }

        int fd = getFd();
        if (fd < 0) return -1;

        File target = new File("/proc/self/fd/" + fd);
        return target.isFile() ? target.length() : -1;
    }

    public int detachFd()
    {
        if (mWrapped != null) return mWrapped.detachFd();

        int detached = getFd();
        mFd = -1;
        mResource = null;
        if (detached >= 0) nativeInvalidate(mDescriptor);
        return detached;
    }

    @Override
    public void close() throws IOException
    {
        if (mWrapped != null)
        {
            mWrapped.close();
            return;
        }

        if (mResource != null)
        {
            Closeable resource = mResource;
            mResource = null;
            mFd = -1;
            resource.close();
            notifyClosed(null);
            return;
        }

        if (mFd < 0) return;

        int closing = mFd;
        mFd = -1;
        if (!nativeClose(mDescriptor, closing)) throw new IOException("could not close descriptor " + closing);
        notifyClosed(null);
    }

    public void closeWithError(String message) throws IOException
    {
        close();
    }

    public boolean canDetectErrors()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void checkError() throws IOException
    {
    }

    private void notifyClosed(final IOException exception)
    {
        final OnCloseListener listener = mCloseListener;
        if (listener == null) return;

        mCloseListener = null;
        Runnable report = new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                listener.onClose(exception);
            }
        };

        if (mCloseHandler != null) mCloseHandler.post(report);
        else report.run();
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return Parcelable.CONTENTS_FILE_DESCRIPTOR;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
    {
        out.writeValue(this);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "{ParcelFileDescriptor: " + getFd() + "}";
    }

    private static FileDescriptor channelDescriptor(Object channel)
    {
        for (Class<?> type = channel.getClass(); type != null; type = type.getSuperclass())
        {
            try
            {
                java.lang.reflect.Method method = type.getDeclaredMethod("getFD");
                method.setAccessible(true);
                Object result = method.invoke(channel);
                if (result instanceof FileDescriptor) return (FileDescriptor)result;
            }
            catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException missing)
            {
                continue;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    static int descriptorInt(FileDescriptor descriptor)
    {
        if (descriptor == null) return -1;

        try
        {
            java.lang.reflect.Method method = FileDescriptor.class.getDeclaredMethod("getInt$");
            method.setAccessible(true);
            return (Integer)method.invoke(descriptor);
        }
        catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException missing)
        {
            return descriptorField(descriptor);
        }
    }

    private static int descriptorField(FileDescriptor descriptor)
    {
        for (String name : new String[] {"descriptor", "fd"})
        {
            try
            {
                java.lang.reflect.Field field = FileDescriptor.class.getDeclaredField(name);
                field.setAccessible(true);
                return field.getInt(descriptor);
            }
            catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException missing)
            {
                continue;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private static void setDescriptorInt(FileDescriptor descriptor, int fd)
    {
        try
        {
            java.lang.reflect.Method method = FileDescriptor.class.getDeclaredMethod("setInt$", int.class);
            method.setAccessible(true);
            method.invoke(descriptor, fd);
            return;
        }
        catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException missing)
        {
            for (String name : new String[] {"descriptor", "fd"})
            {
                try
                {
                    java.lang.reflect.Field field = FileDescriptor.class.getDeclaredField(name);
                    field.setAccessible(true);
                    field.setInt(descriptor, fd);
                    return;
                }
                catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException absent)
                {
                    continue;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static native boolean nativeClose(FileDescriptor descriptor, int fd);

    static native void nativeInvalidate(FileDescriptor descriptor);

    public static class AutoCloseInputStream extends FileInputStream
    {
        private final ParcelFileDescriptor mOwner;

        public AutoCloseInputStream(ParcelFileDescriptor owner)
        {
            super(owner.getFileDescriptor());
            mOwner = owner;
        }

        protected ParcelFileDescriptor owner()
        {
            return mOwner;
        }

        @Override
        public void close() throws IOException
        {
            try
            {
                super.close();
            }
            finally
            {
                mOwner.close();
            }
        }
    }

    public static class AutoCloseOutputStream extends FileOutputStream
    {
        private final ParcelFileDescriptor mOwner;

        public AutoCloseOutputStream(ParcelFileDescriptor owner)
        {
            super(owner.getFileDescriptor());
            mOwner = owner;
        }

        @Override
        public void close() throws IOException
        {
            try
            {
                super.close();
            }
            finally
            {
                mOwner.close();
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/ParcelUuid.java`:

```java
package android.os;

import java.util.UUID;

public final class ParcelUuid implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<ParcelUuid> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ParcelUuid>()
    {
        @Override
        public ParcelUuid createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            long mostSignificantBits = source.readLong();
            long leastSignificantBits = source.readLong();
            return new ParcelUuid(new UUID(mostSignificantBits, leastSignificantBits));
        }

        @Override
        public ParcelUuid[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ParcelUuid[size];
        }
    };

    private final UUID mUuid;

    public ParcelUuid(UUID uuid)
    {
        mUuid = uuid;
    }

    public static ParcelUuid fromString(String uuid)
    {
        return new ParcelUuid(UUID.fromString(uuid));
    }

    public UUID getUuid()
    {
        return mUuid;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mUuid.toString();
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mUuid.hashCode();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        if (object == null) return false;
        if (this == object) return true;
        if (!(object instanceof ParcelUuid)) return false;

        return mUuid.equals(((ParcelUuid)object).mUuid);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeLong(mUuid.getMostSignificantBits());
        dest.writeLong(mUuid.getLeastSignificantBits());
    }
}
```

```java
package android.os;

public interface Parcelable

        T[] newArray(int size);

        T createFromParcel(Parcel source, ClassLoader loader);
```

`java/android/os/PerformanceHintManager.java`:

```java
package android.os;

import java.io.Closeable;

public final class PerformanceHintManager
{
    private static final long PREFERRED_UPDATE_RATE_NANOS = 16666666L;

    public PerformanceHintManager(android.content.Context context)
    {
    }

    public Session createHintSession(int[] tids, long initialTargetWorkDurationNanos)
    {
        if (tids == null) throw new NullPointerException("tids cannot be null");
        if (tids.length == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("thread id list can't be empty.");
        if (initialTargetWorkDurationNanos <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the hint target duration should be positive.");

        return new Session(tids, initialTargetWorkDurationNanos);
    }

    public long getPreferredUpdateRateNanos()
    {
        return PREFERRED_UPDATE_RATE_NANOS;
    }

    public static class Session implements Closeable
    {
        private int[] mThreads;
        private long mTargetDurationNanos;
        private long mLastActualDurationNanos;
        private boolean mClosed;

        Session(int[] threads, long targetDurationNanos)
        {
            mThreads = threads.clone();
            mTargetDurationNanos = targetDurationNanos;
        }

        public void updateTargetWorkDuration(long targetDurationNanos)
        {
            if (targetDurationNanos <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the hint target duration should be positive.");
            mTargetDurationNanos = targetDurationNanos;
        }

        public void reportActualWorkDuration(long actualDurationNanos)
        {
            if (actualDurationNanos <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the actual duration should be positive.");
            mLastActualDurationNanos = actualDurationNanos;
        }

        public void close()
        {
            mClosed = true;
        }

        public void setThreads(int[] tids)
        {
            if (tids == null) throw new NullPointerException("tids cannot be null");
            if (tids.length == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Thread id list can't be empty.");
            mThreads = tids.clone();
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/PersistableBundle.java`:

```java
package android.os;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.ObjectInputStream;
import java.io.ObjectOutputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public final class PersistableBundle extends BaseBundle implements Cloneable, Parcelable
{
    public static final PersistableBundle EMPTY =
        new PersistableBundle(Collections.<String, Object>unmodifiableMap(new HashMap<String, Object>()));

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<PersistableBundle> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<PersistableBundle>()
    {
        @Override
        public PersistableBundle createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            PersistableBundle bundle = new PersistableBundle();
            if (source != null) source.readBundleBody(bundle.mMap, null);
            return bundle;
        }

        @Override
        public PersistableBundle[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new PersistableBundle[size];
        }
    };

    public PersistableBundle()
    {
        super();
    }

    public PersistableBundle(int capacity)
    {
        super(capacity);
    }

    public PersistableBundle(PersistableBundle source)
    {
        super();
        if (source != null) mMap.putAll(source.mMap);
    }

    private PersistableBundle(Map<String, Object> map)
    {
        super(map);
    }

    public void putPersistableBundle(String key, PersistableBundle value)
    {
        mMap.put(key, value);
    }

    public PersistableBundle getPersistableBundle(String key)
    {
        Object value = mMap.get(key);
        return value instanceof PersistableBundle ? (PersistableBundle)value : null;
    }

    public PersistableBundle deepCopy()
    {
        PersistableBundle copy = new PersistableBundle();

        for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : mMap.entrySet())
        {
            Object value = entry.getValue();
            copy.mMap.put(entry.getKey(), value instanceof PersistableBundle ? ((PersistableBundle)value).deepCopy() : value);
        }

        return copy;
    }

    @Override
    public Object clone()
    {
        return new PersistableBundle(this);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeBundleBody(this);
    }

    public void writeToStream(OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException
    {
        ObjectOutputStream output = new ObjectOutputStream(outputStream);
        output.writeObject(toPlainMap());
        output.flush();
    }

    public static PersistableBundle readFromStream(InputStream inputStream) throws IOException
    {
        try
        {
            Object read = new ObjectInputStream(inputStream).readObject();
            return read instanceof HashMap ? fromPlainMap((HashMap<?, ?>)read) : new PersistableBundle();
        }
        catch (ClassNotFoundException missing)
        {
            throw new IOException(missing);
        }
    }

    private HashMap<String, Object> toPlainMap()
    {
        HashMap<String, Object> plain = new HashMap<>();

        for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : mMap.entrySet())
        {
            Object value = entry.getValue();
            plain.put(entry.getKey(), value instanceof PersistableBundle ? ((PersistableBundle)value).toPlainMap() : value);
        }

        return plain;
    }

    private static PersistableBundle fromPlainMap(HashMap<?, ?> plain)
    {
        PersistableBundle bundle = new PersistableBundle();

        for (Map.Entry<?, ?> entry : plain.entrySet())
        {
            Object value = entry.getValue();
            bundle.mMap.put(String.valueOf(entry.getKey()), value instanceof HashMap ? fromPlainMap((HashMap<?, ?>)value) : value);
        }

        return bundle;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized String toString()
    {
        return "PersistableBundle[" + mMap + "]";
    }
}
```

```java
    public boolean[] isAllowListed(Set<String> packageNames, boolean includingIdle)
    {
        boolean[] result = new boolean[packageNames == null ? 0 : packageNames.size()];
        int index = 0;

        {
            for (String packageName : packageNames) result[index++] = isExempt(packageName);
        }

    static void addPermanent(String packageName)
    {
        if (packageName == null) return;

        synchronized (sPermanent)
        {
            sPermanent.add(packageName);
        }
    }

    static void removePermanent(String packageName)
    {
        synchronized (sPermanent)
        {
            sPermanent.remove(packageName);
        }
    }

    static String[] permanent()
    {
        synchronized (sPermanent)
        {
            return sPermanent.toArray(new String[0]);
        }
    }

    static void addTemporary(String packageName, long durationMs, int reasonCode, String reason)
    {
        if (packageName == null) return;

        synchronized (sTemporary)
        {
            sTemporary.put(packageName, SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + Math.max(0L, durationMs));
        }

        Log.i(TAG, packageName + " is temporarily allow-listed for " + durationMs + "ms (reason " + reasonCode + ": " + reason
                       + "); this device never enters idle, so nothing is deferred either way");
    }

    static boolean isTemporarilyAllowed(String packageName)
    {
        synchronized (sTemporary)
        {
            Long until = sTemporary.get(packageName);
            if (until == null) return false;
            if (until > SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()) return true;

            sTemporary.remove(packageName);
            return false;
        }
    }

    static boolean isExempt(String packageName)
    {
        if (packageName == null) return false;

        synchronized (sPermanent)
        {
            if (sPermanent.contains(packageName)) return true;
        }

        return isTemporarilyAllowed(packageName);
    }

    static int[] allowListedAppIds()
    {
        String own = android.app.ActivityThread.currentPackageName();
        return own != null && isExempt(own) ? new int[] {Process.myUid() % 100000} : new int[0];
    }

    static int[] temporaryAppIds()
    {
        String own = android.app.ActivityThread.currentPackageName();
        return own != null && isTemporarilyAllowed(own) ? new int[] {Process.myUid() % 100000} : new int[0];
    }

    static final class DeviceIdleController extends IDeviceIdleController.Stub
    {
        @Override
        public void addPowerSaveWhitelistApp(String packageName)
        {
            addPermanent(packageName);
        }

        @Override

        {
            int added = 0;
            if (packageNames == null) return added;

            for (String packageName : packageNames)
            {
                if (packageName == null) continue;

                addPermanent(packageName);
                added++;
            }

            return added;
```

```java
package android.os;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;

public class PowerManager
{
    public static final int PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK = 0x00000001;
    public static final int SCREEN_DIM_WAKE_LOCK = 0x00000006;
    public static final int SCREEN_BRIGHT_WAKE_LOCK = 0x0000000a;
    public static final int FULL_WAKE_LOCK = 0x0000001a;
    public static final int PROXIMITY_SCREEN_OFF_WAKE_LOCK = 0x00000020;
    public static final int ACQUIRE_CAUSES_WAKEUP = 0x10000000;
    public static final int ON_AFTER_RELEASE = 0x20000000;
    public static final int RELEASE_FLAG_WAIT_FOR_NO_PROXIMITY = 1;

    public static final int THERMAL_STATUS_NONE = 0;
    public static final int THERMAL_STATUS_LIGHT = 1;
    public static final int THERMAL_STATUS_MODERATE = 2;
    public static final int THERMAL_STATUS_SEVERE = 3;
    public static final int THERMAL_STATUS_CRITICAL = 4;
    public static final int THERMAL_STATUS_EMERGENCY = 5;
    public static final int THERMAL_STATUS_SHUTDOWN = 6;

    public static final int LOCATION_MODE_NO_CHANGE = 0;
    public static final int LOCATION_MODE_GPS_DISABLED_WHEN_SCREEN_OFF = 1;
    public static final int LOCATION_MODE_ALL_DISABLED_WHEN_SCREEN_OFF = 2;
    public static final int LOCATION_MODE_FOREGROUND_ONLY = 3;
    public static final int LOCATION_MODE_THROTTLE_REQUESTS_WHEN_SCREEN_OFF = 4;

    public static final String ACTION_POWER_SAVE_MODE_CHANGED = "android.os.action.POWER_SAVE_MODE_CHANGED";
    public static final String ACTION_DEVICE_IDLE_MODE_CHANGED = "android.os.action.DEVICE_IDLE_MODE_CHANGED";
    public static final String ACTION_DEVICE_LIGHT_IDLE_MODE_CHANGED = "android.os.action.LIGHT_DEVICE_IDLE_MODE_CHANGED";
    public static final String ACTION_LOW_POWER_STANDBY_ENABLED_CHANGED = "android.os.action.LOW_POWER_STANDBY_ENABLED_CHANGED";

    private static final int WAKE_LOCK_LEVEL_MASK = 0x0000ffff;

    private final ArrayList<OnThermalStatusChangedListener> mThermalListeners = new ArrayList<>();

    public interface OnThermalStatusChangedListener
    {
        void onThermalStatusChanged(int status);
    }

    public final class WakeLock
    {
        private final int mFlags;
        private final String mTag;
        private final Runnable mReleaser = new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                release(RELEASE_FLAG_TIMEOUT);
            }
        };
        private int mCount;
        private boolean mRefCounted = true;
        private boolean mHeld;
        private int mTimeouts;
        private WorkSource mWorkSource;

        WakeLock(int flags, String tag)
        {
            mFlags = flags;
            mTag = tag;
        }

        public void setReferenceCounted(boolean counted)
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                mRefCounted = counted;
            }
        }

        public void acquire()
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                acquireLocked();
            }
        }

        public void acquire(long timeout)
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                acquireLocked();

                Handler handler = handler();
                if (handler == null) return;

                mTimeouts++;
                handler.postDelayed(mReleaser, timeout);
            }
        }

        private void acquireLocked()
        {
            if (!mRefCounted || mCount++ == 0)
            {
                Handler handler = handler();
                if (handler != null) handler.removeCallbacks(mReleaser);
                mTimeouts = 0;
                mHeld = true;
            }
        }

        public void release()
        {
            release(0);
        }

        public void release(int flags)
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                if (flags == RELEASE_FLAG_TIMEOUT)
                {
                    if (mTimeouts <= 0) return;
                    mTimeouts--;
                }

                if (mRefCounted && mCount > 0) mCount--;

                if (!mRefCounted || mCount == 0)
                {
                    Handler handler = handler();
                    if (handler != null) handler.removeCallbacks(mReleaser);
                    mTimeouts = 0;
                    mHeld = false;
                }
            }
        }

        public boolean isHeld()
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                return mHeld;
            }
        }

        public void setWorkSource(WorkSource workSource)
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                mWorkSource = workSource == null ? null : new WorkSource(workSource);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                return "WakeLock{" + Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(this)) + " held=" + mHeld + ", refCount=" + mCount
                       + "}";
            }
        }
    }

    private static final int RELEASE_FLAG_TIMEOUT = 0x10000;

    private static Handler handler()
    {
        Looper main = Looper.getMainLooper();
        return main == null ? null : new Handler(main);
    }

    public WakeLock newWakeLock(int levelAndFlags, String tag)
    {
        if (tag == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("The tag must not be null.");
        if (!isWakeLockLevelSupported(levelAndFlags & WAKE_LOCK_LEVEL_MASK))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Must specify a valid wake lock level.");
        }

        return new WakeLock(levelAndFlags, tag);
    }

    public boolean isWakeLockLevelSupported(int level)
    {
        switch (level)
        {
            case PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK:
            case SCREEN_DIM_WAKE_LOCK:
            case SCREEN_BRIGHT_WAKE_LOCK:
            case FULL_WAKE_LOCK:
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    public boolean isInteractive()
    {
        return true;
    }

    public boolean isScreenOn()
    {
        return true;
    }

    public boolean isPowerSaveMode()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isDeviceIdleMode()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isDeviceLightIdleMode()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isLowPowerStandbyEnabled()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isExemptFromLowPowerStandby()
    {
        return true;
    }

    public boolean isAllowedInLowPowerStandby(int reason)
    {
        return true;
    }

    public boolean isAllowedInLowPowerStandby(String feature)
    {
        return true;
    }

    public boolean isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations(String packageName)
    {
        return true;
    }

    public boolean isSustainedPerformanceModeSupported()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isRebootingUserspaceSupported()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void reboot(String reason)
    {
        throw new SecurityException("android.permission.REBOOT is not granted to this application");
    }

    public java.time.Duration getBatteryDischargePrediction()
    {
        return null;
    }

    public boolean isBatteryDischargePredictionPersonalized()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public int getLocationPowerSaveMode()
    {
        return LOCATION_MODE_NO_CHANGE;
    }

    public int getCurrentThermalStatus()
    {
        return THERMAL_STATUS_NONE;
    }

    public void addThermalStatusListener(OnThermalStatusChangedListener listener)
    {
        addThermalStatusListener(null, listener);
    }

    public void addThermalStatusListener(Executor executor, final OnThermalStatusChangedListener listener)
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new NullPointerException("listener cannot be null");

        synchronized (mThermalListeners)
        {
            if (mThermalListeners.contains(listener)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Listener already registered: " + listener);
            mThermalListeners.add(listener);
        }

        Runnable report = new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                listener.onThermalStatusChanged(getCurrentThermalStatus());
            }
        };

        if (executor != null)
        {
            executor.execute(report);
            return;
        }

        Handler handler = handler();
        if (handler != null) handler.post(report);
    }

    public void removeThermalStatusListener(OnThermalStatusChangedListener listener)
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new NullPointerException("listener cannot be null");

        synchronized (mThermalListeners)
        {
            if (!mThermalListeners.remove(listener)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Listener was not added: " + listener);
        }
    }

    public float getThermalHeadroom(int forecastSeconds)
    {
        if (forecastSeconds < 0 || forecastSeconds > 60) return Float.NaN;
        return 0.3f;
    }
}
```

```java
    }

    {
        boolean[] result = new boolean[packageNames == null ? 0 : packageNames.size()];
        int index = 0;

        if (packageNames != null)
        {
            for (String packageName : packageNames) result[index++] = PowerExemptionManager.isExempt(packageName);
        }

        return result;

    {
        long duration = event == EVENT_MMS ? 60000L : event == EVENT_SMS ? 20000L : 10000L;
        PowerExemptionManager.addTemporary(packageName, duration, reasonCode, reason);
```

```java
public class Process

    public static final int THREAD_PRIORITY_BACKGROUND = 10;

    }

    public static int getThreadPriority(int tid)

        if (java >= Thread.MAX_PRIORITY) return THREAD_PRIORITY_URGENT_DISPLAY;

    }

    public static long getElapsedCpuTime()

    }

    public static final int PHONE_UID = 1001;
    public static final int SHELL_UID = 2000;
    public static final int BLUETOOTH_UID = 1002;
    public static final int WIFI_UID = 1010;
    public static final int LAST_APPLICATION_UID = 19999;

    private static final long START_ELAPSED_REALTIME = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
```

`java/android/os/RemoteCallbackList.java`:

```java
package android.os;

import android.util.ArrayMap;

public class RemoteCallbackList<E extends IInterface>
{
    private final ArrayMap<IBinder, Callback> mCallbacks = new ArrayMap<>();
    private Object[] mActiveBroadcast;
    private int mBroadcastCount = -1;
    private boolean mKilled = false;

    private final class Callback implements IBinder.DeathRecipient
    {
        final E mCallback;
        final Object mCookie;

        Callback(E callback, Object cookie)
        {
            mCallback = callback;
            mCookie = cookie;
        }

        @Override
        public void binderDied()
        {
            synchronized (mCallbacks)
            {
                mCallbacks.remove(mCallback.asBinder());
            }
            onCallbackDied(mCallback, mCookie);
        }
    }

    public RemoteCallbackList()
    {
    }

    public boolean register(E callback)
    {
        return register(callback, null);
    }

    public boolean register(E callback, Object cookie)
    {
        synchronized (mCallbacks)
        {
            if (mKilled) return false;

            IBinder binder = callback.asBinder();
            Callback registered = new Callback(callback, cookie);
            Callback previous = mCallbacks.put(binder, registered);
            if (previous != null && binder != null) binder.unlinkToDeath(previous, 0);
            if (binder != null) binder.linkToDeath(registered, 0);
            return true;
        }
    }

    public boolean unregister(E callback)
    {
        synchronized (mCallbacks)
        {
            Callback registered = mCallbacks.remove(callback.asBinder());
            if (registered == null) return false;

            IBinder binder = registered.mCallback.asBinder();
            if (binder != null) binder.unlinkToDeath(registered, 0);
            return true;
        }
    }

    public void kill()
    {
        synchronized (mCallbacks)
        {
            for (int index = mCallbacks.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
            {
                Callback registered = mCallbacks.valueAt(index);
                IBinder binder = registered.mCallback.asBinder();
                if (binder != null) binder.unlinkToDeath(registered, 0);
            }
            mCallbacks.clear();
            mKilled = true;
        }
    }

    public void onCallbackDied(E callback)
    {
    }

    public void onCallbackDied(E callback, Object cookie)
    {
        onCallbackDied(callback);
    }

    public int beginBroadcast()
    {
        synchronized (mCallbacks)
        {
            if (mBroadcastCount > 0) throw new IllegalStateException("beginBroadcast() called while already in a broadcast");

            final int count = mCallbacks.size();
            mBroadcastCount = count;
            if (count <= 0) return 0;

            Object[] active = mActiveBroadcast;
            if (active == null || active.length < count) mActiveBroadcast = active = new Object[count];
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) active[index] = mCallbacks.valueAt(index);
            return count;
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public E getBroadcastItem(int index)
    {
        return ((Callback)mActiveBroadcast[index]).mCallback;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public Object getBroadcastCookie(int index)
    {
        return ((Callback)mActiveBroadcast[index]).mCookie;
    }

    public void finishBroadcast()
    {
        synchronized (mCallbacks)
        {
            if (mBroadcastCount < 0) throw new IllegalStateException("finishBroadcast() called outside of a broadcast");

            Object[] active = mActiveBroadcast;
            if (active != null)
            {
                final int count = mBroadcastCount;
                for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) active[index] = null;
            }
            mBroadcastCount = -1;
        }
    }

    public int getRegisteredCallbackCount()
    {
        synchronized (mCallbacks)
        {
            if (mKilled) return 0;
            return mCallbacks.size();
        }
    }

    public E getRegisteredCallbackItem(int index)
    {
        synchronized (mCallbacks)
        {
            if (mKilled) return null;
            return mCallbacks.valueAt(index).mCallback;
        }
    }

    public Object getRegisteredCallbackCookie(int index)
    {
        synchronized (mCallbacks)
        {
            if (mKilled) return null;
            return mCallbacks.valueAt(index).mCookie;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.os;

public class ResultReceiver implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<ResultReceiver> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ResultReceiver>()
    {
        @Override
        public ResultReceiver createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            Object value = source == null ? null : source.readValue(null);
            return value instanceof ResultReceiver ? (ResultReceiver)value : new ResultReceiver(null);
        }

        @Override
        public ResultReceiver[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ResultReceiver[size];
        }
    };

    private final Handler mHandler;

    public ResultReceiver(Handler handler)
    {
        mHandler = handler;
    }

    public void send(final int resultCode, final Bundle resultData)
    {
        if (mHandler == null)
        {
            onReceiveResult(resultCode, resultData);
            return;
        }

        mHandler.post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                onReceiveResult(resultCode, resultData);
            }
        });
    }

    protected void onReceiveResult(int resultCode, Bundle resultData)
    {
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
    {
        out.writeValue(this);
    }
}
```

```java
    }

        }

        {

        }
    }

    public static IBinder checkService(String name)

        return getService(name);
    }

    public static String[] listServices()
    {
        synchronized (sServices)
        {
            return sServices.keySet().toArray(new String[0]);
        }
    }
```
