`java/android/os/SharedMemory.java`:

```java
package android.os;

import java.io.Closeable;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.MappedByteBuffer;
import java.nio.channels.FileChannel;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.WeakHashMap;

public final class SharedMemory implements Closeable, Parcelable
{
    private static final int PROT_READ = 1;
    private static final int PROT_WRITE = 2;
    private static final int PROT_EXEC = 4;
    private static final int PROT_MASK = PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE | PROT_EXEC;

    private static final int ENOMEM = 12;
    private static final int EACCES = 13;

    private static final Map<ByteBuffer, Boolean> sMapped = Collections.synchronizedMap(new WeakHashMap<ByteBuffer, Boolean>());

    public static final Creator<SharedMemory> CREATOR = new Creator<SharedMemory>()
    {
        @Override
        public SharedMemory createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            ParcelFileDescriptor descriptor = source.readFileDescriptor();
            return descriptor == null ? null : fromFileDescriptor(descriptor);
        }

        @Override
        public SharedMemory[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new SharedMemory[size];
        }
    };

    private RandomAccessFile mFile;
    private FileChannel mChannel;
    private int mSize;
    private int mProtection = PROT_MASK;

    SharedMemory()
    {
    }

    public static SharedMemory create(String name, int size)
    {
        if (size <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Size must be greater than zero");

        File directory = new File("/dev/shm");
        if (!directory.isDirectory()) directory = new File(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir", "/tmp"));

        try
        {
            File backing = File.createTempFile("shm-" + (name == null ? "anonymous" : name.replace('/', '_')) + "-", ".mem", directory);
            RandomAccessFile file = new RandomAccessFile(backing, "rw");
            backing.delete();
            file.setLength(size);

            SharedMemory memory = new SharedMemory();
            memory.adopt(file, size);
            return memory;
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            throw SharedMemory.<RuntimeException>sneaky(errno("SharedMemory.create", ENOMEM, failure));
        }
    }

    public static SharedMemory fromFileDescriptor(ParcelFileDescriptor descriptor)
    {
        if (descriptor == null) throw new NullPointerException("descriptor");

        try
        {
            RandomAccessFile file = new RandomAccessFile("/proc/self/fd/" + descriptor.getFd(), "rw");
            SharedMemory memory = new SharedMemory();
            memory.adopt(file, (int)file.length());
            return memory;
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("the file descriptor is not a valid shared memory region", failure);
        }
    }

    private void adopt(RandomAccessFile file, int size) throws IOException
    {
        mFile = file;
        mChannel = file.getChannel();
        mSize = size;
    }

    private void checkOpen()
    {
        if (mChannel == null) throw new IllegalStateException("SharedMemory is closed");
    }

    public synchronized int getSize()
    {
        checkOpen();
        return mSize;
    }

    public synchronized boolean setProtect(int protection)
    {
        checkOpen();
        if ((protection & ~PROT_MASK) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid prot value");
        if ((protection & ~mProtection) != 0) return false;

        mProtection = protection;
        return true;
    }

    public ByteBuffer mapReadWrite()
    {
        return map(PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, 0, getSize());
    }

    public ByteBuffer mapReadOnly()
    {
        return map(PROT_READ, 0, getSize());
    }

    public synchronized ByteBuffer map(int protection, int offset, int length)
    {
        checkOpen();
        if ((protection & ~PROT_MASK) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid prot value");
        if (offset < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Offset must be >= 0");
        if (length <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Length must be > 0");
        if (offset + length > mSize) throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset + length must not exceed getSize()");

        if ((protection & ~mProtection) != 0)
        {
            throw SharedMemory.<RuntimeException>sneaky(errno("mmap", EACCES, null));
        }

        try
        {
            boolean writable = (protection & PROT_WRITE) != 0;
            MappedByteBuffer mapped = mChannel.map(writable ? FileChannel.MapMode.READ_WRITE : FileChannel.MapMode.READ_ONLY, offset, length);
            sMapped.put(mapped, Boolean.TRUE);
            return mapped;
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            throw SharedMemory.<RuntimeException>sneaky(errno("mmap", ENOMEM, failure));
        }
    }

    public static void unmap(ByteBuffer buffer)
    {
        if (buffer == null || sMapped.remove(buffer) == null)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("ByteBuffer wasn't created by #map(int, int, int); can't unmap");
        }
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void close()
    {
        if (mChannel == null) return;

        try
        {
            mFile.close();
        }
        catch (IOException ignored)
        {
        }

        mChannel = null;
        mFile = null;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return CONTENTS_FILE_DESCRIPTOR;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        checkOpen();

        try
        {
            destination.writeFileDescriptor(mFile.getFD());
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("the shared memory descriptor is no longer valid", failure);
        }
    }

    private static Exception errno(String functionName, int errno, Throwable cause)
    {
        try
        {
            Class<?> type = Class.forName("android.system.ErrnoException");
            Exception exception = (Exception)type.getConstructor(String.class, int.class).newInstance(functionName, errno);
            if (cause != null) exception.initCause(cause);
            return exception;
        }
        catch (ReflectiveOperationException absent)
        {
            return new IllegalStateException(functionName + " failed with errno " + errno, cause);
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static <T extends Throwable> T sneaky(Throwable throwable) throws T
    {
        throw (T)throwable;
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/StatFs.java`:

```java
package android.os;

import java.io.File;

public class StatFs
{
    private static final long BLOCK_SIZE = 4096L;

    private long mTotalBytes;
    private long mFreeBytes;
    private long mAvailableBytes;

    public StatFs(String path)
    {
        restat(path);
    }

    public void restat(String path)
    {
        if (path == null) throw new NullPointerException("path");

        File file = new File(path);
        if (!file.exists()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid path: " + path);

        mTotalBytes = file.getTotalSpace();
        mFreeBytes = file.getFreeSpace();
        mAvailableBytes = file.getUsableSpace();
    }

    public int getBlockSize()
    {
        return (int)BLOCK_SIZE;
    }

    public long getBlockSizeLong()
    {
        return BLOCK_SIZE;
    }

    public int getBlockCount()
    {
        return (int)getBlockCountLong();
    }

    public long getBlockCountLong()
    {
        return mTotalBytes / BLOCK_SIZE;
    }

    public int getFreeBlocks()
    {
        return (int)getFreeBlocksLong();
    }

    public long getFreeBlocksLong()
    {
        return mFreeBytes / BLOCK_SIZE;
    }

    public long getFreeBytes()
    {
        return getFreeBlocksLong() * BLOCK_SIZE;
    }

    public int getAvailableBlocks()
    {
        return (int)getAvailableBlocksLong();
    }

    public long getAvailableBlocksLong()
    {
        return mAvailableBytes / BLOCK_SIZE;
    }

    public long getAvailableBytes()
    {
        return getAvailableBlocksLong() * BLOCK_SIZE;
    }

    public long getTotalBytes()
    {
        return getBlockCountLong() * BLOCK_SIZE;
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/SystemClock.java`:

```java
package android.os;

public final class SystemClock
{
    private static final long BOOT_NANOS = System.nanoTime();

    private SystemClock()
    {
    }

    public static long uptimeMillis()
    {
        return (System.nanoTime() - BOOT_NANOS) / 1000000L;
    }

    public static long uptimeNanos()
    {
        return System.nanoTime() - BOOT_NANOS;
    }

    public static long elapsedRealtime()
    {
        return uptimeMillis();
    }

    public static long elapsedRealtimeNanos()
    {
        return uptimeNanos();
    }

    public static long currentThreadTimeMillis()
    {
        return uptimeMillis();
    }

    public static boolean setCurrentTimeMillis(long millis)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public static void sleep(long ms)
    {
        if (ms <= 0) return;

        long deadline = uptimeMillis() + ms;
        long remaining = ms;
        boolean interrupted = false;

        while (remaining > 0)
        {
            try
            {
                Thread.sleep(remaining);
            }
            catch (InterruptedException ignored)
            {
                interrupted = true;
            }
            remaining = deadline - uptimeMillis();
        }

        if (interrupted) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
    }
}
```

```java
package android.os;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class SystemProperties
{
    public static final int PROP_VALUE_MAX = 91;

    private static final Map<String, String> sProperties = new HashMap<>();
    private static final List<Runnable> sChangeCallbacks = new ArrayList<>();

    static
    {
        String abis = String.join(",", Build.SUPPORTED_ABIS);

        sProperties.put("ro.build.version.sdk", Integer.toString(Build.VERSION.SDK_INT));
        sProperties.put("ro.build.version.release", Build.VERSION.RELEASE);

        sProperties.put("ro.board.platform", Build.BOARD);

        sProperties.put("ro.bootloader", Build.BOOTLOADER);

        sProperties.put("ro.debuggable", "0");
        sProperties.put("ro.secure", "1");
        sProperties.put("ro.adb.secure", "1");
        sProperties.put("ro.kernel.qemu", "0");
        sProperties.put("ro.boot.qemu", "0");
        sProperties.put("ro.crypto.state", "encrypted");
        sProperties.put("ro.crypto.type", "file");

        sProperties.put("dalvik.vm.heapsize", "512m");
        sProperties.put("dalvik.vm.heapgrowthlimit", "256m");
        sProperties.put("persist.sys.timezone", java.util.TimeZone.getDefault().getID());
    }

    private SystemProperties()
    {
    }

    public static String get(String key)
    {
        return get(key, "");
    }

    public static String get(String key, String def)
    {
        if (key == null) throw new NullPointerException("key");

        synchronized (sProperties)
        {
            String value = sProperties.get(key);
            return value == null || value.isEmpty() ? def : value;
        }
    }

    public static int getInt(String key, int def)
    {
        try
        {
            return Integer.decode(get(key, Integer.toString(def)).trim());
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
        {
            return def;
        }
    }

    public static long getLong(String key, long def)
    {
        try
        {
            return Long.decode(get(key, Long.toString(def)).trim());
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
        {
            return def;
        }
    }

    public static boolean getBoolean(String key, boolean def)
    {
        String value = get(key, "");
        if (value.isEmpty()) return def;

        if ("1".equals(value) || "y".equals(value) || "yes".equals(value) || "on".equals(value) || "true".equals(value)) return true;
        if ("0".equals(value) || "n".equals(value) || "no".equals(value) || "off".equals(value) || "false".equals(value)) return false;
        return def;
    }

    public static void set(String key, String value)
    {
        if (key == null) throw new NullPointerException("key");
        if (value != null && value.length() > PROP_VALUE_MAX && !key.startsWith("ro."))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("value of system property '" + key + "' is longer than " + PROP_VALUE_MAX
                                               + " characters: " + value);
        }

        List<Runnable> callbacks;
        synchronized (sProperties)
        {
            if (key.startsWith("ro.") && sProperties.containsKey(key)) return;

            sProperties.put(key, value == null ? "" : value);
            callbacks = new ArrayList<>(sChangeCallbacks);
        }

        for (Runnable callback : callbacks) callback.run();
    }

    public static void addChangeCallback(Runnable callback)
    {
        synchronized (sProperties)
        {
            sChangeCallbacks.add(callback);
        }
    }

    public static void removeChangeCallback(Runnable callback)
    {
        synchronized (sProperties)
        {
            sChangeCallbacks.remove(callback);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.os;

public final class VibrationAttributes implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int FLAG_BYPASS_INTERRUPTION_POLICY = 1;

    public static final int USAGE_CLASS_UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final int USAGE_CLASS_ALARM = 1;
    public static final int USAGE_CLASS_FEEDBACK = 2;
    public static final int USAGE_CLASS_MEDIA = 3;
    public static final int USAGE_CLASS_MASK = 15;

    public static final int USAGE_UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final int USAGE_ALARM = 17;
    public static final int USAGE_TOUCH = 18;
    public static final int USAGE_MEDIA = 19;
    public static final int USAGE_RINGTONE = 33;
    public static final int USAGE_PHYSICAL_EMULATION = 34;
    public static final int USAGE_NOTIFICATION = 49;
    public static final int USAGE_HARDWARE_FEEDBACK = 50;
    public static final int USAGE_COMMUNICATION_REQUEST = 65;
    public static final int USAGE_ACCESSIBILITY = 66;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<VibrationAttributes> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<VibrationAttributes>()
    {
        @Override
        public VibrationAttributes createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int usage = source.readInt();
            return new VibrationAttributes(usage, source.readInt());
        }

        @Override
        public VibrationAttributes[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new VibrationAttributes[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mUsage;
    private final int mFlags;

    private VibrationAttributes(int usage, int flags)
    {
        mUsage = usage;
        mFlags = flags;
    }

    public static VibrationAttributes createForUsage(int usage)
    {
        return new Builder().setUsage(usage).build();
    }

    public int getUsageClass()
    {
        return mUsage & USAGE_CLASS_MASK;
    }

    public int getUsage()
    {
        return mUsage;
    }

    public int getFlags()
    {
        return mFlags;
    }

    public boolean isFlagSet(int flag)
    {
        return (mFlags & flag) > 0;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mUsage);
        dest.writeInt(mFlags);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof VibrationAttributes)) return false;

        VibrationAttributes attributes = (VibrationAttributes)other;
        return mUsage == attributes.mUsage && mFlags == attributes.mFlags;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mUsage * 31 + mFlags;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "VibrationAttributes{mUsage=" + mUsage + ", mFlags=" + mFlags + "}";
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private int mUsage = USAGE_UNKNOWN;
        private int mFlags;

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public Builder(VibrationAttributes attributes)
        {
            if (attributes == null) return;

            mUsage = attributes.mUsage;
            mFlags = attributes.mFlags;
        }

        public VibrationAttributes build()
        {
            return new VibrationAttributes(mUsage, mFlags);
        }

        public Builder setUsage(int usage)
        {
            mUsage = usage;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setFlags(int flags, int mask)
        {
            mFlags = (mFlags & ~mask) | (flags & mask);
            return this;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/VibrationEffect.java`:

```java
package android.os;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

public abstract class VibrationEffect implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE = -1;
    public static final int MAX_AMPLITUDE = 255;

    public static final int EFFECT_CLICK = 0;
    public static final int EFFECT_DOUBLE_CLICK = 1;
    public static final int EFFECT_TICK = 2;
    public static final int EFFECT_HEAVY_CLICK = 5;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<VibrationEffect> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<VibrationEffect>()
    {
        @Override
        public VibrationEffect createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            long[] timings = source.createLongArray();
            int[] amplitudes = source.createIntArray();
            int repeat = source.readInt();
            return new Waveform(timings == null ? new long[0] : timings, amplitudes == null ? new int[0] : amplitudes, repeat);
        }

        @Override
        public VibrationEffect[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new VibrationEffect[size];
        }
    };

    VibrationEffect()
    {
    }

    public static VibrationEffect createOneShot(long milliseconds, int amplitude)
    {
        if (milliseconds <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("timing must be positive");
        if (amplitude != DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE && (amplitude < 1 || amplitude > MAX_AMPLITUDE))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("amplitude must either be DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE, or between 1 and 255 inclusive");
        }

        return new Waveform(new long[] {milliseconds}, new int[] {amplitude}, -1);
    }

    public static VibrationEffect createWaveform(long[] timings, int repeat)
    {
        if (timings == null) throw new NullPointerException("timings");

        int[] amplitudes = new int[timings.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < amplitudes.length; index++) amplitudes[index] = index % 2 == 0 ? 0 : DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE;
        return createWaveform(timings, amplitudes, repeat);
    }

    public static VibrationEffect createWaveform(long[] timings, int[] amplitudes, int repeat)
    {
        if (timings == null || amplitudes == null) throw new NullPointerException("timings and amplitudes are required");
        if (timings.length != amplitudes.length)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("timing and amplitude arrays must be of equal length");
        }
        if (repeat < -1 || repeat >= timings.length)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("repeat index must be within the bounds of the timings array");
        }

        return new Waveform(timings.clone(), amplitudes.clone(), repeat);
    }

    public static VibrationEffect createPredefined(int effectId)
    {
        switch (effectId)
        {
            case EFFECT_CLICK:
                return new Waveform(new long[] {12}, new int[] {DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE}, -1);
            case EFFECT_DOUBLE_CLICK:
                return new Waveform(new long[] {0, 30, 100, 30}, new int[] {0, DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE, 0, DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE}, -1);
            case EFFECT_TICK:
                return new Waveform(new long[] {5}, new int[] {DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE}, -1);
            case EFFECT_HEAVY_CLICK:
                return new Waveform(new long[] {20}, new int[] {DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE}, -1);
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown predefined effect " + effectId);
        }
    }

    public static Composition startComposition()
    {
        return new Composition();
    }

    public abstract long getDuration();

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    static final class Waveform extends VibrationEffect
    {
        private final long[] mTimings;
        private final int[] mAmplitudes;
        private final int mRepeat;

        Waveform(long[] timings, int[] amplitudes, int repeat)
        {
            mTimings = timings;
            mAmplitudes = amplitudes;
            mRepeat = repeat;
        }

        @Override
        public long getDuration()
        {
            if (mRepeat >= 0) return Long.MAX_VALUE;

            long total = 0;
            for (long timing : mTimings) total += timing;
            return total;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
        {
            dest.writeLongArray(mTimings);
            dest.writeIntArray(mAmplitudes);
            dest.writeInt(mRepeat);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object other)
        {
            if (!(other instanceof Waveform)) return false;

            Waveform waveform = (Waveform)other;
            return Arrays.equals(mTimings, waveform.mTimings) && Arrays.equals(mAmplitudes, waveform.mAmplitudes)
                && mRepeat == waveform.mRepeat;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return Arrays.hashCode(mTimings) * 31 + Arrays.hashCode(mAmplitudes) + mRepeat;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "Waveform{mTimings=" + Arrays.toString(mTimings) + ", mAmplitudes=" + Arrays.toString(mAmplitudes)
                   + ", mRepeat=" + mRepeat + "}";
        }
    }

    public static final class Composition
    {
        public static final int PRIMITIVE_CLICK = 1;
        public static final int PRIMITIVE_THUD = 2;
        public static final int PRIMITIVE_SPIN = 3;
        public static final int PRIMITIVE_QUICK_RISE = 4;
        public static final int PRIMITIVE_SLOW_RISE = 5;
        public static final int PRIMITIVE_QUICK_FALL = 6;
        public static final int PRIMITIVE_TICK = 7;
        public static final int PRIMITIVE_LOW_TICK = 8;

        private final List<long[]> mSegments = new ArrayList<>();

        Composition()
        {
        }

        public Composition addPrimitive(int primitiveId)
        {
            return addPrimitive(primitiveId, 1f, 0);
        }

        public Composition addPrimitive(int primitiveId, float scale)
        {
            return addPrimitive(primitiveId, scale, 0);
        }

        public Composition addPrimitive(int primitiveId, float scale, int delay)
        {
            if (primitiveId < PRIMITIVE_CLICK || primitiveId > PRIMITIVE_LOW_TICK)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("primitiveId must be a valid primitive, got " + primitiveId);
            }
            if (scale < 0f || scale > 1f) throw new IllegalArgumentException("scale must be between 0 and 1");
            if (delay < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("delay must be non-negative");

            mSegments.add(new long[] {delay, 10, Math.max(1, Math.round(scale * MAX_AMPLITUDE))});
            return this;
        }

        public VibrationEffect compose()
        {
            if (mSegments.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("Composition must have at least one element to compose.");

            long[] timings = new long[mSegments.size() * 2];
            int[] amplitudes = new int[timings.length];
            for (int index = 0; index < mSegments.size(); index++)
            {
                long[] segment = mSegments.get(index);
                timings[index * 2] = segment[0];
                amplitudes[index * 2] = 0;
                timings[index * 2 + 1] = segment[1];
                amplitudes[index * 2 + 1] = (int)segment[2];
            }
            return new Waveform(timings, amplitudes, -1);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/WorkSource.java`:

```java
package android.os;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class WorkSource implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<WorkSource> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<WorkSource>()
    {
        @Override
        public WorkSource createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            WorkSource workSource = new WorkSource();
            int count = source.readInt();
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                int uid = source.readInt();
                workSource.addEntry(uid, source.readString());
            }
            return workSource;
        }

        @Override
        public WorkSource[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new WorkSource[size];
        }
    };

    private final List<Integer> mUids = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> mNames = new ArrayList<>();

    public WorkSource()
    {
    }

    public WorkSource(WorkSource original)
    {
        if (original == null) return;

        mUids.addAll(original.mUids);
        mNames.addAll(original.mNames);
    }

    public WorkSource(int uid)
    {
        addEntry(uid, null);
    }

    public WorkSource(int uid, String packageName)
    {
        addEntry(uid, packageName);
    }

    public int size()
    {
        return mUids.size();
    }

    public int getUid(int index)
    {
        return mUids.get(index);
    }

    public String getPackageName(int index)
    {
        return mNames.get(index);
    }

    public boolean isEmpty()
    {
        return mUids.isEmpty();
    }

    public void clear()
    {
        mUids.clear();
        mNames.clear();
    }

    public boolean diff(WorkSource other)
    {
        return !equals(other);
    }

    public void set(WorkSource other)
    {
        clear();
        if (other == null) return;

        mUids.addAll(other.mUids);
        mNames.addAll(other.mNames);
    }

    public boolean add(WorkSource other)
    {
        if (other == null) return false;

        boolean changed = false;
        for (int index = 0; index < other.mUids.size(); index++)
        {
            changed |= addEntry(other.mUids.get(index), other.mNames.get(index));
        }
        return changed;
    }

    public boolean add(int uid)
    {
        return addEntry(uid, null);
    }

    public boolean add(int uid, String packageName)
    {
        return addEntry(uid, packageName);
    }

    public boolean remove(WorkSource other)
    {
        if (other == null) return false;

        boolean changed = false;
        for (int index = 0; index < other.mUids.size(); index++)
        {
            int position = indexOf(other.mUids.get(index), other.mNames.get(index));
            if (position < 0) continue;

            mUids.remove(position);
            mNames.remove(position);
            changed = true;
        }
        return changed;
    }

    private boolean addEntry(int uid, String packageName)
    {
        if (indexOf(uid, packageName) >= 0) return false;

        mUids.add(uid);
        mNames.add(packageName);
        return true;
    }

    private int indexOf(int uid, String packageName)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mUids.size(); index++)
        {
            if (mUids.get(index) != uid) continue;

            String name = mNames.get(index);
            if (name == null ? packageName == null : name.equals(packageName)) return index;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof WorkSource)) return false;

        WorkSource workSource = (WorkSource)other;
        if (workSource.mUids.size() != mUids.size()) return false;

        for (int index = 0; index < mUids.size(); index++)
        {
            if (workSource.indexOf(mUids.get(index), mNames.get(index)) < 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        int hash = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < mUids.size(); index++)
        {
            String name = mNames.get(index);
            hash += mUids.get(index) * 31 + (name == null ? 0 : name.hashCode());
        }
        return hash;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mUids.size());
        for (int index = 0; index < mUids.size(); index++)
        {
            dest.writeInt(mUids.get(index));
            dest.writeString(mNames.get(index));
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder("WorkSource{");
        for (int index = 0; index < mUids.size(); index++)
        {
            if (index > 0) builder.append(", ");
            builder.append(mUids.get(index));
            if (mNames.get(index) != null) builder.append(' ').append(mNames.get(index));
        }
        return builder.append('}').toString();
    }
}
```

```java
package android.os.health;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.TreeMap;

public class HealthStats
{
    private final String mDataType;

    private final int[] mTimerKeys;
    private final int[] mTimerCounts;
    private final long[] mTimerTimes;

    private final int[] mMeasurementKeys;
    private final long[] mMeasurementValues;

    private final int[] mStatsKeys;
    private final Map<String, HealthStats>[] mStatsValues;

    private final int[] mTimersKeys;
    private final Map<String, TimerStat>[] mTimersValues;

    private final int[] mMeasurementsKeys;
    private final Map<String, Long>[] mMeasurementsValues;

    static final class Builder
    {
        private final String mDataType;
        private final TreeMap<Integer, TimerStat> mTimers = new TreeMap<>();
        private final TreeMap<Integer, Long> mMeasurements = new TreeMap<>();
        private final TreeMap<Integer, Map<String, HealthStats>> mStats = new TreeMap<>();
        private final TreeMap<Integer, Map<String, TimerStat>> mTimersMaps = new TreeMap<>();
        private final TreeMap<Integer, Map<String, Long>> mMeasurementsMaps = new TreeMap<>();

        Builder(String dataType)
        {
            mDataType = dataType;
        }

        Builder timer(int key, int count, long timeMs)
        {
            mTimers.put(key, new TimerStat(count, timeMs));
            return this;
        }

        Builder measurement(int key, long value)
        {
            mMeasurements.put(key, value);
            return this;
        }

        Builder stats(int key, String name, HealthStats value)
        {
            Map<String, HealthStats> map = mStats.get(key);
            if (map == null)
            {
                map = new TreeMap<>();
                mStats.put(key, map);
            }

            map.put(name, value);
            return this;
        }

        HealthStats build()
        {
            return new HealthStats(this);
        }
    }

    HealthStats()
    {
        this(new Builder(null));
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private HealthStats(Builder builder)
    {
        mDataType = builder.mDataType;

        mTimerKeys = keys(builder.mTimers);
        mTimerCounts = new int[mTimerKeys.length];
        mTimerTimes = new long[mTimerKeys.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < mTimerKeys.length; index++)
        {
            TimerStat timer = builder.mTimers.get(mTimerKeys[index]);
            mTimerCounts[index] = timer.getCount();
            mTimerTimes[index] = timer.getTime();
        }

        mMeasurementKeys = keys(builder.mMeasurements);
        mMeasurementValues = new long[mMeasurementKeys.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < mMeasurementKeys.length; index++)
        {
            mMeasurementValues[index] = builder.mMeasurements.get(mMeasurementKeys[index]);
        }

        mStatsKeys = keys(builder.mStats);
        mStatsValues = new Map[mStatsKeys.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < mStatsKeys.length; index++)
        {
            mStatsValues[index] = Collections.unmodifiableMap(builder.mStats.get(mStatsKeys[index]));
        }

        mTimersKeys = keys(builder.mTimersMaps);
        mTimersValues = new Map[mTimersKeys.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < mTimersKeys.length; index++)
        {
            mTimersValues[index] = Collections.unmodifiableMap(builder.mTimersMaps.get(mTimersKeys[index]));
        }

        mMeasurementsKeys = keys(builder.mMeasurementsMaps);
        mMeasurementsValues = new Map[mMeasurementsKeys.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < mMeasurementsKeys.length; index++)
        {
            mMeasurementsValues[index] = Collections.unmodifiableMap(builder.mMeasurementsMaps.get(mMeasurementsKeys[index]));
        }
    }

    private static int[] keys(TreeMap<Integer, ?> map)
    {
        int[] keys = new int[map.size()];
        int index = 0;
        for (Integer key : map.keySet()) keys[index++] = key;
        return keys;
    }

    private static int indexOf(int[] keys, int key)
    {
        int index = Arrays.binarySearch(keys, key);
        return index < 0 ? -1 : index;
    }

    private static int require(int[] keys, int key, String kind)
    {
        int index = indexOf(keys, key);
        if (index < 0) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Bad " + kind + " key dataType=" + key);
        return index;
    }

    public String getDataType()
    {
        return mDataType;
    }

    public boolean hasTimer(int key)
    {
        return indexOf(mTimerKeys, key) >= 0;
    }

    public TimerStat getTimer(int key)
    {
        int index = require(mTimerKeys, key, "timer");
        return new TimerStat(mTimerCounts[index], mTimerTimes[index]);
    }

    public int getTimerCount(int key)
    {
        return mTimerCounts[require(mTimerKeys, key, "timer")];
    }

    public long getTimerTime(int key)
    {
        return mTimerTimes[require(mTimerKeys, key, "timer")];
    }

    public int getTimerKeyCount()
    {
        return mTimerKeys.length;
    }

    public int getTimerKeyAt(int index)
    {
        return mTimerKeys[index];
    }

    public boolean hasMeasurement(int key)
    {
        return indexOf(mMeasurementKeys, key) >= 0;
    }

    public long getMeasurement(int key)
    {
        return mMeasurementValues[require(mMeasurementKeys, key, "measurement")];
    }

    public int getMeasurementKeyCount()
    {
        return mMeasurementKeys.length;
    }

    public int getMeasurementKeyAt(int index)
    {
        return mMeasurementKeys[index];
    }

    public boolean hasStats(int key)
    {
        return indexOf(mStatsKeys, key) >= 0;
    }

    public Map<String, HealthStats> getStats(int key)
    {
        return mStatsValues[require(mStatsKeys, key, "stats")];
    }

    public int getStatsKeyCount()
    {
        return mStatsKeys.length;
    }

    public int getStatsKeyAt(int index)
    {
        return mStatsKeys[index];
    }

    public boolean hasTimers(int key)
    {
        return indexOf(mTimersKeys, key) >= 0;
    }

    public Map<String, TimerStat> getTimers(int key)
    {
        return mTimersValues[require(mTimersKeys, key, "timers")];
    }

    public int getTimersKeyCount()
    {
        return mTimersKeys.length;
    }

    public int getTimersKeyAt(int index)
    {
        return mTimersKeys[index];
    }

    public boolean hasMeasurements(int key)
    {
        return indexOf(mMeasurementsKeys, key) >= 0;
    }

    public Map<String, Long> getMeasurements(int key)
    {
        return mMeasurementsValues[require(mMeasurementsKeys, key, "measurements")];
    }

    public int getMeasurementsKeyCount()
    {
        return mMeasurementsKeys.length;
    }

    public int getMeasurementsKeyAt(int index)
    {
        return mMeasurementsKeys[index];
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/health/SystemHealthManager.java`:

```java
package android.os.health;

import android.os.Process;
import android.os.SystemClock;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

public class SystemHealthManager
{
    private static final long CLOCK_TICK_MILLIS = 10L;

    public SystemHealthManager()
    {
    }

    public static SystemHealthManager from(android.content.Context context)
    {
        return (SystemHealthManager)context.getSystemService(android.content.Context.SYSTEM_HEALTH_SERVICE);
    }

    public HealthStats takeUidSnapshot(int uid)
    {
        if (uid != Process.myUid())
        {
            throw new SecurityException("uid " + Process.myUid() + " does not hold android.permission.BATTERY_STATS for uid " + uid);
        }

        return takeMyUidSnapshot();
    }

    public HealthStats takeMyUidSnapshot()
    {
        long[] cpu = cpuTimesMillis();
        long realtime = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - Process.getStartElapsedRealtime();
        long uptime = SystemClock.uptimeMillis() - Process.getStartUptimeMillis();

        String processName = Process.myProcessName();
        if (processName == null) processName = "";

        HealthStats process = new HealthStats.Builder("ProcessHealthStats")
                                      .measurement(ProcessHealthStats.MEASUREMENT_USER_TIME_MS, cpu[0])
                                      .measurement(ProcessHealthStats.MEASUREMENT_SYSTEM_TIME_MS, cpu[1])
                                      .measurement(ProcessHealthStats.MEASUREMENT_STARTS_COUNT, 1)
                                      .measurement(ProcessHealthStats.MEASUREMENT_CRASHES_COUNT, 0)
                                      .measurement(ProcessHealthStats.MEASUREMENT_ANR_COUNT, 0)
                                      .measurement(ProcessHealthStats.MEASUREMENT_FOREGROUND_MS, realtime)
                                      .build();

        HealthStats pid = new HealthStats.Builder("PidHealthStats")
                                  .measurement(PidHealthStats.MEASUREMENT_WAKE_NESTING_COUNT, 0)
                                  .measurement(PidHealthStats.MEASUREMENT_WAKE_SUM_MS, 0)
                                  .measurement(PidHealthStats.MEASUREMENT_WAKE_START_MS, 0)
                                  .build();

        return new HealthStats.Builder("UidHealthStats")
                .measurement(UidHealthStats.MEASUREMENT_REALTIME_BATTERY_MS, realtime)
                .measurement(UidHealthStats.MEASUREMENT_UPTIME_BATTERY_MS, uptime)
                .measurement(UidHealthStats.MEASUREMENT_REALTIME_SCREEN_OFF_BATTERY_MS, 0)
                .measurement(UidHealthStats.MEASUREMENT_UPTIME_SCREEN_OFF_BATTERY_MS, 0)
                .measurement(UidHealthStats.MEASUREMENT_USER_CPU_TIME_MS, cpu[0])
                .measurement(UidHealthStats.MEASUREMENT_SYSTEM_CPU_TIME_MS, cpu[1])
                .timer(UidHealthStats.TIMER_PROCESS_STATE_TOP_MS, 1, realtime)
                .stats(UidHealthStats.STATS_PROCESSES, processName, process)
                .stats(UidHealthStats.STATS_PIDS, Integer.toString(Process.myPid()), pid)
                .build();
    }

    public HealthStats[] takeUidSnapshots(int[] uids)
    {
        HealthStats[] result = new HealthStats[uids.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < uids.length; index++) result[index] = takeUidSnapshot(uids[index]);
        return result;
    }

    private static long[] cpuTimesMillis()
    {
        try
        {
            String stat = new String(Files.readAllBytes(Paths.get("/proc/self/stat")), StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
            String[] fields = stat.substring(stat.lastIndexOf(')') + 2).trim().split("\\s+");
            return new long[] {Long.parseLong(fields[11]) * CLOCK_TICK_MILLIS, Long.parseLong(fields[12]) * CLOCK_TICK_MILLIS};
        }
        catch (IOException | RuntimeException unreadable)
        {
            return new long[] {Process.getElapsedCpuTime(), 0L};
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.os.health;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class TimerStat implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Creator<TimerStat> CREATOR = new Creator<TimerStat>()
    {
        @Override
        public TimerStat createFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
        {
            return new TimerStat(parcel);
        }

        @Override
        public TimerStat[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new TimerStat[size];
        }
    };

    private int mCount;
    private long mTime;

    public TimerStat()
    {
    }

    public TimerStat(int count, long time)
    {
        mCount = count;
        mTime = time;
    }

    public TimerStat(Parcel in)
    {
        mCount = in.readInt();
        mTime = in.readLong();
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
    {
        out.writeInt(mCount);
        out.writeLong(mTime);
    }

    public void setCount(int count)
    {
        mCount = count;
    }

    public int getCount()
    {
        return mCount;
    }

    public void setTime(long time)
    {
        mTime = time;
    }

    public long getTime()
    {
        return mTime;
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/storage/StorageManager.java`:

```java
package android.os.storage;

import android.content.Context;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Environment;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;
import android.os.ProxyFileDescriptorCallback;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;

public class StorageManager
{
    public static final String ACTION_MANAGE_STORAGE = "android.os.storage.action.MANAGE_STORAGE";
    public static final String ACTION_CLEAR_APP_CACHE = "android.os.storage.action.CLEAR_APP_CACHE";
    public static final String EXTRA_REQUESTED_BYTES = "android.os.storage.extra.REQUESTED_BYTES";
    public static final String EXTRA_UUID = "android.os.storage.extra.UUID";
    public static final UUID UUID_DEFAULT = UUID.fromString("41217664-9172-527a-b3d5-edabb50a7d69");

    private static final String TAG = "StorageManager";
    private static final String MEDIA_AUTHORITY = "media";
    private static final long MINIMUM_CACHE_QUOTA_BYTES = 64L * 1024L * 1024L;

    private final Context mContext;
    private final List<StorageVolumeCallback> mCallbacks = new ArrayList<>();

    public static class StorageVolumeCallback
    {
        public StorageVolumeCallback()
        {
        }

        public void onStateChanged(StorageVolume volume)
        {
        }
    }

    public StorageManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public void registerStorageVolumeCallback(Executor executor, StorageVolumeCallback callback)
    {
        if (executor == null || callback == null) throw new NullPointerException("executor and callback are required");

        synchronized (mCallbacks)
        {
            mCallbacks.add(callback);
        }
    }

    public void unregisterStorageVolumeCallback(StorageVolumeCallback callback)
    {
        synchronized (mCallbacks)
        {
            mCallbacks.remove(callback);
        }
    }

    public boolean mountObb(String rawPath, String key, OnObbStateChangeListener listener)
    {
        if (rawPath == null) throw new NullPointerException("rawPath cannot be null");
        if (listener != null) listener.onObbStateChange(rawPath, OnObbStateChangeListener.ERROR_COULD_NOT_MOUNT);
        return false;
    }

    public boolean unmountObb(String rawPath, boolean force, OnObbStateChangeListener listener)
    {
        if (rawPath == null) throw new NullPointerException("rawPath cannot be null");
        if (listener != null) listener.onObbStateChange(rawPath, OnObbStateChangeListener.ERROR_NOT_MOUNTED);
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isObbMounted(String rawPath)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public String getMountedObbPath(String rawPath)
    {
        return null;
    }

    public android.app.PendingIntent getManageSpaceActivityIntent(String packageName, int requestCode)
    {
        return null;
    }

    public UUID getUuidForPath(File path) throws IOException
    {
        if (path == null) throw new NullPointerException("path");
        return UUID_DEFAULT;
    }

    public boolean isAllocationSupported(FileDescriptor descriptor)
    {
        return true;
    }

    public StorageVolume getStorageVolume(File file)
    {
        if (file == null) return null;

        String path = canonical(file);
        for (File root : roots())
        {
            String rootPath = canonical(root);
            if (path.equals(rootPath) || path.startsWith(rootPath + File.separator)) return getPrimaryStorageVolume();
        }
        return null;
    }

    public StorageVolume getStorageVolume(Uri uri)
    {
        if (uri == null) throw new NullPointerException("uri");

        List<String> segments = uri.getPathSegments();
        String volume = segments == null || segments.isEmpty() ? null : segments.get(0);
        if (MEDIA_AUTHORITY.equals(uri.getAuthority()) && ("external".equals(volume) || "external_primary".equals(volume)))
        {
            return getPrimaryStorageVolume();
        }

        throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown volume for " + uri);
    }

    public List<StorageVolume> getStorageVolumes()
    {
        List<StorageVolume> volumes = new ArrayList<>();
        volumes.add(getPrimaryStorageVolume());
        return volumes;
    }

    public List<StorageVolume> getStorageVolumesIncludingSharedProfiles()
    {
        return getStorageVolumes();
    }

    public List<StorageVolume> getRecentStorageVolumes()
    {
        return getStorageVolumes();
    }

    public StorageVolume getPrimaryStorageVolume()
    {
        return StorageVolume.primary(Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory());
    }

    public StorageVolume[] getVolumeList()
    {
        return new StorageVolume[] {getPrimaryStorageVolume()};
    }

    public boolean isEncrypted(File file)
    {
        return true;
    }

    public static boolean isFileEncryptedNativeOrEmulated()
    {
        return true;
    }

    public ParcelFileDescriptor openProxyFileDescriptor(int mode, ProxyFileDescriptorCallback callback, Handler handler)
        throws IOException
    {
        throw new IOException("proxy file descriptors are not supported on this device");
    }

    public long getCacheQuotaBytes(UUID storageUuid) throws IOException
    {
        long usable = dataDirectory().getUsableSpace();
        return Math.max(MINIMUM_CACHE_QUOTA_BYTES, usable / 10L);
    }

    public long getCacheSizeBytes(UUID storageUuid) throws IOException
    {
        long total = 0L;
        if (mContext == null) return total;

        total += sizeOf(mContext.getCacheDir());
        total += sizeOf(mContext.getCodeCacheDir());
        File externalCache = mContext.getExternalCacheDir();
        if (externalCache != null) total += sizeOf(externalCache);
        return total;
    }

    public long getAllocatableBytes(UUID storageUuid) throws IOException
    {
        return dataDirectory().getUsableSpace();
    }

    public void allocateBytes(UUID storageUuid, long bytes) throws IOException
    {
        long allocatable = getAllocatableBytes(storageUuid);
        if (bytes > allocatable) throw new IOException("Failed to allocate " + bytes + " bytes; only " + allocatable + " available");
    }

    public void allocateBytes(FileDescriptor descriptor, long bytes) throws IOException
    {
        allocateBytes(UUID_DEFAULT, bytes);
    }

    public void setCacheBehaviorGroup(File path, boolean group) throws IOException
    {
    }

    public boolean isCacheBehaviorGroup(File path) throws IOException
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void setCacheBehaviorTombstone(File path, boolean tombstone) throws IOException
    {
    }

    public boolean isCacheBehaviorTombstone(File path) throws IOException
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isCheckpointSupported()
    {
        return false;
    }

    private File dataDirectory()
    {
        if (mContext != null)
        {
            File dataDir = mContext.getDataDir();
            if (dataDir != null) return dataDir;
        }
        return Environment.getDataDirectory();
    }

    private List<File> roots()
    {
        List<File> roots = new ArrayList<>();
        roots.add(Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory());

        if (mContext != null)
        {
            File external = mContext.getExternalFilesDir(null);
            if (external != null) roots.add(external);

            File externalCache = mContext.getExternalCacheDir();
            if (externalCache != null) roots.add(externalCache);
        }
        return roots;
    }

    private static String canonical(File file)
    {
        try
        {
            return file.getCanonicalPath();
        }
        catch (IOException unresolvable)
        {
            return file.getAbsolutePath();
        }
    }

    private static long sizeOf(File file)
    {
        if (file == null || !file.exists()) return 0L;
        if (file.isFile()) return file.length();

        long total = 0L;
        File[] children = file.listFiles();
        if (children == null) return total;

        for (File child : children) total += sizeOf(child);
        return total;
    }
}
```

`java/android/os/strictmode/Violation.java`:

```java
package android.os.strictmode;

public abstract class Violation extends Throwable
{
    private int mHashCode;
    private boolean mHashCodeValid;

    Violation()
    {
        super();
    }

    Violation(String message)
    {
        super(message);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mHashCodeValid) return mHashCode;

            String message = getMessage();
            Throwable cause = getCause();
            int hashCode = message != null ? message.hashCode() : getClass().hashCode();
            hashCode = hashCode * 37 + calcStackTraceHashCode(getStackTrace());
            hashCode = hashCode * 37 + (cause != null ? cause.toString().hashCode() : 0);
            mHashCodeValid = true;
            mHashCode = hashCode;
            return hashCode;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized Throwable initCause(Throwable cause)
    {
        mHashCodeValid = false;
        return super.initCause(cause);
    }

    @Override
    public void setStackTrace(StackTraceElement[] stackTrace)
    {
        super.setStackTrace(stackTrace);
        synchronized (this)
        {
            mHashCodeValid = false;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized Throwable fillInStackTrace()
    {
        mHashCodeValid = false;
        return super.fillInStackTrace();
    }

    private static int calcStackTraceHashCode(StackTraceElement[] stackTrace)
    {
        int hashCode = 17;
        if (stackTrace == null) return hashCode;

        for (StackTraceElement element : stackTrace)
        {
            if (element != null) hashCode = hashCode * 37 + element.hashCode();
        }
        return hashCode;
    }
}
```

`java/android/preference/PreferenceManager.java`:

```java
package android.preference;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.content.res.XmlResourceParser;
import android.util.Log;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;

public class PreferenceManager
{
    private static final String TAG = "PreferenceManager";
    private static final String ANDROID_NAMESPACE = "http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android";

    public static final String METADATA_KEY_PREFERENCES = "android.preference";
    public static final String KEY_HAS_SET_DEFAULT_VALUES = "_has_set_default_values";

    private static final int STORAGE_DEFAULT = 0;
    private static final int STORAGE_DEVICE_PROTECTED = 1;

    private final Context mContext;
    private SharedPreferences mSharedPreferences;
    private PreferenceDataStore mPreferenceDataStore;
    private String mSharedPreferencesName;
    private int mSharedPreferencesMode;
    private int mStorage = STORAGE_DEFAULT;

    PreferenceManager()
    {
        this(null);
    }

    PreferenceManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
        if (context != null) setSharedPreferencesName(getDefaultSharedPreferencesName(context));
    }

    public PreferenceDataStore getPreferenceDataStore()
    {
        return mPreferenceDataStore;
    }

    public void setPreferenceDataStore(PreferenceDataStore dataStore)
    {
        mPreferenceDataStore = dataStore;
    }

    public String getSharedPreferencesName()
    {
        return mSharedPreferencesName;
    }

    public void setSharedPreferencesName(String sharedPreferencesName)
    {
        mSharedPreferencesName = sharedPreferencesName;
        mSharedPreferences = null;
    }

    public int getSharedPreferencesMode()
    {
        return mSharedPreferencesMode;
    }

    public void setSharedPreferencesMode(int sharedPreferencesMode)
    {
        mSharedPreferencesMode = sharedPreferencesMode;
        mSharedPreferences = null;
    }

    public void setStorageDefault()
    {
        mStorage = STORAGE_DEFAULT;
        mSharedPreferences = null;
    }

    public void setStorageDeviceProtected()
    {
        mStorage = STORAGE_DEVICE_PROTECTED;
        mSharedPreferences = null;
    }

    public boolean isStorageDefault()
    {
        return mStorage == STORAGE_DEFAULT;
    }

    public boolean isStorageDeviceProtected()
    {
        return mStorage == STORAGE_DEVICE_PROTECTED;
    }

    public SharedPreferences getSharedPreferences()
    {
        if (mPreferenceDataStore != null) return null;
        if (mContext == null) return null;

        if (mSharedPreferences == null)
        {
            Context storageContext = mStorage == STORAGE_DEVICE_PROTECTED ? mContext.createDeviceProtectedStorageContext() : mContext;
            mSharedPreferences = storageContext.getSharedPreferences(mSharedPreferencesName, mSharedPreferencesMode);
        }

        return mSharedPreferences;
    }

    public static SharedPreferences getDefaultSharedPreferences(Context context)
    {
        return context.getSharedPreferences(getDefaultSharedPreferencesName(context), Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
    }

    public static String getDefaultSharedPreferencesName(Context context)
    {
        return context.getPackageName() + "_preferences";
    }

    public static void setDefaultValues(Context context, int resId, boolean readAgain)
    {
        setDefaultValues(context, getDefaultSharedPreferencesName(context), Context.MODE_PRIVATE, resId, readAgain);
    }

    public static void setDefaultValues(Context context, String sharedPreferencesName, int sharedPreferencesMode, int resId, boolean readAgain)
    {
        SharedPreferences marker = context.getSharedPreferences(KEY_HAS_SET_DEFAULT_VALUES, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);

        if (!readAgain && marker.getBoolean(KEY_HAS_SET_DEFAULT_VALUES, false)) return;

        SharedPreferences preferences = context.getSharedPreferences(sharedPreferencesName, sharedPreferencesMode);
        SharedPreferences.Editor editor = preferences.edit();

        try
        {
            applyDefaults(context.getResources(), resId, preferences, editor);
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "could not read default preference values from resource 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resId), failure);
        }

        editor.apply();
        marker.edit().putBoolean(KEY_HAS_SET_DEFAULT_VALUES, true).apply();
    }

    private static void applyDefaults(Resources resources, int resId, SharedPreferences preferences, SharedPreferences.Editor editor)
        throws Exception
    {
        XmlResourceParser parser = resources.getXml(resId);

        try
        {
            int type;
            while ((type = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
            {
                if (type != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

                String key = parser.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "key");
                if (key == null || preferences.contains(key)) continue;

                int valueResource = parser.getAttributeResourceValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "defaultValue", 0);
                String value = parser.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "defaultValue");
                if (valueResource == 0 && value == null) continue;

                applyDefault(resources, simpleName(parser.getName()), key, valueResource, value, editor);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            parser.close();
        }
    }

    private static String simpleName(String tag)
    {
        int dot = tag.lastIndexOf('.');
        return dot < 0 ? tag : tag.substring(dot + 1);
    }

    private static void applyDefault(Resources resources, String tag, String key, int valueResource, String value,
                                     SharedPreferences.Editor editor)
    {
        switch (tag)
        {
            case "CheckBoxPreference":
            case "SwitchPreference":
            case "TwoStatePreference":
            case "SwitchPreferenceCompat":
                editor.putBoolean(key, valueResource != 0 ? resources.getBoolean(valueResource) : Boolean.parseBoolean(value));
                return;

            case "MultiSelectListPreference":
                if (valueResource != 0) editor.putStringSet(key, new LinkedHashSet<>(Arrays.asList(resources.getStringArray(valueResource))));
                return;

            case "SeekBarPreference":
                editor.putInt(key, valueResource != 0 ? resources.getInteger(valueResource) : Integer.parseInt(value.trim()));
                return;

            case "EditTextPreference":
            case "ListPreference":
            case "RingtonePreference":
            case "DropDownPreference":
                editor.putString(key, valueResource != 0 ? resources.getString(valueResource) : value);
                return;

            default:
                Log.i(TAG, "the default of " + key + " belongs to " + tag + ", whose value type is not known here, so it is not stored");
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/print/PageRange.java`:

```java
package android.print;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class PageRange implements Parcelable
{
    public static final PageRange ALL_PAGES = new PageRange(0, Integer.MAX_VALUE);

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<PageRange> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<PageRange>()
    {
        @Override
        public PageRange createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int start = source.readInt();
            int end = source.readInt();
            return new PageRange(start, end);
        }

        @Override
        public PageRange[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new PageRange[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mStart;
    private final int mEnd;

    public PageRange(int start, int end)
    {
        if (start < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("start cannot be less than zero.");
        if (end < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("end cannot be less than zero.");
        if (start > end) throw new IllegalArgumentException("start must be lesser than end.");

        mStart = start;
        mEnd = end;
    }

    public int getStart()
    {
        return mStart;
    }

    public int getEnd()
    {
        return mEnd;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mStart);
        dest.writeInt(mEnd);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return 31 * (31 + mEnd) + mStart;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof PageRange)) return false;

        PageRange range = (PageRange)other;
        return mStart == range.mStart && mEnd == range.mEnd;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        if (mStart == 0 && mEnd == Integer.MAX_VALUE) return "PageRange[<all pages>]";
        return "PageRange[" + mStart + " - " + mEnd + "]";
    }
}
```

```java
    public static final int DUPLEX_MODE_LONG_EDGE = 2;

    {
        @Override
        public PrintAttributes createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            PrintAttributes attributes = new PrintAttributes();
            attributes.mMediaSize = source.readInt() != 0 ? MediaSize.createFromParcel(source) : null;
            attributes.mResolution = source.readInt() != 0 ? Resolution.createFromParcel(source) : null;
            attributes.mMinMargins = source.readInt() != 0 ? Margins.createFromParcel(source) : null;
            attributes.mColorMode = source.readInt();
            attributes.mDuplexMode = source.readInt();
            return attributes;
        }

        public PrintAttributes[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new PrintAttributes[size];
        }
    };

    private int mColorMode;
    private int mDuplexMode;

    {
    }

    {
        return mMediaSize;
    }

    public Resolution getResolution()
    {
        return mResolution;
    }

    public Margins getMinMargins()
    {
        return mMinMargins;
    }

    public int getColorMode()
    {
        return mColorMode;
    }

    public int getDuplexMode()
    {
        return mDuplexMode;
    }

    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mMediaSize != null ? 1 : 0);
        if (mMediaSize != null) mMediaSize.writeToParcel(dest);
        dest.writeInt(mResolution != null ? 1 : 0);
        if (mResolution != null) mResolution.writeToParcel(dest);
        dest.writeInt(mMinMargins != null ? 1 : 0);
        if (mMinMargins != null) mMinMargins.writeToParcel(dest);
        dest.writeInt(mColorMode);
        dest.writeInt(mDuplexMode);
    }

    {
        return 0;
    }

    {
        return Objects.hash(mMediaSize, mResolution, mMinMargins, mColorMode, mDuplexMode);
    }

    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof PrintAttributes)) return false;

        PrintAttributes attributes = (PrintAttributes)other;
        return mColorMode == attributes.mColorMode && mDuplexMode == attributes.mDuplexMode
            && Objects.equals(mMediaSize, attributes.mMediaSize) && Objects.equals(mResolution, attributes.mResolution)
            && Objects.equals(mMinMargins, attributes.mMinMargins);
    }

    {
        return "PrintAttributes{mediaSize: " + mMediaSize + ", resolution: " + mResolution + ", minMargins: " + mMinMargins
            + ", colorMode: " + colorModeToString(mColorMode) + ", duplexMode: " + duplexModeToString(mDuplexMode) + "}";
    }

    private static String colorModeToString(int colorMode)
    {
        switch (colorMode)
        {
            case COLOR_MODE_MONOCHROME: return "COLOR_MODE_MONOCHROME";
            case COLOR_MODE_COLOR: return "COLOR_MODE_COLOR";
            default: return "COLOR_MODE_UNKNOWN";
        }
    }

    private static String duplexModeToString(int duplexMode)
    {
        switch (duplexMode)
        {
            case DUPLEX_MODE_NONE: return "DUPLEX_MODE_NONE";
            case DUPLEX_MODE_LONG_EDGE: return "DUPLEX_MODE_LONG_EDGE";
            case DUPLEX_MODE_SHORT_EDGE: return "DUPLEX_MODE_SHORT_EDGE";
            default: return "DUPLEX_MODE_UNKNOWN";
        }
    }

        private final String mId;
        private final String mLabel;
        private final int mWidthMils;
        private final int mHeightMils;

        public MediaSize(String id, String label, int widthMils, int heightMils)
        {
            if (id == null || id.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("id cannot be empty.");
            if (label == null || label.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("label cannot be empty.");
            if (widthMils <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("widthMils cannot be less than or equal to zero.");
            if (heightMils <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("heightMils cannot be less than or equal to zero.");

            mId = id;
            mLabel = label;
            mWidthMils = widthMils;
            mHeightMils = heightMils;
        }

        public String getId()
        {
            return mId;
        }

        public String getLabel(PackageManager packageManager)
        {
            return mLabel;
        }

        public int getWidthMils()
        {
            return mWidthMils;
        }

        public int getHeightMils()
        {
            return mHeightMils;
        }

        public boolean isPortrait()
        {
            return mHeightMils >= mWidthMils;
        }

        public MediaSize asPortrait()
        {
            if (isPortrait()) return this;
            return new MediaSize(mId, mLabel, Math.min(mWidthMils, mHeightMils), Math.max(mWidthMils, mHeightMils));
        }

        public MediaSize asLandscape()
        {
            if (!isPortrait()) return this;
            return new MediaSize(mId, mLabel, Math.max(mWidthMils, mHeightMils), Math.min(mWidthMils, mHeightMils));
        }

        void writeToParcel(Parcel dest)
        {
            dest.writeString(mId);
            dest.writeString(mLabel);
            dest.writeInt(mWidthMils);
            dest.writeInt(mHeightMils);
        }

        static MediaSize createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            String id = source.readString();
            String label = source.readString();
            int width = source.readInt();
            int height = source.readInt();
            return new MediaSize(id, label, width, height);
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return 31 * (31 + mWidthMils) + mHeightMils;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object other)
        {
            if (this == other) return true;
            if (!(other instanceof MediaSize)) return false;

            MediaSize size = (MediaSize)other;
            return mWidthMils == size.mWidthMils && mHeightMils == size.mHeightMils;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "MediaSize{id: " + mId + ", label: " + mLabel + ", heightMils: " + mHeightMils + ", widthMils: " + mWidthMils + "}";
        }
    }

            }
            mAttributes.mColorMode = colorMode;
            return this;

        {
            if (duplexMode != DUPLEX_MODE_NONE && duplexMode != DUPLEX_MODE_LONG_EDGE && duplexMode != DUPLEX_MODE_SHORT_EDGE)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid duplex mode: " + duplexMode);
            }
            mAttributes.mDuplexMode = duplexMode;
            return this;
        }

        {
            PrintAttributes attributes = new PrintAttributes();
            attributes.mMediaSize = mAttributes.mMediaSize;
            attributes.mResolution = mAttributes.mResolution;
            attributes.mMinMargins = mAttributes.mMinMargins;
            attributes.mColorMode = mAttributes.mColorMode;
            attributes.mDuplexMode = mAttributes.mDuplexMode;
            return attributes;
        }
```

```java
package android.print;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.Objects;

public final class PrintDocumentInfo implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int PAGE_COUNT_UNKNOWN = -1;

    public static final int CONTENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN = -1;
    public static final int CONTENT_TYPE_DOCUMENT = 0;
    public static final int CONTENT_TYPE_PHOTO = 1;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<PrintDocumentInfo> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<PrintDocumentInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public PrintDocumentInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            PrintDocumentInfo info = new PrintDocumentInfo();
            info.mName = source.readString();
            info.mPageCount = source.readInt();
            info.mContentType = source.readInt();
            info.mDataSize = source.readLong();
            return info;
        }

        @Override
        public PrintDocumentInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new PrintDocumentInfo[size];
        }
    };

    private String mName;
    private int mPageCount = PAGE_COUNT_UNKNOWN;
    private int mContentType = CONTENT_TYPE_DOCUMENT;
    private long mDataSize;

    private PrintDocumentInfo()
    {
    }

    private PrintDocumentInfo(PrintDocumentInfo prototype)
    {
        mName = prototype.mName;
        mPageCount = prototype.mPageCount;
        mContentType = prototype.mContentType;
        mDataSize = prototype.mDataSize;
    }

    public String getName()
    {
        return mName;
    }

    public int getPageCount()
    {
        return mPageCount;
    }

    public int getContentType()
    {
        return mContentType;
    }

    public long getDataSize()
    {
        return mDataSize;
    }

    void setDataSize(long dataSize)
    {
        mDataSize = dataSize;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mName);
        dest.writeInt(mPageCount);
        dest.writeInt(mContentType);
        dest.writeLong(mDataSize);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mName, mContentType, mPageCount, mDataSize);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof PrintDocumentInfo)) return false;

        PrintDocumentInfo info = (PrintDocumentInfo)other;
        return Objects.equals(mName, info.mName) && mContentType == info.mContentType && mPageCount == info.mPageCount
            && mDataSize == info.mDataSize;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "PrintDocumentInfo{name=" + mName + ", pageCount=" + mPageCount + ", contentType=" + contentTypeToString(mContentType)
            + ", dataSize=" + mDataSize + "}";
    }

    private static String contentTypeToString(int contentType)
    {
        switch (contentType)
        {
            case CONTENT_TYPE_DOCUMENT: return "CONTENT_TYPE_DOCUMENT";
            case CONTENT_TYPE_PHOTO: return "CONTENT_TYPE_PHOTO";
            default: return "CONTENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN";
        }
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final PrintDocumentInfo mPrototype;

        public Builder(String name)
        {
            if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("name cannot be empty");

            mPrototype = new PrintDocumentInfo();
            mPrototype.mName = name;
        }

        public Builder setPageCount(int pageCount)
        {
            if (pageCount < 0 && pageCount != PAGE_COUNT_UNKNOWN)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("pageCount must be greater than or equal to zero or DocumentInfo#PAGE_COUNT_UNKNOWN");
            }
            mPrototype.mPageCount = pageCount;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setContentType(int type)
        {
            mPrototype.mContentType = type;
            return this;
        }

        public PrintDocumentInfo build()
        {
            if (mPrototype.mPageCount == 0) mPrototype.mPageCount = PAGE_COUNT_UNKNOWN;
            return new PrintDocumentInfo(mPrototype);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/print/PrintJob.java`:

```java
package android.print;

public final class PrintJob
{
    private final PrintManager mPrintManager;
    private final PrintJobInfo mInfo;

    PrintJob(PrintJobInfo info, PrintManager printManager)
    {
        mInfo = info;
        mPrintManager = printManager;
    }

    public PrintJobId getId()
    {
        return mInfo.getId();
    }

    public PrintJobInfo getInfo()
    {
        synchronized (mInfo)
        {
            return new PrintJobInfo(mInfo);
        }
    }

    public void cancel()
    {
        if (isInImmutableState()) return;
        mPrintManager.cancelPrintJob(this);
    }

    public void restart()
    {
        if (isFailed()) mPrintManager.restartPrintJob(this);
    }

    public boolean isQueued()
    {
        return getState() == PrintJobInfo.STATE_QUEUED;
    }

    public boolean isStarted()
    {
        return getState() == PrintJobInfo.STATE_STARTED;
    }

    public boolean isBlocked()
    {
        return getState() == PrintJobInfo.STATE_BLOCKED;
    }

    public boolean isCompleted()
    {
        return getState() == PrintJobInfo.STATE_COMPLETED;
    }

    public boolean isFailed()
    {
        return getState() == PrintJobInfo.STATE_FAILED;
    }

    public boolean isCancelled()
    {
        return getState() == PrintJobInfo.STATE_CANCELED;
    }

    PrintJobInfo getMutableInfo()
    {
        return mInfo;
    }

    void setState(int state)
    {
        synchronized (mInfo)
        {
            mInfo.setState(state);
        }
    }

    private int getState()
    {
        synchronized (mInfo)
        {
            return mInfo.getState();
        }
    }

    private boolean isInImmutableState()
    {
        int state = getState();
        return state == PrintJobInfo.STATE_CANCELED || state == PrintJobInfo.STATE_COMPLETED || state == PrintJobInfo.STATE_FAILED;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof PrintJob)) return false;

        PrintJobId id = mInfo.getId();
        return id != null && id.equals(((PrintJob)other).getId());
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        PrintJobId id = mInfo.getId();
        return id != null ? id.hashCode() : 0;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.print;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.UUID;

public final class PrintJobId implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<PrintJobId> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<PrintJobId>()
    {
        @Override
        public PrintJobId createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new PrintJobId(source.readString());
        }

        @Override
        public PrintJobId[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new PrintJobId[size];
        }
    };

    private final String mValue;

    PrintJobId()
    {
        this(UUID.randomUUID().toString());
    }

    PrintJobId(String value)
    {
        mValue = value;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mValue == null ? 0 : mValue.hashCode();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof PrintJobId)) return false;

        PrintJobId id = (PrintJobId)other;
        return mValue == null ? id.mValue == null : mValue.equals(id.mValue);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mValue);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mValue;
    }
}
```
