```java
package android.print;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.Arrays;

public final class PrintJobInfo implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int STATE_CREATED = 1;
    public static final int STATE_QUEUED = 2;
    public static final int STATE_STARTED = 3;
    public static final int STATE_BLOCKED = 4;
    public static final int STATE_COMPLETED = 5;
    public static final int STATE_FAILED = 6;
    public static final int STATE_CANCELED = 7;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<PrintJobInfo> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<PrintJobInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public PrintJobInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            PrintJobInfo info = new PrintJobInfo();
            info.mId = source.readInt() != 0 ? PrintJobId.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source) : null;
            info.mLabel = source.readString();
            info.mPrinterId = source.readInt() != 0 ? PrinterId.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source) : null;
            info.mState = source.readInt();
            info.mCreationTime = source.readLong();
            info.mCopies = source.readInt();
            int pageCount = source.readInt();
            if (pageCount >= 0)
            {
                info.mPageRanges = new PageRange[pageCount];
                for (int index = 0; index < pageCount; index++) info.mPageRanges[index] = PageRange.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            }
            info.mAttributes = source.readInt() != 0 ? PrintAttributes.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source) : null;
            info.mAdvancedOptions = source.readBundle();
            return info;
        }

        @Override
        public PrintJobInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new PrintJobInfo[size];
        }
    };

    private PrintJobId mId;
    private String mLabel;
    private PrinterId mPrinterId;
    private int mState;
    private long mCreationTime;
    private int mCopies;
    private PageRange[] mPageRanges;
    private PrintAttributes mAttributes;
    private Bundle mAdvancedOptions;

    PrintJobInfo()
    {
    }

    PrintJobInfo(PrintJobInfo other)
    {
        mId = other.mId;
        mLabel = other.mLabel;
        mPrinterId = other.mPrinterId;
        mState = other.mState;
        mCreationTime = other.mCreationTime;
        mCopies = other.mCopies;
        mPageRanges = other.mPageRanges;
        mAttributes = other.mAttributes;
        mAdvancedOptions = other.mAdvancedOptions;
    }

    public PrintJobId getId()
    {
        return mId;
    }

    void setId(PrintJobId id)
    {
        mId = id;
    }

    public String getLabel()
    {
        return mLabel;
    }

    void setLabel(String label)
    {
        mLabel = label;
    }

    public PrinterId getPrinterId()
    {
        return mPrinterId;
    }

    public int getState()
    {
        return mState;
    }

    void setState(int state)
    {
        mState = state;
    }

    public long getCreationTime()
    {
        return mCreationTime;
    }

    void setCreationTime(long creationTime)
    {
        mCreationTime = creationTime;
    }

    public int getCopies()
    {
        return mCopies;
    }

    void setCopies(int copies)
    {
        mCopies = copies;
    }

    public PageRange[] getPages()
    {
        return mPageRanges;
    }

    void setPages(PageRange[] pageRanges)
    {
        mPageRanges = pageRanges;
    }

    public PrintAttributes getAttributes()
    {
        return mAttributes;
    }

    void setAttributes(PrintAttributes attributes)
    {
        mAttributes = attributes;
    }

    public boolean hasAdvancedOption(String key)
    {
        return mAdvancedOptions != null && mAdvancedOptions.containsKey(key);
    }

    public String getAdvancedStringOption(String key)
    {
        return mAdvancedOptions == null ? null : mAdvancedOptions.getString(key);
    }

    public int getAdvancedIntOption(String key)
    {
        return mAdvancedOptions == null ? 0 : mAdvancedOptions.getInt(key);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mId != null ? 1 : 0);
        if (mId != null) mId.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        dest.writeString(mLabel);
        dest.writeInt(mPrinterId != null ? 1 : 0);
        if (mPrinterId != null) mPrinterId.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        dest.writeInt(mState);
        dest.writeLong(mCreationTime);
        dest.writeInt(mCopies);
        dest.writeInt(mPageRanges == null ? -1 : mPageRanges.length);
        if (mPageRanges != null) for (PageRange range : mPageRanges) range.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        dest.writeInt(mAttributes != null ? 1 : 0);
        if (mAttributes != null) mAttributes.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        dest.writeBundle(mAdvancedOptions);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "PrintJobInfo{label: " + mLabel + ", id: " + mId + ", state: " + stateToString(mState) + ", printer: " + mPrinterId
            + ", copies: " + mCopies + ", attributes: " + mAttributes + ", pages: "
            + (mPageRanges != null ? Arrays.toString(mPageRanges) : null) + ", creationTime: " + mCreationTime + "}";
    }

    static String stateToString(int state)
    {
        switch (state)
        {
            case STATE_CREATED: return "PRINT_JOB_STATE_CREATED";
            case STATE_QUEUED: return "PRINT_JOB_STATE_QUEUED";
            case STATE_STARTED: return "PRINT_JOB_STATE_STARTED";
            case STATE_BLOCKED: return "PRINT_JOB_STATE_BLOCKED";
            case STATE_FAILED: return "PRINT_JOB_STATE_FAILED";
            case STATE_COMPLETED: return "PRINT_JOB_STATE_COMPLETED";
            case STATE_CANCELED: return "PRINT_JOB_STATE_CANCELED";
            default: return "PRINT_JOB_STATE_UNKNOWN";
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/print/PrintManager.java`:

```java
package android.print;

import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.CancellationSignal;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

public final class PrintManager
{
    private static final List<Session> sSessions = new ArrayList<>();

    private final Context mContext;
    private final Handler mHandler;

    public PrintManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
        mHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    }

    public List<PrintJob> getPrintJobs()
    {
        List<PrintJob> jobs = new ArrayList<>();
        synchronized (sSessions)
        {
            for (Session session : sSessions) jobs.add(session.mJob);
        }
        return jobs;
    }

    public boolean isPrintServiceEnabled(ComponentName service)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public PrintJob print(String printJobName, PrintDocumentAdapter documentAdapter, PrintAttributes attributes)
    {
        if (printJobName == null || printJobName.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("printJobName cannot be empty");
        if (documentAdapter == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("documentAdapter cannot be null");

        PrintJobInfo info = new PrintJobInfo();
        info.setId(new PrintJobId());
        info.setLabel(printJobName);
        info.setCreationTime(System.currentTimeMillis());
        info.setCopies(1);
        info.setState(PrintJobInfo.STATE_CREATED);
        info.setAttributes(completeAttributes(attributes));

        PrintJob job = new PrintJob(info, this);
        Session session = new Session(job, documentAdapter);
        synchronized (sSessions)
        {
            sSessions.add(session);
        }

        mHandler.post(session::start);
        return job;
    }

    void cancelPrintJob(PrintJob job)
    {
        Session session = findSession(job);
        if (session != null) mHandler.post(session::cancel);
    }

    void restartPrintJob(PrintJob job)
    {
        Session session = findSession(job);
        if (session == null) return;

        job.setState(PrintJobInfo.STATE_CREATED);
        mHandler.post(session::start);
    }

    private Session findSession(PrintJob job)
    {
        synchronized (sSessions)
        {
            for (Session session : sSessions) if (session.mJob.equals(job)) return session;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static PrintAttributes completeAttributes(PrintAttributes attributes)
    {
        PrintAttributes.Builder builder = new PrintAttributes.Builder();
        String country = Locale.getDefault().getCountry();
        boolean letter = "US".equals(country) || "CA".equals(country) || "MX".equals(country);

        PrintAttributes.MediaSize mediaSize = attributes != null ? attributes.getMediaSize() : null;
        PrintAttributes.Resolution resolution = attributes != null ? attributes.getResolution() : null;
        PrintAttributes.Margins margins = attributes != null ? attributes.getMinMargins() : null;
        int colorMode = attributes != null ? attributes.getColorMode() : 0;
        int duplexMode = attributes != null ? attributes.getDuplexMode() : 0;

        PrintAttributes.MediaSize defaultMediaSize = letter ? PrintAttributes.MediaSize.NA_LETTER : PrintAttributes.MediaSize.ISO_A4;
        PrintAttributes.Resolution defaultResolution = new PrintAttributes.Resolution("PDF resolution", "PDF resolution", 300, 300);

        builder.setMediaSize(mediaSize != null ? mediaSize : defaultMediaSize);
        builder.setResolution(resolution != null ? resolution : defaultResolution);
        builder.setMinMargins(margins != null ? margins : PrintAttributes.Margins.NO_MARGINS);
        builder.setColorMode(colorMode != 0 ? colorMode : PrintAttributes.COLOR_MODE_COLOR);
        builder.setDuplexMode(duplexMode != 0 ? duplexMode : PrintAttributes.DUPLEX_MODE_NONE);
        return builder.build();
    }

    private File outputFile(PrintJob job)
    {
        File base = mContext != null ? mContext.getCacheDir() : null;
        if (base == null) base = new File(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir"));

        File directory = new File(base, "print");
        if (!directory.isDirectory()) directory.mkdirs();
        return new File(directory, job.getId() + ".pdf");
    }

    private final class Session
    {
        final PrintJob mJob;
        final PrintDocumentAdapter mAdapter;
        CancellationSignal mCancellation;
        ParcelFileDescriptor mDestination;
        boolean mActive;

        Session(PrintJob job, PrintDocumentAdapter adapter)
        {
            mJob = job;
            mAdapter = adapter;
        }

        void start()
        {
            if (mActive || mJob.isCancelled()) return;

            mActive = true;
            mCancellation = new CancellationSignal();
            mAdapter.onStart();

            Bundle extras = new Bundle();
            extras.putBoolean(PrintDocumentAdapter.EXTRA_PRINT_PREVIEW, false);

            final CancellationSignal cancellation = mCancellation;
            mAdapter.onLayout(null, mJob.getMutableInfo().getAttributes(), cancellation, new PrintDocumentAdapter.LayoutResultCallback()
            {
                @Override
                public void onLayoutFinished(PrintDocumentInfo info, boolean changed)
                {
                    mHandler.post(() -> layoutFinished(cancellation));
                }

                @Override
                public void onLayoutFailed(CharSequence error)
                {
                    mHandler.post(() -> finish(PrintJobInfo.STATE_FAILED));
                }

                @Override
                public void onLayoutCancelled()
                {
                    mHandler.post(() -> finish(PrintJobInfo.STATE_CANCELED));
                }
            }, extras);
        }

        void layoutFinished(CancellationSignal cancellation)
        {
            if (!mActive || cancellation.isCanceled()) return;

            mJob.setState(PrintJobInfo.STATE_QUEUED);

            try
            {
                mDestination = ParcelFileDescriptor.open(outputFile(mJob),
                    ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_READ_WRITE | ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_CREATE | ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_TRUNCATE);
            }
            catch (IOException exception)
            {
                finish(PrintJobInfo.STATE_FAILED);
                return;
            }

            mJob.setState(PrintJobInfo.STATE_STARTED);
            mAdapter.onWrite(new PageRange[] {PageRange.ALL_PAGES}, mDestination, cancellation,
                new PrintDocumentAdapter.WriteResultCallback()
                {
                    @Override
                    public void onWriteFinished(PageRange[] pages)
                    {
                        mHandler.post(() ->
                        {
                            synchronized (mJob.getMutableInfo())
                            {
                                mJob.getMutableInfo().setPages(pages);
                            }
                            finish(PrintJobInfo.STATE_COMPLETED);
                        });
                    }

                    @Override
                    public void onWriteFailed(CharSequence error)
                    {
                        mHandler.post(() -> finish(PrintJobInfo.STATE_FAILED));
                    }

                    @Override
                    public void onWriteCancelled()
                    {
                        mHandler.post(() -> finish(PrintJobInfo.STATE_CANCELED));
                    }
                });
        }

        void cancel()
        {
            if (!mActive)
            {
                mJob.setState(PrintJobInfo.STATE_CANCELED);
                return;
            }

            mCancellation.cancel();
            finish(PrintJobInfo.STATE_CANCELED);
        }

        void finish(int state)
        {
            if (!mActive) return;

            mActive = false;
            if (mDestination != null)
            {
                try
                {
                    mDestination.close();
                }
                catch (IOException exception)
                {
                }
                mDestination = null;
            }

            mJob.setState(state);
            mAdapter.onFinish();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.print;

import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.Objects;

public final class PrinterId implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<PrinterId> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<PrinterId>()
    {
        @Override
        public PrinterId createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            String packageName = source.readString();
            String className = source.readString();
            String localId = source.readString();
            ComponentName serviceName = packageName == null ? null : new ComponentName(packageName, className);
            return new PrinterId(serviceName, localId);
        }

        @Override
        public PrinterId[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new PrinterId[size];
        }
    };

    private final ComponentName mServiceName;
    private final String mLocalId;

    PrinterId(ComponentName serviceName, String localId)
    {
        mServiceName = serviceName;
        mLocalId = localId;
    }

    public String getLocalId()
    {
        return mLocalId;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mServiceName == null ? null : mServiceName.getPackageName());
        dest.writeString(mServiceName == null ? null : mServiceName.getClassName());
        dest.writeString(mLocalId);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof PrinterId)) return false;

        PrinterId id = (PrinterId)other;
        return Objects.equals(mServiceName, id.mServiceName) && Objects.equals(mLocalId, id.mLocalId);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mServiceName, mLocalId);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "PrinterId{serviceName=" + (mServiceName == null ? null : mServiceName.flattenToString()) + ", localId=" + mLocalId + "}";
    }
}
```

`java/android/print/pdf/PrintedPdfDocument.java`:

```java
package android.print.pdf;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.graphics.pdf.PdfDocument;
import android.print.PrintAttributes;

public class PrintedPdfDocument extends PdfDocument
{
    private static final int MILS_PER_INCH = 1000;
    private static final int POINTS_IN_INCH = 72;

    private final int mPageWidth;
    private final int mPageHeight;
    private final Rect mContentRect;

    public PrintedPdfDocument(Context context, PrintAttributes attributes)
    {
        PrintAttributes.MediaSize mediaSize = attributes.getMediaSize();

        mPageWidth = (int)(((float)mediaSize.getWidthMils() / MILS_PER_INCH) * POINTS_IN_INCH);
        mPageHeight = (int)(((float)mediaSize.getHeightMils() / MILS_PER_INCH) * POINTS_IN_INCH);

        PrintAttributes.Margins minMargins = attributes.getMinMargins();
        if (minMargins == null) minMargins = PrintAttributes.Margins.NO_MARGINS;

        final int marginLeft = (int)(((float)minMargins.getLeftMils() / MILS_PER_INCH) * POINTS_IN_INCH);
        final int marginTop = (int)(((float)minMargins.getTopMils() / MILS_PER_INCH) * POINTS_IN_INCH);
        final int marginRight = (int)(((float)minMargins.getRightMils() / MILS_PER_INCH) * POINTS_IN_INCH);
        final int marginBottom = (int)(((float)minMargins.getBottomMils() / MILS_PER_INCH) * POINTS_IN_INCH);

        mContentRect = new Rect(marginLeft, marginTop, mPageWidth - marginRight, mPageHeight - marginBottom);
    }

    public Page startPage(int pageNumber)
    {
        PageInfo pageInfo = new PageInfo.Builder(mPageWidth, mPageHeight, pageNumber).setContentRect(mContentRect).create();
        return startPage(pageInfo);
    }

    public int getPageWidth()
    {
        return mPageWidth;
    }

    public int getPageHeight()
    {
        return mPageHeight;
    }

    public Rect getPageContentRect()
    {
        return mContentRect;
    }
}
```

```java
        {
        }

        public static String getLastOutgoingCall(Context context)
        {
            if (context == null) return "";

            Uri uri = CONTENT_URI.buildUpon().appendQueryParameter(LIMIT_PARAM_KEY, "1").build();
            Cursor cursor = null;

            try
            {
                cursor = context.getContentResolver().query(uri, new String[] {NUMBER}, TYPE + " = " + OUTGOING_TYPE, null,
                    DEFAULT_SORT_ORDER);
                if (cursor == null || !cursor.moveToFirst()) return "";
                String number = cursor.getString(0);
                return number == null ? "" : number;
            }
            catch (RuntimeException failure)
            {
                return "";
            }
            finally
            {
                if (cursor != null) cursor.close();
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    private static Uri lookupFromCursor(ContentResolver resolver, Uri uri, String idColumn)
    {
        if (resolver == null || uri == null) return null;

        Cursor cursor = null;

        try
        {
            cursor = resolver.query(uri, new String[] {idColumn, ContactsColumns.LOOKUP_KEY}, null, null, null);
            if (cursor == null || !cursor.moveToFirst()) return null;
            return Contacts.getLookupUri(cursor.getLong(0), cursor.getString(1));
        }
        catch (RuntimeException failure)
        {
            return null;
        }
        finally
        {
            if (cursor != null) cursor.close();
        }
    }

        public static Uri getLookupUri(long contactId, String lookupKey)
        {
            if (TextUtils.isEmpty(lookupKey)) return null;
            return ContentUris.withAppendedId(Uri.withAppendedPath(CONTENT_LOOKUP_URI, lookupKey), contactId);
        }

        public static Uri lookupContact(ContentResolver resolver, Uri lookupUri)
        {
            if (resolver == null || lookupUri == null) return null;

            Cursor cursor = null;

            try
            {
                cursor = resolver.query(lookupUri, new String[] {_ID}, null, null, null);
                if (cursor == null || !cursor.moveToFirst()) return null;
                return ContentUris.withAppendedId(CONTENT_URI, cursor.getLong(0));
            }
            catch (RuntimeException failure)
            {
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                if (cursor != null) cursor.close();
            }
        }

        public static boolean isEnterpriseContactId(long contactId)
        {
            return contactId >= ENTERPRISE_CONTACT_ID_BASE && contactId < Profile.MIN_ID;
        }

        public static void markAsContacted(ContentResolver resolver, long contactId)
        {
        }

        public static InputStream openContactPhotoInputStream(ContentResolver resolver, Uri contactUri)
        {
            return openContactPhotoInputStream(resolver, contactUri, false);
        }

        public static InputStream openContactPhotoInputStream(ContentResolver resolver, Uri contactUri, boolean preferHighres)
        {
            if (resolver == null || contactUri == null) return null;

            if (preferHighres)
            {
                try
                {
                    AssetFileDescriptor descriptor =
                        resolver.openAssetFileDescriptor(Uri.withAppendedPath(contactUri, DISPLAY_PHOTO_DIRECTORY), "r");
                    if (descriptor != null) return descriptor.createInputStream();
                }
                catch (IOException | RuntimeException failure)
                {
                }
            }

            Cursor cursor = null;

            try
            {
                cursor = resolver.query(Uri.withAppendedPath(contactUri, PHOTO_DIRECTORY), new String[] {PHOTO_COLUMN}, null, null,
                    null);
                if (cursor == null || !cursor.moveToFirst()) return null;
                byte[] data = cursor.getBlob(0);
                return data == null ? null : new ByteArrayInputStream(data);
            }
            catch (RuntimeException failure)
            {
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                if (cursor != null) cursor.close();
            }
        }
    }

                "phoneTypeTtyTdd", "phoneTypeWorkMobile", "phoneTypeWorkPager", "phoneTypeAssistant", "phoneTypeMms"};
            private static final String[] LABELS = {"Custom", "Home", "Mobile", "Work", "Work Fax", "Home Fax", "Pager", "Other",
                "Callback", "Car", "Company Main", "ISDN", "Main", "Other Fax", "Radio", "Telex", "TTY TDD", "Work Mobile",
                "Work Pager", "Assistant", "MMS"};

            private Phone()
            {
            }

            private static int index(int type)
            {
                return type >= 0 && type < LABELS.length ? type : TYPE_CUSTOM;
            }

            public static int getTypeLabelResource(int type)
            {
                return labelResource(RESOURCE_NAMES[index(type)]);
            }

            public static CharSequence getTypeLabel(Resources resources, int type, CharSequence label)
            {
                if ((type == TYPE_CUSTOM || type == TYPE_ASSISTANT) && !TextUtils.isEmpty(label)) return label;
                return CommonDataKinds.label(resources, getTypeLabelResource(type), LABELS[index(type)]);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    public static final class Path implements Parcelable
    {
        public static final Parcelable.Creator<Path> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<Path>()
        {
            @Override
            public Path createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                String rootId = source.readString();
                List<String> path = source.createStringArrayList();
                return new Path(rootId, path);
            }

            @Override
            public Path[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new Path[size];
            }
        };

        private final String mRootId;
        private final List<String> mPath;

        public Path(String rootId, List<String> path)
        {
            if (path == null || path.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Path cannot be empty.");
            mRootId = rootId;
            mPath = path;
        }

        public String getRootId()
        {
            return mRootId;
        }

        public List<String> getPath()
        {
            return mPath;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object other)
        {
            if (this == other) return true;
            if (!(other instanceof Path)) return false;
            Path path = (Path)other;
            return Objects.equals(mRootId, path.mRootId) && Objects.equals(mPath, path.mPath);
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return Objects.hash(mRootId, mPath);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "DocumentsContract.Path{rootId=" + mRootId + ", path=" + mPath + "}";
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
        {
            destination.writeString(mRootId);
            destination.writeStringList(mPath);
        }
    }

    public static Uri buildRootsUri(String authority)
    {
        return new Uri.Builder().scheme(ContentResolver.SCHEME_CONTENT).authority(authority).appendPath(PATH_ROOT).build();
    }

    public static Uri buildRootUri(String authority, String rootId)
    {
        return new Uri.Builder().scheme(ContentResolver.SCHEME_CONTENT).authority(authority).appendPath(PATH_ROOT)
            .appendPath(rootId).build();
    }

    public static Uri buildRecentDocumentsUri(String authority, String rootId)
    {
        return new Uri.Builder().scheme(ContentResolver.SCHEME_CONTENT).authority(authority).appendPath(PATH_ROOT)
            .appendPath(rootId).appendPath(PATH_RECENT).build();
    }

    public static Uri buildTreeDocumentUri(String authority, String documentId)
    {
        return new Uri.Builder().scheme(ContentResolver.SCHEME_CONTENT).authority(authority).appendPath(PATH_TREE)
            .appendPath(documentId).build();
    }

    public static Uri buildDocumentUri(String authority, String documentId)
    {
        return new Uri.Builder().scheme(ContentResolver.SCHEME_CONTENT).authority(authority).appendPath(PATH_DOCUMENT)
            .appendPath(documentId).build();
    }

    public static Uri buildDocumentUriUsingTree(Uri treeUri, String documentId)
    {
        return new Uri.Builder().scheme(ContentResolver.SCHEME_CONTENT).authority(treeUri.getAuthority()).appendPath(PATH_TREE)
            .appendPath(getTreeDocumentId(treeUri)).appendPath(PATH_DOCUMENT).appendPath(documentId).build();
    }

    public static Uri buildChildDocumentsUri(String authority, String parentDocumentId)
    {
        return new Uri.Builder().scheme(ContentResolver.SCHEME_CONTENT).authority(authority).appendPath(PATH_DOCUMENT)
            .appendPath(parentDocumentId).appendPath(PATH_CHILDREN).build();
    }

    public static Uri buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(Uri treeUri, String parentDocumentId)
    {
        return new Uri.Builder().scheme(ContentResolver.SCHEME_CONTENT).authority(treeUri.getAuthority()).appendPath(PATH_TREE)
            .appendPath(getTreeDocumentId(treeUri)).appendPath(PATH_DOCUMENT).appendPath(parentDocumentId)
            .appendPath(PATH_CHILDREN).build();
    }

    public static Uri buildSearchDocumentsUri(String authority, String rootId, String query)
    {
        return new Uri.Builder().scheme(ContentResolver.SCHEME_CONTENT).authority(authority).appendPath(PATH_ROOT)
            .appendPath(rootId).appendPath(PATH_SEARCH).appendQueryParameter(PARAM_QUERY, query).build();
    }

    private static boolean isContentUri(Uri uri)
    {
        return uri != null && ContentResolver.SCHEME_CONTENT.equals(uri.getScheme());
    }

    public static boolean isDocumentUri(Context context, Uri uri)
    {
        if (!isContentUri(uri)) return false;

        List<String> paths = uri.getPathSegments();
        if (paths.size() == 2) return PATH_DOCUMENT.equals(paths.get(0));
        if (paths.size() == 4) return PATH_TREE.equals(paths.get(0)) && PATH_DOCUMENT.equals(paths.get(2));
        return false;
    }

    public static boolean isRootUri(Context context, Uri uri)
    {
        if (!isContentUri(uri)) return false;

        List<String> paths = uri.getPathSegments();
        return paths.size() == 2 && PATH_ROOT.equals(paths.get(0));
    }

    public static boolean isRootsUri(Context context, Uri uri)
    {
        if (!isContentUri(uri)) return false;

        List<String> paths = uri.getPathSegments();
        return paths.size() == 1 && PATH_ROOT.equals(paths.get(0));
    }

    public static boolean isTreeUri(Uri uri)
    {
        if (uri == null) return false;

        List<String> paths = uri.getPathSegments();
        return paths.size() >= 2 && PATH_TREE.equals(paths.get(0));
    }

    public static String getRootId(Uri rootUri)
    {
        List<String> paths = rootUri.getPathSegments();
        if (paths.size() >= 2 && PATH_ROOT.equals(paths.get(0))) return paths.get(1);
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid URI: " + rootUri);
    }

    public static String getDocumentId(Uri documentUri)
    {
        List<String> paths = documentUri.getPathSegments();
        if (paths.size() >= 2 && PATH_DOCUMENT.equals(paths.get(0))) return paths.get(1);
        if (paths.size() >= 4 && PATH_TREE.equals(paths.get(0)) && PATH_DOCUMENT.equals(paths.get(2))) return paths.get(3);
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid URI: " + documentUri);
    }

    public static String getTreeDocumentId(Uri documentUri)
    {
        List<String> paths = documentUri.getPathSegments();
        if (paths.size() >= 2 && PATH_TREE.equals(paths.get(0))) return paths.get(1);
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid URI: " + documentUri);
    }

    public static String getSearchDocumentsQuery(Uri searchDocumentsUri)
    {
        return searchDocumentsUri.getQueryParameter(PARAM_QUERY);
    }

    private static Bundle invoke(ContentResolver content, Uri uri, String method, Bundle in) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        Bundle out;

        try
        {
            out = content.call(uri, method, null, in);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException failure)
        {
            FileNotFoundException missing = new FileNotFoundException(failure.getMessage());
            missing.initCause(failure);
            throw missing;
        }

        if (out == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("No documents provider answered " + method + " for " + uri);
        return out;
    }

    public static Uri createDocument(ContentResolver content, Uri parentDocumentUri, String mimeType, String displayName)
        throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        Bundle in = new Bundle();
        in.putParcelable(EXTRA_URI, parentDocumentUri);
        in.putString(Document.COLUMN_MIME_TYPE, mimeType);
        in.putString(Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME, displayName);
        return invoke(content, parentDocumentUri, METHOD_CREATE_DOCUMENT, in).getParcelable(EXTRA_URI);
    }

    public static Uri renameDocument(ContentResolver content, Uri documentUri, String displayName) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        Bundle in = new Bundle();
        in.putParcelable(EXTRA_URI, documentUri);
        in.putString(Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME, displayName);
        Uri outUri = invoke(content, documentUri, METHOD_RENAME_DOCUMENT, in).getParcelable(EXTRA_URI);
        return outUri != null ? outUri : documentUri;
    }

    public static boolean deleteDocument(ContentResolver content, Uri documentUri) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        Bundle in = new Bundle();
        in.putParcelable(EXTRA_URI, documentUri);
        invoke(content, documentUri, METHOD_DELETE_DOCUMENT, in);
        return true;
    }

    public static Uri copyDocument(ContentResolver content, Uri sourceDocumentUri, Uri targetParentDocumentUri)
        throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        Bundle in = new Bundle();
        in.putParcelable(EXTRA_URI, sourceDocumentUri);
        in.putParcelable(EXTRA_TARGET_URI, targetParentDocumentUri);
        return invoke(content, sourceDocumentUri, METHOD_COPY_DOCUMENT, in).getParcelable(EXTRA_URI);
    }

    public static Uri moveDocument(ContentResolver content, Uri sourceDocumentUri, Uri sourceParentDocumentUri,
        Uri targetParentDocumentUri) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        Bundle in = new Bundle();
        in.putParcelable(EXTRA_URI, sourceDocumentUri);
        in.putParcelable(EXTRA_PARENT_URI, sourceParentDocumentUri);
        in.putParcelable(EXTRA_TARGET_URI, targetParentDocumentUri);
        return invoke(content, sourceDocumentUri, METHOD_MOVE_DOCUMENT, in).getParcelable(EXTRA_URI);
    }

    public static boolean removeDocument(ContentResolver content, Uri documentUri, Uri parentDocumentUri)
        throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        Bundle in = new Bundle();
        in.putParcelable(EXTRA_URI, documentUri);
        in.putParcelable(EXTRA_PARENT_URI, parentDocumentUri);
        invoke(content, documentUri, METHOD_REMOVE_DOCUMENT, in);
        return true;
    }

    public static boolean isChildDocument(ContentResolver content, Uri parentDocumentUri, Uri childDocumentUri)
        throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        Bundle in = new Bundle();
        in.putParcelable(EXTRA_URI, parentDocumentUri);
        in.putParcelable(EXTRA_TARGET_URI, childDocumentUri);
        return invoke(content, parentDocumentUri, METHOD_IS_CHILD_DOCUMENT, in).getBoolean(EXTRA_RESULT);
    }

    public static void ejectRoot(ContentResolver content, Uri rootUri)
    {
        Bundle in = new Bundle();
        in.putParcelable(EXTRA_URI, rootUri);

        try
        {
            invoke(content, rootUri, METHOD_EJECT_ROOT, in);
        }
        catch (FileNotFoundException missing)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException(missing);
        }
    }

    public static Path findDocumentPath(ContentResolver content, Uri treeUri) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        Bundle in = new Bundle();
        in.putParcelable(EXTRA_URI, treeUri);
        return invoke(content, treeUri, METHOD_FIND_DOCUMENT_PATH, in).getParcelable(EXTRA_RESULT);
    }

    public static IntentSender createWebLinkIntent(ContentResolver content, Uri uri, Bundle options) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        Bundle in = new Bundle();
        in.putParcelable(EXTRA_URI, uri);
        if (options != null) in.putBundle(EXTRA_OPTIONS, options);
        return invoke(content, uri, METHOD_CREATE_WEB_LINK_INTENT, in).getParcelable(EXTRA_RESULT);
    }

    public static Bundle getDocumentMetadata(ContentResolver content, Uri documentUri) throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        Bundle in = new Bundle();
        in.putParcelable(EXTRA_URI, documentUri);
        return invoke(content, documentUri, METHOD_GET_DOCUMENT_METADATA, in);
    }

    public static Bitmap getDocumentThumbnail(ContentResolver content, Uri documentUri, Point size, CancellationSignal signal)
        throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        try
        {
            return content.loadThumbnail(documentUri, new Size(size.x, size.y), signal);
        }
        catch (FileNotFoundException missing)
        {
            throw missing;
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            FileNotFoundException missing = new FileNotFoundException(failure.getMessage());
            missing.initCause(failure);
            throw missing;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    private static Uri volumeUri(String volumeName, String first, String second)
    {
        if (volumeName == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Volume must not be null");

        Uri.Builder builder = AUTHORITY_URI.buildUpon().appendPath(volumeName).appendPath(first);
        if (second != null) builder.appendPath(second);
        return builder.build();
    }

    private static Uri withId(Uri base, long id)
    {
        return ContentUris.withAppendedId(base, id);
    }

    private static PendingIntent createRequest(ContentResolver resolver, String action, Collection<Uri> uris, Boolean value)
    {
        if (resolver == null) throw new NullPointerException("resolver");
        if (uris == null) throw new NullPointerException("uris");

        for (Uri uri : uris)
        {
            if (uri == null) throw new NullPointerException("uri");
            if (!AUTHORITY.equals(uri.getAuthority())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("All requested items must be media items");
        }

        Intent intent = new Intent(action);
        intent.putParcelableArrayListExtra(EXTRA_URIS, new ArrayList<>(uris));
        if (value != null) intent.putExtra(EXTRA_VALUE, value.booleanValue());
        return PendingIntent.getActivity(resolver.getContext(), 0, intent, PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
    }

    public static PendingIntent createWriteRequest(ContentResolver resolver, Collection<Uri> uris)
    {
        return createRequest(resolver, ACTION_WRITE_REQUEST, uris, null);
    }

    public static PendingIntent createDeleteRequest(ContentResolver resolver, Collection<Uri> uris)
    {
        return createRequest(resolver, ACTION_DELETE_REQUEST, uris, null);
    }

    public static PendingIntent createTrashRequest(ContentResolver resolver, Collection<Uri> uris, boolean value)
    {
        return createRequest(resolver, ACTION_TRASH_REQUEST, uris, value);
    }

    public static PendingIntent createFavoriteRequest(ContentResolver resolver, Collection<Uri> uris, boolean value)
    {
        return createRequest(resolver, ACTION_FAVORITE_REQUEST, uris, value);
    }

    public static void markIsFavoriteStatus(ContentResolver resolver, Collection<Uri> uris, boolean areFavorites)
    {
        if (resolver == null || uris == null) return;

        ContentValues values = new ContentValues();
        values.put(MediaColumns.IS_FAVORITE, areFavorites ? 1 : 0);

        for (Uri uri : uris)
        {
            try
            {
                resolver.update(uri, values, null, null);
            }
            catch (RuntimeException failure)
            {
            }
        }
    }

    private static Size kindSize(int kind)
    {
        if (kind == Images.Thumbnails.MICRO_KIND) return new Size(96, 96);
        if (kind == Images.Thumbnails.MINI_KIND) return new Size(512, 384);
        if (kind == Images.Thumbnails.FULL_SCREEN_KIND) return new Size(1024, 786);
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported kind: " + kind);
    }

        public static String keyFor(String name)
        {
            if (name == null) return null;

            String key = name.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (key.equals(UNKNOWN_STRING)) return "\001";
            if (key.startsWith("the ")) key = key.substring(4);
            else if (key.startsWith("an ")) key = key.substring(3);
            else if (key.startsWith("a ")) key = key.substring(2);
            if (key.endsWith(", the") || key.endsWith(",the") || key.endsWith(", an") || key.endsWith(",an")
                || key.endsWith(", a") || key.endsWith(",a"))
            {
                key = key.substring(0, key.lastIndexOf(','));
            }

            StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();

            for (int index = 0; index < key.length(); index++)
            {
                char character = key.charAt(index);
                if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(character)) builder.append(character);
            }

            return builder.toString();
        }

            public static Bitmap getBitmap(ContentResolver resolver, Uri url) throws FileNotFoundException, IOException
            {
                InputStream input = resolver.openInputStream(url);
                if (input == null) throw new FileNotFoundException(String.valueOf(url));

                try
                {
                    return BitmapFactory.decodeStream(input);
                }
                finally
                {
                    input.close();
                }
            }

            public static String insertImage(ContentResolver resolver, String imagePath, String name, String description)
                throws FileNotFoundException
            {
                if (imagePath == null || !new File(imagePath).isFile()) throw new FileNotFoundException(imagePath);

                Bitmap source = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(imagePath);
                if (source == null) return null;
                return insertImage(resolver, source, name, description);
            }

            public static String insertImage(ContentResolver resolver, Bitmap source, String title, String description)
            {
                if (resolver == null || source == null) return null;

                ContentValues values = new ContentValues();
                values.put(DISPLAY_NAME, title);
                values.put(TITLE, title);
                values.put(DESCRIPTION, description);
                values.put(MIME_TYPE, "image/jpeg");
                values.put(IS_PENDING, 1);

                Uri url = null;

                try
                {
                    url = resolver.insert(EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, values);
                    if (url == null) return null;

                    OutputStream output = resolver.openOutputStream(url);
                    if (output == null) throw new IOException("Unable to open " + url);

                    try
                    {
                        source.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 90, output);
                    }
                    finally
                    {
                        output.close();
                    }

                    values.clear();
                    values.put(IS_PENDING, 0);
                    resolver.update(url, values, null, null);
                    return url.toString();
                }
                catch (IOException | RuntimeException failure)
                {
                    if (url != null)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            resolver.delete(url, null, null);
                        }
                        catch (RuntimeException ignored)
                        {
                        }
                    }

                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
```

```java
package android.provider;

import android.content.ContentResolver;
import android.net.Uri;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public final class Settings
{
    public static final String ACTION_SETTINGS = "android.settings.SETTINGS";
    public static final String ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS = "android.settings.APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS";
    public static final String ACTION_MANAGE_OVERLAY_PERMISSION = "android.settings.action.MANAGE_OVERLAY_PERMISSION";

    private Settings()
    {
    }

    public static boolean canDrawOverlays(android.content.Context context)
    {
        return context != null && runtime.Permissions.isDeclared("android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW");
    }

    public static class SettingNotFoundException extends android.util.AndroidException
    {
        public SettingNotFoundException(String message)
        {
            super(message);
        }
    }

    public static class NameValueTable implements BaseColumns
    {
        public static final String NAME = "name";
        public static final String VALUE = "value";

        public NameValueTable()
        {
        }

        protected static boolean putString(ContentResolver resolver, Uri uri, String name, String value)
        {
            Table table = Table.forUri(uri);
            return table != null && table.write(name, value);
        }

        public static Uri getUriFor(Uri uri, String name)
        {
            return Uri.withAppendedPath(uri, name);
        }
    }

    private static final class Table
    {
        private static final List<Table> ALL = new ArrayList<>();

        private final Uri contentUri;
        private final Map<String, String> values = new HashMap<>();

        Table(String authorityPath)
        {
            contentUri = Uri.parse("content://settings/" + authorityPath);

            synchronized (ALL)
            {
                ALL.add(this);
            }
        }

        static Table forUri(Uri uri)
        {
            synchronized (ALL)
            {
                for (Table table : ALL)
                {
                    if (table.contentUri.equals(uri)) return table;
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        synchronized String get(String name)
        {
            return values.get(name);
        }

        synchronized boolean put(String name, String value)
        {
            String previous = value == null ? values.remove(name) : values.put(name, value);
            return value == null ? previous != null : !value.equals(previous);
        }

        void seed(String name, String value)
        {
            values.put(name, value);
        }

        Uri uriFor(String name)
        {
            return Uri.withAppendedPath(contentUri, name);
        }

        boolean write(String name, String value)
        {
            if (!put(name, value)) return true;

            ContentResolver.dispatchChange(uriFor(name), null, 0);
            return true;
        }
    }

    private static int readInt(Table table, String name, int fallback)
    {
        String value = table.get(name);
        if (value == null) return fallback;

        try
        {
            return Integer.parseInt(value);
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
        {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    {

        {
```

```java
            private Intents()
            {
            }

            public static SmsMessage[] getMessagesFromIntent(Intent intent)
            {
                if (intent == null) return null;

                Object pdus = intent.getSerializableExtra("pdus");
                if (!(pdus instanceof Object[])) return null;

                Object[] messages = (Object[])pdus;
                String format = intent.getStringExtra("format");
                SmsMessage[] result = new SmsMessage[messages.length];

                for (int index = 0; index < messages.length; index++)
                {
                    result[index] = SmsMessage.createFromPdu((byte[])messages[index], format);
                }

                return result;
            }
        }
    }
```

```java
package android.renderscript;

import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory;
import android.util.Half;
import android.view.Surface;

import java.lang.reflect.Array;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

public class Allocation extends BaseObj
{
    public static final int USAGE_SCRIPT = 0x0001;
    public static final int USAGE_GRAPHICS_TEXTURE = 0x0002;
    public static final int USAGE_GRAPHICS_VERTEX = 0x0004;
    public static final int USAGE_GRAPHICS_CONSTANTS = 0x0008;
    public static final int USAGE_GRAPHICS_RENDER_TARGET = 0x0010;
    public static final int USAGE_IO_INPUT = 0x0020;
    public static final int USAGE_IO_OUTPUT = 0x0040;
    public static final int USAGE_SHARED = 0x0080;

    private static final int USAGE_ALL = USAGE_SCRIPT | USAGE_GRAPHICS_TEXTURE | USAGE_GRAPHICS_VERTEX | USAGE_GRAPHICS_CONSTANTS
            | USAGE_GRAPHICS_RENDER_TARGET | USAGE_IO_INPUT | USAGE_IO_OUTPUT | USAGE_SHARED;

    private Type mType;
    private ByteBuffer mData;
    private final int mUsage;
    private final MipmapControl mMipmapControl;
    private boolean mAutoPadding;
    private long mTimeStamp = -1;
    private Surface mSurface;
    private OnBufferAvailableListener mBufferNotifier;

    public enum MipmapControl
    {
        MIPMAP_NONE(0),
        MIPMAP_FULL(1),
        MIPMAP_ON_SYNC_TO_TEXTURE(2);

        final int mID;

        MipmapControl(int id)
        {
            mID = id;
        }
    }

    public interface OnBufferAvailableListener
    {
        void onBufferAvailable(Allocation a);
    }

    Allocation(RenderScript rs, Type type, MipmapControl mipmapControl, int usage)
    {
        super(rs);

        if ((usage & ~USAGE_ALL) != 0) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Unknown usage specified.");
        if ((usage & USAGE_IO_INPUT) != 0 && (usage & ~(USAGE_IO_INPUT | USAGE_GRAPHICS_TEXTURE | USAGE_SCRIPT)) != 0)
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Invalid usage combination.");
        }

        mType = type;
        mUsage = usage;
        mMipmapControl = mipmapControl;
        mData = ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(computeBytesSize(type)).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
    }

    private static int computeBytesSize(Type type)
    {
        int size = type.getCount() * type.getElement().getBytesSize();
        if (type.getYuv() != 0) return (int) Math.ceil(size * 1.5);
        return size;
    }

    ByteBuffer data()
    {
        return mData;
    }

    int elementSize()
    {
        return mType.getElement().getBytesSize();
    }

    public Element getElement()
    {
        return mType.getElement();
    }

    public int getUsage()
    {
        return mUsage;
    }

    public void setAutoPadding(boolean useAutoPadding)
    {
        mAutoPadding = useAutoPadding;
    }

    public int getBytesSize()
    {
        return computeBytesSize(mType);
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        super.finalize();
    }

    public Type getType()
    {
        return mType;
    }

    public void syncAll(int srcLocation)
    {
        switch (srcLocation)
        {
            case USAGE_GRAPHICS_TEXTURE:
            case USAGE_SCRIPT:
            case USAGE_GRAPHICS_CONSTANTS:
            case USAGE_GRAPHICS_VERTEX:
            case USAGE_SHARED:
                break;
            default:
                throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Source must be exactly one usage type.");
        }
        checkValid();
    }

    public void ioSend()
    {
        if ((mUsage & USAGE_IO_OUTPUT) == 0)
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Can only send buffer if IO_OUTPUT usage specified.");
        }
        checkValid();
    }

    public void ioReceive()
    {
        if ((mUsage & USAGE_IO_INPUT) == 0)
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Can only receive if IO_INPUT usage specified.");
        }
        checkValid();
        mTimeStamp = System.nanoTime();
    }

    public void copyFrom(BaseObj[] d)
    {
        checkValid();
        Element.DataType dataType = mType.getElement().mType;
        if (dataType.mID < Element.DataType.RS_ELEMENT.mID)
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("copyFrom BaseObj[] requires an object element type.");
        }
        if (d.length != mType.getCount())
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Array size mismatch, allocation sizeX = " + mType.getCount() + ", array length = "
                    + d.length);
        }

        int size = elementSize();
        for (int index = 0; index < d.length; index++)
        {
            int offset = index * size;
            for (int byteIndex = 0; byteIndex < size; byteIndex++) mData.put(offset + byteIndex, (byte) 0);
            mData.putLong(offset, d[index] == null ? 0 : d[index].getID());
        }
    }

    public void copyFromUnchecked(Object array)
    {
        copyWholeFrom(array, false);
    }

    public void copyFromUnchecked(int[] d)
    {
        copyWholeFrom(d, false);
    }

    public void copyFromUnchecked(short[] d)
    {
        copyWholeFrom(d, false);
    }

    public void copyFromUnchecked(byte[] d)
    {
        copyWholeFrom(d, false);
    }

    public void copyFromUnchecked(float[] d)
    {
        copyWholeFrom(d, false);
    }

    public void copyFrom(Object array)
    {
        copyWholeFrom(array, true);
    }

    public void copyFrom(int[] d)
    {
        copyWholeFrom(d, true);
    }

    public void copyFrom(short[] d)
    {
        copyWholeFrom(d, true);
    }

    public void copyFrom(byte[] d)
    {
        copyWholeFrom(d, true);
    }

    public void copyFrom(float[] d)
    {
        copyWholeFrom(d, true);
    }

    public void copyFrom(Bitmap b)
    {
        checkValid();
        if (b.getConfig() == null)
        {
            Bitmap converted = Bitmap.createBitmap(b.getWidth(), b.getHeight(), Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
            copyFrom(converted);
            return;
        }

        validateBitmapSize(b);
        byte[] bytes = RuntimeBitmapBridge.read(b, 0, 0, b.getWidth(), b.getHeight(), elementSize());
        writeBytes(0, bytes, 0, bytes.length);
    }

    public void copyFrom(Allocation a)
    {
        checkValid();
        if (!a.getType().getElement().equals(mType.getElement())
                && !a.getType().getElement().isCompatible(mType.getElement()))
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Types of allocations must match.");
        }
        if (a.getType().getX() != mType.getX() || a.getType().getY() != mType.getY() || a.getType().getZ() != mType.getZ())
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Types of allocations must match.");
        }

        int length = Math.min(a.getBytesSize(), getBytesSize());
        copyBuffer(a.mData, 0, mData, 0, length);
    }

    public void setFromFieldPacker(int xoff, FieldPacker fp)
    {
        checkValid();
        int size = elementSize();
        byte[] data = fp.getData();
        int dataSize = fp.getPos();

        int count = dataSize / size;
        if (size * count != dataSize)
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Field packer length " + dataSize + " not divisible by element size " + size + ".");
        }
        copy1DRangeFromUnchecked(xoff, count, data);
    }

    public void setFromFieldPacker(int xoff, int componentNumber, FieldPacker fp)
    {
        setFromFieldPacker(xoff, 0, 0, componentNumber, fp);
    }

    public void setFromFieldPacker(int xoff, int yoff, int zoff, int componentNumber, FieldPacker fp)
    {
        checkValid();
        Element element = mType.getElement();
        if (componentNumber >= element.getSubElementCount())
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Component_number " + componentNumber + " out of range.");
        }
        if (xoff < 0) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Offset x must be >= 0.");
        if (yoff < 0) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Offset y must be >= 0.");
        if (zoff < 0) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Offset z must be >= 0.");

        byte[] data = fp.getData();
        int dataSize = fp.getPos();
        int componentSize = element.getSubElement(componentNumber).getBytesSize() * element.getSubElementArraySize(componentNumber);
        if (dataSize != componentSize)
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Field packer sizelength " + dataSize + " does not match component size "
                    + componentSize + ".");
        }

        int index = (zoff * Math.max(mType.getY(), 1) + yoff) * Math.max(mType.getX(), 1) + xoff;
        int offset = index * element.getBytesSize() + element.getSubElementOffsetBytes(componentNumber);
        writeBytes(offset, data, 0, dataSize);
    }

    public void generateMipmaps()
    {
        checkValid();
    }

    public void copy1DRangeFrom(int off, int count, Allocation data, int dataOff)
    {
        checkValid();
        validate1DRange(off, count);
        data.validate1DRange(dataOff, count);

        int size = elementSize();
        copyBuffer(data.mData, dataOff * size, mData, off * size, count * size);
    }

    public void copy2DRangeFrom(int xoff, int yoff, int w, int h, Object array)

        copy2DIn(xoff, yoff, w, h, array, true);

        copy2DIn(xoff, yoff, w, h, data, true);

    public void copy2DRangeFrom(int xoff, int yoff, int w, int h, Allocation data, int dataXoff, int dataYoff)
    {
        checkValid();
        validate2DRange(xoff, yoff, w, h);
        data.validate2DRange(dataXoff, dataYoff, w, h);

        int size = elementSize();
        int width = Math.max(mType.getX(), 1);
        int sourceWidth = Math.max(data.mType.getX(), 1);
        for (int row = 0; row < h; row++)
        {
            int source = ((dataYoff + row) * sourceWidth + dataXoff) * size;
            int target = ((yoff + row) * width + xoff) * size;
            copyBuffer(data.mData, source, mData, target, w * size);
        }
    }

    public void copy2DRangeFrom(int xoff, int yoff, Bitmap data)
    {
        checkValid();
        int w = data.getWidth();
        int h = data.getHeight();
        validate2DRange(xoff, yoff, w, h);

        byte[] bytes = RuntimeBitmapBridge.read(data, 0, 0, w, h, elementSize());
        copy2DIn(xoff, yoff, w, h, bytes, false);
    }

    public void copy3DRangeFrom(int xoff, int yoff, int zoff, int w, int h, int d, Object array)
    {
        checkValid();
        validate3DRange(xoff, yoff, zoff, w, h, d);
        validateArrayType(array, true);

        int size = elementSize();
        int primitiveSize = primitiveSize(array);
        int width = Math.max(mType.getX(), 1);
        int height = Math.max(mType.getY(), 1);
        checkArrayLength(array, w * h * d * size);
        for (int slice = 0; slice < d; slice++)
        {
            for (int row = 0; row < h; row++)
            {
                int target = (((zoff + slice) * height + yoff + row) * width + xoff) * size;
                int source = ((slice * h + row) * w * size) / primitiveSize;
                writeArray(target, array, source, w * size);
            }
        }
    }

    public void copy3DRangeFrom(int xoff, int yoff, int zoff, int w, int h, int d, Allocation data, int dataXoff, int dataYoff,
            int dataZoff)
    {
        checkValid();
        validate3DRange(xoff, yoff, zoff, w, h, d);
        data.validate3DRange(dataXoff, dataYoff, dataZoff, w, h, d);

        int size = elementSize();
        int width = Math.max(mType.getX(), 1);
        int height = Math.max(mType.getY(), 1);
        int sourceWidth = Math.max(data.mType.getX(), 1);
        int sourceHeight = Math.max(data.mType.getY(), 1);
        for (int slice = 0; slice < d; slice++)
        {
            for (int row = 0; row < h; row++)
            {
                int source = (((dataZoff + slice) * sourceHeight + dataYoff + row) * sourceWidth + dataXoff) * size;
                int target = (((zoff + slice) * height + yoff + row) * width + xoff) * size;
                copyBuffer(data.mData, source, mData, target, w * size);
            }
        }
    }

    public void copyTo(Bitmap b)
    {
        checkValid();
        validateBitmapSize(b);

        int length = b.getWidth() * b.getHeight() * elementSize();
        byte[] bytes = new byte[length];
        readBytes(0, bytes, 0, length);
        RuntimeBitmapBridge.write(b, 0, 0, b.getWidth(), b.getHeight(), elementSize(), bytes);
    }

    public void copyTo(Object array)

        copyWholeTo(array, true);
    }

    }

    public synchronized void resize(int dimX)
    {
        if (mType.getY() > 0 || mType.getZ() > 0 || mType.hasFaces() || mType.hasMipmaps())
        {
            throw new RSInvalidStateException("Resize only support for 1D allocations at this time.");
        }

        Type type = new Type(mRS, mType.getElement(), dimX, 0, 0, false, false, 0);
        ByteBuffer data = ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(computeBytesSize(type)).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        copyBuffer(mData, 0, data, 0, Math.min(data.capacity(), mData.capacity()));
        mType = type;
        mData = data;
    }
```
