```java
    public void copy3DRangeTo(int xoff, int yoff, int zoff, int w, int h, int d, Object array)
    {
        checkValid();
        validate3DRange(xoff, yoff, zoff, w, h, d);
        validateArrayType(array, true);

        int size = elementSize();
        int primitiveSize = primitiveSize(array);
        int width = Math.max(mType.getX(), 1);
        int height = Math.max(mType.getY(), 1);
        checkArrayLength(array, w * h * d * size);
        for (int slice = 0; slice < d; slice++)
        {
            for (int row = 0; row < h; row++)
            {
                int source = (((zoff + slice) * height + yoff + row) * width + xoff) * size;
                int target = ((slice * h + row) * w * size) / primitiveSize;
                readArray(source, array, target, w * size);
            }
        }
    }

    public static Allocation createTyped(RenderScript rs, Type type, MipmapControl mips, int usage)
    {
        rs.validate();
        type.checkValid();
        return new Allocation(rs, type, mips, usage);
    }

    public static Allocation createTyped(RenderScript rs, Type type, int usage)
    {
        return createTyped(rs, type, MipmapControl.MIPMAP_NONE, usage);
    }

    public static Allocation createTyped(RenderScript rs, Type type)
    {
        return createTyped(rs, type, MipmapControl.MIPMAP_NONE, USAGE_SCRIPT);
    }

    public static Allocation createSized(RenderScript rs, Element e, int count, int usage)
    {
        rs.validate();
        Type type = new Type.Builder(rs, e).setX(count).create();
        return new Allocation(rs, type, MipmapControl.MIPMAP_NONE, usage);
    }

    public static Allocation createSized(RenderScript rs, Element e, int count)
    {
        return createSized(rs, e, count, USAGE_SCRIPT);
    }

    static Element elementFromBitmap(RenderScript rs, Bitmap b)
    {
        Bitmap.Config config = b.getConfig();
        if (config == Bitmap.Config.ALPHA_8) return Element.A_8(rs);
        if (config == Bitmap.Config.ARGB_4444) return Element.RGBA_4444(rs);
        if (config == Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888) return Element.RGBA_8888(rs);
        if (config == Bitmap.Config.RGB_565) return Element.RGB_565(rs);
        if (config == Bitmap.Config.RGBA_F16) return Element.F16_4(rs);
        throw new RSInvalidStateException("Bad bitmap type: " + config);
    }

    static Type typeFromBitmap(RenderScript rs, Bitmap b, MipmapControl mips)
    {
        Type.Builder builder = new Type.Builder(rs, elementFromBitmap(rs, b));
        builder.setX(b.getWidth());
        builder.setY(b.getHeight());
        builder.setMipmaps(mips == MipmapControl.MIPMAP_FULL);
        return builder.create();
    }

    public static Allocation createFromBitmap(RenderScript rs, Bitmap b, MipmapControl mips, int usage)
    {
        rs.validate();
        if (b.getConfig() == null)
        {
            if ((usage & USAGE_SHARED) != 0)
            {
                throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("USAGE_SHARED cannot be used with a Bitmap that has a null config.");
            }

            Bitmap converted = Bitmap.createBitmap(b.getWidth(), b.getHeight(), Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
            return createFromBitmap(rs, converted, mips, usage);
        }

        Allocation allocation = new Allocation(rs, typeFromBitmap(rs, b, mips), mips, usage);
        allocation.copyFrom(b);
        return allocation;
    }

    public ByteBuffer getByteBuffer()
    {
        if (mType.getZ() > 0) throw new RSInvalidStateException("Cannot get ByteBuffer of a 3D Allocation");

        return mData.duplicate().order(ByteOrder.nativeOrder());
    }

    public static Allocation[] createAllocations(RenderScript rs, Type t, int usage, int numAlloc)
    {
        if (numAlloc < 1 || numAlloc > 16) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Exceeds the max number of Allocations allowed: 16");
        if ((usage & USAGE_IO_INPUT) == 0) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Allocation must be USAGE_IO_INPUT");

        Allocation[] allocations = new Allocation[numAlloc];
        for (int index = 0; index < numAlloc; index++) allocations[index] = createTyped(rs, t, usage);
        return allocations;
    }

    public long getStride()
    {
        return (long) Math.max(mType.getX(), 1) * elementSize();
    }

    public long getTimeStamp()
    {
        return mTimeStamp;
    }

    public Surface getSurface()
    {
        if ((mUsage & USAGE_IO_INPUT) == 0) throw new RSInvalidStateException("Allocation is not a surface texture.");

        if (mSurface == null) mSurface = new Surface();
        return mSurface;
    }

    public void setSurface(Surface sur)
    {
        checkValid();
        if ((mUsage & USAGE_IO_OUTPUT) == 0) throw new RSInvalidStateException("Allocation is not USAGE_IO_OUTPUT.");

        mSurface = sur;
    }

    public static Allocation createFromBitmap(RenderScript rs, Bitmap b)
    {
        return createFromBitmap(rs, b, MipmapControl.MIPMAP_NONE, USAGE_SHARED | USAGE_SCRIPT | USAGE_GRAPHICS_TEXTURE);
    }

    public static Allocation createCubemapFromBitmap(RenderScript rs, Bitmap b, MipmapControl mips, int usage)
    {
        rs.validate();

        int height = b.getHeight();
        int width = b.getWidth();
        if (width % 6 != 0) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Cubemap height must be multiple of 6");
        if (width / 6 != height) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Only square cube map faces supported");
        if ((height & (height - 1)) != 0) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Only power of 2 cube faces supported");

        Type type = new Type.Builder(rs, elementFromBitmap(rs, b)).setX(height).setY(height).setFaces(true)
                .setMipmaps(mips == MipmapControl.MIPMAP_FULL).create();
        Allocation allocation = new Allocation(rs, type, mips, usage);
        int faceBytes = height * height * allocation.elementSize();
        for (int face = 0; face < 6; face++)
        {
            byte[] bytes = RuntimeBitmapBridge.read(b, face * height, 0, height, height, allocation.elementSize());
            allocation.writeBytes(face * faceBytes, bytes, 0, bytes.length);
        }
        return allocation;
    }

    public static Allocation createCubemapFromBitmap(RenderScript rs, Bitmap b)
    {
        return createCubemapFromBitmap(rs, b, MipmapControl.MIPMAP_NONE, USAGE_GRAPHICS_TEXTURE);
    }

    public static Allocation createCubemapFromCubeFaces(RenderScript rs, Bitmap xpos, Bitmap xneg, Bitmap ypos, Bitmap yneg, Bitmap zpos,
            Bitmap zneg, MipmapControl mips, int usage)
    {
        int height = xpos.getHeight();
        if (xpos.getWidth() != height || xneg.getWidth() != height || xneg.getHeight() != height || ypos.getWidth() != height
                || ypos.getHeight() != height || yneg.getWidth() != height || yneg.getHeight() != height
                || zpos.getWidth() != height || zpos.getHeight() != height || zneg.getWidth() != height
                || zneg.getHeight() != height)
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Only square cube map faces supported");
        }
        if ((height & (height - 1)) != 0) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Only power of 2 cube faces supported");

        Type type = new Type.Builder(rs, elementFromBitmap(rs, xpos)).setX(height).setY(height).setFaces(true)
                .setMipmaps(mips == MipmapControl.MIPMAP_FULL).create();
        Allocation allocation = new Allocation(rs, type, mips, usage);
        Bitmap[] faces = {xpos, xneg, ypos, yneg, zpos, zneg};
        int faceBytes = height * height * allocation.elementSize();
        for (int face = 0; face < faces.length; face++)
        {
            byte[] bytes = RuntimeBitmapBridge.read(faces[face], 0, 0, height, height, allocation.elementSize());
            allocation.writeBytes(face * faceBytes, bytes, 0, bytes.length);
        }
        return allocation;
    }

    public static Allocation createCubemapFromCubeFaces(RenderScript rs, Bitmap xpos, Bitmap xneg, Bitmap ypos, Bitmap yneg, Bitmap zpos,
            Bitmap zneg)
    {
        return createCubemapFromCubeFaces(rs, xpos, xneg, ypos, yneg, zpos, zneg, MipmapControl.MIPMAP_NONE, USAGE_GRAPHICS_TEXTURE);
    }

    public static Allocation createFromBitmapResource(RenderScript rs, Resources res, int id, MipmapControl mips, int usage)
    {
        rs.validate();
        if ((usage & (USAGE_SHARED | USAGE_IO_INPUT | USAGE_IO_OUTPUT)) != 0)
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Unsupported usage specified.");
        }

        Bitmap bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeResource(res, id);
        Allocation allocation = createFromBitmap(rs, bitmap, mips, usage);
        bitmap.recycle();
        return allocation;
    }

    public static Allocation createFromBitmapResource(RenderScript rs, Resources res, int id)
    {
        return createFromBitmapResource(rs, res, id, MipmapControl.MIPMAP_NONE, USAGE_GRAPHICS_TEXTURE);
    }

    public static Allocation createFromString(RenderScript rs, String str, int usage)
    {
        rs.validate();
        byte[] bytes = str.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        Allocation allocation = createSized(rs, Element.U8(rs), bytes.length, usage);
        allocation.copyFrom(bytes);
        return allocation;
    }

    public void setOnBufferAvailableListener(OnBufferAvailableListener callback)
    {
        mBufferNotifier = callback;
    }

    @Override
    public void destroy()
    {
        mBufferNotifier = null;
        super.destroy();
    }

    private void validateBitmapSize(Bitmap b)
    {
        if (mType.getX() != b.getWidth() || mType.getY() != b.getHeight())
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Cannot update allocation from bitmap, sizes mismatch");
        }
    }

    private void copyWholeFrom(Object array, boolean checked)
    {
        checkValid();
        validateArrayType(array, checked);

        int length = Math.min(getBytesSize(), Array.getLength(array) * primitiveSize(array));
        if (Array.getLength(array) * primitiveSize(array) < mType.getCount() * elementSize())
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Array too small for allocation type.");
        }
        writeArray(0, array, 0, length);
    }

    private void copyWholeTo(Object array, boolean checked)
    {
        checkValid();
        validateArrayType(array, checked);

        int length = Math.min(getBytesSize(), Array.getLength(array) * primitiveSize(array));
        if (Array.getLength(array) * primitiveSize(array) < mType.getCount() * elementSize())
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Size of output array cannot be smaller than size of allocation.");
        }
        readArray(0, array, 0, length);
    }

    private void copy1DIn(int off, int count, Object array, boolean checked)
    {
        checkValid();
        validateArrayType(array, checked);
        validate1DRange(off, count);

        int size = elementSize();
        checkArrayLength(array, count * size);
        writeArray(off * size, array, 0, count * size);
    }

    private void copy1DOut(int off, int count, Object array, boolean checked)
    {
        checkValid();
        validateArrayType(array, checked);
        validate1DRange(off, count);

        int size = elementSize();
        checkArrayLength(array, count * size);
        readArray(off * size, array, 0, count * size);
    }

    private void copy2DIn(int xoff, int yoff, int w, int h, Object array, boolean checked)
    {
        checkValid();
        validateArrayType(array, checked);
        validate2DRange(xoff, yoff, w, h);

        int size = elementSize();
        int primitiveSize = primitiveSize(array);
        int width = Math.max(mType.getX(), 1);
        checkArrayLength(array, w * h * size);
        for (int row = 0; row < h; row++)
        {
            int target = ((yoff + row) * width + xoff) * size;
            writeArray(target, array, (row * w * size) / primitiveSize, w * size);
        }
    }

    private void copy2DOut(int xoff, int yoff, int w, int h, Object array)
    {
        checkValid();
        validateArrayType(array, true);
        validate2DRange(xoff, yoff, w, h);

        int size = elementSize();
        int primitiveSize = primitiveSize(array);
        int width = Math.max(mType.getX(), 1);
        checkArrayLength(array, w * h * size);
        for (int row = 0; row < h; row++)
        {
            int source = ((yoff + row) * width + xoff) * size;
            readArray(source, array, (row * w * size) / primitiveSize, w * size);
        }
    }

    private void validate1DRange(int off, int count)
    {
        if (off < 0) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Offset must be >= 0.");
        if (count < 1) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Count must be >= 1.");
        if (off + count > mType.getCount())
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Overflow, Available count " + mType.getCount() + ", got " + count + " at offset "
                    + off + ".");
        }
    }

    private void validate2DRange(int xoff, int yoff, int w, int h)
    {
        if (xoff < 0 || yoff < 0) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Offset cannot be negative.");
        if (h < 0 || w < 0) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Height or width cannot be negative.");
        if (xoff + w > Math.max(mType.getX(), 1) || yoff + h > Math.max(mType.getY(), 1))
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Updated region larger than allocation.");
        }
    }

    private void validate3DRange(int xoff, int yoff, int zoff, int w, int h, int d)
    {
        if (xoff < 0 || yoff < 0 || zoff < 0) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Offset cannot be negative.");
        if (h < 0 || w < 0 || d < 0) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Height or width cannot be negative.");
        if (xoff + w > Math.max(mType.getX(), 1) || yoff + h > Math.max(mType.getY(), 1) || zoff + d > Math.max(mType.getZ(), 1))
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Updated region larger than allocation.");
        }
    }

    private static void checkArrayLength(Object array, int bytes)
    {
        if (Array.getLength(array) * primitiveSize(array) < bytes)
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Array too small for allocation type.");
        }
    }

    private static int primitiveSize(Object array)
    {
        Class<?> component = array.getClass().getComponentType();
        if (component == Byte.TYPE || component == Boolean.TYPE) return 1;
        if (component == Short.TYPE || component == Character.TYPE) return 2;
        if (component == Integer.TYPE || component == Float.TYPE) return 4;
        return 8;
    }

    private void validateArrayType(Object array, boolean checked)
    {
        if (array == null) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Array cannot be null");

        Class<?> component = array.getClass().getComponentType();
        if (component == null || !component.isPrimitive())
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Object passed is not an array of primitives.");
        }
        if (!checked) return;

        Element.DataType type = mType.getElement().mType;
        if (component == Long.TYPE)
        {
            if (type != Element.DataType.SIGNED_64 && type != Element.DataType.UNSIGNED_64)
            {
                throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("64 bit integer source does not match allocation type " + type);
            }
        }
        else if (component == Integer.TYPE)
        {
            if (type != Element.DataType.SIGNED_32 && type != Element.DataType.UNSIGNED_32 && type != Element.DataType.SIGNED_64
                    && type != Element.DataType.UNSIGNED_64)
            {
                throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("32 bit integer source does not match allocation type " + type);
            }
        }
        else if (component == Short.TYPE)
        {
            if (type != Element.DataType.SIGNED_16 && type != Element.DataType.UNSIGNED_16 && type != Element.DataType.FLOAT_16)
            {
                throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("16 bit integer source does not match allocation type " + type);
            }
        }
        else if (component == Byte.TYPE)
        {
            if (type != Element.DataType.SIGNED_8 && type != Element.DataType.UNSIGNED_8)
            {
                throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("8 bit integer source does not match allocation type " + type);
            }
        }
        else if (component == Float.TYPE)
        {
            if (type != Element.DataType.FLOAT_32)
            {
                throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("32 bit float source does not match allocation type " + type);
            }
        }
        else if (component == Double.TYPE)
        {
            if (type != Element.DataType.FLOAT_64)
            {
                throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("64 bit float source does not match allocation type " + type);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Parameter of type " + component.getSimpleName() + "[] is not compatible.");
        }
    }

    private void writeArray(int byteOffset, Object array, int arrayIndex, int byteCount)
    {
        int size = primitiveSize(array);
        int count = byteCount / size;
        ByteBuffer data = mData;

        if (array instanceof byte[])
        {
            byte[] values = (byte[]) array;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) data.put(byteOffset + index, values[arrayIndex + index]);
        }
        else if (array instanceof short[])
        {
            short[] values = (short[]) array;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) data.putShort(byteOffset + index * 2, values[arrayIndex + index]);
        }
        else if (array instanceof int[])
        {
            int[] values = (int[]) array;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) data.putInt(byteOffset + index * 4, values[arrayIndex + index]);
        }
        else if (array instanceof float[])
        {
            float[] values = (float[]) array;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) data.putFloat(byteOffset + index * 4, values[arrayIndex + index]);
        }
        else if (array instanceof long[])
        {
            long[] values = (long[]) array;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) data.putLong(byteOffset + index * 8, values[arrayIndex + index]);
        }
        else if (array instanceof double[])
        {
            double[] values = (double[]) array;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) data.putDouble(byteOffset + index * 8, values[arrayIndex + index]);
        }
        else if (array instanceof char[])
        {
            char[] values = (char[]) array;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) data.putChar(byteOffset + index * 2, values[arrayIndex + index]);
        }
        else if (array instanceof boolean[])
        {
            boolean[] values = (boolean[]) array;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) data.put(byteOffset + index, (byte) (values[arrayIndex + index] ? 1 : 0));
        }
    }

    private void readArray(int byteOffset, Object array, int arrayIndex, int byteCount)
    {
        int size = primitiveSize(array);
        int count = byteCount / size;
        ByteBuffer data = mData;

        if (array instanceof byte[])
        {
            byte[] values = (byte[]) array;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) values[arrayIndex + index] = data.get(byteOffset + index);
        }
        else if (array instanceof short[])
        {
            short[] values = (short[]) array;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) values[arrayIndex + index] = data.getShort(byteOffset + index * 2);
        }
        else if (array instanceof int[])
        {
            int[] values = (int[]) array;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) values[arrayIndex + index] = data.getInt(byteOffset + index * 4);
        }
        else if (array instanceof float[])
        {
            float[] values = (float[]) array;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) values[arrayIndex + index] = data.getFloat(byteOffset + index * 4);
        }
        else if (array instanceof long[])
        {
            long[] values = (long[]) array;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) values[arrayIndex + index] = data.getLong(byteOffset + index * 8);
        }
        else if (array instanceof double[])
        {
            double[] values = (double[]) array;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) values[arrayIndex + index] = data.getDouble(byteOffset + index * 8);
        }
        else if (array instanceof char[])
        {
            char[] values = (char[]) array;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) values[arrayIndex + index] = data.getChar(byteOffset + index * 2);
        }
        else if (array instanceof boolean[])
        {
            boolean[] values = (boolean[]) array;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) values[arrayIndex + index] = data.get(byteOffset + index) != 0;
        }
    }

    void writeBytes(int byteOffset, byte[] source, int sourceOffset, int length)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) mData.put(byteOffset + index, source[sourceOffset + index]);
    }

    void readBytes(int byteOffset, byte[] target, int targetOffset, int length)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) target[targetOffset + index] = mData.get(byteOffset + index);
    }

    private static void copyBuffer(ByteBuffer source, int sourceOffset, ByteBuffer target, int targetOffset, int length)
    {
        if (source == target && sourceOffset < targetOffset)
        {
            for (int index = length - 1; index >= 0; index--) target.put(targetOffset + index, source.get(sourceOffset + index));
            return;
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) target.put(targetOffset + index, source.get(sourceOffset + index));
    }

    static final class RuntimeBitmapBridge
    {
        private RuntimeBitmapBridge()
        {
        }

        static byte[] read(Bitmap bitmap, int x, int y, int width, int height, int elementSize)
        {
            int[] colors = new int[width * height];
            bitmap.getPixels(colors, 0, width, x, y, width, height);

            Bitmap.Config config = bitmap.getConfig();
            boolean premultiplied = bitmap.isPremultiplied();
            byte[] bytes = new byte[width * height * elementSize];

            for (int index = 0; index < colors.length; index++)
            {
                int color = colors[index];
                int alpha = color >>> 24;
                int red = (color >> 16) & 0xFF;
                int green = (color >> 8) & 0xFF;
                int blue = color & 0xFF;
                if (premultiplied && alpha != 0xFF)
                {
                    red = (red * alpha + 127) / 255;
                    green = (green * alpha + 127) / 255;
                    blue = (blue * alpha + 127) / 255;
                }

                int offset = index * elementSize;
                if (config == Bitmap.Config.ALPHA_8 || elementSize == 1)
                {
                    bytes[offset] = (byte) alpha;
                }
                else if (config == Bitmap.Config.RGB_565)
                {
                    int packed = ((red >> 3) << 11) | ((green >> 2) << 5) | (blue >> 3);
                    bytes[offset] = (byte) packed;
                    bytes[offset + 1] = (byte) (packed >> 8);
                }
                else if (config == Bitmap.Config.ARGB_4444)
                {
                    int packed = ((red >> 4) << 12) | ((green >> 4) << 8) | ((blue >> 4) << 4) | (alpha >> 4);
                    bytes[offset] = (byte) packed;
                    bytes[offset + 1] = (byte) (packed >> 8);
                }
                else if (config == Bitmap.Config.RGBA_F16 && elementSize == 8)
                {
                    putHalf(bytes, offset, red / 255.0f);
                    putHalf(bytes, offset + 2, green / 255.0f);
                    putHalf(bytes, offset + 4, blue / 255.0f);
                    putHalf(bytes, offset + 6, alpha / 255.0f);
                }
                else
                {
                    bytes[offset] = (byte) red;
                    if (elementSize > 1) bytes[offset + 1] = (byte) green;
                    if (elementSize > 2) bytes[offset + 2] = (byte) blue;
                    if (elementSize > 3) bytes[offset + 3] = (byte) alpha;
                }
            }

            return bytes;
        }

        static void write(Bitmap bitmap, int x, int y, int width, int height, int elementSize, byte[] bytes)
        {
            Bitmap.Config config = bitmap.getConfig();
            boolean premultiplied = bitmap.isPremultiplied();
            int[] colors = new int[width * height];

            for (int index = 0; index < colors.length; index++)
            {
                int offset = index * elementSize;
                int alpha;
                int red;
                int green;
                int blue;

                if (config == Bitmap.Config.ALPHA_8 || elementSize == 1)
                {
                    alpha = bytes[offset] & 0xFF;
                    red = 0;
                    green = 0;
                    blue = 0;
                }
                else if (config == Bitmap.Config.RGB_565)
                {
                    int packed = (bytes[offset] & 0xFF) | ((bytes[offset + 1] & 0xFF) << 8);
                    red = ((packed >> 11) & 0x1F) * 255 / 31;
                    green = ((packed >> 5) & 0x3F) * 255 / 63;
                    blue = (packed & 0x1F) * 255 / 31;
                    alpha = 0xFF;
                }
                else if (config == Bitmap.Config.ARGB_4444)
                {
                    int packed = (bytes[offset] & 0xFF) | ((bytes[offset + 1] & 0xFF) << 8);
                    red = ((packed >> 12) & 0xF) * 17;
                    green = ((packed >> 8) & 0xF) * 17;
                    blue = ((packed >> 4) & 0xF) * 17;
                    alpha = (packed & 0xF) * 17;
                }
                else if (config == Bitmap.Config.RGBA_F16 && elementSize == 8)
                {
                    red = channel(getHalf(bytes, offset));
                    green = channel(getHalf(bytes, offset + 2));
                    blue = channel(getHalf(bytes, offset + 4));
                    alpha = channel(getHalf(bytes, offset + 6));
                }
                else
                {
                    red = bytes[offset] & 0xFF;
                    green = elementSize > 1 ? bytes[offset + 1] & 0xFF : 0;
                    blue = elementSize > 2 ? bytes[offset + 2] & 0xFF : 0;
                    alpha = elementSize > 3 ? bytes[offset + 3] & 0xFF : 0xFF;
                }

                if (premultiplied && alpha != 0 && alpha != 0xFF)
                {
                    red = Math.min(255, (red * 255 + alpha / 2) / alpha);
                    green = Math.min(255, (green * 255 + alpha / 2) / alpha);
                    blue = Math.min(255, (blue * 255 + alpha / 2) / alpha);
                }
                else if (premultiplied && alpha == 0)
                {
                    red = 0;
                    green = 0;
                    blue = 0;
                }

                colors[index] = (alpha << 24) | (red << 16) | (green << 8) | blue;
            }

            bitmap.setPixels(colors, 0, width, x, y, width, height);
        }

        private static int channel(float value)
        {
            return Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(value * 255.0f)));
        }

        private static void putHalf(byte[] bytes, int offset, float value)
        {
            short half = Half.toHalf(value);
            bytes[offset] = (byte) half;
            bytes[offset + 1] = (byte) (half >> 8);
        }

        private static float getHalf(byte[] bytes, int offset)
        {
            short half = (short) ((bytes[offset] & 0xFF) | ((bytes[offset + 1] & 0xFF) << 8));
            return Half.toFloat(half);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/renderscript/BaseObj.java`:

```java
package android.renderscript;

public class BaseObj
{
    final RenderScript mRS;

    private final long mID;

    private String mName;
    private boolean mDestroyed;

    BaseObj(RenderScript rs)
    {
        if (rs != null) rs.validate();

        mRS = rs;
        mID = RenderScript.nextIdentifier();
    }

    long getID()
    {
        if (mDestroyed) throw new RSInvalidStateException("using a destroyed object.");
        return mID;
    }

    void checkValid()
    {
        if (mDestroyed) throw new RSInvalidStateException("using a destroyed object.");
        if (mRS != null) mRS.validate();
    }

    public void setName(String name)
    {
        if (name == null) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("setName requires a string of non-zero length.");
        if (name.length() < 1) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("setName does not accept a zero length string.");
        if (mName != null) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("setName object already has a name.");

        mName = name;
    }

    public String getName()
    {
        return mName;
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        mDestroyed = true;
        super.finalize();
    }

    public void destroy()
    {
        if (mDestroyed) throw new RSInvalidStateException("Object already destroyed.");
        mDestroyed = true;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return (int) ((mID & 0xFFFFFFFL) ^ (mID >> 32));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (other == null || getClass() != other.getClass()) return false;

        return mID == ((BaseObj) other).mID;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.renderscript;

public class Element extends BaseObj
{
    private static final String PADDING_PREFIX = "#padding_";

    final DataType mType;
    final DataKind mKind;
    final boolean mNormalized;
    final int mVectorSize;
    final int mSize;

    final Element[] mElements;
    final String[] mElementNames;
    final int[] mArraySizes;
    final int[] mOffsetInBytes;

    public enum DataType
    {
        NONE(0, 0),
        FLOAT_16(1, 2),
        FLOAT_32(2, 4),
        FLOAT_64(3, 8),
        SIGNED_8(4, 1),
        SIGNED_16(5, 2),
        SIGNED_32(6, 4),
        SIGNED_64(7, 8),
        UNSIGNED_8(8, 1),
        UNSIGNED_16(9, 2),
        UNSIGNED_32(10, 4),
        UNSIGNED_64(11, 8),
        BOOLEAN(12, 1),
        UNSIGNED_5_6_5(13, 2),
        UNSIGNED_5_5_5_1(14, 2),
        UNSIGNED_4_4_4_4(15, 2),
        MATRIX_4X4(16, 64),
        MATRIX_3X3(17, 36),
        MATRIX_2X2(18, 16),
        RS_ELEMENT(1000, 32),
        RS_TYPE(1001, 32),
        RS_ALLOCATION(1002, 32),
        RS_SAMPLER(1003, 32),
        RS_SCRIPT(1004, 32),
        RS_MESH(1005, 32),
        RS_PROGRAM_FRAGMENT(1006, 32),
        RS_PROGRAM_VERTEX(1007, 32),
        RS_PROGRAM_RASTER(1008, 32),
        RS_PROGRAM_STORE(1009, 32),
        RS_FONT(1010, 32);

        final int mID;
        final int mSize;

        DataType(int id, int size)
        {
            mID = id;
            mSize = size;
        }
    }

    public enum DataKind
    {
        USER(0),
        PIXEL_L(7),
        PIXEL_A(8),
        PIXEL_LA(9),
        PIXEL_RGB(10),
        PIXEL_RGBA(11),
        PIXEL_DEPTH(12),
        PIXEL_YUV(13);

        final int mID;

        DataKind(int id)
        {
            mID = id;
        }
    }

    Element(RenderScript rs, DataType dataType, DataKind dataKind, boolean normalized, int vectorSize)
    {
        super(rs);

        if (dataType != DataType.UNSIGNED_5_6_5 && dataType != DataType.UNSIGNED_4_4_4_4 && dataType != DataType.UNSIGNED_5_5_5_1)
        {
            mSize = vectorSize == 3 ? dataType.mSize * 4 : dataType.mSize * vectorSize;
        }
        else
        {
            mSize = dataType.mSize;
        }

        mType = dataType;
        mKind = dataKind;
        mNormalized = normalized;
        mVectorSize = vectorSize;
        mElements = null;
        mElementNames = null;
        mArraySizes = null;
        mOffsetInBytes = null;
    }

    Element(RenderScript rs, Element[] elements, String[] elementNames, int[] arraySizes)
    {
        super(rs);

        mType = DataType.NONE;
        mKind = DataKind.USER;
        mNormalized = false;
        mVectorSize = 1;
        mElements = elements;
        mElementNames = elementNames;
        mArraySizes = arraySizes;
        mOffsetInBytes = new int[elements.length];

        int size = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < elements.length; index++)
        {
            mOffsetInBytes[index] = size;
            size += elements[index].mSize * arraySizes[index];
        }
        mSize = size;
    }

    public int getBytesSize()
    {
        return mSize;
    }

    public int getVectorSize()
    {
        return mVectorSize;
    }

    public boolean isComplex()
    {
        if (mElements == null) return false;

        for (Element element : mElements)
        {
            if (element.mElements != null) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public int getSubElementCount()
    {
        return mElements == null ? 0 : mElements.length;
    }

    public Element getSubElement(int index)
    {
        checkSubElementIndex(index);
        return mElements[index];
    }

    public String getSubElementName(int index)
    {
        checkSubElementIndex(index);
        return mElementNames[index];
    }

    public int getSubElementArraySize(int index)
    {
        checkSubElementIndex(index);
        return mArraySizes[index];
    }

    public int getSubElementOffsetBytes(int index)
    {
        checkSubElementIndex(index);
        return mOffsetInBytes[index];
    }

    private void checkSubElementIndex(int index)
    {
        if (mElements == null) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Element contains no sub-elements");
        if (index < 0 || index >= mElements.length) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Illegal sub-element index");
    }

    public DataType getDataType()
    {
        return mType;
    }

    public DataKind getDataKind()
    {
        return mKind;
    }

    private static Element user(RenderScript rs, DataType dataType)
    {
        String key = "user:" + dataType.name();
        Element cached = rs.cachedElement(key);
        if (cached != null) return cached;

        return rs.cacheElement(key, new Element(rs, dataType, DataKind.USER, false, 1));
    }

    private static Element vector(RenderScript rs, DataType dataType, int size)
    {
        String key = "vector:" + dataType.name() + ":" + size;
        Element cached = rs.cachedElement(key);
        if (cached != null) return cached;

        return rs.cacheElement(key, createVector(rs, dataType, size));
    }

    private static Element pixel(RenderScript rs, DataType dataType, DataKind dataKind)
    {
        String key = "pixel:" + dataType.name() + ":" + dataKind.name();
        Element cached = rs.cachedElement(key);
        if (cached != null) return cached;

        return rs.cacheElement(key, createPixel(rs, dataType, dataKind));
    }

    public static Element createVector(RenderScript rs, DataType dataType, int size)
    {
        if (size < 2 || size > 4) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Vector size out of range 2-4.");

        switch (dataType)
        {
            case FLOAT_16:
            case FLOAT_32:
            case FLOAT_64:
            case SIGNED_8:
            case SIGNED_16:
            case SIGNED_32:
            case SIGNED_64:
            case UNSIGNED_8:
            case UNSIGNED_16:
            case UNSIGNED_32:
            case UNSIGNED_64:
            case BOOLEAN:
                return new Element(rs, dataType, DataKind.USER, false, size);
            default:
                throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Cannot create vector of non-primitive type.");
        }
    }

    public static Element createPixel(RenderScript rs, DataType dataType, DataKind dataKind)
    {
        if (!(dataKind == DataKind.PIXEL_L || dataKind == DataKind.PIXEL_A || dataKind == DataKind.PIXEL_LA
                || dataKind == DataKind.PIXEL_RGB || dataKind == DataKind.PIXEL_RGBA || dataKind == DataKind.PIXEL_DEPTH
                || dataKind == DataKind.PIXEL_YUV))
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Unsupported DataKind");
        }
        if (!(dataType == DataType.UNSIGNED_8 || dataType == DataType.UNSIGNED_16 || dataType == DataType.UNSIGNED_5_6_5
                || dataType == DataType.UNSIGNED_4_4_4_4 || dataType == DataType.UNSIGNED_5_5_5_1))
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Unsupported DataType");
        }
        if (dataType == DataType.UNSIGNED_5_6_5 && dataKind != DataKind.PIXEL_RGB)
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Bad kind and type combo");
        }
        if (dataType == DataType.UNSIGNED_5_5_5_1 && dataKind != DataKind.PIXEL_RGBA)
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Bad kind and type combo");
        }
        if (dataType == DataType.UNSIGNED_4_4_4_4 && dataKind != DataKind.PIXEL_RGBA)
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Bad kind and type combo");
        }
        if (dataType == DataType.UNSIGNED_16 && dataKind != DataKind.PIXEL_DEPTH)
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Bad kind and type combo");
        }

        int size = 1;
        switch (dataKind)
        {
            case PIXEL_LA:
                size = 2;
                break;
            case PIXEL_RGB:
                size = 3;
                break;
            case PIXEL_RGBA:
                size = 4;
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }

        return new Element(rs, dataType, dataKind, true, size);
    }

    public boolean isCompatible(Element element)
    {
        if (equals(element)) return true;
        if (element == null) return false;

        return mSize == element.mSize && mType != DataType.NONE && mType == element.mType && mVectorSize == element.mVectorSize;
    }

    public static class Builder
    {
        private final RenderScript mRS;

        private Element[] mElements = new Element[8];
        private String[] mElementNames = new String[8];
        private int[] mArraySizes = new int[8];
        private int mCount;
        private boolean mSkipPadding;

        public Builder(RenderScript rs)
        {
            mRS = rs;
        }

        public Builder add(Element element, String name, int arraySize)
        {
            if (arraySize < 1) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Array size cannot be less than 1.");

            if (mSkipPadding && name.startsWith(PADDING_PREFIX))
            {
                mSkipPadding = false;
                return this;
            }
            mSkipPadding = element.mVectorSize == 3;

            if (mCount == mElements.length)
            {
                Element[] elements = new Element[mCount + 8];
                String[] names = new String[mCount + 8];
                int[] arraySizes = new int[mCount + 8];
                System.arraycopy(mElements, 0, elements, 0, mCount);
                System.arraycopy(mElementNames, 0, names, 0, mCount);
                System.arraycopy(mArraySizes, 0, arraySizes, 0, mCount);
                mElements = elements;
                mElementNames = names;
                mArraySizes = arraySizes;
            }

            mElements[mCount] = element;
            mElementNames[mCount] = name;
            mArraySizes[mCount] = arraySize;
            mCount++;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder add(Element element, String name)
        {
            return add(element, name, 1);
        }

        public Element create()
        {
            mRS.validate();

            Element[] elements = new Element[mCount];
            String[] names = new String[mCount];
            int[] arraySizes = new int[mCount];
            System.arraycopy(mElements, 0, elements, 0, mCount);
            System.arraycopy(mElementNames, 0, names, 0, mCount);
            System.arraycopy(mArraySizes, 0, arraySizes, 0, mCount);
            return new Element(mRS, elements, names, arraySizes);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.renderscript;

import java.util.BitSet;

public class FieldPacker
{
    private final byte[] mData;
    private final int mLen;
    private final BitSet mAlignment;

    private int mPos;

    public FieldPacker(int len)
    {
        mPos = 0;
        mLen = len;
        mData = new byte[len];
        mAlignment = new BitSet();
    }

    public FieldPacker(byte[] data)
    {
        mPos = data.length;
        mLen = data.length;
        mData = data;
        mAlignment = new BitSet();
    }

    public void align(int v)
    {
        if (v <= 0 || (v & (v - 1)) != 0)
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("argument must be a non-negative non-zero power of 2: " + v);
        }

        while ((mPos & (v - 1)) != 0)
        {
            mAlignment.flip(mPos);
            mData[mPos++] = 0;
        }
    }

    public void subalign(int v)
    {
        if ((v & (v - 1)) != 0)
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("argument must be a non-negative non-zero power of 2: " + v);
        }

        while ((mPos & (v - 1)) != 0) mPos--;

        if (mPos > 0)
        {
            while (mAlignment.get(mPos - 1))
            {
                mPos--;
                mAlignment.flip(mPos);
            }
        }
    }

    public void reset()
    {
        mPos = 0;
    }

    public void reset(int i)
    {
        if (i < 0 || i > mLen) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("out of range argument: " + i);
        mPos = i;
    }

    public void skip(int i)
    {
        int position = mPos + i;
        if (position < 0 || position > mLen) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("out of range argument: " + i);
        mPos = position;
    }

    public void addI8(byte v)
    {
        mData[mPos++] = v;
    }

    public byte subI8()
    {
        subalign(1);
        return mData[--mPos];
    }

    public void addI16(short v)
    {
        align(2);
        mData[mPos++] = (byte) (v & 0xFF);
        mData[mPos++] = (byte) (v >> 8);
    }

    public short subI16()
    {
        subalign(2);
        int value = (mData[--mPos] & 0xFF) << 8;
        value |= mData[--mPos] & 0xFF;
        return (short) value;
    }

    public void addI32(int v)
    {
        align(4);
        mData[mPos++] = (byte) (v & 0xFF);
        mData[mPos++] = (byte) ((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
        mData[mPos++] = (byte) ((v >> 16) & 0xFF);
        mData[mPos++] = (byte) ((v >> 24) & 0xFF);
    }

    public int subI32()
    {
        subalign(4);
        int value = (mData[--mPos] & 0xFF) << 24;
        value |= (mData[--mPos] & 0xFF) << 16;
        value |= (mData[--mPos] & 0xFF) << 8;
        value |= mData[--mPos] & 0xFF;
        return value;
    }

    public void addI64(long v)
    {
        align(8);
        for (int shift = 0; shift < 64; shift += 8) mData[mPos++] = (byte) ((v >> shift) & 0xFF);
    }

    public long subI64()
    {
        subalign(8);
        long value = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < 8; index++) value = (value << 8) | (mData[--mPos] & 0xFFL);
        return value;
    }

    public void addU8(short v)
    {
        if (v < 0 || v > 0xFF) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Saving value out of range for type");
        mData[mPos++] = (byte) v;
    }

    public void addU16(int v)
    {
        if (v < 0 || v > 0xFFFF) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Saving value out of range for type");

        align(2);
        mData[mPos++] = (byte) (v & 0xFF);
        mData[mPos++] = (byte) (v >> 8);
    }

    public void addU32(long v)
    {
        if (v < 0 || v > 0xFFFFFFFFL) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Saving value out of range for type");

        align(4);
        mData[mPos++] = (byte) (v & 0xFF);
        mData[mPos++] = (byte) ((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
        mData[mPos++] = (byte) ((v >> 16) & 0xFF);
        mData[mPos++] = (byte) ((v >> 24) & 0xFF);
    }

    public void addU64(long v)
    {
        if (v < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Saving value out of range for type");
        addI64(v);
    }

    public void addF32(float v)
    {
        addI32(Float.floatToRawIntBits(v));
    }

    public float subF32()
    {
        return Float.intBitsToFloat(subI32());
    }

    public void addF64(double v)
    {
        addI64(Double.doubleToRawLongBits(v));
    }

    public double subF64()
    {
        return Double.longBitsToDouble(subI64());
    }

    public void addObj(BaseObj obj)
    {
        addI64(obj == null ? 0 : obj.getID());
        addI64(0);
        addI64(0);
        addI64(0);
    }
```

`java/android/renderscript/Matrix2f.java`:

```java
package android.renderscript;

public class Matrix2f
{
    final float[] mMat;

    public Matrix2f()
    {
        mMat = new float[4];
        loadIdentity();
    }

    public Matrix2f(float[] dataArray)
    {
        mMat = new float[4];
        System.arraycopy(dataArray, 0, mMat, 0, mMat.length);
    }

    public float[] getArray()
    {
        return mMat;
    }

    public float get(int x, int y)
    {
        return mMat[x * 2 + y];
    }

    public void set(int x, int y, float value)
    {
        mMat[x * 2 + y] = value;
    }

    public void loadIdentity()
    {
        mMat[0] = 1;
        mMat[1] = 0;
        mMat[2] = 0;
        mMat[3] = 1;
    }

    public void load(Matrix2f src)
    {
        System.arraycopy(src.getArray(), 0, mMat, 0, mMat.length);
    }

    public void loadRotate(float rot)
    {
        double radians = rot * (Math.PI / 180.0f);
        float cosine = (float) Math.cos(radians);
        float sine = (float) Math.sin(radians);
        mMat[0] = cosine;
        mMat[1] = -sine;
        mMat[2] = sine;
        mMat[3] = cosine;
    }

    public void loadScale(float x, float y)
    {
        loadIdentity();
        mMat[0] = x;
        mMat[3] = y;
    }

    public void loadMultiply(Matrix2f lhs, Matrix2f rhs)
    {
        float[] result = new float[4];
        for (int column = 0; column < 2; column++)
        {
            for (int row = 0; row < 2; row++)
            {
                result[column * 2 + row] = lhs.get(0, row) * rhs.get(column, 0) + lhs.get(1, row) * rhs.get(column, 1);
            }
        }
        System.arraycopy(result, 0, mMat, 0, 4);
    }

    public void multiply(Matrix2f rhs)
    {
        loadMultiply(this, rhs);
    }

    public void rotate(float rot)
    {
        Matrix2f rotation = new Matrix2f();
        rotation.loadRotate(rot);
        multiply(rotation);
    }

    public void scale(float x, float y)
    {
        Matrix2f scaling = new Matrix2f();
        scaling.loadScale(x, y);
        multiply(scaling);
    }

    public void transpose()
    {
        float temporary = mMat[1];
        mMat[1] = mMat[2];
        mMat[2] = temporary;
    }
}
```

`java/android/renderscript/Matrix3f.java`:

```java
package android.renderscript;

public class Matrix3f
{
    final float[] mMat;

    public Matrix3f()
    {
        mMat = new float[9];
        loadIdentity();
    }

    public Matrix3f(float[] dataArray)
    {
        mMat = new float[9];
        System.arraycopy(dataArray, 0, mMat, 0, mMat.length);
    }

    public float[] getArray()
    {
        return mMat;
    }

    public float get(int x, int y)
    {
        return mMat[x * 3 + y];
    }

    public void set(int x, int y, float value)
    {
        mMat[x * 3 + y] = value;
    }

    public void loadIdentity()
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < 9; index++) mMat[index] = index % 4 == 0 ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    }

    public void load(Matrix3f src)
    {
        System.arraycopy(src.getArray(), 0, mMat, 0, mMat.length);
    }

    public void loadRotate(float rot, float x, float y, float z)
    {
        float[] rotation = new float[16];
        android.opengl.Matrix.setRotateM(rotation, 0, rot, x, y, z);
        for (int column = 0; column < 3; column++)
        {
            for (int row = 0; row < 3; row++) mMat[column * 3 + row] = rotation[column * 4 + row];
        }
    }

    public void loadRotate(float rot)
    {
        loadIdentity();
        double radians = rot * (Math.PI / 180.0f);
        float cosine = (float) Math.cos(radians);
        float sine = (float) Math.sin(radians);
        mMat[0] = cosine;
        mMat[1] = -sine;
        mMat[3] = sine;
        mMat[4] = cosine;
    }

    public void loadScale(float x, float y)
    {
        loadIdentity();
        mMat[0] = x;
        mMat[4] = y;
    }

    public void loadScale(float x, float y, float z)
    {
        loadIdentity();
        mMat[0] = x;
        mMat[4] = y;
        mMat[8] = z;
    }

    public void loadTranslate(float x, float y)
    {
        loadIdentity();
        mMat[6] = x;
        mMat[7] = y;
    }

    public void loadMultiply(Matrix3f lhs, Matrix3f rhs)
    {
        float[] result = new float[9];
        for (int column = 0; column < 3; column++)
        {
            for (int row = 0; row < 3; row++)
            {
                float sum = 0;
                for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++) sum += lhs.get(index, row) * rhs.get(column, index);
                result[column * 3 + row] = sum;
            }
        }
        System.arraycopy(result, 0, mMat, 0, 9);
    }

    public void multiply(Matrix3f rhs)
    {
        loadMultiply(this, rhs);
    }

    public void rotate(float rot, float x, float y, float z)
    {
        Matrix3f rotation = new Matrix3f();
        rotation.loadRotate(rot, x, y, z);
        multiply(rotation);
    }

    public void rotate(float rot)
    {
        Matrix3f rotation = new Matrix3f();
        rotation.loadRotate(rot);
        multiply(rotation);
    }

    public void scale(float x, float y)
    {
        Matrix3f scaling = new Matrix3f();
        scaling.loadScale(x, y);
        multiply(scaling);
    }

    public void scale(float x, float y, float z)
    {
        Matrix3f scaling = new Matrix3f();
        scaling.loadScale(x, y, z);
        multiply(scaling);
    }

    public void translate(float x, float y)
    {
        Matrix3f translation = new Matrix3f();
        translation.loadTranslate(x, y);
        multiply(translation);
    }

    public void transpose()
    {
        for (int column = 0; column < 2; column++)
        {
            for (int row = column + 1; row < 3; row++)
            {
                float temporary = mMat[column * 3 + row];
                mMat[column * 3 + row] = mMat[row * 3 + column];
                mMat[row * 3 + column] = temporary;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/renderscript/Matrix4f.java`:

```java
package android.renderscript;

public class Matrix4f
{
    final float[] mMat;

    public Matrix4f()
    {
        mMat = new float[16];
        loadIdentity();
    }

    public Matrix4f(float[] dataArray)
    {
        mMat = new float[16];
        System.arraycopy(dataArray, 0, mMat, 0, mMat.length);
    }

    public float[] getArray()
    {
        return mMat;
    }

    public float get(int x, int y)
    {
        return mMat[x * 4 + y];
    }

    public void set(int x, int y, float value)
    {
        mMat[x * 4 + y] = value;
    }

    public void loadIdentity()
    {
        android.opengl.Matrix.setIdentityM(mMat, 0);
    }

    public void load(Matrix4f src)
    {
        System.arraycopy(src.getArray(), 0, mMat, 0, mMat.length);
    }

    public void loadRotate(float rot, float x, float y, float z)
    {
        android.opengl.Matrix.setRotateM(mMat, 0, rot, x, y, z);
    }

    public void loadScale(float x, float y, float z)
    {
        loadIdentity();
        mMat[0] = x;
        mMat[5] = y;
        mMat[10] = z;
    }

    public void loadTranslate(float x, float y, float z)
    {
        loadIdentity();
        mMat[12] = x;
        mMat[13] = y;
        mMat[14] = z;
    }

    public void loadMultiply(Matrix4f lhs, Matrix4f rhs)
    {
        android.opengl.Matrix.multiplyMM(mMat, 0, lhs.mMat, 0, rhs.mMat, 0);
    }

    public void loadOrtho(float left, float right, float bottom, float top, float near, float far)
    {
        loadIdentity();
        mMat[0] = 2 / (right - left);
        mMat[5] = 2 / (top - bottom);
        mMat[10] = -2 / (far - near);
        mMat[12] = -(right + left) / (right - left);
        mMat[13] = -(top + bottom) / (top - bottom);
        mMat[14] = -(far + near) / (far - near);
    }

    public void loadOrthoWindow(int w, int h)
    {
        loadOrtho(0, w, h, 0, -1, 1);
    }

    public void loadFrustum(float left, float right, float bottom, float top, float near, float far)
    {
        loadIdentity();
        mMat[0] = 2 * near / (right - left);
        mMat[5] = 2 * near / (top - bottom);
        mMat[8] = (right + left) / (right - left);
        mMat[9] = (top + bottom) / (top - bottom);
        mMat[10] = -(far + near) / (far - near);
        mMat[11] = -1;
        mMat[14] = -2 * far * near / (far - near);
        mMat[15] = 0;
    }

    public void loadPerspective(float fovy, float aspect, float near, float far)
    {
        float top = near * (float) Math.tan((float) (fovy * Math.PI / 360.0f));
        float bottom = -top;
        float left = bottom * aspect;
        float right = top * aspect;
        loadFrustum(left, right, bottom, top, near, far);
    }

    public void loadProjectionNormalized(int w, int h)
    {
        Matrix4f projection = new Matrix4f();
        Matrix4f step = new Matrix4f();

        if (w > h)
        {
            float aspect = ((float) w) / h;
            projection.loadFrustum(-aspect, aspect, -1, 1, 1, 100);
        }
        else
        {
            float aspect = ((float) h) / w;
            projection.loadFrustum(-1, 1, -aspect, aspect, 1, 100);
        }

        step.loadRotate(180, 0, 1, 0);
        projection.loadMultiply(projection, step);

        step.loadScale(-2, 2, 1);
        projection.loadMultiply(projection, step);

        step.loadTranslate(0, 0, 2);
        projection.loadMultiply(projection, step);

        load(projection);
    }

    public void multiply(Matrix4f rhs)
    {
        loadMultiply(this, rhs);
    }

    public void rotate(float rot, float x, float y, float z)
    {
        Matrix4f rotation = new Matrix4f();
        rotation.loadRotate(rot, x, y, z);
        multiply(rotation);
    }

    public void scale(float x, float y, float z)
    {
        Matrix4f scaling = new Matrix4f();
        scaling.loadScale(x, y, z);
        multiply(scaling);
    }

    public void translate(float x, float y, float z)
    {
        Matrix4f translation = new Matrix4f();
        translation.loadTranslate(x, y, z);
        multiply(translation);
    }

    public boolean inverse()
    {
        float[] result = new float[16];
        if (!android.opengl.Matrix.invertM(result, 0, mMat, 0)) return false;

        System.arraycopy(result, 0, mMat, 0, 16);
        return true;
    }

    public boolean inverseTranspose()
    {
        if (!inverse()) return false;

        transpose();
        return true;
    }

    public void transpose()
    {
        for (int column = 0; column < 3; column++)
        {
            for (int row = column + 1; row < 4; row++)
            {
                float temporary = mMat[column * 4 + row];
                mMat[column * 4 + row] = mMat[row * 4 + column];
                mMat[row * 4 + column] = temporary;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/renderscript/RenderScript.java`:

```java
package android.renderscript;

import android.content.Context;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class RenderScript
{
    public static final int CREATE_FLAG_NONE = 0x0000;
    public static final int CREATE_FLAG_LOW_LATENCY = 0x0002;
    public static final int CREATE_FLAG_LOW_POWER = 0x0004;

    private static final int CREATE_FLAG_WAIT_FOR_ATTACH = 0x0008;
    private static final int CREATE_FLAG_OPT_LEVEL_0 = 0x0010;
    private static final int CREATE_FLAG_ANY = CREATE_FLAG_LOW_LATENCY | CREATE_FLAG_LOW_POWER | CREATE_FLAG_WAIT_FOR_ATTACH
            | CREATE_FLAG_OPT_LEVEL_0;

    private static final ArrayList<RenderScript> sContexts = new ArrayList<>();

    private static long sNextIdentifier = 1;

    private final Context mApplicationContext;
    private final ContextType mContextType;
    private final int mCreateFlags;
    private final Map<String, Element> mElements = new HashMap<>();

    private RSMessageHandler mMessageCallback;
    private RSErrorHandler mErrorCallback;
    private Priority mPriority = Priority.NORMAL;
    private boolean mDestroyed;

    public enum ContextType
    {
        NORMAL,
        DEBUG,
        PROFILE
    }

    public enum Priority
    {
        LOW,
        NORMAL
    }

    public static class RSMessageHandler implements Runnable
    {
        protected int[] mData;
        protected int mID;
        protected int mLength;

        public RSMessageHandler()
        {
        }

        @Override
        public void run()
        {
        }
    }

    public static class RSErrorHandler implements Runnable
    {
        protected String mErrorMessage;
        protected int mErrorNum;

        public RSErrorHandler()
        {
        }

        @Override
        public void run()
        {
        }
    }

    RenderScript(Context context, ContextType contextType, int createFlags)
    {
        Context applicationContext = context == null ? null : context.getApplicationContext();
        mApplicationContext = applicationContext != null ? applicationContext : context;
        mContextType = contextType;
        mCreateFlags = createFlags;
    }

    public static long getMinorVersion()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public void setMessageHandler(RSMessageHandler messageHandler)
    {
        mMessageCallback = messageHandler;
    }

    public RSMessageHandler getMessageHandler()
    {
        return mMessageCallback;
    }

    public void sendMessage(int id, int[] data)
    {
        validate();
    }

    public void setErrorHandler(RSErrorHandler errorHandler)
    {
        mErrorCallback = errorHandler;
    }

    public RSErrorHandler getErrorHandler()
    {
        return mErrorCallback;
    }

    public void setPriority(Priority priority)
    {
        validate();
        if (priority == null) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("priority == null");
        mPriority = priority;
    }

    public final Context getApplicationContext()
    {
        return mApplicationContext;
    }

    public static RenderScript create(Context context)
    {
        return create(context, ContextType.NORMAL);
    }

    public static RenderScript create(Context context, ContextType contextType)
    {
        return create(context, contextType, CREATE_FLAG_NONE);
    }

    public static RenderScript create(Context context, ContextType contextType, int flags)
    {
        if ((flags & ~CREATE_FLAG_ANY) != 0) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Invalid flags passed.");

        RenderScript renderScript = new RenderScript(context, contextType, flags);
        synchronized (sContexts)
        {
            sContexts.add(renderScript);
        }
        return renderScript;
    }

    public static void releaseAllContexts()
    {
        ArrayList<RenderScript> contexts;
        synchronized (sContexts)
        {
            contexts = new ArrayList<>(sContexts);
            sContexts.clear();
        }

        for (RenderScript renderScript : contexts) renderScript.destroy();
    }

    public static RenderScript createMultiContext(Context context, ContextType contextType, int flags, int api)
    {
        return create(context, contextType, flags);
    }

    public void contextDump()
    {
        validate();
    }

    public void finish()
    {
        validate();
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        mDestroyed = true;
        super.finalize();
    }

    public void destroy()
    {
        if (mDestroyed) return;

        validate();
        mDestroyed = true;
        synchronized (sContexts)
        {
            sContexts.remove(this);
        }
    }

    void validate()
    {
        if (mDestroyed) throw new RSInvalidStateException("Calling RS with no Context active.");
    }

    static synchronized long nextIdentifier()
    {
        return sNextIdentifier++;
    }

    synchronized Element cachedElement(String name)
    {
        return mElements.get(name);
    }

    synchronized Element cacheElement(String name, Element element)
    {
        Element existing = mElements.get(name);
        if (existing != null) return existing;

        mElements.put(name, element);
        return element;
    }

    ContextType getContextType()
    {
        return mContextType;
    }

    int getCreateFlags()
    {
        return mCreateFlags;
    }

    Priority getPriority()
    {
        return mPriority;
    }
}

```

`java/android/renderscript/Script.java`:

```java
package android.renderscript;

import android.util.SparseArray;

public class Script extends BaseObj
{
    private final SparseArray<KernelID> mKernelIDs = new SparseArray<>();
    private final SparseArray<InvokeID> mInvokeIDs = new SparseArray<>();
    private final SparseArray<FieldID> mFieldIDs = new SparseArray<>();
    private final SparseArray<Object> mVariables = new SparseArray<>();

    private String mTimeZone;

    Script(RenderScript rs)
    {
        super(rs);
    }

    public static final class KernelID extends BaseObj
    {
        final Script mScript;
        final int mSlot;
        final int mSignature;

        KernelID(RenderScript rs, Script script, int slot, int signature)
        {
            super(rs);
            mScript = script;
            mSlot = slot;
            mSignature = signature;
        }
    }

    public static final class InvokeID extends BaseObj
    {
        final Script mScript;
        final int mSlot;

        InvokeID(RenderScript rs, Script script, int slot)
        {
            super(rs);
            mScript = script;
            mSlot = slot;
        }
    }

    public static final class FieldID extends BaseObj
    {
        final Script mScript;
        final int mSlot;

        FieldID(RenderScript rs, Script script, int slot)
        {
            super(rs);
            mScript = script;
            mSlot = slot;
        }
    }

    public static final class LaunchOptions
    {
        private int mXStart;
        private int mXEnd;
        private int mYStart;
        private int mYEnd;
        private int mZStart;
        private int mZEnd;

        public LaunchOptions()
        {
        }

        public LaunchOptions setX(int xstartArg, int xendArg)
        {
            if (xstartArg < 0 || xendArg <= xstartArg) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Invalid dimensions");
            mXStart = xstartArg;
            mXEnd = xendArg;
            return this;
        }

        public LaunchOptions setY(int ystartArg, int yendArg)
        {
            if (ystartArg < 0 || yendArg <= ystartArg) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Invalid dimensions");
            mYStart = ystartArg;
            mYEnd = yendArg;
            return this;
        }

        public LaunchOptions setZ(int zstartArg, int zendArg)
        {
            if (zstartArg < 0 || zendArg <= zstartArg) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Invalid dimensions");
            mZStart = zstartArg;
            mZEnd = zendArg;
            return this;
        }

        public int getXStart()
        {
            return mXStart;
        }

        public int getXEnd()
        {
            return mXEnd;
        }

        public int getYStart()
        {
            return mYStart;
        }

        public int getYEnd()
        {
            return mYEnd;
        }

        public int getZStart()
        {
            return mZStart;
        }

        public int getZEnd()
        {
            return mZEnd;
        }
    }

    public static class Builder
    {
        final RenderScript mRS;

        Builder(RenderScript rs)
        {
            mRS = rs;
        }
    }

    public static class FieldBase
    {
        protected Element mElement;
        protected Allocation mAllocation;

        protected FieldBase()
        {
        }

        protected void init(RenderScript rs, int dimx)
        {
            mAllocation = Allocation.createSized(rs, mElement, dimx, Allocation.USAGE_SCRIPT);
        }

        protected void init(RenderScript rs, int dimx, int usages)
        {
            mAllocation = Allocation.createSized(rs, mElement, dimx, Allocation.USAGE_SCRIPT | usages);
        }

        public Element getElement()
        {
            return mElement;
        }

        public Type getType()
        {
            return mAllocation.getType();
        }

        public Allocation getAllocation()
        {
            return mAllocation;
        }

        public void updateAllocation()
        {
        }
    }

    protected KernelID createKernelID(int slot, int sig, Element ein, Element eout)
    {
        KernelID kernelId = mKernelIDs.get(slot);
        if (kernelId != null) return kernelId;

        kernelId = new KernelID(mRS, this, slot, sig);
        mKernelIDs.put(slot, kernelId);
        return kernelId;
    }

    protected InvokeID createInvokeID(int slot)
    {
        InvokeID invokeId = mInvokeIDs.get(slot);
        if (invokeId != null) return invokeId;

        invokeId = new InvokeID(mRS, this, slot);
        mInvokeIDs.put(slot, invokeId);
        return invokeId;
    }

    protected FieldID createFieldID(int slot, Element e)
    {
        FieldID fieldId = mFieldIDs.get(slot);
        if (fieldId != null) return fieldId;

        fieldId = new FieldID(mRS, this, slot);
        mFieldIDs.put(slot, fieldId);
        return fieldId;
    }

    protected void invoke(int slot)
    {
        checkValid();
    }

    protected void invoke(int slot, FieldPacker v)
    {
        checkValid();
    }

    protected void forEach(int slot, Allocation ain, Allocation aout, FieldPacker v)
    {
        forEach(slot, ain, aout, v, null);
    }

    protected void forEach(int slot, Allocation ain, Allocation aout, FieldPacker v, LaunchOptions sc)
    {
        checkValid();
        if (ain == null && aout == null && sc == null)
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException(
                    "At least one of input allocation, output allocation, or LaunchOptions is required to be non-null.");
        }
    }

    protected void forEach(int slot, Allocation[] ains, Allocation aout, FieldPacker v)
    {
        forEach(slot, ains, aout, v, null);
    }

    protected void forEach(int slot, Allocation[] ains, Allocation aout, FieldPacker v, LaunchOptions sc)
    {
        checkValid();
        if (ains == null && aout == null) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("At least one of ain or aout is required to be non-null.");
    }

    protected void reduce(int slot, Allocation[] ains, Allocation aout, LaunchOptions sc)
    {
        checkValid();
        if (ains == null || ains.length < 1) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("At least one input is required.");
        if (aout == null) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("aout is required to be non-null.");
    }

    public void bindAllocation(Allocation va, int slot)
    {
        checkValid();
        mVariables.put(slot, va);
    }

        mVariables.put(index, v);

    {

    }

    public void setVar(int index, FieldPacker v, Element e, int[] dims)
    {
        if (e == null || dims == null) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Element and dims must be non-null");
        mVariables.put(index, v.getData().clone());
    }

    public void getVarV(int index, FieldPacker v)
    {
        Object value = mVariables.get(index);
        if (!(value instanceof byte[])) return;

        byte[] stored = (byte[]) value;
        byte[] target = v.getData();
        System.arraycopy(stored, 0, target, 0, Math.min(stored.length, target.length));
    }

    public void setTimeZone(String timeZone)
    {
        checkValid();
        if (timeZone == null) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("timeZone must be non-null");
        mTimeZone = timeZone;
    }
```

```java
package android.renderscript;

import java.nio.ByteBuffer;

public final class ScriptIntrinsicBlur extends ScriptIntrinsic
{
    private static final int KERNEL_SLOT = 0;
    private static final int RADIUS_SLOT = 0;
    private static final int INPUT_SLOT = 1;

    private final Element mElement;

    private float mRadius = 5.0f;
    private Allocation mInput;

    private ScriptIntrinsicBlur(RenderScript rs, Element element)
    {
        super(rs);
        mElement = element;
    }

    public static ScriptIntrinsicBlur create(RenderScript rs, Element e)
    {
        if (!e.isCompatible(Element.U8_4(rs)) && !e.isCompatible(Element.U8(rs)))
        {
            throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Unsupported element type.");
        }

        ScriptIntrinsicBlur blur = new ScriptIntrinsicBlur(rs, e);
        blur.setRadius(5.0f);
        return blur;
    }

    public void setInput(Allocation ain)
    {
        if (ain.getType().getY() == 0) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Input set to a 1D Allocation");

        mInput = ain;
        setVar(INPUT_SLOT, ain);
    }

    public void setRadius(float radius)
    {
        if (radius <= 0 || radius > 25) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Radius out of range (0 < r <= 25).");

        mRadius = radius;
        setVar(RADIUS_SLOT, radius);
    }

    public void forEach(Allocation aout)
    {
        forEach(aout, null);
    }

    public void forEach(Allocation aout, Script.LaunchOptions opt)
    {
        if (aout.getType().getY() == 0) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Output is a 1D Allocation");
        checkValid();
        if (mInput == null) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Input is required to be set before forEach.");

        int channels = mInput.elementSize();
        if (channels != 1 && channels != 4) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Unsupported element type.");
        if (aout.elementSize() != channels) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Input and output element types must match.");

        int inputWidth = mInput.getType().getX();
        int inputHeight = mInput.getType().getY();
        int outputWidth = aout.getType().getX();
        int outputHeight = aout.getType().getY();

        int startX = 0;
        int endX = outputWidth;
        int startY = 0;
        int endY = outputHeight;
        if (opt != null)
        {
            if (opt.getXEnd() > 0)
            {
                startX = opt.getXStart();
                endX = Math.min(opt.getXEnd(), outputWidth);
            }
            if (opt.getYEnd() > 0)
            {
                startY = opt.getYStart();
                endY = Math.min(opt.getYEnd(), outputHeight);
            }
        }
        if (startX >= endX || startY >= endY) return;

        float[] weights = weights(mRadius);
        int reach = weights.length / 2;
        ByteBuffer source = mInput.data();

        int firstRow = Math.max(0, startY - reach);
        int lastRow = Math.min(inputHeight - 1, endY - 1 + reach);
        int rows = lastRow - firstRow + 1;
        int columns = endX - startX;
        float[] horizontal = new float[rows * columns * channels];

        for (int row = 0; row < rows; row++)
        {
            int inputRow = firstRow + row;
            for (int column = 0; column < columns; column++)
            {
                int x = startX + column;
                int target = (row * columns + column) * channels;
                for (int tap = -reach; tap <= reach; tap++)
                {
                    int sampleX = Math.max(0, Math.min(inputWidth - 1, x + tap));
                    float weight = weights[tap + reach];
                    int sample = (inputRow * inputWidth + sampleX) * channels;
                    for (int channel = 0; channel < channels; channel++)
                    {
                        horizontal[target + channel] += weight * (source.get(sample + channel) & 0xFF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        ByteBuffer target = aout.data();
        float[] accumulator = new float[channels];
        for (int y = startY; y < endY; y++)
        {
            for (int column = 0; column < columns; column++)
            {
                for (int channel = 0; channel < channels; channel++) accumulator[channel] = 0;

                for (int tap = -reach; tap <= reach; tap++)
                {
                    int sampleY = Math.max(0, Math.min(inputHeight - 1, y + tap));
                    int row = Math.max(0, Math.min(rows - 1, sampleY - firstRow));
                    float weight = weights[tap + reach];
                    int sample = (row * columns + column) * channels;
                    for (int channel = 0; channel < channels; channel++) accumulator[channel] += weight * horizontal[sample + channel];
                }

                int output = (y * outputWidth + startX + column) * channels;
                for (int channel = 0; channel < channels; channel++)
                {
                    int value = Math.round(accumulator[channel]);
                    target.put(output + channel, (byte) Math.max(0, Math.min(255, value)));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static float[] weights(float radius)
    {
        float sigma = 0.4f * radius + 0.6f;
        int reach = (int) Math.ceil(radius);
        float[] weights = new float[reach * 2 + 1];
        double exponentScale = -1.0 / (2.0 * sigma * sigma);

        float sum = 0;
        for (int offset = -reach; offset <= reach; offset++)
        {
            float weight = (float) Math.exp(offset * offset * exponentScale);
            weights[offset + reach] = weight;
            sum += weight;
        }
        for (int index = 0; index < weights.length; index++) weights[index] /= sum;
        return weights;
    }

    public Script.KernelID getKernelID()
    {
        return createKernelID(KERNEL_SLOT, 2, null, mElement);
    }

    public Script.FieldID getFieldID_Input()
    {
        return createFieldID(INPUT_SLOT, null);
    }
}
```
