`java/android/renderscript/Type.java`:

```java
package android.renderscript;

import android.graphics.ImageFormat;

public class Type extends BaseObj
{
    final Element mElement;
    final int mDimX;
    final int mDimY;
    final int mDimZ;
    final boolean mDimMipmaps;
    final boolean mDimFaces;
    final int mDimYuv;
    final int mElementCount;

    public enum CubemapFace
    {
        POSITIVE_X(0),
        NEGATIVE_X(1),
        POSITIVE_Y(2),
        NEGATIVE_Y(3),
        POSITIVE_Z(4),
        NEGATIVE_Z(5),
        @Deprecated
        POSITVE_X(0),
        @Deprecated
        POSITVE_Y(2),
        @Deprecated
        POSITVE_Z(4);

        final int mID;

        CubemapFace(int id)
        {
            mID = id;
        }
    }

    Type(RenderScript rs, Element element, int dimX, int dimY, int dimZ, boolean mipmaps, boolean faces, int yuv)
    {
        super(rs);

        mElement = element;
        mDimX = dimX;
        mDimY = dimY;
        mDimZ = dimZ;
        mDimMipmaps = mipmaps;
        mDimFaces = faces;
        mDimYuv = yuv;
        mElementCount = calculateElementCount();
    }

    private int calculateElementCount()
    {
        int x = Math.max(mDimX, 1);
        int y = Math.max(mDimY, 1);
        int z = Math.max(mDimZ, 1);
        int faces = mDimFaces ? 6 : 1;

        int count = x * y * z * faces;
        while (mDimMipmaps && (x > 1 || y > 1 || z > 1))
        {
            if (x > 1) x >>= 1;
            if (y > 1) y >>= 1;
            if (z > 1) z >>= 1;
            count += x * y * z * faces;
        }
        return count;
    }

    public Element getElement()
    {
        return mElement;
    }

    public int getX()
    {
        return mDimX;
    }

    public int getY()
    {
        return mDimY;
    }

    public int getZ()
    {
        return mDimZ;
    }

    public int getYuv()
    {
        return mDimYuv;
    }

    public boolean hasMipmaps()
    {
        return mDimMipmaps;
    }

    public boolean hasFaces()
    {
        return mDimFaces;
    }

    public int getCount()
    {
        return mElementCount;
    }

    public static Type createX(RenderScript rs, Element element, int dimX)
    {
        if (dimX < 1) throw new RSInvalidStateException("Dimension must be >= 1.");
        return new Type(rs, element, dimX, 0, 0, false, false, 0);
    }

    public static Type createXY(RenderScript rs, Element element, int dimX, int dimY)
    {
        if (dimX < 1 || dimY < 1) throw new RSInvalidStateException("Dimension must be >= 1.");
        return new Type(rs, element, dimX, dimY, 0, false, false, 0);
    }

    public static Type createXYZ(RenderScript rs, Element element, int dimX, int dimY, int dimZ)
    {
        if (dimX < 1 || dimY < 1 || dimZ < 1) throw new RSInvalidStateException("Dimension must be >= 1.");
        return new Type(rs, element, dimX, dimY, dimZ, false, false, 0);
    }

    public static class Builder
    {
        private final RenderScript mRS;
        private final Element mElement;

        private int mDimX = 1;
        private int mDimY;
        private int mDimZ;
        private boolean mDimMipmaps;
        private boolean mDimFaces;
        private int mYuv;

        public Builder(RenderScript rs, Element element)
        {
            element.checkValid();
            mRS = rs;
            mElement = element;
        }

        public Builder setX(int value)
        {
            if (value < 1) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Values of less than 1 for Dimension X are not valid.");
            mDimX = value;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setY(int value)
        {
            if (value < 1) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Values of less than 1 for Dimension Y are not valid.");
            mDimY = value;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setZ(int value)
        {
            if (value < 1) throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Values of less than 1 for Dimension Z are not valid.");
            mDimZ = value;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setMipmaps(boolean value)
        {
            mDimMipmaps = value;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setFaces(boolean value)
        {
            mDimFaces = value;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setYuvFormat(int yuvFormat)
        {
            switch (yuvFormat)
            {
                case ImageFormat.NV21:
                case ImageFormat.YV12:
                case ImageFormat.YUV_420_888:
                    break;
                default:
                    throw new RSIllegalArgumentException("Only ImageFormat.NV21, .YV12, and .YUV_420_888 are supported..");
            }

            mYuv = yuvFormat;
            return this;
        }

        public Type create()
        {
            if (mDimZ > 0)
            {
                if (mDimX < 1 || mDimY < 1) throw new RSInvalidStateException("Both X and Y dimension required when Z is present.");
                if (mDimFaces) throw new RSInvalidStateException("Cube maps not supported with 3D types.");
            }
            if (mDimY > 0 && mDimX < 1) throw new RSInvalidStateException("X dimension required when Y is present.");
            if (mDimFaces && mDimY < 1) throw new RSInvalidStateException("Cube maps require 2D Types.");
            if (mYuv != 0 && (mDimZ != 0 || mDimFaces || mDimMipmaps))
            {
                throw new RSInvalidStateException("YUV only supports basic 2D.");
            }

            return new Type(mRS, mElement, mDimX, mDimY, mDimZ, mDimMipmaps, mDimFaces, mYuv);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/security/AppUriAuthenticationPolicy.java`:

```java
package android.security;

import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public final class AppUriAuthenticationPolicy implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<AppUriAuthenticationPolicy> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<AppUriAuthenticationPolicy>()
    {
        @Override
        public AppUriAuthenticationPolicy createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            Map<String, Map<Uri, String>> mappings = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            int appCount = source.readInt();
            for (int appIndex = 0; appIndex < appCount; appIndex++)
            {
                String packageName = source.readString();
                Map<Uri, String> uris = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                int uriCount = source.readInt();
                for (int uriIndex = 0; uriIndex < uriCount; uriIndex++)
                {
                    Uri uri = Uri.parse(source.readString());
                    uris.put(uri, source.readString());
                }
                mappings.put(packageName, uris);
            }
            return new AppUriAuthenticationPolicy(mappings);
        }

        @Override
        public AppUriAuthenticationPolicy[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new AppUriAuthenticationPolicy[size];
        }
    };

    private final Map<String, Map<Uri, String>> mAppToUris;

    private AppUriAuthenticationPolicy(Map<String, Map<Uri, String>> appToUris)
    {
        mAppToUris = appToUris;
    }

    public Map<String, Map<Uri, String>> getAppAndUriMappings()
    {
        Map<String, Map<Uri, String>> copy = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (Map.Entry<String, Map<Uri, String>> entry : mAppToUris.entrySet())
        {
            copy.put(entry.getKey(), new LinkedHashMap<>(entry.getValue()));
        }
        return copy;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeInt(mAppToUris.size());
        for (Map.Entry<String, Map<Uri, String>> app : mAppToUris.entrySet())
        {
            destination.writeString(app.getKey());
            destination.writeInt(app.getValue().size());
            for (Map.Entry<Uri, String> uri : app.getValue().entrySet())
            {
                destination.writeString(uri.getKey().toString());
                destination.writeString(uri.getValue());
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        return other instanceof AppUriAuthenticationPolicy && ((AppUriAuthenticationPolicy)other).mAppToUris.equals(mAppToUris);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mAppToUris.hashCode();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "AppUriAuthenticationPolicy{mPackageNameToUris=" + mAppToUris + "}";
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final Map<String, Map<Uri, String>> mPackageNameToUris = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public Builder addAppAndUriMapping(String appPackageName, Uri uri, String alias)
        {
            mPackageNameToUris.computeIfAbsent(appPackageName, key -> new LinkedHashMap<>()).put(uri, alias);
            return this;
        }

        public AppUriAuthenticationPolicy build()
        {
            Map<String, Map<Uri, String>> copy = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<String, Map<Uri, String>> entry : mPackageNameToUris.entrySet())
            {
                copy.put(entry.getKey(), new LinkedHashMap<>(entry.getValue()));
            }
            return new AppUriAuthenticationPolicy(copy);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public final class KeyChain
{

    private static final String ACTION_MANAGE_CREDENTIALS = "android.security.MANAGE_CREDENTIALS";
    private static final String EXTRA_AUTHENTICATION_POLICY = "android.security.extra.AUTHENTICATION_POLICY";

    public KeyChain()
    {
    }

    public static Intent createInstallIntent()

        return new Intent(ACTION_INSTALL);

    {
        Intent intent = new Intent(ACTION_MANAGE_CREDENTIALS);

        return intent;
    }

    public static void choosePrivateKeyAlias(Activity activity, KeyChainAliasCallback response, String[] keyTypes,
            Principal[] issuers, String host, int port, String alias)
    {
        choosePrivateKeyAlias(activity, response, keyTypes, issuers, null, alias);
    }

    public static void choosePrivateKeyAlias(Activity activity, KeyChainAliasCallback response, String[] keyTypes,
            Principal[] issuers, Uri uri, String alias)
    {
        if (activity == null) throw new NullPointerException("activity == null");
        if (response == null) throw new NullPointerException("response == null");

        Thread thread = new Thread(() -> response.alias(null), "KeyChainAliasCallback");
        thread.setDaemon(true);
        thread.start();
    }

    public static boolean isCredentialManagementApp(Context context)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public static AppUriAuthenticationPolicy getCredentialManagementAppPolicy(Context context) throws SecurityException
    {
        throw new SecurityException("The caller is not the current credential management application");
    }

    public static boolean removeCredentialManagementApp(Context context)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public static PrivateKey getPrivateKey(Context context, String alias) throws KeyChainException, InterruptedException
    {
        if (alias == null) throw new NullPointerException("alias == null");
        if (context == null) throw new NullPointerException("context == null");
        return null;
    }

    public static X509Certificate[] getCertificateChain(Context context, String alias)
            throws KeyChainException, InterruptedException
    {
        if (alias == null) throw new NullPointerException("alias == null");
        return null;
    }

    public static boolean isKeyAlgorithmSupported(String algorithm)
    {
        return "RSA".equalsIgnoreCase(algorithm) || "EC".equalsIgnoreCase(algorithm);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public static boolean isBoundKeyAlgorithm(String algorithm)
    {
        return false;
    }
```

`java/android/security/KeyPairGeneratorSpec.java`:

```java
package android.security;

import android.content.Context;

import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.security.spec.AlgorithmParameterSpec;
import java.util.Date;

import javax.security.auth.x500.X500Principal;

@Deprecated
public final class KeyPairGeneratorSpec implements AlgorithmParameterSpec
{
    private final Context mContext;
    private final String mKeystoreAlias;
    private final String mKeyType;
    private final int mKeySize;
    private final AlgorithmParameterSpec mSpec;
    private final X500Principal mSubjectDN;
    private final BigInteger mSerialNumber;
    private final Date mStartDate;
    private final Date mEndDate;
    private final boolean mEncryptionRequired;

    private KeyPairGeneratorSpec(Builder builder)
    {
        if (builder.mContext == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("context == null");
        if (builder.mKeystoreAlias == null || builder.mKeystoreAlias.isEmpty())
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("keyStoreAlias must not be empty");
        }
        if (builder.mSubjectDN == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("subjectDN == null");
        if (builder.mSerialNumber == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("serialNumber == null");
        if (builder.mStartDate == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("startDate == null");
        if (builder.mEndDate == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("endDate == null");
        if (builder.mEndDate.before(builder.mStartDate)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("endDate < startDate");

        mContext = builder.mContext;
        mKeystoreAlias = builder.mKeystoreAlias;
        mKeyType = builder.mKeyType;
        mKeySize = builder.mKeySize;
        mSpec = builder.mSpec;
        mSubjectDN = builder.mSubjectDN;
        mSerialNumber = builder.mSerialNumber;
        mStartDate = new Date(builder.mStartDate.getTime());
        mEndDate = new Date(builder.mEndDate.getTime());
        mEncryptionRequired = builder.mEncryptionRequired;
    }

    public Context getContext()
    {
        return mContext;
    }

    public String getKeystoreAlias()
    {
        return mKeystoreAlias;
    }

    public String getKeyType()
    {
        return mKeyType;
    }

    public int getKeySize()
    {
        return mKeySize;
    }

    public AlgorithmParameterSpec getAlgorithmParameterSpec()
    {
        return mSpec;
    }

    public X500Principal getSubjectDN()
    {
        return mSubjectDN;
    }

    public BigInteger getSerialNumber()
    {
        return mSerialNumber;
    }

    public Date getStartDate()
    {
        return new Date(mStartDate.getTime());
    }

    public Date getEndDate()
    {
        return new Date(mEndDate.getTime());
    }

    public boolean isEncryptionRequired()
    {
        return mEncryptionRequired;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final Context mContext;
        private String mKeystoreAlias;
        private String mKeyType = "RSA";
        private int mKeySize = -1;
        private AlgorithmParameterSpec mSpec;
        private X500Principal mSubjectDN;
        private BigInteger mSerialNumber;
        private Date mStartDate;
        private Date mEndDate;
        private boolean mEncryptionRequired;

        public Builder(Context context)
        {
            if (context == null) throw new NullPointerException("context == null");
            mContext = context;
        }

        public Builder setAlias(String alias)
        {
            if (alias == null) throw new NullPointerException("alias == null");
            mKeystoreAlias = alias;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setKeyType(String keyType) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException
        {
            if (keyType == null) throw new NullPointerException("keyType == null");
            if (!"RSA".equalsIgnoreCase(keyType) && !"EC".equalsIgnoreCase(keyType))
            {
                throw new NoSuchAlgorithmException("Unsupported key type: " + keyType);
            }
            mKeyType = keyType;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setKeySize(int keySize)
        {
            if (keySize < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("keySize < 0");
            mKeySize = keySize;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setAlgorithmParameterSpec(AlgorithmParameterSpec spec)
        {
            if (spec == null) throw new NullPointerException("spec == null");
            mSpec = spec;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setSubject(X500Principal subject)
        {
            if (subject == null) throw new NullPointerException("subject == null");
            mSubjectDN = subject;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setSerialNumber(BigInteger serialNumber)
        {
            if (serialNumber == null) throw new NullPointerException("serialNumber == null");
            mSerialNumber = serialNumber;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setStartDate(Date startDate)
        {
            if (startDate == null) throw new NullPointerException("startDate == null");
            mStartDate = startDate;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setEndDate(Date endDate)
        {
            if (endDate == null) throw new NullPointerException("endDate == null");
            mEndDate = endDate;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setEncryptionRequired()
        {
            mEncryptionRequired = true;
            return this;
        }

        public KeyPairGeneratorSpec build()
        {
            return new KeyPairGeneratorSpec(this);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/security/identity/PersonalizationData.java`:

```java
package android.security.identity;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class PersonalizationData
{
    private final List<AccessControlProfile> mProfiles = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Map<String, Map<String, byte[]>> mNamespaces = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, Map<String, Collection<AccessControlProfileId>>> mAccessControlProfileIds = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    private PersonalizationData()
    {
    }

    Collection<AccessControlProfile> getAccessControlProfiles()
    {
        return mProfiles;
    }

    Collection<String> getNamespaces()
    {
        return mNamespaces.keySet();
    }

    Map<String, byte[]> getEntries(String namespace)
    {
        return mNamespaces.get(namespace);
    }

    Collection<AccessControlProfileId> getAccessControlProfileIds(String namespace, String name)
    {
        Map<String, Collection<AccessControlProfileId>> entries = mAccessControlProfileIds.get(namespace);
        return entries != null ? entries.get(name) : null;
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final PersonalizationData mData = new PersonalizationData();

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public Builder putEntry(String namespace, String name, Collection<AccessControlProfileId> accessControlProfileIds,
                byte[] value)
        {
            mData.mNamespaces.computeIfAbsent(namespace, key -> new LinkedHashMap<>()).put(name, value);
            mData.mAccessControlProfileIds.computeIfAbsent(namespace, key -> new LinkedHashMap<>()).put(name,
                    accessControlProfileIds);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder addAccessControlProfile(AccessControlProfile profile)
        {
            mData.mProfiles.add(profile);
            return this;
        }

        public PersonalizationData build()
        {
            return mData;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/security/keystore/AndroidKeyStoreBackend.java`:

```java
package android.security.keystore;

import android.util.Log;

import java.io.BufferedInputStream;
import java.io.BufferedOutputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.DataInputStream;
import java.io.DataOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.security.GeneralSecurityException;
import java.security.Key;
import java.security.KeyFactory;
import java.security.PrivateKey;
import java.security.cert.Certificate;
import java.security.cert.CertificateFactory;
import java.security.spec.PKCS8EncodedKeySpec;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;

final class AndroidKeyStoreBackend
{
    private static final String TAG = "AndroidKeyStore";
    private static final int MAGIC = 0x41434b53;
    private static final int VERSION = 1;

    private static final Map<String, KeyStoreRecord> sRecords = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private static File sFile;
    private static boolean sLoaded;

    private AndroidKeyStoreBackend()
    {
    }

    static synchronized void setFile(File file)
    {
        sFile = file;
        sLoaded = false;
        sRecords.clear();
    }

    private static void ensureLoaded()
    {
        if (sLoaded) return;
        sLoaded = true;
        if (sFile == null || !sFile.isFile()) return;

        try (DataInputStream input = new DataInputStream(new BufferedInputStream(new FileInputStream(sFile))))
        {
            if (input.readInt() != MAGIC || input.readInt() != VERSION) throw new IOException("unknown keystore format");
            int count = input.readInt();
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                KeyStoreRecord record = KeyStoreRecord.read(input);
                sRecords.put(record.mAlias, record);
            }
        }
        catch (IOException exception)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "could not read " + sFile + ", starting empty", exception);
            sRecords.clear();
        }
    }

    private static void save()
    {
        if (sFile == null) return;

        File parent = sFile.getParentFile();
        if (parent != null && !parent.isDirectory()) parent.mkdirs();

        File temporary = new File(sFile.getPath() + ".tmp");
        try (DataOutputStream output = new DataOutputStream(new BufferedOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(temporary))))
        {
            output.writeInt(MAGIC);
            output.writeInt(VERSION);
            output.writeInt(sRecords.size());
            for (KeyStoreRecord record : sRecords.values()) record.write(output);
        }
        catch (IOException exception)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "could not write " + temporary, exception);
            temporary.delete();
            return;
        }

        if (!temporary.renameTo(sFile)) Log.w(TAG, "could not replace " + sFile);
    }

    static synchronized void load()
    {
        ensureLoaded();
    }

    static synchronized KeyStoreRecord get(String alias)
    {
        ensureLoaded();
        return sRecords.get(alias);
    }

    static synchronized void put(KeyStoreRecord record)
    {
        ensureLoaded();
        sRecords.remove(record.mAlias);
        sRecords.put(record.mAlias, record);
        save();
    }

    static synchronized boolean remove(String alias)
    {
        ensureLoaded();
        boolean removed = sRecords.remove(alias) != null;
        if (removed) save();
        return removed;
    }

    static synchronized List<String> aliases()
    {
        ensureLoaded();
        return new ArrayList<>(sRecords.keySet());
    }

    static synchronized KeyStoreRecord findByKey(Key key)
    {
        ensureLoaded();
        if (key == null) return null;
        byte[] encoded = key.getEncoded();
        if (encoded == null) return null;

        for (KeyStoreRecord record : sRecords.values())
        {
            if (record.mKeyEncoded != null && Arrays.equals(record.mKeyEncoded, encoded)) return record;
        }

        if (key instanceof PrivateKey)
        {
            for (KeyStoreRecord record : sRecords.values())
            {
                if (record.mType != KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_PRIVATE_KEY) continue;
                try
                {
                    if (decodeKey(record).equals(key)) return record;
                }
                catch (GeneralSecurityException exception)
                {
                    Log.w(TAG, "could not decode " + record.mAlias, exception);
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    static synchronized String findCertificateAlias(Certificate certificate)
    {
        ensureLoaded();
        if (certificate == null) return null;
        try
        {
            byte[] encoded = certificate.getEncoded();
            for (KeyStoreRecord record : sRecords.values())
            {
                if (record.mCertificateChain.length > 0 && Arrays.equals(record.mCertificateChain[0], encoded))
                {
                    return record.mAlias;
                }
            }
        }
        catch (GeneralSecurityException exception)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "could not encode certificate", exception);
        }
        return null;
    }

    static Key decodeKey(KeyStoreRecord record) throws GeneralSecurityException
    {
        if (record.mType == KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_SECRET_KEY) return new SecretKeySpec(record.mKeyEncoded, record.mAlgorithm);
        if (record.mType == KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_PRIVATE_KEY)
        {
            return KeyFactory.getInstance(record.mAlgorithm).generatePrivate(new PKCS8EncodedKeySpec(record.mKeyEncoded));
        }
        return null;
    }

    static Certificate[] decodeChain(KeyStoreRecord record) throws GeneralSecurityException
    {
        CertificateFactory factory = CertificateFactory.getInstance("X.509");
        Certificate[] chain = new Certificate[record.mCertificateChain.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < chain.length; index++)
        {
            chain[index] = factory.generateCertificate(new ByteArrayInputStream(record.mCertificateChain[index]));
        }
        return chain;
    }
}
```

`java/android/security/keystore/AndroidKeyStoreKeyFactorySpi.java`:

```java
package android.security.keystore;

import java.security.InvalidKeyException;
import java.security.Key;
import java.security.KeyFactory;
import java.security.KeyFactorySpi;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.security.PrivateKey;
import java.security.PublicKey;
import java.security.spec.InvalidKeySpecException;
import java.security.spec.KeySpec;

final class AndroidKeyStoreKeyFactorySpi extends KeyFactorySpi
{
    private final String mAlgorithm;

    AndroidKeyStoreKeyFactorySpi(String algorithm)
    {
        mAlgorithm = algorithm;
    }

    private KeyFactory hostFactory() throws InvalidKeySpecException
    {
        try
        {
            return KeyFactory.getInstance(mAlgorithm);
        }
        catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException exception)
        {
            throw new InvalidKeySpecException(exception);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected PublicKey engineGeneratePublic(KeySpec keySpec) throws InvalidKeySpecException
    {
        return hostFactory().generatePublic(keySpec);
    }

    @Override
    protected PrivateKey engineGeneratePrivate(KeySpec keySpec) throws InvalidKeySpecException
    {
        throw new InvalidKeySpecException("To generate a key pair in Android Keystore, use KeyPairGenerator initialized with "
                + KeyGenParameterSpec.class.getName());
    }

    @Override
    protected <T extends KeySpec> T engineGetKeySpec(Key key, Class<T> keySpec) throws InvalidKeySpecException
    {
        if (key == null) throw new InvalidKeySpecException("key == null");
        if (keySpec == null) throw new InvalidKeySpecException("keySpecClass == null");

        if (KeyInfo.class.equals(keySpec))
        {
            if (!(key instanceof PrivateKey)) throw new InvalidKeySpecException("Unsupported key type: " + key.getClass().getName());
            KeyStoreRecord record = AndroidKeyStoreBackend.findByKey(key);
            if (record == null || record.mType != KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_PRIVATE_KEY)
            {
                throw new InvalidKeySpecException("Only Android KeyStore private keys are supported");
            }
            return keySpec.cast(new KeyInfo(record));
        }

        if (key instanceof PrivateKey && AndroidKeyStoreBackend.findByKey(key) != null)
        {
            throw new InvalidKeySpecException("Key material export of Android Keystore private keys is not supported");
        }
        return hostFactory().getKeySpec(key, keySpec);
    }

    @Override
    protected Key engineTranslateKey(Key key) throws InvalidKeyException
    {
        if (key == null) throw new InvalidKeyException("key == null");
        if (key instanceof PublicKey || AndroidKeyStoreBackend.findByKey(key) != null) return key;
        throw new InvalidKeyException("To import a key into Android Keystore, use KeyStore.setEntry");
    }
}
```

`java/android/security/keystore/AndroidKeyStoreKeyGeneratorSpi.java`:

```java
package android.security.keystore;

import java.security.GeneralSecurityException;
import java.security.InvalidAlgorithmParameterException;
import java.security.ProviderException;
import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.security.spec.AlgorithmParameterSpec;

import javax.crypto.KeyGenerator;
import javax.crypto.KeyGeneratorSpi;
import javax.crypto.SecretKey;
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;

final class AndroidKeyStoreKeyGeneratorSpi extends KeyGeneratorSpi
{
    private final String mAlgorithm;
    private final int mDefaultKeySize;
    private KeyGenParameterSpec mSpec;
    private int mKeySize;
    private SecureRandom mRandom;

    AndroidKeyStoreKeyGeneratorSpi(String algorithm, int defaultKeySize)
    {
        mAlgorithm = algorithm;
        mDefaultKeySize = defaultKeySize;
    }

    @Override
    protected void engineInit(SecureRandom random)
    {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Cannot initialize without a " + KeyGenParameterSpec.class.getName()
                + " parameter");
    }

    @Override
    protected void engineInit(int keySize, SecureRandom random)
    {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Cannot initialize without a " + KeyGenParameterSpec.class.getName()
                + " parameter");
    }

    @Override
    protected void engineInit(AlgorithmParameterSpec params, SecureRandom random) throws InvalidAlgorithmParameterException
    {
        if (!(params instanceof KeyGenParameterSpec))
        {
            throw new InvalidAlgorithmParameterException("Cannot initialize without a " + KeyGenParameterSpec.class.getName()
                    + " parameter");
        }

        KeyGenParameterSpec spec = (KeyGenParameterSpec)params;
        if (spec.getKeystoreAlias() == null) throw new InvalidAlgorithmParameterException("KeyStore entry alias not provided");

        int keySize = spec.getKeySize() == -1 ? mDefaultKeySize : spec.getKeySize();
        if (keySize <= 0 || keySize % 8 != 0) throw new InvalidAlgorithmParameterException("Key size must be a multiple of 8: " + keySize);
        if ("AES".equals(mAlgorithm) && keySize != 128 && keySize != 192 && keySize != 256)
        {
            throw new InvalidAlgorithmParameterException("Unsupported key size: " + keySize + ". Supported: 128, 192, 256.");
        }
        if ("DESede".equals(mAlgorithm) && keySize != 168)
        {
            throw new InvalidAlgorithmParameterException("3DES key size must be 168 bits.");
        }
        if (mAlgorithm.startsWith("Hmac") && (keySize < 64 || keySize > 512))
        {
            throw new InvalidAlgorithmParameterException("HMAC key sizes must be within 64-512 bits, inclusive.");
        }

        mSpec = spec;
        mKeySize = keySize;
        mRandom = random;
    }

    @Override
    protected SecretKey engineGenerateKey()
    {
        if (mSpec == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Not initialized");
        if (mSpec.isStrongBoxBacked()) throw new StrongBoxUnavailableException("No StrongBox available");

        byte[] material;
        if (mAlgorithm.startsWith("Hmac"))
        {
            material = new byte[mKeySize / 8];
            (mRandom != null ? mRandom : new SecureRandom()).nextBytes(material);
        }
        else
        {
            try
            {
                KeyGenerator generator = KeyGenerator.getInstance(mAlgorithm);
                if (mRandom != null) generator.init(mKeySize, mRandom);
                else generator.init(mKeySize);
                material = generator.generateKey().getEncoded();
            }
            catch (GeneralSecurityException exception)
            {
                throw new ProviderException("Failed to generate key", exception);
            }
        }

        KeyStoreRecord record = new KeyStoreRecord(mSpec.getKeystoreAlias(), KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_SECRET_KEY);
        record.mAlgorithm = mAlgorithm;
        record.mKeyEncoded = material;
        record.applyGenerationSpec(mSpec, mKeySize);
        AndroidKeyStoreBackend.put(record);

        return new SecretKeySpec(material, mAlgorithm);
    }
}
```

`java/android/security/keystore/AndroidKeyStoreKeyPairGeneratorSpi.java`:

```java
package android.security.keystore;

import android.security.KeyPairGeneratorSpec;

import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.security.GeneralSecurityException;
import java.security.InvalidAlgorithmParameterException;
import java.security.KeyPair;
import java.security.KeyPairGenerator;
import java.security.KeyPairGeneratorSpi;
import java.security.ProviderException;
import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.security.cert.X509Certificate;
import java.security.spec.AlgorithmParameterSpec;
import java.security.spec.ECGenParameterSpec;
import java.security.spec.RSAKeyGenParameterSpec;
import java.util.Date;

import javax.security.auth.x500.X500Principal;

final class AndroidKeyStoreKeyPairGeneratorSpi extends KeyPairGeneratorSpi
{
    private final String mAlgorithm;
    private KeyGenParameterSpec mSpec;
    private String mAlias;
    private int mKeySize;
    private AlgorithmParameterSpec mAlgorithmSpec;
    private X500Principal mSubject;
    private BigInteger mSerialNumber;
    private Date mNotBefore;
    private Date mNotAfter;
    private SecureRandom mRandom;

    AndroidKeyStoreKeyPairGeneratorSpi(String algorithm)
    {
        mAlgorithm = algorithm;
    }

    private boolean isRsa()
    {
        return "RSA".equals(mAlgorithm);
    }

    @Override
    public void initialize(int keySize, SecureRandom random)
    {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException(KeyGenParameterSpec.class.getName() + " or " + KeyPairGeneratorSpec.class.getName()
                + " required to initialize this KeyPairGenerator");
    }

    @Override
    public void initialize(AlgorithmParameterSpec params, SecureRandom random) throws InvalidAlgorithmParameterException
    {
        mRandom = random;

        if (params instanceof KeyGenParameterSpec)
        {
            KeyGenParameterSpec spec = (KeyGenParameterSpec)params;
            mSpec = spec;
            mAlias = spec.getKeystoreAlias();
            mKeySize = spec.getKeySize();
            mAlgorithmSpec = spec.getAlgorithmParameterSpec();
            mSubject = spec.getCertificateSubject();
            mSerialNumber = spec.getCertificateSerialNumber();
            mNotBefore = spec.getCertificateNotBefore();
            mNotAfter = spec.getCertificateNotAfter();
        }
        else if (params instanceof KeyPairGeneratorSpec)
        {
            KeyPairGeneratorSpec spec = (KeyPairGeneratorSpec)params;
            if (spec.getKeyType() != null && !mAlgorithm.equalsIgnoreCase(spec.getKeyType()))
            {
                throw new InvalidAlgorithmParameterException("Key type " + spec.getKeyType() + " does not match " + mAlgorithm);
            }
            mSpec = new KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder(spec.getKeystoreAlias(), KeyProperties.PURPOSE_ENCRYPT
                    | KeyProperties.PURPOSE_DECRYPT | KeyProperties.PURPOSE_SIGN | KeyProperties.PURPOSE_VERIFY)
                    .setDigests(KeyProperties.DIGEST_NONE, KeyProperties.DIGEST_MD5, KeyProperties.DIGEST_SHA1,
                            KeyProperties.DIGEST_SHA224, KeyProperties.DIGEST_SHA256, KeyProperties.DIGEST_SHA384,
                            KeyProperties.DIGEST_SHA512)
                    .setEncryptionPaddings(KeyProperties.ENCRYPTION_PADDING_NONE, KeyProperties.ENCRYPTION_PADDING_RSA_PKCS1,
                            KeyProperties.ENCRYPTION_PADDING_RSA_OAEP)
                    .setSignaturePaddings(KeyProperties.SIGNATURE_PADDING_RSA_PKCS1, KeyProperties.SIGNATURE_PADDING_RSA_PSS)
                    .setRandomizedEncryptionRequired(false)
                    .build();
            mAlias = spec.getKeystoreAlias();
            mKeySize = spec.getKeySize();
            mAlgorithmSpec = spec.getAlgorithmParameterSpec();
            mSubject = spec.getSubjectDN();
            mSerialNumber = spec.getSerialNumber();
            mNotBefore = spec.getStartDate();
            mNotAfter = spec.getEndDate();
        }
        else
        {
            throw new InvalidAlgorithmParameterException("Unsupported params class: "
                    + (params != null ? params.getClass().getName() : "null") + ". Supported: " + KeyGenParameterSpec.class.getName()
                    + ", " + KeyPairGeneratorSpec.class.getName());
        }

        if (mKeySize == -1)
        {
            if (mAlgorithmSpec instanceof RSAKeyGenParameterSpec) mKeySize = ((RSAKeyGenParameterSpec)mAlgorithmSpec).getKeysize();
            else mKeySize = isRsa() ? 2048 : 256;
        }

        if (isRsa() && (mKeySize < 512 || mKeySize > 8192))
        {
            throw new InvalidAlgorithmParameterException("RSA key size must be >= 512 and <= 8192");
        }
        if (!isRsa() && !(mAlgorithmSpec instanceof ECGenParameterSpec) && mKeySize != 224 && mKeySize != 256 && mKeySize != 384
                && mKeySize != 521)
        {
            throw new InvalidAlgorithmParameterException("Unsupported EC key size: " + mKeySize
                    + " bits. Supported: 224, 256, 384, 521");
        }
    }

    @Override
    public KeyPair generateKeyPair()
    {
        if (mSpec == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Not initialized");
        if (mSpec.isStrongBoxBacked()) throw new StrongBoxUnavailableException("No StrongBox available");

        try
        {
            KeyPairGenerator generator = KeyPairGenerator.getInstance(mAlgorithm);
            if (mAlgorithmSpec instanceof ECGenParameterSpec || mAlgorithmSpec instanceof RSAKeyGenParameterSpec)
            {
                if (mRandom != null) generator.initialize(mAlgorithmSpec, mRandom);
                else generator.initialize(mAlgorithmSpec);
            }
            else if (mRandom != null)
            {
                generator.initialize(mKeySize, mRandom);
            }
            else
            {
                generator.initialize(mKeySize);
            }

            KeyPair keyPair = generator.generateKeyPair();
            X509Certificate certificate = SelfSignedCertificate.create(keyPair, mSubject, mSerialNumber, mNotBefore, mNotAfter);

            KeyStoreRecord record = new KeyStoreRecord(mAlias, KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_PRIVATE_KEY);
            record.mAlgorithm = mAlgorithm;
            record.mKeyEncoded = keyPair.getPrivate().getEncoded();
            record.mCertificateChain = new byte[][] {certificate.getEncoded()};
            record.applyGenerationSpec(mSpec, KeyStoreRecord.keySizeOf(keyPair.getPrivate(), null));
            AndroidKeyStoreBackend.put(record);

            return new KeyPair(certificate.getPublicKey(), keyPair.getPrivate());
        }
        catch (GeneralSecurityException exception)
        {
            throw new ProviderException("Failed to generate key pair", exception);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/security/keystore/AndroidKeyStoreProvider.java`:

```java
package android.security.keystore;

import java.io.File;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.security.Provider;
import java.security.Security;
import java.util.function.Supplier;

public final class AndroidKeyStoreProvider extends Provider
{
    public static final String PROVIDER_NAME = "AndroidKeyStore";

    private static final String KEYSTORE_FILE = "keystore/AndroidKeyStore.bin";

    private AndroidKeyStoreProvider()
    {
        super(PROVIDER_NAME, 1.0, "Android KeyStore security provider");

        register("KeyStore", PROVIDER_NAME, AndroidKeyStoreSpi::new);

        register("KeyPairGenerator", KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_RSA,
                () -> new AndroidKeyStoreKeyPairGeneratorSpi(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_RSA));
        register("KeyPairGenerator", KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_EC,
                () -> new AndroidKeyStoreKeyPairGeneratorSpi(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_EC));

        register("KeyFactory", KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_RSA,
                () -> new AndroidKeyStoreKeyFactorySpi(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_RSA));
        register("KeyFactory", KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_EC,
                () -> new AndroidKeyStoreKeyFactorySpi(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_EC));

        registerKeyGenerator(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_AES, 128);
        registerKeyGenerator(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_3DES, 168);
        registerKeyGenerator(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_HMAC_SHA1, 160);
        registerKeyGenerator(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_HMAC_SHA224, 224);
        registerKeyGenerator(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_HMAC_SHA256, 256);
        registerKeyGenerator(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_HMAC_SHA384, 384);
        registerKeyGenerator(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_HMAC_SHA512, 512);
    }

    public static synchronized void install(File dataDirectory)
    {
        AndroidKeyStoreBackend.setFile(dataDirectory != null ? new File(dataDirectory, KEYSTORE_FILE) : null);
        if (Security.getProvider(PROVIDER_NAME) == null) Security.addProvider(new AndroidKeyStoreProvider());
    }

    private void registerKeyGenerator(String algorithm, int defaultKeySize)
    {
        register("KeyGenerator", algorithm, () -> new AndroidKeyStoreKeyGeneratorSpi(algorithm, defaultKeySize));
        register("SecretKeyFactory", algorithm, AndroidKeyStoreSecretKeyFactorySpi::new);
    }

    private void register(String type, String algorithm, Supplier<Object> factory)
    {
        putService(new FactoryService(this, type, algorithm, factory));
    }

    private static final class FactoryService extends Provider.Service
    {
        private final Supplier<Object> mFactory;

        FactoryService(Provider provider, String type, String algorithm, Supplier<Object> factory)
        {
            super(provider, type, algorithm, AndroidKeyStoreProvider.class.getName() + "$" + type + "$" + algorithm, null, null);
            mFactory = factory;
        }

        @Override
        public Object newInstance(Object constructorParameter) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException
        {
            return mFactory.get();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.security.keystore;

import java.security.InvalidKeyException;
import java.security.spec.InvalidKeySpecException;
import java.security.spec.KeySpec;

import javax.crypto.SecretKey;
import javax.crypto.SecretKeyFactorySpi;

final class AndroidKeyStoreSecretKeyFactorySpi extends SecretKeyFactorySpi
{
    @Override
    protected KeySpec engineGetKeySpec(SecretKey key, Class keySpecClass) throws InvalidKeySpecException
    {
        if (keySpecClass == null) throw new InvalidKeySpecException("keySpecClass == null");
        if (!KeyInfo.class.equals(keySpecClass))
        {
            throw new InvalidKeySpecException("Unsupported key spec: " + keySpecClass.getName());
        }

        KeyStoreRecord record = AndroidKeyStoreBackend.findByKey(key);
        if (record == null || record.mType != KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_SECRET_KEY)
        {
            throw new InvalidKeySpecException("Only Android KeyStore secret keys are supported");
        }
        return new KeyInfo(record);
    }

    @Override

    {
        throw new InvalidKeySpecException("To generate secret key in Android Keystore, use KeyGenerator initialized with "
                + KeyGenParameterSpec.class.getName());
    }

    @Override
    protected SecretKey engineTranslateKey(SecretKey key) throws InvalidKeyException
    {
        if (key == null) throw new InvalidKeyException("key == null");
        if (AndroidKeyStoreBackend.findByKey(key) == null)
        {
            throw new InvalidKeyException("To import a secret key into Android Keystore, use KeyStore.setEntry");
        }

    }
```

`java/android/security/keystore/AndroidKeyStoreSpi.java`:

```java
package android.security.keystore;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.security.GeneralSecurityException;
import java.security.Key;
import java.security.KeyStore;
import java.security.KeyStoreException;
import java.security.KeyStoreSpi;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.security.PrivateKey;
import java.security.UnrecoverableEntryException;
import java.security.UnrecoverableKeyException;
import java.security.cert.Certificate;
import java.security.cert.CertificateEncodingException;
import java.security.cert.CertificateException;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Enumeration;

import javax.crypto.SecretKey;

final class AndroidKeyStoreSpi extends KeyStoreSpi
{
    @Override
    public Key engineGetKey(String alias, char[] password) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException, UnrecoverableKeyException
    {
        KeyStoreRecord record = AndroidKeyStoreBackend.get(alias);
        if (record == null || record.mType == KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_CERTIFICATE) return null;
        try
        {
            return AndroidKeyStoreBackend.decodeKey(record);
        }
        catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException exception)
        {
            throw exception;
        }
        catch (GeneralSecurityException exception)
        {
            UnrecoverableKeyException failure = new UnrecoverableKeyException("Failed to load key " + alias);
            failure.initCause(exception);
            throw failure;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public Certificate[] engineGetCertificateChain(String alias)
    {
        KeyStoreRecord record = AndroidKeyStoreBackend.get(alias);
        if (record == null || record.mType != KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_PRIVATE_KEY) return null;
        try
        {
            return AndroidKeyStoreBackend.decodeChain(record);
        }
        catch (GeneralSecurityException exception)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public Certificate engineGetCertificate(String alias)
    {
        KeyStoreRecord record = AndroidKeyStoreBackend.get(alias);
        if (record == null || record.mCertificateChain.length == 0) return null;
        try
        {
            return AndroidKeyStoreBackend.decodeChain(record)[0];
        }
        catch (GeneralSecurityException exception)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public Date engineGetCreationDate(String alias)
    {
        KeyStoreRecord record = AndroidKeyStoreBackend.get(alias);
        return record != null ? new Date(record.mCreationDate) : null;
    }

    @Override
    public void engineSetKeyEntry(String alias, Key key, char[] password, Certificate[] chain) throws KeyStoreException
    {
        if (password != null && password.length > 0)
        {
            throw new KeyStoreException("entries cannot be protected with passwords");
        }
        if (key instanceof PrivateKey)
        {
            setPrivateKeyEntry(alias, (PrivateKey)key, chain, null);
        }
        else if (key instanceof SecretKey)
        {
            setSecretKeyEntry(alias, (SecretKey)key, null);
        }
        else
        {
            throw new KeyStoreException("Only PrivateKey and SecretKey are supported");
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void engineSetKeyEntry(String alias, byte[] key, Certificate[] chain) throws KeyStoreException
    {
        throw new KeyStoreException("Operation not supported because key encoding is unknown");
    }

    @Override
    public void engineSetCertificateEntry(String alias, Certificate certificate) throws KeyStoreException
    {
        if (alias == null) throw new NullPointerException("alias == null");
        if (certificate == null) throw new NullPointerException("cert == null");

        KeyStoreRecord existing = AndroidKeyStoreBackend.get(alias);
        if (existing != null && existing.mType != KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_CERTIFICATE)
        {
            throw new KeyStoreException("Entry exists and is not a trusted certificate");
        }

        KeyStoreRecord record = new KeyStoreRecord(alias, KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_CERTIFICATE);
        record.mCertificateChain = new byte[][] {encode(certificate)};
        AndroidKeyStoreBackend.put(record);
    }

    @Override
    public void engineDeleteEntry(String alias) throws KeyStoreException
    {
        AndroidKeyStoreBackend.remove(alias);
    }

    @Override
    public Enumeration<String> engineAliases()
    {
        return Collections.enumeration(AndroidKeyStoreBackend.aliases());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean engineContainsAlias(String alias)
    {
        if (alias == null) throw new NullPointerException("alias == null");
        return AndroidKeyStoreBackend.get(alias) != null;
    }

    @Override
    public int engineSize()
    {
        return AndroidKeyStoreBackend.aliases().size();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean engineIsKeyEntry(String alias)
    {
        KeyStoreRecord record = AndroidKeyStoreBackend.get(alias);
        return record != null && record.mType != KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_CERTIFICATE;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean engineIsCertificateEntry(String alias)
    {
        KeyStoreRecord record = AndroidKeyStoreBackend.get(alias);
        return record != null && record.mType == KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_CERTIFICATE;
    }

    @Override
    public String engineGetCertificateAlias(Certificate certificate)
    {
        return AndroidKeyStoreBackend.findCertificateAlias(certificate);
    }

    @Override
    public void engineStore(OutputStream stream, char[] password) throws IOException, NoSuchAlgorithmException, CertificateException
    {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Can not serialize AndroidKeyStore to OutputStream");
    }

    @Override
    public void engineLoad(InputStream stream, char[] password) throws IOException, NoSuchAlgorithmException, CertificateException
    {
        if (stream != null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("InputStream not supported");
        if (password != null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("password not supported");
        AndroidKeyStoreBackend.load();
    }

    @Override
    public void engineLoad(KeyStore.LoadStoreParameter parameter)
            throws IOException, NoSuchAlgorithmException, CertificateException
    {
        AndroidKeyStoreBackend.load();
    }

    @Override
    public KeyStore.Entry engineGetEntry(String alias, KeyStore.ProtectionParameter parameter)
            throws KeyStoreException, NoSuchAlgorithmException, UnrecoverableEntryException
    {
        if (alias == null) throw new NullPointerException("alias == null");
        KeyStoreRecord record = AndroidKeyStoreBackend.get(alias);
        if (record == null) return null;

        try
        {
            switch (record.mType)
            {
                case KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_SECRET_KEY:
                    return new KeyStore.SecretKeyEntry((SecretKey)AndroidKeyStoreBackend.decodeKey(record));
                case KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_PRIVATE_KEY:
                    return new KeyStore.PrivateKeyEntry((PrivateKey)AndroidKeyStoreBackend.decodeKey(record),
                            AndroidKeyStoreBackend.decodeChain(record));
                default:
                    return new KeyStore.TrustedCertificateEntry(AndroidKeyStoreBackend.decodeChain(record)[0]);
            }
        }
        catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException exception)
        {
            throw exception;
        }
        catch (GeneralSecurityException exception)
        {
            UnrecoverableEntryException failure = new UnrecoverableEntryException("Failed to load entry " + alias);
            failure.initCause(exception);
            throw failure;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void engineSetEntry(String alias, KeyStore.Entry entry, KeyStore.ProtectionParameter parameter)
            throws KeyStoreException
    {
        if (entry == null) throw new KeyStoreException("entry == null");
        if (parameter != null && !(parameter instanceof KeyProtection))
        {
            throw new KeyStoreException("Unsupported protection parameter class: " + parameter.getClass().getName()
                    + ". Supported: " + KeyProtection.class.getName());
        }
        KeyProtection protection = (KeyProtection)parameter;

        if (entry instanceof KeyStore.TrustedCertificateEntry)
        {
            engineSetCertificateEntry(alias, ((KeyStore.TrustedCertificateEntry)entry).getTrustedCertificate());
        }
        else if (entry instanceof KeyStore.PrivateKeyEntry)
        {
            KeyStore.PrivateKeyEntry privateEntry = (KeyStore.PrivateKeyEntry)entry;
            setPrivateKeyEntry(alias, privateEntry.getPrivateKey(), privateEntry.getCertificateChain(), protection);
        }
        else if (entry instanceof KeyStore.SecretKeyEntry)
        {
            setSecretKeyEntry(alias, ((KeyStore.SecretKeyEntry)entry).getSecretKey(), protection);
        }
        else
        {
            throw new KeyStoreException("Entry must be a PrivateKeyEntry, SecretKeyEntry or TrustedCertificateEntry; was " + entry);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean engineEntryInstanceOf(String alias, Class<? extends KeyStore.Entry> entryClass)
    {
        KeyStoreRecord record = AndroidKeyStoreBackend.get(alias);
        if (record == null) return false;
        switch (record.mType)
        {
            case KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_SECRET_KEY:
                return entryClass == KeyStore.SecretKeyEntry.class;
            case KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_PRIVATE_KEY:
                return entryClass == KeyStore.PrivateKeyEntry.class;
            default:
                return entryClass == KeyStore.TrustedCertificateEntry.class;
        }
    }

    private static byte[] encode(Certificate certificate) throws KeyStoreException
    {
        try
        {
            return certificate.getEncoded();
        }
        catch (CertificateEncodingException exception)
        {
            throw new KeyStoreException("Failed to encode certificate", exception);
        }
    }

    private static void setPrivateKeyEntry(String alias, PrivateKey key, Certificate[] chain, KeyProtection protection)
            throws KeyStoreException
    {
        if (alias == null) throw new NullPointerException("alias == null");
        if (chain == null || chain.length == 0) throw new KeyStoreException("Must supply at least one Certificate with PrivateKey");
        if (protection != null && protection.isStrongBoxBacked())
        {
            throw new KeyStoreException("Failed to import key", new StrongBoxUnavailableException("No StrongBox available"));
        }

        byte[] encoded = key.getEncoded();
        if (encoded == null || !"PKCS#8".equals(key.getFormat()))
        {
            throw new KeyStoreException("Unsupported private key export format: " + key.getFormat()
                    + ". Only private keys which export their key material in PKCS#8 format are supported.");
        }

        KeyStoreRecord record = new KeyStoreRecord(alias, KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_PRIVATE_KEY);
        record.mAlgorithm = key.getAlgorithm();
        record.mKeyEncoded = encoded;
        record.mCertificateChain = new byte[chain.length][];
        for (int index = 0; index < chain.length; index++) record.mCertificateChain[index] = encode(chain[index]);
        record.applyProtection(protection, KeyStoreRecord.keySizeOf(key, encoded));
        AndroidKeyStoreBackend.put(record);
    }

    private static void setSecretKeyEntry(String alias, SecretKey key, KeyProtection protection) throws KeyStoreException
    {
        if (alias == null) throw new NullPointerException("alias == null");
        if (protection == null)
        {
            throw new KeyStoreException("Protection parameters must be specified when importing a symmetric key");
        }
        if (protection.isStrongBoxBacked())
        {
            throw new KeyStoreException("Failed to import key", new StrongBoxUnavailableException("No StrongBox available"));
        }

        byte[] encoded = key.getEncoded();
        if (encoded == null || !"RAW".equals(key.getFormat()))
        {
            throw new KeyStoreException("Unsupported secret key material export format: " + key.getFormat()
                    + ". Only secret keys which export their key material in RAW format are supported.");
        }

        KeyStoreRecord record = new KeyStoreRecord(alias, KeyStoreRecord.TYPE_SECRET_KEY);
        record.mAlgorithm = key.getAlgorithm();
        record.mKeyEncoded = encoded;
        record.applyProtection(protection, encoded.length * 8);
        AndroidKeyStoreBackend.put(record);
    }
}
```

```java
import java.security.KeyStore;

import java.util.Set;

public final class KeyProtection implements KeyStore.ProtectionParameter
{
    private final int mPurposes;
    private final Date mKeyValidityStart;
    private final Date mKeyValidityForOriginationEnd;
    private final Date mKeyValidityForConsumptionEnd;
    private final String[] mEncryptionPaddings;
    private final String[] mSignaturePaddings;
    private final String[] mDigests;
    private final Set<String> mMgf1Digests;
    private final String[] mBlockModes;
    private final boolean mRandomizedEncryptionRequired;
    private final boolean mUserAuthenticationRequired;
    private final int mUserAuthenticationType;
    private final int mUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds;
    private final boolean mUserPresenceRequired;
    private final boolean mUserAuthenticationValidWhileOnBody;
    private final boolean mInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment;
    private final boolean mUserConfirmationRequired;
    private final boolean mUnlockedDeviceRequired;
    private final boolean mIsStrongBoxBacked;
    private final int mMaxUsageCount;

    private KeyProtection(Builder builder)
    {
        mPurposes = builder.mPurposes;
        mKeyValidityStart = copy(builder.mKeyValidityStart);
        mKeyValidityForOriginationEnd = copy(builder.mKeyValidityForOriginationEnd);
        mKeyValidityForConsumptionEnd = copy(builder.mKeyValidityForConsumptionEnd);
        mEncryptionPaddings = builder.mEncryptionPaddings != null ? builder.mEncryptionPaddings.clone() : new String[0];
        mSignaturePaddings = builder.mSignaturePaddings != null ? builder.mSignaturePaddings.clone() : new String[0];
        mDigests = builder.mDigests != null ? builder.mDigests.clone() : null;
        mMgf1Digests = builder.mMgf1Digests != null ? Collections.unmodifiableSet(new LinkedHashSet<>(builder.mMgf1Digests))
                                                   : Collections.emptySet();
        mBlockModes = builder.mBlockModes != null ? builder.mBlockModes.clone() : new String[0];
        mRandomizedEncryptionRequired = builder.mRandomizedEncryptionRequired;
        mUserAuthenticationRequired = builder.mUserAuthenticationRequired;
        mUserAuthenticationType = builder.mUserAuthenticationType;
        mUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds = builder.mUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds;
        mUserPresenceRequired = builder.mUserPresenceRequired;
        mUserAuthenticationValidWhileOnBody = builder.mUserAuthenticationValidWhileOnBody;
        mInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment = builder.mInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment;
        mUserConfirmationRequired = builder.mUserConfirmationRequired;
        mUnlockedDeviceRequired = builder.mUnlockedDeviceRequired;
        mIsStrongBoxBacked = builder.mIsStrongBoxBacked;
        mMaxUsageCount = builder.mMaxUsageCount;
    }

    private static Date copy(Date date)
    {
        return date != null ? new Date(date.getTime()) : null;
    }

    public Date getKeyValidityStart()
    {
        return copy(mKeyValidityStart);
    }

    public Date getKeyValidityForConsumptionEnd()
    {
        return copy(mKeyValidityForConsumptionEnd);
    }

    public Date getKeyValidityForOriginationEnd()

        return copy(mKeyValidityForOriginationEnd);
    }

    public int getPurposes()

        return mPurposes;
    }

    public String[] getEncryptionPaddings()
    {
        return mEncryptionPaddings.clone();
    }

    public String[] getSignaturePaddings()
    {
        return mSignaturePaddings.clone();
    }

    public String[] getDigests()
    {
        if (mDigests == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Digests not specified");
        return mDigests.clone();
    }

    public boolean isDigestsSpecified()
    {
        return mDigests != null;
    }

    public Set<String> getMgf1Digests()
    {
        if (mMgf1Digests.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("Mgf1 digests not specified");
        return mMgf1Digests;
    }

    public boolean isMgf1DigestsSpecified()
    {
        return !mMgf1Digests.isEmpty();
    }

    public String[] getBlockModes()
    {
        return mBlockModes.clone();
    }

    public boolean isRandomizedEncryptionRequired()

        return mRandomizedEncryptionRequired;

    public boolean isUserAuthenticationRequired()

        return mInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment;

    public boolean isUnlockedDeviceRequired()

        return mUnlockedDeviceRequired;

        return mMaxUsageCount;

    boolean isStrongBoxBacked()
    {
        return mIsStrongBoxBacked;
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final int mPurposes;
        private Date mKeyValidityStart;
        private Date mKeyValidityForOriginationEnd;
        private Date mKeyValidityForConsumptionEnd;
        private String[] mEncryptionPaddings;
        private String[] mSignaturePaddings;
        private String[] mDigests;
        private Set<String> mMgf1Digests;
        private String[] mBlockModes;
        private boolean mRandomizedEncryptionRequired = true;
        private boolean mUserAuthenticationRequired;
        private int mUserAuthenticationType = KeyProperties.AUTH_BIOMETRIC_STRONG;
        private int mUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds;
        private boolean mUserPresenceRequired;
        private boolean mUserAuthenticationValidWhileOnBody;
        private boolean mInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment = true;
        private boolean mUserConfirmationRequired;
        private boolean mUnlockedDeviceRequired;
        private boolean mIsStrongBoxBacked;
        private int mMaxUsageCount = KeyProperties.UNRESTRICTED_USAGE_COUNT;

        public Builder(int purposes)
        {
            mPurposes = purposes;
        }

        public Builder setKeyValidityStart(Date startDate)
        {
            mKeyValidityStart = copy(startDate);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setKeyValidityEnd(Date endDate)
        {
            setKeyValidityForOriginationEnd(endDate);
            setKeyValidityForConsumptionEnd(endDate);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setKeyValidityForOriginationEnd(Date endDate)
        {
            mKeyValidityForOriginationEnd = copy(endDate);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setKeyValidityForConsumptionEnd(Date endDate)
        {
            mKeyValidityForConsumptionEnd = copy(endDate);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setEncryptionPaddings(String... paddings)
        {
            mEncryptionPaddings = paddings != null ? paddings.clone() : null;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setSignaturePaddings(String... paddings)
        {
            mSignaturePaddings = paddings != null ? paddings.clone() : null;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setDigests(String... digests)
        {
            mDigests = digests != null ? digests.clone() : null;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setMgf1Digests(String... mgf1Digests)
        {
            mMgf1Digests = new LinkedHashSet<>();
            if (mgf1Digests != null) Collections.addAll(mMgf1Digests, mgf1Digests);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setBlockModes(String... blockModes)
        {
            mBlockModes = blockModes != null ? blockModes.clone() : null;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setRandomizedEncryptionRequired(boolean required)
        {
            mRandomizedEncryptionRequired = required;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setUserAuthenticationRequired(boolean required)
        {
            mUserAuthenticationRequired = required;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setUserConfirmationRequired(boolean required)
        {
            mUserConfirmationRequired = required;
            return this;
        }

        @Deprecated
        public Builder setUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds(int seconds)
        {
            if (seconds < -1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("seconds must be -1 or larger");
            if (seconds == -1) return setUserAuthenticationParameters(0, KeyProperties.AUTH_BIOMETRIC_STRONG);
            return setUserAuthenticationParameters(seconds, KeyProperties.AUTH_DEVICE_CREDENTIAL | KeyProperties.AUTH_BIOMETRIC_STRONG);
        }

        public Builder setUserAuthenticationParameters(int timeout, int type)
        {
            if (timeout < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("timeout must be 0 or larger");
            mUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds = timeout;
            mUserAuthenticationType = type;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setUserPresenceRequired(boolean required)
        {
            mUserPresenceRequired = required;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setUserAuthenticationValidWhileOnBody(boolean remainsValid)
        {
            mUserAuthenticationValidWhileOnBody = remainsValid;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment(boolean invalidateKey)
        {
            mInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment = invalidateKey;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setUnlockedDeviceRequired(boolean unlockedDeviceRequired)
        {
            mUnlockedDeviceRequired = unlockedDeviceRequired;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setIsStrongBoxBacked(boolean isStrongBoxBacked)
        {
            mIsStrongBoxBacked = isStrongBoxBacked;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setMaxUsageCount(int maxUsageCount)
        {
            if (maxUsageCount != KeyProperties.UNRESTRICTED_USAGE_COUNT && maxUsageCount <= 0)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxUsageCount is not valid");
            }
            mMaxUsageCount = maxUsageCount;
            return this;
        }

        public KeyProtection build()
        {
            return new KeyProtection(this);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/security/keystore/KeyStoreRecord.java`:

```java
package android.security.keystore;

import java.io.DataInputStream;
import java.io.DataOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.security.Key;
import java.security.interfaces.ECKey;
import java.security.interfaces.RSAKey;
import java.util.Date;

final class KeyStoreRecord
{
    static final int TYPE_SECRET_KEY = 1;
    static final int TYPE_PRIVATE_KEY = 2;
    static final int TYPE_CERTIFICATE = 3;

    static final long NO_DATE = Long.MIN_VALUE;

    private static final String[] NO_STRINGS = new String[0];

    String mAlias;
    int mType;
    String mAlgorithm;
    byte[] mKeyEncoded;
    byte[][] mCertificateChain = new byte[0][];
    long mCreationDate = System.currentTimeMillis();
    int mOrigin = KeyProperties.ORIGIN_UNKNOWN;
    int mKeySize = -1;
    long mValidityStart = NO_DATE;
    long mValidityForOriginationEnd = NO_DATE;
    long mValidityForConsumptionEnd = NO_DATE;
    int mPurposes;
    String[] mBlockModes = NO_STRINGS;
    String[] mEncryptionPaddings = NO_STRINGS;
    String[] mSignaturePaddings = NO_STRINGS;
    String[] mDigests = NO_STRINGS;
    boolean mUserAuthenticationRequired;
    boolean mUserConfirmationRequired;
    int mUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds;
    int mUserAuthenticationType = KeyProperties.AUTH_BIOMETRIC_STRONG;
    boolean mUserAuthenticationValidWhileOnBody;
    boolean mInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment;
    boolean mUserPresenceRequired;
    int mMaxUsageCount = KeyProperties.UNRESTRICTED_USAGE_COUNT;

    KeyStoreRecord(String alias, int type)
    {
        mAlias = alias;
        mType = type;
    }

    private static long time(Date date)
    {
        return date != null ? date.getTime() : NO_DATE;
    }

    private static String[] strings(String[] values)
    {
        return values != null ? values.clone() : NO_STRINGS;
    }

    static int keySizeOf(Key key, byte[] encoded)
    {
        if (key instanceof RSAKey) return ((RSAKey)key).getModulus().bitLength();
        if (key instanceof ECKey) return ((ECKey)key).getParams().getCurve().getField().getFieldSize();
        return encoded != null ? encoded.length * 8 : -1;
    }

    void applyGenerationSpec(KeyGenParameterSpec spec, int keySize)
    {
        mOrigin = KeyProperties.ORIGIN_GENERATED;
        mKeySize = keySize;
        mValidityStart = time(spec.getKeyValidityStart());
        mValidityForOriginationEnd = time(spec.getKeyValidityForOriginationEnd());
        mValidityForConsumptionEnd = time(spec.getKeyValidityForConsumptionEnd());
        mPurposes = spec.getPurposes();
        mBlockModes = strings(spec.getBlockModes());
        mEncryptionPaddings = strings(spec.getEncryptionPaddings());
        mSignaturePaddings = strings(spec.getSignaturePaddings());
        mDigests = spec.isDigestsSpecified() ? strings(spec.getDigests()) : NO_STRINGS;
        mUserAuthenticationRequired = spec.isUserAuthenticationRequired();
        mUserConfirmationRequired = spec.isUserConfirmationRequired();
        mUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds = spec.getUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds();
        mUserAuthenticationType = spec.getUserAuthenticationType();
        mUserAuthenticationValidWhileOnBody = spec.isUserAuthenticationValidWhileOnBody();
        mInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment = spec.isUserAuthenticationRequired() && spec.isInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment();
        mUserPresenceRequired = spec.isUserPresenceRequired();
        mMaxUsageCount = spec.getMaxUsageCount();
    }

    void applyProtection(KeyProtection protection, int keySize)
    {
        mOrigin = KeyProperties.ORIGIN_IMPORTED;
        mKeySize = keySize;
        if (protection == null)
        {
            mPurposes = KeyProperties.PURPOSE_ENCRYPT | KeyProperties.PURPOSE_DECRYPT | KeyProperties.PURPOSE_SIGN
                    | KeyProperties.PURPOSE_VERIFY;
            mDigests = new String[] {KeyProperties.DIGEST_NONE, KeyProperties.DIGEST_MD5, KeyProperties.DIGEST_SHA1,
                    KeyProperties.DIGEST_SHA224, KeyProperties.DIGEST_SHA256, KeyProperties.DIGEST_SHA384,
                    KeyProperties.DIGEST_SHA512};
            mEncryptionPaddings = new String[] {KeyProperties.ENCRYPTION_PADDING_NONE, KeyProperties.ENCRYPTION_PADDING_RSA_PKCS1,
                    KeyProperties.ENCRYPTION_PADDING_RSA_OAEP};
            mSignaturePaddings = new String[] {KeyProperties.SIGNATURE_PADDING_RSA_PKCS1, KeyProperties.SIGNATURE_PADDING_RSA_PSS};
            return;
        }

        mValidityStart = time(protection.getKeyValidityStart());
        mValidityForOriginationEnd = time(protection.getKeyValidityForOriginationEnd());
        mValidityForConsumptionEnd = time(protection.getKeyValidityForConsumptionEnd());
        mPurposes = protection.getPurposes();
        mBlockModes = strings(protection.getBlockModes());
        mEncryptionPaddings = strings(protection.getEncryptionPaddings());
        mSignaturePaddings = strings(protection.getSignaturePaddings());
        mDigests = protection.isDigestsSpecified() ? strings(protection.getDigests()) : NO_STRINGS;
        mUserAuthenticationRequired = protection.isUserAuthenticationRequired();
        mUserConfirmationRequired = protection.isUserConfirmationRequired();
        mUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds = protection.getUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds();
        mUserAuthenticationType = protection.getUserAuthenticationType();
        mUserAuthenticationValidWhileOnBody = protection.isUserAuthenticationValidWhileOnBody();
        mInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment =
                protection.isUserAuthenticationRequired() && protection.isInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment();
        mUserPresenceRequired = protection.isUserPresenceRequired();
        mMaxUsageCount = protection.getMaxUsageCount();
    }

    void write(DataOutputStream output) throws IOException
    {
        output.writeUTF(mAlias);
        output.writeInt(mType);
        output.writeUTF(mAlgorithm != null ? mAlgorithm : "");
        writeBytes(output, mKeyEncoded);
        output.writeInt(mCertificateChain.length);
        for (byte[] certificate : mCertificateChain) writeBytes(output, certificate);
        output.writeLong(mCreationDate);
        output.writeInt(mOrigin);
        output.writeInt(mKeySize);
        output.writeLong(mValidityStart);
        output.writeLong(mValidityForOriginationEnd);
        output.writeLong(mValidityForConsumptionEnd);
        output.writeInt(mPurposes);
        writeStrings(output, mBlockModes);
        writeStrings(output, mEncryptionPaddings);
        writeStrings(output, mSignaturePaddings);
        writeStrings(output, mDigests);
        output.writeBoolean(mUserAuthenticationRequired);
        output.writeBoolean(mUserConfirmationRequired);
        output.writeInt(mUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds);
        output.writeInt(mUserAuthenticationType);
        output.writeBoolean(mUserAuthenticationValidWhileOnBody);
        output.writeBoolean(mInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment);
        output.writeBoolean(mUserPresenceRequired);
        output.writeInt(mMaxUsageCount);
    }

    static KeyStoreRecord read(DataInputStream input) throws IOException
    {
        KeyStoreRecord record = new KeyStoreRecord(input.readUTF(), input.readInt());
        String algorithm = input.readUTF();
        record.mAlgorithm = algorithm.isEmpty() ? null : algorithm;
        record.mKeyEncoded = readBytes(input);
        int chainLength = input.readInt();
        if (chainLength < 0 || chainLength > 64) throw new IOException("corrupt certificate chain");
        record.mCertificateChain = new byte[chainLength][];
        for (int index = 0; index < chainLength; index++) record.mCertificateChain[index] = readBytes(input);
        record.mCreationDate = input.readLong();
        record.mOrigin = input.readInt();
        record.mKeySize = input.readInt();
        record.mValidityStart = input.readLong();
        record.mValidityForOriginationEnd = input.readLong();
        record.mValidityForConsumptionEnd = input.readLong();
        record.mPurposes = input.readInt();
        record.mBlockModes = readStrings(input);
        record.mEncryptionPaddings = readStrings(input);
        record.mSignaturePaddings = readStrings(input);
        record.mDigests = readStrings(input);
        record.mUserAuthenticationRequired = input.readBoolean();
        record.mUserConfirmationRequired = input.readBoolean();
        record.mUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds = input.readInt();
        record.mUserAuthenticationType = input.readInt();
        record.mUserAuthenticationValidWhileOnBody = input.readBoolean();
        record.mInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment = input.readBoolean();
        record.mUserPresenceRequired = input.readBoolean();
        record.mMaxUsageCount = input.readInt();
        return record;
    }

    private static void writeBytes(DataOutputStream output, byte[] value) throws IOException
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            output.writeInt(-1);
            return;
        }
        output.writeInt(value.length);
        output.write(value);
    }

    private static byte[] readBytes(DataInputStream input) throws IOException
    {
        int length = input.readInt();
        if (length < 0) return null;
        if (length > (1 << 24)) throw new IOException("corrupt entry");
        byte[] value = new byte[length];
        input.readFully(value);
        return value;
    }

    private static void writeStrings(DataOutputStream output, String[] values) throws IOException
    {
        output.writeInt(values.length);
        for (String value : values) output.writeUTF(value != null ? value : "");
    }

    private static String[] readStrings(DataInputStream input) throws IOException
    {
        int count = input.readInt();
        if (count < 0 || count > 256) throw new IOException("corrupt entry");
        String[] values = new String[count];
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) values[index] = input.readUTF();
        return values;
    }
}
```
