`java/android/security/keystore/SelfSignedCertificate.java`:

```java
package android.security.keystore;

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.GeneralSecurityException;
import java.security.KeyPair;
import java.security.Signature;
import java.security.cert.CertificateFactory;
import java.security.cert.X509Certificate;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.TimeZone;

import javax.security.auth.x500.X500Principal;

final class SelfSignedCertificate
{
    private static final int TAG_INTEGER = 0x02;
    private static final int TAG_BIT_STRING = 0x03;
    private static final int TAG_NULL = 0x05;
    private static final int TAG_OBJECT_IDENTIFIER = 0x06;
    private static final int TAG_UTC_TIME = 0x17;
    private static final int TAG_GENERALIZED_TIME = 0x18;
    private static final int TAG_SEQUENCE = 0x30;
    private static final int TAG_CONTEXT_ZERO = 0xa0;

    private static final byte[] OID_SHA256_WITH_RSA = {0x2a, (byte)0x86, 0x48, (byte)0x86, (byte)0xf7, 0x0d, 0x01, 0x01, 0x0b};
    private static final byte[] OID_ECDSA_WITH_SHA256 = {0x2a, (byte)0x86, 0x48, (byte)0xce, 0x3d, 0x04, 0x03, 0x02};

    private SelfSignedCertificate()
    {
    }

    static X509Certificate create(KeyPair keyPair, X500Principal subject, BigInteger serialNumber, Date notBefore, Date notAfter)
            throws GeneralSecurityException
    {
        boolean rsa = "RSA".equalsIgnoreCase(keyPair.getPrivate().getAlgorithm());
        byte[] algorithmIdentifier = rsa ? sequence(encode(TAG_OBJECT_IDENTIFIER, OID_SHA256_WITH_RSA), encode(TAG_NULL, new byte[0]))
                                         : sequence(encode(TAG_OBJECT_IDENTIFIER, OID_ECDSA_WITH_SHA256));
        byte[] name = subject.getEncoded();

        byte[] tbsCertificate = sequence(
                encode(TAG_CONTEXT_ZERO, encode(TAG_INTEGER, new byte[] {2})),
                encode(TAG_INTEGER, serialNumber.toByteArray()),
                algorithmIdentifier,
                name,
                sequence(time(notBefore), time(notAfter)),
                name,
                keyPair.getPublic().getEncoded());

        Signature signature = Signature.getInstance(rsa ? "SHA256withRSA" : "SHA256withECDSA");
        signature.initSign(keyPair.getPrivate());
        signature.update(tbsCertificate);
        byte[] signatureBytes = signature.sign();

        byte[] bitString = new byte[signatureBytes.length + 1];
        System.arraycopy(signatureBytes, 0, bitString, 1, signatureBytes.length);

        byte[] certificate = sequence(tbsCertificate, algorithmIdentifier, encode(TAG_BIT_STRING, bitString));
        return (X509Certificate)CertificateFactory.getInstance("X.509").generateCertificate(new ByteArrayInputStream(certificate));
    }

    private static byte[] time(Date date)
    {
        Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance(TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC"), Locale.US);
        calendar.setTime(date);
        int year = calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR);
        boolean utc = year >= 1950 && year < 2050;
        SimpleDateFormat format = new SimpleDateFormat(utc ? "yyMMddHHmmss'Z'" : "yyyyMMddHHmmss'Z'", Locale.US);
        format.setTimeZone(TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC"));
        return encode(utc ? TAG_UTC_TIME : TAG_GENERALIZED_TIME, format.format(date).getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII));
    }

    private static byte[] sequence(byte[]... elements)
    {
        ByteArrayOutputStream content = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        for (byte[] element : elements) content.write(element, 0, element.length);
        return encode(TAG_SEQUENCE, content.toByteArray());
    }

    private static byte[] encode(int tag, byte[] content)
    {
        ByteArrayOutputStream output = new ByteArrayOutputStream(content.length + 6);
        output.write(tag);
        int length = content.length;
        if (length < 0x80)
        {
            output.write(length);
        }
        else
        {
            int byteCount = 0;
            for (int remaining = length; remaining > 0; remaining >>>= 8) byteCount++;
            output.write(0x80 | byteCount);
            for (int shift = (byteCount - 1) * 8; shift >= 0; shift -= 8) output.write((length >>> shift) & 0xff);
        }
        output.write(content, 0, content.length);
        return output.toByteArray();
    }
}
```

```java
package android.service.chooser;

import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.graphics.drawable.Icon;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class ChooserTarget implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<ChooserTarget> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ChooserTarget>()
    {
        @Override
        public ChooserTarget createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            CharSequence title = source.readString();
            Icon icon = source.readInt() != 0 ? Icon.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source) : null;
            float score = source.readFloat();
            ComponentName componentName = ComponentName.readFromParcel(source);
            Bundle extras = source.readBundle();
            return new ChooserTarget(title, icon, score, componentName, extras);
        }

        @Override
        public ChooserTarget[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ChooserTarget[size];
        }
    };

    private final CharSequence mTitle;
    private final Icon mIcon;
    private final float mScore;
    private final ComponentName mComponentName;
    private final Bundle mIntentExtras;

    public ChooserTarget(CharSequence title, Icon icon, float score, ComponentName componentName, Bundle intentExtras)
    {
        if (score > 1.f || score < 0.f)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Score " + score + " out of range; must be between 0.0f and 1.0f");
        }

        mTitle = title;
        mIcon = icon;
        mScore = score;
        mComponentName = componentName;
        mIntentExtras = intentExtras;
    }

    public CharSequence getTitle()
    {
        return mTitle;
    }

    public Icon getIcon()
    {
        return mIcon;
    }

    public float getScore()
    {
        return mScore;
    }

    public ComponentName getComponentName()
    {
        return mComponentName;
    }

    public Bundle getIntentExtras()
    {
        return mIntentExtras;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "ChooserTarget{" + mComponentName + ", " + mIntentExtras + ", '" + mTitle + "', " + mScore + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeString(mTitle == null ? null : mTitle.toString());
        if (mIcon == null)
        {
            destination.writeInt(0);
        }
        else
        {
            destination.writeInt(1);
            mIcon.writeToParcel(destination, flags);
        }
        destination.writeFloat(mScore);
        ComponentName.writeToParcel(mComponentName, destination);
        destination.writeBundle(mIntentExtras);
    }
```

`java/android/service/media/MediaBrowserService.java`:

```java
package android.service.media;

import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.media.browse.MediaBrowser;
import android.media.session.MediaSession;
import android.media.session.MediaSessionManager;
import android.os.Binder;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.IInterface;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.util.Log;

import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import java.util.function.Supplier;

public abstract class MediaBrowserService extends Service
{
    public static final String SERVICE_INTERFACE = "android.media.browse.MediaBrowserService";

    private static final String TAG = "MediaBrowserService";

    private static final int RESULT_FLAG_OPTION_NOT_HANDLED = 1;

    private final List<Connection> mConnections = new ArrayList<>();
    private Connection mCurrentConnection;
    private MediaSession.Token mSession;
    private IBinder mBinder;
    private Handler mHandler;

    private static final class Connection
    {
        String packageName;
        int pid;
        int uid;
        Bundle rootHints;
        BrowserRoot root;
        final List<Subscription> subscriptions = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    private static final class Subscription
    {
        String parentId;
        Bundle options;
        Consumer<List<MediaBrowser.MediaItem>> listener;
    }

    public MediaBrowserService()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public void onCreate()
    {
        super.onCreate();

        Looper main = Looper.getMainLooper();
        mHandler = main == null ? null : new Handler(main);
        Binder binder = new Binder(BINDER_DESCRIPTOR);
        binder.attachInterface(new LocalInterface(this, binder), BINDER_DESCRIPTOR);
        mBinder = binder;
    }

    private static final String BINDER_DESCRIPTOR = "android.service.media.IMediaBrowserService";

    private static final class LocalInterface implements IInterface, Supplier<MediaBrowserService>
    {
        private final MediaBrowserService mService;
        private final IBinder mBinder;

        LocalInterface(MediaBrowserService service, IBinder binder)
        {
            mService = service;
            mBinder = binder;
        }

        @Override
        public IBinder asBinder()
        {
            return mBinder;
        }

        @Override
        public MediaBrowserService get()
        {
            return mService;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public IBinder onBind(Intent intent)
    {
        if (SERVICE_INTERFACE.equals(intent == null ? null : intent.getAction())) return mBinder;
        return null;
    }

    public void dump(FileDescriptor fd, PrintWriter writer, String[] args)
    {
        writer.println("MediaBrowserService: " + mConnections.size() + " connection(s), session " + mSession);
    }

    public abstract BrowserRoot onGetRoot(String clientPackageName, int clientUid, Bundle rootHints);

    public abstract void onLoadChildren(String parentId, Result<List<MediaBrowser.MediaItem>> result);

    public void onLoadChildren(String parentId, Result<List<MediaBrowser.MediaItem>> result, Bundle options)
    {
        result.setFlags(RESULT_FLAG_OPTION_NOT_HANDLED);
        onLoadChildren(parentId, result);
    }

    public void onLoadItem(String itemId, Result<MediaBrowser.MediaItem> result)
    {
        result.setFlags(RESULT_FLAG_OPTION_NOT_HANDLED);
        result.sendResult(null);
    }

    public void setSessionToken(final MediaSession.Token token)
    {
        if (token == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Session token may not be null.");
        if (mSession != null) throw new IllegalStateException("The session token has already been set.");

        mSession = token;
    }

    public MediaSession.Token getSessionToken()
    {
        return mSession;
    }

    public final Bundle getBrowserRootHints()
    {
        if (mCurrentConnection == null)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("This should be called inside of onGetRoot or onLoadChildren or onLoadItem methods");
        }

        return mCurrentConnection.rootHints == null ? null : new Bundle(mCurrentConnection.rootHints);
    }

    public final MediaSessionManager.RemoteUserInfo getCurrentBrowserInfo()
    {
        if (mCurrentConnection == null)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("This should be called inside of onGetRoot or onLoadChildren or onLoadItem methods");
        }

        return new MediaSessionManager.RemoteUserInfo(mCurrentConnection.packageName, mCurrentConnection.pid,
                                                      mCurrentConnection.uid);
    }

    public void notifyChildrenChanged(String parentId)
    {
        notifyChildrenChangedInternal(parentId, null);
    }

    public void notifyChildrenChanged(String parentId, Bundle options)
    {
        if (options == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("options cannot be null in notifyChildrenChanged");

        notifyChildrenChangedInternal(parentId, options);
    }

    public final BrowserRoot connectBrowser(String packageName, int pid, int uid, Bundle rootHints)
    {
        Connection connection = new Connection();
        connection.packageName = packageName;
        connection.pid = pid;
        connection.uid = uid;
        connection.rootHints = rootHints;

        mCurrentConnection = connection;
        try
        {
            connection.root = onGetRoot(packageName, uid, rootHints);
        }
        finally
        {
            mCurrentConnection = null;
        }

        if (connection.root == null)
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "no root for client " + packageName + " from service " + getClass().getName());
            return null;
        }

        mConnections.add(connection);
        return connection.root;
    }

    public final void disconnectBrowser(String packageName, int uid)
    {
        for (int index = mConnections.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            Connection connection = mConnections.get(index);
            if (Objects.equals(connection.packageName, packageName) && connection.uid == uid) mConnections.remove(index);
        }
    }

    public final void subscribeBrowser(String packageName, int uid, String parentId, Bundle options,
                                       Consumer<List<MediaBrowser.MediaItem>> listener)
    {
        Connection connection = connectionFor(packageName, uid);
        if (connection == null) return;

        Subscription subscription = new Subscription();
        subscription.parentId = parentId;
        subscription.options = options;
        subscription.listener = listener;
        connection.subscriptions.add(subscription);

        performLoadChildren(connection, subscription);
    }

    public final void unsubscribeBrowser(String packageName, int uid, String parentId)
    {
        Connection connection = connectionFor(packageName, uid);
        if (connection == null) return;

        for (int index = connection.subscriptions.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            if (Objects.equals(connection.subscriptions.get(index).parentId, parentId)) connection.subscriptions.remove(index);
        }
    }

    public final void loadItemForBrowser(String packageName, int uid, String itemId,
                                         final Consumer<MediaBrowser.MediaItem> listener)
    {
        Connection connection = connectionFor(packageName, uid);
        if (connection == null) return;

        Result<MediaBrowser.MediaItem> result = new Result<MediaBrowser.MediaItem>(itemId)
        {
            @Override
            void onResultSent(MediaBrowser.MediaItem item, int flags)
            {
                if (listener != null) listener.accept(item);
            }
        };

        mCurrentConnection = connection;
        try
        {
            onLoadItem(itemId, result);
        }
        finally
        {
            mCurrentConnection = null;
        }

        if (!result.isDone())
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("onLoadItem must call detach() or sendResult() before returning for id=" + itemId);
        }
    }

    private void notifyChildrenChangedInternal(final String parentId, final Bundle options)
    {
        if (parentId == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("parentId cannot be null in notifyChildrenChanged");

        Runnable work = new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                for (Connection connection : new ArrayList<>(mConnections))
                {
                    for (Subscription subscription : new ArrayList<>(connection.subscriptions))
                    {
                        if (!parentId.equals(subscription.parentId)) continue;
                        if (options != null && subscription.options != null && !optionsOverlap(options, subscription.options))
                        {
                            continue;
                        }

                        performLoadChildren(connection, subscription);
                    }
                }
            }
        };

        if (mHandler != null) mHandler.post(work);
        else work.run();
    }

    private void performLoadChildren(Connection connection, final Subscription subscription)
    {
        Result<List<MediaBrowser.MediaItem>> result = new Result<List<MediaBrowser.MediaItem>>(subscription.parentId)
        {
            @Override
            void onResultSent(List<MediaBrowser.MediaItem> list, int flags)
            {
                List<MediaBrowser.MediaItem> delivered = list;
                if ((flags & RESULT_FLAG_OPTION_NOT_HANDLED) != 0 && list != null) delivered = page(list, subscription.options);
                if (subscription.listener != null) subscription.listener.accept(delivered);
            }
        };

        mCurrentConnection = connection;
        try
        {
            if (subscription.options == null) onLoadChildren(subscription.parentId, result);
            else onLoadChildren(subscription.parentId, result, subscription.options);
        }
        finally
        {
            mCurrentConnection = null;
        }

        if (!result.isDone())
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("onLoadChildren must call detach() or sendResult() before returning for package="
                                            + connection.packageName + " id=" + subscription.parentId);
        }
    }

    private static List<MediaBrowser.MediaItem> page(List<MediaBrowser.MediaItem> list, Bundle options)
    {
        if (options == null) return list;

        int page = options.getInt(MediaBrowser.EXTRA_PAGE, -1);
        int pageSize = options.getInt(MediaBrowser.EXTRA_PAGE_SIZE, -1);
        if (page == -1 && pageSize == -1) return list;

        int fromIndex = pageSize * page;
        int toIndex = fromIndex + pageSize;
        if (page < 0 || pageSize < 1 || fromIndex >= list.size()) return new ArrayList<>();
        if (toIndex > list.size()) toIndex = list.size();
        return list.subList(fromIndex, toIndex);
    }

    private static boolean optionsOverlap(Bundle first, Bundle second)
    {
        int firstPage = first.getInt(MediaBrowser.EXTRA_PAGE, -1);
        int secondPage = second.getInt(MediaBrowser.EXTRA_PAGE, -1);
        int firstSize = first.getInt(MediaBrowser.EXTRA_PAGE_SIZE, -1);
        int secondSize = second.getInt(MediaBrowser.EXTRA_PAGE_SIZE, -1);

        long firstStart = firstPage == -1 || firstSize == -1 ? 0 : (long)firstSize * firstPage;
        long firstEnd = firstPage == -1 || firstSize == -1 ? Long.MAX_VALUE : firstStart + firstSize - 1;
        long secondStart = secondPage == -1 || secondSize == -1 ? 0 : (long)secondSize * secondPage;
        long secondEnd = secondPage == -1 || secondSize == -1 ? Long.MAX_VALUE : secondStart + secondSize - 1;

        return firstEnd >= secondStart && secondEnd >= firstStart;
    }

    private Connection connectionFor(String packageName, int uid)
    {
        for (Connection connection : mConnections)
        {
            if (Objects.equals(connection.packageName, packageName) && connection.uid == uid) return connection;
        }

        return null;
    }

    public class Result<T>
    {
        private final Object mDebug;
        private boolean mDetachCalled;
        private boolean mSendResultCalled;
        private int mFlags;

        Result(Object debug)
        {
            mDebug = debug;
        }

        public void sendResult(T result)
        {
            if (mSendResultCalled) throw new IllegalStateException("sendResult() called twice for: " + mDebug);

            mSendResultCalled = true;
            onResultSent(result, mFlags);
        }

        public void detach()
        {
            if (mDetachCalled)
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException("detach() called when detach() had already been called for: " + mDebug);
            }
            if (mSendResultCalled)
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException("detach() called when sendResult() had already been called for: " + mDebug);
            }

            mDetachCalled = true;
        }

        boolean isDone()
        {
            return mDetachCalled || mSendResultCalled;
        }

        void setFlags(int flags)
        {
            mFlags = flags;
        }

        void onResultSent(T result, int flags)
        {
        }
    }

    public static final class BrowserRoot
    {
        public static final String EXTRA_RECENT = "android.service.media.extra.RECENT";
        public static final String EXTRA_OFFLINE = "android.service.media.extra.OFFLINE";
        public static final String EXTRA_SUGGESTED = "android.service.media.extra.SUGGESTED";

        private final String mRootId;
        private final Bundle mExtras;

        public BrowserRoot(String rootId, Bundle extras)
        {
            if (rootId == null)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("The root id in BrowserRoot cannot be null. Use null for BrowserRoot instead.");
            }

            mRootId = rootId;
            mExtras = extras;
        }

        public String getRootId()
        {
            return mRootId;
        }

        public Bundle getExtras()
        {
            return mExtras;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/service/notification/StatusBarNotification.java`:

```java
package android.service.notification;

import android.app.Notification;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.os.UserHandle;

public class StatusBarNotification implements Parcelable
{
    private final String mPackageName;
    private final String mOpPackageName;
    private final int mId;
    private final String mTag;
    private final int mUid;
    private final int mInitialPid;
    private final long mPostTime;
    private final Notification mNotification;
    private final UserHandle mUser;
    private String mOverrideGroupKey;
    private String mKey;
    private String mGroupKey;

    public StatusBarNotification(String packageName, String opPackageName, int id, String tag, int uid, int initialPid,
                                 int score, Notification notification, UserHandle user, long postTime)
    {
        if (packageName == null) throw new NullPointerException();
        if (notification == null) throw new NullPointerException();

        mPackageName = packageName;
        mOpPackageName = opPackageName;
        mId = id;
        mTag = tag;
        mUid = uid;
        mInitialPid = initialPid;
        mNotification = notification;
        mUser = user == null ? new UserHandle(0) : user;
        mPostTime = postTime;
        updateKeys();
    }

    public StatusBarNotification(Parcel parcel)
    {
        mPackageName = parcel.readString();
        mOpPackageName = parcel.readString();
        mId = parcel.readInt();
        mTag = parcel.readString();
        mUid = parcel.readInt();
        mInitialPid = parcel.readInt();
        Notification notification = parcel.readParcelable(Notification.class.getClassLoader());
        mNotification = notification == null ? new Notification() : notification;
        UserHandle user = parcel.readParcelable(UserHandle.class.getClassLoader());
        mUser = user == null ? new UserHandle(0) : user;
        mPostTime = parcel.readLong();
        mOverrideGroupKey = parcel.readString();
        updateKeys();
    }

    private void updateKeys()
    {
        mKey = mUser.getIdentifier() + "|" + mPackageName + "|" + mId + "|" + mTag + "|" + mUid;

        String group = mNotification.getGroup();
        String sortKey = mNotification.getSortKey();

        if (mOverrideGroupKey != null) mGroupKey = mUser.getIdentifier() + "|" + mPackageName + "|g:" + mOverrideGroupKey;
        else if (group == null && sortKey == null) mGroupKey = mKey;
        else if (group != null) mGroupKey = mUser.getIdentifier() + "|" + mPackageName + "|g:" + group;
        else mGroupKey = mUser.getIdentifier() + "|" + mPackageName + "|p:" + mNotification.priority;
    }

    public String getPackageName()
    {
        return mPackageName;
    }

    public String getOpPkg()
    {
        return mOpPackageName;
    }

    public int getId()
    {
        return mId;
    }

    public String getTag()
    {
        return mTag;
    }

    public int getUid()
    {
        return mUid;
    }

    public String getKey()
    {
        return mKey;
    }

    public String getGroupKey()
    {
        return mGroupKey;
    }

    public String getOverrideGroupKey()
    {
        return mOverrideGroupKey;
    }

    public void setOverrideGroupKey(String overrideGroupKey)
    {
        mOverrideGroupKey = overrideGroupKey;
        updateKeys();
    }

    public long getPostTime()
    {
        return mPostTime;
    }

    public Notification getNotification()
    {
        return mNotification;
    }

    public UserHandle getUser()
    {
        return mUser;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public int getUserId()
    {
        return mUser.getIdentifier();
    }

    public boolean isClearable()
    {
        return (mNotification.flags & Notification.FLAG_ONGOING_EVENT) == 0
               && (mNotification.flags & Notification.FLAG_NO_CLEAR) == 0;
    }

    public boolean isOngoing()
    {
        return (mNotification.flags & Notification.FLAG_ONGOING_EVENT) != 0;
    }

    public boolean isGroup()
    {
        return mOverrideGroupKey != null || isAppGroup();
    }

    public boolean isAppGroup()
    {
        return mNotification.getGroup() != null || mNotification.getSortKey() != null;
    }

    @Override
    public StatusBarNotification clone()
    {
        StatusBarNotification cloned = new StatusBarNotification(mPackageName, mOpPackageName, mId, mTag, mUid, mInitialPid,
                                                                 0, mNotification.clone(), mUser, mPostTime);
        cloned.setOverrideGroupKey(mOverrideGroupKey);
        return cloned;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "StatusBarNotification(pkg=" + mPackageName + " user=" + mUser + " id=" + mId + " tag=" + mTag + " key=" + mKey
               + ": " + mNotification + ")";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        parcel.writeString(mPackageName);
        parcel.writeString(mOpPackageName);
        parcel.writeInt(mId);
        parcel.writeString(mTag);
        parcel.writeInt(mUid);
        parcel.writeInt(mInitialPid);
        parcel.writeParcelable(mNotification, flags);
        parcel.writeParcelable(mUser, flags);
        parcel.writeLong(mPostTime);
        parcel.writeString(mOverrideGroupKey);
    }

    public static final Creator<StatusBarNotification> CREATOR = new Creator<StatusBarNotification>()
    {
        @Override
        public StatusBarNotification createFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
        {
            return new StatusBarNotification(parcel);
        }

        @Override
        public StatusBarNotification[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new StatusBarNotification[size];
        }
    };
}
```

```java
package android.service.quicksettings;

import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.graphics.drawable.Icon;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class Tile implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int STATE_UNAVAILABLE = 0;
    public static final int STATE_INACTIVE = 1;
    public static final int STATE_ACTIVE = 2;

    private static final String TAG = "Tile";

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<Tile> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<Tile>()
    {
        @Override
        public Tile createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            Tile tile = new Tile();
            tile.mIcon = source.readInt() != 0 ? Icon.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source) : null;
            tile.mState = source.readInt();
            tile.mLabel = source.readString();
            tile.mSubtitle = source.readString();
            tile.mContentDescription = source.readString();
            tile.mStateDescription = source.readString();
            return tile;
        }

        @Override
        public Tile[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Tile[size];
        }
    };

    private Icon mIcon;
    private CharSequence mLabel;
    private CharSequence mSubtitle;
    private CharSequence mContentDescription;
    private CharSequence mStateDescription;
    private PendingIntent mPendingIntent;
    private int mState = STATE_ACTIVE;

    Tile()
    {
    }

    public int getState()
    {
        return mState;
    }

    }

    @Override

    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        if (mIcon == null)

            destination.writeInt(0);
        }
        else
        {
            destination.writeInt(1);
            mIcon.writeToParcel(destination, flags);
        }
        destination.writeInt(mState);
        destination.writeString(asString(mLabel));
        destination.writeString(asString(mSubtitle));
        destination.writeString(asString(mContentDescription));
        destination.writeString(asString(mStateDescription));
    }

    {
        return value == null ? null : value.toString();
```

```java
        startActivity(launched);
    }

    {

        {
            Log.w(TAG, "the pending intent for the tile was cancelled", cause);
        }
```

```java
package android.speech;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class RecognitionSupport implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<RecognitionSupport> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<RecognitionSupport>()
    {
        @Override
        public RecognitionSupport createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            Builder builder = new Builder();
            builder.setInstalledOnDeviceLanguages(source.createStringArrayList());
            builder.setPendingOnDeviceLanguages(source.createStringArrayList());
            builder.setSupportedOnDeviceLanguages(source.createStringArrayList());
            builder.setOnlineLanguages(source.createStringArrayList());
            return builder.build();
        }

        @Override
        public RecognitionSupport[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new RecognitionSupport[size];
        }
    };

    private final List<String> mInstalledOnDeviceLanguages;
    private final List<String> mPendingOnDeviceLanguages;
    private final List<String> mSupportedOnDeviceLanguages;
    private final List<String> mOnlineLanguages;

    private RecognitionSupport(Builder builder)
    {
        mInstalledOnDeviceLanguages = new ArrayList<>(builder.mInstalledOnDeviceLanguages);
        mPendingOnDeviceLanguages = new ArrayList<>(builder.mPendingOnDeviceLanguages);
        mSupportedOnDeviceLanguages = new ArrayList<>(builder.mSupportedOnDeviceLanguages);
        mOnlineLanguages = new ArrayList<>(builder.mOnlineLanguages);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object object)
    {
        if (this == object) return true;
        if (!(object instanceof RecognitionSupport)) return false;

        RecognitionSupport other = (RecognitionSupport)object;
        return mInstalledOnDeviceLanguages.equals(other.mInstalledOnDeviceLanguages)
            && mPendingOnDeviceLanguages.equals(other.mPendingOnDeviceLanguages)
            && mSupportedOnDeviceLanguages.equals(other.mSupportedOnDeviceLanguages) && mOnlineLanguages.equals(other.mOnlineLanguages);
    }

    public List<String> getInstalledOnDeviceLanguages()
    {
        return mInstalledOnDeviceLanguages;
    }

    public List<String> getOnlineLanguages()
    {
        return mOnlineLanguages;
    }

    public List<String> getPendingOnDeviceLanguages()
    {
        return mPendingOnDeviceLanguages;
    }

    public List<String> getSupportedOnDeviceLanguages()
    {
        return mSupportedOnDeviceLanguages;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mInstalledOnDeviceLanguages, mPendingOnDeviceLanguages, mSupportedOnDeviceLanguages, mOnlineLanguages);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "RecognitionSupport { installedOnDeviceLanguages = " + mInstalledOnDeviceLanguages + ", pendingOnDeviceLanguages = "
            + mPendingOnDeviceLanguages + ", supportedOnDeviceLanguages = " + mSupportedOnDeviceLanguages + ", onlineLanguages = "
            + mOnlineLanguages + " }";
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel destination, int flags)
    {
        destination.writeStringList(mInstalledOnDeviceLanguages);
        destination.writeStringList(mPendingOnDeviceLanguages);
        destination.writeStringList(mSupportedOnDeviceLanguages);
        destination.writeStringList(mOnlineLanguages);
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private List<String> mInstalledOnDeviceLanguages = new ArrayList<>();
        private List<String> mPendingOnDeviceLanguages = new ArrayList<>();
        private List<String> mSupportedOnDeviceLanguages = new ArrayList<>();
        private List<String> mOnlineLanguages = new ArrayList<>();

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public Builder addInstalledOnDeviceLanguage(String language)
        {
            mInstalledOnDeviceLanguages.add(Objects.requireNonNull(language));
            return this;
        }

        public Builder addOnlineLanguage(String language)
        {
            mOnlineLanguages.add(Objects.requireNonNull(language));
            return this;
        }

        public Builder addPendingOnDeviceLanguage(String language)
        {
            mPendingOnDeviceLanguages.add(Objects.requireNonNull(language));
            return this;
        }

        public Builder addSupportedOnDeviceLanguage(String language)
        {
            mSupportedOnDeviceLanguages.add(Objects.requireNonNull(language));
            return this;
        }

        public RecognitionSupport build()
        {
            return new RecognitionSupport(this);
        }

        public Builder setInstalledOnDeviceLanguages(List<String> languages)
        {
            mInstalledOnDeviceLanguages = new ArrayList<>(Objects.requireNonNull(languages));
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setOnlineLanguages(List<String> languages)
        {
            mOnlineLanguages = new ArrayList<>(Objects.requireNonNull(languages));
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setPendingOnDeviceLanguages(List<String> languages)
        {
            mPendingOnDeviceLanguages = new ArrayList<>(Objects.requireNonNull(languages));
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setSupportedOnDeviceLanguages(List<String> languages)
        {
            mSupportedOnDeviceLanguages = new ArrayList<>(Objects.requireNonNull(languages));
            return this;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.speech;

import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;

import java.util.concurrent.Executor;

public class SpeechRecognizer
{
    public static final String CONFIDENCE_SCORES = "confidence_scores";
    public static final String DETECTED_LANGUAGE = "detected_language";
    public static final int ERROR_AUDIO = 3;
    public static final int ERROR_CANNOT_CHECK_SUPPORT = 14;
    public static final int ERROR_CANNOT_LISTEN_TO_DOWNLOAD_EVENTS = 15;
    public static final int ERROR_CLIENT = 5;
    public static final int ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS = 9;
    public static final int ERROR_LANGUAGE_NOT_SUPPORTED = 12;
    public static final int ERROR_LANGUAGE_UNAVAILABLE = 13;
    public static final int ERROR_NETWORK = 2;
    public static final int ERROR_NETWORK_TIMEOUT = 1;
    public static final int ERROR_NO_MATCH = 7;
    public static final int ERROR_RECOGNIZER_BUSY = 8;
    public static final int ERROR_SERVER = 4;
    public static final int ERROR_SERVER_DISCONNECTED = 11;
    public static final int ERROR_SPEECH_TIMEOUT = 6;
    public static final int ERROR_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS = 10;
    public static final String LANGUAGE_DETECTION_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL = "language_detection_confidence_level";
    public static final int LANGUAGE_DETECTION_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL_CONFIDENT = 2;
    public static final int LANGUAGE_DETECTION_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL_HIGHLY_CONFIDENT = 3;
    public static final int LANGUAGE_DETECTION_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL_NOT_CONFIDENT = 1;
    public static final int LANGUAGE_DETECTION_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL_UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final String LANGUAGE_SWITCH_RESULT = "language_switch_result";
    public static final int LANGUAGE_SWITCH_RESULT_FAILED = 2;
    public static final int LANGUAGE_SWITCH_RESULT_NOT_ATTEMPTED = 0;
    public static final int LANGUAGE_SWITCH_RESULT_SKIPPED_NO_MODEL = 3;
    public static final int LANGUAGE_SWITCH_RESULT_SUCCEEDED = 1;
    public static final String RECOGNITION_PARTS = "recognition_parts";
    public static final String RESULTS_ALTERNATIVES = "results_alternatives";
    public static final String RESULTS_RECOGNITION = "results_recognition";
    public static final String TOP_LOCALE_ALTERNATIVES = "top_locale_alternatives";

    private final Context mContext;
    private final ComponentName mServiceComponent;
    private final Handler mHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private RecognitionListener mListener;
    private boolean mDestroyed;

    SpeechRecognizer(Context context, ComponentName serviceComponent)
    {
        mContext = context;
        mServiceComponent = serviceComponent;
    }

    public void cancel()
    {
        checkIsCalledFromMainThread();
    }

    public void checkRecognitionSupport(Intent recognizerIntent, Executor executor, final RecognitionSupportCallback supportListener)
    {
        if (recognizerIntent == null) throw new NullPointerException("intent must not be null");
        if (executor == null) throw new NullPointerException("executor must not be null");
        if (supportListener == null) throw new NullPointerException("listener must not be null");

        executor.execute(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                supportListener.onError(ERROR_CANNOT_CHECK_SUPPORT);
            }
        });
    }

    public static SpeechRecognizer createOnDeviceSpeechRecognizer(Context context)
    {
        if (context == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Context cannot be null");

        return new SpeechRecognizer(context, null);
    }

    public static SpeechRecognizer createSpeechRecognizer(Context context)
    {
        return createSpeechRecognizer(context, null);
    }

    public static SpeechRecognizer createSpeechRecognizer(Context context, ComponentName serviceComponent)
    {
        if (context == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Context cannot be null");

        return new SpeechRecognizer(context, serviceComponent);
    }

    public void destroy()
    {
        mDestroyed = true;
        mListener = null;
    }

    public static boolean isOnDeviceRecognitionAvailable(Context context)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public static boolean isRecognitionAvailable(Context context)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void setRecognitionListener(RecognitionListener listener)
    {
        checkIsCalledFromMainThread();
        mListener = listener;
    }

    public void startListening(Intent recognizerIntent)
    {
        if (recognizerIntent == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("intent must not be null");

        checkIsCalledFromMainThread();
        reportError(ERROR_CLIENT);
    }

    public void stopListening()
    {
        checkIsCalledFromMainThread();
    }

    public void triggerModelDownload(Intent recognizerIntent)
    {
        if (recognizerIntent == null) throw new NullPointerException("intent must not be null");

        checkIsCalledFromMainThread();
        reportError(ERROR_CLIENT);
    }

    public void triggerModelDownload(Intent recognizerIntent, Executor executor, final ModelDownloadListener listener)
    {
        if (recognizerIntent == null) throw new NullPointerException("intent must not be null");
        if (executor == null) throw new NullPointerException("executor must not be null");
        if (listener == null) throw new NullPointerException("listener must not be null");

        checkIsCalledFromMainThread();
        executor.execute(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                listener.onError(ERROR_CANNOT_LISTEN_TO_DOWNLOAD_EVENTS);
            }
        });
    }

    private void reportError(final int error)
    {
        mHandler.post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                RecognitionListener listener = mListener;

                if (listener != null && !mDestroyed) listener.onError(error);
            }
        });
    }

    private static void checkIsCalledFromMainThread()
    {
        if (Looper.myLooper() != Looper.getMainLooper())
        {
            throw new RuntimeException("SpeechRecognizer should be used only from the application's main thread");
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/telecom/CallAudioState.java`:

```java
package android.telecom;

import android.bluetooth.BluetoothDevice;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class CallAudioState implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int ROUTE_EARPIECE = 0x00000001;
    public static final int ROUTE_BLUETOOTH = 0x00000002;
    public static final int ROUTE_WIRED_HEADSET = 0x00000004;
    public static final int ROUTE_SPEAKER = 0x00000008;
    public static final int ROUTE_STREAMING = 0x00000010;
    public static final int ROUTE_WIRED_OR_EARPIECE = ROUTE_EARPIECE | ROUTE_WIRED_HEADSET;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<CallAudioState> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<CallAudioState>()
    {
        @Override
        public CallAudioState createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            boolean muted = source.readBoolean();
            int route = source.readInt();
            int supportedRouteMask = source.readInt();
            BluetoothDevice active = source.readBoolean() ? BluetoothDevice.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source) : null;
            List<BluetoothDevice> devices = new ArrayList<>();
            source.readTypedList(devices, BluetoothDevice.CREATOR);
            return new CallAudioState(muted, route, supportedRouteMask, active, devices);
        }

        @Override
        public CallAudioState[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new CallAudioState[size];
        }
    };

    private final boolean mIsMuted;
    private final int mRoute;
    private final int mSupportedRouteMask;
    private final BluetoothDevice mActiveBluetoothDevice;
    private final List<BluetoothDevice> mSupportedBluetoothDevices;

    public CallAudioState(boolean muted, int route, int supportedRouteMask)
    {
        this(muted, route, supportedRouteMask, null, null);
    }

    CallAudioState(boolean muted, int route, int supportedRouteMask, BluetoothDevice activeBluetoothDevice,
        Collection<BluetoothDevice> supportedBluetoothDevices)
    {
        mIsMuted = muted;
        mRoute = route;
        mSupportedRouteMask = supportedRouteMask;
        mActiveBluetoothDevice = activeBluetoothDevice;
        mSupportedBluetoothDevices = supportedBluetoothDevices == null ? new ArrayList<>() : new ArrayList<>(supportedBluetoothDevices);
    }

    public boolean isMuted()
    {
        return mIsMuted;
    }

    public int getRoute()
    {
        return mRoute;
    }

    public int getSupportedRouteMask()
    {
        return mSupportedRouteMask;
    }

    public BluetoothDevice getActiveBluetoothDevice()
    {
        return mActiveBluetoothDevice;
    }

    public Collection<BluetoothDevice> getSupportedBluetoothDevices()
    {
        return Collections.unmodifiableList(mSupportedBluetoothDevices);
    }

    public static String audioRouteToString(int route)
    {
        if (route == 0 || (route & ~(ROUTE_EARPIECE | ROUTE_BLUETOOTH | ROUTE_WIRED_HEADSET | ROUTE_SPEAKER | ROUTE_STREAMING)) != 0)
        {
            return "UNKNOWN";
        }
        StringBuilder buffer = new StringBuilder();
        appendRoute(buffer, route, ROUTE_EARPIECE, "EARPIECE");
        appendRoute(buffer, route, ROUTE_BLUETOOTH, "BLUETOOTH");
        appendRoute(buffer, route, ROUTE_WIRED_HEADSET, "WIRED_HEADSET");
        appendRoute(buffer, route, ROUTE_SPEAKER, "SPEAKER");
        appendRoute(buffer, route, ROUTE_STREAMING, "STREAMING");
        return buffer.toString();
    }

    private static void appendRoute(StringBuilder buffer, int route, int flag, String name)
    {
        if ((route & flag) != flag) return;
        if (buffer.length() > 0) buffer.append(", ");
        buffer.append(name);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeBoolean(mIsMuted);
        dest.writeInt(mRoute);
        dest.writeInt(mSupportedRouteMask);
        dest.writeBoolean(mActiveBluetoothDevice != null);
        if (mActiveBluetoothDevice != null) mActiveBluetoothDevice.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        dest.writeTypedList(mSupportedBluetoothDevices);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof CallAudioState)) return false;
        CallAudioState state = (CallAudioState)other;
        return mIsMuted == state.mIsMuted && mRoute == state.mRoute && mSupportedRouteMask == state.mSupportedRouteMask
            && Objects.equals(mActiveBluetoothDevice, state.mActiveBluetoothDevice)
            && mSupportedBluetoothDevices.equals(state.mSupportedBluetoothDevices);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mIsMuted, mRoute, mSupportedRouteMask, mActiveBluetoothDevice, mSupportedBluetoothDevices);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "[AudioState isMuted: " + mIsMuted + ", route: " + audioRouteToString(mRoute) + ", supportedRouteMask: "
            + audioRouteToString(mSupportedRouteMask) + ", activeBluetoothDevice: [" + mActiveBluetoothDevice
            + "], supportedBluetoothDevices: [" + mSupportedBluetoothDevices + "]]";
    }
}
```

`java/android/telecom/CallEndpoint.java`:

```java
package android.telecom;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.ParcelUuid;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.text.TextUtils;

import java.util.Objects;

public final class CallEndpoint implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int TYPE_UNKNOWN = -1;
    public static final int TYPE_EARPIECE = 1;
    public static final int TYPE_BLUETOOTH = 2;
    public static final int TYPE_WIRED_HEADSET = 3;
    public static final int TYPE_SPEAKER = 4;
    public static final int TYPE_STREAMING = 5;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<CallEndpoint> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<CallEndpoint>()
    {
        @Override
        public CallEndpoint createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            String name = source.readString();
            int type = source.readInt();
            ParcelUuid identifier = ParcelUuid.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            return new CallEndpoint(name, type, identifier);
        }

        @Override
        public CallEndpoint[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new CallEndpoint[size];
        }
    };

    private final CharSequence mName;
    private final int mType;
    private final ParcelUuid mIdentifier;

    public CallEndpoint(CharSequence name, int type, ParcelUuid id)
    {
        mName = name;
        mType = type;
        mIdentifier = id;
    }

    public CharSequence getEndpointName()
    {
        return mName;
    }

    public int getEndpointType()
    {
        return mType;
    }

    public ParcelUuid getIdentifier()
    {
        return mIdentifier;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mName == null ? null : mName.toString());
        dest.writeInt(mType);
        mIdentifier.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof CallEndpoint)) return false;
        CallEndpoint endpoint = (CallEndpoint)other;
        return TextUtils.equals(mName, endpoint.mName) && mType == endpoint.mType && Objects.equals(mIdentifier, endpoint.mIdentifier);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mName == null ? null : mName.toString(), mType, mIdentifier);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        String[] types = {"UNKNOWN", "EARPIECE", "BLUETOOTH", "WIRED_HEADSET", "SPEAKER", "STREAMING"};
        String type = mType >= TYPE_EARPIECE && mType <= TYPE_STREAMING ? types[mType] : types[0];
        return "[CallEndpoint Name: " + mName + ", Type: " + type + ", Identifier: " + mIdentifier + "]";
    }
```

```java
package android.telecom;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class CallEndpointException extends RuntimeException implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int ERROR_ENDPOINT_DOES_NOT_EXIST = 1;
    public static final int ERROR_REQUEST_TIME_OUT = 2;
    public static final int ERROR_ANOTHER_REQUEST = 3;
    public static final int ERROR_UNSPECIFIED = 4;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<CallEndpointException> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<CallEndpointException>()
    {
        @Override
        public CallEndpointException createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            String message = source.readString();
            return new CallEndpointException(message, source.readInt());
        }

        @Override
        public CallEndpointException[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new CallEndpointException[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mCode;

    public CallEndpointException(String message, int code)
    {
        super(message);
        mCode = code;
    }

    public int getCode()
    {
        return mCode;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(getMessage());
        dest.writeInt(mCode);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.telecom;

import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.SystemClock;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

public abstract class Conference extends Conferenceable
{
    public static final long CONNECT_TIME_NOT_SPECIFIED = 0;

    private final PhoneAccountHandle mPhoneAccount;
    private final List<Connection> mChildConnections = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<Connection> mConferenceableConnections = new ArrayList<>();

        mConnectionProperties = connectionProperties;

    public final boolean addConnection(Connection connection)
    {
        if (connection == null || mChildConnections.contains(connection)) return false;
        if (!connection.setConference(this)) return false;
        mChildConnections.add(connection);
        onConnectionAdded(connection);
        return true;
    }

    public final void removeConnection(Connection connection)
    {
        if (connection != null && mChildConnections.remove(connection)) connection.resetConference();
    }

    public final void setConferenceableConnections(List<Connection> conferenceableConnections)
    {
        mConferenceableConnections.clear();
        if (conferenceableConnections == null) return;
        for (Connection connection : conferenceableConnections)
        {
            if (!mConferenceableConnections.contains(connection)) mConferenceableConnections.add(connection);
        }
    }

    public final void setRingbackRequested(boolean ringback)
    {
        mRingbackRequested = ringback;
    }

    public final void setVideoState(Connection connection, int videoState)
    {
        mVideoState = videoState;
    }

    {
        mVideoProvider = videoProvider;
    }

    public final List<Connection> getConferenceableConnections()
    {
        return Collections.unmodifiableList(mConferenceableConnections);
    }

    public final void destroy()
    {
        for (Connection connection : new ArrayList<>(mChildConnections)) removeConnection(connection);
        if (mState != Connection.STATE_DISCONNECTED) setDisconnected(new DisconnectCause(DisconnectCause.OTHER));
    }

    @Deprecated
    public final void setConnectionTime(long connectionTimeMillis)
    {
        mConnectTimeMillis = connectionTimeMillis;
    }

    @Deprecated

    {
        setConnectionStartElapsedRealtimeMillis(connectionStartElapsedRealTime);

    }

        return mConnectionStartElapsedRealtimeMillis;
    }

    {
        mStatusHints = statusHints;
    }

    public final StatusHints getStatusHints()
    {
        return mStatusHints;
    }

    public final void setExtras(Bundle extras)
    {
        mExtras = extras == null ? null : new Bundle(extras);
        onExtrasChanged(getExtras());
    }

    public final void putExtras(Bundle extras)
    {
        if (extras == null) return;
        if (mExtras == null) mExtras = new Bundle();
        mExtras.putAll(extras);
        onExtrasChanged(getExtras());
    }

    public final void removeExtras(List<String> keys)
    {
        if (keys == null || mExtras == null) return;
        for (String key : keys) mExtras.remove(key);
        onExtrasChanged(getExtras());
    }

    public final void removeExtras(String... keys)
    {
        if (keys == null) return;
        List<String> list = new ArrayList<>();
        Collections.addAll(list, keys);
        removeExtras(list);
    }

    public final Bundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras == null ? null : new Bundle(mExtras);
    }

    public void sendConferenceEvent(String event, Bundle extras)
    {
    }

    private void setState(int newState)
    {
        if (mState == newState) return;
        if (newState == Connection.STATE_ACTIVE && mConnectionStartElapsedRealtimeMillis == CONNECT_TIME_NOT_SPECIFIED)
        {
            mConnectTimeMillis = System.currentTimeMillis();
            mConnectionStartElapsedRealtimeMillis = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        }
        mState = newState;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "[State: " + Connection.stateToString(mState) + ",Capabilities: " + Connection.capabilitiesToString(mConnectionCapabilities)
            + ", VideoState: " + mVideoState + ", VideoProvider: " + mVideoProvider + ", isRingbackRequested: " + mRingbackRequested
            + ", ThisObject " + super.toString() + "]";
    }

    private static final class FailureSignalingConference extends Conference
    {
        FailureSignalingConference(PhoneAccountHandle phoneAccount)
        {
            super(phoneAccount);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    {
```

```java
            case STATE_NEW: return "NEW";
            case STATE_RINGING: return "RINGING";
            case STATE_DIALING: return "DIALING";
            case STATE_PULLING_CALL: return "PULLING_CALL";
            case STATE_ACTIVE: return "ACTIVE";
            case STATE_HOLDING: return "HOLDING";
            case STATE_DISCONNECTED: return "DISCONNECTED";
            default: return "UNKNOWN";
        }

    public static String capabilitiesToString(int capabilities)
    {
        String[] names = {"CAPABILITY_HOLD", "CAPABILITY_SUPPORT_HOLD", "CAPABILITY_MERGE_CONFERENCE", "CAPABILITY_SWAP_CONFERENCE", null,
            "CAPABILITY_RESPOND_VIA_TEXT", "CAPABILITY_MUTE", "CAPABILITY_MANAGE_CONFERENCE", "CAPABILITY_SUPPORTS_VT_LOCAL_RX",

            "CAPABILITY_CANNOT_DOWNGRADE_VIDEO_TO_AUDIO", "CAPABILITY_CAN_PULL_CALL", "CAPABILITY_SUPPORT_DEFLECT",
            "CAPABILITY_ADD_PARTICIPANT", null, null, "CAPABILITY_REMOTE_PARTY_SUPPORTS_RTT"};

            "PROPERTY_NETWORK_IDENTIFIED_EMERGENCY_CALL", null, "PROPERTY_IS_ADHOC_CONFERENCE", "PROPERTY_CROSS_SIM"};

    private static String flagsToString(int flags, String[] names)
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        for (int bit = 0; bit < names.length; bit++)
        {
            if (names[bit] != null && (flags & (1 << bit)) != 0) builder.append(' ').append(names[bit]);
        }
        return builder.toString();
    }
```

```java
package android.telecom;

import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class ConnectionRequest implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<ConnectionRequest> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ConnectionRequest>()
    {
        @Override
        public ConnectionRequest createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            PhoneAccountHandle account = source.readBoolean() ? PhoneAccountHandle.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source) : null;
            Uri address = source.readBoolean() ? Uri.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source) : null;
            Bundle extras = source.readBundle();
            int videoState = source.readInt();
            boolean requestingRtt = source.readBoolean();
            boolean adhocConference = source.readBoolean();
            List<Uri> participants = new ArrayList<>();
            source.readTypedList(participants, Uri.CREATOR);
            return new ConnectionRequest(account, address, extras, videoState, requestingRtt, adhocConference, participants);
        }

        @Override
        public ConnectionRequest[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ConnectionRequest[size];
        }
    };

    private final PhoneAccountHandle mAccountHandle;
    private final Uri mAddress;
    private final Bundle mExtras;
    private final int mVideoState;
    private final boolean mRequestingRtt;
    private final boolean mIsAdhocConference;
    private final List<Uri> mParticipants;

    public ConnectionRequest(PhoneAccountHandle accountHandle, Uri handle, Bundle extras)
    {
        this(accountHandle, handle, extras, VideoProfile.STATE_AUDIO_ONLY);
    }

    public ConnectionRequest(PhoneAccountHandle accountHandle, Uri handle, Bundle extras, int videoState)
    {
        this(accountHandle, handle, extras, videoState, false, false, null);
    }

    ConnectionRequest(PhoneAccountHandle accountHandle, Uri handle, Bundle extras, int videoState, boolean requestingRtt,
        boolean adhocConference, List<Uri> participants)
    {
        mAccountHandle = accountHandle;
        mAddress = handle;
        mExtras = extras;
        mVideoState = videoState;
        mRequestingRtt = requestingRtt;
        mIsAdhocConference = adhocConference;
        mParticipants = participants == null ? null : new ArrayList<>(participants);
    }

    public PhoneAccountHandle getAccountHandle()
    {
        return mAccountHandle;
    }

    public Uri getAddress()
    {
        return mAddress;
    }

    public List<Uri> getParticipants()
    {
        return mParticipants;
    }

    public Bundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    public int getVideoState()
    {
        return mVideoState;
    }

    public boolean isAdhocConferenceCall()
    {
        return mIsAdhocConference;
    }

    public boolean isRequestingRtt()
    {
        return mRequestingRtt;
    }

    public Connection.RttTextStream getRttTextStream()
    {
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "ConnectionRequest " + (mAddress == null ? Uri.EMPTY : "xxxxxxx") + " " + (mExtras == null ? "" : mExtras)
            + " isAdhocConf: " + mIsAdhocConference;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeBoolean(mAccountHandle != null);
        if (mAccountHandle != null) mAccountHandle.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        dest.writeBoolean(mAddress != null);
        if (mAddress != null) mAddress.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        dest.writeBundle(mExtras);
        dest.writeInt(mVideoState);
        dest.writeBoolean(mRequestingRtt);
        dest.writeBoolean(mIsAdhocConference);
        dest.writeTypedList(mParticipants);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.telecom;

import android.app.Service;

public abstract class ConnectionService extends Service
{
    public static final String SERVICE_INTERFACE = "android.telecom.ConnectionService";

    private final IBinder mBinder = new Binder(SERVICE_INTERFACE);
    private final List<Connection> mConnections = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<Conference> mConferences = new ArrayList<>();

    public ConnectionService()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public final IBinder onBind(Intent intent)
    {
        return mBinder;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onUnbind(Intent intent)
    {
        synchronized (mConnections)
        {
            for (Connection connection : new ArrayList<>(mConnections))
            {
                if (connection.getConference() == null) connection.onDisconnect();
            }
        }
        synchronized (mConferences)
        {
            for (Conference conference : new ArrayList<>(mConferences)) conference.onDisconnect();
        }
        return super.onUnbind(intent);
    }
```

```java
package android.telecom;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.text.TextUtils;

import java.util.Objects;

public final class DisconnectCause implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final int ERROR = 1;
    public static final int LOCAL = 2;
    public static final int REMOTE = 3;
    public static final int CANCELED = 4;
    public static final int MISSED = 5;
    public static final int REJECTED = 6;
    public static final int BUSY = 7;
    public static final int RESTRICTED = 8;
    public static final int OTHER = 9;
    public static final int CONNECTION_MANAGER_NOT_SUPPORTED = 10;
    public static final int ANSWERED_ELSEWHERE = 11;
    public static final int CALL_PULLED = 12;

    public static final String REASON_EMERGENCY_CALL_PLACED = "REASON_EMERGENCY_CALL_PLACED";
    public static final String REASON_EMULATING_SINGLE_CALL = "EMULATING_SINGLE_CALL";
    public static final String REASON_IMS_ACCESS_BLOCKED = "REASON_IMS_ACCESS_BLOCKED";
    public static final String REASON_WIFI_ON_BUT_WFC_OFF = "REASON_WIFI_ON_BUT_WFC_OFF";

    private static final int TONE_UNKNOWN = -1;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<DisconnectCause> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<DisconnectCause>()
    {
        @Override
        public DisconnectCause createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int code = source.readInt();
            String label = source.readString();
            String description = source.readString();
            String reason = source.readString();
            int tone = source.readInt();
            return new DisconnectCause(code, label, description, reason, tone);
        }

        @Override
        public DisconnectCause[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new DisconnectCause[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mDisconnectCode;
    private final CharSequence mDisconnectLabel;
    private final CharSequence mDisconnectDescription;
    private final String mDisconnectReason;
    private final int mToneToPlay;

    public DisconnectCause(int code)
    {
        this(code, null, null, null, TONE_UNKNOWN);
    }

    public DisconnectCause(int code, String reason)
    {
        this(code, null, null, reason, TONE_UNKNOWN);
    }

    public DisconnectCause(int code, CharSequence label, CharSequence description, String reason)
    {
        this(code, label, description, reason, TONE_UNKNOWN);
    }

    public DisconnectCause(int code, CharSequence label, CharSequence description, String reason, int toneToPlay)
    {
        mDisconnectCode = code;
        mDisconnectLabel = label;
        mDisconnectDescription = description;
        mDisconnectReason = reason;
        mToneToPlay = toneToPlay;
    }

    public int getCode()
    {
        return mDisconnectCode;
    }

    public CharSequence getLabel()
    {
        return mDisconnectLabel;
    }

    public CharSequence getDescription()
    {
        return mDisconnectDescription;
    }

    public String getReason()
    {
        return mDisconnectReason;
    }

    public int getTone()
    {
        return mToneToPlay;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mDisconnectCode);
        dest.writeString(mDisconnectLabel == null ? null : mDisconnectLabel.toString());
        dest.writeString(mDisconnectDescription == null ? null : mDisconnectDescription.toString());
        dest.writeString(mDisconnectReason);
        dest.writeInt(mToneToPlay);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof DisconnectCause)) return false;
        DisconnectCause cause = (DisconnectCause)other;
        return mDisconnectCode == cause.mDisconnectCode && TextUtils.equals(mDisconnectLabel, cause.mDisconnectLabel)
            && TextUtils.equals(mDisconnectDescription, cause.mDisconnectDescription)
            && Objects.equals(mDisconnectReason, cause.mDisconnectReason) && mToneToPlay == cause.mToneToPlay;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mDisconnectCode, mDisconnectLabel == null ? null : mDisconnectLabel.toString(),
            mDisconnectDescription == null ? null : mDisconnectDescription.toString(), mDisconnectReason, mToneToPlay);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        String[] names = {"UNKNOWN", "ERROR", "LOCAL", "REMOTE", "CANCELED", "MISSED", "REJECTED", "BUSY", "RESTRICTED", "OTHER",
            "CONNECTION_MANAGER_NOT_SUPPORTED", "ANSWERED_ELSEWHERE", "CALL_PULLED"};
        String code = mDisconnectCode >= 0 && mDisconnectCode < names.length ? names[mDisconnectCode] : "invalid code: " + mDisconnectCode;
        return "DisconnectCause [ Code: (" + code + ") Label: (" + mDisconnectLabel + ") Description: (" + mDisconnectDescription
            + ") Reason: (" + mDisconnectReason + ") Tone: (" + mToneToPlay + ") ]";
    }
}
```

```java
package android.telecom;

import android.graphics.drawable.Icon;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;

import java.util.Objects;

public final class PhoneAccount implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int CAPABILITY_CONNECTION_MANAGER = 0x1;
```
