```java
    public static final int CAPABILITY_VOICE_CALLING_AVAILABLE = 0x20000;
    public static final int CAPABILITY_SUPPORTS_TRANSACTIONAL_OPERATIONS = 0x40000;
    public static final int CAPABILITY_SUPPORTS_CALL_STREAMING = 0x80000;

    public static final String EXTRA_ADD_SELF_MANAGED_CALLS_TO_INCALLSERVICE = "android.telecom.extra.ADD_SELF_MANAGED_CALLS_TO_INCALLSERVICE";
    public static final String EXTRA_ALWAYS_USE_VOIP_AUDIO_MODE = "android.telecom.extra.ALWAYS_USE_VOIP_AUDIO_MODE";
    public static final String EXTRA_CALL_SUBJECT_CHARACTER_ENCODING = "android.telecom.extra.CALL_SUBJECT_CHARACTER_ENCODING";
    public static final String EXTRA_CALL_SUBJECT_MAX_LENGTH = "android.telecom.extra.CALL_SUBJECT_MAX_LENGTH";
    public static final String EXTRA_LOG_SELF_MANAGED_CALLS = "android.telecom.extra.LOG_SELF_MANAGED_CALLS";
    public static final String EXTRA_SUPPORTS_HANDOVER_FROM = "android.telecom.extra.SUPPORTS_HANDOVER_FROM";
    public static final String EXTRA_SUPPORTS_HANDOVER_TO = "android.telecom.extra.SUPPORTS_HANDOVER_TO";

    public static final int NO_HIGHLIGHT_COLOR = 0;
    public static final int NO_RESOURCE_ID = -1;

    public static final String SCHEME_TEL = "tel";
    public static final String SCHEME_VOICEMAIL = "voicemail";
    public static final String SCHEME_SIP = "sip";

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<PhoneAccount> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<PhoneAccount>()
    {
        @Override
        public PhoneAccount createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            PhoneAccountHandle handle = source.readBoolean() ? PhoneAccountHandle.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source) : null;
            Builder builder = new Builder(handle, source.readString());
            builder.setAddress(source.readBoolean() ? Uri.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source) : null);
            builder.setSubscriptionAddress(source.readBoolean() ? Uri.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source) : null);
            builder.setCapabilities(source.readInt());
            builder.setHighlightColor(source.readInt());
            builder.setShortDescription(source.readString());
            builder.setSupportedUriSchemes(source.createStringArrayList());
            builder.setIcon(source.readBoolean() ? Icon.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source) : null);
            builder.setExtras(source.readBundle());
            builder.mIsEnabled = source.readBoolean();
            List<PhoneAccountHandle> restriction = source.createTypedArrayList(PhoneAccountHandle.CREATOR);
            if (restriction != null) builder.setSimultaneousCallingRestriction(new LinkedHashSet<>(restriction));
            return builder.build();
        }

        @Override
        public PhoneAccount[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new PhoneAccount[size];
        }
    };

    private final PhoneAccountHandle mAccountHandle;
    private final Uri mAddress;
    private final Uri mSubscriptionAddress;
    private final int mCapabilities;
    private final int mHighlightColor;
    private final CharSequence mLabel;
    private final CharSequence mShortDescription;
    private final List<String> mSupportedUriSchemes;
    private final Icon mIcon;
    private final Bundle mExtras;
    private final boolean mIsEnabled;
    private final Set<PhoneAccountHandle> mSimultaneousCallingRestriction;

    private PhoneAccount(Builder builder)
    {
        mAccountHandle = builder.mAccountHandle;
        mAddress = builder.mAddress;
        mSubscriptionAddress = builder.mSubscriptionAddress;
        mCapabilities = builder.mCapabilities;
        mHighlightColor = builder.mHighlightColor;
        mLabel = builder.mLabel;
        mShortDescription = builder.mShortDescription;
        mSupportedUriSchemes = Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(builder.mSupportedUriSchemes));
        mIcon = builder.mIcon;
        mExtras = builder.mExtras;
        mIsEnabled = builder.mIsEnabled;
        mSimultaneousCallingRestriction = builder.mSimultaneousCallingRestriction == null ? null
            : Collections.unmodifiableSet(new LinkedHashSet<>(builder.mSimultaneousCallingRestriction));
    }

    public static Builder builder(PhoneAccountHandle accountHandle, CharSequence label)
    {
        return new Builder(accountHandle, label);
    }

    public Builder toBuilder()
    {
        return new Builder(this);
    }

    public PhoneAccountHandle getAccountHandle()
    {
        return mAccountHandle;
    }

    public Uri getAddress()
    {
        return mAddress;
    }

    public Uri getSubscriptionAddress()
    {
        return mSubscriptionAddress;
    }

    public int getCapabilities()
    {
        return mCapabilities;
    }

    public boolean hasCapabilities(int capability)
    {
        return (mCapabilities & capability) == capability;
    }

    public CharSequence getLabel()
    {
        return mLabel;
    }

    public CharSequence getShortDescription()
    {
        return mShortDescription;
    }

    public List<String> getSupportedUriSchemes()
    {
        return mSupportedUriSchemes;
    }

    public Bundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    public boolean supportsUriScheme(String uriScheme)
    {
        if (uriScheme == null) return false;
        for (String scheme : mSupportedUriSchemes)
        {
            if (scheme != null && scheme.equals(uriScheme)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public int getHighlightColor()
    {
        return mHighlightColor;
    }

    public Icon getIcon()
    {
        return mIcon;
    }

    public boolean isEnabled()
    {
        return mIsEnabled;
    }

    public Set<PhoneAccountHandle> getSimultaneousCallingRestriction()
    {
        if (mSimultaneousCallingRestriction == null) throw new IllegalStateException("This method can not be called if there is no "
            + "simultaneous calling restriction. See #hasSimultaneousCallingRestriction");
        return mSimultaneousCallingRestriction;
    }

    public boolean hasSimultaneousCallingRestriction()
    {
        return mSimultaneousCallingRestriction != null;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeBoolean(mAccountHandle != null);
        if (mAccountHandle != null) mAccountHandle.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        dest.writeString(mLabel == null ? null : mLabel.toString());
        dest.writeBoolean(mAddress != null);
        if (mAddress != null) mAddress.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        dest.writeBoolean(mSubscriptionAddress != null);
        if (mSubscriptionAddress != null) mSubscriptionAddress.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        dest.writeInt(mCapabilities);
        dest.writeInt(mHighlightColor);
        dest.writeString(mShortDescription == null ? null : mShortDescription.toString());
        dest.writeStringList(mSupportedUriSchemes);
        dest.writeBoolean(mIcon != null);
        if (mIcon != null) mIcon.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        dest.writeBundle(mExtras);
        dest.writeBoolean(mIsEnabled);
        dest.writeTypedList(mSimultaneousCallingRestriction == null ? null : new ArrayList<>(mSimultaneousCallingRestriction));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof PhoneAccount)) return false;
        PhoneAccount account = (PhoneAccount)other;
        return mCapabilities == account.mCapabilities && mHighlightColor == account.mHighlightColor && mIsEnabled == account.mIsEnabled
            && Objects.equals(mAccountHandle, account.mAccountHandle) && Objects.equals(mAddress, account.mAddress)
            && Objects.equals(mSubscriptionAddress, account.mSubscriptionAddress) && TextUtils.equals(mLabel, account.mLabel)
            && TextUtils.equals(mShortDescription, account.mShortDescription) && mSupportedUriSchemes.equals(account.mSupportedUriSchemes)
            && Objects.equals(mSimultaneousCallingRestriction, account.mSimultaneousCallingRestriction);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mAccountHandle, mAddress, mSubscriptionAddress, mCapabilities, mHighlightColor,
            mLabel == null ? null : mLabel.toString(), mShortDescription == null ? null : mShortDescription.toString(), mSupportedUriSchemes,
            mIsEnabled, mSimultaneousCallingRestriction);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "[[" + (mIsEnabled ? 'X' : ' ') + "] PhoneAccount: " + mAccountHandle + " Capabilities: " + mCapabilities
            + " Schemes: " + TextUtils.join(" ", mSupportedUriSchemes) + "]";
    }

    public static class Builder
    {
        private PhoneAccountHandle mAccountHandle;
        private Uri mAddress;
        private Uri mSubscriptionAddress;
        private int mCapabilities;
        private int mHighlightColor = NO_HIGHLIGHT_COLOR;
        private CharSequence mLabel;
        private CharSequence mShortDescription;
        private List<String> mSupportedUriSchemes = new ArrayList<>();
        private Icon mIcon;
        private Bundle mExtras;
        private boolean mIsEnabled;
        private Set<PhoneAccountHandle> mSimultaneousCallingRestriction;

        public Builder(PhoneAccountHandle accountHandle, CharSequence label)
        {
            mAccountHandle = accountHandle;
            mLabel = label;
        }

        public Builder(PhoneAccount phoneAccount)
        {
            mAccountHandle = phoneAccount.mAccountHandle;
            mAddress = phoneAccount.mAddress;
            mSubscriptionAddress = phoneAccount.mSubscriptionAddress;
            mCapabilities = phoneAccount.mCapabilities;
            mHighlightColor = phoneAccount.mHighlightColor;
            mLabel = phoneAccount.mLabel;
            mShortDescription = phoneAccount.mShortDescription;
            mSupportedUriSchemes.addAll(phoneAccount.mSupportedUriSchemes);
            mIcon = phoneAccount.mIcon;
            mExtras = phoneAccount.mExtras;
            mIsEnabled = phoneAccount.mIsEnabled;
            mSimultaneousCallingRestriction = phoneAccount.mSimultaneousCallingRestriction;
        }

        public Builder setAddress(Uri value)
        {
            mAddress = value;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setSubscriptionAddress(Uri value)
        {
            mSubscriptionAddress = value;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setCapabilities(int value)
        {
            mCapabilities = value;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setIcon(Icon icon)
        {
            mIcon = icon;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setHighlightColor(int value)
        {
            mHighlightColor = value;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setShortDescription(CharSequence value)
        {
            mShortDescription = value;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder addSupportedUriScheme(String uriScheme)
        {
            if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(uriScheme) && !mSupportedUriSchemes.contains(uriScheme)) mSupportedUriSchemes.add(uriScheme);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setSupportedUriSchemes(List<String> uriSchemes)
        {
            mSupportedUriSchemes.clear();
            if (uriSchemes != null)
            {
                for (String scheme : uriSchemes) addSupportedUriScheme(scheme);
            }
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setExtras(Bundle extras)
        {
            mExtras = extras;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setSimultaneousCallingRestriction(Set<PhoneAccountHandle> handles)
        {
            if (handles == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the Set of PhoneAccountHandles must not be null");
            mSimultaneousCallingRestriction = handles;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder clearSimultaneousCallingRestriction()
        {
            mSimultaneousCallingRestriction = null;
            return this;
        }

        public PhoneAccount build()
        {
            if (mSupportedUriSchemes.isEmpty()) addSupportedUriScheme(SCHEME_TEL);
            return new PhoneAccount(this);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.telecom;

import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.os.Process;
import android.os.UserHandle;

import java.util.Objects;

public final class PhoneAccountHandle implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<PhoneAccountHandle> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<PhoneAccountHandle>()
    {
        @Override
        public PhoneAccountHandle createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            ComponentName component = ComponentName.readFromParcel(source);
            String id = source.readString();
            UserHandle user = UserHandle.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            return new PhoneAccountHandle(component, id, user);
        }

        @Override
        public PhoneAccountHandle[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new PhoneAccountHandle[size];
        }
    };

    private final ComponentName mComponentName;
    private final String mId;
    private final UserHandle mUserHandle;

    public PhoneAccountHandle(ComponentName componentName, String id)
    {
        this(componentName, id, UserHandle.getUserHandleForUid(Process.myUid()));
    }

    public PhoneAccountHandle(ComponentName componentName, String id, UserHandle userHandle)
    {
        if (componentName == null) throw new NullPointerException("componentName");
        if (id == null) throw new NullPointerException("id");
        if (userHandle == null) throw new NullPointerException("userHandle");
        mComponentName = componentName;
        mId = id;
        mUserHandle = userHandle;
    }

    public ComponentName getComponentName()
    {
        return mComponentName;
    }

    public String getId()
    {
        return mId;
    }

    public UserHandle getUserHandle()
    {
        return mUserHandle;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        ComponentName.writeToParcel(mComponentName, dest);
        dest.writeString(mId);
        mUserHandle.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof PhoneAccountHandle)) return false;
        PhoneAccountHandle handle = (PhoneAccountHandle)other;
        return mComponentName.equals(handle.mComponentName) && mId.equals(handle.mId) && mUserHandle.equals(handle.mUserHandle);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mComponentName, mId, mUserHandle);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mComponentName + ", " + mId + ", " + mUserHandle;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.telecom;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class QueryLocationException extends RuntimeException implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int ERROR_REQUEST_TIME_OUT = 1;
    public static final int ERROR_PREVIOUS_REQUEST_EXISTS = 2;
    public static final int ERROR_NOT_PERMITTED = 3;
    public static final int ERROR_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_NON_EMERGENCY_CONNECTIONS = 4;
    public static final int ERROR_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE = 5;
    public static final int ERROR_UNSPECIFIED = 6;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<QueryLocationException> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<QueryLocationException>()
    {
        @Override
        public QueryLocationException createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            String message = source.readString();
            return new QueryLocationException(message, source.readInt());
        }

        @Override
        public QueryLocationException[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new QueryLocationException[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mCode;

    public QueryLocationException(String message)
    {
        this(message, ERROR_UNSPECIFIED);
    }

    public QueryLocationException(String message, int code)
    {
        super(message);
        mCode = code;
    }

    public QueryLocationException(String message, int code, Throwable cause)
    {
        super(message, cause);
        mCode = code;
    }

    public int getCode()
    {
        return mCode;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(getMessage());
        dest.writeInt(mCode);
    }
}
```

```java
    private final Set<Callback> mCallbacks = new CopyOnWriteArraySet<>();
    private final List<RemoteConnection> mChildConnections = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<RemoteConnection> mConferenceableConnections = new ArrayList<>();
    private int mState = Connection.STATE_NEW;
    private DisconnectCause mDisconnectCause;

            callback.onStateChanged(this, oldState, mState);
            callback.onDestroyed(this);
        }
    }
```

```java
package android.telecom;

import android.graphics.drawable.Icon;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.text.TextUtils;

import java.util.Objects;

public final class StatusHints implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<StatusHints> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<StatusHints>()
    {
        @Override
        public StatusHints createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            String label = source.readString();
            Icon icon = source.readBoolean() ? Icon.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source) : null;
            Bundle extras = source.readBundle();
            return new StatusHints(label, icon, extras);
        }

        @Override
        public StatusHints[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new StatusHints[size];
        }
    };

    private final CharSequence mLabel;
    private final Icon mIcon;
    private final Bundle mExtras;

    public StatusHints(CharSequence label, Icon icon, Bundle extras)
    {
        mLabel = label;
        mIcon = icon;
        mExtras = extras;
    }

    public CharSequence getLabel()
    {
        return mLabel;
    }

    public Icon getIcon()
    {
        return mIcon;
    }

    public Bundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mLabel == null ? null : mLabel.toString());
        dest.writeBoolean(mIcon != null);
        if (mIcon != null) mIcon.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        dest.writeBundle(mExtras);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof StatusHints)) return false;
        StatusHints hints = (StatusHints)other;
        return TextUtils.equals(mLabel, hints.mLabel) && Objects.equals(mIcon, hints.mIcon) && Objects.equals(mExtras, hints.mExtras);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hashCode(mLabel == null ? null : mLabel.toString()) + Objects.hashCode(mIcon) + Objects.hashCode(mExtras);
```

```java
    public List<PhoneAccountHandle> getOwnSelfManagedPhoneAccounts()
    {
        List<PhoneAccountHandle> result = new ArrayList<>();
        String packageName = mContext == null ? null : mContext.getPackageName();
        synchronized (sPhoneAccounts)
        {
            for (PhoneAccount account : sPhoneAccounts.values())
            {
                if (!account.hasCapabilities(PhoneAccount.CAPABILITY_SELF_MANAGED)) continue;
                PhoneAccountHandle handle = account.getAccountHandle();
                if (packageName == null || packageName.equals(handle.getComponentName().getPackageName())) result.add(handle);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
```

```java
package android.telecom;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public class VideoProfile implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int QUALITY_HIGH = 1;
    public static final int QUALITY_MEDIUM = 2;
    public static final int QUALITY_LOW = 3;
    public static final int QUALITY_DEFAULT = 4;

    public static final int STATE_AUDIO_ONLY = 0x0;
    public static final int STATE_TX_ENABLED = 0x1;
    public static final int STATE_RX_ENABLED = 0x2;
    public static final int STATE_BIDIRECTIONAL = STATE_TX_ENABLED | STATE_RX_ENABLED;
    public static final int STATE_PAUSED = 0x4;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<VideoProfile> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<VideoProfile>()
    {
        @Override
        public VideoProfile createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int state = source.readInt();
            int quality = source.readInt();
            return new VideoProfile(state, quality);
        }

        @Override
        public VideoProfile[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new VideoProfile[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mVideoState;
    private final int mQuality;

    public VideoProfile(int videoState)
    {
        this(videoState, QUALITY_DEFAULT);
    }

    public VideoProfile(int videoState, int quality)
    {
        mVideoState = videoState;
        mQuality = quality;
    }

    public int getVideoState()
    {
        return mVideoState;
    }

    public int getQuality()
    {
        return mQuality;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mVideoState);
        dest.writeInt(mQuality);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "[VideoProfile videoState = " + videoStateToString(mVideoState) + " videoQuality = " + mQuality + "]";
    }

    public static String videoStateToString(int videoState)
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder("Audio");
        if (videoState == STATE_AUDIO_ONLY)
        {
            builder.append(" Only");
        }
        else
        {
            if (isTransmissionEnabled(videoState)) builder.append(" Tx");
            if (isReceptionEnabled(videoState)) builder.append(" Rx");
            if (isPaused(videoState)) builder.append(" Pause");
        }
        return builder.toString();
    }

    public static boolean isAudioOnly(int videoState)
    {
        return !hasState(videoState, STATE_TX_ENABLED) && !hasState(videoState, STATE_RX_ENABLED);
    }

    public static boolean isVideo(int videoState)
    {
        return hasState(videoState, STATE_TX_ENABLED) || hasState(videoState, STATE_RX_ENABLED)
            || hasState(videoState, STATE_BIDIRECTIONAL);
    }

    public static boolean isTransmissionEnabled(int videoState)
    {
        return hasState(videoState, STATE_TX_ENABLED);
    }

    public static boolean isReceptionEnabled(int videoState)
    {
        return hasState(videoState, STATE_RX_ENABLED);
    }

    public static boolean isBidirectional(int videoState)
    {
        return hasState(videoState, STATE_BIDIRECTIONAL);
    }

    public static boolean isPaused(int videoState)
    {
        return hasState(videoState, STATE_PAUSED);
    }

    private static boolean hasState(int videoState, int state)
    {
        return (videoState & state) == state;
    }

    public static final class CameraCapabilities implements Parcelable
    {
        public static final Parcelable.Creator<CameraCapabilities> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<CameraCapabilities>()
        {
            @Override
            public CameraCapabilities createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                int width = source.readInt();
                int height = source.readInt();
                boolean zoomSupported = source.readBoolean();
                float maxZoom = source.readFloat();
                return new CameraCapabilities(width, height, zoomSupported, maxZoom);
            }

            @Override
            public CameraCapabilities[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new CameraCapabilities[size];
            }
        };

        private final int mWidth;
        private final int mHeight;
        private final boolean mZoomSupported;
        private final float mMaxZoom;

        public CameraCapabilities(int width, int height)
        {
            this(width, height, false, 1.0f);
        }

        public CameraCapabilities(int width, int height, boolean zoomSupported, float maxZoom)
        {
            mWidth = width;
            mHeight = height;
            mZoomSupported = zoomSupported;
            mMaxZoom = maxZoom;
        }

        public int getWidth()
        {
            return mWidth;
        }

        public int getHeight()
        {
            return mHeight;
        }

        public boolean isZoomSupported()
        {
            return mZoomSupported;
        }

        public float getMaxZoom()
        {
            return mMaxZoom;
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
        {
            dest.writeInt(mWidth);
            dest.writeInt(mHeight);
            dest.writeBoolean(mZoomSupported);
            dest.writeFloat(mMaxZoom);
        }
    }
```

`java/android/telephony/CellIdentity.java`:

```java
package android.telephony;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.Objects;

public abstract class CellIdentity implements Parcelable
{
    static final int TYPE_GSM = 1;
    static final int TYPE_CDMA = 2;
    static final int TYPE_LTE = 3;
    static final int TYPE_WCDMA = 4;
    static final int TYPE_TDSCDMA = 5;
    static final int TYPE_NR = 6;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<CellIdentity> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<CellIdentity>()
    {
        @Override
        public CellIdentity createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int type = source.readInt();
            switch (type)
            {
                case TYPE_GSM: return new CellIdentityGsm(source);
                case TYPE_CDMA: return new CellIdentityCdma(source);
                case TYPE_LTE: return new CellIdentityLte(source);
                case TYPE_WCDMA: return new CellIdentityWcdma(source);
                case TYPE_NR: return new CellIdentityNr(source);
                default: throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bad CellIdentity type " + type);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public CellIdentity[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new CellIdentity[size];
        }
    };

    final int mType;
    final String mMccString;
    final String mMncString;
    final String mAlphaLong;
    final String mAlphaShort;

    CellIdentity(int type, String mcc, String mnc, String alphaLong, String alphaShort)
    {
        mType = type;
        mMccString = mcc;
        mMncString = mnc;
        mAlphaLong = alphaLong;
        mAlphaShort = alphaShort;
    }

    CellIdentity(int type, Parcel source)
    {
        mType = type;
        mMccString = source.readString();
        mMncString = source.readString();
        mAlphaLong = source.readString();
        mAlphaShort = source.readString();
    }

    public CharSequence getOperatorAlphaLong()
    {
        return mAlphaLong;
    }

    public CharSequence getOperatorAlphaShort()
    {
        return mAlphaShort;
    }

    String getPlmn()
    {
        return mMccString == null || mMncString == null ? null : mMccString + mMncString;
    }

    static int parseCode(String code)
    {
        if (code == null) return CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE;
        try
        {
            return Integer.parseInt(code);
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException exception)
        {
            return CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mType);
        dest.writeString(mMccString);
        dest.writeString(mMncString);
        dest.writeString(mAlphaLong);
        dest.writeString(mAlphaShort);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof CellIdentity)) return false;
        CellIdentity identity = (CellIdentity)other;
        return mType == identity.mType && Objects.equals(mMccString, identity.mMccString) && Objects.equals(mMncString, identity.mMncString)
            && Objects.equals(mAlphaLong, identity.mAlphaLong) && Objects.equals(mAlphaShort, identity.mAlphaShort);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mType, mMccString, mMncString, mAlphaLong, mAlphaShort);
    }

    String baseToString()
    {
        return "mMcc=" + mMccString + " mMnc=" + mMncString + " mAlphaLong=" + mAlphaLong + " mAlphaShort=" + mAlphaShort;
    }
}
```

```java
        mSystemId = source.readInt();

        mLongitude = source.readInt();

        return mLatitude;
    }

    {
        super.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        dest.writeInt(mNetworkId);
        dest.writeInt(mSystemId);
        dest.writeInt(mBasestationId);
        dest.writeInt(mLongitude);
        dest.writeInt(mLatitude);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof CellIdentityCdma) || !super.equals(other)) return false;
        CellIdentityCdma identity = (CellIdentityCdma)other;
        return mNetworkId == identity.mNetworkId && mSystemId == identity.mSystemId && mBasestationId == identity.mBasestationId
            && mLongitude == identity.mLongitude && mLatitude == identity.mLatitude;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(super.hashCode(), mNetworkId, mSystemId, mBasestationId, mLongitude, mLatitude);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "CellIdentityCdma:{ mNetworkId=" + mNetworkId + " mSystemId=" + mSystemId + " mBasestationId=" + mBasestationId
            + " mLongitude=" + mLongitude + " mLatitude=" + mLatitude + " " + baseToString() + "}";
    }
}
```

`java/android/telephony/CellInfo.java`:

```java
package android.telephony;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.Objects;

public abstract class CellInfo implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int UNAVAILABLE = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    public static final long UNAVAILABLE_LONG = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    public static final int CONNECTION_NONE = 0;
    public static final int CONNECTION_PRIMARY_SERVING = 1;
    public static final int CONNECTION_SECONDARY_SERVING = 2;
    public static final int CONNECTION_UNKNOWN = Integer.MAX_VALUE;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<CellInfo> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<CellInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public CellInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int type = source.readInt();
            switch (type)
            {
                case CellIdentity.TYPE_GSM: return new CellInfoGsm(source);
                case CellIdentity.TYPE_CDMA: return new CellInfoCdma(source);
                case CellIdentity.TYPE_LTE: return new CellInfoLte(source);
                case CellIdentity.TYPE_WCDMA: return new CellInfoWcdma(source);
                case CellIdentity.TYPE_NR: return new CellInfoNr(source);
                default: throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bad CellInfo type " + type);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public CellInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new CellInfo[size];
        }
    };

    private final boolean mRegistered;
    private final long mTimestampNanos;
    private final int mCellConnectionStatus;

    CellInfo()
    {
        mRegistered = false;
        mTimestampNanos = UNAVAILABLE_LONG;
        mCellConnectionStatus = CONNECTION_NONE;
    }

    CellInfo(Parcel source)
    {
        mRegistered = source.readBoolean();
        mTimestampNanos = source.readLong();
        mCellConnectionStatus = source.readInt();
    }

    public boolean isRegistered()
    {
        return mRegistered;
    }

    public long getTimestampMillis()
    {
        return mTimestampNanos == UNAVAILABLE_LONG ? UNAVAILABLE_LONG : mTimestampNanos / 1000000L;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public long getTimeStamp()
    {
        return mTimestampNanos;
    }

    public int getCellConnectionStatus()
    {
        return mCellConnectionStatus;
    }

    public abstract CellIdentity getCellIdentity();

    public abstract CellSignalStrength getCellSignalStrength();

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public abstract void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags);

    void writeBaseToParcel(Parcel dest, int type)
    {
        dest.writeInt(type);
        dest.writeBoolean(mRegistered);
        dest.writeLong(mTimestampNanos);
        dest.writeInt(mCellConnectionStatus);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof CellInfo)) return false;
        CellInfo info = (CellInfo)other;
        return mRegistered == info.mRegistered && mTimestampNanos == info.mTimestampNanos && mCellConnectionStatus == info.mCellConnectionStatus;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mRegistered, mTimestampNanos, mCellConnectionStatus);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "mRegistered=" + (mRegistered ? "YES" : "NO") + " mTimeStamp=" + mTimestampNanos + "ns mCellConnectionStatus="
            + mCellConnectionStatus;
    }
}
```

`java/android/telephony/CellSignalStrength.java`:

```java
package android.telephony;

public abstract class CellSignalStrength
{
    public static final int SIGNAL_STRENGTH_NONE_OR_UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final int SIGNAL_STRENGTH_POOR = 1;
    public static final int SIGNAL_STRENGTH_MODERATE = 2;
    public static final int SIGNAL_STRENGTH_GOOD = 3;
    public static final int SIGNAL_STRENGTH_GREAT = 4;

    static final int NUM_SIGNAL_STRENGTH_BINS = 5;

    CellSignalStrength()
    {
    }

    public abstract int getLevel();

    public abstract int getAsuLevel();

    public abstract int getDbm();

    @Override
    public abstract int hashCode();

    @Override
    public abstract boolean equals(Object other);

    static int inRangeOrUnavailable(int value, int minimum, int maximum)
    {
        return value < minimum || value > maximum ? CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE : value;
    }

    static int levelFromThresholds(int value, int[] thresholds)
    {
        if (value == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE) return SIGNAL_STRENGTH_NONE_OR_UNKNOWN;
        int level = SIGNAL_STRENGTH_NONE_OR_UNKNOWN;
        for (int threshold : thresholds)
        {
            if (value < threshold) break;
            level++;
        }
        return level;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.telephony;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.Objects;

public final class CellSignalStrengthCdma extends CellSignalStrength implements Parcelable
{
    private static final int[] CDMA_DBM_THRESHOLDS = {-100, -95, -85, -75};
    private static final int[] EVDO_DBM_THRESHOLDS = {-105, -90, -75, -65};

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<CellSignalStrengthCdma> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<CellSignalStrengthCdma>()
    {
        @Override
        public CellSignalStrengthCdma createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new CellSignalStrengthCdma(source.readInt(), source.readInt(), source.readInt(), source.readInt(), source.readInt());
        }

        @Override
        public CellSignalStrengthCdma[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new CellSignalStrengthCdma[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mCdmaDbm;
    private final int mCdmaEcio;
    private final int mEvdoDbm;
    private final int mEvdoEcio;
    private final int mEvdoSnr;

    CellSignalStrengthCdma()
    {
        this(CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE);
    }

    CellSignalStrengthCdma(int cdmaDbm, int cdmaEcio, int evdoDbm, int evdoEcio, int evdoSnr)
    {
        mCdmaDbm = inRangeOrUnavailable(cdmaDbm, -120, 0);
        mCdmaEcio = inRangeOrUnavailable(cdmaEcio, -160, 0);
        mEvdoDbm = inRangeOrUnavailable(evdoDbm, -120, 0);
        mEvdoEcio = inRangeOrUnavailable(evdoEcio, -160, 0);
        mEvdoSnr = inRangeOrUnavailable(evdoSnr, 0, 8);
    }

    @Override
    public int getLevel()
    {
        int cdmaLevel = getCdmaLevel();
        int evdoLevel = getEvdoLevel();
        if (evdoLevel == SIGNAL_STRENGTH_NONE_OR_UNKNOWN) return cdmaLevel;
        if (cdmaLevel == SIGNAL_STRENGTH_NONE_OR_UNKNOWN) return evdoLevel;
        return Math.min(cdmaLevel, evdoLevel);
    }

    @Override
    public int getAsuLevel()
    {
        if (mCdmaDbm == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE) return 99;
        if (mCdmaDbm >= -75) return 16;
        if (mCdmaDbm >= -82) return 8;
        if (mCdmaDbm >= -90) return 4;
        if (mCdmaDbm >= -95) return 2;
        if (mCdmaDbm >= -100) return 1;
        return 99;
    }

    public int getCdmaLevel()
    {
        return levelFromThresholds(mCdmaDbm, CDMA_DBM_THRESHOLDS);
    }

    public int getEvdoLevel()
    {
        return levelFromThresholds(mEvdoDbm, EVDO_DBM_THRESHOLDS);
    }

    @Override
    public int getDbm()
    {
        if (mCdmaDbm == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE) return mEvdoDbm;
        if (mEvdoDbm == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE) return mCdmaDbm;
        return Math.min(mCdmaDbm, mEvdoDbm);
    }

    public int getCdmaDbm()
    {
        return mCdmaDbm;
    }

    public int getCdmaEcio()
    {
        return mCdmaEcio;
    }

    public int getEvdoDbm()
    {
        return mEvdoDbm;
    }

    public int getEvdoEcio()
    {
        return mEvdoEcio;
    }

    public int getEvdoSnr()
    {
        return mEvdoSnr;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mCdmaDbm);
        dest.writeInt(mCdmaEcio);
        dest.writeInt(mEvdoDbm);
        dest.writeInt(mEvdoEcio);
        dest.writeInt(mEvdoSnr);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof CellSignalStrengthCdma)) return false;
        CellSignalStrengthCdma strength = (CellSignalStrengthCdma)other;
        return mCdmaDbm == strength.mCdmaDbm && mCdmaEcio == strength.mCdmaEcio && mEvdoDbm == strength.mEvdoDbm
            && mEvdoEcio == strength.mEvdoEcio && mEvdoSnr == strength.mEvdoSnr;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mCdmaDbm, mCdmaEcio, mEvdoDbm, mEvdoEcio, mEvdoSnr);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "CellSignalStrengthCdma: cdmaDbm=" + mCdmaDbm + " cdmaEcio=" + mCdmaEcio + " evdoDbm=" + mEvdoDbm + " evdoEcio=" + mEvdoEcio
            + " evdoSnr=" + mEvdoSnr + " level=" + getLevel();
    }
}
```

```java
package android.telephony;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class CellSignalStrengthNr extends CellSignalStrength implements Parcelable
{
    private static final int[] SS_RSRP_THRESHOLDS = {-110, -90, -80, -65};

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<CellSignalStrengthNr> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<CellSignalStrengthNr>()
    {
        @Override
        public CellSignalStrengthNr createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int csiRsrp = source.readInt();
            int csiRsrq = source.readInt();
            int csiSinr = source.readInt();
            int csiCqiTableIndex = source.readInt();
            int[] report = source.createIntArray();
            List<Integer> csiCqiReport = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int value : report) csiCqiReport.add(value);
            return new CellSignalStrengthNr(csiRsrp, csiRsrq, csiSinr, csiCqiTableIndex, csiCqiReport, source.readInt(), source.readInt(),
                source.readInt(), source.readInt());
        }

        @Override
        public CellSignalStrengthNr[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new CellSignalStrengthNr[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mCsiRsrp;
    private final int mCsiRsrq;
    private final int mCsiSinr;
    private final int mCsiCqiTableIndex;
    private final List<Integer> mCsiCqiReport;
    private final int mSsRsrp;
    private final int mSsRsrq;
    private final int mSsSinr;
    private final int mTimingAdvance;

    CellSignalStrengthNr()
    {
        this(CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, null, CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE,
            CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE);
    }

    CellSignalStrengthNr(int csiRsrp, int csiRsrq, int csiSinr, int csiCqiTableIndex, List<Integer> csiCqiReport, int ssRsrp, int ssRsrq,
        int ssSinr, int timingAdvance)
    {
        mCsiRsrp = inRangeOrUnavailable(csiRsrp, -156, -31);
        mCsiRsrq = inRangeOrUnavailable(csiRsrq, -20, -3);
        mCsiSinr = inRangeOrUnavailable(csiSinr, -23, 23);
        mCsiCqiTableIndex = inRangeOrUnavailable(csiCqiTableIndex, 1, 3);
        mCsiCqiReport = csiCqiReport == null ? new ArrayList<>() : new ArrayList<>(csiCqiReport);
        mSsRsrp = inRangeOrUnavailable(ssRsrp, -156, -31);
        mSsRsrq = inRangeOrUnavailable(ssRsrq, -43, 20);
        mSsSinr = inRangeOrUnavailable(ssSinr, -23, 40);
        mTimingAdvance = inRangeOrUnavailable(timingAdvance, 0, 1282);
    }

    public int getSsRsrp()
    {
        return mSsRsrp;
    }

    public int getSsRsrq()
    {
        return mSsRsrq;
    }

    public int getSsSinr()
    {
        return mSsSinr;
    }

    public int getCsiRsrp()
    {
        return mCsiRsrp;
    }

    public int getCsiRsrq()
    {
        return mCsiRsrq;
    }

    public int getCsiSinr()
    {
        return mCsiSinr;
    }

    public int getCsiCqiTableIndex()
    {
        return mCsiCqiTableIndex;
    }

    public List<Integer> getCsiCqiReport()
    {
        return Collections.unmodifiableList(mCsiCqiReport);
    }

    public int getTimingAdvanceMicros()
    {
        return mTimingAdvance;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLevel()
    {
        return levelFromThresholds(mSsRsrp, SS_RSRP_THRESHOLDS);
    }

    @Override
    public int getAsuLevel()
    {
        int dbm = getDbm();
        if (dbm == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE) return 99;
        if (dbm <= -140) return 0;
        if (dbm >= -43) return 97;
        return dbm + 140;
    }

    @Override
    public int getDbm()
    {
        return mSsRsrp;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mCsiRsrp);
        dest.writeInt(mCsiRsrq);
        dest.writeInt(mCsiSinr);
        dest.writeInt(mCsiCqiTableIndex);
        int[] report = new int[mCsiCqiReport.size()];
        for (int index = 0; index < report.length; index++) report[index] = mCsiCqiReport.get(index);
        dest.writeIntArray(report);
        dest.writeInt(mSsRsrp);
        dest.writeInt(mSsRsrq);
        dest.writeInt(mSsSinr);
        dest.writeInt(mTimingAdvance);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof CellSignalStrengthNr)) return false;
        CellSignalStrengthNr strength = (CellSignalStrengthNr)other;
        return mCsiRsrp == strength.mCsiRsrp && mCsiRsrq == strength.mCsiRsrq && mCsiSinr == strength.mCsiSinr
```

```java
            int accessNetworkTechnology = source.readInt();
            int rejectCause = source.readInt();
            int[] services = source.createIntArray();
            List<Integer> availableServices = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int service : services) availableServices.add(service);
            CellIdentity cellIdentity = source.readBoolean() ? CellIdentity.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source) : null;
            String registeredPlmn = source.readString();
            boolean nonTerrestrial = source.readBoolean();
            return new NetworkRegistrationInfo(domain, transportType, registrationState, accessNetworkTechnology, rejectCause,
                availableServices, cellIdentity, registeredPlmn, nonTerrestrial);
        }

    private final String mRegisteredPlmn;

        mRegistrationState = registrationState;
        mAccessNetworkTechnology = accessNetworkTechnology;
        mRejectCause = rejectCause;
        mAvailableServices = availableServices == null ? new ArrayList<>() : new ArrayList<>(availableServices);
        mCellIdentity = cellIdentity;
        mRegisteredPlmn = registeredPlmn == null ? "" : registeredPlmn;
        mNonTerrestrial = nonTerrestrial;
    }

    static NetworkRegistrationInfo outOfService(int domain)
    {
        return new NetworkRegistrationInfo(domain, TRANSPORT_TYPE_WWAN, REGISTRATION_STATE_NOT_REGISTERED_OR_SEARCHING,

        dest.writeInt(mAccessNetworkTechnology);

        for (int index = 0; index < services.length; index++) services[index] = mAvailableServices.get(index);

            + mAccessNetworkTechnology + " availableServices=" + mAvailableServices + " cellIdentity=" + mCellIdentity
            + " registeredPlmn=" + mRegisteredPlmn + " isNonTerrestrialNetwork=" + mNonTerrestrial + "}";
```

`java/android/telephony/PhoneNumberFormattingTextWatcher.java`:

```java
package android.telephony;

import android.text.Editable;
import android.text.Selection;
import android.text.TextWatcher;

import java.util.Locale;

public class PhoneNumberFormattingTextWatcher implements TextWatcher
{
    private final String mCountryCode;
    private boolean mSelfChange;
    private boolean mStopFormatting;

    public PhoneNumberFormattingTextWatcher()
    {
        this(Locale.getDefault().getCountry());
    }

    public PhoneNumberFormattingTextWatcher(String countryCode)
    {
        if (countryCode == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        mCountryCode = countryCode;
    }

    @Override
    public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int count, int after)
    {
        if (mSelfChange || mStopFormatting) return;
        if (count > 0 && hasSeparator(s, start, count)) mStopFormatting = true;
    }

    @Override
    public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int before, int count)
    {
        if (mSelfChange || mStopFormatting) return;
        if (count > 0 && hasSeparator(s, start, count)) mStopFormatting = true;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void afterTextChanged(Editable s)
    {
        if (mStopFormatting)
        {
            mStopFormatting = s.length() != 0;
            return;
        }
        if (mSelfChange) return;
        String formatted = reformat(s);
        if (formatted == null || formatted.contentEquals(s)) return;
        mSelfChange = true;
        s.replace(0, s.length(), formatted, 0, formatted.length());
        if (formatted.equals(s.toString())) Selection.setSelection(s, s.length());
        mSelfChange = false;
    }

    private String reformat(CharSequence s)
    {
        StringBuilder dialable = new StringBuilder();
        for (int index = 0; index < s.length(); index++)
        {
            char c = s.charAt(index);
            if (PhoneNumberUtils.isNonSeparator(c))
            {
                dialable.append(c);
            }
            else if (!PhoneNumberUtils.isSeparator(c))
            {
                return null;
            }
        }
        if (!PhoneNumberUtils.isNanpCountry(mCountryCode)) return null;
        String digits = dialable.toString();
        String prefix = "";
        if (digits.startsWith("+1"))
        {
            prefix = "+1 ";
            digits = digits.substring(2);
        }
        else if (digits.startsWith("1"))
        {
            prefix = "1 ";
            digits = digits.substring(1);
        }
        else if (digits.startsWith("+"))
        {
            return null;
        }
        for (int index = 0; index < digits.length(); index++)
        {
            if (!PhoneNumberUtils.isISODigit(digits.charAt(index))) return null;
        }
        int length = digits.length();
        if (length == 0) return prefix.trim();
        if (length > 10) return dialable.toString();
        if (length <= 3) return prefix + digits;
        if (length <= 7 && prefix.isEmpty()) return digits.substring(0, 3) + "-" + digits.substring(3);
        if (length <= 6) return prefix + digits.substring(0, 3) + "-" + digits.substring(3);
        return prefix + digits.substring(0, 3) + "-" + digits.substring(3, 6) + "-" + digits.substring(6);
    }

    private static boolean hasSeparator(CharSequence s, int start, int count)
    {
        for (int index = start; index < start + count && index < s.length(); index++)
        {
            if (!PhoneNumberUtils.isNonSeparator(s.charAt(index))) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}
```

`java/android/telephony/PhoneNumberUtils.java`:

```java
package android.telephony;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.text.Editable;
import android.text.Spannable;
import android.text.SpannableStringBuilder;
import android.text.Spanned;
import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.text.style.TtsSpan;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public class PhoneNumberUtils
{
    public static final char PAUSE = ',';
    public static final char WAIT = ';';
    public static final char WILD = 'N';

    public static final int TOA_International = 0x91;
    public static final int TOA_Unknown = 0x81;

    public static final int FORMAT_UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final int FORMAT_NANP = 1;
    public static final int FORMAT_JAPAN = 2;

    public static final int BCD_EXTENDED_TYPE_EF_ADN = 1;
    public static final int BCD_EXTENDED_TYPE_CALLED_PARTY = 2;

    private static final int MIN_MATCH = 7;
    private static final String CLIR_ON = "*31#";
    private static final String CLIR_OFF = "#31#";

    private static final Pattern GLOBAL_PHONE_NUMBER_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("[\\+]?[0-9.-]+");
    private static final Pattern MMI_PREFIX_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("^([*#]+[0-9]*[*#])(.*)$");

    private static final Set<String> NANP_COUNTRIES = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList("US", "CA", "AS", "AI", "AG", "BS", "BB", "BM", "VG",
        "KY", "DM", "DO", "GD", "GU", "JM", "PR", "MS", "MP", "KN", "LC", "VC", "TT", "TC", "VI"));

    private static final Set<String> DEFAULT_EMERGENCY_NUMBERS = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList("112", "911", "000", "08", "110", "118",
        "119", "999"));

    private static final Map<String, Integer> COUNTRY_CALLING_CODES = new HashMap<>();

    private static final int NANP_STATE_DIGIT = 1;
    private static final int NANP_STATE_PLUS = 2;
    private static final int NANP_STATE_ONE = 3;
    private static final int NANP_STATE_DASH = 4;

    static
    {
        for (String country : NANP_COUNTRIES) COUNTRY_CALLING_CODES.put(country, 1);
        String[] codes = {
            "RU", "7", "KZ", "7", "EG", "20", "ZA", "27", "GR", "30", "NL", "31", "BE", "32", "FR", "33", "ES", "34", "PT", "351", "IE", "353",
            "IS", "354", "FI", "358", "BG", "359", "HU", "36", "LT", "370", "LV", "371", "EE", "372", "UA", "380", "RS", "381", "HR", "385",
            "SI", "386", "IT", "39", "RO", "40", "CH", "41", "CZ", "420", "SK", "421", "AT", "43", "GB", "44", "DK", "45", "SE", "46",
            "NO", "47", "PL", "48", "DE", "49", "PE", "51", "MX", "52", "AR", "54", "BR", "55", "CL", "56", "CO", "57", "VE", "58",
            "MY", "60", "AU", "61", "ID", "62", "PH", "63", "NZ", "64", "SG", "65", "TH", "66", "JP", "81", "KR", "82", "VN", "84",
            "CN", "86", "HK", "852", "TW", "886", "TR", "90", "IN", "91", "PK", "92", "AF", "93", "LK", "94", "IR", "98", "MA", "212",
            "DZ", "213", "TN", "216", "NG", "234", "KE", "254", "IL", "972", "AE", "971", "SA", "966", "QA", "974", "BD", "880", "LU", "352",
            "CY", "357", "MT", "356", "BY", "375", "GE", "995", "AM", "374", "AZ", "994", "UZ", "998"
        };
        for (int index = 0; index < codes.length; index += 2) COUNTRY_CALLING_CODES.put(codes[index], Integer.parseInt(codes[index + 1]));
    }

    public PhoneNumberUtils()
    {
    }

    public static boolean isISODigit(char c)
    {
        return c >= '0' && c <= '9';
    }

    public static final boolean is12Key(char c)
    {
        return (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '*' || c == '#';
    }

    public static final boolean isDialable(char c)
    {
        return (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '*' || c == '#' || c == '+' || c == WILD;
    }

    public static final boolean isReallyDialable(char c)
    {
        return (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '*' || c == '#' || c == '+';
    }

    public static final boolean isNonSeparator(char c)
    {
        return (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '*' || c == '#' || c == '+' || c == WILD || c == WAIT || c == PAUSE;
    }

    public static final boolean isStartsPostDial(char c)
    {
        return c == PAUSE || c == WAIT;
    }

    static boolean isSeparator(char c)
    {
        return !isDialable(c) && !(('a' <= c && c <= 'z') || ('A' <= c && c <= 'Z'));
    }

    public static String getNumberFromIntent(Intent intent, Context context)
    {
        if (intent == null) return null;
        Uri uri = intent.getData();
        if (uri == null) return null;
        String scheme = uri.getScheme();
        if ("tel".equals(scheme) || "sip".equals(scheme)) return uri.getSchemeSpecificPart();
        return null;
    }

    public static String extractNetworkPortion(String phoneNumber)
    {
        if (phoneNumber == null) return null;
        int length = phoneNumber.length();
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(length);
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
        {
            char c = phoneNumber.charAt(index);
            int digit = Character.digit(c, 10);
            if (digit != -1)
            {
                result.append(digit);
            }
            else if (c == '+')
            {
                String prefix = result.toString();
                if (prefix.length() == 0 || prefix.equals(CLIR_ON) || prefix.equals(CLIR_OFF)) result.append(c);
            }
            else if (isDialable(c))
            {
                result.append(c);
            }
            else if (isStartsPostDial(c))
            {
                break;
            }
        }
        return result.toString();
    }

    private static int indexOfLastNetworkChar(String phoneNumber)
    {
        int length = phoneNumber.length();
        int pauseIndex = minPositive(phoneNumber.indexOf(PAUSE), phoneNumber.indexOf(WAIT));
        return pauseIndex < 0 ? length - 1 : pauseIndex - 1;
    }

    private static int minPositive(int first, int second)
    {
        if (first >= 0 && second >= 0) return Math.min(first, second);
        if (first >= 0) return first;
        return second;
    }

    public static String extractPostDialPortion(String phoneNumber)
    {
        if (phoneNumber == null) return null;
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
        int trimIndex = indexOfLastNetworkChar(phoneNumber);
        for (int index = trimIndex + 1; index < phoneNumber.length(); index++)
        {
            char c = phoneNumber.charAt(index);
            if (isNonSeparator(c)) result.append(c);
        }
        return result.toString();
    }

    public static String stripSeparators(String phoneNumber)
    {
        if (phoneNumber == null) return null;
        int length = phoneNumber.length();
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(length);
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
        {
            char c = phoneNumber.charAt(index);
            int digit = Character.digit(c, 10);
            if (digit != -1)
            {
                result.append(digit);
            }
            else if (isNonSeparator(c))
            {
                result.append(c);
            }
        }
        return result.toString();
    }

    public static String convertKeypadLettersToDigits(String input)
    {
        if (input == null) return input;
        int length = input.length();
        if (length == 0) return input;
        char[] out = input.toCharArray();
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
        {
            out[index] = keypadDigit(out[index]);
        }
        return new String(out);
    }

    private static char keypadDigit(char c)
    {
        char upper = Character.toUpperCase(c);
        if (upper < 'A' || upper > 'Z') return c;
        if (upper <= 'C') return '2';
        if (upper <= 'F') return '3';
        if (upper <= 'I') return '4';
        if (upper <= 'L') return '5';
        if (upper <= 'O') return '6';
        if (upper <= 'S') return '7';
        if (upper <= 'V') return '8';
        return '9';
    }

    public static String normalizeNumber(String phoneNumber)
    {
        if (TextUtils.isEmpty(phoneNumber)) return "";
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
        int length = phoneNumber.length();
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
        {
            char c = phoneNumber.charAt(index);
            int digit = Character.digit(c, 10);
            if (digit != -1)
            {
                result.append(digit);
            }
            else if (result.length() == 0 && c == '+')
            {
                result.append(c);
            }
            else if ((c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z'))
            {
                return normalizeNumber(convertKeypadLettersToDigits(phoneNumber));
            }
        }
        return result.toString();
    }

    public static String replaceUnicodeDigits(String number)
    {
        StringBuilder normalizedDigits = new StringBuilder(number.length());
        for (char c : number.toCharArray())
        {
            int digit = Character.digit(c, 10);
            if (digit != -1)
            {
                normalizedDigits.append(digit);
            }
            else
            {
                normalizedDigits.append(c);
            }
        }
        return normalizedDigits.toString();
    }

    @Deprecated
    public static boolean compare(String first, String second)
    {
        return compareLoosely(first, second);
    }

    public static boolean compare(Context context, String first, String second)
    {
        return compareLoosely(first, second);
    }

    private static boolean compareLoosely(String first, String second)
    {
        if (first == null || second == null) return first == second;
        if (first.length() == 0 || second.length() == 0) return false;
        String firstDigits = dialableDigits(first);
        String secondDigits = dialableDigits(second);
        if (firstDigits.length() == 0 || secondDigits.length() == 0) return false;
        int firstIndex = firstDigits.length() - 1;
        int secondIndex = secondDigits.length() - 1;
        int matched = 0;
        while (firstIndex >= 0 && secondIndex >= 0)
        {
            if (firstDigits.charAt(firstIndex) != secondDigits.charAt(secondIndex)) break;
            matched++;
            firstIndex--;
            secondIndex--;
        }
        if (matched >= MIN_MATCH) return true;
        return firstIndex < 0 && secondIndex < 0;
    }

    private static String dialableDigits(String number)
    {
        String networkPortion = extractNetworkPortion(number);
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(networkPortion.length());
        for (int index = 0; index < networkPortion.length(); index++)
        {
            char c = networkPortion.charAt(index);
            if (c != '+') result.append(c);
        }
        return result.toString();
    }

    public static boolean areSamePhoneNumber(String number1, String number2, String defaultCountryIso)
    {
        if (number1 == null || number2 == null) return false;
        String e1 = formatNumberToE164(number1, defaultCountryIso);
        String e2 = formatNumberToE164(number2, defaultCountryIso);
        if (e1 != null && e2 != null) return e1.equals(e2);
        return compareLoosely(number1, number2);
    }

    public static String toCallerIDMinMatch(String phoneNumber)
    {
        String networkPortion = extractNetworkPortion(phoneNumber);
        return internalGetStrippedReversed(networkPortion, MIN_MATCH);
    }

    public static String getStrippedReversed(String phoneNumber)
    {
        String networkPortion = extractNetworkPortion(phoneNumber);
        if (networkPortion == null) return null;
        return internalGetStrippedReversed(networkPortion, networkPortion.length());
    }

    private static String internalGetStrippedReversed(String networkPortion, int length)
    {
        if (networkPortion == null) return null;
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(length);
        int size = networkPortion.length();
        for (int index = size - 1, count = length; index >= 0 && count > 0; index--, count--)
        {
            result.append(networkPortion.charAt(index));
        }
        return result.toString();
    }

    public static String stringFromStringAndTOA(String phoneNumber, int toa)
    {
        if (phoneNumber == null) return null;
        if (toa == TOA_International && phoneNumber.length() > 0 && phoneNumber.charAt(0) != '+') return "+" + phoneNumber;
        return phoneNumber;

        return TOA_Unknown;

    @Deprecated
    public static void formatNumber(Editable text, int defaultFormattingType)
    {
        int formatType = defaultFormattingType;
        if (text.length() > 2 && text.charAt(0) == '+')
        {
            if (text.charAt(1) == '1')
            {
                formatType = FORMAT_NANP;
            }
            else if (text.length() >= 3 && text.charAt(1) == '8' && text.charAt(2) == '1')
            {
                formatType = FORMAT_JAPAN;
            }
            else
            {
                formatType = FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
            }
        }

        switch (formatType)
        {
            case FORMAT_NANP:
                formatNanpNumber(text);
                return;
            case FORMAT_JAPAN:
                formatJapaneseNumber(text);
                return;
            default:
                removeDashes(text);
        }
    }

    @Deprecated
    public static void formatNanpNumber(Editable text)
    {
        int length = text.length();
        if (length > "+1-nnn-nnn-nnnn".length()) return;
        if (length <= 5) return;

        CharSequence saved = text.subSequence(0, length);
        removeDashes(text);
        length = text.length();

        int[] breaks = new int[3];
        int numBreaks = 0;
        int state = NANP_STATE_DIGIT;
        int numDigits = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
        {
            char c = text.charAt(index);
            if (c == '1' && (numDigits == 0 || state == NANP_STATE_PLUS))
            {
                state = NANP_STATE_ONE;
                continue;
            }
            if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
            {
                if (state == NANP_STATE_PLUS)
                {
                    text.replace(0, length, saved);
                    return;
                }
                if (state == NANP_STATE_ONE)
                {
                    breaks[numBreaks++] = index;
                }
                else if (state != NANP_STATE_DASH && (numDigits == 3 || numDigits == 6))
                {
                    breaks[numBreaks++] = index;
                }
                state = NANP_STATE_DIGIT;
                numDigits++;
                continue;
            }
            if (c == '-')
            {
                state = NANP_STATE_DASH;
                continue;
            }
            if (c == '+' && index == 0)
            {
                state = NANP_STATE_PLUS;
                continue;
            }
            text.replace(0, length, saved);
            return;
        }

        if (numDigits == 7) numBreaks--;

        for (int index = 0; index < numBreaks; index++)
        {
            int position = breaks[index];
            text.replace(position + index, position + index, "-");
        }

        int newLength = text.length();
        while (newLength > 0 && text.charAt(newLength - 1) == '-')
        {
            text.delete(newLength - 1, newLength);
            newLength--;
        }
    }

    @Deprecated
    public static void formatJapaneseNumber(Editable text)
    {
        String digits = text.toString();
        if (digits.indexOf('-') >= 0 || digits.length() < 6) return;
        boolean international = digits.startsWith("+81");
        String national = international ? digits.substring(3) : digits;
        for (int index = 0; index < national.length(); index++)
        {
            if (!isISODigit(national.charAt(index))) return;
        }
        if (!international && !national.startsWith("0")) return;
        String body = international ? national : national.substring(1);
        String formatted = body.startsWith("3") || body.startsWith("6") ? group(body, 1, 4) : group(body, 2, 4);
        if (formatted == null) return;
        String result = international ? "+81-" + formatted : "0" + formatted;
        text.replace(0, text.length(), result);
    }

    private static String group(String body, int first, int second)
    {
        if (body.length() <= first + second) return null;
        return body.substring(0, first) + "-" + body.substring(first, first + second) + "-" + body.substring(first + second);
    }

    private static void removeDashes(Editable text)
    {
        int position = 0;
        while (position < text.length())
        {
            if (text.charAt(position) == '-')
            {
                text.delete(position, position + 1);
            }
            else
            {
                position++;
            }
        }
    }

    public static String formatNumber(String phoneNumber, String defaultCountryIso)
    {
        if (phoneNumber == null) return null;
        if (phoneNumber.startsWith("#") || phoneNumber.startsWith("*")) return phoneNumber;
        String normalized = normalizeNumber(phoneNumber);
        if (normalized.length() == 0) return null;
        String country = defaultCountryIso == null ? "" : defaultCountryIso.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);

        if (normalized.startsWith("+"))
        {
            String e164 = normalized;
            if (e164.startsWith("+1") && e164.length() == 12 && isValidNanpNational(e164.substring(2)))
            {
                String national = e164.substring(2);
                return "+1 " + national.substring(0, 3) + "-" + national.substring(3, 6) + "-" + national.substring(6);
            }
            return e164.length() >= 4 && e164.length() <= 16 ? phoneNumber : null;
        }

        if (NANP_COUNTRIES.contains(country))
        {
            String national = normalized;
            boolean trunk = national.length() == 11 && national.charAt(0) == '1';
            if (trunk) national = national.substring(1);
            if (national.length() == 10 && isValidNanpNational(national))
            {
                String formatted = "(" + national.substring(0, 3) + ") " + national.substring(3, 6) + "-" + national.substring(6);
                return trunk ? "1 " + formatted : formatted;
            }
            if (national.length() == 7) return national.substring(0, 3) + "-" + national.substring(3);
            return phoneNumber;
        }

        return COUNTRY_CALLING_CODES.containsKey(country) ? phoneNumber : null;
    }

    public static String formatNumber(String phoneNumber, String phoneNumberE164, String defaultCountryIso)
    {
        if (phoneNumber == null) return null;
        int length = phoneNumber.length();
        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
        {
            if (!isDialable(phoneNumber.charAt(index))) return phoneNumber;
        }
        String country = defaultCountryIso;
        if (phoneNumberE164 != null && phoneNumberE164.length() >= 2 && phoneNumberE164.charAt(0) == '+')
        {
            String region = regionForE164(phoneNumberE164);
            if (region != null && normalizeNumber(phoneNumber).indexOf(phoneNumberE164.substring(1)) <= 0) country = region;
        }
        String result = formatNumber(phoneNumber, country);
        return result != null ? result : phoneNumber;
    }

    private static String regionForE164(String e164)
    {
        String digits = e164.substring(1);
        for (int length = 1; length <= 3 && length <= digits.length(); length++)
        {
            int code;
            try
            {
                code = Integer.parseInt(digits.substring(0, length));
            }
            catch (NumberFormatException exception)
            {
                return null;
            }
            if (code == 1) return "US";
            for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : COUNTRY_CALLING_CODES.entrySet())
            {
                if (entry.getValue() == code && !NANP_COUNTRIES.contains(entry.getKey())) return entry.getKey();
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static boolean isValidNanpNational(String national)
    {
        if (national.length() != 10) return false;
        for (int index = 0; index < 10; index++)
        {
            if (!isISODigit(national.charAt(index))) return false;
        }
        return national.charAt(0) >= '2' && national.charAt(3) >= '2';
    }

    public static String formatNumberToE164(String phoneNumber, String defaultCountryIso)
    {
        if (phoneNumber == null) return null;
        String normalized = normalizeNumber(phoneNumber);
        if (normalized.length() == 0) return null;
        if (normalized.startsWith("+"))
        {
            String digits = normalized.substring(1);
            if (digits.length() < 7 || digits.length() > 15 || digits.charAt(0) == '0') return null;
            if (digits.charAt(0) == '1' && !isValidNanpNational(digits.substring(1))) return null;
            return normalized;
        }
        if (defaultCountryIso == null) return null;
        String country = defaultCountryIso.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
        Integer code = COUNTRY_CALLING_CODES.get(country);
        if (code == null) return null;
        String national = normalized;
        if (code == 1)
        {
            if (national.length() == 11 && national.charAt(0) == '1') national = national.substring(1);
            return isValidNanpNational(national) ? "+1" + national : null;
        }
        String international = String.valueOf(code);
        if (national.startsWith("00"))
        {
            String digits = national.substring(2);
            return digits.length() >= 7 && digits.length() <= 15 ? "+" + digits : null;
        }
        if (national.startsWith("0") && !"IT".equals(country)) national = national.substring(1);
        if (national.length() < 4 || national.length() + international.length() > 15) return null;
        return "+" + international + national;
    }

    public static String formatNumberToRFC3966(String phoneNumber, String defaultCountryIso)
    {
        String e164 = formatNumberToE164(phoneNumber, defaultCountryIso);
        if (e164 == null) return null;
        if (e164.startsWith("+1") && e164.length() == 12)
        {
            String national = e164.substring(2);
            return "tel:+1-" + national.substring(0, 3) + "-" + national.substring(3, 6) + "-" + national.substring(6);
        }
        String region = regionForE164(e164);
        Integer code = region == null ? null : COUNTRY_CALLING_CODES.get(region);
        if (code == null) return "tel:" + e164;
        String international = String.valueOf(code);
        return "tel:+" + international + "-" + e164.substring(1 + international.length());
    }

    public static void addTtsSpan(Spannable s, int start, int endExclusive)
    {
        s.setSpan(createTtsSpan(s.subSequence(start, endExclusive).toString()), start, endExclusive, Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE);
    }

    public static CharSequence createTtsSpannable(CharSequence phoneNumber)
    {
        if (phoneNumber == null) return null;
        Spannable spannable = Spannable.Factory.getInstance().newSpannable(phoneNumber);
        addTtsSpan(spannable, 0, spannable.length());
        return spannable;
    }

    public static TtsSpan createTtsSpan(String phoneNumber)
    {
        if (phoneNumber == null) return null;
        TtsSpan.Builder<?> builder = new TtsSpan.Builder<>(TtsSpan.TYPE_TELEPHONE);
        builder.setStringArgument(TtsSpan.ARG_NUMBER_PARTS, splitAtNonNumerics(phoneNumber));
        return builder.build();
    }

    private static String splitAtNonNumerics(CharSequence number)
    {
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(number.length());
        for (int index = 0; index < number.length(); index++)
        {
            char c = number.charAt(index);
            result.append(is12Key(c) ? c : ' ');
        }
        return result.toString().replaceAll(" +", " ").trim();
    }

    public static String calledPartyBCDToString(byte[] bytes, int offset, int length)
    {
        return calledPartyBCDToString(bytes, offset, length, BCD_EXTENDED_TYPE_EF_ADN);
    }

    public static String calledPartyBCDToString(byte[] bytes, int offset, int length, int bcdExtType)
    {
        if (length < 2) return "";
        boolean prependPlus = (bytes[offset] & 0xf0) == (TOA_International & 0xf0);
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(1 + length * 2);
        internalCalledPartyBCDFragmentToString(result, bytes, offset + 1, length - 1, bcdExtType);
        if (prependPlus && result.length() == 0) return "";
        if (!prependPlus) return result.toString();
        String digits = result.toString();
        Matcher matcher = MMI_PREFIX_PATTERN.matcher(digits);
        if (matcher.matches() && matcher.group(2).length() > 0) return matcher.group(1) + "+" + matcher.group(2);
        return "+" + digits;
    }

    public static String calledPartyBCDFragmentToString(byte[] bytes, int offset, int length)
    {
        return calledPartyBCDFragmentToString(bytes, offset, length, BCD_EXTENDED_TYPE_EF_ADN);
    }

    public static String calledPartyBCDFragmentToString(byte[] bytes, int offset, int length, int bcdExtType)
    {
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(length * 2);
        internalCalledPartyBCDFragmentToString(result, bytes, offset, length, bcdExtType);
        return result.toString();
    }

    private static void internalCalledPartyBCDFragmentToString(StringBuilder result, byte[] bytes, int offset, int length, int bcdExtType)
    {
        for (int index = offset; index < length + offset; index++)
        {
            char c = bcdToChar((byte)(bytes[index] & 0xf), bcdExtType);
            if (c == 0) return;
            result.append(c);
            byte high = (byte)((bytes[index] >> 4) & 0xf);
            if (high == 0xf && index + 1 == length + offset) break;
            c = bcdToChar(high, bcdExtType);
            if (c == 0) return;
            result.append(c);
        }
    }

    private static char bcdToChar(byte b, int bcdExtType)
    {
        if (b < 0xa) return (char)('0' + b);
        String extended = bcdExtType == BCD_EXTENDED_TYPE_CALLED_PARTY ? "*#abc" : "*#" + PAUSE + WILD + WAIT;
        int index = b - 0xa;
        return index < extended.length() ? extended.charAt(index) : 0;
    }

    private static int charToBcd(char c, int bcdExtType)
    {
        if ('0' <= c && c <= '9') return c - '0';
        String extended = bcdExtType == BCD_EXTENDED_TYPE_CALLED_PARTY ? "*#abc" : "*#" + PAUSE + WILD + WAIT;
        int index = extended.indexOf(c);
        if (index == -1) throw new RuntimeException("invalid char for BCD " + c);
        return 0xa + index;
    }

    public static byte[] networkPortionToCalledPartyBCD(String s)
    {
        return numberToCalledPartyBCDHelper(extractNetworkPortion(s), false, BCD_EXTENDED_TYPE_EF_ADN);
    }

    public static byte[] networkPortionToCalledPartyBCDWithLength(String s)
    {
        return numberToCalledPartyBCDHelper(extractNetworkPortion(s), true, BCD_EXTENDED_TYPE_EF_ADN);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public static byte[] numberToCalledPartyBCD(String number)
    {
        return numberToCalledPartyBCD(number, BCD_EXTENDED_TYPE_EF_ADN);
    }

    public static byte[] numberToCalledPartyBCD(String number, int bcdExtType)
    {
        return numberToCalledPartyBCDHelper(number, false, bcdExtType);
    }

    private static byte[] numberToCalledPartyBCDHelper(String number, boolean includeLength, int bcdExtType)
    {
        if (number == null) return null;
        int effectiveLength = number.length();
        boolean hasPlus = number.indexOf('+') != -1;
        if (hasPlus) effectiveLength--;
        if (effectiveLength == 0) return null;

        int extraBytes = includeLength ? 2 : 1;
        int resultLength = (effectiveLength + 1) / 2 + extraBytes;
        byte[] result = new byte[resultLength];

        int digitCount = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < number.length(); index++)
        {
            char c = number.charAt(index);
            if (c == '+') continue;
            int shift = (digitCount & 0x01) == 1 ? 4 : 0;
            result[extraBytes + (digitCount >> 1)] |= (byte)((charToBcd(c, bcdExtType) & 0x0F) << shift);
            digitCount++;
        }

        if ((digitCount & 0x01) == 1) result[extraBytes + (digitCount >> 1)] |= (byte)0xF0;

        int offset = 0;
        if (includeLength) result[offset++] = (byte)(resultLength - 1);
        result[offset] = (byte)(hasPlus ? TOA_International : TOA_Unknown);
        return result;
    }

    static boolean isNanpCountry(String country)
    {
        return country != null && NANP_COUNTRIES.contains(country.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
    }
}
```

```java
    public PhoneStateListener()

        Handler handler = new Handler(looper);
        mExecutor = command -> handler.post(command);
    }

    public PhoneStateListener(Executor executor)
    {
        if (executor == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("PhoneStateListener Executor must be non-null");
        mExecutor = executor;
```
