```java
package android.telephony;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

public class ServiceState implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int STATE_IN_SERVICE = 0;
    public static final int STATE_OUT_OF_SERVICE = 1;
    public static final int STATE_EMERGENCY_ONLY = 2;
    public static final int STATE_POWER_OFF = 3;

    public static final int DUPLEX_MODE_UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final int DUPLEX_MODE_FDD = 1;
    public static final int DUPLEX_MODE_TDD = 2;

    public static final int UNKNOWN_ID = -1;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<ServiceState> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ServiceState>()
    {
        @Override
        public ServiceState createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new ServiceState(source);
        }

        @Override
        public ServiceState[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ServiceState[size];
        }
    };

    private int mState = STATE_OUT_OF_SERVICE;
    private boolean mRoaming;
    private String mOperatorAlphaLong;
    private String mOperatorAlphaShort;
    private String mOperatorNumeric;
    private boolean mIsManualSelection;
    private int mChannelNumber = CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE;
    private int[] mCellBandwidths = new int[0];
    private int mCdmaNetworkId = UNKNOWN_ID;
    private int mCdmaSystemId = UNKNOWN_ID;
    private final List<NetworkRegistrationInfo> mNetworkRegistrationInfos = new ArrayList<>();

    public ServiceState()
    {
        resetRegistrationInfos();
    }

    public ServiceState(ServiceState source)
    {
        copyFrom(source);
    }

    public ServiceState(Parcel source)
    {
        mState = source.readInt();
        mRoaming = source.readBoolean();
        mOperatorAlphaLong = source.readString();
        mOperatorAlphaShort = source.readString();
        mOperatorNumeric = source.readString();
        mIsManualSelection = source.readBoolean();
        mChannelNumber = source.readInt();
        mCellBandwidths = source.createIntArray();
        mCdmaNetworkId = source.readInt();
        mCdmaSystemId = source.readInt();
        source.readTypedList(mNetworkRegistrationInfos, NetworkRegistrationInfo.CREATOR);
    }

    private void copyFrom(ServiceState source)
    {
        mState = source.mState;
        mRoaming = source.mRoaming;
        mOperatorAlphaLong = source.mOperatorAlphaLong;
        mOperatorAlphaShort = source.mOperatorAlphaShort;
        mOperatorNumeric = source.mOperatorNumeric;
        mIsManualSelection = source.mIsManualSelection;
        mChannelNumber = source.mChannelNumber;
        mCellBandwidths = source.mCellBandwidths.clone();
        mCdmaNetworkId = source.mCdmaNetworkId;
        mCdmaSystemId = source.mCdmaSystemId;
        mNetworkRegistrationInfos.clear();
        mNetworkRegistrationInfos.addAll(source.mNetworkRegistrationInfos);
    }

    private void resetRegistrationInfos()
    {
        mNetworkRegistrationInfos.clear();
        mNetworkRegistrationInfos.add(NetworkRegistrationInfo.outOfService(NetworkRegistrationInfo.DOMAIN_CS));
        mNetworkRegistrationInfos.add(NetworkRegistrationInfo.outOfService(NetworkRegistrationInfo.DOMAIN_PS));
    }

    public int getState()
    {
        return mState;
    }

    public void setState(int state)
    {
        mState = state;
    }

    public boolean getRoaming()
    {
        return mRoaming;
    }

    public void setRoaming(boolean roaming)
    {
        mRoaming = roaming;
    }

    public int getDuplexMode()
    {
        return DUPLEX_MODE_UNKNOWN;
    }

    public int getChannelNumber()
    {
        return mChannelNumber;
    }

    public int[] getCellBandwidths()

    }

        return mOperatorAlphaLong;

        return mOperatorAlphaShort;

    }

        mOperatorAlphaLong = longName;

        mOperatorNumeric = numeric;
    }

    public int getCdmaNetworkId()
    {
        return mCdmaNetworkId;
    }

        return mCdmaSystemId;
    }

    public boolean isSearching()
    {
        for (NetworkRegistrationInfo info : mNetworkRegistrationInfos)
        {
            if (info.isSearching()) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isUsingNonTerrestrialNetwork()
    {
        for (NetworkRegistrationInfo info : mNetworkRegistrationInfos)
        {
            if (info.isNonTerrestrialNetwork()) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public List<NetworkRegistrationInfo> getNetworkRegistrationInfoList()
    {
        return new ArrayList<>(mNetworkRegistrationInfos);
    }

    public void setStateOutOfService()
    {
        mState = STATE_OUT_OF_SERVICE;
        mRoaming = false;
        mOperatorAlphaLong = null;
        mOperatorAlphaShort = null;
        mOperatorNumeric = null;
        mIsManualSelection = false;
        mChannelNumber = CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE;
        mCellBandwidths = new int[0];
        mCdmaNetworkId = UNKNOWN_ID;
        mCdmaSystemId = UNKNOWN_ID;
        resetRegistrationInfos();
    }

    public void setStateOff()

        mState = STATE_POWER_OFF;
    }

    @Override

    {
        return 0;
    }

    {
        dest.writeInt(mState);
        dest.writeBoolean(mRoaming);
        dest.writeString(mOperatorAlphaLong);
        dest.writeString(mOperatorAlphaShort);
        dest.writeString(mOperatorNumeric);
        dest.writeBoolean(mIsManualSelection);
        dest.writeInt(mChannelNumber);
        dest.writeIntArray(mCellBandwidths);
        dest.writeInt(mCdmaNetworkId);
        dest.writeInt(mCdmaSystemId);
        dest.writeTypedList(mNetworkRegistrationInfos);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof ServiceState)) return false;
        ServiceState state = (ServiceState)other;
        return mState == state.mState && mRoaming == state.mRoaming && Objects.equals(mOperatorAlphaLong, state.mOperatorAlphaLong)
            && Objects.equals(mOperatorAlphaShort, state.mOperatorAlphaShort) && Objects.equals(mOperatorNumeric, state.mOperatorNumeric)
            && mIsManualSelection == state.mIsManualSelection && mChannelNumber == state.mChannelNumber
            && Arrays.equals(mCellBandwidths, state.mCellBandwidths) && mCdmaNetworkId == state.mCdmaNetworkId
            && mCdmaSystemId == state.mCdmaSystemId && mNetworkRegistrationInfos.equals(state.mNetworkRegistrationInfos);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mState, mRoaming, mOperatorAlphaLong, mOperatorAlphaShort, mOperatorNumeric, mIsManualSelection, mChannelNumber,
            Arrays.hashCode(mCellBandwidths), mCdmaNetworkId, mCdmaSystemId, mNetworkRegistrationInfos);

            + ", mCdmaNetworkId=" + mCdmaNetworkId + ", mCdmaSystemId=" + mCdmaSystemId + ", mNetworkRegistrationInfos="
            + mNetworkRegistrationInfos + "}";
```

```java
        mCdma = new CellSignalStrengthCdma();
        mGsm = new CellSignalStrengthGsm();
        mWcdma = new CellSignalStrengthWcdma();
        mLte = new CellSignalStrengthLte();
        mNr = new CellSignalStrengthNr();
        mTimestampMillis = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();

    public SignalStrength(SignalStrength source)
    {
        mCdma = source.mCdma;
        mGsm = source.mGsm;
        mWcdma = source.mWcdma;
        mLte = source.mLte;
        mNr = source.mNr;
        mTimestampMillis = source.mTimestampMillis;
    }

    SignalStrength(Parcel source)
    {
        mCdma = CellSignalStrengthCdma.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
        mGsm = CellSignalStrengthGsm.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
        mWcdma = CellSignalStrengthWcdma.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
        mLte = CellSignalStrengthLte.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
        mNr = CellSignalStrengthNr.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
        mTimestampMillis = source.readLong();
    }

    public List<CellSignalStrength> getCellSignalStrengths()
    {
        return getCellSignalStrengths(CellSignalStrength.class);
    }

    public <T extends CellSignalStrength> List<T> getCellSignalStrengths(Class<T> type)
    {
        List<T> result = new ArrayList<>();
        addIfValid(result, type, mLte, new CellSignalStrengthLte());
        addIfValid(result, type, mNr, new CellSignalStrengthNr());
        addIfValid(result, type, mWcdma, new CellSignalStrengthWcdma());
        addIfValid(result, type, mGsm, new CellSignalStrengthGsm());
        addIfValid(result, type, mCdma, new CellSignalStrengthCdma());
        return result;
    }

    private static <T extends CellSignalStrength> void addIfValid(List<T> result, Class<T> type, CellSignalStrength strength,
        CellSignalStrength empty)
    {
        if (type.isInstance(strength) && !strength.equals(empty)) result.add(type.cast(strength));
    }

    public long getTimestampMillis()
    {
        return mTimestampMillis;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public int getGsmSignalStrength()
    {
        if (!mWcdma.equals(new CellSignalStrengthWcdma())) return mWcdma.getAsuLevel();
        return mGsm.getAsuLevel();

        for (CellSignalStrength strength : getCellSignalStrengths()) level = Math.max(level, strength.getLevel());
        return level;
    }

    @Deprecated

    }

    }

    {
        mCdma.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        mGsm.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        mWcdma.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        mLte.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        mNr.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        dest.writeLong(mTimestampMillis);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof SignalStrength)) return false;
        SignalStrength strength = (SignalStrength)other;
        return mCdma.equals(strength.mCdma) && mGsm.equals(strength.mGsm) && mWcdma.equals(strength.mWcdma) && mLte.equals(strength.mLte)
            && mNr.equals(strength.mNr);

            + ",primary=" + (getCellSignalStrengths().isEmpty() ? "CellSignalStrength" : getCellSignalStrengths().get(0)) + "}";
```

`java/android/telephony/SmsMessage.java`:

```java
package android.telephony;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.nio.charset.Charset;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public class SmsMessage
{
    public static final int ENCODING_UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final int ENCODING_7BIT = 1;
    public static final int ENCODING_8BIT = 2;
    public static final int ENCODING_16BIT = 3;
    public static final int ENCODING_KSC5601 = 4;

    public static final String FORMAT_3GPP = "3gpp";
    public static final String FORMAT_3GPP2 = "3gpp2";

    public static final int MAX_USER_DATA_BYTES = 140;
    public static final int MAX_USER_DATA_BYTES_WITH_HEADER = 134;
    public static final int MAX_USER_DATA_SEPTETS = 160;
    public static final int MAX_USER_DATA_SEPTETS_WITH_HEADER = 153;

    private static final int MAX_USER_DATA_UNITS_16BIT = 70;
    private static final int MAX_USER_DATA_UNITS_16BIT_WITH_HEADER = 67;

    private static final String GSM_BASIC_TABLE = "@£$¥èéùìòÇ\nØø\rÅå"
        + "Δ_ΦΓΛΩΠΨΣΘΞ\u001BÆæßÉ"
        + " !\"#¤%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?"
        + "¡ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZÄÖÑÜ§"
        + "¿abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzäöñüà";

    private static final int GSM_ESCAPE = 0x1B;
    private static final char[] GSM_EXTENSION_CHARS = {'\f', '^', '{', '}', '\\', '[', '~', ']', '|', '€'};
    private static final int[] GSM_EXTENSION_CODES = {0x0A, 0x14, 0x28, 0x29, 0x2F, 0x3C, 0x3D, 0x3E, 0x40, 0x65};

    private static final Pattern EMAIL_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("[a-zA-Z0-9\\+\\.\\_\\%\\-]{1,256}\\@[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\\-]{0,64}"
        + "(\\.[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\\-]{0,25})+");

    public enum MessageClass
    {
        UNKNOWN,
        CLASS_0,
        CLASS_1,
        CLASS_2,
        CLASS_3
    }

    public static class SubmitPdu
    {
        public byte[] encodedScAddress;
        public byte[] encodedMessage;

        SubmitPdu()
        {
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "SubmitPdu: encodedScAddress = " + Arrays.toString(encodedScAddress) + ", encodedMessage = "
                + Arrays.toString(encodedMessage);
        }
    }

    private byte[] mPdu;
    private String mScAddress;
    private String mOriginatingAddress;
    private String mRecipientAddress;
    private String mMessageBody;
    private byte[] mUserData;
    private int mProtocolIdentifier;
    private int mDataCodingScheme;
    private long mTimestampMillis;
    private boolean mReplyPathPresent;
    private boolean mIsStatusReport;
    private int mStatus;
    private MessageClass mMessageClass = MessageClass.UNKNOWN;
    private boolean mIsMwi;
    private boolean mMwiSense;
    private boolean mMwiDontStore;
    private boolean mIsCphsMwi;
    private boolean mCphsMwiSet;
    private boolean mIsEmail;
    private String mEmailFrom;
    private String mEmailBody;
    private int mIndexOnIcc = -1;
    private int mStatusOnIcc = -1;

    private SmsMessage()
    {
    }

    @Deprecated
    public static SmsMessage createFromPdu(byte[] pdu)
    {
        return createFromPdu(pdu, FORMAT_3GPP);
    }

    public static SmsMessage createFromPdu(byte[] pdu, String format)
    {
        if (pdu == null || !FORMAT_3GPP.equals(format)) return null;
        try
        {
            SmsMessage message = new SmsMessage();
            message.parsePdu(pdu);
            return message;
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static int getTPLayerLengthForPDU(String pdu)
    {
        int length = pdu.length() / 2;
        int smscLength = Integer.parseInt(pdu.substring(0, 2), 16);
        return length - smscLength - 1;
    }

    public static int[] calculateLength(CharSequence messageBody, boolean use7bitOnly)
    {
        int septets = countGsmSeptets(messageBody, use7bitOnly);
        int[] result = new int[4];
        if (septets >= 0)
        {
            result[1] = septets;
            if (septets > MAX_USER_DATA_SEPTETS)
            {
                result[0] = (septets + MAX_USER_DATA_SEPTETS_WITH_HEADER - 1) / MAX_USER_DATA_SEPTETS_WITH_HEADER;
                result[2] = result[0] * MAX_USER_DATA_SEPTETS_WITH_HEADER - septets;
            }
            else
            {
                result[0] = 1;
                result[2] = MAX_USER_DATA_SEPTETS - septets;
            }
            result[3] = ENCODING_7BIT;
            return result;
        }
        int units = messageBody.length();
        result[1] = units;
        if (units > MAX_USER_DATA_UNITS_16BIT)
        {
            result[0] = (units + MAX_USER_DATA_UNITS_16BIT_WITH_HEADER - 1) / MAX_USER_DATA_UNITS_16BIT_WITH_HEADER;
            result[2] = result[0] * MAX_USER_DATA_UNITS_16BIT_WITH_HEADER - units;
        }
        else
        {
            result[0] = 1;
            result[2] = MAX_USER_DATA_UNITS_16BIT - units;
        }
        result[3] = ENCODING_16BIT;
        return result;
    }

    public static int[] calculateLength(String messageBody, boolean use7bitOnly)
    {
        return calculateLength((CharSequence)messageBody, use7bitOnly);
    }

    public static SubmitPdu getSubmitPdu(String scAddress, String destinationAddress, String message, boolean statusReportRequested)
    {
        if (message == null || destinationAddress == null) return null;
        ByteArrayOutputStream stream = startSubmitPdu(destinationAddress, statusReportRequested, false);
        if (stream == null) return null;
        byte[] septets = encodeGsm7Bit(message);
        if (septets != null)
        {
            if (septets.length > MAX_USER_DATA_SEPTETS) return null;
            stream.write(0x00);
            stream.write(0x00);
            stream.write(septets.length);
            byte[] packed = packSeptets(septets);
            stream.write(packed, 0, packed.length);
        }
        else
        {
            byte[] ucs2 = message.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_16BE);
            if (ucs2.length > MAX_USER_DATA_BYTES) return null;
            stream.write(0x00);
            stream.write(0x08);
            stream.write(ucs2.length);
            stream.write(ucs2, 0, ucs2.length);
        }
        return finishSubmitPdu(scAddress, stream);
    }

    public static SubmitPdu getSubmitPdu(String scAddress, String destinationAddress, short destinationPort, byte[] data,
        boolean statusReportRequested)
    {
        if (data == null || destinationAddress == null) return null;
        byte[] header = {0x05, 0x04, (byte)((destinationPort >> 8) & 0xFF), (byte)(destinationPort & 0xFF), 0x00, 0x00};
        if (data.length + header.length + 1 > MAX_USER_DATA_BYTES) return null;
        ByteArrayOutputStream stream = startSubmitPdu(destinationAddress, statusReportRequested, true);
        if (stream == null) return null;
        stream.write(0x00);
        stream.write(0x04);
        stream.write(data.length + header.length + 1);
        stream.write(header.length);
        stream.write(header, 0, header.length);
        stream.write(data, 0, data.length);
        return finishSubmitPdu(scAddress, stream);
    }

    private static ByteArrayOutputStream startSubmitPdu(String destinationAddress, boolean statusReportRequested, boolean hasHeader)
    {
        byte[] destination = PhoneNumberUtils.networkPortionToCalledPartyBCD(destinationAddress);
        if (destination == null) return null;
        ByteArrayOutputStream stream = new ByteArrayOutputStream(MAX_USER_DATA_BYTES + 40);
        int firstByte = 0x01;
        if (hasHeader) firstByte |= 0x40;
        if (statusReportRequested) firstByte |= 0x20;
        stream.write(firstByte);
        stream.write(0x00);
        int semiOctets = (destination.length - 1) * 2 - ((destination[destination.length - 1] & 0xF0) == 0xF0 ? 1 : 0);
        stream.write(semiOctets);
        stream.write(destination, 0, destination.length);
        return stream;
    }

    private static SubmitPdu finishSubmitPdu(String scAddress, ByteArrayOutputStream stream)
    {
        SubmitPdu result = new SubmitPdu();
        result.encodedScAddress = scAddress == null ? null : PhoneNumberUtils.networkPortionToCalledPartyBCDWithLength(scAddress);
        result.encodedMessage = stream.toByteArray();
        return result;
    }

    private static int gsmCode(char c)
    {
        return GSM_BASIC_TABLE.indexOf(c);
    }

    private static int gsmExtensionCode(char c)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < GSM_EXTENSION_CHARS.length; index++)
        {
            if (GSM_EXTENSION_CHARS[index] == c) return GSM_EXTENSION_CODES[index];
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private static int countGsmSeptets(CharSequence text, boolean use7bitOnly)
    {
        int count = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < text.length(); index++)
        {
            char c = text.charAt(index);
            if (c != GSM_ESCAPE && gsmCode(c) >= 0)
            {
                count++;
            }
            else if (gsmExtensionCode(c) >= 0)
            {
                count += 2;
            }
            else if (use7bitOnly)
            {
                count++;
            }
            else
            {
                return -1;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    private static byte[] encodeGsm7Bit(String text)
    {
        ByteArrayOutputStream septets = new ByteArrayOutputStream(text.length());
        for (int index = 0; index < text.length(); index++)
        {
            char c = text.charAt(index);
            int code = c == GSM_ESCAPE ? -1 : gsmCode(c);
            if (code >= 0)
            {
                septets.write(code);
                continue;
            }
            int extension = gsmExtensionCode(c);
            if (extension < 0) return null;
            septets.write(GSM_ESCAPE);
            septets.write(extension);
        }
        return septets.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] packSeptets(byte[] septets)
    {
        byte[] packed = new byte[(septets.length * 7 + 7) / 8];
        int bitOffset = 0;
        for (byte septet : septets)
        {
            int value = septet & 0x7F;
            int byteIndex = bitOffset / 8;
            int shift = bitOffset % 8;
            packed[byteIndex] |= (byte)(value << shift);
            if (shift > 1) packed[byteIndex + 1] |= (byte)(value >> (8 - shift));
            bitOffset += 7;
        }
        return packed;
    }

    private static String unpackGsm7Bit(byte[] pdu, int offset, int septetCount, int fillBits)
    {
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(septetCount);
        boolean escaped = false;
        for (int index = 0; index < septetCount; index++)
        {
            int bitOffset = 7 * index + fillBits;
            int byteIndex = offset + bitOffset / 8;
            int shift = bitOffset % 8;
            int value = ((pdu[byteIndex] & 0xFF) >> shift) & 0x7F;
            if (shift > 1 && byteIndex + 1 < pdu.length) value = (value | ((pdu[byteIndex + 1] & 0xFF) << (8 - shift))) & 0x7F;
            if (escaped)
            {
                char extension = ' ';
                for (int code = 0; code < GSM_EXTENSION_CODES.length; code++)
                {
                    if (GSM_EXTENSION_CODES[code] == value) extension = GSM_EXTENSION_CHARS[code];
                }
                result.append(extension);
                escaped = false;
            }
            else if (value == GSM_ESCAPE)
            {
                escaped = true;
            }
            else
            {
                result.append(GSM_BASIC_TABLE.charAt(value));
            }
        }
        return result.toString();
    }

    private static int gsmBcdByteToInt(byte b)
    {
        int result = 0;
        if ((b & 0xF0) <= 0x90) result = (b >> 4) & 0xF;
        if ((b & 0x0F) <= 0x09) result += (b & 0xF) * 10;
        return result;
    }

    private void parsePdu(byte[] pdu)
    {
        mPdu = pdu;
        int position = 0;
        int scLength = pdu[position++] & 0xFF;
        if (scLength > 0)
        {
            mScAddress = PhoneNumberUtils.calledPartyBCDToString(pdu, position, scLength);
            position += scLength;
        }
        int firstByte = pdu[position++] & 0xFF;
        int messageType = firstByte & 0x3;
        switch (messageType)
        {
            case 0:
            case 3:
                parseDeliver(pdu, position, firstByte);
                break;
            case 1:
                parseSubmit(pdu, position, firstByte);
                break;
            case 2:
                parseStatusReport(pdu, position, firstByte);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unsupported message type");
        }
    }

    private int parseOriginatingAddress(byte[] pdu, int position, boolean recipient)
    {
        int semiOctets = pdu[position] & 0xFF;
        int typeOfAddress = pdu[position + 1] & 0xFF;
        int byteCount = (semiOctets + 1) / 2;
        String address;
        if ((typeOfAddress & 0x70) == 0x50)
        {
            address = unpackGsm7Bit(pdu, position + 2, semiOctets * 4 / 7, 0);
            if (semiOctets == 4 && !recipient)
            {
                int first = pdu[position + 2] & 0xFF;
                int second = pdu[position + 3] & 0xFF;
                mIsCphsMwi = (first & 0x7E) == 0x10 && second == 0x00;
                mCphsMwiSet = mIsCphsMwi && (first & 0x01) == 0x01;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            String digits = PhoneNumberUtils.calledPartyBCDFragmentToString(pdu, position + 2, byteCount);
            if (digits.length() > semiOctets) digits = digits.substring(0, semiOctets);
            address = (typeOfAddress & 0x70) == 0x10 ? "+" + digits : digits;
        }
        if (recipient)
        {
            mRecipientAddress = address;
        }
        else
        {
            mOriginatingAddress = address;
        }
        return position + 2 + byteCount;
    }

    private long parseTimestamp(byte[] pdu, int position)
    {
        int year = gsmBcdByteToInt(pdu[position]);
        int month = gsmBcdByteToInt(pdu[position + 1]);
        int day = gsmBcdByteToInt(pdu[position + 2]);
        int hour = gsmBcdByteToInt(pdu[position + 3]);
        int minute = gsmBcdByteToInt(pdu[position + 4]);
        int second = gsmBcdByteToInt(pdu[position + 5]);
        byte zone = pdu[position + 6];
        int quarters = gsmBcdByteToInt((byte)(zone & ~0x08));
        if ((zone & 0x08) != 0) quarters = -quarters;
        try
        {
            LocalDateTime time = LocalDateTime.of(year >= 90 ? 1900 + year : 2000 + year, month, day, hour, minute, second);
            return time.toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC).toEpochMilli() - quarters * 15L * 60L * 1000L;
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception)
        {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    private void parseDeliver(byte[] pdu, int position, int firstByte)
    {
        mReplyPathPresent = (firstByte & 0x80) != 0;
        position = parseOriginatingAddress(pdu, position, false);
        mProtocolIdentifier = pdu[position++] & 0xFF;
        mDataCodingScheme = pdu[position++] & 0xFF;
        mTimestampMillis = parseTimestamp(pdu, position);
        position += 7;
        parseUserData(pdu, position, (firstByte & 0x40) != 0);
    }

    private void parseSubmit(byte[] pdu, int position, int firstByte)
    {
        position++;
        position = parseOriginatingAddress(pdu, position, true);
        mProtocolIdentifier = pdu[position++] & 0xFF;
        mDataCodingScheme = pdu[position++] & 0xFF;
        int validityFormat = (firstByte >> 3) & 0x3;
        if (validityFormat == 2)
        {
            position += 1;
        }
        else if (validityFormat != 0)
        {
            position += 7;
        }
        parseUserData(pdu, position, (firstByte & 0x40) != 0);
    }

    private void parseStatusReport(byte[] pdu, int position, int firstByte)
    {
        mIsStatusReport = true;
        position++;
        position = parseOriginatingAddress(pdu, position, true);
        mTimestampMillis = parseTimestamp(pdu, position);
        position += 14;
        mStatus = pdu[position++] & 0xFF;
        if (position < pdu.length)
        {
            int extraParams = pdu[position++] & 0xFF;
            if ((extraParams & 0x01) != 0 && position < pdu.length) mProtocolIdentifier = pdu[position++] & 0xFF;
            if ((extraParams & 0x02) != 0 && position < pdu.length) mDataCodingScheme = pdu[position++] & 0xFF;
            if ((extraParams & 0x04) != 0 && position < pdu.length) parseUserData(pdu, position, (firstByte & 0x40) != 0);
        }
    }

    private int decodeDataCodingScheme()
    {
        int scheme = mDataCodingScheme;
        int encoding = ENCODING_7BIT;
        if ((scheme & 0x80) == 0)
        {
            if ((scheme & 0x20) != 0)
            {
                encoding = ENCODING_UNKNOWN;
            }
            else
            {
                int alphabet = (scheme >> 2) & 0x3;
                encoding = alphabet == 1 ? ENCODING_8BIT : alphabet == 2 ? ENCODING_16BIT : ENCODING_7BIT;
            }
            if ((scheme & 0x10) != 0) mMessageClass = MessageClass.values()[(scheme & 0x3) + 1];
        }
        else if ((scheme & 0xF0) == 0xF0)
        {
            encoding = (scheme & 0x04) == 0 ? ENCODING_7BIT : ENCODING_8BIT;
            mMessageClass = MessageClass.values()[(scheme & 0x3) + 1];
        }
        else if ((scheme & 0xF0) == 0xC0 || (scheme & 0xF0) == 0xD0 || (scheme & 0xF0) == 0xE0)
        {
            encoding = (scheme & 0xF0) == 0xE0 ? ENCODING_16BIT : ENCODING_7BIT;
            mIsMwi = true;
            mMwiSense = (scheme & 0x08) == 0x08;
            mMwiDontStore = (scheme & 0xF0) == 0xC0;
        }
        else if ((scheme & 0xC0) == 0x80)
        {
            encoding = scheme == 0x84 ? ENCODING_KSC5601 : ENCODING_UNKNOWN;
        }
        return encoding;
    }

    private void parseUserData(byte[] pdu, int position, boolean hasHeader)
    {
        int encoding = decodeDataCodingScheme();
        int userDataLength = pdu[position++] & 0xFF;
        int headerOctets = 0;
        if (hasHeader) headerOctets = (pdu[position] & 0xFF) + 1;

        if (encoding == ENCODING_7BIT)
        {
            int headerSeptets = (headerOctets * 8 + 6) / 7;
            int fillBits = headerSeptets * 7 - headerOctets * 8;
            int bodySeptets = Math.max(0, userDataLength - headerSeptets);
            int bodyOffset = position + headerOctets;
            mMessageBody = unpackGsm7Bit(pdu, bodyOffset, bodySeptets, fillBits);
            int packedLength = Math.min(pdu.length - position, (userDataLength * 7 + 7) / 8);
            mUserData = Arrays.copyOfRange(pdu, bodyOffset, Math.max(bodyOffset, position + packedLength));
        }
        else
        {
            int end = Math.min(pdu.length, position + userDataLength);
            int bodyOffset = Math.min(end, position + headerOctets);
            mUserData = Arrays.copyOfRange(pdu, bodyOffset, end);
            Charset charset = encoding == ENCODING_16BIT ? StandardCharsets.UTF_16BE
                : encoding == ENCODING_KSC5601 ? Charset.forName("EUC-KR") : StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1;
            mMessageBody = encoding == ENCODING_UNKNOWN ? null : new String(mUserData, charset);
        }

        if (mMessageBody != null && mOriginatingAddress != null && mOriginatingAddress.length() <= 4 && !mOriginatingAddress.isEmpty())
        {
            String[] parts = mMessageBody.split("( /)|( )", 2);
            if (parts.length >= 2 && EMAIL_PATTERN.matcher(parts[0]).matches())
            {
                mIsEmail = true;
                mEmailFrom = parts[0];
                mEmailBody = parts[1];
            }
        }
    }

    public String getServiceCenterAddress()
    {
        return mScAddress;
    }

    public String getOriginatingAddress()
    {
        return mOriginatingAddress;
    }

    public String getDisplayOriginatingAddress()
    {
        return mIsEmail ? mEmailFrom : mOriginatingAddress;
    }

    public String getRecipientAddress()
    {
        return mRecipientAddress;
    }

    public String getMessageBody()
    {
        return mMessageBody;
    }

    public MessageClass getMessageClass()
    {
        return mMessageClass;
    }

    public String getDisplayMessageBody()
    {
        return mIsEmail ? mEmailBody : mMessageBody;
    }

    public String getPseudoSubject()
    {
        return "";
    }

    public long getTimestampMillis()
    {
        return mTimestampMillis;
    }

    public boolean isEmail()
    {
        return mIsEmail;
    }

    public String getEmailBody()
    {
        return mEmailBody;
    }

    public String getEmailFrom()
    {
        return mEmailFrom;
    }

    public int getProtocolIdentifier()
    {
        return mProtocolIdentifier;
    }

    public boolean isReplace()
    {
        return (mProtocolIdentifier & 0xC0) == 0x40 && (mProtocolIdentifier & 0x3F) > 0 && (mProtocolIdentifier & 0x3F) < 8;
    }

    public boolean isCphsMwiMessage()
    {
        return mIsCphsMwi;
    }

    public boolean isMWIClearMessage()
    {
        if (mIsMwi && !mMwiSense) return true;
        return mIsCphsMwi && !mCphsMwiSet;
    }

    public boolean isMWISetMessage()
    {
        if (mIsMwi && mMwiSense) return true;
        return mIsCphsMwi && mCphsMwiSet;
    }

    public boolean isMwiDontStore()
    {
        if (mIsMwi && mMwiDontStore) return true;
        return mIsCphsMwi && " ".equals(mMessageBody);
    }

    public byte[] getUserData()
    {
        return mUserData;
    }

    public byte[] getPdu()
    {
        return mPdu;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public int getStatusOnSim()
    {
        return mStatusOnIcc;
    }

    public int getStatusOnIcc()
    {
        return mStatusOnIcc;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public int getIndexOnSim()
    {
        return mIndexOnIcc;
    }

    public int getIndexOnIcc()
    {
        return mIndexOnIcc;
    }

    public int getStatus()
    {
        return mStatus;
    }

    {
        return mIsStatusReport;
    }

    {
        return mReplyPathPresent;
    }
}
```

```java
    private static final Map<OnOpportunisticSubscriptionsChangedListener, Executor> sOpportunisticListeners =
        Collections.synchronizedMap(new LinkedHashMap<>());

    private final Context mContext;

    public SubscriptionManager(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public static SubscriptionManager from(Context context)
    {
        Object service = context == null ? null : context.getSystemService(Context.TELEPHONY_SUBSCRIPTION_SERVICE);
        return service instanceof SubscriptionManager ? (SubscriptionManager)service : new SubscriptionManager(context);
    }

    private static Executor mainExecutor()
    {
        Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
        return command -> handler.post(command);
    }

    public void addOnSubscriptionsChangedListener(OnSubscriptionsChangedListener listener)
    {
        addOnSubscriptionsChangedListener(mainExecutor(), listener);
    }

    public void addOnSubscriptionsChangedListener(Executor executor, OnSubscriptionsChangedListener listener)
    {
        if (executor == null || listener == null) return;
        sSubscriptionListeners.put(listener, executor);
        executor.execute(() ->
        {
            if (sSubscriptionListeners.containsKey(listener)) listener.onSubscriptionsChanged();
        });
    }

    public void removeOnSubscriptionsChangedListener(OnSubscriptionsChangedListener listener)
    {
        if (listener != null) sSubscriptionListeners.remove(listener);
    }

    public void addOnOpportunisticSubscriptionsChangedListener(Executor executor, OnOpportunisticSubscriptionsChangedListener listener)
    {
        if (executor == null || listener == null) return;
        sOpportunisticListeners.put(listener, executor);
        executor.execute(() ->
        {
            if (sOpportunisticListeners.containsKey(listener)) listener.onOpportunisticSubscriptionsChanged();
        });
    }

    public void removeOnOpportunisticSubscriptionsChangedListener(OnOpportunisticSubscriptionsChangedListener listener)
    {
        if (listener != null) sOpportunisticListeners.remove(listener);
    }
```

```java
package android.telephony;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.Objects;

public final class TelephonyDisplayInfo implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int OVERRIDE_NETWORK_TYPE_NONE = 0;
    public static final int OVERRIDE_NETWORK_TYPE_LTE_CA = 1;
    public static final int OVERRIDE_NETWORK_TYPE_LTE_ADVANCED_PRO = 2;
    public static final int OVERRIDE_NETWORK_TYPE_NR_NSA = 3;
    public static final int OVERRIDE_NETWORK_TYPE_NR_NSA_MMWAVE = 4;
    public static final int OVERRIDE_NETWORK_TYPE_NR_ADVANCED = 5;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<TelephonyDisplayInfo> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<TelephonyDisplayInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public TelephonyDisplayInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new TelephonyDisplayInfo(source.readInt(), source.readInt(), source.readBoolean());
        }

        @Override
        public TelephonyDisplayInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new TelephonyDisplayInfo[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mNetworkType;
    private final int mOverrideNetworkType;
    private final boolean mIsRoaming;

    TelephonyDisplayInfo(int networkType, int overrideNetworkType, boolean isRoaming)
    {
        mNetworkType = networkType;
        mOverrideNetworkType = overrideNetworkType;
        mIsRoaming = isRoaming;
    }

    public int getNetworkType()
    {
        return mNetworkType;
    }

    public int getOverrideNetworkType()
    {
        return mOverrideNetworkType;
    }

    public boolean isRoaming()
    {
        return mIsRoaming;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mNetworkType);
        dest.writeInt(mOverrideNetworkType);
        dest.writeBoolean(mIsRoaming);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof TelephonyDisplayInfo)) return false;
        TelephonyDisplayInfo info = (TelephonyDisplayInfo)other;
        return mNetworkType == info.mNetworkType && mOverrideNetworkType == info.mOverrideNetworkType && mIsRoaming == info.mIsRoaming;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mNetworkType, mOverrideNetworkType, mIsRoaming);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "TelephonyDisplayInfo {network=" + mNetworkType + ", overrideNetwork=" + mOverrideNetworkType + ", isRoaming=" + mIsRoaming
            + "}";
    }
}
```

```java
    private static void failCallComposerUpload(Executor executor, OutcomeReceiver<ParcelUuid, CallComposerException> callback)
    {
        if (executor == null || callback == null) return;
        executor.execute(() -> callback.onError(new CallComposerException(CallComposerException.ERROR_NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE, null)));
    }

    public void sendUssdRequest(String ussdRequest, UssdResponseCallback callback, Handler handler)
    {
        if (callback == null) return;
        Handler target = handler != null ? handler : new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
        target.post(() -> callback.onReceiveUssdResponseFailed(this, ussdRequest, USSD_ERROR_SERVICE_UNAVAIL));
    }

    @Deprecated
    public void listen(PhoneStateListener listener, int events)
    {
        if (listener == null) return;
        if (events == PhoneStateListener.LISTEN_NONE)
        {
            sListeners.remove(listener);
            return;
        }
        sListeners.put(listener, events);
        listener.mExecutor.execute(() -> dispatchInitialState(listener, events));
    }

    private void dispatchInitialState(PhoneStateListener listener, int events)
    {
        if ((events & PhoneStateListener.LISTEN_SERVICE_STATE) != 0) listener.onServiceStateChanged(getServiceState());
        if ((events & PhoneStateListener.LISTEN_SIGNAL_STRENGTH) != 0) listener.onSignalStrengthChanged(99);
        if ((events & PhoneStateListener.LISTEN_MESSAGE_WAITING_INDICATOR) != 0) listener.onMessageWaitingIndicatorChanged(false);
        if ((events & PhoneStateListener.LISTEN_CALL_FORWARDING_INDICATOR) != 0) listener.onCallForwardingIndicatorChanged(false);
        if ((events & PhoneStateListener.LISTEN_CALL_STATE) != 0) listener.onCallStateChanged(CALL_STATE_IDLE, "");
        if ((events & PhoneStateListener.LISTEN_DATA_CONNECTION_STATE) != 0)
        {
            listener.onDataConnectionStateChanged(DATA_DISCONNECTED, NETWORK_TYPE_UNKNOWN);
            listener.onDataConnectionStateChanged(DATA_DISCONNECTED);
        }
        if ((events & PhoneStateListener.LISTEN_DATA_ACTIVITY) != 0) listener.onDataActivity(DATA_ACTIVITY_NONE);
        if ((events & PhoneStateListener.LISTEN_SIGNAL_STRENGTHS) != 0) listener.onSignalStrengthsChanged(getSignalStrength());
        if ((events & PhoneStateListener.LISTEN_CELL_INFO) != 0) listener.onCellInfoChanged(getAllCellInfo());
        if ((events & PhoneStateListener.LISTEN_USER_MOBILE_DATA_STATE) != 0) listener.onUserMobileDataStateChanged(false);
        if ((events & PhoneStateListener.LISTEN_DISPLAY_INFO_CHANGED) != 0) listener.onDisplayInfoChanged(defaultDisplayInfo());
        if ((events & PhoneStateListener.LISTEN_ACTIVE_DATA_SUBSCRIPTION_ID_CHANGE) != 0)
        {
            listener.onActiveDataSubscriptionIdChanged(SubscriptionManager.INVALID_SUBSCRIPTION_ID);
        }
    }

    public void registerTelephonyCallback(Executor executor, TelephonyCallback callback)
    {
        registerTelephonyCallback(INCLUDE_LOCATION_DATA_FINE, executor, callback);
    }

    public void registerTelephonyCallback(int includeLocationData, Executor executor, TelephonyCallback callback)
    {
        if (executor == null) throw new IllegalStateException("telephony service is null.");
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalStateException("callback is null.");
        sCallbacks.put(callback, executor);
        executor.execute(() -> dispatchInitialState(callback));
    }

    public void unregisterTelephonyCallback(TelephonyCallback callback)
    {
        if (callback != null) sCallbacks.remove(callback);
    }

    private void dispatchInitialState(TelephonyCallback callback)
    {
        if (!sCallbacks.containsKey(callback)) return;
        if (callback instanceof TelephonyCallback.ServiceStateListener)
        {
            ((TelephonyCallback.ServiceStateListener)callback).onServiceStateChanged(getServiceState());
        }
        if (callback instanceof TelephonyCallback.MessageWaitingIndicatorListener)
        {
            ((TelephonyCallback.MessageWaitingIndicatorListener)callback).onMessageWaitingIndicatorChanged(false);
        }
        if (callback instanceof TelephonyCallback.CallForwardingIndicatorListener)
        {
            ((TelephonyCallback.CallForwardingIndicatorListener)callback).onCallForwardingIndicatorChanged(false);
        }
        if (callback instanceof TelephonyCallback.CallStateListener)
        {
            ((TelephonyCallback.CallStateListener)callback).onCallStateChanged(CALL_STATE_IDLE);
        }
        if (callback instanceof TelephonyCallback.DataConnectionStateListener)
        {
            ((TelephonyCallback.DataConnectionStateListener)callback).onDataConnectionStateChanged(DATA_DISCONNECTED, NETWORK_TYPE_UNKNOWN);
        }
        if (callback instanceof TelephonyCallback.DataActivityListener)
        {
            ((TelephonyCallback.DataActivityListener)callback).onDataActivity(DATA_ACTIVITY_NONE);
        }
        if (callback instanceof TelephonyCallback.SignalStrengthsListener)
        {
            ((TelephonyCallback.SignalStrengthsListener)callback).onSignalStrengthsChanged(getSignalStrength());
        }
        if (callback instanceof TelephonyCallback.CellInfoListener)
        {
            ((TelephonyCallback.CellInfoListener)callback).onCellInfoChanged(getAllCellInfo());
        }
        if (callback instanceof TelephonyCallback.UserMobileDataStateListener)
        {
            ((TelephonyCallback.UserMobileDataStateListener)callback).onUserMobileDataStateChanged(false);
        }
        if (callback instanceof TelephonyCallback.DisplayInfoListener)
        {
            ((TelephonyCallback.DisplayInfoListener)callback).onDisplayInfoChanged(defaultDisplayInfo());
        }
        if (callback instanceof TelephonyCallback.ActiveDataSubscriptionIdListener)
        {
            ((TelephonyCallback.ActiveDataSubscriptionIdListener)callback).onActiveDataSubscriptionIdChanged(
                SubscriptionManager.INVALID_SUBSCRIPTION_ID);
        }
        if (callback instanceof TelephonyCallback.CarrierNetworkListener)
        {
            ((TelephonyCallback.CarrierNetworkListener)callback).onCarrierNetworkChange(false);
        }
    }

    private static TelephonyDisplayInfo defaultDisplayInfo()
    {
        return new TelephonyDisplayInfo(NETWORK_TYPE_UNKNOWN, TelephonyDisplayInfo.OVERRIDE_NETWORK_TYPE_NONE, false);
    }

    public abstract static class CellInfoCallback
    {
        public static final int ERROR_TIMEOUT = 1;
        public static final int ERROR_MODEM_ERROR = 2;

        public CellInfoCallback()
        {
        }

        public abstract void onCellInfo(List<CellInfo> cellInfo);

        public void onError(int errorCode, Throwable detail)
        {
            onCellInfo(new ArrayList<>());
        }
    }

    public abstract static class UssdResponseCallback
    {
        public UssdResponseCallback()
        {
        }

        public void onReceiveUssdResponse(TelephonyManager telephonyManager, String request, CharSequence response)
        {
        }

        public void onReceiveUssdResponseFailed(TelephonyManager telephonyManager, String request, int failureCode)
        {
        }
    }

    public static class CallComposerException extends Exception
    {
        public static final int ERROR_UNKNOWN = 0;
        public static final int ERROR_REMOTE_END_CLOSED = 1;
        public static final int ERROR_FILE_TOO_LARGE = 2;
        public static final int ERROR_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED = 3;
        public static final int ERROR_INPUT_CLOSED = 4;
        public static final int ERROR_IO_EXCEPTION = 5;
        public static final int ERROR_NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE = 6;

        private final int mErrorCode;
        private final IOException mIOException;

        public CallComposerException(int errorCode, IOException ioException)
        {
            mErrorCode = errorCode;
            mIOException = ioException;
        }

        public int getErrorCode()
        {
            return mErrorCode;
        }

        public IOException getIOException()
        {
            return mIOException;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.telephony.cdma;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.telephony.CellLocation;

public class CdmaCellLocation extends CellLocation
{
    private static final int INVALID_LAT_LONG = Integer.MAX_VALUE;

    private int mBaseStationId = -1;
    private int mBaseStationLatitude = INVALID_LAT_LONG;
    private int mBaseStationLongitude = INVALID_LAT_LONG;
    private int mSystemId = -1;
    private int mNetworkId = -1;

    public CdmaCellLocation()
    {
    }

    public CdmaCellLocation(Bundle bundle)
    {
        mBaseStationId = bundle.getInt("baseStationId", -1);
        mBaseStationLatitude = bundle.getInt("baseStationLatitude", INVALID_LAT_LONG);
        mBaseStationLongitude = bundle.getInt("baseStationLongitude", INVALID_LAT_LONG);
        mSystemId = bundle.getInt("systemId", -1);
        mNetworkId = bundle.getInt("networkId", -1);
    }

    public int getBaseStationId()
    {
        return mBaseStationId;
    }

    public int getBaseStationLatitude()
    {
        return mBaseStationLatitude;
    }

    public int getBaseStationLongitude()
    {
        return mBaseStationLongitude;
    }

    public int getSystemId()
    {
        return mSystemId;
    }

    public int getNetworkId()
    {
        return mNetworkId;
    }

    @Override
    public void setStateInvalid()
    {
        mBaseStationId = -1;
        mBaseStationLatitude = INVALID_LAT_LONG;
        mBaseStationLongitude = INVALID_LAT_LONG;
        mSystemId = -1;
        mNetworkId = -1;
    }

    public void setCellLocationData(int baseStationId, int baseStationLatitude, int baseStationLongitude)
    {
        mBaseStationId = baseStationId;
        mBaseStationLatitude = baseStationLatitude;
        mBaseStationLongitude = baseStationLongitude;
    }

    public void setCellLocationData(int baseStationId, int baseStationLatitude, int baseStationLongitude, int systemId, int networkId)
    {
        setCellLocationData(baseStationId, baseStationLatitude, baseStationLongitude);
        mSystemId = systemId;
        mNetworkId = networkId;
    }

    public static double convertQuartSecToDecDegrees(int quartSec)
    {
        if (quartSec < -2592000 || quartSec > 2592000)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid coordiante value:" + quartSec);
        }
        return ((double)quartSec) / (3600 * 4);
    }

    @Override
    public void fillInNotifierBundle(Bundle bundle)
    {
        bundle.putInt("baseStationId", mBaseStationId);
        bundle.putInt("baseStationLatitude", mBaseStationLatitude);
        bundle.putInt("baseStationLongitude", mBaseStationLongitude);
        bundle.putInt("systemId", mSystemId);
        bundle.putInt("networkId", mNetworkId);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isEmpty()
    {
        return mBaseStationId == -1 && mBaseStationLatitude == INVALID_LAT_LONG && mBaseStationLongitude == INVALID_LAT_LONG
            && mSystemId == -1 && mNetworkId == -1;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mBaseStationId ^ mBaseStationLatitude ^ mBaseStationLongitude ^ mSystemId ^ mNetworkId;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof CdmaCellLocation)) return false;
        CdmaCellLocation location = (CdmaCellLocation)other;
        return mBaseStationId == location.mBaseStationId && mBaseStationLatitude == location.mBaseStationLatitude
            && mBaseStationLongitude == location.mBaseStationLongitude && mSystemId == location.mSystemId && mNetworkId == location.mNetworkId;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "[" + mBaseStationId + "," + mBaseStationLatitude + "," + mBaseStationLongitude + "," + mSystemId + "," + mNetworkId + "]";
    }
}
```

```java
package android.telephony.gsm;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.telephony.CellLocation;

public class GsmCellLocation extends CellLocation
{
    private int mLac;
    private int mCid;
    private int mPsc;

    public GsmCellLocation()
    {
        mLac = -1;
        mCid = -1;
        mPsc = -1;
    }

    public GsmCellLocation(Bundle bundle)
    {
        mLac = bundle.getInt("lac", -1);
        mCid = bundle.getInt("cid", -1);
        mPsc = bundle.getInt("psc", -1);
    }

    public int getLac()
    {
        return mLac;
    }

    public int getCid()
    {
        return mCid;
    }

    public int getPsc()
    {
        return mPsc;
    }

    @Override
    public void setStateInvalid()
    {
        mLac = -1;
        mCid = -1;
        mPsc = -1;
    }

    public void setLacAndCid(int lac, int cid)
    {
        mLac = lac;
        mCid = cid;
    }

    public void setPsc(int psc)
    {
        mPsc = psc;
    }

    @Override
    public void fillInNotifierBundle(Bundle bundle)
    {
        bundle.putInt("lac", mLac);
        bundle.putInt("cid", mCid);
        bundle.putInt("psc", mPsc);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isEmpty()
    {
        return mLac == -1 && mCid == -1 && mPsc == -1;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mLac ^ mCid;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof GsmCellLocation)) return false;
        GsmCellLocation location = (GsmCellLocation)other;
        return mLac == location.mLac && mCid == location.mCid && mPsc == location.mPsc;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "[" + mLac + "," + mCid + "," + mPsc + "]";
    }
}
```

```java
package android.telephony.mbms;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;

public class ServiceInfo
{
    private final Map<Locale, String> mNames;
    private final String mClassName;
    private final List<Locale> mLocales;
    private final String mServiceId;
    private final Date mSessionStartTime;
    private final Date mSessionEndTime;

    ServiceInfo(Map<Locale, String> names, String className, List<Locale> locales, String serviceId, Date start, Date end)
    {
        mNames = new HashMap<>(names == null ? new HashMap<Locale, String>() : names);
        mClassName = className;
        mLocales = new ArrayList<>(locales == null ? new ArrayList<Locale>() : locales);
        mServiceId = serviceId;
        mSessionStartTime = start == null ? null : (Date)start.clone();
        mSessionEndTime = end == null ? null : (Date)end.clone();
    }

    public CharSequence getNameForLocale(Locale locale)
    {
        if (!mNames.containsKey(locale)) throw new NoSuchElementException("Locale not supported");
        return mNames.get(locale);
    }

    public Set<Locale> getNamedContentLocales()
    {
        return Collections.unmodifiableSet(mNames.keySet());
    }

    public String getServiceClassName()
    {
        return mClassName;
    }

    public List<Locale> getLocales()
    {
        return mLocales;
    }

    public String getServiceId()
    {
        return mServiceId;
    }

    public Date getSessionStartTime()
    {
        return mSessionStartTime;
    }

    public Date getSessionEndTime()
    {
        return mSessionEndTime;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof ServiceInfo)) return false;
        ServiceInfo info = (ServiceInfo)other;
        return Objects.equals(mNames, info.mNames) && Objects.equals(mClassName, info.mClassName) && Objects.equals(mLocales, info.mLocales)
            && Objects.equals(mServiceId, info.mServiceId) && Objects.equals(mSessionStartTime, info.mSessionStartTime)
            && Objects.equals(mSessionEndTime, info.mSessionEndTime);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mNames, mClassName, mLocales, mServiceId, mSessionStartTime, mSessionEndTime);
    }
}
```

`java/android/text/AndroidCharacter.java`:

```java
package android.text;

public class AndroidCharacter
{
    public static final int EAST_ASIAN_WIDTH_NEUTRAL = 0;
    public static final int EAST_ASIAN_WIDTH_AMBIGUOUS = 1;
    public static final int EAST_ASIAN_WIDTH_HALF_WIDTH = 2;
    public static final int EAST_ASIAN_WIDTH_FULL_WIDTH = 3;
    public static final int EAST_ASIAN_WIDTH_NARROW = 4;
    public static final int EAST_ASIAN_WIDTH_WIDE = 5;

    private static final char[] MIRROR_PAIRS = {'(', ')', '<', '>', '[', ']', '{', '}', '«', '»', '‹', '›',
                                                '⁅', '⁆', '⁽', '⁾', '₍', '₎', '≤', '≥',
                                                '〈', '〉', '《', '》', '「', '」', '『', '』',
                                                '【', '】', '（', '）', '＜', '＞', '［', '］',
                                                '｛', '｝'};

    public AndroidCharacter()
    {
    }

    public static void getDirectionalities(char[] source, byte[] destination, int count)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            char character = source[index];

            if (Character.isHighSurrogate(character) && index + 1 < count && Character.isLowSurrogate(source[index + 1]))
            {
                byte direction = Character.getDirectionality(Character.toCodePoint(character, source[index + 1]));
                destination[index] = direction;
                destination[index + 1] = direction;
                index++;
                continue;
            }

            destination[index] = Character.getDirectionality(character);
        }
    }

    public static int getEastAsianWidth(char input)
    {
        if (input >= 0xFF61 && input <= 0xFFDC) return EAST_ASIAN_WIDTH_HALF_WIDTH;
        if (input >= 0xFFE8 && input <= 0xFFEE) return EAST_ASIAN_WIDTH_HALF_WIDTH;
        if (input == 0x3000 || (input >= 0xFF01 && input <= 0xFF60) || (input >= 0xFFE0 && input <= 0xFFE6))
        {
            return EAST_ASIAN_WIDTH_FULL_WIDTH;
        }

        if ((input >= 0x1100 && input <= 0x115F) || (input >= 0x2E80 && input <= 0x303E) || (input >= 0x3041 && input <= 0x33FF)
            || (input >= 0x3400 && input <= 0x4DBF) || (input >= 0x4E00 && input <= 0x9FFF) || (input >= 0xA000 && input <= 0xA4CF)
            || (input >= 0xAC00 && input <= 0xD7A3) || (input >= 0xF900 && input <= 0xFAFF) || (input >= 0xFE30 && input <= 0xFE4F))
        {
            return EAST_ASIAN_WIDTH_WIDE;
        }

        if ((input >= 0x20 && input <= 0x7E) || input == 0xA2 || input == 0xA3 || input == 0xA5 || input == 0xA6 || input == 0xAC
            || input == 0xAF)
        {
            return EAST_ASIAN_WIDTH_NARROW;
        }

        if (input == 0xA1 || input == 0xA4 || input == 0xA7 || input == 0xA8 || input == 0xAA || input == 0xAD || input == 0xAE
            || (input >= 0xB0 && input <= 0xB4) || (input >= 0xB6 && input <= 0xBA) || (input >= 0xBC && input <= 0xBF)
            || (input >= 0x2010 && input <= 0x203E) || (input >= 0x2460 && input <= 0x24FF) || (input >= 0x2500 && input <= 0x257F)
            || (input >= 0x25A0 && input <= 0x25FF) || (input >= 0xE000 && input <= 0xF8FF))
        {
            return EAST_ASIAN_WIDTH_AMBIGUOUS;
        }

        return EAST_ASIAN_WIDTH_NEUTRAL;
    }

    public static void getEastAsianWidths(char[] source, int start, int count, byte[] destination)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            destination[index] = (byte)getEastAsianWidth(source[start + index]);
        }
    }

    public static boolean mirror(char[] text, int start, int count)
    {
        boolean changed = false;

        for (int index = start; index < start + count; index++)
        {
            char mirrored = getMirror(text[index]);

            if (mirrored != text[index])
            {
                text[index] = mirrored;
                changed = true;
            }
        }

        return changed;
    }

    public static char getMirror(char character)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < MIRROR_PAIRS.length; index++)
        {
            if (MIRROR_PAIRS[index] == character) return (index & 1) == 0 ? MIRROR_PAIRS[index + 1] : MIRROR_PAIRS[index - 1];
        }

        return character;
    }
}
```

```java
        mValue = source.readString();
    }

    }

    @Override

        dest.writeString(mValue);
```

```java
package android.text;

import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Path;

public class BoringLayout extends Layout implements TextUtils.EllipsizeCallback
{
    private int mBottom;
    private int mDescent;
    private int mTopPadding;
    private int mBottomPadding;
    private float mMax;
    private int mEllipsizedWidth;
    private int mEllipsizedStart;
    private int mEllipsizedCount;
    private boolean mUseFallbackLineSpacing;

    public BoringLayout(CharSequence source, TextPaint paint, int outerWidth, Alignment alignment, float spacingMultiplier,
                        float spacingAdd, Metrics metrics, boolean includePad)
    {
        super(source, paint, outerWidth, alignment, spacingMultiplier, spacingAdd);

        mEllipsizedWidth = outerWidth;
        init(source, paint, alignment, metrics, includePad, true, false);
    }

    public BoringLayout(CharSequence source, TextPaint paint, int outerWidth, Alignment alignment, float spacingMultiplier,
                        float spacingAdd, Metrics metrics, boolean includePad, TextUtils.TruncateAt ellipsize, int ellipsizedWidth)
    {
        this(source, paint, outerWidth, alignment, spacingMultiplier, spacingAdd, metrics, includePad, ellipsize, ellipsizedWidth, false);
    }

    public BoringLayout(CharSequence source, TextPaint paint, int outerWidth, Alignment alignment, float spacingMultiplier,
                        float spacingAdd, Metrics metrics, boolean includePad, TextUtils.TruncateAt ellipsize, int ellipsizedWidth,
                        boolean useFallbackLineSpacing)
    {
        super(source, paint, outerWidth, alignment, spacingMultiplier, spacingAdd);

        boolean trust;

        if (ellipsize == null || ellipsize == TextUtils.TruncateAt.MARQUEE)
        {
            mEllipsizedWidth = outerWidth;
            mEllipsizedStart = 0;
            mEllipsizedCount = 0;
            trust = true;
        }
        else
        {
            TextUtils.ellipsize(source, paint, ellipsizedWidth, ellipsize, true, this);
            mEllipsizedWidth = ellipsizedWidth;
            trust = false;
        }

        init(getText(), paint, alignment, metrics, includePad, trust, useFallbackLineSpacing);
    }

    public static BoringLayout make(CharSequence source, TextPaint paint, int outerWidth, Alignment alignment, float spacingMultiplier,
                                    float spacingAdd, Metrics metrics, boolean includePad)
    {
        return new BoringLayout(source, paint, outerWidth, alignment, spacingMultiplier, spacingAdd, metrics, includePad);
    }

    public static BoringLayout make(CharSequence source, TextPaint paint, int outerWidth, Alignment alignment, float spacingMultiplier,
                                    float spacingAdd, Metrics metrics, boolean includePad, TextUtils.TruncateAt ellipsize,
                                    int ellipsizedWidth)
    {
        return new BoringLayout(source, paint, outerWidth, alignment, spacingMultiplier, spacingAdd, metrics, includePad, ellipsize,
                                ellipsizedWidth);
    }

    public static BoringLayout make(CharSequence source, TextPaint paint, int outerWidth, Alignment alignment, Metrics metrics,
                                    boolean includePad, TextUtils.TruncateAt ellipsize, int ellipsizedWidth,
                                    boolean useFallbackLineSpacing)
    {
        return new BoringLayout(source, paint, outerWidth, alignment, 1f, 0f, metrics, includePad, ellipsize, ellipsizedWidth,
                                useFallbackLineSpacing);
    }

    public BoringLayout replaceOrMake(CharSequence source, TextPaint paint, int outerWidth, Alignment alignment, float spacingMultiplier,
                                      float spacingAdd, Metrics metrics, boolean includePad)
    {
        replaceWith(source, paint, outerWidth, alignment, spacingMultiplier, spacingAdd);

        mEllipsizedWidth = outerWidth;
        mEllipsizedStart = 0;
        mEllipsizedCount = 0;

        init(source, paint, alignment, metrics, includePad, true, false);
        return this;
    }

    public BoringLayout replaceOrMake(CharSequence source, TextPaint paint, int outerWidth, Alignment alignment, Metrics metrics,
                                      boolean includePad, TextUtils.TruncateAt ellipsize, int ellipsizedWidth,
                                      boolean useFallbackLineSpacing)
    {
        boolean trust;

        if (ellipsize == null || ellipsize == TextUtils.TruncateAt.MARQUEE)
        {
            replaceWith(source, paint, outerWidth, alignment, 1f, 0f);
            mEllipsizedWidth = outerWidth;
            mEllipsizedStart = 0;
            mEllipsizedCount = 0;
            trust = true;
        }
        else
        {
            replaceWith(source, paint, ellipsizedWidth, alignment, 1f, 0f);
            mEllipsizedStart = 0;
            mEllipsizedCount = 0;
            TextUtils.ellipsize(source, paint, ellipsizedWidth, ellipsize, true, this);
            mEllipsizedWidth = ellipsizedWidth;
            trust = false;
        }

        init(getText(), paint, alignment, metrics, includePad, trust, useFallbackLineSpacing);
        return this;
    }

    public BoringLayout replaceOrMake(CharSequence source, TextPaint paint, int outerWidth, Alignment alignment, float spacingMultiplier,
                                      float spacingAdd, Metrics metrics, boolean includePad, TextUtils.TruncateAt ellipsize,
                                      int ellipsizedWidth)
    {
        return replaceOrMake(source, paint, outerWidth, alignment, metrics, includePad, ellipsize, ellipsizedWidth, false);
    }

    private void init(CharSequence source, TextPaint paint, Alignment alignment, Metrics metrics, boolean includePad, boolean trustWidth,
                      boolean useFallbackLineSpacing)
    {
        if (metrics == null) metrics = isBoring(source, paint, null);
        if (metrics == null) metrics = measure(source, paint, new Metrics());

        mUseFallbackLineSpacing = useFallbackLineSpacing;

        int spacing;
        if (includePad)
        {
            spacing = metrics.bottom - metrics.top;
            mDescent = metrics.bottom;
        }
        else
        {
            spacing = metrics.descent - metrics.ascent;
            mDescent = metrics.descent;
        }

        mBottom = spacing;

        if (includePad)
        {
            mTopPadding = metrics.top - metrics.ascent;
            mBottomPadding = metrics.bottom - metrics.descent;
        }
        else
        {
            mTopPadding = 0;
            mBottomPadding = 0;
        }

        if (trustWidth) mMax = metrics.width;
        else mMax = paint == null ? 0f : TextLine.measure(paint, source, 0, source.length(), null) - ellipsisSavings(paint, source);
    }

    private float ellipsisSavings(TextPaint paint, CharSequence source)
    {
        if (mEllipsizedCount <= 0) return 0f;

        int end = Math.min(source.length(), mEllipsizedStart + mEllipsizedCount);
        return TextLine.measure(paint, source, mEllipsizedStart, end, null) - paint.measureText(ELLIPSIS);
    }

    private static Metrics measure(CharSequence text, TextPaint paint, Metrics metrics)
    {
        if (paint == null)
        {
            metrics.width = 0;
            return metrics;
        }

        paint.getFontMetricsInt(metrics);
        metrics.width = (int)Math.ceil(TextLine.measure(paint, text, 0, text.length(), metrics));
        return metrics;
    }

    public static Metrics isBoring(CharSequence text, TextPaint paint)
    {
        return isBoring(text, paint, TextDirectionHeuristics.FIRSTSTRONG_LTR, false, null);
    }

    public static Metrics isBoring(CharSequence text, TextPaint paint, Metrics metrics)
    {
        return isBoring(text, paint, TextDirectionHeuristics.FIRSTSTRONG_LTR, false, metrics);
    }

    public static Metrics isBoring(CharSequence text, TextPaint paint, TextDirectionHeuristic direction, Metrics metrics)
    {
        return isBoring(text, paint, direction, false, metrics);
    }

    public static Metrics isBoring(CharSequence text, TextPaint paint, TextDirectionHeuristic direction, boolean useFallbackLineSpacing,
                                   Metrics metrics)
    {
        if (text == null) return null;

        int length = text.length();

        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
        {
            char character = text.charAt(index);

            if (character == '\n' || character == '\t') return null;
            if (character >= 0x0590 && character <= 0x08FF) return null;
            if (character >= 0xD800 && character <= 0xDFFF) return null;
            if (character >= 0xFB1D && character <= 0xFDFF) return null;
            if (character >= 0xFE70 && character <= 0xFEFE) return null;
            if (character >= 0x202A && character <= 0x202E) return null;
            if (character >= 0x2066 && character <= 0x2069) return null;
        }

        if (hasParagraphStyle(text)) return null;

        Metrics result = metrics == null ? new Metrics() : metrics;
        result.reset();

        return measure(text, paint, result);
    }

    @Override
    public int getHeight()
    {
        return mBottom;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLineCount()
    {
        return 1;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLineTop(int line)
    {
        return line == 0 ? 0 : mBottom;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLineDescent(int line)
    {
        return mDescent;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLineStart(int line)
    {
        return line == 0 ? 0 : getText().length();
    }

    @Override
    public int getParagraphDirection(int line)
    {
        return DIR_LEFT_TO_RIGHT;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean getLineContainsTab(int line)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public float getLineMax(int line)
    {
        return mMax;
    }

    @Override
    public float getLineWidth(int line)
    {
        return line == 0 ? mMax : 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public final Directions getLineDirections(int line)
    {
        return DIRS_ALL_LEFT_TO_RIGHT;
    }

    @Override
    public int getTopPadding()
    {
        return mTopPadding;
    }

    @Override
    public int getBottomPadding()
    {
        return mBottomPadding;
    }

    @Override
    public int getEllipsisCount(int line)
    {
        return mEllipsizedCount;
    }

    @Override
    public int getEllipsisStart(int line)
    {
        return mEllipsizedStart;
    }

    @Override
    public int getEllipsizedWidth()
    {
        return mEllipsizedWidth;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isFallbackLineSpacingEnabled()
    {
        return mUseFallbackLineSpacing;
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas, Path highlight, Paint highlightPaint, int cursorOffset)
    {
        super.draw(canvas, highlight, highlightPaint, cursorOffset);
    }

    @Override
    public void ellipsized(int start, int end)
    {
        mEllipsizedStart = start;
        mEllipsizedCount = end - start;
    }

    public static class Metrics extends Paint.FontMetricsInt
    {
        public int width;

        public Metrics()
        {
        }

        void reset()
        {
            top = 0;
            bottom = 0;
            ascent = 0;
            descent = 0;
            width = 0;
            leading = 0;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "BoringLayout.Metrics{top=" + top + ", ascent=" + ascent + ", descent=" + descent + ", bottom=" + bottom
                   + ", leading=" + leading + ", width=" + width + "}";
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/text/DynamicLayout.java`:

```java
package android.text;

import java.lang.ref.WeakReference;

public class DynamicLayout extends Layout
{
    private final CharSequence mBase;
    private final CharSequence mDisplay;
    private final TextPaint mTextPaint;
    private final int mLayoutWidth;
    private final Alignment mLayoutAlignment;
    private final TextDirectionHeuristic mTextDirection;
    private final float mLayoutSpacingMultiplier;
    private final float mLayoutSpacingAdd;
    private final boolean mIncludePad;
    private final boolean mFallbackLineSpacing;
    private final TextUtils.TruncateAt mEllipsizeAt;
    private final int mEllipsizedWidth;
    private final int mBreakStrategy;
    private final int mHyphenationFrequency;
    private final int mJustificationMode;
    private final ChangeWatcher mWatcher;

    private StaticLayout mLayout;
    private boolean mDirty = true;
    private String mSnapshot;

    public DynamicLayout(CharSequence base, TextPaint paint, int width, Alignment alignment, float spacingMultiplier, float spacingAdd,
                         boolean includePad)
    {
        this(base, base, paint, width, alignment, spacingMultiplier, spacingAdd, includePad);
    }

    public DynamicLayout(CharSequence base, CharSequence display, TextPaint paint, int width, Alignment alignment,
                         float spacingMultiplier, float spacingAdd, boolean includePad)
    {
        this(base, display, paint, width, alignment, spacingMultiplier, spacingAdd, includePad, null, 0);
    }

    public DynamicLayout(CharSequence base, CharSequence display, TextPaint paint, int width, Alignment alignment,
                         float spacingMultiplier, float spacingAdd, boolean includePad, TextUtils.TruncateAt ellipsize,
                         int ellipsizedWidth)
    {
        this(Builder.obtain(base, paint, width).setDisplayText(display).setAlignment(alignment)
                 .setLineSpacing(spacingAdd, spacingMultiplier).setIncludePad(includePad).setEllipsize(ellipsize)
                 .setEllipsizedWidth(ellipsizedWidth));
    }

    private DynamicLayout(Builder builder)
    {
        super(builder.mDisplay, builder.mPaint, builder.mWidth, builder.mAlignment, builder.mSpacingMultiplier, builder.mSpacingAdd);

        mBase = builder.mBase;
        mDisplay = builder.mDisplay;
        mTextPaint = builder.mPaint;
        mLayoutWidth = builder.mWidth;
        mLayoutAlignment = builder.mAlignment;
        mTextDirection = builder.mTextDirection;
        mLayoutSpacingMultiplier = builder.mSpacingMultiplier;
        mLayoutSpacingAdd = builder.mSpacingAdd;
        mIncludePad = builder.mIncludePad;
        mFallbackLineSpacing = builder.mFallbackLineSpacing;
        mEllipsizeAt = builder.mEllipsize;
        mEllipsizedWidth = builder.mEllipsize == null ? builder.mWidth : builder.mEllipsizedWidth;
        mBreakStrategy = builder.mBreakStrategy;
        mHyphenationFrequency = builder.mHyphenationFrequency;
        mJustificationMode = builder.mJustificationMode;

        if (mBase instanceof Spannable)
        {
            mWatcher = new ChangeWatcher(this);
            Spannable spannable = (Spannable)mBase;

            ChangeWatcher[] existing = spannable.getSpans(0, spannable.length(), ChangeWatcher.class);
            for (ChangeWatcher watcher : existing)
            {
                if (watcher.mLayout.get() == null) spannable.removeSpan(watcher);
            }

            spannable.setSpan(mWatcher, 0, mBase.length(), Spanned.SPAN_INCLUSIVE_INCLUSIVE | (100 << Spanned.SPAN_PRIORITY_SHIFT));
        }
        else
        {
            mWatcher = null;
        }
    }

    private StaticLayout layout()
    {
        if (!mDirty && mWatcher == null && mSnapshot != null && !mSnapshot.contentEquals(mDisplay)) mDirty = true;

        if (mDirty || mLayout == null)
        {
            mLayout = StaticLayout.Builder.obtain(mDisplay, 0, mDisplay.length(), mTextPaint, mLayoutWidth)
                .setAlignment(mLayoutAlignment).setTextDirection(mTextDirection)
                .setLineSpacing(mLayoutSpacingAdd, mLayoutSpacingMultiplier).setIncludePad(mIncludePad)
                .setUseLineSpacingFromFallbacks(mFallbackLineSpacing).setEllipsize(mEllipsizeAt)
                .setEllipsizedWidth(mEllipsizedWidth).setBreakStrategy(mBreakStrategy)
                .setHyphenationFrequency(mHyphenationFrequency).setJustificationMode(mJustificationMode).build();

            mDirty = false;
            if (mWatcher == null) mSnapshot = mDisplay.toString();
        }

        return mLayout;
    }

    void invalidate()
    {
        mDirty = true;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLineCount()
    {
        return layout().getLineCount();
    }

    @Override
    public int getLineTop(int line)
    {
        return layout().getLineTop(line);
    }

    @Override

    private static final class ChangeWatcher implements TextWatcher, SpanWatcher
    {
        private final WeakReference<DynamicLayout> mLayout;

        ChangeWatcher(DynamicLayout layout)
        {
            mLayout = new WeakReference<>(layout);
        }

        private void reflow()
        {
            DynamicLayout layout = mLayout.get();
            if (layout != null) layout.invalidate();
        }

        @Override
        public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence text, int start, int count, int after)
        {
        }

        @Override
        public void onTextChanged(CharSequence text, int start, int before, int count)
        {
            reflow();
        }

        @Override
        public void afterTextChanged(Editable text)
        {
        }

        @Override
        public void onSpanAdded(Spannable text, Object what, int start, int end)
        {
            if (what instanceof android.text.style.UpdateLayout) reflow();
        }

        @Override
        public void onSpanRemoved(Spannable text, Object what, int start, int end)
        {
            if (what instanceof android.text.style.UpdateLayout) reflow();
        }

        @Override
        public void onSpanChanged(Spannable text, Object what, int start, int end, int oldStart, int oldEnd)
        {
            if (what instanceof android.text.style.UpdateLayout) reflow();
        }
    }
```

`java/android/text/GraphemeClusterSegmentFinder.java`:

```java
package android.text;

import java.text.BreakIterator;

public class GraphemeClusterSegmentFinder extends SegmentFinder
{
    private final CharSequence mText;
    private final BreakIterator mBreaker;

    public GraphemeClusterSegmentFinder(CharSequence text, TextPaint textPaint)
    {
        mText = text;
        mBreaker = BreakIterator.getCharacterInstance();
        mBreaker.setText(text.toString());
    }

    @Override
    public int previousStartBoundary(int offset)
    {
        if (offset <= 0) return DONE;

        int boundary = mBreaker.preceding(Math.min(offset, mText.length()));
        return boundary == BreakIterator.DONE ? DONE : boundary;
    }

    @Override
    public int previousEndBoundary(int offset)
    {
        int boundary = previousStartBoundary(offset);
        if (boundary == DONE || boundary == 0) return DONE;

        return boundary;
    }

    @Override
    public int nextStartBoundary(int offset)
    {
        if (offset >= mText.length()) return DONE;
        if (offset < 0) return mText.length() == 0 ? DONE : 0;

        int boundary = mBreaker.following(offset);
        if (boundary == BreakIterator.DONE || boundary >= mText.length()) return DONE;

        return boundary;
    }

    @Override
    public int nextEndBoundary(int offset)
    {
        if (offset >= mText.length()) return DONE;

        int boundary = mBreaker.following(Math.max(0, offset));
        return boundary == BreakIterator.DONE ? DONE : boundary;
    }
}
```

`java/android/text/Highlights.java`:

```java
package android.text;

import android.graphics.Paint;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public class Highlights
{
    private final Paint[] mPaints;
    private final int[][] mRanges;

    private Highlights(Paint[] paints, int[][] ranges)
    {
        mPaints = paints;
        mRanges = ranges;
    }

    public int getSize()
    {
        return mPaints.length;
    }

    public Paint getPaint(int index)
    {
        return mPaints[index];
    }

    public int[] getRanges(int index)
    {
        return mRanges[index];
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final ArrayList<Paint> mPaints = new ArrayList<>();
        private final ArrayList<int[]> mRanges = new ArrayList<>();

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public Builder addRange(Paint paint, int start, int end)
        {
            if (start > end) throw new IllegalArgumentException("start must not be larger than end: " + start + ", " + end);
            if (paint == null) throw new NullPointerException("paint");

            mPaints.add(paint);
            mRanges.add(new int[] {start, end});
            return this;
        }

        public Builder addRanges(Paint paint, int... ranges)
        {
            if (ranges.length % 2 == 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Flatten ranges must have even numbered elements");

            for (int index = 0; index < ranges.length; index += 2)
            {
                if (ranges[index] > ranges[index + 1])
                {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Reverse range found in the flatten range: " + ranges[index] + ", "
                                                       + ranges[index + 1] + " at " + index);
                }
            }

            if (paint == null) throw new NullPointerException("paint");

            mPaints.add(paint);
            mRanges.add(ranges.clone());
            return this;
        }

        public Highlights build()
        {
            return new Highlights(mPaints.toArray(new Paint[0]), mRanges.toArray(new int[0][]));
        }
    }
}
```
