```java
package android.text;

import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.graphics.text.LineBreakConfig;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Objects;

public class PrecomputedText implements Spannable
{
    private final SpannableString mText;
    private final int mStart;
    private final int mEnd;
    private final Params mParams;
    private final int[] mParagraphEnds;

    private PrecomputedText(CharSequence text, int start, int end, Params params, int[] paragraphEnds)
    {
        mText = new SpannableString(text, true);
        mStart = start;
        mEnd = end;
        mParams = params;
        mParagraphEnds = paragraphEnds;
    }

    public static PrecomputedText create(CharSequence text, Params params)
    {
        if (text instanceof PrecomputedText)
        {
            PrecomputedText existing = (PrecomputedText)text;
            if (existing.getParams().equals(params)) return existing;
        }

        ArrayList<Integer> ends = new ArrayList<>();
        int length = text.length();

        for (int index = 0; index < length; )
        {
            int newline = TextUtils.indexOf(text, '\n', index, length);
            int end = newline < 0 ? length : newline + 1;

            ends.add(end);
            index = end;
        }

        int[] paragraphEnds = new int[ends.size()];
        for (int index = 0; index < paragraphEnds.length; index++)
        {
            paragraphEnds[index] = ends.get(index);
        }

        return new PrecomputedText(text, 0, length, params, paragraphEnds);
    }

    public CharSequence getText()
    {
        return mText;
    }

    public int getStart()
    {
        return mStart;
    }

    public int getEnd()
    {
        return mEnd;
    }

    public Params getParams()
    {
        return mParams;
    }

    public int getParagraphCount()
    {
        return mParagraphEnds.length;
    }

    public int getParagraphStart(int paragraphIndex)
    {
        Objects.checkIndex(paragraphIndex, getParagraphCount());

        return paragraphIndex == 0 ? mStart : getParagraphEnd(paragraphIndex - 1);
    }

    public int getParagraphEnd(int paragraphIndex)
    {
        Objects.checkIndex(paragraphIndex, getParagraphCount());

        return mParagraphEnds[paragraphIndex];
    }

    private void checkRange(int start, int end)
    {
        if (start < 0 || end > length() || start > end) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid range: " + start + ", " + end);
    }

    public float getWidth(int start, int end)
    {
        checkRange(start, end);

        float width = 0f;
        int paragraphStart = start;

        while (paragraphStart < end)
        {
            int newline = TextUtils.indexOf(mText, '\n', paragraphStart, end);
            int paragraphEnd = newline < 0 ? end : newline;

            width += TextLine.measure(mParams.getTextPaint(), mText, paragraphStart, paragraphEnd, null);
            paragraphStart = newline < 0 ? end : newline + 1;
        }

        return width;
    }

    public void getBounds(int start, int end, Rect bounds)
    {
        checkRange(start, end);
        Objects.requireNonNull(bounds);

        Paint.FontMetricsInt metrics = new Paint.FontMetricsInt();
        float width = start == end ? 0f : TextLine.measure(mParams.getTextPaint(), mText, start, end, metrics);

        bounds.set(0, metrics.ascent, (int)Math.ceil(width), metrics.descent);
    }

    public void getFontMetricsInt(int start, int end, Paint.FontMetricsInt outMetrics)
    {
        checkRange(start, end);
        Objects.requireNonNull(outMetrics);

        if (start == end)
        {
            mParams.getTextPaint().getFontMetricsInt(outMetrics);
            return;
        }

        TextLine.measure(mParams.getTextPaint(), mText, start, end, outMetrics);
    }

    @Override
    public void setSpan(Object what, int start, int end, int flags)
    {
        if (what instanceof android.text.style.MetricAffectingSpan)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("MetricAffectingSpan can not be set to PrecomputedText.");
        }

        mText.setSpan(what, start, end, flags);
    }

    @Override
    public void removeSpan(Object what)
    {
        if (what instanceof android.text.style.MetricAffectingSpan)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("MetricAffectingSpan can not be removed from PrecomputedText.");
        }

        mText.removeSpan(what);
    }

    @Override
    public <T> T[] getSpans(int start, int end, Class<T> type)
    {
        return mText.getSpans(start, end, type);
    }

    @Override
    public int getSpanStart(Object span)
    {
        return mText.getSpanStart(span);
    }

    @Override
    public int getSpanEnd(Object span)
    {
        return mText.getSpanEnd(span);
    }

    @Override
    public int getSpanFlags(Object span)
    {
        return mText.getSpanFlags(span);
    }

    @Override
    public int nextSpanTransition(int start, int limit, Class type)
    {
        return mText.nextSpanTransition(start, limit, type);
    }

    @Override
    public int length()
    {
        return mText.length();
    }

    @Override
    public char charAt(int index)
    {
        return mText.charAt(index);
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence subSequence(int start, int end)
    {
        return PrecomputedText.create(mText.subSequence(start, end), mParams);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mText.toString();
    }

    public static final class Params
    {
        private final TextPaint mPaint;
        private final TextDirectionHeuristic mTextDirection;
        private final int mBreakStrategy;
        private final int mHyphenationFrequency;
        private final LineBreakConfig mLineBreakConfig;

        private Params(TextPaint paint, LineBreakConfig lineBreakConfig, TextDirectionHeuristic textDirection, int breakStrategy,
                       int hyphenationFrequency)
        {
            mPaint = paint;
            mTextDirection = textDirection;
            mBreakStrategy = breakStrategy;
            mHyphenationFrequency = hyphenationFrequency;
            mLineBreakConfig = lineBreakConfig;
        }

        public TextPaint getTextPaint()
        {
            return mPaint;
        }

        public TextDirectionHeuristic getTextDirection()
        {
            return mTextDirection;
        }

        public int getBreakStrategy()
        {
            return mBreakStrategy;
        }

        public int getHyphenationFrequency()
        {
            return mHyphenationFrequency;
        }

        public LineBreakConfig getLineBreakConfig()
        {
            return mLineBreakConfig;
        }

        public boolean sameTextMetrics(Params other)
        {
            if (other == null) return false;

            return mBreakStrategy == other.mBreakStrategy && mHyphenationFrequency == other.mHyphenationFrequency
                   && mTextDirection == other.mTextDirection && samePaint(mPaint, other.mPaint);
        }

        private static boolean samePaint(TextPaint first, TextPaint second)
        {
            if (first == second) return true;
            if (first == null || second == null) return false;

            return first.getTextSize() == second.getTextSize() && first.getTextScaleX() == second.getTextScaleX()
                   && first.getTextSkewX() == second.getTextSkewX() && first.getLetterSpacing() == second.getLetterSpacing()
                   && first.getFlags() == second.getFlags() && Objects.equals(first.getTypeface(), second.getTypeface())
                   && Objects.equals(first.getTextLocales(), second.getTextLocales())
                   && Objects.equals(first.getFontFeatureSettings(), second.getFontFeatureSettings());
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object other)
        {
            if (other == this) return true;
            if (!(other instanceof Params)) return false;

            return sameTextMetrics((Params)other);
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return Objects.hash(mPaint == null ? 0f : mPaint.getTextSize(), mPaint == null ? 0f : mPaint.getTextScaleX(),
                                mPaint == null ? 0f : mPaint.getTextSkewX(), mPaint == null ? null : mPaint.getTypeface(),
                                mTextDirection, mBreakStrategy, mHyphenationFrequency);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "{textSize=" + (mPaint == null ? 0f : mPaint.getTextSize()) + ", textScaleX="
                   + (mPaint == null ? 0f : mPaint.getTextScaleX()) + ", textSkewX=" + (mPaint == null ? 0f : mPaint.getTextSkewX())
                   + ", letterSpacing=" + (mPaint == null ? 0f : mPaint.getLetterSpacing()) + ", textDir=" + mTextDirection
                   + ", breakStrategy=" + mBreakStrategy + ", hyphenationFrequency=" + mHyphenationFrequency + "}";
        }

        public static class Builder
        {
            private final TextPaint mPaint;
            private TextDirectionHeuristic mTextDirection = TextDirectionHeuristics.FIRSTSTRONG_LTR;
            private int mBreakStrategy = Layout.BREAK_STRATEGY_HIGH_QUALITY;
            private int mHyphenationFrequency = Layout.HYPHENATION_FREQUENCY_NORMAL;
            private LineBreakConfig mLineBreakConfig = new LineBreakConfig.Builder().build();

            public Builder(TextPaint paint)
            {
                mPaint = paint;
            }

            public Builder(Params params)
            {
                mPaint = params.mPaint;
                mTextDirection = params.mTextDirection;
                mBreakStrategy = params.mBreakStrategy;
                mHyphenationFrequency = params.mHyphenationFrequency;
                mLineBreakConfig = params.mLineBreakConfig;
            }

            public Builder setBreakStrategy(int strategy)
            {
                mBreakStrategy = strategy;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setHyphenationFrequency(int frequency)
            {
                mHyphenationFrequency = frequency;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setTextDirection(TextDirectionHeuristic textDirection)
            {
                mTextDirection = textDirection;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setLineBreakConfig(LineBreakConfig lineBreakConfig)
            {
                mLineBreakConfig = lineBreakConfig;
                return this;
            }

            public Params build()
            {
                return new Params(mPaint, mLineBreakConfig, mTextDirection, mBreakStrategy, mHyphenationFrequency);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/text/Selection.java`:

```java
package android.text;

public class Selection
{
    public static final Object SELECTION_START = new StartSelectionObject();
    public static final Object SELECTION_END = new EndSelectionObject();

    private static final Object SELECTION_MEMORY = new MemoryTextWatcher();

    private Selection()
    {
    }

    public static final int getSelectionStart(CharSequence text)
    {
        if (!(text instanceof Spanned)) return -1;

        return ((Spanned)text).getSpanStart(SELECTION_START);
    }

    public static final int getSelectionEnd(CharSequence text)
    {
        if (!(text instanceof Spanned)) return -1;

        return ((Spanned)text).getSpanStart(SELECTION_END);
    }

    private static int getSelectionMemory(CharSequence text)
    {
        if (!(text instanceof Spanned)) return -1;

        return ((Spanned)text).getSpanStart(SELECTION_MEMORY);
    }

    public static void setSelection(Spannable text, int start, int stop)
    {
        setSelection(text, start, stop, -1);
    }

    private static void setSelection(Spannable text, int start, int stop, int memory)
    {
        if (text == null) return;

        int length = text.length();
        start = Math.max(0, Math.min(start, length));
        stop = Math.max(0, Math.min(stop, length));

        int oldStart = getSelectionStart(text);
        int oldEnd = getSelectionEnd(text);

        if (oldStart != start || oldEnd != stop)
        {
            text.setSpan(SELECTION_START, start, start, Spanned.SPAN_POINT_POINT | Spanned.SPAN_INTERMEDIATE);
            text.setSpan(SELECTION_END, stop, stop, Spanned.SPAN_POINT_POINT);
            updateMemory(text, memory);
        }
    }

    private static void updateMemory(Spannable text, int memory)
    {
        if (memory > -1)
        {
            if (memory != getSelectionMemory(text)) text.setSpan(SELECTION_MEMORY, memory, memory, Spanned.SPAN_POINT_POINT);
        }
        else
        {
            removeMemory(text);
        }
    }

    private static void removeMemory(Spannable text)
    {
        text.removeSpan(SELECTION_MEMORY);
    }

    public static final void setSelection(Spannable text, int index)
    {
        setSelection(text, index, index);
    }

    public static final void selectAll(Spannable text)
    {
        if (text != null) setSelection(text, 0, text.length());
    }

    public static final void extendSelection(Spannable text, int index)
    {
        extendSelection(text, index, -1);
    }

    private static void extendSelection(Spannable text, int index, int memory)
    {
        if (text == null) return;

        int length = text.length();
        index = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, length));

        if (text.getSpanStart(SELECTION_END) != index) text.setSpan(SELECTION_END, index, index, Spanned.SPAN_POINT_POINT);

        updateMemory(text, memory);
    }

    public static final void removeSelection(Spannable text)
    {
        if (text == null) return;

        text.removeSpan(SELECTION_START);
        text.removeSpan(SELECTION_END);
        removeMemory(text);
    }

    public static boolean moveUp(Spannable text, Layout layout)
    {
        int start = getSelectionStart(text);
        int end = getSelectionEnd(text);

        if (start != end)
        {
            int min = Math.min(start, end);
            int max = Math.max(start, end);

            setSelection(text, min);

            return !(min == 0 && max == text.length());
        }

        int line = layout.getLineForOffset(end);

        if (line > 0)
        {
            setSelectionAndMemory(text, layout, line, end, -1, false);
            return true;
        }

        if (end != 0)
        {
            setSelection(text, 0);
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private static void setSelectionAndMemory(Spannable text, Layout layout, int line, int end, int direction, boolean extend)
    {
        int memory = getSelectionMemory(text);
        int origin = memory > -1 ? memory : end;
        float horizontal = layout.getPrimaryHorizontal(origin);
        int target = layout.getOffsetForHorizontal(line + direction, horizontal);

        if (extend) extendSelection(text, target, origin);
        else setSelection(text, target, target, origin);
    }

    public static boolean moveDown(Spannable text, Layout layout)
    {
        int start = getSelectionStart(text);
        int end = getSelectionEnd(text);

        if (start != end)
        {
            int min = Math.min(start, end);
            int max = Math.max(start, end);

            setSelection(text, max);

            return !(min == 0 && max == text.length());
        }

        int line = layout.getLineForOffset(end);

        if (line < layout.getLineCount() - 1)
        {
            setSelectionAndMemory(text, layout, line, end, 1, false);
            return true;
        }

        if (end != text.length())
        {
            setSelection(text, text.length());
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public static boolean moveLeft(Spannable text, Layout layout)
    {
        int start = getSelectionStart(text);
        int end = getSelectionEnd(text);

        if (start != end)
        {
            setSelection(text, Math.min(start, end));
            return true;
        }

        int target = layout == null ? TextUtils.getOffsetBefore(text, end) : layout.getOffsetToLeftOf(end);

        if (target != end)
        {
            setSelection(text, target);
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public static boolean moveRight(Spannable text, Layout layout)
    {
        int start = getSelectionStart(text);
        int end = getSelectionEnd(text);

        if (start != end)
        {
            setSelection(text, Math.max(start, end));
            return true;
        }

        int target = layout == null ? TextUtils.getOffsetAfter(text, end) : layout.getOffsetToRightOf(end);

        if (target != end)
        {
            setSelection(text, target);
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public static boolean moveToParagraphStart(Spannable text, Layout layout)
    {
        int start = getSelectionStart(text);
        int end = getSelectionEnd(text);
        if (start != end) return false;

        int target = paragraphStart(text, Math.min(start, end));
        setSelection(text, target);
        return true;
    }

    public static boolean moveToParagraphEnd(Spannable text, Layout layout)
    {
        int start = getSelectionStart(text);
        int end = getSelectionEnd(text);
        if (start != end) return false;

        int target = paragraphEnd(text, Math.max(start, end));
        setSelection(text, target);
        return true;
    }

    public static boolean extendToParagraphStart(Spannable text)
    {
        int end = getSelectionEnd(text);
        extendSelection(text, paragraphStart(text, end));
        return true;
    }

    public static boolean extendToParagraphEnd(Spannable text)
    {
        int end = getSelectionEnd(text);
        extendSelection(text, paragraphEnd(text, end));
        return true;
    }

    private static int paragraphStart(CharSequence text, int offset)
    {
        int index = Math.max(0, Math.min(offset, text.length()));
        while (index > 0 && text.charAt(index - 1) != '\n') index--;
        return index;
    }

    private static int paragraphEnd(CharSequence text, int offset)
    {
        int index = Math.max(0, Math.min(offset, text.length()));
        while (index < text.length() && text.charAt(index) != '\n') index++;
        return index;
    }

    public static boolean extendUp(Spannable text, Layout layout)
    {
        int end = getSelectionEnd(text);
        int line = layout.getLineForOffset(end);

        if (line > 0)
        {
            setSelectionAndMemory(text, layout, line, end, -1, true);
            return true;
        }

        if (end != 0)
        {
            extendSelection(text, 0);
            return true;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static boolean extendDown(Spannable text, Layout layout)
    {
        int end = getSelectionEnd(text);
        int line = layout.getLineForOffset(end);

        if (line < layout.getLineCount() - 1)
        {
            setSelectionAndMemory(text, layout, line, end, 1, true);
            return true;
        }

        if (end != text.length())
        {
            extendSelection(text, text.length(), -1);
            return true;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static boolean extendLeft(Spannable text, Layout layout)
    {
        int end = getSelectionEnd(text);
        int target = layout == null ? TextUtils.getOffsetBefore(text, end) : layout.getOffsetToLeftOf(end);

        if (target != end) extendSelection(text, target);

        return true;
    }

    public static boolean extendRight(Spannable text, Layout layout)
    {
        int end = getSelectionEnd(text);
        int target = layout == null ? TextUtils.getOffsetAfter(text, end) : layout.getOffsetToRightOf(end);

        if (target != end) extendSelection(text, target);

        return true;
    }

    public static boolean extendToLeftEdge(Spannable text, Layout layout)
    {
        int where = findEdge(text, layout, -1);
        extendSelection(text, where);
        return true;
    }

    public static boolean extendToRightEdge(Spannable text, Layout layout)
    {
        int where = findEdge(text, layout, 1);
        extendSelection(text, where);
        return true;
    }

    public static boolean moveToLeftEdge(Spannable text, Layout layout)
    {
        int where = findEdge(text, layout, -1);
        setSelection(text, where);
        return true;
    }

    public static boolean moveToRightEdge(Spannable text, Layout layout)
    {
        int where = findEdge(text, layout, 1);
        setSelection(text, where);
        return true;
    }

    private static int findEdge(Spannable text, Layout layout, int direction)
    {
        int point = Math.max(0, getSelectionEnd(text));
        int line = layout.getLineForOffset(point);

        if (direction < 0) return layout.getLineStart(line);

        int end = layout.getLineEnd(line);
        if (line == layout.getLineCount() - 1) return end;

        return Math.max(layout.getLineStart(line), end - 1);
    }

    private static final class StartSelectionObject implements NoCopySpan
    {
    }

    private static final class EndSelectionObject implements NoCopySpan
    {
    }

    private static final class MemoryTextWatcher implements NoCopySpan
    {
    }
}
```

`java/android/text/SpannableStringBuilder.java`:

```java
package android.text;

import java.lang.reflect.Array;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class SpannableStringBuilder implements CharSequence, GetChars, Spannable, Editable, Appendable
{
    private static final InputFilter[] NO_FILTERS = new InputFilter[0];
    private static final int POINT = 2;
    private static final int PARAGRAPH = 3;

    private final StringBuilder mText;
    private final List<SpanRecord> mSpans = new ArrayList<>();
    private InputFilter[] mFilters = NO_FILTERS;
    private int mTextWatcherDepth;
    private int mInsertionOrder;

    public SpannableStringBuilder()
    {
        this("");
    }

    public SpannableStringBuilder(CharSequence text)
    {
        this(text, 0, text == null ? 0 : text.length());
    }

    public SpannableStringBuilder(CharSequence text, int start, int end)
    {
        CharSequence source = text == null ? "" : text;

        if (end < start) throw new StringIndexOutOfBoundsException("start > end");

        mText = new StringBuilder(end - start);
        mText.append(source, start, end);

        if (source instanceof Spanned)
        {
            Spanned spanned = (Spanned)source;
            Object[] spans = spanned.getSpans(start, end, Object.class);

            for (Object span : spans)
            {
                if (span instanceof NoCopySpan) continue;

                int spanStart = spanned.getSpanStart(span) - start;
                int spanEnd = spanned.getSpanEnd(span) - start;
                int flags = spanned.getSpanFlags(span);

                if (spanStart < 0) spanStart = 0;
                if (spanStart > end - start) spanStart = end - start;
                if (spanEnd < 0) spanEnd = 0;
                if (spanEnd > end - start) spanEnd = end - start;

                setSpan(false, span, spanStart, spanEnd, flags, false);
            }
        }
    }

    public static SpannableStringBuilder valueOf(CharSequence source)
    {
        if (source instanceof SpannableStringBuilder) return (SpannableStringBuilder)source;

        return new SpannableStringBuilder(source);
    }

    @Override
    public char charAt(int index)
    {
        int length = length();

        if (index < 0) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("charAt: " + index + " < 0");
        if (index >= length) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("charAt: " + index + " >= length " + length);

        return mText.charAt(index);
    }

    @Override
    public int length()
    {
        return mText.length();
    }

    @Override
    public SpannableStringBuilder insert(int where, CharSequence text, int start, int end)
    {
        return replace(where, where, text, start, end);
    }

    @Override
    public SpannableStringBuilder insert(int where, CharSequence text)
    {
        return replace(where, where, text, 0, text.length());
    }

    @Override
    public SpannableStringBuilder delete(int start, int end)
    {
        return replace(start, end, "", 0, 0);
    }

    @Override
    public void clear()
    {
        replace(0, length(), "", 0, 0);
    }

    @Override
    public void clearSpans()
    {
        for (int index = mSpans.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            SpanRecord record = mSpans.get(index);
            mSpans.remove(index);
            sendSpanRemoved(record.what, record.start, record.end);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public SpannableStringBuilder append(CharSequence text)
    {
        int length = length();
        return replace(length, length, text, 0, text.length());
    }

    public SpannableStringBuilder append(CharSequence text, Object what, int flags)
    {
        int start = length();
        append(text);
        setSpan(what, start, length(), flags);
        return this;
    }

    @Override
    public SpannableStringBuilder append(CharSequence text, int start, int end)
    {
        int length = length();
        return replace(length, length, text, start, end);
    }

    @Override
    public SpannableStringBuilder append(char text)
    {
        return append(String.valueOf(text));
    }

    @Override
    public SpannableStringBuilder replace(int start, int end, CharSequence text)
    {
        return replace(start, end, text, 0, text.length());
    }

    @Override
    public SpannableStringBuilder replace(final int start, final int end, CharSequence text, int textStart, int textEnd)
    {
        checkRange("replace", start, end);

        for (InputFilter filter : mFilters)
        {
            CharSequence filtered = filter.filter(text, textStart, textEnd, this, start, end);

            if (filtered != null)
            {
                text = filtered;
                textStart = 0;
                textEnd = filtered.length();
            }
        }

        int originalLength = end - start;
        int newLength = textEnd - textStart;

        if (originalLength == 0 && newLength == 0 && !hasNonExclusiveExclusiveSpanAt(text, textStart)) return this;

        TextWatcher[] watchers = getSpans(start, start + originalLength, TextWatcher.class);
        sendBeforeTextChanged(watchers, start, originalLength, newLength);

        boolean adjustSelection = originalLength != 0 && newLength != 0;
        int selectionStart = 0;
        int selectionEnd = 0;

        if (adjustSelection)
        {
            selectionStart = Selection.getSelectionStart(this);
            selectionEnd = Selection.getSelectionEnd(this);
        }

        change(start, end, text, textStart, textEnd);

        if (adjustSelection)
        {
            if (selectionStart > start && selectionStart < end)
            {
                long offset = (long)(selectionStart - start) * newLength / originalLength;
                selectionStart = start + (int)offset;
                setSpan(false, Selection.SELECTION_START, selectionStart, selectionStart, Spanned.SPAN_POINT_POINT, true);
            }

            if (selectionEnd > start && selectionEnd < end)
            {
                long offset = (long)(selectionEnd - start) * newLength / originalLength;
                selectionEnd = start + (int)offset;
                setSpan(false, Selection.SELECTION_END, selectionEnd, selectionEnd, Spanned.SPAN_POINT_POINT, true);
            }
        }

        sendTextChanged(watchers, start, originalLength, newLength);
        sendAfterTextChanged(watchers);

        return this;
    }

    private static boolean hasNonExclusiveExclusiveSpanAt(CharSequence text, int offset)
    {
        if (!(text instanceof Spanned)) return false;

        Spanned spanned = (Spanned)text;
        Object[] spans = spanned.getSpans(offset, offset, Object.class);

        for (Object span : spans)
        {
            if (spanned.getSpanFlags(span) != Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private void change(int start, int end, CharSequence text, int textStart, int textEnd)
    {
        int replacedLength = end - start;
        int replacementLength = textEnd - textStart;
        int delta = replacementLength - replacedLength;
        boolean textIsRemoved = replacedLength > 0;

        ArrayList<SpanRecord> removed = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int index = mSpans.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            SpanRecord record = mSpans.get(index);

            if ((record.flags & Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE) == Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE && record.start >= start
                && record.start <= end && record.end >= start && record.end <= end
                && (textIsRemoved || record.start > start || record.end < end))
            {
                mSpans.remove(index);
                removed.add(record);
            }
        }

        int count = mSpans.size();
        int[] oldStarts = new int[count];
        int[] oldEnds = new int[count];
        Object[] what = new Object[count];

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            SpanRecord record = mSpans.get(index);
            oldStarts[index] = record.start;
            oldEnds[index] = record.end;
            what[index] = record.what;
        }

        String replacement = textStart == 0 && textEnd == text.length() ? text.toString() : text.subSequence(textStart, textEnd).toString();
        mText.replace(start, end, replacement);

        int newLength = mText.length();

        for (SpanRecord record : mSpans)
        {
            int flags = record.flags;
            int startFlag = (flags & Spanned.SPAN_POINT_MARK_MASK) >> 4;
            int endFlag = flags & 0x3;

            record.start = updatedBound(record.start, start, end, replacementLength, startFlag, false);
            record.end = updatedBound(record.end, start, end, replacementLength, endFlag, true);

            if ((flags & Spanned.SPAN_POINT_MARK_MASK) == Spanned.SPAN_PARAGRAPH)
            {
                record.start = paragraphBoundary(record.start, newLength);
                record.end = paragraphBoundary(record.end, newLength);
            }

            if (record.end < record.start) record.end = record.start;
        }

        ArrayList<SpanRecord> added = new ArrayList<>();

        if (text instanceof Spanned)
        {
            Spanned spanned = (Spanned)text;
            Object[] spans = spanned.getSpans(textStart, textEnd, Object.class);

            for (Object span : spans)
            {
                int spanStart = spanned.getSpanStart(span);
                int spanEnd = spanned.getSpanEnd(span);

                if (spanStart < textStart) spanStart = textStart;
                if (spanEnd > textEnd) spanEnd = textEnd;

                if (getSpanStart(span) >= 0) continue;

                int copyStart = spanStart - textStart + start;
                int copyEnd = spanEnd - textStart + start;
                int flags = spanned.getSpanFlags(span);

                if ((flags & Spanned.SPAN_POINT_MARK_MASK) == Spanned.SPAN_PARAGRAPH
                    && (isIndexFollowsNextLine(copyStart) || isIndexFollowsNextLine(copyEnd)))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                SpanRecord record = new SpanRecord(span, copyStart, copyEnd, flags, mInsertionOrder++);
                mSpans.add(record);
                added.add(record);
            }
        }

        for (SpanRecord record : removed)
        {
            sendSpanRemoved(record.what, record.start, record.end);
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            SpanRecord record = find(what[index]);
            if (record == null) continue;

            int oldStart = oldStarts[index];
            int oldEnd = oldEnds[index];

            boolean moved = record.start != oldStart || record.end != oldEnd;
            boolean touched = delta != 0 && (oldStart >= start && oldStart <= end || oldEnd >= start && oldEnd <= end);

            if (moved || touched) sendSpanChanged(record.what, oldStart, oldEnd, record.start, record.end);
        }

        for (SpanRecord record : added)
        {
            sendSpanAdded(record.what, record.start, record.end);
        }
    }

    private int paragraphBoundary(int offset, int length)
    {
        if (offset <= 0 || offset >= length) return offset;

        while (offset < length && mText.charAt(offset - 1) != '\n') offset++;

        return offset;
    }

    private static int updatedBound(int offset, int start, int end, int replacementLength, int flag, boolean atEnd)
    {
        if (offset < start) return offset;

        int delta = replacementLength - (end - start);

        if (offset > end) return offset + delta;

        if (offset == end && end > start) return start + replacementLength;

        if (flag == POINT) return start + replacementLength;
        if (flag == PARAGRAPH) return atEnd ? start + replacementLength : start;

        return start;
    }

    private void sendBeforeTextChanged(TextWatcher[] watchers, int start, int before, int after)
    {
        mTextWatcherDepth++;

        for (TextWatcher watcher : watchers)
        {
            watcher.beforeTextChanged(this, start, before, after);
        }

        mTextWatcherDepth--;
    }

    private void sendTextChanged(TextWatcher[] watchers, int start, int before, int after)
    {
        mTextWatcherDepth++;

        for (TextWatcher watcher : watchers)
        {
            watcher.onTextChanged(this, start, before, after);
        }

        mTextWatcherDepth--;
    }

    private void sendAfterTextChanged(TextWatcher[] watchers)
    {
        mTextWatcherDepth++;

        for (TextWatcher watcher : watchers)
        {
            watcher.afterTextChanged(this);
        }

        mTextWatcherDepth--;
    }

    private void sendSpanAdded(Object what, int start, int end)
    {
        SpanWatcher[] watchers = getSpans(start, end, SpanWatcher.class);

        for (SpanWatcher watcher : watchers)
        {
            watcher.onSpanAdded(this, what, start, end);
        }
    }

    private void sendSpanRemoved(Object what, int start, int end)
    {
        SpanWatcher[] watchers = getSpans(start, end, SpanWatcher.class);

        for (SpanWatcher watcher : watchers)
        {
            watcher.onSpanRemoved(this, what, start, end);
        }
    }

    private void sendSpanChanged(Object what, int oldStart, int oldEnd, int start, int end)
    {
        SpanWatcher[] watchers = getSpans(Math.min(oldStart, start), Math.min(Math.max(oldEnd, end), length()), SpanWatcher.class);

        for (SpanWatcher watcher : watchers)
        {
            watcher.onSpanChanged(this, what, oldStart, oldEnd, start, end);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setSpan(Object what, int start, int end, int flags)
    {
        setSpan(true, what, start, end, flags, true);
    }

    private boolean isIndexFollowsNextLine(int index)
    {
        return index != 0 && index != length() && mText.charAt(index - 1) != '\n';
    }

    private void setSpan(boolean send, Object what, int start, int end, int flags, boolean enforceParagraph)
    {
        checkRange("setSpan", start, end);

        int flagsStart = (flags & Spanned.SPAN_POINT_MARK_MASK) >> 4;
        if (isInvalidParagraph(start, flagsStart))
        {
            if (!enforceParagraph) return;
            throw new RuntimeException("PARAGRAPH span must start at paragraph boundary");
        }

        int flagsEnd = flags & 0x3;
        if (isInvalidParagraph(end, flagsEnd))
        {
            if (!enforceParagraph) return;
            throw new RuntimeException("PARAGRAPH span must end at paragraph boundary");
        }

        if (flagsStart == POINT && flagsEnd == 1 && start == end)
        {
            if (send) android.util.Log.e("SpannableStringBuilder", "SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE spans cannot have a zero length");
            return;
        }

        SpanRecord existing = find(what);

        if (existing != null)
        {
            int oldStart = existing.start;
            int oldEnd = existing.end;

            existing.start = start;
            existing.end = end;
            existing.flags = flags;

            if (send) sendSpanChanged(what, oldStart, oldEnd, start, end);
            return;
        }

        mSpans.add(new SpanRecord(what, start, end, flags, mInsertionOrder++));

        if (send) sendSpanAdded(what, start, end);
    }

    private boolean isInvalidParagraph(int index, int flag)
    {
        return flag == PARAGRAPH && index != 0 && index != length() && mText.charAt(index - 1) != '\n';
    }

    @Override
    public void removeSpan(Object what)
    {
        for (int index = mSpans.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            SpanRecord record = mSpans.get(index);
            if (record.what != what) continue;

            mSpans.remove(index);
            sendSpanRemoved(what, record.start, record.end);
            return;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int getSpanStart(Object what)
    {
        SpanRecord record = find(what);
        return record == null ? -1 : record.start;
    }

    @Override
    public int getSpanEnd(Object what)
    {
        SpanRecord record = find(what);
        return record == null ? -1 : record.end;
    }

    @Override
    public int getSpanFlags(Object what)
    {
        SpanRecord record = find(what);
        return record == null ? 0 : record.flags;
    }

    @Override
    public <T> T[] getSpans(int queryStart, int queryEnd, Class<T> kind)
    {
        return getSpans(queryStart, queryEnd, kind, true);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public <T> T[] getSpans(int queryStart, int queryEnd, Class<T> kind, boolean sortByInsertionOrder)
    {
        if (kind == null) return (T[])new Object[0];

        ArrayList<SpanRecord> found = new ArrayList<>();

        for (SpanRecord record : mSpans)
        {
            int spanStart = record.start;
            int spanEnd = record.end;

            if (spanStart > queryEnd || spanEnd < queryStart) continue;
            if (spanStart != spanEnd && queryStart != queryEnd && (spanStart == queryEnd || spanEnd == queryStart)) continue;
            if (kind != Object.class && !kind.isInstance(record.what)) continue;

            found.add(record);
        }

        found.sort((first, second) ->
        {
            int firstPriority = first.flags & Spanned.SPAN_PRIORITY;
            int secondPriority = second.flags & Spanned.SPAN_PRIORITY;

            if (firstPriority != secondPriority) return firstPriority > secondPriority ? -1 : 1;

            return Integer.compare(first.order, second.order);
        });

        T[] result = (T[])Array.newInstance(kind, found.size());
        for (int index = 0; index < found.size(); index++)
        {
            result[index] = (T)found.get(index).what;
        }

        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public int nextSpanTransition(int start, int limit, Class kind)
    {
        if (kind == null) kind = Object.class;

        for (SpanRecord record : mSpans)
        {
            if (record.start > start && record.start < limit && kind.isInstance(record.what)) limit = record.start;
            if (record.end > start && record.end < limit && kind.isInstance(record.what)) limit = record.end;
        }

        return limit;
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence subSequence(int start, int end)
    {
        return new SpannableStringBuilder(this, start, end);
    }

    @Override
    public void getChars(int start, int end, char[] destination, int destinationOffset)
    {
        checkRange("getChars", start, end);
        mText.getChars(start, end, destination, destinationOffset);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mText.toString();
    }

    public String substring(int start, int end)
    {
        return mText.substring(start, end);
    }

    public int getTextWatcherDepth()
    {
        return mTextWatcherDepth;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public int getTextRunCursor(int contextStart, int contextEnd, int direction, int offset, int cursorOpt, android.graphics.Paint paint)
    {
        int length = contextEnd - contextStart;
        if (length <= 0) return offset;

        if (cursorOpt == 0)
        {
            if (offset >= contextEnd) return contextEnd;
            return TextUtils.getOffsetAfter(this, offset);
        }

        if (cursorOpt == 2)
        {
            if (offset <= contextStart) return contextStart;
            return TextUtils.getOffsetBefore(this, offset);
        }

        return offset;
    }

    @Override
    public void setFilters(InputFilter[] filters)
    {
        if (filters == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException();

        mFilters = filters;
    }

    @Override
    public InputFilter[] getFilters()
    {
        return mFilters;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof Spanned) || !toString().equals(other.toString())) return false;

        Spanned spanned = (Spanned)other;
        Object[] otherSpans = spanned.getSpans(0, spanned.length(), Object.class);
        Object[] spans = getSpans(0, length(), Object.class);

        if (spans.length != otherSpans.length) return false;

        for (int index = 0; index < spans.length; index++)
        {
            Object span = spans[index];
            Object otherSpan = otherSpans[index];

            if (span == this)
            {
                if (spanned != otherSpan) return false;
            }
            else if (!span.equals(otherSpan))
            {
                return false;
            }

            if (getSpanStart(span) != spanned.getSpanStart(otherSpan) || getSpanEnd(span) != spanned.getSpanEnd(otherSpan)
                || getSpanFlags(span) != spanned.getSpanFlags(otherSpan))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        int hash = toString().hashCode();
        hash = hash * 31 + mSpans.size();

        for (SpanRecord record : mSpans)
        {
            if (record.what != this) hash = hash * 31 + record.what.hashCode();

            hash = hash * 31 + record.start;
            hash = hash * 31 + record.end;
            hash = hash * 31 + record.flags;
        }

        return hash;
    }

    private SpanRecord find(Object what)
    {
        for (int index = mSpans.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            SpanRecord record = mSpans.get(index);
            if (record.what == what) return record;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private void checkRange(String operation, int start, int end)
    {
        if (end < start)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException(operation + " " + region(start, end) + " has end before start");
        }

        int length = length();

        if (start > length || end > length)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException(operation + " " + region(start, end) + " ends beyond length " + length);
        }

        if (start < 0 || end < 0)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException(operation + " " + region(start, end) + " starts before 0");
        }
    }

    private static String region(int start, int end)
    {
        return "(" + start + " ... " + end + ")";
    }

    private static final class SpanRecord
    {
        final Object what;
        int start;
        int end;
        int flags;
        final int order;

        SpanRecord(Object what, int start, int end, int flags, int order)
        {
            this.what = what;
            this.start = start;
            this.end = end;
            this.flags = flags;
            this.order = order;
        }
    }
}

```

`java/android/text/SpannableStringInternal.java`:

```java
package android.text;

import java.lang.reflect.Array;

final class SpannableStringInternal
{
    private static final int START = 0;
    private static final int END = 1;
    private static final int FLAGS = 2;
    private static final int COLUMNS = 3;

    private final CharSequence mOwner;
    private final String mText;
    private Object[] mSpans;
    private int[] mSpanData;
    private int mSpanCount;

    SpannableStringInternal(CharSequence owner, CharSequence source, int start, int end, boolean ignoreNoCopySpan)
    {
        mOwner = owner;

        if (start == 0 && end == source.length()) mText = source.toString();
        else mText = source.toString().substring(start, end);

        mSpans = new Object[0];
        mSpanData = new int[0];

        if (source instanceof Spanned) copySpans((Spanned)source, start, end, ignoreNoCopySpan);
    }

    private void copySpans(Spanned source, int start, int end, boolean ignoreNoCopySpan)
    {
        Object[] spans = source.getSpans(start, end, Object.class);

        for (Object span : spans)
        {
            if (ignoreNoCopySpan && span instanceof NoCopySpan) continue;

            int spanStart = source.getSpanStart(span);
            int spanEnd = source.getSpanEnd(span);
            int flags = source.getSpanFlags(span);

            if (spanStart < start) spanStart = start;
            if (spanEnd > end) spanEnd = end;

            setSpan(span, spanStart - start, spanEnd - start, flags, false);
        }
    }

    public final int length()
    {
        return mText.length();
    }

    public final char charAt(int index)
    {
        return mText.charAt(index);
    }

    public final String toString()
    {
        return mText;
    }

    public final void getChars(int start, int end, char[] destination, int offset)
    {
        mText.getChars(start, end, destination, offset);
    }

    void setSpan(Object what, int start, int end, int flags)
    {
        setSpan(what, start, end, flags, true);
    }

    private boolean isIndexFollowsNextLine(int index)
    {
        return index != 0 && index != length() && charAt(index - 1) != '\n';
    }

    private void setSpan(Object what, int start, int end, int flags, boolean enforceParagraph)
    {
        checkRange("setSpan", start, end);

        if ((flags & Spanned.SPAN_POINT_MARK_MASK) == Spanned.SPAN_PARAGRAPH)
        {
            if (isIndexFollowsNextLine(start))
            {
                if (!enforceParagraph) return;
                throw new RuntimeException("PARAGRAPH span must start at paragraph boundary (" + start + " follows " + charAt(start - 1)
                                           + ")");
            }

            if (isIndexFollowsNextLine(end))
            {
                if (!enforceParagraph) return;
                throw new RuntimeException("PARAGRAPH span must end at paragraph boundary (" + end + " follows " + charAt(end - 1)
                                           + ")");
            }
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < mSpanCount; index++)
        {
            if (mSpans[index] != what) continue;

            int oldStart = mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + START];
            int oldEnd = mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + END];

            mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + START] = start;
            mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + END] = end;
            mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + FLAGS] = flags;

            sendSpanChanged(what, oldStart, oldEnd, start, end);
            return;
        }

        if (mSpanCount + 1 >= mSpans.length)
        {
            int capacity = Math.max(4, mSpans.length * 2);
            Object[] spans = new Object[capacity];
            int[] data = new int[capacity * COLUMNS];

            System.arraycopy(mSpans, 0, spans, 0, mSpanCount);
            System.arraycopy(mSpanData, 0, data, 0, mSpanCount * COLUMNS);

            mSpans = spans;
            mSpanData = data;
        }

        mSpans[mSpanCount] = what;
        mSpanData[mSpanCount * COLUMNS + START] = start;
        mSpanData[mSpanCount * COLUMNS + END] = end;
        mSpanData[mSpanCount * COLUMNS + FLAGS] = flags;
        mSpanCount++;

        if (mOwner instanceof Spannable) sendSpanAdded(what, start, end);
    }

    void removeSpan(Object what)
    {
        for (int index = mSpanCount - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            if (mSpans[index] != what) continue;

            int start = mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + START];
            int end = mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + END];

            int count = mSpanCount - (index + 1);
            System.arraycopy(mSpans, index + 1, mSpans, index, count);
            System.arraycopy(mSpanData, (index + 1) * COLUMNS, mSpanData, index * COLUMNS, count * COLUMNS);

            mSpanCount--;
            mSpans[mSpanCount] = null;

            sendSpanRemoved(what, start, end);
            return;
        }
    }

    public int getSpanStart(Object what)
    {
        for (int index = mSpanCount - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            if (mSpans[index] == what) return mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + START];
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public int getSpanEnd(Object what)
    {
        for (int index = mSpanCount - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            if (mSpans[index] == what) return mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + END];
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public int getSpanFlags(Object what)
    {
        for (int index = mSpanCount - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            if (mSpans[index] == what) return mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + FLAGS];
        }

        return 0;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public <T> T[] getSpans(int queryStart, int queryEnd, Class<T> kind)
    {
        int count = 0;
        Object[] found = null;
        int[] priorities = null;

        for (int index = 0; index < mSpanCount; index++)
        {
            int spanStart = mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + START];
            int spanEnd = mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + END];

            if (spanStart > queryEnd) continue;
            if (spanEnd < queryStart) continue;

            if (spanStart != spanEnd && queryStart != queryEnd)
            {
                if (spanStart == queryEnd) continue;
                if (spanEnd == queryStart) continue;
            }

            if (kind != null && kind != Object.class && !kind.isInstance(mSpans[index])) continue;

            if (found == null)
            {
                found = new Object[mSpanCount - index];
                priorities = new int[mSpanCount - index];
            }

            int priority = mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + FLAGS] & Spanned.SPAN_PRIORITY;
            int insertAt = count;

            if (priority != 0)
            {
                insertAt = 0;
                while (insertAt < count && priority <= priorities[insertAt]) insertAt++;

                System.arraycopy(found, insertAt, found, insertAt + 1, count - insertAt);
                System.arraycopy(priorities, insertAt, priorities, insertAt + 1, count - insertAt);
            }

            found[insertAt] = mSpans[index];
            priorities[insertAt] = priority;
            count++;
        }

        T[] result = (T[])Array.newInstance(kind == null ? Object.class : kind, count);
        if (count > 0) System.arraycopy(found, 0, result, 0, count);

        return result;
    }

    public int nextSpanTransition(int start, int limit, Class kind)
    {
        if (kind == null) kind = Object.class;

        for (int index = 0; index < mSpanCount; index++)
        {
            int spanStart = mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + START];
            int spanEnd = mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + END];

            if (spanStart > start && spanStart < limit && kind.isInstance(mSpans[index])) limit = spanStart;
            if (spanEnd > start && spanEnd < limit && kind.isInstance(mSpans[index])) limit = spanEnd;
        }

        return limit;
    }

    private void sendSpanAdded(Object what, int start, int end)
    {
        SpanWatcher[] watchers = getSpans(start, end, SpanWatcher.class);

        for (SpanWatcher watcher : watchers)
        {
            watcher.onSpanAdded((Spannable)mOwner, what, start, end);
        }
    }

    private void sendSpanRemoved(Object what, int start, int end)
    {
        if (!(mOwner instanceof Spannable)) return;

        SpanWatcher[] watchers = getSpans(start, end, SpanWatcher.class);

        for (SpanWatcher watcher : watchers)
        {
            watcher.onSpanRemoved((Spannable)mOwner, what, start, end);
        }
    }

    private void sendSpanChanged(Object what, int oldStart, int oldEnd, int start, int end)
    {
        if (!(mOwner instanceof Spannable)) return;

        SpanWatcher[] watchers = getSpans(Math.min(oldStart, start), Math.max(oldEnd, end), SpanWatcher.class);

        for (SpanWatcher watcher : watchers)
        {
            watcher.onSpanChanged((Spannable)mOwner, what, oldStart, oldEnd, start, end);
        }
    }

    private void checkRange(String operation, int start, int end)
    {
        if (end < start)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException(operation + " (" + start + " ... " + end + ") has end before start");
        }

        int length = length();

        if (start > length || end > length)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException(operation + " (" + start + " ... " + end + ") ends beyond length " + length);
        }

        if (start < 0 || end < 0)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException(operation + " (" + start + " ... " + end + ") starts before 0");
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof Spanned) || !toString().equals(other.toString())) return false;

        Spanned spanned = (Spanned)other;
        Object[] otherSpans = spanned.getSpans(0, spanned.length(), Object.class);
        Object[] spans = getSpans(0, length(), Object.class);

        if (spans.length != otherSpans.length) return false;

        for (int index = 0; index < spans.length; index++)
        {
            Object span = spans[index];
            Object otherSpan = otherSpans[index];

            if (span == mOwner)
            {
                if (spanned != otherSpan) return false;
            }
            else if (span == null ? otherSpan != null : !span.equals(otherSpan))
            {
                return false;
            }

            if (getSpanStart(span) != spanned.getSpanStart(otherSpan) || getSpanEnd(span) != spanned.getSpanEnd(otherSpan)
                || getSpanFlags(span) != spanned.getSpanFlags(otherSpan))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        int hash = toString().hashCode();
        hash = hash * 31 + mSpanCount;

        for (int index = 0; index < mSpanCount; index++)
        {
            Object span = mSpans[index];
            if (span != mOwner) hash = hash * 31 + span.hashCode();

            hash = hash * 31 + mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + START];
            hash = hash * 31 + mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + END];
            hash = hash * 31 + mSpanData[index * COLUMNS + FLAGS];
        }

        return hash;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.text;

public interface Spanned extends CharSequence
{
    int SPAN_POINT_MARK_MASK = 0x33;
    int SPAN_MARK_MARK = 0x11;
    int SPAN_MARK_POINT = 0x12;
    int SPAN_POINT_MARK = 0x21;
    int SPAN_POINT_POINT = 0x22;
    int SPAN_PARAGRAPH = 0x33;
    int SPAN_INCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE = SPAN_MARK_MARK;
    int SPAN_INCLUSIVE_INCLUSIVE = SPAN_MARK_POINT;
    int SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE = SPAN_POINT_MARK;
    int SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_INCLUSIVE = SPAN_POINT_POINT;
    int SPAN_COMPOSING = 0x100;
    int SPAN_INTERMEDIATE = 0x200;
    int SPAN_USER_SHIFT = 24;
    int SPAN_USER = 0xFFFFFFFF << SPAN_USER_SHIFT;
    int SPAN_PRIORITY_SHIFT = 16;
    int SPAN_PRIORITY = 0xFF << SPAN_PRIORITY_SHIFT;

    <T> T[] getSpans(int start, int end, Class<T> type);

    int getSpanStart(Object span);

    int getSpanEnd(Object span);

    int getSpanFlags(Object span);

    int nextSpanTransition(int start, int limit, Class type);
}
```

```java
package android.text;

public final class SpannedString implements CharSequence, GetChars, Spanned

    public SpannedString(CharSequence source)

        this(source, false);
    }

    SpannedString(CharSequence source, boolean ignoreNoCopySpan)
    {
        CharSequence text = source == null ? "" : source;
        mStore = new SpannableStringInternal(this, text, 0, text.length(), ignoreNoCopySpan);
```

`java/android/text/StaticLayout.java`:

```java
package android.text;

import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.text.style.LeadingMarginSpan;
import android.text.style.LineHeightSpan;

public class StaticLayout extends Layout
{
    private int mLineCount;
    private int[] mLineStarts;
    private int[] mLineTops;
    private int[] mLineDescents;
    private int[] mEllipsisStarts;
    private int[] mEllipsisCounts;
    private boolean[] mLineTabs;
    private int mTopPadding;
    private int mBottomPadding;
    private int mEllipsizedWidth;
    private int mMaximumLines;
    private boolean mFallbackLineSpacing;
    private int[] mLeftIndents;
    private int[] mRightIndents;

    public StaticLayout(CharSequence source, TextPaint paint, int width, Alignment alignment, float spacingMultiplier, float spacingAdd,
                        boolean includePad)
    {
        this(source, 0, source == null ? 0 : source.length(), paint, width, alignment, spacingMultiplier, spacingAdd, includePad);
    }

    public StaticLayout(CharSequence source, int bufferStart, int bufferEnd, TextPaint paint, int outerWidth, Alignment alignment,
                        float spacingMultiplier, float spacingAdd, boolean includePad)
    {
        this(source, bufferStart, bufferEnd, paint, outerWidth, alignment, spacingMultiplier, spacingAdd, includePad, null, 0);
    }

    public StaticLayout(CharSequence source, int bufferStart, int bufferEnd, TextPaint paint, int outerWidth, Alignment alignment,
                        float spacingMultiplier, float spacingAdd, boolean includePad, TextUtils.TruncateAt ellipsize, int ellipsizedWidth)
    {
        this(Builder.obtain(source == null ? "" : source, bufferStart, bufferEnd, paint, outerWidth).setAlignment(alignment)
                 .setLineSpacing(spacingAdd, spacingMultiplier).setIncludePad(includePad).setEllipsize(ellipsize)
                 .setEllipsizedWidth(ellipsizedWidth).setMaxLines(Integer.MAX_VALUE));
    }

    public StaticLayout(CharSequence source, int bufferStart, int bufferEnd, TextPaint paint, int outerWidth, Alignment alignment,
                        TextDirectionHeuristic direction, float spacingMultiplier, float spacingAdd, boolean includePad,
                        TextUtils.TruncateAt ellipsize, int ellipsizedWidth, int maxLines)
    {
        this(Builder.obtain(source == null ? "" : source, bufferStart, bufferEnd, paint, outerWidth).setAlignment(alignment)
                 .setTextDirection(direction).setLineSpacing(spacingAdd, spacingMultiplier).setIncludePad(includePad)
                 .setEllipsize(ellipsize).setEllipsizedWidth(ellipsizedWidth).setMaxLines(maxLines));
    }

    private StaticLayout(Builder builder)
    {
        super(builder.mText, builder.mPaint, builder.mWidth, builder.mAlignment, builder.mSpacingMultiplier, builder.mSpacingAdd);

        mEllipsizedWidth = builder.mEllipsize != null ? builder.mEllipsizedWidth : builder.mWidth;
        mMaximumLines = builder.mMaxLines;
        mFallbackLineSpacing = builder.mFallbackLineSpacing;
        mLeftIndents = builder.mLeftIndents;
        mRightIndents = builder.mRightIndents;

        generate(builder);
    }

    private void ensureCapacity(int lines)
    {
        if (mLineStarts != null && mLineStarts.length > lines + 1) return;

        int capacity = Math.max(8, lines * 2 + 2);
        mLineStarts = grow(mLineStarts, capacity);
        mLineTops = grow(mLineTops, capacity);
        mLineDescents = grow(mLineDescents, capacity);
        mEllipsisStarts = grow(mEllipsisStarts, capacity);
        mEllipsisCounts = grow(mEllipsisCounts, capacity);

        boolean[] tabs = new boolean[capacity];
        if (mLineTabs != null) System.arraycopy(mLineTabs, 0, tabs, 0, mLineTabs.length);
        mLineTabs = tabs;
    }

    private static int[] grow(int[] array, int capacity)
    {
        int[] grown = new int[capacity];
        if (array != null) System.arraycopy(array, 0, grown, 0, array.length);
        return grown;
    }

    private int indentWidth(int line)
    {
        int indent = 0;

        if (mLeftIndents != null && mLeftIndents.length > 0) indent += mLeftIndents[Math.min(line, mLeftIndents.length - 1)];
        if (mRightIndents != null && mRightIndents.length > 0) indent += mRightIndents[Math.min(line, mRightIndents.length - 1)];

        return indent;
    }

    private void generate(Builder builder)
    {
        CharSequence text = builder.mText;
        int start = builder.mStart;
        int end = builder.mEnd;
        TextPaint paint = builder.mPaint;
        int width = builder.mWidth;
        boolean includePad = builder.mIncludePad;
        TextUtils.TruncateAt ellipsize = builder.mEllipsize;

        boolean ellipsisMayBeApplied = ellipsize != null
                                       && (ellipsize == TextUtils.TruncateAt.END
                                           || (mMaximumLines == 1 && ellipsize != TextUtils.TruncateAt.MARQUEE));

        ensureCapacity(1);
        mLineCount = 0;
        mLineStarts[0] = start;
        mLineTops[0] = 0;

        Spanned spanned = text instanceof Spanned ? (Spanned)text : null;
        Paint.FontMetricsInt metrics = new Paint.FontMetricsInt();

        java.text.BreakIterator breaker = java.text.BreakIterator.getLineInstance(java.util.Locale.getDefault());
        String string = text.toString();
        breaker.setText(string);

        int paragraphStart = start;
        int top = 0;

        while (paragraphStart <= end)
        {
            int newline = TextUtils.indexOf(text, '\n', paragraphStart, end);
            int paragraphEnd = newline < 0 ? end : newline + 1;

            int firstWidth = width;
            int restWidth = width;
            int firstWidthLineCount = 1;
            LineHeightSpan[] chooseHeight = null;

            if (spanned != null)
            {
                LeadingMarginSpan[] margins = getParagraphSpans(spanned, paragraphStart, paragraphEnd, LeadingMarginSpan.class);

                for (LeadingMarginSpan margin : margins)
                {
                    firstWidth -= margin.getLeadingMargin(true);
                    restWidth -= margin.getLeadingMargin(false);

                    if (margin instanceof LeadingMarginSpan.LeadingMarginSpan2)
                    {
                        int spanLine = getLineForOffsetInternal(spanned.getSpanStart(margin));
                        int count = ((LeadingMarginSpan.LeadingMarginSpan2)margin).getLeadingMarginLineCount();
                        firstWidthLineCount = Math.max(firstWidthLineCount, spanLine + count - mLineCount);
                    }
                }

                chooseHeight = getParagraphSpans(spanned, paragraphStart, paragraphEnd, LineHeightSpan.class);
                if (chooseHeight.length == 0) chooseHeight = null;
            }

            int lineStart = paragraphStart;
            int paragraphLine = 0;

            while (true)
            {
                int available = (paragraphLine < firstWidthLineCount ? firstWidth : restWidth) - indentWidth(mLineCount);
                boolean lastAllowedLine = mLineCount + 1 >= mMaximumLines;

                int lineEnd;
                if (lastAllowedLine && ellipsisMayBeApplied) lineEnd = paragraphEnd;
                else lineEnd = breakLine(text, string, breaker, paint, lineStart, paragraphEnd, Math.max(1, available));

                boolean moreChars = lineEnd < end || paragraphEnd < end;
                boolean lastLine = lineEnd >= end || lastAllowedLine;

                top = addLine(text, paint, lineStart, lineEnd, top, metrics, chooseHeight, spanned, includePad, mLineCount == 0,
                              lastLine && !(lineEnd >= end && end > start && text.charAt(end - 1) == '\n'));

                if (ellipsize != null)
                {
                    boolean forceEllipsis = moreChars && lastAllowedLine;
                    boolean firstLine = mLineCount == 1;
                    boolean doEllipsis = (((mMaximumLines == 1 && moreChars) || (firstLine && !moreChars))
                                          && ellipsize != TextUtils.TruncateAt.MARQUEE)
                                         || (!firstLine && (lastAllowedLine || !moreChars) && ellipsize == TextUtils.TruncateAt.END);

                    if (doEllipsis)
                    {
                        calculateEllipsis(text, paint, lineStart, lineEnd, mLineCount - 1,
                                          mEllipsizedWidth - (width - (paragraphLine < firstWidthLineCount ? firstWidth : restWidth)),
                                          ellipsize, forceEllipsis);
                    }
                }

                paragraphLine++;
                lineStart = lineEnd;

                if (mLineCount >= mMaximumLines) break;
                if (lineStart >= paragraphEnd) break;
            }

            if (mLineCount >= mMaximumLines) break;

            if (paragraphEnd >= end)
            {
                if (end > start && text.charAt(end - 1) == '\n' && mLineCount < mMaximumLines)
                {
                    top = addLine(text, paint, end, end, top, metrics, null, null, includePad, mLineCount == 0, true);
                }
                break;
            }

            paragraphStart = paragraphEnd;
        }

        if (mLineCount == 0) top = addLine(text, paint, start, end, top, metrics, null, null, includePad, true, true);
    }

    private int getLineForOffsetInternal(int offset)
    {
        for (int line = mLineCount - 1; line >= 0; line--)
        {
            if (mLineStarts[line] <= offset) return line;
        }

        return 0;
    }

    private static float measure(CharSequence text, TextPaint paint, int start, int end)
    {
        if (end <= start) return 0f;

        if (!(text instanceof Spanned)) return paint.measureText(text, start, end);

        return TextLine.measure(paint, text, start, end, null);
    }

    private static int trimmedEnd(CharSequence text, int start, int end)
    {
        int trimmed = end;
        while (trimmed > start)
        {
            char character = text.charAt(trimmed - 1);
            if (character != ' ' && character != '\n' && character != '\t') break;
            trimmed--;
        }
        return trimmed;
    }

    private static int breakLine(CharSequence text, String string, java.text.BreakIterator breaker, TextPaint paint, int lineStart,
                                 int paragraphEnd, int available)
    {
        if (paint == null) return paragraphEnd;

        int visibleEnd = trimmedEnd(text, lineStart, paragraphEnd);
        if (measure(text, paint, lineStart, visibleEnd) <= available) return paragraphEnd;

        int lastFitting = -1;
        int candidate = breaker.following(lineStart);

        while (candidate != java.text.BreakIterator.DONE && candidate <= paragraphEnd)
        {
            float width = measure(text, paint, lineStart, trimmedEnd(text, lineStart, candidate));

            if (width > available) break;

            lastFitting = candidate;
            if (candidate >= paragraphEnd) break;

            candidate = breaker.next();
        }

        if (lastFitting > lineStart) return lastFitting;

        int limit = candidate == java.text.BreakIterator.DONE ? paragraphEnd : Math.min(candidate, paragraphEnd);
        return hardWrap(text, paint, lineStart, limit, available);
    }

    private static int hardWrap(CharSequence text, TextPaint paint, int lineStart, int limit, int available)
    {
        int low = lineStart + 1;
        int high = limit;
        int fits = lineStart;

        while (low <= high)
        {
            int middle = (low + high) >>> 1;

            if (measure(text, paint, lineStart, middle) <= available)
            {
                fits = middle;
                low = middle + 1;
            }
            else
            {
                high = middle - 1;
            }
        }

        if (fits <= lineStart) fits = TextUtils.getOffsetAfter(text, lineStart);
        if (fits > lineStart && fits < text.length() && Character.isLowSurrogate(text.charAt(fits))
            && Character.isHighSurrogate(text.charAt(fits - 1)))
        {
            fits = fits - 1 > lineStart ? fits - 1 : fits + 1;
        }

        return Math.min(fits, limit);
    }

    private int addLine(CharSequence text, TextPaint paint, int start, int end, int top, Paint.FontMetricsInt metrics,
                        LineHeightSpan[] chooseHeight, Spanned spanned, boolean includePad, boolean firstLine, boolean lastLine)
    {
        ensureCapacity(mLineCount + 1);

        int line = mLineCount;

        if (paint != null)
        {
            int visibleEnd = trimmedEnd(text, start, end);
            if (visibleEnd > start && text instanceof Spanned) TextLine.measure(paint, text, start, visibleEnd, metrics);
            else paint.getFontMetricsInt(metrics);
        }
        else
        {
            metrics.top = metrics.ascent = metrics.descent = metrics.bottom = metrics.leading = 0;
        }

        if (chooseHeight != null)
        {
            for (LineHeightSpan span : chooseHeight)
            {
                int spanStart = spanned.getSpanStart(span);
                int spanTop = spanStart < start ? mLineTops[getLineForOffsetInternal(spanStart)] : top;

                if (span instanceof LineHeightSpan.WithDensity)
                {
                    ((LineHeightSpan.WithDensity)span).chooseHeight(text, start, end, spanTop, top, metrics, paint);
                }
                else
                {
                    span.chooseHeight(text, start, end, spanTop, top, metrics);
                }
            }
        }

        int above = metrics.ascent;
        int below = metrics.descent;

        if (includePad && firstLine)
        {
            mTopPadding = metrics.top - metrics.ascent;
            above = metrics.top;
        }

        if (includePad && lastLine)
        {
            mBottomPadding = metrics.bottom - metrics.descent;
            below = metrics.bottom;
        }

        int extra = 0;
        float multiplier = getSpacingMultiplier();
        float add = getSpacingAdd();

        if ((multiplier != 1f || add != 0f) && !lastLine)
        {
            double extraSpace = (below - above) * (multiplier - 1) + add;
            extra = extraSpace >= 0 ? (int)(extraSpace + 0.5) : -(int)(-extraSpace + 0.5);
        }

        mLineStarts[line] = start;
        mLineTops[line] = top;
        mLineDescents[line] = below + extra;
        mEllipsisStarts[line] = 0;
        mEllipsisCounts[line] = 0;
        mLineTabs[line] = TextUtils.indexOf(text, '\t', start, end) >= 0;

        int bottom = top + (below - above) + extra;

        mLineCount++;
        mLineStarts[mLineCount] = end;
        mLineTops[mLineCount] = bottom;

        return bottom;
    }

    private void calculateEllipsis(CharSequence text, TextPaint paint, int lineStart, int lineEnd, int line, float available,
                                   TextUtils.TruncateAt where, boolean forceEllipsis)
    {
        if (paint == null) return;

        int visibleEnd = trimmedEnd(text, lineStart, lineEnd);
        float textWidth = measure(text, paint, lineStart, visibleEnd);

        if (textWidth <= available && !forceEllipsis)
        {
            mEllipsisStarts[line] = 0;
            mEllipsisCounts[line] = 0;
            return;
        }

        float ellipsisWidth = paint.measureText(ELLIPSIS);
        int length = visibleEnd - lineStart;
        float[] widths = new float[length];

        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
        {
            widths[index] = measure(text, paint, lineStart + index, lineStart + index + 1);
        }

        int ellipsisStart = 0;
        int ellipsisCount = 0;

        if (where == TextUtils.TruncateAt.START)
        {
            if (mMaximumLines == 1)
            {
                float sum = 0;
                int index = length;

                for (; index > 0; index--)
                {
                    float width = widths[index - 1];
                    if (width + sum + ellipsisWidth > available) break;
                    sum += width;
                }

                ellipsisStart = 0;
                ellipsisCount = index;
            }
        }
        else if (where == TextUtils.TruncateAt.END || where == TextUtils.TruncateAt.MARQUEE)
        {
            float sum = 0;
            int index = 0;

            for (; index < length; index++)
            {
                float width = widths[index];
                if (width + sum + ellipsisWidth > available) break;
                sum += width;
            }

            ellipsisStart = index;
            ellipsisCount = length - index;

            if (forceEllipsis && ellipsisCount == 0 && length > 0)
            {
                ellipsisStart = length - 1;
                ellipsisCount = 1;
            }
        }
        else if (mMaximumLines == 1)
        {
            float leftSum = 0;
            float rightSum = 0;
            int left = 0;
            int right = length;

            float rightAvailable = (available - ellipsisWidth) / 2;
            for (; right > 0; right--)
            {
                float width = widths[right - 1];
                if (width + rightSum > rightAvailable) break;
                rightSum += width;
            }

            float leftAvailable = available - ellipsisWidth - rightSum;
            for (; left < right; left++)
            {
                float width = widths[left];
                if (width + leftSum > leftAvailable) break;
                leftSum += width;
            }

            ellipsisStart = left;
            ellipsisCount = right - left;
        }

        mEllipsisStarts[line] = ellipsisStart;
        mEllipsisCounts[line] = ellipsisCount;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLineForVertical(int vertical)
    {
        int high = mLineCount;
        int low = -1;

        while (high - low > 1)
        {
            int guess = (high + low) >> 1;

            if (mLineTops[guess] > vertical) high = guess;
            else low = guess;
        }

        return Math.max(0, low);
    }

    @Override
    public int getLineCount()
    {
        return mLineCount;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLineTop(int line)
    {
        if (line < 0) return 0;
        if (line > mLineCount) return mLineTops[mLineCount];

        return mLineTops[line];
    }

    @Override
    public int getLineDescent(int line)
    {
        if (line < 0 || line >= mLineCount) return 0;

        return mLineDescents[line];
    }

    @Override
    public int getLineStart(int line)
    {
        if (line < 0) return mLineStarts[0];
        if (line > mLineCount) return mLineStarts[mLineCount];

        return mLineStarts[line];
    }

    @Override
    public int getParagraphDirection(int line)
    {
        return DIR_LEFT_TO_RIGHT;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean getLineContainsTab(int line)
    {
        return line >= 0 && line < mLineCount && mLineTabs[line];
    }

    @Override
    public final Directions getLineDirections(int line)
    {
        return DIRS_ALL_LEFT_TO_RIGHT;
    }

    @Override
    public int getTopPadding()
    {
        return mTopPadding;
    }

    @Override
    public int getBottomPadding()
    {
        return mBottomPadding;
    }

    @Override
    public int getEllipsisCount(int line)
    {
        if (line < 0 || line >= mLineCount) return 0;

        return mEllipsisCounts[line];
    }

    @Override
    public int getEllipsisStart(int line)
    {
        if (line < 0 || line >= mLineCount) return 0;

        return mEllipsisStarts[line];
    }

    @Override
    public int getEllipsizedWidth()
    {
        return mEllipsizedWidth;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isFallbackLineSpacingEnabled()
    {
        return mFallbackLineSpacing;
    }

    public static final class Builder

        public StaticLayout build()
        {
            if (mText == null) mText = "";
            if (mMaxLines <= 0) mMaxLines = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            if (mWidth < 0) mWidth = 0;
            if (mStart < 0) mStart = 0;
            if (mEnd > mText.length()) mEnd = mText.length();
            if (mEnd < mStart) mEnd = mStart;

            return new StaticLayout(this);
        }
    }
```
