`java/android/text/TextDirectionHeuristics.java`:

```java
package android.text;

public class TextDirectionHeuristics
{
    public static final TextDirectionHeuristic LTR = new Fixed(false);
    public static final TextDirectionHeuristic RTL = new Fixed(true);
    public static final TextDirectionHeuristic FIRSTSTRONG_LTR = new FirstStrong(false);
    public static final TextDirectionHeuristic FIRSTSTRONG_RTL = new FirstStrong(true);
    public static final TextDirectionHeuristic ANYRTL_LTR = new AnyRtl();
    public static final TextDirectionHeuristic LOCALE = new FirstStrong(false);

    public TextDirectionHeuristics()
    {
    }

    private static final class Fixed implements TextDirectionHeuristic
    {
        private final boolean mRtl;

        Fixed(boolean rtl)
        {
            mRtl = rtl;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isRtl(char[] array, int start, int count)
        {
            return mRtl;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isRtl(CharSequence text, int start, int count)
        {
            return mRtl;
        }
    }

    private static final class FirstStrong implements TextDirectionHeuristic
    {
        private final boolean mFallback;

        FirstStrong(boolean fallback)
        {
            mFallback = fallback;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isRtl(char[] array, int start, int count)
        {
            return isRtl(new String(array, start, count), 0, count);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isRtl(CharSequence text, int start, int count)
        {
            if (text == null) return mFallback;

            for (int index = start; index < start + count && index < text.length(); index++)
            {
                byte direction = Character.getDirectionality(text.charAt(index));

                if (direction == Character.DIRECTIONALITY_LEFT_TO_RIGHT) return false;

                if (direction == Character.DIRECTIONALITY_RIGHT_TO_LEFT
                    || direction == Character.DIRECTIONALITY_RIGHT_TO_LEFT_ARABIC)
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return mFallback;
        }
    }

    private static final class AnyRtl implements TextDirectionHeuristic
    {
        @Override
        public boolean isRtl(char[] array, int start, int count)
        {
            return isRtl(new String(array, start, count), 0, count);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isRtl(CharSequence text, int start, int count)
        {
            if (text == null) return false;

            for (int index = start; index < start + count && index < text.length(); index++)
            {
                byte direction = Character.getDirectionality(text.charAt(index));

                if (direction == Character.DIRECTIONALITY_RIGHT_TO_LEFT
                    || direction == Character.DIRECTIONALITY_RIGHT_TO_LEFT_ARABIC)
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/text/TextLine.java`:

```java
package android.text;

import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.text.style.CharacterStyle;
import android.text.style.MetricAffectingSpan;
import android.text.style.ReplacementSpan;
import android.text.style.TabStopSpan;

final class TextLine
{
    private static final int TAB_INCREMENT = 20;

    private final TextPaint mWorkPaint = new TextPaint();
    private final Paint.FontMetricsInt mWorkMetrics = new Paint.FontMetricsInt();

    private TextLine()
    {
    }

    static TextLine obtain()
    {
        return new TextLine();
    }

    static float measure(TextPaint paint, CharSequence text, int start, int end, Paint.FontMetricsInt metrics)
    {
        return obtain().run(null, paint, text, start, end, 0f, 0, 0, 0, metrics, -1);
    }

    static float measureTo(TextPaint paint, CharSequence text, int start, int end, int offset)
    {
        return obtain().run(null, paint, text, start, end, 0f, 0, 0, 0, null, offset);
    }

    static void draw(Canvas canvas, TextPaint paint, CharSequence text, int start, int end, float x, int top, int baseline, int bottom)
    {
        obtain().run(canvas, paint, text, start, end, x, top, baseline, bottom, null, -1);
    }

    static int offsetForAdvance(TextPaint paint, CharSequence text, int start, int end, float advance)
    {
        if (advance <= 0) return start;

        TextLine line = obtain();
        float previous = 0f;

        for (int index = start; index < end; )
        {
            int next = TextUtils.getOffsetAfter(text, index);
            if (next > end) next = end;

            float width = line.run(null, paint, text, start, end, 0f, 0, 0, 0, null, next);

            if (width >= advance) return advance - previous < width - advance ? index : next;

            previous = width;
            index = next;
        }

        return end;
    }

    private static boolean hasTab(CharSequence text, int start, int end)
    {
        for (int index = start; index < end; index++)
        {
            if (text.charAt(index) == '\t') return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private float nextTab(CharSequence text, int start, int end, float horizontal)
    {
        if (text instanceof Spanned)
        {
            TabStopSpan[] stops = ((Spanned)text).getSpans(start, end, TabStopSpan.class);
            float best = Float.MAX_VALUE;

            for (TabStopSpan stop : stops)
            {
                int where = stop.getTabStop();
                if (where > horizontal && where < best) best = where;
            }

            if (best != Float.MAX_VALUE) return best;
        }

        return ((int)((horizontal + TAB_INCREMENT) / TAB_INCREMENT)) * TAB_INCREMENT;
    }

    private float run(Canvas canvas, TextPaint base, CharSequence text, int start, int end, float x, int top, int baseline, int bottom,
                      Paint.FontMetricsInt metrics, int stopAt)
    {
        if (base == null || text == null) return 0f;

        int limit = stopAt >= 0 ? Math.min(stopAt, end) : end;
        float horizontal = 0f;

        if (metrics != null) mergeMetrics(base, metrics, true);

        boolean tabs = hasTab(text, start, limit);
        Spanned spanned = text instanceof Spanned ? (Spanned)text : null;

        int segmentStart = start;
        while (segmentStart < limit)
        {
            int segmentEnd = limit;

            if (tabs)
            {
                int tab = TextUtils.indexOf(text, '\t', segmentStart, limit);
                if (tab >= 0) segmentEnd = tab;
            }

            if (spanned == null)
            {
                horizontal += drawRun(canvas, base, text, segmentStart, segmentEnd, x + horizontal, top, baseline, bottom, metrics);
            }
            else
            {
                horizontal += runSpans(canvas, base, spanned, segmentStart, segmentEnd, x + horizontal, top, baseline, bottom, metrics,
                                       start, end);
            }

            if (segmentEnd < limit)
            {
                horizontal = nextTab(text, start, end, horizontal);
                segmentStart = segmentEnd + 1;
            }
            else
            {
                segmentStart = segmentEnd;
            }
        }

        return horizontal;
    }

    private float runSpans(Canvas canvas, TextPaint base, Spanned text, int start, int end, float x, int top, int baseline, int bottom,
                           Paint.FontMetricsInt metrics, int lineStart, int lineEnd)
    {
        float horizontal = 0f;

        for (int index = start; index < end; )
        {
            int next = text.nextSpanTransition(index, end, CharacterStyle.class);

            CharacterStyle[] styles = text.getSpans(index, next, CharacterStyle.class);
            ReplacementSpan replacement = null;

            mWorkPaint.set(base);
            mWorkPaint.baselineShift = 0;
            mWorkPaint.bgColor = 0;

            for (CharacterStyle style : styles)
            {
                int spanStart = text.getSpanStart(style);
                int spanEnd = text.getSpanEnd(style);
                if (spanStart > index || spanEnd < next || spanStart == spanEnd) continue;

                if (style instanceof ReplacementSpan)
                {
                    replacement = (ReplacementSpan)style;
                    continue;
                }

                if (canvas != null) style.updateDrawState(mWorkPaint);
                else if (style instanceof MetricAffectingSpan) ((MetricAffectingSpan)style).updateMeasureState(mWorkPaint);
            }

            if (replacement != null)
            {
                int spanStart = Math.max(text.getSpanStart(replacement), lineStart);
                int spanEnd = Math.min(text.getSpanEnd(replacement), lineEnd);

                if (spanStart == index)
                {
                    Paint.FontMetricsInt replacementMetrics = metrics == null ? null : mWorkMetrics;
                    if (replacementMetrics != null) base.getFontMetricsInt(replacementMetrics);

                    float width = replacement.getSize(mWorkPaint, text, spanStart, spanEnd, replacementMetrics);

                    if (replacementMetrics != null) mergeMetricsFrom(replacementMetrics, metrics);
                    if (canvas != null)
                    {
                        replacement.draw(canvas, text, spanStart, spanEnd, x + horizontal, top, baseline, bottom, mWorkPaint);
                    }

                    horizontal += width;
                }

                index = Math.max(next, Math.min(spanEnd, end));
                continue;
            }

            horizontal += drawRun(canvas, mWorkPaint, text, index, next, x + horizontal, top, baseline, bottom, metrics);
            index = next;
        }

        return horizontal;
    }

    private float drawRun(Canvas canvas, TextPaint paint, CharSequence text, int start, int end, float x, int top, int baseline,
                          int bottom, Paint.FontMetricsInt metrics)
    {
        if (end <= start) return 0f;

        float width = paint.measureText(text, start, end);

        if (metrics != null) mergeMetrics(paint, metrics, false);

        if (canvas == null) return width;

        if (paint.bgColor != 0)
        {
            int color = paint.getColor();
            Paint.Style style = paint.getStyle();

            paint.setColor(paint.bgColor);
            paint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
            canvas.drawRect(x, top, x + width, bottom, paint);

            paint.setStyle(style);
            paint.setColor(color);
        }

        int y = baseline + paint.baselineShift;
        canvas.drawText(text, start, end, x, y, paint);

        float size = paint.getTextSize();

        if (paint.isUnderlineText() || paint.underlineColor != 0)
        {
            float thickness = paint.underlineThickness > 0 ? paint.underlineThickness : Math.max(1f, size / 18f);
            float position = y + size / 9f;
            int color = paint.getColor();

            if (paint.underlineColor != 0 && !paint.isUnderlineText()) paint.setColor(paint.underlineColor);
            canvas.drawRect(x, position, x + width, position + thickness, paint);
            paint.setColor(color);
        }

        if (paint.isStrikeThruText())
        {
            float thickness = Math.max(1f, size / 18f);
            float position = y - size * 0.3f;
            canvas.drawRect(x, position, x + width, position + thickness, paint);
        }

        return width;
    }

    private void mergeMetrics(Paint paint, Paint.FontMetricsInt metrics, boolean reset)
    {
        paint.getFontMetricsInt(mWorkMetrics);

        int shift = paint instanceof TextPaint ? ((TextPaint)paint).baselineShift : 0;
        mWorkMetrics.top += Math.min(0, shift);
        mWorkMetrics.ascent += Math.min(0, shift);
        mWorkMetrics.descent += Math.max(0, shift);
        mWorkMetrics.bottom += Math.max(0, shift);

        if (reset)
        {
            metrics.top = mWorkMetrics.top;
            metrics.ascent = mWorkMetrics.ascent;
            metrics.descent = mWorkMetrics.descent;
            metrics.bottom = mWorkMetrics.bottom;
            metrics.leading = mWorkMetrics.leading;
            return;
        }

        mergeMetricsFrom(mWorkMetrics, metrics);
    }

    private static void mergeMetricsFrom(Paint.FontMetricsInt source, Paint.FontMetricsInt metrics)
    {
        metrics.top = Math.min(metrics.top, source.top);
        metrics.ascent = Math.min(metrics.ascent, source.ascent);
        metrics.descent = Math.max(metrics.descent, source.descent);
        metrics.bottom = Math.max(metrics.bottom, source.bottom);
        metrics.leading = Math.max(metrics.leading, source.leading);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.text;

import android.graphics.Paint;

public class TextPaint extends Paint
{
    public int bgColor;
    public int baselineShift;
    public int linkColor;
    public int[] drawableState;
    public float density = 1.0f;
    public int underlineColor;
    public float underlineThickness;

    public TextPaint()
    {
    }

    public TextPaint(int flags)
    {
        super(flags);
    }

    public TextPaint(Paint from)
    {
        super(from);
    }

    public void set(TextPaint from)
    {
        super.set(from);

        bgColor = from.bgColor;
        baselineShift = from.baselineShift;
        linkColor = from.linkColor;
        drawableState = from.drawableState;
        density = from.density;
        underlineColor = from.underlineColor;
        underlineThickness = from.underlineThickness;
    }

    public float getUnderlineThickness()
    {
        if (underlineThickness > 0) return underlineThickness;

        return Math.max(1f, getTextSize() / 18f);
    }
}
```

```java
    public static final int SUGGESTION_SPAN = 19;

    public static final int SUGGESTION_RANGE_SPAN = 21;
    public static final int EASY_EDIT_SPAN = 22;
    public static final int LOCALE_SPAN = 23;
    public static final int TTS_SPAN = 24;
    public static final int ACCESSIBILITY_CLICKABLE_SPAN = 25;
    public static final int ACCESSIBILITY_URL_SPAN = 26;
    public static final int LINE_BACKGROUND_SPAN = 27;
    public static final int LINE_HEIGHT_SPAN = 28;
    public static final int ACCESSIBILITY_REPLACEMENT_SPAN = 29;

    public static final int CAP_MODE_CHARACTERS = InputType.TYPE_TEXT_FLAG_CAP_CHARACTERS;
    public static final int CAP_MODE_WORDS = InputType.TYPE_TEXT_FLAG_CAP_WORDS;
    public static final int CAP_MODE_SENTENCES = InputType.TYPE_TEXT_FLAG_CAP_SENTENCES;

    public static final int SAFE_STRING_FLAG_TRIM = 0x1;
    public static final int SAFE_STRING_FLAG_SINGLE_LINE = 0x2;
    public static final int SAFE_STRING_FLAG_FIRST_LINE = 0x4;

    private static final String ELLIPSIS = "…";

    public static final android.os.Parcelable.Creator<CharSequence> CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR =
        new android.os.Parcelable.Creator<CharSequence>()
        {
            @Override
            public CharSequence createFromParcel(android.os.Parcel source)
            {
                Object value = source.readValue(null);
                return value instanceof CharSequence ? (CharSequence)value : null;
            }

            @Override
            public CharSequence[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new CharSequence[size];
            }
        };

    private TextUtils()
    {
    }

    public static void getChars(CharSequence text, int start, int end, char[] destination, int destinationOffset)
    {
        if (text instanceof String)
        {
            ((String)text).getChars(start, end, destination, destinationOffset);
            return;
        }

        if (text instanceof GetChars)
        {
            ((GetChars)text).getChars(start, end, destination, destinationOffset);
            return;
        }

        if (text instanceof StringBuilder)
        {
            ((StringBuilder)text).getChars(start, end, destination, destinationOffset);
            return;
        }

        if (text instanceof StringBuffer)
        {
            ((StringBuffer)text).getChars(start, end, destination, destinationOffset);
            return;
        }

        for (int index = start; index < end; index++)
        {
            destination[destinationOffset++] = text.charAt(index);
        }
    }

    public static int indexOf(CharSequence text, char character)
    {
        return indexOf(text, character, 0);
    }

    public static int indexOf(CharSequence text, char character, int start)
    {
        if (text instanceof String) return ((String)text).indexOf(character, start);

        return indexOf(text, character, start, text.length());
    }

    public static int indexOf(CharSequence text, char character, int start, int end)
    {
        for (int index = Math.max(0, start); index < end; index++)
        {
            if (text.charAt(index) == character) return index;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public static int lastIndexOf(CharSequence text, char character)
    {
        return lastIndexOf(text, character, text.length() - 1);
    }

    public static int lastIndexOf(CharSequence text, char character, int last)
    {
        if (text instanceof String) return ((String)text).lastIndexOf(character, last);

        return lastIndexOf(text, character, 0, last);
    }

    public static int lastIndexOf(CharSequence text, char character, int start, int last)
    {
        if (last < 0) return -1;
        if (last >= text.length()) last = text.length() - 1;

        for (int index = last; index >= start; index--)
        {
            if (text.charAt(index) == character) return index;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public static int indexOf(CharSequence text, CharSequence needle)
    {
        return indexOf(text, needle, 0, text.length());
    }

    public static int indexOf(CharSequence text, CharSequence needle, int start)
    {
        return indexOf(text, needle, start, text.length());
    }

    public static int indexOf(CharSequence text, CharSequence needle, int start, int end)
    {
        int needleLength = needle.length();
        if (needleLength == 0) return start;

        char first = needle.charAt(0);

        for (;;)
        {
            start = indexOf(text, first, start);
            if (start > end - needleLength) break;
            if (start < 0) return -1;
            if (regionMatches(text, start, needle, 0, needleLength)) return start;

            start++;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public static boolean regionMatches(CharSequence first, int firstStart, CharSequence second, int secondStart, int length)
    {
        if (firstStart < 0 || secondStart < 0 || length < 0) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
        if (firstStart + length > first.length() || secondStart + length > second.length()) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();

        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
        {
            if (first.charAt(firstStart + index) != second.charAt(secondStart + index)) return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static String substring(CharSequence source, int start, int end)
    {
        if (source instanceof String) return ((String)source).substring(start, end);

        char[] buffer = new char[end - start];
        getChars(source, start, end, buffer, 0);
        return new String(buffer);
    }

    public static boolean isEmpty(CharSequence text)
    {
        return text == null || text.length() == 0;
    }

    public static int getTrimmedLength(CharSequence text)
    {
        if (text == null) return 0;

        int length = text.length();
        int start = 0;
        while (start < length && text.charAt(start) <= ' ')
        {
            start++;
        }

        int end = length;
        while (end > start && text.charAt(end - 1) <= ' ')
        {
            end--;
        }

        return end - start;
    }

    public static boolean equals(CharSequence first, CharSequence second)
    {
        if (first == second) return true;
        if (first == null || second == null) return false;
        if (first.length() != second.length()) return false;
        if (first instanceof String && second instanceof String) return first.equals(second);

        for (int index = 0; index < first.length(); index++)
        {
            if (first.charAt(index) != second.charAt(index)) return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static String join(CharSequence delimiter, Iterable tokens)
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        Iterator<?> iterator = tokens.iterator();
        boolean first = true;

        while (iterator.hasNext())
        {
            if (!first) builder.append(delimiter);
            builder.append(iterator.next());
            first = false;
        }

        return builder.toString();
    }

    public static String join(CharSequence delimiter, Object[] tokens)
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        for (int index = 0; index < tokens.length; index++)
        {
            if (index > 0) builder.append(delimiter);
            builder.append(tokens[index]);
        }
        return builder.toString();
    }

    public static String[] split(String text, String expression)
    {
        return text.isEmpty() ? new String[0] : text.split(expression, -1);
    }

    public static String[] split(String text, Pattern pattern)
    {
        return text.isEmpty() ? new String[0] : pattern.split(text, -1);
    }

    public static CharSequence stringOrSpannedString(CharSequence source)
    {
        if (source == null) return null;
        if (source instanceof SpannedString) return source;
        if (source instanceof Spanned) return new SpannedString(source);

        return source.toString();
    }

    public static CharSequence getReverse(CharSequence source, int start, int end)
    {
        return new StringBuilder(source.subSequence(start, end)).reverse().toString();
    }

    public static void writeToParcel(CharSequence text, android.os.Parcel parcel, int parcelableFlags)
    {
        if (text instanceof Spanned) parcel.writeValue(new SpannedString(text));
        else parcel.writeValue(text == null ? null : text.toString());
    }

    public static void dumpSpans(CharSequence text, android.util.Printer printer, String prefix)
    {
        if (!(text instanceof Spanned))
        {
            printer.println(prefix + text + ": (no spans)");
            return;
        }

        Spanned spanned = (Spanned)text;
        Object[] spans = spanned.getSpans(0, text.length(), Object.class);

        for (Object span : spans)
        {
            printer.println(prefix + text.subSequence(spanned.getSpanStart(span), spanned.getSpanEnd(span)) + ": "
                            + Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(span)) + " " + span.getClass().getCanonicalName()
                            + " (" + spanned.getSpanStart(span) + "-" + spanned.getSpanEnd(span) + ") fl=#"
                            + spanned.getSpanFlags(span));
        }
    }

    public static CharSequence replace(CharSequence template, String[] sources, CharSequence[] destinations)
    {
        SpannableStringBuilder builder = new SpannableStringBuilder(template);

        for (int index = 0; index < sources.length; index++)
        {
            int where = indexOf(builder, sources[index]);
            if (where >= 0) builder.setSpan(sources[index], where, where + sources[index].length(), Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE);
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < sources.length; index++)
        {
            int start = builder.getSpanStart(sources[index]);
            int end = builder.getSpanEnd(sources[index]);
            if (start >= 0) builder.replace(start, end, destinations[index]);
        }

        return builder;
    }

    public static CharSequence expandTemplate(CharSequence template, CharSequence... values)
    {
        if (values.length > 9) throw new IllegalArgumentException("max of 9 values are supported");

        SpannableStringBuilder builder = new SpannableStringBuilder(template);

        int index = 0;
        while (index < builder.length())
        {
            if (builder.charAt(index) != '^')
            {
                index++;
                continue;
            }

            char next = index + 1 < builder.length() ? builder.charAt(index + 1) : 0;

            if (next == '^')
            {
                builder.delete(index + 1, index + 2);
                index++;
                continue;
            }

            if (!Character.isDigit(next))
            {
                index++;
                continue;
            }

            int which = Character.getNumericValue(next) - 1;
            if (which < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("template requests value ^0");
            if (which >= values.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("template requests value ^" + (which + 1)
                                                                           + "; only " + values.length + " provided");

            builder.replace(index, index + 2, values[which]);
            index += values[which].length();
        }

        return builder;
    }

    public static int getOffsetBefore(CharSequence text, int offset)
    {
        if (offset == 0) return 0;
        if (offset == 1) return 0;

        char character = text.charAt(offset - 1);

        if (Character.isLowSurrogate(character) && Character.isHighSurrogate(text.charAt(offset - 2))) offset -= 2;
        else offset -= 1;

        if (text instanceof Spanned)
        {
            android.text.style.ReplacementSpan[] spans =
                ((Spanned)text).getSpans(offset, offset, android.text.style.ReplacementSpan.class);

            for (android.text.style.ReplacementSpan span : spans)
            {
                int start = ((Spanned)text).getSpanStart(span);
                int end = ((Spanned)text).getSpanEnd(span);
                if (start < offset && end > offset) offset = start;
            }
        }

        return offset;
    }

    public static int getOffsetAfter(CharSequence text, int offset)
    {
        int length = text.length();

        if (offset == length) return length;
        if (offset == length - 1) return length;

        char character = text.charAt(offset);

        if (Character.isHighSurrogate(character) && Character.isLowSurrogate(text.charAt(offset + 1))) offset += 2;
        else offset += 1;

        if (text instanceof Spanned)
        {
            android.text.style.ReplacementSpan[] spans =
                ((Spanned)text).getSpans(offset, offset, android.text.style.ReplacementSpan.class);

            for (android.text.style.ReplacementSpan span : spans)
            {
                int start = ((Spanned)text).getSpanStart(span);
                int end = ((Spanned)text).getSpanEnd(span);
                if (start < offset && end > offset) offset = end;
            }
        }

        return offset;
    }

    public static void copySpansFrom(Spanned source, int start, int end, Class kind, Spannable destination, int destinationOffset)
    {
        if (kind == null) kind = Object.class;

        Object[] spans = source.getSpans(start, end, kind);

        for (Object span : spans)
        {
            int spanStart = Math.max(source.getSpanStart(span), start);
            int spanEnd = Math.min(source.getSpanEnd(span), end);

            destination.setSpan(span, spanStart - start + destinationOffset, spanEnd - start + destinationOffset,
                                source.getSpanFlags(span));
        }
    }

    public static String htmlEncode(String text)
    {
        if (text == null) return null;

        StringBuilder encoded = new StringBuilder(text.length());
        for (int index = 0; index < text.length(); index++)
        {
            char character = text.charAt(index);
            switch (character)
            {
                case '<': encoded.append("&lt;"); break;
                case '>': encoded.append("&gt;"); break;
                case '&': encoded.append("&amp;"); break;
                case '"': encoded.append("&quot;"); break;
                case '\'': encoded.append("&#39;"); break;
                default: encoded.append(character); break;
            }
        }

        return encoded.toString();
    }

    public static CharSequence concat(CharSequence... parts)
    {
        if (parts.length == 0) return "";
        if (parts.length == 1) return parts[0];

        boolean spanned = false;
        for (CharSequence part : parts)
        {
            if (part instanceof Spanned)
            {
                spanned = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (spanned)
        {
            SpannableStringBuilder builder = new SpannableStringBuilder();
            for (CharSequence part : parts)
            {
                builder.append(part == null ? "null" : part);
            }
            return new SpannedString(builder);
        }

        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        for (CharSequence part : parts)
        {
            builder.append(part);
        }
        return builder.toString();
    }

    public static boolean isGraphic(CharSequence text)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < text.length(); )
        {
            int codePoint = Character.codePointAt(text, index);
            if (isGraphicCodePoint(codePoint)) return true;

            index += Character.charCount(codePoint);
        }

        return false;
    }

    public static boolean isGraphic(char character)
    {
        return isGraphicCodePoint(character);
    }

    private static boolean isGraphicCodePoint(int codePoint)
    {
        int type = Character.getType(codePoint);

        return type != Character.CONTROL && type != Character.FORMAT && type != Character.SURROGATE && type != Character.UNASSIGNED
               && type != Character.LINE_SEPARATOR && type != Character.PARAGRAPH_SEPARATOR && type != Character.SPACE_SEPARATOR;
    }

    public static boolean isDigitsOnly(CharSequence text)
    {
        if (isEmpty(text)) return false;

        for (int index = 0; index < text.length(); )
        {
            int codePoint = Character.codePointAt(text, index);
            if (!Character.isDigit(codePoint)) return false;

            index += Character.charCount(codePoint);
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static int getCapsMode(CharSequence text, int offset, int requestedModes)
    {
        if (offset < 0) return 0;

        int mode = 0;
        if ((requestedModes & CAP_MODE_CHARACTERS) != 0) mode |= CAP_MODE_CHARACTERS;
        if ((requestedModes & (CAP_MODE_WORDS | CAP_MODE_SENTENCES)) == 0) return mode;

        int index = offset;
        while (index > 0)
        {
            char character = text.charAt(index - 1);
            if (character != '"' && character != '\'' && Character.getType(character) != Character.START_PUNCTUATION) break;
            index--;
        }

        int spaces = index;
        while (spaces > 0 && (text.charAt(spaces - 1) == ' ' || text.charAt(spaces - 1) == '\t')) spaces--;

        if (spaces == 0 || text.charAt(spaces - 1) == '\n') return mode | CAP_MODE_WORDS | CAP_MODE_SENTENCES;
        if ((requestedModes & CAP_MODE_SENTENCES) == 0)
        {
            if (index != spaces) mode |= CAP_MODE_WORDS;
            return mode;
        }

        if (index == spaces) return mode;

        int end = spaces;
        while (end > 0)
        {
            char character = text.charAt(end - 1);
            if (character != '"' && character != '\'' && Character.getType(character) != Character.END_PUNCTUATION) break;
            end--;
        }

        if (end > 0)
        {
            char character = text.charAt(end - 1);

            if (character == '.' || character == '?' || character == '!')
            {
                if (character == '.')
                {
                    for (int scan = end - 2; scan >= 0; scan--)
                    {
                        char previous = text.charAt(scan);
                        if (previous == '.') return mode;
                        if (!Character.isLetter(previous)) break;
                    }
                }

                return mode | CAP_MODE_SENTENCES;
            }
        }

        return mode;
    }

    public static int getLayoutDirectionFromLocale(java.util.Locale locale)
    {
        if (locale == null || locale.equals(java.util.Locale.ROOT)) return 0;

        String language = locale.getLanguage();
        if (language.equals("ar") || language.equals("fa") || language.equals("he") || language.equals("iw") || language.equals("ur")
            || language.equals("yi") || language.equals("ji") || language.equals("ps") || language.equals("sd")
            || language.equals("ug") || language.equals("dv") || language.equals("ckb"))
        {
            return 1;
        }

        return 0;
    }

    public static CharSequence makeSafeForPresentation(String unclean, int maxCharactersToConsider, float ellipsizeDip, int flags)
    {
        String text = unclean == null ? "" : unclean;
        if (maxCharactersToConsider > 0 && text.length() > maxCharactersToConsider) text = text.substring(0, maxCharactersToConsider);

        if ((flags & SAFE_STRING_FLAG_FIRST_LINE) != 0)
        {
            int newline = text.indexOf('\n');
            if (newline >= 0) text = text.substring(0, newline);
        }

        if ((flags & SAFE_STRING_FLAG_SINGLE_LINE) != 0) text = text.replace('\n', ' ');

        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(text.length());
        for (int index = 0; index < text.length(); index++)
        {
            char character = text.charAt(index);
            if (character == '\n' || character == '\t' || !Character.isISOControl(character)) builder.append(character);
        }

        String result = builder.toString();
        if ((flags & SAFE_STRING_FLAG_TRIM) != 0) result = result.trim();

        return result;
    }

    public enum TruncateAt
    {
        START,
        MIDDLE,
        END,
        MARQUEE
    }

    public static CharSequence ellipsize(CharSequence text, TextPaint paint, float available, TruncateAt where)
    {
        return ellipsize(text, paint, available, where, false, null);
    }

    public static CharSequence ellipsize(CharSequence text, TextPaint paint, float available, TruncateAt where,
                                         boolean preserveLength, EllipsizeCallback callback)
    {
        if (text == null) return null;

        int length = text.length();

        if (paint == null || paint.measureText(text, 0, length) <= available)
        {
            if (callback != null) callback.ellipsized(0, 0);
            return text;
        }

        float ellipsisWidth = paint.measureText(ELLIPSIS);
        float budget = available - ellipsisWidth;

        int start;
        int end;

        if (budget < 0)
        {
            start = 0;
            end = length;
        }
        else if (where == TruncateAt.START)
        {
            start = 0;
            end = length;
            while (end > 0 && paint.measureText(text, end - 1, length) <= budget) end--;
        }
        else if (where == TruncateAt.MIDDLE)
        {
            float half = budget / 2f;
            int left = 0;
            while (left < length && paint.measureText(text, 0, left + 1) <= half) left++;

            int right = length;
            while (right > left && paint.measureText(text, 0, left) + paint.measureText(text, right - 1, length) <= budget) right--;

            start = left;
            end = right;
        }
        else
        {
            start = 0;
            while (start < length && paint.measureText(text, 0, start + 1) <= budget) start++;
            end = length;
        }

        if (start > 0 && start < length && Character.isLowSurrogate(text.charAt(start))) start--;
        if (end > 0 && end < length && Character.isLowSurrogate(text.charAt(end))) end++;

        if (callback != null) callback.ellipsized(start, end);

        if (preserveLength)
        {
            char[] buffer = new char[length];
            getChars(text, 0, length, buffer, 0);

            if (end > start)
            {
                buffer[start] = ELLIPSIS.charAt(0);
                for (int index = start + 1; index < end; index++)
                {
                    buffer[index] = '﻿';
                }
            }

            String result = new String(buffer);
            if (!(text instanceof Spanned)) return result;

            SpannableString spannable = new SpannableString(result);
            copySpansFrom((Spanned)text, 0, length, Object.class, spannable, 0);
            return spannable;
        }

        if (budget < 0) return "";

        if (!(text instanceof Spanned))
        {
            return new StringBuilder(length - (end - start) + 1).append(text, 0, start).append(ELLIPSIS).append(text, end, length)
                .toString();
        }

        SpannableStringBuilder builder = new SpannableStringBuilder(text);
        builder.replace(start, end, ELLIPSIS);
        return builder;
    }

    public static CharSequence listEllipsize(android.content.Context context, List<CharSequence> elements, String separator,
                                             TextPaint paint, float available, int moreId)
    {
        if (elements == null) return "";

        int total = elements.size();
        if (total == 0) return "";

        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        for (int index = 0; index < total; index++)
        {
            if (index > 0) builder.append(separator);
            builder.append(elements.get(index));
        }

        if (paint == null || paint.measureText(builder.toString()) <= available) return builder.toString();

        for (int count = total - 1; count > 0; count--)
        {
            StringBuilder partial = new StringBuilder();
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                if (index > 0) partial.append(separator);
                partial.append(elements.get(index));
            }

            partial.append(separator).append('+').append(total - count);
            if (paint.measureText(partial.toString()) <= available) return partial.toString();
        }

        return "";
    }

    public static CharSequence commaEllipsize(CharSequence text, TextPaint paint, float available, String oneMore, String more)
    {
        if (text == null) return null;
        if (paint == null || paint.measureText(text, 0, text.length()) <= available) return text;

        String value = text.toString();
        String[] parts = value.split(",", -1);

        for (int count = parts.length - 1; count > 0; count--)
        {
            StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                if (index > 0) builder.append(',');
                builder.append(parts[index]);
            }

            int remaining = parts.length - count;
            String suffix = remaining == 1 ? oneMore : String.format(more, remaining);
            if (suffix != null) builder.append(suffix);

            if (paint.measureText(builder.toString()) <= available) return builder.toString();
        }

        return "";
    }

    public interface EllipsizeCallback
    {
        void ellipsized(int start, int end);
    }

    public interface StringSplitter extends Iterable<String>
    {
        void setString(String string);
    }

    public static class SimpleStringSplitter implements StringSplitter, Iterator<String>
    {
        private String mString;
        private final char mDelimiter;
        private int mPosition;
        private int mLength;

        public SimpleStringSplitter(char delimiter)
        {
            mDelimiter = delimiter;
        }

        @Override
        public void setString(String string)
        {
            mString = string;
            mPosition = 0;
            mLength = mString.length();
        }

        @Override
        public Iterator<String> iterator()
        {
            return this;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean hasNext()
        {
            return mPosition < mLength;
        }

        @Override
        public String next()
        {
            int end = mString.indexOf(mDelimiter, mPosition);
            if (end == -1) end = mLength;

            String next = mString.substring(mPosition, end);
            mPosition = end + 1;
            return next;
        }

        @Override
        public void remove()
        {
            throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.text.format;

import android.content.Context;
import android.text.SpannableStringBuilder;
import android.text.Spanned;

import java.text.DateFormatSymbols;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.GregorianCalendar;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.TimeZone;

public class DateFormat
{
    private static final char QUOTE = '\'';

    public DateFormat()
    {
    }

    public static boolean is24HourFormat(Context context)
    {
        String value = null;

        try
        {
            if (context != null) value = android.provider.Settings.System.getString(context.getContentResolver(),
                                                                                  android.provider.Settings.System.TIME_12_24);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception)
        {
            value = null;
        }

        if (value != null) return "24".equals(value);

        return is24HourLocale(Locale.getDefault());
    }

    private static boolean is24HourLocale(Locale locale)
    {
        java.text.DateFormat format = java.text.DateFormat.getTimeInstance(java.text.DateFormat.SHORT, locale);
        if (!(format instanceof SimpleDateFormat)) return false;

        String pattern = ((SimpleDateFormat)format).toPattern();
        return pattern.indexOf('H') >= 0 || pattern.indexOf('k') >= 0;
    }

    public static String getBestDateTimePattern(Locale locale, String skeleton)
    {
        if (locale == null) locale = Locale.getDefault();
        if (skeleton == null) throw new NullPointerException("skeleton == null");

        String pattern = icuBestPattern(locale, skeleton);
        if (pattern != null) return pattern;

        return fallbackBestPattern(locale, skeleton);
    }

    private static String icuBestPattern(Locale locale, String skeleton)
    {
        try
        {
            Class<?> generatorClass = Class.forName("android.icu.text.DateTimePatternGenerator");
            Object generator = generatorClass.getMethod("getInstance", Locale.class).invoke(null, locale);
            Object pattern = generatorClass.getMethod("getBestPattern", String.class).invoke(generator, skeleton);
            return pattern instanceof String ? (String)pattern : null;
        }
        catch (ReflectiveOperationException | LinkageError | RuntimeException exception)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static int countOf(String skeleton, String letters)
    {
        int count = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index < skeleton.length(); index++)
        {
            if (letters.indexOf(skeleton.charAt(index)) >= 0) count++;
        }

        return count;
    }

    private static String repeat(char character, int count)
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(count);
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) builder.append(character);
        return builder.toString();
    }

    private static String fallbackBestPattern(Locale locale, String skeleton)
    {
        int years = countOf(skeleton, "yY");
        int months = countOf(skeleton, "ML");
        int days = countOf(skeleton, "d");
        int weekdays = countOf(skeleton, "Ec");
        int hours12 = countOf(skeleton, "hK");
        int hours24 = countOf(skeleton, "Hk");
        int hoursLocale = countOf(skeleton, "j");
        int minutes = countOf(skeleton, "m");
        int seconds = countOf(skeleton, "s");
        int zones = countOf(skeleton, "zZv");

        StringBuilder date = new StringBuilder();
        boolean textualMonth = months >= 3;
        char[] order = dateOrder(locale);

        for (char field : order)
        {
            String part = null;

            if (field == 'y' && years > 0) part = years == 2 ? "yy" : "y";
            else if (field == 'M' && months > 0) part = repeat('M', Math.min(months, 4));
            else if (field == 'd' && days > 0) part = days >= 2 ? "dd" : "d";

            if (part == null) continue;

            if (date.length() > 0)
            {
                if (textualMonth) date.append(field == 'y' && order[0] == 'M' ? ", " : " ");
                else date.append(dateSeparator(locale));
            }

            date.append(part);
        }

        if (weekdays > 0)
        {
            String weekday = repeat('E', Math.min(weekdays, 4));
            date.insert(0, date.length() > 0 ? weekday + ", " : weekday);
        }

        StringBuilder time = new StringBuilder();
        boolean twelveHour = hours12 > 0 || (hoursLocale > 0 && !is24HourLocale(locale));

        if (hours12 > 0 || hours24 > 0 || hoursLocale > 0)
        {
            int hourCount = Math.max(hours12, Math.max(hours24, hoursLocale));
            time.append(twelveHour ? repeat('h', Math.min(hourCount, 2)) : repeat('H', Math.min(hourCount, 2)));
        }

        if (minutes > 0)
        {
            if (time.length() > 0) time.append(':');
            time.append("mm");
        }

        if (seconds > 0)
        {
            if (time.length() > 0) time.append(':');
            time.append("ss");
        }

        if (twelveHour && time.length() > 0) time.append(" a");
        if (zones > 0 && time.length() > 0) time.append(" z");

        if (date.length() == 0) return time.toString();
        if (time.length() == 0) return date.toString();

        return date + ", " + time;
    }

    private static String dateSeparator(Locale locale)
    {
        java.text.DateFormat format = java.text.DateFormat.getDateInstance(java.text.DateFormat.SHORT, locale);
        if (!(format instanceof SimpleDateFormat)) return "/";

        String pattern = ((SimpleDateFormat)format).toPattern();

        for (int index = 0; index < pattern.length(); index++)
        {
            char character = pattern.charAt(index);
            if (!Character.isLetter(character) && character != QUOTE) return String.valueOf(character);
        }

        return "/";
    }

    private static char[] dateOrder(Locale locale)
    {
        java.text.DateFormat format = java.text.DateFormat.getDateInstance(java.text.DateFormat.SHORT, locale);
        String pattern = format instanceof SimpleDateFormat ? ((SimpleDateFormat)format).toPattern() : "M/d/y";

        char[] result = new char[3];
        int found = 0;
        boolean quoted = false;

        for (int index = 0; index < pattern.length() && found < 3; index++)
        {
            char character = pattern.charAt(index);

            if (character == QUOTE)
            {
                quoted = !quoted;
                continue;
            }

            if (quoted) continue;

            if (character == 'L') character = 'M';
            if (character != 'd' && character != 'M' && character != 'y') continue;

            boolean seen = false;
            for (int other = 0; other < found; other++)
            {
                if (result[other] == character) seen = true;
            }

            if (!seen) result[found++] = character;
        }

        String defaults = "Mdy";
        for (int index = 0; index < defaults.length() && found < 3; index++)
        {
            char character = defaults.charAt(index);
            boolean seen = false;
            for (int other = 0; other < found; other++)
            {
                if (result[other] == character) seen = true;
            }

            if (!seen) result[found++] = character;
        }

        return result;
    }

    public static java.text.DateFormat getTimeFormat(Context context)
    {
        return new SimpleDateFormat(is24HourFormat(context) ? "HH:mm" : "h:mm a", Locale.getDefault());
    }

    public static java.text.DateFormat getDateFormat(Context context)
    {
        return java.text.DateFormat.getDateInstance(java.text.DateFormat.SHORT, Locale.getDefault());
    }

    public static java.text.DateFormat getLongDateFormat(Context context)
    {
        return java.text.DateFormat.getDateInstance(java.text.DateFormat.LONG, Locale.getDefault());
    }

    public static java.text.DateFormat getMediumDateFormat(Context context)
    {
        return java.text.DateFormat.getDateInstance(java.text.DateFormat.MEDIUM, Locale.getDefault());
    }

    public static char[] getDateFormatOrder(Context context)
    {
        return dateOrder(Locale.getDefault());
    }

    public static CharSequence format(CharSequence inFormat, long inTimeInMillis)
    {
        return format(inFormat, new Date(inTimeInMillis));
    }

    public static CharSequence format(CharSequence inFormat, Date inDate)
    {
        Calendar calendar = new GregorianCalendar();
        calendar.setTime(inDate);
        return format(inFormat, calendar);
    }

    public static CharSequence format(CharSequence inFormat, Calendar inDate)
    {
        SpannableStringBuilder builder = new SpannableStringBuilder(inFormat);
        DateFormatSymbols symbols = DateFormatSymbols.getInstance(Locale.getDefault());
        int length = builder.length();
        int count;

        for (int index = 0; index < length; index += count)
        {
            count = 1;
            char character = builder.charAt(index);

            if (character == QUOTE)
            {
                count = appendQuotedText(builder, index);
                length = builder.length();
                continue;
            }

            while (index + count < length && builder.charAt(index + count) == character) count++;

            String replacement;

            switch (character)
            {
                case 'A':
                case 'a':
                    replacement = symbols.getAmPmStrings()[inDate.get(Calendar.AM_PM) - Calendar.AM];
                    break;
                case 'd':
                    replacement = zeroPad(inDate.get(Calendar.DATE), count);
                    break;
                case 'c':
                case 'E':
                    replacement = getDayOfWeekString(symbols, inDate.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK), count);
                    break;
                case 'K':
                case 'h':
                {
                    int hour = inDate.get(Calendar.HOUR);
                    if (character == 'h' && hour == 0) hour = 12;
                    replacement = zeroPad(hour, count);
                    break;
                }
                case 'H':
                case 'k':
                {
                    int hour = inDate.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY);
                    if (character == 'k' && hour == 0) hour = 24;
                    replacement = zeroPad(hour, count);
                    break;
                }
                case 'L':
                case 'M':
                    replacement = getMonthString(symbols, inDate.get(Calendar.MONTH), count);
                    break;
                case 'm':
                    replacement = zeroPad(inDate.get(Calendar.MINUTE), count);
                    break;
                case 's':
                    replacement = zeroPad(inDate.get(Calendar.SECOND), count);
                    break;
                case 'y':
                    replacement = getYearString(inDate.get(Calendar.YEAR), count);
                    break;
                case 'z':
                    replacement = getTimeZoneString(inDate, count);
                    break;
                default:
                    replacement = null;
                    break;
            }

            if (replacement != null)
            {
                builder.replace(index, index + count, replacement);
                count = replacement.length();
                length = builder.length();
            }
        }

        if (inFormat instanceof Spanned) return builder;

        return builder.toString();
    }

    private static String getDayOfWeekString(DateFormatSymbols symbols, int day, int count)
    {
        if (count == 4) return symbols.getWeekdays()[day];

        String shortName = symbols.getShortWeekdays()[day];
        if (count == 5) return shortName.isEmpty() ? shortName : shortName.substring(0, 1);

        return shortName;
    }

    private static String getMonthString(DateFormatSymbols symbols, int month, int count)
    {
        if (count == 4) return symbols.getMonths()[month];

        if (count == 5)
        {
            String name = symbols.getShortMonths()[month];
            return name.isEmpty() ? name : name.substring(0, 1);
        }

        if (count == 3) return symbols.getShortMonths()[month];

        return zeroPad(month + 1, count);
    }

    private static String getTimeZoneString(Calendar inDate, int count)
    {
        TimeZone zone = inDate.getTimeZone();

        if (count < 2) return formatZoneOffset(inDate.get(Calendar.DST_OFFSET) + inDate.get(Calendar.ZONE_OFFSET));

        boolean daylight = inDate.get(Calendar.DST_OFFSET) != 0;
        return zone.getDisplayName(daylight, TimeZone.SHORT);
    }

    private static String formatZoneOffset(int offset)
    {
        offset /= 1000;

        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();

        if (offset < 0)
        {
            builder.insert(0, "-");
            offset = -offset;
        }
        else
        {
            builder.insert(0, "+");
        }

        int hours = offset / 3600;
        int minutes = (offset % 3600) / 60;

        builder.append(zeroPad(hours, 2));
        builder.append(zeroPad(minutes, 2));
        return builder.toString();
    }

    private static String getYearString(int year, int count)
    {
        return count <= 2 ? zeroPad(year % 100, 2) : String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%d", year);
    }

    private static int appendQuotedText(SpannableStringBuilder builder, int index)
    {
        int length = builder.length();

        if (index + 1 < length && builder.charAt(index + 1) == QUOTE)
        {
            builder.delete(index, index + 1);
            return 1;
        }

        int count = 0;

        builder.delete(index, index + 1);
        length--;

        while (index < length)
        {
            char character = builder.charAt(index);

            if (character == QUOTE)
            {
                if (index + 1 < length && builder.charAt(index + 1) == QUOTE)
                {
                    builder.delete(index, index + 1);
                    length--;
                    count++;
                    index++;
                }
                else
                {
                    builder.delete(index, index + 1);
                    break;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                index++;
                count++;
            }
        }

        return count;
    }

    private static String zeroPad(int value, int minimumDigits)
    {
        return String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%0" + minimumDigits + "d", value);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.text.format;

import android.content.Context;

import java.text.DateFormatSymbols;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.GregorianCalendar;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.TimeZone;

public class DateUtils
{
    public static final long SECOND_IN_MILLIS = 1000;
    public static final long MINUTE_IN_MILLIS = SECOND_IN_MILLIS * 60;
    public static final long HOUR_IN_MILLIS = MINUTE_IN_MILLIS * 60;
    public static final long DAY_IN_MILLIS = HOUR_IN_MILLIS * 24;
    public static final long WEEK_IN_MILLIS = DAY_IN_MILLIS * 7;
    public static final long YEAR_IN_MILLIS = WEEK_IN_MILLIS * 52;

    public static final int FORMAT_SHOW_TIME = 0x00001;
    public static final int FORMAT_SHOW_WEEKDAY = 0x00002;
    public static final int FORMAT_SHOW_YEAR = 0x00004;
    public static final int FORMAT_NO_YEAR = 0x00008;
    public static final int FORMAT_SHOW_DATE = 0x00010;
    public static final int FORMAT_NO_MONTH_DAY = 0x00020;
    public static final int FORMAT_12HOUR = 0x00040;
    public static final int FORMAT_24HOUR = 0x00080;
    public static final int FORMAT_CAP_AMPM = 0x00100;
    public static final int FORMAT_NO_NOON = 0x00200;
    public static final int FORMAT_CAP_NOON = 0x00400;
    public static final int FORMAT_NO_MIDNIGHT = 0x00800;
    public static final int FORMAT_CAP_MIDNIGHT = 0x01000;
    public static final int FORMAT_UTC = 0x02000;
    public static final int FORMAT_ABBREV_TIME = 0x04000;
    public static final int FORMAT_ABBREV_WEEKDAY = 0x08000;
    public static final int FORMAT_ABBREV_MONTH = 0x10000;
    public static final int FORMAT_NUMERIC_DATE = 0x20000;
    public static final int FORMAT_ABBREV_RELATIVE = 0x40000;
    public static final int FORMAT_ABBREV_ALL = 0x80000;
    public static final int FORMAT_CAP_NOON_MIDNIGHT = FORMAT_CAP_NOON | FORMAT_CAP_MIDNIGHT;
    public static final int FORMAT_NO_NOON_MIDNIGHT = FORMAT_NO_NOON | FORMAT_NO_MIDNIGHT;

    public static final String HOUR_MINUTE_24 = "%H:%M";
    public static final String MONTH_FORMAT = "%B";
    public static final String ABBREV_MONTH_FORMAT = "%b";
    public static final String NUMERIC_MONTH_FORMAT = "%m";
    public static final String MONTH_DAY_FORMAT = "%-d";
    public static final String YEAR_FORMAT = "%Y";
    public static final String YEAR_FORMAT_TWO_DIGITS = "%g";
    public static final String WEEKDAY_FORMAT = "%A";
    public static final String ABBREV_WEEKDAY_FORMAT = "%a";

    public static final int[] sameYearTable = null;
    public static final int[] sameMonthTable = null;

    public static final int LENGTH_LONG = 10;
    public static final int LENGTH_MEDIUM = 20;
    public static final int LENGTH_SHORT = 30;
    public static final int LENGTH_SHORTER = 40;
    public static final int LENGTH_SHORTEST = 50;

    public DateUtils()
    {
    }

    public static String getDayOfWeekString(int dayOfWeek, int abbrev)
    {
        DateFormatSymbols symbols = DateFormatSymbols.getInstance(Locale.getDefault());

        if (abbrev == LENGTH_LONG) return symbols.getWeekdays()[dayOfWeek];

        String shortName = symbols.getShortWeekdays()[dayOfWeek];
        if (abbrev == LENGTH_SHORTEST && !shortName.isEmpty()) return shortName.substring(0, 1);
        if (abbrev == LENGTH_SHORTER && shortName.length() > 2) return shortName.substring(0, 2);

        return shortName;
    }

    public static String getAMPMString(int ampm)
    {
        return DateFormatSymbols.getInstance(Locale.getDefault()).getAmPmStrings()[ampm - Calendar.AM];
    }

    public static String getMonthString(int month, int abbrev)
    {
        DateFormatSymbols symbols = DateFormatSymbols.getInstance(Locale.getDefault());

        if (abbrev == LENGTH_LONG) return symbols.getMonths()[month];

        String shortName = symbols.getShortMonths()[month];
        if (abbrev == LENGTH_SHORTEST && !shortName.isEmpty()) return shortName.substring(0, 1);

        return shortName;
    }

    public static CharSequence getRelativeTimeSpanString(long startTime)
    {
        return getRelativeTimeSpanString(startTime, System.currentTimeMillis(), MINUTE_IN_MILLIS);
    }

    public static CharSequence getRelativeTimeSpanString(long time, long now, long minResolution)
    {
        return getRelativeTimeSpanString(time, now, minResolution, FORMAT_SHOW_DATE | FORMAT_SHOW_YEAR | FORMAT_ABBREV_MONTH);
    }

    public static CharSequence getRelativeTimeSpanString(long time, long now, long minResolution, int flags)
    {
        boolean abbreviate = (flags & (FORMAT_ABBREV_RELATIVE | FORMAT_ABBREV_ALL)) != 0;
        boolean past = now >= time;
        long duration = Math.abs(now - time);

        long count;
        String unit;

        if (duration < MINUTE_IN_MILLIS && minResolution < MINUTE_IN_MILLIS)
        {
            count = duration / SECOND_IN_MILLIS;
            unit = abbreviate ? "sec." : count == 1 ? "second" : "seconds";
        }
        else if (duration < HOUR_IN_MILLIS && minResolution < HOUR_IN_MILLIS)
        {
            count = duration / MINUTE_IN_MILLIS;
            unit = abbreviate ? "min." : count == 1 ? "minute" : "minutes";
        }
        else if (duration < DAY_IN_MILLIS && minResolution < DAY_IN_MILLIS)
        {
            count = duration / HOUR_IN_MILLIS;
            unit = abbreviate ? "hr." : count == 1 ? "hour" : "hours";
        }
        else if (duration < WEEK_IN_MILLIS && minResolution < WEEK_IN_MILLIS)
        {
            count = Math.abs(dayDistance(time, now));

            if (count == 0) return abbreviate ? "today" : "Today";
            if (count == 1) return past ? "Yesterday" : "Tomorrow";

            unit = "days";
        }
        else if (minResolution == WEEK_IN_MILLIS)
        {
            count = duration / WEEK_IN_MILLIS;
            unit = abbreviate ? "wk." : count == 1 ? "week" : "weeks";
        }
        else
        {
            return formatDateRange(null, time, time, flags);
        }

        if (count == 0 && !past) return "In 0 " + unit;
        if (count == 0) return "0 " + unit + " ago";

        return past ? count + " " + unit + " ago" : "In " + count + " " + unit;
    }

    private static int dayDistance(long startTime, long endTime)
    {
        return julianDay(endTime) - julianDay(startTime);
    }

    private static int julianDay(long millis)
    {
        long offset = TimeZone.getDefault().getOffset(millis);
        return (int)Math.floorDiv(millis + offset, DAY_IN_MILLIS);
    }

    public static CharSequence getRelativeDateTimeString(Context context, long time, long minResolution, long transitionResolution,
                                                         int flags)
    {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        long duration = Math.abs(now - time);

        if (transitionResolution > WEEK_IN_MILLIS) transitionResolution = WEEK_IN_MILLIS;
        else if (transitionResolution < DAY_IN_MILLIS) transitionResolution = DAY_IN_MILLIS;

        CharSequence timeClause = formatDateRange(context, time, time, FORMAT_SHOW_TIME);

        if (duration < transitionResolution)
        {
            CharSequence relative = getRelativeTimeSpanString(time, now, minResolution, flags);
            return relative + ", " + timeClause;
        }

        CharSequence dateClause = getRelativeTimeSpanString(context, time, false);
        return dateClause + ", " + timeClause;
    }

    public static String formatElapsedTime(long elapsedSeconds)
    {
        return formatElapsedTime(null, elapsedSeconds);
    }

    public static String formatElapsedTime(StringBuilder recycle, long elapsedSeconds)
    {
        long hours = 0;
        long minutes = 0;
        long seconds = 0;

        if (elapsedSeconds >= 3600)
        {
            hours = elapsedSeconds / 3600;
            elapsedSeconds -= hours * 3600;
        }

        if (elapsedSeconds >= 60)
        {
            minutes = elapsedSeconds / 60;
            elapsedSeconds -= minutes * 60;
        }

        seconds = elapsedSeconds;

        StringBuilder builder = recycle;
        if (builder == null) builder = new StringBuilder(8);
        else builder.setLength(0);

        java.util.Formatter formatter = new java.util.Formatter(builder, Locale.getDefault());

        if (hours > 0) return formatter.format("%1$d:%2$02d:%3$02d", hours, minutes, seconds).toString();

        return formatter.format("%1$02d:%2$02d", minutes, seconds).toString();
    }

    public static final CharSequence formatSameDayTime(long then, long now, int dateStyle, int timeStyle)
    {
        Calendar thenCalendar = new GregorianCalendar();
        thenCalendar.setTimeInMillis(then);
        Calendar nowCalendar = new GregorianCalendar();
        nowCalendar.setTimeInMillis(now);

        java.text.DateFormat format;

        if (thenCalendar.get(Calendar.YEAR) == nowCalendar.get(Calendar.YEAR)
            && thenCalendar.get(Calendar.MONTH) == nowCalendar.get(Calendar.MONTH)
            && thenCalendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH) == nowCalendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH))
        {
            format = java.text.DateFormat.getTimeInstance(timeStyle);
        }
        else
        {
            format = java.text.DateFormat.getDateInstance(dateStyle);
        }

        return format.format(thenCalendar.getTime());
    }

    public static boolean isToday(long when)
    {
        return julianDay(when) == julianDay(System.currentTimeMillis());
    }

    public static String formatDateRange(Context context, long startMillis, long endMillis, int flags)
    {
        java.util.Formatter formatter = new java.util.Formatter(new StringBuilder(50), Locale.getDefault());
        return formatDateRange(context, formatter, startMillis, endMillis, flags).toString();
    }

    public static java.util.Formatter formatDateRange(Context context, java.util.Formatter formatter, long startMillis, long endMillis,
                                                      int flags)
    {
        return formatDateRange(context, formatter, startMillis, endMillis, flags, null);
    }

    public static java.util.Formatter formatDateRange(Context context, java.util.Formatter formatter, long startMillis, long endMillis,
                                                      int flags, String timeZone)
    {
        String range = formatRange(context, startMillis, endMillis, flags, timeZone);

        try
        {
            formatter.out().append(range);
        }
        catch (java.io.IOException exception)
        {
            throw new AssertionError(exception);
        }

        return formatter;
    }

    public static String formatDateTime(Context context, long millis, int flags)
    {
        return formatDateRange(context, millis, millis, flags);
    }

    public static CharSequence getRelativeTimeSpanString(Context context, long millis, boolean withPreposition)
    {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        long span = Math.abs(now - millis);

        Calendar thenCalendar = new GregorianCalendar();
        thenCalendar.setTimeInMillis(millis);
        Calendar nowCalendar = new GregorianCalendar();
        nowCalendar.setTimeInMillis(now);

        String result;
        String preposition;

        if (span < DAY_IN_MILLIS && julianDay(millis) == julianDay(now))
        {
            result = formatDateRange(context, millis, millis, FORMAT_SHOW_TIME);
            preposition = "at ";
        }
        else if (thenCalendar.get(Calendar.YEAR) == nowCalendar.get(Calendar.YEAR))
        {
            result = formatDateRange(context, millis, millis, FORMAT_SHOW_DATE | FORMAT_ABBREV_MONTH);
            preposition = "on ";
        }
        else
        {
            result = formatDateRange(context, millis, millis, FORMAT_SHOW_DATE | FORMAT_SHOW_YEAR | FORMAT_NUMERIC_DATE);
            preposition = "on ";
        }

        return withPreposition ? preposition + result : result;
    }

    public static CharSequence getRelativeTimeSpanString(Context context, long millis)
    {
        return getRelativeTimeSpanString(context, millis, false);
    }

    private static String formatRange(Context context, long startMillis, long endMillis, int flags, String timeZoneId)
    {
        TimeZone zone;
        if ((flags & FORMAT_UTC) != 0) zone = TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC");
        else if (timeZoneId != null) zone = TimeZone.getTimeZone(timeZoneId);
        else zone = TimeZone.getDefault();

        Calendar start = new GregorianCalendar(zone);
        start.setTimeInMillis(startMillis);

        Calendar end = new GregorianCalendar(zone);
        end.setTimeInMillis(endMillis);

        boolean showTime = (flags & FORMAT_SHOW_TIME) != 0;

        if (endMillis > startMillis && !showTime && end.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY) == 0 && end.get(Calendar.MINUTE) == 0
            && end.get(Calendar.SECOND) == 0 && end.get(Calendar.MILLISECOND) == 0)
        {
            end.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, -1);
            if (end.before(start)) end.setTimeInMillis(startMillis);
        }

        boolean sameDay = start.get(Calendar.YEAR) == end.get(Calendar.YEAR)
                          && start.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR) == end.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR);

        String skeleton = skeletonFor(context, flags, start, end, sameDay);
        String pattern = DateFormat.getBestDateTimePattern(Locale.getDefault(), skeleton);

        SimpleDateFormat format = new SimpleDateFormat(pattern, Locale.getDefault());
        format.setTimeZone(zone);

        String first = format.format(start.getTime());

        if (startMillis == endMillis) return first;

        if (sameDay && showTime)
        {
            String timePattern = DateFormat.getBestDateTimePattern(Locale.getDefault(), timeSkeleton(context, flags));
            SimpleDateFormat timeFormat = new SimpleDateFormat(timePattern, Locale.getDefault());
            timeFormat.setTimeZone(zone);

            String last = timeFormat.format(end.getTime());
            if (last.equals(timeFormat.format(start.getTime()))) return first;

            return first + " – " + last;
        }

        String last = format.format(end.getTime());
        if (last.equals(first)) return first;

        return first + " – " + last;
    }

    private static String timeSkeleton(Context context, int flags)
    {
        boolean twentyFour;
        if ((flags & FORMAT_24HOUR) != 0) twentyFour = true;
        else if ((flags & FORMAT_12HOUR) != 0) twentyFour = false;
        else twentyFour = DateFormat.is24HourFormat(context);

        return twentyFour ? "Hm" : "hm";
    }

    private static String skeletonFor(Context context, int flags, Calendar start, Calendar end, boolean sameDay)
    {
        boolean showTime = (flags & FORMAT_SHOW_TIME) != 0;
        boolean showWeekday = (flags & FORMAT_SHOW_WEEKDAY) != 0;
        boolean showYear = (flags & FORMAT_SHOW_YEAR) != 0;
        boolean noYear = (flags & FORMAT_NO_YEAR) != 0;
        boolean showDate = (flags & FORMAT_SHOW_DATE) != 0;
        boolean noMonthDay = (flags & FORMAT_NO_MONTH_DAY) != 0;
        boolean numericDate = (flags & FORMAT_NUMERIC_DATE) != 0;
        boolean abbrevAll = (flags & FORMAT_ABBREV_ALL) != 0;
        boolean abbrevMonth = abbrevAll || (flags & FORMAT_ABBREV_MONTH) != 0;
        boolean abbrevWeekday = abbrevAll || (flags & FORMAT_ABBREV_WEEKDAY) != 0;

        if (!showTime && !showWeekday && !showDate && !showYear) showDate = true;
        if (showTime && !sameDay) showDate = true;

        if (showDate && !showYear && !noYear)
        {
            int currentYear = new GregorianCalendar(start.getTimeZone()).get(Calendar.YEAR);
            if (start.get(Calendar.YEAR) != currentYear || end.get(Calendar.YEAR) != currentYear) showYear = true;
        }

        StringBuilder skeleton = new StringBuilder();

        if (showDate || showYear)
        {
            if (numericDate)
            {
                if (showDate) skeleton.append(noMonthDay ? "M" : "Md");
                if (showYear && !noYear) skeleton.append('y');
            }
            else
            {
                if (showDate) skeleton.append(abbrevMonth ? "MMM" : "MMMM");
                if (showDate && !noMonthDay) skeleton.append('d');
                if (showYear && !noYear) skeleton.append('y');
            }
        }

        if (showWeekday) skeleton.append(abbrevWeekday ? "EEE" : "EEEE");
        if (showTime) skeleton.append(timeSkeleton(context, flags));

        return skeleton.toString();
    }
}
```

`java/android/text/format/Formatter.java`:

```java
package android.text.format;

import android.content.Context;

public final class Formatter
{
    private static final int FLAG_SHORTER = 1;
    private static final String[] SUFFIXES = {"B", "kB", "MB", "GB", "TB", "PB"};

    public Formatter()
    {
    }

    public static String formatFileSize(Context context, long sizeBytes)
    {
        return formatBytes(sizeBytes, 0);
    }

    public static String formatShortFileSize(Context context, long sizeBytes)
    {
        return formatBytes(sizeBytes, FLAG_SHORTER);
    }

    public static String formatIpAddress(int ipv4Address)
    {
        return (ipv4Address & 0xFF) + "." + ((ipv4Address >> 8) & 0xFF) + "." + ((ipv4Address >> 16) & 0xFF) + "."
            + ((ipv4Address >> 24) & 0xFF);
    }

    private static String formatBytes(long sizeBytes, int flags)
    {
        boolean negative = sizeBytes < 0;
        float result = negative ? -(float)sizeBytes : (float)sizeBytes;
        int suffix = 0;
        long multiplier = 1;

        while (result > 900 && suffix < SUFFIXES.length - 1)
        {
            suffix++;
            multiplier *= 1000;
            result = result / 1000;
        }

        String format;
        if (multiplier == 1 || result >= 100) format = "%.0f";
        else if (result < 1) format = "%.2f";
        else if (result < 10) format = (flags & FLAG_SHORTER) != 0 ? "%.1f" : "%.2f";
        else format = (flags & FLAG_SHORTER) != 0 ? "%.0f" : "%.2f";

        if (negative) result = -result;

        return String.format(java.util.Locale.getDefault(), format, result) + " " + SUFFIXES[suffix];
    }
}
```
