`java/android/text/style/IconMarginSpan.java`:

```java
package android.text.style;

import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.text.Layout;
import android.text.Spanned;

public class IconMarginSpan implements LeadingMarginSpan, LineHeightSpan
{
    private final Bitmap mBitmap;
    private final int mPad;

    public IconMarginSpan(Bitmap bitmap)
    {
        this(bitmap, 0);
    }

    public IconMarginSpan(Bitmap bitmap, int pad)
    {
        mBitmap = bitmap;
        mPad = pad;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLeadingMargin(boolean first)
    {
        return mBitmap.getWidth() + mPad;
    }

    @Override
    public void drawLeadingMargin(Canvas canvas, Paint paint, int x, int direction, int top, int baseline, int bottom,
                                  CharSequence text, int start, int end, boolean first, Layout layout)
    {
        int spanStart = ((Spanned)text).getSpanStart(this);
        int itemTop = layout.getLineTop(layout.getLineForOffset(spanStart));

        if (direction < 0) x -= mBitmap.getWidth();

        canvas.drawBitmap(mBitmap, x, itemTop, paint);
    }

    @Override
    public void chooseHeight(CharSequence text, int start, int end, int spanstartv, int lineHeight, Paint.FontMetricsInt fontMetrics)
    {
        if (end != ((Spanned)text).getSpanEnd(this)) return;

        int height = mBitmap.getHeight();
        int need = height - (spanstartv + fontMetrics.descent - fontMetrics.ascent - lineHeight);
        if (need > 0) fontMetrics.descent += need;

        need = height - (spanstartv + fontMetrics.bottom - fontMetrics.top - lineHeight);
        if (need > 0) fontMetrics.bottom += need;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "IconMarginSpan{bitmap=" + getBitmap() + ", padding=" + getPadding() + "}";
    }

    public Bitmap getBitmap()
    {
        return mBitmap;
    }

    public int getPadding()
    {
        return mPad;
    }
}
```

`java/android/text/style/ImageSpan.java`:

```java
package android.text.style;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.drawable.BitmapDrawable;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.net.Uri;

public class ImageSpan extends DynamicDrawableSpan
{
    private Drawable mDrawable;
    private Uri mContentUri;
    private int mResourceId;
    private Context mContext;
    private String mSource;

    public ImageSpan(Bitmap bitmap)
    {
        this(null, bitmap, ALIGN_BOTTOM);
    }

    public ImageSpan(Bitmap bitmap, int verticalAlignment)
    {
        this(null, bitmap, verticalAlignment);
    }

    public ImageSpan(Context context, Bitmap bitmap)
    {
        this(context, bitmap, ALIGN_BOTTOM);
    }

    public ImageSpan(Context context, Bitmap bitmap, int verticalAlignment)
    {
        super(verticalAlignment);
        mContext = context;
        mDrawable = context != null ? new BitmapDrawable(context.getResources(), bitmap) : new BitmapDrawable(bitmap);

        int width = mDrawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
        int height = mDrawable.getIntrinsicHeight();
        mDrawable.setBounds(0, 0, width > 0 ? width : 0, height > 0 ? height : 0);
    }

    public ImageSpan(Drawable drawable)
    {
        this(drawable, ALIGN_BOTTOM);
    }

    public ImageSpan(Drawable drawable, int verticalAlignment)
    {
        super(verticalAlignment);
        mDrawable = drawable;
    }

    public ImageSpan(Drawable drawable, String source)
    {
        this(drawable, source, ALIGN_BOTTOM);
    }

    public ImageSpan(Drawable drawable, String source, int verticalAlignment)
    {
        super(verticalAlignment);
        mDrawable = drawable;
        mSource = source;
    }

    public ImageSpan(Context context, Uri uri)
    {
        this(context, uri, ALIGN_BOTTOM);
    }

    public ImageSpan(Context context, Uri uri, int verticalAlignment)
    {
        super(verticalAlignment);
        mContext = context;
        mContentUri = uri;
        mSource = uri == null ? null : uri.toString();
    }

    public ImageSpan(Context context, int resourceId)
    {
        this(context, resourceId, ALIGN_BOTTOM);
    }

    public ImageSpan(Context context, int resourceId, int verticalAlignment)
    {
        super(verticalAlignment);
        mContext = context;
        mResourceId = resourceId;
    }

    @Override
    public Drawable getDrawable()
    {
        if (mDrawable != null) return mDrawable;

        Drawable drawable = null;

        if (mContentUri != null && mContext != null)
        {
            try
            {
                java.io.InputStream stream = mContext.getContentResolver().openInputStream(mContentUri);
                Bitmap bitmap = android.graphics.BitmapFactory.decodeStream(stream);
                if (stream != null) stream.close();

                if (bitmap != null)
                {
                    drawable = new BitmapDrawable(mContext.getResources(), bitmap);
                    drawable.setBounds(0, 0, drawable.getIntrinsicWidth(), drawable.getIntrinsicHeight());
                }
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                android.util.Log.e("ImageSpan", "Failed to loaded content " + mContentUri, exception);
            }
        }
        else if (mContext != null && mResourceId != 0)
        {
            try
            {
                drawable = mContext.getDrawable(mResourceId);
                if (drawable != null) drawable.setBounds(0, 0, drawable.getIntrinsicWidth(), drawable.getIntrinsicHeight());
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                android.util.Log.e("ImageSpan", "Unable to find resource: " + mResourceId);
            }
        }

        return drawable;
    }

    public String getSource()
    {
        return mSource;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "ImageSpan{drawable=" + getDrawable() + ", source='" + mSource + "', verticalAlignment=" + getVerticalAlignment() + "}";
    }
```

```java
package android.text.style;

import android.graphics.text.LineBreakConfig;

public class LineBreakConfigSpan
{
    private final LineBreakConfig mLineBreakConfig;

    public LineBreakConfigSpan(LineBreakConfig lineBreakConfig)
    {
        if (lineBreakConfig == null) throw new NullPointerException("lineBreakConfig");

        mLineBreakConfig = lineBreakConfig;
    }

    public LineBreakConfig getLineBreakConfig()
    {
        return mLineBreakConfig;
    }

    public static LineBreakConfigSpan createNoBreakSpan()
    {
        return new LineBreakConfigSpan(new LineBreakConfig.Builder().setLineBreakStyle(LineBreakConfig.LINE_BREAK_STYLE_STRICT).build());
    }

    public static LineBreakConfigSpan createNoHyphenationSpan()
    {
        return new LineBreakConfigSpan(new LineBreakConfig.Builder().build());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof LineBreakConfigSpan)) return false;

        LineBreakConfig config = ((LineBreakConfigSpan)other).mLineBreakConfig;
        return config.getLineBreakStyle() == mLineBreakConfig.getLineBreakStyle()
               && config.getLineBreakWordStyle() == mLineBreakConfig.getLineBreakWordStyle();
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return 31 * mLineBreakConfig.getLineBreakStyle() + mLineBreakConfig.getLineBreakWordStyle();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "LineBreakConfigSpan{mLineBreakConfig=" + mLineBreakConfig + "}";
    }
}
```

`java/android/text/style/LineHeightSpan.java`:

```java
package android.text.style;

import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.text.ParcelableSpan;
import android.text.TextUtils;

public interface LineHeightSpan extends ParagraphStyle, WrapTogetherSpan
{
    void chooseHeight(CharSequence text, int start, int end, int spanstartv, int lineHeight, Paint.FontMetricsInt fontMetrics);

    interface WithDensity extends LineHeightSpan
    {
        void chooseHeight(CharSequence text, int start, int end, int spanstartv, int lineHeight,
                          Paint.FontMetricsInt fontMetrics, android.text.TextPaint paint);
    }

    class Standard implements LineHeightSpan, ParcelableSpan
    {
        private final int mHeight;

        public Standard(int height)
        {
            if (height <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Height:" + height + "must be positive");

            mHeight = height;
        }

        public Standard(Parcel source)
        {
            mHeight = source.readInt();
        }

        public int getHeight()
        {
            return mHeight;
        }

        @Override
        public int getSpanTypeId()
        {
            return TextUtils.LINE_HEIGHT_SPAN;
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
        {
            dest.writeInt(mHeight);
        }

        @Override
        public void chooseHeight(CharSequence text, int start, int end, int spanstartv, int lineHeight,
                                 Paint.FontMetricsInt fontMetrics)
        {
            int originalHeight = fontMetrics.descent - fontMetrics.ascent;
            if (originalHeight <= 0) return;

            float ratio = mHeight * 1.0f / originalHeight;
            fontMetrics.descent = Math.round(fontMetrics.descent * ratio);
            fontMetrics.ascent = fontMetrics.descent - mHeight;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.text.style;

import android.os.LocaleList;

import android.text.ParcelableSpan;

    }

        if (locales == null) throw new NullPointerException("locales cannot be null");

        mLocales = locales;
    }

    {
        mLocales = LocaleList.forLanguageTags(source.readString());
    }

    @Override
    public int getSpanTypeId()
    {
        return TextUtils.LOCALE_SPAN;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mLocales.toLanguageTags());
    }

    public Locale getLocale()
    {
        return mLocales.size() == 0 ? null : mLocales.get(0);
    }

    public LocaleList getLocales()
    {
        return mLocales;
    }

    @Override
    public void updateDrawState(TextPaint paint)
    {
        if (paint != null) paint.setTextLocales(mLocales);
    }

    @Override
    public void updateMeasureState(TextPaint paint)
    {
        if (paint != null) paint.setTextLocales(mLocales);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "LocaleSpan{locales=" + mLocales + "}";
    }
}
```

```java
package android.text.style;

import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.text.Layout;
import android.text.ParcelableSpan;
import android.text.TextUtils;

public class QuoteSpan implements LeadingMarginSpan, ParcelableSpan
{
    public static final int STANDARD_STRIPE_WIDTH_PX = 2;
    public static final int STANDARD_GAP_WIDTH_PX = 2;
    public static final int STANDARD_COLOR = 0xFF0000FF;

    private final int mColor;
    private final int mStripeWidth;
    private final int mGapWidth;

    public QuoteSpan()
    {
        this(STANDARD_COLOR, STANDARD_STRIPE_WIDTH_PX, STANDARD_GAP_WIDTH_PX);
    }

    public QuoteSpan(int color)
    {
        this(color, STANDARD_STRIPE_WIDTH_PX, STANDARD_GAP_WIDTH_PX);
    }

    public QuoteSpan(int color, int stripeWidth, int gapWidth)
    {
        mColor = color;
        mStripeWidth = stripeWidth;
        mGapWidth = gapWidth;
    }

    public QuoteSpan(Parcel source)
    {
        mColor = source.readInt();
        mStripeWidth = source.readInt();
        mGapWidth = source.readInt();
    }

    @Override
    public int getSpanTypeId()
    {
        return TextUtils.QUOTE_SPAN;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mColor);
        dest.writeInt(mStripeWidth);
        dest.writeInt(mGapWidth);
    }

    public int getColor()
    {
        return mColor;
    }

    public int getStripeWidth()
    {
        return mStripeWidth;
    }

    public int getGapWidth()
    {
        return mGapWidth;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLeadingMargin(boolean first)
    {
        return mStripeWidth + mGapWidth;
    }

    @Override
    public void drawLeadingMargin(Canvas canvas, Paint paint, int x, int direction, int top, int baseline, int bottom,
                                  CharSequence text, int start, int end, boolean first, Layout layout)
    {
        Paint.Style style = paint.getStyle();
        int color = paint.getColor();

        paint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
        paint.setColor(mColor);

        canvas.drawRect(x, top, x + direction * mStripeWidth, bottom, paint);

        paint.setStyle(style);
        paint.setColor(color);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "QuoteSpan{color=#" + String.format("%08X", mColor) + ", stripeWidth=" + mStripeWidth + ", gapWidth=" + mGapWidth + "}";
    }
}
```

`java/android/text/style/StyleSpan.java`:

```java
package android.text.style;

import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.text.ParcelableSpan;
import android.text.TextPaint;
import android.text.TextUtils;

public class StyleSpan extends MetricAffectingSpan implements ParcelableSpan
{
    private final int mStyle;
    private final int mFontWeightAdjustment;

    public StyleSpan(int style)
    {
        this(style, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
    }

    public StyleSpan(int style, int fontWeightAdjustment)
    {
        mStyle = style;
        mFontWeightAdjustment = fontWeightAdjustment;
    }

    public StyleSpan(Parcel source)
    {
        mStyle = source.readInt();
        mFontWeightAdjustment = source.readInt();
    }

    @Override
    public int getSpanTypeId()
    {
        return TextUtils.STYLE_SPAN;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mStyle);
        dest.writeInt(mFontWeightAdjustment);
    }

    public int getStyle()
    {
        return mStyle;
    }

    public int getFontWeightAdjustment()
    {
        return mFontWeightAdjustment;
    }

    @Override
    public void updateDrawState(TextPaint paint)
    {
        apply(paint, mStyle);
    }

    @Override
    public void updateMeasureState(TextPaint paint)
    {
        apply(paint, mStyle);
    }

    static void apply(Paint paint, int style)
    {
        if (paint == null) return;

        Typeface old = paint.getTypeface();
        int oldStyle = old == null ? Typeface.NORMAL : old.getStyle();
        int want = oldStyle | style;

        Typeface typeface = old == null ? Typeface.defaultFromStyle(want) : Typeface.create(old, want);
        if (typeface == null)
        {
            if ((want & Typeface.BOLD) != 0) paint.setFakeBoldText(true);
            if ((want & Typeface.ITALIC) != 0) paint.setTextSkewX(-0.25f);
            return;
        }

        int fake = want & ~typeface.getStyle();
        if ((fake & Typeface.BOLD) != 0) paint.setFakeBoldText(true);
        if ((fake & Typeface.ITALIC) != 0) paint.setTextSkewX(-0.25f);

        paint.setTypeface(typeface);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "StyleSpan{style=" + mStyle + ", fontWeightAdjustment=" + mFontWeightAdjustment + "}";
    }
}

```

`java/android/text/style/SuggestionSpan.java`:

```java
package android.text.style;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.text.ParcelableSpan;
import android.text.TextPaint;
import android.text.TextUtils;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Locale;

public class SuggestionSpan extends CharacterStyle implements ParcelableSpan
{
    public static final int FLAG_EASY_CORRECT = 0x0001;
    public static final int FLAG_MISSPELLED = 0x0002;
    public static final int FLAG_AUTO_CORRECTION = 0x0004;
    public static final int FLAG_GRAMMAR_ERROR = 0x0008;

    public static final String ACTION_SUGGESTION_PICKED = "android.text.style.SUGGESTION_PICKED";
    public static final String SUGGESTION_SPAN_PICKED_AFTER = "after";
    public static final String SUGGESTION_SPAN_PICKED_BEFORE = "before";
    public static final String SUGGESTION_SPAN_PICKED_HASHCODE = "hashcode";

    public static final int SUGGESTIONS_MAX_SIZE = 5;

    private static final int DEFAULT_UNDERLINE_COLOR = 0xFF4285F4;
    private static final int MISSPELLED_UNDERLINE_COLOR = 0xFFFF0000;
    private static final int GRAMMAR_UNDERLINE_COLOR = 0xFF00A000;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<SuggestionSpan> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<SuggestionSpan>()
    {
        @Override
        public SuggestionSpan createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new SuggestionSpan(source);
        }

        @Override
        public SuggestionSpan[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new SuggestionSpan[size];
        }
    };

    private int mFlags;
    private final String[] mSuggestions;
    private final String mLocaleStringForCompatibility;
    private final String mLanguageTag;
    private final int mHashCode;
    private final float mUnderlineThickness;

    public SuggestionSpan(Context context, String[] suggestions, int flags)
    {
        this(context, null, suggestions, flags, null);
    }

    public SuggestionSpan(Locale locale, String[] suggestions, int flags)
    {
        this(null, locale, suggestions, flags, null);
    }

    public SuggestionSpan(Context context, Locale locale, String[] suggestions, int flags, Class<?> notificationTargetClass)
    {
        int size = Math.min(SUGGESTIONS_MAX_SIZE, suggestions.length);
        mSuggestions = Arrays.copyOf(suggestions, size);
        mFlags = flags;

        Locale resolved = locale;
        if (resolved == null && context != null) resolved = context.getResources().getConfiguration().locale;
        if (resolved == null) resolved = Locale.getDefault();

        mLocaleStringForCompatibility = resolved.toString();
        mLanguageTag = resolved.toLanguageTag();
        mHashCode = hashCodeInternal(mSuggestions, mLanguageTag, mLocaleStringForCompatibility);
        mUnderlineThickness = 2f;
    }

    public SuggestionSpan(Parcel source)
    {
        int count = source.readInt();
        mSuggestions = new String[count];
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            mSuggestions[index] = source.readString();
        }

        mFlags = source.readInt();
        mLocaleStringForCompatibility = source.readString();
        mLanguageTag = source.readString();
        mHashCode = source.readInt();
        mUnderlineThickness = source.readFloat();
    }

    public String[] getSuggestions()
    {
        return mSuggestions;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public String getLocale()
    {
        return mLocaleStringForCompatibility;
    }

    public Locale getLocaleObject()
    {
        return mLanguageTag == null || mLanguageTag.isEmpty() ? null : Locale.forLanguageTag(mLanguageTag);
    }

    public int getFlags()
    {
        return mFlags;
    }

    public void setFlags(int flags)
    {
        mFlags = flags;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mSuggestions.length);
        for (String suggestion : mSuggestions)
        {
            dest.writeString(suggestion);
        }

        dest.writeInt(mFlags);
        dest.writeString(mLocaleStringForCompatibility);
        dest.writeString(mLanguageTag);
        dest.writeInt(mHashCode);
        dest.writeFloat(mUnderlineThickness);
    }

    @Override
    public int getSpanTypeId()
    {
        return TextUtils.SUGGESTION_SPAN;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (other instanceof SuggestionSpan) return ((SuggestionSpan)other).hashCode() == mHashCode;

        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mHashCode;
    }

    private static int hashCodeInternal(String[] suggestions, String languageTag, String localeString)
    {
        return Arrays.hashCode(new Object[] {Long.valueOf(SystemClock.uptimeMillis()), suggestions, languageTag, localeString});
    }

    @Override
    public void updateDrawState(TextPaint paint)
    {
        if (paint == null) return;

        boolean misspelled = (mFlags & FLAG_MISSPELLED) != 0;
        boolean easy = (mFlags & FLAG_EASY_CORRECT) != 0;
        boolean autoCorrection = (mFlags & FLAG_AUTO_CORRECTION) != 0;
        boolean grammar = (mFlags & FLAG_GRAMMAR_ERROR) != 0;

        if (easy || misspelled || grammar || autoCorrection)
        {
            paint.underlineColor = getUnderlineColor();
            paint.underlineThickness = mUnderlineThickness;
        }
    }

    public int getUnderlineColor()
    {
        boolean misspelled = (mFlags & FLAG_MISSPELLED) != 0;
        boolean easy = (mFlags & FLAG_EASY_CORRECT) != 0;
        boolean autoCorrection = (mFlags & FLAG_AUTO_CORRECTION) != 0;
        boolean grammar = (mFlags & FLAG_GRAMMAR_ERROR) != 0;

        if (easy)
        {
            if (grammar) return GRAMMAR_UNDERLINE_COLOR;
            if (misspelled) return MISSPELLED_UNDERLINE_COLOR;
            return DEFAULT_UNDERLINE_COLOR;
        }

        if (autoCorrection) return DEFAULT_UNDERLINE_COLOR;
        if (misspelled) return MISSPELLED_UNDERLINE_COLOR;
        if (grammar) return GRAMMAR_UNDERLINE_COLOR;

        return 0;
    }
}
```

`java/android/text/style/TextAppearanceSpan.java`:

```java
package android.text.style;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.LocaleList;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.text.ParcelableSpan;
import android.text.TextPaint;
import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.view.StyleableSet;

public class TextAppearanceSpan extends MetricAffectingSpan implements ParcelableSpan
{
    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private final String mFamilyName;
    private final int mStyle;
    private final int mTextSize;
    private final ColorStateList mTextColor;
    private final ColorStateList mTextColorLink;
    private final Typeface mTypeface;
    private final int mTextFontWeight;
    private final LocaleList mTextLocales;
    private final float mShadowRadius;
    private final float mShadowDx;
    private final float mShadowDy;
    private final int mShadowColor;
    private final boolean mHasElegantTextHeight;
    private final boolean mElegantTextHeight;
    private final boolean mHasLetterSpacing;
    private final float mLetterSpacing;
    private final String mFontFeatureSettings;
    private final String mFontVariationSettings;

    public TextAppearanceSpan(Context context, int appearance)
    {
        this(context, appearance, -1);
    }

    public TextAppearanceSpan(Context context, int appearance, int colorList)
    {
        StyleableSet styleable = styleable(context);
        TypedArray array = styleable.isEmpty() ? null : context.obtainStyledAttributes(appearance, styleable.attributes());

        ColorStateList textColor = null;
        ColorStateList linkColor = null;
        int size = -1;
        int style = Typeface.NORMAL;
        String family = null;
        Typeface typeface = null;
        int weight = -1;
        float shadowRadius = 0f;
        float shadowDx = 0f;
        float shadowDy = 0f;
        int shadowColor = 0;
        boolean hasElegant = false;
        boolean elegant = false;
        boolean hasLetterSpacing = false;
        float letterSpacing = 0f;
        String featureSettings = null;
        String variationSettings = null;
        LocaleList locales = null;

        if (array != null)
        {
            textColor = colorStateList(array, styleable.indexOf("textColor"));
            linkColor = colorStateList(array, styleable.indexOf("textColorLink"));
            size = dimensionPixelSize(array, styleable.indexOf("textSize"), -1);
            style = integer(array, styleable.indexOf("textStyle"), Typeface.NORMAL);
            weight = integer(array, styleable.indexOf("textFontWeight"), -1);
            shadowRadius = floatValue(array, styleable.indexOf("shadowRadius"), 0f);
            shadowDx = floatValue(array, styleable.indexOf("shadowDx"), 0f);
            shadowDy = floatValue(array, styleable.indexOf("shadowDy"), 0f);
            shadowColor = color(array, styleable.indexOf("shadowColor"), 0);

            int elegantIndex = styleable.indexOf("elegantTextHeight");
            hasElegant = elegantIndex >= 0 && array.hasValue(elegantIndex);
            elegant = hasElegant && array.getBoolean(elegantIndex, false);

            int spacingIndex = styleable.indexOf("letterSpacing");
            hasLetterSpacing = spacingIndex >= 0 && array.hasValue(spacingIndex);
            letterSpacing = hasLetterSpacing ? array.getFloat(spacingIndex, 0f) : 0f;

            featureSettings = string(array, styleable.indexOf("fontFeatureSettings"));
            variationSettings = string(array, styleable.indexOf("fontVariationSettings"));

            String localeTags = string(array, styleable.indexOf("textLocale"));
            if (localeTags != null) locales = LocaleList.forLanguageTags(localeTags);

            int fontIndex = styleable.indexOf("fontFamily");
            if (fontIndex >= 0 && array.hasValue(fontIndex))
            {
                try
                {
                    typeface = array.getFont(fontIndex);
                }
                catch (RuntimeException exception)
                {
                    typeface = null;
                }

                if (typeface == null) family = array.getString(fontIndex);
            }

            if (typeface == null && family == null)
            {
                int typefaceIndex = integer(array, styleable.indexOf("typeface"), 0);
                if (typefaceIndex == 1) family = "sans";
                else if (typefaceIndex == 2) family = "serif";
                else if (typefaceIndex == 3) family = "monospace";
            }

            array.recycle();
        }

        if (colorList >= 0)
        {
            try
            {
                textColor = context.getColorStateList(colorList);
            }
            catch (RuntimeException exception)
            {
                textColor = null;
            }
        }

        mTextColor = textColor;
        mTextColorLink = linkColor;
        mTextSize = size;
        mStyle = style;
        mFamilyName = family;
        mTypeface = typeface;
        mTextFontWeight = weight;
        mShadowRadius = shadowRadius;
        mShadowDx = shadowDx;
        mShadowDy = shadowDy;
        mShadowColor = shadowColor;
        mHasElegantTextHeight = hasElegant;
        mElegantTextHeight = elegant;
        mHasLetterSpacing = hasLetterSpacing;
        mLetterSpacing = letterSpacing;
        mFontFeatureSettings = featureSettings;
        mFontVariationSettings = variationSettings;
        mTextLocales = locales;
    }

    public TextAppearanceSpan(String family, int style, int size, ColorStateList color, ColorStateList linkColor)
    {
        mFamilyName = family;
        mStyle = style;
        mTextSize = size;
        mTextColor = color;
        mTextColorLink = linkColor;
        mTypeface = null;
        mTextFontWeight = -1;
        mTextLocales = null;
        mShadowRadius = 0f;
        mShadowDx = 0f;
        mShadowDy = 0f;
        mShadowColor = 0;
        mHasElegantTextHeight = false;
        mElegantTextHeight = false;
        mHasLetterSpacing = false;
        mLetterSpacing = 0f;
        mFontFeatureSettings = null;
        mFontVariationSettings = null;
    }

    public TextAppearanceSpan(Parcel source)
    {
        mFamilyName = source.readString();
        mStyle = source.readInt();
        mTextSize = source.readInt();
        mTextColor = (ColorStateList)source.readValue(null);
        mTextColorLink = (ColorStateList)source.readValue(null);
        mTypeface = (Typeface)source.readValue(null);
        mTextFontWeight = source.readInt();
        String locales = source.readString();
        mTextLocales = locales == null ? null : LocaleList.forLanguageTags(locales);
        mShadowRadius = source.readFloat();
        mShadowDx = source.readFloat();
        mShadowDy = source.readFloat();
        mShadowColor = source.readInt();
        mHasElegantTextHeight = source.readInt() != 0;
        mElegantTextHeight = source.readInt() != 0;
        mHasLetterSpacing = source.readInt() != 0;
        mLetterSpacing = source.readFloat();
        mFontFeatureSettings = source.readString();
        mFontVariationSettings = source.readString();
    }

    private static StyleableSet styleable(Context context)
    {
        if (sStyleable == null)
        {
            sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "textColor", "textColorLink", "textSize", "textStyle",
                                         "textFontWeight", "shadowRadius", "shadowDx", "shadowDy", "shadowColor",
                                         "elegantTextHeight", "letterSpacing", "fontFeatureSettings", "fontVariationSettings",
                                         "textLocale", "fontFamily", "typeface");
        }
        return sStyleable;
    }

    private static ColorStateList colorStateList(TypedArray array, int index)
    {
        if (index < 0 || !array.hasValue(index)) return null;

        return array.getColorStateList(index);
    }

    private static int dimensionPixelSize(TypedArray array, int index, int defaultValue)
    {
        return index < 0 ? defaultValue : array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, defaultValue);
    }

    private static int integer(TypedArray array, int index, int defaultValue)
    {
        return index < 0 ? defaultValue : array.getInt(index, defaultValue);
    }

    private static float floatValue(TypedArray array, int index, float defaultValue)
    {
        return index < 0 ? defaultValue : array.getFloat(index, defaultValue);
    }

    private static int color(TypedArray array, int index, int defaultValue)
    {
        return index < 0 ? defaultValue : array.getColor(index, defaultValue);
    }

    private static String string(TypedArray array, int index)
    {
        return index < 0 ? null : array.getString(index);
    }

    @Override
    public int getSpanTypeId()
    {
        return TextUtils.TEXT_APPEARANCE_SPAN;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mFamilyName);
        dest.writeInt(mStyle);
        dest.writeInt(mTextSize);
        dest.writeValue(mTextColor);
        dest.writeValue(mTextColorLink);
        dest.writeValue(mTypeface);
        dest.writeInt(mTextFontWeight);
        dest.writeString(mTextLocales == null ? null : mTextLocales.toLanguageTags());
        dest.writeFloat(mShadowRadius);
        dest.writeFloat(mShadowDx);
        dest.writeFloat(mShadowDy);
        dest.writeInt(mShadowColor);
        dest.writeInt(mHasElegantTextHeight ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeInt(mElegantTextHeight ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeInt(mHasLetterSpacing ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeFloat(mLetterSpacing);
        dest.writeString(mFontFeatureSettings);
        dest.writeString(mFontVariationSettings);
    }

    public String getFamily()
    {
        return mFamilyName;
    }

    public ColorStateList getTextColor()
    {
        return mTextColor;
    }

    public ColorStateList getLinkTextColor()
    {
        return mTextColorLink;
    }

    public int getTextSize()
    {
        return mTextSize;
    }

    public int getTextStyle()
    {
        return mStyle;
    }

        return mTextFontWeight;
    }

        return mTextLocales;

    {
        return mTypeface;
    }

    {
        return mShadowColor;
    }

    public float getShadowDx()
    {
        return mShadowDx;
    }

    public float getShadowDy()
    {
        return mShadowDy;
    }

    public float getShadowRadius()
    {
        return mShadowRadius;
    }

    public String getFontFeatureSettings()
    {
        return mFontFeatureSettings;
    }

    public String getFontVariationSettings()
    {
        return mFontVariationSettings;
    }

    public boolean isElegantTextHeight()
    {
        return mElegantTextHeight;
    }

    public float getLetterSpacing()
    {
        return mLetterSpacing;
    }

    @Override
    public void updateDrawState(TextPaint paint)
    {
        if (paint == null) return;

        updateMeasureState(paint);

        if (mTextColor != null) paint.setColor(mTextColor.getColorForState(paint.drawableState, 0));
        if (mTextColorLink != null) paint.linkColor = mTextColorLink.getColorForState(paint.drawableState, 0);
        if (mShadowColor != 0) paint.setShadowLayer(mShadowRadius, mShadowDx, mShadowDy, mShadowColor);
    }

    @Override
    public void updateMeasureState(TextPaint paint)
    {
        if (paint == null) return;

        Typeface styled = null;
        int style = 0;

        if (mTypeface != null)
        {
            style = mStyle;
            styled = Typeface.create(mTypeface, style);
        }
        else if (mFamilyName != null || mStyle != 0)
        {
            Typeface old = paint.getTypeface();
            if (old != null) style = old.getStyle();

            style |= mStyle;

            if (mFamilyName != null) styled = Typeface.create(mFamilyName, style);
            else if (old == null) styled = Typeface.defaultFromStyle(style);
            else styled = Typeface.create(old, style);
        }

        if (styled != null)
        {
            if (mTextFontWeight >= 0) styled = Typeface.create(styled, Math.min(1000, mTextFontWeight), (style & Typeface.ITALIC) != 0);

            int fake = style & ~styled.getStyle();
            if ((fake & Typeface.BOLD) != 0) paint.setFakeBoldText(true);
            if ((fake & Typeface.ITALIC) != 0) paint.setTextSkewX(-0.25f);

            paint.setTypeface(styled);
        }

        if (mTextSize > 0) paint.setTextSize(mTextSize);
        if (mTextLocales != null) paint.setTextLocales(mTextLocales);
        if (mHasElegantTextHeight) paint.setElegantTextHeight(mElegantTextHeight);
        if (mHasLetterSpacing) paint.setLetterSpacing(mLetterSpacing);
        if (mFontFeatureSettings != null) paint.setFontFeatureSettings(mFontFeatureSettings);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "TextAppearanceSpan{familyName='" + mFamilyName + "', style=" + mStyle + ", textSize=" + mTextSize + ", textColor="
               + mTextColor + ", textColorLink=" + mTextColorLink + ", typeface=" + mTypeface + ", textFontWeight=" + mTextFontWeight
               + ", textLocales=" + mTextLocales + ", shadowRadius=" + mShadowRadius + ", shadowDx=" + mShadowDx + ", shadowDy="
               + mShadowDy + ", shadowColor=#" + String.format("%08X", mShadowColor) + ", elegantTextHeight=" + mElegantTextHeight
               + ", letterSpacing=" + mLetterSpacing + ", fontFeatureSettings='" + mFontFeatureSettings
               + "', fontVariationSettings='" + mFontVariationSettings + "'}";
    }
}
```

`java/android/text/style/TypefaceSpan.java`:

```java
package android.text.style;

import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.text.ParcelableSpan;
import android.text.TextPaint;
import android.text.TextUtils;

public class TypefaceSpan extends MetricAffectingSpan implements ParcelableSpan
{
    private final String mFamily;
    private final Typeface mTypeface;

    public TypefaceSpan(String family)
    {
        mFamily = family;
        mTypeface = null;
    }

    public TypefaceSpan(Typeface typeface)
    {
        mFamily = null;
        mTypeface = typeface;
    }

    public TypefaceSpan(Parcel source)
    {
        mFamily = source.readString();
        mTypeface = null;
    }

    @Override
    public int getSpanTypeId()
    {
        return TextUtils.TYPEFACE_SPAN;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mFamily);
    }

    public String getFamily()
    {
        return mFamily;
    }

    public Typeface getTypeface()
    {
        return mTypeface;
    }

    @Override
    public void updateDrawState(TextPaint paint)
    {
        apply(paint);
    }

    @Override
    public void updateMeasureState(TextPaint paint)
    {
        apply(paint);
    }

    private void apply(Paint paint)
    {
        if (paint == null) return;

        if (mTypeface != null)
        {
            Typeface old = paint.getTypeface();
            int oldStyle = old == null ? Typeface.NORMAL : old.getStyle();
            Typeface styled = Typeface.create(mTypeface, oldStyle);
            int fake = oldStyle & ~styled.getStyle();

            if ((fake & Typeface.BOLD) != 0) paint.setFakeBoldText(true);
            if ((fake & Typeface.ITALIC) != 0) paint.setTextSkewX(-0.25f);

            paint.setTypeface(styled);
            return;
        }

        if (mFamily == null) return;

        Typeface old = paint.getTypeface();
        int oldStyle = old == null ? Typeface.NORMAL : old.getStyle();
        Typeface styled = Typeface.create(mFamily, oldStyle);
        if (styled == null) return;

        int fake = oldStyle & ~styled.getStyle();
        if ((fake & Typeface.BOLD) != 0) paint.setFakeBoldText(true);
        if ((fake & Typeface.ITALIC) != 0) paint.setTextSkewX(-0.25f);

        paint.setTypeface(styled);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "TypefaceSpan{family='" + mFamily + "', typeface=" + mTypeface + "}";
    }
}
```

```java
package android.text.style;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.text.ParcelableSpan;
import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.view.View;

public class URLSpan extends ClickableSpan implements ParcelableSpan
{
    private static final String EXTRA_APPLICATION_ID = "com.android.browser.application_id";

    private final String mURL;

    public URLSpan(String url)
    {
        mURL = url;
    }

    public URLSpan(Parcel source)
    {
        mURL = source.readString();
    }

    @Override
    public int getSpanTypeId()
    {
        return TextUtils.URL_SPAN;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mURL);
    }

    public String getURL()
    {
        return mURL;
    }

    @Override
    public void onClick(View widget)
    {
        if (widget == null || mURL == null) return;

        Context context = widget.getContext();
        Intent intent = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(mURL));
        intent.putExtra(EXTRA_APPLICATION_ID, context.getPackageName());

        try
        {
            context.startActivity(intent);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception)
        {
            android.util.Log.w("URLSpan", "Actvity was not found for intent, " + intent.toString());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "URLSpan{URL='" + mURL + "'}";
    }
}
```

`java/android/text/util/Linkify.java`:

```java
package android.text.util;

import android.text.Spannable;
import android.text.SpannableString;
import android.text.Spanned;
import android.text.method.LinkMovementMethod;
import android.text.method.MovementMethod;
import android.text.style.URLSpan;
import android.util.Patterns;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public class Linkify
{
    public static final int WEB_URLS = 0x01;
    public static final int EMAIL_ADDRESSES = 0x02;
    public static final int PHONE_NUMBERS = 0x04;
    public static final int MAP_ADDRESSES = 0x08;
    public static final int ALL = WEB_URLS | EMAIL_ADDRESSES | PHONE_NUMBERS | MAP_ADDRESSES;

    private static final int PHONE_NUMBER_MINIMUM_DIGITS = 5;

    private static final Function<String, URLSpan> DEFAULT_SPAN_FACTORY = URLSpan::new;

    public static final MatchFilter sUrlMatchFilter = new MatchFilter()
    {
        @Override
        public final boolean acceptMatch(CharSequence text, int start, int end)
        {
            if (start == 0) return true;

            return text.charAt(start - 1) != '@';
        }
    };

    public static final MatchFilter sPhoneNumberMatchFilter = new MatchFilter()
    {
        @Override
        public final boolean acceptMatch(CharSequence text, int start, int end)
        {
            int digitCount = 0;

            for (int index = start; index < end; index++)
            {
                if (Character.isDigit(text.charAt(index)))
                {
                    digitCount++;
                    if (digitCount >= PHONE_NUMBER_MINIMUM_DIGITS) return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }
    };

    public static final TransformFilter sPhoneNumberTransformFilter = new TransformFilter()
    {
        @Override
        public final String transformUrl(Matcher match, String url)
        {
            return Patterns.digitsAndPlusOnly(match);
        }
    };

    public interface MatchFilter
    {
        boolean acceptMatch(CharSequence text, int start, int end);
    }

    public interface TransformFilter
    {
        String transformUrl(Matcher match, String url);
    }

    public Linkify()
    {
    }

    public static final boolean addLinks(Spannable text, int mask)
    {
        return addLinks(text, mask, null);
    }

    public static final boolean addLinks(Spannable text, int mask, Function<String, URLSpan> urlSpanFactory)
    {
        if (text == null || mask == 0) return false;

        URLSpan[] old = text.getSpans(0, text.length(), URLSpan.class);
        for (int index = old.length - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            text.removeSpan(old[index]);
        }

        ArrayList<LinkSpec> links = new ArrayList<>();

        if ((mask & WEB_URLS) != 0)
        {
            gatherLinks(links, text, Patterns.AUTOLINK_WEB_URL, new String[] {"http://", "https://", "rtsp://", "ftp://"},
                        sUrlMatchFilter, null);
        }

        if ((mask & EMAIL_ADDRESSES) != 0)
        {
            gatherLinks(links, text, Patterns.AUTOLINK_EMAIL_ADDRESS, new String[] {"mailto:"}, null, null);
        }

        if ((mask & PHONE_NUMBERS) != 0)
        {
            gatherLinks(links, text, Patterns.PHONE, new String[] {"tel:"}, sPhoneNumberMatchFilter, sPhoneNumberTransformFilter);
        }

        pruneOverlaps(links);

        if (links.isEmpty()) return false;

        for (LinkSpec link : links)
        {
            applyLink(link.url, link.start, link.end, text, urlSpanFactory);
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static final boolean addLinks(TextView text, int mask)
    {
        if (text == null || mask == 0) return false;

        CharSequence content = text.getText();

        if (content instanceof Spannable)
        {
            if (!addLinks((Spannable)content, mask)) return false;

            addLinkMovementMethod(text);
            return true;
        }

        SpannableString spannable = SpannableString.valueOf(content);
        if (!addLinks(spannable, mask)) return false;

        addLinkMovementMethod(text);
        text.setText(spannable);
        return true;
    }

    private static void addLinkMovementMethod(TextView text)
    {
        MovementMethod method = text.getMovementMethod();

        if (method instanceof LinkMovementMethod) return;
        if (text.getLinksClickable()) text.setMovementMethod(LinkMovementMethod.getInstance());
    }

    public static final void addLinks(TextView text, Pattern pattern, String scheme)
    {
        addLinks(text, pattern, scheme, null, null, null);
    }

    public static final void addLinks(TextView text, Pattern pattern, String scheme, MatchFilter matchFilter,
                                      TransformFilter transformFilter)
    {
        addLinks(text, pattern, scheme, null, matchFilter, transformFilter);
    }

    public static final void addLinks(TextView text, Pattern pattern, String defaultScheme, String[] schemes, MatchFilter matchFilter,
                                      TransformFilter transformFilter)
    {
        SpannableString spannable = SpannableString.valueOf(text.getText());

        if (addLinks(spannable, pattern, defaultScheme, schemes, matchFilter, transformFilter))
        {
            text.setText(spannable);
            addLinkMovementMethod(text);
        }
    }

    public static final boolean addLinks(Spannable text, Pattern pattern, String scheme)
    {
        return addLinks(text, pattern, scheme, null, null, null);
    }

    public static final boolean addLinks(Spannable spannable, Pattern pattern, String scheme, MatchFilter matchFilter,
                                         TransformFilter transformFilter)
    {
        return addLinks(spannable, pattern, scheme, null, matchFilter, transformFilter);
    }

    public static final boolean addLinks(Spannable spannable, Pattern pattern, String defaultScheme, String[] schemes,
                                         MatchFilter matchFilter, TransformFilter transformFilter)
    {
        return addLinks(spannable, pattern, defaultScheme, schemes, matchFilter, transformFilter, null);
    }

    public static final boolean addLinks(Spannable spannable, Pattern pattern, String defaultScheme, String[] schemes,
                                         MatchFilter matchFilter, TransformFilter transformFilter,
                                         Function<String, URLSpan> urlSpanFactory)
    {
        if (spannable == null || pattern == null) return false;

        if (defaultScheme == null) defaultScheme = "";
        if (schemes == null || schemes.length < 1) schemes = new String[0];

        String[] schemesCopy = new String[schemes.length + 1];
        schemesCopy[0] = defaultScheme.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        for (int index = 0; index < schemes.length; index++)
        {
            String scheme = schemes[index];
            schemesCopy[index + 1] = scheme == null ? "" : scheme.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        }

        boolean hasMatches = false;
        Matcher matcher = pattern.matcher(spannable);

        while (matcher.find())
        {
            int start = matcher.start();
            int end = matcher.end();

            if (matchFilter != null && !matchFilter.acceptMatch(spannable, start, end)) continue;

            String url = makeUrl(matcher.group(0), schemesCopy, matcher, transformFilter);
            applyLink(url, start, end, spannable, urlSpanFactory);
            hasMatches = true;
        }

        return hasMatches;
    }

    private static void applyLink(String url, int start, int end, Spannable text, Function<String, URLSpan> urlSpanFactory)
    {
        if (urlSpanFactory == null) urlSpanFactory = DEFAULT_SPAN_FACTORY;

        URLSpan span = urlSpanFactory.apply(url);
        text.setSpan(span, start, end, Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE);
    }

    private static String makeUrl(String url, String[] prefixes, Matcher matcher, TransformFilter filter)
    {
        if (filter != null) url = filter.transformUrl(matcher, url);

        boolean hasPrefix = false;

        for (String prefix : prefixes)
        {
            if (url.regionMatches(true, 0, prefix, 0, prefix.length()))
            {
                hasPrefix = true;

                if (!url.regionMatches(false, 0, prefix, 0, prefix.length())) url = prefix + url.substring(prefix.length());
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!hasPrefix && prefixes.length > 0) url = prefixes[0] + url;

        return url;
    }

    private static void gatherLinks(ArrayList<LinkSpec> links, Spannable text, Pattern pattern, String[] schemes,
                                    MatchFilter matchFilter, TransformFilter transformFilter)
    {
        Matcher matcher = pattern.matcher(text);

        while (matcher.find())
        {
            int start = matcher.start();
            int end = matcher.end();

            if (matchFilter != null && !matchFilter.acceptMatch(text, start, end)) continue;

            LinkSpec spec = new LinkSpec();
            spec.url = makeUrl(matcher.group(0), schemes, matcher, transformFilter);
            spec.start = start;
            spec.end = end;
            links.add(spec);
        }
    }

    private static void pruneOverlaps(ArrayList<LinkSpec> links)
    {
        Comparator<LinkSpec> comparator = new Comparator<LinkSpec>()
        {
            @Override
            public int compare(LinkSpec first, LinkSpec second)
            {
                if (first.start < second.start) return -1;
                if (first.start > second.start) return 1;
                if (first.end < second.end) return 1;
                if (first.end > second.end) return -1;

                return 0;
            }
        };

        Collections.sort(links, comparator);

        int length = links.size();
        int index = 0;

        while (index < length - 1)
        {
            LinkSpec first = links.get(index);
            LinkSpec second = links.get(index + 1);
            int remove = -1;

            if (first.start <= second.start && first.end > second.start)
            {
                if (second.end <= first.end) remove = index + 1;
                else if (first.end - first.start > second.end - second.start) remove = index + 1;
                else if (first.end - first.start < second.end - second.start) remove = index;

                if (remove != -1)
                {
                    links.remove(remove);
                    length--;
                    continue;
                }
            }

            index++;
        }
    }

    private static final class LinkSpec
    {
        String url;
        int start;
        int end;
    }
}
```

`java/android/text/util/Rfc822Token.java`:

```java
package android.text.util;

public class Rfc822Token
{
    private String mName;
    private String mAddress;
    private String mComment;

    public Rfc822Token(String name, String address, String comment)
    {
        mName = name;
        mAddress = address;
        mComment = comment;
    }

    public String getName()
    {
        return mName;
    }

    public String getAddress()
    {
        return mAddress;
    }

    public String getComment()
    {
        return mComment;
    }

    public void setName(String name)
    {
        mName = name;
    }

    public void setAddress(String address)
    {
        mAddress = address;
    }

    public void setComment(String comment)
    {
        mComment = comment;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();

        if (mName != null && mName.length() != 0)
        {
            builder.append(quoteNameIfNecessary(mName));
            builder.append(' ');
        }

        if (mComment != null && mComment.length() != 0)
        {
            builder.append('(');
            builder.append(quoteComment(mComment));
            builder.append(") ");
        }

        if (mAddress != null && mAddress.length() != 0)
        {
            builder.append('<');
            builder.append(mAddress);
            builder.append('>');
        }

        return builder.toString();
    }

    public static String quoteNameIfNecessary(String name)
    {
        int length = name.length();

        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
        {
            char character = name.charAt(index);

            if (!((character >= 'a' && character <= 'z') || (character >= 'A' && character <= 'Z') || character == ' '
                  || (character >= '0' && character <= '9')))
            {
                return '"' + quoteName(name) + '"';
            }
        }

        return name;
    }

    public static String quoteName(String name)
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        int length = name.length();

        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
        {
            char character = name.charAt(index);

            if (character == '\\' || character == '"') builder.append('\\');
            builder.append(character);
        }

        return builder.toString();
    }

    public static String quoteComment(String comment)
    {
        int length = comment.length();
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();

        for (int index = 0; index < length; index++)
        {
            char character = comment.charAt(index);

            if (character == '(' || character == ')' || character == '\\') builder.append('\\');
            builder.append(character);
        }

        return builder.toString();
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        int result = 17;
        if (mName != null) result = 31 * result + mName.hashCode();
        if (mAddress != null) result = 31 * result + mAddress.hashCode();
        if (mComment != null) result = 31 * result + mComment.hashCode();
        return result;
    }

    private static boolean stringEquals(String first, String second)
    {
        if (first == null) return second == null;

        return first.equals(second);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof Rfc822Token)) return false;

        Rfc822Token token = (Rfc822Token)other;
        return stringEquals(mName, token.mName) && stringEquals(mAddress, token.mAddress) && stringEquals(mComment, token.mComment);
    }
}
```

`java/android/text/util/Rfc822Tokenizer.java`:

```java
package android.text.util;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collection;

public class Rfc822Tokenizer implements android.widget.MultiAutoCompleteTextView.Tokenizer
{
    public Rfc822Tokenizer()
    {
    }

    public static void tokenize(CharSequence text, Collection<Rfc822Token> out)
    {
        StringBuilder name = new StringBuilder();
        StringBuilder address = new StringBuilder();
        StringBuilder comment = new StringBuilder();

        int index = 0;
        int cursor = text.length();

        while (index < cursor)
        {
            char character = text.charAt(index);

            if (character == ',' || character == ';')
            {
                index++;

                while (index < cursor && text.charAt(index) == ' ') index++;

                crunch(name);

                if (address.length() > 0) out.add(new Rfc822Token(name.toString(), address.toString(), comment.toString()));
                else if (name.length() > 0) out.add(new Rfc822Token(null, name.toString(), comment.toString()));

                name.setLength(0);
                address.setLength(0);
                comment.setLength(0);
            }
            else if (character == '"')
            {
                index++;

                while (index < cursor)
                {
                    character = text.charAt(index);

                    if (character == '"')
                    {
                        index++;
                        break;
                    }
                    else if (character == '\\')
                    {
                        if (index + 1 < cursor) name.append(text.charAt(index + 1));
                        index += 2;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        name.append(character);
                        index++;
                    }
                }
            }
            else if (character == '(')
            {
                int level = 1;
                index++;

                while (index < cursor && level > 0)
                {
                    character = text.charAt(index);

                    if (character == ')')
                    {
                        if (level > 1) comment.append(character);
                        level--;
                        index++;
                    }
                    else if (character == '(')
                    {
                        comment.append(character);
                        level++;
                        index++;
                    }
                    else if (character == '\\')
                    {
                        if (index + 1 < cursor) comment.append(text.charAt(index + 1));
                        index += 2;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        comment.append(character);
                        index++;
                    }
                }
            }
            else if (character == '<')
            {
                index++;

                while (index < cursor)
                {
                    character = text.charAt(index);

                    if (character == '>')
                    {
                        index++;
                        break;
                    }

                    address.append(character);
                    index++;
                }
            }
            else if (character == ' ')
            {
                name.append('\0');
                index++;
            }
            else
            {
                name.append(character);
                index++;
            }
        }

        crunch(name);

        if (address.length() > 0) out.add(new Rfc822Token(name.toString(), address.toString(), comment.toString()));
        else if (name.length() > 0) out.add(new Rfc822Token(null, name.toString(), comment.toString()));
    }

    public static Rfc822Token[] tokenize(CharSequence text)
    {
        ArrayList<Rfc822Token> out = new ArrayList<>();
        tokenize(text, out);
        return out.toArray(new Rfc822Token[out.size()]);
    }

    private static void crunch(StringBuilder builder)
    {
        int index = 0;
        int length = builder.length();

        while (index < length)
        {
            char character = builder.charAt(index);

            if (character != '\0')
            {
                index++;
                continue;
            }

            if (index == 0 || index == length - 1 || builder.charAt(index - 1) == ' ' || builder.charAt(index - 1) == '\0'
                || builder.charAt(index + 1) == ' ' || builder.charAt(index + 1) == '\0')
            {
                builder.deleteCharAt(index);
                length--;
            }
            else
            {
                builder.setCharAt(index, ' ');
                index++;
            }
        }
    }

    public int findTokenStart(CharSequence text, int cursor)
    {
        int best = 0;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < cursor)
        {
            index = findTokenEnd(text, index);

            if (index < cursor)
            {
                index++;

                while (index < cursor && text.charAt(index) == ' ') index++;

                if (index < cursor) best = index;
            }
        }

        return best;
    }

    public int findTokenEnd(CharSequence text, int cursor)
    {
        int length = text.length();
        int index = cursor;

        while (index < length)
        {
            char character = text.charAt(index);

            if (character == ',' || character == ';') return index;

            if (character == '"')
            {
                index++;

                while (index < length)
                {
                    character = text.charAt(index);

                    if (character == '"')
                    {
                        index++;
                        break;
                    }
                    else if (character == '\\' && index + 1 < length)
                    {
                        index += 2;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        index++;
                    }
                }
            }
            else if (character == '(')
            {
                int level = 1;
                index++;

                while (index < length && level > 0)
                {
                    character = text.charAt(index);

                    if (character == ')') level--;
                    else if (character == '(') level++;
                    else if (character == '\\' && index + 1 < length) index++;

                    index++;
                }
            }
            else if (character == '<')
            {
                index++;

                while (index < length)
                {
                    character = text.charAt(index);
                    index++;

                    if (character == '>') break;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                index++;
            }
        }

        return index;
    }

    public CharSequence terminateToken(CharSequence text)
    {
        return text + ", ";
    }
}

```

`java/android/transition/ArcMotion.java`:

```java
package android.transition;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

public class ArcMotion extends PathMotion
{
    private static final float DEFAULT_MIN_ANGLE_DEGREES = 0;
    private static final float DEFAULT_MAX_ANGLE_DEGREES = 70;
    private static final float DEFAULT_MAX_TANGENT = (float)Math.tan(Math.toRadians(DEFAULT_MAX_ANGLE_DEGREES / 2));

    private float mMinimumHorizontalAngle = 0;
    private float mMinimumVerticalAngle = 0;
    private float mMaximumAngle = DEFAULT_MAX_ANGLE_DEGREES;
    private float mMinimumHorizontalTangent = 0;
    private float mMinimumVerticalTangent = 0;
    private float mMaximumTangent = DEFAULT_MAX_TANGENT;

    public ArcMotion()
    {
    }

    public ArcMotion(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        setMinimumVerticalAngle(TransitionAttributes.getFloat(attributes, "minimumVerticalAngle", DEFAULT_MIN_ANGLE_DEGREES));
        setMinimumHorizontalAngle(TransitionAttributes.getFloat(attributes, "minimumHorizontalAngle", DEFAULT_MIN_ANGLE_DEGREES));
        setMaximumAngle(TransitionAttributes.getFloat(attributes, "maximumAngle", DEFAULT_MAX_ANGLE_DEGREES));
    }

    public void setMinimumHorizontalAngle(float angleInDegrees)
    {
        mMinimumHorizontalAngle = angleInDegrees;
        mMinimumHorizontalTangent = toTangent(angleInDegrees);
    }

    public float getMinimumHorizontalAngle()
    {
        return mMinimumHorizontalAngle;
    }

    public void setMinimumVerticalAngle(float angleInDegrees)
    {
        mMinimumVerticalAngle = angleInDegrees;
        mMinimumVerticalTangent = toTangent(angleInDegrees);
    }

    public float getMinimumVerticalAngle()
    {
        return mMinimumVerticalAngle;
    }

    public void setMaximumAngle(float angleInDegrees)
    {
        mMaximumAngle = angleInDegrees;
        mMaximumTangent = toTangent(angleInDegrees);
    }

    public float getMaximumAngle()
    {
        return mMaximumAngle;
    }

    private static float toTangent(float arcInDegrees)
    {
        if (arcInDegrees < 0 || arcInDegrees > 90) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Arc must be between 0 and 90 degrees");

        return (float)Math.tan(Math.toRadians(arcInDegrees / 2));
    }

    @Override
    public Path getPath(float startX, float startY, float endX, float endY)
    {
        Path path = new Path();
        path.moveTo(startX, startY);

        float ex;
        float ey;
        float deltaX = endX - startX;
        float deltaY = endY - startY;

        float h2 = deltaX * deltaX + deltaY * deltaY;

        float dx = (startX + endX) / 2;
        float dy = (startY + endY) / 2;

        float midDist2 = h2 * 0.25f;

        float minimumArcDist2;

        boolean isMovingUpwards = startY > endY;

        if (deltaY == 0)
        {
            ex = dx;
            ey = dy + (Math.abs(deltaX) * 0.5f * mMinimumHorizontalTangent);
            minimumArcDist2 = 0;
        }
        else if (deltaX == 0)
        {
            ex = dx + (Math.abs(deltaY) * 0.5f * mMinimumVerticalTangent);
            ey = dy;
            minimumArcDist2 = 0;
        }
        else if (Math.abs(deltaX) < Math.abs(deltaY))
        {
            float eDistY = Math.abs(h2 / (2 * deltaY));

            if (isMovingUpwards)
            {
                ey = endY + eDistY;
                ex = endX;
            }
            else
            {
                ey = startY + eDistY;
                ex = startX;
            }

            minimumArcDist2 = midDist2 * mMinimumVerticalTangent * mMinimumVerticalTangent;
        }
        else
        {
            float eDistX = h2 / (2 * deltaX);

            if (isMovingUpwards)
            {
                ex = startX + eDistX;
                ey = startY;
            }
            else
            {
                ex = endX - eDistX;
                ey = endY;
            }

            minimumArcDist2 = midDist2 * mMinimumHorizontalTangent * mMinimumHorizontalTangent;
        }

        float arcDistX = dx - ex;
        float arcDistY = dy - ey;
        float arcDist2 = arcDistX * arcDistX + arcDistY * arcDistY;

        float maximumArcDist2 = midDist2 * mMaximumTangent * mMaximumTangent;

        float newArcDistance2 = 0;
        if (arcDist2 < minimumArcDist2) newArcDistance2 = minimumArcDist2;
        else if (arcDist2 > maximumArcDist2) newArcDistance2 = maximumArcDist2;

        if (newArcDistance2 != 0 && arcDist2 != 0)
        {
            float ratio = (float)Math.sqrt(newArcDistance2 / arcDist2);
            ex = dx + (ratio * (ex - dx));
            ey = dy + (ratio * (ey - dy));
        }

        float control1X = (startX + ex) / 2;
        float control1Y = (startY + ey) / 2;
        float control2X = (ex + endX) / 2;
        float control2Y = (ey + endY) / 2;

        path.cubicTo(control1X, control1Y, control2X, control2Y, endX, endY);
        return path;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.transition;

import android.animation.Animator;
import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

public class ChangeBounds extends Transition
{
    private static final String PROPNAME_BOUNDS = "android:changeBounds:bounds";
    private static final String PROPNAME_CLIP = "android:changeBounds:clip";
    private static final String PROPNAME_PARENT = "android:changeBounds:parent";
    private static final String PROPNAME_WINDOW_X = "android:changeBounds:windowX";
    private static final String PROPNAME_WINDOW_Y = "android:changeBounds:windowY";

    private static final String[] TRANSITION_PROPERTIES = { PROPNAME_BOUNDS, PROPNAME_CLIP, PROPNAME_PARENT, PROPNAME_WINDOW_X,
                                                            PROPNAME_WINDOW_Y };

    private boolean mResizeClip;
    private boolean mReparent;

    public ChangeBounds()
    {
    }

    public ChangeBounds(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        setResizeClip(TransitionAttributes.getBoolean(attributes, "resizeClip", false));
    }

    @Override
    public String[] getTransitionProperties()
    {
        return TRANSITION_PROPERTIES;
    }

    public void setResizeClip(boolean resizeClip)
    {
        mResizeClip = resizeClip;
    }

    public boolean getResizeClip()
    {
        return mResizeClip;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public void setReparent(boolean reparent)
    {
        mReparent = reparent;
    }

    private void captureValues(TransitionValues values)
    {
        View view = values.view;
        if (view == null) return;

        if (view.isLaidOut() || view.getWidth() != 0 || view.getHeight() != 0)
        {
            values.values.put(PROPNAME_BOUNDS, new Rect(view.getLeft(), view.getTop(), view.getRight(), view.getBottom()));
            values.values.put(PROPNAME_PARENT, values.view.getParent());

            if (mReparent)
            {
                int[] location = new int[2];
                values.view.getLocationInWindow(location);
                values.values.put(PROPNAME_WINDOW_X, location[0]);
                values.values.put(PROPNAME_WINDOW_Y, location[1]);
            }

            if (mResizeClip) values.values.put(PROPNAME_CLIP, view.getClipBounds());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void captureStartValues(TransitionValues transitionValues)
    {
        captureValues(transitionValues);
    }

    @Override
    public void captureEndValues(TransitionValues transitionValues)
    {
        captureValues(transitionValues);
    }

    @Override
    public Animator createAnimator(ViewGroup sceneRoot, TransitionValues startValues, TransitionValues endValues)
    {
        return null;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.transition;

import android.animation.Animator;
```

```java
import android.graphics.Matrix;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

public class ChangeTransform extends Transition
{
    private static final String PROPNAME_MATRIX = "android:changeTransform:matrix";
    private static final String PROPNAME_TRANSFORMS = "android:changeTransform:transforms";
    private static final String PROPNAME_PARENT = "android:changeTransform:parent";
    private static final String PROPNAME_PARENT_MATRIX = "android:changeTransform:parentMatrix";

    private static final String[] TRANSITION_PROPERTIES = { PROPNAME_MATRIX, PROPNAME_TRANSFORMS, PROPNAME_PARENT_MATRIX };

    private boolean mUseOverlay = true;
    private boolean mReparent = true;

    public ChangeTransform()
    {
    }

    public ChangeTransform(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        mUseOverlay = TransitionAttributes.getBoolean(attributes, "reparentWithOverlay", true);
        mReparent = TransitionAttributes.getBoolean(attributes, "reparent", true);
    }

    public boolean getReparentWithOverlay()
    {
        return mUseOverlay;
    }

    public void setReparentWithOverlay(boolean reparentWithOverlay)
    {
        mUseOverlay = reparentWithOverlay;
    }

    public boolean getReparent()

        return mReparent;
    }

    public void setReparent(boolean reparent)
    {
        mReparent = reparent;
    }

    @Override
    public String[] getTransitionProperties()
    {
        return TRANSITION_PROPERTIES;
    }

    private void captureValues(TransitionValues transitionValues)
    {
        View view = transitionValues.view;
        if (view == null || view.getVisibility() == View.GONE) return;

        transitionValues.values.put(PROPNAME_PARENT, view.getParent());

        float[] transforms = { view.getTranslationX(), view.getTranslationY(), view.getTranslationZ(), view.getScaleX(),
                               view.getScaleY(), view.getRotationX(), view.getRotationY(), view.getRotation() };
        transitionValues.values.put(PROPNAME_TRANSFORMS, transforms);

        Matrix matrix = view.getMatrix();
        transitionValues.values.put(PROPNAME_MATRIX, matrix == null || matrix.isIdentity() ? null : new Matrix(matrix));
    }

    public void captureStartValues(TransitionValues transitionValues)
    {
        captureValues(transitionValues);
    }

    @Override
    public void captureEndValues(TransitionValues transitionValues)
    {
        captureValues(transitionValues);
```

`java/android/transition/CircularPropagation.java`:

```java
package android.transition;

import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

public class CircularPropagation extends VisibilityPropagation
{
    private float mPropagationSpeed = 3.0f;

    public CircularPropagation()
    {
    }

    public void setPropagationSpeed(float propagationSpeed)
    {
        if (propagationSpeed == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("propagationSpeed may not be 0");

        mPropagationSpeed = propagationSpeed;
    }

    @Override
    public long getStartDelay(ViewGroup sceneRoot, Transition transition, TransitionValues startValues, TransitionValues endValues)
    {
        if (startValues == null && endValues == null) return 0;

        int directionMultiplier = 1;
        TransitionValues positionValues;

        if (endValues == null || getViewVisibility(startValues) == android.view.View.VISIBLE)
        {
            positionValues = startValues;
            directionMultiplier = -1;
        }
        else
        {
            positionValues = endValues;
        }

        int viewCenterX = getViewX(positionValues);
        int viewCenterY = getViewY(positionValues);

        Rect epicenter = transition.getEpicenter();
        int epicenterX;
        int epicenterY;

        if (epicenter != null)
        {
            epicenterX = epicenter.centerX();
            epicenterY = epicenter.centerY();
        }
        else
        {
            int[] location = new int[2];
            sceneRoot.getLocationOnScreen(location);
            epicenterX = Math.round(location[0] + (sceneRoot.getWidth() / 2) + sceneRoot.getTranslationX());
            epicenterY = Math.round(location[1] + (sceneRoot.getHeight() / 2) + sceneRoot.getTranslationY());
        }

        double distance = distance(viewCenterX, viewCenterY, epicenterX, epicenterY);
        double maxDistance = distance(0, 0, sceneRoot.getWidth(), sceneRoot.getHeight());
        double distanceFraction = maxDistance == 0 ? 0 : distance / maxDistance;

        long duration = transition.getDuration();
        if (duration < 0) duration = 300;

        return Math.round(duration * directionMultiplier / mPropagationSpeed * distanceFraction);
    }

    private static double distance(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)
    {
        double x = x2 - x1;
        double y = y2 - y1;
        return Math.hypot(x, y);
    }
}
```

`java/android/transition/PatternPathMotion.java`:

```java
package android.transition;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Matrix;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.graphics.PathMeasure;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

public class PatternPathMotion extends PathMotion
{
    private Path mOriginalPatternPath;
    private final Path mPatternPath = new Path();
    private final Matrix mTempMatrix = new Matrix();

    public PatternPathMotion()
    {
        mPatternPath.lineTo(1, 0);
        mOriginalPatternPath = mPatternPath;
    }

    public PatternPathMotion(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        String pathData = TransitionAttributes.getString(attributes, "patternPathData");
        if (pathData == null) throw new RuntimeException("pathData must be supplied for patternPathMotion");

        setPatternPath(android.util.PathParser.createPathFromPathData(pathData));
    }

    public PatternPathMotion(Path patternPath)
    {
        setPatternPath(patternPath);
    }

    public Path getPatternPath()
    {
        return mOriginalPatternPath;
    }

    public void setPatternPath(Path patternPath)
    {
        PathMeasure pathMeasure = new PathMeasure(patternPath, false);
        float length = pathMeasure.getLength();
        float[] position = new float[2];
        pathMeasure.getPosTan(length, position, null);
        float endX = position[0];
        float endY = position[1];
        pathMeasure.getPosTan(0, position, null);
        float startX = position[0];
        float startY = position[1];

        if (startX == endX && startY == endY) throw new IllegalArgumentException("pattern must not end at the starting point");

        mTempMatrix.setTranslate(-startX, -startY);
        float dx = endX - startX;
        float dy = endY - startY;
        float distance = (float)Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        float scale = 1 / distance;
        mTempMatrix.postScale(scale, scale);
        double angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
        mTempMatrix.postRotate((float)Math.toDegrees(-angle));
        patternPath.transform(mTempMatrix, mPatternPath);
        mOriginalPatternPath = patternPath;
    }

    @Override
    public Path getPath(float startX, float startY, float endX, float endY)
    {
        float dx = endX - startX;
        float dy = endY - startY;
        float length = (float)Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        double angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);

        mTempMatrix.setScale(length, length);
        mTempMatrix.postRotate((float)Math.toDegrees(angle));
        mTempMatrix.postTranslate(startX, startY);

        Path path = new Path();
        mPatternPath.transform(mTempMatrix, path);
        return path;
    }
}
```
