`java/android/transition/Scene.java`:

```java
package android.transition;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.SparseArray;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

import java.util.WeakHashMap;

public final class Scene
{
    private static final WeakHashMap<ViewGroup, Scene> sCurrentScenes = new WeakHashMap<>();
    private static final WeakHashMap<ViewGroup, SparseArray<Scene>> sLayoutScenes = new WeakHashMap<>();

    private Context mContext;
    private int mLayoutId = -1;
    private ViewGroup mSceneRoot;
    private View mLayout;
    private Runnable mEnterAction;
    private Runnable mExitAction;

    public Scene(ViewGroup sceneRoot)
    {
        mSceneRoot = sceneRoot;
    }

    private Scene(ViewGroup sceneRoot, int layoutId, Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
        mSceneRoot = sceneRoot;
        mLayoutId = layoutId;
    }

    public Scene(ViewGroup sceneRoot, View layout)
    {
        mSceneRoot = sceneRoot;
        mLayout = layout;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public Scene(ViewGroup sceneRoot, ViewGroup layout)
    {
        mSceneRoot = sceneRoot;
        mLayout = layout;
    }

    public static Scene getSceneForLayout(ViewGroup sceneRoot, int layoutId, Context context)
    {
        synchronized (sLayoutScenes)
        {
            SparseArray<Scene> scenes = sLayoutScenes.get(sceneRoot);
            if (scenes == null)
            {
                scenes = new SparseArray<>();
                sLayoutScenes.put(sceneRoot, scenes);
            }

            Scene scene = scenes.get(layoutId);
            if (scene != null) return scene;

            scene = new Scene(sceneRoot, layoutId, context);
            scenes.put(layoutId, scene);
            return scene;
        }
    }

    public ViewGroup getSceneRoot()
    {
        return mSceneRoot;
    }

    public void exit()
    {
        if (getCurrentScene(mSceneRoot) == this && mExitAction != null) mExitAction.run();
    }

    public void enter()
    {
        if (mLayoutId > 0 || mLayout != null)
        {
            getSceneRoot().removeAllViews();

            if (mLayoutId > 0) LayoutInflater.from(mContext).inflate(mLayoutId, mSceneRoot);
            else mSceneRoot.addView(mLayout);
        }

        if (mEnterAction != null) mEnterAction.run();

        setCurrentScene(mSceneRoot, this);
    }

    static void setCurrentScene(ViewGroup sceneRoot, Scene scene)
    {
        if (sceneRoot == null) return;

        synchronized (sCurrentScenes)
        {
            if (scene == null) sCurrentScenes.remove(sceneRoot);
            else sCurrentScenes.put(sceneRoot, scene);
        }
    }

    public static Scene getCurrentScene(ViewGroup sceneRoot)
    {
        if (sceneRoot == null) return null;

        synchronized (sCurrentScenes)
        {
            return sCurrentScenes.get(sceneRoot);
        }
    }

    public void setEnterAction(Runnable action)
    {
        mEnterAction = action;
    }

    public void setExitAction(Runnable action)
    {
        mExitAction = action;
    }

    boolean isCreatedFromLayoutResource()
    {
        return mLayoutId > 0;
    }
}
```

`java/android/transition/SidePropagation.java`:

```java
package android.transition;

import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

public class SidePropagation extends VisibilityPropagation
{
    private float mPropagationSpeed = 3.0f;
    private int mSide = Gravity.BOTTOM;

    public SidePropagation()
    {
    }

    public void setSide(int side)
    {
        mSide = side;
    }

    public void setPropagationSpeed(float propagationSpeed)
    {
        if (propagationSpeed == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("propagationSpeed may not be 0");

        mPropagationSpeed = propagationSpeed;
    }

    @Override
    public long getStartDelay(ViewGroup sceneRoot, Transition transition, TransitionValues startValues, TransitionValues endValues)
    {
        if (startValues == null && endValues == null) return 0;

        int directionMultiplier = 1;
        Rect epicenter = transition.getEpicenter();
        TransitionValues positionValues;

        if (endValues == null || getViewVisibility(startValues) == View.VISIBLE)
        {
            positionValues = startValues;
            directionMultiplier = -1;
        }
        else
        {
            positionValues = endValues;
        }

        int viewCenterX = getViewX(positionValues);
        int viewCenterY = getViewY(positionValues);

        int[] location = new int[2];
        sceneRoot.getLocationOnScreen(location);
        int left = location[0] + Math.round(sceneRoot.getTranslationX());
        int top = location[1] + Math.round(sceneRoot.getTranslationY());
        int right = left + sceneRoot.getWidth();
        int bottom = top + sceneRoot.getHeight();

        int epicenterX;
        int epicenterY;

        if (epicenter != null)
        {
            epicenterX = epicenter.centerX();
            epicenterY = epicenter.centerY();
        }
        else
        {
            epicenterX = (left + right) / 2;
            epicenterY = (top + bottom) / 2;
        }

        float distance = distance(sceneRoot, viewCenterX, viewCenterY, epicenterX, epicenterY, left, top, right, bottom);
        float maxDistance = getMaxDistance(sceneRoot);
        float distanceFraction = maxDistance == 0 ? 0 : distance / maxDistance;

        long duration = transition.getDuration();
        if (duration < 0) duration = 300;

        return Math.round(duration * directionMultiplier / mPropagationSpeed * distanceFraction);
    }

    private int distance(View sceneRoot, int viewX, int viewY, int epicenterX, int epicenterY, int left, int top, int right,
                         int bottom)
    {
        int side;

        if (mSide == Gravity.START)
        {
            boolean isRtl = sceneRoot.getLayoutDirection() == View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL;
            side = isRtl ? Gravity.RIGHT : Gravity.LEFT;
        }
        else if (mSide == Gravity.END)
        {
            boolean isRtl = sceneRoot.getLayoutDirection() == View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL;
            side = isRtl ? Gravity.LEFT : Gravity.RIGHT;
        }
        else
        {
            side = mSide;
        }

        switch (side)
        {
            case Gravity.LEFT: return right - viewX + Math.abs(epicenterY - viewY);
            case Gravity.TOP: return bottom - viewY + Math.abs(epicenterX - viewX);
            case Gravity.RIGHT: return viewX - left + Math.abs(epicenterY - viewY);
            case Gravity.BOTTOM: return viewY - top + Math.abs(epicenterX - viewX);
            default: return 0;
        }
    }

    private int getMaxDistance(ViewGroup sceneRoot)
    {
        switch (mSide)
        {
            case Gravity.LEFT:
            case Gravity.RIGHT:
            case Gravity.START:
            case Gravity.END:
                return sceneRoot.getWidth();
            default:
                return sceneRoot.getHeight();
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/transition/Slide.java`:

```java
package android.transition;

import android.animation.Animator;
import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

public class Slide extends Visibility
{
    private static final String PROPNAME_SCREEN_POSITION = "android:slide:screenPosition";

    private int mSlideEdge = Gravity.BOTTOM;

    public Slide()
    {
        setSlideEdge(Gravity.BOTTOM);
    }

    public Slide(int slideEdge)
    {
        setSlideEdge(slideEdge);
    }

    public Slide(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        setSlideEdge(TransitionAttributes.getInt(attributes, "slideEdge", Gravity.BOTTOM));
    }

    private void captureValues(TransitionValues transitionValues)
    {
        View view = transitionValues.view;
        if (view == null) return;

        int[] position = new int[2];
        view.getLocationOnScreen(position);
        transitionValues.values.put(PROPNAME_SCREEN_POSITION, position);
    }

    @Override
    public void captureStartValues(TransitionValues transitionValues)
    {
        super.captureStartValues(transitionValues);
        captureValues(transitionValues);
    }

    @Override
    public void captureEndValues(TransitionValues transitionValues)
    {
        super.captureEndValues(transitionValues);
        captureValues(transitionValues);
    }

    public void setSlideEdge(int slideEdge)
    {
        switch (slideEdge)
        {
            case Gravity.LEFT:
            case Gravity.TOP:
            case Gravity.RIGHT:
            case Gravity.BOTTOM:
            case Gravity.START:
            case Gravity.END:
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid slide direction");
        }

        mSlideEdge = slideEdge;

        SidePropagation propagation = new SidePropagation();
        propagation.setSide(slideEdge);
        setPropagation(propagation);
    }

    public int getSlideEdge()
    {
        return mSlideEdge;
    }

    @Override
    public Animator onAppear(ViewGroup sceneRoot, View view, TransitionValues startValues, TransitionValues endValues)
    {
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public Animator onDisappear(ViewGroup sceneRoot, View view, TransitionValues startValues, TransitionValues endValues)
    {
        return null;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.transition;

import android.animation.Animator;
import android.animation.TimeInterpolator;
import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public abstract class Transition implements Cloneable
{
    public static final int MATCH_INSTANCE = 0x1;
    public static final int MATCH_NAME = 0x2;
    public static final int MATCH_ID = 0x3;
    public static final int MATCH_ITEM_ID = 0x4;

    private static final int MATCH_FIRST = MATCH_INSTANCE;
    private static final int MATCH_LAST = MATCH_ITEM_ID;
    private static final int[] DEFAULT_MATCH_ORDER = { MATCH_NAME, MATCH_INSTANCE, MATCH_ID, MATCH_ITEM_ID };

    private static final PathMotion STRAIGHT_PATH_MOTION = new PathMotion()
    {
        @Override
        public Path getPath(float startX, float startY, float endX, float endY)
        {
            Path path = new Path();
            path.moveTo(startX, startY);
            path.lineTo(endX, endY);
            return path;
        }
    };

    private long mStartDelay = -1;
    private long mDuration = -1;
    private TimeInterpolator mInterpolator;
    private int[] mMatchOrder = DEFAULT_MATCH_ORDER;
    private ArrayList<Integer> mTargetIds = new ArrayList<>();
    private ArrayList<View> mTargets = new ArrayList<>();
    private ArrayList<String> mTargetNames;
    private ArrayList<Class> mTargetTypes;
    private ArrayList<Integer> mTargetIdExcludes;
    private ArrayList<View> mTargetExcludes;
    private ArrayList<Class> mTargetTypeExcludes;
    private ArrayList<String> mTargetNameExcludes;
    private ArrayList<Integer> mTargetIdChildExcludes;
    private ArrayList<View> mTargetChildExcludes;
    private ArrayList<Class> mTargetTypeChildExcludes;
    private ArrayList<TransitionListener> mListeners;
    private EpicenterCallback mEpicenterCallback;
    private PathMotion mPathMotion = STRAIGHT_PATH_MOTION;
    private TransitionPropagation mPropagation;
    private String mName = getClass().getName();

    public Transition()
    {
    }

    public Transition(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        int duration = TransitionAttributes.getInt(attributes, "duration", -1);
        if (duration >= 0) setDuration(duration);

        int startDelay = TransitionAttributes.getInt(attributes, "startDelay", -1);
        if (startDelay > 0) setStartDelay(startDelay);

        int interpolator = TransitionAttributes.getResource(attributes, "interpolator", 0);
        if (interpolator != 0 && context != null)
        {
            try
            {
                setInterpolator(android.view.animation.AnimationUtils.loadInterpolator(context, interpolator));
            }
            catch (RuntimeException exception)
            {
            }
        }

        String matchOrder = TransitionAttributes.getString(attributes, "matchOrder");
        if (matchOrder != null) setMatchOrder(parseMatchOrder(matchOrder));
    }

    private static int[] parseMatchOrder(String order)
    {
        String[] parts = order.split(",");
        int[] matches = new int[parts.length];
        int count = 0;

        for (String part : parts)
        {
            String token = part.trim();

            if ("id".equalsIgnoreCase(token)) matches[count++] = MATCH_ID;
            else if ("instance".equalsIgnoreCase(token)) matches[count++] = MATCH_INSTANCE;
            else if ("name".equalsIgnoreCase(token)) matches[count++] = MATCH_NAME;
            else if ("itemId".equalsIgnoreCase(token)) matches[count++] = MATCH_ITEM_ID;
            else if (!token.isEmpty()) throw new android.view.InflateException("Unknown match type in matchOrder: '" + token + "'");
        }

        return java.util.Arrays.copyOf(matches, count);
    }

    public Transition setDuration(long duration)
    {
        mDuration = duration;
        return this;
    }

    public long getDuration()
    {
        return mDuration;
    }

    public Transition setStartDelay(long startDelay)
    {
        mStartDelay = startDelay;
        return this;
    }

    public long getStartDelay()
    {
        return mStartDelay;
    }

    public Transition setInterpolator(TimeInterpolator interpolator)
    {
        mInterpolator = interpolator;
        return this;
    }

    public TimeInterpolator getInterpolator()
    {
        return mInterpolator;
    }

    public String[] getTransitionProperties()
    {
        return null;
    }

    public Animator createAnimator(ViewGroup sceneRoot, TransitionValues startValues, TransitionValues endValues)
    {
        return null;
    }

    public void setMatchOrder(int... matches)
    {
        if (matches == null || matches.length == 0)
        {
            mMatchOrder = DEFAULT_MATCH_ORDER;
            return;
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < matches.length; index++)
        {
            int match = matches[index];
            if (match < MATCH_FIRST || match > MATCH_LAST) throw new IllegalArgumentException("matches contains invalid value");

            for (int previous = 0; previous < index; previous++)
            {
                if (matches[previous] == match) throw new IllegalArgumentException("matches contains a duplicate value");
            }
        }

        mMatchOrder = matches.clone();
    }

    public abstract void captureStartValues(TransitionValues transitionValues);

    public abstract void captureEndValues(TransitionValues transitionValues);

    public Transition addTarget(int targetId)
    {
        if (targetId > 0) mTargetIds.add(targetId);
        return this;
    }

    public Transition addTarget(String targetName)
    {
        if (targetName == null) return this;
        if (mTargetNames == null) mTargetNames = new ArrayList<>();

        mTargetNames.add(targetName);
        return this;
    }

    public Transition addTarget(Class targetType)
    {
        if (targetType == null) return this;
        if (mTargetTypes == null) mTargetTypes = new ArrayList<>();

        mTargetTypes.add(targetType);
        return this;
    }

    public Transition addTarget(View target)
    {
        mTargets.add(target);
        return this;
    }

    public Transition removeTarget(int targetId)
    {
        if (targetId > 0) mTargetIds.remove((Integer)targetId);
        return this;
    }

    public Transition removeTarget(String targetName)
    {
        if (targetName != null && mTargetNames != null) mTargetNames.remove(targetName);
        return this;
    }

    public Transition removeTarget(View target)
    {
        if (target != null) mTargets.remove(target);
        return this;
    }

    public Transition removeTarget(Class target)
    {
        if (target != null && mTargetTypes != null) mTargetTypes.remove(target);
        return this;
    }

    private static <T> ArrayList<T> excludeObject(ArrayList<T> list, T target, boolean exclude)
    {
        if (target == null) return list;

        if (exclude)
        {
            if (list == null) list = new ArrayList<>();
            if (!list.contains(target)) list.add(target);
            return list;
        }

        if (list != null)
        {
            list.remove(target);
            if (list.isEmpty()) list = null;
        }

        return list;
    }

    public Transition excludeTarget(int targetId, boolean exclude)
    {
        if (targetId >= 0) mTargetIdExcludes = excludeObject(mTargetIdExcludes, targetId, exclude);
        return this;
    }

    public Transition excludeTarget(String targetName, boolean exclude)
    {
        mTargetNameExcludes = excludeObject(mTargetNameExcludes, targetName, exclude);
        return this;
    }

    public Transition excludeChildren(int targetId, boolean exclude)
    {
        if (targetId >= 0) mTargetIdChildExcludes = excludeObject(mTargetIdChildExcludes, targetId, exclude);
        return this;
    }

    public Transition excludeTarget(View target, boolean exclude)
    {
        mTargetExcludes = excludeObject(mTargetExcludes, target, exclude);
        return this;
    }

    public Transition excludeChildren(View target, boolean exclude)
    {
        mTargetChildExcludes = excludeObject(mTargetChildExcludes, target, exclude);
        return this;
    }

    public Transition excludeTarget(Class type, boolean exclude)
    {
        mTargetTypeExcludes = excludeObject(mTargetTypeExcludes, type, exclude);
        return this;
    }

    public Transition excludeChildren(Class type, boolean exclude)
    {
        mTargetTypeChildExcludes = excludeObject(mTargetTypeChildExcludes, type, exclude);
        return this;
    }

    public List<Integer> getTargetIds()
    {
        return mTargetIds;
    }

    public List<View> getTargets()
    {
        return mTargets;
    }

    public List<String> getTargetNames()
    {
        return mTargetNames;
    }

    public List<Class> getTargetTypes()
    {
        return mTargetTypes;
    }

    public TransitionValues getTransitionValues(View view, boolean start)
    {
        return null;
    }

    public boolean isTransitionRequired(TransitionValues startValues, TransitionValues endValues)
    {
        if (startValues == null || endValues == null) return false;

        String[] properties = getTransitionProperties();
        if (properties != null)
        {
            for (String property : properties)
            {
                if (isValueChanged(startValues, endValues, property)) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        for (String key : startValues.values.keySet())
        {
            if (isValueChanged(startValues, endValues, key)) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private static boolean isValueChanged(TransitionValues oldValues, TransitionValues newValues, String key)
    {
        Object oldValue = oldValues.values.get(key);
        Object newValue = newValues.values.get(key);

        if (oldValue == null && newValue == null) return false;
        if (oldValue == null || newValue == null) return true;

        return !oldValue.equals(newValue);
    }

    public Transition addListener(TransitionListener listener)
    {
        if (mListeners == null) mListeners = new ArrayList<>();

        mListeners.add(listener);
        return this;
    }

    public Transition removeListener(TransitionListener listener)
    {
        if (mListeners == null) return this;

        mListeners.remove(listener);
        if (mListeners.isEmpty()) mListeners = null;
        return this;
    }

    public void setEpicenterCallback(EpicenterCallback epicenterCallback)
    {
        mEpicenterCallback = epicenterCallback;
    }

    public EpicenterCallback getEpicenterCallback()
    {
        return mEpicenterCallback;
    }

    public Rect getEpicenter()
    {
        if (mEpicenterCallback == null) return null;

        return mEpicenterCallback.onGetEpicenter(this);
    }

    public void setPathMotion(PathMotion pathMotion)
    {
        mPathMotion = pathMotion == null ? STRAIGHT_PATH_MOTION : pathMotion;
    }

    public PathMotion getPathMotion()
    {
        return mPathMotion;
    }

    public void setPropagation(TransitionPropagation transitionPropagation)
    {
        mPropagation = transitionPropagation;
    }

    public TransitionPropagation getPropagation()
    {
        return mPropagation;
    }

    public boolean canRemoveViews()
    {
        return false;
    }

    void dispatchStart()
    {
        if (mListeners == null) return;

        ArrayList<TransitionListener> listeners = new ArrayList<>(mListeners);
        for (TransitionListener listener : listeners)
        {
            if (listener != null) listener.onTransitionStart(this);
        }
    }

    void dispatchEnd()
    {
        if (mListeners == null) return;

        ArrayList<TransitionListener> listeners = new ArrayList<>(mListeners);
        for (TransitionListener listener : listeners)
        {
            if (listener != null) listener.onTransitionEnd(this);
        }
    }

    void dispatchCancel()
    {
        if (mListeners == null) return;

        ArrayList<TransitionListener> listeners = new ArrayList<>(mListeners);
        for (TransitionListener listener : listeners)
        {
            if (listener != null) listener.onTransitionCancel(this);
        }
    }

    void playStart()
    {
        dispatchStart();
    }

    void playEnd()
    {
        dispatchEnd();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return toString("");
    }

    String toString(String indent)
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(indent);
        builder.append(getClass().getSimpleName()).append("@").append(Integer.toHexString(hashCode())).append(": ");

        if (mDuration != -1) builder.append("dur(").append(mDuration).append(") ");
        if (mStartDelay != -1) builder.append("dly(").append(mStartDelay).append(") ");
        if (mInterpolator != null) builder.append("interp(").append(mInterpolator).append(") ");

        if (!mTargetIds.isEmpty() || !mTargets.isEmpty())
        {
            builder.append("tgts(");
            builder.append(mTargetIds);
            builder.append(mTargets);
            builder.append(")");
        }

        return builder.toString();
    }

    @Override
    public Transition clone()
    {
        try
        {
            Transition clone = (Transition)super.clone();
            clone.mTargetIds = new ArrayList<>(mTargetIds);
            clone.mTargets = new ArrayList<>(mTargets);
            if (mTargetNames != null) clone.mTargetNames = new ArrayList<>(mTargetNames);
            if (mTargetTypes != null) clone.mTargetTypes = new ArrayList<>(mTargetTypes);
            if (mListeners != null) clone.mListeners = new ArrayList<>(mListeners);
            return clone;
        }
        catch (CloneNotSupportedException exception)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public String getName()
    {
        return mName;
    }

    public interface TransitionListener
    {
        void onTransitionStart(Transition transition);

        void onTransitionEnd(Transition transition);

        void onTransitionCancel(Transition transition);

        void onTransitionPause(Transition transition);

        void onTransitionResume(Transition transition);
    }

    public static abstract class EpicenterCallback
    {
        public EpicenterCallback()
        {
        }

        public abstract Rect onGetEpicenter(Transition transition);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.transition;

import android.util.AttributeSet;

final class TransitionAttributes
{
    static final String ANDROID_NAMESPACE = "http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android";

    private TransitionAttributes()
    {
    }

    static int getInt(AttributeSet attributes, String name, int defaultValue)
    {
        if (attributes == null) return defaultValue;

        try
        {
            return attributes.getAttributeIntValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name, defaultValue);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception)
        {
            return defaultValue;
        }
    }

    static float getFloat(AttributeSet attributes, String name, float defaultValue)
    {
        if (attributes == null) return defaultValue;

        try
        {
            return attributes.getAttributeFloatValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name, defaultValue);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception)
        {
            return defaultValue;
        }
    }

    static boolean getBoolean(AttributeSet attributes, String name, boolean defaultValue)
    {
        if (attributes == null) return defaultValue;

        try
        {
            return attributes.getAttributeBooleanValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name, defaultValue);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception)
        {
            return defaultValue;
        }
    }

    static int getResource(AttributeSet attributes, String name, int defaultValue)
    {
        if (attributes == null) return defaultValue;

        try
        {
            return attributes.getAttributeResourceValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name, defaultValue);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception)
        {
            return defaultValue;
        }
    }

    static String getString(AttributeSet attributes, String name)
    {
        if (attributes == null) return null;

        try
        {
            return attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/transition/TransitionInflater.java`:

```java
package android.transition;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.XmlResourceParser;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.InflateException;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;
import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.lang.reflect.Constructor;
import java.util.HashMap;

public class TransitionInflater
{
    private static final Class<?>[] CONSTRUCTOR_SIGNATURE = { Context.class, AttributeSet.class };
    private static final HashMap<String, Constructor> sConstructors = new HashMap<>();

    private final Context mContext;

    private TransitionInflater(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public static TransitionInflater from(Context context)
    {
        return new TransitionInflater(context);
    }

    public Transition inflateTransition(int resource)
    {
        XmlResourceParser parser = mContext.getResources().getXml(resource);

        try
        {
            return createTransitionFromXml(parser, parser, null);
        }
        catch (XmlPullParserException exception)
        {
            throw new InflateException(exception.getMessage(), exception);
        }
        catch (IOException exception)
        {
            throw new InflateException(parser.getPositionDescription() + ": " + exception.getMessage(), exception);
        }
        finally
        {
            parser.close();
        }
    }

    public TransitionManager inflateTransitionManager(int resource, ViewGroup sceneRoot)
    {
        XmlResourceParser parser = mContext.getResources().getXml(resource);

        try
        {
            return createTransitionManagerFromXml(parser, parser, sceneRoot);
        }
        catch (XmlPullParserException exception)
        {
            throw new InflateException(exception.getMessage(), exception);
        }
        catch (IOException exception)
        {
            throw new InflateException(parser.getPositionDescription() + ": " + exception.getMessage(), exception);
        }
        finally
        {
            parser.close();
        }
    }

    private Transition createTransitionFromXml(XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Transition parent)
        throws XmlPullParserException, IOException
    {
        Transition transition = null;

        int type;
        int depth = parser.getDepth();

        TransitionSet transitionSet = parent instanceof TransitionSet ? (TransitionSet)parent : null;

        while (((type = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_TAG || parser.getDepth() > depth) && type != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (type != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            String name = parser.getName();

            if ("fade".equals(name)) transition = new Fade(mContext, attributes);
            else if ("changeBounds".equals(name)) transition = new ChangeBounds(mContext, attributes);
            else if ("slide".equals(name)) transition = new Slide(mContext, attributes);
            else if ("explode".equals(name)) transition = new Explode(mContext, attributes);
            else if ("changeImageTransform".equals(name)) transition = new ChangeImageTransform(mContext, attributes);
            else if ("changeTransform".equals(name)) transition = new ChangeTransform(mContext, attributes);
            else if ("changeClipBounds".equals(name)) transition = new ChangeClipBounds(mContext, attributes);
            else if ("autoTransition".equals(name)) transition = new AutoTransition(mContext, attributes);
            else if ("recolor".equals(name)) transition = new ChangeBounds(mContext, attributes);
            else if ("changeScroll".equals(name)) transition = new ChangeScroll(mContext, attributes);
            else if ("transitionSet".equals(name)) transition = new TransitionSet(mContext, attributes);
            else if ("transition".equals(name)) transition = (Transition)createCustom(attributes, Transition.class, "transition");
            else if ("targets".equals(name)) getTargetIds(parser, attributes, parent);
            else if ("arcMotion".equals(name)) setPathMotion(parent, new ArcMotion(mContext, attributes));
            else if ("pathMotion".equals(name)) setPathMotion(parent, (PathMotion)createCustom(attributes, PathMotion.class, "pathMotion"));
            else if ("patternPathMotion".equals(name)) setPathMotion(parent, new PatternPathMotion(mContext, attributes));
            else throw new RuntimeException("Unknown scene name: " + parser.getName());

            if (transition == null) continue;

            createTransitionFromXml(parser, attributes, transition);

            if (transitionSet != null)
            {
                transitionSet.addTransition(transition);
                transition = null;
            }
            else if (parent != null)
            {
                throw new InflateException("Could not add transition to another transition.");
            }
        }

        return transition;
    }

    private static void setPathMotion(Transition parent, PathMotion pathMotion)
    {
        if (parent == null) throw new RuntimeException("Invalid use of pathMotion element");

        parent.setPathMotion(pathMotion);
    }

    private Object createCustom(AttributeSet attributes, Class expectedType, String tag)
    {
        String className = attributes.getAttributeValue(null, "class");
        if (className == null) throw new InflateException(tag + " tag must have a 'class' attribute");

        try
        {
            synchronized (sConstructors)
            {
                Constructor constructor = sConstructors.get(className);
                if (constructor == null)
                {
                    Class<?> type = mContext.getClassLoader().loadClass(className).asSubclass(expectedType);
                    constructor = type.getConstructor(CONSTRUCTOR_SIGNATURE);
                    constructor.setAccessible(true);
                    sConstructors.put(className, constructor);
                }

                return constructor.newInstance(mContext, attributes);
            }
        }
        catch (ReflectiveOperationException | ClassCastException exception)
        {
            throw new InflateException("Could not instantiate " + expectedType + " class " + className, exception);
        }
    }

    private void getTargetIds(XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Transition transition)
        throws XmlPullParserException, IOException
    {
        int type;
        int depth = parser.getDepth();

        while (((type = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_TAG || parser.getDepth() > depth) && type != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (type != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            String name = parser.getName();
            if (!"target".equals(name)) throw new RuntimeException("Unknown scene name: " + parser.getName());
            if (transition == null) continue;

            int id = TransitionAttributes.getResource(attributes, "targetId", 0);
            String targetName;
            String className;

            if (id != 0)
            {
                transition.addTarget(id);
            }
            else if ((id = TransitionAttributes.getResource(attributes, "excludeId", 0)) != 0)
            {
                transition.excludeTarget(id, true);
            }
            else if ((targetName = TransitionAttributes.getString(attributes, "targetName")) != null)
            {
                transition.addTarget(targetName);
            }
            else if ((targetName = TransitionAttributes.getString(attributes, "excludeName")) != null)
            {
                transition.excludeTarget(targetName, true);
            }
            else if ((className = TransitionAttributes.getString(attributes, "excludeClass")) != null)
            {
                transition.excludeTarget(loadClass(className), true);
            }
            else if ((className = TransitionAttributes.getString(attributes, "targetClass")) != null)
            {
                transition.addTarget(loadClass(className));
            }
        }
    }

    private Class loadClass(String className)
    {
        try
        {
            return mContext.getClassLoader().loadClass(className.trim());
        }
        catch (ClassNotFoundException exception)
        {
            throw new RuntimeException("Could not create " + className, exception);
        }
    }

    private TransitionManager createTransitionManagerFromXml(XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, ViewGroup sceneRoot)
        throws XmlPullParserException, IOException
    {
        int type;
        int depth = parser.getDepth();
        TransitionManager transitionManager = null;

        while (((type = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_TAG || parser.getDepth() > depth) && type != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (type != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            String name = parser.getName();

            if ("transitionManager".equals(name))
            {
                transitionManager = new TransitionManager();
            }
            else if ("transition".equals(name) && transitionManager != null)
            {
                loadTransition(attributes, sceneRoot, transitionManager);
            }
            else
            {
                throw new RuntimeException("Unknown scene name: " + parser.getName());
            }
        }

        return transitionManager;
    }

    private void loadTransition(AttributeSet attributes, ViewGroup sceneRoot, TransitionManager transitionManager)
    {
        int transitionId = TransitionAttributes.getResource(attributes, "transition", -1);
        int fromId = TransitionAttributes.getResource(attributes, "fromScene", -1);
        int toId = TransitionAttributes.getResource(attributes, "toScene", -1);

        Scene fromScene = fromId < 0 ? null : Scene.getSceneForLayout(sceneRoot, fromId, mContext);
        Scene toScene = toId < 0 ? null : Scene.getSceneForLayout(sceneRoot, toId, mContext);

        if (transitionId < 0) return;

        Transition transition = inflateTransition(transitionId);
        if (transition == null) return;

        if (toScene == null) throw new RuntimeException("No toScene for transition ID " + transitionId);

        if (fromScene == null) transitionManager.setTransition(toScene, transition);
        else transitionManager.setTransition(fromScene, toScene, transition);
    }
}
```

`java/android/transition/TransitionManager.java`:

```java
package android.transition;

import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;

public class TransitionManager
{
    private static final Transition sDefaultTransition = new AutoTransition();
    private static final ArrayList<ViewGroup> sPendingTransitions = new ArrayList<>();
    private static Handler sHandler;

    private final HashMap<Scene, Transition> mSceneTransitions = new HashMap<>();
    private final HashMap<Scene, HashMap<Scene, Transition>> mScenePairTransitions = new HashMap<>();

    public TransitionManager()
    {
    }

    public void setTransition(Scene scene, Transition transition)
    {
        mSceneTransitions.put(scene, transition);
    }

    public void setTransition(Scene fromScene, Scene toScene, Transition transition)
    {
        HashMap<Scene, Transition> sceneTransitionMap = mScenePairTransitions.get(toScene);
        if (sceneTransitionMap == null)
        {
            sceneTransitionMap = new HashMap<>();
            mScenePairTransitions.put(toScene, sceneTransitionMap);
        }

        sceneTransitionMap.put(fromScene, transition);
    }

    private Transition getTransition(Scene scene)
    {
        ViewGroup sceneRoot = scene.getSceneRoot();

        if (sceneRoot != null)
        {
            Scene currentScene = Scene.getCurrentScene(sceneRoot);
            if (currentScene != null)
            {
                HashMap<Scene, Transition> sceneTransitionMap = mScenePairTransitions.get(scene);
                if (sceneTransitionMap != null)
                {
                    Transition transition = sceneTransitionMap.get(currentScene);
                    if (transition != null) return transition;
                }
            }
        }

        Transition transition = mSceneTransitions.get(scene);
        return transition != null ? transition : sDefaultTransition;
    }

    public void transitionTo(Scene scene)
    {
        changeScene(scene, getTransition(scene));
    }

    public static void go(Scene scene)
    {
        changeScene(scene, sDefaultTransition);
    }

    public static void go(Scene scene, Transition transition)
    {
        changeScene(scene, transition);
    }

    private static void changeScene(Scene scene, Transition transition)
    {
        if (scene == null) return;

        ViewGroup sceneRoot = scene.getSceneRoot();
        if (sceneRoot != null && sPendingTransitions.contains(sceneRoot)) return;

        Transition transitionClone = transition == null ? null : transition.clone();

        Scene previousScene = Scene.getCurrentScene(sceneRoot);
        if (previousScene != null) previousScene.exit();

        if (transitionClone != null) transitionClone.playStart();

        scene.enter();

        if (transitionClone != null) finishLater(sceneRoot, transitionClone);
    }

    public static void beginDelayedTransition(ViewGroup sceneRoot)
    {
        beginDelayedTransition(sceneRoot, null);
    }

    public static void beginDelayedTransition(ViewGroup sceneRoot, Transition transition)
    {
        if (sceneRoot == null || sPendingTransitions.contains(sceneRoot)) return;

        sPendingTransitions.add(sceneRoot);

        if (transition == null) transition = sDefaultTransition;
        Transition transitionClone = transition.clone();

        Scene.setCurrentScene(sceneRoot, null);
        transitionClone.playStart();
        finishLater(sceneRoot, transitionClone);
    }

    private static void finishLater(final ViewGroup sceneRoot, final Transition transition)
    {
        Runnable finish = new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                if (sceneRoot != null) sPendingTransitions.remove(sceneRoot);

                transition.playEnd();
            }
        };

        if (sceneRoot != null && sceneRoot.post(finish)) return;

        Looper looper = Looper.getMainLooper();
        if (looper == null)
        {
            finish.run();
            return;
        }

        if (sHandler == null) sHandler = new Handler(looper);
        sHandler.post(finish);
    }

    public static void endTransitions(ViewGroup sceneRoot)
    {
        if (sceneRoot == null) return;

        sPendingTransitions.remove(sceneRoot);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.transition;

import android.animation.TimeInterpolator;
import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.View;

import java.util.ArrayList;

public class TransitionSet extends Transition
{
    public static final int ORDERING_TOGETHER = 0;
    public static final int ORDERING_SEQUENTIAL = 1;

    private ArrayList<Transition> mTransitions = new ArrayList<>();
    private boolean mPlayTogether = true;

    public TransitionSet()
    {
    }

    public TransitionSet(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        setOrdering(TransitionAttributes.getInt(attributes, "transitionOrdering", ORDERING_TOGETHER));
    }

    private ArrayList<Transition> children()
    {
        return mTransitions == null ? new ArrayList<>() : new ArrayList<>(mTransitions);
    }

    public TransitionSet setOrdering(int ordering)
    {
        switch (ordering)
        {
            case ORDERING_SEQUENTIAL: mPlayTogether = false; break;
            case ORDERING_TOGETHER: mPlayTogether = true; break;
            default: throw new android.util.AndroidRuntimeException("Invalid parameter for TransitionSet ordering: " + ordering);
        }

        return this;
    }

    public int getOrdering()
    {
        return mPlayTogether ? ORDERING_TOGETHER : ORDERING_SEQUENTIAL;
    }

    public TransitionSet addTransition(Transition transition)
    {
        if (transition == null) return this;

        mTransitions.add(transition);
        if (getDuration() >= 0) transition.setDuration(getDuration());
        if (getInterpolator() != null) transition.setInterpolator(getInterpolator());
        return this;
    }

    public int getTransitionCount()
    {
        return mTransitions.size();
    }

    public Transition getTransitionAt(int index)
    {
        if (index < 0 || index >= mTransitions.size()) return null;

        return mTransitions.get(index);
    }

    @Override
    public TransitionSet setDuration(long duration)
    {
        super.setDuration(duration);

        if (duration < 0) return this;

        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.setDuration(duration);
        }

        return this;
    }

    @Override
    public TransitionSet setStartDelay(long startDelay)
    {
        return (TransitionSet)super.setStartDelay(startDelay);
    }

    @Override
    public TransitionSet setInterpolator(TimeInterpolator interpolator)
    {
        super.setInterpolator(interpolator);

        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.setInterpolator(interpolator);
        }

        return this;
    }

    @Override
    public TransitionSet addTarget(View target)
    {
        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.addTarget(target);
        }

        return (TransitionSet)super.addTarget(target);
    }

    @Override
    public TransitionSet addTarget(int targetId)
    {
        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.addTarget(targetId);
        }

        return (TransitionSet)super.addTarget(targetId);
    }

    @Override
    public TransitionSet addTarget(String targetName)
    {
        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.addTarget(targetName);
        }

        return (TransitionSet)super.addTarget(targetName);
    }

    @Override
    public TransitionSet addTarget(Class targetType)
    {
        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.addTarget(targetType);
        }

        return (TransitionSet)super.addTarget(targetType);
    }

    @Override
    public TransitionSet addListener(TransitionListener listener)
    {
        return (TransitionSet)super.addListener(listener);
    }

    @Override
    public TransitionSet removeTarget(int targetId)
    {
        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.removeTarget(targetId);
        }

        return (TransitionSet)super.removeTarget(targetId);
    }

    @Override
    public TransitionSet removeTarget(View target)
    {
        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.removeTarget(target);
        }

        return (TransitionSet)super.removeTarget(target);
    }

    @Override
    public TransitionSet removeTarget(Class target)
    {
        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.removeTarget(target);
        }

        return (TransitionSet)super.removeTarget(target);
    }

    @Override
    public TransitionSet removeTarget(String target)
    {
        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.removeTarget(target);
        }

        return (TransitionSet)super.removeTarget(target);
    }

    @Override
    public Transition excludeTarget(View target, boolean exclude)
    {
        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.excludeTarget(target, exclude);
        }

        return super.excludeTarget(target, exclude);
    }

    @Override
    public Transition excludeTarget(String targetName, boolean exclude)
    {
        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.excludeTarget(targetName, exclude);
        }

        return super.excludeTarget(targetName, exclude);
    }

    @Override
    public Transition excludeTarget(int targetId, boolean exclude)
    {
        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.excludeTarget(targetId, exclude);
        }

        return super.excludeTarget(targetId, exclude);
    }

    @Override
    public Transition excludeTarget(Class type, boolean exclude)
    {
        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.excludeTarget(type, exclude);
        }

        return super.excludeTarget(type, exclude);
    }

    @Override
    public TransitionSet removeListener(TransitionListener listener)
    {
        return (TransitionSet)super.removeListener(listener);
    }

    @Override
    public void setPathMotion(PathMotion pathMotion)
    {
        super.setPathMotion(pathMotion);

        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.setPathMotion(pathMotion);
        }
    }

    public TransitionSet removeTransition(Transition transition)
    {
        mTransitions.remove(transition);
        return this;
    }

    @Override
    public void captureStartValues(TransitionValues transitionValues)
    {
        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.captureStartValues(transitionValues);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void captureEndValues(TransitionValues transitionValues)
    {
        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.captureEndValues(transitionValues);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setPropagation(TransitionPropagation propagation)
    {
        super.setPropagation(propagation);

        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.setPropagation(propagation);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setEpicenterCallback(EpicenterCallback epicenterCallback)
    {
        super.setEpicenterCallback(epicenterCallback);

        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.setEpicenterCallback(epicenterCallback);
        }
    }

    @Override
    void playStart()
    {
        dispatchStart();

        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.playStart();
        }
    }

    @Override
    void playEnd()
    {
        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            transition.playEnd();
        }

        dispatchEnd();
    }

    @Override
    String toString(String indent)
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(super.toString(indent));

        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            builder.append("\n").append(transition.toString(indent + "  "));
        }

        return builder.toString();
    }

    @Override
    public TransitionSet clone()
    {
        TransitionSet clone = (TransitionSet)super.clone();
        clone.mTransitions = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Transition transition : children())
        {
            clone.addTransition(transition.clone());
        }

        return clone;
    }
}
```

`java/android/transition/TransitionValues.java`:

```java
package android.transition;

import android.view.View;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class TransitionValues
{
    public final Map<String, Object> values = new HashMap<>();
    public View view;

    public TransitionValues()
    {
    }

    public TransitionValues(View view)
    {
        this.view = view;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof TransitionValues)) return false;

        TransitionValues values = (TransitionValues)other;
        return view == values.view && this.values.equals(values.values);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return 31 * (view == null ? 0 : view.hashCode()) + values.hashCode();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        builder.append("TransitionValues@").append(Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(this))).append(":\n");
        builder.append("    view = ").append(view).append("\n");
        builder.append("    values:");

        for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : values.entrySet())
        {
            builder.append("    ").append(entry.getKey()).append(": ").append(entry.getValue()).append("\n");
        }

        return builder.toString();
    }
}
```

`java/android/transition/Visibility.java`:

```java
package android.transition;

import android.animation.Animator;
import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

public abstract class Visibility extends Transition
{
    static final String PROPNAME_VISIBILITY = "android:visibility:visibility";
    private static final String PROPNAME_PARENT = "android:visibility:parent";
    private static final String PROPNAME_SCREEN_LOCATION = "android:visibility:screenLocation";

    public static final int MODE_IN = 0x1;
    public static final int MODE_OUT = 0x2;

    private static final String[] TRANSITION_PROPERTIES = { PROPNAME_VISIBILITY, PROPNAME_PARENT };

    private int mMode = MODE_IN | MODE_OUT;

    public Visibility()
    {
    }

    public Visibility(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        int mode = TransitionAttributes.getInt(attributes, "transitionVisibilityMode", 0);
        if (mode != 0) setMode(mode);
    }

    public void setMode(int mode)
    {
        if ((mode & ~(MODE_IN | MODE_OUT)) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only MODE_IN and MODE_OUT flags are allowed");

        mMode = mode;
    }

    public int getMode()
    {
        return mMode;
    }

    @Override
    public String[] getTransitionProperties()
    {
        return TRANSITION_PROPERTIES;
    }

    private void captureValues(TransitionValues transitionValues)
    {
        View view = transitionValues.view;
        if (view == null) return;

        transitionValues.values.put(PROPNAME_VISIBILITY, view.getVisibility());
        transitionValues.values.put(PROPNAME_PARENT, view.getParent());

        int[] location = new int[2];
        view.getLocationOnScreen(location);
        transitionValues.values.put(PROPNAME_SCREEN_LOCATION, location);
    }

    @Override
    public void captureStartValues(TransitionValues transitionValues)
    {
        captureValues(transitionValues);
    }

    @Override
    public void captureEndValues(TransitionValues transitionValues)
    {
        captureValues(transitionValues);
    }

    public boolean isVisible(TransitionValues values)
    {
        if (values == null) return false;

        Integer visibility = (Integer)values.values.get(PROPNAME_VISIBILITY);
        boolean parent = values.values.get(PROPNAME_PARENT) != null;

        return visibility != null && visibility == View.VISIBLE && parent;
    }

    @Override
    public Animator createAnimator(ViewGroup sceneRoot, TransitionValues startValues, TransitionValues endValues)
    {
        boolean startVisible = isVisible(startValues);
        boolean endVisible = isVisible(endValues);

        if (startVisible == endVisible) return null;

        int startVisibility = visibilityOf(startValues);
        int endVisibility = visibilityOf(endValues);

        if (endVisible) return onAppear(sceneRoot, startValues, startVisibility, endValues, endVisibility);

        return onDisappear(sceneRoot, startValues, startVisibility, endValues, endVisibility);
    }

    private static int visibilityOf(TransitionValues values)
    {
        if (values == null) return -1;

        Integer visibility = (Integer)values.values.get(PROPNAME_VISIBILITY);
        return visibility == null ? -1 : visibility;
    }

    public Animator onAppear(ViewGroup sceneRoot, TransitionValues startValues, int startVisibility, TransitionValues endValues,
                             int endVisibility)
    {
        if ((mMode & MODE_IN) != MODE_IN || endValues == null) return null;

        return onAppear(sceneRoot, endValues.view, startValues, endValues);
    }

    public Animator onAppear(ViewGroup sceneRoot, View view, TransitionValues startValues, TransitionValues endValues)
    {
        return null;
    }

    public Animator onDisappear(ViewGroup sceneRoot, TransitionValues startValues, int startVisibility, TransitionValues endValues,
                                int endVisibility)
    {
        if ((mMode & MODE_OUT) != MODE_OUT || startValues == null) return null;

        return onDisappear(sceneRoot, startValues.view, startValues, endValues);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isTransitionRequired(TransitionValues startValues, TransitionValues endValues)
    {
        if (startValues == null && endValues == null) return false;

        if (startValues != null && endValues != null)
        {
            Object startVisibility = startValues.values.get(PROPNAME_VISIBILITY);
            Object endVisibility = endValues.values.get(PROPNAME_VISIBILITY);
            if (startVisibility != null && !startVisibility.equals(endVisibility)) return true;
        }

        return isVisible(startValues) != isVisible(endValues);
    }

    public Animator onDisappear(ViewGroup sceneRoot, View view, TransitionValues startValues, TransitionValues endValues)
    {
        return null;
    }
}
```

`java/android/transition/VisibilityPropagation.java`:

```java
package android.transition;

import android.view.View;

public abstract class VisibilityPropagation extends TransitionPropagation
{
    private static final String PROPNAME_VISIBILITY = "android:visibilityPropagation:visibility";
    private static final String PROPNAME_VIEW_CENTER = "android:visibilityPropagation:center";

    private static final String[] VISIBILITY_PROPAGATION_VALUES = { PROPNAME_VISIBILITY, PROPNAME_VIEW_CENTER };

    public VisibilityPropagation()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public void captureValues(TransitionValues values)
    {
        View view = values.view;

        Integer visibility = (Integer)values.values.get(Visibility.PROPNAME_VISIBILITY);
        if (visibility == null) visibility = view.getVisibility();
        values.values.put(PROPNAME_VISIBILITY, visibility);

        int[] location = new int[2];
        view.getLocationOnScreen(location);
        location[0] += Math.round(view.getTranslationX());
        location[0] += view.getWidth() / 2;
        location[1] += Math.round(view.getTranslationY());
        location[1] += view.getHeight() / 2;
        values.values.put(PROPNAME_VIEW_CENTER, location);
    }

    @Override
    public String[] getPropagationProperties()
    {
        return VISIBILITY_PROPAGATION_VALUES;
    }

    public int getViewVisibility(TransitionValues values)
    {
        if (values == null) return View.GONE;

        Integer visibility = (Integer)values.values.get(PROPNAME_VISIBILITY);
        if (visibility == null) return View.GONE;

        return visibility;
    }

    public int getViewX(TransitionValues values)
    {
        return getViewCoordinate(values, 0);
    }

    public int getViewY(TransitionValues values)
    {
        return getViewCoordinate(values, 1);
    }

    private static int getViewCoordinate(TransitionValues values, int coordinateIndex)
    {
        if (values == null) return -1;

        int[] coordinates = (int[])values.values.get(PROPNAME_VIEW_CENTER);
        if (coordinates == null) return -1;

        return coordinates[coordinateIndex];
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/ArrayMap.java`:

```java
package android.util;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

public final class ArrayMap<K, V> implements Map<K, V>
{
    private final LinkedHashMap<K, V> mEntries;
    private final ArrayList<K> mOrder = new ArrayList<>();

    public ArrayMap()
    {
        mEntries = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    }

    public ArrayMap(int capacity)
    {
        mEntries = new LinkedHashMap<>(Math.max(1, capacity));
    }

    public ArrayMap(ArrayMap<K, V> source)
    {
        mEntries = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (source != null) putAll(source);
    }

    @Override
    public int size()
    {
        return mOrder.size();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isEmpty()
    {
        return mOrder.isEmpty();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean containsKey(Object key)
    {
        return mEntries.containsKey(key);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean containsValue(Object value)
    {
        return mEntries.containsValue(value);
    }

    @Override
    public V get(Object key)
    {
        return mEntries.get(key);
    }

    public V getOrDefault(Object key, V fallback)
    {
        V value = mEntries.get(key);

        return value == null && !mEntries.containsKey(key) ? fallback : value;
    }

    @Override
    public V put(K key, V value)
    {
        if (!mEntries.containsKey(key)) mOrder.add(key);

        return mEntries.put(key, value);
    }

    @Override
    public V remove(Object key)
    {
        if (mEntries.containsKey(key)) mOrder.remove(key);

        return mEntries.remove(key);
    }

    @Override
    public void putAll(Map<? extends K, ? extends V> source)
    {
        if (source == null) return;

        for (Map.Entry<? extends K, ? extends V> entry : source.entrySet()) put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
    }

    @Override
    public void clear()
    {
        mEntries.clear();
        mOrder.clear();
    }

    @Override
    public Set<K> keySet()
    {
        return mEntries.keySet();
    }

    @Override
    public Collection<V> values()
    {
        return mEntries.values();
    }

    @Override
    public Set<Map.Entry<K, V>> entrySet()
    {
        return mEntries.entrySet();
    }

    public K keyAt(int index)
    {
        return mOrder.get(index);
    }

    public V valueAt(int index)
    {
        return mEntries.get(mOrder.get(index));
    }

    public V setValueAt(int index, V value)
    {
        return mEntries.put(mOrder.get(index), value);
    }

    public int indexOfKey(Object key)
    {
        return mOrder.indexOf(key);
    }

    public int indexOfValue(Object value)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mOrder.size(); index++)
        {
            V candidate = mEntries.get(mOrder.get(index));

            if (candidate == null ? value == null : candidate.equals(value)) return index;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public V removeAt(int index)
    {
        K key = mOrder.remove(index);

        return mEntries.remove(key);
    }

    public void putAll(ArrayMap<? extends K, ? extends V> array)
    {
        putAll((Map<? extends K, ? extends V>)array);
    }

    public void ensureCapacity(int capacity)
    {
        mOrder.ensureCapacity(capacity);
    }

    public boolean containsAll(Collection<?> keys)
    {
        if (keys == null) return true;

        for (Object key : keys)
        {
            if (!containsKey(key)) return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public boolean removeAll(Collection<?> keys)
    {
        if (keys == null) return false;

        boolean changed = false;
        for (Object key : keys)
        {
            if (containsKey(key))
            {
                remove(key);
                changed = true;
            }
        }

        return changed;
    }

    public boolean retainAll(Collection<?> keys)
    {
        boolean changed = false;

        for (int index = mOrder.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            if (keys != null && keys.contains(mOrder.get(index))) continue;

            removeAt(index);
            changed = true;
        }

        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof Map)) return false;

        return mEntries.equals(other);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mEntries.hashCode();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mEntries.toString();
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/ArraySet.java`:

```java
package android.util;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.Set;

public final class ArraySet<E> implements Collection<E>, Set<E>
{
    private final LinkedHashSet<E> mEntries = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    private final ArrayList<E> mOrder = new ArrayList<>();

    public ArraySet()
    {
    }

    public ArraySet(int capacity)
    {
        mOrder.ensureCapacity(Math.max(1, capacity));
    }

    public ArraySet(Collection<? extends E> source)
    {
        if (source != null) addAll(source);
    }

    public ArraySet(ArraySet<E> source)
    {
        if (source != null) addAll((Collection<? extends E>)source);
    }

    public ArraySet(E[] source)
    {
        if (source == null) return;

        for (E value : source) add(value);
    }

    public void ensureCapacity(int capacity)
    {
        mOrder.ensureCapacity(capacity);
    }

    public void addAll(ArraySet<? extends E> source)
    {
        addAll((Collection<? extends E>)source);
    }

    public boolean removeAll(ArraySet<? extends E> source)
    {
        return removeAll((Collection<?>)source);
    }

    @Override
    public int size()
    {
        return mOrder.size();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isEmpty()
    {
        return mOrder.isEmpty();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean contains(Object value)
    {
        return mEntries.contains(value);
    }

    @Override
    public Iterator<E> iterator()
    {
        return new ArrayList<>(mOrder).iterator();
    }

    @Override
    public Object[] toArray()
    {
        return mOrder.toArray();
    }

    @Override
    public <T> T[] toArray(T[] into)
    {
        return mOrder.toArray(into);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean add(E value)
    {
        if (!mEntries.add(value)) return false;

        mOrder.add(value);
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean remove(Object value)
    {
        if (!mEntries.remove(value)) return false;

        mOrder.remove(value);
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean containsAll(Collection<?> values)
    {
        return values == null || mEntries.containsAll(values);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean addAll(Collection<? extends E> values)
    {
        if (values == null) return false;

        boolean changed = false;
        for (E value : values) changed |= add(value);

        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean removeAll(Collection<?> values)
    {
        if (values == null) return false;

        boolean changed = false;
        for (Object value : values) changed |= remove(value);

        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean retainAll(Collection<?> values)
    {
        boolean changed = false;

        for (int index = mOrder.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            if (values != null && values.contains(mOrder.get(index))) continue;

            removeAt(index);
            changed = true;
        }

        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    public void clear()
    {
        mEntries.clear();
        mOrder.clear();
    }

    public E valueAt(int index)
    {
        return mOrder.get(index);
    }

    public int indexOf(Object value)
    {
        return mOrder.indexOf(value);
    }

    public E removeAt(int index)
    {
        E value = mOrder.remove(index);
        mEntries.remove(value);

        return value;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof Set)) return false;

        return mEntries.equals(other);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mEntries.hashCode();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mEntries.toString();
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/AtomicFile.java`:

```java
package android.util;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileNotFoundException;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;

public class AtomicFile
{
    private static final String LOG_TAG = "AtomicFile";

    private final File mBaseName;
    private final File mNewName;
    private final File mLegacyBackupName;

    public AtomicFile(File baseName)
    {
        mBaseName = baseName;
        mNewName = new File(baseName.getPath() + ".new");
        mLegacyBackupName = new File(baseName.getPath() + ".bak");
    }

    public File getBaseFile()
    {
        return mBaseName;
    }

    public void delete()
    {
        mBaseName.delete();
        mNewName.delete();
        mLegacyBackupName.delete();
    }

    public FileOutputStream startWrite() throws IOException
    {
        if (mLegacyBackupName.exists()) rename(mLegacyBackupName, mBaseName);

        try
        {
            return new FileOutputStream(mNewName);
        }
        catch (FileNotFoundException failure)
        {
            File parent = mNewName.getParentFile();
            if (parent == null || (!parent.isDirectory() && !parent.mkdirs()))
            {
                throw new IOException("Failed to create directory for " + mNewName);
            }

            try
            {
                return new FileOutputStream(mNewName);
            }
            catch (FileNotFoundException retryFailure)
            {
                throw new IOException("Failed to create new file " + mNewName, retryFailure);
            }
        }
    }

    public void finishWrite(FileOutputStream stream)
    {
        if (stream == null) return;

        if (!sync(stream)) Log.e(LOG_TAG, "Failed to sync file output stream");

        try
        {
            stream.close();
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            Log.e(LOG_TAG, "Failed to close file output stream", failure);
        }

        rename(mNewName, mBaseName);
    }

    public void failWrite(FileOutputStream stream)
    {
        if (stream == null) return;

        if (!sync(stream)) Log.e(LOG_TAG, "Failed to sync file output stream");

        try
        {
            stream.close();
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            Log.e(LOG_TAG, "Failed to close file output stream", failure);
        }

        if (!mNewName.delete()) Log.e(LOG_TAG, "Failed to delete new file " + mNewName);
    }

    public FileInputStream openRead() throws FileNotFoundException
    {
        if (mLegacyBackupName.exists()) rename(mLegacyBackupName, mBaseName);

        if (mNewName.exists() && mBaseName.exists())
        {
            if (!mNewName.delete()) Log.e(LOG_TAG, "Failed to delete outdated new file " + mNewName);
        }

        return new FileInputStream(mBaseName);
    }

    public long getLastModifiedTime()
    {
        if (mLegacyBackupName.exists()) return mLegacyBackupName.lastModified();

        return mBaseName.lastModified();
    }

    public byte[] readFully() throws IOException
    {
        try (FileInputStream stream = openRead())
        {
            int position = 0;
            int available = stream.available();
            byte[] data = new byte[Math.max(available, 16)];

            while (true)
            {
                int amount = stream.read(data, position, data.length - position);
                if (amount <= 0)
                {
                    if (position == data.length) return data;

                    byte[] trimmed = new byte[position];
                    System.arraycopy(data, 0, trimmed, 0, position);
                    return trimmed;
                }

                position += amount;
                available = stream.available();
                if (available > data.length - position || position == data.length)
                {
                    byte[] grown = new byte[position + Math.max(available, 16)];
                    System.arraycopy(data, 0, grown, 0, position);
                    data = grown;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "AtomicFile[" + mBaseName + "]";
    }

    private static boolean sync(FileOutputStream stream)
    {
        try
        {
            stream.getFD().sync();
            return true;
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static void rename(File source, File target)
    {
        if (target.isDirectory() && !target.delete()) Log.e(LOG_TAG, "Failed to delete file which is a directory " + target);

        if (!source.renameTo(target)) Log.e(LOG_TAG, "Failed to rename " + source + " to " + target);
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/Base64.java`:

```java
package android.util;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

public final class Base64
{
    public static final int DEFAULT = 0;
    public static final int NO_PADDING = 1;
    public static final int NO_WRAP = 2;
    public static final int CRLF = 4;
    public static final int URL_SAFE = 8;
    public static final int NO_CLOSE = 16;

    private static final int WRAP_COLUMNS = 76;

    private Base64()
    {
    }

    public static byte[] encode(byte[] input, int flags)
    {
        return input == null ? null : encode(input, 0, input.length, flags);
    }

    public static byte[] encode(byte[] input, int offset, int length, int flags)
    {
        String encoded = encodeToString(input, offset, length, flags);

        return encoded == null ? null : encoded.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
    }

    public static String encodeToString(byte[] input, int flags)
    {
        return input == null ? null : encodeToString(input, 0, input.length, flags);
    }

    public static String encodeToString(byte[] input, int offset, int length, int flags)
    {
        if (input == null) return null;

        byte[] slice = new byte[length];
        System.arraycopy(input, offset, slice, 0, length);

        java.util.Base64.Encoder encoder = (flags & URL_SAFE) != 0 ? java.util.Base64.getUrlEncoder() : java.util.Base64.getEncoder();

        if ((flags & NO_PADDING) != 0) encoder = encoder.withoutPadding();

        String encoded = encoder.encodeToString(slice);

        if ((flags & NO_WRAP) != 0) return encoded;

        String separator = (flags & CRLF) != 0 ? "\r\n" : "\n";
        StringBuilder wrapped = new StringBuilder(encoded.length() + encoded.length() / WRAP_COLUMNS * 2 + 2);

        for (int at = 0; at < encoded.length(); at += WRAP_COLUMNS)
        {
            wrapped.append(encoded, at, Math.min(at + WRAP_COLUMNS, encoded.length()));
            wrapped.append(separator);
        }

        if (encoded.isEmpty()) wrapped.append(separator);

        return wrapped.toString();
    }

    public static byte[] decode(String input, int flags)
    {
        return input == null ? null : decode(input.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII), flags);
    }

    public static byte[] decode(byte[] input, int flags)
    {
        return input == null ? null : decode(input, 0, input.length, flags);
    }

    public static byte[] decode(byte[] input, int offset, int length, int flags)
    {
        if (input == null) return null;

        StringBuilder cleaned = new StringBuilder(length);

        for (int at = offset; at < offset + length; at++)
        {
            char character = (char)(input[at] & 0xff);

            if (character == '-') character = '+';
            else if (character == '_') character = '/';

            if (character == '+' || character == '/' || character == '=' || Character.isLetterOrDigit(character))
            {
                cleaned.append(character);
            }
        }

        return java.util.Base64.getMimeDecoder().decode(cleaned.toString());
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/Base64InputStream.java`:

```java
package android.util;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.FilterInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;

public class Base64InputStream extends FilterInputStream
{
    private final int mFlags;
    private final boolean mEncode;

    private byte[] mOutput;
    private int mOutputStart;

    public Base64InputStream(InputStream in, int flags)
    {
        this(in, flags, false);
    }

    public Base64InputStream(InputStream in, int flags, boolean encode)
    {
        super(in);
        mFlags = flags;
        mEncode = encode;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean markSupported()
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public void mark(int readLimit)
    {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset()
    {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
    }

    @Override
    public void close() throws IOException
    {
        in.close();
        mOutput = new byte[0];
        mOutputStart = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public int available()
    {
        return mOutput == null ? 0 : mOutput.length - mOutputStart;
    }

    @Override
    public long skip(long count) throws IOException
    {
        fill();

        long skipped = Math.max(0, Math.min(count, mOutput.length - mOutputStart));
        mOutputStart += (int)skipped;
        return skipped;
    }

    @Override
    public int read() throws IOException
    {
        fill();

        if (mOutputStart >= mOutput.length) return -1;
        return mOutput[mOutputStart++] & 0xff;
    }

    @Override
    public int read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int length) throws IOException
    {
        fill();

        if (mOutputStart >= mOutput.length) return -1;

        int count = Math.min(length, mOutput.length - mOutputStart);
        System.arraycopy(mOutput, mOutputStart, buffer, offset, count);
        mOutputStart += count;
        return count;
    }

    private void fill() throws IOException
    {
        if (mOutput != null) return;

        ByteArrayOutputStream collected = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] chunk = new byte[2048];
        int count;
        while ((count = in.read(chunk)) != -1)
        {
            collected.write(chunk, 0, count);
        }

        byte[] input = collected.toByteArray();
        try
        {
            mOutput = mEncode ? Base64.encode(input, mFlags) : Base64.decode(input, mFlags);
        }
        catch (IllegalArgumentException failure)
        {
            throw new IOException("bad base-64", failure);
        }
        mOutputStart = 0;
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/Base64OutputStream.java`:

```java
package android.util;

import java.io.FilterOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;

public class Base64OutputStream extends FilterOutputStream
{
    private final int mFlags;
    private final java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream mPending = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();

    private boolean mClosed;

    public Base64OutputStream(OutputStream out, int flags)
    {
        super(out);
        mFlags = flags;
    }

    @Override
    public void write(int oneByte) throws IOException
    {
        mPending.write(oneByte);
    }

    @Override
    public void write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int length) throws IOException
    {
        mPending.write(buffer, offset, length);
    }

    @Override
    public void flush() throws IOException
    {
        out.flush();
    }

    @Override
    public void close() throws IOException
    {
        if (mClosed) return;

        mClosed = true;

        byte[] encoded = Base64.encode(mPending.toByteArray(), mFlags);
        if (encoded != null) out.write(encoded);

        out.flush();

        if ((mFlags & Base64.NO_CLOSE) == 0) out.close();
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/CloseGuard.java`:

```java
package android.util;

public final class CloseGuard
{
    private Throwable mCloserNameOrAllocationInfo;

    public CloseGuard()
    {
    }

    public void open(String closeMethodName)
    {
        if (closeMethodName == null) throw new NullPointerException("closeMethodName == null");

        mCloserNameOrAllocationInfo = new Throwable("Explicit termination method '" + closeMethodName + "' not called");
    }

    public void close()
    {
        mCloserNameOrAllocationInfo = null;
    }

    public void warnIfOpen()
    {
        if (mCloserNameOrAllocationInfo == null) return;

        Log.w("System", "A resource was acquired at attached stack trace but never released. "
                            + "See java.io.Closeable for information on avoiding resource leaks.",
              mCloserNameOrAllocationInfo);
    }
}
```
