```java
package android.util;

public class DisplayMetrics
{
    public static final int DENSITY_LOW = 120;
    public static final int DENSITY_MEDIUM = 160;
    public static final int DENSITY_HIGH = 240;
    public static final int DENSITY_XHIGH = 320;
    public static final int DENSITY_XXHIGH = 480;
    public static final int DENSITY_XXXHIGH = 640;
    public static final int DENSITY_DEFAULT = DENSITY_MEDIUM;
    public static final int DENSITY_140 = 140;
    public static final int DENSITY_180 = 180;
    public static final int DENSITY_200 = 200;
    public static final int DENSITY_TV = 213;
    public static final int DENSITY_220 = 220;
    public static final int DENSITY_260 = 260;
    public static final int DENSITY_280 = 280;
    public static final int DENSITY_300 = 300;
    public static final int DENSITY_340 = 340;
    public static final int DENSITY_360 = 360;
    public static final int DENSITY_400 = 400;
    public static final int DENSITY_420 = 420;
    public static final int DENSITY_440 = 440;
    public static final int DENSITY_450 = 450;
    public static final int DENSITY_520 = 520;
    public static final int DENSITY_560 = 560;
    public static final int DENSITY_600 = 600;

    public static final int DENSITY_DEVICE_STABLE = densityDeviceStable();

    private static int densityDeviceStable()
    {
        String value = runtime.Settings.get("density");

        if (value != null && !value.isEmpty())
        {
            try
            {
                int parsed = Integer.parseInt(value.trim());
                if (parsed > 0) return parsed;
            }
            catch (NumberFormatException ignored)
            {
            }
        }

        return DENSITY_MEDIUM;
    }

    public int widthPixels;
    public int heightPixels;
    public float density = 1.0f;
    public int densityDpi = DENSITY_DEFAULT;
    public float scaledDensity = 1.0f;
    public float xdpi = DENSITY_DEFAULT;
    public float ydpi = DENSITY_DEFAULT;

    public void setToDefaults()
    {
        widthPixels = 0;
        heightPixels = 0;
        density = 1.0f;
        densityDpi = DENSITY_DEFAULT;
        scaledDensity = 1.0f;
        xdpi = DENSITY_DEFAULT;
        ydpi = DENSITY_DEFAULT;
    }

    public void setTo(DisplayMetrics other)
    {
        widthPixels = other.widthPixels;
        heightPixels = other.heightPixels;
        density = other.density;
        densityDpi = other.densityDpi;
        scaledDensity = other.scaledDensity;
        xdpi = other.xdpi;
        ydpi = other.ydpi;
    }

    {
        return other instanceof DisplayMetrics && equals((DisplayMetrics)other);
    }

    public boolean equals(DisplayMetrics other)
    {
        return other != null && widthPixels == other.widthPixels && heightPixels == other.heightPixels && density == other.density
               && densityDpi == other.densityDpi && scaledDensity == other.scaledDensity && xdpi == other.xdpi
               && ydpi == other.ydpi;
    }

        return widthPixels * heightPixels * densityDpi;
    }
```

`java/android/util/Half.java`:

```java
package android.util;

public final class Half extends Number implements Comparable<Half>
{
    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;

    public static final int SIZE = 16;
    public static final short EPSILON = (short)0x1400;
    public static final short LOWEST_VALUE = (short)0xfbff;
    public static final int MAX_EXPONENT = 15;
    public static final short MAX_VALUE = (short)0x7bff;
    public static final int MIN_EXPONENT = -14;
    public static final short MIN_NORMAL = (short)0x0400;
    public static final short MIN_VALUE = (short)0x0001;
    public static final short NaN = (short)0x7e00;
    public static final short NEGATIVE_INFINITY = (short)0xfc00;
    public static final short NEGATIVE_ZERO = (short)0x8000;
    public static final short POSITIVE_INFINITY = (short)0x7c00;
    public static final short POSITIVE_ZERO = (short)0x0000;

    private static final int FP16_SIGN_SHIFT = 15;
    private static final int FP16_SIGN_MASK = 0x8000;
    private static final int FP16_EXPONENT_SHIFT = 10;
    private static final int FP16_EXPONENT_MASK = 0x1f;
    private static final int FP16_SIGNIFICAND_MASK = 0x3ff;
    private static final int FP16_EXPONENT_BIAS = 15;
    private static final int FP16_COMBINED = 0x7fff;
    private static final int FP16_EXPONENT_MAX = 0x7c00;

    private static final int FP32_SIGN_SHIFT = 31;
    private static final int FP32_EXPONENT_SHIFT = 23;
    private static final int FP32_EXPONENT_MASK = 0xff;
    private static final int FP32_SIGNIFICAND_MASK = 0x7fffff;
    private static final int FP32_EXPONENT_BIAS = 127;
    private static final int FP32_QNAN_MASK = 0x400000;
    private static final int FP32_DENORMAL_MAGIC = 126 << 23;
    private static final float FP32_DENORMAL_FLOAT = Float.intBitsToFloat(FP32_DENORMAL_MAGIC);

    private final short mValue;

    public Half(short value)
    {
        mValue = value;
    }

    public Half(float value)
    {
        mValue = toHalf(value);
    }

    public Half(double value)
    {
        mValue = toHalf((float)value);
    }

    public Half(String value) throws NumberFormatException
    {
        mValue = toHalf(Float.parseFloat(value));
    }

    public short halfValue()
    {
        return mValue;
    }

    @Override
    public byte byteValue()
    {
        return (byte)toFloat(mValue);
    }

    @Override
    public short shortValue()
    {
        return (short)toFloat(mValue);
    }

    @Override
    public int intValue()
    {
        return (int)toFloat(mValue);
    }

    @Override
    public long longValue()
    {
        return (long)toFloat(mValue);
    }

    @Override
    public float floatValue()
    {
        return toFloat(mValue);
    }

    @Override
    public double doubleValue()
    {
        return toFloat(mValue);
    }

    public boolean isNaN()
    {
        return isNaN(mValue);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        return other instanceof Half && halfToIntBits(((Half)other).mValue) == halfToIntBits(mValue);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return hashCode(mValue);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return toString(mValue);
    }

    @Override
    public int compareTo(Half other)
    {
        return compare(mValue, other.mValue);
    }

    public static int hashCode(short half)
    {
        return halfToIntBits(half);
    }

    public static int compare(short first, short second)
    {
        if (less(first, second)) return -1;
        if (greater(first, second)) return 1;

        short firstBits = (first & FP16_COMBINED) > FP16_EXPONENT_MAX ? NaN : first;
        short secondBits = (second & FP16_COMBINED) > FP16_EXPONENT_MAX ? NaN : second;

        return firstBits == secondBits ? 0 : (firstBits < secondBits ? -1 : 1);
    }

    public static short halfToShortBits(short half)
    {
        return (half & FP16_COMBINED) > FP16_EXPONENT_MAX ? NaN : half;
    }

    public static int halfToIntBits(short half)
    {
        return (half & FP16_COMBINED) > FP16_EXPONENT_MAX ? NaN : half & 0xffff;
    }

    public static int halfToRawIntBits(short half)
    {
        return half & 0xffff;
    }

    public static short intBitsToHalf(int bits)
    {
        return (short)(bits & 0xffff);
    }

    public static short copySign(short magnitude, short sign)
    {
        return (short)((sign & FP16_SIGN_MASK) | (magnitude & FP16_COMBINED));
    }

    public static short abs(short half)
    {
        return (short)(half & FP16_COMBINED);
    }

    public static short round(short half)
    {
        int bits = half & 0xffff;
        int exponent = bits & 0x7fff;
        int result = bits;

        if (exponent < 0x3c00)
        {
            result &= FP16_SIGN_MASK;
            result |= 0x3c00 & (exponent >= 0x3800 ? 0xffff : 0x0);
        }
        else if (exponent < 0x6400)
        {
            exponent = 25 - (exponent >> 10);
            int mask = (1 << exponent) - 1;
            result += 1 << (exponent - 1);
            result &= ~mask;
        }

        return (short)result;
    }

    public static short ceil(short half)
    {
        int bits = half & 0xffff;
        int exponent = bits & 0x7fff;
        int result = bits;

        if (exponent < 0x3c00)
        {
            result &= FP16_SIGN_MASK;
            result |= 0x3c00 & -(~(bits >> 15) & (exponent != 0 ? 1 : 0));
        }
        else if (exponent < 0x6400)
        {
            exponent = 25 - (exponent >> 10);
            int mask = (1 << exponent) - 1;
            result += mask & ((bits >> 15) - 1);
            result &= ~mask;
        }

        return (short)result;
    }

    public static short floor(short half)
    {
        int bits = half & 0xffff;
        int exponent = bits & 0x7fff;
        int result = bits;

        if (exponent < 0x3c00)
        {
            result &= FP16_SIGN_MASK;
            result |= 0x3c00 & (bits > 0x8000 ? 0xffff : 0x0);
        }
        else if (exponent < 0x6400)
        {
            exponent = 25 - (exponent >> 10);
            int mask = (1 << exponent) - 1;
            result += mask & -(bits >> 15);
            result &= ~mask;
        }

        return (short)result;
    }

    public static short trunc(short half)
    {
        int bits = half & 0xffff;
        int exponent = bits & 0x7fff;
        int result = bits;

        if (exponent < 0x3c00)
        {
            result &= FP16_SIGN_MASK;
        }
        else if (exponent < 0x6400)
        {
            exponent = 25 - (exponent >> 10);
            int mask = (1 << exponent) - 1;
            result &= ~mask;
        }

        return (short)result;
    }

    public static short min(short first, short second)
    {
        if (isNaN(first) || isNaN(second)) return NaN;
        if ((first & FP16_COMBINED) == 0 && (second & FP16_COMBINED) == 0) return (first & FP16_SIGN_MASK) != 0 ? first : second;

        return toCompareValue(first) < toCompareValue(second) ? first : second;
    }

    public static short max(short first, short second)
    {
        if (isNaN(first) || isNaN(second)) return NaN;
        if ((first & FP16_COMBINED) == 0 && (second & FP16_COMBINED) == 0) return (first & FP16_SIGN_MASK) != 0 ? second : first;

        return toCompareValue(first) > toCompareValue(second) ? first : second;
    }

    public static boolean less(short first, short second)
    {
        if (isNaN(first) || isNaN(second)) return false;

        return toCompareValue(first) < toCompareValue(second);
    }

    public static boolean lessEquals(short first, short second)
    {
        if (isNaN(first) || isNaN(second)) return false;

        return toCompareValue(first) <= toCompareValue(second);
    }

    public static boolean greater(short first, short second)
    {
        if (isNaN(first) || isNaN(second)) return false;

        return toCompareValue(first) > toCompareValue(second);
    }

    public static boolean greaterEquals(short first, short second)
    {
        if (isNaN(first) || isNaN(second)) return false;

        return toCompareValue(first) >= toCompareValue(second);
    }

    public static boolean equals(short first, short second)
    {
        if (isNaN(first) || isNaN(second)) return false;

        return first == second || ((first | second) & FP16_COMBINED) == 0;
    }

    public static int getSign(short half)
    {
        return (half & FP16_SIGN_MASK) == 0 ? 1 : -1;
    }

    public static int getExponent(short half)
    {
        return ((half >>> FP16_EXPONENT_SHIFT) & FP16_EXPONENT_MASK) - FP16_EXPONENT_BIAS;
    }

    public static int getSignificand(short half)
    {
        return half & FP16_SIGNIFICAND_MASK;
    }

    public static boolean isInfinite(short half)
    {
        return (half & FP16_COMBINED) == FP16_EXPONENT_MAX;
    }

    public static boolean isNaN(short half)
    {
        return (half & FP16_COMBINED) > FP16_EXPONENT_MAX;
    }

    public static boolean isNormalized(short half)
    {
        return (half & FP16_EXPONENT_MAX) != 0 && (half & FP16_EXPONENT_MAX) != FP16_EXPONENT_MAX;
    }

    public static float toFloat(short half)
    {
        int bits = half & 0xffff;
        int sign = bits & FP16_SIGN_MASK;
        int exponent = (bits >>> FP16_EXPONENT_SHIFT) & FP16_EXPONENT_MASK;
        int significand = bits & FP16_SIGNIFICAND_MASK;

        int outExponent = 0;
        int outSignificand = 0;

        if (exponent == 0)
        {
            if (significand != 0)
            {
                float value = Float.intBitsToFloat(FP32_DENORMAL_MAGIC + significand);
                value -= FP32_DENORMAL_FLOAT;
                return sign == 0 ? value : -value;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            outSignificand = significand << 13;
            if (exponent == 0x1f)
            {
                outExponent = 0xff;
                if (outSignificand != 0) outSignificand |= FP32_QNAN_MASK;
            }
            else
            {
                outExponent = exponent - FP16_EXPONENT_BIAS + FP32_EXPONENT_BIAS;
            }
        }

        int out = (sign << 16) | (outExponent << FP32_EXPONENT_SHIFT) | outSignificand;
        return Float.intBitsToFloat(out);
    }

    public static short toHalf(float value)
    {
        int bits = Float.floatToRawIntBits(value);
        int sign = bits >>> FP32_SIGN_SHIFT;
        int exponent = (bits >>> FP32_EXPONENT_SHIFT) & FP32_EXPONENT_MASK;
        int significand = bits & FP32_SIGNIFICAND_MASK;

        int outExponent = 0;
        int outSignificand = 0;

        if (exponent == 0xff)
        {
            outExponent = 0x1f;
            outSignificand = significand != 0 ? 0x200 : 0;
        }
        else
        {
            exponent = exponent - FP32_EXPONENT_BIAS + FP16_EXPONENT_BIAS;
            if (exponent >= 0x1f)
            {
                outExponent = 0x1f;
            }
            else if (exponent <= 0)
            {
                if (exponent >= -10)
                {
                    significand = significand | 0x800000;
                    int shift = 14 - exponent;
                    outSignificand = significand >> shift;

                    int lowSignificand = significand & ((1 << shift) - 1);
                    int halfway = 1 << (shift - 1);
                    if (lowSignificand + (outSignificand & 1) > halfway) outSignificand++;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                outExponent = exponent;
                outSignificand = significand >> 13;
                if ((significand & 0x1fff) + (outSignificand & 0x1) > 0x1000) outSignificand++;
            }
        }

        return (short)((sign << FP16_SIGN_SHIFT) | (outExponent << FP16_EXPONENT_SHIFT) + outSignificand);
    }

    public static Half valueOf(short half)
    {
        return new Half(half);
    }

    public static Half valueOf(float value)
    {
        return new Half(value);
    }

    public static Half valueOf(String value)
    {
        return new Half(value);
    }

    public static short parseHalf(String value) throws NumberFormatException
    {
        return toHalf(Float.parseFloat(value));
    }

    public static String toString(short half)
    {
        return Float.toString(toFloat(half));
    }

    public static String toHexString(short half)
    {
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();

        int bits = half & 0xffff;
        int sign = bits >>> FP16_SIGN_SHIFT;
        int exponent = (bits >>> FP16_EXPONENT_SHIFT) & FP16_EXPONENT_MASK;
        int significand = bits & FP16_SIGNIFICAND_MASK;

        if (exponent == 0x1f)
        {
            if (significand == 0)
            {
                if (sign != 0) out.append('-');
                out.append("Infinity");
            }
            else
            {
                out.append("NaN");
            }
            return out.toString();
        }

        if (sign == 1) out.append('-');

        if (exponent == 0)
        {
            if (significand == 0)
            {
                out.append("0x0.0p0");
            }
            else
            {
                out.append("0x0.");
                out.append(Integer.toHexString(significand).replaceFirst("0{2,}$", ""));
                out.append("p-14");
            }
        }
        else
        {
            out.append("0x1.");
            out.append(Integer.toHexString(significand).replaceFirst("0{2,}$", ""));
            out.append('p');
            out.append(exponent - FP16_EXPONENT_BIAS);
        }

        return out.toString();
    }

    private static int toCompareValue(short half)
    {
        return (half & FP16_SIGN_MASK) != 0 ? 0x8000 - (half & 0xffff) : half & 0xffff;
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/JsonReader.java`:

```java
package android.util;

import java.io.Closeable;
import java.io.EOFException;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.Reader;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class JsonReader implements Closeable
{
    private static final String TRUE = "true";
    private static final String FALSE = "false";

    private final Reader mIn;
    private final char[] mBuffer = new char[1024];
    private final List<JsonScope> mStack = new ArrayList<>();

    private boolean mLenient;
    private int mPosition;
    private int mLimit;
    private int mBufferStartLine = 1;
    private int mBufferStartColumn = 1;
    private JsonToken mToken;
    private String mName;
    private String mValue;
    private int mValuePosition;
    private int mValueLength;
    private boolean mSkipping;

    public JsonReader(Reader in)
    {
        if (in == null) throw new NullPointerException("in == null");

        push(JsonScope.EMPTY_DOCUMENT);
        mIn = in;
    }

    public void setLenient(boolean lenient)
    {
        mLenient = lenient;
    }

    public boolean isLenient()
    {
        return mLenient;
    }

    public void beginArray() throws IOException
    {
        expect(JsonToken.BEGIN_ARRAY);
    }

    public void endArray() throws IOException
    {
        expect(JsonToken.END_ARRAY);
    }

    public void beginObject() throws IOException
    {
        expect(JsonToken.BEGIN_OBJECT);
    }

    public void endObject() throws IOException
    {
        expect(JsonToken.END_OBJECT);
    }

    private void expect(JsonToken expected) throws IOException
    {
        peek();
        if (mToken != expected) throw new IllegalStateException("Expected " + expected + " but was " + peek());

        advance();
    }

    public boolean hasNext() throws IOException
    {
        peek();
        return mToken != JsonToken.END_OBJECT && mToken != JsonToken.END_ARRAY;
    }

    public JsonToken peek() throws IOException
    {
        if (mToken != null) return mToken;

        switch (peekStack())
        {
            case EMPTY_DOCUMENT:
                replaceTop(JsonScope.NONEMPTY_DOCUMENT);
                JsonToken firstToken = nextValue();
                if (!mLenient && mToken != JsonToken.BEGIN_ARRAY && mToken != JsonToken.BEGIN_OBJECT)
                {
                    throw new IOException("Expected JSON document to start with '[' or '{' but was " + mToken);
                }
                return firstToken;
            case EMPTY_ARRAY:
                return nextInArray(true);
            case NONEMPTY_ARRAY:
                return nextInArray(false);
            case EMPTY_OBJECT:
                return nextInObject(true);
            case DANGLING_NAME:
                return objectValue();
            case NONEMPTY_OBJECT:
                return nextInObject(false);
            case NONEMPTY_DOCUMENT:
                int character = nextNonWhitespace(false);
                if (character == -1) return JsonToken.END_DOCUMENT;

                mPosition--;
                if (!mLenient) throw syntaxError("Expected EOF");
                return nextValue();
            case CLOSED:
                throw new IllegalStateException("JsonReader is closed");
            default:
                throw new AssertionError();
        }
    }

    private JsonToken advance() throws IOException
    {
        peek();

        JsonToken result = mToken;
        mToken = null;
        mValue = null;
        mName = null;
        return result;
    }

    public String nextName() throws IOException
    {
        peek();
        if (mToken != JsonToken.NAME) throw new IllegalStateException("Expected a name but was " + peek());

        String result = mName;
        advance();
        return result;
    }

    public String nextString() throws IOException
    {
        peek();
        if (mToken != JsonToken.STRING && mToken != JsonToken.NUMBER)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Expected a string but was " + peek());
        }

        String result = mValue;
        advance();
        return result;
    }

    public boolean nextBoolean() throws IOException
    {
        peek();
        if (mToken != JsonToken.BOOLEAN) throw new IllegalStateException("Expected a boolean but was " + mToken);

        boolean result = mValue == TRUE;
        advance();
        return result;
    }

    public void nextNull() throws IOException
    {
        peek();
        if (mToken != JsonToken.NULL) throw new IllegalStateException("Expected null but was " + mToken);

        advance();
    }

    public double nextDouble() throws IOException
    {
        peek();
        if (mToken != JsonToken.STRING && mToken != JsonToken.NUMBER)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Expected a double but was " + mToken);
        }

        double result = Double.parseDouble(mValue);
        advance();
        return result;
    }

    public long nextLong() throws IOException
    {
        peek();
        if (mToken != JsonToken.STRING && mToken != JsonToken.NUMBER)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Expected a long but was " + mToken);
        }

        long result;
        try
        {
            result = Long.parseLong(mValue);
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException ignored)
        {
            double asDouble = Double.parseDouble(mValue);
            result = (long)asDouble;
            if ((double)result != asDouble) throw new NumberFormatException(mValue);
        }

        advance();
        return result;
    }

    public int nextInt() throws IOException
    {
        peek();
        if (mToken != JsonToken.STRING && mToken != JsonToken.NUMBER)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Expected an int but was " + mToken);
        }

        int result;
        try
        {
            result = Integer.parseInt(mValue);
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException ignored)
        {
            double asDouble = Double.parseDouble(mValue);
            result = (int)asDouble;
            if ((double)result != asDouble) throw new NumberFormatException(mValue);
        }

        advance();
        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public void close() throws IOException
    {
        mValue = null;
        mToken = null;
        mStack.clear();
        mStack.add(JsonScope.CLOSED);
        mIn.close();
    }

    public void skipValue() throws IOException
    {
        mSkipping = true;
        try
        {
            if (!hasNext() || peek() == JsonToken.END_DOCUMENT) throw new IllegalStateException("No element left to skip");

            int count = 0;
            do
            {
                JsonToken token = advance();
                if (token == JsonToken.BEGIN_ARRAY || token == JsonToken.BEGIN_OBJECT) count++;
                else if (token == JsonToken.END_ARRAY || token == JsonToken.END_OBJECT) count--;
            }
            while (count != 0);
        }
        finally
        {
            mSkipping = false;
        }
    }

    private JsonScope peekStack()
    {
        return mStack.get(mStack.size() - 1);
    }

    private JsonScope pop()
    {
        return mStack.remove(mStack.size() - 1);
    }

    private void push(JsonScope scope)
    {
        mStack.add(scope);
    }

    private void replaceTop(JsonScope scope)
    {
        mStack.set(mStack.size() - 1, scope);
    }

    private JsonToken nextInArray(boolean firstElement) throws IOException
    {
        if (firstElement)
        {
            replaceTop(JsonScope.NONEMPTY_ARRAY);
        }
        else
        {
            switch (nextNonWhitespace(true))
            {
                case ']':
                    pop();
                    return mToken = JsonToken.END_ARRAY;
                case ';':
                    checkLenient();
                    break;
                case ',':
                    break;
                default:
                    throw syntaxError("Unterminated array");
            }
        }

        int character = nextNonWhitespace(true);
        if (character == ']' && firstElement)
        {
            pop();
            return mToken = JsonToken.END_ARRAY;
        }

        if (character == ']' || character == ';' || character == ',')
        {
            checkLenient();
            mPosition--;
            mValue = "null";
            return mToken = JsonToken.NULL;
        }

        mPosition--;
        return nextValue();
    }

    private JsonToken nextInObject(boolean firstElement) throws IOException
    {
        int character = nextNonWhitespace(true);
        if (character == '}')
        {
            pop();
            return mToken = JsonToken.END_OBJECT;
        }

        if (firstElement)
        {
            mPosition--;
        }
        else if (character != ';' && character != ',')
        {
            throw syntaxError("Unterminated object");
        }

        int quote = nextNonWhitespace(true);
        if (quote == '\'' || quote == '"')
        {
            if (quote == '\'') checkLenient();
            mName = nextString((char)quote);
        }
        else
        {
            checkLenient();
            mPosition--;
            mName = nextLiteral(false);
            if (mName.isEmpty()) throw syntaxError("Expected name");
        }

        replaceTop(JsonScope.DANGLING_NAME);
        return mToken = JsonToken.NAME;
    }

    private JsonToken objectValue() throws IOException
    {
        switch (nextNonWhitespace(true))
        {
            case ':':
                break;
            case '=':
                checkLenient();
                if ((mPosition < mLimit || fillBuffer(1)) && mBuffer[mPosition] == '>') mPosition++;
                break;
            default:
                throw syntaxError("Expected ':'");
        }

        replaceTop(JsonScope.NONEMPTY_OBJECT);
        return nextValue();
    }

    private JsonToken nextValue() throws IOException
    {
        int character = nextNonWhitespace(true);
        switch (character)
        {
            case '{':
                push(JsonScope.EMPTY_OBJECT);
                return mToken = JsonToken.BEGIN_OBJECT;
            case '[':
                push(JsonScope.EMPTY_ARRAY);
                return mToken = JsonToken.BEGIN_ARRAY;
            case '\'':
                checkLenient();
                mValue = nextString((char)character);
                return mToken = JsonToken.STRING;
            case '"':
                mValue = nextString((char)character);
                return mToken = JsonToken.STRING;
            default:
                mPosition--;
                return readLiteral();
        }
    }

    private boolean fillBuffer(int minimum) throws IOException
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mPosition; index++)
        {
            if (mBuffer[index] == '\n')
            {
                mBufferStartLine++;
                mBufferStartColumn = 1;
            }
            else
            {
                mBufferStartColumn++;
            }
        }

        if (mLimit != mPosition)
        {
            mLimit -= mPosition;
            System.arraycopy(mBuffer, mPosition, mBuffer, 0, mLimit);
        }
        else
        {
            mLimit = 0;
        }

        mPosition = 0;
        int total;
        while ((total = mIn.read(mBuffer, mLimit, mBuffer.length - mLimit)) != -1)
        {
            mLimit += total;

            if (mBufferStartLine == 1 && mBufferStartColumn == 1 && mLimit > 0 && mBuffer[0] == '﻿')
            {
                mPosition++;
                mBufferStartColumn--;
            }

            if (mLimit >= minimum) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private int getLineNumber()
    {
        int result = mBufferStartLine;
        for (int index = 0; index < mPosition; index++)
        {
            if (mBuffer[index] == '\n') result++;
        }
        return result;
    }

    private int getColumnNumber()
    {
        int result = mBufferStartColumn;
        for (int index = 0; index < mPosition; index++)
        {
            if (mBuffer[index] == '\n') result = 1;
            else result++;
        }
        return result;
    }

    private int nextNonWhitespace(boolean throwOnEof) throws IOException
    {
        while (mPosition < mLimit || fillBuffer(1))
        {
            int character = mBuffer[mPosition++];
            switch (character)
            {
                case '\t':
                case ' ':
                case '\n':
                case '\r':
                    continue;
                case '/':
                    if (mPosition == mLimit && !fillBuffer(1)) return character;

                    checkLenient();
                    char next = mBuffer[mPosition];
                    if (next == '*')
                    {
                        mPosition++;
                        if (!skipTo("*/")) throw syntaxError("Unterminated comment");
                        mPosition += 2;
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (next == '/')
                    {
                        mPosition++;
                        skipToEndOfLine();
                        continue;
                    }
                    return character;
                case '#':
                    checkLenient();
                    skipToEndOfLine();
                    continue;
                default:
                    return character;
            }
        }

        if (throwOnEof) throw new EOFException("End of input");
        return -1;
    }

    private void checkLenient() throws IOException
    {
        if (!mLenient) throw syntaxError("Use JsonReader.setLenient(true) to accept malformed JSON");
    }

    private void skipToEndOfLine() throws IOException
    {
        while (mPosition < mLimit || fillBuffer(1))
        {
            char character = mBuffer[mPosition++];
            if (character == '\r' || character == '\n') break;
        }
    }

    private boolean skipTo(String toFind) throws IOException
    {
        for (; mPosition + toFind.length() <= mLimit || fillBuffer(toFind.length()); mPosition++)
        {
            boolean matched = true;
            for (int index = 0; index < toFind.length(); index++)
            {
                if (mBuffer[mPosition + index] != toFind.charAt(index))
                {
                    matched = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (matched) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private String nextString(char quote) throws IOException
    {
        StringBuilder builder = null;
        do
        {
            int start = mPosition;
            while (mPosition < mLimit)
            {
                int character = mBuffer[mPosition++];
                if (character == quote)
                {
                    if (mSkipping) return "skipped!";
                    if (builder == null) return new String(mBuffer, start, mPosition - start - 1);

                    builder.append(mBuffer, start, mPosition - start - 1);
                    return builder.toString();
                }

                if (character == '\\')
                {
                    if (builder == null) builder = new StringBuilder();
                    builder.append(mBuffer, start, mPosition - start - 1);
                    builder.append(readEscapeCharacter());
                    start = mPosition;
                }
            }

            if (builder == null) builder = new StringBuilder();
            builder.append(mBuffer, start, mPosition - start);
        }
        while (fillBuffer(1));

        throw syntaxError("Unterminated string");
    }

    private String nextLiteral(boolean assignOffsetsOnly) throws IOException
    {
        StringBuilder builder = null;
        mValuePosition = -1;
        mValueLength = 0;
        int index = 0;

        while (true)
        {
            boolean terminated = false;
            for (; mPosition + index < mLimit; index++)
            {
                char character = mBuffer[mPosition + index];
                if (character == '/' || character == '\\' || character == ';' || character == '#' || character == '=')
                {
                    checkLenient();
                    terminated = true;
                    break;
                }
                if (character == '{' || character == '}' || character == '[' || character == ']' || character == ':' || character == ','
                    || character == ' ' || character == '\t' || character == '\f' || character == '\r' || character == '\n')
                {
                    terminated = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (terminated) break;

            if (index < mBuffer.length)
            {
                if (fillBuffer(index + 1)) continue;
                break;
            }

            if (builder == null) builder = new StringBuilder();
            builder.append(mBuffer, mPosition, index);
            mValueLength += index;
            mPosition += index;
            index = 0;
            if (!fillBuffer(1)) break;
        }

        String result;
        if (assignOffsetsOnly && builder == null)
        {
            mValuePosition = mPosition;
            result = null;
        }
        else if (mSkipping)
        {
            result = "skipped!";
        }
        else if (builder == null)
        {
            result = new String(mBuffer, mPosition, index);
        }
        else
        {
            builder.append(mBuffer, mPosition, index);
            result = builder.toString();
        }

        mValueLength += index;
        mPosition += index;
        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return getClass().getSimpleName() + " near " + getSnippet();
    }

    private char readEscapeCharacter() throws IOException
    {
        if (mPosition == mLimit && !fillBuffer(1)) throw syntaxError("Unterminated escape sequence");

        char escaped = mBuffer[mPosition++];
        switch (escaped)
        {
            case 'u':
                if (mPosition + 4 > mLimit && !fillBuffer(4)) throw syntaxError("Unterminated escape sequence");

                String hex = new String(mBuffer, mPosition, 4);
                mPosition += 4;
                return (char)Integer.parseInt(hex, 16);
            case 't':
                return '\t';
            case 'b':
                return '\b';
            case 'n':
                return '\n';
            case 'r':
                return '\r';
            case 'f':
                return '\f';
            default:
                return escaped;
        }
    }

    private JsonToken readLiteral() throws IOException
    {
        mValue = nextLiteral(true);
        if (mValueLength == 0) throw syntaxError("Expected literal value");

        mToken = decodeLiteral();
        if (mToken == JsonToken.STRING) checkLenient();
        return mToken;
    }

    private JsonToken decodeLiteral() throws IOException
    {
        if (mValuePosition == -1) return JsonToken.STRING;

        if (literalEquals("null"))
        {
            mValue = "null";
            return JsonToken.NULL;
        }

        if (literalEquals(TRUE))
        {
            mValue = TRUE;
            return JsonToken.BOOLEAN;
        }

        if (literalEquals(FALSE))
        {
            mValue = FALSE;
            return JsonToken.BOOLEAN;
        }

        mValue = new String(mBuffer, mValuePosition, mValueLength);
        return decodeNumber(mBuffer, mValuePosition, mValueLength);
    }

    private boolean literalEquals(String keyword)
    {
        if (mValueLength != keyword.length()) return false;

        for (int index = 0; index < mValueLength; index++)
        {
            if (Character.toLowerCase(mBuffer[mValuePosition + index]) != keyword.charAt(index)) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static JsonToken decodeNumber(char[] characters, int offset, int length)
    {
        int end = offset + length;
        int index = offset;
        int character = charAt(characters, index, end);

        if (character == '-') character = charAt(characters, ++index, end);

        if (character == '0')
        {
            character = charAt(characters, ++index, end);
        }
        else if (character >= '1' && character <= '9')
        {
            character = charAt(characters, ++index, end);
            while (character >= '0' && character <= '9') character = charAt(characters, ++index, end);
        }
        else
        {
            return JsonToken.STRING;
        }

        if (character == '.')
        {
            character = charAt(characters, ++index, end);
            while (character >= '0' && character <= '9') character = charAt(characters, ++index, end);
        }

        if (character == 'e' || character == 'E')
        {
            character = charAt(characters, ++index, end);
            if (character == '+' || character == '-') character = charAt(characters, ++index, end);

            if (character >= '0' && character <= '9')
            {
                character = charAt(characters, ++index, end);
                while (character >= '0' && character <= '9') character = charAt(characters, ++index, end);
            }
            else
            {
                return JsonToken.STRING;
            }
        }

        return index == end ? JsonToken.NUMBER : JsonToken.STRING;
    }

    private static int charAt(char[] characters, int index, int end)
    {
        return index < end ? characters[index] : -1;
    }

    private IOException syntaxError(String message) throws IOException
    {
        throw new MalformedJsonException(message + " at line " + getLineNumber() + " column " + getColumnNumber());
    }

    private CharSequence getSnippet()
    {
        StringBuilder snippet = new StringBuilder();
        int before = Math.min(mPosition, 20);
        snippet.append(mBuffer, mPosition - before, before);
        int after = Math.min(mLimit - mPosition, 20);
        snippet.append(mBuffer, mPosition, after);
        return snippet;
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/JsonWriter.java`:

```java
package android.util;

import java.io.Closeable;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.Writer;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class JsonWriter implements Closeable
{
    private final Writer mOut;
    private final List<JsonScope> mStack = new ArrayList<>();

    private String mIndent;
    private String mSeparator = ":";
    private boolean mLenient;

    public JsonWriter(Writer out)
    {
        if (out == null) throw new NullPointerException("out == null");

        mOut = out;
        mStack.add(JsonScope.EMPTY_DOCUMENT);
    }

    public void setIndent(String indent)
    {
        if (indent.isEmpty())
        {
            mIndent = null;
            mSeparator = ":";
        }
        else
        {
            mIndent = indent;
            mSeparator = ": ";
        }
    }

    public void setLenient(boolean lenient)
    {
        mLenient = lenient;
    }

    public boolean isLenient()
    {
        return mLenient;
    }

    public JsonWriter beginArray() throws IOException
    {
        return open(JsonScope.EMPTY_ARRAY, "[");
    }

    public JsonWriter endArray() throws IOException
    {
        return close(JsonScope.EMPTY_ARRAY, JsonScope.NONEMPTY_ARRAY, "]");
    }

    public JsonWriter beginObject() throws IOException
    {
        return open(JsonScope.EMPTY_OBJECT, "{");
    }

    public JsonWriter endObject() throws IOException
    {
        return close(JsonScope.EMPTY_OBJECT, JsonScope.NONEMPTY_OBJECT, "}");
    }

    private JsonWriter open(JsonScope empty, String openBracket) throws IOException
    {
        beforeValue(true);
        mStack.add(empty);
        mOut.write(openBracket);
        return this;
    }

    private JsonWriter close(JsonScope empty, JsonScope nonempty, String closeBracket) throws IOException
    {
        JsonScope context = peek();
        if (context != nonempty && context != empty) throw new IllegalStateException("Nesting problem: " + mStack);

        mStack.remove(mStack.size() - 1);
        if (context == nonempty) newline();

        mOut.write(closeBracket);
        return this;
    }

    private JsonScope peek()
    {
        return mStack.get(mStack.size() - 1);
    }

    private void replaceTop(JsonScope scope)
    {
        mStack.set(mStack.size() - 1, scope);
    }

    public JsonWriter name(String name) throws IOException
    {
        if (name == null) throw new NullPointerException("name == null");

        beforeName();
        string(name);
        return this;
    }

    public JsonWriter value(String value) throws IOException
    {
        if (value == null) return nullValue();

        beforeValue(false);
        string(value);
        return this;
    }

    public JsonWriter nullValue() throws IOException
    {
        beforeValue(false);
        mOut.write("null");
        return this;
    }

    public JsonWriter value(boolean value) throws IOException
    {
        beforeValue(false);
        mOut.write(value ? "true" : "false");
        return this;
    }

    public JsonWriter value(double value) throws IOException
    {
        if (!mLenient && (Double.isNaN(value) || Double.isInfinite(value)))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Numeric values must be finite, but was " + value);
        }

        beforeValue(false);
        mOut.append(Double.toString(value));
        return this;
    }

    public JsonWriter value(long value) throws IOException
    {
        beforeValue(false);
        mOut.write(Long.toString(value));
        return this;
    }

    public JsonWriter value(Number value) throws IOException
    {
        if (value == null) return nullValue();

        String string = value.toString();
        if (!mLenient && (string.equals("-Infinity") || string.equals("Infinity") || string.equals("NaN")))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Numeric values must be finite, but was " + value);
        }

        beforeValue(false);
        mOut.append(string);
        return this;
    }

    public void flush() throws IOException
    {
        mOut.flush();
    }

    @Override
    public void close() throws IOException
    {
        mOut.close();

        if (peek() != JsonScope.NONEMPTY_DOCUMENT) throw new IOException("Incomplete document");
    }

    private void string(String value) throws IOException
    {
        mOut.write("\"");
        for (int index = 0, length = value.length(); index < length; index++)
        {
            char character = value.charAt(index);
            switch (character)
            {
                case '"':
                case '\\':
                    mOut.write('\\');
                    mOut.write(character);
                    break;
                case '\t':
                    mOut.write("\\t");
                    break;
                case '\b':
                    mOut.write("\\b");
                    break;
                case '\n':
                    mOut.write("\\n");
                    break;
                case '\r':
                    mOut.write("\\r");
                    break;
                case '\f':
                    mOut.write("\\f");
                    break;
                case ' ':
                case ' ':
                    mOut.write(String.format("\\u%04x", (int)character));
                    break;
                default:
                    if (character <= 0x1F) mOut.write(String.format("\\u%04x", (int)character));
                    else mOut.write(character);
                    break;
            }
        }
        mOut.write("\"");
    }

    private void newline() throws IOException
    {
        if (mIndent == null) return;

        mOut.write("\n");
        for (int index = 1; index < mStack.size(); index++)
        {
            mOut.write(mIndent);
        }
    }

    private void beforeName() throws IOException
    {
        JsonScope context = peek();
        if (context == JsonScope.NONEMPTY_OBJECT) mOut.write(',');
        else if (context != JsonScope.EMPTY_OBJECT) throw new IllegalStateException("Nesting problem: " + mStack);

        newline();
        replaceTop(JsonScope.DANGLING_NAME);
    }

    private void beforeValue(boolean root) throws IOException
    {
        switch (peek())
        {
            case EMPTY_DOCUMENT:
                if (!mLenient && !root) throw new IllegalStateException("JSON must start with an array or an object.");
                replaceTop(JsonScope.NONEMPTY_DOCUMENT);
                break;
            case EMPTY_ARRAY:
                replaceTop(JsonScope.NONEMPTY_ARRAY);
                newline();
                break;
            case NONEMPTY_ARRAY:
                mOut.append(',');
                newline();
                break;
            case DANGLING_NAME:
                mOut.append(mSeparator);
                replaceTop(JsonScope.NONEMPTY_OBJECT);
                break;
            case NONEMPTY_DOCUMENT:
                throw new IllegalStateException("JSON must have only one top-level value.");
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Nesting problem: " + mStack);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/Log.java`:

```java
package android.util;

public final class Log
{
    public static final int VERBOSE = 2;
    public static final int DEBUG = 3;
    public static final int INFO = 4;
    public static final int WARN = 5;
    public static final int ERROR = 6;
    public static final int ASSERT = 7;

    private Log()
    {
    }

    public static native int println_native(int bufferId, int priority, String tag, String message);

    public static int v(String tag, String message)
    {
        return println_native(0, VERBOSE, tag, message);
    }

    public static int v(String tag, String message, Throwable cause)
    {
        return println_native(0, VERBOSE, tag, message + '\n' + getStackTraceString(cause));
    }

    public static int d(String tag, String message)
    {
        return println_native(0, DEBUG, tag, message);
    }

    public static int d(String tag, String message, Throwable cause)
    {
        return println_native(0, DEBUG, tag, message + '\n' + getStackTraceString(cause));
    }

    public static int i(String tag, String message)
    {
        return println_native(0, INFO, tag, message);
    }

    public static int i(String tag, String message, Throwable cause)
    {
        return println_native(0, INFO, tag, message + '\n' + getStackTraceString(cause));
    }

    public static int w(String tag, String message)
    {
        return println_native(0, WARN, tag, message);
    }

    public static int w(String tag, String message, Throwable cause)
    {
        return println_native(0, WARN, tag, message + '\n' + getStackTraceString(cause));
    }

    public static int w(String tag, Throwable cause)
    {
        return println_native(0, WARN, tag, getStackTraceString(cause));
    }

    public static int e(String tag, String message)
    {
        return println_native(0, ERROR, tag, message);
    }

    public static int e(String tag, String message, Throwable cause)
    {
        return println_native(0, ERROR, tag, message + '\n' + getStackTraceString(cause));
    }

    public static int wtf(String tag, String message)
    {
        return println_native(0, ASSERT, tag, message);
    }

    public static int wtf(String tag, Throwable cause)
    {
        return println_native(0, ASSERT, tag, getStackTraceString(cause));
    }

    public static int wtf(String tag, String message, Throwable cause)
    {
        return println_native(0, ASSERT, tag, message + '\n' + getStackTraceString(cause));
    }

    public static int println(int priority, String tag, String message)
    {
        return println_native(0, priority, tag, message);
    }

    public static boolean isLoggable(String tag, int level)
    {
        return level >= INFO;
    }

    public static String getStackTraceString(Throwable cause)
    {
        if (cause == null) return "";

        java.io.StringWriter writer = new java.io.StringWriter();
        cause.printStackTrace(new java.io.PrintWriter(writer));
        return writer.toString();
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/LongSparseArray.java`:

```java
package android.util;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;

public class LongSparseArray<E> implements Cloneable
{
    private final LinkedHashMap<Long, E> mValues = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    public LongSparseArray()
    {
    }

    public LongSparseArray(int initialCapacity)
    {
    }

    public E get(long key)
    {
        return mValues.get(key);
    }

    public E get(long key, E valueIfKeyNotFound)
    {
        E value = mValues.get(key);
        return value == null ? valueIfKeyNotFound : value;
    }

    public void put(long key, E value)
    {
        mValues.put(key, value);
    }

    public void append(long key, E value)
    {
        mValues.put(key, value);
    }

    public void delete(long key)
    {
        mValues.remove(key);
    }

    public void remove(long key)
    {
        mValues.remove(key);
    }

    public void removeAt(int index)
    {
        long key = keyAt(index);
        mValues.remove(key);
    }

    public int size()
    {
        return mValues.size();
    }

    public long keyAt(int index)
    {
        int at = 0;
        for (Long key : mValues.keySet())
        {
            if (at++ == index) return key;
        }

        return 0;
    }

    public E valueAt(int index)
    {
        int at = 0;
        for (E value : mValues.values())
        {
            if (at++ == index) return value;
        }

        return null;
    }

    public void setValueAt(int index, E value)
    {
        long key = keyAt(index);
        mValues.put(key, value);
    }

    public int indexOfKey(long key)
    {
        int at = 0;
        for (Long candidate : mValues.keySet())
        {
            if (candidate == key) return at;
            at++;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public int indexOfValue(E value)
    {
        int at = 0;
        for (E candidate : mValues.values())
        {
            if (candidate == value) return at;
            at++;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public boolean containsKey(long key)
    {
        return mValues.containsKey(key);
    }

    public void clear()
    {
        mValues.clear();
    }

    public boolean isEmpty()
    {
        return mValues.isEmpty();
    }

    @Override
    public LongSparseArray<E> clone()
    {
        LongSparseArray<E> copy = new LongSparseArray<>();
        copy.mValues.putAll(mValues);

        return copy;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mValues.toString();
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/LruCache.java`:

```java
package android.util;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class LruCache<K, V>
{
    private final LinkedHashMap<K, V> mMap;

    private int mSize;
    private int mMaxSize;
    private int mPutCount;
    private int mCreateCount;
    private int mEvictionCount;
    private int mHitCount;
    private int mMissCount;

    public LruCache(int maxSize)
    {
        if (maxSize <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxSize <= 0");

        mMaxSize = maxSize;
        mMap = new LinkedHashMap<K, V>(0, 0.75f, true);
    }

    public void resize(int maxSize)
    {
        if (maxSize <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxSize <= 0");

        synchronized (this)
        {
            mMaxSize = maxSize;
        }

        trimToSize(maxSize);
    }

    public final V get(K key)
    {
        if (key == null) throw new NullPointerException("key == null");

        V mapValue;
        synchronized (this)
        {
            mapValue = mMap.get(key);
            if (mapValue != null)
            {
                mHitCount++;
                return mapValue;
            }

            mMissCount++;
        }

        V createdValue = create(key);
        if (createdValue == null) return null;

        synchronized (this)
        {
            mCreateCount++;
            mapValue = mMap.put(key, createdValue);

            if (mapValue != null) mMap.put(key, mapValue);
            else mSize += safeSizeOf(key, createdValue);
        }

        if (mapValue != null)
        {
            entryRemoved(false, key, createdValue, mapValue);
            return mapValue;
        }

        trimToSize(mMaxSize);
        return createdValue;
    }

    public final V put(K key, V value)
    {
        if (key == null || value == null) throw new NullPointerException("key == null || value == null");

        V previous;
        synchronized (this)
        {
            mPutCount++;
            mSize += safeSizeOf(key, value);
            previous = mMap.put(key, value);
            if (previous != null) mSize -= safeSizeOf(key, previous);
        }

        if (previous != null) entryRemoved(false, key, previous, value);

        trimToSize(mMaxSize);
        return previous;
    }

    public void trimToSize(int maxSize)
    {
        while (true)
        {
            K key;
            V value;

            synchronized (this)
            {
                if (mSize < 0 || (mMap.isEmpty() && mSize != 0))
                {
                    throw new IllegalStateException(getClass().getName() + ".sizeOf() is reporting inconsistent results!");
                }

                if (mSize <= maxSize || mMap.isEmpty()) break;

                Map.Entry<K, V> toEvict = mMap.entrySet().iterator().next();
                key = toEvict.getKey();
                value = toEvict.getValue();
                mMap.remove(key);
                mSize -= safeSizeOf(key, value);
                mEvictionCount++;
            }

            entryRemoved(true, key, value, null);
        }
    }

    public final V remove(K key)
    {
        if (key == null) throw new NullPointerException("key == null");

        V previous;
        synchronized (this)
        {
            previous = mMap.remove(key);
            if (previous != null) mSize -= safeSizeOf(key, previous);
        }

        if (previous != null) entryRemoved(false, key, previous, null);
        return previous;
    }

    protected void entryRemoved(boolean evicted, K key, V oldValue, V newValue)
    {
    }

    protected V create(K key)
    {
        return null;
    }

    private int safeSizeOf(K key, V value)
    {
        int result = sizeOf(key, value);
        if (result < 0) throw new IllegalStateException("Negative size: " + key + "=" + value);
        return result;
    }

    protected int sizeOf(K key, V value)
    {
        return 1;
    }

    public final void evictAll()
    {
        trimToSize(-1);
    }

    public final synchronized int size()
    {
        return mSize;
    }

    public final synchronized int maxSize()
    {
        return mMaxSize;
    }

    public final synchronized int hitCount()
    {
        return mHitCount;
    }

    public final synchronized int missCount()
    {
        return mMissCount;
    }

    public final synchronized int createCount()
    {
        return mCreateCount;
    }

    public final synchronized int putCount()
    {
        return mPutCount;
    }

    public final synchronized int evictionCount()
    {
        return mEvictionCount;
    }

    public final synchronized Map<K, V> snapshot()
    {
        return new LinkedHashMap<K, V>(mMap);
    }

    @Override
    public final synchronized String toString()
    {
        int accesses = mHitCount + mMissCount;
        int hitPercent = accesses != 0 ? (100 * mHitCount / accesses) : 0;
        return String.format("LruCache[maxSize=%d,hits=%d,misses=%d,hitRate=%d%%]", mMaxSize, mHitCount, mMissCount, hitPercent);
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/Pair.java`:

```java
package android.util;

public class Pair<F, S>
{
    public final F first;
    public final S second;

    public Pair(F first, S second)
    {
        this.first = first;
        this.second = second;
    }

    public static <A, B> Pair<A, B> create(A first, B second)
    {
        return new Pair<>(first, second);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof Pair)) return false;

        Pair<?, ?> compared = (Pair<?, ?>)other;
        return java.util.Objects.equals(first, compared.first) && java.util.Objects.equals(second, compared.second);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return java.util.Objects.hash(first, second);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Pair{" + first + " " + second + "}";
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/PathParser.java`:

```java
package android.util;

import android.graphics.Path;

public class PathParser
{
    public static Path createPathFromPathData(String data)
    {
        Path path = new Path();
        if (!parseInto(data, path)) return null;

        return path;
    }

    public static boolean canParse(String data)
    {
        return parse(data, new CountingSink());
    }

    private static final class CountingSink implements Sink
    {
        @Override
        public void moveTo(float x, float y)
        {
        }

        @Override
        public void lineTo(float x, float y)
        {
        }

        @Override
        public void quadTo(float controlX, float controlY, float x, float y)
        {
        }

        @Override
        public void cubicTo(float firstX, float firstY, float secondX, float secondY, float x, float y)
        {
        }

        @Override
        public void close()
        {
        }
    }

    public static boolean parseInto(String data, Path path)
    {
        if (path == null) return false;

        return parse(data, new PathSink(path));
    }

    interface Sink
    {
        void moveTo(float x, float y);

        void lineTo(float x, float y);

        void quadTo(float controlX, float controlY, float x, float y);

        void cubicTo(float firstX, float firstY, float secondX, float secondY, float x, float y);

        void close();
    }

    private static final class PathSink implements Sink
    {
        private final Path mPath;

        PathSink(Path path)
        {
            mPath = path;
        }

        @Override
        public void moveTo(float x, float y)
        {
            mPath.moveTo(x, y);
        }

        @Override
        public void lineTo(float x, float y)
        {
            mPath.lineTo(x, y);
        }

        @Override
        public void quadTo(float controlX, float controlY, float x, float y)
        {
            mPath.quadTo(controlX, controlY, x, y);
        }

        @Override
        public void cubicTo(float firstX, float firstY, float secondX, float secondY, float x, float y)
        {
            mPath.cubicTo(firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, x, y);
        }

        @Override
        public void close()
        {
            mPath.close();
        }
    }

    static boolean parse(String data, Sink path)
    {
        if (data == null || path == null) return false;

        Cursor cursor = new Cursor(data);

        float currentX = 0;
        float currentY = 0;
        float startX = 0;
        float startY = 0;
        float lastControlX = 0;
        float lastControlY = 0;

        char previous = 0;
        char command = 0;

        while (true)
        {
            cursor.skipSeparators();
            if (cursor.done()) break;

            char next = cursor.peek();

            if (isCommand(next))
            {
                command = next;
                cursor.advance();
            }
            else if (command == 0)
            {
                return false;
            }
            else if (command == 'M')
            {
                command = 'L';
            }
            else if (command == 'm')
            {
                command = 'l';
            }

            boolean relative = Character.isLowerCase(command);
            char normalised = Character.toUpperCase(command);

            switch (normalised)
            {
                case 'M':
                {
                    float x = cursor.number();
                    float y = cursor.number();
                    if (cursor.failed()) return false;

                    currentX = relative ? currentX + x : x;
                    currentY = relative ? currentY + y : y;
                    startX = currentX;
                    startY = currentY;

                    path.moveTo(currentX, currentY);
                    break;
                }

                case 'L':
                {
                    float x = cursor.number();
                    float y = cursor.number();
                    if (cursor.failed()) return false;

                    currentX = relative ? currentX + x : x;
                    currentY = relative ? currentY + y : y;

                    path.lineTo(currentX, currentY);
                    break;
                }

                case 'H':
                {
                    float x = cursor.number();
                    if (cursor.failed()) return false;

                    currentX = relative ? currentX + x : x;
                    path.lineTo(currentX, currentY);
                    break;
                }

                case 'V':
                {
                    float y = cursor.number();
                    if (cursor.failed()) return false;

                    currentY = relative ? currentY + y : y;
                    path.lineTo(currentX, currentY);
                    break;
                }

                case 'C':
                {
                    float firstX = cursor.number();
                    float firstY = cursor.number();
                    float secondX = cursor.number();
                    float secondY = cursor.number();
                    float endX = cursor.number();
                    float endY = cursor.number();
                    if (cursor.failed()) return false;

                    if (relative)
                    {
                        firstX += currentX;
                        firstY += currentY;
                        secondX += currentX;
                        secondY += currentY;
                        endX += currentX;
                        endY += currentY;
                    }

                    path.cubicTo(firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY);

                    lastControlX = secondX;
                    lastControlY = secondY;
                    currentX = endX;
                    currentY = endY;
                    break;
                }

                case 'S':
                {
                    float secondX = cursor.number();
                    float secondY = cursor.number();
                    float endX = cursor.number();
                    float endY = cursor.number();
                    if (cursor.failed()) return false;

                    if (relative)
                    {
                        secondX += currentX;
                        secondY += currentY;
                        endX += currentX;
                        endY += currentY;
                    }

                    float firstX = currentX;
                    float firstY = currentY;

                    if (previous == 'C' || previous == 'S')
                    {
                        firstX = 2 * currentX - lastControlX;
                        firstY = 2 * currentY - lastControlY;
                    }

                    path.cubicTo(firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY);

                    lastControlX = secondX;
                    lastControlY = secondY;
                    currentX = endX;
                    currentY = endY;
                    break;
                }

                case 'Q':
                {
                    float controlX = cursor.number();
                    float controlY = cursor.number();
                    float endX = cursor.number();
                    float endY = cursor.number();
                    if (cursor.failed()) return false;

                    if (relative)
                    {
                        controlX += currentX;
                        controlY += currentY;
                        endX += currentX;
                        endY += currentY;
                    }

                    path.quadTo(controlX, controlY, endX, endY);

                    lastControlX = controlX;
                    lastControlY = controlY;
                    currentX = endX;
                    currentY = endY;
                    break;
                }

                case 'T':
                {
                    float endX = cursor.number();
                    float endY = cursor.number();
                    if (cursor.failed()) return false;

                    if (relative)
                    {
                        endX += currentX;
                        endY += currentY;
                    }

                    float controlX = currentX;
                    float controlY = currentY;

                    if (previous == 'Q' || previous == 'T')
                    {
                        controlX = 2 * currentX - lastControlX;
                        controlY = 2 * currentY - lastControlY;
                    }

                    path.quadTo(controlX, controlY, endX, endY);

                    lastControlX = controlX;
                    lastControlY = controlY;
                    currentX = endX;
                    currentY = endY;
                    break;
                }

                case 'A':
                {
                    float radiusX = cursor.number();
                    float radiusY = cursor.number();
                    float rotation = cursor.number();
                    boolean largeArc = cursor.flag();
                    boolean sweep = cursor.flag();
                    float endX = cursor.number();
                    float endY = cursor.number();
                    if (cursor.failed()) return false;

                    if (relative)
                    {
                        endX += currentX;
                        endY += currentY;
                    }

                    arcTo(path, currentX, currentY, endX, endY, radiusX, radiusY, rotation, largeArc, sweep);

                    currentX = endX;
                    currentY = endY;
                    break;
                }

                case 'Z':
                {
                    path.close();
                    currentX = startX;
                    currentY = startY;
                    break;
                }

                default:
                    return false;
            }

            previous = normalised;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static boolean isCommand(char value)
    {
        switch (Character.toUpperCase(value))
        {
            case 'M':
            case 'L':
            case 'H':
            case 'V':
            case 'C':
            case 'S':
            case 'Q':
            case 'T':
            case 'A':
            case 'Z':
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    private static void arcTo(Sink path, float fromX, float fromY, float toX, float toY, float radiusX, float radiusY,
                              float rotationDegrees, boolean largeArc, boolean sweep)
    {
        if (fromX == toX && fromY == toY) return;

        if (radiusX == 0 || radiusY == 0)
        {
            path.lineTo(toX, toY);
            return;
        }

        radiusX = Math.abs(radiusX);
        radiusY = Math.abs(radiusY);

        double rotation = Math.toRadians(rotationDegrees);
        double cosine = Math.cos(rotation);
        double sine = Math.sin(rotation);

        double halfDeltaX = (fromX - toX) / 2.0;
        double halfDeltaY = (fromY - toY) / 2.0;

        double turnedX = cosine * halfDeltaX + sine * halfDeltaY;
        double turnedY = -sine * halfDeltaX + cosine * halfDeltaY;

        double scaledX = turnedX / radiusX;
        double scaledY = turnedY / radiusY;
        double overshoot = scaledX * scaledX + scaledY * scaledY;

        if (overshoot > 1)
        {
            double growth = Math.sqrt(overshoot);
            radiusX = (float) (radiusX * growth);
            radiusY = (float) (radiusY * growth);
            scaledX /= growth;
            scaledY /= growth;
        }

        double numerator = 1.0 - scaledX * scaledX - scaledY * scaledY;
        if (numerator < 0) numerator = 0;

        double factor = Math.sqrt(numerator / (scaledX * scaledX + scaledY * scaledY));
        if (largeArc == sweep) factor = -factor;

        double centreTurnedX = factor * radiusX * scaledY;
        double centreTurnedY = -factor * radiusY * scaledX;

        double centreX = cosine * centreTurnedX - sine * centreTurnedY + (fromX + toX) / 2.0;
        double centreY = sine * centreTurnedX + cosine * centreTurnedY + (fromY + toY) / 2.0;

        double startAngle = angleBetween(1, 0, (turnedX - centreTurnedX) / radiusX, (turnedY - centreTurnedY) / radiusY);
        double sweepAngle = angleBetween((turnedX - centreTurnedX) / radiusX, (turnedY - centreTurnedY) / radiusY,
                                         (-turnedX - centreTurnedX) / radiusX, (-turnedY - centreTurnedY) / radiusY);

        if (!sweep && sweepAngle > 0) sweepAngle -= 2 * Math.PI;
        else if (sweep && sweepAngle < 0) sweepAngle += 2 * Math.PI;

        emitArc(path, centreX, centreY, radiusX, radiusY, startAngle, sweepAngle, cosine, sine);
    }

    private static double angleBetween(double firstX, double firstY, double secondX, double secondY)
    {
        double dot = firstX * secondX + firstY * secondY;
        double length = Math.sqrt((firstX * firstX + firstY * firstY) * (secondX * secondX + secondY * secondY));

        if (length == 0) return 0;

        double cosine = dot / length;
        if (cosine > 1) cosine = 1;
        if (cosine < -1) cosine = -1;

        double angle = Math.acos(cosine);
        return firstX * secondY - firstY * secondX < 0 ? -angle : angle;
    }

    private static void emitArc(Sink path, double centreX, double centreY, float radiusX, float radiusY, double startAngle,
                                double sweepAngle, double cosine, double sine)
    {
        int segments = (int) Math.ceil(Math.abs(sweepAngle) / (Math.PI / 2));
        if (segments < 1) segments = 1;

        double step = sweepAngle / segments;
        double control = 4.0 / 3.0 * Math.tan(step / 4.0);

        double angle = startAngle;

        for (int segment = 0; segment < segments; segment++)
        {
            double next = angle + step;

            double sineStart = Math.sin(angle);
            double cosineStart = Math.cos(angle);
            double sineEnd = Math.sin(next);
            double cosineEnd = Math.cos(next);

            double firstX = radiusX * (cosineStart - control * sineStart);
            double firstY = radiusY * (sineStart + control * cosineStart);
            double secondX = radiusX * (cosineEnd + control * sineEnd);
            double secondY = radiusY * (sineEnd - control * cosineEnd);
            double endX = radiusX * cosineEnd;
            double endY = radiusY * sineEnd;

            path.cubicTo((float) (centreX + cosine * firstX - sine * firstY),
                         (float) (centreY + sine * firstX + cosine * firstY),
                         (float) (centreX + cosine * secondX - sine * secondY),
                         (float) (centreY + sine * secondX + cosine * secondY),
                         (float) (centreX + cosine * endX - sine * endY),
                         (float) (centreY + sine * endX + cosine * endY));

            angle = next;
        }
    }

    private static final class Cursor
    {
        private final String mText;
        private int mAt;
        private boolean mFailed;

        Cursor(String text)
        {
            mText = text;
        }

        boolean done()
        {
            return mAt >= mText.length();
        }

        boolean failed()
        {
            return mFailed;
        }

        char peek()
        {
            return mText.charAt(mAt);
        }

        void advance()
        {
            mAt++;
        }

        void skipSeparators()
        {
            while (mAt < mText.length())
            {
                char value = mText.charAt(mAt);
                if (value != ' ' && value != ',' && value != '\t' && value != '\n' && value != '\r') break;

                mAt++;
            }
        }

        boolean flag()
        {
            skipSeparators();
            if (mAt >= mText.length())
            {
                mFailed = true;
                return false;
            }

            char value = mText.charAt(mAt);
            if (value != '0' && value != '1')
            {
                mFailed = true;
                return false;
            }

            mAt++;
            return value == '1';
        }

        float number()
        {
            skipSeparators();

            int start = mAt;
            boolean seenDigit = false;
            boolean seenDot = false;

            if (mAt < mText.length() && (mText.charAt(mAt) == '-' || mText.charAt(mAt) == '+')) mAt++;

            while (mAt < mText.length())
            {
                char value = mText.charAt(mAt);

                if (value >= '0' && value <= '9')
                {
                    seenDigit = true;
                    mAt++;
                    continue;
                }

                if (value == '.' && !seenDot)
                {
                    seenDot = true;
                    mAt++;
                    continue;
                }

                if ((value == 'e' || value == 'E') && seenDigit)
                {
                    int mark = mAt;
                    mAt++;

                    if (mAt < mText.length() && (mText.charAt(mAt) == '-' || mText.charAt(mAt) == '+')) mAt++;

                    if (mAt < mText.length() && mText.charAt(mAt) >= '0' && mText.charAt(mAt) <= '9')
                    {
                        while (mAt < mText.length() && mText.charAt(mAt) >= '0' && mText.charAt(mAt) <= '9') mAt++;
                        continue;
                    }

                    mAt = mark;
                }

                break;
            }

            if (!seenDigit)
            {
                mFailed = true;
                return 0;
            }

            try
            {
                return Float.parseFloat(mText.substring(start, mAt));
            }
            catch (NumberFormatException failure)
            {
                mFailed = true;
                return 0;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    public static final String concatGroups(Matcher matcher)
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        int count = matcher.groupCount();

        for (int index = 1; index <= count; index++)
        {
            String group = matcher.group(index);
            if (group != null) builder.append(group);
        }

        return builder.toString();
    }

    public static final String digitsAndPlusOnly(Matcher matcher)
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        String matching = matcher.group();

        for (int index = 0, size = matching.length(); index < size; index++)
        {
            char character = matching.charAt(index);
            if (character == '+' || Character.isDigit(character)) builder.append(character);
        }

        return builder.toString();
    }
```

`java/android/util/Property.java`:

```java
package android.util;

import java.lang.reflect.Method;

public abstract class Property<T, V>
{
    private final Class<V> mType;
    private final String mName;

    public Property(Class<V> type, String name)
    {
        mType = type;
        mName = name;
    }

    public static <T, V> Property<T, V> of(Class<T> hostType, Class<V> valueType, String name)
    {
        return new ReflectiveProperty<T, V>(hostType, valueType, name);
    }

    public boolean isReadOnly()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void set(T object, V value)
    {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("this property is read only: " + mName);
    }

    public abstract V get(T object);

    public String getName()
    {
        return mName;
    }

    public Class<V> getType()
    {
        return mType;
    }

    private static final class ReflectiveProperty<T, V> extends Property<T, V>
    {
        private Method mGetter;
        private Method mSetter;

        ReflectiveProperty(Class<T> hostType, Class<V> valueType, String name)
        {
            super(valueType, name);

            String capitalised = Character.toUpperCase(name.charAt(0)) + name.substring(1);

            try
            {
                mGetter = hostType.getMethod("get" + capitalised);
            }
            catch (NoSuchMethodException ignored)
            {
                try
                {
                    mGetter = hostType.getMethod("is" + capitalised);
                }
                catch (NoSuchMethodException alsoIgnored)
                {
                }
            }

            try
            {
                mSetter = hostType.getMethod("set" + capitalised, valueType);
            }
            catch (NoSuchMethodException ignored)
            {
            }
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isReadOnly()
        {
            return mSetter == null;
        }

        @Override
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        public V get(T object)
        {
            if (mGetter == null) return null;

            try
            {
                return (V)mGetter.invoke(object);
            }
            catch (ReflectiveOperationException failure)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void set(T object, V value)
        {
            if (mSetter == null) throw new UnsupportedOperationException("this property is read only: " + getName());

            try
            {
                mSetter.invoke(object, value);
            }
            catch (ReflectiveOperationException failure)
            {
                throw new UnsupportedOperationException("could not set " + getName(), failure);
            }
        }
    }
}
```
