`java/android/util/Range.java`:

```java
package android.util;

public final class Range<T extends Comparable<? super T>>
{
    private final T mLower;
    private final T mUpper;

    public Range(T lower, T upper)
    {
        if (lower == null || upper == null) throw new NullPointerException("bounds");
        if (lower.compareTo(upper) > 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("lower must be less than or equal to upper");

        mLower = lower;
        mUpper = upper;
    }

    public static <T extends Comparable<? super T>> Range<T> create(T lower, T upper)
    {
        return new Range<>(lower, upper);
    }

    public T getLower()
    {
        return mLower;
    }

    public T getUpper()
    {
        return mUpper;
    }

    public boolean contains(T value)
    {
        return mLower.compareTo(value) <= 0 && mUpper.compareTo(value) >= 0;
    }

    public boolean contains(Range<T> other)
    {
        return contains(other.mLower) && contains(other.mUpper);
    }

    public T clamp(T value)
    {
        if (mLower.compareTo(value) > 0) return mLower;
        if (mUpper.compareTo(value) < 0) return mUpper;

        return value;
    }

    public Range<T> intersect(Range<T> other)
    {
        T lower = mLower.compareTo(other.mLower) >= 0 ? mLower : other.mLower;
        T upper = mUpper.compareTo(other.mUpper) <= 0 ? mUpper : other.mUpper;

        return new Range<>(lower, upper);
    }

    public Range<T> intersect(T lower, T upper)
    {
        return intersect(new Range<>(lower, upper));
    }

    public Range<T> extend(Range<T> other)
    {
        T lower = mLower.compareTo(other.mLower) <= 0 ? mLower : other.mLower;
        T upper = mUpper.compareTo(other.mUpper) >= 0 ? mUpper : other.mUpper;

        return new Range<>(lower, upper);
    }

    public Range<T> extend(T lower, T upper)
    {
        return extend(new Range<>(lower, upper));
    }

    public Range<T> extend(T value)
    {
        if (value == null) throw new NullPointerException("value must not be null");

        return extend(value, value);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof Range)) return false;

        Range<?> candidate = (Range<?>)other;
        return mLower.equals(candidate.mLower) && mUpper.equals(candidate.mUpper);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mLower.hashCode() * 31 + mUpper.hashCode();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "[" + mLower + ", " + mUpper + "]";
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/Rational.java`:

```java
package android.util;

public final class Rational extends Number implements Comparable<Rational>
{
    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;

    public static final Rational NaN = new Rational(0, 0);
    public static final Rational POSITIVE_INFINITY = new Rational(1, 0);
    public static final Rational NEGATIVE_INFINITY = new Rational(-1, 0);
    public static final Rational ZERO = new Rational(0, 1);

    private final int mNumerator;
    private final int mDenominator;

    public Rational(int numerator, int denominator)
    {
        if (denominator < 0)
        {
            numerator = -numerator;
            denominator = -denominator;
        }

        if (denominator == 0 && numerator > 0)
        {
            mNumerator = 1;
            mDenominator = 0;
        }
        else if (denominator == 0 && numerator < 0)
        {
            mNumerator = -1;
            mDenominator = 0;
        }
        else if (denominator == 0)
        {
            mNumerator = 0;
            mDenominator = 0;
        }
        else if (numerator == 0)
        {
            mNumerator = 0;
            mDenominator = 1;
        }
        else
        {
            int divisor = gcd(numerator, denominator);
            mNumerator = numerator / divisor;
            mDenominator = denominator / divisor;
        }
    }

    public int getNumerator()
    {
        return mNumerator;
    }

    public int getDenominator()
    {
        return mDenominator;
    }

    public boolean isNaN()
    {
        return mDenominator == 0 && mNumerator == 0;
    }

    public boolean isInfinite()
    {
        return mNumerator != 0 && mDenominator == 0;
    }

    public boolean isFinite()
    {
        return mDenominator != 0;
    }

    public boolean isZero()
    {
        return isFinite() && mNumerator == 0;
    }

    private boolean isPositiveInfinity()
    {
        return mDenominator == 0 && mNumerator > 0;
    }

    private boolean isNegativeInfinity()
    {
        return mDenominator == 0 && mNumerator < 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof Rational)) return false;

        Rational rational = (Rational)other;
        return mNumerator == rational.mNumerator && mDenominator == rational.mDenominator;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        if (isNaN()) return "NaN";
        if (isPositiveInfinity()) return "Infinity";
        if (isNegativeInfinity()) return "-Infinity";

        return mNumerator + "/" + mDenominator;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        int numeratorFlipped = mNumerator << 16 | mNumerator >>> 16;
        return mDenominator ^ numeratorFlipped;
    }

    private static int gcd(int numerator, int denominator)
    {
        int first = numerator;
        int second = denominator;

        while (second != 0)
        {
            int previous = second;
            second = first % second;
            first = previous;
        }

        return Math.abs(first);
    }

    @Override
    public double doubleValue()
    {
        return (double)mNumerator / (double)mDenominator;
    }

    @Override
    public float floatValue()
    {
        return (float)mNumerator / (float)mDenominator;
    }

    @Override
    public int intValue()
    {
        if (isPositiveInfinity()) return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        if (isNegativeInfinity()) return Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        if (isNaN()) return 0;

        return mNumerator / mDenominator;
    }

    @Override
    public long longValue()
    {
        if (isPositiveInfinity()) return Long.MAX_VALUE;
        if (isNegativeInfinity()) return Long.MIN_VALUE;
        if (isNaN()) return 0;

        return mNumerator / mDenominator;
    }

    @Override
    public short shortValue()
    {
        return (short)intValue();
    }

    @Override
    public int compareTo(Rational other)
    {
        if (other == null) throw new NullPointerException("another must not be null");

        if (equals(other)) return 0;
        if (isNaN()) return 1;
        if (other.isNaN()) return -1;
        if (isPositiveInfinity() || other.isNegativeInfinity()) return 1;
        if (isNegativeInfinity() || other.isPositiveInfinity()) return -1;

        long thisNumerator = (long)mNumerator * other.mDenominator;
        long otherNumerator = (long)other.mNumerator * mDenominator;

        if (thisNumerator < otherNumerator) return -1;
        if (thisNumerator > otherNumerator) return 1;
        return 0;
    }

    public static Rational parseRational(String string) throws NumberFormatException
    {
        if (string == null) throw new NullPointerException("string must not be null");

        if (string.equals("NaN")) return NaN;
        if (string.equals("Infinity")) return POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        if (string.equals("-Infinity")) return NEGATIVE_INFINITY;

        int separator = string.indexOf(':');
        if (separator < 0) separator = string.indexOf('/');
        if (separator < 0) throw invalidRational(string, "missing colon or slash");

        try
        {
            return new Rational(Integer.parseInt(string.substring(0, separator)), Integer.parseInt(string.substring(separator + 1)));
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException failure)
        {
            throw invalidRational(string, "numerator or denominator not an integer");
        }
    }

    private static NumberFormatException invalidRational(String string, String cause)
    {
        return new NumberFormatException("Invalid Rational: \"" + string + "\"");
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/Size.java`:

```java
package android.util;

public final class Size
{
    private final int mWidth;
    private final int mHeight;

    public Size(int width, int height)
    {
        mWidth = width;
        mHeight = height;
    }

    public int getWidth()
    {
        return mWidth;
    }

    public int getHeight()
    {
        return mHeight;
    }

    public static Size parseSize(String text)
    {
        if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("text");

        int separator = text.indexOf('*');
        if (separator < 0) separator = text.indexOf('x');
        if (separator < 0) throw new NumberFormatException("Invalid Size: \"" + text + "\"");

        return new Size(Integer.parseInt(text.substring(0, separator)), Integer.parseInt(text.substring(separator + 1)));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof Size)) return false;

        Size candidate = (Size)other;
        return candidate.mWidth == mWidth && candidate.mHeight == mHeight;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mHeight ^ ((mWidth << 16) | (mWidth >>> 16));
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mWidth + "x" + mHeight;
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/SparseArray.java`:

```java
package android.util;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class SparseArray<E> implements Cloneable
{
    private final LinkedHashMap<Integer, E> mEntries = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private ArrayList<Integer> mSortedKeys;

    public SparseArray()
    {
    }

    public SparseArray(int initialCapacity)
    {
    }

    public void put(int key, E value)
    {
        mEntries.put(key, value);
        mSortedKeys = null;
    }

    public E get(int key)
    {
        return mEntries.get(key);
    }

    public E get(int key, E valueIfKeyNotFound)
    {
        E value = mEntries.get(key);
        return value == null ? valueIfKeyNotFound : value;
    }

    public void remove(int key)
    {
        delete(key);
    }

    public void delete(int key)
    {
        mEntries.remove(key);
        mSortedKeys = null;
    }

    public void removeAt(int index)
    {
        Integer key = keyAtOrNull(index);
        if (key != null) delete(key);
    }

    public void removeAtRange(int index, int size)
    {
        int end = Math.min(size(), index + size);
        ArrayList<Integer> keys = new ArrayList<>(sortedKeys());
        for (int position = index; position < end; position++)
        {
            mEntries.remove(keys.get(position));
        }
        mSortedKeys = null;
    }

    public void set(int key, E value)
    {
        put(key, value);
    }

    public boolean contentEquals(SparseArray<?> other)
    {
        if (other == null) return false;

        int size = size();
        if (size != other.size()) return false;

        for (int index = 0; index < size; index++)
        {
            if (keyAt(index) != other.keyAt(index) || !java.util.Objects.equals(valueAt(index), other.valueAt(index))) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public int contentHashCode()
    {
        int hash = 0;
        int size = size();
        for (int index = 0; index < size; index++)
        {
            int key = keyAt(index);
            E value = valueAt(index);
            hash = 31 * hash + key;
            hash = 31 * hash + java.util.Objects.hashCode(value);
        }
        return hash;
    }

    public void clear()
    {
        mEntries.clear();
        mSortedKeys = null;
    }

    public int size()
    {
        return mEntries.size();
    }

    public int keyAt(int index)
    {
        Integer key = keyAtOrNull(index);
        return key == null ? 0 : key;
    }

    public E valueAt(int index)
    {
        Integer key = keyAtOrNull(index);
        return key == null ? null : mEntries.get(key);
    }

    public void setValueAt(int index, E value)
    {
        Integer key = keyAtOrNull(index);
        if (key != null) mEntries.put(key, value);
    }

    public int indexOfKey(int key)
    {
        return sortedKeys().indexOf(key);
    }

    public int indexOfValue(E value)
    {
        ArrayList<Integer> keys = sortedKeys();
        for (int index = 0; index < keys.size(); index++)
        {
            if (mEntries.get(keys.get(index)) == value) return index;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    public void append(int key, E value)
    {
        put(key, value);
    }

    public boolean contains(int key)
    {
        return mEntries.containsKey(key);
    }

    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public SparseArray<E> clone()
    {
        SparseArray<E> copy = new SparseArray<>();
        for (Map.Entry<Integer, E> entry : mEntries.entrySet())
        {
            copy.mEntries.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
        }
        return copy;
    }

    private Integer keyAtOrNull(int index)
    {
        ArrayList<Integer> keys = sortedKeys();
        return index >= 0 && index < keys.size() ? keys.get(index) : null;
    }

    private ArrayList<Integer> sortedKeys()
    {
        if (mSortedKeys == null)
        {
            mSortedKeys = new ArrayList<>(mEntries.keySet());
            java.util.Collections.sort(mSortedKeys);
        }
        return mSortedKeys;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "SparseArray" + mEntries;
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/SparseBooleanArray.java`:

```java
package android.util;

import java.util.Arrays;

public class SparseBooleanArray implements Cloneable
{
    private int[] mKeys;
    private boolean[] mValues;
    private int mSize;

    public SparseBooleanArray()
    {
        this(10);
    }

    public SparseBooleanArray(int initialCapacity)
    {
        int capacity = Math.max(0, initialCapacity);
        mKeys = new int[capacity];
        mValues = new boolean[capacity];
    }

    public boolean get(int key)
    {
        return get(key, false);
    }

    public boolean get(int key, boolean valueIfKeyNotFound)
    {
        int index = Arrays.binarySearch(mKeys, 0, mSize, key);
        return index < 0 ? valueIfKeyNotFound : mValues[index];
    }

    public void put(int key, boolean value)
    {
        int index = Arrays.binarySearch(mKeys, 0, mSize, key);

        if (index >= 0)
        {
            mValues[index] = value;
            return;
        }

        insertAt(~index, key, value);
    }

    public void append(int key, boolean value)
    {
        if (mSize != 0 && key <= mKeys[mSize - 1])
        {
            put(key, value);
            return;
        }

        insertAt(mSize, key, value);
    }

    public void delete(int key)
    {
        int index = Arrays.binarySearch(mKeys, 0, mSize, key);
        if (index >= 0) removeAt(index);
    }

    public void removeAt(int index)
    {
        if (index >= mSize) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException(index);

        System.arraycopy(mKeys, index + 1, mKeys, index, mSize - (index + 1));
        System.arraycopy(mValues, index + 1, mValues, index, mSize - (index + 1));
        mSize--;
    }

    public int size()
    {
        return mSize;
    }

    public int keyAt(int index)
    {
        if (index >= mSize) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException(index);

        return mKeys[index];
    }

    public boolean valueAt(int index)
    {
        if (index >= mSize) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException(index);

        return mValues[index];
    }

    public void setValueAt(int index, boolean value)
    {
        if (index >= mSize) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException(index);

        mValues[index] = value;
    }

    public void setKeyAt(int index, int key)
    {
        if (index >= mSize) throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException(index);

        mKeys[index] = key;
    }

    public int indexOfKey(int key)
    {
        return Arrays.binarySearch(mKeys, 0, mSize, key);
    }

    public int indexOfValue(boolean value)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mSize; index++)
        {
            if (mValues[index] == value) return index;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public void clear()
    {
        mSize = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public SparseBooleanArray clone()
    {
        try
        {
            SparseBooleanArray copy = (SparseBooleanArray)super.clone();
            copy.mKeys = mKeys.clone();
            copy.mValues = mValues.clone();
            return copy;
        }
        catch (CloneNotSupportedException failure)
        {
            throw new AssertionError(failure);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        int hash = mSize;

        for (int index = 0; index < mSize; index++) hash = 31 * hash + mKeys[index] | (mValues[index] ? 1 : 0);

        return hash;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof SparseBooleanArray)) return false;

        SparseBooleanArray that = (SparseBooleanArray)other;
        if (mSize != that.mSize) return false;

        for (int index = 0; index < mSize; index++)
        {
            if (mKeys[index] != that.mKeys[index] || mValues[index] != that.mValues[index]) return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        if (mSize <= 0) return "{}";

        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(mSize * 28);
        builder.append('{');

        for (int index = 0; index < mSize; index++)
        {
            if (index > 0) builder.append(", ");

            builder.append(mKeys[index]).append('=').append(mValues[index]);
        }

        return builder.append('}').toString();
    }

    private void insertAt(int index, int key, boolean value)
    {
        if (mSize == mKeys.length)
        {
            int capacity = mSize < 4 ? 8 : mSize * 2;
            mKeys = Arrays.copyOf(mKeys, capacity);
            mValues = Arrays.copyOf(mValues, capacity);
        }

        System.arraycopy(mKeys, index, mKeys, index + 1, mSize - index);
        System.arraycopy(mValues, index, mValues, index + 1, mSize - index);
        mKeys[index] = key;
        mValues[index] = value;
        mSize++;
    }
}
```

```java
    private final LinkedHashMap<Integer, Long> mValues = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    {
    }

    public SparseLongArray(int initialCapacity)
    {
    }

    public long get(int key)
    {
        return get(key, 0);
    }

    public long get(int key, long valueIfKeyNotFound)
    {
        Long value = mValues.get(key);
        return value == null ? valueIfKeyNotFound : value;
    }

    public void put(int key, long value)
    {
        mValues.put(key, value);
    }

    public void append(int key, long value)
    {
        mValues.put(key, value);
    }

    public void delete(int key)
    {
        mValues.remove(key);
    }

    public void removeAt(int index)
    {
        int key = keyAt(index);
        if (key != Integer.MIN_VALUE) mValues.remove(key);
    }

    public int size()
    {
        return mValues.size();
    }

    public int keyAt(int index)
    {
        int at = 0;
        for (Integer key : mValues.keySet())
        {
            if (at++ == index) return key;
        }

        return Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    }

    public long valueAt(int index)
    {
        int at = 0;
        for (Long value : mValues.values())
        {
            if (at++ == index) return value;
        }

        return 0;
    }

    public int indexOfKey(int key)
    {
        int at = 0;
        for (Integer candidate : mValues.keySet())
        {
            if (candidate == key) return at;
            at++;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public int indexOfValue(long value)
    {
        int at = 0;
        for (Long candidate : mValues.values())
        {
            if (candidate == value) return at;
            at++;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public void clear()
    {
        mValues.clear();
    }

    @Override
    public SparseLongArray clone()
    {
        SparseLongArray copy = new SparseLongArray();
        copy.mValues.putAll(mValues);

        return copy;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {

    }
```

`java/android/util/StateSet.java`:

```java
package android.util;

public class StateSet
{
    public static final int[] WILD_CARD = new int[0];
    public static final int[] NOTHING = new int[] {0};

    private StateSet()
    {
    }

    public static boolean isWildCard(int[] stateSetOrSpec)
    {
        return stateSetOrSpec.length == 0 || stateSetOrSpec[0] == 0;
    }

    public static boolean stateSetMatches(int[] stateSpec, int[] stateSet)
    {
        if (stateSet == null) return stateSpec == null || isWildCard(stateSpec);

        for (int specState : stateSpec)
        {
            if (specState == 0) return true;

            boolean mustMatch = specState > 0;
            int wanted = mustMatch ? specState : -specState;

            boolean present = false;
            for (int state : stateSet)
            {
                if (state == 0) break;
                if (state == wanted)
                {
                    present = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (present != mustMatch) return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static boolean stateSetMatches(int[] stateSpec, int state)
    {
        for (int specState : stateSpec)
        {
            if (specState == 0) return true;

            if (specState > 0)
            {
                if (specState != state) return false;
                continue;
            }

            if (-specState == state) return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static int[] trimStateSet(int[] states, int newSize)
    {
        if (states.length == newSize) return states;

        int[] trimmed = new int[newSize];
        System.arraycopy(states, 0, trimmed, 0, newSize);
        return trimmed;
    }

    public static String dump(int[] states)
    {
        StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
        for (int state : states)
        {
            if (text.length() != 0) text.append(' ');
            text.append(state);
        }
        return text.toString();
    }
}
```

`java/android/util/TimingLogger.java`:

```java
package android.util;

import java.util.ArrayList;

public class TimingLogger
{
    private final ArrayList<Long> mTimes = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<String> mLabels = new ArrayList<>();

    private String mTag;
    private String mLabel;
    private boolean mEnabled;

    public TimingLogger(String tag, String label)
    {
        reset(tag, label);
    }

    public void reset(String tag, String label)
    {
        mTag = tag;
        mLabel = label;
        reset();
    }

    public void reset()
    {
        mEnabled = Log.isLoggable(mTag, Log.VERBOSE);

        mTimes.clear();
        mLabels.clear();

        addSplit(null);
    }

    public void addSplit(String splitLabel)
    {
        if (!mEnabled) return;

        mTimes.add(Long.valueOf(android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()));
        mLabels.add(splitLabel);
    }

    public void dumpToLog()
    {
        if (!mEnabled || mTimes.isEmpty()) return;

        Log.d(mTag, mLabel + ": begin");

        long first = mTimes.get(0).longValue();
        long previous = first;

        for (int index = 1; index < mTimes.size(); index++)
        {
            long now = mTimes.get(index).longValue();

            Log.d(mTag, mLabel + ":      " + (now - previous) + " ms, " + mLabels.get(index));
            previous = now;
        }

        Log.d(mTag, mLabel + ": end, " + (previous - first) + " ms");
    }
}
```

```java
    public static final int TYPE_INT_COLOR_ARGB4 = 0x1e;
    public static final int TYPE_INT_COLOR_RGB4 = 0x1f;
    public static final int TYPE_LAST_COLOR_INT = 0x1f;
    public static final int TYPE_LAST_INT = 0x1f;

    public static final int COMPLEX_UNIT_PX = 0;
    public static final int COMPLEX_UNIT_DIP = 1;
    public static final int COMPLEX_UNIT_SP = 2;
    public static final int COMPLEX_UNIT_PT = 3;
    public static final int COMPLEX_UNIT_IN = 4;
    public static final int COMPLEX_UNIT_MM = 5;
    public static final int COMPLEX_UNIT_FRACTION = 0;
    public static final int COMPLEX_UNIT_FRACTION_PARENT = 1;

    public static final int COMPLEX_UNIT_SHIFT = 0;
    public static final int COMPLEX_UNIT_MASK = 0xf;
    public static final int COMPLEX_RADIX_SHIFT = 4;
    public static final int COMPLEX_RADIX_MASK = 0x3;
    public static final int COMPLEX_RADIX_23p0 = 0;
    public static final int COMPLEX_RADIX_16p7 = 1;
    public static final int COMPLEX_RADIX_8p15 = 2;
    public static final int COMPLEX_RADIX_0p23 = 3;
    public static final int DATA_NULL_UNDEFINED = 0;
    public static final int DATA_NULL_EMPTY = 1;
    public static final int COMPLEX_MANTISSA_SHIFT = 8;
    public static final int COMPLEX_MANTISSA_MASK = 0xffffff;

    public static final int DENSITY_DEFAULT = 0;
    public static final int DENSITY_NONE = 0xffff;

    private static final float MANTISSA_MULTIPLIER = 1.0f / (1 << COMPLEX_MANTISSA_SHIFT);
    private static final float[] RADIX_MULTIPLIERS = {MANTISSA_MULTIPLIER, MANTISSA_MULTIPLIER / (1 << 7),
                                                      MANTISSA_MULTIPLIER / (1 << 15), MANTISSA_MULTIPLIER / (1 << 23)};

    public int type;
    public CharSequence string;
    public int data;
    public int assetCookie;
    public int resourceId;
    public int changingConfigurations = -1;
    public int density;
    public int sourceResourceId;

    public final float getFloat()
    {
        return Float.intBitsToFloat(data);
    }

    public int getComplexUnit()
    {
        return (data >> COMPLEX_UNIT_SHIFT) & COMPLEX_UNIT_MASK;
    }

    public static float complexToFloat(int complex)
    {
        return (complex & (COMPLEX_MANTISSA_MASK << COMPLEX_MANTISSA_SHIFT))
                * RADIX_MULTIPLIERS[(complex >> COMPLEX_RADIX_SHIFT) & COMPLEX_RADIX_MASK];
    }

    public static float complexToDimension(int data, DisplayMetrics metrics)
    {
        return applyDimension((data >> COMPLEX_UNIT_SHIFT) & COMPLEX_UNIT_MASK, complexToFloat(data), metrics);
    }

    public static int complexToDimensionPixelOffset(int data, DisplayMetrics metrics)
    {
        return (int)complexToDimension(data, metrics);
    }

    public static int complexToDimensionPixelSize(int data, DisplayMetrics metrics)
    {
        float value = complexToDimension(data, metrics);
        int rounded = (int)(value >= 0 ? value + 0.5f : value - 0.5f);

        if (rounded != 0) return rounded;
        if (value == 0) return 0;
        return value > 0 ? 1 : -1;
    }

    public static float applyDimension(int unit, float value, DisplayMetrics metrics)
    {
        switch (unit)
        {
            case COMPLEX_UNIT_PX: return value;
            case COMPLEX_UNIT_DIP: return value * metrics.density;
            case COMPLEX_UNIT_SP: return value * metrics.scaledDensity;
            case COMPLEX_UNIT_PT: return value * metrics.xdpi * (1.0f / 72);
            case COMPLEX_UNIT_IN: return value * metrics.xdpi;
            case COMPLEX_UNIT_MM: return value * metrics.xdpi * (1.0f / 25.4f);
            default: return 0;
        }
    }

    public static float deriveDimension(int unitToConvertTo, float pixelValue, DisplayMetrics metrics)
    {
        float base = applyDimension(unitToConvertTo, 1.0f, metrics);
        return base == 0 ? 0 : pixelValue / base;
    }

    public static float convertPixelsToDimension(int unitToConvertTo, float pixelValue, DisplayMetrics metrics)
    {
        return deriveDimension(unitToConvertTo, pixelValue, metrics);
    }

    public static float convertDimensionToPixels(int unitToConvertFrom, float value, DisplayMetrics metrics)
    {
        return applyDimension(unitToConvertFrom, value, metrics);
    }

    public boolean isColorType()
    {
        return type >= TYPE_FIRST_COLOR_INT && type <= TYPE_LAST_COLOR_INT;
    }

    public float getDimension(DisplayMetrics metrics)
    {
        return complexToDimension(data, metrics);
    }

    public final float getFraction(float base, float pbase)
    {
        return complexToFraction(data, base, pbase);
    }

    public static float complexToFraction(int data, float base, float pbase)
    {
        int unit = (data >> COMPLEX_UNIT_SHIFT) & COMPLEX_UNIT_MASK;
        float value = complexToFloat(data);
        return unit == COMPLEX_UNIT_FRACTION ? value * base : value * pbase;
    }

    public final CharSequence coerceToString()
    {
        if (type == TYPE_STRING) return string;
        return coerceToString(type, data);
    }

    public static String coerceToString(int type, int data)
    {
        switch (type)
        {
            case TYPE_NULL: return null;
            case TYPE_REFERENCE: return "@" + data;
            case TYPE_ATTRIBUTE: return "?" + data;
            case TYPE_FLOAT: return Float.toString(Float.intBitsToFloat(data));
            case TYPE_INT_HEX: return "0x" + Integer.toHexString(data);
            case TYPE_INT_BOOLEAN: return data != 0 ? "true" : "false";
            default: break;
        }

        if (type >= TYPE_FIRST_COLOR_INT && type <= TYPE_LAST_COLOR_INT) return "#" + Integer.toHexString(data);
        if (type >= TYPE_FIRST_INT && type <= TYPE_LAST_INT) return Integer.toString(data);
        return null;
    }

    public void setTo(TypedValue other)
    {
        type = other.type;
        string = other.string;
        data = other.data;
        assetCookie = other.assetCookie;
        resourceId = other.resourceId;
        changingConfigurations = other.changingConfigurations;
        density = other.density;
        sourceResourceId = other.sourceResourceId;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "TypedValue{t=0x" + Integer.toHexString(type) + "/d=0x" + Integer.toHexString(data) + "}";
    }
}
```

```java
public class Xml
{
    public enum Encoding
    {
        US_ASCII("US-ASCII"),
        UTF_8("UTF-8"),
        UTF_16("UTF-16"),
        ISO_8859_1("ISO-8859-1");

        private final String mName;

        Encoding(String name)
        {
            mName = name;
        }

        public String expectedName()

        }
    }

    public static String FEATURE_RELAXED = "http://xmlpull.org/v1/doc/features.html#relaxed";

    Xml()
    {
    }

    public static XmlPullParser newPullParser()
    {

        {

            throw new AssertionError(failure);
        }
        catch (InstantiationException failure)
        {
            throw new AssertionError(failure);
        }
        catch (IllegalAccessException failure)
        {
            throw new AssertionError(failure);
        }
    }

    public static AttributeSet asAttributeSet(XmlPullParser parser)
    {
        if (parser instanceof AttributeSet) return (AttributeSet)parser;

        return new ParserAttributeSet(parser);
    }

    public static Encoding findEncodingByName(String name) throws java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException
    {
        if (name == null) return Encoding.UTF_8;

        for (Encoding encoding : Encoding.values())
        {
            if (encoding.expectedName().equalsIgnoreCase(name)) return encoding;
        }

        throw new java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException(name);
    }

    public static void parse(String xml, org.xml.sax.ContentHandler contentHandler) throws org.xml.sax.SAXException
    {
        try
        {
            parse(new org.xml.sax.InputSource(new java.io.StringReader(xml)), contentHandler);
        }
        catch (java.io.IOException failure)
        {
            throw new AssertionError(failure);
        }
    }

    public static void parse(java.io.Reader in, org.xml.sax.ContentHandler contentHandler) throws java.io.IOException,
                                                                                               org.xml.sax.SAXException
    {
        parse(new org.xml.sax.InputSource(in), contentHandler);
    }

    public static void parse(java.io.InputStream in, Encoding encoding, org.xml.sax.ContentHandler contentHandler)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xml.sax.SAXException
    {
        org.xml.sax.InputSource source = new org.xml.sax.InputSource(in);
        source.setEncoding(encoding == null ? Encoding.UTF_8.expectedName() : encoding.expectedName());
        parse(source, contentHandler);
    }

    private static void parse(org.xml.sax.InputSource source, org.xml.sax.ContentHandler contentHandler)
        throws java.io.IOException, org.xml.sax.SAXException
    {
        try
        {
            javax.xml.parsers.SAXParserFactory factory = javax.xml.parsers.SAXParserFactory.newInstance();
            factory.setNamespaceAware(true);

            org.xml.sax.XMLReader reader = factory.newSAXParser().getXMLReader();
            reader.setContentHandler(contentHandler);
            reader.parse(source);
        }
        catch (javax.xml.parsers.ParserConfigurationException failure)
        {
            throw new org.xml.sax.SAXException(failure);
        }
    }

    private static final class ParserAttributeSet implements AttributeSet
    {
        private final XmlPullParser mParser;

        ParserAttributeSet(XmlPullParser parser)
        {
            mParser = parser;
        }

        @Override
        public int getAttributeCount()
        {
            return mParser.getAttributeCount();
        }

        @Override
        public String getAttributeName(int index)
        {
            return mParser.getAttributeName(index);
        }

        @Override
        public String getAttributeValue(int index)
        {
            return mParser.getAttributeValue(index);
        }

        @Override
        public String getAttributeValue(String namespace, String name)
        {
            return mParser.getAttributeValue(namespace, name);
        }

        @Override
        public String getPositionDescription()
        {
            return mParser.getPositionDescription();
        }

        @Override
        public int getAttributeNameResource(int index)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public int getAttributeListValue(String namespace, String attribute, String[] options, int defaultValue)
        {
            return indexOf(options, getAttributeValue(namespace, attribute), defaultValue);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean getAttributeBooleanValue(String namespace, String attribute, boolean defaultValue)
        {
            return booleanOf(getAttributeValue(namespace, attribute), defaultValue);
        }

        @Override
        public int getAttributeResourceValue(String namespace, String attribute, int defaultValue)
        {
            return integerOf(getAttributeValue(namespace, attribute), defaultValue);
        }

        @Override
        public int getAttributeIntValue(String namespace, String attribute, int defaultValue)
        {
            return integerOf(getAttributeValue(namespace, attribute), defaultValue);
        }

        @Override
        public int getAttributeUnsignedIntValue(String namespace, String attribute, int defaultValue)
        {
            return integerOf(getAttributeValue(namespace, attribute), defaultValue);
        }

        @Override
        public float getAttributeFloatValue(String namespace, String attribute, float defaultValue)
        {
            return floatOf(getAttributeValue(namespace, attribute), defaultValue);
        }

        @Override
        public int getAttributeListValue(int index, String[] options, int defaultValue)
        {
            return indexOf(options, getAttributeValue(index), defaultValue);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean getAttributeBooleanValue(int index, boolean defaultValue)
        {
            return booleanOf(getAttributeValue(index), defaultValue);
        }

        @Override
        public int getAttributeResourceValue(int index, int defaultValue)
        {
            return integerOf(getAttributeValue(index), defaultValue);
        }

        @Override
        public int getAttributeIntValue(int index, int defaultValue)
        {
            return integerOf(getAttributeValue(index), defaultValue);
        }

        @Override
        public int getAttributeUnsignedIntValue(int index, int defaultValue)
        {
            return integerOf(getAttributeValue(index), defaultValue);
        }

        @Override
        public float getAttributeFloatValue(int index, float defaultValue)
        {
            return floatOf(getAttributeValue(index), defaultValue);
        }

        @Override
        public String getIdAttribute()
        {
            return getAttributeValue(null, "id");
        }

        @Override
        public String getClassAttribute()
        {
            return getAttributeValue(null, "class");
        }

        @Override
        public int getIdAttributeResourceValue(int defaultValue)
        {
            return integerOf(getIdAttribute(), defaultValue);
        }

        @Override
        public int getStyleAttribute()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        private static int indexOf(String[] options, String value, int defaultValue)
        {
            if (options == null || value == null) return defaultValue;

            for (int index = 0; index < options.length; index++)
            {
                if (value.equals(options[index])) return index;
            }

            return defaultValue;
        }

        private static boolean booleanOf(String value, boolean defaultValue)
        {
            if (value == null) return defaultValue;

            return "true".equalsIgnoreCase(value) || "1".equals(value);
        }

        private static int integerOf(String value, int defaultValue)
        {
            if (value == null) return defaultValue;

            try
            {
                if (value.startsWith("@")) return Integer.parseInt(value.substring(1));
                if (value.startsWith("0x") || value.startsWith("0X")) return (int)Long.parseLong(value.substring(2), 16);

                return Integer.parseInt(value);
            }
            catch (NumberFormatException failure)
            {
                return defaultValue;
            }
        }

        private static float floatOf(String value, float defaultValue)
        {
            if (value == null) return defaultValue;

            try
            {
                return Float.parseFloat(value);
            }
            catch (NumberFormatException failure)
            {
                return defaultValue;
            }
        }
    }
```

```java
package android.view;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public abstract class AbsSavedState implements Parcelable
{
    public static final AbsSavedState EMPTY_STATE = new AbsSavedState()
    {
    };

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<AbsSavedState> CREATOR = new Parcelable.ClassLoaderCreator<AbsSavedState>()
    {
        @Override
        public AbsSavedState createFromParcel(Parcel source, ClassLoader loader)
        {
            Parcelable superState = source.readParcelable(loader);
            if (superState != null) throw new IllegalStateException("superState must be null");
            return EMPTY_STATE;
        }

        @Override
        public AbsSavedState createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return createFromParcel(source, null);
        }

        @Override
        public AbsSavedState[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new AbsSavedState[size];
        }
    };

    private final Parcelable mSuperState;

    private AbsSavedState()
    {
        mSuperState = null;
    }

    protected AbsSavedState(Parcelable superState)
    {
        if (superState == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("superState must not be null");
        mSuperState = superState != EMPTY_STATE ? superState : null;
    }

    protected AbsSavedState(Parcel source)
    {
        this(source, null);
    }

    protected AbsSavedState(Parcel source, ClassLoader loader)
    {
        Parcelable superState = source.readParcelable(loader);
        mSuperState = superState != null ? superState : EMPTY_STATE;
    }

    public final Parcelable getSuperState()
    {
        return mSuperState;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeParcelable(mSuperState, flags);
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/Choreographer.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.Message;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public final class Choreographer
{
    public static final int CALLBACK_INPUT = 0;
    public static final int CALLBACK_ANIMATION = 1;
    public static final int CALLBACK_INSETS_ANIMATION = 2;
    public static final int CALLBACK_TRAVERSAL = 3;
    public static final int CALLBACK_COMMIT = 4;

    private static final int CALLBACK_TYPE_COUNT = 5;
    private static final long FRAME_INTERVAL_MILLIS = 16;
    private static final long BACKSTOP_INTERVAL_MILLIS = 50;

    private static final ThreadLocal<Choreographer> THREAD_INSTANCE = new ThreadLocal<Choreographer>()
    {
        @Override
        protected Choreographer initialValue()
        {
            Looper looper = Looper.myLooper();
            if (looper == null) throw new IllegalStateException("The current thread must have a looper!");
            return new Choreographer(looper);
        }
    };

    private static final int FRAME_TIMELINE_COUNT = 3;

    private final Handler mHandler;
    private final ArrayList<Object> mFrameCallbacks = new ArrayList<>();
    private long mVsyncId;
    private final ArrayList<TypedCallback>[] mTypedCallbacks = newQueues();
    private final ArrayList<DelayedTypedCallback> mPendingDelayed = new ArrayList<>();
    private long mLastFrameTimeNanos;
    private boolean mTimerArmed;
    private final Runnable mTimerFrame = new TimerFrame(this);

    private Choreographer(Looper looper)
    {
        mHandler = new Handler(looper);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static ArrayList<TypedCallback>[] newQueues()
    {
        ArrayList<TypedCallback>[] queues = new ArrayList[CALLBACK_TYPE_COUNT];
        for (int index = 0; index < CALLBACK_TYPE_COUNT; index++)
        {
            queues[index] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        return queues;
    }

    public static Choreographer getInstance()
    {
        return THREAD_INSTANCE.get();
    }

    public void postFrameCallback(FrameCallback callback)
    {
        postFrameCallbackDelayed(callback, 0);
    }

    public void postFrameCallbackDelayed(FrameCallback callback, long delayMillis)
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("callback must not be null");

        if (delayMillis > 0)
        {
            Message message = Message.obtain(mHandler, new DelayedFrameCallback(this, callback));
            message.obj = callback;
            mHandler.sendMessageDelayed(message, delayMillis);
            return;
        }

        synchronized (mFrameCallbacks)
        {
            mFrameCallbacks.add(callback);
        }

        scheduleFrame();
    }

    public void removeFrameCallback(FrameCallback callback)
    {
        if (callback == null) return;

        synchronized (mFrameCallbacks)
        {
            mFrameCallbacks.remove(callback);
        }
        mHandler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(callback);
    }

    public void postVsyncCallback(VsyncCallback callback)
    {
        if (callback == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("callback must not be null");

        synchronized (mFrameCallbacks)
        {
            mFrameCallbacks.add(callback);
        }

        scheduleFrame();
    }

    public void removeVsyncCallback(VsyncCallback callback)
    {
        if (callback == null) return;

        synchronized (mFrameCallbacks)
        {
            mFrameCallbacks.remove(callback);
        }
    }

    private static long frameIntervalNanos()
    {
        float refreshRate = runtime.WindowBridge.refreshRate();
        if (refreshRate <= 0) refreshRate = runtime.WindowBridge.FALLBACK_REFRESH_RATE;

        return (long)(1000000000L / refreshRate);
    }

    public void doFrame(long frameTimeNanos)
    {
        mLastFrameTimeNanos = frameTimeNanos;

        if (mTimerArmed)
        {
            mTimerArmed = false;
            mHandler.removeCallbacks(mTimerFrame);
        }

        runTyped(CALLBACK_INPUT);
        runTyped(CALLBACK_ANIMATION);
        runTyped(CALLBACK_INSETS_ANIMATION);

        runFrameCallbacks(frameTimeNanos);

        runTyped(CALLBACK_TRAVERSAL);
        runTyped(CALLBACK_COMMIT);
    }

    private void runTyped(int type)
    {
        TypedCallback[] due;

        synchronized (mTypedCallbacks)
        {
            if (mTypedCallbacks[type].isEmpty()) return;

            due = mTypedCallbacks[type].toArray(new TypedCallback[0]);
            mTypedCallbacks[type].clear();
        }

        for (TypedCallback entry : due)
        {
            entry.action.run();
        }
    }

    private void runFrameCallbacks(long frameTimeNanos)
    {
        Object[] pending;

        synchronized (mFrameCallbacks)
        {
            if (mFrameCallbacks.isEmpty()) return;

            pending = mFrameCallbacks.toArray();
            mFrameCallbacks.clear();
        }

        FrameData frameData = null;

        for (Object callback : pending)
        {
            if (callback instanceof FrameCallback)
            {
                ((FrameCallback)callback).doFrame(frameTimeNanos);
                continue;
            }

            if (frameData == null) frameData = newFrameData(frameTimeNanos);
            ((VsyncCallback)callback).onVsync(frameData);
        }
    }

    private FrameData newFrameData(long frameTimeNanos)
    {
        long interval = frameIntervalNanos();
        FrameTimeline[] timelines = new FrameTimeline[FRAME_TIMELINE_COUNT];

        for (int index = 0; index < FRAME_TIMELINE_COUNT; index++)
        {
            long presentation = frameTimeNanos + interval * (index + 1);
            timelines[index] = new FrameTimeline(++mVsyncId, presentation, presentation - interval / 2);
        }

        return new FrameData(frameTimeNanos, timelines, 0);
    }

    public void postCallback(int callbackType, Runnable action, Object token)
    {
        postCallbackDelayed(callbackType, action, token, 0);
    }

    public void postCallbackDelayed(int callbackType, Runnable action, Object token, long delayMillis)
    {
        if (action == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("action must not be null");
        if (callbackType < 0 || callbackType >= CALLBACK_TYPE_COUNT)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("unknown callback type " + callbackType);
        }

        if (delayMillis > 0)
        {
            DelayedTypedCallback pending = new DelayedTypedCallback(this, callbackType, action, token);
            synchronized (mPendingDelayed)
            {
                mPendingDelayed.add(pending);
            }

            Message message = Message.obtain(mHandler, pending);
            message.obj = token;
            mHandler.sendMessageDelayed(message, delayMillis);
            return;
        }

        synchronized (mTypedCallbacks)
        {
            mTypedCallbacks[callbackType].add(new TypedCallback(action, token));
        }

        scheduleFrame();
    }

    public void removeCallbacks(int callbackType, Runnable action, Object token)
    {
        if (callbackType < 0 || callbackType >= CALLBACK_TYPE_COUNT) return;

        DelayedTypedCallback[] pending;
        synchronized (mPendingDelayed)
        {
            pending = mPendingDelayed.toArray(new DelayedTypedCallback[0]);
        }

        for (DelayedTypedCallback entry : pending)
        {
            if (entry.mType != callbackType) continue;
            if (action != null && entry.mAction != action) continue;
            if (token != null && entry.mToken != token) continue;

            mHandler.removeCallbacks(entry, entry.mToken);
            synchronized (mPendingDelayed)
            {
                mPendingDelayed.remove(entry);
            }
        }

        synchronized (mTypedCallbacks)
        {
            ArrayList<TypedCallback> queue = mTypedCallbacks[callbackType];
            for (int index = queue.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
            {
                TypedCallback entry = queue.get(index);
                if (action != null && entry.action != action) continue;
                if (token != null && entry.token != token) continue;
                queue.remove(index);
            }
        }

        mHandler.removeCallbacks(action, token);
    }

    private void scheduleFrame()
    {
        runtime.WindowBridge window = runtime.WindowBridge.get();
        if (window != null) window.requestFrame();

        if (mTimerArmed) return;

        mTimerArmed = true;
        mHandler.postDelayed(mTimerFrame, window != null ? BACKSTOP_INTERVAL_MILLIS : FRAME_INTERVAL_MILLIS);
    }

    public long getFrameTime()
    {
        return getFrameTimeNanos() / 1000000L;
    }

    public long getFrameTimeNanos()
    {
        return mLastFrameTimeNanos != 0 ? mLastFrameTimeNanos : SystemClock.uptimeNanos();
    }

    public interface FrameCallback
    {
        void doFrame(long frameTimeNanos);
    }

    public interface VsyncCallback
    {
        void onVsync(FrameData data);
    }

    public static class FrameData
    {
        private final long mFrameTimeNanos;
        private final FrameTimeline[] mFrameTimelines;
        private final int mPreferredIndex;

        FrameData(long frameTimeNanos, FrameTimeline[] frameTimelines, int preferredIndex)
        {
            mFrameTimeNanos = frameTimeNanos;
            mFrameTimelines = frameTimelines;
            mPreferredIndex = preferredIndex;
        }

        public long getFrameTimeNanos()
        {
            return mFrameTimeNanos;
        }

        public FrameTimeline[] getFrameTimelines()
        {
            return mFrameTimelines.clone();
        }

        public FrameTimeline getPreferredFrameTimeline()
        {
            return mFrameTimelines[mPreferredIndex];
        }
    }

    public static class FrameTimeline
    {
        private final long mVsyncId;
        private final long mExpectedPresentationTimeNanos;
        private final long mDeadlineNanos;

        FrameTimeline(long vsyncId, long expectedPresentationTimeNanos, long deadlineNanos)
        {
            mVsyncId = vsyncId;
            mExpectedPresentationTimeNanos = expectedPresentationTimeNanos;
            mDeadlineNanos = deadlineNanos;
        }

        public long getVsyncId()
        {
            return mVsyncId;
        }

        public long getExpectedPresentationTimeNanos()
        {
            return mExpectedPresentationTimeNanos;
        }

        public long getDeadlineNanos()
        {
            return mDeadlineNanos;
        }
    }

    private static final class TypedCallback
    {
        final Runnable action;
        final Object token;

        TypedCallback(Runnable action, Object token)
        {
            this.action = action;
            this.token = token;
        }
    }

    private static final class TimerFrame implements Runnable
    {
        private final Choreographer mChoreographer;

        TimerFrame(Choreographer choreographer)
        {
            mChoreographer = choreographer;
        }

        @Override
        public void run()
        {
            mChoreographer.doFrame(SystemClock.uptimeNanos());
        }
    }

    private static final class DelayedFrameCallback implements Runnable
    {
        private final Choreographer mChoreographer;
        private final FrameCallback mCallback;

        DelayedFrameCallback(Choreographer choreographer, FrameCallback callback)
        {
            mChoreographer = choreographer;
            mCallback = callback;
        }

        @Override
        public void run()
        {
            mChoreographer.postFrameCallback(mCallback);
        }
    }

    private static final class DelayedTypedCallback implements Runnable
    {
        private final Choreographer mChoreographer;
        private final int mType;
        private final Runnable mAction;
        private final Object mToken;

        DelayedTypedCallback(Choreographer choreographer, int type, Runnable action, Object token)
        {
            mChoreographer = choreographer;
            mType = type;
            mAction = action;
            mToken = token;
        }

        @Override
        public void run()
        {
            synchronized (mChoreographer.mPendingDelayed)
            {
                mChoreographer.mPendingDelayed.remove(this);
            }
            mChoreographer.postCallback(mType, mAction, mToken);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view;

import android.content.ClipData;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class ContentInfo implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int SOURCE_APP = 0;
    public static final int SOURCE_CLIPBOARD = 1;
    public static final int SOURCE_INPUT_METHOD = 2;
    public static final int SOURCE_DRAG_AND_DROP = 3;
    public static final int SOURCE_AUTOFILL = 4;
    public static final int SOURCE_PROCESS_TEXT = 5;

    public static final int FLAG_CONVERT_TO_PLAIN_TEXT = 1;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<ContentInfo> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ContentInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public ContentInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            ClipData clip = ClipData.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            int contentSource = source.readInt();
            int flags = source.readInt();
            String link = source.readString();
            Bundle extras = source.readBundle();

            Builder builder = new Builder(clip, contentSource).setFlags(flags).setExtras(extras);
            if (link != null) builder.setLinkUri(Uri.parse(link));
            return builder.build();
        }

        @Override
        public ContentInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ContentInfo[size];
        }
    };

    private final ClipData mClip;
    private final int mSource;
    private final int mFlags;
    private final Uri mLinkUri;
    private final Bundle mExtras;

    private ContentInfo(Builder builder)
    {
        mClip = builder.mClip;
        mSource = builder.mSource;
        mFlags = builder.mFlags;
        mLinkUri = builder.mLinkUri;
        mExtras = builder.mExtras;
    }

    public ClipData getClip()
    {
        return mClip;
    }

    public int getSource()
    {
        return mSource;
    }

    public int getFlags()
    {
        return mFlags;
    }

    public Uri getLinkUri()
    {
        return mLinkUri;
    }

    public Bundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "ContentInfo{clip=" + mClip + ", source=" + mSource + ", flags=" + mFlags + ", linkUri=" + mLinkUri + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        mClip.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        dest.writeInt(mSource);
        dest.writeInt(mFlags);
        dest.writeString(mLinkUri == null ? null : mLinkUri.toString());
        dest.writeBundle(mExtras);
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private ClipData mClip;
        private int mSource;
        private int mFlags;
        private Uri mLinkUri;
        private Bundle mExtras;

        public Builder(ContentInfo other)
        {
            mClip = other.mClip;
            mSource = other.mSource;
            mFlags = other.mFlags;
            mLinkUri = other.mLinkUri;
            mExtras = other.mExtras;
        }

        public Builder(ClipData clip, int source)
        {
            mClip = clip;
            mSource = source;
        }

        public Builder setClip(ClipData clip)
        {
            mClip = clip;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setSource(int source)
        {
            mSource = source;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setFlags(int flags)
        {
            mFlags = flags;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setLinkUri(Uri linkUri)
        {
            mLinkUri = linkUri;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setExtras(Bundle extras)
        {
            mExtras = extras;
            return this;
        }

        public ContentInfo build()
        {
            if (mClip == null) throw new NullPointerException("clip must not be null");
            if (mSource < SOURCE_APP || mSource > SOURCE_PROCESS_TEXT) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid source " + mSource);
            if ((mFlags & ~FLAG_CONVERT_TO_PLAIN_TEXT) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid flags " + mFlags);
            return new ContentInfo(this);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/ContextThemeWrapper.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.ContextWrapper;
import android.content.res.AssetManager;
import android.content.res.Configuration;
import android.content.res.Resources;

public class ContextThemeWrapper extends ContextWrapper
{
    private int mThemeResource;
    private Resources.Theme mTheme;
    private LayoutInflater mInflater;
    private Configuration mOverrideConfiguration;
    private Resources mResources;
    private boolean mResourcesRequested;

    public ContextThemeWrapper()
    {
        super(null);
    }

    public ContextThemeWrapper(Context base, int themeResourceId)
    {
        super(base);
        mThemeResource = themeResourceId;
    }

    public ContextThemeWrapper(Context base, Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        super(base);
        mTheme = theme;
    }

    @Override
    protected void attachBaseContext(Context base)
    {
        super.attachBaseContext(base);
    }

    public void applyOverrideConfiguration(Configuration overrideConfiguration)
    {
        if (mResources != null || mResourcesRequested)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("getResources() or getAssets() has already been called");
        }
        if (mOverrideConfiguration != null) throw new IllegalStateException("Override configuration has already been set");

        mOverrideConfiguration = new Configuration(overrideConfiguration);
    }

    public Configuration getOverrideConfiguration()
    {
        return mOverrideConfiguration;
    }

    @Override
    public AssetManager getAssets()
    {
        return getResourcesInternal().getAssets();
    }

    @Override
    public Resources getResources()
    {
        return getResourcesInternal();
    }

    private Resources getResourcesInternal()
    {
        if (mResources != null) return mResources;

        if (mOverrideConfiguration == null)
        {
            Resources resources = super.getResources();
            if (resources != null) mResourcesRequested = true;
            return resources;
        }

        mResources = createConfigurationContext(mOverrideConfiguration).getResources();
        return mResources;
    }

    public int getThemeResId()
    {
        return mThemeResource;
    }

    public void setTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        mTheme = theme;
    }

    @Override
    public void setTheme(int resourceId)
    {
        if (mThemeResource == resourceId) return;

        mThemeResource = resourceId;

        if (mTheme != null)
        {
            mTheme.release();
            mTheme = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public Resources.Theme getTheme()
    {
        if (mTheme != null) return mTheme;

        if (mThemeResource == 0) return getBaseContext().getTheme();

        mTheme = getResources().newTheme();

        Resources.Theme base = getBaseContext().getTheme();
        if (base != null) mTheme.setTo(base);

        onApplyThemeResource(mTheme, mThemeResource, true);
        return mTheme;
    }

    @Override
    public Object getSystemService(String name)
    {
        if (Context.LAYOUT_INFLATER_SERVICE.equals(name))
        {
            if (mInflater == null)
            {
                LayoutInflater base = (LayoutInflater)getBaseContext().getSystemService(name);
                mInflater = base != null ? base.cloneInContext(this) : new RuntimeLayoutInflater(this);
            }
            return mInflater;
        }
        return getBaseContext().getSystemService(name);
    }

    protected void onApplyThemeResource(Resources.Theme theme, int resourceId, boolean first)
    {
        theme.applyStyle(resourceId, true);
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/DecorView.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Canvas;

public class DecorView extends ViewGroup
{
    private final ViewGroup mContentParent;
    private Window mWindow;
    private View mActionBarView;
    private android.graphics.Insets mBarInsets = android.graphics.Insets.NONE;

    public DecorView(Context context)
    {
        super(context);

        mContentParent = new ContentFrame(context);
        mContentParent.setId(Window.ID_ANDROID_CONTENT);
        addView(mContentParent, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT));
    }

    void attachWindow(Window window)
    {
        mWindow = window;
    }

    public Window getWindow()
    {
        return mWindow;
    }

    public ViewGroup getContentParent()
    {
        return mContentParent;
    }

    public void setActionBarView(View view)
    {
        if (mActionBarView == view) return;
        if (mActionBarView != null) removeView(mActionBarView);

        mActionBarView = view;
        if (view != null)
        {
            if (view.getParent() instanceof ViewGroup) ((ViewGroup)view.getParent()).removeView(view);
            addView(view, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        }

        applyContentPadding();
        requestLayout();
    }

    public View getActionBarView()
    {
        return mActionBarView;
    }

    private boolean hasActionBar()
    {
        return mActionBarView != null && mActionBarView.getVisibility() != GONE;
    }

    private void applyContentPadding()
    {
        int top = hasActionBar() ? 0 : mBarInsets.top;
        mContentParent.setPadding(mBarInsets.left, top, mBarInsets.right, mBarInsets.bottom);
    }

    @Override
    public WindowInsets onApplyWindowInsets(WindowInsets insets)
    {
        if (insets == null) return WindowInsets.empty();

        mBarInsets = insets.getSystemWindowInsets();
        applyContentPadding();
        if (mActionBarView != null) mActionBarView.setPadding(mBarInsets.left, 0, mBarInsets.right, 0);

        mContentParent.dispatchApplyWindowInsets(insets);

        return WindowInsets.CONSUMED;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        int width = MeasureSpec.getSize(widthMeasureSpec);
        int height = MeasureSpec.getSize(heightMeasureSpec);
        boolean exactWidth = MeasureSpec.getMode(widthMeasureSpec) == MeasureSpec.EXACTLY;
        boolean exactHeight = MeasureSpec.getMode(heightMeasureSpec) == MeasureSpec.EXACTLY;

        int minimumWidth = Math.min(getMinimumWidth(), width);
        int measuredWidth = exactWidth ? width : 0;
        int measuredHeight = exactHeight ? height : 0;
        int barHeight = 0;

        if (hasActionBar())
        {
            int barWidthSpec = exactWidth ? MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(width, MeasureSpec.EXACTLY) : widthMeasureSpec;
            mActionBarView.measure(barWidthSpec, MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(height, MeasureSpec.AT_MOST));
            barHeight = mBarInsets.top + mActionBarView.getMeasuredHeight();
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < getChildCount(); index++)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            if (child.getVisibility() == GONE || child == mActionBarView) continue;

            int contentHeight = Math.max(height - barHeight, 0);
            int childWidthSpec = exactWidth ? MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(width, MeasureSpec.EXACTLY) : widthMeasureSpec;
            int childHeightSpec = exactHeight ? MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(contentHeight, MeasureSpec.EXACTLY)
                                              : MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(contentHeight, MeasureSpec.getMode(heightMeasureSpec));

            child.measure(childWidthSpec, childHeightSpec);

            if (!exactWidth && child.getMeasuredWidth() < minimumWidth)
            {
                child.measure(MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(minimumWidth, MeasureSpec.EXACTLY), childHeightSpec);
            }

            if (!exactWidth) measuredWidth = Math.max(measuredWidth, child.getMeasuredWidth());
            if (!exactHeight) measuredHeight = Math.max(measuredHeight, child.getMeasuredHeight() + barHeight);
        }

        if (!exactWidth) measuredWidth = Math.max(measuredWidth, minimumWidth);

        setMeasuredDimension(measuredWidth, measuredHeight);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onLayout(boolean changed, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        int width = right - left;
        int height = bottom - top;
        int contentTop = 0;

        if (hasActionBar())
        {
            int barTop = mBarInsets.top;
            int barBottom = Math.min(barTop + mActionBarView.getMeasuredHeight(), height);
            mActionBarView.layout(0, barTop, width, barBottom);
            contentTop = barBottom;
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < getChildCount(); index++)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            if (child.getVisibility() == GONE || child == mActionBarView) continue;
            child.layout(0, contentTop, width, height);
        }
    }

    private static final class ContentFrame extends ViewGroup
    {
        ContentFrame(Context context)
        {
            super(context);
        }

        @Override
        protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
        {
            int widthMode = MeasureSpec.getMode(widthMeasureSpec);
            int heightMode = MeasureSpec.getMode(heightMeasureSpec);
            int width = MeasureSpec.getSize(widthMeasureSpec);
            int height = MeasureSpec.getSize(heightMeasureSpec);

            int horizontal = getPaddingLeft() + getPaddingRight();
            int vertical = getPaddingTop() + getPaddingBottom();

            int innerWidth = Math.max(width - horizontal, 0);
            int innerHeight = Math.max(height - vertical, 0);

            measureChildren(MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(innerWidth, widthMode), MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(innerHeight, heightMode));

            int widest = 0;
            int tallest = 0;

            for (int index = 0; index < getChildCount(); index++)
            {
                View child = getChildAt(index);
                if (child.getVisibility() == GONE) continue;

                widest = Math.max(widest, child.getMeasuredWidth());
                tallest = Math.max(tallest, child.getMeasuredHeight());
            }

            int measuredWidth = widthMode == MeasureSpec.EXACTLY ? width : widest + horizontal;
            int measuredHeight = heightMode == MeasureSpec.EXACTLY ? height : tallest + vertical;

            if (widthMode == MeasureSpec.AT_MOST) measuredWidth = Math.min(measuredWidth, width);
            if (heightMode == MeasureSpec.AT_MOST) measuredHeight = Math.min(measuredHeight, height);

            setMeasuredDimension(measuredWidth, measuredHeight);
        }

        @Override
        protected void onLayout(boolean changed, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
        {
            int innerLeft = getPaddingLeft();
            int innerTop = getPaddingTop();
            int width = Math.max(right - left - innerLeft - getPaddingRight(), 0);
            int height = Math.max(bottom - top - innerTop - getPaddingBottom(), 0);

            for (int index = 0; index < getChildCount(); index++)
            {
                View child = getChildAt(index);
                if (child.getVisibility() == GONE) continue;

                int childWidth = child.getMeasuredWidth();
                int childHeight = child.getMeasuredHeight();
                if (childWidth <= 0) childWidth = width;
                if (childHeight <= 0) childHeight = height;

                child.layout(innerLeft, innerTop, innerLeft + childWidth, innerTop + childHeight);
            }
        }

        @Override
        protected void dispatchDraw(Canvas canvas)
        {
            super.dispatchDraw(canvas);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    public void getSize(Point outSize)
    {

        outSize.set(mWidth, mHeight);
    }

    {

        outSize.set(0, 0, mWidth, mHeight);
    }

    public void getCurrentSizeRange(Point outSmallestSize, Point outLargestSize)
    {
        int shorter = Math.min(mWidth, mHeight);
        int longer = Math.max(mWidth, mHeight);

        if (outSmallestSize != null) outSmallestSize.set(shorter, shorter);
        if (outLargestSize != null) outLargestSize.set(longer, longer);
    }

    public void getMetrics(DisplayMetrics outMetrics)
    {
        if (outMetrics == null) return;

        outMetrics.widthPixels = mWidth;
        outMetrics.heightPixels = mHeight;
        outMetrics.densityDpi = mDensityDpi;
        outMetrics.density = mDensityDpi / (float)DisplayMetrics.DENSITY_DEFAULT;
        outMetrics.scaledDensity = outMetrics.density;
        outMetrics.xdpi = mDensityDpi;
        outMetrics.ydpi = mDensityDpi;
    }

    public void getRealMetrics(DisplayMetrics outMetrics)
    {
        getMetrics(outMetrics);
    }

    public void getRealSize(Point outSize)
    {
        getSize(outSize);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view;

import android.graphics.Insets;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.graphics.Rect;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class DisplayCutout
{
    private static final int BOUNDS_POSITION_LEFT = 0;
    private static final int BOUNDS_POSITION_TOP = 1;
    private static final int BOUNDS_POSITION_RIGHT = 2;
    private static final int BOUNDS_POSITION_BOTTOM = 3;

    private final Insets mSafeInsets;
    private final Insets mWaterfallInsets;
    private final Rect[] mBounds = {new Rect(), new Rect(), new Rect(), new Rect()};
    private final List<Rect> mExtraRects = new ArrayList<>();

    public DisplayCutout(Insets safeInsets, Rect boundLeft, Rect boundTop, Rect boundRight, Rect boundBottom)
    {
        this(safeInsets, boundLeft, boundTop, boundRight, boundBottom, null);
    }

    public DisplayCutout(Insets safeInsets, Rect boundLeft, Rect boundTop, Rect boundRight, Rect boundBottom, Insets waterfallInsets)
    {
        mSafeInsets = safeInsets == null ? Insets.NONE : safeInsets;
        mWaterfallInsets = waterfallInsets == null ? Insets.NONE : waterfallInsets;

        assign(BOUNDS_POSITION_LEFT, boundLeft);
        assign(BOUNDS_POSITION_TOP, boundTop);
        assign(BOUNDS_POSITION_RIGHT, boundRight);
        assign(BOUNDS_POSITION_BOTTOM, boundBottom);
    }

    public DisplayCutout(Insets safeInsets, List<Rect> boundingRects)
    {
        mSafeInsets = safeInsets == null ? Insets.NONE : safeInsets;
        mWaterfallInsets = Insets.NONE;

        if (boundingRects == null) return;

        for (Rect rect : boundingRects)
        {
            if (rect == null || rect.isEmpty()) continue;

            int position = sideOf(rect);
            if (position >= 0 && mBounds[position].isEmpty()) mBounds[position].set(rect);
            else mExtraRects.add(new Rect(rect));
        }
    }

    @Deprecated
    public DisplayCutout(Rect safeInsets, List<Rect> boundingRects)
    {
        this(safeInsets == null ? Insets.NONE : Insets.of(safeInsets.left, safeInsets.top, safeInsets.right, safeInsets.bottom),
             boundingRects);
    }

    private void assign(int position, Rect rect)
    {
        if (rect != null) mBounds[position].set(rect);
    }

    private int sideOf(Rect rect)
    {
        if (mSafeInsets.top > 0 && rect.top <= 0) return BOUNDS_POSITION_TOP;
        if (mSafeInsets.left > 0 && rect.left <= 0) return BOUNDS_POSITION_LEFT;
        if (mSafeInsets.bottom > 0) return BOUNDS_POSITION_BOTTOM;
        if (mSafeInsets.right > 0) return BOUNDS_POSITION_RIGHT;
        return -1;
    }

    public int getSafeInsetLeft()
    {
        return mSafeInsets.left;
    }

    public int getSafeInsetTop()
    {
        return mSafeInsets.top;
    }

    public int getSafeInsetRight()
    {
        return mSafeInsets.right;
    }

    public int getSafeInsetBottom()
    {
        return mSafeInsets.bottom;
    }

    public Insets getWaterfallInsets()
    {
        return mWaterfallInsets;
    }

    public List<Rect> getBoundingRects()
    {
        List<Rect> rects = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Rect rect : mBounds)
        {
            if (!rect.isEmpty()) rects.add(new Rect(rect));
        }

        for (Rect rect : mExtraRects)
        {
            rects.add(new Rect(rect));
        }

        return rects;
    }

    public Rect getBoundingRectLeft()
    {
        return new Rect(mBounds[BOUNDS_POSITION_LEFT]);
    }

    public Rect getBoundingRectTop()
    {
        return new Rect(mBounds[BOUNDS_POSITION_TOP]);
    }

    public Rect getBoundingRectRight()
    {
        return new Rect(mBounds[BOUNDS_POSITION_RIGHT]);
    }

    public Rect getBoundingRectBottom()
    {
        return new Rect(mBounds[BOUNDS_POSITION_BOTTOM]);
    }

    public Path getCutoutPath()
    {
        List<Rect> rects = getBoundingRects();
        if (rects.isEmpty()) return null;

        Path path = new Path();
        for (Rect rect : rects)
        {
            path.addRect(rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom, Path.Direction.CW);
        }

        return path;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (other == this) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof DisplayCutout)) return false;

        DisplayCutout cutout = (DisplayCutout)other;
        return mSafeInsets.equals(cutout.mSafeInsets) && mWaterfallInsets.equals(cutout.mWaterfallInsets)
               && getBoundingRects().equals(cutout.getBoundingRects());
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        int result = mSafeInsets.hashCode();
        result = result * 48271 + mWaterfallInsets.hashCode();
        result = result * 48271 + getBoundingRects().hashCode();
        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "DisplayCutout{insets=" + mSafeInsets + " waterfall=" + mWaterfallInsets + " boundingRect=" + getBoundingRects() + "}";
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view;

import android.graphics.Path;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.Objects;

public final class DisplayShape implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<DisplayShape> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<DisplayShape>()
    {
        @Override
        public DisplayShape createFromParcel(Parcel in)
        {
            int width = in.readInt();
            int height = in.readInt();
            float scale = in.readFloat();
            int rotation = in.readInt();
            int offsetX = in.readInt();
            int offsetY = in.readInt();
            return new DisplayShape(width, height, scale, rotation, offsetX, offsetY);
        }

        @Override
        public DisplayShape[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new DisplayShape[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mDisplayWidth;
    private final int mDisplayHeight;
    private final float mPhysicalPixelDisplaySizeRatio;
    private final int mRotation;
    private final int mOffsetX;
    private final int mOffsetY;

    private DisplayShape(int displayWidth, int displayHeight, float physicalPixelDisplaySizeRatio, int rotation, int offsetX,
                         int offsetY)
    {
        mDisplayWidth = displayWidth;
        mDisplayHeight = displayHeight;
        mPhysicalPixelDisplaySizeRatio = physicalPixelDisplaySizeRatio;
        mRotation = rotation;
        mOffsetX = offsetX;
        mOffsetY = offsetY;
    }

    static DisplayShape rectangle(int width, int height)
    {
        return new DisplayShape(width, height, 1.0f, Surface.ROTATION_0, 0, 0);
    }

    DisplayShape offset(int dx, int dy)
    {
        return new DisplayShape(mDisplayWidth, mDisplayHeight, mPhysicalPixelDisplaySizeRatio, mRotation, mOffsetX + dx, mOffsetY + dy);
    }

    public Path getPath()
    {
        Path path = new Path();
        path.addRect(mOffsetX, mOffsetY, mOffsetX + mDisplayWidth * mPhysicalPixelDisplaySizeRatio,
                     mOffsetY + mDisplayHeight * mPhysicalPixelDisplaySizeRatio, Path.Direction.CW);
        return path;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof DisplayShape)) return false;

        DisplayShape shape = (DisplayShape)other;
        return mDisplayWidth == shape.mDisplayWidth && mDisplayHeight == shape.mDisplayHeight
               && mPhysicalPixelDisplaySizeRatio == shape.mPhysicalPixelDisplaySizeRatio && mRotation == shape.mRotation
               && mOffsetX == shape.mOffsetX && mOffsetY == shape.mOffsetY;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mDisplayWidth, mDisplayHeight, mPhysicalPixelDisplaySizeRatio, mRotation, mOffsetX, mOffsetY);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "DisplayShape{ spec=rect displayWidth=" + mDisplayWidth + " displayHeight=" + mDisplayHeight
               + " physicalPixelDisplaySizeRatio=" + mPhysicalPixelDisplaySizeRatio + " rotation=" + mRotation + " offsetX=" + mOffsetX
               + " offsetY=" + mOffsetY + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mDisplayWidth);
        dest.writeInt(mDisplayHeight);
        dest.writeFloat(mPhysicalPixelDisplaySizeRatio);
        dest.writeInt(mRotation);
        dest.writeInt(mOffsetX);
        dest.writeInt(mOffsetY);
    }
}
```
