```java
package android.view;

import android.content.ClipData;
import android.content.ClipDescription;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public class DragEvent implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int ACTION_DRAG_STARTED = 1;
    public static final int ACTION_DRAG_LOCATION = 2;
    public static final int ACTION_DROP = 3;
    public static final int ACTION_DRAG_ENDED = 4;
    public static final int ACTION_DRAG_ENTERED = 5;
    public static final int ACTION_DRAG_EXITED = 6;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<DragEvent> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<DragEvent>()
    {
        @Override
        public DragEvent createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int action = source.readInt();
            float x = source.readFloat();
            float y = source.readFloat();
            boolean result = source.readBoolean();
            ClipData clip = source.readInt() != 0 ? ClipData.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source) : null;
            ClipDescription description = clip != null ? clip.getDescription() : null;
            return obtain(action, x, y, null, description, clip, result);
        }

        @Override
        public DragEvent[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new DragEvent[size];
        }
    };

    private int mAction;
    private float mX;
    private float mY;
    private ClipDescription mClipDescription;
    private ClipData mClipData;
    private Object mLocalState;
    private boolean mResult;

    private DragEvent()
    {
    }

    static DragEvent obtain(int action, float x, float y, Object localState, ClipDescription description, ClipData data, boolean result)
    {
        DragEvent event = new DragEvent();
        event.mAction = action;
        event.mX = x;
        event.mY = y;
        event.mLocalState = localState;
        event.mClipDescription = description;
        event.mClipData = data;
        event.mResult = result;
        return event;
    }

    static DragEvent obtain(DragEvent source)
    {
        return obtain(source.mAction, source.mX, source.mY, source.mLocalState, source.mClipDescription, source.mClipData, source.mResult);
    }

    void setLocation(float x, float y)
    {
        mX = x;
        mY = y;
    }

    void setAction(int action)
    {
        mAction = action;
    }

    public int getAction()
    {
        return mAction;
    }

    public float getX()
    {
        return mX;
    }

    public float getY()
    {
        return mY;
    }

    public ClipData getClipData()
    {
        return mClipData;
    }

    public ClipDescription getClipDescription()
    {
        return mClipDescription;
    }

    public Object getLocalState()
    {
        return mLocalState;
    }

    public boolean getResult()
    {
        return mResult;
    }

    public final void recycle()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "DragEvent{action=" + mAction + " @ (" + mX + ", " + mY + ") desc=" + mClipDescription + " data=" + mClipData
               + " local=" + mLocalState + " result=" + mResult + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mAction);
        dest.writeFloat(mX);
        dest.writeFloat(mY);
        dest.writeBoolean(mResult);
        dest.writeInt(mClipData != null ? 1 : 0);
        if (mClipData != null) mClipData.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/FocusFinder.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.graphics.Rect;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public class FocusFinder
{
    private static final ThreadLocal<FocusFinder> sFocusFinder = new ThreadLocal<FocusFinder>()
    {
        @Override
        protected FocusFinder initialValue()
        {
            return new FocusFinder();
        }
    };

    private final Rect mFocusedRect = new Rect();
    private final Rect mOtherRect = new Rect();
    private final Rect mBestCandidateRect = new Rect();

    private FocusFinder()
    {
    }

    public static FocusFinder getInstance()
    {
        return sFocusFinder.get();
    }

    public final View findNextFocus(ViewGroup root, View focused, int direction)
    {
        return findNextFocus(root, focused, null, direction);
    }

    public View findNextFocusFromRect(ViewGroup root, Rect focusedRect, int direction)
    {
        mFocusedRect.set(focusedRect);
        return findNextFocus(root, null, mFocusedRect, direction);
    }

    public View findNextKeyboardNavigationCluster(View root, View currentCluster, int direction)
    {
        ArrayList<View> clusters = new ArrayList<>();
        root.addKeyboardNavigationClusters(clusters, direction);
        if (clusters.isEmpty()) return null;

        int index = currentCluster == null ? -1 : clusters.indexOf(currentCluster);
        if (direction == View.FOCUS_BACKWARD)
        {
            if (index <= 0) return clusters.get(clusters.size() - 1);
            return clusters.get(index - 1);
        }

        if (index < 0 || index + 1 >= clusters.size()) return clusters.get(0);
        return clusters.get(index + 1);
    }

    public View findNearestTouchable(ViewGroup root, int x, int y, int direction, int[] deltas)
    {
        ArrayList<View> touchables = root.getTouchables();
        int minDistance = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        View closest = null;
        int edgeSlop = ViewConfiguration.get(root.getContext()).getScaledEdgeSlop();
        Rect closestBounds = new Rect();
        Rect touchableBounds = mOtherRect;

        for (int index = 0; index < touchables.size(); index++)
        {
            View touchable = touchables.get(index);

            touchable.getDrawingRect(touchableBounds);
            root.offsetRectBetweenParentAndChild(touchable, touchableBounds, true, true);

            if (!isTouchCandidate(x, y, touchableBounds, direction)) continue;

            int distance = Integer.MAX_VALUE;

            switch (direction)
            {
                case View.FOCUS_LEFT:
                    distance = x - touchableBounds.right + 1;
                    break;
                case View.FOCUS_RIGHT:
                    distance = touchableBounds.left;
                    break;
                case View.FOCUS_UP:
                    distance = y - touchableBounds.bottom + 1;
                    break;
                case View.FOCUS_DOWN:
                    distance = touchableBounds.top;
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }

            if (distance < edgeSlop && (closest == null || closestBounds.contains(touchableBounds)
                                        || (!touchableBounds.contains(closestBounds) && distance < minDistance)))
            {
                minDistance = distance;
                closest = touchable;
                closestBounds.set(touchableBounds);

                switch (direction)
                {
                    case View.FOCUS_LEFT:
                        deltas[0] = -distance;
                        break;
                    case View.FOCUS_RIGHT:
                        deltas[0] = distance;
                        break;
                    case View.FOCUS_UP:
                        deltas[1] = -distance;
                        break;
                    case View.FOCUS_DOWN:
                        deltas[1] = distance;
                        break;
                    default:
                        break;
                }
            }
        }

        return closest;
    }

    private boolean isTouchCandidate(int x, int y, Rect destination, int direction)
    {
        switch (direction)
        {
            case View.FOCUS_LEFT:
                return destination.left <= x && destination.top <= y && y <= destination.bottom;
            case View.FOCUS_RIGHT:
                return destination.left >= x && destination.top <= y && y <= destination.bottom;
            case View.FOCUS_UP:
                return destination.top <= y && destination.left <= x && x <= destination.right;
            case View.FOCUS_DOWN:
                return destination.top >= y && destination.left <= x && x <= destination.right;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("direction must be one of {FOCUS_UP, FOCUS_DOWN, FOCUS_LEFT, FOCUS_RIGHT}.");
        }
    }

    private View findNextFocus(ViewGroup root, View focused, Rect focusedRect, int direction)
    {
        View next = null;

        if (focused != null) next = findNextUserSpecifiedFocus(root, focused, direction);
        if (next != null) return next;

        ArrayList<View> focusables = new ArrayList<>();
        root.addFocusables(focusables, direction);
        if (focusables.isEmpty()) return null;

        return findNextFocus(root, focused, focusedRect, direction, focusables);
    }

    private View findNextUserSpecifiedFocus(ViewGroup root, View focused, int direction)
    {
        int id = focused.getNextFocusId(direction);
        if (id == View.NO_ID) return null;

        View userSetNextFocus = root.findViewById(id);
        if (userSetNextFocus == null || userSetNextFocus == focused) return null;
        if (userSetNextFocus.isFocusable() && userSetNextFocus.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) return userSetNextFocus;

        return null;
    }

    private View findNextFocus(ViewGroup root, View focused, Rect focusedRect, int direction, ArrayList<View> focusables)
    {
        if (focused != null)
        {
            if (focusedRect == null) focusedRect = mFocusedRect;
            focused.getFocusedRect(focusedRect);
            root.offsetDescendantRectToMyCoords(focused, focusedRect);
        }
        else if (focusedRect == null)
        {
            focusedRect = mFocusedRect;

            switch (direction)
            {
                case View.FOCUS_RIGHT:
                case View.FOCUS_DOWN:
                case View.FOCUS_FORWARD:
                    setFocusTopLeft(root, focusedRect);
                    break;
                case View.FOCUS_LEFT:
                case View.FOCUS_UP:
                case View.FOCUS_BACKWARD:
                    setFocusBottomRight(root, focusedRect);
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
        }

        switch (direction)
        {
            case View.FOCUS_FORWARD:
            case View.FOCUS_BACKWARD:
                return findNextFocusInRelativeDirection(focusables, focused, direction);
            case View.FOCUS_UP:
            case View.FOCUS_DOWN:
            case View.FOCUS_LEFT:
            case View.FOCUS_RIGHT:
                return findNextFocusInAbsoluteDirection(focusables, root, focused, focusedRect, direction);
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown direction: " + direction);
        }
    }

    private View findNextFocusInRelativeDirection(ArrayList<View> focusables, View focused, int direction)
    {
        int count = focusables.size();
        if (count == 0) return null;

        if (direction == View.FOCUS_FORWARD)
        {
            if (focused != null)
            {
                int position = focusables.lastIndexOf(focused);
                if (position >= 0 && position + 1 < count) return focusables.get(position + 1);
            }
            return focusables.get(0);
        }

        if (focused != null)
        {
            int position = focusables.indexOf(focused);
            if (position > 0) return focusables.get(position - 1);
        }
        return focusables.get(count - 1);
    }

    private void setFocusBottomRight(ViewGroup root, Rect focusedRect)
    {
        int rootBottom = root.getScrollY() + root.getHeight();
        int rootRight = root.getScrollX() + root.getWidth();
        focusedRect.set(rootRight, rootBottom, rootRight, rootBottom);
    }

    private void setFocusTopLeft(ViewGroup root, Rect focusedRect)
    {
        int rootTop = root.getScrollY();
        int rootLeft = root.getScrollX();
        focusedRect.set(rootLeft, rootTop, rootLeft, rootTop);
    }

    View findNextFocusInAbsoluteDirection(ArrayList<View> focusables, ViewGroup root, View focused, Rect focusedRect, int direction)
    {
        mBestCandidateRect.set(focusedRect);

        switch (direction)
        {
            case View.FOCUS_LEFT:
                mBestCandidateRect.offset(focusedRect.width() + 1, 0);
                break;
            case View.FOCUS_RIGHT:
                mBestCandidateRect.offset(-(focusedRect.width() + 1), 0);
                break;
            case View.FOCUS_UP:
                mBestCandidateRect.offset(0, focusedRect.height() + 1);
                break;
            case View.FOCUS_DOWN:
                mBestCandidateRect.offset(0, -(focusedRect.height() + 1));
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }

        View closest = null;

        for (int index = 0; index < focusables.size(); index++)
        {
            View focusable = focusables.get(index);
            if (focusable == focused || focusable == root) continue;

            focusable.getFocusedRect(mOtherRect);
            root.offsetDescendantRectToMyCoords(focusable, mOtherRect);

            if (isBetterCandidate(direction, focusedRect, mOtherRect, mBestCandidateRect))
            {
                mBestCandidateRect.set(mOtherRect);
                closest = focusable;
            }
        }

        return closest;
    }

    boolean isBetterCandidate(int direction, Rect source, Rect candidate, Rect best)
    {
        if (!isCandidate(source, candidate, direction)) return false;
        if (!isCandidate(source, best, direction)) return true;
        if (beamBeats(direction, source, candidate, best)) return true;
        if (beamBeats(direction, source, best, candidate)) return false;

        return getWeightedDistanceFor(majorAxisDistance(direction, source, candidate), minorAxisDistance(direction, source, candidate))
               < getWeightedDistanceFor(majorAxisDistance(direction, source, best), minorAxisDistance(direction, source, best));
    }

    boolean beamBeats(int direction, Rect source, Rect first, Rect second)
    {
        boolean firstInBeam = beamsOverlap(direction, source, first);
        boolean secondInBeam = beamsOverlap(direction, source, second);

        if (secondInBeam || !firstInBeam) return false;
        if (!isToDirectionOf(direction, source, second)) return true;
        if (direction == View.FOCUS_LEFT || direction == View.FOCUS_RIGHT) return true;

        return majorAxisDistance(direction, source, first) < majorAxisDistanceToFarEdge(direction, source, second);
    }

    int getWeightedDistanceFor(long majorAxisDistance, long minorAxisDistance)
    {
        long distance = 13 * majorAxisDistance * majorAxisDistance + minorAxisDistance * minorAxisDistance;
        return distance > Integer.MAX_VALUE ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : (int)distance;
    }

    boolean isCandidate(Rect source, Rect destination, int direction)
    {
        switch (direction)
        {
            case View.FOCUS_LEFT:
                return (source.right > destination.right || source.left >= destination.right) && source.left > destination.left;
            case View.FOCUS_RIGHT:
                return (source.left < destination.left || source.right <= destination.left) && source.right < destination.right;
            case View.FOCUS_UP:
                return (source.bottom > destination.bottom || source.top >= destination.bottom) && source.top > destination.top;
            case View.FOCUS_DOWN:
                return (source.top < destination.top || source.bottom <= destination.top) && source.bottom < destination.bottom;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("direction must be one of {FOCUS_UP, FOCUS_DOWN, FOCUS_LEFT, FOCUS_RIGHT}.");
        }
    }

    boolean beamsOverlap(int direction, Rect first, Rect second)
    {
        switch (direction)
        {
            case View.FOCUS_LEFT:
            case View.FOCUS_RIGHT:
                return second.bottom > first.top && second.top < first.bottom;
            case View.FOCUS_UP:
            case View.FOCUS_DOWN:
                return second.right > first.left && second.left < first.right;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("direction must be one of {FOCUS_UP, FOCUS_DOWN, FOCUS_LEFT, FOCUS_RIGHT}.");
        }
    }

    boolean isToDirectionOf(int direction, Rect source, Rect destination)
    {
        switch (direction)
        {
            case View.FOCUS_LEFT:
                return source.left >= destination.right;
            case View.FOCUS_RIGHT:
                return source.right <= destination.left;
            case View.FOCUS_UP:
                return source.top >= destination.bottom;
            case View.FOCUS_DOWN:
                return source.bottom <= destination.top;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("direction must be one of {FOCUS_UP, FOCUS_DOWN, FOCUS_LEFT, FOCUS_RIGHT}.");
        }
    }

    static int majorAxisDistance(int direction, Rect source, Rect destination)
    {
        return Math.max(0, majorAxisDistanceRaw(direction, source, destination));
    }

    static int majorAxisDistanceRaw(int direction, Rect source, Rect destination)
    {
        switch (direction)
        {
            case View.FOCUS_LEFT:
                return source.left - destination.right;
            case View.FOCUS_RIGHT:
                return destination.left - source.right;
            case View.FOCUS_UP:
                return source.top - destination.bottom;
            case View.FOCUS_DOWN:
                return destination.top - source.bottom;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("direction must be one of {FOCUS_UP, FOCUS_DOWN, FOCUS_LEFT, FOCUS_RIGHT}.");
        }
    }

    static int majorAxisDistanceToFarEdge(int direction, Rect source, Rect destination)
    {
        return Math.max(1, majorAxisDistanceToFarEdgeRaw(direction, source, destination));
    }

    static int majorAxisDistanceToFarEdgeRaw(int direction, Rect source, Rect destination)
    {
        switch (direction)
        {
            case View.FOCUS_LEFT:
                return source.left - destination.left;
            case View.FOCUS_RIGHT:
                return destination.right - source.right;
            case View.FOCUS_UP:
                return source.top - destination.top;
            case View.FOCUS_DOWN:
                return destination.bottom - source.bottom;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("direction must be one of {FOCUS_UP, FOCUS_DOWN, FOCUS_LEFT, FOCUS_RIGHT}.");
        }
    }

    static int minorAxisDistance(int direction, Rect source, Rect destination)
    {
        switch (direction)
        {
            case View.FOCUS_LEFT:
            case View.FOCUS_RIGHT:
                return Math.abs((source.top + source.height() / 2) - (destination.top + destination.height() / 2));
            case View.FOCUS_UP:
            case View.FOCUS_DOWN:
                return Math.abs((source.left + source.width() / 2) - (destination.left + destination.width() / 2));
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("direction must be one of {FOCUS_UP, FOCUS_DOWN, FOCUS_LEFT, FOCUS_RIGHT}.");
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/FrameMetrics.java`:

```java
package android.view;

public final class FrameMetrics
{
    public static final int UNKNOWN_DELAY_DURATION = 0;
    public static final int INPUT_HANDLING_DURATION = 1;
    public static final int ANIMATION_DURATION = 2;
    public static final int LAYOUT_MEASURE_DURATION = 3;
    public static final int DRAW_DURATION = 4;
    public static final int SYNC_DURATION = 5;
    public static final int COMMAND_ISSUE_DURATION = 6;
    public static final int SWAP_BUFFERS_DURATION = 7;
    public static final int TOTAL_DURATION = 8;
    public static final int FIRST_DRAW_FRAME = 9;
    public static final int INTENDED_VSYNC_TIMESTAMP = 10;
    public static final int VSYNC_TIMESTAMP = 11;
    public static final int GPU_DURATION = 12;
    public static final int DEADLINE = 13;
    public static final int FRAME_TIMELINE_VSYNC_ID = 14;

    private static final int METRIC_COUNT = 15;

    private static long sNextVsyncId;

    private final long[] mMetrics = new long[METRIC_COUNT];

    FrameMetrics()
    {
    }

    public FrameMetrics(FrameMetrics other)
    {
        System.arraycopy(other.mMetrics, 0, mMetrics, 0, METRIC_COUNT);
    }

    static FrameMetrics forFrame(long vsyncNanos, long startNanos, long endNanos, boolean firstFrame)
    {
        FrameMetrics metrics = new FrameMetrics();
        long now = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeNanos();
        long drawNanos = Math.max(0, endNanos - startNanos);
        long delay = Math.max(0, now - drawNanos - vsyncNanos);
        long interval = (long)(1000000000L / Math.max(1.0f, runtime.WindowBridge.refreshRate()));

        metrics.setMetric(UNKNOWN_DELAY_DURATION, delay);
        metrics.setMetric(LAYOUT_MEASURE_DURATION, 0);
        metrics.setMetric(DRAW_DURATION, drawNanos);
        metrics.setMetric(TOTAL_DURATION, delay + drawNanos);
        metrics.setMetric(FIRST_DRAW_FRAME, firstFrame ? 1 : 0);
        metrics.setMetric(INTENDED_VSYNC_TIMESTAMP, vsyncNanos);
        metrics.setMetric(VSYNC_TIMESTAMP, vsyncNanos);
        metrics.setMetric(DEADLINE, interval);

        synchronized (FrameMetrics.class)
        {
            metrics.setMetric(FRAME_TIMELINE_VSYNC_ID, ++sNextVsyncId);
        }

        return metrics;
    }

    void setMetric(int id, long value)
    {
        if (id >= 0 && id < METRIC_COUNT) mMetrics[id] = value;
    }

    public long getMetric(int id)
    {
        if (id < 0 || id >= METRIC_COUNT) return -1;
        return mMetrics[id];
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/GestureDetector.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Handler;

public class GestureDetector
{
    public interface OnGestureListener
    {
        boolean onDown(MotionEvent event);

        void onShowPress(MotionEvent event);

        boolean onSingleTapUp(MotionEvent event);

        boolean onScroll(MotionEvent down, MotionEvent move, float distanceX, float distanceY);

        void onLongPress(MotionEvent event);

        boolean onFling(MotionEvent down, MotionEvent move, float velocityX, float velocityY);
    }

    public interface OnDoubleTapListener
    {
        boolean onSingleTapConfirmed(MotionEvent event);

        boolean onDoubleTap(MotionEvent event);

        boolean onDoubleTapEvent(MotionEvent event);
    }

    public interface OnContextClickListener
    {
        boolean onContextClick(MotionEvent event);
    }

    public static class SimpleOnGestureListener implements OnGestureListener, OnDoubleTapListener, OnContextClickListener
    {
        @Override
        public boolean onDown(MotionEvent event)
        {
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public void onShowPress(MotionEvent event)
        {
        }

        @Override
        public boolean onSingleTapUp(MotionEvent event)
        {
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean onScroll(MotionEvent down, MotionEvent move, float distanceX, float distanceY)
        {
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public void onLongPress(MotionEvent event)
        {
        }

        @Override
        public boolean onFling(MotionEvent down, MotionEvent move, float velocityX, float velocityY)
        {
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean onSingleTapConfirmed(MotionEvent event)
        {
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean onDoubleTap(MotionEvent event)
        {
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean onDoubleTapEvent(MotionEvent event)
        {
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean onContextClick(MotionEvent event)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private final OnGestureListener mListener;
    private OnDoubleTapListener mDoubleTapListener;
    private OnContextClickListener mContextClickListener;
    private boolean mInContextClick;
    private final Handler mHandler;

    private final int mTouchSlop;
    private final int mMinimumFlingVelocity;
    private final int mMaximumFlingVelocity;
    private final int mDoubleTapSlop;

    private VelocityTracker mVelocityTracker;

    private MotionEvent mDownEvent;
    private MotionEvent mPreviousUp;

    private float mLastFocusX;
    private float mLastFocusY;
    private float mDownFocusX;
    private float mDownFocusY;

    private boolean mInLongPress;
    private boolean mStillWithinTapRegion;
    private boolean mIsDoubleTapping;
    private boolean mLongpressEnabled = true;

    private final Runnable mLongPressRunnable = new Runnable()
    {
        @Override
        public void run()
        {
            if (mDownEvent == null || !mStillWithinTapRegion) return;

            mInLongPress = true;
            mListener.onLongPress(mDownEvent);
        }
    };

    @Deprecated
    public GestureDetector(OnGestureListener listener, Handler handler)
    {
        this(null, listener, handler);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public GestureDetector(OnGestureListener listener)
    {
        this(null, listener, null);
    }

    public GestureDetector(Context context, OnGestureListener listener)
    {
        this(context, listener, null);
    }

    public GestureDetector(Context context, OnGestureListener listener, Handler handler, boolean unused)
    {
        this(context, listener, handler);
    }

    public GestureDetector(Context context, OnGestureListener listener, Handler handler)
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new NullPointerException("OnGestureListener must not be null");

        mListener = listener;

        android.os.Looper looper = handler != null ? handler.getLooper() : android.os.Looper.myLooper();
        if (looper == null) looper = android.os.Looper.getMainLooper();
        mHandler = new Handler(looper);

        if (listener instanceof OnDoubleTapListener) mDoubleTapListener = (OnDoubleTapListener)listener;
        if (listener instanceof OnContextClickListener) mContextClickListener = (OnContextClickListener)listener;

        ViewConfiguration configuration = ViewConfiguration.get(context);

        mTouchSlop = configuration.getScaledTouchSlop();
        mDoubleTapSlop = configuration.getScaledDoubleTapSlop();
        mMinimumFlingVelocity = configuration.getScaledMinimumFlingVelocity();
        mMaximumFlingVelocity = configuration.getScaledMaximumFlingVelocity();
    }

    public void setOnDoubleTapListener(OnDoubleTapListener listener)
    {
        mDoubleTapListener = listener;
    }

    public void setContextClickListener(OnContextClickListener onContextClickListener)
    {
        mContextClickListener = onContextClickListener;
    }

    public boolean onGenericMotionEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (event == null) return false;

        int actionButton = event.getActionButton();

        switch (event.getActionMasked())
        {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_BUTTON_PRESS:
                if (mContextClickListener != null && !mInContextClick && !mInLongPress
                    && (actionButton == MotionEvent.BUTTON_STYLUS_PRIMARY || actionButton == MotionEvent.BUTTON_SECONDARY))
                {
                    if (mContextClickListener.onContextClick(event))
                    {
                        mInContextClick = true;
                        mHandler.removeCallbacks(mLongPressRunnable);
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                break;

            case MotionEvent.ACTION_BUTTON_RELEASE:
                if (mInContextClick && (actionButton == MotionEvent.BUTTON_STYLUS_PRIMARY || actionButton == MotionEvent.BUTTON_SECONDARY))
                {
                    mInContextClick = false;
                }
                break;

            default:
                break;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public void setIsLongpressEnabled(boolean enabled)
    {
        mLongpressEnabled = enabled;
    }

    public boolean isLongpressEnabled()
    {
        return mLongpressEnabled;
    }

    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (event == null) return false;

        int action = event.getActionMasked();

        if (mVelocityTracker == null) mVelocityTracker = VelocityTracker.obtain();
        mVelocityTracker.addMovement(event);

        boolean handled = false;

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN)
        {
            handled = handleDown(event);
        }
        else if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE)
        {
            handled = handleMove(event);
        }
        else if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP)
        {
            handled = handleUp(event);
        }
        else if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL)
        {
            cancel();
        }

        return handled;
    }

    private boolean handleDown(MotionEvent event)
    {
        boolean handled = false;

        if (mDoubleTapListener != null && isDoubleTap(event))
        {
            mIsDoubleTapping = true;
            handled = mDoubleTapListener.onDoubleTap(event) | mDoubleTapListener.onDoubleTapEvent(event);
        }

        mDownFocusX = event.getX();
        mDownFocusY = event.getY();
        mLastFocusX = mDownFocusX;
        mLastFocusY = mDownFocusY;

        if (mDownEvent != null) mDownEvent.recycle();
        mDownEvent = MotionEvent.obtain(event);

        mStillWithinTapRegion = true;
        mInLongPress = false;

        if (mLongpressEnabled)
        {
            mHandler.removeCallbacks(mLongPressRunnable);
            mHandler.postDelayed(mLongPressRunnable,
                                 ViewConfiguration.getTapTimeout() + ViewConfiguration.getLongPressTimeout());
        }

        return mListener.onDown(event) || handled;
    }

    private boolean handleMove(MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (mInLongPress) return false;

        float x = event.getX();
        float y = event.getY();
        float scrollX = mLastFocusX - x;
        float scrollY = mLastFocusY - y;

        if (mIsDoubleTapping && mDoubleTapListener != null) return mDoubleTapListener.onDoubleTapEvent(event);

        if (mStillWithinTapRegion)
        {
            float deltaX = x - mDownFocusX;
            float deltaY = y - mDownFocusY;

            if (deltaX * deltaX + deltaY * deltaY <= mTouchSlop * mTouchSlop) return false;

            mStillWithinTapRegion = false;
            mHandler.removeCallbacks(mLongPressRunnable);

            mLastFocusX = x;
            mLastFocusY = y;

            return mListener.onScroll(mDownEvent, event, scrollX, scrollY);
        }

        if (Math.abs(scrollX) < 1 && Math.abs(scrollY) < 1) return false;

        mLastFocusX = x;
        mLastFocusY = y;

        return mListener.onScroll(mDownEvent, event, scrollX, scrollY);
    }

    private boolean handleUp(MotionEvent event)
    {
        mHandler.removeCallbacks(mLongPressRunnable);

        boolean handled = false;

        if (mIsDoubleTapping)
        {
            if (mDoubleTapListener != null) handled = mDoubleTapListener.onDoubleTapEvent(event);
        }
        else if (mInLongPress)
        {
            mInLongPress = false;
        }
        else if (mStillWithinTapRegion)
        {
            handled = mListener.onSingleTapUp(event);

            if (mDoubleTapListener != null) handled |= mDoubleTapListener.onSingleTapConfirmed(event);

            if (mPreviousUp != null) mPreviousUp.recycle();
            mPreviousUp = MotionEvent.obtain(event);
        }
        else
        {
            mVelocityTracker.computeCurrentVelocity(1000, mMaximumFlingVelocity);

            float velocityX = mVelocityTracker.getXVelocity();
            float velocityY = mVelocityTracker.getYVelocity();

            if (Math.abs(velocityX) > mMinimumFlingVelocity || Math.abs(velocityY) > mMinimumFlingVelocity)
            {
                handled = mListener.onFling(mDownEvent, event, velocityX, velocityY);
            }
        }

        mIsDoubleTapping = false;
        mStillWithinTapRegion = false;

        if (mVelocityTracker != null)
        {
            mVelocityTracker.recycle();
            mVelocityTracker = null;
        }

        return handled;
    }

    private void cancel()
    {
        mHandler.removeCallbacks(mLongPressRunnable);

        mIsDoubleTapping = false;
        mStillWithinTapRegion = false;
        mInLongPress = false;

        if (mVelocityTracker != null)
        {
            mVelocityTracker.recycle();
            mVelocityTracker = null;
        }
    }

    private boolean isDoubleTap(MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (mPreviousUp == null || mDownEvent == null) return false;

        long interval = event.getEventTime() - mPreviousUp.getEventTime();
        if (interval > ViewConfiguration.getDoubleTapTimeout()) return false;

        float deltaX = mDownEvent.getX() - event.getX();
        float deltaY = mDownEvent.getY() - event.getY();

        return deltaX * deltaX + deltaY * deltaY < mDoubleTapSlop * mDoubleTapSlop;
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/Gravity.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.graphics.Rect;

public class Gravity
{
    public static final int NO_GRAVITY = 0x0000;

    public static final int AXIS_SPECIFIED = 0x0001;
    public static final int AXIS_PULL_BEFORE = 0x0002;
    public static final int AXIS_PULL_AFTER = 0x0004;
    public static final int AXIS_CLIP = 0x0008;

    public static final int AXIS_X_SHIFT = 0;
    public static final int AXIS_Y_SHIFT = 4;

    public static final int TOP = (AXIS_PULL_BEFORE | AXIS_SPECIFIED) << AXIS_Y_SHIFT;
    public static final int BOTTOM = (AXIS_PULL_AFTER | AXIS_SPECIFIED) << AXIS_Y_SHIFT;
    public static final int LEFT = (AXIS_PULL_BEFORE | AXIS_SPECIFIED) << AXIS_X_SHIFT;
    public static final int RIGHT = (AXIS_PULL_AFTER | AXIS_SPECIFIED) << AXIS_X_SHIFT;

    public static final int CENTER_VERTICAL = AXIS_SPECIFIED << AXIS_Y_SHIFT;
    public static final int CENTER_HORIZONTAL = AXIS_SPECIFIED << AXIS_X_SHIFT;
    public static final int CENTER = CENTER_VERTICAL | CENTER_HORIZONTAL;

    public static final int FILL_VERTICAL = TOP | BOTTOM;
    public static final int FILL_HORIZONTAL = LEFT | RIGHT;
    public static final int FILL = FILL_VERTICAL | FILL_HORIZONTAL;

    public static final int CLIP_VERTICAL = AXIS_CLIP << AXIS_Y_SHIFT;
    public static final int CLIP_HORIZONTAL = AXIS_CLIP << AXIS_X_SHIFT;

    public static final int VERTICAL_GRAVITY_MASK = (AXIS_SPECIFIED | AXIS_PULL_BEFORE | AXIS_PULL_AFTER) << AXIS_Y_SHIFT;
    public static final int HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK = (AXIS_SPECIFIED | AXIS_PULL_BEFORE | AXIS_PULL_AFTER) << AXIS_X_SHIFT;

    public static final int RELATIVE_LAYOUT_DIRECTION = 0x00800000;
    public static final int START = RELATIVE_LAYOUT_DIRECTION | LEFT;
    public static final int END = RELATIVE_LAYOUT_DIRECTION | RIGHT;
    public static final int RELATIVE_HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK = START | END;

    public static final int DISPLAY_CLIP_VERTICAL = 0x10000000;
    public static final int DISPLAY_CLIP_HORIZONTAL = 0x01000000;

    public Gravity()
    {
    }

    public static boolean isHorizontal(int gravity)
    {
        return gravity > 0 && (gravity & RELATIVE_HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK) != 0;
    }

    public static boolean isVertical(int gravity)
    {
        return gravity > 0 && (gravity & VERTICAL_GRAVITY_MASK) != 0;
    }

    public static int getAbsoluteGravity(int gravity, int layoutDirection)
    {
        int absolute = gravity & ~RELATIVE_LAYOUT_DIRECTION;
        if ((gravity & RELATIVE_LAYOUT_DIRECTION) == 0) return absolute;

        boolean rightToLeft = layoutDirection == 1;
        if ((gravity & START) == START) return (absolute & ~HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK) | (rightToLeft ? RIGHT : LEFT);
        if ((gravity & END) == END) return (absolute & ~HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK) | (rightToLeft ? LEFT : RIGHT);

        return absolute;
    }

    public static void apply(int gravity, int width, int height, Rect container, Rect out)
    {
        apply(gravity, width, height, container, 0, 0, out);
    }

    public static void apply(int gravity, int width, int height, Rect container, Rect out, int layoutDirection)
    {
        apply(getAbsoluteGravity(gravity, layoutDirection), width, height, container, 0, 0, out);
    }

    public static void apply(int gravity, int width, int height, Rect container, int xAdjust, int yAdjust, Rect out,
                             int layoutDirection)
    {
        apply(getAbsoluteGravity(gravity, layoutDirection), width, height, container, xAdjust, yAdjust, out);
    }

    public static void apply(int gravity, int width, int height, Rect container, int xAdjust, int yAdjust, Rect out)
    {
        applyHorizontal(gravity, width, container, out);
        applyVertical(gravity, height, container, out);

        int horizontal = gravity & HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK;
        int vertical = gravity & VERTICAL_GRAVITY_MASK;

        if (horizontal != FILL_HORIZONTAL) out.offset(horizontal == RIGHT ? -xAdjust : xAdjust, 0);
        if (vertical != FILL_VERTICAL) out.offset(0, vertical == BOTTOM ? -yAdjust : yAdjust);

        if ((gravity & (AXIS_CLIP << AXIS_X_SHIFT)) != 0)
        {
            if (out.left < container.left) out.left = container.left;
            if (out.right > container.right) out.right = container.right;
        }

        if ((gravity & (AXIS_CLIP << AXIS_Y_SHIFT)) != 0)
        {
            if (out.top < container.top) out.top = container.top;
            if (out.bottom > container.bottom) out.bottom = container.bottom;
        }
    }

    public static void applyDisplay(int gravity, Rect display, Rect inoutObject)
    {
        if ((gravity & DISPLAY_CLIP_VERTICAL) != 0)
        {
            if (inoutObject.top < display.top) inoutObject.top = display.top;
            if (inoutObject.bottom > display.bottom) inoutObject.bottom = display.bottom;
        }

        if ((gravity & DISPLAY_CLIP_HORIZONTAL) != 0)
        {
            if (inoutObject.left < display.left) inoutObject.left = display.left;
            if (inoutObject.right > display.right) inoutObject.right = display.right;
        }
    }

    public static void applyDisplay(int gravity, Rect display, Rect inoutObject, int layoutDirection)
    {
        applyDisplay(getAbsoluteGravity(gravity, layoutDirection), display, inoutObject);
    }

    private static void applyHorizontal(int gravity, int width, Rect container, Rect out)
    {
        int horizontal = gravity & HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK;

        if (horizontal == FILL_HORIZONTAL)
        {
            out.left = container.left;
            out.right = container.right;
            return;
        }

        if (horizontal == RIGHT) out.left = container.right - width;
        else if (horizontal == CENTER_HORIZONTAL) out.left = container.left + (container.width() - width) / 2;
        else out.left = container.left;

        out.right = out.left + width;
    }

    private static void applyVertical(int gravity, int height, Rect container, Rect out)
    {
        int vertical = gravity & VERTICAL_GRAVITY_MASK;

        if (vertical == FILL_VERTICAL)
        {
            out.top = container.top;
            out.bottom = container.bottom;
            return;
        }

        if (vertical == BOTTOM) out.top = container.bottom - height;
        else if (vertical == CENTER_VERTICAL) out.top = container.top + (container.height() - height) / 2;
        else out.top = container.top;

        out.bottom = out.top + height;
    }
}
```

```java
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<InputDevice> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<InputDevice>()
    {
        @Override
        public InputDevice createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int id = source.readInt();
            String name = source.readString();
            int sources = source.readInt();
            int keyboardType = source.readInt();

            InputDevice known = getDevice(id);
            if (known != null) return known;

            return new InputDevice(id, name, sources, keyboardType);
        }

        }

    private static final InputDevice[] DEVICES = {
        new InputDevice(TOUCHSCREEN_ID, "acl-touchscreen", SOURCE_TOUCHSCREEN, KEYBOARD_TYPE_NONE),
        new InputDevice(KEYBOARD_ID, "acl-keyboard", SOURCE_KEYBOARD | SOURCE_DPAD, KEYBOARD_TYPE_ALPHABETIC),
        new InputDevice(MOUSE_ID, "acl-mouse", SOURCE_MOUSE, KEYBOARD_TYPE_NONE),

    public static final class ViewBehavior
    {
        private final InputDevice mInputDevice;
        private boolean mShouldSmoothScroll;

        ViewBehavior(InputDevice device)
        {
            mInputDevice = device;
        }

        public boolean shouldSmoothScroll(int axis, int source)
        {
            if (axis != MotionEvent.AXIS_SCROLL && axis != MotionEvent.AXIS_HSCROLL && axis != MotionEvent.AXIS_VSCROLL) return false;
            if (mInputDevice != null && !mInputDevice.supportsSource(source)) return false;

            return mShouldSmoothScroll;
        }
    }

    public static final class MotionRange

        }

        public float getMax()

            return mMax;
        }

        public float getRange()

            return mMax - mMin;
        }

        public float getFlat()

            return 0f;
        }

        public float getFuzz()

            return 0f;
        }

        public float getResolution()
        {
            return 0f;
        }
    }

    private final int mId;
    private final String mName;
    private final int mSources;
    private final int mKeyboardType;
    private final List<MotionRange> mRanges = new ArrayList<>();
    private android.os.Vibrator mVibrator;
    private android.os.VibratorManager mVibratorManager;

    private InputDevice(int id, String name, int sources, int keyboardType)
    {
        mId = id;
        mName = name;
        mSources = sources;
        mKeyboardType = keyboardType;

        if ((sources & SOURCE_CLASS_POINTER) != 0)
        {
            mRanges.add(new MotionRange(MotionEvent.AXIS_X, sources, 0f, 4096f));
            mRanges.add(new MotionRange(MotionEvent.AXIS_Y, sources, 0f, 4096f));
        }
    }

    public static InputDevice getDevice(int id)
    {
        for (InputDevice device : DEVICES)
        {
            if (device.mId == id) return device;
        }

        return null;
    }

    public static int[] getDeviceIds()
    {
        int[] ids = new int[DEVICES.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < DEVICES.length; index++) ids[index] = DEVICES[index].mId;

        return ids;
    }

    public int getId()

        return mId;
    }

    public int getControllerNumber()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public int getVendorId()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public int getProductId()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public String getDescriptor()

    {
        return false;

    }

    public String getName()

        return mName;
    }

    public int getSources()

        return mSources;
    }

    public int getKeyboardType()

    public boolean[] hasKeys(int... keys)

        return present;
    }

    public KeyCharacterMap getKeyCharacterMap()
    {
        return KeyCharacterMap.load(mId);
    }

    public android.os.Vibrator getVibrator()

        synchronized (this)
        {

            return mVibrator;
        }
    }

    public android.os.VibratorManager getVibratorManager()

    }

    public int getKeyCodeForKeyLocation(int locationKeyCode)
    {
        return locationKeyCode;
    }

    public MotionRange getMotionRange(int axis)

    }

    public MotionRange getMotionRange(int axis, int source)
    {
        for (MotionRange range : mRanges)

            if (range.getAxis() == axis && range.isFromSource(source)) return range;
        }
```

```java
package android.view;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public abstract class InputEvent implements Parcelable
{
    static final int PARCEL_TOKEN_MOTION_EVENT = 1;
    static final int PARCEL_TOKEN_KEY_EVENT = 2;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<InputEvent> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<InputEvent>()
    {
        @Override
        public InputEvent createFromParcel(Parcel in)
        {
            int token = in.readInt();
            if (token == PARCEL_TOKEN_KEY_EVENT) return KeyEvent.createFromParcelBody(in);
            if (token == PARCEL_TOKEN_MOTION_EVENT) return MotionEvent.createFromParcelBody(in);

            throw new IllegalStateException("Unexpected input event type token in parcel.");
        }

        @Override
        public InputEvent[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new InputEvent[size];
        }
    };

    InputEvent()
    {
    }

    public abstract int getDeviceId();

    public final InputDevice getDevice()
    {
        return InputDevice.getDevice(getDeviceId());
    }

    public abstract int getSource();

    public abstract long getEventTime();

    public boolean isFromSource(int source)
    {
        return (getSource() & source) == source;
    }

    public void recycle()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/InsetsController.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.os.CancellationSignal;
import android.view.animation.Interpolator;

import java.util.ArrayList;

public final class InsetsController implements WindowInsetsController
{
    private int mAppearance;
    private int mBehavior = BEHAVIOR_DEFAULT;
    private final ArrayList<OnControllableInsetsChangedListener> mControllableListeners = new ArrayList<>();

    @Override
    public void setSystemBarsAppearance(int appearance, int mask)
    {
        mAppearance = (mAppearance & ~mask) | (appearance & mask);
    }

    @Override
    public int getSystemBarsAppearance()
    {
        return mAppearance;
    }

    @Override
    public void setSystemBarsBehavior(int behavior)
    {
        mBehavior = behavior;
    }

    @Override
    public int getSystemBarsBehavior()
    {
        return mBehavior;
    }

    @Override
    public void show(int types)
    {
    }

    @Override
    public void hide(int types)
    {
    }

    private int controllableTypes()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void controlWindowInsetsAnimation(int types, long durationMillis, Interpolator interpolator, CancellationSignal cancellationSignal,
                                             WindowInsetsAnimationControlListener listener)
    {
        if (listener == null) return;

        if ((types & controllableTypes()) == 0 || (cancellationSignal != null && cancellationSignal.isCanceled()))
        {
            listener.onCancelled(null);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void addOnControllableInsetsChangedListener(OnControllableInsetsChangedListener listener)
    {
        if (listener == null || mControllableListeners.contains(listener)) return;

        mControllableListeners.add(listener);
        listener.onControllableInsetsChanged(this, controllableTypes());
    }

    @Override
    public void removeOnControllableInsetsChangedListener(OnControllableInsetsChangedListener listener)
    {
        mControllableListeners.remove(listener);
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/KeyCharacterMap.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class KeyCharacterMap implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int BUILT_IN_KEYBOARD = 0;
    public static final int VIRTUAL_KEYBOARD = -1;

    public static final int NUMERIC = 1;
    public static final int PREDICTIVE = 2;
    public static final int ALPHA = 3;
    public static final int FULL = 4;
    public static final int SPECIAL_FUNCTION = 5;

    public static final char HEX_INPUT = '';
    public static final char PICKER_DIALOG_INPUT = '';

    public static final int MODIFIER_BEHAVIOR_CHORDED = 0;
    public static final int MODIFIER_BEHAVIOR_CHORDED_OR_TOGGLED = 1;

    public static final int COMBINING_ACCENT = 0x80000000;
    public static final int COMBINING_ACCENT_MASK = 0x7FFFFFFF;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<KeyCharacterMap> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<KeyCharacterMap>()
    {
        @Override
        public KeyCharacterMap createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            source.readInt();
            return INSTANCE;
        }

        @Override
        public KeyCharacterMap[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new KeyCharacterMap[size];
        }
    };

    public static class KeyData
    {
        public static final int META_LENGTH = 4;

        public char displayLabel;
        public char number;
        public char[] meta = new char[META_LENGTH];

        public KeyData()
        {
        }
    }

    private static final KeyCharacterMap INSTANCE = new KeyCharacterMap();

    private static final char[] BASE = new char[KeyEvent.getMaxKeyCode() + 1];
    private static final char[] SHIFTED = new char[KeyEvent.getMaxKeyCode() + 1];

    private static void map(int keyCode, char base, char shifted)
    {
        BASE[keyCode] = base;
        SHIFTED[keyCode] = shifted;
    }

    static
    {
        for (int letter = 0; letter < 26; letter++) map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_A + letter, (char)('a' + letter), (char)('A' + letter));

        String shiftedDigits = ")!@#$%^&*(";
        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_0 + digit, (char)('0' + digit), shiftedDigits.charAt(digit));

        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_0 + digit, (char)('0' + digit), (char)('0' + digit));

        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SPACE, ' ', ' ');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_TAB, '\t', '\t');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER, '\n', '\n');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_ENTER, '\n', '\n');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_COMMA, ',', '<');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_PERIOD, '.', '>');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_GRAVE, '`', '~');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MINUS, '-', '_');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_EQUALS, '=', '+');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_LEFT_BRACKET, '[', '{');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_RIGHT_BRACKET, ']', '}');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACKSLASH, '\\', '|');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SEMICOLON, ';', ':');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_APOSTROPHE, '\'', '"');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SLASH, '/', '?');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_AT, '@', '@');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_PLUS, '+', '+');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_STAR, '*', '*');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_POUND, '#', '#');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_DIVIDE, '/', '/');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_MULTIPLY, '*', '*');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_SUBTRACT, '-', '-');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_ADD, '+', '+');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_DOT, '.', '.');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_COMMA, ',', ',');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_EQUALS, '=', '=');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_LEFT_PAREN, '(', '(');
        map(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_RIGHT_PAREN, ')', ')');
    }

    KeyCharacterMap()
    {
    }

    static int unicodeFor(int keyCode, int metaState)
    {
        if (keyCode < 0 || keyCode >= BASE.length) return 0;
        if ((metaState & (KeyEvent.META_CTRL_ON | KeyEvent.META_ALT_ON | KeyEvent.META_META_ON)) != 0) return 0;

        boolean shifted = (metaState & KeyEvent.META_SHIFT_ON) != 0;
        boolean letter = keyCode >= KeyEvent.KEYCODE_A && keyCode <= KeyEvent.KEYCODE_Z;
        if (letter && (metaState & KeyEvent.META_CAPS_LOCK_ON) != 0) shifted = !shifted;

        return shifted ? SHIFTED[keyCode] : BASE[keyCode];
    }

    public static KeyCharacterMap load(int deviceId)
    {
        return INSTANCE;
    }

    public int get(int keyCode, int metaState)
    {
        return unicodeFor(keyCode, metaState);
    }

    public char getNumber(int keyCode)
    {
        char base = keyCode >= 0 && keyCode < BASE.length ? BASE[keyCode] : 0;
        return Character.isDigit(base) || base == '*' || base == '#' || base == '+' ? base : 0;
    }

    public char getMatch(int keyCode, char[] chars)
    {
        return getMatch(keyCode, chars, 0);
    }

    public char getMatch(int keyCode, char[] chars, int metaState)
    {
        if (chars == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("chars must not be null.");

        char primary = (char)unicodeFor(keyCode, metaState);
        char base = (char)unicodeFor(keyCode, 0);
        char shifted = (char)unicodeFor(keyCode, KeyEvent.META_SHIFT_ON);

        for (char candidate : chars)
        {
            if (candidate != 0 && candidate == primary) return candidate;
        }

        for (char candidate : chars)
        {
            if (candidate != 0 && (candidate == base || candidate == shifted)) return candidate;
        }

        return 0;
    }

    public char getDisplayLabel(int keyCode)
    {
        return (char)Character.toUpperCase(unicodeFor(keyCode, 0));
    }

    public static int getDeadChar(int accent, int character)
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public boolean getKeyData(int keyCode, KeyData results)
    {
        if (results.meta.length < KeyData.META_LENGTH) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("results.meta.length must be >= " + KeyData.META_LENGTH);

        char label = getDisplayLabel(keyCode);
        if (label == 0) return false;

        results.displayLabel = label;
        results.number = getNumber(keyCode);
        results.meta[0] = (char)unicodeFor(keyCode, 0);
        results.meta[1] = (char)unicodeFor(keyCode, KeyEvent.META_SHIFT_ON);
        results.meta[2] = 0;
        results.meta[3] = 0;
        return true;
    }

    public KeyEvent[] getEvents(char[] chars)
    {
        if (chars == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("chars must not be null.");

        List<KeyEvent> events = new ArrayList<>();
        long now = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();

        for (char wanted : chars)
        {
            int keyCode = -1;
            int metaState = 0;

            for (int candidate = 0; candidate < BASE.length && keyCode < 0; candidate++)
            {
                if (BASE[candidate] == wanted) keyCode = candidate;
                else if (SHIFTED[candidate] == wanted)
                {
                    keyCode = candidate;
                    metaState = KeyEvent.META_SHIFT_ON;
                }
            }

            if (keyCode < 0) return null;

            events.add(new KeyEvent(now, now, KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN, keyCode, 0, metaState, VIRTUAL_KEYBOARD, 0, 0,
                                    InputDevice.SOURCE_KEYBOARD));
            events.add(new KeyEvent(now, now, KeyEvent.ACTION_UP, keyCode, 0, metaState, VIRTUAL_KEYBOARD, 0, 0,
                                    InputDevice.SOURCE_KEYBOARD));
        }

        return events.toArray(new KeyEvent[0]);
    }

    public boolean isPrintingKey(int keyCode)
    {
        return unicodeFor(keyCode, 0) != 0;
    }

    public int getKeyboardType()
    {
        return FULL;
    }

    public int getModifierBehavior()
    {
        return MODIFIER_BEHAVIOR_CHORDED;
    }

    public static boolean deviceHasKey(int keyCode)
    {
        return keyCode >= 0 && keyCode <= KeyEvent.getMaxKeyCode();
    }

    public static boolean[] deviceHasKeys(int[] keyCodes)
    {
        boolean[] present = new boolean[keyCodes.length];
        for (int index = 0; index < keyCodes.length; index++) present[index] = deviceHasKey(keyCodes[index]);

        return present;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
    {
        out.writeInt(VIRTUAL_KEYBOARD);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        return other instanceof KeyCharacterMap;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return 1;
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        super.finalize();
    }

    public static class UnavailableException extends android.util.AndroidRuntimeException
    {
        public UnavailableException(String message)
        {
            super(message);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    public static final int FLAG_CANCELED_LONG_PRESS = 0x100;
    public static final int FLAG_TRACKING = 0x200;
    public static final int FLAG_FALLBACK = 0x400;

    private static final int MODIFIER_META_STATE_MASK = META_SHIFT_MASK | META_ALT_MASK | META_CTRL_MASK | META_META_MASK | META_SYM_ON
                                                       | META_FUNCTION_ON;
    private static final int LOCK_META_STATE_MASK = META_CAPS_LOCK_ON | META_NUM_LOCK_ON | META_SCROLL_LOCK_ON;
    private static final int FLAG_START_TRACKING_INTERNAL = 0x40000000;
    private static final String KEYCODE_PREFIX = "KEYCODE_";

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<KeyEvent> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<KeyEvent>()
    {
        @Override
        public KeyEvent createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            source.readInt();
            return createFromParcelBody(source);
        }

        @Override
        public KeyEvent[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new KeyEvent[size];
        }
    };

    public interface Callback
    {
        boolean onKeyDown(int keyCode, KeyEvent event);

        boolean onKeyLongPress(int keyCode, KeyEvent event);

        boolean onKeyUp(int keyCode, KeyEvent event);

        boolean onKeyMultiple(int keyCode, int count, KeyEvent event);
    }

    public static class DispatcherState
    {
        private int mDownKeyCode;
        private Object mDownTarget;
        private final android.util.SparseIntArray mActiveLongPresses = new android.util.SparseIntArray();

        public DispatcherState()
        {
        }

        public void reset()
        {
            mDownKeyCode = 0;
            mDownTarget = null;
            mActiveLongPresses.clear();
        }

        public void reset(Object target)
        {
            if (mDownTarget != target) return;

            mDownKeyCode = 0;
            mDownTarget = null;
        }

        public void startTracking(KeyEvent event, Object target)
        {
            if (event.getAction() != ACTION_DOWN) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Can only start tracking on a down event");

            mDownKeyCode = event.getKeyCode();
            mDownTarget = target;
        }

        public boolean isTracking(KeyEvent event)
        {
            return mDownKeyCode == event.getKeyCode();
        }

        public void performedLongPress(KeyEvent event)
        {
            mActiveLongPresses.put(event.getKeyCode(), 1);
        }

        public void handleUpEvent(KeyEvent event)
        {
            int keyCode = event.getKeyCode();
            int index = mActiveLongPresses.indexOfKey(keyCode);

            if (index >= 0)
            {
                event.mFlags |= FLAG_CANCELED | FLAG_CANCELED_LONG_PRESS;
                mActiveLongPresses.removeAt(index);
            }

            if (mDownKeyCode == keyCode)
            {
                event.mFlags |= FLAG_TRACKING;
                mDownKeyCode = 0;
                mDownTarget = null;
            }
        }
    }

    private int mAction;
    private int mKeyCode;
    private int mRepeat;
    private int mMetaState;
    private long mDownTime;
    private long mEventTime;
    private int mScanCode;

    private int mSource;
    private int mDeviceId;
    private String mCharacters;

    public static int getModifierMetaStateMask()

    public static boolean isModifierKey(int keyCode)
    {
        switch (keyCode)
        {
            case KEYCODE_SHIFT_LEFT:
            case KEYCODE_SHIFT_RIGHT:
            case KEYCODE_ALT_LEFT:
            case KEYCODE_ALT_RIGHT:
            case KEYCODE_CTRL_LEFT:
            case KEYCODE_CTRL_RIGHT:
            case KEYCODE_META_LEFT:
            case KEYCODE_META_RIGHT:
            case KEYCODE_SYM:
            case KEYCODE_NUM:
            case KEYCODE_FUNCTION:
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    public static int normalizeMetaState(int metaState)
    {
        if ((metaState & (META_SHIFT_LEFT_ON | META_SHIFT_RIGHT_ON)) != 0) metaState |= META_SHIFT_ON;
        if ((metaState & (META_ALT_LEFT_ON | META_ALT_RIGHT_ON)) != 0) metaState |= META_ALT_ON;
        if ((metaState & (META_CTRL_LEFT_ON | META_CTRL_RIGHT_ON)) != 0) metaState |= META_CTRL_ON;
        if ((metaState & (META_META_LEFT_ON | META_META_RIGHT_ON)) != 0) metaState |= META_META_ON;

        return metaState & (MODIFIER_META_STATE_MASK | LOCK_META_STATE_MASK);
    }

    public static boolean metaStateHasNoModifiers(int metaState)
    {
        return (normalizeMetaState(metaState) & MODIFIER_META_STATE_MASK) == 0;
    }

    public static boolean metaStateHasModifiers(int metaState, int modifiers)
    {
        if ((modifiers & LOCK_META_STATE_MASK) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("modifiers must not contain lock keys");

        metaState = normalizeMetaState(metaState) & MODIFIER_META_STATE_MASK;
        return modifierGroupMatches(metaState, modifiers, META_SHIFT_ON, META_SHIFT_LEFT_ON, META_SHIFT_RIGHT_ON)
               && modifierGroupMatches(metaState, modifiers, META_ALT_ON, META_ALT_LEFT_ON, META_ALT_RIGHT_ON)
               && modifierGroupMatches(metaState, modifiers, META_CTRL_ON, META_CTRL_LEFT_ON, META_CTRL_RIGHT_ON)
               && modifierGroupMatches(metaState, modifiers, META_META_ON, META_META_LEFT_ON, META_META_RIGHT_ON)
               && (metaState & (META_SYM_ON | META_FUNCTION_ON)) == (modifiers & (META_SYM_ON | META_FUNCTION_ON));
    }

    private static boolean modifierGroupMatches(int metaState, int modifiers, int basic, int left, int right)
    {
        int group = basic | left | right;
        int wanted = modifiers & group;

        if ((wanted & basic) != 0) return (metaState & basic) != 0 && (metaState & (left | right) & ~wanted & ~basic) == 0;

        return (metaState & group) == wanted;
    }

    public final boolean hasNoModifiers()
    {
        return metaStateHasNoModifiers(mMetaState);
    }

    public final boolean hasModifiers(int modifiers)
    {
        return metaStateHasModifiers(mMetaState, modifiers);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public final boolean dispatch(Callback receiver)
    {
        return dispatch(receiver, null, null);
    }

    public final boolean dispatch(Callback receiver, DispatcherState state, Object target)
    {
        switch (mAction)
        {
            case ACTION_DOWN:
            {
                mFlags &= ~FLAG_START_TRACKING_INTERNAL;
                boolean result = receiver.onKeyDown(mKeyCode, this);

                if (state != null)
                {
                    if (result && mRepeat == 0 && (mFlags & FLAG_START_TRACKING_INTERNAL) != 0)
                    {
                        state.startTracking(this, target);
                    }
                    else if (isLongPress() && state.isTracking(this))
                    {
                        if (receiver.onKeyLongPress(mKeyCode, this))
                        {
                            state.performedLongPress(this);
                            result = true;
                        }
                    }
                }

                return result;
            }

            case ACTION_UP:
                if (state != null) state.handleUpEvent(this);
                return receiver.onKeyUp(mKeyCode, this);

            case ACTION_MULTIPLE:
            {
                int count = mRepeat;
                int code = mKeyCode;

                if (receiver.onKeyMultiple(code, count, this)) return true;
                if (code == KEYCODE_UNKNOWN) return false;

                mAction = ACTION_DOWN;
                mRepeat = 0;
                boolean handled = receiver.onKeyDown(code, this);

                if (handled)
                {
                    mAction = ACTION_UP;
                    receiver.onKeyUp(code, this);
                }

                mAction = ACTION_MULTIPLE;
                mRepeat = count;
                return handled;
            }

            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    public static String keyCodeToString(int keyCode)
    {
        if (keyCode >= 0 && keyCode < KEYCODE_NAMES.length) return KEYCODE_PREFIX + KEYCODE_NAMES[keyCode];
        return Integer.toString(keyCode);
    }

    private static final String[] META_SYMBOLIC_NAMES = {"META_SHIFT_ON", "META_ALT_ON", "META_SYM_ON", "META_FUNCTION_ON",
                                                         "META_ALT_LEFT_ON", "META_ALT_RIGHT_ON", "META_SHIFT_LEFT_ON",
                                                         "META_SHIFT_RIGHT_ON", "META_CAP_LOCKED", "META_ALT_LOCKED", "META_SYM_LOCKED",
                                                         "0x00000800", "META_CTRL_ON", "META_CTRL_LEFT_ON", "META_CTRL_RIGHT_ON",
                                                         "0x00008000", "META_META_ON", "META_META_LEFT_ON", "META_META_RIGHT_ON",
                                                         "0x00080000", "META_CAPS_LOCK_ON", "META_NUM_LOCK_ON", "META_SCROLL_LOCK_ON"};

    public static String metaStateToString(int metaState)
    {
        if (metaState == 0) return "0";

        StringBuilder result = null;
        int index = 0;

        while (metaState != 0)
        {
            boolean isSet = (metaState & 1) != 0;
            metaState >>>= 1;

            if (isSet)
            {
                String name = index < META_SYMBOLIC_NAMES.length ? META_SYMBOLIC_NAMES[index]
                                                                 : "0x" + String.format("%08x", 1 << index);

                if (result == null)
                {
                    if (metaState == 0) return name;
                    result = new StringBuilder(name);
                }
                else
                {
                    result.append('|').append(name);
                }
            }

            index++;
        }

        return result.toString();
    }

    public static int keyCodeFromString(String symbolicName)
    {
        if (symbolicName == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("symbolicName must not be null");

        String name = symbolicName.startsWith(KEYCODE_PREFIX) ? symbolicName.substring(KEYCODE_PREFIX.length()) : symbolicName;

        for (int index = 0; index < KEYCODE_NAMES.length; index++)
        {
            if (KEYCODE_NAMES[index].equals(name)) return index;
        }

        try
        {
            return Integer.parseInt(symbolicName);
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
        {
            return KEYCODE_UNKNOWN;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    static KeyEvent createFromParcelBody(Parcel source)
    {
        source.readInt();
        int deviceId = source.readInt();
        int inputSource = source.readInt();
        source.readInt();
        source.createByteArray();
        int action = source.readInt();
        int keyCode = source.readInt();
        int repeat = source.readInt();
        int metaState = source.readInt();
        int scanCode = source.readInt();
        int flags = source.readInt();
        long downTime = source.readLong();
        long eventTime = source.readLong();

        KeyEvent event = new KeyEvent(downTime, eventTime, action, keyCode, repeat, metaState, deviceId, scanCode, flags, inputSource);
        event.mCharacters = source.readString();
        return event;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
    {
        out.writeInt(PARCEL_TOKEN_KEY_EVENT);
        out.writeInt(0);
        out.writeInt(mDeviceId);
        out.writeInt(mSource);
        out.writeInt(0);
        out.writeByteArray(null);
        out.writeInt(mAction);
        out.writeInt(mKeyCode);
        out.writeInt(mRepeat);
        out.writeInt(mMetaState);
        out.writeInt(mScanCode);
        out.writeInt(mFlags);
        out.writeLong(mDownTime);
        out.writeLong(mEventTime);
        out.writeString(mCharacters);
    }

    private static final int PARCEL_TOKEN_KEY_EVENT = 2;

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "KeyEvent { action=" + (mAction == ACTION_DOWN ? "ACTION_DOWN" : mAction == ACTION_UP ? "ACTION_UP" : "ACTION_MULTIPLE")
               + ", keyCode=" + keyCodeToString(mKeyCode) + ", metaState=" + mMetaState + ", flags=0x" + Integer.toHexString(mFlags)
               + ", repeatCount=" + mRepeat + ", eventTime=" + mEventTime + ", downTime=" + mDownTime + ", deviceId=" + mDeviceId
               + ", source=0x" + Integer.toHexString(mSource) + " }";
    }
}
```
