`java/android/view/LayoutInflater.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.XmlResourceParser;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;
import java.lang.reflect.Constructor;
import java.util.HashMap;

public abstract class LayoutInflater
{
    private static final String ANDROID_NAMESPACE = "http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android";
    private static final Class<?>[] CONSTRUCTOR_SIGNATURE = {Context.class, AttributeSet.class};
    private static final HashMap<String, Constructor<? extends View>> sConstructorMap = new HashMap<>();
    private static final int[] INCLUDE_VISIBILITIES = {View.VISIBLE, View.INVISIBLE, View.GONE};

    static final boolean TRACE_INFLATE = runtime.Settings.tracing("inflate");

    protected final Context mContext;
    private Factory mFactory;
    private Factory2 mFactory2;
    private Factory2 mPrivateFactory;
    private Filter mFilter;
    private boolean mFactorySet;
    private HashMap<String, Boolean> mFilterMap;

    protected LayoutInflater(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    protected LayoutInflater(LayoutInflater original, Context newContext)
    {
        mContext = newContext;
        mFactory = original.mFactory;
        mFactory2 = original.mFactory2;
        mPrivateFactory = original.mPrivateFactory;
        setFilter(original.mFilter);
    }

    public static LayoutInflater from(Context context)
    {
        if (context == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("context must not be null");

        Object service = context.getSystemService(Context.LAYOUT_INFLATER_SERVICE);
        if (service instanceof LayoutInflater) return (LayoutInflater)service;

        throw new AssertionError("LayoutInflater not found.");
    }

    public abstract LayoutInflater cloneInContext(Context newContext);

    public Context getContext()
    {
        return mContext;
    }

    public final Factory getFactory()
    {
        return mFactory;
    }

    public final Factory2 getFactory2()
    {
        return mFactory2;
    }

    public void setFactory(Factory factory)
    {
        if (mFactorySet) throw new IllegalStateException("A factory has already been set on this LayoutInflater");
        if (factory == null) throw new NullPointerException("Given factory can not be null");

        mFactorySet = true;
        if (mFactory == null) mFactory = factory;
        else mFactory = new FactoryMerger(factory, null, mFactory, mFactory2);
    }

    public void setFactory2(Factory2 factory)
    {
        if (mFactorySet) throw new IllegalStateException("A factory has already been set on this LayoutInflater");
        if (factory == null) throw new NullPointerException("Given factory can not be null");

        mFactorySet = true;

        if (mFactory == null)
        {
            mFactory = factory;
            mFactory2 = factory;
            return;
        }

        FactoryMerger merger = new FactoryMerger(factory, factory, mFactory, mFactory2);
        mFactory = merger;
        mFactory2 = merger;
    }

    public void setPrivateFactory(Factory2 factory)
    {
        if (mPrivateFactory == null) mPrivateFactory = factory;
        else mPrivateFactory = new FactoryMerger(factory, factory, mPrivateFactory, mPrivateFactory);
    }

    public Filter getFilter()
    {
        return mFilter;
    }

    public void setFilter(Filter filter)
    {
        mFilter = filter;
        if (filter != null) mFilterMap = new HashMap<>();
    }

    public View inflate(int resource, ViewGroup root)
    {
        return inflate(resource, root, root != null);
    }

    public View inflate(int resource, ViewGroup root, boolean attachToRoot)
    {
        XmlResourceParser parser = getContext().getResources().getLayout(resource);
        try
        {
            return inflate(parser, root, attachToRoot);
        }
        finally
        {
            parser.close();
        }
    }

    public View inflate(XmlPullParser parser, ViewGroup root)
    {
        return inflate(parser, root, root != null);
    }

    public View inflate(XmlPullParser parser, ViewGroup root, boolean attachToRoot)
    {
        int event = advance(parser);
        while (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG && event != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            event = advance(parser);
        }

        if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG)
        {
            throw new InflateException(parser.getPositionDescription() + ": No start tag found!");
        }

        String name = parser.getName();
        Context inflaterContext = mContext;

        if ("merge".equals(name))
        {
            if (root == null || !attachToRoot)
            {
                throw new InflateException("<merge /> can be used only with a valid ViewGroup root and attachToRoot=true");
            }

            readChildren(parser, root, inflaterContext, parser.getDepth());
            root.onFinishInflate();
            return root;
        }

        AttributeSet attributes = asAttributeSet(parser);
        View created = createViewFromTag(root, name, inflaterContext, attributes, false);
        ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = root != null ? root.generateLayoutParams(attributes) : null;

        if (root != null && !attachToRoot && params != null) created.setLayoutParams(params);

        inflateChildren(parser, created, parser.getDepth());

        if (root != null && attachToRoot) root.addView(created, params);
        return root != null && attachToRoot ? root : created;
    }

    private static AttributeSet asAttributeSet(XmlPullParser parser)
    {
        if (parser instanceof AttributeSet) return (AttributeSet)parser;
        throw new InflateException(parser.getPositionDescription() + ": inflation requires a compiled resource parser");
    }

    private static int advance(XmlPullParser parser)
    {
        try
        {
            return parser.next();
        }
        catch (org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParserException malformed)
        {
            throw new InflateException(parser.getPositionDescription() + ": " + malformed.getMessage(), malformed);
        }
        catch (java.io.IOException unreadable)
        {
            throw new InflateException(parser.getPositionDescription() + ": " + unreadable.getMessage(), unreadable);
        }
    }

    private void inflateChildren(XmlPullParser parser, View parent, int parentDepth)
    {
        readChildren(parser, parent, parent.getContext(), parentDepth);

        parent.onFinishInflate();
    }

    private void readChildren(XmlPullParser parser, View parent, Context context, int parentDepth)
    {
        boolean pendingRequestFocus = false;

        for (;;)
        {
            int event = advance(parser);
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT) break;

            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG)
            {
                if (parser.getDepth() <= parentDepth) break;
                continue;
            }

            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            String name = parser.getName();

            if ("requestFocus".equals(name))
            {
                pendingRequestFocus = true;
                skipTag(parser);
                continue;
            }

            if ("tag".equals(name))
            {
                parseViewTag(parser, parent);
                continue;
            }

            if (!(parent instanceof ViewGroup))
            {
                throw new InflateException(parser.getPositionDescription() + ": " + name + " needs a ViewGroup parent");
            }

            ViewGroup group = (ViewGroup)parent;

            if ("include".equals(name))
            {
                if (parser.getDepth() == 0) throw new InflateException("<include /> cannot be the root element");

                inflateInclude(parser, group, context);
                continue;
            }

            if ("merge".equals(name)) throw new InflateException("<merge /> must be the root element");

            if ("fragment".equals(name))
            {
                inflateFragment(parser, group);
                continue;
            }

            AttributeSet attributes = asAttributeSet(parser);
            View child = createViewFromTag(group, name, context, attributes, false);
            ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = group.generateLayoutParams(attributes);
            inflateChildren(parser, child, parser.getDepth());
            group.addView(child, params);
        }

        if (pendingRequestFocus) parent.restoreDefaultFocus();
    }

    private static void skipTag(XmlPullParser parser)
    {
        int depth = parser.getDepth();

        for (;;)
        {
            int event = advance(parser);
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT) return;
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= depth) return;
        }
    }

    private void parseViewTag(XmlPullParser parser, View view)
    {
        AttributeSet attributes = asAttributeSet(parser);

        int key = attributes.getAttributeResourceValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "id", 0);
        String value = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "value");
        if (key != 0) view.setTag(key, value);

        skipTag(parser);
    }

    private void inflateFragment(XmlPullParser parser, ViewGroup parent)
    {
        AttributeSet attributes = asAttributeSet(parser);

        String className = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "name");
        if (className == null) className = attributes.getAttributeValue(null, "class");

        if (className == null)
        {
            throw new InflateException(parser.getPositionDescription() + ": <fragment> needs a name or class");
        }

        int id = attributes.getAttributeResourceValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "id", View.NO_ID);
        String tag = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "tag");

        android.app.Fragment fragment = android.app.Fragment.instantiate(mContext, className);

        fragment.setId(id);
        fragment.setTag(tag);
        fragment.attachTo(activityOf(mContext), mContext);
        fragment.onAttach(mContext);
        fragment.onCreate(null);

        View created = fragment.onCreateView(this, parent, null);

        if (created == null) created = new View(mContext);

        if (id != View.NO_ID && created.getId() == View.NO_ID) created.setId(id);

        fragment.setView(created);

        ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = parent.generateLayoutParams(attributes);
        parent.addView(created, params);

        fragment.onViewCreated(created, null);
        fragment.onActivityCreated(null);

        skipTag(parser);

        if (TRACE_INFLATE)
        {
            android.util.Log.i("LayoutInflater", "inflated fragment " + className + " id=0x" + Integer.toHexString(id));
        }
    }

    private static android.app.Activity activityOf(Context context)
    {
        Context cursor = context;

        while (cursor instanceof android.content.ContextWrapper)
        {
            if (cursor instanceof android.app.Activity) return (android.app.Activity)cursor;

            cursor = ((android.content.ContextWrapper)cursor).getBaseContext();
        }

        return cursor instanceof android.app.Activity ? (android.app.Activity)cursor : null;
    }

    private void inflateInclude(XmlPullParser parser, ViewGroup parent, Context context)
    {
        AttributeSet attributes = asAttributeSet(parser);

        int layout = attributes.getAttributeResourceValue(null, "layout", 0);
        if (layout == 0)
        {
            String value = attributes.getAttributeValue(null, "layout");
            if (value == null || value.isEmpty())
            {
                throw new InflateException("You must specify a layout in the include tag: <include layout=\"@layout/layoutID\" />");
            }

            throw new InflateException("You must specify a valid layout reference. The layout ID " + value + " is not valid.");
        }

        int themeResource = attributes.getAttributeResourceValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "theme", 0);
        if (themeResource != 0) context = new ContextThemeWrapper(context, themeResource);

        int overrideId = attributes.getAttributeResourceValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "id", View.NO_ID);
        int overrideVisibility = attributes.getAttributeIntValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "visibility", -1);
        boolean overrideLayout = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "layout_width") != null
                                 || attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "layout_height") != null;

        int before = parent.getChildCount();

        XmlResourceParser included = context.getResources().getLayout(layout);
        try
        {
            inflateIncluded(included, parent, context);
        }
        finally
        {
            included.close();
        }

        for (int index = before; index < parent.getChildCount(); index++)
        {
            View child = parent.getChildAt(index);
            if (overrideId != View.NO_ID) child.setId(overrideId);
            if (overrideVisibility >= 0 && overrideVisibility <= 2) child.setVisibility(INCLUDE_VISIBILITIES[overrideVisibility]);
            if (overrideLayout)
            {
                try
                {
                    child.setLayoutParams(parent.generateLayoutParams(attributes));
                }
                catch (RuntimeException incomplete)
                {
                    if (TRACE_INFLATE) android.util.Log.i("LayoutInflater", "the include tag's layout params were incomplete", incomplete);
                }
            }
        }

        skipTag(parser);
    }

    private void inflateIncluded(XmlPullParser parser, ViewGroup parent, Context context)
    {
        int event = advance(parser);
        while (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG && event != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            event = advance(parser);
        }

        if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) throw new InflateException(parser.getPositionDescription() + ": No start tag found!");

        String name = parser.getName();

        if ("merge".equals(name))
        {
            readChildren(parser, parent, context, parser.getDepth());
            return;
        }

        AttributeSet attributes = asAttributeSet(parser);
        View created = createViewFromTag(parent, name, context, attributes, false);
        ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = parent.generateLayoutParams(attributes);
        inflateChildren(parser, created, parser.getDepth());
        parent.addView(created, params);
    }

    public final View createView(Context viewContext, String name, String prefix, AttributeSet attrs)
        throws ClassNotFoundException, InflateException
    {
        if (viewContext == null) throw new NullPointerException("viewContext");
        if (name == null) throw new NullPointerException("name");

        String qualified = prefix != null ? prefix + name : name;
        Constructor<? extends View> constructor;

        synchronized (sConstructorMap)
        {
            constructor = sConstructorMap.get(qualified);
        }

        if (constructor != null && !verifyClassLoader(constructor))
        {
            constructor = null;

            synchronized (sConstructorMap)
            {
                sConstructorMap.remove(qualified);
            }
        }

        Class<? extends View> type = null;

        try
        {
            if (constructor == null)
            {
                type = Class.forName(qualified, false, mContext.getClassLoader()).asSubclass(View.class);

                if (mFilter != null && !mFilter.onLoadClass(type)) failNotAllowed(name, prefix, viewContext, attrs);

                constructor = type.getConstructor(CONSTRUCTOR_SIGNATURE);
                constructor.setAccessible(true);

                synchronized (sConstructorMap)
                {
                    sConstructorMap.put(qualified, constructor);
                }
            }
            else if (mFilter != null)
            {
                Boolean allowed = mFilterMap.get(qualified);

                if (allowed == null)
                {
                    type = Class.forName(qualified, false, mContext.getClassLoader()).asSubclass(View.class);
                    allowed = mFilter.onLoadClass(type);
                    mFilterMap.put(qualified, allowed);
                }

                if (!allowed) failNotAllowed(name, prefix, viewContext, attrs);
            }

            View created = constructor.newInstance(viewContext, attrs);
            if (created instanceof ViewStub) ((ViewStub)created).setLayoutInflater(cloneInContext(viewContext));

            if (TRACE_INFLATE)
            {
                android.util.Log.i("LayoutInflater", "inflated " + qualified + " id=0x" + Integer.toHexString(created.getId()));
            }

            return created;
        }
        catch (NoSuchMethodException missing)
        {
            throw new InflateException(attrs.getPositionDescription() + ": Error inflating class " + qualified, missing);
        }
        catch (ClassCastException notView)
        {
            throw new InflateException(attrs.getPositionDescription() + ": Class is not a View " + qualified, notView);
        }
        catch (ClassNotFoundException absent)
        {
            throw absent;
        }
        catch (java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException failed)
        {
            Throwable cause = failed.getCause() == null ? failed : failed.getCause();
            throw new InflateException(attrs.getPositionDescription() + ": Error inflating class " + qualified, cause);
        }
        catch (InflateException rethrown)
        {
            throw rethrown;
        }
        catch (Exception failed)
        {
            throw new InflateException(attrs.getPositionDescription() + ": Error inflating class " + qualified, failed);
        }
    }

    public final View createView(String name, String prefix, AttributeSet attrs) throws ClassNotFoundException, InflateException
    {
        Context context = mCurrentContext != null ? mCurrentContext : mContext;
        return createView(context, name, prefix, attrs);
    }

    private Context mCurrentContext;

    private boolean verifyClassLoader(Constructor<? extends View> constructor)
    {
        ClassLoader constructorLoader = constructor.getDeclaringClass().getClassLoader();
        if (constructorLoader == LayoutInflater.class.getClassLoader()) return true;

        ClassLoader cursor = mContext.getClassLoader();
        while (cursor != null)
        {
            if (constructorLoader == cursor) return true;
            cursor = cursor.getParent();
        }

        return false;
    }

    private void failNotAllowed(String name, String prefix, Context context, AttributeSet attrs)
    {
        throw new InflateException(attrs.getPositionDescription() + ": Class not allowed to be inflated "
                                   + (prefix != null ? prefix + name : name));
    }

    protected View onCreateView(String name, AttributeSet attrs) throws ClassNotFoundException
    {
        return createView(name, "android.view.", attrs);
    }

    protected View onCreateView(View parent, String name, AttributeSet attrs) throws ClassNotFoundException
    {
        return onCreateView(name, attrs);
    }

    public View onCreateView(Context viewContext, View parent, String name, AttributeSet attrs) throws ClassNotFoundException
    {
        return onCreateView(parent, name, attrs);
    }

    private View createViewFromTag(View parent, String name, Context context, AttributeSet attrs, boolean ignoreThemeAttr)
    {
        if ("view".equals(name)) name = attrs.getAttributeValue(null, "class");
        if (name == null) throw new InflateException(attrs.getPositionDescription() + ": <view> needs a class attribute");

        if (!ignoreThemeAttr)
        {
            int themeResource = attrs.getAttributeResourceValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "theme", 0);
            if (themeResource != 0) context = new ContextThemeWrapper(context, themeResource);
        }

        View created = tryCreateView(parent, name, context, attrs);
        if (created != null) return created;

        Context previous = mCurrentContext;
        mCurrentContext = context;

        try
        {
            if (name.indexOf('.') < 0) created = onCreateView(context, parent, name, attrs);
            else created = createView(context, name, null, attrs);
        }
        catch (ClassNotFoundException absent)
        {
            throw new InflateException(attrs.getPositionDescription() + ": Error inflating class " + name, absent);
        }
        finally
        {
            mCurrentContext = previous;
        }

        if (created == null) throw new InflateException(attrs.getPositionDescription() + ": Error inflating class " + name);

        return created;
    }

    private View tryCreateView(View parent, String name, Context context, AttributeSet attrs)
    {
        View created = null;

        if (mFactory2 != null) created = mFactory2.onCreateView(parent, name, context, attrs);
        else if (mFactory != null) created = mFactory.onCreateView(name, context, attrs);

        if (created == null && mPrivateFactory != null) created = mPrivateFactory.onCreateView(parent, name, context, attrs);

        return created;
    }

    public interface Factory
    {
        View onCreateView(String name, Context context, AttributeSet attrs);
    }

    public interface Factory2 extends Factory
    {
        View onCreateView(View parent, String name, Context context, AttributeSet attrs);
    }

    public interface Filter
    {
        boolean onLoadClass(Class clazz);
    }

    private static final class FactoryMerger implements Factory2
    {
        private final Factory mFirst;
        private final Factory mSecond;
        private final Factory2 mFirst2;
        private final Factory2 mSecond2;

        FactoryMerger(Factory first, Factory2 first2, Factory second, Factory2 second2)
        {
            mFirst = first;
            mSecond = second;
            mFirst2 = first2;
            mSecond2 = second2;
        }

        @Override
        public View onCreateView(String name, Context context, AttributeSet attrs)
        {
            View created = mFirst.onCreateView(name, context, attrs);
            if (created != null) return created;

            return mSecond.onCreateView(name, context, attrs);
        }

        @Override
        public View onCreateView(View parent, String name, Context context, AttributeSet attrs)
        {
            View created = mFirst2 != null ? mFirst2.onCreateView(parent, name, context, attrs) : mFirst.onCreateView(name, context, attrs);
            if (created != null) return created;

            return mSecond2 != null ? mSecond2.onCreateView(parent, name, context, attrs) : mSecond.onCreateView(name, context, attrs);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/MenuInflater.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.content.res.XmlBlock;
import android.content.res.XmlResourceParser;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.util.Log;
import android.util.TypedValue;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class MenuInflater
{
    private static final String TAG = "MenuInflater";
    private static final String ANDROID_NAMESPACE = "http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android";
    private static final String[] SHOW_AS_ACTION_LABELS = {"never", "ifRoom", "always", "withText", "collapseActionView"};

    private final Context mContext;

    public MenuInflater(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public void inflate(int menuRes, Menu menu)
    {
        XmlResourceParser parser = null;

        try
        {
            parser = mContext.getResources().getLayout(menuRes);
            parseMenu(parser, parser, menu);
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            throw new InflateException("Error inflating menu XML", failure);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (parser != null) parser.close();
        }
    }

    private void parseMenu(XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Menu menu) throws Exception
    {
        int event = parser.getEventType();
        while (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG && event != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT) event = parser.next();

        if (event == XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT || !"menu".equals(parser.getName()))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expecting menu, got " + parser.getName());
        }

        parseChildren(parser, attributes, menu, new GroupState());
    }

    private static final class GroupState
    {
        int id = Menu.NONE;
        int category;
        int order;
        int checkable;
        boolean visible = true;
        boolean enabled = true;
    }

    private void parseChildren(XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Menu menu, GroupState group) throws Exception
    {
        int depth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= depth) return;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            String tag = parser.getName();

            if ("group".equals(tag))
            {
                GroupState nested = new GroupState();
                nested.id = reference(attributes, "id", Menu.NONE);
                nested.category = integer(attributes, "menuCategory", 0);
                nested.order = integer(attributes, "orderInCategory", 0);
                nested.checkable = integer(attributes, "checkableBehavior", 0);
                nested.visible = flag(attributes, "visible", true);
                nested.enabled = flag(attributes, "enabled", true);

                parseChildren(parser, attributes, menu, nested);
                continue;
            }

            if ("item".equals(tag))
            {
                parseItem(parser, attributes, menu, group);
                continue;
            }

            skip(parser);
        }
    }

    private void parseItem(XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes, Menu menu, GroupState group) throws Exception
    {
        int id = reference(attributes, "id", Menu.NONE);
        int category = integer(attributes, "menuCategory", group.category) & Menu.CATEGORY_MASK;
        int order = integer(attributes, "orderInCategory", group.order) | category;
        CharSequence title = text(attributes, "title");
        CharSequence condensed = text(attributes, "titleCondensed");
        int icon = reference(attributes, "icon", 0);
        int checkable = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "checkable") != null
                            ? (flag(attributes, "checkable", false) ? 1 : 0)
                            : group.checkable;
        boolean checked = flag(attributes, "checked", false);
        boolean visible = flag(attributes, "visible", group.visible);
        boolean enabled = flag(attributes, "enabled", group.enabled);
        int showAsAction = showAsAction(attributes);
        int actionLayout = reference(attributes, "actionLayout", 0);
        String actionViewClass = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "actionViewClass");

        MenuItem item;
        boolean hasSubMenu = false;
        SubMenu subMenu = null;

        int depth = parser.getDepth();
        int event;
        int marker = parser.getLineNumber();

        item = menu.add(group.id, id, order, title);

        while ((event = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG && parser.getDepth() <= depth) break;
            if (event != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            if ("menu".equals(parser.getName()))
            {
                if (!hasSubMenu)
                {
                    menu.removeItem(id);
                    subMenu = menu.addSubMenu(group.id, id, order, title);
                    item = subMenu.getItem();
                    hasSubMenu = true;
                }

                parseChildren(parser, attributes, subMenu, new GroupState());
                continue;
            }

            skip(parser);
        }

        if (condensed != null) item.setTitleCondensed(condensed);
        if (icon != 0) item.setIcon(icon);
        item.setCheckable(checkable != 0);
        if (checkable == 2 && menu instanceof RuntimeMenu) ((RuntimeMenu)menu).setGroupCheckable(group.id, true, true);
        item.setChecked(checked);
        item.setVisible(visible);
        item.setEnabled(enabled);
        if (showAsAction >= 0) item.setShowAsAction(showAsAction);

        if (actionLayout != 0)
        {
            item.setActionView(actionLayout);
        }
        else if (actionViewClass != null)
        {
            try
            {
                Class<?> type = mContext.getClassLoader().loadClass(actionViewClass);
                item.setActionView((View)type.getConstructor(Context.class).newInstance(mContext));
            }
            catch (ReflectiveOperationException failure)
            {
                Log.w(TAG, "cannot instantiate the action view " + actionViewClass + " for the item on line " + marker, failure);
            }
        }
    }

    private static void skip(XmlPullParser parser) throws Exception
    {
        int depth = 1;

        while (depth > 0)
        {
            int event = parser.next();
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT) return;
            if (event == XmlPullParser.START_TAG) depth++;
            if (event == XmlPullParser.END_TAG) depth--;
        }
    }

    private static int[] typedValue(AttributeSet attributes, String name)
    {
        if (!(attributes instanceof XmlBlock.Parser)) return null;

        return ((XmlBlock.Parser)attributes).getAttributeTypedValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
    }

    private static int reference(AttributeSet attributes, String name, int fallback)
    {
        int[] packed = typedValue(attributes, name);
        if (packed != null && packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_REFERENCE) return packed[1];

        return fallback;
    }

    private static int integer(AttributeSet attributes, String name, int fallback)
    {
        int[] packed = typedValue(attributes, name);
        if (packed != null && packed[0] >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && packed[0] <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return packed[1];

        String value = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
        if (value == null) return fallback;

        try
        {
            return Integer.parseInt(value);
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
        {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    private static boolean flag(AttributeSet attributes, String name, boolean fallback)
    {
        int[] packed = typedValue(attributes, name);
        if (packed != null && packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_INT_BOOLEAN) return packed[1] != 0;

        String value = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
        return value == null ? fallback : "true".equals(value);
    }

    private CharSequence text(AttributeSet attributes, String name)
    {
        int[] packed = typedValue(attributes, name);

        if (packed != null && packed[0] == TypedValue.TYPE_REFERENCE && packed[1] != 0)
        {
            try
            {
                return mContext.getResources().getText(packed[1]);
            }
            catch (Resources.NotFoundException missing)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        return attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, name);
    }

    private static int showAsAction(AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        int[] packed = typedValue(attributes, "showAsAction");
        if (packed != null && packed[0] >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && packed[0] <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return packed[1];

        String value = attributes.getAttributeValue(ANDROID_NAMESPACE, "showAsAction");
        if (value == null) return -1;

        int flags = 0;
        for (String part : value.split("\\|"))
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < SHOW_AS_ACTION_LABELS.length; index++)
            {
                if (SHOW_AS_ACTION_LABELS[index].equals(part.trim())) flags |= index == 0 ? 0 : 1 << (index - 1);
            }
        }

        return flags;
    }
}
```

```java
    private static final int DEFAULT_SOURCE = 0x1002;
    private static final int HISTORY_CURRENT = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    private static final long NANOS_PER_MILLISECOND = 1000000L;

    private static final String[] AXIS_NAMES = {"X", "Y", "PRESSURE", "SIZE", "TOUCH_MAJOR", "TOUCH_MINOR", "TOOL_MAJOR", "TOOL_MINOR",
                                                "ORIENTATION", "VSCROLL", "HSCROLL", "Z", "RX", "RY", "RZ", "HAT_X", "HAT_Y", "LTRIGGER",

                                                "GENERIC_4", "GENERIC_5", "GENERIC_6", "GENERIC_7", "GENERIC_8", "GENERIC_9",
                                                "GENERIC_10", "GENERIC_11", "GENERIC_12", "GENERIC_13", "GENERIC_14", "GENERIC_15",
                                                "GENERIC_16", "GESTURE_X_OFFSET", "GESTURE_Y_OFFSET", "GESTURE_SCROLL_X_DISTANCE",
                                                "GESTURE_SCROLL_Y_DISTANCE", "GESTURE_PINCH_SCALE_FACTOR"};

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<MotionEvent> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<MotionEvent>()
    {
        @Override
        public MotionEvent createFromParcel(Parcel in)
        {
            in.readInt();
            return createFromParcelBody(in);
        }

        @Override
        public MotionEvent[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new MotionEvent[size];
        }
    };

    private long mDownTimeNanos;
    private int mAction;
    private int mActionButton;
    private int mFlags;
    private int mEdgeFlags;
    private int mMetaState;
    private int mButtonState;
    private int mClassification;
    private int mDeviceId;
    private int mSource = DEFAULT_SOURCE;
    private int mDisplayId;
    private float mXPrecision = 1.0f;
    private float mYPrecision = 1.0f;
    private final float[] mTransform = {1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0};

    private int mPointerCount;
    private PointerProperties[] mProperties = new PointerProperties[0];
    private int mSampleCount;
    private long[] mSampleTimesNanos = new long[1];
    private PointerCoords[] mSamples = new PointerCoords[0];

    private MotionEvent()
    {
    }

    private static MotionEvent create(long downTime, long eventTime, int action, int pointerCount, PointerProperties[] properties,
                                      PointerCoords[] coords, int metaState, int buttonState, float xPrecision, float yPrecision,
                                      int deviceId, int edgeFlags, int source, int displayId, int flags, int classification)
    {
        if (pointerCount < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("pointerCount must be at least 1");
        if (properties == null || properties.length < pointerCount)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("pointerProperties array must be large enough to hold all pointers");
        }
        if (coords == null || coords.length < pointerCount)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("pointerCoords array must be large enough to hold all pointers");
        }

        MotionEvent event = new MotionEvent();
        event.mDownTimeNanos = downTime * NANOS_PER_MILLISECOND;
        event.mAction = action;
        event.mMetaState = metaState;
        event.mButtonState = buttonState;
        event.mXPrecision = xPrecision;
        event.mYPrecision = yPrecision;
        event.mDeviceId = deviceId;
        event.mEdgeFlags = edgeFlags;
        event.mSource = source;
        event.mDisplayId = displayId;
        event.mFlags = flags;
        event.mClassification = classification;
        event.mPointerCount = pointerCount;
        event.mProperties = new PointerProperties[pointerCount];

        for (int index = 0; index < pointerCount; index++)
        {
            event.mProperties[index] = new PointerProperties(properties[index]);
        }

        event.mSampleCount = 0;
        event.mSamples = new PointerCoords[pointerCount * 2];
        event.mSampleTimesNanos = new long[2];
        event.appendSample(eventTime * NANOS_PER_MILLISECOND, coords, false);
        return event;
    }

    private void appendSample(long eventTimeNanos, PointerCoords[] coords, boolean untransform)
    {
        int needed = (mSampleCount + 1) * mPointerCount;

        if (mSamples.length < needed) mSamples = Arrays.copyOf(mSamples, Math.max(needed, mSamples.length * 2));
        if (mSampleTimesNanos.length < mSampleCount + 1) mSampleTimesNanos = Arrays.copyOf(mSampleTimesNanos, (mSampleCount + 1) * 2);

        float[] inverse = untransform ? inverseTransform() : null;

        for (int pointer = 0; pointer < mPointerCount; pointer++)
        {
            PointerCoords source = pointer < coords.length && coords[pointer] != null ? coords[pointer] : sampleAt(mSampleCount - 1, pointer);
            PointerCoords copy = new PointerCoords(source);

            if (inverse != null)
            {
                float x = copy.x;
                float y = copy.y;
                copy.x = inverse[0] * x + inverse[1] * y + inverse[4];
                copy.y = inverse[2] * x + inverse[3] * y + inverse[5];
            }

            mSamples[mSampleCount * mPointerCount + pointer] = copy;
        }

        mSampleTimesNanos[mSampleCount] = eventTimeNanos;
        mSampleCount++;
    }

    private PointerCoords sampleAt(int sample, int pointer)
    {
        if (sample < 0) return new PointerCoords();

        return mSamples[sample * mPointerCount + pointer];
    }

    private float[] inverseTransform()
    {
        float a = mTransform[0];
        float b = mTransform[1];
        float c = mTransform[2];
        float d = mTransform[3];
        float determinant = a * d - b * c;
        if (determinant == 0) return null;

        float inverseA = d / determinant;
        float inverseB = -b / determinant;
        float inverseC = -c / determinant;
        float inverseD = a / determinant;
        float tx = mTransform[4];
        float ty = mTransform[5];

        return new float[] {inverseA, inverseB, inverseC, inverseD, -(inverseA * tx + inverseB * ty), -(inverseC * tx + inverseD * ty)};
    }

    private boolean isIdentity()
    {
        return mTransform[0] == 1 && mTransform[1] == 0 && mTransform[2] == 0 && mTransform[3] == 1 && mTransform[4] == 0
               && mTransform[5] == 0;
    }

    private static PointerProperties[] defaultProperties(int pointerCount, int[] pointerIds)
    {
        PointerProperties[] properties = new PointerProperties[pointerCount];

        for (int index = 0; index < pointerCount; index++)
        {
            properties[index] = new PointerProperties();
            properties[index].id = pointerIds == null ? index : pointerIds[index];
            properties[index].toolType = TOOL_TYPE_FINGER;
        }

        return properties;
    }

    private static PointerCoords coords(float x, float y, float pressure, float size)
    {
        PointerCoords coords = new PointerCoords();
        coords.x = x;
        coords.y = y;
        coords.pressure = pressure;
        coords.size = size;
        return coords;
    }

    }

    public static MotionEvent obtain(long downTime, long eventTime, int action, int pointerCount, int[] pointerIds, float[] x,
                                     float[] y, float[] pressure, int metaState, int deviceId, int source)
    {
        PointerCoords[] coords = new PointerCoords[pointerCount];
        for (int index = 0; index < pointerCount; index++)
        {
            coords[index] = coords(x[index], y[index], pressure == null ? 1.0f : pressure[index], 0);
        }

        return create(downTime, eventTime, action, pointerCount, defaultProperties(pointerCount, pointerIds), coords, metaState, 0, 1.0f,
                      1.0f, deviceId, 0, source, Display.DEFAULT_DISPLAY, 0, CLASSIFICATION_NONE);
    }

    public static MotionEvent obtain(long downTime, long eventTime, int action, int pointerCount, int[] pointerIds, float[] x,
                                     float[] y, int metaState)
    {
        return obtain(downTime, eventTime, action, pointerCount, pointerIds, x, y, null, metaState, 0, DEFAULT_SOURCE);
    }

    public static MotionEvent obtain(MotionEvent other)
    {
        if (other == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("other motion event must not be null");

        MotionEvent event = other.copyHeader();
        event.mSampleCount = other.mSampleCount;
        event.mSampleTimesNanos = Arrays.copyOf(other.mSampleTimesNanos, Math.max(1, other.mSampleCount));
        event.mSamples = new PointerCoords[other.mSampleCount * other.mPointerCount];

        for (int index = 0; index < event.mSamples.length; index++)
        {
            event.mSamples[index] = new PointerCoords(other.mSamples[index]);
        }

        return event;
    }

    public static MotionEvent obtainNoHistory(MotionEvent other)
    {
        if (other == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("other motion event must not be null");

        MotionEvent event = other.copyHeader();
        int last = other.mSampleCount - 1;
        event.mSampleCount = 1;
        event.mSampleTimesNanos = new long[] {other.mSampleTimesNanos[last]};
        event.mSamples = new PointerCoords[other.mPointerCount];

        for (int pointer = 0; pointer < other.mPointerCount; pointer++)
        {
            event.mSamples[pointer] = new PointerCoords(other.sampleAt(last, pointer));
        }

        return event;
    }

    private MotionEvent copyHeader()
    {
        MotionEvent event = new MotionEvent();
        event.mDownTimeNanos = mDownTimeNanos;
        event.mAction = mAction;
        event.mActionButton = mActionButton;
        event.mFlags = mFlags;
        event.mEdgeFlags = mEdgeFlags;
        event.mMetaState = mMetaState;
        event.mButtonState = mButtonState;
        event.mClassification = mClassification;
        event.mDeviceId = mDeviceId;
        event.mSource = mSource;
        event.mDisplayId = mDisplayId;
        event.mXPrecision = mXPrecision;
        event.mYPrecision = mYPrecision;
        System.arraycopy(mTransform, 0, event.mTransform, 0, mTransform.length);
        event.mPointerCount = mPointerCount;
        event.mProperties = new PointerProperties[mPointerCount];

        for (int index = 0; index < mPointerCount; index++)
        {
            event.mProperties[index] = new PointerProperties(mProperties[index]);
        }

        return event;
    }

    static MotionEvent createFromParcelBody(Parcel in)
    {
        MotionEvent event = new MotionEvent();
        int pointerCount = in.readInt();
        int sampleCount = in.readInt();

        event.mDeviceId = in.readInt();
        event.mSource = in.readInt();
        event.mDisplayId = in.readInt();
        event.mAction = in.readInt();
        event.mActionButton = in.readInt();
        event.mFlags = in.readInt();
        event.mEdgeFlags = in.readInt();
        event.mMetaState = in.readInt();
        event.mButtonState = in.readInt();
        event.mClassification = in.readInt();
        event.mXPrecision = in.readFloat();
        event.mYPrecision = in.readFloat();
        event.mDownTimeNanos = in.readLong();

        for (int index = 0; index < event.mTransform.length; index++)
        {
            event.mTransform[index] = in.readFloat();
        }

        event.mPointerCount = pointerCount;
        event.mProperties = new PointerProperties[pointerCount];

        for (int index = 0; index < pointerCount; index++)
        {
            PointerProperties properties = new PointerProperties();
            properties.id = in.readInt();
            properties.toolType = in.readInt();
            event.mProperties[index] = properties;
        }

        event.mSampleCount = sampleCount;
        event.mSampleTimesNanos = new long[Math.max(1, sampleCount)];
        event.mSamples = new PointerCoords[sampleCount * pointerCount];

        for (int sample = 0; sample < sampleCount; sample++)
        {
            event.mSampleTimesNanos[sample] = in.readLong();

            for (int pointer = 0; pointer < pointerCount; pointer++)
            {
                event.mSamples[sample * pointerCount + pointer] = PointerCoords.readFromParcel(in);
            }
        }

        return event;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
    {
        out.writeInt(PARCEL_TOKEN_MOTION_EVENT);
        out.writeInt(mPointerCount);
        out.writeInt(mSampleCount);
        out.writeInt(mDeviceId);
        out.writeInt(mSource);
        out.writeInt(mDisplayId);
        out.writeInt(mAction);
        out.writeInt(mActionButton);
        out.writeInt(mFlags);
        out.writeInt(mEdgeFlags);
        out.writeInt(mMetaState);
        out.writeInt(mButtonState);
        out.writeInt(mClassification);
        out.writeFloat(mXPrecision);
        out.writeFloat(mYPrecision);
        out.writeLong(mDownTimeNanos);

        for (float value : mTransform)
        {
            out.writeFloat(value);
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < mPointerCount; index++)
        {
            out.writeInt(mProperties[index].id);
            out.writeInt(mProperties[index].toolType);
        }

        for (int sample = 0; sample < mSampleCount; sample++)
        {
            out.writeLong(mSampleTimesNanos[sample]);

            for (int pointer = 0; pointer < mPointerCount; pointer++)
            {
                sampleAt(sample, pointer).writeToParcel(out);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    {
    }

    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        super.finalize();
    }

    public final void addBatch(long eventTime, float x, float y, float pressure, float size, int metaState)
    {
        PointerCoords[] coords = new PointerCoords[mPointerCount];
        coords[0] = coords(x, y, pressure, size);

        for (int pointer = 1; pointer < mPointerCount; pointer++)
        {
            coords[pointer] = transformedCoords(mSampleCount - 1, pointer);
        }

        appendSample(eventTime * NANOS_PER_MILLISECOND, coords, true);
        mMetaState |= metaState;
    }

    public final void addBatch(long eventTime, PointerCoords[] pointerCoords, int metaState)
    {
        if (pointerCoords == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("pointerCoords must not be null");

        appendSample(eventTime * NANOS_PER_MILLISECOND, pointerCoords, true);
        mMetaState |= metaState;
    }

    private PointerCoords transformedCoords(int sample, int pointer)
    {
        PointerCoords raw = sampleAt(sample, pointer);
        PointerCoords result = new PointerCoords(raw);
        if (isIdentity()) return result;

        result.x = mTransform[0] * raw.x + mTransform[1] * raw.y + mTransform[4];
        result.y = mTransform[2] * raw.x + mTransform[3] * raw.y + mTransform[5];

        float relativeX = raw.getAxisValue(AXIS_RELATIVE_X);
        float relativeY = raw.getAxisValue(AXIS_RELATIVE_Y);
        if (relativeX != 0 || relativeY != 0)
        {
            result.setAxisValue(AXIS_RELATIVE_X, mTransform[0] * relativeX + mTransform[1] * relativeY);
            result.setAxisValue(AXIS_RELATIVE_Y, mTransform[2] * relativeX + mTransform[3] * relativeY);
        }

        if (raw.orientation != 0 || mTransform[1] != 0 || mTransform[2] != 0)
        {
            float vectorX = (float)Math.sin(raw.orientation);
            float vectorY = (float)-Math.cos(raw.orientation);
            float transformedX = mTransform[0] * vectorX + mTransform[1] * vectorY;
            float transformedY = mTransform[2] * vectorX + mTransform[3] * vectorY;
            result.orientation = (float)Math.atan2(transformedX, -transformedY);
        }

        return result;
    }

    private int sampleIndex(int position)
    {
        if (position == HISTORY_CURRENT) return mSampleCount - 1;
        if (position < 0 || position >= mSampleCount - 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("historyPos out of range");

        return position;
    }

    private void checkPointer(int pointerIndex)
    {
        if (pointerIndex < 0 || pointerIndex >= mPointerCount) throw new IllegalArgumentException("pointerIndex out of range");
    }

    private float axis(int axis, int pointerIndex, int position)
    {
        checkPointer(pointerIndex);

        return transformedCoords(sampleIndex(position), pointerIndex).getAxisValue(axis);
    }

    private float rawAxis(int axis, int pointerIndex)
    {
        checkPointer(pointerIndex);

        return sampleAt(mSampleCount - 1, pointerIndex).getAxisValue(axis);
    }

    public final void offsetLocation(float deltaX, float deltaY)
    {
        if (deltaX == 0 && deltaY == 0) return;

        mTransform[4] += deltaX;
        mTransform[5] += deltaY;
    }

    public final void setLocation(float x, float y)
    {
        offsetLocation(x - getX(), y - getY());
    }

    public final void transform(Matrix matrix)
    {
        if (matrix == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("matrix must not be null");

        float[] values = new float[9];
        matrix.getValues(values);

        float a = values[Matrix.MSCALE_X];
        float b = values[Matrix.MSKEW_X];
        float tx = values[Matrix.MTRANS_X];
        float c = values[Matrix.MSKEW_Y];
        float d = values[Matrix.MSCALE_Y];
        float ty = values[Matrix.MTRANS_Y];

        float[] current = mTransform.clone();
        mTransform[0] = a * current[0] + b * current[2];
        mTransform[1] = a * current[1] + b * current[3];
        mTransform[2] = c * current[0] + d * current[2];
        mTransform[3] = c * current[1] + d * current[3];
        mTransform[4] = a * current[4] + b * current[5] + tx;
        mTransform[5] = c * current[4] + d * current[5] + ty;
    }

    public final int findPointerIndex(int pointerId)
    {

    }

    public final void getHistoricalPointerCoords(int pointerIndex, int pos, PointerCoords outPointerCoords)
    {
        checkPointer(pointerIndex);
        if (outPointerCoords == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("outPointerCoords must not be null");

        outPointerCoords.copyFrom(transformedCoords(sampleIndex(pos), pointerIndex));
    }

    public static String actionToString(int action)
    {
        switch (action)
        {
            case ACTION_DOWN:
                return "ACTION_DOWN";
            case ACTION_UP:
                return "ACTION_UP";
            case ACTION_CANCEL:
                return "ACTION_CANCEL";
            case ACTION_OUTSIDE:
                return "ACTION_OUTSIDE";
            case ACTION_MOVE:
                return "ACTION_MOVE";
            case ACTION_HOVER_MOVE:
                return "ACTION_HOVER_MOVE";
            case ACTION_SCROLL:
                return "ACTION_SCROLL";
            case ACTION_HOVER_ENTER:
                return "ACTION_HOVER_ENTER";
            case ACTION_HOVER_EXIT:
                return "ACTION_HOVER_EXIT";
            case ACTION_BUTTON_PRESS:
                return "ACTION_BUTTON_PRESS";
            case ACTION_BUTTON_RELEASE:
                return "ACTION_BUTTON_RELEASE";
            default:
                break;
        }

        int index = (action & ACTION_POINTER_INDEX_MASK) >> ACTION_POINTER_INDEX_SHIFT;

        switch (action & ACTION_MASK)
        {
            case ACTION_POINTER_DOWN:
                return "ACTION_POINTER_DOWN(" + index + ")";
            case ACTION_POINTER_UP:
                return "ACTION_POINTER_UP(" + index + ")";
            default:
                return Integer.toString(action);
        }
    }

    public static String axisToString(int axis)
    {
        if (axis >= 0 && axis < AXIS_NAMES.length && AXIS_NAMES[axis] != null) return "AXIS_" + AXIS_NAMES[axis];

        return Integer.toString(axis);
    }

    public static int axisFromString(String symbolicName)
    {
        if (symbolicName == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("symbolicName must not be null");

        if (symbolicName.startsWith("AXIS_"))
        {
            String name = symbolicName.substring("AXIS_".length());

            for (int axis = 0; axis < AXIS_NAMES.length; axis++)
            {
                if (name.equals(AXIS_NAMES[axis])) return axis;
            }
        }

        try
        {
            return Integer.parseInt(symbolicName, 10);
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
        {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder("MotionEvent { action=").append(actionToString(getAction()));

        for (int index = 0; index < mPointerCount; index++)
        {
            builder.append(", id[").append(index).append("]=").append(getPointerId(index));
            builder.append(", x[").append(index).append("]=").append(getX(index));
            builder.append(", y[").append(index).append("]=").append(getY(index));
            builder.append(", toolType[").append(index).append("]=").append(getToolType(index));
        }

        builder.append(", buttonState=").append(mButtonState);
        builder.append(", metaState=").append(KeyEvent.metaStateToString(mMetaState));
        builder.append(", flags=0x").append(Integer.toHexString(mFlags));
        builder.append(", edgeFlags=0x").append(Integer.toHexString(mEdgeFlags));
        builder.append(", pointerCount=").append(mPointerCount);
        builder.append(", historySize=").append(getHistorySize());
        builder.append(", eventTime=").append(getEventTime());
        builder.append(", downTime=").append(getDownTime());
        builder.append(", deviceId=").append(mDeviceId);
        builder.append(", source=0x").append(Integer.toHexString(mSource));
        builder.append(", displayId=").append(mDisplayId);
        return builder.append(" }").toString();
    }

    public static final class PointerProperties
    {
        public int id;
        public int toolType;

        public PointerProperties()
        {
            clear();
        }

        public PointerProperties(PointerProperties other)
        {
            copyFrom(other);
        }

        public void clear()
        {
            id = INVALID_POINTER_ID;
            toolType = TOOL_TYPE_UNKNOWN;
        }

        public void copyFrom(PointerProperties other)
        {
            id = other.id;
            toolType = other.toolType;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object other)
        {
            if (!(other instanceof PointerProperties)) return false;

            PointerProperties properties = (PointerProperties)other;
            return id == properties.id && toolType == properties.toolType;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode()
        {
            return id | (toolType << 8);
        }
    }

    public static final class PointerCoords
    {
        public float x;
        public float y;
        public float pressure;
        public float size;
        public float touchMajor;
        public float touchMinor;
        public float toolMajor;
        public float toolMinor;
        public float orientation;

        private long mPackedAxisBits;
        private float[] mPackedAxisValues;
        private boolean mIsResampled;

        public PointerCoords()
        {
        }

        public PointerCoords(PointerCoords other)
        {
            copyFrom(other);
        }

        public void clear()
        {
            mPackedAxisBits = 0;
            mPackedAxisValues = null;
            x = 0;
            y = 0;
            pressure = 0;
            size = 0;
            touchMajor = 0;
            touchMinor = 0;
            toolMajor = 0;
            toolMinor = 0;
            orientation = 0;
            mIsResampled = false;
        }

        public void copyFrom(PointerCoords other)
        {
            mPackedAxisBits = other.mPackedAxisBits;
            mPackedAxisValues = other.mPackedAxisValues == null ? null : other.mPackedAxisValues.clone();
            x = other.x;
            y = other.y;
            pressure = other.pressure;
            size = other.size;
            touchMajor = other.touchMajor;
            touchMinor = other.touchMinor;
            toolMajor = other.toolMajor;
            toolMinor = other.toolMinor;
            orientation = other.orientation;
            mIsResampled = other.mIsResampled;
        }

        public boolean isResampled()
        {
            return mIsResampled;
        }

        public float getAxisValue(int axis)
        {
            switch (axis)
            {
                case AXIS_X:
                    return x;
                case AXIS_Y:
                    return y;
                case AXIS_PRESSURE:
                    return pressure;
                case AXIS_SIZE:
                    return size;
                case AXIS_TOUCH_MAJOR:
                    return touchMajor;
                case AXIS_TOUCH_MINOR:
                    return touchMinor;
                case AXIS_TOOL_MAJOR:
                    return toolMajor;
                case AXIS_TOOL_MINOR:
                    return toolMinor;
                case AXIS_ORIENTATION:
                    return orientation;
                default:
                    break;
            }

            if (axis < 0 || axis > 63) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Axis out of range.");

            long bit = 1L << axis;
            if ((mPackedAxisBits & bit) == 0) return 0;

            return mPackedAxisValues[Long.bitCount(mPackedAxisBits & (bit - 1))];
        }

        public void setAxisValue(int axis, float value)
        {
            switch (axis)
            {
                case AXIS_X:
                    x = value;
                    return;
                case AXIS_Y:
                    y = value;
                    return;
                case AXIS_PRESSURE:
                    pressure = value;
                    return;
                case AXIS_SIZE:
                    size = value;
                    return;
                case AXIS_TOUCH_MAJOR:
                    touchMajor = value;
                    return;
                case AXIS_TOUCH_MINOR:
                    touchMinor = value;
                    return;
                case AXIS_TOOL_MAJOR:
                    toolMajor = value;
                    return;
                case AXIS_TOOL_MINOR:
                    toolMinor = value;
                    return;
                case AXIS_ORIENTATION:
                    orientation = value;
                    return;
                default:
                    break;
            }

            if (axis < 0 || axis > 63) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Axis out of range.");

            long bit = 1L << axis;
            int index = Long.bitCount(mPackedAxisBits & (bit - 1));

            if ((mPackedAxisBits & bit) != 0)
            {
                mPackedAxisValues[index] = value;
                return;
            }

            int count = Long.bitCount(mPackedAxisBits);
            float[] values = new float[count + 1];
            if (mPackedAxisValues != null)
            {
                System.arraycopy(mPackedAxisValues, 0, values, 0, index);
                System.arraycopy(mPackedAxisValues, index, values, index + 1, count - index);
            }

            values[index] = value;
            mPackedAxisValues = values;
            mPackedAxisBits |= bit;
        }

        void writeToParcel(Parcel out)
        {
            out.writeFloat(x);
            out.writeFloat(y);
            out.writeFloat(pressure);
            out.writeFloat(size);
            out.writeFloat(touchMajor);
            out.writeFloat(touchMinor);
            out.writeFloat(toolMajor);
            out.writeFloat(toolMinor);
            out.writeFloat(orientation);
            out.writeLong(mPackedAxisBits);

            int count = Long.bitCount(mPackedAxisBits);
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                out.writeFloat(mPackedAxisValues[index]);
            }

            out.writeInt(mIsResampled ? 1 : 0);
        }

        static PointerCoords readFromParcel(Parcel in)
        {
            PointerCoords coords = new PointerCoords();
            coords.x = in.readFloat();
            coords.y = in.readFloat();
            coords.pressure = in.readFloat();
            coords.size = in.readFloat();
            coords.touchMajor = in.readFloat();
            coords.touchMinor = in.readFloat();
            coords.toolMajor = in.readFloat();
            coords.toolMinor = in.readFloat();
            coords.orientation = in.readFloat();
            coords.mPackedAxisBits = in.readLong();

            int count = Long.bitCount(coords.mPackedAxisBits);
            if (count > 0)
            {
                coords.mPackedAxisValues = new float[count];
                for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
                {
                    coords.mPackedAxisValues[index] = in.readFloat();
                }
            }

            coords.mIsResampled = in.readInt() != 0;
            return coords;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/PixelCopy.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.os.Handler;

import java.util.concurrent.Executor;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

public final class PixelCopy
{
    public static final int SUCCESS = 0;
    public static final int ERROR_UNKNOWN = 1;
    public static final int ERROR_TIMEOUT = 2;
    public static final int ERROR_SOURCE_NO_DATA = 3;
    public static final int ERROR_SOURCE_INVALID = 4;
    public static final int ERROR_DESTINATION_INVALID = 5;

    private PixelCopy()
    {
    }

    public interface OnPixelCopyFinishedListener
    {
        void onPixelCopyFinished(int copyResult);
    }

    public static void request(SurfaceView source, Bitmap dest, OnPixelCopyFinishedListener listener, Handler listenerThread)
    {
        request(source, null, dest, listener, listenerThread);
    }

    public static void request(SurfaceView source, Rect srcRect, Bitmap dest, OnPixelCopyFinishedListener listener, Handler listenerThread)
    {
        request(source.getHolder().getSurface(), srcRect, dest, listener, listenerThread);
    }

    public static void request(Surface source, Bitmap dest, OnPixelCopyFinishedListener listener, Handler listenerThread)
    {
        request(source, null, dest, listener, listenerThread);
    }

    public static void request(Surface source, Rect srcRect, Bitmap dest, OnPixelCopyFinishedListener listener, Handler listenerThread)
    {
        validateBitmapDest(dest);
        if (source == null || !source.isValid()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Surface isn't valid, source.isValid() == false");
        if (srcRect != null && srcRect.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("sourceRect is empty");

        int result = copySurface(source, srcRect, dest);
        deliver(result, listener, listenerThread);
    }

    public static void request(Window source, Bitmap dest, OnPixelCopyFinishedListener listener, Handler listenerThread)
    {
        request(source, null, dest, listener, listenerThread);
    }

    public static void request(Window source, Rect srcRect, Bitmap dest, OnPixelCopyFinishedListener listener, Handler listenerThread)
    {
        validateBitmapDest(dest);
        if (source == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("source is null");
        if (source.peekDecorView() == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only able to copy windows with decor views");
        if (srcRect != null && srcRect.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("sourceRect is empty");

        int result = copyView(source.peekDecorView(), srcRect, dest);
        deliver(result, listener, listenerThread);
    }

    public static void request(Request request, Executor callbackExecutor, Consumer<Result> listener)
    {
        if (request == null || callbackExecutor == null || listener == null) throw new NullPointerException();

        Bitmap destination = request.mDestination;
        int status;

        if (request.mSurface != null && !request.mSurface.isValid())
        {
            status = ERROR_SOURCE_INVALID;
        }
        else
        {
            if (destination == null)
            {
                Rect bounds = request.sourceBounds();
                if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())
                {
                    callbackExecutor.execute(() -> listener.accept(new Result(ERROR_SOURCE_INVALID, null)));
                    return;
                }

                destination = Bitmap.createBitmap(bounds.width(), bounds.height(), Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
            }

            if (request.mSurface != null) status = copySurface(request.mSurface, request.mSourceRect, destination);
            else status = copyView(request.mView, request.mSourceRect, destination);
        }

        Result result = new Result(status, status == SUCCESS ? destination : null);
        callbackExecutor.execute(() -> listener.accept(result));
    }

    private static void validateBitmapDest(Bitmap bitmap)
    {
        if (bitmap == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bitmap cannot be null");
        if (bitmap.isRecycled()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bitmap is recycled");
        if (!bitmap.isMutable()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bitmap is immutable");
    }

    private static void deliver(int result, OnPixelCopyFinishedListener listener, Handler handler)
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("listener cannot be null");

        Handler target = handler == null ? new Handler(android.os.Looper.getMainLooper()) : handler;
        if (!target.post(() -> listener.onPixelCopyFinished(result))) listener.onPixelCopyFinished(result);
    }

    private static int copySurface(Surface source, Rect sourceRect, Bitmap dest)
    {
        Bitmap front = source.peekFrontBuffer();
        if (front == null || front.isRecycled()) return ERROR_SOURCE_NO_DATA;

        Rect from = sourceRect == null ? new Rect(0, 0, front.getWidth(), front.getHeight()) : new Rect(sourceRect);
        if (!from.intersect(0, 0, front.getWidth(), front.getHeight())) return ERROR_SOURCE_INVALID;

        try
        {
            new Canvas(dest).drawBitmap(front, from, new Rect(0, 0, dest.getWidth(), dest.getHeight()), new Paint(Paint.FILTER_BITMAP_FLAG));
            return SUCCESS;
        }
        catch (RuntimeException failure)
        {
            return ERROR_DESTINATION_INVALID;
        }
    }

    private static int copyView(View view, Rect sourceRect, Bitmap dest)
    {
        if (view == null) return ERROR_SOURCE_INVALID;
        if (view.getWidth() <= 0 || view.getHeight() <= 0) return ERROR_SOURCE_NO_DATA;

        Rect from = sourceRect == null ? new Rect(0, 0, view.getWidth(), view.getHeight()) : new Rect(sourceRect);
        if (!from.intersect(0, 0, view.getWidth(), view.getHeight())) return ERROR_SOURCE_INVALID;

        try
        {
            Canvas canvas = new Canvas(dest);
            canvas.scale(dest.getWidth() / (float)from.width(), dest.getHeight() / (float)from.height());
            canvas.translate(-from.left, -from.top);
            view.draw(canvas);
            return SUCCESS;
        }
        catch (RuntimeException failure)
        {
            android.util.Log.w("PixelCopy", "the window could not be copied", failure);
            return ERROR_UNKNOWN;
        }
    }

    public static final class Result
    {
        private final int mStatus;
        private final Bitmap mBitmap;

        Result(int status, Bitmap bitmap)
        {
            mStatus = status;
            mBitmap = bitmap;
        }

        public int getStatus()
        {
            return mStatus;
        }

        public Bitmap getBitmap()
        {
            if (mStatus != SUCCESS) throw new IllegalStateException("getBitmap() is not valid for a failed copy, status " + mStatus);

            return mBitmap;
        }
    }

    public static final class Request
    {
        private final Surface mSurface;
        private final View mView;
        private final Rect mSourceRect;
        private final Bitmap mDestination;

        Request(Surface surface, View view, Rect sourceRect, Bitmap destination)
        {
            mSurface = surface;
            mView = view;
            mSourceRect = sourceRect;
            mDestination = destination;
        }

        Rect sourceBounds()
        {
            if (mSourceRect != null) return new Rect(mSourceRect);
            if (mView != null) return new Rect(0, 0, mView.getWidth(), mView.getHeight());

            Bitmap front = mSurface == null ? null : mSurface.peekFrontBuffer();
            return front == null ? null : new Rect(0, 0, front.getWidth(), front.getHeight());
        }

        public Rect getSourceRect()
        {
            return mSourceRect;
        }

        public Bitmap getDestinationBitmap()
        {
            return mDestination;
        }

        public static final class Builder
        {
            private final Surface mSurface;
            private final View mView;
            private Rect mSourceRect;
            private Bitmap mDestination;

            private Builder(Surface surface, View view)
            {
                mSurface = surface;
                mView = view;
            }

            public static Builder ofSurface(Surface source)
            {
                if (source == null || !source.isValid()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source must not be null & must be valid");

                return new Builder(source, null);
            }

            public static Builder ofSurface(SurfaceView source)
            {
                return ofSurface(source.getHolder().getSurface());
            }

            public static Builder ofWindow(Window source)
            {
                if (source == null || source.peekDecorView() == null)
                {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only able to copy windows with decor views");
                }

                return new Builder(null, source.peekDecorView());
            }

            public static Builder ofWindow(View source)
            {
                if (source == null || !source.isAttachedToWindow())
                {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("View must not be null & must be attached to window");
                }

                return new Builder(null, source.getRootView());
            }

            public Builder setSourceRect(Rect srcRect)
            {
                mSourceRect = srcRect == null ? null : new Rect(srcRect);
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setDestinationBitmap(Bitmap destination)
            {
                if (destination != null) validateBitmapDest(destination);

                mDestination = destination;
                return this;
            }

            public Request build()
            {
                return new Request(mSurface, mView, mSourceRect, mDestination);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class PointerIcon implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int TYPE_NULL = 0;
    public static final int TYPE_ARROW = 1000;
    public static final int TYPE_DEFAULT = TYPE_ARROW;
    public static final int TYPE_CONTEXT_MENU = 1001;
    public static final int TYPE_HAND = 1002;
    public static final int TYPE_HELP = 1003;
    public static final int TYPE_WAIT = 1004;
    public static final int TYPE_CELL = 1006;
    public static final int TYPE_CROSSHAIR = 1007;
    public static final int TYPE_TEXT = 1008;
    public static final int TYPE_VERTICAL_TEXT = 1009;
    public static final int TYPE_ALIAS = 1010;
    public static final int TYPE_COPY = 1011;
    public static final int TYPE_NO_DROP = 1012;
    public static final int TYPE_ALL_SCROLL = 1013;
    public static final int TYPE_HORIZONTAL_DOUBLE_ARROW = 1014;
    public static final int TYPE_VERTICAL_DOUBLE_ARROW = 1015;
    public static final int TYPE_TOP_RIGHT_DIAGONAL_DOUBLE_ARROW = 1016;
    public static final int TYPE_TOP_LEFT_DIAGONAL_DOUBLE_ARROW = 1017;
    public static final int TYPE_ZOOM_IN = 1018;
    public static final int TYPE_ZOOM_OUT = 1019;
    public static final int TYPE_GRAB = 1020;
    public static final int TYPE_GRABBING = 1021;
    public static final int TYPE_HANDWRITING = 1022;

    private static final int TYPE_CUSTOM = -1;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<PointerIcon> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<PointerIcon>()
    {
        @Override
        public PointerIcon createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int type = source.readInt();
            float hotSpotX = source.readFloat();
            float hotSpotY = source.readFloat();
            return new PointerIcon(type, null, hotSpotX, hotSpotY);
        }

        @Override
        public PointerIcon[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new PointerIcon[size];
        }
    };

    private static final android.util.SparseArray<PointerIcon> sSystemIcons = new android.util.SparseArray<>();

    private final int mType;
    private final Bitmap mBitmap;
    private final float mHotSpotX;
    private final float mHotSpotY;

    private PointerIcon(int type, Bitmap bitmap, float hotSpotX, float hotSpotY)
    {
        mType = type;
        mBitmap = bitmap;
        mHotSpotX = hotSpotX;
        mHotSpotY = hotSpotY;
    }

    public static PointerIcon getSystemIcon(Context context, int type)
    {
        if (context == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("context must not be null");

        synchronized (sSystemIcons)
        {
            PointerIcon icon = sSystemIcons.get(type);
            if (icon == null)
            {
                icon = new PointerIcon(type, null, 0, 0);
                sSystemIcons.put(type, icon);
            }
            return icon;
        }
    }

    public static PointerIcon create(Bitmap bitmap, float hotSpotX, float hotSpotY)
    {
        if (bitmap == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("bitmap must not be null");
        if (hotSpotX < 0 || hotSpotX >= bitmap.getWidth()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("x hotspot lies outside of the bitmap area");
        if (hotSpotY < 0 || hotSpotY >= bitmap.getHeight()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("y hotspot lies outside of the bitmap area");

        return new PointerIcon(TYPE_CUSTOM, bitmap, hotSpotX, hotSpotY);
    }

    public static PointerIcon load(android.content.res.Resources resources, int resourceId)
    {
        if (resources == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("resources must not be null");
        return new PointerIcon(TYPE_CUSTOM, null, 0, 0);
    }

    int getType()
    {
        return mType;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mType);
        dest.writeFloat(mHotSpotX);
        dest.writeFloat(mHotSpotY);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof PointerIcon)) return false;

        PointerIcon icon = (PointerIcon)other;
        if (mType != icon.mType) return false;
        if (mType != TYPE_CUSTOM) return true;

        return mBitmap == icon.mBitmap && mHotSpotX == icon.mHotSpotX && mHotSpotY == icon.mHotSpotY;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mType;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "PointerIcon{type=" + mType + ", hotspotX=" + mHotSpotX + ", hotspotY=" + mHotSpotY + "}";
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view;

import android.graphics.Point;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class RoundedCorner implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int POSITION_TOP_LEFT = 0;
    public static final int POSITION_TOP_RIGHT = 1;
    public static final int POSITION_BOTTOM_RIGHT = 2;
    public static final int POSITION_BOTTOM_LEFT = 3;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<RoundedCorner> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<RoundedCorner>()
    {
        @Override
        public RoundedCorner createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new RoundedCorner(source.readInt(), source.readInt(), source.readInt(), source.readInt());
        }

        @Override
        public RoundedCorner[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new RoundedCorner[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mPosition;
    private final int mRadius;
    private final Point mCenter;

    public RoundedCorner(int position, int radius, int centerX, int centerY)
    {
        mPosition = position;
        mRadius = radius > 0 ? radius : 0;
        mCenter = new Point(radius > 0 ? centerX : 0, radius > 0 ? centerY : 0);
    }

    public int getPosition()
    {
        return mPosition;
    }

    public int getRadius()
    {
        return mRadius;
    }

    public Point getCenter()
    {
        return new Point(mCenter.x, mCenter.y);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (other == this) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof RoundedCorner)) return false;

        RoundedCorner corner = (RoundedCorner)other;
        return mPosition == corner.mPosition && mRadius == corner.mRadius && mCenter.x == corner.mCenter.x && mCenter.y == corner.mCenter.y;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        int result = 0;
        result = 31 * result + mPosition;
        result = 31 * result + mRadius;
        result = 31 * result + mCenter.x;
        result = 31 * result + mCenter.y;
        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "RoundedCorner{position=" + mPosition + ", radius=" + mRadius + ", center=" + mCenter + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mPosition);
        dest.writeInt(mRadius);
        dest.writeInt(mCenter.x);
        dest.writeInt(mCenter.y);
    }
}
```
