```java
package android.view;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

public class RuntimeLayoutInflater extends LayoutInflater
{
    private static final String[] CLASS_PREFIXES = {"android.widget.", "android.webkit.", "android.app."};

    public RuntimeLayoutInflater(Context context)
    {
        super(context);
    }

    protected RuntimeLayoutInflater(LayoutInflater original, Context newContext)
    {
        super(original, newContext);
    }

    @Override
    protected View onCreateView(String name, AttributeSet attrs) throws ClassNotFoundException
    {
        for (String prefix : CLASS_PREFIXES)
        {
            try
            {
                View view = createView(name, prefix, attrs);
                if (view != null) return view;
            }
            catch (ClassNotFoundException absent)
            {
            }
        }

        return super.onCreateView(name, attrs);
    }

    @Override
    public LayoutInflater cloneInContext(Context newContext)
    {
        return new RuntimeLayoutInflater(this, newContext);
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/RuntimeMenu.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class RuntimeMenu implements Menu
{
    public interface Callback
    {
        boolean onMenuItemSelected(RuntimeMenu menu, MenuItem item);
    }

    private final Context mContext;
    private final List<RuntimeMenuItem> mItems = new ArrayList<>();
    private Callback mCallback;
    private boolean mQwertyMode = true;
    private boolean mGroupDividerEnabled;

    public RuntimeMenu(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    public void setCallback(Callback callback)
    {
        mCallback = callback;
    }

    public Context getContext()
    {
        return mContext;
    }

    boolean dispatchItemSelected(MenuItem item)
    {
        return mCallback != null && mCallback.onMenuItemSelected(this, item);
    }

    void uncheckGroup(int groupId, MenuItem except)
    {
        for (RuntimeMenuItem item : mItems)
        {
            if (item.getGroupId() == groupId && item != except && item.isCheckable()) item.setChecked(false);
        }
    }

    private RuntimeMenuItem addInternal(int groupId, int itemId, int order, CharSequence title)
    {
        RuntimeMenuItem item = new RuntimeMenuItem(mContext, this, groupId, itemId, order, title);

        int position = mItems.size();
        for (int index = 0; index < mItems.size(); index++)
        {
            if (mItems.get(index).getOrder() > order)
            {
                position = index;
                break;
            }
        }

        mItems.add(position, item);
        return item;
    }

    private CharSequence text(int titleRes)
    {
        return titleRes == 0 ? null : mContext.getResources().getText(titleRes);
    }

    @Override
    public MenuItem add(CharSequence title)
    {
        return addInternal(NONE, NONE, NONE, title);
    }

    @Override
    public MenuItem add(int titleRes)
    {
        return addInternal(NONE, NONE, NONE, text(titleRes));
    }

    @Override
    public MenuItem add(int groupId, int itemId, int order, CharSequence title)
    {
        return addInternal(groupId, itemId, order, title);
    }

    @Override
    public MenuItem add(int groupId, int itemId, int order, int titleRes)
    {
        return addInternal(groupId, itemId, order, text(titleRes));
    }

    @Override
    public SubMenu addSubMenu(CharSequence title)
    {
        return addSubMenu(NONE, NONE, NONE, title);
    }

    @Override
    public SubMenu addSubMenu(int titleRes)
    {
        return addSubMenu(NONE, NONE, NONE, text(titleRes));
    }

    @Override
    public SubMenu addSubMenu(int groupId, int itemId, int order, CharSequence title)
    {
        RuntimeMenuItem item = addInternal(groupId, itemId, order, title);
        RuntimeSubMenu subMenu = new RuntimeSubMenu(mContext, this, item);
        item.setSubMenu(subMenu);
        return subMenu;
    }

    @Override
    public SubMenu addSubMenu(int groupId, int itemId, int order, int titleRes)
    {
        return addSubMenu(groupId, itemId, order, text(titleRes));
    }

    @Override
    public int addIntentOptions(int groupId, int itemId, int order, ComponentName caller, Intent[] specifics, Intent intent, int flags,
                                MenuItem[] outSpecificItems)
    {
        if ((flags & FLAG_APPEND_TO_GROUP) == 0) removeGroup(groupId);
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void removeItem(int id)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mItems.size(); index++)
        {
            if (mItems.get(index).getItemId() != id) continue;

            mItems.remove(index);
            return;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void removeGroup(int groupId)
    {
        for (int index = mItems.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            if (mItems.get(index).getGroupId() == groupId) mItems.remove(index);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void clear()
    {
        mItems.clear();
    }

    @Override
    public void setGroupCheckable(int group, boolean checkable, boolean exclusive)
    {
        for (RuntimeMenuItem item : mItems)
        {
            if (item.getGroupId() != group) continue;

            item.setExclusiveCheckable(exclusive);
            item.setCheckable(checkable);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setGroupVisible(int group, boolean visible)
    {
        for (RuntimeMenuItem item : mItems)
        {
            if (item.getGroupId() == group) item.setVisible(visible);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setGroupEnabled(int group, boolean enabled)
    {
        for (RuntimeMenuItem item : mItems)
        {
            if (item.getGroupId() == group) item.setEnabled(enabled);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasVisibleItems()
    {
        for (RuntimeMenuItem item : mItems)
        {
            if (item.isVisible()) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public MenuItem findItem(int id)
    {
        for (RuntimeMenuItem item : mItems)
        {
            if (item.getItemId() == id) return item;

            if (item.hasSubMenu())
            {
                MenuItem nested = item.getSubMenu().findItem(id);
                if (nested != null) return nested;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public int size()
    {
        return mItems.size();
    }

    @Override
    public MenuItem getItem(int index)
    {
        return mItems.get(index);
    }

    @Override
    public void close()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean performShortcut(int keyCode, KeyEvent event, int flags)
    {
        MenuItem item = findShortcut(event);
        return item instanceof RuntimeMenuItem && ((RuntimeMenuItem)item).invoke();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isShortcutKey(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        return findShortcut(event) != null;
    }

    private MenuItem findShortcut(KeyEvent event)
    {
        if (event == null) return null;

        int unicode = event.getUnicodeChar();
        if (unicode == 0) return null;

        char wanted = Character.toLowerCase((char)unicode);

        for (RuntimeMenuItem item : mItems)
        {
            char shortcut = mQwertyMode ? item.getAlphabeticShortcut() : item.getNumericShortcut();
            if (shortcut != 0 && shortcut == wanted && item.isEnabled()) return item;
        }

        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean performIdentifierAction(int id, int flags)
    {
        MenuItem item = findItem(id);
        return item instanceof RuntimeMenuItem && ((RuntimeMenuItem)item).invoke();
    }

    @Override
    public void setQwertyMode(boolean isQwerty)
    {
        mQwertyMode = isQwerty;
    }

    @Override
    public void setGroupDividerEnabled(boolean groupDividerEnabled)
    {
        mGroupDividerEnabled = groupDividerEnabled;
    }

    public List<MenuItem> getVisibleItems()
    {
        List<MenuItem> visible = new ArrayList<>();
        for (RuntimeMenuItem item : mItems)
        {
            if (item.isVisible()) visible.add(item);
        }

        return visible;
    }

    public boolean performItemAction(MenuItem item)
    {
        return item instanceof RuntimeMenuItem && ((RuntimeMenuItem)item).invoke();
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Configuration;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.util.SparseArray;

public class RuntimeWindow extends Window
{
    private static final String VIEWS_TAG = "android:views";
    private static final int USE_DEFAULT_STREAM_TYPE = Integer.MIN_VALUE;

    private final DecorView mDecor;
    private final boolean mFloating;
    private SurfaceHolder.Callback2 mSurfaceCallback;
    private InputQueue.Callback mInputQueueCallback;
    private boolean mTakeKeyEvents;
    private int mTitleColor;
    private int mVolumeControlStream = USE_DEFAULT_STREAM_TYPE;
    private int mStatusBarColor;
    private int mNavigationBarColor;
    private int mDecorCaptionShade = DECOR_CAPTION_SHADE_AUTO;

    public RuntimeWindow(Context context)
    {
        super(context);
        mDecor = new DecorView(context);
        mDecor.attachWindow(this);
        mFloating = themeBoolean("windowIsFloating", false);
        applyWindowBackground(context);
    }

    private void applyWindowBackground(Context context)
    {
        int attribute = context.getResources().getIdentifier("windowBackground", "attr", "android");
        if (attribute == 0) return;

        android.util.TypedValue value = new android.util.TypedValue();
        if (!context.getTheme().resolveAttribute(attribute, value, true)) return;

        if (value.type >= android.util.TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_COLOR_INT && value.type <= android.util.TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_COLOR_INT)
        {
            mDecor.setBackgroundColor(value.data);
            return;
        }

        if (value.resourceId != 0)
        {
            android.graphics.drawable.Drawable background = context.getResources().getDrawable(value.resourceId);
            if (background instanceof android.graphics.drawable.ColorDrawable)
            {
                mDecor.setBackgroundColor(((android.graphics.drawable.ColorDrawable)background).getColor());
            }
        }
    }

    private void notifyContentChanged()
    {
        Callback callback = getCallback();
        if (callback != null) callback.onContentChanged();
    }

    @Override
    public void setContentView(int layoutResID)
    {
        ViewGroup content = mDecor.getContentParent();
        content.removeAllViews();
        getLayoutInflater().inflate(layoutResID, content);

        notifyContentChanged();
    }

    @Override
    public void setContentView(View view)
    {
        setContentView(view, new ViewGroup.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT));
    }

    @Override
    public void setContentView(View view, ViewGroup.LayoutParams layoutParams)
    {
        ViewGroup content = mDecor.getContentParent();
        content.removeAllViews();
        content.addView(view, layoutParams);

        notifyContentChanged();
    }

    @Override
    public void addContentView(View view, ViewGroup.LayoutParams params)
    {
        mDecor.getContentParent().addView(view, params);

        notifyContentChanged();
    }

    @Override

    {
        return mDecor;
    }

    @Override

    {
        return mDecor;
    }

    @Override

        return (T)mDecor.findViewById(id);
    }

    @Override

        return mDecor.findFocus();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean superDispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (View.TRACE_INPUT && event.getActionMasked() == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) describeTree(mDecor, 0);

        return mDecor.dispatchTouchEvent(event);
    }

    private static void describeTree(View view, int depth)
    {
        StringBuilder indent = new StringBuilder();
        for (int step = 0; step < depth; step++) indent.append("  ");

        android.util.Log.i("Window", indent + view.getClass().getName() + " at " + view.getLeft() + "," + view.getTop() + " size "
                                         + view.getWidth() + "x" + view.getHeight() + " visibility " + view.getVisibility());

        if (!(view instanceof ViewGroup)) return;

        ViewGroup group = (ViewGroup)view;
        for (int index = 0; index < group.getChildCount(); index++) describeTree(group.getChildAt(index), depth + 1);
    }
```

`java/android/view/ScaleGestureDetector.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Handler;

public class ScaleGestureDetector
{
    private static final float SCALE_FACTOR = 0.5f;
    private static final int ANCHORED_SCALE_MODE_NONE = 0;
    private static final int ANCHORED_SCALE_MODE_DOUBLE_TAP = 1;
    private static final int ANCHORED_SCALE_MODE_STYLUS = 2;
    private static final int BUTTON_STYLUS_PRIMARY = 32;

    public interface OnScaleGestureListener
    {
        boolean onScale(ScaleGestureDetector detector);

        boolean onScaleBegin(ScaleGestureDetector detector);

        void onScaleEnd(ScaleGestureDetector detector);
    }

    public static class SimpleOnScaleGestureListener implements OnScaleGestureListener
    {
        public SimpleOnScaleGestureListener()
        {
        }

        @Override
        public boolean onScale(ScaleGestureDetector detector)
        {
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean onScaleBegin(ScaleGestureDetector detector)
        {
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public void onScaleEnd(ScaleGestureDetector detector)
        {
        }
    }

    private final Context mContext;
    private final OnScaleGestureListener mListener;
    private final Handler mHandler;

    private float mFocusX;
    private float mFocusY;
    private boolean mQuickScaleEnabled;
    private boolean mStylusScaleEnabled;
    private float mCurrSpan;
    private float mPrevSpan;
    private float mInitialSpan;
    private float mCurrSpanX;
    private float mCurrSpanY;
    private float mPrevSpanX;
    private float mPrevSpanY;
    private long mCurrTime;
    private long mPrevTime;
    private boolean mInProgress;
    private final int mSpanSlop;
    private final int mMinSpan;
    private float mAnchoredScaleStartX;
    private float mAnchoredScaleStartY;
    private int mAnchoredScaleMode = ANCHORED_SCALE_MODE_NONE;
    private boolean mEventBeforeOrAboveStartingGestureEvent;
    private GestureDetector mGestureDetector;

    public ScaleGestureDetector(Context context, OnScaleGestureListener listener)
    {
        this(context, listener, null);
    }

    public ScaleGestureDetector(Context context, OnScaleGestureListener listener, Handler handler)
    {
        mContext = context;
        mListener = listener;
        mHandler = handler;

        ViewConfiguration configuration = ViewConfiguration.get(context);
        mSpanSlop = configuration.getScaledTouchSlop() * 2;
        mMinSpan = configuration.getScaledMinimumScalingSpan();

        int targetSdk = context != null && context.getApplicationInfo() != null ? context.getApplicationInfo().targetSdkVersion : 34;
        if (targetSdk > 18) setQuickScaleEnabled(true);
        if (targetSdk > 22) setStylusScaleEnabled(true);
    }

    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        mCurrTime = event.getEventTime();

        int action = event.getActionMasked();

        if (mQuickScaleEnabled && mGestureDetector != null) mGestureDetector.onTouchEvent(event);

        int count = event.getPointerCount();
        boolean isStylusButtonDown = (event.getButtonState() & BUTTON_STYLUS_PRIMARY) != 0;

        boolean anchoredScaleCancelled = mAnchoredScaleMode == ANCHORED_SCALE_MODE_STYLUS && !isStylusButtonDown;
        boolean streamComplete = action == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP || action == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL || anchoredScaleCancelled;

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN || streamComplete)
        {
            if (mInProgress)
            {
                mListener.onScaleEnd(this);
                mInProgress = false;
                mInitialSpan = 0;
                mAnchoredScaleMode = ANCHORED_SCALE_MODE_NONE;
            }
            else if (inAnchoredScaleMode() && streamComplete)
            {
                mInProgress = false;
                mInitialSpan = 0;
                mAnchoredScaleMode = ANCHORED_SCALE_MODE_NONE;
            }

            if (streamComplete) return true;
        }

        if (!mInProgress && mStylusScaleEnabled && !inAnchoredScaleMode() && !streamComplete && isStylusButtonDown)
        {
            mAnchoredScaleStartX = event.getX();
            mAnchoredScaleStartY = event.getY();
            mAnchoredScaleMode = ANCHORED_SCALE_MODE_STYLUS;
            mInitialSpan = 0;
        }

        boolean configChanged = action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN || action == MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP
                                || action == MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN || anchoredScaleCancelled;

        boolean pointerUp = action == MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP;
        int skipIndex = pointerUp ? event.getActionIndex() : -1;

        float sumX = 0;
        float sumY = 0;
        int divisor = pointerUp ? count - 1 : count;
        float focusX;
        float focusY;

        if (inAnchoredScaleMode())
        {
            focusX = mAnchoredScaleStartX;
            focusY = mAnchoredScaleStartY;
            mEventBeforeOrAboveStartingGestureEvent = event.getY() < focusY;
        }
        else
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                if (skipIndex == index) continue;

                sumX += event.getX(index);
                sumY += event.getY(index);
            }

            focusX = divisor > 0 ? sumX / divisor : 0;
            focusY = divisor > 0 ? sumY / divisor : 0;
        }

        float deviationSumX = 0;
        float deviationSumY = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            if (skipIndex == index) continue;

            deviationSumX += Math.abs(event.getX(index) - focusX);
            deviationSumY += Math.abs(event.getY(index) - focusY);
        }

        float deviationX = divisor > 0 ? deviationSumX / divisor : 0;
        float deviationY = divisor > 0 ? deviationSumY / divisor : 0;

        float spanX = deviationX * 2;
        float spanY = deviationY * 2;
        float span = inAnchoredScaleMode() ? spanY : (float)Math.hypot(spanX, spanY);

        boolean wasInProgress = mInProgress;
        mFocusX = focusX;
        mFocusY = focusY;

        if (!inAnchoredScaleMode() && mInProgress && (span < mMinSpan || configChanged))
        {
            mListener.onScaleEnd(this);
            mInProgress = false;
            mInitialSpan = span;
        }

        if (configChanged)
        {
            mPrevSpanX = spanX;
            mCurrSpanX = spanX;
            mPrevSpanY = spanY;
            mCurrSpanY = spanY;
            mInitialSpan = span;
            mPrevSpan = span;
            mCurrSpan = span;
        }

        int minSpan = inAnchoredScaleMode() ? mSpanSlop : mMinSpan;

        if (!mInProgress && span >= minSpan && (wasInProgress || Math.abs(span - mInitialSpan) > mSpanSlop))
        {
            mPrevSpanX = spanX;
            mCurrSpanX = spanX;
            mPrevSpanY = spanY;
            mCurrSpanY = spanY;
            mPrevSpan = span;
            mCurrSpan = span;
            mPrevTime = mCurrTime;
            mInProgress = mListener.onScaleBegin(this);
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE)
        {
            mCurrSpanX = spanX;
            mCurrSpanY = spanY;
            mCurrSpan = span;

            boolean updatePrevious = true;
            if (mInProgress) updatePrevious = mListener.onScale(this);

            if (updatePrevious)
            {
                mPrevSpanX = mCurrSpanX;
                mPrevSpanY = mCurrSpanY;
                mPrevSpan = mCurrSpan;
                mPrevTime = mCurrTime;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private boolean inAnchoredScaleMode()
    {
        return mAnchoredScaleMode != ANCHORED_SCALE_MODE_NONE;
    }

    public void setQuickScaleEnabled(boolean scales)
    {
        mQuickScaleEnabled = scales;

        if (mQuickScaleEnabled && mGestureDetector == null)
        {
            GestureDetector.SimpleOnGestureListener gestureListener = new GestureDetector.SimpleOnGestureListener()
            {
                @Override
                public boolean onDoubleTap(MotionEvent event)
                {
                    mAnchoredScaleStartX = event.getX();
                    mAnchoredScaleStartY = event.getY();
                    mAnchoredScaleMode = ANCHORED_SCALE_MODE_DOUBLE_TAP;
                    return true;
                }
            };

            mGestureDetector = new GestureDetector(mContext, gestureListener, mHandler);
        }
    }

    public boolean isQuickScaleEnabled()
    {
        return mQuickScaleEnabled;
    }

    public void setStylusScaleEnabled(boolean scales)
    {
        mStylusScaleEnabled = scales;
    }

    public boolean isStylusScaleEnabled()
    {
        return mStylusScaleEnabled;
    }

    public boolean isInProgress()
    {
        return mInProgress;
    }

    public float getFocusX()
    {
        return mFocusX;
    }

    public float getFocusY()
    {
        return mFocusY;
    }

    public float getCurrentSpan()
    {
        return mCurrSpan;
    }

    public float getCurrentSpanX()
    {
        return mCurrSpanX;
    }

    public float getCurrentSpanY()
    {
        return mCurrSpanY;
    }

    public float getPreviousSpan()
    {
        return mPrevSpan;
    }

    public float getPreviousSpanX()
    {
        return mPrevSpanX;
    }

    public float getPreviousSpanY()
    {
        return mPrevSpanY;
    }

    public float getScaleFactor()
    {
        if (inAnchoredScaleMode())
        {
            boolean scaleUp = (mEventBeforeOrAboveStartingGestureEvent && mCurrSpan < mPrevSpan)
                              || (!mEventBeforeOrAboveStartingGestureEvent && mCurrSpan > mPrevSpan);
            float spanDifference = Math.abs(1 - (mCurrSpan / mPrevSpan)) * SCALE_FACTOR;

            if (mPrevSpan <= 0) return 1;
            return scaleUp ? 1 + spanDifference : 1 - spanDifference;
        }

        return mPrevSpan > 0 ? mCurrSpan / mPrevSpan : 1;
    }

    public long getTimeDelta()
    {
        return mCurrTime - mPrevTime;
    }

    public long getEventTime()
    {
        return mCurrTime;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view;
```

```java
import android.graphics.Point;
```

```java
public final class ScrollCaptureTarget

    private final View mContainingView;
    private final ScrollCaptureCallback mCallback;
    private final Rect mLocalVisibleRect;
    private final Point mPositionInWindow;
    private final int mHint;
    private Rect mScrollBounds;
    private final int[] mTmpIntArray = new int[2];

    public ScrollCaptureTarget(View scrollTarget, Rect localVisibleRect, Point positionInWindow, ScrollCaptureCallback callback)
    {
        if (scrollTarget == null) throw new NullPointerException("scrollTarget must not be null");
        if (localVisibleRect == null) throw new NullPointerException("localVisibleRect must not be null");
        if (positionInWindow == null) throw new NullPointerException("positionInWindow must not be null");
        if (callback == null) throw new NullPointerException("callback must not be null");

        mContainingView = scrollTarget;
        mHint = scrollTarget.getScrollCaptureHint();
        mCallback = callback;
        mLocalVisibleRect = localVisibleRect;
        mPositionInWindow = positionInWindow;
    }

    public int getHint()
    {
        return mHint;
    }

    public ScrollCaptureCallback getCallback()
    {
        return mCallback;
    }

    public View getContainingView()
    {
        return mContainingView;
    }

    public Rect getLocalVisibleRect()
    {
        return mLocalVisibleRect;
    }

    public Point getPositionInWindow()
    {
        return mPositionInWindow;
    }

    public Rect getScrollBounds()
    {
        return mScrollBounds;
    }

    public void setScrollBounds(Rect scrollBounds)
    {
        mScrollBounds = scrollBounds == null ? null : new Rect(scrollBounds);
        if (mScrollBounds != null && !mScrollBounds.intersect(0, 0, mContainingView.getWidth(), mContainingView.getHeight()))
        {
            mScrollBounds.setEmpty();
        }
    }

    public void updatePositionInWindow()
    {
        mContainingView.getLocationInWindow(mTmpIntArray);
        mPositionInWindow.x = mTmpIntArray[0];
        mPositionInWindow.y = mTmpIntArray[1];
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "ScrollCaptureTarget{view=" + mContainingView + ", rect=" + mLocalVisibleRect + ", window=" + mPositionInWindow + ", hint="
               + mHint + "}";
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view;

public class SoundEffectConstants
{
    public static final int CLICK = 0;
    public static final int NAVIGATION_LEFT = 1;
    public static final int NAVIGATION_UP = 2;
    public static final int NAVIGATION_RIGHT = 3;
    public static final int NAVIGATION_DOWN = 4;
    public static final int NAVIGATION_REPEAT_LEFT = 5;
    public static final int NAVIGATION_REPEAT_UP = 6;
    public static final int NAVIGATION_REPEAT_RIGHT = 7;
    public static final int NAVIGATION_REPEAT_DOWN = 8;

    private SoundEffectConstants()
    {
    }

    public static int getContantForFocusDirection(int direction)
    {
        switch (direction)
        {
            case View.FOCUS_RIGHT:
                return NAVIGATION_RIGHT;
            case View.FOCUS_FORWARD:
            case View.FOCUS_DOWN:
                return NAVIGATION_DOWN;
            case View.FOCUS_LEFT:
                return NAVIGATION_LEFT;
            case View.FOCUS_BACKWARD:
            case View.FOCUS_UP:
                return NAVIGATION_UP;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("direction must be one of {FOCUS_UP, FOCUS_DOWN, FOCUS_LEFT, FOCUS_RIGHT, "
                                                   + "FOCUS_FORWARD, FOCUS_BACKWARD}.");
        }
    }

    public static int getConstantForFocusDirection(int direction, boolean repeating)
    {
        if (!repeating) return getContantForFocusDirection(direction);

        switch (direction)
        {
            case View.FOCUS_RIGHT:
                return NAVIGATION_REPEAT_RIGHT;
            case View.FOCUS_FORWARD:
            case View.FOCUS_DOWN:
                return NAVIGATION_REPEAT_DOWN;
            case View.FOCUS_LEFT:
                return NAVIGATION_REPEAT_LEFT;
            case View.FOCUS_BACKWARD:
            case View.FOCUS_UP:
                return NAVIGATION_REPEAT_UP;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("direction must be one of {FOCUS_UP, FOCUS_DOWN, FOCUS_LEFT, FOCUS_RIGHT, "
                                                   + "FOCUS_FORWARD, FOCUS_BACKWARD}.");
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/StyleableSet.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import java.util.HashMap;

public final class StyleableSet
{
    private final int[] mSorted;
    private final HashMap<String, Integer> mIndices = new HashMap<>();

    private StyleableSet(int[] sorted, HashMap<String, Integer> indices)
    {
        mSorted = sorted;
        mIndices.putAll(indices);
    }

    public static StyleableSet of(Resources resources, String... names)
    {
        int[] identifiers = new int[names.length];
        int found = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index < names.length; index++)
        {
            int identifier = resources.getIdentifier(names[index], "attr", "android");
            if (identifier != 0) identifiers[found++] = identifier;
        }

        int[] sorted = new int[found];
        System.arraycopy(identifiers, 0, sorted, 0, found);
        java.util.Arrays.sort(sorted);

        HashMap<String, Integer> indices = new HashMap<>();
        for (String name : names)
        {
            int identifier = resources.getIdentifier(name, "attr", "android");
            if (identifier == 0) continue;

            int position = java.util.Arrays.binarySearch(sorted, identifier);
            if (position >= 0) indices.put(name, position);
        }

        return new StyleableSet(sorted, indices);
    }

    public int[] attributes()
    {
        return mSorted;
    }

    public int indexOf(String name)
    {
        Integer position = mIndices.get(name);
        return position == null ? -1 : position;
    }

    public boolean isEmpty()
    {
        return mSorted.length == 0;
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/Surface.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.graphics.SurfaceTexture;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public class Surface implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int ROTATION_0 = 0;
    public static final int ROTATION_90 = 1;
    public static final int ROTATION_180 = 2;
    public static final int ROTATION_270 = 3;

    public static final int FRAME_RATE_COMPATIBILITY_DEFAULT = 0;
    public static final int FRAME_RATE_COMPATIBILITY_FIXED_SOURCE = 1;
    public static final int FRAME_RATE_COMPATIBILITY_AT_LEAST = 2;

    public static final int CHANGE_FRAME_RATE_ONLY_IF_SEAMLESS = 0;
    public static final int CHANGE_FRAME_RATE_ALWAYS = 1;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<Surface> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<Surface>()
    {
        @Override
        public Surface createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            Surface surface = new Surface();
            surface.readFromParcel(source);
            return surface;
        }

        @Override
        public Surface[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new Surface[size];
        }
    };

    private final Object mLock = new Object();

    private long mNativeWindow;
    private boolean mValid;
    private boolean mReleased;
    private String mName;
    private SurfaceTexture mSurfaceTexture;
    private SurfaceControl mSurfaceControl;
    private BufferProducer mProducer;
    private Canvas mLockedCanvas;
    private Bitmap mLockedBuffer;
    private BufferProducer mLockedProducer;
    private float mFrameRate;
    private int mFrameRateCompatibility;
    private int mChangeFrameRateStrategy;

    public Surface()
    {
        mNativeWindow = 0;
        mValid = false;
    }

    public Surface(SurfaceTexture surfaceTexture)
    {
        if (surfaceTexture == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("surfaceTexture must not be null");

        mSurfaceTexture = surfaceTexture;
        mName = surfaceTexture.toString();
        mValid = true;
    }

    public Surface(SurfaceControl from)
    {
        if (from == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("from must not be null");
        if (!from.isValid()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the SurfaceControl has already been released");

        mSurfaceControl = from;
        mName = from.getName();
        mValid = true;
        mProducer = from.bufferProducer();
    }

    Surface(long nativeWindow)
    {
        mNativeWindow = nativeWindow;
        mValid = nativeWindow != 0;
    }

    abstract static class BufferProducer
    {
        abstract Bitmap lockBuffer();

        abstract void unlockAndPost(Bitmap buffer);

        Bitmap peekFrontBuffer()
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    Bitmap peekFrontBuffer()
    {
        BufferProducer producer;

        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (!isValid()) return null;
            producer = producerLocked();
        }

        return producer == null ? null : producer.peekFrontBuffer();
    }

    void setBufferProducer(BufferProducer producer)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            mProducer = producer;
        }
    }

    public boolean isValid()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mReleased) return false;
            if (mSurfaceTexture != null) return !mSurfaceTexture.isReleased();
            if (mSurfaceControl != null) return mSurfaceControl.isValid();

            return mValid && mNativeWindow != 0;
        }
    }

    public void release()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            mNativeWindow = 0;
            mValid = false;
            mReleased = mSurfaceTexture != null || mSurfaceControl != null;
            mLockedCanvas = null;
            mLockedBuffer = null;
            mLockedProducer = null;
        }
    }

    private BufferProducer producerLocked()
    {
        if (mProducer != null) return mProducer;
        if (mSurfaceTexture == null) return null;

        BufferProducer consumer = TextureView.producerFor(mSurfaceTexture);
        if (consumer != null) return consumer;

        if (mTextureProducer == null) mTextureProducer = new TextureBufferProducer(mSurfaceTexture);
        return mTextureProducer;
    }

    private TextureBufferProducer mTextureProducer;

    private static final class TextureBufferProducer extends BufferProducer
    {
        private final SurfaceTexture mTexture;
        private Bitmap mBuffer;
        private boolean mPosted;

        TextureBufferProducer(SurfaceTexture texture)
        {
            mTexture = texture;
        }

        private int defaultSize(String field)
        {
            try
            {
                java.lang.reflect.Field size = SurfaceTexture.class.getDeclaredField(field);
                size.setAccessible(true);
                return size.getInt(mTexture);
            }
            catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException unavailable)
            {
                return 0;
            }
        }

        @Override
        synchronized Bitmap lockBuffer()
        {
            int width = defaultSize("mDefaultWidth");
            int height = defaultSize("mDefaultHeight");
            if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return null;

            if (mBuffer == null || mBuffer.getWidth() != width || mBuffer.getHeight() != height)
            {
                mBuffer = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
            }

            return mBuffer;
        }

        @Override
        void unlockAndPost(Bitmap buffer)
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                mPosted = true;
            }

            try
            {
                java.lang.reflect.Method notify = SurfaceTexture.class.getDeclaredMethod("postFrameAvailable");
                notify.setAccessible(true);
                notify.invoke(mTexture);
            }
            catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException unavailable)
            {
                android.util.Log.w("Surface", "the SurfaceTexture could not be told about a new frame", unavailable);
            }
        }

        @Override
        synchronized Bitmap peekFrontBuffer()
        {
            return mPosted ? mBuffer : null;
        }
    }

    public Canvas lockCanvas(Rect inOutDirty) throws OutOfResourcesException, IllegalArgumentException
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (!isValid()) throw new IllegalStateException("Surface has already been released.");
            if (mLockedCanvas != null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Surface was already locked");

            BufferProducer producer = producerLocked();
            if (producer == null) throw new OutOfResourcesException("this surface has no consumer that accepts software buffers");

            Bitmap buffer = producer.lockBuffer();
            if (buffer == null) throw new OutOfResourcesException("no buffer is available for this surface");

            Canvas canvas = new Canvas(buffer);

            if (inOutDirty != null)
            {
                if (!inOutDirty.intersect(0, 0, buffer.getWidth(), buffer.getHeight())) inOutDirty.setEmpty();
                canvas.clipRect(inOutDirty);
            }

            mLockedCanvas = canvas;
            mLockedBuffer = buffer;
            mLockedProducer = producer;
            return canvas;
        }
    }

    public Canvas lockHardwareCanvas()
    {
        return lockCanvas(null);
    }

    public void unlockCanvasAndPost(Canvas canvas)
    {
        BufferProducer producer;
        Bitmap buffer;

        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mLockedCanvas == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Surface was not locked");
            if (canvas != mLockedCanvas)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("canvas object must be the same instance that was previously returned by lockCanvas");
            }

            producer = mLockedProducer;
            buffer = mLockedBuffer;
            mLockedCanvas = null;
            mLockedBuffer = null;
            mLockedProducer = null;
        }

        if (producer != null) producer.unlockAndPost(buffer);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public void unlockCanvas(Canvas canvas)
    {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
    }

    public void setFrameRate(float frameRate, int compatibility)
    {
        setFrameRate(frameRate, compatibility, CHANGE_FRAME_RATE_ONLY_IF_SEAMLESS);
    }

    public void setFrameRate(float frameRate, int compatibility, int changeFrameRateStrategy)
    {
        if (Float.isNaN(frameRate) || Float.isInfinite(frameRate) || frameRate < 0)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid frame rate " + frameRate);
        }

        if (compatibility < FRAME_RATE_COMPATIBILITY_DEFAULT || compatibility > FRAME_RATE_COMPATIBILITY_AT_LEAST)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid compatibility " + compatibility);
        }

        if (changeFrameRateStrategy != CHANGE_FRAME_RATE_ONLY_IF_SEAMLESS && changeFrameRateStrategy != CHANGE_FRAME_RATE_ALWAYS)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid change frame rate strategy " + changeFrameRateStrategy);
        }

        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (!isValid()) throw new IllegalStateException("Surface has already been released.");

            mFrameRate = frameRate;
            mFrameRateCompatibility = compatibility;
            mChangeFrameRateStrategy = changeFrameRateStrategy;
        }
    }

    public void clearFrameRate()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (!isValid()) throw new IllegalStateException("Surface has already been released.");

            mFrameRate = 0;
            mFrameRateCompatibility = FRAME_RATE_COMPATIBILITY_DEFAULT;
            mChangeFrameRateStrategy = CHANGE_FRAME_RATE_ONLY_IF_SEAMLESS;
        }
    }

    long getNativeWindow()
    {
        return mNativeWindow;
    }

    void attach(long nativeWindow)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            mNativeWindow = nativeWindow;
            mValid = nativeWindow != 0;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
    {
        if (out == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dest must not be null");

        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            out.writeString(mName);
            out.writeLong(mNativeWindow);
            out.writeInt(mValid ? 1 : 0);
        }

        if ((flags & PARCELABLE_WRITE_RETURN_VALUE) != 0) release();
    }

    public void readFromParcel(Parcel source)
    {
        if (source == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("source must not be null");

        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            mName = source.readString();
            mNativeWindow = source.readLong();
            mValid = source.readInt() != 0;
            mReleased = false;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        try
        {
            release();
        }
        finally
        {
            super.finalize();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Surface(name=" + mName + ")/@0x" + Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(this));
    }

    public static class OutOfResourcesException extends RuntimeException
    {
        public OutOfResourcesException()
        {
        }

        public OutOfResourcesException(String name)
        {
            super(name);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    private Bitmap mSoftwareBuffer;
    private boolean mSoftwarePosted;
    private Surface.BufferProducer mProducer;

    SurfaceControl()
    {
    }

    SurfaceControl(String name, int width, int height, int format, boolean opaque, boolean hidden, SurfaceControl parent)
    {
        mName = name;
        mWidth = width;
        mHeight = height;
        mFormat = format;
        mOpaque = opaque;
        mVisible = !hidden;
        mParent = parent;
        mValid = true;
    }

    String getName()
    {
        return mName;
    }

    synchronized void setBufferSize(int width, int height)
    {
        mWidth = width;
        mHeight = height;
    }

    synchronized Surface.BufferProducer bufferProducer()
    {
        if (mProducer != null) return mProducer;

        mProducer = new Surface.BufferProducer()
        {
            @Override
            Bitmap lockBuffer()
            {
                synchronized (SurfaceControl.this)
                {
                    if (!mValid || mWidth <= 0 || mHeight <= 0) return null;

                    if (mSoftwareBuffer == null || mSoftwareBuffer.getWidth() != mWidth || mSoftwareBuffer.getHeight() != mHeight)
                    {
                        mSoftwareBuffer = Bitmap.createBitmap(mWidth, mHeight, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
                    }

                    return mSoftwareBuffer;
                }
            }

            @Override
            void unlockAndPost(Bitmap buffer)
            {
                synchronized (SurfaceControl.this)
                {
                    mSoftwarePosted = true;
                }
            }

            @Override
            Bitmap peekFrontBuffer()
            {
                synchronized (SurfaceControl.this)
                {
                    return mSoftwarePosted ? mSoftwareBuffer : null;
                }
            }
        };

        return mProducer;
    }

    public synchronized boolean isValid()
    {
        return mValid;
    }

    public void release()
    {
        Consumer<SyncFence> release;

        synchronized (this)
        {
            mValid = false;
            mSoftwareBuffer = null;
            release = mBufferRelease;
            mBufferRelease = null;
            mBuffer = null;
        }

        if (release != null) release.accept(null);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
    {
        out.writeString(mName);
        out.writeInt(mValid ? 1 : 0);
        out.writeInt(mWidth);
        out.writeInt(mHeight);
        out.writeInt(mFormat);
        out.writeInt(mOpaque ? 1 : 0);
        out.writeInt(mVisible ? 1 : 0);

        if ((flags & PARCELABLE_WRITE_RETURN_VALUE) != 0) mValid = false;
    }

    public synchronized void readFromParcel(Parcel source)
    {
        if (source == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("source must not be null");

        mName = source.readString();
        mValid = source.readInt() != 0;
        mWidth = source.readInt();
        mHeight = source.readInt();
        mFormat = source.readInt();
        mOpaque = source.readInt() != 0;
        mVisible = source.readInt() != 0;
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        try
        {
            release();
        }
        finally
        {
            super.finalize();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Surface(name=" + mName + ")/@0x" + Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(this));
    }

    public static class Builder

    public static final class TrustedPresentationThresholds

            mStabilityRequirementMs = stabilityRequirementMs;

    private interface Operation
    {
        void apply();
    }

    public static class Transaction implements Closeable, Parcelable
    {
        public static final Parcelable.Creator<Transaction> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<Transaction>()
        {
            @Override
            public Transaction createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                source.readInt();
                return new Transaction();
            }

            @Override
            public Transaction[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new Transaction[size];
            }
        };

        private final ArrayList<Operation> mOperations = new ArrayList<>();
        private final ArrayList<Runnable> mCommittedCallbacks = new ArrayList<>();

        public Transaction()
        {
        }

        private Transaction add(SurfaceControl control, Operation operation)
        {
            if (control == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the surface control must not be null");

            synchronized (this)
            {
                mOperations.add(operation);
            }

            return this;
        }

        public void apply()
        {
            ArrayList<Operation> operations;
            ArrayList<Runnable> callbacks;

            synchronized (this)
            {
                operations = new ArrayList<>(mOperations);
                callbacks = new ArrayList<>(mCommittedCallbacks);
                mOperations.clear();
                mCommittedCallbacks.clear();
            }

            for (Operation operation : operations)
            {
                operation.apply();
            }

            for (Runnable callback : callbacks)
            {
                callback.run();
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void close()
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                mOperations.clear();
                mCommittedCallbacks.clear();
            }
        }

        public Transaction merge(Transaction other)
        {
            if (other == null || other == this) return this;

            ArrayList<Operation> operations;
            ArrayList<Runnable> callbacks;

            synchronized (other)
            {
                operations = new ArrayList<>(other.mOperations);
                callbacks = new ArrayList<>(other.mCommittedCallbacks);
                other.mOperations.clear();
                other.mCommittedCallbacks.clear();
            }

            synchronized (this)
            {
                mOperations.addAll(operations);
                mCommittedCallbacks.addAll(callbacks);
            }

            return this;
        }

        public Transaction addTransactionCommittedListener(Executor executor, TransactionCommittedListener listener)
        {
            if (executor == null || listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("executor and listener must not be null");

            synchronized (this)
            {
                mCommittedCallbacks.add(() -> executor.execute(listener::onTransactionCommitted));
            }

            return this;
        }

        public Transaction setVisibility(SurfaceControl control, boolean visible)
        {
            return add(control, () ->
            {
                synchronized (control)
                {
                    control.mVisible = visible;
                }
            });
        }

        public Transaction setPosition(SurfaceControl control, float x, float y)
        {
            return add(control, () ->
            {
                synchronized (control)
                {
                    control.mPositionX = x;
                    control.mPositionY = y;
                }
            });
        }

        public Transaction setScale(SurfaceControl control, float scaleX, float scaleY)
        {
            if (scaleX < 0 || scaleY < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative scale");

            return add(control, () ->
            {
                synchronized (control)
                {
                    control.mScaleX = scaleX;
                    control.mScaleY = scaleY;
                }
            });
        }

        public Transaction setBufferSize(SurfaceControl control, int width, int height)
        {
            if (width < 0 || height < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative buffer size");

            return add(control, () -> control.setBufferSize(width, height));
        }

        public Transaction setGeometry(SurfaceControl control, Rect sourceCrop, Rect destFrame, int orientation)
        {
            Rect crop = sourceCrop == null ? null : new Rect(sourceCrop);
            Rect frame = destFrame == null ? null : new Rect(destFrame);

            return add(control, () ->
            {
                synchronized (control)
                {
                    if (crop != null) control.mCrop.set(crop);
                    else control.mCrop.setEmpty();

                    if (frame != null)
                    {
                        control.mPositionX = frame.left;
                        control.mPositionY = frame.top;
                    }

                    control.mBufferTransform = orientation;
                }
            });
        }

        public Transaction setCrop(SurfaceControl control, Rect crop)
        {
            if (crop != null && (crop.width() < 0 || crop.height() < 0)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("crop must be a valid rect");

            Rect copy = crop == null ? null : new Rect(crop);

            return add(control, () ->
            {
                synchronized (control)
                {
                    if (copy == null) control.mCrop.setEmpty();
                    else control.mCrop.set(copy);
                }
            });
        }

        public Transaction setAlpha(SurfaceControl control, float alpha)
        {
            if (alpha < 0 || alpha > 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("alpha must be between 0 and 1");

            return add(control, () ->
            {
                synchronized (control)
                {
                    control.mAlpha = alpha;
                }
            });
        }

        public Transaction setLayer(SurfaceControl control, int z)
        {
            return add(control, () ->
            {
                synchronized (control)
                {
                    control.mLayer = z;
                }
            });
        }

        public Transaction setOpaque(SurfaceControl control, boolean isOpaque)
        {
            return add(control, () ->
            {
                synchronized (control)
                {
                    control.mOpaque = isOpaque;
                }
            });
        }

        public Transaction setBufferTransform(SurfaceControl control, int transform)
        {
            return add(control, () ->
            {
                synchronized (control)
                {
                    control.mBufferTransform = transform;
                }
            });
        }

        public Transaction setDataSpace(SurfaceControl control, int dataSpace)
        {
            return add(control, () ->
            {
                synchronized (control)
                {
                    control.mDataSpace = dataSpace;
                }
            });
        }

        public Transaction setDamageRegion(SurfaceControl control, Region region)
        {
            return add(control, () ->
            {
            });
        }

        public Transaction setContentPriority(SurfaceControl control, int priority)
        {
            return add(control, () ->
            {
            });
        }

        public Transaction setDesiredPresentTimeNanos(long desiredPresentTimeNanos)
        {
            return this;
        }

        public Transaction setFrameTimeline(long vsyncId)
        {
            return this;
        }

        public Transaction setExtendedRangeBrightness(SurfaceControl control, float currentBufferRatio, float desiredRatio)
        {
            if (!Float.isFinite(currentBufferRatio) || currentBufferRatio < 1.0f)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("currentBufferRatio must be finite and >= 1.0f");
            }

            if (!Float.isFinite(desiredRatio) || desiredRatio < 1.0f)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("desiredRatio must be finite and >= 1.0f");
            }

            return add(control, () ->
            {
            });
        }

        public Transaction setDesiredHdrHeadroom(SurfaceControl control, float desiredRatio)
        {
            if (!Float.isFinite(desiredRatio) || (desiredRatio != 0 && desiredRatio < 1.0f))
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("desiredRatio must be finite and either 0 or >= 1.0f");
            }

            return add(control, () ->
            {
                synchronized (control)
                {
                    control.mDesiredHdrHeadroom = desiredRatio;
                }
            });
        }

        public Transaction setFrameRate(SurfaceControl control, float frameRate, int compatibility)
        {
            return setFrameRate(control, frameRate, compatibility, Surface.CHANGE_FRAME_RATE_ONLY_IF_SEAMLESS);
        }

        public Transaction setFrameRate(SurfaceControl control, float frameRate, int compatibility, int changeFrameRateStrategy)
        {
            if (Float.isNaN(frameRate) || Float.isInfinite(frameRate) || frameRate < 0)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid frame rate " + frameRate);
            }

            return add(control, () ->
            {
                synchronized (control)
                {
                    control.mFrameRate = frameRate;
                }
            });
        }

        public Transaction clearFrameRate(SurfaceControl control)
        {
            return add(control, () ->
            {
                synchronized (control)
                {
                    control.mFrameRate = 0;
                }
            });
        }

        public Transaction setBuffer(SurfaceControl control, HardwareBuffer buffer)
        {
            return setBuffer(control, buffer, null);
        }

        public Transaction setBuffer(SurfaceControl control, HardwareBuffer buffer, SyncFence fence)
        {
            return setBuffer(control, buffer, fence, null);
        }

        public Transaction setBuffer(SurfaceControl control, HardwareBuffer buffer, SyncFence fence, Consumer<SyncFence> releaseCallback)
        {
            return add(control, () ->
            {
                Consumer<SyncFence> previous;

                synchronized (control)
                {
                    previous = control.mBufferRelease;
                    control.mBuffer = buffer;
                    control.mBufferRelease = releaseCallback;
                }

                if (previous != null) previous.accept(null);
            });
        }

        public Transaction reparent(SurfaceControl control, SurfaceControl newParent)
        {
            return add(control, () ->
            {
                synchronized (control)
                {
                    control.mParent = newParent;
                }
            });
        }

        public Transaction setTrustedPresentationCallback(SurfaceControl control, TrustedPresentationThresholds thresholds,
                                                          Executor executor, Consumer<Boolean> listener)
        {
            if (thresholds == null || executor == null || listener == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("arguments must not be null");

            return add(control, () ->
            {
            });
        }

        public Transaction clearTrustedPresentationCallback(SurfaceControl control)
        {
            return add(control, () ->
            {
            });
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
        {
            out.writeInt(0);
        }
    }
```

```java
package android.view;

import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Rect;

public interface SurfaceHolder
{
    int SURFACE_TYPE_NORMAL = 0;
    int SURFACE_TYPE_HARDWARE = 1;
    int SURFACE_TYPE_GPU = 2;
    int SURFACE_TYPE_PUSH_BUFFERS = 3;

    interface Callback
    {
        void surfaceCreated(SurfaceHolder holder);

        void surfaceChanged(SurfaceHolder holder, int format, int width, int height);

        void surfaceDestroyed(SurfaceHolder holder);
    }

    interface Callback2 extends Callback
    {
        void surfaceRedrawNeeded(SurfaceHolder holder);

        default void surfaceRedrawNeededAsync(SurfaceHolder holder, Runnable drawingFinished)
        {
            surfaceRedrawNeeded(holder);
            if (drawingFinished != null) drawingFinished.run();
        }
    }

    void addCallback(Callback callback);

    void removeCallback(Callback callback);

    boolean isCreating();

    void setType(int type);

    void setFixedSize(int width, int height);

    void setSizeFromLayout();

    void setFormat(int format);

    void setKeepScreenOn(boolean screenOn);

    Canvas lockCanvas();

    Canvas lockCanvas(Rect dirty);

    default Canvas lockHardwareCanvas()
    {
        throw new IllegalStateException("This SurfaceHolder doesn't support lockHardwareCanvas");
    }

    void unlockCanvasAndPost(Canvas canvas);

    class BadSurfaceTypeException extends RuntimeException
    {
        public BadSurfaceTypeException()
        {
        }

        public BadSurfaceTypeException(String name)
        {
            super(name);
        }
    }

    Rect getSurfaceFrame();

    Surface getSurface();
}
```

```java
package android.view;

import android.content.Context;

import java.util.ArrayList;

public class SurfaceView extends View
{
    public static final int SURFACE_LIFECYCLE_DEFAULT = 0;
    public static final int SURFACE_LIFECYCLE_FOLLOWS_VISIBILITY = 1;
    public static final int SURFACE_LIFECYCLE_FOLLOWS_ATTACHMENT = 2;

    private static final int MEDIA_SUBLAYER = -2;
    private static final int MEDIA_OVERLAY_SUBLAYER = -1;
    private static final int APPLICATION_PANEL_SUBLAYER = 1;

    private final Surface mSurface = new Surface();
    private final Holder mHolder = new Holder();
    private final ArrayList<SurfaceHolder.Callback> mCallbacks = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Object mBufferLock = new Object();
    private final Paint mBufferPaint = new Paint(Paint.FILTER_BITMAP_FLAG);

    private boolean mCreated;
    private boolean mCreating;
    private boolean mLaidOut;
    private int mFormat = 4;
    private int mSurfaceWidth;
    private int mSurfaceHeight;
    private int mRequestedWidth = -1;
    private int mRequestedHeight = -1;
    private int mSurfaceLifecycle = SURFACE_LIFECYCLE_DEFAULT;
    private int mSubLayer = MEDIA_SUBLAYER;
    private boolean mSecure;
    private float mDesiredHdrHeadroom;
    private SurfaceControl mSurfaceControl;
    private Bitmap mFrontBuffer;
    private Bitmap mBackBuffer;
    private boolean mSoftwarePosted;

    private final Surface.BufferProducer mProducer = new Surface.BufferProducer()
    {
        @Override
        Bitmap lockBuffer()
        {
            synchronized (mBufferLock)
            {
                if (!mCreated || mSurfaceWidth <= 0 || mSurfaceHeight <= 0) return null;

                if (mBackBuffer == null || mBackBuffer.getWidth() != mSurfaceWidth || mBackBuffer.getHeight() != mSurfaceHeight)
                {
                    mBackBuffer = Bitmap.createBitmap(mSurfaceWidth, mSurfaceHeight, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
                }

                if (mFrontBuffer != null && mFrontBuffer.getWidth() == mSurfaceWidth && mFrontBuffer.getHeight() == mSurfaceHeight)
                {
                    new Canvas(mBackBuffer).drawBitmap(mFrontBuffer, 0, 0, null);
                }

                return mBackBuffer;
            }
        }

        @Override
        void unlockAndPost(Bitmap buffer)
        {
            synchronized (mBufferLock)
            {
                if (buffer == mBackBuffer)
                {
                    mBackBuffer = mFrontBuffer;
                    mFrontBuffer = buffer;
                }

                mSoftwarePosted = true;
            }

            postInvalidate();
        }

        @Override
        Bitmap peekFrontBuffer()
        {
            synchronized (mBufferLock)
            {
                return mSoftwarePosted ? mFrontBuffer : null;
            }
        }
    };

    public SurfaceView(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public SurfaceView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, 0);
    }

    public SurfaceView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public SurfaceView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        mSurface.setBufferProducer(mProducer);
    }

    public SurfaceHolder getHolder()
    {
        return mHolder;
    }

    boolean presentsThroughFramework()
    {
        synchronized (mBufferLock)
        {
            return mSoftwarePosted;
        }
    }

    public void setZOrderOnTop(boolean onTop)
    {
        mSubLayer = onTop ? APPLICATION_PANEL_SUBLAYER : MEDIA_SUBLAYER;
    }

    public void setZOrderMediaOverlay(boolean isMediaOverlay)
    {
        mSubLayer = isMediaOverlay ? MEDIA_OVERLAY_SUBLAYER : MEDIA_SUBLAYER;
    }

    public void setCompositionOrder(int compositionOrder)
    {
        mSubLayer = compositionOrder;
    }

    public int getCompositionOrder()
    {
        return mSubLayer;
    }

    public void setSecure(boolean isSecure)
    {
        mSecure = isSecure;
    }

    public void setSurfaceLifecycle(int lifecycleStrategy)
    {
        if (lifecycleStrategy < SURFACE_LIFECYCLE_DEFAULT || lifecycleStrategy > SURFACE_LIFECYCLE_FOLLOWS_ATTACHMENT) return;

        mSurfaceLifecycle = lifecycleStrategy;
        if (isAttachedToWindow() && !shouldKeepSurface()) destroySurface();
    }

    public void setDesiredHdrHeadroom(float desiredHeadroom)
    {
        if (!Float.isFinite(desiredHeadroom) || (desiredHeadroom != 0 && (desiredHeadroom < 1.0f || desiredHeadroom > 10000.0f)))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("desiredHeadroom must be 0 or within [1.0, 10000.0], received: " + desiredHeadroom);
        }

        mDesiredHdrHeadroom = desiredHeadroom;
    }

    public SurfaceControl getSurfaceControl()
    {
        return mSurfaceControl;
    }

    public IBinder getHostToken()
    {
        return null;
    }

    public void applyTransactionToFrame(SurfaceControl.Transaction transaction)
    {
        if (transaction == null) return;

        AttachedSurfaceControl root = getRootSurfaceControl();
        if (root == null || !root.applyTransactionOnDraw(transaction)) transaction.apply();
    }

    public void clearChildSurfacePackage()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return SurfaceView.class.getName();
    }

    {
        return super.getImportantForAccessibility();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasOverlappingRendering()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean gatherTransparentRegion(Region region)
    {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onSetAlpha(int alpha)
    {
        return false;

        super.setAlpha(alpha);

        int height = mRequestedHeight >= 0 ? resolveSizeAndState(mRequestedHeight, heightMeasureSpec, 0)

    private boolean shouldKeepSurface()
    {
        if (!isAttachedToWindow()) return false;
        if (mSurfaceLifecycle == SURFACE_LIFECYCLE_FOLLOWS_ATTACHMENT) return true;

        return getVisibility() == VISIBLE && getWindowVisibility() == VISIBLE;
    }

    private void refreshSurfaceForVisibility()
    {
        if (!isAttachedToWindow()) return;

        if (!shouldKeepSurface())
        {
            destroySurface();
            return;
        }

        if (!mCreated) requestLayout();
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        drawSoftwareFrame(canvas);

        super.draw(canvas);
    }

    @Override
    protected void dispatchDraw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        super.dispatchDraw(canvas);
    }

    private void drawSoftwareFrame(Canvas canvas)
    {
        Bitmap front;

        synchronized (mBufferLock)
        {
            front = mSoftwarePosted ? mFrontBuffer : null;
        }

        if (front == null || front.isRecycled()) return;

        canvas.drawBitmap(front, new Rect(0, 0, front.getWidth(), front.getHeight()), new Rect(0, 0, getWidth(), getHeight()),
                          mBufferPaint);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onLayout(boolean changed, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        super.onLayout(changed, left, top, right, bottom);
        updateSurface(right - left, bottom - top);
    }

    private void updateSurface(int width, int height)
    {
        if (!shouldKeepSurface()) return;

        int targetWidth = mRequestedWidth > 0 ? mRequestedWidth : width;
        int targetHeight = mRequestedHeight > 0 ? mRequestedHeight : height;

        if (targetWidth <= 0 || targetHeight <= 0) return;
        if (mCreated && targetWidth == mSurfaceWidth && targetHeight == mSurfaceHeight) return;

        if (!mLaidOut)
        {
            mLaidOut = true;
            requestLayout();
            return;
        }

        synchronized (mBufferLock)
        {
            mSurfaceWidth = targetWidth;
            mSurfaceHeight = targetHeight;
        }

        mSurface.attach(runtime.SurfaceBridge.acquireNativeWindow(targetWidth, targetHeight));

        if (!mCreated)
        {
            mSurfaceControl = new SurfaceControl.Builder().setName("SurfaceView[" + Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(this)) + "]")
                                                          .setBufferSize(targetWidth, targetHeight)
                                                          .build();

            synchronized (mBufferLock)
            {
                mCreated = true;
            }

            mCreating = true;

            for (SurfaceHolder.Callback callback : new ArrayList<>(mCallbacks)) callback.surfaceCreated(mHolder);

            mCreating = false;
        }
        else if (mSurfaceControl != null)
        {
            mSurfaceControl.setBufferSize(targetWidth, targetHeight);
        }

        for (SurfaceHolder.Callback callback : new ArrayList<>(mCallbacks))
        {
            callback.surfaceChanged(mHolder, mFormat, mSurfaceWidth, mSurfaceHeight);
        }

        for (SurfaceHolder.Callback callback : new ArrayList<>(mCallbacks))
        {
            if (callback instanceof SurfaceHolder.Callback2) ((SurfaceHolder.Callback2)callback).surfaceRedrawNeeded(mHolder);
        }
    }

    void destroySurface()
    {
        if (!mCreated) return;

        for (SurfaceHolder.Callback callback : new ArrayList<>(mCallbacks)) callback.surfaceDestroyed(mHolder);

        synchronized (mBufferLock)
        {
            mCreated = false;
            mSoftwarePosted = false;
            mFrontBuffer = null;
            mBackBuffer = null;
        }

        mLaidOut = false;
        mSurface.release();

        if (mSurfaceControl != null)
        {
            mSurfaceControl.release();
            mSurfaceControl = null;
        }
    }

    private final class Holder implements SurfaceHolder
    {
        @Override
        public void addCallback(Callback callback)
        {
            if (callback == null || mCallbacks.contains(callback)) return;

            mCallbacks.add(callback);
            if (mCreated) callback.surfaceCreated(this);
            if (mCreated) callback.surfaceChanged(this, mFormat, mSurfaceWidth, mSurfaceHeight);
        }

        @Override
        public void removeCallback(Callback callback)
        {
            mCallbacks.remove(callback);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isCreating()
        {
            return mCreating;
        }

        @Override
        public void setType(int type)
        {
        }

        @Override
        public void setFixedSize(int width, int height)
        {
            if (mRequestedWidth == width && mRequestedHeight == height) return;

            mRequestedWidth = width;
            mRequestedHeight = height;
            requestLayout();
        }

        @Override
        public void setSizeFromLayout()
        {
            if (mRequestedWidth == -1 && mRequestedHeight == -1) return;

            mRequestedWidth = -1;
            mRequestedHeight = -1;
            requestLayout();
        }

        @Override
        public void setFormat(int format)
        {
            if (format == android.graphics.PixelFormat.OPAQUE) format = android.graphics.PixelFormat.RGB_565;

            mFormat = format;
        }

        @Override
        public void setKeepScreenOn(boolean screenOn)
        {
            SurfaceView.this.setKeepScreenOn(screenOn);
        }

        @Override
        public Canvas lockCanvas()
        {
            return lockCanvas(null);
        }

        @Override
        public Canvas lockCanvas(Rect dirty)
        {
            if (!mSurface.isValid()) return null;

            try
            {
                return mSurface.lockCanvas(dirty);
            }
            catch (RuntimeException unavailable)
            {
                android.util.Log.w("SurfaceView", "the surface could not be locked", unavailable);
                return null;
            }
        }

        @Override
        public Canvas lockHardwareCanvas()
        {
            return lockCanvas(null);
        }

        @Override
        public void unlockCanvasAndPost(Canvas canvas)
        {
            mSurface.unlockCanvasAndPost(canvas);
        }

        @Override
        public Rect getSurfaceFrame()
        {
            return new Rect(0, 0, mSurfaceWidth, mSurfaceHeight);
        }

        @Override
        public Surface getSurface()
        {
            return mSurface;
        }
    }
}
```
