`java/android/view/ViewRootImpl.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.util.Log;

public final class ViewRootImpl implements Choreographer.FrameCallback, ViewParent, AttachedSurfaceControl
{
    private static final String TAG = "ViewRootImpl";

    private final SurfaceControl mSurfaceControl;
    private final java.util.ArrayList<SurfaceControl.Transaction> mDrawTransactions = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
    private static final java.util.ArrayList<FrameMetricsObserver> sFrameMetricsObservers = new java.util.ArrayList<>();

    private View mRoot;
    private final runtime.WindowBridge mWindow;
    private int mWidth;
    private int mHeight;
    private final int mFrameLimit;
    private final boolean mContinuous;

    private int mSystemBarTop;
    private int mSystemBarBottom;
    private WindowInsets mWindowInsets = WindowInsets.empty();
    private boolean mInsetsDispatched;

    private int mFramesDrawn;
    private boolean mTraversalScheduled;
    private boolean mDrawNeeded = true;
    private boolean mLayoutNeeded = true;
    private int mLaidOutWidth = -1;
    private int mLaidOutHeight = -1;
    private Runnable mFirstFrameCallback;
    private boolean mGuestPresents;
    private boolean mReportedIdle;
    private View mFocused;

    private static ViewRootImpl sActive;

    private static final class Panel
    {
        final View view;
        final WindowManager.LayoutParams params;
        final android.graphics.Rect frame = new android.graphics.Rect();

        Panel(View view, WindowManager.LayoutParams params)
        {
            this.view = view;
            this.params = params;
        }

        Window.Callback callback()
        {
            if (!(view instanceof DecorView)) return null;

            Window window = ((DecorView)view).getWindow();
            return window == null ? null : window.getCallback();
        }

        boolean visible()
        {
            return view.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE;
        }
    }

    private final java.util.ArrayList<Panel> mPanels = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
    private Panel mTouchPanel;

    public ViewRootImpl(View root, runtime.WindowBridge window, int frameLimit)
    {
        mRoot = root;
        mWindow = window;
        mWidth = window.getWidth();
        mHeight = window.getHeight();
        mWindowInsets = buildWindowInsets();
        mSurfaceControl = new SurfaceControl.Builder().setName("ViewRoot").setBufferSize(mWidth, mHeight).build();
        mFrameLimit = frameLimit;
        mContinuous = frameLimit > 0 && !"0".equals(runtime.Settings.get("continuous-frames"));

        if (mRoot != null)
        {
            mRoot.assignParent(this);
            mRoot.dispatchAttachedToWindow();
        }

        sActive = this;
    }

    public static ViewRootImpl active()
    {
        return sActive;
    }

    static boolean panelOrigin(View root, int[] origin)
    {
        ViewRootImpl active = sActive;
        if (active == null || root == null) return false;

        for (Panel panel : active.mPanels)
        {
            if (panel.view != root) continue;

            origin[0] = panel.frame.left;
            origin[1] = panel.frame.top;
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    java.util.List<View> windowViews()
    {
        java.util.ArrayList<View> views = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        if (mRoot != null) views.add(mRoot);

        for (Panel panel : mPanels) views.add(panel.view);

        return views;
    }

    java.util.List<WindowManager.LayoutParams> windowParams()
    {
        java.util.ArrayList<WindowManager.LayoutParams> params = new java.util.ArrayList<>();

        if (mRoot != null)
        {
            ViewGroup.LayoutParams rootParams = mRoot.getLayoutParams();
            params.add(rootParams instanceof WindowManager.LayoutParams ? (WindowManager.LayoutParams)rootParams
                                                                      : new WindowManager.LayoutParams());
        }

        for (Panel panel : mPanels) params.add(panel.params);

        return params;
    }

    public void addPanel(View view, WindowManager.LayoutParams params)
    {
        if (findPanel(view) != null) throw new IllegalStateException("View " + view + " has already been added to the window manager.");

        mPanels.add(new Panel(view, params));
        view.setLayoutParams(params);
        view.assignParent(this);
        view.dispatchAttachedToWindow();

        Log.i(TAG, "a " + view.getClass().getName() + " window of type " + params.type + " was added above the activity, "
                       + mPanels.size() + " in all");

        requestLayout();
    }

    public void updatePanel(View view, WindowManager.LayoutParams params)
    {
        Panel panel = findPanel(view);
        if (panel == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("View=" + view + " not attached to window manager");

        if (params != panel.params) panel.params.copyFrom(params);
        view.setLayoutParams(panel.params);
        requestLayout();
    }

    public void removePanel(View view)
    {
        Panel panel = findPanel(view);
        if (panel == null) return;

        mPanels.remove(panel);
        if (mTouchPanel == panel) mTouchPanel = null;

        view.dispatchDetachedFromWindow();
        view.assignParent(null);

        if (mFocused != null && isDescendant(view, mFocused)) setFocusedView(null);

        mDrawNeeded = true;
        scheduleTraversal();
    }

    public boolean hasPanel(View view)
    {
        return findPanel(view) != null;
    }

    private Panel findPanel(View view)
    {
        for (Panel panel : mPanels)
        {
            if (panel.view == view) return panel;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static boolean isDescendant(View ancestor, View view)
    {
        for (ViewParent parent = view == null ? null : view.getParent(); view != null; parent = view.getParent())
        {
            if (view == ancestor) return true;
            view = parent instanceof View ? (View)parent : null;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private void layoutPanels()
    {
        for (Panel panel : new java.util.ArrayList<>(mPanels)) layoutPanel(panel);
    }

    private void layoutPanel(Panel panel)
    {
        WindowManager.LayoutParams params = panel.params;
        boolean fullScreen = (params.flags & (WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN | WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS)) != 0;

        int top = fullScreen ? 0 : mSystemBarTop;
        int bottom = fullScreen ? mHeight : mHeight - mSystemBarBottom;
        android.graphics.Rect container = new android.graphics.Rect(0, top, mWidth, Math.max(top, bottom));

        panel.view.measure(panelSpec(params.width, container.width()), panelSpec(params.height, container.height()));

        int gravity = params.gravity == Gravity.NO_GRAVITY ? Gravity.TOP | Gravity.LEFT : params.gravity;
        gravity = Gravity.getAbsoluteGravity(gravity, View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_LTR);

        Gravity.apply(gravity, panel.view.getMeasuredWidth(), panel.view.getMeasuredHeight(), container, params.x, params.y,
                      panel.frame);

        panel.view.layout(0, 0, panel.frame.width(), panel.frame.height());
    }

    private static int panelSpec(int size, int available)
    {
        if (size == ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT) return View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(available, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY);
        if (size == ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT) return View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(available, View.MeasureSpec.AT_MOST);

        return View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(Math.max(size, 0), View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY);
    }

    private void drawPanels(Canvas canvas)
    {
        android.graphics.Paint dim = null;

        for (Panel panel : new java.util.ArrayList<>(mPanels))
        {
            if (!panel.visible()) continue;

            if ((panel.params.flags & WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_DIM_BEHIND) != 0 && panel.params.dimAmount > 0f)
            {
                if (dim == null) dim = new android.graphics.Paint();

                int alpha = Math.round(Math.min(1f, panel.params.dimAmount) * 255f);
                dim.setColor(android.graphics.Color.argb(alpha, 0, 0, 0));
                canvas.drawRect(0, 0, mWidth, mHeight, dim);
            }

            int saved = canvas.save();
            canvas.translate(panel.frame.left, panel.frame.top);
            panel.view.draw(canvas);
            canvas.restoreToCount(saved);
        }
    }

    public boolean dispatchPanelTouch(MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (mPanels.isEmpty())
        {
            mTouchPanel = null;
            return false;
        }

        int action = event.getActionMasked();
        int x = (int)event.getX();
        int y = (int)event.getY();

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN)
        {
            mTouchPanel = null;

            for (int index = mPanels.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
            {
                Panel panel = mPanels.get(index);
                int flags = panel.params.flags;

                if (!panel.visible() || (flags & WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE) != 0) continue;

                boolean inside = panel.frame.contains(x, y);
                boolean modal = (flags & WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL) == 0 &&
                                (flags & WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE) == 0;

                if (inside || modal)
                {
                    mTouchPanel = panel;
                    break;
                }

                if ((flags & WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_WATCH_OUTSIDE_TOUCH) != 0)
                {
                    MotionEvent outside = MotionEvent.obtain(event);
                    outside.setAction(MotionEvent.ACTION_OUTSIDE);
                    deliverToPanel(panel, outside);
                }
            }
        }

        Panel target = mTouchPanel;
        if (target == null || !mPanels.contains(target)) return false;

        deliverToPanel(target, MotionEvent.obtain(event));

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP || action == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL) mTouchPanel = null;
        return true;
    }

    private static void deliverToPanel(Panel panel, MotionEvent event)
    {
        event.offsetLocation(-panel.frame.left, -panel.frame.top);

        Window.Callback callback = panel.callback();
        if (callback != null) callback.dispatchTouchEvent(event);
        else panel.view.dispatchTouchEvent(event);
    }

    public boolean dispatchPanelKey(KeyEvent event)
    {
        for (int index = mPanels.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            Panel panel = mPanels.get(index);

            if (!panel.visible() || (panel.params.flags & WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE) != 0) continue;

            Window.Callback callback = panel.callback();
            if (callback != null) callback.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
            else panel.view.dispatchKeyEvent(event);

            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public void setSystemBarInsets(int top, int bottom)
    {
        if (top == mSystemBarTop && bottom == mSystemBarBottom) return;

        mSystemBarTop = Math.max(top, 0);
        mSystemBarBottom = Math.max(bottom, 0);

        mWindowInsets = buildWindowInsets();

        mInsetsDispatched = false;
        mLayoutNeeded = true;
        mDrawNeeded = true;
        scheduleTraversal();

        Log.i(TAG, "the system bars take " + mSystemBarTop + "px at the top and " + mSystemBarBottom + "px at the bottom");
    }

    public WindowInsets getWindowInsets()
    {
        return mWindowInsets;
    }

    private WindowInsets buildWindowInsets()
    {
        android.graphics.Insets status = android.graphics.Insets.of(0, mSystemBarTop, 0, 0);
        android.graphics.Insets navigation = android.graphics.Insets.of(0, 0, 0, mSystemBarBottom);
        android.graphics.Insets bars = android.graphics.Insets.of(0, mSystemBarTop, 0, mSystemBarBottom);

        return new WindowInsets.Builder()
                   .setInsets(WindowInsets.Type.statusBars(), status)
                   .setInsetsIgnoringVisibility(WindowInsets.Type.statusBars(), status)
                   .setInsets(WindowInsets.Type.navigationBars(), navigation)
                   .setInsetsIgnoringVisibility(WindowInsets.Type.navigationBars(), navigation)
                   .setInsets(WindowInsets.Type.tappableElement(), bars)
                   .setInsetsIgnoringVisibility(WindowInsets.Type.tappableElement(), bars)
                   .setVisible(WindowInsets.Type.statusBars() | WindowInsets.Type.navigationBars(), true)
                   .setVisible(WindowInsets.Type.ime(), false)
                   .setFrame(mWidth, mHeight)
                   .setDisplayShape(DisplayShape.rectangle(mWidth, mHeight))
                   .build();
    }

    private void dispatchInsets()
    {
        if (mInsetsDispatched || mRoot == null) return;

        mInsetsDispatched = true;
        mRoot.dispatchApplyWindowInsets(mWindowInsets);
    }

    public void onWindowResized(int width, int height)
    {
        if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;
        if (width == mWidth && height == mHeight) return;

        Log.i(TAG, "the window became " + width + "x" + height + ", so everything is laid out again");

        mWidth = width;
        mHeight = height;
        mWindowInsets = buildWindowInsets();
        mInsetsDispatched = false;
        mLaidOutWidth = -1;
        mLaidOutHeight = -1;
        mLayoutNeeded = true;
        mDrawNeeded = true;
        mReportedIdle = false;

        scheduleTraversal();
    }

    public int getWindowWidth()
    {
        return mWidth;
    }

    public int getWindowHeight()
    {
        return mHeight;
    }

    public void setContentRoot(View root)
    {
        if (root == null || root == mRoot) return;

        if (mRoot != null)
        {
            mRoot.dispatchDetachedFromWindow();
            mRoot.assignParent(null);
        }

        mRoot = root;
        mRoot.assignParent(this);
        mRoot.dispatchAttachedToWindow();
        mLaidOutWidth = -1;
        mLaidOutHeight = -1;
        mLayoutNeeded = true;
        mDrawNeeded = true;
        scheduleTraversal();
    }

    @Override
    public void requestLayout()
    {
        mLayoutNeeded = true;
        mDrawNeeded = true;
        scheduleTraversal();
    }

    @Override
    public void invalidateChild(View child, android.graphics.Rect dirty)
    {
        mDrawNeeded = true;
        scheduleTraversal();
    }

    @Override
    public void onDescendantInvalidated(View child, View target)
    {
        mDrawNeeded = true;
        scheduleTraversal();
    }

    @Override
    public ViewParent getParent()
    {
        return null;
    }

    public View getFocusedView()
    {
        return mFocused;
    }

    public void setFocusedView(View view)
    {
        if (mFocused == view) return;

        View previous = mFocused;
        mFocused = view;

        if (previous != null) previous.onFocusLost();

        android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager input =
            android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager.getInstance();

        if (view != null && view.onCheckIsTextEditor()) input.startInput(view);
        else if (previous != null && input.getServedView() == previous) input.finishInput();
    }

    public boolean dispatchKeyToFocus(KeyEvent event)
    {
        if (android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager.getInstance().dispatchKeyEvent(event)) return true;

        return mFocused != null && mFocused.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
    }

    public int getFramesDrawn()
    {
        return mFramesDrawn;
    }

    public void setFirstFrameCallback(Runnable callback)
    {
        mFirstFrameCallback = callback;
    }

    public void start()
    {
        doFrame(android.os.SystemClock.uptimeNanos());
    }

    public void scheduleTraversal()
    {
        if (mTraversalScheduled) return;

        mTraversalScheduled = true;
        Choreographer.getInstance().postCallback(Choreographer.CALLBACK_TRAVERSAL, mTraversal, this);
    }

    private final Runnable mTraversal = new Runnable()
    {
        @Override
        public void run()
        {
            doFrame(Choreographer.getInstance().getFrameTimeNanos());
        }
    };

    @Override
    public SurfaceControl.Transaction buildReparentTransaction(SurfaceControl child)
    {
        if (child == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("child must not be null");

        return new SurfaceControl.Transaction().reparent(child, mSurfaceControl);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean applyTransactionOnDraw(SurfaceControl.Transaction transaction)
    {
        if (transaction == null) return false;

        synchronized (mDrawTransactions)
        {
            mDrawTransactions.add(transaction);
        }

        mDrawNeeded = true;
        scheduleTraversal();
        return true;
    }

    private void applyDrawTransactions()
    {
        SurfaceControl.Transaction[] pending;

        synchronized (mDrawTransactions)
        {
            if (mDrawTransactions.isEmpty()) return;

            pending = mDrawTransactions.toArray(new SurfaceControl.Transaction[0]);
            mDrawTransactions.clear();
        }

        for (SurfaceControl.Transaction transaction : pending)
        {
            transaction.apply();
        }
    }

    static final class FrameMetricsObserver
    {
        final Window.OnFrameMetricsAvailableListener listener;
        final android.os.Handler handler;
        final Window window;
        int dropped;

        FrameMetricsObserver(Window window, Window.OnFrameMetricsAvailableListener listener, android.os.Handler handler)
        {
            this.window = window;
            this.listener = listener;
            this.handler = handler;
        }
    }

    static void addFrameMetricsObserver(FrameMetricsObserver observer)
    {
        synchronized (sFrameMetricsObservers)
        {
            sFrameMetricsObservers.add(observer);
        }
    }

    static boolean removeFrameMetricsObserver(Window.OnFrameMetricsAvailableListener listener)
    {
        synchronized (sFrameMetricsObservers)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < sFrameMetricsObservers.size(); index++)
            {
                if (sFrameMetricsObservers.get(index).listener != listener) continue;

                sFrameMetricsObservers.remove(index);
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private void reportFrameMetrics(long vsyncNanos, long startNanos, long endNanos)
    {
        FrameMetricsObserver[] observers;

        synchronized (sFrameMetricsObservers)
        {
            if (sFrameMetricsObservers.isEmpty()) return;

            observers = sFrameMetricsObservers.toArray(new FrameMetricsObserver[0]);
        }

        for (FrameMetricsObserver observer : observers)
        {
            FrameMetrics metrics = FrameMetrics.forFrame(vsyncNanos, startNanos, endNanos, mFramesDrawn == 1);
            int dropped = observer.dropped;
            observer.dropped = 0;

            Runnable delivery = () -> observer.listener.onFrameMetricsAvailable(observer.window, metrics, dropped);
            if (observer.handler == null || !observer.handler.post(delivery)) observer.dropped++;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void doFrame(long frameTimeNanos)
    {
        mTraversalScheduled = false;

        if (mContinuous)
        {
            mDrawNeeded = true;
            mLayoutNeeded = true;
        }

        long startNanos = System.nanoTime();
        int framesBefore = mFramesDrawn;

        boolean drew = performTraversal();

        if (mFramesDrawn != framesBefore)
        {
            applyDrawTransactions();
            reportFrameMetrics(frameTimeNanos, startNanos, System.nanoTime());
        }

        if (mWindow.isCloseRequested())
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "compositor requested close after " + mFramesDrawn + " frames");
            android.os.Looper.quitMainLooper();
            return;
        }

        if (mFrameLimit > 0 && mFramesDrawn >= mFrameLimit)
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "frame limit reached: " + mFramesDrawn);
            android.os.Looper.quitMainLooper();
            return;
        }

        if (mContinuous || mDrawNeeded || mLayoutNeeded)
        {
            mReportedIdle = false;
            scheduleTraversal();
            return;
        }

        if (drew || !mReportedIdle)
        {
            mReportedIdle = true;
            Log.i(TAG, "nothing is dirty after " + mFramesDrawn + " frames, so the next frame waits for an invalidate");
        }
    }

    public boolean performTraversal()
    {
        if (!mDrawNeeded && !mLayoutNeeded) return false;

        if (mLayoutNeeded)
        {
            mLayoutNeeded = false;

            dispatchInsets();

            int widthSpec = View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(mWidth, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY);
            int heightSpec = View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(mHeight, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY);

            mRoot.measure(widthSpec, heightSpec);
            mRoot.layout(0, 0, mRoot.getMeasuredWidth(), mRoot.getMeasuredHeight());

            if (mRoot.getWidth() != mLaidOutWidth || mRoot.getHeight() != mLaidOutHeight)
            {
                mLaidOutWidth = mRoot.getWidth();
                mLaidOutHeight = mRoot.getHeight();
                mRoot.getViewTreeObserver().dispatchOnGlobalLayout();
            }

            layoutPanels();
        }

        mDrawNeeded = false;

        int surface = surfaceState(mRoot);

        if (surface == SURFACE_READY)
        {
            if (!mGuestPresents)
            {
                mGuestPresents = true;
                mWindow.setGuestPresents(true);
                Log.i(TAG, "a surface view owns the window, so its producer presents it from here on");
            }

            mFramesDrawn++;
        }
        else
        {
            if (mGuestPresents)
            {
                mGuestPresents = false;
                mWindow.setGuestPresents(false);
                Log.i(TAG, "the surface view that owned the window is gone, so the framework presents it again");
            }

            Canvas canvas = mWindow.beginFrame();
            if (canvas == null)
            {
                Log.w(TAG, "no buffer available for this frame");
                mDrawNeeded = true;
                return false;
            }

            int before = android.graphics.Canvas.sDrawOperations;

            mRoot.draw(canvas);
            drawPanels(canvas);
            mWindow.endFrame();
            mFramesDrawn++;

            if (View.TRACE_DRAW)
            {
                Log.i(TAG, "frame " + mFramesDrawn + " issued "
                           + (android.graphics.Canvas.sDrawOperations - before) + " shape operations");
            }
        }

        if (runtime.Strict.isTracing("views"))
        {
            int views = countViews(mRoot);
            if (views != mDumpedViewCount)
            {
                mDumpedViewCount = views;
                Log.i(TAG, "frame " + mFramesDrawn + " shows " + views + " view(s)");
                dumpHierarchy(mRoot, 0);
            }
        }

        if (mFirstFrameCallback != null && surface != SURFACE_PENDING)
        {
            Runnable callback = mFirstFrameCallback;
            mFirstFrameCallback = null;
            callback.run();
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static final int SURFACE_ABSENT = 0;
    private static final int SURFACE_PENDING = 1;
    private static final int SURFACE_READY = 2;

    private static int surfaceState(View view)
    {
        if (view instanceof SurfaceView)
        {
            if (((SurfaceView)view).presentsThroughFramework()) return SURFACE_ABSENT;

            Surface surface = ((SurfaceView)view).getHolder().getSurface();
            return surface != null && surface.isValid() ? SURFACE_READY : SURFACE_PENDING;
        }

        int state = SURFACE_ABSENT;

        if (view instanceof ViewGroup)
        {
            ViewGroup group = (ViewGroup)view;
            for (int index = 0; index < group.getChildCount(); ++index)
            {
                int child = surfaceState(group.getChildAt(index));
                if (child == SURFACE_PENDING) return SURFACE_PENDING;
                if (child == SURFACE_READY) state = SURFACE_READY;
            }
        }

        return state;
    }

    private int mDumpedViewCount = -1;

    private static int countViews(View view)
    {
        if (!(view instanceof ViewGroup)) return 1;

        ViewGroup group = (ViewGroup)view;
        int total = 1;
        for (int index = 0; index < group.getChildCount(); index++) total += countViews(group.getChildAt(index));

        return total;
    }

    private static void dumpHierarchy(View view, int depth)
    {
        StringBuilder indent = new StringBuilder();
        for (int level = 0; level < depth; level++)
        {
            indent.append("  ");
        }

        String detail = "";
        if (view.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) detail += " visibility=" + view.getVisibility();
        if (view instanceof android.widget.TextView)
        {
            android.widget.TextView text = (android.widget.TextView)view;
            detail += " text=\"" + text.getText() + "\" color=#" + Integer.toHexString(text.getCurrentTextColor()) + " size=" +
                      text.getTextSize();
        }

        Log.i(TAG, indent + view.getClass().getName() + " id=0x" + Integer.toHexString(view.getId()) + " bounds=" + view.getLeft() + ","
                       + view.getTop() + "-" + view.getRight() + "," + view.getBottom() + detail);

        if (!(view instanceof ViewGroup)) return;

        ViewGroup group = (ViewGroup)view;
        for (int index = 0; index < group.getChildCount(); index++)
        {
            dumpHierarchy(group.getChildAt(index), depth + 1);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/ViewStub.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

import java.lang.ref.WeakReference;

public final class ViewStub extends View
{
    public interface OnInflateListener
    {
        void onInflate(ViewStub stub, View inflated);
    }

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private int mInflatedId = NO_ID;
    private int mLayoutResource;
    private WeakReference<View> mInflatedViewRef;
    private LayoutInflater mInflater;
    private OnInflateListener mInflateListener;

    public ViewStub(Context context)
    {
        this(context, 0);
    }

    public ViewStub(Context context, int layoutResource)
    {
        this(context, null);

        mLayoutResource = layoutResource;
    }

    public ViewStub(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, 0);
    }

    public ViewStub(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public ViewStub(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        setVisibility(GONE);
        setWillNotDraw(true);

        if (attributes == null) return;

        if (sStyleable == null) sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "layout", "inflatedId");
        if (sStyleable.isEmpty()) return;

        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        int layoutIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("layout");
        if (layoutIndex >= 0) mLayoutResource = array.getResourceId(layoutIndex, 0);

        int idIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("inflatedId");
        if (idIndex >= 0) mInflatedId = array.getResourceId(idIndex, NO_ID);

        array.recycle();
    }

    public int getInflatedId()
    {
        return mInflatedId;
    }

    public void setInflatedId(int inflatedId)
    {
        mInflatedId = inflatedId;
    }

    public int getLayoutResource()
    {
        return mLayoutResource;
    }

    public void setLayoutResource(int layoutResource)
    {
        mLayoutResource = layoutResource;
    }

    public void setLayoutInflater(LayoutInflater inflater)
    {
        mInflater = inflater;
    }

    public LayoutInflater getLayoutInflater()
    {
        return mInflater;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        setMeasuredDimension(0, 0);
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
    }

    @Override
    protected void dispatchDraw(Canvas canvas)
    {
    }

    @Override
    public void setVisibility(int visibility)
    {
        if (mInflatedViewRef != null)
        {
            View view = mInflatedViewRef.get();
            if (view == null) throw new IllegalStateException("setVisibility called on un-referenced view");

            view.setVisibility(visibility);
            return;
        }

        super.setVisibility(visibility);

        if (visibility == VISIBLE || visibility == INVISIBLE) inflate();
    }

    private View inflateViewNoAdd(ViewGroup parent)
    {
        LayoutInflater inflater = mInflater != null ? mInflater : LayoutInflater.from(getContext());
        View view = inflater.inflate(mLayoutResource, parent, false);

        if (mInflatedId != NO_ID) view.setId(mInflatedId);

        return view;
    }

    private void replaceSelfWithView(View view, ViewGroup parent)
    {
        int index = parent.indexOfChild(this);
        parent.removeViewInLayout(this);

        ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = getLayoutParams();
        if (params != null) parent.addView(view, index, params);
        else parent.addView(view, index);
    }

    public View inflate()
    {
        ViewParent viewParent = getParent();

        if (!(viewParent instanceof ViewGroup)) throw new IllegalStateException("ViewStub must have a non-null ViewGroup viewParent");
        if (mLayoutResource == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ViewStub must have a valid layoutResource");

        ViewGroup parent = (ViewGroup)viewParent;
        View view = inflateViewNoAdd(parent);

        replaceSelfWithView(view, parent);

        mInflatedViewRef = new WeakReference<>(view);

        if (mInflateListener != null) mInflateListener.onInflate(this, view);

        return view;
    }

    public void setOnInflateListener(OnInflateListener inflateListener)
    {
        mInflateListener = inflateListener;
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/ViewTreeObserver.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.graphics.Rect;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

public final class ViewTreeObserver
{
    private final ArrayList<OnGlobalLayoutListener> mGlobalLayout = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<OnPreDrawListener> mPreDraw = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<OnDrawListener> mDraw = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<OnScrollChangedListener> mScrollChanged = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<OnWindowFocusChangeListener> mWindowFocus = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<OnWindowAttachListener> mWindowAttach = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<OnWindowVisibilityChangeListener> mWindowVisibility = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<OnTouchModeChangeListener> mTouchMode = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<OnGlobalFocusChangeListener> mGlobalFocus = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<Consumer<List<Rect>>> mGestureExclusion = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<Runnable> mFrameCommit = new ArrayList<>();
    private boolean mAlive = true;

    ViewTreeObserver()
    {
    }

    public boolean isAlive()
    {
        return mAlive;
    }

    void kill()
    {
        mAlive = false;
    }

    private void checkIsAlive()
    {
        if (!mAlive) throw new IllegalStateException("This ViewTreeObserver is not alive, call getViewTreeObserver() again");
    }

    void merge(ViewTreeObserver observer)
    {
        if (observer == null || observer == this) return;

        mGlobalLayout.addAll(observer.mGlobalLayout);
        mPreDraw.addAll(observer.mPreDraw);
        mDraw.addAll(observer.mDraw);
        mScrollChanged.addAll(observer.mScrollChanged);
        mWindowFocus.addAll(observer.mWindowFocus);
        mWindowAttach.addAll(observer.mWindowAttach);
        mWindowVisibility.addAll(observer.mWindowVisibility);
        mTouchMode.addAll(observer.mTouchMode);
        mGlobalFocus.addAll(observer.mGlobalFocus);
        mGestureExclusion.addAll(observer.mGestureExclusion);
        mFrameCommit.addAll(observer.mFrameCommit);

        observer.kill();
    }

    public void addOnGlobalLayoutListener(OnGlobalLayoutListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        if (listener != null) mGlobalLayout.add(listener);
    }

    public void removeOnGlobalLayoutListener(OnGlobalLayoutListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        mGlobalLayout.remove(listener);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public void removeGlobalOnLayoutListener(OnGlobalLayoutListener listener)
    {
        removeOnGlobalLayoutListener(listener);
    }

    public void addOnPreDrawListener(OnPreDrawListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        if (listener != null) mPreDraw.add(listener);
    }

    public void removeOnPreDrawListener(OnPreDrawListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        mPreDraw.remove(listener);
    }

    public void addOnDrawListener(OnDrawListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        if (listener != null) mDraw.add(listener);
    }

    public void removeOnDrawListener(OnDrawListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        mDraw.remove(listener);
    }

    public void registerFrameCommitCallback(Runnable callback)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        if (callback != null) mFrameCommit.add(callback);
    }

    public boolean unregisterFrameCommitCallback(Runnable callback)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        return mFrameCommit.remove(callback);
    }

    public void addOnScrollChangedListener(OnScrollChangedListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        if (listener != null) mScrollChanged.add(listener);
    }

    public void removeOnScrollChangedListener(OnScrollChangedListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        mScrollChanged.remove(listener);
    }

    public void addOnWindowFocusChangeListener(OnWindowFocusChangeListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        if (listener != null) mWindowFocus.add(listener);
    }

    public void removeOnWindowFocusChangeListener(OnWindowFocusChangeListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        mWindowFocus.remove(listener);
    }

    public void addOnWindowAttachListener(OnWindowAttachListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        if (listener != null) mWindowAttach.add(listener);
    }

    public void removeOnWindowAttachListener(OnWindowAttachListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        mWindowAttach.remove(listener);
    }

    public void addOnWindowVisibilityChangeListener(OnWindowVisibilityChangeListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        if (listener != null) mWindowVisibility.add(listener);
    }

    public void removeOnWindowVisibilityChangeListener(OnWindowVisibilityChangeListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        mWindowVisibility.remove(listener);
    }

    public void addOnTouchModeChangeListener(OnTouchModeChangeListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        if (listener != null) mTouchMode.add(listener);
    }

    public void removeOnTouchModeChangeListener(OnTouchModeChangeListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        mTouchMode.remove(listener);
    }

    public void addOnGlobalFocusChangeListener(OnGlobalFocusChangeListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        if (listener != null) mGlobalFocus.add(listener);
    }

    public void removeOnGlobalFocusChangeListener(OnGlobalFocusChangeListener listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        mGlobalFocus.remove(listener);
    }

    public void addOnSystemGestureExclusionRectsChangedListener(Consumer<List<Rect>> listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        if (listener != null) mGestureExclusion.add(listener);
    }

    public void removeOnSystemGestureExclusionRectsChangedListener(Consumer<List<Rect>> listener)
    {
        checkIsAlive();
        mGestureExclusion.remove(listener);
    }

    public void dispatchOnGlobalLayout()
    {
        for (OnGlobalLayoutListener listener : new ArrayList<>(mGlobalLayout))
        {
            listener.onGlobalLayout();
        }
    }

    public boolean dispatchOnPreDraw()
    {
        boolean cancelDraw = false;
        for (OnPreDrawListener listener : new ArrayList<>(mPreDraw))
        {
            cancelDraw |= !listener.onPreDraw();
        }
        return cancelDraw;
    }

    public void dispatchOnDraw()
    {
        for (OnDrawListener listener : new ArrayList<>(mDraw))
        {
            listener.onDraw();
        }
    }

    void dispatchOnFrameCommit()
    {
        if (mFrameCommit.isEmpty()) return;

        ArrayList<Runnable> callbacks = new ArrayList<>(mFrameCommit);
        mFrameCommit.clear();

        for (Runnable callback : callbacks)
        {
            callback.run();
        }
    }

    void dispatchOnScrollChanged()
    {
        for (OnScrollChangedListener listener : new ArrayList<>(mScrollChanged))
        {
            listener.onScrollChanged();
        }
    }

    void dispatchOnWindowFocusChange(boolean hasFocus)
    {
        for (OnWindowFocusChangeListener listener : new ArrayList<>(mWindowFocus))
        {
            listener.onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus);
        }
    }

    void dispatchOnWindowAttachedChange(boolean attached)
    {
        for (OnWindowAttachListener listener : new ArrayList<>(mWindowAttach))
        {
            if (attached) listener.onWindowAttached();
            else listener.onWindowDetached();
        }
    }

    void dispatchOnWindowVisibilityChange(int visibility)
    {
        for (OnWindowVisibilityChangeListener listener : new ArrayList<>(mWindowVisibility))
        {
            listener.onWindowVisibilityChanged(visibility);
        }
    }

    void dispatchOnTouchModeChanged(boolean inTouchMode)
    {
        for (OnTouchModeChangeListener listener : new ArrayList<>(mTouchMode))
        {
            listener.onTouchModeChanged(inTouchMode);
        }
    }

    void dispatchOnGlobalFocusChange(View oldFocus, View newFocus)
    {
        for (OnGlobalFocusChangeListener listener : new ArrayList<>(mGlobalFocus))
        {
            listener.onGlobalFocusChanged(oldFocus, newFocus);
        }
    }

    void dispatchOnSystemGestureExclusionRectsChanged(List<Rect> rects)
    {
        for (Consumer<List<Rect>> listener : new ArrayList<>(mGestureExclusion))
        {
            listener.accept(rects);
        }
    }

    boolean hasOnPreDrawListeners()
    {
        return !mPreDraw.isEmpty();
    }

    public interface OnGlobalLayoutListener
    {
        void onGlobalLayout();
    }

    public interface OnPreDrawListener
    {
        boolean onPreDraw();
    }

    public interface OnDrawListener
    {
        void onDraw();
    }

    public interface OnScrollChangedListener
    {
        void onScrollChanged();
    }

    public interface OnWindowFocusChangeListener
    {
        void onWindowFocusChanged(boolean hasFocus);
    }

    public interface OnWindowAttachListener
    {
        void onWindowAttached();

        void onWindowDetached();
    }

    public interface OnWindowVisibilityChangeListener
    {
        void onWindowVisibilityChanged(int visibility);
    }

    public interface OnGlobalFocusChangeListener
    {
        void onGlobalFocusChanged(View oldFocus, View newFocus);
    }

    public interface OnTouchModeChangeListener
    {
        void onTouchModeChanged(boolean isInTouchMode);
    }
}
```

```java
    public final TypedArray getWindowStyle()
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mWindowStyle == null)
            {
                if (sWindowStyleable == null)
                {
                    sWindowStyleable = StyleableSet.of(mContext.getResources(), "windowBackground", "windowFrame", "windowNoTitle",
                                                       "windowFullscreen", "windowIsFloating", "windowIsTranslucent",
                                                       "windowContentOverlay", "windowAnimationStyle", "windowSoftInputMode",
                                                       "windowActionBar", "windowActionBarOverlay", "windowCloseOnTouchOutside",
                                                       "windowTranslucentStatus", "windowTranslucentNavigation", "statusBarColor",
                                                       "navigationBarColor", "windowLightStatusBar", "windowLightNavigationBar",
                                                       "windowLayoutInDisplayCutoutMode", "backgroundDimEnabled",
                                                       "backgroundDimAmount", "windowMinWidthMajor", "windowMinWidthMinor");
                }

                mWindowStyle = mContext.obtainStyledAttributes(sWindowStyleable.attributes());
            }

            return mWindowStyle;
        }
    }

    final boolean themeBoolean(String attributeName, boolean fallback)
    {
        int attribute = mContext.getResources().getIdentifier(attributeName, "attr", "android");
        if (attribute == 0) return fallback;

        android.util.TypedValue value = new android.util.TypedValue();
        if (!mContext.getTheme().resolveAttribute(attribute, value, true)) return fallback;
        if (value.type != android.util.TypedValue.TYPE_INT_BOOLEAN) return fallback;

        return value.data != 0;
    }

    public void setContainer(Window container)
    {
        mContainer = container;

        if (container == null) return;

        mFeatures |= 1 << FEATURE_NO_TITLE;
        mLocalFeatures |= 1 << FEATURE_NO_TITLE;
        container.mHasChildren = true;
    }

    public final void addOnFrameMetricsAvailableListener(OnFrameMetricsAvailableListener listener, Handler handler)
    {
        if (listener == null) throw new NullPointerException("listener cannot be null");

        View decorView = getDecorView();
        if (decorView == null) throw new IllegalStateException("can't observe a Window without an attached view");

        Handler target = handler == null ? new Handler(android.os.Looper.getMainLooper()) : handler;
        ViewRootImpl.addFrameMetricsObserver(new ViewRootImpl.FrameMetricsObserver(this, listener, target));
    }

    public boolean shouldCloseOnTouch(Context context, MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (!mCloseOnTouchOutside || event.getAction() != MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) return false;

        View decor = peekDecorView();
        if (decor == null) return false;

        int x = (int)event.getX();
        int y = (int)event.getY();
        return x < 0 || y < 0 || x > decor.getWidth() || y > decor.getHeight();
    }
```

`java/android/view/WindowId.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public class WindowId implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<WindowId> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<WindowId>()
    {
        @Override
        public WindowId createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new WindowId(source.readStrongBinder());
        }

        @Override
        public WindowId[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new WindowId[size];
        }
    };

    private final android.os.IBinder mToken;
    private final ArrayList<FocusObserver> mObservers = new ArrayList<>();
    private boolean mFocused = true;

    WindowId(android.os.IBinder token)
    {
        mToken = token;
    }

    public boolean isFocused()
    {
        return mFocused;
    }

    void setFocused(boolean focused)
    {
        if (mFocused == focused) return;

        mFocused = focused;

        for (FocusObserver observer : new ArrayList<>(mObservers))
        {
            if (focused) observer.onFocusGained(this);
            else observer.onFocusLost(this);
        }
    }

    public void registerFocusObserver(FocusObserver observer)
    {
        if (observer != null && !mObservers.contains(observer)) mObservers.add(observer);
    }

    public void unregisterFocusObserver(FocusObserver observer)
    {
        mObservers.remove(observer);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (!(other instanceof WindowId)) return false;
        return mToken == ((WindowId)other).mToken;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mToken == null ? 0 : System.identityHashCode(mToken);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "WindowId{" + Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(this)) + ": " + mToken + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeStrongBinder(mToken);
    }

    public static abstract class FocusObserver
    {
        public FocusObserver()
        {
        }

        public abstract void onFocusGained(WindowId token);

        public abstract void onFocusLost(WindowId token);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view;

import android.graphics.Insets;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.util.Size;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class WindowInsets
{
    private static final int TYPE_COUNT = 9;

    private static final WindowInsets EMPTY = new Builder().build();

    public static final WindowInsets CONSUMED = new WindowInsets(null, null, null, false, null, null, null, 0, 0, null, null, true, true, true);

    private final Insets[] mTypeInsets;
    private final Insets[] mTypeMaxInsets;
    private final boolean[] mTypeVisibility;
    private final boolean mIsRound;
    private final DisplayCutout mDisplayCutout;
    private final RoundedCorner[] mRoundedCorners;
    private final Rect mPrivacyIndicatorBounds;
    private final int mFrameWidth;
    private final int mFrameHeight;
    private final List<Rect>[] mTypeBoundingRects;
    private final List<Rect>[] mTypeMaxBoundingRects;
    private final boolean mSystemWindowInsetsConsumed;
    private final boolean mStableInsetsConsumed;
    private final boolean mDisplayCutoutConsumed;
    private DisplayShape mDisplayShape;

    private WindowInsets(Insets[] typeInsets, Insets[] typeMaxInsets, boolean[] typeVisibility, boolean isRound, DisplayCutout displayCutout,
                         RoundedCorner[] roundedCorners, Rect privacyIndicatorBounds, int frameWidth, int frameHeight,
                         List<Rect>[] typeBoundingRects, List<Rect>[] typeMaxBoundingRects, boolean systemWindowInsetsConsumed,
                         boolean stableInsetsConsumed, boolean displayCutoutConsumed)
    {
        mSystemWindowInsetsConsumed = systemWindowInsetsConsumed;
        mStableInsetsConsumed = stableInsetsConsumed;
        mDisplayCutoutConsumed = displayCutoutConsumed;

        mTypeInsets = systemWindowInsetsConsumed ? filledInsets() : copyInsets(typeInsets);
        mTypeMaxInsets = stableInsetsConsumed ? filledInsets() : copyInsets(typeMaxInsets);
        mTypeVisibility = typeVisibility == null ? new boolean[TYPE_COUNT] : typeVisibility.clone();
        mIsRound = isRound;
        mDisplayCutout = displayCutoutConsumed ? null : displayCutout;
        mRoundedCorners = roundedCorners == null ? new RoundedCorner[4] : roundedCorners.clone();
        mPrivacyIndicatorBounds = privacyIndicatorBounds == null ? null : new Rect(privacyIndicatorBounds);
        mFrameWidth = frameWidth;
        mFrameHeight = frameHeight;
        mTypeBoundingRects = copyRects(typeBoundingRects);
        mTypeMaxBoundingRects = copyRects(typeMaxBoundingRects);
    }

    public WindowInsets(WindowInsets source)
    {
        this(source.mTypeInsets, source.mTypeMaxInsets, source.mTypeVisibility, source.mIsRound, source.mDisplayCutout,
             source.mRoundedCorners, source.mPrivacyIndicatorBounds, source.mFrameWidth, source.mFrameHeight, source.mTypeBoundingRects,
             source.mTypeMaxBoundingRects, source.mSystemWindowInsetsConsumed, source.mStableInsetsConsumed, source.mDisplayCutoutConsumed);
        mDisplayShape = source.mDisplayShape;
    }

    private static Insets[] filledInsets()
    {
        Insets[] insets = new Insets[TYPE_COUNT];
        Arrays.fill(insets, Insets.NONE);
        return insets;
    }

    private static Insets[] copyInsets(Insets[] source)
    {
        Insets[] insets = filledInsets();
        if (source == null) return insets;

        for (int index = 0; index < TYPE_COUNT; index++)
        {
            if (source[index] != null) insets[index] = source[index];
        }

        return insets;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static List<Rect>[] copyRects(List<Rect>[] source)
    {
        List<Rect>[] rects = new List[TYPE_COUNT];

        for (int index = 0; index < TYPE_COUNT; index++)
        {
            ArrayList<Rect> copy = new ArrayList<>();
            if (source != null && source[index] != null)
            {
                for (Rect rect : source[index])
                {
                    if (rect != null) copy.add(new Rect(rect));
                }
            }
            rects[index] = copy;
        }

        return rects;
    }

    public static WindowInsets empty()
    {
        return EMPTY;
    }

    private static Insets union(Insets[] insets, int typeMask)
    {
        Insets result = Insets.NONE;

        for (int index = 0; index < TYPE_COUNT; index++)
        {
            if ((typeMask & (1 << index)) == 0) continue;
            result = Insets.max(result, insets[index]);
        }

        return result;
    }

    private static int compatTypes()
    {
        return Type.systemBars() | Type.ime() | Type.displayCutout();
    }

    public Insets getInsets(int typeMask)
    {
        return union(mTypeInsets, typeMask);
    }

    public Insets getInsetsIgnoringVisibility(int typeMask)
    {
        if ((typeMask & Type.ime()) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unable to query the maximum insets for IME");

        return union(mTypeMaxInsets, typeMask);
    }

    public boolean isVisible(int typeMask)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < TYPE_COUNT; index++)
        {
            if ((typeMask & (1 << index)) != 0 && !mTypeVisibility[index]) return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public List<Rect> getBoundingRects(int typeMask)
    {
        return collectRects(mTypeBoundingRects, typeMask);
    }

    public List<Rect> getBoundingRectsIgnoringVisibility(int typeMask)
    {
        if ((typeMask & Type.ime()) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unable to query the bounding rects for IME");

        return collectRects(mTypeMaxBoundingRects, typeMask);
    }

    private static List<Rect> collectRects(List<Rect>[] rects, int typeMask)
    {
        ArrayList<Rect> result = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int index = 0; index < TYPE_COUNT; index++)
        {
            if ((typeMask & (1 << index)) == 0) continue;

            for (Rect rect : rects[index])
            {
                if (!result.contains(rect)) result.add(new Rect(rect));
            }
        }

        return Collections.unmodifiableList(result);
    }

    public Size getFrame()
    {
        return new Size(mFrameWidth, mFrameHeight);
    }

    public Insets getSystemWindowInsets()
    {
        return getInsets(compatTypes());
    }

    public int getSystemWindowInsetLeft()
    {
        return getSystemWindowInsets().left;
    }

    public int getSystemWindowInsetTop()
    {
        return getSystemWindowInsets().top;
    }

    public int getSystemWindowInsetRight()
    {
        return getSystemWindowInsets().right;
    }

    public int getSystemWindowInsetBottom()
    {
        return getSystemWindowInsets().bottom;
    }

    public boolean hasSystemWindowInsets()
    {
        return !Insets.NONE.equals(getSystemWindowInsets());
    }

    public boolean hasInsets()
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < TYPE_COUNT; index++)
        {
            if (!Insets.NONE.equals(mTypeInsets[index])) return true;
        }

        return mDisplayCutout != null || hasRoundedCorners();
    }

    private boolean hasRoundedCorners()
    {
        for (RoundedCorner corner : mRoundedCorners)
        {
            if (corner != null) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public DisplayCutout getDisplayCutout()
    {
        return mDisplayCutout;
    }

    public RoundedCorner getRoundedCorner(int position)
    {
        if (position < RoundedCorner.POSITION_TOP_LEFT || position > RoundedCorner.POSITION_BOTTOM_LEFT) return null;

        return mRoundedCorners[position];
    }

    public Rect getPrivacyIndicatorBounds()
    {
        return mPrivacyIndicatorBounds == null ? null : new Rect(mPrivacyIndicatorBounds);
    }

    public WindowInsets consumeDisplayCutout()
    {
        return new WindowInsets(mTypeInsets, mTypeMaxInsets, mTypeVisibility, mIsRound, null, mRoundedCorners, mPrivacyIndicatorBounds,
                                mFrameWidth, mFrameHeight, mTypeBoundingRects, mTypeMaxBoundingRects, mSystemWindowInsetsConsumed,
                                mStableInsetsConsumed, true).shaped(mDisplayShape);
    }

    public boolean isConsumed()
    {
        return mSystemWindowInsetsConsumed && mStableInsetsConsumed && mDisplayCutoutConsumed;
    }

    public boolean isRound()
    {
        return mIsRound;
    }

    public WindowInsets consumeSystemWindowInsets()
    {
        return new WindowInsets(null, mTypeMaxInsets, mTypeVisibility, mIsRound, mDisplayCutout, mRoundedCorners, mPrivacyIndicatorBounds,
                                mFrameWidth, mFrameHeight, mTypeBoundingRects, mTypeMaxBoundingRects, true, mStableInsetsConsumed,
                                mDisplayCutoutConsumed).shaped(mDisplayShape);
    }

    public WindowInsets consumeStableInsets()
    {
        return new WindowInsets(mTypeInsets, null, mTypeVisibility, mIsRound, mDisplayCutout, mRoundedCorners, mPrivacyIndicatorBounds,
                                mFrameWidth, mFrameHeight, mTypeBoundingRects, mTypeMaxBoundingRects, mSystemWindowInsetsConsumed, true,
                                mDisplayCutoutConsumed).shaped(mDisplayShape);
    }

    public WindowInsets replaceSystemWindowInsets(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        if (left == getSystemWindowInsetLeft() && top == getSystemWindowInsetTop() && right == getSystemWindowInsetRight()
            && bottom == getSystemWindowInsetBottom())
        {
            return this;
        }

        return new Builder(this).setSystemWindowInsets(Insets.of(left, top, right, bottom)).build();
    }

    public WindowInsets replaceSystemWindowInsets(Rect systemWindowInsets)
    {
        if (systemWindowInsets == null) return this;

        return replaceSystemWindowInsets(systemWindowInsets.left, systemWindowInsets.top, systemWindowInsets.right,
                                         systemWindowInsets.bottom);
    }

    public Insets getStableInsets()
    {
        return getInsetsIgnoringVisibility(Type.systemBars());
    }

    public int getStableInsetTop()
    {
        return getStableInsets().top;
    }

    public int getStableInsetLeft()
    {
        return getStableInsets().left;
    }

    public int getStableInsetRight()
    {
        return getStableInsets().right;
    }

    public int getStableInsetBottom()
    {
        return getStableInsets().bottom;
    }

    public boolean hasStableInsets()
    {
        return !Insets.NONE.equals(getStableInsets());
    }

    public Insets getSystemGestureInsets()
    {
        return getInsets(Type.systemGestures());
    }

    public Insets getMandatorySystemGestureInsets()
    {
        return getInsets(Type.mandatorySystemGestures());
    }

    public Insets getTappableElementInsets()
    {
        return getInsets(Type.tappableElement());
    }

    public WindowInsets inset(Insets insets)
    {
        if (insets == null) throw new NullPointerException("insets");

        return inset(insets.left, insets.top, insets.right, insets.bottom);
    }

    public WindowInsets inset(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        if (left < 0 || top < 0 || right < 0 || bottom < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("insets must be non-negative");

        Insets[] typeInsets = new Insets[TYPE_COUNT];
        Insets[] typeMaxInsets = new Insets[TYPE_COUNT];

        for (int index = 0; index < TYPE_COUNT; index++)
        {
            typeInsets[index] = insetInsets(mTypeInsets[index], left, top, right, bottom);
            typeMaxInsets[index] = insetInsets(mTypeMaxInsets[index], left, top, right, bottom);
        }

        Rect privacy = null;
        if (mPrivacyIndicatorBounds != null)
        {
            privacy = new Rect(mPrivacyIndicatorBounds);
            privacy.offset(-left, -top);
        }

        int frameWidth = Math.max(0, mFrameWidth - left - right);
        int frameHeight = Math.max(0, mFrameHeight - top - bottom);

        return new WindowInsets(mSystemWindowInsetsConsumed ? null : typeInsets, mStableInsetsConsumed ? null : typeMaxInsets,
                                mTypeVisibility, mIsRound, mDisplayCutoutConsumed ? null : mDisplayCutout, mRoundedCorners, privacy,
                                frameWidth, frameHeight, mTypeBoundingRects, mTypeMaxBoundingRects, mSystemWindowInsetsConsumed,
                                mStableInsetsConsumed, mDisplayCutoutConsumed)
                   .shaped(mDisplayShape == null ? null : mDisplayShape.offset(-left, -top));
    }

    private WindowInsets shaped(DisplayShape shape)
    {
        mDisplayShape = shape;
        return this;
    }

    public DisplayShape getDisplayShape()
    {
        return mDisplayShape;
    }

    private static Insets insetInsets(Insets insets, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        return Insets.of(Math.max(0, insets.left - left), Math.max(0, insets.top - top), Math.max(0, insets.right - right),
                         Math.max(0, insets.bottom - bottom));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof WindowInsets)) return false;

        WindowInsets that = (WindowInsets)other;
        return mIsRound == that.mIsRound && mSystemWindowInsetsConsumed == that.mSystemWindowInsetsConsumed
               && mStableInsetsConsumed == that.mStableInsetsConsumed && mDisplayCutoutConsumed == that.mDisplayCutoutConsumed
               && Arrays.equals(mTypeInsets, that.mTypeInsets) && Arrays.equals(mTypeMaxInsets, that.mTypeMaxInsets)
               && Arrays.equals(mTypeVisibility, that.mTypeVisibility) && Objects.equals(mDisplayCutout, that.mDisplayCutout)
               && Arrays.equals(mRoundedCorners, that.mRoundedCorners) && Objects.equals(mPrivacyIndicatorBounds, that.mPrivacyIndicatorBounds)
               && mFrameWidth == that.mFrameWidth && mFrameHeight == that.mFrameHeight
               && Arrays.equals(mTypeBoundingRects, that.mTypeBoundingRects) && Arrays.equals(mTypeMaxBoundingRects, that.mTypeMaxBoundingRects);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(Arrays.hashCode(mTypeInsets), Arrays.hashCode(mTypeMaxInsets), Arrays.hashCode(mTypeVisibility), mIsRound,
                            mDisplayCutout, Arrays.hashCode(mRoundedCorners), mPrivacyIndicatorBounds, mFrameWidth, mFrameHeight,
                            mSystemWindowInsetsConsumed, mStableInsetsConsumed, mDisplayCutoutConsumed);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder("WindowInsets{");

        for (int index = 0; index < TYPE_COUNT; index++)
        {
            if (Insets.NONE.equals(mTypeInsets[index])) continue;
            builder.append(Type.toString(1 << index)).append('=').append(mTypeInsets[index]).append(' ');
        }

        if (mDisplayCutout != null) builder.append(mDisplayCutout).append(' ');
        if (mPrivacyIndicatorBounds != null) builder.append("privacyIndicatorBounds=").append(mPrivacyIndicatorBounds).append(' ');
        if (mIsRound) builder.append("round ");
        if (isConsumed()) builder.append("consumed ");

        return builder.append('}').toString();
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final Insets[] mTypeInsets;
        private final Insets[] mTypeMaxInsets;
        private final boolean[] mTypeVisibility;
        private boolean mSystemInsetsConsumed = true;
        private boolean mStableInsetsConsumed = true;
        private DisplayCutout mDisplayCutout;
        private final RoundedCorner[] mRoundedCorners;
        private Rect mPrivacyIndicatorBounds;
        private boolean mIsRound;
        private int mFrameWidth;
        private int mFrameHeight;
        private final List<Rect>[] mTypeBoundingRects;
        private final List<Rect>[] mTypeMaxBoundingRects;
        private DisplayShape mDisplayShape;

        public Builder()
        {
            mTypeInsets = filledInsets();
            mTypeMaxInsets = filledInsets();
            mTypeVisibility = new boolean[TYPE_COUNT];
            mRoundedCorners = new RoundedCorner[4];
            mTypeBoundingRects = copyRects(null);
            mTypeMaxBoundingRects = copyRects(null);
        }

        public Builder(WindowInsets insets)
        {
            mTypeInsets = insets.mTypeInsets.clone();
            mTypeMaxInsets = insets.mTypeMaxInsets.clone();
            mTypeVisibility = insets.mTypeVisibility.clone();
            mSystemInsetsConsumed = insets.mSystemWindowInsetsConsumed;
            mStableInsetsConsumed = insets.mStableInsetsConsumed;
            mDisplayCutout = insets.mDisplayCutout;
            mRoundedCorners = insets.mRoundedCorners.clone();
            mPrivacyIndicatorBounds = insets.mPrivacyIndicatorBounds;
            mIsRound = insets.mIsRound;
            mFrameWidth = insets.mFrameWidth;
            mFrameHeight = insets.mFrameHeight;
            mTypeBoundingRects = copyRects(insets.mTypeBoundingRects);
            mTypeMaxBoundingRects = copyRects(insets.mTypeMaxBoundingRects);
            mDisplayShape = insets.mDisplayShape;
        }

        @Deprecated
        public Builder setSystemWindowInsets(Insets systemWindowInsets)
        {
            if (systemWindowInsets == null) throw new NullPointerException("systemWindowInsets");

            Arrays.fill(mTypeInsets, Insets.NONE);
            mTypeInsets[0] = systemWindowInsets;
            mSystemInsetsConsumed = false;
            return this;
        }

        @Deprecated
        public Builder setSystemGestureInsets(Insets insets)
        {
            return setInsets(Type.systemGestures(), insets);
        }

        @Deprecated
        public Builder setMandatorySystemGestureInsets(Insets insets)
        {
            return setInsets(Type.mandatorySystemGestures(), insets);
        }

        @Deprecated
        public Builder setTappableElementInsets(Insets insets)
        {
            return setInsets(Type.tappableElement(), insets);
        }

        public Builder setInsets(int typeMask, Insets insets)
        {
            if (insets == null) throw new NullPointerException("insets");

            for (int index = 0; index < TYPE_COUNT; index++)
            {
                if ((typeMask & (1 << index)) != 0) mTypeInsets[index] = insets;
            }

            mSystemInsetsConsumed = false;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setInsetsIgnoringVisibility(int typeMask, Insets insets)
        {
            if (insets == null) throw new NullPointerException("insets");
            if ((typeMask & Type.ime()) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Maximum inset not available for IME");

            for (int index = 0; index < TYPE_COUNT; index++)
            {
                if ((typeMask & (1 << index)) != 0) mTypeMaxInsets[index] = insets;
            }

            mStableInsetsConsumed = false;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setVisible(int typeMask, boolean visible)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < TYPE_COUNT; index++)
            {
                if ((typeMask & (1 << index)) != 0) mTypeVisibility[index] = visible;
            }

            return this;
        }

        @Deprecated
        public Builder setStableInsets(Insets stableInsets)
        {
            if (stableInsets == null) throw new NullPointerException("stableInsets");

            Arrays.fill(mTypeMaxInsets, Insets.NONE);
            mTypeMaxInsets[0] = stableInsets;
            mStableInsetsConsumed = false;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setDisplayCutout(DisplayCutout displayCutout)
        {
            mDisplayCutout = displayCutout;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setRoundedCorner(int position, RoundedCorner roundedCorner)
        {
            if (position < RoundedCorner.POSITION_TOP_LEFT || position > RoundedCorner.POSITION_BOTTOM_LEFT) return this;

            mRoundedCorners[position] = roundedCorner;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setPrivacyIndicatorBounds(Rect bounds)
        {
            mPrivacyIndicatorBounds = bounds == null ? null : new Rect(bounds);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setBoundingRects(int typeMask, List<Rect> rects)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < TYPE_COUNT; index++)
            {
                if ((typeMask & (1 << index)) == 0) continue;
                mTypeBoundingRects[index] = rects == null ? new ArrayList<>() : new ArrayList<>(rects);
            }

            return this;
        }

        public Builder setBoundingRectsIgnoringVisibility(int typeMask, List<Rect> rects)
        {
            if ((typeMask & Type.ime()) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Maximum bounding rects not available for IME");

            for (int index = 0; index < TYPE_COUNT; index++)
            {
                if ((typeMask & (1 << index)) == 0) continue;
                mTypeMaxBoundingRects[index] = rects == null ? new ArrayList<>() : new ArrayList<>(rects);
            }

            return this;
        }

        public Builder setFrame(int width, int height)
        {
            mFrameWidth = width;
            mFrameHeight = height;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setRound(boolean round)
        {
            mIsRound = round;
            return this;
        }

        public WindowInsets build()
        {
            return new WindowInsets(mSystemInsetsConsumed ? null : mTypeInsets, mStableInsetsConsumed ? null : mTypeMaxInsets,
                                    mTypeVisibility, mIsRound, mDisplayCutout, mRoundedCorners, mPrivacyIndicatorBounds, mFrameWidth,
                                    mFrameHeight, mTypeBoundingRects, mTypeMaxBoundingRects, mSystemInsetsConsumed, mStableInsetsConsumed,
                                    mDisplayCutout == null).shaped(mDisplayShape);
        }

        public Builder setDisplayShape(DisplayShape displayShape)
        {
            mDisplayShape = displayShape;
            return this;
        }
    }

    public static final class Type
    {
        static String toString(int type)
        {
            switch (type)
            {
                case 1:
                    return "statusBars";
                case 1 << 1:
                    return "navigationBars";
                case 1 << 2:
                    return "captionBar";
                case 1 << 3:
                    return "ime";
                case 1 << 4:
                    return "systemGestures";
                case 1 << 5:
                    return "mandatorySystemGestures";
                case 1 << 6:
                    return "tappableElement";
                case 1 << 7:
                    return "displayCutout";
                default:
                    return "systemOverlays";
            }
        }

        public static int statusBars()
        {
            return 1;
        }

        public static int navigationBars()
        {
            return 1 << 1;
        }

        public static int captionBar()
        {
            return 1 << 2;
        }

        public static int ime()
        {
            return 1 << 3;
        }

        public static int systemGestures()
        {
            return 1 << 4;
        }

        public static int mandatorySystemGestures()
        {
            return 1 << 5;
        }

        public static int tappableElement()
        {
            return 1 << 6;
        }

        public static int displayCutout()
        {
            return 1 << 7;
        }

        public static int systemOverlays()
        {
            return 1 << 8;
        }

        public static int systemBars()
        {
            return statusBars() | navigationBars() | captionBar() | systemOverlays();
        }

        static int all()
        {
            return (1 << TYPE_COUNT) - 1;
        }

        private Type()
        {
        }
    }

    public static final class Side
    {
        public static final int LEFT = 1;
        public static final int TOP = 1 << 1;
        public static final int RIGHT = 1 << 2;
        public static final int BOTTOM = 1 << 3;

        public static int all()
        {
            return LEFT | TOP | RIGHT | BOTTOM;
        }

        private Side()
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view;

import android.graphics.Insets;

import java.util.List;

public final class WindowInsetsAnimation
{
    private final int mTypeMask;
    private final long mDurationMillis;
    private final Interpolator mInterpolator;

    private float mFraction;
    private float mAlpha = 1.0f;

    public WindowInsetsAnimation(int typeMask, Interpolator interpolator, long durationMillis)
    {
        mTypeMask = typeMask;
        mInterpolator = interpolator;
        mDurationMillis = durationMillis;
    }

    public int getTypeMask()
    {
        return mTypeMask;
    }

    public float getFraction()
    {
        return mFraction;
    }

    public void setFraction(float fraction)
    {
        mFraction = fraction;
    }

    public float getInterpolatedFraction()
    {
        return mInterpolator == null ? mFraction : mInterpolator.getInterpolation(mFraction);
    }

    public Interpolator getInterpolator()
    {
        return mInterpolator;
    }

    public long getDurationMillis()
    {
        return mDurationMillis;
    }

    public float getAlpha()
    {
        return mAlpha;
    }

    public void setAlpha(float alpha)
    {
        mAlpha = alpha;
    }

    public static final class Bounds
    {
        private final Insets mLowerBound;
        private final Insets mUpperBound;

        public Bounds(Insets lowerBound, Insets upperBound)
        {
            mLowerBound = lowerBound;
            mUpperBound = upperBound;
        }

        public Insets getLowerBound()
        {
            return mLowerBound;
        }

        public Insets getUpperBound()
        {
            return mUpperBound;
        }

        public Bounds inset(Insets insets)
        {
            return new Bounds(subtract(mLowerBound, insets), subtract(mUpperBound, insets));
        }

        private static Insets subtract(Insets source, Insets insets)
        {
            return Insets.of(Math.max(0, source.left - insets.left), Math.max(0, source.top - insets.top),
                             Math.max(0, source.right - insets.right), Math.max(0, source.bottom - insets.bottom));
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "Bounds{lower=" + mLowerBound + " upper=" + mUpperBound + "}";
        }
    }

    public abstract static class Callback
    {
        public static final int DISPATCH_MODE_STOP = 0;
        public static final int DISPATCH_MODE_CONTINUE_ON_SUBTREE = 1;

        private final int mDispatchMode;

        public Callback(int dispatchMode)
        {
            mDispatchMode = dispatchMode;
        }

        public final int getDispatchMode()
        {
            return mDispatchMode;
        }

        public void onPrepare(WindowInsetsAnimation animation)
        {
        }

        public Bounds onStart(WindowInsetsAnimation animation, Bounds bounds)
        {
            return bounds;
        }

        public abstract WindowInsets onProgress(WindowInsets insets, List<WindowInsetsAnimation> runningAnimations);

        public void onEnd(WindowInsetsAnimation animation)
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```java
        {
            return ((flags & FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE) == 0) != ((flags & FLAG_ALT_FOCUSABLE_IM) != 0);
        }

        public final int copyFrom(LayoutParams other)
        {
            int changes = 0;

            if (width != other.width || height != other.height) changes |= LAYOUT_CHANGED;
            width = other.width;
            height = other.height;

            if (x != other.x || y != other.y || gravity != other.gravity) changes |= LAYOUT_CHANGED;
            x = other.x;
            y = other.y;
            horizontalWeight = other.horizontalWeight;
            verticalWeight = other.verticalWeight;
            horizontalMargin = other.horizontalMargin;
            verticalMargin = other.verticalMargin;
            gravity = other.gravity;

            if (type != other.type) changes |= TYPE_CHANGED;
            type = other.type;

            if (flags != other.flags) changes |= FLAGS_CHANGED;
            flags = other.flags;

            if (format != other.format) changes |= FORMAT_CHANGED;
            format = other.format;

            if (windowAnimations != other.windowAnimations) changes |= ANIMATION_CHANGED;
            windowAnimations = other.windowAnimations;

            if (dimAmount != other.dimAmount) changes |= DIM_AMOUNT_CHANGED;
            dimAmount = other.dimAmount;

            if (alpha != other.alpha) changes |= ALPHA_CHANGED;
            alpha = other.alpha;

            if (softInputMode != other.softInputMode) changes |= SOFT_INPUT_MODE_CHANGED_FLAG;
            softInputMode = other.softInputMode;

            if (!mTitle.equals(other.mTitle)) changes |= TITLE_CHANGED;
            mTitle = other.mTitle;

            memoryType = other.memoryType;
            screenBrightness = other.screenBrightness;
            buttonBrightness = other.buttonBrightness;
            rotationAnimation = other.rotationAnimation;
            token = other.token != null ? other.token : token;
            packageName = other.packageName != null ? other.packageName : packageName;
            screenOrientation = other.screenOrientation;
            preferredRefreshRate = other.preferredRefreshRate;
            preferredDisplayModeId = other.preferredDisplayModeId;
            systemUiVisibility = other.systemUiVisibility;
            layoutInDisplayCutoutMode = other.layoutInDisplayCutoutMode;
            mFitInsetsTypes = other.mFitInsetsTypes;
            mFitInsetsSides = other.mFitInsetsSides;
            mFitInsetsIgnoringVisibility = other.mFitInsetsIgnoringVisibility;
            preferMinimalPostProcessing = other.preferMinimalPostProcessing;
            mColorMode = other.mColorMode;
            mDesiredHdrHeadroom = other.mDesiredHdrHeadroom;
            mBlurBehindRadius = other.mBlurBehindRadius;
            mWallpaperTouchEventsEnabled = other.mWallpaperTouchEventsEnabled;
            mCanPlayMoveAnimation = other.mCanPlayMoveAnimation;
            mFrameRateBoostOnTouch = other.mFrameRateBoostOnTouch;
            mFrameRatePowerSavingsBalanced = other.mFrameRatePowerSavingsBalanced;
            mHdrConversionEnabled = other.mHdrConversionEnabled;

            return changes;
        }
```

```java
package android.view;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class WindowManagerGlobal
{
    private static WindowManagerGlobal sDefaultWindowManager;

    private WindowManagerGlobal()
    {
    }

    public static WindowManagerGlobal getInstance()
    {
        synchronized (WindowManagerGlobal.class)
        {
            if (sDefaultWindowManager == null) sDefaultWindowManager = new WindowManagerGlobal();

            return sDefaultWindowManager;
        }
    }

    public static void initialize()
    {
        getInstance();
    }

    private static List<View> windowViews()
    {
        ViewRootImpl root = ViewRootImpl.active();
        return root == null ? new ArrayList<View>() : root.windowViews();
    }

    private static String nameOf(View view, int index)
    {
        ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = view.getLayoutParams();
        CharSequence title = params instanceof WindowManager.LayoutParams ? ((WindowManager.LayoutParams)params).getTitle() : null;

        String name = title == null || title.length() == 0 ? view.getClass().getName() : title.toString();
        return name + "/" + Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(view)) + "#" + index;
    }

    public String[] getViewRootNames()
    {
        List<View> views = windowViews();
        String[] names = new String[views.size()];

        for (int index = 0; index < names.length; index++)
        {
            names[index] = nameOf(views.get(index), index);
        }

        return names;
    }

    public View getRootView(String name)
    {
        List<View> views = windowViews();

        for (int index = 0; index < views.size(); index++)
        {
            if (nameOf(views.get(index), index).equals(name)) return views.get(index);
        }

        return null;
    }

    public ArrayList<View> getWindowViews()
    {
        return new ArrayList<>(windowViews());
    }

    public ArrayList<ViewRootImpl> getRootViews()
    {
        ArrayList<ViewRootImpl> roots = new ArrayList<>();
        ViewRootImpl root = ViewRootImpl.active();
        if (root != null) roots.add(root);
        return roots;
    }

    public ArrayList<WindowManager.LayoutParams> getWindowParams()
    {
        ViewRootImpl root = ViewRootImpl.active();
        return root == null ? new ArrayList<WindowManager.LayoutParams>() : new ArrayList<>(root.windowParams());
    }

    public void trimMemory(int level)
    {
    }

    public void setStoppedState(android.os.IBinder token, boolean stopped)
    {
    }

    public void closeAll(android.os.IBinder token, String who, String what)
    {
    }
}
```
