`java/android/view/WindowManagerImpl.java`:

```java
package android.view;

import android.content.Context;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public final class WindowManagerImpl implements WindowManager
{
    private final Context mContext;
    private final ArrayList<View> mViews = new ArrayList<>();

    public WindowManagerImpl(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
    }

    @Override
    public Display getDefaultDisplay()
    {
        if (mDisplay == null)
        {
            runtime.WindowBridge bridge = runtime.WindowBridge.get();
            int width = bridge == null ? 1280 : bridge.getWidth();
            int height = bridge == null ? 720 : bridge.getHeight();
            mDisplay = new Display(Display.DEFAULT_DISPLAY, "acl", width, height, densityDpi());
        }

        return mDisplay;
    }

    @Override
    public WindowMetrics getCurrentWindowMetrics()
    {
        ViewRootImpl root = ViewRootImpl.active();
        android.graphics.Rect bounds;
        WindowInsets insets;

        if (root != null)
        {
            bounds = new android.graphics.Rect(0, 0, root.getWindowWidth(), root.getWindowHeight());
            insets = root.getWindowInsets();
        }
        else
        {
            Display display = getDefaultDisplay();
            bounds = new android.graphics.Rect(0, 0, display.getWidth(), display.getHeight());
            insets = new WindowInsets.Builder().setFrame(bounds.width(), bounds.height()).build();
        }

        return new WindowMetrics(bounds, insets, densityDpi() / (float)android.util.DisplayMetrics.DENSITY_DEFAULT);
    }

    @Override
    public WindowMetrics getMaximumWindowMetrics()
    {
        WindowMetrics current = getCurrentWindowMetrics();
        Display display = getDefaultDisplay();

        android.graphics.Rect bounds = new android.graphics.Rect(current.getBounds());
        bounds.union(0, 0, display.getWidth(), display.getHeight());

        return new WindowMetrics(bounds, current.getWindowInsets(), current.getDensity());
    }

    public static final String DENSITY_SETTING = "density";

    private static int densityDpi()
    {
        String value = runtime.Settings.get(DENSITY_SETTING);

        if (value != null && !value.isEmpty())
        {
            try
            {
                int parsed = Integer.parseInt(value.trim());
                if (parsed > 0) return parsed;
            }
            catch (NumberFormatException ignored)
            {
            }
        }

        return android.util.DisplayMetrics.DENSITY_DEFAULT;
    }

    private Display mDisplay;

    public Context getContext()
    {
        return mContext;
    }

    private static WindowManager.LayoutParams windowParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams params)
    {
        if (!(params instanceof WindowManager.LayoutParams)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Params must be WindowManager.LayoutParams");

        return (WindowManager.LayoutParams)params;
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View view, ViewGroup.LayoutParams params)
    {
        if (view == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("view must not be null");
        if (mViews.contains(view)) throw new IllegalStateException("View has already been added to the window manager.");

        WindowManager.LayoutParams windowParams = windowParams(params);
        ViewRootImpl root = ViewRootImpl.active();

        mViews.add(view);

        if (root == null)
        {
            android.util.Log.w("WindowManager", "a " + view.getClass().getName() + " window was added before the activity had one, so it is not shown");
            view.setLayoutParams(windowParams);
            return;
        }

        root.addPanel(view, windowParams);
    }

    @Override
    public void updateViewLayout(View view, ViewGroup.LayoutParams params)
    {
        if (view == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("view must not be null");

        WindowManager.LayoutParams windowParams = windowParams(params);
        ViewRootImpl root = ViewRootImpl.active();

        if (root != null && root.hasPanel(view))
        {
            root.updatePanel(view, windowParams);
            return;
        }

        if (!mViews.contains(view)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("View not attached to window manager");

        view.setLayoutParams(windowParams);
        view.requestLayout();
    }

    @Override
    public void removeView(View view)
    {
        mViews.remove(view);

        ViewRootImpl root = ViewRootImpl.active();
        if (root != null) root.removePanel(view);
    }

    @Override
    public void removeViewImmediate(View view)
    {
        removeView(view);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view;

import android.graphics.Rect;

public final class WindowMetrics
{
    private final Rect mBounds;
    private final WindowInsets mWindowInsets;
    private final float mDensity;

    public WindowMetrics(Rect bounds, WindowInsets windowInsets)
    {
        this(bounds, windowInsets, 1.0f);
    }

    public WindowMetrics(Rect bounds, WindowInsets windowInsets, float density)
    {
        mBounds = bounds;
        mWindowInsets = windowInsets;
        mDensity = density;
    }

    public Rect getBounds()
    {
        return mBounds;
    }

    public WindowInsets getWindowInsets()
    {
        return mWindowInsets;
    }

    public float getDensity()
    {
        return mDensity;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "WindowMetrics{bounds=" + mBounds + ", windowInsets=" + mWindowInsets + ", density=" + mDensity + "}";
    }
}
```

```java
        mMovementGranularity = event.mMovementGranularity;

    {

    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mEventType);
        dest.writeInt(mMovementGranularity);
        dest.writeInt(mAction);
        dest.writeInt(mContentChangeTypes);
        android.text.TextUtils.writeToParcel(mPackageName, dest, flags);
        dest.writeLong(mEventTime);
        dest.writeInt(mWindowChangeTypes);
        dest.writeInt(mSpeechStateChangeTypes);
        writeRecordToParcel(dest, flags);

        dest.writeInt(mRecords.size());
        for (AccessibilityRecord record : mRecords) record.writeRecordToParcel(dest, flags);
    }

    public void initFromParcel(Parcel source)
    {
        mEventType = source.readInt();
        mMovementGranularity = source.readInt();
        mAction = source.readInt();
        mContentChangeTypes = source.readInt();
        mPackageName = android.text.TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
        mEventTime = source.readLong();
        mWindowChangeTypes = source.readInt();
        mSpeechStateChangeTypes = source.readInt();
        readRecordFromParcel(source);

        mRecords.clear();
        int count = source.readInt();
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            AccessibilityRecord record = new AccessibilityRecord();
            record.readRecordFromParcel(source);
            mRecords.add(record);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "AccessibilityEvent[type=" + mEventType + " " + super.toString() + "]";
    }
```

```java
package android.view.accessibility;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class AccessibilityManager
{
    public static final int FLAG_CONTENT_ICONS = 1;
    public static final int FLAG_CONTENT_TEXT = 2;
    public static final int FLAG_CONTENT_CONTROLS = 4;

    private static final int DEFAULT_FOCUS_STROKE_WIDTH = 4;
    private static final int DEFAULT_FOCUS_COLOR = 0xbf39b500;

    private static final AccessibilityManager INSTANCE = new AccessibilityManager();

    private final List<AccessibilityStateChangeListener> mStateListeners = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<TouchExplorationStateChangeListener> mTouchListeners = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<AccessibilityServicesStateChangeListener> mServicesListeners = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<AudioDescriptionRequestedChangeListener> mAudioDescriptionListeners = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<HighContrastTextStateChangeListener> mHighContrastListeners = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<AccessibilityRequestPreparer> mRequestPreparers = new ArrayList<>();

    private AccessibilityManager()
    {
    }

    public static AccessibilityManager getInstance()
    {
        return INSTANCE;
    }

    public static AccessibilityManager getInstance(android.content.Context context)
    {
        return INSTANCE;
    }

    public static boolean isAccessibilityButtonSupported()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isEnabled()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isTouchExplorationEnabled()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isHighTextContrastEnabled()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void sendAccessibilityEvent(AccessibilityEvent event)
    {
    }

    public void interrupt()
    {
    }

    public List<android.content.pm.ServiceInfo> getAccessibilityServiceList()
    {
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public List<Object> getEnabledAccessibilityServiceList(int feedbackTypeFlags)
    {
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public List<Object> getInstalledAccessibilityServiceList()
    {
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public boolean addAccessibilityStateChangeListener(AccessibilityStateChangeListener listener)
    {
        if (listener == null || mStateListeners.contains(listener)) return false;

        mStateListeners.add(listener);
        return true;
    }

    public void addAccessibilityStateChangeListener(AccessibilityStateChangeListener listener, android.os.Handler handler)
    {
        addAccessibilityStateChangeListener(listener);
    }

    public boolean removeAccessibilityStateChangeListener(AccessibilityStateChangeListener listener)
    {
        return mStateListeners.remove(listener);
    }

    public boolean addTouchExplorationStateChangeListener(TouchExplorationStateChangeListener listener)
    {
        if (listener == null || mTouchListeners.contains(listener)) return false;

        mTouchListeners.add(listener);
        return true;
    }

    public void addTouchExplorationStateChangeListener(TouchExplorationStateChangeListener listener, android.os.Handler handler)
    {
        addTouchExplorationStateChangeListener(listener);
    }

    public boolean removeTouchExplorationStateChangeListener(TouchExplorationStateChangeListener listener)
    {
        return mTouchListeners.remove(listener);
    }

    public void addAccessibilityServicesStateChangeListener(java.util.concurrent.Executor executor,
                                                            AccessibilityServicesStateChangeListener listener)
    {
        addAccessibilityServicesStateChangeListener(listener);
    }

    public void addAccessibilityServicesStateChangeListener(AccessibilityServicesStateChangeListener listener)
    {
        if (listener != null && !mServicesListeners.contains(listener)) mServicesListeners.add(listener);
    }

    public boolean removeAccessibilityServicesStateChangeListener(AccessibilityServicesStateChangeListener listener)
    {
        return mServicesListeners.remove(listener);
    }

    public boolean isRequestFromAccessibilityTool()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public int getRecommendedTimeoutMillis(int originalTimeout, int uiContentFlags)
    {
        return originalTimeout;
    }

    public int getAccessibilityFocusStrokeWidth()
    {
        return DEFAULT_FOCUS_STROKE_WIDTH;
    }

    public int getAccessibilityFocusColor()
    {
        return DEFAULT_FOCUS_COLOR;
    }

    public void addAudioDescriptionRequestedChangeListener(java.util.concurrent.Executor executor,
                                                           AudioDescriptionRequestedChangeListener listener)
    {
        if (listener != null && !mAudioDescriptionListeners.contains(listener)) mAudioDescriptionListeners.add(listener);
    }

    public boolean removeAudioDescriptionRequestedChangeListener(AudioDescriptionRequestedChangeListener listener)
    {
        return mAudioDescriptionListeners.remove(listener);
    }

    public boolean isAudioDescriptionRequested()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isHighContrastTextEnabled()
    {
        return isHighTextContrastEnabled();
    }

    public void addHighContrastTextStateChangeListener(java.util.concurrent.Executor executor, HighContrastTextStateChangeListener listener)
    {
        if (executor == null || listener == null) throw new NullPointerException();

        synchronized (mHighContrastListeners)
        {
            if (!mHighContrastListeners.contains(listener)) mHighContrastListeners.add(listener);
        }
    }

    public void removeHighContrastTextStateChangeListener(HighContrastTextStateChangeListener listener)
    {
        synchronized (mHighContrastListeners)
        {
            mHighContrastListeners.remove(listener);
        }
    }

    public void addAccessibilityRequestPreparer(AccessibilityRequestPreparer preparer)
    {
        if (preparer == null) return;

        synchronized (mRequestPreparers)
        {
            if (!mRequestPreparers.contains(preparer)) mRequestPreparers.add(preparer);
        }
    }

    public void removeAccessibilityRequestPreparer(AccessibilityRequestPreparer preparer)
    {
        synchronized (mRequestPreparers)
        {
            mRequestPreparers.remove(preparer);
        }
    }

    public interface HighContrastTextStateChangeListener
    {
        void onHighContrastTextStateChanged(boolean enabled);
    }

    public interface AccessibilityStateChangeListener
    {
        void onAccessibilityStateChanged(boolean enabled);
    }

    public interface TouchExplorationStateChangeListener
    {
        void onTouchExplorationStateChanged(boolean enabled);
    }

    public interface AccessibilityServicesStateChangeListener
    {
        void onAccessibilityServicesStateChanged(AccessibilityManager manager);
    }

    public interface AudioDescriptionRequestedChangeListener
    {
        void onAudioDescriptionRequestedChanged(boolean enabled);
    }
}
```

```java
    private static AccessibilityNodeInfo createInfo(View view, int virtualId)
    {
        if (view == null) return null;

        if (virtualId != UNDEFINED_ID)
        {
            AccessibilityNodeProvider provider = view.getAccessibilityNodeProvider();
            if (provider != null) return provider.createAccessibilityNodeInfo(virtualId);
            return null;
        }

        return view.createAccessibilityNodeInfo();
    }

    public int getChildCount()
    {
        return mChildViews.size();
    }

    public AccessibilityNodeInfo getChild(int index)
    {
        if (index < 0 || index >= mChildViews.size()) return null;

        return createInfo(mChildViews.get(index), mChildVirtualIds.get(index));
    }

    public void addChild(View root, int virtualDescendantId)
    {
        if (root == null) return;

        mChildViews.add(root);
        mChildVirtualIds.add(virtualDescendantId);
    }

    public boolean removeChild(View child)
    {
        return removeChild(child, UNDEFINED_ID);
    }

    public boolean removeChild(View root, int virtualDescendantId)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mChildViews.size(); index++)
        {
            if (mChildViews.get(index) != root || mChildVirtualIds.get(index) != virtualDescendantId) continue;

            mChildViews.remove(index);
            mChildVirtualIds.remove(index);
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public void addAction(int action)
    {
        mActionMask |= action;
    }

    public void addAction(AccessibilityAction action)
    {
        if (action == null) return;

        mActions.remove(action);
        mActions.add(action);

        if (Integer.bitCount(action.getId()) == 1 && action.getId() <= ACTION_SET_TEXT) mActionMask |= action.getId();
    }

    public void removeAction(int action)
    {
        mActionMask &= ~action;
    }

    public boolean removeAction(AccessibilityAction action)
    {
        if (action == null) return false;

        if (Integer.bitCount(action.getId()) == 1 && action.getId() <= ACTION_SET_TEXT) mActionMask &= ~action.getId();
        return mActions.remove(action);
    }

    public int getActions()
    {
        int mask = mActionMask;

        for (AccessibilityAction action : mActions)
        {
            if (Integer.bitCount(action.getId()) == 1 && action.getId() <= ACTION_SET_TEXT) mask |= action.getId();
        }

        return mask;
    }

    public List<AccessibilityAction> getActionList()
    {
        ArrayList<AccessibilityAction> list = new ArrayList<>(mActions);

        for (int bit = 0; bit < 32; bit++)
        {
            int id = 1 << bit;
            if ((mActionMask & id) == 0) continue;

            AccessibilityAction action = new AccessibilityAction(id, null);
            if (!list.contains(action)) list.add(action);
        }

        return list;
    }

        mMinDurationBetweenContentChanges = duration == null ? java.time.Duration.ZERO : duration;
    }

    public java.time.Duration getMinDurationBetweenContentChanges()
    {
        return mMinDurationBetweenContentChanges;
    }

    public boolean performAction(int action)
    {
        return performAction(action, null);
    }

    public boolean performAction(int action, Bundle arguments)
    {
        if (mSource == null) return false;

        if (mVirtualDescendantId != UNDEFINED_ID)
        {
            AccessibilityNodeProvider provider = mSource.getAccessibilityNodeProvider();
            return provider != null && provider.performAction(mVirtualDescendantId, action, arguments);
        }

        return mSource.performAccessibilityAction(action, arguments);
    }

    public List<AccessibilityNodeInfo> findAccessibilityNodeInfosByText(String text)
    {
        ArrayList<AccessibilityNodeInfo> result = new ArrayList<>();
        if (mSource == null || text == null) return result;

        ArrayList<View> found = new ArrayList<>();
        mSource.findViewsWithText(found, text, FIND_VIEWS_WITH_TEXT | FIND_VIEWS_WITH_CONTENT_DESCRIPTION);

        for (View view : found)
        {
            AccessibilityNodeInfo info = createInfo(view, UNDEFINED_ID);
            if (info != null) result.add(info);
        }

        return result;
    }

    public List<AccessibilityNodeInfo> findAccessibilityNodeInfosByViewId(String viewId)
    {
        ArrayList<AccessibilityNodeInfo> result = new ArrayList<>();
        if (mSource == null || viewId == null) return result;

        int id = mSource.getResources().getIdentifier(viewId, null, null);
        if (id == 0) return result;

        View view = mSource.findViewById(id);
        AccessibilityNodeInfo info = createInfo(view, UNDEFINED_ID);
        if (info != null) result.add(info);

        return result;
    }

    public AccessibilityWindowInfo getWindow()
    {
        return null;
    }

    public AccessibilityNodeInfo getParent()
    {
        if (mParentView != null) return createInfo(mParentView, mParentVirtualId);
        if (mSource == null || mVirtualDescendantId != UNDEFINED_ID) return null;

        android.view.ViewParent parent = mSource.getParentForAccessibility();
        return parent instanceof View ? createInfo((View)parent, UNDEFINED_ID) : null;
    }

    private boolean getProperty(int property)
    {
        return (mBooleanProperties & property) != 0;
    }

    private void setProperty(int property, boolean value)
    {
        if (value) mBooleanProperties |= property;
        else mBooleanProperties &= ~property;
    }

    }

    public void addLabeledBy(View label)
    {
        addLabeledBy(label, UNDEFINED_ID);
    }

    public void addLabeledBy(View root, int virtualDescendantId)
    {
        if (root == null) return;

        if (mLabeledByView == null)
        {
            mLabeledByView = root;
            mLabeledByVirtualId = virtualDescendantId;
            return;
        }

        if (mLabeledByView == root && mLabeledByVirtualId == virtualDescendantId) return;

        for (int index = 0; index < mExtraLabeledByViews.size(); index++)
        {
            if (mExtraLabeledByViews.get(index) == root && mExtraLabeledByVirtualIds.get(index) == virtualDescendantId) return;
        }

        mExtraLabeledByViews.add(root);
        mExtraLabeledByVirtualIds.add(virtualDescendantId);
    }

    public boolean removeLabeledBy(View label)
    {
        return removeLabeledBy(label, UNDEFINED_ID);
    }

    public boolean removeLabeledBy(View root, int virtualDescendantId)
    {
        if (root == null) return false;

        if (mLabeledByView == root && mLabeledByVirtualId == virtualDescendantId)
        {
            if (mExtraLabeledByViews.isEmpty())
            {
                mLabeledByView = null;
                mLabeledByVirtualId = UNDEFINED_ID;
            }
            else
            {
                mLabeledByView = mExtraLabeledByViews.remove(0);
                mLabeledByVirtualId = mExtraLabeledByVirtualIds.remove(0);
            }

            return true;
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < mExtraLabeledByViews.size(); index++)
        {
            if (mExtraLabeledByViews.get(index) != root || mExtraLabeledByVirtualIds.get(index) != virtualDescendantId) continue;

            mExtraLabeledByViews.remove(index);
            mExtraLabeledByVirtualIds.remove(index);
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public java.util.List<AccessibilityNodeInfo> getLabeledByList()
    {
        java.util.ArrayList<AccessibilityNodeInfo> labels = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        if (mLabeledByView == null) return labels;

        AccessibilityNodeInfo first = createInfo(mLabeledByView, mLabeledByVirtualId);
        if (first != null) labels.add(first);

        for (int index = 0; index < mExtraLabeledByViews.size(); index++)
        {
            AccessibilityNodeInfo label = createInfo(mExtraLabeledByViews.get(index), mExtraLabeledByVirtualIds.get(index));
            if (label != null) labels.add(label);
        }

        return labels;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        parcel.writeString(mClassName == null ? null : mClassName.toString());
        parcel.writeString(mPackageName == null ? null : mPackageName.toString());
        parcel.writeString(mText == null ? null : mText.toString());
        parcel.writeString(mContentDescription == null ? null : mContentDescription.toString());
        parcel.writeInt(mBooleanProperties);
        parcel.writeInt(mActionMask);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof AccessibilityNodeInfo)) return false;

        AccessibilityNodeInfo info = (AccessibilityNodeInfo)other;
        return mSource != null && mSource == info.mSource && mVirtualDescendantId == info.mVirtualDescendantId;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return (mSource == null ? 0 : System.identityHashCode(mSource)) * 31 + mVirtualDescendantId;
    }

    @Override

    {
        return "AccessibilityNodeInfo{className=" + mClassName + ", text=" + mText + ", contentDescription=" + mContentDescription
               + ", viewId=" + mViewIdResourceName + ", boundsInScreen=" + mBoundsInScreen + "}";
    }

    public static final class CollectionInfo
    {

    public static final class TouchDelegateInfo implements Parcelable
    {
        public static final Parcelable.Creator<TouchDelegateInfo> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<TouchDelegateInfo>()
        {
            @Override
            public TouchDelegateInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                return new TouchDelegateInfo(new java.util.HashMap<Region, View>());
            }

            @Override
            public TouchDelegateInfo[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new TouchDelegateInfo[size];
            }
        };

        private final ArrayList<Region> mRegions = new ArrayList<>();
        private final ArrayList<View> mTargets = new ArrayList<>();

        public TouchDelegateInfo(Map<Region, View> targetMap)
        {
            if (targetMap == null) return;

            for (Map.Entry<Region, View> entry : targetMap.entrySet())
            {
                mRegions.add(entry.getKey());
                mTargets.add(entry.getValue());
            }
        }

        public int getRegionCount()
        {
            return mRegions.size();
        }

        public Region getRegionAt(int index)
        {
            return mRegions.get(index);
        }

        public AccessibilityNodeInfo getTargetForRegion(Region region)
        {
            int index = mRegions.indexOf(region);
            return index < 0 ? null : createInfo(mTargets.get(index), UNDEFINED_ID);
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class AccessibilityRecord
{
    private final List<CharSequence> mText = new ArrayList<>();

    void writeRecordToParcel(android.os.Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mSourceId);
        dest.writeInt(mChecked ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeInt(mEnabled ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeInt(mPassword ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeInt(mFullScreen ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeInt(mScrollable ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeInt(mItemCount);
        dest.writeInt(mCurrentItemIndex);
        dest.writeInt(mFromIndex);
        dest.writeInt(mToIndex);
        dest.writeInt(mScrollX);
        dest.writeInt(mScrollY);
        dest.writeInt(mScrollDeltaX);
        dest.writeInt(mScrollDeltaY);
        dest.writeInt(mMaxScrollX);
        dest.writeInt(mMaxScrollY);
        dest.writeInt(mAddedCount);
        dest.writeInt(mRemovedCount);
        android.text.TextUtils.writeToParcel(mClassName, dest, flags);
        android.text.TextUtils.writeToParcel(mContentDescription, dest, flags);
        android.text.TextUtils.writeToParcel(mBeforeText, dest, flags);
        dest.writeParcelable(mParcelableData, flags);
        dest.writeInt(mText.size());
        for (CharSequence text : mText) android.text.TextUtils.writeToParcel(text, dest, flags);
    }

    void readRecordFromParcel(android.os.Parcel source)
    {
        mSourceId = source.readInt();
        mChecked = source.readInt() != 0;
        mEnabled = source.readInt() != 0;
        mPassword = source.readInt() != 0;
        mFullScreen = source.readInt() != 0;
        mScrollable = source.readInt() != 0;
        mItemCount = source.readInt();
        mCurrentItemIndex = source.readInt();
        mFromIndex = source.readInt();
        mToIndex = source.readInt();
        mScrollX = source.readInt();
        mScrollY = source.readInt();
        mScrollDeltaX = source.readInt();
        mScrollDeltaY = source.readInt();
        mMaxScrollX = source.readInt();
        mMaxScrollY = source.readInt();
        mAddedCount = source.readInt();
        mRemovedCount = source.readInt();
        mClassName = android.text.TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
        mContentDescription = android.text.TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
        mBeforeText = android.text.TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
        mParcelableData = source.readParcelable(null);

        mText.clear();
        int count = source.readInt();
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) mText.add(android.text.TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source));
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "AccessibilityRecord[className=" + mClassName + " text=" + mText + "]";
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/accessibility/AccessibilityRequestPreparer.java`:

```java
package android.view.accessibility;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Message;
import android.view.View;

import java.lang.ref.WeakReference;

public abstract class AccessibilityRequestPreparer
{
    public static final int REQUEST_TYPE_EXTRA_DATA = 0x00000001;

    private final WeakReference<View> mViewRef;
    private final int mRequestTypes;

    public AccessibilityRequestPreparer(View view, int requestTypes)
    {
        if (!view.isAttachedToWindow()) throw new IllegalStateException("View must be attached to a window");

        mViewRef = new WeakReference<>(view);
        mRequestTypes = requestTypes;
    }

    public abstract void onPrepareExtraData(int virtualViewId, String extraDataKey, Bundle args, Message preparationFinishedMessage);

    public View getView()
    {
        return mViewRef.get();
    }

    int getRequestTypes()
    {
        return mRequestTypes;
    }
}
```

```java
    public static final int TYPE_MAGNIFICATION_OVERLAY = 6;
    public static final int TYPE_WINDOW_CONTROL = 7;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<AccessibilityWindowInfo> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<AccessibilityWindowInfo>()
    {

        {
            AccessibilityWindowInfo info = new AccessibilityWindowInfo();
            info.mType = source.readInt();
            info.mLayer = source.readInt();
            info.mId = source.readInt();
            info.mDisplayId = source.readInt();
            info.mTitle = source.readString();
            return info;
        }

    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mId;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof AccessibilityWindowInfo)) return false;

        return mId == ((AccessibilityWindowInfo)other).mId;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "AccessibilityWindowInfo[title=" + mTitle + ", id=" + mId + ", type=" + mType + ", layer=" + mLayer + ", bounds=" + mBounds
               + "]";
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

public class AccelerateInterpolator extends BaseInterpolator
{
    private final float mFactor;
    private final double mDoubledFactor;

    public AccelerateInterpolator()
    {
        this(1.0f);
    }

    public AccelerateInterpolator(float factor)
    {
        mFactor = factor;
        mDoubledFactor = 2.0 * factor;
    }

    public AccelerateInterpolator(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(new AnimationAttributes(context, attributes).getFloat("factor", 1.0f));
    }

    @Override
    public float getInterpolation(float input)
    {
        if (mFactor == 1.0f) return input * input;

        return (float)Math.pow(input, mDoubledFactor);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

public class AlphaAnimation extends Animation
{
    private float mFromAlpha;
    private float mToAlpha;

    public AlphaAnimation(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        AnimationAttributes values = new AnimationAttributes(context, attributes);
        mFromAlpha = values.getFloat("fromAlpha", 1.0f);
        mToAlpha = values.getFloat("toAlpha", 1.0f);
    }

    public AlphaAnimation(float fromAlpha, float toAlpha)
    {
        mFromAlpha = fromAlpha;
        mToAlpha = toAlpha;
    }

    @Override
    protected void applyTransformation(float interpolatedTime, Transformation transformation)
    {
        float alpha = mFromAlpha;
        transformation.setAlpha(alpha + ((mToAlpha - alpha) * interpolatedTime));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean willChangeTransformationMatrix()
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean willChangeBounds()
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasAlpha()
    {
        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.graphics.RectF;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

public abstract class Animation implements Cloneable
{
    public static final int INFINITE = -1;
    public static final int RESTART = 1;
    public static final int REVERSE = 2;
    public static final int START_ON_FIRST_FRAME = -1;
    public static final int ABSOLUTE = 0;
    public static final int RELATIVE_TO_SELF = 1;
    public static final int RELATIVE_TO_PARENT = 2;
    public static final int ZORDER_NORMAL = 0;
    public static final int ZORDER_TOP = 1;
    public static final int ZORDER_BOTTOM = -1;

    private static final String[] REPEAT_MODE_NAMES = {"restart", "reverse"};
    private static final int[] REPEAT_MODE_VALUES = {RESTART, REVERSE};
    private static final String[] Z_ADJUSTMENT_NAMES = {"normal", "top", "bottom"};
    private static final int[] Z_ADJUSTMENT_VALUES = {ZORDER_NORMAL, ZORDER_TOP, ZORDER_BOTTOM};

    boolean mEnded;
    boolean mStarted;
    boolean mCycleFlip;
    boolean mInitialized;
    boolean mFillBefore = true;
    boolean mFillAfter;
    boolean mFillEnabled;
    long mStartTime = -1;
    long mStartOffset;
    long mDuration;
    int mRepeatCount;
    int mRepeated;
    int mRepeatMode = RESTART;
    Interpolator mInterpolator;
    AnimationListener mListener;

    private int mZAdjustment;
    private int mBackgroundColor;
    private float mScaleFactor = 1.0f;
    private boolean mDetachWallpaper;
    private boolean mShowBackdrop;
    private int mBackdropColor;
    private boolean mMore = true;
    private boolean mOneMoreTime = true;

    RectF mPreviousRegion = new RectF();
    RectF mRegion = new RectF();
    Transformation mTransformation = new Transformation();
    Transformation mPreviousTransformation = new Transformation();

    public Animation()
    {
        ensureInterpolator();
    }

    public Animation(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        AnimationAttributes values = new AnimationAttributes(context, attributes);

        setDuration(values.getInt("duration", 0));
        setStartOffset(values.getInt("startOffset", 0));
        setFillEnabled(values.getBoolean("fillEnabled", mFillEnabled));
        setFillBefore(values.getBoolean("fillBefore", mFillBefore));
        setFillAfter(values.getBoolean("fillAfter", mFillAfter));
        setRepeatCount(values.getInt("repeatCount", mRepeatCount));
        setRepeatMode(values.getEnum("repeatMode", REPEAT_MODE_NAMES, REPEAT_MODE_VALUES, RESTART));
        setZAdjustment(values.getEnum("zAdjustment", Z_ADJUSTMENT_NAMES, Z_ADJUSTMENT_VALUES, ZORDER_NORMAL));
        setBackgroundColor(values.getColor("background", 0));
        setDetachWallpaper(values.getBoolean("detachWallpaper", false));
        setShowBackdrop(values.getBoolean("showBackdrop", false));
        setBackdropColor(values.getColor("backdropColor", 0));

        int interpolator = values.getResourceId("interpolator", 0);
        if (interpolator > 0) setInterpolator(context, interpolator);

        ensureInterpolator();
    }

    @Override
    protected Animation clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException
    {
        Animation animation = (Animation)super.clone();
        animation.mPreviousRegion = new RectF();
        animation.mRegion = new RectF();
        animation.mTransformation = new Transformation();
        animation.mPreviousTransformation = new Transformation();
        return animation;
    }

    public void reset()
    {
        mPreviousRegion.setEmpty();
        mPreviousTransformation.clear();
        mInitialized = false;
        mCycleFlip = false;
        mRepeated = 0;
        mMore = true;
        mOneMoreTime = true;
    }

    public void cancel()
    {
        if (mStarted && !mEnded)
        {
            fireAnimationEnd();
            mEnded = true;
        }

        mStartTime = Long.MIN_VALUE;
        mMore = false;
        mOneMoreTime = false;
    }

    public void detach()
    {
        if (mStarted && !mEnded)
        {
            mEnded = true;
            fireAnimationEnd();
        }
    }

    public boolean isInitialized()
    {
        return mInitialized;
    }

    public void initialize(int width, int height, int parentWidth, int parentHeight)
    {
        reset();
        mInitialized = true;
    }

    public void setInterpolator(Context context, int resourceId)
    {
        setInterpolator(AnimationUtils.loadInterpolator(context, resourceId));
    }

    public void setInterpolator(Interpolator interpolator)
    {
        mInterpolator = interpolator;
    }

    public void setStartOffset(long startOffset)
    {
        mStartOffset = startOffset;
    }

    public void setDuration(long durationMillis)
    {
        if (durationMillis < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Animation duration cannot be negative");

        mDuration = durationMillis;
    }

    public void restrictDuration(long durationMillis)
    {
        if (mStartOffset > durationMillis)
        {
            mStartOffset = durationMillis;
            mDuration = 0;
            mRepeatCount = 0;
            return;
        }

        long total = mDuration + mStartOffset;
        if (total > durationMillis)
        {
            mDuration = durationMillis - mStartOffset;
            total = durationMillis;
        }

        if (mDuration <= 0)
        {
            mDuration = 0;
            mRepeatCount = 0;
            return;
        }

        if (mRepeatCount < 0 || mRepeatCount > durationMillis || (total * mRepeatCount) > durationMillis)
        {
            mRepeatCount = (int)(durationMillis / total) - 1;
            if (mRepeatCount < 0) mRepeatCount = 0;
        }
    }

    public void scaleCurrentDuration(float scale)
    {
        mDuration = (long)(mDuration * scale);
        mStartOffset = (long)(mStartOffset * scale);
    }

    public void setStartTime(long startTimeMillis)
    {
        mStartTime = startTimeMillis;
        mStarted = false;
        mEnded = false;
        mCycleFlip = false;
        mRepeated = 0;
        mMore = true;
    }

    public void start()
    {
        setStartTime(-1);
    }

    public void startNow()
    {
        setStartTime(AnimationUtils.currentAnimationTimeMillis());
    }

    public void setRepeatMode(int repeatMode)
    {
        mRepeatMode = repeatMode;
    }

    public void setRepeatCount(int repeatCount)
    {
        if (repeatCount < 0) repeatCount = INFINITE;

        mRepeatCount = repeatCount;
    }

    public boolean isFillEnabled()
    {
        return mFillEnabled;
    }

    public void setFillEnabled(boolean fillEnabled)
    {
        mFillEnabled = fillEnabled;
    }

    public void setFillBefore(boolean fillBefore)

        mFillBefore = fillBefore;
    }

    public void setFillAfter(boolean fillAfter)
    {
        mFillAfter = fillAfter;
    }

    public void setZAdjustment(int zAdjustment)
    {
        mZAdjustment = zAdjustment;
    }

    public void setBackgroundColor(int backgroundColor)
    {
        mBackgroundColor = backgroundColor;
    }

    protected float getScaleFactor()
    {
        return mScaleFactor;
    }

    public void setDetachWallpaper(boolean detachWallpaper)
    {
        mDetachWallpaper = detachWallpaper;
    }

    public void setShowBackdrop(boolean showBackdrop)
    {
        mShowBackdrop = showBackdrop;
    }

    public void setBackdropColor(int backdropColor)
    {
        mBackdropColor = backdropColor;
    }

    public Interpolator getInterpolator()
    {
        return mInterpolator;
    }

    public long getStartTime()
    {
        return mStartTime;
    }

    public long getDuration()
    {
        return mDuration;
    }

    public long getStartOffset()
    {
        return mStartOffset;
    }

    public int getRepeatMode()
    {
        return mRepeatMode;
    }

    public int getRepeatCount()
    {
        return mRepeatCount;
    }

    public boolean getFillBefore()
    {
        return mFillBefore;
    }

    public boolean getFillAfter()
    {
        return mFillAfter;
    }

    public int getZAdjustment()
    {
        return mZAdjustment;
    }

    public int getBackgroundColor()
    {
        return mBackgroundColor;
    }

    public boolean getDetachWallpaper()
    {
        return mDetachWallpaper;
    }

    public boolean getShowBackdrop()
    {
        return mShowBackdrop;
    }

    public int getBackdropColor()
    {
        return mBackdropColor;
    }

    public boolean willChangeTransformationMatrix()
    {
        return true;
    }

    public boolean willChangeBounds()
    {
        return true;
    }

    public boolean hasAlpha()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void setAnimationListener(AnimationListener listener)
    {
        mListener = listener;
    }

    public AnimationListener getAnimationListener()
    {
        return mListener;
    }

    protected void ensureInterpolator()
    {
        if (mInterpolator == null) mInterpolator = new AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator();
    }

    public long computeDurationHint()
    {
        return (getStartOffset() + getDuration()) * (getRepeatCount() + 1);
    }

    private boolean isCanceled()
    {
        return mStartTime == Long.MIN_VALUE;
    }

    public boolean getTransformation(long currentTime, Transformation outTransformation)
    {
        if (mStartTime == -1) mStartTime = currentTime;

        long startOffset = getStartOffset();
        long duration = mDuration;
        float normalizedTime;

        if (duration != 0) normalizedTime = ((float)(currentTime - (mStartTime + startOffset))) / (float)duration;
        else normalizedTime = currentTime < mStartTime ? 0.0f : 1.0f;

        boolean expired = normalizedTime >= 1.0f || isCanceled();
        mMore = !expired;

        if (!mFillEnabled) normalizedTime = Math.max(Math.min(normalizedTime, 1.0f), 0.0f);

        if ((normalizedTime >= 0.0f || mFillBefore) && (normalizedTime <= 1.0f || mFillAfter))
        {
            if (!mStarted)
            {
                fireAnimationStart();
                mStarted = true;
            }

            if (mFillEnabled) normalizedTime = Math.max(Math.min(normalizedTime, 1.0f), 0.0f);
            if (mCycleFlip) normalizedTime = 1.0f - normalizedTime;

            getTransformationAt(normalizedTime, outTransformation);
        }

        if (expired)
        {
            if (mRepeatCount == mRepeated || isCanceled())
            {
                if (!mEnded)
                {
                    mEnded = true;
                    fireAnimationEnd();
                }
            }
            else
            {
                if (mRepeatCount > 0) mRepeated++;
                if (mRepeatMode == REVERSE) mCycleFlip = !mCycleFlip;

                mStartTime = -1;
                mMore = true;

                fireAnimationRepeat();
            }
        }

        if (!mMore && mOneMoreTime)
        {
            mOneMoreTime = false;
            return true;
        }

        return mMore;
    }

    public boolean getTransformation(long currentTime, Transformation outTransformation, float scale)
    {
        mScaleFactor = scale;
        return getTransformation(currentTime, outTransformation);
    }

    public void getTransformationAt(float normalizedTime, Transformation outTransformation)
    {
        ensureInterpolator();

        float interpolatedTime = mInterpolator.getInterpolation(normalizedTime);
        applyTransformation(interpolatedTime, outTransformation);
    }

    void fireAnimationStart()
    {
        if (mListener != null) mListener.onAnimationStart(this);
    }

    void fireAnimationRepeat()
    {
        if (mListener != null) mListener.onAnimationRepeat(this);
    }

    void fireAnimationEnd()
    {
        if (mListener != null) mListener.onAnimationEnd(this);
    }

    public boolean hasStarted()
    {
        return mStarted;
    }

    public boolean hasEnded()
    {
        return mEnded;
    }

    protected void applyTransformation(float interpolatedTime, Transformation transformation)
    {
    }

    protected float resolveSize(int type, float value, int size, int parentSize)
    {
        switch (type)
        {
            case ABSOLUTE:
                return value;
            case RELATIVE_TO_SELF:
                return size * value;
            case RELATIVE_TO_PARENT:
                return parentSize * value;
            default:
                return value;
        }
    }

    public void getInvalidateRegion(int left, int top, int right, int bottom, RectF invalidate, Transformation transformation)
    {
        RectF tempRegion = mRegion;
        RectF previousRegion = mPreviousRegion;

        invalidate.set(left, top, right, bottom);
        transformation.getMatrix().mapRect(invalidate);
        invalidate.inset(-1.0f, -1.0f);
        tempRegion.set(invalidate);
        invalidate.union(previousRegion);

        previousRegion.set(tempRegion);

        Transformation tempTransformation = mTransformation;
        Transformation previousTransformation = mPreviousTransformation;

        tempTransformation.set(transformation);
        transformation.set(previousTransformation);
        previousTransformation.set(tempTransformation);
    }

    public void initializeInvalidateRegion(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        RectF region = mPreviousRegion;
        region.set(left, top, right, bottom);
        region.inset(-1.0f, -1.0f);

        if (mFillBefore)
        {
            Transformation previousTransformation = mPreviousTransformation;
            applyTransformation(mInterpolator.getInterpolation(0.0f), previousTransformation);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void finalize() throws Throwable
    {
        super.finalize();
    }

    public static class Description
    {
        public int type;
        public float value;

        protected Description()
        {
        }
    }

    public interface AnimationListener
    {
        void onAnimationStart(Animation animation);

        void onAnimationEnd(Animation animation);

        void onAnimationRepeat(Animation animation);
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/animation/AnimationAttributes.java`:

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.content.res.XmlBlock;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.util.TypedValue;

final class AnimationAttributes
{
    private final Context mContext;
    private final AttributeSet mAttributes;

    AnimationAttributes(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        mContext = context;
        mAttributes = attributes;
    }

    Context getContext()
    {
        return mContext;
    }

    private int indexOf(String name)
    {
        if (mAttributes == null) return -1;

        int count = mAttributes.getAttributeCount();
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            String attribute = mAttributes.getAttributeName(index);
            if (attribute == null) continue;

            int colon = attribute.indexOf(':');
            if (colon >= 0) attribute = attribute.substring(colon + 1);

            if (attribute.equals(name)) return index;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    boolean has(String name)
    {
        return indexOf(name) >= 0;
    }

    TypedValue getValue(String name)
    {
        int index = indexOf(name);
        if (index < 0) return null;

        TypedValue value = new TypedValue();

        if (mAttributes instanceof XmlBlock.Parser)
        {
            int[] packed = ((XmlBlock.Parser)mAttributes).getAttributeTypedValue(index);
            if (packed != null)
            {
                value.type = packed[0];
                value.data = packed[1];

                if (value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING) value.string = mAttributes.getAttributeValue(index);

                return resolve(value);
            }
        }

        return parse(mAttributes.getAttributeValue(index));
    }

    private TypedValue resolve(TypedValue value)
    {
        Resources resources = mContext == null ? null : mContext.getResources();

        for (int depth = 0; depth < 8 && value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_REFERENCE && resources != null; depth++)
        {
            int resourceId = value.data;
            if (resourceId == 0) return value;

            TypedValue resolved = new TypedValue();
            try
            {
                resources.getValue(resourceId, resolved, true);
            }
            catch (RuntimeException failure)
            {
                return value;
            }

            if (resolved.resourceId == 0) resolved.resourceId = resourceId;
            value = resolved;
        }

        return value;
    }

    static TypedValue parse(String text)
    {
        if (text == null) return null;

        String trimmed = text.trim();
        TypedValue value = new TypedValue();

        if (trimmed.startsWith("@"))
        {
            value.type = TypedValue.TYPE_STRING;
            value.string = trimmed;
            return value;
        }

        if (trimmed.equals("true") || trimmed.equals("false"))
        {
            value.type = TypedValue.TYPE_INT_BOOLEAN;
            value.data = trimmed.equals("true") ? 1 : 0;
            return value;
        }

        try
        {
            if (trimmed.endsWith("%p"))
            {
                value.type = TypedValue.TYPE_FRACTION;
                value.data = encodeFraction(Float.parseFloat(trimmed.substring(0, trimmed.length() - 2)) / 100.0f,
                                            TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_FRACTION_PARENT);
                return value;
            }

            if (trimmed.endsWith("%"))
            {
                value.type = TypedValue.TYPE_FRACTION;
                value.data = encodeFraction(Float.parseFloat(trimmed.substring(0, trimmed.length() - 1)) / 100.0f,
                                            TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_FRACTION);
                return value;
            }

            if (trimmed.startsWith("0x") || trimmed.startsWith("0X"))
            {
                value.type = TypedValue.TYPE_INT_HEX;
                value.data = (int)Long.parseLong(trimmed.substring(2), 16);
                return value;
            }

            String numeric = trimmed;
            if (numeric.endsWith("dip")) numeric = numeric.substring(0, numeric.length() - 3);
            else if (numeric.endsWith("px")) numeric = numeric.substring(0, numeric.length() - 2);
            else if (numeric.endsWith("dp") || numeric.endsWith("sp")) numeric = numeric.substring(0, numeric.length() - 2);

            if (numeric.indexOf('.') < 0 && numeric.indexOf('e') < 0 && numeric.indexOf('E') < 0)
            {
                value.type = TypedValue.TYPE_INT_DEC;
                value.data = Integer.parseInt(numeric);
                return value;
            }

            value.type = TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT;
            value.data = Float.floatToIntBits(Float.parseFloat(numeric));
            return value;
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException failure)
        {
            value.type = TypedValue.TYPE_STRING;
            value.string = trimmed;
            return value;
        }
    }

    private static int encodeFraction(float fraction, int unit)
    {
        float magnitude = Math.abs(fraction);
        int radix;
        int shift;

        if (magnitude < 1.0f)
        {
            radix = 3;
            shift = 23;
        }
        else if (magnitude < 256.0f)
        {
            radix = 2;
            shift = 15;
        }
        else if (magnitude < 65536.0f)
        {
            radix = 1;
            shift = 7;
        }
        else
        {
            radix = 0;
            shift = 0;
        }

        int mantissa = Math.round(fraction * (1 << shift));
        return ((mantissa & TypedValue.COMPLEX_MANTISSA_MASK) << TypedValue.COMPLEX_MANTISSA_SHIFT)
               | (radix << TypedValue.COMPLEX_RADIX_SHIFT) | unit;
    }

    float getFloat(String name, float fallback)
    {
        TypedValue value = getValue(name);
        if (value == null) return fallback;

        if (value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT) return value.getFloat();
        if (value.type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && value.type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return value.data;
        if (value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_DIMENSION) return value.getDimension(displayMetrics());
        if (value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_FRACTION) return TypedValue.complexToFloat(value.data);

        return fallback;
    }

    int getInt(String name, int fallback)
    {
        TypedValue value = getValue(name);
        if (value == null) return fallback;

        if (value.type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && value.type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return value.data;
        if (value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT) return (int)value.getFloat();

        return fallback;
    }

    boolean getBoolean(String name, boolean fallback)
    {
        TypedValue value = getValue(name);
        if (value == null) return fallback;

        if (value.type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && value.type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return value.data != 0;

        return fallback;
    }

    int getEnum(String name, String[] options, int[] values, int fallback)
    {
        int index = indexOf(name);
        if (index < 0) return fallback;

        TypedValue value = getValue(name);
        if (value != null && value.type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && value.type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return value.data;

        String text = mAttributes.getAttributeValue(index);
        if (text == null) return fallback;

        for (int option = 0; option < options.length; option++)
        {
            if (options[option].equals(text.trim())) return values[option];
        }

        return fallback;
    }

    int getColor(String name, int fallback)
    {
        TypedValue value = getValue(name);
        if (value == null) return fallback;

        if (value.type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && value.type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) return value.data;

        return fallback;
    }

    int getResourceId(String name, int fallback)
    {
        int index = indexOf(name);
        if (index < 0) return fallback;

        int resourceId = mAttributes.getAttributeResourceValue(index, 0);
        if (resourceId != 0) return resourceId;

        String text = mAttributes.getAttributeValue(index);
        if (text != null && text.startsWith("@"))
        {
            String reference = text.substring(1);

            try
            {
                return (int)Long.parseLong(reference);
            }
            catch (NumberFormatException failure)
            {
                if (mContext == null || mContext.getResources() == null) return fallback;

                int identifier = mContext.getResources().getIdentifier(reference, null, mContext.getPackageName());
                return identifier != 0 ? identifier : fallback;
            }
        }

        return fallback;
    }

    Animation.Description getDescription(String name)
    {
        Animation.Description description = new Animation.Description();
        TypedValue value = getValue(name);

        if (value == null)
        {
            description.type = Animation.ABSOLUTE;
            description.value = 0;
            return description;
        }

        if (value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_FRACTION)
        {
            description.type = (value.data & TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_MASK) == TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_FRACTION_PARENT
                                   ? Animation.RELATIVE_TO_PARENT : Animation.RELATIVE_TO_SELF;
            description.value = TypedValue.complexToFloat(value.data);
            return description;
        }

        description.type = Animation.ABSOLUTE;

        if (value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT) description.value = value.getFloat();
        else if (value.type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && value.type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT) description.value = value.data;
        else if (value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_DIMENSION) description.value = value.getDimension(displayMetrics());
        else description.value = 0;

        return description;
    }

    private android.util.DisplayMetrics displayMetrics()
    {
        if (mContext != null && mContext.getResources() != null && mContext.getResources().getDisplayMetrics() != null)
        {
            return mContext.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
        }

        android.util.DisplayMetrics metrics = new android.util.DisplayMetrics();
        metrics.density = 1.0f;
        metrics.scaledDensity = 1.0f;
        metrics.xdpi = 160.0f;
        return metrics;
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/animation/AnimationSet.java`:

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.RectF;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class AnimationSet extends Animation
{
    private static final int PROPERTY_FILL_AFTER_MASK = 0x1;
    private static final int PROPERTY_FILL_BEFORE_MASK = 0x2;
    private static final int PROPERTY_REPEAT_MODE_MASK = 0x4;
    private static final int PROPERTY_START_OFFSET_MASK = 0x8;
    private static final int PROPERTY_SHARE_INTERPOLATOR_MASK = 0x10;
    private static final int PROPERTY_DURATION_MASK = 0x20;
    private static final int PROPERTY_MORPH_MATRIX_MASK = 0x40;
    private static final int PROPERTY_CHANGE_BOUNDS_MASK = 0x80;

    private int mFlags = 0;
    private boolean mDirty = false;
    private boolean mHasAlpha = false;

    private ArrayList<Animation> mAnimations = new ArrayList<>();
    private Transformation mTempTransformation = new Transformation();
    private long mLastEnd = 0;
    private long[] mStoredOffsets = null;

    public AnimationSet(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        AnimationAttributes values = new AnimationAttributes(context, attributes);
        setFlag(PROPERTY_SHARE_INTERPOLATOR_MASK, values.getBoolean("shareInterpolator", true));
        init();

        if (values.has("duration")) mFlags |= PROPERTY_DURATION_MASK;
        if (values.has("fillBefore")) mFlags |= PROPERTY_FILL_BEFORE_MASK;
        if (values.has("fillAfter")) mFlags |= PROPERTY_FILL_AFTER_MASK;
        if (values.has("repeatMode")) mFlags |= PROPERTY_REPEAT_MODE_MASK;
        if (values.has("startOffset")) mFlags |= PROPERTY_START_OFFSET_MASK;
    }

    public AnimationSet(boolean shareInterpolator)
    {
        setFlag(PROPERTY_SHARE_INTERPOLATOR_MASK, shareInterpolator);
        init();
    }

    @Override
    protected AnimationSet clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException
    {
        AnimationSet animation = (AnimationSet)super.clone();
        animation.mTempTransformation = new Transformation();
        animation.mAnimations = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Animation child : mAnimations)
        {
            animation.mAnimations.add(child.clone());
        }

        if (mStoredOffsets != null) animation.mStoredOffsets = mStoredOffsets.clone();

        return animation;
    }

    private void setFlag(int mask, boolean value)
    {
        if (value) mFlags |= mask;
        else mFlags &= ~mask;
    }

    private void init()
    {
        mStartTime = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void setFillAfter(boolean fillAfter)
    {
        mFlags |= PROPERTY_FILL_AFTER_MASK;
        super.setFillAfter(fillAfter);
    }

    @Override
    public void setFillBefore(boolean fillBefore)
    {
        mFlags |= PROPERTY_FILL_BEFORE_MASK;
        super.setFillBefore(fillBefore);
    }

    @Override
    public void setRepeatMode(int repeatMode)
    {
        mFlags |= PROPERTY_REPEAT_MODE_MASK;
        super.setRepeatMode(repeatMode);
    }

    @Override
    public void setStartOffset(long startOffset)
    {
        mFlags |= PROPERTY_START_OFFSET_MASK;
        super.setStartOffset(startOffset);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasAlpha()
    {
        if (mDirty)
        {
            mDirty = false;
            mHasAlpha = false;

            for (Animation child : mAnimations)
            {
                if (!child.hasAlpha()) continue;

                mHasAlpha = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        return mHasAlpha;
    }

    @Override
    public void setDuration(long durationMillis)
    {
        mFlags |= PROPERTY_DURATION_MASK;
        super.setDuration(durationMillis);
        mLastEnd = mStartOffset + mDuration;
    }

    public void addAnimation(Animation animation)
    {
        mAnimations.add(animation);

        boolean noMatrix = (mFlags & PROPERTY_MORPH_MATRIX_MASK) == 0;
        if (noMatrix && animation.willChangeTransformationMatrix()) mFlags |= PROPERTY_MORPH_MATRIX_MASK;

        boolean changeBounds = (mFlags & PROPERTY_CHANGE_BOUNDS_MASK) == 0;
        if (changeBounds && animation.willChangeBounds()) mFlags |= PROPERTY_CHANGE_BOUNDS_MASK;

        if ((mFlags & PROPERTY_DURATION_MASK) == PROPERTY_DURATION_MASK)
        {
            mLastEnd = mStartOffset + mDuration;
        }
        else if (mAnimations.size() == 1)
        {
            mDuration = animation.getStartOffset() + animation.getDuration();
            mLastEnd = mStartOffset + mDuration;
        }
        else
        {
            mLastEnd = Math.max(mLastEnd, mStartOffset + animation.getStartOffset() + animation.getDuration());
            mDuration = mLastEnd - mStartOffset;
        }

        mDirty = true;
    }

    @Override
    public void setStartTime(long startTimeMillis)
    {
        super.setStartTime(startTimeMillis);

        for (Animation child : mAnimations)
        {
            child.setStartTime(startTimeMillis);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public long getStartTime()
    {
        long startTime = Long.MAX_VALUE;

        for (Animation child : mAnimations)
        {
            startTime = Math.min(startTime, child.getStartTime());
        }

        return startTime;
    }

    @Override
    public void restrictDuration(long durationMillis)
    {
        super.restrictDuration(durationMillis);

        for (Animation child : mAnimations)
        {
            child.restrictDuration(durationMillis);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public long getDuration()
    {
        if ((mFlags & PROPERTY_DURATION_MASK) == PROPERTY_DURATION_MASK) return mDuration;

        long duration = 0;
        for (Animation child : mAnimations)
        {
            duration = Math.max(duration, child.getDuration());
        }

        return duration;
    }

    @Override
    public long computeDurationHint()
    {
        long duration = 0;

        for (int index = mAnimations.size() - 1; index >= 0; --index)
        {
            long hint = mAnimations.get(index).computeDurationHint();
            if (hint > duration) duration = hint;
        }

        return duration;
    }

    @Override
    public void initializeInvalidateRegion(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        RectF region = mPreviousRegion;
        region.set(left, top, right, bottom);
        region.inset(-1.0f, -1.0f);

        if (!mFillBefore) return;

        Transformation temporary = mTempTransformation;
        Transformation previous = mPreviousTransformation;
        previous.clear();

        for (int index = mAnimations.size() - 1; index >= 0; --index)
        {
            Animation child = mAnimations.get(index);
            if (child.isFillEnabled() && !child.getFillBefore() && child.getStartOffset() != 0) continue;

            temporary.clear();
            Interpolator interpolator = child.mInterpolator;
            child.applyTransformation(interpolator != null ? interpolator.getInterpolation(0.0f) : 0.0f, temporary);
            previous.compose(temporary);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean getTransformation(long currentTime, Transformation transformation)
    {
        boolean more = false;
        boolean started = false;
        boolean ended = true;

        transformation.clear();

        Transformation temporary = mTempTransformation;

        for (int index = mAnimations.size() - 1; index >= 0; --index)
        {
            Animation child = mAnimations.get(index);

            temporary.clear();
            more = child.getTransformation(currentTime, temporary, getScaleFactor()) || more;
            transformation.compose(temporary);

            started = started || child.hasStarted();
            ended = child.hasEnded() && ended;
        }

        if (started && !mStarted)
        {
            fireAnimationStart();
            mStarted = true;
        }

        if (ended != mEnded)
        {
            fireAnimationEnd();
            mEnded = ended;
        }

        return more;
    }

    @Override
    public void scaleCurrentDuration(float scale)
    {
        for (Animation child : mAnimations)
        {
            child.scaleCurrentDuration(scale);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void initialize(int width, int height, int parentWidth, int parentHeight)
    {
        super.initialize(width, height, parentWidth, parentHeight);

        boolean durationSet = (mFlags & PROPERTY_DURATION_MASK) == PROPERTY_DURATION_MASK;
        boolean fillAfterSet = (mFlags & PROPERTY_FILL_AFTER_MASK) == PROPERTY_FILL_AFTER_MASK;
        boolean fillBeforeSet = (mFlags & PROPERTY_FILL_BEFORE_MASK) == PROPERTY_FILL_BEFORE_MASK;
        boolean repeatModeSet = (mFlags & PROPERTY_REPEAT_MODE_MASK) == PROPERTY_REPEAT_MODE_MASK;
        boolean shareInterpolator = (mFlags & PROPERTY_SHARE_INTERPOLATOR_MASK) == PROPERTY_SHARE_INTERPOLATOR_MASK;
        boolean startOffsetSet = (mFlags & PROPERTY_START_OFFSET_MASK) == PROPERTY_START_OFFSET_MASK;

        if (shareInterpolator) ensureInterpolator();

        int count = mAnimations.size();
        long[] storedOffsets = mStoredOffsets;

        if (startOffsetSet)
        {
            if (storedOffsets == null || storedOffsets.length != count)
            {
                storedOffsets = new long[count];
                mStoredOffsets = storedOffsets;
            }
        }
        else if (storedOffsets != null)
        {
            storedOffsets = null;
            mStoredOffsets = null;
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            Animation child = mAnimations.get(index);

            if (durationSet) child.setDuration(mDuration);
            if (fillAfterSet) child.setFillAfter(mFillAfter);
            if (fillBeforeSet) child.setFillBefore(mFillBefore);
            if (repeatModeSet) child.setRepeatMode(mRepeatMode);
            if (shareInterpolator) child.setInterpolator(mInterpolator);

            if (startOffsetSet)
            {
                long offset = child.getStartOffset();
                child.setStartOffset(offset + mStartOffset);
                storedOffsets[index] = offset;
            }

            child.initialize(width, height, parentWidth, parentHeight);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void reset()
    {
        super.reset();
        restoreChildrenStartOffset();
    }

    void restoreChildrenStartOffset()
    {
        long[] offsets = mStoredOffsets;
        if (offsets == null) return;

        int count = Math.min(offsets.length, mAnimations.size());
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            mAnimations.get(index).setStartOffset(offsets[index]);
        }
    }

    public List<Animation> getAnimations()
    {
        return mAnimations;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean willChangeTransformationMatrix()
    {
        return (mFlags & PROPERTY_MORPH_MATRIX_MASK) == PROPERTY_MORPH_MATRIX_MASK;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean willChangeBounds()
    {
        return (mFlags & PROPERTY_CHANGE_BOUNDS_MASK) == PROPERTY_CHANGE_BOUNDS_MASK;
    }
}
```
