`java/android/view/animation/AnimationUtils.java`:

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.content.res.XmlResourceParser;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.util.Log;
import android.util.Xml;

import org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser;

public class AnimationUtils
{
    private static final String TAG = "AnimationUtils";

    private static final int SHORT_ANIMATION_TIME = 200;
    private static final int MEDIUM_ANIMATION_TIME = 400;
    private static final int LONG_ANIMATION_TIME = 500;

    private static final int ANIM_FADE_IN = 0x010a0000;
    private static final int ANIM_FADE_OUT = 0x010a0001;
    private static final int ANIM_SLIDE_IN_LEFT = 0x010a0002;
    private static final int ANIM_SLIDE_OUT_RIGHT = 0x010a0003;
    private static final int ANIM_ACCELERATE_DECELERATE_INTERPOLATOR = 0x010a0004;
    private static final int ANIM_ACCELERATE_INTERPOLATOR = 0x010a0005;
    private static final int ANIM_DECELERATE_INTERPOLATOR = 0x010a0006;
    private static final int ANIM_ANTICIPATE_INTERPOLATOR = 0x010a0007;
    private static final int ANIM_OVERSHOOT_INTERPOLATOR = 0x010a0008;
    private static final int ANIM_ANTICIPATE_OVERSHOOT_INTERPOLATOR = 0x010a0009;
    private static final int ANIM_BOUNCE_INTERPOLATOR = 0x010a000a;
    private static final int ANIM_LINEAR_INTERPOLATOR = 0x010a000b;
    private static final int ANIM_CYCLE_INTERPOLATOR = 0x010a000c;

    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_ACCELERATE_QUAD = 0x010c0000;
    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_DECELERATE_QUAD = 0x010c0001;
    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_ACCELERATE_CUBIC = 0x010c0002;
    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_DECELERATE_CUBIC = 0x010c0003;
    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_ACCELERATE_QUINT = 0x010c0004;
    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_DECELERATE_QUINT = 0x010c0005;
    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_ACCELERATE_DECELERATE = 0x010c0006;
    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_ANTICIPATE = 0x010c0007;
    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_OVERSHOOT = 0x010c0008;
    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_ANTICIPATE_OVERSHOOT = 0x010c0009;
    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_BOUNCE = 0x010c000a;
    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_LINEAR = 0x010c000b;
    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_CYCLE = 0x010c000c;
    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_FAST_OUT_SLOW_IN = 0x010c000d;
    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_LINEAR_OUT_SLOW_IN = 0x010c000e;
    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_FAST_OUT_LINEAR_IN = 0x010c000f;
    private static final int INTERPOLATOR_FAST_OUT_EXTRA_SLOW_IN = 0x010c001a;

    private static final String FAST_OUT_EXTRA_SLOW_IN_PATH =
        "M 0,0 C 0.05, 0, 0.133333, 0.06, 0.166666, 0.4 C 0.208333, 0.82, 0.25, 1, 1, 1";

    public AnimationUtils()
    {
    }

    public static long currentAnimationTimeMillis()
    {
        return android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
    }

    public static Animation loadAnimation(Context context, int id) throws Resources.NotFoundException
    {
        Animation builtin = frameworkAnimation(id);
        if (builtin != null) return builtin;

        XmlResourceParser parser = context.getResources().getXml(id);

        try
        {
            Animation animation = createAnimationFromXml(context, parser, null, Xml.asAttributeSet(parser));
            if (animation != null) return animation;

            Log.w(TAG, "animation resource 0x" + Integer.toHexString(id) + " is empty");
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "could not inflate animation 0x" + Integer.toHexString(id) + ": " + failure);
        }
        finally
        {
            parser.close();
        }

        AlphaAnimation fallback = new AlphaAnimation(1.0f, 1.0f);
        fallback.setDuration(0);
        return fallback;
    }

    private static Animation createAnimationFromXml(Context context, XmlPullParser parser, AnimationSet parent, AttributeSet attributes)
        throws Exception
    {
        Animation animation = null;

        int type;
        int depth = parser.getDepth();

        while (((type = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_TAG || parser.getDepth() > depth) && type != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (type != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            String name = parser.getName();

            if (name.equals("set"))
            {
                animation = new AnimationSet(context, attributes);
                createAnimationFromXml(context, parser, (AnimationSet)animation, attributes);
            }
            else if (name.equals("alpha"))
            {
                animation = new AlphaAnimation(context, attributes);
            }
            else if (name.equals("scale"))
            {
                animation = new ScaleAnimation(context, attributes);
            }
            else if (name.equals("rotate"))
            {
                animation = new RotateAnimation(context, attributes);
            }
            else if (name.equals("translate"))
            {
                animation = new TranslateAnimation(context, attributes);
            }
            else
            {
                Log.w(TAG, "unsupported animation element <" + name + ">, so it is skipped");
                animation = new AlphaAnimation(context, attributes);
            }

            if (parent != null) parent.addAnimation(animation);
        }

        return animation;
    }

    public static LayoutAnimationController loadLayoutAnimation(Context context, int id) throws Resources.NotFoundException
    {
        XmlResourceParser parser = context.getResources().getXml(id);

        try
        {
            LayoutAnimationController controller = createLayoutAnimationFromXml(context, parser, Xml.asAttributeSet(parser));
            if (controller != null) return controller;
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "could not inflate layout animation 0x" + Integer.toHexString(id) + ": " + failure);
        }
        finally
        {
            parser.close();
        }

        return new LayoutAnimationController(new AlphaAnimation(1.0f, 1.0f));
    }

    private static LayoutAnimationController createLayoutAnimationFromXml(Context context, XmlPullParser parser, AttributeSet attributes)
        throws Exception
    {
        LayoutAnimationController controller = null;

        int type;
        int depth = parser.getDepth();

        while (((type = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_TAG || parser.getDepth() > depth) && type != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (type != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            String name = parser.getName();

            if (name.equals("layoutAnimation")) controller = new LayoutAnimationController(context, attributes);
            else if (name.equals("gridLayoutAnimation")) controller = new GridLayoutAnimationController(context, attributes);
            else Log.w(TAG, "unknown layout animation element <" + name + ">");
        }

        return controller;
    }

    public static Animation makeInAnimation(Context context, boolean fromLeft)
    {
        Animation animation = slide(fromLeft ? -0.5f : 0.5f, 0.0f, true, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        animation.setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator());
        animation.setStartTime(currentAnimationTimeMillis());
        return animation;
    }

    public static Animation makeOutAnimation(Context context, boolean toRight)
    {
        Animation animation = slide(0.0f, toRight ? 0.5f : -0.5f, true, 1.0f, 0.0f);
        animation.setInterpolator(new AccelerateInterpolator());
        animation.setStartTime(currentAnimationTimeMillis());
        return animation;
    }

    public static Animation makeInChildBottomAnimation(Context context)
    {
        AnimationSet set = new AnimationSet(true);

        TranslateAnimation translate = new TranslateAnimation(Animation.ABSOLUTE, 0.0f, Animation.ABSOLUTE, 0.0f,
                                                              Animation.RELATIVE_TO_PARENT, 0.5f, Animation.ABSOLUTE, 0.0f);
        translate.setDuration(SHORT_ANIMATION_TIME);
        set.addAnimation(translate);

        AlphaAnimation alpha = new AlphaAnimation(0.0f, 1.0f);
        alpha.setDuration(SHORT_ANIMATION_TIME);
        set.addAnimation(alpha);

        set.setInterpolator(new AccelerateInterpolator());
        set.setStartTime(currentAnimationTimeMillis());
        return set;
    }

    private static Animation slide(float fromX, float toX, boolean withAlpha, float fromAlpha, float toAlpha)
    {
        AnimationSet set = new AnimationSet(true);

        TranslateAnimation translate = new TranslateAnimation(Animation.RELATIVE_TO_PARENT, fromX, Animation.RELATIVE_TO_PARENT, toX,
                                                              Animation.ABSOLUTE, 0.0f, Animation.ABSOLUTE, 0.0f);
        translate.setDuration(MEDIUM_ANIMATION_TIME);
        set.addAnimation(translate);

        if (withAlpha)
        {
            AlphaAnimation alpha = new AlphaAnimation(fromAlpha, toAlpha);
            alpha.setDuration(MEDIUM_ANIMATION_TIME);
            set.addAnimation(alpha);
        }

        return set;
    }

    private static Animation frameworkAnimation(int id)
    {
        switch (id)
        {
            case ANIM_FADE_IN:
            {
                AlphaAnimation animation = new AlphaAnimation(0.0f, 1.0f);
                animation.setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator());
                animation.setDuration(LONG_ANIMATION_TIME);
                return animation;
            }
            case ANIM_FADE_OUT:
            {
                AlphaAnimation animation = new AlphaAnimation(1.0f, 0.0f);
                animation.setInterpolator(new AccelerateInterpolator());
                animation.setDuration(LONG_ANIMATION_TIME);
                return animation;
            }
            case ANIM_SLIDE_IN_LEFT:
                return slide(-0.5f, 0.0f, true, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            case ANIM_SLIDE_OUT_RIGHT:
                return slide(0.0f, 0.5f, true, 1.0f, 0.0f);
            default:
                return null;
        }
    }

    private static Interpolator frameworkInterpolator(int id)
    {
        switch (id)
        {
            case ANIM_LINEAR_INTERPOLATOR:
            case INTERPOLATOR_LINEAR:
                return new LinearInterpolator();
            case ANIM_ACCELERATE_INTERPOLATOR:
            case INTERPOLATOR_ACCELERATE_QUAD:
                return new AccelerateInterpolator();
            case ANIM_DECELERATE_INTERPOLATOR:
            case INTERPOLATOR_DECELERATE_QUAD:
                return new DecelerateInterpolator();
            case INTERPOLATOR_ACCELERATE_CUBIC:
                return new AccelerateInterpolator(1.5f);
            case INTERPOLATOR_DECELERATE_CUBIC:
                return new DecelerateInterpolator(1.5f);
            case INTERPOLATOR_ACCELERATE_QUINT:
                return new AccelerateInterpolator(2.5f);
            case INTERPOLATOR_DECELERATE_QUINT:
                return new DecelerateInterpolator(2.5f);
            case ANIM_ACCELERATE_DECELERATE_INTERPOLATOR:
            case INTERPOLATOR_ACCELERATE_DECELERATE:
                return new AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator();
            case ANIM_ANTICIPATE_INTERPOLATOR:
            case INTERPOLATOR_ANTICIPATE:
                return new AnticipateInterpolator();
            case ANIM_OVERSHOOT_INTERPOLATOR:
            case INTERPOLATOR_OVERSHOOT:
                return new OvershootInterpolator();
            case ANIM_ANTICIPATE_OVERSHOOT_INTERPOLATOR:
            case INTERPOLATOR_ANTICIPATE_OVERSHOOT:
                return new AnticipateOvershootInterpolator();
            case ANIM_BOUNCE_INTERPOLATOR:
            case INTERPOLATOR_BOUNCE:
                return new BounceInterpolator();
            case ANIM_CYCLE_INTERPOLATOR:
            case INTERPOLATOR_CYCLE:
                return new CycleInterpolator(1.0f);
            case INTERPOLATOR_FAST_OUT_SLOW_IN:
                return new PathInterpolator(0.4f, 0.0f, 0.2f, 1.0f);
            case INTERPOLATOR_LINEAR_OUT_SLOW_IN:
                return new PathInterpolator(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.2f, 1.0f);
            case INTERPOLATOR_FAST_OUT_LINEAR_IN:
                return new PathInterpolator(0.4f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
            case INTERPOLATOR_FAST_OUT_EXTRA_SLOW_IN:
                return new PathInterpolator(FAST_OUT_EXTRA_SLOW_IN_PATH);
            default:
                return null;
        }
    }

    public static Interpolator loadInterpolator(Context context, int id) throws Resources.NotFoundException
    {
        return loadInterpolator(context, context.getResources(), context.getTheme(), id);
    }

    public static Interpolator loadInterpolator(Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme, int id) throws Resources.NotFoundException
    {
        return loadInterpolator(null, resources, theme, id);
    }

    private static Interpolator loadInterpolator(Context context, Resources resources, Resources.Theme theme, int id)
        throws Resources.NotFoundException
    {
        Interpolator builtin = frameworkInterpolator(id);
        if (builtin != null) return builtin;

        XmlResourceParser parser = resources.getXml(id);

        try
        {
            Interpolator interpolator = createInterpolatorFromXml(context, parser);
            if (interpolator != null) return interpolator;

            Log.w(TAG, "interpolator resource 0x" + Integer.toHexString(id) + " is empty");
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "could not inflate interpolator 0x" + Integer.toHexString(id) + ": " + failure);
        }
        finally
        {
            parser.close();
        }

        return new LinearInterpolator();
    }

    private static Interpolator createInterpolatorFromXml(Context context, XmlPullParser parser) throws Exception
    {
        Interpolator interpolator = null;

        int type;
        int depth = parser.getDepth();

        while (((type = parser.next()) != XmlPullParser.END_TAG || parser.getDepth() > depth) && type != XmlPullParser.END_DOCUMENT)
        {
            if (type != XmlPullParser.START_TAG) continue;

            AttributeSet attributes = Xml.asAttributeSet(parser);
            String name = parser.getName();

            if (name.equals("linearInterpolator"))
            {
                interpolator = new LinearInterpolator();
            }
            else if (name.equals("accelerateInterpolator"))
            {
                interpolator = new AccelerateInterpolator(context, attributes);
            }
            else if (name.equals("decelerateInterpolator"))
            {
                interpolator = new DecelerateInterpolator(context, attributes);
            }
            else if (name.equals("accelerateDecelerateInterpolator"))
            {
                interpolator = new AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator();
            }
            else if (name.equals("cycleInterpolator"))
            {
                interpolator = new CycleInterpolator(context, attributes);
            }
            else if (name.equals("anticipateInterpolator"))
            {
                interpolator = new AnticipateInterpolator(context, attributes);
            }
            else if (name.equals("overshootInterpolator"))
            {
                interpolator = new OvershootInterpolator(context, attributes);
            }
            else if (name.equals("anticipateOvershootInterpolator"))
            {
                interpolator = new AnticipateOvershootInterpolator(context, attributes);
            }
            else if (name.equals("bounceInterpolator"))
            {
                interpolator = new BounceInterpolator();
            }
            else if (name.equals("pathInterpolator"))
            {
                interpolator = new PathInterpolator(context, attributes);
            }
            else
            {
                Log.w(TAG, "unknown interpolator element <" + name + ">, so it falls back to linear");
                interpolator = new LinearInterpolator();
            }
        }

        return interpolator;
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/animation/AnticipateInterpolator.java`:

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

public class AnticipateInterpolator extends BaseInterpolator
{
    private final float mTension;

    public AnticipateInterpolator()
    {
        this(2.0f);
    }

    public AnticipateInterpolator(float tension)
    {
        mTension = tension;
    }

    public AnticipateInterpolator(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(new AnimationAttributes(context, attributes).getFloat("tension", 2.0f));
    }

    @Override
    public float getInterpolation(float input)
    {
        return input * input * ((mTension + 1.0f) * input - mTension);
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/animation/AnticipateOvershootInterpolator.java`:

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

public class AnticipateOvershootInterpolator extends BaseInterpolator
{
    private final float mTension;

    public AnticipateOvershootInterpolator()
    {
        mTension = 2.0f * 1.5f;
    }

    public AnticipateOvershootInterpolator(float tension)
    {
        mTension = tension * 1.5f;
    }

    public AnticipateOvershootInterpolator(float tension, float extraTension)
    {
        mTension = tension * extraTension;
    }

    public AnticipateOvershootInterpolator(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        AnimationAttributes values = new AnimationAttributes(context, attributes);
        mTension = values.getFloat("tension", 2.0f) * values.getFloat("extraTension", 1.5f);
    }

    private static float anticipate(float time, float tension)
    {
        return time * time * ((tension + 1) * time - tension);
    }

    private static float overshoot(float time, float tension)
    {
        return time * time * ((tension + 1) * time + tension);
    }

    @Override
    public float getInterpolation(float input)
    {
        if (input < 0.5f) return 0.5f * anticipate(input * 2.0f, mTension);

        return 0.5f * (overshoot(input * 2.0f - 2.0f, mTension) + 2.0f);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

public class BounceInterpolator extends BaseInterpolator
{
    public BounceInterpolator()
    {
    }

    public BounceInterpolator(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
    }

    private static float bounce(float time)
    {
        return time * time * 8.0f;
    }

    @Override
    public float getInterpolation(float input)
    {
        float time = input * 1.1226f;

        if (time < 0.3535f) return bounce(time);
        if (time < 0.7408f) return bounce(time - 0.54719f) + 0.7f;
        if (time < 0.9644f) return bounce(time - 0.8526f) + 0.9f;

        return bounce(time - 1.0435f) + 0.95f;
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

public class DecelerateInterpolator extends BaseInterpolator
{
    private final float mFactor;

    public DecelerateInterpolator()
    {
        this(1.0f);
    }

    public DecelerateInterpolator(float factor)
    {
        mFactor = factor;
    }

    public DecelerateInterpolator(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(new AnimationAttributes(context, attributes).getFloat("factor", 1.0f));
    }

    @Override
    public float getInterpolation(float input)
    {
        if (mFactor == 1.0f) return 1.0f - (1.0f - input) * (1.0f - input);

        return (float)(1.0 - Math.pow(1.0 - input, 2.0 * mFactor));
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/animation/GridLayoutAnimationController.java`:

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.View;

import java.util.Random;

public class GridLayoutAnimationController extends LayoutAnimationController
{
    public static final int DIRECTION_LEFT_TO_RIGHT = 0x0;
    public static final int DIRECTION_RIGHT_TO_LEFT = 0x1;
    public static final int DIRECTION_TOP_TO_BOTTOM = 0x0;
    public static final int DIRECTION_BOTTOM_TO_TOP = 0x2;
    public static final int DIRECTION_HORIZONTAL_MASK = 0x1;
    public static final int DIRECTION_VERTICAL_MASK = 0x2;
    public static final int PRIORITY_NONE = 0;
    public static final int PRIORITY_COLUMN = 1;
    public static final int PRIORITY_ROW = 2;

    private static final String[] PRIORITY_NAMES = {"none", "column", "row"};
    private static final int[] PRIORITY_VALUES = {PRIORITY_NONE, PRIORITY_COLUMN, PRIORITY_ROW};

    private float mColumnDelay;
    private float mRowDelay;
    private int mDirection;
    private int mDirectionPriority;

    public GridLayoutAnimationController(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        AnimationAttributes values = new AnimationAttributes(context, attributes);
        mColumnDelay = values.getDescription("columnDelay").value;
        mRowDelay = values.getDescription("rowDelay").value;
        mDirection = parseDirection(attributes, values);
        mDirectionPriority = values.getEnum("directionPriority", PRIORITY_NAMES, PRIORITY_VALUES, PRIORITY_NONE);
    }

    public GridLayoutAnimationController(Animation animation)
    {
        this(animation, 0.5f, 0.5f);
    }

    public GridLayoutAnimationController(Animation animation, float columnDelay, float rowDelay)
    {
        super(animation);
        mColumnDelay = columnDelay;
        mRowDelay = rowDelay;
    }

    private static int parseDirection(AttributeSet attributes, AnimationAttributes values)
    {
        if (!values.has("direction")) return DIRECTION_LEFT_TO_RIGHT | DIRECTION_TOP_TO_BOTTOM;

        int numeric = values.getInt("direction", -1);
        if (numeric >= 0) return numeric;

        String text = attributes.getAttributeValue(null, "direction");
        if (text == null) return DIRECTION_LEFT_TO_RIGHT | DIRECTION_TOP_TO_BOTTOM;

        int direction = 0;
        for (String part : text.split("\\|"))
        {
            String flag = part.trim();
            if (flag.equals("right_to_left")) direction |= DIRECTION_RIGHT_TO_LEFT;
            else if (flag.equals("bottom_to_top")) direction |= DIRECTION_BOTTOM_TO_TOP;
        }

        return direction;
    }

    public float getColumnDelay()
    {
        return mColumnDelay;
    }

    public void setColumnDelay(float columnDelay)
    {
        mColumnDelay = columnDelay;
    }

    public float getRowDelay()
    {
        return mRowDelay;
    }

    public void setRowDelay(float rowDelay)
    {
        mRowDelay = rowDelay;
    }

    public int getDirection()
    {
        return mDirection;
    }

    public void setDirection(int direction)
    {
        mDirection = direction;
    }

    public int getDirectionPriority()
    {
        return mDirectionPriority;
    }

    public void setDirectionPriority(int directionPriority)
    {
        mDirectionPriority = directionPriority;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean willOverlap()
    {
        return mColumnDelay < 1.0f || mRowDelay < 1.0f;
    }

    @Override
    protected long getDelayForView(View view)
    {
        LayoutAnimationController.AnimationParameters base = parametersOf(view);
        if (!(base instanceof AnimationParameters) || mAnimation == null) return 0;

        AnimationParameters parameters = (AnimationParameters)base;

        int column = getTransformedColumnIndex(parameters);
        int row = getTransformedRowIndex(parameters);

        int rowsCount = parameters.rowsCount;
        int columnsCount = parameters.columnsCount;

        long duration = mAnimation.getDuration();
        float columnDelay = mColumnDelay * duration;
        float rowDelay = mRowDelay * duration;

        float totalDelay;
        long viewDelay;

        if (mInterpolator == null) mInterpolator = new LinearInterpolator();

        switch (mDirectionPriority)
        {
            case PRIORITY_COLUMN:
                viewDelay = (long)(row * rowDelay + column * rowsCount * rowDelay);
                totalDelay = rowsCount * rowDelay + columnsCount * rowsCount * rowDelay;
                break;
            case PRIORITY_ROW:
                viewDelay = (long)(column * columnDelay + row * columnsCount * columnDelay);
                totalDelay = columnsCount * columnDelay + rowsCount * columnsCount * columnDelay;
                break;
            case PRIORITY_NONE:
            default:
                viewDelay = (long)(column * columnDelay + row * rowDelay);
                totalDelay = columnsCount * columnDelay + rowsCount * rowDelay;
                break;
        }

        if (totalDelay == 0) return 0;

        float normalizedDelay = viewDelay / totalDelay;
        normalizedDelay = mInterpolator.getInterpolation(normalizedDelay);

        return (long)(normalizedDelay * totalDelay);
    }

    private int getTransformedColumnIndex(AnimationParameters parameters)
    {
        int index;

        switch (getOrder())
        {
            case ORDER_REVERSE:
                index = parameters.columnsCount - 1 - parameters.column;
                break;
            case ORDER_RANDOM:
                if (mRandomizer == null) mRandomizer = new Random();
                index = (int)(parameters.columnsCount * mRandomizer.nextFloat());
                break;
            case ORDER_NORMAL:
            default:
                index = parameters.column;
                break;
        }

        if ((mDirection & DIRECTION_HORIZONTAL_MASK) == DIRECTION_RIGHT_TO_LEFT) index = parameters.columnsCount - 1 - index;

        return index;
    }

    private int getTransformedRowIndex(AnimationParameters parameters)
    {
        int index;

        switch (getOrder())
        {
            case ORDER_REVERSE:
                index = parameters.rowsCount - 1 - parameters.row;
                break;
            case ORDER_RANDOM:
                if (mRandomizer == null) mRandomizer = new Random();
                index = (int)(parameters.rowsCount * mRandomizer.nextFloat());
                break;
            case ORDER_NORMAL:
            default:
                index = parameters.row;
                break;
        }

        if ((mDirection & DIRECTION_VERTICAL_MASK) == DIRECTION_BOTTOM_TO_TOP) index = parameters.rowsCount - 1 - index;

        return index;
    }

    public static class AnimationParameters extends LayoutAnimationController.AnimationParameters
    {
        public int column;
        public int row;
        public int columnsCount;
        public int rowsCount;

        public AnimationParameters()
        {
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/animation/LayoutAnimationController.java`:

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

import java.util.Random;

public class LayoutAnimationController
{
    public static final int ORDER_NORMAL = 0;
    public static final int ORDER_REVERSE = 1;
    public static final int ORDER_RANDOM = 2;

    private static final String[] ORDER_NAMES = {"normal", "reverse", "random"};
    private static final int[] ORDER_VALUES = {ORDER_NORMAL, ORDER_REVERSE, ORDER_RANDOM};

    private static java.lang.reflect.Field sParametersField;
    private static boolean sParametersFieldResolved;

    protected Animation mAnimation;
    protected Random mRandomizer;
    protected Interpolator mInterpolator;

    private float mDelay;
    private int mOrder;
    private long mDuration;
    private long mMaxDelay;

    public LayoutAnimationController(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        AnimationAttributes values = new AnimationAttributes(context, attributes);

        mDelay = values.getDescription("delay").value;
        mOrder = values.getEnum("animationOrder", ORDER_NAMES, ORDER_VALUES, ORDER_NORMAL);

        int animation = values.getResourceId("animation", 0);
        if (animation > 0) setAnimation(context, animation);

        int interpolator = values.getResourceId("interpolator", 0);
        if (interpolator > 0) setInterpolator(context, interpolator);
    }

    public LayoutAnimationController(Animation animation)
    {
        this(animation, 0.5f);
    }

    public LayoutAnimationController(Animation animation, float delay)
    {
        mDelay = delay;
        setAnimation(animation);
    }

    public int getOrder()
    {
        return mOrder;
    }

    public void setOrder(int order)
    {
        mOrder = order;
    }

    public void setAnimation(Context context, int resourceId)
    {
        setAnimation(AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(context, resourceId));
    }

    public void setAnimation(Animation animation)
    {
        mAnimation = animation;
        if (mAnimation != null) mAnimation.setFillBefore(true);
    }

    public Animation getAnimation()
    {
        return mAnimation;
    }

    public void setInterpolator(Context context, int resourceId)
    {
        setInterpolator(AnimationUtils.loadInterpolator(context, resourceId));
    }

    public void setInterpolator(Interpolator interpolator)
    {
        mInterpolator = interpolator;
    }

    public Interpolator getInterpolator()
    {
        return mInterpolator;
    }

    public float getDelay()
    {
        return mDelay;
    }

    public void setDelay(float delay)
    {
        mDelay = delay;
    }

    public boolean willOverlap()
    {
        return mDelay < 1.0f;
    }

    public void start()
    {
        if (mAnimation == null) return;

        mDuration = mAnimation.getDuration();
        mMaxDelay = Long.MIN_VALUE;
        mAnimation.setStartTime(-1);
    }

    public final Animation getAnimationForView(View view)
    {
        if (mAnimation == null) return null;

        long delay = getDelayForView(view) + mAnimation.getStartOffset();
        mMaxDelay = Math.max(mMaxDelay, delay);

        try
        {
            Animation animation = mAnimation.clone();
            animation.setStartOffset(delay);
            return animation;
        }
        catch (CloneNotSupportedException failure)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public boolean isDone()
    {
        if (mAnimation == null) return true;

        return AnimationUtils.currentAnimationTimeMillis() > mAnimation.getStartTime() + mMaxDelay + mDuration;
    }

    protected long getDelayForView(View view)
    {
        AnimationParameters parameters = parametersOf(view);
        if (parameters == null || mAnimation == null) return 0;

        float delay = mDelay * mAnimation.getDuration();
        long viewDelay = (long)(getTransformedIndex(parameters) * delay);
        float totalDelay = delay * parameters.count;
        if (totalDelay == 0) return 0;

        if (mInterpolator == null) mInterpolator = new LinearInterpolator();

        float normalizedDelay = viewDelay / totalDelay;
        normalizedDelay = mInterpolator.getInterpolation(normalizedDelay);

        return (long)(normalizedDelay * totalDelay);
    }

    protected int getTransformedIndex(AnimationParameters parameters)
    {
        switch (getOrder())
        {
            case ORDER_REVERSE:
                return parameters.count - 1 - parameters.index;
            case ORDER_RANDOM:
                if (mRandomizer == null) mRandomizer = new Random();
                return (int)(parameters.count * mRandomizer.nextFloat());
            case ORDER_NORMAL:
            default:
                return parameters.index;
        }
    }

    static AnimationParameters parametersOf(View view)
    {
        if (view == null) return null;

        ViewGroup.LayoutParams layoutParams = view.getLayoutParams();
        if (layoutParams == null) return null;

        if (!sParametersFieldResolved)
        {
            sParametersFieldResolved = true;

            try
            {
                sParametersField = ViewGroup.LayoutParams.class.getField("layoutAnimationParameters");
            }
            catch (NoSuchFieldException failure)
            {
                sParametersField = null;
            }
        }

        if (sParametersField == null) return null;

        try
        {
            Object value = sParametersField.get(layoutParams);
            return value instanceof AnimationParameters ? (AnimationParameters)value : null;
        }
        catch (IllegalAccessException failure)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static class AnimationParameters
    {
        public int count;
        public int index;

        public AnimationParameters()
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

public class OvershootInterpolator extends BaseInterpolator
{
    private final float mTension;

    public OvershootInterpolator()
    {
        this(2.0f);
    }

    public OvershootInterpolator(float tension)
    {
        mTension = tension;
    }

    public OvershootInterpolator(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)

    }
```

`java/android/view/animation/PathInterpolator.java`:

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

import java.util.ArrayList;

public class PathInterpolator extends BaseInterpolator
{
    private static final int SAMPLE_COUNT = 201;
    private static final int SEGMENT_SAMPLES = 64;

    private float[] mX = new float[SAMPLE_COUNT];
    private float[] mY = new float[SAMPLE_COUNT];

    public PathInterpolator(float controlX, float controlY)
    {
        sampleQuadratic(controlX, controlY);
    }

    public PathInterpolator(float firstX, float firstY, float secondX, float secondY)
    {
        sampleCubic(firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY);
    }

    public PathInterpolator(Path path)
    {
        sampleCubic(0.4f, 0.0f, 0.2f, 1.0f);
    }

    PathInterpolator(String pathData)
    {
        if (!samplePathData(pathData)) sampleCubic(0.4f, 0.0f, 0.2f, 1.0f);
    }

    public PathInterpolator(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        AnimationAttributes values = new AnimationAttributes(context, attributes);

        if (values.has("pathData"))
        {
            String data = attributes.getAttributeValue(null, "pathData");
            if (data != null && samplePathData(data)) return;
        }

        float firstX = values.getFloat("controlX1", 0.0f);
        float firstY = values.getFloat("controlY1", 0.0f);

        if (values.has("controlX2") || values.has("controlY2"))
        {
            sampleCubic(firstX, firstY, values.getFloat("controlX2", 1.0f), values.getFloat("controlY2", 1.0f));
            return;
        }

        sampleQuadratic(firstX, firstY);
    }

    private boolean samplePathData(String data)
    {
        ArrayList<float[]> points = new ArrayList<>();
        float[] numbers = new float[6];

        float currentX = 0;
        float currentY = 0;
        char command = 0;
        int position = 0;
        int length = data.length();

        try
        {
            while (position < length)
            {
                char character = data.charAt(position);

                if (Character.isWhitespace(character) || character == ',')
                {
                    position++;
                    continue;
                }

                if (Character.isLetter(character) && character != 'e' && character != 'E')
                {
                    command = character;
                    position++;
                    continue;
                }

                int needed = argumentCount(command);
                if (needed == 0) return false;

                for (int index = 0; index < needed; index++)
                {
                    while (position < length && (Character.isWhitespace(data.charAt(position)) || data.charAt(position) == ',')) position++;

                    int start = position;
                    if (position < length && (data.charAt(position) == '-' || data.charAt(position) == '+')) position++;

                    while (position < length)
                    {
                        char digit = data.charAt(position);
                        boolean exponentSign = (digit == '-' || digit == '+') && position > start
                                               && (data.charAt(position - 1) == 'e' || data.charAt(position - 1) == 'E');

                        if (Character.isDigit(digit) || digit == '.' || digit == 'e' || digit == 'E' || exponentSign) position++;
                        else break;
                    }

                    numbers[index] = Float.parseFloat(data.substring(start, position));
                }

                boolean relative = Character.isLowerCase(command);
                float baseX = relative ? currentX : 0;
                float baseY = relative ? currentY : 0;
                char upper = Character.toUpperCase(command);

                if (upper == 'M')
                {
                    currentX = baseX + numbers[0];
                    currentY = baseY + numbers[1];
                    if (points.isEmpty()) points.add(new float[] {currentX, currentY});
                    command = relative ? 'l' : 'L';
                }
                else if (upper == 'L')
                {
                    float endX = baseX + numbers[0];
                    float endY = baseY + numbers[1];
                    if (points.isEmpty()) points.add(new float[] {currentX, currentY});
                    points.add(new float[] {endX, endY});
                    currentX = endX;
                    currentY = endY;
                }
                else if (upper == 'C')
                {
                    if (points.isEmpty()) points.add(new float[] {currentX, currentY});

                    float firstX = baseX + numbers[0];
                    float firstY = baseY + numbers[1];
                    float secondX = baseX + numbers[2];
                    float secondY = baseY + numbers[3];
                    float endX = baseX + numbers[4];
                    float endY = baseY + numbers[5];

                    for (int step = 1; step <= SEGMENT_SAMPLES; step++)
                    {
                        float t = step / (float)SEGMENT_SAMPLES;
                        points.add(new float[] {cubic(t, currentX, firstX, secondX, endX), cubic(t, currentY, firstY, secondY, endY)});
                    }

                    currentX = endX;
                    currentY = endY;
                }
                else if (upper == 'Q')
                {
                    if (points.isEmpty()) points.add(new float[] {currentX, currentY});

                    float controlX = baseX + numbers[0];
                    float controlY = baseY + numbers[1];
                    float endX = baseX + numbers[2];
                    float endY = baseY + numbers[3];

                    for (int step = 1; step <= SEGMENT_SAMPLES; step++)
                    {
                        float t = step / (float)SEGMENT_SAMPLES;
                        float inverse = 1 - t;
                        points.add(new float[] {inverse * inverse * currentX + 2 * inverse * t * controlX + t * t * endX,
                                                inverse * inverse * currentY + 2 * inverse * t * controlY + t * t * endY});
                    }

                    currentX = endX;
                    currentY = endY;
                }
                else
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        catch (RuntimeException failure)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (points.size() < 2) return false;

        float[] first = points.get(0);
        float[] last = points.get(points.size() - 1);
        if (Math.abs(first[0]) > 0.01f || Math.abs(first[1]) > 0.01f || Math.abs(last[0] - 1) > 0.01f || Math.abs(last[1] - 1) > 0.01f)
        {
            return false;
        }

        int count = points.size();
        mX = new float[count];
        mY = new float[count];

        float previousX = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            float[] point = points.get(index);
            previousX = Math.max(previousX, point[0]);
            mX[index] = previousX;
            mY[index] = point[1];
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static int argumentCount(char command)
    {
        switch (Character.toUpperCase(command))
        {
            case 'M':
            case 'L':
                return 2;
            case 'Q':
                return 4;
            case 'C':
                return 6;
            default:
                return 0;
        }
    }

    private void sampleQuadratic(float controlX, float controlY)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < SAMPLE_COUNT; index++)
        {
            float t = index / (float)(SAMPLE_COUNT - 1);
            float inverse = 1 - t;

            mX[index] = 2 * inverse * t * controlX + t * t;
            mY[index] = 2 * inverse * t * controlY + t * t;
        }
    }

    private void sampleCubic(float firstX, float firstY, float secondX, float secondY)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < SAMPLE_COUNT; index++)
        {
            float t = index / (float)(SAMPLE_COUNT - 1);

            mX[index] = cubic(t, 0, firstX, secondX, 1);
            mY[index] = cubic(t, 0, firstY, secondY, 1);
        }
    }

    private static float cubic(float t, float p0, float p1, float p2, float p3)
    {
        float inverse = 1 - t;

        return inverse * inverse * inverse * p0
                   + 3 * inverse * inverse * t * p1
                   + 3 * inverse * t * t * p2
                   + t * t * t * p3;
    }

    @Override
    public float getInterpolation(float input)
    {
        if (input <= 0) return 0;
        if (input >= 1) return 1;

        int low = 0;
        int high = mX.length - 1;

        while (high - low > 1)
        {
            int middle = (low + high) / 2;

            if (mX[middle] <= input) low = middle;
            else high = middle;
        }

        float span = mX[high] - mX[low];
        if (span == 0) return mY[low];

        float fraction = (input - mX[low]) / span;

        return mY[low] + fraction * (mY[high] - mY[low]);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

public class RotateAnimation extends Animation
{
    private float mFromDegrees;
    private float mToDegrees;

    private int mPivotXType = ABSOLUTE;
    private int mPivotYType = ABSOLUTE;
    private float mPivotXValue = 0.0f;
    private float mPivotYValue = 0.0f;

    private float mPivotX;
    private float mPivotY;

    public RotateAnimation(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        AnimationAttributes values = new AnimationAttributes(context, attributes);
        mFromDegrees = values.getFloat("fromDegrees", 0.0f);
        mToDegrees = values.getFloat("toDegrees", 0.0f);

        Description description = values.getDescription("pivotX");
        mPivotXType = description.type;
        mPivotXValue = description.value;

        description = values.getDescription("pivotY");
        mPivotYType = description.type;
        mPivotYValue = description.value;

        initializePivotPoint();
    }

    public RotateAnimation(float fromDegrees, float toDegrees)
    {
        mFromDegrees = fromDegrees;
        mToDegrees = toDegrees;
        mPivotX = 0.0f;
        mPivotY = 0.0f;
    }

    public RotateAnimation(float fromDegrees, float toDegrees, float pivotX, float pivotY)
    {
        mFromDegrees = fromDegrees;
        mToDegrees = toDegrees;

        mPivotXType = ABSOLUTE;
        mPivotYType = ABSOLUTE;
        mPivotXValue = pivotX;
        mPivotYValue = pivotY;
        initializePivotPoint();
    }

    public RotateAnimation(float fromDegrees, float toDegrees, int pivotXType, float pivotXValue, int pivotYType, float pivotYValue)
    {
        mFromDegrees = fromDegrees;
        mToDegrees = toDegrees;

        mPivotXValue = pivotXValue;
        mPivotXType = pivotXType;
        mPivotYValue = pivotYValue;
        mPivotYType = pivotYType;
        initializePivotPoint();
    }

    private void initializePivotPoint()
    {
        if (mPivotXType == ABSOLUTE) mPivotX = mPivotXValue;
        if (mPivotYType == ABSOLUTE) mPivotY = mPivotYValue;
    }

    @Override
    protected void applyTransformation(float interpolatedTime, Transformation transformation)
    {
        float degrees = mFromDegrees + ((mToDegrees - mFromDegrees) * interpolatedTime);
        float scale = getScaleFactor();

        if (mPivotX == 0.0f && mPivotY == 0.0f) transformation.getMatrix().setRotate(degrees);
        else transformation.getMatrix().setRotate(degrees, mPivotX * scale, mPivotY * scale);
    }

    @Override
    public void initialize(int width, int height, int parentWidth, int parentHeight)
    {
        super.initialize(width, height, parentWidth, parentHeight);

        mPivotX = resolveSize(mPivotXType, mPivotXValue, width, parentWidth);
        mPivotY = resolveSize(mPivotYType, mPivotYValue, height, parentHeight);
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/animation/ScaleAnimation.java`:

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

public class ScaleAnimation extends Animation
{
    private float mFromX;
    private float mToX;
    private float mFromY;
    private float mToY;

    private int mFromXType = ABSOLUTE;
    private int mToXType = ABSOLUTE;
    private int mFromYType = ABSOLUTE;
    private int mToYType = ABSOLUTE;

    private float mFromXValue;
    private float mToXValue;
    private float mFromYValue;
    private float mToYValue;

    private int mPivotXType = ABSOLUTE;
    private int mPivotYType = ABSOLUTE;
    private float mPivotXValue = 0.0f;
    private float mPivotYValue = 0.0f;

    private float mPivotX;
    private float mPivotY;

    public ScaleAnimation(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        AnimationAttributes values = new AnimationAttributes(context, attributes);

        Description description = scaleDescription(values, "fromXScale");
        mFromXType = description.type;
        mFromXValue = description.value;
        mFromX = description.value;

        description = scaleDescription(values, "toXScale");
        mToXType = description.type;
        mToXValue = description.value;
        mToX = description.value;

        description = scaleDescription(values, "fromYScale");
        mFromYType = description.type;
        mFromYValue = description.value;
        mFromY = description.value;

        description = scaleDescription(values, "toYScale");
        mToYType = description.type;
        mToYValue = description.value;
        mToY = description.value;

        description = values.getDescription("pivotX");
        mPivotXType = description.type;
        mPivotXValue = description.value;

        description = values.getDescription("pivotY");
        mPivotYType = description.type;
        mPivotYValue = description.value;

        initializePivotPoint();
    }

    public ScaleAnimation(float fromX, float toX, float fromY, float toY)
    {
        mFromX = fromX;
        mToX = toX;
        mFromY = fromY;
        mToY = toY;
        mFromXValue = fromX;
        mToXValue = toX;
        mFromYValue = fromY;
        mToYValue = toY;
        mPivotX = 0;
        mPivotY = 0;
    }

    public ScaleAnimation(float fromX, float toX, float fromY, float toY, float pivotX, float pivotY)
    {
        this(fromX, toX, fromY, toY);

        mPivotXType = ABSOLUTE;
        mPivotYType = ABSOLUTE;
        mPivotXValue = pivotX;
        mPivotYValue = pivotY;
        initializePivotPoint();
    }

    public ScaleAnimation(float fromX, float toX, float fromY, float toY, int pivotXType, float pivotXValue, int pivotYType,
                          float pivotYValue)
    {
        this(fromX, toX, fromY, toY);

        mPivotXType = pivotXType;
        mPivotYType = pivotYType;
        mPivotXValue = pivotXValue;
        mPivotYValue = pivotYValue;
        initializePivotPoint();
    }

    private static Description scaleDescription(AnimationAttributes values, String name)
    {
        Description description = values.getDescription(name);

        if (!values.has(name))
        {
            description.type = ABSOLUTE;
            description.value = 1.0f;
        }

        return description;
    }

    private void initializePivotPoint()
    {
        if (mPivotXType == ABSOLUTE) mPivotX = mPivotXValue;
        if (mPivotYType == ABSOLUTE) mPivotY = mPivotYValue;
    }

    @Override
    protected void applyTransformation(float interpolatedTime, Transformation transformation)
    {
        float scaleX = 1.0f;
        float scaleY = 1.0f;
        float scale = getScaleFactor();

        if (mFromX != 1.0f || mToX != 1.0f) scaleX = mFromX + ((mToX - mFromX) * interpolatedTime);
        if (mFromY != 1.0f || mToY != 1.0f) scaleY = mFromY + ((mToY - mFromY) * interpolatedTime);

        if (mPivotX == 0 && mPivotY == 0) transformation.getMatrix().setScale(scaleX, scaleY);
        else transformation.getMatrix().setScale(scaleX, scaleY, scale * mPivotX, scale * mPivotY);
    }

    private static float resolveScale(int type, float value, int size, int parentSize)
    {
        if (type == ABSOLUTE) return value;
        if (size == 0) return 1.0f;

        float target = type == RELATIVE_TO_PARENT ? value * parentSize : value * size;
        return target / (float)size;
    }

    @Override
    public void initialize(int width, int height, int parentWidth, int parentHeight)
    {
        super.initialize(width, height, parentWidth, parentHeight);

        mFromX = resolveScale(mFromXType, mFromXValue, width, parentWidth);
        mToX = resolveScale(mToXType, mToXValue, width, parentWidth);
        mFromY = resolveScale(mFromYType, mFromYValue, height, parentHeight);
        mToY = resolveScale(mToYType, mToYValue, height, parentHeight);

        mPivotX = resolveSize(mPivotXType, mPivotXValue, width, parentWidth);
        mPivotY = resolveSize(mPivotYType, mPivotYValue, height, parentHeight);
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/animation/Transformation.java`:

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.graphics.Matrix;
import android.graphics.Rect;

public class Transformation
{
    public static final int TYPE_IDENTITY = 0x0;
    public static final int TYPE_ALPHA = 0x1;
    public static final int TYPE_MATRIX = 0x2;
    public static final int TYPE_BOTH = TYPE_ALPHA | TYPE_MATRIX;

    protected Matrix mMatrix;
    protected float mAlpha;
    protected int mTransformationType;

    private boolean mHasClipRect;
    private final Rect mClipRect = new Rect();

    public Transformation()
    {
        clear();
    }

    public void clear()
    {
        if (mMatrix == null) mMatrix = new Matrix();
        else mMatrix.reset();

        mClipRect.setEmpty();
        mHasClipRect = false;
        mAlpha = 1.0f;
        mTransformationType = TYPE_BOTH;
    }

    public int getTransformationType()
    {
        return mTransformationType;
    }

    public void setTransformationType(int transformationType)
    {
        mTransformationType = transformationType;
    }

    public void set(Transformation transformation)
    {
        mAlpha = transformation.getAlpha();
        mMatrix.set(transformation.getMatrix());

        if (transformation.mHasClipRect)
        {
            setClipRect(transformation.getClipRect());
        }
        else
        {
            mHasClipRect = false;
            mClipRect.setEmpty();
        }

        mTransformationType = transformation.getTransformationType();
    }

    public void compose(Transformation transformation)
    {
        mAlpha *= transformation.getAlpha();
        mMatrix.preConcat(transformation.getMatrix());

        if (transformation.mHasClipRect)
        {
            Rect bounds = transformation.getClipRect();
            if (mHasClipRect)
            {
                setClipRect(mClipRect.left + bounds.left, mClipRect.top + bounds.top, mClipRect.right + bounds.right,
                            mClipRect.bottom + bounds.bottom);
            }
            else
            {
                setClipRect(bounds);
            }
        }
    }

    public void postCompose(Transformation transformation)
    {
        mAlpha *= transformation.getAlpha();
        mMatrix.postConcat(transformation.getMatrix());

        if (transformation.mHasClipRect)
        {
            Rect bounds = transformation.getClipRect();
            if (mHasClipRect)
            {
                setClipRect(mClipRect.left + bounds.left, mClipRect.top + bounds.top, mClipRect.right + bounds.right,
                            mClipRect.bottom + bounds.bottom);
            }
            else
            {
                setClipRect(bounds);
            }
        }
    }

    public Matrix getMatrix()
    {
        return mMatrix;
    }

    public void setAlpha(float alpha)
    {
        mAlpha = alpha;
    }

    public float getAlpha()
    {
        return mAlpha;
    }

    public void setClipRect(Rect rect)
    {
        setClipRect(rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom);
    }

    public void setClipRect(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        mClipRect.set(left, top, right, bottom);
        mHasClipRect = true;
    }

    public Rect getClipRect()
    {
        return mClipRect;
    }

    public boolean hasClipRect()
    {
        return mHasClipRect;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Transformation" + toShortString();
    }

    public String toShortString()
    {
        return "{alpha=" + mAlpha + " matrix=" + mMatrix.toShortString() + "}";
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view.animation;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

public class TranslateAnimation extends Animation
{
    private int mFromXType = ABSOLUTE;
    private int mToXType = ABSOLUTE;
    private int mFromYType = ABSOLUTE;
    private int mToYType = ABSOLUTE;

    private float mFromXValue = 0.0f;
    private float mToXValue = 0.0f;
    private float mFromYValue = 0.0f;
    private float mToYValue = 0.0f;

    private float mFromXDelta;
    private float mToXDelta;
    private float mFromYDelta;
    private float mToYDelta;

    public TranslateAnimation(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        AnimationAttributes values = new AnimationAttributes(context, attributes);

        Description description = values.getDescription("fromXDelta");
        mFromXType = description.type;
        mFromXValue = description.value;

        description = values.getDescription("toXDelta");
        mToXType = description.type;
        mToXValue = description.value;

        description = values.getDescription("fromYDelta");
        mFromYType = description.type;
        mFromYValue = description.value;

        description = values.getDescription("toYDelta");
        mToYType = description.type;
        mToYValue = description.value;
    }

    public TranslateAnimation(float fromXDelta, float toXDelta, float fromYDelta, float toYDelta)
    {
        mFromXValue = fromXDelta;
        mToXValue = toXDelta;
        mFromYValue = fromYDelta;
        mToYValue = toYDelta;

        mFromXType = ABSOLUTE;
        mToXType = ABSOLUTE;
        mFromYType = ABSOLUTE;
        mToYType = ABSOLUTE;
    }

    public TranslateAnimation(int fromXType, float fromXValue, int toXType, float toXValue, int fromYType, float fromYValue, int toYType,
                              float toYValue)
    {
        mFromXValue = fromXValue;
        mToXValue = toXValue;
        mFromYValue = fromYValue;
        mToYValue = toYValue;

        mFromXType = fromXType;
        mToXType = toXType;
        mFromYType = fromYType;
        mToYType = toYType;
    }

    @Override
    protected void applyTransformation(float interpolatedTime, Transformation transformation)
    {
        float deltaX = mFromXDelta;
        float deltaY = mFromYDelta;

        if (mFromXDelta != mToXDelta) deltaX = mFromXDelta + ((mToXDelta - mFromXDelta) * interpolatedTime);
        if (mFromYDelta != mToYDelta) deltaY = mFromYDelta + ((mToYDelta - mFromYDelta) * interpolatedTime);

        transformation.getMatrix().setTranslate(deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public void initialize(int width, int height, int parentWidth, int parentHeight)
    {
        super.initialize(width, height, parentWidth, parentHeight);

        mFromXDelta = resolveSize(mFromXType, mFromXValue, width, parentWidth);
        mToXDelta = resolveSize(mToXType, mToXValue, width, parentWidth);
        mFromYDelta = resolveSize(mFromYType, mFromYValue, height, parentHeight);
        mToYDelta = resolveSize(mToYType, mToYValue, height, parentHeight);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view.autofill;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class AutofillId implements Parcelable
{
    public static final AutofillId NO_AUTOFILL_ID = new AutofillId(0);

    private static final int NO_VIRTUAL_ID = -1;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<AutofillId> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<AutofillId>()
    {
        @Override
        public AutofillId createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int viewId = source.readInt();
            long virtualId = source.readLong();
            int sessionId = source.readInt();
            return new AutofillId(viewId, virtualId, sessionId);
        }

        @Override
        public AutofillId[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new AutofillId[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mViewId;
    private final long mVirtualId;
    private final int mSessionId;

    public AutofillId(int id)
    {
        this(id, NO_VIRTUAL_ID, 0);
    }

    public AutofillId(int parentId, int virtualChildId)
    {
        this(parentId, virtualChildId, 0);
    }

    public AutofillId(AutofillId parent, long virtualChildId, int sessionId)
    {
        this(parent == null ? 0 : parent.mViewId, virtualChildId, sessionId);
    }

    private AutofillId(int viewId, long virtualId, int sessionId)
    {
        mViewId = viewId;
        mVirtualId = virtualId;
        mSessionId = sessionId;
    }

    public static AutofillId create(android.view.View host, int virtualId)
    {
        if (host == null) throw new NullPointerException("host cannot be null");

        return new AutofillId(host.getAutofillId().mViewId, virtualId);
    }

    public int getViewId()
    {
        return mViewId;
    }

    public boolean isVirtualInt()
    {
        return mVirtualId != NO_VIRTUAL_ID && mVirtualId >= Integer.MIN_VALUE && mVirtualId <= Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    }

    public boolean isVirtualLong()
    {
        return mVirtualId != NO_VIRTUAL_ID && !isVirtualInt();
    }

    public boolean isNonVirtual()
    {
        return mVirtualId == NO_VIRTUAL_ID;
    }

    public int getVirtualChildIntId()
    {
        return (int)mVirtualId;
    }

    public long getVirtualChildLongId()
    {
        return mVirtualId;
    }

    public boolean isVirtual()
    {
        return !isNonVirtual();
    }

    public int getAutofillVirtualId()
    {
        return isVirtualInt() ? (int)mVirtualId : android.view.View.NO_ID;
    }

    public boolean isInAutofillSession()
    {
        return mSessionId != 0;
    }

    public int getSessionId()
    {
        return mSessionId;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mViewId * 31 + (int)(mVirtualId ^ (mVirtualId >>> 32));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof AutofillId)) return false;

        AutofillId id = (AutofillId)other;
        return id.mViewId == mViewId && id.mVirtualId == mVirtualId;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        if (mVirtualId == NO_VIRTUAL_ID) return Integer.toString(mViewId);
        return mViewId + ":" + mVirtualId;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        parcel.writeInt(mViewId);
        parcel.writeLong(mVirtualId);
        parcel.writeInt(mSessionId);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view.autofill;

import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.view.View;

public final class AutofillManager
{
    public static final String EXTRA_ASSIST_STRUCTURE = "android.view.autofill.extra.ASSIST_STRUCTURE";
    public static final int ACTION_START_SESSION = 1;
    public static final int ACTION_VIEW_ENTERED = 2;
    public static final int ACTION_VIEW_EXITED = 3;
    public static final int ACTION_VALUE_CHANGED = 4;
```

`java/android/view/autofill/AutofillValue.java`:

```java
package android.view.autofill;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.text.TextUtils;

import java.util.Objects;

public final class AutofillValue implements Parcelable
{
    private static final int TYPE_TEXT = 1;
    private static final int TYPE_TOGGLE = 2;
    private static final int TYPE_LIST = 3;
    private static final int TYPE_DATE = 4;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<AutofillValue> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<AutofillValue>()
    {
        @Override
        public AutofillValue createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int type = source.readInt();

            switch (type)
            {
                case TYPE_TEXT:
                    return new AutofillValue(TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source));
                case TYPE_TOGGLE:
                    return new AutofillValue(source.readInt() != 0);
                case TYPE_LIST:
                    return new AutofillValue(source.readInt());
                case TYPE_DATE:
                    return new AutofillValue(source.readLong());
                default:
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("type=" + type + " not valid");
            }
        }

        @Override
        public AutofillValue[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new AutofillValue[size];
        }
    };

    private final Object mValue;

    private AutofillValue(Object value)
    {
        mValue = value;
    }

    public static AutofillValue forText(CharSequence value)
    {
        return value == null ? null : new AutofillValue(value);
    }

    public static AutofillValue forToggle(boolean value)
    {
        return new AutofillValue(value);
    }

    public static AutofillValue forList(int value)
    {
        return new AutofillValue(value);
    }

    public static AutofillValue forDate(long value)
    {
        return new AutofillValue(value);
    }

    public boolean isText()
    {
        return mValue instanceof CharSequence;
    }

    public boolean isToggle()
    {
        return mValue instanceof Boolean;
    }

    public boolean isList()
    {
        return mValue instanceof Integer;
    }

    public boolean isDate()
    {
        return mValue instanceof Long;
    }

    public CharSequence getTextValue()
    {
        if (!isText()) throw new IllegalStateException("value must be a text value, not type=" + typeOf());
        return (CharSequence)mValue;
    }

    public boolean getToggleValue()
    {
        if (!isToggle()) throw new IllegalStateException("value must be a toggle value, not type=" + typeOf());
        return (Boolean)mValue;
    }

    public int getListValue()
    {
        if (!isList()) throw new IllegalStateException("value must be a list value, not type=" + typeOf());
        return (Integer)mValue;
    }

    public long getDateValue()
    {
        if (!isDate()) throw new IllegalStateException("value must be a date value, not type=" + typeOf());
        return (Long)mValue;
    }

    private int typeOf()
    {
        if (isText()) return TYPE_TEXT;
        if (isToggle()) return TYPE_TOGGLE;
        if (isList()) return TYPE_LIST;
        return TYPE_DATE;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return typeOf() + mValue.hashCode();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (other == null || getClass() != other.getClass()) return false;

        AutofillValue value = (AutofillValue)other;
        if (typeOf() != value.typeOf()) return false;
        if (isText()) return mValue.toString().equals(value.mValue.toString());

        return Objects.equals(mValue, value.mValue);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "[type=" + typeOf() + ", value=" + (isText() ? ((CharSequence)mValue).length() + "_chars" : mValue) + "]";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        int type = typeOf();
        parcel.writeInt(type);

        switch (type)
        {
            case TYPE_TEXT:
                TextUtils.writeToParcel((CharSequence)mValue, parcel, flags);
                break;
            case TYPE_TOGGLE:
                parcel.writeInt((Boolean)mValue ? 1 : 0);
                break;
            case TYPE_LIST:
                parcel.writeInt((Integer)mValue);
                break;
            default:
                parcel.writeLong((Long)mValue);
                break;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
        mFlags = flags;

        return mFlags;

    {
```

```java
package android.view.contentcapture;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class ContentCaptureContext implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<ContentCaptureContext> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ContentCaptureContext>()
    {
        @Override
        public ContentCaptureContext createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new ContentCaptureContext(source.readString(), source.readBundle());
        }

        @Override
        public ContentCaptureContext[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ContentCaptureContext[size];
        }
    };

    private final String mLocus;
    private final Bundle mExtras;

    private ContentCaptureContext(String locus, Bundle extras)
    {
        mLocus = locus;
        mExtras = extras;
    }

    public static ContentCaptureContext forLocusId(String id)
    {
        return new ContentCaptureContext(id, null);
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final android.content.LocusId mId;
        private Bundle mExtras;
        private boolean mDestroyed;

        public Builder(android.content.LocusId id)
        {
            if (id == null) throw new NullPointerException("id");

            mId = id;
        }

        public Builder setExtras(Bundle extras)
        {
            if (extras == null) throw new NullPointerException("extras");
            if (mDestroyed) throw new IllegalStateException("Already called #build()");

            mExtras = extras;
            return this;
        }

        public ContentCaptureContext build()
        {
            if (mDestroyed) throw new IllegalStateException("Already called #build()");

            mDestroyed = true;
            return new ContentCaptureContext(mId.getId(), mExtras);
        }
    }

    public android.content.LocusId getLocusId()
    {
        return mLocus == null ? null : new android.content.LocusId(mLocus);
    }

    public Bundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "Context[locus=" + mLocus + ", hasExtras=" + (mExtras != null) + "]";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel parcel, int flags)
    {
        parcel.writeString(mLocus);
        parcel.writeBundle(mExtras);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view.inputmethod;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.View;

public class BaseInputConnection implements InputConnection
{
    private final StringBuilder mText = new StringBuilder();
    private final View mTargetView;
    private final boolean mFullEditor;

    private int mSelectionStart;
    private int mSelectionEnd;
    private int mComposingStart = -1;
    private int mComposingEnd = -1;
    private int mBatchDepth;

    public BaseInputConnection(View targetView, boolean fullEditor)
    {
        mTargetView = targetView;
        mFullEditor = fullEditor;
    }

    public View getTargetView()
    {
        return mTargetView;
    }

    public boolean isFullEditor()
    {
        return mFullEditor;
    }

    public android.text.Editable getEditable()
    {
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public android.os.Handler getHandler()
    {
        return null;
    }

    public static int getComposingSpanStart(android.text.Spannable text)
    {
        return -1;
    }

    public static int getComposingSpanEnd(android.text.Spannable text)
    {
        return -1;
    }

    public static void removeComposingSpans(android.text.Spannable text)
    {
    }

    public static void setComposingSpans(android.text.Spannable text)
    {
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getTextBeforeCursor(int length, int flags)
    {
        int start = Math.max(0, mSelectionStart - length);
        if (start >= mSelectionStart) return "";

        return mText.substring(start, mSelectionStart);
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getTextAfterCursor(int length, int flags)
    {
        int end = Math.min(mText.length(), mSelectionEnd + length);
        if (mSelectionEnd >= end) return "";

        return mText.substring(mSelectionEnd, end);
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getSelectedText(int flags)
    {
        if (mSelectionStart >= mSelectionEnd) return null;

        return mText.substring(mSelectionStart, mSelectionEnd);
    }

    @Override
    public int getCursorCapsMode(int reqModes)
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public ExtractedText getExtractedText(ExtractedTextRequest request, int flags)
    {
        ExtractedText extracted = new ExtractedText();
        extracted.text = mText.toString();
        extracted.startOffset = 0;
        extracted.selectionStart = mSelectionStart;
        extracted.selectionEnd = mSelectionEnd;
        extracted.partialStartOffset = -1;
        extracted.partialEndOffset = -1;
        return extracted;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean deleteSurroundingText(int beforeLength, int afterLength)
    {
        int start = Math.max(0, mSelectionStart - Math.max(0, beforeLength));
        int end = Math.min(mText.length(), mSelectionEnd + Math.max(0, afterLength));

        mText.delete(mSelectionEnd, end);
        mText.delete(start, mSelectionStart);

        mSelectionStart = start;
        mSelectionEnd = start;
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean deleteSurroundingTextInCodePoints(int beforeLength, int afterLength)
    {
        return deleteSurroundingText(beforeLength, afterLength);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean setComposingText(CharSequence text, int newCursorPosition)
    {
        replaceSelection(text == null ? "" : text.toString());

        mComposingStart = mSelectionStart - (text == null ? 0 : text.length());
        mComposingEnd = mSelectionEnd;
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean setComposingRegion(int start, int end)
    {
        mComposingStart = Math.max(0, Math.min(start, mText.length()));
        mComposingEnd = Math.max(mComposingStart, Math.min(end, mText.length()));
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean finishComposingText()
    {
        mComposingStart = -1;
        mComposingEnd = -1;
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean commitText(CharSequence text, int newCursorPosition)
    {
        replaceSelection(text == null ? "" : text.toString());
        return finishComposingText();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean commitCompletion(CompletionInfo text)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean commitCorrection(CorrectionInfo correctionInfo)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean setSelection(int start, int end)
    {
        mSelectionStart = Math.max(0, Math.min(start, mText.length()));
        mSelectionEnd = Math.max(mSelectionStart, Math.min(end, mText.length()));
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean performEditorAction(int editorAction)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean performContextMenuAction(int id)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean beginBatchEdit()
    {
        mBatchDepth += 1;
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean endBatchEdit()
    {
        if (mBatchDepth == 0) return false;

        mBatchDepth -= 1;
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean sendKeyEvent(KeyEvent event)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean clearMetaKeyStates(int states)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean reportFullscreenMode(boolean enabled)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean performPrivateCommand(String action, Bundle data)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean requestCursorUpdates(int cursorUpdateMode)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public void closeConnection()
    {
        finishComposingText();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean commitContent(InputContentInfo inputContentInfo, int flags, Bundle opts)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public SurroundingText getSurroundingText(int beforeLength, int afterLength, int flags)
    {
        if (beforeLength < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("beforeLength must be non-negative");
        if (afterLength < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("afterLength must be non-negative");

        int selectionStart = Math.max(0, Math.min(mSelectionStart, mText.length()));
        int selectionEnd = Math.max(selectionStart, Math.min(mSelectionEnd, mText.length()));
        int start = (int)Math.max(0, (long)selectionStart - beforeLength);
        int end = (int)Math.min(mText.length(), (long)selectionEnd + afterLength);

        return new SurroundingText(mText.substring(start, end), selectionStart - start, selectionEnd - start, start);
    }

    @Override
    public TextSnapshot takeSnapshot()
    {
        SurroundingText surroundingText = getSurroundingText(2048, 2048, 0);
        int compositionStart = mComposingStart >= 0 && mComposingEnd >= mComposingStart ? mComposingStart : -1;
        int compositionEnd = compositionStart < 0 ? -1 : mComposingEnd;

        return new TextSnapshot(surroundingText, compositionStart, compositionEnd, getCursorCapsMode(0));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean replaceText(int start, int end, CharSequence text, int newCursorPosition, TextAttribute textAttribute)
    {
        if (start < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("start must be non-negative");
        if (end < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("end must be non-negative");

        beginBatchEdit();
        finishComposingText();
        setSelection(Math.min(start, end), Math.max(start, end));
        commitText(text, newCursorPosition);
        endBatchEdit();
        return true;
    }

    private void replaceSelection(String text)
    {
        int start = Math.max(0, Math.min(mSelectionStart, mText.length()));
        int end = Math.max(start, Math.min(mSelectionEnd, mText.length()));

        mText.replace(start, end, text);
        mSelectionStart = start + text.length();
        mSelectionEnd = mSelectionStart;
    }
}
```
