```java
package android.view.inputmethod;

import android.graphics.Matrix;
import android.graphics.RectF;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.util.SparseArray;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class CursorAnchorInfo implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int FLAG_HAS_VISIBLE_REGION = 0x01;
    public static final int FLAG_HAS_INVISIBLE_REGION = 0x02;
    public static final int FLAG_IS_RTL = 0x04;

    private int mSelectionStart = -1;
    private int mSelectionEnd = -1;
    private int mComposingTextStart = -1;
    private CharSequence mComposingText;
    private int mInsertionMarkerFlags;
    private float mInsertionMarkerHorizontal = Float.NaN;
    private float mInsertionMarkerTop = Float.NaN;
    private float mInsertionMarkerBaseline = Float.NaN;
    private float mInsertionMarkerBottom = Float.NaN;
    private final SparseArray<RectF> mCharacterBounds = new SparseArray<>();
    private final SparseArray<Integer> mCharacterBoundsFlags = new SparseArray<>();
    private final ArrayList<RectF> mVisibleLineBounds = new ArrayList<>();
    private EditorBoundsInfo mEditorBoundsInfo;
    private TextAppearanceInfo mTextAppearanceInfo;
    private final Matrix mMatrix = new Matrix();

    private CursorAnchorInfo()
    {
    }

    public CursorAnchorInfo(Parcel source)
    {
        mSelectionStart = source.readInt();
        mSelectionEnd = source.readInt();
        mComposingTextStart = source.readInt();
        mComposingText = (CharSequence)source.readValue(null);
        mInsertionMarkerFlags = source.readInt();
        mInsertionMarkerHorizontal = source.readFloat();
        mInsertionMarkerTop = source.readFloat();
        mInsertionMarkerBaseline = source.readFloat();
        mInsertionMarkerBottom = source.readFloat();
        mEditorBoundsInfo = source.readParcelable(EditorBoundsInfo.class.getClassLoader());

        float[] values = (float[])source.readValue(null);
        if (values != null) mMatrix.setValues(values);

        if (source.readInt() != 0) mTextAppearanceInfo = TextAppearanceInfo.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mSelectionStart);
        dest.writeInt(mSelectionEnd);
        dest.writeInt(mComposingTextStart);
        dest.writeValue(mComposingText);
        dest.writeInt(mInsertionMarkerFlags);
        dest.writeFloat(mInsertionMarkerHorizontal);
        dest.writeFloat(mInsertionMarkerTop);
        dest.writeFloat(mInsertionMarkerBaseline);
        dest.writeFloat(mInsertionMarkerBottom);
        dest.writeParcelable(mEditorBoundsInfo, flags);

        float[] values = new float[9];
        mMatrix.getValues(values);
        dest.writeValue(values);

        dest.writeInt(mTextAppearanceInfo == null ? 0 : 1);
        if (mTextAppearanceInfo != null) mTextAppearanceInfo.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public static final Creator<CursorAnchorInfo> CREATOR = new Creator<CursorAnchorInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public CursorAnchorInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            return new CursorAnchorInfo(source);
        }

        @Override
        public CursorAnchorInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new CursorAnchorInfo[size];
        }
    };

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mSelectionStart, mSelectionEnd, mComposingTextStart, mComposingText, mInsertionMarkerFlags,
                            mInsertionMarkerHorizontal, mInsertionMarkerTop, mInsertionMarkerBaseline, mInsertionMarkerBottom,
                            mEditorBoundsInfo, mMatrix);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof CursorAnchorInfo)) return false;

        CursorAnchorInfo that = (CursorAnchorInfo)other;
        return mSelectionStart == that.mSelectionStart && mSelectionEnd == that.mSelectionEnd
            && mComposingTextStart == that.mComposingTextStart && Objects.equals(mComposingText, that.mComposingText)
            && mInsertionMarkerFlags == that.mInsertionMarkerFlags
            && Float.compare(mInsertionMarkerHorizontal, that.mInsertionMarkerHorizontal) == 0
            && Float.compare(mInsertionMarkerTop, that.mInsertionMarkerTop) == 0
            && Float.compare(mInsertionMarkerBaseline, that.mInsertionMarkerBaseline) == 0
            && Float.compare(mInsertionMarkerBottom, that.mInsertionMarkerBottom) == 0
            && Objects.equals(mEditorBoundsInfo, that.mEditorBoundsInfo) && mMatrix.equals(that.mMatrix)
            && mVisibleLineBounds.equals(that.mVisibleLineBounds);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "CursorAnchorInfo{mSelection=" + mSelectionStart + "," + mSelectionEnd + " mComposingTextStart=" + mComposingTextStart
               + " mComposingText=" + mComposingText + " mInsertionMarkerFlags=" + mInsertionMarkerFlags
               + " mInsertionMarkerHorizontal=" + mInsertionMarkerHorizontal + " mInsertionMarkerTop=" + mInsertionMarkerTop
               + " mInsertionMarkerBaseline=" + mInsertionMarkerBaseline + " mInsertionMarkerBottom=" + mInsertionMarkerBottom
               + " mEditorBoundsInfo=" + mEditorBoundsInfo + " mMatrix=" + mMatrix.toShortString() + "}";
    }

    public int getSelectionStart()
    {
        return mSelectionStart;
    }

    public int getSelectionEnd()
    {
        return mSelectionEnd;
    }

    public int getComposingTextStart()
    {
        return mComposingTextStart;
    }

    public CharSequence getComposingText()
    {
        return mComposingText;
    }

    public float getInsertionMarkerHorizontal()
    {
        return mInsertionMarkerHorizontal;
    }

    public float getInsertionMarkerTop()
    {
        return mInsertionMarkerTop;
    }

    public float getInsertionMarkerBaseline()
    {
        return mInsertionMarkerBaseline;
    }

    public float getInsertionMarkerBottom()
    {
        return mInsertionMarkerBottom;
    }

    public int getInsertionMarkerFlags()
    {
        return mInsertionMarkerFlags;
    }

    public RectF getCharacterBounds(int index)
    {
        RectF bounds = mCharacterBounds.get(index);
        return bounds == null ? null : new RectF(bounds);
    }

    public int getCharacterBoundsFlags(int index)
    {
        Integer flags = mCharacterBoundsFlags.get(index);
        return flags == null ? 0 : flags.intValue();
    }

    public List<RectF> getVisibleLineBounds()
    {
        return new ArrayList<>(mVisibleLineBounds);
    }

    public EditorBoundsInfo getEditorBoundsInfo()
    {
        return mEditorBoundsInfo;
    }

    public TextAppearanceInfo getTextAppearanceInfo()
    {
        return mTextAppearanceInfo;
    }

    public Matrix getMatrix()
    {
        return new Matrix(mMatrix);
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private CursorAnchorInfo mInfo = new CursorAnchorInfo();

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public Builder setSelectionRange(int newStart, int newEnd)
        {
            mInfo.mSelectionStart = newStart;
            mInfo.mSelectionEnd = newEnd;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setComposingText(int composingTextStart, CharSequence composingText)
        {
            mInfo.mComposingTextStart = composingTextStart;
            mInfo.mComposingText = composingText;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setInsertionMarkerLocation(float horizontalPosition, float lineTop, float lineBaseline, float lineBottom,
                                                  int flags)
        {
            mInfo.mInsertionMarkerHorizontal = horizontalPosition;
            mInfo.mInsertionMarkerTop = lineTop;
            mInfo.mInsertionMarkerBaseline = lineBaseline;
            mInfo.mInsertionMarkerBottom = lineBottom;
            mInfo.mInsertionMarkerFlags = flags;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder addCharacterBounds(int index, float left, float top, float right, float bottom, int flags)
        {
            if (index < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("index must not be a negative integer.");

            mInfo.mCharacterBounds.put(index, new RectF(left, top, right, bottom));
            mInfo.mCharacterBoundsFlags.put(index, flags);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setMatrix(Matrix matrix)
        {
            mInfo.mMatrix.set(matrix != null ? matrix : Matrix.IDENTITY_MATRIX);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setEditorBoundsInfo(EditorBoundsInfo editorBoundsInfo)
        {
            mInfo.mEditorBoundsInfo = editorBoundsInfo;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder addVisibleLineBounds(float left, float top, float right, float bottom)
        {
            mInfo.mVisibleLineBounds.add(new RectF(left, top, right, bottom));
            return this;
        }

        public Builder clearVisibleLineBounds()
        {
            mInfo.mVisibleLineBounds.clear();
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setTextAppearanceInfo(TextAppearanceInfo textAppearanceInfo)
        {
            mInfo.mTextAppearanceInfo = textAppearanceInfo;
            return this;
        }

        public void reset()
        {
            mInfo = new CursorAnchorInfo();
        }

        public CursorAnchorInfo build()
        {
            CursorAnchorInfo built = mInfo;
            CursorAnchorInfo copy = new CursorAnchorInfo();
            copy.mSelectionStart = built.mSelectionStart;
            copy.mSelectionEnd = built.mSelectionEnd;
            copy.mComposingTextStart = built.mComposingTextStart;
            copy.mComposingText = built.mComposingText;
            copy.mInsertionMarkerFlags = built.mInsertionMarkerFlags;
            copy.mInsertionMarkerHorizontal = built.mInsertionMarkerHorizontal;
            copy.mInsertionMarkerTop = built.mInsertionMarkerTop;
            copy.mInsertionMarkerBaseline = built.mInsertionMarkerBaseline;
            copy.mInsertionMarkerBottom = built.mInsertionMarkerBottom;
            copy.mEditorBoundsInfo = built.mEditorBoundsInfo;
            copy.mTextAppearanceInfo = built.mTextAppearanceInfo;
            copy.mMatrix.set(built.mMatrix);
            copy.mVisibleLineBounds.addAll(built.mVisibleLineBounds);

            for (int index = 0; index < built.mCharacterBounds.size(); index++)
            {
                copy.mCharacterBounds.put(built.mCharacterBounds.keyAt(index), built.mCharacterBounds.valueAt(index));
                copy.mCharacterBoundsFlags.put(built.mCharacterBoundsFlags.keyAt(index), built.mCharacterBoundsFlags.valueAt(index));
            }

            return copy;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view.inputmethod;

import android.os.Bundle;

public class EditorInfo implements android.text.InputType, android.os.Parcelable
{
    public static final int IME_ACTION_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
    public static final int IME_ACTION_NONE = 1;
    public static final int IME_ACTION_GO = 2;
    public static final int IME_ACTION_SEARCH = 3;
    public static final int IME_ACTION_SEND = 4;
    public static final int IME_ACTION_NEXT = 5;
    public static final int IME_ACTION_DONE = 6;
    public static final int IME_ACTION_PREVIOUS = 7;
    public static final int IME_FLAG_NO_PERSONALIZED_LEARNING = 0x1000000;
    public static final int IME_FLAG_NO_FULLSCREEN = 0x2000000;
    public static final int IME_FLAG_NAVIGATE_PREVIOUS = 0x4000000;
    public static final int IME_FLAG_NAVIGATE_NEXT = 0x8000000;
    public static final int IME_FLAG_NO_EXTRACT_UI = 0x10000000;
    public static final int IME_FLAG_NO_ACCESSORY_ACTION = 0x20000000;
    public static final int IME_FLAG_NO_ENTER_ACTION = 0x40000000;
    public static final int IME_FLAG_FORCE_ASCII = 0x80000000;
    public static final int IME_MASK_ACTION = 0x000000ff;
    public static final int IME_NULL = 0;

    public int inputType = 0;
    public int imeOptions = IME_NULL;
    public String privateImeOptions;
    public CharSequence actionLabel;
    public int actionId = 0;
    public int initialSelStart = -1;
    public int initialSelEnd = -1;
    public int initialCapsMode = 0;
    public CharSequence hintText;
    public String packageName;
    public int fieldId = 0;
    public String fieldName;
    public Bundle extras;
    public String[] contentMimeTypes;
    public android.os.LocaleList hintLocales;
    public CharSequence label;

    public final void makeCompatible(int targetSdkVersion)
    {
        if (targetSdkVersion >= 11) return;

        switch (inputType & (TYPE_MASK_CLASS | TYPE_MASK_VARIATION))
        {
            case TYPE_CLASS_TEXT | TYPE_TEXT_VARIATION_WEB_EDIT_TEXT:
                inputType = TYPE_CLASS_TEXT | TYPE_TEXT_VARIATION_NORMAL | (inputType & TYPE_MASK_FLAGS);
                break;
            case TYPE_CLASS_TEXT | TYPE_TEXT_VARIATION_WEB_PASSWORD:
                inputType = TYPE_CLASS_TEXT | TYPE_TEXT_VARIATION_PASSWORD | (inputType & TYPE_MASK_FLAGS);
                break;
            case TYPE_CLASS_NUMBER | TYPE_NUMBER_VARIATION_NORMAL:
            case TYPE_CLASS_NUMBER | TYPE_NUMBER_VARIATION_PASSWORD:
                inputType = TYPE_CLASS_NUMBER | (inputType & TYPE_MASK_FLAGS);
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }
    }

    public void setAutofillId(android.view.autofill.AutofillId autofillId)
    {
        mAutofillId = autofillId;
    }

    public android.view.autofill.AutofillId getAutofillId()
    {
        return mAutofillId;
    }

    public void setWritingToolsEnabled(boolean enabled)
    {
        mWritingToolsEnabled = enabled;
    }

    public boolean isWritingToolsEnabled()
    {
        return mWritingToolsEnabled;
    }

    public SurroundingText getInitialSurroundingText(int beforeLength, int afterLength, int flags)
    {
        int selectionStart = initialSelStart - mInitialSurroundingOffset;
        int selectionEnd = initialSelEnd - mInitialSurroundingOffset;
        if (selectionStart < 0 || selectionEnd < selectionStart || selectionEnd > mInitialSurroundingText.length()) return null;

        int start = Math.max(0, selectionStart - Math.max(0, beforeLength));
        int end = Math.min(mInitialSurroundingText.length(), selectionEnd + Math.max(0, afterLength));
        CharSequence text = mInitialSurroundingText.subSequence(start, end);

        return new SurroundingText(text, selectionStart - start, selectionEnd - start, mInitialSurroundingOffset + start);
    }

    public void dump(android.util.Printer printer, String prefix)
    {
        printer.println(prefix + "inputType=0x" + Integer.toHexString(inputType) + " imeOptions=0x" + Integer.toHexString(imeOptions)
                        + " privateImeOptions=" + privateImeOptions);
        printer.println(prefix + "actionLabel=" + actionLabel + " actionId=" + actionId);
        printer.println(prefix + "initialSelStart=" + initialSelStart + " initialSelEnd=" + initialSelEnd
                        + " initialCapsMode=0x" + Integer.toHexString(initialCapsMode));
        printer.println(prefix + "hintText=" + hintText + " label=" + label);
        printer.println(prefix + "packageName=" + packageName + " fieldId=" + fieldId + " fieldName=" + fieldName);
        printer.println(prefix + "extras=" + extras);
        printer.println(prefix + "hintLocales=" + hintLocales);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(android.os.Parcel out, int flags)
    {
        out.writeInt(inputType);
        out.writeInt(imeOptions);
        out.writeString(privateImeOptions);
        android.text.TextUtils.writeToParcel(actionLabel, out, flags);
        out.writeInt(actionId);
        out.writeInt(initialSelStart);
        out.writeInt(initialSelEnd);
        out.writeInt(initialCapsMode);
        android.text.TextUtils.writeToParcel(hintText, out, flags);
        android.text.TextUtils.writeToParcel(label, out, flags);
        out.writeString(packageName);
        out.writeInt(fieldId);
        out.writeString(fieldName);
        out.writeBundle(extras);
        out.writeStringArray(contentMimeTypes);
        android.text.TextUtils.writeToParcel(mInitialSurroundingText, out, flags);
        out.writeInt(mInitialSurroundingOffset);
        out.writeInt(mStylusHandwritingEnabled ? 1 : 0);
        out.writeInt(mWritingToolsEnabled ? 1 : 0);
        out.writeInt(mInitialToolType);
    }

    public static final android.os.Parcelable.Creator<EditorInfo> CREATOR = new android.os.Parcelable.Creator<EditorInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public EditorInfo createFromParcel(android.os.Parcel source)
        {
            EditorInfo info = new EditorInfo();
            info.inputType = source.readInt();
            info.imeOptions = source.readInt();
            info.privateImeOptions = source.readString();
            info.actionLabel = android.text.TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            info.actionId = source.readInt();
            info.initialSelStart = source.readInt();
            info.initialSelEnd = source.readInt();
            info.initialCapsMode = source.readInt();
            info.hintText = android.text.TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            info.label = android.text.TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            info.packageName = source.readString();
            info.fieldId = source.readInt();
            info.fieldName = source.readString();
            info.extras = source.readBundle();
            info.contentMimeTypes = source.createStringArray();
            CharSequence surrounding = android.text.TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            info.mInitialSurroundingText = surrounding == null ? "" : surrounding;
            info.mInitialSurroundingOffset = source.readInt();
            info.mStylusHandwritingEnabled = source.readInt() != 0;
            info.mWritingToolsEnabled = source.readInt() != 0;
            info.mInitialToolType = source.readInt();
            return info;
        }

        @Override
        public EditorInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new EditorInfo[size];
        }
    };

    public void setSupportedHandwritingGestures(java.util.List<Class<? extends HandwritingGesture>> gestures)

        mSupportedGestures = gestures == null ? new java.util.ArrayList<>() : new java.util.ArrayList<>(gestures);

    }

    {
        mInitialToolType = toolType;
    }

    public void setInitialSurroundingText(CharSequence text)
    {
        setInitialSurroundingSubText(text, 0);
    }

    public void setInitialSurroundingSubText(CharSequence text, int subTextStart)
    {
        mInitialSurroundingText = text == null ? "" : text;
        mInitialSurroundingOffset = subTextStart;
    }

    public CharSequence getInitialTextBeforeCursor(int length, int flags)
    {
        int end = initialSelStart - mInitialSurroundingOffset;
        if (end <= 0) return "";

        int start = Math.max(0, end - length);
        if (end > mInitialSurroundingText.length()) end = mInitialSurroundingText.length();
        if (start >= end) return "";

        return mInitialSurroundingText.subSequence(start, end);
    }

    public CharSequence getInitialTextAfterCursor(int length, int flags)
    {
        int start = initialSelEnd - mInitialSurroundingOffset;
        if (start < 0) return "";
        if (start >= mInitialSurroundingText.length()) return "";

        int end = Math.min(mInitialSurroundingText.length(), start + length);
        return mInitialSurroundingText.subSequence(start, end);
    }

    public CharSequence getInitialSelectedText(int flags)
    {
        int start = initialSelStart - mInitialSurroundingOffset;
        int end = initialSelEnd - mInitialSurroundingOffset;

        if (start < 0 || end > mInitialSurroundingText.length() || start >= end) return "";

        return mInitialSurroundingText.subSequence(start, end);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "EditorInfo(inputType=" + inputType + " imeOptions=" + imeOptions + " hint=" + hintText + ")";
    }

    private CharSequence mInitialSurroundingText = "";
    private int mInitialSurroundingOffset = 0;
    private java.util.List<Class<? extends HandwritingGesture>> mSupportedGestures = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
    private java.util.Set<Class<? extends PreviewableHandwritingGesture>> mSupportedGesturePreviews = new java.util.HashSet<>();
    private boolean mStylusHandwritingEnabled;
    private int mInitialToolType;
    private boolean mWritingToolsEnabled = true;
    private android.view.autofill.AutofillId mAutofillId;
}
```

```java
package android.view.inputmethod;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.text.TextUtils;

public class ExtractedText implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int FLAG_SINGLE_LINE = 0x0001;
    public static final int FLAG_SELECTING = 0x0002;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<ExtractedText> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ExtractedText>()
    {
        @Override
        public ExtractedText createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            ExtractedText result = new ExtractedText();
            result.text = TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            result.startOffset = source.readInt();
            result.partialStartOffset = source.readInt();
            result.partialEndOffset = source.readInt();
            result.selectionStart = source.readInt();
            result.selectionEnd = source.readInt();
            result.flags = source.readInt();
            result.hint = TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            return result;
        }

        @Override
        public ExtractedText[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ExtractedText[size];
        }
    };

    public CharSequence text;
    public int startOffset;
    public int partialStartOffset;
    public int partialEndOffset;
    public int selectionStart;
    public int selectionEnd;
    public int flags;
    public CharSequence hint;

    public ExtractedText()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int parcelableFlags)
    {
        TextUtils.writeToParcel(text, dest, parcelableFlags);
        dest.writeInt(startOffset);
        dest.writeInt(partialStartOffset);
        dest.writeInt(partialEndOffset);
        dest.writeInt(selectionStart);
        dest.writeInt(selectionEnd);
        dest.writeInt(flags);
        TextUtils.writeToParcel(hint, dest, parcelableFlags);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view.inputmethod;

public abstract class HandwritingGesture
{
    public static final int GRANULARITY_WORD = 1;
    public static final int GRANULARITY_CHARACTER = 2;

    static final int GESTURE_TYPE_NONE = 0x0000;
    static final int GESTURE_TYPE_SELECT = 0x0001;
    static final int GESTURE_TYPE_INSERT = 1 << 1;
    static final int GESTURE_TYPE_DELETE = 1 << 2;
    static final int GESTURE_TYPE_REMOVE_SPACE = 1 << 3;
    static final int GESTURE_TYPE_JOIN_OR_SPLIT = 1 << 4;
    static final int GESTURE_TYPE_SELECT_RANGE = 1 << 5;
    static final int GESTURE_TYPE_DELETE_RANGE = 1 << 6;
    static final int GESTURE_TYPE_INSERT_MODE = 1 << 7;

    int mType = GESTURE_TYPE_NONE;
    String mFallbackText;

    HandwritingGesture()
    {
    }

    public final String getFallbackText()
    {
        return mFallbackText;
    }

    int getGestureType()
    {
        return mType;
    }

    static boolean same(Object first, Object second)
    {
        return first == null ? second == null : first.equals(second);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view.inputmethod;

import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

public final class InputBinding implements Parcelable
{
    private final InputConnection mConnection;
    private final IBinder mConnectionToken;
    private final int mUid;
    private final int mPid;

    public InputBinding(InputConnection connection, IBinder connectionToken, int uid, int pid)
    {
        mConnection = connection;
        mConnectionToken = connectionToken;
        mUid = uid;
        mPid = pid;
    }

    public InputBinding(InputConnection connection, InputBinding binding)
    {
        mConnection = connection;
        mConnectionToken = binding.getConnectionToken();
        mUid = binding.getUid();
        mPid = binding.getPid();
    }

    private InputBinding(Parcel source)
    {
        mConnection = null;
        mConnectionToken = source.readStrongBinder();
        mUid = source.readInt();
        mPid = source.readInt();
    }

    public InputConnection getConnection()
    {
        return mConnection;
    }

    public IBinder getConnectionToken()
    {
        return mConnectionToken;
    }

    public int getUid()
    {
        return mUid;
    }

    public int getPid()
    {
        return mPid;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "InputBinding{" + mConnectionToken + " / uid " + mUid + " / pid " + mPid + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
    {
        out.writeStrongBinder(mConnectionToken);
        out.writeInt(mUid);
        out.writeInt(mPid);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<InputBinding> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<InputBinding>()
    {
        @Override

        {
            return new InputBinding(source);
        }

        @Override
        public InputBinding[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new InputBinding[size];
        }
    };
}
```

```java
package android.view.inputmethod;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.CancellationSignal;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.view.KeyEvent;

import java.util.concurrent.Executor;
import java.util.function.IntConsumer;

public interface InputConnection
{
    int GET_TEXT_WITH_STYLES = 1;
    int GET_EXTRACTED_TEXT_MONITOR = 1;
    int INPUT_CONTENT_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION = 1;

    int CURSOR_UPDATE_IMMEDIATE = 1;
    int CURSOR_UPDATE_MONITOR = 2;
    int CURSOR_UPDATE_FILTER_EDITOR_BOUNDS = 4;
    int CURSOR_UPDATE_FILTER_CHARACTER_BOUNDS = 8;
    int CURSOR_UPDATE_FILTER_INSERTION_MARKER = 16;
    int CURSOR_UPDATE_FILTER_VISIBLE_LINE_BOUNDS = 32;
    int CURSOR_UPDATE_FILTER_TEXT_APPEARANCE = 64;

    int HANDWRITING_GESTURE_RESULT_UNKNOWN = 0;
    int HANDWRITING_GESTURE_RESULT_SUCCESS = 1;
    int HANDWRITING_GESTURE_RESULT_UNSUPPORTED = 2;
    int HANDWRITING_GESTURE_RESULT_FAILED = 3;
    int HANDWRITING_GESTURE_RESULT_CANCELLED = 4;
    int HANDWRITING_GESTURE_RESULT_FALLBACK = 5;

    CharSequence getTextBeforeCursor(int length, int flags);

    CharSequence getTextAfterCursor(int length, int flags);

    CharSequence getSelectedText(int flags);

    int getCursorCapsMode(int reqModes);

    ExtractedText getExtractedText(ExtractedTextRequest request, int flags);

    boolean deleteSurroundingText(int beforeLength, int afterLength);

    boolean deleteSurroundingTextInCodePoints(int beforeLength, int afterLength);

    boolean setComposingText(CharSequence text, int newCursorPosition);

    boolean setComposingRegion(int start, int end);

    boolean finishComposingText();

    boolean commitText(CharSequence text, int newCursorPosition);

    boolean commitCompletion(CompletionInfo text);

    boolean commitCorrection(CorrectionInfo correctionInfo);

    boolean setSelection(int start, int end);

    boolean performEditorAction(int editorAction);

    boolean performContextMenuAction(int id);

    boolean beginBatchEdit();

    boolean endBatchEdit();

    boolean sendKeyEvent(KeyEvent event);

    boolean clearMetaKeyStates(int states);

    boolean reportFullscreenMode(boolean enabled);

    default boolean performSpellCheck()
    {
        return false;
    }

    boolean performPrivateCommand(String action, Bundle data);

    default void performHandwritingGesture(HandwritingGesture gesture, Executor executor, IntConsumer consumer)
    {
        if (executor == null || consumer == null) return;

        executor.execute(() -> consumer.accept(HANDWRITING_GESTURE_RESULT_UNSUPPORTED));
    }

    default boolean previewHandwritingGesture(PreviewableHandwritingGesture gesture, CancellationSignal cancellationSignal)
    {
        return false;
    }

    boolean requestCursorUpdates(int cursorUpdateMode);

    default boolean requestCursorUpdates(int cursorUpdateMode, int cursorUpdateFilter)
    {
        if (cursorUpdateFilter == 0) return requestCursorUpdates(cursorUpdateMode);

        return false;
    }

    default Handler getHandler()
    {
        return null;
    }

    void closeConnection();

    boolean commitContent(InputContentInfo inputContentInfo, int flags, Bundle opts);

    default boolean setImeConsumesInput(boolean imeConsumesInput)
    {
        return false;
    }

    default SurroundingText getSurroundingText(int beforeLength, int afterLength, int flags)
    {
        if (beforeLength < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("beforeLength must be non-negative");
        if (afterLength < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("afterLength must be non-negative");

        CharSequence textBeforeCursor = getTextBeforeCursor(beforeLength, flags);
        if (textBeforeCursor == null) return null;

        CharSequence textAfterCursor = getTextAfterCursor(afterLength, flags);
        if (textAfterCursor == null) return null;

        CharSequence selectedText = getSelectedText(flags);
        if (selectedText == null) selectedText = "";

        CharSequence surroundingText = android.text.TextUtils.concat(textBeforeCursor, selectedText, textAfterCursor);
        return new SurroundingText(surroundingText, textBeforeCursor.length(), textBeforeCursor.length() + selectedText.length(), -1);
    }

    default boolean setComposingText(CharSequence text, int newCursorPosition, TextAttribute textAttribute)
    {
        return setComposingText(text, newCursorPosition);
    }

    default boolean setComposingRegion(int start, int end, TextAttribute textAttribute)
    {
        return setComposingRegion(start, end);
    }

    default boolean commitText(CharSequence text, int newCursorPosition, TextAttribute textAttribute)
    {
        return commitText(text, newCursorPosition);
    }

    default boolean replaceText(int start, int end, CharSequence text, int newCursorPosition, TextAttribute textAttribute)
    {
        if (start < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("start must be non-negative");
        if (end < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("end must be non-negative");

        beginBatchEdit();
        finishComposingText();
        setSelection(start, end);
        commitText(text, newCursorPosition);
        endBatchEdit();
        return true;
    }

    default TextSnapshot takeSnapshot()
    {
        return null;
    }

    default void requestTextBoundsInfo(android.graphics.RectF bounds, Executor executor,
                                       java.util.function.Consumer<TextBoundsInfoResult> consumer)
    {
        if (executor == null || consumer == null) throw new NullPointerException();

        executor.execute(() -> consumer.accept(new TextBoundsInfoResult(TextBoundsInfoResult.CODE_UNSUPPORTED)));
    }
}
```

```java
    public InputContentInfo(Uri contentUri, ClipDescription description, Uri linkUri)
    {
        if (contentUri == null) throw new NullPointerException("contentUri");
        if (description == null) throw new NullPointerException("description");

        mContentUri = contentUri;
        mDescription = description;
        mLinkUri = linkUri;

    }

    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeValue(mContentUri);
        dest.writeValue(mDescription);
        dest.writeValue(mLinkUri);
    }

    public static final Creator<InputContentInfo> CREATOR = new Creator<InputContentInfo>()
    {
```

```java
package android.view.inputmethod;

import android.view.View;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class InputMethodManager
{
    public static final int SHOW_IMPLICIT = 0x0001;
    public static final int SHOW_FORCED = 0x0002;
    public static final int HIDE_IMPLICIT_ONLY = 0x0001;
    public static final int HIDE_NOT_ALWAYS = 0x0002;
    public static final int RESULT_UNCHANGED_SHOWN = 0;
    public static final int RESULT_UNCHANGED_HIDDEN = 1;
    public static final int RESULT_SHOWN = 2;
    public static final int RESULT_HIDDEN = 3;

    private static InputMethodManager sInstance;

    private boolean mVisible;
    private View mServedView;
    private InputConnection mConnection;
    private EditorInfo mEditorInfo;
    private CursorAnchorInfo mCursorAnchorInfo;

    private InputMethodManager()
    {
    }

    public static InputMethodManager getInstance()
    {
        if (sInstance == null) sInstance = new InputMethodManager();

        return sInstance;
    }

    public boolean showSoftInput(View view, int flags)
    {
        startInput(view);
        mVisible = true;

        return true;
    }

    public boolean hideSoftInputFromWindow(android.os.IBinder windowToken, int flags)
    {
        boolean wasVisible = mVisible;
        mVisible = false;

        return wasVisible;
    }

    public boolean isSoftInputVisible()
    {
        return mVisible;
    }

    public void restartInput(View view)
    {
        if (view == mServedView) startInput(view);
    }

    public void startInput(View view)
    {
        if (view == null || !view.onCheckIsTextEditor())
        {
            finishInput();
            return;
        }

        EditorInfo editorInfo = new EditorInfo();
        InputConnection connection = view.onCreateInputConnection(editorInfo);

        if (connection == null)
        {
            finishInput();
            return;
        }

        mServedView = view;
        mConnection = connection;
        mEditorInfo = editorInfo;
    }

    public void finishInput()
    {
        mServedView = null;
        mConnection = null;
        mEditorInfo = null;
        mVisible = false;
    }

    public View getServedView()
    {
        return mServedView;
    }

    public InputConnection getCurrentInputConnection()
    {
        return mConnection;
    }

    public EditorInfo getCurrentEditorInfo()
    {
        return mEditorInfo;
    }

    public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(android.view.KeyEvent event)
    {
        if (mConnection == null || event == null) return false;
        if (event.getAction() != android.view.KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) return false;

        int keyCode = event.getKeyCode();

        if (keyCode == android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DEL || keyCode == android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_FORWARD_DEL)
        {
            CharSequence selected = mConnection.getSelectedText(0);
            if (selected != null && selected.length() > 0) return mConnection.commitText("", 1);

            if (keyCode == android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_FORWARD_DEL) return mConnection.deleteSurroundingText(0, 1);
            return mConnection.deleteSurroundingText(1, 0);
        }

        if (keyCode == android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER || keyCode == android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_ENTER)
        {
            int action = enterAction(mEditorInfo);
            if (action == EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_NONE) return mConnection.commitText("\n", 1);

            return mConnection.performEditorAction(action);
        }

        int character = event.getUnicodeChar();
        if (character == 0) return false;

        return mConnection.commitText(String.valueOf((char)character), 1);
    }

    private static int enterAction(EditorInfo info)
    {
        if (info == null) return EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_NONE;
        if ((info.imeOptions & EditorInfo.IME_FLAG_NO_ENTER_ACTION) != 0) return EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_NONE;
        if (info.actionLabel != null) return info.actionId;

        return info.imeOptions & EditorInfo.IME_MASK_ACTION;
    }

    public void displayCompletions(View view, CompletionInfo[] completions)
    {
    }

    public void updateExtractedText(View view, int token, ExtractedText text)
    {
    }

    public void updateSelection(View view, int selStart, int selEnd, int candidatesStart, int candidatesEnd)
    {
    }

    public boolean isActive()
    {
        return mVisible;
    }

    public boolean isActive(View view)
    {
        return mVisible;
    }

    public boolean isAcceptingText()
    {
        return mVisible;
    }

    public void toggleSoftInput(int showFlags, int hideFlags)
    {
        mVisible = !mVisible;
    }

    public List<InputMethodSubtype> getEnabledInputMethodSubtypeList(InputMethodInfo imi, boolean allowsImplicitlyEnabledSubtypes)
    {
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public InputMethodSubtype getCurrentInputMethodSubtype()
    {
        return null;
    }

    public List<InputMethodInfo> getInputMethodList()
    {
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public List<InputMethodInfo> getEnabledInputMethodList()

    public void dispatchKeyEventFromInputMethod(View targetView, android.view.KeyEvent event)
```

```java
package android.view.inputmethod;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import java.util.Objects;

public final class InputMethodSubtype implements Parcelable
{
    private final int mNameResId;
    private final int mIconResId;
    private final String mLocale;
    private final String mMode;
    private final String mExtraValue;
    private final boolean mAuxiliary;
    private final boolean mOverridesImplicitlyEnabledSubtype;
    private final int mSubtypeId;

    public InputMethodSubtype(int nameId, int iconId, String locale, String mode, String extraValue, boolean isAuxiliary,
                              boolean overridesImplicitlyEnabledSubtype)
    {
        this(nameId, iconId, locale, mode, extraValue, isAuxiliary, overridesImplicitlyEnabledSubtype, 0);
    }

    public InputMethodSubtype(int nameId, int iconId, String locale, String mode, String extraValue, boolean isAuxiliary,
                              boolean overridesImplicitlyEnabledSubtype, int id)
    {
        mNameResId = nameId;
        mIconResId = iconId;
        mLocale = locale == null ? "" : locale;
        mMode = mode == null ? "" : mode;
        mExtraValue = extraValue == null ? "" : extraValue;
        mAuxiliary = isAuxiliary;
        mOverridesImplicitlyEnabledSubtype = overridesImplicitlyEnabledSubtype;
        mSubtypeId = id != 0 ? id : Objects.hash(mLocale, mMode, mExtraValue, mAuxiliary, mOverridesImplicitlyEnabledSubtype);
    }

    public int getNameResId()
    {
        return mNameResId;
    }

    public CharSequence getNameOverride()
    {
        return "";
    }

    public String getPhysicalKeyboardHintLayoutType()
    {
        return "";
    }

    public int getLayoutLabelResource()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public CharSequence getLayoutLabelNonLocalized()
    {
        return "";
    }

    public CharSequence getLayoutDisplayName(Context context, ApplicationInfo imeAppInfo)
    {
        return getLayoutLabelNonLocalized();
    }

    public int getIconResId()
    {
        return mIconResId;
    }

    public String getLocale()
    {
        return mLocale;
    }

    public String getLanguageTag()
    {
        return mLocale.replace('_', '-');
    }

    public String getMode()
    {
        return mMode;
    }

    public String getExtraValue()
    {
        return mExtraValue;
    }

    public boolean isAuxiliary()
    {
        return mAuxiliary;
    }

    public boolean overridesImplicitlyEnabledSubtype()
    {
        return mOverridesImplicitlyEnabledSubtype;
    }

    public boolean isAsciiCapable()
    {
        return containsExtraValueKey("AsciiCapable");
    }

    public CharSequence getDisplayName(Context context, String packageName, ApplicationInfo appInfo)
    {
        String locale = getLanguageTag();
        String localeName = locale.isEmpty() ? "" : java.util.Locale.forLanguageTag(locale).getDisplayName();

        if (mNameResId == 0 || context == null) return localeName;

        CharSequence name;
        try
        {
            name = context.getResources().getText(mNameResId);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception)
        {
            return localeName;
        }

        if (name == null) return localeName;

        String text = name.toString();
        if (!text.contains("%s")) return text;

        return String.format(text, localeName);
    }

    public boolean containsExtraValueKey(String key)
    {
        return getExtraValueOf(key) != null || hasBareKey(key);
    }

    private boolean hasBareKey(String key)
    {
        for (String pair : mExtraValue.split(","))
        {
            if (pair.equals(key)) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public String getExtraValueOf(String key)
    {
        for (String pair : mExtraValue.split(","))
        {
            int separator = pair.indexOf('=');
            if (separator > 0 && pair.substring(0, separator).equals(key)) return pair.substring(separator + 1);
        }

        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return mSubtypeId;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof InputMethodSubtype)) return false;

        InputMethodSubtype that = (InputMethodSubtype)other;
        return mSubtypeId == that.mSubtypeId && mLocale.equals(that.mLocale) && mMode.equals(that.mMode)
            && mExtraValue.equals(that.mExtraValue) && mAuxiliary == that.mAuxiliary;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mNameResId);
        dest.writeInt(mIconResId);
        dest.writeString(mLocale);
        dest.writeString(mMode);
        dest.writeString(mExtraValue);
        dest.writeInt(mAuxiliary ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeInt(mOverridesImplicitlyEnabledSubtype ? 1 : 0);
        dest.writeInt(mSubtypeId);
    }

    public static final Creator<InputMethodSubtype> CREATOR = new Creator<InputMethodSubtype>()
    {
        @Override
        public InputMethodSubtype createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int nameId = source.readInt();
            int iconId = source.readInt();
            String locale = source.readString();
            String mode = source.readString();
            String extraValue = source.readString();
            boolean auxiliary = source.readInt() != 0;
            boolean overrides = source.readInt() != 0;
            int id = source.readInt();
            return new InputMethodSubtype(nameId, iconId, locale, mode, extraValue, auxiliary, overrides, id);
        }

        @Override
        public InputMethodSubtype[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new InputMethodSubtype[size];
        }
    };
}
```

```java
package android.view.inputmethod;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.text.TextUtils;

public final class SurroundingText implements Parcelable
{
    private final CharSequence mText;
    private final int mSelectionStart;
    private final int mSelectionEnd;
    private final int mOffset;

    public SurroundingText(CharSequence text, int selectionStart, int selectionEnd, int offset)
    {
        mText = text == null ? "" : copy(text);
        mSelectionStart = selectionStart;
        mSelectionEnd = selectionEnd;
        mOffset = offset;
    }

    private static CharSequence copy(CharSequence text)
    {
        return text instanceof android.text.Spanned ? new android.text.SpannableString(text) : text.toString();
    }

    public CharSequence getText()
    {
        return mText;
    }

    public int getSelectionStart()
    {
        return mSelectionStart;
    }

    public int getSelectionEnd()
    {
        return mSelectionEnd;
    }

    public int getOffset()
    {
        return mOffset;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
    {
        TextUtils.writeToParcel(mText, out, flags);
        out.writeInt(mSelectionStart);
        out.writeInt(mSelectionEnd);
        out.writeInt(mOffset);
    }

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<SurroundingText> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<SurroundingText>()
    {
        @Override
        public SurroundingText createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            CharSequence text = TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            int selectionStart = source.readInt();
            int selectionEnd = source.readInt();
            int offset = source.readInt();
            return new SurroundingText(text, selectionStart, selectionEnd, offset);
        }

        @Override
        public SurroundingText[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new SurroundingText[size];
        }
    };
}
```

```java
    @Override

    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof TextAppearanceInfo)) return false;

        TextAppearanceInfo that = (TextAppearanceInfo)other;

               && mAllCaps == that.mAllCaps && Float.compare(that.mShadowDx, mShadowDx) == 0
               && Float.compare(that.mShadowDy, mShadowDy) == 0 && Float.compare(that.mShadowRadius, mShadowRadius) == 0
               && mShadowColor == that.mShadowColor && mElegantTextHeight == that.mElegantTextHeight
               && mFallbackLineSpacing == that.mFallbackLineSpacing && Float.compare(that.mLetterSpacing, mLetterSpacing) == 0
               && mLineBreakStyle == that.mLineBreakStyle && mLineBreakWordStyle == that.mLineBreakWordStyle
               && Float.compare(that.mTextScaleX, mTextScaleX) == 0 && mHighlightTextColor == that.mHighlightTextColor
               && mTextColor == that.mTextColor && mLinkTextColor == that.mLinkTextColor && mHintTextColor == that.mHintTextColor
               && Objects.equals(languageTags(mTextLocales), languageTags(that.mTextLocales))
               && Objects.equals(mSystemFontFamilyName, that.mSystemFontFamilyName)
```

```java
package android.view.inputmethod;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.os.PersistableBundle;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

public final class TextAttribute implements Parcelable
{
    public static final Parcelable.Creator<TextAttribute> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<TextAttribute>()
    {
        @Override
        public TextAttribute createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            List<String> suggestions = source.createStringArrayList();
            PersistableBundle extras = source.readPersistableBundle();
            return new TextAttribute(suggestions, extras);
        }

        @Override
        public TextAttribute[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new TextAttribute[size];
        }
    };

    private final List<String> mTextConversionSuggestions;
    private final PersistableBundle mExtras;

    private TextAttribute(List<String> textConversionSuggestions, PersistableBundle extras)
    {
        mTextConversionSuggestions = textConversionSuggestions == null ? new ArrayList<String>()
                                                                       : new ArrayList<>(textConversionSuggestions);
        mExtras = extras == null ? new PersistableBundle() : extras;
    }

    public List<String> getTextConversionSuggestions()
    {
        return Collections.unmodifiableList(mTextConversionSuggestions);
    }

    public PersistableBundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeStringList(mTextConversionSuggestions);
        dest.writePersistableBundle(mExtras);
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private List<String> mTextConversionSuggestions = new ArrayList<>();
        private PersistableBundle mExtras = new PersistableBundle();

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public Builder setTextConversionSuggestions(List<String> textConversionSuggestions)
        {
            mTextConversionSuggestions = Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(textConversionSuggestions));
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setExtras(PersistableBundle extras)
        {
            mExtras = extras;
            return this;
        }

        public TextAttribute build()
        {
            return new TextAttribute(mTextConversionSuggestions, mExtras);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/inputmethod/TextBoundsInfo.java`:

```java
package android.view.inputmethod;

import android.graphics.Matrix;
import android.graphics.RectF;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.text.Layout;
import android.text.SegmentFinder;

import java.util.Arrays;

public final class TextBoundsInfo implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int FLAG_CHARACTER_WHITESPACE = 1;
    public static final int FLAG_CHARACTER_LINEFEED = 1 << 1;
    public static final int FLAG_CHARACTER_PUNCTUATION = 1 << 2;
    public static final int FLAG_LINE_IS_RTL = 1 << 3;

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<TextBoundsInfo> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<TextBoundsInfo>()
    {
        @Override
        public TextBoundsInfo createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            int start = source.readInt();
            int end = source.readInt();
            float[] matrix = source.createFloatArray();
            float[] bounds = source.createFloatArray();
            int[] flags = source.createIntArray();
            int[] bidiLevels = source.createIntArray();
            SegmentFinder grapheme = new RangeSegmentFinder(source.createIntArray());
            SegmentFinder word = new RangeSegmentFinder(source.createIntArray());
            SegmentFinder line = new RangeSegmentFinder(source.createIntArray());

            return new TextBoundsInfo(start, end, matrix, bounds, flags, bidiLevels, grapheme, word, line);
        }

        @Override
        public TextBoundsInfo[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new TextBoundsInfo[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mStart;
    private final int mEnd;
    private final float[] mMatrixValues;
    private final float[] mCharacterBounds;
    private final int[] mCharacterFlags;
    private final int[] mCharacterBidiLevels;
    private final SegmentFinder mGraphemeSegmentFinder;
    private final SegmentFinder mWordSegmentFinder;
    private final SegmentFinder mLineSegmentFinder;

    private TextBoundsInfo(int start, int end, float[] matrixValues, float[] characterBounds, int[] characterFlags, int[] bidiLevels,
                           SegmentFinder grapheme, SegmentFinder word, SegmentFinder line)
    {
        mStart = start;
        mEnd = end;
        mMatrixValues = matrixValues;
        mCharacterBounds = characterBounds;
        mCharacterFlags = characterFlags;
        mCharacterBidiLevels = bidiLevels;
        mGraphemeSegmentFinder = grapheme;
        mWordSegmentFinder = word;
        mLineSegmentFinder = line;
    }

    public void getMatrix(Matrix matrix)
    {
        if (matrix == null) throw new NullPointerException("matrix");

        matrix.setValues(mMatrixValues);
    }

    public int getStartIndex()
    {
        return mStart;
    }

    public int getEndIndex()
    {
        return mEnd;
    }

    private int checkIndex(int index)
    {
        if (index < mStart || index >= mEnd)
        {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Index is out of the bounds of [" + mStart + ", " + mEnd + ").");
        }

        return index - mStart;
    }

    public void getCharacterBounds(int index, RectF bounds)
    {
        int offset = checkIndex(index) * 4;
        bounds.set(mCharacterBounds[offset], mCharacterBounds[offset + 1], mCharacterBounds[offset + 2], mCharacterBounds[offset + 3]);
    }

    public int getCharacterFlags(int index)
    {
        return mCharacterFlags[checkIndex(index)];
    }

    public int getCharacterBidiLevel(int index)
    {
        return mCharacterBidiLevels[checkIndex(index)];
    }

    public SegmentFinder getGraphemeSegmentFinder()
    {
        return mGraphemeSegmentFinder;
    }

    public SegmentFinder getWordSegmentFinder()
    {
        return mWordSegmentFinder;
    }

    public SegmentFinder getLineSegmentFinder()
    {
        return mLineSegmentFinder;
    }

    public int getOffsetForPosition(float x, float y)
    {
        int best = -1;
        float bestDistance = Float.MAX_VALUE;
        boolean bestAfter = false;

        for (int index = 0; index < mEnd - mStart; index++)
        {
            float left = mCharacterBounds[index * 4];
            float top = mCharacterBounds[index * 4 + 1];
            float right = mCharacterBounds[index * 4 + 2];
            float bottom = mCharacterBounds[index * 4 + 3];

            if (y < top || y > bottom) continue;

            float center = (left + right) / 2;
            float distance = x < left ? left - x : (x > right ? x - right : 0);

            if (distance < bestDistance)
            {
                bestDistance = distance;
                best = index;

                boolean rtl = (mCharacterBidiLevels[index] & 1) != 0;
                bestAfter = rtl ? x < center : x > center;
            }
        }

        if (best < 0) return -1;

        return mStart + best + (bestAfter ? 1 : 0);
    }

    public int[] getRangeForRect(RectF area, SegmentFinder segmentFinder, Layout.TextInclusionStrategy inclusionStrategy)
    {
        int rangeStart = -1;
        int rangeEnd = -1;
        int start = segmentFinder.nextStartBoundary(mStart - 1);
        RectF segmentBounds = new RectF();

        while (start != SegmentFinder.DONE && start < mEnd)
        {
            int end = segmentFinder.nextEndBoundary(start);
            if (end == SegmentFinder.DONE) break;

            segmentBounds.setEmpty();
            boolean first = true;

            for (int index = Math.max(start, mStart); index < Math.min(end, mEnd); index++)
            {
                int offset = (index - mStart) * 4;
                RectF character = new RectF(mCharacterBounds[offset], mCharacterBounds[offset + 1], mCharacterBounds[offset + 2],
                                            mCharacterBounds[offset + 3]);

                if (first) segmentBounds.set(character);
                else segmentBounds.union(character);

                first = false;
            }

            if (!first && inclusionStrategy.isSegmentInside(segmentBounds, area))
            {
                if (rangeStart < 0) rangeStart = start;
                rangeEnd = end;
            }

            start = segmentFinder.nextStartBoundary(start);
        }

        return rangeStart < 0 ? null : new int[] {rangeStart, rangeEnd};
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mStart);
        dest.writeInt(mEnd);
        dest.writeFloatArray(mMatrixValues);
        dest.writeFloatArray(mCharacterBounds);
        dest.writeIntArray(mCharacterFlags);
        dest.writeIntArray(mCharacterBidiLevels);
        dest.writeIntArray(encode(mGraphemeSegmentFinder));
        dest.writeIntArray(encode(mWordSegmentFinder));
        dest.writeIntArray(encode(mLineSegmentFinder));
    }

    private int[] encode(SegmentFinder finder)
    {
        int[] ranges = new int[8];
        int count = 0;
        int start = finder.nextStartBoundary(mStart - 1);

        while (start != SegmentFinder.DONE && start < mEnd)
        {
            int end = finder.nextEndBoundary(start);
            if (end == SegmentFinder.DONE) break;

            if (count + 2 > ranges.length) ranges = Arrays.copyOf(ranges, ranges.length * 2);
            ranges[count++] = start;
            ranges[count++] = end;

            start = finder.nextStartBoundary(start);
        }

        return Arrays.copyOf(ranges, count);
    }

    private static final class RangeSegmentFinder extends SegmentFinder
    {
        private final int[] mRanges;

        RangeSegmentFinder(int[] ranges)
        {
            mRanges = ranges == null ? new int[0] : ranges;
        }

        @Override
        public int previousStartBoundary(int offset)
        {
            for (int index = mRanges.length - 2; index >= 0; index -= 2)
            {
                if (mRanges[index] < offset) return mRanges[index];
            }

            return DONE;
        }

        @Override
        public int previousEndBoundary(int offset)
        {
            for (int index = mRanges.length - 1; index >= 1; index -= 2)
            {
                if (mRanges[index] < offset) return mRanges[index];
            }

            return DONE;
        }

        @Override
        public int nextStartBoundary(int offset)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < mRanges.length; index += 2)
            {
                if (mRanges[index] > offset) return mRanges[index];
            }

            return DONE;
        }

        @Override
        public int nextEndBoundary(int offset)
        {
            for (int index = 1; index < mRanges.length; index += 2)
            {
                if (mRanges[index] > offset) return mRanges[index];
            }

            return DONE;
        }
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private int mStart = -1;
        private int mEnd = -1;
        private float[] mMatrixValues;
        private float[] mCharacterBounds;
        private int[] mCharacterFlags;
        private int[] mCharacterBidiLevels;
        private SegmentFinder mGraphemeSegmentFinder;
        private SegmentFinder mWordSegmentFinder;
        private SegmentFinder mLineSegmentFinder;

        public Builder(int start, int end)
        {
            setStartAndEnd(start, end);
        }

        public Builder clear()
        {
            mStart = -1;
            mEnd = -1;
            mMatrixValues = null;
            mCharacterBounds = null;
            mCharacterFlags = null;
            mCharacterBidiLevels = null;
            mGraphemeSegmentFinder = null;
            mWordSegmentFinder = null;
            mLineSegmentFinder = null;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setMatrix(Matrix matrix)
        {
            if (mMatrixValues == null) mMatrixValues = new float[9];

            if (matrix == null) Matrix.IDENTITY_MATRIX.getValues(mMatrixValues);
            else matrix.getValues(mMatrixValues);

            return this;
        }

        public Builder setStartAndEnd(int start, int end)
        {
            if (start < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("start must be greater or equal to 0");
            if (start > end) throw new IllegalArgumentException("end must be greater or equal to start");

            mStart = start;
            mEnd = end;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setCharacterBounds(float[] characterBounds)
        {
            if (characterBounds == null) throw new NullPointerException("characterBounds");

            mCharacterBounds = characterBounds;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setCharacterFlags(int[] characterFlags)
        {
            if (characterFlags == null) throw new NullPointerException("characterFlags");

            for (int flag : characterFlags)
            {
                if ((flag & ~(FLAG_CHARACTER_WHITESPACE | FLAG_CHARACTER_LINEFEED | FLAG_CHARACTER_PUNCTUATION | FLAG_LINE_IS_RTL)) != 0)
                {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("characterFlags contains invalid flags.");
                }
            }

            mCharacterFlags = characterFlags;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setCharacterBidiLevel(int[] characterBidiLevels)
        {
            if (characterBidiLevels == null) throw new NullPointerException("characterBidiLevels");

            mCharacterBidiLevels = characterBidiLevels;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setGraphemeSegmentFinder(SegmentFinder graphemeSegmentFinder)
        {
            if (graphemeSegmentFinder == null) throw new NullPointerException("graphemeSegmentFinder");

            mGraphemeSegmentFinder = graphemeSegmentFinder;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setWordSegmentFinder(SegmentFinder wordSegmentFinder)
        {
            if (wordSegmentFinder == null) throw new NullPointerException("wordSegmentFinder");

            mWordSegmentFinder = wordSegmentFinder;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setLineSegmentFinder(SegmentFinder lineSegmentFinder)
        {
            if (lineSegmentFinder == null) throw new NullPointerException("lineSegmentFinder");

            mLineSegmentFinder = lineSegmentFinder;
            return this;
        }

        public TextBoundsInfo build()
        {
            if (mStart < 0 || mEnd < 0) throw new IllegalStateException("Start and end must be set.");
            if (mMatrixValues == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Matrix must be set.");
            if (mCharacterBounds == null) throw new IllegalStateException("CharacterBounds must be set.");
            if (mCharacterFlags == null) throw new IllegalStateException("CharacterFlags must be set.");
            if (mCharacterBidiLevels == null) throw new IllegalStateException("CharacterBidiLevel must be set.");
            if (mGraphemeSegmentFinder == null) throw new IllegalStateException("GraphemeSegmentFinder must be set.");
            if (mWordSegmentFinder == null) throw new IllegalStateException("WordSegmentFinder must be set.");
            if (mLineSegmentFinder == null) throw new IllegalStateException("LineSegmentFinder must be set.");

            int length = mEnd - mStart;
            if (mCharacterBounds.length != length * 4)
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException("The length of characterBounds doesn't match the length of the given start and end.");
            }

            if (mCharacterFlags.length != length)
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException("The length of characterFlags doesn't match the length of the given start and end.");
            }

            if (mCharacterBidiLevels.length != length)
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException("The length of characterBidiLevels doesn't match the length of the given start and end.");
            }

            return new TextBoundsInfo(mStart, mEnd, mMatrixValues.clone(), mCharacterBounds.clone(), mCharacterFlags.clone(),
                                      mCharacterBidiLevels.clone(), mGraphemeSegmentFinder, mWordSegmentFinder, mLineSegmentFinder);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.view.inputmethod;

public final class TextBoundsInfoResult
{
    public static final int CODE_UNSUPPORTED = 0;
    public static final int CODE_SUCCESS = 1;
    public static final int CODE_FAILED = 2;
    public static final int CODE_CANCELLED = 3;

    private final int mResultCode;
    private final TextBoundsInfo mTextBoundsInfo;

    public TextBoundsInfoResult(int resultCode)
    {
        this(resultCode, null);
    }

    public TextBoundsInfoResult(int resultCode, TextBoundsInfo textBoundsInfo)
    {
        if (resultCode == CODE_SUCCESS && textBoundsInfo == null)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("TextBoundsInfo must be provided when the resultCode is CODE_SUCCESS.");
        }

        mResultCode = resultCode;
        mTextBoundsInfo = textBoundsInfo;
    }

    public int getResultCode()
    {
        return mResultCode;
    }

    public TextBoundsInfo getTextBoundsInfo()
    {
        return mTextBoundsInfo;
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/inputmethod/TextSnapshot.java`:

```java
package android.view.inputmethod;

public final class TextSnapshot
{
    private final SurroundingText mSurroundingText;
    private final int mCompositionStart;
    private final int mCompositionEnd;
    private final int mCursorCapsMode;

    public TextSnapshot(SurroundingText surroundingText, int compositionStart, int compositionEnd, int cursorCapsMode)
    {
        if (surroundingText == null) throw new NullPointerException("surroundingText");
        if (compositionStart < -1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("compositionStart must be -1 or higher but was " + compositionStart);
        if (compositionEnd < -1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("compositionEnd must be -1 or higher but was " + compositionEnd);

        if (compositionStart == -1 && compositionEnd != -1)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("compositionEnd must be -1 if compositionStart is -1 but was " + compositionEnd);
        }

        if (compositionStart != -1 && compositionEnd == -1)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("compositionStart must be -1 if compositionEnd is -1 but was " + compositionStart);
        }

        if (compositionStart > compositionEnd)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("compositionStart=" + compositionStart + " must be equal to or greater than compositionEnd="
                                               + compositionEnd);
        }

        mSurroundingText = surroundingText;
        mCompositionStart = compositionStart;
        mCompositionEnd = compositionEnd;
        mCursorCapsMode = cursorCapsMode;
    }

    public SurroundingText getSurroundingText()
    {
        return mSurroundingText;
    }

    public int getSelectionStart()
    {
        return mSurroundingText.getOffset() < 0 ? -1 : mSurroundingText.getSelectionStart() + mSurroundingText.getOffset();
    }

    public int getSelectionEnd()
    {
        return mSurroundingText.getOffset() < 0 ? -1 : mSurroundingText.getSelectionEnd() + mSurroundingText.getOffset();
    }

    public int getCompositionStart()
    {
        return mCompositionStart;
    }

    public int getCompositionEnd()
    {
        return mCompositionEnd;
    }

    public int getCursorCapsMode()
    {
        return mCursorCapsMode;
    }
}
```

`java/android/view/inspector/IntFlagMapping.java`:

```java
package android.view.inspector;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

public final class IntFlagMapping
{
    private final ArrayList<Flag> mFlags = new ArrayList<>();

    public IntFlagMapping()
    {
    }

    public Set<String> get(int value)
    {
        HashSet<String> enabledFlagNames = new HashSet<>(mFlags.size());

        for (Flag flag : mFlags)
        {
            if ((value & flag.mMask) == flag.mTarget) enabledFlagNames.add(flag.mName);
        }

        return enabledFlagNames;
    }

    public void add(int mask, int target, String name)
    {
        mFlags.add(new Flag(mask, target, name));
    }

    private static final class Flag
    {
        final int mMask;
        final int mTarget;
        final String mName;

        Flag(int mask, int target, String name)
        {
            mTarget = target;
            mMask = mask;
            mName = name;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    int mapColor(String name, int attributeId);

    int mapGravity(String name, int attributeId);

    int mapIntEnum(String name, int attributeId, IntFunction<String> mapping);

    int mapResourceId(String name, int attributeId);

    int mapIntFlag(String name, int attributeId, IntFunction<Set<String>> mapping);

    class PropertyConflictException extends RuntimeException
    {
        public PropertyConflictException(String name, String newPropertyType, String existingPropertyType)
        {
            super(String.format("Attempted to map property \"%s\" as type %s, but it is already mapped as %s.", name, newPropertyType,
                                existingPropertyType));
        }
    }
```

`java/android/view/textclassifier/EntityConfidence.java`:

```java
package android.view.textclassifier;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

final class EntityConfidence
{
    private final HashMap<String, Float> mScores = new HashMap<>();
    private final ArrayList<String> mSortedEntities = new ArrayList<>();

    EntityConfidence()
    {
    }

    EntityConfidence(Map<String, Float> scores)
    {
        if (scores != null) mScores.putAll(scores);

        mSortedEntities.addAll(mScores.keySet());
        mSortedEntities.sort((first, second) -> Float.compare(mScores.get(second), mScores.get(first)));
    }

    List<String> getEntities()
    {
        return new ArrayList<>(mSortedEntities);
    }

    int getEntityCount()
    {
        return mSortedEntities.size();
    }

    String getEntity(int index)
    {
        return mSortedEntities.get(index);
    }

    float getConfidenceScore(String entity)
    {
        Float score = mScores.get(entity);
        return score == null ? 0 : score.floatValue();
    }

    Map<String, Float> toMap()
    {
        return new HashMap<>(mScores);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return mScores.toString();
    }
}
```

```java
public final class SelectionEvent implements Parcelable

    public static final int ACTION_OVERTYPE = 100;
    public static final int ACTION_COPY = 101;
    public static final int ACTION_PASTE = 102;
    public static final int ACTION_CUT = 103;
    public static final int ACTION_SHARE = 104;
    public static final int ACTION_SMART_SHARE = 105;
    public static final int ACTION_DRAG = 106;
    public static final int ACTION_ABANDON = 107;
    public static final int ACTION_OTHER = 108;
    public static final int ACTION_SELECT_ALL = 200;
    public static final int ACTION_RESET = 201;

    public static final int EVENT_SELECTION_STARTED = 1;
    public static final int EVENT_SELECTION_MODIFIED = 2;
    public static final int EVENT_SMART_SELECTION_SINGLE = 3;
    public static final int EVENT_SMART_SELECTION_MULTI = 4;
    public static final int EVENT_AUTO_SELECTION = 5;

    public static final int INVOCATION_UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final int INVOCATION_MANUAL = 1;
    public static final int INVOCATION_LINK = 2;

    private final int mAbsoluteStart;
    private final int mAbsoluteEnd;
    private final int mEventType;
    private final String mEntityType;
    private final int mInvocationMethod;
    private final String mResultId;
    private final long mEventTime;
    private String mPackageName = "";
    private String mWidgetType = TextClassifier.WIDGET_TYPE_UNKNOWN;
    private String mWidgetVersion;
    private long mDurationSinceSessionStart;
    private long mDurationSincePreviousEvent;
    private int mEventIndex;
    private TextClassificationSessionId mSessionId;
    private int mStart;
    private int mEnd;
    private int mSmartStart;
    private int mSmartEnd;

    private SelectionEvent(int start, int end, int eventType, String entityType, int invocationMethod, String resultId)
    {
        mAbsoluteStart = start;
        mAbsoluteEnd = end;
        mEventType = eventType;
        mEntityType = entityType == null ? TextClassifier.TYPE_UNKNOWN : entityType;
        mInvocationMethod = invocationMethod;
        mResultId = resultId;
        mEventTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
    }

    public static SelectionEvent createSelectionStartedEvent(int invocationMethod, int start)
    {
        return new SelectionEvent(start, start + 1, EVENT_SELECTION_STARTED, TextClassifier.TYPE_UNKNOWN, invocationMethod, null);
    }

    public static SelectionEvent createSelectionModifiedEvent(int start, int end)
    {
        checkRange(start, end);
        return new SelectionEvent(start, end, EVENT_SELECTION_MODIFIED, TextClassifier.TYPE_UNKNOWN, INVOCATION_UNKNOWN, null);
    }

    public static SelectionEvent createSelectionModifiedEvent(int start, int end, TextClassification classification)
    {
        checkRange(start, end);
        String entityType = classification.getEntityCount() > 0 ? classification.getEntity(0) : TextClassifier.TYPE_UNKNOWN;
        return new SelectionEvent(start, end, EVENT_SELECTION_MODIFIED, entityType, INVOCATION_UNKNOWN, classification.getId());
    }

    public static SelectionEvent createSelectionModifiedEvent(int start, int end, TextSelection selection)
    {
        checkRange(start, end);
        String entityType = selection.getEntityCount() > 0 ? selection.getEntity(0) : TextClassifier.TYPE_UNKNOWN;
        return new SelectionEvent(start, end, EVENT_AUTO_SELECTION, entityType, INVOCATION_UNKNOWN, selection.getId());
    }

    public static SelectionEvent createSelectionActionEvent(int start, int end, int actionType)
    {
        checkRange(start, end);
        return new SelectionEvent(start, end, actionType, TextClassifier.TYPE_UNKNOWN, INVOCATION_UNKNOWN, null);
    }

    public static SelectionEvent createSelectionActionEvent(int start, int end, int actionType, TextClassification classification)
    {
        checkRange(start, end);
        String entityType = classification.getEntityCount() > 0 ? classification.getEntity(0) : TextClassifier.TYPE_UNKNOWN;
        return new SelectionEvent(start, end, actionType, entityType, INVOCATION_UNKNOWN, classification.getId());
    }

    private static void checkRange(int start, int end)
    {
        if (end < start) throw new IllegalArgumentException("end cannot be less than start");
    }

    public static boolean isTerminal(int eventType)
    {
        switch (eventType)
        {
        case ACTION_OVERTYPE:
        case ACTION_COPY:
        case ACTION_PASTE:
        case ACTION_CUT:
        case ACTION_SHARE:
        case ACTION_SMART_SHARE:
        case ACTION_DRAG:
        case ACTION_ABANDON:
        case ACTION_OTHER:
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
        }
    }

    public int getEventType()
    {
        return mEventType;
    }

    public String getEntityType()
    {
        return mEntityType;
    }

    public String getPackageName()
    {
        return mPackageName;
    }

    public String getWidgetType()
    {
        return mWidgetType;
    }

    public String getWidgetVersion()
    {
        return mWidgetVersion;
    }

    public int getInvocationMethod()
    {
        return mInvocationMethod;
    }

    public String getResultId()
    {
        return mResultId;
    }

    public long getEventTime()
    {
        return mEventTime;
    }

    public long getDurationSinceSessionStart()
    {
        return mDurationSinceSessionStart;
    }

    public long getDurationSincePreviousEvent()
    {
        return mDurationSincePreviousEvent;
    }

    public int getEventIndex()
    {
        return mEventIndex;
    }

    public TextClassificationSessionId getSessionId()
    {
        return mSessionId;
    }

    public int getStart()
    {
        return mStart;
    }

    public int getEnd()
    {
        return mEnd;
    }

    public int getSmartStart()
    {
        return mSmartStart;
    }

    public int getSmartEnd()
    {
        return mSmartEnd;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return Objects.hash(mAbsoluteStart, mAbsoluteEnd, mEventType, mEntityType, mWidgetVersion, mPackageName, mWidgetType,
                            mInvocationMethod, mResultId, mEventTime, mEventIndex, mSessionId, mStart, mEnd, mSmartStart, mSmartEnd);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof SelectionEvent)) return false;

        SelectionEvent that = (SelectionEvent)other;
        return mAbsoluteStart == that.mAbsoluteStart && mAbsoluteEnd == that.mAbsoluteEnd && mEventType == that.mEventType
            && Objects.equals(mEntityType, that.mEntityType) && Objects.equals(mWidgetVersion, that.mWidgetVersion)
            && Objects.equals(mPackageName, that.mPackageName) && Objects.equals(mWidgetType, that.mWidgetType)
            && mInvocationMethod == that.mInvocationMethod && Objects.equals(mResultId, that.mResultId) && mEventTime == that.mEventTime
            && mEventIndex == that.mEventIndex && Objects.equals(mSessionId, that.mSessionId) && mStart == that.mStart
            && mEnd == that.mEnd && mSmartStart == that.mSmartStart && mSmartEnd == that.mSmartEnd;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "SelectionEvent {absoluteStart=" + mAbsoluteStart + ", absoluteEnd=" + mAbsoluteEnd + ", eventType=" + mEventType
               + ", entityType=" + mEntityType + ", invocationMethod=" + mInvocationMethod + ", resultId=" + mResultId + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

        dest.writeInt(mAbsoluteStart);

        dest.writeInt(mEventType);
        dest.writeString(mEntityType);
        dest.writeInt(mInvocationMethod);
        dest.writeString(mResultId);
```
