```java
    public static final class Request implements Parcelable
    {
        private final CharSequence mText;
        private final int mStartIndex;
        private final int mEndIndex;
        private final LocaleList mDefaultLocales;
        private final ZonedDateTime mReferenceTime;
        private final Bundle mExtras;
        private String mCallingPackageName;

        private Request(CharSequence text, int startIndex, int endIndex, LocaleList defaultLocales, ZonedDateTime referenceTime,
                        Bundle extras)
        {
            mText = text;
            mStartIndex = startIndex;
            mEndIndex = endIndex;
            mDefaultLocales = defaultLocales;
            mReferenceTime = referenceTime;
            mExtras = extras == null ? Bundle.EMPTY : extras;
        }

        public CharSequence getText()
        {
            return mText;
        }

        public int getStartIndex()
        {
            return mStartIndex;
        }

        public int getEndIndex()
        {
            return mEndIndex;
        }

        public LocaleList getDefaultLocales()
        {
            return mDefaultLocales;
        }

        public ZonedDateTime getReferenceTime()
        {
            return mReferenceTime;
        }

        public String getCallingPackageName()
        {
            return mCallingPackageName;
        }

        public Bundle getExtras()
        {
            return mExtras;
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
        {
            dest.writeValue(mText);
            dest.writeInt(mStartIndex);
            dest.writeInt(mEndIndex);
            dest.writeValue(mDefaultLocales);
            dest.writeValue(mReferenceTime);
            dest.writeBundle(mExtras);
            dest.writeString(mCallingPackageName);
        }

        public static final Creator<Request> CREATOR = new Creator<Request>()
        {
            @Override
            public Request createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                CharSequence text = (CharSequence)source.readValue(null);
                int startIndex = source.readInt();
                int endIndex = source.readInt();
                LocaleList locales = (LocaleList)source.readValue(null);
                ZonedDateTime referenceTime = (ZonedDateTime)source.readValue(null);
                Bundle extras = source.readBundle();

                Request request = new Request(text, startIndex, endIndex, locales, referenceTime, extras);
                request.mCallingPackageName = source.readString();
                return request;
            }

            @Override
            public Request[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new Request[size];
            }
        };

        public static final class Builder
        {
            private final CharSequence mText;
            private final int mStartIndex;
            private final int mEndIndex;
            private LocaleList mDefaultLocales;
            private ZonedDateTime mReferenceTime;
            private Bundle mExtras;

            public Builder(CharSequence text, int startIndex, int endIndex)
            {
                if (text == null) throw new NullPointerException("text");
                if (startIndex < 0 || endIndex > text.length() || startIndex >= endIndex)
                {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid range " + startIndex + ".." + endIndex + " for text of length "
                                                       + text.length());
                }

                mText = text;
                mStartIndex = startIndex;
                mEndIndex = endIndex;
            }

            public Builder setDefaultLocales(LocaleList defaultLocales)
            {
                mDefaultLocales = defaultLocales;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setReferenceTime(ZonedDateTime referenceTime)
            {
                mReferenceTime = referenceTime;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setExtras(Bundle extras)
            {
                mExtras = extras;
                return this;
            }

            public Request build()
            {
                return new Request(mText.toString(), mStartIndex, mEndIndex, mDefaultLocales, mReferenceTime, mExtras);
            }
        }
    }
```

```java
package android.view.textclassifier;

public final class TextClassificationManager
{
    private static TextClassificationManager sInstance;

    private final Object mLock = new Object();
    private TextClassifier mCustomTextClassifier;
    private TextClassificationSessionFactory mSessionFactory;

    private TextClassificationManager()
    {
    }

    public static TextClassificationManager getInstance()
    {
        if (sInstance == null) sInstance = new TextClassificationManager();

        return sInstance;
    }

    public TextClassifier getTextClassifier()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            return mCustomTextClassifier != null ? mCustomTextClassifier : TextClassifier.NO_OP;
        }
    }

    public void setTextClassifier(TextClassifier textClassifier)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            mCustomTextClassifier = textClassifier;
        }
    }

    public TextClassifier createTextClassificationSession(TextClassificationContext classificationContext)
    {
        if (classificationContext == null) throw new NullPointerException("classificationContext");

        TextClassificationSessionFactory factory;
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            factory = mSessionFactory;
        }

        if (factory != null)
        {
            TextClassifier session = factory.createTextClassificationSession(classificationContext);
            if (session != null) return session;
        }

        return getTextClassifier();
    }

    public void setTextClassificationSessionFactory(TextClassificationSessionFactory factory)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            mSessionFactory = factory;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
                             boolean includeTypesFromTextClassifier)
        {
            mIncludedTypes = includedTypes == null ? new ArrayList<>() : new ArrayList<>(includedTypes);
            mExcludedTypes = excludedTypes == null ? new ArrayList<>() : new ArrayList<>(excludedTypes);

            mIncludeTypesFromTextClassifier = includeTypesFromTextClassifier;

                                          Collection<String> excludedEntityTypes)

        public Collection<String> resolveEntityListModifications(Collection<String> entityTypes)

            if (mIncludeTypesFromTextClassifier && entityTypes != null) resolved.addAll(entityTypes);

            resolved.addAll(mIncludedTypes);
            resolved.removeAll(mExcludedTypes);
            return resolved;

        }
```

`java/android/view/textclassifier/TextLinks.java`:

```java
package android.view.textclassifier;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.LocaleList;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.text.Spannable;
import android.text.style.ClickableSpan;
import android.view.View;

import java.time.ZonedDateTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.function.Function;

public final class TextLinks implements Parcelable
{
    public static final int STATUS_LINKS_APPLIED = 0;
    public static final int STATUS_NO_LINKS_FOUND = 1;
    public static final int STATUS_NO_LINKS_APPLIED = 2;
    public static final int STATUS_DIFFERENT_TEXT = 3;
    public static final int STATUS_UNSUPPORTED_CHARACTER = 4;

    public static final int APPLY_STRATEGY_IGNORE = 0;
    public static final int APPLY_STRATEGY_REPLACE = 1;

    private final String mFullText;
    private final List<TextLink> mLinks;
    private final Bundle mExtras;

    private TextLinks(String fullText, List<TextLink> links, Bundle extras)
    {
        mFullText = fullText;
        mLinks = Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(links));
        mExtras = extras == null ? Bundle.EMPTY : extras;
    }

    public CharSequence getText()
    {
        return mFullText;
    }

    public Collection<TextLink> getLinks()
    {
        return mLinks;
    }

    public Bundle getExtras()
    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    public int apply(Spannable text, int applyStrategy, Function<TextLink, TextLinkSpan> spanFactory)
    {
        if (text == null) throw new NullPointerException("text");
        if (applyStrategy != APPLY_STRATEGY_IGNORE && applyStrategy != APPLY_STRATEGY_REPLACE)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid apply strategy.");
        }

        if (mLinks.isEmpty()) return STATUS_NO_LINKS_FOUND;
        if (!mFullText.equals(text.toString())) return STATUS_DIFFERENT_TEXT;

        int applied = 0;
        for (TextLink link : mLinks)
        {
            TextLinkSpan span = spanFactory != null ? spanFactory.apply(link) : new TextLinkSpan(link);
            if (span == null) continue;

            ClickableSpan[] existing = text.getSpans(link.getStart(), link.getEnd(), ClickableSpan.class);
            if (existing != null && existing.length > 0)
            {
                if (applyStrategy == APPLY_STRATEGY_IGNORE) continue;

                for (ClickableSpan old : existing)
                {
                    text.removeSpan(old);
                }
            }

            text.setSpan(span, link.getStart(), link.getEnd(), Spannable.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE);
            applied++;
        }

        return applied == 0 ? STATUS_NO_LINKS_APPLIED : STATUS_LINKS_APPLIED;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "TextLinks{fullText=" + mFullText + ", links=" + mLinks + "}";
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeString(mFullText);
        dest.writeValue(new ArrayList<>(mLinks));
        dest.writeBundle(mExtras);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static <T> T readTyped(Parcel source)
    {
        return (T)source.readValue(null);
    }

    public static final Creator<TextLinks> CREATOR = new Creator<TextLinks>()
    {
        @Override
        public TextLinks createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            String fullText = source.readString();
            List<TextLink> links = readTyped(source);
            Bundle extras = source.readBundle();
            return new TextLinks(fullText, links == null ? new ArrayList<>() : links, extras);
        }

        @Override
        public TextLinks[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new TextLinks[size];
        }
    };

    public static final class TextLink implements Parcelable
    {
        private final EntityConfidence mEntityScores;
        private final int mStart;
        private final int mEnd;
        private final Bundle mExtras;

        private TextLink(int start, int end, Map<String, Float> entityScores, Bundle extras)
        {
            if (entityScores == null || entityScores.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("entityScores");
            if (start >= end) throw new IllegalArgumentException("start must be smaller than end");

            mStart = start;
            mEnd = end;
            mEntityScores = new EntityConfidence(entityScores);
            mExtras = extras == null ? Bundle.EMPTY : extras;
        }

        public int getStart()
        {
            return mStart;
        }

        public int getEnd()
        {
            return mEnd;
        }

        public int getEntityCount()
        {
            return mEntityScores.getEntityCount();
        }

        public String getEntity(int index)
        {
            return mEntityScores.getEntity(index);
        }

        public float getConfidenceScore(String entityType)
        {
            return mEntityScores.getConfidenceScore(entityType);
        }

        public Bundle getExtras()
        {
            return mExtras;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return "TextLink{start=" + mStart + ", end=" + mEnd + ", entityScores=" + mEntityScores + "}";
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
        {
            dest.writeValue(mEntityScores.toMap());
            dest.writeInt(mStart);
            dest.writeInt(mEnd);
            dest.writeBundle(mExtras);
        }

        public static final Creator<TextLink> CREATOR = new Creator<TextLink>()
        {
            @Override
            public TextLink createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                Map<String, Float> scores = readTyped(source);
                int start = source.readInt();
                int end = source.readInt();
                Bundle extras = source.readBundle();
                return new TextLink(start, end, scores, extras);
            }

            @Override
            public TextLink[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new TextLink[size];
            }
        };
    }

    public static class TextLinkSpan extends ClickableSpan
    {
        private final TextLink mTextLink;

        public TextLinkSpan(TextLink textLink)
        {
            mTextLink = textLink;
        }

        @Override

        {
        }

            return mTextLink;
        }
    }

    public static final class Request implements Parcelable
    {
        private final CharSequence mText;
        private final LocaleList mDefaultLocales;
        private final TextClassifier.EntityConfig mEntityConfig;
        private final ZonedDateTime mReferenceTime;
        private final Bundle mExtras;
        private String mCallingPackageName;

        private Request(CharSequence text, LocaleList defaultLocales, TextClassifier.EntityConfig entityConfig, ZonedDateTime referenceTime,
                        Bundle extras)
        {
            mText = text;
            mDefaultLocales = defaultLocales;
            mEntityConfig = entityConfig;
            mReferenceTime = referenceTime;
            mExtras = extras == null ? Bundle.EMPTY : extras;
        }

            return mExtras;

        {
            return 0;

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
        {
            dest.writeValue(mText);
            dest.writeValue(mDefaultLocales);
            dest.writeParcelable(mEntityConfig, flags);
            dest.writeValue(mReferenceTime);
            dest.writeBundle(mExtras);
            dest.writeString(mCallingPackageName);
        }

        public static final Creator<Request> CREATOR = new Creator<Request>()
        {
            @Override
            public Request createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                CharSequence text = (CharSequence)source.readValue(null);
                LocaleList locales = (LocaleList)source.readValue(null);
                TextClassifier.EntityConfig entityConfig = source.readParcelable(TextClassifier.EntityConfig.class.getClassLoader());
                ZonedDateTime referenceTime = (ZonedDateTime)source.readValue(null);
                Bundle extras = source.readBundle();

                Request request = new Request(text, locales, entityConfig, referenceTime, extras);
                request.mCallingPackageName = source.readString();
                return request;
            }

            @Override
            public Request[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new Request[size];
            }
        };

        public static final class Builder
        {
            private final CharSequence mText;
            private LocaleList mDefaultLocales;
            private TextClassifier.EntityConfig mEntityConfig;
            private ZonedDateTime mReferenceTime;
            private Bundle mExtras;

            public Builder(CharSequence text)
            {
                if (text == null) throw new NullPointerException("text");

                mText = text;
            }

            public Builder setDefaultLocales(LocaleList defaultLocales)
            {
                mDefaultLocales = defaultLocales;
                return this;
            }

            }
        }
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final String mFullText;
        private final ArrayList<TextLink> mLinks = new ArrayList<>();
        private Bundle mExtras;

        public Builder(String fullText)
        {
            if (fullText == null) throw new NullPointerException("fullText");

            mFullText = fullText;
        }

        public Builder addLink(int start, int end, Map<String, Float> entityScores)
        {
            return addLink(start, end, entityScores, Bundle.EMPTY);
        }

            return this;

            return this;

    {

        {
```

```java
            int endIndex = source.readInt();
            Map<String, Float> scores = readScores(source);
            String id = source.readString();
            Bundle extras = source.readBundle();
            TextClassification classification = source.readParcelable(TextClassification.class.getClassLoader());
            return new TextSelection(startIndex, endIndex, scores, id, classification, extras);
        }

        {
            return new TextSelection[size];
        }

            mEndIndex = endIndex;

        }

    public static final class Request implements Parcelable
    {
        private final CharSequence mText;
        private final int mStartIndex;
        private final int mEndIndex;
        private final LocaleList mDefaultLocales;
        private final boolean mIncludeTextClassification;
        private final Bundle mExtras;
        private String mCallingPackageName;

        private Request(CharSequence text, int startIndex, int endIndex, LocaleList defaultLocales, boolean includeTextClassification,
                        Bundle extras)
        {
            mText = text;
            mStartIndex = startIndex;
            mEndIndex = endIndex;
            mDefaultLocales = defaultLocales;
            mIncludeTextClassification = includeTextClassification;
            mExtras = extras == null ? Bundle.EMPTY : extras;
        }

        public CharSequence getText()
        {
            return mText;
        }

        public int getStartIndex()
        {
            return mStartIndex;
        }

        public int getEndIndex()
        {
            return mEndIndex;
        }

        public LocaleList getDefaultLocales()
        {
            return mDefaultLocales;
        }

        public String getCallingPackageName()
        {
            return mCallingPackageName;
        }

        public boolean shouldIncludeTextClassification()
        {
            return mIncludeTextClassification;
        }

        public Bundle getExtras()
        {
            return mExtras;
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
        {
            dest.writeValue(mText);
            dest.writeInt(mStartIndex);
            dest.writeInt(mEndIndex);
            dest.writeValue(mDefaultLocales);
            dest.writeInt(mIncludeTextClassification ? 1 : 0);
            dest.writeBundle(mExtras);
            dest.writeString(mCallingPackageName);
        }

        public static final Creator<Request> CREATOR = new Creator<Request>()
        {
            @Override
            public Request createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                CharSequence text = (CharSequence)source.readValue(null);
                int startIndex = source.readInt();
                int endIndex = source.readInt();
                LocaleList locales = (LocaleList)source.readValue(null);
                boolean includeClassification = source.readInt() != 0;
                Bundle extras = source.readBundle();

                Request request = new Request(text, startIndex, endIndex, locales, includeClassification, extras);
                request.mCallingPackageName = source.readString();
                return request;
            }

            @Override
            public Request[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new Request[size];
            }
        };

        public static final class Builder
        {
            private final CharSequence mText;
            private final int mStartIndex;
            private final int mEndIndex;
            private LocaleList mDefaultLocales;
            private boolean mIncludeTextClassification;
            private Bundle mExtras;

            public Builder(CharSequence text, int startIndex, int endIndex)
            {
                if (text == null) throw new NullPointerException("text");
                if (startIndex < 0 || endIndex > text.length() || startIndex >= endIndex)
                {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid range " + startIndex + ".." + endIndex + " for text of length "
                                                       + text.length());
                }

                mText = text;
                mStartIndex = startIndex;
                mEndIndex = endIndex;
            }

            public Builder setDefaultLocales(LocaleList defaultLocales)
            {
                mDefaultLocales = defaultLocales;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setIncludeTextClassification(boolean includeTextClassification)
            {
                mIncludeTextClassification = includeTextClassification;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setExtras(Bundle extras)
            {
                mExtras = extras;
                return this;
            }

            public Request build()
            {
                return new Request(mText.toString(), mStartIndex, mEndIndex, mDefaultLocales, mIncludeTextClassification, mExtras);
            }
        }
    }
```

```java
            String text = source.readString();
            String transliteration = source.readString();
            Bundle extras = source.readBundle();
            return new TranslationResponseValue(status, text, extras, transliteration);
        }

        {
            return new TranslationResponseValue[size];
        }
    };

    private final int mStatusCode;
    private final CharSequence mText;
    private final Bundle mExtras;
    private final CharSequence mTransliteration;

    TranslationResponseValue(int statusCode, CharSequence text, Bundle extras, CharSequence transliteration)
    {
        mStatusCode = statusCode;
        mText = text;
        mExtras = extras == null ? Bundle.EMPTY : extras;
        mTransliteration = transliteration;

    {
        return new TranslationResponseValue(STATUS_ERROR, null, Bundle.EMPTY, null);
    }

        return mStatusCode;
    }

    {
        return mText;

    {
        return mExtras;
    }

    public CharSequence getTransliteration()
    {
        return mTransliteration;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "TranslationResponseValue { statusCode = " + mStatusCode + ", text = " + mText + ", transliteration = " + mTransliteration
               + " }";
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof TranslationResponseValue)) return false;

        TranslationResponseValue value = (TranslationResponseValue)other;
        return mStatusCode == value.mStatusCode && TextUtils.equals(mText, value.mText)
               && TextUtils.equals(mTransliteration, value.mTransliteration);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        int result = mStatusCode;
        result = 31 * result + (mText == null ? 0 : mText.toString().hashCode());
        result = 31 * result + (mTransliteration == null ? 0 : mTransliteration.toString().hashCode());
        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeInt(mStatusCode);
        dest.writeString(mText == null ? null : mText.toString());
        dest.writeString(mTransliteration == null ? null : mTransliteration.toString());
        dest.writeBundle(mExtras);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

        private Bundle mExtras;

            return this;
        }

        {
            mExtras = extras;
            return this;

            return this;
        }
```

```java
package android.view.translation;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.view.autofill.AutofillId;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

public final class ViewTranslationRequest implements Parcelable
{
    public static final String ID_TEXT = "android:text";

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<ViewTranslationRequest> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<ViewTranslationRequest>()
    {
        @Override
        public ViewTranslationRequest createFromParcel(Parcel source)
        {
            AutofillId id = source.readParcelable(AutofillId.class.getClassLoader());
            int count = source.readInt();
            Builder builder = new Builder(id);

            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                String key = source.readString();
                builder.setValue(key, TranslationRequestValue.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source));
            }

            return builder.build();
        }

        @Override
        public ViewTranslationRequest[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new ViewTranslationRequest[size];
        }
    };

    private final AutofillId mAutofillId;
    private final Map<String, TranslationRequestValue> mTranslationRequestValues;

    ViewTranslationRequest(AutofillId autofillId, Map<String, TranslationRequestValue> values)
    {
        mAutofillId = autofillId;
        mTranslationRequestValues = values;
    }

    public TranslationRequestValue getValue(String key)
    {
        if (key == null) throw new NullPointerException("key must not be null");
        if (!mTranslationRequestValues.containsKey(key))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Request does not contain value for key=" + key);
        }

        return mTranslationRequestValues.get(key);
    }

    public Set<String> getKeys()
    {
        return mTranslationRequestValues.keySet();
    }

    public AutofillId getAutofillId()
    {
        return mAutofillId;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString()
    {
        return "ViewTranslationRequest { autofillId = " + mAutofillId + ", translationRequestValues = " + mTranslationRequestValues + " }";
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other)
    {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof ViewTranslationRequest)) return false;

        ViewTranslationRequest request = (ViewTranslationRequest)other;
        return java.util.Objects.equals(mAutofillId, request.mAutofillId)
               && mTranslationRequestValues.equals(request.mTranslationRequestValues);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode()
    {
        return 31 * java.util.Objects.hashCode(mAutofillId) + mTranslationRequestValues.hashCode();
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
    {
        dest.writeParcelable(mAutofillId, flags);
        dest.writeInt(mTranslationRequestValues.size());

        for (Map.Entry<String, TranslationRequestValue> entry : mTranslationRequestValues.entrySet())
        {
            dest.writeString(entry.getKey());
            entry.getValue().writeToParcel(dest, flags);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final AutofillId mAutofillId;
        private final Map<String, TranslationRequestValue> mValues = new HashMap<>();

        public Builder(AutofillId autofillId)
        {
            if (autofillId == null) throw new NullPointerException("autofillId must not be null");
            mAutofillId = autofillId;
        }

        public Builder(AutofillId autofillId, long virtualChildId)
        {
            this(autofillId);
        }

        public Builder setValue(String key, TranslationRequestValue value)
        {
            mValues.put(key, value);
            return this;
        }

        public ViewTranslationRequest build()
        {
            return new ViewTranslationRequest(mAutofillId, new HashMap<>(mValues));
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.webkit;

import android.content.Context;

public final class CookieSyncManager implements Runnable
{
    private static CookieSyncManager sInstance;

    private CookieSyncManager()
    {
    }

    public static synchronized CookieSyncManager getInstance()
    {
        if (sInstance == null)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("CookieSyncManager::createInstance() needs to be called before "
                + "CookieSyncManager::getInstance()");
        }
        return sInstance;
    }

    public static synchronized CookieSyncManager createInstance(Context context)
    {
        if (context == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid context argument");
        if (sInstance == null) sInstance = new CookieSyncManager();
        return sInstance;
    }

    public void sync()
```

```java
package android.webkit;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

public class GeolocationPermissions
{
    private static final GeolocationPermissions INSTANCE = new GeolocationPermissions();

    private final Map<String, Boolean> mPermissions = new HashMap<>();

    GeolocationPermissions()
    {
    }

    public static GeolocationPermissions getInstance()
    {
        return INSTANCE;
    }

    public void getOrigins(ValueCallback<Set<String>> callback)
    {
        Set<String> origins;
        synchronized (mPermissions)
        {
            origins = new HashSet<>(mPermissions.keySet());
        }
        if (callback != null) callback.onReceiveValue(origins);
    }

    public void getAllowed(String origin, ValueCallback<Boolean> callback)
    {
        Boolean allowed;
        synchronized (mPermissions)
        {
            allowed = origin == null ? null : mPermissions.get(origin);
        }
        if (callback != null) callback.onReceiveValue(allowed != null && allowed);
    }

    public void clear(String origin)
    {
        synchronized (mPermissions)
        {
            mPermissions.remove(origin);
        }
    }

    public void allow(String origin)
    {
        if (origin == null) return;
        synchronized (mPermissions)
        {
            mPermissions.put(origin, Boolean.TRUE);
        }
    }

    public void clearAll()
    {
        synchronized (mPermissions)
        {
            mPermissions.clear();
        }
    }

    public interface Callback
    {
        void invoke(String origin, boolean allow, boolean retain);
    }
}
```

`java/android/webkit/InMemoryCookieManager.java`:

```java
package android.webkit;

import java.net.URI;
import java.text.ParseException;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.TimeZone;
import java.util.WeakHashMap;

final class InMemoryCookieManager extends CookieManager
{
    static final InMemoryCookieManager INSTANCE = new InMemoryCookieManager();

    private static final String[] DATE_FORMATS = {
        "EEE, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss zzz",
        "EEE, dd-MMM-yyyy HH:mm:ss zzz",
        "EEE, dd-MMM-yy HH:mm:ss zzz",
        "EEEE, dd-MMM-yy HH:mm:ss zzz",
        "EEE MMM d HH:mm:ss yyyy",
    };

    private final List<Cookie> mCookies = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Map<WebView, Boolean> mThirdPartyAcceptance = new WeakHashMap<>();
    private boolean mAcceptCookie = true;

    private InMemoryCookieManager()
    {
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void setAcceptCookie(boolean accept)
    {
        mAcceptCookie = accept;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized boolean acceptCookie()
    {
        return mAcceptCookie;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void setAcceptThirdPartyCookies(WebView webview, boolean accept)
    {
        if (webview == null) return;
        mThirdPartyAcceptance.put(webview, accept);
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized boolean acceptThirdPartyCookies(WebView webview)
    {
        if (webview == null) return false;
        Boolean accept = mThirdPartyAcceptance.get(webview);
        return accept != null && accept;
    }

    @Override
    public void setCookie(String url, String value)
    {
        store(url, value);
    }

    @Override
    public void setCookie(String url, String value, ValueCallback<Boolean> callback)
    {
        WebkitCallbacks.deliver(callback, store(url, value));
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized String getCookie(String url)
    {
        URI uri = parse(url);
        if (uri == null) return null;
        String host = uri.getHost().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        String path = uri.getRawPath() == null || uri.getRawPath().isEmpty() ? "/" : uri.getRawPath();
        boolean secure = "https".equalsIgnoreCase(uri.getScheme()) || "wss".equalsIgnoreCase(uri.getScheme());
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();

        List<Cookie> matches = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Iterator<Cookie> iterator = mCookies.iterator(); iterator.hasNext();)
        {
            Cookie cookie = iterator.next();
            if (cookie.isExpired(now))
            {
                iterator.remove();
                continue;
            }
            if (cookie.mSecure && !secure) continue;
            if (!cookie.matchesHost(host) || !cookie.matchesPath(path)) continue;
            matches.add(cookie);
        }
        if (matches.isEmpty()) return null;

        Collections.sort(matches, new Comparator<Cookie>()
        {
            @Override
            public int compare(Cookie first, Cookie second)
            {
                int byPath = second.mPath.length() - first.mPath.length();
                if (byPath != 0) return byPath;
                return Long.compare(first.mCreationTime, second.mCreationTime);
            }
        });

        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        for (Cookie cookie : matches)
        {
            if (builder.length() > 0) builder.append("; ");
            if (cookie.mName.isEmpty())
            {
                builder.append(cookie.mValue);
            }
            else
            {
                builder.append(cookie.mName).append('=').append(cookie.mValue);
            }
        }
        return builder.toString();
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void removeSessionCookie()
    {
        removeSessionCookiesLocked();
    }

    @Override
    public void removeSessionCookies(ValueCallback<Boolean> callback)
    {
        boolean removed;
        synchronized (this)
        {
            removed = removeSessionCookiesLocked();
        }
        WebkitCallbacks.deliver(callback, removed);
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void removeAllCookie()
    {
        mCookies.clear();
    }

    @Override
    public void removeAllCookies(ValueCallback<Boolean> callback)
    {
        boolean removed;
        synchronized (this)
        {
            removed = !mCookies.isEmpty();
            mCookies.clear();
        }
        WebkitCallbacks.deliver(callback, removed);
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized boolean hasCookies()
    {
        removeExpiredLocked();
        return !mCookies.isEmpty();
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void removeExpiredCookie()
    {
        removeExpiredLocked();
    }

    @Override
    public void flush()
    {
    }

    private boolean removeSessionCookiesLocked()
    {
        boolean removed = false;
        for (Iterator<Cookie> iterator = mCookies.iterator(); iterator.hasNext();)
        {
            if (iterator.next().mExpiry < 0)
            {
                iterator.remove();
                removed = true;
            }
        }
        return removed;
    }

    private void removeExpiredLocked()
    {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        for (Iterator<Cookie> iterator = mCookies.iterator(); iterator.hasNext();)
        {
            if (iterator.next().isExpired(now)) iterator.remove();
        }
    }

    private synchronized boolean store(String url, String value)
    {
        if (!mAcceptCookie || value == null) return false;
        URI uri = parse(url);
        if (uri == null) return false;
        if ("file".equalsIgnoreCase(uri.getScheme()) && !allowFileSchemeCookies()) return false;

        String host = uri.getHost().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        String[] parts = value.split(";");
        String pair = parts[0].trim();
        int equals = pair.indexOf('=');
        String name = equals < 0 ? "" : pair.substring(0, equals).trim();
        String cookieValue = equals < 0 ? pair : pair.substring(equals + 1).trim();
        if (name.isEmpty() && cookieValue.isEmpty()) return false;

        Cookie cookie = new Cookie(name, cookieValue);
        cookie.mDomain = host;
        cookie.mHostOnly = true;
        cookie.mPath = defaultPath(uri.getRawPath());
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        boolean maxAgeSeen = false;

        for (int index = 1; index < parts.length; index++)
        {
            String attribute = parts[index].trim();
            if (attribute.isEmpty()) continue;
            int separator = attribute.indexOf('=');
            String key = (separator < 0 ? attribute : attribute.substring(0, separator)).trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            String argument = separator < 0 ? "" : attribute.substring(separator + 1).trim();
            switch (key)
            {
                case "domain":
                {
                    String domain = argument.startsWith(".") ? argument.substring(1) : argument;
                    domain = domain.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                    if (domain.isEmpty()) break;
                    if (!host.equals(domain) && !host.endsWith("." + domain)) return false;
                    cookie.mDomain = domain;
                    cookie.mHostOnly = false;
                    break;
                }
                case "path":
                    if (argument.startsWith("/")) cookie.mPath = argument;
                    break;
                case "max-age":
                    try
                    {
                        long seconds = Long.parseLong(argument);
                        cookie.mExpiry = seconds <= 0 ? 0 : now + seconds * 1000L;
                        maxAgeSeen = true;
                    }
                    catch (NumberFormatException ignored)
                    {
                    }
                    break;
                case "expires":
                    if (!maxAgeSeen)
                    {
                        Date date = parseDate(argument);
                        if (date != null) cookie.mExpiry = Math.max(0, date.getTime());
                    }
                    break;
                case "secure":
                    cookie.mSecure = true;
                    break;
                case "httponly":
                    cookie.mHttpOnly = true;
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
        }

        for (Iterator<Cookie> iterator = mCookies.iterator(); iterator.hasNext();)
        {
            Cookie existing = iterator.next();
            if (existing.mName.equals(cookie.mName) && existing.mDomain.equals(cookie.mDomain) && existing.mPath.equals(cookie.mPath))
            {
                cookie.mCreationTime = existing.mCreationTime;
                iterator.remove();
            }
        }
        if (cookie.isExpired(now)) return true;
        mCookies.add(cookie);
        return true;
    }

    private static URI parse(String url)
    {
        if (url == null) return null;
        String candidate = url.trim();
        if (candidate.isEmpty()) return null;
        if (!candidate.contains("://")) candidate = "http://" + candidate;
        try
        {
            URI uri = new URI(candidate);
            if (uri.getHost() == null) return null;
            return uri;
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static String defaultPath(String path)
    {
        if (path == null || path.isEmpty() || path.charAt(0) != '/') return "/";
        int slash = path.lastIndexOf('/');
        if (slash == 0) return "/";
        return path.substring(0, slash);
    }

    private static Date parseDate(String text)
    {
        for (String format : DATE_FORMATS)
        {
            SimpleDateFormat parser = new SimpleDateFormat(format, Locale.US);
            parser.setTimeZone(TimeZone.getTimeZone("GMT"));
            parser.setLenient(true);
            try
            {
                return parser.parse(text);
            }
            catch (ParseException ignored)
            {
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static final class Cookie
    {
        final String mName;
        final String mValue;
        String mDomain;
        String mPath;
        boolean mHostOnly;
        boolean mSecure;
        boolean mHttpOnly;
        long mExpiry = -1;
        long mCreationTime = System.nanoTime();

        Cookie(String name, String value)
        {
            mName = name;
            mValue = value;
        }

        boolean isExpired(long now)
        {
            return mExpiry >= 0 && mExpiry <= now;
        }

        boolean matchesHost(String host)
        {
            if (host.equals(mDomain)) return true;
            return !mHostOnly && host.endsWith("." + mDomain);
        }

        boolean matchesPath(String path)
        {
            if (path.equals(mPath)) return true;
            if (!path.startsWith(mPath)) return false;
            return mPath.endsWith("/") || path.charAt(mPath.length()) == '/';
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.webkit;

public class JsResult
{
    private final ResultReceiver mReceiver;
    private boolean mResult;

    public JsResult(ResultReceiver receiver)
    {
        mReceiver = receiver;
    }

    public final void cancel()
    {
        mResult = false;
        wakeUp();
    }

    public final void confirm()
    {
        mResult = true;
        wakeUp();
    }

    public final boolean getResult()
    {
        return mResult;
    }

    private void wakeUp()
    {
        if (mReceiver != null) mReceiver.onJsResultComplete(this);
    }

    public interface ResultReceiver
    {
        void onJsResultComplete(JsResult result);
    }
```

`java/android/webkit/LocalBackForwardList.java`:

```java
package android.webkit;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

final class LocalBackForwardList extends WebBackForwardList
{
    private final List<LocalHistoryItem> mItems = new ArrayList<>();
    private int mCurrentIndex = -1;

    synchronized void push(LocalHistoryItem item)
    {
        while (mItems.size() > mCurrentIndex + 1) mItems.remove(mItems.size() - 1);
        mItems.add(item);
        mCurrentIndex = mItems.size() - 1;
    }

    synchronized void replaceCurrent(LocalHistoryItem item)
    {
        if (mCurrentIndex < 0)
        {
            push(item);
            return;
        }
        mItems.set(mCurrentIndex, item);
    }

    synchronized boolean canGoBackOrForward(int steps)
    {
        int target = mCurrentIndex + steps;
        return mCurrentIndex >= 0 && target >= 0 && target < mItems.size();
    }

    synchronized LocalHistoryItem goBackOrForward(int steps)
    {
        if (!canGoBackOrForward(steps)) return null;
        mCurrentIndex += steps;
        return mItems.get(mCurrentIndex);
    }

    synchronized void clearAllButCurrent()
    {
        if (mCurrentIndex < 0)
        {
            mItems.clear();
            return;
        }
        LocalHistoryItem current = mItems.get(mCurrentIndex);
        mItems.clear();
        mItems.add(current);
        mCurrentIndex = 0;
    }

    synchronized void clear()
    {
        mItems.clear();
        mCurrentIndex = -1;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized LocalHistoryItem getCurrentItem()
    {
        return mCurrentIndex < 0 ? null : mItems.get(mCurrentIndex);
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized int getCurrentIndex()
    {
        return mCurrentIndex;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized LocalHistoryItem getItemAtIndex(int index)
    {
        if (index < 0 || index >= mItems.size()) return null;
        return mItems.get(index);
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized int getSize()
    {
        return mItems.size();
    }

    @Override
    protected synchronized LocalBackForwardList clone()
    {
        LocalBackForwardList copy = new LocalBackForwardList();
        for (LocalHistoryItem item : mItems) copy.mItems.add(item.clone());
        copy.mCurrentIndex = mCurrentIndex;
        return copy;
    }
}
```

`java/android/webkit/LocalWebMessagePort.java`:

```java
package android.webkit;

import android.os.Handler;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

final class LocalWebMessagePort extends WebMessagePort
{
    private LocalWebMessagePort mPeer;
    private WebMessageCallback mCallback;
    private Handler mHandler;
    private boolean mClosed;
    private final List<WebMessage> mPending = new ArrayList<>();

    private LocalWebMessagePort()
    {
    }

    static WebMessagePort[] createChannel()
    {
        LocalWebMessagePort first = new LocalWebMessagePort();
        LocalWebMessagePort second = new LocalWebMessagePort();
        first.mPeer = second;
        second.mPeer = first;
        return new WebMessagePort[] {first, second};
    }

    @Override
    public void postMessage(WebMessage message)
    {
        LocalWebMessagePort peer;
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mClosed) throw new IllegalStateException("Port is already closed");
            peer = mPeer;
        }
        if (message != null && message.getPorts() != null)
        {
            for (WebMessagePort port : message.getPorts())
            {
                if (port == this || port == peer) throw new IllegalStateException("The port cannot be transferred to itself");
            }
        }
        if (peer != null) peer.receive(message);
    }

    @Override
    public void close()
    {
        synchronized (this)
        {
            mClosed = true;
            mPending.clear();
            mCallback = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setWebMessageCallback(WebMessageCallback callback)
    {
        setWebMessageCallback(callback, null);
    }

    @Override
    public void setWebMessageCallback(WebMessageCallback callback, Handler handler)
    {
        List<WebMessage> pending;
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mClosed) throw new IllegalStateException("Port is already closed");
            mCallback = callback;
            mHandler = handler;
            pending = new ArrayList<>(mPending);
            mPending.clear();
        }
        for (WebMessage message : pending) receive(message);
    }

    private void receive(final WebMessage message)
    {
        final WebMessageCallback callback;
        Handler handler;
        synchronized (this)
        {
            if (mClosed) return;
            if (mCallback == null)
            {
                mPending.add(message);
                return;
            }
            callback = mCallback;
            handler = mHandler;
        }
        Runnable delivery = new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                callback.onMessage(LocalWebMessagePort.this, message);
            }
        };
        if (handler != null)
        {
            handler.post(delivery);
        }
        else
        {
            WebkitCallbacks.post(delivery);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    private static final Map<String, String> MIME_TO_EXTENSION = new HashMap<>();
    private static final Map<String, String> EXTENSION_TO_MIME = new HashMap<>();

    static
    {
        for (String[] row : TABLE)
        {
            String mimeType = row[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (!MIME_TO_EXTENSION.containsKey(mimeType)) MIME_TO_EXTENSION.put(mimeType, row[1]);
            for (int index = 1; index < row.length; index++)
            {
                if (!EXTENSION_TO_MIME.containsKey(row[index])) EXTENSION_TO_MIME.put(row[index], row[0]);
            }
        }
        EXTENSION_TO_MIME.put("mp3", "audio/mpeg");
        EXTENSION_TO_MIME.put("m4a", "audio/mp4");
        EXTENSION_TO_MIME.put("xml", "text/xml");
        EXTENSION_TO_MIME.put("csv", "text/comma-separated-values");
        EXTENSION_TO_MIME.put("rtf", "application/rtf");
        EXTENSION_TO_MIME.put("bmp", "image/bmp");
        EXTENSION_TO_MIME.put("ts", "video/mp2ts");
        EXTENSION_TO_MIME.put("vcf", "text/x-vcard");
        EXTENSION_TO_MIME.put("avi", "video/avi");
        EXTENSION_TO_MIME.put("rar", "application/rar");
        EXTENSION_TO_MIME.put("crt", "application/x-x509-ca-cert");
        EXTENSION_TO_MIME.put("aac", "audio/aac");
        EXTENSION_TO_MIME.put("m3u8", "application/vnd.apple.mpegurl");
        EXTENSION_TO_MIME.put("m4v", "video/mp4");
    }

    private MimeTypeMap()
    {
    }

    public static MimeTypeMap getSingleton()
    {
        return INSTANCE;
    }

    public static String getFileExtensionFromUrl(String url)
    {
        if (url != null && !url.isEmpty())
        {
            int fragment = url.lastIndexOf('#');
            if (fragment > 0) url = url.substring(0, fragment);

            int query = url.lastIndexOf('?');
            if (query > 0) url = url.substring(0, query);

            int filenamePosition = url.lastIndexOf('/');
            String filename = filenamePosition >= 0 ? url.substring(filenamePosition + 1) : url;

            if (!filename.isEmpty() && FILENAME.matcher(filename).matches())
            {
                int dotPosition = filename.lastIndexOf('.');
                if (dotPosition >= 0) return filename.substring(dotPosition + 1);
            }
        }
        return "";
    }

    public boolean hasMimeType(String mimeType)
    {
        return mimeType != null && !mimeType.isEmpty() && MIME_TO_EXTENSION.containsKey(mimeType.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
    }

    public String getMimeTypeFromExtension(String extension)
    {
        if (extension == null || extension.isEmpty()) return null;
        return EXTENSION_TO_MIME.get(extension.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
    }

    public boolean hasExtension(String extension)
    {
        return extension != null && !extension.isEmpty() && EXTENSION_TO_MIME.containsKey(extension.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
    }

    public String getExtensionFromMimeType(String mimeType)
    {
        if (mimeType == null || mimeType.isEmpty()) return null;
        return MIME_TO_EXTENSION.get(mimeType.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
    }
}
```

`java/android/webkit/TracingConfig.java`:

```java
package android.webkit;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.List;

public class TracingConfig
{
    public static final int CATEGORIES_NONE = 0;
    public static final int CATEGORIES_ALL = 1 << 0;
    public static final int CATEGORIES_ANDROID_WEBVIEW = 1 << 1;
    public static final int CATEGORIES_WEB_DEVELOPER = 1 << 2;
    public static final int CATEGORIES_INPUT_LATENCY = 1 << 3;
    public static final int CATEGORIES_RENDERING = 1 << 4;
    public static final int CATEGORIES_JAVASCRIPT_AND_RENDERING = 1 << 5;
    public static final int CATEGORIES_FRAME_VIEWER = 1 << 6;

    public static final int RECORD_UNTIL_FULL = 0;
    public static final int RECORD_CONTINUOUSLY = 1;

    private final int mPredefinedCategories;
    private final List<String> mCustomIncludedCategories = new ArrayList<>();
    private final int mTracingMode;

    TracingConfig(int predefinedCategories, List<String> customIncludedCategories, int tracingMode)
    {
        mPredefinedCategories = predefinedCategories;
        mCustomIncludedCategories.addAll(customIncludedCategories);
        mTracingMode = tracingMode;
    }

    public int getPredefinedCategories()
    {
        return mPredefinedCategories;
    }

    public List<String> getCustomIncludedCategories()
    {
        return mCustomIncludedCategories;
    }

    public int getTracingMode()
    {
        return mTracingMode;
    }

    public static class Builder
    {
        private int mPredefinedCategories = CATEGORIES_NONE;
        private final List<String> mCustomIncludedCategories = new ArrayList<>();
        private int mTracingMode = RECORD_CONTINUOUSLY;

        public Builder()
        {
        }

        public TracingConfig build()
        {
            return new TracingConfig(mPredefinedCategories, mCustomIncludedCategories, mTracingMode);
        }

        public Builder addCategories(int... predefinedCategories)
        {
            for (int categoryBitmask : predefinedCategories) mPredefinedCategories |= categoryBitmask;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder addCategories(String... categories)
        {
            mCustomIncludedCategories.addAll(Arrays.asList(categories));
            return this;
        }

        public Builder addCategories(Collection<String> categories)
        {
            mCustomIncludedCategories.addAll(categories);
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setTracingMode(int tracingMode)
        {
            mTracingMode = tracingMode;
            return this;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/webkit/TracingController.java`:

```java
package android.webkit;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;

public abstract class TracingController
{
    public TracingController()
    {
    }

    public static TracingController getInstance()
    {
        return LocalTracingController.INSTANCE;
    }

    public abstract void start(TracingConfig tracingConfig);

    public abstract boolean stop(OutputStream outputStream, Executor executor);

    public abstract boolean isTracing();

    private static final class LocalTracingController extends TracingController
    {
        static final LocalTracingController INSTANCE = new LocalTracingController();

        private boolean mTracing;

        @Override
        public synchronized void start(TracingConfig tracingConfig)
        {
            if (tracingConfig == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("tracingConfig cannot be null");
            if (mTracing) throw new IllegalStateException("cannot start tracing: tracing is already enabled");
            mTracing = true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean stop(final OutputStream outputStream, Executor executor)
        {
            synchronized (this)
            {
                if (!mTracing) return false;
                mTracing = false;
            }
            if (outputStream == null) return true;
            Runnable writer = new Runnable()
            {
                @Override
                public void run()
                {
                    try
                    {
                        outputStream.write("{\"traceEvents\":[]}".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
                        outputStream.close();
                    }
                    catch (IOException ignored)
                    {
                    }
                }
            };
            if (executor != null)
            {
                executor.execute(writer);
            }
            else
            {
                writer.run();
            }
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public synchronized boolean isTracing()
        {
            return mTracing;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/webkit/URLUtil.java`:

```java
package android.webkit;

import android.net.Uri;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public final class URLUtil
{
    static final String ASSET_BASE = "file:///android_asset/";
    static final String RESOURCE_BASE = "file:///android_res/";
    static final String FILE_BASE = "file:";
    static final String PROXY_BASE = "file:///cookieless_proxy/";
    static final String CONTENT_BASE = "content:";

    private static final Pattern CONTENT_DISPOSITION = Pattern.compile(
        "attachment;\\s*filename\\s*=\\s*(\"?)([^\"]*)\\1\\s*$", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);
    private static final Pattern CONTENT_DISPOSITION_EXTENDED = Pattern.compile(
        "filename\\*\\s*=\\s*([^']*)'[^']*'([^;\\s]+)", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);
    private static final Pattern CONTENT_DISPOSITION_PLAIN = Pattern.compile(
        "filename\\s*=\\s*(\"?)([^\";]*)\\1", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);

    public URLUtil()
    {
    }

    public static String guessUrl(String inUrl)
    {
        String original = inUrl;
        if (inUrl.length() == 0) return inUrl;
        if (inUrl.startsWith("about:")) return inUrl;
        if (inUrl.startsWith("data:")) return inUrl;
        if (inUrl.startsWith("file:")) return inUrl;
        if (inUrl.startsWith("javascript:")) return inUrl;

        if (inUrl.endsWith(".")) inUrl = inUrl.substring(0, inUrl.length() - 1);
        String candidate = inUrl.trim();
        if (candidate.contains(" ")) return original;

        String scheme = "http";
        int schemeEnd = candidate.indexOf("://");
        if (schemeEnd > 0)
        {
            scheme = candidate.substring(0, schemeEnd).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            candidate = candidate.substring(schemeEnd + 3);
        }

        int pathStart = candidate.length();
        for (int index = 0; index < candidate.length(); index++)
        {
            char character = candidate.charAt(index);
            if (character == '/' || character == '?' || character == '#')
            {
                pathStart = index;
                break;
            }
        }
        String authority = candidate.substring(0, pathStart);
        String path = candidate.substring(pathStart);
        if (authority.isEmpty()) return original;

        String userInfo = "";
        int at = authority.lastIndexOf('@');
        if (at >= 0)
        {
            userInfo = authority.substring(0, at + 1);
            authority = authority.substring(at + 1);
        }
        String host = authority;
        String port = "";
        int colon = authority.lastIndexOf(':');
        if (colon >= 0 && authority.indexOf(']') < colon)
        {
            host = authority.substring(0, colon);
            port = authority.substring(colon);
        }
        if (host.isEmpty()) return original;
        if (host.indexOf('.') == -1 && !host.startsWith("[")) host = "www." + host + ".com";
        if (path.isEmpty()) path = "/";
        return scheme + "://" + userInfo + host.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT) + port + path;
    }

    public static String composeSearchUrl(String inQuery, String template, String queryPlaceHolder)
    {
        int placeHolderIndex = template.indexOf(queryPlaceHolder);
        if (placeHolderIndex < 0) return null;

        String query;
        StringBuilder buffer = new StringBuilder();
        buffer.append(template.substring(0, placeHolderIndex));
        try
        {
            query = URLEncoder.encode(inQuery, "utf-8");
            buffer.append(query);
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            return null;
        }
        buffer.append(template.substring(placeHolderIndex + queryPlaceHolder.length()));
        return buffer.toString();
    }

    public static byte[] decode(byte[] url) throws IllegalArgumentException
    {
        if (url.length == 0) return new byte[0];

        ByteArrayOutputStream output = new ByteArrayOutputStream(url.length);
        for (int index = 0; index < url.length; index++)
        {
            byte value = url[index];
            if (value == '%')
            {
                if (url.length - index > 2)
                {
                    value = (byte)(parseHex(url[index + 1]) * 16 + parseHex(url[index + 2]));
                    index += 2;
                }
                else
                {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid format");
                }
            }
            output.write(value);
        }
        return output.toByteArray();
    }

    private static int parseHex(byte value)
    {
        if (value >= '0' && value <= '9') return value - '0';
        if (value >= 'A' && value <= 'F') return value - 'A' + 10;
        if (value >= 'a' && value <= 'f') return value - 'a' + 10;
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid hex char '" + (char)value + "'");
    }

    public static boolean isAssetUrl(String url)
    {
        return url != null && url.startsWith(ASSET_BASE);
    }

    public static boolean isResourceUrl(String url)
    {
        return url != null && url.startsWith(RESOURCE_BASE);
    }

    public static boolean isCookielessProxyUrl(String url)
    {
        return url != null && url.startsWith(PROXY_BASE);
    }

    public static boolean isFileUrl(String url)
    {
        return url != null && url.startsWith(FILE_BASE) && !url.startsWith(ASSET_BASE) && !url.startsWith(PROXY_BASE);
    }

    public static boolean isAboutUrl(String url)
    {
        return url != null && url.startsWith("about:");
    }

    public static boolean isDataUrl(String url)
    {
        return url != null && url.startsWith("data:");
    }

    public static boolean isJavaScriptUrl(String url)
    {
        return url != null && url.startsWith("javascript:");
    }

    public static boolean isHttpUrl(String url)
    {
        return url != null && url.length() > 6 && url.substring(0, 7).equalsIgnoreCase("http://");
    }

    public static boolean isHttpsUrl(String url)
    {
        return url != null && url.length() > 7 && url.substring(0, 8).equalsIgnoreCase("https://");
    }

    public static boolean isNetworkUrl(String url)
    {
        if (url == null || url.length() == 0) return false;
        return isHttpUrl(url) || isHttpsUrl(url);
    }

    public static boolean isContentUrl(String url)
    {
        return url != null && url.startsWith(CONTENT_BASE);
    }

    public static boolean isValidUrl(String url)
    {
        if (url == null || url.length() == 0) return false;
        return isAssetUrl(url) || isResourceUrl(url) || isFileUrl(url) || isAboutUrl(url) || isHttpUrl(url)
            || isHttpsUrl(url) || isJavaScriptUrl(url) || isContentUrl(url);
    }

    public static String stripAnchor(String url)
    {
        int anchorIndex = url.indexOf('#');
        if (anchorIndex != -1) return url.substring(0, anchorIndex);
        return url;
    }

    public static String guessFileName(String url, String contentDisposition, String mimeType)
    {
        String filename = null;
        String extension = null;

        if (contentDisposition != null) filename = parseContentDisposition(contentDisposition);
        if (filename != null)
        {
            int index = filename.lastIndexOf('/') + 1;
            if (index > 0) filename = filename.substring(index);
        }

        if (filename == null)
        {
            String decodedUrl = Uri.decode(url);
            if (decodedUrl != null)
            {
                int queryIndex = decodedUrl.indexOf('?');
                if (queryIndex > 0) decodedUrl = decodedUrl.substring(0, queryIndex);
                if (!decodedUrl.endsWith("/"))
                {
                    int index = decodedUrl.lastIndexOf('/') + 1;
                    if (index > 0) filename = decodedUrl.substring(index);
                }
            }
        }

        if (filename == null || filename.isEmpty()) filename = "downloadfile";

        int dotIndex = filename.indexOf('.');
        if (dotIndex < 0)
        {
            if (mimeType != null)
            {
                extension = MimeTypeMap.getSingleton().getExtensionFromMimeType(mimeType);
                if (extension != null) extension = "." + extension;
            }
            if (extension == null)
            {
                if (mimeType != null && mimeType.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith("text/"))
                {
                    extension = mimeType.equalsIgnoreCase("text/html") ? ".html" : ".txt";
                }
                else
                {
                    extension = ".bin";
                }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (mimeType != null)
            {
                int lastDotIndex = filename.lastIndexOf('.');
                String typeFromExtension = MimeTypeMap.getSingleton().getMimeTypeFromExtension(filename.substring(lastDotIndex + 1));
                if (typeFromExtension != null && !typeFromExtension.equalsIgnoreCase(mimeType))
                {
                    extension = MimeTypeMap.getSingleton().getExtensionFromMimeType(mimeType);
                    if (extension != null) extension = "." + extension;
                }
            }
            if (extension == null) extension = filename.substring(dotIndex);
            filename = filename.substring(0, dotIndex);
        }

        return filename + extension;
    }

    static String parseContentDisposition(String contentDisposition)
    {
        try
        {
            Matcher extended = CONTENT_DISPOSITION_EXTENDED.matcher(contentDisposition);
            if (extended.find())
            {
                String charset = extended.group(1).isEmpty() ? "UTF-8" : extended.group(1);
                return java.net.URLDecoder.decode(extended.group(2), charset);
            }
            Matcher matcher = CONTENT_DISPOSITION.matcher(contentDisposition);
            if (matcher.find()) return matcher.group(2);
            Matcher plain = CONTENT_DISPOSITION_PLAIN.matcher(contentDisposition);
            if (plain.find()) return plain.group(2);
        }
        catch (Exception ignored)
        {
        }
        return null;
    }
}
```

```java
        public static Uri[] parseResult(int resultCode, Intent data)
        {
            if (resultCode != Activity.RESULT_OK || data == null) return null;
            ClipData clipData = data.getClipData();
            if (clipData != null && clipData.getItemCount() > 0)
            {
                Uri[] uris = new Uri[clipData.getItemCount()];
                int count = 0;
                for (int index = 0; index < clipData.getItemCount(); index++)
                {
                    Uri uri = clipData.getItemAt(index).getUri();
                    if (uri != null) uris[count++] = uri;
                }
                if (count > 0)
                {
                    Uri[] result = new Uri[count];
                    System.arraycopy(uris, 0, result, 0, count);
                    return result;
                }
            }
            Uri uri = data.getData();
            return uri == null ? null : new Uri[] {uri};
        }

        public abstract int getMode();

        public abstract String[] getAcceptTypes();

        public abstract boolean isCaptureEnabled();

        public abstract CharSequence getTitle();

        public abstract String getFilenameHint();

        public abstract Intent createIntent();
    }
```

```java
package android.webkit;

import android.os.Handler;

public abstract class WebMessagePort
{
    WebMessagePort()
```

`java/android/webkit/WebResourceResponse.java`:

```java
package android.webkit;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.Map;

public class WebResourceResponse
{
    private String mMimeType;
    private String mEncoding;
    private int mStatusCode = 200;
    private String mReasonPhrase = "OK";
    private Map<String, String> mResponseHeaders;
    private InputStream mInputStream;

    public WebResourceResponse(String mimeType, String encoding, InputStream data)
    {
        mMimeType = mimeType;
        mEncoding = encoding;
        setData(data);
    }

    public WebResourceResponse(String mimeType, String encoding, int statusCode, String reasonPhrase,
        Map<String, String> responseHeaders, InputStream data)
    {
        this(mimeType, encoding, data);
        setStatusCodeAndReasonPhrase(statusCode, reasonPhrase);
        setResponseHeaders(responseHeaders);
    }

    public void setMimeType(String mimeType)
    {
        mMimeType = mimeType;
    }

    public String getMimeType()
    {
        return mMimeType;
    }

    public void setEncoding(String encoding)
    {
        mEncoding = encoding;
    }

    public String getEncoding()
    {
        return mEncoding;
    }

    public void setStatusCodeAndReasonPhrase(int statusCode, String reasonPhrase)
    {
        if (statusCode < 100) throw new IllegalArgumentException("statusCode can't be less than 100.");
        if (statusCode > 599) throw new IllegalArgumentException("statusCode can't be greater than 599.");
        if (statusCode > 299 && statusCode < 400)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("statusCode can't be in the [300, 399] range.");
        }
        if (reasonPhrase == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("reasonPhrase can't be null.");
        if (reasonPhrase.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("reasonPhrase can't be empty.");
        for (int index = 0; index < reasonPhrase.length(); index++)
        {
            if (reasonPhrase.charAt(index) > 0x7F)
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("reasonPhrase can't contain non-ASCII characters.");
            }
        }
        mStatusCode = statusCode;
        mReasonPhrase = reasonPhrase;
    }

    public int getStatusCode()
    {
        return mStatusCode;
    }

    public String getReasonPhrase()
    {
        return mReasonPhrase;
    }

    public void setResponseHeaders(Map<String, String> headers)
    {
        mResponseHeaders = headers;
    }

    public Map<String, String> getResponseHeaders()
    {
        return mResponseHeaders;
    }

    public void setData(InputStream data)
    {
        if (data instanceof java.io.StringBufferInputStream)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("StringBufferInputStream is deprecated and must not be passed to a "
                + "WebResourceResponse");
        }
        mInputStream = data;
    }

    public InputStream getData()
    {
        return mInputStream;
    }
}
```

`java/android/webkit/WebStorage.java`:

```java
package android.webkit;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class WebStorage
{
    private static final WebStorage INSTANCE = new WebStorage();

    private final Map<String, Origin> mOrigins = new HashMap<>();

    WebStorage()
    {
    }

    public static WebStorage getInstance()
    {
        return INSTANCE;
    }

    public void getOrigins(ValueCallback<Map> callback)
    {
        Map<String, Origin> origins;
        synchronized (mOrigins)
        {
            origins = new HashMap<>(mOrigins);
        }
        if (callback != null) callback.onReceiveValue(origins);
    }

    public void getUsageForOrigin(String origin, ValueCallback<Long> callback)
    {
        Origin entry;
        synchronized (mOrigins)
        {
            entry = origin == null ? null : mOrigins.get(origin);
        }
        if (callback != null) callback.onReceiveValue(entry == null ? 0L : entry.getUsage());
    }

    public void getQuotaForOrigin(String origin, ValueCallback<Long> callback)
    {
        Origin entry;
        synchronized (mOrigins)
        {
            entry = origin == null ? null : mOrigins.get(origin);
        }
        if (callback != null) callback.onReceiveValue(entry == null ? 0L : entry.getQuota());
    }

    public void setQuotaForOrigin(String origin, long quota)
    {
        if (origin == null) return;
        synchronized (mOrigins)
        {
            Origin entry = mOrigins.get(origin);
            mOrigins.put(origin, new Origin(origin, quota, entry == null ? 0 : entry.getUsage()));
        }
    }

    public void deleteOrigin(String origin)
    {
        synchronized (mOrigins)
        {
            mOrigins.remove(origin);
        }
    }

    public void deleteAllData()
    {
        synchronized (mOrigins)
        {
            mOrigins.clear();
        }
    }

    public interface QuotaUpdater
    {
        void updateQuota(long newQuota);
    }

    public static class Origin
    {
        private final String mOrigin;
        private final long mQuota;
        private final long mUsage;

        protected Origin(String origin, long quota, long usage)
        {
            mOrigin = origin;
            mQuota = quota;
            mUsage = usage;
        }

        public String getOrigin()
        {
            return mOrigin;
        }

        public long getQuota()
        {
            return mQuota;
        }

        public long getUsage()
        {
            return mUsage;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    public WebBackForwardList saveState(Bundle outState)
    {
        checkThread();
        if (outState == null || mHistory.getSize() == 0) return null;
        ArrayList<String> urls = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<String> originalUrls = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<String> titles = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int index = 0; index < mHistory.getSize(); index++)
        {
            LocalHistoryItem item = mHistory.getItemAtIndex(index);
            urls.add(item.getUrl());
            originalUrls.add(item.getOriginalUrl());
            titles.add(item.getTitle());
        }
        outState.putStringArrayList(STATE_URLS, urls);
        outState.putStringArrayList(STATE_ORIGINAL_URLS, originalUrls);
        outState.putStringArrayList(STATE_TITLES, titles);
        outState.putInt(STATE_INDEX, mHistory.getCurrentIndex());
        return copyBackForwardList();
    }

    public WebBackForwardList restoreState(Bundle inState)
    {
        checkThread();
        if (inState == null) return null;
        ArrayList<String> urls = inState.getStringArrayList(STATE_URLS);
        ArrayList<String> originalUrls = inState.getStringArrayList(STATE_ORIGINAL_URLS);
        ArrayList<String> titles = inState.getStringArrayList(STATE_TITLES);
        if (urls == null || urls.isEmpty()) return null;
        int index = inState.getInt(STATE_INDEX);
        if (index < 0 || index >= urls.size()) return null;

        mHistory.clear();
        for (int position = 0; position < urls.size(); position++)
        {
            String original = originalUrls != null && position < originalUrls.size() ? originalUrls.get(position) : urls.get(position);
            String title = titles != null && position < titles.size() ? titles.get(position) : urls.get(position);
            mHistory.push(new LocalHistoryItem(urls.get(position), original, title));
        }
        mHistory.goBackOrForward(index - mHistory.getCurrentIndex());
        LocalHistoryItem current = mHistory.getCurrentItem();
        navigate(current.getUrl(), current.getOriginalUrl(), null, "GET", null, NavigationKind.HISTORY);
        return copyBackForwardList();
    }

    public void loadUrl(String url, Map<String, String> additionalHttpHeaders)
    {
        checkThread();
        if (url == null || mDestroyed) return;
        if (URLUtil.isJavaScriptUrl(url))
        {
            evaluateJavascript(url.substring("javascript:".length()), null);
            return;
        }
        navigate(url, url, null, "GET", additionalHttpHeaders, NavigationKind.NEW);
    }

    public void loadUrl(String url)
    {
        loadUrl(url, null);
    }

    public void postUrl(String url, byte[] postData)
    {
        checkThread();
        if (url == null || mDestroyed) return;
        if (URLUtil.isNetworkUrl(url))
        {
            navigate(url, url, null, "POST", null, NavigationKind.NEW);
            return;
        }
        loadUrl(url);
    }

    public void loadData(String data, String mimeType, String encoding)
    {
        checkThread();
        if (mDestroyed) return;
        String type = mimeType == null || mimeType.isEmpty() ? "text/html" : mimeType;
        boolean base64 = encoding != null && encoding.equalsIgnoreCase("base64");
        String url = "data:" + type + (base64 ? ";base64" : "") + "," + (data == null ? "" : data);
        navigate(url, url, base64 ? null : data, "GET", null, NavigationKind.NEW);
    }

    public void loadDataWithBaseURL(String baseUrl, String data, String mimeType, String encoding, String historyUrl)
    {
        checkThread();
        if (mDestroyed) return;
        String url = baseUrl == null || baseUrl.isEmpty() ? ABOUT_BLANK : baseUrl;
        if (URLUtil.isDataUrl(url))
        {
            loadData(data, mimeType, encoding);
            return;
        }
        String original = historyUrl == null || historyUrl.isEmpty() ? ABOUT_BLANK : historyUrl;
        navigate(url, original, data == null ? "" : data, "GET", null, NavigationKind.INLINE);
    }
```
