```java
    }

    public boolean isSelectedChildViewEnabled()
    {
        return mSelectedChildViewEnabled;
    }

    public void setSelectedChildViewEnabled(boolean selectedChildViewEnabled)
    {
        mSelectedChildViewEnabled = selectedChildViewEnabled;
    }

    @Override
    protected void dispatchDraw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        int saveCount = canvas.save();
        if (getClipToPadding())
        {
            canvas.clipRect(getScrollX() + getPaddingLeft(), getScrollY() + getPaddingTop(), getScrollX() + getWidth() - getPaddingRight(),
                            getScrollY() + getHeight() - getPaddingBottom());
        }

        if (!mDrawSelectorOnTop) drawSelector(canvas);
        super.dispatchDraw(canvas);
        if (mDrawSelectorOnTop) drawSelector(canvas);

        canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
    }

    private void drawSelector(Canvas canvas)
    {
        if (mSelectorRect.isEmpty() || mSelectorPosition < 0) return;
        if (mTouchMode != TOUCH_MODE_TAP && mTouchMode != TOUCH_MODE_DONE_WAITING && !isPressed()) return;

        Drawable selector = getSelector();
        selector.setBounds(mSelectorRect);
        selector.draw(canvas);
    }

    protected boolean isPaddingOffsetRequired()
    {
        return !getClipToPadding();
    }

    protected int getLeftPaddingOffset()
    {
        return getClipToPadding() ? 0 : -getPaddingLeft();
    }

    protected int getTopPaddingOffset()
    {
        return getClipToPadding() ? 0 : -getPaddingTop();
    }

    protected int getRightPaddingOffset()
    {
        return getClipToPadding() ? 0 : getPaddingRight();
    }

    protected int getBottomPaddingOffset()
    {
        return getClipToPadding() ? 0 : getPaddingBottom();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onSizeChanged(int width, int height, int oldWidth, int oldHeight)
    {
        super.onSizeChanged(width, height, oldWidth, oldHeight);
        if (getChildCount() > 0 && height != oldHeight) invokeOnItemScrollListener();
    }

    public void setDrawSelectorOnTop(boolean onTop)
    {
        mDrawSelectorOnTop = onTop;
    }

    public boolean isDrawSelectorOnTop()
    {
        return mDrawSelectorOnTop;
    }

    public void setSelector(int resID)
    {
        setSelector(getContext().getDrawable(resID));
    }

    public void setSelector(Drawable selector)
    {
        if (mSelector != null) mSelector.setCallback(null);

        mSelector = selector;
        if (selector != null) selector.setCallback(this);

        invalidate();
    }

    public Drawable getSelector()
    {
        if (mSelector == null)
        {
            mSelector = new ColorDrawable(DEFAULT_SELECTOR_COLOR);
            mSelector.setCallback(this);
        }

        return mSelector;
    }

    void positionSelector(int position)
    {
        mSelectorPosition = position;

        View child = getChildAt(position - mFirstPosition);
        if (child == null)
        {
            mSelectorRect.setEmpty();
            return;
        }

        mSelectorRect.set(child.getLeft(), child.getTop(), child.getRight(), child.getBottom());
        if (child instanceof SelectionBoundsAdjuster) ((SelectionBoundsAdjuster)child).adjustListItemSelectionBounds(mSelectorRect);
    }

    private void clearSelector()
    {
        mSelectorPosition = INVALID_POSITION;
        mSelectorRect.setEmpty();
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setScrollIndicators(View up, View down)
    {
        mScrollUp = up;
        mScrollDown = down;
        updateScrollIndicators();
    }

    @Override
    protected void drawableStateChanged()
    {
        super.drawableStateChanged();
        updateSelectorState();
    }

    private void updateSelectorState()
    {
        if (mSelector == null) return;

        boolean pressed = isPressed() || mTouchMode == TOUCH_MODE_TAP || mTouchMode == TOUCH_MODE_DONE_WAITING;
        mSelector.setState(pressed ? new int[] {STATE_PRESSED} : EMPTY_STATE_SET);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean verifyDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        return mSelector == drawable || super.verifyDrawable(drawable);
    }

    public void jumpDrawablesToCurrentState()
    {
        if (mSelector != null) mSelector.jumpToCurrentState();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onAttachedToWindow()
    {
        super.onAttachedToWindow();

        if (mAdapter != null && mDataSetObserver == null)
        {
            mDataSetObserver = new AdapterDataSetObserver();
            mAdapter.registerDataSetObserver(mDataSetObserver);

            mDataChanged = true;
            mOldItemCount = mItemCount;
            mItemCount = mAdapter.getCount();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow()
    {
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();

        stopFling();
        if (mPositionScroller != null) mPositionScroller.stop();
        if (mPendingCheckForTap != null) removeCallbacks(mPendingCheckForTap);
        if (mPendingCheckForLongPress != null) removeCallbacks(mPendingCheckForLongPress);
        if (mTouchModeReset != null)
        {
            removeCallbacks(mTouchModeReset);
            mTouchModeReset.run();
        }

        mRecycler.clear();

        if (mAdapter != null && mDataSetObserver != null)
        {
            mAdapter.unregisterDataSetObserver(mDataSetObserver);
            mDataSetObserver = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onWindowFocusChanged(boolean hasWindowFocus)
    {
        super.onWindowFocusChanged(hasWindowFocus);

        if (!hasWindowFocus)
        {
            if (mTouchMode == TOUCH_MODE_FLING) stopFling();
            setPressed(false);
        }
    }

    public void onRtlPropertiesChanged(int layoutDirection)
    {
        requestLayoutIfNecessary();
    }

    public void onCancelPendingInputEvents()
    {
        if (mPendingCheckForTap != null) removeCallbacks(mPendingCheckForTap);
        if (mPendingCheckForLongPress != null) removeCallbacks(mPendingCheckForLongPress);
    }

    protected ContextMenu.ContextMenuInfo getContextMenuInfo()
    {
        return mContextMenuInfo;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean showContextMenu()
    {
        return super.showContextMenu();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean showContextMenu(float x, float y)
    {
        int position = pointToPosition((int)x, (int)y);
        if (position != INVALID_POSITION)
        {
            long id = mAdapter.getItemId(position);
            View child = getChildAt(position - mFirstPosition);
            if (child != null)
            {
                mContextMenuInfo = new AdapterContextMenuInfo(child, position, id);
                return super.showContextMenu();
            }
        }

        return super.showContextMenu(x, y);
    }

    public boolean showContextMenuForChild(View originalView)
    {
        int position = getPositionForView(originalView);
        if (position < 0) return false;

        long id = mAdapter.getItemId(position);
        boolean handled = false;
        if (mOnItemLongClickListener != null) handled = mOnItemLongClickListener.onItemLongClick(this, originalView, position, id);

        if (!handled)
        {
            mContextMenuInfo = new AdapterContextMenuInfo(getChildAt(position - mFirstPosition), position, id);
            handled = super.showContextMenu();
        }

        return handled;
    }

    public boolean showContextMenuForChild(View originalView, float x, float y)
    {
        return showContextMenuForChild(originalView);
    }

    boolean performLongPress(View child, int position, long id)
    {
        if (mChoiceMode == CHOICE_MODE_MULTIPLE_MODAL)
        {
            if (mChoiceActionMode == null && startChoiceActionMode())
            {
                setItemChecked(position, true);
                performHapticFeedback(HAPTIC_LONG_PRESS);
            }

            return true;
        }

        boolean handled = false;
        if (mOnItemLongClickListener != null) handled = mOnItemLongClickListener.onItemLongClick(this, child, position, id);

        if (!handled)
        {
            mContextMenuInfo = new AdapterContextMenuInfo(child, position, id);
            handled = super.showContextMenu();
        }

        if (handled) performHapticFeedback(HAPTIC_LONG_PRESS);
        return handled;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onKeyDown(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        if (mAdapter == null || mItemCount == 0) return super.onKeyDown(keyCode, event);

        int page = Math.max(1, getHeight() - mListPadding.top - mListPadding.bottom);
        int row = getChildCount() > 0 ? Math.max(1, getChildAt(0).getHeight() + rowSpacing()) : page / 4;

        switch (keyCode)
        {
            case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP:
                smoothScrollBy(-row, DEFAULT_SMOOTH_SCROLL_DURATION);
                return true;
            case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN:
                smoothScrollBy(row, DEFAULT_SMOOTH_SCROLL_DURATION);
                return true;
            case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_PAGE_UP:
                smoothScrollBy(-page, DEFAULT_SMOOTH_SCROLL_DURATION);
                return true;
            case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_PAGE_DOWN:
                smoothScrollBy(page, DEFAULT_SMOOTH_SCROLL_DURATION);
                return true;
            case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MOVE_HOME:
                setSelection(0);
                return true;
            case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MOVE_END:
                setSelection(mItemCount - 1);
                return true;
            default:
                return super.onKeyDown(keyCode, event);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onKeyUp(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_CENTER || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_ENTER)
        {
            if (!isEnabled()) return true;

            int position = mSelectedPosition;
            if (isClickable() && isPressed() && position >= 0 && mAdapter != null && position < mAdapter.getCount())
            {
                View view = getChildAt(position - mFirstPosition);
                if (view != null)
                {
                    performItemClick(view, position, mSelectedRowId);
                    view.setPressed(false);
                }

                setPressed(false);
                return true;
            }
        }

        return super.onKeyUp(keyCode, event);
    }

    protected void dispatchSetPressed(boolean pressed)
    {
    }

    public void dispatchDrawableHotspotChanged(float x, float y)
    {
    }

    public int pointToPosition(int x, int y)
    {
        for (int index = getChildCount() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            if (child.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) continue;

            if (x >= child.getLeft() && x < child.getRight() && y >= child.getTop() && y < child.getBottom()) return mFirstPosition + index;
        }

        return INVALID_POSITION;
    }

    public long pointToRowId(int x, int y)
    {
        int position = pointToPosition(x, y);
        if (position >= 0 && mAdapter != null) return mAdapter.getItemId(position);
        return INVALID_ROW_ID;
    }

    @Override
    public void onTouchModeChanged(boolean isInTouchMode)
    {
        if (isInTouchMode) clearSelector();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onInterceptTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        int action = event.getActionMasked();

        if (mPositionScroller != null) mPositionScroller.stop();
        if (!isEnabled()) return false;
        if (action != MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN && mTouchOwnedBySelf) return false;

        switch (action)
        {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
            {
                mTouchOwnedBySelf = false;
                int touchMode = mTouchMode;
                int x = (int)event.getX();
                int y = (int)event.getY();

                mMotionX = x;
                mMotionY = y;
                mLastY = y;
                mMotionPosition = pointToPosition(x, y);
                obtainVelocityTracker().clear();
                mVelocityTracker.addMovement(event);

                if (touchMode == TOUCH_MODE_FLING)
                {
                    stopFling();
                    mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_SCROLL;
                    reportScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_TOUCH_SCROLL);
                    return true;
                }

                mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_DOWN;
                return false;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE:
            {
                if (mTouchMode == TOUCH_MODE_SCROLL) return true;
                if (mVelocityTracker != null) mVelocityTracker.addMovement(event);

                if (mTouchMode == TOUCH_MODE_DOWN || mTouchMode == TOUCH_MODE_TAP || mTouchMode == TOUCH_MODE_DONE_WAITING)
                {
                    return startScrollIfNeeded((int)event.getY());
                }

                return false;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_REST;
                recycleVelocityTracker();
                reportScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_IDLE);
                return false;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    private boolean startScrollIfNeeded(int y)
    {
        int distance = y - mMotionY;
        if (Math.abs(distance) <= mTouchSlop) return false;
        if (!canScrollList(distance > 0 ? -1 : 1)) return false;

        mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_SCROLL;
        mLastY = distance > 0 ? mMotionY + mTouchSlop : mMotionY - mTouchSlop;

        cancelPendingPress();
        setPressed(false);
        clearSelector();

        View child = getChildAt(mMotionPosition - mFirstPosition);
        if (child != null) child.setPressed(false);

        android.view.ViewParent parent = getParent();
        if (parent != null) parent.requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);

        reportScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_TOUCH_SCROLL);
        scrollByTouch(y);
        return true;
    }

    private void scrollByTouch(int y)
    {
        int incremental = y - mLastY;
        mLastY = y;

        if (incremental != 0) trackMotionScroll(incremental);
    }

    private void cancelPendingPress()
    {
        if (mPendingCheckForTap != null) removeCallbacks(mPendingCheckForTap);
        if (mPendingCheckForLongPress != null) removeCallbacks(mPendingCheckForLongPress);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (!isEnabled()) return isClickable() || isLongClickable();

        if (mPositionScroller != null) mPositionScroller.stop();

        int action = event.getActionMasked();
        int x = (int)event.getX();
        int y = (int)event.getY();

        obtainVelocityTracker().addMovement(event);

        switch (action)
        {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                mTouchOwnedBySelf = true;
                onTouchDown(x, y);
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE:
                onTouchMove(y);
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                mTouchOwnedBySelf = false;
                onTouchUp(x, y);
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                mTouchOwnedBySelf = false;
                onTouchCancel();
                return true;
            default:
                return true;
        }
    }

    private void onTouchDown(int x, int y)
    {
        if (mTouchMode == TOUCH_MODE_SCROLL) return;

        mMotionX = x;
        mMotionY = y;
        mLastY = y;

        if (mTouchMode == TOUCH_MODE_FLING || !mScroller.isFinished())
        {
            stopFling();
            mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_SCROLL;
            mMotionPosition = pointToPosition(x, y);
            reportScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_TOUCH_SCROLL);
            return;
        }

        mMotionPosition = pointToPosition(x, y);
        mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_DOWN;

        if (mMotionPosition < 0 || mDataChanged || mAdapter == null) return;

        if (mPendingCheckForTap == null)
        {
            mPendingCheckForTap = new Runnable()
            {
                @Override
                public void run()
                {
                    onTapTimeout();
                }
            };
        }

        postDelayed(mPendingCheckForTap, ViewConfiguration.getTapTimeout());
    }

    private void onTapTimeout()
    {
        if (mTouchMode != TOUCH_MODE_DOWN) return;

        mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_TAP;
        View child = getChildAt(mMotionPosition - mFirstPosition);
        if (child == null) return;

        if (!mDataChanged && mAdapter != null && mMotionPosition < mAdapter.getCount() && mAdapter.isEnabled(mMotionPosition))
        {
            child.setPressed(true);
            setPressed(true);
            positionSelector(mMotionPosition);
            updateSelectorState();
            invalidate();
        }

        if (!isLongClickable())
        {
            mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_DONE_WAITING;
            return;
        }

        if (mPendingCheckForLongPress == null)
        {
            mPendingCheckForLongPress = new Runnable()
            {
                @Override
                public void run()
                {
                    onLongPressTimeout();
                }
            };
        }

        int delay = Math.max(0, ViewConfiguration.getLongPressTimeout() - ViewConfiguration.getTapTimeout());
        postDelayed(mPendingCheckForLongPress, delay);
    }

    private void onLongPressTimeout()
    {
        if (mTouchMode != TOUCH_MODE_TAP) return;

        int position = mMotionPosition;
        View child = getChildAt(position - mFirstPosition);
        if (child == null || mDataChanged || mAdapter == null || position >= mAdapter.getCount())
        {
            mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_DONE_WAITING;
            return;
        }

        boolean handled = performLongPress(child, position, mAdapter.getItemId(position));
        if (!handled)
        {
            mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_DONE_WAITING;
            return;
        }

        mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_REST;
        setPressed(false);
        child.setPressed(false);
        clearSelector();
    }

    private void onTouchMove(int y)
    {
        switch (mTouchMode)
        {
            case TOUCH_MODE_DOWN:
            case TOUCH_MODE_TAP:
            case TOUCH_MODE_DONE_WAITING:
                if (startScrollIfNeeded(y)) return;
                if (Math.abs(y - mMotionY) > mTouchSlop)
                {
                    cancelPendingPress();
                    setPressed(false);
                    View child = getChildAt(mMotionPosition - mFirstPosition);
                    if (child != null) child.setPressed(false);
                    clearSelector();
                    mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_DONE_WAITING;
                    mMotionPosition = INVALID_POSITION;
                }
                return;
            case TOUCH_MODE_SCROLL:
                scrollByTouch(y);
                return;
            default:
                return;
        }
    }

    private void onTouchUp(int x, int y)
    {
        switch (mTouchMode)
        {
            case TOUCH_MODE_DOWN:
            case TOUCH_MODE_TAP:
            case TOUCH_MODE_DONE_WAITING:
                performTouchClick(x, y);
                break;
            case TOUCH_MODE_SCROLL:
            {
                int velocity = 0;
                if (mVelocityTracker != null)
                {
                    mVelocityTracker.computeCurrentVelocity(1000, mMaximumVelocity);
                    velocity = (int)(mVelocityTracker.getYVelocity() * mVelocityScale);
                }

                if (Math.abs(velocity) > mMinimumVelocity && getChildCount() > 0) startFling(velocity);
                else
                {
                    mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_REST;
                    reportScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_IDLE);
                }
                break;
            }
            default:
                mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_REST;
                break;
        }

        setPressed(false);
        recycleVelocityTracker();

        android.view.ViewParent parent = getParent();
        if (parent != null) parent.requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(false);

        invalidate();
    }

    private void performTouchClick(int x, int y)
    {
        cancelPendingPress();

        final int position = mMotionPosition;
        final View child = getChildAt(position - mFirstPosition);
        boolean clickable = child != null && position >= 0 && !mDataChanged && mAdapter != null && position < mAdapter.getCount()
                            && mAdapter.isEnabled(position) && x >= 0 && x < getWidth();

        if (!clickable)
        {
            mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_REST;
            clearSelector();
            return;
        }

        final long id = mAdapter.getItemId(position);
        child.setPressed(true);
        positionSelector(position);
        mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_TAP;
        updateSelectorState();
        invalidate();

        if (mTouchModeReset != null) removeCallbacks(mTouchModeReset);

        mTouchModeReset = new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                mTouchModeReset = null;
                mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_REST;
                child.setPressed(false);
                setPressed(false);
                clearSelector();

                if (!mDataChanged && isAttachedToWindow() && mAdapter != null && position < mAdapter.getCount())
                {
                    performItemClick(child, position, id);
                }
            }
        };

        postDelayed(mTouchModeReset, ViewConfiguration.getPressedStateDuration());
    }

    private void onTouchCancel()
    {
        cancelPendingPress();
        mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_REST;
        setPressed(false);

        View child = getChildAt(mMotionPosition - mFirstPosition);
        if (child != null) child.setPressed(false);

        clearSelector();
        recycleVelocityTracker();
        reportScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_IDLE);
    }

    private VelocityTracker obtainVelocityTracker()
    {
        if (mVelocityTracker == null) mVelocityTracker = VelocityTracker.obtain();
        return mVelocityTracker;
    }

    private void recycleVelocityTracker()
    {
        if (mVelocityTracker == null) return;

        mVelocityTracker.recycle();
        mVelocityTracker = null;
    }

    protected void onOverScrolled(int scrollX, int scrollY, boolean clampedX, boolean clampedY)
    {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onGenericMotionEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (event.getActionMasked() == MotionEvent.ACTION_SCROLL && mTouchMode == TOUCH_MODE_REST)
        {
            float vertical = event.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_VSCROLL);
            int delta = Math.round(vertical * mVerticalScrollFactor);

            if (delta != 0)
            {
                if (mPositionScroller != null) mPositionScroller.stop();
                stopFling();

                if (!trackMotionScroll(delta)) return true;
            }
        }

        return super.onGenericMotionEvent(event);
    }

    public void fling(int velocityY)
    {
        startFling(-velocityY);
    }

    void startFling(int velocity)
    {
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return;

        mScroller.fling(0, 0, 0, velocity, 0, 0, Integer.MIN_VALUE / 2, Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
        mLastFlingY = 0;
        mFlinging = true;
        mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_FLING;
        reportScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_FLING);
        invalidate();
    }

    void startScroll(int distance, int duration)
    {
        if (getChildCount() == 0 || distance == 0) return;

        mScroller.startScroll(0, 0, 0, -distance, duration);
        mLastFlingY = 0;
        mFlinging = true;
        mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_FLING;
        reportScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_FLING);
        invalidate();
    }

    void stopFling()
    {
        if (!mFlinging && mScroller.isFinished()) return;

        mScroller.abortAnimation();
        mFlinging = false;
        if (mTouchMode == TOUCH_MODE_FLING) mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_REST;
        reportScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_IDLE);
    }

    @Override
    public void computeScroll()
    {
        if (!mFlinging) return;

        if (!mScroller.computeScrollOffset())
        {
            mFlinging = false;
            if (mTouchMode == TOUCH_MODE_FLING) mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_REST;
            reportScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_IDLE);
            return;
        }

        int y = mScroller.getCurrY();
        int delta = y - mLastFlingY;
        mLastFlingY = y;

        if (delta != 0 && trackMotionScroll(delta))
        {
            stopFling();
            return;
        }

        if (mScroller.isFinished())
        {
            mFlinging = false;
            if (mTouchMode == TOUCH_MODE_FLING) mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_REST;
            reportScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_IDLE);
            return;
        }

        invalidate();
    }

    public boolean onStartNestedScroll(View child, View target, int nestedScrollAxes)
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void onNestedScrollAccepted(View child, View target, int axes)
    {
    }

    public void onNestedScroll(View target, int dxConsumed, int dyConsumed, int dxUnconsumed, int dyUnconsumed)
    {
        if (dyUnconsumed != 0) trackMotionScroll(-dyUnconsumed);
    }

    public boolean onNestedFling(View target, float velocityX, float velocityY, boolean consumed)
    {
        if (consumed) return false;

        fling((int)velocityY);
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(boolean disallowIntercept)
    {
        if (disallowIntercept) recycleVelocityTracker();
        super.requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(disallowIntercept);
    }

    }

    }

    public void addTouchables(ArrayList<View> views)
    {
        if (mAdapter == null) return;

        for (int index = 0; index < getChildCount(); index++)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            if (mAdapter.isEnabled(mFirstPosition + index)) views.add(child);
        }
    }

    public void setFriction(float friction)
    {
    }

    public void setVelocityScale(float scale)
    {
        mVelocityScale = scale;
    }

    public void smoothScrollToPosition(int position)
    {
        positionScroller().start(position, INVALID_POSITION, 0, false, DEFAULT_SMOOTH_SCROLL_DURATION);
    }

    public void smoothScrollToPositionFromTop(int position, int offset, int duration)
    {
        positionScroller().start(position, INVALID_POSITION, offset, true, duration);
    }

    public void smoothScrollToPositionFromTop(int position, int offset)
    {
        positionScroller().start(position, INVALID_POSITION, offset, true, DEFAULT_SMOOTH_SCROLL_DURATION);
    }

    public void smoothScrollToPosition(int position, int boundPosition)

    }

    public void smoothScrollBy(int distance, int duration)
    {
        if (mPositionScroller != null) mPositionScroller.stop();
        stopFling();
        startScroll(distance, duration);
    }

    private PositionScroller positionScroller()
    {
        if (mPositionScroller == null) mPositionScroller = new PositionScroller();
        return mPositionScroller;
    }

    public void scrollListBy(int y)
    {
        trackMotionScroll(-y);
    }

    public boolean canScrollList(int direction)
    {
        int childCount = getChildCount();
        if (childCount == 0) return false;

        if (direction > 0)
        {
            int lastPosition = mFirstPosition + childCount - 1;
            return lastPosition < mItemCount - 1 || lastRowBottom() > getHeight() - mListPadding.bottom;
        }

        return mFirstPosition > 0 || firstRowTop() < mListPadding.top;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canScrollVertically(int direction)
    {
        return canScrollList(direction);
    }

    public void invalidateViews()
    {
        mDataChanged = true;
        if (getChildCount() > 0)
        {
            mSyncPosition = mFirstPosition;
            mSpecificTop = getChildAt(0).getTop() - mListPadding.top;
        }

        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    protected void handleDataChanged()
    {
        int count = mItemCount;
        if (count <= 0)
        {
            setSelectedPositionInt(INVALID_POSITION);
            setNextSelectedPositionInt(INVALID_POSITION);
            return;
        }

        if (mSelectedPosition >= count) setSelectedPositionInt(count - 1);
        if (mNextSelectedPosition >= count) setNextSelectedPositionInt(count - 1);
    }

    public void clearTextFilter()
    {
        if (!mFiltered) return;

        mFiltered = false;
        mFilterText = null;

        if (mAdapter instanceof Filterable)
        {
            Filter filter = ((Filterable)mAdapter).getFilter();
            if (filter != null) filter.filter(null);
        }
    }

    public boolean hasTextFilter()
    {

    }

    public void onGlobalLayout()

    }

    @Override
    public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence text, int start, int count, int after)
    {
    }

    @Override
    public void onTextChanged(CharSequence text, int start, int before, int count)
    {
        if (!mTextFilterEnabled || !(mAdapter instanceof Filterable)) return;

        Filter filter = ((Filterable)mAdapter).getFilter();
        if (filter == null) throw new IllegalStateException("You cannot call onTextChanged with a non filterable adapter");

        mFiltered = text != null && text.length() > 0;
        mFilterText = text;
        filter.filter(text, this);
    }

    {
    }

    @Override
    public void onFilterComplete(int count)
    {
        if (mSelectedPosition < 0 && count > 0) mResurrectToPosition = INVALID_POSITION;
        requestLayout();
    }

    public void reclaimViews(List<View> views)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < getChildCount(); index++)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = child.getLayoutParams();
            if (params instanceof LayoutParams && mRecycler.shouldRecycleViewType(((LayoutParams)params).viewType)) views.add(child);
        }

        mRecycler.reclaimScrapViews(views);
        removeAllViewsInLayout();
    }

    public void setSelectionFromTop(int position, int y)
    {
        if (mAdapter == null) return;

        if (!isInTouchMode())
        {
            if (position >= 0 && position < mItemCount) setNextSelectedPositionInt(position);
        }
        else
        {
            mResurrectToPosition = position;
        }

        if (position < 0) return;

        if (mPositionScroller != null) mPositionScroller.stop();
        stopFling();

        mSyncPosition = position;
        mSpecificTop = y;
        requestLayout();
    }

        }

    final class RecycleBin
    {
        private final HashMap<Integer, View> mActiveViews = new HashMap<>();
        private final ArrayList<View> mTransientViews = new ArrayList<>();
        private ArrayList<View>[] mScrapViews = newScrapArray(1);

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        private ArrayList<View>[] newScrapArray(int count)
        {
            ArrayList<View>[] scrap = new ArrayList[Math.max(1, count)];
            for (int index = 0; index < scrap.length; index++) scrap[index] = new ArrayList<View>();
            return scrap;
        }

        void setViewTypeCount(int viewTypeCount)
        {
            if (viewTypeCount < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Can't have a viewTypeCount < 1");

            clear();
            mScrapViews = newScrapArray(viewTypeCount);
        }

        boolean shouldRecycleViewType(int viewType)
        {
            return viewType >= 0 && viewType < mScrapViews.length;
        }

        void fillActiveViews(int firstPosition)
        {
            int childCount = getChildCount();
            View[] children = new View[childCount];
            for (int index = 0; index < childCount; index++) children[index] = getChildAt(index);

            detachAllViewsFromParent();

            for (int index = 0; index < childCount; index++) mActiveViews.put(firstPosition + index, children[index]);
        }

        View takeActiveView(int position)
        {
            return mActiveViews.remove(position);
        }

        View takeScrapView(int viewType)
        {
            ArrayList<View> scrap = mScrapViews[viewType];
            if (scrap.isEmpty()) return null;

            return scrap.remove(scrap.size() - 1);
        }

        void addScrapView(View scrap, int position)
        {
            ViewGroup.LayoutParams raw = scrap.getLayoutParams();
            int viewType = raw instanceof LayoutParams ? ((LayoutParams)raw).viewType : ITEM_VIEW_TYPE_IGNORE;

            if (raw instanceof LayoutParams) ((LayoutParams)raw).scrappedFromPosition = position;

            scrap.setPressed(false);

            if (!shouldRecycleViewType(viewType))
            {
                if (!mTransientViews.contains(scrap)) mTransientViews.add(scrap);
                return;
            }

            ArrayList<View> list = mScrapViews[viewType];
            if (!list.contains(scrap)) list.add(scrap);

            if (mRecyclerListener != null) mRecyclerListener.onMovedToScrapHeap(scrap);
        }

        void forget(View view)
        {
            mTransientViews.remove(view);

            for (ArrayList<View> list : mScrapViews) list.remove(view);

            java.util.Iterator<java.util.Map.Entry<Integer, View>> iterator = mActiveViews.entrySet().iterator();
            while (iterator.hasNext())
            {
                if (iterator.next().getValue() == view) iterator.remove();
            }
        }

        void scrapActiveViews()
        {
            if (mActiveViews.isEmpty()) return;

            ArrayList<java.util.Map.Entry<Integer, View>> leftovers = new ArrayList<>(mActiveViews.entrySet());
            mActiveViews.clear();

            for (java.util.Map.Entry<Integer, View> entry : leftovers) addScrapView(entry.getValue(), entry.getKey());
        }

        void flushTransient()
        {
            if (mTransientViews.isEmpty()) return;

            ArrayList<View> leftovers = new ArrayList<>(mTransientViews);
            mTransientViews.clear();

            for (View view : leftovers) release(view);
        }

        void prune(int visibleCount)
        {
            int limit = Math.max(4, visibleCount * 2 + 2);

            for (ArrayList<View> list : mScrapViews)
            {
                while (list.size() > limit) release(list.remove(0));
            }
        }

        void clear()
        {
            ArrayList<View> leftovers = new ArrayList<>(mTransientViews);
            leftovers.addAll(mActiveViews.values());
            for (ArrayList<View> list : mScrapViews)
            {
                leftovers.addAll(list);
                list.clear();
            }

            mTransientViews.clear();
            mActiveViews.clear();

            for (View view : leftovers) release(view);
        }

        void reclaimScrapViews(List<View> views)
        {
            for (ArrayList<View> list : mScrapViews)
            {
                views.addAll(list);
                for (View view : list) release(view);
                list.clear();
            }
        }

        private void release(View view)
        {
            if (view.getParent() == AbsListView.this && indexOfChild(view) < 0) removeDetachedView(view, false);
        }
    }

    private final class PositionScroller implements Runnable
    {
        private int mTargetPosition;
        private int mBoundPosition;
        private int mOffset;
        private boolean mAlignTop;
        private int mDuration;

        void start(int position, int boundPosition, int offset, boolean alignTop, int duration)
        {
            stop();
            stopFling();

            if (mAdapter == null || mItemCount == 0) return;

            mTargetPosition = Math.max(0, Math.min(mItemCount - 1, position));
            mBoundPosition = boundPosition;
            mOffset = offset;
            mAlignTop = alignTop;
            mDuration = duration;

            if (getChildCount() == 0 || isLayoutRequested() && !isLaidOut())
            {
                setSelectionFromTop(mTargetPosition, mOffset);
                return;
            }

            postOnAnimation(this);
        }

        void stop()
        {
            removeCallbacks(this);
        }

        @Override
        public void run()
        {
            int childCount = getChildCount();
            if (childCount == 0 || mAdapter == null) return;

            int first = mFirstPosition;
            int last = first + childCount - 1;
            int listTop = mListPadding.top;
            int listBottom = getHeight() - mListPadding.bottom;
            int viewport = Math.max(1, listBottom - listTop);

            if (mTargetPosition >= first && mTargetPosition <= last)
            {
                View child = getChildAt(mTargetPosition - first);
                int distance;

                if (mAlignTop) distance = child.getTop() - (listTop + mOffset);
                else if (child.getTop() < listTop) distance = child.getTop() - listTop;
                else if (child.getBottom() > listBottom) distance = Math.min(child.getBottom() - listBottom, child.getTop() - listTop);
                else distance = 0;

                if (!mAlignTop && mBoundPosition >= first && mBoundPosition <= last && distance > 0)
                {
                    View bound = getChildAt(mBoundPosition - first);
                    distance = Math.min(distance, Math.max(0, bound.getTop() - listTop));
                }

                if (distance != 0) startScroll(distance, Math.max(1, mDuration));
                return;
            }

            int step = Math.max(viewport / 3, 1);
            boolean stuck = mTargetPosition > last ? trackMotionScroll(-step) : trackMotionScroll(step);
            if (stuck) return;

            postOnAnimation(this);
        }
    }

    private final class ChoiceActionMode extends ActionMode
    {
        private final RuntimeMenu mMenu = new RuntimeMenu(getContext());
        private CharSequence mTitle;
        private CharSequence mSubtitle;
        private View mCustomView;
        private boolean mFinished;

        @Override
        public void setTitle(CharSequence title)
        {
            mTitle = title;
        }

        @Override
        public void setTitle(int resId)
        {
            mTitle = getContext().getText(resId);
        }

        @Override
        public void setSubtitle(CharSequence subtitle)
        {
            mSubtitle = subtitle;
        }

        @Override
        public void setSubtitle(int resId)
        {
            mSubtitle = getContext().getText(resId);
        }

        @Override
        public void setCustomView(View view)
        {
            mCustomView = view;
        }

        @Override
        public void invalidate()
        {
            if (mMultiChoiceModeListener != null) mMultiChoiceModeListener.onPrepareActionMode(this, mMenu);
        }

        @Override
        public void finish()
        {
            if (mFinished) return;

            mFinished = true;
            if (mMultiChoiceModeListener != null) mMultiChoiceModeListener.onDestroyActionMode(this);
            if (mChoiceActionMode == this) mChoiceActionMode = null;

            clearChoices();
            mDataChanged = true;
            requestLayout();
            setLongClickable(true);
        }

        @Override
        public Menu getMenu()
        {
            return mMenu;
        }

        @Override
        public CharSequence getTitle()
        {
            return mTitle;
        }

        @Override
        public CharSequence getSubtitle()
        {
            return mSubtitle;
        }

        @Override
        public View getCustomView()
        {
            return mCustomView;
        }

        @Override
        public MenuInflater getMenuInflater()
        {
            return new MenuInflater(getContext());
        }
    }

    static class SavedState extends AbsSavedState
    {
        int firstPosition;
        int viewTop;
        int checkedItemCount;
        String filter;
        int[] checkedPositions;
        boolean[] checkedValues;
        long[] checkedIds;
        int[] checkedIdPositions;

        SavedState(Parcelable superState)
        {
            super(superState == null ? AbsSavedState.EMPTY_STATE : superState);
        }

        private SavedState(Parcel source)
        {
            super(source);
            firstPosition = source.readInt();
            viewTop = source.readInt();
            checkedItemCount = source.readInt();
            filter = source.readString();

            int checkedCount = source.readInt();
            if (checkedCount >= 0)
            {
                checkedPositions = new int[checkedCount];
                checkedValues = new boolean[checkedCount];
                for (int index = 0; index < checkedCount; index++)
                {
                    checkedPositions[index] = source.readInt();
                    checkedValues[index] = source.readInt() != 0;
                }
            }

            int idCount = source.readInt();
            if (idCount >= 0)
            {
                checkedIds = new long[idCount];
                checkedIdPositions = new int[idCount];
                for (int index = 0; index < idCount; index++)
                {
                    checkedIds[index] = source.readLong();
                    checkedIdPositions[index] = source.readInt();
                }
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
        {
            super.writeToParcel(out, flags);
            out.writeInt(firstPosition);
            out.writeInt(viewTop);
            out.writeInt(checkedItemCount);
            out.writeString(filter);

            out.writeInt(checkedPositions == null ? -1 : checkedPositions.length);
            if (checkedPositions != null)
            {
                for (int index = 0; index < checkedPositions.length; index++)
                {
                    out.writeInt(checkedPositions[index]);
                    out.writeInt(checkedValues[index] ? 1 : 0);
                }
            }

            out.writeInt(checkedIds == null ? -1 : checkedIds.length);
            if (checkedIds != null)
            {
                for (int index = 0; index < checkedIds.length; index++)
                {
                    out.writeLong(checkedIds[index]);
                    out.writeInt(checkedIdPositions[index]);
                }
            }
        }

        public static final Parcelable.Creator<SavedState> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<SavedState>()
        {
            @Override
            public SavedState createFromParcel(Parcel in)
            {
                return new SavedState(in);
            }

            @Override
            public SavedState[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new SavedState[size];
            }
        };
    }
}
```

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.graphics.BlendMode;

public abstract class AbsSeekBar extends ProgressBar
{
    private static final int NO_ALPHA = 0xFF;

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private Drawable mThumb;
    private Drawable mTickMark;
    private ColorStateList mThumbTintList;
    private ColorStateList mTickMarkTintList;
    private PorterDuff.Mode mThumbTintMode = PorterDuff.Mode.SRC_IN;
    private PorterDuff.Mode mTickMarkTintMode = PorterDuff.Mode.SRC_IN;
    private BlendMode mThumbTintBlendMode = BlendMode.SRC_IN;
    private BlendMode mTickMarkTintBlendMode = BlendMode.SRC_IN;
    private int mThumbOffset;
    private boolean mThumbOffsetSet;
    private boolean mSplitTrack;
    private int mKeyProgressIncrement = 1;
    private float mDisabledAlpha = 0.5f;
    private boolean mDragging;
    private final Paint mThumbPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Rect mThumbBounds = new Rect();

    boolean mIsUserSeekable = true;
    float mTouchProgressOffset;

    public AbsSeekBar(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public AbsSeekBar(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, 0);
    }

    public AbsSeekBar(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public AbsSeekBar(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        setFocusable(true);
        updateKeyProgressIncrement();

        StyleableSet styleable = styleable(context);
        if (styleable.isEmpty() || (attributes == null && defStyleAttr == 0 && defStyleRes == 0)) return;

        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, styleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        int index = styleable.indexOf("thumb");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) setThumb(loadDrawable(array, index));

        index = styleable.indexOf("tickMark");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) setTickMark(loadDrawable(array, index));

        index = styleable.indexOf("thumbOffset");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) setThumbOffset(array.getDimensionPixelOffset(index, mThumbOffset));

        index = styleable.indexOf("splitTrack");
        if (index >= 0) mSplitTrack = array.getBoolean(index, false);

        index = styleable.indexOf("disabledAlpha");
        if (index >= 0) mDisabledAlpha = array.getFloat(index, mDisabledAlpha);

        index = styleable.indexOf("thumbTint");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) mThumbTintList = readColors(array, index);

        index = styleable.indexOf("tickMarkTint");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) mTickMarkTintList = readColors(array, index);

        array.recycle();

        applyTint(mThumb, mThumbTintList, getDrawableState());
        applyTint(mTickMark, mTickMarkTintList, getDrawableState());
    }

    private static StyleableSet styleable(Context context)
    {
        if (sStyleable == null)
        {
            sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "thumb", "tickMark", "thumbOffset", "splitTrack", "disabledAlpha",
                                         "thumbTint", "tickMarkTint");
        }
        return sStyleable;
    }

    private static Drawable loadDrawable(TypedArray array, int index)
    {
        try
        {
            return array.getDrawable(index);
        }
        catch (Throwable unsupported)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static ColorStateList readColors(TypedArray array, int index)
    {
        try
        {
            return array.getColorStateList(index);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException unresolved)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public void setThumb(Drawable thumb)
    {
        if (mThumb == thumb) return;

        if (mThumb != null) mThumb.setCallback(null);

        mThumb = thumb;

        if (thumb != null)
        {
            thumb.setCallback(this);
            if (thumb.isStateful()) thumb.setState(getDrawableState());
            if (!mThumbOffsetSet) mThumbOffset = thumb.getIntrinsicWidth() / 2;
        }

        applyTint(thumb, mThumbTintList, getDrawableState());
        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public Drawable getThumb()
    {
        return mThumb;
    }

    public void setThumbTintList(ColorStateList tint)
    {
        mThumbTintList = tint;
        applyTint(mThumb, tint, getDrawableState());
        invalidate();
    }

    public ColorStateList getThumbTintList()
    {
        return mThumbTintList;
    }

    public void setThumbTintMode(PorterDuff.Mode tintMode)
    {
        mThumbTintMode = tintMode;
    }

    public void setThumbTintBlendMode(BlendMode blendMode)
    {
        mThumbTintBlendMode = blendMode;
    }

    public PorterDuff.Mode getThumbTintMode()
    {
        return mThumbTintMode;
    }

    public BlendMode getThumbTintBlendMode()
    {
        return mThumbTintBlendMode;
    }

    public int getThumbOffset()
    {
        return mThumbOffset;
    }

    public void setThumbOffset(int thumbOffset)
    {
        mThumbOffset = thumbOffset;
        mThumbOffsetSet = true;
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setSplitTrack(boolean splitTrack)
    {
        mSplitTrack = splitTrack;
        invalidate();
    }

    public boolean getSplitTrack()
    {
        return mSplitTrack;
    }

    public void setTickMark(Drawable tickMark)
    {
        if (mTickMark == tickMark) return;

        if (mTickMark != null) mTickMark.setCallback(null);

        mTickMark = tickMark;

        if (tickMark != null)
        {
            tickMark.setCallback(this);
            if (tickMark.isStateful()) tickMark.setState(getDrawableState());
        }

        applyTint(tickMark, mTickMarkTintList, getDrawableState());
        invalidate();
    }

    public Drawable getTickMark()
    {
        return mTickMark;
    }

    public void setTickMarkTintList(ColorStateList tint)
    {
        mTickMarkTintList = tint;
        applyTint(mTickMark, tint, getDrawableState());
        invalidate();
    }

    public ColorStateList getTickMarkTintList()
    {
        return mTickMarkTintList;
    }

    public void setTickMarkTintMode(PorterDuff.Mode tintMode)
    {
        mTickMarkTintMode = tintMode;
    }

    public void setTickMarkTintBlendMode(BlendMode blendMode)
    {
        mTickMarkTintBlendMode = blendMode;
    }

    public PorterDuff.Mode getTickMarkTintMode()
    {
        return mTickMarkTintMode;
    }

    public BlendMode getTickMarkTintBlendMode()
    {
        return mTickMarkTintBlendMode;
    }

    public void setKeyProgressIncrement(int increment)
    {
        mKeyProgressIncrement = increment < 0 ? -increment : increment;
    }

    public int getKeyProgressIncrement()
    {
        return mKeyProgressIncrement;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void setMin(int min)
    {
        super.setMin(min);
        updateKeyProgressIncrement();
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void setMax(int max)
    {
        super.setMax(max);
        updateKeyProgressIncrement();
    }

    private void updateKeyProgressIncrement()
    {
        int range = getMax() - getMin();

        if (mKeyProgressIncrement == 0 || range / mKeyProgressIncrement > 20) setKeyProgressIncrement(Math.max(1, Math.round(range / 20f)));
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean verifyDrawable(Drawable who)
    {
        return who == mThumb || who == mTickMark || super.verifyDrawable(who);
    }

    @Override
    public void jumpDrawablesToCurrentState()
    {
        super.jumpDrawablesToCurrentState();

        if (mThumb != null) mThumb.jumpToCurrentState();
        if (mTickMark != null) mTickMark.jumpToCurrentState();
    }

    @Override
    protected void drawableStateChanged()
    {
        super.drawableStateChanged();

        int[] state = getDrawableState();

        if (mThumb != null && mThumb.isStateful()) mThumb.setState(state);
        if (mTickMark != null && mTickMark.isStateful()) mTickMark.setState(state);
    }

    @Override
    public void drawableHotspotChanged(float x, float y)
    {
        super.drawableHotspotChanged(x, y);

        if (mThumb != null) mThumb.setHotspot(x, y);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onSizeChanged(int width, int height, int oldWidth, int oldHeight)
    {
        super.onSizeChanged(width, height, oldWidth, oldHeight);
    }

    @Override
    public void setSystemGestureExclusionRects(java.util.List<Rect> rects)
    {
        super.setSystemGestureExclusionRects(rects);
    }

    boolean drawsDefaultThumb()
    {
        return true;
    }

    int thumbWidth()
    {
        if (mThumb != null) return Math.max(0, mThumb.getIntrinsicWidth());
        if (!drawsDefaultThumb()) return 0;

        return (int)(20 * density());
    }

    int thumbHeight()
    {
        if (mThumb != null) return Math.max(0, mThumb.getIntrinsicHeight());
        if (!drawsDefaultThumb()) return 0;

        return (int)(20 * density());
    }

    private int effectiveThumbOffset()
    {
        if (mThumbOffsetSet || mThumb != null) return mThumbOffset;

        return thumbWidth() / 2;
    }

    @Override
    protected synchronized void onDraw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        super.onDraw(canvas);

        if (isIndeterminate()) return;

        drawTickMarks(canvas);
        drawThumb(canvas);
    }

    private void drawTickMarks(Canvas canvas)
    {
        if (mTickMark == null) return;

        int count = getMax() - getMin();
        if (count <= 1) return;

        int halfWidth = Math.max(1, mTickMark.getIntrinsicWidth() / 2);
        int halfHeight = Math.max(1, mTickMark.getIntrinsicHeight() / 2);
        float spacing = (getWidth() - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight()) / (float)count;
        float centreY = (getPaddingTop() + getHeight() - getPaddingBottom()) / 2f;

        mTickMark.setBounds(-halfWidth, (int)centreY - halfHeight, halfWidth, (int)centreY + halfHeight);

        int saveCount = canvas.save();
        canvas.translate(getPaddingLeft(), 0);

        for (int index = 0; index <= count; index++)
        {
            mTickMark.draw(canvas);
            canvas.translate(spacing, 0);
        }

        canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
    }

    private void drawThumb(Canvas canvas)
    {
        int width = thumbWidth();
        int height = thumbHeight();
        if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;

        int offset = effectiveThumbOffset();
        int available = getWidth() - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight() - width + offset * 2;
        float scale = getScale(getProgress());

        int position = (int)(scale * available + 0.5f);
        if (getLayoutDirection() == LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL) position = available - position;

        int left = getPaddingLeft() - offset + position;
        int top = (getPaddingTop() + getHeight() - getPaddingBottom() - height) / 2;

        mThumbBounds.set(left, top, left + width, top + height);

        if (mThumb != null)
        {
            mThumb.setBounds(mThumbBounds);
            mThumb.draw(canvas);
            return;
        }

        int colour = tintColor(mThumbTintList, getDrawableState(), accentColor());
        if (!isEnabled()) colour = (colour & 0x00FFFFFF) | ((int)(NO_ALPHA * mDisabledAlpha) << 24);

        float radius = Math.min(width, height) / 2f * (mDragging ? 1f : 0.75f);

        mThumbPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
        mThumbPaint.setColor(colour);
        canvas.drawCircle(mThumbBounds.exactCenterX(), mThumbBounds.exactCenterY(), radius, mThumbPaint);
    }

    @Override
    protected synchronized void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        int contentWidth = Math.max(getMinWidth(), Math.min(getMaxWidth(), intrinsicContentWidth()));
        int contentHeight = Math.max(getMinHeight(), Math.min(getMaxHeight(), intrinsicContentHeight()));
        contentHeight = Math.max(contentHeight, thumbHeight());

        int width = contentWidth + getPaddingLeft() + getPaddingRight();
        int height = contentHeight + getPaddingTop() + getPaddingBottom();

        setMeasuredDimension(resolveSizeAndState(width, widthMeasureSpec, 0), resolveSizeAndState(height, heightMeasureSpec, 0));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (!mIsUserSeekable || !isEnabled() || isIndeterminate()) return false;

        int action = event.getActionMasked();

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN)
        {
            startDrag(event);
            return true;
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE)
        {
            if (mDragging) trackTouchEvent(event);
            else startDrag(event);

            return true;
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP)
        {
            if (mDragging)
            {
                trackTouchEvent(event);
                onStopTrackingTouch();
                setPressed(false);
            }
            else
            {
                onStartTrackingTouch();
                trackTouchEvent(event);
                onStopTrackingTouch();
            }

            invalidate();
            return true;
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL)
        {
            if (mDragging)
            {
                onStopTrackingTouch();
                setPressed(false);
            }

            invalidate();
            return true;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private void startDrag(MotionEvent event)
    {
        setPressed(true);
        onStartTrackingTouch();
        trackTouchEvent(event);

        ViewParent parent = getParent();
        if (parent != null) parent.requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);
    }

    private void trackTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        int x = Math.round(event.getX());
        int width = getWidth();
        int available = width - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight();

        float scale;
        float progress = 0f;

        if (getLayoutDirection() == LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL)
        {
            if (x > width - getPaddingRight()) scale = 0f;
            else if (x < getPaddingLeft()) scale = 1f;
            else scale = (available - x + getPaddingLeft()) / (float)Math.max(1, available);
        }
        else
        {
            if (x < getPaddingLeft()) scale = 0f;
            else if (x > width - getPaddingRight()) scale = 1f;
            else scale = (x - getPaddingLeft()) / (float)Math.max(1, available);

            progress = mTouchProgressOffset;
        }

        int range = getMax() - getMin();
        progress += scale * range + getMin();

        drawableHotspotChanged(x, event.getY());
        setProgressInternal(Math.round(progress), true, false);
    }

    void onStartTrackingTouch()
    {
        mDragging = true;
    }

    void onStopTrackingTouch()
    {
        mDragging = false;
    }

    void onKeyChange()
    {
    }

    boolean isDragging()
    {
        return mDragging;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onKeyDown(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        if (isEnabled() && mIsUserSeekable && !isIndeterminate())
        {
            int increment = mKeyProgressIncrement;
            boolean handled = true;

            if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_LEFT || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MINUS || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_SUBTRACT)
            {
                increment = -increment;
            }
            else if (keyCode != KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_RIGHT && keyCode != KeyEvent.KEYCODE_PLUS && keyCode != KeyEvent.KEYCODE_EQUALS
                     && keyCode != KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_ADD)
            {
                handled = false;
            }

            if (handled)
            {
                if (getLayoutDirection() == LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL) increment = -increment;

                if (setProgressInternal(getProgress() + increment, true, true)) onKeyChange();
                return true;
            }
        }

        return super.onKeyDown(keyCode, event);
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return AbsSeekBar.class.getName();
    }

    @Override
    public void onRtlPropertiesChanged(int layoutDirection)
    {
        super.onRtlPropertiesChanged(layoutDirection);
        invalidate();
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/AbsSpinner.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.database.DataSetObserver;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.util.SparseArray;
import android.view.AbsSavedState;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.autofill.AutofillValue;

public abstract class AbsSpinner extends AdapterView<SpinnerAdapter>
{
    private static final int AUTOFILL_TYPE_LIST = 3;

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    SpinnerAdapter mAdapter;
    int mHeightMeasureSpec;
    int mWidthMeasureSpec;
    final Rect mSpinnerPadding = new Rect();
    final SparseArray<View> mRecycledViews = new SparseArray<View>();
    private DataSetObserver mDataSetObserver;

    public AbsSpinner(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public AbsSpinner(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, 0);
    }

    public AbsSpinner(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public AbsSpinner(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        setFocusable(true);
        setWillNotDraw(false);

        if (attributes != null) readAttributes(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
    }

    private void readAttributes(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        if (sStyleable == null) sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "entries");
        if (sStyleable.isEmpty()) return;

        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        int entriesIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("entries");
        CharSequence[] entries = entriesIndex >= 0 && array.hasValue(entriesIndex) ? array.getTextArray(entriesIndex) : null;
        array.recycle();

        if (entries == null) return;

        android.content.res.Resources resources = context.getResources();
        int itemLayout = resources.getIdentifier("simple_spinner_item", "layout", "android");
        int dropDownLayout = resources.getIdentifier("simple_spinner_dropdown_item", "layout", "android");

        ArrayAdapter<CharSequence> adapter = new ArrayAdapter<CharSequence>(context, itemLayout, entries);
        adapter.setDropDownViewResource(dropDownLayout);
        setAdapter(adapter);
    }

    @Override
    public void setAdapter(SpinnerAdapter adapter)
    {
        if (mAdapter != null && mDataSetObserver != null)
        {
            mAdapter.unregisterDataSetObserver(mDataSetObserver);
            resetList();
        }

        mAdapter = adapter;

        mOldSelectedPosition = INVALID_POSITION;
        mOldSelectedRowId = INVALID_ROW_ID;

        if (mAdapter != null)
        {
            mOldItemCount = mItemCount;
            mItemCount = mAdapter.getCount();
            checkFocus();

            mDataSetObserver = new AdapterDataSetObserver();
            mAdapter.registerDataSetObserver(mDataSetObserver);

            int position = mItemCount > 0 ? 0 : INVALID_POSITION;
            setSelectedPositionInt(position);
            setNextSelectedPositionInt(position);

            if (mItemCount == 0) checkSelectionChanged();
        }
        else
        {
            checkFocus();
            resetList();
            checkSelectionChanged();
        }

        requestLayout();
    }

    void resetList()
    {
        mDataChanged = false;

        removeAllViewsInLayout();
        mOldSelectedPosition = INVALID_POSITION;
        mOldSelectedRowId = INVALID_ROW_ID;

        setSelectedPositionInt(INVALID_POSITION);
        setNextSelectedPositionInt(INVALID_POSITION);
        invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        int widthMode = MeasureSpec.getMode(widthMeasureSpec);

        mSpinnerPadding.set(getPaddingLeft(), getPaddingTop(), getPaddingRight(), getPaddingBottom());

        if (mDataChanged) handleDataChanged();

        int preferredHeight = 0;
        int preferredWidth = 0;
        boolean needsMeasuring = true;

        int selectedPosition = getSelectedItemPosition();
        if (selectedPosition >= 0 && mAdapter != null && selectedPosition < mAdapter.getCount())
        {
            View view = currentSelectedChild(selectedPosition);
            if (view == null) view = mRecycledViews.get(selectedPosition);

            if (view == null)
            {
                view = mAdapter.getView(selectedPosition, null, this);
                if (view != null) mRecycledViews.put(selectedPosition, view);
            }

            if (view != null)
            {
                if (view.getLayoutParams() == null)
                {
                    mBlockLayoutRequests = true;
                    view.setLayoutParams(generateDefaultLayoutParams());
                    mBlockLayoutRequests = false;
                }

                measureChild(view, widthMeasureSpec, heightMeasureSpec);

                preferredHeight = view.getMeasuredHeight() + mSpinnerPadding.top + mSpinnerPadding.bottom;
                preferredWidth = view.getMeasuredWidth() + mSpinnerPadding.left + mSpinnerPadding.right;
                needsMeasuring = false;
            }
        }

        if (needsMeasuring)
        {
            preferredHeight = mSpinnerPadding.top + mSpinnerPadding.bottom;
            if (widthMode == MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED) preferredWidth = mSpinnerPadding.left + mSpinnerPadding.right;
        }

        preferredHeight = Math.max(preferredHeight, getSuggestedMinimumHeight());
        preferredWidth = Math.max(preferredWidth, getSuggestedMinimumWidth());

        int heightSize = resolveSizeAndState(preferredHeight, heightMeasureSpec, 0);
        int widthSize = resolveSizeAndState(preferredWidth, widthMeasureSpec, 0);

        setMeasuredDimension(widthSize, heightSize);
        mHeightMeasureSpec = heightMeasureSpec;
        mWidthMeasureSpec = widthMeasureSpec;
    }

    private View currentSelectedChild(int position)
    {
        if (mDataChanged || getChildCount() == 0 || mFirstPosition != position) return null;
        return getChildAt(0);
    }

    void handleDataChanged()
    {
        if (mAdapter != null) mItemCount = mAdapter.getCount();

        if (mItemCount <= 0)
        {
            setSelectedPositionInt(INVALID_POSITION);
            setNextSelectedPositionInt(INVALID_POSITION);
            return;
        }

        int selected = mNextSelectedPosition;
        if (selected < 0) selected = 0;
        if (selected >= mItemCount) selected = mItemCount - 1;

        setNextSelectedPositionInt(selected);
        setSelectedPositionInt(selected);
    }

    int getChildHeight(View child)
    {
        return child.getMeasuredHeight();
    }

    int getChildWidth(View child)
    {
        return child.getMeasuredWidth();
    }

    @Override
    protected ViewGroup.LayoutParams generateDefaultLayoutParams()
    {
        return new ViewGroup.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
    }

    void recycleAllViews()
    {
        int childCount = getChildCount();
        int position = mFirstPosition;

        for (int index = 0; index < childCount; index++)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            mRecycledViews.put(position + index, child);
        }
    }

    public void setSelection(int position, boolean animate)
    {
        boolean shouldAnimate = animate && mFirstPosition <= position && position <= mFirstPosition + getChildCount() - 1;
        setSelectionInt(position, shouldAnimate);
    }

    @Override
    public void setSelection(int position)
    {
        setNextSelectedPositionInt(position);
        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    void setSelectionInt(int position, boolean animate)
    {
        if (position == mOldSelectedPosition) return;

        mBlockLayoutRequests = true;
        int delta = position - mSelectedPosition;
        setNextSelectedPositionInt(position);
        layout(delta, animate);
        mBlockLayoutRequests = false;
    }

    abstract void layout(int delta, boolean animate);

    @Override
    public View getSelectedView()
    {
        if (mItemCount > 0 && mSelectedPosition >= 0) return getChildAt(mSelectedPosition - mFirstPosition);
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public void requestLayout()
    {
        if (!mBlockLayoutRequests) super.requestLayout();
    }

    @Override
    public SpinnerAdapter getAdapter()
    {
        return mAdapter;
    }

    @Override
    public int getCount()
    {
        return mItemCount;
    }

    public int pointToPosition(int x, int y)
    {
        Rect frame = new Rect();

        for (int index = getChildCount() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            if (child.getVisibility() != VISIBLE) continue;

            child.getHitRect(frame);
            if (frame.contains(x, y)) return index + mFirstPosition;
        }

        return INVALID_POSITION;
    }

    @Override
    protected void dispatchRestoreInstanceState(SparseArray<Parcelable> container)
    {
        super.dispatchRestoreInstanceState(container);
        handleDataChanged();
    }

    @Override
    public Parcelable onSaveInstanceState()
    {
        SavedState state = new SavedState(super.onSaveInstanceState());
        state.selectedId = getSelectedItemId();
        state.position = state.selectedId >= 0 ? getSelectedItemPosition() : INVALID_POSITION;
        return state;
    }

    @Override
    public void onRestoreInstanceState(Parcelable parcelable)
    {
        if (!(parcelable instanceof SavedState))
        {
            super.onRestoreInstanceState(parcelable);
            return;
        }

        SavedState state = (SavedState)parcelable;
        super.onRestoreInstanceState(state.getSuperState());
        if (state.selectedId < 0 || state.position < 0) return;

        mDataChanged = true;
        setNextSelectedPositionInt(state.position);
        requestLayout();
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return AbsSpinner.class.getName();
    }

    @Override
    public void autofill(AutofillValue value)
    {
        if (!isEnabled() || value == null) return;

        if (!value.isList())
        {
            android.util.Log.w("AbsSpinner", value + " could not be autofilled into " + this);
            return;
        }

        setSelection(value.getListValue());
    }

    @Override
    public int getAutofillType()
    {
        return isEnabled() ? AUTOFILL_TYPE_LIST : 0;
    }

    @Override
    public AutofillValue getAutofillValue()
    {
        return isEnabled() ? AutofillValue.forList(getSelectedItemPosition()) : null;
    }

    static class SavedState extends AbsSavedState
    {
        long selectedId;
        int position;

        SavedState(Parcelable superState)
        {
            super(superState == null ? AbsSavedState.EMPTY_STATE : superState);
        }

        private SavedState(Parcel source)
        {
            super(source);
            selectedId = source.readLong();
            position = source.readInt();
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
        {
            super.writeToParcel(out, flags);
            out.writeLong(selectedId);
            out.writeInt(position);
        }

        public static final Parcelable.Creator<SavedState> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<SavedState>()
        {
            @Override
            public SavedState createFromParcel(Parcel in)
            {
                return new SavedState(in);
            }

            @Override
            public SavedState[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new SavedState[size];
            }
        };
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/AbsoluteLayout.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

@Deprecated
public class AbsoluteLayout extends ViewGroup
{
    public AbsoluteLayout(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public AbsoluteLayout(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, 0);
    }

    public AbsoluteLayout(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public AbsoluteLayout(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        int count = getChildCount();

        int maxHeight = 0;
        int maxWidth = 0;

        measureChildren(widthMeasureSpec, heightMeasureSpec);

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            if (child.getVisibility() == GONE) continue;

            LayoutParams params = paramsFor(child);

            maxWidth = Math.max(maxWidth, params.x + child.getMeasuredWidth());
            maxHeight = Math.max(maxHeight, params.y + child.getMeasuredHeight());
        }

        maxWidth += getPaddingLeft() + getPaddingRight();
        maxHeight += getPaddingTop() + getPaddingBottom();

        maxHeight = Math.max(maxHeight, getSuggestedMinimumHeight());
        maxWidth = Math.max(maxWidth, getSuggestedMinimumWidth());

        setMeasuredDimension(resolveSizeAndState(maxWidth, widthMeasureSpec, 0), resolveSizeAndState(maxHeight, heightMeasureSpec, 0));
    }

    private LayoutParams paramsFor(View child)
    {
        ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = child.getLayoutParams();
        if (params instanceof LayoutParams) return (LayoutParams)params;

        LayoutParams converted = (LayoutParams)generateLayoutParams(params == null ? generateDefaultLayoutParams() : params);
        child.setLayoutParams(converted);
        return converted;
    }

    @Override
    protected ViewGroup.LayoutParams generateDefaultLayoutParams()
    {
        return new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 0, 0);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onLayout(boolean changed, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        int count = getChildCount();

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            if (child.getVisibility() == GONE) continue;

            LayoutParams params = paramsFor(child);

            int childLeft = getPaddingLeft() + params.x;
            int childTop = getPaddingTop() + params.y;
            child.layout(childLeft, childTop, childLeft + child.getMeasuredWidth(), childTop + child.getMeasuredHeight());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public ViewGroup.LayoutParams generateLayoutParams(AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        return new LayoutParams(getContext(), attributes);
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean checkLayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams layoutParams)
    {
        return layoutParams instanceof LayoutParams;
    }

    @Override
    protected ViewGroup.LayoutParams generateLayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams source)
    {
        return new LayoutParams(source);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean shouldDelayChildPressedState()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public static class LayoutParams extends ViewGroup.LayoutParams
    {
        private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

        public int x;
        public int y;

        public LayoutParams(int width, int height, int x, int y)
        {
            super(width, height);
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }

        public LayoutParams(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
        {
            super(context, attributes);

            if (attributes == null) return;

            if (sStyleable == null) sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "layout_x", "layout_y");
            if (sStyleable.isEmpty()) return;

            android.content.res.TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), 0, 0);

            int xIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("layout_x");
            int yIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("layout_y");

            if (xIndex >= 0) x = array.getDimensionPixelOffset(xIndex, 0);
            if (yIndex >= 0) y = array.getDimensionPixelOffset(yIndex, 0);

            array.recycle();
        }

        public LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams source)
        {
            super(source);
        }

        public String debug(String output)
        {
            return output + "Absolute.LayoutParams={width=" + LinearLayout.LayoutParams.sizeToString(width) + ", height="
                + LinearLayout.LayoutParams.sizeToString(height) + " x=" + x + " y=" + y + "}";
        }
    }
}
```
