```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.database.DataSetObserver;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.util.SparseArray;
import android.view.ContextMenu;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.ViewStructure;

public abstract class AdapterView<T extends Adapter> extends ViewGroup
{
    public static final int ITEM_VIEW_TYPE_IGNORE = -1;
    public static final int ITEM_VIEW_TYPE_HEADER_OR_FOOTER = -2;
    public static final int INVALID_POSITION = -1;
    public static final long INVALID_ROW_ID = Long.MIN_VALUE;

    private static final int SOUND_EFFECT_CLICK = 0;

    int mFirstPosition;
    int mItemCount;
    int mOldItemCount;
    int mSelectedPosition = INVALID_POSITION;
    long mSelectedRowId = INVALID_ROW_ID;
    int mNextSelectedPosition = INVALID_POSITION;
    long mNextSelectedRowId = INVALID_ROW_ID;
    int mOldSelectedPosition = INVALID_POSITION;
    long mOldSelectedRowId = INVALID_ROW_ID;
    boolean mDataChanged;
    boolean mInLayout;
    boolean mBlockLayoutRequests;
    int mLayoutHeight;

    OnItemClickListener mOnItemClickListener;
    OnItemLongClickListener mOnItemLongClickListener;
    OnItemSelectedListener mOnItemSelectedListener;

    private View mEmptyView;
    private boolean mDesiredFocusableState = true;
    private boolean mDesiredFocusableInTouchModeState;
    private Runnable mSelectionNotifier;

    public AdapterView(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public AdapterView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, 0);
    }

    public AdapterView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public AdapterView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
    }

    public void setOnItemClickListener(OnItemClickListener listener)
    {
        mOnItemClickListener = listener;
    }

    public final OnItemClickListener getOnItemClickListener()
    {
        return mOnItemClickListener;
    }

    public boolean performItemClick(View view, int position, long id)
    {
        if (mOnItemClickListener == null) return false;

        playSoundEffect(SOUND_EFFECT_CLICK);
        mOnItemClickListener.onItemClick(this, view, position, id);
        return true;
    }

    public void setOnItemLongClickListener(OnItemLongClickListener listener)
    {
        if (!isLongClickable()) setLongClickable(true);
        mOnItemLongClickListener = listener;
    }

    public final OnItemLongClickListener getOnItemLongClickListener()
    {
        return mOnItemLongClickListener;
    }

    public void setOnItemSelectedListener(OnItemSelectedListener listener)
    {
        mOnItemSelectedListener = listener;
    }

    public final OnItemSelectedListener getOnItemSelectedListener()
    {
        return mOnItemSelectedListener;
    }

    public abstract T getAdapter();

    public abstract void setAdapter(T adapter);

    @Override
    public void addView(View child)
    {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("addView(View) is not supported in AdapterView");
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child, int index)
    {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("addView(View, int) is not supported in AdapterView");
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child, ViewGroup.LayoutParams params)
    {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("addView(View, LayoutParams) is not supported in AdapterView");
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child, int index, ViewGroup.LayoutParams params)
    {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("addView(View, int, LayoutParams) is not supported in AdapterView");
    }

    @Override
    public void removeView(View child)
    {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("removeView(View) is not supported in AdapterView");
    }

    @Override
    public void removeViewAt(int index)
    {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("removeViewAt(int) is not supported in AdapterView");
    }

    @Override
    public void removeAllViews()
    {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("removeAllViews() is not supported in AdapterView");
    }

    @Override
    protected void onLayout(boolean changed, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        mLayoutHeight = getHeight();
    }

    public int getSelectedItemPosition()
    {
        return mNextSelectedPosition;
    }

    public long getSelectedItemId()
    {
        return mNextSelectedRowId;
    }

    public abstract View getSelectedView();

    public Object getSelectedItem()
    {
        T adapter = getAdapter();
        int selection = getSelectedItemPosition();

        if (adapter != null && adapter.getCount() > 0 && selection >= 0) return adapter.getItem(selection);
        return null;
    }

    public int getCount()
    {
        return mItemCount;
    }

    public int getPositionForView(View view)
    {
        View listItem = view;

        try
        {
            View parent;
            while ((parent = (View)listItem.getParent()) != null && parent != this) listItem = parent;
            if (parent == null) return INVALID_POSITION;
        }
        catch (ClassCastException notAView)
        {
            return INVALID_POSITION;
        }

        int index = indexOfChild(listItem);
        return index < 0 ? INVALID_POSITION : mFirstPosition + index;
    }

    public int getFirstVisiblePosition()
    {
        return mFirstPosition;
    }

    public int getLastVisiblePosition()
    {
        return mFirstPosition + getChildCount() - 1;
    }

    public abstract void setSelection(int position);

    public void setEmptyView(View emptyView)
    {
        mEmptyView = emptyView;

        T adapter = getAdapter();
        updateEmptyStatus(adapter == null || adapter.isEmpty());
    }

    public View getEmptyView()
    {
        return mEmptyView;
    }

    boolean isInFilterModeInternal()
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public void setFocusable(int focusable)
    {
        T adapter = getAdapter();
        boolean empty = adapter == null || adapter.getCount() == 0;

        mDesiredFocusableState = focusable != 0;
        super.setFocusable(focusable != 0 && (!empty || isInFilterModeInternal()));
    }

    @Override
    public void setFocusable(boolean focusable)
    {
        setFocusable(focusable ? 1 : 0);
    }

    @Override
    public void setFocusableInTouchMode(boolean focusable)
    {
        T adapter = getAdapter();
        boolean empty = adapter == null || adapter.getCount() == 0;

        mDesiredFocusableInTouchModeState = focusable;
        super.setFocusableInTouchMode(focusable && (!empty || isInFilterModeInternal()));
    }

    void checkFocus()
    {
        T adapter = getAdapter();
        boolean empty = adapter == null || adapter.getCount() == 0;
        boolean focusable = !empty || isInFilterModeInternal();

        super.setFocusableInTouchMode(focusable && mDesiredFocusableInTouchModeState);
        super.setFocusable(focusable && mDesiredFocusableState);

        if (mEmptyView != null) updateEmptyStatus(adapter == null || adapter.isEmpty());
    }

    void updateEmptyStatus(boolean empty)
    {
        if (isInFilterModeInternal()) empty = false;

        if (empty)
        {
            if (mEmptyView != null)
            {
                mEmptyView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                setVisibility(View.GONE);
            }
            else
            {
                setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            }

            if (mDataChanged) onLayout(false, getLeft(), getTop(), getRight(), getBottom());
            return;
        }

        if (mEmptyView != null) mEmptyView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
    }

    public Object getItemAtPosition(int position)
    {
        T adapter = getAdapter();
        return adapter == null || position < 0 ? null : adapter.getItem(position);
    }

    public long getItemIdAtPosition(int position)
    {
        T adapter = getAdapter();
        return adapter == null || position < 0 ? INVALID_ROW_ID : adapter.getItemId(position);
    }

    @Override
    public void setOnClickListener(View.OnClickListener listener)
    {
        throw new RuntimeException("Don't call setOnClickListener for an AdapterView. You probably want setOnItemClickListener instead");
    }

    @Override
    protected void dispatchSaveInstanceState(SparseArray<Parcelable> container)
    {
        dispatchFreezeSelfOnly(container);
    }

    @Override
    protected void dispatchRestoreInstanceState(SparseArray<Parcelable> container)
    {
        dispatchThawSelfOnly(container);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow()
    {
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
        if (mSelectionNotifier != null) removeCallbacks(mSelectionNotifier);
    }

    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return AdapterView.class.getName();
    }

    protected boolean canAnimate()
    {
        return mItemCount > 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void onProvideAutofillStructure(ViewStructure structure, int flags)
    {
        super.onProvideAutofillStructure(structure, flags);

        T adapter = getAdapter();
        if (adapter == null) return;

        CharSequence[] options = adapter.getAutofillOptions();
        if (options != null) structure.setAutofillOptions(options);
    }

    void selectionChanged()
    {
        if (mOnItemSelectedListener == null) return;

        if (!mInLayout && !mBlockLayoutRequests)
        {
            fireOnSelected();
            return;
        }

        if (mSelectionNotifier == null)
        {
            mSelectionNotifier = new Runnable()
            {
                @Override
                public void run()
                {
                    if (mDataChanged && getAdapter() != null)
                    {
                        post(this);
                        return;
                    }

                    fireOnSelected();
                }
            };
        }
        else
        {
            removeCallbacks(mSelectionNotifier);
        }

        post(mSelectionNotifier);
    }

    private void fireOnSelected()
    {
        if (mOnItemSelectedListener == null) return;

        int selection = getSelectedItemPosition();
        if (selection >= 0)
        {
            View view = getSelectedView();
            T adapter = getAdapter();
            long id = adapter == null ? INVALID_ROW_ID : adapter.getItemId(selection);
            mOnItemSelectedListener.onItemSelected(this, view, selection, id);
            return;
        }

        mOnItemSelectedListener.onNothingSelected(this);
    }

    void checkSelectionChanged()
    {
        if (mSelectedPosition == mOldSelectedPosition && mSelectedRowId == mOldSelectedRowId) return;

        selectionChanged();
        mOldSelectedPosition = mSelectedPosition;
        mOldSelectedRowId = mSelectedRowId;
    }

    void setSelectedPositionInt(int position)
    {
        mSelectedPosition = position;
        mSelectedRowId = getItemIdAtPosition(position);
    }

    void setNextSelectedPositionInt(int position)
    {
        mNextSelectedPosition = position;
        mNextSelectedRowId = getItemIdAtPosition(position);
    }

    class AdapterDataSetObserver extends DataSetObserver
    {
        @Override
        public void onChanged()
        {
            mDataChanged = true;
            mOldItemCount = mItemCount;
            mItemCount = getAdapter() == null ? 0 : getAdapter().getCount();

            checkFocus();
            requestLayout();
        }

        @Override
        public void onInvalidated()
        {
            mDataChanged = true;
            mOldItemCount = mItemCount;
            mItemCount = 0;

            mSelectedPosition = INVALID_POSITION;
            mSelectedRowId = INVALID_ROW_ID;
            mNextSelectedPosition = INVALID_POSITION;
            mNextSelectedRowId = INVALID_ROW_ID;

            checkFocus();
            requestLayout();
        }
    }

    public interface OnItemClickListener
    {
        void onItemClick(AdapterView<?> parent, View view, int position, long id);
    }

    public interface OnItemLongClickListener
    {
        boolean onItemLongClick(AdapterView<?> parent, View view, int position, long id);
    }

    public interface OnItemSelectedListener
    {
        void onItemSelected(AdapterView<?> parent, View view, int position, long id);

        void onNothingSelected(AdapterView<?> parent);
    }

    public static class AdapterContextMenuInfo implements ContextMenu.ContextMenuInfo
    {
        public View targetView;
        public int position;
        public long id;

        public AdapterContextMenuInfo(View targetView, int position, long id)
        {
            this.targetView = targetView;
            this.position = position;
            this.id = id;
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/Advanceable.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

public interface Advanceable
{
    void advance();

    void fyiWillBeAdvancedByHostKThx();
}
```

`java/android/widget/ArrayAdapter.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.view.ContextThemeWrapper;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

public class ArrayAdapter<T> extends BaseAdapter implements Filterable, ThemedSpinnerAdapter
{
    private final Object mLock = new Object();
    private final Context mContext;
    private final LayoutInflater mInflater;
    private LayoutInflater mDropDownInflater;
    private final int mResource;
    private int mDropDownResource;
    private int mFieldId;
    private List<T> mObjects;
    private final boolean mObjectsFromResources;
    private boolean mNotifyOnChange = true;
    private ArrayList<T> mOriginalValues;
    private ArrayFilter mFilter;

    public ArrayAdapter(Context context, int resource)
    {
        this(context, resource, 0, new ArrayList<T>());
    }

    public ArrayAdapter(Context context, int resource, int textViewResourceId)
    {
        this(context, resource, textViewResourceId, new ArrayList<T>());
    }

    public ArrayAdapter(Context context, int resource, T[] objects)
    {
        this(context, resource, 0, Arrays.asList(objects));
    }

    public ArrayAdapter(Context context, int resource, int textViewResourceId, T[] objects)
    {
        this(context, resource, textViewResourceId, Arrays.asList(objects));
    }

    public ArrayAdapter(Context context, int resource, List<T> objects)
    {
        this(context, resource, 0, objects);
    }

    public ArrayAdapter(Context context, int resource, int textViewResourceId, List<T> objects)
    {
        this(context, resource, textViewResourceId, objects, false);
    }

    private ArrayAdapter(Context context, int resource, int textViewResourceId, List<T> objects, boolean objectsFromResources)
    {
        mContext = context;
        mInflater = LayoutInflater.from(context);
        mResource = resource;
        mDropDownResource = resource;
        mObjects = objects;
        mObjectsFromResources = objectsFromResources;
        mFieldId = textViewResourceId;
    }

    public void add(T object)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mOriginalValues != null) mOriginalValues.add(object);
            else mObjects.add(object);
        }

        if (mNotifyOnChange) notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    public void addAll(Collection<? extends T> collection)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mOriginalValues != null) mOriginalValues.addAll(collection);
            else mObjects.addAll(collection);
        }

        if (mNotifyOnChange) notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public void addAll(T... items)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mOriginalValues != null) Collections.addAll(mOriginalValues, items);
            else Collections.addAll(mObjects, items);
        }

        if (mNotifyOnChange) notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    public void insert(T object, int index)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mOriginalValues != null) mOriginalValues.add(index, object);
            else mObjects.add(index, object);
        }

        if (mNotifyOnChange) notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    public void remove(T object)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mOriginalValues != null) mOriginalValues.remove(object);
            else mObjects.remove(object);
        }

        if (mNotifyOnChange) notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    public void clear()
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mOriginalValues != null) mOriginalValues.clear();
            else mObjects.clear();
        }

        if (mNotifyOnChange) notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    public void sort(Comparator<? super T> comparator)
    {
        synchronized (mLock)
        {
            if (mOriginalValues != null) Collections.sort(mOriginalValues, comparator);
            else Collections.sort(mObjects, comparator);
        }

        if (mNotifyOnChange) notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    @Override
    public void notifyDataSetChanged()
    {
        super.notifyDataSetChanged();
        mNotifyOnChange = true;
    }

    public void setNotifyOnChange(boolean notifyOnChange)
    {
        mNotifyOnChange = notifyOnChange;
    }

    public Context getContext()
    {
        return mContext;
    }

    @Override
    public int getCount()
    {
        return mObjects.size();
    }

    @Override
    public T getItem(int position)
    {
        return mObjects.get(position);
    }

    public int getPosition(T item)
    {
        return mObjects.indexOf(item);
    }

    @Override
    public long getItemId(int position)
    {
        return position;
    }

    @Override
    public View getView(int position, View convertView, ViewGroup parent)
    {
        return createViewFromResource(mInflater, position, convertView, parent, mResource);
    }

    private View createViewFromResource(LayoutInflater inflater, int position, View convertView, ViewGroup parent, int resource)
    {
        View view = convertView != null ? convertView : inflateItem(inflater, resource, parent);

        TextView text;
        try
        {
            if (mFieldId == 0) text = (TextView)view;
            else text = (TextView)view.findViewById(mFieldId);

            if (text == null)
            {
                throw new RuntimeException("Failed to find view with ID " + mContext.getResources().getResourceName(mFieldId)
                                           + " in item layout");
            }
        }
        catch (ClassCastException failure)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("ArrayAdapter requires the resource ID to be a TextView", failure);
        }

        T item = getItem(position);
        if (item instanceof CharSequence) text.setText((CharSequence)item);
        else text.setText(item == null ? "null" : item.toString());

        return view;
    }

    private View inflateItem(LayoutInflater inflater, int resource, ViewGroup parent)
    {
        try
        {
            return inflater.inflate(resource, parent, false);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException failure)
        {
            if (mFieldId != 0) throw failure;

            android.util.Log.w("ArrayAdapter", "item layout 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resource)
                                               + " could not be inflated, so a plain TextView is used", failure);
            return fallbackItemView(inflater.getContext());
        }
    }

    static TextView fallbackItemView(Context context)
    {
        float density = context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        int horizontal = (int)(16 * density);
        int vertical = (int)(12 * density);

        TextView text = new TextView(context);
        text.setPadding(horizontal, vertical, horizontal, vertical);
        text.setMinimumHeight((int)(48 * density));
        text.setTextSize(16);
        return text;
    }

    public void setDropDownViewResource(int resource)
    {
        mDropDownResource = resource;
    }

    @Override
    public void setDropDownViewTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        if (theme == null) mDropDownInflater = null;
        else if (theme == mInflater.getContext().getTheme()) mDropDownInflater = mInflater;
        else mDropDownInflater = LayoutInflater.from(new ContextThemeWrapper(mContext, theme));
    }

    @Override
    public Resources.Theme getDropDownViewTheme()
    {
        return mDropDownInflater == null ? null : mDropDownInflater.getContext().getTheme();
    }

    @Override
    public View getDropDownView(int position, View convertView, ViewGroup parent)
    {
        LayoutInflater inflater = mDropDownInflater == null ? mInflater : mDropDownInflater;
        return createViewFromResource(inflater, position, convertView, parent, mDropDownResource);
    }

    public static ArrayAdapter<CharSequence> createFromResource(Context context, int textArrayResId, int textViewResId)
    {
        CharSequence[] strings = context.getResources().getTextArray(textArrayResId);
        return new ArrayAdapter<CharSequence>(context, textViewResId, 0, Arrays.asList(strings), true);
    }

    @Override
    public Filter getFilter()
    {
        if (mFilter == null) mFilter = new ArrayFilter();
        return mFilter;
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence[] getAutofillOptions()
    {
        CharSequence[] explicit = super.getAutofillOptions();
        if (explicit != null) return explicit;

        if (!mObjectsFromResources || mObjects == null || mObjects.isEmpty()) return null;

        CharSequence[] options = new CharSequence[mObjects.size()];
        mObjects.toArray(options);
        return options;
    }

    private class ArrayFilter extends Filter
    {
        @Override
        protected FilterResults performFiltering(CharSequence prefix)
        {
            FilterResults results = new FilterResults();

            if (mOriginalValues == null)
            {
                synchronized (mLock)
                {
                    mOriginalValues = new ArrayList<>(mObjects);
                }
            }

            if (prefix == null || prefix.length() == 0)
            {
                ArrayList<T> list;
                synchronized (mLock)
                {
                    list = new ArrayList<>(mOriginalValues);
                }

                results.values = list;
                results.count = list.size();
                return results;
            }

            String prefixString = prefix.toString().toLowerCase(Locale.getDefault());

            ArrayList<T> values;
            synchronized (mLock)
            {
                values = new ArrayList<>(mOriginalValues);
            }

            ArrayList<T> matches = new ArrayList<>();
            for (T value : values)
            {
                String valueText = String.valueOf(value).toLowerCase(Locale.getDefault());

                if (valueText.startsWith(prefixString))
                {
                    matches.add(value);
                    continue;
                }

                String[] words = valueText.split(" ");
                for (String word : words)
                {
                    if (!word.startsWith(prefixString)) continue;

                    matches.add(value);
                    break;
                }
            }

            results.values = matches;
            results.count = matches.size();
            return results;
        }

        @Override
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        protected void publishResults(CharSequence constraint, FilterResults results)
        {
            mObjects = results.values == null ? new ArrayList<T>() : (List<T>)results.values;

            if (results.count > 0) notifyDataSetChanged();
            else notifyDataSetInvalidated();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.database.DataSetObserver;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.text.Editable;
import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.text.TextWatcher;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.ContextThemeWrapper;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.inputmethod.CompletionInfo;

public class AutoCompleteTextView extends EditText implements Filter.FilterListener
{
    private static final int DEFAULT_THRESHOLD = 2;
    private static final int DISPLAY_HINT_INVISIBLE = 4;

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private CharSequence mHintText;
    private TextView mHintView;
    private ListAdapter mAdapter;
    private Filter mFilter;
    private int mThreshold = DEFAULT_THRESHOLD;
    private ListPopupWindow mPopup;
    private int mDropDownAnchorId = View.NO_ID;
    private AdapterView.OnItemClickListener mItemClickListener;
    private AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener mItemSelectedListener;
    private boolean mDropDownDismissedOnCompletion = true;
    private int mLastKeyCode = KeyEvent.KEYCODE_UNKNOWN;
    private Validator mValidator;
    private boolean mBlockCompletion;
    private boolean mPopupCanBeUpdated = true;
    private boolean mOpenBefore;
    private DataSetObserver mObserver;
    private OnDismissListener mOnDismissListener;

    public AutoCompleteTextView(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public AutoCompleteTextView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, 0);
    }

    public AutoCompleteTextView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public AutoCompleteTextView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes, null);
    }

    public AutoCompleteTextView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes, Resources.Theme popupTheme)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        Context popupContext = popupTheme != null ? new ContextThemeWrapper(context, popupTheme) : context;

        mPopup = new ListPopupWindow(popupContext, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
        mPopup.setSoftInputMode(android.view.WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE);
        mPopup.setPromptPosition(ListPopupWindow.POSITION_PROMPT_BELOW);
        mPopup.setOnItemClickListener(new AdapterView.OnItemClickListener()
        {
            @Override
            public void onItemClick(AdapterView<?> parent, View view, int position, long id)
            {
                performCompletion(view, position, id);
            }
        });
        mPopup.setOnDismissListener(new PopupWindow.OnDismissListener()
        {
            @Override
            public void onDismiss()
            {
                if (mOnDismissListener != null) mOnDismissListener.onDismiss();
            }
        });

        addTextChangedListener(new CompletionWatcher());

        if (attributes != null) readAttributes(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
    }

    private void readAttributes(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        if (sStyleable == null)
        {
            sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "completionThreshold", "completionHint", "dropDownWidth", "dropDownHeight",
                                         "dropDownAnchor", "dropDownSelector", "popupBackground");
        }
        if (sStyleable.isEmpty()) return;

        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        int index = sStyleable.indexOf("completionThreshold");
        if (index >= 0) mThreshold = array.getInt(index, DEFAULT_THRESHOLD);

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("completionHint");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) setCompletionHint(array.getText(index));

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("dropDownWidth");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) mPopup.setWidth(array.getLayoutDimension(index, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("dropDownHeight");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) mPopup.setHeight(array.getLayoutDimension(index, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("dropDownAnchor");
        if (index >= 0) mDropDownAnchorId = array.getResourceId(index, View.NO_ID);

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("dropDownSelector");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index))
        {
            Drawable selector = safeDrawable(array, index);
            if (selector != null) mPopup.setListSelector(selector);
        }

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("popupBackground");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index))
        {
            Drawable background = safeDrawable(array, index);
            if (background != null) mPopup.setBackgroundDrawable(background);
        }

        array.recycle();
    }

    private static Drawable safeDrawable(TypedArray array, int index)
    {
        try
        {
            return array.getDrawable(index);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException unsupported)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setOnClickListener(View.OnClickListener listener)
    {
        super.setOnClickListener(listener);
    }

    public void setCompletionHint(CharSequence hint)
    {
        mHintText = hint;

        if (hint == null)
        {
            mPopup.setPromptView(null);
            mHintView = null;
            return;
        }

        if (mHintView == null)
        {
            float density = getContext().getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
            int padding = (int)(10 * density);

            mHintView = new TextView(getContext());
            mHintView.setPadding(padding, padding, padding, padding);
            mHintView.setTextSize(14);
        }

        mHintView.setText(hint);
        mPopup.setPromptView(mHintView);
    }

    public CharSequence getCompletionHint()
    {
        return mHintText;
    }

    public int getDropDownWidth()
    {
        return mPopup.getWidth();
    }

    public void setDropDownWidth(int width)
    {
        mPopup.setWidth(width);
    }

    public int getDropDownHeight()
    {
        return mPopup.getHeight();
    }

    public void setDropDownHeight(int height)
    {
        mPopup.setHeight(height);
    }

    public int getDropDownAnchor()
    {
        return mDropDownAnchorId;
    }

    public void setDropDownAnchor(int id)
    {
        mDropDownAnchorId = id;
        mPopup.setAnchorView(null);
    }

    public Drawable getDropDownBackground()
    {
        return mPopup.getBackground();
    }

    public void setDropDownBackgroundDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        mPopup.setBackgroundDrawable(drawable);
    }

    public void setDropDownBackgroundResource(int id)
    {
        mPopup.setBackgroundDrawable(getContext().getDrawable(id));
    }

    public void setDropDownVerticalOffset(int offset)
    {
        mPopup.setVerticalOffset(offset);
    }

    public int getDropDownVerticalOffset()
    {
        return mPopup.getVerticalOffset();
    }

    public void setDropDownHorizontalOffset(int offset)
    {
        mPopup.setHorizontalOffset(offset);
    }

    public int getDropDownHorizontalOffset()
    {
        return mPopup.getHorizontalOffset();
    }

    public int getThreshold()
    {
        return mThreshold;
    }

    public void setThreshold(int threshold)
    {
        mThreshold = threshold <= 0 ? 1 : threshold;
    }

    public void setOnItemClickListener(AdapterView.OnItemClickListener listener)
    {
        mItemClickListener = listener;
    }

    public void setOnItemSelectedListener(AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener listener)
    {
        mItemSelectedListener = listener;
        mPopup.setOnItemSelectedListener(listener);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public AdapterView.OnItemClickListener getItemClickListener()
    {
        return mItemClickListener;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener getItemSelectedListener()
    {
        return mItemSelectedListener;
    }

    public AdapterView.OnItemClickListener getOnItemClickListener()
    {
        return mItemClickListener;
    }

    public AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener getOnItemSelectedListener()
    {
        return mItemSelectedListener;
    }

    public void setOnDismissListener(OnDismissListener dismissListener)
    {
        mOnDismissListener = dismissListener;
    }

    public ListAdapter getAdapter()
    {
        return mAdapter;
    }

    public <T extends ListAdapter & Filterable> void setAdapter(T adapter)
    {
        if (mObserver == null)
        {
            mObserver = new DataSetObserver()
            {
                @Override
                public void onChanged()
                {
                    post(new Runnable()
                    {
                        @Override
                        public void run()
                        {
                            if (mAdapter != null) updateDropDownForFilter(mAdapter.getCount());
                        }
                    });
                }
            };
        }
        else if (mAdapter != null)
        {
            mAdapter.unregisterDataSetObserver(mObserver);
        }

        mAdapter = adapter;

        if (mAdapter != null)
        {
            mFilter = ((Filterable)mAdapter).getFilter();
            adapter.registerDataSetObserver(mObserver);
        }
        else
        {
            mFilter = null;
        }

        mPopup.setAdapter(mAdapter);
    }

    public boolean onKeyPreIme(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        boolean dismissKey = keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE;
        if (dismissKey && isPopupShowing() && !mPopup.isDropDownAlwaysVisible())
        {
            if (event.getAction() == KeyEvent.ACTION_UP && !event.isCanceled()) dismissDropDown();
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onKeyUp(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        boolean consumed = mPopup.onKeyUp(keyCode, event);
        if (consumed)
        {
            switch (keyCode)
            {
                case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER:
                case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_CENTER:
                case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_TAB:
                case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_ENTER:
                    performCompletion();
                    return true;
                default:
                    break;
            }
        }

        if (isPopupShowing() && keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_TAB && event.getModifiers() == 0)
        {
            performCompletion();
            return true;
        }

        if (onKeyPreIme(keyCode, event)) return true;

        return super.onKeyUp(keyCode, event);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onKeyDown(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        if (mPopup.onKeyDown(keyCode, event)) return true;

        if (!isPopupShowing() && keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN && event.getModifiers() == 0)
        {
            performValidation();
        }

        if (isPopupShowing() && keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_TAB && event.getModifiers() == 0) return true;

        if (onKeyPreIme(keyCode, event)) return true;

        mLastKeyCode = keyCode;
        boolean handled = super.onKeyDown(keyCode, event);
        mLastKeyCode = KeyEvent.KEYCODE_UNKNOWN;

        if (handled && isPopupShowing()) clearListSelection();

        return handled;
    }

    public boolean enoughToFilter()
    {
        return getText().length() >= mThreshold;
    }

    private void doAfterTextChanged()
    {
        if (mBlockCompletion) return;
        if (mOpenBefore && !isPopupShowing()) return;

        refreshAutoCompleteResults();
    }

    public final void refreshAutoCompleteResults()
    {
        if (enoughToFilter())
        {
            if (mFilter == null) return;

            mPopupCanBeUpdated = true;
            performFiltering(getText(), mLastKeyCode);
            return;
        }

        if (!mPopup.isDropDownAlwaysVisible()) dismissDropDown();
        if (mFilter != null) mFilter.filter(null);
    }

    public boolean isPopupShowing()
    {
        return mPopup != null && mPopup.isShowing();
    }

    protected CharSequence convertSelectionToString(Object selectedItem)
    {
        if (mFilter == null) return selectedItem == null ? "" : selectedItem.toString();
        return mFilter.convertResultToString(selectedItem);
    }

    public void clearListSelection()
    {
        mPopup.clearListSelection();
    }

    public void setListSelection(int position)
    {
        mPopup.setSelection(position);
    }

    public int getListSelection()
    {
        return mPopup.getSelectedItemPosition();
    }

    protected void performFiltering(CharSequence text, int keyCode)
    {
        mFilter.filter(text, this);
    }

    public void performCompletion()
    {
        performCompletion(null, -1, -1);
    }

    public void onCommitCompletion(CompletionInfo completion)
    {
        if (isPopupShowing() && completion != null) mPopup.performItemClick(completion.getPosition());
    }

    private void performCompletion(View selectedView, int position, long id)
    {
        if (isPopupShowing())
        {
            Object selectedItem;
            if (position < 0) selectedItem = mPopup.getSelectedItem();
            else selectedItem = mAdapter == null ? null : mAdapter.getItem(position);

            if (selectedItem == null)
            {
                android.util.Log.w("AutoCompleteTextView", "performCompletion: no selected item");
                return;
            }

            mBlockCompletion = true;
            replaceText(convertSelectionToString(selectedItem));
            mBlockCompletion = false;

            if (mItemClickListener != null)
            {
                ListPopupWindow list = mPopup;
                if (selectedView == null || position < 0)
                {
                    selectedView = list.getSelectedView();
                    position = list.getSelectedItemPosition();
                    id = list.getSelectedItemId();
                }

                mItemClickListener.onItemClick(list.getListView(), selectedView, position, id);
            }
        }

        if (mDropDownDismissedOnCompletion && !mPopup.isDropDownAlwaysVisible()) dismissDropDown();
    }

    public boolean isPerformingCompletion()
    {
        return mBlockCompletion;
    }

    public void setText(CharSequence text, boolean filter)
    {
        if (filter)
        {
            setText(text);
            return;
        }

        mBlockCompletion = true;
        setText(text);
        mBlockCompletion = false;
    }

    protected void replaceText(CharSequence text)
    {
        clearComposingText();
        setText(text);
        setSelection(getText().length());
    }

    @Override
    public void onFilterComplete(int count)
    {
        updateDropDownForFilter(count);
    }

    private void updateDropDownForFilter(int count)
    {
        if (getWindowVisibility() == View.GONE) return;

        boolean dropDownAlwaysVisible = mPopup.isDropDownAlwaysVisible();
        boolean enoughToFilter = enoughToFilter();

        if ((count > 0 || dropDownAlwaysVisible) && enoughToFilter)
        {
            if (hasFocus() && hasWindowFocus() && mPopupCanBeUpdated) showDropDown();
            return;
        }

        if (!dropDownAlwaysVisible && isPopupShowing())
        {
            dismissDropDown();
            mPopupCanBeUpdated = true;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onWindowFocusChanged(boolean hasWindowFocus)
    {
        super.onWindowFocusChanged(hasWindowFocus);
        if (!hasWindowFocus && !mPopup.isDropDownAlwaysVisible()) dismissDropDown();
    }

    protected void onDisplayHint(int hint)
    {
        if (hint == DISPLAY_HINT_INVISIBLE && !mPopup.isDropDownAlwaysVisible()) dismissDropDown();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onFocusChanged(boolean focused, int direction, Rect previouslyFocusedRect)
    {
        super.onFocusChanged(focused, direction, previouslyFocusedRect);

        if (focused) return;

        performValidation();
        if (!mPopup.isDropDownAlwaysVisible()) dismissDropDown();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onAttachedToWindow()
    {
        super.onAttachedToWindow();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow()
    {
        dismissDropDown();
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
    }

    public void dismissDropDown()
    {
        if (mPopup == null) return;

        mPopup.dismiss();
        mPopupCanBeUpdated = false;
    }

    protected boolean setFrame(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        boolean changed = super.setFrame(left, top, right, bottom);
        if (changed && isPopupShowing()) showDropDown();
        return changed;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onSizeChanged(int width, int height, int oldWidth, int oldHeight)
    {
        super.onSizeChanged(width, height, oldWidth, oldHeight);
        if (isPopupShowing()) showDropDown();
    }

    public int getInputMethodMode()
    {
        return mPopup.getInputMethodMode();
    }

    public void setInputMethodMode(int mode)
    {
        mPopup.setInputMethodMode(mode);
    }

    public void showDropDown()
    {
        if (mPopup.getAnchorView() == null)
        {
            View anchor = null;
            if (mDropDownAnchorId != View.NO_ID) anchor = getRootView().findViewById(mDropDownAnchorId);
            mPopup.setAnchorView(anchor != null ? anchor : this);
        }

        if (!isPopupShowing()) mPopup.setInputMethodMode(ListPopupWindow.INPUT_METHOD_NEEDED);

        mPopup.show();
    }

    public void setValidator(Validator validator)
    {
        mValidator = validator;
    }

    public Validator getValidator()
    {
        return mValidator;
    }

    public void performValidation()
    {
        if (mValidator == null) return;

        CharSequence text = getText();
        if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(text) && !mValidator.isValid(text)) setText(mValidator.fixText(text));
    }

    protected Filter getFilter()
    {
        return mFilter;
    }

    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return AutoCompleteTextView.class.getName();
    }

    private final class CompletionWatcher implements TextWatcher
    {
        @Override
        public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence text, int start, int count, int after)
        {
            if (mBlockCompletion) return;

            mOpenBefore = isPopupShowing();
        }

        @Override
        public void onTextChanged(CharSequence text, int start, int before, int count)
        {
        }

        @Override
        public void afterTextChanged(Editable text)
        {
            doAfterTextChanged();
        }
    }

    public interface Validator
    {
        boolean isValid(CharSequence text);

        CharSequence fixText(CharSequence invalidText);
    }

    public interface OnDismissListener
    {
        void onDismiss();
    }
}
```

```java
    }

    public Button(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public Button(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
    }

    private static int attribute(Context context, String name)
    {
        if (context == null) return 0;

        return context.getResources().getIdentifier(name, "attr", "android");
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return Button.class.getName();
    }

    @Override
    public PointerIcon onResolvePointerIcon(MotionEvent event, int pointerIndex)
    {
        if (getPointerIcon() == null && isClickable() && isEnabled()) return PointerIcon.getSystemIcon(getContext(), PointerIcon.TYPE_HAND);

        return super.onResolvePointerIcon(event, pointerIndex);
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/CalendarView.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Configuration;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;
import java.text.DateFormatSymbols;
import java.text.ParseException;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.Locale;

public class CalendarView extends FrameLayout
{
    private static final String DEFAULT_MIN_DATE = "01/01/1900";
    private static final String DEFAULT_MAX_DATE = "01/01/2100";

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private final Calendar mDate = Calendar.getInstance();
    private final Calendar mMinDate = Calendar.getInstance();
    private final Calendar mMaxDate = Calendar.getInstance();
    private final Calendar mShownMonth = Calendar.getInstance();
    private final MonthView mMonthView;
    private OnDateChangeListener mOnDateChangeListener;
    private int mFirstDayOfWeek;
    private boolean mShowWeekNumber;
    private int mShownWeekCount = 6;
    private int mSelectedWeekBackgroundColor;
    private int mFocusedMonthDateColor;
    private int mUnfocusedMonthDateColor;
    private int mWeekSeparatorLineColor;
    private int mWeekNumberColor;
    private int mDateTextAppearance;
    private int mWeekDayTextAppearance;
    private Drawable mSelectedDateVerticalBar;

    public CalendarView(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public CalendarView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, ProgressBar.attributeIdentifier(context, "calendarViewStyle"));
    }

    public CalendarView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public CalendarView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        mFirstDayOfWeek = mDate.getFirstDayOfWeek();
        mSelectedWeekBackgroundColor = ProgressBar.resolveThemeColor(context, 0xFF009688, "colorControlActivated", "colorAccent");
        mFocusedMonthDateColor = ProgressBar.resolveThemeColor(context, 0xDE000000, "textColorPrimary");
        mUnfocusedMonthDateColor = ProgressBar.resolveThemeColor(context, 0x8A000000, "textColorSecondary");
        mWeekSeparatorLineColor = 0x1F000000;
        mWeekNumberColor = mUnfocusedMonthDateColor;

        parseDate(DEFAULT_MIN_DATE, mMinDate);
        parseDate(DEFAULT_MAX_DATE, mMaxDate);

        if (attributes != null || defStyleAttr != 0 || defStyleRes != 0) readAttributes(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        clamp(mDate);
        mShownMonth.setTimeInMillis(mDate.getTimeInMillis());

        mMonthView = new MonthView(context);
        addView(mMonthView, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
    }

    private void readAttributes(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        if (sStyleable == null)
        {
            sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "firstDayOfWeek", "minDate", "maxDate", "showWeekNumber", "shownWeekCount",
                                         "selectedWeekBackgroundColor", "focusedMonthDateColor", "unfocusedMonthDateColor",
                                         "weekNumberColor", "weekSeparatorLineColor", "selectedDateVerticalBar", "weekDayTextAppearance",
                                         "dateTextAppearance");
        }
        if (sStyleable.isEmpty()) return;

        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        int index = sStyleable.indexOf("firstDayOfWeek");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) mFirstDayOfWeek = array.getInt(index, mFirstDayOfWeek);

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("minDate");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) parseDate(array.getString(index), mMinDate);

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("maxDate");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) parseDate(array.getString(index), mMaxDate);

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("showWeekNumber");
        if (index >= 0) mShowWeekNumber = array.getBoolean(index, mShowWeekNumber);

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("shownWeekCount");
        if (index >= 0) mShownWeekCount = array.getInt(index, mShownWeekCount);

        mSelectedWeekBackgroundColor = readColor(array, "selectedWeekBackgroundColor", mSelectedWeekBackgroundColor);
        mFocusedMonthDateColor = readColor(array, "focusedMonthDateColor", mFocusedMonthDateColor);
        mUnfocusedMonthDateColor = readColor(array, "unfocusedMonthDateColor", mUnfocusedMonthDateColor);
        mWeekNumberColor = readColor(array, "weekNumberColor", mWeekNumberColor);
        mWeekSeparatorLineColor = readColor(array, "weekSeparatorLineColor", mWeekSeparatorLineColor);

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("weekDayTextAppearance");
        if (index >= 0) mWeekDayTextAppearance = array.getResourceId(index, 0);

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("dateTextAppearance");
        if (index >= 0) mDateTextAppearance = array.getResourceId(index, 0);

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("selectedDateVerticalBar");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index))
        {
            try
            {
                mSelectedDateVerticalBar = array.getDrawable(index);
            }
            catch (RuntimeException unsupported)
            {
                mSelectedDateVerticalBar = null;
            }
        }

        array.recycle();
    }

    private static int readColor(TypedArray array, String name, int fallback)
    {
        int index = sStyleable.indexOf(name);
        if (index < 0 || !array.hasValue(index)) return fallback;

        return array.getColor(index, fallback);
    }

    static boolean parseDate(String date, Calendar outDate)
    {
        if (date == null || date.isEmpty()) return false;

        try
        {
            outDate.setTime(new SimpleDateFormat("MM/dd/yyyy", Locale.US).parse(date));
            return true;
        }
        catch (ParseException malformed)
        {
            android.util.Log.w("CalendarView", "Date: " + date + " not in format: MM/dd/yyyy");
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void clamp(Calendar date)
    {
        if (date.before(mMinDate)) date.setTimeInMillis(mMinDate.getTimeInMillis());
        else if (date.after(mMaxDate)) date.setTimeInMillis(mMaxDate.getTimeInMillis());
    }

    public void setShownWeekCount(int count)
    {
        mShownWeekCount = count;
    }

    public int getShownWeekCount()
    {
        return mShownWeekCount;
    }

    public void setSelectedWeekBackgroundColor(int color)
    {
        mSelectedWeekBackgroundColor = color;
        mMonthView.invalidate();
    }

    public int getSelectedWeekBackgroundColor()
    {
        return mSelectedWeekBackgroundColor;
    }

    public void setFocusedMonthDateColor(int color)
    {
        mFocusedMonthDateColor = color;
        mMonthView.invalidate();
    }

    public int getFocusedMonthDateColor()
    {
        return mFocusedMonthDateColor;
    }

    public void setUnfocusedMonthDateColor(int color)
    {
        mUnfocusedMonthDateColor = color;
        mMonthView.invalidate();
    }

    public int getUnfocusedMonthDateColor()
    {
        return mUnfocusedMonthDateColor;
    }

    public void setWeekNumberColor(int color)
    {
        mWeekNumberColor = color;
        mMonthView.invalidate();
    }

    public int getWeekNumberColor()
    {
        return mWeekNumberColor;
    }

    public void setWeekSeparatorLineColor(int color)
    {
        mWeekSeparatorLineColor = color;
        mMonthView.invalidate();
    }

    public int getWeekSeparatorLineColor()
    {
        return mWeekSeparatorLineColor;
    }

    public void setSelectedDateVerticalBar(int resourceId)
    {
        setSelectedDateVerticalBar(resourceId == 0 ? null : getContext().getDrawable(resourceId));
    }

    public void setSelectedDateVerticalBar(Drawable drawable)
    {
        mSelectedDateVerticalBar = drawable;
        mMonthView.invalidate();
    }

    public Drawable getSelectedDateVerticalBar()
    {
        return mSelectedDateVerticalBar;
    }

    public void setWeekDayTextAppearance(int resourceId)
    {
        mWeekDayTextAppearance = resourceId;
    }

    public int getWeekDayTextAppearance()
    {
        return mWeekDayTextAppearance;
    }

    public void setDateTextAppearance(int resourceId)
    {
        mDateTextAppearance = resourceId;
    }

    public int getDateTextAppearance()
    {
        return mDateTextAppearance;
    }

    public void setMinDate(long minDate)
    {
        mMinDate.setTimeInMillis(minDate);
        if (mMaxDate.before(mMinDate)) mMaxDate.setTimeInMillis(minDate);
        clamp(mDate);
        clamp(mShownMonth);
        mMonthView.invalidate();
    }

    public long getMinDate()
    {
        return mMinDate.getTimeInMillis();
    }

    public void setMaxDate(long maxDate)
    {
        mMaxDate.setTimeInMillis(maxDate);
        if (mMinDate.after(mMaxDate)) mMinDate.setTimeInMillis(maxDate);
        clamp(mDate);
        clamp(mShownMonth);
        mMonthView.invalidate();
    }

    public long getMaxDate()
    {
        return mMaxDate.getTimeInMillis();
    }

    public void setShowWeekNumber(boolean showWeekNumber)
    {
        mShowWeekNumber = showWeekNumber;
        mMonthView.invalidate();
    }

    public boolean getShowWeekNumber()
    {
        return mShowWeekNumber;
    }

    public void setFirstDayOfWeek(int firstDayOfWeek)
    {
        mFirstDayOfWeek = firstDayOfWeek;
        mMonthView.invalidate();
    }

    public int getFirstDayOfWeek()
    {
        return mFirstDayOfWeek;
    }

    public void setOnDateChangeListener(OnDateChangeListener listener)
    {
        mOnDateChangeListener = listener;
    }

    public long getDate()
    {
        return mDate.getTimeInMillis();
    }

    public void setDate(long date)
    {
        setDate(date, false, false);
    }

    public void setDate(long date, boolean animate, boolean center)
    {
        mDate.setTimeInMillis(date);
        clamp(mDate);
        mShownMonth.setTimeInMillis(mDate.getTimeInMillis());
        mMonthView.invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onConfigurationChanged(Configuration newConfig)
    {
        super.onConfigurationChanged(newConfig);

        mMonthView.requestLayout();
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return CalendarView.class.getName();
    }

    private void selectDay(int year, int month, int dayOfMonth)
    {
        Calendar candidate = Calendar.getInstance();
        candidate.setTimeInMillis(mDate.getTimeInMillis());
        candidate.set(year, month, dayOfMonth);

        if (candidate.before(startOfDay(mMinDate)) || candidate.after(mMaxDate)) return;

        mDate.setTimeInMillis(candidate.getTimeInMillis());
        mShownMonth.setTimeInMillis(candidate.getTimeInMillis());
        mMonthView.invalidate();

        if (mOnDateChangeListener != null) mOnDateChangeListener.onSelectedDayChange(this, year, month, dayOfMonth);
    }

    private static Calendar startOfDay(Calendar source)
    {
        Calendar result = Calendar.getInstance();
        result.setTimeInMillis(source.getTimeInMillis());
        result.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0);
        result.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
        result.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
        result.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
        return result;
    }

    private void moveMonth(int delta)
    {
        Calendar next = Calendar.getInstance();
        next.setTimeInMillis(mShownMonth.getTimeInMillis());
        next.set(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
        next.add(Calendar.MONTH, delta);

        Calendar firstAllowed = startOfDay(mMinDate);
        firstAllowed.set(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
        if (next.before(firstAllowed) || next.after(mMaxDate)) return;

        mShownMonth.setTimeInMillis(next.getTimeInMillis());
        mMonthView.invalidate();
    }

    public interface OnDateChangeListener
    {
        void onSelectedDayChange(CalendarView view, int year, int month, int dayOfMonth);
    }

    private class MonthView extends View
    {
        private static final int ROWS = 6;

        private final Paint mTextPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
        private final Paint mFillPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
        private final float mDensity;

        private MonthView(Context context)
        {
            super(context);

            mDensity = context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
            mTextPaint.setTextAlign(Paint.Align.CENTER);
            setClickable(true);
        }

        private float headerHeight()
        {
            return 48 * mDensity;
        }

        private float weekdayHeight()
        {
            return 32 * mDensity;
        }

        private float rowHeight()
        {
            return 40 * mDensity;
        }

        @Override
        protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
        {
            int width = (int)(7 * 44 * mDensity) + getPaddingLeft() + getPaddingRight();
            int height = (int)(headerHeight() + weekdayHeight() + ROWS * rowHeight()) + getPaddingTop() + getPaddingBottom();

            setMeasuredDimension(resolveSize(width, widthMeasureSpec), resolveSize(height, heightMeasureSpec));
        }

        private Calendar firstCell()
        {
            Calendar first = Calendar.getInstance();
            first.setTimeInMillis(mShownMonth.getTimeInMillis());
            first.set(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);

            int offset = (first.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK) - mFirstDayOfWeek + 7) % 7;
            first.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, -offset);
            return first;
        }

        @Override
        protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas)
        {
            super.onDraw(canvas);

            float left = getPaddingLeft();
            float width = getWidth() - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight();
            float cellWidth = width / 7f;
            float top = getPaddingTop();

            mTextPaint.setColor(mFocusedMonthDateColor);
            mTextPaint.setTextSize(16 * mDensity);
            mTextPaint.setFakeBoldText(true);

            String title = new SimpleDateFormat("LLLL yyyy", Locale.getDefault()).format(mShownMonth.getTime());
            float headerBaseline = top + headerHeight() / 2 - (mTextPaint.ascent() + mTextPaint.descent()) / 2;
            canvas.drawText(title, left + width / 2, headerBaseline, mTextPaint);
            canvas.drawText("‹", left + cellWidth / 2, headerBaseline, mTextPaint);
            canvas.drawText("›", left + width - cellWidth / 2, headerBaseline, mTextPaint);

            mTextPaint.setFakeBoldText(false);
            mTextPaint.setTextSize(12 * mDensity);
            mTextPaint.setColor(mUnfocusedMonthDateColor);

            String[] weekdays = new DateFormatSymbols(Locale.getDefault()).getShortWeekdays();
            float weekdayTop = top + headerHeight();
            float weekdayBaseline = weekdayTop + weekdayHeight() / 2 - (mTextPaint.ascent() + mTextPaint.descent()) / 2;
            for (int column = 0; column < 7; column++)
            {
                int day = (mFirstDayOfWeek - 1 + column) % 7 + 1;
                String label = weekdays[day];
                if (label.length() > 2) label = label.substring(0, 2);
                canvas.drawText(label, left + cellWidth * column + cellWidth / 2, weekdayBaseline, mTextPaint);
            }

            mFillPaint.setColor(mWeekSeparatorLineColor);
            canvas.drawRect(left, weekdayTop + weekdayHeight() - mDensity, left + width, weekdayTop + weekdayHeight(), mFillPaint);

            Calendar cell = firstCell();
            Calendar minimum = startOfDay(mMinDate);
            int shownMonth = mShownMonth.get(Calendar.MONTH);
            float gridTop = weekdayTop + weekdayHeight();
            mTextPaint.setTextSize(14 * mDensity);

            for (int row = 0; row < ROWS; row++)
            {
                for (int column = 0; column < 7; column++)
                {
                    float centerX = left + cellWidth * column + cellWidth / 2;
                    float centerY = gridTop + rowHeight() * row + rowHeight() / 2;

                    boolean selected = cell.get(Calendar.YEAR) == mDate.get(Calendar.YEAR)
                                       && cell.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR) == mDate.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR);
                    boolean enabled = !cell.before(minimum) && !cell.after(mMaxDate);
                    boolean inMonth = cell.get(Calendar.MONTH) == shownMonth;

                    if (selected)
                    {
                        mFillPaint.setColor(mSelectedWeekBackgroundColor);
                        canvas.drawCircle(centerX, centerY, Math.min(cellWidth, rowHeight()) / 2 - 2 * mDensity, mFillPaint);
                    }

                    int colour = inMonth ? mFocusedMonthDateColor : mUnfocusedMonthDateColor;
                    if (selected) colour = 0xFFFFFFFF;
                    if (!enabled) colour = (colour & 0x00FFFFFF) | 0x42000000;
                    mTextPaint.setColor(colour);

                    float baseline = centerY - (mTextPaint.ascent() + mTextPaint.descent()) / 2;
                    canvas.drawText(Integer.toString(cell.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH)), centerX, baseline, mTextPaint);

                    cell.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
                }
            }
        }

        @Override
        public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
        {
            if (!isEnabled()) return false;
            if (event.getActionMasked() != MotionEvent.ACTION_UP) return true;

            float x = event.getX() - getPaddingLeft();
            float y = event.getY() - getPaddingTop();
            float width = getWidth() - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight();
            float cellWidth = width / 7f;

            if (y < headerHeight())
            {
                if (x < cellWidth) moveMonth(-1);
                else if (x > width - cellWidth) moveMonth(1);
                return true;
            }

            float gridY = y - headerHeight() - weekdayHeight();
            if (gridY < 0) return true;

            int row = (int)(gridY / rowHeight());
            int column = (int)(x / cellWidth);
            if (row < 0 || row >= ROWS || column < 0 || column >= 7) return true;

            Calendar cell = firstCell();
            cell.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, row * 7 + column);
            selectDay(cell.get(Calendar.YEAR), cell.get(Calendar.MONTH), cell.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH));
            playSoundEffect(android.view.SoundEffectConstants.CLICK);
            return true;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

public class CheckBox extends CompoundButton
{
    public CheckBox(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public CheckBox(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, ProgressBar.attributeIdentifier(context, "checkboxStyle"));
    }

    public CheckBox(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public CheckBox(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return CheckBox.class.getName();
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/CheckedTextView.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.graphics.BlendMode;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.PorterDuff;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.AbsSavedState;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.StyleableSet;

public class CheckedTextView extends TextView implements Checkable
{
    private static final int STATE_CHECKED = 0x010100a0;

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private boolean mChecked;
    private int mCheckMarkResource;
    private Drawable mCheckMarkDrawable;
    private ColorStateList mCheckMarkTintList;
    private PorterDuff.Mode mCheckMarkTintMode;
    private BlendMode mCheckMarkBlendMode;
    private int mBasePaddingRight;
    private int mCheckMarkWidth;
    private int mCheckMarkGravity = Gravity.END;

    public CheckedTextView(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public CheckedTextView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, 0);
    }

    public CheckedTextView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public CheckedTextView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        mBasePaddingRight = getPaddingRight();
        if (attributes != null) readAttributes(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
    }

    private void readAttributes(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        if (sStyleable == null) sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "checked", "checkMark", "checkMarkGravity");
        if (sStyleable.isEmpty()) return;

        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        int markIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("checkMark");
        if (markIndex >= 0 && array.hasValue(markIndex))
        {
            try
            {
                Drawable mark = array.getDrawable(markIndex);
                if (mark != null) setCheckMarkDrawable(mark);
            }
            catch (RuntimeException unsupported)
            {
                android.util.Log.w("CheckedTextView", "the check mark could not be loaded", unsupported);
            }
        }

        int gravityIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("checkMarkGravity");
        if (gravityIndex >= 0) mCheckMarkGravity = array.getInt(gravityIndex, Gravity.END);

        int checkedIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("checked");
        if (checkedIndex >= 0) setChecked(array.getBoolean(checkedIndex, false));

        array.recycle();
    }

    @Override
    public void toggle()
    {
        setChecked(!mChecked);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isChecked()
    {
        return mChecked;
    }

    @Override
    public void setChecked(boolean checked)
    {
        if (mChecked == checked) return;

        mChecked = checked;
        refreshDrawableState();
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setCheckMarkDrawable(int resId)
    {
        if (resId != 0 && resId == mCheckMarkResource) return;

        Drawable drawable = resId == 0 ? null : getContext().getDrawable(resId);
        setCheckMarkDrawableInternal(drawable, resId);
    }

    public void setCheckMarkDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        setCheckMarkDrawableInternal(drawable, 0);
    }

    private void setCheckMarkDrawableInternal(Drawable drawable, int resId)
    {
        if (mCheckMarkDrawable != null)
        {
            mCheckMarkDrawable.setCallback(null);
            unscheduleDrawable(mCheckMarkDrawable);
        }

        mCheckMarkDrawable = drawable;
        mCheckMarkResource = resId;

        if (drawable != null)
        {
            drawable.setCallback(this);
            drawable.setVisible(getVisibility() == VISIBLE, false);
            drawable.setState(getDrawableState());
            mCheckMarkWidth = Math.max(0, drawable.getIntrinsicWidth());
            applyCheckMarkTint();
        }
        else
        {
            mCheckMarkWidth = 0;
        }

        updatePadding();
        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setCheckMarkTintList(ColorStateList tint)
    {
        mCheckMarkTintList = tint;
        applyCheckMarkTint();
    }

    public ColorStateList getCheckMarkTintList()
    {
        return mCheckMarkTintList;
    }

    public void setCheckMarkTintMode(PorterDuff.Mode tintMode)
    {
        mCheckMarkTintMode = tintMode;
        applyCheckMarkTint();
    }

    public void setCheckMarkTintBlendMode(BlendMode blendMode)
    {
        mCheckMarkBlendMode = blendMode;
        applyCheckMarkTint();
    }

    public PorterDuff.Mode getCheckMarkTintMode()
    {
        return mCheckMarkTintMode;
    }

    public BlendMode getCheckMarkTintBlendMode()
    {
        return mCheckMarkBlendMode;
    }

    private void applyCheckMarkTint()
    {
        if (mCheckMarkDrawable == null) return;
        if (mCheckMarkTintList == null && mCheckMarkTintMode == null && mCheckMarkBlendMode == null) return;

        mCheckMarkDrawable = mCheckMarkDrawable.mutate();
        if (mCheckMarkTintList != null) mCheckMarkDrawable.setTintList(mCheckMarkTintList);
        if (mCheckMarkTintMode != null) mCheckMarkDrawable.setTintMode(mCheckMarkTintMode);
        if (mCheckMarkBlendMode != null) mCheckMarkDrawable.setTintBlendMode(mCheckMarkBlendMode);
        if (mCheckMarkDrawable.isStateful()) mCheckMarkDrawable.setState(getDrawableState());
    }

    @Override
    public void setVisibility(int visibility)
    {
        super.setVisibility(visibility);
        if (mCheckMarkDrawable != null) mCheckMarkDrawable.setVisible(visibility == VISIBLE, false);
    }

    public void jumpDrawablesToCurrentState()
    {
        if (mCheckMarkDrawable != null) mCheckMarkDrawable.jumpToCurrentState();
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean verifyDrawable(Drawable who)
    {
        return who == mCheckMarkDrawable || super.verifyDrawable(who);
    }

    public Drawable getCheckMarkDrawable()
    {
        return mCheckMarkDrawable;
    }

    public void onRtlPropertiesChanged(int layoutDirection)
    {
        updatePadding();
    }

    @Override
    public void setPadding(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        mBasePaddingRight = right;
        super.setPadding(left, top, right + mCheckMarkWidth, bottom);
    }

    private void updatePadding()
    {
        super.setPadding(getPaddingLeft(), getPaddingTop(), mBasePaddingRight + mCheckMarkWidth, getPaddingBottom());
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        super.onDraw(canvas);

        Drawable mark = mCheckMarkDrawable;
        if (mark == null) return;

        int height = mark.getIntrinsicHeight();
        if (height < 0) height = getHeight();

        int top = (getHeight() - height) / 2;
        int gravity = Gravity.getAbsoluteGravity(mCheckMarkGravity, getLayoutDirection());
        boolean atStart = (gravity & Gravity.HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK) == Gravity.LEFT;

        int right = atStart ? getPaddingLeft() + mCheckMarkWidth : getWidth() - mBasePaddingRight;
        int left = right - mCheckMarkWidth;

        mark.setBounds(getScrollX() + left, top, getScrollX() + right, top + height);
        mark.draw(canvas);
    }

    @Override
    protected int[] onCreateDrawableState(int extraSpace)
    {
        int[] state = super.onCreateDrawableState(extraSpace + 1);
        if (!mChecked) return state;

        for (int index = 0; index < state.length; index++)
        {
            if (state[index] != 0) continue;

            state[index] = STATE_CHECKED;
            return state;
        }

        int[] grown = new int[state.length + 1];
        System.arraycopy(state, 0, grown, 0, state.length);
        grown[state.length] = STATE_CHECKED;
        return grown;
    }

    @Override
    protected void drawableStateChanged()
    {
        super.drawableStateChanged();

        if (mCheckMarkDrawable != null && mCheckMarkDrawable.isStateful() && mCheckMarkDrawable.setState(getDrawableState())) invalidate();
    }

    public void drawableHotspotChanged(float x, float y)
    {
        if (mCheckMarkDrawable != null) mCheckMarkDrawable.setHotspot(x, y);
    }

    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return CheckedTextView.class.getName();
    }

    @Override
    public Parcelable onSaveInstanceState()
    {
        SavedState state = new SavedState(super.onSaveInstanceState());
        state.checked = isChecked();
        return state;
    }

    @Override
    public void onRestoreInstanceState(Parcelable parcelable)
    {
        if (!(parcelable instanceof SavedState))
        {
            super.onRestoreInstanceState(parcelable);
            return;
        }

        SavedState state = (SavedState)parcelable;
        super.onRestoreInstanceState(state.getSuperState());
        setChecked(state.checked);
        requestLayout();
    }

    static class SavedState extends BaseSavedState
    {
        boolean checked;

        SavedState(Parcelable superState)
        {
            super(superState == null ? AbsSavedState.EMPTY_STATE : superState);
        }

        private SavedState(Parcel source)
        {
            super(source);
            checked = source.readInt() != 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
        {
            super.writeToParcel(out, flags);
            out.writeInt(checked ? 1 : 0);
        }

        public static final Parcelable.Creator<SavedState> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<SavedState>()
        {
            @Override
            public SavedState createFromParcel(Parcel in)
            {
                return new SavedState(in);
            }

            @Override
            public SavedState[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new SavedState[size];
            }
        };
    }
}
```
