`java/android/widget/Chronometer.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;

import java.util.Locale;

public class Chronometer extends TextView
{
    public interface OnChronometerTickListener
    {
        void onChronometerTick(Chronometer chronometer);
    }

    private static final int TICK_INTERVAL = 1000;

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private long mBase;
    private long mNow;
    private boolean mVisible;
    private boolean mStarted;
    private boolean mRunning;
    private boolean mCountDown;
    private String mFormat;
    private OnChronometerTickListener mOnChronometerTickListener;

    private final Runnable mTickRunnable = new Runnable()
    {
        @Override
        public void run()
        {
            if (!mRunning) return;

            updateText(SystemClock.elapsedRealtime());
            dispatchChronometerTick();
            postDelayed(this, TICK_INTERVAL);
        }
    };

    public Chronometer(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null, 0);
    }

    public Chronometer(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, 0);
    }

    public Chronometer(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public Chronometer(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        if (attributes != null)
        {
            if (sStyleable == null) sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "format", "countDown");

            if (!sStyleable.isEmpty())
            {
                TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

                int index = sStyleable.indexOf("format");
                if (index >= 0) setFormat(array.getString(index));

                index = sStyleable.indexOf("countDown");
                if (index >= 0) mCountDown = array.getBoolean(index, false);

                array.recycle();
            }
        }

        mBase = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        updateText(mBase);
    }

    public void setCountDown(boolean countDown)
    {
        mCountDown = countDown;
        updateText(SystemClock.elapsedRealtime());
    }

    public boolean isCountDown()
    {
        return mCountDown;
    }

    public boolean isTheFinalCountDown()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void setBase(long base)
    {
        mBase = base;
        dispatchChronometerTick();
        updateText(SystemClock.elapsedRealtime());
    }

    public long getBase()
    {
        return mBase;
    }

    public void setFormat(String format)
    {
        mFormat = format;
    }

    public String getFormat()
    {
        return mFormat;
    }

    public void setOnChronometerTickListener(OnChronometerTickListener listener)
    {
        mOnChronometerTickListener = listener;
    }

    public OnChronometerTickListener getOnChronometerTickListener()
    {
        return mOnChronometerTickListener;
    }

    public void start()
    {
        mStarted = true;
        updateRunning();
    }

    public void stop()
    {
        mStarted = false;
        updateRunning();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow()
    {
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();

        mVisible = false;
        updateRunning();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onWindowVisibilityChanged(int visibility)
    {
        super.onWindowVisibilityChanged(visibility);

        mVisible = visibility == VISIBLE;
        updateRunning();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onVisibilityChanged(View changedView, int visibility)
    {
        super.onVisibilityChanged(changedView, visibility);

        updateRunning();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onAttachedToWindow()
    {
        super.onAttachedToWindow();

        mVisible = getWindowVisibility() == VISIBLE;
        updateRunning();
    }

    private synchronized void updateText(long now)
    {
        mNow = now;

        long seconds = mCountDown ? mBase - now : now - mBase;
        seconds /= 1000;

        boolean negative = false;

        if (seconds < 0)
        {
            seconds = -seconds;
            negative = true;
        }

        String text = formatElapsedTime(seconds);
        if (negative) text = "−" + text;

        if (mFormat != null)
        {
            try
            {
                text = String.format(Locale.getDefault(), mFormat, text);
            }
            catch (RuntimeException malformed)
            {
                android.util.Log.w("Chronometer", "Illegal format string: " + mFormat);
            }
        }

        setText(text);
    }

    static String formatElapsedTime(long elapsedSeconds)
    {
        long hours = elapsedSeconds / 3600;
        long minutes = (elapsedSeconds % 3600) / 60;
        long seconds = elapsedSeconds % 60;

        if (hours > 0) return String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%d:%02d:%02d", hours, minutes, seconds);

        return String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%02d:%02d", minutes, seconds);
    }

    private void updateRunning()
    {
        boolean running = mVisible && mStarted && isShown();
        if (running == mRunning) return;

        if (running)
        {
            updateText(SystemClock.elapsedRealtime());
            dispatchChronometerTick();
            postDelayed(mTickRunnable, TICK_INTERVAL);
        }
        else
        {
            removeCallbacks(mTickRunnable);
        }

        mRunning = running;
    }

    void dispatchChronometerTick()
    {
        if (mOnChronometerTickListener != null) mOnChronometerTickListener.onChronometerTick(this);
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getContentDescription()
    {
        CharSequence description = super.getContentDescription();
        if (description != null) return description;

        long elapsed = Math.abs(mCountDown ? mBase - mNow : mNow - mBase) / 1000;
        long hours = elapsed / 3600;
        long minutes = (elapsed % 3600) / 60;
        long seconds = elapsed % 60;

        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        if (hours > 0) builder.append(hours).append(hours == 1 ? " hour, " : " hours, ");
        if (hours > 0 || minutes > 0) builder.append(minutes).append(minutes == 1 ? " minute, " : " minutes, ");
        builder.append(seconds).append(seconds == 1 ? " second" : " seconds");

        return builder.toString();
    }

    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return Chronometer.class.getName();
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/CompoundButton.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.graphics.BlendMode;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.PorterDuff;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.graphics.drawable.Icon;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.AbsSavedState;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.autofill.AutofillValue;

public abstract class CompoundButton extends Button implements Checkable
{
    private static final int[] CHECKED_STATE_SET = {0x010100a0};

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private OnCheckedChangeListener mListener;
    private OnCheckedChangeListener mWidgetListener;
    private boolean mChecked;
    private boolean mBroadcasting;
    private Drawable mButtonDrawable;
    private int mButtonResource;
    private ColorStateList mButtonTintList;
    private PorterDuff.Mode mButtonTintMode;
    private BlendMode mButtonBlendMode;
    private CharSequence mCustomStateDescription;

    public CompoundButton(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public CompoundButton(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, 0);
    }

    public CompoundButton(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public CompoundButton(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        if (attributes != null || defStyleAttr != 0 || defStyleRes != 0) readAttributes(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
    }

    private void readAttributes(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        if (sStyleable == null)
        {
            sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "button", "buttonTint", "buttonTintMode", "checked");
        }
        if (sStyleable.isEmpty()) return;

        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        int buttonIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("button");
        if (buttonIndex >= 0 && array.hasValue(buttonIndex))
        {
            try
            {
                Drawable button = array.getDrawable(buttonIndex);
                if (button != null) setButtonDrawable(button);
            }
            catch (RuntimeException unsupported)
            {
                android.util.Log.w("CompoundButton", "the button drawable could not be loaded", unsupported);
            }
        }

        int tintIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("buttonTint");
        if (tintIndex >= 0 && array.hasValue(tintIndex)) mButtonTintList = array.getColorStateList(tintIndex);

        int modeIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("buttonTintMode");
        if (modeIndex >= 0 && array.hasValue(modeIndex)) mButtonTintMode = parseTintMode(array.getInt(modeIndex, -1));

        int checkedIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("checked");
        if (checkedIndex >= 0 && array.hasValue(checkedIndex)) mChecked = array.getBoolean(checkedIndex, false);

        array.recycle();

        applyButtonTint();
        refreshDrawableState();
    }

    private static PorterDuff.Mode parseTintMode(int value)
    {
        switch (value)
        {
            case 3:
                return PorterDuff.Mode.SRC_OVER;
            case 5:
                return PorterDuff.Mode.SRC_IN;
            case 9:
                return PorterDuff.Mode.SRC_ATOP;
            case 14:
                return PorterDuff.Mode.MULTIPLY;
            case 15:
                return PorterDuff.Mode.SCREEN;
            case 16:
                return PorterDuff.Mode.ADD;
            default:
                return null;
        }
    }

    public void setOnCheckedChangeListener(OnCheckedChangeListener listener)
    {
        mListener = listener;
    }

    public void setOnCheckedChangeWidgetListener(OnCheckedChangeListener listener)
    {
        mWidgetListener = listener;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isChecked()
    {
        return mChecked;
    }

    @Override
    public void setChecked(boolean checked)
    {
        if (mChecked == checked) return;

        mChecked = checked;
        refreshDrawableState();
        invalidate();

        if (mBroadcasting) return;

        mBroadcasting = true;
        if (mListener != null) mListener.onCheckedChanged(this, mChecked);
        if (mWidgetListener != null) mWidgetListener.onCheckedChanged(this, mChecked);

        android.view.autofill.AutofillManager manager = getContext().getSystemService(android.view.autofill.AutofillManager.class);
        if (manager != null) manager.notifyValueChanged(this);

        mBroadcasting = false;
    }

    @Override
    public void toggle()
    {
        setChecked(!mChecked);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean performClick()
    {
        toggle();
        boolean handled = super.performClick();
        if (!handled) playSoundEffect(android.view.SoundEffectConstants.CLICK);
        return handled;
    }

    @Override
    public void setStateDescription(CharSequence stateDescription)
    {
        mCustomStateDescription = stateDescription;
        super.setStateDescription(stateDescription);
    }

    public void setButtonDrawable(int resId)
    {
        if (resId != 0 && resId == mButtonResource) return;

        Drawable drawable = resId == 0 ? null : getContext().getDrawable(resId);
        setButtonDrawable(drawable);
        mButtonResource = resId;
    }

    public void setButtonDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        if (mButtonDrawable == drawable) return;

        if (mButtonDrawable != null)
        {
            mButtonDrawable.setCallback(null);
            unscheduleDrawable(mButtonDrawable);
        }

        mButtonDrawable = drawable;
        mButtonResource = 0;

        if (drawable != null)
        {
            drawable.setCallback(this);
            drawable.setLayoutDirection(getLayoutDirection());
            if (drawable.isStateful()) drawable.setState(getDrawableState());
            drawable.setVisible(getVisibility() == VISIBLE, false);
            setMinHeight(drawable.getIntrinsicHeight());
            applyButtonTint();
        }

        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setButtonIcon(Icon icon)
    {
        setButtonDrawable(icon == null ? null : icon.loadDrawable(getContext()));
    }

    public Drawable getButtonDrawable()
    {
        return mButtonDrawable;
    }

    public void setButtonTintList(ColorStateList tint)
    {
        mButtonTintList = tint;
        applyButtonTint();
    }

    public ColorStateList getButtonTintList()
    {
        return mButtonTintList;
    }

    public void setButtonTintMode(PorterDuff.Mode tintMode)
    {
        mButtonTintMode = tintMode;
        mButtonBlendMode = null;
        applyButtonTint();
    }

    public PorterDuff.Mode getButtonTintMode()
    {
        return mButtonTintMode;
    }

    public void setButtonTintBlendMode(BlendMode tintMode)
    {
        mButtonBlendMode = tintMode;
        applyButtonTint();
    }

    public BlendMode getButtonTintBlendMode()
    {
        return mButtonBlendMode;
    }

    private void applyButtonTint()
    {
        if (mButtonDrawable == null) return;
        if (mButtonTintList == null && mButtonTintMode == null && mButtonBlendMode == null) return;

        mButtonDrawable = mButtonDrawable.mutate();
        if (mButtonTintList != null) mButtonDrawable.setTintList(mButtonTintList);
        if (mButtonTintMode != null) mButtonDrawable.setTintMode(mButtonTintMode);
        if (mButtonBlendMode != null) mButtonDrawable.setTintBlendMode(mButtonBlendMode);
        if (mButtonDrawable.isStateful()) mButtonDrawable.setState(getDrawableState());
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return CompoundButton.class.getName();
    }

    @Override
    public int getCompoundPaddingLeft()
    {
        int padding = super.getCompoundPaddingLeft();
        if (!isLayoutRtl() && mButtonDrawable != null) padding += Math.max(0, mButtonDrawable.getIntrinsicWidth());
        return padding;
    }

    @Override
    public int getCompoundPaddingRight()
    {
        int padding = super.getCompoundPaddingRight();
        if (isLayoutRtl() && mButtonDrawable != null) padding += Math.max(0, mButtonDrawable.getIntrinsicWidth());
        return padding;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        Drawable button = mButtonDrawable;

        if (button != null)
        {
            int drawableHeight = Math.max(0, button.getIntrinsicHeight());
            int drawableWidth = Math.max(0, button.getIntrinsicWidth());

            int top;
            int verticalGravity = getGravity() & Gravity.VERTICAL_GRAVITY_MASK;
            if (verticalGravity == Gravity.BOTTOM) top = getHeight() - drawableHeight;
            else if (verticalGravity == Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL) top = (getHeight() - drawableHeight) / 2;
            else top = 0;

            boolean rtl = isLayoutRtl();
            int left = rtl ? getWidth() - drawableWidth : 0;
            int right = rtl ? getWidth() : drawableWidth;

            button.setBounds(left, top, right, top + drawableHeight);

            Drawable background = getBackground();
            if (background != null) background.setHotspotBounds(left, top, right, top + drawableHeight);
        }

        super.onDraw(canvas);

        if (button == null) return;

        int scrollX = getScrollX();
        int scrollY = getScrollY();

        if (scrollX == 0 && scrollY == 0)
        {
            button.draw(canvas);
            return;
        }

        canvas.translate(scrollX, scrollY);
        button.draw(canvas);
        canvas.translate(-scrollX, -scrollY);
    }

    @Override
    protected int[] onCreateDrawableState(int extraSpace)
    {
        int[] state = super.onCreateDrawableState(extraSpace + 1);
        if (isChecked()) mergeDrawableStates(state, CHECKED_STATE_SET);
        return state;
    }

    @Override
    protected void drawableStateChanged()
    {
        super.drawableStateChanged();

        if (mButtonDrawable != null && mButtonDrawable.isStateful() && mButtonDrawable.setState(getDrawableState()))
        {
            invalidateDrawable(mButtonDrawable);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void drawableHotspotChanged(float x, float y)
    {
        super.drawableHotspotChanged(x, y);

        if (mButtonDrawable != null) mButtonDrawable.setHotspot(x, y);
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean verifyDrawable(Drawable who)
    {
        return super.verifyDrawable(who) || who == mButtonDrawable;
    }

    @Override
    public void jumpDrawablesToCurrentState()
    {
        super.jumpDrawablesToCurrentState();

        if (mButtonDrawable != null) mButtonDrawable.jumpToCurrentState();
    }

    @Override
    public void setVisibility(int visibility)
    {
        super.setVisibility(visibility);

        if (mButtonDrawable != null) mButtonDrawable.setVisible(visibility == VISIBLE, false);
    }

    @Override
    public void autofill(AutofillValue value)
    {
        if (!isEnabled() || value == null || !value.isToggle()) return;

        setChecked(value.getToggleValue());
    }

    @Override
    public int getAutofillType()
    {
        return isEnabled() ? AUTOFILL_TYPE_TOGGLE : AUTOFILL_TYPE_NONE;
    }

    @Override
    public AutofillValue getAutofillValue()
    {
        return isEnabled() ? AutofillValue.forToggle(isChecked()) : null;
    }

    @Override
    public Parcelable onSaveInstanceState()
    {
        SavedState state = new SavedState(super.onSaveInstanceState());
        state.checked = isChecked();
        return state;
    }

    @Override
    public void onRestoreInstanceState(Parcelable parcelable)
    {
        if (!(parcelable instanceof SavedState))
        {
            super.onRestoreInstanceState(parcelable);
            return;
        }

        SavedState state = (SavedState)parcelable;
        super.onRestoreInstanceState(state.getSuperState());
        setChecked(state.checked);
        requestLayout();
    }

    static class SavedState extends BaseSavedState
    {
        boolean checked;

        SavedState(Parcelable superState)
        {
            super(superState == null ? AbsSavedState.EMPTY_STATE : superState);
        }

        private SavedState(Parcel source)
        {
            super(source);
            checked = source.readInt() != 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
        {
            super.writeToParcel(out, flags);
            out.writeInt(checked ? 1 : 0);
        }

        public static final Parcelable.Creator<SavedState> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<SavedState>()
        {
            @Override
            public SavedState createFromParcel(Parcel in)
            {
                return new SavedState(in);
            }

            @Override
            public SavedState[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new SavedState[size];
            }
        };
    }

    public interface OnCheckedChangeListener
    {
        void onCheckedChanged(CompoundButton buttonView, boolean isChecked);
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/CursorAdapter.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.database.ContentObserver;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.database.DataSetObserver;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.view.ContextThemeWrapper;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

public abstract class CursorAdapter extends BaseAdapter implements Filterable, ThemedSpinnerAdapter
{
    public static final int FLAG_AUTO_REQUERY = 0x01;
    public static final int FLAG_REGISTER_CONTENT_OBSERVER = 0x02;

    private static final String ROW_ID_COLUMN = "_id";

    private boolean mDataValid;
    private boolean mAutoRequery;
    private Cursor mCursor;
    private Context mContext;
    private Context mDropDownContext;
    private int mRowIdColumn;
    private ChangeObserver mChangeObserver;
    private DataSetObserver mDataSetObserver;
    private CursorFilter mCursorFilter;
    private FilterQueryProvider mFilterQueryProvider;

    public CursorAdapter(Context context, Cursor cursor)
    {
        init(context, cursor, FLAG_AUTO_REQUERY);
    }

    public CursorAdapter(Context context, Cursor cursor, boolean autoRequery)
    {
        init(context, cursor, autoRequery ? FLAG_AUTO_REQUERY : FLAG_REGISTER_CONTENT_OBSERVER);
    }

    public CursorAdapter(Context context, Cursor cursor, int flags)
    {
        init(context, cursor, flags);
    }

    protected void init(Context context, Cursor cursor, boolean autoRequery)
    {
        init(context, cursor, autoRequery ? FLAG_AUTO_REQUERY : FLAG_REGISTER_CONTENT_OBSERVER);
    }

    void init(Context context, Cursor cursor, int flags)
    {
        if ((flags & FLAG_AUTO_REQUERY) == FLAG_AUTO_REQUERY)
        {
            flags |= FLAG_REGISTER_CONTENT_OBSERVER;
            mAutoRequery = true;
        }
        else
        {
            mAutoRequery = false;
        }

        boolean cursorPresent = cursor != null;
        mCursor = cursor;
        mDataValid = cursorPresent;
        mContext = context;
        mRowIdColumn = cursorPresent ? cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(ROW_ID_COLUMN) : -1;

        if ((flags & FLAG_REGISTER_CONTENT_OBSERVER) == FLAG_REGISTER_CONTENT_OBSERVER)
        {
            mChangeObserver = new ChangeObserver();
            mDataSetObserver = new MyDataSetObserver();
        }
        else
        {
            mChangeObserver = null;
            mDataSetObserver = null;
        }

        if (!cursorPresent) return;

        if (mChangeObserver != null) cursor.registerContentObserver(mChangeObserver);
        if (mDataSetObserver != null) cursor.registerDataSetObserver(mDataSetObserver);
    }

    @Override
    public void setDropDownViewTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        if (theme == null) mDropDownContext = null;
        else if (theme == mContext.getTheme()) mDropDownContext = mContext;
        else mDropDownContext = new ContextThemeWrapper(mContext, theme);
    }

    @Override
    public Resources.Theme getDropDownViewTheme()
    {
        return mDropDownContext == null ? null : mDropDownContext.getTheme();
    }

    public Cursor getCursor()
    {
        return mCursor;
    }

    @Override
    public int getCount()
    {
        if (mDataValid && mCursor != null) return mCursor.getCount();
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public Object getItem(int position)
    {
        if (!mDataValid || mCursor == null) return null;

        mCursor.moveToPosition(position);
        return mCursor;
    }

    @Override
    public long getItemId(int position)
    {
        if (!mDataValid || mCursor == null) return 0;
        if (!mCursor.moveToPosition(position)) return 0;

        return mCursor.getLong(mRowIdColumn);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasStableIds()
    {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public View getView(int position, View convertView, ViewGroup parent)
    {
        if (!mDataValid) throw new IllegalStateException("this should only be called when the cursor is valid");
        if (!mCursor.moveToPosition(position)) throw new IllegalStateException("couldn't move cursor to position " + position);

        View view = convertView == null ? newView(mContext, mCursor, parent) : convertView;
        bindView(view, mContext, mCursor);
        return view;
    }

    @Override
    public View getDropDownView(int position, View convertView, ViewGroup parent)
    {
        if (!mDataValid) return null;

        Context context = mDropDownContext == null ? mContext : mDropDownContext;
        mCursor.moveToPosition(position);

        View view = convertView == null ? newDropDownView(context, mCursor, parent) : convertView;
        bindView(view, context, mCursor);
        return view;
    }

    public abstract View newView(Context context, Cursor cursor, ViewGroup parent);

    public View newDropDownView(Context context, Cursor cursor, ViewGroup parent)
    {
        return newView(context, cursor, parent);
    }

    public abstract void bindView(View view, Context context, Cursor cursor);

    public void changeCursor(Cursor cursor)
    {
        Cursor old = swapCursor(cursor);
        if (old != null) old.close();
    }

    public Cursor swapCursor(Cursor newCursor)
    {
        if (newCursor == mCursor) return null;

        Cursor old = mCursor;
        if (old != null)
        {
            if (mChangeObserver != null) old.unregisterContentObserver(mChangeObserver);
            if (mDataSetObserver != null) old.unregisterDataSetObserver(mDataSetObserver);
        }

        mCursor = newCursor;

        if (newCursor == null)
        {
            mRowIdColumn = -1;
            mDataValid = false;
            notifyDataSetInvalidated();
            return old;
        }

        if (mChangeObserver != null) newCursor.registerContentObserver(mChangeObserver);
        if (mDataSetObserver != null) newCursor.registerDataSetObserver(mDataSetObserver);

        mRowIdColumn = newCursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(ROW_ID_COLUMN);
        mDataValid = true;
        notifyDataSetChanged();
        return old;
    }

    public CharSequence convertToString(Cursor cursor)
    {
        return cursor == null ? "" : cursor.toString();
    }

    public Cursor runQueryOnBackgroundThread(CharSequence constraint)
    {
        if (mFilterQueryProvider != null) return mFilterQueryProvider.runQuery(constraint);
        return mCursor;
    }

    @Override
    public Filter getFilter()
    {
        if (mCursorFilter == null) mCursorFilter = new CursorFilter();
        return mCursorFilter;
    }

    public FilterQueryProvider getFilterQueryProvider()
    {
        return mFilterQueryProvider;
    }

    public void setFilterQueryProvider(FilterQueryProvider filterQueryProvider)
    {
        mFilterQueryProvider = filterQueryProvider;
    }

    protected void onContentChanged()
    {
        if (!mAutoRequery || mCursor == null || mCursor.isClosed()) return;

        mDataValid = mCursor.requery();
    }

    private class ChangeObserver extends ContentObserver
    {
        ChangeObserver()
        {
            super(new Handler());
        }

        @Override
        public boolean deliverSelfNotifications()
        {
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public void onChange(boolean selfChange)
        {
            onContentChanged();
        }
    }

    private class MyDataSetObserver extends DataSetObserver
    {
        @Override
        public void onChanged()
        {
            mDataValid = true;
            notifyDataSetChanged();
        }

        @Override
        public void onInvalidated()
        {
            mDataValid = false;
            notifyDataSetInvalidated();
        }
    }

    private class CursorFilter extends Filter
    {
        @Override
        public CharSequence convertResultToString(Object resultValue)
        {
            return convertToString((Cursor)resultValue);
        }

        @Override
        protected FilterResults performFiltering(CharSequence constraint)
        {
            Cursor cursor = runQueryOnBackgroundThread(constraint);

            FilterResults results = new FilterResults();
            if (cursor != null)
            {
                results.count = cursor.getCount();
                results.values = cursor;
            }
            else
            {
                results.count = 0;
                results.values = null;
            }

            return results;
        }

        @Override
        protected void publishResults(CharSequence constraint, FilterResults results)
        {
            Cursor old = mCursor;
            if (results.values != null && results.values != old) changeCursor((Cursor)results.values);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/DatePicker.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Configuration;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.util.SparseArray;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.ViewStructure;
import android.view.autofill.AutofillValue;
import java.text.DateFormatSymbols;
import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.Locale;

public class DatePicker extends FrameLayout
{
    private static final int MODE_SPINNER = 1;
    private static final int MODE_CALENDAR = 2;
    private static final String DEFAULT_MIN_DATE = "01/01/1900";
    private static final String DEFAULT_MAX_DATE = "12/31/2100";

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private final Calendar mCurrentDate = Calendar.getInstance();
    private final Calendar mMinDate = Calendar.getInstance();
    private final Calendar mMaxDate = Calendar.getInstance();
    private final int mMode;
    private final LinearLayout mContainer;
    private final LinearLayout mSpinners;
    private final NumberPicker mMonthSpinner;
    private final NumberPicker mDaySpinner;
    private final NumberPicker mYearSpinner;
    private CalendarView mCalendarView;
    private OnDateChangedListener mOnDateChangedListener;
    private OnDateChangedListener mAutoFillChangeListener;
    private int mFirstDayOfWeek;
    private boolean mSpinnersShown = true;
    private boolean mCalendarViewShown;
    private String[] mShortMonths;

    public DatePicker(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public DatePicker(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, ProgressBar.attributeIdentifier(context, "datePickerStyle"));
    }

    public DatePicker(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public DatePicker(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        mFirstDayOfWeek = mCurrentDate.getFirstDayOfWeek();
        CalendarView.parseDate(DEFAULT_MIN_DATE, mMinDate);
        CalendarView.parseDate(DEFAULT_MAX_DATE, mMaxDate);

        int mode = MODE_CALENDAR;

        if (sStyleable == null)
        {
            sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "datePickerMode", "spinnersShown", "calendarViewShown", "minDate", "maxDate",
                                         "startYear", "endYear", "firstDayOfWeek");
        }

        if (!sStyleable.isEmpty() && (attributes != null || defStyleAttr != 0 || defStyleRes != 0))
        {
            TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

            int index = sStyleable.indexOf("datePickerMode");
            if (index >= 0) mode = array.getInt(index, mode);

            index = sStyleable.indexOf("spinnersShown");
            if (index >= 0) mSpinnersShown = array.getBoolean(index, true);

            index = sStyleable.indexOf("calendarViewShown");
            if (index >= 0) mCalendarViewShown = array.getBoolean(index, false);

            index = sStyleable.indexOf("startYear");
            if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) mMinDate.set(array.getInt(index, 1900), Calendar.JANUARY, 1);

            index = sStyleable.indexOf("endYear");
            if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) mMaxDate.set(array.getInt(index, 2100), Calendar.DECEMBER, 31);

            index = sStyleable.indexOf("minDate");
            if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) CalendarView.parseDate(array.getString(index), mMinDate);

            index = sStyleable.indexOf("maxDate");
            if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) CalendarView.parseDate(array.getString(index), mMaxDate);

            index = sStyleable.indexOf("firstDayOfWeek");
            if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) mFirstDayOfWeek = array.getInt(index, mFirstDayOfWeek);

            array.recycle();
        }

        mMode = mode == MODE_SPINNER ? MODE_SPINNER : MODE_CALENDAR;
        if (mMaxDate.before(mMinDate)) mMaxDate.setTimeInMillis(mMinDate.getTimeInMillis());
        clampCurrent();

        mShortMonths = new DateFormatSymbols(Locale.getDefault()).getShortMonths();

        mContainer = new LinearLayout(context);
        mContainer.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        mContainer.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);

        mSpinners = new LinearLayout(context);
        mSpinners.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        mSpinners.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);

        NumberPicker.OnValueChangeListener listener = new NumberPicker.OnValueChangeListener()
        {
            public void onValueChange(NumberPicker picker, int oldValue, int newValue)
            {
                onSpinnerChanged(picker, oldValue, newValue);
            }
        };

        mMonthSpinner = createSpinner(context, listener);
        mDaySpinner = createSpinner(context, listener);
        mYearSpinner = createSpinner(context, listener);
        mYearSpinner.setWrapSelectorWheel(false);

        mDaySpinner.setFormatter(new NumberPicker.Formatter()
        {
            public String format(int value)
            {
                return String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%02d", value);
            }
        });

        addSpinnersInLocaleOrder();
        mContainer.addView(mSpinners, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                                                                     ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        addView(mContainer, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, Gravity.CENTER));

        if (mMode == MODE_CALENDAR)
        {
            mSpinnersShown = false;
            mCalendarViewShown = true;
        }

        updateSpinners();
        updateCalendarView();
        updateVisibility();
    }

    private static NumberPicker createSpinner(Context context, NumberPicker.OnValueChangeListener listener)
    {
        NumberPicker spinner = new NumberPicker(context);
        spinner.setOnValueChangedListener(listener);
        spinner.setOnLongPressUpdateInterval(100);
        return spinner;
    }

    private void addSpinnersInLocaleOrder()
    {
        String pattern = android.text.format.DateFormat.getBestDateTimePattern(Locale.getDefault(), "yyyyMMMdd");
        boolean monthAdded = false;
        boolean dayAdded = false;
        boolean yearAdded = false;

        for (int index = 0; index < pattern.length(); index++)
        {
            char symbol = pattern.charAt(index);

            if ((symbol == 'M' || symbol == 'L') && !monthAdded)
            {
                addSpinner(mMonthSpinner);
                monthAdded = true;
            }
            else if (symbol == 'd' && !dayAdded)
            {
                addSpinner(mDaySpinner);
                dayAdded = true;
            }
            else if (symbol == 'y' && !yearAdded)
            {
                addSpinner(mYearSpinner);
                yearAdded = true;
            }
        }

        if (!monthAdded) addSpinner(mMonthSpinner);
        if (!dayAdded) addSpinner(mDaySpinner);
        if (!yearAdded) addSpinner(mYearSpinner);
    }

    private void addSpinner(NumberPicker spinner)
    {
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams params = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                                                                         ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        int margin = (int)(8 * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
        params.setMargins(margin, 0, margin, 0);
        mSpinners.addView(spinner, params);
    }

    private void onSpinnerChanged(NumberPicker picker, int oldValue, int newValue)
    {
        Calendar temp = Calendar.getInstance();
        temp.setTimeInMillis(mCurrentDate.getTimeInMillis());

        if (picker == mDaySpinner)
        {
            int maxDay = temp.getActualMaximum(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);
            if (oldValue == maxDay && newValue == 1) temp.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
            else if (oldValue == 1 && newValue == maxDay) temp.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, -1);
            else temp.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, newValue - oldValue);
        }
        else if (picker == mMonthSpinner)
        {
            if (oldValue == 11 && newValue == 0) temp.add(Calendar.MONTH, 1);
            else if (oldValue == 0 && newValue == 11) temp.add(Calendar.MONTH, -1);
            else temp.add(Calendar.MONTH, newValue - oldValue);
        }
        else
        {
            temp.set(Calendar.YEAR, newValue);
        }

        setDate(temp.get(Calendar.YEAR), temp.get(Calendar.MONTH), temp.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH));
        updateSpinners();
        updateCalendarView();
        notifyDateChanged();
    }

    private void setDate(int year, int month, int dayOfMonth)
    {
        mCurrentDate.set(Calendar.YEAR, year);
        mCurrentDate.set(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
        mCurrentDate.set(Calendar.MONTH, month);
        mCurrentDate.set(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, Math.min(dayOfMonth, mCurrentDate.getActualMaximum(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH)));
        clampCurrent();
    }

    private void clampCurrent()
    {
        if (mCurrentDate.before(mMinDate)) mCurrentDate.setTimeInMillis(mMinDate.getTimeInMillis());
        else if (mCurrentDate.after(mMaxDate)) mCurrentDate.setTimeInMillis(mMaxDate.getTimeInMillis());
    }

    private boolean sameMonth(Calendar first, Calendar second)
    {
        return first.get(Calendar.YEAR) == second.get(Calendar.YEAR) && first.get(Calendar.MONTH) == second.get(Calendar.MONTH);
    }

    private void updateSpinners()
    {
        int year = mCurrentDate.get(Calendar.YEAR);

        mDaySpinner.setDisplayedValues(null);
        if (sameMonth(mCurrentDate, mMinDate))
        {
            mDaySpinner.setMinValue(mMinDate.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH));
            mDaySpinner.setMaxValue(mCurrentDate.getActualMaximum(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH));
            mDaySpinner.setWrapSelectorWheel(false);
        }
        else if (sameMonth(mCurrentDate, mMaxDate))
        {
            mDaySpinner.setMinValue(mCurrentDate.getActualMinimum(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH));
            mDaySpinner.setMaxValue(mMaxDate.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH));
            mDaySpinner.setWrapSelectorWheel(false);
        }
        else
        {
            mDaySpinner.setMinValue(1);
            mDaySpinner.setMaxValue(mCurrentDate.getActualMaximum(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH));
            mDaySpinner.setWrapSelectorWheel(true);
        }

        mMonthSpinner.setDisplayedValues(null);
        int minMonth = year == mMinDate.get(Calendar.YEAR) ? mMinDate.get(Calendar.MONTH) : 0;
        int maxMonth = year == mMaxDate.get(Calendar.YEAR) ? mMaxDate.get(Calendar.MONTH) : 11;
        mMonthSpinner.setMinValue(minMonth);
        mMonthSpinner.setMaxValue(maxMonth);
        mMonthSpinner.setWrapSelectorWheel(minMonth == 0 && maxMonth == 11);

        String[] months = new String[maxMonth - minMonth + 1];
        for (int index = 0; index < months.length; index++) months[index] = mShortMonths[minMonth + index];
        mMonthSpinner.setDisplayedValues(months);

        mYearSpinner.setMinValue(mMinDate.get(Calendar.YEAR));
        mYearSpinner.setMaxValue(mMaxDate.get(Calendar.YEAR));

        mYearSpinner.setValue(year);
        mMonthSpinner.setValue(mCurrentDate.get(Calendar.MONTH));
        mDaySpinner.setValue(mCurrentDate.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH));
    }

    private CalendarView ensureCalendarView()
    {
        if (mCalendarView != null) return mCalendarView;

        mCalendarView = new CalendarView(getContext());
        mCalendarView.setMinDate(mMinDate.getTimeInMillis());
        mCalendarView.setMaxDate(mMaxDate.getTimeInMillis());
        mCalendarView.setFirstDayOfWeek(mFirstDayOfWeek);
        mCalendarView.setOnDateChangeListener(new CalendarView.OnDateChangeListener()
        {
            public void onSelectedDayChange(CalendarView view, int year, int month, int dayOfMonth)
            {
                setDate(year, month, dayOfMonth);
                updateSpinners();
                notifyDateChanged();
            }
        });

        mContainer.addView(mCalendarView, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                                                                         ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        return mCalendarView;
    }

    private void updateCalendarView()
    {
        if (mCalendarView != null) mCalendarView.setDate(mCurrentDate.getTimeInMillis(), false, false);
    }

    private void updateVisibility()
    {
        mSpinners.setVisibility(mSpinnersShown ? VISIBLE : GONE);

        if (mCalendarViewShown)
        {
            ensureCalendarView().setVisibility(VISIBLE);
            updateCalendarView();
        }
        else if (mCalendarView != null)
        {
            mCalendarView.setVisibility(GONE);
        }
    }

    private void notifyDateChanged()
    {
        sendAccessibilityEvent(android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_VIEW_SELECTED);

        if (mOnDateChangedListener != null) mOnDateChangedListener.onDateChanged(this, getYear(), getMonth(), getDayOfMonth());
        if (mAutoFillChangeListener != null) mAutoFillChangeListener.onDateChanged(this, getYear(), getMonth(), getDayOfMonth());

        android.view.autofill.AutofillManager manager = getContext().getSystemService(android.view.autofill.AutofillManager.class);
        if (manager != null) manager.notifyValueChanged(this);
    }

    public void init(int year, int monthOfYear, int dayOfMonth, OnDateChangedListener onDateChangedListener)
    {
        setDate(year, monthOfYear, dayOfMonth);
        updateSpinners();
        updateCalendarView();
        mOnDateChangedListener = onDateChangedListener;
    }

    public void setOnDateChangedListener(OnDateChangedListener onDateChangedListener)
    {
        mOnDateChangedListener = onDateChangedListener;
    }

    public void updateDate(int year, int month, int dayOfMonth)
    {
        if (getYear() == year && getMonth() == month && getDayOfMonth() == dayOfMonth) return;

        setDate(year, month, dayOfMonth);
        updateSpinners();
        updateCalendarView();
        notifyDateChanged();
    }

    public int getYear()
    {
        return mCurrentDate.get(Calendar.YEAR);
    }

    public int getMonth()
    {
        return mCurrentDate.get(Calendar.MONTH);
    }

    public int getDayOfMonth()
    {
        return mCurrentDate.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);
    }

    public void setMinDate(long minDate)
    {
        Calendar candidate = Calendar.getInstance();
        candidate.setTimeInMillis(minDate);
        if (candidate.get(Calendar.YEAR) == mMinDate.get(Calendar.YEAR)
            && candidate.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR) == mMinDate.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR))
        {
            return;
        }

        mMinDate.setTimeInMillis(minDate);
        if (mMaxDate.before(mMinDate)) mMaxDate.setTimeInMillis(minDate);
        if (mCalendarView != null) mCalendarView.setMinDate(minDate);
        clampCurrent();
        updateSpinners();
        updateCalendarView();
    }

    public long getMinDate()
    {
        return mMinDate.getTimeInMillis();
    }

    public void setMaxDate(long maxDate)
    {
        Calendar candidate = Calendar.getInstance();
        candidate.setTimeInMillis(maxDate);
        if (candidate.get(Calendar.YEAR) == mMaxDate.get(Calendar.YEAR)
            && candidate.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR) == mMaxDate.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR))
        {
            return;
        }

        mMaxDate.setTimeInMillis(maxDate);
        if (mMinDate.after(mMaxDate)) mMinDate.setTimeInMillis(maxDate);
        if (mCalendarView != null) mCalendarView.setMaxDate(maxDate);
        clampCurrent();
        updateSpinners();
        updateCalendarView();
    }

    public long getMaxDate()
    {
        return mMaxDate.getTimeInMillis();
    }

    public void setFirstDayOfWeek(int firstDayOfWeek)
    {
        if (firstDayOfWeek < Calendar.SUNDAY || firstDayOfWeek > Calendar.SATURDAY)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("firstDayOfWeek must be between 1 and 7");
        }

        mFirstDayOfWeek = firstDayOfWeek;
        if (mCalendarView != null) mCalendarView.setFirstDayOfWeek(firstDayOfWeek);
    }

    public int getFirstDayOfWeek()
    {
        return mFirstDayOfWeek;
    }

    public boolean getCalendarViewShown()
    {
        return mCalendarViewShown;
    }

    public CalendarView getCalendarView()
    {
        return ensureCalendarView();
    }

    public void setCalendarViewShown(boolean shown)
    {
        mCalendarViewShown = shown;
        updateVisibility();
    }

    public boolean getSpinnersShown()
    {
        return mSpinnersShown;
    }

    public void setSpinnersShown(boolean shown)
    {
        mSpinnersShown = shown;
        updateVisibility();
    }

    @Override
    public void setEnabled(boolean enabled)
    {
        if (isEnabled() == enabled) return;

        super.setEnabled(enabled);
        if (mDaySpinner != null) mDaySpinner.setEnabled(enabled);
        if (mMonthSpinner != null) mMonthSpinner.setEnabled(enabled);
        if (mYearSpinner != null) mYearSpinner.setEnabled(enabled);
        if (mCalendarView != null) mCalendarView.setEnabled(enabled);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isEnabled()
    {
        return super.isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onConfigurationChanged(Configuration newConfig)
    {
        super.onConfigurationChanged(newConfig);

        mShortMonths = new DateFormatSymbols(Locale.getDefault()).getShortMonths();
        updateSpinners();
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return DatePicker.class.getName();
    }

    @Override
    public void dispatchProvideAutofillStructure(ViewStructure structure, int flags)
    {
        structure.setAutofillId(getAutofillId());
        onProvideAutofillStructure(structure, flags);
    }

    @Override
    public void autofill(AutofillValue value)
    {
        if (!isEnabled() || value == null) return;

        if (!value.isDate())
        {
            android.util.Log.w("DatePicker", value + " could not be autofilled into " + this);
            return;
        }

        Calendar date = Calendar.getInstance();
        date.setTimeInMillis(value.getDateValue());
        updateDate(date.get(Calendar.YEAR), date.get(Calendar.MONTH), date.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH));
    }

    @Override
    public int getAutofillType()
    {
        return isEnabled() ? AUTOFILL_TYPE_DATE : AUTOFILL_TYPE_NONE;
    }

    @Override
    public AutofillValue getAutofillValue()
    {
        return isEnabled() ? AutofillValue.forDate(mCurrentDate.getTimeInMillis()) : null;
    }

    void setAutoFillChangeListener(OnDateChangedListener listener)
    {
        mAutoFillChangeListener = listener;
    }

    @Override
    protected void dispatchRestoreInstanceState(SparseArray<Parcelable> container)
    {
        dispatchThawSelfOnly(container);
    }

    @Override
    protected Parcelable onSaveInstanceState()
    {
        Parcelable superState = super.onSaveInstanceState();
        return new SavedState(superState, getYear(), getMonth(), getDayOfMonth(), getMinDate(), getMaxDate());
    }

    @Override
    protected void onRestoreInstanceState(Parcelable state)
    {
        if (!(state instanceof SavedState))
        {
            super.onRestoreInstanceState(state);
            return;
        }

        SavedState saved = (SavedState)state;
        super.onRestoreInstanceState(saved.getSuperState());

        mMinDate.setTimeInMillis(saved.mMinDate);
        mMaxDate.setTimeInMillis(saved.mMaxDate);
        if (mCalendarView != null)
        {
            mCalendarView.setMinDate(saved.mMinDate);
            mCalendarView.setMaxDate(saved.mMaxDate);
        }

        setDate(saved.mYear, saved.mMonth, saved.mDay);
        updateSpinners();
        updateCalendarView();
    }

    public interface OnDateChangedListener
    {
        void onDateChanged(DatePicker view, int year, int monthOfYear, int dayOfMonth);
    }

    private static class SavedState extends View.BaseSavedState
    {
        private final int mYear;
        private final int mMonth;
        private final int mDay;
        private final long mMinDate;
        private final long mMaxDate;

        SavedState(Parcelable superState, int year, int month, int day, long minDate, long maxDate)
        {
            super(superState == null ? android.view.AbsSavedState.EMPTY_STATE : superState);
            mYear = year;
            mMonth = month;
            mDay = day;
            mMinDate = minDate;
            mMaxDate = maxDate;
        }

        private SavedState(Parcel in)
        {
            super(in);
            mYear = in.readInt();
            mMonth = in.readInt();
            mDay = in.readInt();
            mMinDate = in.readLong();
            mMaxDate = in.readLong();
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
        {
            super.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
            dest.writeInt(mYear);
            dest.writeInt(mMonth);
            dest.writeInt(mDay);
            dest.writeLong(mMinDate);
            dest.writeLong(mMaxDate);
        }

        public static final Parcelable.Creator<SavedState> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<SavedState>()
        {
            public SavedState createFromParcel(Parcel in)
            {
                return new SavedState(in);
            }

            public SavedState[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new SavedState[size];
            }
        };
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/EdgeEffect.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Rect;

public class EdgeEffect
{
    public static final int TYPE_NONE = 0;
    public static final int TYPE_GLOW = 1;
    public static final int TYPE_STRETCH = 2;

    private static final int RECEDE_MILLIS = 600;
    private static final int PULL_MILLIS = 167;
    private static final float MAX_ALPHA = 0.15f;

    public static final android.graphics.BlendMode DEFAULT_BLEND_MODE = android.graphics.BlendMode.SRC_ATOP;

    private final Paint mPaint = new Paint();
    private android.graphics.BlendMode mBlendMode = DEFAULT_BLEND_MODE;
    private final Rect mBounds = new Rect();

    private float mDistance;
    private float mVelocity;
    private float mGlowAlpha;
    private long mStartTime;
    private boolean mFinished = true;
    private int mColor = 0xFF666666;

    public EdgeEffect(Context context)
    {
        mPaint.setAntiAlias(true);
    }

    public void setBlendMode(android.graphics.BlendMode blendMode)
    {
        mBlendMode = blendMode;
        mPaint.setBlendMode(blendMode);
    }

    public android.graphics.BlendMode getBlendMode()
    {
        return mBlendMode;
    }

    public EdgeEffect(Context context, android.util.AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context);
    }

    public void setSize(int width, int height)
    {
        mBounds.set(0, 0, width, height);
    }

    public boolean isFinished()
    {
        return mFinished;
    }

    public void finish()
    {
        mFinished = true;
        mGlowAlpha = 0.0f;
        mDistance = 0.0f;
        mVelocity = 0.0f;
    }

    public void onPull(float deltaDistance)
    {
        onPull(deltaDistance, 0.5f);
    }

    public void onPull(float deltaDistance, float displacement)
    {
        mFinished = false;
        mStartTime = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();

        mDistance = Math.max(0.0f, mDistance + deltaDistance);
        mGlowAlpha = Math.min(MAX_ALPHA, mGlowAlpha + Math.abs(deltaDistance) * 0.8f);
    }

    public float onPullDistance(float deltaDistance, float displacement)
    {
        onPull(deltaDistance, displacement);

        return deltaDistance;
    }

    public float getDistance()
    {
        return mDistance;
    }

    public void onRelease()
    {
        if (mFinished) return;

        mStartTime = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        mDistance = 0.0f;
    }

    public void onAbsorb(int velocity)
    {
        mFinished = false;
        mVelocity = velocity;
        mStartTime = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        mGlowAlpha = MAX_ALPHA;
    }

    public void setColor(int color)
    {
        mColor = color;
    }

    public int getColor()
    {
        return mColor;
    }

    public int getMaxHeight()
    {
        return mBounds.height();
    }

    public boolean draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        if (mFinished || canvas == null) return false;

        long elapsed = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() - mStartTime;

        if (elapsed >= RECEDE_MILLIS)
        {
            finish();
            return false;
        }

        float alpha = mGlowAlpha * (1.0f - (float)elapsed / RECEDE_MILLIS);

        if (alpha <= 0.0f)
        {
            finish();
            return false;
        }

        mPaint.setColor((Math.round(alpha * 255.0f) << 24) | (mColor & 0x00FFFFFF));
        canvas.drawRect(mBounds.left, mBounds.top, mBounds.right, mBounds.top + mBounds.height() * 0.1f, mPaint);

        return true;
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/ExpandableListConnector.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.database.DataSetObserver;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import java.util.ArrayList;

class ExpandableListConnector extends BaseAdapter implements Filterable
{
    private ExpandableListAdapter mExpandableListAdapter;
    private final ArrayList<Integer> mExpandedGroups = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ArrayList<Long> mExpandedIds = new ArrayList<>();
    private int[] mFlatGroups = new int[0];
    private int[] mFlatChildren = new int[0];
    private int[] mGroupFlatPositions = new int[0];
    private int mMaxExpandedGroupCount = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    private final DataSetObserver mDataSetObserver = new MyDataSetObserver();

    ExpandableListConnector(ExpandableListAdapter expandableListAdapter)
    {
        setExpandableListAdapter(expandableListAdapter);
    }

    void setExpandableListAdapter(ExpandableListAdapter expandableListAdapter)
    {
        if (mExpandableListAdapter != null) mExpandableListAdapter.unregisterDataSetObserver(mDataSetObserver);

        mExpandableListAdapter = expandableListAdapter;
        mExpandedGroups.clear();
        mExpandedIds.clear();

        if (expandableListAdapter != null) expandableListAdapter.registerDataSetObserver(mDataSetObserver);

        rebuild();
    }

    ExpandableListAdapter getAdapter()
    {
        return mExpandableListAdapter;
    }

    void setMaxExpGroupCount(int maxExpandedGroupCount)
    {
        mMaxExpandedGroupCount = maxExpandedGroupCount;
    }

    private void rebuild()
    {
        ExpandableListAdapter adapter = mExpandableListAdapter;
        int groupCount = adapter == null ? 0 : adapter.getGroupCount();

        int total = groupCount;
        for (int index = 0; index < mExpandedGroups.size(); index++)
        {
            int group = mExpandedGroups.get(index);
            if (group < groupCount) total += adapter.getChildrenCount(group);
        }

        int[] groups = new int[total];
        int[] children = new int[total];
        int[] groupPositions = new int[groupCount];
        int flat = 0;

        for (int group = 0; group < groupCount; group++)
        {
            groupPositions[group] = flat;
            groups[flat] = group;
            children[flat] = -1;
            flat++;

            if (!mExpandedGroups.contains(group)) continue;

            int childCount = adapter.getChildrenCount(group);
            for (int child = 0; child < childCount; child++)
            {
                groups[flat] = group;
                children[flat] = child;
                flat++;
            }
        }

        mFlatGroups = groups;
        mFlatChildren = children;
        mGroupFlatPositions = groupPositions;
    }

    private void refreshExpandedGroups()
    {
        ExpandableListAdapter adapter = mExpandableListAdapter;
        int groupCount = adapter == null ? 0 : adapter.getGroupCount();

        if (adapter != null && adapter.hasStableIds())
        {
            for (int index = mExpandedGroups.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
            {
                long id = mExpandedIds.get(index);
                int position = mExpandedGroups.get(index);

                if (position < groupCount && adapter.getGroupId(position) == id) continue;

                int found = -1;
                for (int group = 0; group < groupCount; group++)
                {
                    if (adapter.getGroupId(group) != id) continue;

                    found = group;
                    break;
                }

                if (found < 0)
                {
                    mExpandedGroups.remove(index);
                    mExpandedIds.remove(index);
                }
                else
                {
                    mExpandedGroups.set(index, found);
                }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            for (int index = mExpandedGroups.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
            {
                if (mExpandedGroups.get(index) < groupCount) continue;

                mExpandedGroups.remove(index);
                mExpandedIds.remove(index);
            }
        }

        rebuild();
    }

    boolean isGroupExpanded(int groupPosition)
    {
        return mExpandedGroups.contains(groupPosition);
    }

    boolean expandGroup(int groupPosition)
    {
        ExpandableListAdapter adapter = mExpandableListAdapter;
        if (adapter == null || groupPosition < 0 || groupPosition >= adapter.getGroupCount()) return false;
        if (mExpandedGroups.contains(groupPosition)) return false;

        if (mExpandedGroups.size() >= mMaxExpandedGroupCount && !mExpandedGroups.isEmpty())
        {
            int oldest = mExpandedGroups.get(0);
            collapseGroup(oldest);
        }

        mExpandedGroups.add(groupPosition);
        mExpandedIds.add(adapter.getGroupId(groupPosition));

        adapter.onGroupExpanded(groupPosition);
        rebuild();
        notifyDataSetChanged();
        return true;
    }

    boolean collapseGroup(int groupPosition)
    {
        int index = mExpandedGroups.indexOf(groupPosition);
        if (index < 0) return false;

        mExpandedGroups.remove(index);
        mExpandedIds.remove(index);

        if (mExpandableListAdapter != null) mExpandableListAdapter.onGroupCollapsed(groupPosition);
        rebuild();
        notifyDataSetChanged();
        return true;
    }

    int[] getExpandedGroups()
    {
        int[] result = new int[mExpandedGroups.size()];
        for (int index = 0; index < result.length; index++) result[index] = mExpandedGroups.get(index);
        return result;
    }

    long[] getExpandedGroupIds()
    {
        long[] result = new long[mExpandedIds.size()];
        for (int index = 0; index < result.length; index++) result[index] = mExpandedIds.get(index);
        return result;
    }

    void setExpandedGroups(int[] groups, long[] ids)
    {
        mExpandedGroups.clear();
        mExpandedIds.clear();

        if (groups != null && mExpandableListAdapter != null)
        {
            int groupCount = mExpandableListAdapter.getGroupCount();
            for (int index = 0; index < groups.length; index++)
            {
                if (groups[index] < 0 || groups[index] >= groupCount) continue;

                mExpandedGroups.add(groups[index]);
                mExpandedIds.add(ids != null && index < ids.length ? ids[index] : mExpandableListAdapter.getGroupId(groups[index]));
            }
        }

        refreshExpandedGroups();
        notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    int groupAt(int flatPosition)
    {
        return flatPosition < 0 || flatPosition >= mFlatGroups.length ? -1 : mFlatGroups[flatPosition];
    }

    int childAt(int flatPosition)
    {
        return flatPosition < 0 || flatPosition >= mFlatChildren.length ? -1 : mFlatChildren[flatPosition];
    }

    int flatPositionOfGroup(int groupPosition)
    {
        return groupPosition < 0 || groupPosition >= mGroupFlatPositions.length ? -1 : mGroupFlatPositions[groupPosition];
    }

    int flatPositionOfChild(int groupPosition, int childPosition)
    {
        if (!isGroupExpanded(groupPosition)) return -1;

        int base = flatPositionOfGroup(groupPosition);
        if (base < 0 || childPosition < 0 || childPosition >= mExpandableListAdapter.getChildrenCount(groupPosition)) return -1;

        return base + 1 + childPosition;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean areAllItemsEnabled()
    {
        return mExpandableListAdapter == null || mExpandableListAdapter.areAllItemsEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isEnabled(int flatPosition)
    {
        int child = childAt(flatPosition);
        if (child < 0) return true;

        return mExpandableListAdapter.isChildSelectable(groupAt(flatPosition), child);
    }

    @Override
    public int getCount()
    {
        return mFlatGroups.length;
    }

    @Override
    public Object getItem(int flatPosition)
    {
        int group = groupAt(flatPosition);
        if (group < 0) return null;

        int child = childAt(flatPosition);
        return child < 0 ? mExpandableListAdapter.getGroup(group) : mExpandableListAdapter.getChild(group, child);
    }

    @Override
    public long getItemId(int flatPosition)
    {
        int group = groupAt(flatPosition);
        if (group < 0) return 0;

        long groupId = mExpandableListAdapter.getGroupId(group);
        int child = childAt(flatPosition);
        if (child < 0) return mExpandableListAdapter.getCombinedGroupId(groupId);

        return mExpandableListAdapter.getCombinedChildId(groupId, mExpandableListAdapter.getChildId(group, child));
    }

    @Override
    public View getView(int flatPosition, View convertView, ViewGroup parent)
    {
        int group = groupAt(flatPosition);
        if (group < 0) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("flat list position " + flatPosition + " is out of range");

        int child = childAt(flatPosition);
        if (child < 0) return mExpandableListAdapter.getGroupView(group, isGroupExpanded(group), convertView, parent);

        boolean isLastChild = child == mExpandableListAdapter.getChildrenCount(group) - 1;
        return mExpandableListAdapter.getChildView(group, child, isLastChild, convertView, parent);
    }

    @Override
    public int getItemViewType(int flatPosition)
    {
        int group = groupAt(flatPosition);
        int child = childAt(flatPosition);

        if (mExpandableListAdapter instanceof HeterogeneousExpandableList)
        {
            HeterogeneousExpandableList list = (HeterogeneousExpandableList)mExpandableListAdapter;
            if (child < 0) return list.getGroupType(group);

            return list.getChildType(group, child) + list.getGroupTypeCount();
        }

        return child < 0 ? 0 : 1;
    }

    @Override
    public int getViewTypeCount()
    {
        if (mExpandableListAdapter instanceof HeterogeneousExpandableList)
        {
            HeterogeneousExpandableList list = (HeterogeneousExpandableList)mExpandableListAdapter;
            return list.getGroupTypeCount() + list.getChildTypeCount();
        }

        return 2;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasStableIds()
    {
        return mExpandableListAdapter != null && mExpandableListAdapter.hasStableIds();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isEmpty()
    {
        return mExpandableListAdapter == null || mExpandableListAdapter.isEmpty();
    }

    @Override
    public Filter getFilter()
    {
        ExpandableListAdapter adapter = mExpandableListAdapter;
        return adapter instanceof Filterable ? ((Filterable)adapter).getFilter() : null;
    }

    private class MyDataSetObserver extends DataSetObserver
    {
        @Override
        public void onChanged()
        {
            refreshExpandedGroups();
            notifyDataSetChanged();
        }

        @Override
        public void onInvalidated()
        {
            refreshExpandedGroups();
            notifyDataSetInvalidated();
        }
    }
}

```

`java/android/widget/ExpandableListView.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
```
