package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.InputDevice;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.VelocityTracker;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewConfiguration;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.ViewParent;

public class HorizontalScrollView extends FrameLayout
{
    private static final float MAX_SCROLL_FACTOR = 0.5f;

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private boolean mFillViewport;
    private boolean mSmoothScrollingEnabled = true;

    private OverScroller mScroller;
    private EdgeEffect mEdgeGlowLeft;
    private EdgeEffect mEdgeGlowRight;
    private VelocityTracker mVelocityTracker;

    private boolean mDragging;
    private float mLastMotionX;
    private int mTouchSlop;
    private int mMinimumVelocity;
    private int mMaximumVelocity;
    private float mHorizontalScrollFactor;
    private int mSavedScrollPosition = -1;

    public HorizontalScrollView(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public HorizontalScrollView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, ProgressBar.attributeIdentifier(context, "horizontalScrollViewStyle"));
    }

    public HorizontalScrollView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public HorizontalScrollView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        mScroller = new OverScroller(context);
        mEdgeGlowLeft = new EdgeEffect(context);
        mEdgeGlowRight = new EdgeEffect(context);

        ViewConfiguration configuration = ViewConfiguration.get(context);

        mTouchSlop = configuration.getScaledTouchSlop();
        mMinimumVelocity = configuration.getScaledMinimumFlingVelocity();
        mMaximumVelocity = configuration.getScaledMaximumFlingVelocity();
        mHorizontalScrollFactor = configuration.getScaledHorizontalScrollFactor();

        setFocusable(true);
        setWillNotDraw(false);

        if (attributes == null) return;

        if (sStyleable == null) sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "fillViewport");
        if (sStyleable.isEmpty()) return;

        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
        mFillViewport = array.getBoolean(0, false);
        array.recycle();
    }

    @Override
    protected float getLeftFadingEdgeStrength()
    {
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return 0f;

        int length = getHorizontalFadingEdgeLength();
        if (length <= 0) return 0f;

        return getScrollX() < length ? getScrollX() / (float)length : 1f;
    }

    @Override
    protected float getRightFadingEdgeStrength()
    {
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return 0f;

        int length = getHorizontalFadingEdgeLength();
        if (length <= 0) return 0f;

        int span = getChildAt(0).getRight() - getScrollX() - (getWidth() - getPaddingRight());
        return span < length ? span / (float)length : 1f;
    }

    public void setEdgeEffectColor(int color)
    {
        setLeftEdgeEffectColor(color);
        setRightEdgeEffectColor(color);
    }

    public void setRightEdgeEffectColor(int color)
    {
        mEdgeGlowRight.setColor(color);
    }

    public void setLeftEdgeEffectColor(int color)
    {
        mEdgeGlowLeft.setColor(color);
    }

    public int getLeftEdgeEffectColor()
    {
        return mEdgeGlowLeft.getColor();
    }

    public int getRightEdgeEffectColor()
    {
        return mEdgeGlowRight.getColor();
    }

    public int getMaxScrollAmount()
    {
        return (int)(MAX_SCROLL_FACTOR * (getRight() - getLeft()));
    }

    private void ensureSingleChild()
    {
        if (getChildCount() > 0) throw new IllegalStateException("HorizontalScrollView can host only one direct child");
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child)
    {
        ensureSingleChild();
        super.addView(child);
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child, int index)
    {
        ensureSingleChild();
        super.addView(child, index);
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child, ViewGroup.LayoutParams params)
    {
        ensureSingleChild();
        super.addView(child, params);
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child, int index, ViewGroup.LayoutParams params)
    {
        ensureSingleChild();
        super.addView(child, index, params);
    }

    private int getScrollRange()
    {
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return 0;

        View child = getChildAt(0);
        int available = getWidth() - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight();

        return Math.max(0, child.getWidth() - available);
    }

    public boolean isFillViewport()
    {
        return mFillViewport;
    }

    public void setFillViewport(boolean fillViewport)
    {
        if (mFillViewport == fillViewport) return;

        mFillViewport = fillViewport;
        requestLayout();
    }

    public boolean isSmoothScrollingEnabled()
    {
        return mSmoothScrollingEnabled;
    }

    public void setSmoothScrollingEnabled(boolean smoothScrollingEnabled)
    {
        mSmoothScrollingEnabled = smoothScrollingEnabled;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        super.onMeasure(widthMeasureSpec, heightMeasureSpec);

        if (!mFillViewport) return;
        if (MeasureSpec.getMode(widthMeasureSpec) == MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED) return;
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return;

        View child = getChildAt(0);
        int width = getMeasuredWidth() - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight();

        ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = child.getLayoutParams();
        int horizontalMargins = 0;
        int verticalMargins = 0;

        if (params instanceof MarginLayoutParams)
        {
            MarginLayoutParams margins = (MarginLayoutParams)params;
            horizontalMargins = margins.leftMargin + margins.rightMargin;
            verticalMargins = margins.topMargin + margins.bottomMargin;
        }

        width -= horizontalMargins;
        if (child.getMeasuredWidth() >= width) return;

        int childWidthSpec = MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(width, MeasureSpec.EXACTLY);
        int childHeightSpec = getChildMeasureSpec(heightMeasureSpec, getPaddingTop() + getPaddingBottom() + verticalMargins,
                                                  params == null ? LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT : params.height);

        child.measure(childWidthSpec, childHeightSpec);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event)
    {
        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event) || executeKeyEvent(event);
    }

    public boolean executeKeyEvent(KeyEvent event)
    {
        if (event.getAction() != KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) return false;
        if (getScrollRange() == 0) return false;

        int keyCode = event.getKeyCode();

        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_LEFT) return event.isAltPressed() ? fullScroll(FOCUS_LEFT) : arrowScroll(FOCUS_LEFT);
        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_RIGHT) return event.isAltPressed() ? fullScroll(FOCUS_RIGHT) : arrowScroll(FOCUS_RIGHT);
        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SPACE) return pageScroll(event.isShiftPressed() ? FOCUS_LEFT : FOCUS_RIGHT);
        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MOVE_HOME) return fullScroll(FOCUS_LEFT);
        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MOVE_END) return fullScroll(FOCUS_RIGHT);

        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public void requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(boolean disallowIntercept)
    {
        if (disallowIntercept) recycleVelocityTracker();

        super.requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(disallowIntercept);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onInterceptTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        int action = event.getActionMasked();

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE && mDragging) return true;

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN)
        {
            mLastMotionX = event.getX();
            mDragging = !mScroller.isFinished();

            return mDragging;
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE)
        {
            if (Math.abs(event.getX() - mLastMotionX) > mTouchSlop)
            {
                mDragging = true;
                mLastMotionX = event.getX();

                ViewParent parent = getParent();
                if (parent != null) parent.requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);

                return true;
            }
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP || action == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL)
        {
            mDragging = false;

            springBack();
        }

        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (mVelocityTracker == null) mVelocityTracker = VelocityTracker.obtain();
        mVelocityTracker.addMovement(event);

        int action = event.getActionMasked();

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN)
        {
            if (getChildCount() == 0) return false;

            mLastMotionX = event.getX();

            if (!mScroller.isFinished()) mScroller.abortAnimation();

            return true;
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE)
        {
            float x = event.getX();
            int delta = (int)(mLastMotionX - x);

            if (!mDragging && Math.abs(delta) > mTouchSlop)
            {
                mDragging = true;
                delta = delta > 0 ? delta - mTouchSlop : delta + mTouchSlop;

                ViewParent parent = getParent();
                if (parent != null) parent.requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);
            }

            if (!mDragging) return true;

            mLastMotionX = x;

            int range = getScrollRange();
            int requested = getScrollX() + delta;
            int target = Math.max(0, Math.min(range, requested));

            int overScrollMode = getOverScrollMode();
            boolean canOverScroll = overScrollMode == OVER_SCROLL_ALWAYS || (overScrollMode == OVER_SCROLL_IF_CONTENT_SCROLLS && range > 0);

            if (canOverScroll && getWidth() > 0)
            {
                float vertical = 1f - event.getY() / Math.max(1, getHeight());

                if (requested < 0)
                {
                    mEdgeGlowLeft.onPull((float)(requested) / getWidth(), vertical);
                    if (!mEdgeGlowRight.isFinished()) mEdgeGlowRight.onRelease();
                }
                else if (requested > range)
                {
                    mEdgeGlowRight.onPull((float)(requested - range) / getWidth(), 1f - vertical);
                    if (!mEdgeGlowLeft.isFinished()) mEdgeGlowLeft.onRelease();
                }

                if (!mEdgeGlowLeft.isFinished() || !mEdgeGlowRight.isFinished()) invalidate();
            }

            if (target != getScrollX()) scrollTo(target, getScrollY());

            return true;
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP)
        {
            if (mDragging)
            {
                mVelocityTracker.computeCurrentVelocity(1000, mMaximumVelocity);

                int velocity = (int)mVelocityTracker.getXVelocity();

                if (Math.abs(velocity) > mMinimumVelocity) fling(-velocity);
                else springBack();
            }

            endDrag();
            return true;
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL)
        {
            if (mDragging) springBack();

            endDrag();
            return true;
        }

        return super.onTouchEvent(event);
    }

    private void springBack()
    {
        mScroller.springBack(getScrollX(), getScrollY(), 0, getScrollRange(), 0, 0);

        if (!mScroller.isFinished()) invalidate();
    }

    private void endDrag()
    {
        mDragging = false;

        recycleVelocityTracker();

        mEdgeGlowLeft.onRelease();
        mEdgeGlowRight.onRelease();
    }

    private void recycleVelocityTracker()
    {
        if (mVelocityTracker == null) return;

        mVelocityTracker.recycle();
        mVelocityTracker = null;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onGenericMotionEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (event.getActionMasked() == MotionEvent.ACTION_SCROLL && event.isFromSource(InputDevice.SOURCE_CLASS_POINTER))
        {
            float axis = event.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_HSCROLL);
            if (axis == 0) axis = -event.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_VSCROLL);

            if (axis != 0)
            {
                int delta = Math.round(axis * mHorizontalScrollFactor);
                int range = getScrollRange();
                int target = Math.max(0, Math.min(range, getScrollX() + delta));

                if (target != getScrollX())
                {
                    super.scrollTo(target, getScrollY());
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return super.onGenericMotionEvent(event);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean shouldDelayChildPressedState()
    {
        return true;
    }

    protected void onOverScrolled(int scrollX, int scrollY, boolean clampedX, boolean clampedY)
    {
        if (!mScroller.isFinished())
        {
            super.scrollTo(scrollX, scrollY);

            if (clampedX) mScroller.springBack(getScrollX(), getScrollY(), 0, getScrollRange(), 0, 0);
            return;
        }

        super.scrollTo(scrollX, scrollY);
    }

    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return HorizontalScrollView.class.getName();
    }

    public boolean pageScroll(int direction)
    {
        int width = getWidth();
        int current = getScrollX();
        int target = direction == FOCUS_RIGHT ? current + width : current - width;

        target = Math.max(0, Math.min(getScrollRange(), target));
        if (target == current) return false;

        smoothScrollTo(target, getScrollY());
        return true;
    }

    public boolean fullScroll(int direction)
    {
        int current = getScrollX();
        int target = direction == FOCUS_RIGHT ? getScrollRange() : 0;
        if (target == current) return false;

        smoothScrollTo(target, getScrollY());
        return true;
    }

    public boolean arrowScroll(int direction)
    {
        int amount = getMaxScrollAmount();
        int current = getScrollX();
        int target = direction == FOCUS_RIGHT ? current + amount : current - amount;

        target = Math.max(0, Math.min(getScrollRange(), target));
        if (target == current) return false;

        if (mSmoothScrollingEnabled) smoothScrollBy(target - current, 0);
        else scrollTo(target, getScrollY());

        return true;
    }

    public final void smoothScrollBy(int dx, int dy)
    {
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return;

        int target = Math.max(0, Math.min(getScrollRange(), getScrollX() + dx));

        if (!mSmoothScrollingEnabled)
        {
            if (!mScroller.isFinished()) mScroller.abortAnimation();

            scrollTo(target, getScrollY());
            return;
        }

        mScroller.startScroll(getScrollX(), getScrollY(), target - getScrollX(), 0);
        invalidate();
    }

    public final void smoothScrollTo(int x, int y)
    {
        smoothScrollBy(x - getScrollX(), y - getScrollY());
    }

    @Override
    protected int computeHorizontalScrollRange()
    {
        int contentWidth = getWidth() - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight();
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return contentWidth;

        int scrollRange = getChildAt(0).getRight();
        int scrollX = getScrollX();
        int overscrollRight = Math.max(0, scrollRange - contentWidth);

        if (scrollX < 0) scrollRange -= scrollX;
        else if (scrollX > overscrollRight) scrollRange += scrollX - overscrollRight;

        return scrollRange;
    }

    @Override
    protected int computeHorizontalScrollOffset()
    {
        return Math.max(0, getScrollX());
    }

    @Override
    protected void measureChild(View child, int parentWidthMeasureSpec, int parentHeightMeasureSpec)
    {
        ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = child.getLayoutParams();
        if (params == null) params = generateDefaultLayoutParams();

        int childHeightSpec = getChildMeasureSpec(parentHeightMeasureSpec, getPaddingTop() + getPaddingBottom(), params.height);
        int childWidthSpec = MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(
            Math.max(0, MeasureSpec.getSize(parentWidthMeasureSpec) - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight()), MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED);

        child.measure(childWidthSpec, childHeightSpec);
    }

    @Override
    protected void measureChildWithMargins(View child, int parentWidthMeasureSpec, int widthUsed, int parentHeightMeasureSpec,
                                           int heightUsed)
    {
        ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = child.getLayoutParams();
        if (params == null) params = generateDefaultLayoutParams();

        int horizontalMargins = 0;
        int verticalMargins = 0;

        if (params instanceof MarginLayoutParams)
        {
            MarginLayoutParams margins = (MarginLayoutParams)params;
            horizontalMargins = margins.leftMargin + margins.rightMargin;
            verticalMargins = margins.topMargin + margins.bottomMargin;
        }

        int verticalUsed = getPaddingTop() + getPaddingBottom() + verticalMargins + heightUsed;
        int childHeightSpec = getChildMeasureSpec(parentHeightMeasureSpec, verticalUsed, params.height);
        int usedTotal = getPaddingLeft() + getPaddingRight() + horizontalMargins + widthUsed;
        int childWidthSpec = MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(Math.max(0, MeasureSpec.getSize(parentWidthMeasureSpec) - usedTotal),
                                                         MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED);

        child.measure(childWidthSpec, childHeightSpec);
    }

    @Override
    public void computeScroll()
    {
        if (mScroller == null || !mScroller.computeScrollOffset()) return;

        int range = getScrollRange();
        int x = mScroller.getCurrX();
        int clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(range, x));

        if (x != clamped && !mScroller.isFinished())
        {
            if (x < 0 && mEdgeGlowLeft.isFinished()) mEdgeGlowLeft.onAbsorb((int)mScroller.getCurrVelocity());
            else if (x > range && mEdgeGlowRight.isFinished()) mEdgeGlowRight.onAbsorb((int)mScroller.getCurrVelocity());
        }

        if (clamped != getScrollX()) onOverScrolled(clamped, getScrollY(), x != clamped, false);

        invalidate();
    }

    protected int computeScrollDeltaToGetChildRectOnScreen(Rect rect)
    {
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return 0;

        int width = getWidth();
        int screenLeft = getScrollX();
        int screenRight = screenLeft + width;
        int fadingEdge = getHorizontalFadingEdgeLength();
        View child = getChildAt(0);

        if (rect.left > 0) screenLeft += fadingEdge;
        if (rect.right < child.getWidth()) screenRight -= fadingEdge;

        int delta = 0;

        if (rect.right > screenRight && rect.left > screenLeft)
        {
            if (rect.width() > width) delta += rect.left - screenLeft;
            else delta += rect.right - screenRight;

            delta = Math.min(delta, child.getRight() - screenRight);
        }
        else if (rect.left < screenLeft && rect.right < screenRight)
        {
            if (rect.width() > width) delta -= screenRight - rect.right;
            else delta -= screenLeft - rect.left;

            delta = Math.max(delta, -getScrollX());
        }

        return delta;
    }

    private boolean scrollToChildRect(Rect rect, boolean immediate)
    {
        int delta = computeScrollDeltaToGetChildRectOnScreen(rect);
        if (delta == 0) return false;

        if (immediate) scrollBy(delta, 0);
        else smoothScrollBy(delta, 0);

        return true;
    }

    private void rectInMyCoordinates(View descendant, Rect rect)
    {
        View current = descendant;

        while (current != null && current != this)
        {
            rect.offset(current.getLeft() - current.getScrollX(), current.getTop() - current.getScrollY());

            ViewParent parent = current.getParent();
            current = parent instanceof View ? (View)parent : null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void requestChildFocus(View child, View focused)
    {
        if (focused != null && !isInLayout())
        {
            Rect rect = new Rect(0, 0, focused.getWidth(), focused.getHeight());
            rectInMyCoordinates(focused, rect);
            rect.offset(getScrollX(), getScrollY());
            scrollToChildRect(rect, false);
        }

        super.requestChildFocus(child, focused);
    }

    protected boolean onRequestFocusInDescendants(int direction, Rect previouslyFocusedRect)
    {
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return false;

        return getChildAt(0).requestFocus(direction, previouslyFocusedRect);
    }

    public boolean requestChildRectangleOnScreen(View child, Rect rectangle, boolean immediate)
    {
        rectangle.offset(child.getLeft() - child.getScrollX(), child.getTop() - child.getScrollY());

        return scrollToChildRect(rectangle, immediate);
    }

    @Override
    public void requestLayout()
    {
        super.requestLayout();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onLayout(boolean changed, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        super.onLayout(changed, left, top, right, bottom);

        if (mSavedScrollPosition >= 0)
        {
            int position = mSavedScrollPosition;
            mSavedScrollPosition = -1;
            super.scrollTo(Math.max(0, Math.min(getScrollRange(), position)), getScrollY());
            return;
        }

        int clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(getScrollRange(), getScrollX()));
        if (clamped != getScrollX()) super.scrollTo(clamped, getScrollY());
    }

    @Override
    protected void onSizeChanged(int width, int height, int oldWidth, int oldHeight)
    {
        super.onSizeChanged(width, height, oldWidth, oldHeight);

        int clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(getScrollRange(), getScrollX()));
        if (clamped != getScrollX()) super.scrollTo(clamped, getScrollY());
    }

    public void fling(int velocityX)
    {
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return;

        int width = getWidth() - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight();
        int right = getChildAt(0).getWidth();

        mScroller.fling(getScrollX(), getScrollY(), velocityX, 0, 0, Math.max(0, right - width), 0, 0, width / 2, 0);
        invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    public void scrollTo(int x, int y)
    {
        if (getChildCount() > 0)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(0);
            x = clamp(x, getWidth() - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight(), child.getWidth());
            y = clamp(y, getHeight() - getPaddingTop() - getPaddingBottom(), child.getHeight());
        }

        if (x != getScrollX() || y != getScrollY()) super.scrollTo(x, y);
    }

    private static int clamp(int position, int viewport, int content)
    {
        if (viewport >= content || position < 0) return 0;
        if (viewport + position > content) return content - viewport;

        return position;
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        super.draw(canvas);

        if (!mEdgeGlowLeft.isFinished())
        {
            int saveCount = canvas.save();
            int height = getHeight() - getPaddingTop() - getPaddingBottom();

            canvas.rotate(270);
            canvas.translate(-height - getPaddingTop(), 0);
            mEdgeGlowLeft.setSize(height, getWidth());
            if (mEdgeGlowLeft.draw(canvas)) invalidate();
            canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
        }

        if (!mEdgeGlowRight.isFinished())
        {
            int saveCount = canvas.save();
            int width = getWidth();
            int height = getHeight() - getPaddingTop() - getPaddingBottom();

            canvas.rotate(90);
            canvas.translate(getPaddingTop(), -width);
            mEdgeGlowRight.setSize(height, width);
            if (mEdgeGlowRight.draw(canvas)) invalidate();
            canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onRestoreInstanceState(Parcelable state)
    {
        if (!(state instanceof SavedState))
        {
            super.onRestoreInstanceState(state);
            return;
        }

        SavedState saved = (SavedState)state;
        super.onRestoreInstanceState(saved.getSuperState());

        mSavedScrollPosition = saved.mScrollPosition;
        requestLayout();
    }

    @Override
    protected Parcelable onSaveInstanceState()
    {
        SavedState state = new SavedState(super.onSaveInstanceState());
        state.mScrollPosition = getScrollX();
        return state;
    }

    static class SavedState extends BaseSavedState
    {
        public static final Parcelable.Creator<SavedState> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<SavedState>()
        {
            @Override
            public SavedState createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                return new SavedState(source);
            }

            @Override
            public SavedState[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new SavedState[size];
            }
        };

        int mScrollPosition;

        SavedState(Parcelable superState)
        {
            super(superState);
        }

        private SavedState(Parcel source)
        {
            super(source);
            mScrollPosition = source.readInt();
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
        {
            super.writeToParcel(out, flags);
            out.writeInt(mScrollPosition);
        }
    }
}

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.BlendMode;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.ColorFilter;
import android.graphics.Matrix;
import android.graphics.PixelFormat;
import android.graphics.PorterDuff;
import android.graphics.PorterDuffColorFilter;
import android.graphics.RectF;
import android.graphics.drawable.BitmapDrawable;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.graphics.drawable.Icon;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;

public class ImageView extends View
{
    public enum ScaleType
    {
        MATRIX,
        FIT_XY,
        FIT_START,
        FIT_CENTER,
        FIT_END,
        CENTER,
        CENTER_CROP,
        CENTER_INSIDE
    }

    private static final ScaleType[] SCALE_TYPES = ScaleType.values();

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private Drawable mDrawable;
    private int mResource;
    private Uri mUri;
    private int mDrawableWidth = -1;
    private int mDrawableHeight = -1;
    private ScaleType mScaleType = ScaleType.FIT_CENTER;
    private boolean mAdjustViewBounds;
    private int mMaxWidth = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    private int mMaxHeight = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    private final Matrix mMatrix = new Matrix();
    private Matrix mDrawMatrix;
    private final RectF mTempSource = new RectF();
    private final RectF mTempDestination = new RectF();
    private boolean mHaveFrame;
    private boolean mCropToPadding;
    private int mBaseline = -1;
    private boolean mBaselineAlignBottom;
    private int mLevel;
    private int[] mState;
    private boolean mMergeState;
    private ColorFilter mColorFilter;
    private boolean mHasColorFilter;
    private int mAlpha = 255;
    private boolean mHasAlpha;
    private ColorStateList mDrawableTintList;
    private boolean mHasDrawableTint;
    private BlendMode mDrawableBlendMode;
    private PorterDuff.Mode mDrawableTintMode;
    private boolean mHasDrawableBlendMode;

    public ImageView(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public ImageView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, 0);
    }

    public ImageView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public ImageView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        if (attributes == null && defStyleAttr == 0 && defStyleRes == 0) return;

        if (sStyleable == null)
        {
            sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "src", "scaleType", "adjustViewBounds", "maxWidth", "maxHeight", "baseline",
                                         "baselineAlignBottom", "cropToPadding", "tint", "tintMode", "drawableAlpha");
        }

        if (!sStyleable.isEmpty()) readAttributes(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        if (mDrawable == null && attributes != null) readCompatSource(context, attributes);
    }

    private void readAttributes(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        int sourceIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("src");
        if (sourceIndex >= 0)
        {
            int resource = array.getResourceId(sourceIndex, 0);
            if (resource != 0) setImageDrawable(resolveDrawable(resource));
        }

        int index = sStyleable.indexOf("baselineAlignBottom");
        if (index >= 0) mBaselineAlignBottom = array.getBoolean(index, false);

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("baseline");
        if (index >= 0) mBaseline = array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, -1);

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("adjustViewBounds");
        if (index >= 0) setAdjustViewBounds(array.getBoolean(index, false));

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("maxWidth");
        if (index >= 0) setMaxWidth(array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, Integer.MAX_VALUE));

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("maxHeight");
        if (index >= 0) setMaxHeight(array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, Integer.MAX_VALUE));

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("scaleType");
        if (index >= 0)
        {
            int scaleType = array.getInt(index, -1);
            if (scaleType >= 0 && scaleType < SCALE_TYPES.length) setScaleType(SCALE_TYPES[scaleType]);
        }

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("tint");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index))
        {
            mDrawableTintList = array.getColorStateList(index);
            mHasDrawableTint = true;
            mDrawableTintMode = PorterDuff.Mode.SRC_ATOP;
            mHasDrawableBlendMode = true;
        }

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("tintMode");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index))
        {
            PorterDuff.Mode mode = parseTintMode(array.getInt(index, -1));
            if (mode != null)
            {
                mDrawableTintMode = mode;
                mHasDrawableBlendMode = true;
            }
        }

        applyImageTint();

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("drawableAlpha");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) setImageAlpha(array.getInt(index, 255));

        index = sStyleable.indexOf("cropToPadding");
        if (index >= 0) mCropToPadding = array.getBoolean(index, false);

        array.recycle();
    }

    private static PorterDuff.Mode parseTintMode(int value)
    {
        switch (value)
        {
            case 3:
                return PorterDuff.Mode.SRC_OVER;
            case 5:
                return PorterDuff.Mode.SRC_IN;
            case 9:
                return PorterDuff.Mode.SRC_ATOP;
            case 14:
                return PorterDuff.Mode.MULTIPLY;
            case 15:
                return PorterDuff.Mode.SCREEN;
            case 16:
                return PorterDuff.Mode.ADD;
            default:
                return null;
        }
    }

    private void readCompatSource(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        int attribute = context.getResources().getIdentifier("srcCompat", "attr", context.getPackageName());
        if (attribute == 0) return;

        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, new int[] {attribute}, 0, 0);
        int resource = array.getResourceId(0, 0);
        array.recycle();

        if (resource != 0) setImageDrawable(resolveDrawable(resource));
    }

    private Drawable resolveDrawable(int resourceId)
    {
        try
        {
            return getContext().getResources().getDrawable(resourceId, getContext().getTheme());
        }
        catch (Throwable missing)
        {
            android.util.Log.w("ImageView", "drawable 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId) + " did not load", missing);
            return null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean verifyDrawable(Drawable who)
    {
        return mDrawable == who || super.verifyDrawable(who);
    }

    @Override
    public void jumpDrawablesToCurrentState()
    {
        super.jumpDrawablesToCurrentState();

        if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.jumpToCurrentState();
    }

    @Override
    public void invalidateDrawable(Drawable who)
    {
        if (who != mDrawable)
        {
            super.invalidateDrawable(who);
            return;
        }

        if (who != null)
        {
            int width = who.getIntrinsicWidth();
            int height = who.getIntrinsicHeight();

            if (width != mDrawableWidth || height != mDrawableHeight)
            {
                mDrawableWidth = width;
                mDrawableHeight = height;
                configureBounds();
            }
        }

        invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasOverlappingRendering()
    {
        Drawable background = getBackground();
        return background != null && background.getCurrent() != null;
    }

    public boolean getAdjustViewBounds()
    {
        return mAdjustViewBounds;
    }

    public void setAdjustViewBounds(boolean adjustViewBounds)
    {
        mAdjustViewBounds = adjustViewBounds;
        if (adjustViewBounds) setScaleType(ScaleType.FIT_CENTER);
        requestLayout();
    }

    public int getMaxWidth()
    {
        return mMaxWidth;
    }

    public void setMaxWidth(int maxWidth)
    {
        mMaxWidth = maxWidth;
    }

    public int getMaxHeight()
    {
        return mMaxHeight;
    }

    public void setMaxHeight(int maxHeight)
    {
        mMaxHeight = maxHeight;
    }

    public Drawable getDrawable()
    {
        if (mDrawable == null && mResource != 0) resolveUri();

        return mDrawable;
    }

    public void setImageResource(int resId)
    {
        int oldWidth = mDrawableWidth;
        int oldHeight = mDrawableHeight;

        updateDrawable(null);
        mResource = resId;
        mUri = null;

        resolveUri();

        if (oldWidth != mDrawableWidth || oldHeight != mDrawableHeight) requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setImageURI(Uri uri)
    {
        if (mResource == 0 && (mUri == uri || (uri != null && uri.equals(mUri)))) return;

        updateDrawable(null);
        mResource = 0;
        mUri = uri;

        int oldWidth = mDrawableWidth;
        int oldHeight = mDrawableHeight;

        resolveUri();

        if (oldWidth != mDrawableWidth || oldHeight != mDrawableHeight) requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setImageDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        if (mDrawable == drawable) return;

        mResource = 0;
        mUri = null;

        int oldWidth = mDrawableWidth;
        int oldHeight = mDrawableHeight;

        updateDrawable(drawable);

        if (oldWidth != mDrawableWidth || oldHeight != mDrawableHeight) requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setImageIcon(Icon icon)
    {
        setImageDrawable(icon == null ? null : icon.loadDrawable(getContext()));
    }

    public void setImageTintList(ColorStateList tint)
    {
        mDrawableTintList = tint;
        mHasDrawableTint = true;
        applyImageTint();
    }

    public ColorStateList getImageTintList()
    {
        return mDrawableTintList;
    }

    public void setImageTintMode(PorterDuff.Mode tintMode)
    {
        mDrawableTintMode = tintMode;
        mDrawableBlendMode = null;
        mHasDrawableBlendMode = true;
        applyImageTint();
    }

    public void setImageTintBlendMode(BlendMode blendMode)
    {
        mDrawableBlendMode = blendMode;
        mDrawableTintMode = null;
        mHasDrawableBlendMode = true;
        applyImageTint();
    }

    public PorterDuff.Mode getImageTintMode()
    {
        return mDrawableTintMode;
    }

    public BlendMode getImageTintBlendMode()
    {
        return mDrawableBlendMode;
    }

    private void applyImageTint()
    {
        if (mDrawable == null || (!mHasDrawableTint && !mHasDrawableBlendMode)) return;

        replaceWithMutated();

        if (mHasDrawableTint) mDrawable.setTintList(mDrawableTintList);
        if (mHasDrawableBlendMode && mDrawableBlendMode != null) mDrawable.setTintBlendMode(mDrawableBlendMode);
        else if (mHasDrawableBlendMode) mDrawable.setTintMode(mDrawableTintMode);
        if (mDrawable.isStateful()) mDrawable.setState(getDrawableState());
    }

    private void replaceWithMutated()
    {
        Drawable mutated = mDrawable.mutate();
        if (mutated == mDrawable) return;

        mDrawable.setCallback(null);
        mDrawable = mutated;
        mutated.setCallback(this);
    }

    public void setImageBitmap(Bitmap bitmap)
    {
        setImageDrawable(bitmap == null ? null : new BitmapDrawable(getContext().getResources(), bitmap));
    }

    public void setImageState(int[] state, boolean merge)
    {
        mState = state;
        mMergeState = merge;

        if (mDrawable == null) return;

        refreshDrawableState();
        resizeFromDrawable();
    }

    @Override
    public void setSelected(boolean selected)
    {
        super.setSelected(selected);

        resizeFromDrawable();
    }

    public void setImageLevel(int level)
    {
        mLevel = level;

        if (mDrawable == null) return;

        mDrawable.setLevel(level);
        resizeFromDrawable();
    }

    public void setScaleType(ScaleType scaleType)
    {
        if (scaleType == null) throw new NullPointerException();
        if (mScaleType == scaleType) return;

        mScaleType = scaleType;
        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public ScaleType getScaleType()
    {
        return mScaleType;
    }

    public Matrix getImageMatrix()
    {
        if (mDrawMatrix == null) return new Matrix(Matrix.IDENTITY_MATRIX);

        return mDrawMatrix;
    }

    public void setImageMatrix(Matrix matrix)
    {
        if (matrix != null && matrix.isIdentity()) matrix = null;

        if ((matrix == null && !mMatrix.isIdentity()) || (matrix != null && !mMatrix.equals(matrix)))
        {
            if (matrix == null) mMatrix.reset();
            else mMatrix.set(matrix);

            configureBounds();
            invalidate();
        }
    }

    public boolean getCropToPadding()
    {
        return mCropToPadding;
    }

    public void setCropToPadding(boolean cropToPadding)
    {
        if (mCropToPadding == cropToPadding) return;

        mCropToPadding = cropToPadding;
        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    private void resolveUri()
    {
        if (mDrawable != null) return;
        if (getResources() == null) return;

        Drawable drawable = null;

        if (mResource != 0)
        {
            drawable = resolveDrawable(mResource);
            if (drawable == null) mUri = null;
        }
        else if (mUri != null)
        {
            drawable = drawableFromUri(mUri);
            if (drawable == null) mUri = null;
        }
        else
        {
            return;
        }

        updateDrawable(drawable);
    }

    private Drawable drawableFromUri(Uri uri)
    {
        String scheme = uri.getScheme();

        try
        {
            if (android.content.ContentResolver.SCHEME_ANDROID_RESOURCE.equals(scheme))
            {
                int identifier = resourceIdentifier(uri);
                return identifier == 0 ? null : resolveDrawable(identifier);
            }

            if (android.content.ContentResolver.SCHEME_CONTENT.equals(scheme)
                || android.content.ContentResolver.SCHEME_FILE.equals(scheme))
            {
                try (java.io.InputStream stream = getContext().getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri))
                {
                    return Drawable.createFromStream(stream, null);
                }
            }

            return Drawable.createFromPath(uri.toString());
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            android.util.Log.w("ImageView", "unable to open content: " + uri, failure);
            return null;
        }
    }

    private int resourceIdentifier(Uri uri)
    {
        java.util.List<String> segments = uri.getPathSegments();
        String authority = uri.getAuthority();
        if (segments == null || segments.isEmpty()) return 0;

        if (segments.size() == 1)
        {
            try
            {
                return Integer.parseInt(segments.get(0));
            }
            catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
            {
                return 0;
            }
        }

        return getResources().getIdentifier(segments.get(1), segments.get(0), authority);
    }

    @Override
    public int[] onCreateDrawableState(int extraSpace)
    {
        if (mState == null) return super.onCreateDrawableState(extraSpace);
        if (!mMergeState) return mState;

        return mergeDrawableStates(super.onCreateDrawableState(extraSpace + mState.length), mState);
    }

    private void updateDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        boolean sameDrawable = false;

        if (mDrawable != null)
        {
            sameDrawable = mDrawable == drawable;
            mDrawable.setCallback(null);
            unscheduleDrawable(mDrawable);
            if (!sameDrawable && isAttachedToWindow()) mDrawable.setVisible(false, false);
        }

        mDrawable = drawable;

        if (drawable == null)
        {
            mDrawableWidth = -1;
            mDrawableHeight = -1;
            return;
        }

        drawable.setCallback(this);
        drawable.setLayoutDirection(getLayoutDirection());
        if (drawable.isStateful()) drawable.setState(getDrawableState());

        if (!sameDrawable)
        {
            boolean visible = isAttachedToWindow() && getWindowVisibility() == VISIBLE && isShown();
            drawable.setVisible(visible, true);
        }

        drawable.setLevel(mLevel);
        mDrawableWidth = drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
        mDrawableHeight = drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();

        applyImageTint();
        applyColorFilter();
        applyAlpha();

        configureBounds();
    }

    private void resizeFromDrawable()
    {
        Drawable drawable = mDrawable;
        if (drawable == null) return;

        int width = drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
        if (width < 0) width = mDrawableWidth;
        int height = drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();
        if (height < 0) height = mDrawableHeight;

        if (width == mDrawableWidth && height == mDrawableHeight) return;

        mDrawableWidth = width;
        mDrawableHeight = height;
        configureBounds();
        requestLayout();
    }

    @Override
    public void onRtlPropertiesChanged(int layoutDirection)
    {
        super.onRtlPropertiesChanged(layoutDirection);

        if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.setLayoutDirection(layoutDirection);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        resolveUri();

        int width;
        int height;
        float desiredAspect = 0.0f;
        boolean resizeWidth = false;
        boolean resizeHeight = false;

        int widthMode = MeasureSpec.getMode(widthMeasureSpec);
        int heightMode = MeasureSpec.getMode(heightMeasureSpec);

        if (mDrawable == null)
        {
            mDrawableWidth = -1;
            mDrawableHeight = -1;
            width = 0;
            height = 0;
        }
        else
        {
            width = Math.max(mDrawableWidth, 1);
            height = Math.max(mDrawableHeight, 1);

            if (mAdjustViewBounds)
            {
                resizeWidth = widthMode != MeasureSpec.EXACTLY;
                resizeHeight = heightMode != MeasureSpec.EXACTLY;
                desiredAspect = (float)width / (float)height;
            }
        }

        int paddingLeft = getPaddingLeft();
        int paddingRight = getPaddingRight();
        int paddingTop = getPaddingTop();
        int paddingBottom = getPaddingBottom();

        int widthSize;
        int heightSize;

        if (resizeWidth || resizeHeight)
        {
            widthSize = resolveAdjustedSize(width + paddingLeft + paddingRight, mMaxWidth, widthMeasureSpec);
            heightSize = resolveAdjustedSize(height + paddingTop + paddingBottom, mMaxHeight, heightMeasureSpec);

            if (desiredAspect != 0.0f)
            {
                float actualAspect = (float)(widthSize - paddingLeft - paddingRight) / (heightSize - paddingTop - paddingBottom);

                if (Math.abs(actualAspect - desiredAspect) > 0.0000001)
                {
                    boolean done = false;

                    if (resizeWidth)
                    {
                        int newWidth = (int)(desiredAspect * (heightSize - paddingTop - paddingBottom)) + paddingLeft + paddingRight;
                        if (!resizeHeight) widthSize = resolveAdjustedSize(newWidth, mMaxWidth, widthMeasureSpec);

                        if (newWidth <= widthSize)
                        {
                            widthSize = newWidth;
                            done = true;
                        }
                    }

                    if (!done && resizeHeight)
                    {
                        int newHeight = (int)((widthSize - paddingLeft - paddingRight) / desiredAspect) + paddingTop + paddingBottom;
                        if (!resizeWidth) heightSize = resolveAdjustedSize(newHeight, mMaxHeight, heightMeasureSpec);

                        if (newHeight <= heightSize) heightSize = newHeight;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            width = Math.max(width + paddingLeft + paddingRight, getSuggestedMinimumWidth());
            height = Math.max(height + paddingTop + paddingBottom, getSuggestedMinimumHeight());

            widthSize = resolveSizeAndState(width, widthMeasureSpec, 0);
            heightSize = resolveSizeAndState(height, heightMeasureSpec, 0);
        }

        setMeasuredDimension(widthSize, heightSize);
    }

    private int resolveAdjustedSize(int desiredSize, int maxSize, int measureSpec)
    {
        int specMode = MeasureSpec.getMode(measureSpec);
        int specSize = MeasureSpec.getSize(measureSpec);

        if (specMode == MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED) return Math.min(desiredSize, maxSize);
        if (specMode == MeasureSpec.AT_MOST) return Math.min(Math.min(desiredSize, specSize), maxSize);

        return specSize;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean setFrame(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        boolean changed = super.setFrame(left, top, right, bottom);
        mHaveFrame = true;
        configureBounds();
        return changed;
    }

    private void configureBounds()
    {
        if (mDrawable == null || !mHaveFrame) return;

        int drawableWidth = mDrawableWidth;
        int drawableHeight = mDrawableHeight;

        int viewWidth = getWidth() - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight();
        int viewHeight = getHeight() - getPaddingTop() - getPaddingBottom();

        boolean fits = (drawableWidth < 0 || viewWidth == drawableWidth) && (drawableHeight < 0 || viewHeight == drawableHeight);

        if (drawableWidth <= 0 || drawableHeight <= 0 || mScaleType == ScaleType.FIT_XY)
        {
            mDrawable.setBounds(0, 0, viewWidth, viewHeight);
            mDrawMatrix = null;
            return;
        }

        mDrawable.setBounds(0, 0, drawableWidth, drawableHeight);

        if (mScaleType == ScaleType.MATRIX)
        {
            mDrawMatrix = mMatrix.isIdentity() ? null : mMatrix;
        }
        else if (fits)
        {
            mDrawMatrix = null;
        }
        else if (mScaleType == ScaleType.CENTER)
        {
            mDrawMatrix = mMatrix;
            mDrawMatrix.setTranslate(Math.round((viewWidth - drawableWidth) * 0.5f), Math.round((viewHeight - drawableHeight) * 0.5f));
        }
        else if (mScaleType == ScaleType.CENTER_CROP)
        {
            mDrawMatrix = mMatrix;

            float scale;
            float offsetX = 0;
            float offsetY = 0;

            if (drawableWidth * viewHeight > viewWidth * drawableHeight)
            {
                scale = (float)viewHeight / (float)drawableHeight;
                offsetX = (viewWidth - drawableWidth * scale) * 0.5f;
            }
            else
            {
                scale = (float)viewWidth / (float)drawableWidth;
                offsetY = (viewHeight - drawableHeight * scale) * 0.5f;
            }

            mDrawMatrix.setScale(scale, scale);
            mDrawMatrix.postTranslate(Math.round(offsetX), Math.round(offsetY));
        }
        else if (mScaleType == ScaleType.CENTER_INSIDE)
        {
            mDrawMatrix = mMatrix;

            float scale = 1.0f;
            if (drawableWidth > viewWidth || drawableHeight > viewHeight)
            {
                scale = Math.min((float)viewWidth / (float)drawableWidth, (float)viewHeight / (float)drawableHeight);
            }

            float offsetX = Math.round((viewWidth - drawableWidth * scale) * 0.5f);
            float offsetY = Math.round((viewHeight - drawableHeight * scale) * 0.5f);

            mDrawMatrix.setScale(scale, scale);
            mDrawMatrix.postTranslate(offsetX, offsetY);
        }
        else
        {
            mTempSource.set(0, 0, drawableWidth, drawableHeight);
            mTempDestination.set(0, 0, viewWidth, viewHeight);

            mDrawMatrix = mMatrix;
            mDrawMatrix.setRectToRect(mTempSource, mTempDestination, scaleToFit(mScaleType));
        }
    }

    private static Matrix.ScaleToFit scaleToFit(ScaleType scaleType)
    {
        switch (scaleType)
        {
            case FIT_START:
                return Matrix.ScaleToFit.START;
            case FIT_END:
                return Matrix.ScaleToFit.END;
            case FIT_XY:
                return Matrix.ScaleToFit.FILL;
            default:
                return Matrix.ScaleToFit.CENTER;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void drawableStateChanged()
    {
        super.drawableStateChanged();

        Drawable drawable = mDrawable;
        if (drawable != null && drawable.isStateful() && drawable.setState(getDrawableState())) invalidateDrawable(drawable);
    }

    @Override
    public void drawableHotspotChanged(float x, float y)
    {
        super.drawableHotspotChanged(x, y);

        if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.setHotspot(x, y);
    }

    public void animateTransform(Matrix matrix)
    {
        if (mDrawable == null) return;

        if (matrix == null)
        {
            int viewWidth = getWidth() - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight();
            int viewHeight = getHeight() - getPaddingTop() - getPaddingBottom();
            mDrawable.setBounds(0, 0, viewWidth, viewHeight);
            mDrawMatrix = null;
        }
        else
        {
            mDrawable.setBounds(0, 0, mDrawableWidth, mDrawableHeight);
            if (mDrawMatrix == null) mDrawMatrix = new Matrix();
            mDrawMatrix.set(matrix);
        }

        invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        super.onDraw(canvas);

        if (mDrawable == null) return;
        if (mDrawableWidth == 0 || mDrawableHeight == 0) return;

        int paddingLeft = getPaddingLeft();
        int paddingTop = getPaddingTop();

        if (mDrawMatrix == null && paddingLeft == 0 && paddingTop == 0 && !mCropToPadding)
        {
            mDrawable.draw(canvas);
            return;
        }

        int saveCount = canvas.getSaveCount();
        canvas.save();

        if (mCropToPadding)
        {
            int scrollX = getScrollX();
            int scrollY = getScrollY();
            canvas.clipRect(scrollX + paddingLeft, scrollY + paddingTop, scrollX + getWidth() - getPaddingRight(),
                            scrollY + getHeight() - getPaddingBottom());
        }

        canvas.translate(paddingLeft, paddingTop);
        if (mDrawMatrix != null) canvas.concat(mDrawMatrix);

        mDrawable.draw(canvas);
        canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
    }

    @Override
    public int getBaseline()
    {
        return mBaselineAlignBottom ? getMeasuredHeight() : mBaseline;
    }

    public void setBaseline(int baseline)
    {
        if (mBaseline == baseline) return;

        mBaseline = baseline;
        requestLayout();
    }

    public void setBaselineAlignBottom(boolean aligned)
    {
        if (mBaselineAlignBottom == aligned) return;

        mBaselineAlignBottom = aligned;
        requestLayout();
    }

    public boolean getBaselineAlignBottom()
    {
        return mBaselineAlignBottom;
    }

    public final void setColorFilter(int color, PorterDuff.Mode mode)
    {
        setColorFilter(new PorterDuffColorFilter(color, mode));
    }

    public final void setColorFilter(int color)
    {
        setColorFilter(color, PorterDuff.Mode.SRC_ATOP);
    }

    public final void clearColorFilter()
    {
        setColorFilter(null);
    }

    public ColorFilter getColorFilter()
    {
        return mColorFilter;
    }

    public void setColorFilter(ColorFilter colorFilter)
    {
        if (mColorFilter == colorFilter && mHasColorFilter) return;

        mColorFilter = colorFilter;
        mHasColorFilter = true;
        applyColorFilter();
        invalidate();
    }

    private void applyColorFilter()
    {
        if (mDrawable == null || !mHasColorFilter) return;

        replaceWithMutated();
        mDrawable.setColorFilter(mColorFilter);
    }

    public int getImageAlpha()
    {
        return mAlpha;
    }

    public void setImageAlpha(int alpha)
    {
        setAlpha(alpha);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public void setAlpha(int alpha)
    {
        alpha &= 0xFF;
        if (mAlpha == alpha) return;

        mAlpha = alpha;
        mHasAlpha = true;
        applyAlpha();
        invalidate();
    }

    private void applyAlpha()
    {
        if (mDrawable == null || !mHasAlpha) return;

        replaceWithMutated();
        mDrawable.setAlpha(mAlpha);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOpaque()
    {
        if (super.isOpaque()) return true;
        if (mDrawable == null || mAlpha != 255 || getAlpha() < 1.0f) return false;
        if (mDrawable.getOpacity() != PixelFormat.OPAQUE) return false;

        return isFilledByImage();
    }

    private boolean isFilledByImage()
    {
        if (mDrawable == null) return false;

        android.graphics.Rect bounds = mDrawable.getBounds();
        Matrix matrix = mDrawMatrix;

        if (matrix == null)
        {
            return bounds.left <= 0 && bounds.top <= 0 && bounds.right >= getWidth() && bounds.bottom >= getHeight();
        }

        RectF mapped = new RectF(bounds);
        matrix.mapRect(mapped);
        return mapped.left <= 0 && mapped.top <= 0 && mapped.right >= getWidth() && mapped.bottom >= getHeight();
    }

    @Override
    public void onVisibilityAggregated(boolean isVisible)
    {
        super.onVisibilityAggregated(isVisible);

        if (mDrawable != null && mDrawable.isVisible() != isVisible) mDrawable.setVisible(isVisible, false);
    }

    @Override
    public void setVisibility(int visibility)
    {
        super.setVisibility(visibility);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onAttachedToWindow()
    {
        super.onAttachedToWindow();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow()
    {
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();

        if (mDrawable != null) mDrawable.setVisible(false, false);
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return ImageView.class.getName();
    }
}

```

`java/android/widget/LinearLayout.java`:
