```java
    public void setContentWidth(int width)
    {
        Drawable background = mPopup.getBackground();
        if (background != null)
        {
            Rect padding = new Rect();
            background.getPadding(padding);
            mDropDownWidth = padding.left + padding.right + width;
            return;
        }

        setWidth(width);
    }

    public int getHeight()
    {
        return mDropDownHeight;
    }

    public void setHeight(int height)
    {
        if (height < 0 && height != WRAP_CONTENT && height != MATCH_PARENT)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid height. Must be a positive value, MATCH_PARENT, or WRAP_CONTENT.");
        }

        mDropDownHeight = height;
    }

    public void setWindowLayoutType(int layoutType)
    {
        mDropDownWindowLayoutType = layoutType;
    }

    public void setOnItemClickListener(AdapterView.OnItemClickListener listener)
    {
        mItemClickListener = listener;
        if (mDropDownList != null) mDropDownList.setOnItemClickListener(listener);
    }

    public void setOnItemSelectedListener(AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener selectedListener)
    {
        mItemSelectedListener = selectedListener;
        if (mDropDownList != null) mDropDownList.setOnItemSelectedListener(selectedListener);
    }

    public void setPromptView(View prompt)
    {
        boolean showing = isShowing();
        if (showing) removePromptView();

        mPromptView = prompt;
        mContentView = null;

        if (showing) show();
    }

    private void removePromptView()
    {
        if (mPromptView == null) return;

        android.view.ViewParent parent = mPromptView.getParent();
        if (parent instanceof ViewGroup) ((ViewGroup)parent).removeView(mPromptView);
    }

    public void postShow()
    {
        View anchor = getAnchorView();
        if (anchor == null)
        {
            show();
            return;
        }

        anchor.post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                show();
            }
        });
    }

    public void show()
    {
        View anchor = getAnchorView();
        if (anchor == null) return;

        int height = buildDropDown();
        boolean noInputMethod = isInputMethodNotNeeded();

        mPopup.setWindowLayoutType(mDropDownWindowLayoutType);
        mPopup.setEpicenterBounds(mEpicenterBounds);

        int widthSpec;
        if (mDropDownWidth == MATCH_PARENT) widthSpec = MATCH_PARENT;
        else if (mDropDownWidth == WRAP_CONTENT) widthSpec = anchor.getWidth();
        else widthSpec = mDropDownWidth;

        int heightSpec;
        if (mDropDownHeight == MATCH_PARENT) heightSpec = noInputMethod ? height : MATCH_PARENT;
        else if (mDropDownHeight == WRAP_CONTENT) heightSpec = height;
        else heightSpec = mDropDownHeight;

        if (mPopup.isShowing())
        {
            mPopup.setOutsideTouchable(!mForceIgnoreOutsideTouch && !mDropDownAlwaysVisible);
            if (widthSpec == MATCH_PARENT) mPopup.setWidth(MATCH_PARENT);
            if (heightSpec == MATCH_PARENT) mPopup.setHeight(MATCH_PARENT);

            mPopup.update(anchor, mDropDownHorizontalOffset, mDropDownVerticalOffset, widthSpec < 0 ? -1 : widthSpec,
                          heightSpec < 0 ? -1 : heightSpec);
            return;
        }

        mPopup.setWidth(widthSpec);
        mPopup.setHeight(heightSpec);
        mPopup.setOutsideTouchable(!mForceIgnoreOutsideTouch && !mDropDownAlwaysVisible);
        mPopup.setTouchModal(mModal);
        mPopup.showAsDropDown(anchor, mDropDownHorizontalOffset, mDropDownVerticalOffset, mDropDownGravity);

        if (!mModal || mDropDownList.isInTouchMode()) clearListSelection();
        if (mSelectedPosition >= 0) mDropDownList.setSelection(mSelectedPosition);
    }

    public void dismiss()
    {
        mPopup.dismiss();
        removePromptView();
        mPopup.setContentView(null);
        mContentView = null;
        mDropDownList = null;
    }

    public void setOnDismissListener(PopupWindow.OnDismissListener listener)
    {
        mPopup.setOnDismissListener(listener);
    }

    public void setInputMethodMode(int mode)
    {
        mPopup.setInputMethodMode(mode);
    }

    public int getInputMethodMode()
    {
        return mPopup.getInputMethodMode();
    }

    public void setSelection(int position)
    {
        mSelectedPosition = position;

        ListView list = mDropDownList;
        if (!isShowing() || list == null) return;

        if (position >= 0 && position < list.getCount())
        {
            int firstVisible = list.getFirstVisiblePosition();
            int lastVisible = list.getLastVisiblePosition();
            if (position < firstVisible || position > lastVisible || list.getChildCount() == 0) list.setSelection(position);
        }

        highlightSelection();
    }

    private void highlightSelection()
    {
        ListView list = mDropDownList;
        if (list == null) return;

        for (int index = 0; index < list.getChildCount(); index++)
        {
            list.getChildAt(index).setSelected(list.getFirstVisiblePosition() + index == mSelectedPosition);
        }
    }

    public void clearListSelection()
    {
        mSelectedPosition = AdapterView.INVALID_POSITION;
        highlightSelection();
    }

    public boolean isShowing()
    {
        return mPopup.isShowing();
    }

    public boolean isInputMethodNotNeeded()
    {
        return mPopup.getInputMethodMode() == INPUT_METHOD_NOT_NEEDED;
    }

    public boolean performItemClick(int position)
    {
        if (!isShowing() || mDropDownList == null || mAdapter == null) return false;
        if (position < 0 || position >= mAdapter.getCount()) return false;

        if (mItemClickListener != null)
        {
            View child = mDropDownList.getChildAt(position - mDropDownList.getFirstVisiblePosition());
            mItemClickListener.onItemClick(mDropDownList, child, position, mAdapter.getItemId(position));
        }

        return true;
    }

    public Object getSelectedItem()
    {
        if (!isShowing() || mAdapter == null || mSelectedPosition < 0 || mSelectedPosition >= mAdapter.getCount()) return null;
        return mAdapter.getItem(mSelectedPosition);
    }

    public int getSelectedItemPosition()
    {
        if (!isShowing()) return ListView.INVALID_POSITION;
        return mSelectedPosition;
    }

    public long getSelectedItemId()
    {
        if (getSelectedItem() == null) return ListView.INVALID_ROW_ID;
        return mAdapter.getItemId(mSelectedPosition);
    }

    public View getSelectedView()
    {
        if (!isShowing() || mDropDownList == null || mSelectedPosition < 0) return null;
        return mDropDownList.getChildAt(mSelectedPosition - mDropDownList.getFirstVisiblePosition());
    }

    public ListView getListView()
    {
        return mDropDownList;
    }

    public boolean onKeyDown(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        if (!isShowing() || mAdapter == null) return false;

        int count = mAdapter.getCount();
        if (count == 0) return false;

        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP)
        {
            boolean down = keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN;
            int next = mSelectedPosition < 0 ? (down ? 0 : count - 1) : mSelectedPosition + (down ? 1 : -1);

            while (next >= 0 && next < count && !mAdapter.isEnabled(next)) next += down ? 1 : -1;

            if (next < 0 || next >= count)
            {
                clearListSelection();
                return true;
            }

            setSelection(next);
            return true;
        }

        return keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_CENTER || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_ENTER
               ? mSelectedPosition >= 0 : false;
    }

    public boolean onKeyUp(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        if (!isShowing() || mSelectedPosition < 0) return false;

        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_CENTER || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_ENTER)
        {
            boolean consumed = performItemClick(mSelectedPosition);
            if (consumed) dismiss();
            return consumed;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean onKeyPreIme(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        if ((keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE) && isShowing())
        {
            if (event.getAction() == KeyEvent.ACTION_UP && !event.isCanceled()) dismiss();
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public View.OnTouchListener createDragToOpenListener(View src)
    {
        return new View.OnTouchListener()
        {
            @Override
            public boolean onTouch(View view, MotionEvent event)
            {
                return false;
            }
        };
    }

    private int buildDropDown()
    {
        int otherHeights = 0;

        if (mContentView == null || mDropDownList == null)
        {
            mDropDownList = new ListView(mContext);
            mDropDownList.setFocusable(true);
            mDropDownList.setFocusableInTouchMode(true);
            if (mDropDownListHighlight != null) mDropDownList.setSelector(mDropDownListHighlight);
            mDropDownList.setAdapter(mAdapter);
            mDropDownList.setOnItemClickListener(mItemClickListener);
            if (mItemSelectedListener != null) mDropDownList.setOnItemSelectedListener(mItemSelectedListener);

            View content = mDropDownList;

            if (mPromptView != null)
            {
                removePromptView();

                LinearLayout layout = new LinearLayout(mContext);
                layout.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);

                LinearLayout.LayoutParams listParams = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1.0f);
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams promptParams = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                                                                                       ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);

                if (mPromptPosition == POSITION_PROMPT_BELOW)
                {
                    layout.addView(mDropDownList, listParams);
                    layout.addView(mPromptView, promptParams);
                }
                else
                {
                    layout.addView(mPromptView, promptParams);
                    layout.addView(mDropDownList, listParams);
                }

                int promptWidthSpec = mDropDownWidth >= 0 ? View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(mDropDownWidth, View.MeasureSpec.AT_MOST)
                                                          : View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(0, View.MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED);
                mPromptView.measure(promptWidthSpec, View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(0, View.MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED));
                otherHeights = mPromptView.getMeasuredHeight() + promptParams.topMargin + promptParams.bottomMargin;

                content = layout;
            }

            mContentView = content;
            mPopup.setContentView(content);
        }
        else if (mPromptView != null)
        {
            otherHeights = mPromptView.getMeasuredHeight();
        }

        int padding = 0;
        Rect backgroundPadding = new Rect();
        Drawable background = mPopup.getBackground();
        if (background != null && background.getPadding(backgroundPadding)) padding = backgroundPadding.top + backgroundPadding.bottom;

        View anchor = getAnchorView();
        boolean ignoreBottomDecorations = mPopup.getInputMethodMode() == PopupWindow.INPUT_METHOD_NOT_NEEDED;
        int maxHeight = mPopup.getMaxAvailableHeight(anchor, mDropDownVerticalOffset, ignoreBottomDecorations);

        if (mDropDownAlwaysVisible || mDropDownHeight == MATCH_PARENT) return maxHeight + padding;

        int displayWidth = mContext.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().widthPixels;
        int outerWidth;
        if (mDropDownWidth == WRAP_CONTENT) outerWidth = anchor != null && anchor.getWidth() > 0 ? anchor.getWidth() : displayWidth;
        else if (mDropDownWidth == MATCH_PARENT) outerWidth = displayWidth;
        else outerWidth = mDropDownWidth;

        int innerWidth = Math.max(0, outerWidth - backgroundPadding.left - backgroundPadding.right);
        int childWidthSpec = View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(innerWidth, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY);

        int listContent = mDropDownList.measureHeightOfChildren(childWidthSpec, 0, ListView.NO_POSITION, maxHeight - otherHeights, -1);
        if (listContent > 0) otherHeights += padding;

        return listContent + otherHeights;
    }
}

```

`java/android/widget/ListView.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityNodeInfo;

import java.util.ArrayList;

public class ListView extends AbsListView
{
    static final int NO_POSITION = -1;

    private static final float MAX_SCROLL_FACTOR = 0.33f;
    private static final int DEFAULT_SMOOTH_SCROLL_DURATION = 250;

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private final ArrayList<FixedViewInfo> mHeaderViewInfos = new ArrayList<FixedViewInfo>();
    private final ArrayList<FixedViewInfo> mFooterViewInfos = new ArrayList<FixedViewInfo>();

    private Drawable mDivider;
    private int mDividerHeight;
    private boolean mHeaderDividersEnabled = true;
    private boolean mFooterDividersEnabled = true;
    private Drawable mOverScrollHeader;
    private Drawable mOverScrollFooter;
    private boolean mItemsCanFocus;
    private boolean mAreAllItemsSelectable = true;
    private final Rect mTempRect = new Rect();

    public ListView(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public ListView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, 0);
    }

    public ListView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public ListView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        if (attributes != null) readAttributes(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
    }

    private void readAttributes(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        if (sStyleable == null)
        {
            sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "entries", "divider", "dividerHeight", "headerDividersEnabled",
                                         "footerDividersEnabled", "overScrollHeader", "overScrollFooter");
        }
        if (sStyleable.isEmpty()) return;

        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        int entriesIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("entries");
        if (entriesIndex >= 0 && array.hasValue(entriesIndex))
        {
            CharSequence[] entries = array.getTextArray(entriesIndex);
            if (entries != null)
            {
                int layout = context.getResources().getIdentifier("simple_list_item_1", "layout", "android");
                setAdapter(new ArrayAdapter<CharSequence>(context, layout, entries));
            }
        }

        int dividerIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("divider");
        if (dividerIndex >= 0 && array.hasValue(dividerIndex))
        {
            Drawable divider = readDrawable(array, dividerIndex);
            setDivider(divider);
        }

        mOverScrollHeader = readDrawable(array, sStyleable.indexOf("overScrollHeader"));
        mOverScrollFooter = readDrawable(array, sStyleable.indexOf("overScrollFooter"));

        int heightIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("dividerHeight");
        if (heightIndex >= 0 && array.hasValue(heightIndex))
        {
            int height = array.getDimensionPixelSize(heightIndex, 0);
            if (height != 0) setDividerHeight(height);
        }

        int headerIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("headerDividersEnabled");
        if (headerIndex >= 0) mHeaderDividersEnabled = array.getBoolean(headerIndex, true);

        int footerIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("footerDividersEnabled");
        if (footerIndex >= 0) mFooterDividersEnabled = array.getBoolean(footerIndex, true);

        array.recycle();
    }

    private static Drawable readDrawable(TypedArray array, int index)
    {
        if (index < 0 || !array.hasValue(index)) return null;

        try
        {
            return array.getDrawable(index);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException unsupported)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public int getMaxScrollAmount()
    {
        return (int)(MAX_SCROLL_FACTOR * getHeight());
    }

    public void addHeaderView(View view, Object data, boolean isSelectable)
    {
        if (view.getParent() != null && view.getParent() != this)
        {
            android.util.Log.w("ListView", "The specified child already has a parent. "
                                           + "You must call removeView() on the child's parent first.");
        }

        FixedViewInfo info = new FixedViewInfo();
        info.view = view;
        info.data = data;
        info.isSelectable = isSelectable;
        mHeaderViewInfos.add(info);
        mAreAllItemsSelectable &= isSelectable;

        onFixedViewsChanged();
    }

    public void addHeaderView(View view)
    {
        addHeaderView(view, null, true);
    }

    public int getHeaderViewsCount()
    {
        return mHeaderViewInfos.size();
    }

    public boolean removeHeaderView(View view)
    {
        if (mHeaderViewInfos.isEmpty()) return false;

        boolean result = false;
        if (mAdapter instanceof HeaderViewListAdapter && ((HeaderViewListAdapter)mAdapter).removeHeader(view))
        {
            if (mDataSetObserver != null) mDataSetObserver.onChanged();
            result = true;
        }

        removeFixedViewInfo(view, mHeaderViewInfos);
        return result;
    }

    public void addFooterView(View view, Object data, boolean isSelectable)
    {
        if (view.getParent() != null && view.getParent() != this)
        {
            android.util.Log.w("ListView", "The specified child already has a parent. "
                                           + "You must call removeView() on the child's parent first.");
        }

        FixedViewInfo info = new FixedViewInfo();
        info.view = view;
        info.data = data;
        info.isSelectable = isSelectable;
        mFooterViewInfos.add(info);
        mAreAllItemsSelectable &= isSelectable;

        onFixedViewsChanged();
    }

    public void addFooterView(View view)
    {
        addFooterView(view, null, true);
    }

    public int getFooterViewsCount()
    {
        return mFooterViewInfos.size();
    }

    public boolean removeFooterView(View view)
    {
        if (mFooterViewInfos.isEmpty()) return false;

        boolean result = false;
        if (mAdapter instanceof HeaderViewListAdapter && ((HeaderViewListAdapter)mAdapter).removeFooter(view))
        {
            if (mDataSetObserver != null) mDataSetObserver.onChanged();
            result = true;
        }

        removeFixedViewInfo(view, mFooterViewInfos);
        return result;
    }

    private void onFixedViewsChanged()
    {
        if (mAdapter == null) return;

        if (!(mAdapter instanceof HeaderViewListAdapter)) wrapHeaderListAdapterInternal();
        if (mDataSetObserver != null) mDataSetObserver.onChanged();
    }

    private void wrapHeaderListAdapterInternal()
    {
        ListAdapter wrapped = mAdapter;
        if (wrapped != null && mDataSetObserver != null) wrapped.unregisterDataSetObserver(mDataSetObserver);

        mAdapter = new HeaderViewListAdapter(mHeaderViewInfos, mFooterViewInfos, wrapped);
        if (mDataSetObserver != null) mAdapter.registerDataSetObserver(mDataSetObserver);

        mRecycler.setViewTypeCount(Math.max(1, mAdapter.getViewTypeCount()));
        resetChildrenForNewAdapter();
    }

    private void resetChildrenForNewAdapter()
    {
        removeAllViewsInLayout();
        mDataChanged = true;
        mOldItemCount = mItemCount;
        mItemCount = mAdapter == null ? 0 : mAdapter.getCount();
    }

    private void removeFixedViewInfo(View view, ArrayList<FixedViewInfo> where)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < where.size(); index++)
        {
            if (where.get(index).view != view) continue;

            where.remove(index);
            break;
        }

        if (view.getParent() == this)
        {
            if (indexOfChild(view) >= 0) removeViewInLayout(view);
            else removeDetachedView(view, false);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public ListAdapter getAdapter()
    {
        return mAdapter;
    }

    @Override
    public void setRemoteViewsAdapter(Intent intent)
    {
        super.setRemoteViewsAdapter(intent);
    }

    @Override
    public void setAdapter(ListAdapter adapter)
    {
        if (mAdapter != null && mDataSetObserver != null) mAdapter.unregisterDataSetObserver(mDataSetObserver);
        mDataSetObserver = null;

        resetList();
        mRecycler.clear();

        boolean hasFixedViews = !mHeaderViewInfos.isEmpty() || !mFooterViewInfos.isEmpty();
        mAdapter = hasFixedViews ? new HeaderViewListAdapter(mHeaderViewInfos, mFooterViewInfos, adapter) : adapter;

        mOldSelectedPosition = INVALID_POSITION;
        mOldSelectedRowId = INVALID_ROW_ID;

        super.setAdapter(adapter);

        if (mAdapter != null)
        {
            mAreAllItemsSelectable = mAdapter.areAllItemsEnabled();
            mOldItemCount = mItemCount;
            mItemCount = mAdapter.getCount();
            checkFocus();

            mDataSetObserver = new AdapterDataSetObserver();
            mAdapter.registerDataSetObserver(mDataSetObserver);

            mRecycler.setViewTypeCount(Math.max(1, mAdapter.getViewTypeCount()));
        }
        else
        {
            mAreAllItemsSelectable = true;
            mItemCount = 0;
            checkFocus();
        }

        checkSelectionChanged();
        requestLayout();
    }

    @Override
    void resetList()
    {
        super.resetList();
    }

    public boolean requestChildRectangleOnScreen(View child, Rect rect, boolean immediate)
    {
        int listTop = mListPadding.top;
        int listBottom = getHeight() - mListPadding.bottom;

        mTempRect.set(rect);
        mTempRect.offset(child.getLeft(), child.getTop());

        int delta = 0;
        if (mTempRect.bottom > listBottom) delta = Math.min(mTempRect.bottom - listBottom, mTempRect.top - listTop);
        else if (mTempRect.top < listTop) delta = mTempRect.top - listTop;

        if (delta == 0) return false;

        if (immediate) trackMotionScroll(-delta);
        else smoothScrollBy(delta, DEFAULT_SMOOTH_SCROLL_DURATION);

        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void smoothScrollToPosition(int position)
    {
        super.smoothScrollToPosition(position);
    }

    public void smoothScrollByOffset(int offset)
    {
        if (mItemCount == 0) return;

        int base = offset < 0 ? getFirstVisiblePosition() : getLastVisiblePosition();
        int target = Math.max(0, Math.min(mItemCount - 1, base + offset));
        smoothScrollToPosition(target);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow()
    {
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onSizeChanged(int width, int height, int oldWidth, int oldHeight)
    {
        super.onSizeChanged(width, height, oldWidth, oldHeight);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        super.onMeasure(widthMeasureSpec, heightMeasureSpec);

        int widthMode = MeasureSpec.getMode(widthMeasureSpec);
        int heightMode = MeasureSpec.getMode(heightMeasureSpec);
        int widthSize = MeasureSpec.getSize(widthMeasureSpec);
        int heightSize = MeasureSpec.getSize(heightMeasureSpec);

        int childWidth = 0;
        int childHeight = 0;

        int count = mAdapter == null ? 0 : mAdapter.getCount();
        if (count > 0 && (widthMode == MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED || heightMode == MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED))
        {
            View child = measuredItemView(0);
            childWidth = child.getMeasuredWidth();
            childHeight = child.getMeasuredHeight();
            releaseMeasuredItemView(child, 0);
        }

        if (widthMode == MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED)
        {
            widthSize = mListPadding.left + mListPadding.right + childWidth + getVerticalScrollbarWidth();
        }

        if (heightMode == MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED)
        {
            heightSize = mListPadding.top + mListPadding.bottom + childHeight;
        }

        if (heightMode == MeasureSpec.AT_MOST)
        {
            heightSize = measureHeightOfChildren(widthMeasureSpec, 0, NO_POSITION, heightSize, -1);
        }

        setMeasuredDimension(Math.max(widthSize, getSuggestedMinimumWidth()), Math.max(heightSize, getSuggestedMinimumHeight()));
        mWidthMeasureSpec = widthMeasureSpec;
    }

    private View measuredItemView(int position)
    {
        int index = position - mFirstPosition;
        View child = index >= 0 && index < getChildCount() ? getChildAt(index) : null;

        if (child == null) child = obtainView(position);

        measureItem(child, 0);
        return child;
    }

    private void releaseMeasuredItemView(View child, int position)
    {
        if (child.getParent() == this && indexOfChild(child) >= 0) return;

        mRecycler.addScrapView(child, position);
    }

    final int measureHeightOfChildren(int widthMeasureSpec, int startPosition, int endPosition, int maxHeight,
                                      int disallowPartialChildPosition)
    {
        ListAdapter adapter = mAdapter;
        updateListPadding();
        if (adapter == null) return mListPadding.top + mListPadding.bottom;

        mWidthMeasureSpec = widthMeasureSpec;
        int returnedHeight = mListPadding.top + mListPadding.bottom;
        int dividerHeight = dividerSpacing();
        int prevHeightWithoutPartialChild = 0;

        int end = endPosition == NO_POSITION ? adapter.getCount() - 1 : endPosition;

        for (int position = startPosition; position <= end; position++)
        {
            View child = measuredItemView(position);
            if (position > 0) returnedHeight += dividerHeight;

            returnedHeight += child.getMeasuredHeight();
            releaseMeasuredItemView(child, position);

            if (returnedHeight >= maxHeight)
            {
                return disallowPartialChildPosition >= 0 && position > disallowPartialChildPosition && prevHeightWithoutPartialChild > 0
                       && returnedHeight != maxHeight ? prevHeightWithoutPartialChild : maxHeight;
            }

            boolean fullyCounted = disallowPartialChildPosition >= 0 && position >= disallowPartialChildPosition;
            if (fullyCounted) prevHeightWithoutPartialChild = returnedHeight;
        }

        return returnedHeight;
    }

    private int dividerSpacing()
    {
        return mDivider != null && mDividerHeight > 0 ? mDividerHeight : 0;
    }

    @Override
    int rowSpacing()
    {
        return dividerSpacing();
    }

    @Override
    protected void layoutChildren()
    {
        layoutRows();
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean canAnimate()
    {
        return super.canAnimate() && mItemCount > 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void setSelection(int position)
    {
        setSelectionFromTop(position, 0);
    }

    public void setSelectionAfterHeaderView()
    {
        int count = getHeaderViewsCount();
        if (count > 0)
        {
            setSelectionFromTop(count, 0);
            return;
        }

        if (mAdapter != null) setSelection(count);
        else mResurrectToPosition = count;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event)
    {
        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onKeyDown(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        return super.onKeyDown(keyCode, event);
    }

    public boolean onKeyMultiple(int keyCode, int repeatCount, KeyEvent event)
    {
        boolean handled = false;
        for (int index = 0; index < Math.max(1, repeatCount); index++) handled |= onKeyDown(keyCode, event);
        return handled;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onKeyUp(int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
    {
        return super.onKeyUp(keyCode, event);
    }

    public void setItemsCanFocus(boolean itemsCanFocus)
    {
        mItemsCanFocus = itemsCanFocus;
        if (!itemsCanFocus) setDescendantFocusability(ViewGroup.FOCUS_BLOCK_DESCENDANTS);
    }

    public boolean getItemsCanFocus()
    {
        return mItemsCanFocus;
    }

    public boolean isOpaque()
    {
        return (getCacheColorHint() >>> 24) == 0xFF && getChildCount() > 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void setCacheColorHint(int color)
    {
        super.setCacheColorHint(color);
    }

    @Override
    protected void dispatchDraw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        super.dispatchDraw(canvas);

        int dividerHeight = dividerSpacing();
        if (dividerHeight <= 0 || mDivider == null) return;

        int childCount = getChildCount();
        int headerCount = getHeaderViewsCount();
        int footerLimit = mItemCount - mFooterViewInfos.size();
        int left = mListPadding.left;
        int right = getWidth() - mListPadding.right;

        int saveCount = canvas.save();
        if (getClipToPadding())
        {
            canvas.clipRect(mListPadding.left, mListPadding.top, getWidth() - mListPadding.right, getHeight() - mListPadding.bottom);
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < childCount; index++)
        {
            int position = mFirstPosition + index;
            if (position >= mItemCount - 1) break;

            boolean isHeader = position < headerCount;
            boolean nextIsFooter = position + 1 >= footerLimit;
            if (!mHeaderDividersEnabled && isHeader) continue;
            if (!mFooterDividersEnabled && (nextIsFooter || position >= footerLimit)) continue;
            boolean bothEnabled = mAdapter != null && mAdapter.isEnabled(position) && mAdapter.isEnabled(position + 1);
            if (!mAreAllItemsSelectable && !bothEnabled) continue;

            int bottom = getChildAt(index).getBottom();
            mTempRect.set(left, bottom, right, bottom + dividerHeight);
            mDivider.setBounds(mTempRect);
            mDivider.draw(canvas);
        }

        canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean drawChild(Canvas canvas, View child, long drawingTime)
    {
        return super.drawChild(canvas, child, drawingTime);
    }

    public Drawable getDivider()
    {
        return mDivider;
    }

    public void setDivider(Drawable divider)
    {
        mDividerHeight = divider != null ? Math.max(0, divider.getIntrinsicHeight()) : 0;
        if (divider != null && mDividerHeight == 0) mDividerHeight = 1;

        mDivider = divider;
        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public int getDividerHeight()
    {
        return mDividerHeight;
    }

    public void setDividerHeight(int height)
    {
        mDividerHeight = height;
        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setHeaderDividersEnabled(boolean headerDividersEnabled)
    {
        mHeaderDividersEnabled = headerDividersEnabled;
        invalidate();
    }

    public boolean areHeaderDividersEnabled()
    {
        return mHeaderDividersEnabled;
    }

    public void setFooterDividersEnabled(boolean footerDividersEnabled)
    {
        mFooterDividersEnabled = footerDividersEnabled;
        invalidate();
    }

    public boolean areFooterDividersEnabled()
    {
        return mFooterDividersEnabled;
    }

    public void setOverscrollHeader(Drawable header)
    {
        mOverScrollHeader = header;
    }

    public Drawable getOverscrollHeader()
    {
        return mOverScrollHeader;
    }

    public void setOverscrollFooter(Drawable footer)
    {
        mOverScrollFooter = footer;
    }

    public Drawable getOverscrollFooter()
    {
        return mOverScrollFooter;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onFocusChanged(boolean gainFocus, int direction, Rect previouslyFocusedRect)
    {
        super.onFocusChanged(gainFocus, direction, previouslyFocusedRect);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onFinishInflate()
    {
        super.onFinishInflate();

        int count = getChildCount();
        if (count == 0) return;

        View[] children = new View[count];
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) children[index] = getChildAt(index);

        removeAllViewsInLayout();
        for (View child : children) addHeaderView(child);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public long[] getCheckItemIds()
    {
        if (mAdapter != null && mAdapter.hasStableIds()) return getCheckedItemIds();

        if (mChoiceMode == CHOICE_MODE_NONE || mCheckStates == null || mAdapter == null) return new long[0];

        long[] ids = new long[mCheckStates.size()];
        int found = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < mCheckStates.size(); index++)
        {
            if (mCheckStates.valueAt(index)) ids[found++] = mAdapter.getItemId(mCheckStates.keyAt(index));
        }

        if (found == ids.length) return ids;

        long[] trimmed = new long[found];
        System.arraycopy(ids, 0, trimmed, 0, found);
        return trimmed;
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return ListView.class.getName();
    }

    @Override
    public void onInitializeAccessibilityNodeInfoForItem(View view, int position, AccessibilityNodeInfo info)
    {
        super.onInitializeAccessibilityNodeInfoForItem(view, position, info);
    }

    public class FixedViewInfo
    {
        public View view;
        public Object data;
        public boolean isSelectable;

        public FixedViewInfo()
        {
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/Magnifier.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.graphics.Point;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.TypedValue;
import android.view.View;

public final class Magnifier
{
    public static final int SOURCE_BOUND_MAX_IN_SURFACE = 0;
    public static final int SOURCE_BOUND_MAX_VISIBLE = 1;

    private final View mView;
    private final int mWidth;
    private final int mHeight;
    private float mZoom;
    private int mSourceWidth;
    private int mSourceHeight;
    private final float mElevation;
    private final float mCornerRadius;
    private final Drawable mOverlay;
    private final int mHorizontalOffset;
    private final int mVerticalOffset;
    private final boolean mClippingEnabled;
    private final int mLeftBound;
    private final int mTopBound;
    private final int mRightBound;
    private final int mBottomBound;
    private boolean mShowing;
    private float mSourceCenterX;
    private float mSourceCenterY;
    private float mMagnifierCenterX;
    private float mMagnifierCenterY;

    public Magnifier(View view)
    {
        this(new Builder(view));
    }

    private Magnifier(Builder builder)
    {
        mView = builder.mView;
        mWidth = builder.mWidth;
        mHeight = builder.mHeight;
        mZoom = builder.mZoom;
        mElevation = builder.mElevation;
        mCornerRadius = builder.mCornerRadius;
        mOverlay = builder.mOverlay;
        mHorizontalOffset = builder.mHorizontalOffset;
        mVerticalOffset = builder.mVerticalOffset;
        mClippingEnabled = builder.mClippingEnabled;
        mLeftBound = builder.mLeftBound;
        mTopBound = builder.mTopBound;
        mRightBound = builder.mRightBound;
        mBottomBound = builder.mBottomBound;
        updateSourceSize();
    }

    private void updateSourceSize()
    {
        mSourceWidth = Math.round(mWidth / mZoom);
        mSourceHeight = Math.round(mHeight / mZoom);
    }

    public void show(float sourceCenterX, float sourceCenterY)
    {
        show(sourceCenterX, sourceCenterY, sourceCenterX + mHorizontalOffset, sourceCenterY + mVerticalOffset);
    }

    public void show(float sourceCenterX, float sourceCenterY, float magnifierCenterX, float magnifierCenterY)
    {
        mSourceCenterX = clamp(sourceCenterX, 0, mView.getWidth());
        mSourceCenterY = clamp(sourceCenterY, 0, mView.getHeight());
        mMagnifierCenterX = magnifierCenterX;
        mMagnifierCenterY = magnifierCenterY;
        mShowing = true;
    }

    private static float clamp(float value, float minimum, float maximum)
    {
        if (maximum < minimum) return minimum;

        return Math.max(minimum, Math.min(maximum, value));
    }

    public void dismiss()
    {
        mShowing = false;
    }

    public void update()
    {
        if (mShowing && mOverlay != null) mOverlay.invalidateSelf();
    }

    public int getWidth()
    {
        return mWidth;
    }

    public int getHeight()
    {
        return mHeight;
    }

    public int getSourceWidth()
    {
        return mSourceWidth;
    }

    public int getSourceHeight()
    {
        return mSourceHeight;
    }

    public void setZoom(float zoom)
    {
        if (zoom <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Zoom should be positive");

        mZoom = zoom;
        updateSourceSize();
    }

    public float getZoom()
    {
        return mZoom;
    }

    public float getElevation()
    {
        return mElevation;
    }

    public float getCornerRadius()
    {
        return mCornerRadius;
    }

    public int getDefaultHorizontalSourceToMagnifierOffset()
    {
        return mHorizontalOffset;
    }

    public int getDefaultVerticalSourceToMagnifierOffset()
    {
        return mVerticalOffset;
    }

    public Drawable getOverlay()
    {
        return mOverlay;
    }

    public boolean isClippingEnabled()
    {
        return mClippingEnabled;
    }

    public Point getPosition()
    {
        if (!mShowing) return null;

        int[] location = new int[2];
        mView.getLocationInWindow(location);

        int left = Math.round(location[0] + mMagnifierCenterX - mWidth / 2f);
        int top = Math.round(location[1] + mMagnifierCenterY - mHeight / 2f);
        return new Point(left, top);
    }

    public Point getSourcePosition()
    {
        if (!mShowing) return null;

        int[] location = new int[2];
        mView.getLocationInWindow(location);

        float left = location[0] + mSourceCenterX - mSourceWidth / 2f;
        float top = location[1] + mSourceCenterY - mSourceHeight / 2f;

        View root = mView.getRootView();
        float minimumLeft = mLeftBound == SOURCE_BOUND_MAX_IN_SURFACE ? 0 : location[0];
        float minimumTop = mTopBound == SOURCE_BOUND_MAX_IN_SURFACE ? 0 : location[1];
        float maximumRight = mRightBound == SOURCE_BOUND_MAX_IN_SURFACE ? root.getWidth() : location[0] + mView.getWidth();
        float maximumBottom = mBottomBound == SOURCE_BOUND_MAX_IN_SURFACE ? root.getHeight() : location[1] + mView.getHeight();

        left = clamp(left, minimumLeft, maximumRight - mSourceWidth);
        top = clamp(top, minimumTop, maximumBottom - mSourceHeight);
        return new Point(Math.round(left), Math.round(top));
    }

    public static final class Builder
    {
        private final View mView;
        private int mWidth;
        private int mHeight;
        private float mZoom = 1.25f;
        private float mElevation;
        private float mCornerRadius;
        private Drawable mOverlay;
        private int mHorizontalOffset;
        private int mVerticalOffset;
        private boolean mClippingEnabled = true;
        private int mLeftBound = SOURCE_BOUND_MAX_VISIBLE;
        private int mTopBound = SOURCE_BOUND_MAX_IN_SURFACE;
        private int mRightBound = SOURCE_BOUND_MAX_VISIBLE;
        private int mBottomBound = SOURCE_BOUND_MAX_IN_SURFACE;

        public Builder(View view)
        {
            if (view == null) throw new NullPointerException("view");

            mView = view;

            android.util.DisplayMetrics metrics = view.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
            mWidth = Math.round(TypedValue.applyDimension(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_DIP, 100, metrics));
            mHeight = Math.round(TypedValue.applyDimension(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_DIP, 48, metrics));
            mElevation = TypedValue.applyDimension(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_DIP, 4, metrics);
            mCornerRadius = TypedValue.applyDimension(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_DIP, 2, metrics);
            mVerticalOffset = -Math.round(TypedValue.applyDimension(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_DIP, 42, metrics));
        }

        public Builder setSize(int width, int height)
        {
            if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("The size must be positive");

            mWidth = width;
            mHeight = height;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setInitialZoom(float zoom)
        {
            if (zoom <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Zoom should be positive");

            mZoom = zoom;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setElevation(float elevation)
        {
            if (elevation < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Elevation should not be negative");

            mElevation = elevation;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setCornerRadius(float cornerRadius)
        {
            if (cornerRadius < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Corner radius should not be negative");

            mCornerRadius = cornerRadius;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setOverlay(Drawable overlay)
        {
            mOverlay = overlay;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setDefaultSourceToMagnifierOffset(int horizontalOffset, int verticalOffset)
        {
            mHorizontalOffset = horizontalOffset;
            mVerticalOffset = verticalOffset;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setClippingEnabled(boolean clip)
        {
            mClippingEnabled = clip;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder setSourceBounds(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
        {
            mLeftBound = left;
            mTopBound = top;
            mRightBound = right;
            mBottomBound = bottom;
            return this;
        }

        public Magnifier build()
        {
            return new Magnifier(this);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/MediaController.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.drawable.ColorDrawable;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.util.TypedValue;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

import java.util.Formatter;
import java.util.Locale;

public class MediaController extends FrameLayout
{
    private static final int DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 3000;
    private static final int PROGRESS_STEPS = 1000;

    private MediaPlayerControl mPlayer;
    private final Context mContext;
    private View mAnchor;
    private View mRoot;
    private PopupWindow mWindow;
    private ProgressBar mProgress;
    private TextView mEndTime;
    private TextView mCurrentTime;
    private boolean mShowing;
    private boolean mDragging;
    private final boolean mUseFastForward;
    private boolean mFromXml;
    private boolean mListenersSet;
    private View.OnClickListener mNextListener;
    private View.OnClickListener mPreviousListener;
    private final StringBuilder mFormatBuilder = new StringBuilder();
    private final Formatter mFormatter = new Formatter(mFormatBuilder, Locale.getDefault());
    private ImageButton mPauseButton;
    private ImageButton mFastForwardButton;
    private ImageButton mRewindButton;
    private ImageButton mNextButton;
    private ImageButton mPreviousButton;
    private final int[] mAnchorLocation = new int[2];

    private final View.OnLayoutChangeListener mLayoutChangeListener =
        (view, left, top, right, bottom, oldLeft, oldTop, oldRight, oldBottom) ->
        {
            if (mShowing) updateWindowLayout();
        };

    private final Runnable mFadeOut = this::hide;

    private final Runnable mShowProgress = new Runnable()
    {
        @Override
        public void run()
        {
            int position = setProgress();
            if (!mDragging && mShowing && mPlayer != null && mPlayer.isPlaying()) postDelayed(this, 1000 - (position % 1000));
        }
    };

    public MediaController(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        mContext = context;
        mRoot = this;
        mUseFastForward = true;
        mFromXml = true;
    }

    public MediaController(Context context, boolean useFastForward)
    {
        super(context);

        mContext = context;
        mUseFastForward = useFastForward;
        initFloatingWindow();
    }

    public MediaController(Context context)
    {
        this(context, true);
    }

    private void initFloatingWindow()
    {
        mWindow = new PopupWindow(mContext);
        mWindow.setFocusable(false);
        mWindow.setBackgroundDrawable(new ColorDrawable(0));
        mWindow.setOutsideTouchable(false);
        setFocusable(true);
        setFocusableInTouchMode(true);
        setDescendantFocusability(ViewGroup.FOCUS_AFTER_DESCENDANTS);
        requestFocus();
    }

    @Override
    public void onFinishInflate()
    {
        super.onFinishInflate();

        if (mRoot != null) initControllerView(mRoot);
    }

    public void setMediaPlayer(MediaPlayerControl player)
    {
        mPlayer = player;
        updatePausePlay();
    }

    public void setAnchorView(View view)
    {
        if (mAnchor != null) mAnchor.removeOnLayoutChangeListener(mLayoutChangeListener);

        mAnchor = view;
        if (mAnchor != null) mAnchor.addOnLayoutChangeListener(mLayoutChangeListener);

        removeAllViews();
        View controller = makeControllerView();
        addView(controller, new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
    }

    protected View makeControllerView()
    {
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(mContext);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(0xCC000000);

        LinearLayout buttons = new LinearLayout(mContext);
        buttons.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        buttons.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);

        mPreviousButton = button("ic_media_previous", "Previous");
        mRewindButton = button("ic_media_rew", "Rewind");
        mPauseButton = button("ic_media_pause", "Pause");
        mFastForwardButton = button("ic_media_ff", "Fast forward");
        mNextButton = button("ic_media_next", "Next");

        buttons.addView(mPreviousButton);
        buttons.addView(mRewindButton);
        buttons.addView(mPauseButton);
        buttons.addView(mFastForwardButton);
        buttons.addView(mNextButton);

        LinearLayout timeline = new LinearLayout(mContext);
        timeline.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        timeline.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);

        mCurrentTime = timeLabel();
        mEndTime = timeLabel();
        SeekBar seekBar = new SeekBar(mContext);
        mProgress = seekBar;

        timeline.addView(mCurrentTime);
        timeline.addView(seekBar, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
        timeline.addView(mEndTime);

        root.addView(buttons, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        root.addView(timeline, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        mRoot = root;
        initControllerView(root);
        return root;
    }

    private ImageButton button(String drawableName, String description)
    {
        ImageButton button = new ImageButton(mContext);
        int identifier = mContext.getResources().getIdentifier(drawableName, "drawable", "android");
        Drawable icon = null;

        if (identifier != 0)
        {
            try
            {
                icon = mContext.getDrawable(identifier);
            }
            catch (RuntimeException missing)
            {
                icon = null;
            }
        }

        if (icon != null) button.setImageDrawable(icon);
        button.setContentDescription(description);
        button.setBackground(null);

        int size = Math.round(TypedValue.applyDimension(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_DIP, 48, getResources().getDisplayMetrics()));
        button.setMinimumWidth(size);
        button.setMinimumHeight(size);
        return button;
    }

    private TextView timeLabel()
    {
        TextView label = new TextView(mContext);
        label.setTextColor(0xFFBEBEBE);
        label.setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 14);
        int padding = Math.round(TypedValue.applyDimension(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_DIP, 4, getResources().getDisplayMetrics()));
        label.setPadding(padding, padding, padding, padding);
        return label;
    }

    private void initControllerView(View root)
    {
        if (mPauseButton != null)
        {
            mPauseButton.requestFocus();
            mPauseButton.setOnClickListener(view ->
            {
                doPauseResume();
                show(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT);
            });
        }

        if (mFastForwardButton != null)
        {
            mFastForwardButton.setOnClickListener(view -> seekBy(15000));
            if (!mFromXml) mFastForwardButton.setVisibility(mUseFastForward ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        }

        if (mRewindButton != null)
        {
            mRewindButton.setOnClickListener(view -> seekBy(-5000));
            if (!mFromXml) mRewindButton.setVisibility(mUseFastForward ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        }

        if (mNextButton != null && !mFromXml && !mListenersSet) mNextButton.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        if (mPreviousButton != null && !mFromXml && !mListenersSet) mPreviousButton.setVisibility(View.GONE);

        if (mProgress instanceof SeekBar)
        {
            ((SeekBar)mProgress).setOnSeekBarChangeListener(new SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener()
            {
                @Override
                public void onStartTrackingTouch(SeekBar bar)
                {
                    show(3600000);
                    mDragging = true;
                    removeCallbacks(mShowProgress);
                }

                @Override
                public void onProgressChanged(SeekBar bar, int progress, boolean fromUser)
                {
                    if (!fromUser || mPlayer == null) return;

                    long duration = mPlayer.getDuration();
                    long position = duration * progress / PROGRESS_STEPS;
                    mPlayer.seekTo((int)position);
                    if (mCurrentTime != null) mCurrentTime.setText(stringForTime((int)position));
                }

                @Override
                public void onStopTrackingTouch(SeekBar bar)
                {
                    mDragging = false;
                    setProgress();
                    updatePausePlay();
                    show(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT);
                    post(mShowProgress);
                }
            });
        }

        if (mProgress != null) mProgress.setMax(PROGRESS_STEPS);

        installPrevNextListeners();
    }

    private void seekBy(int delta)
    {
        if (mPlayer == null) return;

        mPlayer.seekTo(mPlayer.getCurrentPosition() + delta);
        setProgress();
        show(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT);
    }

    private void installPrevNextListeners()
    {
        if (mNextButton != null)
        {
            mNextButton.setOnClickListener(mNextListener);
            mNextButton.setEnabled(mNextListener != null);
        }

        if (mPreviousButton != null)
        {
            mPreviousButton.setOnClickListener(mPreviousListener);
            mPreviousButton.setEnabled(mPreviousListener != null);
        }
    }

    public void setPrevNextListeners(View.OnClickListener next, View.OnClickListener previous)
    {
        mNextListener = next;
        mPreviousListener = previous;
        mListenersSet = true;

        if (mRoot == null) return;

        installPrevNextListeners();

        if (mNextButton != null && !mFromXml) mNextButton.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        if (mPreviousButton != null && !mFromXml) mPreviousButton.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
    }

    private void disableUnsupportedButtons()
    {
        if (mPlayer == null) return;

        if (mPauseButton != null && !mPlayer.canPause()) mPauseButton.setEnabled(false);
        if (mRewindButton != null && !mPlayer.canSeekBackward()) mRewindButton.setEnabled(false);
        if (mFastForwardButton != null && !mPlayer.canSeekForward()) mFastForwardButton.setEnabled(false);
        if (mProgress != null && !mPlayer.canSeekBackward() && !mPlayer.canSeekForward()) mProgress.setEnabled(false);
    }

    public void show()
    {
        show(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT);
    }

    public void show(int timeout)
    {
        if (!mShowing && mAnchor != null)
        {
            setProgress();
            if (mPauseButton != null) mPauseButton.requestFocus();
            disableUnsupportedButtons();

            if (mWindow != null)
            {
                mWindow.setContentView(this);
                updateWindowLayout();
                mAnchor.getLocationInWindow(mAnchorLocation);
                mWindow.showAtLocation(mAnchor, Gravity.NO_GRAVITY, mAnchorLocation[0],
                                       mAnchorLocation[1] + mAnchor.getHeight() - controllerHeight());
            }
            else
            {
                setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            }

            mShowing = true;
        }

        updatePausePlay();
        post(mShowProgress);

        removeCallbacks(mFadeOut);
        if (timeout != 0) postDelayed(mFadeOut, timeout);
    }

    private int controllerHeight()
    {
        int width = mAnchor == null ? getResources().getDisplayMetrics().widthPixels : mAnchor.getWidth();
        measure(MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(width, MeasureSpec.EXACTLY), MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(0, MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED));
        return getMeasuredHeight();
    }

    private void updateWindowLayout()
    {
        if (mWindow == null || mAnchor == null) return;

        int height = controllerHeight();
        mAnchor.getLocationInWindow(mAnchorLocation);
        int x = mAnchorLocation[0];
        int y = mAnchorLocation[1] + mAnchor.getHeight() - height;

        mWindow.setWidth(mAnchor.getWidth());
        mWindow.setHeight(height);
        if (mWindow.isShowing()) mWindow.update(x, y, mAnchor.getWidth(), height);
    }

    public boolean isShowing()
    {
        return mShowing;
    }

    public void hide()
    {
        if (mAnchor == null || !mShowing) return;

        removeCallbacks(mShowProgress);
        removeCallbacks(mFadeOut);

        if (mWindow != null) mWindow.dismiss();
        else setVisibility(View.GONE);

        mShowing = false;
    }

    private String stringForTime(int timeMs)
    {
        int totalSeconds = Math.max(0, timeMs) / 1000;
        int seconds = totalSeconds % 60;
        int minutes = (totalSeconds / 60) % 60;
        int hours = totalSeconds / 3600;

        mFormatBuilder.setLength(0);
        if (hours > 0) return mFormatter.format("%d:%02d:%02d", hours, minutes, seconds).toString();

        return mFormatter.format("%02d:%02d", minutes, seconds).toString();
    }

    private int setProgress()
    {
        if (mPlayer == null || mDragging) return 0;

        int position = mPlayer.getCurrentPosition();
        int duration = mPlayer.getDuration();

        if (mProgress != null)
        {
            if (duration > 0) mProgress.setProgress((int)(PROGRESS_STEPS * (long)position / duration));
            mProgress.setSecondaryProgress(mPlayer.getBufferPercentage() * 10);
        }

        if (mEndTime != null) mEndTime.setText(stringForTime(duration));
        if (mCurrentTime != null) mCurrentTime.setText(stringForTime(position));

        return position;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        switch (event.getAction())
        {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                show(0);
                break;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                show(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT);
                break;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                hide();
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public boolean onTrackballEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        show(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT);
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event)
    {
        int keyCode = event.getKeyCode();
        boolean uniqueDown = event.getRepeatCount() == 0 && event.getAction() == KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN;

        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_HEADSETHOOK || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_PLAY_PAUSE || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SPACE)
        {
            if (uniqueDown)
            {
                doPauseResume();
                show(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT);
                if (mPauseButton != null) mPauseButton.requestFocus();
            }

            return true;
        }

        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_PLAY)
        {
            if (uniqueDown && mPlayer != null && !mPlayer.isPlaying())
            {
                mPlayer.start();
                updatePausePlay();
                show(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT);
            }

            return true;
        }

        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_STOP || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_PAUSE)
        {
            if (uniqueDown && mPlayer != null && mPlayer.isPlaying())
            {
                mPlayer.pause();
                updatePausePlay();
                show(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT);
            }

            return true;
        }

        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_VOLUME_DOWN || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_VOLUME_UP || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_VOLUME_MUTE
            || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_CAMERA)
        {
            return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
        }

        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MENU)
        {
            if (uniqueDown) hide();
            return true;
        }

        show(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT);
        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
    }

    private void updatePausePlay()
    {
        if (mRoot == null || mPauseButton == null) return;

        boolean playing = mPlayer != null && mPlayer.isPlaying();
        String name = playing ? "ic_media_pause" : "ic_media_play";
        int identifier = mContext.getResources().getIdentifier(name, "drawable", "android");

        if (identifier != 0)
        {
            try
            {
                mPauseButton.setImageDrawable(mContext.getDrawable(identifier));
            }
            catch (RuntimeException missing)
            {
                mPauseButton.setImageDrawable(null);
            }
        }

        mPauseButton.setContentDescription(playing ? "Pause" : "Play");
    }

    private void doPauseResume()
    {
        if (mPlayer == null) return;

        if (mPlayer.isPlaying()) mPlayer.pause();
        else mPlayer.start();

        updatePausePlay();
    }

    @Override
    public void setEnabled(boolean enabled)
    {
        if (mPauseButton != null) mPauseButton.setEnabled(enabled);
        if (mFastForwardButton != null) mFastForwardButton.setEnabled(enabled);
        if (mRewindButton != null) mRewindButton.setEnabled(enabled);
        if (mNextButton != null) mNextButton.setEnabled(enabled && mNextListener != null);
        if (mPreviousButton != null) mPreviousButton.setEnabled(enabled && mPreviousListener != null);
        if (mProgress != null) mProgress.setEnabled(enabled);

        disableUnsupportedButtons();
        super.setEnabled(enabled);
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return MediaController.class.getName();
    }

    public interface MediaPlayerControl
    {
        void start();

        void pause();

        int getDuration();

        int getCurrentPosition();

        void seekTo(int pos);

        boolean isPlaying();

        int getBufferPercentage();

        boolean canPause();

        boolean canSeekBackward();

        boolean canSeekForward();

        int getAudioSessionId();
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/MultiAutoCompleteTextView.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.text.Editable;
import android.text.SpannableString;
import android.text.Spanned;
import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.util.AttributeSet;

public class MultiAutoCompleteTextView extends AutoCompleteTextView
{
    private Tokenizer mTokenizer;

    public MultiAutoCompleteTextView(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public MultiAutoCompleteTextView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, 0);
    }

    public MultiAutoCompleteTextView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public MultiAutoCompleteTextView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
    }

    public void setTokenizer(Tokenizer tokenizer)
    {
        mTokenizer = tokenizer;
    }

    private int cursorPosition()
    {
        Editable text = getText();
        int length = text == null ? 0 : text.length();
        int end = getSelectionEnd();

        if (end < 0 || end > length) end = length;
        return end;
    }

    @Override
    protected void performFiltering(CharSequence text, int keyCode)
    {
        if (enoughToFilter())
        {
            int end = cursorPosition();
            int start = mTokenizer.findTokenStart(text, end);
            performFiltering(text, start, end, keyCode);
            return;
        }

        dismissDropDown();

        Filter filter = getFilter();
        if (filter != null) filter.filter(null);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean enoughToFilter()
    {
        Editable text = getText();
        if (text == null || mTokenizer == null) return false;

        int end = cursorPosition();
        if (end < 0) return false;

        int start = mTokenizer.findTokenStart(text, end);
        return end - start >= getThreshold();
    }

    @Override
    public void performValidation()
    {
        Validator validator = getValidator();
        if (validator == null || mTokenizer == null) return;

        Editable editable = getText();
        int index = editable.length();

        while (index > 0)
        {
            int start = mTokenizer.findTokenStart(editable, index);
            int end = mTokenizer.findTokenEnd(editable, start);

            CharSequence token = editable.subSequence(start, end);
            if (TextUtils.isEmpty(token)) editable.replace(start, index, "");
            else if (!validator.isValid(token)) editable.replace(start, index, mTokenizer.terminateToken(validator.fixText(token)));

            index = start;
        }
    }

    protected void performFiltering(CharSequence text, int start, int end, int keyCode)
    {
        Filter filter = getFilter();
        if (filter != null) filter.filter(text.subSequence(start, end), this);
    }

    @Override
    protected void replaceText(CharSequence text)
    {
        if (mTokenizer == null)
        {
            super.replaceText(text);
            return;
        }

        clearComposingText();

        Editable editable = getText();
        int end = cursorPosition();
        int start = mTokenizer.findTokenStart(editable, end);

        editable.replace(start, end, mTokenizer.terminateToken(text));
    }

    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return MultiAutoCompleteTextView.class.getName();
    }

    public interface Tokenizer
    {
        int findTokenStart(CharSequence text, int cursor);

        int findTokenEnd(CharSequence text, int cursor);

        CharSequence terminateToken(CharSequence text);
    }

    public static class CommaTokenizer implements Tokenizer
    {
        public CommaTokenizer()
        {
        }

        @Override
        public int findTokenStart(CharSequence text, int cursor)
        {
            int index = cursor;

            while (index > 0 && text.charAt(index - 1) != ',') index--;
            while (index < cursor && text.charAt(index) == ' ') index++;

            return index;
        }

        @Override
        public int findTokenEnd(CharSequence text, int cursor)
        {
            int length = text.length();

            for (int index = cursor; index < length; index++)
            {
                if (text.charAt(index) == ',') return index;
            }

            return length;
        }

        @Override
        public CharSequence terminateToken(CharSequence text)
        {
            int index = text.length();

            while (index > 0 && text.charAt(index - 1) == ' ') index--;

            if (index > 0 && text.charAt(index - 1) == ',') return text;

            if (text instanceof Spanned)
            {
                SpannableString terminated = new SpannableString(text + ", ");
                TextUtils.copySpansFrom((Spanned)text, 0, text.length(), Object.class, terminated, 0);
                return terminated;
            }

            return text + ", ";
        }
    }
}
```
