`java/android/widget/NumberPicker.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.VelocityTracker;
import android.view.ViewConfiguration;
import android.view.ViewParent;
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityNodeProvider;

import java.util.Locale;

public class NumberPicker extends LinearLayout
{
    public interface OnValueChangeListener
    {
        void onValueChange(NumberPicker picker, int oldVal, int newVal);
    }

    public interface OnScrollListener
    {
        int SCROLL_STATE_IDLE = 0;
        int SCROLL_STATE_TOUCH_SCROLL = 1;
        int SCROLL_STATE_FLING = 2;

        void onScrollStateChange(NumberPicker view, int scrollState);
    }

    public interface Formatter
    {
        String format(int value);
    }

    private static final int SELECTOR_WHEEL_ITEM_COUNT = 3;
    private static final int SNAP_SCROLL_DURATION = 300;
    private static final float FADING_EDGE_STRENGTH = 0.9f;
    private static final long DEFAULT_LONG_PRESS_UPDATE_INTERVAL = 300;

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private int mMinValue;
    private int mMaxValue;
    private int mValue;
    private String[] mDisplayedValues;
    private Formatter mFormatter;
    private boolean mWrapSelectorWheelPreferred = true;
    private long mLongPressUpdateInterval = DEFAULT_LONG_PRESS_UPDATE_INTERVAL;

    private OnValueChangeListener mOnValueChangeListener;
    private OnScrollListener mOnScrollListener;
    private int mScrollState = OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_IDLE;

    private final Paint mTextPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint mDividerPaint = new Paint();
    private int mTextColor;
    private int mSelectionDividerHeight;
    private int mSolidColor;
    private final float mDensity;

    private int mElementHeight;
    private float mScrollOffset;
    private final Scroller mFlingScroller;
    private final Scroller mAdjustScroller;
    private int mPreviousScrollerY;
    private VelocityTracker mVelocityTracker;
    private float mDownY;
    private float mLastY;
    private boolean mMoved;
    private final int mTouchSlop;
    private final int mMinimumFlingVelocity;
    private final int mMaximumFlingVelocity;

    public NumberPicker(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public NumberPicker(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, ProgressBar.attributeIdentifier(context, "numberPickerStyle"));
    }

    public NumberPicker(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public NumberPicker(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        mDensity = context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        mTextColor = ProgressBar.resolveThemeColor(context, 0xDE000000, "textColorPrimary");
        mSelectionDividerHeight = (int)(2 * mDensity + 0.5f);
        mTextPaint.setTextSize(20 * context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().scaledDensity);
        mTextPaint.setTextAlign(Paint.Align.CENTER);
        mDividerPaint.setColor(ProgressBar.resolveThemeColor(context, 0xFF009688, "colorControlNormal", "colorAccent"));

        ViewConfiguration configuration = ViewConfiguration.get(context);
        mTouchSlop = configuration.getScaledTouchSlop();
        mMinimumFlingVelocity = configuration.getScaledMinimumFlingVelocity();
        mMaximumFlingVelocity = configuration.getScaledMaximumFlingVelocity() / 8;

        mFlingScroller = new Scroller(context, null, true);
        mAdjustScroller = new Scroller(context, new android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator(2.5f));

        setOrientation(VERTICAL);
        setWillNotDraw(false);
        setFocusable(true);
        setVerticalFadingEdgeEnabled(true);

        StyleableSet styleable = styleable(context);
        if (styleable.isEmpty() || (attributes == null && defStyleAttr == 0 && defStyleRes == 0)) return;

        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, styleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        int index = styleable.indexOf("solidColor");
        if (index >= 0) mSolidColor = array.getColor(index, 0);

        index = styleable.indexOf("selectionDividerHeight");
        if (index >= 0) mSelectionDividerHeight = array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, mSelectionDividerHeight);

        index = styleable.indexOf("textColor");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) mTextColor = array.getColor(index, mTextColor);

        index = styleable.indexOf("textSize");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) mTextPaint.setTextSize(array.getDimension(index, mTextPaint.getTextSize()));

        array.recycle();
    }

    private static StyleableSet styleable(Context context)
    {
        if (sStyleable == null)
        {
            sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "solidColor", "selectionDividerHeight", "textColor", "textSize");
        }
        return sStyleable;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onLayout(boolean changed, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        super.onLayout(changed, left, top, right, bottom);

        mElementHeight = Math.max(1, (bottom - top - getPaddingTop() - getPaddingBottom()) / SELECTOR_WHEEL_ITEM_COUNT);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        int widest = 0;

        if (mDisplayedValues != null)
        {
            for (String value : mDisplayedValues) widest = Math.max(widest, measureLabel(value));
        }
        else
        {
            widest = Math.max(measureLabel(formatNumber(mMinValue)), measureLabel(formatNumber(mMaxValue)));
        }

        int width = Math.max((int)(64 * mDensity), widest + (int)(32 * mDensity)) + getPaddingLeft() + getPaddingRight();
        int height = (int)(180 * mDensity) + getPaddingTop() + getPaddingBottom();

        width = Math.max(width, getSuggestedMinimumWidth());
        height = Math.max(height, getSuggestedMinimumHeight());

        setMeasuredDimension(resolveSizeAndState(width, widthMeasureSpec, 0), resolveSizeAndState(height, heightMeasureSpec, 0));
    }

    private int measureLabel(String label)
    {
        return (int)Math.ceil(mTextPaint.measureText(label == null ? "" : label));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onInterceptTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        return isEnabled() && event.getActionMasked() == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (!isEnabled()) return false;

        if (mVelocityTracker == null) mVelocityTracker = VelocityTracker.obtain();
        mVelocityTracker.addMovement(event);

        int action = event.getActionMasked();

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN)
        {
            mDownY = event.getY();
            mLastY = mDownY;
            mMoved = false;

            if (!mFlingScroller.isFinished()) mFlingScroller.forceFinished(true);
            if (!mAdjustScroller.isFinished()) mAdjustScroller.forceFinished(true);

            ViewParent parent = getParent();
            if (parent != null) parent.requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);

            return true;
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE)
        {
            float y = event.getY();

            if (!mMoved && Math.abs(y - mDownY) > mTouchSlop)
            {
                mMoved = true;
                onScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_TOUCH_SCROLL);
            }

            if (mMoved)
            {
                scrollBy(0, (int)(y - mLastY));
                invalidate();
            }

            mLastY = y;
            return true;
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP)
        {
            mVelocityTracker.computeCurrentVelocity(1000, mMaximumFlingVelocity);
            int velocity = (int)mVelocityTracker.getYVelocity();

            if (mMoved && Math.abs(velocity) > mMinimumFlingVelocity)
            {
                fling(velocity);
                onScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_FLING);
            }
            else if (!mMoved)
            {
                float y = event.getY();
                int third = getHeight() / SELECTOR_WHEEL_ITEM_COUNT;

                if (y < third) changeValueByOne(false);
                else if (y > getHeight() - third) changeValueByOne(true);
                else performClick();

                onScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_IDLE);
            }
            else
            {
                ensureScrollWheelAdjusted();
                onScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_IDLE);
            }

            recycleVelocityTracker();
            return true;
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL)
        {
            ensureScrollWheelAdjusted();
            onScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_IDLE);
            recycleVelocityTracker();
            return true;
        }

        return super.onTouchEvent(event);
    }

    private void recycleVelocityTracker()
    {
        if (mVelocityTracker == null) return;

        mVelocityTracker.recycle();
        mVelocityTracker = null;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(event);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event)
    {
        int keyCode = event.getKeyCode();

        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN)
        {
            if (event.getAction() != KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) return true;

            boolean increment = keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN;
            boolean canMove = getWrapSelectorWheel() || (increment ? mValue < mMaxValue : mValue > mMinValue);

            if (canMove)
            {
                changeValueByOne(increment);
                return true;
            }
        }

        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
    }

    public boolean dispatchTrackballEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean dispatchHoverEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        return super.dispatchHoverEvent(event);
    }

    @Override
    public void computeScroll()
    {
        Scroller scroller = !mFlingScroller.isFinished() ? mFlingScroller : mAdjustScroller;
        if (scroller.isFinished()) return;

        scroller.computeScrollOffset();

        int currentY = scroller.getCurrY();

        scrollBy(0, currentY - mPreviousScrollerY);
        mPreviousScrollerY = currentY;

        if (scroller.isFinished())
        {
            mPreviousScrollerY = 0;

            if (scroller == mFlingScroller)
            {
                if (!ensureScrollWheelAdjusted()) onScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_IDLE);
            }
            else
            {
                onScrollStateChange(OnScrollListener.SCROLL_STATE_IDLE);
            }
        }

        invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    public void setEnabled(boolean enabled)
    {
        super.setEnabled(enabled);
        invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    public void scrollBy(int x, int y)
    {
        if (mElementHeight <= 0 || y == 0) return;

        boolean wrap = getWrapSelectorWheel();

        if (!wrap && y > 0 && mValue <= mMinValue && mScrollOffset + y > 0)
        {
            mScrollOffset = 0;
            return;
        }

        if (!wrap && y < 0 && mValue >= mMaxValue && mScrollOffset + y < 0)
        {
            mScrollOffset = 0;
            return;
        }

        mScrollOffset += y;

        while (mScrollOffset > mElementHeight / 2f)
        {
            if (!wrap && mValue <= mMinValue)
            {
                mScrollOffset = 0;
                break;
            }

            mScrollOffset -= mElementHeight;
            setValueInternal(mValue - 1, true);
        }

        while (mScrollOffset < -mElementHeight / 2f)
        {
            if (!wrap && mValue >= mMaxValue)
            {
                mScrollOffset = 0;
                break;
            }

            mScrollOffset += mElementHeight;
            setValueInternal(mValue + 1, true);
        }

        invalidate();
    }

    private void fling(int velocityY)
    {
        if (velocityY > 0) mFlingScroller.fling(0, 0, 0, velocityY, 0, 0, 0, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        else mFlingScroller.fling(0, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0, velocityY, 0, 0, 0, Integer.MAX_VALUE);

        mPreviousScrollerY = mFlingScroller.getStartY();
        invalidate();
    }

    private boolean ensureScrollWheelAdjusted()
    {
        int delta = (int)-mScrollOffset;
        if (delta == 0) return false;

        mAdjustScroller.startScroll(0, 0, 0, delta, SNAP_SCROLL_DURATION);
        mPreviousScrollerY = mAdjustScroller.getStartY();
        invalidate();

        return true;
    }

    private void changeValueByOne(boolean increment)
    {
        if (!mFlingScroller.isFinished()) mFlingScroller.forceFinished(true);
        if (!mAdjustScroller.isFinished()) mAdjustScroller.forceFinished(true);

        mScrollOffset = 0;
        setValueInternal(increment ? mValue + 1 : mValue - 1, true);
        invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    protected int computeVerticalScrollOffset()
    {
        return (int)((mValue - mMinValue) * Math.max(1, mElementHeight) - mScrollOffset);
    }

    @Override
    protected int computeVerticalScrollRange()
    {
        return (mMaxValue - mMinValue + 1) * Math.max(1, mElementHeight);
    }

    @Override
    protected int computeVerticalScrollExtent()
    {
        return getHeight();
    }

    public int getSolidColor()
    {
        return mSolidColor;
    }

    public void setOnValueChangedListener(OnValueChangeListener onValueChangedListener)
    {
        mOnValueChangeListener = onValueChangedListener;
    }

    public void setOnScrollListener(OnScrollListener onScrollListener)
    {
        mOnScrollListener = onScrollListener;
    }

    private void onScrollStateChange(int scrollState)
    {
        if (mScrollState == scrollState) return;

        mScrollState = scrollState;
        if (mOnScrollListener != null) mOnScrollListener.onScrollStateChange(this, scrollState);
    }

    public void setFormatter(Formatter formatter)
    {
        if (formatter == mFormatter) return;

        mFormatter = formatter;
        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setValue(int value)
    {
        setValueInternal(value, false);
    }

    private void setValueInternal(int current, boolean notifyChange)
    {
        if (mValue == current) return;

        if (getWrapSelectorWheel())
        {
            current = wrapValue(current);
        }
        else
        {
            current = Math.max(current, mMinValue);
            current = Math.min(current, mMaxValue);
        }

        int previous = mValue;
        mValue = current;

        boolean changed = previous != current;
        if (notifyChange && changed && mOnValueChangeListener != null) mOnValueChangeListener.onValueChange(this, previous, current);

        invalidate();
    }

    private int wrapValue(int value)
    {
        if (value > mMaxValue) return mMinValue + (value - mMaxValue) % (mMaxValue - mMinValue + 1) - 1;
        if (value < mMinValue) return mMaxValue - (mMinValue - value) % (mMaxValue - mMinValue + 1) + 1;

        return value;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean performClick()
    {
        super.performClick();
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean performLongClick()
    {
        super.performLongClick();
        return true;
    }

    public boolean getWrapSelectorWheel()
    {
        return mWrapSelectorWheelPreferred && mMaxValue - mMinValue >= SELECTOR_WHEEL_ITEM_COUNT;
    }

    public void setWrapSelectorWheel(boolean wrapSelectorWheel)
    {
        mWrapSelectorWheelPreferred = wrapSelectorWheel;
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setOnLongPressUpdateInterval(long intervalMillis)
    {
        mLongPressUpdateInterval = intervalMillis;
    }

    public int getValue()
    {
        return mValue;
    }

    public int getMinValue()
    {
        return mMinValue;
    }

    public void setMinValue(int minValue)
    {
        if (mMinValue == minValue) return;
        if (minValue < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("minValue must be >= 0");

        mMinValue = minValue;
        if (mMinValue > mValue) mValue = mMinValue;

        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public int getMaxValue()
    {
        return mMaxValue;
    }

    public void setMaxValue(int maxValue)
    {
        if (mMaxValue == maxValue) return;
        if (maxValue < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxValue must be >= 0");

        mMaxValue = maxValue;
        if (mMaxValue < mValue) mValue = mMaxValue;

        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public String[] getDisplayedValues()
    {
        return mDisplayedValues;
    }

    public void setDisplayedValues(String[] displayedValues)
    {
        if (mDisplayedValues == displayedValues) return;

        mDisplayedValues = displayedValues;
        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setSelectionDividerHeight(int height)
    {
        mSelectionDividerHeight = height;
        invalidate();
    }

    public int getSelectionDividerHeight()
    {
        return mSelectionDividerHeight;
    }

    @Override
    protected float getTopFadingEdgeStrength()
    {
        return FADING_EDGE_STRENGTH;
    }

    @Override
    protected float getBottomFadingEdgeStrength()
    {
        return FADING_EDGE_STRENGTH;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow()
    {
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();

        mFlingScroller.forceFinished(true);
        mAdjustScroller.forceFinished(true);
        recycleVelocityTracker();
    }

    @Override
    protected void drawableStateChanged()
    {
        super.drawableStateChanged();
        invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    public void jumpDrawablesToCurrentState()
    {
        super.jumpDrawablesToCurrentState();

        if (!mAdjustScroller.isFinished())
        {
            mAdjustScroller.forceFinished(true);
            mScrollOffset = 0;
        }
    }

    private String formatNumber(int value)
    {
        if (mFormatter != null) return mFormatter.format(value);

        return String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%d", value);
    }

    private String labelFor(int value)
    {
        if (mDisplayedValues != null)
        {
            int index = value - mMinValue;
            if (index < 0 || index >= mDisplayedValues.length) return "";

            String label = mDisplayedValues[index];
            return label == null ? "" : label;
        }

        return formatNumber(value);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        super.onDraw(canvas);

        int innerHeight = getHeight() - getPaddingTop() - getPaddingBottom();
        if (mElementHeight <= 0) mElementHeight = Math.max(1, innerHeight / SELECTOR_WHEEL_ITEM_COUNT);

        float centreX = (getPaddingLeft() + getWidth() - getPaddingRight()) / 2f;
        float centreY = (getPaddingTop() + getHeight() - getPaddingBottom()) / 2f;
        Paint.FontMetrics metrics = mTextPaint.getFontMetrics();
        float baselineOffset = -(metrics.ascent + metrics.descent) / 2f;
        boolean wrap = getWrapSelectorWheel();

        for (int slot = -2; slot <= 2; slot++)
        {
            int value = mValue + slot;

            if (wrap) value = wrapValue(value);
            else if (value < mMinValue || value > mMaxValue) continue;

            float y = centreY + slot * mElementHeight + mScrollOffset;
            float distance = Math.min(1f, Math.abs(y - centreY) / mElementHeight);
            int alpha = (int)(255 * (1f - 0.6f * distance));

            if (!isEnabled()) alpha = alpha * 38 / 100;

            mTextPaint.setColor((mTextColor & 0x00FFFFFF) | ((((mTextColor >>> 24) * alpha) / 255) << 24));
            canvas.drawText(labelFor(value), centreX, y + baselineOffset, mTextPaint);
        }

        if (mSelectionDividerHeight <= 0) return;

        float half = mElementHeight / 2f;
        float left = getPaddingLeft();
        float right = getWidth() - getPaddingRight();

        canvas.drawRect(left, centreY - half - mSelectionDividerHeight, right, centreY - half, mDividerPaint);
        canvas.drawRect(left, centreY + half, right, centreY + half + mSelectionDividerHeight, mDividerPaint);
    }

    public AccessibilityNodeProvider getAccessibilityNodeProvider()
    {
        return null;
    }

    public void setTextColor(int color)
    {
        mTextColor = color;
        invalidate();
    }

    public int getTextColor()
    {
        return mTextColor;
    }

    public void setTextSize(float size)
    {
        mTextPaint.setTextSize(size);
        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public float getTextSize()
    {
        return mTextPaint.getTextSize();
    }

    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return NumberPicker.class.getName();
    }
}
```

```java
import android.content.Context;

public class OverScroller
{
    private final Scroller mScroller;

    public OverScroller(Context context)

        this(context, null);

    public OverScroller(Context context, Interpolator interpolator, float bounceX, float bounceY)

    public OverScroller(Context context, Interpolator interpolator, float bounceX, float bounceY, boolean flywheel)

        this(context, interpolator);

    public final boolean isFinished()

    }

    public final void forceFinished(boolean finished)

        mScroller.forceFinished(finished);
    }

    public final int getCurrX()

    }

    }

    }

    public final int getFinalY()

        return mScroller.getFinalY();
    }

    {
        return mScroller.getDuration();
    }

    {
        return mScroller.getCurrVelocity();
    }

    public boolean computeScrollOffset()
    {
        return mScroller.computeScrollOffset();
    }

    public void startScroll(int startX, int startY, int deltaX, int deltaY)
    {
        mScroller.startScroll(startX, startY, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    public void startScroll(int startX, int startY, int deltaX, int deltaY, int duration)
    {
        mScroller.startScroll(startX, startY, deltaX, deltaY, duration);
    }

    public void fling(int startX, int startY, int velocityX, int velocityY, int minX, int maxX, int minY, int maxY)
    {
        fling(startX, startY, velocityX, velocityY, minX, maxX, minY, maxY, 0, 0);
    }

    public void fling(int startX, int startY, int velocityX, int velocityY, int minX, int maxX, int minY, int maxY,
                      int overX, int overY)
    {
        mOverX = overX;
        mOverY = overY;

        mScroller.fling(startX, startY, velocityX, velocityY, minX - overX, maxX + overX, minY - overY, maxY + overY);
    }

    public boolean springBack(int startX, int startY, int minX, int maxX, int minY, int maxY)
    {
        int targetX = Scroller.clamp(startX, minX, maxX);
        int targetY = Scroller.clamp(startY, minY, maxY);

        if (targetX == startX && targetY == startY)
        {
            mScroller.forceFinished(true);
            return false;
        }

        mScroller.startScroll(startX, startY, targetX - startX, targetY - startY);
        return true;
    }

    public void notifyHorizontalEdgeReached(int start, int end, int overX)
    {
        mOverX = overX;
        springBack(start, getCurrY(), end, end, getCurrY(), getCurrY());
    }

    public void notifyVerticalEdgeReached(int start, int end, int overY)
    {
        mOverY = overY;
        springBack(getCurrX(), start, getCurrX(), getCurrX(), end, end);
    }

    public boolean isOverScrolled()
    {
        return false;
    }

    public void abortAnimation()
    {
        mScroller.abortAnimation();
    }

    public void extendDuration(int extra)
    {
        mScroller.extendDuration(extra);
    }

    public int timePassed()
    {
        return mScroller.timePassed();
    }
}
```

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.Menu;
import android.view.MenuInflater;
import android.view.MenuItem;
import android.view.RuntimeMenu;
import android.view.SubMenu;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

import java.util.List;

public class PopupMenu
{
    private static final float MINIMUM_WIDTH_DIP = 112;
    private static final float MAXIMUM_WIDTH_DIP = 320;
    private static final float ITEM_HEIGHT_DIP = 48;
    private static final float ITEM_PADDING_DIP = 16;
    private static final float ICON_SIZE_DIP = 24;

    private final Context mContext;
    private final RuntimeMenu mMenu;
    private final View mAnchor;
    private ListPopupWindow mPopup;
    private int mGravity;
    private boolean mForceShowIcon;
    private boolean mSwitchingMenu;
    private OnMenuItemClickListener mMenuItemClickListener;
    private OnDismissListener mOnDismissListener;
    private View.OnTouchListener mDragListener;

    public PopupMenu(Context context, View anchor)
    {
        this(context, anchor, Gravity.NO_GRAVITY);
    }

    public PopupMenu(Context context, View anchor, int gravity)
    {
        this(context, anchor, gravity, 0, 0);
    }

    public PopupMenu(Context context, View anchor, int gravity, int popupStyleAttr, int popupStyleRes)
    {
        mContext = context;
        mAnchor = anchor;
        mGravity = gravity;
        mMenu = new RuntimeMenu(context);
        mMenu.setCallback(new RuntimeMenu.Callback()
        {
            @Override
            public boolean onMenuItemSelected(RuntimeMenu menu, MenuItem item)
            {
                return mMenuItemClickListener != null && mMenuItemClickListener.onMenuItemClick(item);
            }
        });
    }

    public void setGravity(int gravity)
    {
        mGravity = gravity;
    }

    public int getGravity()
    {
        return mGravity;
    }

    public View.OnTouchListener getDragToOpenListener()
    {
        if (mDragListener == null) mDragListener = popup().createDragToOpenListener(mAnchor);
        return mDragListener;
    }

    public Menu getMenu()
    {
        return mMenu;
    }

    public MenuInflater getMenuInflater()
    {
        return new MenuInflater(mContext);
    }

    public void inflate(int menuRes)
    {
        getMenuInflater().inflate(menuRes, mMenu);
    }

    public void show()
    {
        showMenu(mMenu);
    }

    public void dismiss()
    {
        if (mPopup != null) mPopup.dismiss();
    }

    public void setOnMenuItemClickListener(OnMenuItemClickListener listener)
    {
        mMenuItemClickListener = listener;
    }

    public void setOnDismissListener(OnDismissListener listener)
    {
        mOnDismissListener = listener;
    }

    public void setForceShowIcon(boolean forceShowIcon)
    {
        mForceShowIcon = forceShowIcon;
    }

    private ListPopupWindow popup()
    {
        if (mPopup != null) return mPopup;

        mPopup = new ListPopupWindow(mContext);
        mPopup.setModal(true);
        mPopup.setOnDismissListener(new PopupWindow.OnDismissListener()
        {
            @Override
            public void onDismiss()
            {
                if (!mSwitchingMenu && mOnDismissListener != null) mOnDismissListener.onDismiss(PopupMenu.this);
            }
        });

        return mPopup;
    }

    private void showMenu(RuntimeMenu menu)
    {
        if (mAnchor == null) throw new IllegalStateException("MenuPopupHelper cannot be used without an anchor");

        final MenuAdapter adapter = new MenuAdapter(menu.getVisibleItems(), menuHasIcons(menu));
        ListPopupWindow popup = popup();

        popup.setAdapter(adapter);
        popup.setAnchorView(mAnchor);
        popup.setDropDownGravity(mGravity);
        popup.setContentWidth(measureContentWidth(adapter));
        popup.setOnItemClickListener(new AdapterView.OnItemClickListener()
        {
            @Override
            public void onItemClick(AdapterView<?> parent, View view, int position, long id)
            {
                onMenuItemChosen(adapter.getItem(position));
            }
        });

        if (popup.isShowing())
        {
            mSwitchingMenu = true;
            popup.dismiss();
            mSwitchingMenu = false;
        }

        popup.show();
    }

    private void onMenuItemChosen(MenuItem item)
    {
        if (item == null || !item.isEnabled()) return;

        mMenu.performItemAction(item);
        SubMenu subMenu = item.getSubMenu();

        if (item.hasSubMenu() && subMenu instanceof RuntimeMenu)
        {
            RuntimeMenu runtimeSubMenu = (RuntimeMenu)subMenu;
            runtimeSubMenu.setCallback(new RuntimeMenu.Callback()
            {
                @Override
                public boolean onMenuItemSelected(RuntimeMenu menu, MenuItem selected)
                {
                    return mMenuItemClickListener != null && mMenuItemClickListener.onMenuItemClick(selected);
                }
            });

            showMenu(runtimeSubMenu);
            return;
        }

        dismiss();
    }

    private boolean menuHasIcons(RuntimeMenu menu)
    {
        if (!mForceShowIcon) return false;

        for (MenuItem item : menu.getVisibleItems())
        {
            if (item.getIcon() != null) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private int measureContentWidth(MenuAdapter adapter)
    {
        float density = mContext.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        int screenWidth = mContext.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().widthPixels;
        int maximum = Math.max(screenWidth / 2, (int)(MAXIMUM_WIDTH_DIP * density));
        int widest = (int)(MINIMUM_WIDTH_DIP * density);

        int widthSpec = View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(0, View.MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED);
        int heightSpec = View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(0, View.MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED);
        FrameLayout measureParent = new FrameLayout(mContext);
        View convertView = null;

        for (int position = 0; position < adapter.getCount(); position++)
        {
            convertView = adapter.getView(position, convertView, measureParent);
            convertView.measure(widthSpec, heightSpec);

            int width = convertView.getMeasuredWidth();
            if (width >= maximum) return maximum;
            widest = Math.max(widest, width);
        }

        return widest;
    }

    public interface OnMenuItemClickListener
    {
        boolean onMenuItemClick(MenuItem item);
    }

    public interface OnDismissListener
    {
        void onDismiss(PopupMenu menu);
    }

    private final class MenuAdapter extends BaseAdapter
    {
        private final List<MenuItem> mItems;
        private final boolean mShowIcons;

        MenuAdapter(List<MenuItem> items, boolean showIcons)
        {
            mItems = items;
            mShowIcons = showIcons;
        }

        @Override
        public int getCount()
        {
            return mItems.size();
        }

        @Override
        public MenuItem getItem(int position)
        {
            return position >= 0 && position < mItems.size() ? mItems.get(position) : null;
        }

        @Override
        public long getItemId(int position)
        {
            MenuItem item = getItem(position);
            return item == null ? position : item.getItemId();
        }

        @Override
        public boolean areAllItemsEnabled()
        {
            for (MenuItem item : mItems)
            {
                if (!item.isEnabled()) return false;
            }

            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isEnabled(int position)
        {
            MenuItem item = getItem(position);
            return item != null && item.isEnabled();
        }

        @Override
        public View getView(int position, View convertView, ViewGroup parent)
        {
            MenuItem item = mItems.get(position);
            float density = mContext.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;

            ItemView view = convertView instanceof ItemView ? (ItemView)convertView : new ItemView(mContext, density);
            view.bind(item, mShowIcons, density);
            return view;
        }
    }

    private static final class ItemView extends LinearLayout
    {
        private final ImageView mIcon;
        private final CheckedTextView mTitle;

        ItemView(Context context, float density)
        {
            super(context);

            setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
            setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
            setMinimumHeight((int)(ITEM_HEIGHT_DIP * density));

            int padding = (int)(ITEM_PADDING_DIP * density);
            setPadding(padding, 0, padding, 0);

            int iconSize = (int)(ICON_SIZE_DIP * density);
            mIcon = new ImageView(context);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams iconParams = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(iconSize, iconSize);
            iconParams.rightMargin = padding;
            addView(mIcon, iconParams);

            mTitle = new CheckedTextView(context);
            mTitle.setTextSize(16);
            mTitle.setSingleLine(true);
            addView(mTitle, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        }

        void bind(MenuItem item, boolean showIcons, float density)
        {
            Drawable icon = item.getIcon();
            mIcon.setImageDrawable(icon);
            mIcon.setVisibility(showIcons && icon != null ? View.VISIBLE : showIcons ? View.INVISIBLE : View.GONE);

            CharSequence title = item.getTitle();
            if (title == null) title = "";
            if (item.isCheckable() && item.isChecked()) title = title + "  ✓";
            if (item.hasSubMenu()) title = title + "  ▸";

            mTitle.setText(title);
            mTitle.setChecked(item.isCheckable() && item.isChecked());
            mTitle.setAlpha(item.isEnabled() ? 1.0f : 0.38f);

            int verticalPadding = (int)(12 * density);
            mTitle.setPadding(0, verticalPadding, 0, verticalPadding);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    public PopupWindow(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        mContext = context;
        mWindowManager = context == null ? null : (WindowManager)context.getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE);

        if (context != null && attributes != null) readAttributes(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
    }

    private void readAttributes(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        if (sStyleable == null) sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "popupBackground", "popupElevation", "overlapAnchor");
        if (sStyleable.isEmpty()) return;

        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        int backgroundIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("popupBackground");
        if (backgroundIndex >= 0 && array.hasValue(backgroundIndex))
        {
            try
            {
                mBackground = array.getDrawable(backgroundIndex);
            }
            catch (RuntimeException unsupported)
            {
                mBackground = null;
            }
        }

        int elevationIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("popupElevation");
        if (elevationIndex >= 0) mElevation = array.getDimension(elevationIndex, 0);

        int overlapIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("overlapAnchor");
        if (overlapIndex >= 0) mOverlapAnchor = array.getBoolean(overlapIndex, false);

        array.recycle();
    }

    public void showAtLocation(View parent, int gravity, int x, int y)
    {
        if (isShowing() || mContentView == null) return;

        detachFromAnchor();

        mIsShowing = true;
        mIsDropdown = false;

        WindowManager.LayoutParams params = createPopupLayoutParams();
        params.gravity = gravity == Gravity.NO_GRAVITY ? Gravity.TOP | Gravity.LEFT : gravity;
        params.x = x;
        params.y = y;

        preparePopup(params);
        invokePopup(params);
    }

    public void showAsDropDown(View anchor)
    {
        showAsDropDown(anchor, 0, 0);
    }

    public void showAsDropDown(View anchor, int xoff, int yoff)
    {
        showAsDropDown(anchor, xoff, yoff, DEFAULT_ANCHORED_GRAVITY);
    }

    public void showAsDropDown(View anchor, int xoff, int yoff, int gravity)
    {
        if (isShowing() || mContentView == null || anchor == null) return;

        attachToAnchor(anchor, xoff, yoff, gravity);

        mIsShowing = true;
        mIsDropdown = true;

        WindowManager.LayoutParams params = createPopupLayoutParams();
        preparePopup(params);

        mAboveAnchor = findDropDownPosition(anchor, params, xoff, yoff, gravity);
        invokePopup(params);
    }

    public boolean isAboveAnchor()

        return mAboveAnchor;

        return getMaxAvailableHeight(anchor, yOffset, false);
    }

    public int getMaxAvailableHeight(View anchor, int yOffset, boolean ignoreBottomDecorations)
    {
        Rect display = displayFrame(anchor, ignoreBottomDecorations);
        int[] location = new int[2];
        locateInWindow(anchor, location);

        int distanceToBottom = display.bottom - (location[1] + anchor.getHeight()) - yOffset;
        int distanceToTop = location[1] - display.top + yOffset;
        int available = Math.max(distanceToBottom, distanceToTop);

        if (mBackground != null)
        {
            Rect padding = new Rect();
            mBackground.getPadding(padding);
            available -= padding.top + padding.bottom;
        }

        return available;
    }

    public void dismiss()
    {
        if (!isShowing()) return;

        mIsShowing = false;

        PopupDecorView decor = mDecorView;
        mDecorView = null;

        if (decor != null)
        {
            try
            {
                if (mWindowManager != null) mWindowManager.removeViewImmediate(decor);
            }
            finally
            {
                decor.removeAllViews();
            }
        }

        detachFromAnchor();

        if (mOnDismissListener != null) mOnDismissListener.onDismiss();
    }

    public void setOnDismissListener(OnDismissListener listener)
    {
        mOnDismissListener = listener;
    }

    public void update()
    {
        if (!isShowing() || mDecorView == null) return;

        WindowManager.LayoutParams params = (WindowManager.LayoutParams)mDecorView.getLayoutParams();
        params.flags = computeFlags(params.flags);
        if (mAnimationStyle != ANIMATION_STYLE_DEFAULT) params.windowAnimations = mAnimationStyle;

        mDecorView.setBackground(mBackground);
        mDecorView.setElevation(mElevation);
        mWindowManager.updateViewLayout(mDecorView, params);
    }

    public void update(int width, int height)
    {
        if (!isShowing() || mDecorView == null) return;

        WindowManager.LayoutParams params = (WindowManager.LayoutParams)mDecorView.getLayoutParams();
        update(params.x, params.y, width, height, false);
    }

    public void update(int x, int y, int width, int height)
    {
        update(x, y, width, height, false);
    }

    public void update(int x, int y, int width, int height, boolean force)
    {
        if (width >= 0) setWidth(width);
        if (height >= 0) setHeight(height);

        if (!isShowing() || mDecorView == null) return;

        WindowManager.LayoutParams params = (WindowManager.LayoutParams)mDecorView.getLayoutParams();
        params.width = resolvedWidth();
        params.height = resolvedHeight();

        if (x != -1) params.x = x;
        if (y != -1) params.y = y;

        params.flags = computeFlags(params.flags);
        mWindowManager.updateViewLayout(mDecorView, params);
    }

    public void update(View anchor, int width, int height)
    {
        update(anchor, false, 0, 0, width, height);
    }

    public void update(View anchor, int xoff, int yoff, int width, int height)
    {
        update(anchor, true, xoff, yoff, width, height);
    }

    private void update(View anchor, boolean updateLocation, int xoff, int yoff, int width, int height)
    {
        if (!isShowing() || mDecorView == null || anchor == null) return;

        WeakReference<View> oldAnchor = mAnchor;
        if (oldAnchor == null || oldAnchor.get() != anchor || (updateLocation && (mAnchorXoff != xoff || mAnchorYoff != yoff)))
        {
            attachToAnchor(anchor, updateLocation ? xoff : mAnchorXoff, updateLocation ? yoff : mAnchorYoff, mAnchoredGravity);
        }

        if (width >= 0) setWidth(width);
        if (height >= 0) setHeight(height);

        WindowManager.LayoutParams params = (WindowManager.LayoutParams)mDecorView.getLayoutParams();
        params.width = resolvedWidth();
        params.height = resolvedHeight();
        params.flags = computeFlags(params.flags);

        measureDecor(params);
        mAboveAnchor = findDropDownPosition(anchor, params, mAnchorXoff, mAnchorYoff, mAnchoredGravity);
        mWindowManager.updateViewLayout(mDecorView, params);
    }

    private void attachToAnchor(View anchor, int xoff, int yoff, int gravity)
    {
        detachFromAnchor();

        anchor.addOnAttachStateChangeListener(mAnchorDetachListener);

        mAnchor = new WeakReference<View>(anchor);
        mAnchorXoff = xoff;
        mAnchorYoff = yoff;
        mAnchoredGravity = gravity;
    }

    private void detachFromAnchor()
    {
        View anchor = mAnchor == null ? null : mAnchor.get();
        if (anchor != null) anchor.removeOnAttachStateChangeListener(mAnchorDetachListener);

        mAnchor = null;
    }

    private int resolvedWidth()
    {
        return mWidthMode < 0 ? mWidthMode : mWidth;
    }

    private int resolvedHeight()
    {
        return mHeightMode < 0 ? mHeightMode : mHeight;
    }

    private WindowManager.LayoutParams createPopupLayoutParams()
    {
        WindowManager.LayoutParams params = new WindowManager.LayoutParams();
        params.gravity = Gravity.TOP | Gravity.LEFT;
        params.flags = computeFlags(params.flags);
        params.type = mWindowLayoutType;
        params.softInputMode = mSoftInputMode;
        params.format = PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;
        params.width = resolvedWidth();
        params.height = resolvedHeight();
        if (mAnimationStyle != ANIMATION_STYLE_DEFAULT) params.windowAnimations = mAnimationStyle;
        params.setTitle("PopupWindow:" + Integer.toHexString(hashCode()));
        return params;
    }

    private int computeFlags(int flags)
    {
        flags &= ~(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_IGNORE_CHEEK_PRESSES | WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE
                   | WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE | WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_WATCH_OUTSIDE_TOUCH
                   | WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS | WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN
                   | WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_INSET_DECOR | WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SPLIT_TOUCH
                   | WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL | WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_ALT_FOCUSABLE_IM);

        if (mIgnoreCheekPress) flags |= WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_IGNORE_CHEEK_PRESSES;

        if (!mFocusable)
        {
            flags |= WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE | WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL;
            if (mInputMethodMode == INPUT_METHOD_NEEDED) flags |= WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_ALT_FOCUSABLE_IM;
        }
        else if (mInputMethodMode == INPUT_METHOD_NOT_NEEDED)
        {
            flags |= WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_ALT_FOCUSABLE_IM;
        }

        if (!mTouchModal) flags |= WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL;
        if (!mTouchable) flags |= WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE;
        if (mOutsideTouchable) flags |= WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_WATCH_OUTSIDE_TOUCH;
        if (!mClippingEnabled || mClippedToScreen) flags |= WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS;
        if (mSplitTouchEnabled) flags |= WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SPLIT_TOUCH;

        flags |= WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN;
        return flags;
    }

    private void preparePopup(WindowManager.LayoutParams params)
    {
        if (mDecorView != null) mDecorView.removeAllViews();

        ViewParent oldParent = mContentView.getParent();
        if (oldParent instanceof ViewGroup) ((ViewGroup)oldParent).removeView(mContentView);

        Context context = mContext != null ? mContext : mContentView.getContext();
        mDecorView = new PopupDecorView(context);
        mDecorView.setBackground(mBackground);
        mDecorView.setElevation(mElevation);
        mDecorView.setClipChildren(true);

        ViewGroup.LayoutParams contentParams = mContentView.getLayoutParams();
        int width = ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT;
        int height = ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT;
        if (contentParams != null)
        {
            if (contentParams.height == ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT) height = ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
            if (contentParams.width == ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT) width = ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        }

        mDecorView.addView(mContentView, new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(width, height));
        mDecorView.setLayoutParams(params);

        if (mFocusable)
        {
            mDecorView.setFocusable(true);
            mDecorView.setFocusableInTouchMode(true);
        }

        measureDecor(params);
    }

    private void invokePopup(WindowManager.LayoutParams params)
    {
        if (mWindowManager == null)
        {
            android.util.Log.w("PopupWindow", "a popup window has no window manager to show it, so it stays hidden");
            return;
        }

        mWindowManager.addView(mDecorView, params);
        if (mFocusable) mDecorView.requestFocus();
    }

    private void measureDecor(WindowManager.LayoutParams params)
    {
        Rect display = displayFrame(anchorView(), false);
        int widthSpec = decorSpec(params.width, display.width());
        int heightSpec = decorSpec(params.height, display.height());
        mDecorView.measure(widthSpec, heightSpec);
    }

    private static int decorSpec(int size, int available)
    {
        if (size == ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT) return View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(available, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY);
        if (size == ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT) return View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(available, View.MeasureSpec.AT_MOST);
        return View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(Math.max(0, size), View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY);
    }

    private View anchorView()
    {
        return mAnchor == null ? null : mAnchor.get();
    }

    private boolean findDropDownPosition(View anchor, WindowManager.LayoutParams params, int xOffset, int yOffset, int gravity)
    {
        int anchorHeight = anchor.getHeight();
        int anchorWidth = anchor.getWidth();
        if (mOverlapAnchor) yOffset -= anchorHeight;

        int[] location = new int[2];
        locateInWindow(anchor, location);

        int width = mDecorView.getMeasuredWidth();
        int height = mDecorView.getMeasuredHeight();

        params.gravity = Gravity.TOP | Gravity.LEFT;
        params.x = location[0] + xOffset;
        params.y = location[1] + anchorHeight + yOffset;

        int horizontal = Gravity.getAbsoluteGravity(gravity, anchor.getLayoutDirection()) & Gravity.HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK;
        if (horizontal == Gravity.RIGHT) params.x -= width - anchorWidth;

        Rect display = displayFrame(anchor, false);
        boolean above = false;

        if (params.y + height > display.bottom)
        {
            int aboveTop = location[1] - height + (mOverlapAnchor ? anchorHeight : 0) - (mOverlapAnchor ? 0 : yOffset);
            int spaceAbove = location[1] - display.top;
            int spaceBelow = display.bottom - (location[1] + anchorHeight);

            if (aboveTop >= display.top || spaceAbove > spaceBelow)
            {
                params.y = Math.max(display.top, aboveTop);
                above = true;
            }
        }

        if (mClippingEnabled)
        {
            if (params.x + width > display.right) params.x = display.right - width;
            if (params.x < display.left) params.x = display.left;

            if (params.y + height > display.bottom) params.y = Math.max(display.top, display.bottom - height);
            if (params.y < display.top) params.y = display.top;
        }

        return above;
    }

    Rect displayFrame(View anchor, boolean ignoreBottomDecorations)
    {
        ViewRootImpl root = ViewRootImpl.active();
        int width;
        int height;
        int insetTop = 0;
        int insetBottom = 0;

        if (root != null)
        {
            width = root.getWindowWidth();
            height = root.getWindowHeight();

            WindowInsets insets = root.getWindowInsets();
            if (insets != null)
            {
                insetTop = insets.getSystemWindowInsetTop();
                insetBottom = insets.getSystemWindowInsetBottom();
            }
        }
        else if (anchor != null)
        {
            View top = anchor.getRootView();
            width = top.getWidth();
            height = top.getHeight();
        }
        else
        {
            android.util.DisplayMetrics metrics = mContext == null ? null : mContext.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
            width = metrics == null ? 1280 : metrics.widthPixels;
            height = metrics == null ? 720 : metrics.heightPixels;
        }

        if (ignoreBottomDecorations) insetBottom = 0;
        return new Rect(0, insetTop, width, Math.max(insetTop, height - insetBottom));
    }

    static void locateInWindow(View view, int[] out)
    {
        float x = 0;
        float y = 0;
        View cursor = view;

        for (;;)
        {
            x += cursor.getLeft() + cursor.getTranslationX();
            y += cursor.getTop() + cursor.getTranslationY();

            ViewParent parent = cursor.getParent();
            if (!(parent instanceof View)) break;

            View parentView = (View)parent;
            x -= parentView.getScrollX();
            y -= parentView.getScrollY();
            cursor = parentView;
        }

        ViewRootImpl root = ViewRootImpl.active();
        ViewGroup.LayoutParams rootParams = cursor.getLayoutParams();

        if (root != null && rootParams instanceof WindowManager.LayoutParams && root.hasPanel(cursor))
        {
            Rect frame = panelFrame(root, cursor, (WindowManager.LayoutParams)rootParams);
            x += frame.left;
            y += frame.top;
        }

        out[0] = Math.round(x);
        out[1] = Math.round(y);
    }

    private static Rect panelFrame(ViewRootImpl root, View panel, WindowManager.LayoutParams params)
    {
        int width = root.getWindowWidth();
        int height = root.getWindowHeight();
        int insetTop = 0;
        int insetBottom = 0;

        WindowInsets insets = root.getWindowInsets();
        if (insets != null)
        {
            insetTop = insets.getSystemWindowInsetTop();
            insetBottom = insets.getSystemWindowInsetBottom();
        }

        int screenFlags = WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN | WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS;
        boolean fullScreen = (params.flags & screenFlags) != 0;

        int top = fullScreen ? 0 : insetTop;
        int bottom = fullScreen ? height : height - insetBottom;
        Rect container = new Rect(0, top, width, Math.max(top, bottom));

        int gravity = params.gravity == Gravity.NO_GRAVITY ? Gravity.TOP | Gravity.LEFT : params.gravity;
        gravity = Gravity.getAbsoluteGravity(gravity, View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_LTR);

        Rect frame = new Rect();
        Gravity.apply(gravity, panel.getWidth(), panel.getHeight(), container, params.x, params.y, frame);
        return frame;
    }

    static Drawable defaultPopupBackground(Context context)
    {
        int color = DEFAULT_POPUP_COLOR;

        try
        {
            int attribute = context.getResources().getIdentifier("colorBackgroundFloating", "attr", "android");
            TypedValue value = new TypedValue();

            if (attribute != 0 && context.getTheme().resolveAttribute(attribute, value, true))
            {
                boolean isColor = value.type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_COLOR_INT && value.type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_COLOR_INT;
                boolean isReference = value.type == TypedValue.TYPE_REFERENCE && value.data != 0;

                if (isColor) color = value.data;
                else if (isReference) color = context.getResources().getColor(value.data, context.getTheme());
            }
        }
        catch (RuntimeException unresolved)
        {
            color = DEFAULT_POPUP_COLOR;
        }

        if ((color >>> 24) == 0) color = DEFAULT_POPUP_COLOR;
        return new ColorDrawable(color);
    }

    private boolean handleKey(KeyEvent event)
    {
        int keyCode = event.getKeyCode();
        if (keyCode != KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK && keyCode != KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE) return false;

        if (event.getAction() == KeyEvent.ACTION_UP && !event.isCanceled()) dismiss();
        return true;
    }

    public interface OnDismissListener
    {
        void onDismiss();
    }

    private class PopupDecorView extends FrameLayout
    {
        PopupDecorView(Context context)
        {
            super(context);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event)
        {
            if (super.dispatchKeyEvent(event)) return true;
            return handleKey(event);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
        {
            if (mTouchInterceptor != null && mTouchInterceptor.onTouch(this, event)) return true;
            return super.dispatchTouchEvent(event);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
        {
            int x = (int)event.getX();
            int y = (int)event.getY();
            int action = event.getActionMasked();

            if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN && (x < 0 || x >= getWidth() || y < 0 || y >= getHeight()))
            {
                dismiss();
                return true;
            }

            if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_OUTSIDE)
            {
                dismiss();
                return true;
            }

            return super.onTouchEvent(event);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
            if (!mAnimating) return;

            invalidate();
            postDelayed(this, FRAME_DELAY);
        }
    };

    public ProgressBar(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public ProgressBar(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, attributeIdentifier(context, "progressBarStyle"));
    }

    public ProgressBar(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public ProgressBar(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        mDensity = context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        mAccentColor = resolveThemeColor(context, DEFAULT_ACCENT, "colorControlActivated", "colorAccent");

        mMinWidth = (int)(24 * mDensity);
        mMaxWidth = (int)(48 * mDensity);
        mMinHeight = (int)(24 * mDensity);
        mMaxHeight = (int)(48 * mDensity);

        StyleableSet styleable = styleable(context);
        if (!styleable.isEmpty() && (attributes != null || defStyleAttr != 0 || defStyleRes != 0))
        {
            TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, styleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
            readAttributes(array, styleable);
            array.recycle();
        }

        if (mInterpolator == null) mInterpolator = new LinearInterpolator();
        if (mOnlyIndeterminate) mIndeterminate = true;

        attachDrawable(mProgressDrawable);
        attachDrawable(mIndeterminateDrawable);
        applyProgressTints();
        applyIndeterminateTint();

        mCurrentDrawable = mIndeterminate ? mIndeterminateDrawable : mProgressDrawable;
    }

    private static StyleableSet styleable(Context context)
    {
        if (sStyleable == null)
        {
            sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "min", "max", "progress", "secondaryProgress", "indeterminate",
                                         "indeterminateOnly", "minWidth", "maxWidth", "minHeight", "maxHeight", "progressDrawable",
                                         "indeterminateDrawable", "progressTint", "progressBackgroundTint", "secondaryProgressTint",
                                         "indeterminateTint", "interpolator");
        }
        return sStyleable;
    }

    private void readAttributes(TypedArray array, StyleableSet styleable)
    {
        int index = styleable.indexOf("progressDrawable");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) mProgressDrawable = loadDrawable(array, index);

        index = styleable.indexOf("indeterminateDrawable");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) mIndeterminateDrawable = loadDrawable(array, index);

        index = styleable.indexOf("minWidth");
        if (index >= 0) mMinWidth = array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, mMinWidth);

        index = styleable.indexOf("maxWidth");
        if (index >= 0) mMaxWidth = array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, mMaxWidth);

        index = styleable.indexOf("minHeight");
        if (index >= 0) mMinHeight = array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, mMinHeight);

        index = styleable.indexOf("maxHeight");
        if (index >= 0) mMaxHeight = array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, mMaxHeight);

        index = styleable.indexOf("interpolator");
        if (index >= 0)
        {
            int resource = array.getResourceId(index, 0);
            if (resource != 0) setInterpolator(getContext(), resource);
        }

        index = styleable.indexOf("min");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) setMin(array.getInt(index, mMin));

        index = styleable.indexOf("max");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) setMax(array.getInt(index, mMax));

        index = styleable.indexOf("progress");
        if (index >= 0) setProgress(array.getInt(index, mProgress));

        index = styleable.indexOf("secondaryProgress");
        if (index >= 0) setSecondaryProgress(array.getInt(index, mSecondaryProgress));

        index = styleable.indexOf("indeterminateOnly");
        if (index >= 0) mOnlyIndeterminate = array.getBoolean(index, false);

        index = styleable.indexOf("indeterminate");
        if (index >= 0) mIndeterminate = array.getBoolean(index, mIndeterminate);

        mProgressTintList = readTint(array, styleable, "progressTint", mProgressTintList);
        mProgressBackgroundTintList = readTint(array, styleable, "progressBackgroundTint", mProgressBackgroundTintList);
        mSecondaryProgressTintList = readTint(array, styleable, "secondaryProgressTint", mSecondaryProgressTintList);
        mIndeterminateTintList = readTint(array, styleable, "indeterminateTint", mIndeterminateTintList);
    }

    private static ColorStateList readTint(TypedArray array, StyleableSet styleable, String name, ColorStateList fallback)
    {
        int index = styleable.indexOf(name);
        if (index < 0 || !array.hasValue(index)) return fallback;

        try
        {
            ColorStateList list = array.getColorStateList(index);
            return list != null ? list : fallback;
        }
        catch (RuntimeException unresolved)
        {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    private static Drawable loadDrawable(TypedArray array, int index)
    {
        try
        {
            return array.getDrawable(index);
        }
        catch (Throwable unsupported)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    static int attributeIdentifier(Context context, String name)
    {
        if (context == null) return 0;

        return context.getResources().getIdentifier(name, "attr", "android");
    }

    static int resolveThemeColor(Context context, int fallback, String... names)
    {
        for (String name : names)
        {
            int identifier = attributeIdentifier(context, name);
            if (identifier == 0) continue;

            try
            {
                TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(new int[] {identifier});
                boolean present = array.hasValue(0);
                int color = array.getColor(0, fallback);
                array.recycle();

                if (present) return color;
            }
            catch (RuntimeException unresolved)
            {
                continue;
            }
        }

        return fallback;
    }

    float density()
    {
        return mDensity;
    }

    int accentColor()
    {
        return mAccentColor;
    }

    static int tintColor(ColorStateList list, int[] state, int fallback)
    {
        if (list == null) return fallback;

        return list.getColorForState(state, list.getDefaultColor());
    }

    public synchronized boolean isIndeterminate()
    {
        return mIndeterminate;
    }

    public synchronized void setIndeterminate(boolean indeterminate)
    {
        if (mOnlyIndeterminate && !indeterminate) return;
        if (mIndeterminate == indeterminate) return;

        mIndeterminate = indeterminate;

        if (indeterminate)
        {
            mCurrentDrawable = mIndeterminateDrawable;
            startAnimation();
        }
        else
        {
            mCurrentDrawable = mProgressDrawable;
            stopAnimation();
        }

        invalidate();
    }

    public Drawable getIndeterminateDrawable()
    {
        return mIndeterminateDrawable;
    }

    public void setIndeterminateDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        if (mIndeterminateDrawable == drawable) return;

        boolean animating = mAnimating;
        if (animating) stopAnimation();

        if (mIndeterminateDrawable != null) mIndeterminateDrawable.setCallback(null);

        mIndeterminateDrawable = drawable;
        attachDrawable(drawable);
        applyIndeterminateTint();

        if (mIndeterminate) mCurrentDrawable = drawable;
        if (animating) startAnimation();

        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    private void attachDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        if (drawable == null) return;

        drawable.setCallback(this);
        if (drawable.isStateful()) drawable.setState(getDrawableState());
    }

    public void setProgressDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        if (mProgressDrawable == drawable) return;

        if (mProgressDrawable != null) mProgressDrawable.setCallback(null);

        mProgressDrawable = drawable;
        attachDrawable(drawable);
        applyProgressTints();

        if (drawable != null)
        {
            int drawableHeight = drawable.getMinimumHeight();
            if (mMaxHeight < drawableHeight) mMaxHeight = drawableHeight;
        }

        if (!mIndeterminate) mCurrentDrawable = drawable;

        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean verifyDrawable(Drawable who)
    {
        return who == mProgressDrawable || who == mIndeterminateDrawable || super.verifyDrawable(who);
    }

    @Override

    {
        super.jumpDrawablesToCurrentState();

        if (mProgressDrawable != null) mProgressDrawable.jumpToCurrentState();
        if (mIndeterminateDrawable != null) mIndeterminateDrawable.jumpToCurrentState();
    }
```
