```java
    public synchronized void setProgress(int progress)
    {
        setProgressInternal(progress, false, false);
    }

    public void setProgress(int progress, boolean animate)
    {
        setProgressInternal(progress, false, animate);
    }

    synchronized boolean setProgressInternal(int progress, boolean fromUser, boolean animate)
    {
        if (mIndeterminate) return false;

        progress = Math.max(mMin, Math.min(mMax, progress));
        if (progress == mProgress) return false;

        mProgress = progress;
        invalidate();
        onProgressRefresh(getScale(progress), fromUser, progress);

        return true;
    }

    void onProgressRefresh(float scale, boolean fromUser, int progress)
    {
    }

    float getScale(int progress)
    {
        int range = mMax - mMin;
        return range > 0 ? (progress - mMin) / (float)range : 0f;
    }

    public synchronized void setSecondaryProgress(int secondaryProgress)
    {
        if (mIndeterminate) return;

        secondaryProgress = Math.max(mMin, Math.min(mMax, secondaryProgress));
        if (secondaryProgress == mSecondaryProgress) return;

        mSecondaryProgress = secondaryProgress;
        invalidate();
    }

    public synchronized int getProgress()
    {
        return mIndeterminate ? 0 : mProgress;
    }

    public synchronized int getSecondaryProgress()
    {
        return mIndeterminate ? 0 : mSecondaryProgress;
    }

    public synchronized int getMin()
    {
        return mMin;
    }

    public synchronized int getMax()
    {
        return mMax;
    }

    public synchronized void setMin(int min)
    {
        if (mMaxInitialised && min > mMax) min = mMax;

        mMinInitialised = true;
        if (mMin == min) return;

        mMin = min;
        if (mProgress < min) mProgress = min;
        if (mSecondaryProgress < min) mSecondaryProgress = min;

        invalidate();
        onProgressRefresh(getScale(mProgress), false, mProgress);
    }

    public synchronized void setMax(int max)
    {
        if (mMinInitialised && max < mMin) max = mMin;

        mMaxInitialised = true;
        if (mMax == max) return;

        mMax = max;
        if (mProgress > max) mProgress = max;
        if (mSecondaryProgress > max) mSecondaryProgress = max;

        invalidate();
        onProgressRefresh(getScale(mProgress), false, mProgress);
    }

    public final synchronized void incrementProgressBy(int diff)
    {
        setProgress(mProgress + diff);
    }

    public final synchronized void incrementSecondaryProgressBy(int diff)
    {
        setSecondaryProgress(mSecondaryProgress + diff);
    }

    public void setInterpolator(Context context, int resourceId)
    {
        try
        {
            setInterpolator(AnimationUtils.loadInterpolator(context, resourceId));
        }
        catch (RuntimeException unsupported)
        {
            setInterpolator(new LinearInterpolator());
        }
    }

    public void setInterpolator(Interpolator interpolator)
    {
        mInterpolator = interpolator == null ? new LinearInterpolator() : interpolator;
    }

    public Interpolator getInterpolator()
    {
        return mInterpolator;
    }

    @Override
    public void onVisibilityAggregated(boolean isVisible)
    {
        super.onVisibilityAggregated(isVisible);

        mAggregatedVisible = isVisible;

        if (mIndeterminate && mAggregatedVisible && isAttachedToWindow()) startAnimation();
        else stopAnimation();
    }

    void startAnimation()
    {
        if (!mIndeterminate || mAnimating || getVisibility() != VISIBLE) return;

        mAnimating = true;
        mAnimationStart = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();

        removeCallbacks(mAnimationTick);

        if (mIndeterminateDrawable instanceof Animatable)
        {
            ((Animatable)mIndeterminateDrawable).start();
            return;
        }

        postDelayed(mAnimationTick, FRAME_DELAY);
    }

    void stopAnimation()
    {
        if (!mAnimating) return;

        mAnimating = false;
        removeCallbacks(mAnimationTick);

        if (mIndeterminateDrawable instanceof Animatable) ((Animatable)mIndeterminateDrawable).stop();
    }

    @Override
    public void invalidateDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        if (!verifyDrawable(drawable))
        {
            super.invalidateDrawable(drawable);
            return;
        }

        android.graphics.Rect dirty = drawable.getBounds();
        int scrollX = getScrollX() + getPaddingLeft();
        int scrollY = getScrollY() + getPaddingTop();

        invalidate(dirty.left + scrollX, dirty.top + scrollY, dirty.right + scrollX, dirty.bottom + scrollY);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onSizeChanged(int width, int height, int oldWidth, int oldHeight)
    {
        super.onSizeChanged(width, height, oldWidth, oldHeight);
    }

    @Override
    protected synchronized void onDraw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        super.onDraw(canvas);

        int left = getPaddingLeft();
        int top = getPaddingTop();
        int right = getWidth() - getPaddingRight();
        int bottom = getHeight() - getPaddingBottom();

        if (right <= left || bottom <= top) return;

        if (mIndeterminate) drawIndeterminate(canvas, left, top, right, bottom);
        else drawTrack(canvas, left, top, right, bottom);

        if (mIndeterminate && !mAnimating && isAttachedToWindow()) startAnimation();
    }

    void drawTrack(Canvas canvas, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        float primary = getScale(mProgress);
        float secondary = getScale(mSecondaryProgress);

        if (mProgressDrawable != null)
        {
            applyVisualProgress(LAYER_SECONDARY_PROGRESS, secondary);
            applyVisualProgress(LAYER_PROGRESS, primary);

            mProgressDrawable.setBounds(left, top, right, bottom);
            mProgressDrawable.draw(canvas);
            return;
        }

        int[] state = getDrawableState();
        int trackColor = tintColor(mProgressBackgroundTintList, state, (mAccentColor & 0x00FFFFFF) | 0x4C000000);
        int secondaryColor = tintColor(mSecondaryProgressTintList, state, (mAccentColor & 0x00FFFFFF) | 0x80000000);
        int progressColor = tintColor(mProgressTintList, state, mAccentColor);

        drawBar(canvas, left, top, right, bottom, 1f, trackColor);
        drawBar(canvas, left, top, right, bottom, secondary, secondaryColor);
        drawBar(canvas, left, top, right, bottom, primary, progressColor);
    }

    private void applyVisualProgress(int layerId, float scale)
    {
        Drawable target = mProgressDrawable;

        if (target instanceof LayerDrawable)
        {
            Drawable layer = ((LayerDrawable)target).findDrawableByLayerId(layerId);
            target = layer != null ? layer : layerId == LAYER_PROGRESS ? target : null;
        }
        else if (layerId != LAYER_PROGRESS)
        {
            target = null;
        }

        if (target != null) target.setLevel((int)(scale * 10000));
    }

    private void applyProgressTints()
    {
        if (mProgressDrawable == null) return;

        if (mProgressTintList != null) tintLayer(LAYER_PROGRESS, mProgressTintList, true);
        if (mProgressBackgroundTintList != null) tintLayer(LAYER_BACKGROUND, mProgressBackgroundTintList, false);
        if (mSecondaryProgressTintList != null) tintLayer(LAYER_SECONDARY_PROGRESS, mSecondaryProgressTintList, false);
    }

    private void tintLayer(int layerId, ColorStateList tint, boolean fallbackToRoot)
    {
        Drawable target = null;

        if (mProgressDrawable instanceof LayerDrawable) target = ((LayerDrawable)mProgressDrawable).findDrawableByLayerId(layerId);
        if (target == null && fallbackToRoot) target = mProgressDrawable;

        applyTint(target, tint, getDrawableState());
    }

    private void applyIndeterminateTint()
    {
        applyTint(mIndeterminateDrawable, mIndeterminateTintList, getDrawableState());
    }

    static void applyTint(Drawable drawable, ColorStateList tint, int[] state)
    {
        if (drawable == null || tint == null) return;

        drawable.mutate();
        drawable.setTintList(tint);
        if (drawable.isStateful()) drawable.setState(state);
    }

    private void drawBar(Canvas canvas, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, float scale, int color)
    {
        if (scale <= 0f) return;

        boolean rightToLeft = getLayoutDirection() == LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL;
        float extent = (right - left) * Math.min(1f, scale);
        float clipLeft = rightToLeft ? right - extent : left;
        float clipRight = rightToLeft ? right : left + extent;

        float thickness = Math.min(bottom - top, 4 * mDensity);
        float centre = (top + bottom) / 2f;

        mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
        mPaint.setColor(color);
        canvas.drawRect(clipLeft, centre - thickness / 2f, clipRight, centre + thickness / 2f, mPaint);
    }

    private void drawIndeterminate(Canvas canvas, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        long elapsed = SystemClock.uptimeMillis() - mAnimationStart;
        int width = right - left;
        int height = bottom - top;

        if (mIndeterminateDrawable != null)
        {
            Drawable drawable = mIndeterminateDrawable;
            int intrinsicWidth = drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
            int intrinsicHeight = drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();

            if (mOnlyIndeterminate && intrinsicWidth > 0 && intrinsicHeight > 0)
            {
                float intrinsicAspect = (float)intrinsicWidth / intrinsicHeight;
                float boundAspect = (float)width / height;

                if (intrinsicAspect > boundAspect)
                {
                    int scaledHeight = (int)(width / intrinsicAspect);
                    top += (height - scaledHeight) / 2;
                    bottom = top + scaledHeight;
                }
                else if (intrinsicAspect < boundAspect)
                {
                    int scaledWidth = (int)(height * intrinsicAspect);
                    left += (width - scaledWidth) / 2;
                    right = left + scaledWidth;
                }
            }

            if (!(drawable instanceof Animatable)) drawable.setLevel((int)((elapsed % SLIDE_DURATION) * 10000 / SLIDE_DURATION));

            drawable.setBounds(left, top, right, bottom);
            drawable.draw(canvas);
            return;
        }

        int color = tintColor(mIndeterminateTintList, getDrawableState(), mAccentColor);

        if (width > height * 3)
        {
            float phase = mInterpolator.getInterpolation((elapsed % SLIDE_DURATION) / (float)SLIDE_DURATION);
            float thickness = Math.min(height, 4 * mDensity);
            float centre = (top + bottom) / 2f;
            float segment = width * 0.4f;
            float start = left - segment + (width + segment) * phase;

            mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
            mPaint.setColor((color & 0x00FFFFFF) | 0x4C000000);
            canvas.drawRect(left, centre - thickness / 2f, right, centre + thickness / 2f, mPaint);

            mPaint.setColor(color);
            canvas.drawRect(Math.max(left, start), centre - thickness / 2f, Math.min(right, start + segment), centre + thickness / 2f,
                            mPaint);
            return;
        }

        float rotation = (elapsed % ROTATION_DURATION) * 360f / ROTATION_DURATION;
        int size = Math.min(width, height);
        float centreX = (left + right) / 2f;
        float centreY = (top + bottom) / 2f;

        float stroke = Math.max(2f, size / 12f);
        float radius = size / 2f - stroke;
        float cycle = (elapsed % (ROTATION_DURATION * 2)) / (float)ROTATION_DURATION;
        float sweep = cycle < 1f ? 20f + 250f * cycle : 270f - 250f * (cycle - 1f);
        float start = rotation * 2f + (cycle < 1f ? 0f : 250f * (cycle - 1f));

        mArcBounds.set(centreX - radius, centreY - radius, centreX + radius, centreY + radius);
        mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        mPaint.setStrokeWidth(stroke);
        mPaint.setStrokeCap(Paint.Cap.ROUND);
        mPaint.setColor(color);
        canvas.drawArc(mArcBounds, start - 90f, sweep, false, mPaint);
    }

    int intrinsicContentWidth()
    {
        Drawable drawable = mCurrentDrawable;
        if (drawable != null && drawable.getIntrinsicWidth() > 0) return drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();

        return mIndeterminate ? (int)(48 * mDensity) : 0;
    }

    int intrinsicContentHeight()
    {
        Drawable drawable = mCurrentDrawable;
        if (drawable != null && drawable.getIntrinsicHeight() > 0) return drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();

        return mIndeterminate ? (int)(48 * mDensity) : (int)(4 * mDensity);
    }

    @Override
    protected synchronized void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        int contentWidth = Math.max(mMinWidth, Math.min(mMaxWidth, intrinsicContentWidth()));
        int contentHeight = Math.max(mMinHeight, Math.min(mMaxHeight, intrinsicContentHeight()));

        int width = contentWidth + getPaddingLeft() + getPaddingRight();
        int height = contentHeight + getPaddingTop() + getPaddingBottom();

        setMeasuredDimension(resolveSizeAndState(width, widthMeasureSpec, 0), resolveSizeAndState(height, heightMeasureSpec, 0));
    }

    @Override
    protected void drawableStateChanged()
    {
        super.drawableStateChanged();

        int[] state = getDrawableState();

        if (mProgressDrawable != null && mProgressDrawable.isStateful()) mProgressDrawable.setState(state);
        if (mIndeterminateDrawable != null && mIndeterminateDrawable.isStateful()) mIndeterminateDrawable.setState(state);

        invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    public void drawableHotspotChanged(float x, float y)
    {
        super.drawableHotspotChanged(x, y);

        if (mProgressDrawable != null) mProgressDrawable.setHotspot(x, y);
    }

    @Override
    public Parcelable onSaveInstanceState()
    {
        SavedState state = new SavedState(super.onSaveInstanceState());
        state.mProgress = mProgress;
        state.mSecondaryProgress = mSecondaryProgress;
        return state;
    }

    @Override
    public void onRestoreInstanceState(Parcelable state)
    {
        if (!(state instanceof SavedState))
        {
            super.onRestoreInstanceState(state);
            return;
        }

        SavedState saved = (SavedState)state;
        super.onRestoreInstanceState(saved.getSuperState());

        setProgress(saved.mProgress);
        setSecondaryProgress(saved.mSecondaryProgress);
    }

    static class SavedState extends BaseSavedState
    {
        public static final Parcelable.Creator<SavedState> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<SavedState>()
        {
            @Override
            public SavedState createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                return new SavedState(source);
            }

            @Override
            public SavedState[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new SavedState[size];
            }
        };

        int mProgress;
        int mSecondaryProgress;

        SavedState(Parcelable superState)
        {
            super(superState);
        }

        private SavedState(Parcel source)
        {
            super(source);
            mProgress = source.readInt();
            mSecondaryProgress = source.readInt();
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
        {
            super.writeToParcel(out, flags);
            out.writeInt(mProgress);
            out.writeInt(mSecondaryProgress);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onAttachedToWindow()
    {
        super.onAttachedToWindow();

        if (mIndeterminate) startAnimation();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow()
    {
        stopAnimation();

        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return ProgressBar.class.getName();
    }

    public boolean isAnimating()
    {
        return mAnimating && isIndeterminate() && getWindowVisibility() == VISIBLE && isShown();
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/RadioGroup.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityNodeInfo;
import android.view.autofill.AutofillValue;

public class RadioGroup extends LinearLayout
{
    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private int mCheckedId = View.NO_ID;
    private CompoundButton.OnCheckedChangeListener mChildOnCheckedChangeListener;
    private boolean mProtectFromCheckedChange;
    private OnCheckedChangeListener mOnCheckedChangeListener;
    private PassThroughHierarchyChangeListener mPassThroughListener;

    public RadioGroup(Context context)
    {
        super(context);
        setOrientation(VERTICAL);
        init();
    }

    public RadioGroup(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        int orientation = VERTICAL;

        if (attributes != null)
        {
            if (sStyleable == null) sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "checkedButton", "orientation");

            if (!sStyleable.isEmpty())
            {
                TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), 0, 0);

                int checkedIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("checkedButton");
                if (checkedIndex >= 0)
                {
                    int value = array.getResourceId(checkedIndex, View.NO_ID);
                    if (value != View.NO_ID) mCheckedId = value;
                }

                int orientationIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("orientation");
                if (orientationIndex >= 0) orientation = array.getInt(orientationIndex, VERTICAL);

                array.recycle();
            }
        }

        setOrientation(orientation);
        init();
    }

    private void init()
    {
        mChildOnCheckedChangeListener = new CheckedStateTracker();
        mPassThroughListener = new PassThroughHierarchyChangeListener();
        super.setOnHierarchyChangeListener(mPassThroughListener);
    }

    @Override
    public void setOnHierarchyChangeListener(OnHierarchyChangeListener listener)
    {
        mPassThroughListener.mOnHierarchyChangeListener = listener;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onFinishInflate()
    {
        super.onFinishInflate();

        if (mCheckedId == View.NO_ID) return;

        mProtectFromCheckedChange = true;
        setCheckedStateForView(mCheckedId, true);
        mProtectFromCheckedChange = false;
        setCheckedId(mCheckedId);
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child, int index, ViewGroup.LayoutParams params)
    {
        if (child instanceof RadioButton)
        {
            RadioButton button = (RadioButton)child;

            if (button.isChecked())
            {
                mProtectFromCheckedChange = true;
                if (mCheckedId != View.NO_ID) setCheckedStateForView(mCheckedId, false);
                mProtectFromCheckedChange = false;
                setCheckedId(button.getId());
            }
        }

        super.addView(child, index, params);
    }

    public void check(int id)
    {
        if (id != View.NO_ID && id == mCheckedId) return;

        if (mCheckedId != View.NO_ID) setCheckedStateForView(mCheckedId, false);
        if (id != View.NO_ID) setCheckedStateForView(id, true);

        setCheckedId(id);
    }

    private void setCheckedId(int id)
    {
        mCheckedId = id;

        if (mOnCheckedChangeListener != null) mOnCheckedChangeListener.onCheckedChanged(this, mCheckedId);
    }

    private void setCheckedStateForView(int viewId, boolean checked)
    {
        View checkedView = findViewById(viewId);
        if (checkedView instanceof RadioButton) ((RadioButton)checkedView).setChecked(checked);
    }

    public int getCheckedRadioButtonId()
    {
        return mCheckedId;
    }

    public void clearCheck()
    {
        check(View.NO_ID);
    }

    public void setOnCheckedChangeListener(OnCheckedChangeListener listener)
    {
        mOnCheckedChangeListener = listener;
    }

    @Override
    public LayoutParams generateLayoutParams(AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        return new RadioGroup.LayoutParams(getContext(), attributes);
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean checkLayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams layoutParams)
    {
        return layoutParams instanceof RadioGroup.LayoutParams;
    }

    @Override
    protected LinearLayout.LayoutParams generateDefaultLayoutParams()
    {
        return new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
    }

    @Override
    protected LinearLayout.LayoutParams generateLayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams source)
    {
        if (source instanceof RadioGroup.LayoutParams) return (RadioGroup.LayoutParams)source;
        if (source instanceof MarginLayoutParams) return new LayoutParams((MarginLayoutParams)source);
        return new LayoutParams(source);
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return RadioGroup.class.getName();
    }

    @Override
    public void onInitializeAccessibilityNodeInfo(AccessibilityNodeInfo info)
    {
        super.onInitializeAccessibilityNodeInfo(info);
    }

    @Override
    public void autofill(AutofillValue value)
    {
        if (!isEnabled() || value == null) return;

        if (!value.isList()) return;

        int index = value.getListValue();
        View child = getChildAt(index);
        if (child == null) return;

        check(child.getId());
    }

    @Override
    public int getAutofillType()
    {
        return isEnabled() ? AUTOFILL_TYPE_LIST : AUTOFILL_TYPE_NONE;
    }

    @Override
    public AutofillValue getAutofillValue()
    {
        if (!isEnabled()) return null;

        int count = getChildCount();

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            if (child.getId() == mCheckedId) return AutofillValue.forList(index);
        }

        return null;
    }

    public static class LayoutParams extends LinearLayout.LayoutParams
    {
        public LayoutParams(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
        {
            super(context, attributes);
        }

        public LayoutParams(int width, int height)
        {
            super(width, height);
        }

        public LayoutParams(int width, int height, float initWeight)
        {
            super(width, height, initWeight);
        }

        public LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams source)
        {
            super(source);
        }

        public LayoutParams(MarginLayoutParams source)
        {
            super(source);
        }

        @Override
        protected void setBaseAttributes(TypedArray array, int widthAttr, int heightAttr)
        {
            width = array.hasValue(widthAttr) ? array.getLayoutDimension(widthAttr, "layout_width") : WRAP_CONTENT;
            height = array.hasValue(heightAttr) ? array.getLayoutDimension(heightAttr, "layout_height") : WRAP_CONTENT;
        }
    }

    public interface OnCheckedChangeListener
    {
        void onCheckedChanged(RadioGroup group, int checkedId);
    }

    private class CheckedStateTracker implements CompoundButton.OnCheckedChangeListener
    {
        @Override
        public void onCheckedChanged(CompoundButton buttonView, boolean isChecked)
        {
            if (mProtectFromCheckedChange) return;

            mProtectFromCheckedChange = true;
            if (mCheckedId != View.NO_ID) setCheckedStateForView(mCheckedId, false);
            mProtectFromCheckedChange = false;

            setCheckedId(buttonView.getId());
        }
    }

    private class PassThroughHierarchyChangeListener implements ViewGroup.OnHierarchyChangeListener
    {
        private ViewGroup.OnHierarchyChangeListener mOnHierarchyChangeListener;

        @Override
        public void onChildViewAdded(View parent, View child)
        {
            if (parent == RadioGroup.this && child instanceof RadioButton)
            {
                int id = child.getId();

                if (id == View.NO_ID)
                {
                    id = View.generateViewId();
                    child.setId(id);
                }

                ((RadioButton)child).setOnCheckedChangeWidgetListener(mChildOnCheckedChangeListener);
            }

            if (mOnHierarchyChangeListener != null) mOnHierarchyChangeListener.onChildViewAdded(parent, child);
        }

        @Override
        public void onChildViewRemoved(View parent, View child)
        {
            if (parent == RadioGroup.this && child instanceof RadioButton)
            {
                ((RadioButton)child).setOnCheckedChangeWidgetListener(null);
            }

            if (mOnHierarchyChangeListener != null) mOnHierarchyChangeListener.onChildViewRemoved(parent, child);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/RatingBar.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.StyleableSet;

public class RatingBar extends AbsSeekBar
{
    public interface OnRatingBarChangeListener
    {
        void onRatingChanged(RatingBar ratingBar, float rating, boolean fromUser);
    }

    private static final int DEFAULT_NUM_STARS = 5;
    private static final float DEFAULT_STEP_SIZE = 0.5f;

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private int mNumStars = DEFAULT_NUM_STARS;
    private float mStepSize = DEFAULT_STEP_SIZE;
    private int mProgressOnStartTracking;
    private OnRatingBarChangeListener mOnRatingBarChangeListener;
    private final Paint mStarPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Path mStarPath = new Path();

    public RatingBar(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public RatingBar(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        int numStars = DEFAULT_NUM_STARS;
        float stepSize = DEFAULT_STEP_SIZE;
        float rating = -1f;

        StyleableSet styleable = styleable(context);
        if (!styleable.isEmpty() && (attributes != null || defStyleAttr != 0 || defStyleRes != 0))
        {
            TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, styleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

            int index = styleable.indexOf("numStars");
            if (index >= 0) numStars = array.getInt(index, numStars);

            index = styleable.indexOf("isIndicator");
            if (index >= 0) setIsIndicator(array.getBoolean(index, false));

            index = styleable.indexOf("rating");
            if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) rating = array.getFloat(index, rating);

            index = styleable.indexOf("stepSize");
            if (index >= 0) stepSize = array.getFloat(index, stepSize);

            array.recycle();
        }

        if (numStars <= 0) numStars = DEFAULT_NUM_STARS;

        mNumStars = numStars;
        setStepSize(stepSize);

        if (rating >= 0) setRating(rating);

        mTouchProgressOffset = 0.6f;
    }

    public RatingBar(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, attributeIdentifier(context, "ratingBarStyle"));
    }

    public RatingBar(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    private static StyleableSet styleable(Context context)
    {
        if (sStyleable == null) sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "numStars", "isIndicator", "rating", "stepSize");
        return sStyleable;
    }

    public void setOnRatingBarChangeListener(OnRatingBarChangeListener listener)
    {
        mOnRatingBarChangeListener = listener;
    }

    public OnRatingBarChangeListener getOnRatingBarChangeListener()
    {
        return mOnRatingBarChangeListener;
    }

    public void setIsIndicator(boolean isIndicator)
    {
        mIsUserSeekable = !isIndicator;
        setFocusable(!isIndicator);
    }

    public boolean isIndicator()
    {
        return !mIsUserSeekable;
    }

    public void setNumStars(int numStars)
    {
        if (numStars <= 0) return;

        float rating = getRating();

        mNumStars = numStars;
        setMax(Math.max(1, Math.round(numStars / mStepSize)));
        setRating(rating);
        requestLayout();
    }

    public int getNumStars()
    {
        return mNumStars;
    }

    public void setRating(float rating)
    {
        setProgress(Math.round(rating * getProgressPerStar()));
    }

    public float getRating()
    {
        return getProgress() / getProgressPerStar();
    }

    public void setStepSize(float stepSize)
    {
        if (stepSize <= 0) return;

        float newMax = mNumStars / stepSize;
        int newProgress = (int)(newMax / Math.max(1, getMax()) * getProgress());

        mStepSize = stepSize;
        setMax((int)newMax);
        setProgress(newProgress);
    }

    public float getStepSize()
    {
        return (float)getNumStars() / Math.max(1, getMax());
    }

    private float getProgressPerStar()
    {
        if (mNumStars > 0) return 1f * getMax() / mNumStars;

        return 1;
    }

    @Override
    void onProgressRefresh(float scale, boolean fromUser, int progress)
    {
        super.onProgressRefresh(scale, fromUser, progress);

        if (!fromUser) dispatchRatingChange(false);
    }

    @Override
    void onStartTrackingTouch()
    {
        mProgressOnStartTracking = getProgress();

        super.onStartTrackingTouch();
    }

    @Override
    void onStopTrackingTouch()
    {
        super.onStopTrackingTouch();

        if (getProgress() != mProgressOnStartTracking) dispatchRatingChange(true);
    }

    @Override
    void onKeyChange()
    {
        super.onKeyChange();

        dispatchRatingChange(true);
    }

    void dispatchRatingChange(boolean fromUser)
    {
        if (mOnRatingBarChangeListener != null) mOnRatingBarChangeListener.onRatingChanged(this, getRating(), fromUser);
    }

    @Override
    boolean drawsDefaultThumb()
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    int intrinsicContentHeight()
    {
        return (int)(48 * density());
    }

    @Override
    void drawTrack(Canvas canvas, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        int stars = Math.max(1, mNumStars);
        float starSize = Math.min(bottom - top, (right - left) / (float)stars);
        float rating = getRating();
        int[] state = getDrawableState();

        int filledColor = tintColor(getProgressTintList(), state, accentColor());
        int emptyColor = tintColor(getProgressBackgroundTintList(), state, 0x42000000);
        float starTop = top + ((bottom - top) - starSize) / 2f;

        boolean rightToLeft = getLayoutDirection() == LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL;

        for (int index = 0; index < stars; index++)
        {
            float starLeft = rightToLeft ? right - (index + 1) * starSize : left + index * starSize;

            buildStar(starLeft, starTop, starSize);

            mStarPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
            mStarPaint.setColor(emptyColor);
            canvas.drawPath(mStarPath, mStarPaint);

            float fill = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, rating - index));
            if (fill <= 0f) continue;

            int saveCount = canvas.save();

            if (rightToLeft) canvas.clipRect(starLeft + starSize * (1f - fill), starTop, starLeft + starSize, starTop + starSize);
            else canvas.clipRect(starLeft, starTop, starLeft + starSize * fill, starTop + starSize);

            mStarPaint.setColor(filledColor);
            canvas.drawPath(mStarPath, mStarPaint);
            canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
        }
    }

    private void buildStar(float left, float top, float size)
    {
        float centreX = left + size / 2f;
        float centreY = top + size * 0.53f;
        float outer = size * 0.48f;
        float inner = outer * 0.4f;

        mStarPath.reset();

        for (int point = 0; point < 10; point++)
        {
            double angle = Math.PI / 5 * point - Math.PI / 2;
            float radius = (point & 1) == 0 ? outer : inner;
            float x = centreX + (float)(Math.cos(angle) * radius);
            float y = centreY + (float)(Math.sin(angle) * radius);

            if (point == 0) mStarPath.moveTo(x, y);
            else mStarPath.lineTo(x, y);
        }

        mStarPath.close();
    }

    @Override
    protected synchronized void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        super.onMeasure(widthMeasureSpec, heightMeasureSpec);

        int starSize = getMeasuredHeight() - getPaddingTop() - getPaddingBottom();
        int width = starSize * mNumStars + getPaddingLeft() + getPaddingRight();

        setMeasuredDimension(resolveSizeAndState(width, widthMeasureSpec, 0), getMeasuredHeightAndState());
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void setMax(int max)
    {
        if (max <= 0) return;

        super.setMax(max);
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return RatingBar.class.getName();
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/RelativeLayout.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

public class RelativeLayout extends ViewGroup
{
    public static final int TRUE = -1;

    public static final int LEFT_OF = 0;
    public static final int RIGHT_OF = 1;
    public static final int ABOVE = 2;
    public static final int BELOW = 3;
    public static final int ALIGN_BASELINE = 4;
    public static final int ALIGN_LEFT = 5;
    public static final int ALIGN_TOP = 6;
    public static final int ALIGN_RIGHT = 7;
    public static final int ALIGN_BOTTOM = 8;
    public static final int ALIGN_PARENT_LEFT = 9;
    public static final int ALIGN_PARENT_TOP = 10;
    public static final int ALIGN_PARENT_RIGHT = 11;
    public static final int ALIGN_PARENT_BOTTOM = 12;
    public static final int CENTER_IN_PARENT = 13;
    public static final int CENTER_HORIZONTAL = 14;
    public static final int CENTER_VERTICAL = 15;
    public static final int START_OF = 16;
    public static final int END_OF = 17;
    public static final int ALIGN_START = 18;
    public static final int ALIGN_END = 19;
    public static final int ALIGN_PARENT_START = 20;
    public static final int ALIGN_PARENT_END = 21;

    private static final int RULE_COUNT = 22;
    private static final int UNRESOLVED = Integer.MIN_VALUE;

    private int mGravity = Gravity.START | Gravity.TOP;
    private int mIgnoreGravity = View.NO_ID;

    public RelativeLayout(Context context)
    {
        super(context);
    }

    public RelativeLayout(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);
    }

    public RelativeLayout(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr);
    }

    public RelativeLayout(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
    }

    public void setGravity(int gravity)
    {
        if (mGravity == gravity) return;

        mGravity = gravity;
        requestLayout();
    }

    public void setHorizontalGravity(int gravity)
    {
        setGravity((mGravity & ~Gravity.HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK) | (gravity & Gravity.HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK));
    }

    public void setVerticalGravity(int gravity)
    {
        setGravity((mGravity & ~Gravity.VERTICAL_GRAVITY_MASK) | (gravity & Gravity.VERTICAL_GRAVITY_MASK));
    }

    public int getGravity()
    {
        return mGravity;
    }

    public void setIgnoreGravity(int viewId)
    {
        mIgnoreGravity = viewId;
    }

    public int getIgnoreGravity()
    {
        return mIgnoreGravity;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean shouldDelayChildPressedState()
    {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return RelativeLayout.class.getName();
    }

    @Override
    public LayoutParams generateLayoutParams(AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        return new LayoutParams(getContext(), attributes);
    }

    @Override
    protected LayoutParams generateDefaultLayoutParams()
    {
        return new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
    }

    @Override
    protected LayoutParams generateLayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams source)
    {
        if (source instanceof LayoutParams) return (LayoutParams)source;
        if (source instanceof MarginLayoutParams) return new LayoutParams((MarginLayoutParams)source);
        return new LayoutParams(source);
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean checkLayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams layoutParams)
    {
        return layoutParams instanceof LayoutParams;
    }

    private LayoutParams paramsFor(View child)
    {
        ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = child.getLayoutParams();
        if (params instanceof LayoutParams) return (LayoutParams)params;

        LayoutParams converted = generateLayoutParams(params == null ? generateDefaultLayoutParams() : params);
        child.setLayoutParams(converted);

        return converted;
    }

    private View childWithId(int id)
    {
        if (id == View.NO_ID) return null;

        for (int index = 0; index < getChildCount(); index++)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            if (child.getId() == id) return child;
        }

        return null;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        final int widthMode = MeasureSpec.getMode(widthMeasureSpec);
        final int heightMode = MeasureSpec.getMode(heightMeasureSpec);

        final int innerWidth = MeasureSpec.getSize(widthMeasureSpec) - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight();
        final int innerHeight = MeasureSpec.getSize(heightMeasureSpec) - getPaddingTop() - getPaddingBottom();

        for (int index = 0; index < getChildCount(); index++)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            LayoutParams params = paramsFor(child);

            params.left = UNRESOLVED;
            params.top = UNRESOLVED;
            params.right = UNRESOLVED;
            params.bottom = UNRESOLVED;

            if (child.getVisibility() == GONE) continue;

            measureChildWithMargins(child, widthMeasureSpec, 0, heightMeasureSpec, 0);
        }

        for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < getChildCount(); index++)
            {
                View child = getChildAt(index);
                if (child.getVisibility() == GONE) continue;

                place(child, paramsFor(child), innerWidth, innerHeight, widthMode, heightMode);
            }
        }

        int widest = 0;
        int tallest = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index < getChildCount(); index++)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            if (child.getVisibility() == GONE) continue;

            LayoutParams params = paramsFor(child);
            widest = Math.max(widest, params.right + params.rightMargin);
            tallest = Math.max(tallest, params.bottom + params.bottomMargin);
        }

        widest = Math.max(widest + getPaddingLeft() + getPaddingRight(), getSuggestedMinimumWidth());
        tallest = Math.max(tallest + getPaddingTop() + getPaddingBottom(), getSuggestedMinimumHeight());

        setMeasuredDimension(resolveSize(widest, widthMeasureSpec), resolveSize(tallest, heightMeasureSpec));
    }

    private void place(View child, LayoutParams params, int innerWidth, int innerHeight, int widthMode, int heightMode)
    {
        final int[] rules = params.getRules();
        final boolean rightToLeft = getLayoutDirection() == LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL;

        int left = UNRESOLVED;
        int top = UNRESOLVED;
        int right = UNRESOLVED;
        int bottom = UNRESOLVED;

        int width = child.getMeasuredWidth();
        int height = child.getMeasuredHeight();

        if (rules[ALIGN_PARENT_LEFT] == TRUE || (rules[ALIGN_PARENT_START] == TRUE && !rightToLeft)
            || (rules[ALIGN_PARENT_END] == TRUE && rightToLeft))
        {
            left = params.leftMargin;
        }

        if (rules[ALIGN_PARENT_RIGHT] == TRUE || (rules[ALIGN_PARENT_END] == TRUE && !rightToLeft)
            || (rules[ALIGN_PARENT_START] == TRUE && rightToLeft))
        {
            right = innerWidth - params.rightMargin;
        }

        if (rules[ALIGN_PARENT_TOP] == TRUE) top = params.topMargin;
        if (rules[ALIGN_PARENT_BOTTOM] == TRUE) bottom = innerHeight - params.bottomMargin;

        left = fromSibling(rules[rightToLeft ? END_OF : START_OF] != 0 ? rules[rightToLeft ? END_OF : START_OF] : rules[RIGHT_OF],
                           Edge.RIGHT, params.leftMargin, left);
        right = fromSibling(rules[rightToLeft ? START_OF : END_OF] != 0 ? rules[rightToLeft ? START_OF : END_OF] : rules[LEFT_OF],
                            Edge.LEFT, -params.rightMargin, right);
        top = fromSibling(rules[BELOW], Edge.BOTTOM, params.topMargin, top);
        bottom = fromSibling(rules[ABOVE], Edge.TOP, -params.bottomMargin, bottom);

        left = fromSibling(rules[ALIGN_LEFT] != 0 ? rules[ALIGN_LEFT] : rules[ALIGN_START], Edge.LEFT, params.leftMargin, left);
        right = fromSibling(rules[ALIGN_RIGHT] != 0 ? rules[ALIGN_RIGHT] : rules[ALIGN_END], Edge.RIGHT, -params.rightMargin, right);
        top = fromSibling(rules[ALIGN_TOP], Edge.TOP, params.topMargin, top);
        bottom = fromSibling(rules[ALIGN_BOTTOM], Edge.BOTTOM, -params.bottomMargin, bottom);

        if (left != UNRESOLVED && right != UNRESOLVED && right - left != width && right > left)
        {
            width = right - left;
            child.measure(MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(width, MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                          MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(height, height > 0 ? MeasureSpec.EXACTLY : MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED));
            width = child.getMeasuredWidth();
            height = child.getMeasuredHeight();
        }

        if (top != UNRESOLVED && bottom != UNRESOLVED && bottom - top != height && bottom > top)
        {
            height = bottom - top;
            child.measure(MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(width, MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                          MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(height, MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
            width = child.getMeasuredWidth();
            height = child.getMeasuredHeight();
        }

        final boolean centreHorizontally = rules[CENTER_IN_PARENT] == TRUE || rules[CENTER_HORIZONTAL] == TRUE;
        final boolean centreVertically = rules[CENTER_IN_PARENT] == TRUE || rules[CENTER_VERTICAL] == TRUE;

        if (centreHorizontally && left == UNRESOLVED && right == UNRESOLVED)
        {
            left = (innerWidth - width) / 2 + params.leftMargin - params.rightMargin;
        }

        if (centreVertically && top == UNRESOLVED && bottom == UNRESOLVED)
        {
            top = (innerHeight - height) / 2 + params.topMargin - params.bottomMargin;
        }

        if (left == UNRESOLVED && right != UNRESOLVED) left = right - width;
        if (top == UNRESOLVED && bottom != UNRESOLVED) top = bottom - height;

        if (left == UNRESOLVED) left = params.leftMargin;
        if (top == UNRESOLVED) top = params.topMargin;

        params.left = left;
        params.top = top;
        params.right = left + width;
        params.bottom = top + height;
    }

    private enum Edge
    {
        LEFT,
        TOP,
        RIGHT,
        BOTTOM
    }

    private int fromSibling(int siblingId, Edge edge, int offset, int current)
    {
        if (current != UNRESOLVED || siblingId == 0 || siblingId == TRUE) return current;

        View sibling = childWithId(siblingId);
        if (sibling == null || sibling.getVisibility() == GONE) return current;

        LayoutParams params = paramsFor(sibling);
        int anchor;

        switch (edge)
        {
            case LEFT: anchor = params.left; break;
            case TOP: anchor = params.top; break;
            case RIGHT: anchor = params.right; break;
            default: anchor = params.bottom; break;
        }

        if (anchor == UNRESOLVED) return current;

        return anchor + offset;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onLayout(boolean changed, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        final int offsetLeft = getPaddingLeft();
        final int offsetTop = getPaddingTop();

        for (int index = 0; index < getChildCount(); index++)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            if (child.getVisibility() == GONE) continue;

            LayoutParams params = paramsFor(child);

            child.layout(offsetLeft + params.left, offsetTop + params.top, offsetLeft + params.right, offsetTop + params.bottom);
        }
    }

    public static class LayoutParams extends ViewGroup.MarginLayoutParams
    {
        private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

        private static final String[] RULE_ATTRIBUTES = {
            "layout_toLeftOf",        "layout_toRightOf",       "layout_above",           "layout_below",
            "layout_alignBaseline",   "layout_alignLeft",       "layout_alignTop",        "layout_alignRight",
            "layout_alignBottom",     "layout_alignParentLeft", "layout_alignParentTop",  "layout_alignParentRight",
            "layout_alignParentBottom", "layout_centerInParent", "layout_centerHorizontal", "layout_centerVertical",
            "layout_toStartOf",       "layout_toEndOf",         "layout_alignStart",      "layout_alignEnd",
            "layout_alignParentStart", "layout_alignParentEnd",
        };

        private final int[] mRules = new int[RULE_COUNT];

        public boolean alignWithParent;

        int left;
        int top;
        int right;
        int bottom;

        public LayoutParams(int width, int height)
        {
            super(width, height);
        }

        public LayoutParams(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
        {
            super(context, attributes);

            if (attributes == null) return;

            if (sStyleable == null) sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), RULE_ATTRIBUTES);
            if (sStyleable.isEmpty()) return;

            android.content.res.TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), 0, 0);

            for (int rule = 0; rule < RULE_ATTRIBUTES.length; rule++)
            {
                int index = sStyleable.indexOf(RULE_ATTRIBUTES[rule]);
                if (index < 0) continue;

                if (rule >= ALIGN_PARENT_LEFT && rule <= CENTER_VERTICAL)
                {
                    if (array.getBoolean(index, false)) mRules[rule] = TRUE;
                }
                else if (rule == ALIGN_PARENT_START || rule == ALIGN_PARENT_END)
                {
                    if (array.getBoolean(index, false)) mRules[rule] = TRUE;
                }
                else
                {
                    mRules[rule] = array.getResourceId(index, 0);
                }
            }

            array.recycle();
        }

        public LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams source)
        {
            super(source);
        }

        public LayoutParams(MarginLayoutParams source)
        {
            super(source);
        }

        public LayoutParams(LayoutParams source)
        {
            super(source);

            this.alignWithParent = source.alignWithParent;
            System.arraycopy(source.mRules, 0, mRules, 0, RULE_COUNT);
        }

        public String debug(String output)
        {
            return output + "ViewGroup.LayoutParams={ width=" + LinearLayout.LayoutParams.sizeToString(width) + ", height="
                + LinearLayout.LayoutParams.sizeToString(height) + " }";
        }

        public void addRule(int verb)
        {
            mRules[verb] = TRUE;
        }

        public void addRule(int verb, int anchor)
        {
            mRules[verb] = anchor;
        }

        public void removeRule(int verb)
        {
            mRules[verb] = 0;
        }

        public int getRule(int verb)
        {
            return mRules[verb];
        }

        public int[] getRules()
        {
            return mRules;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class RemoteViews implements LayoutInflater.Filter, Parcelable
{
    public static final String EXTRA_CHECKED = "android.widget.extra.CHECKED";
    public static final String EXTRA_SHARED_ELEMENT_BOUNDS = "android.widget.extra.SHARED_ELEMENT_BOUNDS";
    public static final int MARGIN_LEFT = 0;
    public static final int MARGIN_TOP = 1;
    public static final int MARGIN_RIGHT = 2;
    public static final int MARGIN_BOTTOM = 3;
    public static final int MARGIN_START = 4;
    public static final int MARGIN_END = 5;

    private static final String TAG = "RemoteViews";
    private static final int CONTEXT_RESTRICTED = 4;

    private static final int MODE_NORMAL = 0;
    private static final int MODE_ORIENTATION = 1;
    private static final int MODE_SIZED = 2;
    private static final int MODE_DRAW_INSTRUCTIONS = 3;

    private static final int KIND_REFLECT = 1;
    private static final int KIND_REFLECT_NIGHT = 2;
    private static final int KIND_RESOURCE = 3;
    private static final int KIND_ATTRIBUTE = 4;
    private static final int KIND_DIMENSION = 5;
    private static final int KIND_IMAGE_ICON = 6;
    private static final int KIND_ADD_VIEW = 7;
    private static final int KIND_REMOVE_ALL = 8;
    private static final int KIND_PADDING = 9;
    private static final int KIND_TEXT_SIZE = 10;
    private static final int KIND_COMPOUND = 11;
    private static final int KIND_CHRONOMETER = 12;
    private static final int KIND_CLICK = 13;
    private static final int KIND_CHECKED_RESPONSE = 14;
    private static final int KIND_TEMPLATE = 15;
    private static final int KIND_EMPTY_VIEW = 16;
    private static final int KIND_LAYOUT = 17;
    private static final int KIND_COLLECTION = 18;
    private static final int KIND_SERVICE_ADAPTER = 19;
    private static final int KIND_PROGRESS = 20;
    private static final int KIND_STYLUS = 21;

    private static final int RESOLVE_COLOR = 0;
    private static final int RESOLVE_COLOR_STATE_LIST = 1;
    private static final int RESOLVE_DIMENSION_INT = 2;
    private static final int RESOLVE_DIMENSION_FLOAT = 3;
    private static final int RESOLVE_TEXT = 4;

    private static final int LAYOUT_SOURCE_VALUE = 0;
    private static final int LAYOUT_SOURCE_DIMENSION = 1;
    private static final int LAYOUT_SOURCE_ATTRIBUTE = 2;

    private static final int LAYOUT_WIDTH = 100;
    private static final int LAYOUT_HEIGHT = 101;
    private static final int LAYOUT_OUTLINE_RADIUS = 102;

    private static final HashSet<String> REMOTABLE_CLASSES = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
        "android.widget.AdapterViewFlipper", "android.widget.AnalogClock", "android.widget.Button", "android.widget.CheckBox",
        "android.widget.Chronometer", "android.widget.FrameLayout", "android.widget.GridLayout", "android.widget.GridView",
        "android.widget.ImageButton", "android.widget.ImageView", "android.widget.LinearLayout", "android.widget.ListView",
        "android.widget.ProgressBar", "android.widget.RadioButton", "android.widget.RadioGroup", "android.widget.RelativeLayout",
        "android.widget.StackView", "android.widget.Switch", "android.widget.TextClock", "android.widget.TextView",
        "android.widget.ViewFlipper", "android.view.ViewStub"));

    private static final WeakHashMap<View, PendingIntent> sTemplates = new WeakHashMap<>();

    private final String mPackageName;
    private final int mLayoutId;
    private final int mViewId;
    private final int mMode;
    private final ArrayList<Action> mActions = new ArrayList<>();
    private int mLightBackgroundLayoutId;
    private RemoteViews mLandscape;
    private RemoteViews mPortrait;
    private LinkedHashMap<SizeF, RemoteViews> mSizedViews;
    private DrawInstructions mDrawInstructions;

    public RemoteViews(String packageName, int layoutId)
    {
        this(packageName, layoutId, View.NO_ID);
    }

    public RemoteViews(String packageName, int layoutId, int viewId)
    {
        mPackageName = packageName;
        mLayoutId = layoutId;
        mViewId = viewId;
        mMode = MODE_NORMAL;
    }

    public RemoteViews(RemoteViews landscape, RemoteViews portrait)
    {
        if (landscape == null || portrait == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Both RemoteViews must be non-null");
        if (!landscape.hasSamePackage(portrait)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Both RemoteViews must share the same package");

        mPackageName = portrait.mPackageName;
        mLayoutId = portrait.mLayoutId;
        mViewId = portrait.mViewId;
        mLightBackgroundLayoutId = portrait.mLightBackgroundLayoutId;
        mMode = MODE_ORIENTATION;
        mLandscape = landscape;
        mPortrait = portrait;
    }

    public RemoteViews(Map<SizeF, RemoteViews> remoteViews)
    {
        if (remoteViews == null || remoteViews.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("The set of RemoteViews cannot be empty");
        if (remoteViews.size() > 16) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Too many RemoteViews in constructor");

        RemoteViews smallest = null;
        float smallestArea = Float.MAX_VALUE;

        for (Map.Entry<SizeF, RemoteViews> entry : remoteViews.entrySet())
        {
            RemoteViews views = entry.getValue();
            if (views == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("RemoteViews cannot be null");
            if (smallest != null && !smallest.hasSamePackage(views))
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("All RemoteViews must share the same package");
            }

            float area = entry.getKey().getWidth() * entry.getKey().getHeight();
            if (smallest == null || area < smallestArea)
            {
                smallest = views;
                smallestArea = area;
            }
        }

        mPackageName = smallest.mPackageName;
        mLayoutId = smallest.mLayoutId;
        mViewId = smallest.mViewId;
        mLightBackgroundLayoutId = smallest.mLightBackgroundLayoutId;
        mMode = MODE_SIZED;
        mSizedViews = new LinkedHashMap<>(remoteViews);
    }

    public RemoteViews(DrawInstructions drawInstructions)
    {
        if (drawInstructions == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("drawInstructions cannot be null");

        mPackageName = null;
        mLayoutId = 0;
        mViewId = View.NO_ID;
        mMode = MODE_DRAW_INSTRUCTIONS;
        mDrawInstructions = drawInstructions;
    }

    public RemoteViews(RemoteViews source)
    {
        mPackageName = source.mPackageName;
        mLayoutId = source.mLayoutId;
        mViewId = source.mViewId;
        mMode = source.mMode;
        mLightBackgroundLayoutId = source.mLightBackgroundLayoutId;
        mDrawInstructions = source.mDrawInstructions;
        if (source.mLandscape != null) mLandscape = new RemoteViews(source.mLandscape);
        if (source.mPortrait != null) mPortrait = new RemoteViews(source.mPortrait);

        if (source.mSizedViews != null)
        {
            mSizedViews = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<SizeF, RemoteViews> entry : source.mSizedViews.entrySet())
            {
                mSizedViews.put(entry.getKey(), new RemoteViews(entry.getValue()));
            }
        }

        for (Action action : source.mActions) mActions.add(action.copy());
    }

    public RemoteViews(Parcel parcel)
    {
        mMode = parcel.readInt();
        mPackageName = parcel.readString();
        mLayoutId = parcel.readInt();
        mViewId = parcel.readInt();
        mLightBackgroundLayoutId = parcel.readInt();

        if (mMode == MODE_ORIENTATION)
        {
            mLandscape = new RemoteViews(parcel);
            mPortrait = new RemoteViews(parcel);
        }
        else if (mMode == MODE_SIZED)
        {
            int count = parcel.readInt();
            mSizedViews = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                SizeF size = new SizeF(parcel.readFloat(), parcel.readFloat());
                mSizedViews.put(size, new RemoteViews(parcel));
            }
        }
        else if (mMode == MODE_DRAW_INSTRUCTIONS)
        {
            int count = parcel.readInt();
            ArrayList<byte[]> instructions = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) instructions.add(parcel.createByteArray());
            mDrawInstructions = new DrawInstructions(instructions);
        }

        int count = parcel.readInt();
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) mActions.add(Action.read(parcel));
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
    {
        out.writeInt(mMode);
        out.writeString(mPackageName);
        out.writeInt(mLayoutId);
        out.writeInt(mViewId);
        out.writeInt(mLightBackgroundLayoutId);

        if (mMode == MODE_ORIENTATION)
        {
            mLandscape.writeToParcel(out, flags);
            mPortrait.writeToParcel(out, flags);
        }
        else if (mMode == MODE_SIZED)
        {
            out.writeInt(mSizedViews.size());
            for (Map.Entry<SizeF, RemoteViews> entry : mSizedViews.entrySet())
            {
                out.writeFloat(entry.getKey().getWidth());
                out.writeFloat(entry.getKey().getHeight());
                entry.getValue().writeToParcel(out, flags);
            }
        }
        else if (mMode == MODE_DRAW_INSTRUCTIONS)
        {
            out.writeInt(mDrawInstructions.mInstructions.size());
            for (byte[] instruction : mDrawInstructions.mInstructions) out.writeByteArray(instruction);
        }

        out.writeInt(mActions.size());
        for (Action action : mActions) action.write(out);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public static final Parcelable.Creator<RemoteViews> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<RemoteViews>()
    {
        @Override
        public RemoteViews createFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
        {
            return new RemoteViews(parcel);
        }

        @Override
        public RemoteViews[] newArray(int size)
        {
            return new RemoteViews[size];
        }

    private boolean hasSamePackage(RemoteViews other)
    {
        return mPackageName == null ? other.mPackageName == null : mPackageName.equals(other.mPackageName);
    }

    @Override
    public RemoteViews clone()
    {
        if (mMode == MODE_ORIENTATION || mMode == MODE_SIZED)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot clone a RemoteViews built from several RemoteViews");
        }

        return new RemoteViews(this);
    }

    public String getPackage()
    {
        return mPackageName;
    }

    public int getLayoutId()
    {
        return mLayoutId;
    }

    public int getViewId()
    {
        return mViewId;
    }

    {
        mLightBackgroundLayoutId = layoutId;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onLoadClass(Class type)
    {
        if (type == null) return false;

        return type.isAnnotationPresent(RemoteView.class) || REMOTABLE_CLASSES.contains(type.getName());
    }

    public View apply(Context context, ViewGroup parent)
    {
        RemoteViews target = chooseLayout(context);

        if (target.mMode == MODE_DRAW_INSTRUCTIONS)
        {
            android.util.Log.w(TAG, "draw instructions cannot be played back here, so an empty view stands in for them");
            return new View(context);
        }

        if (target.mLayoutId == 0)
        {
            android.util.Log.w(TAG, "no layout was given for " + target.mPackageName + ", so nothing was inflated");
            return null;
        }

        Context inflationContext = packageContext(context, target.mPackageName);
        LayoutInflater inflater = LayoutInflater.from(inflationContext).cloneInContext(inflationContext);
        inflater.setFilter(target);

        View view = inflater.inflate(target.mLayoutId, parent, false);
        if (target.mViewId != View.NO_ID) view.setId(target.mViewId);
        view.setTag(TAG.hashCode(), Integer.valueOf(target.mLayoutId));

        target.performApply(view, parent, context);
        return view;
    }

    public void reapply(Context context, View view)
    {
        RemoteViews target = chooseLayout(context);
        if (target.mMode == MODE_DRAW_INSTRUCTIONS) return;

        Object layout = view.getTag(TAG.hashCode());
        if (layout instanceof Integer && (Integer)layout != target.mLayoutId)
        {
            throw new ActionException("Attempting to re-apply RemoteViews to a view that was not created from the same layout");
        }

        ViewGroup parent = view.getParent() instanceof ViewGroup ? (ViewGroup)view.getParent() : null;
        target.performApply(view, parent, context);
    }

    private RemoteViews chooseLayout(Context context)
    {
        if (mMode == MODE_ORIENTATION)
        {
            boolean landscape = context.getResources().getConfiguration().orientation == Configuration.ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE;
            return landscape ? mLandscape : mPortrait;
        }

        if (mMode == MODE_SIZED)
        {
            RemoteViews smallest = null;
            float smallestArea = Float.MAX_VALUE;

            for (Map.Entry<SizeF, RemoteViews> entry : mSizedViews.entrySet())
            {
                float area = entry.getKey().getWidth() * entry.getKey().getHeight();
                if (smallest == null || area < smallestArea)
                {
                    smallest = entry.getValue();
                    smallestArea = area;
                }
            }

            return smallest;
        }

        return this;
    }

    private static Context packageContext(Context context, String packageName)
    {
        if (packageName == null || packageName.equals(context.getPackageName())) return context;

        try
        {
            return context.createPackageContext(packageName, CONTEXT_RESTRICTED);
        }
        catch (Throwable missing)
        {
            android.util.Log.w(TAG, "package " + packageName + " is not available, so its layout is inflated from " + context.getPackageName());
            return context;
        }
    }

    private void performApply(View root, ViewGroup parent, Context context)
    {
        for (Action action : mActions) action.apply(root, parent, context);
    }

    private void addAction(Action action)
    {
        if (mMode == MODE_ORIENTATION || mMode == MODE_SIZED)
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("RemoteViews built from several RemoteViews cannot be modified; modify the children instead");
        }

        if (mMode == MODE_DRAW_INSTRUCTIONS) throw new IllegalStateException("RemoteViews made from draw instructions cannot be modified");

        mActions.add(action);
    }

    private void reflect(int viewId, String method, Class<?> type, Object value)
    {
        addAction(new Action(KIND_REFLECT, viewId, method, type, value, null, null));
    }

    private void resource(int kind, int viewId, String method, Class<?> type, int resourceId, int resolve)
    {
        addAction(new Action(kind, viewId, method, type, null, null, new int[] {resourceId, resolve}));
    }

    private void layout(int viewId, int target, int source, int argument, float value)
    {
        if (target < MARGIN_LEFT || (target > MARGIN_END && target < LAYOUT_WIDTH))
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown margin type " + target);
        }

        addAction(new Action(KIND_LAYOUT, viewId, null, null, value, null, new int[] {target, source, argument}));
    }
```
