```java
    private static Class<?> typeFor(String name)
    {
        if (name == null) return null;

        switch (name)
        {
            case "boolean":
                return boolean.class;
            case "byte":
                return byte.class;
            case "short":
                return short.class;
            case "int":
                return int.class;
            case "long":
                return long.class;
            case "float":
                return float.class;
            case "double":
                return double.class;
            case "char":
                return char.class;
            default:
                try
                {
                    return Class.forName(name);
                }
                catch (ClassNotFoundException missing)
                {
                    throw new ActionException(missing);
                }
        }
    }

    private static Object convert(Class<?> type, Object value)
    {
        if (value == null) return null;
        if (type == byte.class) return (byte)((Number)value).intValue();
        if (type == char.class) return (char)((Number)value).intValue();
        if (type == short.class) return ((Number)value).shortValue();
        if (type == BlendMode.class && value instanceof String) return BlendMode.valueOf((String)value);

        return value;
    }

    private static boolean isNight(Context context)
    {
        Configuration configuration = context.getResources().getConfiguration();
        return (configuration.uiMode & Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_MASK) == Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_YES;
    }

    private static void sendClick(View view, PendingIntent pendingIntent, Intent fillIn)
    {
        try
        {
            pendingIntent.send(view.getContext(), 0, fillIn);
        }
        catch (PendingIntent.CanceledException cancelled)
        {
            android.util.Log.w(TAG, "the click PendingIntent was cancelled", cancelled);
        }
    }

    private static PendingIntent templateFor(View view)
    {
        android.view.ViewParent current = view.getParent();

        while (current instanceof View)
        {
            PendingIntent template = sTemplates.get((View)current);
            if (template != null) return template;

            current = current.getParent();
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static final class Action
    {
        private final int mKind;
        private final int mViewId;
        private final String mMethod;
        private final Class<?> mType;
        private final Object mValue;
        private final Object mAlternate;
        private final int[] mNumbers;

        Action(int kind, int viewId, String method, Class<?> type, Object value, Object alternate, int[] numbers)
        {
            mKind = kind;
            mViewId = viewId;
            mMethod = method;
            mType = type;
            mValue = value;
            mAlternate = alternate;
            mNumbers = numbers;
        }

        Action copy()
        {
            Object value = mValue instanceof RemoteViews ? new RemoteViews((RemoteViews)mValue) : mValue;
            return new Action(mKind, mViewId, mMethod, mType, value, mAlternate, mNumbers == null ? null : mNumbers.clone());
        }

        void write(Parcel out)
        {
            out.writeInt(mKind);
            out.writeInt(mViewId);
            out.writeString(mMethod);
            out.writeString(mType == null ? null : mType.getName());

            if (mValue instanceof RemoteViews)
            {
                out.writeInt(1);
                ((RemoteViews)mValue).writeToParcel(out, 0);
            }
            else if (mValue instanceof RemoteCollectionItems)
            {
                out.writeInt(2);
                ((RemoteCollectionItems)mValue).writeToParcel(out, 0);
            }
            else
            {
                out.writeInt(0);
                out.writeValue(mValue);
            }

            out.writeValue(mAlternate);
            out.writeIntArray(mNumbers);
        }

        static Action read(Parcel source)
        {
            int kind = source.readInt();
            int viewId = source.readInt();
            String method = source.readString();
            Class<?> type = typeFor(source.readString());

            int valueKind = source.readInt();
            Object value;
            if (valueKind == 1) value = new RemoteViews(source);
            else if (valueKind == 2) value = RemoteCollectionItems.CREATOR.createFromParcel(source);
            else value = source.readValue(RemoteViews.class.getClassLoader());

            Object alternate = source.readValue(RemoteViews.class.getClassLoader());
            int[] numbers = source.createIntArray();

            return new Action(kind, viewId, method, type, value, alternate, numbers);
        }

        void apply(View root, ViewGroup parent, Context context)
        {
            View target = root.findViewById(mViewId);
            if (target == null) return;

            switch (mKind)
            {
                case KIND_REFLECT:
                    invoke(target, mMethod, mType, mValue);
                    break;
                case KIND_REFLECT_NIGHT:
                    invoke(target, mMethod, mType, isNight(context) ? mAlternate : mValue);
                    break;
                case KIND_RESOURCE:
                    invoke(target, mMethod, mType, resolveResource(target.getContext(), mNumbers[0], mNumbers[1]));
                    break;
                case KIND_ATTRIBUTE:
                    invoke(target, mMethod, mType, resolveAttribute(target.getContext(), mNumbers[0], mNumbers[1]));
                    break;
                case KIND_DIMENSION:
                    applyDimension(target);
                    break;
                case KIND_IMAGE_ICON:
                    applyIcon(target);
                    break;
                case KIND_ADD_VIEW:
                    applyAddView(target, context);
                    break;
                case KIND_REMOVE_ALL:
                    if (!(target instanceof ViewGroup)) throw new ActionException("view " + mViewId + " is not a ViewGroup");
                    ((ViewGroup)target).removeAllViews();
                    break;
                case KIND_PADDING:
                    target.setPadding(mNumbers[0], mNumbers[1], mNumbers[2], mNumbers[3]);
                    break;
                case KIND_TEXT_SIZE:
                    if (!(target instanceof TextView)) throw new ActionException("view " + mViewId + " is not a TextView");
                    ((TextView)target).setTextSize(mNumbers[0], (Float)mValue);
                    break;
                case KIND_COMPOUND:
                    applyCompound(target);
                    break;
                case KIND_CHRONOMETER:
                    applyChronometer(target);
                    break;
                case KIND_CLICK:
                    applyClick(target);
                    break;
                case KIND_CHECKED_RESPONSE:
                    applyCheckedResponse(target);
                    break;
                case KIND_TEMPLATE:
                    if (mValue == null) sTemplates.remove(target);
                    else sTemplates.put(target, (PendingIntent)mValue);
                    break;
                case KIND_EMPTY_VIEW:
                    if (!(target instanceof AdapterView)) throw new ActionException("view " + mViewId + " is not an AdapterView");
                    ((AdapterView<?>)target).setEmptyView(root.findViewById(mNumbers[0]));
                    break;
                case KIND_LAYOUT:
                    applyLayout(target);
                    break;
                case KIND_COLLECTION:
                    applyCollection(target, context);
                    break;
                case KIND_SERVICE_ADAPTER:
                    android.util.Log.w(TAG, "no RemoteViewsService host exists here, so the adapter for view " + mViewId + " stays empty");
                    break;
                case KIND_PROGRESS:
                    applyProgress(target);
                    break;
                case KIND_STYLUS:
                    applyStylus(target);
                    break;
                default:
                    throw new ActionException("unknown action " + mKind);
            }
        }

        private static void invoke(View target, String name, Class<?> type, Object value)
        {
            Method method;

            try
            {
                method = type == null ? target.getClass().getMethod(name) : target.getClass().getMethod(name, type);
            }
            catch (NoSuchMethodException missing)
            {
                throw new ActionException("view: " + target.getClass().getName() + " doesn't have method: " + name
                                          + (type == null ? "()" : "(" + type.getName() + ")"));
            }

            try
            {
                if (type == null) method.invoke(target);
                else method.invoke(target, convert(type, value));
            }
            catch (InvocationTargetException failure)
            {
                Throwable cause = failure.getCause();
                throw new ActionException(cause instanceof Exception ? (Exception)cause : failure);
            }
            catch (IllegalAccessException failure)
            {
                throw new ActionException(failure);
            }
        }

        private static Object resolveResource(Context context, int resourceId, int resolve)
        {
            android.content.res.Resources resources = context.getResources();

            switch (resolve)
            {
                case RESOLVE_COLOR:
                    return resources.getColor(resourceId, context.getTheme());
                case RESOLVE_COLOR_STATE_LIST:
                    return resources.getColorStateList(resourceId, context.getTheme());
                case RESOLVE_DIMENSION_INT:
                    return resourceId == 0 ? 0 : resources.getDimensionPixelSize(resourceId);
                case RESOLVE_DIMENSION_FLOAT:
                    return resourceId == 0 ? 0f : resources.getDimension(resourceId);
                default:
                    return resourceId == 0 ? null : resources.getText(resourceId);
            }
        }

        private static Object resolveAttribute(Context context, int attribute, int resolve)
        {
            android.content.res.TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(new int[] {attribute});

            try
            {
                switch (resolve)
                {
                    case RESOLVE_COLOR:
                        return array.getColor(0, 0);
                    case RESOLVE_COLOR_STATE_LIST:
                        return array.getColorStateList(0);
                    case RESOLVE_DIMENSION_INT:
                        return array.getDimensionPixelSize(0, 0);
                    case RESOLVE_DIMENSION_FLOAT:
                        return array.getDimension(0, 0f);
                    default:
                        return array.getText(0);
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                array.recycle();
            }
        }

        private void applyDimension(View target)
        {
            float pixels = TypedValue.applyDimension(mNumbers[0], (Float)mValue, target.getResources().getDisplayMetrics());
            if (mType == int.class) invoke(target, mMethod, int.class, (int)pixels);
            else invoke(target, mMethod, float.class, pixels);
        }

        private void applyIcon(View target)
        {
            if (!(target instanceof ImageView)) throw new ActionException("view " + mViewId + " is not an ImageView");

            Icon icon = (Icon)mValue;
            ((ImageView)target).setImageDrawable(icon == null ? null : icon.loadDrawable(target.getContext()));
        }

        private void applyAddView(View target, Context context)
        {
            if (!(target instanceof ViewGroup)) throw new ActionException("view " + mViewId + " is not a ViewGroup");

            ViewGroup group = (ViewGroup)target;
            RemoteViews nested = (RemoteViews)mValue;
            int stableId = mNumbers[0];

            if (stableId >= 0)
            {
                for (int index = 0; index < group.getChildCount(); index++)
                {
                    View child = group.getChildAt(index);
                    if (!Integer.valueOf(stableId).equals(child.getTag(STABLE_TAG))) continue;

                    nested.reapply(context, child);
                    return;
                }
            }

            View child = nested.apply(context, group);
            if (child == null) return;

            if (stableId >= 0) child.setTag(STABLE_TAG, stableId);
            group.addView(child);
        }

        private void applyCompound(View target)
        {
            if (!(target instanceof TextView)) throw new ActionException("view " + mViewId + " is not a TextView");

            TextView text = (TextView)target;
            if ("relative".equals(mMethod))
            {
                text.setCompoundDrawablesRelativeWithIntrinsicBounds(mNumbers[0], mNumbers[1], mNumbers[2], mNumbers[3]);
            }
            else
            {
                text.setCompoundDrawablesWithIntrinsicBounds(mNumbers[0], mNumbers[1], mNumbers[2], mNumbers[3]);
            }
        }

        private void applyChronometer(View target)
        {
            if (!(target instanceof Chronometer)) throw new ActionException("view " + mViewId + " is not a Chronometer");

            Chronometer chronometer = (Chronometer)target;
            chronometer.setBase((Long)mValue);
            chronometer.setFormat((String)mAlternate);
            if (mNumbers[0] != 0) chronometer.start();
            else chronometer.stop();
        }

        private void applyClick(View target)
        {
            PendingIntent pendingIntent = (PendingIntent)mValue;
            Intent fillIn = (Intent)mAlternate;

            if (pendingIntent == null && fillIn == null)
            {
                target.setOnClickListener(null);
                return;
            }

            target.setOnClickListener(view ->
            {
                PendingIntent intent = pendingIntent != null ? pendingIntent : templateFor(view);
                if (intent == null)
                {
                    android.util.Log.w(TAG, "a fill-in intent was clicked outside any PendingIntent template");
                    return;
                }

                sendClick(view, intent, fillIn);
            });
        }

        private void applyCheckedResponse(View target)
        {
            if (!(target instanceof CompoundButton)) throw new ActionException("view " + mViewId + " is not a CompoundButton");

            PendingIntent pendingIntent = (PendingIntent)mValue;
            Intent fillIn = (Intent)mAlternate;

            ((CompoundButton)target).setOnCheckedChangeListener((button, checked) ->
            {
                PendingIntent intent = pendingIntent != null ? pendingIntent : templateFor(button);
                if (intent == null) return;

                Intent extras = fillIn == null ? new Intent() : new Intent(fillIn);
                extras.putExtra(EXTRA_CHECKED, checked);
                sendClick(button, intent, extras);
            });
        }

        private void applyLayout(View target)
        {
            int kind = mNumbers[0];
            int source = mNumbers[1];
            int argument = mNumbers[2];
            float amount = (Float)mValue;

            android.util.DisplayMetrics metrics = target.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
            float pixels;
            boolean special = false;

            if (source == LAYOUT_SOURCE_DIMENSION)
            {
                pixels = argument == 0 ? 0 : target.getResources().getDimension(argument);
            }
            else if (source == LAYOUT_SOURCE_ATTRIBUTE)
            {
                pixels = (Float)resolveAttribute(target.getContext(), argument, RESOLVE_DIMENSION_FLOAT);
            }
            else
            {
                special = argument == TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_PX && (amount == ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
                                                                    || amount == ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
                pixels = special ? amount : TypedValue.applyDimension(argument, amount, metrics);
            }

            if (kind == LAYOUT_OUTLINE_RADIUS)
            {
                float radius = pixels;
                target.setOutlineProvider(new android.view.ViewOutlineProvider()
                {
                    @Override
                    public void getOutline(View view, android.graphics.Outline outline)
                    {
                        outline.setRoundRect(0, 0, view.getWidth(), view.getHeight(), radius);
                    }
                });
                target.setClipToOutline(true);
                return;
            }

            ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = target.getLayoutParams();
            if (params == null) return;

            int size = special ? (int)pixels : Math.round(pixels);

            if (kind == LAYOUT_WIDTH) params.width = size;
            else if (kind == LAYOUT_HEIGHT) params.height = size;
            else if (params instanceof ViewGroup.MarginLayoutParams) applyMargin((ViewGroup.MarginLayoutParams)params, kind, size);
            else return;

            target.setLayoutParams(params);
        }

        private static void applyMargin(ViewGroup.MarginLayoutParams params, int kind, int size)
        {
            switch (kind)
            {
                case MARGIN_LEFT:
                    params.leftMargin = size;
                    break;
                case MARGIN_TOP:
                    params.topMargin = size;
                    break;
                case MARGIN_RIGHT:
                    params.rightMargin = size;
                    break;
                case MARGIN_BOTTOM:
                    params.bottomMargin = size;
                    break;
                case MARGIN_START:
                    params.setMarginStart(size);
                    break;
                default:
                    params.setMarginEnd(size);
                    break;
            }
        }

        private void applyCollection(View target, Context context)
        {
            if (!(target instanceof AbsListView) && !(target instanceof AdapterView))
            {
                throw new ActionException("view " + mViewId + " cannot take a remote adapter");
            }

            RemoteCollectionItems items = (RemoteCollectionItems)mValue;
            CollectionAdapter adapter = new CollectionAdapter(context, items);

            if (target instanceof AbsListView) ((AbsListView)target).setAdapter(adapter);
            else invoke(target, "setAdapter", android.widget.Adapter.class, adapter);
        }

        private void applyProgress(View target)
        {
            if (!(target instanceof ProgressBar)) throw new ActionException("view " + mViewId + " is not a ProgressBar");

            ProgressBar progress = (ProgressBar)target;
            progress.setIndeterminate(mNumbers[2] != 0);
            if (mNumbers[2] != 0) return;

            progress.setMax(mNumbers[0]);
            progress.setProgress(mNumbers[1]);
        }

        private void applyStylus(View target)
        {
            PendingIntent pendingIntent = (PendingIntent)mValue;

            if (pendingIntent == null)
            {
                target.setHandwritingDelegatorCallback(null);
                return;
            }

            target.setHandwritingDelegatorCallback(() -> sendClick(target, pendingIntent, null));
            target.setAllowedHandwritingDelegatePackage(pendingIntent.getCreatorPackage());
        }
    }

    private static final int STABLE_TAG = "RemoteViews.stableId".hashCode();

    private static final class CollectionAdapter extends BaseAdapter
    {
        private final Context mContext;
        private final RemoteCollectionItems mItems;

        CollectionAdapter(Context context, RemoteCollectionItems items)
        {
            mContext = context;
            mItems = items;
        }

        @Override
        public int getCount()
        {
            return mItems.getItemCount();
        }

        @Override
        public Object getItem(int position)
        {
            return mItems.getItemView(position);
        }

        @Override
        public long getItemId(int position)
        {
            return mItems.getItemId(position);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean hasStableIds()
        {
            return mItems.hasStableIds();
        }

        @Override
        public int getViewTypeCount()
        {
            return Math.max(1, mItems.getViewTypeCount());
        }

        @Override
        public int getItemViewType(int position)
        {
            int layout = mItems.getItemView(position).getLayoutId();
            int index = mItems.mLayoutIds.indexOf(layout);
            return index < 0 || index >= getViewTypeCount() ? 0 : index;
        }

        @Override
        public View getView(int position, View convertView, ViewGroup parent)
        {
            RemoteViews views = mItems.getItemView(position);

            if (convertView != null)
            {
                Object layout = convertView.getTag(TAG.hashCode());
                if (layout instanceof Integer && (Integer)layout == views.getLayoutId())
                {
                    views.reapply(mContext, convertView);
                    return convertView;
                }
            }

            View view = views.apply(mContext, parent);
            return view == null ? new View(mContext) : view;
        }
    }

    public static class ActionException extends RuntimeException
    {
        public ActionException(Exception exception)
        {
            super(exception);
        }

        public ActionException(String message)
        {
            super(message);
        }
    }

    @Target(ElementType.TYPE)
    @Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
    public @interface RemoteView
    {
    }

    public static class RemoteResponse
    {
        private PendingIntent mPendingIntent;
        private Intent mFillIntent;
        private final ArrayList<Integer> mSharedElementIds = new ArrayList<>();
        private final ArrayList<String> mSharedElementNames = new ArrayList<>();

        public RemoteResponse()
        {
        }

        public static RemoteResponse fromPendingIntent(PendingIntent pendingIntent)
        {
            RemoteResponse response = new RemoteResponse();
            response.mPendingIntent = pendingIntent;
            return response;
        }

        public static RemoteResponse fromFillInIntent(Intent fillIntent)
        {
            RemoteResponse response = new RemoteResponse();
            response.mFillIntent = fillIntent;
            return response;
        }

        public RemoteResponse addSharedElement(int viewId, String sharedElementName)
        {
            mSharedElementIds.add(viewId);
            mSharedElementNames.add(sharedElementName);
            return this;
        }
    }

    public static final class RemoteCollectionItems implements Parcelable
    {
        private final long[] mIds;
        private final RemoteViews[] mViews;
        private final boolean mHasStableIds;
        private final int mViewTypeCount;
        private final ArrayList<Integer> mLayoutIds = new ArrayList<>();

        RemoteCollectionItems()
        {
            this(new long[0], new RemoteViews[0], false, 1);
        }

        private RemoteCollectionItems(long[] ids, RemoteViews[] views, boolean hasStableIds, int viewTypeCount)
        {
            mIds = ids;
            mViews = views;
            mHasStableIds = hasStableIds;

            for (RemoteViews view : views)
            {
                if (!mLayoutIds.contains(view.getLayoutId())) mLayoutIds.add(view.getLayoutId());
            }

            int count = viewTypeCount < 1 ? mLayoutIds.size() : viewTypeCount;
            if (count < mLayoutIds.size())
            {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("View type count is set to " + viewTypeCount + ", but the collection contains "
                                                   + mLayoutIds.size() + " different layout ids");
            }

            mViewTypeCount = Math.max(1, count);
        }

        public int getItemCount()
        {
            return mIds.length;
        }

        public long getItemId(int position)
        {
            return mIds[position];
        }

        public RemoteViews getItemView(int position)
        {
            return mViews[position];
        }

        public int getViewTypeCount()
        {
            return mViewTypeCount;
        }

        public boolean hasStableIds()
        {
            return mHasStableIds;
        }

        @Override
        public int describeContents()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
        {
            out.writeInt(mIds.length);
            for (int index = 0; index < mIds.length; index++)
            {
                out.writeLong(mIds[index]);
                mViews[index].writeToParcel(out, flags);
            }
            out.writeInt(mHasStableIds ? 1 : 0);
            out.writeInt(mViewTypeCount);
        }

        public static final Parcelable.Creator<RemoteCollectionItems> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<RemoteCollectionItems>()
        {
            @Override
            public RemoteCollectionItems createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                int count = source.readInt();
                long[] ids = new long[count];
                RemoteViews[] views = new RemoteViews[count];
                for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
                {
                    ids[index] = source.readLong();
                    views[index] = new RemoteViews(source);
                }

                boolean stable = source.readInt() != 0;
                int viewTypeCount = source.readInt();
                return new RemoteCollectionItems(ids, views, stable, viewTypeCount);
            }

            @Override
            public RemoteCollectionItems[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new RemoteCollectionItems[size];
            }
        };

        public static final class Builder
        {
            private final ArrayList<Long> mIds = new ArrayList<>();
            private final ArrayList<RemoteViews> mViews = new ArrayList<>();
            private boolean mHasStableIds;
            private int mViewTypeCount;

            public Builder()
            {
            }

            public Builder addItem(long id, RemoteViews view)
            {
                if (view == null) throw new NullPointerException("view");
                if (view.mMode != MODE_NORMAL) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only plain RemoteViews can be collection items");

                mIds.add(id);
                mViews.add(view);
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setHasStableIds(boolean hasStableIds)
            {
                mHasStableIds = hasStableIds;
                return this;
            }

            public Builder setViewTypeCount(int viewTypeCount)
            {
                mViewTypeCount = viewTypeCount;
                return this;
            }

            public RemoteCollectionItems build()
            {
                long[] ids = new long[mIds.size()];
                for (int index = 0; index < ids.length; index++) ids[index] = mIds.get(index);

                return new RemoteCollectionItems(ids, mViews.toArray(new RemoteViews[0]), mHasStableIds, mViewTypeCount);
            }
        }
    }

    public static final class DrawInstructions
    {
        private final java.util.List<byte[]> mInstructions;

        DrawInstructions()
        {
            this(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        private DrawInstructions(java.util.List<byte[]> instructions)
        {
            mInstructions = instructions;
        }

        public static long getSupportedVersion()
        {
            return 0L;
        }

        public static final class Builder
        {
            private final ArrayList<byte[]> mInstructions;

            public Builder(java.util.List<byte[]> instructions)
            {
                if (instructions == null) throw new NullPointerException("instructions");

                mInstructions = new ArrayList<>(instructions);
            }

            public DrawInstructions build()
            {
                return new DrawInstructions(mInstructions);
            }
        }
    }
```

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.view.ContextThemeWrapper;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

public abstract class ResourceCursorAdapter extends CursorAdapter
{
    private int mLayout;
    private int mDropDownLayout;
    private LayoutInflater mInflater;
    private LayoutInflater mDropDownInflater;

    public ResourceCursorAdapter(Context context, int layout, Cursor cursor)
    {
        super(context, cursor);
        setup(context, layout);
    }

    public ResourceCursorAdapter(Context context, int layout, Cursor cursor, boolean autoRequery)
    {
        super(context, cursor, autoRequery);
        setup(context, layout);
    }

    public ResourceCursorAdapter(Context context, int layout, Cursor cursor, int flags)
    {
        super(context, cursor, flags);
        setup(context, layout);
    }

    private void setup(Context context, int layout)
    {
        mLayout = layout;
        mDropDownLayout = layout;
        mInflater = LayoutInflater.from(context);
        mDropDownInflater = mInflater;
    }

    @Override
    public void setDropDownViewTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        super.setDropDownViewTheme(theme);

        if (theme == null) mDropDownInflater = null;
        else if (theme == mInflater.getContext().getTheme()) mDropDownInflater = mInflater;
        else mDropDownInflater = LayoutInflater.from(new ContextThemeWrapper(mInflater.getContext(), theme));
    }

    @Override
    public View newView(Context context, Cursor cursor, ViewGroup parent)
    {
        return mInflater.inflate(mLayout, parent, false);
    }

    @Override
    public View newDropDownView(Context context, Cursor cursor, ViewGroup parent)
    {
        LayoutInflater inflater = mDropDownInflater == null ? mInflater : mDropDownInflater;
        return inflater.inflate(mDropDownLayout, parent, false);
    }

    public void setViewResource(int layout)
    {
        mLayout = layout;
    }

    public void setDropDownViewResource(int dropDownLayout)
    {
        mDropDownLayout = dropDownLayout;
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/ScrollView.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.InputDevice;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.VelocityTracker;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewConfiguration;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.ViewParent;

public class ScrollView extends FrameLayout
{
    private static final float MAX_SCROLL_FACTOR = 0.5f;

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private boolean mFillViewport;
    private boolean mSmoothScrollingEnabled = true;

    private OverScroller mScroller;
    private EdgeEffect mEdgeGlowTop;
    private EdgeEffect mEdgeGlowBottom;
    private VelocityTracker mVelocityTracker;

    private boolean mDragging;
    private float mLastMotionY;
    private int mTouchSlop;
    private int mMinimumVelocity;
    private int mMaximumVelocity;
    private float mVerticalScrollFactor;
    private int mSavedScrollPosition = -1;
    private int mNestedYOffset;

    public ScrollView(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public ScrollView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, ProgressBar.attributeIdentifier(context, "scrollViewStyle"));
    }

    public ScrollView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public ScrollView(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        mScroller = new OverScroller(context);
        mEdgeGlowTop = new EdgeEffect(context);
        mEdgeGlowBottom = new EdgeEffect(context);

        ViewConfiguration configuration = ViewConfiguration.get(context);

        mTouchSlop = configuration.getScaledTouchSlop();
        mMinimumVelocity = configuration.getScaledMinimumFlingVelocity();
        mMaximumVelocity = configuration.getScaledMaximumFlingVelocity();
        mVerticalScrollFactor = configuration.getScaledVerticalScrollFactor();

        setFocusable(true);
        setWillNotDraw(false);

        if (attributes == null) return;

        if (sStyleable == null) sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "fillViewport");
        if (sStyleable.isEmpty()) return;

        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
        mFillViewport = array.getBoolean(0, false);
        array.recycle();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean shouldDelayChildPressedState()
    {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    protected float getTopFadingEdgeStrength()
    {
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return 0f;

        int length = getVerticalFadingEdgeLength();
        if (length <= 0) return 0f;

        return getScrollY() < length ? getScrollY() / (float)length : 1f;
    }

    @Override
    protected float getBottomFadingEdgeStrength()
    {
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return 0f;

        int length = getVerticalFadingEdgeLength();
        if (length <= 0) return 0f;

        int span = getChildAt(0).getBottom() - getScrollY() - (getHeight() - getPaddingBottom());
        return span < length ? span / (float)length : 1f;
    }

    public void setEdgeEffectColor(int color)
    {
        setTopEdgeEffectColor(color);
        setBottomEdgeEffectColor(color);
    }

    public void setBottomEdgeEffectColor(int color)
    {
        mEdgeGlowBottom.setColor(color);
    }

    public void setTopEdgeEffectColor(int color)
    {
        mEdgeGlowTop.setColor(color);
    }

    public int getTopEdgeEffectColor()
    {
        return mEdgeGlowTop.getColor();
    }

    public int getBottomEdgeEffectColor()
    {
        return mEdgeGlowBottom.getColor();
    }

    public int getMaxScrollAmount()
    {
        return (int)(MAX_SCROLL_FACTOR * (getBottom() - getTop()));
    }

    private void ensureSingleChild()
    {
        if (getChildCount() > 0) throw new IllegalStateException("ScrollView can host only one direct child");
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child)
    {
        ensureSingleChild();
        super.addView(child);
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child, int index)
    {
        ensureSingleChild();
        super.addView(child, index);
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child, ViewGroup.LayoutParams params)
    {
        ensureSingleChild();
        super.addView(child, params);
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child, int index, ViewGroup.LayoutParams params)
    {
        ensureSingleChild();
        super.addView(child, index, params);
    }

    private int getScrollRange()
    {
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return 0;

        View child = getChildAt(0);
        int available = getHeight() - getPaddingTop() - getPaddingBottom();

        return Math.max(0, child.getHeight() - available);
    }

    public boolean isFillViewport()
    {
        return mFillViewport;
    }

    public void setFillViewport(boolean fillViewport)
    {
        if (mFillViewport == fillViewport) return;

        mFillViewport = fillViewport;
        requestLayout();
    }

    public boolean isSmoothScrollingEnabled()
    {
        return mSmoothScrollingEnabled;
    }

    public void setSmoothScrollingEnabled(boolean smoothScrollingEnabled)
    {
        mSmoothScrollingEnabled = smoothScrollingEnabled;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        super.onMeasure(widthMeasureSpec, heightMeasureSpec);

        if (!mFillViewport) return;
        if (MeasureSpec.getMode(heightMeasureSpec) == MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED) return;
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return;

        View child = getChildAt(0);
        int height = getMeasuredHeight() - getPaddingTop() - getPaddingBottom();

        ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = child.getLayoutParams();
        int horizontalMargins = 0;
        int verticalMargins = 0;

        if (params instanceof MarginLayoutParams)
        {
            MarginLayoutParams margins = (MarginLayoutParams)params;
            horizontalMargins = margins.leftMargin + margins.rightMargin;
            verticalMargins = margins.topMargin + margins.bottomMargin;
        }

        height -= verticalMargins;
        if (child.getMeasuredHeight() >= height) return;

        int childHeightSpec = MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(height, MeasureSpec.EXACTLY);
        int childWidthSpec = getChildMeasureSpec(widthMeasureSpec, getPaddingLeft() + getPaddingRight() + horizontalMargins,
                                                 params == null ? LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT : params.width);

        child.measure(childWidthSpec, childHeightSpec);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event)
    {
        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event) || executeKeyEvent(event);
    }

    public boolean executeKeyEvent(KeyEvent event)
    {
        if (event.getAction() != KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) return false;
        if (getScrollRange() == 0) return false;

        int keyCode = event.getKeyCode();

        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP) return event.isAltPressed() ? fullScroll(FOCUS_UP) : arrowScroll(FOCUS_UP);
        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN) return event.isAltPressed() ? fullScroll(FOCUS_DOWN) : arrowScroll(FOCUS_DOWN);
        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SPACE) return pageScroll(event.isShiftPressed() ? FOCUS_UP : FOCUS_DOWN);
        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_PAGE_UP) return pageScroll(FOCUS_UP);
        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_PAGE_DOWN) return pageScroll(FOCUS_DOWN);
        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MOVE_HOME) return fullScroll(FOCUS_UP);
        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MOVE_END) return fullScroll(FOCUS_DOWN);

        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public void requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(boolean disallowIntercept)
    {
        if (disallowIntercept) recycleVelocityTracker();

        super.requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(disallowIntercept);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onInterceptTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        int action = event.getActionMasked();

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE && mDragging) return true;

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN)
        {
            mLastMotionY = event.getY();
            mDragging = !mScroller.isFinished();

            startNestedScroll(SCROLL_AXIS_VERTICAL);

            return mDragging;
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE)
        {
            if (Math.abs(event.getY() - mLastMotionY) > mTouchSlop && (getNestedScrollAxes() & SCROLL_AXIS_VERTICAL) == 0)
            {
                mDragging = true;
                mLastMotionY = event.getY();
                mNestedYOffset = 0;

                ViewParent parent = getParent();
                if (parent != null) parent.requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);

                return true;
            }
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP || action == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL)
        {
            mDragging = false;

            springBack();
            stopNestedScroll();
        }

        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (mVelocityTracker == null) mVelocityTracker = VelocityTracker.obtain();
        mVelocityTracker.addMovement(event);

        int action = event.getActionMasked();

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN)
        {
            if (getChildCount() == 0) return false;

            mLastMotionY = event.getY();
            mNestedYOffset = 0;

            if (!mScroller.isFinished()) mScroller.abortAnimation();

            startNestedScroll(SCROLL_AXIS_VERTICAL);
            return true;
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE)
        {
            float y = event.getY();
            int delta = (int)(mLastMotionY - y);

            if (!mDragging && Math.abs(delta) > mTouchSlop)
            {
                mDragging = true;
                delta = delta > 0 ? delta - mTouchSlop : delta + mTouchSlop;

                ViewParent parent = getParent();
                if (parent != null) parent.requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);
            }

            if (!mDragging) return true;

            int[] consumed = new int[2];
            int[] offset = new int[2];

            if (dispatchNestedPreScroll(0, delta, consumed, offset))
            {
                delta -= consumed[1];
                mNestedYOffset += offset[1];
            }

            mLastMotionY = y - offset[1];

            int oldY = getScrollY();
            int range = getScrollRange();
            int requested = oldY + delta;
            int target = Math.max(0, Math.min(range, requested));

            if (target != oldY) scrollTo(getScrollX(), target);

            int scrolled = getScrollY() - oldY;
            int unconsumed = delta - scrolled;

            if (dispatchNestedScroll(0, scrolled, 0, unconsumed, offset))
            {
                mLastMotionY -= offset[1];
                mNestedYOffset += offset[1];
                return true;
            }

            int overScrollMode = getOverScrollMode();
            boolean canOverScroll = overScrollMode == OVER_SCROLL_ALWAYS || (overScrollMode == OVER_SCROLL_IF_CONTENT_SCROLLS && range > 0);

            if (canOverScroll && getHeight() > 0)
            {
                float horizontal = event.getX() / Math.max(1, getWidth());

                if (requested < 0)
                {
                    mEdgeGlowTop.onPull((float)(-requested) / getHeight(), horizontal);
                    if (!mEdgeGlowBottom.isFinished()) mEdgeGlowBottom.onRelease();
                }
                else if (requested > range)
                {
                    mEdgeGlowBottom.onPull((float)(requested - range) / getHeight(), 1f - horizontal);
                    if (!mEdgeGlowTop.isFinished()) mEdgeGlowTop.onRelease();
                }

                if (!mEdgeGlowTop.isFinished() || !mEdgeGlowBottom.isFinished()) invalidate();
            }

            return true;
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP)
        {
            if (mDragging)
            {
                mVelocityTracker.computeCurrentVelocity(1000, mMaximumVelocity);

                int velocity = (int)mVelocityTracker.getYVelocity();

                if (Math.abs(velocity) > mMinimumVelocity) flingWithNestedDispatch(-velocity);
                else springBack();
            }

            endDrag();
            return true;
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL)
        {
            if (mDragging) springBack();

            endDrag();
            return true;
        }

        return super.onTouchEvent(event);
    }

    private void flingWithNestedDispatch(int velocityY)
    {
        int scrollY = getScrollY();
        boolean canFling = (scrollY > 0 || velocityY > 0) && (scrollY < getScrollRange() || velocityY < 0);

        if (dispatchNestedPreFling(0, velocityY)) return;

        dispatchNestedFling(0, velocityY, canFling);
        if (canFling) fling(velocityY);
    }

    private void springBack()
    {
        mScroller.springBack(getScrollX(), getScrollY(), 0, 0, 0, getScrollRange());

        if (!mScroller.isFinished()) invalidate();
    }

    private void endDrag()
    {
        mDragging = false;

        recycleVelocityTracker();
        stopNestedScroll();

        mEdgeGlowTop.onRelease();
        mEdgeGlowBottom.onRelease();
    }

    private void recycleVelocityTracker()
    {
        if (mVelocityTracker == null) return;

        mVelocityTracker.recycle();
        mVelocityTracker = null;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onGenericMotionEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (event.getActionMasked() == MotionEvent.ACTION_SCROLL && event.isFromSource(InputDevice.SOURCE_CLASS_POINTER))
        {
            float axis = event.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_VSCROLL);

            if (axis != 0)
            {
                int delta = Math.round(axis * mVerticalScrollFactor);
                int range = getScrollRange();
                int target = Math.max(0, Math.min(range, getScrollY() - delta));

                if (target != getScrollY())
                {
                    super.scrollTo(getScrollX(), target);
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return super.onGenericMotionEvent(event);
    }

    protected void onOverScrolled(int scrollX, int scrollY, boolean clampedX, boolean clampedY)
    {
        if (!mScroller.isFinished())
        {
            super.scrollTo(scrollX, scrollY);

            if (clampedY) mScroller.springBack(getScrollX(), getScrollY(), 0, 0, 0, getScrollRange());
            return;
        }

        super.scrollTo(scrollX, scrollY);
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return ScrollView.class.getName();
    }

    public boolean pageScroll(int direction)
    {
        int height = getHeight();
        int current = getScrollY();
        int target = direction == FOCUS_DOWN ? current + height : current - height;

        target = Math.max(0, Math.min(getScrollRange(), target));
        if (target == current) return false;

        smoothScrollTo(getScrollX(), target);
        return true;
    }

    public boolean fullScroll(int direction)
    {
        int current = getScrollY();
        int target = direction == FOCUS_DOWN ? getScrollRange() : 0;
        if (target == current) return false;

        smoothScrollTo(getScrollX(), target);
        return true;
    }

    public boolean arrowScroll(int direction)
    {
        int amount = getMaxScrollAmount();
        int current = getScrollY();
        int target = direction == FOCUS_DOWN ? current + amount : current - amount;

        target = Math.max(0, Math.min(getScrollRange(), target));
        if (target == current) return false;

        if (mSmoothScrollingEnabled) smoothScrollBy(0, target - current);
        else scrollTo(getScrollX(), target);

        return true;
    }

    public final void smoothScrollBy(int dx, int dy)
    {
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return;

        int target = Math.max(0, Math.min(getScrollRange(), getScrollY() + dy));

        if (!mSmoothScrollingEnabled)
        {
            if (!mScroller.isFinished()) mScroller.abortAnimation();

            scrollTo(getScrollX(), target);
            return;
        }

        mScroller.startScroll(getScrollX(), getScrollY(), 0, target - getScrollY());
        invalidate();
    }

    public final void smoothScrollTo(int x, int y)
    {
        smoothScrollBy(x - getScrollX(), y - getScrollY());
    }

    @Override
    protected int computeVerticalScrollRange()
    {
        int contentHeight = getHeight() - getPaddingBottom() - getPaddingTop();
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return contentHeight;

        int scrollRange = getChildAt(0).getBottom();
        int scrollY = getScrollY();
        int overscrollBottom = Math.max(0, scrollRange - contentHeight);

        if (scrollY < 0) scrollRange -= scrollY;
        else if (scrollY > overscrollBottom) scrollRange += scrollY - overscrollBottom;

        return scrollRange;
    }

    @Override
    protected int computeVerticalScrollOffset()
    {
        return Math.max(0, getScrollY());
    }

    @Override
    protected void measureChild(View child, int parentWidthMeasureSpec, int parentHeightMeasureSpec)
    {
        ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = child.getLayoutParams();
        if (params == null) params = generateDefaultLayoutParams();

        int childWidthSpec = getChildMeasureSpec(parentWidthMeasureSpec, getPaddingLeft() + getPaddingRight(), params.width);
        int childHeightSpec = MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(
            Math.max(0, MeasureSpec.getSize(parentHeightMeasureSpec) - getPaddingTop() - getPaddingBottom()), MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED);

        child.measure(childWidthSpec, childHeightSpec);
    }

    @Override
    protected void measureChildWithMargins(View child, int parentWidthMeasureSpec, int widthUsed, int parentHeightMeasureSpec,
                                           int heightUsed)
    {
        ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = child.getLayoutParams();
        if (params == null) params = generateDefaultLayoutParams();

        int horizontalMargins = 0;
        int verticalMargins = 0;

        if (params instanceof MarginLayoutParams)
        {
            MarginLayoutParams margins = (MarginLayoutParams)params;
            horizontalMargins = margins.leftMargin + margins.rightMargin;
            verticalMargins = margins.topMargin + margins.bottomMargin;
        }

        int horizontalUsed = getPaddingLeft() + getPaddingRight() + horizontalMargins + widthUsed;
        int childWidthSpec = getChildMeasureSpec(parentWidthMeasureSpec, horizontalUsed, params.width);
        int usedTotal = getPaddingTop() + getPaddingBottom() + verticalMargins + heightUsed;
        int childHeightSpec = MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(Math.max(0, MeasureSpec.getSize(parentHeightMeasureSpec) - usedTotal),
                                                          MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED);

        child.measure(childWidthSpec, childHeightSpec);
    }

    @Override
    public void computeScroll()
    {
        if (mScroller == null || !mScroller.computeScrollOffset()) return;

        int range = getScrollRange();
        int y = mScroller.getCurrY();
        int clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(range, y));

        if (y != clamped && !mScroller.isFinished())
        {
            if (y < 0 && mEdgeGlowTop.isFinished()) mEdgeGlowTop.onAbsorb((int)mScroller.getCurrVelocity());
            else if (y > range && mEdgeGlowBottom.isFinished()) mEdgeGlowBottom.onAbsorb((int)mScroller.getCurrVelocity());
        }

        if (clamped != getScrollY()) onOverScrolled(getScrollX(), clamped, false, y != clamped);

        invalidate();
    }

    public void scrollToDescendant(View child)
    {
        if (child == null || isInLayout()) return;

        Rect rect = new Rect(0, 0, child.getWidth(), child.getHeight());
        rectInMyCoordinates(child, rect);
        rect.offset(getScrollX(), getScrollY());

        int delta = computeScrollDeltaToGetChildRectOnScreen(rect);
        if (delta != 0) scrollBy(0, delta);
    }

    protected int computeScrollDeltaToGetChildRectOnScreen(Rect rect)
    {
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return 0;

        int height = getHeight();
        int screenTop = getScrollY();
        int screenBottom = screenTop + height;
        int fadingEdge = getVerticalFadingEdgeLength();
        View child = getChildAt(0);

        if (rect.top > 0) screenTop += fadingEdge;
        if (rect.bottom < child.getHeight()) screenBottom -= fadingEdge;

        int delta = 0;

        if (rect.bottom > screenBottom && rect.top > screenTop)
        {
            if (rect.height() > height) delta += rect.top - screenTop;
            else delta += rect.bottom - screenBottom;

            delta = Math.min(delta, child.getBottom() - screenBottom);
        }
        else if (rect.top < screenTop && rect.bottom < screenBottom)
        {
            if (rect.height() > height) delta -= screenBottom - rect.bottom;
            else delta -= screenTop - rect.top;

            delta = Math.max(delta, -getScrollY());
        }

        return delta;
    }

    private boolean scrollToChildRect(Rect rect, boolean immediate)
    {
        int delta = computeScrollDeltaToGetChildRectOnScreen(rect);
        if (delta == 0) return false;

        if (immediate) scrollBy(0, delta);
        else smoothScrollBy(0, delta);

        return true;
    }

    private void rectInMyCoordinates(View descendant, Rect rect)
    {
        View current = descendant;

        while (current != null && current != this)
        {
            rect.offset(current.getLeft() - current.getScrollX(), current.getTop() - current.getScrollY());

            ViewParent parent = current.getParent();
            current = parent instanceof View ? (View)parent : null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void requestChildFocus(View child, View focused)
    {
        if (focused != null && !isInLayout())
        {
            Rect rect = new Rect(0, 0, focused.getWidth(), focused.getHeight());
            rectInMyCoordinates(focused, rect);
            rect.offset(getScrollX(), getScrollY());
            scrollToChildRect(rect, false);
        }

        super.requestChildFocus(child, focused);
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onRequestFocusInDescendants(int direction, Rect previouslyFocusedRect)
    {
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return false;

        return getChildAt(0).requestFocus(direction, previouslyFocusedRect);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean requestChildRectangleOnScreen(View child, Rect rectangle, boolean immediate)
    {
        rectangle.offset(child.getLeft() - child.getScrollX(), child.getTop() - child.getScrollY());

        return scrollToChildRect(rectangle, immediate);
    }

    @Override
    public void requestLayout()
    {
        super.requestLayout();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onLayout(boolean changed, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        super.onLayout(changed, left, top, right, bottom);

        if (mSavedScrollPosition >= 0)
        {
            int position = mSavedScrollPosition;
            mSavedScrollPosition = -1;
            super.scrollTo(getScrollX(), Math.max(0, Math.min(getScrollRange(), position)));
            return;
        }

        int clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(getScrollRange(), getScrollY()));
        if (clamped != getScrollY()) super.scrollTo(getScrollX(), clamped);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow()
    {
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();

        if (!mScroller.isFinished()) mScroller.abortAnimation();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onSizeChanged(int width, int height, int oldWidth, int oldHeight)
    {
        super.onSizeChanged(width, height, oldWidth, oldHeight);

        int clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(getScrollRange(), getScrollY()));
        if (clamped != getScrollY()) super.scrollTo(getScrollX(), clamped);
    }

    public void fling(int velocityY)
    {
        if (getChildCount() == 0) return;

        int height = getHeight() - getPaddingBottom() - getPaddingTop();
        int bottom = getChildAt(0).getHeight();

        mScroller.fling(getScrollX(), getScrollY(), 0, velocityY, 0, 0, 0, Math.max(0, bottom - height), 0, height / 2);
        invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    public void scrollTo(int x, int y)
    {
        if (getChildCount() > 0)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(0);
            x = clamp(x, getWidth() - getPaddingRight() - getPaddingLeft(), child.getWidth());
            y = clamp(y, getHeight() - getPaddingBottom() - getPaddingTop(), child.getHeight());
        }

        if (x != getScrollX() || y != getScrollY()) super.scrollTo(x, y);
    }

    private static int clamp(int position, int viewport, int content)
    {
        if (viewport >= content || position < 0) return 0;
        if (viewport + position > content) return content - viewport;

        return position;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onStartNestedScroll(View child, View target, int nestedScrollAxes)
    {
        return (nestedScrollAxes & SCROLL_AXIS_VERTICAL) != 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void onNestedScrollAccepted(View child, View target, int axes)
    {
        super.onNestedScrollAccepted(child, target, axes);

        startNestedScroll(SCROLL_AXIS_VERTICAL);
    }

    @Override
    public void onStopNestedScroll(View target)
    {
        super.onStopNestedScroll(target);
    }

    @Override
    public void onNestedScroll(View target, int dxConsumed, int dyConsumed, int dxUnconsumed, int dyUnconsumed)
    {
        int oldScrollY = getScrollY();
        scrollBy(0, dyUnconsumed);

        int consumed = getScrollY() - oldScrollY;
        dispatchNestedScroll(0, consumed, 0, dyUnconsumed - consumed, null);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onNestedFling(View target, float velocityX, float velocityY, boolean consumed)
    {
        if (consumed) return false;

        flingWithNestedDispatch((int)velocityY);
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        super.draw(canvas);

        int scrollY = getScrollY();

        if (!mEdgeGlowTop.isFinished())
        {
            int saveCount = canvas.save();
            int width = getWidth() - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight();

            canvas.translate(getPaddingLeft(), Math.min(0, scrollY));
            mEdgeGlowTop.setSize(width, getHeight());
            if (mEdgeGlowTop.draw(canvas)) invalidate();
            canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
        }

        if (!mEdgeGlowBottom.isFinished())
        {
            int saveCount = canvas.save();
            int width = getWidth() - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight();
            int height = getHeight();

            canvas.translate(getPaddingLeft() - width, Math.max(getScrollRange(), scrollY) + height);
            canvas.rotate(180, width, 0);
            mEdgeGlowBottom.setSize(width, height);
            if (mEdgeGlowBottom.draw(canvas)) invalidate();
            canvas.restoreToCount(saveCount);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onRestoreInstanceState(Parcelable state)
    {
        if (!(state instanceof SavedState))
        {
            super.onRestoreInstanceState(state);
            return;
        }

        SavedState saved = (SavedState)state;
        super.onRestoreInstanceState(saved.getSuperState());

        mSavedScrollPosition = saved.mScrollPosition;
        requestLayout();
    }

    @Override
    protected Parcelable onSaveInstanceState()
    {
        SavedState state = new SavedState(super.onSaveInstanceState());
        state.mScrollPosition = getScrollY();
        return state;
    }

    static class SavedState extends BaseSavedState
    {
        public static final Parcelable.Creator<SavedState> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<SavedState>()
        {
            @Override
            public SavedState createFromParcel(Parcel source)
            {
                return new SavedState(source);
            }

            @Override
            public SavedState[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new SavedState[size];
            }
        };

        int mScrollPosition;

        SavedState(Parcelable superState)
        {
            super(superState);
        }

        private SavedState(Parcel source)
        {
            super(source);
            mScrollPosition = source.readInt();
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
        {
            super.writeToParcel(out, flags);
            out.writeInt(mScrollPosition);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/Scroller.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.view.ViewConfiguration;
import android.view.animation.Interpolator;

public class Scroller
{
    private static final int DEFAULT_DURATION = 250;
    private static final float INFLEXION = 0.35f;

    private final Interpolator mInterpolator;
    private final float mBaseDeceleration;
    private final float mPhysicalCoefficient;
    private float mDeceleration;

    private int mMode;
    private static final int MODE_SCROLL = 0;
    private static final int MODE_FLING = 1;

    private int mStartX;
    private int mStartY;
    private int mFinalX;
    private int mFinalY;
    private int mCurrentX;
    private int mCurrentY;
    private int mDeltaX;
    private int mDeltaY;

    private long mStartTime;
    private int mDuration;
    private boolean mFinished = true;

    private float mVelocity;
    private float mDirectionX;
    private float mDirectionY;

    public Scroller(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public Scroller(Context context, Interpolator interpolator)
    {
        this(context, interpolator, true);
    }

    public Scroller(Context context, Interpolator interpolator, boolean flywheel)
    {
        mInterpolator = interpolator;

        float density = context == null || context.getResources() == null
                            ? 1.0f
                            : context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;

        mBaseDeceleration = 386.0878f * 160.0f * density * 0.84f;
        mDeceleration = mBaseDeceleration;
        mPhysicalCoefficient = 9.80665f * 39.37f * 160.0f * density * 0.84f;
    }

    public final void setFriction(float friction)
    {
        mDeceleration = mBaseDeceleration * (Math.max(friction, 0.0001f) / ViewConfiguration.getScrollFriction());
    }

    public final boolean isFinished()
    {
        return mFinished;
    }

    public final void forceFinished(boolean finished)
    {
        mFinished = finished;
    }

    public final int getDuration()
    {
        return mDuration;
    }

    public final int getCurrX()
    {
        return mCurrentX;
    }

    public final int getCurrY()
    {
        return mCurrentY;
    }

    public final int getStartX()
    {
        return mStartX;
    }

    public final int getStartY()
    {
        return mStartY;
    }

    public final int getFinalX()
    {
        return mFinalX;
    }

    public final int getFinalY()
    {
        return mFinalY;
    }

    public void setFinalX(int x)
    {
        mFinalX = x;
        mDeltaX = mFinalX - mStartX;
        mFinished = false;
    }

    public void setFinalY(int y)
    {
        mFinalY = y;
        mDeltaY = mFinalY - mStartY;
        mFinished = false;
    }

    public float getCurrVelocity()
    {
        if (mMode != MODE_FLING) return 0;

        long elapsed = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() - mStartTime;
        float remaining = mVelocity - mDeceleration * (elapsed / 1000.0f);

        return remaining < 0 ? 0 : remaining;
    }

    public boolean computeScrollOffset()
    {
        if (mFinished) return false;

        long elapsed = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() - mStartTime;

        if (elapsed >= mDuration)
        {
            mCurrentX = mFinalX;
            mCurrentY = mFinalY;
            mFinished = true;

            return true;
        }

        float fraction = (float)elapsed / (float)mDuration;
        float eased = mInterpolator == null ? viscous(fraction) : mInterpolator.getInterpolation(fraction);

        mCurrentX = mStartX + Math.round(eased * mDeltaX);
        mCurrentY = mStartY + Math.round(eased * mDeltaY);

        return true;
    }

    private static float viscous(float fraction)
    {
        float inverse = 1.0f - fraction;

        return 1.0f - inverse * inverse * inverse;
    }

    public void startScroll(int startX, int startY, int deltaX, int deltaY)
    {
        startScroll(startX, startY, deltaX, deltaY, DEFAULT_DURATION);
    }

    public void startScroll(int startX, int startY, int deltaX, int deltaY, int duration)
    {
        mMode = MODE_SCROLL;
        mFinished = false;
        mDuration = duration <= 0 ? 1 : duration;
        mStartTime = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();

        mStartX = startX;
        mStartY = startY;
        mCurrentX = startX;
        mCurrentY = startY;
        mFinalX = startX + deltaX;
        mFinalY = startY + deltaY;
        mDeltaX = deltaX;
        mDeltaY = deltaY;
    }

    public void fling(int startX, int startY, int velocityX, int velocityY, int minX, int maxX, int minY, int maxY)
    {
        mMode = MODE_FLING;
        mFinished = false;

        float velocity = (float)Math.hypot(velocityX, velocityY);
        mVelocity = velocity;

        if (velocity < 1)
        {
            mDuration = 1;
            mStartX = mCurrentX = mFinalX = startX;
            mStartY = mCurrentY = mFinalY = startY;
            mDeltaX = 0;
            mDeltaY = 0;
            mStartTime = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();

            return;
        }

        mDuration = Math.max(1, (int)(1000.0f * velocity / mDeceleration));
        mStartTime = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();

        mDirectionX = velocityX / velocity;
        mDirectionY = velocityY / velocity;

        double distance = velocity * velocity / (2.0 * mDeceleration);

        mStartX = startX;
        mStartY = startY;
        mCurrentX = startX;
        mCurrentY = startY;

        mFinalX = clamp(startX + (int)Math.round(distance * mDirectionX), minX, maxX);
        mFinalY = clamp(startY + (int)Math.round(distance * mDirectionY), minY, maxY);

        mDeltaX = mFinalX - mStartX;
        mDeltaY = mFinalY - mStartY;
    }

    static int clamp(int value, int low, int high)
    {
        if (value < low) return low;
        if (value > high) return high;

        return value;
    }

    public void abortAnimation()
    {
        mCurrentX = mFinalX;
        mCurrentY = mFinalY;
        mFinished = true;
    }

    public void extendDuration(int extra)
    {
        long elapsed = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() - mStartTime;

        mDuration = (int)elapsed + extra;
        mFinished = false;
    }

    public int timePassed()
    {
        return (int)(android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() - mStartTime);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.widget;
```

```java
        void onStartTrackingTouch(SeekBar seekBar);

        void onStopTrackingTouch(SeekBar seekBar);

        this(context, null);

        mOnSeekBarChangeListener = listener;
    }

        if (mOnSeekBarChangeListener != null) mOnSeekBarChangeListener.onStopTrackingTouch(this);
```

`java/android/widget/ShareActionProvider.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.content.pm.ResolveInfo;
import android.view.ActionProvider;
import android.view.MenuItem;
import android.view.SubMenu;
import android.view.View;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;

public class ShareActionProvider extends ActionProvider
{
    public static final String DEFAULT_SHARE_HISTORY_FILE_NAME = "share_history.xml";

    private static final int DEFAULT_INITIAL_ACTIVITY_COUNT = 4;

    private static final HashMap<String, HashMap<String, Integer>> sHistories = new HashMap<>();

    private final Context mContext;
    private String mShareHistoryFileName = DEFAULT_SHARE_HISTORY_FILE_NAME;
    private Intent mShareIntent;
    private OnShareTargetSelectedListener mListener;

    public ShareActionProvider(Context context)
    {
        super(context);
        mContext = context;
    }

    public void setOnShareTargetSelectedListener(OnShareTargetSelectedListener listener)
    {
        mListener = listener;
    }

    public void setShareHistoryFileName(String shareHistoryFile)
    {
        mShareHistoryFileName = shareHistoryFile;
    }

    public void setShareIntent(Intent shareIntent)
    {
        if (shareIntent != null)
        {
            String action = shareIntent.getAction();
            if (Intent.ACTION_SEND.equals(action) || Intent.ACTION_SEND_MULTIPLE.equals(action))
            {
                shareIntent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_DOCUMENT | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_MULTIPLE_TASK);
            }
        }

        mShareIntent = shareIntent;
    }

    @Override
    public View onCreateActionView()
    {
        ImageButton button = new ImageButton(mContext);
        List<ResolveInfo> targets = targets();
        PackageManager packageManager = mContext.getPackageManager();

        if (!targets.isEmpty()) button.setImageDrawable(targets.get(0).loadIcon(packageManager));
        button.setContentDescription("Share with");
        button.setEnabled(mShareIntent != null && !targets.isEmpty());
        button.setOnClickListener(view ->
        {
            List<ResolveInfo> current = targets();
            if (current.isEmpty()) return;

            if (current.size() == 1)
            {
                choose(current.get(0));
                return;
            }

            PopupMenu popup = new PopupMenu(mContext, view);
            populate(popup.getMenu(), current, current.size());
            popup.show();
        });

        return button;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasSubMenu()
    {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void onPrepareSubMenu(SubMenu subMenu)
    {
        subMenu.clear();

        List<ResolveInfo> targets = targets();
        int shown = Math.min(targets.size(), DEFAULT_INITIAL_ACTIVITY_COUNT);
        populate(subMenu, targets, shown);

        if (shown >= targets.size()) return;

        SubMenu expanded = subMenu.addSubMenu(0, shown, shown, "See all");
        populate(expanded, targets, targets.size());
    }

    private void populate(android.view.Menu menu, List<ResolveInfo> targets, int count)
    {
        PackageManager packageManager = mContext.getPackageManager();

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            ResolveInfo target = targets.get(index);
            MenuItem item = menu.add(0, index, index, target.loadLabel(packageManager));
            item.setIcon(target.loadIcon(packageManager));
            item.setOnMenuItemClickListener(clicked ->
            {
                choose(target);
                return true;
            });
        }
    }

    private List<ResolveInfo> targets()
    {
        if (mShareIntent == null) return new ArrayList<>();

        List<ResolveInfo> resolved = mContext.getPackageManager().queryIntentActivities(mShareIntent, 0);
        ArrayList<ResolveInfo> sorted = resolved == null ? new ArrayList<>() : new ArrayList<>(resolved);
        HashMap<String, Integer> history = history();
        sorted.sort((first, second) -> Integer.compare(count(history, second), count(history, first)));
        return sorted;
    }

    private HashMap<String, Integer> history()
    {
        synchronized (sHistories)
        {
            String key = mShareHistoryFileName == null ? "" : mShareHistoryFileName;
            HashMap<String, Integer> history = sHistories.get(key);

            if (history == null)
            {
                history = new HashMap<>();
                sHistories.put(key, history);
            }

            return history;
        }
    }

    private static int count(HashMap<String, Integer> history, ResolveInfo target)
    {
        synchronized (sHistories)
        {
            Integer count = history.get(componentOf(target).flattenToString());
            return count == null ? 0 : count;
        }
    }

    private static ComponentName componentOf(ResolveInfo target)
    {
        return new ComponentName(target.activityInfo.packageName, target.activityInfo.name);
    }

    private void choose(ResolveInfo target)
    {
        if (mShareIntent == null) return;

        ComponentName component = componentOf(target);
        Intent intent = new Intent(mShareIntent);
        intent.setComponent(component);

        if (mShareHistoryFileName != null)
        {
            HashMap<String, Integer> history = history();
            synchronized (sHistories)
            {
                String key = component.flattenToString();
                Integer count = history.get(key);
                history.put(key, count == null ? 1 : count + 1);
            }
        }

        if (mListener != null) mListener.onShareTargetSelected(this, intent);

        intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
        mContext.startActivity(intent);
    }

    public interface OnShareTargetSelectedListener
    {
        boolean onShareTargetSelected(ShareActionProvider source, Intent intent);
    }
}
```
