`java/android/widget/SimpleAdapter.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.view.ContextThemeWrapper;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;

public class SimpleAdapter extends BaseAdapter implements Filterable, ThemedSpinnerAdapter
{
    private final LayoutInflater mInflater;
    private final int[] mTo;
    private final String[] mFrom;
    private ViewBinder mViewBinder;
    private List<? extends Map<String, ?>> mData;
    private final int mResource;
    private int mDropDownResource;
    private LayoutInflater mDropDownInflater;
    private SimpleFilter mFilter;
    private ArrayList<Map<String, ?>> mUnfilteredData;

    public SimpleAdapter(Context context, List<? extends Map<String, ?>> data, int resource, String[] from, int[] to)
    {
        mData = data;
        mResource = resource;
        mDropDownResource = resource;
        mFrom = from;
        mTo = to;
        mInflater = LayoutInflater.from(context);
    }

    @Override
    public int getCount()
    {
        return mData.size();
    }

    @Override
    public Object getItem(int position)
    {
        return mData.get(position);
    }

    @Override
    public long getItemId(int position)
    {
        return position;
    }

    @Override
    public View getView(int position, View convertView, ViewGroup parent)
    {
        return createViewFromResource(mInflater, position, convertView, parent, mResource);
    }

    private View createViewFromResource(LayoutInflater inflater, int position, View convertView, ViewGroup parent, int resource)
    {
        View view = convertView == null ? inflater.inflate(resource, parent, false) : convertView;

        bindView(position, view);
        return view;
    }

    public void setDropDownViewResource(int resource)
    {
        mDropDownResource = resource;
    }

    @Override
    public void setDropDownViewTheme(Resources.Theme theme)
    {
        if (theme == null) mDropDownInflater = null;
        else if (theme == mInflater.getContext().getTheme()) mDropDownInflater = mInflater;
        else mDropDownInflater = LayoutInflater.from(new ContextThemeWrapper(mInflater.getContext(), theme));
    }

    @Override
    public Resources.Theme getDropDownViewTheme()
    {
        return mDropDownInflater == null ? null : mDropDownInflater.getContext().getTheme();
    }

    @Override
    public View getDropDownView(int position, View convertView, ViewGroup parent)
    {
        LayoutInflater inflater = mDropDownInflater == null ? mInflater : mDropDownInflater;
        return createViewFromResource(inflater, position, convertView, parent, mDropDownResource);
    }

    private void bindView(int position, View view)
    {
        Map<String, ?> data = mData.get(position);
        if (data == null) return;

        ViewBinder binder = mViewBinder;
        int count = Math.min(mTo.length, mFrom.length);

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            View target = view.findViewById(mTo[index]);
            if (target == null) continue;

            Object value = data.get(mFrom[index]);
            String text = value == null ? "" : value.toString();

            boolean bound = binder != null && binder.setViewValue(target, value, text);
            if (bound) continue;

            if (target instanceof Checkable)
            {
                if (value instanceof Boolean) ((Checkable)target).setChecked((Boolean)value);
                else if (target instanceof TextView) setViewText((TextView)target, text);
                else throw new IllegalStateException(target.getClass().getName() + " should be bound to a Boolean, not a "
                                                     + (value == null ? "<unknown type>" : value.getClass().getName()));
            }
            else if (target instanceof TextView)
            {
                setViewText((TextView)target, text);
            }
            else if (target instanceof ImageView)
            {
                if (value instanceof Integer) setViewImage((ImageView)target, (Integer)value);
                else setViewImage((ImageView)target, text);
            }
            else
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException(target.getClass().getName() + " is not a view that can be bounds by this SimpleAdapter");
            }
        }
    }

    public ViewBinder getViewBinder()
    {
        return mViewBinder;
    }

    public void setViewBinder(ViewBinder viewBinder)
    {
        mViewBinder = viewBinder;
    }

    public void setViewImage(ImageView view, int value)
    {
        view.setImageResource(value);
    }

    public void setViewImage(ImageView view, String value)
    {
        try
        {
            view.setImageResource(Integer.parseInt(value));
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException notResource)
        {
            view.setImageURI(Uri.parse(value));
        }
    }

    public void setViewText(TextView view, String text)
    {
        view.setText(text);
    }

    @Override
    public Filter getFilter()
    {
        if (mFilter == null) mFilter = new SimpleFilter();
        return mFilter;
    }

    public interface ViewBinder
    {
        boolean setViewValue(View view, Object data, String textRepresentation);
    }

    private class SimpleFilter extends Filter
    {
        @Override
        protected FilterResults performFiltering(CharSequence prefix)
        {
            FilterResults results = new FilterResults();

            if (mUnfilteredData == null) mUnfilteredData = new ArrayList<Map<String, ?>>(mData);

            if (prefix == null || prefix.length() == 0)
            {
                ArrayList<Map<String, ?>> list = new ArrayList<Map<String, ?>>(mUnfilteredData);
                results.values = list;
                results.count = list.size();
                return results;
            }

            String prefixString = prefix.toString().toLowerCase(Locale.getDefault());
            ArrayList<Map<String, ?>> matches = new ArrayList<Map<String, ?>>();

            for (Map<String, ?> entry : mUnfilteredData)
            {
                if (entry == null) continue;

                for (String key : mFrom)
                {
                    Object value = entry.get(key);
                    if (value == null) continue;

                    if (matchesPrefix(value.toString().toLowerCase(Locale.getDefault()), prefixString))
                    {
                        matches.add(entry);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            results.values = matches;
            results.count = matches.size();
            return results;
        }

        private boolean matchesPrefix(String value, String prefix)
        {
            for (String word : value.split(" "))
            {
                if (word.startsWith(prefix)) return true;
            }

            return false;
        }

        @Override
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        protected void publishResults(CharSequence constraint, FilterResults results)
        {
            mData = results.values == null ? new ArrayList<Map<String, ?>>() : (List<Map<String, ?>>)results.values;

            if (results.count > 0) notifyDataSetChanged();
            else notifyDataSetInvalidated();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.view.View;

public class SimpleCursorAdapter extends ResourceCursorAdapter
{
    protected int[] mFrom;
    protected int[] mTo;

    private int mStringConversionColumn = -1;
    private CursorToStringConverter mCursorToStringConverter;
    private ViewBinder mViewBinder;
    private String[] mOriginalFrom;

    @Deprecated
    public SimpleCursorAdapter(Context context, int layout, Cursor cursor, String[] from, int[] to)
    {
        super(context, layout, cursor);
        mTo = to;
        mOriginalFrom = from;
        findColumns(cursor, from);
    }

    public SimpleCursorAdapter(Context context, int layout, Cursor cursor, String[] from, int[] to, int flags)
    {
        super(context, layout, cursor, flags);
        mTo = to;
        mOriginalFrom = from;
        findColumns(cursor, from);
    }

    @Override
    public void bindView(View view, Context context, Cursor cursor)
    {
        ViewBinder binder = mViewBinder;
        int[] from = mFrom;
        int[] to = mTo;
        if (from == null || to == null) return;

        int count = Math.min(from.length, to.length);

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            View target = view.findViewById(to[index]);
            if (target == null) continue;

            boolean bound = binder != null && binder.setViewValue(target, cursor, from[index]);
            if (bound) continue;

            String text = cursor.getString(from[index]);
            if (text == null) text = "";

            if (target instanceof TextView)
            {
                setViewText((TextView)target, text);
            }
            else if (target instanceof ImageView)
            {
                setViewImage((ImageView)target, text);
            }
            else
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException(target.getClass().getName() + " is not a view that can be bound by this SimpleCursorAdapter");
            }
        }
    }

    public ViewBinder getViewBinder()
    {
        return mViewBinder;
    }

    public void setViewBinder(ViewBinder viewBinder)
    {
        mViewBinder = viewBinder;
    }

    public void setViewImage(ImageView view, String value)
    {
        try
        {
            view.setImageResource(Integer.parseInt(value));
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException notResource)
        {
            view.setImageURI(Uri.parse(value));
        }
    }

    public void setViewText(TextView view, String text)
    {
        view.setText(text);
    }

    public int getStringConversionColumn()
    {
        return mStringConversionColumn;
    }

    public void setStringConversionColumn(int stringConversionColumn)
    {
        mStringConversionColumn = stringConversionColumn;
    }

    public CursorToStringConverter getCursorToStringConverter()
    {
        return mCursorToStringConverter;
    }

    public void setCursorToStringConverter(CursorToStringConverter cursorToStringConverter)
    {
        mCursorToStringConverter = cursorToStringConverter;
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence convertToString(Cursor cursor)
    {
        if (mCursorToStringConverter != null) return mCursorToStringConverter.convertToString(cursor);
        if (mStringConversionColumn > -1) return cursor.getString(mStringConversionColumn);

        return super.convertToString(cursor);
    }

    private void findColumns(Cursor cursor, String[] from)
    {
        if (cursor == null || from == null)
        {
            mFrom = null;
            return;
        }

        int count = from.length;
        if (mFrom == null || mFrom.length != count) mFrom = new int[count];

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) mFrom[index] = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(from[index]);
    }

    @Override
    public Cursor swapCursor(Cursor cursor)
    {
        findColumns(cursor, mOriginalFrom);
        return super.swapCursor(cursor);
    }

    public void changeCursorAndColumns(Cursor cursor, String[] from, int[] to)
    {
        mOriginalFrom = from;
        mTo = to;
        findColumns(cursor, mOriginalFrom);
        super.changeCursor(cursor);
    }

    public interface ViewBinder
    {
        boolean setViewValue(View view, Cursor cursor, int columnIndex);
    }

    public interface CursorToStringConverter
    {
        CharSequence convertToString(Cursor cursor);
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/Spinner.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.DialogInterface;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.database.DataSetObserver;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.ContextThemeWrapper;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.PointerIcon;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

public class Spinner extends AbsSpinner implements DialogInterface.OnClickListener
{
    public static final int MODE_DIALOG = 0;
    public static final int MODE_DROPDOWN = 1;

    private static final int MODE_THEME = -1;
    private static final int MAX_ITEMS_MEASURED = 15;

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private final Context mPopupContext;
    private SpinnerPopup mPopup;
    private SpinnerAdapter mTempAdapter;
    private int mDropDownWidth = ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
    private int mGravity = Gravity.CENTER;
    private boolean mDisableChildrenWhenDisabled;
    private final Rect mTempRect = new Rect();

    public Spinner(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public Spinner(Context context, int mode)
    {
        this(context, null, 0, 0, mode);
    }

    public Spinner(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, 0);
    }

    public Spinner(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0, MODE_THEME);
    }

    public Spinner(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int mode)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0, mode);
    }

    public Spinner(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes, int mode)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes, mode, null);
    }

    public Spinner(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes, int mode, Resources.Theme popupTheme)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        mPopupContext = popupTheme != null ? new ContextThemeWrapper(context, popupTheme) : context;
        setClickable(true);

        int resolvedMode = mode;
        CharSequence prompt = null;
        Drawable popupBackground = null;
        int verticalOffset = 0;
        int horizontalOffset = 0;
        boolean verticalOffsetSet = false;

        if (attributes != null)
        {
            if (sStyleable == null)
            {
                sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "spinnerMode", "prompt", "dropDownWidth", "dropDownVerticalOffset",
                                             "dropDownHorizontalOffset", "popupBackground", "gravity", "disableChildrenWhenDisabled");
            }

            if (!sStyleable.isEmpty())
            {
                TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

                int index = sStyleable.indexOf("spinnerMode");
                if (resolvedMode == MODE_THEME && index >= 0) resolvedMode = array.getInt(index, MODE_DROPDOWN);

                index = sStyleable.indexOf("prompt");
                if (index >= 0) prompt = array.getText(index);

                index = sStyleable.indexOf("dropDownWidth");
                if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index))
                {
                    mDropDownWidth = array.getLayoutDimension(index, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
                }

                index = sStyleable.indexOf("dropDownVerticalOffset");
                if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index))
                {
                    verticalOffset = array.getDimensionPixelOffset(index, 0);
                    verticalOffsetSet = true;
                }

                index = sStyleable.indexOf("dropDownHorizontalOffset");
                if (index >= 0) horizontalOffset = array.getDimensionPixelOffset(index, 0);

                index = sStyleable.indexOf("popupBackground");
                if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index))
                {
                    try
                    {
                        popupBackground = array.getDrawable(index);
                    }
                    catch (RuntimeException unsupported)
                    {
                        popupBackground = null;
                    }
                }

                index = sStyleable.indexOf("gravity");
                if (index >= 0) mGravity = array.getInt(index, Gravity.CENTER);

                index = sStyleable.indexOf("disableChildrenWhenDisabled");
                if (index >= 0) mDisableChildrenWhenDisabled = array.getBoolean(index, false);

                array.recycle();
            }
        }

        if (resolvedMode == MODE_THEME) resolvedMode = MODE_DROPDOWN;

        if (resolvedMode == MODE_DIALOG)
        {
            mPopup = new DialogPopup();
        }
        else
        {
            DropdownPopup popup = new DropdownPopup(mPopupContext);
            if (popupBackground != null) popup.setBackgroundDrawable(popupBackground);
            if (verticalOffsetSet) popup.setVerticalOffset(verticalOffset);
            popup.setHorizontalOffset(horizontalOffset);
            mPopup = popup;
        }

        if (prompt != null) mPopup.setPromptText(prompt);

        if (mTempAdapter != null)
        {
            setAdapter(mTempAdapter);
            mTempAdapter = null;
        }
    }

    public Context getPopupContext()
    {
        return mPopupContext;
    }

    public void setPopupBackgroundDrawable(Drawable background)
    {
        if (!(mPopup instanceof DropdownPopup))
        {
            android.util.Log.e("Spinner", "setPopupBackgroundDrawable: incompatible spinner mode; ignoring...");
            return;
        }

        mPopup.setBackgroundDrawable(background);
    }

    public void setPopupBackgroundResource(int resId)
    {
        setPopupBackgroundDrawable(getPopupContext().getDrawable(resId));
    }

    public Drawable getPopupBackground()
    {
        return mPopup.getBackground();
    }

    public void setDropDownVerticalOffset(int pixels)
    {
        mPopup.setVerticalOffset(pixels);
    }

    public int getDropDownVerticalOffset()
    {
        return mPopup.getVerticalOffset();
    }

    public void setDropDownHorizontalOffset(int pixels)
    {
        mPopup.setHorizontalOffset(pixels);
    }

    public int getDropDownHorizontalOffset()
    {
        return mPopup.getHorizontalOffset();
    }

    public void setDropDownWidth(int pixels)
    {
        if (!(mPopup instanceof DropdownPopup))
        {
            android.util.Log.e("Spinner", "Cannot set dropdown width for MODE_DIALOG, ignoring");
            return;
        }

        mDropDownWidth = pixels;
    }

    public int getDropDownWidth()
    {
        return mDropDownWidth;
    }

    @Override
    public void setEnabled(boolean enabled)
    {
        super.setEnabled(enabled);

        if (!mDisableChildrenWhenDisabled) return;

        for (int index = 0; index < getChildCount(); index++) getChildAt(index).setEnabled(enabled);
    }

    public void setGravity(int gravity)
    {
        if (mGravity == gravity) return;

        if ((gravity & Gravity.HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK) == 0) gravity |= Gravity.START;
        mGravity = gravity;
        requestLayout();
    }

    public int getGravity()
    {
        return mGravity;
    }

    @Override
    public void setAdapter(SpinnerAdapter adapter)
    {
        if (mPopup == null)
        {
            mTempAdapter = adapter;
            return;
        }

        super.setAdapter(adapter);
        mRecycledViews.clear();

        if (adapter != null && adapter.getViewTypeCount() != 1)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Spinner adapter view type count must be 1");
        }

        mPopup.setAdapter(new DropDownAdapter(adapter, mPopupContext.getTheme()));
    }

    @Override
    public int getBaseline()
    {
        View child = null;

        if (getChildCount() > 0) child = getChildAt(0);
        else if (mAdapter != null && mAdapter.getCount() > 0)
        {
            child = makeView(0, false);
            mRecycledViews.put(0, child);
        }

        if (child == null) return -1;

        int childBaseline = child.getBaseline();
        return childBaseline >= 0 ? child.getTop() + childBaseline : -1;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow()
    {
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
        if (mPopup != null && mPopup.isShowing()) mPopup.dismiss();
    }

    @Override
    public void setOnItemClickListener(OnItemClickListener listener)
    {
        throw new RuntimeException("setOnItemClickListener cannot be used with a spinner.");
    }

    void setOnItemClickListenerInt(OnItemClickListener listener)
    {
        super.setOnItemClickListener(listener);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        return super.onTouchEvent(event);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        super.onMeasure(widthMeasureSpec, heightMeasureSpec);

        if (mPopup != null && MeasureSpec.getMode(widthMeasureSpec) == MeasureSpec.AT_MOST)
        {
            int measuredWidth = getMeasuredWidth();
            int contentWidth = measureContentWidth(getAdapter(), getBackground());
            int width = Math.min(Math.max(measuredWidth, contentWidth), MeasureSpec.getSize(widthMeasureSpec));
            setMeasuredDimension(width, getMeasuredHeight());
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onLayout(boolean changed, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        super.onLayout(changed, left, top, right, bottom);

        mInLayout = true;
        layout(0, false);
        mInLayout = false;
    }

    @Override
    void layout(int delta, boolean animate)
    {
        int childrenLeft = mSpinnerPadding.left;
        int childrenWidth = getRight() - getLeft() - mSpinnerPadding.left - mSpinnerPadding.right;

        if (mDataChanged) handleDataChanged();

        if (mItemCount == 0 || mAdapter == null)
        {
            resetList();
            return;
        }

        if (mNextSelectedPosition >= 0) setSelectedPositionInt(mNextSelectedPosition);

        recycleAllViews();
        removeAllViewsInLayout();

        mFirstPosition = mSelectedPosition;

        View selected = makeView(mSelectedPosition, true);
        int width = selected.getMeasuredWidth();
        int selectedOffset = childrenLeft;

        int horizontal = Gravity.getAbsoluteGravity(mGravity, getLayoutDirection()) & Gravity.HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK;
        if (horizontal == Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL) selectedOffset = childrenLeft + (childrenWidth / 2) - (width / 2);
        else if (horizontal == Gravity.RIGHT) selectedOffset = childrenLeft + childrenWidth - width;

        selected.offsetLeftAndRight(selectedOffset);

        mRecycledViews.clear();
        invalidate();
        checkSelectionChanged();

        mDataChanged = false;
        setNextSelectedPositionInt(mSelectedPosition);
    }

    private View makeView(int position, boolean addChild)
    {
        View child;

        if (!mDataChanged)
        {
            child = mRecycledViews.get(position);
            if (child != null)
            {
                mRecycledViews.remove(position);
                setUpChild(child, addChild);
                return child;
            }
        }

        child = mAdapter.getView(position, null, this);
        setUpChild(child, addChild);
        return child;
    }

    private void setUpChild(View child, boolean addChild)
    {
        ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = child.getLayoutParams();
        if (params == null) params = generateDefaultLayoutParams();

        if (addChild)
        {
            if (child.getParent() instanceof ViewGroup && child.getParent() != this) ((ViewGroup)child.getParent()).removeView(child);
            if (child.getParent() == null) addViewInLayout(child, 0, params);
        }

        child.setSelected(hasFocus());
        if (mDisableChildrenWhenDisabled) child.setEnabled(isEnabled());

        int verticalPadding = mSpinnerPadding.top + mSpinnerPadding.bottom;
        int horizontalPadding = mSpinnerPadding.left + mSpinnerPadding.right;

        int childHeightSpec = ViewGroup.getChildMeasureSpec(mHeightMeasureSpec, verticalPadding, params.height);
        int childWidthSpec = ViewGroup.getChildMeasureSpec(mWidthMeasureSpec, horizontalPadding, params.width);
        child.measure(childWidthSpec, childHeightSpec);

        int childTop = mSpinnerPadding.top + ((getMeasuredHeight() - verticalPadding - child.getMeasuredHeight()) / 2);
        int childBottom = childTop + child.getMeasuredHeight();
        child.layout(0, childTop, child.getMeasuredWidth(), childBottom);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean performClick()
    {
        boolean handled = super.performClick();

        if (!handled)
        {
            handled = true;
            if (mPopup != null && !mPopup.isShowing() && isEnabled()) mPopup.show();
        }

        return handled;
    }

    @Override
    public void onClick(DialogInterface dialog, int which)
    {
        setSelection(which);
        dialog.dismiss();
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return Spinner.class.getName();
    }

    public void setPrompt(CharSequence prompt)
    {
        mPopup.setPromptText(prompt);
    }

    public void setPromptId(int promptId)
    {
        setPrompt(getContext().getText(promptId));
    }

    public CharSequence getPrompt()
    {
        return mPopup.getHintText();
    }

    int measureContentWidth(SpinnerAdapter adapter, Drawable background)
    {
        if (adapter == null) return 0;

        int width = 0;
        View itemView = null;
        int itemType = 0;
        int widthMeasureSpec = MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(getMeasuredWidth(), MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED);
        int heightMeasureSpec = MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(getMeasuredHeight(), MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED);

        int start = Math.max(0, getSelectedItemPosition());
        int end = Math.min(adapter.getCount(), start + MAX_ITEMS_MEASURED);
        int count = end - start;
        start = Math.max(0, start - (MAX_ITEMS_MEASURED - count));

        for (int position = start; position < end; position++)
        {
            int positionType = adapter.getItemViewType(position);
            if (positionType != itemType)
            {
                itemType = positionType;
                itemView = null;
            }

            itemView = adapter.getView(position, itemView, this);
            if (itemView.getLayoutParams() == null) itemView.setLayoutParams(generateDefaultLayoutParams());

            itemView.measure(widthMeasureSpec, heightMeasureSpec);
            width = Math.max(width, itemView.getMeasuredWidth());
        }

        if (background != null && background.getPadding(mTempRect)) width += mTempRect.left + mTempRect.right;

        return width + getPaddingLeft() + getPaddingRight();
    }

    @Override
    public Parcelable onSaveInstanceState()
    {
        return super.onSaveInstanceState();
    }

    @Override
    public void onRestoreInstanceState(Parcelable state)
    {
        super.onRestoreInstanceState(state);
    }

    @Override
    public PointerIcon onResolvePointerIcon(MotionEvent event, int pointerIndex)
    {
        if (getPointerIcon() == null && isClickable() && isEnabled()) return PointerIcon.getSystemIcon(getContext(), PointerIcon.TYPE_HAND);
        return super.onResolvePointerIcon(event, pointerIndex);
    }

    private void onPopupItemChosen(View view, int position)
    {
        setSelection(position);

        if (mOnItemClickListener != null && mAdapter != null) performItemClick(view, position, mAdapter.getItemId(position));

        mPopup.dismiss();
    }

    private interface SpinnerPopup
    {
        void setAdapter(ListAdapter adapter);

        void show();

        void dismiss();

        boolean isShowing();

        void setPromptText(CharSequence hintText);

        CharSequence getHintText();

        void setBackgroundDrawable(Drawable background);

        void setVerticalOffset(int pixels);

        void setHorizontalOffset(int pixels);

        Drawable getBackground();

        int getVerticalOffset();

        int getHorizontalOffset();
    }

    private static class DropDownAdapter implements ListAdapter, SpinnerAdapter
    {
        private final SpinnerAdapter mAdapter;
        private final ListAdapter mListAdapter;

        DropDownAdapter(SpinnerAdapter adapter, Resources.Theme dropDownTheme)
        {
            mAdapter = adapter;
            mListAdapter = adapter instanceof ListAdapter ? (ListAdapter)adapter : null;

            if (dropDownTheme != null && adapter instanceof ThemedSpinnerAdapter)
            {
                ThemedSpinnerAdapter themed = (ThemedSpinnerAdapter)adapter;
                if (themed.getDropDownViewTheme() == null) themed.setDropDownViewTheme(dropDownTheme);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public int getCount()
        {
            return mAdapter == null ? 0 : mAdapter.getCount();
        }

        @Override
        public Object getItem(int position)
        {
            return mAdapter == null ? null : mAdapter.getItem(position);
        }

        @Override
        public long getItemId(int position)
        {
            return mAdapter == null ? -1 : mAdapter.getItemId(position);
        }

        @Override
        public View getView(int position, View convertView, ViewGroup parent)
        {
            return getDropDownView(position, convertView, parent);
        }

        @Override
        public View getDropDownView(int position, View convertView, ViewGroup parent)
        {
            return mAdapter == null ? null : mAdapter.getDropDownView(position, convertView, parent);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean hasStableIds()
        {
            return mAdapter != null && mAdapter.hasStableIds();
        }

        @Override
        public void registerDataSetObserver(DataSetObserver observer)
        {
            if (mAdapter != null) mAdapter.registerDataSetObserver(observer);
        }

        @Override
        public void unregisterDataSetObserver(DataSetObserver observer)
        {
            if (mAdapter != null) mAdapter.unregisterDataSetObserver(observer);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean areAllItemsEnabled()
        {
            return mListAdapter == null || mListAdapter.areAllItemsEnabled();
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isEnabled(int position)
        {
            return mListAdapter == null || mListAdapter.isEnabled(position);
        }

        @Override
        public int getItemViewType(int position)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public int getViewTypeCount()
        {
            return 1;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isEmpty()
        {
            return getCount() == 0;
        }
    }

    private class DialogPopup implements SpinnerPopup
    {
        private AlertDialog mDialog;
        private ListAdapter mListAdapter;
        private CharSequence mPrompt;

        @Override
        public void dismiss()
        {
            if (mDialog == null) return;

            mDialog.dismiss();
            mDialog = null;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isShowing()
        {
            return mDialog != null && mDialog.isShowing();
        }

        @Override
        public void setAdapter(ListAdapter adapter)
        {
            mListAdapter = adapter;
        }

        @Override
        public void setPromptText(CharSequence hintText)
        {
            mPrompt = hintText;
        }

        @Override
        public CharSequence getHintText()
        {
            return mPrompt;
        }

        @Override
        public void show()
        {
            if (mListAdapter == null) return;

            ListView list = new ListView(getPopupContext());
            list.setAdapter(mListAdapter);
            list.setChoiceMode(AbsListView.CHOICE_MODE_SINGLE);

            int selected = getSelectedItemPosition();
            if (selected >= 0)
            {
                list.setItemChecked(selected, true);
                list.setSelection(selected);
            }

            list.setOnItemClickListener(new OnItemClickListener()
            {
                @Override
                public void onItemClick(AdapterView<?> parent, View view, int position, long id)
                {
                    onPopupItemChosen(view, position);
                }
            });

            AlertDialog.Builder builder = new AlertDialog.Builder(getPopupContext());
            if (mPrompt != null) builder.setTitle(mPrompt);
            builder.setView(list);

            mDialog = builder.create();
            mDialog.show();
        }

        @Override
        public void setBackgroundDrawable(Drawable background)
        {
            android.util.Log.e("Spinner", "Cannot set popup background for MODE_DIALOG, ignoring");
        }

        @Override
        public void setVerticalOffset(int pixels)
        {
            android.util.Log.e("Spinner", "Cannot set vertical offset for MODE_DIALOG, ignoring");
        }

        @Override
        public void setHorizontalOffset(int pixels)
        {
            android.util.Log.e("Spinner", "Cannot set horizontal offset for MODE_DIALOG, ignoring");
        }

        @Override
        public Drawable getBackground()
        {
            return null;
        }

        @Override
        public int getVerticalOffset()
        {
            return 0;
        }

        @Override
        public int getHorizontalOffset()
        {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    private class DropdownPopup extends ListPopupWindow implements SpinnerPopup
    {
        private CharSequence mHintText;
        private ListAdapter mListAdapter;

        DropdownPopup(Context context)
        {
            super(context);

            setAnchorView(Spinner.this);
            setModal(true);
            setPromptPosition(POSITION_PROMPT_ABOVE);
            setOnItemClickListener(new OnItemClickListener()
            {
                @Override
                public void onItemClick(AdapterView<?> parent, View view, int position, long id)
                {
                    onPopupItemChosen(view, position);
                }
            });
        }

        @Override
        public void setAdapter(ListAdapter adapter)
        {
            super.setAdapter(adapter);
            mListAdapter = adapter;
        }

        @Override
        public CharSequence getHintText()
        {
            return mHintText;
        }

        @Override
        public void setPromptText(CharSequence hintText)
        {
            mHintText = hintText;
        }

        void computeContentWidth()
        {
            Drawable background = getBackground();
            int horizontalOffset = 0;
            if (background != null)
            {
                background.getPadding(mTempRect);
                horizontalOffset = getLayoutDirection() == LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL ? mTempRect.right : -mTempRect.left;
            }
            else
            {
                mTempRect.set(0, 0, 0, 0);
            }

            int spinnerPaddingLeft = Spinner.this.getPaddingLeft();
            int spinnerPaddingRight = Spinner.this.getPaddingRight();
            int spinnerWidth = Spinner.this.getWidth();

            if (mDropDownWidth == WRAP_CONTENT)
            {
                int contentWidth = measureContentWidth((SpinnerAdapter)mListAdapter, getBackground());
                int contentWidthLimit = getContext().getResources().getDisplayMetrics().widthPixels - mTempRect.left - mTempRect.right;
                if (contentWidth > contentWidthLimit) contentWidth = contentWidthLimit;

                setContentWidth(Math.max(contentWidth, spinnerWidth - spinnerPaddingLeft - spinnerPaddingRight));
            }
            else if (mDropDownWidth == MATCH_PARENT)
            {
                setContentWidth(spinnerWidth - spinnerPaddingLeft - spinnerPaddingRight);
            }
            else
            {
                setContentWidth(mDropDownWidth);
            }

            if (getLayoutDirection() == LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL) horizontalOffset += spinnerWidth - spinnerPaddingRight - getWidth();
            else horizontalOffset += spinnerPaddingLeft;

            setHorizontalOffset(horizontalOffset);
        }

        @Override
        public void show()
        {
            computeContentWidth();
            setInputMethodMode(ListPopupWindow.INPUT_METHOD_NOT_NEEDED);

            super.show();

            ListView list = getListView();
            if (list == null) return;

            list.setChoiceMode(AbsListView.CHOICE_MODE_SINGLE);

            int selected = Spinner.this.getSelectedItemPosition();
            if (selected >= 0)
            {
                list.setItemChecked(selected, true);
                list.setSelection(selected);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
import android.content.Context;

public class Switch extends CompoundButton
{
    private static final int THUMB_ANIMATION_DURATION = 250;
    private static final int FRAME_DELAY = 16;

    private static final int TOUCH_MODE_DOWN = 1;

    }

    public Switch(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        mDensity = context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        mAccentColor = ProgressBar.resolveThemeColor(context, 0xFF009688, "colorControlActivated", "colorAccent");
        mTextPaint.density = mDensity;
        mTextPaint.setTextSize(14 * mDensity);
        mTextPaint.setTypeface(Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD);
        mSwitchPadding = (int)(16 * mDensity);
        mThumbTextPadding = (int)(4 * mDensity);

        ViewConfiguration configuration = ViewConfiguration.get(context);
        mTouchSlop = configuration.getScaledTouchSlop();
        mMinimumFlingVelocity = configuration.getScaledMinimumFlingVelocity();

        setClickable(true);
        setFocusable(true);

        StyleableSet styleable = styleable(context);
        if (!styleable.isEmpty() && (attributes != null || defStyleAttr != 0 || defStyleRes != 0))
        {
            TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, styleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

            int index = styleable.indexOf("thumb");
            if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) setThumbDrawable(loadDrawable(array, index));

            index = styleable.indexOf("track");
            if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) setTrackDrawable(loadDrawable(array, index));

            index = styleable.indexOf("textOn");
            if (index >= 0)
            {
                CharSequence text = array.getText(index);
                if (text != null) mTextOn = text;
            }

            index = styleable.indexOf("textOff");
            if (index >= 0)
            {
                CharSequence text = array.getText(index);
                if (text != null) mTextOff = text;
            }

            index = styleable.indexOf("showText");
            if (index >= 0) mShowText = array.getBoolean(index, false);

            index = styleable.indexOf("thumbTextPadding");
            if (index >= 0) mThumbTextPadding = array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, mThumbTextPadding);

            index = styleable.indexOf("switchMinWidth");
            if (index >= 0) mSwitchMinWidth = array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, 0);

            index = styleable.indexOf("switchPadding");
            if (index >= 0) mSwitchPadding = array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, mSwitchPadding);

            index = styleable.indexOf("splitTrack");
            if (index >= 0) mSplitTrack = array.getBoolean(index, false);

            index = styleable.indexOf("thumbTint");
            if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) mThumbTintList = readColors(array, index);

            index = styleable.indexOf("trackTint");
            if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) mTrackTintList = readColors(array, index);

            index = styleable.indexOf("switchTextAppearance");
            if (index >= 0)
            {
                int appearance = array.getResourceId(index, 0);
                if (appearance != 0) setSwitchTextAppearance(context, appearance);
            }

            array.recycle();
        }

        ProgressBar.applyTint(mThumbDrawable, mThumbTintList, getDrawableState());
        ProgressBar.applyTint(mTrackDrawable, mTrackTintList, getDrawableState());

        mThumbPosition = isChecked() ? 1f : 0f;
    }

    private static StyleableSet styleable(Context context)
    {
        if (sStyleable == null)
        {
            sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "thumb", "track", "textOn", "textOff", "showText", "thumbTextPadding",
                                         "switchMinWidth", "switchPadding", "splitTrack", "thumbTint", "trackTint", "switchTextAppearance");
        }
        return sStyleable;
    }

    private static Drawable loadDrawable(TypedArray array, int index)
    {
        try
        {
            return array.getDrawable(index);
        }
        catch (Throwable unsupported)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static ColorStateList readColors(TypedArray array, int index)
    {
        try
        {
            return array.getColorStateList(index);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException unresolved)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public void setSwitchTextAppearance(Context context, int resourceId)
    {
        if (sAppearanceStyleable == null)
        {
            sAppearanceStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "textSize", "textColor", "textStyle", "textAllCaps");
        }
        if (sAppearanceStyleable.isEmpty()) return;

        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(resourceId, sAppearanceStyleable.attributes());

        int index = sAppearanceStyleable.indexOf("textColor");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index))
        {
            ColorStateList colors = readColors(array, index);
            mTextColors = colors != null ? colors : ColorStateList.valueOf(array.getColor(index, 0xFF000000));
        }

        index = sAppearanceStyleable.indexOf("textSize");
        if (index >= 0)
        {
            int size = array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, 0);
            if (size > 0 && size != mTextPaint.getTextSize()) mTextPaint.setTextSize(size);
        }

        index = sAppearanceStyleable.indexOf("textStyle");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) setSwitchTypeface(null, array.getInt(index, Typeface.NORMAL));

        array.recycle();

        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setSwitchTypeface(Typeface typeface, int style)
    {
        if (style > 0)
        {
            Typeface styled = typeface == null ? Typeface.defaultFromStyle(style) : Typeface.create(typeface, style);
            setSwitchTypeface(styled);

            int missing = style & ~(styled == null ? 0 : styled.getStyle());
            mTextPaint.setFakeBoldText((missing & Typeface.BOLD) != 0);
            mTextPaint.setTextSkewX((missing & Typeface.ITALIC) != 0 ? -0.25f : 0);
            return;
        }

        mTextPaint.setFakeBoldText(false);
        mTextPaint.setTextSkewX(0);
        setSwitchTypeface(typeface);
    }

        if (mTextPaint.getTypeface() == typeface) return;

    private static boolean usable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        return drawable != null && drawable.getIntrinsicWidth() > 0 && drawable.getIntrinsicHeight() > 0;
    }

    private int measureLabel(CharSequence text)
    {
        if (text == null || text.length() == 0) return 0;

        return (int)Math.ceil(mTextPaint.measureText(text, 0, text.length()));
    }

    private boolean hasLabel()
    {
        CharSequence text = getText();
        return text != null && text.length() > 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        int maxTextWidth = mShowText ? Math.max(measureLabel(mTextOn), measureLabel(mTextOff)) + mThumbTextPadding * 2 : 0;

        int thumbWidth = usable(mThumbDrawable) ? mThumbDrawable.getIntrinsicWidth() : (int)(20 * mDensity);
        int thumbHeight = usable(mThumbDrawable) ? mThumbDrawable.getIntrinsicHeight() : (int)(20 * mDensity);
        int trackHeight = usable(mTrackDrawable) ? mTrackDrawable.getIntrinsicHeight() : (int)(14 * mDensity);

        mThumbWidth = Math.max(maxTextWidth, thumbWidth);

        int minimumTrackWidth = usable(mTrackDrawable) ? mTrackDrawable.getIntrinsicWidth() : (int)(36 * mDensity);
        mSwitchWidth = Math.max(Math.max(mSwitchMinWidth, mThumbWidth * 2), minimumTrackWidth);
        mSwitchHeight = Math.max(trackHeight, thumbHeight);

        int reserved = mSwitchWidth + (hasLabel() ? mSwitchPadding : 0);
        int widthMode = MeasureSpec.getMode(widthMeasureSpec);
        int innerWidth = Math.max(0, MeasureSpec.getSize(widthMeasureSpec) - reserved);
        int innerSpec = widthMode == MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED ? widthMeasureSpec : MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(innerWidth, widthMode);

        super.onMeasure(innerSpec, heightMeasureSpec);

        int width = getMeasuredWidth() + reserved;
        if (!hasLabel()) width = Math.max(getSuggestedMinimumWidth(), mSwitchWidth + getPaddingLeft() + getPaddingRight());

        int height = Math.max(getMeasuredHeight(), mSwitchHeight + getPaddingTop() + getPaddingBottom());
        if (!hasLabel()) height = Math.max(getSuggestedMinimumHeight(), mSwitchHeight + getPaddingTop() + getPaddingBottom());

        setMeasuredDimension(resolveSize(width, widthMeasureSpec), resolveSize(height, heightMeasureSpec));
    }

    @Override
    protected void onLayout(boolean changed, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        super.onLayout(changed, left, top, right, bottom);

        positionSwitch();
    }

    private void positionSwitch()
    {
        if (getLayoutDirection() == LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL)
        {
            mSwitchLeft = getPaddingLeft();
            mSwitchRight = mSwitchLeft + mSwitchWidth;
        }
        else
        {
            mSwitchRight = getWidth() - getPaddingRight();
            mSwitchLeft = mSwitchRight - mSwitchWidth;
        }

        int innerTop = getPaddingTop();
        int innerBottom = getHeight() - getPaddingBottom();

        mSwitchTop = innerTop + (innerBottom - innerTop - mSwitchHeight) / 2;
        mSwitchBottom = mSwitchTop + mSwitchHeight;
    }

    private int thumbScrollRange()
    {
        return Math.max(0, mSwitchWidth - mThumbWidth);
    }

    private int thumbOffset()
    {
        float position = getLayoutDirection() == LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL ? 1f - mThumbPosition : mThumbPosition;
        return (int)(position * thumbScrollRange() + 0.5f);
    }

    private boolean hitThumb(float x, float y)
    {
        int slop = mTouchSlop;
        int thumbLeft = mSwitchLeft + thumbOffset() - slop;
        int thumbRight = mSwitchLeft + thumbOffset() + mThumbWidth + slop;

        return x > thumbLeft && x < thumbRight && y > mSwitchTop - slop && y < mSwitchBottom + slop;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
    {
        if (mVelocityTracker == null) mVelocityTracker = VelocityTracker.obtain();
        mVelocityTracker.addMovement(event);

        int action = event.getActionMasked();

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN)
        {
            float x = event.getX();
            float y = event.getY();

            if (isEnabled() && hitThumb(x, y))
            {
                mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_DOWN;
                mTouchX = x;
                mTouchY = y;
            }
        }
        else if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE)
        {
            if (mTouchMode == TOUCH_MODE_DOWN)
            {
                float x = event.getX();
                float y = event.getY();

                if (Math.abs(x - mTouchX) > mTouchSlop || Math.abs(y - mTouchY) > mTouchSlop)
                {
                    mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_DRAGGING;
                    mTouchX = x;
                    mTouchY = y;

                    cancelLongPress();
                    setPressed(false);

                    ViewParent parent = getParent();
                    if (parent != null) parent.requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);

                    return true;
                }
            }
            else if (mTouchMode == TOUCH_MODE_DRAGGING)
            {
                float x = event.getX();
                int range = thumbScrollRange();
                float delta = range > 0 ? (x - mTouchX) / range : (x > mTouchX ? 1f : -1f);
                if (getLayoutDirection() == LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL) delta = -delta;

                float position = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, mThumbPosition + delta));
                if (position != mThumbPosition)
                {
                    mTouchX = x;
                    setThumbPosition(position);
                }

                return true;
            }
        }
        else if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP || action == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL)
        {
            if (mTouchMode == TOUCH_MODE_DRAGGING)
            {
                stopDrag(event);
                return true;
            }

            mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_IDLE;
            recycleVelocityTracker();
        }

        return super.onTouchEvent(event);
    }

    private void stopDrag(MotionEvent event)
    {
        mTouchMode = TOUCH_MODE_IDLE;

        boolean commit = event.getActionMasked() == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP && isEnabled();
        boolean oldState = isChecked();
        boolean newState = oldState;

        if (commit)
        {
            mVelocityTracker.computeCurrentVelocity(1000);
            float velocity = mVelocityTracker.getXVelocity();

            if (Math.abs(velocity) > mMinimumFlingVelocity)
            {
                newState = getLayoutDirection() == LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL ? velocity < 0 : velocity > 0;
            }
            else
            {
                newState = mThumbPosition > 0.5f;
            }
        }

        recycleVelocityTracker();

        if (newState != oldState) playSoundEffect(0);

        setChecked(newState);
        animateThumbTo(newState ? 1f : 0f);
    }

    private void recycleVelocityTracker()
    {
        if (mVelocityTracker == null) return;

        mVelocityTracker.recycle();
        mVelocityTracker = null;
    }

    private void setThumbPosition(float position)
    {
        mThumbPosition = position;
        invalidate();
    }

    private void animateThumbTo(float target)
    {
        if (!isAttachedToWindow() || getWidth() == 0)
        {
            mAnimating = false;
            removeCallbacks(mAnimationTick);
            setThumbPosition(target);
            return;
        }

        mAnimationFrom = mThumbPosition;
        mAnimationTo = target;
        mAnimationStart = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();

        if (!mAnimating)
        {
            mAnimating = true;
            postDelayed(mAnimationTick, FRAME_DELAY);
        }
    }

    private void stepAnimation()
    {
        if (!mAnimating) return;

        float fraction = Math.min(1f, (SystemClock.uptimeMillis() - mAnimationStart) / (float)THUMB_ANIMATION_DURATION);
        float eased = (float)(Math.cos((fraction + 1) * Math.PI) / 2.0f) + 0.5f;

        setThumbPosition(mAnimationFrom + (mAnimationTo - mAnimationFrom) * eased);

        if (fraction >= 1f)
        {
            mAnimating = false;
            return;
        }

        postDelayed(mAnimationTick, FRAME_DELAY);
    }

    @Override
    public void toggle()
    {
        setChecked(!isChecked());
    }

    @Override
    public void setChecked(boolean checked)
    {
        super.setChecked(checked);

        boolean current = isChecked();

        if (mTouchMode != TOUCH_MODE_DRAGGING) animateThumbTo(current ? 1f : 0f);

        refreshDrawableState();
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        super.draw(canvas);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        super.onDraw(canvas);

        if (mSwitchWidth == 0) return;
        if (mSwitchRight - mSwitchLeft != mSwitchWidth) positionSwitch();

        int[] state = getDrawableState();
        boolean enabled = isEnabled();
        float alpha = enabled ? 1f : 0.38f;

        int thumbLeft = mSwitchLeft + thumbOffset();
        int thumbTop = usable(mThumbDrawable) ? mSwitchTop + (mSwitchHeight - mThumbDrawable.getIntrinsicHeight()) / 2 : mSwitchTop;
        int thumbBottom = usable(mThumbDrawable) ? thumbTop + mThumbDrawable.getIntrinsicHeight() : mSwitchBottom;
        mThumbBounds.set(thumbLeft, thumbTop, thumbLeft + mThumbWidth, thumbBottom);

        float position = mThumbPosition;

        if (usable(mTrackDrawable))
        {
            int trackTop = mSwitchTop + (mSwitchHeight - mTrackDrawable.getIntrinsicHeight()) / 2;
            mTrackDrawable.setBounds(mSwitchLeft, trackTop, mSwitchRight, trackTop + mTrackDrawable.getIntrinsicHeight());
            mTrackDrawable.draw(canvas);
        }
        else
        {
            int off = ProgressBar.tintColor(mTrackTintList, state, 0x4D000000);
            int on = (mAccentColor & 0x00FFFFFF) | 0x80000000;
            int colour = blend(off, on, position);

            float trackHeight = 14 * mDensity;
            float centreY = (mSwitchTop + mSwitchBottom) / 2f;

            mRect.set(mSwitchLeft, centreY - trackHeight / 2f, mSwitchRight, centreY + trackHeight / 2f);
            mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
            mPaint.setColor(withAlpha(colour, alpha));
            canvas.drawRoundRect(mRect, trackHeight / 2f, trackHeight / 2f, mPaint);
        }

        if (usable(mThumbDrawable))
        {
            mThumbDrawable.setBounds(mThumbBounds);
            mThumbDrawable.draw(canvas);
        }
        else
        {
            int off = 0xFFF1F1F1;
            int on = ProgressBar.tintColor(mThumbTintList, state, mAccentColor);
            int colour = blend(off, on, position);

            float radius = Math.min(mThumbBounds.width(), mThumbBounds.height()) / 2f;

            mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
            mPaint.setColor(withAlpha(0x33000000, alpha));
            canvas.drawCircle(mThumbBounds.exactCenterX(), mThumbBounds.exactCenterY() + mDensity, radius, mPaint);

            mPaint.setColor(withAlpha(colour, alpha));
            canvas.drawCircle(mThumbBounds.exactCenterX(), mThumbBounds.exactCenterY(), radius, mPaint);
        }

        if (!mShowText) return;

        CharSequence label = position > 0.5f ? mTextOn : mTextOff;
        if (label == null || label.length() == 0) return;

        int textColour = mTextColors != null ? mTextColors.getColorForState(state, mTextColors.getDefaultColor()) : getCurrentTextColor();
        mTextPaint.setColor(textColour);
        mTextPaint.drawableState = state;

        String text = label.toString();
        float textWidth = mTextPaint.measureText(text);
        Paint.FontMetrics metrics = mTextPaint.getFontMetrics();
        float baseline = mThumbBounds.exactCenterY() - (metrics.ascent + metrics.descent) / 2f;

        canvas.drawText(text, mThumbBounds.exactCenterX() - textWidth / 2f, baseline, mTextPaint);
    }

    private static int blend(int from, int to, float fraction)
    {
        float inverse = 1f - fraction;

        int alpha = (int)(((from >>> 24) & 0xFF) * inverse + ((to >>> 24) & 0xFF) * fraction);
        int red = (int)(((from >> 16) & 0xFF) * inverse + ((to >> 16) & 0xFF) * fraction);
        int green = (int)(((from >> 8) & 0xFF) * inverse + ((to >> 8) & 0xFF) * fraction);
        int blue = (int)((from & 0xFF) * inverse + (to & 0xFF) * fraction);

        return (alpha << 24) | (red << 16) | (green << 8) | blue;
    }

    private static int withAlpha(int colour, float alpha)
    {
        int channel = (int)(((colour >>> 24) & 0xFF) * alpha);
        return (colour & 0x00FFFFFF) | (channel << 24);
    }

    public int getCompoundPaddingLeft()
    {
        if (getLayoutDirection() != LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL) return getPaddingLeft();

        return getPaddingLeft() + mSwitchWidth + (hasLabel() ? mSwitchPadding : 0);
    }

    public int getCompoundPaddingRight()
    {
        if (getLayoutDirection() == LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL) return getPaddingRight();

        return getPaddingRight() + mSwitchWidth + (hasLabel() ? mSwitchPadding : 0);
    }

    @Override
    protected int[] onCreateDrawableState(int extraSpace)
    {
        return super.onCreateDrawableState(extraSpace);
    }

    @Override
    protected void drawableStateChanged()
    {
        super.drawableStateChanged();

        int[] state = getDrawableState();

        if (mThumbDrawable != null && mThumbDrawable.isStateful()) mThumbDrawable.setState(state);
        if (mTrackDrawable != null && mTrackDrawable.isStateful()) mTrackDrawable.setState(state);

        invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    public void drawableHotspotChanged(float x, float y)
    {
        super.drawableHotspotChanged(x, y);

        if (mThumbDrawable != null) mThumbDrawable.setHotspot(x, y);
        if (mTrackDrawable != null) mTrackDrawable.setHotspot(x, y);
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean verifyDrawable(Drawable who)
    {
        return who == mThumbDrawable || who == mTrackDrawable || super.verifyDrawable(who);
    }

    @Override
    public void jumpDrawablesToCurrentState()
    {
        super.jumpDrawablesToCurrentState();

        if (mThumbDrawable != null) mThumbDrawable.jumpToCurrentState();
        if (mTrackDrawable != null) mTrackDrawable.jumpToCurrentState();

        if (mAnimating)
        {
            mAnimating = false;
            removeCallbacks(mAnimationTick);
            setThumbPosition(isChecked() ? 1f : 0f);
        }
    }

    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return Switch.class.getName();
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/TabHost.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.SoundEffectConstants;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.ViewTreeObserver;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class TabHost extends FrameLayout implements ViewTreeObserver.OnTouchModeChangeListener
{
    private static final int ID_TABS = 0x01020013;
    private static final int ID_TAB_CONTENT = 0x01020011;
    private static final int ID_TITLE = 0x01020016;
    private static final int ID_ICON = 0x01020006;

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private final List<TabSpec> mTabSpecs = new ArrayList<>(2);
    private TabWidget mTabWidget;
    private FrameLayout mTabContent;
    private int mCurrentTab = -1;
    private View mCurrentView;
    private OnTabChangeListener mOnTabChangeListener;
    private OnKeyListener mTabKeyListener;
    private int mTabLayoutId;

    public TabHost(Context context)
    {
        super(context);

        initTabHost();
        mTabLayoutId = defaultTabLayout(context);
    }

    public TabHost(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, ProgressBar.attributeIdentifier(context, "tabWidgetStyle"));
    }

    public TabHost(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public TabHost(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        if (sStyleable == null) sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "tabLayout");

        if (!sStyleable.isEmpty() && (attributes != null || defStyleAttr != 0 || defStyleRes != 0))
        {
            TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
            int index = sStyleable.indexOf("tabLayout");
            if (index >= 0) mTabLayoutId = array.getResourceId(index, 0);
            array.recycle();
        }

        if (mTabLayoutId == 0) mTabLayoutId = defaultTabLayout(context);

        initTabHost();
    }

    private static int defaultTabLayout(Context context)
    {
        return context.getResources().getIdentifier("tab_indicator_holo", "layout", "android");
    }

    private void initTabHost()
    {
        setFocusableInTouchMode(true);
        setDescendantFocusability(FOCUS_AFTER_DESCENDANTS);

        mCurrentTab = -1;
        mCurrentView = null;
    }

    public TabSpec newTabSpec(String tag)
    {
        if (tag == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("tag must be non-null");

        return new TabSpec(tag);
    }

    public void setup()
    {
        View tabs = findViewById(ID_TABS);
        if (!(tabs instanceof TabWidget))
        {
            throw new RuntimeException("Your TabHost must have a TabWidget whose id attribute is 'android.R.id.tabs'");
        }
        mTabWidget = (TabWidget)tabs;

        mTabKeyListener = new OnKeyListener()
        {
            public boolean onKey(View view, int keyCode, KeyEvent event)
            {
                if (KeyEvent.isModifierKey(keyCode)) return false;

                switch (keyCode)
                {
                    case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_CENTER:
                    case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_LEFT:
                    case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_RIGHT:
                    case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP:
                    case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN:
                    case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_TAB:
                    case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SPACE:
                    case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER:
                        return false;
                    default:
                        break;
                }

                mTabContent.requestFocus(View.FOCUS_FORWARD);
                return mTabContent.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
            }
        };

        mTabWidget.setTabSelectionListener(new TabWidget.OnTabSelectionChanged()
        {
            public void onTabSelectionChanged(int tabIndex, boolean clicked)
            {
                setCurrentTab(tabIndex);
                if (clicked) mTabContent.requestFocus(View.FOCUS_FORWARD);
            }
        });

        View content = findViewById(ID_TAB_CONTENT);
        if (!(content instanceof FrameLayout))
        {
            throw new RuntimeException("Your TabHost must have a FrameLayout whose id attribute is 'android.R.id.tabcontent'");
        }
        mTabContent = (FrameLayout)content;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onAttachedToWindow()
    {
        super.onAttachedToWindow();

        getViewTreeObserver().addOnTouchModeChangeListener(this);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow()
    {
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();

        getViewTreeObserver().removeOnTouchModeChangeListener(this);
    }

    public void onTouchModeChanged(boolean isInTouchMode)
    {
    }

    public void addTab(TabSpec tabSpec)
    {
        if (tabSpec.mIndicatorStrategy == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("you must specify a way to create the tab indicator.");
        if (tabSpec.mContentStrategy == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("you must specify a way to create the tab content");
        if (mTabWidget == null) throw new IllegalStateException("you must call setup() before adding tabs");

        View tabIndicator = tabSpec.mIndicatorStrategy.createIndicatorView();
        tabIndicator.setOnKeyListener(mTabKeyListener);

        if (tabSpec.mContentStrategy instanceof IntentContentStrategy) mTabWidget.setStripEnabled(false);

        mTabWidget.addView(tabIndicator);
        mTabSpecs.add(tabSpec);

        if (mCurrentTab == -1) setCurrentTab(0);
    }

    public void clearAllTabs()
    {
        if (mTabWidget != null) mTabWidget.removeAllViews();
        initTabHost();
        if (mTabContent != null) mTabContent.removeAllViews();
        mTabSpecs.clear();
        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public TabWidget getTabWidget()
    {
        return mTabWidget;
    }

    public int getCurrentTab()
    {
        return mCurrentTab;
    }

    public String getCurrentTabTag()
    {
        if (mCurrentTab >= 0 && mCurrentTab < mTabSpecs.size()) return mTabSpecs.get(mCurrentTab).getTag();

        return null;
    }

    public View getCurrentTabView()
    {
        if (mCurrentTab >= 0 && mCurrentTab < mTabSpecs.size()) return mTabWidget.getChildTabViewAt(mCurrentTab);

        return null;
    }

    public View getCurrentView()
    {
        return mCurrentView;
    }

    public void setCurrentTabByTag(String tag)
    {
        int count = mTabSpecs.size();

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            if (!mTabSpecs.get(index).getTag().equals(tag)) continue;

            setCurrentTab(index);
            return;
        }
    }

    public FrameLayout getTabContentView()
    {
        return mTabContent;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event)
    {
        boolean handled = super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
        if (handled || event.getAction() != KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN || mCurrentView == null || !mCurrentView.hasFocus()) return handled;
        if (event.getKeyCode() != KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP) return false;

        View focused = mCurrentView.findFocus();
        if (focused != null && focused.focusSearch(View.FOCUS_UP) != null) return false;

        View tab = mTabWidget.getChildTabViewAt(mCurrentTab);
        if (tab == null) return false;

        tab.requestFocus();
        playSoundEffect(SoundEffectConstants.NAVIGATION_UP);
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void dispatchWindowFocusChanged(boolean hasFocus)
    {
        if (mCurrentView != null) mCurrentView.dispatchWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus);
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return TabHost.class.getName();
    }

    public void setCurrentTab(int index)
    {
        if (index < 0 || index >= mTabSpecs.size()) return;
        if (index == mCurrentTab) return;

        if (mCurrentTab != -1) mTabSpecs.get(mCurrentTab).mContentStrategy.tabClosed();

        mCurrentTab = index;
        TabSpec spec = mTabSpecs.get(index);

        mTabWidget.focusCurrentTab(mCurrentTab);

        mCurrentView = spec.mContentStrategy.getContentView();

        if (mCurrentView.getParent() == null)
        {
            mTabContent.addView(mCurrentView, new ViewGroup.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                                                                       ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT));
        }

        if (!mTabWidget.hasFocus()) mCurrentView.requestFocus();

        if (mOnTabChangeListener != null) mOnTabChangeListener.onTabChanged(getCurrentTabTag());
    }

    public void setOnTabChangedListener(OnTabChangeListener listener)
    {
        mOnTabChangeListener = listener;
    }

    public interface OnTabChangeListener
    {
        void onTabChanged(String tabId);
    }

    public interface TabContentFactory
    {
        View createTabContent(String tag);
    }

    public class TabSpec
    {
        private final String mTag;
        private IndicatorStrategy mIndicatorStrategy;
        private ContentStrategy mContentStrategy;

        TabSpec(String tag)
        {
            mTag = tag;
        }

        public TabSpec setIndicator(CharSequence label)
        {
            mIndicatorStrategy = new LabelIndicatorStrategy(label);
            return this;
        }

        public TabSpec setIndicator(CharSequence label, Drawable icon)
        {
            mIndicatorStrategy = new LabelAndIconIndicatorStrategy(label, icon);
            return this;
        }

        public TabSpec setIndicator(View view)
        {
            mIndicatorStrategy = new ViewIndicatorStrategy(view);
            return this;
        }

        public TabSpec setContent(int viewId)
        {
            mContentStrategy = new ViewIdContentStrategy(viewId);
            return this;
        }

        public TabSpec setContent(TabContentFactory contentFactory)
        {
            mContentStrategy = new FactoryContentStrategy(mTag, contentFactory);
            return this;
        }

        public TabSpec setContent(Intent intent)
        {
            mContentStrategy = new IntentContentStrategy(mTag, intent);
            return this;
        }

        public String getTag()
        {
            return mTag;
        }
    }

    private interface IndicatorStrategy
    {
        View createIndicatorView();
    }

    private interface ContentStrategy
    {
        View getContentView();

        void tabClosed();
    }

    private View inflateIndicator()
    {
        if (mTabLayoutId != 0)
        {
            try
            {
                return LayoutInflater.from(getContext()).inflate(mTabLayoutId, mTabWidget, false);
            }
            catch (RuntimeException missing)
            {
                android.util.Log.w("TabHost", "the tab indicator layout could not be inflated", missing);
            }
        }

        LinearLayout fallback = new LinearLayout(getContext());
        fallback.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        fallback.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER);

        ImageView icon = new ImageView(getContext());
        icon.setId(ID_ICON);
        icon.setVisibility(GONE);
        fallback.addView(icon);

        TextView title = new TextView(getContext());
        title.setId(ID_TITLE);
        title.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER);
        fallback.addView(title);

        int padding = (int)(8 * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
        fallback.setPadding(padding, padding, padding, padding);
        return fallback;
    }

    private class LabelIndicatorStrategy implements IndicatorStrategy
    {
        private final CharSequence mLabel;

        private LabelIndicatorStrategy(CharSequence label)
        {
            mLabel = label;
        }

        public View createIndicatorView()
        {
            View tabIndicator = inflateIndicator();

            View title = tabIndicator.findViewById(ID_TITLE);
            if (title instanceof TextView) ((TextView)title).setText(mLabel);

            return tabIndicator;
        }
    }

    private class LabelAndIconIndicatorStrategy implements IndicatorStrategy
    {
        private final CharSequence mLabel;
        private final Drawable mIcon;

        private LabelAndIconIndicatorStrategy(CharSequence label, Drawable icon)
        {
            mLabel = label;
            mIcon = icon;
        }

        public View createIndicatorView()
        {
            View tabIndicator = inflateIndicator();

            View title = tabIndicator.findViewById(ID_TITLE);
            View icon = tabIndicator.findViewById(ID_ICON);

            boolean exclusive = icon != null && icon.getVisibility() == GONE;
            boolean bindIcon = !exclusive || TextUtils.isEmpty(mLabel);

            if (title instanceof TextView) ((TextView)title).setText(mLabel);

            if (bindIcon && mIcon != null && icon instanceof ImageView)
            {
                ((ImageView)icon).setImageDrawable(mIcon);
                icon.setVisibility(VISIBLE);
            }

            return tabIndicator;
        }
    }

    private static class ViewIndicatorStrategy implements IndicatorStrategy
    {
        private final View mView;

        private ViewIndicatorStrategy(View view)
        {
            mView = view;
        }

        public View createIndicatorView()
        {
            return mView;
        }
    }

    private class ViewIdContentStrategy implements ContentStrategy
    {
        private final View mView;

        private ViewIdContentStrategy(int viewId)
        {
            mView = mTabContent == null ? null : mTabContent.findViewById(viewId);
            if (mView == null) throw new RuntimeException("Could not create tab content because could not find view with id " + viewId);

            mView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }

        public View getContentView()
        {
            mView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            return mView;
        }

        public void tabClosed()
        {
            mView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
    }

    private static class FactoryContentStrategy implements ContentStrategy
    {
        private View mTabContent;
        private final CharSequence mTag;
        private final TabContentFactory mFactory;

        private FactoryContentStrategy(CharSequence tag, TabContentFactory factory)
        {
            mTag = tag;
            mFactory = factory;
        }

        public View getContentView()
        {
            if (mTabContent == null) mTabContent = mFactory.createTabContent(mTag.toString());

            mTabContent.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            return mTabContent;
        }

        public void tabClosed()
        {
            if (mTabContent != null) mTabContent.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
    }

    private static class IntentContentStrategy implements ContentStrategy
    {
        private final String mTag;
        private final Intent mIntent;

        private IntentContentStrategy(String tag, Intent intent)
        {
            mTag = tag;
            mIntent = intent;
        }

        public View getContentView()
        {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Did you forget to call 'public void setup(LocalActivityManager activityGroup)'?");
        }

        public void tabClosed()
        {
        }
    }
}
```
