`java/android/widget/TabWidget.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.PointerIcon;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

public class TabWidget extends LinearLayout implements View.OnFocusChangeListener
{
    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private final Rect mBounds = new Rect();

    private OnTabSelectionChanged mSelectionChangedListener;
    private int mSelectedTab = -1;
    private Drawable mLeftStrip;
    private Drawable mRightStrip;
    private boolean mDrawBottomStrips = true;
    private boolean mStripMoved;

    public TabWidget(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public TabWidget(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, ProgressBar.attributeIdentifier(context, "tabWidgetStyle"));
    }

    public TabWidget(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public TabWidget(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        if (attributes != null || defStyleAttr != 0 || defStyleRes != 0) readAttributes(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        setChildrenDrawingOrderEnabled(true);
    }

    private void readAttributes(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        if (sStyleable == null)
        {
            sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "tabStripEnabled", "tabStripLeft", "tabStripRight", "divider");
        }
        if (sStyleable.isEmpty()) return;

        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        int enabledIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("tabStripEnabled");
        if (enabledIndex >= 0) mDrawBottomStrips = array.getBoolean(enabledIndex, true);

        mLeftStrip = readDrawable(array, sStyleable.indexOf("tabStripLeft"));
        mRightStrip = readDrawable(array, sStyleable.indexOf("tabStripRight"));

        Drawable divider = readDrawable(array, sStyleable.indexOf("divider"));
        if (divider != null) setDividerDrawable(divider);

        array.recycle();
    }

    private static Drawable readDrawable(TypedArray array, int index)
    {
        if (index < 0 || !array.hasValue(index)) return null;

        try
        {
            return array.getDrawable(index);
        }
        catch (RuntimeException unsupported)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onSizeChanged(int width, int height, int oldWidth, int oldHeight)
    {
        mStripMoved = true;

        super.onSizeChanged(width, height, oldWidth, oldHeight);
    }

    @Override
    protected int getChildDrawingOrder(int childCount, int drawingPosition)
    {
        if (mSelectedTab == -1 || mSelectedTab >= childCount) return drawingPosition;
        if (drawingPosition == childCount - 1) return mSelectedTab;
        if (drawingPosition >= mSelectedTab) return drawingPosition + 1;

        return drawingPosition;
    }

    public View getChildTabViewAt(int index)
    {
        return getChildAt(index);
    }

    public int getTabCount()
    {
        return getChildCount();
    }

    @Override
    public void setDividerDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        super.setDividerDrawable(drawable);
    }

    public void setDividerDrawable(int resId)
    {
        setDividerDrawable(resId == 0 ? null : getContext().getDrawable(resId));
    }

    public void setLeftStripDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        mLeftStrip = drawable;
        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setLeftStripDrawable(int resId)
    {
        setLeftStripDrawable(resId == 0 ? null : getContext().getDrawable(resId));
    }

    public Drawable getLeftStripDrawable()
    {
        return mLeftStrip;
    }

    public void setRightStripDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        mRightStrip = drawable;
        requestLayout();
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setRightStripDrawable(int resId)
    {
        setRightStripDrawable(resId == 0 ? null : getContext().getDrawable(resId));
    }

    public Drawable getRightStripDrawable()
    {
        return mRightStrip;
    }

    public void setStripEnabled(boolean stripEnabled)
    {
        mDrawBottomStrips = stripEnabled;
        invalidate();
    }

    public boolean isStripEnabled()
    {
        return mDrawBottomStrips;
    }

    @Override
    public void childDrawableStateChanged(View child)
    {
        if (getTabCount() > 0 && child == getChildTabViewAt(mSelectedTab)) invalidate();

        super.childDrawableStateChanged(child);
    }

    @Override
    public void dispatchDraw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        super.dispatchDraw(canvas);

        if (getTabCount() == 0 || !mDrawBottomStrips) return;

        View selected = getChildTabViewAt(mSelectedTab);
        if (selected == null) return;

        Drawable leftStrip = mLeftStrip;
        Drawable rightStrip = mRightStrip;
        int[] state = selected.getDrawableState();

        if (leftStrip != null) leftStrip.setState(state);
        if (rightStrip != null) rightStrip.setState(state);

        if (mStripMoved)
        {
            mBounds.left = selected.getLeft();
            mBounds.right = selected.getRight();
            int height = getHeight();

            if (leftStrip != null)
            {
                leftStrip.setBounds(Math.min(0, mBounds.left - leftStrip.getIntrinsicWidth()), height - leftStrip.getIntrinsicHeight(),
                                    mBounds.left, height);
            }

            if (rightStrip != null)
            {
                rightStrip.setBounds(mBounds.right, height - rightStrip.getIntrinsicHeight(),
                                     Math.max(getWidth(), mBounds.right + rightStrip.getIntrinsicWidth()), height);
            }

            mStripMoved = false;
        }

        if (leftStrip != null) leftStrip.draw(canvas);
        if (rightStrip != null) rightStrip.draw(canvas);
    }

    public void setCurrentTab(int index)
    {
        if (index < 0 || index >= getTabCount() || index == mSelectedTab) return;

        if (mSelectedTab != -1 && mSelectedTab < getTabCount()) getChildTabViewAt(mSelectedTab).setSelected(false);

        mSelectedTab = index;
        getChildTabViewAt(mSelectedTab).setSelected(true);
        mStripMoved = true;
        invalidate();
    }

    public void focusCurrentTab(int index)
    {
        int oldTab = mSelectedTab;

        setCurrentTab(index);

        if (oldTab != index && index >= 0 && index < getTabCount()) getChildTabViewAt(index).requestFocus();
    }

    @Override
    public void setEnabled(boolean enabled)
    {
        super.setEnabled(enabled);

        int count = getTabCount();
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) getChildTabViewAt(index).setEnabled(enabled);
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child)
    {
        if (child.getLayoutParams() == null)
        {
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams params = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 1.0f);
            params.setMargins(0, 0, 0, 0);
            child.setLayoutParams(params);
        }

        child.setFocusable(true);
        child.setClickable(true);

        if (child.getPointerIcon() == null)
        {
            child.setPointerIcon(PointerIcon.getSystemIcon(getContext(), PointerIcon.TYPE_HAND));
        }

        super.addView(child);

        child.setOnClickListener(new TabClickListener(getTabCount() - 1));
    }

    @Override
    public void removeAllViews()
    {
        super.removeAllViews();

        mSelectedTab = -1;
    }

    @Override
    public PointerIcon onResolvePointerIcon(MotionEvent event, int pointerIndex)
    {
        if (!isEnabled()) return null;

        return super.onResolvePointerIcon(event, pointerIndex);
    }

    void setTabSelectionListener(OnTabSelectionChanged listener)
    {
        mSelectionChangedListener = listener;
    }

    @Override
    public void onFocusChange(View view, boolean hasFocus)
    {
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return TabWidget.class.getName();
    }

    private class TabClickListener implements OnClickListener
    {
        private final int mTabIndex;

        private TabClickListener(int tabIndex)
        {
            mTabIndex = tabIndex;
        }

        public void onClick(View view)
        {
            if (mSelectionChangedListener != null) mSelectionChangedListener.onTabSelectionChanged(mTabIndex, true);
        }
    }

    interface OnTabSelectionChanged
    {
        void onTabSelectionChanged(int tabIndex, boolean clicked);
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/TableLayout.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.util.SparseBooleanArray;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

public class TableLayout extends LinearLayout
{
    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private int[] mMaxWidths;
    private SparseBooleanArray mCollapsedColumns;
    private SparseBooleanArray mShrinkableColumns;
    private SparseBooleanArray mStretchableColumns;
    private boolean mShrinkAllColumns;
    private boolean mStretchAllColumns;
    private PassThroughHierarchyChangeListener mPassThroughListener;
    private boolean mInitialized;

    public TableLayout(Context context)
    {
        super(context);
        initTableLayout();
    }

    public TableLayout(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);

        if (attributes != null)
        {
            if (sStyleable == null)
            {
                sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "stretchColumns", "shrinkColumns", "collapseColumns");
            }

            if (!sStyleable.isEmpty())
            {
                TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), 0, 0);

                String stretched = readString(array, sStyleable.indexOf("stretchColumns"));
                if (stretched != null && !stretched.isEmpty())
                {
                    if (stretched.charAt(0) == '*') mStretchAllColumns = true;
                    else mStretchableColumns = parseColumns(stretched);
                }

                String shrunk = readString(array, sStyleable.indexOf("shrinkColumns"));
                if (shrunk != null && !shrunk.isEmpty())
                {
                    if (shrunk.charAt(0) == '*') mShrinkAllColumns = true;
                    else mShrinkableColumns = parseColumns(shrunk);
                }

                String collapsed = readString(array, sStyleable.indexOf("collapseColumns"));
                if (collapsed != null && !collapsed.isEmpty()) mCollapsedColumns = parseColumns(collapsed);

                array.recycle();
            }
        }

        initTableLayout();
    }

    private static String readString(TypedArray array, int index)
    {
        if (index < 0) return null;

        CharSequence text = array.getText(index);
        if (text != null) return text.toString();

        if (array.hasValue(index)) return String.valueOf(array.getInt(index, -1));

        return null;
    }

    private static SparseBooleanArray parseColumns(String sequence)
    {
        SparseBooleanArray columns = new SparseBooleanArray();
        String[] columnDefinitions = sequence.split("\\s*,\\s*");

        for (String columnIdentifier : columnDefinitions)
        {
            try
            {
                int columnIndex = Integer.parseInt(columnIdentifier.trim());
                if (columnIndex >= 0) columns.put(columnIndex, true);
            }
            catch (NumberFormatException ignored)
            {
            }
        }

        return columns;
    }

    private void initTableLayout()
    {
        if (mCollapsedColumns == null) mCollapsedColumns = new SparseBooleanArray();
        if (mStretchableColumns == null) mStretchableColumns = new SparseBooleanArray();
        if (mShrinkableColumns == null) mShrinkableColumns = new SparseBooleanArray();

        setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);

        mPassThroughListener = new PassThroughHierarchyChangeListener();
        super.setOnHierarchyChangeListener(mPassThroughListener);

        mInitialized = true;
    }

    @Override
    public void setOnHierarchyChangeListener(OnHierarchyChangeListener listener)
    {
        mPassThroughListener.mOnHierarchyChangeListener = listener;
    }

    private void requestRowsLayout()
    {
        if (!mInitialized) return;

        int count = getChildCount();
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            getChildAt(index).requestLayout();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void requestLayout()
    {
        if (mInitialized)
        {
            int count = getChildCount();
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                getChildAt(index).forceLayout();
            }
        }

        super.requestLayout();
    }

    public boolean isShrinkAllColumns()
    {
        return mShrinkAllColumns;
    }

    public void setShrinkAllColumns(boolean shrinkAllColumns)
    {
        mShrinkAllColumns = shrinkAllColumns;
    }

    public boolean isStretchAllColumns()
    {
        return mStretchAllColumns;
    }

    public void setStretchAllColumns(boolean stretchAllColumns)
    {
        mStretchAllColumns = stretchAllColumns;
    }

    public void setColumnCollapsed(int columnIndex, boolean isCollapsed)
    {
        mCollapsedColumns.put(columnIndex, isCollapsed);

        int count = getChildCount();
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            View view = getChildAt(index);
            if (view instanceof TableRow) ((TableRow)view).setColumnCollapsed(columnIndex, isCollapsed);
        }

        requestRowsLayout();
    }

    public boolean isColumnCollapsed(int columnIndex)
    {
        return mCollapsedColumns.get(columnIndex);
    }

    public void setColumnStretchable(int columnIndex, boolean isStretchable)
    {
        mStretchableColumns.put(columnIndex, isStretchable);
        requestRowsLayout();
    }

    public boolean isColumnStretchable(int columnIndex)
    {
        return mStretchAllColumns || mStretchableColumns.get(columnIndex);
    }

    public void setColumnShrinkable(int columnIndex, boolean isShrinkable)
    {
        mShrinkableColumns.put(columnIndex, isShrinkable);
        requestRowsLayout();
    }

    public boolean isColumnShrinkable(int columnIndex)
    {
        return mShrinkAllColumns || mShrinkableColumns.get(columnIndex);
    }

    private void trackCollapsedColumns(View child)
    {
        if (!(child instanceof TableRow)) return;

        TableRow row = (TableRow)child;
        SparseBooleanArray collapsedColumns = mCollapsedColumns;
        int count = collapsedColumns.size();

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            int columnIndex = collapsedColumns.keyAt(index);
            boolean isCollapsed = collapsedColumns.valueAt(index);

            if (isCollapsed) row.setColumnCollapsed(columnIndex, true);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child)
    {
        super.addView(child);
        requestRowsLayout();
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child, int index)
    {
        super.addView(child, index);
        requestRowsLayout();
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child, ViewGroup.LayoutParams params)
    {
        super.addView(child, params);
        requestRowsLayout();
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child, int index, ViewGroup.LayoutParams params)
    {
        super.addView(child, index, params);
        requestRowsLayout();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        measureVertical(widthMeasureSpec, heightMeasureSpec);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onLayout(boolean changed, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        layoutVertical(left, top, right, bottom);
    }

    @Override
    void measureChildBeforeLayout(View child, int childIndex, int widthMeasureSpec, int totalWidth, int heightMeasureSpec,
                                  int totalHeight)
    {
        if (child instanceof TableRow) ((TableRow)child).setColumnsWidthConstraints(mMaxWidths);

        super.measureChildBeforeLayout(child, childIndex, widthMeasureSpec, totalWidth, heightMeasureSpec, totalHeight);
    }

    @Override
    void measureVertical(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        findLargestCells(widthMeasureSpec, heightMeasureSpec);
        shrinkAndStretchColumns(widthMeasureSpec);

        super.measureVertical(widthMeasureSpec, heightMeasureSpec);
    }

    private void findLargestCells(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        boolean firstRow = true;
        int count = getChildCount();

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            if (child.getVisibility() == GONE) continue;
            if (!(child instanceof TableRow)) continue;

            TableRow row = (TableRow)child;
            ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = row.getLayoutParams();
            if (params != null) params.height = LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;

            int[] widths = row.getColumnsWidths(widthMeasureSpec, heightMeasureSpec);
            int newColumnCount = widths.length;

            if (firstRow)
            {
                if (mMaxWidths == null || mMaxWidths.length != newColumnCount) mMaxWidths = new int[newColumnCount];

                System.arraycopy(widths, 0, mMaxWidths, 0, newColumnCount);
                firstRow = false;
                continue;
            }

            int length = mMaxWidths.length;
            int difference = newColumnCount - length;

            if (difference > 0)
            {
                int[] oldMaxWidths = mMaxWidths;
                mMaxWidths = new int[newColumnCount];
                System.arraycopy(oldMaxWidths, 0, mMaxWidths, 0, oldMaxWidths.length);
                System.arraycopy(widths, oldMaxWidths.length, mMaxWidths, oldMaxWidths.length, difference);
            }

            int[] maxWidths = mMaxWidths;
            length = Math.min(length, newColumnCount);

            for (int column = 0; column < length; column++)
            {
                maxWidths[column] = Math.max(maxWidths[column], widths[column]);
            }
        }
    }

    private void shrinkAndStretchColumns(int widthMeasureSpec)
    {
        if (mMaxWidths == null) return;

        int totalWidth = 0;
        for (int width : mMaxWidths)
        {
            totalWidth += width;
        }

        int size = MeasureSpec.getSize(widthMeasureSpec) - getPaddingLeft() - getPaddingRight();

        if (totalWidth > size && (mShrinkAllColumns || mShrinkableColumns.size() > 0))
        {
            mutateColumnsWidth(mShrinkableColumns, mShrinkAllColumns, size, totalWidth);
        }
        else if (totalWidth < size && (mStretchAllColumns || mStretchableColumns.size() > 0))
        {
            mutateColumnsWidth(mStretchableColumns, mStretchAllColumns, size, totalWidth);
        }
    }

    private void mutateColumnsWidth(SparseBooleanArray columns, boolean allColumns, int size, int totalWidth)
    {
        int skipped = 0;
        int[] maxWidths = mMaxWidths;
        int length = maxWidths.length;
        int count = allColumns ? length : columns.size();
        if (count == 0) return;

        int totalExtraSpace = size - totalWidth;
        int extraSpace = totalExtraSpace / count;

        int children = getChildCount();
        for (int index = 0; index < children; index++)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            if (child instanceof TableRow) child.forceLayout();
        }

        if (allColumns)
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                maxWidths[index] += extraSpace;
            }

            return;
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            int column = columns.keyAt(index);

            if (columns.valueAt(index))
            {
                if (column < length) maxWidths[column] += extraSpace;
                else skipped++;
            }
        }

        if (skipped > 0 && skipped < count)
        {
            extraSpace = skipped * extraSpace / (count - skipped);

            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                int column = columns.keyAt(index);

                if (columns.valueAt(index) && column < length)
                {
                    if (extraSpace > maxWidths[column]) maxWidths[column] = 0;
                    else maxWidths[column] += extraSpace;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public LayoutParams generateLayoutParams(AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        return new TableLayout.LayoutParams(getContext(), attributes);
    }

    @Override
    protected LinearLayout.LayoutParams generateDefaultLayoutParams()
    {
        return new LayoutParams();
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean checkLayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams layoutParams)
    {
        return layoutParams instanceof TableLayout.LayoutParams;
    }

    @Override
    protected LinearLayout.LayoutParams generateLayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams source)
    {
        if (source instanceof MarginLayoutParams) return new LayoutParams((MarginLayoutParams)source);
        return new LayoutParams(source);
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return TableLayout.class.getName();
    }

    public static class LayoutParams extends LinearLayout.LayoutParams
    {
        public LayoutParams(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
        {
            super(context, attributes);
            width = MATCH_PARENT;
        }

        public LayoutParams(int width, int height)
        {
            super(MATCH_PARENT, height);
        }

        public LayoutParams(int width, int height, float initWeight)
        {
            super(MATCH_PARENT, height, initWeight);
        }

        public LayoutParams()
        {
            super(MATCH_PARENT, WRAP_CONTENT);
        }

        public LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams source)
        {
            super(source);
            width = MATCH_PARENT;
        }

        public LayoutParams(MarginLayoutParams source)
        {
            super(source);
            width = MATCH_PARENT;

            if (source instanceof LinearLayout.LayoutParams)
            {
                weight = ((LinearLayout.LayoutParams)source).weight;
                gravity = ((LinearLayout.LayoutParams)source).gravity;
            }
        }

        @Override
        protected void setBaseAttributes(TypedArray array, int widthAttr, int heightAttr)
        {
            width = MATCH_PARENT;
            height = array.hasValue(heightAttr) ? array.getLayoutDimension(heightAttr, "layout_height") : WRAP_CONTENT;
        }
    }

    private class PassThroughHierarchyChangeListener implements OnHierarchyChangeListener
    {
        private OnHierarchyChangeListener mOnHierarchyChangeListener;

        @Override
        public void onChildViewAdded(View parent, View child)
        {
            trackCollapsedColumns(child);

            if (mOnHierarchyChangeListener != null) mOnHierarchyChangeListener.onChildViewAdded(parent, child);
        }

        @Override
        public void onChildViewRemoved(View parent, View child)
        {
            if (mOnHierarchyChangeListener != null) mOnHierarchyChangeListener.onChildViewRemoved(parent, child);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/TableRow.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.util.SparseIntArray;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

public class TableRow extends LinearLayout
{
    private int mNumColumns;
    private int[] mColumnWidths;
    private int[] mConstrainedColumnWidths;
    private SparseIntArray mColumnToChildIndex;
    private ChildrenTracker mChildrenTracker;

    public TableRow(Context context)
    {
        super(context);
        initTableRow();
    }

    public TableRow(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);
        initTableRow();
    }

    private void initTableRow()
    {
        mChildrenTracker = new ChildrenTracker();
        super.setOnHierarchyChangeListener(mChildrenTracker);
    }

    @Override
    public void setOnHierarchyChangeListener(OnHierarchyChangeListener listener)
    {
        mChildrenTracker.setOnHierarchyChangeListener(listener);
    }

    void setColumnCollapsed(int columnIndex, boolean collapsed)
    {
        View child = getVirtualChildAt(columnIndex);
        if (child != null) child.setVisibility(collapsed ? GONE : VISIBLE);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        measureHorizontal(widthMeasureSpec, heightMeasureSpec);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onLayout(boolean changed, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
    {
        layoutHorizontal(left, top, right, bottom);
    }

    @Override
    public View getVirtualChildAt(int index)
    {
        if (mColumnToChildIndex == null) mapIndexAndColumns();

        int deflectedIndex = mColumnToChildIndex.get(index, -1);
        if (deflectedIndex != -1) return getChildAt(deflectedIndex);

        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public int getVirtualChildCount()
    {
        if (mColumnToChildIndex == null) mapIndexAndColumns();

        return mNumColumns;
    }

    private void mapIndexAndColumns()
    {
        if (mColumnToChildIndex != null) return;

        int virtualCount = 0;
        int count = getChildCount();

        mColumnToChildIndex = new SparseIntArray();
        SparseIntArray columnToChild = mColumnToChildIndex;

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            View child = getChildAt(index);
            LayoutParams params = cellParams(child);

            if (params.column >= virtualCount) virtualCount = params.column;

            for (int span = 0; span < params.span; span++)
            {
                columnToChild.put(virtualCount++, index);
            }
        }

        mNumColumns = virtualCount;
    }

    private LayoutParams cellParams(View child)
    {
        ViewGroup.LayoutParams params = child.getLayoutParams();
        if (params instanceof LayoutParams) return (LayoutParams)params;

        LayoutParams converted = params == null ? new LayoutParams() : new LayoutParams(params);
        child.setLayoutParams(converted);
        return converted;
    }

    @Override
    int measureNullChild(int childIndex)
    {
        if (mConstrainedColumnWidths == null || childIndex >= mConstrainedColumnWidths.length) return 0;

        return mConstrainedColumnWidths[childIndex];
    }

    @Override
    void measureChildBeforeLayout(View child, int childIndex, int widthMeasureSpec, int totalWidth, int heightMeasureSpec,
                                  int totalHeight)
    {
        if (mConstrainedColumnWidths == null)
        {
            super.measureChildBeforeLayout(child, childIndex, widthMeasureSpec, totalWidth, heightMeasureSpec, totalHeight);
            return;
        }

        LayoutParams params = cellParams(child);

        int measureMode = MeasureSpec.EXACTLY;
        int columnWidth = 0;

        int span = params.span;
        int[] constrainedColumnWidths = mConstrainedColumnWidths;

        for (int index = 0; index < span; index++)
        {
            columnWidth += constrainedColumnWidths[childIndex + index];
        }

        int gravity = params.gravity;
        boolean isHorizontalGravity = gravity > 0 && (gravity & Gravity.RELATIVE_HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK) != 0;

        if (isHorizontalGravity) measureMode = MeasureSpec.AT_MOST;

        int childWidthMeasureSpec = MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(Math.max(0, columnWidth - params.leftMargin - params.rightMargin),
                                                                measureMode);
        int childHeightMeasureSpec = getChildMeasureSpec(heightMeasureSpec, getPaddingTop() + getPaddingBottom() + params.topMargin
                                                         + params.bottomMargin + totalHeight, params.height);

        child.measure(childWidthMeasureSpec, childHeightMeasureSpec);

        if (!isHorizontalGravity)
        {
            params.mOffset[LayoutParams.LOCATION] = 0;
            params.mOffset[LayoutParams.LOCATION_NEXT] = 0;
            return;
        }

        int childWidth = child.getMeasuredWidth();
        params.mOffset[LayoutParams.LOCATION_NEXT] = columnWidth - childWidth;

        int absoluteGravity = Gravity.getAbsoluteGravity(gravity, getLayoutDirection());
        int horizontal = absoluteGravity & Gravity.HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK;

        if (horizontal == Gravity.RIGHT) params.mOffset[LayoutParams.LOCATION] = params.mOffset[LayoutParams.LOCATION_NEXT];
        else if (horizontal == Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL) params.mOffset[LayoutParams.LOCATION] = params.mOffset[LayoutParams.LOCATION_NEXT] / 2;
        else params.mOffset[LayoutParams.LOCATION] = 0;
    }

    @Override
    int getChildrenSkipCount(View child, int index)
    {
        return cellParams(child).span - 1;
    }

    @Override
    int getLocationOffset(View child)
    {
        return cellParams(child).mOffset[LayoutParams.LOCATION];
    }

    @Override
    int getNextLocationOffset(View child)
    {
        return cellParams(child).mOffset[LayoutParams.LOCATION_NEXT];
    }

    int[] getColumnsWidths(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
    {
        int numColumns = getVirtualChildCount();
        if (mColumnWidths == null || numColumns != mColumnWidths.length) mColumnWidths = new int[numColumns];

        int[] columnWidths = mColumnWidths;

        for (int index = 0; index < numColumns; index++)
        {
            View child = getVirtualChildAt(index);

            if (child == null || child.getVisibility() == GONE)
            {
                columnWidths[index] = 0;
                continue;
            }

            LayoutParams params = cellParams(child);

            if (params.span != 1)
            {
                columnWidths[index] = 0;
                continue;
            }

            int spec;

            if (params.width == LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
            {
                spec = getChildMeasureSpec(widthMeasureSpec, 0, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            }
            else if (params.width == LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT)
            {
                spec = MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(MeasureSpec.getSize(heightMeasureSpec), MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED);
            }
            else
            {
                spec = MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(params.width, MeasureSpec.EXACTLY);
            }

            child.measure(spec, spec);

            columnWidths[index] = child.getMeasuredWidth() + params.leftMargin + params.rightMargin;
        }

        return columnWidths;
    }

    void setColumnsWidthConstraints(int[] columnWidths)
    {
        if (columnWidths == null || columnWidths.length < getVirtualChildCount())
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("columnWidths should be >= getVirtualChildCount()");
        }

        mConstrainedColumnWidths = columnWidths;
    }

    @Override
    public LayoutParams generateLayoutParams(AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        return new TableRow.LayoutParams(getContext(), attributes);
    }

    @Override
    protected LinearLayout.LayoutParams generateDefaultLayoutParams()
    {
        return new LayoutParams();
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean checkLayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams layoutParams)
    {
        return layoutParams instanceof TableRow.LayoutParams;
    }

    @Override
    protected LinearLayout.LayoutParams generateLayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams source)
    {
        return new LayoutParams(source);
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return TableRow.class.getName();
    }

    public static class LayoutParams extends LinearLayout.LayoutParams
    {
        private static final int LOCATION = 0;
        private static final int LOCATION_NEXT = 1;

        private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

        public int column = -1;
        public int span = 1;

        private final int[] mOffset = new int[2];

        public LayoutParams(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
        {
            super(context, attributes);

            if (attributes == null)
            {
                width = MATCH_PARENT;
                return;
            }

            if (sStyleable == null)
            {
                sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "layout_width", "layout_height", "layout_column", "layout_span");
            }
            if (sStyleable.isEmpty()) return;

            TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), 0, 0);

            int widthIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("layout_width");
            int heightIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("layout_height");
            int columnIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("layout_column");
            int spanIndex = sStyleable.indexOf("layout_span");

            if (widthIndex >= 0 && !array.hasValue(widthIndex)) width = MATCH_PARENT;
            if (heightIndex >= 0 && !array.hasValue(heightIndex)) height = WRAP_CONTENT;
            if (columnIndex >= 0) column = array.getInt(columnIndex, -1);
            if (spanIndex >= 0) span = array.getInt(spanIndex, 1);
            if (span <= 1) span = 1;

            array.recycle();
        }

        public LayoutParams(int width, int height)
        {
            super(width, height);
        }

        public LayoutParams(int width, int height, float initWeight)
        {
            super(width, height, initWeight);
        }

        public LayoutParams()
        {
            super(MATCH_PARENT, WRAP_CONTENT);
        }

        public LayoutParams(int column)
        {
            this();
            this.column = column;
        }

        public LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams source)
        {
            super(source);
        }

        public LayoutParams(MarginLayoutParams source)
        {
            super(source);
        }

        @Override
        protected void setBaseAttributes(TypedArray array, int widthAttr, int heightAttr)
        {
            width = array.hasValue(widthAttr) ? array.getLayoutDimension(widthAttr, "layout_width") : MATCH_PARENT;
            height = array.hasValue(heightAttr) ? array.getLayoutDimension(heightAttr, "layout_height") : WRAP_CONTENT;
        }
    }

    private class ChildrenTracker implements OnHierarchyChangeListener
    {
        private OnHierarchyChangeListener mListener;

        private void setOnHierarchyChangeListener(OnHierarchyChangeListener listener)
        {
            mListener = listener;
        }

        @Override
        public void onChildViewAdded(View parent, View child)
        {
            mColumnToChildIndex = null;

            if (mListener != null) mListener.onChildViewAdded(parent, child);
        }

        @Override
        public void onChildViewRemoved(View parent, View child)
        {
            mColumnToChildIndex = null;

            if (mListener != null) mListener.onChildViewRemoved(parent, child);
        }
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/TextClock.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.provider.Settings;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.StyleableSet;

import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.TimeZone;

public class TextClock extends TextView
{
    public static final CharSequence DEFAULT_FORMAT_12_HOUR = "h:mm a";
    public static final CharSequence DEFAULT_FORMAT_24_HOUR = "H:mm";

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private CharSequence mFormat12 = DEFAULT_FORMAT_12_HOUR;
    private CharSequence mFormat24 = DEFAULT_FORMAT_24_HOUR;
    private CharSequence mFormat;
    private boolean mHasSeconds;
    private String mTimeZone;
    private Calendar mTime;
    private boolean mRegistered;
    private boolean mShouldRunTicker;

    private final Runnable mTicker = new Runnable()
    {
        @Override
        public void run()
        {
            removeCallbacks(this);
            if (!mShouldRunTicker) return;

            onTimeChanged();

            long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
            long interval = mHasSeconds ? 1000 : 60000;
            long next = interval - (now % interval);

            postDelayed(this, next);
        }
    };

    public TextClock(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public TextClock(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, 0);
    }

    public TextClock(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public TextClock(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        if (attributes != null)
        {
            if (sStyleable == null) sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "format12Hour", "format24Hour", "timeZone");

            if (!sStyleable.isEmpty())
            {
                TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

                int index = sStyleable.indexOf("format12Hour");
                if (index >= 0)
                {
                    CharSequence format = array.getText(index);
                    if (format != null) mFormat12 = format;
                }

                index = sStyleable.indexOf("format24Hour");
                if (index >= 0)
                {
                    CharSequence format = array.getText(index);
                    if (format != null) mFormat24 = format;
                }

                index = sStyleable.indexOf("timeZone");
                if (index >= 0) mTimeZone = array.getString(index);

                array.recycle();
            }
        }

        createTime(mTimeZone);
        chooseFormat();
        onTimeChanged();
    }

    private void createTime(String timeZone)
    {
        mTime = timeZone != null ? Calendar.getInstance(TimeZone.getTimeZone(timeZone)) : Calendar.getInstance();
    }

    public CharSequence getFormat12Hour()
    {
        return mFormat12;
    }

    public void setFormat12Hour(CharSequence format)
    {
        mFormat12 = format;
        chooseFormat();
        onTimeChanged();
    }

    public CharSequence getFormat24Hour()
    {
        return mFormat24;
    }

    public void setFormat24Hour(CharSequence format)
    {
        mFormat24 = format;
        chooseFormat();
        onTimeChanged();
    }

    public void refreshTime()
    {
        onTimeChanged();
        invalidate();
    }

    public boolean is24HourModeEnabled()
    {
        try
        {
            String value = Settings.System.getString(getContext().getContentResolver(), Settings.System.TIME_12_24);
            if ("24".equals(value)) return true;
            if ("12".equals(value)) return false;
        }
        catch (RuntimeException unavailable)
        {
            android.util.Log.w("TextClock", "time format setting unavailable", unavailable);
        }

        java.text.DateFormat natural = java.text.DateFormat.getTimeInstance(java.text.DateFormat.SHORT, Locale.getDefault());
        if (natural instanceof SimpleDateFormat) return ((SimpleDateFormat)natural).toPattern().indexOf('H') >= 0;

        return false;
    }

    public String getTimeZone()
    {
        return mTimeZone;
    }

    public void setTimeZone(String timeZone)
    {
        mTimeZone = timeZone;
        createTime(timeZone);
        onTimeChanged();
    }

    private void chooseFormat()
    {
        boolean format24 = is24HourModeEnabled();

        CharSequence chosen = format24 ? firstNonEmpty(mFormat24, mFormat12, DEFAULT_FORMAT_24_HOUR)
                                       : firstNonEmpty(mFormat12, mFormat24, DEFAULT_FORMAT_12_HOUR);

        boolean hadSeconds = mHasSeconds;
        mFormat = chosen;
        mHasSeconds = hasSeconds(chosen);

        if (mShouldRunTicker && hadSeconds != mHasSeconds) mTicker.run();
    }

    private static CharSequence firstNonEmpty(CharSequence first, CharSequence second, CharSequence third)
    {
        if (first != null && first.length() > 0) return first;
        if (second != null && second.length() > 0) return second;

        return third;
    }

    private static boolean hasSeconds(CharSequence format)
    {
        if (format == null) return false;

        boolean quoted = false;

        for (int index = 0; index < format.length(); index++)
        {
            char character = format.charAt(index);

            if (character == '\'') quoted = !quoted;
            else if (!quoted && character == 's') return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private void onTimeChanged()
    {
        if (mTime == null || mFormat == null) return;

        mTime.setTimeInMillis(System.currentTimeMillis());

        try
        {
            SimpleDateFormat formatter = new SimpleDateFormat(mFormat.toString(), Locale.getDefault());
            formatter.setTimeZone(mTime.getTimeZone());
            setText(formatter.format(new Date(mTime.getTimeInMillis())));
        }
        catch (IllegalArgumentException malformed)
        {
            setText(mFormat);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onAttachedToWindow()
    {
        super.onAttachedToWindow();

        if (!mRegistered)
        {
            mRegistered = true;
            createTime(mTimeZone);
            chooseFormat();
        }

        if (!mShouldRunTicker && isShown())
        {
            mShouldRunTicker = true;
            mTicker.run();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onVisibilityAggregated(boolean isVisible)
    {
        super.onVisibilityAggregated(isVisible);

        if (!mShouldRunTicker && isVisible)
        {
            mShouldRunTicker = true;
            mTicker.run();
        }
        else if (mShouldRunTicker && !isVisible)
        {
            mShouldRunTicker = false;
            removeCallbacks(mTicker);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow()
    {
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();

        mRegistered = false;
        mShouldRunTicker = false;
        removeCallbacks(mTicker);
    }
}
```

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

public class TextSwitcher extends ViewSwitcher
{
    public TextSwitcher(Context context)
    {
        super(context);
    }

    public TextSwitcher(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        super(context, attributes);
    }

    @Override
    public void addView(View child, int index, ViewGroup.LayoutParams params)
    {
        if (!(child instanceof TextView)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("TextSwitcher children must be instances of TextView");

        super.addView(child, index, params);
    }

    public void setText(CharSequence text)
    {
        TextView next = (TextView)getNextView();
        if (next == null) return;

        next.setText(text);
        showNext();
    }

    public void setCurrentText(CharSequence text)
    {
        TextView current = (TextView)getCurrentView();
        if (current != null) current.setText(text);
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return TextSwitcher.class.getName();
    }
}
```

```java
    private static final int EMS = LINES;
    private static final int PIXELS = 2;
    private static final int VERY_WIDE = 1024 * 1024;
    private static final int CHANGE_WATCHER_PRIORITY = 100;
    private static final int DEFAULT_AUTO_SIZE_MIN_TEXT_SIZE_IN_SP = 12;
    private static final int DEFAULT_AUTO_SIZE_MAX_TEXT_SIZE_IN_SP = 112;
    private static final int DEFAULT_AUTO_SIZE_GRANULARITY_IN_PX = 1;
    private static final float UNSET_AUTO_SIZE_UNIFORM_CONFIGURATION_VALUE = -1f;
    private static final int DEFAULT_TYPEFACE = -1;
    private static final int SANS = 1;
    private static final int SERIF = 2;
    private static final int MONOSPACE = 3;
    private static final int CURSOR_BLINK_INTERVAL = 500;
    private static final int DEFAULT_HIGHLIGHT_COLOR = 0x6633B5E5;
    private static final InputFilter[] NO_FILTERS = new InputFilter[0];
    private static final Spanned EMPTY_SPANNED = new SpannedString("");

    }

    public interface OnEditorActionListener

    }

    private final TextPaint mTextPaint;
    private final Paint mHighlightPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final ArrayList<TextWatcher> mListeners = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Rect mTempRect = new Rect();

    private CharSequence mText = "";
    private CharSequence mTransformed = "";
    private BufferType mBufferType = BufferType.NORMAL;
    private Editable.Factory mEditableFactory = Editable.Factory.getInstance();
    private Spannable.Factory mSpannableFactory = Spannable.Factory.getInstance();
    private ChangeWatcher mChangeWatcher;
    private boolean mInSetText;

    private CharSequence mHint;
    private Layout mLayout;
    private Layout mHintLayout;

    private ColorStateList mTextColor;
    private ColorStateList mHintTextColor;
    private ColorStateList mLinkTextColor;
    private int mCurTextColor = 0xFF000000;
    private int mCurHintTextColor;
    private int mHighlightColor = DEFAULT_HIGHLIGHT_COLOR;

    private int mGravity = Gravity.TOP | Gravity.START;
    private boolean mHorizontallyScrolling;
    private boolean mSingleLine;
    private TextUtils.TruncateAt mEllipsize;
    private int mMarqueeRepeatLimit = 3;

    private int mMaximum = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    private int mMaxMode = LINES;
    private int mMinimum;
    private int mMinMode = LINES;
    private int mOldMaximum = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    private int mOldMaxMode = LINES;
    private int mMaxWidthValue = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    private int mMaxWidthMode = PIXELS;
    private int mMinWidthValue;
    private int mMinWidthMode = PIXELS;

    private float mSpacingMultiplier = 1.0f;
    private float mSpacingAdd;
    private boolean mIncludePad = true;
    private boolean mUseFallbackLineSpacing = true;
    private int mBreakStrategy = Layout.BREAK_STRATEGY_SIMPLE;
    private int mHyphenationFrequency = Layout.HYPHENATION_FREQUENCY_NONE;
    private int mJustificationMode = Layout.JUSTIFICATION_MODE_NONE;
    private int mLineBreakStyle;
    private int mLineBreakWordStyle;
    private String mFontVariationSettings;

    private MovementMethod mMovement;
    private KeyListener mKeyListener;
    private TransformationMethod mTransformation;
    private boolean mAllowTransformationLengthChange;
    private InputFilter[] mFilters = NO_FILTERS;
    private boolean mAllCaps;

    private int mInputType = InputType.TYPE_NULL;
    private int mImeOptions = EditorInfo.IME_NULL;
    private CharSequence mImeActionLabel;
    private int mImeActionId;
    private String mPrivateImeOptions;
    private LocaleList mImeHintLocales;
    private Bundle mInputExtras;
    private OnEditorActionListener mEditorActionListener;
    private boolean mShowSoftInputOnFocus = true;

    private CharSequence mError;
    private Drawable mErrorDrawable;

    private final Drawable[] mDrawables = new Drawable[4];
    private Drawable mDrawableStart;
    private Drawable mDrawableEnd;
    private boolean mDrawablesRelative;
    private int mDrawablePadding;
    private ColorStateList mDrawableTintList;
    private PorterDuff.Mode mDrawableTintMode;
    private BlendMode mDrawableTintBlendMode;
    private boolean mHasDrawableTint;
    private boolean mHasDrawableTintMode;

    private int mAutoLinkMask;
    private boolean mLinksClickable = true;

    private float mShadowRadius;
    private float mShadowDx;
    private float mShadowDy;
    private int mShadowColor;

    private int mAutoSizeTextType = AUTO_SIZE_TEXT_TYPE_NONE;
    private float mAutoSizeMinTextSizeInPx = UNSET_AUTO_SIZE_UNIFORM_CONFIGURATION_VALUE;
    private float mAutoSizeMaxTextSizeInPx = UNSET_AUTO_SIZE_UNIFORM_CONFIGURATION_VALUE;
    private float mAutoSizeStepGranularityInPx = UNSET_AUTO_SIZE_UNIFORM_CONFIGURATION_VALUE;
    private int[] mAutoSizeTextSizesInPx = new int[0];
    private boolean mHasPresetAutoSizeValues;
    private boolean mNeedsAutoSizeText;

    private int mTextSizeUnit = TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP;
    private boolean mCursorVisible = true;
    private boolean mCursorBlinkOn = true;
    private Runnable mBlink;
    private boolean mTextIsSelectable;
    private boolean mSelectAllOnFocus;

    private boolean mTouchFocusSelected;
```
