```java
    private final class ChangeWatcher implements TextWatcher, SpanWatcher
    {
        @Override
        public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence buffer, int start, int before, int after)
        {
            sendBeforeTextChanged(buffer, start, before, after);
        }

        @Override
        public void onTextChanged(CharSequence buffer, int start, int before, int after)
        {
            handleTextChanged(buffer, start, before, after);
        }

        @Override
        public void afterTextChanged(Editable buffer)
        {
            sendAfterTextChanged(buffer);
        }

        @Override
        public void onSpanChanged(Spannable buffer, Object what, int oldStart, int oldEnd, int start, int end)
        {
            spanChange(buffer, what, oldStart, start, oldEnd, end);
        }

        @Override
        public void onSpanAdded(Spannable buffer, Object what, int start, int end)
        {
            spanChange(buffer, what, -1, start, -1, end);
        }

        @Override
        public void onSpanRemoved(Spannable buffer, Object what, int start, int end)
        {
            spanChange(buffer, what, start, -1, end, -1);
        }
    }

    private static final class AllCapsTransformationMethod implements TransformationMethod
    {
        private final Locale mLocale;

        AllCapsTransformationMethod(Context context)
        {
            Locale locale = null;

            if (context != null && context.getResources() != null && context.getResources().getConfiguration() != null)
            {
                locale = context.getResources().getConfiguration().locale;
            }

            mLocale = locale == null ? Locale.getDefault() : locale;
        }

        @Override
        public CharSequence getTransformation(CharSequence source, View view)
        {
            if (source == null) return null;

            String upper = source.toString().toUpperCase(mLocale);

            if (!(source instanceof Spanned) || upper.length() != source.length()) return upper;

            SpannableString spannable = new SpannableString(upper);
            TextUtils.copySpansFrom((Spanned)source, 0, source.length(), CharacterStyle.class, spannable, 0);
            return spannable;
        }

        @Override
        public void onFocusChanged(View view, CharSequence sourceText, boolean focused, int direction, Rect previouslyFocusedRect)
        {
        }
    }

    private static final class CharWrapper implements CharSequence, GetChars
    {
        private final char[] mChars;
        private final int mStart;
        private final int mLength;

        CharWrapper(char[] chars, int start, int length)
        {
            mChars = chars;
            mStart = start;
            mLength = length;
        }

        @Override
        public int length()
        {
            return mLength;
        }

        @Override
        public char charAt(int offset)
        {
            return mChars[offset + mStart];
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            return new String(mChars, mStart, mLength);
        }

        @Override
        public CharSequence subSequence(int start, int end)
        {
            if (start < 0 || end < 0 || start > mLength || end > mLength) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException(start + ", " + end);

            return new String(mChars, start + mStart, end - start);
        }

        @Override
        public void getChars(int start, int end, char[] buffer, int offset)
        {
            if (start < 0 || end < 0 || start > mLength || end > mLength) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException(start + ", " + end);

            System.arraycopy(mChars, start + mStart, buffer, offset, end - start);
        }
    }

    static final class EditableInputConnection extends BaseInputConnection
    {
        private static final Object COMPOSING = new ComposingText();

        private final TextView mTextView;

        EditableInputConnection(TextView textView)
        {
            super(textView, true);
            mTextView = textView;
        }

        private static final class ComposingText implements NoCopySpan
        {
        }

        static void removeComposingSpansFrom(Spannable text)
        {
            text.removeSpan(COMPOSING);
        }

        private static int composingStart(Spannable text)
        {
            return text.getSpanStart(COMPOSING);
        }

        private static int composingEnd(Spannable text)
        {
            return text.getSpanEnd(COMPOSING);
        }

        @Override
        public Editable getEditable()
        {
            return mTextView.getEditableText();
        }

        @Override
        public boolean beginBatchEdit()
        {
            mTextView.beginBatchEdit();
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean endBatchEdit()
        {
            mTextView.endBatchEdit();
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean clearMetaKeyStates(int states)
        {
            Editable content = getEditable();
            if (content == null) return false;

            KeyListener listener = mTextView.getKeyListener();
            if (listener != null) listener.clearMetaKeyState(mTextView, content, states);

            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public CharSequence getTextBeforeCursor(int length, int flags)
        {
            Editable content = getEditable();
            if (content == null) return null;

            int start = Selection.getSelectionStart(content);
            int end = Selection.getSelectionEnd(content);
            if (start > end) start = end;
            if (start < 0) start = content.length();

            int from = Math.max(0, start - length);
            return (flags & GET_TEXT_WITH_STYLES) != 0 ? content.subSequence(from, start) : TextUtils.substring(content, from, start);
        }

        @Override
        public CharSequence getTextAfterCursor(int length, int flags)
        {
            Editable content = getEditable();
            if (content == null) return null;

            int start = Selection.getSelectionStart(content);
            int end = Selection.getSelectionEnd(content);
            if (start > end) end = start;
            if (end < 0) end = content.length();

            int to = (int)Math.min((long)end + length, content.length());
            return (flags & GET_TEXT_WITH_STYLES) != 0 ? content.subSequence(end, to) : TextUtils.substring(content, end, to);
        }

        @Override
        public CharSequence getSelectedText(int flags)
        {
            Editable content = getEditable();
            if (content == null) return null;

            int start = Selection.getSelectionStart(content);
            int end = Selection.getSelectionEnd(content);
            if (start > end)
            {
                int swap = start;
                start = end;
                end = swap;
            }

            if (start == end || start < 0) return null;

            return (flags & GET_TEXT_WITH_STYLES) != 0 ? content.subSequence(start, end) : TextUtils.substring(content, start, end);
        }

        @Override
        public int getCursorCapsMode(int reqModes)
        {
            Editable content = getEditable();
            if (content == null) return 0;

            int start = Selection.getSelectionStart(content);
            int end = Selection.getSelectionEnd(content);
            if (start > end) start = end;

            return TextUtils.getCapsMode(content, Math.max(0, start), reqModes);
        }

        @Override
        public ExtractedText getExtractedText(ExtractedTextRequest request, int flags)
        {
            ExtractedText extracted = new ExtractedText();
            if (mTextView.extractText(request, extracted)) return extracted;

            return null;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean deleteSurroundingText(int beforeLength, int afterLength)
        {
            Editable content = getEditable();
            if (content == null) return false;

            beginBatchEdit();

            int start = Selection.getSelectionStart(content);
            int end = Selection.getSelectionEnd(content);

            if (start > end)
            {
                int swap = start;
                start = end;
                end = swap;
            }

            int composingStart = composingStart(content);
            int composingEnd = composingEnd(content);

            if (composingStart < 0 && start >= 0 && start != end && beforeLength == 1 && afterLength == 0)
            {
                content.delete(start, end);
                endBatchEdit();
                return true;
            }

            if (start < 0) start = end = content.length();

            if (composingEnd < composingStart)
            {
                int swap = composingStart;
                composingStart = composingEnd;
                composingEnd = swap;
            }

            if (composingStart != -1 && composingEnd != -1)
            {
                if (composingStart < start) start = composingStart;
                if (composingEnd > end) end = composingEnd;
            }

            int deleted = 0;

            if (beforeLength > 0)
            {
                int from = Math.max(0, start - beforeLength);
                if (from > 0 && Character.isLowSurrogate(content.charAt(from)) && Character.isHighSurrogate(content.charAt(from - 1)))
                {
                    from--;
                }

                content.delete(from, start);
                deleted = start - from;
            }

            if (afterLength > 0)
            {
                end = end - deleted;
                int to = Math.min(content.length(), end + afterLength);
                content.delete(end, to);
            }

            endBatchEdit();
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean deleteSurroundingTextInCodePoints(int beforeLength, int afterLength)
        {
            Editable content = getEditable();
            if (content == null) return false;

            int start = Math.max(0, Math.min(Selection.getSelectionStart(content), Selection.getSelectionEnd(content)));
            int end = Math.max(0, Math.max(Selection.getSelectionStart(content), Selection.getSelectionEnd(content)));

            int before = 0;
            int position = start;
            for (int count = 0; count < beforeLength && position > 0; count++)
            {
                int next = Character.offsetByCodePoints(content, position, -1);
                before += position - next;
                position = next;
            }

            int after = 0;
            position = end;
            for (int count = 0; count < afterLength && position < content.length(); count++)
            {
                int next = Character.offsetByCodePoints(content, position, 1);
                after += next - position;
                position = next;
            }

            return deleteSurroundingText(before, after);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean setComposingText(CharSequence text, int newCursorPosition)
        {
            replaceText(text, newCursorPosition, true);
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean setComposingRegion(int start, int end)
        {
            Editable content = getEditable();
            if (content == null) return false;

            beginBatchEdit();
            removeComposingSpansFrom(content);

            int from = Math.min(start, end);
            int to = Math.max(start, end);
            int length = content.length();

            if (from < 0) from = 0;
            if (to < 0) to = 0;
            if (from > length) from = length;
            if (to > length) to = length;

            if (from != to) content.setSpan(COMPOSING, from, to, Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE | Spanned.SPAN_COMPOSING);

            endBatchEdit();
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean finishComposingText()
        {
            Editable content = getEditable();
            if (content == null) return false;

            beginBatchEdit();
            removeComposingSpansFrom(content);
            endBatchEdit();
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean commitText(CharSequence text, int newCursorPosition)
        {
            replaceText(text, newCursorPosition, false);
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean commitCompletion(CompletionInfo text)
        {
            mTextView.beginBatchEdit();
            mTextView.onCommitCompletion(text);
            mTextView.endBatchEdit();
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean commitCorrection(CorrectionInfo correctionInfo)
        {
            mTextView.beginBatchEdit();
            mTextView.onCommitCorrection(correctionInfo);
            mTextView.endBatchEdit();
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean setSelection(int start, int end)
        {
            Editable content = getEditable();
            if (content == null) return false;

            int length = content.length();
            if (start > length || end > length || start < 0 || end < 0) return true;

            Selection.setSelection(content, start, end);
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean performEditorAction(int actionCode)
        {
            mTextView.onEditorAction(actionCode);
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean performContextMenuAction(int id)
        {
            mTextView.beginBatchEdit();
            mTextView.onTextContextMenuItem(id);
            mTextView.endBatchEdit();
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean performPrivateCommand(String action, Bundle data)
        {
            mTextView.onPrivateIMECommand(action, data);
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean sendKeyEvent(KeyEvent event)
        {
            return mTextView.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
        }

        @Override
        public void closeConnection()
        {
            finishComposingText();
        }

        private void replaceText(CharSequence text, int newCursorPosition, boolean composing)
        {
            Editable content = getEditable();
            if (content == null) return;
            if (text == null) text = "";

            beginBatchEdit();

            int start = composingStart(content);
            int end = composingEnd(content);

            if (end < start)
            {
                int swap = start;
                start = end;
                end = swap;
            }

            if (start != -1 && end != -1)
            {
                removeComposingSpansFrom(content);
            }
            else
            {
                start = Selection.getSelectionStart(content);
                end = Selection.getSelectionEnd(content);

                if (start < 0) start = content.length();
                if (end < 0) end = start;

                if (end < start)
                {
                    int swap = start;
                    start = end;
                    end = swap;
                }
            }

            if (newCursorPosition > 0) newCursorPosition += end - 1;
            else newCursorPosition += start;

            if (newCursorPosition < 0) newCursorPosition = 0;
            if (newCursorPosition > content.length()) newCursorPosition = content.length();

            Selection.setSelection(content, newCursorPosition);

            int lengthBefore = content.length();
            content.replace(start, end, text);

            if (composing)
            {
                int inserted = content.length() - lengthBefore + (end - start);
                int flags = Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE | Spanned.SPAN_COMPOSING;
                if (inserted > 0) content.setSpan(COMPOSING, start, start + inserted, flags);
            }

            endBatchEdit();
        }
    }

    public static class SavedState extends BaseSavedState
    {
        int selStart = -1;
        int selEnd = -1;
        CharSequence text;
        boolean frozenWithFocus;
        CharSequence error;

        SavedState(Parcelable superState)
        {
            super(superState);
        }

        private SavedState(Parcel in)
        {
            super(in);
            selStart = in.readInt();
            selEnd = in.readInt();
            frozenWithFocus = in.readInt() != 0;
            text = TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(in);
            error = TextUtils.CHAR_SEQUENCE_CREATOR.createFromParcel(in);
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
        {
            super.writeToParcel(out, flags);
            out.writeInt(selStart);
            out.writeInt(selEnd);
            out.writeInt(frozenWithFocus ? 1 : 0);
            TextUtils.writeToParcel(text, out, flags);
            TextUtils.writeToParcel(error, out, flags);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString()
        {
            String value = "TextView.SavedState{" + Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(this)) + " start=" + selStart + " end="
                           + selEnd;
            if (text != null) value += " text=" + text;

            return value + "}";
        }

        public static final Parcelable.Creator<SavedState> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<SavedState>()
        {
            @Override
            public SavedState createFromParcel(Parcel in)
            {
                return new SavedState(in);
            }

            @Override
            public SavedState[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new SavedState[size];
            }
        };
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/TimePicker.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.StyleableSet;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.ViewStructure;
import android.view.autofill.AutofillValue;
import java.text.DateFormatSymbols;
import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.Locale;

public class TimePicker extends FrameLayout
{
    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private final LinearLayout mContainer;
    private final NumberPicker mHourSpinner;
    private final NumberPicker mMinuteSpinner;
    private final NumberPicker mAmPmSpinner;
    private final TextView mDivider;
    private final String[] mAmPmStrings;
    private OnTimeChangedListener mOnTimeChangedListener;
    private OnTimeChangedListener mAutoFillChangeListener;
    private int mHour;
    private int mMinute;
    private boolean mIs24HourView;

    public TimePicker(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public TimePicker(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, ProgressBar.attributeIdentifier(context, "timePickerStyle"));
    }

    public TimePicker(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public TimePicker(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        Calendar now = Calendar.getInstance();
        mHour = now.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY);
        mMinute = now.get(Calendar.MINUTE);
        mIs24HourView = android.text.format.DateFormat.is24HourFormat(context);

        if (sStyleable == null) sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "is24HourView");

        if (!sStyleable.isEmpty() && (attributes != null || defStyleAttr != 0 || defStyleRes != 0))
        {
            TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, sStyleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
            int index = sStyleable.indexOf("is24HourView");
            if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) mIs24HourView = array.getBoolean(index, mIs24HourView);
            array.recycle();
        }

        mAmPmStrings = new DateFormatSymbols(Locale.getDefault()).getAmPmStrings();

        mContainer = new LinearLayout(context);
        mContainer.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        mContainer.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);

        mHourSpinner = new NumberPicker(context);
        mHourSpinner.setOnLongPressUpdateInterval(100);
        mHourSpinner.setOnValueChangedListener(new NumberPicker.OnValueChangeListener()
        {
            public void onValueChange(NumberPicker picker, int oldValue, int newValue)
            {
                int hour = newValue;

                if (!mIs24HourView)
                {
                    boolean wasPm = mHour >= 12;
                    if ((oldValue == 11 && newValue == 12) || (oldValue == 12 && newValue == 11)) wasPm = !wasPm;
                    hour = newValue % 12 + (wasPm ? 12 : 0);
                }

                setHourInternal(hour, true);
            }
        });

        mDivider = new TextView(context);
        mDivider.setText(":");
        mDivider.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);

        mMinuteSpinner = new NumberPicker(context);
        mMinuteSpinner.setMinValue(0);
        mMinuteSpinner.setMaxValue(59);
        mMinuteSpinner.setOnLongPressUpdateInterval(100);
        mMinuteSpinner.setFormatter(new NumberPicker.Formatter()
        {
            public String format(int value)
            {
                return String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%02d", value);
            }
        });
        mMinuteSpinner.setOnValueChangedListener(new NumberPicker.OnValueChangeListener()
        {
            public void onValueChange(NumberPicker picker, int oldValue, int newValue)
            {
                int hour = mHour;
                if (oldValue == 59 && newValue == 0) hour = (hour + 1) % 24;
                else if (oldValue == 0 && newValue == 59) hour = (hour + 23) % 24;

                mMinute = newValue;
                if (hour != mHour) setHourInternal(hour, false);
                updateSpinners();
                onTimeChanged();
            }
        });

        mAmPmSpinner = new NumberPicker(context);
        mAmPmSpinner.setMinValue(0);
        mAmPmSpinner.setMaxValue(1);
        mAmPmSpinner.setDisplayedValues(mAmPmStrings);
        mAmPmSpinner.setOnValueChangedListener(new NumberPicker.OnValueChangeListener()
        {
            public void onValueChange(NumberPicker picker, int oldValue, int newValue)
            {
                setHourInternal(mHour % 12 + (newValue == 1 ? 12 : 0), true);
            }
        });

        int margin = (int)(8 * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
        mContainer.addView(mHourSpinner, spinnerParams(margin));
        mContainer.addView(mDivider, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                                                                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        mContainer.addView(mMinuteSpinner, spinnerParams(margin));

        String pattern = android.text.format.DateFormat.getBestDateTimePattern(Locale.getDefault(), "hm");
        boolean amPmAtStart = pattern.startsWith("a");
        if (amPmAtStart) mContainer.addView(mAmPmSpinner, 0, spinnerParams(margin));
        else mContainer.addView(mAmPmSpinner, spinnerParams(margin));

        addView(mContainer, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, Gravity.CENTER));

        updateHourRange();
        updateSpinners();
    }

    private static LinearLayout.LayoutParams spinnerParams(int margin)
    {
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams params = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                                                                         ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        params.setMargins(margin, 0, margin, 0);
        return params;
    }

    private void updateHourRange()
    {
        mHourSpinner.setDisplayedValues(null);

        if (mIs24HourView)
        {
            mHourSpinner.setMinValue(0);
            mHourSpinner.setMaxValue(23);
            mHourSpinner.setFormatter(new NumberPicker.Formatter()
            {
                public String format(int value)
                {
                    return String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%02d", value);
                }
            });
            mAmPmSpinner.setVisibility(GONE);
        }
        else
        {
            mHourSpinner.setMinValue(1);
            mHourSpinner.setMaxValue(12);
            mHourSpinner.setFormatter(null);
            mAmPmSpinner.setVisibility(VISIBLE);
        }

        mHourSpinner.setWrapSelectorWheel(true);
        mMinuteSpinner.setWrapSelectorWheel(true);
    }

    private void updateSpinners()
    {
        if (mIs24HourView)
        {
            mHourSpinner.setValue(mHour);
        }
        else
        {
            int hour = mHour % 12;
            mHourSpinner.setValue(hour == 0 ? 12 : hour);
            mAmPmSpinner.setValue(mHour >= 12 ? 1 : 0);
        }

        mMinuteSpinner.setValue(mMinute);
    }

    private void setHourInternal(int hour, boolean notify)
    {
        if (hour == mHour)
        {
            updateSpinners();
            return;
        }

        mHour = hour;
        updateSpinners();
        if (notify) onTimeChanged();
    }

    private void onTimeChanged()
    {
        sendAccessibilityEvent(android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_VIEW_SELECTED);

        if (mOnTimeChangedListener != null) mOnTimeChangedListener.onTimeChanged(this, mHour, mMinute);
        if (mAutoFillChangeListener != null) mAutoFillChangeListener.onTimeChanged(this, mHour, mMinute);

        android.view.autofill.AutofillManager manager = getContext().getSystemService(android.view.autofill.AutofillManager.class);
        if (manager != null) manager.notifyValueChanged(this);
    }

    public void setHour(int hour)
    {
        hour = Math.max(0, Math.min(hour, 23));
        if (hour == mHour) return;

        mHour = hour;
        updateSpinners();
        onTimeChanged();
    }

    public int getHour()
    {
        return mHour;
    }

    public void setMinute(int minute)
    {
        minute = Math.max(0, Math.min(minute, 59));
        if (minute == mMinute) return;

        mMinute = minute;
        updateSpinners();
        onTimeChanged();
    }

    public int getMinute()
    {
        return mMinute;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public void setCurrentHour(Integer currentHour)
    {
        setHour(currentHour);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public Integer getCurrentHour()
    {
        return getHour();
    }

    @Deprecated
    public void setCurrentMinute(Integer currentMinute)
    {
        setMinute(currentMinute);
    }

    @Deprecated
    public Integer getCurrentMinute()
    {
        return getMinute();
    }

    public void setIs24HourView(Boolean is24HourView)
    {
        if (is24HourView == null || is24HourView == mIs24HourView) return;

        mIs24HourView = is24HourView;
        updateHourRange();
        updateSpinners();
    }

    public boolean is24HourView()
    {
        return mIs24HourView;
    }

    public void setOnTimeChangedListener(OnTimeChangedListener onTimeChangedListener)
    {
        mOnTimeChangedListener = onTimeChangedListener;
    }

    void setAutoFillChangeListener(OnTimeChangedListener listener)
    {
        mAutoFillChangeListener = listener;
    }

    @Override
    public void setEnabled(boolean enabled)
    {
        super.setEnabled(enabled);

        if (mHourSpinner != null) mHourSpinner.setEnabled(enabled);
        if (mMinuteSpinner != null) mMinuteSpinner.setEnabled(enabled);
        if (mAmPmSpinner != null) mAmPmSpinner.setEnabled(enabled);
        if (mDivider != null) mDivider.setEnabled(enabled);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isEnabled()
    {
        return super.isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public int getBaseline()
    {
        int baseline = mHourSpinner.getBaseline();
        if (baseline < 0) return super.getBaseline();

        return mContainer.getTop() + mHourSpinner.getTop() + baseline;
    }

    public boolean validateInput()
    {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return TimePicker.class.getName();
    }

    @Override
    public void dispatchProvideAutofillStructure(ViewStructure structure, int flags)
    {
        structure.setAutofillId(getAutofillId());
        onProvideAutofillStructure(structure, flags);
    }

    @Override
    public void autofill(AutofillValue value)
    {
        if (!isEnabled() || value == null) return;

        if (!value.isDate())
        {
            android.util.Log.w("TimePicker", value + " could not be autofilled into " + this);
            return;
        }

        Calendar time = Calendar.getInstance();
        time.setTimeInMillis(value.getDateValue());
        mHour = time.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY);
        mMinute = time.get(Calendar.MINUTE);
        updateSpinners();
        onTimeChanged();
    }

    @Override
    public int getAutofillType()
    {
        return isEnabled() ? AUTOFILL_TYPE_DATE : AUTOFILL_TYPE_NONE;
    }

    @Override
    public AutofillValue getAutofillValue()
    {
        if (!isEnabled()) return null;

        Calendar time = Calendar.getInstance();
        time.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, mHour);
        time.set(Calendar.MINUTE, mMinute);
        time.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
        time.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
        return AutofillValue.forDate(time.getTimeInMillis());
    }

    @Override
    protected Parcelable onSaveInstanceState()
    {
        Parcelable superState = super.onSaveInstanceState();
        return new SavedState(superState, mHour, mMinute, mIs24HourView);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onRestoreInstanceState(Parcelable state)
    {
        if (!(state instanceof SavedState))
        {
            super.onRestoreInstanceState(state);
            return;
        }

        SavedState saved = (SavedState)state;
        super.onRestoreInstanceState(saved.getSuperState());

        mIs24HourView = saved.mIs24HourView;
        mHour = saved.mHour;
        mMinute = saved.mMinute;
        updateHourRange();
        updateSpinners();
    }

    public interface OnTimeChangedListener
    {
        void onTimeChanged(TimePicker view, int hourOfDay, int minute);
    }

    private static class SavedState extends View.BaseSavedState
    {
        private final int mHour;
        private final int mMinute;
        private final boolean mIs24HourView;

        SavedState(Parcelable superState, int hour, int minute, boolean is24HourView)
        {
            super(superState == null ? android.view.AbsSavedState.EMPTY_STATE : superState);
            mHour = hour;
            mMinute = minute;
            mIs24HourView = is24HourView;
        }

        private SavedState(Parcel in)
        {
            super(in);
            mHour = in.readInt();
            mMinute = in.readInt();
            mIs24HourView = in.readInt() == 1;
        }

        @Override
        public void writeToParcel(Parcel dest, int flags)
        {
            super.writeToParcel(dest, flags);
            dest.writeInt(mHour);
            dest.writeInt(mMinute);
            dest.writeInt(mIs24HourView ? 1 : 0);
        }

        public static final Parcelable.Creator<SavedState> CREATOR = new Parcelable.Creator<SavedState>()
        {
            public SavedState createFromParcel(Parcel in)
            {
                return new SavedState(in);
            }

            public SavedState[] newArray(int size)
            {
                return new SavedState[size];
            }
        };
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/Toast.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.util.Log;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.View;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class Toast
{
    private static final String TAG = "Toast";
    private static final long SHORT_DURATION_MILLISECONDS = 2000;
    private static final long LONG_DURATION_MILLISECONDS = 3500;

    public static final int LENGTH_SHORT = 0;
    public static final int LENGTH_LONG = 1;

    public abstract static class Callback
    {
        public Callback()
        {
        }

        public void onToastShown()
        {
        }

        public void onToastHidden()
        {
        }
    }

    private final Context mContext;
    private final List<Callback> mCallbacks = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Handler mHandler;
    private final Runnable mHide = new Runnable()
    {
        @Override
        public void run()
        {
            hide();
        }
    };

    private CharSequence mText;
    private View mView;
    private int mDuration = LENGTH_SHORT;
    private int mGravity = Gravity.BOTTOM | Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL;
    private int mXOffset;
    private int mYOffset;
    private float mHorizontalMargin;
    private float mVerticalMargin;
    private boolean mShowing;

    public Toast(Context context)
    {
        mContext = context;
        Looper looper = Looper.myLooper();
        mHandler = new Handler(looper != null ? looper : Looper.getMainLooper());
    }

    public static Toast makeText(Context context, CharSequence text, int duration)
    {
        Toast toast = new Toast(context);
        toast.mText = text;
        toast.mDuration = duration;
        return toast;
    }

    public static Toast makeText(Context context, int resId, int duration)
    {
        return makeText(context, context.getResources().getText(resId), duration);
    }

    public void show()
    {
        if (mText == null && mView == null) throw new RuntimeException("setText must have been called");

        Log.i(TAG, mText != null ? mText.toString() : "(custom view " + mView.getClass().getName() + ")");

        mShowing = true;
        for (Callback callback : new ArrayList<>(mCallbacks)) callback.onToastShown();

        mHandler.removeCallbacks(mHide);
        mHandler.postDelayed(mHide, mDuration == LENGTH_LONG ? LONG_DURATION_MILLISECONDS : SHORT_DURATION_MILLISECONDS);
    }

    public void cancel()
    {
        mHandler.removeCallbacks(mHide);
        hide();
    }

    private void hide()
    {
        if (!mShowing) return;

        mShowing = false;
        for (Callback callback : new ArrayList<>(mCallbacks)) callback.onToastHidden();
    }

    @Deprecated
    public void setView(View view)
    {
        mView = view;
    }

    @Deprecated
    public View getView()
    {
        return mView;
    }

    public void setDuration(int duration)
    {
        mDuration = duration;
    }

    public int getDuration()
    {
        return mDuration;
    }

    public void setMargin(float horizontalMargin, float verticalMargin)
    {
        mHorizontalMargin = horizontalMargin;
        mVerticalMargin = verticalMargin;
    }

    public float getHorizontalMargin()
    {
        return mHorizontalMargin;
    }

    public float getVerticalMargin()
    {
        return mVerticalMargin;
    }

    public void setGravity(int gravity, int xOffset, int yOffset)
    {
        mGravity = gravity;
        mXOffset = xOffset;
        mYOffset = yOffset;
    }

    public int getGravity()
    {
        return mGravity;
    }

    public int getXOffset()
    {
        return mXOffset;
    }

    public int getYOffset()
    {
        return mYOffset;
    }

    public void addCallback(Callback callback)
    {
        if (callback != null) mCallbacks.add(callback);
    }

    public void removeCallback(Callback callback)
    {
        mCallbacks.remove(callback);
    }

    public void setText(int resId)
    {
        setText(mContext.getResources().getText(resId));
    }

    public void setText(CharSequence text)
    {
        mText = text;
    }
}
```

`java/android/widget/ToggleButton.java`:

```java
package android.widget;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.TypedArray;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.StyleableSet;

public class ToggleButton extends CompoundButton
{
    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;

    private CharSequence mTextOn = "ON";
    private CharSequence mTextOff = "OFF";
    private float mDisabledAlpha = 0.5f;
    private final Paint mIndicatorPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final int mAccentColor;
    private final float mDensity;

    public ToggleButton(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        mDensity = context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        mAccentColor = ProgressBar.resolveThemeColor(context, 0xFF009688, "colorControlActivated", "colorAccent");

        setClickable(true);
        setFocusable(true);

        StyleableSet styleable = styleable(context);
        if (!styleable.isEmpty() && (attributes != null || defStyleAttr != 0 || defStyleRes != 0))
        {
            TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, styleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

            int index = styleable.indexOf("textOn");
            if (index >= 0)
            {
                CharSequence text = array.getText(index);
                if (text != null) mTextOn = text;
            }

            index = styleable.indexOf("textOff");
            if (index >= 0)
            {
                CharSequence text = array.getText(index);
                if (text != null) mTextOff = text;
            }

            index = styleable.indexOf("disabledAlpha");
            if (index >= 0) mDisabledAlpha = array.getFloat(index, mDisabledAlpha);

            array.recycle();
        }

        syncTextState();
    }

    public ToggleButton(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public ToggleButton(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, ProgressBar.attributeIdentifier(context, "buttonStyleToggle"));
    }

    public ToggleButton(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    private static StyleableSet styleable(Context context)
    {
        if (sStyleable == null) sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "textOn", "textOff", "disabledAlpha");
        return sStyleable;
    }

    @Override
    public void setChecked(boolean checked)
    {
        super.setChecked(checked);

        syncTextState();
        refreshDrawableState();
    }

    private void syncTextState()
    {
        boolean checked = isChecked();

        if (checked && mTextOn != null) setText(mTextOn);
        else if (!checked && mTextOff != null) setText(mTextOff);
    }

    public CharSequence getTextOn()
    {
        return mTextOn;
    }

    public void setTextOn(CharSequence textOn)
    {
        mTextOn = textOn;
        syncTextState();
    }

    public CharSequence getTextOff()
    {
        return mTextOff;
    }

    public void setTextOff(CharSequence textOff)
    {
        mTextOff = textOff;
        syncTextState();
    }

    public float getDisabledAlpha()
    {
        return mDisabledAlpha;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onFinishInflate()
    {
        super.onFinishInflate();

        syncTextState();
    }

    @Override
    public void setBackgroundDrawable(Drawable drawable)
    {
        super.setBackgroundDrawable(drawable);
    }

    @Override
    protected void drawableStateChanged()
    {
        super.drawableStateChanged();

        invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        super.onDraw(canvas);

        if (getBackground() != null) return;

        float inset = 8 * mDensity;
        float thickness = 2 * mDensity;
        float bottom = getHeight() - getPaddingBottom() * 0.5f;

        int colour = isChecked() ? mAccentColor : 0x42000000;
        if (!isEnabled()) colour = (colour & 0x00FFFFFF) | ((int)(((colour >>> 24) & 0xFF) * mDisabledAlpha) << 24);

        mIndicatorPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
        mIndicatorPaint.setColor(colour);
        canvas.drawRect(inset, bottom - thickness, getWidth() - inset, bottom, mIndicatorPaint);
    }

    public CharSequence getAccessibilityClassName()
    {
        return ToggleButton.class.getName();
    }
}
```

```java
package android.widget;

import android.app.ActionBar;

import android.view.RuntimeMenu;

import android.view.ViewGroup;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class Toolbar extends ViewGroup
{
    public interface OnMenuItemClickListener
    {
        boolean onMenuItemClick(MenuItem item);
    }

    private static StyleableSet sStyleable;
    private static StyleableSet sAppearanceStyleable;

    private ImageButton mNavButtonView;
    private ImageView mLogoView;
    private TextView mTitleTextView;
    private TextView mSubtitleTextView;
    private LinearLayout mMenuView;
    private ImageButton mOverflowButton;
    private RuntimeMenu mMenu;
    private AlertDialog mOverflowDialog;

    private Drawable mNavigationIcon;
    private CharSequence mNavigationContentDescription;
    private Drawable mCollapseIcon;
    private CharSequence mCollapseContentDescription;
    private Drawable mLogo;
    private CharSequence mLogoDescription;
    private Drawable mOverflowIcon;

    private CharSequence mTitleText;
    private CharSequence mSubtitleText;
    private int mTitleTextColor;
    private int mSubtitleTextColor;
    private boolean mTitleColorSet;
    private boolean mSubtitleColorSet;
    private int mTitleTextAppearance;
    private int mSubtitleTextAppearance;

    private int mPopupTheme;
    private int mGravity = Gravity.START | Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL;
    private int mMaxButtonHeight;
    private int mBarHeight;

    private int mTitleMarginStart;
    private int mTitleMarginEnd;
    private int mTitleMarginTop;
    private int mTitleMarginBottom;

    private int mContentInsetStart;
    private int mContentInsetEnd;
    private int mContentInsetLeft = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    private int mContentInsetRight = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    private boolean mExplicitInsetsAbsolute;
    private int mContentInsetStartWithNavigation;
    private int mContentInsetEndWithActions;

    private OnMenuItemClickListener mOnMenuItemClickListener;
    private final List<Object> mMenuSignature = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<MenuItem> mOverflowItems = new ArrayList<>();
    private final float mDensity;

    public Toolbar(Context context)
    {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public Toolbar(Context context, AttributeSet attributes)
    {
        this(context, attributes, ProgressBar.attributeIdentifier(context, "toolbarStyle"));
    }

    public Toolbar(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr)
    {
        this(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, 0);
    }

    public Toolbar(Context context, AttributeSet attributes, int defStyleAttr, int defStyleRes)
    {
        super(context, attributes, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);

        mDensity = context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        mContentInsetStart = dp(16);
        mContentInsetStartWithNavigation = dp(72);
        mTitleMarginStart = dp(4);
        mTitleMarginEnd = dp(4);
        mBarHeight = resolveThemeDimension(context, "actionBarSize", dp(56));
        mTitleTextColor = ProgressBar.resolveThemeColor(context, 0xDE000000, "textColorPrimary");
        mSubtitleTextColor = ProgressBar.resolveThemeColor(context, 0x8A000000, "textColorSecondary");

        StyleableSet styleable = styleable(context);
        if (styleable.isEmpty() || (attributes == null && defStyleAttr == 0 && defStyleRes == 0)) return;

        TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributes, styleable.attributes(), defStyleAttr, defStyleRes);
        readAttributes(context, array, styleable);
        array.recycle();
    }

    private static StyleableSet styleable(Context context)
    {
        if (sStyleable == null)
        {
            sStyleable = StyleableSet.of(context.getResources(), "title", "subtitle", "titleTextAppearance", "subtitleTextAppearance",
                                         "titleTextColor", "subtitleTextColor", "navigationIcon", "navigationContentDescription", "logo",
                                         "logoDescription", "contentInsetStart", "contentInsetEnd", "contentInsetLeft", "contentInsetRight",
                                         "contentInsetStartWithNavigation", "contentInsetEndWithActions", "titleMargin", "titleMarginStart",
                                         "titleMarginEnd", "titleMarginTop", "titleMarginBottom", "maxButtonHeight", "popupTheme",
                                         "gravity", "collapseIcon", "collapseContentDescription", "minHeight");
        }
        return sStyleable;
    }

    private void readAttributes(Context context, TypedArray array, StyleableSet styleable)
    {
        int index = styleable.indexOf("titleTextAppearance");
        if (index >= 0) mTitleTextAppearance = array.getResourceId(index, 0);

        index = styleable.indexOf("subtitleTextAppearance");
        if (index >= 0) mSubtitleTextAppearance = array.getResourceId(index, 0);

        index = styleable.indexOf("gravity");
        if (index >= 0) mGravity = array.getInt(index, mGravity);

        index = styleable.indexOf("titleMargin");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index))
        {
            int margin = array.getDimensionPixelOffset(index, 0);
            mTitleMarginStart = margin;
            mTitleMarginEnd = margin;
            mTitleMarginTop = margin;
            mTitleMarginBottom = margin;
        }

        mTitleMarginStart = readOffset(array, styleable, "titleMarginStart", mTitleMarginStart);
        mTitleMarginEnd = readOffset(array, styleable, "titleMarginEnd", mTitleMarginEnd);
        mTitleMarginTop = readOffset(array, styleable, "titleMarginTop", mTitleMarginTop);
        mTitleMarginBottom = readOffset(array, styleable, "titleMarginBottom", mTitleMarginBottom);

        index = styleable.indexOf("maxButtonHeight");
        if (index >= 0) mMaxButtonHeight = array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, 0);

        mContentInsetStart = readOffset(array, styleable, "contentInsetStart", mContentInsetStart);
        mContentInsetEnd = readOffset(array, styleable, "contentInsetEnd", mContentInsetEnd);
        mContentInsetStartWithNavigation =
            readOffset(array, styleable, "contentInsetStartWithNavigation", mContentInsetStartWithNavigation);
        mContentInsetEndWithActions = readOffset(array, styleable, "contentInsetEndWithActions", mContentInsetEndWithActions);

        index = styleable.indexOf("contentInsetLeft");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index))
        {
            mContentInsetLeft = array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, 0);
            mExplicitInsetsAbsolute = true;
        }

        index = styleable.indexOf("contentInsetRight");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index))
        {
            mContentInsetRight = array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, 0);
            mExplicitInsetsAbsolute = true;
        }

        index = styleable.indexOf("minHeight");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index))
        {
            int minimum = array.getDimensionPixelSize(index, 0);
            if (minimum > 0) setMinimumHeight(minimum);
        }

        index = styleable.indexOf("collapseIcon");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) mCollapseIcon = loadDrawable(array, index);

        index = styleable.indexOf("collapseContentDescription");
        if (index >= 0) mCollapseContentDescription = array.getText(index);

        index = styleable.indexOf("popupTheme");
        if (index >= 0) mPopupTheme = array.getResourceId(index, 0);

        index = styleable.indexOf("titleTextColor");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) setTitleTextColor(array.getColor(index, mTitleTextColor));

        index = styleable.indexOf("subtitleTextColor");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index)) setSubtitleTextColor(array.getColor(index, mSubtitleTextColor));

        index = styleable.indexOf("title");
        if (index >= 0)
        {
            CharSequence title = array.getText(index);
            if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(title)) setTitle(title);
        }

        index = styleable.indexOf("subtitle");
        if (index >= 0)
        {
            CharSequence subtitle = array.getText(index);
            if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(subtitle)) setSubtitle(subtitle);
        }

        index = styleable.indexOf("navigationIcon");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index))
        {
            Drawable icon = loadDrawable(array, index);
            if (icon != null) setNavigationIcon(icon);
        }

        index = styleable.indexOf("navigationContentDescription");
        if (index >= 0)
        {
            CharSequence description = array.getText(index);
            if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(description)) setNavigationContentDescription(description);
        }

        index = styleable.indexOf("logo");
        if (index >= 0 && array.hasValue(index))
        {
            Drawable logo = loadDrawable(array, index);
            if (logo != null) setLogo(logo);
        }

        index = styleable.indexOf("logoDescription");
        if (index >= 0)
        {
            CharSequence description = array.getText(index);
            if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(description)) setLogoDescription(description);
        }
    }

    private static int readOffset(TypedArray array, StyleableSet styleable, String name, int fallback)
    {
        int index = styleable.indexOf(name);
        if (index < 0 || !array.hasValue(index)) return fallback;

        return array.getDimensionPixelOffset(index, fallback);
    }

    private static Drawable loadDrawable(TypedArray array, int index)
    {
        try
        {
            return array.getDrawable(index);
        }
        catch (Throwable unsupported)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static int resolveThemeDimension(Context context, String name, int fallback)
    {
        int identifier = ProgressBar.attributeIdentifier(context, name);
        if (identifier == 0) return fallback;

        try
        {
            TypedArray array = context.obtainStyledAttributes(new int[] {identifier});
            int value = array.getDimensionPixelSize(0, fallback);
            array.recycle();

            return value > 0 ? value : fallback;
        }
        catch (RuntimeException unresolved)
        {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    private int dp(int value)
    {
        return (int)(value * mDensity + 0.5f);
    }

    private Drawable resolveDrawable(int resourceId)
    {
        if (resourceId == 0) return null;

        try
        {
            return getContext().getResources().getDrawable(resourceId);
        }
        catch (Throwable missing)
        {
            android.util.Log.w("Toolbar", "drawable 0x" + Integer.toHexString(resourceId) + " did not load", missing);
            return null;
        }
    }

    private CharSequence resolveText(int resourceId)
    {
        return resourceId == 0 ? null : getContext().getText(resourceId);
    }

    protected void onAttachedToWindow()

    }
```
