`java/runtime/Activities.java`:

```java
package runtime;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AppComponentFactory;
import android.app.Application;
import android.app.Instrumentation;
import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.util.Log;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewRootImpl;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class Activities
{
    private static final String TAG = "Activities";

    public static final int RESULT_CANCELED = 0;
    public static final int RESULT_OK = -1;

    public static final int LAUNCH_MULTIPLE = 0;
    public static final int LAUNCH_SINGLE_TOP = 1;
    public static final int LAUNCH_SINGLE_TASK = 2;
    public static final int LAUNCH_SINGLE_INSTANCE = 3;

    private static final class Entry
    {
        Activity activity;
        String className;
        Intent intent;
        android.os.Bundle savedState;
        int taskId = 1;
        int launchMode = LAUNCH_MULTIPLE;
        int requestCode = -1;
        int resultCode = RESULT_CANCELED;
        Intent resultData;
        boolean finishing;
        boolean noHistory;
    }

    private static int sNextTaskId = 1;

    private static final List<Entry> sStack = new ArrayList<>();

    private static Context sBaseContext;
    private static Application sApplication;
    private static AppComponentFactory sFactory;
    private static ClassLoader sLoader;
    private static Instrumentation sInstrumentation;
    private static ViewRootImpl sViewRoot;
    private static String sPackageName;
    private static String sDataDir;

    private Activities()
    {
    }

    public static void attachRuntime(Context base, Application application, AppComponentFactory factory, ClassLoader loader,
                                     Instrumentation instrumentation, String packageName)
    {
        sBaseContext = base;
        sApplication = application;
        sFactory = factory;
        sLoader = loader;
        sInstrumentation = instrumentation;
        sPackageName = packageName;
    }

    public static void attachDataDir(String dataDir)
    {
        sDataDir = dataDir;
    }

    public static android.os.Bundle restoreInstanceState(String className)
    {
        if (sDataDir == null || className == null) return null;

        java.io.File source = SavedState.fileFor(sDataDir, className);
        android.os.Bundle state = SavedState.read(source);

        if (state == null) return null;

        source.delete();
        Log.i(TAG, className + " comes back with the state it left behind: " + state.size() + " value(s)");

        return state;
    }

    public static void discardInstanceState(String className)
    {
        if (sDataDir == null || className == null) return;

        SavedState.fileFor(sDataDir, className).delete();
    }

    public static void attachViewRoot(ViewRootImpl root)
    {
        sViewRoot = root;
        showTop();
    }

    public static void adoptLaunchedActivity(Activity activity)
    {
        Entry entry = new Entry();
        entry.activity = activity;
        entry.className = activity.getClass().getName();
        entry.intent = activity.getIntent();
        entry.launchMode = Bootstrap.nativeActivityLaunchMode(entry.className);
        entry.taskId = sNextTaskId;
        sStack.add(entry);
    }

    public static Activity current()
    {
        return sStack.isEmpty() ? null : sStack.get(sStack.size() - 1).activity;
    }

    public static int depth()
    {
        return sStack.size();
    }

    private static String targetPackage(Intent intent)
    {
        if (intent == null || sPackageName == null) return null;

        String named = intent.getPackage();

        if (named == null && intent.getComponent() != null) named = intent.getComponent().getPackageName();
        if (named == null || named.isEmpty() || named.equals(sPackageName)) return null;

        return named;
    }

    public static void start(final Intent intent, final int requestCode)
    {
        if (sBaseContext == null)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "startActivity before the runtime was attached: " + intent);
            return;
        }

        android.os.Looper main = android.os.Looper.getMainLooper();
        if (main == null)
        {
            startNow(intent, requestCode);
            return;
        }

        final Intent copied = new Intent(intent);
        new android.os.Handler(main).post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                startNow(copied, requestCode);
            }
        });
    }

    private static void startNow(final Intent intent, final int requestCode)
    {
        String otherPackage = targetPackage(intent);

        if (otherPackage != null)
        {
            if (Packages.launch(otherPackage))
            {
                Log.i(TAG, "asked the shell to start " + otherPackage + ", which runs in its own process");
                return;
            }

            Log.w(TAG, "nothing here can start " + otherPackage + "; it is not installed, or this player has no shell");
            return;
        }

        Components.Record record = Components.resolve(Components.ACTIVITY, intent);
        if (record == null)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "no activity answers " + intent + ", so nothing was started");
            return;
        }

        Intent launch = new Intent(intent);
        launch.setComponent(new ComponentName(sPackageName, record.className));

        final int flags = launch.getFlags();
        final int launchMode = Bootstrap.nativeActivityLaunchMode(record.className);

        if (reusedExisting(record.className, launch, flags, launchMode)) return;

        Entry caller = sStack.isEmpty() ? null : sStack.get(sStack.size() - 1);

        Activity started;
        try
        {
            started = sFactory.instantiateActivity(sLoader, record.className, launch);
            started.attach(sBaseContext, sApplication);
            started.setIntent(launch);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "could not instantiate activity " + record.className, cause);
            return;
        }

        if (caller != null)
        {
            caller.requestCode = requestCode;
            pause(caller);

            if (caller.noHistory)
            {
                Log.i(TAG, caller.className + " asked not to be kept, so it leaves the stack as soon as it is left");
                sStack.remove(caller);
                stop(caller);
                destroy(caller);
                caller = null;
            }
        }

        Entry entry = new Entry();
        entry.activity = started;
        entry.className = record.className;
        entry.intent = launch;
        entry.launchMode = launchMode;
        entry.noHistory = (flags & Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NO_HISTORY) != 0;

        final boolean newTask = (flags & Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK) != 0 || launchMode == LAUNCH_SINGLE_TASK
                                || launchMode == LAUNCH_SINGLE_INSTANCE;

        if (newTask || caller == null)
        {
            sNextTaskId += 1;
            entry.taskId = sNextTaskId;
        }
        else
        {
            entry.taskId = caller.taskId;
        }

        sStack.add(entry);

        Log.i(TAG, "started " + record.className + " in task " + entry.taskId + ", stack is now " + sStack.size() + " deep");

        android.os.Bundle restored = restoreInstanceState(record.className);
        entry.savedState = restored;

        try
        {
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnCreate(started, restored);
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnPostCreate(started, restored);
            if (restored != null) sInstrumentation.callActivityOnRestoreInstanceState(started, restored);
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnStart(started);
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnResume(started);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "the activity did not start, so the one that launched it stays on screen", cause);

            entry.finishing = true;
            sStack.remove(entry);
            destroy(entry);

            if (caller != null)
            {
                try
                {
                    sInstrumentation.callActivityOnResume(caller.activity);
                }
                catch (Throwable resumeFailed)
                {
                    Log.e(TAG, "the activity underneath did not come back", resumeFailed);
                }
            }

            showTop();
            return;
        }

        if (caller != null) stop(caller);

        showTop();
    }

    private static boolean reusedExisting(String className, Intent launch, int flags, int launchMode)
    {
        final boolean singleTop = launchMode == LAUNCH_SINGLE_TOP || (flags & Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP) != 0;
        final boolean clearTop = (flags & Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP) != 0;
        final boolean singleTask = launchMode == LAUNCH_SINGLE_TASK || launchMode == LAUNCH_SINGLE_INSTANCE;

        if (!singleTop && !clearTop && !singleTask) return false;

        Entry top = sStack.isEmpty() ? null : sStack.get(sStack.size() - 1);

        if (singleTop && top != null && className.equals(top.className))
        {
            Log.i(TAG, className + " is already on top, so it is given the intent rather than a second instance");
            deliverNewIntent(top, launch);
            return true;
        }

        if (!clearTop && !singleTask) return false;

        int found = -1;
        for (int index = sStack.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            if (!className.equals(sStack.get(index).className)) continue;

            found = index;
            break;
        }

        if (found < 0) return false;

        while (sStack.size() - 1 > found)
        {
            Entry above = sStack.remove(sStack.size() - 1);
            Log.i(TAG, "clearing " + above.className + " from above " + className);
            pause(above);
            stop(above);
            destroy(above);
        }

        Entry entry = sStack.get(found);
        deliverNewIntent(entry, launch);
        showTop();

        return true;
    }

    private static void deliverNewIntent(Entry entry, Intent launch)
    {
        entry.intent = launch;

        try
        {
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnNewIntent(entry.activity, launch);
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnResume(entry.activity);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "the activity did not take the new intent", cause);
        }
    }

    public static int taskIdOf(Activity activity)
    {
        Entry entry = entryFor(activity);
        return entry != null ? entry.taskId : -1;
    }

    public static boolean moveTaskToBack(Activity activity, boolean nonRoot)
    {
        Entry entry = entryFor(activity);
        if (entry == null) return false;

        int lowest = -1;
        for (int index = 0; index < sStack.size(); index++)
        {
            if (sStack.get(index).taskId != entry.taskId) continue;

            lowest = index;
            break;
        }

        if (lowest < 0) return false;
        if (!nonRoot && sStack.get(lowest) != entry) return false;

        List<Entry> moved = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int index = sStack.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            if (sStack.get(index).taskId != entry.taskId) continue;

            moved.add(0, sStack.remove(index));
        }

        if (moved.isEmpty()) return false;
        if (sStack.isEmpty())
        {
            sStack.addAll(moved);
            Log.i(TAG, "task " + entry.taskId + " is the only one, so it stays in front");
            return false;
        }

        pause(entry);
        stop(entry);
        sStack.addAll(0, moved);

        Entry top = sStack.get(sStack.size() - 1);
        try
        {
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnStart(top.activity);
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnResume(top.activity);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "the activity brought forward did not resume", cause);
        }

        Log.i(TAG, "task " + entry.taskId + " went to the back, so " + top.className + " is in front");
        showTop();

        return true;
    }

    public static void recreate(Activity activity)
    {
        Entry entry = entryFor(activity);
        if (entry == null || entry.className == null) return;

        android.os.Bundle state = new android.os.Bundle();
        sInstrumentation.callActivityOnSaveInstanceState(activity, state);

        Object retained = null;
        try
        {
            retained = activity.onRetainNonConfigurationInstance();
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "the activity threw while retaining its non-configuration instance", cause);
        }

        activity.setChangingConfigurations(true);
        pause(entry);
        stop(entry);
        destroy(entry);

        Activity replacement;
        try
        {
            replacement = sFactory.instantiateActivity(sLoader, entry.className, entry.intent);
            replacement.attach(sBaseContext, sApplication);
            replacement.setIntent(entry.intent);
            replacement.setLastNonConfigurationInstance(retained);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "could not build a replacement for " + entry.className, cause);
            sStack.remove(entry);
            return;
        }

        entry.activity = replacement;
        entry.savedState = state;

        Log.i(TAG, "recreated " + entry.className + " with " + state.size() + " saved value(s)");

        try
        {
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnCreate(replacement, state);
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnRestoreInstanceState(replacement, state);
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnPostCreate(replacement, state);
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnStart(replacement);
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnResume(replacement);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "the recreated activity did not start", cause);
        }

        showTop();
    }

    public static void recreateAll()
    {
        List<Entry> snapshot = new ArrayList<>(sStack);

        for (Entry entry : snapshot)
        {
            if (entry.activity == null) continue;

            recreate(entry.activity);
        }
    }

    public static List<String> classNames()
    {
        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Entry entry : sStack)
        {
            if (entry.className != null) names.add(entry.className);
        }

        return names;
    }

    public static void deliverConfigurationChange(android.content.res.Configuration configuration, int changed)
    {
        List<Entry> snapshot = new ArrayList<>(sStack);

        for (Entry entry : snapshot)
        {
            if (entry.activity == null || entry.className == null) continue;

            int declared = Bootstrap.nativeActivityConfigChanges(entry.className);

            if ((declared & changed) == changed)
            {
                try
                {
                    entry.activity.onConfigurationChanged(configuration);
                }
                catch (Throwable cause)
                {
                    Log.e(TAG, entry.className + " threw while handling the configuration change", cause);
                }

                continue;
            }

            recreate(entry.activity);
        }
    }

    public static void setResult(Activity activity, int resultCode, Intent data)
    {
        Entry entry = entryFor(activity);
        if (entry == null) return;

        entry.resultCode = resultCode;
        entry.resultData = data;
    }

    public static boolean isFinishing(Activity activity)
    {
        Entry entry = entryFor(activity);
        return entry != null && entry.finishing;
    }

    public static void finish(final Activity activity)
    {
        final Entry pending = entryFor(activity);
        if (pending == null || pending.finishing) return;

        pending.finishing = true;

        android.os.Looper main = android.os.Looper.getMainLooper();
        if (main == null)
        {
            finishNow(activity);
            return;
        }

        new android.os.Handler(main).post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                finishNow(activity);
            }
        });
    }

    private static void finishNow(Activity activity)
    {
        Entry entry = entryFor(activity);
        if (entry == null) return;

        entry.finishing = true;
        discardInstanceState(entry.className);

        if (sStack.size() <= 1)
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "the last activity finished, so the main loop will end");
            android.os.Looper.quitMainLooper();
            return;
        }

        if (entry != sStack.get(sStack.size() - 1))
        {
            sStack.remove(entry);
            destroy(entry);
            return;
        }

        sStack.remove(sStack.size() - 1);
        pause(entry);
        stop(entry);
        destroy(entry);

        Entry below = sStack.get(sStack.size() - 1);
        Log.i(TAG, "finished " + entry.activity.getClass().getName() + ", back to " + below.activity.getClass().getName());

        try
        {
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnStart(below.activity);

            if (below.requestCode >= 0)
            {
                below.activity.deliverActivityResult(below.requestCode, entry.resultCode, entry.resultData);
                below.requestCode = -1;
            }

            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnResume(below.activity);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "the activity underneath did not resume", cause);
        }

        showTop();
    }

    public static boolean back()
    {
        Activity top = current();
        if (top == null) return false;

        finish(top);
        return true;
    }

    private static void showTop()
    {
        Activity top = current();
        if (top == null || sViewRoot == null) return;
        if (top.getWindow() == null) return;

        View decor = top.getWindow().getDecorView();
        if (decor != null) sViewRoot.setContentRoot(decor);
    }

    public static void shutdown()
    {
        List<Entry> snapshot = new ArrayList<>(sStack);
        sStack.clear();

        for (int index = snapshot.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
        {
            Entry entry = snapshot.get(index);
            if (entry.activity == null || entry.activity.isDestroyed()) continue;

            pause(entry);
            stop(entry);
            destroy(entry);
        }
    }

    private static Entry entryFor(Activity activity)
    {
        for (Entry entry : sStack)
        {
            if (entry.activity == activity) return entry;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static void pause(Entry entry)
    {
        try
        {
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnPause(entry.activity);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "the activity did not pause", cause);
        }
    }

    private static void stop(Entry entry)
    {
        saveInstanceState(entry);

        try
        {
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnStop(entry.activity);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "the activity did not stop", cause);
        }
    }

    private static void saveInstanceState(Entry entry)
    {
        if (entry.activity == null || entry.finishing) return;
        if (entry.activity.isChangingConfigurations()) return;

        android.os.Bundle state = new android.os.Bundle();

        try
        {
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnSaveInstanceState(entry.activity, state);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "the activity threw while saving its state", cause);
            return;
        }

        entry.savedState = state;

        if (sDataDir == null || entry.className == null) return;

        if (SavedState.write(SavedState.fileFor(sDataDir, entry.className), state))
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "the state of " + entry.className + " is on disk, so it survives the process");
        }
    }

    private static void destroy(Entry entry)
    {
        try
        {
            sInstrumentation.callActivityOnDestroy(entry.activity);
            entry.activity.setDestroyed();
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "the activity did not shut down cleanly", cause);
        }
    }
}

```

`java/runtime/Bootstrap.java`:

```java
package runtime;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AppComponentFactory;
import android.app.Application;
import android.app.ContextImpl;
import android.app.Instrumentation;
import android.content.ContentProvider;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.content.pm.ProviderInfo;
import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.util.Log;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewRootImpl;

public final class Bootstrap
{
    private static final String TAG = "Bootstrap";

    public static final int OK = 0;
    public static final int FACTORY_FAILED = 1;
    public static final int APPLICATION_FAILED = 2;
    public static final int PROVIDER_FAILED = 3;
    public static final int ON_CREATE_FAILED = 4;
    public static final int WINDOW_FAILED = 5;
    public static final int ACTIVITY_FAILED = 6;
    public static final int NO_FRAMES = 7;

    private static Application sApplication;
    private static Activity sActivity;

    private Bootstrap()
    {
    }

    public static Application getApplication()
    {
        return sApplication;
    }

    public static int start(String dataDir, String nativeLibraryDir)
    {
        ClassLoader loader = Bootstrap.class.getClassLoader();

        TextMeasurers.install(new NativeTextMeasurer());

        if (Looper.getMainLooper() == null) Looper.prepareMainLooper();

        SurfaceBridge.prepareLooper();

        ApplicationInfo info = new ApplicationInfo();
        info.packageName = nativePackageName();
        info.name = info.packageName;
        info.className = nativeApplicationClassName();
        info.appComponentFactory = nativeAppComponentFactory();
        info.sourceDir = nativeSourceDir();
        info.publicSourceDir = info.sourceDir;
        info.uid = android.os.Process.myUid();
        info.processName = info.packageName;

        int splitCount = Math.max(nativeSplitCount(), 0);
        if (splitCount > 0)
        {
            info.splitNames = new String[splitCount];
            info.splitSourceDirs = new String[splitCount];

            for (int index = 0; index < splitCount; index++)
            {
                info.splitNames[index] = nativeSplitName(index);
                info.splitSourceDirs[index] = nativeSplitPath(index);
            }

            info.splitPublicSourceDirs = info.splitSourceDirs;
            Log.i(TAG, "the package is installed as a base plus " + splitCount + " split(s)");
        }

        info.dataDir = dataDir;
        info.nativeLibraryDir = nativeLibraryDir;
        info.nativeLibraryRootDir = nativeLibraryDir == null ? null : new java.io.File(nativeLibraryDir).getParent();
        info.nativeLibraryRootRequiresIsa = true;
        info.primaryCpuAbi = "arm64-v8a";
        info.credentialProtectedDataDir = dataDir;
        info.scanSourceDir = info.sourceDir;
        info.scanPublicSourceDir = info.publicSourceDir;
        info.seInfo = "default:targetSdkVersion=" + nativeTargetSdkVersion();
        info.minSdkVersion = nativeMinSdkVersion();
        info.targetSdkVersion = nativeTargetSdkVersion();
        if (nativeDebuggable()) info.flags |= ApplicationInfo.FLAG_DEBUGGABLE;
        if (nativeExtractNativeLibs()) info.flags |= ApplicationInfo.FLAG_EXTRACT_NATIVE_LIBS;

        java.io.File dataRoot = new java.io.File(dataDir);

        String externalStorage = nativeExternalStorageDir();
        java.io.File externalRoot =
                externalStorage != null && !externalStorage.isEmpty() ? new java.io.File(externalStorage)
                                                                      : new java.io.File(dataRoot, "external");

        android.os.Environment.setDirectories(dataRoot.getParentFile(), dataRoot, externalRoot);

        Log.i(TAG, "storage: data=" + dataRoot + " external=" + externalRoot);

        Permissions.initialize(dataDir);

        android.security.keystore.AndroidKeyStoreProvider.install(dataRoot);

        PackageManager packageManager = new PackageManager(info);
        Resources resources = new Resources(nativeAssetsHandle());
        info.metaData = MetaData.read(resources, MetaData.APPLICATION, 0);
        if (info.metaData != null) Log.i(TAG, "application meta-data: " + info.metaData.size() + " entries");

        AppComponentFactory factory;
        try
        {
            factory = createFactory(loader, info.appComponentFactory);
            Log.i(TAG, "factory: " + factory.getClass().getName());
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "could not instantiate AppComponentFactory " + info.appComponentFactory, cause);
            return FACTORY_FAILED;
        }

        try
        {
            ClassLoader chosen = factory.instantiateClassLoader(loader, info);
            if (chosen != null && chosen != loader)
            {
                Log.i(TAG, "the component factory supplied the class loader " + chosen.getClass().getName());
                loader = chosen;
            }
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "the component factory could not supply a class loader, so the default one is kept", cause);
        }

        Thread.currentThread().setContextClassLoader(loader);

        ContextImpl base = new ContextImpl(info, packageManager, resources, loader, dataDir);
        android.app.ActivityThread.attachRuntime(base);

        Application application;
        try
        {
            application = factory.instantiateApplication(loader, info.className);
            application.attach(base);
            base.setApplicationContext(application);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "could not instantiate Application " + info.className, cause);
            return APPLICATION_FAILED;
        }

        sApplication = application;

        describeComponents();

        Services.attachRuntime(base, application, factory, loader, base.getPackageName());
        Broadcasts.attachRuntime(base, factory, loader, base.getPackageName());
        Jobs.attachRuntime(base, application, factory, loader);

        int providerCount = nativeProviderCount();
        ProviderInfo[] providers = new ProviderInfo[providerCount];
        for (int index = 0; index < providerCount; index++)
        {
            providers[index] = readProviderInfo(info, resources, index);
            packageManager.addProvider(providers[index]);
        }

        for (ProviderInfo provider : providers)
        {
            int setting = packageManager.getComponentEnabledSetting(new android.content.ComponentName(provider.packageName, provider.name));
            boolean enabled = setting == PackageManager.COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE_ENABLED ||
                              (setting == PackageManager.COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE_DEFAULT && provider.enabled);

            if (!enabled)
            {
                Log.i(TAG, "provider skipped, it is disabled: " + provider.name);
                continue;
            }

            if (!runsInThisProcess(info, provider))
            {
                Log.i(TAG, "provider skipped, it runs in process " + provider.processName + ": " + provider.name);
                continue;
            }

            try
            {
                ContentProvider instance = factory.instantiateProvider(loader, provider.name);
                instance.attachInfo(application, provider);
                Log.i(TAG, "provider ready: " + provider.name + " authority=" + provider.authority);
            }
            catch (Throwable cause)
            {
                Log.e(TAG, "provider failed: " + provider.name, cause);
                return PROVIDER_FAILED;
            }
        }

        StartupProbe.reportInitializers(application, providers);

        Instrumentation instrumentation = new Instrumentation();

        try
        {
            instrumentation.callApplicationOnCreate(application);
            Log.i(TAG, "Application.onCreate returned: " + info.className);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "Application.onCreate failed", cause);
            return ON_CREATE_FAILED;
        }

        return launchActivity(loader, factory, instrumentation, base, application);
    }

    private static int launchActivity(ClassLoader loader, AppComponentFactory factory, Instrumentation instrumentation, ContextImpl base,
                                      Application application)
    {
        String requested = Settings.get("activity");
        String className = requested != null ? requested : nativeLauncherActivity();

        if (className == null || className.isEmpty())
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "no launcher activity in the manifest; stopping after Application.onCreate");
            return OK;
        }

        if (requested != null) Log.i(TAG, "activity selected by --activity: " + className);

        if ("0".equals(Settings.get("launch-activity")))
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "activity launch disabled; stopping after Application.onCreate");
            return OK;
        }

        int width = Settings.integer("window-width", 1080);
        int height = Settings.integer("window-height", 2400);
        int frameLimit = Settings.integer("max-frames", 0);

        WindowBridge window = WindowBridge.open(width, height, application.getPackageName());
        if (window == null)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "no window: a compositor is required to start " + className);
            return WINDOW_FAILED;
        }

        int theme = nativeActivityTheme(className);
        int densityDpi = intProperty(android.view.WindowManagerImpl.DENSITY_SETTING, android.util.DisplayMetrics.DENSITY_DEFAULT);
        base.updateMetricsForWindow(width, height, densityDpi);
        Configurations.attach(base);

        Log.i(TAG, "display: " + width + "x" + height + " at " + densityDpi + " dpi, "
                   + base.getResources().getConfiguration().screenWidthDp + "x"
                   + base.getResources().getConfiguration().screenHeightDp + " dp, "
                   + WindowBridge.refreshRate() + " Hz");

        android.content.pm.ActivityInfo activityInfo = new android.content.pm.ActivityInfo();
        activityInfo.name = className;
        activityInfo.packageName = base.getPackageName();
        activityInfo.applicationInfo = base.getApplicationInfo();
        activityInfo.theme = theme;

        int activityCount = nativeComponentCount(MetaData.ACTIVITY);
        for (int index = 0; index < activityCount; index++)
        {
            if (!className.equals(nativeComponentClassName(MetaData.ACTIVITY, index))) continue;

            activityInfo.metaData = MetaData.read(base.getResources(), MetaData.ACTIVITY, index);
            break;
        }

        base.getPackageManager().addActivity(activityInfo);
        if (theme != 0)
        {
            base.setTheme(theme);
            Log.i(TAG, "activity theme: 0x" + Integer.toHexString(theme));
        }
        else
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "no android:theme on the manifest's application or activity");
        }

        Activity activity;
        try
        {
            Intent intent = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN);
            intent.setComponent(new android.content.ComponentName(base.getPackageName(), className));

            activity = factory.instantiateActivity(loader, className, intent);
            activity.attach(base, application);
            activity.setIntent(intent);
            sActivity = activity;
            Activities.attachRuntime(base, application, factory, loader, instrumentation, base.getPackageName());
            Activities.attachDataDir(base.getApplicationInfo().dataDir);
            Activities.adoptLaunchedActivity(activity);
            Log.i(TAG, "activity: " + activity.getClass().getName());
            Log.i(TAG, "activity dirs: files=" + activity.getFilesDir() + " cache=" + activity.getCacheDir() + " obb="
                           + activity.getObbDir() + " external=" + activity.getExternalFilesDir(null));
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "could not instantiate Activity " + className, cause);
            window.close();
            return ACTIVITY_FAILED;
        }

        android.os.Bundle restored = Activities.restoreInstanceState(className);

        try
        {
            instrumentation.callActivityOnCreate(activity, restored);
            instrumentation.callActivityOnPostCreate(activity, restored);
            if (restored != null) instrumentation.callActivityOnRestoreInstanceState(activity, restored);

            if (activity.isFinishing())
            {
                Log.i(TAG, activity.getClass().getName() + " finished while it was being created, so it is never shown");
            }
            else if (Activities.current() != activity)
            {
                Log.i(TAG, activity.getClass().getName() + " started " + Activities.current().getClass().getName()
                               + " while it was being created, so it stays behind it until that one finishes");
            }
            else
            {
                instrumentation.callActivityOnStart(activity);
                instrumentation.callActivityOnResume(activity);
                if (activity instanceof android.app.NativeActivity) ((android.app.NativeActivity)activity).attachWindow(width, height);
            }
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "Activity.onCreate failed", cause);
            window.close();
            return ACTIVITY_FAILED;
        }

        if (activity instanceof android.app.NativeActivity)
        {
            return runGuestPresentedLoop((android.app.NativeActivity)activity, instrumentation, window, base);
        }

        View decor = activity.getWindow().getDecorView();
        final ViewRootImpl root = new ViewRootImpl(decor, window, frameLimit);
        Activities.attachViewRoot(root);

        root.setSystemBarInsets(intProperty("RUNTIME_STATUS_BAR_HEIGHT", 0), intProperty("RUNTIME_NAVIGATION_BAR_HEIGHT", 0));

        final int windowDensityDpi = densityDpi;
        window.setResizeListener(new WindowBridge.ResizeListener()
        {
            @Override
            public void onWindowResized(int newWidth, int newHeight)
            {
                root.onWindowResized(newWidth, newHeight);
                Configurations.apply(newWidth, newHeight, windowDensityDpi);
            }
        });

        final Activity inputTarget = activity;
        sDescribedInputState = !Settings.tracing("input");

        if (Settings.tracing("input"))
        {
            String[] wanted = {"onTouchEvent", "dispatchTouchEvent", "dispatchGenericMotionEvent", "onGenericMotionEvent"};
            for (String name : wanted)
            {
                try
                {
                    java.lang.reflect.Method found = inputTarget.getClass().getMethod(name, android.view.MotionEvent.class);
                    Log.i(TAG, "input: " + name + " is declared by " + found.getDeclaringClass().getName());
                }
                catch (Throwable cause)
                {
                    Log.i(TAG, "input: " + name + " is not present: " + cause);
                }
            }

            for (Class<?> level = inputTarget.getClass(); level != null && !level.getName().startsWith("android.app.");
                 level = level.getSuperclass())
            {
                for (java.lang.reflect.Field field : level.getDeclaredFields())
                {
                    if (java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(field.getModifiers())) continue;

                    try
                    {
                        field.setAccessible(true);
                        Object value = field.get(inputTarget);
                        Log.i(TAG, "input: " + level.getSimpleName() + "." + field.getName() + " = " + value);
                    }
                    catch (Throwable ignored)
                    {
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        window.setInputSink(new WindowBridge.InputSink()
        {
            @Override
            public void onTouch(android.view.MotionEvent event)
            {
                try
                {
                    int action = event.getActionMasked();

                    if (action == android.view.MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_ENTER
                        || action == android.view.MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_MOVE
                        || action == android.view.MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_EXIT
                        || action == android.view.MotionEvent.ACTION_SCROLL)
                    {
                        Activity hoverTarget = Activities.current();
                        windowCallbackOf(hoverTarget != null ? hoverTarget : inputTarget).dispatchGenericMotionEvent(event);
                        return;
                    }

                    if (root.dispatchPanelTouch(event)) return;

                    Activity touchTarget = Activities.current();
                    if (touchTarget == null) touchTarget = inputTarget;

                    if (action == android.view.MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) describeInputState(touchTarget);
                    windowCallbackOf(touchTarget).dispatchTouchEvent(event);
                }
                catch (Throwable cause)
                {
                    Log.e(TAG, "the activity threw while handling a touch", cause);
                }
            }

            @Override
            public void onKey(android.view.KeyEvent event)
            {
                try
                {
                    Activity target = Activities.current();
                    if (target == null) target = inputTarget;

                    if (android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager.getInstance().dispatchKeyEvent(event)) return;
                    if (root.dispatchPanelKey(event)) return;
                    if (windowCallbackOf(target).dispatchKeyEvent(event)) return;

                    if (event.getKeyCode() != android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK) return;
                    if (event.getAction() != android.view.KeyEvent.ACTION_UP) return;

                    Log.i(TAG, "back was pressed, so " + target.getClass().getName() + " is asked to handle it");
                    target.onBackPressed();
                }
                catch (Throwable cause)
                {
                    Log.e(TAG, "the activity threw while handling a key", cause);
                }
            }
        });

        scheduleScriptedReconfigure();

        Log.i(TAG, "entering the main loop, frameLimit=" + frameLimit);

        final Activity focusTarget = activity;
        root.setFirstFrameCallback(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                try
                {
                    focusTarget.onWindowFocusChanged(true);
                }
                catch (Throwable cause)
                {
                    Log.e(TAG, "the activity did not accept window focus", cause);
                }
            }
        });

        root.start();
        if (Looper.getMainLooper() != null) Looper.loop();
        Log.i(TAG, "main loop finished after " + root.getFramesDrawn() + " frames");

        try
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "unwinding the activity stack");
            Activities.shutdown();
            Log.i(TAG, "the activity is destroyed");
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "the activity did not shut down cleanly", cause);
        }

        window.close();
        base.getResources().releaseThemes();
        return root.getFramesDrawn() > 0 ? OK : NO_FRAMES;
    }

    private static boolean sDescribedInputState = true;

    private static void scheduleScriptedReconfigure()
    {
        String script = Settings.get("reconfigure");
        if (script == null || script.isEmpty()) return;

        for (String entry : script.split(";"))
        {
            String trimmed = entry.trim();
            if (trimmed.isEmpty()) continue;

            int colon = trimmed.indexOf(':');
            int cross = trimmed.indexOf('x', colon + 1);
            int at = trimmed.indexOf('@', cross + 1);

            if (colon < 0 || cross < 0 || at < 0)
            {
                Log.w(TAG, "a scripted reconfigure could not be read: " + trimmed + " (want <millis>:<width>x<height>@<dpi>)");
                continue;
            }

            try
            {
                long delay = Long.parseLong(trimmed.substring(0, colon).trim());
                final int width = Integer.parseInt(trimmed.substring(colon + 1, cross).trim());
                final int height = Integer.parseInt(trimmed.substring(cross + 1, at).trim());
                final int densityDpi = Integer.parseInt(trimmed.substring(at + 1).trim());

                new android.os.Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed(new Runnable()
                {
                    @Override
                    public void run()
                    {
                        Log.i(TAG, "scripted reconfigure to " + width + "x" + height + " at " + densityDpi + " dpi");
                        Configurations.apply(width, height, densityDpi);
                    }
                }, delay);
            }
            catch (NumberFormatException ignored)
            {
                Log.w(TAG, "a scripted reconfigure could not be read: " + trimmed);
            }
        }
    }

    private static void describeInputState(Activity activity)
    {
        if (sDescribedInputState) return;
        sDescribedInputState = true;

        String[] wanted = {"mCurSurfaceHolder", "mDestroyed", "mNativeHandle", "mLastContentWidth", "mLastContentHeight",
                           "mSurfaceView"};

        for (Class<?> level = activity.getClass(); level != null && !level.getName().startsWith("android.app.");
             level = level.getSuperclass())
        {
            for (String name : wanted)
            {
                try
                {
                    java.lang.reflect.Field field = level.getDeclaredField(name);
                    field.setAccessible(true);
                    Log.i(TAG, "at touch: " + level.getSimpleName() + "." + name + " = " + field.get(activity));
                }
                catch (Throwable ignored)
                {
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static int runGuestPresentedLoop(android.app.NativeActivity activity, Instrumentation instrumentation, WindowBridge window,
                                             ContextImpl base)
    {
        long deadlineNanos = System.nanoTime() + intProperty("RUNTIME_GUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", 10) * 1000000000L;
        Log.i(TAG, "the guest owns presentation; the framework will not draw to this window");

        boolean finished = false;
        while (!window.isCloseRequested())
        {
            window.poll(16);

            if (activity.isFinishRequested())
            {
                finished = true;
                break;
            }

            if (System.nanoTime() > deadlineNanos)
            {
                Log.e(TAG, "the guest never finished presenting");
                break;
            }
        }

        Log.i(TAG, finished ? "the guest finished presenting" : "the window closed before the guest finished");

        try
        {
            activity.detachWindow();
            instrumentation.callActivityOnPause(activity);
            instrumentation.callActivityOnStop(activity);
            instrumentation.callActivityOnDestroy(activity);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "the native activity did not shut down cleanly", cause);
            window.close();
            base.getResources().releaseThemes();
            return ACTIVITY_FAILED;
        }

        window.close();
        base.getResources().releaseThemes();
        return finished ? OK : NO_FRAMES;
    }

    private static android.view.Window.Callback windowCallbackOf(Activity activity)
    {
        android.view.Window window = activity.getWindow();
        android.view.Window.Callback callback = window == null ? null : window.getCallback();

        return callback != null ? callback : activity;
    }

    private static int intProperty(String name, int fallback)
    {
        String value = Settings.get(name);
        if (value == null) return fallback;

        int parsed;
        try
        {
            parsed = Integer.parseInt(value.trim());
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " is not an integer: '" + value + "'", malformed);
        }

        if (parsed < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " must not be negative: '" + value + "'");
        return parsed;
    }

    private static AppComponentFactory createFactory(ClassLoader loader, String className) throws Exception
    {
        if (className == null || className.isEmpty()) return AppComponentFactory.DEFAULT;
        return (AppComponentFactory)loader.loadClass(className).getDeclaredConstructor().newInstance();
    }

    private static String processNameFor(ApplicationInfo applicationInfo, String declared)
    {
        String main = applicationInfo.processName != null ? applicationInfo.processName : applicationInfo.packageName;
        if (declared == null || declared.isEmpty()) return main;
        if (declared.startsWith(":")) return applicationInfo.packageName + declared;
        return declared;
    }

    private static boolean runsInThisProcess(ApplicationInfo applicationInfo, ProviderInfo provider)
    {
        String main = applicationInfo.processName != null ? applicationInfo.processName : applicationInfo.packageName;
        return provider.processName == null || provider.processName.equals(main);
    }

    private static ProviderInfo readProviderInfo(ApplicationInfo applicationInfo, Resources resources, int index)
    {
        ProviderInfo provider = new ProviderInfo();
        provider.applicationInfo = applicationInfo;
        provider.packageName = applicationInfo.packageName;
        provider.processName = processNameFor(applicationInfo, nativeProviderProcess(index));
        provider.enabled = nativeProviderEnabled(index);
        provider.name = nativeProviderClassName(index);
        provider.authority = nativeProviderAuthority(index);
        provider.directBootAware = nativeProviderDirectBootAware(index);
        provider.grantUriPermissions = nativeProviderGrantUriPermissions(index);

        provider.metaData = MetaData.read(resources, MetaData.PROVIDER, index);

        return provider;
    }

    private static native String nativePackageName();

    private static native String nativeApplicationClassName();

    private static native String nativeAppComponentFactory();

    private static void describeComponents()
    {
        int[] kinds = {Components.ACTIVITY, Components.SERVICE, Components.RECEIVER};

        for (int kind : kinds)
        {
            for (Components.Record record : Components.declared(kind))
            {
                StringBuilder described = new StringBuilder();
                for (android.content.IntentFilter filter : record.filters)
                {
                    for (int index = 0; index < filter.countActions(); index++)
                    {
                        described.append(described.length() == 0 ? " answers " : ", ").append(filter.getAction(index));
                    }
                }

                Log.i(TAG, "declared " + describeKind(kind) + " " + record.className + described);
            }
        }
    }

    private static String describeKind(int kind)
    {
        if (kind == Components.SERVICE) return "service";
        if (kind == Components.RECEIVER) return "receiver";

        return "activity";
    }

    static native int nativeComponentCount(int kind);

    static native int nativePermissionCount();

    static native String nativePermissionAt(int index);

    static native int nativeActivityLaunchMode(String className);

```

`java/runtime/Broadcasts.java`:

```java
package runtime;

import android.app.AppComponentFactory;
import android.content.BroadcastReceiver;
import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.IntentFilter;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.util.Log;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;

public final class Broadcasts
{
    private static final String TAG = "Broadcasts";

    private static final class Registration
    {
        BroadcastReceiver receiver;
        IntentFilter filter;
        Context context;
    }

    private static final class Delivery
    {
        BroadcastReceiver receiver;
        int priority;
        String describedBy;
    }

    private static final List<Registration> sRegistered = new ArrayList<>();

    private static Context sBaseContext;
    private static AppComponentFactory sFactory;
    private static ClassLoader sLoader;
    private static String sPackageName;
    private static Handler sHandler;

    private Broadcasts()
    {
    }

    public static void attachRuntime(Context base, AppComponentFactory factory, ClassLoader loader, String packageName)
    {
        sBaseContext = base;
        sFactory = factory;
        sLoader = loader;
        sPackageName = packageName;

        Looper main = Looper.getMainLooper();
        sHandler = main == null ? null : new Handler(main);
    }

    private static Intent stickyFor(IntentFilter filter)
    {
        if (filter.hasAction(Intent.ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED)) return android.os.BatteryManager.createBatteryChangedIntent();
        return null;
    }

    public static Intent register(Context context, BroadcastReceiver receiver, IntentFilter filter)
    {
        if (filter == null) return null;

        Intent sticky = stickyFor(filter);
        if (receiver == null) return sticky;

        Registration registration = new Registration();
        registration.receiver = receiver;
        registration.filter = filter;
        registration.context = context;

        synchronized (sRegistered)
        {
            sRegistered.add(registration);
        }

        return sticky;
    }

    public static void unregister(BroadcastReceiver receiver)
    {
        if (receiver == null) return;

        synchronized (sRegistered)
        {
            for (int index = sRegistered.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--)
            {
                if (sRegistered.get(index).receiver == receiver) sRegistered.remove(index);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void send(final Intent intent, final BroadcastReceiver resultReceiver, final boolean ordered)
    {
        if (intent == null) return;

        final List<Delivery> deliveries = collect(intent);

        if (deliveries.isEmpty())
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "nothing is listening for " + intent);
            return;
        }

        deliveries.sort(new Comparator<Delivery>()
        {
            @Override
            public int compare(Delivery first, Delivery second)
            {
                return Integer.compare(second.priority, first.priority);
            }
        });

        final Intent delivered = new Intent(intent);

        post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                for (Delivery delivery : deliveries)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        delivery.receiver.onReceive(sBaseContext, delivered);
                        if (ordered && delivery.receiver.isAborted())
                        {
                            Log.i(TAG, delivery.describedBy + " aborted the ordered broadcast " + delivered.getAction());
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Throwable cause)
                    {
                        Log.e(TAG, "onReceive threw in " + delivery.describedBy, cause);
                    }
                }

                if (resultReceiver != null)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        resultReceiver.onReceive(sBaseContext, delivered);
                    }
                    catch (Throwable cause)
                    {
                        Log.e(TAG, "the result receiver threw", cause);
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private static List<Delivery> collect(Intent intent)
    {
        List<Delivery> deliveries = new ArrayList<>();

        synchronized (sRegistered)
        {
            for (Registration registration : sRegistered)
            {
                int outcome = registration.filter.match(intent.getAction(), intent.getType(), intent.getScheme(), intent.getData(),
                                                        intent.getCategories(), TAG);
                if (outcome < 0) continue;

                Delivery delivery = new Delivery();
                delivery.receiver = registration.receiver;
                delivery.priority = registration.filter.getPriority();
                delivery.describedBy = registration.receiver.getClass().getName();
                deliveries.add(delivery);
            }
        }

        if (sFactory == null) return deliveries;

        for (Components.Record record : Components.resolveAll(Components.RECEIVER, intent))
        {
            try
            {
                BroadcastReceiver receiver = sFactory.instantiateReceiver(sLoader, record.className, intent);

                Delivery delivery = new Delivery();
                delivery.receiver = receiver;
                delivery.priority = highestPriority(record);
                delivery.describedBy = record.className;
                deliveries.add(delivery);
            }
            catch (Throwable cause)
            {
                Log.e(TAG, "could not instantiate receiver " + record.className, cause);
            }
        }

        return deliveries;
    }

    private static int highestPriority(Components.Record record)
    {
        int best = 0;
        for (IntentFilter filter : record.filters)
        {
            if (filter.getPriority() > best) best = filter.getPriority();
        }

        return best;
    }

    private static void post(Runnable work)
    {
        if (sHandler != null)
        {
            sHandler.post(work);
            return;
        }

        work.run();
    }
}

```

`java/runtime/Components.java`:

```java
package runtime;

import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.IntentFilter;
import android.util.Log;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class Components
{
    public static final int ACTIVITY = 0;
    public static final int SERVICE = 1;
    public static final int RECEIVER = 2;

    private static final String TAG = "Components";
    private static final int KINDS = 3;

    private static final Record[][] sRecords = new Record[KINDS][];

    public static final class Record
    {
        public final int kind;
        public final String className;
        public final IntentFilter[] filters;
        public final android.os.Bundle metaData;

        Record(int kind, String className, IntentFilter[] filters, android.os.Bundle metaData)
        {
            this.kind = kind;
            this.className = className;
            this.filters = filters;
            this.metaData = metaData;
        }
    }

    private Components()
    {
    }

    public static synchronized Record[] declared(int kind)
    {
        if (kind < 0 || kind >= KINDS) return new Record[0];
        if (sRecords[kind] != null) return sRecords[kind];

        int count = Bootstrap.nativeComponentCount(kind);
        List<Record> records = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            String className = Bootstrap.nativeComponentClassName(kind, index);
            if (className == null || className.isEmpty()) continue;

            int filterCount = Bootstrap.nativeComponentFilterCount(kind, index);
            IntentFilter[] filters = new IntentFilter[filterCount];

            for (int at = 0; at < filterCount; at++)
            {
                IntentFilter filter = new IntentFilter();

                for (String action : split(Bootstrap.nativeFilterActions(kind, index, at))) filter.addAction(action);
                for (String category : split(Bootstrap.nativeFilterCategories(kind, index, at))) filter.addCategory(category);
                for (String scheme : split(Bootstrap.nativeFilterSchemes(kind, index, at))) filter.addDataScheme(scheme);
                for (String type : split(Bootstrap.nativeFilterTypes(kind, index, at))) filter.addDataType(type);

                filter.setPriority(Bootstrap.nativeFilterPriority(kind, index, at));
                filters[at] = filter;
            }

            android.app.Application application = Bootstrap.getApplication();
            android.os.Bundle metaData = MetaData.read(application == null ? null : application.getResources(), kind, index);

            records.add(new Record(kind, className, filters, metaData));
        }

        sRecords[kind] = records.toArray(new Record[0]);
        return sRecords[kind];
    }

    public static Record resolve(int kind, Intent intent)
    {
        List<Record> matches = resolveAll(kind, intent);
        return matches.isEmpty() ? null : matches.get(0);
    }

    public static List<Record> resolveAll(int kind, Intent intent)
    {
        List<Record> matches = new ArrayList<>();
        if (intent == null) return matches;

        Record[] records = declared(kind);
        ComponentName component = intent.getComponent();

        if (component != null)
        {
            for (Record record : records)
            {
                if (record.className.equals(component.getClassName())) matches.add(record);
            }

            if (matches.isEmpty())
            {
                Log.w(TAG, "no " + describe(kind) + " named " + component.getClassName() + " is declared in the manifest");
            }

            return matches;
        }

        int best = Integer.MIN_VALUE;

        for (Record record : records)
        {
            for (IntentFilter filter : record.filters)
            {
                int outcome = filter.match(intent.getAction(), intent.getType(), intent.getScheme(), intent.getData(),
                                           intent.getCategories(), TAG);
                if (outcome < 0) continue;

                if (outcome > best)
                {
                    best = outcome;
                    matches.add(0, record);
                }
                else
                {
                    matches.add(record);
                }

                break;
            }
        }

        if (matches.isEmpty())
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "nothing declared answers " + intent + " as a " + describe(kind));
        }

        return matches;
    }

    public static ComponentName nameOf(Record record, String packageName)
    {
        return new ComponentName(packageName, record.className);
    }

    private static String describe(int kind)
    {
        if (kind == ACTIVITY) return "activity";
        if (kind == SERVICE) return "service";
        if (kind == RECEIVER) return "receiver";

        return "component";
    }

    private static String[] split(String joined)
    {
        if (joined == null || joined.isEmpty()) return new String[0];

        return joined.split("\n");
    }
}
```

`java/runtime/Configurations.java`:

```java
package runtime;

import android.content.pm.ActivityInfo;
import android.content.res.Configuration;
import android.util.Log;

public final class Configurations
{
    private static final String TAG = "Configurations";

    private static android.app.ContextImpl sBase;

    private Configurations()
    {
    }

    public static void attach(android.app.ContextImpl base)
    {
        sBase = base;
    }

    public static boolean apply(int widthPixels, int heightPixels, int densityDpi)
    {
        if (sBase == null) return false;

        Configuration before = new Configuration();
        before.setTo(sBase.getResources().getConfiguration());

        sBase.updateMetricsForWindow(widthPixels, heightPixels, densityDpi);

        Configuration after = sBase.getResources().getConfiguration();
        int changed = before.diff(after);

        if (changed == 0)
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "the window changed but nothing in the configuration did");
            return false;
        }

        Log.i(TAG, "the configuration changed: " + describe(changed) + " (" + widthPixels + "x" + heightPixels + " at "
                   + densityDpi + " dpi, " + after.screenWidthDp + "x" + after.screenHeightDp + " dp)");

        android.content.Context.dispatchConfigurationChanged(after);

        int handled = 0;
        int recreated = 0;

        for (String className : Activities.classNames())
        {
            int declared = Bootstrap.nativeActivityConfigChanges(className);

            if ((declared & changed) == changed)
            {
                handled += 1;
                continue;
            }

            recreated += 1;
        }

        Log.i(TAG, handled + " activity(ies) declared they handle it, " + recreated + " will be recreated");

        Activities.deliverConfigurationChange(after, changed);

        return true;
    }

    private static String describe(int changed)
    {
        StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();

        if ((changed & ActivityInfo.CONFIG_ORIENTATION) != 0) text.append("orientation ");
        if ((changed & ActivityInfo.CONFIG_SCREEN_SIZE) != 0) text.append("screenSize ");
        if ((changed & ActivityInfo.CONFIG_SMALLEST_SCREEN_SIZE) != 0) text.append("smallestScreenSize ");
        if ((changed & ActivityInfo.CONFIG_DENSITY) != 0) text.append("density ");
        if ((changed & ActivityInfo.CONFIG_LOCALE) != 0) text.append("locale ");
        if ((changed & ActivityInfo.CONFIG_UI_MODE) != 0) text.append("uiMode ");
        if ((changed & ActivityInfo.CONFIG_FONT_SCALE) != 0) text.append("fontScale ");

        if (text.length() == 0) text.append("0x").append(Integer.toHexString(changed));

        return text.toString().trim();
    }
}
```

`java/runtime/FixedAdvanceTextMeasurer.java`:

```java
package runtime;

public final class FixedAdvanceTextMeasurer implements TextMeasurer
{
    public static final float ADVANCE_RATIO = 0.5f;
    public static final float ASCENT_RATIO = -0.928f;
    public static final float DESCENT_RATIO = 0.244f;

    private static final int MAX_STYLE_COUNT = 4096;

    private final float[] mSizes = new float[MAX_STYLE_COUNT];
    private int mStyleCount;

    @Override
    public int resolveFamily(String familyName, int weight, boolean italic)
    {
        return 1;
    }

    @Override
    public int internStyle(int font, float textSize, float scaleX, float skewX, float letterSpacing, int flags)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mStyleCount; index++)
        {
            if (mSizes[index] == textSize) return index + 1;
        }

        if (mStyleCount >= MAX_STYLE_COUNT) return 0;

        mSizes[mStyleCount] = textSize;
        mStyleCount++;
        return mStyleCount;
    }

    private float sizeOf(int style)
    {
        if (style < 1 || style > mStyleCount) return 0f;
        return mSizes[style - 1];
    }

    private float advanceOf(int style)
    {
        return Math.max(1f, Math.round(sizeOf(style) * ADVANCE_RATIO));
    }

    @Override
    public float measureText(int style, char[] text, int index, int count)
    {
        return count * advanceOf(style);
    }

    @Override
    public int textWidths(int style, char[] text, int index, int count, float[] outWidths)
    {
        float advance = advanceOf(style);
        for (int position = 0; position < count; position++)
        {
            outWidths[position] = advance;
        }
        return count;
    }

    @Override
    public void fontMetrics(int style, float[] outMetrics)
    {
        float size = sizeOf(style);
        outMetrics[0] = size * ASCENT_RATIO - 1f;
        outMetrics[1] = size * ASCENT_RATIO;
        outMetrics[2] = size * DESCENT_RATIO;
        outMetrics[3] = size * DESCENT_RATIO + 1f;
        outMetrics[4] = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public void textBounds(int style, char[] text, int index, int count, int[] outBounds)
    {
        float size = sizeOf(style);
        outBounds[0] = 0;
        outBounds[1] = Math.round(size * ASCENT_RATIO);
        outBounds[2] = Math.round(count * advanceOf(style));
        outBounds[3] = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public int breakText(int style, char[] text, int index, int count, float maxWidth, boolean forwards, float[] outMeasured)
    {
        float advance = advanceOf(style);
        int fits = advance <= 0f ? count : (int)Math.floor(maxWidth / advance);
        if (fits > count) fits = count;
        if (fits < 0) fits = 0;

        if (outMeasured != null && outMeasured.length > 0) outMeasured[0] = fits * advance;
        return fits;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasGlyph(int style, String text)
    {
        return text != null && text.length() == 1;
    }
}
```
