`java/runtime/Jobs.java`:

```java
package runtime;

import android.app.AppComponentFactory;
import android.app.Application;
import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.Service;
import android.app.job.JobInfo;
import android.app.job.JobParameters;
import android.app.job.JobScheduler;
import android.app.job.JobService;
import android.app.job.JobServiceEngine;
import android.app.job.JobWorkItem;
import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.database.ContentObserver;
import android.net.ConnectivityManager;
import android.net.Network;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.util.Log;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class Jobs extends JobScheduler
{
    private static final String TAG = "Jobs";

    private static final long EXECUTION_LIMIT_MILLIS = 10L * 60L * 1000L;
    private static final long EXPEDITED_EXECUTION_LIMIT_MILLIS = 3L * 60L * 1000L;
    private static final long DEFAULT_TRIGGER_UPDATE_DELAY_MILLIS = 10000L;
    private static final long DEFAULT_TRIGGER_MAX_DELAY_MILLIS = 2L * 60L * 1000L;
    private static final int MAX_JOBS_PER_APP = 150;

    private static final class Record
    {
        String namespace;
        JobInfo info;
        ServiceRecord host;
        JobParameters parameters;
        Runnable pending;
        Runnable timeout;
        boolean running;
        boolean settled;
        boolean waitingForContent;
        int failures;
        int nextWorkId = 1;
        int notificationId;
        int notificationPolicy = -1;
        final List<JobWorkItem> queuedWork = new ArrayList<>();
        final List<JobWorkItem> deliveredWork = new ArrayList<>();
        final LinkedHashSet<Uri> changedUris = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        long firstChangeUptime;
        ContentObserver observer;
    }

    private static final class ServiceRecord
    {
        String className;
        Service service;
        JobServiceEngine engine;
        int running;
    }

    private static final Map<String, Record> sJobs = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private static final Map<String, ServiceRecord> sServices = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private static final Map<String, Jobs> sSchedulers = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private static final Jobs sInstance = new Jobs(null);

    private static Context sBaseContext;
    private static Application sApplication;
    private static AppComponentFactory sFactory;
    private static ClassLoader sLoader;
    private static boolean sSaidConstraintsAreAssumed;

    private final String mNamespace;

    private Jobs(String namespace)
    {
        mNamespace = namespace;
    }

    public static Jobs instance()
    {
        return sInstance;
    }

    public static void attachRuntime(Context base, Application application, AppComponentFactory factory, ClassLoader loader)
    {
        sBaseContext = base;
        sApplication = application;
        sFactory = factory;
        sLoader = loader;
    }

    @Override
    public JobScheduler forNamespace(String namespace)
    {
        if (namespace == null) throw new NullPointerException("namespace cannot be null");

        String trimmed = namespace.trim();
        if (trimmed.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("namespace cannot be empty");

        synchronized (sSchedulers)
        {
            Jobs scheduler = sSchedulers.get(trimmed);
            if (scheduler == null)
            {
                scheduler = new Jobs(trimmed);
                sSchedulers.put(trimmed, scheduler);
            }

            return scheduler;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String getNamespace()
    {
        return mNamespace;
    }

    @Override
    public int schedule(JobInfo job)
    {
        return scheduleInternal(job, null);
    }

    @Override
    public int enqueue(JobInfo job, JobWorkItem work)
    {
        if (work == null) throw new NullPointerException("work");
        if (job != null && job.isPersisted()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Can't enqueue work for persisted jobs");
        if (job != null && job.isPeriodic()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Can't enqueue work for periodic jobs");

        return scheduleInternal(job, work);
    }

    private int scheduleInternal(JobInfo job, JobWorkItem work)
    {
        if (job == null || job.getService() == null) return RESULT_FAILURE;
        if (sBaseContext == null)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "a job was scheduled before the runtime was attached");
            return RESULT_FAILURE;
        }

        Handler handler = handler();
        if (handler == null)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "no main looper, so job " + job.getId() + " cannot be scheduled");
            return RESULT_FAILURE;
        }

        if (Components.resolve(Components.SERVICE, new Intent().setComponent(job.getService())) == null)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("No such service " + job.getService());
        }

        noteAssumedConstraints(job);

        final String key = keyFor(mNamespace, job.getId());
        Record previous;
        Record record;

        synchronized (sJobs)
        {
            previous = sJobs.get(key);

            if (work != null && previous != null && !previous.settled && previous.info.equals(job))
            {
                synchronized (previous)
                {
                    addWork(previous, work);
                }

                Log.i(TAG, "queued work on job " + describe(previous) + " (" + previous.queuedWork.size() + " waiting)");
                return RESULT_SUCCESS;
            }

            if (previous == null && sJobs.size() >= MAX_JOBS_PER_APP)
            {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Apps may not schedule more than " + MAX_JOBS_PER_APP + " distinct jobs");
            }

            record = new Record();
            record.namespace = mNamespace;
            record.info = job;
            record.pending = new Runnable()
            {
                @Override
                public void run()
                {
                    runJob(key);
                }
            };

            if (work != null) addWork(record, work);

            sJobs.put(key, record);
        }

        if (previous != null) retire(previous, JobParameters.STOP_REASON_CANCELLED_BY_APP);

        if (job.getTriggerContentUris() != null)
        {
            watchContent(record);
            Log.i(TAG, "job " + describe(record) + " for " + job.getService().getClassName()
                           + " waits for a change to " + job.getTriggerContentUris().length + " content uri(s)");
            return RESULT_SUCCESS;
        }

        long delay = Math.max(job.getMinLatencyMillis(), 0);
        handler.postDelayed(record.pending, delay);
        Log.i(TAG, "job " + describe(record) + " for " + job.getService().getClassName() + " runs in " + delay + "ms"
                       + (job.isPeriodic() ? ", then every " + job.getIntervalMillis() + "ms" : ""));

        return RESULT_SUCCESS;
    }

    @Override
    public void cancel(int jobId)
    {
        Record record;
        synchronized (sJobs)
        {
            record = sJobs.remove(keyFor(mNamespace, jobId));
        }

        if (record == null) return;

        retire(record, JobParameters.STOP_REASON_CANCELLED_BY_APP);
        Log.i(TAG, "cancelled job " + describe(record));
    }

    @Override
    public void cancelAll()
    {
        for (Record record : records(mNamespace, false)) cancel(record.info.getId());
    }

    @Override
    public void cancelInAllNamespaces()
    {
        for (Record record : records(null, true))
        {
            Record removed;
            synchronized (sJobs)
            {
                removed = sJobs.remove(keyFor(record.namespace, record.info.getId()));
            }

            if (removed != null) retire(removed, JobParameters.STOP_REASON_CANCELLED_BY_APP);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public List<JobInfo> getAllPendingJobs()
    {
        List<JobInfo> pending = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Record record : records(mNamespace, false)) pending.add(record.info);
        return pending;
    }

    @Override
    public Map<String, List<JobInfo>> getPendingJobsInAllNamespaces()
    {
        Map<String, List<JobInfo>> pending = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (Record record : records(null, true))
        {
            List<JobInfo> jobs = pending.get(record.namespace);
            if (jobs == null)
            {
                jobs = new ArrayList<>();
                pending.put(record.namespace, jobs);
            }

            jobs.add(record.info);
        }

        return pending;
    }

    @Override
    public JobInfo getPendingJob(int jobId)
    {
        synchronized (sJobs)
        {
            Record record = sJobs.get(keyFor(mNamespace, jobId));
            return record == null ? null : record.info;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int getPendingJobReason(int jobId)
    {
        Record record;
        synchronized (sJobs)
        {
            record = sJobs.get(keyFor(mNamespace, jobId));
        }

        if (record == null) return PENDING_JOB_REASON_INVALID_JOB_ID;
        if (record.running) return PENDING_JOB_REASON_EXECUTING;
        if (record.waitingForContent) return PENDING_JOB_REASON_CONSTRAINT_CONTENT_TRIGGER;
        if (record.info.getMinLatencyMillis() > 0 || record.info.isPeriodic()) return PENDING_JOB_REASON_CONSTRAINT_MINIMUM_LATENCY;
        return PENDING_JOB_REASON_UNDEFINED;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canRunUserInitiatedJobs()
    {
        return true;
    }

    public static JobWorkItem dequeueWork(JobParameters parameters)
    {
        Record record = recordFor(parameters);
        if (record == null) return null;

        JobWorkItem item = null;
        boolean finished = false;

        synchronized (record)
        {
            if (!record.queuedWork.isEmpty())
            {
                item = record.queuedWork.remove(0);
                item.bumpDeliveryCount();
                record.deliveredWork.add(item);
            }
            else if (record.deliveredWork.isEmpty())
            {
                finished = true;
            }
        }

        if (finished)
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "job " + describe(record) + " has no more work");
            finishOnMain(parameters, false);
        }

        return item;
    }

    public static boolean completeWork(JobParameters parameters, JobWorkItem work)
    {
        Record record = recordFor(parameters);
        if (record == null || work == null) return false;

        synchronized (record)
        {
            return record.deliveredWork.remove(work);
        }
    }

    public static void setNotification(JobParameters parameters, int notificationId, Notification notification, int policy)
    {
        Record record = recordFor(parameters);
        if (record == null) return;

        if (record.notificationPolicy >= 0 && record.notificationId != notificationId)
        {
            NotificationStore.cancel(null, record.notificationId);
        }

        record.notificationId = notificationId;
        record.notificationPolicy = policy;
        NotificationStore.post(null, notificationId, notification);
    }

    public static void finished(JobService service, JobParameters parameters, boolean wantsReschedule)
    {
        finished(parameters, wantsReschedule);
    }

    public static void finished(JobParameters parameters, boolean wantsReschedule)
    {
        if (parameters == null) return;

        finishOnMain(parameters, wantsReschedule);
    }

    private static void finishOnMain(final JobParameters parameters, final boolean wantsReschedule)
    {
        Handler handler = handler();
        if (handler == null) return;

        if (Looper.myLooper() == handler.getLooper())
        {
            settle(parameters, wantsReschedule);
            return;
        }

        handler.post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                settle(parameters, wantsReschedule);
            }
        });
    }

    private static void settle(JobParameters parameters, boolean wantsReschedule)
    {
        Record record = recordFor(parameters);
        if (record == null || record.settled) return;

        record.settled = true;
        record.running = false;

        Handler handler = handler();
        if (handler != null && record.timeout != null) handler.removeCallbacks(record.timeout);

        Log.i(TAG, "job " + describe(record) + " finished" + (wantsReschedule ? " and asked to run again" : ""));

        releaseHost(record);

        boolean moreWork;
        synchronized (record)
        {
            if (wantsReschedule)
            {
                record.queuedWork.addAll(0, record.deliveredWork);
            }

            record.deliveredWork.clear();
            moreWork = !record.queuedWork.isEmpty();
        }

        if (wantsReschedule)
        {
            record.failures++;
            long delay = backoffFor(record);
            Log.i(TAG, "job " + describe(record) + " backs off for " + delay + "ms");
            requeue(record, delay);
            return;
        }

        record.failures = 0;

        if (record.info.isPeriodic())
        {
            requeue(record, record.info.getIntervalMillis());
            return;
        }

        if (moreWork)
        {
            requeue(record, 0);
            return;
        }

        synchronized (sJobs)
        {
            String key = keyFor(record.namespace, record.info.getId());
            if (sJobs.get(key) == record) sJobs.remove(key);
        }

        unwatchContent(record);
        endNotification(record);
    }

    private static void requeue(Record record, long delay)
    {
        record.parameters = null;
        record.settled = false;

        Handler handler = handler();
        if (handler != null) handler.postDelayed(record.pending, Math.max(delay, 0));
    }

    private static long backoffFor(Record record)
    {
        long initial = record.info.getInitialBackoffMillis();
        long delay;

        if (record.info.getBackoffPolicy() == JobInfo.BACKOFF_POLICY_LINEAR)
        {
            delay = initial * record.failures;
        }
        else
        {
            int shift = Math.min(record.failures - 1, 30);
            delay = initial << shift;
        }

        if (delay < 0 || delay > JobInfo.MAX_BACKOFF_DELAY_MILLIS) delay = JobInfo.MAX_BACKOFF_DELAY_MILLIS;
        return delay;
    }

    private static void runJob(String key)
    {
        final Record record;
        synchronized (sJobs)
        {
            record = sJobs.get(key);
        }

        if (record == null || record.running) return;

        record.waitingForContent = false;

        ServiceRecord host = acquireHost(record.info.getService());
        if (host == null) return;

        record.host = host;

        Uri[] triggeredUris = null;
        String[] triggeredAuthorities = null;

        if (!record.changedUris.isEmpty())
        {
            triggeredUris = record.changedUris.toArray(new Uri[0]);
            LinkedHashSet<String> authorities = new LinkedHashSet<>();
            for (Uri uri : triggeredUris)
            {
                if (uri.getAuthority() != null) authorities.add(uri.getAuthority());
            }

            triggeredAuthorities = authorities.toArray(new String[0]);
            record.changedUris.clear();
            record.firstChangeUptime = 0;
        }

        JobInfo info = record.info;
        record.parameters = new JobParameters(info.getId(), record.namespace, info.getExtras(), info.getTransientExtras(),
                                              info.getClipData(), info.getClipGrantFlags(), triggeredUris, triggeredAuthorities,
                                              networkFor(info), false, info.isExpedited(), info.isUserInitiated());
        record.settled = false;
        record.running = true;

        final JobParameters parameters = record.parameters;

        record.timeout = new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                if (record.parameters != parameters || record.settled) return;

                Log.w(TAG, "job " + describe(record) + " ran past its execution limit and is being stopped");
                stopRunning(record, JobParameters.STOP_REASON_TIMEOUT, true);
            }
        };

        Handler handler = handler();
        if (handler != null)
        {
            handler.postDelayed(record.timeout, info.isExpedited() ? EXPEDITED_EXECUTION_LIMIT_MILLIS : EXECUTION_LIMIT_MILLIS);
        }

        try
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "job " + describe(record) + " started");

            boolean running = host.engine.onStartJob(parameters);
            if (!running) settle(parameters, false);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "onStartJob threw for job " + describe(record), cause);
            settle(parameters, false);
        }
    }

    private static void retire(Record record, int stopReason)
    {
        Handler handler = handler();
        if (handler != null)
        {
            handler.removeCallbacks(record.pending);
            if (record.timeout != null) handler.removeCallbacks(record.timeout);
        }

        unwatchContent(record);

        if (record.running && !record.settled) stopRunning(record, stopReason, false);

        endNotification(record);
    }

    private static void stopRunning(Record record, int stopReason, boolean mayReschedule)
    {
        JobParameters parameters = record.parameters;
        if (parameters == null || record.host == null) return;

        parameters.markStopped(stopReason);

        boolean reschedule = false;
        try
        {
            reschedule = record.host.engine.onStopJob(parameters);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "onStopJob threw for job " + describe(record), cause);
        }

        if (mayReschedule)
        {
            settle(parameters, reschedule);
            return;
        }

        record.settled = true;
        record.running = false;
        releaseHost(record);
    }

    private static void endNotification(Record record)
    {
        if (record.notificationPolicy == JobService.JOB_END_NOTIFICATION_POLICY_REMOVE)
        {
            NotificationStore.cancel(null, record.notificationId);
        }

        record.notificationPolicy = -1;
    }

    private static ServiceRecord acquireHost(ComponentName component)
    {
        String className = component.getClassName();
        ServiceRecord host = sServices.get(className);

        if (host == null)
        {
            host = new ServiceRecord();
            host.className = className;

            try
            {
                Intent intent = new Intent().setComponent(component);
                host.service = sFactory.instantiateService(sLoader, className, intent);
                host.service.attach(sBaseContext, sApplication);
                host.service.onCreate();

                IBinder binder = host.service.onBind(intent);
                host.engine = JobServiceEngine.fromBinder(binder);
            }
            catch (Throwable cause)
            {
                Log.e(TAG, "could not bring up job service " + className, cause);
                return null;
            }

            if (host.engine == null)
            {
                Log.e(TAG, className + " is not a JobService and returned no JobServiceEngine binder, so its jobs cannot run");
                destroyHost(host);
                return null;
            }

            sServices.put(className, host);
        }

        host.running++;
        return host;
    }

    private static void releaseHost(Record record)
    {
        ServiceRecord host = record.host;
        record.host = null;
        if (host == null) return;

        host.running--;
        if (host.running > 0) return;

        sServices.remove(host.className);

        try
        {
            host.service.onUnbind(new Intent().setComponent(record.info.getService()));
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "onUnbind threw in " + host.className, cause);
        }

        destroyHost(host);
    }

    private static void destroyHost(ServiceRecord host)
    {
        try
        {
            host.service.onDestroy();
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "onDestroy threw in " + host.className, cause);
        }
    }

    private static void watchContent(final Record record)
    {
        final Handler handler = handler();
        if (handler == null) return;

        record.waitingForContent = true;

        record.observer = new ContentObserver(handler)
        {
            @Override
            public void onChange(boolean selfChange, Uri uri)
            {
                contentChanged(record, uri);
            }
        };

        for (JobInfo.TriggerContentUri trigger : record.info.getTriggerContentUris())
        {
            boolean descendants = (trigger.getFlags() & JobInfo.TriggerContentUri.FLAG_NOTIFY_FOR_DESCENDANTS) != 0;
            sBaseContext.getContentResolver().registerContentObserver(trigger.getUri(), descendants, record.observer);
        }
    }

    private static void unwatchContent(Record record)
    {
        if (record.observer == null) return;

        sBaseContext.getContentResolver().unregisterContentObserver(record.observer);
        record.observer = null;
    }

    private static void contentChanged(Record record, Uri uri)
    {
        if (!record.waitingForContent) return;

        if (uri != null && record.changedUris.size() < 50) record.changedUris.add(uri);

        long now = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        if (record.firstChangeUptime == 0) record.firstChangeUptime = now;

        long update = record.info.getTriggerContentUpdateDelay();
        long maximum = record.info.getTriggerContentMaxDelay();
        if (update < 0) update = DEFAULT_TRIGGER_UPDATE_DELAY_MILLIS;
        if (maximum < 0) maximum = DEFAULT_TRIGGER_MAX_DELAY_MILLIS;

        long latest = record.firstChangeUptime + maximum;
        long due = Math.min(now + update, latest);
        due = Math.max(due, record.firstChangeUptime + Math.max(record.info.getMinLatencyMillis(), 0));

        Handler handler = handler();
        if (handler == null) return;

        handler.removeCallbacks(record.pending);
        handler.postDelayed(record.pending, Math.max(due - now, 0));
    }

    private static Network networkFor(JobInfo info)
    {
        if (info.getNetworkType() == JobInfo.NETWORK_TYPE_NONE && info.getRequiredNetwork() == null) return null;

        try
        {
            Object manager = sBaseContext.getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE);
            return manager instanceof ConnectivityManager ? ((ConnectivityManager)manager).getActiveNetwork() : null;
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static void addWork(Record record, JobWorkItem work)
    {
        work.setWorkId(record.nextWorkId++);
        record.queuedWork.add(work);
    }

    private static Record recordFor(JobParameters parameters)
    {
        if (parameters == null) return null;

        synchronized (sJobs)
        {
            Record record = sJobs.get(keyFor(parameters.getJobNamespace(), parameters.getJobId()));
            if (record != null && record.parameters == parameters) return record;

            for (Record candidate : sJobs.values())
            {
                if (candidate.parameters == parameters) return candidate;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static List<Record> records(String namespace, boolean everyNamespace)
    {
        List<Record> matched = new ArrayList<>();

        synchronized (sJobs)
        {
            for (Record record : sJobs.values())
            {
                if (everyNamespace || Objects.equals(record.namespace, namespace)) matched.add(record);
            }
        }

        return matched;
    }

    private static String keyFor(String namespace, int jobId)
    {
        return (namespace == null ? "" : namespace + "/") + jobId;
    }

    private static String describe(Record record)
    {
        return keyFor(record.namespace, record.info.getId());
    }

    private static void noteAssumedConstraints(JobInfo job)
    {
        boolean constrained = job.getNetworkType() != JobInfo.NETWORK_TYPE_NONE || job.getRequiredNetwork() != null
                              || job.isRequireCharging() || job.isRequireDeviceIdle() || job.isRequireBatteryNotLow()
                              || job.isRequireStorageNotLow();

        if (!constrained || sSaidConstraintsAreAssumed) return;

        sSaidConstraintsAreAssumed = true;
        Log.i(TAG, "this runtime has no network, charging, battery, storage or idle state to wait for, so those constraints are "
                       + "treated as met");
    }

    private static Handler handler()
    {
        Looper main = Looper.getMainLooper();
        return main == null ? null : new Handler(main);
    }
}
```

`java/runtime/MetaData.java`:

```java
package runtime;

import android.content.res.Resources;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.util.TypedValue;

public final class MetaData
{
    public static final int ACTIVITY = 0;
    public static final int SERVICE = 1;
    public static final int RECEIVER = 2;
    public static final int PROVIDER = 3;
    public static final int APPLICATION = 4;

    private static final int NO_VALUE = -1;
    private static final int RESOURCE = -2;

    private MetaData()
    {
    }

    public static Bundle read(Resources resources, int kind, int index)
    {
        int count = Bootstrap.nativeComponentMetaDataCount(kind, index);
        if (count <= 0) return null;

        Bundle bundle = new Bundle();

        for (int entry = 0; entry < count; entry++)
        {
            String name = Bootstrap.nativeComponentMetaDataName(kind, index, entry);
            if (name == null) continue;

            int type = Bootstrap.nativeComponentMetaDataType(kind, index, entry);
            int data = Bootstrap.nativeComponentMetaDataData(kind, index, entry);
            String text = Bootstrap.nativeComponentMetaDataValue(kind, index, entry);

            put(bundle, resources, name, type, data, text);
        }

        return bundle;
    }

    private static void put(Bundle bundle, Resources resources, String name, int type, int data, String text)
    {
        if (type == RESOURCE)
        {
            bundle.putInt(name, data);
            return;
        }

        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_REFERENCE && data != 0 && resources != null)
        {
            TypedValue resolved = new TypedValue();

            try
            {
                resources.getValue(data, resolved, true);
                put(bundle, null, name, resolved.type, resolved.data, resolved.type == TypedValue.TYPE_STRING
                                                                          ? String.valueOf(resolved.coerceToString())
                                                                          : text);
                return;
            }
            catch (Resources.NotFoundException missing)
            {
                bundle.putInt(name, data);
                return;
            }
        }

        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_INT_BOOLEAN)
        {
            bundle.putBoolean(name, data != 0);
            return;
        }

        if (type >= TypedValue.TYPE_FIRST_INT && type <= TypedValue.TYPE_LAST_INT)
        {
            bundle.putInt(name, data);
            return;
        }

        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_FLOAT)
        {
            bundle.putFloat(name, Float.intBitsToFloat(data));
            return;
        }

        if (type == TypedValue.TYPE_REFERENCE)
        {
            bundle.putInt(name, data);
            return;
        }

        if (type == NO_VALUE && text == null) return;

        bundle.putString(name, text);
    }
}
```

`java/runtime/NativeSignatures.java`:

```java
package runtime;

import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.lang.reflect.Modifier;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public final class NativeSignatures
{
    private NativeSignatures()
    {
    }

    public static String[] describe(String className)
    {
        Class<?> subject;

        String binaryName = className.replace('/', '.');

        try
        {
            subject = Class.forName(binaryName, false, NativeSignatures.class.getClassLoader());
        }
        catch (Throwable missing)
        {
            try
            {
                subject = Class.forName(binaryName, false, Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader());
            }
            catch (Throwable stillMissing)
            {
                return new String[0];
            }
        }

        ArrayList<String> described = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Method method : subject.getDeclaredMethods())
        {
            if (!Modifier.isNative(method.getModifiers())) continue;

            described.add(method.getName());
            described.add(signatureOf(method));
        }

        return described.toArray(new String[0]);
    }

    private static String signatureOf(Method method)
    {
        StringBuilder built = new StringBuilder("(");

        for (Class<?> parameter : method.getParameterTypes()) appendDescriptor(built, parameter);

        built.append(')');
        appendDescriptor(built, method.getReturnType());
        return built.toString();
    }

    private static void appendDescriptor(StringBuilder out, Class<?> type)
    {
        if (type.isArray())
        {
            out.append('[');
            appendDescriptor(out, type.getComponentType());
            return;
        }

        if (!type.isPrimitive())
        {
            out.append('L').append(type.getName().replace('.', '/')).append(';');
            return;
        }

        if (type == void.class) out.append('V');
        else if (type == boolean.class) out.append('Z');
        else if (type == byte.class) out.append('B');
        else if (type == char.class) out.append('C');
        else if (type == short.class) out.append('S');
        else if (type == int.class) out.append('I');
        else if (type == long.class) out.append('J');
        else if (type == float.class) out.append('F');
        else out.append('D');
    }
}
```

`java/runtime/NotificationStore.java`:

```java
package runtime;

import android.app.Application;
import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationChannelGroup;
import android.os.Process;
import android.service.notification.StatusBarNotification;
import android.util.Log;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public final class NotificationStore
{
    private static final String TAG = "Notifications";

    public static final class Posted
    {
        public final String tag;
        public final int id;
        public final Notification notification;
        public final long postTime;

        Posted(String tag, int id, Notification notification, long postTime)
        {
            this.tag = tag;
            this.id = id;
            this.notification = notification;
            this.postTime = postTime;
        }
    }

    private static final Map<String, Posted> sActive = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private static final Map<String, NotificationChannel> sChannels = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private static final Map<String, NotificationChannelGroup> sGroups = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    private static String sDelegate;

    private NotificationStore()
    {
    }

    public static void addChannel(NotificationChannel channel)
    {
        if (channel == null || channel.getId() == null) return;

        synchronized (sChannels)
        {
            NotificationChannel existing = sChannels.get(channel.getId());
            if (existing != null)
            {
                existing.setName(channel.getName());
                existing.setDescription(channel.getDescription());
                if (channel.getImportance() < existing.getImportance()) existing.setImportance(channel.getImportance());
                if (existing.getGroup() == null) existing.setGroup(channel.getGroup());
                return;
            }

            sChannels.put(channel.getId(), channel);
        }

        Log.i(TAG, "channel " + channel.getId() + " (" + channel.getName() + ") at importance " + channel.getImportance());
    }

    public static void removeChannel(String channelId)
    {
        synchronized (sChannels)
        {
            sChannels.remove(channelId);
        }
    }

    public static NotificationChannel channel(String channelId)
    {
        synchronized (sChannels)
        {
            return sChannels.get(channelId);
        }
    }

    public static List<NotificationChannel> channels()
    {
        synchronized (sChannels)
        {
            return new ArrayList<>(sChannels.values());
        }
    }

    public static void addGroup(NotificationChannelGroup group)
    {
        if (group == null || group.getId() == null) return;

        synchronized (sChannels)
        {
            sGroups.put(group.getId(), group);
        }

        Log.i(TAG, "channel group " + group.getId() + " (" + group.getName() + ")");
    }

    public static void removeGroup(String groupId)
    {
        if (groupId == null) return;

        synchronized (sChannels)
        {
            sGroups.remove(groupId);

            Iterator<NotificationChannel> iterator = sChannels.values().iterator();
            while (iterator.hasNext())
            {
                if (groupId.equals(iterator.next().getGroup())) iterator.remove();
            }
        }
    }

    public static NotificationChannelGroup group(String groupId)
    {
        synchronized (sChannels)
        {
            return sGroups.get(groupId);
        }
    }

    public static List<NotificationChannelGroup> groups()
    {
        synchronized (sChannels)
        {
            return new ArrayList<>(sGroups.values());
        }
    }

    public static void setDelegate(String delegate)
    {
        sDelegate = delegate;
    }

    public static String delegate()
    {
        return sDelegate;
    }

    public static void post(String tag, int id, Notification notification)
    {
        if (notification == null) return;

        String key = keyFor(tag, id);
        boolean replaced;

        synchronized (sActive)
        {
            replaced = sActive.containsKey(key);
            sActive.put(key, new Posted(tag, id, notification, System.currentTimeMillis()));
        }

        Log.i(TAG, (replaced ? "updated " : "posted ") + key + " " + notification);

        if (notification.getChannelId() != null && channel(notification.getChannelId()) == null)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "no channel " + notification.getChannelId() + " was created for notification " + key);
        }

        NotificationChannel channel = channel(notification.getChannelId());

        nativePost(tag, id, notification.getChannelId(), asText(notification.extras.getCharSequence(Notification.EXTRA_TITLE)),
                   asText(notification.extras.getCharSequence(Notification.EXTRA_TEXT)), notification.when,
                   notification.priority, channel == null ? -1 : channel.getImportance(), notification.flags);
    }

    private static String asText(CharSequence value)
    {
        return value == null ? "" : value.toString();
    }

    public static void cancel(String tag, int id)
    {
        String key = keyFor(tag, id);
        Posted removed;

        synchronized (sActive)
        {
            removed = sActive.remove(key);
        }

        if (removed != null)
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "cancelled " + key);
            nativeCancel(tag, id);
        }
    }

    public static void cancelAll()
    {
        int count;

        synchronized (sActive)
        {
            count = sActive.size();
            sActive.clear();
        }

        if (count != 0)
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "cancelled all " + count + " notification(s)");
            nativeCancelAll();
        }
    }

    private static native void nativePost(String tag, int id, String channelId, String title, String text, long whenMillis,
                                          int priority, int importance, int flags);

    private static native void nativeCancel(String tag, int id);

    private static native void nativeCancelAll();

    public static List<Posted> active()
    {
        synchronized (sActive)
        {
            return new ArrayList<>(sActive.values());
        }
    }

    public static Posted find(String tag, int id)
    {
        synchronized (sActive)
        {
            return sActive.get(keyFor(tag, id));
        }
    }

    public static StatusBarNotification[] statusBarNotifications()
    {
        List<Posted> posted = active();
        String packageName = packageName();
        int uid = Process.myUid();

        StatusBarNotification[] result = new StatusBarNotification[posted.size()];
        for (int index = 0; index < result.length; index++)
        {
            Posted entry = posted.get(index);
            result[index] = new StatusBarNotification(packageName, packageName, entry.id, entry.tag, uid, Process.myPid(), 0,
                                                      entry.notification.clone(), Process.myUserHandle(), entry.postTime);
        }

        return result;
    }

    private static String packageName()
    {
        Application application = Bootstrap.getApplication();
        String name = application == null ? null : application.getPackageName();
        return name == null ? "android" : name;
    }

    private static String keyFor(String tag, int id)
    {
        return tag == null ? Integer.toString(id) : tag + ":" + id;
    }
}
```

`java/runtime/Packages.java`:

```java
package runtime;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class Packages
{
    public static final class Entry
    {
        public String packageName;
        public String label;
        public String archivePath;
        public String iconPath;
        public int targetSdkVersion;
    }

    private static List<Entry> sEntries;

    private Packages()
    {
    }

    public static List<Entry> installed()
    {
        if (sEntries != null) return sEntries;

        List<Entry> entries = new ArrayList<>();
        int count = 0;

        try
        {
            count = nativeCount();
        }
        catch (UnsatisfiedLinkError absent)
        {
            count = 0;
        }

        for (int slot = 0; slot < count; slot++)
        {
            Entry entry = new Entry();
            entry.packageName = nativeNameAt(slot);
            entry.label = nativeLabelAt(slot);
            entry.archivePath = nativeArchiveAt(slot);
            entry.iconPath = nativeIconAt(slot);
            entry.targetSdkVersion = nativeTargetSdkAt(slot);

            if (entry.packageName == null || entry.packageName.isEmpty()) continue;
            if (entry.label == null || entry.label.isEmpty()) entry.label = entry.packageName;

            entries.add(entry);
        }

        sEntries = entries;
        return sEntries;
    }

    public static Entry find(String packageName)
    {
        if (packageName == null) return null;

        for (Entry entry : installed())
        {
            if (packageName.equals(entry.packageName)) return entry;
        }

        return null;
    }

    public static boolean isHome()
    {
        return !installed().isEmpty();
    }

    public static boolean launch(String packageName)
    {
        if (packageName == null || packageName.isEmpty()) return false;

        try
        {
            return nativeLaunch(packageName);
        }
        catch (UnsatisfiedLinkError absent)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static native boolean nativeLaunch(String packageName);

    private static native int nativeCount();

    private static native String nativeNameAt(int slot);

    private static native String nativeLabelAt(int slot);

    private static native String nativeArchiveAt(int slot);

    private static native String nativeIconAt(int slot);

    private static native int nativeTargetSdkAt(int slot);
}
```

```java
        "android.permission.READ_SMS",               "android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE",
        "android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE", "android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES",
        "android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO",       "android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO",
        "android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS",     "android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION",
        "android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT",      "android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN",
        "android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE",    "android.permission.NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES",
    };

    private static final Set<String> DANGEROUS_SET = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(DANGEROUS));

    private static String[] sDeclared = new String[0];
    private static final Set<String> sGranted = new HashSet<>();
    private static final Set<String> sRefused = new HashSet<>();
    private static File sGrantFile;
    private static boolean sReady;

    private Permissions()
    {
    }

    public static synchronized void initialize(String dataDir)
    {
        if (sReady) return;

        sReady = true;

        int count = Bootstrap.nativePermissionCount();
        List<String> declared = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
        {
            String name = Bootstrap.nativePermissionAt(index);
            if (name != null && !name.isEmpty()) declared.add(name);
        }

        sDeclared = declared.toArray(new String[0]);

        for (String permission : sDeclared)
        {
            if (!isDangerous(permission)) sGranted.add(permission);
        }

        if (dataDir != null && !dataDir.isEmpty())
        {
            sGrantFile = new File(dataDir, GRANT_FILE);

            if (sGrantFile.exists()) readGrantFile();
            else writeGrantFile();
        }

        Log.i(TAG, "the manifest declares " + sDeclared.length + " permission(s), " + sGranted.size()
                   + " of them granted; the rest need a grant before they answer yes");
    }

    private static void readGrantFile()
    {
        if (sGrantFile == null || !sGrantFile.exists()) return;

        BufferedReader reader = null;

        try
        {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(sGrantFile));
            String line;

            while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null)
            {
                String trimmed = line.trim();
                if (trimmed.isEmpty() || trimmed.startsWith("#")) continue;

                if (trimmed.startsWith("-"))
                {
                    String refused = trimmed.substring(1).trim();
                    sGranted.remove(refused);
                    sRefused.add(refused);
                    continue;
                }

                sGranted.add(trimmed);
                sRefused.remove(trimmed);
            }
        }
        catch (java.io.IOException failure)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "the grant file could not be read: " + failure);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (reader != null) try { reader.close(); } catch (java.io.IOException ignored) { }
        }
    }

    private static void writeGrantFile()
    {
        if (sGrantFile == null) return;

        FileWriter writer = null;

        try
        {
            writer = new FileWriter(sGrantFile);
            writer.write("# one granted permission per line; a leading - records an explicit refusal\n");
            writer.write("# what is not listed at all is declared but never asked about\n");

            for (String permission : sGranted) writer.write(permission + "\n");
            for (String permission : sRefused) writer.write("-" + permission + "\n");

            for (String permission : sDeclared)
            {
                if (sGranted.contains(permission) || sRefused.contains(permission)) continue;

                writer.write("-" + permission + "\n");
            }
        }
        catch (java.io.IOException failure)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "the grant file could not be written: " + failure);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (writer != null) try { writer.close(); } catch (java.io.IOException ignored) { }
        }
    }

    public static boolean isDangerous(String permission)
    {
        return permission != null && DANGEROUS_SET.contains(permission);
    }

    public static synchronized boolean isDeclared(String permission)
    {
        if (permission == null) return false;

        for (String declared : sDeclared)
        {
            if (declared.equals(permission)) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public static synchronized String[] declared()
    {
        return sDeclared.clone();
    }

    public static synchronized int check(String permission)
    {
        if (permission == null) return PackageManager.PERMISSION_DENIED;
        if (!isDeclared(permission)) return PackageManager.PERMISSION_DENIED;

        return sGranted.contains(permission) ? PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED : PackageManager.PERMISSION_DENIED;
    }

    public static synchronized boolean grant(String permission)
    {
        if (!isDeclared(permission)) return false;

        sGranted.add(permission);
        sRefused.remove(permission);
        writeGrantFile();

        return true;
    }

    public static synchronized boolean deny(String permission)
    {
        if (!isDeclared(permission)) return false;

        sGranted.remove(permission);
        sRefused.add(permission);
        writeGrantFile();

        return true;
    }

    public static synchronized boolean wasRefused(String permission)
    {
        return sRefused.contains(permission);
    }
}
```

`java/runtime/PointerTracker.java`:

```java
package runtime;

import android.view.MotionEvent;

public final class PointerTracker
{
    public static final int MAX_POINTERS = 10;

    private final int[] mPointerIds = new int[MAX_POINTERS];
    private final float[] mPointerX = new float[MAX_POINTERS];
    private final float[] mPointerY = new float[MAX_POINTERS];

    private int mPointerCount;
    private long mDownTime;

    public interface Sink
    {
        void onMotion(MotionEvent event);
    }

    public int getPointerCount()
    {
        return mPointerCount;
    }

    public void reset()
    {
        mPointerCount = 0;
        mDownTime = 0;
    }

    public void track(int action, int pointerId, float x, float y, long eventTime, int metaState, Sink sink)
    {
        if (sink == null) return;

        if (isHover(action))
        {
            MotionEvent hover = MotionEvent.obtain(mDownTime, eventTime, action, x, y, metaState);
            sink.onMotion(hover);
            hover.recycle();

            return;
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN || action == MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN)
        {
            press(pointerId, x, y, eventTime, metaState, sink);
            return;
        }

        int index = indexOf(pointerId);
        if (index < 0) return;

        mPointerX[index] = x;
        mPointerY[index] = y;

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE)
        {
            send(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, eventTime, metaState, sink);
            return;
        }

        if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL)
        {
            send(MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL, eventTime, metaState, sink);
            mPointerCount = 0;
            return;
        }

        if (action != MotionEvent.ACTION_UP && action != MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP) return;

        int reported = mPointerCount == 1 ? MotionEvent.ACTION_UP
                                          : MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP | (index << MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_INDEX_SHIFT);

        send(reported, eventTime, metaState, sink);
        forget(index);
    }

    private static boolean isHover(int action)
    {
        return action == MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_MOVE || action == MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_ENTER
               || action == MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_EXIT || action == MotionEvent.ACTION_SCROLL;
    }

    private void press(int pointerId, float x, float y, long eventTime, int metaState, Sink sink)
    {
        int index = indexOf(pointerId);

        if (index < 0)
        {
            if (mPointerCount >= MAX_POINTERS) return;

            index = mPointerCount;
            mPointerIds[index] = pointerId;
            mPointerCount++;
        }

        mPointerX[index] = x;
        mPointerY[index] = y;

        if (mPointerCount == 1) mDownTime = eventTime;

        int reported = mPointerCount == 1 ? MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN
                                          : MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN
                                            | (index << MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_INDEX_SHIFT);

        send(reported, eventTime, metaState, sink);
    }

    private int indexOf(int pointerId)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < mPointerCount; index++)
        {
            if (mPointerIds[index] == pointerId) return index;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    private void forget(int index)
    {
        for (int move = index; move + 1 < mPointerCount; move++)
        {
            mPointerIds[move] = mPointerIds[move + 1];
            mPointerX[move] = mPointerX[move + 1];
            mPointerY[move] = mPointerY[move + 1];
        }

        if (mPointerCount > 0) mPointerCount--;
    }

    private void send(int action, long eventTime, int metaState, Sink sink)
    {
        if (mPointerCount <= 0) return;

        MotionEvent event = MotionEvent.obtain(mDownTime, eventTime, action, mPointerCount, mPointerIds, mPointerX,
                                               mPointerY, metaState);

        sink.onMotion(event);
        event.recycle();
    }
}
```

`java/runtime/SavedState.java`:

```java
package runtime;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.util.Log;

import java.io.BufferedInputStream;
import java.io.BufferedOutputStream;
import java.io.DataInputStream;
import java.io.DataOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public final class SavedState
{
    private static final String TAG = "SavedState";

    public static final int MAGIC = 0x41475253;
    public static final int VERSION = 1;
    public static final String LEAF = "saved-state";

    private static final int TYPE_END = 0;
    private static final int TYPE_STRING = 1;
    private static final int TYPE_INT = 2;
    private static final int TYPE_LONG = 3;
    private static final int TYPE_FLOAT = 4;
    private static final int TYPE_DOUBLE = 5;
    private static final int TYPE_BOOLEAN = 6;
    private static final int TYPE_BUNDLE = 7;
    private static final int TYPE_INT_ARRAY = 8;
    private static final int TYPE_STRING_ARRAY = 9;
    private static final int TYPE_STRING_LIST = 10;
    private static final int TYPE_BYTE_ARRAY = 11;
    private static final int TYPE_BYTE = 12;
    private static final int TYPE_SHORT = 13;
    private static final int TYPE_CHAR = 14;
    private static final int TYPE_LONG_ARRAY = 15;
    private static final int TYPE_INTEGER_LIST = 16;

    private SavedState()
    {
    }

    public static File fileFor(String dataDir, String activityClassName)
    {
        return new File(new File(dataDir), LEAF + "-" + activityClassName + ".bin");
    }

    public static boolean write(File target, Bundle bundle)
    {
        if (target == null || bundle == null) return false;

        DataOutputStream out = null;

        try
        {
            out = new DataOutputStream(new BufferedOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(target)));
            out.writeInt(MAGIC);
            out.writeInt(VERSION);
            writeBundle(out, bundle);
            out.flush();

            return true;
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "saved state could not be written: " + failure);
            return false;
        }
        finally
        {
            if (out != null) try { out.close(); } catch (IOException ignored) { }
        }
    }

    public static Bundle read(File source)
    {
        if (source == null || !source.exists()) return null;

        DataInputStream in = null;

        try
        {
            in = new DataInputStream(new BufferedInputStream(new FileInputStream(source)));

            if (in.readInt() != MAGIC) return null;
            if (in.readInt() != VERSION) return null;

            return readBundle(in);
        }
        catch (IOException failure)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "saved state could not be read: " + failure);
            return null;
        }
        finally
        {
            if (in != null) try { in.close(); } catch (IOException ignored) { }
        }
    }

    private static void writeBundle(DataOutputStream out, Bundle bundle) throws IOException
    {
        for (String key : bundle.keySet())
        {
            Object value = bundle.get(key);
            int type = typeOf(value);

            if (type == TYPE_END)
            {
                Log.w(TAG, "dropping " + key + ", whose type does not survive being written down");
                continue;
            }

            out.writeByte(type);
            out.writeUTF(key);
            writeValue(out, type, value);
        }

        out.writeByte(TYPE_END);
    }

    private static int typeOf(Object value)
    {
        if (value instanceof String) return TYPE_STRING;
        if (value instanceof Integer) return TYPE_INT;
        if (value instanceof Long) return TYPE_LONG;
        if (value instanceof Float) return TYPE_FLOAT;
        if (value instanceof Double) return TYPE_DOUBLE;
        if (value instanceof Boolean) return TYPE_BOOLEAN;
        if (value instanceof Byte) return TYPE_BYTE;
        if (value instanceof Short) return TYPE_SHORT;
        if (value instanceof Character) return TYPE_CHAR;
        if (value instanceof Bundle) return TYPE_BUNDLE;
        if (value instanceof int[]) return TYPE_INT_ARRAY;
        if (value instanceof long[]) return TYPE_LONG_ARRAY;
        if (value instanceof byte[]) return TYPE_BYTE_ARRAY;
        if (value instanceof String[]) return TYPE_STRING_ARRAY;

        if (value instanceof ArrayList)
        {
            ArrayList<?> list = (ArrayList<?>)value;
            if (list.isEmpty()) return TYPE_STRING_LIST;
            if (list.get(0) instanceof String) return TYPE_STRING_LIST;
            if (list.get(0) instanceof Integer) return TYPE_INTEGER_LIST;
        }

        return TYPE_END;
    }

    private static void writeValue(DataOutputStream out, int type, Object value) throws IOException
    {
        switch (type)
        {
            case TYPE_STRING: out.writeUTF((String)value); break;
            case TYPE_INT: out.writeInt((Integer)value); break;
            case TYPE_LONG: out.writeLong((Long)value); break;
            case TYPE_FLOAT: out.writeFloat((Float)value); break;
            case TYPE_DOUBLE: out.writeDouble((Double)value); break;
            case TYPE_BOOLEAN: out.writeBoolean((Boolean)value); break;
            case TYPE_BYTE: out.writeByte((Byte)value); break;
            case TYPE_SHORT: out.writeShort((Short)value); break;
            case TYPE_CHAR: out.writeChar((Character)value); break;
            case TYPE_BUNDLE: writeBundle(out, (Bundle)value); break;

            case TYPE_INT_ARRAY:
            {
                int[] array = (int[])value;
                out.writeInt(array.length);
                for (int element : array) out.writeInt(element);
                break;
            }

            case TYPE_LONG_ARRAY:
            {
                long[] array = (long[])value;
                out.writeInt(array.length);
                for (long element : array) out.writeLong(element);
                break;
            }

            case TYPE_BYTE_ARRAY:
            {
                byte[] array = (byte[])value;
                out.writeInt(array.length);
                out.write(array);
                break;
            }

            case TYPE_STRING_ARRAY:
            {
                String[] array = (String[])value;
                out.writeInt(array.length);
                for (String element : array) out.writeUTF(element == null ? "" : element);
                break;
            }

            case TYPE_STRING_LIST:
            {
                ArrayList<?> list = (ArrayList<?>)value;
                out.writeInt(list.size());
                for (Object element : list) out.writeUTF(element == null ? "" : element.toString());
                break;
            }

            case TYPE_INTEGER_LIST:
            {
                ArrayList<?> list = (ArrayList<?>)value;
                out.writeInt(list.size());
                for (Object element : list) out.writeInt(((Integer)element).intValue());
                break;
            }

            default: break;
        }
    }

    private static Bundle readBundle(DataInputStream in) throws IOException
    {
        Bundle bundle = new Bundle();

        for (;;)
        {
            int type = in.readByte();
            if (type == TYPE_END) return bundle;

            String key = in.readUTF();

            switch (type)
            {
                case TYPE_STRING: bundle.putString(key, in.readUTF()); break;
                case TYPE_INT: bundle.putInt(key, in.readInt()); break;
                case TYPE_LONG: bundle.putLong(key, in.readLong()); break;
                case TYPE_FLOAT: bundle.putFloat(key, in.readFloat()); break;
                case TYPE_DOUBLE: bundle.putDouble(key, in.readDouble()); break;
                case TYPE_BOOLEAN: bundle.putBoolean(key, in.readBoolean()); break;
                case TYPE_BYTE: bundle.putByte(key, in.readByte()); break;
                case TYPE_SHORT: bundle.putShort(key, in.readShort()); break;
                case TYPE_CHAR: bundle.putChar(key, in.readChar()); break;
                case TYPE_BUNDLE: bundle.putBundle(key, readBundle(in)); break;

                case TYPE_INT_ARRAY:
                {
                    int[] array = new int[in.readInt()];
                    for (int index = 0; index < array.length; index++) array[index] = in.readInt();
                    bundle.putIntArray(key, array);
                    break;
                }

                case TYPE_LONG_ARRAY:
                {
                    long[] array = new long[in.readInt()];
                    for (int index = 0; index < array.length; index++) array[index] = in.readLong();
                    bundle.putLongArray(key, array);
                    break;
                }

                case TYPE_BYTE_ARRAY:
                {
                    byte[] array = new byte[in.readInt()];
                    in.readFully(array);
                    bundle.putByteArray(key, array);
                    break;
                }

                case TYPE_STRING_ARRAY:
                {
                    String[] array = new String[in.readInt()];
                    for (int index = 0; index < array.length; index++) array[index] = in.readUTF();
                    bundle.putStringArray(key, array);
                    break;
                }

                case TYPE_STRING_LIST:
                {
                    int size = in.readInt();
                    ArrayList<String> list = new ArrayList<>(size);
                    for (int index = 0; index < size; index++) list.add(in.readUTF());
                    bundle.putStringArrayList(key, list);
                    break;
                }

                case TYPE_INTEGER_LIST:
                {
                    int size = in.readInt();
                    ArrayList<Integer> list = new ArrayList<>(size);
                    for (int index = 0; index < size; index++) list.add(Integer.valueOf(in.readInt()));
                    bundle.putIntegerArrayList(key, list);
                    break;
                }

                default: throw new IOException("unknown saved-state type " + type);
            }
        }
    }
}

```

`java/runtime/Services.java`:

```java
package runtime;

import android.app.AppComponentFactory;
import android.app.Application;
import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.ServiceConnection;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.util.Log;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public final class Services
{
    private static final String TAG = "Services";

    private static final class Record
    {
        Service service;
        String className;
        IBinder binding;
        boolean started;
        int nextStartId = 1;
        int lastStartId;
        boolean foreground;
        final List<ServiceConnection> connections = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    private static final Map<String, Record> sRecords = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    private static Context sBaseContext;
    private static Application sApplication;
    private static AppComponentFactory sFactory;
    private static ClassLoader sLoader;
    private static String sPackageName;
    private static Handler sHandler;

    private Services()
    {
    }

    public static void attachRuntime(Context base, Application application, AppComponentFactory factory, ClassLoader loader,
                                     String packageName)
    {
        sBaseContext = base;
        sApplication = application;
        sFactory = factory;
        sLoader = loader;
        sPackageName = packageName;

        Looper main = Looper.getMainLooper();
        sHandler = main == null ? null : new Handler(main);
    }

    public static ComponentName start(Intent intent)
    {
        Record record = obtain(intent);
        if (record == null) return null;

        record.started = true;
        final int startId = record.nextStartId++;
        record.lastStartId = startId;

        final Record target = record;
        final Intent delivered = intent == null ? null : new Intent(intent);

        post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                try
                {
                    int outcome = target.service.onStartCommand(delivered, 0, startId);
                    Log.i(TAG, "started " + target.className + " with id " + startId + ", it answered " + outcome);
                }
                catch (Throwable cause)
                {
                    Log.e(TAG, "onStartCommand threw in " + target.className, cause);
                }
            }
        });

        return new ComponentName(sPackageName, record.className);
    }

    public static boolean stop(Intent intent)
    {
        Components.Record declared = Components.resolve(Components.SERVICE, intent);
        if (declared == null) return false;

        Record record = sRecords.get(declared.className);
        if (record == null) return false;

        record.started = false;
        return teardownIfIdle(record);
    }

    public static boolean stopSelf(Service service, int startId)
    {
        Record record = recordFor(service);
        if (record == null) return false;
        if (startId >= 0 && startId != record.lastStartId) return false;

        record.started = false;
        teardownIfIdle(record);
        return true;
    }

    public static boolean bind(Intent intent, final ServiceConnection connection, int flags)
    {
        if (connection == null) return false;

        Record record = obtain(intent);
        if (record == null) return false;

        final Record target = record;
        final Intent delivered = intent == null ? null : new Intent(intent);

        if (!target.connections.contains(connection)) target.connections.add(connection);

        post(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                try
                {
                    if (target.binding == null) target.binding = target.service.onBind(delivered);

                    ComponentName name = new ComponentName(sPackageName, target.className);

                    if (target.binding == null)
                    {
                        Log.i(TAG, target.className + " bound with no interface");
                        connection.onNullBinding(name);
                        return;
                    }

                    Log.i(TAG, "bound " + target.className);
                    connection.onServiceConnected(name, target.binding);
                }
                catch (Throwable cause)
                {
                    Log.e(TAG, "onBind threw in " + target.className, cause);
                }
            }
        });

        return true;
    }

    public static void unbind(ServiceConnection connection)
    {
        if (connection == null) return;

        for (Record record : new ArrayList<>(sRecords.values()))
        {
            if (!record.connections.remove(connection)) continue;

            try
            {
                connection.onServiceDisconnected(new ComponentName(sPackageName, record.className));
                if (record.connections.isEmpty() && record.binding != null)
                {
                    record.service.onUnbind(null);
                    record.binding = null;
                }
            }
            catch (Throwable cause)
            {
                Log.e(TAG, "onUnbind threw in " + record.className, cause);
            }

            teardownIfIdle(record);
        }
    }

    public static void startForeground(Service service, int id, Notification notification)
    {
        Record record = recordFor(service);
        if (record == null) return;

        record.foreground = true;
        Log.i(TAG, record.className + " went to the foreground with notification " + id);

        if (notification != null) NotificationStore.post(null, id, notification);
    }

    public static void stopForeground(Service service, boolean removeNotification)
    {
        Record record = recordFor(service);
        if (record == null) return;

        record.foreground = false;
        Log.i(TAG, record.className + " left the foreground");
    }

    private static Record obtain(Intent intent)
    {
        if (sBaseContext == null)
        {
            Log.w(TAG, "a service was asked for before the runtime was attached: " + intent);
            return null;
        }

        Components.Record declared = Components.resolve(Components.SERVICE, intent);
        if (declared == null) return null;

        Record record = sRecords.get(declared.className);
        if (record != null) return record;

        record = new Record();
        record.className = declared.className;

        try
        {
            record.service = sFactory.instantiateService(sLoader, declared.className, intent);
            record.service.attach(sBaseContext, sApplication);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "could not instantiate service " + declared.className, cause);
            return null;
        }

        sRecords.put(declared.className, record);

        try
        {
            record.service.onCreate();
            Log.i(TAG, "created " + declared.className);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "onCreate threw in " + declared.className, cause);
        }

        return record;
    }

    private static boolean teardownIfIdle(Record record)
    {
        if (record.started || !record.connections.isEmpty()) return false;

        sRecords.remove(record.className);

        try
        {
            record.service.onDestroy();
            Log.i(TAG, "destroyed " + record.className);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "onDestroy threw in " + record.className, cause);
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static Record recordFor(Service service)
    {
        for (Record record : sRecords.values())
        {
            if (record.service == service) return record;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static void post(Runnable work)
    {
        if (sHandler != null && sHandler.getLooper() != Looper.myLooper())
        {
            sHandler.post(work);
            return;
        }

        if (sHandler != null)
        {
            sHandler.post(work);
            return;
        }

        work.run();
    }
}
```

`java/runtime/Settings.java`:

```java
package runtime;

public final class Settings
{
    private Settings()
    {
    }

    private static native String nativeLookup(String name);

    public static String get(String name)
    {
        String value = nativeLookup(name);
        if (value == null || value.isEmpty()) return null;

        return value;
    }

    public static boolean has(String name)
    {
        return get(name) != null;
    }

    public static boolean enabled(String name)
    {
        String value = get(name);

        return value != null && !"0".equals(value);
    }

    public static int integer(String name, int fallback)
    {
        String value = get(name);
        if (value == null) return fallback;

        try
        {
            return Integer.parseInt(value.trim());
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException malformed)
        {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " is not an integer: '" + value + "'", malformed);
        }
    }

    public static boolean tracing(String area)
    {
        String areas = get("trace");
        if (areas == null) return false;

        for (String candidate : areas.split("[, ]"))
        {
            if (candidate.equals("all") || candidate.equals(area)) return true;
        }

        return false;
    }
}
```

`java/runtime/StartupProbe.java`:

```java
package runtime;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.pm.ProviderInfo;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.util.Log;

public final class StartupProbe
{
    private static final String TAG = "StartupProbe";
    private static final String APP_INITIALIZER = "androidx.startup.AppInitializer";

    private StartupProbe()
    {
    }

    public static void reportInitializers(Context context, ProviderInfo[] providers)
    {
        Object appInitializer = instance(context);
        if (appInitializer == null) return;

        for (ProviderInfo provider : providers)
        {
            Bundle metaData = provider.metaData;
            if (metaData == null) continue;

            for (String className : metaData.keySet())
            {
                report(appInitializer, className);
            }
        }
    }

    private static Object instance(Context context)
    {
        try
        {
            Class<?> type = Class.forName(APP_INITIALIZER);
            return type.getMethod("getInstance", Context.class).invoke(null, context);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "androidx.startup not present in this package");
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static void report(Object appInitializer, String className)
    {
        Class<?> initializer;
        try
        {
            initializer = Class.forName(className);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "initializer " + className + " not loadable");
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            Object initialized = appInitializer.getClass()
                    .getMethod("isEagerlyInitialized", Class.class)
                    .invoke(appInitializer, initializer);
            Log.i(TAG, "initializer " + className + " initialized=" + initialized);
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "initializer " + className + " state unavailable: " + cause);
        }
    }
}
```
