```hpp
    Result RegisterAll(const Vm& vm, const NativeMethodTable* tables, int tableCount);

    Result FindClass(const Vm& vm, const char* className, jclass& classOut);
    bool DescribeAndClearException(const Vm& vm);

    Configuration DefaultConfiguration(const std::string& hostRoot);
    std::string ConscryptPrebuiltDirectory(const std::string& hostRoot);
```

`src/AudioDevice/AudioDevice.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "AudioDevice/AudioDevice.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>

#if RUNTIME_HAVE_AUDIO
#include <pipewire/pipewire.h>
#include <spa/param/audio/format-utils.h>

#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"
#endif

uint32_t AudioDevice::SampleBytes(SampleFormat sampleFormat)
{
    return sampleFormat == SampleFormat::Signed16 ? 2u : 4u;
}

const char* AudioDevice::ResultName(Result result)
{
    switch (result)
    {
        case Result::Ok: return "Ok";
        case Result::Unsupported: return "Unsupported";
        case Result::InvalidFormat: return "InvalidFormat";
        case Result::ConnectionFailed: return "ConnectionFailed";
        case Result::StreamFailed: return "StreamFailed";
        case Result::NotOpen: return "NotOpen";
    }
    return "Unknown";
}

#if !RUNTIME_HAVE_AUDIO

struct AudioDevice::Stream
{
    Format format;
};

bool AudioDevice::IsSupported()
{
    return false;
}

AudioDevice::Result AudioDevice::Open(const Format&, FillFunction, void*, Stream*& stream)
{
    stream = nullptr;
    return Result::Unsupported;
}

AudioDevice::Result AudioDevice::Start(Stream&)
{
    return Result::Unsupported;
}

AudioDevice::Result AudioDevice::Stop(Stream&)
{
    return Result::Unsupported;
}

void AudioDevice::Close(Stream*& stream)
{
    stream = nullptr;
}

AudioDevice::Format AudioDevice::DescribeFormat(const Stream& stream)
{
    return stream.format;
}

uint32_t AudioDevice::BufferCapacityInFrames(const Stream&)
{
    return 0;
}

uint64_t AudioDevice::UnderrunCount(const Stream&)
{
    return 0;
}

#else

struct AudioDevice::Stream
{
    Format format;
    FillFunction fill = nullptr;
    void* context = nullptr;
    pw_thread_loop* loop = nullptr;
    pw_stream* stream = nullptr;
    spa_hook listener{};
    uint32_t sampleBytes = 4;
    uint32_t capacityInFrames = 0;
    uint64_t underruns = 0;
    bool running = false;
    bool streaming = false;
};

static bool gLibraryReady = false;

static void EnsureLibrary()
{
    if (gLibraryReady) return;

    pw_init(nullptr, nullptr);
    gLibraryReady = true;
}

static void OnStreamStateChanged(void* userData, enum pw_stream_state previous, enum pw_stream_state current, const char* error)
{
    AudioDevice::Stream* stream = (AudioDevice::Stream*)userData;

    if (current == PW_STREAM_STATE_ERROR)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[audiodevice] the stream went from %s to %s%s%s\n", pw_stream_state_as_string(previous),
                pw_stream_state_as_string(current), error ? ": " : "", error ? error : "");
    }

    if (stream) stream->streaming = current == PW_STREAM_STATE_STREAMING;
}

static void OnStreamProcess(void* userData)
{
    AudioDevice::Stream* stream = (AudioDevice::Stream*)userData;
    if (!stream || !stream->stream) return;

    pw_buffer* held = pw_stream_dequeue_buffer(stream->stream);
    if (!held)
    {
        stream->underruns += 1;
        return;
    }

    spa_buffer* buffer = held->buffer;
    uint32_t stride = stream->format.channels * stream->sampleBytes;

    if (!buffer->datas[0].data || stride == 0)
    {
        pw_stream_queue_buffer(stream->stream, held);
        return;
    }

    uint32_t capacity = buffer->datas[0].maxsize / stride;
    uint32_t wanted = held->requested != 0 ? (uint32_t)held->requested : capacity;
    if (wanted > capacity) wanted = capacity;

    uint32_t produced = 0;
    if (wanted != 0 && stream->fill) produced = stream->fill(stream->context, buffer->datas[0].data, wanted);
    if (produced > wanted) produced = wanted;

    if (produced < wanted)
    {
        uint8_t* silence = (uint8_t*)buffer->datas[0].data + (size_t)produced * stride;
        memset(silence, 0, (size_t)(wanted - produced) * stride);
        stream->underruns += 1;
    }

    buffer->datas[0].chunk->offset = 0;
    buffer->datas[0].chunk->stride = (int32_t)stride;
    buffer->datas[0].chunk->size = wanted * stride;

    pw_stream_queue_buffer(stream->stream, held);
}

static const pw_stream_events STREAM_EVENTS = {
    PW_VERSION_STREAM_EVENTS, nullptr, &OnStreamStateChanged, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr,     nullptr,
    nullptr,                  &OnStreamProcess, nullptr,      nullptr, nullptr,
};

bool AudioDevice::IsSupported()
{
    return true;
}

AudioDevice::Result AudioDevice::Open(const Format& requested, FillFunction fill, void* context, Stream*& stream)
{
    stream = nullptr;

    if (requested.channels == 0 || requested.channels > MAXIMUM_CHANNELS) return Result::InvalidFormat;
    if (requested.sampleRate == 0) return Result::InvalidFormat;

    EnsureLibrary();

    Stream* opened = new Stream();
    opened->format = requested;
    opened->fill = fill;
    opened->context = context;
    opened->sampleBytes = SampleBytes(requested.sampleFormat);

    opened->loop = pw_thread_loop_new("acl-audio", nullptr);
    if (!opened->loop)
    {
        delete opened;
        return Result::ConnectionFailed;
    }

    pw_properties* properties = pw_properties_new(PW_KEY_MEDIA_TYPE, "Audio", PW_KEY_MEDIA_CATEGORY, "Playback", PW_KEY_MEDIA_ROLE,
                                                  "Game", PW_KEY_NODE_NAME, "acl", nullptr);

    char latency[64];
    snprintf(latency, sizeof(latency), "%u/%u", requested.framesPerBurst, requested.sampleRate);
    pw_properties_set(properties, PW_KEY_NODE_LATENCY, latency);

    pw_thread_loop_lock(opened->loop);

    opened->stream = pw_stream_new_simple(pw_thread_loop_get_loop(opened->loop), "acl", properties, &STREAM_EVENTS, opened);
    if (!opened->stream)
    {
        pw_thread_loop_unlock(opened->loop);
        pw_thread_loop_destroy(opened->loop);
        delete opened;
        return Result::StreamFailed;
    }

    uint8_t podStorage[1024];
    spa_pod_builder builder{};
    builder.data = podStorage;
    builder.size = sizeof(podStorage);

    spa_audio_info_raw info{};
    info.format = requested.sampleFormat == SampleFormat::Signed16 ? SPA_AUDIO_FORMAT_S16 : SPA_AUDIO_FORMAT_F32;
    info.rate = requested.sampleRate;
    info.channels = requested.channels;

    const spa_pod* params[1];
    params[0] = spa_format_audio_raw_build(&builder, SPA_PARAM_EnumFormat, &info);

    int connected = pw_stream_connect(opened->stream, PW_DIRECTION_OUTPUT, PW_ID_ANY,
                                      (pw_stream_flags)(PW_STREAM_FLAG_AUTOCONNECT | PW_STREAM_FLAG_MAP_BUFFERS), params, 1);

    pw_thread_loop_unlock(opened->loop);

    if (connected < 0)
    {
        pw_stream_destroy(opened->stream);
        pw_thread_loop_destroy(opened->loop);
        delete opened;
        return Result::ConnectionFailed;
    }

    opened->capacityInFrames = requested.framesPerBurst * 4;
    stream = opened;

    return Result::Ok;
}

AudioDevice::Result AudioDevice::Start(Stream& stream)
{
    if (!stream.loop || !stream.stream) return Result::NotOpen;
    if (stream.running) return Result::Ok;

    if (pw_thread_loop_start(stream.loop) < 0) return Result::ConnectionFailed;

    pw_thread_loop_lock(stream.loop);
    pw_stream_set_active(stream.stream, true);
    pw_thread_loop_unlock(stream.loop);

    stream.running = true;

    return Result::Ok;
}

AudioDevice::Result AudioDevice::Stop(Stream& stream)
{
    if (!stream.loop || !stream.stream) return Result::NotOpen;
    if (!stream.running) return Result::Ok;

    pw_thread_loop_lock(stream.loop);
    pw_stream_set_active(stream.stream, false);
    pw_thread_loop_unlock(stream.loop);

    pw_thread_loop_stop(stream.loop);
    stream.running = false;
    return Result::Ok;
}

void AudioDevice::Close(Stream*& stream)
{
    if (!stream) return;

    if (stream->running) Stop(*stream);
    if (stream->stream) pw_stream_destroy(stream->stream);
    if (stream->loop) pw_thread_loop_destroy(stream->loop);

    delete stream;
    stream = nullptr;
}

AudioDevice::Format AudioDevice::DescribeFormat(const Stream& stream)
{
    return stream.format;
}

uint32_t AudioDevice::BufferCapacityInFrames(const Stream& stream)
{
    return stream.capacityInFrames;
}

uint64_t AudioDevice::UnderrunCount(const Stream& stream)
{
    return stream.underruns;
}

#endif
```

`src/AudioDevice/include/AudioDevice/AudioDevice.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

namespace AudioDevice
{
    inline constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_SAMPLE_RATE = 48000;
    inline constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_CHANNELS = 2;
    inline constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_FRAMES_PER_BURST = 256;
    inline constexpr uint32_t MAXIMUM_CHANNELS = 8;

    enum class Result : uint8_t
    {
        Ok,
        Unsupported,
        InvalidFormat,
        ConnectionFailed,
        StreamFailed,
        NotOpen
    };

    enum class SampleFormat : uint8_t
    {
        Signed16,
        Float32
    };

    struct Format
    {
        uint32_t sampleRate = DEFAULT_SAMPLE_RATE;
        uint32_t channels = DEFAULT_CHANNELS;
        uint32_t framesPerBurst = DEFAULT_FRAMES_PER_BURST;
        SampleFormat sampleFormat = SampleFormat::Float32;
    };

    typedef uint32_t (*FillFunction)(void* context, void* frames, uint32_t frameCount);

    struct Stream;

    bool IsSupported();

    Result Open(const Format& requested, FillFunction fill, void* context, Stream*& stream);
    Result Start(Stream& stream);
    Result Stop(Stream& stream);
    void Close(Stream*& stream);

    Format DescribeFormat(const Stream& stream);
    uint32_t BufferCapacityInFrames(const Stream& stream);
    uint64_t UnderrunCount(const Stream& stream);
    uint32_t SampleBytes(SampleFormat sampleFormat);

    const char* ResultName(Result result);
}

```

`src/CheckContractObjects.cmake`:

```cmake
if(NOT DEFINED BINARY_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "BINARY_DIR not set")
endif()

file(GLOB sources ${BINARY_DIR}/contract_*.cpp)
if(sources STREQUAL "")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "no generated contract sources under ${BINARY_DIR}")
endif()

set(missing "")
set(stale "")

foreach(source ${sources})
    get_filename_component(name ${source} NAME_WE)
    file(GLOB object ${BINARY_DIR}/CMakeFiles/${name}.dir/${name}.cpp.o)
    if(object STREQUAL "")
        list(APPEND missing ${name})
    else()
        string(REPLACE "contract_" "" module ${name})
        set(header ${SOURCE_DIR}/${module}/include/${module}/${module}.hpp)
        if(NOT EXISTS ${header})
            set(header ${SOURCE_DIR}/ui/${module}/include/${module}/${module}.hpp)
        endif()
        if(EXISTS ${header} AND ${header} IS_NEWER_THAN ${object})
            list(APPEND stale ${module})
        endif()
    endif()
endforeach()

if(missing)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "contract objects never built: ${missing} - run: cmake --build <dir>")
endif()
if(stale)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "header newer than its contract object: ${stale} - run: cmake --build <dir>")
endif()

list(LENGTH sources count)
message(STATUS "contract headers compiled: ${count}")

```

`src/CodeMap/CodeMap.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "CodeMap/CodeMap.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

static bool ReadGuest(const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory, uint64_t address, void* destination, uint64_t length)
{
    if (!memory.Read) return false;
    return memory.Read(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)address, destination, length);
}

static bool EncodedSize(uint8_t encoding, uint64_t& size)
{
    if (encoding == CodeMap::ENCODING_OMITTED)
    {
        size = 0;
        return true;
    }

    switch (encoding & 0x0f)
    {
        case 0x02:
        case 0x03: size = 4; return true;
        case 0x04: size = 8; return true;
        case 0x09:
        case 0x0a:
        case 0x0b: size = 4; return true;
        case 0x0c: size = 8; return true;
        default: break;
    }

    return false;
}

CodeMap::Result CodeMap::ExecutableRange(const ElfLoader::Library& library, GuestState::GuestAddress& start, GuestState::GuestAddress& end)
{
    uint64_t lowest = 0;
    uint64_t highest = 0;
    bool found = false;

    for (const ElfLoader::Segment& segment : library.segments)
    {
        if (!segment.executable) continue;
        if (segment.length == 0) continue;

        uint64_t segmentStart = (uint64_t)segment.guestAddress;
        uint64_t segmentEnd = segmentStart + segment.length;

        if (!found || segmentStart < lowest) lowest = segmentStart;
        if (!found || segmentEnd > highest) highest = segmentEnd;

        found = true;
    }

    if (!found) return Result::NoExecutableSegment;

    start = (GuestState::GuestAddress)lowest;
    end = (GuestState::GuestAddress)highest;

    return Result::Ok;
}

void CodeMap::AddEntryPoint(GuestState::GuestAddress address, GuestState::GuestAddress executableStart,
                            GuestState::GuestAddress executableEnd, std::vector<FunctionRange>& functions)
{
    uint64_t raw = (uint64_t)address;
    if (raw < (uint64_t)executableStart || raw >= (uint64_t)executableEnd) return;

    FunctionRange range;
    range.startAddress = address;
    range.endAddress = executableEnd;

    functions.push_back(range);
}

static CodeMap::Result CollectFromExceptionTable(const ElfLoader::Library& library, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory,
                                                 GuestState::GuestAddress executableStart, GuestState::GuestAddress executableEnd,
                                                 std::vector<CodeMap::FunctionRange>& functions, CodeMap::Statistics& statistics)
{
    if (library.ehFrameAddress == GuestState::GuestAddress{} || library.ehFrameLength < 12) return CodeMap::Result::Ok;

    uint64_t base = (uint64_t)library.ehFrameAddress;

    uint8_t header[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
    if (!ReadGuest(memory, base, header, sizeof(header))) return CodeMap::Result::UnreadableExceptionTable;

    if (header[0] != CodeMap::EXCEPTION_TABLE_VERSION) return CodeMap::Result::UnsupportedExceptionTable;
    if (header[3] != CodeMap::ENCODING_TABLE_RELATIVE_SIGNED_WORD) return CodeMap::Result::UnsupportedExceptionTable;

    uint64_t frameSize = 0;
    uint64_t countSize = 0;
    if (!EncodedSize(header[1], frameSize)) return CodeMap::Result::UnsupportedExceptionTable;
    if (!EncodedSize(header[2], countSize)) return CodeMap::Result::UnsupportedExceptionTable;
    if (countSize != 4) return CodeMap::Result::UnsupportedExceptionTable;

    uint64_t cursor = base + sizeof(header) + frameSize;

    uint32_t count = 0;
    if (!ReadGuest(memory, cursor, &count, sizeof(count))) return CodeMap::Result::UnreadableExceptionTable;
    cursor += countSize;

    if (count > CodeMap::MAX_FUNCTIONS) return CodeMap::Result::TooManyFunctions;
    if (cursor + (uint64_t)count * 8 > base + library.ehFrameLength) return CodeMap::Result::UnreadableExceptionTable;

    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < count; ++index)
    {
        int32_t delta = 0;
        if (!ReadGuest(memory, cursor + (uint64_t)index * 8, &delta, sizeof(delta))) return CodeMap::Result::UnreadableExceptionTable;

        uint64_t address = base + (uint64_t)(int64_t)delta;
        if (address < (uint64_t)executableStart || address >= (uint64_t)executableEnd)
        {
            statistics.discarded += 1;
            continue;
        }

        CodeMap::FunctionRange range;
        range.startAddress = (GuestState::GuestAddress)address;
        range.endAddress = executableEnd;

        functions.push_back(range);
        statistics.fromExceptionTable += 1;
    }

    statistics.exceptionTableUsed = true;
    return CodeMap::Result::Ok;
}

CodeMap::Result CodeMap::Discover(const ElfLoader::Library& library, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory,
                                  std::vector<FunctionRange>& functions, Statistics& statistics)
{
    functions.clear();
    statistics = Statistics();

    GuestState::GuestAddress executableStart{};
    GuestState::GuestAddress executableEnd{};

    Result ranged = ExecutableRange(library, executableStart, executableEnd);
    if (ranged != Result::Ok) return ranged;

    statistics.executableBytes = (uint64_t)executableEnd - (uint64_t)executableStart;

    Result collected = CollectFromExceptionTable(library, memory, executableStart, executableEnd, functions, statistics);
    if (collected != Result::Ok && collected != Result::UnsupportedExceptionTable) return collected;

    for (const ElfLoader::Symbol& symbol : library.exports)
    {
        if (!symbol.isDefined || !symbol.isFunction) continue;

        uint64_t address = (uint64_t)symbol.guestAddress;
        if (address < (uint64_t)executableStart || address >= (uint64_t)executableEnd)
        {
            statistics.discarded += 1;
            continue;
        }

        FunctionRange range;
        range.startAddress = symbol.guestAddress;
        range.endAddress = executableEnd;

        functions.push_back(range);
        statistics.fromSymbols += 1;
    }

    for (const ElfLoader::StubRegion& region : library.stubRegions)
    {
        if (region.entryBytes == 0) continue;

        for (uint64_t offset = 0; offset + region.entryBytes <= region.length; offset += region.entryBytes)
        {
            uint64_t address = (uint64_t)region.guestAddress + offset;
            if (address < (uint64_t)executableStart || address >= (uint64_t)executableEnd) continue;

            FunctionRange range;
            range.startAddress = (GuestState::GuestAddress)address;
            range.endAddress = (GuestState::GuestAddress)(address + region.entryBytes);

            functions.push_back(range);
            statistics.fromStubs += 1;
        }
    }

    AddEntryPoint(library.initAddress, executableStart, executableEnd, functions);
    AddEntryPoint(library.finiAddress, executableStart, executableEnd, functions);

    if (functions.size() > MAX_FUNCTIONS) return Result::TooManyFunctions;

    std::sort(functions.begin(), functions.end(),
              [](const FunctionRange& left, const FunctionRange& right) { return left.startAddress < right.startAddress; });

    functions.erase(std::unique(functions.begin(), functions.end(),
                                [](const FunctionRange& left, const FunctionRange& right)
                                { return left.startAddress == right.startAddress; }),
                    functions.end());

    for (size_t index = 0; index + 1 < functions.size(); ++index) functions[index].endAddress = functions[index + 1].startAddress;
    if (!functions.empty()) functions.back().endAddress = executableEnd;

    return Result::Ok;
}

const char* CodeMap::ResultName(Result result)
{
    switch (result)
    {
        case Result::Ok: return "Ok";
        case Result::NoExecutableSegment: return "NoExecutableSegment";
        case Result::UnreadableExceptionTable: return "UnreadableExceptionTable";
        case Result::UnsupportedExceptionTable: return "UnsupportedExceptionTable";
        case Result::TooManyFunctions: return "TooManyFunctions";
    }

    return "Unknown";
}
```

```hpp
        NoExecutableSegment,
```

`src/ControlChannel/ControlChannel.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "ControlChannel/ControlChannel.hpp"

#include <cerrno>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>

#include <fcntl.h>
#include <poll.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"

static bool KindIsKnown(ControlChannel::MessageKind kind)
{
    return kind > ControlChannel::MessageKind::Invalid && kind <= ControlChannel::MessageKind::Exit;
}

static void TerminateText(char* text, uint32_t capacity)
{
    if (!text || capacity == 0) return;

    text[capacity - 1] = '\0';
}

static void SanitiseMessage(ControlChannel::Message& message)
{
    if (message.kind == ControlChannel::MessageKind::Hello)
    {
        TerminateText(message.payload.hello.packageName, ControlChannel::MAX_NAME_BYTES);
        return;
    }

    if (message.kind == ControlChannel::MessageKind::Progress)
    {
        TerminateText(message.payload.progress.libraryName, ControlChannel::MAX_NAME_BYTES);
        return;
    }

    if (message.kind == ControlChannel::MessageKind::Log)
    {
        TerminateText(message.payload.log.tag, ControlChannel::MAX_TAG_BYTES);
        TerminateText(message.payload.log.text, ControlChannel::MAX_TEXT_BYTES);
        return;
    }

    if (message.kind == ControlChannel::MessageKind::LaunchPackage)
    {
        TerminateText(message.payload.launchPackage.packageName, ControlChannel::MAX_PACKAGE_BYTES);
    }
}

static ControlChannel::Result WaitReadable(int fileDescriptor, int timeoutMillis)
{
    pollfd watched{};
    watched.fd = fileDescriptor;
    watched.events = POLLIN;

    for (;;)
    {
        int ready = poll(&watched, 1, timeoutMillis);
        if (ready > 0) return ControlChannel::Result::Ok;
        if (ready == 0) return ControlChannel::Result::WouldBlock;
        if (errno == EINTR) continue;

        return ControlChannel::Result::ReceiveFailed;
    }
}

ControlChannel::Result ControlChannel::CreatePair(Endpoint& endpoint, int& peerDescriptor)
{
    if (endpoint.fileDescriptor != INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR) return Result::AlreadyOpen;

    int pair[2] = {INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR, INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR};

    if (socketpair(AF_UNIX, SOCK_SEQPACKET | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0, pair) != 0) return Result::SendFailed;

    int flags = fcntl(pair[1], F_GETFD);
    if (flags < 0 || fcntl(pair[1], F_SETFD, flags & ~FD_CLOEXEC) != 0)
    {
        close(pair[0]);
        close(pair[1]);
        return Result::SendFailed;
    }

    endpoint = Endpoint{};
    endpoint.fileDescriptor = pair[0];
    peerDescriptor = pair[1];

    return Result::Ok;
}

ControlChannel::Result ControlChannel::Adopt(int fileDescriptor, Endpoint& endpoint)
{
    if (fileDescriptor < 0) return Result::InvalidArgument;
    if (fcntl(fileDescriptor, F_GETFD) < 0) return Result::InvalidArgument;

    endpoint = Endpoint{};
    endpoint.fileDescriptor = fileDescriptor;

    return Result::Ok;
}

ControlChannel::Result ControlChannel::AdoptFromEnvironment(Endpoint& endpoint)
{
    const char* value = Settings::Lookup(DESCRIPTOR_SETTING);
    if (!value || value[0] == '\0') return Result::NotConfigured;

    char* end = nullptr;
    long parsed = strtol(value, &end, 10);

    if (!end || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > 65535) return Result::InvalidArgument;

    return Adopt((int)parsed, endpoint);
}

void ControlChannel::Close(Endpoint& endpoint)
{
    if (endpoint.fileDescriptor == INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR) return;

    close(endpoint.fileDescriptor);
    endpoint.fileDescriptor = INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR;
}

ControlChannel::Result ControlChannel::Send(Endpoint& endpoint, const Message& message)
{
    return SendWithDescriptors(endpoint, message, nullptr, 0);
}

ControlChannel::Result ControlChannel::SendWithDescriptors(Endpoint& endpoint, const Message& message, const int* descriptors,
                                                           uint32_t descriptorCount)
{
    if (endpoint.fileDescriptor == INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR) return Result::NotOpen;
    if (!KindIsKnown(message.kind)) return Result::InvalidArgument;
    if (descriptorCount > MAX_DESCRIPTORS) return Result::InvalidArgument;
    if (descriptorCount > 0 && !descriptors) return Result::InvalidArgument;

    iovec span{};
    span.iov_base = (void*)&message;
    span.iov_len = sizeof(Message);

    alignas(cmsghdr) char control[CMSG_SPACE(sizeof(int) * MAX_DESCRIPTORS)];
    memset(control, 0, sizeof(control));

    msghdr header{};
    header.msg_iov = &span;
    header.msg_iovlen = 1;

    if (descriptorCount > 0)
    {
        header.msg_control = control;
        header.msg_controllen = CMSG_SPACE(sizeof(int) * descriptorCount);

        cmsghdr* entry = CMSG_FIRSTHDR(&header);
        entry->cmsg_level = SOL_SOCKET;
        entry->cmsg_type = SCM_RIGHTS;
        entry->cmsg_len = CMSG_LEN(sizeof(int) * descriptorCount);
        memcpy(CMSG_DATA(entry), descriptors, sizeof(int) * descriptorCount);
    }

    for (;;)
    {
        ssize_t written = sendmsg(endpoint.fileDescriptor, &header, MSG_NOSIGNAL);

        if (written == (ssize_t)sizeof(Message))
        {
            endpoint.messagesSent += 1;
            return Result::Ok;
        }

        if (written < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
        if (written < 0 && (errno == EPIPE || errno == ECONNRESET))
        {
            endpoint.peerClosed = true;
            return Result::PeerClosed;
        }

        return Result::SendFailed;
    }
}

ControlChannel::Result ControlChannel::Receive(Endpoint& endpoint, Message& message, int timeoutMillis)
{
    uint32_t descriptorCount = 0;
    return ReceiveWithDescriptors(endpoint, message, nullptr, descriptorCount, timeoutMillis);
}

ControlChannel::Result ControlChannel::ReceiveWithDescriptors(Endpoint& endpoint, Message& message, int* descriptors,
                                                              uint32_t& descriptorCount, int timeoutMillis)
{
    uint32_t capacity = descriptors ? descriptorCount : 0;
    descriptorCount = 0;

    if (endpoint.fileDescriptor == INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR) return Result::NotOpen;
    if (capacity > MAX_DESCRIPTORS) return Result::InvalidArgument;

    Result ready = WaitReadable(endpoint.fileDescriptor, timeoutMillis);
    if (ready != Result::Ok) return ready;

    memset(&message, 0, sizeof(Message));

    iovec span{};
    span.iov_base = &message;
    span.iov_len = sizeof(Message);

    alignas(cmsghdr) char control[CMSG_SPACE(sizeof(int) * MAX_DESCRIPTORS)];
    memset(control, 0, sizeof(control));

    msghdr header{};
    header.msg_iov = &span;
    header.msg_iovlen = 1;
    header.msg_control = control;
    header.msg_controllen = sizeof(control);

    ssize_t read = 0;

    for (;;)
    {
        read = recvmsg(endpoint.fileDescriptor, &header, MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC);
        if (read >= 0) break;
        if (errno == EINTR) continue;

        if (errno == ECONNRESET)
        {
            endpoint.peerClosed = true;
            return Result::PeerClosed;
        }

        return Result::ReceiveFailed;
    }

    if (read == 0)
    {
        endpoint.peerClosed = true;
        return Result::PeerClosed;
    }

    for (cmsghdr* entry = CMSG_FIRSTHDR(&header); entry; entry = CMSG_NXTHDR(&header, entry))
    {
        if (entry->cmsg_level != SOL_SOCKET || entry->cmsg_type != SCM_RIGHTS) continue;

        uint32_t carried = (uint32_t)((entry->cmsg_len - CMSG_LEN(0)) / sizeof(int));

        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < carried; ++index)
        {
            int carriedDescriptor = INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR;
            memcpy(&carriedDescriptor, CMSG_DATA(entry) + index * sizeof(int), sizeof(int));

            if (descriptorCount < capacity)
            {
                descriptors[descriptorCount] = carriedDescriptor;
                descriptorCount += 1;
                continue;
            }

            close(carriedDescriptor);
        }
    }

    if (read != (ssize_t)sizeof(Message) || (header.msg_flags & MSG_TRUNC) != 0 || !KindIsKnown(message.kind))
    {
        endpoint.malformedReceived += 1;
        message.kind = MessageKind::Invalid;
        return Result::Malformed;
    }

    SanitiseMessage(message);
    endpoint.messagesReceived += 1;

    return Result::Ok;
}

void ControlChannel::Prepare(Message& message, MessageKind kind)
{
    memset(&message, 0, sizeof(Message));
    message.kind = kind;
}

bool ControlChannel::CopyText(char* destination, uint32_t capacity, const char* source)
{
    if (!destination || capacity == 0) return false;

    destination[0] = '\0';
    if (!source) return true;

    size_t length = strnlen(source, capacity);
    if (length >= capacity) length = capacity - 1;

    memcpy(destination, source, length);
    destination[length] = '\0';

    return source[length] == '\0';
}

bool ControlChannel::PeerHasGone(Endpoint& endpoint)
{
    if (endpoint.fileDescriptor == INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR) return true;
    if (endpoint.peerClosed) return true;

    pollfd watched{};
    watched.fd = endpoint.fileDescriptor;
    watched.events = 0;

    for (;;)
    {
        const int ready = poll(&watched, 1, 0);

        if (ready < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
        if (ready < 0) return false;

        break;
    }

    if ((watched.revents & (POLLHUP | POLLERR | POLLNVAL)) == 0) return false;

    endpoint.peerClosed = true;
    return true;
}

bool ControlChannel::IsConfigured()
{
    const char* value = Settings::Lookup(DESCRIPTOR_SETTING);
    return value && value[0] != '\0';
}

bool ControlChannel::PublishDescriptor(int fileDescriptor)
{
    if (fileDescriptor < 0) return false;

    Settings::Set(DESCRIPTOR_SETTING, std::to_string(fileDescriptor));

    return true;
}

const char* ControlChannel::ResultName(Result result)

        case Result::Ok: return "Ok";
        case Result::NotOpen: return "NotOpen";
        case Result::AlreadyOpen: return "AlreadyOpen";
        case Result::InvalidArgument: return "InvalidArgument";
        case Result::NotConfigured: return "NotConfigured";
        case Result::PeerClosed: return "PeerClosed";
        case Result::WouldBlock: return "WouldBlock";
        case Result::SendFailed: return "SendFailed";
        case Result::ReceiveFailed: return "ReceiveFailed";
        case Result::Malformed: return "Malformed";
        case Result::VersionMismatch: return "VersionMismatch";
    }

    return "Unknown";
}
```

`src/ControlChannel/include/ControlChannel/ControlChannel.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

namespace ControlChannel
{
    inline constexpr const char* DESCRIPTOR_SETTING = "control-fd";
    inline constexpr uint32_t PROTOCOL_VERSION = 1;
    inline constexpr int INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR = -1;
    inline constexpr uint32_t FRAME_BUFFER_COUNT = 3;
    inline constexpr uint32_t MAX_FRAME_BUFFERS = 8;
    inline constexpr uint32_t MAX_DESCRIPTORS = MAX_FRAME_BUFFERS;
    inline constexpr uint32_t MAX_NAME_BYTES = 256;
    inline constexpr uint32_t MAX_TEXT_BYTES = 512;
    inline constexpr uint32_t MAX_TAG_BYTES = 64;
    inline constexpr uint32_t PHASE_COUNT = 4;

    enum class Result : uint8_t
    {
        Ok,
        NotOpen,
        AlreadyOpen,
        InvalidArgument,
        NotConfigured,
        PeerClosed,
        WouldBlock,
        SendFailed,
        ReceiveFailed,
        Malformed,
        VersionMismatch
    };

    enum class MessageKind : uint16_t
    {
        Invalid = 0,
        Hello,
        Buffers,
        FrameReady,
        BufferReleased,
        PresentDone,
        Input,
        Stop,
        Progress,
        Statistics,
        Log,
        GuestPresents,
        LaunchPackage,
        Exit
    };

    enum class InputKind : uint8_t
    {
        Touch,
        Key
    };

    struct HelloPayload
    {
        uint32_t version;
        uint32_t width;
        uint32_t height;
        char packageName[MAX_NAME_BYTES];
    };

    struct BuffersPayload
    {
        uint32_t count;
        uint32_t width;
        uint32_t height;
        uint32_t stride;
    };

    struct FrameReadyPayload
    {
        uint32_t index;
        uint64_t sequence;
        uint64_t frameTimeNanos;
    };

    struct BufferReleasedPayload
    {
        uint32_t index;
    };

    struct PresentDonePayload
    {
        uint64_t frameTimeNanos;
    };

    struct InputPayload
    {
        InputKind kind;
        int32_t action;
        int32_t pointerId;
        int32_t keyCode;
        uint32_t unicode;
        int32_t metaState;
        float x;
        float y;
        uint64_t timeNanos;
    };

    struct ProgressPayload
    {
        char libraryName[MAX_NAME_BYTES];
        uint64_t functionsDiscovered;
        uint64_t functionsTranslated;
        uint64_t blocksTranslated;
        uint64_t sizeBytes;
        uint64_t memoryBytes;
        uint64_t memoryBudgetBytes;
        double elapsedSeconds;
        float phases[PHASE_COUNT];
        uint32_t translatorVersion;
        bool cacheHit;
    };

    struct StatisticsPayload
    {
        uint64_t blocksExecuted;
        uint64_t blocksTranslated;
        uint64_t blocksInterpreted;
        uint64_t trapsHit;
        uint64_t framesPresented;
    };

    struct LogPayload
    {
        uint8_t priority;
        char tag[MAX_TAG_BYTES];
        char text[MAX_TEXT_BYTES];
    };

    inline constexpr uint32_t MAX_PACKAGE_BYTES = 256;

    struct LaunchPackagePayload
    {
        char packageName[MAX_PACKAGE_BYTES];
    };

    struct ExitPayload
    {
        int32_t status;
    };

    union Payload
    {
        HelloPayload hello;
        BuffersPayload buffers;
        FrameReadyPayload frameReady;
        BufferReleasedPayload bufferReleased;
        PresentDonePayload presentDone;
        InputPayload input;
        ProgressPayload progress;
        StatisticsPayload statistics;
        LogPayload log;
        LaunchPackagePayload launchPackage;
        ExitPayload exit;
    };

    struct Message
    {
        MessageKind kind;
        Payload payload;
    };

    struct Endpoint
    {
        int fileDescriptor = INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR;
        bool peerClosed = false;
        uint64_t messagesSent = 0;
        uint64_t messagesReceived = 0;
        uint64_t malformedReceived = 0;
    };

    Result CreatePair(Endpoint& endpoint, int& peerDescriptor);
    Result Adopt(int fileDescriptor, Endpoint& endpoint);
    Result AdoptFromEnvironment(Endpoint& endpoint);
    void Close(Endpoint& endpoint);

    Result Send(Endpoint& endpoint, const Message& message);
    Result SendWithDescriptors(Endpoint& endpoint, const Message& message, const int* descriptors, uint32_t descriptorCount);

    Result Receive(Endpoint& endpoint, Message& message, int timeoutMillis);
    Result ReceiveWithDescriptors(Endpoint& endpoint, Message& message, int* descriptors, uint32_t& descriptorCount, int timeoutMillis);

    void Prepare(Message& message, MessageKind kind);
    bool CopyText(char* destination, uint32_t capacity, const char* source);

    bool PeerHasGone(Endpoint& endpoint);

    bool IsConfigured();
    bool PublishDescriptor(int fileDescriptor);

    const char* ResultName(Result result);
    const char* MessageKindName(MessageKind kind);
}
```

`src/Diagnostics/Diagnostics.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Diagnostics/Diagnostics.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <ctime>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include <cerrno>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <poll.h>
#include <sys/eventfd.h>
#include <unistd.h>

static std::mutex gGuard;
static std::vector<Diagnostics::Record> gRecords;
static uint64_t gNextSequence = 1;
static uint64_t gWritten = 0;
static uint64_t gDropped = 0;
static uint64_t gTruncated = 0;

static int gOriginalStandardError = -1;
static Diagnostics::ConsoleFilter gConsoleFilter = nullptr;

static void ForwardToConsole(const char* line, uint32_t length)
{
    if (gOriginalStandardError < 0) return;
    if (gConsoleFilter && !gConsoleFilter(line, length)) return;

    uint32_t offset = 0;

    while (offset < length)
    {
        const ssize_t written = ::write(gOriginalStandardError, line + offset, (size_t)(length - offset));
        if (written <= 0) break;

        offset += (uint32_t)written;
    }

    const char newline = '\n';
    const ssize_t ended = ::write(gOriginalStandardError, &newline, 1);
    (void)ended;
}

void Diagnostics::SetConsoleFilter(Diagnostics::ConsoleFilter filter)
{
    gConsoleFilter = filter;
}
static int gCaptureRead = -1;
static int gCaptureWake = -1;
static std::thread gReader;
static std::atomic_bool gReaderRunning{false};

static uint64_t RealtimeNanos()
{
    timespec now{};
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &now);
    return (uint64_t)now.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)now.tv_nsec;
}

static bool PriorityFromLetter(char letter, Diagnostics::Priority& priority)
{
    switch (letter)
    {
        case 'V': priority = Diagnostics::Priority::Verbose; return true;
        case 'D': priority = Diagnostics::Priority::Debug; return true;
        case 'I': priority = Diagnostics::Priority::Info; return true;
        case 'W': priority = Diagnostics::Priority::Warn; return true;
        case 'E': priority = Diagnostics::Priority::Error; return true;
        case 'F': priority = Diagnostics::Priority::Fatal; return true;
        default: return false;
    }
}

static void CopyBounded(char* destination, uint32_t capacity, const char* source, uint32_t length)
{
    if (capacity == 0) return;

    if (length >= capacity)
    {
        length = capacity - 1;
        gTruncated += 1;
    }

    if (source && length > 0) memcpy(destination, source, length);

    destination[length] = '\0';
}

static bool ParseShortForm(const char* line, uint32_t length, Diagnostics::Priority& priority, const char*& tag, uint32_t& tagLength,
                           const char*& text, uint32_t& textLength)
{
    if (length < 4 || line[1] != '/') return false;
    if (!PriorityFromLetter(line[0], priority)) return false;

    for (uint32_t index = 2; index + 1 < length; ++index)
    {
        if (line[index] != ':' || line[index + 1] != ' ') continue;

        tag = line + 2;
        tagLength = index - 2;
        text = line + index + 2;
        textLength = length - index - 2;
        return tagLength > 0;
    }

    return false;
}

static bool ParseModuleForm(const char* line, uint32_t length, const char*& tag, uint32_t& tagLength, const char*& text,
                            uint32_t& textLength)
{
    if (length < 3 || line[0] != '[') return false;

    for (uint32_t index = 1; index < length; ++index)
    {
        if (line[index] != ']') continue;

        tag = line + 1;
        tagLength = index - 1;

        uint32_t start = index + 1;
        while (start < length && line[start] == ' ') start += 1;

        text = line + start;
        textLength = length - start;
        return tagLength > 0;
    }

    return false;
}

static bool ParseLongForm(const char* line, uint32_t length, Diagnostics::Priority& priority, const char*& tag, uint32_t& tagLength,
                          const char*& text, uint32_t& textLength)
{
    if (length < 20) return false;
    if (line[0] < '0' || line[0] > '9' || line[2] != '-') return false;

    uint32_t index = 0;

    while (index + 2 < length)
    {
        const bool isolated = line[index] == ' ' && line[index + 2] == ' ';

        Diagnostics::Priority parsed = Diagnostics::Priority::Info;
        if (isolated && PriorityFromLetter(line[index + 1], parsed))
        {
            priority = parsed;
            index += 3;
            break;
        }

        index += 1;
    }

    if (index + 2 >= length) return false;

    const uint32_t tagStart = index;

    while (index < length && line[index] != ':') index += 1;
    if (index >= length) return false;

    uint32_t tagEnd = index;
    while (tagEnd > tagStart && line[tagEnd - 1] == ' ') tagEnd -= 1;

    uint32_t textStart = index + 1;
    while (textStart < length && line[textStart] == ' ') textStart += 1;

    tag = line + tagStart;
    tagLength = tagEnd - tagStart;
    text = line + textStart;
    textLength = length - textStart;

    return tagLength > 0;
}

bool Diagnostics::Initialize(uint32_t capacity)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gGuard);

    if (!gRecords.empty()) return true;
    if (capacity == 0 || capacity > MAX_CAPACITY) capacity = DEFAULT_CAPACITY;

    gRecords.assign(capacity, Record{});
    gNextSequence = 1;
    gWritten = 0;
    gDropped = 0;
    gTruncated = 0;

    return true;
}

void Diagnostics::Shutdown()
{
    ReleaseStandardError();

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gGuard);
    gRecords.clear();
}

bool Diagnostics::IsInitialized()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gGuard);
    return !gRecords.empty();
}

void Diagnostics::Write(Priority priority, const char* tag, const char* text)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gGuard);

    if (gRecords.empty()) return;

    Record& record = gRecords[(size_t)((gNextSequence - 1) % gRecords.size())];

    if (record.sequence != 0) gDropped += 1;

    record.sequence = gNextSequence;
    record.realtimeNanos = RealtimeNanos();
    record.priority = priority;

    CopyBounded(record.tag, MAX_TAG_BYTES, tag, tag ? (uint32_t)strlen(tag) : 0);
    CopyBounded(record.text, MAX_TEXT_BYTES, text, text ? (uint32_t)strlen(text) : 0);

    gNextSequence += 1;
    gWritten += 1;
}

void Diagnostics::WriteLine(const char* line, uint32_t length)
{
    if (!line || length == 0) return;

    Priority priority = Priority::Info;
    const char* tag = nullptr;
    uint32_t tagLength = 0;
    const char* text = nullptr;
    uint32_t textLength = 0;

    if (!ParseShortForm(line, length, priority, tag, tagLength, text, textLength) &&
        !ParseLongForm(line, length, priority, tag, tagLength, text, textLength) &&
        !ParseModuleForm(line, length, tag, tagLength, text, textLength))
    {
        priority = Priority::Info;
        tag = "stderr";
        tagLength = 6;
        text = line;
        textLength = length;
    }

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gGuard);

    if (gRecords.empty()) return;

    Record& record = gRecords[(size_t)((gNextSequence - 1) % gRecords.size())];

    if (record.sequence != 0) gDropped += 1;

    record.sequence = gNextSequence;
    record.realtimeNanos = RealtimeNanos();
    record.priority = priority;

    CopyBounded(record.tag, MAX_TAG_BYTES, tag, tagLength);
    CopyBounded(record.text, MAX_TEXT_BYTES, text, textLength);

    gNextSequence += 1;
    gWritten += 1;
}

static void ReadCapturedOutput()
{
    std::vector<char> pending;
    char buffer[4096];
    bool stopping = false;

    for (;;)
    {
        pollfd watched[2]{};
        watched[0].fd = gCaptureRead;
        watched[0].events = POLLIN;
        watched[1].fd = gCaptureWake;
        watched[1].events = POLLIN;

        const int ready = poll(watched, 2, -1);

        if (ready < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
        if (ready < 0) break;

        if ((watched[1].revents & POLLIN) != 0) stopping = true;

        if ((watched[0].revents & (POLLIN | POLLHUP)) == 0)
        {
            if (stopping) break;
            continue;
        }

        const ssize_t read = ::read(gCaptureRead, buffer, sizeof(buffer));

        if (read == 0) break;

        if (read < 0)
        {
            if (errno == EINTR) continue;
            if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK)
            {
                if (stopping) break;
                continue;
            }

            break;
        }

        for (ssize_t index = 0; index < read; ++index)
        {
            if (buffer[index] != '\n')
            {
                if (pending.size() < Diagnostics::MAX_TEXT_BYTES * 4) pending.push_back(buffer[index]);
                continue;
            }

            ForwardToConsole(pending.data(), (uint32_t)pending.size());
            Diagnostics::WriteLine(pending.data(), (uint32_t)pending.size());
            pending.clear();
        }
    }

    if (!pending.empty())
    {
        ForwardToConsole(pending.data(), (uint32_t)pending.size());
        Diagnostics::WriteLine(pending.data(), (uint32_t)pending.size());
    }

    gReaderRunning = false;
}

bool Diagnostics::CaptureStandardError()
{
    if (gCaptureRead >= 0) return true;
    if (!IsInitialized()) return false;

    int channel[2] = {-1, -1};
    if (pipe(channel) != 0) return false;

    gCaptureWake = eventfd(0, EFD_CLOEXEC | EFD_NONBLOCK);

    gOriginalStandardError = dup(STDERR_FILENO);

    if (gCaptureWake < 0 || gOriginalStandardError < 0 || dup2(channel[1], STDERR_FILENO) < 0)
    {
        if (gCaptureWake >= 0) close(gCaptureWake);
        close(channel[0]);
        close(channel[1]);
        gCaptureWake = -1;
        return false;
    }

    close(channel[1]);
    gCaptureRead = channel[0];

    setvbuf(stderr, nullptr, _IOLBF, 0);

    gReaderRunning = true;
    gReader = std::thread(&ReadCapturedOutput);

    return true;
}

void Diagnostics::ReleaseStandardError()
{
    if (gCaptureRead < 0) return;

    if (gOriginalStandardError >= 0)
    {
        fflush(stderr);
        dup2(gOriginalStandardError, STDERR_FILENO);
    }

    if (gCaptureWake >= 0)
    {
        const uint64_t one = 1;
        const ssize_t woke = write(gCaptureWake, &one, sizeof(one));
        (void)woke;
    }

    if (gReader.joinable()) gReader.join();

    close(gCaptureRead);
    gCaptureRead = -1;

    if (gCaptureWake >= 0)
    {
        close(gCaptureWake);
        gCaptureWake = -1;
    }

    if (gOriginalStandardError >= 0)
    {
        close(gOriginalStandardError);
        gOriginalStandardError = -1;
    }
}

uint32_t Diagnostics::Read(uint64_t& cursor, Record* records, uint32_t capacity)
{
    if (!records || capacity == 0) return 0;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gGuard);

    if (gRecords.empty()) return 0;

    const uint64_t oldest = gNextSequence > gRecords.size() ? gNextSequence - gRecords.size() : 1;
    if (cursor < oldest) cursor = oldest;

    uint32_t produced = 0;

    while (cursor < gNextSequence && produced < capacity)
    {
        const Record& record = gRecords[(size_t)((cursor - 1) % gRecords.size())];

        if (record.sequence == cursor)
        {
            records[produced] = record;
            produced += 1;
        }

        cursor += 1;
    }

    return produced;
}

uint64_t Diagnostics::NextSequence()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gGuard);
    return gNextSequence;
}

bool Diagnostics::Dump(const char* path)
{
    if (!path || path[0] == '\0') return false;

    FILE* out = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!out) return false;

    uint64_t cursor = 0;
    Record batch[64];

    for (;;)
    {
        const uint32_t produced = Read(cursor, batch, 64);
        if (produced == 0) break;

        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < produced; ++index)
        {
            const Record& record = batch[index];
            const time_t seconds = (time_t)(record.realtimeNanos / 1000000000ull);
            const unsigned millis = (unsigned)((record.realtimeNanos / 1000000ull) % 1000ull);

            tm parts{};
            char stamp[32] = "00-00 00:00:00";

            if (localtime_r(&seconds, &parts)) strftime(stamp, sizeof(stamp), "%m-%d %H:%M:%S", &parts);

            fprintf(out, "%s.%03u %c/%s: %s\n", stamp, millis, PriorityLetter(record.priority), record.tag, record.text);
        }
    }

    fclose(out);
    return true;
}

bool Diagnostics::WriteTombstone(const char* path, uint64_t faultSequence, uint32_t contextLines)
{
    if (!path || path[0] == '\0') return false;
    if (!IsInitialized()) return false;

    uint64_t settled = NextSequence();

    for (int waited = 0; waited < TOMBSTONE_SETTLE_MILLIS; waited += 20)
    {
        timespec pause{};
        pause.tv_nsec = 20 * 1000 * 1000;
        nanosleep(&pause, nullptr);

        const uint64_t now = NextSequence();
        if (now == settled) break;

        settled = now;
    }

    FILE* out = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!out) return false;

    const time_t seconds = (time_t)(RealtimeNanos() / 1000000000ull);
    tm parts{};
    char stamp[64] = "unknown time";

    if (localtime_r(&seconds, &parts)) strftime(stamp, sizeof(stamp), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", &parts);

    fprintf(out, "acl tombstone, written %s\n", stamp);
    fprintf(out, "the fault is at log line %llu; the %u line(s) before it are kept for context\n\n",
            (unsigned long long)faultSequence, contextLines);

    uint64_t cursor = faultSequence > contextLines ? faultSequence - contextLines : 0;
    Record batch[64];
    uint64_t written = 0;

    for (;;)
    {
        const bool crossing = cursor <= faultSequence;
        const uint32_t produced = Read(cursor, batch, 64);
        if (produced == 0) break;

        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < produced; ++index)
        {
            const Record& record = batch[index];

            if (crossing && record.sequence == faultSequence) fprintf(out, "--- the fault begins here ---\n");

            const time_t line = (time_t)(record.realtimeNanos / 1000000000ull);
            const unsigned millis = (unsigned)((record.realtimeNanos / 1000000ull) % 1000ull);

            tm lineParts{};
            char lineStamp[32] = "00-00 00:00:00";

            if (localtime_r(&line, &lineParts)) strftime(lineStamp, sizeof(lineStamp), "%m-%d %H:%M:%S", &lineParts);

            fprintf(out, "%s.%03u %c/%s: %s\n", lineStamp, millis, PriorityLetter(record.priority), record.tag, record.text);
            written += 1;
        }
    }

    fprintf(out, "\n%llu line(s) written\n", (unsigned long long)written);
    fclose(out);

    return written > 0;
}

Diagnostics::Statistics Diagnostics::GetStatistics()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gGuard);

    Statistics statistics;
    statistics.written = gWritten;
    statistics.dropped = gDropped;
    statistics.truncated = gTruncated;
    statistics.capacity = (uint32_t)gRecords.size();
    statistics.held = gRecords.empty() ? 0 : (uint32_t)(gNextSequence - 1 < gRecords.size() ? gNextSequence - 1 : gRecords.size());

    return statistics;
}

static std::mutex gGapGuard;
static std::vector<Diagnostics::GapRecord> gGaps;
static uint64_t gGapHits = 0;
static uint64_t gGapsBeyondCapacity = 0;

void Diagnostics::NoteGap(Gap kind, const char* name)
{
    if (!name || name[0] == '\0') return;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gGapGuard);

    gGapHits += 1;

    for (GapRecord& record : gGaps)
    {
        if (record.kind != kind || strncmp(record.name, name, MAX_GAP_NAME_BYTES - 1) != 0) continue;

        record.count += 1;
        return;
    }

    if (gGaps.size() >= MAX_GAPS)
    {
        gGapsBeyondCapacity += 1;
        return;
    }

    GapRecord created{};
    created.kind = kind;
    created.count = 1;

    const size_t length = strnlen(name, MAX_GAP_NAME_BYTES - 1);
    memcpy(created.name, name, length);
    created.name[length] = '\0';

    gGaps.push_back(created);
}

uint32_t Diagnostics::ReadGaps(GapRecord* records, uint32_t capacity)
{
    if (!records || capacity == 0) return 0;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gGapGuard);

    uint32_t produced = 0;

    for (const GapRecord& record : gGaps)
    {
        if (produced >= capacity) break;

        records[produced] = record;
        produced += 1;
    }

    return produced;
}

uint32_t Diagnostics::DistinctGaps()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gGapGuard);
    return (uint32_t)gGaps.size();
}

uint64_t Diagnostics::TotalGapHits()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gGapGuard);
    return gGapHits;
}

void Diagnostics::ReportGaps()
{
    std::vector<GapRecord> snapshot;
    uint64_t hits = 0;
    uint64_t beyond = 0;

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gGapGuard);
        snapshot = gGaps;
        hits = gGapHits;
        beyond = gGapsBeyondCapacity;
    }

    if (snapshot.empty())
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[diagnostics] this app asked for nothing this runtime does not have\n");
        return;
    }

    std::sort(snapshot.begin(), snapshot.end(), [](const GapRecord& left, const GapRecord& right) {
        if (left.kind != right.kind) return left.kind < right.kind;
        return left.count > right.count;
    });

    fprintf(stderr, "[diagnostics] this app asked for %zu thing(s) this runtime does not have, %llu time(s) in total:\n",
            snapshot.size(), (unsigned long long)hits);

    for (const GapRecord& record : snapshot)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[diagnostics]   %-11s %-64s x%llu\n", GapName(record.kind), record.name, (unsigned long long)record.count);
    }

    if (beyond > 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[diagnostics]   and %llu more that did not fit in the report\n", (unsigned long long)beyond);
    }
}

const char* Diagnostics::GapName(Gap kind)
{
    switch (kind)
    {
        case Gap::FrameworkMethod: return "framework";
        case Gap::JniSlot: return "jni";
        case Gap::GuestSymbol: return "guest";
        case Gap::Syscall: return "syscall";
        case Gap::Instruction: return "instruction";
        case Gap::Other: return "other";
    }

    return "unknown";
}

char Diagnostics::PriorityLetter(Priority priority)
{
    switch (priority)
    {
        case Priority::Verbose: return 'V';
        case Priority::Debug: return 'D';
        case Priority::Info: return 'I';
        case Priority::Warn: return 'W';
        case Priority::Error: return 'E';
        case Priority::Fatal: return 'F';
    }

    return '?';
}

const char* Diagnostics::PriorityName(Priority priority)
{
    switch (priority)
    {
        case Priority::Verbose: return "verbose";
        case Priority::Debug: return "debug";
        case Priority::Info: return "info";
        case Priority::Warn: return "warn";
        case Priority::Error: return "error";
        case Priority::Fatal: return "fatal";
    }

    return "unknown";
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

namespace Diagnostics
{
    inline constexpr uint32_t MAX_TAG_BYTES = 48;
    inline constexpr uint32_t MAX_TEXT_BYTES = 512;
    inline constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_CAPACITY = 4096;
    inline constexpr uint32_t MAX_CAPACITY = 262144;

    inline constexpr const char* FILE_SETTING = "log";
    inline constexpr const char* TOMBSTONE_SETTING = "tombstone";
    inline constexpr uint32_t TOMBSTONE_CONTEXT_LINES = 200;
    inline constexpr int TOMBSTONE_SETTLE_MILLIS = 400;

    enum class Priority : uint8_t
    {
        Verbose,
        Debug,
        Info,
        Warn,
        Error,
        Fatal
    };

    struct Record
    {
        uint64_t sequence;
        uint64_t realtimeNanos;
        Priority priority;
        char tag[MAX_TAG_BYTES];
        char text[MAX_TEXT_BYTES];
    };

    struct Statistics
    {
        uint64_t written = 0;
        uint64_t dropped = 0;
        uint64_t truncated = 0;
        uint32_t capacity = 0;
        uint32_t held = 0;
    };

    bool Initialize(uint32_t capacity);
    void Shutdown();
    bool IsInitialized();

    void Write(Priority priority, const char* tag, const char* text);
    void WriteLine(const char* line, uint32_t length);

    using ConsoleFilter = bool (*)(const char* line, uint32_t length);

    void SetConsoleFilter(ConsoleFilter filter);

    bool CaptureStandardError();
    void ReleaseStandardError();

    uint32_t Read(uint64_t& cursor, Record* records, uint32_t capacity);
    uint64_t NextSequence();

    bool Dump(const char* path);
    bool WriteTombstone(const char* path, uint64_t faultSequence, uint32_t contextLines);
    Statistics GetStatistics();

    inline constexpr uint32_t MAX_GAPS = 512;
    inline constexpr uint32_t MAX_GAP_NAME_BYTES = 160;

    enum class Gap : uint8_t
    {
        FrameworkMethod,
        JniSlot,
        GuestSymbol,
        Syscall,
        Instruction,
        Other
    };

    struct GapRecord
    {
        Gap kind;
        uint64_t count;
        char name[MAX_GAP_NAME_BYTES];
    };

    void NoteGap(Gap kind, const char* name);
    uint32_t ReadGaps(GapRecord* records, uint32_t capacity);
    uint32_t DistinctGaps();
    uint64_t TotalGapHits();
    void ReportGaps();

    const char* GapName(Gap kind);

    char PriorityLetter(Priority priority);
    const char* PriorityName(Priority priority);
}
```
