`src/FontStack/FontStack.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "FontStack/FontStack.hpp"

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include <ft2build.h>
#include FT_FREETYPE_H
#include FT_MULTIPLE_MASTERS_H

#include <hb-ft.h>
#include <hb.h>

#include "FontStack/FontRegistry.hpp"
#include "FontStack/GlyphCache.hpp"
#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"

struct FontEntry
{
    std::string fileName;
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
    FT_Face face = nullptr;
    hb_font_t* shaper = nullptr;
    float weightAxis = FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL;
    float widthAxis = FontRegistry::AXIS_WIDTH_NORMAL;
    float italicAxis = 0.0f;
    bool syntheticItalic = false;
    int weight = FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL;
    bool italic = false;
};

struct StyleEntry
{
    uint32_t font = FontStack::INVALID_FONT;
    float textSize = 0.0f;
    float scaleX = 1.0f;
    float skewX = 0.0f;
    float letterSpacing = 0.0f;
    int flags = 0;
};

struct RunEntry
{
    uint32_t generation = 0;
    uint32_t style = FontStack::INVALID_STYLE;
    bool live = false;
    float advance = 0.0f;
    std::vector<FontStack::GlyphPosition> glyphs;
};

static FT_Library gLibrary = nullptr;
static std::string gFontDirectory;
static std::vector<FontEntry> gFonts;
static std::vector<StyleEntry> gStyles;
static std::vector<RunEntry> gRuns;
static std::vector<size_t> gFreeRuns;
static std::thread::id gOwnerThread;
static bool gInitialized = false;

static bool OnOwnerThread()
{
    return std::this_thread::get_id() == gOwnerThread;
}

static float ClampTextSize(float textSize)
{
    if (!(textSize > 0.0f)) return FontStack::MIN_TEXT_SIZE;
    if (textSize < FontStack::MIN_TEXT_SIZE) return FontStack::MIN_TEXT_SIZE;
    if (textSize > FontStack::MAX_TEXT_SIZE) return FontStack::MAX_TEXT_SIZE;
    return textSize;
}

static FT_Fixed ToFixed(float value)
{
    return static_cast<FT_Fixed>(std::lround(static_cast<double>(value) * 65536.0));
}

static FontStack::Result ApplyVariationAxes(FontEntry& entry)
{
    FT_MM_Var* variations = nullptr;
    if (FT_Get_MM_Var(entry.face, &variations) != 0 || !variations) return FontStack::Result::Ok;

    std::vector<FT_Fixed> coordinates(variations->num_axis, 0);
    std::vector<hb_variation_t> shaperAxes;

    for (FT_UInt axis = 0; axis < variations->num_axis; ++axis)
    {
        uint32_t tag = static_cast<uint32_t>(variations->axis[axis].tag);
        float wanted = static_cast<float>(variations->axis[axis].def) / 65536.0f;

        if (tag == FT_MAKE_TAG('w', 'g', 'h', 't')) wanted = entry.weightAxis;
        else if (tag == FT_MAKE_TAG('w', 'd', 't', 'h')) wanted = entry.widthAxis;
        else if (tag == FT_MAKE_TAG('i', 't', 'a', 'l')) wanted = entry.italicAxis;

        float minimum = static_cast<float>(variations->axis[axis].minimum) / 65536.0f;
        float maximum = static_cast<float>(variations->axis[axis].maximum) / 65536.0f;
        if (wanted < minimum) wanted = minimum;
        if (wanted > maximum) wanted = maximum;

        coordinates[axis] = ToFixed(wanted);

        hb_variation_t shaperAxis{};
        shaperAxis.tag = tag;
        shaperAxis.value = wanted;
        shaperAxes.push_back(shaperAxis);
    }

    FT_Error setError = FT_Set_Var_Design_Coordinates(entry.face, variations->num_axis, coordinates.data());
    FT_Done_MM_Var(gLibrary, variations);

    if (setError != 0) return FontStack::Result::FontFileMalformed;

    if (entry.shaper && !shaperAxes.empty())
    {
        hb_font_set_variations(entry.shaper, shaperAxes.data(), static_cast<unsigned int>(shaperAxes.size()));
    }

    return FontStack::Result::Ok;
}

static FontStack::Result CreateFont(std::vector<uint8_t>&& bytes, const FontRegistry::Selection& selection, int weight, bool italic,
                                    uint32_t& font)
{
    if (gFonts.size() >= static_cast<size_t>(FontStack::MAX_FONT_COUNT)) return FontStack::Result::FontTableFull;

    FontEntry entry;
    entry.bytes = std::move(bytes);
    entry.fileName = selection.fileName ? selection.fileName : "";
    entry.weightAxis = selection.weightAxis;
    entry.widthAxis = selection.widthAxis;
    entry.italicAxis = selection.italicAxis;
    entry.syntheticItalic = selection.syntheticItalic;
    entry.weight = weight;
    entry.italic = italic;

    FT_Error error = FT_New_Memory_Face(gLibrary, entry.bytes.data(), static_cast<FT_Long>(entry.bytes.size()), 0, &entry.face);
    if (error != 0) return FontStack::Result::FontFileMalformed;

    if (entry.face->units_per_EM == 0)
    {
        FT_Done_Face(entry.face);
        return FontStack::Result::FontFileMalformed;
    }

    entry.shaper = hb_ft_font_create_referenced(entry.face);
    if (!entry.shaper)
    {
        FT_Done_Face(entry.face);
        return FontStack::Result::FontFileMalformed;
    }

    hb_ft_font_set_load_flags(entry.shaper, FT_LOAD_NO_HINTING | FT_LOAD_NO_BITMAP);

    FontStack::Result applied = ApplyVariationAxes(entry);
    if (applied != FontStack::Result::Ok)
    {
        hb_font_destroy(entry.shaper);
        FT_Done_Face(entry.face);
        return applied;
    }

    gFonts.push_back(std::move(entry));
    font = static_cast<uint32_t>(gFonts.size());
    return FontStack::Result::Ok;
}

static FontEntry* FontFrom(uint32_t font)
{
    if (font == FontStack::INVALID_FONT || font > gFonts.size()) return nullptr;
    return &gFonts[font - 1];
}

static StyleEntry* StyleFrom(uint32_t style)
{
    if (style == FontStack::INVALID_STYLE || style > gStyles.size()) return nullptr;
    return &gStyles[style - 1];
}

static FontStack::Result PrepareFace(const StyleEntry& style, FontEntry*& entry)
{
    entry = FontFrom(style.font);
    if (!entry) return FontStack::Result::InvalidFont;

    FT_F26Dot6 size = static_cast<FT_F26Dot6>(std::lround(static_cast<double>(style.textSize) * 64.0));
    if (FT_Set_Char_Size(entry->face, 0, size, 72, 72) != 0) return FontStack::Result::RasterizationFailed;

    hb_ft_font_changed(entry->shaper);
    return FontStack::Result::Ok;
}

static bool ReadFile(const std::string& path, std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes)
{
    FILE* handle = fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!handle) return false;

    if (fseek(handle, 0, SEEK_END) != 0)
    {
        fclose(handle);
        return false;
    }

    long length = ftell(handle);
    if (length <= 0 || static_cast<size_t>(length) > FontStack::MAX_FONT_FILE_BYTES)
    {
        fclose(handle);
        return false;
    }

    rewind(handle);
    bytes.resize(static_cast<size_t>(length));
    size_t got = fread(bytes.data(), 1, bytes.size(), handle);
    fclose(handle);

    return got == bytes.size();
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::Initialize(const char* fontDirectory)
{
    if (gInitialized) return Result::AlreadyInitialized;

    const char* directory = fontDirectory;
    if (!directory || !*directory) directory = Settings::Lookup(FontStack::DIRECTORY_SETTING);
    if (!directory || !*directory) directory = RUNTIME_DEFAULT_FONT_DIR;

    std::string probe = std::string(directory) + "/Roboto-Regular.ttf";
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
    if (!ReadFile(probe, bytes)) return Result::FontDirectoryMissing;

    if (FT_Init_FreeType(&gLibrary) != 0) return Result::RasterizationFailed;

    gFontDirectory = directory;
    gOwnerThread = std::this_thread::get_id();
    gInitialized = true;
    return Result::Ok;
}

void FontStack::Shutdown()
{
    if (!gInitialized) return;

    ShapeCache::Clear();
    GlyphCache::Clear();

    for (FontEntry& entry : gFonts)
    {
        if (entry.shaper) hb_font_destroy(entry.shaper);
        if (entry.face) FT_Done_Face(entry.face);
    }

    gFonts.clear();
    gStyles.clear();
    gRuns.clear();
    gFreeRuns.clear();

    if (gLibrary) FT_Done_FreeType(gLibrary);
    gLibrary = nullptr;
    gInitialized = false;
}

bool FontStack::IsInitialized()
{
    return gInitialized;
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::ResolveFamily(const char* familyName, int weight, bool italic, uint32_t& font)
{
    if (!gInitialized) return Result::NotInitialized;
    if (!OnOwnerThread()) return Result::WrongThread;

    FontRegistry::Selection selection;
    if (!FontRegistry::Resolve(familyName, weight, italic, selection)) return Result::UnknownFamily;

    for (size_t index = 0; index < gFonts.size(); ++index)
    {
        const FontEntry& entry = gFonts[index];
        if (entry.fileName != selection.fileName) continue;
        if (entry.weightAxis != selection.weightAxis) continue;
        if (entry.widthAxis != selection.widthAxis) continue;
        if (entry.italicAxis != selection.italicAxis) continue;
        if (entry.syntheticItalic != selection.syntheticItalic) continue;

        font = static_cast<uint32_t>(index + 1);
        return Result::Ok;
    }

    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
    if (!ReadFile(gFontDirectory + "/" + selection.fileName, bytes)) return Result::FontFileUnreadable;

    return CreateFont(std::move(bytes), selection, weight, italic, font);
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::LoadFontFromMemory(const uint8_t* fontBytes, size_t byteCount, int weight, bool italic, uint32_t& font)
{
    if (!gInitialized) return Result::NotInitialized;
    if (!OnOwnerThread()) return Result::WrongThread;
    if (!fontBytes || byteCount == 0) return Result::InvalidArgument;
    if (byteCount > MAX_FONT_FILE_BYTES) return Result::FontFileTooLarge;

    FontRegistry::Selection selection;
    selection.fileName = "";
    selection.weightAxis = static_cast<float>(weight);
    selection.widthAxis = FontRegistry::AXIS_WIDTH_NORMAL;
    selection.italicAxis = italic ? 1.0f : 0.0f;

    std::vector<uint8_t> copied(fontBytes, fontBytes + byteCount);
    return CreateFont(std::move(copied), selection, weight, italic, font);
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::FontWeight(uint32_t font, int& weight)
{
    FontEntry* entry = FontFrom(font);
    if (!entry) return Result::InvalidFont;

    weight = entry->weight;
    return Result::Ok;
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::FontIsItalic(uint32_t font, bool& italic)
{
    FontEntry* entry = FontFrom(font);
    if (!entry) return Result::InvalidFont;

    italic = entry->italic;
    return Result::Ok;
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::InternStyle(uint32_t font, float textSize, float scaleX, float skewX, float letterSpacing, int flags,
                                         uint32_t& style)
{
    if (!gInitialized) return Result::NotInitialized;
    if (!OnOwnerThread()) return Result::WrongThread;
    if (!FontFrom(font)) return Result::InvalidFont;

    float clamped = ClampTextSize(textSize);

    for (size_t index = 0; index < gStyles.size(); ++index)
    {
        const StyleEntry& entry = gStyles[index];
        if (entry.font != font) continue;
        if (entry.textSize != clamped) continue;
        if (entry.scaleX != scaleX) continue;
        if (entry.skewX != skewX) continue;
        if (entry.letterSpacing != letterSpacing) continue;
        if (entry.flags != flags) continue;

        style = static_cast<uint32_t>(index + 1);
        return Result::Ok;
    }

    if (gStyles.size() >= static_cast<size_t>(MAX_STYLE_COUNT)) return Result::StyleTableFull;

    StyleEntry entry;
    entry.font = font;
    entry.textSize = clamped;
    entry.scaleX = scaleX;
    entry.skewX = skewX;
    entry.letterSpacing = letterSpacing;
    entry.flags = flags;

    gStyles.push_back(entry);
    style = static_cast<uint32_t>(gStyles.size());
    return Result::Ok;
}

static RunEntry* RunFrom(uint64_t run);

static FontStack::Result ShapeInternal(uint32_t style, const uint16_t* text, int32_t count, bool rightToLeft,
                                       std::vector<FontStack::GlyphPosition>& glyphs, float& advance)
{
    if (!gInitialized) return FontStack::Result::NotInitialized;
    if (!OnOwnerThread()) return FontStack::Result::WrongThread;
    if (!text && count > 0) return FontStack::Result::InvalidArgument;
    if (count < 0) return FontStack::Result::InvalidArgument;
    if (count > FontStack::MAX_RUN_LENGTH) return FontStack::Result::TextTooLong;

    StyleEntry* entry = StyleFrom(style);
    if (!entry) return FontStack::Result::InvalidStyle;

    FontEntry* font = nullptr;
    FontStack::Result prepared = PrepareFace(*entry, font);
    if (prepared != FontStack::Result::Ok) return prepared;

    glyphs.clear();
    advance = 0.0f;
    if (count == 0) return FontStack::Result::Ok;

    hb_buffer_t* buffer = hb_buffer_create();
    if (!buffer) return FontStack::Result::ShapingFailed;

    hb_buffer_add_utf16(buffer, text, count, 0, count);
    hb_buffer_guess_segment_properties(buffer);
    hb_buffer_set_direction(buffer, rightToLeft ? HB_DIRECTION_RTL : HB_DIRECTION_LTR);

    hb_shape(font->shaper, buffer, nullptr, 0);

    unsigned int produced = 0;
    hb_glyph_info_t* infos = hb_buffer_get_glyph_infos(buffer, &produced);
    hb_glyph_position_t* positions = hb_buffer_get_glyph_positions(buffer, &produced);

    if (!infos || !positions)
    {
        hb_buffer_destroy(buffer);
        return FontStack::Result::ShapingFailed;
    }

    float penX = 0.0f;
    float penY = 0.0f;
    glyphs.reserve(produced);

    for (unsigned int index = 0; index < produced; ++index)
    {
        FontStack::GlyphPosition position;
        position.glyphId = infos[index].codepoint;
        position.cluster = static_cast<int32_t>(infos[index].cluster);
        position.x = (penX + static_cast<float>(positions[index].x_offset) / 64.0f) * entry->scaleX;
        position.y = penY + static_cast<float>(positions[index].y_offset) / 64.0f;
        glyphs.push_back(position);

        float shaped = static_cast<float>(positions[index].x_advance) / 64.0f;
        float base = static_cast<float>(hb_font_get_glyph_h_advance(font->shaper, infos[index].codepoint)) / 64.0f;

        penX += std::round(base) + (shaped - base) + entry->letterSpacing;
        penY += static_cast<float>(positions[index].y_advance) / 64.0f;
    }

    hb_buffer_destroy(buffer);

    advance = penX * entry->scaleX;
    return FontStack::Result::Ok;
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::MeasureText(uint32_t style, const uint16_t* text, int32_t count, float& advance)
{
    std::vector<GlyphPosition> glyphs;
    Result shaped = ShapeInternal(style, text, count, false, glyphs, advance);
    if (shaped != Result::Ok) return shaped;

    advance = std::ceil(advance - ADVANCE_EPSILON);
    return Result::Ok;
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::TextWidths(uint32_t style, const uint16_t* text, int32_t count, float* outWidths, int32_t& written)
{
    written = 0;
    if (!outWidths && count > 0) return Result::InvalidArgument;

    std::vector<GlyphPosition> glyphs;
    float advance = 0.0f;
    Result shaped = ShapeInternal(style, text, count, false, glyphs, advance);
    if (shaped != Result::Ok) return shaped;

    for (int32_t index = 0; index < count; ++index)
    {
        outWidths[index] = 0.0f;
    }

    for (size_t index = 0; index < glyphs.size(); ++index)
    {
        float next = index + 1 < glyphs.size() ? glyphs[index + 1].x : advance;
        int32_t cluster = glyphs[index].cluster;
        if (cluster < 0 || cluster >= count) continue;
        outWidths[cluster] += next - glyphs[index].x;
    }

    written = count;
    return Result::Ok;
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::FontMetrics(uint32_t style, Metrics& metrics)
{
    if (!gInitialized) return Result::NotInitialized;
    if (!OnOwnerThread()) return Result::WrongThread;

    StyleEntry* entry = StyleFrom(style);
    if (!entry) return Result::InvalidStyle;

    FontEntry* font = nullptr;
    Result prepared = PrepareFace(*entry, font);
    if (prepared != Result::Ok) return prepared;

    const FT_Size_Metrics& sized = font->face->size->metrics;
    FT_Fixed verticalScale = sized.y_scale;

    metrics.ascent = -static_cast<float>(FT_MulFix(font->face->ascender, verticalScale)) / 64.0f;
    metrics.descent = -static_cast<float>(FT_MulFix(font->face->descender, verticalScale)) / 64.0f;
    metrics.top = -static_cast<float>(FT_MulFix(font->face->bbox.yMax, verticalScale)) / 64.0f;
    metrics.bottom = -static_cast<float>(FT_MulFix(font->face->bbox.yMin, verticalScale)) / 64.0f;
    metrics.leading = static_cast<float>(FT_MulFix(font->face->height, verticalScale)) / 64.0f - (metrics.descent - metrics.ascent);

    return Result::Ok;
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::TextBounds(uint32_t style, const uint16_t* text, int32_t count, Bounds& bounds)
{
    std::vector<GlyphPosition> glyphs;
    float advance = 0.0f;
    Result shaped = ShapeInternal(style, text, count, false, glyphs, advance);
    if (shaped != Result::Ok) return shaped;

    bounds = Bounds{};
    if (glyphs.empty()) return Result::Ok;

    bool first = true;
    for (const GlyphPosition& glyph : glyphs)
    {
        GlyphImage image;
        if (RasterizeGlyph(style, glyph.glyphId, image) != Result::Ok) continue;

        int32_t left = static_cast<int32_t>(std::lround(glyph.x)) + image.bearingX;
        int32_t top = -image.bearingY;
        int32_t right = left + image.width;
        int32_t bottom = top + image.height;

        if (first)
        {
            bounds.left = left;
            bounds.top = top;
            bounds.right = right;
            bounds.bottom = bottom;
            first = false;
            continue;
        }

        if (left < bounds.left) bounds.left = left;
        if (top < bounds.top) bounds.top = top;
        if (right > bounds.right) bounds.right = right;
        if (bottom > bounds.bottom) bounds.bottom = bottom;
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::BreakText(uint32_t style, const uint16_t* text, int32_t count, float maxWidth, bool forwards,
                                       int32_t& breakAt, float& measuredWidth)
{
    breakAt = 0;
    measuredWidth = 0.0f;

    std::vector<GlyphPosition> glyphs;
    float advance = 0.0f;
    Result shaped = ShapeInternal(style, text, count, false, glyphs, advance);
    if (shaped != Result::Ok) return shaped;

    if (advance <= maxWidth)
    {
        breakAt = count;
        measuredWidth = advance;
        return Result::Ok;
    }

    if (forwards)
    {
        for (size_t index = 0; index < glyphs.size(); ++index)
        {
            float edge = index + 1 < glyphs.size() ? glyphs[index + 1].x : advance;
            if (edge > maxWidth) break;

            breakAt = index + 1 < glyphs.size() ? glyphs[index + 1].cluster : count;
            measuredWidth = edge;
        }
        return Result::Ok;
    }

    for (size_t index = glyphs.size(); index > 0; --index)
    {
        float consumed = advance - glyphs[index - 1].x;
        if (consumed > maxWidth) break;

        breakAt = count - glyphs[index - 1].cluster;
        measuredWidth = consumed;
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::HasGlyph(uint32_t style, const uint16_t* text, int32_t count, bool& present)
{
    present = false;

    std::vector<GlyphPosition> glyphs;
    float advance = 0.0f;
    Result shaped = ShapeInternal(style, text, count, false, glyphs, advance);
    if (shaped != Result::Ok) return shaped;

    if (glyphs.size() != 1) return Result::Ok;

    present = glyphs[0].glyphId != 0;
    return Result::Ok;
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::ShapeRun(uint32_t style, const uint16_t* text, int32_t count, bool rightToLeft, uint64_t& run)
{
    run = INVALID_RUN;

    uint64_t cached = INVALID_RUN;
    if (ShapeCache::Lookup(style, text, count, rightToLeft, cached))
    {
        if (RunFrom(cached))
        {
            run = cached;
            return Result::Ok;
        }

        ShapeCache::Forget(cached);
    }

    std::vector<GlyphPosition> glyphs;
    float advance = 0.0f;
    Result shaped = ShapeInternal(style, text, count, rightToLeft, glyphs, advance);
    if (shaped != Result::Ok) return shaped;

    size_t slot = 0;
    if (!gFreeRuns.empty())
    {
        slot = gFreeRuns.back();
        gFreeRuns.pop_back();
    }
    else
    {
        gRuns.push_back(RunEntry{});
        slot = gRuns.size() - 1;
    }

    RunEntry& entry = gRuns[slot];
    entry.generation += 1;
    entry.style = style;
    entry.live = true;
    entry.advance = advance;
    entry.glyphs = std::move(glyphs);

    run = (static_cast<uint64_t>(entry.generation) << 32) | static_cast<uint64_t>(slot + 1);

    uint64_t evicted = INVALID_RUN;
    ShapeCache::Insert(style, text, count, rightToLeft, run, evicted);
    if (evicted != INVALID_RUN && evicted != run) ReleaseRun(evicted);

    return Result::Ok;
}

static RunEntry* RunFrom(uint64_t run)
{
    uint32_t slot = static_cast<uint32_t>(run & 0xFFFFFFFFull);
    uint32_t generation = static_cast<uint32_t>(run >> 32);
    if (slot == 0 || slot > gRuns.size()) return nullptr;

    RunEntry& entry = gRuns[slot - 1];
    if (!entry.live || entry.generation != generation) return nullptr;
    return &entry;
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::RunAdvance(uint64_t run, float& advance)
{
    RunEntry* entry = RunFrom(run);
    if (!entry) return Result::InvalidRun;

    advance = entry->advance;
    return Result::Ok;
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::RunGlyphCount(uint64_t run, int32_t& count)
{
    RunEntry* entry = RunFrom(run);
    if (!entry) return Result::InvalidRun;

    count = static_cast<int32_t>(entry->glyphs.size());
    return Result::Ok;
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::RunGlyph(uint64_t run, int32_t index, GlyphPosition& position)
{
    RunEntry* entry = RunFrom(run);
    if (!entry) return Result::InvalidRun;
    if (index < 0 || index >= static_cast<int32_t>(entry->glyphs.size())) return Result::InvalidArgument;

    position = entry->glyphs[static_cast<size_t>(index)];
    return Result::Ok;
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::ReleaseRun(uint64_t run)
{
    RunEntry* entry = RunFrom(run);
    if (!entry) return Result::InvalidRun;

    uint32_t slot = static_cast<uint32_t>(run & 0xFFFFFFFFull);
    entry->live = false;
    entry->glyphs.clear();
    gFreeRuns.push_back(slot - 1);
    return Result::Ok;
}

FontStack::Result FontStack::RasterizeGlyph(uint32_t style, uint32_t glyphId, GlyphImage& image)
{
    if (!gInitialized) return Result::NotInitialized;
    if (!OnOwnerThread()) return Result::WrongThread;

    StyleEntry* entry = StyleFrom(style);
    if (!entry) return Result::InvalidStyle;

    uint64_t key = GlyphCache::KeyFor(style, glyphId, entry->flags);
    if (GlyphCache::Lookup(key, image)) return Result::Ok;

    FontEntry* font = nullptr;
    Result prepared = PrepareFace(*entry, font);
    if (prepared != Result::Ok) return prepared;

    if (FT_Load_Glyph(font->face, glyphId, FT_LOAD_NO_HINTING | FT_LOAD_NO_BITMAP) != 0) return Result::RasterizationFailed;
    if (FT_Render_Glyph(font->face->glyph, FT_RENDER_MODE_NORMAL) != 0) return Result::RasterizationFailed;

    const FT_Bitmap& bitmap = font->face->glyph->bitmap;
    image.samples = bitmap.buffer;
    image.width = static_cast<int32_t>(bitmap.width);
    image.height = static_cast<int32_t>(bitmap.rows);
    image.pitch = bitmap.pitch;
    image.bearingX = font->face->glyph->bitmap_left;
    image.bearingY = font->face->glyph->bitmap_top;

    if (GlyphCache::ShouldCache(image.width, image.height)) GlyphCache::Insert(key, image);
    return Result::Ok;
}

const char* FontStack::ResultName(Result result)
{
    switch (result)
    {
        case Result::Ok: return "Ok";
        case Result::NotInitialized: return "NotInitialized";
        case Result::AlreadyInitialized: return "AlreadyInitialized";
        case Result::FontDirectoryMissing: return "FontDirectoryMissing";
        case Result::FontFileUnreadable: return "FontFileUnreadable";
        case Result::FontFileMalformed: return "FontFileMalformed";
        case Result::FontFileTooLarge: return "FontFileTooLarge";
        case Result::UnknownFamily: return "UnknownFamily";
        case Result::InvalidFont: return "InvalidFont";
        case Result::InvalidStyle: return "InvalidStyle";
        case Result::InvalidRun: return "InvalidRun";
        case Result::InvalidArgument: return "InvalidArgument";
        case Result::TextTooLong: return "TextTooLong";
        case Result::StyleTableFull: return "StyleTableFull";
        case Result::FontTableFull: return "FontTableFull";
        case Result::ShapingFailed: return "ShapingFailed";
        case Result::RasterizationFailed: return "RasterizationFailed";
        case Result::WrongThread: return "WrongThread";
    }

    return "Unknown";
}
```

`src/FontStack/GlyphCache.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "FontStack/GlyphCache.hpp"

#include <cstring>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

struct CachedGlyph
{
    std::vector<uint8_t> samples;
    int32_t width = 0;
    int32_t height = 0;
    int32_t pitch = 0;
    int32_t bearingX = 0;
    int32_t bearingY = 0;
    uint64_t lastUsed = 0;
};

static std::unordered_map<uint64_t, CachedGlyph> gGlyphs;
static GlyphCache::Statistics gStatistics;
static uint64_t gClock = 0;

uint64_t GlyphCache::KeyFor(uint32_t style, uint32_t glyphId, int flags)
{
    uint64_t key = static_cast<uint64_t>(style) & 0xFFFFull;
    key |= (static_cast<uint64_t>(glyphId) & 0xFFFFFFull) << 16;
    key |= (static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<uint32_t>(flags)) & 0xFFull) << 40;
    return key;
}

bool GlyphCache::ShouldCache(int32_t width, int32_t height)
{
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return false;
    return width <= FontStack::MAX_CACHED_GLYPH_DIMENSION && height <= FontStack::MAX_CACHED_GLYPH_DIMENSION;
}

bool GlyphCache::Lookup(uint64_t key, FontStack::GlyphImage& image)
{
    gStatistics.lookups += 1;

    auto found = gGlyphs.find(key);
    if (found == gGlyphs.end()) return false;

    found->second.lastUsed = ++gClock;
    image.samples = found->second.samples.data();
    image.width = found->second.width;
    image.height = found->second.height;
    image.pitch = found->second.pitch;
    image.bearingX = found->second.bearingX;
    image.bearingY = found->second.bearingY;

    gStatistics.hits += 1;
    return true;
}

static void EvictUntilUnder(size_t budget)
{
    while (gStatistics.bytesResident > budget && !gGlyphs.empty())
    {
        auto oldest = gGlyphs.begin();
        for (auto candidate = gGlyphs.begin(); candidate != gGlyphs.end(); ++candidate)
        {
            if (candidate->second.lastUsed < oldest->second.lastUsed) oldest = candidate;
        }

        gStatistics.bytesResident -= oldest->second.samples.size();
        gStatistics.entriesResident -= 1;
        gStatistics.evictions += 1;
        gGlyphs.erase(oldest);
    }
}

bool GlyphCache::Insert(uint64_t key, const FontStack::GlyphImage& image)
{
    if (!ShouldCache(image.width, image.height))
    {
        gStatistics.bypasses += 1;
        return false;
    }

    if (!image.samples) return false;

    size_t rowBytes = static_cast<size_t>(image.width);
    size_t total = rowBytes * static_cast<size_t>(image.height);

    CachedGlyph entry;
    entry.samples.resize(total);
    for (int32_t row = 0; row < image.height; ++row)
    {
        const uint8_t* source = image.samples + static_cast<ptrdiff_t>(row) * image.pitch;
        memcpy(entry.samples.data() + static_cast<size_t>(row) * rowBytes, source, rowBytes);
    }

    entry.width = image.width;
    entry.height = image.height;
    entry.pitch = image.width;
    entry.bearingX = image.bearingX;
    entry.bearingY = image.bearingY;
    entry.lastUsed = ++gClock;

    gStatistics.bytesResident += total;
    gStatistics.entriesResident += 1;
    gGlyphs[key] = std::move(entry);

    EvictUntilUnder(FontStack::MAX_GLYPH_CACHE_BYTES);
    return true;
}

void GlyphCache::Clear()
{
    gGlyphs.clear();
    gStatistics = Statistics{};
    gClock = 0;
}

GlyphCache::Statistics GlyphCache::Snapshot()
{
    return gStatistics;
}
```

`src/FontStack/ShapeCache.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "FontStack/GlyphCache.hpp"

#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

struct CachedShape
{
    uint32_t style = 0;
    bool rightToLeft = false;
    std::vector<uint16_t> text;
    uint64_t run = 0;
    uint64_t lastUsed = 0;
};

static std::vector<CachedShape> gShapes;
static ShapeCache::Statistics gStatistics;
static uint64_t gClock = 0;

static bool SameText(const CachedShape& entry, const uint16_t* text, int32_t count)
{
    if (entry.text.size() != static_cast<size_t>(count)) return false;
    if (count == 0) return true;
    return memcmp(entry.text.data(), text, static_cast<size_t>(count) * sizeof(uint16_t)) == 0;
}

bool ShapeCache::Lookup(uint32_t style, const uint16_t* text, int32_t count, bool rightToLeft, uint64_t& run)
{
    gStatistics.lookups += 1;
    if (count < 0) return false;

    for (CachedShape& entry : gShapes)
    {
        if (entry.style != style) continue;
        if (entry.rightToLeft != rightToLeft) continue;

        if (!SameText(entry, text, count))
        {
            gStatistics.collisionsRejected += 1;
            continue;
        }

        entry.lastUsed = ++gClock;
        run = entry.run;
        gStatistics.hits += 1;
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

bool ShapeCache::Insert(uint32_t style, const uint16_t* text, int32_t count, bool rightToLeft, uint64_t run, uint64_t& evicted)
{
    evicted = FontStack::INVALID_RUN;
    if (count < 0) return false;

    while (gShapes.size() >= static_cast<size_t>(FontStack::MAX_SHAPE_CACHE_ENTRIES))
    {
        size_t oldest = 0;
        for (size_t index = 1; index < gShapes.size(); ++index)
        {
            if (gShapes[index].lastUsed < gShapes[oldest].lastUsed) oldest = index;
        }

        evicted = gShapes[oldest].run;
        gShapes.erase(gShapes.begin() + static_cast<ptrdiff_t>(oldest));
        gStatistics.evictions += 1;
    }

    CachedShape entry;
    entry.style = style;
    entry.rightToLeft = rightToLeft;
    entry.text.assign(text, text + count);
    entry.run = run;
    entry.lastUsed = ++gClock;

    gShapes.push_back(std::move(entry));
    gStatistics.entriesResident = static_cast<int32_t>(gShapes.size());
    return true;
}

void ShapeCache::Forget(uint64_t run)
{
    for (size_t index = 0; index < gShapes.size(); ++index)
    {
        if (gShapes[index].run != run) continue;

        gShapes.erase(gShapes.begin() + static_cast<ptrdiff_t>(index));
        gStatistics.entriesResident = static_cast<int32_t>(gShapes.size());
        return;
    }
}

void ShapeCache::DrainAll(uint64_t* out, int32_t capacity, int32_t& written)
{
    written = 0;
    if (!out || capacity <= 0) return;

    for (const CachedShape& entry : gShapes)
    {
        if (written >= capacity) break;
        out[written] = entry.run;
        written += 1;
    }
}

void ShapeCache::Clear()
{
    gShapes.clear();
    gStatistics = Statistics{};
    gClock = 0;
}

ShapeCache::Statistics ShapeCache::Snapshot()
{
    return gStatistics;
}
```

`src/FontStack/include/FontStack/FontStack.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

namespace FontStack
{
    inline constexpr const char* DIRECTORY_SETTING = "font-dir";

    inline constexpr uint32_t INVALID_FONT = 0;
    inline constexpr uint64_t INVALID_RUN = 0;
    inline constexpr uint32_t INVALID_STYLE = 0;

    inline constexpr int WEIGHT_THIN = 100;
    inline constexpr int WEIGHT_LIGHT = 300;
    inline constexpr int WEIGHT_NORMAL = 400;
    inline constexpr int WEIGHT_MEDIUM = 500;
    inline constexpr int WEIGHT_BOLD = 700;
    inline constexpr int WEIGHT_BLACK = 900;

    inline constexpr float ADVANCE_EPSILON = 1.0e-4f;
    inline constexpr float MIN_TEXT_SIZE = 1.0f;
    inline constexpr float MAX_TEXT_SIZE = 2048.0f;
    inline constexpr int MAX_STYLE_COUNT = 4096;
    inline constexpr int MAX_FONT_COUNT = 256;
    inline constexpr size_t MAX_FONT_FILE_BYTES = 32u * 1024u * 1024u;
    inline constexpr int MAX_CACHED_GLYPH_DIMENSION = 128;
    inline constexpr size_t MAX_GLYPH_CACHE_BYTES = 4u * 1024u * 1024u;
    inline constexpr int MAX_SHAPE_CACHE_ENTRIES = 512;
    inline constexpr int MAX_RUN_LENGTH = 8192;

    inline constexpr int FLAG_FAKE_BOLD = 1 << 0;
    inline constexpr int FLAG_SYNTHETIC_ITALIC = 1 << 1;

    enum class Result : uint8_t
    {
        Ok,
        NotInitialized,
        AlreadyInitialized,
        FontDirectoryMissing,
        FontFileUnreadable,
        FontFileMalformed,
        FontFileTooLarge,
        UnknownFamily,
        InvalidFont,
        InvalidStyle,
        InvalidRun,
        InvalidArgument,
        TextTooLong,
        StyleTableFull,
        FontTableFull,
        ShapingFailed,
        RasterizationFailed,
        WrongThread
    };

    struct Metrics
    {
        float top = 0.0f;
        float ascent = 0.0f;
        float descent = 0.0f;
        float bottom = 0.0f;
        float leading = 0.0f;
    };

    struct Bounds
    {
        int32_t left = 0;
        int32_t top = 0;
        int32_t right = 0;
        int32_t bottom = 0;
    };

    struct GlyphImage
    {
        const uint8_t* samples = nullptr;
        int32_t width = 0;
        int32_t height = 0;
        int32_t pitch = 0;
        int32_t bearingX = 0;
        int32_t bearingY = 0;
    };

    struct GlyphPosition
    {
```

`src/FrameworkJni/BitmapBridge.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "FrameworkJni/GraphicsBridge.hpp"

#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#include "ImageCodec/ImageCodec.hpp"
#include "Rasterizer/Rasterizer.hpp"

struct BitmapHandle
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    bool hasAlpha = false;
};

BitmapHandle* FrameworkJniBitmapFrom(jlong handle)
{
    return reinterpret_cast<BitmapHandle*>(static_cast<intptr_t>(handle));
}

const Rasterizer::Surface* FrameworkJniBitmapSurface(BitmapHandle* bitmap)
{
    return bitmap ? &bitmap->surface : nullptr;
}

static jlong BitmapDecode(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jbyteArray data, jint offset, jint length)
{
    if (!data || length <= 0) return 0;

    jsize available = env->GetArrayLength(data);
    if (offset < 0 || length > available - offset) return 0;

    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(static_cast<size_t>(length));
    env->GetByteArrayRegion(data, offset, length, reinterpret_cast<jbyte*>(bytes.data()));

    ImageCodec::Image decoded;
    if (ImageCodec::Decode(bytes.data(), bytes.size(), decoded) != ImageCodec::Result::Ok) return 0;

    BitmapHandle* bitmap = new BitmapHandle();
    bitmap->surface.pixels = decoded.pixels;
    bitmap->surface.width = decoded.width;
    bitmap->surface.height = decoded.height;
    bitmap->surface.stride = decoded.stride;
    bitmap->surface.ownsPixels = true;
    bitmap->hasAlpha = decoded.hasAlpha;

    return reinterpret_cast<jlong>(bitmap);
}

static jboolean BitmapMeasure(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jbyteArray data, jint offset, jint length, jintArray into)
{
    if (!data || length <= 0 || !into || env->GetArrayLength(into) < 2) return JNI_FALSE;

    jsize available = env->GetArrayLength(data);
    if (offset < 0 || length > available - offset) return JNI_FALSE;

    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(static_cast<size_t>(length));
    env->GetByteArrayRegion(data, offset, length, reinterpret_cast<jbyte*>(bytes.data()));

    uint32_t width = 0;
    uint32_t height = 0;

    if (ImageCodec::MeasureOnly(bytes.data(), bytes.size(), width, height) != ImageCodec::Result::Ok) return JNI_FALSE;

    jint size[2] = {static_cast<jint>(width), static_cast<jint>(height)};
    env->SetIntArrayRegion(into, 0, 2, size);

    return JNI_TRUE;
}

static jlong BitmapCreate(JNIEnv*, jclass, jint width, jint height)
{
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return 0;
    if (static_cast<uint32_t>(width) > Rasterizer::MAX_DIMENSION) return 0;
    if (static_cast<uint32_t>(height) > Rasterizer::MAX_DIMENSION) return 0;

    BitmapHandle* bitmap = new BitmapHandle();

    if (Rasterizer::CreateSurface(static_cast<uint32_t>(width), static_cast<uint32_t>(height), bitmap->surface)
        != Rasterizer::Result::Ok)
    {
        delete bitmap;
        return 0;
    }

    std::memset(bitmap->surface.pixels, 0, static_cast<size_t>(bitmap->surface.stride) * bitmap->surface.height);
    bitmap->hasAlpha = true;

    return reinterpret_cast<jlong>(bitmap);
}

static void BitmapDestroy(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    BitmapHandle* bitmap = FrameworkJniBitmapFrom(handle);
    if (!bitmap) return;

    Rasterizer::DestroySurface(bitmap->surface);
    delete bitmap;
}

static jint BitmapWidth(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    BitmapHandle* bitmap = FrameworkJniBitmapFrom(handle);
    return bitmap ? static_cast<jint>(bitmap->surface.width) : 0;
}

static jint BitmapHeight(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    BitmapHandle* bitmap = FrameworkJniBitmapFrom(handle);
    return bitmap ? static_cast<jint>(bitmap->surface.height) : 0;
}

static jboolean BitmapHasAlpha(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    BitmapHandle* bitmap = FrameworkJniBitmapFrom(handle);
    return bitmap && bitmap->hasAlpha ? JNI_TRUE : JNI_FALSE;
}

static uint32_t StraightFromPremultiplied(uint32_t pixel)
{
    uint32_t alpha = (pixel >> 24) & 0xFFu;
    if (alpha == 0 || alpha == 255) return pixel;

    uint32_t blue = ((pixel & 0xFFu) * 255u + alpha / 2) / alpha;
    uint32_t green = (((pixel >> 8) & 0xFFu) * 255u + alpha / 2) / alpha;
    uint32_t red = (((pixel >> 16) & 0xFFu) * 255u + alpha / 2) / alpha;

    if (blue > 255) blue = 255;
    if (green > 255) green = 255;
    if (red > 255) red = 255;

    return (alpha << 24) | (red << 16) | (green << 8) | blue;
}

static uint32_t PremultipliedFromStraight(uint32_t pixel)
{
    uint32_t alpha = (pixel >> 24) & 0xFFu;
    if (alpha == 255) return pixel;
    if (alpha == 0) return 0;

    uint32_t blue = ((pixel & 0xFFu) * alpha + 127u) / 255u;
    uint32_t green = (((pixel >> 8) & 0xFFu) * alpha + 127u) / 255u;
    uint32_t red = (((pixel >> 16) & 0xFFu) * alpha + 127u) / 255u;

    return (alpha << 24) | (red << 16) | (green << 8) | blue;
}

static jint BitmapPixel(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle, jint x, jint y)
{
    BitmapHandle* bitmap = FrameworkJniBitmapFrom(handle);
    if (!bitmap || !bitmap->surface.pixels) return 0;
    if (x < 0 || y < 0) return 0;
    if (static_cast<uint32_t>(x) >= bitmap->surface.width || static_cast<uint32_t>(y) >= bitmap->surface.height) return 0;

    const uint8_t* row = bitmap->surface.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * bitmap->surface.stride;
    return static_cast<jint>(StraightFromPremultiplied(reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(row)[x]));
}

static void BitmapSetPixel(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle, jint x, jint y, jint color)
{
    BitmapHandle* bitmap = FrameworkJniBitmapFrom(handle);
    if (!bitmap || !bitmap->surface.pixels) return;
    if (x < 0 || y < 0) return;
    if (static_cast<uint32_t>(x) >= bitmap->surface.width || static_cast<uint32_t>(y) >= bitmap->surface.height) return;

    uint8_t* row = bitmap->surface.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * bitmap->surface.stride;
    reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(row)[x] = PremultipliedFromStraight(static_cast<uint32_t>(color));
}

static void BitmapWritePixels(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jintArray from, jint offset, jint stride, jint x, jint y,
                              jint width, jint height)
{
    BitmapHandle* bitmap = FrameworkJniBitmapFrom(handle);
    if (!bitmap || !bitmap->surface.pixels || !from) return;
    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;
    if (static_cast<uint32_t>(x + width) > bitmap->surface.width) return;
    if (static_cast<uint32_t>(y + height) > bitmap->surface.height) return;

    std::vector<jint> row(static_cast<size_t>(width));

    for (jint line = 0; line < height; ++line)
    {
        env->GetIntArrayRegion(from, offset + line * stride, width, row.data());
        if (env->ExceptionCheck()) return;

        uint8_t* destination = bitmap->surface.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y + line) * bitmap->surface.stride;
        uint32_t* pixels = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(destination) + x;

        for (jint column = 0; column < width; ++column) pixels[column] = PremultipliedFromStraight(static_cast<uint32_t>(row[column]));
    }
}

static void BitmapReadPixels(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jintArray into, jint offset, jint stride, jint x, jint y,
                             jint width, jint height)
{
    BitmapHandle* bitmap = FrameworkJniBitmapFrom(handle);
    if (!bitmap || !bitmap->surface.pixels || !into) return;
    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;
    if (static_cast<uint32_t>(x + width) > bitmap->surface.width) return;
    if (static_cast<uint32_t>(y + height) > bitmap->surface.height) return;

    std::vector<jint> row(static_cast<size_t>(width));

    for (jint line = 0; line < height; ++line)
    {
        const uint8_t* source = bitmap->surface.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y + line) * bitmap->surface.stride;
        const uint32_t* pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(source) + x;

        for (jint column = 0; column < width; ++column) row[column] = static_cast<jint>(StraightFromPremultiplied(pixels[column]));

        env->SetIntArrayRegion(into, offset + line * stride, width, row.data());
    }
}

static void BitmapErase(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle, jint color)
{
    BitmapHandle* bitmap = FrameworkJniBitmapFrom(handle);
    if (!bitmap || !bitmap->surface.pixels) return;

    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < bitmap->surface.height; ++y)
    {
        uint32_t* row = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(bitmap->surface.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * bitmap->surface.stride);
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < bitmap->surface.width; ++x) row[x] = static_cast<uint32_t>(color);
    }
}

static jlong BitmapOpenCanvas(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    BitmapHandle* bitmap = FrameworkJniBitmapFrom(handle);
    if (!bitmap || !bitmap->surface.pixels) return 0;

    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = new Rasterizer::Canvas();

    if (Rasterizer::Begin(bitmap->surface, *canvas) != Rasterizer::Result::Ok)
    {
        delete canvas;
        return 0;
    }

    return reinterpret_cast<jlong>(canvas);
}

static void BitmapCloseCanvas(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = reinterpret_cast<Rasterizer::Canvas*>(static_cast<intptr_t>(handle));
    if (!canvas) return;

    Rasterizer::End(*canvas);
    delete canvas;
}

static const JNINativeMethod BITMAP_METHODS[] = {
    {"nativeOpenCanvas", "(J)J", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&BitmapOpenCanvas)},
    {"nativeCloseCanvas", "(J)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&BitmapCloseCanvas)},
    {"nativeDecode", "([BII)J", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&BitmapDecode)},
    {"nativeMeasure", "([BII[I)Z", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&BitmapMeasure)},
    {"nativeCreate", "(II)J", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&BitmapCreate)},
    {"nativeDestroy", "(J)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&BitmapDestroy)},
    {"nativeWidth", "(J)I", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&BitmapWidth)},
    {"nativeHeight", "(J)I", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&BitmapHeight)},
    {"nativeHasAlpha", "(J)Z", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&BitmapHasAlpha)},
    {"nativePixel", "(JII)I", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&BitmapPixel)},
    {"nativeSetPixel", "(JIII)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&BitmapSetPixel)},
    {"nativeReadPixels", "(J[IIIIIII)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&BitmapReadPixels)},
    {"nativeWritePixels", "(J[IIIIIII)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&BitmapWritePixels)},
    {"nativeErase", "(JI)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&BitmapErase)},
};

const JNINativeMethod* FrameworkJniBitmapMethods(int& count)
{
    count = static_cast<int>(sizeof(BITMAP_METHODS) / sizeof(BITMAP_METHODS[0]));
    return BITMAP_METHODS;
}
```

`src/FrameworkJni/FrameworkJni.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "FrameworkJni/FrameworkJni.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <vector>

#include "ApkSignature/ApkSignature.hpp"
#include "Diagnostics/Diagnostics.hpp"
#include "FontStack/FontStack.hpp"
#include "FrameworkJni/ResourceBridge.hpp"
#include "FrameworkJni/GraphicsBridge.hpp"
#include "FrameworkJni/SqliteBridge.hpp"
#include "FrameworkJni/TextBridge.hpp"
#include "FrameworkJni/WindowBridge.hpp"
#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"

static const Apk::Package* gPackage = nullptr;
static const std::vector<PackageRegistry::Entry>* gInstalledPackages = nullptr;

static std::string CopyJavaString(JNIEnv* env, jstring value)
{
    if (!value) return std::string();

    const char* chars = env->GetStringUTFChars(value, nullptr);
    if (!chars) return std::string();

    std::string result(chars);
    env->ReleaseStringUTFChars(value, chars);
    return result;
}

static jint LogPrintlnNative(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint, jint priority, jstring tag, jstring message)
{
    std::string tagText = CopyJavaString(env, tag);
    std::string messageText = CopyJavaString(env, message);

    fprintf(stderr, "%c/%s: %s\n", FrameworkJni::PriorityLetter(priority), tagText.c_str(), messageText.c_str());
    fflush(stderr);

    return static_cast<jint>(messageText.size());
}

static jstring MakeString(JNIEnv* env, const std::string& value)
{
    return env->NewStringUTF(value.c_str());
}

static const Apk::ProviderInfo* ProviderAt(jint index)
{
    if (!gPackage) return nullptr;
    if (index < 0 || static_cast<size_t>(index) >= gPackage->manifest.providers.size()) return nullptr;
    return &gPackage->manifest.providers[static_cast<size_t>(index)];
}

static constexpr jint COMPONENT_ACTIVITY = 0;
static constexpr jint COMPONENT_SERVICE = 1;
static constexpr jint COMPONENT_RECEIVER = 2;
static constexpr jint COMPONENT_PROVIDER = 3;
static constexpr jint COMPONENT_APPLICATION = 4;

static const std::vector<Apk::IntentFilterInfo>* FiltersFor(jint kind, jint index)
{
    if (!gPackage) return nullptr;

    size_t at = static_cast<size_t>(index);
    if (index < 0) return nullptr;

    if (kind == COMPONENT_ACTIVITY && at < gPackage->manifest.activities.size())
        return &gPackage->manifest.activities[at].filters;
    if (kind == COMPONENT_SERVICE && at < gPackage->manifest.services.size())
        return &gPackage->manifest.services[at].filters;
    if (kind == COMPONENT_RECEIVER && at < gPackage->manifest.receivers.size())
        return &gPackage->manifest.receivers[at].filters;

    return nullptr;
}

static const Apk::IntentFilterInfo* FilterAt(jint kind, jint index, jint filterIndex)
{
    const std::vector<Apk::IntentFilterInfo>* filters = FiltersFor(kind, index);
    if (!filters) return nullptr;
    if (filterIndex < 0 || static_cast<size_t>(filterIndex) >= filters->size()) return nullptr;

    return &(*filters)[static_cast<size_t>(filterIndex)];
}

static jstring JoinedLines(JNIEnv* env, const std::vector<std::string>& values)
{
    std::string joined;
    for (const std::string& value : values)
    {
        if (!joined.empty()) joined += '\n';
        joined += value;
    }

    return MakeString(env, joined);
}

static jint BootstrapComponentCount(JNIEnv*, jclass, jint kind)
{
    if (!gPackage) return 0;

    if (kind == COMPONENT_ACTIVITY) return static_cast<jint>(gPackage->manifest.activities.size());
    if (kind == COMPONENT_SERVICE) return static_cast<jint>(gPackage->manifest.services.size());
    if (kind == COMPONENT_RECEIVER) return static_cast<jint>(gPackage->manifest.receivers.size());

    return 0;
}

static jint BootstrapPermissionCount(JNIEnv*, jclass)
{
    if (!gPackage) return 0;

    return static_cast<jint>(gPackage->manifest.permissions.size());
}

static jstring BootstrapPermissionAt(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint index)
{
    if (!gPackage || index < 0) return nullptr;

    const size_t at = static_cast<size_t>(index);
    if (at >= gPackage->manifest.permissions.size()) return nullptr;

    return MakeString(env, gPackage->manifest.permissions[at]);
}

static jint BootstrapActivityLaunchMode(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jstring className)
{
    if (!gPackage) return 0;

    const std::string wanted = CopyJavaString(env, className);

    for (const Apk::ActivityInfo& activity : gPackage->manifest.activities)
    {
        if (activity.className != wanted && activity.targetActivity != wanted) continue;

        return static_cast<jint>(activity.launchMode);
    }

    return 0;
}

static jint BootstrapActivityConfigChanges(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jstring className)
{
    if (!gPackage) return 0;

    const std::string wanted = CopyJavaString(env, className);

    for (const Apk::ActivityInfo& activity : gPackage->manifest.activities)
    {
        if (activity.className != wanted && activity.targetActivity != wanted) continue;

        return static_cast<jint>(activity.configChanges);
    }

    return 0;
}

static jlong BootstrapVersionCode(JNIEnv*, jclass)
{
    if (!gPackage) return 0;

    return static_cast<jlong>(gPackage->manifest.versionCode);
}

static jstring BootstrapVersionName(JNIEnv* env, jclass)
{
    if (!gPackage) return nullptr;

    return MakeString(env, gPackage->manifest.versionName);
}

static jstring BootstrapComponentClassName(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint kind, jint index)
{
    if (!gPackage || index < 0) return nullptr;

    size_t at = static_cast<size_t>(index);

    if (kind == COMPONENT_ACTIVITY && at < gPackage->manifest.activities.size())
    {
        const Apk::ActivityInfo& activity = gPackage->manifest.activities[at];
        return MakeString(env, activity.targetActivity.empty() ? activity.className : activity.targetActivity);
    }

    if (kind == COMPONENT_SERVICE && at < gPackage->manifest.services.size())
        return MakeString(env, gPackage->manifest.services[at].className);

    if (kind == COMPONENT_RECEIVER && at < gPackage->manifest.receivers.size())
        return MakeString(env, gPackage->manifest.receivers[at].className);

    return nullptr;
}

static const std::vector<Apk::MetaDataEntry>* ComponentMetaDataAt(jint kind, jint index)
{
    if (!gPackage || index < 0) return nullptr;

    size_t at = static_cast<size_t>(index);

    if (kind == COMPONENT_ACTIVITY && at < gPackage->manifest.activities.size())
        return &gPackage->manifest.activities[at].metaData;

    if (kind == COMPONENT_SERVICE && at < gPackage->manifest.services.size())
        return &gPackage->manifest.services[at].metaData;

    if (kind == COMPONENT_RECEIVER && at < gPackage->manifest.receivers.size())
        return &gPackage->manifest.receivers[at].metaData;

    if (kind == COMPONENT_PROVIDER && at < gPackage->manifest.providers.size())
        return &gPackage->manifest.providers[at].metaData;

    if (kind == COMPONENT_APPLICATION && at == 0) return &gPackage->manifest.applicationMetaData;

    return nullptr;
}

static const Apk::MetaDataEntry* ComponentMetaDataEntry(jint kind, jint index, jint entry)
{
    const std::vector<Apk::MetaDataEntry>* entries = ComponentMetaDataAt(kind, index);
    if (!entries || entry < 0 || static_cast<size_t>(entry) >= entries->size()) return nullptr;

    return &(*entries)[static_cast<size_t>(entry)];
}

static jint BootstrapComponentMetaDataType(JNIEnv*, jclass, jint kind, jint index, jint entry)
{
    const Apk::MetaDataEntry* found = ComponentMetaDataEntry(kind, index, entry);
    if (!found) return Apk::META_DATA_NO_VALUE;
    if (found->resource != 0) return Apk::META_DATA_RESOURCE;

    return found->valueType;
}

static jint BootstrapComponentMetaDataData(JNIEnv*, jclass, jint kind, jint index, jint entry)
{
    const Apk::MetaDataEntry* found = ComponentMetaDataEntry(kind, index, entry);
    if (!found) return 0;

    return static_cast<jint>(found->resource != 0 ? found->resource : found->valueData);
}

static jint BootstrapComponentMetaDataCount(JNIEnv*, jclass, jint kind, jint index)
{
    const std::vector<Apk::MetaDataEntry>* entries = ComponentMetaDataAt(kind, index);
    return entries ? static_cast<jint>(entries->size()) : 0;
}

static jstring BootstrapComponentMetaDataName(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint kind, jint index, jint entry)
{
    const std::vector<Apk::MetaDataEntry>* entries = ComponentMetaDataAt(kind, index);
    if (!entries || entry < 0 || static_cast<size_t>(entry) >= entries->size()) return nullptr;

    return MakeString(env, (*entries)[static_cast<size_t>(entry)].name);
}

static jstring BootstrapComponentMetaDataValue(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint kind, jint index, jint entry)
{
    const std::vector<Apk::MetaDataEntry>* entries = ComponentMetaDataAt(kind, index);
    if (!entries || entry < 0 || static_cast<size_t>(entry) >= entries->size()) return nullptr;

    return MakeString(env, (*entries)[static_cast<size_t>(entry)].value);
}

static jint BootstrapComponentFilterCount(JNIEnv*, jclass, jint kind, jint index)
{
    const std::vector<Apk::IntentFilterInfo>* filters = FiltersFor(kind, index);
    return filters ? static_cast<jint>(filters->size()) : 0;
}

static jstring BootstrapFilterActions(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint kind, jint index, jint filterIndex)

}

}

static jstring BootstrapFilterSchemes(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint kind, jint index, jint filterIndex)

    return filter ? JoinedLines(env, filter->schemes) : nullptr;
}

static jstring BootstrapFilterTypes(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint kind, jint index, jint filterIndex)

static jint BootstrapFilterPriority(JNIEnv*, jclass, jint kind, jint index, jint filterIndex)

static jstring BootstrapPackageName(JNIEnv* env, jclass)
{
    if (!gPackage) return nullptr;

static std::string gArchivePath;

{
    gArchivePath = path;
}

static ApkSignature::Info gSigningInfo;

void FrameworkJni::SetSigningInfo(const ApkSignature::Info& info)
{
    gSigningInfo = info;
}

static jint BootstrapSignatureCount(JNIEnv*, jclass)
{
    return static_cast<jint>(gSigningInfo.signers.size());
}

static jbyteArray BootstrapSignatureAt(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint index)
{
    const ApkSignature::Info& info = gSigningInfo;
    if (index < 0 || static_cast<size_t>(index) >= info.signers.size()) return nullptr;

    const std::vector<uint8_t>& certificate = info.signers[static_cast<size_t>(index)].certificate;
    jbyteArray array = env->NewByteArray(static_cast<jsize>(certificate.size()));
    if (array == nullptr) return nullptr;

    env->SetByteArrayRegion(array, 0, static_cast<jsize>(certificate.size()), reinterpret_cast<const jbyte*>(certificate.data()));

    return array;
}

static jint BootstrapSignatureScheme(JNIEnv*, jclass)
{
    return static_cast<jint>(gSigningInfo.scheme);
}

static jboolean BootstrapSignatureVerified(JNIEnv*, jclass)
{
    return gSigningInfo.verified ? JNI_TRUE : JNI_FALSE;
}

static const Apk::ActivityInfo* ActivityNamed(JNIEnv* env, jstring className)
{
    if (!gPackage) return nullptr;

    std::string name = CopyJavaString(env, className);
    for (const Apk::ActivityInfo& activity : gPackage->manifest.activities)
    {
        if (activity.className == name) return &activity;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

static WindowBridge::Session gWindowSession;

static constexpr jlong CANVAS_TOKEN = 1;

static Rasterizer::Canvas* CanvasFrom(jlong handle)
{
    if (handle == 0) return nullptr;

    if (handle == CANVAS_TOKEN) return gWindowSession.open ? &gWindowSession.canvas : nullptr;

    return reinterpret_cast<Rasterizer::Canvas*>(static_cast<intptr_t>(handle));
}

Rasterizer::Canvas* FrameworkJniCanvasFrom(jlong handle)
{
    return CanvasFrom(handle);
}

static jint CanvasSave(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasFrom(handle);
    if (!canvas) return 0;

    int before = canvas->depth;
    if (Rasterizer::Save(*canvas) != Rasterizer::Result::Ok) return -1;

    return before;
}

static jboolean CanvasRestore(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasFrom(handle);
    if (!canvas) return JNI_FALSE;

    return Rasterizer::Restore(*canvas) == Rasterizer::Result::Ok ? JNI_TRUE : JNI_FALSE;
}

static jint CanvasGetSaveCount(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasFrom(handle);
    return canvas ? canvas->depth : 0;
}

static void CanvasTranslate(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle, jint deltaX, jint deltaY)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasFrom(handle);
    if (canvas) Rasterizer::Translate(*canvas, deltaX, deltaY);
}

static jboolean CanvasClipRect(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle, jint left, jint top, jint right, jint bottom)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasFrom(handle);
    if (!canvas) return JNI_FALSE;

    Rasterizer::ClipRect(*canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{left, top, right, bottom});
    return Rasterizer::IsEmpty(Rasterizer::CurrentState(*canvas).clip) ? JNI_FALSE : JNI_TRUE;
}

jboolean PackagesLaunch(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jstring packageName)
{
    const std::string name = CopyJavaString(env, packageName);
    if (name.empty()) return JNI_FALSE;

    if (!gWindowSession.open || !gWindowSession.isHosted)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[framework] %s cannot be started: only a player the shell is hosting can ask for a launch\n", name.c_str());
        return JNI_FALSE;
    }

    return HostedWindow::RequestLaunch(gWindowSession.hosted, name.c_str()) ? JNI_TRUE : JNI_FALSE;
}

static void CanvasDrawColor(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle, jint color)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasFrom(handle);
    if (canvas) Rasterizer::DrawColor(*canvas, static_cast<uint32_t>(color));
}

static void CanvasDrawRect(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle, jint left, jint top, jint right, jint bottom, jint color)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasFrom(handle);
    if (canvas) Rasterizer::DrawRect(*canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{left, top, right, bottom}, static_cast<uint32_t>(color));
}

static void CanvasDrawLine(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle, jint startX, jint startY, jint stopX, jint stopY, jint color)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasFrom(handle);
    if (!canvas) return;

    if (startY == stopY)
    {
        int32_t left = startX < stopX ? startX : stopX;
        int32_t length = startX < stopX ? stopX - startX : startX - stopX;
        if (length > 0) Rasterizer::DrawHorizontalLine(*canvas, left, startY, length, static_cast<uint32_t>(color));
        return;
    }

    if (startX == stopX)
    {
        int32_t top = startY < stopY ? startY : stopY;
        int32_t length = startY < stopY ? stopY - startY : startY - stopY;
        if (length > 0) Rasterizer::DrawVerticalLine(*canvas, startX, top, length, static_cast<uint32_t>(color));
    }
}

static void CanvasDrawTextRun(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jint style, jcharArray text, jint index, jint count, jfloat x, jfloat y,
                              jint color, jboolean rightToLeft)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasFrom(handle);
    if (!canvas || !text || count <= 0 || index < 0) return;

    jsize length = env->GetArrayLength(text);
    if (index + count > length) return;

    std::vector<uint16_t> chars(static_cast<size_t>(count));
    env->GetCharArrayRegion(text, index, count, reinterpret_cast<jchar*>(chars.data()));

    uint64_t run = FontStack::INVALID_RUN;
    if (FontStack::ShapeRun(static_cast<uint32_t>(style), chars.data(), count, rightToLeft == JNI_TRUE, run) != FontStack::Result::Ok)
    {
        return;
    }

    int32_t glyphCount = 0;
    FontStack::RunGlyphCount(run, glyphCount);

    int32_t originX = static_cast<int32_t>(x);
    int32_t baseline = static_cast<int32_t>(y);

    for (int32_t glyph = 0; glyph < glyphCount; ++glyph)
    {
        FontStack::GlyphPosition position;
        if (FontStack::RunGlyph(run, glyph, position) != FontStack::Result::Ok) break;

        FontStack::GlyphImage image;
        if (FontStack::RasterizeGlyph(static_cast<uint32_t>(style), position.glyphId, image) != FontStack::Result::Ok) continue;
        if (!image.samples || image.width <= 0 || image.height <= 0) continue;

        Rasterizer::Coverage mask;
        mask.samples = image.samples;
        mask.width = image.width;
        mask.height = image.height;
        mask.pitch = image.pitch;

        Rasterizer::DrawCoverage(*canvas, mask, originX + static_cast<int32_t>(position.x) + image.bearingX,
                                 baseline - image.bearingY, static_cast<uint32_t>(color));
    }
}

static const JNINativeMethod CANVAS_METHODS[] = {
    {"nativeSave", "(J)I", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&CanvasSave)},
    {"nativeRestore", "(J)Z", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&CanvasRestore)},
    {"nativeGetSaveCount", "(J)I", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&CanvasGetSaveCount)},
    {"nativeTranslate", "(JII)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&CanvasTranslate)},
    {"nativeClipRect", "(JIIII)Z", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&CanvasClipRect)},
    {"nativeDrawColor", "(JI)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&CanvasDrawColor)},
    {"nativeDrawRect", "(JIIIII)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&CanvasDrawRect)},
    {"nativeDrawLine", "(JIIIII)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&CanvasDrawLine)},
    {"nativeDrawTextRun", "(JI[CIIFFIZ)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&CanvasDrawTextRun)},
};

static jlong WindowOpen(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint width, jint height, jstring title)
{
    if (gWindowSession.open) return reinterpret_cast<jlong>(&gWindowSession);

    std::string titleText = CopyJavaString(env, title);
    WindowBridge::Result result = WindowBridge::Open(static_cast<uint32_t>(width), static_cast<uint32_t>(height), titleText.c_str(), gWindowSession);

    if (result != WindowBridge::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[window] cannot open: %s\n", WindowBridge::ResultName(result));
        return 0;
    }

    return reinterpret_cast<jlong>(&gWindowSession);
}

static WindowBridge::Session* SessionFrom(jlong handle)
{
    WindowBridge::Session* session = reinterpret_cast<WindowBridge::Session*>(handle);
    return session == &gWindowSession ? session : nullptr;
}

static void WindowClose(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    WindowBridge::Session* session = SessionFrom(handle);
    if (session) WindowBridge::Close(*session);
}

static jlong WindowBeginFrame(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    WindowBridge::Session* session = SessionFrom(handle);
    if (!session) return 0;

    if (WindowBridge::BeginFrame(*session) != WindowBridge::Result::Ok) return 0;
    return CANVAS_TOKEN;
}

static void WindowEndFrame(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    WindowBridge::Session* session = SessionFrom(handle);
    if (session) WindowBridge::EndFrame(*session);
}

static void WindowRequestFrame(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    WindowBridge::Session* session = SessionFrom(handle);
    if (session) WindowBridge::RequestFrame(*session);
}

static jboolean WindowPoll(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle, jint timeoutMillis)
{
    WindowBridge::Session* session = SessionFrom(handle);
    if (!session) return JNI_FALSE;

    return WindowBridge::Poll(*session, timeoutMillis) == WindowBridge::Result::Ok ? JNI_TRUE : JNI_FALSE;
}

static void WindowWake(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    WindowBridge::Session* session = SessionFrom(handle);
    if (session) WindowBridge::Wake(*session);
}

static constexpr jsize INPUT_EVENT_WORDS = 8;

static jboolean WindowConsumeFrame(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    WindowBridge::Session* session = SessionFrom(handle);
    return session && WindowBridge::ConsumeFrame(*session) ? JNI_TRUE : JNI_FALSE;
}

static jboolean WindowNextInputEvent(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jlongArray output)
{
    WindowBridge::Session* session = SessionFrom(handle);
    if (!session || !output || env->GetArrayLength(output) < INPUT_EVENT_WORDS) return JNI_FALSE;

    WaylandClient::InputEvent event;
    if (!WindowBridge::NextInputEvent(*session, event)) return JNI_FALSE;

    uint32_t xBits = 0;
    uint32_t yBits = 0;
    memcpy(&xBits, &event.x, sizeof(xBits));
    memcpy(&yBits, &event.y, sizeof(yBits));

    jlong words[INPUT_EVENT_WORDS];
    words[0] = static_cast<jlong>(event.kind);
    words[1] = event.action;
    words[2] = event.pointerId;
    words[3] = event.keyCode;
    words[4] = static_cast<jlong>(event.unicode);
    words[5] = event.metaState;
    words[6] = static_cast<jlong>(event.timeNanos);
    words[7] = (static_cast<jlong>(xBits) << 32) | static_cast<jlong>(yBits);

    env->SetLongArrayRegion(output, 0, INPUT_EVENT_WORDS, words);
    return JNI_TRUE;
}

static jlong WindowLastFrameTimeNanos(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    WindowBridge::Session* session = SessionFrom(handle);
    return session ? static_cast<jlong>(session->lastFrameTimeNanos) : 0;
}

    return session && WindowBridge::IsCloseRequested(*session) ? JNI_TRUE : JNI_FALSE;
}

static jboolean WindowConsumeResize(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jintArray sizeOut)
{
    WindowBridge::Session* session = SessionFrom(handle);
    if (!session || !sizeOut) return JNI_FALSE;
    if (env->GetArrayLength(sizeOut) < 2) return JNI_FALSE;

    uint32_t width = 0;
    uint32_t height = 0;
    if (!WindowBridge::ConsumeResize(*session, width, height)) return JNI_FALSE;

    jint values[2] = {(jint)width, (jint)height};
    env->SetIntArrayRegion(sizeOut, 0, 2, values);

    return JNI_TRUE;
}

    WindowBridge::Session* session = SessionFrom(handle);
    if (!session) return;

    WindowBridge::SetFullscreen(*session, fullscreen == JNI_TRUE);
}

static jboolean WindowDisplayMode(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jintArray modeOut)
{
    WindowBridge::Session* session = SessionFrom(handle);
    if (!session || !modeOut) return JNI_FALSE;
    if (env->GetArrayLength(modeOut) < 6) return JNI_FALSE;
    if (session->isHosted) return JNI_FALSE;

    WaylandClient::DisplayMode mode = WaylandClient::CurrentDisplayMode(session->connection);
    if (!mode.described) return JNI_FALSE;

    jint values[6] = {(jint)mode.width,           (jint)mode.height,          (jint)mode.refreshMilliHertz,
                      (jint)mode.scale,           (jint)mode.physicalWidthMm, (jint)mode.physicalHeightMm};
    env->SetIntArrayRegion(modeOut, 0, 6, values);

    return JNI_TRUE;
}

        case PRIORITY_DEBUG: return 'D';
        case PRIORITY_INFO: return 'I';

        default: return '?';

bool FrameworkJni::IsStrict()
{
    const char* value = Settings::Lookup(STRICT_SETTING);
    if (!value) return true;
    return strcmp(value, "0") != 0;
}

bool FrameworkJni::IsTracing(const char* topic)
{
    const char* value = Settings::Lookup(TRACE_SETTING);
    if (!value || !*value) return false;

    size_t topicLength = strlen(topic);
    const char* cursor = value;

    while (*cursor)
    {
        const char* separator = strchr(cursor, ',');
        size_t length = separator ? static_cast<size_t>(separator - cursor) : strlen(cursor);

        if (length == 3 && strncmp(cursor, "all", 3) == 0) return true;
        if (length == topicLength && strncmp(cursor, topic, topicLength) == 0) return true;

        if (!separator) break;
        cursor = separator + 1;
    }

    return false;
}

void FrameworkJni::Unimplemented(JNIEnv* env, const char* method)
{
    Diagnostics::NoteGap(Diagnostics::Gap::FrameworkMethod, method);

    fprintf(stderr, "[framework] unimplemented: %s\n", method);

    if (env)
    {
        jclass throwable = env->FindClass("java/lang/Throwable");
        if (throwable)
        {
            jmethodID init = env->GetMethodID(throwable, "<init>", "(Ljava/lang/String;)V");
            jmethodID print = env->GetMethodID(throwable, "printStackTrace", "()V");
            jstring label = env->NewStringUTF(method);
            if (init && print && label)
            {
                jobject trace = env->NewObject(throwable, init, label);
                if (trace) env->CallVoidMethod(trace, print);
            }
        }
        env->ExceptionClear();
    }

    fflush(stderr);
    if (IsStrict()) abort();
}

ArtRuntime::Result FrameworkJni::RegisterAll(const ArtRuntime::Vm& vm)
{
    const ArtRuntime::NativeMethodTable tables[] = {
        {LOG_CLASS, LOG_METHODS, static_cast<int>(sizeof(LOG_METHODS) / sizeof(LOG_METHODS[0]))},
        {BOOTSTRAP_CLASS, BOOTSTRAP_METHODS, static_cast<int>(sizeof(BOOTSTRAP_METHODS) / sizeof(BOOTSTRAP_METHODS[0]))},
        {STRICT_CLASS, STRICT_METHODS, static_cast<int>(sizeof(STRICT_METHODS) / sizeof(STRICT_METHODS[0]))},
        {SETTINGS_CLASS, SETTINGS_METHODS, static_cast<int>(sizeof(SETTINGS_METHODS) / sizeof(SETTINGS_METHODS[0]))},
        {PACKAGES_CLASS, PACKAGES_METHODS, static_cast<int>(sizeof(PACKAGES_METHODS) / sizeof(PACKAGES_METHODS[0]))},
        {NOTIFICATION_STORE_CLASS, NOTIFICATION_STORE_METHODS,
         static_cast<int>(sizeof(NOTIFICATION_STORE_METHODS) / sizeof(NOTIFICATION_STORE_METHODS[0]))},
        {CANVAS_CLASS, CANVAS_METHODS, static_cast<int>(sizeof(CANVAS_METHODS) / sizeof(CANVAS_METHODS[0]))},
        {WINDOW_CLASS, WINDOW_METHODS, static_cast<int>(sizeof(WINDOW_METHODS) / sizeof(WINDOW_METHODS[0]))},
        {PROCESS_CLASS, PROCESS_METHODS, static_cast<int>(sizeof(PROCESS_METHODS) / sizeof(PROCESS_METHODS[0]))},
    };

    ArtRuntime::Result result = ArtRuntime::RegisterAll(vm, tables, static_cast<int>(sizeof(tables) / sizeof(tables[0])));
    if (result != ArtRuntime::Result::Ok) return result;

    int resourceTableCount = 0;
    const ArtRuntime::NativeMethodTable* resourceTables = ResourceBridge::Tables(resourceTableCount);
    result = ArtRuntime::RegisterAll(vm, resourceTables, resourceTableCount);
    if (result != ArtRuntime::Result::Ok) return result;

    int textTableCount = 0;
    const ArtRuntime::NativeMethodTable* textTables = TextBridge::Tables(textTableCount);
    result = ArtRuntime::RegisterAll(vm, textTables, textTableCount);
    if (result != ArtRuntime::Result::Ok) return result;

    int sqliteTableCount = 0;
    const ArtRuntime::NativeMethodTable* sqliteTables = SqliteBridge::Tables(sqliteTableCount);
    result = ArtRuntime::RegisterAll(vm, sqliteTables, sqliteTableCount);
    if (result != ArtRuntime::Result::Ok) return result;

    int graphicsTableCount = 0;
    const ArtRuntime::NativeMethodTable* graphicsTables = GraphicsBridge::Tables(graphicsTableCount);
    return ArtRuntime::RegisterAll(vm, graphicsTables, graphicsTableCount);
}
```

```cpp
static Rasterizer::Transform TransformFrom(JNIEnv* env, jfloatArray values)
{
    Rasterizer::Transform transform;
    if (!values || env->GetArrayLength(values) < 6) return transform;

    jfloat stored[9];
    env->GetFloatArrayRegion(values, 0, 6, stored);

    transform.scaleX = stored[0];
    transform.skewX = stored[1];
    transform.translateX = stored[2];
    transform.skewY = stored[3];
    transform.scaleY = stored[4];
    transform.translateY = stored[5];

    return transform;
}

static jboolean PathComputeBounds(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jfloatArray into)
{
    Rasterizer::Path* path = PathOf(handle);
    if (!path || !into || env->GetArrayLength(into) < 4) return JNI_FALSE;

    float left = 0.0f;
    float top = 0.0f;
    float right = 0.0f;
    float bottom = 0.0f;

    if (!Rasterizer::PathBounds(*path, left, top, right, bottom)) return JNI_FALSE;

    jfloat bounds[4] = {left, top, right, bottom};
    env->SetFloatArrayRegion(into, 0, 4, bounds);

    return JNI_TRUE;
```
