```cpp
static Rasterizer::BlendMode BlendFrom(jint value)
{
    switch (value)
    {
        case 1: return Rasterizer::BlendMode::Source;
        case 2: return Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceIn;
        case 3: return Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceAtop;
        case 4: return Rasterizer::BlendMode::DestinationOver;
        case 5: return Rasterizer::BlendMode::DestinationOut;
        case 6: return Rasterizer::BlendMode::Multiply;
        case 7: return Rasterizer::BlendMode::Screen;
        case 8: return Rasterizer::BlendMode::Plus;
        case 9: return Rasterizer::BlendMode::Clear;
        case 10: return Rasterizer::BlendMode::DestinationIn;
        case 11: return Rasterizer::BlendMode::DestinationAtop;
        case 12: return Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOut;
        case 13: return Rasterizer::BlendMode::Xor;
        case 14: return Rasterizer::BlendMode::Destination;
        default: return Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver;
    }
}

static Rasterizer::TileMode TileFrom(jint value)
{
    switch (value)
    {
        case 1: return Rasterizer::TileMode::Repeat;
        case 2: return Rasterizer::TileMode::Mirror;
        default: return Rasterizer::TileMode::Clamp;
    }
}

struct PaintSnapshot
{
    Rasterizer::Source source;
    Rasterizer::StrokeStyle stroke;
    Rasterizer::Transform local;
    Rasterizer::BlendMode blend = Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver;
    std::vector<Rasterizer::GradientStop> stops;
    uint8_t alpha = 255;
    int style = GraphicsBridge::STYLE_FILL;
};

static void ResolveShaderSpace(const Rasterizer::Canvas& canvas, PaintSnapshot& snapshot)
{
    if (snapshot.source.kind == Rasterizer::SourceKind::Solid) return;

    Rasterizer::Transform combined = Rasterizer::Multiply(Rasterizer::CurrentTransform(canvas), snapshot.local);
    if (!Rasterizer::Invert(combined, snapshot.source.inverse)) snapshot.source.inverse = Rasterizer::Transform();
}

static bool ReadPaint(JNIEnv* env, jintArray paintInts, jfloatArray paintFloats, jintArray stopColors,
                      jfloatArray stopPositions, PaintSnapshot& snapshot, jlong shaderBitmap = 0)
{
    if (!paintInts || !paintFloats) return false;
    if (env->GetArrayLength(paintInts) < GraphicsBridge::PAINT_INT_COUNT) return false;
    if (env->GetArrayLength(paintFloats) < GraphicsBridge::PAINT_FLOAT_COUNT) return false;

    jint integers[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_INT_COUNT];
    jfloat decimals[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_FLOAT_COUNT];

    env->GetIntArrayRegion(paintInts, 0, GraphicsBridge::PAINT_INT_COUNT, integers);
    env->GetFloatArrayRegion(paintFloats, 0, GraphicsBridge::PAINT_FLOAT_COUNT, decimals);

    snapshot.style = integers[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_STYLE];
    snapshot.blend = BlendFrom(integers[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_BLEND]);
    snapshot.alpha = static_cast<uint8_t>(integers[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_ALPHA] & 0xFF);

    snapshot.source.color = static_cast<uint32_t>(integers[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_COLOR]);
    snapshot.source.tileMode = TileFrom(integers[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_TILE_MODE]);
    snapshot.source.filter = integers[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_FILTER] != 0;
    snapshot.source.tinted = integers[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_TINTED] != 0;
    snapshot.source.tint = static_cast<uint32_t>(integers[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_TINT]);

    snapshot.stroke.width = decimals[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_STROKE_WIDTH];
    snapshot.stroke.miterLimit = decimals[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_MITER];

    switch (integers[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_CAP])
    {
        case 1: snapshot.stroke.cap = Rasterizer::LineCap::Round; break;
        case 2: snapshot.stroke.cap = Rasterizer::LineCap::Square; break;
        default: snapshot.stroke.cap = Rasterizer::LineCap::Butt; break;
    }

    switch (integers[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_JOIN])
    {
        case 1: snapshot.stroke.join = Rasterizer::LineJoin::Round; break;
        case 2: snapshot.stroke.join = Rasterizer::LineJoin::Bevel; break;
        default: snapshot.stroke.join = Rasterizer::LineJoin::Miter; break;
    }

    int shaderKind = integers[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_SHADER_KIND];
    if (shaderKind == GraphicsBridge::SHADER_NONE) return true;

    if (shaderKind == GraphicsBridge::SHADER_LINEAR) snapshot.source.kind = Rasterizer::SourceKind::LinearGradient;
    else if (shaderKind == GraphicsBridge::SHADER_RADIAL) snapshot.source.kind = Rasterizer::SourceKind::RadialGradient;
    else if (shaderKind == GraphicsBridge::SHADER_SWEEP) snapshot.source.kind = Rasterizer::SourceKind::SweepGradient;
    else if (shaderKind == GraphicsBridge::SHADER_BITMAP)
    {
        snapshot.source.kind = Rasterizer::SourceKind::Image;
        snapshot.source.image = FrameworkJniBitmapSurface(FrameworkJniBitmapFrom(shaderBitmap));

        if (!snapshot.source.image) snapshot.source.kind = Rasterizer::SourceKind::Solid;
    }

    snapshot.source.startX = decimals[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_START_X];
    snapshot.source.startY = decimals[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_START_Y];
    snapshot.source.endX = decimals[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_END_X];
    snapshot.source.endY = decimals[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_END_Y];
    snapshot.source.radius = decimals[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_RADIUS];

    snapshot.local.scaleX = decimals[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_LOCAL];
    snapshot.local.skewX = decimals[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_LOCAL + 1];
    snapshot.local.translateX = decimals[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_LOCAL + 2];
    snapshot.local.skewY = decimals[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_LOCAL + 3];
    snapshot.local.scaleY = decimals[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_LOCAL + 4];
    snapshot.local.translateY = decimals[GraphicsBridge::PAINT_LOCAL + 5];

    if (!stopColors || !stopPositions) return true;

    int stopCount = env->GetArrayLength(stopColors);
    if (stopCount > env->GetArrayLength(stopPositions)) stopCount = env->GetArrayLength(stopPositions);
    if (stopCount <= 0) return true;

    std::vector<jint> colors(stopCount);
    std::vector<jfloat> positions(stopCount);

    env->GetIntArrayRegion(stopColors, 0, stopCount, colors.data());
    env->GetFloatArrayRegion(stopPositions, 0, stopCount, positions.data());

    snapshot.stops.resize(stopCount);
    for (int index = 0; index < stopCount; ++index)
    {
        snapshot.stops[index].color = static_cast<uint32_t>(colors[index]);
        snapshot.stops[index].position = positions[index];
    }

    snapshot.source.stops = snapshot.stops.data();
    snapshot.source.stopCount = stopCount;

    return true;
}

static Rasterizer::FillRule RuleFrom(jint fillType)
{
    return fillType == 1 || fillType == 3 ? Rasterizer::FillRule::EvenOdd : Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero;
}

static void PaintPath(Rasterizer::Canvas& canvas, const Rasterizer::Path& path, const PaintSnapshot& snapshot,
                      Rasterizer::FillRule rule)
{
    if (snapshot.style != GraphicsBridge::STYLE_STROKE)
    {
        Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, path, snapshot.source, rule, snapshot.blend, snapshot.alpha);
    }

    if (snapshot.style != GraphicsBridge::STYLE_FILL)
    {
        Rasterizer::StrokePath(canvas, path, snapshot.source, snapshot.stroke, snapshot.blend, snapshot.alpha);
    }
}

static void CanvasDrawPath(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong canvasHandle, jlong pathHandle, jint fillType, jintArray paintInts,
                           jfloatArray paintFloats, jintArray stopColors, jfloatArray stopPositions, jfloat blurRadius,
                           jfloatArray dashIntervals, jfloat dashPhase, jlong shaderBitmap)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasOf(canvasHandle);
    Rasterizer::Path* path = PathOf(pathHandle);
    if (!canvas || !path) return;

    PaintSnapshot snapshot;
    if (!ReadPaint(env, paintInts, paintFloats, stopColors, stopPositions, snapshot, shaderBitmap)) return;

    ResolveShaderSpace(*canvas, snapshot);

    Rasterizer::Path* dashed = nullptr;

    if (dashIntervals && env->GetArrayLength(dashIntervals) >= 2)
    {
        int count = env->GetArrayLength(dashIntervals);
        std::vector<jfloat> spans(count);
        env->GetFloatArrayRegion(dashIntervals, 0, count, spans.data());

        dashed = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
        if (dashed && Rasterizer::DashPath(*path, *dashed, spans.data(), count, dashPhase) != Rasterizer::Result::Ok)
        {
            Rasterizer::DestroyPath(dashed);
            dashed = nullptr;
        }
    }

    const Rasterizer::Path& shape = dashed ? *dashed : *path;

    if (blurRadius > 0.0f)
    {
        Rasterizer::FillPathBlurred(*canvas, shape, snapshot.source, RuleFrom(fillType), snapshot.blend, snapshot.alpha,
                                    blurRadius);
    }
    else if (dashed)
    {
        Rasterizer::StrokePath(*canvas, shape, snapshot.source, snapshot.stroke, snapshot.blend, snapshot.alpha);
    }
    else
    {
        PaintPath(*canvas, shape, snapshot, RuleFrom(fillType));
    }

    if (dashed) Rasterizer::DestroyPath(dashed);
}

static void CanvasDrawBitmap(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong canvasHandle, jlong bitmapHandle, jfloat sourceLeft,
                             jfloat sourceTop, jfloat sourceRight, jfloat sourceBottom, jfloat destinationLeft,
                             jfloat destinationTop, jfloat destinationRight, jfloat destinationBottom, jintArray paintInts,
                             jfloatArray paintFloats)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasOf(canvasHandle);
    const Rasterizer::Surface* image = FrameworkJniBitmapSurface(FrameworkJniBitmapFrom(bitmapHandle));
    if (!canvas || !image || !image->pixels) return;

    float sourceWidth = sourceRight - sourceLeft;
    float sourceHeight = sourceBottom - sourceTop;
    float destinationWidth = destinationRight - destinationLeft;
    float destinationHeight = destinationBottom - destinationTop;

    if (sourceWidth <= 0.0f || sourceHeight <= 0.0f || destinationWidth <= 0.0f || destinationHeight <= 0.0f) return;

    PaintSnapshot snapshot;
    if (!ReadPaint(env, paintInts, paintFloats, nullptr, nullptr, snapshot)) return;

    Rasterizer::Transform placement;
    placement.scaleX = destinationWidth / sourceWidth;
    placement.scaleY = destinationHeight / sourceHeight;
    placement.translateX = destinationLeft - sourceLeft * placement.scaleX;
    placement.translateY = destinationTop - sourceTop * placement.scaleY;

    Rasterizer::Transform combined = Rasterizer::Multiply(Rasterizer::CurrentTransform(*canvas), placement);

    Rasterizer::Source source;
    source.kind = Rasterizer::SourceKind::Image;
    source.image = image;
    source.filter = snapshot.source.filter;
    source.tileMode = Rasterizer::TileMode::Clamp;
    source.tinted = snapshot.source.tinted;
    source.tint = snapshot.source.tint;

    if (!Rasterizer::Invert(combined, source.inverse)) return;

    Rasterizer::Path* shape = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    if (!shape) return;

    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*shape, destinationLeft, destinationTop, destinationRight, destinationBottom);
    Rasterizer::FillPath(*canvas, *shape, source, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, snapshot.blend, snapshot.alpha);
    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(shape);
}

static void CanvasConcat(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jfloatArray values)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasOf(handle);
    if (canvas) Rasterizer::Concat(*canvas, TransformFrom(env, values));
}

static void CanvasSetMatrix(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jfloatArray values)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasOf(handle);
    if (canvas) Rasterizer::SetTransform(*canvas, TransformFrom(env, values));
}

static void CanvasGetMatrix(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jfloatArray into)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasOf(handle);
    if (!canvas || !into || env->GetArrayLength(into) < 6) return;

    const Rasterizer::Transform& transform = Rasterizer::CurrentTransform(*canvas);
    jfloat values[6] = {transform.scaleX, transform.skewX, transform.translateX,
                        transform.skewY, transform.scaleY, transform.translateY};

    env->SetFloatArrayRegion(into, 0, 6, values);
}

static jboolean CanvasClipPath(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong canvasHandle, jlong pathHandle, jint fillType, jboolean subtract)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasOf(canvasHandle);
    Rasterizer::Path* path = PathOf(pathHandle);
    if (!canvas || !path) return JNI_FALSE;

    Rasterizer::Result outcome = Rasterizer::ClipPath(*canvas, *path, RuleFrom(fillType), subtract == JNI_TRUE);

    return outcome == Rasterizer::Result::Ok ? JNI_TRUE : JNI_FALSE;
}

static jint CanvasSaveLayer(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle, jint left, jint top, jint right, jint bottom, jint alpha,
                            jint blend)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasOf(handle);
    if (!canvas) return -1;

    int depth = canvas->depth;

    Rasterizer::Rect bounds{left, top, right, bottom};
    Rasterizer::Result outcome =
        Rasterizer::SaveLayer(*canvas, bounds, static_cast<uint8_t>(alpha & 0xFF), BlendFrom(blend));

    if (outcome != Rasterizer::Result::Ok) return -1;

    return depth;
}

static void CanvasRestoreLayer(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasOf(handle);
    if (canvas) Rasterizer::RestoreLayer(*canvas);
}

static void CanvasClipBounds(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jintArray into)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasOf(handle);
    if (!canvas || !into || env->GetArrayLength(into) < 4) return;

    Rasterizer::Rect clip = Rasterizer::CurrentState(*canvas).clip;
    jint edges[4] = {clip.left, clip.top, clip.right, clip.bottom};

    env->SetIntArrayRegion(into, 0, 4, edges);
}

static jint CanvasLayerCount(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas = CanvasOf(handle);
    return canvas ? canvas->layerCount : 0;
}

const ArtRuntime::NativeMethodTable* GraphicsBridge::Tables(int& count)
{
    int bitmapCount = 0;
    const JNINativeMethod* bitmapMethods = FrameworkJniBitmapMethods(bitmapCount);

    TABLES[0] = {PATH_CLASS, PATH_METHODS, static_cast<int>(sizeof(PATH_METHODS) / sizeof(PATH_METHODS[0]))};
    TABLES[1] = {CANVAS_CLASS, CANVAS_METHODS, static_cast<int>(sizeof(CANVAS_METHODS) / sizeof(CANVAS_METHODS[0]))};
    TABLES[2] = {BITMAP_CLASS, bitmapMethods, bitmapCount};

    count = 3;
    return TABLES;
}
```

`src/FrameworkJni/HostedWindow.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "FrameworkJni/HostedWindow.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <unistd.h>

static void QueueInput(HostedWindow::Session& session, const WaylandClient::InputEvent& event)
{
    if (session.queueCount >= HostedWindow::MAX_QUEUED_INPUT)
    {
        session.queueDropped += 1;
        return;
    }

    int slot = (session.queueHead + session.queueCount) % HostedWindow::MAX_QUEUED_INPUT;
    session.queued[slot] = event;
    session.queueCount += 1;
}

static void ReleaseBuffers(HostedWindow::Session& session)
{
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < session.bufferCount; ++index)
    {
        HostedWindow::Buffer& buffer = session.buffers[index];

        if (buffer.pixels) munmap(buffer.pixels, buffer.sizeBytes);
        if (buffer.fileDescriptor >= 0) close(buffer.fileDescriptor);

        buffer = HostedWindow::Buffer{};
    }

    session.bufferCount = 0;
}

static bool AdoptBuffers(HostedWindow::Session& session, const ControlChannel::BuffersPayload& payload, const int* descriptors,
                         uint32_t descriptorCount)
{
    if (payload.count == 0 || payload.count > ControlChannel::MAX_FRAME_BUFFERS) return false;
    if (payload.count != descriptorCount) return false;
    if (payload.width == 0 || payload.height == 0) return false;
    if (payload.stride < payload.width * 4) return false;

    size_t sizeBytes = (size_t)payload.stride * payload.height;

    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < descriptorCount; ++index)
    {
        void* mapped = mmap(nullptr, sizeBytes, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, descriptors[index], 0);
        if (mapped == MAP_FAILED)
        {
            for (uint32_t taken = 0; taken < descriptorCount; ++taken) close(descriptors[taken]);
            ReleaseBuffers(session);
            return false;
        }

        session.buffers[index].pixels = (uint8_t*)mapped;
        session.buffers[index].sizeBytes = sizeBytes;
        session.buffers[index].fileDescriptor = descriptors[index];
        session.buffers[index].heldByShell = false;
    }

    session.bufferCount = payload.count;
    session.width = payload.width;
    session.height = payload.height;
    session.stride = payload.stride;

    return true;
}

static void HandleMessage(HostedWindow::Session& session, const ControlChannel::Message& message)
{
    if (message.kind == ControlChannel::MessageKind::PresentDone)
    {
        session.frameArrived = true;
        session.framePending = false;
        session.lastFrameTimeNanos = message.payload.presentDone.frameTimeNanos;
        return;
    }

    if (message.kind == ControlChannel::MessageKind::BufferReleased)
    {
        uint32_t index = message.payload.bufferReleased.index;
        if (index < session.bufferCount) session.buffers[index].heldByShell = false;
        return;
    }

    if (message.kind == ControlChannel::MessageKind::Input)
    {
        const ControlChannel::InputPayload& source = message.payload.input;

        WaylandClient::InputEvent event{};
        event.kind = source.kind == ControlChannel::InputKind::Key ? WaylandClient::InputKind::Key : WaylandClient::InputKind::Touch;
        event.action = source.action;
        event.pointerId = source.pointerId;
        event.keyCode = source.keyCode;
        event.unicode = source.unicode;
        event.metaState = source.metaState;
        event.x = source.x;
        event.y = source.y;
        event.timeNanos = source.timeNanos;

        QueueInput(session, event);
        return;
    }

    if (message.kind == ControlChannel::MessageKind::Stop)
    {
        session.stopRequested = true;
    }
}

bool HostedWindow::IsRequested()
{
    return ControlChannel::IsConfigured();
}

HostedWindow::Result HostedWindow::Open(uint32_t width, uint32_t height, const char* packageName, Session& session)
{
    if (session.open) return Result::AlreadyOpen;

    if (ControlChannel::AdoptFromEnvironment(session.channel) != ControlChannel::Result::Ok) return Result::NoChannel;

    ControlChannel::Message hello{};
    ControlChannel::Prepare(hello, ControlChannel::MessageKind::Hello);
    hello.payload.hello.version = ControlChannel::PROTOCOL_VERSION;
    hello.payload.hello.width = width;
    hello.payload.hello.height = height;
    ControlChannel::CopyText(hello.payload.hello.packageName, ControlChannel::MAX_NAME_BYTES, packageName);

    if (ControlChannel::Send(session.channel, hello) != ControlChannel::Result::Ok)
    {
        ControlChannel::Close(session.channel);
        return Result::HandshakeFailed;
    }

    ControlChannel::Message reply{};
    int descriptors[ControlChannel::MAX_DESCRIPTORS];
    uint32_t descriptorCount = ControlChannel::MAX_DESCRIPTORS;

    ControlChannel::Result received =
        ControlChannel::ReceiveWithDescriptors(session.channel, reply, descriptors, descriptorCount, HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT_MILLIS);

    if (received != ControlChannel::Result::Ok || reply.kind != ControlChannel::MessageKind::Buffers)
    {
        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < descriptorCount; ++index) close(descriptors[index]);
        fprintf(stderr, "[hostedwindow] the shell did not hand over frame buffers\n");
        ControlChannel::Close(session.channel);
        return Result::HandshakeFailed;
    }

    if (!AdoptBuffers(session, reply.payload.buffers, descriptors, descriptorCount))
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[hostedwindow] the frame buffers the shell offered cannot be mapped\n");
        ControlChannel::Close(session.channel);
        return Result::MappingFailed;
    }

    session.open = true;

    fprintf(stderr, "[hostedwindow] hosted by a shell: %u buffer(s) of %ux%u, stride %u\n", session.bufferCount, session.width,
            session.height, session.stride);

    return Result::Ok;
}

void HostedWindow::Close(Session& session)
{
    if (!session.open && session.channel.fileDescriptor == ControlChannel::INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR) return;

    ReleaseBuffers(session);
    ControlChannel::Close(session.channel);

    session.currentIndex = INVALID_BUFFER_INDEX;
    session.open = false;
}

HostedWindow::Result HostedWindow::AcquireBuffer(Session& session, Buffer*& buffer)
{
    if (!session.open) return Result::NotOpen;

    for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 2; ++attempt)
    {
        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < session.bufferCount; ++index)
        {
            if (session.buffers[index].heldByShell) continue;

            session.currentIndex = index;
            buffer = &session.buffers[index];
            return Result::Ok;
        }

        if (attempt == 0) Pump(session, 0);
    }

    return Result::NoFreeBuffer;
}

HostedWindow::Result HostedWindow::Present(Session& session, uint64_t frameTimeNanos)
{
    if (!session.open) return Result::NotOpen;
    if (session.currentIndex >= session.bufferCount) return Result::NoFreeBuffer;

    ControlChannel::Message ready{};
    ControlChannel::Prepare(ready, ControlChannel::MessageKind::FrameReady);
    ready.payload.frameReady.index = session.currentIndex;
    ready.payload.frameReady.sequence = session.sequence;
    ready.payload.frameReady.frameTimeNanos = frameTimeNanos;

    ControlChannel::Result sent = ControlChannel::Send(session.channel, ready);

    if (sent == ControlChannel::Result::PeerClosed)
    {
        session.stopRequested = true;
        return Result::PeerClosed;
    }

    session.buffers[session.currentIndex].heldByShell = true;
    session.currentIndex = INVALID_BUFFER_INDEX;
    session.sequence += 1;

    return sent == ControlChannel::Result::Ok ? Result::Ok : Result::PeerClosed;
}

HostedWindow::Result HostedWindow::RequestFrame(Session& session)
{
    if (!session.open) return Result::NotOpen;

    session.framePending = true;
    return Result::Ok;
}

HostedWindow::Result HostedWindow::Pump(Session& session, int timeoutMillis)
{
    if (!session.open) return Result::NotOpen;

    int remaining = timeoutMillis;

    for (;;)
    {
        ControlChannel::Message message{};
        ControlChannel::Result received = ControlChannel::Receive(session.channel, message, remaining);

        if (received == ControlChannel::Result::WouldBlock) return Result::Ok;

        if (received == ControlChannel::Result::PeerClosed)
        {
            session.stopRequested = true;
            return Result::PeerClosed;
        }

        if (received == ControlChannel::Result::Ok) HandleMessage(session, message);

        remaining = 0;
    }
}

bool HostedWindow::NextInputEvent(Session& session, WaylandClient::InputEvent& event)
{
    if (session.queueCount <= 0) return false;

    event = session.queued[session.queueHead];
    session.queueHead = (session.queueHead + 1) % MAX_QUEUED_INPUT;
    session.queueCount -= 1;

    return true;
}

void HostedWindow::ReportGuestPresents(Session& session)
{
    if (!session.open) return;

    ControlChannel::Message message{};
    ControlChannel::Prepare(message, ControlChannel::MessageKind::GuestPresents);
    ControlChannel::Send(session.channel, message);
}

bool HostedWindow::RequestLaunch(Session& session, const char* packageName)
{
    if (!session.open || !packageName || packageName[0] == '\0') return false;

    ControlChannel::Message message{};
    ControlChannel::Prepare(message, ControlChannel::MessageKind::LaunchPackage);

    if (!ControlChannel::CopyText(message.payload.launchPackage.packageName, ControlChannel::MAX_PACKAGE_BYTES, packageName)) return false;

    return ControlChannel::Send(session.channel, message) == ControlChannel::Result::Ok;
}


void HostedWindow::SendExit(Session& session, int32_t status)
{
    if (session.channel.fileDescriptor == ControlChannel::INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR) return;

    ControlChannel::Message message{};
    ControlChannel::Prepare(message, ControlChannel::MessageKind::Exit);
    message.payload.exit.status = status;

    ControlChannel::Send(session.channel, message);
}

const char* HostedWindow::ResultName(Result result)
{
    switch (result)
    {
        case Result::Ok: return "Ok";
        case Result::AlreadyOpen: return "AlreadyOpen";
        case Result::NotOpen: return "NotOpen";
        case Result::NoChannel: return "NoChannel";
        case Result::HandshakeFailed: return "HandshakeFailed";
        case Result::MappingFailed: return "MappingFailed";
        case Result::NoFreeBuffer: return "NoFreeBuffer";
        case Result::PeerClosed: return "PeerClosed";
    }

    return "Unknown";
}
```

`src/FrameworkJni/ResourceBridge.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "FrameworkJni/ResourceBridge.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <mutex>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <vector>

#include "AndroidfwC.h"
#include "FrameworkJni/FrameworkJni.hpp"

static std::mutex gHandleLock;
static std::set<jlong> gLiveThemes;
static std::set<jlong> gLiveXml;

static AndroidfwApk* ApkFrom(jlong handle)
{
    const Apk::Package* package = FrameworkJni::GetPackage();
    if (!package || package->assetsHandle != reinterpret_cast<void*>(handle)) return nullptr;
    return reinterpret_cast<AndroidfwApk*>(handle);
}

static AndroidfwTheme* ThemeFrom(jlong handle)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gHandleLock);
    if (handle == 0 || gLiveThemes.find(handle) == gLiveThemes.end()) return nullptr;
    return reinterpret_cast<AndroidfwTheme*>(handle);
}

static AndroidfwXml* XmlFrom(jlong handle)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gHandleLock);
    if (handle == 0 || gLiveXml.find(handle) == gLiveXml.end()) return nullptr;
    return reinterpret_cast<AndroidfwXml*>(handle);
}

static void RegisterHandle(std::set<jlong>& registry, jlong handle)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gHandleLock);
    registry.insert(handle);
}

static void ForgetHandle(std::set<jlong>& registry, jlong handle)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gHandleLock);
    registry.erase(handle);
}

static std::string TakeString(JNIEnv* env, jstring value)
{
    if (!value) return std::string();

    const char* chars = env->GetStringUTFChars(value, nullptr);
    if (!chars) return std::string();

    std::string result(chars);
    env->ReleaseStringUTFChars(value, chars);
    return result;
}

static bool GrownText(int (*fetch)(void*, char*, int), void* context, std::string& out)
{
    std::string buffer(1024, '\0');

    int needed = fetch(context, buffer.data(), static_cast<int>(buffer.size()));
    if (needed == ANDROIDFW_ABSENT) return false;

    if (needed >= static_cast<int>(buffer.size()))
    {
        if (needed >= ResourceBridge::MAX_RESOURCE_TEXT) return false;
        buffer.assign(static_cast<size_t>(needed) + 1, '\0');
        needed = fetch(context, buffer.data(), static_cast<int>(buffer.size()));
        if (needed == ANDROIDFW_ABSENT || needed >= static_cast<int>(buffer.size())) return false;
    }

    buffer.resize(static_cast<size_t>(needed));
    out = buffer;
    return true;
}

static jstring Grown(JNIEnv* env, int (*fetch)(void*, char*, int), void* context)
{
    std::string text;
    if (!GrownText(fetch, context, text)) return nullptr;
    return env->NewStringUTF(text.c_str());
}

struct ResourceRequest
{
    AndroidfwApk* apk = nullptr;
    uint32_t resourceId = 0;
    int cookie = 0;
};

static int FetchString(void* context, char* out, int outSize)
{
    ResourceRequest* request = static_cast<ResourceRequest*>(context);
    return AndroidfwApkGetString(request->apk, request->resourceId, out, outSize);
}

static int FetchPooled(void* context, char* out, int outSize)
{
    ResourceRequest* request = static_cast<ResourceRequest*>(context);
    return AndroidfwApkGetPooledString(request->apk, request->cookie, request->resourceId, out, outSize);
}

static int FetchResourceName(void* context, char* out, int outSize)
{
    ResourceRequest* request = static_cast<ResourceRequest*>(context);
    return AndroidfwApkGetResourceName(request->apk, request->resourceId, out, outSize);
}

static jstring ResourcesGetString(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jint resourceId)
{
    bool trace = FrameworkJni::IsTracing("resources");

    AndroidfwApk* apk = ApkFrom(handle);
    if (!apk)
    {
        if (trace) fprintf(stderr, "[resources] 0x%08x -> <no package>\n", static_cast<unsigned>(resourceId));
        return nullptr;
    }

    ResourceRequest request{apk, static_cast<uint32_t>(resourceId), 0};

    std::string value;
    if (!GrownText(&FetchString, &request, value))
    {
        if (trace) fprintf(stderr, "[resources] 0x%08x -> EntryNotFound\n", static_cast<unsigned>(resourceId));
        return nullptr;
    }

    if (trace)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[resources] 0x%08x -> \"%s\"\n", static_cast<unsigned>(resourceId), value.c_str());
        fflush(stderr);
    }

    return env->NewStringUTF(value.c_str());
}

static jstring ResourcesGetPooledString(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jint cookie, jint stringIndex)
{
    AndroidfwApk* apk = ApkFrom(handle);
    if (!apk) return nullptr;

    ResourceRequest request{apk, static_cast<uint32_t>(stringIndex), cookie};
    return Grown(env, &FetchPooled, &request);
}

static jstring ResourcesGetResourceName(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jint resourceId)
{
    AndroidfwApk* apk = ApkFrom(handle);
    if (!apk) return nullptr;

    ResourceRequest request{apk, static_cast<uint32_t>(resourceId), 0};
    return Grown(env, &FetchResourceName, &request);
}

static jint ResourcesGetIdentifier(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jstring name, jstring defType, jstring defPackage)
{
    AndroidfwApk* apk = ApkFrom(handle);
    if (!apk) return 0;

    std::string nameText = TakeString(env, name);
    std::string typeText = TakeString(env, defType);
    std::string packageText = TakeString(env, defPackage);

    return static_cast<jint>(AndroidfwApkGetIdentifier(apk, nameText.c_str(), typeText.c_str(), packageText.c_str()));
}

static jintArray PackTriple(JNIEnv* env, int32_t type, uint32_t data, uint32_t resourceId)
{
    jintArray array = env->NewIntArray(3);
    if (!array) return nullptr;

    jint values[3] = {static_cast<jint>(type), static_cast<jint>(data), static_cast<jint>(resourceId)};
    env->SetIntArrayRegion(array, 0, 3, values);
    return array;
}

static jintArray ResourcesGetResourceValue(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jint resourceId)
{
    AndroidfwApk* apk = ApkFrom(handle);
    if (!apk) return nullptr;

    int32_t type = 0;
    uint32_t data = 0;
    uint32_t resolved = 0;
    if (!AndroidfwApkGetResourceValue(apk, static_cast<uint32_t>(resourceId), &type, &data, &resolved)) return nullptr;

    return PackTriple(env, type, data, resolved);
}

static jint ResourcesGetArraySize(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle, jint resourceId)
{
    AndroidfwApk* apk = ApkFrom(handle);
    if (!apk) return -1;

    return static_cast<jint>(AndroidfwApkGetArraySize(apk, static_cast<uint32_t>(resourceId)));
}

static jintArray ResourcesGetArrayEntry(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jint resourceId, jint index)
{
    AndroidfwApk* apk = ApkFrom(handle);
    if (!apk) return nullptr;

    int32_t type = 0;
    uint32_t data = 0;
    uint32_t resolved = 0;

    if (!AndroidfwApkGetArrayEntry(apk, static_cast<uint32_t>(resourceId), index, &type, &data, &resolved)) return nullptr;

    return PackTriple(env, type, data, resolved);
}

static jlong ResourcesOpenXmlResource(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle, jint resourceId)
{
    AndroidfwApk* apk = ApkFrom(handle);
    if (!apk) return 0;

    AndroidfwXml* xml = AndroidfwXmlOpenResource(apk, static_cast<uint32_t>(resourceId));
    if (!xml) return 0;

    jlong xmlHandle = reinterpret_cast<jlong>(xml);
    RegisterHandle(gLiveXml, xmlHandle);
    return xmlHandle;
}

static jlong ResourcesOpenXmlBuffer(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jbyteArray data)
{
    AndroidfwApk* apk = ApkFrom(handle);
    if (!apk || !data) return 0;

    jsize length = env->GetArrayLength(data);
    if (length <= 0) return 0;

    std::vector<jbyte> bytes(static_cast<size_t>(length));
    env->GetByteArrayRegion(data, 0, length, bytes.data());

    AndroidfwXml* xml = AndroidfwXmlOpenBuffer(apk, bytes.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>(length));
    if (!xml) return 0;

    jlong xmlHandle = reinterpret_cast<jlong>(xml);
    RegisterHandle(gLiveXml, xmlHandle);
    return xmlHandle;
}

static bool ReadAttributes(JNIEnv* env, jintArray attributes, std::vector<uint32_t>& out)
{
    jsize count = env->GetArrayLength(attributes);
    if (count <= 0) return false;

    out.resize(static_cast<size_t>(count));
    env->GetIntArrayRegion(attributes, 0, count, reinterpret_cast<jint*>(out.data()));
    return true;
}

static void WriteResults(JNIEnv* env, jintArray outValues, jintArray outIndices, const std::vector<uint32_t>& values,
                         const std::vector<uint32_t>& indices)
{
    env->SetIntArrayRegion(outValues, 0, static_cast<jsize>(values.size()), reinterpret_cast<const jint*>(values.data()));
    if (outIndices) env->SetIntArrayRegion(outIndices, 0, static_cast<jsize>(indices.size()), reinterpret_cast<const jint*>(indices.data()));
}

static void ResourcesObtainNoTheme(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jlong xmlHandle, jintArray attributes, jintArray outValues,
                                   jintArray outIndices)
{
    AndroidfwApk* apk = ApkFrom(handle);
    if (!apk) return;

    std::vector<uint32_t> wanted;
    if (!ReadAttributes(env, attributes, wanted)) return;

    std::vector<uint32_t> values(wanted.size() * ANDROIDFW_STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES, 0);
    std::vector<uint32_t> indices(wanted.size() + 1, 0);

    AndroidfwObtainStyledNoTheme(apk, XmlFrom(xmlHandle), wanted.data(), static_cast<int>(wanted.size()), values.data(),
                                 indices.data());

    WriteResults(env, outValues, outIndices, values, indices);
}

static std::set<jlong> gLiveAssets;
static std::set<int> gLiveDescriptors;

static jlong AssetsOpen(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jstring path)
{
    const Apk::Package* package = FrameworkJni::GetPackage();
    if (!package || !ApkFrom(handle) || !path) return 0;

    std::string wanted = TakeString(env, path);
    if (wanted.empty()) return 0;

    Apk::Asset* asset = new Apk::Asset();
    if (Apk::OpenAsset(*package, wanted, *asset) != Apk::Result::Ok)
    {
        delete asset;
        return 0;
    }

    jlong assetHandle = reinterpret_cast<jlong>(asset);
    RegisterHandle(gLiveAssets, assetHandle);
    return assetHandle;
}

static jlong AssetsOpenNonAsset(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jstring path)
{
    const Apk::Package* package = FrameworkJni::GetPackage();
    if (!package || !ApkFrom(handle) || !path) return 0;

    std::string wanted = TakeString(env, path);
    if (wanted.empty()) return 0;

    Apk::Asset* asset = new Apk::Asset();
    if (Apk::OpenNonAsset(*package, wanted, *asset) != Apk::Result::Ok)
    {
        delete asset;
        return 0;
    }

    jlong assetHandle = reinterpret_cast<jlong>(asset);
    RegisterHandle(gLiveAssets, assetHandle);
    return assetHandle;
}

static Apk::Asset* AssetFrom(jlong handle)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gHandleLock);
    if (handle == 0 || gLiveAssets.find(handle) == gLiveAssets.end()) return nullptr;
    return reinterpret_cast<Apk::Asset*>(handle);
}

static Apk::Asset* ClaimAsset(jlong handle)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gHandleLock);
    if (handle == 0 || gLiveAssets.erase(handle) == 0) return nullptr;
    return reinterpret_cast<Apk::Asset*>(handle);
}

static jobject AssetsOpenFd(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong assetHandle, jlongArray outExtent)
{
    Apk::Asset* asset = AssetFrom(assetHandle);
    if (!asset || !outExtent) return nullptr;
    if (env->GetArrayLength(outExtent) < 3) return nullptr;

    int descriptor = -1;
    int64_t offset = 0;
    int64_t length = 0;
    if (Apk::AssetFileDescriptor(*asset, descriptor, offset, length) != Apk::Result::Ok) return nullptr;

    jclass descriptorClass = env->FindClass("java/io/FileDescriptor");
    if (!descriptorClass)
    {
        env->ExceptionClear();
        close(descriptor);
        FrameworkJni::Unimplemented(env, "java.io.FileDescriptor is missing");
        return nullptr;
    }

    jmethodID init = env->GetMethodID(descriptorClass, "<init>", "()V");
    if (!init)
    {
        env->ExceptionClear();
        close(descriptor);
        FrameworkJni::Unimplemented(env, "java.io.FileDescriptor has no no-argument constructor");
        return nullptr;
    }

    jmethodID setInt = env->GetMethodID(descriptorClass, "setInt$", "(I)V");
    if (!setInt)
    {
        env->ExceptionClear();
        close(descriptor);
        FrameworkJni::Unimplemented(env, "java.io.FileDescriptor has no setInt$(int)");
        return nullptr;
    }

    jobject produced = env->NewObject(descriptorClass, init);
    if (!produced)
    {
        close(descriptor);
        return nullptr;
    }

    env->CallVoidMethod(produced, setInt, static_cast<jint>(descriptor));

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gHandleLock);
        gLiveDescriptors.insert(descriptor);
    }

    jlong extent[3] = {static_cast<jlong>(descriptor), static_cast<jlong>(offset), static_cast<jlong>(length)};
    env->SetLongArrayRegion(outExtent, 0, 3, extent);

    return produced;
}

static void InvalidateDescriptor(JNIEnv* env, jobject descriptor)
{
    if (!descriptor) return;

    jclass descriptorClass = env->GetObjectClass(descriptor);
    jmethodID setInt = descriptorClass ? env->GetMethodID(descriptorClass, "setInt$", "(I)V") : nullptr;
    if (!setInt)
    {
        env->ExceptionClear();
        return;
    }

    env->CallVoidMethod(descriptor, setInt, static_cast<jint>(-1));
}

static jboolean DescriptorClose(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jobject descriptor, jint fileDescriptor)
{
    InvalidateDescriptor(env, descriptor);

    if (fileDescriptor < 0) return JNI_FALSE;

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gHandleLock);
        if (gLiveDescriptors.erase(fileDescriptor) == 0)
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "[resources] refusing to close descriptor %d, which this runtime did not open\n", fileDescriptor);
            return JNI_FALSE;
        }
    }

    return close(fileDescriptor) == 0 ? JNI_TRUE : JNI_FALSE;
}

static void DescriptorInvalidate(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jobject descriptor)
{
    if (descriptor)
    {
        jclass descriptorClass = env->GetObjectClass(descriptor);
        jmethodID getInt = descriptorClass ? env->GetMethodID(descriptorClass, "getInt$", "()I") : nullptr;

        if (getInt)
        {
            jint detached = env->CallIntMethod(descriptor, getInt);
            if (detached >= 0)
            {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gHandleLock);
                gLiveDescriptors.erase(detached);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            env->ExceptionClear();
        }
    }

    InvalidateDescriptor(env, descriptor);
}

static jlong AssetsLength(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong assetHandle)
{
    Apk::Asset* asset = AssetFrom(assetHandle);
    return asset ? static_cast<jlong>(asset->length) : -1;
}

static jint AssetsRead(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong assetHandle, jbyteArray buffer, jint offset, jint count)
{
    Apk::Asset* asset = AssetFrom(assetHandle);
    if (!asset || !buffer || offset < 0 || count < 0) return -1;

    jsize length = env->GetArrayLength(buffer);
    if (offset > length || count > length - offset) return -1;
    if (count == 0) return 0;

    std::vector<uint8_t> scratch(static_cast<size_t>(count));
    int got = Apk::ReadAsset(*asset, scratch.data(), count);
    if (got == 0) return -1;
    if (got < 0) return -2;

    env->SetByteArrayRegion(buffer, offset, got, reinterpret_cast<const jbyte*>(scratch.data()));
    return got;
}

static void AssetsClose(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong assetHandle)
{
    Apk::Asset* asset = ClaimAsset(assetHandle);
    if (!asset) return;

    Apk::CloseAsset(*asset);
    delete asset;
}

static jobjectArray AssetsList(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jstring directory)
{
    const Apk::Package* package = FrameworkJni::GetPackage();
    if (!package || !ApkFrom(handle)) return nullptr;

    std::string wanted = directory ? TakeString(env, directory) : std::string();

    std::vector<std::string> names;
    if (Apk::ListAssets(*package, wanted, names) != Apk::Result::Ok) return nullptr;

    jclass stringClass = env->FindClass("java/lang/String");
    if (!stringClass) return nullptr;

    jobjectArray result = env->NewObjectArray(static_cast<jsize>(names.size()), stringClass, nullptr);
    if (!result) return nullptr;

    for (size_t index = 0; index < names.size(); ++index)
    {
        jstring name = env->NewStringUTF(names[index].c_str());
        env->SetObjectArrayElement(result, static_cast<jsize>(index), name);
        env->DeleteLocalRef(name);
    }

    return result;
}

static jlong ResourcesCreateTheme(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    AndroidfwApk* apk = ApkFrom(handle);
    if (!apk) return 0;

    AndroidfwTheme* theme = AndroidfwThemeCreate(apk);
    if (!theme) return 0;

    jlong themeHandle = reinterpret_cast<jlong>(theme);
    RegisterHandle(gLiveThemes, themeHandle);
    return themeHandle;
}

static void ResourcesDestroyTheme(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong themeHandle)
{
    AndroidfwTheme* theme = ThemeFrom(themeHandle);
    if (!theme) return;

    ForgetHandle(gLiveThemes, themeHandle);
    AndroidfwThemeDestroy(theme);
}

static void ResourcesClearTheme(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong themeHandle)
{
    AndroidfwTheme* theme = ThemeFrom(themeHandle);
    if (!theme) return;

    AndroidfwThemeClear(theme);
}

static void ResourcesApplyStyle(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong themeHandle, jint resourceId, jboolean force)
{
    AndroidfwTheme* theme = ThemeFrom(themeHandle);
    if (!theme) return;

    bool applied = AndroidfwThemeApplyStyle(theme, static_cast<uint32_t>(resourceId), force == JNI_TRUE);

    if (FrameworkJni::IsTracing("styled") || (!applied && FrameworkJni::IsTracing("resources")))
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[styled] applyStyle theme=%p style=0x%08x applied=%d\n", reinterpret_cast<void*>(themeHandle),
                static_cast<unsigned>(resourceId), applied ? 1 : 0);
        fflush(stderr);
    }
}

static void ResourcesSetTo(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong targetHandle, jlong sourceHandle)
{
    AndroidfwTheme* target = ThemeFrom(targetHandle);
    AndroidfwTheme* source = ThemeFrom(sourceHandle);
    if (!target || !source) return;

    bool copied = AndroidfwThemeSetTo(target, source);
    if (FrameworkJni::IsTracing("styled"))
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[styled] setTo target=%p source=%p copied=%d\n", (void*)target, (void*)source, copied ? 1 : 0);
        fflush(stderr);
    }
}

static jintArray ResourcesResolveAttribute(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong themeHandle, jint attributeId)
{
    AndroidfwTheme* theme = ThemeFrom(themeHandle);
    if (!theme) return nullptr;

    int32_t type = 0;
    uint32_t data = 0;
    uint32_t resourceId = 0;
    if (!AndroidfwThemeResolveAttribute(theme, static_cast<uint32_t>(attributeId), &type, &data, &resourceId)) return nullptr;

    return PackTriple(env, type, data, resourceId);
}

static void ResourcesObtainStyled(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong themeHandle, jlong xmlHandle, jint defStyleAttr, jint defStyleRes, jintArray attributes,
                                  jintArray outValues, jintArray outIndices)
{
    AndroidfwTheme* theme = ThemeFrom(themeHandle);
    if (!theme) return;

    std::vector<uint32_t> wanted;
    if (!ReadAttributes(env, attributes, wanted)) return;

    std::vector<uint32_t> values(wanted.size() * ANDROIDFW_STYLE_NUM_ENTRIES, 0);
    std::vector<uint32_t> indices(wanted.size() + 1, 0);

    bool ok =
        AndroidfwThemeObtainStyled(theme, XmlFrom(xmlHandle), static_cast<uint32_t>(defStyleAttr),
                                   static_cast<uint32_t>(defStyleRes), wanted.data(), static_cast<int>(wanted.size()), values.data(), indices.data());

    if (FrameworkJni::IsTracing("styled"))
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[styled] theme=%p attrs=%zu ok=%d resolved=%u first=0x%08x\n", reinterpret_cast<void*>(themeHandle), wanted.size(),
                ok ? 1 : 0, indices[0], wanted.empty() ? 0u : wanted[0]);
        fflush(stderr);
    }

    WriteResults(env, outValues, outIndices, values, indices);
}

static jint XmlNext(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    AndroidfwXml* xml = XmlFrom(handle);
    if (!xml) return ANDROIDFW_XML_END_DOCUMENT;

    AndroidfwXmlEvent event = AndroidfwXmlNext(xml);
    if (event == ANDROIDFW_XML_ERROR) return ANDROIDFW_XML_END_DOCUMENT;
    return static_cast<jint>(event);
}

static jintArray XmlAttributeValue(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jint index)
{
    int32_t type = 0;
    uint32_t data = 0;
    if (!AndroidfwXmlAttributeValue(XmlFrom(handle), index, &type, &data)) return nullptr;

    jintArray array = env->NewIntArray(2);
    if (!array) return nullptr;

    jint values[2] = {static_cast<jint>(type), static_cast<jint>(data)};
    env->SetIntArrayRegion(array, 0, 2, values);
    return array;
}
```

`src/FrameworkJni/SqliteBridge.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "FrameworkJni/SqliteBridge.hpp"

#include <cstring>
#include <sqlite3.h>
#include <string>

static sqlite3* DatabaseOf(jlong handle)
{
    return reinterpret_cast<sqlite3*>(static_cast<intptr_t>(handle));
}

static sqlite3_stmt* StatementOf(jlong handle)
{
    return reinterpret_cast<sqlite3_stmt*>(static_cast<intptr_t>(handle));
}

static std::string ReadString(JNIEnv* env, jstring value)
{
    if (!value) return std::string();

    const char* bytes = env->GetStringUTFChars(value, nullptr);
    std::string copied = bytes ? bytes : "";
    if (bytes) env->ReleaseStringUTFChars(value, bytes);

    return copied;
}

static jlong SqliteOpen(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jstring path, jboolean readOnly)
{
    std::string target = ReadString(env, path);

    int flags = readOnly ? SQLITE_OPEN_READONLY : (SQLITE_OPEN_READWRITE | SQLITE_OPEN_CREATE);

    sqlite3* database = nullptr;
    if (sqlite3_open_v2(target.c_str(), &database, flags, nullptr) != SQLITE_OK)
    {
        if (database) sqlite3_close_v2(database);
        return 0;
    }

    sqlite3_busy_timeout(database, 5000);
    sqlite3_extended_result_codes(database, 1);

    return static_cast<jlong>(reinterpret_cast<intptr_t>(database));
}

static void SqliteClose(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    sqlite3* database = DatabaseOf(handle);
    if (database) sqlite3_close_v2(database);
}

static jint SqliteExec(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jstring sql)
{
    sqlite3* database = DatabaseOf(handle);
    if (!database) return SQLITE_MISUSE;

    std::string statement = ReadString(env, sql);
    return sqlite3_exec(database, statement.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);
}

static jlong SqlitePrepare(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle, jstring sql)
{
    sqlite3* database = DatabaseOf(handle);
    if (!database) return 0;

    std::string statement = ReadString(env, sql);

    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = nullptr;
    if (sqlite3_prepare_v2(database, statement.c_str(), -1, &prepared, nullptr) != SQLITE_OK) return 0;

    return static_cast<jlong>(reinterpret_cast<intptr_t>(prepared));
}

static void SqliteFinalize(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong statement)
{
    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = StatementOf(statement);
    if (prepared) sqlite3_finalize(prepared);
}

static jint SqliteStep(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong statement)
{
    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = StatementOf(statement);
    if (!prepared) return SqliteBridge::STEP_ERROR;

    int outcome = sqlite3_step(prepared);
    if (outcome == SQLITE_ROW) return SqliteBridge::STEP_ROW;
    if (outcome == SQLITE_DONE) return SqliteBridge::STEP_DONE;

    return SqliteBridge::STEP_ERROR;
}

static void SqliteReset(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong statement)
{
    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = StatementOf(statement);
    if (!prepared) return;

    sqlite3_reset(prepared);
    sqlite3_clear_bindings(prepared);
}

static void SqliteBindNull(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong statement, jint index)
{
    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = StatementOf(statement);
    if (prepared) sqlite3_bind_null(prepared, index);
}

static void SqliteBindLong(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong statement, jint index, jlong value)
{
    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = StatementOf(statement);
    if (prepared) sqlite3_bind_int64(prepared, index, value);
}

static void SqliteBindDouble(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong statement, jint index, jdouble value)
{
    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = StatementOf(statement);
    if (prepared) sqlite3_bind_double(prepared, index, value);
}

static void SqliteBindString(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong statement, jint index, jstring value)
{
    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = StatementOf(statement);
    if (!prepared) return;

    std::string text = ReadString(env, value);
    sqlite3_bind_text(prepared, index, text.c_str(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), SQLITE_TRANSIENT);
}

static void SqliteBindBlob(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong statement, jint index, jbyteArray value)
{
    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = StatementOf(statement);
    if (!prepared) return;

    if (!value)
    {
        sqlite3_bind_null(prepared, index);
        return;
    }

    jsize length = env->GetArrayLength(value);
    jbyte* bytes = env->GetByteArrayElements(value, nullptr);

    sqlite3_bind_blob(prepared, index, bytes, static_cast<int>(length), SQLITE_TRANSIENT);
    env->ReleaseByteArrayElements(value, bytes, JNI_ABORT);
}

static jint SqliteColumnCount(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong statement)
{
    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = StatementOf(statement);
    return prepared ? sqlite3_column_count(prepared) : 0;
}

static jstring SqliteColumnName(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong statement, jint index)
{
    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = StatementOf(statement);
    if (!prepared) return nullptr;

    const char* name = sqlite3_column_name(prepared, index);
    return name ? env->NewStringUTF(name) : nullptr;
}

static jint SqliteColumnType(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong statement, jint index)
{
    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = StatementOf(statement);
    if (!prepared) return SQLITE_NULL;

    return sqlite3_column_type(prepared, index);
}

static jlong SqliteColumnLong(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong statement, jint index)
{
    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = StatementOf(statement);
    return prepared ? sqlite3_column_int64(prepared, index) : 0;
}

static jdouble SqliteColumnDouble(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong statement, jint index)
{
    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = StatementOf(statement);
    return prepared ? sqlite3_column_double(prepared, index) : 0.0;
}

static jstring SqliteColumnString(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong statement, jint index)
{
    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = StatementOf(statement);
    if (!prepared) return nullptr;

    const unsigned char* text = sqlite3_column_text(prepared, index);
    return text ? env->NewStringUTF(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(text)) : nullptr;
}

static jbyteArray SqliteColumnBlob(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong statement, jint index)
{
    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = StatementOf(statement);
    if (!prepared) return nullptr;

    const void* bytes = sqlite3_column_blob(prepared, index);
    int length = sqlite3_column_bytes(prepared, index);
    if (!bytes || length < 0) return nullptr;

    jbyteArray copied = env->NewByteArray(length);
    if (!copied) return nullptr;

    env->SetByteArrayRegion(copied, 0, length, reinterpret_cast<const jbyte*>(bytes));
    return copied;
}

static jint SqliteChanges(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    sqlite3* database = DatabaseOf(handle);
    return database ? sqlite3_changes(database) : 0;
}

static jlong SqliteLastInsertRowId(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    sqlite3* database = DatabaseOf(handle);
    return database ? sqlite3_last_insert_rowid(database) : 0;
}

static jstring SqliteErrorMessage(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    sqlite3* database = DatabaseOf(handle);
    const char* message = database ? sqlite3_errmsg(database) : "no database";

    return env->NewStringUTF(message ? message : "");
}

static jint SqliteErrorCode(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong handle)
{
    sqlite3* database = DatabaseOf(handle);
    return database ? sqlite3_extended_errcode(database) : SQLITE_MISUSE;
}

static jint SqliteParameterCount(JNIEnv*, jclass, jlong statement)
{
    sqlite3_stmt* prepared = StatementOf(statement);
    return prepared ? sqlite3_bind_parameter_count(prepared) : 0;
}

    {"nativeOpen", "(Ljava/lang/String;Z)J", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteOpen)},
    {"nativeClose", "(J)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteClose)},

    {"nativePrepare", "(JLjava/lang/String;)J", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqlitePrepare)},

    {"nativeReset", "(J)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteReset)},
    {"nativeBindNull", "(JI)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteBindNull)},
    {"nativeBindLong", "(JIJ)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteBindLong)},
    {"nativeBindDouble", "(JID)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteBindDouble)},
    {"nativeBindString", "(JILjava/lang/String;)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteBindString)},
    {"nativeBindBlob", "(JI[B)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteBindBlob)},
    {"nativeColumnCount", "(J)I", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteColumnCount)},
    {"nativeColumnName", "(JI)Ljava/lang/String;", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteColumnName)},
    {"nativeColumnType", "(JI)I", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteColumnType)},
    {"nativeColumnLong", "(JI)J", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteColumnLong)},
    {"nativeColumnDouble", "(JI)D", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteColumnDouble)},
    {"nativeColumnString", "(JI)Ljava/lang/String;", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteColumnString)},
    {"nativeColumnBlob", "(JI)[B", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteColumnBlob)},
    {"nativeChanges", "(J)I", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteChanges)},
    {"nativeLastInsertRowId", "(J)J", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteLastInsertRowId)},
    {"nativeErrorMessage", "(J)Ljava/lang/String;", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteErrorMessage)},
    {"nativeErrorCode", "(J)I", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteErrorCode)},
    {"nativeParameterCount", "(J)I", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&SqliteParameterCount)},

    {SqliteBridge::SQLITE_CLASS, SQLITE_METHODS, static_cast<int>(sizeof(SQLITE_METHODS) / sizeof(SQLITE_METHODS[0]))},
};

const ArtRuntime::NativeMethodTable* SqliteBridge::Tables(int& count)

    count = static_cast<int>(sizeof(TABLES) / sizeof(TABLES[0]));
    return TABLES;
}
```

`src/FrameworkJni/TextBridge.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "FrameworkJni/TextBridge.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "FontStack/FontStack.hpp"
#include "FrameworkJni/FrameworkJni.hpp"

static bool gStarted = false;
static bool gStartFailed = false;

static void ReportTextFailure(JNIEnv* env, const char* what, FontStack::Result result);

static bool EnsureFontStack()
{
    if (gStarted) return true;
    if (gStartFailed) return false;

    FontStack::Result started = FontStack::Initialize(nullptr);
    if (started == FontStack::Result::Ok || started == FontStack::Result::AlreadyInitialized)
    {
        gStarted = true;
        return true;
    }

    gStartFailed = true;
    fprintf(stderr, "[text] font stack unavailable: %s\n", FontStack::ResultName(started));
    fprintf(stderr, "[text] set RUNTIME_FONT_DIR to a directory containing Roboto-Regular.ttf\n");
    fflush(stderr);
    return false;
}

static bool ReadChars(JNIEnv* env, jcharArray source, jint index, jint count, std::vector<uint16_t>& out)
{
    if (!source || count < 0 || index < 0) return false;

    jsize length = env->GetArrayLength(source);
    if (index > length || count > length - index) return false;

    out.resize(static_cast<size_t>(count));
    if (count == 0) return true;

    env->GetCharArrayRegion(source, index, count, reinterpret_cast<jchar*>(out.data()));
    return true;
}

static jint TypefaceCreate(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jstring familyName, jint weight, jboolean italic)
{
    if (!EnsureFontStack()) return 0;

    const char* chars = familyName ? env->GetStringUTFChars(familyName, nullptr) : nullptr;

    uint32_t font = FontStack::INVALID_FONT;
    FontStack::Result resolved = FontStack::ResolveFamily(chars, weight, italic == JNI_TRUE, font);

    if (chars) env->ReleaseStringUTFChars(familyName, chars);
    if (resolved != FontStack::Result::Ok) return 0;

    return static_cast<jint>(font);
}

static jint TypefaceLoadFromMemory(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jbyteArray data, jint weight, jboolean italic)
{
    if (!data || !EnsureFontStack()) return 0;

    jsize length = env->GetArrayLength(data);
    if (length <= 0) return 0;

    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(static_cast<size_t>(length));
    env->GetByteArrayRegion(data, 0, length, reinterpret_cast<jbyte*>(bytes.data()));
    if (env->ExceptionCheck()) return 0;

    uint32_t font = FontStack::INVALID_FONT;
    FontStack::Result loaded = FontStack::LoadFontFromMemory(bytes.data(), bytes.size(), weight, italic == JNI_TRUE, font);
    if (loaded != FontStack::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[text] a %d byte app font could not be loaded: %s\n", static_cast<int>(length), FontStack::ResultName(loaded));
        return 0;
    }

    return static_cast<jint>(font);
}

static jint TypefaceWeight(JNIEnv*, jclass, jint font)
{
    int weight = FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL;
    FontStack::FontWeight(static_cast<uint32_t>(font), weight);
    return weight;
}

static jboolean TypefaceIsItalic(JNIEnv*, jclass, jint font)
{
    bool italic = false;
    FontStack::FontIsItalic(static_cast<uint32_t>(font), italic);
    return italic ? JNI_TRUE : JNI_FALSE;
}

static jint PaintInternStyle(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint font, jfloat textSize, jfloat scaleX, jfloat skewX, jfloat letterSpacing, jint flags)
{
    if (!EnsureFontStack())
    {
        FrameworkJni::Unimplemented(env, "android.graphics.Paint text metrics without a usable font directory");
        return 0;
    }

    uint32_t style = FontStack::INVALID_STYLE;
    FontStack::Result interned =
        FontStack::InternStyle(static_cast<uint32_t>(font), textSize, scaleX, skewX, letterSpacing, flags, style);

    if (interned != FontStack::Result::Ok)
    {
        ReportTextFailure(env, "internStyle", interned);
        return 0;
    }

    return static_cast<jint>(style);
}

static void ReportTextFailure(JNIEnv* env, const char* what, FontStack::Result result)
{
    std::string message = std::string("android.graphics.Paint.") + what + " -> " + FontStack::ResultName(result);
    FrameworkJni::Unimplemented(env, message.c_str());
}

static jfloat PaintMeasureText(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint style, jcharArray text, jint index, jint count)
{
    std::vector<uint16_t> chars;
    if (!ReadChars(env, text, index, count, chars)) return 0.0f;

    float advance = 0.0f;
    FontStack::Result measured = FontStack::MeasureText(static_cast<uint32_t>(style), chars.data(), count, advance);
    if (measured != FontStack::Result::Ok)
    {
        ReportTextFailure(env, "measureText", measured);
        return 0.0f;
    }

    return advance;
}

static jint PaintGetTextWidths(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint style, jcharArray text, jint index, jint count, jfloatArray outWidths)
{
    std::vector<uint16_t> chars;
    if (!ReadChars(env, text, index, count, chars)) return 0;
    if (!outWidths || env->GetArrayLength(outWidths) < count) return 0;

    std::vector<float> widths(static_cast<size_t>(count), 0.0f);
    int32_t written = 0;
    if (FontStack::TextWidths(static_cast<uint32_t>(style), chars.data(), count, widths.data(), written) != FontStack::Result::Ok)
    {
        return 0;
    }

    env->SetFloatArrayRegion(outWidths, 0, written, widths.data());
    return written;
}

static void PaintGetFontMetrics(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint style, jfloatArray outMetrics)
{
    if (!outMetrics || env->GetArrayLength(outMetrics) < TextBridge::METRICS_FIELD_COUNT) return;

    FontStack::Metrics metrics;
    if (FontStack::FontMetrics(static_cast<uint32_t>(style), metrics) != FontStack::Result::Ok) return;

    float values[TextBridge::METRICS_FIELD_COUNT] = {metrics.top, metrics.ascent, metrics.descent, metrics.bottom, metrics.leading};
    env->SetFloatArrayRegion(outMetrics, 0, TextBridge::METRICS_FIELD_COUNT, values);
}

static void PaintGetTextBounds(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint style, jcharArray text, jint index, jint count, jintArray outBounds)
{
    if (!outBounds || env->GetArrayLength(outBounds) < TextBridge::BOUNDS_FIELD_COUNT) return;

    std::vector<uint16_t> chars;
    if (!ReadChars(env, text, index, count, chars)) return;

    FontStack::Bounds bounds;
    if (FontStack::TextBounds(static_cast<uint32_t>(style), chars.data(), count, bounds) != FontStack::Result::Ok) return;

    jint values[TextBridge::BOUNDS_FIELD_COUNT] = {bounds.left, bounds.top, bounds.right, bounds.bottom};
    env->SetIntArrayRegion(outBounds, 0, TextBridge::BOUNDS_FIELD_COUNT, values);
}

static jint PaintBreakText(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint style, jcharArray text, jint index, jint count, jfloat maxWidth, jboolean forwards,
                           jfloatArray outMeasured)
{
    std::vector<uint16_t> chars;
    if (!ReadChars(env, text, index, count, chars)) return 0;

    int32_t breakAt = 0;
    float measured = 0.0f;
    if (FontStack::BreakText(static_cast<uint32_t>(style), chars.data(), count, maxWidth, forwards == JNI_TRUE, breakAt, measured)
        != FontStack::Result::Ok)
    {
        return 0;
    }

    if (outMeasured && env->GetArrayLength(outMeasured) >= 1) env->SetFloatArrayRegion(outMeasured, 0, 1, &measured);
    return breakAt;
}

static jboolean PaintHasGlyph(JNIEnv* env, jclass, jint style, jstring text)
{
    if (!text) return JNI_FALSE;

    jsize length = env->GetStringLength(text);
    std::vector<uint16_t> chars(static_cast<size_t>(length));
    if (length > 0) env->GetStringRegion(text, 0, length, reinterpret_cast<jchar*>(chars.data()));

    bool present = false;
    if (FontStack::HasGlyph(static_cast<uint32_t>(style), chars.data(), length, present) != FontStack::Result::Ok) return JNI_FALSE;
    return present ? JNI_TRUE : JNI_FALSE;
}

static const JNINativeMethod TYPEFACE_METHODS[] = {
    {"nativeResolveFamily", "(Ljava/lang/String;IZ)I", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&TypefaceCreate)},
    {"nativeWeight", "(I)I", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&TypefaceWeight)},
    {"nativeIsItalic", "(I)Z", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&TypefaceIsItalic)},
    {"nativeLoadFromMemory", "([BIZ)I", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&TypefaceLoadFromMemory)},
};

static const JNINativeMethod PAINT_METHODS[] = {
    {"nativeInternStyle", "(IFFFFI)I", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&PaintInternStyle)},
    {"nativeMeasureText", "(I[CII)F", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&PaintMeasureText)},
    {"nativeGetTextWidths", "(I[CII[F)I", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&PaintGetTextWidths)},
    {"nativeGetFontMetrics", "(I[F)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&PaintGetFontMetrics)},
    {"nativeGetTextBounds", "(I[CII[I)V", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&PaintGetTextBounds)},
    {"nativeBreakText", "(I[CIIFZ[F)I", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&PaintBreakText)},
    {"nativeHasGlyph", "(ILjava/lang/String;)Z", reinterpret_cast<void*>(&PaintHasGlyph)},
};

static const ArtRuntime::NativeMethodTable TABLES[] = {
    {TextBridge::TYPEFACE_CLASS, TYPEFACE_METHODS, static_cast<int>(sizeof(TYPEFACE_METHODS) / sizeof(TYPEFACE_METHODS[0]))},
    {TextBridge::PAINT_CLASS, PAINT_METHODS, static_cast<int>(sizeof(PAINT_METHODS) / sizeof(PAINT_METHODS[0]))},
};

const ArtRuntime::NativeMethodTable* TextBridge::Tables(int& count)
{
    count = static_cast<int>(sizeof(TABLES) / sizeof(TABLES[0]));
    return TABLES;
}
```

`src/FrameworkJni/WindowBridge.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "FrameworkJni/WindowBridge.hpp"

#include <cerrno>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <sys/epoll.h>
#include <sys/eventfd.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "Overlay/FrameRate.hpp"
#include "Overlay/Overlay.hpp"

#if defined(RUNTIME_HAVE_VULKAN)
#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"
#include "VulkanWsi/VulkanWsi.hpp"
#endif

#if defined(RUNTIME_HAVE_GLES)
#include "GlesWsi/GlesWsi.hpp"
#endif

static void HandleFrame(void* context, uint64_t frameTimeNanos)
{
    WindowBridge::Session* session = static_cast<WindowBridge::Session*>(context);
    session->frameArrived = true;
    session->framePending = false;
    session->lastFrameTimeNanos = frameTimeNanos;
}

static int WatchedDescriptor(const WindowBridge::Session& session)
{
    if (session.isHosted) return session.hosted.channel.fileDescriptor;

    return session.connection.fileDescriptor;
}

WindowBridge::Result WindowBridge::Open(uint32_t width, uint32_t height, const char* title, Session& session)
{
    if (session.open) return Result::AlreadyOpen;

    session.isHosted = HostedWindow::IsRequested();

    if (session.isHosted)
    {
        if (HostedWindow::Open(width, height, title, session.hosted) != HostedWindow::Result::Ok)
        {
            session.isHosted = false;
            return Result::SurfaceFailed;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        if (WaylandClient::Connect(session.connection) != WaylandClient::Result::Ok) return Result::NoCompositor;

        if (WaylandClient::CreateSurface(session.connection, width, height, title, session.surface) != WaylandClient::Result::Ok)
        {
            WaylandClient::Disconnect(session.connection);
            return Result::SurfaceFailed;
        }
    }

    session.wakeFileDescriptor = eventfd(0, EFD_CLOEXEC | EFD_NONBLOCK);
    session.epollFileDescriptor = epoll_create1(EPOLL_CLOEXEC);

    if (session.wakeFileDescriptor < 0 || session.epollFileDescriptor < 0)
    {
        Close(session);
        return Result::PollFailed;
    }

    epoll_event displayEvent{};
    displayEvent.events = EPOLLIN;
    displayEvent.data.fd = WatchedDescriptor(session);
    epoll_ctl(session.epollFileDescriptor, EPOLL_CTL_ADD, displayEvent.data.fd, &displayEvent);

    epoll_event wakeEvent{};
    wakeEvent.events = EPOLLIN;
    wakeEvent.data.fd = session.wakeFileDescriptor;
    epoll_ctl(session.epollFileDescriptor, EPOLL_CTL_ADD, session.wakeFileDescriptor, &wakeEvent);

    session.open = true;

#if defined(RUNTIME_HAVE_VULKAN)
    if (!session.isHosted) VulkanWsi::AttachSurfaceTarget(session.connection.display, session.surface.surface);
#endif

#if defined(RUNTIME_HAVE_GLES)
    if (!session.isHosted) GlesWsi::AttachSurfaceTarget(session.connection.display, session.surface.surface, width, height);
#endif

    return Result::Ok;
}

void WindowBridge::Close(Session& session)
{
    if (session.epollFileDescriptor >= 0) close(session.epollFileDescriptor);
    if (session.wakeFileDescriptor >= 0) close(session.wakeFileDescriptor);

    session.epollFileDescriptor = INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR;
    session.wakeFileDescriptor = INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR;

    if (session.isHosted)
    {
        HostedWindow::SendExit(session.hosted, 0);
        HostedWindow::Close(session.hosted);
        session.hostedCurrent = nullptr;
        session.open = false;
        return;
    }

    WaylandClient::DestroySurface(session.surface);
    WaylandClient::Disconnect(session.connection);

    session.current = nullptr;
    session.open = false;
}

static void ClearToTransparent(Rasterizer::Surface& surface)
{
    if (!surface.pixels) return;

    for (uint32_t row = 0; row < surface.height; row++)
    {
        std::memset(surface.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(row) * surface.stride, 0, static_cast<size_t>(surface.width) * 4);
    }
}

WindowBridge::Result WindowBridge::BeginFrame(Session& session)
{
    if (!session.open) return Result::NotOpen;

    if (session.isHosted)
    {
        HostedWindow::Buffer* hostedBuffer = nullptr;
        if (HostedWindow::AcquireBuffer(session.hosted, hostedBuffer) != HostedWindow::Result::Ok) return Result::NoFreeBuffer;

        session.hostedCurrent = hostedBuffer;
        Rasterizer::WrapSurface(hostedBuffer->pixels, session.hosted.width, session.hosted.height, session.hosted.stride, session.target);
        Rasterizer::Begin(session.target, session.canvas);

        if (session.transparent) ClearToTransparent(session.target);

        return Result::Ok;
    }

    WaylandClient::Buffer* buffer = nullptr;
    if (WaylandClient::AcquireBuffer(session.surface, buffer) != WaylandClient::Result::Ok)
    {
        WaylandClient::Roundtrip(session.connection);
        if (WaylandClient::AcquireBuffer(session.surface, buffer) != WaylandClient::Result::Ok) return Result::NoFreeBuffer;
    }

    session.current = buffer;
    Rasterizer::WrapSurface(buffer->pixels, buffer->width, buffer->height, buffer->stride, session.target);
    Rasterizer::Begin(session.target, session.canvas);

    if (session.transparent) ClearToTransparent(session.target);

    return Result::Ok;
}

static void DumpFrame(const uint8_t* pixels, size_t sizeBytes)
{
    const char* path = Settings::Lookup(WindowBridge::FRAME_DUMP_SETTING);
    if (!path || !*path) return;

    FILE* out = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!out) return;

    fwrite(pixels, 1, sizeBytes, out);
    fclose(out);
}

WindowBridge::Result WindowBridge::EndFrame(Session& session)
{
    if (!session.open) return Result::NotOpen;

    FrameRate::Tick();

    if (session.isHosted)
    {
        if (!session.hostedCurrent) return Result::NoFreeBuffer;

        Overlay::DrawInto(session.hostedCurrent->pixels, session.hosted.width, session.hosted.height, session.hosted.stride);
        DumpFrame(session.hostedCurrent->pixels, session.hostedCurrent->sizeBytes);
        HostedWindow::Present(session.hosted, session.hosted.lastFrameTimeNanos);
        session.hostedCurrent = nullptr;
        return Result::Ok;
    }

    if (!session.current) return Result::NoFreeBuffer;

    Overlay::DrawInto(session.current->pixels, session.current->width, session.current->height, session.current->stride);
    DumpFrame(session.current->pixels, session.current->sizeBytes);
    WaylandClient::Present(session.connection, session.surface, *session.current);
    session.current = nullptr;
    return Result::Ok;
}

WindowBridge::Result WindowBridge::RequestFrame(Session& session)
{
    if (!session.open) return Result::NotOpen;

    if (session.isHosted)
    {
        HostedWindow::RequestFrame(session.hosted);
        Wake(session);
        return Result::Ok;
    }

    if (session.framePending) return Result::Ok;

    if (WaylandClient::RequestFrame(session.connection, session.surface, &HandleFrame, &session) != WaylandClient::Result::Ok)
    {
        return Result::PollFailed;
    }

    session.framePending = true;
    Wake(session);
    return Result::Ok;
}

static void ApplyPendingResize(WindowBridge::Session& session)
{
    if (session.isHosted) return;

    WaylandClient::Surface& surface = session.surface;

    if (surface.pendingWidth == 0 || surface.pendingHeight == 0) return;
    if (surface.pendingWidth == surface.width && surface.pendingHeight == surface.height) return;

    uint32_t width = surface.pendingWidth;
    uint32_t height = surface.pendingHeight;

    if (session.current != nullptr) return;

    WaylandClient::Result resized = WaylandClient::Resize(session.connection, surface, width, height);

    if (resized != WaylandClient::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[windowbridge] the compositor asked for %ux%u and the buffers could not follow: %s\n", width, height,
                WaylandClient::ResultName(resized));
        surface.pendingWidth = surface.width;
        surface.pendingHeight = surface.height;
        return;
    }

    fprintf(stderr, "[windowbridge] the window is now %ux%u\n", width, height);

    session.resizedWidth = width;
    session.resizedHeight = height;
    session.resizePending = true;

#if defined(RUNTIME_HAVE_GLES)
    GlesWsi::ResizeSurfaceTarget(width, height);
#endif
}

WindowBridge::Result WindowBridge::Poll(Session& session, int timeoutMillis)
{
    if (!session.open) return Result::NotOpen;

    if (!session.isHosted) WaylandClient::Flush(session.connection);

    epoll_event events[POLL_EVENT_CAPACITY];
    int ready = epoll_wait(session.epollFileDescriptor, events, POLL_EVENT_CAPACITY, timeoutMillis);
    if (ready < 0) return errno == EINTR ? Result::Ok : Result::PollFailed;

    for (int index = 0; index < ready; ++index)
    {
        if (events[index].data.fd == session.wakeFileDescriptor)
        {
            uint64_t drained = 0;
            ssize_t got = read(session.wakeFileDescriptor, &drained, sizeof(drained));
            (void)got;
            continue;
        }

        if (events[index].data.fd != WatchedDescriptor(session)) continue;

        if (session.isHosted)
        {
            if (HostedWindow::Pump(session.hosted, 0) == HostedWindow::Result::PeerClosed)
            {
                fprintf(stderr, "[windowbridge] the shell closed the control channel\n");
                return Result::NoCompositor;
            }

            continue;
        }

        if ((events[index].events & (EPOLLHUP | EPOLLERR)) != 0)
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "[windowbridge] the compositor hung up on the connection\n");
            session.surface.closeRequested = true;
            return Result::NoCompositor;
        }

        if (WaylandClient::DispatchPending(session.connection) != WaylandClient::Result::Ok)
        {
            WaylandClient::ReportConnectionError(session.connection);
            session.surface.closeRequested = true;
            return Result::NoCompositor;
        }
    }

    ApplyPendingResize(session);

    return Result::Ok;
}

void WindowBridge::Wake(Session& session)
{
    if (session.wakeFileDescriptor < 0) return;

    uint64_t one = 1;
    ssize_t written = write(session.wakeFileDescriptor, &one, sizeof(one));
    (void)written;
}

bool WindowBridge::NextInputEvent(Session& session, WaylandClient::InputEvent& event)
{
    if (session.isHosted) return HostedWindow::NextInputEvent(session.hosted, event);

    return WaylandClient::NextInputEvent(session.connection, event);
}

bool WindowBridge::ConsumeResize(Session& session, uint32_t& width, uint32_t& height)
{
    if (!session.resizePending) return false;

    session.resizePending = false;
    width = session.resizedWidth;
    height = session.resizedHeight;
    return true;
}

WindowBridge::Result WindowBridge::SetFullscreen(Session& session, bool fullscreen)
{
    if (!session.open) return Result::NotOpen;
    if (session.isHosted) return Result::Ok;

    return WaylandClient::SetFullscreen(session.surface, fullscreen) == WaylandClient::Result::Ok ? Result::Ok : Result::NoCompositor;
}

bool WindowBridge::ConsumeFrame(Session& session)
{
    if (session.isHosted)
    {
        if (!session.hosted.frameArrived) return false;

        session.hosted.frameArrived = false;
        return true;
    }

    if (!session.frameArrived) return false;

    session.frameArrived = false;
    return true;
}

bool WindowBridge::IsCloseRequested(const Session& session)
{
    if (session.isHosted) return session.hosted.stopRequested;

    return session.surface.closeRequested;
}

const char* WindowBridge::ResultName(Result result)
{
    switch (result)
    {
        case Result::Ok: return "Ok";
        case Result::AlreadyOpen: return "AlreadyOpen";
        case Result::NotOpen: return "NotOpen";
        case Result::NoCompositor: return "NoCompositor";
        case Result::SurfaceFailed: return "SurfaceFailed";
        case Result::NoFreeBuffer: return "NoFreeBuffer";
        case Result::PollFailed: return "PollFailed";
    }
    return "Unknown";
}
```

`src/FrameworkJni/include/FrameworkJni/HostedWindow.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

#include "ControlChannel/ControlChannel.hpp"
#include "WaylandClient/WaylandClient.hpp"

namespace HostedWindow
{
    inline constexpr int INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR = -1;
    inline constexpr uint32_t INVALID_BUFFER_INDEX = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    inline constexpr int HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT_MILLIS = 5000;
    inline constexpr int MAX_QUEUED_INPUT = 256;

    enum class Result : uint8_t
    {
        Ok,
        AlreadyOpen,
        NotOpen,
        NoChannel,
        HandshakeFailed,
        MappingFailed,
        NoFreeBuffer,
        PeerClosed
    };

    struct Buffer
    {
        uint8_t* pixels = nullptr;
        size_t sizeBytes = 0;
        int fileDescriptor = INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR;
        bool heldByShell = false;
    };

    struct Session
    {
        ControlChannel::Endpoint channel;
        Buffer buffers[ControlChannel::MAX_FRAME_BUFFERS];
        uint32_t bufferCount = 0;
        uint32_t width = 0;
        uint32_t height = 0;
        uint32_t stride = 0;
        uint32_t currentIndex = INVALID_BUFFER_INDEX;
        uint64_t sequence = 0;
        uint64_t lastFrameTimeNanos = 0;
        WaylandClient::InputEvent queued[MAX_QUEUED_INPUT];
        int queueHead = 0;
        int queueCount = 0;
        uint64_t queueDropped = 0;
        bool framePending = false;
        bool frameArrived = false;
        bool stopRequested = false;
        bool open = false;
    };

    bool IsRequested();

    Result Open(uint32_t width, uint32_t height, const char* packageName, Session& session);
    void Close(Session& session);

    Result AcquireBuffer(Session& session, Buffer*& buffer);
    Result Present(Session& session, uint64_t frameTimeNanos);
    Result RequestFrame(Session& session);

    Result Pump(Session& session, int timeoutMillis);
    bool NextInputEvent(Session& session, WaylandClient::InputEvent& event);

    void ReportGuestPresents(Session& session);
    bool RequestLaunch(Session& session, const char* packageName);
    void SendExit(Session& session, int32_t status);

    const char* ResultName(Result result);
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

#include "FrameworkJni/HostedWindow.hpp"
#include "Rasterizer/Rasterizer.hpp"
#include "WaylandClient/WaylandClient.hpp"

namespace WindowBridge
{
    inline constexpr const char* FRAME_DUMP_SETTING = "frame-dump";

    inline constexpr int POLL_EVENT_CAPACITY = 8;
    inline constexpr int INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR = -1;

    enum class Result : uint8_t
    {
        Ok,
        AlreadyOpen,
        NotOpen,
        NoCompositor,
        SurfaceFailed,
        NoFreeBuffer,
        PollFailed
    };

    struct Session
    {
        WaylandClient::Connection connection;
        WaylandClient::Surface surface;
        WaylandClient::Buffer* current = nullptr;
        HostedWindow::Session hosted;
        HostedWindow::Buffer* hostedCurrent = nullptr;
        Rasterizer::Surface target;
        Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
        int epollFileDescriptor = INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR;
        int wakeFileDescriptor = INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR;
        uint64_t lastFrameTimeNanos = 0;
        uint32_t resizedWidth = 0;
        uint32_t resizedHeight = 0;
        bool resizePending = false;
        bool framePending = false;
        bool frameArrived = false;
        bool isHosted = false;
        bool open = false;
        bool transparent = false;
    };

    Result Open(uint32_t width, uint32_t height, const char* title, Session& session);
    void Close(Session& session);

    Result BeginFrame(Session& session);
    Result EndFrame(Session& session);
    Result RequestFrame(Session& session);

    Result Poll(Session& session, int timeoutMillis);
    void Wake(Session& session);

    bool ConsumeFrame(Session& session);
    bool ConsumeResize(Session& session, uint32_t& width, uint32_t& height);
    Result SetFullscreen(Session& session, bool fullscreen);
    bool NextInputEvent(Session& session, WaylandClient::InputEvent& event);
    bool IsCloseRequested(const Session& session);

    const char* ResultName(Result result);
}
```

```cpp
#include "GlesWsi/GlesWsi.hpp"

#define EGL_NO_X11 1

#include <EGL/egl.h>
#include <EGL/eglext.h>
#include <GLES3/gl32.h>

#include <cstring>
```
