```cpp
                         (unsigned long long)registers.general[0], DescribeGuestText(state, registers.general[0]).c_str(),
                         (unsigned long long)registers.general[1], DescribeGuestText(state, registers.general[1]).c_str(),
                         (unsigned long long)registers.general[2], DescribeGuestText(state, registers.general[2]).c_str(),
                         DescribeGuestAddress(state, registers.general[30]).c_str());

                traced = described;
                if (state->traceHostCallStacks) traced += DescribeGuestBacktrace(state, registers);
            }

            AbiBridge::Result called =
                AbiBridge::CallHostFromGuest(state->registry, (GuestState::GuestAddress)cursor, registers, state->memory);

            if (state->traceHostCalls)
            {
                fprintf(stderr, "%s = %016llx\n", traced.c_str(), (unsigned long long)registers.general[0]);
                fflush(stderr);
            }

            if (called != AbiBridge::Result::Ok)
            {
                const AbiBridge::Trampoline* trampoline = AbiBridge::LookupTrampoline(state->registry, (GuestState::GuestAddress)cursor);
                fprintf(stderr, "[guestruntime] host call to %s failed: %s\n", trampoline ? trampoline->symbolName.c_str() : "?",
                        AbiBridge::ResultName(called));
                return GuestRuntime::Result::HostCallFailed;
            }

            cursor = registers.general[30];
            continue;
        }

        gRecentEntries[gRecentEntryCursor % RECENT_ENTRY_COUNT] = cursor;
        gRecentEntryCursor += 1;

        Interpreter::ExitStatus status;
        TranslatedBlock translated;

        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(state->translatedMutex);
            auto found = state->translatedBlocks.find(cursor);
            if (found != state->translatedBlocks.end()) translated = found->second;
        }

        const Ir::Block* block = nullptr;

        if (translated.hostEntry)
        {
            LlvmBackend::RuntimeContext runtime;
            runtime.memory = state->memory;
            AttachBlockTrace(runtime);

            memset(&status, 0, sizeof(status));
            ((LlvmBackend::EntryPoint)translated.hostEntry)(&registers, &runtime, &status, translated.entryBlock);

            Bump(state->statistics.blocksExecutedTranslated);
            if (status.reason == Interpreter::ExitReason::Undefined) Bump(state->statistics.trapsHit);
        }
        else
        {
            if (state->configuration.requireTranslated)
            {
                fprintf(stderr,
                        "[guestruntime] %016llx (%s) was reached with no translated entry, and everything is meant to be translated "
                        "ahead of time, so this run cannot continue; it is a hole in ahead-of-time discovery, not something to "
                        "interpret around\n",
                        (unsigned long long)cursor, DescribeGuestAddress(state, cursor).c_str());
                return GuestRuntime::Result::GuestFaulted;
            }

            GuestRuntime::Result failure = GuestRuntime::Result::Ok;
            block = BlockAt(state, cursor, failure);
            if (!block)
            {
                fprintf(stderr,
                        "[guestruntime %d] the guest branched to %016llx, which holds no code; it would return to %016llx (%s), and this "
                        "call entered the guest at %016llx (%s)\n",
                        (int)syscall(SYS_gettid), (unsigned long long)cursor, (unsigned long long)registers.general[30],
                        DescribeGuestAddress(state, registers.general[30]).c_str(), (unsigned long long)entryAddress,
                        DescribeGuestAddress(state, (uint64_t)entryAddress).c_str());
                return failure;
            }

            NativeEntry native = state->configuration.recompile ? NativeEntryFor(state, cursor) : NativeEntry{};

            if (native.hostEntry)
            {
                LlvmBackend::RuntimeContext runtime;
                runtime.memory = state->memory;
                AttachBlockTrace(runtime);

                memset(&status, 0, sizeof(status));

                const uint64_t enclosingEntry = gRecompiledEntry;
                gRecompiledEntry = native.regionAddress;
                ((LlvmBackend::EntryPoint)native.hostEntry)(&registers, &runtime, &status, native.entryBlock);
                gRecompiledEntry = enclosingEntry;

                Bump(state->statistics.blocksExecutedNative);
                if (status.reason == Interpreter::ExitReason::Undefined) Bump(state->statistics.trapsHit);
            }
            else
            {
                status = Interpreter::RunBlock(*block, registers, state->memory, interpreterConfiguration);
                Bump(state->statistics.blocksInterpreted);
                NoteInterpretedBlock(cursor);
            }
        }

        Bump(state->statistics.blocksExecuted);

        if (state->configuration.stepLimit != 0)
        {
            if (status.stepsExecuted > remaining) return GuestRuntime::Result::StepLimitReached;
            remaining -= status.stepsExecuted;
        }

        if (state->configuration.traceGuest)
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "[guest] %016llx -> %s %016llx\n", (unsigned long long)cursor, Interpreter::ExitReasonName(status.reason),
                    (unsigned long long)status.targetAddress);
        }

        if (status.reason == Interpreter::ExitReason::HostCall)
        {
            Bump(state->statistics.hostCalls);

            AbiBridge::Result called = AbiBridge::CallHostFromGuest(state->registry, status.targetAddress, registers, state->memory);
            if (called != AbiBridge::Result::Ok)
            {
                const AbiBridge::Trampoline* trampoline = AbiBridge::LookupTrampoline(state->registry, status.targetAddress);
                fprintf(stderr, "[guestruntime] host call to %s failed: %s\n", trampoline ? trampoline->symbolName.c_str() : "?",
                        AbiBridge::ResultName(called));
                return GuestRuntime::Result::HostCallFailed;
            }

            cursor = registers.general[30];
            continue;
        }

        if (status.reason == Interpreter::ExitReason::Syscall)
        {
            Bump(state->statistics.syscalls);

            GuestSyscall::Result serviced = GuestSyscall::Dispatch(registers, state->memory, state->syscallStatistics);
            if (serviced == GuestSyscall::Result::GuestMemoryFault) return GuestRuntime::Result::GuestFaulted;
            if (serviced == GuestSyscall::Result::ProcessExit) return GuestRuntime::Result::Ok;

            if (state->configuration.traceGuest || serviced == GuestSyscall::Result::Unimplemented)
            {
                fprintf(stderr, "[syscall] %s (%llu) -> %s\n", GuestSyscall::SyscallName((uint32_t)registers.general[8]),
                        (unsigned long long)registers.general[8], GuestSyscall::ResultName(serviced));
            }

            cursor = (uint64_t)status.targetAddress + 4;
            continue;
        }

        if (status.reason == Interpreter::ExitReason::InstructionCacheInvalidated)
        {
            uint64_t line = RoundDownTo((uint64_t)status.faultAddress, Ir::INSTRUCTION_CACHE_LINE_BYTES);
            InvalidateRange(state, line, line + Ir::INSTRUCTION_CACHE_LINE_BYTES);

            cursor = (uint64_t)status.targetAddress + Arm64Decoder::INSTRUCTION_SIZE_BYTES;
            continue;
        }

        if (status.reason == Interpreter::ExitReason::BlockExhausted)
        {
            if (status.hasTargetAddress) cursor = (uint64_t)status.targetAddress;
            else if (block) cursor = (uint64_t)block->guestEndAddress;
            else return GuestRuntime::Result::GuestFaulted;

            continue;
        }

        if (status.reason == Interpreter::ExitReason::IndirectBranch || status.reason == Interpreter::ExitReason::Returned)
        {
            if (!status.hasTargetAddress) return GuestRuntime::Result::GuestFaulted;
            cursor = (uint64_t)status.targetAddress;
            continue;
        }

        uint32_t encoding = 0;
        bool readable = status.hasFaultAddress &&
                        state->memory.Read(state->memory.context, status.faultAddress, &encoding, sizeof(encoding));

        if (readable)
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "[guestruntime] guest exited at %016llx with %s (fault %016llx, encoding %08x)\n",
                    (unsigned long long)cursor, Interpreter::ExitReasonName(status.reason),
                    (unsigned long long)status.faultAddress, encoding);
        }
        else
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "[guestruntime] guest exited at %016llx with %s (fault %016llx)\n", (unsigned long long)cursor,
                    Interpreter::ExitReasonName(status.reason), (unsigned long long)status.faultAddress);
        }

        fprintf(stderr, "[guestruntime] the fault is in %s, called from %s\n", DescribeGuestAddress(state, cursor).c_str(),
                DescribeGuestAddress(state, registers.general[30]).c_str());
        fprintf(stderr, "[guestruntime] sp %016llx, this thread's guest stack spans %016llx-%016llx\n",
                (unsigned long long)registers.stackPointer, (unsigned long long)(gGuestStackTop - gGuestStackBytes),
                (unsigned long long)gGuestStackTop);
        fprintf(stderr, "[guestruntime] guest backtrace:%s\n", DescribeGuestBacktrace(state, registers).c_str());

        uint64_t frame = registers.general[29];
        std::string previous;
        uint64_t repeats = 0;
        for (int depth = 0; depth < 4096 && frame != 0; ++depth)
        {
            uint64_t record[2] = {0, 0};
            if (!state->memory.Read(state->memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)frame, record, sizeof(record))) break;

            std::string described = DescribeGuestAddress(state, record[1]);
            if (described == previous)
            {
                repeats += 1;
            }
            else
            {
                if (repeats != 0) fprintf(stderr, "[guestruntime]   ... repeated %llu more time(s)\n", (unsigned long long)repeats);
                fprintf(stderr, "[guestruntime]   frame %d returns to %s\n", depth, described.c_str());
                previous = described;
                repeats = 0;
            }

            if (record[0] <= frame) break;
            frame = record[0];
        }

        if (repeats != 0) fprintf(stderr, "[guestruntime]   ... repeated %llu more time(s)\n", (unsigned long long)repeats);

        return GuestRuntime::Result::GuestFaulted;
    }
}

static bool EnterGuestCallback(void* context, GuestState::GuestAddress guestAddress, GuestState::Registers& registers)
{
    return CallGuestIn((GuestRuntimeState*)context, guestAddress, registers) == GuestRuntime::Result::Ok;
}

static bool EnterGuestWithStackCallback(void* context, GuestState::GuestAddress guestAddress, GuestState::Registers& registers,
                                        const uint64_t* stackWords, uint32_t stackWordCount)
{
    return CallGuestIn((GuestRuntimeState*)context, guestAddress, registers, stackWords, stackWordCount) == GuestRuntime::Result::Ok;
}

static constexpr uint32_t GUEST_BREAKPOINT_ENCODING = 0xd4200000u;

static void MapSentinelReturnPage(uint64_t pageBytes)
{
    static std::once_flag mapped;
    std::call_once(mapped, [pageBytes]() {
        void* wanted = (void*)GuestRuntime::SENTINEL_RETURN_ADDRESS;
        void* page = mmap(wanted, (size_t)pageBytes, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE, -1, 0);
        if (page == MAP_FAILED || page != wanted)
        {
            if (page != MAP_FAILED) munmap(page, (size_t)pageBytes);
            fprintf(stderr, "[guestruntime] the sentinel return address cannot be backed by a readable page, so guest code that "
                            "reads its own return address will fault\n");
            return;
        }

        uint32_t* words = (uint32_t*)page;
        for (uint64_t index = 0; index < pageBytes / sizeof(uint32_t); ++index) words[index] = GUEST_BREAKPOINT_ENCODING;

        mprotect(page, (size_t)pageBytes, PROT_READ);
    });
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::Create(const Configuration& configuration, Instance& instance)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = new GuestRuntimeState();
    state->configuration = configuration;
    state->pageBytes = Platform::HostPageBytes();

    MapSentinelReturnPage(state->pageBytes);

    uint64_t length = RoundUpTo(configuration.arenaLength, state->pageBytes);

    void* mapped = mmap((void*)configuration.arenaBase, (size_t)length, PROT_NONE,
                        MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_NORESERVE | MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE, -1, 0);
    if (mapped == MAP_FAILED)
    {
        delete state;
        return Result::ArenaUnavailable;
    }

    if ((uint64_t)mapped != configuration.arenaBase)
    {
        munmap(mapped, (size_t)length);
        delete state;
        return Result::ArenaUnavailable;
    }

    state->arena = (uint8_t*)mapped;
    state->arenaBase = configuration.arenaBase;
    InstallFaultReporter(configuration.arenaBase, length);
    GuestSync::SetAddressDescriber(&DescribeAddressForSync, state);
    StartBlockReporter(state);
    state->arenaLength = length;
    state->arenaCursor = configuration.arenaBase + GuestRuntime::IMAGE_REGION_LENGTH;
    state->imageRegionBase = configuration.arenaBase;
    state->scratchCursor = configuration.arenaBase + length;
    state->traceHostCalls = Settings::Tracing("hostcalls");
    state->traceHostCallStacks = Settings::Tracing("hostcall-stacks");
    state->pageFlags.assign((size_t)(length / state->pageBytes), 0);

    state->memory.Read = &MemoryRead;
    state->memory.Write = &MemoryWrite;
    state->memory.TranslateForAtomic = &MemoryTranslateForAtomic;
    state->memory.context = state;
    state->decoder.memory = state->memory;

    instance.implementation = state;

    GuestState::GuestAddress stubBase{};
    Result reserved = ReserveIn(state, configuration.stubRegionLength, Platform::GUEST_MAX_PAGE_BYTES, stubBase);
    if (reserved != Result::Ok)
    {
        Destroy(instance);
        return reserved;
    }

    Result committed = CommitIn(state, (uint64_t)stubBase, configuration.stubRegionLength, true, true, false);
    if (committed != Result::Ok)
    {
        Destroy(instance);
        return committed;
    }

    state->stubBase = (uint64_t)stubBase;
    state->stubLength = configuration.stubRegionLength;

    for (uint64_t offset = 0; offset + sizeof(BRK_ENCODING) <= state->stubLength; offset += sizeof(BRK_ENCODING))
        memcpy(HostAddress(state, state->stubBase + offset), &BRK_ENCODING, sizeof(BRK_ENCODING));

    ProtectIn(state, state->stubBase, state->stubLength, true, false, false);

    AbiBridge::RegistryConfiguration registryConfiguration;
    registryConfiguration.stubRegionBase = stubBase;
    registryConfiguration.stubRegionLength = configuration.stubRegionLength;

    if (AbiBridge::CreateRegistry(registryConfiguration, state->registry) != AbiBridge::Result::Ok)
    {
        Destroy(instance);
        return Result::ArenaUnavailable;
    }

    ElfLoader::Configuration loaderConfiguration;
    loaderConfiguration.searchPaths = configuration.searchPaths;
    loaderConfiguration.memory = state->memory;
    loaderConfiguration.hostResolver.ResolveToGuestStub = &ResolveToGuestStubCallback;
    loaderConfiguration.hostResolver.LookupDefinedStub = &LookupDefinedStubCallback;
    loaderConfiguration.hostResolver.ResolveDataObject = &ResolveDataObjectCallback;
    loaderConfiguration.hostResolver.IsProxyLibrary = &IsProxyLibraryCallback;
    loaderConfiguration.hostResolver.context = state;
    loaderConfiguration.addressSpace.Reserve = &ReserveCallback;
    loaderConfiguration.addressSpace.ReserveForImage = &ReserveForImageCallback;
    loaderConfiguration.addressSpace.Commit = &CommitCallback;
    loaderConfiguration.addressSpace.Protect = &ProtectCallback;
    loaderConfiguration.addressSpace.Release = &ReleaseCallback;
    loaderConfiguration.addressSpace.context = state;

    if (ElfLoader::CreateNamespace(loaderConfiguration, state->libraryNamespace) != ElfLoader::Result::Ok)
    {
        Destroy(instance);
        return Result::ArenaUnavailable;
    }

    Result proxies = RegisterPlatformProxies(instance);
    if (proxies != Result::Ok)
    {
        Destroy(instance);
        return proxies;
    }

    if (configuration.recompile)
    {
        LlvmBackend::Configuration backendConfiguration;
        backendConfiguration.tier = configuration.tier;
        backendConfiguration.traceBlocks = configuration.traceBlocks;

        if (LlvmBackend::Initialize(backendConfiguration, state->backend) != LlvmBackend::Result::Ok)
        {
            Destroy(instance);
            return Result::ArenaUnavailable;
        }

        state->backendReady = true;

        if (configuration.recompileInBackground) state->compiler = std::thread(&RunBackgroundCompiler, state);
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

void GuestRuntime::Destroy(Instance& instance)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state) return;

    uint64_t running = 0;
    for (uint64_t waited = 0;; waited += SHUTDOWN_POLL_MILLISECONDS)
    {
        running = 0;
        for (GuestThread& record : state->threads)
        {
            if (record.worker.joinable() && !record.finished.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) running += 1;
        }

        if (running == 0 || waited >= SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MILLISECONDS) break;
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(SHUTDOWN_POLL_MILLISECONDS));
    }

    if (running != 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr,
                "[guestruntime] %llu guest thread(s) were still running %llu ms after shutdown began, so the arena stays mapped and "
                "the runtime is abandoned rather than pulled out from under them\n",
                (unsigned long long)running, (unsigned long long)SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MILLISECONDS);

        for (GuestThread& record : state->threads)
        {
            if (record.worker.joinable()) record.worker.detach();
        }

        instance.implementation = nullptr;
        return;
    }

    for (GuestThread& record : state->threads)
    {
        if (record.worker.joinable()) record.worker.join();
    }

    ElfLoader::DestroyNamespace(state->libraryNamespace);
    AbiBridge::DestroyRegistry(state->registry);

    if (state->backendReady)
    {
        StopBackgroundCompiler(state);

        for (auto& region : state->recompiledRegions) LlvmBackend::ReleaseFunction(state->backend, region.second.compiled);
        for (LlvmBackend::CompiledFunction& compiled : state->retiredCode) LlvmBackend::ReleaseFunction(state->backend, compiled);

        state->recompiledRegions.clear();
        state->retiredCode.clear();
        state->nativeEntries.clear();

        LlvmBackend::Shutdown(state->backend);
    }

    if (state->arena) munmap(state->arena, (size_t)state->arenaLength);

    delete state;
    instance.implementation = nullptr;
}

ElfLoader::Namespace& GuestRuntime::LibraryNamespace(Instance& instance)
{
    return Implementation(instance)->libraryNamespace;
}

AbiBridge::Registry& GuestRuntime::BridgeRegistry(Instance& instance)
{
    return Implementation(instance)->registry;
}

const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& GuestRuntime::Memory(const Instance& instance)
{
    return Implementation(instance)->memory;
}

GuestState::GuestCaller GuestRuntime::Caller(Instance& instance)
{
    GuestState::GuestCaller caller;
    caller.EnterGuest = &EnterGuestCallback;
    caller.EnterGuestWithStack = &EnterGuestWithStackCallback;
    caller.context = instance.implementation;
    return caller;
}

const GuestRuntime::Statistics& GuestRuntime::GetStatistics(const Instance& instance)
{
    return Implementation(instance)->statistics;
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::Reserve(Instance& instance, uint64_t length, uint64_t alignment, GuestState::GuestAddress& base)
{
    return ReserveIn(Implementation(instance), length, alignment, base);
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::ReserveScratch(Instance& instance, uint64_t length, uint64_t alignment, GuestState::GuestAddress& base)
{
    return ReserveScratchIn(Implementation(instance), length, alignment, base);
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::Commit(Instance& instance, GuestState::GuestAddress address, uint64_t length, bool readable, bool writable,
                                          bool executable)
{
    return CommitIn(Implementation(instance), (uint64_t)address, length, readable, writable, executable);
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::Protect(Instance& instance, GuestState::GuestAddress address, uint64_t length, bool readable, bool writable,
                                           bool executable)
{
    return ProtectIn(Implementation(instance), (uint64_t)address, length, readable, writable, executable);
}

void* GuestRuntime::HostPointer(Instance& instance, GuestState::GuestAddress address, uint64_t length)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state) return nullptr;
    if (length == 0) return nullptr;
    if (!PagesAllow(state, (uint64_t)address, length, PAGE_COMMITTED | PAGE_READABLE | PAGE_WRITABLE)) return nullptr;

    return HostAddress(state, (uint64_t)address);
}

void GuestRuntime::ArenaBounds(const Instance& instance, GuestState::GuestAddress& base, uint64_t& length)
{
    const GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state)
    {
        base = GuestState::GuestAddress{};
        length = 0;
        return;
    }

    base = (GuestState::GuestAddress)state->arenaBase;
    length = state->arenaLength;
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::RegisterDataObject(Instance& instance, const std::string& symbolName, uint64_t sizeInBytes,
                                                      GuestState::GuestAddress& address)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state) return Result::ArenaUnavailable;
    if (sizeInBytes == 0) return Result::OutOfGuestMemory;

    GuestState::GuestAddress base{};
    Result reserved = ReserveScratchIn(state, sizeInBytes, sizeof(uint64_t), base);
    if (reserved != Result::Ok) return reserved;

    Result committed = Commit(instance, base, sizeInBytes, true, true, false);
    if (committed != Result::Ok) return committed;

    if (AbiBridge::RegisterHostData(state->registry, symbolName, base, sizeInBytes) != AbiBridge::Result::Ok)
        return Result::OutOfGuestMemory;

    address = base;
    return Result::Ok;
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::RegisterTranslatedBlock(Instance& instance, GuestState::GuestAddress blockAddress, void* hostEntry,
                                                           uint32_t entryBlock)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state) return Result::ArenaUnavailable;
    if (!hostEntry) return Result::DecodeFailed;

    TranslatedBlock translated;
    translated.hostEntry = hostEntry;
    translated.entryBlock = entryBlock;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(state->translatedMutex);
    state->translatedBlocks[(uint64_t)blockAddress] = translated;

    return Result::Ok;
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::RegisterPlatformProxies(Instance& instance)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state) return Result::ArenaUnavailable;

    static const char* const PLATFORM_SONAMES[] = {
        "libc.so",         "libm.so",           "libdl.so",       "liblog.so",         "libandroid.so",
        "libstdc++.so",    "libz.so",           "libEGL.so",      "libGLESv1_CM.so",   "libGLESv2.so",
        "libGLESv3.so",    "libvulkan.so",      "libjnigraphics.so", "libOpenSLES.so", "libaaudio.so",
        "libmediandk.so",  "libnativewindow.so", "libcamera2ndk.so", "libneuralnetworks.so", "libsync.so"};

    for (const char* soname : PLATFORM_SONAMES)
    {
        AbiBridge::Result registered = AbiBridge::RegisterProxyLibrary(state->registry, soname);
        if (registered != AbiBridge::Result::Ok && registered != AbiBridge::Result::AlreadyRegistered) return Result::ArenaUnavailable;
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::Load(Instance& instance, const std::string& sonameOrPath, uint32_t& moduleId)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state) return Result::ArenaUnavailable;

    ElfLoader::Result result;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(state->libraryMutex);
        result = ElfLoader::LoadLibrary(state->libraryNamespace, sonameOrPath, moduleId);
    }

    if (result != ElfLoader::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[guestruntime] cannot load %s: %s\n", sonameOrPath.c_str(), ElfLoader::ResultName(result));
        return Result::LoadFailed;
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

void GuestRuntime::DescribeModules(Instance& instance, std::vector<Module>& modules)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state) return;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(state->libraryMutex);

    uint64_t loaded = state->libraryNamespace.loaded.size();
    for (const ElfLoader::Library& library : state->libraryNamespace.loaded)
    {
        Module described;
        described.path = library.path;
        described.loadBias = library.loadBias;
        described.programHeaderAddress = (uint64_t)library.programHeaderAddress;
        described.programHeaderCount = library.programHeaderCount;
        described.threadLocalModuleId = library.threadLocalStorage.present ? library.threadLocalStorage.moduleId : 0;
        described.loadEventCount = loaded;

        modules.push_back(described);
    }
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::DescribeAddress(Instance& instance, uint64_t address, Description& description)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state) return Result::ArenaUnavailable;

    description = Description();

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(state->libraryMutex);
    return DescribeAddressIn(state, address, description) ? Result::Ok : Result::NoSuchSymbol;
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::RunInitializers(Instance& instance, uint32_t moduleId)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state) return Result::ArenaUnavailable;

    GuestState::GuestCaller caller = Caller(instance);
    if (ElfLoader::RunInitializers(state->libraryNamespace, moduleId, caller) != ElfLoader::Result::Ok) return Result::GuestFaulted;

    return Result::Ok;
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::Lookup(Instance& instance, const std::string& symbolName, GuestState::GuestAddress& address)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state) return Result::ArenaUnavailable;

    if (ElfLoader::LookupExport(state->libraryNamespace, symbolName, address) != ElfLoader::Result::Ok) return Result::NoSuchSymbol;

    return Result::Ok;
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::CallGuest(Instance& instance, GuestState::GuestAddress entryAddress, GuestState::Registers& registers)
{
    return CallGuestIn(Implementation(instance), entryAddress, registers);
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::CallGuestNested(Instance& instance, const GuestState::Registers& caller,
                                                   GuestState::GuestAddress entryAddress, const uint64_t* arguments,
                                                   uint32_t argumentCount, uint64_t& returned)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state) return Result::ArenaUnavailable;

    GuestState::Registers nested;
    GuestState::Reset(nested);

    uint32_t supplied = argumentCount;
    if (supplied > (uint32_t)GuestState::GENERAL_REGISTER_COUNT) supplied = (uint32_t)GuestState::GENERAL_REGISTER_COUNT;
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < supplied; ++index) nested.general[index] = arguments[index];

    nested.stackPointer = caller.stackPointer;
    nested.threadPointer = caller.threadPointer;
    nested.floatingPointControl = caller.floatingPointControl;

    Result called = CallGuestIn(state, entryAddress, nested);
    returned = nested.general[0];
    return called;
}

bool GuestRuntime::OnGuestThread()
{
    return gActiveState != nullptr && gActiveRegisters != nullptr;
}

bool GuestRuntime::CurrentGuestStack(uint64_t& base, uint64_t& bytes)
{
    if (gGuestStackTop == 0 || gGuestStackBytes == 0) return false;

    bytes = gGuestStackBytes;
    base = gGuestStackTop > bytes ? gGuestStackTop - bytes : 0;
    return true;
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::CallGuestOnCurrentThread(GuestState::GuestAddress entryAddress, const uint64_t* arguments,
                                                            uint32_t argumentCount, uint64_t& returned)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = gActiveState;
    GuestState::Registers* interrupted = gActiveRegisters;
    if (!state || !interrupted) return Result::ArenaUnavailable;

    GuestState::Registers nested;
    GuestState::Reset(nested);

    uint32_t supplied = argumentCount;
    if (supplied > (uint32_t)GuestState::GENERAL_REGISTER_COUNT) supplied = (uint32_t)GuestState::GENERAL_REGISTER_COUNT;
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < supplied; ++index) nested.general[index] = arguments[index];

    nested.stackPointer = (interrupted->stackPointer - SIGNAL_FRAME_GAP_BYTES) & ~(uint64_t)15;
    nested.threadPointer = interrupted->threadPointer;
    nested.floatingPointControl = interrupted->floatingPointControl;

    Result called = CallGuestIn(state, entryAddress, nested);
    returned = nested.general[0];
    return called;
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::AllocateStack(Instance& instance, uint64_t bytes, GuestState::GuestAddress& stackTop)
{
    return AllocateStackIn(Implementation(instance), bytes, stackTop);
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::AllocateThreadPointer(Instance& instance, GuestState::GuestAddress& threadPointer)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state) return Result::ArenaUnavailable;

    uint64_t needed = state->libraryNamespace.staticTlsBytes;
    uint64_t bytes = RoundUpTo(needed < Platform::GUEST_MAX_PAGE_BYTES ? Platform::GUEST_MAX_PAGE_BYTES : needed, state->pageBytes);

    GuestState::GuestAddress base{};
    Result reserved = ReserveIn(state, bytes, Platform::GUEST_MAX_PAGE_BYTES, base);
    if (reserved != Result::Ok) return reserved;

    Result committed = CommitIn(state, (uint64_t)base, bytes, true, true, false);
    if (committed != Result::Ok) return committed;

    std::vector<uint8_t> zeros((size_t)bytes, 0);
    if (!state->memory.Write(state->memory.context, base, zeros.data(), bytes)) return Result::OutOfGuestMemory;

    for (const ElfLoader::Library& library : state->libraryNamespace.loaded)
    {
        const ElfLoader::ThreadLocalStorage& storage = library.threadLocalStorage;
        if (!storage.present || storage.imageSize == 0) continue;

        std::vector<uint8_t> image((size_t)storage.imageSize);
        if (!state->memory.Read(state->memory.context, storage.imageAddress, image.data(), storage.imageSize))
            return Result::OutOfGuestMemory;

        uint64_t destination = (uint64_t)base + storage.staticOffsetFromThreadPointer;
        if (!state->memory.Write(state->memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)destination, image.data(), storage.imageSize))
            return Result::OutOfGuestMemory;
    }

    threadPointer = base;

    fprintf(stderr, "[guestruntime %d] thread pointer %016llx covers %llu bytes\n", (int)syscall(SYS_gettid),
            (unsigned long long)base, (unsigned long long)bytes);

    return Result::Ok;
}

void GuestRuntime::SetThreadExitHandler(Instance& instance, ThreadExitHandler handler, void* context)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state) return;

    state->threadExitHandler = handler;
    state->threadExitContext = context;
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::StartThread(Instance& instance, GuestState::GuestAddress entryAddress, uint64_t argument, uint64_t& handle)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state) return Result::ArenaUnavailable;

    GuestState::GuestAddress stackTop{};
    Result stackReady = AllocateStackIn(state, state->configuration.stackBytes, stackTop);

    if (stackReady != Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[guestruntime] a guest thread needs %llu stack bytes, which the arena refused: %s\n",
                (unsigned long long)state->configuration.stackBytes, ResultName(stackReady));
        return stackReady;
    }

    GuestState::GuestAddress threadPointer{};
    Result pointerReady = AllocateThreadPointer(instance, threadPointer);

    if (pointerReady != Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[guestruntime] a guest thread needs a thread pointer, which the arena refused: %s\n",
                ResultName(pointerReady));
        return pointerReady;
    }

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(state->threadMutex);

    state->threads.emplace_back();
    GuestThread& record = state->threads.back();
    handle = state->threads.size();

    GuestThread* target = &record;
    uint64_t entry = (uint64_t)entryAddress;
    uint64_t stack = (uint64_t)stackTop;
    uint64_t pointer = (uint64_t)threadPointer;

    uint64_t stackBytes = state->configuration.stackBytes;

    target->worker = std::thread([state, target, entry, stack, pointer, argument, stackBytes]() {
        GuestState::Registers registers;
        GuestState::Reset(registers);
        registers.general[0] = argument;
        registers.stackPointer = stack;
        registers.threadPointer = pointer;

        gGuestStackTop = stack;
        gGuestStackBytes = stackBytes;

        GuestRuntime::Result result = CallGuestIn(state, (GuestState::GuestAddress)entry, registers);
        target->faulted = result != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok;
        target->returnValue = registers.general[0];

        fprintf(stderr, "[guestruntime] the guest thread that started at %016llx ended with %s, returning %016llx\n",
                (unsigned long long)entry, GuestRuntime::ResultName(result), (unsigned long long)registers.general[0]);

        if (state->threadExitHandler) state->threadExitHandler(state->threadExitContext);

        target->finished.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    });

    Bump(state->statistics.threadsStarted);
    return Result::Ok;
}

GuestRuntime::Result GuestRuntime::JoinThread(Instance& instance, uint64_t handle, uint64_t& returnValue)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state) return Result::ArenaUnavailable;

    GuestThread* record = nullptr;

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(state->threadMutex);
        if (handle == 0 || handle > state->threads.size()) return Result::ThreadCreationFailed;

        record = &state->threads[(size_t)handle - 1];
        if (record->joined) return Result::ThreadCreationFailed;
        record->joined = true;
    }

    if (record->worker.joinable()) record->worker.join();

    returnValue = record->returnValue;
    return record->faulted ? Result::GuestFaulted : Result::Ok;
}

static uint64_t InvalidateRange(GuestRuntimeState* state, uint64_t start, uint64_t end)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(state->blockMutex);
    uint64_t dropped = 0;

    if (end <= state->codeLowAddress || start >= state->codeHighAddress) return dropped;

    state->invalidationEpoch += 1;
    Bump(state->statistics.codeInvalidations);

    for (auto entry = state->blocks.begin(); entry != state->blocks.end();)
    {
        const Ir::Function& function = entry->second;
        uint64_t blockStart = (uint64_t)function.entryAddress;
        uint64_t blockEnd = function.blocks.empty() ? blockStart + 4 : (uint64_t)function.blocks.front().guestEndAddress;

        if (blockEnd <= start || end <= blockStart)
        {
            ++entry;
            continue;
        }

        state->blockHits.erase(entry->first);
        state->unrecompilable.erase(entry->first);
        state->retired.push_back(std::move(entry->second));
        entry = state->blocks.erase(entry);
        dropped += 1;
    }

    for (auto region = state->recompiledRegions.begin(); region != state->recompiledRegions.end();)
    {
        const RecompiledRegion& record = region->second;

        if (record.endAddress <= start || end <= record.startAddress)
        {
            ++region;
            continue;
        }

        for (uint64_t blockAddress : record.blockAddresses)
        {
            auto native = state->nativeEntries.find(blockAddress);
            if (native != state->nativeEntries.end() && native->second.regionAddress == region->first) state->nativeEntries.erase(native);
        }

        state->retiredCode.push_back(record.compiled);
        region = state->recompiledRegions.erase(region);
        dropped += 1;
    }

    for (auto refused = state->unrecompilable.begin(); refused != state->unrecompilable.end();)
    {
        if (*refused >= start && *refused < end) refused = state->unrecompilable.erase(refused);
        else ++refused;
    }

    return dropped;
}

void GuestRuntime::InvalidateBlocks(Instance& instance, GuestState::GuestAddress address, uint64_t length)
{
    GuestRuntimeState* state = Implementation(instance);
    if (!state) return;

    InvalidateRange(state, (uint64_t)address, (uint64_t)address + length);
}

const char* GuestRuntime::ResultName(Result result)
{
    switch (result)
    {
        case Result::Ok: return "Ok";
        case Result::ArenaUnavailable: return "ArenaUnavailable";
        case Result::OutOfGuestMemory: return "OutOfGuestMemory";
        case Result::LoadFailed: return "LoadFailed";
        case Result::DecodeFailed: return "DecodeFailed";
        case Result::GuestFaulted: return "GuestFaulted";
        case Result::HostCallFailed: return "HostCallFailed";
        case Result::StepLimitReached: return "StepLimitReached";
        case Result::NoSuchSymbol: return "NoSuchSymbol";
        case Result::ThreadCreationFailed: return "ThreadCreationFailed";
    }

    return "Unknown";
}
```

`src/GuestShim/GuestShim.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <jni.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef jint (*AclGuestLoader)(const char* soname, JavaVM* vm, void* reserved);

extern "C" JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL JNI_OnLoad(JavaVM* vm, void* reserved)
{
    Dl_info info;
    memset(&info, 0, sizeof(info));

    if (dladdr((void*)&JNI_OnLoad, &info) == 0 || !info.dli_fname)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[aclguest] the shim cannot determine its own path, so it cannot tell which guest library it stands for\n");
        return JNI_ERR;
    }

    const char* leaf = strrchr(info.dli_fname, '/');
    leaf = leaf ? leaf + 1 : info.dli_fname;

    AclGuestLoader loader = (AclGuestLoader)dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "AclLoadGuestLibrary");
    if (!loader)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[aclguest] %s was loaded outside acl, where there is no guest runtime to hand it to\n", leaf);
        return JNI_ERR;
    }

    return loader(leaf, vm, reserved);
}
```

`src/GuestState/GuestState.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "GuestState/GuestState.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <type_traits>

static_assert(std::has_unique_object_representations<GuestState::Registers>::value,
              "Registers must have no padding holes; Equals compares it with memcmp");

void GuestState::Reset(Registers& registers)
{
    registers = Registers();
}

bool GuestState::Equals(const Registers& left, const Registers& right)
{
    return memcmp(&left, &right, sizeof(Registers)) == 0;
}

void GuestState::Dump(const Registers& registers)
{
    for (int index = 0; index < GENERAL_REGISTER_COUNT; ++index)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "x%-2d = %016llx%s", index, (unsigned long long)registers.general[index], (index % 4) == 3 ? "\n" : "  ");
    }

    fprintf(stderr, "\nsp  = %016llx  pc  = %016llx  tp  = %016llx\n", (unsigned long long)registers.stackPointer,
            (unsigned long long)registers.programCounter, (unsigned long long)registers.threadPointer);
    fprintf(stderr, "nzcv= %08x  fpcr= %08x  fpsr= %08x\n", registers.flagsNzcv, registers.floatingPointControl,
            registers.floatingPointStatus);

    for (int index = 0; index < VECTOR_REGISTER_COUNT; ++index)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "v%-2d = %016llx:%016llx%s", index, (unsigned long long)registers.vector[index].high,
                (unsigned long long)registers.vector[index].low, (index % 2) == 1 ? "\n" : "  ");
    }

    if (registers.exclusive.valid)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "monitor address=%016llx width=%u\n", (unsigned long long)registers.exclusive.address, registers.exclusive.widthBytes);
    }

    fflush(stderr);
}

bool GuestState::ConditionHolds(uint32_t flagsNzcv, uint8_t condition)
{
    bool negative = (flagsNzcv & FLAG_NEGATIVE) != 0;
    bool zero = (flagsNzcv & FLAG_ZERO) != 0;
    bool carry = (flagsNzcv & FLAG_CARRY) != 0;
    bool overflow = (flagsNzcv & FLAG_OVERFLOW) != 0;

    bool result = false;
    switch ((condition >> 1) & 0x7)
    {
        case 0: result = zero; break;
        case 1: result = carry; break;
        case 2: result = negative; break;
        case 3: result = overflow; break;
        case 4: result = carry && !zero; break;
        case 5: result = negative == overflow; break;
        case 6: result = (negative == overflow) && !zero; break;
        case 7: result = true; break;
        default: result = false; break;
    }

    if ((condition & 1) != 0 && (condition & 0xF) != 0xF) result = !result;
    return result;
}
```

`src/GuestState/include/GuestState/GuestState.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

namespace GuestState
{
    inline constexpr int GENERAL_REGISTER_COUNT = 31;
    inline constexpr int VECTOR_REGISTER_COUNT = 32;

    inline constexpr uint32_t FLAG_NEGATIVE = 1u << 31;
    inline constexpr uint32_t FLAG_ZERO = 1u << 30;
    inline constexpr uint32_t FLAG_CARRY = 1u << 29;
    inline constexpr uint32_t FLAG_OVERFLOW = 1u << 28;

    inline constexpr uint32_t FPSR_INVALID_OPERATION = 1u << 0;
    inline constexpr uint32_t FPSR_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO = 1u << 1;
    inline constexpr uint32_t FPSR_OVERFLOW = 1u << 2;
    inline constexpr uint32_t FPSR_UNDERFLOW = 1u << 3;
    inline constexpr uint32_t FPSR_INEXACT = 1u << 4;
    inline constexpr uint32_t FPSR_INPUT_DENORMAL = 1u << 7;
    inline constexpr uint32_t FPSR_SATURATION = 1u << 27;
    inline constexpr uint32_t FPSR_CAPTURED_BITS = 0x0800009Fu;

    enum class GuestAddress : uint64_t;

    struct VectorRegister
    {
        uint64_t low = 0;
        uint64_t high = 0;
    };

    struct ExclusiveMonitor
    {
        uint64_t address = 0;
        uint64_t valueLow = 0;
        uint64_t valueHigh = 0;
        uint32_t widthBytes = 0;
        uint8_t valid = 0;
        uint8_t reservedPadding[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    };

    struct Registers
    {
        uint64_t general[GENERAL_REGISTER_COUNT] = {};
        uint64_t stackPointer = 0;
        uint64_t programCounter = 0;
        uint64_t threadPointer = 0;
        VectorRegister vector[VECTOR_REGISTER_COUNT] = {};
        ExclusiveMonitor exclusive;
        uint32_t flagsNzcv = 0;
        uint32_t floatingPointControl = 0;
        uint32_t floatingPointStatus = 0;
        uint32_t reservedPadding = 0;
    };

    struct MemoryAccessor
    {
        bool (*Read)(void* context, GuestAddress address, void* destination, uint64_t length) = nullptr;
        bool (*Write)(void* context, GuestAddress address, const void* source, uint64_t length) = nullptr;
        void* (*TranslateForAtomic)(void* context, GuestAddress address, uint64_t length) = nullptr;
        void* context = nullptr;
    };

    struct GuestCaller
    {
        bool (*EnterGuest)(void* context, GuestAddress guestAddress, Registers& registers) = nullptr;
        bool (*EnterGuestWithStack)(void* context, GuestAddress guestAddress, Registers& registers, const uint64_t* stackWords,
                                    uint32_t stackWordCount) = nullptr;
        void* context = nullptr;
    };

    void Reset(Registers& registers);
    bool Equals(const Registers& left, const Registers& right);
    void Dump(const Registers& registers);
    bool ConditionHolds(uint32_t flagsNzcv, uint8_t condition);
}
```

`src/GuestSync/GuestSync.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "GuestSync/GuestSync.hpp"

#include <atomic>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <ctime>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"

struct WaitRecord
{
    std::atomic<uint64_t> object{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> caller{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> startedNanos{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> wakesAtStart{0};
    std::atomic<int> threadId{0};
    std::atomic<uint8_t> operation{(uint8_t)GuestSync::Operation::Count};
    std::atomic<bool> active{false};
    std::atomic<bool> reported{false};
};

static std::mutex gRegistryLock;
static std::vector<WaitRecord*> gWaiters;
static std::mutex gWakeLock;
static std::unordered_map<uint64_t, uint64_t> gWakes;
static std::atomic<GuestSync::AddressDescriber> gDescriber{nullptr};
static std::atomic<void*> gDescriberContext{nullptr};
static std::atomic<bool> gDumpedOnStall{false};

static void DescribeAddress(uint64_t address, char* buffer, uint64_t bytes)
{
    GuestSync::AddressDescriber describer = gDescriber.load(std::memory_order_acquire);

    if (!describer || address == 0)
    {
        snprintf(buffer, (size_t)bytes, "%016llx", (unsigned long long)address);
        return;
    }

    describer(gDescriberContext.load(std::memory_order_relaxed), address, buffer, bytes);
}

void GuestSync::SetAddressDescriber(AddressDescriber describer, void* context)
{
    gDescriberContext.store(context, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    gDescriber.store(describer, std::memory_order_release);
}

static uint64_t MonotonicNanos()
{
    struct timespec now;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now);
    return (uint64_t)now.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)now.tv_nsec;
}

const char* GuestSync::OperationName(Operation operation)
{
    switch (operation)
    {
        case Operation::MutexLock: return "mutex lock";
        case Operation::MutexTryLock: return "mutex trylock";
        case Operation::MutexUnlock: return "mutex unlock";
        case Operation::MutexDestroy: return "mutex destroy";
        case Operation::ConditionWait: return "condition wait";
        case Operation::ConditionTimedWait: return "condition timed wait";
        case Operation::ConditionSignal: return "condition signal";
        case Operation::ConditionBroadcast: return "condition broadcast";
        case Operation::ConditionDestroy: return "condition destroy";
        case Operation::SemaphoreWait: return "semaphore wait";
        case Operation::SemaphoreTimedWait: return "semaphore timed wait";
        case Operation::SemaphorePost: return "semaphore post";
        case Operation::OnceEnter: return "once";
        case Operation::ThreadJoin: return "thread join";
        default: return "?";
    }
}

bool GuestSync::TracingRequested()
{
    static const bool requested = Settings::Tracing("sync");

    return requested;
}

static uint64_t StallThresholdNanos()
{
    if (!GuestSync::TracingRequested()) return 0;

    return GuestSync::DEFAULT_STALL_SECONDS * 1000000000ull;
}

static bool ReportStalledWaiters(uint64_t threshold)
{
    uint64_t now = MonotonicNanos();
    bool stalled = false;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gRegistryLock);

    for (WaitRecord* record : gWaiters)
    {
        if (!record->active.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) continue;
        if (record->reported.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) continue;

        uint64_t started = record->startedNanos.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        if (started == 0 || now - started < threshold) continue;

        uint64_t object = record->object.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        uint64_t wakesNow = GuestSync::WakesFor(object);
        uint64_t wakesThen = record->wakesAtStart.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);

        record->reported.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);

        char described[256];
        DescribeAddress(record->caller.load(std::memory_order_relaxed), described, sizeof(described));

        fprintf(stderr,
                "[guestsync] thread %d has been in %s on %016llx for %llu ms, called from %s; that object has been woken %llu time(s) "
                "since the wait began, so this is %s\n",
                record->threadId.load(std::memory_order_relaxed),
                GuestSync::OperationName((GuestSync::Operation)record->operation.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)),
                (unsigned long long)object, (unsigned long long)((now - started) / 1000000ull), described,
                (unsigned long long)(wakesNow - wakesThen), wakesNow == wakesThen ? "a wake that never came" : "a wake that was missed");

        stalled = true;
    }

    return stalled;
}

static void StartWatchdog()
{
    static std::once_flag started;

    std::call_once(started, []() {
        uint64_t threshold = StallThresholdNanos();
        if (threshold == 0) return;

        std::thread watcher([threshold]() {
            for (;;)
            {
                struct timespec span;
                span.tv_sec = (time_t)(GuestSync::WATCHDOG_INTERVAL_NANOS / 1000000000ull);
                span.tv_nsec = (long)(GuestSync::WATCHDOG_INTERVAL_NANOS % 1000000000ull);
                nanosleep(&span, nullptr);

                if (!ReportStalledWaiters(threshold)) continue;
                if (gDumpedOnStall.exchange(true)) continue;

                GuestSync::DescribeWaiters();
            }
        });

        watcher.detach();
    });
}

static WaitRecord& RecordForCallingThread()
{
    static thread_local WaitRecord* record = []() {
        WaitRecord* created = new WaitRecord();
        created->threadId.store((int)gettid(), std::memory_order_relaxed);

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gRegistryLock);
        gWaiters.push_back(created);

        return created;
    }();

    return *record;
}

bool GuestSync::StallReportingRequested()
{
    return StallThresholdNanos() != 0;
}

uint64_t GuestSync::WakesFor(uint64_t object)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gWakeLock);

    auto found = gWakes.find(object);
    return found == gWakes.end() ? 0 : found->second;
}

void GuestSync::Record(Operation operation, uint64_t object, uint64_t detail)
{
    if (!TracingRequested()) return;

    fprintf(stderr, "[guestsync %d] %s %016llx (%llu)\n", (int)gettid(), OperationName(operation), (unsigned long long)object,
            (unsigned long long)detail);
}

void GuestSync::BeginWait(Operation operation, uint64_t object, uint64_t caller)
{
    if (!TracingRequested() && !StallReportingRequested()) return;

    StartWatchdog();

    WaitRecord& record = RecordForCallingThread();
    record.object.store(object, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    record.caller.store(caller, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    record.operation.store((uint8_t)operation, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    record.startedNanos.store(MonotonicNanos(), std::memory_order_relaxed);
    record.wakesAtStart.store(WakesFor(object), std::memory_order_relaxed);
    record.reported.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    record.active.store(true, std::memory_order_release);

    Record(operation, object, 0);
}

void GuestSync::EndWait(uint64_t outcome)
{
    if (!TracingRequested() && !StallReportingRequested()) return;

    WaitRecord& record = RecordForCallingThread();
    record.active.store(false, std::memory_order_release);

    if (!TracingRequested()) return;

    fprintf(stderr, "[guestsync %d] %s %016llx returned %llu after %llu ms\n", (int)gettid(),
            OperationName((Operation)record.operation.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)),
            (unsigned long long)record.object.load(std::memory_order_relaxed), (unsigned long long)outcome,
            (unsigned long long)((MonotonicNanos() - record.startedNanos.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) / 1000000ull));
}

void GuestSync::NoteWake(Operation operation, uint64_t object, uint64_t woken)
{
    if (!TracingRequested() && !StallReportingRequested()) return;

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gWakeLock);
        gWakes[object] += 1;
    }

    Record(operation, object, woken);
}

void GuestSync::DescribeWaiters()
{
    uint64_t now = MonotonicNanos();

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gRegistryLock);

    uint64_t waiting = 0;
    for (WaitRecord* record : gWaiters)
    {
        if (record->active.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) waiting += 1;
    }

    if (waiting == 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[guestsync] no guest thread is inside a synchronisation wait\n");
        return;
    }

    fprintf(stderr, "[guestsync] %llu guest thread(s) are inside a synchronisation wait:\n", (unsigned long long)waiting);

    for (WaitRecord* record : gWaiters)
    {
        if (!record->active.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) continue;

        uint64_t object = record->object.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        uint64_t started = record->startedNanos.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);

        char described[256];
        DescribeAddress(record->caller.load(std::memory_order_relaxed), described, sizeof(described));

        fprintf(stderr, "[guestsync]   thread %d in %s on %016llx for %llu ms, woken %llu time(s) since, called from %s\n",
                record->threadId.load(std::memory_order_relaxed),
                OperationName((Operation)record->operation.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)), (unsigned long long)object,
                (unsigned long long)((now - started) / 1000000ull),
                (unsigned long long)(WakesFor(object) - record->wakesAtStart.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)), described);
    }
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

namespace GuestSync
{
    inline constexpr uint64_t DEFAULT_STALL_SECONDS = 5;
    inline constexpr uint64_t WATCHDOG_INTERVAL_NANOS = 1000000000ull;

    enum class Operation : uint8_t
    {
        MutexLock,
        MutexTryLock,
        MutexUnlock,
        MutexDestroy,
        ConditionWait,
        ConditionTimedWait,
        ConditionSignal,
        ConditionBroadcast,
        ConditionDestroy,
        SemaphoreWait,
        SemaphoreTimedWait,
        SemaphorePost,
        OnceEnter,
        ThreadJoin,
        Count
    };

    const char* OperationName(Operation operation);

    bool TracingRequested();
    bool StallReportingRequested();

    using AddressDescriber = void (*)(void* context, uint64_t address, char* buffer, uint64_t bytes);

    void SetAddressDescriber(AddressDescriber describer, void* context);

    void Record(Operation operation, uint64_t object, uint64_t detail);
    void BeginWait(Operation operation, uint64_t object, uint64_t caller);
    void EndWait(uint64_t outcome);
    void NoteWake(Operation operation, uint64_t object, uint64_t woken);

    void DescribeWaiters();
    uint64_t WakesFor(uint64_t object);
}
```

`src/GuestSyscall/GuestSyscall.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "GuestSyscall/GuestSyscall.hpp"

#include "Diagnostics/Diagnostics.hpp"

#include <atomic>
#include <cerrno>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <ctime>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <linux/futex.h>
#include <sched.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <vector>

#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"

static constexpr uint64_t MAX_TRANSFER_BYTES = 1u << 20;

static bool TracingRequested()
{
    static const bool wanted = Settings::Tracing("syscall");

    return wanted;
}

static uint64_t ErrnoResult(long returned)
{
    if (returned >= 0) return (uint64_t)returned;
    return (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)errno);
}

static bool FutexTakesDeadline(uint32_t command)
{
    return command == FUTEX_WAIT || command == FUTEX_WAIT_BITSET || command == FUTEX_LOCK_PI || command == FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI;
}

static GuestSyscall::Result FutexSyscall(GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    uint64_t address = registers.general[0];
    uint32_t operation = (uint32_t)registers.general[1];
    uint32_t expected = (uint32_t)registers.general[2];
    uint64_t fourth = registers.general[3];
    uint64_t secondAddress = registers.general[4];
    uint32_t third = (uint32_t)registers.general[5];

    uint32_t command = operation & FUTEX_CMD_MASK;

    struct timespec span;
    const void* deadline = nullptr;

    if (FutexTakesDeadline(command))
    {
        if (fourth != 0)
        {
            int64_t seconds = 0;
            int64_t nanoseconds = 0;

            if (!memory.Read(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)fourth, &seconds, sizeof(seconds)) ||
                !memory.Read(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)(fourth + 8), &nanoseconds, sizeof(nanoseconds)))
            {
                return GuestSyscall::Result::GuestMemoryFault;
            }

            span.tv_sec = (time_t)seconds;
            span.tv_nsec = (long)nanoseconds;
            deadline = &span;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        deadline = (const void*)(uintptr_t)fourth;
    }

    long returned = syscall(SYS_futex, (void*)(uintptr_t)address, (int)operation, expected, deadline,
                            (void*)(uintptr_t)secondAddress, third);

    registers.general[0] = ErrnoResult(returned);
    return GuestSyscall::Result::Ok;
}

static GuestSyscall::Result GetRandomSyscall(GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    uint64_t address = registers.general[0];
    uint64_t length = registers.general[1];

    if (length > MAX_TRANSFER_BYTES) length = MAX_TRANSFER_BYTES;

    std::vector<uint8_t> buffer((size_t)length);
    long produced = syscall(SYS_getrandom, buffer.data(), (size_t)length, 0);

    if (produced < 0)
    {
        registers.general[0] = ErrnoResult(produced);
        return GuestSyscall::Result::Ok;
    }

    if (produced != 0 && !memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)address, buffer.data(), (uint64_t)produced))
        return GuestSyscall::Result::GuestMemoryFault;

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)produced;
    return GuestSyscall::Result::Ok;
}

static GuestSyscall::Result WriteSyscall(GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    int descriptor = (int)registers.general[0];
    uint64_t address = registers.general[1];
    uint64_t length = registers.general[2];

    if (length > MAX_TRANSFER_BYTES) length = MAX_TRANSFER_BYTES;

    std::vector<uint8_t> buffer((size_t)length);
    if (length != 0 && !memory.Read(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)address, buffer.data(), length))
        return GuestSyscall::Result::GuestMemoryFault;

    registers.general[0] = ErrnoResult(write(descriptor, buffer.data(), (size_t)length));
    return GuestSyscall::Result::Ok;
}

static GuestSyscall::Result ReadSyscall(GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    int descriptor = (int)registers.general[0];
    uint64_t address = registers.general[1];
    uint64_t length = registers.general[2];

    if (length > MAX_TRANSFER_BYTES) length = MAX_TRANSFER_BYTES;

    std::vector<uint8_t> buffer((size_t)length);
    long returned = read(descriptor, buffer.data(), (size_t)length);

    if (returned > 0 && !memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)address, buffer.data(), (uint64_t)returned))
        return GuestSyscall::Result::GuestMemoryFault;

    registers.general[0] = ErrnoResult(returned);
    return GuestSyscall::Result::Ok;
}

static GuestSyscall::Result ClockGetTimeSyscall(GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    clockid_t clock = (clockid_t)registers.general[0];
    uint64_t address = registers.general[1];

    struct timespec value = {};
    if (clock_gettime(clock, &value) != 0)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)errno);
        return GuestSyscall::Result::Ok;
    }

    uint64_t packed[2] = {(uint64_t)value.tv_sec, (uint64_t)value.tv_nsec};
    if (!memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)address, packed, sizeof(packed))) return GuestSyscall::Result::GuestMemoryFault;

    registers.general[0] = 0;
    return GuestSyscall::Result::Ok;
}

static GuestSyscall::Result GetTimeOfDaySyscall(GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    uint64_t address = registers.general[0];

    struct timeval value = {};
    if (gettimeofday(&value, nullptr) != 0)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)errno);
        return GuestSyscall::Result::Ok;
    }

    if (address != 0)
    {
        uint64_t packed[2] = {(uint64_t)value.tv_sec, (uint64_t)value.tv_usec};
        if (!memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)address, packed, sizeof(packed)))
            return GuestSyscall::Result::GuestMemoryFault;
    }

    registers.general[0] = 0;
    return GuestSyscall::Result::Ok;
}

static constexpr unsigned SYNTHETIC_CPU_COUNT = 8;

static GuestSyscall::Result GetCpuSyscall(GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    int processor = sched_getcpu();
    uint32_t reported = processor < 0 ? 0 : (uint32_t)processor % SYNTHETIC_CPU_COUNT;
    uint32_t node = 0;

    if (registers.general[0] != 0 &&
        !memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)registers.general[0], &reported, sizeof(reported)))
        return GuestSyscall::Result::GuestMemoryFault;

    if (registers.general[1] != 0 && !memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)registers.general[1], &node, sizeof(node)))
        return GuestSyscall::Result::GuestMemoryFault;

    registers.general[0] = 0;
    return GuestSyscall::Result::Ok;
}

static GuestSyscall::Result AffinitySyscall(GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    uint64_t requested = registers.general[1];
    uint64_t destination = registers.general[2];

    cpu_set_t allowed;
    CPU_ZERO(&allowed);

    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(allowed), &allowed) != 0)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)errno);
        return GuestSyscall::Result::Ok;
    }

    uint64_t copied = requested < sizeof(allowed) ? requested : sizeof(allowed);
    if (copied == 0 || destination == 0)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)EINVAL);
        return GuestSyscall::Result::Ok;
    }

    if (!memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)destination, &allowed, copied))
        return GuestSyscall::Result::GuestMemoryFault;

    registers.general[0] = copied;
    return GuestSyscall::Result::Ok;
}

static GuestSyscall::Result SetAffinitySyscall(GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    uint64_t requested = registers.general[1];
    uint64_t source = registers.general[2];

    cpu_set_t wanted;
    CPU_ZERO(&wanted);

    uint64_t copied = requested < sizeof(wanted) ? requested : sizeof(wanted);
    if (copied == 0 || source == 0)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)EINVAL);
        return GuestSyscall::Result::Ok;
    }

    if (!memory.Read(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)source, &wanted, copied)) return GuestSyscall::Result::GuestMemoryFault;

    registers.general[0] = ErrnoResult(sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(wanted), &wanted));
    return GuestSyscall::Result::Ok;
}

GuestSyscall::Result GuestSyscall::Dispatch(GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory, Statistics& statistics)
{
    if (!memory.Read || !memory.Write) return Result::GuestMemoryFault;

    std::atomic_ref<uint64_t>(statistics.dispatched).fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    uint32_t number = (uint32_t)registers.general[8];

    if (TracingRequested())
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[syscall %d] %u(%016llx, %016llx, %016llx, %016llx) from %016llx\n", (int)gettid(), number,
                (unsigned long long)registers.general[0], (unsigned long long)registers.general[1],
                (unsigned long long)registers.general[2], (unsigned long long)registers.general[3],
                (unsigned long long)registers.general[30]);
    }

    switch (number)
    {
        case SYSCALL_GET_THREAD_ID: registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)gettid(); return Result::Ok;
        case SYSCALL_GET_PROCESS_ID: registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)getpid(); return Result::Ok;
        case SYSCALL_GET_USER_ID: registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)getuid(); return Result::Ok;
        case SYSCALL_YIELD: registers.general[0] = ErrnoResult(sched_yield()); return Result::Ok;
        case SYSCALL_EXIT_GROUP:
            fprintf(stderr, "[guestsyscall] the guest called exit_group(%d)\n", (int)registers.general[0]);
            return Result::ProcessExit;
        case SYSCALL_ADVISE_MEMORY: registers.general[0] = 0; return Result::Ok;
        case SYSCALL_WRITE: return WriteSyscall(registers, memory);
        case SYSCALL_READ: return ReadSyscall(registers, memory);
        case SYSCALL_CLOCK_GET_TIME: return ClockGetTimeSyscall(registers, memory);
        case SYSCALL_GET_TIME_OF_DAY: return GetTimeOfDaySyscall(registers, memory);
        case SYSCALL_FUTEX: return FutexSyscall(registers, memory);
        case SYSCALL_GET_RANDOM: return GetRandomSyscall(registers, memory);
        case SYSCALL_PROTECT_MEMORY: registers.general[0] = 0; return Result::Ok;
        case SYSCALL_SCHED_GET_AFFINITY: return AffinitySyscall(registers, memory);
        case SYSCALL_SCHED_SET_AFFINITY: return SetAffinitySyscall(registers, memory);
        case SYSCALL_TRUNCATE_DESCRIPTOR:
            registers.general[0] = ErrnoResult(ftruncate((int)registers.general[0], (off_t)registers.general[1]));
            return Result::Ok;
        case SYSCALL_ALLOCATE_FILE_SPACE:
            registers.general[0] = ErrnoResult(fallocate((int)registers.general[0], (int)registers.general[1], (off_t)registers.general[2],
                                                         (off_t)registers.general[3]));
            return Result::Ok;
        case SYSCALL_SYNCHRONIZE_DESCRIPTOR: registers.general[0] = ErrnoResult(fsync((int)registers.general[0])); return Result::Ok;
        case SYSCALL_SYNCHRONIZE_DESCRIPTOR_DATA: registers.general[0] = ErrnoResult(fdatasync((int)registers.general[0])); return Result::Ok;
        case SYSCALL_GET_CPU: return GetCpuSyscall(registers, memory);
        case SYSCALL_GET_PARENT_PROCESS_ID: registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)getppid(); return Result::Ok;
        case SYSCALL_GET_EFFECTIVE_USER_ID: registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)geteuid(); return Result::Ok;
        case SYSCALL_GET_GROUP_ID: registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)getgid(); return Result::Ok;
        case SYSCALL_GET_EFFECTIVE_GROUP_ID: registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)getegid(); return Result::Ok;
        case SYSCALL_READ_OTHER_PROCESS:
        case SYSCALL_WRITE_OTHER_PROCESS: registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)EPERM); return Result::Ok;
        default: break;
    }

    std::atomic_ref<uint64_t>(statistics.unimplemented).fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);

    static std::atomic<uint64_t> announced[4] = {};
    bool seen = false;
    for (std::atomic<uint64_t>& slot : announced)
    {
        uint64_t held = slot.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        if (held == (uint64_t)number + 1)
        {
            seen = true;
            break;
        }

        if (held != 0) continue;

        uint64_t empty = 0;
        if (slot.compare_exchange_strong(empty, (uint64_t)number + 1, std::memory_order_relaxed)) break;
    }

    char described[48];
    snprintf(described, sizeof(described), "syscall %u", number);
    Diagnostics::NoteGap(Diagnostics::Gap::Syscall, described);

    if (!seen)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[guestsyscall] the guest made syscall %u, which is not implemented; it was told ENOSYS\n", number);
        fflush(stderr);
    }

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)ENOSYS);
    return Result::Unimplemented;
}

const char* GuestSyscall::SyscallName(uint32_t number)
{
    switch (number)
    {
        case SYSCALL_GET_THREAD_ID: return "gettid";
        case SYSCALL_GET_PROCESS_ID: return "getpid";
        case SYSCALL_GET_USER_ID: return "getuid";
        case SYSCALL_WRITE: return "write";
        case SYSCALL_READ: return "read";
        case SYSCALL_CLOCK_GET_TIME: return "clock_gettime";
        case SYSCALL_GET_TIME_OF_DAY: return "gettimeofday";
        case SYSCALL_EXIT_GROUP: return "exit_group";
        case SYSCALL_ADVISE_MEMORY: return "madvise";
        case SYSCALL_YIELD: return "sched_yield";
        case SYSCALL_TRUNCATE_DESCRIPTOR: return "ftruncate";
        case SYSCALL_ALLOCATE_FILE_SPACE: return "fallocate";
        case SYSCALL_SYNCHRONIZE_DESCRIPTOR: return "fsync";
        case SYSCALL_SYNCHRONIZE_DESCRIPTOR_DATA: return "fdatasync";
        case SYSCALL_GET_CPU: return "getcpu";
        case SYSCALL_GET_PARENT_PROCESS_ID: return "getppid";
        case SYSCALL_GET_EFFECTIVE_USER_ID: return "geteuid";
        case SYSCALL_GET_GROUP_ID: return "getgid";
        case SYSCALL_GET_EFFECTIVE_GROUP_ID: return "getegid";
        case SYSCALL_READ_OTHER_PROCESS: return "process_vm_readv";
        case SYSCALL_WRITE_OTHER_PROCESS: return "process_vm_writev";
```
