`src/NativeActivity/AssetBridge.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "NativeActivity/NativeActivity.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <vector>

#include "AbiBridge/AbiBridge.hpp"
#include "Apk/Apk.hpp"
#include "GuestRuntime/GuestRuntime.hpp"

static constexpr int32_t ASSET_SEEK_SET = 0;
static constexpr int32_t ASSET_SEEK_CURRENT = 1;
static constexpr int32_t ASSET_SEEK_END = 2;
static constexpr int32_t ASSET_SKIP_CHUNK_BYTES = 65536;
static constexpr uint64_t MAXIMUM_ASSET_PATH_BYTES = 4096;

struct GuestAsset
{
    std::mutex lock;
    std::string path;
    Apk::Asset asset;
    int64_t position = 0;
    std::vector<uint8_t> content;
    bool loaded = false;
};

struct GuestAssetDirectory
{
    std::vector<std::string> names;
    size_t next = 0;
    std::string current;
};

static const Apk::Package* gAssetPackage = nullptr;
static std::mutex gAssetLock;
static std::set<GuestAsset*> gLiveAssets;
static std::set<GuestAssetDirectory*> gLiveDirectories;

static bool ReadGuestPath(const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory, uint64_t address, std::string& path)
{
    path.clear();
    if (address == 0) return false;

    for (uint64_t offset = 0; offset < MAXIMUM_ASSET_PATH_BYTES; ++offset)
    {
        char character = 0;
        if (!memory.Read(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)(address + offset), &character, 1)) return false;
        if (character == '\0') return true;

        path.push_back(character);
    }

    return false;
}

static GuestAsset* LiveAsset(uint64_t handle)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gAssetLock);

    GuestAsset* asset = (GuestAsset*)handle;
    return gLiveAssets.count(asset) ? asset : nullptr;
}

static GuestAssetDirectory* LiveDirectory(uint64_t handle)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gAssetLock);

    GuestAssetDirectory* directory = (GuestAssetDirectory*)handle;
    return gLiveDirectories.count(directory) ? directory : nullptr;
}

static bool LoadWholeAsset(GuestAsset& asset)
{
    if (asset.loaded) return true;

    Apk::Asset fresh;
    if (Apk::OpenAsset(*gAssetPackage, asset.path, fresh) != Apk::Result::Ok) return false;

    std::vector<uint8_t> content((size_t)(fresh.length > 0 ? fresh.length : 0));
    size_t filled = 0;

    while (filled < content.size())
    {
        int wanted = (int)std::min<size_t>(content.size() - filled, (size_t)ASSET_SKIP_CHUNK_BYTES);
        int produced = Apk::ReadAsset(fresh, content.data() + filled, wanted);
        if (produced <= 0) break;

        filled += (size_t)produced;
    }

    Apk::CloseAsset(fresh);
    content.resize(filled);

    asset.content = std::move(content);
    asset.loaded = true;
    return true;
}

static AbiBridge::Result AssetOpenHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    registers.general[0] = 0;

    std::string path;
    if (!gAssetPackage || !ReadGuestPath(memory, registers.general[1], path)) return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;

    while (!path.empty() && path.front() == '/') path.erase(path.begin());

    std::unique_ptr<GuestAsset> asset = std::make_unique<GuestAsset>();
    asset->path = path;

    if (Apk::OpenAsset(*gAssetPackage, path, asset->asset) != Apk::Result::Ok) return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gAssetLock);
    GuestAsset* opened = asset.release();
    gLiveAssets.insert(opened);

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)opened;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result AssetCloseHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    GuestAsset* asset = nullptr;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gAssetLock);

        GuestAsset* candidate = (GuestAsset*)registers.general[0];
        if (gLiveAssets.erase(candidate)) asset = candidate;
    }

    if (asset)
    {
        Apk::CloseAsset(asset->asset);
        delete asset;
    }

    registers.general[0] = 0;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result AssetReadHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    GuestAsset* asset = LiveAsset(registers.general[0]);
    uint64_t destination = registers.general[1];
    uint64_t count = registers.general[2];

    if (!asset || (destination == 0 && count != 0))
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)-1;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(asset->lock);

    int64_t remaining = asset->loaded ? (int64_t)asset->content.size() - asset->position : asset->asset.length - asset->position;
    if (remaining < 0) remaining = 0;
    if ((int64_t)count > remaining) count = (uint64_t)remaining;

    std::vector<uint8_t> buffer((size_t)count);
    int64_t produced = 0;

    if (asset->loaded)
    {
        memcpy(buffer.data(), asset->content.data() + asset->position, (size_t)count);
        produced = (int64_t)count;
    }
    else
    {
        while ((uint64_t)produced < count)
        {
            int wanted = (int)std::min<uint64_t>(count - (uint64_t)produced, (uint64_t)ASSET_SKIP_CHUNK_BYTES);
            int read = Apk::ReadAsset(asset->asset, buffer.data() + produced, wanted);
            if (read <= 0) break;

            produced += read;
        }
    }

    if (produced > 0 && !memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)destination, buffer.data(), (uint64_t)produced))
        return AbiBridge::Result::MalformedArguments;

    asset->position += produced;
    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)produced;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static bool SkipForward(GuestAsset& asset, int64_t target)
{
    std::vector<uint8_t> scratch((size_t)ASSET_SKIP_CHUNK_BYTES);

    while (asset.position < target)
    {
        int wanted = (int)std::min<int64_t>(target - asset.position, (int64_t)ASSET_SKIP_CHUNK_BYTES);
        int read = Apk::ReadAsset(asset.asset, scratch.data(), wanted);
        if (read <= 0) return false;

        asset.position += read;
    }

    return true;
}

static AbiBridge::Result AssetSeekHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    GuestAsset* asset = LiveAsset(registers.general[0]);
    int64_t offset = (int64_t)registers.general[1];
    int32_t whence = (int32_t)(uint32_t)registers.general[2];

    if (!asset)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)-1;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(asset->lock);

    int64_t length = asset->loaded ? (int64_t)asset->content.size() : asset->asset.length;
    int64_t target = -1;

    if (whence == ASSET_SEEK_SET) target = offset;
    if (whence == ASSET_SEEK_CURRENT) target = asset->position + offset;
    if (whence == ASSET_SEEK_END) target = length + offset;

    if (target < 0 || target > length)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)-1;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    if (!asset->loaded && target < asset->position && !LoadWholeAsset(*asset))
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)-1;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    if (!asset->loaded && !SkipForward(*asset, target))
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)-1;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    asset->position = target;
    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)target;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result AssetLengthHandler(void* context, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    GuestAsset* asset = LiveAsset(registers.general[0]);
    bool remainingOnly = context != nullptr;

    if (!asset)
    {
        registers.general[0] = 0;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(asset->lock);

    int64_t length = asset->loaded ? (int64_t)asset->content.size() : asset->asset.length;
    int64_t reported = remainingOnly ? length - asset->position : length;

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(reported < 0 ? 0 : reported);
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result AssetBufferHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    GuestAsset* asset = LiveAsset(registers.general[0]);
    registers.general[0] = 0;

    if (!asset) return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(asset->lock);
    if (!LoadWholeAsset(*asset)) return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)asset->content.data();
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result AssetAllocatedHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    GuestAsset* asset = LiveAsset(registers.general[0]);
    registers.general[0] = asset && asset->loaded ? 1 : 0;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result AssetDescriptorHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    GuestAsset* asset = LiveAsset(registers.general[0]);
    uint64_t startOut = registers.general[1];
    uint64_t lengthOut = registers.general[2];

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)-1;
    if (!asset || startOut == 0 || lengthOut == 0) return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;

    Apk::Asset fresh;
    if (Apk::OpenAsset(*gAssetPackage, asset->path, fresh) != Apk::Result::Ok) return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;

    int descriptor = -1;
    int64_t start = 0;
    int64_t length = 0;
    Apk::Result described = Apk::AssetFileDescriptor(fresh, descriptor, start, length);
    Apk::CloseAsset(fresh);

    if (described != Apk::Result::Ok || descriptor < 0) return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;

    if (!memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)startOut, &start, sizeof(start)) ||
        !memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)lengthOut, &length, sizeof(length)))
    {
        close(descriptor);
        return AbiBridge::Result::MalformedArguments;
    }

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)descriptor;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result DirectoryOpenHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    registers.general[0] = 0;

    std::string path;
    if (!gAssetPackage || !ReadGuestPath(memory, registers.general[1], path)) return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;

    while (!path.empty() && path.front() == '/') path.erase(path.begin());
    while (!path.empty() && path.back() == '/') path.pop_back();

    std::vector<std::string> names;
    Apk::ListAssets(*gAssetPackage, path, names);

    std::unique_ptr<GuestAssetDirectory> directory = std::make_unique<GuestAssetDirectory>();

    for (const std::string& name : names)
    {
        Apk::Asset probe;
        std::string full = path.empty() ? name : path + "/" + name;
        if (Apk::OpenAsset(*gAssetPackage, full, probe) != Apk::Result::Ok) continue;

        Apk::CloseAsset(probe);
        directory->names.push_back(name);
    }

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gAssetLock);
    GuestAssetDirectory* opened = directory.release();
    gLiveDirectories.insert(opened);

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)opened;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result DirectoryNextHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    GuestAssetDirectory* directory = LiveDirectory(registers.general[0]);
    registers.general[0] = 0;

    if (!directory || directory->next >= directory->names.size()) return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;

    directory->current = directory->names[directory->next++];
    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)directory->current.c_str();
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result DirectoryRewindHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    GuestAssetDirectory* directory = LiveDirectory(registers.general[0]);
    if (directory) directory->next = 0;

    registers.general[0] = 0;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result DirectoryCloseHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    GuestAssetDirectory* directory = nullptr;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gAssetLock);

        GuestAssetDirectory* candidate = (GuestAssetDirectory*)registers.general[0];
        if (gLiveDirectories.erase(candidate)) directory = candidate;
    }

    delete directory;
    registers.general[0] = 0;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

NativeActivity::Result NativeActivity::RegisterAssetFunctions(GuestRuntime::Instance& runtime, const Apk::Package& package)
{
    struct HandlerEntry
    {
        const char* name;
        AbiBridge::GuestCallHandler handler;
        void* context;
    };

    const HandlerEntry handlers[] = {
        {"AAssetManager_open", &AssetOpenHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAssetManager_openDir", &DirectoryOpenHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAssetDir_getNextFileName", &DirectoryNextHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAssetDir_rewind", &DirectoryRewindHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAssetDir_close", &DirectoryCloseHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAsset_close", &AssetCloseHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAsset_read", &AssetReadHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAsset_seek", &AssetSeekHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAsset_seek64", &AssetSeekHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAsset_getLength", &AssetLengthHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAsset_getLength64", &AssetLengthHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAsset_getRemainingLength", &AssetLengthHandler, (void*)1},
        {"AAsset_getRemainingLength64", &AssetLengthHandler, (void*)1},
        {"AAsset_getBuffer", &AssetBufferHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAsset_isAllocated", &AssetAllocatedHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAsset_openFileDescriptor", &AssetDescriptorHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAsset_openFileDescriptor64", &AssetDescriptorHandler, nullptr},
    };

    gAssetPackage = &package;
    AbiBridge::Registry& registry = GuestRuntime::BridgeRegistry(runtime);

    for (const HandlerEntry& entry : handlers)
    {
        AbiBridge::Result registered = AbiBridge::RegisterHostHandler(registry, entry.name, entry.handler, entry.context);

        if (registered != AbiBridge::Result::Ok && registered != AbiBridge::Result::AlreadyRegistered)
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "[assetbridge] cannot register %s: %s\n", entry.name, AbiBridge::ResultName(registered));
            return Result::JniRegistrationFailed;
        }
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}
```

`src/NativeActivity/AudioBridge.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "NativeActivity/NativeActivity.hpp"

#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <ctime>
#include <mutex>
#include <set>

#include "AbiBridge/AbiBridge.hpp"
#include "AudioDevice/AudioDevice.hpp"
#include "GuestRuntime/GuestRuntime.hpp"
#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"

static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_OK = 0;
static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_STATE = -895;
static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE = -892;
static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_ERROR_UNAVAILABLE = -889;
static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_ERROR_NULL = -886;

static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_FORMAT_PCM_I16 = 1;
static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_FORMAT_PCM_FLOAT = 2;

static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_DIRECTION_OUTPUT = 0;

static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_CALLBACK_RESULT_STOP = 1;

static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_ERROR_TIMEOUT = -899;

static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_OPEN = 1;
static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_STARTED = 3;
static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_PAUSED = 5;
static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_FLUSHED = 7;
static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_STOPPED = 9;
static constexpr int32_t AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_CLOSED = 11;

static constexpr uint64_t AUDIO_TRACE_INTERVAL = 256;

static constexpr int32_t UNSPECIFIED = 0;

struct AudioBuilder
{
    int32_t deviceId = UNSPECIFIED;
    int32_t sampleRate = UNSPECIFIED;
    int32_t channelCount = UNSPECIFIED;
    int32_t format = AUDIO_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED;
    int32_t direction = AUDIO_DIRECTION_OUTPUT;
    int32_t sharingMode = UNSPECIFIED;
    int32_t performanceMode = UNSPECIFIED;
    int32_t bufferCapacityInFrames = UNSPECIFIED;
    int32_t framesPerDataCallback = UNSPECIFIED;
    int32_t usage = UNSPECIFIED;
    int32_t contentType = UNSPECIFIED;
    int32_t sessionId = UNSPECIFIED;
    uint64_t dataCallback = 0;
    uint64_t dataUserData = 0;
    uint64_t errorCallback = 0;
    uint64_t errorUserData = 0;
};

struct AudioStream
{
    AudioBuilder settings;
    AudioDevice::Stream* device = nullptr;
    AudioDevice::Format format;
    std::atomic<int32_t> state{AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_OPEN};
    int32_t bufferSizeInFrames = 0;
    std::atomic<uint64_t> framesWritten{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> presentedNanos{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> callbacks{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> soundingSamples{0};
    std::mutex stateLock;
    std::condition_variable stateChanged;
};

static bool AudioTracingRequested()
{
    static const bool requested = Settings::Tracing("audio");

    return requested;
}

static uint64_t AudioMonotonicNanos()
{
    struct timespec now;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now);
    return (uint64_t)now.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)now.tv_nsec;
}

static void EnterState(AudioStream* stream, int32_t state)
{
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(stream->stateLock);
        stream->state.store(state, std::memory_order_release);
    }

    stream->stateChanged.notify_all();
}

static std::mutex gAudioLock;
static std::set<AudioBuilder*> gBuilders;
static std::set<AudioStream*> gStreams;
static GuestRuntime::Instance* gAudioRuntime = nullptr;
static uint64_t gAudioThreadPointer = 0;

static AudioBuilder* LookupBuilder(uint64_t handle)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gAudioLock);
    AudioBuilder* builder = (AudioBuilder*)handle;
    return gBuilders.count(builder) != 0 ? builder : nullptr;
}

static AudioStream* LookupStream(uint64_t handle)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gAudioLock);
    AudioStream* stream = (AudioStream*)handle;
    return gStreams.count(stream) != 0 ? stream : nullptr;
}

static uint64_t AudioThreadPointer()
{
    if (gAudioThreadPointer != 0) return gAudioThreadPointer;
    if (!gAudioRuntime) return 0;

    GuestState::GuestAddress pointer{};
    if (GuestRuntime::AllocateThreadPointer(*gAudioRuntime, pointer) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok) return 0;

    gAudioThreadPointer = (uint64_t)pointer;
    return gAudioThreadPointer;
}

static uint64_t PresentedFrames(const AudioStream& stream, uint64_t written)
{
    uint64_t buffered = (uint64_t)stream.format.framesPerBurst;
    return written > buffered ? written - buffered : 0;
}

static const char* DescribeAudioResult(int32_t result)
{
    switch (result)
    {
        case AUDIO_OK: return "AAUDIO_OK";
        case AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_STATE: return "AAUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_STATE";
        case AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE: return "AAUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE";
        case AUDIO_ERROR_UNAVAILABLE: return "AAUDIO_ERROR_UNAVAILABLE";
        case AUDIO_ERROR_NULL: return "AAUDIO_ERROR_NULL";
        case AUDIO_ERROR_TIMEOUT: return "AAUDIO_ERROR_TIMEOUT";
        default: return "AAUDIO_ERROR";
    }
}

static const char* DescribeStreamState(int32_t state)
{
    switch (state)
    {
        case AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_OPEN: return "OPEN";
        case AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_STARTED: return "STARTED";
        case AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_STOPPED: return "STOPPED";
        case AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_PAUSED: return "PAUSED";
        case AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_FLUSHED: return "FLUSHED";
        case AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_CLOSED: return "CLOSED";
        default: return "UNKNOWN";
    }
}

static uint64_t CountSoundingSamples(const AudioDevice::Format& format, const void* frames, uint32_t frameCount)
{
    if (!frames || frameCount == 0) return 0;

    uint64_t samples = (uint64_t)frameCount * format.channels;
    uint64_t sounding = 0;

    if (format.sampleFormat == AudioDevice::SampleFormat::Signed16)
    {
        const int16_t* narrow = (const int16_t*)frames;
        for (uint64_t index = 0; index < samples; ++index)
        {
            if (narrow[index] != 0) sounding += 1;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        const float* wide = (const float*)frames;
        for (uint64_t index = 0; index < samples; ++index)
        {
            if (wide[index] != 0.0f) sounding += 1;
        }
    }

    return sounding;
}

static uint32_t FillFromGuest(void* context, void* frames, uint32_t frameCount)
{
    AudioStream* stream = (AudioStream*)context;
    if (!stream || !gAudioRuntime || stream->settings.dataCallback == 0) return 0;

    GuestState::Registers registers;
    GuestState::Reset(registers);

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)stream;
    registers.general[1] = stream->settings.dataUserData;
    registers.general[2] = (uint64_t)frames;
    registers.general[3] = frameCount;
    registers.threadPointer = AudioThreadPointer();

    GuestRuntime::Result called =
        GuestRuntime::CallGuest(*gAudioRuntime, (GuestState::GuestAddress)stream->settings.dataCallback, registers);

    if (called != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok) return 0;
    if ((int32_t)(uint32_t)registers.general[0] == AUDIO_CALLBACK_RESULT_STOP) EnterState(stream, AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_STOPPED);

    stream->framesWritten.fetch_add(frameCount, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    stream->presentedNanos.store(AudioMonotonicNanos(), std::memory_order_relaxed);

    uint64_t sounding = CountSoundingSamples(stream->format, frames, frameCount);
    stream->soundingSamples.fetch_add(sounding, std::memory_order_relaxed);

    uint64_t seen = stream->callbacks.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed) + 1;

    if (AudioTracingRequested() && (seen <= 4 || seen % AUDIO_TRACE_INTERVAL == 0))
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[audiobridge] callback %llu filled %u frame(s) holding %llu sounding sample(s); %llu frames written in total\n",
                (unsigned long long)seen, frameCount, (unsigned long long)sounding,
                (unsigned long long)stream->framesWritten.load(std::memory_order_relaxed));
    }

    return frameCount;
}

static AbiBridge::Result CreateBuilderHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    uint64_t output = registers.general[0];

    if (output == 0)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_ERROR_NULL;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    AudioBuilder* builder = new AudioBuilder();
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gAudioLock);
        gBuilders.insert(builder);
    }

    uint64_t handle = (uint64_t)builder;
    if (!memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)output, &handle, sizeof(handle)))
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gAudioLock);
        gBuilders.erase(builder);
        delete builder;
        return AbiBridge::Result::MalformedArguments;
    }

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_OK;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result DeleteBuilderHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    AudioBuilder* builder = LookupBuilder(registers.general[0]);

    if (builder)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gAudioLock);
        gBuilders.erase(builder);
        delete builder;
    }

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_OK;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result BuilderSetHandler(void* context, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    AudioBuilder* builder = LookupBuilder(registers.general[0]);
    if (!builder) return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;

    int32_t value = (int32_t)(uint32_t)registers.general[1];
    uint64_t field = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)context;

    if (field == 0) builder->deviceId = value;
    else if (field == 1) builder->sampleRate = value;
    else if (field == 2) builder->channelCount = value;
    else if (field == 3) builder->format = value;
    else if (field == 4) builder->direction = value;
    else if (field == 5) builder->sharingMode = value;
    else if (field == 6) builder->performanceMode = value;
    else if (field == 7) builder->bufferCapacityInFrames = value;
    else if (field == 8) builder->framesPerDataCallback = value;
    else if (field == 9) builder->usage = value;
    else if (field == 10) builder->contentType = value;
    else if (field == 11) builder->sessionId = value;

    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result BuilderSetDataCallbackHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    AudioBuilder* builder = LookupBuilder(registers.general[0]);
    if (!builder) return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;

    builder->dataCallback = registers.general[1];
    builder->dataUserData = registers.general[2];
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result BuilderSetErrorCallbackHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    AudioBuilder* builder = LookupBuilder(registers.general[0]);
    if (!builder) return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;

    builder->errorCallback = registers.general[1];
    builder->errorUserData = registers.general[2];
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result OpenStreamHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    AudioBuilder* builder = LookupBuilder(registers.general[0]);
    uint64_t output = registers.general[1];

    if (!builder || output == 0)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_ERROR_NULL;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    if (builder->direction != AUDIO_DIRECTION_OUTPUT || !AudioDevice::IsSupported())
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_ERROR_UNAVAILABLE;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    AudioStream* stream = new AudioStream();
    stream->settings = *builder;

    AudioDevice::Format wanted;
    wanted.sampleRate = builder->sampleRate > 0 ? (uint32_t)builder->sampleRate : AudioDevice::DEFAULT_SAMPLE_RATE;
    wanted.channels = builder->channelCount > 0 ? (uint32_t)builder->channelCount : AudioDevice::DEFAULT_CHANNELS;
    wanted.framesPerBurst =
        builder->framesPerDataCallback > 0 ? (uint32_t)builder->framesPerDataCallback : AudioDevice::DEFAULT_FRAMES_PER_BURST;
    wanted.sampleFormat =
        builder->format == AUDIO_FORMAT_PCM_I16 ? AudioDevice::SampleFormat::Signed16 : AudioDevice::SampleFormat::Float32;

    AudioDevice::Result opened = AudioDevice::Open(wanted, &FillFromGuest, stream, stream->device);

    if (opened != AudioDevice::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[audiobridge] the host device did not open: %s\n", AudioDevice::ResultName(opened));
        delete stream;
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_ERROR_UNAVAILABLE;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    stream->format = AudioDevice::DescribeFormat(*stream->device);
    stream->bufferSizeInFrames = (int32_t)AudioDevice::BufferCapacityInFrames(*stream->device);
    stream->state = AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_OPEN;

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gAudioLock);
        gStreams.insert(stream);
    }

    uint64_t handle = (uint64_t)stream;
    if (!memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)output, &handle, sizeof(handle)))
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gAudioLock);
        gStreams.erase(stream);
        AudioDevice::Close(stream->device);
        delete stream;
        return AbiBridge::Result::MalformedArguments;
    }

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_OK;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result StreamStartHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    AudioStream* stream = LookupStream(registers.general[0]);

    if (!stream)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    AudioDevice::Result started = AudioDevice::Start(*stream->device);
    if (started != AudioDevice::Result::Ok)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_STATE;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    EnterState(stream, AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_STARTED);
    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_OK;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result StreamStopHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    AudioStream* stream = LookupStream(registers.general[0]);

    if (!stream)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    AudioDevice::Stop(*stream->device);
    EnterState(stream, AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_STOPPED);
    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_OK;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result StreamPauseHandler(void* context, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    AudioStream* stream = LookupStream(registers.general[0]);

    if (!stream)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    bool flushing = context != nullptr;

    if (flushing)
    {
        if (stream->state.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_STARTED)
        {
            registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_STATE;
            return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
        }

        EnterState(stream, AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_FLUSHED);
    }
    else
    {
        AudioDevice::Stop(*stream->device);
        EnterState(stream, AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_PAUSED);
    }

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_OK;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result StreamCloseHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    AudioStream* stream = LookupStream(registers.general[0]);

    if (!stream)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gAudioLock);
        gStreams.erase(stream);
    }

    AudioDevice::Close(stream->device);
    EnterState(stream, AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_CLOSED);
    delete stream;

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_OK;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result StreamQueryHandler(void* context, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    AudioStream* stream = LookupStream(registers.general[0]);
    uint64_t field = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)context;

    if (!stream)
    {
        registers.general[0] = 0;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    int32_t answer = 0;

    if (field == 0) answer = (int32_t)stream->format.sampleRate;
    else if (field == 1) answer = (int32_t)stream->format.channels;
    else if (field == 2)
        answer = stream->format.sampleFormat == AudioDevice::SampleFormat::Signed16 ? AUDIO_FORMAT_PCM_I16 : AUDIO_FORMAT_PCM_FLOAT;
    else if (field == 3) answer = stream->bufferSizeInFrames;
    else if (field == 4) answer = (int32_t)AudioDevice::BufferCapacityInFrames(*stream->device);
    else if (field == 5) answer = (int32_t)stream->format.framesPerBurst;
    else if (field == 6) answer = (int32_t)AudioDevice::UnderrunCount(*stream->device);
    else if (field == 7) answer = stream->settings.deviceId;
    else if (field == 8) answer = 0;
    else if (field == 9) answer = stream->settings.direction;
    else if (field == 10) answer = stream->settings.sharingMode;
    else if (field == 11) answer = stream->settings.performanceMode;
    else if (field == 12) answer = stream->settings.usage;
    else if (field == 13) answer = stream->settings.contentType;
    else if (field == 14) answer = stream->settings.sessionId;

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)answer;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result StreamSetBufferSizeHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    AudioStream* stream = LookupStream(registers.general[0]);

    if (!stream)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    int32_t wanted = (int32_t)(uint32_t)registers.general[1];
    int32_t capacity = (int32_t)AudioDevice::BufferCapacityInFrames(*stream->device);

    if (wanted < 1) wanted = 1;
    if (capacity > 0 && wanted > capacity) wanted = capacity;

    stream->bufferSizeInFrames = wanted;
    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)wanted;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result StreamWaitForStateHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    AudioStream* stream = LookupStream(registers.general[0]);
    int32_t wanted = (int32_t)(uint32_t)registers.general[1];
    uint64_t output = registers.general[2];
    int64_t timeoutNanos = (int64_t)registers.general[3];

    if (!stream)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    int32_t reached = stream->state.load(std::memory_order_acquire);

    if (reached == wanted && timeoutNanos > 0)
    {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> held(stream->stateLock);
        stream->stateChanged.wait_for(held, std::chrono::nanoseconds(timeoutNanos),
                                      [stream, wanted]() { return stream->state.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != wanted; });

        reached = stream->state.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    }

    if (output != 0 && !memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)output, &reached, sizeof(reached)))
        return AbiBridge::Result::MalformedArguments;

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)(reached == wanted ? AUDIO_ERROR_TIMEOUT : AUDIO_OK);
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result StreamStateHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    AudioStream* stream = LookupStream(registers.general[0]);
    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)(stream ? stream->state.load(std::memory_order_acquire) : AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_CLOSED);

    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result StreamFramePositionHandler(void* context, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    AudioStream* stream = LookupStream(registers.general[0]);

    if (!stream)
    {
        registers.general[0] = 0;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    uint64_t written = stream->framesWritten.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    bool wantRead = context != nullptr;

    registers.general[0] = wantRead ? PresentedFrames(*stream, written) : written;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result StreamTimestampHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    AudioStream* stream = LookupStream(registers.general[0]);
    uint64_t framesOut = registers.general[2];
    uint64_t nanosOut = registers.general[3];

    if (!stream)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    if (stream->state.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != AUDIO_STREAM_STATE_STARTED)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_STATE;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    int64_t written = (int64_t)stream->framesWritten.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    int64_t position = (int64_t)PresentedFrames(*stream, (uint64_t)written);
    int64_t when = (int64_t)stream->presentedNanos.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);

    if (when == 0) when = (int64_t)AudioMonotonicNanos();

    if (framesOut != 0 && !memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)framesOut, &position, sizeof(position)))
        return AbiBridge::Result::MalformedArguments;

    if (nanosOut != 0 && !memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)nanosOut, &when, sizeof(when)))
        return AbiBridge::Result::MalformedArguments;

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_OK;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result StreamWriteHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    AudioStream* stream = LookupStream(registers.general[0]);

    if (!stream)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_STATE;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result StreamTextHandler(void* context, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(context != nullptr ? DescribeStreamState((int32_t)(uint32_t)registers.general[0])
                                                                   : DescribeAudioResult((int32_t)(uint32_t)registers.general[0]));

    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static constexpr uint32_t OPENSL_RESULT_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED = 12;

static AbiBridge::Result OpenSlUnsupportedHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    uint64_t engineOut = registers.general[0];
    uint64_t none = 0;

    if (engineOut != 0 && !memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)engineOut, &none, sizeof(none)))
        return AbiBridge::Result::MalformedArguments;

    registers.general[0] = OPENSL_RESULT_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

NativeActivity::Result NativeActivity::RegisterAudioFunctions(GuestRuntime::Instance& runtime)
{
    struct HandlerEntry
    {
        const char* name;
        AbiBridge::GuestCallHandler handler;
        void* context;
    };

    const HandlerEntry handlers[] = {
        {"AAudio_createStreamBuilder", &CreateBuilderHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudioStreamBuilder_delete", &DeleteBuilderHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudioStreamBuilder_setDeviceId", &BuilderSetHandler, (void*)0},
        {"AAudioStreamBuilder_setSampleRate", &BuilderSetHandler, (void*)1},
        {"AAudioStreamBuilder_setChannelCount", &BuilderSetHandler, (void*)2},
        {"AAudioStreamBuilder_setFormat", &BuilderSetHandler, (void*)3},
        {"AAudioStreamBuilder_setDirection", &BuilderSetHandler, (void*)4},
        {"AAudioStreamBuilder_setSharingMode", &BuilderSetHandler, (void*)5},
        {"AAudioStreamBuilder_setPerformanceMode", &BuilderSetHandler, (void*)6},
        {"AAudioStreamBuilder_setBufferCapacityInFrames", &BuilderSetHandler, (void*)7},
        {"AAudioStreamBuilder_setFramesPerDataCallback", &BuilderSetHandler, (void*)8},
        {"AAudioStreamBuilder_setDataCallback", &BuilderSetDataCallbackHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudioStreamBuilder_setErrorCallback", &BuilderSetErrorCallbackHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudioStreamBuilder_openStream", &OpenStreamHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudioStream_requestStart", &StreamStartHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudioStream_requestStop", &StreamStopHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudioStream_close", &StreamCloseHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudioStream_getSampleRate", &StreamQueryHandler, (void*)0},
        {"AAudioStream_getChannelCount", &StreamQueryHandler, (void*)1},
        {"AAudioStream_getFormat", &StreamQueryHandler, (void*)2},
        {"AAudioStream_getBufferSizeInFrames", &StreamQueryHandler, (void*)3},
        {"AAudioStream_getBufferCapacityInFrames", &StreamQueryHandler, (void*)4},
        {"AAudioStream_getFramesPerBurst", &StreamQueryHandler, (void*)5},
        {"AAudioStream_getXRunCount", &StreamQueryHandler, (void*)6},
        {"AAudioStream_getDeviceId", &StreamQueryHandler, (void*)7},
        {"AAudioStream_isMMapUsed", &StreamQueryHandler, (void*)8},
        {"AAudioStream_setBufferSizeInFrames", &StreamSetBufferSizeHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudioStream_waitForStateChange", &StreamWaitForStateHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudioStream_getState", &StreamStateHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudioStream_getFramesWritten", &StreamFramePositionHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudioStream_getFramesRead", &StreamFramePositionHandler, (void*)1},
        {"AAudioStream_getTimestamp", &StreamTimestampHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudioStream_requestPause", &StreamPauseHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudioStream_requestFlush", &StreamPauseHandler, (void*)1},
        {"AAudioStream_release", &StreamStopHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudioStream_write", &StreamWriteHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudioStream_getDirection", &StreamQueryHandler, (void*)9},
        {"AAudioStream_getSharingMode", &StreamQueryHandler, (void*)10},
        {"AAudioStream_getPerformanceMode", &StreamQueryHandler, (void*)11},
        {"AAudioStream_getSamplesPerFrame", &StreamQueryHandler, (void*)1},
        {"AAudioStream_getUsage", &StreamQueryHandler, (void*)12},
        {"AAudioStream_getContentType", &StreamQueryHandler, (void*)13},
        {"AAudioStream_getSessionId", &StreamQueryHandler, (void*)14},
        {"AAudioStreamBuilder_setUsage", &BuilderSetHandler, (void*)9},
        {"AAudioStreamBuilder_setContentType", &BuilderSetHandler, (void*)10},
        {"AAudioStreamBuilder_setSessionId", &BuilderSetHandler, (void*)11},
        {"AAudio_convertResultToText", &StreamTextHandler, nullptr},
        {"AAudio_convertStreamStateToText", &StreamTextHandler, (void*)1},
        {"slCreateEngine", &OpenSlUnsupportedHandler, nullptr},
    };

    gAudioRuntime = &runtime;
    AbiBridge::Registry& registry = GuestRuntime::BridgeRegistry(runtime);

    for (const HandlerEntry& entry : handlers)
    {
        AbiBridge::Result registered = AbiBridge::RegisterHostHandler(registry, entry.name, entry.handler, entry.context);

        if (registered != AbiBridge::Result::Ok && registered != AbiBridge::Result::AlreadyRegistered)
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "[audiobridge] cannot register %s: %s\n", entry.name, AbiBridge::ResultName(registered));
            return Result::JniRegistrationFailed;
        }
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

```

`src/NativeActivity/NativeActivity.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "NativeActivity/NativeActivity.hpp"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <android/native_activity.h>

#include "AbiBridge/AbiBridge.hpp"
#include "ElfLoader/ElfLoader.hpp"

static constexpr int CALLBACK_COUNT = (int)NativeActivity::Callback::Count;
static constexpr int32_t GUEST_SDK_VERSION = RUNTIME_BUILD_SDK_VERSION;

struct NativeActivityState
{
    GuestRuntime::Instance* runtime = nullptr;
    GuestState::GuestAddress activityAddress{};
    GuestState::GuestAddress callbacksAddress{};
    GuestState::GuestAddress dataPathAddress{};
    uint64_t callbacks[CALLBACK_COUNT] = {};
    NativeActivity::Statistics statistics;
};

static NativeActivityState* Implementation(const NativeActivity::Instance& activity)
{
    return (NativeActivityState*)activity.implementation;
}

static uint64_t CallbackOffset(NativeActivity::Callback callback)
{
    switch (callback)
    {
        case NativeActivity::Callback::Start: return offsetof(ANativeActivityCallbacks, onStart);
        case NativeActivity::Callback::Resume: return offsetof(ANativeActivityCallbacks, onResume);
        case NativeActivity::Callback::SaveInstanceState: return offsetof(ANativeActivityCallbacks, onSaveInstanceState);
        case NativeActivity::Callback::Pause: return offsetof(ANativeActivityCallbacks, onPause);
        case NativeActivity::Callback::Stop: return offsetof(ANativeActivityCallbacks, onStop);
        case NativeActivity::Callback::Destroy: return offsetof(ANativeActivityCallbacks, onDestroy);
        case NativeActivity::Callback::WindowFocusChanged: return offsetof(ANativeActivityCallbacks, onWindowFocusChanged);
        case NativeActivity::Callback::NativeWindowCreated: return offsetof(ANativeActivityCallbacks, onNativeWindowCreated);
        case NativeActivity::Callback::NativeWindowResized: return offsetof(ANativeActivityCallbacks, onNativeWindowResized);
        case NativeActivity::Callback::NativeWindowRedrawNeeded: return offsetof(ANativeActivityCallbacks, onNativeWindowRedrawNeeded);
        case NativeActivity::Callback::NativeWindowDestroyed: return offsetof(ANativeActivityCallbacks, onNativeWindowDestroyed);
        case NativeActivity::Callback::InputQueueCreated: return offsetof(ANativeActivityCallbacks, onInputQueueCreated);
        case NativeActivity::Callback::InputQueueDestroyed: return offsetof(ANativeActivityCallbacks, onInputQueueDestroyed);
        case NativeActivity::Callback::ContentRectChanged: return offsetof(ANativeActivityCallbacks, onContentRectChanged);
        case NativeActivity::Callback::ConfigurationChanged: return offsetof(ANativeActivityCallbacks, onConfigurationChanged);
        case NativeActivity::Callback::LowMemory: return offsetof(ANativeActivityCallbacks, onLowMemory);
        default: break;
    }

    return 0;
}

static bool WriteGuestWord(const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory, uint64_t address, uint64_t value)
{
    return memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)address, &value, sizeof(value));
}

static bool ReadGuestWord(const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory, uint64_t address, uint64_t& value)
{
    return memory.Read(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)address, &value, sizeof(value));
}

static NativeActivity::Result PublishDataPath(GuestRuntime::Instance& runtime, const std::string& path, GuestState::GuestAddress& address)
{
    uint64_t bytes = path.size() + 1;

    if (GuestRuntime::Reserve(runtime, bytes, sizeof(uint64_t), address) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
        return NativeActivity::Result::OutOfGuestMemory;

    if (GuestRuntime::Commit(runtime, address, bytes, true, true, false) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
        return NativeActivity::Result::OutOfGuestMemory;

    const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory = GuestRuntime::Memory(runtime);
    if (!memory.Write(memory.context, address, path.c_str(), bytes)) return NativeActivity::Result::OutOfGuestMemory;

    return NativeActivity::Result::Ok;
}

NativeActivity::Result NativeActivity::Create(GuestRuntime::Instance& runtime, JniBridge::Instance& bridge, uint32_t moduleId,
                                              const std::string& internalDataPath, void* activityObject, Instance& activity)
{
    GuestState::GuestAddress entry{};
    if (ElfLoader::LookupExportIn(GuestRuntime::LibraryNamespace(runtime), moduleId, ENTRY_POINT_SYMBOL, entry) != ElfLoader::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] the guest library does not export %s\n", ENTRY_POINT_SYMBOL);
        return Result::NoEntryPoint;
    }

    NativeActivityState* state = new NativeActivityState();
    state->runtime = &runtime;

    Result published = PublishDataPath(runtime, internalDataPath, state->dataPathAddress);
    if (published != Result::Ok)
    {
        delete state;
        return published;
    }

    if (GuestRuntime::RegisterDataObject(runtime, "acl:activity", sizeof(ANativeActivity), state->activityAddress) !=
            GuestRuntime::Result::Ok ||
        GuestRuntime::RegisterDataObject(runtime, "acl:activity:callbacks", sizeof(ANativeActivityCallbacks), state->callbacksAddress) !=
            GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        delete state;
        return Result::OutOfGuestMemory;
    }

    GuestState::GuestAddress guestVm{};
    GuestState::GuestAddress guestEnv{};
    JniBridge::GuestJavaVm(bridge, guestVm);
    JniBridge::GuestJniEnv(bridge, guestEnv);

    const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory = GuestRuntime::Memory(runtime);
    uint64_t base = (uint64_t)state->activityAddress;

    bool written = WriteGuestWord(memory, base + offsetof(ANativeActivity, callbacks), (uint64_t)state->callbacksAddress) &&
                   WriteGuestWord(memory, base + offsetof(ANativeActivity, vm), (uint64_t)guestVm) &&
                   WriteGuestWord(memory, base + offsetof(ANativeActivity, env), (uint64_t)guestEnv) &&
                   WriteGuestWord(memory, base + offsetof(ANativeActivity, clazz), (uint64_t)activityObject) &&
                   WriteGuestWord(memory, base + offsetof(ANativeActivity, internalDataPath), (uint64_t)state->dataPathAddress) &&
                   WriteGuestWord(memory, base + offsetof(ANativeActivity, externalDataPath), (uint64_t)state->dataPathAddress) &&
                   WriteGuestWord(memory, base + offsetof(ANativeActivity, instance), 0) &&
                   WriteGuestWord(memory, base + offsetof(ANativeActivity, assetManager), 0) &&
                   WriteGuestWord(memory, base + offsetof(ANativeActivity, obbPath), (uint64_t)state->dataPathAddress);

    int32_t sdkVersion = GUEST_SDK_VERSION;
    written = written && memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)(base + offsetof(ANativeActivity, sdkVersion)),
                                      &sdkVersion, sizeof(sdkVersion));

    if (!written)
    {
        delete state;
        return Result::OutOfGuestMemory;
    }

    for (uint64_t offset = 0; offset < sizeof(ANativeActivityCallbacks); offset += sizeof(uint64_t))
    {
        if (WriteGuestWord(memory, (uint64_t)state->callbacksAddress + offset, 0)) continue;

        delete state;
        return Result::OutOfGuestMemory;
    }

    AbiBridge::Argument pointer;
    pointer.argumentClass = AbiBridge::ArgumentClass::Pointer;
    pointer.sizeInBytes = sizeof(void*);
    pointer.alignmentInBytes = sizeof(void*);

    AbiBridge::Signature signature;
    signature.arguments[0] = pointer;
    signature.arguments[1] = pointer;
    signature.arguments[2] = pointer;
    signature.totalArgumentCount = 3;
    signature.namedArgumentCount = 3;

    uint64_t slots[3] = {(uint64_t)state->activityAddress, 0, 0};

    AbiBridge::ArgumentBuffer arguments;
    arguments.slots = slots;
    arguments.slotCount = 3;
    arguments.slotStrideBytes = sizeof(uint64_t);

    AbiBridge::Result entered = AbiBridge::CallGuestFromHost(GuestRuntime::Caller(runtime), entry, signature, arguments, nullptr, 0);
    if (entered != AbiBridge::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] %s failed: %s\n", ENTRY_POINT_SYMBOL, AbiBridge::ResultName(entered));
        delete state;
        return Result::GuestFaulted;
    }

    state->statistics.entryPointRan = true;

    for (int index = 0; index < CALLBACK_COUNT; ++index)
    {
        uint64_t slot = 0;
        if (!ReadGuestWord(memory, (uint64_t)state->callbacksAddress + CallbackOffset((Callback)index), slot)) continue;

        state->callbacks[index] = slot;
        if (slot != 0) state->statistics.callbacksRegistered += 1;
    }

    fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] %s ran and registered %llu callback(s)\n", ENTRY_POINT_SYMBOL,
            (unsigned long long)state->statistics.callbacksRegistered);

    activity.implementation = state;
    return Result::Ok;
}

void NativeActivity::Destroy(Instance& activity)
{
    delete Implementation(activity);
    activity.implementation = nullptr;
}

bool NativeActivity::HasCallback(const Instance& activity, Callback callback)
{
    const NativeActivityState* state = Implementation(activity);
    if (!state || callback >= Callback::Count) return false;

    return state->callbacks[(int)callback] != 0;
}

NativeActivity::Result NativeActivity::Invoke(Instance& activity, Callback callback, uint64_t argument)
{
    NativeActivityState* state = Implementation(activity);
    if (!state) return Result::NotInitialized;
    if (callback >= Callback::Count) return Result::NoCallback;

    uint64_t target = state->callbacks[(int)callback];
    if (target == 0)
    {
        state->statistics.callbacksAbsent += 1;
        return Result::NoCallback;
    }

    AbiBridge::Argument pointer;
    pointer.argumentClass = AbiBridge::ArgumentClass::Pointer;
    pointer.sizeInBytes = sizeof(void*);
    pointer.alignmentInBytes = sizeof(void*);

    AbiBridge::Signature signature;
    signature.arguments[0] = pointer;
    signature.arguments[1] = pointer;
    signature.totalArgumentCount = 2;
    signature.namedArgumentCount = 2;

    uint64_t slots[2] = {(uint64_t)state->activityAddress, argument};

    AbiBridge::ArgumentBuffer arguments;
    arguments.slots = slots;
    arguments.slotCount = 2;
    arguments.slotStrideBytes = sizeof(uint64_t);

    AbiBridge::Result entered = AbiBridge::CallGuestFromHost(GuestRuntime::Caller(*state->runtime),
                                                             (GuestState::GuestAddress)target, signature, arguments, nullptr, 0);

    if (entered != AbiBridge::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] %s failed: %s\n", CallbackName(callback), AbiBridge::ResultName(entered));
        return Result::GuestFaulted;
    }

    state->statistics.callbacksInvoked += 1;
    return Result::Ok;
}

NativeActivity::Statistics NativeActivity::GetStatistics(const Instance& activity)
{
    const NativeActivityState* state = Implementation(activity);
    if (!state) return Statistics();

    return state->statistics;
}

const char* NativeActivity::CallbackName(Callback callback)
{
    switch (callback)
    {
        case Callback::Start: return "onStart";
        case Callback::Resume: return "onResume";
        case Callback::SaveInstanceState: return "onSaveInstanceState";
        case Callback::Pause: return "onPause";
        case Callback::Stop: return "onStop";
        case Callback::Destroy: return "onDestroy";
        case Callback::WindowFocusChanged: return "onWindowFocusChanged";
        case Callback::NativeWindowCreated: return "onNativeWindowCreated";
        case Callback::NativeWindowResized: return "onNativeWindowResized";
        case Callback::NativeWindowRedrawNeeded: return "onNativeWindowRedrawNeeded";
        case Callback::NativeWindowDestroyed: return "onNativeWindowDestroyed";
        case Callback::InputQueueCreated: return "onInputQueueCreated";
        case Callback::InputQueueDestroyed: return "onInputQueueDestroyed";
        case Callback::ContentRectChanged: return "onContentRectChanged";
        case Callback::ConfigurationChanged: return "onConfigurationChanged";
        case Callback::LowMemory: return "onLowMemory";
        default: break;
    }

    return "unknown";
}

const char* NativeActivity::ResultName(Result result)
{
    switch (result)
    {
        case Result::Ok: return "Ok";
        case Result::NotInitialized: return "NotInitialized";
        case Result::NoEntryPoint: return "NoEntryPoint";
        case Result::OutOfGuestMemory: return "OutOfGuestMemory";
        case Result::GuestFaulted: return "GuestFaulted";
        case Result::NoCallback: return "NoCallback";
        case Result::LibraryMissing: return "LibraryMissing";
        case Result::ClassMissing: return "ClassMissing";
        case Result::JniRegistrationFailed: return "JniRegistrationFailed";
    }

    return "Unknown";
}
```

`src/NativeActivity/NativeActivityJni.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "NativeActivity/NativeActivity.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <mutex>
#include <set>
#include <string>

static GuestRuntime::Instance* gRuntime = nullptr;
static JniBridge::Instance* gBridge = nullptr;
static std::mutex gActivityLock;
static std::set<jlong> gLiveActivities;

static std::string CopyJavaString(JNIEnv* env, jstring value)
{
    if (!value) return std::string();

    const char* raw = env->GetStringUTFChars(value, nullptr);
    if (!raw) return std::string();

    std::string copied(raw);
    env->ReleaseStringUTFChars(value, raw);
    return copied;
}

static jlong NativeActivityCreate(JNIEnv* env, jobject self, jstring libraryName, jstring internalDataPath)
{
    if (!gRuntime || !gBridge)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] no guest runtime is installed, so %s cannot start\n", NativeActivity::ACTIVITY_CLASS);
        return 0;
    }

    std::string name = CopyJavaString(env, libraryName);
    std::string dataPath = CopyJavaString(env, internalDataPath);
    std::string soname = "lib" + name + ".so";

    uint32_t moduleId = 0;
    JniBridge::Result loaded = JniBridge::LoadGuestLibrary(*gBridge, soname, moduleId);
    if (loaded != JniBridge::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] cannot load %s: %s\n", soname.c_str(), JniBridge::ResultName(loaded));
        return 0;
    }

    NativeActivity::Instance* activity = new NativeActivity::Instance();
    jobject reference = env->NewGlobalRef(self);

    NativeActivity::Result created = NativeActivity::Create(*gRuntime, *gBridge, moduleId, dataPath, reference, *activity);
    if (created != NativeActivity::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] %s did not start: %s\n", soname.c_str(), NativeActivity::ResultName(created));
        env->DeleteGlobalRef(reference);
        delete activity;
        return 0;
    }

    fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] %s is live\n", soname.c_str());
    jlong handle = (jlong)(uintptr_t)activity;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gActivityLock);
        gLiveActivities.insert(handle);
    }

    return handle;
}

static NativeActivity::Instance* ActivityFrom(jlong handle)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gActivityLock);
    if (handle == 0 || gLiveActivities.find(handle) == gLiveActivities.end()) return nullptr;

    return (NativeActivity::Instance*)(uintptr_t)handle;
}

static NativeActivity::Instance* ClaimActivity(jlong handle)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> held(gActivityLock);
    if (handle == 0 || gLiveActivities.erase(handle) == 0) return nullptr;

    return (NativeActivity::Instance*)(uintptr_t)handle;
}

static void NativeActivityDispatch(JNIEnv*, jobject, jlong handle, jint callback)
{
    NativeActivity::Instance* activity = ActivityFrom(handle);
    if (!activity || callback < 0 || callback >= (jint)NativeActivity::Callback::Count) return;

    NativeActivity::Callback selected = (NativeActivity::Callback)callback;
    NativeActivity::Result invoked = NativeActivity::Invoke(*activity, selected, 0);

    if (invoked == NativeActivity::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] %s\n", NativeActivity::CallbackName(selected));
    }
}

static void NativeActivitySetWindow(JNIEnv*, jobject, jlong handle, jlong window)
{
    NativeActivity::Instance* activity = ActivityFrom(handle);
    if (!activity) return;

    NativeActivity::Callback callback =
        window != 0 ? NativeActivity::Callback::NativeWindowCreated : NativeActivity::Callback::NativeWindowDestroyed;

    if (NativeActivity::Invoke(*activity, callback, (uint64_t)window) == NativeActivity::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] %s\n", NativeActivity::CallbackName(callback));
    }
}

static void NativeActivityDestroy(JNIEnv*, jobject, jlong handle)
{
    NativeActivity::Instance* activity = ClaimActivity(handle);
    if (!activity) return;

    NativeActivity::Statistics statistics = NativeActivity::GetStatistics(*activity);
    fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] finished: %llu registered, %llu invoked, %llu absent\n",
            (unsigned long long)statistics.callbacksRegistered, (unsigned long long)statistics.callbacksInvoked,
            (unsigned long long)statistics.callbacksAbsent);

    NativeActivity::Destroy(*activity);
    delete activity;
}

static jlong NativeActivityCreateWindow(JNIEnv*, jobject, jint width, jint height)
{
    if (!gRuntime) return 0;

    GuestState::GuestAddress window{};
    if (NativeActivity::CreateWindow(*gRuntime, (int32_t)width, (int32_t)height, window) != NativeActivity::Result::Ok) return 0;

    return (jlong)(uint64_t)window;
}

static jboolean NativeActivityFinishRequested(JNIEnv*, jobject)
{
    return NativeActivity::FinishRequested() ? JNI_TRUE : JNI_FALSE;
}

static const JNINativeMethod ACTIVITY_METHODS[] = {
    {"nativeCreate", "(Ljava/lang/String;Ljava/lang/String;)J", (void*)&NativeActivityCreate},
    {"nativeDispatch", "(JI)V", (void*)&NativeActivityDispatch},
    {"nativeSetWindow", "(JJ)V", (void*)&NativeActivitySetWindow},
    {"nativeDestroy", "(J)V", (void*)&NativeActivityDestroy},
    {"nativeCreateWindow", "(II)J", (void*)&NativeActivityCreateWindow},
    {"nativeFinishRequested", "()Z", (void*)&NativeActivityFinishRequested},
};

static jboolean NativeActivityServiceLooper(JNIEnv*, jobject)
{
    return NativeActivity::ServiceLooper() ? JNI_TRUE : JNI_FALSE;
}

static void NativeActivityPrepareLooper(JNIEnv*, jobject)
{
    NativeActivity::PrepareLooper();
}

static const JNINativeMethod SURFACE_METHODS[] = {
    {"nativeServiceLooper", "()Z", (void*)&NativeActivityServiceLooper},
    {"nativePrepareLooper", "()V", (void*)&NativeActivityPrepareLooper},
    {"nativeAcquireWindow", "(II)J", (void*)&NativeActivityCreateWindow},
};

NativeActivity::Result NativeActivity::InstallJni(JNIEnv* env, GuestRuntime::Instance& runtime, JniBridge::Instance& bridge,
                                                 bool guestBridgeLive)
{
    jclass activityClass = env->FindClass(ACTIVITY_CLASS);
    if (!activityClass)
    {
        env->ExceptionClear();
        fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] %s is missing from the framework classes\n", ACTIVITY_CLASS);
        return Result::ClassMissing;
    }

    jint registered = env->RegisterNatives(activityClass, ACTIVITY_METHODS, (jint)(sizeof(ACTIVITY_METHODS) / sizeof(ACTIVITY_METHODS[0])));
    env->DeleteLocalRef(activityClass);

    if (registered != JNI_OK)
    {
        env->ExceptionClear();
        fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] cannot register the natives of %s\n", ACTIVITY_CLASS);
        return Result::JniRegistrationFailed;
    }

    jclass surfaceClass = env->FindClass(SURFACE_BRIDGE_CLASS);
    if (!surfaceClass)
    {
        env->ExceptionClear();
        fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] %s is missing from the framework classes\n", SURFACE_BRIDGE_CLASS);
        return Result::ClassMissing;
    }

    jint surfaceRegistered =
        env->RegisterNatives(surfaceClass, SURFACE_METHODS, (jint)(sizeof(SURFACE_METHODS) / sizeof(SURFACE_METHODS[0])));
    env->DeleteLocalRef(surfaceClass);

    if (surfaceRegistered != JNI_OK)
    {
        env->ExceptionClear();
        fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] cannot register the natives of %s\n", SURFACE_BRIDGE_CLASS);
        return Result::JniRegistrationFailed;
    }

    if (guestBridgeLive)
    {
        Result functions = RegisterWindowFunctions(runtime);
        if (functions != Result::Ok) return functions;
    }

    gRuntime = &runtime;
    gBridge = &bridge;
    return Result::Ok;
}

void NativeActivity::RemoveJni()
{
    gRuntime = nullptr;
    gBridge = nullptr;
}
```

```cpp
static constexpr uint64_t GUEST_LOOPER_BYTES = 64;
static constexpr int IDLE_POLL_MILLISECONDS = 4;
static constexpr uint64_t GUEST_CONFIGURATION_BYTES = 64;

struct LooperWatch
{
    int descriptor = -1;
    int identifier = 0;
    int events = 0;
    uint64_t callback = 0;
    uint64_t data = 0;
};

struct FrameCallbackRequest
{
    uint64_t function = 0;
    uint64_t data = 0;
    bool wide = false;
};

struct GuestLooperRecord
{
    GuestState::GuestAddress address{};
    std::mutex lock;
    std::vector<LooperWatch> watches;
    std::vector<FrameCallbackRequest> pendingFrames;
    std::atomic<int32_t> references{0};
    int wakeDescriptor = -1;

    ~GuestLooperRecord()
    {
        if (wakeDescriptor >= 0) close(wakeDescriptor);
    }
};

static constexpr const char* FRAME_TRACE_VARIABLE = "RUNTIME_TRACE_FRAME_CALLBACKS";

static std::atomic<uint64_t> gFramesPosted{0};
static std::atomic<uint64_t> gFramesDelivered{0};

static bool FrameTracingRequested()
{
    static const bool requested = []() {
        const char* setting = Settings::Lookup(FRAME_TRACE_VARIABLE);
        return setting != nullptr && strcmp(setting, "0") != 0;
    }();

    return requested;
}

static void WakeLooper(const std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord>& looper)
{
    if (!looper || looper->wakeDescriptor < 0) return;

    uint64_t one = 1;
    ssize_t written = write(looper->wakeDescriptor, &one, sizeof(one));
    (void)written;
}

static std::mutex gLooperRegistryLock;
static std::map<uint64_t, std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord>> gLoopersByThread;
static std::map<uint64_t, std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord>> gLoopersByAddress;
static uint64_t gNextLooperName = 0;

static std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord> LooperForCallingThread()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gLooperRegistryLock);

    auto found = gLoopersByThread.find((uint64_t)gettid());
    return found == gLoopersByThread.end() ? nullptr : found->second;
}

static std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord> LooperForAddress(uint64_t address)
{
    if (address == 0) return nullptr;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gLooperRegistryLock);

    auto found = gLoopersByAddress.find(address);
    return found == gLoopersByAddress.end() ? nullptr : found->second;
}

static std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord> PrepareLooperForCallingThread(GuestRuntime::Instance& runtime)
{
    std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord> existing = LooperForCallingThread();
    if (existing) return existing;

    std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord> prepared = std::make_shared<GuestLooperRecord>();
    prepared->wakeDescriptor = eventfd(0, EFD_CLOEXEC | EFD_NONBLOCK);

    std::string name;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gLooperRegistryLock);
        name = "acl:looper:" + std::to_string(gNextLooperName++);
    }

    if (GuestRuntime::RegisterDataObject(runtime, name, GUEST_LOOPER_BYTES, prepared->address) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
        return nullptr;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gLooperRegistryLock);
    gLoopersByThread[(uint64_t)gettid()] = prepared;
    gLoopersByAddress[(uint64_t)prepared->address] = prepared;

    return prepared;
}
static GuestState::GuestAddress gConfiguration{};

static constexpr int32_t POLL_WAKE = -1;
static constexpr int32_t POLL_CALLBACK = -2;
static constexpr int32_t POLL_TIMEOUT = -3;
static constexpr int32_t POLL_ERROR = -4;

static void DeliverPendingFrames();
static void RunLooperCallback(const GuestState::Registers& caller, uint64_t callback, int descriptor, int events, uint64_t data);

static AbiBridge::Result LooperPrepareHandler(void* context, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    GuestRuntime::Instance* runtime = (GuestRuntime::Instance*)context;

    std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord> prepared = PrepareLooperForCallingThread(*runtime);
    registers.general[0] = prepared ? (uint64_t)prepared->address : 0;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result LooperForThreadHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord> existing = LooperForCallingThread();
    registers.general[0] = existing ? (uint64_t)existing->address : 0;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result LooperAcquireHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord> looper = LooperForAddress(registers.general[0]);
    if (looper) looper->references.fetch_add(1);
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result LooperReleaseHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord> looper = LooperForAddress(registers.general[0]);
    if (looper) looper->references.fetch_sub(1);
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result LooperAddDescriptorHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    LooperWatch watch;
    watch.descriptor = (int)(int32_t)(uint32_t)registers.general[1];
    watch.identifier = (int)(int32_t)(uint32_t)registers.general[2];
    watch.events = (int)(int32_t)(uint32_t)registers.general[3];
    watch.callback = registers.general[4];
    watch.data = registers.general[5];

    std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord> looper = LooperForAddress(registers.general[0]);

    if (!looper)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(int32_t)-1;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(looper->lock);

        bool replaced = false;
        for (LooperWatch& existing : looper->watches)
        {
            if (existing.descriptor != watch.descriptor) continue;

            existing = watch;
            replaced = true;
            break;
        }

        if (!replaced) looper->watches.push_back(watch);
    }

    WakeLooper(looper);

    registers.general[0] = 1;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result LooperRemoveDescriptorHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    int descriptor = (int)(int32_t)(uint32_t)registers.general[1];

    std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord> looper = LooperForAddress(registers.general[0]);

    if (looper)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(looper->lock);

        for (size_t index = 0; index < looper->watches.size(); ++index)
        {
            if (looper->watches[index].descriptor != descriptor) continue;

            looper->watches.erase(looper->watches.begin() + (long)index);
            break;
        }
    }

    WakeLooper(looper);

    registers.general[0] = 1;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result LooperPollHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    int timeout = (int)(int32_t)(uint32_t)registers.general[0];
    uint64_t descriptorOut = registers.general[1];
    uint64_t eventsOut = registers.general[2];
    uint64_t dataOut = registers.general[3];

    DeliverPendingFrames();

    std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord> looper = LooperForCallingThread();

    std::vector<LooperWatch> watches;
    if (looper)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(looper->lock);
        watches = looper->watches;
    }

    std::vector<pollfd> descriptors;
    descriptors.reserve(watches.size() + 1);

    for (const LooperWatch& watch : watches)
    {
        pollfd entry{};
        entry.fd = watch.descriptor;
        entry.events = (short)(watch.events & (POLLIN | POLLOUT));
        descriptors.push_back(entry);
    }

    size_t wakeIndex = descriptors.size();
    if (looper && looper->wakeDescriptor >= 0)
    {
        pollfd entry{};
        entry.fd = looper->wakeDescriptor;
        entry.events = POLLIN;
        descriptors.push_back(entry);
    }

    int ready = 0;

    if (!descriptors.empty())
    {
        ready = poll(descriptors.data(), (nfds_t)descriptors.size(), timeout);
    }
    else if (timeout != 0)
    {
        int waited = timeout < 0 || timeout > IDLE_POLL_MILLISECONDS ? IDLE_POLL_MILLISECONDS : timeout;

        struct timespec span;
        span.tv_sec = waited / 1000;
        span.tv_nsec = (long)(waited % 1000) * 1000000l;
        nanosleep(&span, nullptr);
    }

    if (ready <= 0)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(int32_t)(ready < 0 ? POLL_ERROR : POLL_TIMEOUT);
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    if (wakeIndex < descriptors.size() && descriptors[wakeIndex].revents != 0)
    {
        uint64_t drained = 0;
        ssize_t read = ::read(looper->wakeDescriptor, &drained, sizeof(drained));
        (void)read;

        DeliverPendingFrames();

        if (ready == 1)
        {
            registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(int32_t)POLL_WAKE;
            return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
        }
    }

    for (size_t index = 0; index < descriptors.size(); ++index)
    {
        if (descriptors[index].revents == 0) continue;

        int32_t descriptor = descriptors[index].fd;
        int32_t events = descriptors[index].revents;

        if (descriptorOut != 0)
            memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)descriptorOut, &descriptor, sizeof(descriptor));
        if (eventsOut != 0) memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)eventsOut, &events, sizeof(events));
        if (dataOut != 0)
        {
            uint64_t data = watches[index].data;
            memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)dataOut, &data, sizeof(data));
        }

        if (watches[index].callback != 0)
        {
            RunLooperCallback(registers, watches[index].callback, descriptor, events, watches[index].data);
            registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(int32_t)POLL_CALLBACK;
            return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
        }

        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)watches[index].identifier;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(int32_t)-3;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static GuestState::GuestAddress gChoreographer{};
static GuestState::GuestAddress gAssetManager{};
static GuestRuntime::Instance* gLooperRuntime = nullptr;

static AbiBridge::Result ChoreographerInstanceHandler(void* context, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    GuestRuntime::Instance* runtime = (GuestRuntime::Instance*)context;

    if ((uint64_t)gChoreographer == 0 &&
        GuestRuntime::RegisterDataObject(*runtime, "acl:choreographer", GUEST_LOOPER_BYTES, gChoreographer) !=
            GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        registers.general[0] = 0;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)gChoreographer;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result ChoreographerPostFrameHandler(void* context, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    FrameCallbackRequest pending;
    pending.function = registers.general[1];
    pending.data = registers.general[2];
    pending.wide = context != nullptr;

    std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord> looper = LooperForCallingThread();

    if (pending.function != 0 && looper)
    {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(looper->lock);
            looper->pendingFrames.push_back(pending);
        }

        WakeLooper(looper);
    }

    if (FrameTracingRequested())
    {
        uint64_t posted = gFramesPosted.fetch_add(1) + 1;
        if (posted <= 8 || posted % 256 == 0)
            fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] frame callback %llu posted on thread %d, looper %s\n", (unsigned long long)posted,
                    (int)gettid(), looper ? "present" : "missing");
    }

    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static void RunLooperCallback(const GuestState::Registers& caller, uint64_t callback, int descriptor, int events, uint64_t data)
{
    if (!gLooperRuntime || callback == 0) return;

    uint64_t arguments[3];
    arguments[0] = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)descriptor;
    arguments[1] = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)events;
    arguments[2] = data;

    uint64_t returned = 0;
    GuestRuntime::CallGuestNested(*gLooperRuntime, caller, (GuestState::GuestAddress)callback, arguments, 3, returned);
}

static void DeliverPendingFrames()
{
    if (!gLooperRuntime) return;

    std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord> looper = LooperForCallingThread();
    if (!looper) return;

    std::vector<FrameCallbackRequest> due;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(looper->lock);
        due.swap(looper->pendingFrames);
    }

    if (!due.empty() && FrameTracingRequested())
    {
        uint64_t delivered = gFramesDelivered.fetch_add(due.size()) + due.size();
        if (delivered <= 8 || delivered % 256 == 0)
            fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] frame callback %llu delivered on thread %d\n", (unsigned long long)delivered,
                    (int)gettid());
    }

    for (const FrameCallbackRequest& pending : due)
    {
        struct timespec now;
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now);
        uint64_t nanoseconds = (uint64_t)now.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)now.tv_nsec;

        GuestState::Registers registers;
        GuestState::Reset(registers);
        registers.general[0] = nanoseconds;
        registers.general[1] = pending.data;

        GuestRuntime::CallGuest(*gLooperRuntime, (GuestState::GuestAddress)pending.function, registers);
    }
}

static AbiBridge::Result LooperWakeHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    WakeLooper(LooperForAddress(registers.general[0]));
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result WindowSetGeometryHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    registers.general[0] = 0;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result AssetManagerFromJavaHandler(void* context, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)
{
    GuestRuntime::Instance* runtime = (GuestRuntime::Instance*)context;

    if ((uint64_t)gAssetManager == 0 &&
        GuestRuntime::RegisterDataObject(*runtime, "acl:assets", GUEST_LOOPER_BYTES, gAssetManager) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        registers.general[0] = 0;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)gAssetManager;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static AbiBridge::Result SensorAbsentHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)

    registers.general[0] = 0;

static AbiBridge::Result InputQueueIdleHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor&)

    registers.general[0] = 0;

static AbiBridge::Result InputQueueEmptyHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    uint64_t eventOut = registers.general[1];
    uint64_t none = 0;

    if (eventOut != 0 && !memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)eventOut, &none, sizeof(none)))
        return AbiBridge::Result::MalformedArguments;

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)-1;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

            GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)

static AbiBridge::Result ConfigurationLanguageHandler(void*, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)

    if (out != 0 && !memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)out, letters, sizeof(letters)))
        return AbiBridge::Result::MalformedArguments;
```
