```cpp
NativeActivity::Result NativeActivity::RegisterWindowFunctions(GuestRuntime::Instance& runtime)
{
    struct HandlerEntry
    {
        const char* name;
        AbiBridge::GuestCallHandler handler;
        void* context;
    };

    const HandlerEntry handlers[] = {
        {"ALooper_prepare", &LooperPrepareHandler, &runtime},
        {"ALooper_forThread", &LooperForThreadHandler, &runtime},
        {"ALooper_acquire", &LooperAcquireHandler, nullptr},
        {"ALooper_release", &LooperReleaseHandler, nullptr},
        {"ALooper_addFd", &LooperAddDescriptorHandler, nullptr},
        {"ALooper_removeFd", &LooperRemoveDescriptorHandler, nullptr},
        {"ALooper_pollOnce", &LooperPollHandler, nullptr},
        {"ALooper_pollAll", &LooperPollHandler, nullptr},
        {"ALooper_wake", &LooperWakeHandler, nullptr},
        {"AChoreographer_getInstance", &ChoreographerInstanceHandler, &runtime},
        {"AChoreographer_postFrameCallback", &ChoreographerPostFrameHandler, nullptr},
        {"AChoreographer_postFrameCallback64", &ChoreographerPostFrameHandler, &runtime},
        {"AAssetManager_fromJava", &AssetManagerFromJavaHandler, &runtime},
        {"ANativeWindow_setBuffersGeometry", &WindowSetGeometryHandler, nullptr},
        {"ASensorManager_getInstance", &SensorAbsentHandler, nullptr},
        {"ASensorManager_getDefaultSensor", &SensorAbsentHandler, nullptr},
        {"ASensorManager_getSensorList", &SensorAbsentHandler, nullptr},
        {"ASensorManager_createEventQueue", &SensorAbsentHandler, nullptr},
        {"ASensorManager_destroyEventQueue", &SensorAbsentHandler, nullptr},
        {"ASensorEventQueue_enableSensor", &SensorAbsentHandler, nullptr},
        {"ASensorEventQueue_disableSensor", &SensorAbsentHandler, nullptr},
        {"ASensorEventQueue_setEventRate", &SensorAbsentHandler, nullptr},
        {"ASensorEventQueue_hasEvents", &SensorAbsentHandler, nullptr},
        {"ASensorEventQueue_getEvents", &SensorAbsentHandler, nullptr},
        {"ASensor_getName", &SensorAbsentHandler, nullptr},
        {"ASensor_getVendor", &SensorAbsentHandler, nullptr},
        {"ASensor_getType", &SensorAbsentHandler, nullptr},
        {"ASensor_getResolution", &SensorAbsentHandler, nullptr},
        {"ASensor_getMinDelay", &SensorAbsentHandler, nullptr},
        {"AConfiguration_new", &ConfigurationNewHandler, &runtime},
        {"AConfiguration_delete", &ConfigurationIgnoredHandler, nullptr},
        {"AConfiguration_fromAssetManager", &ConfigurationIgnoredHandler, nullptr},
        {"AConfiguration_getSdkVersion", &ConfigurationSdkVersionHandler, nullptr},
        {"AConfiguration_getLanguage", &ConfigurationLanguageHandler, nullptr},
        {"AConfiguration_getCountry", &ConfigurationCountryHandler, nullptr},
        {"ANativeWindow_acquire", &WindowAcquireHandler, nullptr},
        {"ANativeWindow_release", &WindowReleaseHandler, nullptr},
        {"ANativeWindow_getWidth", &WindowWidthHandler, nullptr},
        {"ANativeWindow_getHeight", &WindowHeightHandler, nullptr},
        {"ANativeActivity_finish", &ActivityFinishHandler, nullptr},
        {"ANativeActivity_setWindowFlags", &ActivitySetWindowFlagsHandler, nullptr},
        {"ANativeActivity_showSoftInput", &ActivityShowSoftInputHandler, nullptr},
        {"ANativeActivity_hideSoftInput", &ActivityHideSoftInputHandler, nullptr},
        {"ANativeWindow_fromSurface", &WindowFromSurfaceHandler, nullptr},
        {"ANativeWindow_getFormat", &WindowFormatHandler, nullptr},
        {"AInputQueue_attachLooper", &InputQueueIdleHandler, nullptr},
        {"AInputQueue_detachLooper", &InputQueueIdleHandler, nullptr},
        {"AInputQueue_hasEvents", &InputQueueIdleHandler, nullptr},
        {"AInputQueue_getEvent", &InputQueueEmptyHandler, nullptr},
        {"AInputQueue_preDispatchEvent", &InputQueueIdleHandler, nullptr},
        {"AInputQueue_finishEvent", &InputQueueIdleHandler, nullptr},
    };

    gLooperRuntime = &runtime;
    AbiBridge::Registry& registry = GuestRuntime::BridgeRegistry(runtime);

    for (const HandlerEntry& entry : handlers)
    {
        AbiBridge::Result registered = AbiBridge::RegisterHostHandler(registry, entry.name, entry.handler, entry.context);

        if (registered != AbiBridge::Result::Ok && registered != AbiBridge::Result::AlreadyRegistered)
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] cannot register %s: %s\n", entry.name, AbiBridge::ResultName(registered));
            return Result::JniRegistrationFailed;
        }
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

void NativeActivity::PrepareLooper()
{
    if (!gLooperRuntime) return;
    PrepareLooperForCallingThread(*gLooperRuntime);
}

bool NativeActivity::ServiceLooper()
{
    if (!gLooperRuntime) return false;

    DeliverPendingFrames();

    std::shared_ptr<GuestLooperRecord> looper = LooperForCallingThread();
    if (!looper) return false;

    std::vector<LooperWatch> watches;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(looper->lock);
        watches = looper->watches;
    }

    if (watches.empty()) return false;

    std::vector<pollfd> descriptors;
    descriptors.reserve(watches.size());

    for (const LooperWatch& watch : watches)
    {
        pollfd entry{};
        entry.fd = watch.descriptor;
        entry.events = (short)(watch.events & (POLLIN | POLLOUT));
        descriptors.push_back(entry);
    }

    if (poll(descriptors.data(), (nfds_t)descriptors.size(), 0) <= 0) return true;

    for (size_t index = 0; index < descriptors.size(); ++index)
    {
        if (descriptors[index].revents == 0) continue;
        if (watches[index].callback == 0) continue;

        GuestState::Registers registers;
        GuestState::Reset(registers);
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)descriptors[index].fd;
        registers.general[1] = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)descriptors[index].revents;
        registers.general[2] = watches[index].data;

        GuestRuntime::CallGuest(*gLooperRuntime, (GuestState::GuestAddress)watches[index].callback, registers);
    }

    return true;
}

NativeActivity::Result NativeActivity::CreateWindow(GuestRuntime::Instance& runtime, int32_t width, int32_t height,
                                                    GuestState::GuestAddress& window)
{
    if ((uint64_t)gWindow.address == 0 &&
        GuestRuntime::RegisterDataObject(runtime, "acl:window", GUEST_WINDOW_BYTES, gWindow.address) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        return Result::OutOfGuestMemory;
    }

    gWindow.width = width;
    gWindow.height = height;
    window = gWindow.address;

    fprintf(stderr, "[nativeactivity] the guest window is %dx%d\n", width, height);
    return Result::Ok;
}

bool NativeActivity::FinishRequested()
{
    return gFinishRequested.load();
}
```

`src/Overlay/FrameRate.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Overlay/FrameRate.hpp"

#include <atomic>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <ctime>
#include <mutex>

#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"

namespace FrameRate
{
    static std::mutex gMutex;
    static uint64_t gWindowStart = 0;
    static uint64_t gWindowFrames = 0;
    static std::atomic<uint64_t> gTotalFrames{0};
    static std::atomic<double> gPerSecond{0.0};
    static std::atomic<double> gMilliseconds{0.0};
}

static uint64_t MonotonicNanos()
{
    struct timespec now = {};
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now);

    return (uint64_t)now.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)now.tv_nsec;
}

bool FrameRate::OverlayRequested()
{
    static const bool requested = []() {
        const char* setting = Settings::Lookup(FrameRate::OVERLAY_SETTING);
        return setting != nullptr && strcmp(setting, "0") != 0;
    }();

    return requested;
}

void FrameRate::Tick()
{
    const uint64_t now = MonotonicNanos();

    FrameRate::gTotalFrames.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(FrameRate::gMutex);

    if (FrameRate::gWindowStart == 0)
    {
        FrameRate::gWindowStart = now;
        return;
    }

    FrameRate::gWindowFrames += 1;

    const uint64_t elapsed = now - FrameRate::gWindowStart;
    if (elapsed < FrameRate::WINDOW_NANOS) return;

    const double seconds = (double)elapsed / 1e9;
    const double perSecond = (double)FrameRate::gWindowFrames / seconds;

    FrameRate::gPerSecond.store(perSecond, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    FrameRate::gMilliseconds.store(perSecond > 0.0 ? 1000.0 / perSecond : 0.0, std::memory_order_relaxed);

    FrameRate::gWindowStart = now;
    FrameRate::gWindowFrames = 0;
}

double FrameRate::PerSecond()
{
    return FrameRate::gPerSecond.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

double FrameRate::MillisecondsPerFrame()
{
    return FrameRate::gMilliseconds.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

uint64_t FrameRate::TotalFrames()
{
    return FrameRate::gTotalFrames.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

std::string FrameRate::Caption()
{
    const double perSecond = FrameRate::PerSecond();

    if (perSecond <= 0.0) return std::string("measuring");

    char text[64];
    snprintf(text, sizeof(text), "%.0f fps  %.1f ms", perSecond, FrameRate::MillisecondsPerFrame());

    return std::string(text);
}

std::string FrameRate::PaddedCaption()
{
    std::string caption = FrameRate::Caption();

    if ((int)caption.size() > FrameRate::CAPTION_CHARACTERS) caption.resize(FrameRate::CAPTION_CHARACTERS);
    while ((int)caption.size() < FrameRate::CAPTION_CHARACTERS) caption.push_back(' ');

    return caption;
}
```

`src/Overlay/Overlay.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Overlay/Overlay.hpp"

#include <string>

#include "Overlay/FrameRate.hpp"
#include "Overlay/OverlayFont.hpp"

bool Overlay::Enabled()
{
    return FrameRate::OverlayRequested();
}

void Overlay::DrawInto(void* pixels, int width, int height, int strideBytes)
{
    if (!pixels || width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;
    if (!FrameRate::OverlayRequested()) return;

    static OverlayFont::Panel panel;
    static std::string drawn;

    const std::string caption = FrameRate::Caption();

    if (caption != drawn || panel.pixels.empty())
    {
        drawn = caption;
        OverlayFont::Render(caption, FrameRate::OVERLAY_SCALE, OverlayFont::Channels::Bgra, panel);
    }

    OverlayFont::Blend(panel, pixels, width, height, strideBytes, OverlayFont::MARGIN, OverlayFont::MARGIN);
}
```

```cpp
static const uint8_t* GlyphFor(char character)
{
    int index = (int)(unsigned char)character;

    if (index < OverlayFont::FIRST_PRINTABLE || index > OverlayFont::LAST_PRINTABLE) index = OverlayFont::FIRST_PRINTABLE;

    return OverlayFont::GLYPHS[index - OverlayFont::FIRST_PRINTABLE];
}

int OverlayFont::MeasureWidth(const std::string& text, int scale)
{
    if (text.empty() || scale <= 0) return 0;

    const int advance = (GLYPH_WIDTH + GLYPH_SPACING) * scale;

    return (int)text.size() * advance - GLYPH_SPACING * scale + MARGIN * 2;
}

int OverlayFont::MeasureHeight(int scale)
{
    if (scale <= 0) return 0;

    return GLYPH_HEIGHT * scale + MARGIN * 2;
}

void OverlayFont::Render(const std::string& text, int scale, OverlayFont::Channels channels, OverlayFont::Panel& panel)
{
    panel.width = MeasureWidth(text, scale);
    panel.height = MeasureHeight(scale);

    if (panel.width <= 0 || panel.height <= 0)
    {
        panel.pixels.clear();
        return;
    }

    panel.pixels.assign((size_t)panel.width * (size_t)panel.height * 4, 0);

    const bool blueFirst = channels == OverlayFont::Channels::Bgra;

    for (size_t at = 0; at < panel.pixels.size(); at += 4)
    {
        panel.pixels[at + 0] = blueFirst ? BACKGROUND_BLUE : BACKGROUND_RED;
        panel.pixels[at + 1] = BACKGROUND_GREEN;
        panel.pixels[at + 2] = blueFirst ? BACKGROUND_RED : BACKGROUND_BLUE;
        panel.pixels[at + 3] = BACKGROUND_ALPHA;
    }

    const int advance = (GLYPH_WIDTH + GLYPH_SPACING) * scale;

    for (size_t character = 0; character < text.size(); ++character)
    {
        const uint8_t* glyph = GlyphFor(text[character]);
        const int originX = MARGIN + (int)character * advance;

        for (int row = 0; row < GLYPH_HEIGHT; ++row)
        {
            const uint8_t bits = glyph[row];

            for (int column = 0; column < GLYPH_WIDTH; ++column)
            {
                if ((bits & (1u << (GLYPH_WIDTH - 1 - column))) == 0) continue;

                for (int downscale = 0; downscale < scale; ++downscale)
                {
                    for (int across = 0; across < scale; ++across)
                    {
                        const int x = originX + column * scale + across;
                        const int y = MARGIN + row * scale + downscale;

                        if (x < 0 || x >= panel.width || y < 0 || y >= panel.height) continue;

                        uint8_t* pixel = panel.pixels.data() + ((size_t)y * (size_t)panel.width + (size_t)x) * 4;

                        pixel[0] = blueFirst ? TEXT_BLUE : TEXT_RED;
                        pixel[1] = TEXT_GREEN;
                        pixel[2] = blueFirst ? TEXT_RED : TEXT_BLUE;
                        pixel[3] = 255;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

void OverlayFont::Blend(const OverlayFont::Panel& panel, void* destination, int destinationWidth, int destinationHeight,
                        int destinationStride, int left, int top)
{
    if (!destination || panel.pixels.empty()) return;

    uint8_t* target = (uint8_t*)destination;

    for (int row = 0; row < panel.height; ++row)
    {
        const int y = top + row;
        if (y < 0 || y >= destinationHeight) continue;

        for (int column = 0; column < panel.width; ++column)
        {
            const int x = left + column;
            if (x < 0 || x >= destinationWidth) continue;

            const uint8_t* source = panel.pixels.data() + ((size_t)row * (size_t)panel.width + (size_t)column) * 4;
            uint8_t* pixel = target + (size_t)y * (size_t)destinationStride + (size_t)x * 4;

            const uint32_t alpha = source[3];
            if (alpha == 0) continue;

            if (alpha == 255)
            {
                pixel[0] = source[0];
                pixel[1] = source[1];
                pixel[2] = source[2];
                pixel[3] = 255;
                continue;
            }

            const uint32_t inverse = 255 - alpha;

            pixel[0] = (uint8_t)((source[0] * alpha + pixel[0] * inverse) / 255);
            pixel[1] = (uint8_t)((source[1] * alpha + pixel[1] * inverse) / 255);
            pixel[2] = (uint8_t)((source[2] * alpha + pixel[2] * inverse) / 255);
            pixel[3] = 255;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/Overlay/OverlayVulkan.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Overlay/OverlayVulkan.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <vector>

#include "Overlay/FrameRate.hpp"
#include "Overlay/Overlay.hpp"
#include "Overlay/OverlayFont.hpp"
#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"

namespace OverlayVulkan
{
    struct Api
    {
        PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties GetMemoryProperties = nullptr;
        PFN_vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR GetSwapchainImages = nullptr;
        PFN_vkCreateCommandPool CreateCommandPool = nullptr;
        PFN_vkDestroyCommandPool DestroyCommandPool = nullptr;
        PFN_vkAllocateCommandBuffers AllocateCommandBuffers = nullptr;
        PFN_vkBeginCommandBuffer BeginCommandBuffer = nullptr;
        PFN_vkEndCommandBuffer EndCommandBuffer = nullptr;
        PFN_vkResetCommandBuffer ResetCommandBuffer = nullptr;
        PFN_vkCmdPipelineBarrier CmdPipelineBarrier = nullptr;
        PFN_vkCmdCopyBufferToImage CmdCopyBufferToImage = nullptr;
        PFN_vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer CmdCopyImageToBuffer = nullptr;
        PFN_vkCreateBuffer CreateBuffer = nullptr;
        PFN_vkDestroyBuffer DestroyBuffer = nullptr;
        PFN_vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements GetBufferMemoryRequirements = nullptr;
        PFN_vkAllocateMemory AllocateMemory = nullptr;
        PFN_vkFreeMemory FreeMemory = nullptr;
        PFN_vkBindBufferMemory BindBufferMemory = nullptr;
        PFN_vkMapMemory MapMemory = nullptr;
        PFN_vkUnmapMemory UnmapMemory = nullptr;
        PFN_vkCreateSemaphore CreateSemaphore = nullptr;
        PFN_vkDestroySemaphore DestroySemaphore = nullptr;
        PFN_vkCreateFence CreateFence = nullptr;
        PFN_vkDestroyFence DestroyFence = nullptr;
        PFN_vkWaitForFences WaitForFences = nullptr;
        PFN_vkResetFences ResetFences = nullptr;
        PFN_vkQueueSubmit QueueSubmit = nullptr;
    };

    struct Slot
    {
        VkCommandBuffer commands = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        VkSemaphore finished = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        VkFence fence = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        bool submitted = false;
    };

    struct Target
    {
        VkDevice device = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        VkFormat format = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
        VkExtent2D extent = {};
        bool copyable = false;
        bool ready = false;
        bool broken = false;
        std::vector<VkImage> images;
        std::vector<Slot> slots;
        VkCommandPool pool = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        VkBuffer staging = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        VkDeviceMemory stagingMemory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        void* stagingMapping = nullptr;
        uint64_t stagingBytes = 0;
        VkBuffer readback = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        VkDeviceMemory readbackMemory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        void* readbackMapping = nullptr;
        uint64_t readbackBytes = 0;
        bool captured = false;
        int panelWidth = 0;
        int panelHeight = 0;
        std::string caption;
    };

    static std::mutex gMutex;
    static Api gApi;
    static bool gEnabled = false;
    static const char* gFailure = nullptr;
    static VkPhysicalDevice gPhysicalDevice = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    static std::map<VkQueue, uint32_t> gQueueFamilies;
    static std::map<VkQueue, VkDevice> gQueueDevices;
    static std::map<VkSwapchainKHR, Target> gTargets;
}

static void Fail(const char* reason)
{
    if (OverlayVulkan::gFailure) return;

    OverlayVulkan::gFailure = reason;
    fprintf(stderr, "[overlay] the frame counter cannot be drawn into the guest's frames: %s\n", reason);
}

bool OverlayVulkan::Enable(OverlayVulkan::Resolver resolve)
{
    if (!resolve) return false;

    OverlayVulkan::Api& api = OverlayVulkan::gApi;

#define RESOLVE_OVERLAY(field, name)                                          \
    do                                                                        \
    {                                                                         \
        api.field = (PFN_##name)resolve(#name);                               \
        if (!api.field)                                                       \
        {                                                                     \
            Fail("the host driver does not expose " #name);                   \
            return false;                                                     \
        }                                                                     \
    } while (false)

    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(GetMemoryProperties, vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(GetSwapchainImages, vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(CreateCommandPool, vkCreateCommandPool);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(DestroyCommandPool, vkDestroyCommandPool);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(AllocateCommandBuffers, vkAllocateCommandBuffers);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(BeginCommandBuffer, vkBeginCommandBuffer);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(EndCommandBuffer, vkEndCommandBuffer);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(ResetCommandBuffer, vkResetCommandBuffer);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(CmdPipelineBarrier, vkCmdPipelineBarrier);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(CmdCopyBufferToImage, vkCmdCopyBufferToImage);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(CmdCopyImageToBuffer, vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(CreateBuffer, vkCreateBuffer);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(DestroyBuffer, vkDestroyBuffer);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(GetBufferMemoryRequirements, vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(AllocateMemory, vkAllocateMemory);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(FreeMemory, vkFreeMemory);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(BindBufferMemory, vkBindBufferMemory);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(MapMemory, vkMapMemory);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(UnmapMemory, vkUnmapMemory);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(CreateSemaphore, vkCreateSemaphore);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(DestroySemaphore, vkDestroySemaphore);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(CreateFence, vkCreateFence);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(DestroyFence, vkDestroyFence);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(WaitForFences, vkWaitForFences);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(ResetFences, vkResetFences);
    RESOLVE_OVERLAY(QueueSubmit, vkQueueSubmit);

#undef RESOLVE_OVERLAY

    OverlayVulkan::gEnabled = true;

    return true;
}

bool OverlayVulkan::IsEnabled()
{
    return OverlayVulkan::gEnabled;
}

VkImageUsageFlags OverlayVulkan::AddCopyUsage(VkImageUsageFlags requested)
{
    if (!OverlayVulkan::gEnabled) return requested;

    return requested | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
}

void OverlayVulkan::NoteDevice(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(OverlayVulkan::gMutex);
    OverlayVulkan::gPhysicalDevice = physicalDevice;
}

void OverlayVulkan::NoteQueue(VkDevice device, uint32_t queueFamilyIndex, VkQueue queue)
{
    if (queue == VK_NULL_HANDLE) return;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(OverlayVulkan::gMutex);
    OverlayVulkan::gQueueFamilies[queue] = queueFamilyIndex;
    OverlayVulkan::gQueueDevices[queue] = device;
}

void OverlayVulkan::NoteSwapchain(VkDevice device, VkSwapchainKHR swapchain, VkFormat format, VkExtent2D extent, bool copyable)
{
    if (swapchain == VK_NULL_HANDLE) return;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(OverlayVulkan::gMutex);

    OverlayVulkan::Target target;
    target.device = device;
    target.format = format;
    target.extent = extent;
    target.copyable = copyable;

    OverlayVulkan::gTargets[swapchain] = target;
}

void OverlayVulkan::ForgetSwapchain(VkSwapchainKHR swapchain)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(OverlayVulkan::gMutex);
    OverlayVulkan::gTargets.erase(swapchain);
}

static const char* CapturePath()
{
    static const char* path = Settings::Lookup(Overlay::CAPTURE_SETTING);

    return path && *path ? path : nullptr;
}

static bool FormatIsBlueFirst(VkFormat format)
{
    return format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM || format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB;
}

static bool FormatIsCopyable(VkFormat format)
{
    switch (format)
    {
        case VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM:
        case VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB:
        case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM:
        case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB:
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
    }
}

static bool FindMemoryType(uint32_t allowed, VkMemoryPropertyFlags wanted, uint32_t& chosen)
{
    VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties properties = {};
    OverlayVulkan::gApi.GetMemoryProperties(OverlayVulkan::gPhysicalDevice, &properties);

    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < properties.memoryTypeCount; ++index)
    {
        if ((allowed & (1u << index)) == 0) continue;
        if ((properties.memoryTypes[index].propertyFlags & wanted) != wanted) continue;

        chosen = index;
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

static bool PrepareTarget(OverlayVulkan::Target& target, VkSwapchainKHR swapchain, uint32_t queueFamilyIndex)
{
    OverlayVulkan::Api& api = OverlayVulkan::gApi;

    uint32_t imageCount = 0;
    if (api.GetSwapchainImages(target.device, swapchain, &imageCount, nullptr) != VK_SUCCESS || imageCount == 0)
    {
        Fail("the swapchain images could not be counted");
        return false;
    }

    target.images.assign(imageCount, VK_NULL_HANDLE);
    if (api.GetSwapchainImages(target.device, swapchain, &imageCount, target.images.data()) != VK_SUCCESS)
    {
        Fail("the swapchain images could not be read");
        return false;
    }

    VkCommandPoolCreateInfo poolInfo = {};
    poolInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO;
    poolInfo.flags = VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT;
    poolInfo.queueFamilyIndex = queueFamilyIndex;

    if (api.CreateCommandPool(target.device, &poolInfo, nullptr, &target.pool) != VK_SUCCESS)
    {
        Fail("a command pool could not be created");
        return false;
    }

    target.slots.assign(imageCount, OverlayVulkan::Slot());

    std::vector<VkCommandBuffer> buffers(imageCount, VK_NULL_HANDLE);

    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo allocateInfo = {};
    allocateInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO;
    allocateInfo.commandPool = target.pool;
    allocateInfo.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
    allocateInfo.commandBufferCount = imageCount;

    if (api.AllocateCommandBuffers(target.device, &allocateInfo, buffers.data()) != VK_SUCCESS)
    {
        Fail("the command buffers could not be allocated");
        return false;
    }

    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < imageCount; ++index)
    {
        target.slots[index].commands = buffers[index];

        VkSemaphoreCreateInfo semaphoreInfo = {};
        semaphoreInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_CREATE_INFO;

        if (api.CreateSemaphore(target.device, &semaphoreInfo, nullptr, &target.slots[index].finished) != VK_SUCCESS)
        {
            Fail("a semaphore could not be created");
            return false;
        }

        VkFenceCreateInfo fenceInfo = {};
        fenceInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO;

        if (api.CreateFence(target.device, &fenceInfo, nullptr, &target.slots[index].fence) != VK_SUCCESS)
        {
            Fail("a fence could not be created");
            return false;
        }
    }

    target.panelWidth = OverlayFont::MeasureWidth(std::string(FrameRate::CAPTION_CHARACTERS, '0'), FrameRate::OVERLAY_SCALE);
    target.panelHeight = OverlayFont::MeasureHeight(FrameRate::OVERLAY_SCALE);
    target.stagingBytes = (uint64_t)target.panelWidth * (uint64_t)target.panelHeight * 4;

    VkBufferCreateInfo bufferInfo = {};
    bufferInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO;
    bufferInfo.size = target.stagingBytes;
    bufferInfo.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT;
    bufferInfo.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;

    if (api.CreateBuffer(target.device, &bufferInfo, nullptr, &target.staging) != VK_SUCCESS)
    {
        Fail("the staging buffer could not be created");
        return false;
    }

    VkMemoryRequirements requirements = {};
    api.GetBufferMemoryRequirements(target.device, target.staging, &requirements);

    uint32_t memoryType = 0;
    if (!FindMemoryType(requirements.memoryTypeBits, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT,
                        memoryType))
    {
        Fail("no host visible memory type accepts the staging buffer");
        return false;
    }

    VkMemoryAllocateInfo memoryInfo = {};
    memoryInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO;
    memoryInfo.allocationSize = requirements.size;
    memoryInfo.memoryTypeIndex = memoryType;

    if (api.AllocateMemory(target.device, &memoryInfo, nullptr, &target.stagingMemory) != VK_SUCCESS)
    {
        Fail("the staging memory could not be allocated");
        return false;
    }

    if (api.BindBufferMemory(target.device, target.staging, target.stagingMemory, 0) != VK_SUCCESS)
    {
        Fail("the staging memory could not be bound");
        return false;
    }

    if (api.MapMemory(target.device, target.stagingMemory, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &target.stagingMapping) != VK_SUCCESS)
    {
        Fail("the staging memory could not be mapped");
        return false;
    }

    if (CapturePath())
    {
        target.readbackBytes = (uint64_t)target.extent.width * (uint64_t)target.extent.height * 4;

        VkBufferCreateInfo readbackInfo = {};
        readbackInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO;
        readbackInfo.size = target.readbackBytes;
        readbackInfo.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
        readbackInfo.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;

        VkMemoryRequirements readbackRequirements = {};
        uint32_t readbackType = 0;

        if (api.CreateBuffer(target.device, &readbackInfo, nullptr, &target.readback) == VK_SUCCESS)
        {
            api.GetBufferMemoryRequirements(target.device, target.readback, &readbackRequirements);

            if (FindMemoryType(readbackRequirements.memoryTypeBits,
                               VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT, readbackType))
            {
                VkMemoryAllocateInfo readbackMemoryInfo = {};
                readbackMemoryInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO;
                readbackMemoryInfo.allocationSize = readbackRequirements.size;
                readbackMemoryInfo.memoryTypeIndex = readbackType;

                if (api.AllocateMemory(target.device, &readbackMemoryInfo, nullptr, &target.readbackMemory) == VK_SUCCESS
                    && api.BindBufferMemory(target.device, target.readback, target.readbackMemory, 0) == VK_SUCCESS)
                {
                    api.MapMemory(target.device, target.readbackMemory, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &target.readbackMapping);
                }
            }
        }

        if (!target.readbackMapping) fprintf(stderr, "[overlay] a guest frame cannot be captured: no readable buffer\n");
    }

    target.ready = true;

    fprintf(stderr, "[overlay] the frame counter draws into the guest's own frames, %dx%d at the top left\n", target.panelWidth,
            target.panelHeight);

    return true;
}

static void RecordAndSubmit(OverlayVulkan::Target& target, OverlayVulkan::Slot& slot, VkQueue queue, VkImage image,
                            const VkSemaphore* waitSemaphores, uint32_t waitCount, bool capture)
{
    OverlayVulkan::Api& api = OverlayVulkan::gApi;

    api.ResetCommandBuffer(slot.commands, 0);

    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo beginInfo = {};
    beginInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO;
    beginInfo.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;

    api.BeginCommandBuffer(slot.commands, &beginInfo);

    VkImageMemoryBarrier toTransfer = {};
    toTransfer.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER;
    toTransfer.srcAccessMask = 0;
    toTransfer.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
    toTransfer.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR;
    toTransfer.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
    toTransfer.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    toTransfer.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    toTransfer.image = image;
    toTransfer.subresourceRange.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
    toTransfer.subresourceRange.levelCount = 1;
    toTransfer.subresourceRange.layerCount = 1;

    api.CmdPipelineBarrier(slot.commands, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0, 0, nullptr, 0,
                           nullptr, 1, &toTransfer);

    VkBufferImageCopy region = {};
    region.bufferOffset = 0;
    region.bufferRowLength = (uint32_t)target.panelWidth;
    region.bufferImageHeight = (uint32_t)target.panelHeight;
    region.imageSubresource.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
    region.imageSubresource.layerCount = 1;
    region.imageOffset.x = OverlayFont::MARGIN;
    region.imageOffset.y = OverlayFont::MARGIN;
    region.imageExtent.width = (uint32_t)target.panelWidth;
    region.imageExtent.height = (uint32_t)target.panelHeight;
    region.imageExtent.depth = 1;

    api.CmdCopyBufferToImage(slot.commands, target.staging, image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &region);

    VkImageLayout beforePresent = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;

    if (capture)
    {
        VkImageMemoryBarrier toRead = toTransfer;
        toRead.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
        toRead.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT;
        toRead.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
        toRead.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;

        api.CmdPipelineBarrier(slot.commands, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0, 0, nullptr, 0,
                               nullptr, 1, &toRead);

        VkBufferImageCopy whole = {};
        whole.imageSubresource.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
        whole.imageSubresource.layerCount = 1;
        whole.imageExtent.width = target.extent.width;
        whole.imageExtent.height = target.extent.height;
        whole.imageExtent.depth = 1;

        api.CmdCopyImageToBuffer(slot.commands, image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, target.readback, 1, &whole);

        beforePresent = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
    }

    VkImageMemoryBarrier toPresent = toTransfer;
    toPresent.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
    toPresent.dstAccessMask = 0;
    toPresent.oldLayout = beforePresent;
    toPresent.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR;

    api.CmdPipelineBarrier(slot.commands, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_BIT, 0, 0, nullptr, 0,
                           nullptr, 1, &toPresent);

    api.EndCommandBuffer(slot.commands);

    std::vector<VkPipelineStageFlags> stages(waitCount, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT);

    VkSubmitInfo submit = {};
    submit.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO;
    submit.waitSemaphoreCount = waitCount;
    submit.pWaitSemaphores = waitCount > 0 ? waitSemaphores : nullptr;
    submit.pWaitDstStageMask = waitCount > 0 ? stages.data() : nullptr;
    submit.commandBufferCount = 1;
    submit.pCommandBuffers = &slot.commands;
    submit.signalSemaphoreCount = 1;
    submit.pSignalSemaphores = &slot.finished;

    api.ResetFences(target.device, 1, &slot.fence);

    if (api.QueueSubmit(queue, 1, &submit, slot.fence) != VK_SUCCESS)
    {
        Fail("the overlay copy could not be submitted");
        target.broken = true;
        return;
    }

    slot.submitted = true;
}

bool OverlayVulkan::Draw(VkQueue queue, VkSwapchainKHR swapchain, uint32_t imageIndex, const VkSemaphore* waitSemaphores,
                         uint32_t waitCount, VkSemaphore& signalled)
{
    if (!OverlayVulkan::gEnabled) return false;

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(OverlayVulkan::gMutex);

    auto found = OverlayVulkan::gTargets.find(swapchain);
    if (found == OverlayVulkan::gTargets.end())
    {
        Fail("this swapchain was not created through the interposed vkCreateSwapchainKHR");
        return false;
    }

    OverlayVulkan::Target& target = found->second;
    if (target.broken) return false;

    if (!target.copyable)
    {
        Fail("the swapchain images cannot be copied into");
        return false;
    }

    if (!FormatIsCopyable(target.format))
    {
        Fail("the swapchain format is not one of the four eight bit formats this can write");
        return false;
    }

    auto family = OverlayVulkan::gQueueFamilies.find(queue);
    if (family == OverlayVulkan::gQueueFamilies.end())
    {
        Fail("the presenting queue never came from the interposed vkGetDeviceQueue");
        return false;
    }

    if (OverlayVulkan::gPhysicalDevice == VK_NULL_HANDLE)
    {
        Fail("the physical device never came from the interposed vkCreateDevice");
        return false;
    }

    if (!target.ready && !PrepareTarget(target, swapchain, family->second))
    {
        target.broken = true;
        return false;
    }

    if (imageIndex >= target.images.size() || imageIndex >= target.slots.size()) return false;

    OverlayVulkan::Slot& slot = target.slots[imageIndex];

    if (slot.submitted)
    {
        OverlayVulkan::gApi.WaitForFences(target.device, 1, &slot.fence, VK_TRUE, UINT64_MAX);
        slot.submitted = false;
    }

    const std::string caption = FrameRate::PaddedCaption();

    if (caption != target.caption)
    {
        target.caption = caption;

        OverlayFont::Panel panel;
        OverlayFont::Render(caption, FrameRate::OVERLAY_SCALE,
                            FormatIsBlueFirst(target.format) ? OverlayFont::Channels::Bgra : OverlayFont::Channels::Rgba, panel);

        for (size_t at = 3; at < panel.pixels.size(); at += 4) panel.pixels[at] = 255;

        if (panel.width == target.panelWidth && panel.height == target.panelHeight
            && panel.pixels.size() == (size_t)target.stagingBytes)
        {
            memcpy(target.stagingMapping, panel.pixels.data(), panel.pixels.size());
        }
        else
        {
            Fail("the overlay panel came out a different size than the staging buffer");
            target.broken = true;
            return false;
        }
    }

    const bool capture = CapturePath() && target.readbackMapping && !target.captured
                         && FrameRate::TotalFrames() >= OverlayVulkan::CAPTURE_AFTER_FRAMES;

    RecordAndSubmit(target, slot, queue, target.images[imageIndex], waitSemaphores, waitCount, capture);

    if (target.broken) return false;

    if (capture)
    {
        target.captured = true;

        OverlayVulkan::gApi.WaitForFences(target.device, 1, &slot.fence, VK_TRUE, UINT64_MAX);

        FILE* out = fopen(CapturePath(), "wb");

        if (out)
        {
            fwrite(target.readbackMapping, 1, (size_t)target.readbackBytes, out);
            fclose(out);

            fprintf(stderr, "[overlay] a guest frame with the counter on it is at %s, %ux%u\n", CapturePath(), target.extent.width,
                    target.extent.height);
        }
        else
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "[overlay] a guest frame could not be written to %s\n", CapturePath());
        }
    }

    signalled = slot.finished;

    return true;
}

const char* OverlayVulkan::LastFailure()
{
    return OverlayVulkan::gFailure;
}
```

`src/PackageRegistry/PackageRegistry.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "PackageRegistry/PackageRegistry.hpp"

#include <cerrno>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "Apk/Apk.hpp"

static std::string Trim(const std::string& text)
{
    size_t first = 0;
    size_t last = text.size();

    while (first < last && (text[first] == ' ' || text[first] == '\t' || text[first] == '\r' || text[first] == '\n')) first += 1;
    while (last > first && (text[last - 1] == ' ' || text[last - 1] == '\t' || text[last - 1] == '\r' || text[last - 1] == '\n')) last -= 1;

    return text.substr(first, last - first);
}

static int IntegerFrom(const std::string& text, int fallback)
{
    if (text.empty()) return fallback;

    char* end = nullptr;
    long parsed = strtol(text.c_str(), &end, 10);

    if (end == text.c_str()) return fallback;
    return (int)parsed;
}

std::string PackageRegistry::IndexPath(const std::string& dataRoot)
{
    if (dataRoot.empty()) return std::string();

    return dataRoot + "/" + INDEX_LEAF;
}

std::string PackageRegistry::IconDirectory(const std::string& dataRoot)
{
    if (dataRoot.empty()) return std::string();

    return dataRoot + "/" + ICON_DIRECTORY_LEAF;
}

PackageRegistry::Result PackageRegistry::Load(const std::string& indexPath, std::vector<Entry>& entries)
{
    entries.clear();

    if (indexPath.empty()) return Result::NotFound;

    FILE* file = fopen(indexPath.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!file) return Result::NotFound;

    char line[MAX_LINE_BYTES];
    Entry current;
    bool open = false;

    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), file))
    {
        std::string text = Trim(line);

        const size_t comment = text.find('#');
        if (comment != std::string::npos) text = Trim(text.substr(0, comment));
        if (text.empty()) continue;

        if (text.front() == '[' && text.back() == ']')
        {
            if (open && !current.packageName.empty() && entries.size() < MAX_PACKAGES) entries.push_back(current);

            current = Entry{};
            open = false;

            const std::string section = text.substr(1, text.size() - 2);
            const size_t prefix = strlen(SECTION_PREFIX);

            if (section.size() <= prefix || section.compare(0, prefix, SECTION_PREFIX) != 0) continue;

            current.packageName = section.substr(prefix);
            open = !current.packageName.empty();
            continue;
        }

        if (!open) continue;

        const size_t equals = text.find('=');
        if (equals == std::string::npos) continue;

        const std::string key = Trim(text.substr(0, equals));
        const std::string value = Trim(text.substr(equals + 1));

        if (key == "label") current.label = value;
        else if (key == "apk") current.apkPath = value;
        else if (key == "icon") current.iconPath = value;
        else if (key == "data") current.dataPath = value;
        else if (key == "min_sdk") current.minSdkVersion = IntegerFrom(value, 0);
        else if (key == "target_sdk") current.targetSdkVersion = IntegerFrom(value, 0);
        else if (key == "activities") current.activityCount = IntegerFrom(value, 0);
    }

    if (open && !current.packageName.empty() && entries.size() < MAX_PACKAGES) entries.push_back(current);

    fclose(file);

    return Result::Ok;
}

bool PackageRegistry::Find(const std::vector<Entry>& entries, const std::string& packageName, Entry& found)
{
    if (packageName.empty()) return false;

    for (const Entry& entry : entries)
    {
        if (entry.packageName != packageName) continue;

        found = entry;
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

std::string PackageRegistry::InstalledApkPath(const std::string& dataRoot, const std::string& packageName)
{
    if (dataRoot.empty() || packageName.empty()) return std::string();

    return dataRoot + "/" + packageName + "/base.apk";
}

static bool EnsureDirectory(const std::string& path)
{
    if (path.empty()) return false;
    if (mkdir(path.c_str(), 0755) == 0) return true;

    if (errno != ENOENT) return errno == EEXIST;

    const size_t slash = path.find_last_of('/');
    if (slash == std::string::npos || slash == 0) return false;

    if (!EnsureDirectory(path.substr(0, slash))) return false;

    return mkdir(path.c_str(), 0755) == 0 || errno == EEXIST;
}

static bool CopyFile(const std::string& from, const std::string& to)
{
    FILE* source = fopen(from.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!source) return false;

    FILE* destination = fopen(to.c_str(), "wb");
    if (!destination)
    {
        fclose(source);
        return false;
    }

    char buffer[65536];
    bool ok = true;

    for (;;)
    {
        const size_t read = fread(buffer, 1, sizeof(buffer), source);
        if (read == 0) break;

        if (fwrite(buffer, 1, read, destination) != read)
        {
            ok = false;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (ferror(source)) ok = false;

    fclose(source);
    if (fclose(destination) != 0) ok = false;

    return ok;
}

static bool ExtractIcon(const Apk::Package& package, const std::string& destination)
{
    const std::string entryName = Apk::ResolveRasterIconEntry(package);
    if (entryName.empty()) return false;

    Apk::Asset asset;
    if (Apk::OpenNonAsset(package, entryName, asset) != Apk::Result::Ok) return false;

    FILE* out = fopen(destination.c_str(), "wb");
    if (!out)
    {
        Apk::CloseAsset(asset);
        return false;
    }

    char buffer[65536];
    bool ok = true;

    for (;;)
    {
        const int read = Apk::ReadAsset(asset, buffer, (int)sizeof(buffer));
        if (read <= 0) break;

        if (fwrite(buffer, 1, (size_t)read, out) != (size_t)read)
        {
            ok = false;
            break;
        }
    }

    fclose(out);
    Apk::CloseAsset(asset);

    if (!ok) unlink(destination.c_str());

    return ok;
}

static bool RemoveTree(const std::string& path)
{
    DIR* opened = opendir(path.c_str());

    if (!opened) return unlink(path.c_str()) == 0 || errno == ENOENT;

    for (struct dirent* entry = readdir(opened); entry; entry = readdir(opened))
    {
        const std::string name = entry->d_name;
        if (name == "." || name == "..") continue;

        RemoveTree(path + "/" + name);
    }

    closedir(opened);

    return rmdir(path.c_str()) == 0 || errno == ENOENT;
}

PackageRegistry::Result PackageRegistry::Save(const std::string& indexPath, const std::vector<Entry>& entries)
{
    if (indexPath.empty()) return Result::Unwritable;

    const size_t slash = indexPath.find_last_of('/');
    if (slash != std::string::npos && slash != 0 && !EnsureDirectory(indexPath.substr(0, slash))) return Result::Unwritable;

    const std::string temporary = indexPath + ".new";

    FILE* file = fopen(temporary.c_str(), "wb");
    if (!file) return Result::Unwritable;

    fprintf(file, "# written by acl --install; one section per installed package\n");

    for (const Entry& entry : entries)
    {
        fprintf(file, "\n[%s%s]\n", SECTION_PREFIX, entry.packageName.c_str());
        fprintf(file, "label = %s\n", entry.label.c_str());
        fprintf(file, "apk = %s\n", entry.apkPath.c_str());
        fprintf(file, "icon = %s\n", entry.iconPath.c_str());
        fprintf(file, "data = %s\n", entry.dataPath.c_str());
        fprintf(file, "min_sdk = %d\n", entry.minSdkVersion);
        fprintf(file, "target_sdk = %d\n", entry.targetSdkVersion);
        fprintf(file, "activities = %d\n", entry.activityCount);
    }

    const bool flushed = fflush(file) == 0;
    const bool closed = fclose(file) == 0;

    if (!flushed || !closed)
    {
        unlink(temporary.c_str());
        return Result::Unwritable;
    }

    if (rename(temporary.c_str(), indexPath.c_str()) != 0)
    {
        unlink(temporary.c_str());
        return Result::Unwritable;
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

PackageRegistry::Result PackageRegistry::Install(const std::string& apkPath, const std::string& dataRoot,
                                                 const std::string& frameworkResources, std::vector<Entry>& entries,
                                                 Entry& installed)
{
    Apk::Package package;

    if (Apk::Open(apkPath, frameworkResources, package) != Apk::Result::Ok) return Result::NotAnArchive;

    const Apk::Manifest& manifest = package.manifest;

    if (manifest.packageName.empty() || !Apk::IsValidPackageName(manifest.packageName))
    {
        Apk::Close(package);
        return Result::NoPackageName;
    }

    Entry entry;
    const std::string label = Apk::ResolveLabel(package);

    entry.packageName = manifest.packageName;
    entry.label = label.empty() ? manifest.packageName : label;
    entry.minSdkVersion = manifest.minSdkVersion;
    entry.targetSdkVersion = manifest.targetSdkVersion;
    entry.activityCount = (int)manifest.activities.size();

    Apk::Close(package);

    const std::string directory = dataRoot + "/" + entry.packageName;
    if (!EnsureDirectory(directory)) return Result::CopyFailed;

    const std::string destination = InstalledApkPath(dataRoot, entry.packageName);

    if (destination != apkPath && !CopyFile(apkPath, destination)) return Result::CopyFailed;

    entry.apkPath = destination;
    entry.dataPath = directory;

    Apk::Package copied;

    if (Apk::Open(destination, frameworkResources, copied) == Apk::Result::Ok)
    {
        const std::string iconDirectory = IconDirectory(dataRoot);

        if (EnsureDirectory(iconDirectory))
        {
            const std::string iconPath = iconDirectory + "/" + entry.packageName;
            if (ExtractIcon(copied, iconPath)) entry.iconPath = iconPath;
        }

        Apk::Close(copied);
    }

    for (Entry& existing : entries)
    {
        if (existing.packageName != entry.packageName) continue;

        existing = entry;
        installed = entry;

        return Save(IndexPath(dataRoot), entries);
    }

    if (entries.size() >= MAX_PACKAGES) return Result::TooMany;

    entries.push_back(entry);
    installed = entry;

    return Save(IndexPath(dataRoot), entries);
}

PackageRegistry::Result PackageRegistry::Uninstall(const std::string& packageName, const std::string& dataRoot,
                                                   std::vector<Entry>& entries, bool keepData)
{
    if (!Apk::IsValidPackageName(packageName)) return Result::NoPackageName;

    size_t found = entries.size();

    for (size_t index = 0; index < entries.size(); index++)
    {
        if (entries[index].packageName != packageName) continue;

        found = index;
        break;
    }

    if (found == entries.size()) return Result::NotFound;

    if (keepData)
    {
        if (unlink(InstalledApkPath(dataRoot, packageName).c_str()) != 0 && errno != ENOENT) return Result::Unwritable;
    }
    else if (!RemoveTree(dataRoot + "/" + packageName))
    {
        return Result::Unwritable;
    }

    unlink((IconDirectory(dataRoot) + "/" + packageName).c_str());

    entries.erase(entries.begin() + (long)found);

    return Save(IndexPath(dataRoot), entries);
}

const char* PackageRegistry::ResultName(Result result)
{
    switch (result)
    {
        case Result::Ok:
            return "Ok";
        case Result::NotFound:
            return "NotFound";
        case Result::Unreadable:
            return "Unreadable";
        case Result::Malformed:
            return "Malformed";
        case Result::NotAnArchive:
            return "NotAnArchive";
        case Result::NoPackageName:
            return "NoPackageName";
        case Result::CopyFailed:
            return "CopyFailed";
        case Result::Unwritable:
            return "Unwritable";
        case Result::TooMany:
            return "TooMany";
    }

    return "Unknown";
}
```

`src/Platform/Platform.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Platform/Platform.hpp"

#include <cstdlib>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"

static const int DENSITY_BUCKETS[] = {120, 160, 213, 240, 320, 400, 420, 440, 480, 560, 640};

bool Platform::SdkVersionMatchesBuildConfiguration(int buildConfiguredVersion)
{
    return buildConfiguredVersion == DECLARED_SDK_VERSION;
}

uint64_t Platform::HostPageBytes()
{
    long size = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
    if (size <= 0) return GUEST_MIN_PAGE_BYTES;
    return (uint64_t)size;
}

int Platform::NearestDensityBucket(int densityDpi)
{
    if (densityDpi <= DENSITY_BUCKETS[0]) return DENSITY_BUCKETS[0];

    const int count = (int)(sizeof(DENSITY_BUCKETS) / sizeof(DENSITY_BUCKETS[0]));
    if (densityDpi >= DENSITY_BUCKETS[count - 1]) return DENSITY_BUCKETS[count - 1];

    int best = DENSITY_BUCKETS[0];
    int bestDistance = densityDpi - DENSITY_BUCKETS[0];

    for (int index = 1; index < count; ++index)
    {
        const int distance = densityDpi > DENSITY_BUCKETS[index] ? densityDpi - DENSITY_BUCKETS[index]
                                                                 : DENSITY_BUCKETS[index] - densityDpi;

        if (distance >= bestDistance) continue;

        best = DENSITY_BUCKETS[index];
        bestDistance = distance;
    }

    return best;
}

int Platform::DensityForWindow(uint32_t widthPixels, uint32_t heightPixels)
{
    const uint32_t shortSide = widthPixels < heightPixels ? widthPixels : heightPixels;
    if (shortSide == 0) return DENSITY_DEFAULT;

    const int derived = (int)((shortSide * (uint32_t)DENSITY_DEFAULT + TARGET_SHORT_SIDE_DP / 2) / TARGET_SHORT_SIDE_DP);

    if (derived <= DENSITY_DEFAULT) return DENSITY_DEFAULT;

    return NearestDensityBucket(derived);
}

static int ConfiguredPixels(const char* name)
{
    const char* value = Settings::Lookup(name);
    if (!value || value[0] == '\0') return 0;

    char* end = nullptr;
    const long parsed = strtol(value, &end, 10);

    if (!end || *end != '\0' || parsed <= 0 || parsed > 16384) return 0;

    return (int)parsed;
}

void Platform::ConfiguredScreen(int& widthPixels, int& heightPixels, int& densityDpi)
{
    widthPixels = ConfiguredPixels(WINDOW_WIDTH_SETTING);
    heightPixels = ConfiguredPixels(WINDOW_HEIGHT_SETTING);
    densityDpi = ConfiguredDensity((uint32_t)widthPixels, (uint32_t)heightPixels);
}

int Platform::StatusBarHeight(uint32_t widthPixels, uint32_t heightPixels)
{
    const int density = ConfiguredDensity(widthPixels, heightPixels);
    return (STATUS_BAR_HEIGHT_DP * density + 80) / 160;
}

int Platform::NavigationBarHeight(uint32_t widthPixels, uint32_t heightPixels)
{
    const int density = ConfiguredDensity(widthPixels, heightPixels);
    return (NAVIGATION_BAR_HEIGHT_DP * density + 80) / 160;
}

int Platform::ConfiguredDensity(uint32_t widthPixels, uint32_t heightPixels)
{
    const char* configured = Settings::Lookup(DENSITY_SETTING);

    if (configured && configured[0] != '\0')
    {
        char* end = nullptr;
        const long parsed = strtol(configured, &end, 10);

        if (end && *end == '\0' && parsed >= 40 && parsed <= 1280) return (int)parsed;
    }

    return DensityForWindow(widthPixels, heightPixels);
}
```
