`src/Rasterizer/Rasterizer.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Rasterizer/Rasterizer.hpp"

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>

static constexpr float AXIS_TOLERANCE = 1.0f / (1 << 12);

void RasterizerRetainMask(Rasterizer::ClipMask* mask);
void RasterizerReleaseMask(Rasterizer::ClipMask* mask);

bool Rasterizer::IsEmpty(const Rect& rect)
{
    return rect.right <= rect.left || rect.bottom <= rect.top;
}

Rasterizer::Rect Rasterizer::Intersect(const Rect& first, const Rect& second)
{
    Rect result;
    result.left = first.left > second.left ? first.left : second.left;
    result.top = first.top > second.top ? first.top : second.top;
    result.right = first.right < second.right ? first.right : second.right;
    result.bottom = first.bottom < second.bottom ? first.bottom : second.bottom;

    if (IsEmpty(result)) return Rect{result.left, result.top, result.left, result.top};

    return result;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::CreateSurface(uint32_t width, uint32_t height, Surface& surface)
{
    if (width < 1 || height < 1) return Result::InvalidGeometry;
    if (width > MAX_DIMENSION || height > MAX_DIMENSION) return Result::InvalidGeometry;

    uint32_t stride = width * BYTES_PER_PIXEL;
    size_t sizeBytes = static_cast<size_t>(stride) * height;

    uint8_t* pixels = static_cast<uint8_t*>(calloc(1, sizeBytes));
    if (!pixels) return Result::AllocationFailed;

    surface.pixels = pixels;
    surface.width = width;
    surface.height = height;
    surface.stride = stride;
    surface.ownsPixels = true;
    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::WrapSurface(uint8_t* pixels, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, uint32_t stride, Surface& surface)
{
    if (!pixels) return Result::InvalidSurface;
    if (width < 1 || height < 1) return Result::InvalidGeometry;
    if (width > MAX_DIMENSION || height > MAX_DIMENSION) return Result::InvalidGeometry;
    if (stride < width * BYTES_PER_PIXEL) return Result::InvalidGeometry;

    surface.pixels = pixels;
    surface.width = width;
    surface.height = height;
    surface.stride = stride;
    surface.ownsPixels = false;
    return Result::Ok;
}

void Rasterizer::DestroySurface(Surface& surface)
{
    if (surface.ownsPixels) free(surface.pixels);

    surface.pixels = nullptr;
    surface.width = 0;
    surface.height = 0;
    surface.stride = 0;
    surface.ownsPixels = false;
}

Rasterizer::State& Rasterizer::StateAt(Canvas& canvas, int index)
{
    if (index < MAX_STATE_DEPTH) return canvas.stack[index];

    return canvas.deepStack[index - MAX_STATE_DEPTH];
}

const Rasterizer::State& Rasterizer::StateAt(const Canvas& canvas, int index)
{
    if (index < MAX_STATE_DEPTH) return canvas.stack[index];

    return canvas.deepStack[index - MAX_STATE_DEPTH];
}

Rasterizer::State& Rasterizer::TopState(Canvas& canvas)
{
    return StateAt(canvas, canvas.depth > 0 ? canvas.depth - 1 : 0);
}

static bool ReserveDepth(Rasterizer::Canvas& canvas, int depth)
{
    if (depth < Rasterizer::MAX_STATE_DEPTH) return true;

    int needed = depth - Rasterizer::MAX_STATE_DEPTH + 1;
    if (needed <= canvas.deepCapacity) return true;

    int capacity = canvas.deepCapacity > 0 ? canvas.deepCapacity * 2 : Rasterizer::MAX_STATE_DEPTH;
    while (capacity < needed) capacity *= 2;

    Rasterizer::State* grown = static_cast<Rasterizer::State*>(std::realloc(canvas.deepStack, sizeof(Rasterizer::State) * capacity));
    if (!grown) return false;

    canvas.deepStack = grown;
    canvas.deepCapacity = capacity;
    return true;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::Begin(const Surface& surface, Canvas& canvas)
{
    if (!surface.pixels) return Result::InvalidSurface;

    End(canvas);

    canvas.surface = surface;
    canvas.depth = 1;
    canvas.stack[0] = State{};
    canvas.stack[0].clip = Rect{0, 0, static_cast<int32_t>(surface.width), static_cast<int32_t>(surface.height)};
    return Result::Ok;
}

void Rasterizer::End(Canvas& canvas)
{
    while (canvas.layerCount > 0) RestoreLayer(canvas);

    for (int index = 0; index < canvas.depth; ++index) RasterizerReleaseMask(StateAt(canvas, index).mask);

    canvas.depth = 0;

    std::free(canvas.deepStack);
    canvas.deepStack = nullptr;
    canvas.deepCapacity = 0;

    std::free(canvas.layers);
    canvas.layers = nullptr;
    canvas.layerCapacity = 0;
}

const Rasterizer::State& Rasterizer::CurrentState(const Canvas& canvas)
{
    return StateAt(canvas, canvas.depth > 0 ? canvas.depth - 1 : 0);
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::Save(Canvas& canvas)
{
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;
    if (!ReserveDepth(canvas, canvas.depth)) return Result::StateStackOverflow;

    StateAt(canvas, canvas.depth) = StateAt(canvas, canvas.depth - 1);
    RasterizerRetainMask(StateAt(canvas, canvas.depth).mask);
    canvas.depth++;
    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::Restore(Canvas& canvas)
{
    if (canvas.depth <= 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;

    RasterizerReleaseMask(StateAt(canvas, canvas.depth - 1).mask);
    canvas.depth--;
    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::Translate(Canvas& canvas, int32_t deltaX, int32_t deltaY)
{
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;

    State& state = TopState(canvas);
    state.translateX += deltaX;
    state.translateY += deltaY;

    Transform step;
    step.translateX = static_cast<float>(deltaX);
    step.translateY = static_cast<float>(deltaY);
    state.transform = Multiply(state.transform, step);

    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::ClipRect(Canvas& canvas, const Rect& rect)
{
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;

    State& state = TopState(canvas);
    const Transform& transform = state.transform;

    bool axisAligned = std::fabs(transform.skewX) < AXIS_TOLERANCE && std::fabs(transform.skewY) < AXIS_TOLERANCE;

    if (!axisAligned)
    {
        Path* shape = CreatePath();
        if (!shape) return Result::AllocationFailed;

        AddRectangle(*shape, static_cast<float>(rect.left), static_cast<float>(rect.top), static_cast<float>(rect.right),
                     static_cast<float>(rect.bottom));

        Result outcome = ClipPath(canvas, *shape, FillRule::NonZero, false);
        DestroyPath(shape);

        return outcome;
    }

    float firstX = transform.scaleX * rect.left + transform.translateX;
    float secondX = transform.scaleX * rect.right + transform.translateX;
    float firstY = transform.scaleY * rect.top + transform.translateY;
    float secondY = transform.scaleY * rect.bottom + transform.translateY;

    Rect mapped;
    mapped.left = static_cast<int32_t>(std::lround(firstX < secondX ? firstX : secondX));
    mapped.right = static_cast<int32_t>(std::lround(firstX < secondX ? secondX : firstX));
    mapped.top = static_cast<int32_t>(std::lround(firstY < secondY ? firstY : secondY));
    mapped.bottom = static_cast<int32_t>(std::lround(firstY < secondY ? secondY : firstY));

    state.clip = Intersect(state.clip, mapped);
    return Result::Ok;
}

static void FillDeviceRect(const Rasterizer::Surface& surface, const Rasterizer::Rect& area, uint32_t color)
{
    for (int32_t y = area.top; y < area.bottom; ++y)
    {
        uint8_t* row = surface.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * surface.stride;
        uint32_t* pixel = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(row) + area.left;
        for (int32_t x = area.left; x < area.right; ++x)
        {
            *pixel++ = color;
        }
    }
}

static Rasterizer::Rect ToDeviceRect(const Rasterizer::Canvas& canvas, const Rasterizer::Rect& rect)
{
    const Rasterizer::State& state = Rasterizer::CurrentState(canvas);

    Rasterizer::Rect device;
    device.left = rect.left + state.translateX;
    device.top = rect.top + state.translateY;
    device.right = rect.right + state.translateX;
    device.bottom = rect.bottom + state.translateY;

    Rasterizer::Rect bounds{0, 0, static_cast<int32_t>(canvas.surface.width), static_cast<int32_t>(canvas.surface.height)};
    return Rasterizer::Intersect(Rasterizer::Intersect(device, state.clip), bounds);
}

static uint32_t DivideBy255(uint32_t value)
{
    uint32_t sum = value + 128;
    return (sum + (sum >> 8)) >> 8;
}

static uint32_t BlendChannel(uint32_t source, uint32_t destination, uint32_t alpha)
{
    return DivideBy255(source * alpha + destination * (255u - alpha));
}

static uint32_t BlendPixel(uint32_t source, uint32_t destination, uint32_t coverage)
{
    uint32_t sourceAlpha = (source >> 24) & 0xFFu;
    uint32_t alpha = DivideBy255(coverage * sourceAlpha);
    if (alpha == 0) return destination;
    if (alpha == 255) return source | 0xFF000000u;

    uint32_t red = BlendChannel((source >> 16) & 0xFFu, (destination >> 16) & 0xFFu, alpha);
    uint32_t green = BlendChannel((source >> 8) & 0xFFu, (destination >> 8) & 0xFFu, alpha);
    uint32_t blue = BlendChannel(source & 0xFFu, destination & 0xFFu, alpha);

    return 0xFF000000u | (red << 16) | (green << 8) | blue;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::DrawColor(Canvas& canvas, uint32_t color)
{
    if (!canvas.surface.pixels) return Result::InvalidSurface;
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;

    Rect bounds{0, 0, static_cast<int32_t>(canvas.surface.width), static_cast<int32_t>(canvas.surface.height)};
    Rect area = Intersect(CurrentState(canvas).clip, bounds);
    if (IsEmpty(area)) return Result::Ok;

    FillDeviceRect(canvas.surface, area, color);
    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::DrawRect(Canvas& canvas, const Rect& rect, uint32_t color)
{
    if (!canvas.surface.pixels) return Result::InvalidSurface;
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;

    Rect area = ToDeviceRect(canvas, rect);
    if (IsEmpty(area)) return Result::Ok;

    FillDeviceRect(canvas.surface, area, color);
    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::DrawRectOutline(Canvas& canvas, const Rect& rect, int32_t thickness, uint32_t color)
{
    if (thickness < 1) return Result::OutOfRange;

    int32_t limitX = rect.right - rect.left;
    int32_t limitY = rect.bottom - rect.top;
    if (limitX <= 0 || limitY <= 0) return Result::Ok;

    int32_t horizontal = thickness < limitY ? thickness : limitY;
    int32_t vertical = thickness < limitX ? thickness : limitX;

    DrawRect(canvas, Rect{rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.top + horizontal}, color);
    DrawRect(canvas, Rect{rect.left, rect.bottom - horizontal, rect.right, rect.bottom}, color);
    DrawRect(canvas, Rect{rect.left, rect.top, rect.left + vertical, rect.bottom}, color);
    DrawRect(canvas, Rect{rect.right - vertical, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom}, color);
    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::DrawHorizontalLine(Canvas& canvas, int32_t x, int32_t y, int32_t length, uint32_t color)
{
    if (length < 1) return Result::OutOfRange;
    return DrawRect(canvas, Rect{x, y, x + length, y + 1}, color);
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::DrawVerticalLine(Canvas& canvas, int32_t x, int32_t y, int32_t length, uint32_t color)
{
    if (length < 1) return Result::OutOfRange;
    return DrawRect(canvas, Rect{x, y, x + 1, y + length}, color);
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::DrawRectBlend(Canvas& canvas, const Rect& rect, uint32_t color)
{
    if (!canvas.surface.pixels) return Result::InvalidSurface;
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;

    Rect area = ToDeviceRect(canvas, rect);
    if (IsEmpty(area)) return Result::Ok;

    for (int32_t y = area.top; y < area.bottom; ++y)
    {
        uint8_t* row = canvas.surface.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * canvas.surface.stride;
        uint32_t* pixel = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(row) + area.left;
        for (int32_t x = area.left; x < area.right; ++x)
        {
            *pixel = BlendPixel(color, *pixel, 255u);
            ++pixel;
        }
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::DrawCoverage(Canvas& canvas, const Coverage& mask, int32_t x, int32_t y, uint32_t color)
{
    if (!canvas.surface.pixels) return Result::InvalidSurface;
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;
    if (!mask.samples) return Result::OutOfRange;
    if (mask.width <= 0 || mask.height <= 0) return Result::Ok;
    if (mask.pitch < mask.width) return Result::OutOfRange;

    Rect requested{x, y, x + mask.width, y + mask.height};
    Rect area = ToDeviceRect(canvas, requested);
    if (IsEmpty(area)) return Result::Ok;

    const State& state = CurrentState(canvas);
    int32_t originX = x + state.translateX;
    int32_t originY = y + state.translateY;

    for (int32_t deviceY = area.top; deviceY < area.bottom; ++deviceY)
    {
        const uint8_t* sampleRow = mask.samples + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(deviceY - originY) * mask.pitch;
        uint8_t* row = canvas.surface.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(deviceY) * canvas.surface.stride;
        uint32_t* pixel = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(row) + area.left;

        for (int32_t deviceX = area.left; deviceX < area.right; ++deviceX)
        {
            uint32_t coverage = sampleRow[deviceX - originX];
            if (coverage != 0) *pixel = BlendPixel(color, *pixel, coverage);
            ++pixel;
        }
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::Blit(Canvas& canvas, const Surface& source, int32_t x, int32_t y)
{
    if (!canvas.surface.pixels) return Result::InvalidSurface;
    if (!source.pixels) return Result::InvalidSurface;
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;

    Rect target{x, y, x + static_cast<int32_t>(source.width), y + static_cast<int32_t>(source.height)};
    Rect area = ToDeviceRect(canvas, target);
    if (IsEmpty(area)) return Result::Ok;

    const State& state = CurrentState(canvas);
    int32_t originX = x + state.translateX;
    int32_t originY = y + state.translateY;

    for (int32_t row = area.top; row < area.bottom; ++row)
    {
        const uint8_t* sourceRow = source.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(row - originY) * source.stride;
        uint8_t* targetRow = canvas.surface.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(row) * canvas.surface.stride;

        const uint32_t* sourcePixel = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(sourceRow) + (area.left - originX);
        uint32_t* targetPixel = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(targetRow) + area.left;

        memcpy(targetPixel, sourcePixel, static_cast<size_t>(area.right - area.left) * BYTES_PER_PIXEL);
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

uint32_t Rasterizer::PixelAt(const Surface& surface, uint32_t x, uint32_t y)
{
    if (!surface.pixels) return 0;
    if (x >= surface.width || y >= surface.height) return 0;

    const uint8_t* row = surface.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * surface.stride;
    return reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(row)[x];
}

const char* Rasterizer::ResultName(Result result)
{
    switch (result)
    {
        case Result::Ok: return "Ok";
        case Result::InvalidGeometry: return "InvalidGeometry";
        case Result::InvalidSurface: return "InvalidSurface";
        case Result::AllocationFailed: return "AllocationFailed";
        case Result::StateStackOverflow: return "StateStackOverflow";
        case Result::StateStackUnderflow: return "StateStackUnderflow";
        case Result::OutOfRange: return "OutOfRange";
    }
    return "Unknown";
}

```

`src/Rasterizer/VectorFill.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Rasterizer/Rasterizer.hpp"

#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#include <ft2build.h>
#include FT_FREETYPE_H
#include FT_OUTLINE_H
#include FT_STROKER_H

bool RasterizerFeedStroker(const Rasterizer::Path& path, const Rasterizer::Transform& transform, FT_Stroker stroker);

bool RasterizerBuildOutline(const Rasterizer::Path& path, const Rasterizer::Transform& transform, FT_Outline& outline,
                            std::vector<FT_Vector>& points, std::vector<char>& tags, std::vector<short>& contours);

FT_Library RasterizerOutlineLibrary();

static constexpr int GRADIENT_RAMP_SIZE = 256;
static constexpr float MAXIMUM_STROKE_WIDTH = 8192.0f;
static constexpr float DEFAULT_MITER_LIMIT = 4.0f;
static constexpr float MAXIMUM_MITER_LIMIT = 1000.0f;

struct SpanTarget
{
    Rasterizer::Canvas* canvas;
    const Rasterizer::Source* source;
    Rasterizer::BlendMode blend;
    uint8_t alpha;
    Rasterizer::Rect clip;
    const Rasterizer::ClipMask* mask;
    int32_t height;
    uint32_t solid;
    bool isSolid;
    bool canCopy;
    bool directBlend;
    float axisX;
    float axisY;
    float axisScale;
    bool hasRamp;
    uint32_t ramp[GRADIENT_RAMP_SIZE];
};

static uint32_t DivideBy255(uint32_t value)
{
    return (value + 1 + (value >> 8)) >> 8;
}

static uint32_t ChannelOf(uint32_t color, int shift)
{
    return (color >> shift) & 0xFFu;
}

static uint32_t PackColor(uint32_t alpha, uint32_t red, uint32_t green, uint32_t blue)
{
    return (alpha << 24) | (red << 16) | (green << 8) | blue;
}

static uint32_t Premultiply(uint32_t color)
{
    uint32_t alpha = ChannelOf(color, 24);
    if (alpha == 255) return color;

    return PackColor(alpha, DivideBy255(ChannelOf(color, 16) * alpha), DivideBy255(ChannelOf(color, 8) * alpha),
                     DivideBy255(ChannelOf(color, 0) * alpha));
}

static uint32_t Lerp(uint32_t first, uint32_t second, float amount)
{
    if (amount <= 0.0f) return first;
    if (amount >= 1.0f) return second;

    int32_t weight = static_cast<int32_t>(amount * 255.0f + 0.5f);

    uint32_t channels[4];
    for (int index = 0; index < 4; ++index)
    {
        int shift = index * 8;
        int32_t from = static_cast<int32_t>(ChannelOf(first, shift));
        int32_t to = static_cast<int32_t>(ChannelOf(second, shift));

        channels[index] = static_cast<uint32_t>(from + ((to - from) * weight) / 255);
    }

    return PackColor(channels[3], channels[2], channels[1], channels[0]);
}

static float ApplyTile(float value, Rasterizer::TileMode mode)
{
    if (mode == Rasterizer::TileMode::Clamp) return value < 0.0f ? 0.0f : (value > 1.0f ? 1.0f : value);

    float wrapped = value - std::floor(value);

    if (mode == Rasterizer::TileMode::Repeat) return wrapped;

    float doubled = value * 0.5f;
    float period = doubled - std::floor(doubled);

    return period < 0.5f ? period * 2.0f : 2.0f - period * 2.0f;
}

static uint32_t SampleStops(const Rasterizer::Source& source, float position)
{
    if (source.stopCount <= 0) return source.color;
    if (source.stopCount == 1) return source.stops[0].color;

    if (position <= source.stops[0].position) return source.stops[0].color;
    if (position >= source.stops[source.stopCount - 1].position) return source.stops[source.stopCount - 1].color;

    for (int32_t index = 1; index < source.stopCount; ++index)
    {
        const Rasterizer::GradientStop& upper = source.stops[index];
        if (position > upper.position) continue;

        const Rasterizer::GradientStop& lower = source.stops[index - 1];
        float span = upper.position - lower.position;
        float amount = span <= 0.0f ? 0.0f : (position - lower.position) / span;

        return Lerp(lower.color, upper.color, amount);
    }

    return source.stops[source.stopCount - 1].color;
}

static uint32_t TexelAt(const Rasterizer::Surface& image, int32_t x, int32_t y)
{
    if (x < 0) x = 0;
    if (y < 0) y = 0;
    if (x >= static_cast<int32_t>(image.width)) x = static_cast<int32_t>(image.width) - 1;
    if (y >= static_cast<int32_t>(image.height)) y = static_cast<int32_t>(image.height) - 1;

    const uint8_t* row = image.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * image.stride;
    return reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(row)[x];
}

static uint32_t SampleImage(const Rasterizer::Source& source, float x, float y)
{
    const Rasterizer::Surface* image = source.image;
    if (!image || !image->pixels || image->width == 0 || image->height == 0) return 0;

    float mappedX = ApplyTile(x / static_cast<float>(image->width), source.tileMode) * static_cast<float>(image->width);
    float mappedY = ApplyTile(y / static_cast<float>(image->height), source.tileMode) * static_cast<float>(image->height);

    if (!source.filter) return TexelAt(*image, static_cast<int32_t>(mappedX), static_cast<int32_t>(mappedY));

    float centredX = mappedX - 0.5f;
    float centredY = mappedY - 0.5f;

    float flooredX = std::floor(centredX);
    float flooredY = std::floor(centredY);

    int32_t leftColumn = static_cast<int32_t>(flooredX);
    int32_t topRow = static_cast<int32_t>(flooredY);

    float acrossAmount = centredX - flooredX;
    float downAmount = centredY - flooredY;

    uint32_t topLeft = TexelAt(*image, leftColumn, topRow);
    uint32_t topRight = TexelAt(*image, leftColumn + 1, topRow);
    uint32_t bottomLeft = TexelAt(*image, leftColumn, topRow + 1);
    uint32_t bottomRight = TexelAt(*image, leftColumn + 1, topRow + 1);

    return Lerp(Lerp(topLeft, topRight, acrossAmount), Lerp(bottomLeft, bottomRight, acrossAmount), downAmount);
}

static void BuildRamp(const Rasterizer::Source& source, uint32_t* ramp)
{
    for (int index = 0; index < GRADIENT_RAMP_SIZE; ++index)
    {
        float position = static_cast<float>(index) / static_cast<float>(GRADIENT_RAMP_SIZE - 1);
        ramp[index] = Premultiply(SampleStops(source, position));
    }
}

static uint32_t PremultipliedSourceAt(const SpanTarget& target, int32_t deviceX, int32_t deviceY)
{
    const Rasterizer::Source& source = *target.source;

    float x = static_cast<float>(deviceX) + 0.5f;
    float y = static_cast<float>(deviceY) + 0.5f;

    float localX = source.inverse.scaleX * x + source.inverse.skewX * y + source.inverse.translateX;
    float localY = source.inverse.skewY * x + source.inverse.scaleY * y + source.inverse.translateY;

    if (source.kind == Rasterizer::SourceKind::Image)
    {
        uint32_t sampled = SampleImage(source, localX, localY);
        if (!source.tinted) return sampled;

        uint32_t alpha = DivideBy255(ChannelOf(sampled, 24) * ChannelOf(source.tint, 24));

        return PackColor(alpha, DivideBy255(ChannelOf(source.tint, 16) * alpha),
                         DivideBy255(ChannelOf(source.tint, 8) * alpha),
                         DivideBy255(ChannelOf(source.tint, 0) * alpha));
    }

    float position = 0.0f;

    if (source.kind == Rasterizer::SourceKind::LinearGradient)
    {
        if (target.axisScale > 0.0f)
        {
            position = ((localX - source.startX) * target.axisX + (localY - source.startY) * target.axisY) * target.axisScale;
        }
    }
    else if (source.kind == Rasterizer::SourceKind::RadialGradient)
    {
        float deltaX = localX - source.startX;
        float deltaY = localY - source.startY;

        position = std::sqrt(deltaX * deltaX + deltaY * deltaY) * target.axisScale;
    }
    else
    {
        float angle = std::atan2(localY - source.startY, localX - source.startX);
        if (angle < 0.0f) angle += 6.28318530718f;

        position = angle / 6.28318530718f;
    }

    position = ApplyTile(position, source.tileMode);

    int index = static_cast<int>(position * static_cast<float>(GRADIENT_RAMP_SIZE - 1) + 0.5f);
    if (index < 0) index = 0;
    if (index >= GRADIENT_RAMP_SIZE) index = GRADIENT_RAMP_SIZE - 1;

    return target.ramp[index];
}

static uint32_t LerpChannel(uint32_t from, uint32_t to, uint32_t coverage)
{
    return DivideBy255(from * (255 - coverage) + to * coverage);
}

static uint32_t BlendDestinationModes(Rasterizer::BlendMode blend, uint32_t source, uint32_t destination, uint32_t coverage)
{
    uint32_t sourceAlpha = ChannelOf(source, 24);
    uint32_t destinationAlpha = ChannelOf(destination, 24);
    uint32_t sourceInverse = 255 - sourceAlpha;
    uint32_t destinationInverse = 255 - destinationAlpha;

    uint32_t blended[4];

    for (int channel = 0; channel < 4; ++channel)
    {
        int shift = 24 - channel * 8;
        uint32_t sourceValue = ChannelOf(source, shift);
        uint32_t destinationValue = ChannelOf(destination, shift);
        uint32_t result = destinationValue;

        switch (blend)
        {
            case Rasterizer::BlendMode::DestinationIn:
                result = DivideBy255(destinationValue * sourceAlpha);
                break;

            case Rasterizer::BlendMode::DestinationAtop:
                result = channel == 0 ? sourceAlpha
                                      : DivideBy255(destinationValue * sourceAlpha) + DivideBy255(sourceValue * destinationInverse);
                break;

            case Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOut:
                result = DivideBy255(sourceValue * destinationInverse);
                break;

            case Rasterizer::BlendMode::Xor:
                result = DivideBy255(sourceValue * destinationInverse) + DivideBy255(destinationValue * sourceInverse);
                break;

            default: break;
        }

        blended[channel] = LerpChannel(destinationValue, result > 255 ? 255 : result, coverage);
    }

    return PackColor(blended[0], blended[1], blended[2], blended[3]);
}

uint32_t RasterizerBlendPixel(Rasterizer::BlendMode blend, uint32_t premultiplied, uint32_t destination, uint32_t coverage)
{
    if (blend == Rasterizer::BlendMode::Destination) return destination;

    if (blend == Rasterizer::BlendMode::DestinationIn || blend == Rasterizer::BlendMode::DestinationAtop ||
        blend == Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOut || blend == Rasterizer::BlendMode::Xor)
    {
        return BlendDestinationModes(blend, premultiplied, destination, coverage);
    }

    if (blend == Rasterizer::BlendMode::Clear)
    {
        uint32_t kept = 255 - coverage;

        return PackColor(DivideBy255(ChannelOf(destination, 24) * kept), DivideBy255(ChannelOf(destination, 16) * kept),
                         DivideBy255(ChannelOf(destination, 8) * kept), DivideBy255(ChannelOf(destination, 0) * kept));
    }

    uint32_t sourceAlpha = DivideBy255(ChannelOf(premultiplied, 24) * coverage);
    if (sourceAlpha == 0 && blend != Rasterizer::BlendMode::Source) return destination;

    uint32_t sourceRed = DivideBy255(ChannelOf(premultiplied, 16) * coverage);
    uint32_t sourceGreen = DivideBy255(ChannelOf(premultiplied, 8) * coverage);
    uint32_t sourceBlue = DivideBy255(ChannelOf(premultiplied, 0) * coverage);

    uint32_t destinationAlpha = ChannelOf(destination, 24);
    uint32_t destinationRed = ChannelOf(destination, 16);
    uint32_t destinationGreen = ChannelOf(destination, 8);
    uint32_t destinationBlue = ChannelOf(destination, 0);

    uint32_t inverse = 255 - sourceAlpha;

    switch (blend)
    {
        case Rasterizer::BlendMode::Source:
            return PackColor(sourceAlpha, sourceRed, sourceGreen, sourceBlue);

        case Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceIn:
            return PackColor(DivideBy255(sourceAlpha * destinationAlpha), DivideBy255(sourceRed * destinationAlpha),
                             DivideBy255(sourceGreen * destinationAlpha), DivideBy255(sourceBlue * destinationAlpha));

        case Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceAtop:
            return PackColor(destinationAlpha, DivideBy255(sourceRed * destinationAlpha) + DivideBy255(destinationRed * inverse),
                             DivideBy255(sourceGreen * destinationAlpha) + DivideBy255(destinationGreen * inverse),
                             DivideBy255(sourceBlue * destinationAlpha) + DivideBy255(destinationBlue * inverse));

        case Rasterizer::BlendMode::DestinationOver:
        {
            uint32_t destinationInverse = 255 - destinationAlpha;
            return PackColor(destinationAlpha + DivideBy255(sourceAlpha * destinationInverse),
                             destinationRed + DivideBy255(sourceRed * destinationInverse),
                             destinationGreen + DivideBy255(sourceGreen * destinationInverse),
                             destinationBlue + DivideBy255(sourceBlue * destinationInverse));
        }

        case Rasterizer::BlendMode::DestinationOut:
            return PackColor(DivideBy255(destinationAlpha * inverse), DivideBy255(destinationRed * inverse),
                             DivideBy255(destinationGreen * inverse), DivideBy255(destinationBlue * inverse));

        case Rasterizer::BlendMode::Multiply:
            return PackColor(sourceAlpha + DivideBy255(destinationAlpha * inverse),
                             DivideBy255(sourceRed * destinationRed) + DivideBy255(destinationRed * inverse),
                             DivideBy255(sourceGreen * destinationGreen) + DivideBy255(destinationGreen * inverse),
                             DivideBy255(sourceBlue * destinationBlue) + DivideBy255(destinationBlue * inverse));

        case Rasterizer::BlendMode::Screen:
            return PackColor(sourceAlpha + DivideBy255(destinationAlpha * inverse),
                             sourceRed + destinationRed - DivideBy255(sourceRed * destinationRed),
                             sourceGreen + destinationGreen - DivideBy255(sourceGreen * destinationGreen),
                             sourceBlue + destinationBlue - DivideBy255(sourceBlue * destinationBlue));

        case Rasterizer::BlendMode::Plus:
        {
            uint32_t red = sourceRed + destinationRed;
            uint32_t green = sourceGreen + destinationGreen;
            uint32_t blue = sourceBlue + destinationBlue;
            uint32_t alpha = sourceAlpha + destinationAlpha;

            return PackColor(alpha > 255 ? 255 : alpha, red > 255 ? 255 : red, green > 255 ? 255 : green,
                             blue > 255 ? 255 : blue);
        }

        default:
            return PackColor(sourceAlpha + DivideBy255(destinationAlpha * inverse), sourceRed + DivideBy255(destinationRed * inverse),
                             sourceGreen + DivideBy255(destinationGreen * inverse),
                             sourceBlue + DivideBy255(destinationBlue * inverse));
    }
}

static void PaintSpans(int y, int count, const FT_Span* spans, void* user)
{
    SpanTarget* target = static_cast<SpanTarget*>(user);

    int32_t deviceY = y;
    if (deviceY < target->clip.top || deviceY >= target->clip.bottom) return;

    uint8_t* row = target->canvas->surface.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(deviceY) * target->canvas->surface.stride;

    for (int index = 0; index < count; ++index)
    {
        int32_t left = spans[index].x;
        int32_t right = left + spans[index].len;

        if (left < target->clip.left) left = target->clip.left;
        if (right > target->clip.right) right = target->clip.right;

        if (target->canCopy && spans[index].coverage == 255)
        {
            uint32_t* pixel = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(row) + left;
            for (int32_t deviceX = left; deviceX < right; ++deviceX) *pixel++ = target->solid;
            continue;
        }

        for (int32_t deviceX = left; deviceX < right; ++deviceX)
        {
            uint32_t coverage = spans[index].coverage;

            if (target->mask)
            {
                uint32_t clipping = target->mask->samples[static_cast<size_t>(deviceY) * target->mask->width + deviceX];
                if (clipping == 0) continue;

                coverage = DivideBy255(coverage * clipping);
            }

            if (target->alpha != 255) coverage = DivideBy255(coverage * target->alpha);
            if (coverage == 0) continue;

            uint32_t* pixel = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(row) + deviceX;
            uint32_t premultiplied = target->isSolid ? target->solid : PremultipliedSourceAt(*target, deviceX, deviceY);

            if (target->directBlend && coverage == 255 && ChannelOf(premultiplied, 24) == 255)
            {
                *pixel = premultiplied;
                continue;
            }

            *pixel = RasterizerBlendPixel(target->blend, premultiplied, *pixel, coverage);
        }
    }
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::FillCoverage(Canvas& canvas, const Coverage& mask, const Source& source, BlendMode blend,
                                            uint8_t alpha)
{
    if (!canvas.surface.pixels) return Result::InvalidSurface;
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;
    if (!mask.samples) return Result::OutOfRange;

    const State& state = StateAt(canvas, canvas.depth - 1);

    Rect surfaceBounds{0, 0, static_cast<int32_t>(canvas.surface.width), static_cast<int32_t>(canvas.surface.height)};
    Rect band = Intersect(Intersect(state.clip, surfaceBounds), Rect{0, 0, mask.width, mask.height});

    if (IsEmpty(band)) return Result::Ok;

    SpanTarget target;
    target.canvas = &canvas;
    target.source = &source;
    target.blend = blend;
    target.alpha = alpha;
    target.clip = band;
    target.mask = state.mask;
    target.height = static_cast<int32_t>(canvas.surface.height);
    target.isSolid = source.kind == Rasterizer::SourceKind::Solid;
    target.solid = target.isSolid ? Premultiply(source.color) : 0;
    target.directBlend = false;
    target.canCopy = false;
    target.axisX = source.endX - source.startX;
    target.axisY = source.endY - source.startY;
    target.axisScale = 0.0f;

    if (source.kind == SourceKind::LinearGradient)
    {
        float lengthSquared = target.axisX * target.axisX + target.axisY * target.axisY;
        if (lengthSquared > 0.0f) target.axisScale = 1.0f / lengthSquared;
    }
    else if (source.kind == SourceKind::RadialGradient && source.radius > 0.0f)
    {
        target.axisScale = 1.0f / source.radius;
    }

    target.hasRamp = source.kind == SourceKind::LinearGradient || source.kind == SourceKind::RadialGradient
                     || source.kind == SourceKind::SweepGradient;

    if (target.hasRamp) BuildRamp(source, target.ramp);

    for (int32_t y = band.top; y < band.bottom; ++y)
    {
        const uint8_t* maskRow = mask.samples + static_cast<size_t>(y) * mask.pitch;
        uint8_t* row = canvas.surface.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * canvas.surface.stride;

        for (int32_t x = band.left; x < band.right; ++x)
        {
            uint32_t coverage = maskRow[x];
            if (coverage == 0) continue;

            if (state.mask)
            {
                uint32_t clipping = state.mask->samples[static_cast<size_t>(y) * state.mask->width + x];
                if (clipping == 0) continue;

                coverage = DivideBy255(coverage * clipping);
            }

            if (alpha != 255) coverage = DivideBy255(coverage * alpha);
            if (coverage == 0) continue;

            uint32_t premultiplied = target.isSolid ? target.solid : PremultipliedSourceAt(target, x, y);
            uint32_t* pixel = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(row) + x;

            *pixel = RasterizerBlendPixel(blend, premultiplied, *pixel, coverage);
        }
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

static Rasterizer::Result RenderOutline(Rasterizer::Canvas& canvas, FT_Outline& outline, const Rasterizer::Source& source,
                                        Rasterizer::FillRule rule, Rasterizer::BlendMode blend, uint8_t alpha)
{
    FT_Library library = RasterizerOutlineLibrary();
    if (!library) return Rasterizer::Result::AllocationFailed;

    if (rule == Rasterizer::FillRule::EvenOdd) outline.flags |= FT_OUTLINE_EVEN_ODD_FILL;
    else outline.flags &= ~FT_OUTLINE_EVEN_ODD_FILL;

    const Rasterizer::State& state = Rasterizer::StateAt(canvas, canvas.depth - 1);

    SpanTarget target;
    target.canvas = &canvas;
    target.source = &source;
    target.blend = blend;
    target.alpha = alpha;
    target.clip = state.clip;
    target.mask = state.mask;
    target.height = static_cast<int32_t>(canvas.surface.height);
    target.isSolid = source.kind == Rasterizer::SourceKind::Solid;
    target.solid = target.isSolid ? Premultiply(source.color) : 0;
    target.directBlend = !state.mask && alpha == 255 &&
                         (blend == Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver || blend == Rasterizer::BlendMode::Source);
    target.canCopy = target.isSolid && target.directBlend && ChannelOf(source.color, 24) == 255;

    target.axisX = source.endX - source.startX;
    target.axisY = source.endY - source.startY;
    target.axisScale = 0.0f;

    if (source.kind == Rasterizer::SourceKind::LinearGradient)
    {
        float lengthSquared = target.axisX * target.axisX + target.axisY * target.axisY;
        if (lengthSquared > 0.0f) target.axisScale = 1.0f / lengthSquared;
    }
    else if (source.kind == Rasterizer::SourceKind::RadialGradient && source.radius > 0.0f)
    {
        target.axisScale = 1.0f / source.radius;
    }

    target.hasRamp = source.kind == Rasterizer::SourceKind::LinearGradient ||
                     source.kind == Rasterizer::SourceKind::RadialGradient ||
                     source.kind == Rasterizer::SourceKind::SweepGradient;

    if (target.hasRamp) BuildRamp(source, target.ramp);

    Rasterizer::Rect surfaceBounds{0, 0, static_cast<int32_t>(canvas.surface.width),
                                   static_cast<int32_t>(canvas.surface.height)};
    Rasterizer::Rect band = Rasterizer::Intersect(state.clip, surfaceBounds);

    if (Rasterizer::IsEmpty(band)) return Rasterizer::Result::Ok;

    FT_Raster_Params parameters;
    std::memset(&parameters, 0, sizeof(parameters));
    parameters.flags = FT_RASTER_FLAG_AA | FT_RASTER_FLAG_DIRECT | FT_RASTER_FLAG_CLIP;
    parameters.gray_spans = &PaintSpans;
    parameters.user = &target;
    parameters.clip_box.xMin = band.left;
    parameters.clip_box.yMin = band.top;
    parameters.clip_box.xMax = band.right;
    parameters.clip_box.yMax = band.bottom;

    if (FT_Outline_Render(library, &outline, &parameters) != 0) return Rasterizer::Result::OutOfRange;

    return Rasterizer::Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::FillPath(Canvas& canvas, const Path& path, const Source& source, FillRule rule, BlendMode blend,
                                        uint8_t alpha)
{
    if (!canvas.surface.pixels) return Result::InvalidSurface;
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;
    if (PathIsEmpty(path)) return Result::Ok;

    std::vector<FT_Vector> points;
    std::vector<char> tags;
    std::vector<short> contours;

    FT_Outline outline;
    if (!RasterizerBuildOutline(path, StateAt(canvas, canvas.depth - 1).transform, outline, points, tags, contours))
        return Result::Ok;

    return RenderOutline(canvas, outline, source, rule, blend, alpha);
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::StrokePath(Canvas& canvas, const Path& path, const Source& source, const StrokeStyle& style,
                                          BlendMode blend, uint8_t alpha)
{
    if (!canvas.surface.pixels) return Result::InvalidSurface;
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;
    if (PathIsEmpty(path)) return Result::Ok;

    FT_Library library = RasterizerOutlineLibrary();
    if (!library) return Result::AllocationFailed;

    FT_Stroker stroker = nullptr;
    if (FT_Stroker_New(library, &stroker) != 0) return Result::AllocationFailed;

    FT_Stroker_LineCap cap = FT_STROKER_LINECAP_BUTT;
    if (style.cap == LineCap::Round) cap = FT_STROKER_LINECAP_ROUND;
    if (style.cap == LineCap::Square) cap = FT_STROKER_LINECAP_SQUARE;

    FT_Stroker_LineJoin join = FT_STROKER_LINEJOIN_MITER_VARIABLE;
    if (style.join == LineJoin::Round) join = FT_STROKER_LINEJOIN_ROUND;
    if (style.join == LineJoin::Bevel) join = FT_STROKER_LINEJOIN_BEVEL;

    const Transform& transform = StateAt(canvas, canvas.depth - 1).transform;
    float scale = std::sqrt(std::fabs(transform.scaleX * transform.scaleY - transform.skewX * transform.skewY));
    if (!std::isfinite(scale) || scale <= 0.0f) scale = 1.0f;

    float width = style.width * scale;
    if (!std::isfinite(width) || width < 1.0f) width = 1.0f;
    if (width > MAXIMUM_STROKE_WIDTH) width = MAXIMUM_STROKE_WIDTH;

    float miterLimit = style.miterLimit;
    if (!std::isfinite(miterLimit) || miterLimit < 1.0f) miterLimit = DEFAULT_MITER_LIMIT;
    if (miterLimit > MAXIMUM_MITER_LIMIT) miterLimit = MAXIMUM_MITER_LIMIT;

    FT_Stroker_Set(stroker, static_cast<FT_Fixed>(width * 32.0f), cap, join, static_cast<FT_Fixed>(miterLimit * 65536.0f));

    Result outcome = Result::Ok;

    if (RasterizerFeedStroker(path, transform, stroker))
    {
        FT_UInt strokedPoints = 0;
        FT_UInt strokedContours = 0;

        if (FT_Stroker_GetCounts(stroker, &strokedPoints, &strokedContours) == 0)
        {
            FT_Outline stroked;
            if (FT_Outline_New(library, strokedPoints, static_cast<FT_Int>(strokedContours), &stroked) == 0)
            {
                stroked.n_points = 0;
                stroked.n_contours = 0;

                FT_Stroker_Export(stroker, &stroked);
                outcome = RenderOutline(canvas, stroked, source, FillRule::NonZero, blend, alpha);

                FT_Outline_Done(library, &stroked);
            }
            else
            {
                outcome = Result::AllocationFailed;
            }
        }
    }

    FT_Stroker_Done(stroker);
    return outcome;
}

```

`src/Rasterizer/VectorPath.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Rasterizer/Rasterizer.hpp"

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#include <ft2build.h>
#include FT_FREETYPE_H
#include FT_OUTLINE_H
#include FT_STROKER_H

static constexpr float OVAL_CONTROL_RATIO = 0.5522847498f;
static constexpr float PI_VALUE = 3.14159265358979323846f;
static constexpr float PI_OVER_180 = PI_VALUE / 180.0f;
static constexpr int32_t FIXED_ONE = 64;
static constexpr int FLATTEN_STEPS = 16;

struct Rasterizer::Path
{
    std::vector<FT_Vector> points;
    std::vector<char> tags;
    std::vector<short> contours;
    std::vector<char> closed;
    int32_t contourStart = 0;
    bool open = false;
    float currentX = 0.0f;
    float currentY = 0.0f;
    float startX = 0.0f;
    float startY = 0.0f;
};

static FT_Library gLibrary = nullptr;

static FT_Library OutlineLibrary()
{
    if (!gLibrary && FT_Init_FreeType(&gLibrary) != 0) gLibrary = nullptr;

    return gLibrary;
}

static constexpr float COORDINATE_LIMIT = 32768.0f;
static constexpr FT_Pos SHORT_CURVE_UNITS = FIXED_ONE / 4;

static FT_Pos ToFixed(float value)
{
    if (!std::isfinite(value)) value = value > 0.0f ? COORDINATE_LIMIT : (value < 0.0f ? -COORDINATE_LIMIT : 0.0f);
    if (value > COORDINATE_LIMIT) value = COORDINATE_LIMIT;
    if (value < -COORDINATE_LIMIT) value = -COORDINATE_LIMIT;

    return static_cast<FT_Pos>(std::lround(value * FIXED_ONE));
}

static void PushPoint(Rasterizer::Path& path, float x, float y, char tag)
{
    FT_Vector point;
    point.x = ToFixed(x);
    point.y = ToFixed(y);

    path.points.push_back(point);
    path.tags.push_back(tag);
}

static void FinishContour(Rasterizer::Path& path, bool closed)
{
    if (!path.open) return;

    path.contours.push_back(static_cast<short>(path.points.size() - 1));
    path.closed.push_back(closed ? 1 : 0);
    path.contourStart = static_cast<int32_t>(path.points.size());
    path.open = false;
}

Rasterizer::Path* Rasterizer::CreatePath()
{
    return new Path();
}

void Rasterizer::DestroyPath(Path* path)
{
    delete path;
}

void Rasterizer::ResetPath(Path& path)
{
    path.points.clear();
    path.tags.clear();
    path.contours.clear();
    path.closed.clear();
    path.contourStart = 0;
    path.open = false;
    path.currentX = 0.0f;
    path.currentY = 0.0f;
}

bool Rasterizer::PathIsEmpty(const Path& path)
{
    return path.points.empty();
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::MoveTo(Path& path, float x, float y)
{
    FinishContour(path, false);

    PushPoint(path, x, y, FT_CURVE_TAG_ON);
    path.open = true;
    path.currentX = x;
    path.currentY = y;
    path.startX = x;
    path.startY = y;

    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::LineTo(Path& path, float x, float y)
{
    if (!path.open) return MoveTo(path, x, y);

    PushPoint(path, x, y, FT_CURVE_TAG_ON);
    path.currentX = x;
    path.currentY = y;

    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::QuadraticTo(Path& path, float controlX, float controlY, float x, float y)
{
    if (!path.open) MoveTo(path, path.currentX, path.currentY);

    PushPoint(path, controlX, controlY, FT_CURVE_TAG_CONIC);
    PushPoint(path, x, y, FT_CURVE_TAG_ON);

    path.currentX = x;
    path.currentY = y;

    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::CubicTo(Path& path, float firstX, float firstY, float secondX, float secondY, float x, float y)
{
    if (!path.open) MoveTo(path, path.currentX, path.currentY);

    PushPoint(path, firstX, firstY, FT_CURVE_TAG_CUBIC);
    PushPoint(path, secondX, secondY, FT_CURVE_TAG_CUBIC);
    PushPoint(path, x, y, FT_CURVE_TAG_ON);

    path.currentX = x;
    path.currentY = y;

    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::CloseContour(Path& path)
{
    if (!path.open) return Result::Ok;

    FinishContour(path, true);
    path.currentX = path.startX;
    path.currentY = path.startY;

    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::AddRectangle(Path& path, float left, float top, float right, float bottom)
{
    MoveTo(path, left, top);
    LineTo(path, right, top);
    LineTo(path, right, bottom);
    LineTo(path, left, bottom);

    return CloseContour(path);
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::AddRoundedRectangle(Path& path, float left, float top, float right, float bottom, float radiusX,
                                                   float radiusY)
{
    float halfWidth = (right - left) * 0.5f;
    float halfHeight = (bottom - top) * 0.5f;

    if (radiusX > halfWidth) radiusX = halfWidth;
    if (radiusY > halfHeight) radiusY = halfHeight;

    if (radiusX <= 0.0f || radiusY <= 0.0f) return AddRectangle(path, left, top, right, bottom);

    float offsetX = radiusX * OVAL_CONTROL_RATIO;
    float offsetY = radiusY * OVAL_CONTROL_RATIO;

    MoveTo(path, left + radiusX, top);
    LineTo(path, right - radiusX, top);
    CubicTo(path, right - radiusX + offsetX, top, right, top + radiusY - offsetY, right, top + radiusY);
    LineTo(path, right, bottom - radiusY);
    CubicTo(path, right, bottom - radiusY + offsetY, right - radiusX + offsetX, bottom, right - radiusX, bottom);
    LineTo(path, left + radiusX, bottom);
    CubicTo(path, left + radiusX - offsetX, bottom, left, bottom - radiusY + offsetY, left, bottom - radiusY);
    LineTo(path, left, top + radiusY);
    CubicTo(path, left, top + radiusY - offsetY, left + radiusX - offsetX, top, left + radiusX, top);

    return CloseContour(path);
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::AddOval(Path& path, float left, float top, float right, float bottom)
{
    float centreX = (left + right) * 0.5f;
    float centreY = (top + bottom) * 0.5f;
    float radiusX = (right - left) * 0.5f;
    float radiusY = (bottom - top) * 0.5f;

    if (radiusX <= 0.0f || radiusY <= 0.0f) return Result::Ok;

    float offsetX = radiusX * OVAL_CONTROL_RATIO;
    float offsetY = radiusY * OVAL_CONTROL_RATIO;

    MoveTo(path, centreX, top);
    CubicTo(path, centreX + offsetX, top, right, centreY - offsetY, right, centreY);
    CubicTo(path, right, centreY + offsetY, centreX + offsetX, bottom, centreX, bottom);
    CubicTo(path, centreX - offsetX, bottom, left, centreY + offsetY, left, centreY);
    CubicTo(path, left, centreY - offsetY, centreX - offsetX, top, centreX, top);

    return CloseContour(path);
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::AddArc(Path& path, float left, float top, float right, float bottom, float startDegrees,
                                      float sweepDegrees, bool moveToStart)
{
    float centreX = (left + right) * 0.5f;
    float centreY = (top + bottom) * 0.5f;
    float radiusX = (right - left) * 0.5f;
    float radiusY = (bottom - top) * 0.5f;

    if (radiusX <= 0.0f || radiusY <= 0.0f) return Result::Ok;

    if (sweepDegrees > 360.0f) sweepDegrees = 360.0f;
    if (sweepDegrees < -360.0f) sweepDegrees = -360.0f;

    float start = startDegrees * PI_OVER_180;
    float sweep = sweepDegrees * PI_OVER_180;

    int segments = static_cast<int>(std::ceil(std::fabs(sweep) / (PI_VALUE * 0.5f)));
    if (segments < 1) segments = 1;

    float step = sweep / static_cast<float>(segments);
    float control = 4.0f / 3.0f * std::tan(step * 0.25f);

    float angle = start;
    float pointX = centreX + radiusX * std::cos(angle);
    float pointY = centreY + radiusY * std::sin(angle);

    if (moveToStart || !path.open) MoveTo(path, pointX, pointY);
    else LineTo(path, pointX, pointY);

    for (int segment = 0; segment < segments; ++segment)
    {
        float next = angle + step;

        float sineStart = std::sin(angle);
        float cosineStart = std::cos(angle);
        float sineEnd = std::sin(next);
        float cosineEnd = std::cos(next);

        float endX = centreX + radiusX * cosineEnd;
        float endY = centreY + radiusY * sineEnd;

        CubicTo(path, pointX - control * radiusX * sineStart, pointY + control * radiusY * cosineStart,
                endX + control * radiusX * sineEnd, endY - control * radiusY * cosineEnd, endX, endY);

        angle = next;
        pointX = endX;
        pointY = endY;
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::AddPath(Path& path, const Path& other, const Transform& transform)
{
    FinishContour(path, false);

    size_t base = path.points.size();
    if (base + other.points.size() > 32767) return Result::OutOfRange;

    for (size_t index = 0; index < other.points.size(); ++index)
    {
        float x = static_cast<float>(other.points[index].x) / FIXED_ONE;
        float y = static_cast<float>(other.points[index].y) / FIXED_ONE;

        float mappedX = transform.scaleX * x + transform.skewX * y + transform.translateX;
        float mappedY = transform.skewY * x + transform.scaleY * y + transform.translateY;

        FT_Vector point;
        point.x = ToFixed(mappedX);
        point.y = ToFixed(mappedY);

        path.points.push_back(point);
        path.tags.push_back(other.tags[index]);
    }

    for (short contour : other.contours) path.contours.push_back(static_cast<short>(contour + base));
    for (char closed : other.closed) path.closed.push_back(closed);

    if (other.open && !other.points.empty())
    {
        path.contours.push_back(static_cast<short>(path.points.size() - 1));
        path.closed.push_back(0);
    }

    path.contourStart = static_cast<int32_t>(path.points.size());
    path.open = false;

    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::TransformPath(Path& path, const Transform& transform)
{
    for (FT_Vector& point : path.points)
    {
        float x = static_cast<float>(point.x) / FIXED_ONE;
        float y = static_cast<float>(point.y) / FIXED_ONE;

        point.x = ToFixed(transform.scaleX * x + transform.skewX * y + transform.translateX);
        point.y = ToFixed(transform.skewY * x + transform.scaleY * y + transform.translateY);
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

static void EmitPoint(std::vector<float>& points, float x, float y)
{
    points.push_back(x);
    points.push_back(y);
}

static void EmitQuadratic(std::vector<float>& points, float fromX, float fromY, float controlX, float controlY, float toX,
                          float toY)
{
    for (int step = 1; step <= FLATTEN_STEPS; ++step)
    {
        float amount = static_cast<float>(step) / FLATTEN_STEPS;
        float inverse = 1.0f - amount;

        float x = inverse * inverse * fromX + 2.0f * inverse * amount * controlX + amount * amount * toX;
        float y = inverse * inverse * fromY + 2.0f * inverse * amount * controlY + amount * amount * toY;

        EmitPoint(points, x, y);
    }
}

static void EmitCubic(std::vector<float>& points, float fromX, float fromY, float firstX, float firstY, float secondX,
                      float secondY, float toX, float toY)
{
    for (int step = 1; step <= FLATTEN_STEPS; ++step)
    {
        float amount = static_cast<float>(step) / FLATTEN_STEPS;
        float inverse = 1.0f - amount;

        float x = inverse * inverse * inverse * fromX + 3.0f * inverse * inverse * amount * firstX
                  + 3.0f * inverse * amount * amount * secondX + amount * amount * amount * toX;
        float y = inverse * inverse * inverse * fromY + 3.0f * inverse * inverse * amount * firstY
                  + 3.0f * inverse * amount * amount * secondY + amount * amount * amount * toY;

        EmitPoint(points, x, y);
    }
}

void RasterizerFlattenPath(const Rasterizer::Path& path, std::vector<float>& points, std::vector<int32_t>& starts)
{
    points.clear();
    starts.clear();

    std::vector<int32_t> ends(path.contours.begin(), path.contours.end());
    std::vector<char> closedFlags(path.closed.begin(), path.closed.end());

    if (path.open && !path.points.empty())
    {
        ends.push_back(static_cast<int32_t>(path.points.size()) - 1);
        closedFlags.push_back(0);
    }

    int32_t first = 0;

    for (size_t contour = 0; contour < ends.size(); ++contour)
    {
        int32_t last = ends[contour];
        if (last < first)
        {
            first = last + 1;
            continue;
        }

        starts.push_back(static_cast<int32_t>(points.size() / 2));

        float currentX = static_cast<float>(path.points[first].x) / FIXED_ONE;
        float currentY = static_cast<float>(path.points[first].y) / FIXED_ONE;
        EmitPoint(points, currentX, currentY);

        int32_t index = first + 1;
        while (index <= last)
        {
            char tag = static_cast<char>(path.tags[index] & 3);

            float x = static_cast<float>(path.points[index].x) / FIXED_ONE;
            float y = static_cast<float>(path.points[index].y) / FIXED_ONE;

            if (tag == FT_CURVE_TAG_ON)
            {
                EmitPoint(points, x, y);
                currentX = x;
                currentY = y;
                index += 1;
                continue;
            }

            if (tag == FT_CURVE_TAG_CONIC && index + 1 <= last)
            {
                float endX = static_cast<float>(path.points[index + 1].x) / FIXED_ONE;
                float endY = static_cast<float>(path.points[index + 1].y) / FIXED_ONE;

                EmitQuadratic(points, currentX, currentY, x, y, endX, endY);
                currentX = endX;
                currentY = endY;
                index += 2;
                continue;
            }

            if (index + 2 <= last)
            {
                float secondX = static_cast<float>(path.points[index + 1].x) / FIXED_ONE;
                float secondY = static_cast<float>(path.points[index + 1].y) / FIXED_ONE;
                float endX = static_cast<float>(path.points[index + 2].x) / FIXED_ONE;
                float endY = static_cast<float>(path.points[index + 2].y) / FIXED_ONE;

                EmitCubic(points, currentX, currentY, x, y, secondX, secondY, endX, endY);
                currentX = endX;
                currentY = endY;
                index += 3;
                continue;
            }

            break;
        }

        bool closed = contour < closedFlags.size() && closedFlags[contour] != 0;
        if (closed)
        {
            EmitPoint(points, static_cast<float>(path.points[first].x) / FIXED_ONE,
                      static_cast<float>(path.points[first].y) / FIXED_ONE);
        }

        first = last + 1;
    }

    starts.push_back(static_cast<int32_t>(points.size() / 2));
}

static FT_Vector MapPoint(const FT_Vector& point, const Rasterizer::Transform& transform)
{
    float x = static_cast<float>(point.x) / FIXED_ONE;
    float y = static_cast<float>(point.y) / FIXED_ONE;

    FT_Vector mapped;
    mapped.x = ToFixed(transform.scaleX * x + transform.skewX * y + transform.translateX);
    mapped.y = ToFixed(transform.skewY * x + transform.scaleY * y + transform.translateY);

    return mapped;
}

static bool SamePoint(const FT_Vector& first, const FT_Vector& second)
{
    return first.x == second.x && first.y == second.y;
}

static bool WithinShortCurve(const FT_Vector& from, const FT_Vector& point)
{
    return std::labs(point.x - from.x) < SHORT_CURVE_UNITS && std::labs(point.y - from.y) < SHORT_CURVE_UNITS;
}

bool RasterizerFeedStroker(const Rasterizer::Path& path, const Rasterizer::Transform& transform, FT_Stroker stroker)
{
    std::vector<int32_t> ends(path.contours.begin(), path.contours.end());
    std::vector<char> closedFlags(path.closed.begin(), path.closed.end());

    if (path.open && !path.points.empty())
    {
        ends.push_back(static_cast<int32_t>(path.points.size()) - 1);
        closedFlags.push_back(0);
    }

    if (ends.empty()) return false;

    bool fed = false;
    int32_t first = 0;

    for (size_t contour = 0; contour < ends.size(); ++contour)
    {
        int32_t last = ends[contour];
        if (last <= first)
        {
            first = last + 1;
            continue;
        }

        bool closed = contour < closedFlags.size() && closedFlags[contour] != 0;

        FT_Vector start = MapPoint(path.points[first], transform);

        bool extent = false;
        for (int32_t index = first + 1; index <= last && !extent; ++index)
        {
            FT_Vector point = MapPoint(path.points[index], transform);
            extent = point.x != start.x || point.y != start.y;
        }

        if (!extent)
        {
            first = last + 1;
            continue;
        }

        if (FT_Stroker_BeginSubPath(stroker, &start, closed ? 0 : 1) != 0)
        {
            first = last + 1;
            continue;
        }

        FT_Vector current = start;
        bool emitted = false;

        int32_t index = first + 1;
        while (index <= last)
        {
            char tag = static_cast<char>(path.tags[index] & 3);
            FT_Vector point = MapPoint(path.points[index], transform);

            if (tag == FT_CURVE_TAG_ON)
            {
                if (!SamePoint(point, current))
                {
                    FT_Stroker_LineTo(stroker, &point);
                    current = point;
                    emitted = true;
                }

                index += 1;
                continue;
            }

            if (tag == FT_CURVE_TAG_CONIC && index + 1 <= last)
            {
                FT_Vector end = MapPoint(path.points[index + 1], transform);

                if (!WithinShortCurve(current, point) || !WithinShortCurve(current, end))
                {
                    FT_Stroker_ConicTo(stroker, &point, &end);
                    current = end;
                    emitted = true;
                }
                else if (!SamePoint(end, current))
                {
                    FT_Stroker_LineTo(stroker, &end);
                    current = end;
                    emitted = true;
                }

                index += 2;
                continue;
            }

            if (index + 2 <= last)
            {
                FT_Vector second = MapPoint(path.points[index + 1], transform);
                FT_Vector end = MapPoint(path.points[index + 2], transform);

                if (!WithinShortCurve(current, point) || !WithinShortCurve(current, second) || !WithinShortCurve(current, end))
                {
                    FT_Stroker_CubicTo(stroker, &point, &second, &end);
                    current = end;
                    emitted = true;
                }
                else if (!SamePoint(end, current))
                {
                    FT_Stroker_LineTo(stroker, &end);
                    current = end;
                    emitted = true;
                }

                index += 3;
                continue;
            }

            break;
        }

        if (!emitted)
        {
            FT_Vector farthest = start;
            FT_Pos reach = 0;

            for (int32_t candidate = first + 1; candidate <= last; ++candidate)
            {
                FT_Vector point = MapPoint(path.points[candidate], transform);
                FT_Pos distance = std::labs(point.x - start.x) + std::labs(point.y - start.y);
                if (distance <= reach) continue;

                reach = distance;
                farthest = point;
            }

            FT_Stroker_LineTo(stroker, &farthest);
        }

        FT_Stroker_EndSubPath(stroker);
        fed = true;
        first = last + 1;
    }

    return fed;
}

void Rasterizer::CurrentPoint(const Path& path, float& x, float& y)
{
    x = path.currentX;
    y = path.currentY;
}

bool Rasterizer::PathBounds(const Path& path, float& left, float& top, float& right, float& bottom)
{
    if (path.points.empty()) return false;

    left = right = static_cast<float>(path.points[0].x) / FIXED_ONE;
    top = bottom = static_cast<float>(path.points[0].y) / FIXED_ONE;

    for (const FT_Vector& point : path.points)
    {
        float x = static_cast<float>(point.x) / FIXED_ONE;
        float y = static_cast<float>(point.y) / FIXED_ONE;

        if (x < left) left = x;
        if (x > right) right = x;
        if (y < top) top = y;
        if (y > bottom) bottom = y;
    }

    return true;
}

bool RasterizerBuildOutline(const Rasterizer::Path& path, const Rasterizer::Transform& transform, FT_Outline& outline,
                            std::vector<FT_Vector>& points, std::vector<char>& tags, std::vector<short>& contours)
{
    points.clear();
    tags.clear();
    contours.clear();

    points.reserve(path.points.size());
    tags.reserve(path.tags.size());
    contours.reserve(path.contours.size() + 1);

    for (size_t index = 0; index < path.points.size(); ++index)
    {
        float x = static_cast<float>(path.points[index].x) / FIXED_ONE;
        float y = static_cast<float>(path.points[index].y) / FIXED_ONE;

        float mappedX = transform.scaleX * x + transform.skewX * y + transform.translateX;
        float mappedY = transform.skewY * x + transform.scaleY * y + transform.translateY;

        FT_Vector point;
        point.x = ToFixed(mappedX);
        point.y = ToFixed(mappedY);

        points.push_back(point);
        tags.push_back(path.tags[index]);
    }

    contours = path.contours;

    if (path.open && !points.empty()) contours.push_back(static_cast<short>(points.size() - 1));

    if (points.empty() || contours.empty()) return false;

    outline.n_points = static_cast<short>(points.size());
    outline.n_contours = static_cast<short>(contours.size());
    outline.points = points.data();
    outline.tags = reinterpret_cast<unsigned char*>(tags.data());
    outline.contours = reinterpret_cast<unsigned short*>(contours.data());
    outline.flags = FT_OUTLINE_NONE;

    return true;
}

FT_Library RasterizerOutlineLibrary()
{
    return OutlineLibrary();
}
```

`src/Rasterizer/VectorState.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Rasterizer/Rasterizer.hpp"

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

uint32_t RasterizerBlendPixel(Rasterizer::BlendMode blend, uint32_t premultiplied, uint32_t destination, uint32_t coverage);
void RasterizerFlattenPath(const Rasterizer::Path& path, std::vector<float>& points, std::vector<int32_t>& starts);

Rasterizer::Transform Rasterizer::Multiply(const Transform& outer, const Transform& inner)
{
    Transform result;

    result.scaleX = outer.scaleX * inner.scaleX + outer.skewX * inner.skewY;
    result.skewY = outer.skewY * inner.scaleX + outer.scaleY * inner.skewY;
    result.skewX = outer.scaleX * inner.skewX + outer.skewX * inner.scaleY;
    result.scaleY = outer.skewY * inner.skewX + outer.scaleY * inner.scaleY;
    result.translateX = outer.scaleX * inner.translateX + outer.skewX * inner.translateY + outer.translateX;
    result.translateY = outer.skewY * inner.translateX + outer.scaleY * inner.translateY + outer.translateY;

    return result;
}

bool Rasterizer::Invert(const Transform& transform, Transform& inverse)
{
    float determinant = transform.scaleX * transform.scaleY - transform.skewX * transform.skewY;
    if (std::fabs(determinant) < 1e-9f) return false;

    float reciprocal = 1.0f / determinant;

    inverse.scaleX = transform.scaleY * reciprocal;
    inverse.skewY = -transform.skewY * reciprocal;
    inverse.skewX = -transform.skewX * reciprocal;
    inverse.scaleY = transform.scaleX * reciprocal;
    inverse.translateX = (transform.skewX * transform.translateY - transform.scaleY * transform.translateX) * reciprocal;
    inverse.translateY = (transform.skewY * transform.translateX - transform.scaleX * transform.translateY) * reciprocal;

    return true;
}

const Rasterizer::Transform& Rasterizer::CurrentTransform(const Canvas& canvas)
{
    static const Transform IDENTITY;
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return IDENTITY;

    return StateAt(canvas, canvas.depth - 1).transform;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::Concat(Canvas& canvas, const Transform& transform)
{
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;

    State& state = TopState(canvas);
    state.transform = Multiply(state.transform, transform);

    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::SetTransform(Canvas& canvas, const Transform& transform)
{
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;

    TopState(canvas).transform = transform;
    return Result::Ok;
}

static Rasterizer::ClipMask* AllocateMask(int32_t width, int32_t height)
{
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return nullptr;

    Rasterizer::ClipMask* mask = new Rasterizer::ClipMask();
    mask->width = width;
    mask->height = height;
    mask->references = 1;
    mask->samples = static_cast<uint8_t*>(std::calloc(static_cast<size_t>(width) * height, 1));

    if (!mask->samples)
    {
        delete mask;
        return nullptr;
    }

    return mask;
}

void RasterizerRetainMask(Rasterizer::ClipMask* mask)
{
    if (mask) mask->references += 1;
}

void RasterizerReleaseMask(Rasterizer::ClipMask* mask)
{
    if (!mask) return;

    mask->references -= 1;
    if (mask->references > 0) return;

    std::free(mask->samples);
    delete mask;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::ClipPath(Canvas& canvas, const Path& path, FillRule rule, bool subtract)
{
    if (!canvas.surface.pixels) return Result::InvalidSurface;
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;

    int32_t width = static_cast<int32_t>(canvas.surface.width);
    int32_t height = static_cast<int32_t>(canvas.surface.height);

    ClipMask* built = AllocateMask(width, height);
    if (!built) return Result::AllocationFailed;

    Surface maskSurface;
    maskSurface.pixels = static_cast<uint8_t*>(std::calloc(static_cast<size_t>(width) * height * BYTES_PER_PIXEL, 1));
    maskSurface.width = static_cast<uint32_t>(width);
    maskSurface.height = static_cast<uint32_t>(height);
    maskSurface.stride = static_cast<uint32_t>(width) * BYTES_PER_PIXEL;

    if (!maskSurface.pixels)
    {
        RasterizerReleaseMask(built);
        return Result::AllocationFailed;
    }

    Canvas scratch;
    scratch.surface = maskSurface;
    scratch.depth = 1;
    scratch.stack[0].clip = Rect{0, 0, width, height};
    scratch.stack[0].transform = StateAt(canvas, canvas.depth - 1).transform;
    scratch.stack[0].mask = nullptr;

    Source white;
    white.kind = SourceKind::Solid;
    white.color = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    Result drawn = FillPath(scratch, path, white, rule, BlendMode::Source, 255);

    if (drawn == Result::Ok)
    {
        State& state = TopState(canvas);

        for (int32_t y = 0; y < height; ++y)
        {
            const uint32_t* row = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(maskSurface.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * maskSurface.stride);

            for (int32_t x = 0; x < width; ++x)
            {
                uint32_t coverage = (row[x] >> 24) & 0xFFu;
                if (subtract) coverage = 255 - coverage;

                uint32_t existing = 255;
                if (state.mask) existing = state.mask->samples[static_cast<size_t>(y) * state.mask->width + x];
                else if (x < state.clip.left || x >= state.clip.right || y < state.clip.top || y >= state.clip.bottom) existing = 0;

                built->samples[static_cast<size_t>(y) * width + x] =
                    static_cast<uint8_t>((coverage * existing + 127) / 255);
            }
        }

        RasterizerReleaseMask(state.mask);
        state.mask = built;
    }
    else
    {
        RasterizerReleaseMask(built);
    }

    std::free(maskSurface.pixels);
    return drawn;
}

static Rasterizer::Rect MapBounds(const Rasterizer::Transform& transform, const Rasterizer::Rect& bounds)
{
    float cornerX[4] = {static_cast<float>(bounds.left), static_cast<float>(bounds.right),
                        static_cast<float>(bounds.right), static_cast<float>(bounds.left)};
    float cornerY[4] = {static_cast<float>(bounds.top), static_cast<float>(bounds.top),
                        static_cast<float>(bounds.bottom), static_cast<float>(bounds.bottom)};

    float left = 0.0f;
    float top = 0.0f;
    float right = 0.0f;
    float bottom = 0.0f;

    for (int index = 0; index < 4; ++index)
    {
        float x = transform.scaleX * cornerX[index] + transform.skewX * cornerY[index] + transform.translateX;
        float y = transform.skewY * cornerX[index] + transform.scaleY * cornerY[index] + transform.translateY;

        if (index == 0)
        {
            left = right = x;
            top = bottom = y;
            continue;
        }

        if (x < left) left = x;
        if (x > right) right = x;
        if (y < top) top = y;
        if (y > bottom) bottom = y;
    }

    Rasterizer::Rect mapped;
    mapped.left = static_cast<int32_t>(std::floor(left));
    mapped.top = static_cast<int32_t>(std::floor(top));
    mapped.right = static_cast<int32_t>(std::ceil(right));
    mapped.bottom = static_cast<int32_t>(std::ceil(bottom));

    return mapped;
}

struct Rasterizer::Layer
{
    Surface parent;
    Surface offscreen;
    Rect bounds;
    int depth = 0;
    uint8_t alpha = 255;
    BlendMode blend = BlendMode::SourceOver;
};

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::SaveLayer(Canvas& canvas, const Rect& bounds, uint8_t alpha, BlendMode blend)
{
    if (!canvas.surface.pixels) return Result::InvalidSurface;
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;

    Rect surfaceBounds{0, 0, static_cast<int32_t>(canvas.surface.width), static_cast<int32_t>(canvas.surface.height)};
    Rect area = Intersect(Intersect(MapBounds(TopState(canvas).transform, bounds), TopState(canvas).clip), surfaceBounds);

    if (canvas.layerCount >= canvas.layerCapacity)
    {
        int capacity = canvas.layerCapacity > 0 ? canvas.layerCapacity * 2 : 4;
        Layer* grown = static_cast<Layer*>(std::realloc(canvas.layers, sizeof(Layer) * capacity));
        if (!grown) return Result::AllocationFailed;

        canvas.layers = grown;
        canvas.layerCapacity = capacity;
    }

    Surface offscreen;
    if (CreateSurface(canvas.surface.width, canvas.surface.height, offscreen) != Result::Ok) return Result::AllocationFailed;

    std::memset(offscreen.pixels, 0, static_cast<size_t>(offscreen.stride) * offscreen.height);

    if (Save(canvas) != Result::Ok)
    {
        DestroySurface(offscreen);
        return Result::StateStackOverflow;
    }

    Layer& layer = canvas.layers[canvas.layerCount];
    layer.parent = canvas.surface;
    layer.offscreen = offscreen;
    layer.bounds = area;
    layer.depth = canvas.depth - 1;
    layer.alpha = alpha;
    layer.blend = blend;
    canvas.layerCount += 1;

    canvas.surface = offscreen;
    TopState(canvas).clip = area;

    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::RestoreLayer(Canvas& canvas)
{
    if (canvas.layerCount < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;

    Layer layer = canvas.layers[canvas.layerCount - 1];
    canvas.layerCount -= 1;

    while (canvas.depth > layer.depth + 1) Restore(canvas);

    RasterizerReleaseMask(TopState(canvas).mask);
    TopState(canvas).mask = nullptr;

    canvas.surface = layer.parent;
    canvas.depth = layer.depth;

    for (int32_t y = layer.bounds.top; y < layer.bounds.bottom; ++y)
    {
        const uint32_t* source =
            reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(layer.offscreen.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * layer.offscreen.stride);
        uint32_t* destination = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(layer.parent.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * layer.parent.stride);

        for (int32_t x = layer.bounds.left; x < layer.bounds.right; ++x)
        {
            destination[x] = RasterizerBlendPixel(layer.blend, source[x], destination[x], layer.alpha);
        }
    }

    DestroySurface(layer.offscreen);
    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::FillPathBlurred(Canvas& canvas, const Path& path, const Source& source, FillRule rule,
                                               BlendMode blend, uint8_t alpha, float radius)
{
    if (!canvas.surface.pixels) return Result::InvalidSurface;
    if (canvas.depth < 1) return Result::StateStackUnderflow;
    if (radius <= 0.0f) return FillPath(canvas, path, source, rule, blend, alpha);

    int32_t width = static_cast<int32_t>(canvas.surface.width);
    int32_t height = static_cast<int32_t>(canvas.surface.height);

    Surface scratch;
    if (CreateSurface(canvas.surface.width, canvas.surface.height, scratch) != Result::Ok) return Result::AllocationFailed;

    std::memset(scratch.pixels, 0, static_cast<size_t>(scratch.stride) * scratch.height);

    Canvas offscreen;
    offscreen.surface = scratch;
    offscreen.depth = 1;
    offscreen.stack[0].clip = Rect{0, 0, width, height};
    offscreen.stack[0].transform = TopState(canvas).transform;
    offscreen.stack[0].mask = nullptr;

    Source white;
    white.color = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    Result drawn = FillPath(offscreen, path, white, rule, BlendMode::Source, 255);

    if (drawn != Result::Ok)
    {
        DestroySurface(scratch);
        return drawn;
    }

    std::vector<uint8_t> coverage(static_cast<size_t>(width) * height);

    for (int32_t y = 0; y < height; ++y)
    {
        const uint32_t* row = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(scratch.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * scratch.stride);
        for (int32_t x = 0; x < width; ++x) coverage[static_cast<size_t>(y) * width + x] = (row[x] >> 24) & 0xFFu;
    }

    DestroySurface(scratch);
    BlurMask(coverage.data(), width, height, width, radius);

    Coverage mask;
    mask.samples = coverage.data();
    mask.width = width;
    mask.height = height;
    mask.pitch = width;

    return FillCoverage(canvas, mask, source, blend, alpha);
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::DashPath(const Path& source, Path& into, const float* intervals, int intervalCount,
                                        float phase)
{
    if (!intervals || intervalCount < 2) return Result::OutOfRange;

    float cycle = 0.0f;
    for (int index = 0; index < intervalCount; ++index)
    {
        if (intervals[index] < 0.0f) return Result::OutOfRange;
        cycle += intervals[index];
    }

    if (cycle <= 0.0f) return Result::OutOfRange;

    std::vector<float> points;
    std::vector<int32_t> starts;
    RasterizerFlattenPath(source, points, starts);

    int32_t slot = 0;
    float remaining = intervals[0];
    bool drawing = true;

    float walked = phase;
    while (walked > 0.0f)
    {
        if (walked < remaining)
        {
            remaining -= walked;
            break;
        }

        walked -= remaining;
        slot = (slot + 1) % intervalCount;
        remaining = intervals[slot];
        drawing = !drawing;
    }

    for (size_t contour = 0; contour + 1 < starts.size(); ++contour)
    {
        int32_t first = starts[contour];
        int32_t last = starts[contour + 1];
        bool penDown = false;

        for (int32_t index = first; index + 1 < last; ++index)
        {
            float startX = points[static_cast<size_t>(index) * 2];
            float startY = points[static_cast<size_t>(index) * 2 + 1];
            float endX = points[static_cast<size_t>(index + 1) * 2];
            float endY = points[static_cast<size_t>(index + 1) * 2 + 1];

            float deltaX = endX - startX;
            float deltaY = endY - startY;
            float length = std::sqrt(deltaX * deltaX + deltaY * deltaY);

            if (length <= 0.0f) continue;

            float travelled = 0.0f;
            while (travelled < length)
            {
                float step = length - travelled;
                if (step > remaining) step = remaining;

                float fromX = startX + deltaX * (travelled / length);
                float fromY = startY + deltaY * (travelled / length);
                float toX = startX + deltaX * ((travelled + step) / length);
                float toY = startY + deltaY * ((travelled + step) / length);

                if (drawing)
                {
                    if (!penDown)
                    {
                        MoveTo(into, fromX, fromY);
                        penDown = true;
                    }

                    LineTo(into, toX, toY);
                }
                else
                {
                    penDown = false;
                }

                travelled += step;
                remaining -= step;

                if (remaining > 0.0f) continue;

                slot = (slot + 1) % intervalCount;
                remaining = intervals[slot];
                drawing = !drawing;
                penDown = false;
            }
        }
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

Rasterizer::Result Rasterizer::BlurMask(uint8_t* samples, int32_t width, int32_t height, int32_t pitch, float radius)
{
    if (!samples || width <= 0 || height <= 0) return Result::OutOfRange;

    int32_t span = static_cast<int32_t>(radius);
    if (span < 1) return Result::Ok;

    std::vector<uint8_t> scratch(static_cast<size_t>(width) * height);

    for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass)
    {
        for (int32_t y = 0; y < height; ++y)
        {
            uint8_t* row = samples + static_cast<size_t>(y) * pitch;

            for (int32_t x = 0; x < width; ++x)
            {
                int32_t total = 0;
                int32_t count = 0;

                for (int32_t offset = -span; offset <= span; ++offset)
                {
                    int32_t sample = x + offset;
                    if (sample < 0 || sample >= width) continue;

                    total += row[sample];
                    count += 1;
                }

                scratch[static_cast<size_t>(y) * width + x] = static_cast<uint8_t>(count == 0 ? 0 : total / count);
            }
        }

        for (int32_t x = 0; x < width; ++x)
        {
            for (int32_t y = 0; y < height; ++y)
            {
                int32_t total = 0;
                int32_t count = 0;

                for (int32_t offset = -span; offset <= span; ++offset)
                {
                    int32_t sample = y + offset;
                    if (sample < 0 || sample >= height) continue;

                    total += scratch[static_cast<size_t>(sample) * width + x];
                    count += 1;
                }

                samples[static_cast<size_t>(y) * pitch + x] = static_cast<uint8_t>(count == 0 ? 0 : total / count);
            }
        }
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}
```

```cpp
#include "Sandbox/Sandbox.hpp"

#include <cerrno>
#include <climits>
```
