```cpp
#define MOVE_MOUNT_F_EMPTY_PATH 0x00000004
#endif

static constexpr const char* MERGED_DIRECTORIES[] = {"/lib", "/lib64", "/bin", "/sbin"};
static constexpr const char* WORK_DIRECTORY = "/tmp";
static constexpr const char* REPLACEMENT_ROOT_LEAF = "root";
static constexpr const char* DISPLACED_ROOT_LEAF = ".displaced";
static constexpr const char* RESOURCE_GROUP_ROOT = "/sys/fs/cgroup";
static constexpr const char* EXTERNAL_STORAGE_ROOT = "/storage/emulated/0";

struct AttachRequest
{
    int descriptor;
    std::string path;
    bool readOnly;
    bool directory;
};

struct MergedLink
{
    std::string path;
    std::string destination;
};

static bool WriteControlFile(const std::string& path, const std::string& contents)
{
    int descriptor = open(path.c_str(), O_WRONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (descriptor < 0) return false;

    bool written = write(descriptor, contents.data(), contents.size()) == (ssize_t)contents.size();

    close(descriptor);
    return written;
}

static std::string OwnResourceGroup()
{
    FILE* handle = fopen("/proc/self/cgroup", "r");
    if (!handle) return std::string();

    char line[PATH_MAX];
    if (!fgets(line, sizeof(line), handle))
    {
        fclose(handle);
        return std::string();
    }

    fclose(handle);

    std::string described = line;
    while (!described.empty() && (described.back() == '\n' || described.back() == '\r')) described.pop_back();

    size_t marker = described.find("::");
    if (marker == std::string::npos) return std::string();

    return described.substr(marker + 2);
}

static void SweepAbandonedResourceGroups(const std::string& parent)
{
    DIR* handle = opendir(parent.c_str());
    if (!handle) return;

    for (dirent* entry = readdir(handle); entry; entry = readdir(handle))
    {
        if (strncmp(entry->d_name, "acl-", 4) != 0) continue;

        rmdir((parent + "/" + entry->d_name).c_str());
    }

    closedir(handle);
}

static std::string CreateResourceGroup(const Sandbox::Isolation& isolation, Sandbox::IsolationReport& report, int& parentDescriptor,
                                       std::string& leafName)
{
    parentDescriptor = -1;
    leafName.clear();

    if (isolation.memoryBytes == 0 && isolation.processLimit == 0) return std::string();

    std::string relative = OwnResourceGroup();
    if (relative.empty()) return std::string();

    std::string leaf = "/acl-" + std::to_string((unsigned long long)getpid());

    while (!relative.empty() && relative != "/")
    {
        SweepAbandonedResourceGroups(RESOURCE_GROUP_ROOT + relative);

        std::string candidate = RESOURCE_GROUP_ROOT + relative + leaf;

        if (mkdir(candidate.c_str(), 0755) == 0 || errno == EEXIST)
        {
            bool capped = false;

            if (isolation.memoryBytes != 0 &&
                WriteControlFile(candidate + "/memory.max", std::to_string(isolation.memoryBytes)))
            {
                report.memoryCeilingBytes = isolation.memoryBytes;
                capped = true;
            }

            if (isolation.processLimit != 0 &&
                WriteControlFile(candidate + "/pids.max", std::to_string(isolation.processLimit)))
            {
                report.processCeiling = isolation.processLimit;
                capped = true;
            }

            if (capped)
            {
                parentDescriptor = open((RESOURCE_GROUP_ROOT + relative).c_str(), O_DIRECTORY | O_CLOEXEC);
                leafName = leaf.substr(1);
                return candidate;
            }

            rmdir(candidate.c_str());
        }

        size_t slash = relative.find_last_of('/');
        if (slash == std::string::npos) break;

        relative = relative.substr(0, slash);
    }

    return std::string();
}

static void EnterResourceGroup(const std::string& group, Sandbox::IsolationReport& report)
{
    if (group.empty()) return;

    if (!WriteControlFile(group + "/cgroup.procs", "0"))
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot join the resource group: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        report.memoryCeilingBytes = 0;
        report.processCeiling = 0;
        return;
    }

    report.resourcesGrouped = true;
}

static bool WriteIdentityFile(const char* path, const char* contents)
{
    int descriptor = open(path, O_WRONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (descriptor < 0) return false;

    size_t length = strlen(contents);
    bool written = write(descriptor, contents, length) == (ssize_t)length;

    close(descriptor);
    return written;
}

static bool MakeDirectories(const std::string& path)
{
    if (path.empty() || path == "/") return true;

    std::string built;
    size_t index = 0;

    while (index < path.size())
    {
        size_t slash = path.find('/', index + 1);
        if (slash == std::string::npos) slash = path.size();

        built = path.substr(0, slash);
        if (!built.empty() && mkdir(built.c_str(), 0755) != 0 && errno != EEXIST) return false;

        index = slash;
    }

    return true;
}

static bool MakeParentDirectories(const std::string& path)
{
    size_t slash = path.find_last_of('/');
    if (slash == std::string::npos || slash == 0) return true;

    return MakeDirectories(path.substr(0, slash));
}

static void RememberSource(std::vector<AttachRequest>& requests, const std::string& path, bool readOnly,
                           Sandbox::IsolationReport& report)
{
    struct stat details;
    if (stat(path.c_str(), &details) != 0)
    {
        report.pathsMissing += 1;
        return;
    }

    requests.push_back({-1, path, readOnly, S_ISDIR(details.st_mode) != 0});
}

static void CaptureSources(std::vector<AttachRequest>& requests)
{
    for (AttachRequest& request : requests)
    {
        request.descriptor =
            (int)syscall(SYS_open_tree, AT_FDCWD, request.path.c_str(), OPEN_TREE_CLONE | AT_RECURSIVE | O_CLOEXEC);
    }
}

static void RestrictToReadOnly(const std::string& target, const std::string& path)
{
    unsigned long carried = MS_BIND | MS_REMOUNT | MS_RDONLY;

    struct statvfs attached;
    if (statvfs(target.c_str(), &attached) == 0)
    {
        if (attached.f_flag & ST_NOSUID) carried |= MS_NOSUID;
        if (attached.f_flag & ST_NODEV) carried |= MS_NODEV;
        if (attached.f_flag & ST_NOEXEC) carried |= MS_NOEXEC;
        if (attached.f_flag & ST_NOATIME) carried |= MS_NOATIME;
        if (attached.f_flag & ST_NODIRATIME) carried |= MS_NODIRATIME;
        if (attached.f_flag & ST_RELATIME) carried |= MS_RELATIME;
    }

    if (mount(nullptr, target.c_str(), nullptr, carried, nullptr) != 0)
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] %s stays writable: %s\n", path.c_str(), strerror(errno));
}

static bool AttachRemembered(const std::string& newRoot, const AttachRequest& request, Sandbox::IsolationReport& report)
{
    std::string target = newRoot + request.path;

    if (request.directory)
    {
        if (!MakeDirectories(target)) return false;
    }
    else
    {
        if (!MakeParentDirectories(target)) return false;

        int placeholder = open(target.c_str(), O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_CLOEXEC, 0644);
        if (placeholder < 0 && errno != EEXIST) return false;
        if (placeholder >= 0) close(placeholder);
    }

    bool attached = false;

    if (request.descriptor >= 0)
    {
        attached = syscall(SYS_move_mount, request.descriptor, "", AT_FDCWD, target.c_str(), MOVE_MOUNT_F_EMPTY_PATH) == 0;
        if (!attached)
            fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot place the captured %s: %s\n", request.path.c_str(), strerror(errno));
    }

    if (!attached && mount(request.path.c_str(), target.c_str(), nullptr, MS_BIND | MS_REC, nullptr) != 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot attach %s: %s\n", request.path.c_str(), strerror(errno));
        return false;
    }

    if (request.readOnly) RestrictToReadOnly(target, request.path);

    report.pathsAttached += 1;
    return true;
}

static bool rootWasReplaced = false;

static bool AttachOver(const std::string& source, const std::string& target)
{
    if (!MakeDirectories(target)) return false;

    if (mount(source.c_str(), target.c_str(), nullptr, MS_BIND | MS_REC, nullptr) != 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot place %s at %s: %s\n", source.c_str(), target.c_str(), strerror(errno));
        return false;
    }

    return true;
}

bool Sandbox::RootWasReplaced()
{
    return rootWasReplaced;
}

static std::string ScrambledName(const std::string& seed, uint64_t salt)
{
    static const char ALPHABET[] = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_";

    uint64_t state = 1469598103934665603ull ^ salt;
    for (char letter : seed)
    {
        state ^= (uint64_t)(unsigned char)letter;
        state *= 1099511628211ull;
    }

    std::string scrambled;
    for (int index = 0; index < 22; ++index)
    {
        scrambled += ALPHABET[state & 63];
        state = state * 6364136223846793005ull + 1442695040888963407ull;
    }

    return scrambled + "==";
}

static bool AttachFileOver(const std::string& source, const std::string& target)
{
    if (!MakeParentDirectories(target)) return false;

    int placeholder = open(target.c_str(), O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_CLOEXEC, 0644);
    if (placeholder < 0 && errno != EEXIST) return false;
    if (placeholder >= 0) close(placeholder);

    if (mount(source.c_str(), target.c_str(), nullptr, MS_BIND, nullptr) != 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot place %s at %s: %s\n", source.c_str(), target.c_str(), strerror(errno));
        return false;
    }

    return true;
}

Sandbox::Result Sandbox::AttachSystemFile(const std::string& path, const std::string& contents)
{
    if (!rootWasReplaced) return Result::Unsupported;

    std::string backing = std::string(WORK_DIRECTORY) + "/described";
    if (!MakeDirectories(backing)) return Result::RootBuildFailed;

    size_t slash = path.find_last_of('/');
    backing += slash == std::string::npos ? path : path.substr(slash);

    int descriptor = open(backing.c_str(), O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC | O_CLOEXEC, 0444);
    if (descriptor < 0) return Result::RootBuildFailed;

    bool written = write(descriptor, contents.data(), contents.size()) == (ssize_t)contents.size();
    close(descriptor);

    if (!written) return Result::RootBuildFailed;

    if (mount(backing.c_str(), path.c_str(), nullptr, MS_BIND, nullptr) != 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot describe %s to the guest: %s\n", path.c_str(), strerror(errno));
        return Result::RootBuildFailed;
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

Sandbox::Result Sandbox::AttachAndroidTree(const AndroidTree& tree, AndroidPaths& paths)
{
    if (!rootWasReplaced) return Result::Unsupported;
    if (tree.packageName.empty() || tree.dataDirectory.empty()) return Result::NoPaths;

    std::string installed = "/data/app/~~" + ScrambledName(tree.packageName, 1) + "/" + tree.packageName + "-" +
                            ScrambledName(tree.packageName, 2);

    if (!tree.archivePath.empty() && AttachFileOver(tree.archivePath, installed + "/base.apk"))
    {
        paths.archivePath = installed + "/base.apk";
    }

    if (!tree.libraryDirectory.empty() && AttachOver(tree.libraryDirectory, installed + "/lib/arm64"))
    {
        paths.libraryDirectory = installed + "/lib/arm64";
    }

    std::string packageData = "/data/data/" + tree.packageName;

    if (!AttachOver(tree.dataDirectory, packageData)) return Result::RootBuildFailed;
    if (!AttachOver(tree.dataDirectory, "/data/user/0/" + tree.packageName)) return Result::RootBuildFailed;

    if (!tree.externalDirectory.empty())
    {
        if (!AttachOver(tree.externalDirectory, EXTERNAL_STORAGE_ROOT)) return Result::RootBuildFailed;

        MakeDirectories("/storage/self");
        MakeDirectories("/mnt");

        if (symlink(EXTERNAL_STORAGE_ROOT, "/storage/self/primary") != 0 && errno != EEXIST)
            fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] the primary storage link is missing: %s\n", strerror(errno));

        if (symlink("/storage/self/primary", "/sdcard") != 0 && errno != EEXIST)
            fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] the sdcard link is missing: %s\n", strerror(errno));

        if (symlink(EXTERNAL_STORAGE_ROOT, "/mnt/sdcard") != 0 && errno != EEXIST)
            fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] the mounted sdcard link is missing: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

bool Sandbox::IsolationSupported()
{
    int probe = open("/proc/self/uid_map", O_WRONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (probe < 0) return false;

    close(probe);
    return true;
}

Sandbox::Result Sandbox::Isolate(const Isolation& isolation, IsolationReport& report)
{
    uid_t user = getuid();
    gid_t group = getgid();

    std::vector<AttachRequest> requests;
    std::vector<MergedLink> links;

    for (const std::string& path : isolation.readablePaths) RememberSource(requests, path, true, report);
    for (const std::string& path : isolation.writablePaths) RememberSource(requests, path, false, report);

    for (const char* path : MERGED_DIRECTORIES)
    {
        char destination[PATH_MAX];
        ssize_t length = readlink(path, destination, sizeof(destination) - 1);

        if (length > 0)
        {
            destination[length] = '\0';
            links.push_back({path, destination});
            continue;
        }

        RememberSource(requests, path, true, report);
    }

    size_t deviceFirst = requests.size();
    for (const std::string& path : isolation.devicePaths) RememberSource(requests, path, false, report);

    int resourceGroupParent = -1;
    std::string resourceGroupLeaf;
    std::string resourceGroup = CreateResourceGroup(isolation, report, resourceGroupParent, resourceGroupLeaf);

    int wanted = CLONE_NEWUSER | CLONE_NEWNS | CLONE_NEWIPC | CLONE_NEWUTS;
    if (!isolation.allowNetwork) wanted |= CLONE_NEWNET;
    if (isolation.separateProcessTable) wanted |= CLONE_NEWPID;

    if (unshare(wanted) != 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot create namespaces: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return Result::NamespaceFailed;
    }

    report.userNamespace = true;
    report.mountNamespace = true;
    report.networkNamespace = !isolation.allowNetwork;
    report.processNamespace = isolation.separateProcessTable;

    char identity[64];

    unsigned insideUser = isolation.applicationUserId != 0 ? isolation.applicationUserId : (unsigned)user;
    unsigned insideGroup = isolation.applicationUserId != 0 ? isolation.applicationUserId : (unsigned)group;

    WriteIdentityFile("/proc/self/setgroups", "deny");

    snprintf(identity, sizeof(identity), "%u %u 1", insideUser, (unsigned)user);
    if (!WriteIdentityFile("/proc/self/uid_map", identity)) return Result::IdentityMapFailed;

    snprintf(identity, sizeof(identity), "%u %u 1", insideGroup, (unsigned)group);
    if (!WriteIdentityFile("/proc/self/gid_map", identity)) return Result::IdentityMapFailed;

    if (isolation.separateProcessTable)
    {
        pid_t player = fork();
        if (player < 0)
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot enter the process table: %s\n", strerror(errno));
            return Result::NamespaceFailed;
        }

        if (player != 0)
        {
            int state = 0;
            while (waitpid(player, &state, 0) < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;

            if (resourceGroupParent >= 0 && unlinkat(resourceGroupParent, resourceGroupLeaf.c_str(), AT_REMOVEDIR) != 0)
                fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] the resource group %s outlived the run: %s\n", resourceGroupLeaf.c_str(), strerror(errno));

            if (WIFSIGNALED(state)) _exit(128 + WTERMSIG(state));
            _exit(WIFEXITED(state) ? WEXITSTATUS(state) : 1);
        }
    }

    EnterResourceGroup(resourceGroup, report);
    unshare(CLONE_NEWCGROUP);

    if (mount(nullptr, "/", nullptr, MS_REC | MS_PRIVATE, nullptr) != 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot detach the mount tree: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return Result::RootBuildFailed;
    }

    CaptureSources(requests);

    if (mount("acl",WORK_DIRECTORY, "tmpfs", MS_NOSUID | MS_NODEV, "mode=755") != 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot create a private work directory: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return Result::RootBuildFailed;
    }

    std::string root = std::string(WORK_DIRECTORY) + "/" + REPLACEMENT_ROOT_LEAF;

    if (mkdir(root.c_str(), 0755) != 0 || mount("acl",root.c_str(), "tmpfs", MS_NOSUID | MS_NODEV, "mode=755") != 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot create the replacement root: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return Result::RootBuildFailed;
    }

    for (size_t index = 0; index < deviceFirst; ++index)
    {
        if (!AttachRemembered(root, requests[index], report)) return Result::RootBuildFailed;
    }

    for (const MergedLink& link : links)
    {
        if (symlink(link.destination.c_str(), (root + link.path).c_str()) != 0 && errno != EEXIST)
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot recreate the link %s: %s\n", link.path.c_str(), strerror(errno));
            return Result::RootBuildFailed;
        }
    }

    if (!MakeDirectories(root + "/dev") || mount("acl",(root + "/dev").c_str(), "tmpfs", MS_NOSUID, "mode=755") != 0)
        return Result::RootBuildFailed;

    for (size_t index = deviceFirst; index < requests.size(); ++index)
    {
        if (!AttachRemembered(root, requests[index], report)) return Result::RootBuildFailed;
    }

    if (MakeDirectories(root + "/dev/shm")) mount("acl",(root + "/dev/shm").c_str(), "tmpfs", MS_NOSUID | MS_NODEV, nullptr);
    if (!MakeDirectories(root + "/tmp")) return Result::RootBuildFailed;

    if (!MakeDirectories(root + "/proc")) return Result::RootBuildFailed;

    if (mount("proc", (root + "/proc").c_str(), "proc", MS_NOSUID | MS_NODEV | MS_NOEXEC, nullptr) != 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot give the process its own view of /proc: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return Result::RootBuildFailed;
    }

    std::string displaced = root + "/" + DISPLACED_ROOT_LEAF;
    if (!MakeDirectories(displaced)) return Result::RootBuildFailed;

    if (syscall(SYS_pivot_root, root.c_str(), displaced.c_str()) != 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot replace the root: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return Result::RootPivotFailed;
    }

    if (chdir("/") != 0) return Result::RootPivotFailed;

    std::string oldRoot = std::string("/") + DISPLACED_ROOT_LEAF;
    umount2(oldRoot.c_str(), MNT_DETACH);
    rmdir(oldRoot.c_str());

    for (const AttachRequest& request : requests)
    {
        if (request.descriptor >= 0) close(request.descriptor);
    }

    report.rootReplaced = true;
    rootWasReplaced = true;

    if (!isolation.separateProcessTable) return Result::Ok;

    pid_t worker = fork();
    if (worker < 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot step out of the first process slot: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return Result::NamespaceFailed;
    }

    if (worker == 0) return Result::Ok;

    for (;;)
    {
        int state = 0;
        pid_t finished = waitpid(-1, &state, 0);

        if (finished < 0)
        {
            if (errno == EINTR) continue;
            _exit(1);
        }

        if (finished != worker) continue;

        if (WIFSIGNALED(state)) _exit(128 + WTERMSIG(state));
        _exit(WIFEXITED(state) ? WEXITSTATUS(state) : 1);
    }
}

```

`src/Sandbox/Sandbox.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Sandbox/Sandbox.hpp"

#include <cerrno>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <linux/landlock.h>
#include <sys/prctl.h>
#include <sys/resource.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <unistd.h>

static constexpr uint64_t READ_ACCESS =
    LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_READ_FILE | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_READ_DIR | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_EXECUTE;

static constexpr uint64_t WRITE_ACCESS = READ_ACCESS | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_WRITE_FILE | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_REG |
                                         LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_DIR | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_REMOVE_FILE |
                                         LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_REMOVE_DIR | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_SYM |
                                         LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_TRUNCATE | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_REFER;

static constexpr uint64_t DEVICE_ACCESS =
    LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_READ_FILE | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_WRITE_FILE | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_READ_DIR;

static constexpr uint64_t FILE_ONLY_ACCESS =
    LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_READ_FILE | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_WRITE_FILE | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_EXECUTE;

static int CreateRuleset(const landlock_ruleset_attr* attribute, size_t size, uint32_t flags)
{
    return (int)syscall(__NR_landlock_create_ruleset, attribute, size, flags);
}

static int AddRule(int rulesetFileDescriptor, landlock_rule_type type, const void* attribute, uint32_t flags)
{
    return (int)syscall(__NR_landlock_add_rule, rulesetFileDescriptor, type, attribute, flags);
}

static int RestrictSelf(int rulesetFileDescriptor, uint32_t flags)
{
    return (int)syscall(__NR_landlock_restrict_self, rulesetFileDescriptor, flags);
}

static uint64_t HandledAccessFor(int abi)
{
    uint64_t handled = LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_EXECUTE | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_WRITE_FILE | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_READ_FILE |
                       LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_READ_DIR | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_REMOVE_DIR | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_REMOVE_FILE |
                       LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_CHAR | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_DIR | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_REG |
                       LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_SOCK | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_FIFO | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_BLOCK |
                       LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_SYM;

    if (abi >= 2) handled |= LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_REFER;
    if (abi >= 3) handled |= LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_TRUNCATE;

    return handled;
}

static bool AllowPath(int rulesetFileDescriptor, const std::string& path, uint64_t access, Sandbox::Report& report, bool& applied)
{
    applied = false;

    int target = open(path.c_str(), O_PATH | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (target < 0)
    {
        report.pathsMissing += 1;
        return true;
    }

    struct stat details;
    bool directory = fstat(target, &details) == 0 && S_ISDIR(details.st_mode);

    landlock_path_beneath_attr beneath{};
    beneath.allowed_access = directory ? access : (access & FILE_ONLY_ACCESS);
    beneath.parent_fd = target;

    bool added = AddRule(rulesetFileDescriptor, LANDLOCK_RULE_PATH_BENEATH, &beneath, 0) == 0;
    close(target);

    if (!added) fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot allow %s: %s\n", path.c_str(), strerror(errno));

    applied = added;
    return added;
}

bool Sandbox::IsSupported()
{
    return FilesystemAbi() > 0;
}

int Sandbox::FilesystemAbi()
{
    int abi = CreateRuleset(nullptr, 0, LANDLOCK_CREATE_RULESET_VERSION);
    return abi < 0 ? 0 : abi;
}

Sandbox::Result Sandbox::RestrictFilesystem(const Policy& policy, Report& report)
{
    int abi = FilesystemAbi();
    if (abi <= 0) return Result::Unsupported;

    report.filesystemAbi = abi;

    if (policy.readablePaths.empty() && policy.writablePaths.empty()) return Result::NoPaths;

    landlock_ruleset_attr attribute{};
    attribute.handled_access_fs = HandledAccessFor(abi);

    int ruleset = CreateRuleset(&attribute, sizeof(attribute), 0);
    if (ruleset < 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot create a landlock ruleset: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return Result::RulesetFailed;
    }

    uint64_t readAccess = READ_ACCESS & attribute.handled_access_fs;
    uint64_t writeAccess = WRITE_ACCESS & attribute.handled_access_fs;
    uint64_t deviceAccess = DEVICE_ACCESS & attribute.handled_access_fs;

    bool applied = false;

    for (const std::string& path : policy.readablePaths)
    {
        if (!AllowPath(ruleset, path, readAccess, report, applied))
        {
            close(ruleset);
            return Result::RuleFailed;
        }
        if (applied) report.readablePathsApplied += 1;
    }

    for (const std::string& path : policy.writablePaths)
    {
        if (!AllowPath(ruleset, path, writeAccess, report, applied))
        {
            close(ruleset);
            return Result::RuleFailed;
        }
        if (applied) report.writablePathsApplied += 1;
    }

    for (const std::string& path : policy.devicePaths)
    {
        if (!AllowPath(ruleset, path, deviceAccess, report, applied))
        {
            close(ruleset);
            return Result::RuleFailed;
        }
        if (applied) report.devicePathsApplied += 1;
    }

    if (prctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS, 1, 0, 0, 0) != 0)
    {
        close(ruleset);
        return Result::NoNewPrivilegesFailed;
    }

    if (RestrictSelf(ruleset, 0) != 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot restrict this process: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        close(ruleset);
        return Result::RestrictFailed;
    }

    close(ruleset);
    report.filesystemRestricted = true;
    return Result::Ok;
}

static uint64_t CommittedAddressSpace()
{
    FILE* status = fopen("/proc/self/statm", "r");
    if (!status) return 0;

    unsigned long long pages = 0;
    int scanned = fscanf(status, "%llu", &pages);
    fclose(status);

    if (scanned != 1) return 0;

    long pageSize = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
    if (pageSize <= 0) return 0;

    return (uint64_t)pages * (uint64_t)pageSize;
}

Sandbox::Result Sandbox::RestrictResources(const Policy& policy, Report& report)
{
    rlimit core{};
    core.rlim_cur = 0;
    core.rlim_max = 0;
    if (setrlimit(RLIMIT_CORE, &core) != 0) return Result::LimitsFailed;

    rlimit fileSize{};
    fileSize.rlim_cur = policy.fileSizeBytes;
    fileSize.rlim_max = policy.fileSizeBytes;
    if (setrlimit(RLIMIT_FSIZE, &fileSize) != 0) return Result::LimitsFailed;

    if (policy.threadLimit != 0)
    {
        rlimit threads{};
        threads.rlim_cur = policy.threadLimit;
        threads.rlim_max = policy.threadLimit;
        if (setrlimit(RLIMIT_NPROC, &threads) != 0) return Result::LimitsFailed;
    }

    if (policy.addressSpaceHeadroomBytes != 0)
    {
        uint64_t committed = CommittedAddressSpace();
        uint64_t ceiling = committed + policy.addressSpaceHeadroomBytes;
        if (ceiling < committed) ceiling = policy.addressSpaceHeadroomBytes;

        rlimit addressSpace{};
        addressSpace.rlim_cur = ceiling;
        addressSpace.rlim_max = ceiling;
        if (setrlimit(RLIMIT_AS, &addressSpace) != 0) return Result::LimitsFailed;

        report.addressSpaceCeilingBytes = ceiling;
        report.addressSpaceInUseBytes = committed;
    }

    report.resourcesRestricted = true;
    return Result::Ok;
}

Sandbox::Result Sandbox::Apply(const Policy& policy, Report& report)
{
    Result filesystem = RestrictFilesystem(policy, report);
    if (filesystem != Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] the filesystem was not confined: %s\n", ResultName(filesystem));
    }

    Result resources = RestrictResources(policy, report);
    if (resources != Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] resource limits were not applied: %s\n", ResultName(resources));
    }

    Result syscalls = RestrictSyscalls(policy, report);
    if (syscalls != Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] the syscall filter was not installed: %s\n", ResultName(syscalls));
    }

    if (filesystem != Result::Ok) return filesystem;
    if (syscalls != Result::Ok) return syscalls;

    return resources;
}

const char* Sandbox::ResultName(Result result)
{
    switch (result)
    {
        case Result::Ok: return "Ok";
        case Result::Unsupported: return "Unsupported";
        case Result::NoPaths: return "NoPaths";
        case Result::RulesetFailed: return "RulesetFailed";
        case Result::RuleFailed: return "RuleFailed";
        case Result::NoNewPrivilegesFailed: return "NoNewPrivilegesFailed";
        case Result::RestrictFailed: return "RestrictFailed";
        case Result::FilterFailed: return "FilterFailed";
        case Result::LimitsFailed: return "LimitsFailed";
        case Result::NamespaceFailed: return "NamespaceFailed";
        case Result::IdentityMapFailed: return "IdentityMapFailed";
        case Result::RootBuildFailed: return "RootBuildFailed";
        case Result::RootPivotFailed: return "RootPivotFailed";
    }

    return "Unknown";
}
```

`src/Sandbox/SyscallFilter.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Sandbox/Sandbox.hpp"

#include <cerrno>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <linux/audit.h>
#include <linux/filter.h>
#include <linux/seccomp.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <sys/prctl.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#ifndef SECCOMP_SET_MODE_FILTER
#define SECCOMP_SET_MODE_FILTER 1
#endif

#ifndef SECCOMP_FILTER_FLAG_TSYNC
#define SECCOMP_FILTER_FLAG_TSYNC 1
#endif

#ifndef __X32_SYSCALL_BIT
#define __X32_SYSCALL_BIT 0x40000000
#endif

struct DeniedSyscall
{
    int number;
    const char* name;
};

static const DeniedSyscall LOCAL_ONLY_SYSCALLS[] = {
    {__NR_socket, "socket"},
    {__NR_socketpair, "socketpair"},
};

static const DeniedSyscall EXECUTION_SYSCALLS[] = {
    {__NR_execve, "execve"},
    {__NR_execveat, "execveat"},
};

static const DeniedSyscall MOUNT_SYSCALLS[] = {
    {__NR_mount, "mount"},
    {__NR_umount2, "umount2"},
};

static const DeniedSyscall ALWAYS_DENIED[] = {
    {__NR_ptrace, "ptrace"},
    {__NR_process_vm_readv, "process_vm_readv"},
    {__NR_process_vm_writev, "process_vm_writev"},
    {__NR_kcmp, "kcmp"},
    {__NR_unshare, "unshare"},
    {__NR_setns, "setns"},
    {__NR_pivot_root, "pivot_root"},
    {__NR_chroot, "chroot"},
    {__NR_open_by_handle_at, "open_by_handle_at"},
    {__NR_name_to_handle_at, "name_to_handle_at"},
    {__NR_fsopen, "fsopen"},
    {__NR_fsconfig, "fsconfig"},
    {__NR_fsmount, "fsmount"},
    {__NR_move_mount, "move_mount"},
    {__NR_open_tree, "open_tree"},
    {__NR_io_uring_setup, "io_uring_setup"},
    {__NR_io_uring_enter, "io_uring_enter"},
    {__NR_io_uring_register, "io_uring_register"},
    {__NR_bpf, "bpf"},
    {__NR_perf_event_open, "perf_event_open"},
    {__NR_userfaultfd, "userfaultfd"},
    {__NR_keyctl, "keyctl"},
    {__NR_add_key, "add_key"},
    {__NR_request_key, "request_key"},
    {__NR_kexec_load, "kexec_load"},
    {__NR_kexec_file_load, "kexec_file_load"},
    {__NR_init_module, "init_module"},
    {__NR_finit_module, "finit_module"},
    {__NR_delete_module, "delete_module"},
    {__NR_modify_ldt, "modify_ldt"},
    {__NR_swapon, "swapon"},
    {__NR_swapoff, "swapoff"},
    {__NR_reboot, "reboot"},
    {__NR_settimeofday, "settimeofday"},
    {__NR_clock_settime, "clock_settime"},
    {__NR_quotactl, "quotactl"},
    {__NR_acct, "acct"},
    {__NR_setuid, "setuid"},
    {__NR_setgid, "setgid"},
    {__NR_setreuid, "setreuid"},
    {__NR_setregid, "setregid"},
    {__NR_setresuid, "setresuid"},
    {__NR_setresgid, "setresgid"},
    {__NR_capset, "capset"},
};

static constexpr size_t ALWAYS_DENIED_COUNT = sizeof(ALWAYS_DENIED) / sizeof(ALWAYS_DENIED[0]);
static constexpr size_t EXECUTION_COUNT = sizeof(EXECUTION_SYSCALLS) / sizeof(EXECUTION_SYSCALLS[0]);
static constexpr size_t LOCAL_ONLY_COUNT = sizeof(LOCAL_ONLY_SYSCALLS) / sizeof(LOCAL_ONLY_SYSCALLS[0]);

Sandbox::Result Sandbox::RestrictSyscalls(const Policy& policy, Report& report)
{
    std::vector<sock_filter> program;

    program.push_back(BPF_STMT(BPF_LD | BPF_W | BPF_ABS, (uint32_t)offsetof(seccomp_data, arch)));
    program.push_back(BPF_JUMP(BPF_JMP | BPF_JEQ | BPF_K, AUDIT_ARCH_X86_64, 1, 0));
    program.push_back(BPF_STMT(BPF_RET | BPF_K, SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS));

    program.push_back(BPF_STMT(BPF_LD | BPF_W | BPF_ABS, (uint32_t)offsetof(seccomp_data, nr)));

    program.push_back(BPF_JUMP(BPF_JMP | BPF_JGE | BPF_K, __X32_SYSCALL_BIT, 0, 1));
    program.push_back(BPF_STMT(BPF_RET | BPF_K, SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS));

    uint64_t denied = 0;

    for (size_t index = 0; index < ALWAYS_DENIED_COUNT; ++index)
    {
        program.push_back(BPF_JUMP(BPF_JMP | BPF_JEQ | BPF_K, (uint32_t)ALWAYS_DENIED[index].number, 0, 1));
        program.push_back(BPF_STMT(BPF_RET | BPF_K, SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO | (EPERM & SECCOMP_RET_DATA)));
        denied += 1;
    }

    if (!policy.allowProcessExecution)
    {
        for (size_t index = 0; index < EXECUTION_COUNT; ++index)
        {
            program.push_back(BPF_JUMP(BPF_JMP | BPF_JEQ | BPF_K, (uint32_t)EXECUTION_SYSCALLS[index].number, 0, 1));
            program.push_back(BPF_STMT(BPF_RET | BPF_K, SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO | (EPERM & SECCOMP_RET_DATA)));
            denied += 1;
        }
    }

    if (!policy.allowMountChanges)
    {
        for (const DeniedSyscall& entry : MOUNT_SYSCALLS)
        {
            program.push_back(BPF_JUMP(BPF_JMP | BPF_JEQ | BPF_K, (uint32_t)entry.number, 0, 1));
            program.push_back(BPF_STMT(BPF_RET | BPF_K, SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO | (EPERM & SECCOMP_RET_DATA)));
            denied += 1;
        }
    }

    if (!policy.allowNetwork)
    {
        for (size_t index = 0; index < LOCAL_ONLY_COUNT; ++index)
        {
            program.push_back(BPF_JUMP(BPF_JMP | BPF_JEQ | BPF_K, (uint32_t)LOCAL_ONLY_SYSCALLS[index].number, 0, 4));
            program.push_back(BPF_STMT(BPF_LD | BPF_W | BPF_ABS, (uint32_t)offsetof(seccomp_data, args[0])));
            program.push_back(BPF_JUMP(BPF_JMP | BPF_JEQ | BPF_K, AF_UNIX, 1, 0));
            program.push_back(BPF_STMT(BPF_RET | BPF_K, SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO | (EPERM & SECCOMP_RET_DATA)));
            program.push_back(BPF_STMT(BPF_RET | BPF_K, SECCOMP_RET_ALLOW));
            program.push_back(BPF_STMT(BPF_LD | BPF_W | BPF_ABS, (uint32_t)offsetof(seccomp_data, nr)));
            denied += 1;
        }
    }

    program.push_back(BPF_STMT(BPF_RET | BPF_K, SECCOMP_RET_ALLOW));

    sock_fprog filter{};
    filter.len = (unsigned short)program.size();
    filter.filter = program.data();

    if (prctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS, 1, 0, 0, 0) != 0) return Result::NoNewPrivilegesFailed;

    long installed = syscall(__NR_seccomp, SECCOMP_SET_MODE_FILTER, SECCOMP_FILTER_FLAG_TSYNC, &filter);

    if (installed > 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] thread %ld would not take the syscall filter, so no thread has it\n", installed);
        return Result::FilterFailed;
    }

    if (installed != 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[sandbox] cannot install the syscall filter: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return Result::FilterFailed;
    }

    report.syscallsDenied = denied;
    report.syscallsRestricted = true;
    return Result::Ok;
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once

namespace Sandbox
{
    inline constexpr uint64_t DEFAULT_ADDRESS_SPACE_HEADROOM_BYTES = 32ull * 1024ull * 1024ull * 1024ull;
    inline constexpr uint64_t DEFAULT_FILE_SIZE_BYTES = 4ull * 1024ull * 1024ull * 1024ull;

    enum class Result : uint8_t

        RulesetFailed,
```

`src/Settings/Settings.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"

#include <cstring>
#include <pwd.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <vector>

struct Entry
{
    std::string name;
    std::string value;
};

static std::vector<Entry>& Store()
{
    static std::vector<Entry> store;
    return store;
}

static Entry* Find(const char* name)
{
    if (!name || !*name) return nullptr;

    for (Entry& entry : Store())
    {
        if (entry.name == name) return &entry;
    }

    return nullptr;
}

const char* Settings::Lookup(const char* name)
{
    const Entry* entry = Find(name);
    if (!entry) return nullptr;

    return entry->value.c_str();
}

bool Settings::Has(const char* name)
{
    return Find(name) != nullptr;
}

void Settings::Set(const std::string& name, const std::string& value)
{
    if (name.empty()) return;

    Entry* entry = Find(name.c_str());

    if (entry)
    {
        entry->value = value;
        return;
    }

    Store().push_back(Entry{name, value});
}

void Settings::Unset(const char* name)
{
    if (!name || !*name) return;

    std::vector<Entry>& store = Store();

    for (size_t index = 0; index < store.size(); ++index)
    {
        if (store[index].name != name) continue;

        store.erase(store.begin() + (long)index);
        return;
    }
}

void Settings::Clear()
{
    Store().clear();
}

size_t Settings::Count()
{
    return Store().size();
}

bool Settings::At(size_t index, std::string& name, std::string& value)
{
    if (index >= Store().size()) return false;

    name = Store()[index].name;
    value = Store()[index].value;

    return true;
}

bool Settings::Accept(const std::string& assignment)
{
    size_t separator = assignment.find('=');

    if (separator == std::string::npos)
    {
        Set(assignment, "1");
        return !assignment.empty();
    }

    if (separator == 0) return false;

    Set(assignment.substr(0, separator), assignment.substr(separator + 1));

    return true;
}

bool Settings::Tracing(const char* area)
{
    if (!area || !*area) return false;

    const char* areas = Lookup("trace");
    if (!areas || !*areas) return false;

    const size_t length = strlen(area);
    const char* cursor = areas;

    while (*cursor)
    {
        while (*cursor == ',' || *cursor == ' ') cursor += 1;

        const char* start = cursor;
        while (*cursor && *cursor != ',' && *cursor != ' ') cursor += 1;

        const size_t span = (size_t)(cursor - start);

        if (span == 3 && strncmp(start, "all", 3) == 0) return true;
        if (span == length && strncmp(start, area, length) == 0) return true;
    }

    return false;
}

std::string Settings::HomeDirectory()
{
    const struct passwd* account = getpwuid(getuid());
    if (!account || !account->pw_dir || !*account->pw_dir) return std::string();

    return std::string(account->pw_dir);
}

std::string Settings::RuntimeDirectory()
{
    return "/run/user/" + std::to_string((unsigned)getuid());
}
```

`src/TranslationCache/TranslationCache.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TranslationCache/TranslationCache.hpp"

#include <cerrno>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"

static constexpr uint64_t HASH_OFFSET = 1469598103934665603ull;
static constexpr uint64_t HASH_PRIME = 1099511628211ull;
static constexpr uint64_t READ_CHUNK_BYTES = 1u << 16;

static void MixHash(uint64_t& low, uint64_t& high, const uint8_t* data, uint64_t length)
{
    for (uint64_t index = 0; index < length; ++index)
    {
        low = (low ^ data[index]) * HASH_PRIME;
        high = (high + low) * HASH_PRIME;
        high ^= high >> 29;
    }
}

static bool EnsureDirectory(const std::string& path)
{
    if (path.empty()) return false;
    if (mkdir(path.c_str(), 0755) == 0) return true;

    struct stat information;
    if (stat(path.c_str(), &information) != 0) return false;
    return S_ISDIR(information.st_mode);
}

static std::string HexOf(uint64_t low, uint64_t high)
{
    char text[33];
    snprintf(text, sizeof(text), "%016llx%016llx", (unsigned long long)high, (unsigned long long)low);
    return std::string(text);
}

TranslationCache::Result TranslationCache::DefaultRoot(std::string& root)
{
    const char* explicitRoot = Settings::Lookup(TranslationCache::ROOT_SETTING);
    if (explicitRoot && *explicitRoot)
    {
        root = explicitRoot;
        return Result::Ok;
    }

    std::string home = Settings::HomeDirectory();
    if (home.empty()) return Result::Unwritable;

    root = home + "/.cache/acl";
    return Result::Ok;
}

TranslationCache::Result TranslationCache::KeyForFile(const std::string& imagePath, const std::string& runtimeVersion, std::string& key)
{
    int descriptor = open(imagePath.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (descriptor < 0) return Result::NotFound;

    uint64_t low = HASH_OFFSET;
    uint64_t high = HASH_OFFSET;

    std::vector<uint8_t> chunk((size_t)READ_CHUNK_BYTES);
    for (;;)
    {
        ssize_t taken = read(descriptor, chunk.data(), chunk.size());
        if (taken < 0)
        {
            close(descriptor);
            return Result::Unreadable;
        }
        if (taken == 0) break;

        MixHash(low, high, chunk.data(), (uint64_t)taken);
    }

    close(descriptor);

    MixHash(low, high, (const uint8_t*)runtimeVersion.data(), runtimeVersion.size());
    key = HexOf(low, high);

    return Result::Ok;
}

TranslationCache::Result TranslationCache::Lookup(const Configuration& configuration, const std::string& key, Entry& entry)
{
    if (!configuration.enabled) return Result::Disabled;
    if (key.size() > KEY_CHARACTERS) return Result::KeyMismatch;

    entry.key = key;
    entry.path = configuration.root + "/" + key + ".o";

    struct stat information;
    if (stat(entry.path.c_str(), &information) != 0) return Result::NotFound;
    if (!S_ISREG(information.st_mode)) return Result::Unreadable;
    if ((uint64_t)information.st_size > MAX_OBJECT_BYTES) return Result::Unreadable;

    entry.objectBytes = (uint64_t)information.st_size;
    return Result::Ok;
}

static bool IsSafeKey(const std::string& key)
{
    if (key.empty() || key.size() > TranslationCache::KEY_CHARACTERS) return false;

    for (char character : key)
    {
        bool digit = character >= '0' && character <= '9';
        bool lower = character >= 'a' && character <= 'z';
        bool upper = character >= 'A' && character <= 'Z';

        if (!digit && !lower && !upper) return false;
    }

    return true;
}

TranslationCache::Result TranslationCache::Store(const Configuration& configuration, const std::string& key, const void* object,
                                                 uint64_t length, Entry& entry)
{
    if (!configuration.enabled) return Result::Disabled;
    if (length > MAX_OBJECT_BYTES) return Result::Unwritable;
    if (!IsSafeKey(key)) return Result::KeyMismatch;
    if (!EnsureDirectory(configuration.root)) return Result::Unwritable;

    entry.key = key;
    entry.path = configuration.root + "/" + key + ".o";
    entry.objectBytes = length;

    std::string partial = entry.path + ".partial." + std::to_string((long)getpid());

    int descriptor = open(partial.c_str(), O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC, 0644);
    if (descriptor < 0) return Result::Unwritable;

    const uint8_t* cursor = (const uint8_t*)object;
    uint64_t remaining = length;

    while (remaining != 0)
    {
        ssize_t written = write(descriptor, cursor, (size_t)remaining);
        if (written <= 0)
        {
            close(descriptor);
            unlink(partial.c_str());
            return Result::Unwritable;
        }

        cursor += written;
        remaining -= (uint64_t)written;
    }

    close(descriptor);

    if (rename(partial.c_str(), entry.path.c_str()) != 0)
    {
        unlink(partial.c_str());
        return Result::Unwritable;
    }

    return Result::Ok;
}

TranslationCache::Result TranslationCache::Adopt(const Configuration& configuration, const std::string& key, const std::string& objectPath,
                                                 Entry& entry)
{
    if (!configuration.enabled) return Result::Disabled;
    if (!IsSafeKey(key)) return Result::KeyMismatch;
    if (!EnsureDirectory(configuration.root)) return Result::Unwritable;

    struct stat described{};
    if (stat(objectPath.c_str(), &described) != 0 || !S_ISREG(described.st_mode)) return Result::Unwritable;
    if (described.st_size <= 0 || (uint64_t)described.st_size > MAX_OBJECT_BYTES) return Result::Unwritable;

    entry.key = key;
    entry.path = configuration.root + "/" + key + ".o";
    entry.objectBytes = (uint64_t)described.st_size;

    if (rename(objectPath.c_str(), entry.path.c_str()) != 0) return Result::Unwritable;

    return Result::Ok;
}

static bool WriterHasGone(const std::string& name, const char* marker)
{
    size_t at = name.find(marker);
    if (at == std::string::npos) return false;

    const char* digits = name.c_str() + at + strlen(marker);
    char* end = nullptr;
    long writer = strtol(digits, &end, 10);

    if (end == digits || writer <= 0) return false;
    if (*end != '\0' && *end != '.') return false;

    return kill((pid_t)writer, 0) != 0 && errno == ESRCH;
}

TranslationCache::Result TranslationCache::SweepAbandoned(const Configuration& configuration, uint64_t& removed)
{
    removed = 0;
    if (!configuration.enabled) return Result::Disabled;

    DIR* directory = opendir(configuration.root.c_str());
    if (!directory) return Result::NotFound;

    for (;;)
    {
        struct dirent* entry = readdir(directory);
        if (!entry) break;

        std::string name = entry->d_name;
        if (!WriterHasGone(name, ".building.") && !WriterHasGone(name, ".partial.")) continue;

        if (unlink((configuration.root + "/" + name).c_str()) == 0) removed += 1;
    }

    closedir(directory);
    return Result::Ok;
}

TranslationCache::Result TranslationCache::Load(const Entry& entry, std::vector<uint8_t>& object)
{
    int descriptor = open(entry.path.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (descriptor < 0) return Result::NotFound;

    object.assign((size_t)entry.objectBytes, 0);

    uint64_t filled = 0;
    while (filled < entry.objectBytes)
    {
        ssize_t taken = read(descriptor, object.data() + filled, (size_t)(entry.objectBytes - filled));
        if (taken <= 0)
        {
            close(descriptor);
            return Result::Unreadable;
        }

        filled += (uint64_t)taken;
    }

    close(descriptor);
    return Result::Ok;
}

const char* TranslationCache::ResultName(Result result)
{
    switch (result)
    {
        case Result::Ok: return "Ok";
        case Result::NotFound: return "NotFound";
        case Result::Unreadable: return "Unreadable";
        case Result::Unwritable: return "Unwritable";
        case Result::KeyMismatch: return "KeyMismatch";
        case Result::Disabled: return "Disabled";
    }

    return "Unknown";
}
```

```cpp
#include "VulkanWsi/VulkanWsi.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <mutex>
#include <type_traits>
#include <vector>

#define VK_USE_PLATFORM_WAYLAND_KHR
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>

#include "AbiBridge/AbiBridge.hpp"
#include "Overlay/FrameRate.hpp"
#include "Overlay/OverlayVulkan.hpp"

#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"

struct GuestAndroidSurfaceCreateInfo
{
    VkStructureType sType;
    const void* pNext;
    uint32_t flags;
    uint64_t window;
};

static void* gDriver = nullptr;
static wl_display* gDisplay = nullptr;
static wl_surface* gSurface = nullptr;
static std::mutex gStatisticsMutex;
static VulkanWsi::Statistics gStatistics;
static std::vector<uint64_t> gPresentTimestamps;

static PFN_vkCreateInstance gHostCreateInstance = nullptr;
static PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties gHostGetPhysicalDeviceProperties = nullptr;
static PFN_vkCreateWaylandSurfaceKHR gHostCreateWaylandSurface = nullptr;
static PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr gHostGetInstanceProcAddr = nullptr;
static PFN_vkGetDeviceProcAddr gHostGetDeviceProcAddr = nullptr;
static VkInstance gHostInstance = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
static PFN_vkCreateSwapchainKHR gHostCreateSwapchain = nullptr;
static PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR gHostGetSurfaceFormats = nullptr;
static PFN_vkDestroySurfaceKHR gHostDestroySurface = nullptr;
static VkSurfaceKHR gSharedSurface = VK_NULL_HANDLE;

static PFN_vkDestroySwapchainKHR gHostDestroySwapchain = nullptr;

static uint64_t gFrameWindowStart = 0;
static uint64_t gFrameWindowCount = 0;

static void CountForwardedCall()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gStatisticsMutex);
    gStatistics.callsForwarded += 1;
}

static bool PresentWithoutWaitingRequested()
{
    static const bool requested = []() {
        const char* setting = Settings::Lookup(VulkanWsi::PRESENT_WITHOUT_WAITING_SETTING);
        return setting != nullptr && strcmp(setting, "0") != 0;
    }();

    return requested;
}

static bool FrameTracingRequested()
{
    static const bool requested = []() {
        const char* setting = Settings::Lookup(VulkanWsi::FRAME_TRACE_SETTING);
        return setting != nullptr && strcmp(setting, "0") != 0;
    }();

    return requested;
}

template <typename Signature>
struct EntryPointTraits;

template <typename Returned, typename... Arguments>
struct EntryPointTraits<Returned (*)(Arguments...)>
{
    static constexpr int argumentCount = (int)sizeof...(Arguments);
    static constexpr bool returnsValue = !std::is_void<Returned>::value;
    static constexpr bool argumentsFitRegisters = (... && (sizeof(Arguments) <= sizeof(uint64_t)));
    static constexpr bool argumentsAreIntegral = (... && !std::is_floating_point<Arguments>::value);
};

static AbiBridge::Signature MakeForwardingSignature(int argumentCount, bool returnsValue)
{
    AbiBridge::Argument word;
    word.argumentClass = AbiBridge::ArgumentClass::Integer;
    word.sizeInBytes = sizeof(uint64_t);
    word.alignmentInBytes = sizeof(uint64_t);

    AbiBridge::Signature signature;
    for (int index = 0; index < argumentCount; ++index) signature.arguments[index] = word;

    signature.totalArgumentCount = (uint8_t)argumentCount;
    signature.namedArgumentCount = (uint8_t)argumentCount;

    if (returnsValue)
    {
        signature.returnValue.argumentClass = AbiBridge::ArgumentClass::Integer;
        signature.returnValue.sizeInBytes = sizeof(uint64_t);
        signature.returnValue.alignmentInBytes = sizeof(uint64_t);
    }

    return signature;
}

static constexpr uint32_t GUEST_RENDERER_VENDOR = 0x00010f00u;
static constexpr uint32_t GUEST_RENDERER_DEVICE = 0x00000001u;
static constexpr uint32_t GUEST_RENDERER_DRIVER_VERSION = (1u << 22) | (0u << 12) | 0u;

static constexpr uint64_t MAX_ENTRY_POINT_NAME = 128;
static constexpr int FORWARDED_ARGUMENT_SLOTS = 8;

static AbiBridge::Registry* gRegistry = nullptr;

struct FloatingPointEntryPoint
{
    const char* name;
    int leadingIntegerArguments;
    int floatArguments;
};

static bool DescribeFloatingPointEntryPoint(const char* name, FloatingPointEntryPoint& described)
{
    static const FloatingPointEntryPoint KNOWN[] = {
        {"vkCmdSetLineWidth", 1, 1},   {"vkCmdSetDepthBias", 1, 3},    {"vkCmdSetDepthBiasEXT", 1, 3},
        {"vkCmdSetDepthBounds", 1, 2}, {"vkCmdSetBlendConstants", 1, 0},
    };

    for (const FloatingPointEntryPoint& entry : KNOWN)
    {
        if (strcmp(entry.name, name) != 0) continue;
        if (entry.floatArguments == 0) return false;

        described = entry;
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

static bool RegisterForwardedEntryPoint(AbiBridge::Registry& registry, const char* name, void* hostFunction, int argumentCount,
                                        bool returnsValue);

static bool RegisterFloatingPointEntryPoint(AbiBridge::Registry& registry, const char* name, void* hostFunction,
                                            const FloatingPointEntryPoint& described)
{
    AbiBridge::Argument word;
    word.argumentClass = AbiBridge::ArgumentClass::Integer;
    word.sizeInBytes = sizeof(uint64_t);
    word.alignmentInBytes = sizeof(uint64_t);

    AbiBridge::Argument single;
    single.argumentClass = AbiBridge::ArgumentClass::Float;
    single.sizeInBytes = sizeof(float);
    single.alignmentInBytes = sizeof(float);

    AbiBridge::Signature signature;
    int index = 0;

    for (int leading = 0; leading < described.leadingIntegerArguments; ++leading) signature.arguments[index++] = word;
    for (int floating = 0; floating < described.floatArguments; ++floating) signature.arguments[index++] = single;

    signature.totalArgumentCount = (uint8_t)index;
    signature.namedArgumentCount = (uint8_t)index;

    AbiBridge::Result registered = AbiBridge::RegisterHostFunction(registry, name, signature, hostFunction);

    if (registered != AbiBridge::Result::Ok && registered != AbiBridge::Result::AlreadyRegistered)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] cannot forward %s: %s\n", name, AbiBridge::ResultName(registered));
        return false;
    }

    return true;
}

static void* ResolveFromDriver(const char* name, bool forDevice, uint64_t handle)
{
    void* found = nullptr;

    if (forDevice && gHostGetDeviceProcAddr) found = (void*)gHostGetDeviceProcAddr((VkDevice)handle, name);
    if (!found && !forDevice && gHostGetInstanceProcAddr) found = (void*)gHostGetInstanceProcAddr((VkInstance)handle, name);

    if (!found && forDevice && gHostGetInstanceProcAddr && gHostInstance != VK_NULL_HANDLE)
        found = (void*)gHostGetInstanceProcAddr(gHostInstance, name);

    if (!found) found = dlsym(gDriver, name);

    return found;
}

static bool WithoutPromotedSuffix(const char* name, char* promoted)
{
    size_t length = strlen(name);
    if (length < 4 || length >= MAX_ENTRY_POINT_NAME) return false;

    if (strcmp(name + length - 3, "KHR") != 0) return false;

    memcpy(promoted, name, length - 3);
    promoted[length - 3] = '\0';
    return true;
}

static AbiBridge::Result ProcAddressForGuest(void* context, GuestState::Registers& registers, const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory)
{
    bool forDevice = context != nullptr;
    uint64_t dispatchHandle = registers.general[0];
    uint64_t nameAddress = registers.general[1];
    registers.general[0] = 0;

    if (nameAddress == 0 || !gRegistry) return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;

    char name[MAX_ENTRY_POINT_NAME];
    uint64_t length = 0;

    for (;;)
    {
        char character = 0;
        if (!memory.Read(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)(nameAddress + length), &character, sizeof(character)))
            return AbiBridge::Result::MalformedArguments;

        name[length] = character;
        if (character == '\0') break;

        length += 1;
        if (length + 1 >= sizeof(name)) return AbiBridge::Result::MalformedArguments;
    }

    GuestState::GuestAddress stub{};
    if (AbiBridge::LookupGuestStub(*gRegistry, name, stub) == AbiBridge::Result::Ok)
    {
        registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)stub;
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    void* forwarded = ResolveFromDriver(name, forDevice, dispatchHandle);

    if (!forwarded)
    {
        char promoted[MAX_ENTRY_POINT_NAME];
        if (WithoutPromotedSuffix(name, promoted)) forwarded = ResolveFromDriver(promoted, forDevice, dispatchHandle);
    }

    if (!forwarded)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] the guest asked for %s, which the host driver does not have\n", name);
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    FloatingPointEntryPoint described{};

    if (DescribeFloatingPointEntryPoint(name, described))
    {
        if (!RegisterFloatingPointEntryPoint(*gRegistry, name, forwarded, described)) return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }
    else if (!RegisterForwardedEntryPoint(*gRegistry, name, forwarded, FORWARDED_ARGUMENT_SLOTS, true))
    {
        return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
    }

    if (AbiBridge::LookupGuestStub(*gRegistry, name, stub) != AbiBridge::Result::Ok) return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;

    registers.general[0] = (uint64_t)stub;
    return AbiBridge::Result::Ok;
}

static bool RegisterForwardedEntryPoint(AbiBridge::Registry& registry, const char* name, void* hostFunction, int argumentCount,
                                        bool returnsValue)
{
    AbiBridge::Signature signature = MakeForwardingSignature(argumentCount, returnsValue);
    AbiBridge::Result registered = AbiBridge::RegisterHostFunction(registry, name, signature, hostFunction);

    if (registered != AbiBridge::Result::Ok && registered != AbiBridge::Result::AlreadyRegistered)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] cannot register %s: %s\n", name, AbiBridge::ResultName(registered));
        return false;
    }

    gStatistics.entryPointsRegistered += 1;
    return true;
}

static void DescribeRendererForGuest(VkPhysicalDeviceProperties& properties)
{
    static std::once_flag announced;
    std::call_once(announced, [&properties]() {
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] the guest is told it draws with %s, not %s\n", Platform::DEVICE_GPU, properties.deviceName);
    });

    snprintf(properties.deviceName, sizeof(properties.deviceName), "%s", Platform::DEVICE_GPU);

    properties.vendorID = GUEST_RENDERER_VENDOR;
    properties.deviceID = GUEST_RENDERER_DEVICE;
    properties.deviceType = VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_INTEGRATED_GPU;
    properties.driverVersion = GUEST_RENDERER_DRIVER_VERSION;

    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < VK_UUID_SIZE; ++index)
    {
        properties.pipelineCacheUUID[index] = (uint8_t)(GUEST_RENDERER_VENDOR + index * 7u);
    }
}

static void PropertiesForGuest(VkPhysicalDevice device, VkPhysicalDeviceProperties* properties)
{
    if (gHostGetPhysicalDeviceProperties) gHostGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(device, properties);
    if (!properties) return;

    DescribeRendererForGuest(*properties);
}

static VkResult CreateInstanceForGuest(const VkInstanceCreateInfo* createInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* allocator,
                                       VkInstance* instance)
{
    CountForwardedCall();

    if (allocator)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gStatisticsMutex);
        gStatistics.guestAllocatorsRefused += 1;
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] vkCreateInstance was given guest allocation callbacks; the host cannot call back into the "
                        "guest, so they are refused\n");
        return VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED;
    }

    if (!createInfo) return VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED;

    std::vector<const char*> extensions;
    bool rewrote = false;

    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < createInfo->enabledExtensionCount; ++index)
    {
        const char* requested = createInfo->ppEnabledExtensionNames[index];

        if (requested && strcmp(requested, VulkanWsi::GUEST_SURFACE_EXTENSION) == 0)
        {
            extensions.push_back(VulkanWsi::HOST_SURFACE_EXTENSION);
            rewrote = true;
            continue;
        }

        extensions.push_back(requested);
    }

    if (rewrote)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gStatisticsMutex);
        gStatistics.surfaceExtensionsRewritten += 1;
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] the guest asked for %s; the host is being asked for %s instead\n",
                VulkanWsi::GUEST_SURFACE_EXTENSION, VulkanWsi::HOST_SURFACE_EXTENSION);
    }

    VkInstanceCreateInfo rewritten = *createInfo;
    rewritten.enabledExtensionCount = (uint32_t)extensions.size();
    rewritten.ppEnabledExtensionNames = extensions.empty() ? nullptr : extensions.data();

    return gHostCreateInstance(&rewritten, nullptr, instance);
}

static VkResult SurfaceFormatsForGuest(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkSurfaceKHR surface, uint32_t* count,
                                       VkSurfaceFormatKHR* formats)
{
    CountForwardedCall();

    if (!gHostGetSurfaceFormats && gHostGetInstanceProcAddr && gHostInstance != VK_NULL_HANDLE)
    {
        gHostGetSurfaceFormats = (PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR)gHostGetInstanceProcAddr(
            gHostInstance, "vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR");
    }

    if (!gHostGetSurfaceFormats) return VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED;

    VkResult asked = gHostGetSurfaceFormats(physicalDevice, surface, count, formats);

    fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] the guest asked this surface for formats: result %d, count %u, buffer %p\n", (int)asked,
            count ? (unsigned)*count : 0u, (const void*)formats);

    if (asked == VK_SUCCESS && formats && count)
    {
        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < *count; ++index)
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi]   format %u in colour space %u\n", (unsigned)formats[index].format,
                    (unsigned)formats[index].colorSpace);
        }
    }

    return asked;
}

static VkResult CreateSwapchainForGuest(VkDevice device, const VkSwapchainCreateInfoKHR* createInfo,
                                        const VkAllocationCallbacks*, VkSwapchainKHR* swapchain)
{
    CountForwardedCall();

    if (!createInfo || !swapchain) return VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED;

    if (!gHostCreateSwapchain && gHostGetDeviceProcAddr)
        gHostCreateSwapchain = (PFN_vkCreateSwapchainKHR)gHostGetDeviceProcAddr(device, "vkCreateSwapchainKHR");

    if (!gHostCreateSwapchain)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] the host driver does not expose vkCreateSwapchainKHR\n");
        return VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED;
    }

    VkSwapchainCreateInfoKHR rewritten = *createInfo;

    const VkImageUsageFlags requestedUsage = rewritten.imageUsage;
    rewritten.imageUsage = OverlayVulkan::AddCopyUsage(rewritten.imageUsage);

    if (PresentWithoutWaitingRequested() && rewritten.presentMode != VK_PRESENT_MODE_IMMEDIATE_KHR)
    {
        VkPresentModeKHR asked = rewritten.presentMode;
        rewritten.presentMode = VK_PRESENT_MODE_IMMEDIATE_KHR;

        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] presenting without waiting for the display, so the guest asked for mode %u and gets %u\n",
                (unsigned)asked, (unsigned)rewritten.presentMode);
    }

    VkResult created = gHostCreateSwapchain(device, &rewritten, nullptr, swapchain);

    if (created != VK_SUCCESS && rewritten.presentMode != createInfo->presentMode)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] the host driver refused the unthrottled present mode, so the guest keeps its own\n");

        rewritten.presentMode = createInfo->presentMode;
        created = gHostCreateSwapchain(device, &rewritten, nullptr, swapchain);
    }

    if (created != VK_SUCCESS && rewritten.imageUsage != requestedUsage)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[overlay] the driver refused the extra transfer usage, so the counter stays off the guest's frames\n");

        rewritten.imageUsage = requestedUsage;
        created = gHostCreateSwapchain(device, &rewritten, nullptr, swapchain);
    }

    if (created == VK_SUCCESS)
    {
        OverlayVulkan::NoteSwapchain(device, *swapchain, rewritten.imageFormat, rewritten.imageExtent,
                                     (rewritten.imageUsage & VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT) != 0);
    }

    fprintf(stderr,
            "[vulkanwsi] the swapchain the guest asked for came back %d: type %u, next %p, flags %u, format %u, colour space %u, "
            "%ux%u, layers %u, %u images, present mode %u, usage %u, alpha %u, transform %u, sharing %u, clipped %u, old %p\n",
            (int)created, (unsigned)rewritten.sType, (const void*)rewritten.pNext, (unsigned)rewritten.flags,
            (unsigned)rewritten.imageFormat, (unsigned)rewritten.imageColorSpace, rewritten.imageExtent.width,
            rewritten.imageExtent.height, rewritten.imageArrayLayers, rewritten.minImageCount, (unsigned)rewritten.presentMode,
            (unsigned)rewritten.imageUsage, (unsigned)rewritten.compositeAlpha, (unsigned)rewritten.preTransform,
            (unsigned)rewritten.imageSharingMode, (unsigned)rewritten.clipped, (const void*)rewritten.oldSwapchain);

    return created;
}

static VkResult CreateSurfaceForGuest(VkInstance instance, const GuestAndroidSurfaceCreateInfo* createInfo,
                                      const VkAllocationCallbacks* allocator, VkSurfaceKHR* surface)
{
    CountForwardedCall();

    if (allocator)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gStatisticsMutex);
        gStatistics.guestAllocatorsRefused += 1;
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] vkCreateAndroidSurfaceKHR was given guest allocation callbacks; they are refused\n");
        return VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED;
    }

    if (!createInfo || !surface) return VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED;

    if (!gDisplay || !gSurface)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] the guest asked for a window surface but no compositor surface is attached\n");
        return VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED;
    }

    gHostInstance = instance;

    if (!gHostCreateWaylandSurface)
    {
        gHostCreateWaylandSurface =
            (PFN_vkCreateWaylandSurfaceKHR)gHostGetInstanceProcAddr(instance, "vkCreateWaylandSurfaceKHR");
    }

    if (!gHostCreateWaylandSurface)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] the host driver does not expose vkCreateWaylandSurfaceKHR, so %s cannot be translated\n",
                VulkanWsi::GUEST_SURFACE_EXTENSION);
        return VK_ERROR_EXTENSION_NOT_PRESENT;
    }

    if (gSharedSurface != VK_NULL_HANDLE)
    {
        gSharedSurfaceHolders += 1;
        *surface = gSharedSurface;
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] the guest asked for a second window surface; the one compositor surface is shared instead\n");
        return VK_SUCCESS;
    }

    VkWaylandSurfaceCreateInfoKHR translated{};
    translated.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WAYLAND_SURFACE_CREATE_INFO_KHR;
    translated.display = gDisplay;
    translated.surface = gSurface;

    VkResult created = gHostCreateWaylandSurface(instance, &translated, nullptr, surface);
    if (created != VK_SUCCESS)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] vkCreateWaylandSurfaceKHR failed with %d\n", (int)created);
        return created;
    }

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gStatisticsMutex);
        gStatistics.surfacesCreated += 1;
    }

    gSharedSurface = *surface;
    gSharedSurfaceHolders = 1;

    fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] the guest window surface is a real compositor surface\n");
    return VK_SUCCESS;
}

static void DestroySurfaceForGuest(VkInstance instance, VkSurfaceKHR surface, const VkAllocationCallbacks*)
{
    CountForwardedCall();

    if (surface == VK_NULL_HANDLE) return;

    if (surface == gSharedSurface)
    {
        if (gSharedSurfaceHolders > 0) gSharedSurfaceHolders -= 1;

        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] the guest released the window surface; it is kept because a compositor surface may take its role "
                        "only once\n");
        return;
    }

    if (!gHostDestroySurface && gHostGetInstanceProcAddr)
        gHostDestroySurface = (PFN_vkDestroySurfaceKHR)gHostGetInstanceProcAddr(instance, "vkDestroySurfaceKHR");

    if (gHostDestroySurface) gHostDestroySurface(instance, surface, nullptr);
}

static uint64_t MonotonicNanos()
{
    timespec now{};
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now);
    return (uint64_t)now.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)now.tv_nsec;
}

static VkResult CreateDeviceForGuest(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, const VkDeviceCreateInfo* createInfo,
                                     const VkAllocationCallbacks*, VkDevice* device)
{
    CountForwardedCall();

    VkResult created = gHostCreateDevice(physicalDevice, createInfo, nullptr, device);

    if (created == VK_SUCCESS && device) OverlayVulkan::NoteDevice(physicalDevice, *device);

    return created;
}

static void GetDeviceQueueForGuest(VkDevice device, uint32_t queueFamilyIndex, uint32_t queueIndex, VkQueue* queue)
{
    CountForwardedCall();

    gHostGetDeviceQueue(device, queueFamilyIndex, queueIndex, queue);

    if (queue) OverlayVulkan::NoteQueue(device, queueFamilyIndex, *queue);
}

static void DestroySwapchainForGuest(VkDevice device, VkSwapchainKHR swapchain, const VkAllocationCallbacks*)
{
    CountForwardedCall();

    OverlayVulkan::ForgetSwapchain(swapchain);
    gHostDestroySwapchain(device, swapchain, nullptr);
}

static VkResult QueuePresentForGuest(VkQueue queue, const VkPresentInfoKHR* presentInfo)
{
    FrameRate::Tick();

    VkPresentInfoKHR rewrittenPresent = {};
    VkSemaphore overlaySemaphore = VK_NULL_HANDLE;

    if (presentInfo && presentInfo->swapchainCount == 1 && presentInfo->pSwapchains && presentInfo->pImageIndices
        && OverlayVulkan::Draw(queue, presentInfo->pSwapchains[0], presentInfo->pImageIndices[0], presentInfo->pWaitSemaphores,
                               presentInfo->waitSemaphoreCount, overlaySemaphore))
    {
        rewrittenPresent = *presentInfo;
        rewrittenPresent.waitSemaphoreCount = 1;
        rewrittenPresent.pWaitSemaphores = &overlaySemaphore;
        presentInfo = &rewrittenPresent;
    }

    VkResult presented = gHostQueuePresent(queue, presentInfo);
    uint64_t completed = MonotonicNanos();

    if (presented == VK_SUCCESS || presented == VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gStatisticsMutex);
        gStatistics.framesPresented += presentInfo ? presentInfo->swapchainCount : 1;
        if (gPresentTimestamps.size() < VulkanWsi::MAX_PACING_SAMPLES) gPresentTimestamps.push_back(completed);

        if (FrameTracingRequested())
        {
            if (gFrameWindowStart == 0) gFrameWindowStart = completed;
            gFrameWindowCount += 1;

            uint64_t elapsed = completed - gFrameWindowStart;
            if (elapsed >= VulkanWsi::FRAME_REPORT_NANOS)
            {
                fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] %llu frames presented in the last %.2fs, %.1f per second, %llu in total\n",
                        (unsigned long long)gFrameWindowCount, (double)elapsed / 1e9,
                        (double)gFrameWindowCount * 1e9 / (double)elapsed, (unsigned long long)gStatistics.framesPresented);

                gFrameWindowStart = completed;
                gFrameWindowCount = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    return presented;
}

VulkanWsi::Result VulkanWsi::RegisterAll(GuestRuntime::Instance& runtime)
{
    if (!gDriver) gDriver = dlopen(DRIVER_SONAME, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);

    if (!gDriver)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] no host Vulkan driver: %s\n", dlerror());
        return Result::NoDriver;
    }

    if (FrameRate::OverlayRequested()) OverlayVulkan::Enable([](const char* name) { return dlsym(gDriver, name); });

    gHostGetInstanceProcAddr = (PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr)dlsym(gDriver, "vkGetInstanceProcAddr");
    gHostGetDeviceProcAddr = (PFN_vkGetDeviceProcAddr)dlsym(gDriver, "vkGetDeviceProcAddr");
    gHostCreateInstance = (PFN_vkCreateInstance)dlsym(gDriver, "vkCreateInstance");

    if (!gHostGetInstanceProcAddr || !gHostCreateInstance)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] %s does not expose the loader entry points\n", DRIVER_SONAME);
        return Result::MissingEntryPoint;
    }

    AbiBridge::Registry& registry = GuestRuntime::BridgeRegistry(runtime);
    gRegistry = &registry;

    if (AbiBridge::RegisterHostHandler(registry, "vkGetInstanceProcAddr", &ProcAddressForGuest, nullptr) !=
            AbiBridge::Result::Ok ||
        AbiBridge::RegisterHostHandler(registry, "vkGetDeviceProcAddr", &ProcAddressForGuest, (void*)1) != AbiBridge::Result::Ok)
    {
        return Result::RegistrationFailed;
    }

    gStatistics.entryPointsRegistered += 2;

    if (!RegisterForwardedEntryPoint(registry, "vkCreateInstance", (void*)&CreateInstanceForGuest,
                                     EntryPointTraits<PFN_vkCreateInstance>::argumentCount, true) ||
        !RegisterForwardedEntryPoint(registry, "vkCreateAndroidSurfaceKHR", (void*)&CreateSurfaceForGuest, 4, true) ||
        !RegisterForwardedEntryPoint(registry, "vkCreateSwapchainKHR", (void*)&CreateSwapchainForGuest, 4, true) ||
        !RegisterForwardedEntryPoint(registry, "vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR", (void*)&SurfaceFormatsForGuest, 4, true) ||
        !RegisterForwardedEntryPoint(registry, "vkDestroySurfaceKHR", (void*)&DestroySurfaceForGuest, 3, false))
    {
        return Result::RegistrationFailed;
    }

#define FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(name)                                                                                       \
    do                                                                                                                  \
    {                                                                                                                   \
        static_assert(EntryPointTraits<PFN_##name>::argumentsFitRegisters, #name " passes an argument wider than a register"); \
        static_assert(EntryPointTraits<PFN_##name>::argumentsAreIntegral, #name " passes a floating point argument");    \
        void* symbol = dlsym(gDriver, #name);                                                                           \
        if (!symbol)                                                                                                    \
        {                                                                                                               \
            fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] the host driver does not expose %s\n", #name);                                  \
            return Result::MissingEntryPoint;                                                                           \
        }                                                                                                               \
        if (!RegisterForwardedEntryPoint(registry, #name, symbol, EntryPointTraits<PFN_##name>::argumentCount,           \
                                         EntryPointTraits<PFN_##name>::returnsValue))                                   \
            return Result::RegistrationFailed;                                                                          \
    } while (false)

    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkDestroyInstance);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices);
    gHostGetPhysicalDeviceProperties = (PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties)dlsym(gDriver, "vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties");
    if (!gHostGetPhysicalDeviceProperties)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] the host driver does not expose vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties\n");
        return Result::MissingEntryPoint;
    }

    if (!RegisterForwardedEntryPoint(registry, "vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties", (void*)&PropertiesForGuest, 2, false))
        return Result::RegistrationFailed;

    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties);

    gHostCreateDevice = (PFN_vkCreateDevice)dlsym(gDriver, "vkCreateDevice");
    gHostGetDeviceQueue = (PFN_vkGetDeviceQueue)dlsym(gDriver, "vkGetDeviceQueue");
    gHostDestroySwapchain = (PFN_vkDestroySwapchainKHR)dlsym(gDriver, "vkDestroySwapchainKHR");

    if (!gHostCreateDevice || !gHostGetDeviceQueue || !gHostDestroySwapchain)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] the host driver does not expose vkCreateDevice, vkGetDeviceQueue or vkDestroySwapchainKHR\n");
        return Result::MissingEntryPoint;
    }

    if (!RegisterForwardedEntryPoint(registry, "vkCreateDevice", (void*)&CreateDeviceForGuest, 4, true) ||
        !RegisterForwardedEntryPoint(registry, "vkGetDeviceQueue", (void*)&GetDeviceQueueForGuest, 4, false) ||
        !RegisterForwardedEntryPoint(registry, "vkDestroySwapchainKHR", (void*)&DestroySwapchainForGuest, 3, false))
    {
        return Result::RegistrationFailed;
    }

    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkDestroyDevice);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkDeviceWaitIdle);

    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkDestroySurfaceKHR);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceSupportKHR);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfacePresentModesKHR);

    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkCreateSwapchainKHR);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkDestroySwapchainKHR);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkAcquireNextImageKHR);

    gHostQueuePresent = (PFN_vkQueuePresentKHR)dlsym(gDriver, "vkQueuePresentKHR");
    if (!gHostQueuePresent)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] the host driver does not expose vkQueuePresentKHR\n");
        return Result::MissingEntryPoint;
    }

    if (!RegisterForwardedEntryPoint(registry, "vkQueuePresentKHR", (void*)&QueuePresentForGuest,
                                     EntryPointTraits<PFN_vkQueuePresentKHR>::argumentCount, true))
    {
        return Result::RegistrationFailed;
    }

    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkCreateImageView);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkDestroyImageView);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkCreateRenderPass);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkDestroyRenderPass);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkCreateFramebuffer);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkDestroyFramebuffer);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkCreateShaderModule);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkDestroyShaderModule);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkCreatePipelineLayout);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkDestroyPipelineLayout);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkCreateGraphicsPipelines);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkDestroyPipeline);

    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkCreateCommandPool);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkDestroyCommandPool);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkAllocateCommandBuffers);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkBeginCommandBuffer);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkEndCommandBuffer);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkResetCommandBuffer);

    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkCmdBeginRenderPass);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkCmdEndRenderPass);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkCmdBindPipeline);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkCmdPushConstants);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkCmdDraw);

    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkCreateSemaphore);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkDestroySemaphore);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkCreateFence);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkDestroyFence);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkResetFences);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkWaitForFences);
    FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT(vkQueueSubmit);

#undef FORWARD_ENTRY_POINT

    fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] %llu Vulkan entry points forward to the host driver\n",
            (unsigned long long)gStatistics.entryPointsRegistered);

    return Result::Ok;
}

void VulkanWsi::Shutdown()
{
    gDisplay = nullptr;
    gSurface = nullptr;
}

void VulkanWsi::AttachSurfaceTarget(wl_display* display, wl_surface* surface)
{
    gDisplay = display;
    gSurface = surface;
}

bool VulkanWsi::HasSurfaceTarget()
{
    return gDisplay != nullptr && gSurface != nullptr;
}

VulkanWsi::Result VulkanWsi::WritePacingReport(const std::string& path)
{
    std::vector<uint64_t> samples;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gStatisticsMutex);
        samples = gPresentTimestamps;
    }

    FILE* report = fopen(path.c_str(), "w");
    if (!report)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] cannot write the pacing report to %s\n", path.c_str());
        return Result::ReportUnwritable;
    }

    fprintf(report, "presents %zu\n", samples.size());
    fprintf(report, "capacity %llu\n", (unsigned long long)MAX_PACING_SAMPLES);

    for (size_t index = 1; index < samples.size(); ++index)
    {
        fprintf(report, "interval %zu %llu\n", index, (unsigned long long)(samples[index] - samples[index - 1]));
    }

    fclose(report);

    fprintf(stderr, "[vulkanwsi] wrote %zu present interval(s) to %s\n", samples.empty() ? 0 : samples.size() - 1, path.c_str());
    return Result::Ok;
}

VulkanWsi::Statistics VulkanWsi::GetStatistics()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(gStatisticsMutex);
    return gStatistics;
}

const char* VulkanWsi::ResultName(Result result)
{
    switch (result)
    {
        case Result::Ok: return "Ok";
        case Result::NoDriver: return "NoDriver";
        case Result::MissingEntryPoint: return "MissingEntryPoint";
        case Result::RegistrationFailed: return "RegistrationFailed";
        case Result::NoSurfaceTarget: return "NoSurfaceTarget";
        case Result::GuestAllocatorRefused: return "GuestAllocatorRefused";
        case Result::ReportUnwritable: return "ReportUnwritable";
    }

    return "Unknown";
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once

namespace VulkanWsi
{
    inline constexpr const char* DRIVER_SONAME = "libvulkan.so.1";
    inline constexpr const char* GUEST_SURFACE_EXTENSION = "VK_KHR_android_surface";
    inline constexpr const char* HOST_SURFACE_EXTENSION = "VK_KHR_wayland_surface";

    inline constexpr uint64_t MAX_PACING_SAMPLES = 4096;
    inline constexpr const char* FRAME_TRACE_SETTING = "trace-frames";
    inline constexpr const char* PRESENT_WITHOUT_WAITING_SETTING = "no-vsync";
```
