`tests/apk/ApkZipUnit.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <vector>
#include <zlib.h>

#include "Apk/Apk.hpp"

static int gFailures = 0;
static std::string gWorkDirectory;

static void Check(bool condition, const char* what)
{
    printf("%s %s\n", condition ? "PASS" : "FAIL", what);
    if (!condition) gFailures += 1;
}

static void CheckResult(Apk::Result actual, Apk::Result expected, const char* what)
{
    bool matched = actual == expected;
    printf("%s %s (%s)\n", matched ? "PASS" : "FAIL", what, Apk::ResultName(actual));
    if (!matched) gFailures += 1;
}

struct ZipEntrySource
{
    std::string name;
    std::vector<uint8_t> stored;
    uint32_t crc = 0;
    uint32_t uncompressedSize = 0;
    uint16_t method = 0;
    uint32_t localHeaderOffset = 0;
};

static void PutShort(std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes, uint16_t value)
{
    bytes.push_back((uint8_t)(value & 0xff));
    bytes.push_back((uint8_t)((value >> 8) & 0xff));
}

static void PutLong(std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes, uint32_t value)
{
    bytes.push_back((uint8_t)(value & 0xff));
    bytes.push_back((uint8_t)((value >> 8) & 0xff));
    bytes.push_back((uint8_t)((value >> 16) & 0xff));
    bytes.push_back((uint8_t)((value >> 24) & 0xff));
}

static std::vector<uint8_t> Deflate(const std::vector<uint8_t>& raw)
{
    z_stream stream;
    memset(&stream, 0, sizeof(stream));
    deflateInit2(&stream, Z_DEFAULT_COMPRESSION, Z_DEFLATED, -MAX_WBITS, 8, Z_DEFAULT_STRATEGY);

    std::vector<uint8_t> out(raw.size() + 128);
    stream.next_in = const_cast<uint8_t*>(raw.data());
    stream.avail_in = (unsigned int)raw.size();
    stream.next_out = out.data();
    stream.avail_out = (unsigned int)out.size();

    deflate(&stream, Z_FINISH);
    out.resize(out.size() - stream.avail_out);
    deflateEnd(&stream);

    return out;
}

static ZipEntrySource MakeEntry(const std::string& name, const std::string& text, bool compress)
{
    std::vector<uint8_t> raw(text.begin(), text.end());

    ZipEntrySource entry;
    entry.name = name;
    entry.crc = (uint32_t)crc32(crc32(0, nullptr, 0), raw.data(), (unsigned int)raw.size());
    entry.uncompressedSize = (uint32_t)raw.size();
    entry.method = compress ? 8 : 0;
    entry.stored = compress ? Deflate(raw) : raw;

    return entry;
}

static std::vector<uint8_t> BuildArchive(std::vector<ZipEntrySource>& entries)
{
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;

    for (ZipEntrySource& entry : entries)
    {
        entry.localHeaderOffset = (uint32_t)bytes.size();

        PutLong(bytes, 0x04034b50);
        PutShort(bytes, 20);
        PutShort(bytes, 0);
        PutShort(bytes, entry.method);
        PutShort(bytes, 0);
        PutShort(bytes, 0);
        PutLong(bytes, entry.crc);
        PutLong(bytes, (uint32_t)entry.stored.size());
        PutLong(bytes, entry.uncompressedSize);
        PutShort(bytes, (uint16_t)entry.name.size());
        PutShort(bytes, 0);
        bytes.insert(bytes.end(), entry.name.begin(), entry.name.end());
        bytes.insert(bytes.end(), entry.stored.begin(), entry.stored.end());
    }

    uint32_t directoryOffset = (uint32_t)bytes.size();

    for (const ZipEntrySource& entry : entries)
    {
        PutLong(bytes, 0x02014b50);
        PutShort(bytes, 20);
        PutShort(bytes, 20);
        PutShort(bytes, 0);
        PutShort(bytes, entry.method);
        PutShort(bytes, 0);
        PutShort(bytes, 0);
        PutLong(bytes, entry.crc);
        PutLong(bytes, (uint32_t)entry.stored.size());
        PutLong(bytes, entry.uncompressedSize);
        PutShort(bytes, (uint16_t)entry.name.size());
        PutShort(bytes, 0);
        PutShort(bytes, 0);
        PutShort(bytes, 0);
        PutShort(bytes, 0);
        PutLong(bytes, 0);
        PutLong(bytes, entry.localHeaderOffset);
        bytes.insert(bytes.end(), entry.name.begin(), entry.name.end());
    }

    uint32_t directorySize = (uint32_t)bytes.size() - directoryOffset;

    PutLong(bytes, 0x06054b50);
    PutShort(bytes, 0);
    PutShort(bytes, 0);
    PutShort(bytes, (uint16_t)entries.size());
    PutShort(bytes, (uint16_t)entries.size());
    PutLong(bytes, directorySize);
    PutLong(bytes, directoryOffset);
    PutShort(bytes, 0);

    return bytes;
}

static std::string WriteArchive(const char* leaf, const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes)
{
    std::string path = gWorkDirectory + "/" + leaf;

    FILE* file = fopen(path.c_str(), "wb");
    if (!file) return std::string();

    fwrite(bytes.data(), 1, bytes.size(), file);
    fclose(file);

    return path;
}

static Apk::Result EnumerateOf(const char* leaf, std::vector<ZipEntrySource> entries, Apk::Package& package)
{
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes = BuildArchive(entries);
    package.path = WriteArchive(leaf, bytes);
    if (package.path.empty()) return Apk::Result::FileNotFound;

    return Apk::EnumerateArchive(package);
}

static void TestSafeNames()
{
    Check(Apk::IsSafeEntryName("lib/x86_64/libacl.so"), "a normal entry name is accepted");
    Check(Apk::IsSafeEntryName("classes.dex"), "a root entry name is accepted");
    Check(!Apk::IsSafeEntryName("../evil.so"), "a leading parent segment is rejected");
    Check(!Apk::IsSafeEntryName("lib/../../evil.so"), "an interior parent segment is rejected");
    Check(!Apk::IsSafeEntryName("/etc/passwd"), "an absolute name is rejected");
    Check(!Apk::IsSafeEntryName("lib\\x86_64\\libacl.so"), "a backslash separator is rejected");
    Check(!Apk::IsSafeEntryName("lib//libacl.so"), "an empty segment is rejected");
    Check(!Apk::IsSafeEntryName("./libacl.so"), "a current-directory segment is rejected");
    Check(!Apk::IsSafeEntryName(""), "an empty name is rejected");
    Check(!Apk::IsSafeEntryName(std::string(Apk::MAX_ENTRY_NAME_LENGTH + 1, 'a')), "an over-long name is rejected");
    Check(Apk::IsSafeEntryName("assets/..hidden"), "a leading-dot leaf is not mistaken for a parent segment");
    Check(!Apk::IsSafeEntryName(std::string("lib/") + '\0' + "evil.so"), "an embedded NUL is rejected");
}

static void TestEnumeration()
{
    Apk::Package package;
    Apk::Result result = EnumerateOf("plain.zip",
                                     {MakeEntry("classes.dex", "dex-one", false), MakeEntry("classes2.dex", "dex-two", true),
                                      MakeEntry("lib/x86_64/libacl.so", "elf-bytes-here", false),
                                      MakeEntry("lib/arm64-v8a/libacl.so", "elf-bytes-here", true), MakeEntry("assets/greeting.txt", "hello", true)},
                                     package);

    CheckResult(result, Apk::Result::Ok, "a well-formed archive enumerates");
    Check(package.entries.size() == 5, "every entry is recorded");
    Check(package.dexEntries.size() == 2 && package.dexEntries[0] == "classes.dex" && package.dexEntries[1] == "classes2.dex",
          "dex entries are recorded in load order");
    Check(package.nativeAbis.size() == 2, "both native ABIs are recorded");
    Check(Apk::FindEntry(package, "assets/greeting.txt") >= 0, "an asset entry is findable by name");
    Check(Apk::FindEntry(package, "assets/absent.txt") < 0, "an absent name is not findable");

    const Apk::Entry& stored = package.entries[(size_t)Apk::FindEntry(package, "lib/x86_64/libacl.so")];
    Check(stored.compressionMethod == Apk::COMPRESSION_STORED, "a stored entry reports COMPRESSION_STORED");
    Check(stored.uncompressedSize == 14, "a stored entry reports its uncompressed size");

    const Apk::Entry& deflated = package.entries[(size_t)Apk::FindEntry(package, "lib/arm64-v8a/libacl.so")];
    Check(deflated.compressionMethod == Apk::COMPRESSION_DEFLATE, "a deflated entry reports COMPRESSION_DEFLATE");
    Check(deflated.uncompressedSize == 14, "a deflated entry reports its uncompressed size, not its compressed one");

    Apk::Close(package);
}

static void TestAbiSelection()
{
    Apk::Package package;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("abis.zip", {MakeEntry("lib/arm64-v8a/libacl.so", "elf", false)}, package), Apk::Result::Ok,
                "an arm64-only archive enumerates");

    std::string selected;
    CheckResult(Apk::SelectAbi(package, "", selected), Apk::Result::UnsupportedAbi, "an arm64-only archive has no host ABI");
    Check(selected.empty(), "a refused selection leaves the ABI empty");
    CheckResult(Apk::SelectAbi(package, "arm64-v8a", selected), Apk::Result::Ok, "arm64 can be selected explicitly");
    Check(selected == "arm64-v8a", "the explicit ABI is the one selected");
    Apk::Close(package);

    Apk::Package hostPackage;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("host-abi.zip", {MakeEntry("lib/x86_64/libacl.so", "elf", false)}, hostPackage), Apk::Result::Ok,
                "an x86_64 archive enumerates");
    CheckResult(Apk::SelectAbi(hostPackage, "", selected), Apk::Result::Ok, "the host ABI is selected by default");
    Check(selected == Apk::HOST_NATIVE_ABI, "the default selection is the host ABI");
    Apk::Close(hostPackage);

    Apk::Package bare;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("no-libs.zip", {MakeEntry("classes.dex", "dex", false)}, bare), Apk::Result::Ok, "an archive with no lib/ enumerates");
    CheckResult(Apk::SelectAbi(bare, "", selected), Apk::Result::Ok, "an archive with no native code is not an ABI failure");
    Check(selected.empty(), "an archive with no native code selects no ABI");
    Apk::Close(bare);
}

static void TestDexOrdinals()
{
    Check(Apk::DexOrdinal("classes.dex") == 1, "classes.dex is ordinal 1");
    Check(Apk::DexOrdinal("classes2.dex") == 2, "classes2.dex is ordinal 2");
    Check(Apk::DexOrdinal("classes10.dex") == 10, "classes10.dex is ordinal 10");
    Check(Apk::DexOrdinal("classes0.dex") == -1, "classes0.dex is not part of the multidex scheme");
    Check(Apk::DexOrdinal("classes1.dex") == -1, "classes1.dex is not part of the multidex scheme");
    Check(Apk::DexOrdinal("classes02.dex") == -1, "a leading zero is not the canonical spelling of classes2.dex");
    Check(Apk::DexOrdinal("classesfoo.dex") == -1, "a non-numeric suffix is not a multidex member");
    Check(Apk::DexOrdinal("classes2.dex.bak") == -1, "a trailing suffix is not a multidex member");
    Check(Apk::DexOrdinal("res/classes2.dex") == -1, "a nested classes2.dex is not a multidex member");
    Check(Apk::DexOrdinal("classes99999999.dex") == -1, "an absurd ordinal is refused rather than overflowing");
}

static void TestDataOffsets()
{
    std::string payload = "the-stored-payload-bytes";

    Apk::Package package;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("offsets.zip", {MakeEntry("assets/first.bin", "leading entry", false), MakeEntry("assets/second.bin", payload, false)},
                            package),
                Apk::Result::Ok, "the offset archive enumerates");

    int index = Apk::FindEntry(package, "assets/second.bin");
    Check(index >= 0, "the second stored entry is present");

    if (index >= 0)
    {
        const Apk::Entry& entry = package.entries[(size_t)index];
        Check(entry.dataOffset > 0, "a stored entry records a non-zero data offset");

        FILE* archive = fopen(package.path.c_str(), "rb");
        Check(archive != nullptr, "the archive reopens for a direct read at the recorded offset");

        if (archive)
        {
            std::vector<char> read(payload.size());
            bool sought = fseek(archive, (long)entry.dataOffset, SEEK_SET) == 0;
            size_t got = sought ? fread(read.data(), 1, read.size(), archive) : 0;
            fclose(archive);

            Check(got == payload.size() && std::string(read.data(), got) == payload,
                  "Entry::dataOffset points at the entry's data, which is what M12's MapEntry will rely on");
        }
    }

    Apk::Close(package);
}

static void TestHostileArchives()
{
    Apk::Package slip;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("slip.zip", {MakeEntry("classes.dex", "dex", false), MakeEntry("../../evil.so", "elf", false)}, slip),
                Apk::Result::MalformedArchive, "a zip-slip name is rejected");
    Apk::Close(slip);

    Apk::Package absolute;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("absolute.zip", {MakeEntry("/etc/passwd", "root", false)}, absolute), Apk::Result::MalformedArchive,
                "an absolute name is rejected");
    Apk::Close(absolute);

    Apk::Package backslash;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("backslash.zip", {MakeEntry("lib\\x86_64\\libacl.so", "elf", false)}, backslash), Apk::Result::MalformedArchive,
                "a backslash separator is rejected");
    Apk::Close(backslash);

    Apk::Package embedded;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("nul.zip", {MakeEntry(std::string("lib/") + '\0' + "evil.so", "elf", false)}, embedded), Apk::Result::NotAZipArchive,
                "an embedded NUL is rejected before we ever see the name");
    Apk::Close(embedded);

    Apk::Package empty;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("empty-name.zip", {MakeEntry("", "nameless", false)}, empty), Apk::Result::MalformedArchive,
                "a zero-length entry name is rejected");
    Apk::Close(empty);

    Apk::Package gap;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("dex-gap.zip", {MakeEntry("classes.dex", "one", false), MakeEntry("classes3.dex", "three", false)}, gap),
                Apk::Result::MalformedArchive, "a multi-dex gap is rejected");
    Apk::Close(gap);

    Apk::Package strays;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("dex-strays.zip",
                            {MakeEntry("classes.dex", "one", false), MakeEntry("classes0.dex", "zero", false),
                             MakeEntry("classes1.dex", "one-again", false), MakeEntry("classes02.dex", "padded", false)},
                            strays),
                Apk::Result::Ok, "names outside the multidex scheme are not mistaken for a gap");
    Check(strays.dexEntries.size() == 1, "only the canonical dex file is recorded alongside the strays");
    Apk::Close(strays);

    Apk::Package unordered;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("dex-order.zip",
                            {MakeEntry("classes.dex", "one", false), MakeEntry("classes2.dex", "two", false),
                             MakeEntry("classes4.dex", "four", false), MakeEntry("classes3.dex", "three", false)},
                            unordered),
                Apk::Result::Ok, "central-directory order does not decide dex contiguity");
    Check(unordered.dexEntries.size() == 4, "four contiguous dex files are recorded despite the archive order");
    Apk::Close(unordered);

    Apk::Package named;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("dex-named.zip", {MakeEntry("classes.dex", "one", false), MakeEntry("classesfoo.dex", "not-a-dex", false)}, named),
                Apk::Result::Ok, "a non-numeric classes*.dex is not mistaken for a multi-dex member");
    Check(named.dexEntries.size() == 1, "only the real dex file is recorded");
    Apk::Close(named);

    std::vector<ZipEntrySource> single = {MakeEntry("classes.dex", "dex", false)};
    std::vector<uint8_t> truncated = BuildArchive(single);
    truncated.resize(truncated.size() - 8);
    Apk::Package broken;
    broken.path = WriteArchive("truncated.zip", truncated);
    CheckResult(Apk::EnumerateArchive(broken), Apk::Result::NotAZipArchive, "a truncated central directory is rejected");
    Apk::Close(broken);

    Apk::Package missing;
    missing.path = gWorkDirectory + "/does-not-exist.zip";
    CheckResult(Apk::EnumerateArchive(missing), Apk::Result::NotAZipArchive, "an absent archive is rejected");
    Apk::Close(missing);
}

static void TestExtraction()
{
    Apk::Package package;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("extract.zip",
                            {MakeEntry("lib/x86_64/libstored.so", "stored-payload", false),
                             MakeEntry("lib/x86_64/libdeflated.so", "deflated-payload-which-compresses-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", true)},
                            package),
                Apk::Result::Ok, "the extraction archive enumerates");

    std::string destination = gWorkDirectory + "/lib";
    Check(mkdir(destination.c_str(), 0755) == 0, "the destination directory is created");

    std::vector<std::string> extracted;
    CheckResult(Apk::ExtractNativeLibraries(package, "x86_64", destination, extracted), Apk::Result::Ok, "both native libraries extract");
    Check(extracted.size() == 2, "both libraries are reported");

    Check(Apk::MatchesExtracted(destination + "/libstored.so", package.entries[(size_t)Apk::FindEntry(package, "lib/x86_64/libstored.so")]),
          "the stored library matches its recorded crc32");
    Check(Apk::MatchesExtracted(destination + "/libdeflated.so", package.entries[(size_t)Apk::FindEntry(package, "lib/x86_64/libdeflated.so")]),
          "the deflated library inflates to its recorded crc32");

    FILE* corrupt = fopen((destination + "/libstored.so").c_str(), "r+b");
    Check(corrupt != nullptr, "the extracted library reopens for corruption");
    if (corrupt)
    {
        fputc('X', corrupt);
        fclose(corrupt);
    }
    Check(!Apk::MatchesExtracted(destination + "/libstored.so",
                                 package.entries[(size_t)Apk::FindEntry(package, "lib/x86_64/libstored.so")]),
          "a corrupted library no longer matches, so the next run re-extracts");

    CheckResult(Apk::ExtractNativeLibraries(package, "x86_64", destination, extracted), Apk::Result::Ok, "a corrupted library is re-extracted");
    Check(Apk::MatchesExtracted(destination + "/libstored.so", package.entries[(size_t)Apk::FindEntry(package, "lib/x86_64/libstored.so")]),
          "the re-extracted library matches again");

    CheckResult(Apk::ExtractNativeLibraries(package, "arm64-v8a", destination, extracted), Apk::Result::Ok, "an absent ABI extracts nothing");
    Check(extracted.empty(), "an absent ABI reports no libraries");

    CheckResult(Apk::ExtractEntry(package, -1, destination + "/out.so"), Apk::Result::EntryNotFound, "a negative entry index is refused");
    CheckResult(Apk::ExtractEntry(package, 9999, destination + "/out.so"), Apk::Result::EntryNotFound, "an out-of-range entry index is refused");

    Check(access((destination + "/libstored.so.partial").c_str(), F_OK) != 0, "no partial file survives a successful extraction");

    Apk::Close(package);
}

static void TestDeflateBomb()
{
    std::vector<ZipEntrySource> stored = {MakeEntry("lib/x86_64/libbomb.so", "small", false)};
    stored[0].uncompressedSize = 0xfffffff0;

    Apk::Package rejected;
    rejected.path = WriteArchive("bomb-stored.zip", BuildArchive(stored));
    CheckResult(Apk::EnumerateArchive(rejected), Apk::Result::NotAZipArchive,
                "a stored entry claiming more bytes than the archive holds is rejected at open");
    Apk::Close(rejected);

    std::vector<ZipEntrySource> deflated = {MakeEntry("lib/x86_64/libbomb.so", "small", true)};
    deflated[0].uncompressedSize = (uint32_t)(Apk::MAX_EXTRACT_BYTES + 1);

    Apk::Package package;
    package.path = WriteArchive("bomb-deflated.zip", BuildArchive(deflated));
    CheckResult(Apk::EnumerateArchive(package), Apk::Result::Ok, "a deflated entry with an absurd declared size still enumerates");

    int index = Apk::FindEntry(package, "lib/x86_64/libbomb.so");
    Check(index >= 0, "the bomb entry is present");

    if (index >= 0)
    {
        Check(package.entries[(size_t)index].uncompressedSize > Apk::MAX_EXTRACT_BYTES, "the declared size exceeds the per-entry extraction cap");
        CheckResult(Apk::ExtractEntry(package, index, gWorkDirectory + "/bomb.so"), Apk::Result::MalformedArchive,
                    "an absurd declared size is refused before anything is written");
        Check(access((gWorkDirectory + "/bomb.so").c_str(), F_OK) != 0, "a refused extraction writes no file");
    }

    Apk::Close(package);
}

static void TestAggregateBudget()
{
    std::string payload(4096, 'z');

    std::vector<ZipEntrySource> entries;
    for (int index = 0; index < 12; ++index)
    {
        std::string name = "lib/x86_64/libbomb" + std::to_string(index) + ".so";
        ZipEntrySource entry = MakeEntry(name, payload, true);
        entry.uncompressedSize = (uint32_t)(Apk::MAX_EXTRACT_TOTAL_BYTES / 4);
        entries.push_back(entry);
    }

    Apk::Package package;
    package.path = WriteArchive("budget.zip", BuildArchive(entries));
    CheckResult(Apk::EnumerateArchive(package), Apk::Result::Ok, "the aggregate-budget archive enumerates");

    std::string destination = gWorkDirectory + "/budget";
    Check(mkdir(destination.c_str(), 0755) == 0, "the aggregate-budget destination is created");

    std::vector<std::string> extracted;
    CheckResult(Apk::ExtractNativeLibraries(package, "x86_64", destination, extracted), Apk::Result::MalformedArchive,
                "twelve entries each a quarter of the total budget are refused in aggregate");
    Check(extracted.empty(), "an over-budget archive extracts nothing at all");

    Apk::Close(package);
}

static void TestSymlinkDestination()
{
    std::string payload = "replacement-content";

    Apk::Package package;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("symlink.zip", {MakeEntry("lib/x86_64/libtarget.so", payload, false)}, package), Apk::Result::Ok,
                "the symlink archive enumerates");

    std::string destination = gWorkDirectory + "/symlinkdir";
    Check(mkdir(destination.c_str(), 0755) == 0, "the symlink destination directory is created");

    std::string victim = gWorkDirectory + "/victim.txt";
    FILE* file = fopen(victim.c_str(), "wb");
    Check(file != nullptr, "the victim file is created");
    if (file)
    {
        fputs("ORIGINAL", file);
        fclose(file);
    }

    std::string partial = destination + "/libtarget.so.partial." + std::to_string((long)getpid());
    Check(symlink(victim.c_str(), partial.c_str()) == 0, "a symlink is planted where the partial file would go");

    std::vector<std::string> extracted;
    CheckResult(Apk::ExtractNativeLibraries(package, "x86_64", destination, extracted), Apk::Result::Ok,
                "a planted symlink is replaced rather than followed, so extraction still succeeds");

    char readBack[64] = {0};
    FILE* check = fopen(victim.c_str(), "rb");
    if (check)
    {
        size_t got = fread(readBack, 1, sizeof(readBack) - 1, check);
        readBack[got] = '\0';
        fclose(check);
    }

    Check(std::string(readBack) == "ORIGINAL", "a planted symlink cannot redirect extraction onto another file");

    struct stat status;
    Check(lstat((destination + "/libtarget.so").c_str(), &status) != 0 || S_ISREG(status.st_mode),
          "the extracted library is a regular file, never a symlink");

    Apk::Close(package);
}

static void TestIdempotentEnumeration()
{
    Apk::Package package;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("idempotent.zip",
                            {MakeEntry("classes.dex", "one", false), MakeEntry("lib/x86_64/libacl.so", "elf", false),
                             MakeEntry("assets/a.txt", "a", true)},
                            package),
                Apk::Result::Ok, "the idempotency archive enumerates");

    size_t entries = package.entries.size();
    size_t dex = package.dexEntries.size();
    size_t abis = package.nativeAbis.size();

    CheckResult(Apk::EnumerateArchive(package), Apk::Result::Ok, "a second enumeration of the same package succeeds");
    Check(package.entries.size() == entries && package.dexEntries.size() == dex && package.nativeAbis.size() == abis,
          "a second enumeration replaces the previous state rather than appending to it");

    Apk::Close(package);
}

static void TestOverlongEntryName()
{
    Apk::Package package;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("overlong.zip", {MakeEntry(std::string(65535, 'a'), "payload", false)}, package), Apk::Result::NotAZipArchive,
                "a 65535-byte entry name is refused rather than overflowing the name buffer");
    Apk::Close(package);

    Apk::Package boundary;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("boundary.zip", {MakeEntry(std::string(Apk::MAX_ENTRY_NAME_LENGTH + 1, 'a'), "payload", false)}, boundary),
                Apk::Result::NotAZipArchive, "a name one byte past our own cap is refused");
    Apk::Close(boundary);

    Apk::Package accepted;
    CheckResult(EnumerateOf("longest.zip", {MakeEntry(std::string(Apk::MAX_ENTRY_NAME_LENGTH, 'a'), "payload", false)}, accepted),
                Apk::Result::Ok, "a name at exactly our cap is still accepted");
    Check(accepted.entries.size() == 1 && accepted.entries[0].name.size() == (size_t)Apk::MAX_ENTRY_NAME_LENGTH,
          "the longest accepted name round-trips at full length");
    Apk::Close(accepted);
}

static void RemoveTree(const std::string& path)
{
    if (path.empty()) return;

    DIR* directory = opendir(path.c_str());
    if (!directory) return;

    for (dirent* entry = readdir(directory); entry; entry = readdir(directory))
    {
        std::string name = entry->d_name;
        if (name == "." || name == "..") continue;

        std::string child = path + "/" + name;
        struct stat status;
        if (stat(child.c_str(), &status) == 0 && S_ISDIR(status.st_mode))
        {
            RemoveTree(child);
            continue;
        }

        unlink(child.c_str());
    }

    closedir(directory);
    rmdir(path.c_str());
}

int main()
{
    std::string templatePath = "/tmp/acl-apk-zip-XXXXXX";

    std::vector<char> mutablePath(templatePath.begin(), templatePath.end());
    mutablePath.push_back('\0');

    if (!mkdtemp(mutablePath.data()))
    {
        printf("FAIL could not create a work directory\n");
        return 1;
    }
    gWorkDirectory = mutablePath.data();

    TestSafeNames();
    TestEnumeration();
    TestDexOrdinals();
    TestDataOffsets();
    TestAbiSelection();
    TestHostileArchives();
    TestExtraction();
    TestDeflateBomb();
    TestAggregateBudget();
    TestSymlinkDestination();
    TestIdempotentEnumeration();
    TestOverlongEntryName();

    RemoveTree(gWorkDirectory);

    printf("%s: %d failures\n", gFailures == 0 ? "apk-zip-unit PASSED" : "apk-zip-unit FAILED", gFailures);
    return gFailures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
```

`tests/arm64/CorpusCoverage.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#include "Arm64Decoder/Arm64Decoder.hpp"

static bool ReadNothing(void*, GuestState::GuestAddress, void*, uint64_t)
{
    return false;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 2)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: CorpusCoverageTest <text-blob> [maximum-unimplemented-fraction]\n");
        return 2;
    }

    double allowed = argc > 2 ? atof(argv[2]) : 1.0;

    FILE* blob = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
    if (!blob)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "cannot open %s\n", argv[1]);
        return 2;
    }

    std::vector<uint32_t> words;
    uint32_t encoding = 0;
    while (fread(&encoding, sizeof(encoding), 1, blob) == 1) words.push_back(encoding);
    fclose(blob);

    if (words.empty())
    {
        printf("corpus-coverage FAILED: the blob held no instructions\n");
        return 1;
    }

    Arm64Decoder::Context context;
    context.memory.Read = &ReadNothing;

    int ok = 0;
    int unimplemented = 0;
    int unallocated = 0;

    for (size_t index = 0; index < words.size(); ++index)
    {
        Ir::Function function;
        Ir::Block block;

        Arm64Decoder::Result result =
            Arm64Decoder::DecodeInstruction(context, words[index], static_cast<GuestState::GuestAddress>(0x1000 + index * 4), function, block);

        if (result == Arm64Decoder::Result::Ok) ok += 1;
        else if (result == Arm64Decoder::Result::Unallocated) unallocated += 1;
        else
        {
            unimplemented += 1;
        }
    }

    int total = (int)words.size();
    double fraction = (double)unimplemented / (double)total;

    printf("corpus instructions=%d decoded=%d unimplemented=%d unallocated=%d coverage=%.1f%%\n", total, ok, unimplemented, unallocated,
           100.0 * (double)ok / (double)total);

    if (fraction > allowed)
    {
        printf("corpus-coverage FAILED: %.1f%% unimplemented exceeds the %.1f%% budget\n", 100.0 * fraction, 100.0 * allowed);
        return 1;
    }

    printf("corpus-coverage PASSED\n");
    return 0;
}
```

`tests/arm64/DecodeDifferential.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "Arm64Decoder/Arm64Decoder.hpp"
#include "Interpreter/Interpreter.hpp"

static bool ReadNothing(void*, GuestState::GuestAddress, void*, uint64_t)
{
    return false;
}

static Arm64Decoder::Result DecodeOne(uint32_t encoding, Ir::Function& function, Ir::Block& block)
{
    Arm64Decoder::Context context;
    context.memory.Read = &ReadNothing;

    return Arm64Decoder::DecodeInstruction(context, encoding, static_cast<GuestState::GuestAddress>(0x1000), function, block);
}

static std::string FirstToken(const std::string& line)
{
    size_t start = line.find_first_not_of(" \t");
    if (start == std::string::npos) return std::string();

    size_t end = line.find_first_of(" \t", start);
    if (end == std::string::npos) return line.substr(start);
    return line.substr(start, end - start);
}

static uint32_t NextRandom(uint64_t& state)
{
    state = state * 6364136223846793005ull + 1442695040888963407ull;
    return (uint32_t)(state >> 32);
}

static int Generate(int count, uint64_t seed)
{
    uint64_t state = seed;

    for (int index = 0; index < count; ++index)
    {
        uint32_t encoding = NextRandom(state);

        if ((index % 4) == 1)
        {
            uint32_t shapes[] = {0x8b000000u, 0xcb000000u, 0xab000000u, 0xeb000000u, 0x91000000u, 0xd1000000u,
                                 0x0b000000u, 0x4b000000u, 0x8a000000u, 0xaa000000u, 0xca000000u, 0xea000000u};
            encoding = shapes[NextRandom(state) % (sizeof(shapes) / sizeof(shapes[0]))] | (NextRandom(state) & 0x00ffffffu);
        }
        else if ((index % 4) == 2)
        {
            uint32_t shapes[] = {0x14000000u, 0x94000000u, 0x54000000u, 0x34000000u, 0xb4000000u,
                                 0x36000000u, 0xd65f0000u, 0xd63f0000u, 0xd61f0000u, 0xd2800000u, 0xf2800000u, 0x92800000u};
            encoding = shapes[NextRandom(state) % (sizeof(shapes) / sizeof(shapes[0]))] | (NextRandom(state) & 0x00ffffffu);
        }

        printf("%08x\n", encoding);
    }

    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc >= 4 && strcmp(argv[1], "--generate") == 0)
    {
        return Generate(atoi(argv[2]), strtoull(argv[3], nullptr, 10));
    }

    const char* referencePath = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : nullptr;
    if (!referencePath)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: DecodeDifferentialTest <llvm-mc-reference> | --generate <count> <seed>\n");
        return 2;
    }

    FILE* reference = fopen(referencePath, "rb");
    if (!reference)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "cannot open %s\n", referencePath);
        return 2;
    }

    int total = 0;
    int agreedUndefined = 0;
    int weRejectedTheyAccepted = 0;
    int weAcceptedTheyRejected = 0;
    int agreedDecodable = 0;
    int ambiguous = 0;
    int notYetImplemented = 0;
    int notYetImplementedButUndefined = 0;
    std::vector<std::string> examples;

    char line[512];
    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), reference))
    {
        unsigned encoding = 0;
        char mnemonic[128] = {0};
        if (sscanf(line, "%x %127[^\n]", &encoding, mnemonic) != 2) continue;

        total += 1;

        std::string reported = FirstToken(mnemonic);
        if (reported == "AMBIGUOUS")
        {
            ambiguous += 1;
            continue;
        }

        bool referenceUndefined = reported == "udf" || reported == "INVALID";

        Ir::Function function;
        Ir::Block block;
        Arm64Decoder::Result result = DecodeOne(encoding, function, block);

        bool weRejected = result == Arm64Decoder::Result::Unallocated;
        bool weDecoded = result == Arm64Decoder::Result::Ok;

        if (referenceUndefined && weRejected) agreedUndefined += 1;
        else if (referenceUndefined && weDecoded)
        {
            weAcceptedTheyRejected += 1;
            if (examples.size() < 10)
            {
                char buffer[128];
                snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%08x we=Ok llvm=%s", encoding, reported.c_str());
                examples.push_back(buffer);
            }
        }
        else if (!referenceUndefined && weRejected)
        {
            weRejectedTheyAccepted += 1;
            if (examples.size() < 10)
            {
                char buffer[128];
                snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%08x we=Unallocated llvm=%s", encoding, reported.c_str());
                examples.push_back(buffer);
            }
        }
        else if (!referenceUndefined && weDecoded) agreedDecodable += 1;
        else if (!referenceUndefined) notYetImplemented += 1;
        else notYetImplementedButUndefined += 1;
    }

    fclose(reference);

    printf("encodings=%d agreed_decodable=%d agreed_undefined=%d ambiguous_skipped=%d\n", total, agreedDecodable, agreedUndefined, ambiguous);
    printf("we_accepted_llvm_rejected=%d we_rejected_llvm_accepted=%d\n", weAcceptedTheyRejected, weRejectedTheyAccepted);
    printf("unimplemented_llvm_accepted=%d unimplemented_llvm_rejected=%d\n", notYetImplemented, notYetImplementedButUndefined);

    for (const std::string& example : examples) printf("example %s\n", example.c_str());

    if (total == 0)
    {
        printf("decode-differential FAILED: the reference file held no encodings\n");
        return 1;
    }

    if (weAcceptedTheyRejected != 0)
    {
        printf("decode-differential FAILED: %d encodings decoded that llvm-mc calls undefined\n", weAcceptedTheyRejected);
        return 1;
    }

    printf("decode-differential PASSED: no encoding was accepted that llvm-mc rejects\n");
    return 0;
}
```

`tests/artruntime/ArtRuntimeSmokeTest.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "ArtRuntime/ArtRuntime.hpp"
#include "ArtRuntime/IcuSetup.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 3)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s <host-root> <dex-or-apk> [MainClass]\n", argv[0]);
        return 2;
    }

    std::string hostRoot = argv[1];
    std::string dexPath = argv[2];
    const char* mainClassName = argc > 3 ? argv[3] : "Probe";

    IcuSetup::Result icuResult = IcuSetup::Configure(hostRoot);
    if (icuResult != IcuSetup::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "icu setup failed: %s\n", IcuSetup::ResultName(icuResult));
        return 1;
    }
    printf("icu configured\n");

    ArtRuntime::Configuration configuration = ArtRuntime::DefaultConfiguration(hostRoot);
    configuration.classPath.push_back(dexPath);

    ArtRuntime::Vm vm;
    ArtRuntime::Result result = ArtRuntime::Start(configuration, vm);
    if (result != ArtRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "vm start failed: %s\n", ArtRuntime::ResultName(result));
        return 1;
    }
    printf("vm started\n");

    jclass mainClass = nullptr;
    result = ArtRuntime::FindClass(vm, mainClassName, mainClass);
    if (result != ArtRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "find class failed: %s\n", ArtRuntime::ResultName(result));
        return 1;
    }
    printf("found class %s\n", mainClassName);

    jmethodID main = vm.jniEnv->GetStaticMethodID(mainClass, "main", "([Ljava/lang/String;)V");
    if (!main)
    {
        ArtRuntime::DescribeAndClearException(vm);
        fprintf(stderr, "no main method\n");
        return 1;
    }

    jclass stringClass = vm.jniEnv->FindClass("java/lang/String");
    jobjectArray args = vm.jniEnv->NewObjectArray(0, stringClass, nullptr);
    vm.jniEnv->CallStaticVoidMethod(mainClass, main, args);

    if (ArtRuntime::DescribeAndClearException(vm))
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "main threw\n");
        return 1;
    }

    printf("main returned cleanly\n");
    ArtRuntime::Stop(vm);
    return 0;
}
```

`tests/bench/BenchTiers.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "AheadOfTime/AheadOfTime.hpp"
#include "ElfLoader/ElfLoader.hpp"
#include "GuestLibc/GuestLibc.hpp"
#include "GuestRuntime/GuestRuntime.hpp"

static constexpr int DEFAULT_REPEATS = 5;
static constexpr uint64_t DEFAULT_ITERATIONS = 200000;
static constexpr double REQUIRED_SPEEDUP = 25.0;
static constexpr double REQUIRED_MEMORY_SPEEDUP = 20.0;

struct Measurement
{
    double seconds = 0.0;
    uint64_t result = 0;
    uint64_t recompiled = 0;
    bool ok = false;
};

static Measurement RunTier(const std::string& path, bool translate, uint64_t iterations, bool includeTranslateTime, const char* kernel)
{
    Measurement measurement;

    std::string directory = ".";
    size_t slash = path.find_last_of('/');
    if (slash != std::string::npos) directory = path.substr(0, slash);

    GuestRuntime::Configuration configuration;
    configuration.searchPaths.push_back(directory);
    configuration.requireTranslated = translate;

    GuestRuntime::Instance instance;
    if (GuestRuntime::Create(configuration, instance) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok) return measurement;

    if (GuestLibc::RegisterAll(instance) != GuestLibc::Result::Ok)
    {
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return measurement;
    }

    uint32_t moduleId = ElfLoader::INVALID_MODULE_ID;
    if (GuestRuntime::Load(instance, path, moduleId) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return measurement;
    }

    AheadOfTime::Image image;
    auto translateStarted = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

    if (translate)
    {
        AheadOfTime::Statistics translation;
        if (AheadOfTime::Translate(instance, moduleId, path, image, translation) != AheadOfTime::Result::Ok)
        {
            GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
            return measurement;
        }
    }

    auto translateFinished = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

    GuestState::GuestAddress entry{};
    if (GuestRuntime::Lookup(instance, kernel, entry) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        AheadOfTime::Release(image);
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return measurement;
    }

    GuestState::Registers registers;
    GuestState::Reset(registers);
    registers.general[0] = iterations;
    registers.general[1] = 0x0123456789ABCDEFull;

    auto started = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    GuestRuntime::Result called = GuestRuntime::CallGuest(instance, entry, registers);
    auto finished = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

    if (called == GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        measurement.seconds = std::chrono::duration<double>(finished - started).count();
        if (includeTranslateTime) measurement.seconds += std::chrono::duration<double>(translateFinished - translateStarted).count();

        measurement.result = registers.general[0];
        measurement.recompiled = GuestRuntime::GetStatistics(instance).blocksExecutedTranslated;
        measurement.ok = true;
    }

    AheadOfTime::Release(image);
    GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);

    return measurement;
}

static double Median(std::vector<double>& samples)
{
    std::sort(samples.begin(), samples.end());
    return samples[samples.size() / 2];
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 2)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: BenchTiersTest <bench.so> [iterations] [repeats]\n");
        return 2;
    }

    std::string path = argv[1];
    uint64_t iterations = argc > 2 ? strtoull(argv[2], nullptr, 10) : DEFAULT_ITERATIONS;
    int repeats = argc > 3 ? atoi(argv[3]) : DEFAULT_REPEATS;

    static const char* const KERNELS[] = {"BenchmarkKernel", "BenchmarkMemoryKernel"};
    static const double FLOORS[] = {REQUIRED_SPEEDUP, REQUIRED_MEMORY_SPEEDUP};

    printf("%llu iterations, median of %d\n", (unsigned long long)iterations, repeats);

    bool belowFloor = false;

    for (int kernel = 0; kernel < 2; ++kernel)
    {
        std::vector<double> interpreted;
        std::vector<double> translated;
        uint64_t interpretedResult = 0;
        uint64_t translatedResult = 0;
        uint64_t blocksTranslated = 0;

        for (int repeat = 0; repeat < repeats; ++repeat)
        {
            Measurement slow = RunTier(path, false, iterations, false, KERNELS[kernel]);
            Measurement fast = RunTier(path, true, iterations, false, KERNELS[kernel]);

            if (!slow.ok || !fast.ok)
            {
                printf("bench-tiers FAILED: a guest run of %s did not complete\n", KERNELS[kernel]);
                return 1;
            }

            if (repeat != 0 && (slow.result != interpretedResult || fast.result != translatedResult))
            {
                printf("bench-tiers FAILED: %s produced a different checksum between repeats\n", KERNELS[kernel]);
                return 1;
            }

            interpreted.push_back(slow.seconds);
            translated.push_back(fast.seconds);
            interpretedResult = slow.result;
            translatedResult = fast.result;
            blocksTranslated = fast.recompiled;
        }

        if (interpretedResult != translatedResult)
        {
            printf("bench-tiers FAILED: %s returned %llu interpreted and %llu translated - a faster wrong answer is not a speedup\n",
                   KERNELS[kernel], (unsigned long long)interpretedResult, (unsigned long long)translatedResult);
            return 1;
        }

        if (blocksTranslated == 0)
        {
            printf("bench-tiers FAILED: %s executed no translated blocks, so its measurement is the interpreter twice\n",
                   KERNELS[kernel]);
            return 1;
        }

        double slowMedian = Median(interpreted);
        double fastMedian = Median(translated);
        double speedup = fastMedian > 0.0 ? slowMedian / fastMedian : 0.0;

        Measurement cold = RunTier(path, true, iterations, true, KERNELS[kernel]);

        printf("%s checksum %llu\n", KERNELS[kernel], (unsigned long long)interpretedResult);
        printf("  interpreted        %8.4f s\n", slowMedian);
        printf("  translated         %8.4f s   (%llu blocks entered)\n", fastMedian, (unsigned long long)blocksTranslated);
        printf("  incl. translation  %8.4f s\n", cold.ok ? cold.seconds : 0.0);
        printf("  speedup            %8.2fx   (floor %.1fx)\n", speedup, FLOORS[kernel]);

        if (speedup < FLOORS[kernel])
        {
            printf("bench-tiers FAILED: %s at %.2fx is below the %.1fx floor\n", KERNELS[kernel], speedup, FLOORS[kernel]);
            belowFloor = true;
        }
    }

    if (belowFloor) return 1;

    printf("bench-tiers PASSED: translated code clears the floor on a register kernel and a memory kernel\n");
    return 0;
}
```

`tests/bench/src/bench.c`:

```c
#include <stdint.h>

static uint64_t table[1024];

uint64_t BenchmarkMemoryKernel(uint64_t iterations, uint64_t seed)
{
    uint64_t index = seed | 1;
    uint64_t total = 0;

    for (uint64_t step = 0; step < iterations; ++step)
    {
        index = index * 6364136223846793005ull + 1442695040888963407ull;
        uint64_t slot = (index >> 33) & 1023;

        total += table[slot];
        table[slot] = total ^ step;
    }

    return total;
}

uint64_t BenchmarkKernel(uint64_t iterations, uint64_t seed)
{
    uint64_t accumulator = seed;
    uint64_t alternate = seed ^ 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull;

    for (uint64_t index = 0; index < iterations; ++index)
    {
        accumulator += alternate;
        accumulator ^= accumulator >> 29;
        accumulator *= 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9ull;
        accumulator ^= accumulator >> 32;

        alternate -= accumulator;
        alternate ^= alternate << 17;
        alternate += 0x94D049BB133111EBull;
        alternate ^= alternate >> 13;
    }

    return accumulator ^ alternate;
}
```

`tests/cache/TranslationCacheUnit.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <vector>

#include "TranslationCache/TranslationCache.hpp"

static int failures = 0;

static void Check(bool condition, const char* label)
{
    if (condition)
    {
        printf("PASS %s\n", label);
        return;
    }

    printf("FAIL %s\n", label);
    failures += 1;
}

static bool WriteFile(const std::string& path, const std::string& contents)
{
    FILE* file = fopen(path.c_str(), "wb");
    if (!file) return false;

    size_t written = fwrite(contents.data(), 1, contents.size(), file);
    fclose(file);

    return written == contents.size();
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 2)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: TranslationCacheUnitTest <scratch-directory>\n");
        return 2;
    }

    std::string scratch = argv[1];

    TranslationCache::Configuration configuration;
    configuration.root = scratch + "/cache-" + std::to_string((long)getpid());
    configuration.runtimeVersion = "acl-test-1";

    std::string imageA = scratch + "/imageA.so";
    std::string imageB = scratch + "/imageB.so";

    if (!WriteFile(imageA, "the quick brown fox") || !WriteFile(imageB, "the quick brown fox."))
    {
        printf("translation-cache-unit FAILED: cannot write the fixtures\n");
        return 1;
    }

    std::string keyA;
    std::string keyB;
    Check(TranslationCache::KeyForFile(imageA, configuration.runtimeVersion, keyA) == TranslationCache::Result::Ok,
          "a key is derived from an image");
    Check(TranslationCache::KeyForFile(imageB, configuration.runtimeVersion, keyB) == TranslationCache::Result::Ok,
          "a key is derived from a second image");
    Check(keyA != keyB, "a one-byte difference in the image changes the key");

    std::string keyOtherVersion;
    Check(TranslationCache::KeyForFile(imageA, "acl-test-2", keyOtherVersion) == TranslationCache::Result::Ok,
          "a key is derived for a second runtime version");
    Check(keyA != keyOtherVersion, "the runtime version is part of the key, so a rebuilt acl cannot reuse stale objects");

    std::string repeated;
    Check(TranslationCache::KeyForFile(imageA, configuration.runtimeVersion, repeated) == TranslationCache::Result::Ok &&
              repeated == keyA,
          "the key is stable across repeated derivation");

    std::string missing;
    Check(TranslationCache::KeyForFile(scratch + "/absent.so", configuration.runtimeVersion, missing) == TranslationCache::Result::NotFound,
          "a missing image is NotFound rather than a silent empty key");

    TranslationCache::Entry entry;
    Check(TranslationCache::Lookup(configuration, keyA, entry) == TranslationCache::Result::NotFound,
          "an empty cache reports a miss");

    std::string object = "\x7f"
                         "ELF fake object payload";
    Check(TranslationCache::Store(configuration, keyA, object.data(), object.size(), entry) == TranslationCache::Result::Ok,
          "an object is stored");

    TranslationCache::Entry found;
    Check(TranslationCache::Lookup(configuration, keyA, found) == TranslationCache::Result::Ok, "the stored object is found");
    Check(found.objectBytes == object.size(), "the stored object reports its exact size");

    std::vector<uint8_t> loaded;
    Check(TranslationCache::Load(found, loaded) == TranslationCache::Result::Ok, "the stored object loads back");
    Check(loaded.size() == object.size() && memcmp(loaded.data(), object.data(), object.size()) == 0,
          "the loaded object is byte-identical to what was stored");

    TranslationCache::Entry other;
    Check(TranslationCache::Lookup(configuration, keyB, other) == TranslationCache::Result::NotFound,
          "a different image does not hit the first image's entry");

    TranslationCache::Configuration disabled = configuration;
    disabled.enabled = false;
    TranslationCache::Entry ignored;
    Check(TranslationCache::Lookup(disabled, keyA, ignored) == TranslationCache::Result::Disabled,
          "a disabled cache reports Disabled rather than pretending to miss");
    Check(TranslationCache::Store(disabled, keyA, object.data(), object.size(), ignored) == TranslationCache::Result::Disabled,
          "a disabled cache refuses to store");

    TranslationCache::Entry escaped;
    Check(TranslationCache::Store(configuration, "../../escaped", object.data(), object.size(), escaped) ==
              TranslationCache::Result::KeyMismatch,
          "a key containing a path traversal is refused rather than writing outside the cache root");
    Check(TranslationCache::Store(configuration, "", object.data(), object.size(), escaped) == TranslationCache::Result::KeyMismatch,
          "an empty key is refused");
    Check(TranslationCache::Store(configuration, "has/slash", object.data(), object.size(), escaped) ==
              TranslationCache::Result::KeyMismatch,
          "a key containing a separator is refused");

    std::string adopted = configuration.root + "/" + keyB + ".building." + std::to_string((long)getpid());
    WriteFile(adopted, object);

    TranslationCache::Entry moved;
    Check(TranslationCache::Adopt(configuration, keyB, adopted, moved) == TranslationCache::Result::Ok,
          "a finished object is adopted into the cache without being copied through memory");
    Check(access(adopted.c_str(), F_OK) != 0, "adopting moves the object rather than leaving the scratch copy behind");
    Check(moved.objectBytes == object.size(), "the adopted object reports its exact size");

    TranslationCache::Entry rediscovered;
    Check(TranslationCache::Lookup(configuration, keyB, rediscovered) == TranslationCache::Result::Ok, "the adopted object is found");

    std::vector<uint8_t> readBack;
    Check(TranslationCache::Load(rediscovered, readBack) == TranslationCache::Result::Ok && readBack.size() == object.size() &&
              memcmp(readBack.data(), object.data(), object.size()) == 0,
          "the adopted object is byte-identical to what the translator wrote");

    TranslationCache::Entry refused;
    Check(TranslationCache::Adopt(configuration, "../../escaped", adopted, refused) == TranslationCache::Result::KeyMismatch,
          "adopting refuses a key containing a path traversal");
    Check(TranslationCache::Adopt(configuration, keyA, configuration.root + "/absent.building.1", refused) ==
              TranslationCache::Result::Unwritable,
          "adopting a missing object fails rather than registering an empty entry");

    std::string abandoned = configuration.root + "/" + keyA + ".building.4194304.0.o";
    WriteFile(abandoned, object);
    std::string live = configuration.root + "/" + keyA + ".building." + std::to_string((long)getpid()) + ".0.o";
    WriteFile(live, object);

    uint64_t removed = 0;
    Check(TranslationCache::SweepAbandoned(configuration, removed) == TranslationCache::Result::Ok, "the cache can be swept");
    Check(access(abandoned.c_str(), F_OK) != 0, "an object left by a translation that died is removed");
    Check(access(live.c_str(), F_OK) == 0, "an object a running translation is still writing is left alone");
    Check(access(found.path.c_str(), F_OK) == 0, "sweeping does not touch finished cache entries");

    unlink(live.c_str());
    unlink(rediscovered.path.c_str());
    unlink(found.path.c_str());
    rmdir(configuration.root.c_str());

    printf("%s: %d checks failed\n", failures == 0 ? "translation-cache-unit PASSED" : "translation-cache-unit FAILED", failures);
    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
```

`tests/codemap/CodeMapUnit.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_set>

#include "Arm64Decoder/Arm64Decoder.hpp"
#include "CodeMap/CodeMap.hpp"
#include "GuestLibc/GuestLibc.hpp"
#include "GuestRuntime/GuestRuntime.hpp"
#include "LlvmBackend/LlvmBackend.hpp"

static int failures = 0;

static void Check(bool condition, const char* label)
{
    if (condition)
    {
        printf("PASS %s\n", label);
        return;
    }

    printf("FAIL %s\n", label);
    failures += 1;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 2)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: CodeMapUnitTest <libhelloworld.so>\n");
        return 2;
    }

    std::string path = argv[1];
    std::string directory = ".";
    size_t slash = path.find_last_of('/');
    if (slash != std::string::npos) directory = path.substr(0, slash);

    GuestRuntime::Configuration configuration;
    configuration.searchPaths.push_back(directory);
    configuration.stubUnresolvedSymbols = true;

    GuestRuntime::Instance instance;
    if (GuestRuntime::Create(configuration, instance) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("codemap-unit FAILED: cannot create the guest runtime\n");
        return 1;
    }

    if (GuestRuntime::RegisterPlatformProxies(instance) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok ||
        GuestLibc::RegisterAll(instance) != GuestLibc::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("codemap-unit FAILED: cannot register the guest platform surface\n");
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return 1;
    }

    uint32_t moduleId = ElfLoader::INVALID_MODULE_ID;
    if (GuestRuntime::Load(instance, path, moduleId) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("codemap-unit FAILED: cannot load %s\n", path.c_str());
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return 1;
    }

    const ElfLoader::Library* library = ElfLoader::FindLibrary(GuestRuntime::LibraryNamespace(instance), moduleId);
    if (!library)
    {
        printf("codemap-unit FAILED: the loaded module vanished\n");
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return 1;
    }

    const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory = GuestRuntime::Memory(instance);

    std::vector<CodeMap::FunctionRange> functions;
    CodeMap::Statistics statistics;
    CodeMap::Result discovered = CodeMap::Discover(*library, memory, functions, statistics);

    printf("discovery: %s, %llu functions (%llu from the exception table, %llu from symbols, %llu discarded) over %llu executable bytes\n",
           CodeMap::ResultName(discovered), (unsigned long long)functions.size(), (unsigned long long)statistics.fromExceptionTable,
           (unsigned long long)statistics.fromSymbols, (unsigned long long)statistics.discarded,
           (unsigned long long)statistics.executableBytes);

    Check(discovered == CodeMap::Result::Ok, "the executable range and function table were discovered");
    Check(statistics.exceptionTableUsed, "the exception table was parsed rather than silently skipped");
    Check(statistics.fromExceptionTable > statistics.fromSymbols,
          "the exception table found more functions than the dynamic symbol table, which is why it is the primary source");
    Check(functions.size() > 400, "a real library yields hundreds of function ranges");

    bool sorted = true;
    bool nonEmpty = true;
    bool contiguous = true;

    for (size_t index = 0; index < functions.size(); ++index)
    {
        if ((uint64_t)functions[index].endAddress <= (uint64_t)functions[index].startAddress) nonEmpty = false;
        if (index == 0) continue;

        if (functions[index].startAddress <= functions[index - 1].startAddress) sorted = false;
        if (functions[index - 1].endAddress != functions[index].startAddress) contiguous = false;
    }

    Check(sorted, "the ranges are sorted and free of duplicate starts");
    Check(nonEmpty, "no range is empty or inverted");
    Check(contiguous, "the ranges tile the executable image without gaps or overlaps");

    Arm64Decoder::Context context;
    context.memory = memory;
    context.trapOnUndecodable = true;

    std::map<std::string, uint64_t> rejectionCounts;
    std::map<std::string, uint64_t> unsupportedCounts;
    uint64_t lowerable = 0;
    uint64_t decoded = 0;
    uint64_t rejected = 0;
    uint64_t blocks = 0;
    uint64_t multiBlock = 0;
    bool blocksSorted = true;
    bool blocksOverlap = false;
    bool successorsResolve = true;

    for (const CodeMap::FunctionRange& range : functions)
    {
        Ir::Function function;
        Arm64Decoder::Result outcome = Arm64Decoder::DecodeFunction(context, range.startAddress, range.endAddress, function);

        if (outcome != Arm64Decoder::Result::Ok)
        {
            rejected += 1;
            rejectionCounts[Arm64Decoder::ResultName(outcome)] += 1;
            continue;
        }

        decoded += 1;
        blocks += function.blocks.size();
        if (function.blocks.size() > 1) multiBlock += 1;

        Ir::Opcode unsupported = Ir::Opcode::Invalid;
        if (LlvmBackend::CanLower(function, unsupported)) lowerable += 1;
        else unsupportedCounts[Ir::OpcodeName(unsupported)] += 1;

        std::unordered_set<uint64_t> starts;
        for (const Ir::Block& block : function.blocks) starts.insert((uint64_t)block.guestAddress);

        for (size_t index = 0; index < function.blocks.size(); ++index)
        {
            const Ir::Block& block = function.blocks[index];

            if (index > 0 && block.guestAddress <= function.blocks[index - 1].guestAddress) blocksSorted = false;
            if (index > 0 && function.blocks[index - 1].guestEndAddress > block.guestAddress) blocksOverlap = true;

            const GuestState::GuestAddress successors[2] = {block.successorTaken, block.successorFallthrough};
            for (GuestState::GuestAddress successor : successors)
            {
                if (successor == Ir::NO_SUCCESSOR) continue;

                uint64_t target = (uint64_t)successor;
                if (target < (uint64_t)range.startAddress || target >= (uint64_t)range.endAddress) continue;
                if (starts.count(target) == 0) successorsResolve = false;
            }
        }
    }

    printf("decode: %llu functions decoded, %llu rejected, %llu blocks total, %llu functions with internal control flow\n",
           (unsigned long long)decoded, (unsigned long long)rejected, (unsigned long long)blocks, (unsigned long long)multiBlock);

    for (const auto& entry : rejectionCounts)
        printf("  rejected %llu function(s) with %s\n", (unsigned long long)entry.second, entry.first.c_str());

    printf("  %llu trap(s) emitted for undecodable instructions\n", (unsigned long long)context.statistics.trapsEmitted);
    printf("lowering: %llu of %llu functions translate whole\n", (unsigned long long)lowerable, (unsigned long long)decoded);

    for (const auto& entry : unsupportedCounts)
        printf("  %llu function(s) blocked on %s\n", (unsigned long long)entry.second, entry.first.c_str());

    Check(decoded == functions.size(),
          "every discovered function decodes once undecodable instructions become traps rather than whole-function failures");
    Check(context.statistics.trapsEmitted > 0, "the trap path is exercised, so this library really does contain encodings we lack");
    Check(decoded > 0, "whole functions decode through the control-flow walker");
    Check(multiBlock > 0, "functions with internal control flow produce more than one block");
    Check(blocksSorted, "a decoded function's blocks come back sorted by guest address");
    Check(!blocksOverlap, "no two blocks in a function cover the same instruction, so a branch target really does split its block");
    Check(successorsResolve,
          "every in-range successor lands on a block start, so no branch targets the middle of another block");

    GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);

    printf("%s: %d checks failed\n", failures == 0 ? "codemap-unit PASSED" : "codemap-unit FAILED", failures);
    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
```

`tests/control/ControlChannelUnit.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "ControlChannel/ControlChannel.hpp"

static int failures = 0;

static void Check(bool condition, const char* label)
{
    if (condition)
    {
        printf("PASS %s\n", label);
        return;
    }

    printf("FAIL %s\n", label);
    failures += 1;
}

static int MakeSealedBuffer(const char* contents)
{
    int descriptor = memfd_create("acl-control-unit", MFD_CLOEXEC | MFD_ALLOW_SEALING);
    if (descriptor < 0) return -1;

    size_t length = strlen(contents);

    if (ftruncate(descriptor, (off_t)length) != 0 || write(descriptor, contents, length) != (ssize_t)length)
    {
        close(descriptor);
        return -1;
    }

    return descriptor;
}

static void CheckPairAndRoundTrip()
{
    ControlChannel::Endpoint shell{};
    int playerDescriptor = ControlChannel::INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR;

    Check(ControlChannel::CreatePair(shell, playerDescriptor) == ControlChannel::Result::Ok, "a pair is created");

    int flags = fcntl(playerDescriptor, F_GETFD);
    Check(flags >= 0 && (flags & FD_CLOEXEC) == 0, "the inherited end survives an exec");
    Check((fcntl(shell.fileDescriptor, F_GETFD) & FD_CLOEXEC) != 0, "the owning end does not");

    ControlChannel::Endpoint player{};
    Check(ControlChannel::Adopt(playerDescriptor, player) == ControlChannel::Result::Ok, "the player adopts its end");

    ControlChannel::Message sent{};
    ControlChannel::Prepare(sent, ControlChannel::MessageKind::Hello);
    sent.payload.hello.version = ControlChannel::PROTOCOL_VERSION;
    sent.payload.hello.width = 1080;
    sent.payload.hello.height = 2400;
    ControlChannel::CopyText(sent.payload.hello.packageName, ControlChannel::MAX_NAME_BYTES, "com.example.graphics");

    Check(ControlChannel::Send(player, sent) == ControlChannel::Result::Ok, "the player sends hello");

    ControlChannel::Message received{};
    Check(ControlChannel::Receive(shell, received, 1000) == ControlChannel::Result::Ok, "the shell receives it");
    Check(received.kind == ControlChannel::MessageKind::Hello, "the kind survives");
    Check(received.payload.hello.width == 1080 && received.payload.hello.height == 2400, "the geometry survives");
    Check(strcmp(received.payload.hello.packageName, "com.example.graphics") == 0, "the package name survives");
    Check(shell.messagesReceived == 1 && player.messagesSent == 1, "both ends count the message");

    ControlChannel::Close(shell);
    ControlChannel::Close(player);
}

static void CheckDescriptorPassing()
{
    ControlChannel::Endpoint shell{};
    int playerDescriptor = ControlChannel::INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR;
    ControlChannel::CreatePair(shell, playerDescriptor);

    ControlChannel::Endpoint player{};
    ControlChannel::Adopt(playerDescriptor, player);

    int buffers[2] = {MakeSealedBuffer("first"), MakeSealedBuffer("second")};
    Check(buffers[0] >= 0 && buffers[1] >= 0, "two shared buffers exist");

    ControlChannel::Message sent{};
    ControlChannel::Prepare(sent, ControlChannel::MessageKind::Buffers);
    sent.payload.buffers.count = 2;
    sent.payload.buffers.width = 4;
    sent.payload.buffers.height = 1;
    sent.payload.buffers.stride = 16;

    Check(ControlChannel::SendWithDescriptors(shell, sent, buffers, 2) == ControlChannel::Result::Ok, "the shell sends two descriptors");

    close(buffers[0]);
    close(buffers[1]);

    ControlChannel::Message received{};
    int carried[ControlChannel::MAX_DESCRIPTORS];
    uint32_t carriedCount = ControlChannel::MAX_DESCRIPTORS;

    Check(ControlChannel::ReceiveWithDescriptors(player, received, carried, carriedCount, 1000) == ControlChannel::Result::Ok,
          "the player receives them");
    Check(carriedCount == 2, "both descriptors arrive");
    Check(received.payload.buffers.stride == 16, "the payload arrives with them");

    char text[8];
    memset(text, 0, sizeof(text));
    Check(pread(carried[1], text, 6, 0) == 6 && strcmp(text, "second") == 0, "the second descriptor reads the right bytes");

    close(carried[0]);
    close(carried[1]);
    ControlChannel::Close(shell);
    ControlChannel::Close(player);
}

static void CheckDescriptorOverflow()
{
    ControlChannel::Endpoint shell{};
    int playerDescriptor = ControlChannel::INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR;
    ControlChannel::CreatePair(shell, playerDescriptor);

    ControlChannel::Endpoint player{};
    ControlChannel::Adopt(playerDescriptor, player);

    int buffers[3] = {MakeSealedBuffer("a"), MakeSealedBuffer("b"), MakeSealedBuffer("c")};

    ControlChannel::Message sent{};
    ControlChannel::Prepare(sent, ControlChannel::MessageKind::Buffers);
    sent.payload.buffers.count = 3;
    ControlChannel::SendWithDescriptors(shell, sent, buffers, 3);

    close(buffers[0]);
    close(buffers[1]);
    close(buffers[2]);

    ControlChannel::Message received{};
    int carried[1];
    uint32_t carriedCount = 1;

    ControlChannel::ReceiveWithDescriptors(player, received, carried, carriedCount, 1000);
    Check(carriedCount == 1, "a receiver with room for one keeps one");

    int probe = MakeSealedBuffer("probe");
    Check(probe >= 0 && probe < 64, "the descriptors it could not keep were closed rather than leaked");

    close(probe);
    close(carried[0]);
    ControlChannel::Close(shell);
    ControlChannel::Close(player);
}

static void CheckMalformed()
{
    ControlChannel::Endpoint shell{};
    int playerDescriptor = ControlChannel::INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR;
    ControlChannel::CreatePair(shell, playerDescriptor);

    ControlChannel::Endpoint player{};
    ControlChannel::Adopt(playerDescriptor, player);

    ControlChannel::Message crafted{};
    ControlChannel::Prepare(crafted, ControlChannel::MessageKind::Hello);
    crafted.kind = (ControlChannel::MessageKind)9999;

    Check(send(shell.fileDescriptor, &crafted, sizeof(crafted), MSG_NOSIGNAL) == (ssize_t)sizeof(crafted), "an unknown kind is written raw");

    ControlChannel::Message received{};
    Check(ControlChannel::Receive(player, received, 1000) == ControlChannel::Result::Malformed, "an unknown kind is refused");
    Check(player.malformedReceived == 1, "and counted");

    char shortMessage[8];
    memset(shortMessage, 0, sizeof(shortMessage));
    send(shell.fileDescriptor, shortMessage, sizeof(shortMessage), MSG_NOSIGNAL);
    Check(ControlChannel::Receive(player, received, 1000) == ControlChannel::Result::Malformed, "a truncated datagram is refused");

    ControlChannel::Message unterminated{};
    ControlChannel::Prepare(unterminated, ControlChannel::MessageKind::Progress);
    memset(unterminated.payload.progress.libraryName, 'x', ControlChannel::MAX_NAME_BYTES);
    send(shell.fileDescriptor, &unterminated, sizeof(unterminated), MSG_NOSIGNAL);

    Check(ControlChannel::Receive(player, received, 1000) == ControlChannel::Result::Ok, "an unterminated name is still accepted");
    Check(strlen(received.payload.progress.libraryName) == ControlChannel::MAX_NAME_BYTES - 1, "and is terminated for the reader");

    ControlChannel::Close(shell);
    ControlChannel::Close(player);
}

static void CheckTimeoutAndClose()
{
    ControlChannel::Endpoint shell{};
    int playerDescriptor = ControlChannel::INVALID_FILE_DESCRIPTOR;
    ControlChannel::CreatePair(shell, playerDescriptor);

    ControlChannel::Endpoint player{};
    ControlChannel::Adopt(playerDescriptor, player);

    ControlChannel::Message received{};
    Check(ControlChannel::Receive(player, received, 0) == ControlChannel::Result::WouldBlock, "an empty channel does not block");
    Check(!ControlChannel::PeerHasGone(player), "a live peer is not reported as gone");

    ControlChannel::Message pending{};
    ControlChannel::Prepare(pending, ControlChannel::MessageKind::Stop);
    ControlChannel::Send(shell, pending);
    Check(!ControlChannel::PeerHasGone(player), "and a waiting message is not mistaken for one");
    ControlChannel::Receive(player, received, 100);

    ControlChannel::Close(shell);

    Check(ControlChannel::PeerHasGone(player), "a closed peer is noticed without reading anything");

    Check(ControlChannel::Receive(player, received, 1000) == ControlChannel::Result::PeerClosed, "closing one end reports the other");
    Check(player.peerClosed, "and the endpoint remembers it");

    ControlChannel::Message stop{};
    ControlChannel::Prepare(stop, ControlChannel::MessageKind::Stop);
    ControlChannel::Result sent = ControlChannel::Send(player, stop);
    Check(sent == ControlChannel::Result::PeerClosed || sent == ControlChannel::Result::SendFailed, "sending to a closed peer fails loudly");

    ControlChannel::Close(player);
}

static void CheckText()
{
    char destination[8];

    Check(ControlChannel::CopyText(destination, sizeof(destination), "short") && strcmp(destination, "short") == 0, "text that fits is copied");
    Check(!ControlChannel::CopyText(destination, sizeof(destination), "far too long to fit"), "text that does not fit says so");
    Check(strlen(destination) == sizeof(destination) - 1, "and is truncated with a terminator");
    Check(ControlChannel::CopyText(destination, sizeof(destination), nullptr) && destination[0] == '\0', "a null source is an empty string");
}

int main()
{
    CheckPairAndRoundTrip();
    CheckDescriptorPassing();
    CheckDescriptorOverflow();
    CheckMalformed();
    CheckTimeoutAndClose();
    CheckText();

    printf("%s: %d failure(s)\n", failures == 0 ? "control channel" : "control channel FAILED", failures);

    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
```

`tests/diagnostics/DiagnosticsUnit.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cerrno>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>

#include <csignal>
#include <ctime>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "Diagnostics/Diagnostics.hpp"

static int failures = 0;

static void Check(bool condition, const char* label)
{
    if (condition)
    {
        printf("PASS %s\n", label);
        return;
    }

    printf("FAIL %s\n", label);
    failures += 1;
}

static bool LastRecord(Diagnostics::Record& out)
{
    uint64_t cursor = 0;
    Diagnostics::Record batch[64];
    bool any = false;

    for (;;)
    {
        const uint32_t produced = Diagnostics::Read(cursor, batch, 64);
        if (produced == 0) break;

        out = batch[produced - 1];
        any = true;
    }

    return any;
}

static void CheckLine(const char* line, Diagnostics::Priority priority, const char* tag, const char* text, const char* label)
{
    Diagnostics::WriteLine(line, (uint32_t)strlen(line));

    Diagnostics::Record record{};
    if (!LastRecord(record))
    {
        printf("FAIL %s (nothing was recorded)\n", label);
        failures += 1;
        return;
    }

    const bool ok = record.priority == priority && strcmp(record.tag, tag) == 0 && strcmp(record.text, text) == 0;

    if (ok)
    {
        printf("PASS %s (%c/%s: %s)\n", label, Diagnostics::PriorityLetter(record.priority), record.tag, record.text);
        return;
    }

    printf("FAIL %s (got %c/%s: %s)\n", label, Diagnostics::PriorityLetter(record.priority), record.tag, record.text);
    failures += 1;
}

static void CheckParsing()
{
    Diagnostics::Initialize(64);

    CheckLine("I/Bootstrap: entering the main loop", Diagnostics::Priority::Info, "Bootstrap", "entering the main loop",
              "the framework's own format is understood");
    CheckLine("E/WindowBridge: the window connection ended", Diagnostics::Priority::Error, "WindowBridge",
              "the window connection ended", "and its priority survives");
    CheckLine("[launcher] the guest gets a portrait window", Diagnostics::Priority::Info, "launcher",
              "the guest gets a portrait window", "a native module line becomes a tag");
    CheckLine("08-26 12:00:35.199     2     2 I window  : heap.cc:440 Using CollectorTypeCC GC.", Diagnostics::Priority::Info,
              "window", "heap.cc:440 Using CollectorTypeCC GC.", "the runtime's long format is understood");
    CheckLine("something with no shape at all", Diagnostics::Priority::Info, "stderr", "something with no shape at all",
              "anything else is kept rather than dropped");

    Diagnostics::Shutdown();
}

static void CheckRing()
{
    Diagnostics::Initialize(8);

    for (int index = 0; index < 20; ++index)
    {
        char text[32];
        snprintf(text, sizeof(text), "line %d", index);
        Diagnostics::Write(Diagnostics::Priority::Info, "ring", text);
    }

    const Diagnostics::Statistics statistics = Diagnostics::GetStatistics();
    Check(statistics.written == 20, "every write is counted");
    Check(statistics.dropped == 12, "and the overwritten ones are counted as dropped");
    Check(statistics.held == 8, "the ring holds exactly its capacity");

    uint64_t cursor = 0;
    Diagnostics::Record batch[32];
    const uint32_t produced = Diagnostics::Read(cursor, batch, 32);

    Check(produced == 8, "a reader sees only what survives");
    Check(strcmp(batch[0].text, "line 12") == 0, "starting at the oldest survivor, not the oldest ever");
    Check(strcmp(batch[7].text, "line 19") == 0, "and ending at the newest");

    const uint32_t again = Diagnostics::Read(cursor, batch, 32);
    Check(again == 0, "a cursor that has caught up reads nothing");

    Diagnostics::Write(Diagnostics::Priority::Warn, "ring", "after");
    Check(Diagnostics::Read(cursor, batch, 32) == 1, "and picks up only what arrived since");

    Diagnostics::Shutdown();
}

static void CheckTruncation()
{
    Diagnostics::Initialize(8);

    const std::string huge(Diagnostics::MAX_TEXT_BYTES * 2, 'x');
    Diagnostics::Write(Diagnostics::Priority::Info, "long", huge.c_str());

    Diagnostics::Record record{};
    Check(LastRecord(record), "an over-long line is still recorded");
    Check(strlen(record.text) == Diagnostics::MAX_TEXT_BYTES - 1, "truncated to the record size");
    Check(Diagnostics::GetStatistics().truncated > 0, "and the truncation is counted rather than hidden");

    Diagnostics::Shutdown();
}

static void CheckCapture(const char* scratch)
{
    Diagnostics::Initialize(64);

    Check(Diagnostics::CaptureStandardError(), "standard error can be captured");

    fprintf(stderr, "[capture] a native module line\n");
    fprintf(stderr, "W/Probe: a framework line\n");
    fflush(stderr);

    for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 200 && Diagnostics::GetStatistics().written < 2; ++attempt) usleep(1000);

    Diagnostics::ReleaseStandardError();

    const Diagnostics::Statistics statistics = Diagnostics::GetStatistics();
    Check(statistics.written >= 2, "and what was written to it arrives in the buffer");

    uint64_t cursor = 0;
    Diagnostics::Record batch[16];
    const uint32_t produced = Diagnostics::Read(cursor, batch, 16);

    bool sawModule = false;
    bool sawFramework = false;

    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < produced; ++index)
    {
        if (strcmp(batch[index].tag, "capture") == 0) sawModule = true;
        if (strcmp(batch[index].tag, "Probe") == 0 && batch[index].priority == Diagnostics::Priority::Warn) sawFramework = true;
    }

    Check(sawModule, "a captured module line keeps its tag");
    Check(sawFramework, "a captured framework line keeps its tag and priority");

    std::string path = std::string(scratch) + "/diagnostics.log";
    Check(Diagnostics::Dump(path.c_str()), "the buffer dumps to a file");

    FILE* file = fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
    Check(file != nullptr, "and that file can be read back");

    if (file)
    {
        char line[1024];
        bool found = false;

        while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), file))
        {
            if (strstr(line, "W/Probe: a framework line")) found = true;
        }

        fclose(file);
        Check(found, "with the priority and tag in the logcat shape");
    }

    Diagnostics::Shutdown();
}

static void CheckReleaseWithAnotherHolder()
{
    Diagnostics::Initialize(64);

    if (!Diagnostics::CaptureStandardError())
    {
        printf("FAIL standard error can be captured for the release test\n");
        failures += 1;
        return;
    }

    const pid_t child = fork();

    if (child == 0)
    {
        sleep(30);
        _exit(0);
    }

    if (child < 0)
    {
        printf("FAIL a child could not be forked to hold the write end\n");
        failures += 1;
        Diagnostics::ReleaseStandardError();
        Diagnostics::Shutdown();
        return;
    }

    const time_t started = time(nullptr);
    Diagnostics::ReleaseStandardError();
    const time_t took = time(nullptr) - started;

    Check(took < 5, "releasing does not wait for a forked child that still holds the write end");

    kill(child, SIGKILL);
    int state = 0;
    waitpid(child, &state, 0);

    Diagnostics::Shutdown();
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    const char* scratch = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "/tmp";

    if (mkdir(scratch, 0755) != 0 && errno != EEXIST)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "diagnostics: cannot create the scratch directory %s\n", scratch);
        return 2;
    }

    CheckParsing();
    CheckRing();
    CheckTruncation();
    CheckCapture(scratch);
    CheckReleaseWithAnotherHolder();

    printf("%s: %d failure(s)\n", failures == 0 ? "diagnostics" : "diagnostics FAILED", failures);

    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
```
