`tests/elf/ElfLoaderUnit.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <elf.h>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "ElfLoader/ElfLoader.hpp"
#include "GuestRuntime/GuestRuntime.hpp"

static constexpr uint64_t IMAGE_BYTES = 0x400;
static constexpr uint64_t DYNSTR_OFFSET = 0x100;
static constexpr uint64_t DYNSTR_BYTES = 0x40;
static constexpr uint64_t DYNSYM_OFFSET = 0x140;
static constexpr uint64_t GNUHASH_OFFSET = 0x180;
static constexpr uint64_t RELA_OFFSET = 0x1C0;
static constexpr uint64_t DYNAMIC_OFFSET = 0x200;
static constexpr uint64_t TARGET_OFFSET = 0x300;

static constexpr uint64_t NAME_WIDGET = 1;
static constexpr uint64_t NAME_MISSING = 8;

static int failures = 0;

struct Blueprint
{
    uint8_t elfClass = ELFCLASS64;
    uint8_t elfData = ELFDATA2LSB;
    uint16_t machine = EM_AARCH64;
    uint16_t type = ET_DYN;
    uint16_t programHeaderCount = 2;
    bool includeLoad = true;
    bool includeDynamic = true;
    bool includeGnuHash = true;
    bool oversizeFileSize = false;
    bool offsetPastEnd = false;
    bool corruptStringTable = false;
    uint64_t symbolEntrySize = sizeof(Elf64_Sym);
    uint32_t relocationType = 0;
    bool needMissingLibrary = false;
    bool undefinedSymbol = false;
    bool weakSymbol = false;
    uint64_t relocationOffset = TARGET_OFFSET;
    bool unalignedSegmentAlign = false;
    bool overflowingSegment = false;
};

static void Place(std::vector<uint8_t>& image, uint64_t offset, const void* source, uint64_t bytes)
{
    memcpy(image.data() + offset, source, (size_t)bytes);
}

static std::vector<uint8_t> BuildImage(const Blueprint& blueprint)
{
    std::vector<uint8_t> image((size_t)IMAGE_BYTES, 0);

    const char strings[] = "\0widget\0libmissing.so";
    Place(image, DYNSTR_OFFSET, strings, sizeof(strings));

    Elf64_Sym symbols[2] = {};
    symbols[1].st_name = (Elf32_Word)NAME_WIDGET;
    symbols[1].st_info = (unsigned char)ELF64_ST_INFO(blueprint.weakSymbol ? STB_WEAK : STB_GLOBAL, STT_FUNC);
    symbols[1].st_shndx = blueprint.undefinedSymbol ? SHN_UNDEF : 1;
    symbols[1].st_value = blueprint.undefinedSymbol ? 0 : TARGET_OFFSET;
    Place(image, DYNSYM_OFFSET, symbols, sizeof(symbols));

    uint32_t hashHeader[4] = {1, 2, 1, 0};
    Place(image, GNUHASH_OFFSET, hashHeader, sizeof(hashHeader));

    if (blueprint.relocationType != 0)
    {
        Elf64_Rela relocation = {};
        relocation.r_offset = blueprint.relocationOffset;
        relocation.r_info = ELF64_R_INFO(1, blueprint.relocationType);
        relocation.r_addend = 0;
        Place(image, RELA_OFFSET, &relocation, sizeof(relocation));
    }

    std::vector<Elf64_Dyn> dynamic;
    auto add = [&dynamic](int64_t tag, uint64_t value) {
        Elf64_Dyn entry = {};
        entry.d_tag = tag;
        entry.d_un.d_val = value;
        dynamic.push_back(entry);
    };

    add(DT_STRTAB, blueprint.corruptStringTable ? IMAGE_BYTES + 0x1000 : DYNSTR_OFFSET);
    add(DT_STRSZ, DYNSTR_BYTES);
    add(DT_SYMTAB, DYNSYM_OFFSET);
    add(DT_SYMENT, blueprint.symbolEntrySize);
    if (blueprint.includeGnuHash) add(DT_GNU_HASH, GNUHASH_OFFSET);
    if (blueprint.needMissingLibrary) add(DT_NEEDED, NAME_MISSING);

    if (blueprint.relocationType != 0)
    {
        add(DT_RELA, RELA_OFFSET);
        add(DT_RELASZ, sizeof(Elf64_Rela));
        add(DT_RELAENT, sizeof(Elf64_Rela));
    }

    add(DT_NULL, 0);
    Place(image, DYNAMIC_OFFSET, dynamic.data(), dynamic.size() * sizeof(Elf64_Dyn));

    std::vector<Elf64_Phdr> programs;

    if (blueprint.includeLoad)
    {
        Elf64_Phdr load = {};
        load.p_type = PT_LOAD;
        load.p_flags = PF_R | PF_W;
        load.p_offset = blueprint.offsetPastEnd ? IMAGE_BYTES + 0x1000 : 0;
        load.p_vaddr = 0;
        load.p_filesz = blueprint.oversizeFileSize ? IMAGE_BYTES * 2 : IMAGE_BYTES;
        load.p_memsz = IMAGE_BYTES;
        load.p_align = blueprint.unalignedSegmentAlign ? 0x1001 : 0x1000;
        programs.push_back(load);
    }

    if (blueprint.overflowingSegment)
    {
        Elf64_Phdr overflowing = {};
        overflowing.p_type = PT_LOAD;
        overflowing.p_flags = PF_R;
        overflowing.p_offset = 0;
        overflowing.p_vaddr = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFE000ull;
        overflowing.p_filesz = 0;
        overflowing.p_memsz = 0x1000;
        overflowing.p_align = 0x1000;
        programs.push_back(overflowing);
    }

    if (blueprint.includeDynamic)
    {
        Elf64_Phdr dynamicHeader = {};
        dynamicHeader.p_type = PT_DYNAMIC;
        dynamicHeader.p_flags = PF_R | PF_W;
        dynamicHeader.p_offset = DYNAMIC_OFFSET;
        dynamicHeader.p_vaddr = DYNAMIC_OFFSET;
        dynamicHeader.p_filesz = dynamic.size() * sizeof(Elf64_Dyn);
        dynamicHeader.p_memsz = dynamic.size() * sizeof(Elf64_Dyn);
        dynamicHeader.p_align = 8;
        programs.push_back(dynamicHeader);
    }

    Elf64_Ehdr header = {};
    memcpy(header.e_ident, ELFMAG, SELFMAG);
    header.e_ident[EI_CLASS] = blueprint.elfClass;
    header.e_ident[EI_DATA] = blueprint.elfData;
    header.e_ident[EI_VERSION] = EV_CURRENT;
    header.e_type = blueprint.type;
    header.e_machine = blueprint.machine;
    header.e_version = EV_CURRENT;
    header.e_ehsize = sizeof(Elf64_Ehdr);
    header.e_phoff = sizeof(Elf64_Ehdr);
    header.e_phentsize = sizeof(Elf64_Phdr);
    header.e_phnum = blueprint.programHeaderCount == 2 ? (uint16_t)programs.size() : blueprint.programHeaderCount;

    Place(image, sizeof(Elf64_Ehdr), programs.data(), programs.size() * sizeof(Elf64_Phdr));
    Place(image, 0, &header, sizeof(header));

    return image;
}

static void Expect(const Blueprint& blueprint, ElfLoader::Result expected, const char* label, uint64_t truncateTo = 0)
{
    std::vector<uint8_t> image = BuildImage(blueprint);
    if (truncateTo != 0 && truncateTo < image.size()) image.resize((size_t)truncateTo);

    GuestRuntime::Configuration configuration;
    GuestRuntime::Instance instance;

    if (GuestRuntime::Create(configuration, instance) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("FAIL %s: the guest runtime did not start\n", label);
        failures += 1;
        return;
    }

    uint32_t moduleId = ElfLoader::INVALID_MODULE_ID;
    ElfLoader::Result produced =
        ElfLoader::LoadFromMemory(GuestRuntime::LibraryNamespace(instance), image.data(), image.size(), "libcase.so", moduleId);

    GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);

    if (produced == expected)
    {
        printf("PASS %s -> %s\n", label, ElfLoader::ResultName(produced));
        return;
    }

    printf("FAIL %s: expected %s, got %s\n", label, ElfLoader::ResultName(expected), ElfLoader::ResultName(produced));
    failures += 1;
}

int main()
{
    Blueprint valid;
    Expect(valid, ElfLoader::Result::Ok, "a minimal well-formed image loads");

    Blueprint truncated;
    Expect(truncated, ElfLoader::Result::NotAnElf, "a header shorter than Elf64_Ehdr is rejected", 32);

    Blueprint badMagic;
    badMagic.elfData = ELFDATA2MSB;
    Expect(badMagic, ElfLoader::Result::WrongClass, "big-endian is rejected");

    Blueprint wrongClass;
    wrongClass.elfClass = ELFCLASS32;
    Expect(wrongClass, ElfLoader::Result::WrongClass, "ELFCLASS32 is rejected");

    Blueprint wrongMachine;
    wrongMachine.machine = EM_X86_64;
    Expect(wrongMachine, ElfLoader::Result::WrongMachine, "a non-AArch64 machine is rejected");

    Blueprint executable;
    executable.type = ET_EXEC;
    Expect(executable, ElfLoader::Result::NotAnElf, "ET_EXEC is rejected");

    Blueprint noPrograms;
    noPrograms.programHeaderCount = 0;
    Expect(noPrograms, ElfLoader::Result::MalformedElf, "e_phnum of zero is rejected");

    Blueprint noLoad;
    noLoad.includeLoad = false;
    Expect(noLoad, ElfLoader::Result::MalformedElf, "an image with no PT_LOAD is rejected");

    Blueprint noDynamic;
    noDynamic.includeDynamic = false;
    Expect(noDynamic, ElfLoader::Result::MalformedElf, "an image with no PT_DYNAMIC is rejected");

    Blueprint oversize;
    oversize.oversizeFileSize = true;
    Expect(oversize, ElfLoader::Result::MalformedElf, "p_filesz larger than p_memsz is rejected");

    Blueprint pastEnd;
    pastEnd.offsetPastEnd = true;
    Expect(pastEnd, ElfLoader::Result::MalformedElf, "a segment whose contents run past the file is rejected");

    Blueprint unalignedAlign;
    unalignedAlign.unalignedSegmentAlign = true;
    Expect(unalignedAlign, ElfLoader::Result::MalformedElf, "a p_align that is not a power of two is rejected");

    Blueprint overflowing;
    overflowing.overflowingSegment = true;
    Expect(overflowing, ElfLoader::Result::MalformedElf, "a segment whose p_vaddr plus p_memsz wraps is rejected");

    Blueprint wrappingSpan;
    wrappingSpan.unalignedSegmentAlign = true;
    wrappingSpan.overflowingSegment = true;
    Expect(wrappingSpan, ElfLoader::Result::MalformedElf,
           "a wrapping reservation span cannot escape the module bounds check");

    Blueprint corruptStrings;
    corruptStrings.corruptStringTable = true;
    Expect(corruptStrings, ElfLoader::Result::MalformedElf, "a DT_STRTAB outside every segment is rejected");

    Blueprint noHash;
    noHash.includeGnuHash = false;
    Expect(noHash, ElfLoader::Result::MalformedElf, "an image with no DT_GNU_HASH is rejected");

    Blueprint badSymbolEntry;
    badSymbolEntry.symbolEntrySize = 16;
    Expect(badSymbolEntry, ElfLoader::Result::MalformedElf, "a DT_SYMENT that is not sizeof(Elf64_Sym) is rejected");

    Blueprint missingDependency;
    missingDependency.needMissingLibrary = true;
    Expect(missingDependency, ElfLoader::Result::DependencyNotFound, "an unproxied DT_NEEDED that is not on the search path is rejected");

    Blueprint unsupportedRelocation;
    unsupportedRelocation.relocationType = R_AARCH64_COPY;
    Expect(unsupportedRelocation, ElfLoader::Result::UnsupportedRelocation, "an unimplemented relocation type is named, not ignored");

    Blueprint threadLocalWithoutTls;
    threadLocalWithoutTls.relocationType = R_AARCH64_TLSDESC;
    Expect(threadLocalWithoutTls, ElfLoader::Result::UnsupportedRelocation, "a TLS relocation in an image with no PT_TLS is rejected");

    Blueprint unresolved;
    unresolved.relocationType = R_AARCH64_JUMP_SLOT;
    unresolved.undefinedSymbol = true;
    Expect(unresolved, ElfLoader::Result::SymbolNotFound, "an undefined strong symbol with no host stub is rejected");

    Blueprint weakUnresolved;
    weakUnresolved.relocationType = R_AARCH64_JUMP_SLOT;
    weakUnresolved.undefinedSymbol = true;
    weakUnresolved.weakSymbol = true;
    Expect(weakUnresolved, ElfLoader::Result::Ok, "an undefined weak symbol resolves to zero");

    Blueprint relocationOutside;
    relocationOutside.relocationType = R_AARCH64_RELATIVE;
    relocationOutside.relocationOffset = IMAGE_BYTES + 0x100000;
    Expect(relocationOutside, ElfLoader::Result::MalformedElf, "a relocation past the end of the module image is rejected");

    Blueprint relocationBelowArena;
    relocationBelowArena.relocationType = R_AARCH64_RELATIVE;
    relocationBelowArena.relocationOffset = 0ull - 0x100000000ull;
    Expect(relocationBelowArena, ElfLoader::Result::MalformedElf, "a relocation whose target wraps below the guest arena is rejected");

    Blueprint relocationIntoHostMemory;
    relocationIntoHostMemory.relocationType = R_AARCH64_RELATIVE;
    relocationIntoHostMemory.relocationOffset = 0xFFFF000000000000ull;
    Expect(relocationIntoHostMemory, ElfLoader::Result::MalformedElf, "a relocation targeting host memory outside the arena is rejected");

    Blueprint globalDataOutside;
    globalDataOutside.relocationType = R_AARCH64_GLOB_DAT;
    globalDataOutside.relocationOffset = 0ull - 0x100000000ull;
    Expect(globalDataOutside, ElfLoader::Result::MalformedElf, "a symbol relocation escaping the module image is rejected");

    Blueprint resolvedRelative;
    resolvedRelative.relocationType = R_AARCH64_RELATIVE;
    Expect(resolvedRelative, ElfLoader::Result::Ok, "a well-formed R_AARCH64_RELATIVE applies");

    printf("%s: %d checks failed\n", failures == 0 ? "elfloader-unit PASSED" : "elfloader-unit FAILED", failures);
    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
```

`tests/elf/ElfReadelfDifferential.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "ElfLoader/ElfLoader.hpp"
#include "GuestRuntime/GuestRuntime.hpp"

struct ReferenceImage
{
    uint64_t loadSegments = 0;
    uint64_t dynamicSymbols = 0;
    uint64_t relative = 0;
    uint64_t relrRelative = 0;
    uint64_t globalData = 0;
    uint64_t jumpSlot = 0;
    uint64_t absolute = 0;
    uint64_t threadLocal = 0;
    uint64_t unsupportedRelocations = 0;
    std::string soname;
    std::vector<std::string> needed;
};

static constexpr int MINIMUM_COMPARED_LIBRARIES = 3;

static int failures = 0;
static int compared = 0;
static int skipped = 0;

static void Check(bool condition, const std::string& label)
{
    if (condition)
    {
        printf("PASS %s\n", label.c_str());
        return;
    }

    printf("FAIL %s\n", label.c_str());
    failures += 1;
}

static void CheckEqual(uint64_t produced, uint64_t expected, const std::string& label)
{
    if (produced == expected)
    {
        printf("PASS %s (%llu)\n", label.c_str(), (unsigned long long)expected);
        return;
    }

    printf("FAIL %s: llvm-readelf says %llu, the loader says %llu\n", label.c_str(), (unsigned long long)expected,
           (unsigned long long)produced);
    failures += 1;
}

static bool RunReadelf(const std::string& readelf, const std::string& path, std::string& output)
{
    std::string command = readelf + " --program-headers --dynamic --relocs --dyn-syms '" + path + "' 2>/dev/null";

    FILE* pipe = popen(command.c_str(), "r");
    if (!pipe) return false;

    char chunk[4096];
    output.clear();
    while (fgets(chunk, sizeof(chunk), pipe)) output += chunk;

    return pclose(pipe) == 0 && !output.empty();
}

static std::string Trimmed(const std::string& text)
{
    size_t first = text.find_first_not_of(" \t\r\n");
    if (first == std::string::npos) return std::string();

    size_t last = text.find_last_not_of(" \t\r\n");
    return text.substr(first, last - first + 1);
}

static uint64_t CountOccurrences(const std::string& text, const std::string& needle)
{
    uint64_t count = 0;
    size_t cursor = 0;

    for (;;)
    {
        size_t found = text.find(needle, cursor);
        if (found == std::string::npos) break;

        count += 1;
        cursor = found + needle.size();
    }

    return count;
}

static void ParseReference(const std::string& output, ReferenceImage& reference)
{
    size_t start = 0;
    bool inDynamicSymbols = false;

    while (start < output.size())
    {
        size_t end = output.find('\n', start);
        if (end == std::string::npos) end = output.size();

        std::string line = output.substr(start, end - start);
        std::string trimmed = Trimmed(line);
        start = end + 1;

        if (trimmed.rfind("Symbol table '.dynsym'", 0) == 0)
        {
            inDynamicSymbols = true;
            continue;
        }

        if (trimmed.empty())
        {
            inDynamicSymbols = false;
            continue;
        }

        if (inDynamicSymbols)
        {
            size_t colon = trimmed.find(':');
            if (colon != std::string::npos && colon > 0 && trimmed[0] >= '0' && trimmed[0] <= '9') reference.dynamicSymbols += 1;
            continue;
        }

        if (trimmed.rfind("LOAD ", 0) == 0) reference.loadSegments += 1;

        if (trimmed.find("(SONAME)") != std::string::npos)
        {
            size_t open = trimmed.find('[');
            size_t close = trimmed.find(']');
            if (open != std::string::npos && close != std::string::npos && close > open)
                reference.soname = trimmed.substr(open + 1, close - open - 1);
        }

        if (trimmed.find("(NEEDED)") != std::string::npos)
        {
            size_t open = trimmed.find('[');
            size_t close = trimmed.find(']');
            if (open != std::string::npos && close != std::string::npos && close > open)
                reference.needed.push_back(trimmed.substr(open + 1, close - open - 1));
        }

        if (trimmed.rfind("Relocation section '.relr.dyn'", 0) == 0)
        {
            size_t contains = trimmed.find("contains ");
            if (contains != std::string::npos) reference.relrRelative = strtoull(trimmed.c_str() + contains + 9, nullptr, 10);
        }
    }

    reference.relative = CountOccurrences(output, "R_AARCH64_RELATIVE");
    reference.globalData = CountOccurrences(output, "R_AARCH64_GLOB_DAT");
    reference.jumpSlot = CountOccurrences(output, "R_AARCH64_JUMP_SLOT");
    reference.absolute = CountOccurrences(output, "R_AARCH64_ABS64");

    reference.threadLocal = CountOccurrences(output, "R_AARCH64_TLSDESC") + CountOccurrences(output, "R_AARCH64_TLS_");

    uint64_t named = reference.relative + reference.globalData + reference.jumpSlot + reference.absolute + reference.threadLocal;
    uint64_t allAarch64 = CountOccurrences(output, "R_AARCH64_");
    reference.unsupportedRelocations = allAarch64 > named ? allAarch64 - named : 0;
}

static void CompareOne(const std::string& readelf, const std::string& path)
{
    printf("\n--- %s\n", path.c_str());

    std::string output;
    if (!RunReadelf(readelf, path, output))
    {
        Check(false, "llvm-readelf produced output for " + path);
        return;
    }

    ReferenceImage reference;
    ParseReference(output, reference);

    if (reference.unsupportedRelocations != 0)
    {
        printf("SKIP %s: it uses %llu relocations of types the loader does not implement yet\n", path.c_str(),
               (unsigned long long)reference.unsupportedRelocations);
        skipped += 1;
        return;
    }

    std::string directory = ".";
    size_t slash = path.find_last_of('/');
    if (slash != std::string::npos) directory = path.substr(0, slash);

    GuestRuntime::Configuration configuration;
    configuration.searchPaths.push_back(directory);
    configuration.stubUnresolvedSymbols = true;

    GuestRuntime::Instance instance;
    if (GuestRuntime::Create(configuration, instance) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        Check(false, "the guest runtime started for " + path);
        return;
    }

    uint32_t moduleId = ElfLoader::INVALID_MODULE_ID;
    GuestRuntime::Result loaded = GuestRuntime::Load(instance, path, moduleId);

    if (loaded != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        Check(false, "the loader accepted " + path);
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return;
    }

    const ElfLoader::Library* library = ElfLoader::FindLibrary(GuestRuntime::LibraryNamespace(instance), moduleId);
    if (!library)
    {
        Check(false, "the loaded module has a handle for " + path);
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return;
    }

    CheckEqual(library->segments.size(), reference.loadSegments, "PT_LOAD segments");
    CheckEqual(library->exports.size(), reference.dynamicSymbols, "dynamic symbols");
    CheckEqual(library->relocationCounts.relative, reference.relative, "R_AARCH64_RELATIVE");
    CheckEqual(library->relocationCounts.relrRelative, reference.relrRelative, "RELR-expanded relative");
    CheckEqual(library->relocationCounts.globalData, reference.globalData, "R_AARCH64_GLOB_DAT");
    CheckEqual(library->relocationCounts.jumpSlot, reference.jumpSlot, "R_AARCH64_JUMP_SLOT");
    CheckEqual(library->relocationCounts.absolute, reference.absolute, "R_AARCH64_ABS64");
    CheckEqual(library->relocationCounts.threadLocal, reference.threadLocal, "TLS relocations");

    if (!reference.soname.empty()) Check(library->soname == reference.soname, "DT_SONAME is " + reference.soname);

    CheckEqual(library->dependencies.size(), reference.needed.size(), "DT_NEEDED entries");

    for (size_t index = 0; index < reference.needed.size() && index < library->dependencies.size(); ++index)
        Check(library->dependencies[index] == reference.needed[index], "DT_NEEDED[" + std::to_string(index) + "] is " + reference.needed[index]);

    compared += 1;
    GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 3)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: ElfReadelfDifferentialTest <llvm-readelf> <library.so>...\n");
        return 2;
    }

    std::string readelf = argv[1];

    for (int index = 2; index < argc; ++index) CompareOne(readelf, argv[index]);

    printf("\n%d libraries compared, %d skipped\n", compared, skipped);

    if (compared < MINIMUM_COMPARED_LIBRARIES)
    {
        printf("FAIL only %d libraries were fully compared, which is below the floor of %d - the differential is not proving anything\n",
               compared, MINIMUM_COMPARED_LIBRARIES);
        failures += 1;
    }

    printf("%s: %d checks failed\n", failures == 0 ? "elf-readelf-differential PASSED" : "elf-readelf-differential FAILED", failures);
    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}

```

`tests/framework/src/MessageQueueTest.java`:

```java
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.Message;

public class MessageQueueTest
{
    private static int failures = 0;

    static void check(String name, boolean ok)
    {
        System.out.println((ok ? "PASS " : "FAIL ") + name);
        if (!ok) failures++;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception
    {
        Looper.prepare();
        Handler handler = new Handler();

        Message queued = Message.obtain(handler, 1);
        handler.sendMessage(queued);

        boolean threwOnDoubleEnqueue = false;
        try
        {
            handler.sendMessage(queued);
        }
        catch (IllegalStateException expected)
        {
            threwOnDoubleEnqueue = true;
        }
        check("double enqueue throws instead of self-linking the queue", threwOnDoubleEnqueue);

        boolean threwOnRecycleInUse = false;
        try
        {
            queued.recycle();
        }
        catch (IllegalStateException expected)
        {
            threwOnRecycleInUse = true;
        }
        check("recycle() of a queued message throws", threwOnRecycleInUse);

        Message free = Message.obtain();
        free.recycle();

        boolean threwOnDoubleRecycle = false;
        try
        {
            free.recycle();
        }
        catch (IllegalStateException expected)
        {
            threwOnDoubleRecycle = true;
        }
        check("double recycle throws instead of cycling the pool", threwOnDoubleRecycle);

        check("pool hands out distinct objects", Message.obtain() != Message.obtain());

        final boolean[] dueRan = {false};
        Thread due = new Thread(() ->
        {
            Looper.prepare();
            new Handler().post(() -> dueRan[0] = true);
            Looper.myLooper().quitSafely();
            Looper.loop();
        });
        due.start();
        due.join(5000);
        check("quitSafely delivers an already-due message", dueRan[0]);
        check("quitSafely terminates the loop", !due.isAlive());

        final boolean[] futureRan = {false};
        Thread future = new Thread(() ->
        {
            Looper.prepare();
            new Handler().postDelayed(() -> futureRan[0] = true, 60000);
            Looper.myLooper().quitSafely();
            Looper.loop();
        });
        future.start();
        future.join(5000);
        check("quitSafely drops a not-yet-due message and returns", !future.isAlive() && !futureRan[0]);

        final String[] seen = {null};
        Thread dispatch = new Thread(() ->
        {
            Looper.prepare();
            Handler inner = new Handler()
            {
                @Override
                public void handleMessage(Message message)
                {
                    seen[0] = message.getTarget() == null ? "null" : "present";
                    Looper.myLooper().quit();
                }
            };
            inner.sendEmptyMessage(7);
            Looper.loop();
        });
        dispatch.start();
        dispatch.join(5000);
        check("msg.getTarget() is non-null inside handleMessage", "present".equals(seen[0]));

        final int[] order = {0};
        final StringBuilder sequence = new StringBuilder();
        Thread ordering = new Thread(() ->
        {
            Looper.prepare();
            Handler inner = new Handler();
            inner.postDelayed(() -> sequence.append("b"), 40);
            inner.post(() -> sequence.append("a"));
            inner.postDelayed(() ->
            {
                sequence.append("c");
                Looper.myLooper().quit();
            }, 80);
            Looper.loop();
            order[0] = 1;
        });
        ordering.start();
        ordering.join(5000);
        check("messages dispatch in time order", "abc".contentEquals(sequence) && order[0] == 1);

        System.out.println(failures == 0 ? "ALL PASS" : failures + " FAILURES");
        System.exit(failures == 0 ? 0 : 1);
    }
}
```

`tests/framework/src/StaticLayoutTest.java`:

```java
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.text.Layout;
import android.text.StaticLayout;
import android.text.TextPaint;

public class StaticLayoutTest
{
    private static int failures = 0;

    private static void check(boolean condition, String what)
    {
        System.out.println((condition ? "PASS " : "FAIL ") + what);
        if (!condition) failures++;
    }

    private static TextPaint paintAt(float textSize)
    {
        TextPaint paint = new TextPaint();
        paint.setTextSize(textSize);
        return paint;
    }

    private static StaticLayout layout(String text, float textSize, int width)
    {
        return StaticLayout.Builder.obtain(text, 0, text.length(), paintAt(textSize), width).build();
    }

    private static void testSeamIsPureJava()
    {
        runtime.TextMeasurers.install(new runtime.FixedAdvanceTextMeasurer());

        check(!runtime.TextMeasurers.isNativeBacked(),
              "the host JVM uses the fixed-advance measurer, so no native is required");
        check(runtime.TextMeasurers.get() != null, "a measurer is always available");
    }

    private static void testSingleLineWhenItFits()
    {
        StaticLayout wide = layout("Hello World!", 14f, 10000);
        check(wide.getLineCount() == 1, "text that fits stays on one line");
        check(wide.getLineStart(0) == 0, "the first line starts at zero");
        check(wide.getLineEnd(0) == "Hello World!".length(), "the only line covers the whole string");
    }

    private static void testHardBreaksAlwaysSplit()
    {
        StaticLayout broken = layout("a\nb\nc", 14f, 10000);
        check(broken.getLineCount() == 3, "newlines split lines even when everything fits");

        StaticLayout trailing = layout("ab\n", 14f, 10000);
        check(trailing.getLineCount() == 2, "a trailing newline produces an empty final line");
    }

    private static void testWrappingHappensAtWordBoundaries()
    {
        StaticLayout wrapped = layout("aaa bbb ccc ddd", 14f, 40);
        check(wrapped.getLineCount() > 1, "a narrow width forces wrapping");

        boolean breaksMidWord = false;
        for (int line = 0; line < wrapped.getLineCount(); line++)
        {
            int start = wrapped.getLineStart(line);
            if (start > 0 && wrapped.getText().charAt(start - 1) != ' ') breaksMidWord = true;
        }
        check(!breaksMidWord, "wrapping lands on word boundaries, not mid-word");
    }

    private static void testHeightGrowsWithLines()
    {
        StaticLayout one = layout("aaa", 14f, 10000);
        StaticLayout many = layout("aaa bbb ccc ddd eee fff", 14f, 40);

        check(many.getLineCount() > one.getLineCount(), "the wrapped layout has more lines");
        check(many.getHeight() > one.getHeight(), "height grows with line count");
        check(one.getHeight() > 0, "a single line still has positive height");
    }

    private static void testLineGeometryIsMonotonic()
    {
        StaticLayout wrapped = layout("aaa bbb ccc ddd eee", 14f, 40);

        boolean monotonic = true;
        for (int line = 1; line < wrapped.getLineCount(); line++)
        {
            if (wrapped.getLineTop(line) < wrapped.getLineTop(line - 1)) monotonic = false;
            if (wrapped.getLineStart(line) < wrapped.getLineStart(line - 1)) monotonic = false;
        }

        check(monotonic, "line tops and starts increase monotonically");
        check(wrapped.getLineBottom(wrapped.getLineCount() - 1) == wrapped.getHeight(),
              "the last line's bottom is the layout height");
    }

    private static void testEmptyTextIsOneLine()
    {
        StaticLayout empty = layout("", 14f, 100);
        check(empty.getLineCount() == 1, "empty text still reports one line");
        check(empty.getHeight() > 0, "empty text still has a line height");
    }

    private static void testDesiredWidthTracksTheLongestLine()
    {
        TextPaint paint = paintAt(14f);
        float single = Layout.getDesiredWidth("aaaa", paint);
        float multi = Layout.getDesiredWidth("aa\naaaa\na", paint);

        check(single > 0f, "desired width is positive");
        check(Math.abs(multi - single) < 0.001f, "desired width is the widest line, not the total");
    }

    private static void testStyleKeyTracksTextSize()
    {
        Paint paint = new Paint();
        paint.setTextSize(14f);
        int first = paint.styleId();

        paint.setTextSize(28f);
        int second = paint.styleId();

        check(first != second, "changing the text size invalidates the style key");
        check(paint.measureText("aaaa") > 0f, "measurement still works after the size change");
    }

    private static void testUnbreakableTokenStillWraps()
    {
        StaticLayout layout = layout("supercalifragilistic", 14f, 20);

        check(layout.getLineCount() > 1, "a single unbreakable word wraps by character rather than overflowing");

        float widest = 0f;
        for (int line = 0; line < layout.getLineCount(); line++)
        {
            widest = Math.max(widest, layout.getLineWidth(line));
        }
        check(widest <= 20f, "no line of a character-wrapped word exceeds the requested width");
    }

    private static void testZeroWidthIsNotInfinite()
    {
        StaticLayout narrow = layout("aaa bbb ccc ddd", 14f, 1);
        StaticLayout zero = layout("aaa bbb ccc ddd", 14f, 0);

        check(zero.getLineCount() > 1, "width 0 wraps rather than meaning infinitely wide");
        check(zero.getLineCount() >= narrow.getLineCount(), "width 0 wraps at least as hard as width 1");
    }

    private static void testHardBreakIsNotMeasured()
    {
        StaticLayout broken = layout("ab\ncd", 14f, 10000);
        StaticLayout plain = layout("ab", 14f, 10000);

        check(broken.getLineWidth(0) == plain.getLineWidth(0),
              "a hard-broken line measures its visible text, not the newline that ended it");
    }

    private static void testTrailingSpaceDoesNotForceAnEarlyWrap()
    {
        TextPaint paint = paintAt(14f);
        float twoWords = paint.measureText("aaa bbb");

        StaticLayout layout = StaticLayout.Builder.obtain("aaa bbb ccc", 0, 11, paint, (int)twoWords).build();
        check(layout.getLineEnd(0) > 4, "trailing whitespace is not counted when deciding whether a line fits");
    }

    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        testSeamIsPureJava();
        testSingleLineWhenItFits();
        testHardBreaksAlwaysSplit();
        testWrappingHappensAtWordBoundaries();
        testHeightGrowsWithLines();
        testLineGeometryIsMonotonic();
        testEmptyTextIsOneLine();
        testDesiredWidthTracksTheLongestLine();
        testStyleKeyTracksTextSize();
        testUnbreakableTokenStillWraps();
        testZeroWidthIsNotInfinite();
        testHardBreakIsNotMeasured();
        testTrailingSpaceDoesNotForceAnEarlyWrap();

        System.out.println(failures == 0 ? "ALL PASS" : failures + " FAILURES");
        if (failures != 0) System.exit(1);
    }
}
```

`tests/graphics/host/GraphicsUnit.java`:

```java
import android.graphics.Matrix;
import android.graphics.RectF;

public class GraphicsUnit
{
    private static int checks;
    private static int failures;

    private static void Expect(boolean condition, String description)
    {
        checks++;

        if (condition)
        {
            System.out.println("  ok    " + description);
            return;
        }

        System.out.println("  FAIL  " + description);
        failures++;
    }

    private static void ExpectNear(float actual, float wanted, String description)
    {
        Expect(Math.abs(actual - wanted) < 0.001f, description + " (wanted " + wanted + ", got " + actual + ")");
    }

    private static float[] Map(Matrix matrix, float x, float y)
    {
        float[] point = {x, y};
        matrix.mapPoints(point);

        return point;
    }

    private static void CheckConcatIsNotIgnored()
    {
        Matrix move = new Matrix();
        move.setTranslate(10, 20);

        Matrix scale = new Matrix();
        scale.setScale(2, 3);

        Matrix combined = new Matrix(move);
        combined.preConcat(scale);

        float[] mapped = Map(combined, 1, 1);
        ExpectNear(mapped[0], 12, "preConcat scales before it translates");
        ExpectNear(mapped[1], 23, "preConcat scales before it translates, vertically");

        Matrix other = new Matrix(move);
        other.postConcat(scale);

        float[] posted = Map(other, 1, 1);
        ExpectNear(posted[0], 22, "postConcat translates before it scales");
        ExpectNear(posted[1], 63, "postConcat translates before it scales, vertically");

        Matrix product = new Matrix();
        product.setConcat(move, scale);
        Expect(product.equals(combined), "setConcat matches a preConcat onto the first");
    }

    private static void CheckRotation()
    {
        Matrix turn = new Matrix();
        turn.setRotate(90);

        float[] mapped = Map(turn, 1, 0);
        ExpectNear(mapped[0], 0, "a quarter turn sends x to the origin");
        ExpectNear(mapped[1], 1, "a quarter turn sends x onto y");

        Matrix aboutPoint = new Matrix();
        aboutPoint.setRotate(90, 10, 10);

        float[] pivot = Map(aboutPoint, 10, 10);
        ExpectNear(pivot[0], 10, "a rotation about a pivot leaves the pivot alone");
        ExpectNear(pivot[1], 10, "a rotation about a pivot leaves the pivot alone, vertically");
    }

    private static void CheckScaleCarriesSkew()
    {
        Matrix turned = new Matrix();
        turned.setRotate(90);
        turned.postScale(2, 2);

        float[] mapped = Map(turned, 1, 0);
        ExpectNear(mapped[0], 0, "scaling after a rotation scales the rotated axes");
        ExpectNear(mapped[1], 2, "scaling after a rotation scales the rotated axes, vertically");
    }

    private static void CheckPreTranslateUnderRotation()
    {
        Matrix turned = new Matrix();
        turned.setRotate(90);
        turned.preTranslate(5, 0);

        float[] mapped = Map(turned, 0, 0);
        ExpectNear(mapped[0], 0, "a pre-translate moves along the rotated axes");
        ExpectNear(mapped[1], 5, "a pre-translate moves along the rotated axes, vertically");
    }

    private static void CheckInverseOfARotation()
    {
        Matrix turned = new Matrix();
        turned.setRotate(37);
        turned.postTranslate(11, -4);
        turned.preScale(2, 5);

        Matrix inverse = new Matrix();
        Expect(turned.invert(inverse), "a rotated, scaled, translated matrix inverts");

        float[] point = {3, 7};
        turned.mapPoints(point);
        inverse.mapPoints(point);

        ExpectNear(point[0], 3, "the inverse takes a mapped point back");
        ExpectNear(point[1], 7, "the inverse takes a mapped point back, vertically");

        Matrix singular = new Matrix();
        singular.setScale(0, 4);
        Expect(!singular.invert(new Matrix()), "a singular matrix reports that it cannot invert");
    }

    private static void CheckMapRectUnderRotation()
    {
        Matrix turned = new Matrix();
        turned.setRotate(45);

        RectF box = new RectF(-1, -1, 1, 1);
        boolean stayed = turned.mapRect(box);

        Expect(!stayed, "a forty five degree turn does not keep a rect a rect");
        ExpectNear(box.left, (float) -Math.sqrt(2), "the mapped bounds cover the rotated corners");
        ExpectNear(box.right, (float) Math.sqrt(2), "the mapped bounds cover the rotated corners, on the right");

        Matrix quarter = new Matrix();
        quarter.setRotate(90);
        Expect(quarter.rectStaysRect(), "a quarter turn does keep a rect a rect");
    }

    private static void CheckMapRadius()
    {
        Matrix grown = new Matrix();
        grown.setScale(3, 3);

        ExpectNear(grown.mapRadius(2), 6, "a uniform scale scales a radius by the same amount");
    }

    private static void CheckRectToRect()
    {
        Matrix fit = new Matrix();
        RectF from = new RectF(0, 0, 10, 20);
        RectF to = new RectF(0, 0, 100, 100);

        fit.setRectToRect(from, to, Matrix.ScaleToFit.CENTER);

        RectF result = new RectF(from);
        fit.mapRect(result);

        ExpectNear(result.width(), 50, "a centred fit keeps the aspect ratio");
        ExpectNear(result.height(), 100, "a centred fit fills the constrained axis");
        ExpectNear(result.left, 25, "a centred fit centres what is left over");
    }

    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        System.out.println("graphics geometry:");

        CheckConcatIsNotIgnored();
        CheckRotation();
        CheckScaleCarriesSkew();
        CheckPreTranslateUnderRotation();
        CheckInverseOfARotation();
        CheckMapRectUnderRotation();
        CheckMapRadius();
        CheckRectToRect();

        if (failures != 0)
        {
            System.out.println("graphics-unit FAILED: " + failures + " of " + checks + " checks failed");
            System.exit(1);
        }

        System.out.println("graphics-unit PASSED: " + checks + " checks");
    }
}

```

`tests/graphics/host/PathDataUnit.java`:

```java
package android.util;

public class PathDataUnit
{
    private static int checks;
    private static int failures;

    private static void Expect(boolean condition, String description)
    {
        checks++;

        if (condition)
        {
            System.out.println("  ok    " + description);
            return;
        }

        System.out.println("  FAIL  " + description);
        failures++;
    }

    private static final class Recorder implements PathParser.Sink
    {
        private final StringBuilder mLog = new StringBuilder();

        private static String Round(float value)
        {
            float rounded = Math.round(value * 100) / 100.0f;
            if (rounded == Math.rint(rounded)) return String.valueOf((int) rounded);

            return String.valueOf(rounded);
        }

        @Override
        public void moveTo(float x, float y)
        {
            mLog.append("M").append(Round(x)).append(",").append(Round(y)).append(" ");
        }

        @Override
        public void lineTo(float x, float y)
        {
            mLog.append("L").append(Round(x)).append(",").append(Round(y)).append(" ");
        }

        @Override
        public void quadTo(float controlX, float controlY, float x, float y)
        {
            mLog.append("Q").append(Round(controlX)).append(",").append(Round(controlY)).append(",").append(Round(x))
                .append(",").append(Round(y)).append(" ");
        }

        @Override
        public void cubicTo(float firstX, float firstY, float secondX, float secondY, float x, float y)
        {
            mLog.append("C").append(Round(firstX)).append(",").append(Round(firstY)).append(",").append(Round(secondX))
                .append(",").append(Round(secondY)).append(",").append(Round(x)).append(",").append(Round(y)).append(" ");
        }

        @Override
        public void close()
        {
            mLog.append("Z ");
        }

        String log()
        {
            return mLog.toString().trim();
        }
    }

    private static String Parse(String data)
    {
        Recorder recorder = new Recorder();
        if (!PathParser.parse(data, recorder)) return "REFUSED";

        return recorder.log();
    }

    private static void ExpectParse(String data, String wanted, String description)
    {
        String got = Parse(data);
        Expect(wanted.equals(got), description + " [" + data + "] -> " + got);
    }

    private static void CheckBasicCommands()
    {
        ExpectParse("M10,20 L30,40 Z", "M10,20 L30,40 Z", "absolute move, line and close");
        ExpectParse("m10,20 l5,5", "M10,20 L15,25", "relative commands accumulate");
        ExpectParse("M0,0 H10 V20", "M0,0 L10,0 L10,20", "horizontal and vertical lines hold the other axis");
        ExpectParse("M0,0 h10 v20", "M0,0 L10,0 L10,20", "relative horizontal and vertical");
    }

    private static void CheckRepeatedParameters()
    {
        ExpectParse("M0,0 L1,1 2,2 3,3", "M0,0 L1,1 L2,2 L3,3", "a line command repeats without being named again");
        ExpectParse("M0,0 1,1 2,2", "M0,0 L1,1 L2,2", "a repeated move becomes a line, as the grammar says");
        ExpectParse("m0,0 1,1 2,2", "M0,0 L1,1 L3,3", "a repeated relative move becomes a relative line");
    }

    private static void CheckNumberForms()
    {
        ExpectParse("M1-2L3-4", "M1,-2 L3,-4", "a minus sign separates numbers with no comma");
        ExpectParse("M.5.5L1.5.5", "M0.5,0.5 L1.5,0.5", "a decimal point separates numbers with no comma");
        ExpectParse("M1e2,1E-1", "M100,0.1", "exponents are read");
        ExpectParse("M +1 , +2", "M1,2", "leading plus signs and loose separators are read");
    }

    private static void CheckCurves()
    {
        ExpectParse("M0,0 C1,2,3,4,5,6", "M0,0 C1,2,3,4,5,6", "a cubic passes its control points through");
        ExpectParse("M0,0 Q1,2,3,4", "M0,0 Q1,2,3,4", "a quadratic passes its control point through");

        ExpectParse("M0,0 C1,1,2,2,3,3 S4,4,5,5", "M0,0 C1,1,2,2,3,3 C4,4,4,4,5,5",
                    "a smooth cubic reflects the previous control point");
        ExpectParse("M0,0 S4,4,5,5", "M0,0 C0,0,4,4,5,5", "a smooth cubic with no previous curve starts at the current point");
        ExpectParse("M0,0 Q1,1,2,2 T4,4", "M0,0 Q1,1,2,2 Q3,3,4,4", "a smooth quadratic reflects the previous control point");
    }

    private static void CheckArcs()
    {
        String quarter = Parse("M10,0 A10,10 0 0 1 0,10");
        Expect(quarter.startsWith("M10,0 C"), "an arc becomes cubics");
        Expect(quarter.endsWith("0,10"), "an arc ends where it was told to");

        String flags = Parse("M0,0 a5,5 0 1,1 10,0");
        Expect(!flags.equals("REFUSED"), "arc flags parse when written without spaces");

        ExpectParse("M0,0 A0,0 0 0 1 10,10", "M0,0 L10,10", "an arc with no radius is a straight line");
    }

    private static void CheckRefusals()
    {
        Expect(Parse("10,10 L20,20").equals("REFUSED"), "data that starts without any command is refused");
        Expect(Parse("M10").equals("REFUSED"), "a move missing its second number is refused");
        Expect(Parse("M0,0 A5,5 0 2 1 10,10").equals("REFUSED"), "an arc flag that is not zero or one is refused");
        Expect(PathParser.canParse("M0,0 L1,1"), "canParse accepts what parses");
        Expect(!PathParser.canParse("nonsense"), "canParse refuses what does not");
        Expect(!PathParser.canParse(null), "canParse refuses nothing at all");
        Expect(Parse("").equals(""), "empty data parses to nothing, rather than failing");
    }

    private static void CheckRealIcon()
    {
        String check = "M9,16.17L4.83,12l-1.42,1.41L9,19 21,7l-1.41,-1.41z";
        String got = Parse(check);

        Expect(!got.equals("REFUSED"), "a real material icon path parses");
        Expect(got.startsWith("M9,16.17 L4.83,12 "), "the icon's first two points are right");
        Expect(got.endsWith("Z"), "the icon closes");
    }

    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        System.out.println("path data:");

        CheckBasicCommands();
        CheckRepeatedParameters();
        CheckNumberForms();
        CheckCurves();
        CheckArcs();
        CheckRefusals();
        CheckRealIcon();

        if (failures != 0)
        {
            System.out.println("path-data FAILED: " + failures + " of " + checks + " checks failed");
            System.exit(1);
        }

        System.out.println("path-data PASSED: " + checks + " checks");
    }
}
```

`tests/graphics/host/PointerUnit.java`:

```java
package runtime;

import android.view.MotionEvent;

import java.util.ArrayList;

public class PointerUnit
{
    private static int checks;
    private static int failures;

    private static void Expect(boolean condition, String description)
    {
        checks++;

        if (condition)
        {
            System.out.println("  ok    " + description);
            return;
        }

        System.out.println("  FAIL  " + description);
        failures++;
    }

    private static final class Recorder implements PointerTracker.Sink
    {
        private final ArrayList<String> mSeen = new ArrayList<>();

        @Override
        public void onMotion(MotionEvent event)
        {
            StringBuilder line = new StringBuilder();
            line.append(name(event.getActionMasked()));

            if (event.getActionMasked() == MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN
                || event.getActionMasked() == MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP)
            {
                line.append("#").append(event.getActionIndex());
            }

            line.append("(");
            for (int index = 0; index < event.getPointerCount(); index++)
            {
                if (index > 0) line.append(" ");
                line.append(event.getPointerId(index)).append(":").append((int) event.getX(index)).append(",")
                    .append((int) event.getY(index));
            }
            line.append(")");

            mSeen.add(line.toString());
        }

        String log()
        {
            return String.join(" ", mSeen);
        }
    }

    private static String name(int action)
    {
        switch (action)
        {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN: return "DOWN";
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP: return "UP";
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE: return "MOVE";
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL: return "CANCEL";
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN: return "PDOWN";
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP: return "PUP";
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_MOVE: return "HOVER";
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_ENTER: return "ENTER";
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_EXIT: return "EXIT";
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_SCROLL: return "SCROLL";
            default: return "?" + action;
        }
    }

    private static void CheckOneFinger()
    {
        PointerTracker tracker = new PointerTracker();
        Recorder recorder = new Recorder();

        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 0, 10, 20, 1, 0, recorder);
        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, 0, 11, 21, 2, 0, recorder);
        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 0, 12, 22, 3, 0, recorder);

        Expect("DOWN(0:10,20) MOVE(0:11,21) UP(0:12,22)".equals(recorder.log()),
               "one finger goes down, moves and comes up: " + recorder.log());
        Expect(tracker.getPointerCount() == 0, "the finger is forgotten once it lifts");
    }

    private static void CheckSecondFinger()
    {
        PointerTracker tracker = new PointerTracker();
        Recorder recorder = new Recorder();

        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 7, 10, 10, 1, 0, recorder);
        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN, 9, 50, 50, 2, 0, recorder);

        Expect(recorder.log().contains("PDOWN#1(7:10,10 9:50,50)"),
               "a second finger arrives as a pointer down at index one: " + recorder.log());
        Expect(tracker.getPointerCount() == 2, "both fingers are held");
    }

    private static void CheckFirstFingerLiftsFirst()
    {
        PointerTracker tracker = new PointerTracker();
        Recorder recorder = new Recorder();

        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 7, 10, 10, 1, 0, recorder);
        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN, 9, 50, 50, 2, 0, recorder);
        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP, 7, 10, 10, 3, 0, recorder);
        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, 9, 60, 60, 4, 0, recorder);
        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 9, 60, 60, 5, 0, recorder);

        String log = recorder.log();

        Expect(log.contains("PUP#0(7:10,10 9:50,50)"), "the first finger lifts as index zero: " + log);
        Expect(log.contains("MOVE(9:60,60)"), "the remaining finger keeps its own id and slides down to index zero: " + log);
        Expect(log.endsWith("UP(9:60,60)"), "the last finger up is a plain up, not a pointer up: " + log);
        Expect(tracker.getPointerCount() == 0, "nothing is held at the end");
    }

    private static void CheckCancel()
    {
        PointerTracker tracker = new PointerTracker();
        Recorder recorder = new Recorder();

        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 1, 5, 5, 1, 0, recorder);
        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN, 2, 6, 6, 2, 0, recorder);
        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL, 1, 5, 5, 3, 0, recorder);

        Expect(recorder.log().contains("CANCEL(1:5,5 2:6,6)"), "a cancel reports every pointer still down: " + recorder.log());
        Expect(tracker.getPointerCount() == 0, "a cancel drops every pointer");
    }

    private static void CheckHover()
    {
        PointerTracker tracker = new PointerTracker();
        Recorder recorder = new Recorder();

        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_ENTER, 0, 3, 4, 1, 0, recorder);
        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_MOVE, 0, 5, 6, 2, 0, recorder);
        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_EXIT, 0, 7, 8, 3, 0, recorder);

        Expect("ENTER(0:3,4) HOVER(0:5,6) EXIT(0:7,8)".equals(recorder.log()),
               "hover passes through without becoming a press: " + recorder.log());
        Expect(tracker.getPointerCount() == 0, "hovering never counts as a finger down");
    }

    private static void CheckStrayEvents()
    {
        PointerTracker tracker = new PointerTracker();
        Recorder recorder = new Recorder();

        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, 4, 1, 1, 1, 0, recorder);
        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 4, 1, 1, 2, 0, recorder);

        Expect(recorder.log().isEmpty(), "a move or up for a finger that never went down is ignored: " + recorder.log());

        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 4, 1, 1, 3, 0, recorder);
        tracker.track(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 4, 2, 2, 4, 0, recorder);

        Expect(tracker.getPointerCount() == 1, "the same finger going down twice is still one finger");
    }

    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        System.out.println("pointer tracking:");

        CheckOneFinger();
        CheckSecondFinger();
        CheckFirstFingerLiftsFirst();
        CheckCancel();
        CheckHover();
        CheckStrayEvents();

        if (failures != 0)
        {
            System.out.println("pointer FAILED: " + failures + " of " + checks + " checks failed");
            System.exit(1);
        }

        System.out.println("pointer PASSED: " + checks + " checks");
    }
}
```

`tests/graphics/src/com/example/graphics/DrawablesActivity.java`:

```java
package com.example.graphics;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable;
import android.graphics.drawable.LayerDrawable;
import android.graphics.drawable.StateListDrawable;
import android.graphics.drawable.VectorDrawable;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.util.Log;
import android.view.View;

public class DrawablesActivity extends Activity
{
    private static final String TAG = "Drawables";
    private static final int PRESSED_STATE = 0x010100a7;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        Log.i(TAG, "DrawablesActivity.onCreate package=" + getPackageName());

        setContentView(new DrawablesView(this));
    }

    private static final class DrawablesView extends View
    {
        private final Paint mPaint = new Paint();

        DrawablesView(Activity activity)
        {
            super(activity);
        }

        @Override
        protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas)
        {
            int width = getWidth();
            int height = getHeight();

            mPaint.setColor(0xFF141A26);
            canvas.drawRect(0, 0, width, height, mPaint);

            drawVector(canvas, R.drawable.icon_check, "check", 20, 20, 100);
            drawVector(canvas, R.drawable.icon_ring, "ring", 140, 20, 100);

            drawShape(canvas, R.drawable.panel, "panel", 20, 140, 160, 60);
            drawLayers(canvas, R.drawable.stack, "stack", 200, 140, 80, 80);
            drawSelector(canvas, R.drawable.toggle, "toggle", 300, 140, 80, 80);
        }

        private void drawVector(Canvas canvas, int id, String label, int x, int y, int size)
        {
            Drawable drawable = getResources().getDrawable(id);

            Log.i(TAG, label + " is " + (drawable == null ? "null" : drawable.getClass().getSimpleName()));
            if (drawable == null) return;

            Log.i(TAG, label + " intrinsic " + drawable.getIntrinsicWidth() + "x" + drawable.getIntrinsicHeight());

            drawable.setBounds(x, y, x + size, y + size);
            drawable.draw(canvas);
        }

        private void drawShape(Canvas canvas, int id, String label, int x, int y, int width, int height)
        {
            Drawable drawable = getResources().getDrawable(id);

            Log.i(TAG, label + " is " + (drawable == null ? "null" : drawable.getClass().getSimpleName()));
            if (!(drawable instanceof GradientDrawable)) return;

            drawable.setBounds(x, y, x + width, y + height);
            drawable.draw(canvas);
        }

        private void drawLayers(Canvas canvas, int id, String label, int x, int y, int width, int height)
        {
            Drawable drawable = getResources().getDrawable(id);

            Log.i(TAG, label + " is " + (drawable == null ? "null" : drawable.getClass().getSimpleName()));
            if (!(drawable instanceof LayerDrawable)) return;

            Log.i(TAG, label + " has " + ((LayerDrawable) drawable).getNumberOfLayers() + " layers");

            drawable.setBounds(x, y, x + width, y + height);
            drawable.draw(canvas);
        }

        private void drawSelector(Canvas canvas, int id, String label, int x, int y, int width, int height)
        {
            Drawable drawable = getResources().getDrawable(id);

            Log.i(TAG, label + " is " + (drawable == null ? "null" : drawable.getClass().getSimpleName()));
            if (!(drawable instanceof StateListDrawable)) return;

            StateListDrawable selector = (StateListDrawable) drawable;
            Log.i(TAG, label + " has " + selector.getStateCount() + " states, stateful=" + selector.isStateful());

            selector.setState(new int[0]);
            Drawable resting = selector.getCurrent();

            selector.setState(new int[] {PRESSED_STATE});
            Drawable pressed = selector.getCurrent();

            Log.i(TAG, label + " picks a different drawable when pressed=" + (resting != pressed));

            selector.setState(new int[0]);
            drawable.setBounds(x, y, x + width, y + height / 2 - 2);
            drawable.draw(canvas);

            selector.setState(new int[] {PRESSED_STATE});
            drawable.setBounds(x, y + height / 2 + 2, x + width, y + height);
            drawable.draw(canvas);
        }
    }
}
```

`tests/graphics/src/com/example/graphics/InteractionActivity.java`:

```java
package com.example.graphics;

import android.animation.Animator;
import android.animation.ValueAnimator;
import android.app.Activity;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.util.Log;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager;
import android.widget.EditText;

public class InteractionActivity extends Activity
{
    private static final String TAG = "Interaction";

    private Panel mPanel;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        Log.i(TAG, "InteractionActivity.onCreate package=" + getPackageName());

        mPanel = new Panel(this);
        setContentView(mPanel);

        new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                runScript();
            }
        }, 120);
    }

    private void runScript()
    {
        Log.i(TAG, "draws before any input: " + mPanel.drawCount());

        mPanel.expectIdle();

        press(mPanel.first(), 30, 30);
        Log.i(TAG, "first target touched=" + mPanel.first().touched() + " focused=" + mPanel.first().isFocused());

        press(mPanel.second(), 30, 30);
        Log.i(TAG, "second target focused=" + mPanel.second().isFocused()
                   + " first still focused=" + mPanel.first().isFocused());

        twoFingers();
        Log.i(TAG, "the panel saw " + mPanel.mostPointers() + " pointers at once");

        cancel();
        Log.i(TAG, "the panel saw a cancel=" + mPanel.sawCancel());

        typeIntoField();
        runAnimation();

        int before = mPanel.drawCount();
        mPanel.invalidate();

        new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed(new Runnable()
        {
            @Override
            public void run()
            {
                Log.i(TAG, "an invalidate produced " + (mPanel.drawCount() - before) + " more draw");
                Log.i(TAG, "final draw count " + mPanel.drawCount());

                finish();
            }
        }, 200);
    }

    private void typeIntoField()
    {
        EditText field = mPanel.field();
        InputMethodManager input = (InputMethodManager) getSystemService(INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);

        field.requestFocus();
        Log.i(TAG, "the field is a text editor=" + field.onCheckIsTextEditor() + " focused=" + field.isFocused());

        input.showSoftInput(field, 0);
        Log.i(TAG, "input started for the field=" + input.isActive(field));

        type(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_H);
        type(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_I);
        type(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SPACE);
        type(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_5);

        Log.i(TAG, "the field now reads '" + field.getText() + "'");

        type(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DEL);
        Log.i(TAG, "after a delete it reads '" + field.getText() + "'");

        mPanel.second().requestFocus();
        Log.i(TAG, "moving focus away left the field focused=" + field.isFocused());
    }

    private void type(int keyCode)
    {
        KeyEvent down = new KeyEvent(KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN, keyCode);
        dispatchKeyEvent(down);
    }

    private void runAnimation()
    {
        final float[] seen = new float[2];
        final int[] updates = new int[1];

        ValueAnimator animator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 100f);
        animator.setDuration(60);

        animator.addUpdateListener(new ValueAnimator.AnimatorUpdateListener()
        {
            @Override
            public void onAnimationUpdate(ValueAnimator animation)
            {
                updates[0]++;
                seen[1] = ((Float) animation.getAnimatedValue()).floatValue();
                if (updates[0] == 1) seen[0] = seen[1];
            }
        });

        animator.addListener(new android.animation.AnimatorListenerAdapter()
        {
            @Override
            public void onAnimationEnd(Animator animation)
            {
                Log.i(TAG, "the animation stepped more than once=" + (updates[0] > 1) + " and finished at "
                           + Math.round(seen[1]));
                Log.i(TAG, "the animation is still running=" + animation.isRunning());
            }
        });

        animator.start();
        Log.i(TAG, "the animation started running=" + animator.isRunning());
    }

    private void press(Target target, float localX, float localY)
    {
        float x = target.getLeft() + localX;
        float y = target.getTop() + localY;

        send(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, x, y);
        send(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, x, y);
    }

    private void send(int action, float x, float y)
    {
        MotionEvent event = MotionEvent.obtain(0, 0, action, x, y, 0);
        dispatchTouchEvent(event);
        event.recycle();
    }

    private void twoFingers()
    {
        float baseX = mPanel.first().getLeft() + 10;
        float baseY = mPanel.first().getTop() + 10;

        MotionEvent.PointerProperties[] properties = new MotionEvent.PointerProperties[2];
        MotionEvent.PointerCoords[] coordinates = new MotionEvent.PointerCoords[2];

        for (int index = 0; index < 2; index++)
        {
            properties[index] = new MotionEvent.PointerProperties();
            properties[index].id = index;
            properties[index].toolType = MotionEvent.TOOL_TYPE_FINGER;

            coordinates[index] = new MotionEvent.PointerCoords();
            coordinates[index].x = baseX + index * 10;
            coordinates[index].y = baseY + index * 10;
            coordinates[index].pressure = 1.0f;
        }

        send(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, properties, coordinates, 1);
        send(MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN | (1 << MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_INDEX_SHIFT), properties, coordinates, 2);
        send(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, properties, coordinates, 2);
        send(MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP | (1 << MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_INDEX_SHIFT), properties, coordinates, 2);
        send(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, properties, coordinates, 1);
    }

    private void send(int action, MotionEvent.PointerProperties[] properties, MotionEvent.PointerCoords[] coordinates,
                      int pointerCount)
    {
        MotionEvent event = MotionEvent.obtain(0, 0, action, pointerCount, properties, coordinates, 0, 0, 1.0f, 1.0f, 0, 0,
                                               0x1002, 0);
        dispatchTouchEvent(event);
        event.recycle();
    }

    private void cancel()
    {
        float x = mPanel.first().getLeft() + 5;
        float y = mPanel.first().getTop() + 5;

        send(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, x, y);

        MotionEvent event = MotionEvent.obtain(0, 0, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL, x, y, 0);
        dispatchTouchEvent(event);
        event.recycle();
    }

    private static final class Panel extends ViewGroup
    {
        private final Paint mPaint = new Paint();
        private final Target mFirst;
        private final Target mSecond;
        private final EditText mField;

        private int mDrawCount;
        private int mMostPointers;
        private boolean mSawCancel;
        private int mIdleDrawCount = -1;

        Panel(Activity activity)
        {
            super(activity);

            mFirst = new Target(activity, 0xFF3F7FD0);
            mSecond = new Target(activity, 0xFFD07F3F);
            mField = new EditText(activity);

            addView(mFirst);
            addView(mSecond);
            addView(mField);
        }

        EditText field()
        {
            return mField;
        }

        Target first()
        {
            return mFirst;
        }

        Target second()
        {
            return mSecond;
        }

        int drawCount()
        {
            return mDrawCount;
        }

        int mostPointers()
        {
            return mMostPointers;
        }

        boolean sawCancel()
        {
            return mSawCancel;
        }

        void expectIdle()
        {
            mIdleDrawCount = mDrawCount;
        }

        @Override
        protected void onLayout(boolean changed, int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
        {
            mFirst.layout(20, 20, 120, 120);
            mSecond.layout(160, 20, 260, 120);
            mField.layout(20, 160, 300, 200);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
        {
            if (event.getPointerCount() > mMostPointers) mMostPointers = event.getPointerCount();
            if (event.getActionMasked() == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL) mSawCancel = true;

            return super.dispatchTouchEvent(event);
        }

        @Override
        protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas)
        {
            mDrawCount++;

            mPaint.setColor(0xFF16202E);
            canvas.drawRect(0, 0, getWidth(), getHeight(), mPaint);

            if (mDrawCount < 3) invalidate();
        }
    }

    private static final class Target extends View
    {
        private final Paint mPaint = new Paint();
        private final int mColor;

        private boolean mTouched;

        Target(Activity activity, int color)
        {
            super(activity);

            mColor = color;
            setFocusable(true);
        }

        boolean touched()
        {
            return mTouched;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event)
        {
            if (event.getActionMasked() == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN)
            {
                mTouched = true;
                requestFocus();
            }

            return true;
        }

        @Override
        protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas)
        {
            mPaint.setColor(isFocused() ? 0xFFFFFFFF : mColor);
            canvas.drawRect(0, 0, getWidth(), getHeight(), mPaint);
        }
    }
}
```

`tests/graphics/src/com/example/graphics/ShapesActivity.java`:

```java
package com.example.graphics;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory;
import android.graphics.BitmapShader;
import android.graphics.BlurMaskFilter;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.DashPathEffect;
import android.graphics.LinearGradient;
import android.graphics.Matrix;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.graphics.RadialGradient;
import android.graphics.RecordingCanvas;
import android.graphics.RectF;
import android.graphics.RenderNode;
import android.graphics.Shader;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.util.Log;
import android.view.View;

public class ShapesActivity extends Activity
{
    private static final String TAG = "Shapes";

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        Log.i(TAG, "ShapesActivity.onCreate package=" + getPackageName());

        setContentView(new ShapesView(this));
    }

    private static final class ShapesView extends View
    {
        private final Paint mPaint = new Paint();
        private final Path mPath = new Path();

        ShapesView(Activity activity)
        {
            super(activity);
        }

        @Override
        protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas)
        {
            int width = getWidth();
            int height = getHeight();
            int entrySaveCount = canvas.getSaveCount();

            mPaint.setShader(null);
            mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
            mPaint.setColor(0xFF101828);
            canvas.drawRect(0, 0, width, height, mPaint);

            drawShadowAndDashes(canvas, width, height);
            drawTriangle(canvas, width, height);
            drawRoundRect(canvas, width, height);
            drawGradient(canvas, width, height);
            drawClipped(canvas, width, height);
            drawLayer(canvas, width, height);
            drawStroked(canvas, width, height);
            drawThroughRenderNode(canvas, width, height);
            drawBitmaps(canvas, width, height);

            Log.i(TAG, "ShapesView.onDraw " + width + "x" + height);
            Log.i(TAG, "saveCount balanced=" + (canvas.getSaveCount() == entrySaveCount));
        }

        private void drawTriangle(Canvas canvas, int width, int height)
        {
            mPath.reset();
            mPath.moveTo(width * 0.25f, height * 0.06f);
            mPath.lineTo(width * 0.40f, height * 0.30f);
            mPath.lineTo(width * 0.10f, height * 0.30f);
            mPath.close();

            mPaint.setShader(null);
            mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
            mPaint.setColor(0xFFE04050);
            canvas.drawPath(mPath, mPaint);
        }

        private void drawRoundRect(Canvas canvas, int width, int height)
        {
            mPaint.setShader(null);
            mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
            mPaint.setColor(0xFF40C060);
            canvas.drawRoundRect(width * 0.55f, height * 0.06f, width * 0.92f, height * 0.30f, 18, 18, mPaint);
        }

        private void drawGradient(Canvas canvas, int width, int height)
        {
            LinearGradient gradient = new LinearGradient(width * 0.10f, 0, width * 0.45f, 0, 0xFF102080, 0xFF60D0FF,
                                                         Shader.TileMode.CLAMP);

            mPaint.setShader(gradient);
            mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
            canvas.drawRect(width * 0.10f, height * 0.36f, width * 0.45f, height * 0.56f, mPaint);
            mPaint.setShader(null);
        }

        private void drawClipped(Canvas canvas, int width, int height)
        {
            canvas.save();

            Path clip = new Path();
            clip.addOval(width * 0.55f, height * 0.36f, width * 0.92f, height * 0.56f, Path.Direction.CW);
            canvas.clipPath(clip);

            RadialGradient radial = new RadialGradient(width * 0.73f, height * 0.46f, width * 0.20f, 0xFFFFC020,
                                                       0xFF803000, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP);
            mPaint.setShader(radial);
            canvas.drawRect(width * 0.50f, height * 0.32f, width * 0.98f, height * 0.60f, mPaint);
            mPaint.setShader(null);

            canvas.restore();
        }

        private void drawLayer(Canvas canvas, int width, int height)
        {
            int before = canvas.getSaveCount();

            canvas.saveLayerAlpha(width * 0.10f, height * 0.62f, width * 0.45f, height * 0.92f, 128);

            mPaint.setShader(null);
            mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
            mPaint.setColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
            canvas.drawRect(width * 0.10f, height * 0.62f, width * 0.45f, height * 0.92f, mPaint);

            canvas.restore();

            Log.i(TAG, "layer balanced=" + (canvas.getSaveCount() == before));
        }

        private void drawBitmaps(Canvas canvas, int width, int height)
        {
            Bitmap tile = Bitmap.createBitmap(8, 8, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
            for (int y = 0; y < 8; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < 8; x++)
                {
                    boolean light = ((x / 4) + (y / 4)) % 2 == 0;
                    tile.setPixel(x, y, light ? 0xFF5A6478 : 0xFF2A3040);
                }
            }

            Log.i(TAG, "bitmap made " + tile.getWidth() + "x" + tile.getHeight() + " alpha=" + tile.hasAlpha());
            Log.i(TAG, "bitmap pixel readback=" + Integer.toHexString(tile.getPixel(0, 0)));

            Paint tiled = new Paint();
            tiled.setShader(new BitmapShader(tile, Shader.TileMode.REPEAT, Shader.TileMode.REPEAT));
            canvas.drawRect(width * 0.10f, height * 0.62f, width * 0.28f, height * 0.92f, tiled);

            Bitmap scaled = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(tile, 32, 32, false);
            Log.i(TAG, "bitmap scaled to " + scaled.getWidth() + "x" + scaled.getHeight());

            canvas.drawBitmap(scaled, null, new RectF(width * 0.30f, height * 0.62f, width * 0.45f, height * 0.80f), null);

            byte[] encoded = readAsset("badge.png");
            Log.i(TAG, "png asset bytes=" + (encoded == null ? -1 : encoded.length));

            Bitmap decoded = BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(encoded, 0, encoded == null ? 0 : encoded.length);
            Log.i(TAG, "png decoded=" + (decoded != null));

            if (decoded != null)
            {
                Log.i(TAG, "png size " + decoded.getWidth() + "x" + decoded.getHeight() + " alpha=" + decoded.hasAlpha());
                canvas.drawBitmap(decoded, null, new RectF(width * 0.30f, height * 0.82f, width * 0.45f, height * 0.92f),
                                  null);
            }

            BitmapFactory.Options bounds = new BitmapFactory.Options();
            bounds.inJustDecodeBounds = true;
            BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(encoded, 0, encoded.length, bounds);
            Log.i(TAG, "png measured " + bounds.outWidth + "x" + bounds.outHeight + " type=" + bounds.outMimeType);
        }

        private byte[] readAsset(String name)
        {
            try (java.io.InputStream stream = getContext().getAssets().open(name))
            {
                java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream collected = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
                byte[] chunk = new byte[4096];

                int read;
                while ((read = stream.read(chunk)) > 0) collected.write(chunk, 0, read);

                return collected.toByteArray();
            }
            catch (java.io.IOException failure)
            {
                Log.i(TAG, "asset " + name + " unreadable: " + failure);
                return null;
            }
        }

        private void drawShadowAndDashes(Canvas canvas, int width, int height)
        {
            Paint shadow = new Paint();
            shadow.setColor(0xFF000000);
            shadow.setMaskFilter(new BlurMaskFilter(6, BlurMaskFilter.Blur.NORMAL));
            canvas.drawRoundRect(width * 0.50f, height * 0.06f, width * 0.87f, height * 0.30f, 18, 18, shadow);

            Paint dashes = new Paint();
            dashes.setColor(0xFFB0B8C8);
            dashes.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
            dashes.setStrokeWidth(2);
            dashes.setPathEffect(new DashPathEffect(new float[] {8, 6}, 0));

            Path line = new Path();
            line.moveTo(width * 0.06f, height * 0.335f);
            line.lineTo(width * 0.94f, height * 0.335f);
            canvas.drawPath(line, dashes);

            Log.i(TAG, "shadow and dashes drawn");
        }

        private void drawThroughRenderNode(Canvas canvas, int width, int height)
        {
            RenderNode node = new RenderNode("badge");
            node.setPosition(0, 0, 60, 60);

            RecordingCanvas recording = node.beginRecording(60, 60);

            Paint paint = new Paint();
            paint.setColor(0xFFFF40A0);
            recording.drawOval(0, 0, 60, 60, paint);

            paint.setColor(0xFF201030);
            recording.drawRect(24, 10, 36, 50, paint);

            node.endRecording();

            Log.i(TAG, "renderNode recorded=" + node.hasDisplayList());

            node.setTranslationX(width * 0.46f);
            node.setTranslationY(height * 0.70f);
            node.setScaleX(0.9f);
            node.setScaleY(0.9f);
            node.setRotationZ(15);
            node.setAlpha(0.85f);

            canvas.drawRenderNode(node);

            Matrix nodeMatrix = new Matrix();
            node.getMatrix(nodeMatrix);
            Log.i(TAG, "renderNode identity=" + node.hasIdentityMatrix() + " mapped="
                       + (nodeMatrix.isIdentity() ? "identity" : "transformed"));
        }

        private void drawStroked(Canvas canvas, int width, int height)
        {
            canvas.save();

            Matrix spin = new Matrix();
            spin.setRotate(20, width * 0.73f, height * 0.77f);
            canvas.concat(spin);

            mPath.reset();
            mPath.addRect(new RectF(width * 0.60f, height * 0.66f, width * 0.86f, height * 0.88f), Path.Direction.CW);

            mPaint.setShader(null);
            mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
            mPaint.setStrokeWidth(6);
            mPaint.setStrokeJoin(Paint.Join.ROUND);
            mPaint.setColor(0xFF80E0FF);
            canvas.drawPath(mPath, mPaint);

            canvas.restore();
            mPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
        }
    }
}
```

`tests/guest/src/control.c`:

```c
#include <stdint.h>

typedef int (*Operation)(int, int);

static int AddOperation(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
static int SubtractOperation(int a, int b) { return a - b; }
static int MultiplyOperation(int a, int b) { return a * b; }

static Operation OPERATIONS[] = {AddOperation, SubtractOperation, MultiplyOperation};

int Dispatch(int selector, int a, int b)
{
    if (selector < 0 || selector >= 3) return 0;
    return OPERATIONS[selector](a, b);
}

int Classify(int value)
{
    switch (value)
    {
        case 0: return 10;
        case 1: return 20;
        case 2: return 30;
        case 3: return 40;
        case 7: return 70;
        case 11: return 110;
        case 13: return 130;
        default: return -1;
    }
}

uint64_t Fibonacci(int index)
{
    if (index < 2) return (uint64_t)index;
    return Fibonacci(index - 1) + Fibonacci(index - 2);
}

int NestedLoops(int width, int height)
{
    int total = 0;
    for (int y = 0; y < height; ++y)
    {
        for (int x = 0; x < width; ++x)
        {
            if (((x ^ y) & 3) == 0) total += x * y;
            else if (x > y) total -= x;
            else total += 1;
        }
    }
    return total;
}
```

`tests/guest/src/integer.c`:

```c
#include <stdint.h>

uint64_t MixBits(uint64_t value, uint64_t salt)
{
    value ^= value >> 33;
    value *= 0xff51afd7ed558ccdull;
    value ^= value >> 29;
    value *= salt | 1;
    value ^= value >> 32;
    return value;
}

int64_t SaturatingScale(int64_t value, int32_t numerator, int32_t denominator)
{
    if (denominator == 0) return value < 0 ? INT64_MIN : INT64_MAX;

    int64_t scaled = value * (int64_t)numerator;
    if (numerator != 0 && scaled / numerator != value) return value < 0 ? INT64_MIN : INT64_MAX;
    return scaled / denominator;
}

uint32_t PopulationCount(uint64_t value)
{
    uint32_t total = 0;
    while (value)
    {
        value &= value - 1;
        total += 1;
    }
    return total;
}

uint64_t RotateAndMask(uint64_t value, unsigned amount, uint64_t mask)
{
    amount &= 63;
    uint64_t rotated = amount == 0 ? value : ((value >> amount) | (value << (64 - amount)));
    return (rotated & mask) | ((~rotated) & ~mask);
}

int CompareChain(int64_t a, int64_t b, int64_t c)
{
    if (a < b) return a < c ? -1 : 1;
    if (a > b) return b < c ? 2 : -2;
    return c == a ? 0 : 3;
}
```
