`tests/litmus/src/LitmusHarness.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <pthread.h>
#include <sched.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define CACHE_LINE 128
#define DEFAULT_ITERATIONS 200000

struct Cells
{
    alignas(CACHE_LINE) uint64_t x;
    alignas(CACHE_LINE) uint64_t y;
};

struct LitmusTest
{
    const char* name;
    void (*Writer)(struct Cells* cells, uint64_t* observed);
    void (*Reader)(struct Cells* cells, uint64_t* first, uint64_t* second);
    int forbiddenFirst;
    int forbiddenSecond;
    bool hasForbidden;
    int requiredSlot;
};

static void MessagePassingWriterRelaxed(struct Cells* cells, uint64_t* observed)
{
    (void)observed;
    asm volatile("str %1, [%0]" : : "r"(&cells->x), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
    asm volatile("str %1, [%0]" : : "r"(&cells->y), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
}

static void MessagePassingWriterBarrier(struct Cells* cells, uint64_t* observed)
{
    (void)observed;
    asm volatile("str %1, [%0]\n\tdmb ish" : : "r"(&cells->x), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
    asm volatile("str %1, [%0]" : : "r"(&cells->y), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
}

static void MessagePassingWriterRelease(struct Cells* cells, uint64_t* observed)
{
    (void)observed;
    asm volatile("str %1, [%0]" : : "r"(&cells->x), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
    asm volatile("stlr %1, [%0]" : : "r"(&cells->y), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
}

static void MessagePassingReaderRelaxed(struct Cells* cells, uint64_t* first, uint64_t* second)
{
    asm volatile("ldr %0, [%1]" : "=r"(*first) : "r"(&cells->y) : "memory");
    asm volatile("ldr %0, [%1]" : "=r"(*second) : "r"(&cells->x) : "memory");
}

static void MessagePassingReaderBarrier(struct Cells* cells, uint64_t* first, uint64_t* second)
{
    asm volatile("ldr %0, [%1]\n\tdmb ish" : "=r"(*first) : "r"(&cells->y) : "memory");
    asm volatile("ldr %0, [%1]" : "=r"(*second) : "r"(&cells->x) : "memory");
}

static void MessagePassingReaderAcquire(struct Cells* cells, uint64_t* first, uint64_t* second)
{
    asm volatile("ldar %0, [%1]" : "=r"(*first) : "r"(&cells->y) : "memory");
    asm volatile("ldr %0, [%1]" : "=r"(*second) : "r"(&cells->x) : "memory");
}

static void StoreBufferWriter(struct Cells* cells, uint64_t* observed)
{
    asm volatile("str %1, [%0]" : : "r"(&cells->x), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
    asm volatile("ldr %0, [%1]" : "=r"(*observed) : "r"(&cells->y) : "memory");
}

static void StoreBufferReader(struct Cells* cells, uint64_t* first, uint64_t* second)
{
    (void)first;
    asm volatile("str %1, [%0]" : : "r"(&cells->y), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
    asm volatile("ldr %0, [%1]" : "=r"(*second) : "r"(&cells->x) : "memory");
}

static const struct LitmusTest LITMUS_TESTS[] = {
    {"mp_relaxed", MessagePassingWriterRelaxed, MessagePassingReaderRelaxed, 0, 0, false, 3},
    {"mp_dmb_ish", MessagePassingWriterBarrier, MessagePassingReaderBarrier, 1, 0, true, 3},
    {"mp_release_acquire", MessagePassingWriterRelease, MessagePassingReaderAcquire, 1, 0, true, 3},
    {"sb_relaxed", StoreBufferWriter, StoreBufferReader, 0, 0, false, 0},
};

#define LITMUS_TEST_COUNT ((int)(sizeof(LITMUS_TESTS) / sizeof(LITMUS_TESTS[0])))

static struct Cells gCells;
static const struct LitmusTest* gTest;
static uint64_t gWriterObserved;
static volatile int gWriterRound;
static volatile int gStop;
static int gWriterCpu;
alignas(CACHE_LINE) static int gArrived;

static void Barrier(int round)
{
    __atomic_add_fetch(&gArrived, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    while (__atomic_load_n(&gArrived, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST) < 2 * round) { }
}

static void PinTo(int cpu)
{
    cpu_set_t set;
    CPU_ZERO(&set);
    CPU_SET(cpu, &set);
    sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(set), &set);
}

static void* WriterThread(void* argument)
{
    (void)argument;
    PinTo(gWriterCpu);

    for (int round = 1;; ++round)
    {
        if (gStop) return NULL;

        Barrier(round);
        if (gStop) return NULL;

        gTest->Writer(&gCells, &gWriterObserved);
        gWriterRound = round;
    }
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    int iterations = argc > 1 ? atoi(argv[1]) : DEFAULT_ITERATIONS;
    if (iterations <= 0) iterations = DEFAULT_ITERATIONS;

    gWriterCpu = 0;
    PinTo(4);

    for (int index = 0; index < LITMUS_TEST_COUNT; ++index)
    {
        const struct LitmusTest* test = &LITMUS_TESTS[index];

        gTest = test;
        gWriterRound = 0;
        gStop = 0;
        gArrived = 0;

        pthread_t writer;
        if (pthread_create(&writer, NULL, WriterThread, NULL) != 0)
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "error: could not create the writer thread\n");
            return 2;
        }

        uint64_t forbidden = 0;
        uint64_t outcomes[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};

        for (int round = 1; round <= iterations; ++round)
        {
            memset(&gCells, 0, sizeof(gCells));
            gWriterObserved = 0;

            uint64_t first = 0;
            uint64_t second = 0;

            unsigned delay = (unsigned)(round * 2654435761u) % 96u;

            Barrier(round);
            for (unsigned tick = 0; tick < delay; ++tick) asm volatile("" ::: "memory");
            test->Reader(&gCells, &first, &second);

            while (gWriterRound != round) { }

            if (test->Writer == StoreBufferWriter) first = gWriterObserved;

            int slot = ((first != 0) ? 2 : 0) | ((second != 0) ? 1 : 0);
            outcomes[slot] += 1;

            if (test->hasForbidden && (int)first == test->forbiddenFirst && (int)second == test->forbiddenSecond) forbidden += 1;
        }

        gStop = 1;
        __atomic_add_fetch(&gArrived, 2, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
        pthread_join(writer, NULL);

        bool interleaved = outcomes[test->requiredSlot] > 0;

        printf("%s iterations=%d forbidden=%llu interleaved=%s\n", test->name, iterations, (unsigned long long)forbidden,
               interleaved ? "yes" : "no");
        fprintf(stderr, "%s outcomes 00=%llu 01=%llu 10=%llu 11=%llu\n", test->name, (unsigned long long)outcomes[0],
                (unsigned long long)outcomes[1], (unsigned long long)outcomes[2], (unsigned long long)outcomes[3]);
        fflush(stdout);
        fflush(stderr);
    }

    return 0;
}
```

`tests/ordering/OrderingGate.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>

#include "ElfLoader/ElfLoader.hpp"
#include "GuestLibc/GuestLibc.hpp"
#include "GuestRuntime/GuestRuntime.hpp"

static bool TierRecompileRequested(int argc, char** argv)
{
    for (int index = 1; index + 1 < argc; ++index)
    {
        if (strcmp(argv[index], "--tier") == 0) return strcmp(argv[index + 1], "t1") == 0;
    }

    return false;
}

struct OrderingCase
{
    const char* name;
    const char* forbidden;
    int shapeSlot;
    int controlIndex;
};

static const OrderingCase ORDERING_CASES[] = {
    {"sb_relaxed", nullptr, 0, 0},
    {"sb_release_acquire", "both threads read the stale value through STLR/LDAR", 0, 0},
    {"sb_dmb_ish", "both threads read the stale value across DMB ISH", 0, 0},
    {"mp_relaxed", nullptr, 2, 3},
    {"mp_release_acquire", "the flag was seen set while the payload was still stale", 2, 3},
};

static constexpr int ORDERING_CASE_COUNT = (int)(sizeof(ORDERING_CASES) / sizeof(ORDERING_CASES[0]));
static constexpr uint64_t DEFAULT_ITERATIONS = 20000;
static constexpr int SKIP_EXIT_CODE = 77;
static constexpr uint64_t MINIMUM_CONTROL_HITS = 20;

static int failures = 0;
static int indiscriminate = 0;
static int discriminated = 0;
static uint64_t observed[ORDERING_CASE_COUNT][4];

static bool CallGuest(GuestRuntime::Instance& instance, const char* name, uint64_t first, uint64_t second, uint64_t& returned)
{
    GuestState::GuestAddress address{};
    if (GuestRuntime::Lookup(instance, name, address) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("       the fixture does not export %s\n", name);
        return false;
    }

    GuestState::Registers registers;
    GuestState::Reset(registers);
    registers.general[0] = first;
    registers.general[1] = second;

    GuestRuntime::Result result = GuestRuntime::CallGuest(instance, address, registers);
    if (result != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("       %s failed: %s\n", name, GuestRuntime::ResultName(result));
        return false;
    }

    returned = registers.general[0];
    return true;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 2)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: OrderingGateTest <ordering.so> [iterations]\n");
        return 2;
    }

    std::string path = argv[1];
    uint64_t iterations = argc > 2 ? strtoull(argv[2], nullptr, 10) : DEFAULT_ITERATIONS;

    std::string directory = ".";
    size_t slash = path.find_last_of('/');
    if (slash != std::string::npos) directory = path.substr(0, slash);

    GuestRuntime::Configuration configuration;
    configuration.searchPaths.push_back(directory);

    configuration.recompile = TierRecompileRequested(argc, argv);
    configuration.stepLimit = 0;

    GuestRuntime::Instance instance;
    if (GuestRuntime::Create(configuration, instance) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("ordering-gate FAILED: cannot create the guest runtime\n");
        return 1;
    }

    if (GuestLibc::RegisterAll(instance) != GuestLibc::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("ordering-gate FAILED: cannot register the libc trampolines\n");
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return 1;
    }

    uint32_t moduleId = ElfLoader::INVALID_MODULE_ID;
    if (GuestRuntime::Load(instance, path, moduleId) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("ordering-gate FAILED: cannot load %s\n", path.c_str());
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return 1;
    }

    uint64_t exported = 0;
    if (!CallGuest(instance, "OrderingTestCount", 0, 0, exported) || exported != ORDERING_CASE_COUNT)
    {
        printf("ordering-gate FAILED: the fixture exports %llu cases, the gate knows %d\n", (unsigned long long)exported,
               ORDERING_CASE_COUNT);
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return 1;
    }

    printf("running %d ordering cases at %llu iterations under %s\n", ORDERING_CASE_COUNT, (unsigned long long)iterations,
           configuration.recompile ? "T1" : "T0");

    for (int index = 0; index < ORDERING_CASE_COUNT; ++index)
    {
        const OrderingCase& ordering = ORDERING_CASES[index];

        uint64_t forbidden = 0;
        if (!CallGuest(instance, "RunOrdering", (uint64_t)index, iterations, forbidden))
        {
            printf("FAIL %s: the guest run did not complete\n", ordering.name);
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        uint64_t total = 0;
        for (uint64_t slot = 0; slot < 4; ++slot)
        {
            if (!CallGuest(instance, "OrderingOutcome", slot, 0, observed[index][slot])) break;
            total += observed[index][slot];
        }

        printf("  %-20s 00=%llu 01=%llu 10=%llu 11=%llu forbidden=%llu\n", ordering.name, (unsigned long long)observed[index][0],
               (unsigned long long)observed[index][1], (unsigned long long)observed[index][2], (unsigned long long)observed[index][3],
               (unsigned long long)forbidden);

        if (total != iterations)
        {
            printf("FAIL %s: %llu outcomes recorded for %llu iterations\n", ordering.name, (unsigned long long)total,
                   (unsigned long long)iterations);
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        if (!ordering.forbidden) continue;

        uint64_t controlReach = observed[ordering.controlIndex][ordering.shapeSlot];
        if (controlReach < MINIMUM_CONTROL_HITS)
        {
            printf("INDISCRIMINATE %s: its relaxed control %s reached the outcome only %llu times in %llu iterations,\n"
                   "     below the floor of %llu, so a forbidden count of zero here is too weak to trust\n",
                   ordering.name, ORDERING_CASES[ordering.controlIndex].name, (unsigned long long)controlReach,
                   (unsigned long long)iterations, (unsigned long long)MINIMUM_CONTROL_HITS);
            indiscriminate += 1;
            continue;
        }

        if (forbidden != 0)
        {
            printf("FAIL %s: %llu forbidden outcomes - %s\n", ordering.name, (unsigned long long)forbidden, ordering.forbidden);
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        discriminated += 1;
        printf("PASS %s (forbidden outcome absent, and its control reached that outcome %llu times)\n", ordering.name,
               (unsigned long long)controlReach);
    }

    GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);

    if (failures != 0)
    {
        printf("ordering-gate FAILED: %d checks failed\n", failures);
        return 1;
    }

    if (discriminated == 0)
    {
        printf("\nordering-gate CANNOT DISCRIMINATE: no ordering case has a reachable counterexample.\n");
        printf("Under T0 this is expected and structural: a guest instruction costs hundreds of host instructions, so the\n");
        printf("host store buffer drains between any two guest memory accesses and the interpreter is accidentally\n");
        printf("sequentially consistent. Re-run with GUEST_TIER=t1, where guest instructions become adjacent host ones.\n");
        return SKIP_EXIT_CODE;
    }

    if (indiscriminate != 0)
    {
        printf("\n%d case(s) had no reachable counterexample and were not judged. On an x86-64 host that is expected for\n"
               "message-passing: TSO never reorders store-store or load-load, so the relaxed control cannot reach the\n"
               "outcome either. Store-buffering is the shape that discriminates here, and it did.\n",
               indiscriminate);
    }

    printf("ordering-gate PASSED: %d forbidden outcome(s) absent against a reachable control\n", discriminated);
    return 0;
}

```

`tests/ordering/src/ordering.c`:

```c
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#define CACHE_LINE 128
#define OUTCOME_SLOTS 4

struct Cells
{
    _Alignas(CACHE_LINE) uint64_t x;
    _Alignas(CACHE_LINE) uint64_t y;
};

static struct Cells cells;
static uint64_t outcomes[OUTCOME_SLOTS];
static uint64_t iterationCount;
static int selectedTest;

static uint64_t firstRead;
static uint64_t secondRead;

_Alignas(CACHE_LINE) static uint32_t arrived;
_Alignas(CACHE_LINE) static uint32_t generation;

static void Barrier(void)
{
    uint32_t seen = __atomic_load_n(&generation, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);

    if (__atomic_add_fetch(&arrived, 1u, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL) == 2u)
    {
        __atomic_store_n(&arrived, 0u, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        __atomic_add_fetch(&generation, 1u, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL);
        return;
    }

    while (__atomic_load_n(&generation, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) == seen)
    {
    }
}

static void StoreBufferFirstRelaxed(void)
{
    asm volatile("str %1, [%0]" : : "r"(&cells.x), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
    asm volatile("ldr %0, [%1]" : "=r"(firstRead) : "r"(&cells.y) : "memory");
}

static void StoreBufferSecondRelaxed(void)
{
    asm volatile("str %1, [%0]" : : "r"(&cells.y), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
    asm volatile("ldr %0, [%1]" : "=r"(secondRead) : "r"(&cells.x) : "memory");
}

static void StoreBufferFirstReleaseAcquire(void)
{
    asm volatile("stlr %1, [%0]" : : "r"(&cells.x), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
    asm volatile("ldar %0, [%1]" : "=r"(firstRead) : "r"(&cells.y) : "memory");
}

static void StoreBufferSecondReleaseAcquire(void)
{
    asm volatile("stlr %1, [%0]" : : "r"(&cells.y), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
    asm volatile("ldar %0, [%1]" : "=r"(secondRead) : "r"(&cells.x) : "memory");
}

static void StoreBufferFirstBarrier(void)
{
    asm volatile("str %1, [%0]\n\tdmb ish" : : "r"(&cells.x), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
    asm volatile("ldr %0, [%1]" : "=r"(firstRead) : "r"(&cells.y) : "memory");
}

static void StoreBufferSecondBarrier(void)
{
    asm volatile("str %1, [%0]\n\tdmb ish" : : "r"(&cells.y), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
    asm volatile("ldr %0, [%1]" : "=r"(secondRead) : "r"(&cells.x) : "memory");
}

static void MessagePassingWriterRelaxed(void)
{
    asm volatile("str %1, [%0]" : : "r"(&cells.x), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
    asm volatile("str %1, [%0]" : : "r"(&cells.y), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
}

static void MessagePassingReaderRelaxed(void)
{
    asm volatile("ldr %0, [%1]" : "=r"(firstRead) : "r"(&cells.y) : "memory");
    asm volatile("ldr %0, [%1]" : "=r"(secondRead) : "r"(&cells.x) : "memory");
}

static void MessagePassingWriterRelease(void)
{
    asm volatile("str %1, [%0]" : : "r"(&cells.x), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
    asm volatile("stlr %1, [%0]" : : "r"(&cells.y), "r"(1ull) : "memory");
}

static void MessagePassingReaderAcquire(void)
{
    asm volatile("ldar %0, [%1]" : "=r"(firstRead) : "r"(&cells.y) : "memory");
    asm volatile("ldr %0, [%1]" : "=r"(secondRead) : "r"(&cells.x) : "memory");
}

struct OrderingTest
{
    void (*First)(void);
    void (*Second)(void);
    int forbiddenSlot;
};

static const struct OrderingTest ORDERING_TESTS[] = {
    {StoreBufferFirstRelaxed, StoreBufferSecondRelaxed, -1},
    {StoreBufferFirstReleaseAcquire, StoreBufferSecondReleaseAcquire, 0},
    {StoreBufferFirstBarrier, StoreBufferSecondBarrier, 0},
    {MessagePassingWriterRelaxed, MessagePassingReaderRelaxed, -1},
    {MessagePassingWriterRelease, MessagePassingReaderAcquire, 2},
};

static void* SecondThread(void* raw)
{
    (void)raw;
    const struct OrderingTest* test = &ORDERING_TESTS[selectedTest];

    for (uint64_t index = 0; index < iterationCount; ++index)
    {
        Barrier();
        test->Second();
        Barrier();
    }

    return 0;
}

uint64_t RunOrdering(uint64_t testIndex, uint64_t iterations)
{
    selectedTest = (int)testIndex;
    iterationCount = iterations;

    for (int slot = 0; slot < OUTCOME_SLOTS; ++slot) outcomes[slot] = 0;

    const struct OrderingTest* test = &ORDERING_TESTS[selectedTest];

    pthread_t second;
    if (pthread_create(&second, 0, SecondThread, 0) != 0) return ~0ull;

    for (uint64_t index = 0; index < iterationCount; ++index)
    {
        cells.x = 0;
        cells.y = 0;
        firstRead = ~0ull;
        secondRead = ~0ull;

        Barrier();
        test->First();
        Barrier();

        int slot = ((firstRead != 0) << 1) | (secondRead != 0);
        outcomes[slot] += 1;
    }

    pthread_join(second, 0);

    if (test->forbiddenSlot < 0) return 0;
    return outcomes[test->forbiddenSlot];
}

uint64_t OrderingOutcome(uint64_t slot)
{
    if (slot >= OUTCOME_SLOTS) return 0;
    return outcomes[slot];
}

uint64_t OrderingTestCount(void)
{
    return sizeof(ORDERING_TESTS) / sizeof(ORDERING_TESTS[0]);
}
```

`tests/platform/PlatformUnit.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>

#include "Platform/Platform.hpp"
#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"

static int failures = 0;

static void Check(bool condition, const char* label)
{
    if (condition)
    {
        printf("PASS %s\n", label);
        return;
    }

    printf("FAIL %s\n", label);
    failures += 1;
}

static void CheckDensity(uint32_t width, uint32_t height, int expected, const char* label)
{
    const int measured = Platform::DensityForWindow(width, height);

    if (measured == expected)
    {
        printf("PASS %s (%ux%u -> %d dpi)\n", label, width, height, measured);
        return;
    }

    printf("FAIL %s (%ux%u -> %d dpi, expected %d)\n", label, width, height, measured, expected);
    failures += 1;
}

static void CheckLogicalWidth(uint32_t width, uint32_t height, int lowest, int highest, const char* label)
{
    const int density = Platform::DensityForWindow(width, height);
    const uint32_t shortSide = width < height ? width : height;
    const int logical = (int)shortSide * Platform::DENSITY_DEFAULT / density;

    if (logical >= lowest && logical <= highest)
    {
        printf("PASS %s (%ux%u -> %d dp across)\n", label, width, height, logical);
        return;
    }

    printf("FAIL %s (%ux%u -> %d dp across, wanted %d to %d)\n", label, width, height, logical, lowest, highest);
    failures += 1;
}

int main()
{
    CheckDensity(1080, 2400, 440, "a 1080p phone is xxhdpi");
    CheckDensity(1080, 1920, 440, "an older 1080p phone is the same");
    CheckDensity(1440, 3120, 560, "a 1440p phone is xxxhdpi-ish");
    CheckDensity(720, 1280, 320, "a 720p phone is xhdpi");
    CheckDensity(2400, 1080, 440, "landscape measures the short side, not the long one");

    CheckDensity(400, 300, Platform::DENSITY_DEFAULT, "a small test window stays at the default");
    CheckDensity(420, 880, Platform::DENSITY_DEFAULT, "and so does the app-debug fixture");
    CheckDensity(320, 240, Platform::DENSITY_DEFAULT, "no window is ever reported as ldpi");
    CheckDensity(0, 0, Platform::DENSITY_DEFAULT, "a window with no size falls back rather than dividing by zero");

    CheckLogicalWidth(1080, 2400, 360, 420, "a 1080p phone measures like a phone");
    CheckLogicalWidth(1440, 3120, 360, 420, "and so does a 1440p one");
    CheckLogicalWidth(720, 1280, 340, 420, "and so does a 720p one");

    Check(Platform::NearestDensityBucket(1) == 120, "densities below the lowest bucket clamp up");
    Check(Platform::NearestDensityBucket(100000) == 640, "densities above the highest bucket clamp down");
    Check(Platform::NearestDensityBucket(435) == 440, "a density between buckets takes the nearer one");
    Check(Platform::NearestDensityBucket(425) == 420, "and the nearer one below, when that is nearer");
    Check(Platform::NearestDensityBucket(430) == 420, "an exact tie settles on the lower bucket rather than by accident");
    Check(Platform::NearestDensityBucket(240) == 240, "a density on a bucket stays put");

    Settings::Set(Platform::DENSITY_SETTING, "213");
    Check(Platform::ConfiguredDensity(1080, 2400) == 213, "an explicit density wins over the derived one");

    Settings::Set(Platform::DENSITY_SETTING, "not-a-number");
    Check(Platform::ConfiguredDensity(1080, 2400) == 440, "a malformed density is refused rather than believed");

    Settings::Set(Platform::DENSITY_SETTING, "3");
    Check(Platform::ConfiguredDensity(1080, 2400) == 440, "an implausible density is refused too");

    Settings::Unset(Platform::DENSITY_SETTING);
    Check(Platform::ConfiguredDensity(1080, 2400) == 440, "with nothing set the derived density is used");

    printf("%s: %d failure(s)\n", failures == 0 ? "platform" : "platform FAILED", failures);

    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
```

`tests/rasterizer/RasterizerGolden.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Rasterizer/Rasterizer.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>

static int failures = 0;

static void Check(const char* name, bool ok)
{
    printf("%s %s\n", ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL", name);
    if (!ok) failures++;
}

static const int RAMP_WIDTH = 60;
static const int RAMP_HEIGHT = 14;

static void BuildCoverageRamp(uint8_t* samples)
{
    for (int row = 0; row < RAMP_HEIGHT; ++row)
    {
        for (int column = 0; column < RAMP_WIDTH; ++column)
        {
            int value = (column * 255) / (RAMP_WIDTH - 1);
            if (row < 2 || row >= RAMP_HEIGHT - 2) value = value / 4;
            samples[row * RAMP_WIDTH + column] = static_cast<uint8_t>(value);
        }
    }
}

static void PaintPattern(Rasterizer::Canvas& canvas)
{
    Rasterizer::DrawColor(canvas, 0xFF101828u);

    Rasterizer::DrawRect(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{8, 8, 56, 40}, 0xFFE04050u);
    Rasterizer::DrawRect(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{60, 8, 108, 40}, 0xFF40C060u);

    Rasterizer::Save(canvas);
    Rasterizer::Translate(canvas, 8, 48);
    Rasterizer::ClipRect(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{0, 0, 40, 24});
    Rasterizer::DrawRect(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{-10, -10, 100, 100}, 0xFF4080F0u);
    Rasterizer::Restore(canvas);

    Rasterizer::DrawRectOutline(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{60, 48, 108, 72}, 2, 0xFFF0C040u);

    uint8_t ramp[RAMP_HEIGHT * RAMP_WIDTH];
    BuildCoverageRamp(ramp);

    Rasterizer::Coverage mask;
    mask.samples = ramp;
    mask.width = RAMP_WIDTH;
    mask.height = RAMP_HEIGHT;
    mask.pitch = RAMP_WIDTH;

    Rasterizer::DrawCoverage(canvas, mask, 8, 80, 0xFFFFFFFFu);
    Rasterizer::DrawRectBlend(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{72, 80, 108, 92}, 0x80FF00FFu);

    Rasterizer::DrawHorizontalLine(canvas, 8, 100, 100, 0xFF808080u);
    Rasterizer::DrawVerticalLine(canvas, 116, 8, 100, 0xFF808080u);
}

static void TestClipping()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::CreateSurface(32, 32, surface);

    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    Rasterizer::Begin(surface, canvas);

    Rasterizer::DrawColor(canvas, 0xFF000000u);
    Rasterizer::Save(canvas);
    Rasterizer::ClipRect(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{8, 8, 16, 16});
    Rasterizer::DrawRect(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{0, 0, 32, 32}, 0xFFFFFFFFu);
    Rasterizer::Restore(canvas);

    Check("clip confines the fill", Rasterizer::PixelAt(surface, 10, 10) == 0xFFFFFFFFu && Rasterizer::PixelAt(surface, 7, 10) == 0xFF000000u &&
                                        Rasterizer::PixelAt(surface, 16, 16) == 0xFF000000u);

    Rasterizer::DrawRect(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{0, 0, 32, 32}, 0xFF223344u);
    Check("restore releases the clip", Rasterizer::PixelAt(surface, 0, 0) == 0xFF223344u);

    Rasterizer::DestroySurface(surface);
}

static void TestBoundsAndTranslate()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::CreateSurface(16, 16, surface);

    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    Rasterizer::Begin(surface, canvas);
    Rasterizer::DrawColor(canvas, 0u);

    Rasterizer::DrawRect(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{-100, -100, 100, 100}, 0xFFAABBCCu);
    Check("oversized rect is clamped, not overflowing",
          Rasterizer::PixelAt(surface, 0, 0) == 0xFFAABBCCu && Rasterizer::PixelAt(surface, 15, 15) == 0xFFAABBCCu);

    Rasterizer::DrawColor(canvas, 0u);
    Rasterizer::Translate(canvas, 4, 4);
    Rasterizer::DrawRect(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{0, 0, 4, 4}, 0xFF010203u);
    Check("translate offsets drawing", Rasterizer::PixelAt(surface, 4, 4) == 0xFF010203u && Rasterizer::PixelAt(surface, 3, 3) == 0u);

    Check("state stack underflow is reported", Rasterizer::Restore(canvas) == Rasterizer::Result::StateStackUnderflow);

    Rasterizer::DestroySurface(surface);
}

static void TestDegenerate()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Check("zero width is rejected", Rasterizer::CreateSurface(0, 8, surface) == Rasterizer::Result::InvalidGeometry);
    Check("oversized is rejected", Rasterizer::CreateSurface(99999, 8, surface) == Rasterizer::Result::InvalidGeometry);

    Rasterizer::Surface real;
    Rasterizer::CreateSurface(8, 8, real);
    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    Rasterizer::Begin(real, canvas);
    Rasterizer::DrawColor(canvas, 0xFF000000u);

    Rasterizer::DrawRect(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{4, 4, 4, 4}, 0xFFFFFFFFu);
    Check("empty rect draws nothing", Rasterizer::PixelAt(real, 4, 4) == 0xFF000000u);

    Rasterizer::DrawRect(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{6, 6, 2, 2}, 0xFFFFFFFFu);
    Check("inverted rect draws nothing", Rasterizer::PixelAt(real, 3, 3) == 0xFF000000u);

    Rasterizer::DestroySurface(real);
}

static int SaveReturningPreviousDepth(Rasterizer::Canvas& canvas)
{
    int before = canvas.depth;
    if (Rasterizer::Save(canvas) != Rasterizer::Result::Ok) return -1;
    return before;
}

static void RestoreToCount(Rasterizer::Canvas& canvas, int saveCount)
{
    while (canvas.depth > saveCount)
    {
        if (Rasterizer::Restore(canvas) != Rasterizer::Result::Ok) return;
    }
}

static void DrawSibling(Rasterizer::Canvas& canvas, int left, int top, int width, int height, uint32_t color)
{
    int saveCount = SaveReturningPreviousDepth(canvas);
    Rasterizer::Translate(canvas, left, top);
    Rasterizer::ClipRect(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{0, 0, width, height});
    Rasterizer::DrawRect(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{0, 0, width, height}, color);
    RestoreToCount(canvas, saveCount);
}

static void TestSiblingIsolation()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::CreateSurface(200, 200, surface);

    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    Rasterizer::Begin(surface, canvas);
    Rasterizer::DrawColor(canvas, 0xFF000000u);

    int startDepth = canvas.depth;

    DrawSibling(canvas, 0, 0, 100, 100, 0xFFFF0000u);
    DrawSibling(canvas, 100, 0, 100, 100, 0xFF00FF00u);
    DrawSibling(canvas, 0, 100, 100, 100, 0xFF0000FFu);

    Check("first sibling drawn", Rasterizer::PixelAt(surface, 50, 50) == 0xFFFF0000u);
    Check("second sibling drawn, not clipped away by the first", Rasterizer::PixelAt(surface, 150, 50) == 0xFF00FF00u);
    Check("third sibling drawn", Rasterizer::PixelAt(surface, 50, 150) == 0xFF0000FFu);
    Check("siblings do not bleed into each other", Rasterizer::PixelAt(surface, 150, 150) == 0xFF000000u);
    Check("save/restore returns to the starting depth", canvas.depth == startDepth);

    for (int index = 0; index < Rasterizer::MAX_STATE_DEPTH * 2; index++)
    {
        DrawSibling(canvas, 0, 0, 8, 8, 0xFF808080u);
    }
    Check("a long sibling run does not grow the state stack", canvas.depth == startDepth);

    Rasterizer::DestroySurface(surface);
}

static void TestStateStackLimits()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::CreateSurface(8, 8, surface);

    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    Rasterizer::Begin(surface, canvas);

    int wanted = Rasterizer::MAX_STATE_DEPTH * 2;
    bool saved = true;

    for (int index = 0; index < wanted; ++index)
    {
        if (Rasterizer::Save(canvas) != Rasterizer::Result::Ok) saved = false;
        Rasterizer::Translate(canvas, 1, 0);
    }

    Check("save keeps working past the inline depth", saved && canvas.depth == wanted + 1);
    Check("a state past the inline depth does not share its parent",
          Rasterizer::CurrentState(canvas).translateX == wanted);

    while (Rasterizer::Restore(canvas) == Rasterizer::Result::Ok)
    {
    }

    Check("restore stops at the base state", canvas.depth == 1);
    Check("the base state was left alone", Rasterizer::CurrentState(canvas).translateX == 0);

    Rasterizer::End(canvas);

    Rasterizer::DestroySurface(surface);
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 2)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s <golden.raw> [--regenerate]\n", argv[0]);
        return 2;
    }

    const char* goldenPath = argv[1];
    bool regenerate = argc > 2 && strcmp(argv[2], "--regenerate") == 0;

    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    if (Rasterizer::CreateSurface(128, 112, surface) != Rasterizer::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "could not allocate the pattern surface\n");
        return 1;
    }

    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    Rasterizer::Begin(surface, canvas);
    PaintPattern(canvas);

    size_t sizeBytes = static_cast<size_t>(surface.stride) * surface.height;

    if (regenerate)
    {
        FILE* out = fopen(goldenPath, "wb");
        if (!out)
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "cannot write %s\n", goldenPath);
            return 1;
        }
        fwrite(surface.pixels, 1, sizeBytes, out);
        fclose(out);
        printf("regenerated %s (%zu bytes)\n", goldenPath, sizeBytes);
        Rasterizer::DestroySurface(surface);
        return 0;
    }

    FILE* in = fopen(goldenPath, "rb");
    if (!in)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "golden image missing: %s (run with --regenerate)\n", goldenPath);
        Rasterizer::DestroySurface(surface);
        return 1;
    }

    uint8_t* expected = static_cast<uint8_t*>(malloc(sizeBytes));
    size_t read = fread(expected, 1, sizeBytes, in);
    long extra = fgetc(in) == EOF ? 0 : 1;
    fclose(in);

    if (read != sizeBytes || extra != 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "golden image is %zu bytes, expected %zu\n", read + static_cast<size_t>(extra), sizeBytes);
        free(expected);
        Rasterizer::DestroySurface(surface);
        return 1;
    }

    size_t differing = 0;
    for (size_t index = 0; index < sizeBytes; index += 4)
    {
        if (memcmp(surface.pixels + index, expected + index, 4) != 0) differing++;
    }

    Check("pattern matches the committed golden image", differing == 0);
    if (differing != 0) fprintf(stderr, "%zu of %zu pixels differ\n", differing, sizeBytes / 4);

    free(expected);
    Rasterizer::DestroySurface(surface);

    TestClipping();
    TestBoundsAndTranslate();
    TestDegenerate();
    TestSiblingIsolation();
    TestStateStackLimits();

    printf(failures == 0 ? "ALL PASS\n" : "%d FAILURES\n", failures);
    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
```

`tests/rasterizer/VectorUnit.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>

#include "Rasterizer/Rasterizer.hpp"

static int failures = 0;
static int checks = 0;

static void Expect(bool condition, const char* description)
{
    checks += 1;
    if (condition)
    {
        printf("  ok    %s\n", description);
        return;
    }

    printf("  FAIL  %s\n", description);
    failures += 1;
}

static uint32_t PixelAt(const Rasterizer::Surface& surface, int32_t x, int32_t y)
{
    const uint8_t* row = surface.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * surface.stride;
    return reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(row)[x];
}

static uint32_t AlphaOf(uint32_t pixel)
{
    return (pixel >> 24) & 0xFFu;
}

static void PrepareCanvas(Rasterizer::Canvas& canvas, Rasterizer::Surface& surface, uint32_t size)
{
    Rasterizer::CreateSurface(size, size, surface);
    std::memset(surface.pixels, 0, static_cast<size_t>(surface.stride) * surface.height);

    Rasterizer::Begin(surface, canvas);
}

static void FinishCanvas(Rasterizer::Canvas& canvas, Rasterizer::Surface& surface)
{
    Rasterizer::End(canvas);
    Rasterizer::DestroySurface(surface);
}

static void CheckTriangleFill()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    PrepareCanvas(canvas, surface, 64);

    Rasterizer::Path* path = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::MoveTo(*path, 32.0f, 4.0f);
    Rasterizer::LineTo(*path, 60.0f, 60.0f);
    Rasterizer::LineTo(*path, 4.0f, 60.0f);
    Rasterizer::CloseContour(*path);

    Rasterizer::Source source;
    source.color = 0xFFFF0000u;

    Rasterizer::Result drawn = Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, *path, source, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero,
                                                    Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver, 255);

    Expect(drawn == Rasterizer::Result::Ok, "a triangle fills without error");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 32, 50)) == 255, "the middle of the triangle is opaque");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 4, 8)) == 0, "a corner outside the triangle is untouched");

    uint32_t edge = AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 32, 4));
    Expect(edge > 0 && edge < 255, "the apex is antialiased rather than hard");

    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(path);
    FinishCanvas(canvas, surface);
}

static void CheckEvenOddRule()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    PrepareCanvas(canvas, surface, 64);

    Rasterizer::Path* path = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*path, 8.0f, 8.0f, 56.0f, 56.0f);
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*path, 20.0f, 20.0f, 44.0f, 44.0f);

    Rasterizer::Source source;
    source.color = 0xFF00FF00u;

    Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, *path, source, Rasterizer::FillRule::EvenOdd, Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver, 255);

    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 12, 32)) == 255, "the ring is filled under the even odd rule");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 32, 32)) == 0, "the hole is left empty under the even odd rule");

    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(path);
    FinishCanvas(canvas, surface);
}

static void CheckTransform()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    PrepareCanvas(canvas, surface, 64);

    Rasterizer::Transform move;
    move.translateX = 32.0f;
    Rasterizer::Concat(canvas, move);

    Rasterizer::Path* path = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*path, 0.0f, 0.0f, 16.0f, 16.0f);

    Rasterizer::Source source;
    source.color = 0xFF0000FFu;

    Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, *path, source, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver, 255);

    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 40, 8)) == 255, "the translation moved the rectangle");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 8, 8)) == 0, "nothing was drawn where the rectangle started");

    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(path);
    FinishCanvas(canvas, surface);
}

static void CheckClipPath()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    PrepareCanvas(canvas, surface, 64);

    Rasterizer::Path* clip = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*clip, 0.0f, 0.0f, 32.0f, 64.0f);
    Rasterizer::ClipPath(canvas, *clip, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, false);

    Rasterizer::Path* path = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*path, 0.0f, 0.0f, 64.0f, 64.0f);

    Rasterizer::Source source;
    source.color = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, *path, source, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver, 255);

    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 8, 32)) == 255, "the clipped side still draws");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 48, 32)) == 0, "the far side is clipped away");

    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(path);
    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(clip);
    FinishCanvas(canvas, surface);
}

static void CheckLinearGradient()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    PrepareCanvas(canvas, surface, 64);

    Rasterizer::GradientStop stops[2];
    stops[0].position = 0.0f;
    stops[0].color = 0xFF000000u;
    stops[1].position = 1.0f;
    stops[1].color = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    Rasterizer::Source source;
    source.kind = Rasterizer::SourceKind::LinearGradient;
    source.startX = 0.0f;
    source.endX = 64.0f;
    source.stops = stops;
    source.stopCount = 2;

    Rasterizer::Path* path = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*path, 0.0f, 0.0f, 64.0f, 64.0f);

    Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, *path, source, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, Rasterizer::BlendMode::Source, 255);

    uint32_t left = PixelAt(surface, 2, 32) & 0xFFu;
    uint32_t middle = PixelAt(surface, 32, 32) & 0xFFu;
    uint32_t right = PixelAt(surface, 61, 32) & 0xFFu;

    Expect(left < middle && middle < right, "the gradient runs dark to light across the shape");

    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(path);
    FinishCanvas(canvas, surface);
}

static void CheckStroke()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    PrepareCanvas(canvas, surface, 64);

    Rasterizer::Path* path = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*path, 16.0f, 16.0f, 48.0f, 48.0f);

    Rasterizer::Source source;
    source.color = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    Rasterizer::StrokeStyle style;
    style.width = 4.0f;

    Rasterizer::Result drawn = Rasterizer::StrokePath(canvas, *path, source, style, Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver, 255);

    Expect(drawn == Rasterizer::Result::Ok, "a rectangle strokes without error");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 16, 32)) > 128, "the stroke covers the edge");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 32, 32)) == 0, "the inside of a stroked rectangle stays empty");

    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(path);
    FinishCanvas(canvas, surface);
}

static void CheckBlur()
{
    const int32_t size = 32;
    uint8_t mask[size * size];
    std::memset(mask, 0, sizeof(mask));

    for (int32_t y = 12; y < 20; ++y)
    {
        for (int32_t x = 12; x < 20; ++x) mask[y * size + x] = 255;
    }

    Rasterizer::BlurMask(mask, size, size, size, 3.0f);

    Expect(mask[16 * size + 16] > 128, "the middle of a blurred square stays strong");
    Expect(mask[16 * size + 10] > 0, "the blur spread outside the original square");
    Expect(mask[16 * size + 2] == 0, "the blur did not reach the far edge");
}

static void CheckLayerAlpha()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::CreateSurface(64, 64, surface);
    std::memset(surface.pixels, 0, static_cast<size_t>(surface.stride) * surface.height);

    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    Rasterizer::Begin(surface, canvas);

    Rasterizer::Path* path = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*path, 0.0f, 0.0f, 64.0f, 64.0f);

    Rasterizer::Source source;
    source.color = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    Rasterizer::Result opened = Rasterizer::SaveLayer(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{0, 0, 32, 64}, 128,
                                                      Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver);
    Expect(opened == Rasterizer::Result::Ok, "a layer opens");
    Expect(canvas.surface.pixels != surface.pixels, "drawing is redirected off screen inside a layer");

    Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, *path, source, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver, 255);

    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 8, 8)) == 0, "nothing reached the screen while the layer was open");

    Rasterizer::Result closed = Rasterizer::RestoreLayer(canvas);
    Expect(closed == Rasterizer::Result::Ok, "a layer closes");
    Expect(canvas.surface.pixels == surface.pixels, "drawing goes back to the screen after a layer");

    uint32_t inside = AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 8, 8));
    Expect(inside > 120 && inside < 136, "the layer composited back at half alpha");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 48, 8)) == 0, "the layer bounds clipped what it composited");

    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(path);
    Rasterizer::End(canvas);
    Rasterizer::DestroySurface(surface);
}

static void CheckDeepStack()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::CreateSurface(64, 64, surface);
    std::memset(surface.pixels, 0, static_cast<size_t>(surface.stride) * surface.height);

    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    Rasterizer::Begin(surface, canvas);

    bool saved = true;
    for (int index = 0; index < 300; ++index)
    {
        if (Rasterizer::Save(canvas) != Rasterizer::Result::Ok) saved = false;

        Rasterizer::Transform step;
        step.translateX = 1.0f;
        Rasterizer::Concat(canvas, step);
    }

    Expect(saved, "the state stack grows past its inline depth");
    Expect(canvas.depth == 301, "every save landed");
    Expect(Rasterizer::CurrentTransform(canvas).translateX == 300.0f, "the deep states carry their own transform");

    Rasterizer::Path* path = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*path, 0.0f, 0.0f, 8.0f, 8.0f);

    Rasterizer::Source source;
    source.color = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, *path, source, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver, 255);
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 32, 4)) == 0, "a fill at depth three hundred still respects the transform");

    bool restored = true;
    for (int index = 0; index < 300; ++index)
    {
        if (Rasterizer::Restore(canvas) != Rasterizer::Result::Ok) restored = false;
    }

    Expect(restored, "the deep stack unwinds");
    Expect(canvas.depth == 1, "the stack came back to where it started");

    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(path);
    Rasterizer::End(canvas);
    Rasterizer::DestroySurface(surface);
}

static void CheckClipSurvivesRestore()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::CreateSurface(64, 64, surface);
    std::memset(surface.pixels, 0, static_cast<size_t>(surface.stride) * surface.height);

    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    Rasterizer::Begin(surface, canvas);

    Rasterizer::Path* clip = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*clip, 0.0f, 0.0f, 32.0f, 64.0f);
    Rasterizer::ClipPath(canvas, *clip, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, false);

    Rasterizer::Save(canvas);

    Rasterizer::Path* inner = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*inner, 0.0f, 0.0f, 64.0f, 32.0f);
    Rasterizer::ClipPath(canvas, *inner, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, false);

    Rasterizer::Restore(canvas);

    Rasterizer::Path* path = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*path, 0.0f, 0.0f, 64.0f, 64.0f);

    Rasterizer::Source source;
    source.color = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, *path, source, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver, 255);

    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 8, 48)) == 255, "the outer clip survived the restore");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 48, 48)) == 0, "the outer clip still clips after the restore");

    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(path);
    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(inner);
    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(clip);
    Rasterizer::End(canvas);
    Rasterizer::DestroySurface(surface);
}

static void CheckArc()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    PrepareCanvas(canvas, surface, 64);

    Rasterizer::Path* path = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddArc(*path, 0.0f, 0.0f, 64.0f, 64.0f, 0.0f, 90.0f, true);
    Rasterizer::LineTo(*path, 32.0f, 32.0f);
    Rasterizer::CloseContour(*path);

    Rasterizer::Source source;
    source.color = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, *path, source, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver, 255);

    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 44, 44)) == 255, "the swept quarter is filled");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 20, 44)) == 0, "the quarter before the sweep is empty");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 44, 20)) == 0, "the quarter after the sweep is empty");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 60, 60)) == 0, "the arc bulges outward, leaving the corner clear");

    FinishCanvas(canvas, surface);
    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(path);
}

static void CheckImageFilter()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface image;
    Rasterizer::CreateSurface(2, 2, image);
    for (int32_t y = 0; y < 2; ++y)
    {
        uint32_t* row = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(image.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * image.stride);
        row[0] = 0xFF000000u;
        row[1] = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    }

    uint32_t nearest = 0;
    uint32_t smooth = 0;

    for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass)
    {
        Rasterizer::Surface surface;
        Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
        PrepareCanvas(canvas, surface, 64);

        Rasterizer::Source source;
        source.kind = Rasterizer::SourceKind::Image;
        source.image = &image;
        source.filter = pass == 1;

        Rasterizer::Transform scale;
        scale.scaleX = 32.0f;
        scale.scaleY = 32.0f;
        Rasterizer::Invert(scale, source.inverse);

        Rasterizer::Path* path = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
        Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*path, 0.0f, 0.0f, 64.0f, 64.0f);

        Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, *path, source, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, Rasterizer::BlendMode::Source, 255);

        uint32_t sampled = PixelAt(surface, 32, 32) & 0xFFu;
        if (pass == 0) nearest = sampled;
        else smooth = sampled;

        Rasterizer::DestroyPath(path);
        FinishCanvas(canvas, surface);
    }

    Expect(nearest == 0 || nearest == 255, "nearest sampling lands on one texel or the other");
    Expect(smooth > 0 && smooth < 255, "bilinear sampling blends across the texel boundary");

    Rasterizer::DestroySurface(image);
}

static void CheckNegativeCoordinates()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    PrepareCanvas(canvas, surface, 64);

    Rasterizer::Path* path = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*path, -64.0f, -64.0f, 32.0f, 32.0f);

    Rasterizer::Source source;
    source.color = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, *path, source, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver, 255);

    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 4, 4)) == 255, "a shape reaching past the top left still draws what is on screen");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 48, 48)) == 0, "a shape reaching past the top left stops where it should");

    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(path);
    FinishCanvas(canvas, surface);
}

static void CheckClipRectFollowsTransform()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    PrepareCanvas(canvas, surface, 64);

    Rasterizer::Transform move;
    move.translateX = 32.0f;
    move.translateY = 32.0f;
    Rasterizer::Concat(canvas, move);

    Rasterizer::ClipRect(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{0, 0, 16, 16});

    Rasterizer::Path* path = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*path, -64.0f, -64.0f, 64.0f, 64.0f);

    Rasterizer::Source source;
    source.color = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, *path, source, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver, 255);

    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 40, 40)) == 255, "a clip rect lands where the transform put it");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 8, 8)) == 0, "a clip rect does not stay at the origin the transform left");

    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(path);
    FinishCanvas(canvas, surface);
}

static void CheckLayerFollowsTransform()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    PrepareCanvas(canvas, surface, 64);

    Rasterizer::Transform move;
    move.translateX = 32.0f;
    Rasterizer::Concat(canvas, move);

    Rasterizer::SaveLayer(canvas, Rasterizer::Rect{0, 0, 32, 64}, 255, Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver);

    Rasterizer::Path* path = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*path, 0.0f, 0.0f, 32.0f, 64.0f);

    Rasterizer::Source source;
    source.color = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, *path, source, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, Rasterizer::BlendMode::SourceOver, 255);
    Rasterizer::RestoreLayer(canvas);

    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 40, 32)) == 255, "a layer keeps what the transform drew inside its bounds");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 8, 32)) == 0, "a layer does not sit at the untransformed bounds");

    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(path);
    FinishCanvas(canvas, surface);
}

static void CheckClearBlend()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    PrepareCanvas(canvas, surface, 64);

    Rasterizer::Path* path = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*path, 0.0f, 0.0f, 64.0f, 64.0f);

    Rasterizer::Source white;
    white.color = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, *path, white, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, Rasterizer::BlendMode::Source, 255);
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 32, 32)) == 255, "the surface starts opaque before it is cleared");

    Rasterizer::ResetPath(*path);
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*path, 16.0f, 16.0f, 48.0f, 48.0f);

    Rasterizer::Source black;
    black.color = 0xFF000000u;

    Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, *path, black, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, Rasterizer::BlendMode::Clear, 255);

    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 32, 32)) == 0, "clearing with black erases rather than painting black");
    Expect(PixelAt(surface, 32, 32) == 0, "a cleared pixel keeps no colour either");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 4, 4)) == 255, "clearing leaves what it did not cover alone");

    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(path);
    FinishCanvas(canvas, surface);
}

static void CheckImageTint()
{
    Rasterizer::Surface image;
    Rasterizer::CreateSurface(2, 2, image);

    for (int32_t y = 0; y < 2; ++y)
    {
        uint32_t* row = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(image.pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * image.stride);
        row[0] = 0xFF000000u;
        row[1] = 0x00000000u;
    }

    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    PrepareCanvas(canvas, surface, 64);

    Rasterizer::Source source;
    source.kind = Rasterizer::SourceKind::Image;
    source.image = &image;
    source.filter = false;
    source.tinted = true;
    source.tint = 0xFF2040FFu;

    Rasterizer::Transform scale;
    scale.scaleX = 32.0f;
    scale.scaleY = 32.0f;
    Rasterizer::Invert(scale, source.inverse);

    Rasterizer::Path* path = Rasterizer::CreatePath();
    Rasterizer::AddRectangle(*path, 0.0f, 0.0f, 64.0f, 64.0f);

    Rasterizer::FillPath(canvas, *path, source, Rasterizer::FillRule::NonZero, Rasterizer::BlendMode::Source, 255);

    uint32_t lit = PixelAt(surface, 8, 8);
    Expect(((lit >> 16) & 0xFF) == 0x20, "a tinted image takes the tint's red where the image is opaque");
    Expect((lit & 0xFF) == 0xFF, "a tinted image takes the tint's blue too");
    Expect(AlphaOf(lit) == 255, "an opaque texel stays opaque through the tint");
    Expect(AlphaOf(PixelAt(surface, 40, 8)) == 0, "a transparent texel stays transparent through the tint");

    Rasterizer::DestroyPath(path);
    FinishCanvas(canvas, surface);
    Rasterizer::DestroySurface(image);
}

int main()
{
    printf("vector rasterizer:\n");

    CheckTriangleFill();
    CheckEvenOddRule();
    CheckTransform();
    CheckClipPath();
    CheckLinearGradient();
    CheckStroke();
    CheckBlur();
    CheckLayerAlpha();
    CheckDeepStack();
    CheckClipSurvivesRestore();
    CheckArc();
    CheckImageFilter();
    CheckNegativeCoordinates();
    CheckClipRectFollowsTransform();
    CheckLayerFollowsTransform();
    CheckClearBlend();
    CheckImageTint();

    if (failures != 0)
    {
        printf("vector-unit FAILED: %d of %d checks failed\n", failures, checks);
        return 1;
    }

    printf("vector-unit PASSED: %d checks\n", checks);
    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <atomic>
#include <cerrno>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <csignal>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sched.h>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <sys/ptrace.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "Sandbox/Sandbox.hpp"
#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"

static constexpr int EXEC_REFUSED_CODE = 42;
static constexpr int EXEC_FAILED_CODE = 43;
static constexpr long X32_SYSCALL_BIT = 0x40000000;

static int failures = 0;
static int checks = 0;

static void Expect(bool condition, const char* description)
{
    checks += 1;
    if (condition)
    {
        printf("  ok    %s\n", description);
        return;
    }

    printf("  FAIL  %s\n", description);
    failures += 1;
}

static bool CanRead(const std::string& path)
{
    int descriptor = open(path.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (descriptor < 0) return false;

    close(descriptor);
    return true;
}

static bool ExecIsRefused()
{
    pid_t child = fork();
    if (child == 0)
    {
        char* arguments[] = {(char*)"/usr/bin/true", nullptr};
        execv("/usr/bin/true", arguments);
        _exit(errno == EPERM ? EXEC_REFUSED_CODE : EXEC_FAILED_CODE);
    }

    if (child < 0) return false;

    int state = 0;
    if (waitpid(child, &state, 0) < 0) return false;

    return WIFEXITED(state) && WEXITSTATUS(state) == EXEC_REFUSED_CODE;
}

static bool NonNativeAbiIsRefused()
{
    pid_t child = fork();
    if (child == 0)
    {
        syscall(X32_SYSCALL_BIT | __NR_unshare, CLONE_NEWUSER);
        _exit(EXEC_FAILED_CODE);
    }

    if (child < 0) return false;

    int state = 0;
    if (waitpid(child, &state, 0) < 0) return false;

    return WIFSIGNALED(state) && WTERMSIG(state) == SIGSYS;
}

static std::atomic<bool> filterInstalled{false};
static std::atomic<bool> siblingWasRefused{false};

static void ProbeFromSiblingThread()
{
    while (!filterInstalled.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) std::this_thread::yield();

    int probe = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
    siblingWasRefused.store(probe < 0 && errno == EPERM, std::memory_order_relaxed);

    if (probe >= 0) close(probe);
}

static constexpr int ISOLATION_REFUSED = 10;
static constexpr int HOME_STILL_VISIBLE = 11;
static constexpr int UNLISTED_STILL_VISIBLE = 12;
static constexpr int LISTED_PATH_LOST = 13;
static constexpr int PROCESS_TABLE_SHARED = 14;
static constexpr int NEIGHBOURS_STILL_VISIBLE = 15;
static constexpr int NETWORK_STILL_REACHABLE = 16;

static uint64_t CountProcesses()
{
    DIR* handle = opendir("/proc");
    if (!handle) return 0;

    uint64_t seen = 0;
    for (dirent* entry = readdir(handle); entry; entry = readdir(handle))
    {
        if (entry->d_name[0] >= '1' && entry->d_name[0] <= '9') seen += 1;
    }

    closedir(handle);
    return seen;
}

static int ProbeFromInsideIsolation()
{
    Sandbox::Isolation isolation;
    isolation.readablePaths.push_back("/usr");
    isolation.allowNetwork = false;
    isolation.separateProcessTable = true;

    Sandbox::IsolationReport report;
    if (Sandbox::Isolate(isolation, report) != Sandbox::Result::Ok) return ISOLATION_REFUSED;

    struct stat details;

    const std::string home = Settings::HomeDirectory();
    if (!home.empty() && stat(home.c_str(), &details) == 0) return HOME_STILL_VISIBLE;
    if (stat("/etc", &details) == 0) return UNLISTED_STILL_VISIBLE;
    if (stat("/usr/lib", &details) != 0) return LISTED_PATH_LOST;
    if (getpid() > 2) return PROCESS_TABLE_SHARED;
    if (CountProcesses() > 2) return NEIGHBOURS_STILL_VISIBLE;

    int probe = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
    if (probe >= 0)
    {
        sockaddr_in elsewhere{};
        elsewhere.sin_family = AF_INET;
        elsewhere.sin_port = htons(53);
        elsewhere.sin_addr.s_addr = inet_addr("1.1.1.1");

        bool reached = connect(probe, (sockaddr*)&elsewhere, sizeof(elsewhere)) == 0;
        close(probe);

        if (reached) return NETWORK_STILL_REACHABLE;
    }

    return 0;
}

static bool CanCreate(const std::string& path)
{
    int descriptor = open(path.c_str(), O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC | O_CLOEXEC, 0644);
    if (descriptor < 0) return false;

    close(descriptor);
    unlink(path.c_str());
    return true;
}

int main()
{
    if (!Sandbox::IsSupported())
    {
        printf("sandbox-unit SKIPPED: this kernel does not offer landlock\n");
        return 77;
    }

    char directoryTemplate[] = "/tmp/acl-sandbox-XXXXXX";
    const char* workDirectory = mkdtemp(directoryTemplate);
    if (!workDirectory)
    {
        printf("sandbox-unit FAILED: cannot create a work directory\n");
        return 1;
    }

    std::string allowed = std::string(workDirectory) + "/allowed.txt";
    const std::string home = Settings::HomeDirectory();
    std::string outsideHome = home.empty() ? std::string("/etc/hostname") : home + "/.bashrc";

    if (Sandbox::IsolationSupported())
    {
        pid_t isolated = fork();
        if (isolated == 0) _exit(ProbeFromInsideIsolation());

        int isolationState = 0;
        waitpid(isolated, &isolationState, 0);

        int outcome = WIFEXITED(isolationState) ? WEXITSTATUS(isolationState) : -1;

        printf("inside an isolated process:\n");
        Expect(outcome != ISOLATION_REFUSED, "the process can be isolated at all");
        Expect(outcome != HOME_STILL_VISIBLE, "$HOME is gone, not merely unreadable");
        Expect(outcome != UNLISTED_STILL_VISIBLE, "an unlisted directory does not exist");
        Expect(outcome != LISTED_PATH_LOST, "a listed directory survived the new root");
        Expect(outcome != PROCESS_TABLE_SHARED, "the process has its own process table, behind a reaper");
        Expect(outcome != NEIGHBOURS_STILL_VISIBLE, "no process outside the sandbox is visible in /proc");
        Expect(outcome != NETWORK_STILL_REACHABLE, "the network cannot be reached");
        Expect(outcome == 0, "every isolation check passed");
    }
    else
    {
        printf("isolation SKIPPED: this kernel offers no unprivileged namespaces\n");
    }

    printf("before the sandbox is applied:\n");
    Expect(CanRead("/etc/passwd"), "/etc/passwd is readable");
    Expect(CanCreate(allowed), "the work directory is writable");

    int probe = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
    Expect(probe >= 0, "a socket can be created");
    if (probe >= 0) close(probe);

    std::thread sibling(&ProbeFromSiblingThread);

    Sandbox::Policy policy;
    policy.readablePaths.push_back("/usr");
    policy.writablePaths.push_back(workDirectory);
    policy.allowNetwork = false;

    Sandbox::Report report;
    Sandbox::Result applied = Sandbox::Apply(policy, report);

    filterInstalled.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    sibling.join();

    if (applied != Sandbox::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("sandbox-unit FAILED: Apply returned %s\n", Sandbox::ResultName(applied));
        return 1;
    }

    printf("applied: landlock abi %d, %llu readable, %llu writable, %llu syscalls denied\n", report.filesystemAbi,
           (unsigned long long)report.readablePathsApplied, (unsigned long long)report.writablePathsApplied,
           (unsigned long long)report.syscallsDenied);

    printf("after the sandbox is applied:\n");
    Expect(!CanRead("/etc/passwd"), "/etc/passwd is no longer readable");
    Expect(!CanRead(outsideHome), "a file outside the policy is not readable");
    Expect(!CanRead("/etc"), "an unlisted directory is not readable");
    Expect(CanCreate(allowed), "the work directory is still writable");
    Expect(CanRead("/usr/lib"), "an allowed directory is still readable");

    Expect(socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0) < 0 && errno == EPERM, "socket(AF_INET) is refused with EPERM");
    Expect(socket(AF_INET6, SOCK_STREAM, 0) < 0 && errno == EPERM, "socket(AF_INET6) is refused with EPERM");

    int local = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
    Expect(local >= 0, "socket(AF_UNIX) is permitted, because a compositor connection needs it");
    if (local >= 0) close(local);

    Expect(ptrace(PTRACE_TRACEME, 0, nullptr, nullptr) < 0 && errno == EPERM, "ptrace is refused with EPERM");

    Expect(siblingWasRefused.load(std::memory_order_relaxed),
           "a thread that already existed when the filter was installed is refused too");

    Expect(ExecIsRefused(), "execv is refused, observed from a child so success cannot pass");
    Expect(report.syscallsDenied > 40, "the filter denies the expected number of syscalls");
    Expect(NonNativeAbiIsRefused(), "an x32 syscall is killed rather than falling through the filter");

    Expect(report.filesystemRestricted, "the report says the filesystem was restricted");
    Expect(report.syscallsRestricted, "the report says syscalls were restricted");
    Expect(report.resourcesRestricted, "the report says resources were restricted");
    Expect(report.readablePathsApplied == 1, "one readable path was applied");
    Expect(report.writablePathsApplied == 1, "one writable path was applied");
    Expect(report.syscallsDenied > 0, "the filter denies at least one syscall");

    rmdir(workDirectory);

    if (failures != 0)
    {
        printf("sandbox-unit FAILED: %d of %d checks failed\n", failures, checks);
        return 1;
    }

    printf("sandbox-unit PASSED: %d checks, the process cannot read the host, network, or exec\n", checks);
    return 0;
}
```

`tests/signature/SignatureUnit.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "ApkSignature/ApkSignature.hpp"
#include "ApkSignature/ApkSignatureInternal.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <vector>

static int gChecks = 0;
static int gFailures = 0;

static void Check(bool condition, const std::string& what)
{
    gChecks += 1;

    if (condition) return;

    gFailures += 1;
    std::fprintf(stderr, "FAILED: %s\n", what.c_str());
}

static bool CopyFile(const std::string& from, const std::string& to)
{
    std::FILE* source = std::fopen(from.c_str(), "rb");
    if (source == nullptr) return false;

    std::FILE* target = std::fopen(to.c_str(), "wb");
    if (target == nullptr)
    {
        std::fclose(source);
        return false;
    }

    char buffer[65536];
    size_t read = 0;

    while ((read = std::fread(buffer, 1, sizeof(buffer), source)) > 0)
    {
        std::fwrite(buffer, 1, read, target);
    }

    std::fclose(source);
    std::fclose(target);

    return true;
}

static bool FlipByte(const std::string& path, long offset)
{
    std::FILE* file = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "r+b");
    if (file == nullptr) return false;

    if (std::fseek(file, offset, SEEK_SET) != 0)
    {
        std::fclose(file);
        return false;
    }

    int value = std::fgetc(file);
    if (value < 0)
    {
        std::fclose(file);
        return false;
    }

    std::fseek(file, offset, SEEK_SET);
    std::fputc(value ^ 0xff, file);
    std::fclose(file);

    return true;
}

static std::string Hex(const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes)
{
    static const char* DIGITS = "0123456789abcdef";
    std::string text;

    for (uint8_t value : bytes)
    {
        text.push_back(DIGITS[value >> 4]);
        text.push_back(DIGITS[value & 0x0f]);
    }

    return text;
}

static std::string DigestOf(ApkSignatureInternal::DigestKind kind, const std::string& input)
{
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    ApkSignatureInternal::Digest(kind, input.data(), input.size(), out);

    return Hex(out);
}

static void CheckDigests()
{
    Check(DigestOf(ApkSignatureInternal::DigestKind::Sha256, "")
              == "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855",
          "SHA-256 of the empty string matches the published vector");

    Check(DigestOf(ApkSignatureInternal::DigestKind::Sha256, "abc")
              == "ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad",
          "SHA-256 of \"abc\" matches the published vector");

    Check(DigestOf(ApkSignatureInternal::DigestKind::Sha256,
                   "abcdbcdecdefdefgefghfghighijhijkijkljklmklmnlmnomnopnopq")
              == "248d6a61d20638b8e5c026930c3e6039a33ce45964ff2167f6ecedd419db06c1",
          "SHA-256 of the 56 byte vector, which straddles the padding boundary, matches");

    Check(DigestOf(ApkSignatureInternal::DigestKind::Sha512, "")
              == "cf83e1357eefb8bdf1542850d66d8007d620e4050b5715dc83f4a921d36ce9ce"
                 "47d0d13c5d85f2b0ff8318d2877eec2f63b931bd47417a81a538327af927da3e",
          "SHA-512 of the empty string matches the published vector");

    Check(DigestOf(ApkSignatureInternal::DigestKind::Sha512, "abc")
              == "ddaf35a193617abacc417349ae20413112e6fa4e89a97ea20a9eeee64b55d39a"
                 "2192992a274fc1a836ba3c23a3feebbd454d4423643ce80e2a9ac94fa54ca49f",
          "SHA-512 of \"abc\" matches the published vector");

    std::string long1000;
    long1000.assign(1000000, 'a');

    Check(DigestOf(ApkSignatureInternal::DigestKind::Sha256, long1000)
              == "cdc76e5c9914fb9281a1c7e284d73e67f1809a48a497200e046d39ccc7112cd0",
          "SHA-256 of a million 'a' matches the published vector, so multi block streaming is right");
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 3)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "usage: SignatureUnitTest <apk> <scratch directory>\n");
        return 2;
    }

    std::string apk = argv[1];
    std::string scratch = argv[2];

    ::mkdir(scratch.c_str(), 0755);

    CheckDigests();

    ApkSignature::Info info;
    ApkSignature::Result result = ApkSignature::Verify(apk, info);

    Check(result == ApkSignature::Result::Ok, std::string("the fixture verifies, got: ") + ApkSignature::ResultName(result));
    Check(info.verified, "the fixture reports itself verified");
    Check(info.scheme == ApkSignature::SCHEME_V2 || info.scheme == ApkSignature::SCHEME_V3,
          "the fixture is signed with a block scheme");
    Check(info.signers.size() == 1, "the fixture has exactly one signer");

    if (!info.signers.empty())
    {
        const ApkSignature::Signer& signer = info.signers.front();

        Check(!signer.certificate.empty(), "the signer carries a certificate");
        Check(signer.certificate.size() > 200, "the certificate is a plausible size");
        Check(signer.certificate[0] == 0x30, "the certificate is DER, so it opens with a SEQUENCE tag");
        Check(signer.certificateSha256.size() == 64, "the fingerprint is a full SHA-256 in hex");
        Check(signer.subject.find("Android") != std::string::npos || signer.subject.find("CN=") != std::string::npos,
              std::string("the subject reads as a name, got: ") + signer.subject);
        Check(signer.algorithm.find("SHA-") != std::string::npos, "the algorithm names its digest");
    }

    ApkSignature::Info read;
    ApkSignature::Result readResult = ApkSignature::Read(apk, read);

    Check(readResult == ApkSignature::Result::Ok, "reading without verifying succeeds");
    Check(!read.verified, "reading without verifying does not claim verification");
    Check(read.signers.size() == info.signers.size(), "reading finds the same signer count");

    if (!read.signers.empty() && !info.signers.empty())
    {
        Check(read.signers.front().certificate == info.signers.front().certificate,
              "reading and verifying return the same certificate bytes");
    }

    std::string tampered = scratch + "/tampered.apk";
    Check(CopyFile(apk, tampered), "the fixture can be copied for tampering");
    Check(FlipByte(tampered, 64), "a byte inside the first zip entry can be flipped");

    ApkSignature::Info tamperedInfo;
    ApkSignature::Result tamperedResult = ApkSignature::Verify(tampered, tamperedInfo);

    Check(tamperedResult == ApkSignature::Result::DigestMismatch,
          std::string("a tampered payload is rejected as a digest mismatch, got: ") + ApkSignature::ResultName(tamperedResult));
    Check(!tamperedInfo.verified, "a tampered payload is not reported verified");
    Check(!tamperedInfo.signers.empty(), "a tampered payload still names the signer it claims to be");

    std::string missing = scratch + "/there-is-no-such-file.apk";
    ApkSignature::Info missingInfo;

    Check(ApkSignature::Verify(missing, missingInfo) == ApkSignature::Result::Unreadable, "a missing file is unreadable");

    std::string plain = scratch + "/plain.bin";
    std::FILE* file = std::fopen(plain.c_str(), "wb");

    if (file != nullptr)
    {
        std::fwrite("this is not a zip archive at all", 1, 32, file);
        std::fclose(file);

        ApkSignature::Info plainInfo;
        ApkSignature::Result plainResult = ApkSignature::Verify(plain, plainInfo);

        Check(plainResult == ApkSignature::Result::Unsigned,
              std::string("a file that is not an archive reports unsigned, got: ") + ApkSignature::ResultName(plainResult));
        Check(plainInfo.scheme == ApkSignature::SCHEME_NONE, "a file that is not an archive names no scheme");
    }

    Check(std::strcmp(ApkSignature::SchemeName(ApkSignature::SCHEME_V2), "v2") == 0, "scheme 2 is named v2");
    Check(std::strcmp(ApkSignature::SchemeName(ApkSignature::SCHEME_NONE), "none") == 0, "scheme 0 is named none");
    Check(ApkSignature::DescribeInfo(info).find("signer") != std::string::npos, "the description mentions the signer");

    std::printf("%d check(s), %d failure(s)\n", gChecks, gFailures);

    return gFailures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
```

`tests/strict/src/com/example/strict/StrictApplication.java`:

```java
package com.example.strict;

import android.app.Application;
import android.util.Log;

public class StrictApplication extends Application
{
    private static final String TAG = "Strict";

    @Override
    public void onCreate()
    {
        super.onCreate();
        Log.i(TAG, "StrictApplication.onCreate package=" + getPackageName());

        describePermissions();
        describeSignature();
        describeSplits();

        Object service = getSystemService("no-such-service-at-all");
        Log.i(TAG, "survived the guarded call, service=" + service);
    }

    private void describePermissions()
    {
        Log.i(TAG, "INTERNET is " + describe("android.permission.INTERNET"));
        Log.i(TAG, "CAMERA is " + describe("android.permission.CAMERA"));
        Log.i(TAG, "READ_SMS is " + describe("android.permission.READ_SMS"));

        try
        {
            android.content.pm.PackageInfo info =
                getPackageManager().getPackageInfo(getPackageName(), android.content.pm.PackageManager.GET_PERMISSIONS);

            Log.i(TAG, "the package reports version " + info.versionName + " code " + info.versionCode + " with "
                       + (info.requestedPermissions == null ? -1 : info.requestedPermissions.length) + " requested permission(s)");
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "the package could not describe itself", cause);
        }

        Log.i(TAG, "a touchscreen is " + getPackageManager().hasSystemFeature("android.hardware.touchscreen")
                   + " and a telephone is " + getPackageManager().hasSystemFeature("android.hardware.telephony"));
    }

    private void describeSplits()
    {
        android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo info = getApplicationInfo();
        String[] names = info.splitNames;

        Log.i(TAG, "the package is installed with " + (names == null ? 0 : names.length) + " split(s)");

        if (names != null)
        {
            for (String name : names) Log.i(TAG, "split: " + name);
        }

        try
        {
            java.io.InputStream stream = getAssets().open("from-the-split.txt");
            byte[] buffer = new byte[64];
            int read = stream.read(buffer);
            stream.close();

            Log.i(TAG, "an asset that only the split carries reads back as " + new String(buffer, 0, Math.max(read, 0)).trim());
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "no asset from a split: " + cause.getClass().getSimpleName());
        }

        int identifier = getResources().getIdentifier("split_greeting", "string", getPackageName());

        if (identifier == 0)
        {
            Log.i(TAG, "no resource from a split");
            return;
        }

        Log.i(TAG, "a string that only the split carries resolves to " + getResources().getString(identifier));
    }

    private void describeSignature()
    {
        try
        {
            android.content.pm.PackageInfo info =
                getPackageManager().getPackageInfo(getPackageName(), android.content.pm.PackageManager.GET_SIGNATURES);

            if (info.signatures == null || info.signatures.length == 0)
            {
                Log.i(TAG, "the package carries no signature");
                return;
            }

            android.content.pm.Signature signature = info.signatures[0];
            byte[] certificate = signature.toByteArray();

            java.security.MessageDigest digest = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
            byte[] fingerprint = digest.digest(certificate);

            StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
            for (byte value : fingerprint) text.append(String.format("%02x", value));

            Log.i(TAG, "the package is signed by " + info.signatures.length + " signer(s), the first with a "
                       + certificate.length + " byte certificate");
            Log.i(TAG, "the signing certificate fingerprint is " + text);
            Log.i(TAG, "the signature reads back as " + signature.toCharsString().length() + " hex characters and "
                       + (signature.equals(new android.content.pm.Signature(signature.toCharsString())) ? "round trips"
                                                                                                        : "does not round trip"));
        }
        catch (Throwable cause)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "the package could not describe its signature", cause);
        }
    }

    private String describe(String permission)
    {
        return checkSelfPermission(permission) == android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED ? "granted" : "denied";
    }
}
```

```java
package com.example.surface;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.util.Log;
import android.view.SurfaceHolder;
import android.view.SurfaceView;

public class MainActivity extends Activity implements SurfaceHolder.Callback
{
    private static final String TAG = "SurfaceProbe";

    private int mChangedCount;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState)
    {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        try
        {
            System.loadLibrary("presence");
            Log.i(TAG, "the guest library is loaded, so the surface bridge is installed");
        }
        catch (Throwable missing)
        {
            Log.e(TAG, "the guest library did not load", missing);
        }

        SurfaceView view = new SurfaceView(this);
        view.getHolder().addCallback(this);
        setContentView(view);

        Log.i(TAG, "the content view is a SurfaceView and the callback is registered");
    }

    @Override
    public void surfaceCreated(SurfaceHolder holder)
    {
        Log.i(TAG, "surfaceCreated");
    }

    @Override
    public void surfaceChanged(SurfaceHolder holder, int format, int width, int height)
    {
        mChangedCount += 1;

        Log.i(TAG, "surfaceChanged " + width + "x" + height + " format " + format);

        if (mChangedCount == 1) finish();
    }

    @Override
    public void surfaceDestroyed(SurfaceHolder holder)
    {
        Log.i(TAG, "surfaceDestroyed");
    }
}
```
