`tests/text/FontStackUnit.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#include "FontStack/FontRegistry.hpp"
#include "FontStack/FontStack.hpp"
#include "FontStack/GlyphCache.hpp"

static int gFailures = 0;

static void Check(bool condition, const char* what)
{
    printf("%s %s\n", condition ? "PASS" : "FAIL", what);
    if (!condition) gFailures += 1;
}

static void ToUtf16(const char* ascii, std::vector<uint16_t>& out)
{
    out.clear();
    for (const char* cursor = ascii; *cursor; ++cursor)
    {
        out.push_back(static_cast<uint16_t>(static_cast<unsigned char>(*cursor)));
    }
}

static float MeasureAscii(uint32_t style, const char* ascii)
{
    std::vector<uint16_t> text;
    ToUtf16(ascii, text);

    float advance = 0.0f;
    FontStack::Result result = FontStack::MeasureText(style, text.data(), static_cast<int32_t>(text.size()), advance);
    if (result != FontStack::Result::Ok) return -1.0f;
    return advance;
}

static uint32_t StyleFor(const char* family, int weight, bool italic, float textSize)
{
    uint32_t font = FontStack::INVALID_FONT;
    if (FontStack::ResolveFamily(family, weight, italic, font) != FontStack::Result::Ok) return FontStack::INVALID_STYLE;

    uint32_t style = FontStack::INVALID_STYLE;
    if (FontStack::InternStyle(font, textSize, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0, style) != FontStack::Result::Ok) return FontStack::INVALID_STYLE;
    return style;
}

static void TestFamilyResolution()
{
    FontRegistry::Selection selection;

    Check(FontRegistry::Resolve("sans-serif", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, selection), "sans-serif resolves");
    Check(selection.weightAxis == 400.0f, "sans-serif is weight 400");

    Check(FontRegistry::Resolve("sans-serif-light", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, selection), "sans-serif-light resolves");
    Check(selection.weightAxis == 300.0f, "sans-serif-light pins weight 300 regardless of requested weight");

    Check(FontRegistry::Resolve("sans-serif-medium", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, selection), "sans-serif-medium resolves");
    Check(selection.weightAxis == 500.0f, "sans-serif-medium pins weight 500");

    FontRegistry::Resolve("sans-serif-condensed", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, selection);
    Check(selection.widthAxis == FontRegistry::AXIS_WIDTH_CONDENSED, "sans-serif-condensed narrows the width axis");

    FontRegistry::Resolve("no-such-family-at-all", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, selection);
    Check(selection.substitution == FontRegistry::Substitution::DefaultFamily, "an unknown family falls back and says so");

    FontRegistry::Resolve("serif", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, selection);
    Check(selection.substitution == FontRegistry::Substitution::FamilySubstituted, "serif reports itself as substituted");
}

static void TestWeightAffectsAdvance()
{
    uint32_t regular = StyleFor("sans-serif", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, 48.0f);
    uint32_t medium = StyleFor("sans-serif-medium", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, 48.0f);
    uint32_t light = StyleFor("sans-serif-light", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, 48.0f);

    Check(regular != FontStack::INVALID_STYLE && medium != FontStack::INVALID_STYLE, "regular and medium styles intern");

    float regularWidth = MeasureAscii(regular, "Hello World!");
    float mediumWidth = MeasureAscii(medium, "Hello World!");
    float lightWidth = MeasureAscii(light, "Hello World!");

    Check(regularWidth == 259.0f, "regular at 48px measures 259, the value the device reports");
    Check(lightWidth == 255.0f, "light at 48px measures 255, the value the device reports");
    Check(mediumWidth == 261.0f, "medium at 48px measures 261, the value the device reports");
    Check(mediumWidth > regularWidth && regularWidth > lightWidth, "the variable weight axis orders the three faces");

    uint32_t regularSmall = StyleFor("sans-serif", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, 14.0f);
    uint32_t lightSmall = StyleFor("sans-serif-light", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, 14.0f);

    Check(MeasureAscii(regularSmall, "Hello World!") == MeasureAscii(lightSmall, "Hello World!"),
          "at 14px light and regular collapse to the same advance, exactly as the device reports");
}

static void TestFreeTypeAgreesWithHarfBuzz()
{
    uint32_t style = StyleFor("sans-serif", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, 32.0f);

    std::vector<uint16_t> text;
    ToUtf16("H", text);

    uint64_t run = FontStack::INVALID_RUN;
    Check(FontStack::ShapeRun(style, text.data(), 1, false, run) == FontStack::Result::Ok, "single glyph shapes");

    int32_t glyphCount = 0;
    FontStack::RunGlyphCount(run, glyphCount);
    Check(glyphCount == 1, "one character produces one glyph");

    FontStack::GlyphPosition position;
    FontStack::RunGlyph(run, 0, position);

    float shaperAdvance = 0.0f;
    FontStack::RunAdvance(run, shaperAdvance);

    FontStack::GlyphImage image;
    Check(FontStack::RasterizeGlyph(style, position.glyphId, image) == FontStack::Result::Ok, "the shaped glyph rasterizes");
    Check(image.width > 0 && image.height > 0, "the rasterized glyph has a non-empty bitmap");
    Check(shaperAdvance > static_cast<float>(image.width) * 0.5f, "the shaper advance is consistent with the raster width");
}

static void TestMetricsAreRealAndOrdered()
{
    uint32_t style = StyleFor("sans-serif", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, 14.0f);

    FontStack::Metrics metrics;
    Check(FontStack::FontMetrics(style, metrics) == FontStack::Result::Ok, "font metrics resolve");
    Check(metrics.ascent < 0.0f, "ascent is negative, as Android defines it");
    Check(metrics.descent > 0.0f, "descent is positive");
    Check(metrics.top <= metrics.ascent, "top is at or above ascent");
    Check(metrics.bottom >= metrics.descent, "bottom is at or below descent");
}

static void TestAdvanceScalesWithSize()
{
    float small = MeasureAscii(StyleFor("sans-serif", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, 12.0f), "Hello World!");
    float large = MeasureAscii(StyleFor("sans-serif", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, 48.0f), "Hello World!");

    Check(large > small * 3.0f, "advance grows with text size");
}

static void TestCachesAreBounded()
{
    GlyphCache::Clear();

    uint32_t style = StyleFor("sans-serif", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, 14.0f);
    std::vector<uint16_t> text;
    ToUtf16("Hello World!", text);

    uint64_t first = FontStack::INVALID_RUN;
    FontStack::ShapeRun(style, text.data(), static_cast<int32_t>(text.size()), false, first);

    uint64_t second = FontStack::INVALID_RUN;
    FontStack::ShapeRun(style, text.data(), static_cast<int32_t>(text.size()), false, second);
    Check(first == second, "shaping the same run twice hits the shape cache");

    for (int size = 8; size < 200; ++size)
    {
        uint32_t cycled = StyleFor("sans-serif", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, static_cast<float>(size));
        MeasureAscii(cycled, "Hello World!");
    }

    GlyphCache::Statistics stats = GlyphCache::Snapshot();
    Check(stats.bytesResident <= FontStack::MAX_GLYPH_CACHE_BYTES, "the glyph cache stays inside its byte budget");
}

static void TestHostileInputFailsCleanly()
{
    uint32_t style = StyleFor("sans-serif", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, 14.0f);

    float advance = 0.0f;
    Check(FontStack::MeasureText(style, nullptr, 5, advance) == FontStack::Result::InvalidArgument, "a null string with a count is rejected");
    Check(FontStack::MeasureText(style, nullptr, -1, advance) == FontStack::Result::InvalidArgument, "a negative count is rejected");

    std::vector<uint16_t> huge(FontStack::MAX_RUN_LENGTH + 1, static_cast<uint16_t>('a'));
    Check(FontStack::MeasureText(style, huge.data(), static_cast<int32_t>(huge.size()), advance) == FontStack::Result::TextTooLong,
          "an over-long run is rejected rather than shaped");

    Check(FontStack::MeasureText(9999, huge.data(), 1, advance) == FontStack::Result::InvalidStyle, "a forged style id is rejected");

    uint32_t enormous = StyleFor("sans-serif", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, 1.0e6f);
    FontStack::Metrics metrics;
    Check(FontStack::FontMetrics(enormous, metrics) == FontStack::Result::Ok, "an absurd text size is clamped, not passed to FreeType");

    uint8_t garbage[64];
    memset(garbage, 0xA5, sizeof(garbage));
    uint32_t font = FontStack::INVALID_FONT;
    Check(FontStack::LoadFontFromMemory(garbage, sizeof(garbage), 400, false, font) == FontStack::Result::FontFileMalformed,
          "a malformed font buffer is rejected");
    Check(FontStack::LoadFontFromMemory(garbage, FontStack::MAX_FONT_FILE_BYTES + 1, 400, false, font) == FontStack::Result::FontFileTooLarge,
          "an oversized font is refused before it is read");
}

static void TestRunHandlesAreValidated()
{
    uint32_t style = StyleFor("sans-serif", FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, 14.0f);
    std::vector<uint16_t> text;
    ToUtf16("abc", text);

    uint64_t run = FontStack::INVALID_RUN;
    FontStack::ShapeRun(style, text.data(), 3, false, run);

    float advance = 0.0f;
    Check(FontStack::RunAdvance(run, advance) == FontStack::Result::Ok, "a live run reports its advance");
    Check(FontStack::RunAdvance(run ^ 0xFFFFFFFF00000000ull, advance) == FontStack::Result::InvalidRun,
          "a stale generation is rejected rather than dereferenced");
    Check(FontStack::RunAdvance(0, advance) == FontStack::Result::InvalidRun, "a zero handle is rejected");
    Check(FontStack::RunAdvance(0xFFFFFFFFull, advance) == FontStack::Result::InvalidRun, "an out-of-range slot is rejected");
}

int main()
{
    FontStack::Result started = FontStack::Initialize(nullptr);
    if (started != FontStack::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "font stack did not start: %s\n", FontStack::ResultName(started));
        return 1;
    }

    TestFamilyResolution();
    TestWeightAffectsAdvance();
    TestFreeTypeAgreesWithHarfBuzz();
    TestMetricsAreRealAndOrdered();
    TestAdvanceScalesWithSize();
    TestCachesAreBounded();
    TestHostileInputFailsCleanly();
    TestRunHandlesAreValidated();

    FontStack::Shutdown();

    printf("%s\n", gFailures == 0 ? "ALL PASS" : "FAILURES");
    return gFailures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
```

`tests/text/TextGolden.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include <ft2build.h>
#include FT_FREETYPE_H

#include "FontStack/FontStack.hpp"
#include "Rasterizer/Rasterizer.hpp"

static const uint32_t SURFACE_WIDTH = 360;
static const uint32_t SURFACE_HEIGHT = 220;
static const uint32_t BACKGROUND = 0xFF101828u;
static const uint32_t INK = 0xFFF0F0F0u;

static const char* CORPUS[] = {"Hello World!", "AVATAR Two", "gjpqy 0123", "Wave"};
static const float SIZES[] = {12.0f, 16.0f, 24.0f, 40.0f};
static const char* FAMILIES[] = {"sans-serif", "sans-serif-light", "sans-serif-medium", "monospace"};

static void ToUtf16(const char* ascii, std::vector<uint16_t>& out)
{
    out.clear();
    for (const char* cursor = ascii; *cursor; ++cursor)
    {
        out.push_back(static_cast<uint16_t>(static_cast<unsigned char>(*cursor)));
    }
}

static bool DrawRun(Rasterizer::Canvas& canvas, const char* family, float textSize, const char* ascii, int32_t x, int32_t baseline)
{
    uint32_t font = FontStack::INVALID_FONT;
    if (FontStack::ResolveFamily(family, FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, font) != FontStack::Result::Ok) return false;

    uint32_t style = FontStack::INVALID_STYLE;
    if (FontStack::InternStyle(font, textSize, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0, style) != FontStack::Result::Ok) return false;

    std::vector<uint16_t> text;
    ToUtf16(ascii, text);

    uint64_t run = FontStack::INVALID_RUN;
    if (FontStack::ShapeRun(style, text.data(), static_cast<int32_t>(text.size()), false, run) != FontStack::Result::Ok) return false;

    int32_t glyphCount = 0;
    FontStack::RunGlyphCount(run, glyphCount);

    for (int32_t index = 0; index < glyphCount; ++index)
    {
        FontStack::GlyphPosition position;
        if (FontStack::RunGlyph(run, index, position) != FontStack::Result::Ok) return false;

        FontStack::GlyphImage image;
        if (FontStack::RasterizeGlyph(style, position.glyphId, image) != FontStack::Result::Ok) continue;
        if (!image.samples || image.width <= 0 || image.height <= 0) continue;

        Rasterizer::Coverage mask;
        mask.samples = image.samples;
        mask.width = image.width;
        mask.height = image.height;
        mask.pitch = image.pitch;

        int32_t penX = x + static_cast<int32_t>(position.x) + image.bearingX;
        int32_t penY = baseline - image.bearingY;
        Rasterizer::DrawCoverage(canvas, mask, penX, penY, INK);
    }

    return true;
}

static bool PaintCorpus(Rasterizer::Canvas& canvas)
{
    Rasterizer::DrawColor(canvas, BACKGROUND);

    int32_t baseline = 20;
    for (size_t familyIndex = 0; familyIndex < sizeof(FAMILIES) / sizeof(FAMILIES[0]); ++familyIndex)
    {
        for (size_t sizeIndex = 0; sizeIndex < sizeof(SIZES) / sizeof(SIZES[0]); ++sizeIndex)
        {
            const char* text = CORPUS[(familyIndex + sizeIndex) % (sizeof(CORPUS) / sizeof(CORPUS[0]))];
            if (!DrawRun(canvas, FAMILIES[familyIndex], SIZES[sizeIndex], text, 8, baseline)) return false;
            baseline += static_cast<int32_t>(SIZES[sizeIndex]) / 2 + 6;
        }
    }

    return true;
}

static bool ReadProvenance(const char* path, std::string& freetypeVersion, std::string& fontHash)
{
    FILE* handle = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!handle) return false;

    char line[512];
    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), handle))
    {
        char* newline = strchr(line, '\n');
        if (newline) *newline = '\0';

        if (strncmp(line, "freetype=", 9) == 0) freetypeVersion = line + 9;
        else if (strncmp(line, "font_sha256=", 12) == 0) fontHash = line + 12;
    }

    fclose(handle);
    return !freetypeVersion.empty();
}

static bool FontDigest(const char* path, std::string& digest)
{
    std::string command = std::string("sha256sum ") + path + " 2>/dev/null";

    FILE* pipe = popen(command.c_str(), "r");
    if (!pipe) return false;

    char buffer[128];
    bool read = fgets(buffer, sizeof(buffer), pipe) != nullptr;
    pclose(pipe);

    if (!read) return false;

    digest.assign(buffer);
    size_t space = digest.find(' ');
    if (space != std::string::npos) digest.resize(space);

    return digest.size() == 64;
}

static std::string CurrentFreeTypeVersion()
{
    char buffer[64];
    snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%d.%d.%d", FREETYPE_MAJOR, FREETYPE_MINOR, FREETYPE_PATCH);
    return buffer;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 2)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s <golden.raw> [--regenerate]\n", argv[0]);
        return 2;
    }

    const char* goldenPath = argv[1];
    bool regenerate = argc > 2 && strcmp(argv[2], "--regenerate") == 0;
    if (argc > 2 && !regenerate)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "unrecognised argument: %s\n", argv[2]);
        return 2;
    }

    std::string provenancePath = std::string(goldenPath) + ".provenance";
    std::string pinnedFreeType;
    std::string pinnedFontHash;

    if (!regenerate)
    {
        if (!ReadProvenance(provenancePath.c_str(), pinnedFreeType, pinnedFontHash))
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "text golden provenance missing or malformed: %s\n", provenancePath.c_str());
            return 1;
        }

        std::string current = CurrentFreeTypeVersion();
        if (current != pinnedFreeType)
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "text golden was captured with FreeType %s, this build has %s.\n", pinnedFreeType.c_str(), current.c_str());
            fprintf(stderr, "Anti-aliased glyph coverage is only reproducible for a fixed FreeType.\n");
            fprintf(stderr, "Re-capture deliberately with --regenerate after reviewing the diff.\n");
            return 1;
        }

        if (pinnedFontHash.empty())
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "text golden provenance has no font_sha256= line: %s\n", provenancePath.c_str());
            return 1;
        }

        std::string fontPath = std::string(RUNTIME_DEFAULT_FONT_DIR) + "/Roboto-Regular.ttf";

        std::string actualHash;
        if (!FontDigest(fontPath.c_str(), actualHash))
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "could not hash the font at %s\n", fontPath.c_str());
            return 1;
        }

        if (actualHash != pinnedFontHash)
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "text golden was captured with a font whose SHA-256 is %s,\n", pinnedFontHash.c_str());
            fprintf(stderr, "but %s hashes to %s.\n", fontPath.c_str(), actualHash.c_str());
            return 1;
        }
    }

    FontStack::Result started = FontStack::Initialize(nullptr);
    if (started != FontStack::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "font stack did not start: %s\n", FontStack::ResultName(started));
        return 1;
    }

    Rasterizer::Surface surface;
    if (Rasterizer::CreateSurface(SURFACE_WIDTH, SURFACE_HEIGHT, surface) != Rasterizer::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "could not create the surface\n");
        return 1;
    }

    Rasterizer::Canvas canvas;
    Rasterizer::Begin(surface, canvas);

    if (!PaintCorpus(canvas))
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "the corpus did not render\n");
        return 1;
    }

    size_t sizeBytes = static_cast<size_t>(SURFACE_WIDTH) * SURFACE_HEIGHT * Rasterizer::BYTES_PER_PIXEL;

    if (regenerate)
    {
        FILE* out = fopen(goldenPath, "wb");
        if (!out)
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "cannot write %s\n", goldenPath);
            return 1;
        }
        fwrite(surface.pixels, 1, sizeBytes, out);
        fclose(out);
        printf("regenerated %s (%zu bytes) with FreeType %s\n", goldenPath, sizeBytes, CurrentFreeTypeVersion().c_str());

        Rasterizer::DestroySurface(surface);
        FontStack::Shutdown();
        return 0;
    }

    FILE* golden = fopen(goldenPath, "rb");
    if (!golden)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "text golden missing: %s (run with --regenerate)\n", goldenPath);
        return 1;
    }

    std::vector<uint8_t> expected(sizeBytes);
    size_t got = fread(expected.data(), 1, sizeBytes, golden);
    long extra = 0;
    if (fseek(golden, 0, SEEK_END) == 0) extra = ftell(golden);
    fclose(golden);

    if (got != sizeBytes || static_cast<size_t>(extra) != sizeBytes)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "text golden is %ld bytes, expected %zu\n", extra, sizeBytes);
        return 1;
    }

    size_t differing = 0;
    for (size_t index = 0; index < sizeBytes; index += Rasterizer::BYTES_PER_PIXEL)
    {
        if (memcmp(surface.pixels + index, expected.data() + index, Rasterizer::BYTES_PER_PIXEL) != 0) differing += 1;
    }

    Rasterizer::DestroySurface(surface);
    FontStack::Shutdown();

    if (differing != 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "%zu of %u pixels differ from %s\n", differing, SURFACE_WIDTH * SURFACE_HEIGHT, goldenPath);
        return 1;
    }

    printf("text golden matches: %ux%u, FreeType %s\n", SURFACE_WIDTH, SURFACE_HEIGHT, CurrentFreeTypeVersion().c_str());
    return 0;
}
```

`tests/text/TextMetricsHarness.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "FontStack/FontStack.hpp"

static const float SIZES[] = {12.0f, 14.0f, 16.0f, 20.0f, 24.0f, 32.0f, 48.0f};

static const char* CORPUS[] = {
    "Hello World!", "AV", "To", "Yo", "Ta", "0123456789", "iiiiiiiiii", "WWWWWWWWWW",
    "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog",
};

static const char* FAMILIES[] = {"sans-serif", "sans-serif-light", "sans-serif-medium", "monospace"};

static void ToUtf16(const char* ascii, std::vector<uint16_t>& out)
{
    out.clear();
    for (const char* cursor = ascii; *cursor; ++cursor)
    {
        out.push_back(static_cast<uint16_t>(static_cast<unsigned char>(*cursor)));
    }
}

static void EmitFamily(const char* section, const char* label, const char* family)
{
    uint32_t font = FontStack::INVALID_FONT;
    if (FontStack::ResolveFamily(family, FontStack::WEIGHT_NORMAL, false, font) != FontStack::Result::Ok) return;

    for (size_t sizeIndex = 0; sizeIndex < sizeof(SIZES) / sizeof(SIZES[0]); ++sizeIndex)
    {
        float size = SIZES[sizeIndex];

        uint32_t style = FontStack::INVALID_STYLE;
        if (FontStack::InternStyle(font, size, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0, style) != FontStack::Result::Ok) continue;

        FontStack::Metrics metrics;
        FontStack::FontMetrics(style, metrics);

        printf("%s %s %.4f metrics %.4f %.4f %.4f %.4f %.4f\n", section, label, size, metrics.top, metrics.ascent, metrics.descent,
               metrics.bottom, metrics.leading);

        printf("%s %s %.4f metricsInt %d %d %d %d %d\n", section, label, size, static_cast<int>(std::floor(metrics.top)),
               static_cast<int>(std::lround(metrics.ascent)), static_cast<int>(std::lround(metrics.descent)),
               static_cast<int>(std::ceil(metrics.bottom)), static_cast<int>(std::lround(metrics.leading)));

        for (size_t textIndex = 0; textIndex < sizeof(CORPUS) / sizeof(CORPUS[0]); ++textIndex)
        {
            std::vector<uint16_t> text;
            ToUtf16(CORPUS[textIndex], text);

            float advance = 0.0f;
            FontStack::MeasureText(style, text.data(), static_cast<int32_t>(text.size()), advance);
            printf("%s %s %.4f measure %.4f \"%s\"\n", section, label, size, advance, CORPUS[textIndex]);

            FontStack::Bounds bounds;
            FontStack::TextBounds(style, text.data(), static_cast<int32_t>(text.size()), bounds);
            printf("%s %s %.4f bounds %d %d %d %d \"%s\"\n", section, label, size, bounds.left, bounds.top, bounds.right, bounds.bottom,
                   CORPUS[textIndex]);

            std::vector<float> widths(text.size(), 0.0f);
            int32_t written = 0;
            FontStack::TextWidths(style, text.data(), static_cast<int32_t>(text.size()), widths.data(), written);

            printf("%s %s %.4f widths", section, label, size);
            for (int32_t widthIndex = 0; widthIndex < written; ++widthIndex)
            {
                printf(" %.4f", widths[static_cast<size_t>(widthIndex)]);
            }
            printf(" \"%s\"\n", CORPUS[textIndex]);
        }
    }
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc > 1 && strcmp(argv[1], "--regenerate") == 0)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "This harness has no regenerate mode by design.\n");
        fprintf(stderr, "The golden is ground truth captured from a device; regenerating it from the\n");
        fprintf(stderr, "implementation under test would turn the gate into a tautology.\n");
        fprintf(stderr, "Use tools/capture-text-metrics.sh --regenerate against a real device.\n");
        return 2;
    }

    FontStack::Result started = FontStack::Initialize(nullptr);
    if (started != FontStack::Result::Ok)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "font stack did not start: %s\n", FontStack::ResultName(started));
        return 1;
    }

    EmitFamily("file", "Roboto-Regular", "sans-serif");

    for (size_t index = 0; index < sizeof(FAMILIES) / sizeof(FAMILIES[0]); ++index)
    {
        EmitFamily("family", FAMILIES[index], FAMILIES[index]);
    }

    FontStack::Shutdown();
    return 0;
}
```

`tests/text/TextMetricsHarness.java`:

```java
package acl;

import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import java.util.Locale;

public class TextMetricsHarness
{
    private static final String FONT_PATH = "/data/local/tmp/acl/fonts/Roboto-Regular.ttf";

    private static final float[] SIZES = {12.0f, 14.0f, 16.0f, 20.0f, 24.0f, 32.0f, 48.0f};

    private static final String[] CORPUS = {
        "Hello World!",
        "AV",
        "To",
        "Yo",
        "Ta",
        "0123456789",
        "iiiiiiiiii",
        "WWWWWWWWWW",
        "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog",
    };

    private static final String[] FAMILIES = {"sans-serif", "sans-serif-light", "sans-serif-medium", "monospace"};

    private static void installSystemFontMap()
    {
        try
        {
            java.lang.reflect.Method loader = Typeface.class.getDeclaredMethod("loadPreinstalledSystemFontMap");
            loader.setAccessible(true);
            loader.invoke(null);
        }
        catch (Throwable unavailable)
        {
            System.out.println("# system_font_map_unavailable " + unavailable);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        installSystemFontMap();

        System.out.println("# device_model " + android.os.Build.MODEL);
        System.out.println("# device_manufacturer " + android.os.Build.MANUFACTURER);
        System.out.println("# android_sdk " + android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT);
        System.out.println("# locale " + Locale.getDefault());

        Typeface fromFile = null;
        try
        {
            fromFile = Typeface.createFromFile(FONT_PATH);
        }
        catch (Throwable missing)
        {
            System.out.println("# font_file_unavailable " + missing);
        }

        if (fromFile != null)
        {
            emit("file", "Roboto-Regular", fromFile);
        }

        for (String family : FAMILIES)
        {
            emit("family", family, Typeface.create(family, Typeface.NORMAL));
        }

        System.out.println("# end");
    }

    private static void emit(String section, String label, Typeface typeface)
    {
        Paint paint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
        paint.setTypeface(typeface);

        for (float size : SIZES)
        {
            paint.setTextSize(size);

            Paint.FontMetrics metrics = paint.getFontMetrics();
            Paint.FontMetricsInt metricsInt = paint.getFontMetricsInt();

            System.out.println(row(section, label, size, "metrics",
                                   fixed(metrics.top) + " " + fixed(metrics.ascent) + " " + fixed(metrics.descent) + " "
                                   + fixed(metrics.bottom) + " " + fixed(metrics.leading)));

            System.out.println(row(section, label, size, "metricsInt",
                                   metricsInt.top + " " + metricsInt.ascent + " " + metricsInt.descent + " " + metricsInt.bottom
                                   + " " + metricsInt.leading));

            for (String text : CORPUS)
            {
                System.out.println(row(section, label, size, "measure", fixed(paint.measureText(text)) + " " + quote(text)));

                Rect bounds = new Rect();
                paint.getTextBounds(text, 0, text.length(), bounds);
                System.out.println(row(section, label, size, "bounds",
                                       bounds.left + " " + bounds.top + " " + bounds.right + " " + bounds.bottom + " " + quote(text)));

                float[] widths = new float[text.length()];
                paint.getTextWidths(text, widths);
                StringBuilder perGlyph = new StringBuilder();
                for (int index = 0; index < widths.length; index++)
                {
                    if (index > 0) perGlyph.append(' ');
                    perGlyph.append(fixed(widths[index]));
                }
                System.out.println(row(section, label, size, "widths", perGlyph + " " + quote(text)));
            }
        }
    }

    private static String row(String section, String label, float size, String kind, String payload)
    {
        return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%s %s %s %s %s", section, label, fixed(size), kind, payload);
    }

    private static String fixed(float value)
    {
        return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.4f", value);
    }

    private static String quote(String text)
    {
        return "\"" + text + "\"";
    }
}
```

```cpp
    {"x_signed_divide_minus_one", {0x9AC10800u, 0xAA0003E0u}, 2, {0x8000000000000000ull, ~0ull, 0, 0}},
    {"w_divide_by_zero_is_zero", {0x1AC10C00u, 0xAA0003E0u}, 2, {0x1234ull, 0, 0, 0}},
    {"w_count_leading_zeros", {0x5AC01000u, 0xAA0003E0u}, 2, {0x00008000ull, 0, 0, 0}},
    {"x_count_leading_zeros_of_zero", {0xDAC01000u, 0xAA0003E0u}, 2, {0, 0, 0, 0}},
    {"w_reverse_bytes", {0x5AC00800u, 0xAA0003E0u}, 2, {0xDEADBEEFull, 0, 0, 0}},
    {"x_reverse_bits", {0xDAC00000u, 0xAA0003E0u}, 2, {0x0123456789ABCDEFull, 0, 0, 0}},
    {"w_adds_sets_flags_then_adc", {0x2B010000u, 0x1A0103E2u, 0xAA0203E0u}, 3, {0xFFFFFFFFull, 1, 0, 0}},
    {"x_subs_then_conditional_select", {0xEB010000u, 0x9A819002u, 0xAA0203E0u}, 3, {5, 9, 0, 0}},
    {"w_ands_clears_carry", {0x6A010000u, 0x1A9F37E2u, 0xAA0203E0u}, 3, {0xF0F0F0F0ull, 0x0F0F0F0Full, 0, 0}},
};

static constexpr int LOWERING_CASE_COUNT = (int)(sizeof(LOWERING_CASES) / sizeof(LOWERING_CASES[0]));

struct VectorMemory
{
    uint32_t code[VECTOR_MAX_CODE_WORDS];
    uint64_t scratch[VECTOR_SCRATCH_WORDS];
};

static bool MemoryRead(void* context, GuestState::GuestAddress address, void* destination, uint64_t length)
{
    VectorMemory* memory = (VectorMemory*)context;
    uint64_t raw = (uint64_t)address;

    if (raw >= VECTOR_CODE_BASE && raw + length <= VECTOR_CODE_BASE + sizeof(memory->code))
    {
        memcpy(destination, (const uint8_t*)memory->code + (raw - VECTOR_CODE_BASE), length);
        return true;
    }

    if (raw >= VECTOR_SCRATCH_BASE && raw + length <= VECTOR_SCRATCH_BASE + sizeof(memory->scratch))
    {
        memcpy(destination, (const uint8_t*)memory->scratch + (raw - VECTOR_SCRATCH_BASE), length);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

static bool MemoryWrite(void* context, GuestState::GuestAddress address, const void* source, uint64_t length)
{
    VectorMemory* memory = (VectorMemory*)context;
    uint64_t raw = (uint64_t)address;

    if (raw >= VECTOR_SCRATCH_BASE && raw + length <= VECTOR_SCRATCH_BASE + sizeof(memory->scratch))
    {
        memcpy((uint8_t*)memory->scratch + (raw - VECTOR_SCRATCH_BASE), source, length);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

static void SeedState(const VectorCase& testCase, GuestState::Registers& registers, VectorMemory& memory)
{
    memset(&memory, 0, sizeof(memory));
    memcpy(memory.code, testCase.code, sizeof(memory.code));
    memcpy(memory.scratch, testCase.scratch, sizeof(memory.scratch));

    GuestState::Reset(registers);
    for (int index = 0; index < VECTOR_GENERAL_COUNT; ++index) registers.general[index] = testCase.general[index];
    registers.stackPointer = VECTOR_SCRATCH_BASE + 0x1000;
    registers.flagsNzcv = testCase.nzcv;
}

static bool DecodeCase(const VectorCase& testCase, Ir::Function& function, VectorMemory& memory)
{
    Arm64Decoder::Context context;
    context.memory.Read = &MemoryRead;
    context.memory.Write = &MemoryWrite;
    context.memory.context = &memory;

    Ir::Block block;
    function.entryAddress = (GuestState::GuestAddress)VECTOR_CODE_BASE;
    function.endAddress = (GuestState::GuestAddress)(VECTOR_CODE_BASE + testCase.codeWords * 4);
    block.guestAddress = function.entryAddress;
    block.guestEndAddress = function.endAddress;

    for (int word = 0; word < testCase.codeWords; ++word)
    {
        GuestState::GuestAddress at = (GuestState::GuestAddress)(VECTOR_CODE_BASE + word * 4);
        if (Arm64Decoder::DecodeInstruction(context, testCase.code[word], at, function, block) != Arm64Decoder::Result::Ok) return false;
    }

    function.blocks.push_back(std::move(block));
    return Ir::Verify(function);
}

static int loweringCompiled = 0;

static void RunLoweringCases(LlvmBackend::Session& session, int& failures)
{
    for (int index = 0; index < LOWERING_CASE_COUNT; ++index)
    {
        const LoweringCase& loweringCase = LOWERING_CASES[index];

        VectorMemory memory;
        memset(&memory, 0, sizeof(memory));
        for (int word = 0; word < loweringCase.codeWords; ++word) memory.code[word] = loweringCase.code[word];

        Arm64Decoder::Context context;
        context.memory.Read = &MemoryRead;
        context.memory.Write = &MemoryWrite;
        context.memory.context = &memory;

        Ir::Function function;
        Ir::Block block;
        function.entryAddress = (GuestState::GuestAddress)VECTOR_CODE_BASE;
        function.endAddress = (GuestState::GuestAddress)(VECTOR_CODE_BASE + loweringCase.codeWords * 4);
        block.guestAddress = function.entryAddress;
        block.guestEndAddress = function.endAddress;

        bool decoded = true;
        for (int word = 0; word < loweringCase.codeWords; ++word)
        {
            GuestState::GuestAddress at = (GuestState::GuestAddress)(VECTOR_CODE_BASE + word * 4);
            if (Arm64Decoder::DecodeInstruction(context, loweringCase.code[word], at, function, block) != Arm64Decoder::Result::Ok)
            {
                printf("FAIL %s: word %d (%08x) did not decode\n", loweringCase.name, word, loweringCase.code[word]);
                failures += 1;
                decoded = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!decoded) continue;

        function.blocks.push_back(std::move(block));
        if (!Ir::Verify(function))
        {
            printf("FAIL %s: the decoded IR does not verify\n", loweringCase.name);
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        Ir::Opcode unsupported = Ir::Opcode::Invalid;
        if (!LlvmBackend::CanLower(function, unsupported))
        {
            printf("FAIL %s: this case exists to exercise the lowering but T1 rejected it (%s)\n", loweringCase.name,
                   Ir::OpcodeName(unsupported));
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        LlvmBackend::CompiledFunction target;
        if (LlvmBackend::CompileFunction(session, function, LlvmBackend::Tier::Baseline, target) != LlvmBackend::Result::Ok)
        {
            printf("FAIL %s: T1 compilation failed\n", loweringCase.name);
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        GuestState::Registers interpreted;
        GuestState::Reset(interpreted);
        for (int reg = 0; reg < 4; ++reg) interpreted.general[reg] = loweringCase.general[reg];
        interpreted.stackPointer = VECTOR_SCRATCH_BASE + 0x1000;

        GuestState::Registers recompiled = interpreted;

        VectorMemory interpretedMemory = memory;
        VectorMemory recompiledMemory = memory;

        GuestState::MemoryAccessor accessor;
        accessor.Read = &MemoryRead;
        accessor.Write = &MemoryWrite;
        accessor.context = &interpretedMemory;

        Interpreter::Configuration interpreterConfiguration;
        Interpreter::RunBlock(function.blocks.front(), interpreted, accessor, interpreterConfiguration);

        LlvmBackend::RuntimeContext runtime;
        runtime.memory.Read = &MemoryRead;
        runtime.memory.Write = &MemoryWrite;
        runtime.memory.context = &recompiledMemory;

        Interpreter::ExitStatus status;
        ((LlvmBackend::EntryPoint)target.hostEntryPoint)(&recompiled, &runtime, &status, 0);

        loweringCompiled += 1;

        if (!GuestState::Equals(interpreted, recompiled))
        {
            printf("FAIL %s: T0 x0=%016llx x2=%016llx nzcv=%08x, T1 x0=%016llx x2=%016llx nzcv=%08x\n", loweringCase.name,
                   (unsigned long long)interpreted.general[0], (unsigned long long)interpreted.general[2], interpreted.flagsNzcv,
                   (unsigned long long)recompiled.general[0], (unsigned long long)recompiled.general[2], recompiled.flagsNzcv);
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        printf("PASS %s\n", loweringCase.name);
    }
}

int main()
{
    LlvmBackend::Configuration configuration;
    LlvmBackend::Session session;

    if (LlvmBackend::Initialize(configuration, session) != LlvmBackend::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("tier-differential FAILED: the LLVM backend did not initialise\n");
        return 1;
    }

    int compiled = 0;
    int skipped = 0;
    int failures = 0;

    for (int index = 0; index < VECTOR_CASE_COUNT; ++index)
    {
        const VectorCase& testCase = VECTOR_CASES[index];

        VectorMemory decodeMemory;
        memset(&decodeMemory, 0, sizeof(decodeMemory));
        memcpy(decodeMemory.code, testCase.code, sizeof(decodeMemory.code));

        Ir::Function function;
        if (!DecodeCase(testCase, function, decodeMemory))
        {
            printf("FAIL %s: the case did not decode or verify\n", testCase.name);
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        Ir::Opcode unsupported = Ir::Opcode::Invalid;
        if (!LlvmBackend::CanLower(function, unsupported))
        {
            skipped += 1;
            continue;
        }

        LlvmBackend::CompiledFunction target;
        LlvmBackend::Result lowered = LlvmBackend::CompileFunction(session, function, LlvmBackend::Tier::Baseline, target);
        if (lowered != LlvmBackend::Result::Ok)
        {
            printf("FAIL %s: T1 compilation returned %s\n", testCase.name, LlvmBackend::ResultName(lowered));
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        GuestState::Registers interpreted;
        VectorMemory interpretedMemory;
        SeedState(testCase, interpreted, interpretedMemory);

        GuestState::MemoryAccessor interpretedAccessor;
        interpretedAccessor.Read = &MemoryRead;
        interpretedAccessor.Write = &MemoryWrite;
        interpretedAccessor.context = &interpretedMemory;

        Interpreter::Configuration interpreterConfiguration;
        Interpreter::ExitStatus interpretedStatus =
            Interpreter::RunBlock(function.blocks.front(), interpreted, interpretedAccessor, interpreterConfiguration);

        GuestState::Registers recompiled;
        VectorMemory recompiledMemory;
        SeedState(testCase, recompiled, recompiledMemory);

        LlvmBackend::RuntimeContext runtime;
        runtime.memory.Read = &MemoryRead;
        runtime.memory.Write = &MemoryWrite;
        runtime.memory.context = &recompiledMemory;

        Interpreter::ExitStatus recompiledStatus;
        LlvmBackend::EntryPoint entry = (LlvmBackend::EntryPoint)target.hostEntryPoint;
        entry(&recompiled, &runtime, &recompiledStatus, 0);

        compiled += 1;

        if (!GuestState::Equals(interpreted, recompiled))
        {
            printf("FAIL %s: the register file differs between T0 and T1\n", testCase.name);
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        if (memcmp(&interpretedMemory, &recompiledMemory, sizeof(VectorMemory)) != 0)
        {
            printf("FAIL %s: touched memory differs between T0 and T1\n", testCase.name);
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        if (interpretedStatus.reason != recompiledStatus.reason)
        {
            printf("FAIL %s: T0 exited with %s, T1 with %s\n", testCase.name, Interpreter::ExitReasonName(interpretedStatus.reason),
                   Interpreter::ExitReasonName(recompiledStatus.reason));
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        printf("PASS %s\n", testCase.name);
    }

    printf("\n--- directed lowering cases ---\n");
    RunLoweringCases(session, failures);

    LlvmBackend::Statistics statistics = LlvmBackend::GetStatistics(session);
    printf("\n%d silicon cases compiled and compared, %d skipped as not yet lowerable, %d directed cases, %d failed\n", compiled, skipped,
           loweringCompiled, failures);
    printf("backend: %llu functions compiled, %llu rejected, %llu IR instructions lowered\n",
           (unsigned long long)statistics.functionsCompiled, (unsigned long long)statistics.functionsRejected,
           (unsigned long long)statistics.instructionsLowered);

    LlvmBackend::Shutdown(session);

    if (failures != 0)
    {
        printf("tier-differential FAILED: %d cases diverged\n", failures);
        return 1;
    }

    if (compiled < MINIMUM_COMPILED_CASES)
    {
        printf("tier-differential FAILED: only %d silicon cases ran under T1, below the floor of %d - lowering coverage\n"
               "regressed\n",
               compiled, MINIMUM_COMPILED_CASES);
        return 1;
    }

    if (loweringCompiled < MINIMUM_LOWERING_CASES)
    {
        printf("tier-differential FAILED: only %d directed lowering cases ran, below the floor of %d\n", loweringCompiled,
               MINIMUM_LOWERING_CASES);
        return 1;
    }

    if (statistics.functionsCompiled == 0)
    {
        printf("tier-differential FAILED: the backend reports zero compiled functions, so T1 never ran\n");
        return 1;
    }

    printf("tier-differential PASSED: T0 and T1 agree on %d cases\n", compiled);
    return 0;
}
```

`tests/tiers/FunctionDifferential.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "Arm64Decoder/Arm64Decoder.hpp"
#include "GuestLibc/GuestLibc.hpp"
#include "GuestRuntime/GuestRuntime.hpp"
#include "LlvmBackend/LlvmBackend.hpp"

struct FunctionCase
{
    const char* name;
    uint64_t arguments[4];
    int argumentCount;
};

static const FunctionCase FUNCTION_CASES[] = {
    {"SumTo", {0}, 1},
    {"SumTo", {1}, 1},
    {"SumTo", {97}, 1},
    {"CollatzSteps", {27}, 1},
    {"CollatzSteps", {1}, 1},
    {"CollatzSteps", {97}, 1},
    {"GreatestCommonDivisor", {1071, 462}, 2},
    {"GreatestCommonDivisor", {17, 0}, 2},
    {"GreatestCommonDivisor", {0, 13}, 2},
    {"Branchy", {5, 9}, 2},
    {"Branchy", {9, 5}, 2},
    {"Branchy", {7, 7}, 2},
    {"NestedLoops", {13}, 1},
    {"NestedLoops", {0}, 1},
    {"BitWeights", {0x0123456789abcdefull}, 1},
    {"BitWeights", {0}, 1},
    {"BitWeights", {0xffffffffffffffffull}, 1},
    {"ShiftMix", {0x123456789abcdefull, 0x2b}, 2},
    {"ShiftMix", {0xffffffffffffffffull, 3}, 2},
    {"SelectChain", {5, 19, 2}, 3},
    {"SelectChain", {0xfffffffffffffff0ull, 4, 4}, 3},
    {"CountdownDivide", {1000000}, 1},
    {"CountdownDivide", {0}, 1},
    {"CountdownDivide", {0xffffffffffffffffull}, 1},
};

static constexpr int FUNCTION_CASE_COUNT = (int)(sizeof(FUNCTION_CASES) / sizeof(FUNCTION_CASES[0]));
static constexpr uint64_t STACK_BYTES = 1u << 20;
static constexpr int SKIP_EXIT_CODE = 77;

static int failures = 0;
static int compared = 0;

static void Check(bool condition, const std::string& label)
{
    if (condition)
    {
        printf("PASS %s\n", label.c_str());
        return;
    }

    printf("FAIL %s\n", label.c_str());
    failures += 1;
}

static void ReportDifference(const GuestState::Registers& expected, const GuestState::Registers& produced)
{
    for (int index = 0; index < 31; ++index)
    {
        if (expected.general[index] == produced.general[index]) continue;
        printf("       x%-2d interpreted=%016llx translated=%016llx\n", index, (unsigned long long)expected.general[index],
               (unsigned long long)produced.general[index]);
    }

    if (expected.stackPointer != produced.stackPointer)
        printf("       sp  interpreted=%016llx translated=%016llx\n", (unsigned long long)expected.stackPointer,
               (unsigned long long)produced.stackPointer);

    if (expected.flagsNzcv != produced.flagsNzcv)
        printf("       nzcv interpreted=%08x translated=%08x\n", expected.flagsNzcv, produced.flagsNzcv);

    const uint8_t* left = (const uint8_t*)&expected;
    const uint8_t* right = (const uint8_t*)&produced;

    for (size_t offset = 0; offset < sizeof(GuestState::Registers); ++offset)
    {
        if (left[offset] == right[offset]) continue;
        printf("       byte %zu interpreted=%02x translated=%02x\n", offset, left[offset], right[offset]);
    }
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 2)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: FunctionDifferentialTest <libfunctions.so>\n");
        return 2;
    }

    std::string path = argv[1];
    std::string directory = ".";
    size_t slash = path.find_last_of('/');
    if (slash != std::string::npos) directory = path.substr(0, slash);

    GuestRuntime::Configuration configuration;
    configuration.searchPaths.push_back(directory);
    configuration.stubUnresolvedSymbols = true;

    GuestRuntime::Instance instance;
    if (GuestRuntime::Create(configuration, instance) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("function-differential FAILED: cannot create the guest runtime\n");
        return 1;
    }

    if (GuestRuntime::RegisterPlatformProxies(instance) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok ||
        GuestLibc::RegisterAll(instance) != GuestLibc::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("function-differential FAILED: cannot register the guest platform surface\n");
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return 1;
    }

    uint32_t moduleId = ElfLoader::INVALID_MODULE_ID;
    if (GuestRuntime::Load(instance, path, moduleId) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("function-differential FAILED: cannot load %s\n", path.c_str());
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return 1;
    }

    GuestState::GuestAddress stackTop{};
    if (GuestRuntime::AllocateStack(instance, STACK_BYTES, stackTop) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("function-differential FAILED: cannot allocate a guest stack\n");
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return 1;
    }

    GuestState::GuestAddress threadPointer{};
    if (GuestRuntime::AllocateThreadPointer(instance, threadPointer) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("function-differential FAILED: cannot allocate a guest thread pointer\n");
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return 1;
    }

    LlvmBackend::Configuration backendConfiguration;
    backendConfiguration.directMemoryAccess = true;

    LlvmBackend::Session session;
    if (LlvmBackend::Initialize(backendConfiguration, session) != LlvmBackend::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("function-differential FAILED: cannot start the translator\n");
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return 1;
    }

    Arm64Decoder::Context decoder;
    decoder.memory = GuestRuntime::Memory(instance);
    decoder.trapOnUndecodable = true;

    uint64_t multiBlock = 0;
    uint64_t totalBlocks = 0;

    for (int index = 0; index < FUNCTION_CASE_COUNT; ++index)
    {
        const FunctionCase& testCase = FUNCTION_CASES[index];

        GuestState::GuestAddress entry{};
        if (GuestRuntime::Lookup(instance, testCase.name, entry) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
        {
            printf("FAIL the fixture exports %s\n", testCase.name);
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        GuestState::Registers interpreted;
        GuestState::Reset(interpreted);
        interpreted.stackPointer = (uint64_t)stackTop;
        interpreted.threadPointer = (uint64_t)threadPointer;
        for (int argument = 0; argument < testCase.argumentCount; ++argument)
            interpreted.general[argument] = testCase.arguments[argument];

        GuestState::Registers translated = interpreted;

        if (GuestRuntime::CallGuest(instance, entry, interpreted) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
        {
            printf("FAIL %s interpreted cleanly\n", testCase.name);
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        Ir::Function function;
        if (Arm64Decoder::DecodeFunction(decoder, entry, (GuestState::GuestAddress)((uint64_t)entry + 4096), function) !=
            Arm64Decoder::Result::Ok)
        {
            printf("FAIL %s decodes as a whole function\n", testCase.name);
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        totalBlocks += function.blocks.size();
        if (function.blocks.size() > 1) multiBlock += 1;

        Ir::Opcode unsupported = Ir::Opcode::Invalid;
        if (!LlvmBackend::CanLower(function, unsupported))
        {
            printf("FAIL %s is lowerable (first unsupported opcode %s)\n", testCase.name, Ir::OpcodeName(unsupported));
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        LlvmBackend::CompiledFunction compiled;
        LlvmBackend::Result built = LlvmBackend::CompileFunction(session, function, LlvmBackend::Tier::Baseline, compiled);
        if (built != LlvmBackend::Result::Ok)
        {
            printf("FAIL %s translates (%s)\n", testCase.name, LlvmBackend::ResultName(built));
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        translated.general[30] = GuestRuntime::SENTINEL_RETURN_ADDRESS;

        LlvmBackend::RuntimeContext runtime;
        runtime.memory = GuestRuntime::Memory(instance);

        Interpreter::ExitStatus status;
        memset(&status, 0, sizeof(status));

        ((LlvmBackend::EntryPoint)compiled.hostEntryPoint)(&translated, &runtime, &status, 0);
        LlvmBackend::ReleaseFunction(session, compiled);

        std::string label = std::string(testCase.name) + " case " + std::to_string(index);

        if (status.reason != Interpreter::ExitReason::Returned)
        {
            printf("FAIL %s left translated code with %s rather than a return\n", label.c_str(),
                   Interpreter::ExitReasonName(status.reason));
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        if (!GuestState::Equals(interpreted, translated))
        {
            printf("FAIL %s: the register file differs between the interpreter and the translator\n", label.c_str());
            ReportDifference(interpreted, translated);
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        compared += 1;
        printf("PASS %s -> x0=%016llx over %llu block(s)\n", label.c_str(), (unsigned long long)translated.general[0],
               (unsigned long long)function.blocks.size());
    }

    printf("\n%llu of %d functions had internal control flow, %llu blocks decoded in total\n", (unsigned long long)multiBlock,
           FUNCTION_CASE_COUNT, (unsigned long long)totalBlocks);

    Check(multiBlock * 2 > (uint64_t)FUNCTION_CASE_COUNT,
          "most cases exercise a function with internal control flow, so this really is a whole-function differential");
    Check(totalBlocks >= 3 * (uint64_t)FUNCTION_CASE_COUNT,
          "the cases average several blocks each, so loops and branches stayed inside translated code");
    Check(compared == FUNCTION_CASE_COUNT, "every case was compared rather than skipped");

    LlvmBackend::Shutdown(session);
    GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);

    if (compared == 0)
    {
        printf("function-differential CANNOT DISCRIMINATE: nothing was compared\n");
        return SKIP_EXIT_CODE;
    }

    printf("%s: %d checks failed\n", failures == 0 ? "function-differential PASSED" : "function-differential FAILED", failures);
    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
```

`tests/tiers/InvalidationUnit.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <thread>

#include "GuestRuntime/GuestRuntime.hpp"

static constexpr uint32_t MOVZ_X0_ONE = 0xD2800020u;
static constexpr uint32_t MOVZ_X0_TWO = 0xD2800040u;
static constexpr uint32_t MOVZ_X0_THREE = 0xD2800060u;

static constexpr uint32_t ISB = 0xD5033FDFu;
static constexpr uint32_t MRS_X0_CNTVCT = 0xD53BE040u;
static constexpr uint32_t MRS_X0_CNTFRQ = 0xD53BE000u;
static constexpr uint64_t HOT_THRESHOLD = 4;
static constexpr uint64_t LOOP_OFFSET = 0x100;
static constexpr uint64_t SYSCALL_OFFSET = 0x200;
static constexpr uint64_t PATCHED_OFFSET = 0x300;
static constexpr uint64_t FLUSH_OFFSET = 0x400;

static constexpr uint64_t FREQUENCY_OFFSET = 0x600;
static constexpr uint64_t EXPECTED_COUNTER_FREQUENCY = 24000000;
static constexpr uint64_t BACKGROUND_ATTEMPTS = 500;
static constexpr uint64_t BACKGROUND_PAUSE_MILLISECONDS = 10;

static int failures = 0;

static void Check(bool condition, const char* label)
{
    if (condition)
    {
        printf("PASS %s\n", label);
        return;
    }

    printf("FAIL %s\n", label);
    failures += 1;
}

static bool CallWith(GuestRuntime::Instance& instance, GuestState::GuestAddress entry, uint64_t argument, uint64_t& returned)
{
    GuestState::Registers registers;
    GuestState::Reset(registers);
    registers.general[0] = argument;

    if (GuestRuntime::CallGuest(instance, entry, registers) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok) return false;

    returned = registers.general[0];
    return true;
}

static bool CallAt(GuestRuntime::Instance& instance, GuestState::GuestAddress entry, uint64_t& returned)
{
    return CallWith(instance, entry, 0, returned);
}

static int RunTier(bool recompile)
{
    printf("--- %s ---\n", recompile ? "T1 (recompiling)" : "T0 (interpreting)");

    GuestRuntime::Configuration configuration;
    configuration.recompile = recompile;

    GuestRuntime::Instance instance;
    if (GuestRuntime::Create(configuration, instance) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("invalidation-unit FAILED: the guest runtime did not start\n");
        return 1;
    }

    GuestState::GuestAddress code{};
    if (GuestRuntime::Reserve(instance, 0x4000, 0x4000, code) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok ||
        GuestRuntime::Commit(instance, code, 0x4000, true, true, true) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("invalidation-unit FAILED: cannot reserve an executable guest page\n");
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return 1;
    }

    const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory = GuestRuntime::Memory(instance);

    uint32_t first[2] = {MOVZ_X0_ONE, RET_X30};
    memory.Write(memory.context, code, first, sizeof(first));

    uint64_t returned = 0;
    Check(CallAt(instance, code, returned) && returned == 1, "the guest page executes and returns 1");

    uint64_t decodedAfterFirst = GuestRuntime::GetStatistics(instance).blocksDecoded;

    Check(CallAt(instance, code, returned) && returned == 1, "a second call still returns 1");
    Check(GuestRuntime::GetStatistics(instance).blocksDecoded == decodedAfterFirst,
          "the second call was served from the block cache without re-decoding");

    uint32_t second[2] = {MOVZ_X0_TWO, RET_X30};
    memory.Write(memory.context, code, second, sizeof(second));

    Check(GuestRuntime::GetStatistics(instance).codeWritesObserved > 0, "a write to an executable guest page is observed");

    Check(CallAt(instance, code, returned) && returned == 2,
          "after the code page was rewritten the guest returns the NEW value, so the stale block was invalidated");

    Check(GuestRuntime::GetStatistics(instance).blocksDecoded > decodedAfterFirst,
          "the rewritten page was re-decoded rather than served stale from the cache");

    if (recompile)
    {
        Check(GuestRuntime::GetStatistics(instance).blocksRecompiled > 0,
              "T1 actually recompiled the block, so the native-entry invalidation path was exercised");
    }

    uint32_t third[2] = {MOVZ_X0_THREE, RET_X30};
    GuestRuntime::Protect(instance, code, 0x4000, true, true, false);
    memory.Write(memory.context, code, third, sizeof(third));
    GuestRuntime::Protect(instance, code, 0x4000, true, false, true);

    Check(CallAt(instance, code, returned) && returned == 3,
          "the write-enable / patch / re-protect cycle a real guest JIT uses also invalidates");

    GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
    return failures;
}

static int RunHotRegions()
{
    printf("--- T1 with a hot threshold of %llu and run-time regions ---\n", (unsigned long long)HOT_THRESHOLD);

    GuestRuntime::Configuration configuration;
    configuration.recompile = true;
    configuration.recompileThreshold = HOT_THRESHOLD;

    GuestRuntime::Instance instance;
    if (GuestRuntime::Create(configuration, instance) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("invalidation-unit FAILED: the guest runtime did not start\n");
        return 1;
    }

    GuestState::GuestAddress code{};
    if (GuestRuntime::Reserve(instance, 0x4000, 0x4000, code) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok ||
        GuestRuntime::Commit(instance, code, 0x4000, true, true, true) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("invalidation-unit FAILED: cannot reserve an executable guest page\n");
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return 1;
    }

    const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory = GuestRuntime::Memory(instance);

    uint32_t straight[2] = {MOVZ_X0_ONE, RET_X30};
    memory.Write(memory.context, code, straight, sizeof(straight));

    uint64_t returned = 0;
    bool coldCallsReturned = true;

    for (uint64_t call = 1; call < HOT_THRESHOLD; ++call)
        coldCallsReturned = coldCallsReturned && CallAt(instance, code, returned) && returned == 1;

    Check(coldCallsReturned, "the cold calls below the threshold return 1");
    Check(GuestRuntime::GetStatistics(instance).regionsRecompiled == 0, "nothing is compiled before a block reaches the threshold");
    Check(GuestRuntime::GetStatistics(instance).blocksInterpreted >= HOT_THRESHOLD - 1, "the cold calls were interpreted");

    Check(CallAt(instance, code, returned) && returned == 1, "the call that reaches the threshold still returns 1");
    Check(GuestRuntime::GetStatistics(instance).regionsRecompiled == 1, "the block is compiled once it reaches the threshold");
    Check(GuestRuntime::GetStatistics(instance).blocksExecutedNative > 0, "the hot block then runs compiled");

    GuestState::GuestAddress loop = (GuestState::GuestAddress)((uint64_t)code + LOOP_OFFSET);
    uint32_t looping[7] = {MOVZ_X0_ZERO, MOVZ_X1_FIVE, ADD_X0_X0_TWO, SUBS_X1_X1_ONE, BNE_BACK_TWO, RET_X30, RET_X30};
    memory.Write(memory.context, loop, looping, sizeof(looping));

    bool loopReturned = true;
    for (uint64_t call = 0; call < HOT_THRESHOLD; ++call) loopReturned = loopReturned && CallAt(instance, loop, returned) && returned == 10;

    Check(loopReturned, "a counted loop returns 10 while it warms up");

    uint64_t regionsBefore = GuestRuntime::GetStatistics(instance).regionsRecompiled;
    uint64_t blocksBefore = GuestRuntime::GetStatistics(instance).blocksRecompiled;

    Check(regionsBefore >= 2, "the loop was compiled at run time");
    Check(blocksBefore >= regionsBefore + 2, "a region spans several guest blocks rather than one");

    uint32_t patched = MOVZ_X0_SEVEN;
    memory.Write(memory.context, (GuestState::GuestAddress)((uint64_t)loop + 5 * sizeof(uint32_t)), &patched, sizeof(patched));

    Check(CallAt(instance, loop, returned) && returned == 7,
          "a write to a block that only ever ran inside a compiled region invalidates the whole region");

    GuestState::GuestAddress system = (GuestState::GuestAddress)((uint64_t)code + SYSCALL_OFFSET);
    uint32_t calling[3] = {MOVZ_X8_GETPID, SVC_ZERO, RET_X30};
    memory.Write(memory.context, system, calling, sizeof(calling));

    uint64_t failuresBefore = GuestRuntime::GetStatistics(instance).recompileFailures;
    bool systemReturned = true;

    for (uint64_t call = 0; call < HOT_THRESHOLD * 3; ++call)
        systemReturned = systemReturned && CallAt(instance, system, returned) && returned != 0;

    Check(systemReturned, "a block that makes a system call keeps working past the threshold");
    Check(GuestRuntime::GetStatistics(instance).recompileFailures == failuresBefore + 1,
          "a block the recompiler refuses is tried once and then left to the interpreter");

    GuestState::GuestAddress patchedEntry = (GuestState::GuestAddress)((uint64_t)code + PATCHED_OFFSET);
    memory.Write(memory.context, patchedEntry, straight, sizeof(straight));

    bool patchedReturned = true;
    for (uint64_t call = 0; call <= HOT_THRESHOLD; ++call)
        patchedReturned = patchedReturned && CallAt(instance, patchedEntry, returned) && returned == 1;

    Check(patchedReturned, "the function a guest JIT will patch runs hot and returns 1");

    GuestState::GuestAddress flush = (GuestState::GuestAddress)((uint64_t)code + FLUSH_OFFSET);
    uint32_t flushing[6] = {DC_CVAU_X0, DSB_ISH, IC_IVAU_X0, DSB_ISH, ISB, RET_X30};
    memory.Write(memory.context, flush, flushing, sizeof(flushing));

    uint32_t replacement = MOVZ_X0_TWO;
    memcpy((void*)(uintptr_t)(uint64_t)patchedEntry, &replacement, sizeof(replacement));

    Check(CallAt(instance, patchedEntry, returned) && returned == 1,
          "a host-side patch is invisible to the runtime until the guest flushes, so the old code still runs");

    uint64_t flushed = 0;
    Check(CallWith(instance, flush, (uint64_t)patchedEntry, flushed), "dc cvau, dsb, ic ivau and isb all decode and run");
    Check(CallAt(instance, patchedEntry, returned) && returned == 2,
          "after a host-side patch and an ic ivau the guest runs the new code, not the compiled copy of the old");

    GuestState::GuestAddress counter = (GuestState::GuestAddress)((uint64_t)code + COUNTER_OFFSET);
    uint32_t counting[2] = {MRS_X0_CNTVCT, RET_X30};
    memory.Write(memory.context, counter, counting, sizeof(counting));

    uint64_t previous = 0;
    bool counterAdvances = true;

    for (uint64_t call = 0; call <= HOT_THRESHOLD + 1; ++call)
    {
        uint64_t ticks = 0;
        counterAdvances = counterAdvances && CallAt(instance, counter, ticks) && ticks != 0 && ticks >= previous;
        previous = ticks;
    }

    Check(counterAdvances, "cntvct_el0 reads a nonzero counter that never goes backwards, interpreted and compiled");

    GuestState::GuestAddress frequency = (GuestState::GuestAddress)((uint64_t)code + FREQUENCY_OFFSET);
    uint32_t asking[2] = {MRS_X0_CNTFRQ, RET_X30};
    memory.Write(memory.context, frequency, asking, sizeof(asking));

    Check(CallAt(instance, frequency, returned) && returned == EXPECTED_COUNTER_FREQUENCY, "cntfrq_el0 reports the counter frequency");

    GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
    return failures;
}

static int RunBackgroundCompiler()
{
    printf("--- T1 compiling on a background thread ---\n");

    GuestRuntime::Configuration configuration;
    configuration.recompile = true;
    configuration.recompileThreshold = 1;
    configuration.recompileInBackground = true;

    GuestRuntime::Instance instance;
    if (GuestRuntime::Create(configuration, instance) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("invalidation-unit FAILED: the guest runtime did not start\n");
        return 1;
    }

    GuestState::GuestAddress code{};
    if (GuestRuntime::Reserve(instance, 0x4000, 0x4000, code) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok ||
        GuestRuntime::Commit(instance, code, 0x4000, true, true, true) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        printf("invalidation-unit FAILED: cannot reserve an executable guest page\n");
        GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
        return 1;
    }

    const GuestState::MemoryAccessor& memory = GuestRuntime::Memory(instance);

    uint32_t looping[6] = {MOVZ_X0_ZERO, MOVZ_X1_FIVE, ADD_X0_X0_TWO, SUBS_X1_X1_ONE, BNE_BACK_TWO, RET_X30};
    memory.Write(memory.context, code, looping, sizeof(looping));

    uint64_t returned = 0;
    bool alwaysCorrect = true;
    bool ranCompiled = false;

    for (uint64_t attempt = 0; attempt < BACKGROUND_ATTEMPTS && !ranCompiled; ++attempt)
    {
        alwaysCorrect = alwaysCorrect && CallAt(instance, code, returned) && returned == 10;
        ranCompiled = GuestRuntime::GetStatistics(instance).blocksExecutedNative > 0;

        if (!ranCompiled) std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(BACKGROUND_PAUSE_MILLISECONDS));
    }

    Check(alwaysCorrect, "the loop returns 10 on every call while the background thread compiles it");
    Check(ranCompiled, "the region the background thread compiled is picked up by later calls");

    GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);
    Check(true, "the runtime shuts down with the background compiler running");
    return failures;
}

int main()
{
    RunTier(false);
    RunTier(true);
    RunHotRegions();
    RunBackgroundCompiler();

    printf("%s: %d checks failed\n", failures == 0 ? "invalidation-unit PASSED" : "invalidation-unit FAILED", failures);
    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
```

`tests/tiers/src/functions.c`:

```c
long SumTo(long n)
{
    long total = 0;
    for (long index = 0; index < n; ++index) total += index;
    return total;
}

long CollatzSteps(long n)
{
    long steps = 0;
    while (n > 1)
    {
        n = (n & 1) ? 3 * n + 1 : n / 2;
        steps += 1;
    }
    return steps;
}

long GreatestCommonDivisor(long a, long b)
{
    while (b != 0)
    {
        long carried = b;
        b = a % b;
        a = carried;
    }
    return a;
}

long Branchy(long a, long b)
{
    if (a > b) return a - b;
    if (a == b) return 0;
    return b - a;
}

long NestedLoops(long n)
{
    long total = 0;
    for (long outer = 0; outer < n; ++outer)
    {
        for (long inner = 0; inner < outer; ++inner) total += (outer ^ inner);
    }
    return total;
}

long BitWeights(long value)
{
    long total = 0;
    for (int bit = 0; bit < 64; ++bit)
    {
        if (value & (1L << bit)) total += bit;
    }
    return total;
}

long ShiftMix(long a, long b)
{
    long total = a;
    for (int round = 0; round < 8; ++round)
    {
        total = (total << 3) ^ (total >> 5);
        total += (b >> (round & 7));
        if (total < 0) total = -total;
    }
    return total;
}

long SelectChain(long a, long b, long c)
{
    long best = a > b ? a : b;
    best = best > c ? best : c;
    long worst = a < b ? a : b;
    worst = worst < c ? worst : c;
    return best - worst;
}

long StackSpill(long a, long b, long c, long d, long e, long f, long g, long h)
{
    long values[8];
    values[0] = a;
    values[1] = b;
    values[2] = c;
    values[3] = d;
    values[4] = e;
    values[5] = f;
    values[6] = g;
    values[7] = h;

    long total = 0;
    for (int index = 0; index < 8; ++index)
    {
        total += values[index] * (index + 1);
        if (total > 1000000) total -= 1000000;
    }
    return total;
}

__attribute__((noinline)) static long InnerAccumulate(long n)
{
    long total = 0;
    for (long index = 1; index <= n; ++index) total += (index % 7);
    return total;
}

long CallChain(long n)
{
    long total = 0;
    for (long round = 0; round < 3; ++round) total += InnerAccumulate(n + round);
    return total;
}

long CountdownDivide(long n)
{
    long rounds = 0;
    while (n != 0)
    {
        n = n / 3;
        rounds += 1;
        if (rounds > 100) break;
    }
    return rounds;
}
```

`tests/tombstone/TombstoneHarness.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <string>

#include "AheadOfTime/AheadOfTime.hpp"
#include "Diagnostics/Diagnostics.hpp"
#include "ElfLoader/ElfLoader.hpp"
#include "GuestLibc/GuestLibc.hpp"
#include "GuestRuntime/GuestRuntime.hpp"
#include "Settings/Settings.hpp"

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 2)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: TombstoneHarness <hello.so> [bad-address] [tombstone-file]\n");
        return 2;
    }

    const std::string path = argv[1];
    const uint64_t target = argc > 2 ? strtoull(argv[2], nullptr, 0) : 0x10;

    if (argc > 3) Settings::Set(Diagnostics::TOMBSTONE_SETTING, argv[3]);

    std::string directory = ".";
    const size_t slash = path.find_last_of('/');
    if (slash != std::string::npos) directory = path.substr(0, slash);

    Diagnostics::Initialize(Diagnostics::DEFAULT_CAPACITY);

    if (!Diagnostics::CaptureStandardError())
    {
        printf("harness: standard error could not be captured, so no tombstone is possible\n");
        return 1;
    }

    GuestRuntime::Configuration configuration;
    configuration.searchPaths.push_back(directory);
    configuration.stubUnresolvedSymbols = true;
    configuration.requireTranslated = true;

    GuestRuntime::Instance instance;

    if (GuestRuntime::Create(configuration, instance) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        Diagnostics::ReleaseStandardError();
        printf("harness: cannot create the guest runtime\n");
        return 1;
    }

    if (GuestRuntime::RegisterPlatformProxies(instance) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok ||
        GuestLibc::RegisterAll(instance) != GuestLibc::Result::Ok)
    {
        Diagnostics::ReleaseStandardError();
        printf("harness: cannot register the guest platform surface\n");
        return 1;
    }

    uint32_t moduleId = ElfLoader::INVALID_MODULE_ID;

    if (GuestRuntime::Load(instance, path, moduleId) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        Diagnostics::ReleaseStandardError();
        printf("harness: cannot load %s\n", path.c_str());
        return 1;
    }

    AheadOfTime::Image image;
    AheadOfTime::Statistics statistics;

    if (AheadOfTime::Translate(instance, moduleId, path, image, statistics) != AheadOfTime::Result::Ok)
    {
        Diagnostics::ReleaseStandardError();
        printf("harness: cannot translate %s ahead of time\n", path.c_str());
        return 1;
    }

    GuestState::GuestAddress entry{};

    if (GuestRuntime::Lookup(instance, "FaultWitness", entry) != GuestRuntime::Result::Ok)
    {
        Diagnostics::ReleaseStandardError();
        printf("harness: the fixture does not export FaultWitness\n");
        return 1;
    }

    fprintf(stderr, "[harness] about to read guest address %016llx, which is not mapped\n", (unsigned long long)target);
    fflush(stderr);

    GuestState::Registers registers{};
    registers.general[0] = target;

    GuestRuntime::CallGuest(instance, entry, registers);

    fprintf(stderr, "[harness] the guest returned rather than faulting, so this proves nothing\n");
    fflush(stderr);

    Diagnostics::ReleaseStandardError();
    GuestRuntime::Destroy(instance);

    return 3;
}
```

`tests/vectors/InterpreterVectors.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "Arm64Decoder/Arm64Decoder.hpp"
#include "Interpreter/Interpreter.hpp"

#include "VectorCases.hpp"

struct VectorMemory
{
    uint32_t code[VECTOR_MAX_CODE_WORDS];
    uint64_t scratch[VECTOR_SCRATCH_WORDS];
};

static bool MemoryRead(void* context, GuestState::GuestAddress address, void* destination, uint64_t length)
{
    VectorMemory* memory = (VectorMemory*)context;
    uint64_t raw = (uint64_t)address;

    if (raw >= VECTOR_CODE_BASE && raw + length <= VECTOR_CODE_BASE + sizeof(memory->code))
    {
        memcpy(destination, (const uint8_t*)memory->code + (raw - VECTOR_CODE_BASE), length);
        return true;
    }

    if (raw >= VECTOR_SCRATCH_BASE && raw + length <= VECTOR_SCRATCH_BASE + sizeof(memory->scratch))
    {
        memcpy(destination, (const uint8_t*)memory->scratch + (raw - VECTOR_SCRATCH_BASE), length);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

static bool MemoryWrite(void* context, GuestState::GuestAddress address, const void* source, uint64_t length)
{
    VectorMemory* memory = (VectorMemory*)context;
    uint64_t raw = (uint64_t)address;

    if (raw >= VECTOR_SCRATCH_BASE && raw + length <= VECTOR_SCRATCH_BASE + sizeof(memory->scratch))
    {
        memcpy((uint8_t*)memory->scratch + (raw - VECTOR_SCRATCH_BASE), source, length);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

static std::string Project(const VectorCase& testCase, const GuestState::Registers& registers, const VectorMemory& memory)
{
    std::string line = testCase.name;
    char field[64];

    for (int index = 0; index < VECTOR_GENERAL_COUNT; ++index)
    {
        if (index >= VECTOR_RESERVED_LOW && index <= VECTOR_RESERVED_HIGH) continue;
        snprintf(field, sizeof(field), " x%d=%016llx", index, (unsigned long long)registers.general[index]);
        line += field;
    }

    for (int index = 0; index < VECTOR_REGISTER_COUNT; ++index)
    {
        snprintf(field, sizeof(field), " v%d=%016llx:%016llx", index, (unsigned long long)registers.vector[index].high,
                 (unsigned long long)registers.vector[index].low);
        line += field;
    }

    snprintf(field, sizeof(field), " nzcv=%08x", registers.flagsNzcv & 0xF0000000u);
    line += field;
    snprintf(field, sizeof(field), " fpsr=%08x", registers.floatingPointStatus & 0x0800009Fu);
    line += field;

    for (int index = 0; index < VECTOR_SCRATCH_WORDS - 1; ++index)
    {
        snprintf(field, sizeof(field), " m%d=%016llx", index, (unsigned long long)memory.scratch[index]);
        line += field;
    }

    return line;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    const char* goldenPath = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : nullptr;
    if (!goldenPath)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: InterpreterVectorsTest <golden>\n");
        return 2;
    }

    FILE* golden = fopen(goldenPath, "rb");
    if (!golden)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "cannot open %s\n", goldenPath);
        return 2;
    }

    std::vector<std::string> expected;
    char line[4096];
    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), golden))
    {
        size_t length = strlen(line);
        while (length > 0 && (line[length - 1] == '\n' || line[length - 1] == '\r')) line[--length] = '\0';
        if (length > 0) expected.push_back(line);
    }
    fclose(golden);

    if ((int)expected.size() != VECTOR_CASE_COUNT)
    {
        printf("interpreter-vectors FAILED: the golden holds %d lines but there are %d cases\n", (int)expected.size(), VECTOR_CASE_COUNT);
        printf("the suite changed size; recapture with tools/capture-vectors.sh --regenerate\n");
        return 1;
    }

    int failures = 0;

    for (int index = 0; index < VECTOR_CASE_COUNT; ++index)
    {
        const VectorCase& testCase = VECTOR_CASES[index];

        VectorMemory memory;
        memset(&memory, 0, sizeof(memory));
        memcpy(memory.code, testCase.code, sizeof(memory.code));
        memcpy(memory.scratch, testCase.scratch, sizeof(memory.scratch));

        Arm64Decoder::Context context;
        context.memory.Read = &MemoryRead;
        context.memory.Write = &MemoryWrite;
        context.memory.context = &memory;

        Ir::Function function;
        Ir::Block block;
        function.entryAddress = static_cast<GuestState::GuestAddress>(VECTOR_CODE_BASE);
        function.endAddress = static_cast<GuestState::GuestAddress>(VECTOR_CODE_BASE + testCase.codeWords * 4);
        block.guestAddress = function.entryAddress;
        block.guestEndAddress = function.endAddress;

        bool decoded = true;
        for (int word = 0; word < testCase.codeWords; ++word)
        {
            GuestState::GuestAddress at = static_cast<GuestState::GuestAddress>(VECTOR_CODE_BASE + word * 4);
            Arm64Decoder::Result result = Arm64Decoder::DecodeInstruction(context, testCase.code[word], at, function, block);
            if (result != Arm64Decoder::Result::Ok)
            {
                printf("FAIL %s: word %d (%08x) decoded as %s\n", testCase.name, word, testCase.code[word],
                       Arm64Decoder::ResultName(result));
                decoded = false;
                failures += 1;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!decoded) continue;

        Ir::Function verified = function;
        verified.blocks.push_back(block);
        if (!Ir::Verify(verified))
        {
            printf("FAIL %s: the decoded IR does not verify\n", testCase.name);
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        GuestState::Registers registers;
        GuestState::Reset(registers);
        for (int reg = 0; reg < VECTOR_GENERAL_COUNT; ++reg) registers.general[reg] = testCase.general[reg];
        registers.stackPointer = VECTOR_SCRATCH_BASE + 0x1000;
        registers.flagsNzcv = testCase.nzcv;

        GuestState::MemoryAccessor accessor;
        accessor.Read = &MemoryRead;
        accessor.Write = &MemoryWrite;
        accessor.context = &memory;

        Interpreter::Configuration configuration;
        Interpreter::ExitStatus status = Interpreter::RunBlock(block, registers, accessor, configuration);

        if (status.reason != Interpreter::ExitReason::BlockExhausted)
        {
            printf("FAIL %s: T0 exited with %s\n", testCase.name, Interpreter::ExitReasonName(status.reason));
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        std::string produced = Project(testCase, registers, memory);
        if (produced != expected[index])
        {
            printf("FAIL %s\n  device %s\n  t0     %s\n", testCase.name, expected[index].c_str(), produced.c_str());
            failures += 1;
            continue;
        }

        printf("PASS %s\n", testCase.name);
    }

    printf("%s: %d of %d cases reproduced under T0\n", failures == 0 ? "interpreter-vectors PASSED" : "interpreter-vectors FAILED",
           VECTOR_CASE_COUNT - failures, VECTOR_CASE_COUNT);

    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
```
