```h
#pragma once

#include <ftl/details/array_traits.h>
#include <ftl/static_vector.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <iterator>
#include <utility>
#include <variant>
#include <vector>

#include <ftl/details/type_traits.h>

namespace android::ftl {

template <typename>
struct is_small_vector;

// ftl::StaticVector that promotes to std::vector when full. SmallVector is a drop-in replacement
// for std::vector with statically allocated storage for N elements, whose goal is to improve run
// time by avoiding heap allocation and increasing probability of cache hits. The standard API is
// augmented by an unstable_erase operation that does not preserve order, and a replace operation
// that destructively emplaces.
//
// Unlike std::vector, T does not require copy/move assignment, so may be an object with const data
// members, or be const itself.
//
// SmallVector<T, 0> is a specialization that thinly wraps std::vector.
//
// Example usage:
//
//   ftl::SmallVector<char, 3> vector;
//   assert(vector.empty());
//   assert(!vector.dynamic());
//
//   vector = {'a', 'b', 'c'};
//   assert(vector.size() == 3u);
//   assert(!vector.dynamic());
//
//   vector.push_back('d');
//   assert(vector.dynamic());
//
//   vector.unstable_erase(vector.begin());
//   assert(vector == (ftl::SmallVector{'d', 'b', 'c'}));
//
//   vector.pop_back();
//   assert(vector.back() == 'b');
//   assert(vector.dynamic());
//
//   const char array[] = "hi";
//   vector = ftl::SmallVector(array);
//   assert(vector == (ftl::SmallVector{'h', 'i', '\0'}));
//   assert(!vector.dynamic());
//
//   ftl::SmallVector strings = ftl::init::list<std::string>("abc")("123456", 3u)(3u, '?');
//   assert(strings.size() == 3u);
//   assert(!strings.dynamic());
//
//   assert(strings[0] == "abc");
//   assert(strings[1] == "123");
//   assert(strings[2] == "???");
//
template <typename T, std::size_t N>
class SmallVector final : details::ArrayTraits<T>, details::ArrayComparators<SmallVector> {
  using Static = StaticVector<T, N>;
  using Dynamic = SmallVector<T, 0>;

 public:
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, value_type);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, size_type);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, difference_type);

  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, pointer);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, reference);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, iterator);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, reverse_iterator);

  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, const_pointer);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, const_reference);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, const_iterator);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, const_reverse_iterator);

  // Creates an empty vector.
  SmallVector() = default;

  // Constructs at most N elements. See StaticVector for underlying constructors.
  template <typename Arg, typename... Args,
            typename = std::enable_if_t<!is_small_vector<details::remove_cvref_t<Arg>>{}>>
  SmallVector(Arg&& arg, Args&&... args)
      : vector_(std::in_place_type<Static>, std::forward<Arg>(arg), std::forward<Args>(args)...) {}

  // Copies or moves elements from a smaller convertible vector.
  template <typename U, std::size_t M, typename = std::enable_if_t<(M > 0)>>
  SmallVector(SmallVector<U, M> other) : vector_(convert(std::move(other))) {}

  void swap(SmallVector& other) { vector_.swap(other.vector_); }

  // Returns whether the vector is backed by static or dynamic storage.
  bool dynamic() const { return std::holds_alternative<Dynamic>(vector_); }

  // Avoid std::visit as it generates a dispatch table.
#define DISPATCH(T, F, ...)                                                            \
  T F() __VA_ARGS__ {                                                                  \
    return dynamic() ? std::get<Dynamic>(vector_).F() : std::get<Static>(vector_).F(); \
  }

  DISPATCH(size_type, max_size, const)
  DISPATCH(size_type, size, const)
  DISPATCH(bool, empty, const)

  DISPATCH(iterator, begin, )
  DISPATCH(const_iterator, begin, const)
  DISPATCH(const_iterator, cbegin, const)

  DISPATCH(iterator, end, )
  DISPATCH(const_iterator, end, const)
  DISPATCH(const_iterator, cend, const)

  DISPATCH(reverse_iterator, rbegin, )
  DISPATCH(const_reverse_iterator, rbegin, const)
  DISPATCH(const_reverse_iterator, crbegin, const)

  DISPATCH(reverse_iterator, rend, )
  DISPATCH(const_reverse_iterator, rend, const)
  DISPATCH(const_reverse_iterator, crend, const)

  DISPATCH(iterator, last, )
  DISPATCH(const_iterator, last, const)

  DISPATCH(reference, front, )
  DISPATCH(const_reference, front, const)

  DISPATCH(reference, back, )
  DISPATCH(const_reference, back, const)

  reference operator[](size_type i) {
    return dynamic() ? std::get<Dynamic>(vector_)[i] : std::get<Static>(vector_)[i];
  }

  const_reference operator[](size_type i) const { return const_cast<SmallVector&>(*this)[i]; }

  // Replaces an element, and returns a reference to it. The iterator must be dereferenceable, so
  // replacing at end() is erroneous.
  //
  // The element is emplaced via move constructor, so type T does not need to define copy/move
  // assignment, e.g. its data members may be const.
  //
  // The arguments may directly or indirectly refer to the element being replaced.
  //
  // Iterators to the replaced element point to its replacement, and others remain valid.
  //
  template <typename... Args>
  reference replace(const_iterator it, Args&&... args) {
    if (dynamic()) {
      return std::get<Dynamic>(vector_).replace(it, std::forward<Args>(args)...);
    } else {
      return std::get<Static>(vector_).replace(it, std::forward<Args>(args)...);
    }
  }

  // Appends an element, and returns a reference to it.
  //
  // If the vector reaches its static or dynamic capacity, then all iterators are invalidated.
  // Otherwise, only the end() iterator is invalidated.
  //
  template <typename... Args>
  reference emplace_back(Args&&... args) {
    constexpr auto kInsertStatic = &Static::template emplace_back<Args...>;
    constexpr auto kInsertDynamic = &Dynamic::template emplace_back<Args...>;
    return *insert<kInsertStatic, kInsertDynamic>(std::forward<Args>(args)...);
  }

  // Appends an element.
  //
  // If the vector reaches its static or dynamic capacity, then all iterators are invalidated.
  // Otherwise, only the end() iterator is invalidated.
  //
  void push_back(const value_type& v) {
    constexpr auto kInsertStatic =
        static_cast<bool (Static::*)(const value_type&)>(&Static::push_back);
    constexpr auto kInsertDynamic =
        static_cast<bool (Dynamic::*)(const value_type&)>(&Dynamic::push_back);
    insert<kInsertStatic, kInsertDynamic>(v);
  }

  void push_back(value_type&& v) {
    constexpr auto kInsertStatic = static_cast<bool (Static::*)(value_type &&)>(&Static::push_back);
    constexpr auto kInsertDynamic =
        static_cast<bool (Dynamic::*)(value_type &&)>(&Dynamic::push_back);
    insert<kInsertStatic, kInsertDynamic>(std::move(v));
  }

  // Removes the last element. The vector must not be empty, or the call is erroneous.
  //
  // The last() and end() iterators are invalidated.
  //
  DISPATCH(void, pop_back, )

  // Removes all elements.
  //
  // All iterators are invalidated.
  //
  DISPATCH(void, clear, )

#undef DISPATCH

  // Erases an element, but does not preserve order. Rather than shifting subsequent elements,
  // this moves the last element to the slot of the erased element.
  //
  // The last() and end() iterators, as well as those to the erased element, are invalidated.
  //
  void unstable_erase(iterator it) {
    if (dynamic()) {
      std::get<Dynamic>(vector_).unstable_erase(it);
    } else {
      std::get<Static>(vector_).unstable_erase(it);
    }
  }

  // Extracts the elements as std::vector.
  std::vector<std::remove_const_t<T>> promote() && {
    if (dynamic()) {
      return std::get<Dynamic>(std::move(vector_)).promote();
    } else {
      return {std::make_move_iterator(begin()), std::make_move_iterator(end())};
    }
  }

 private:
  template <typename, std::size_t>
  friend class SmallVector;

  template <typename U, std::size_t M>
  static std::variant<Static, Dynamic> convert(SmallVector<U, M>&& other) {
    using Other = SmallVector<U, M>;

    if (other.dynamic()) {
      return std::get<typename Other::Dynamic>(std::move(other.vector_));
    } else {
      return std::get<typename Other::Static>(std::move(other.vector_));
    }
  }

  template <auto InsertStatic, auto InsertDynamic, typename... Args>
  auto insert(Args&&... args) {
    if (Dynamic* const vector = std::get_if<Dynamic>(&vector_)) {
      return (vector->*InsertDynamic)(std::forward<Args>(args)...);
    }

    auto& vector = std::get<Static>(vector_);
    if (vector.full()) {
      return (promote(vector).*InsertDynamic)(std::forward<Args>(args)...);
    } else {
      return (vector.*InsertStatic)(std::forward<Args>(args)...);
    }
  }

  Dynamic& promote(Static& static_vector) {
    assert(static_vector.full());

    // Allocate double capacity to reduce probability of reallocation.
    Dynamic vector;
    vector.reserve(Static::max_size() * 2);
    std::move(static_vector.begin(), static_vector.end(), std::back_inserter(vector));

    return vector_.template emplace<Dynamic>(std::move(vector));
  }

  std::variant<Static, Dynamic> vector_;
};

// Partial specialization without static storage.
template <typename T>
class SmallVector<T, 0> final : details::ArrayTraits<T>,
                                details::ArrayComparators<SmallVector>,
                                details::ArrayIterators<SmallVector<T, 0>, T>,
                                std::vector<std::remove_const_t<T>> {
  using details::ArrayTraits<T>::replace_at;

  using Iter = details::ArrayIterators<SmallVector, T>;
  using Impl = std::vector<std::remove_const_t<T>>;

  friend Iter;

 public:
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, value_type);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, size_type);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, difference_type);

  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, pointer);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, reference);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, iterator);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, reverse_iterator);

  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, const_pointer);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, const_reference);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, const_iterator);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, const_reverse_iterator);

  // See std::vector for underlying constructors.
  using Impl::Impl;

  // Copies and moves a vector, respectively.
  SmallVector(const SmallVector&) = default;
  SmallVector(SmallVector&&) = default;

  // Constructs elements in place. See StaticVector for underlying constructor.
  template <typename U, std::size_t... Sizes, typename... Types>
  SmallVector(InitializerList<U, std::index_sequence<Sizes...>, Types...>&& list)
      : SmallVector(SmallVector<T, sizeof...(Sizes)>(std::move(list))) {}

  // Copies or moves elements from a convertible vector.
  template <typename U, std::size_t M>
  SmallVector(SmallVector<U, M> other) : Impl(convert(std::move(other))) {}

  SmallVector& operator=(SmallVector other) {
    // Define copy/move assignment in terms of copy/move construction.
    swap(other);
    return *this;
  }

  void swap(SmallVector& other) { Impl::swap(other); }

  using Impl::empty;
  using Impl::max_size;
  using Impl::size;

  using Impl::reserve;

  // std::vector iterators are not necessarily raw pointers.
  iterator begin() { return Impl::data(); }
  iterator end() { return Impl::data() + size(); }

  using Iter::begin;
  using Iter::end;

  using Iter::cbegin;
  using Iter::cend;

  using Iter::rbegin;
  using Iter::rend;

  using Iter::crbegin;
  using Iter::crend;

  using Iter::last;

  using Iter::back;
  using Iter::front;

  using Iter::operator[];

  template <typename... Args>
  reference replace(const_iterator it, Args&&... args) {
    return replace_at(it, std::forward<Args>(args)...);
  }

  template <typename... Args>
  iterator emplace_back(Args&&... args) {
    return &Impl::emplace_back(std::forward<Args>(args)...);
  }

  bool push_back(const value_type& v) {
    Impl::push_back(v);
    return true;
  }

  bool push_back(value_type&& v) {
    Impl::push_back(std::move(v));
    return true;
  }

  using Impl::clear;
  using Impl::pop_back;

  void unstable_erase(iterator it) {
    if (it != last()) replace(it, std::move(back()));
    pop_back();
  }

  std::vector<std::remove_const_t<T>> promote() && { return std::move(*this); }

 private:
  template <typename U, std::size_t M>
  static Impl convert(SmallVector<U, M>&& other) {
    if constexpr (std::is_constructible_v<Impl, std::vector<std::remove_const_t<U>>&&>) {
      return std::move(other).promote();
    } else {
      SmallVector vector(other.size());

      // Consistently with StaticVector, T only requires copy/move construction from U, rather than
      // copy/move assignment.
      auto it = vector.begin();
      for (auto& element : other) {
        vector.replace(it++, std::move(element));
      }

      return vector;
    }
  }
};

template <typename>
struct is_small_vector : std::false_type {};

template <typename T, std::size_t N>
struct is_small_vector<SmallVector<T, N>> : std::true_type {};

// Deduction guide for array constructor.
template <typename T, std::size_t N>
SmallVector(T (&)[N]) -> SmallVector<std::remove_cv_t<T>, N>;

// Deduction guide for variadic constructor.
template <typename T, typename... Us, typename V = std::decay_t<T>,
          typename = std::enable_if_t<(std::is_constructible_v<V, Us> && ...)>>
SmallVector(T&&, Us&&...) -> SmallVector<V, 1 + sizeof...(Us)>;

// Deduction guide for in-place constructor.
template <typename T, std::size_t... Sizes, typename... Types>
SmallVector(InitializerList<T, std::index_sequence<Sizes...>, Types...>&&)
    -> SmallVector<T, sizeof...(Sizes)>;

// Deduction guide for StaticVector conversion.
template <typename T, std::size_t N>
SmallVector(StaticVector<T, N>&&) -> SmallVector<T, N>;

template <typename T, std::size_t N>
inline void swap(SmallVector<T, N>& lhs, SmallVector<T, N>& rhs) {
  lhs.swap(rhs);
}
```

```h
#pragma once

#include <ftl/details/array_traits.h>
#include <ftl/initializer_list.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <iterator>
#include <memory>
#include <type_traits>
#include <utility>

namespace android::ftl {

constexpr struct IteratorRangeTag {
} kIteratorRange;

// Fixed-capacity, statically allocated counterpart of std::vector. Like std::array, StaticVector
// allocates contiguous storage for N elements of type T at compile time, but stores at most (rather
// than exactly) N elements. Unlike std::array, its default constructor does not require T to have a
// default constructor, since elements are constructed in place as the vector grows. Operations that
// insert an element (emplace_back, push_back, etc.) fail when the vector is full. The API otherwise
// adheres to standard containers, except the unstable_erase operation that does not preserve order,
// and the replace operation that destructively emplaces.
//
// Unlike std::vector, T does not require copy/move assignment, so may be an object with const data
// members, or be const itself.
//
// StaticVector<T, 1> is analogous to an iterable std::optional.
// StaticVector<T, 0> is an error.
//
// Example usage:
//
//   ftl::StaticVector<char, 3> vector;
//   assert(vector.empty());
//
//   vector = {'a', 'b'};
//   assert(vector.size() == 2u);
//
//   vector.push_back('c');
//   assert(vector.full());
//
//   assert(!vector.push_back('d'));
//   assert(vector.size() == 3u);
//
//   vector.unstable_erase(vector.begin());
//   assert(vector == (ftl::StaticVector{'c', 'b'}));
//
//   vector.pop_back();
//   assert(vector.back() == 'c');
//
//   const char array[] = "hi";
//   vector = ftl::StaticVector(array);
//   assert(vector == (ftl::StaticVector{'h', 'i', '\0'}));
//
//   ftl::StaticVector strings = ftl::init::list<std::string>("abc")("123456", 3u)(3u, '?');
//   assert(strings.size() == 3u);
//   assert(strings[0] == "abc");
//   assert(strings[1] == "123");
//   assert(strings[2] == "???");
//
template <typename T, std::size_t N>
class StaticVector final : details::ArrayTraits<T>,
                           details::ArrayIterators<StaticVector<T, N>, T>,
                           details::ArrayComparators<StaticVector> {
  static_assert(N > 0);

  // For constructor that moves from a smaller convertible vector.
  template <typename, std::size_t>
  friend class StaticVector;

  using details::ArrayTraits<T>::construct_at;
  using details::ArrayTraits<T>::replace_at;
  using details::ArrayTraits<T>::in_place_swap_ranges;
  using details::ArrayTraits<T>::uninitialized_copy;

  using Iter = details::ArrayIterators<StaticVector, T>;
  friend Iter;

  // There is ambiguity when constructing from two iterator-like elements like pointers:
  // they could be an iterator range, or arguments for in-place construction. Assume the
  // latter unless they are input iterators and cannot be used to construct elements. If
  // the former is intended, the caller can pass an IteratorRangeTag to disambiguate.
  template <typename I, typename Traits = std::iterator_traits<I>>
  using is_input_iterator =
      std::conjunction<std::is_base_of<std::input_iterator_tag, typename Traits::iterator_category>,
                       std::negation<std::is_constructible<T, I>>>;

 public:
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, value_type);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, size_type);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, difference_type);

  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, pointer);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, reference);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, iterator);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, reverse_iterator);

  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, const_pointer);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, const_reference);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, const_iterator);
  FTL_ARRAY_TRAIT(T, const_reverse_iterator);

  // Creates an empty vector.
  StaticVector() = default;

  // Copies and moves a vector, respectively.
  StaticVector(const StaticVector& other)
      : StaticVector(kIteratorRange, other.begin(), other.end()) {}

  StaticVector(StaticVector&& other) { swap<true>(other); }

  // Copies at most N elements from a smaller convertible vector.
  template <typename U, std::size_t M>
  StaticVector(const StaticVector<U, M>& other)
      : StaticVector(kIteratorRange, other.begin(), other.end()) {
    static_assert(N >= M, "Insufficient capacity");
  }

  // Copies at most N elements from a smaller convertible array.
  template <typename U, std::size_t M>
  explicit StaticVector(U (&array)[M])
      : StaticVector(kIteratorRange, std::begin(array), std::end(array)) {
    static_assert(N >= M, "Insufficient capacity");
  }

  // Copies at most N elements from the range [first, last).
  //
  // IteratorRangeTag disambiguates with initialization from two iterator-like elements.
  //
  template <typename Iterator, typename = std::enable_if_t<is_input_iterator<Iterator>{}>>
  StaticVector(Iterator first, Iterator last) : StaticVector(kIteratorRange, first, last) {
    using V = typename std::iterator_traits<Iterator>::value_type;
    static_assert(std::is_constructible_v<value_type, V>, "Incompatible iterator range");
  }

  template <typename Iterator>
  StaticVector(IteratorRangeTag, Iterator first, Iterator last)
      : size_(std::min(max_size(), static_cast<size_type>(std::distance(first, last)))) {
    uninitialized_copy(first, first + size_, begin());
  }

  // Moves at most N elements from a smaller convertible vector.
  template <typename U, std::size_t M>
  StaticVector(StaticVector<U, M>&& other) {
    static_assert(N >= M, "Insufficient capacity");

    // Same logic as swap<true>, though M need not be equal to N.
    std::uninitialized_move(other.begin(), other.end(), begin());
    std::destroy(other.begin(), other.end());
    std::swap(size_, other.size_);
  }

  // Constructs at most N elements. The template arguments T and N are inferred using the
  // deduction guide defined below. Note that T is determined from the first element, and
  // subsequent elements must have convertible types:
  //
  //   ftl::StaticVector vector = {1, 2, 3};
  //   static_assert(std::is_same_v<decltype(vector), ftl::StaticVector<int, 3>>);
  //
  //   const auto copy = "quince"s;
  //   auto move = "tart"s;
  //   ftl::StaticVector vector = {copy, std::move(move)};
  //
  //   static_assert(std::is_same_v<decltype(vector), ftl::StaticVector<std::string, 2>>);
  //
  template <typename E, typename... Es,
            typename = std::enable_if_t<std::is_constructible_v<value_type, E>>>
  StaticVector(E&& element, Es&&... elements)
      : StaticVector(std::index_sequence<0>{}, std::forward<E>(element),
                     std::forward<Es>(elements)...) {
    static_assert(sizeof...(elements) < N, "Too many elements");
  }

  // Constructs at most N elements in place by forwarding per-element constructor arguments. The
  // template arguments T and N are inferred using the deduction guide defined below. The syntax
  // for listing arguments is as follows:
  //
  //   ftl::StaticVector vector = ftl::init::list<std::string>("abc")()(3u, '?');
  //
  //   static_assert(std::is_same_v<decltype(vector), ftl::StaticVector<std::string, 3>>);
  //   assert(vector.full());
  //   assert(vector[0] == "abc");
  //   assert(vector[1].empty());
  //   assert(vector[2] == "???");
  //
  template <typename U, std::size_t Size, std::size_t... Sizes, typename... Types>
  StaticVector(InitializerList<U, std::index_sequence<Size, Sizes...>, Types...>&& list)
      : StaticVector(std::index_sequence<0, 0, Size>{}, std::make_index_sequence<Size>{},
                     std::index_sequence<Sizes...>{}, list.tuple) {
    static_assert(sizeof...(Sizes) < N, "Too many elements");
  }

  ~StaticVector() { std::destroy(begin(), end()); }

  StaticVector& operator=(const StaticVector& other) {
    StaticVector copy(other);
    swap(copy);
    return *this;
  }

  StaticVector& operator=(StaticVector&& other) {
    clear();
    swap<true>(other);
    return *this;
  }

  // IsEmpty enables a fast path when the vector is known to be empty at compile time.
  template <bool IsEmpty = false>
  void swap(StaticVector&);

  static constexpr size_type max_size() { return N; }
  size_type size() const { return size_; }

  bool empty() const { return size() == 0; }
  bool full() const { return size() == max_size(); }

  iterator begin() { return std::launder(reinterpret_cast<pointer>(data_)); }
  iterator end() { return begin() + size(); }

  using Iter::begin;
  using Iter::end;

  using Iter::cbegin;
  using Iter::cend;

  using Iter::rbegin;
  using Iter::rend;

  using Iter::crbegin;
  using Iter::crend;

  using Iter::last;

  using Iter::back;
  using Iter::front;

  using Iter::operator[];

  // Replaces an element, and returns a reference to it. The iterator must be dereferenceable, so
  // replacing at end() is erroneous.
  //
  // The element is emplaced via move constructor, so type T does not need to define copy/move
  // assignment, e.g. its data members may be const.
  //
  // The arguments may directly or indirectly refer to the element being replaced.
  //
  // Iterators to the replaced element point to its replacement, and others remain valid.
  //
  template <typename... Args>
  reference replace(const_iterator it, Args&&... args) {
    return replace_at(it, std::forward<Args>(args)...);
  }

  // Appends an element, and returns an iterator to it. If the vector is full, the element is not
  // inserted, and the end() iterator is returned.
  //
  // On success, the end() iterator is invalidated.
  //
  template <typename... Args>
  iterator emplace_back(Args&&... args) {
    if (full()) return end();
    const iterator it = construct_at(end(), std::forward<Args>(args)...);
    ++size_;
    return it;
  }

  // Appends an element unless the vector is full, and returns whether the element was inserted.
  //
  // On success, the end() iterator is invalidated.
  //
  bool push_back(const value_type& v) {
    // Two statements for sequence point.
    const iterator it = emplace_back(v);
    return it != end();
  }

  bool push_back(value_type&& v) {
    // Two statements for sequence point.
    const iterator it = emplace_back(std::move(v));
    return it != end();
  }

  // Removes the last element. The vector must not be empty, or the call is erroneous.
  //
  // The last() and end() iterators are invalidated.
  //
  void pop_back() { unstable_erase(last()); }

  // Removes all elements.
  //
  // All iterators are invalidated.
  //
  void clear() {
    std::destroy(begin(), end());
    size_ = 0;
  }

  // Erases an element, but does not preserve order. Rather than shifting subsequent elements,
  // this moves the last element to the slot of the erased element.
  //
  // The last() and end() iterators, as well as those to the erased element, are invalidated.
  //
  void unstable_erase(const_iterator it) {
    std::destroy_at(it);
    if (it != last()) {
      // Move last element and destroy its source for destructor side effects. This is only
      // safe because exceptions are disabled.
      construct_at(it, std::move(back()));
      std::destroy_at(last());
    }
    --size_;
  }

 private:
  // Recursion for variadic constructor.
  template <std::size_t I, typename E, typename... Es>
  StaticVector(std::index_sequence<I>, E&& element, Es&&... elements)
      : StaticVector(std::index_sequence<I + 1>{}, std::forward<Es>(elements)...) {
    construct_at(begin() + I, std::forward<E>(element));
  }

  // Base case for variadic constructor.
  template <std::size_t I>
  explicit StaticVector(std::index_sequence<I>) : size_(I) {}

  // Recursion for in-place constructor.
  //
  // Construct element I by extracting its arguments from the InitializerList tuple. ArgIndex
  // is the position of its first argument in Args, and ArgCount is the number of arguments.
  // The Indices sequence corresponds to [0, ArgCount).
  //
  // The Sizes sequence lists the argument counts for elements after I, so Size is the ArgCount
  // for the next element. The recursion stops when Sizes is empty for the last element.
  //
  template <std::size_t I, std::size_t ArgIndex, std::size_t ArgCount, std::size_t... Indices,
            std::size_t Size, std::size_t... Sizes, typename... Args>
  StaticVector(std::index_sequence<I, ArgIndex, ArgCount>, std::index_sequence<Indices...>,
               std::index_sequence<Size, Sizes...>, std::tuple<Args...>& tuple)
      : StaticVector(std::index_sequence<I + 1, ArgIndex + ArgCount, Size>{},
                     std::make_index_sequence<Size>{}, std::index_sequence<Sizes...>{}, tuple) {
    construct_at(begin() + I, std::move(std::get<ArgIndex + Indices>(tuple))...);
  }

  // Base case for in-place constructor.
  template <std::size_t I, std::size_t ArgIndex, std::size_t ArgCount, std::size_t... Indices,
            typename... Args>
  StaticVector(std::index_sequence<I, ArgIndex, ArgCount>, std::index_sequence<Indices...>,
               std::index_sequence<>, std::tuple<Args...>& tuple)
      : size_(I + 1) {
    construct_at(begin() + I, std::move(std::get<ArgIndex + Indices>(tuple))...);
  }

  size_type size_ = 0;
  std::aligned_storage_t<sizeof(value_type), alignof(value_type)> data_[N];
};

// Deduction guide for array constructor.
template <typename T, std::size_t N>
StaticVector(T (&)[N]) -> StaticVector<std::remove_cv_t<T>, N>;

// Deduction guide for variadic constructor.
template <typename T, typename... Us, typename V = std::decay_t<T>,
          typename = std::enable_if_t<(std::is_constructible_v<V, Us> && ...)>>
StaticVector(T&&, Us&&...) -> StaticVector<V, 1 + sizeof...(Us)>;

// Deduction guide for in-place constructor.
template <typename T, std::size_t... Sizes, typename... Types>
StaticVector(InitializerList<T, std::index_sequence<Sizes...>, Types...>&&)
    -> StaticVector<T, sizeof...(Sizes)>;

template <typename T, std::size_t N>
template <bool IsEmpty>
void StaticVector<T, N>::swap(StaticVector& other) {
  auto [to, from] = std::make_pair(this, &other);
  if (from == this) return;

  // Assume this vector has fewer elements, so the excess of the other vector will be moved to it.
  auto [min, max] = std::make_pair(size(), other.size());

  // No elements to swap if moving into an empty vector.
  if constexpr (IsEmpty) {
    assert(min == 0);
  } else {
    if (min > max) {
      std::swap(from, to);
      std::swap(min, max);
    }

    // Swap elements [0, min).
    in_place_swap_ranges(begin(), begin() + min, other.begin());

    // No elements to move if sizes are equal.
    if (min == max) return;
  }

  // Move elements [min, max) and destroy their source for destructor side effects.
  const auto [first, last] = std::make_pair(from->begin() + min, from->begin() + max);
  std::uninitialized_move(first, last, to->begin() + min);
  std::destroy(first, last);

  std::swap(size_, other.size_);
}

template <typename T, std::size_t N>
inline void swap(StaticVector<T, N>& lhs, StaticVector<T, N>& rhs) {
  lhs.swap(rhs);
}

}  // namespace android::ftl
```

```h
#pragma once

#include <cassert>
#include <charconv>
#include <limits>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <type_traits>

namespace android::ftl {

enum class Radix { kBin = 2, kDec = 10, kHex = 16 };

template <typename T>
struct to_chars_length {
  static_assert(std::is_integral_v<T>);
  // Maximum binary digits, plus minus sign and radix prefix.
  static constexpr std::size_t value = std::numeric_limits<std::make_unsigned_t<T>>::digits + 3;
};

template <typename T>
constexpr std::size_t to_chars_length_v = to_chars_length<T>::value;

template <typename T = std::int64_t>
using to_chars_buffer_t = char[to_chars_length_v<T>];

// Lightweight (not allocating nor sprintf-based) alternative to std::to_string for integers, with
// optional radix. See also ftl::to_string below.
//
//   ftl::to_chars_buffer_t<> buffer;
//
//   assert(ftl::to_chars(buffer, 123u) == "123");
//   assert(ftl::to_chars(buffer, -42, ftl::Radix::kBin) == "-0b101010");
//   assert(ftl::to_chars(buffer, 0xcafe, ftl::Radix::kHex) == "0xcafe");
//   assert(ftl::to_chars(buffer, '*', ftl::Radix::kHex) == "0x2a");
//
template <typename T, std::size_t N>
std::string_view to_chars(char (&buffer)[N], T v, Radix radix = Radix::kDec) {
  static_assert(N >= to_chars_length_v<T>);

  auto begin = buffer + 2;
  const auto [end, err] = std::to_chars(begin, buffer + N, v, static_cast<int>(radix));
  assert(err == std::errc());

  if (radix == Radix::kDec) {
    // TODO: Replace with {begin, end} in C++20.
    return {begin, static_cast<std::size_t>(end - begin)};
  }

  const auto prefix = radix == Radix::kBin ? 'b' : 'x';
  if constexpr (std::is_unsigned_v<T>) {
    buffer[0] = '0';
    buffer[1] = prefix;
  } else {
    if (*begin == '-') {
      *buffer = '-';
    } else {
      --begin;
    }

    *begin-- = prefix;
    *begin = '0';
  }

  // TODO: Replace with {buffer, end} in C++20.
  return {buffer, static_cast<std::size_t>(end - buffer)};
}

// Lightweight (not sprintf-based) alternative to std::to_string for integers, with optional radix.
//
//   assert(ftl::to_string(123u) == "123");
//   assert(ftl::to_string(-42, ftl::Radix::kBin) == "-0b101010");
//   assert(ftl::to_string(0xcafe, ftl::Radix::kHex) == "0xcafe");
//   assert(ftl::to_string('*', ftl::Radix::kHex) == "0x2a");
//
template <typename T>
inline std::string to_string(T v, Radix radix = Radix::kDec) {
  to_chars_buffer_t<T> buffer;
  return std::string(to_chars(buffer, v, radix));
}

std::string to_string(bool) = delete;
std::string to_string(bool, Radix) = delete;

}  // namespace android::ftl
```

```h
#pragma once

#include <type_traits>
#include <utility>

namespace android::ftl {

// The unit type, and its only value.
constexpr struct Unit {
} unit;

constexpr bool operator==(Unit, Unit) {
  return true;
}

constexpr bool operator!=(Unit, Unit) {
  return false;
}

// Adapts a function object F to return Unit. The return value of F is ignored.
//
// As a practical use, the function passed to ftl::Optional<T>::transform is not allowed to return
// void (cf. https://wg21.link/P0798R8#mapping-functions-returning-void), but may return Unit if
// only its side effects are meaningful:
//
//   ftl::Optional opt = "food"s;
//   opt.transform(ftl::unit_fn([](std::string& str) { str.pop_back(); }));
//   assert(opt == "foo"s);
//
template <typename F>
struct UnitFn {
  F f;

  template <typename... Args>
  Unit operator()(Args&&... args) {
    return f(std::forward<Args>(args)...), unit;
  }
};

template <typename F>
constexpr auto unit_fn(F&& f) -> UnitFn<std::decay_t<F>> {
  return {std::forward<F>(f)};
}

namespace details {

// Identity function for all T except Unit, which maps to void.
template <typename T>
struct UnitToVoid {
  template <typename U>
  static auto from(U&& value) {
    return value;
  }
};

template <>
struct UnitToVoid<Unit> {
  template <typename U>
  static void from(U&&) {}
};

}  // namespace details
}  // namespace android::ftl
```

```cmake
if(NOT ACL_DIST_DIR OR NOT ACL_BINARY OR NOT ACL_HOST_ROOT)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "assemble-dist.cmake needs ACL_DIST_DIR, ACL_BINARY and ACL_HOST_ROOT")
endif()

set(RUNTIME_JARS
    core-oj-hostdex.jar
    core-libart-hostdex.jar
    okhttp-hostdex.jar
    bouncycastle-hostdex.jar
    apache-xml-hostdex.jar

    "libm.so"
    "libdl.so"

function(acl_copy_file source destination)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${source}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "the build did not produce ${source}")
    endif()

    file(COPY "${source}" DESTINATION "${destination}" USE_SOURCE_PERMISSIONS)
endfunction()

    message(FATAL_ERROR "no fonts found under ${ACL_FONT_DIR}")

    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${ACL_DIST_DIR}/android")
    file(COPY "${ACL_FRAMEWORK_RES}" DESTINATION "${ACL_DIST_DIR}/android")
    get_filename_component(RESOURCE_NAME "${ACL_FRAMEWORK_RES}" NAME)
    if(NOT RESOURCE_NAME STREQUAL "android.jar")
        file(RENAME "${ACL_DIST_DIR}/android/${RESOURCE_NAME}" "${ACL_DIST_DIR}/android/android.jar")
    endif()

    message(WARNING "no framework resource archive was found, so the bundle cannot read layout attributes")
endif()

    message(FATAL_ERROR "no runtime libraries under ${ACL_HOST_ROOT}/lib64")
endif()

    acl_copy_file("${ACL_HOST_ROOT}/framework/${jar}" "${ACL_DIST_DIR}/art/framework")
endforeach()

    if(EXISTS "${ACL_HOST_ROOT}/${module}")
        file(COPY "${ACL_HOST_ROOT}/${module}" DESTINATION "${ACL_DIST_DIR}/art")
    endif()

    file(COPY "${ACL_LINKER}" DESTINATION "${ACL_DIST_DIR}/bin" USE_SOURCE_PERMISSIONS)
endif()

function(acl_resolved_libraries binary output)
    execute_process(COMMAND ldd "${binary}" OUTPUT_VARIABLE listing ERROR_QUIET RESULT_VARIABLE status)

    if(NOT status EQUAL 0)
        set(${output} "" PARENT_SCOPE)
        return()
    endif()

    string(REPLACE "\n" ";" lines "${listing}")
    set(found "")

    foreach(line ${lines})
        if(NOT line MATCHES "=> +(/[^ ]+)")
            continue()
        endif()

        set(resolved "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
        set(skip FALSE)

        foreach(pattern ${SYSTEM_LIBRARY_EXCLUDES})
            if(resolved MATCHES "${pattern}")
                set(skip TRUE)
                break()
            endif()
        endforeach()

        get_filename_component(real "${resolved}" REALPATH)
        if(real MATCHES "^${ACL_HOST_ROOT}")
            set(skip TRUE)
        endif()

        if(NOT skip)
            list(APPEND found "${resolved}")
        endif()
    endforeach()

    set(${output} "${found}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

acl_resolved_libraries("${ACL_BINARY}" BINARY_LIBRARIES)
set(BUNDLED_LIBRARIES ${BINARY_LIBRARIES})

if(ACL_LINKER AND EXISTS "${ACL_LINKER}")
    acl_resolved_libraries("${ACL_LINKER}" LINKER_LIBRARIES)
    list(APPEND BUNDLED_LIBRARIES ${LINKER_LIBRARIES})
endif()

list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES BUNDLED_LIBRARIES)

foreach(library ${BUNDLED_LIBRARIES})
    get_filename_component(name "${library}" NAME)
    get_filename_component(real "${library}" REALPATH)
    file(COPY "${real}" DESTINATION "${ACL_DIST_DIR}/lib")
    get_filename_component(realName "${real}" NAME)

    if(NOT realName STREQUAL name)
        file(CREATE_LINK "${realName}" "${ACL_DIST_DIR}/lib/${name}" SYMBOLIC)
    endif()
endforeach()

list(LENGTH BUNDLED_LIBRARIES LIBRARY_COUNT)

foreach(document LICENSE NOTICE README.md)
    if(EXISTS "${ACL_SOURCE_DIR}/${document}")
        file(COPY "${ACL_SOURCE_DIR}/${document}" DESTINATION "${ACL_DIST_DIR}")
    endif()
endforeach()

file(WRITE "${ACL_DIST_DIR}/VERSION" "${ACL_VERSION}\n")

message(STATUS "bundle at ${ACL_DIST_DIR}: ${LIBRARY_COUNT} host librar(ies), ${ACL_HOST_ROOT} runtime")
```

`tools/bench-tiers.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
SRC_DIR="$PROJ_DIR/tests/bench/src"

SDK_DIR="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"
API_LEVEL="${API_LEVEL:-34}"
NDK_VERSION="${NDK_VERSION:-29.0.14206865}"
GUEST_ARCH="${GUEST_ARCH:-armv8.2-a+lse+rcpc}"
ITERATIONS="${BENCH_ITERATIONS:-200000}"
REPEATS="${BENCH_REPEATS:-5}"
SKIP_EXIT_CODE=77

NDK_DIR="$SDK_DIR/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
CLANG="$NDK_DIR/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android${API_LEVEL}-clang"
binary="$buildDir/src/BenchTiersTest"

if [ ! -x "$binary" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $binary is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -x "$CLANG" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: NDK $NDK_VERSION not installed" >&2
    exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

"$CLANG" -O2 -fPIC -shared -march="$GUEST_ARCH" -Wl,-soname,libbench.so \
         -o "$work/libbench.so" "$SRC_DIR/bench.c" || exit 1

runner=("$binary" "$work/libbench.so" "$ITERATIONS" "$REPEATS")
if command -v taskset >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    runner=(taskset -c 0 "${runner[@]}")
fi

"${runner[@]}"
status=$?

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the recompiler did not clear the throughput floor" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: the recompiler clears the throughput floor"
```

```sh
    "$HOST_PREFIX/lib64/libjavacrypto.so"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/lib64/libjavacore.so"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/lib64/libicu_jni.so"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/lib64/libopenjdkjvm.so"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/lib64/libopenjdkjvmti.so"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/lib64/libandroidio.so"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/lib64/libnativebridge.so"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/lib64/libnativeloader.so"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/lib64/libsigchain.so"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/lib64/libdexfile.so"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/lib64/libprofile.so"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/lib64/libartservice.so"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/lib64/libnpt.so"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/framework/d8.jar"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/framework/core-oj-hostdex.jar"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/framework/core-libart-hostdex.jar"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/framework/okhttp-hostdex.jar"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/framework/bouncycastle-hostdex.jar"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/framework/apache-xml-hostdex.jar"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/framework/conscrypt-hostdex.jar"
    "$HOST_PREFIX/framework/core-icu4j-hostdex.jar"
)

cd "$AOSP_DIR" || exit 1

echo "=== disk before ==="
df -h . | tail -1

source build/envsetup.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
banchan com.android.art "$BANCHAN_ARCH" >/dev/null 2>&1

if [ -z "${TARGET_BUILD_APPS:-}" ]; then
    echo "error: banchan did not take - start a fresh shell" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ -z "${ANDROID_HOST_OUT:-}" ]; then
    echo "error: ANDROID_HOST_OUT unset after envsetup" >&2
    exit 1
fi

export SOONG_ONLY=true

if [ ! -f "$NINJA_FILE" ] && ! compgen -G "$SOONG_NINJA_GLOB" >/dev/null; then
    echo "note: no build graph yet, running 'm nothing' to generate it"
    if ! m nothing; then
        echo "error: 'm nothing' failed, so the build graph was never generated" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

targets=()

if [ -f "$NINJA_FILE" ]; then
    mapfile -t targets < <(
        sed -e ':join' -e '/\$$/{N;s/\$\n[[:space:]]*//;bjoin' -e '}' "$NINJA_FILE" \
        | grep -m1 "^build build-art-host:" \
        | tr ' ' '\n' \
        | grep "^out/host/" \
        | grep -v "/apex/" \
        | grep -v "timestamp" \
        | grep -v "^out/host/linux-x86/lib/" \
        | grep -v "^out/host/linux-x86/bin/art$" \
        | sort -u
    )
fi

if [ ${#targets[@]} -lt "$MINIMUM_EXPECTED_TARGETS" ]; then
    echo "note: no usable build-art-host phony, using the explicit host target list"

    missingFromGraph=()
    for target in "${REQUIRED_HOST_TARGETS[@]}"; do
        if ! grep -qhF "build $target:" $SOONG_NINJA_GLOB 2>/dev/null; then
            missingFromGraph+=("$target")
        fi
    done

    if [ ${#missingFromGraph[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        echo "error: the build graph does not produce these host targets:" >&2
        printf '  %s\n' "${missingFromGraph[@]}" >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    targets=("${REQUIRED_HOST_TARGETS[@]}")
fi

derivedCount=${#targets[@]}
if [ "$derivedCount" -lt "$MINIMUM_EXPECTED_TARGETS" ]; then
    echo "error: derived only $derivedCount host targets from $NINJA_FILE (expected >= $MINIMUM_EXPECTED_TARGETS)" >&2
    echo "the build-art-host edge may have changed shape upstream; check docs/build-notes.md" >&2
    printf '  %s\n' "${targets[@]}" >&2
    exit 1
fi

targets+=(out/host/linux-x86/bin/dalvikvm out/host/linux-x86/bin/dex2oat)
mapfile -t targets < <(printf '%s\n' "${targets[@]}" | sort -u)

echo "=== building ${#targets[@]} host targets ==="
printf '  %s\n' "${targets[@]}"

time m "${targets[@]}"
status=$?

echo "=== disk after ==="
df -h . | tail -1
du -sh out 2>/dev/null

echo "=== result ==="
if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "BUILD FAILED (exit $status)"
    exit $status
fi

missing=0
for target in "${targets[@]}"; do
    [ -e "$target" ] || { echo "MISSING: $target" >&2; missing=$((missing + 1)); }
done
[ "$missing" -eq 0 ] || { echo "error: $missing declared targets absent after a successful build" >&2; exit 1; }

echo "libart       : $(ls -l "$ANDROID_HOST_OUT"/lib64/libart.so 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)"
echo "hostdex jars :"
ls "$ANDROID_HOST_OUT"/framework/ 2>/dev/null | grep hostdex | sed 's/^/  /' || true

exit 0

```

`tools/build-fixture-apk.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_DIR="$(dirname "${SCRIPT_DIR}")"

FIXTURE_DIR="${1:-}"
if [[ -z "${FIXTURE_DIR}" ]]; then
    echo "usage: $(basename "$0") <fixture-dir> [output.apk]" >&2
    exit 2
fi

FIXTURE_DIR="$(cd "${FIXTURE_DIR}" && pwd)"
OUTPUT_APK="${2:-${FIXTURE_DIR}/$(basename "${FIXTURE_DIR}").apk}"

SDK_ROOT="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${HOME}/Android/Sdk}"
BUILD_TOOLS_VERSION="${BUILD_TOOLS_VERSION:-34.0.0}"
PLATFORM_VERSION="${PLATFORM_VERSION:-android-34}"

AAPT2="${SDK_ROOT}/build-tools/${BUILD_TOOLS_VERSION}/aapt2"
ANDROID_JAR="${SDK_ROOT}/platforms/${PLATFORM_VERSION}/android.jar"
D8_JAR="${RUNTIME_D8_JAR:-${HOME}/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86/framework/d8.jar}"

for tool in "${AAPT2}" "${ANDROID_JAR}" "${D8_JAR}" "${FIXTURE_DIR}/AndroidManifest.xml"; do
    if [[ ! -e "${tool}" ]]; then
        echo "missing: ${tool}" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

WORK_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "${WORK_DIR}"' EXIT

mkdir -p "${WORK_DIR}/classes" "${WORK_DIR}/dex"

ASSET_ARGS=()
if [[ -d "${FIXTURE_DIR}/assets" ]]; then
    ASSET_ARGS=(-A "${FIXTURE_DIR}/assets")
fi

RESOURCE_ARGS=()
if [[ -d "${FIXTURE_DIR}/res" ]]; then
    "${AAPT2}" compile --dir "${FIXTURE_DIR}/res" -o "${WORK_DIR}/res.zip"
    RESOURCE_ARGS=("${WORK_DIR}/res.zip" --java "${WORK_DIR}/gen")
    mkdir -p "${WORK_DIR}/gen"
fi

"${AAPT2}" link \
    --manifest "${FIXTURE_DIR}/AndroidManifest.xml" \
    -I "${ANDROID_JAR}" \
    "${ASSET_ARGS[@]}" \
    "${RESOURCE_ARGS[@]}" \
    -0 .bin \
    --min-sdk-version 21 \
    --target-sdk-version 34 \
    -o "${WORK_DIR}/base.apk"

SOURCES=()
if [[ -d "${FIXTURE_DIR}/src" ]]; then
    mapfile -t SOURCES < <(find "${FIXTURE_DIR}/src" -name '*.java')
fi

if [[ ${#SOURCES[@]} -eq 0 && ! -d "${FIXTURE_DIR}/src" ]]; then
    echo "no src directory under ${FIXTURE_DIR}, so this fixture carries resources only"
elif [[ ${#SOURCES[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "no sources under ${FIXTURE_DIR}/src" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [[ ${#SOURCES[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    if [[ -d "${WORK_DIR}/gen" ]]; then
        mapfile -t GENERATED < <(find "${WORK_DIR}/gen" -name '*.java')
        SOURCES+=("${GENERATED[@]}")
    fi

    COMPILE_PATH="${ANDROID_JAR}"
    EXTRA_LIB_ARGS=()

    if [[ -n "${FIXTURE_CLASSPATH:-}" ]]; then
        if [[ ! -e "${FIXTURE_CLASSPATH}" ]]; then
            echo "FIXTURE_CLASSPATH does not exist: ${FIXTURE_CLASSPATH}" >&2
            exit 1
        fi

        COMPILE_PATH="${ANDROID_JAR}:${FIXTURE_CLASSPATH}"
        EXTRA_LIB_ARGS=(--lib "${FIXTURE_CLASSPATH}")
    fi

    javac --release 11 -nowarn -cp "${COMPILE_PATH}" -d "${WORK_DIR}/classes" "${SOURCES[@]}"

    mapfile -t CLASS_FILES < <(find "${WORK_DIR}/classes" -name '*.class')

    java -cp "${D8_JAR}" com.android.tools.r8.D8 \
        --release --min-api 21 \
        --lib "${ANDROID_JAR}" \
        "${EXTRA_LIB_ARGS[@]}" \
        --output "${WORK_DIR}/dex" \
        "${CLASS_FILES[@]}"

    (cd "${WORK_DIR}/dex" && zip -q -X "${WORK_DIR}/base.apk" classes.dex)
fi

if [[ -n "${FIXTURE_NATIVE_LIBS:-}" ]]; then
    if [[ ! -d "${FIXTURE_NATIVE_LIBS}" ]]; then
        echo "FIXTURE_NATIVE_LIBS is not a directory: ${FIXTURE_NATIVE_LIBS}" >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    mapfile -t NATIVE_LIBS < <(find "${FIXTURE_NATIVE_LIBS}" -name '*.so')
    if [[ ${#NATIVE_LIBS[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
        echo "no .so under ${FIXTURE_NATIVE_LIBS}" >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    mkdir -p "${WORK_DIR}/staging"
    cp -r "${FIXTURE_NATIVE_LIBS}" "${WORK_DIR}/staging/lib"
    (cd "${WORK_DIR}/staging" && zip -q -X -r "${WORK_DIR}/base.apk" lib)
fi

mkdir -p "$(dirname "${OUTPUT_APK}")"
mv "${WORK_DIR}/base.apk" "${OUTPUT_APK}"

echo "built ${OUTPUT_APK}"
```

`tools/build-framework-jar.cmake`:

```cmake
if(NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${CLASSES_DIR}")
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CLASSES_DIR}")
endif()

if(NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${DEX_DIR}")
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${DEX_DIR}")
endif()

file(GLOB_RECURSE STALE_CLASSES "${CLASSES_DIR}/*.class")
if(STALE_CLASSES)
    file(REMOVE ${STALE_CLASSES})
endif()

file(GLOB STALE_DEX "${DEX_DIR}/*.dex")
if(STALE_DEX)
    file(REMOVE ${STALE_DEX})
endif()

if(NOT EXISTS "${SOURCE_FILE}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "the framework source list ${SOURCE_FILE} is missing")
endif()

set(JAVAC_CLASSPATH_ARGS)
if(EXTRA_CLASSPATH)
    set(JAVAC_CLASSPATH_ARGS -classpath "${EXTRA_CLASSPATH}")
endif()

execute_process(
    COMMAND ${JAVAC} --release 11 -nowarn ${JAVAC_CLASSPATH_ARGS} -d "${CLASSES_DIR}" "@${SOURCE_FILE}"
    RESULT_VARIABLE JAVAC_STATUS
)
if(NOT JAVAC_STATUS EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "javac failed with status ${JAVAC_STATUS}")
endif()

file(GLOB_RECURSE COMPILED_CLASSES "${CLASSES_DIR}/*.class")
if(NOT COMPILED_CLASSES)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "javac produced no class files in ${CLASSES_DIR}")
endif()

execute_process(
    COMMAND ${JAVA} -cp "${D8_JAR}" com.android.tools.r8.D8
            --release --min-api ${MIN_API}
            --output "${DEX_DIR}"
            ${COMPILED_CLASSES}
    RESULT_VARIABLE D8_STATUS
)
if(NOT D8_STATUS EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "d8 failed with status ${D8_STATUS}")
endif()

if(NOT EXISTS "${DEX_DIR}/classes.dex")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "d8 produced no classes.dex in ${DEX_DIR}")
endif()

file(REMOVE "${JAR_PATH}")

execute_process(
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E tar cf "${JAR_PATH}" --format=zip classes.dex
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${DEX_DIR}"
    RESULT_VARIABLE ZIP_STATUS
)
if(NOT ZIP_STATUS EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "packaging ${JAR_PATH} failed with status ${ZIP_STATUS}")
endif()
```

`tools/capture-litmus.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
SRC_DIR="$PROJ_DIR/tests/litmus/src"
GOLDEN="$PROJ_DIR/tests/litmus/golden-litmus.txt"
PROVENANCE="$PROJ_DIR/tests/litmus/golden-litmus.provenance"
OBSERVED="$PROJ_DIR/tests/litmus/observed-outcomes.txt"

SDK_DIR="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"
API_LEVEL="${API_LEVEL:-34}"
NDK_VERSION="${NDK_VERSION:-29.0.14206865}"
ITERATIONS="${LITMUS_ITERATIONS:-500000}"
DEVICE_DIR=/data/local/tmp/acl
SKIP_EXIT_CODE=77

mode=""
case "${1:-}" in
    --check) mode=check ;;
    --regenerate) mode=regenerate ;;
    *) echo "usage: $(basename "$0") [--check | --regenerate]" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
[ "$#" -le 1 ] || { echo "usage: $(basename "$0") [--check | --regenerate]" >&2; exit 2; }

NDK_DIR="$SDK_DIR/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
CLANG="$NDK_DIR/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android${API_LEVEL}-clang++"

if [ ! -x "$CLANG" ]; then
    if [ "$mode" = "check" ]; then
        echo "skip: NDK $NDK_VERSION not installed" >&2
        exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE
    fi
    echo "error: NDK $NDK_VERSION not found at $NDK_DIR" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! command -v adb > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "skip: adb not installed" >&2
    exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE
fi

transports=$(adb devices | tail -n +2 | grep -c . || true)
if [ "$transports" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "skip: no device attached" >&2
    exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE
fi

if [ "$transports" -gt 1 ] && [ -z "${ANDROID_SERIAL:-}" ]; then
    echo "error: adb reports $transports transports - set ANDROID_SERIAL" >&2
    adb devices >&2
    exit 1
fi

state=$(adb get-state 2>&1 || true)
if [ "$state" != "device" ]; then
    echo "error: adb device not usable: $state" >&2
    exit 1
fi

abi=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.cpu.abi | tr -d '\r')
if [ "$abi" != "arm64-v8a" ]; then
    echo "error: device abi is $abi, expected arm64-v8a" >&2
    exit 1
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

"$CLANG" -std=c++20 -O2 -static -Wall -Wextra -Werror \
    -march=armv8.2-a+lse+rcpc \
    -o "$work/acl-litmus" \
    "$SRC_DIR/LitmusHarness.cpp" || exit 1

adb shell "mkdir -p $DEVICE_DIR" > /dev/null
adb push "$work/acl-litmus" "$DEVICE_DIR/" > /dev/null
adb shell "chmod 755 $DEVICE_DIR/acl-litmus"

adb shell "$DEVICE_DIR/acl-litmus $ITERATIONS 2> $DEVICE_DIR/litmus-observed.txt; echo EXIT=\$?" | tr -d '\r' > "$work/raw"

remoteExit=$(grep -o '^EXIT=[0-9]*$' "$work/raw" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2 || true)
if [ -z "$remoteExit" ]; then
    echo "error: harness produced no exit marker - device output follows" >&2
    cat "$work/raw" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$remoteExit" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "error: harness exited $remoteExit on device" >&2
    cat "$work/raw" >&2
    exit 1
fi

grep -v '^EXIT=' "$work/raw" > "$work/clean" || true
actual=$(wc -l < "$work/clean")
[ "$actual" -gt 0 ] || { echo "error: harness produced no verdicts" >&2; exit 1; }

if grep -qv ' forbidden=0 ' "$work/clean"; then
    echo "FAIL: a forbidden outcome was observed on real hardware" >&2
    cat "$work/clean" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if grep -q 'interleaved=no' "$work/clean"; then
    echo "FAIL: a litmus test never interleaved, so its forbidden=0 proves nothing" >&2
    cat "$work/clean" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ -f "$GOLDEN" ]; then
    expected=$(wc -l < "$GOLDEN")
    if [ "$actual" -ne "$expected" ] && [ "$mode" != "regenerate" ]; then
        echo "error: captured $actual verdicts, committed golden has $expected" >&2
        echo "the suite changed size; re-run with --regenerate if that is intended" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

if [ "$mode" = "check" ]; then
    if diff -u "$GOLDEN" "$work/clean"; then
        echo "OK: all $actual litmus verdicts reproduce, no forbidden outcome observed"
        exit 0
    fi
    echo "FAIL: litmus verdicts differ from $GOLDEN" >&2
    exit 1
fi

cp "$work/clean" "$GOLDEN"
adb shell "cat $DEVICE_DIR/litmus-observed.txt" | tr -d '\r' > "$OBSERVED"

model=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')
sdk=$(adb shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r')
features=$(adb shell 'grep -m1 Features /proc/cpuinfo' | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^Features[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*//')

{
    echo "device_model=$model"
    echo "device_abi=$abi"
    echo "android_sdk=$sdk"
    echo "cpu_features=$features"
    echo "ndk=$NDK_VERSION"
    echo "iterations=$ITERATIONS"
    echo "writer_cpu=0"
    echo "reader_cpu=4"
} > "$PROVENANCE"

echo "captured $actual litmus verdicts to $GOLDEN"

```

`tools/capture-prefs-format.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
PACKAGE=com.reveny.helloworld
PREFS=m3b_prefs.xml
REFERENCE="$PROJ_DIR/tests/m3b-prefs-device.xml"
SKIP=77

mode="${1:-}"
if [ "$#" -gt 1 ] || { [ "$mode" != "--check" ] && [ "$mode" != "--regenerate" ]; }; then
    echo "usage: $0 --check | --regenerate" >&2
    echo "  the device must be installed with $PACKAGE, awake and unlocked -" >&2
    echo "  before first unlock its credential-encrypted data directory does not exist" >&2
    exit 2
fi

if ! command -v adb > /dev/null; then
    echo "capture SKIPPED: adb is not installed" >&2
    exit $SKIP
fi

devices="$(adb devices | awk 'NR > 1 && $2 == "device" { print $1 }')"
deviceCount="$(printf '%s\n' "$devices" | grep -c . || true)"

if [ "$deviceCount" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "capture SKIPPED: no device attached" >&2
    exit $SKIP
fi

if [ "$deviceCount" -gt 1 ] && [ -z "${ANDROID_SERIAL:-}" ]; then
    echo "capture FAILED: $deviceCount devices attached and ANDROID_SERIAL is unset" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$devices" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ -z "${ANDROID_SERIAL:-}" ]; then
    ANDROID_SERIAL="$(printf '%s\n' "$devices" | head -1)"
    export ANDROID_SERIAL
fi

if ! adb shell "pm list packages" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "^package:$PACKAGE$"; then
    echo "capture SKIPPED: $PACKAGE is not installed on the device" >&2
    exit $SKIP
fi

locked="$(adb shell 'dumpsys user | grep -c RUNNING_LOCKED' 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')"
if [ "${locked:-0}" != "0" ]; then
    echo "capture SKIPPED: the device is in RUNNING_LOCKED - unlock it once so the app's" >&2
    echo "                 credential-encrypted data directory exists, then retry" >&2
    exit $SKIP
fi

adb shell "monkey -p $PACKAGE -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1" > /dev/null 2>&1
sleep 3

captured="$(adb shell "run-as $PACKAGE cat shared_prefs/$PREFS" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/\r$//')"

if [ -z "$captured" ]; then
    echo "capture FAILED: no preferences file on the device at shared_prefs/$PREFS" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$mode" = "--regenerate" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$captured" > "$REFERENCE"
    echo "regenerated $REFERENCE"
    exit 0
fi

if [ ! -s "$REFERENCE" ]; then
    echo "capture FAILED: no committed reference at $REFERENCE (run with --regenerate)" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s\n' "$captured" | diff -u "$REFERENCE" - > /dev/null; then
    echo "capture FAILED: the device no longer writes the committed reference format" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$captured" | diff -u "$REFERENCE" - >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "capture PASSED: the device still writes the committed preferences format"

```

```sh
adb shell "$DEVICE_DIR/acl-t0-vectors; echo EXIT=\$?" | tr -d '\r' > "$work/raw"

remoteExit=$(grep -o '^EXIT=[0-9]*$' "$work/raw" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2 || true)
if [ -z "$remoteExit" ]; then
    echo "error: harness produced no exit marker - device output follows" >&2
    cat "$work/raw" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$remoteExit" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "error: harness exited $remoteExit on device" >&2
    cat "$work/raw" >&2
    exit 1
fi

grep -v '^EXIT=' "$work/raw" | grep -v '^error:' > "$work/clean" || true
actual=$(wc -l < "$work/clean")
[ "$actual" -gt 0 ] || { echo "error: harness produced no vectors" >&2; exit 1; }

if [ -f "$GOLDEN" ]; then
    expected=$(wc -l < "$GOLDEN")
    if [ "$actual" -ne "$expected" ] && [ "$mode" != "regenerate" ]; then
        echo "error: captured $actual vectors, committed golden has $expected" >&2
        echo "the suite changed size; re-run with --regenerate if that is intended" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

if [ "$mode" = "check" ]; then
    if diff -u "$GOLDEN" "$work/clean"; then
        echo "OK: device reproduces all $actual golden vectors"
        exit 0
    fi
    echo "FAIL: device output differs from $GOLDEN" >&2
    exit 1
fi

cp "$work/clean" "$GOLDEN"

model=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')
sdk=$(adb shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r')
features=$(adb shell 'grep -m1 Features /proc/cpuinfo' | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^Features[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*//')

{
    echo "device_model=$model"
    echo "device_abi=$abi"
    echo "android_sdk=$sdk"
    echo "cpu_features=$features"
    echo "ndk=$NDK_VERSION"
    echo "api_level=$API_LEVEL"
    echo "harness=VectorExecutor (fixed-address, data-driven)"
    echo "reserved_registers=x16,x17,x18"
} > "$PROVENANCE"

echo "captured $actual vectors to $GOLDEN"
```

`tools/capture-text-metrics.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
GOLDEN="$PROJ_DIR/tests/text/golden-device-metrics.txt"
PROVENANCE="$PROJ_DIR/tests/text/golden-device-metrics.provenance"
FONT="$PROJ_DIR/third_party/roboto/Roboto-Regular.ttf"
HARNESS="$PROJ_DIR/tests/text/TextMetricsHarness.java"
REMOTE_DIR=/data/local/tmp/acl
SDK_JAR="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}/platforms/android-34/android.jar"
D8_JAR="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT:-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}/framework/d8.jar"
SKIP=77

mode="${1:-}"
if [ "$#" -gt 1 ]; then
    echo "usage: $0 --check | --regenerate" >&2
    exit 2
fi

if [ "$mode" != "--check" ] && [ "$mode" != "--regenerate" ]; then
    echo "usage: $0 --check | --regenerate" >&2
    echo "  --check       compare the device against the committed golden" >&2
    echo "  --regenerate  overwrite the committed golden from the device" >&2
    exit 2
fi

if ! command -v adb > /dev/null; then
    echo "capture SKIPPED: adb is not installed" >&2
    exit $SKIP
fi

if [ ! -e "$SDK_JAR" ]; then
    echo "capture SKIPPED: android.jar not found at $SDK_JAR" >&2
    exit $SKIP
fi

if [ ! -e "$D8_JAR" ]; then
    echo "capture SKIPPED: d8 not found at $D8_JAR" >&2
    exit $SKIP
fi

devices="$(adb devices | awk 'NR > 1 && $2 == "device" { print $1 }')"
deviceCount="$(printf '%s\n' "$devices" | grep -c . || true)"

if [ "$deviceCount" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "capture SKIPPED: no device attached" >&2
    exit $SKIP
fi

if [ "$deviceCount" -gt 1 ] && [ -z "${ANDROID_SERIAL:-}" ]; then
    echo "capture FAILED: $deviceCount devices attached and ANDROID_SERIAL is unset" >&2
    echo "                choosing one at random would silently capture from the wrong phone" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$devices" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ -z "${ANDROID_SERIAL:-}" ]; then
    ANDROID_SERIAL="$(printf '%s\n' "$devices" | head -1)"
    export ANDROID_SERIAL
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

mkdir -p "$work/classes"
if ! javac --release 11 -nowarn -classpath "$SDK_JAR" -d "$work/classes" "$HARNESS" > "$work/javac.log" 2>&1; then
    echo "capture FAILED: the harness did not compile" >&2
    sed -n '1,10p' "$work/javac.log" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! java -cp "$D8_JAR" com.android.tools.r8.D8 --min-api 34 --lib "$SDK_JAR" --output "$work" "$work"/classes/acl/*.class \
     > "$work/d8.log" 2>&1; then
    echo "capture FAILED: d8 did not run" >&2
    sed -n '1,10p' "$work/d8.log" >&2
    exit 1
fi

(cd "$work" && zip -q metrics.jar classes.dex)

adb shell "mkdir -p $REMOTE_DIR/fonts" > /dev/null 2>&1
if ! adb push "$work/metrics.jar" "$REMOTE_DIR/metrics.jar" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "capture FAILED: could not push the harness" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! adb push "$FONT" "$REMOTE_DIR/fonts/Roboto-Regular.ttf" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "capture FAILED: could not push the font" >&2
    exit 1
fi

captured="$(adb shell "CLASSPATH=$REMOTE_DIR/metrics.jar app_process /system/bin acl.TextMetricsHarness 2>/dev/null; echo EXIT=\$?")"
status="$(printf '%s\n' "$captured" | sed -n 's/^EXIT=//p' | tail -1)"

if [ "$status" != "0" ]; then
    echo "capture FAILED: the on-device harness exited $status" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$captured" | sed -n '1,10p' >&2
    exit 1
fi

printf '%s\n' "$captured" | sed 's/\r$//' | grep -v '^EXIT=' > "$work/device.txt"

if ! grep -q '^# end$' "$work/device.txt"; then
    echo "capture FAILED: the harness output has no end marker - it was truncated" >&2
    exit 1
fi

capturedLines="$(grep -c . "$work/device.txt")"
if [ "$capturedLines" -lt 100 ]; then
    echo "capture FAILED: only $capturedLines lines captured, expected hundreds" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$mode" = "--regenerate" ]; then
    cp "$work/device.txt" "$GOLDEN"
    echo "regenerated $GOLDEN ($capturedLines lines)"
    echo "review the diff before committing, and update $PROVENANCE"
    exit 0
fi

if [ ! -s "$GOLDEN" ]; then
    echo "capture FAILED: no committed golden at $GOLDEN (run with --regenerate)" >&2
    exit 1
fi

goldenLines="$(grep -c . "$GOLDEN")"
if [ "$capturedLines" -ne "$goldenLines" ]; then
    echo "capture FAILED: captured $capturedLines rows, the committed golden has $goldenLines" >&2
    echo "                changing the suite size needs --regenerate" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! diff -u "$GOLDEN" "$work/device.txt" > "$work/diff.txt"; then
    echo "capture FAILED: the device no longer produces the committed golden" >&2
    sed -n '1,30p' "$work/diff.txt" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "capture PASSED: the device still produces the committed golden ($goldenLines lines)"
```

`tools/capture-vectors.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
SRC_DIR="$PROJ_DIR/tests/vectors/src"
OUT_DIR="$PROJ_DIR/tests/vectors"
SDK_DIR="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"
API_LEVEL="${API_LEVEL:-34}"
NDK_VERSION="${NDK_VERSION:-29.0.14206865}"
DEVICE_DIR=/data/local/tmp/acl
GOLDEN="$OUT_DIR/golden-arm64.txt"
PROVENANCE="$OUT_DIR/golden-arm64.provenance"

SKIP_EXIT_CODE=77

mode=capture
case "${1:-}" in
    "") echo "usage: $(basename "$0") [--check | --regenerate]" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    --check) mode=check ;;
    --regenerate) mode=regenerate ;;
    *) echo "usage: $(basename "$0") [--check | --regenerate]" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
[ "$#" -le 1 ] || { echo "usage: $(basename "$0") [--check | --regenerate]" >&2; exit 2; }

if [ "$mode" = "check" ] && [ ! -d "$SDK_DIR/ndk/$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
    echo "skip: NDK $NDK_VERSION not installed" >&2
    exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE
fi

NDK_DIR="$SDK_DIR/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
if [ ! -d "$NDK_DIR" ]; then
    echo "error: NDK $NDK_VERSION not found at $NDK_DIR" >&2
    echo "installed: $(ls "$SDK_DIR/ndk" 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ')" >&2
    echo "override with NDK_VERSION=<version>" >&2
    exit 1
fi

CLANG="$NDK_DIR/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android${API_LEVEL}-clang++"
[ -x "$CLANG" ] || { echo "error: $CLANG not found" >&2; exit 1; }

if ! command -v adb >/dev/null; then
    echo "skip: adb not installed" >&2
    exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE
fi

if [ -z "${ANDROID_SERIAL:-}" ]; then
    transports=$(adb devices | tail -n +2 | grep -c . || true)
    if [ "$transports" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "skip: no arm64 device attached" >&2
        exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE
    fi
    if [ "$transports" -ne 1 ]; then
        echo "error: set ANDROID_SERIAL - adb reports $transports transports" >&2
        adb devices >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

state=$(adb get-state 2>&1 || true)
if [ "$state" != "device" ]; then
    if [ -n "${ANDROID_SERIAL:-}" ]; then
        echo "error: ANDROID_SERIAL=$ANDROID_SERIAL is set but not usable: $state" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "skip: adb device not ready: $state" >&2
    exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE
fi

model=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r' || true)
abi=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.cpu.abi | tr -d '\r' || true)
sdk=$(adb shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r' || true)
features=$(adb shell 'grep -m1 Features /proc/cpuinfo' 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^Features[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*//' || true)
[ -n "$model" ] && [ -n "$abi" ] || { echo "error: could not read device properties" >&2; exit 1; }
[ "$abi" = "arm64-v8a" ] || { echo "error: device abi is $abi, expected arm64-v8a" >&2; exit 1; }

echo "mode   : $mode"
echo "ndk    : $NDK_VERSION  api=$API_LEVEL"
echo "device : ${ANDROID_SERIAL:-<single>}  $model  sdk=$sdk"

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

"$CLANG" -std=c++20 -O0 -static -Wall -Wextra -Werror \
    -march=armv8.2-a+lse+rcpc \
    -I"$SRC_DIR" \
    -o "$work/acl-vectors-arm64" \
    "$SRC_DIR/VectorHarness.cpp" "$SRC_DIR/VectorTests.cpp"

adb shell "mkdir -p $DEVICE_DIR"
adb push "$work/acl-vectors-arm64" "$DEVICE_DIR/" >/dev/null
adb shell "chmod 755 $DEVICE_DIR/acl-vectors-arm64"

set +e
adb shell "$DEVICE_DIR/acl-vectors-arm64; echo EXIT=\$?" | tr -d '\r' > "$work/raw"
set -e

remoteExit=$(grep -o '^EXIT=[0-9]*$' "$work/raw" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2 || true)
if [ -z "$remoteExit" ]; then
    echo "error: harness produced no exit marker - device output follows" >&2
    sed -n '1,20p' "$work/raw" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ "$remoteExit" != "0" ]; then
    echo "error: harness exited $remoteExit on device" >&2
    sed -n '1,20p' "$work/raw" >&2
    exit 1
fi

grep -v '^EXIT=' "$work/raw" | grep -v '^#' > "$work/clean" || true
actual=$(wc -l < "$work/clean")
[ "$actual" -gt 0 ] || { echo "error: harness produced no vectors" >&2; exit 1; }

if [ -f "$GOLDEN" ]; then
    expected=$(wc -l < "$GOLDEN")
    if [ "$actual" -ne "$expected" ] && [ "$mode" != "regenerate" ]; then
        echo "error: captured $actual vectors, committed golden has $expected" >&2
        echo "the suite changed size; re-run with --regenerate if that is intended" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

if [ "$mode" = "check" ]; then
    if diff -u "$GOLDEN" "$work/clean"; then
        echo "OK: device reproduces all $actual golden vectors"
        exit 0
    fi
    echo "FAIL: device output differs from $GOLDEN" >&2
    exit 1
fi

cp "$work/clean" "$GOLDEN"

{
    echo "device_model=$model"
    echo "device_abi=$abi"
    echo "android_sdk=$sdk"
    echo "cpu_features=$features"
    echo "ndk=$NDK_VERSION"
    echo "api_level=$API_LEVEL"
} > "$PROVENANCE"

echo "captured $actual vectors to $GOLDEN"
```

```cmake
if(NOT ACL_FILE OR NOT EXISTS "${ACL_FILE}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "checksum.cmake needs ACL_FILE to name an existing file")
endif()

file(SHA256 "${ACL_FILE}" digest)
get_filename_component(name "${ACL_FILE}" NAME)
```

`tools/compare-text-metrics.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

if [ "$#" -ne 2 ]; then
    echo "usage: $0 <ours.txt> <golden.txt>" >&2
    exit 2
fi

ours="$1"
golden="$2"

for file in "$ours" "$golden"; do
    if [ ! -s "$file" ]; then
        echo "compare FAILED: $file is missing or empty" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

MAX_ADVANCE_DELTA="${RUNTIME_TEXT_ADVANCE_TOLERANCE:-0.05}"
MIN_EXACT="${RUNTIME_TEXT_MIN_EXACT:-870}"

BOUNDS_DELTA="${RUNTIME_TEXT_BOUNDS_TOLERANCE:-1.001}"

awk -v oursFile="$ours" -v maxDelta="$MAX_ADVANCE_DELTA" -v minExact="$MIN_EXACT" -v boundsDelta="$BOUNDS_DELTA" '
function abs(v) { return v < 0 ? -v : v }

function keyOf(line,    quote, head, tail, parts) {
    quote = index(line, "\"")
    if (quote > 0) {
        head = substr(line, 1, quote - 1)
        tail = substr(line, quote)
        split(head, parts, " ")
        return parts[1] " " parts[2] " " parts[3] " " parts[4] " " tail
    }
    split(line, parts, " ")
    return parts[1] " " parts[2] " " parts[3] " " parts[4]
}

function valuesOf(line,    quote, head, parts, count, i, out) {
    quote = index(line, "\"")
    head = quote > 0 ? substr(line, 1, quote - 1) : line
    count = split(head, parts, " ")
    out = ""
    for (i = 5; i <= count; i++) out = out (i > 5 ? " " : "") parts[i]
    return out
}

/^#/ { next }

FILENAME == oursFile {
    mineByKey[keyOf($0)] = valuesOf($0)
    next
}

{
    key = keyOf($0)
    if (!(key in mineByKey)) { missing++; next }

    split(valuesOf($0), device, " ")
    split(mineByKey[key], mine, " ")

    split(key, keyParts, " ")
    kind = keyParts[4]
    compared++

    if (kind == "measure") {
        delta = abs(device[1] - mine[1])
        if (delta > maxDelta) {
            failed++
            if (failed <= 12) printf "  ADVANCE   %-58s device=%-10s ours=%-10s delta=%+.4f\n", key, device[1], mine[1], mine[1] - device[1]
        } else if (delta > 0.05) {
            near++
        } else {
            exact++
        }
    } else if (kind == "metrics") {
        bad = 0
        for (i = 1; i <= 5; i++) if (abs(device[i] - mine[i]) > 0.05) bad = i
        if (bad) {
            failed++
            if (failed <= 12) printf "  METRICS   %-58s field %d device=%s ours=%s\n", key, bad, device[bad], mine[bad]
        } else exact++
    } else if (kind == "metricsInt") {
        bad = 0
        for (i = 1; i <= 5; i++) if (device[i] != mine[i]) bad = i
        if (bad) {
            failed++
            if (failed <= 12) printf "  METRICSINT %-57s field %d device=%s ours=%s\n", key, bad, device[bad], mine[bad]
        } else exact++
    } else if (kind == "widths") {
        deviceCount = 0
        for (i in device) deviceCount++
        mineCount = 0
        for (i in mine) mineCount++

        if (deviceCount != mineCount) {
            failed++
            if (failed <= 12) printf "  WIDTHS    %-58s device has %d values, ours %d\n", key, deviceCount, mineCount
        } else {
            bad = 0
            for (i = 1; i <= deviceCount; i++) if (abs(device[i] - mine[i]) > maxDelta) bad = i
            if (bad) {
                failed++
                if (failed <= 12) printf "  WIDTHS    %-58s glyph %d device=%s ours=%s\n", key, bad, device[bad], mine[bad]
            } else exact++
        }
    } else if (kind == "bounds") {
        bad = 0
        drift = 0
        for (i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
            if (abs(device[i] - mine[i]) > boundsDelta) bad = i
            else if (device[i] != mine[i]) drift = 1
        }
        if (bad) {
            failed++
            if (failed <= 12) printf "  BOUNDS    %-58s field %d device=%s ours=%s\n", key, bad, device[bad], mine[bad]
        } else if (drift) {
            near++
        } else exact++
    } else {
        skipped++
    }
}

END {
    printf "compared %d rows: %d exact, %d within tolerance, %d failed, %d absent, %d not compared\n",
           compared, exact, near, failed, missing, skipped

    if (exact < minExact) {
        printf "REGRESSION: only %d rows match the device exactly, the committed floor is %d.\n", exact, minExact
        printf "A tolerance nobody can regress under is not a tolerance. Raise the floor only when\n"
        printf "the number genuinely improves, never to make a failure go away.\n"
        exit 1
    }

    exit failed > 0 ? 1 : 0
}
' "$ours" "$golden"

status=$?
if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "compare FAILED: our metrics diverge from the device golden beyond tolerance" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "compare PASSED: text metrics agree with the device within tolerance"

```

```cmake
set(ACL_DIST_NAME "acl-${PROJECT_VERSION}-linux-x86_64")
set(ACL_DIST_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dist/${ACL_DIST_NAME}")

set(ACL_DIST_HOST_ROOT "")

foreach(candidate "${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT}" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/.toolchain/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86")
    if(candidate AND EXISTS "${candidate}/lib64/libart.so")
        set(ACL_DIST_HOST_ROOT "${candidate}")
        break()
    endif()
endforeach()

set(ACL_DIST_FRAMEWORK_RES "")

                  "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/.toolchain/android-sdk/platforms/android-${RUNTIME_DECLARED_SDK_VERSION}/android.jar")

        set(ACL_DIST_FRAMEWORK_RES "${candidate}")
        break()
    endif()

    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
            -DACL_DIST_DIR=${ACL_DIST_DIR}
            -DACL_SOURCE_DIR=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}
            -DACL_VERSION=${PROJECT_VERSION}
            -DACL_BINARY=$<TARGET_FILE:acl>
            -DACL_GUEST_SHIM=$<TARGET_FILE:aclguest>
            -DACL_FRAMEWORK_JAR=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/java/framework.jar
            -DACL_APACHE_HTTP_JAR=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/java/org.apache.http.legacy.jar
            -DACL_FRAMEWORK_RES=${ACL_DIST_FRAMEWORK_RES}
            -DACL_HOST_ROOT=${ACL_DIST_HOST_ROOT}
            -DACL_FONT_DIR=${RUNTIME_FONT_DIR}
            -DACL_LINKER=${ACL_DIST_LINKER}
            -P ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/assemble-dist.cmake
    DEPENDS acl aclguest FrameworkJar ApacheHttpJar
    COMMENT "Assembling ${ACL_DIST_NAME}"
    VERBATIM
)

    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E tar czf "${ACL_DIST_NAME}.tar.gz" "${ACL_DIST_NAME}"
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DACL_FILE=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dist/${ACL_DIST_NAME}.tar.gz
            -P ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/checksum.cmake
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dist"
    DEPENDS dist
    COMMENT "Packing ${ACL_DIST_NAME}.tar.gz"
    VERBATIM
)
```

`tools/extract-icu-data.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

AOSP_DIR="${AOSP_DIR:-$HOME/aosp/master-art}"
APEX="$AOSP_DIR/prebuilts/runtime/mainline/i18n/apex/com.android.i18n-x86_64.apex"
HOST_LIB="$AOSP_DIR/out/host/linux-x86/lib64/libicuuc-host.so"
I18N_ROOT="$AOSP_DIR/out/host/linux-x86/com.android.i18n"
WORK="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT

case "$AOSP_DIR" in
    *[[:space:]]*) echo "error: AOSP_DIR contains whitespace; debugfs -R cannot be quoted safely" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

for tool in debugfs strings python3 od; do
    command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || { echo "error: $tool not found" >&2; exit 1; }
done
[ -f "$APEX" ] || { echo "error: apex not found at $APEX" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HOST_LIB" ] || { echo "error: $HOST_LIB not found - run tools/build-art-host.sh first" >&2; exit 1; }

python3 -c '
import sys, zipfile
z = zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1])
open(sys.argv[2], "wb").write(z.read("apex_payload.img"))
' "$APEX" "$WORK/payload.img"

dat=$(debugfs -R "ls -l /etc/icu" "$WORK/payload.img" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "icudt[0-9]+[lbe]\.dat" | head -1 || true)
[ -n "$dat" ] || { echo "error: no icudt*.dat inside $APEX" >&2; exit 1; }

expected=$(strings "$HOST_LIB" | grep -oE "icudt[0-9]+[lbe]" | sort -u || true)
[ -n "$expected" ] || { echo "error: $HOST_LIB references no ICU data version" >&2; exit 1; }

expectedCount=$(printf '%s\n' "$expected" | grep -c . || true)
if [ "$expectedCount" -ne 1 ]; then
    echo "error: $HOST_LIB references $expectedCount ICU data versions: $(printf '%s' "$expected" | tr '\n' ' ')" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "apex provides : $dat"
echo "host lib wants: $expected"
[ "${dat%.dat}" = "$expected" ] || { echo "error: ICU data version mismatch" >&2; exit 1; }

mkdir -p "$I18N_ROOT/etc/icu"
dest="$I18N_ROOT/etc/icu/$dat"
debugfs -R "dump /etc/icu/$dat $dest" "$WORK/payload.img" 2>/dev/null || true

[ -s "$dest" ] || { echo "error: extraction produced an empty $dest" >&2; rm -f "$dest"; exit 1; }

magic=$(head -c 16 "$dest" | od -An -c | tr -s ' ' | grep -o "C m n D" || true)
[ -n "$magic" ] || { echo "error: $dest is not ICU common data (missing CmnD magic)" >&2; rm -f "$dest"; exit 1; }

ls -l "$dest"
echo "ANDROID_I18N_ROOT=$I18N_ROOT"

```

`tools/gen-gles-entry-points.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_DIR="$(dirname "${SCRIPT_DIR}")"

includeDir="${1:-/usr/include}"
output="${2:-${PROJECT_DIR}/src/GlesWsi/GlesEntryPointList.hpp}"

glesHeaders=("${includeDir}/GLES2/gl2.h" "${includeDir}/GLES3/gl3.h" "${includeDir}/GLES3/gl31.h" "${includeDir}/GLES3/gl32.h")
eglHeaders=("${includeDir}/EGL/egl.h")

for header in "${glesHeaders[@]}" "${eglHeaders[@]}"; do
    if [ ! -f "$header" ]; then
        echo "missing header: $header" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

names_from_gles()
{
    grep -hE '^GL_APICALL .* GL_APIENTRY [a-zA-Z0-9_]+ *\(' "$@" \
        | sed -E 's/^.*GL_APIENTRY +([a-zA-Z0-9_]+) *\(.*$/\1/'
}

names_from_egl()
{
    grep -hE '^EGLAPI .* EGLAPIENTRY [a-zA-Z0-9_]+ *\(' "$@" \
        | sed -E 's/^.*EGLAPIENTRY +([a-zA-Z0-9_]+) *\(.*$/\1/'
}

interposed="eglGetDisplay|eglGetPlatformDisplay|eglCreateWindowSurface|eglSwapBuffers|eglGetProcAddress|glGetString|glGetStringi|glDebugMessageCallback"

glesNames="$(names_from_gles "${glesHeaders[@]}" | sort -u | grep -vE "^(${interposed})$" || true)"
eglNames="$(names_from_egl "${eglHeaders[@]}" | sort -u | grep -vE "^(${interposed})$" || true)"

glesCount="$(printf '%s\n' "$glesNames" | grep -c . || true)"
eglCount="$(printf '%s\n' "$eglNames" | grep -c . || true)"

if [ "$glesCount" -lt 100 ] || [ "$eglCount" -lt 10 ]; then
    echo "refusing to write a suspiciously short list: $glesCount gl, $eglCount egl" >&2
    exit 1
fi

{
    echo "#pragma once"
    echo
    echo "#define RUNTIME_GLES_ENTRY_POINTS(FORWARD) \\"
    printf '%s\n' "$glesNames" | sed 's/^/    FORWARD(/; s/$/) \\/'
    echo "    /* end */"
    echo
    echo "#define RUNTIME_EGL_ENTRY_POINTS(FORWARD) \\"
    printf '%s\n' "$eglNames" | sed 's/^/    FORWARD(/; s/$/) \\/'
    echo "    /* end */"
} > "$output"

echo "wrote $output: $glesCount gl entry points, $eglCount egl entry points"
```

`tools/histogram-arm64.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
SRC_DIR="$PROJ_DIR/tests/guest/src"
HISTOGRAM="$PROJ_DIR/tests/guest/histogram-arm64.txt"

SDK_DIR="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"
API_LEVEL="${API_LEVEL:-34}"
NDK_VERSION="${NDK_VERSION:-29.0.14206865}"
SKIP_EXIT_CODE=77

mode=""
case "${1:-}" in
    --check) mode=check ;;
    --regenerate) mode=regenerate ;;
    *) echo "usage: $(basename "$0") [--check | --regenerate]" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
[ "$#" -le 1 ] || { echo "usage: $(basename "$0") [--check | --regenerate]" >&2; exit 2; }

NDK_DIR="$SDK_DIR/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
CLANG="$NDK_DIR/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android${API_LEVEL}-clang"
OBJDUMP="$NDK_DIR/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/llvm-objdump"

if [ ! -x "$CLANG" ] || [ ! -x "$OBJDUMP" ]; then
    if [ "$mode" = "check" ]; then
        echo "skip: NDK $NDK_VERSION not installed" >&2
        exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE
    fi
    echo "error: NDK $NDK_VERSION not found at $NDK_DIR" >&2
    exit 1
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

sources=$(find "$SRC_DIR" -name '*.c' | sort)
if [ -z "$sources" ]; then
    echo "error: no sources under $SRC_DIR" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for source in $sources; do
    "$CLANG" -O2 -c -march=armv8.2-a+lse+rcpc -o "$work/$(basename "$source" .c).o" "$source" || exit 1
done

"$OBJDUMP" -d --no-show-raw-insn "$work"/*.o 2>/dev/null \
    | awk -F'\t' 'NF > 1 { split($2, parts, " "); if (parts[1] != "") print parts[1] }' \
    | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn -k1,1 -k2,2 \
    | awk '{ printf "%s %s\n", $2, $1 }' > "$work/histogram.txt"

total=$(awk '{ total += $2 } END { print total + 0 }' "$work/histogram.txt")
distinct=$(wc -l < "$work/histogram.txt")

if [ "$total" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "error: the corpus produced no instructions" >&2
    exit 1
fi

{
    echo "# mnemonic count - regenerate with tools/histogram-arm64.sh --regenerate"
    echo "# corpus: tests/guest/src, NDK $NDK_VERSION, -O2 -march=armv8.2-a+lse+rcpc"
    echo "# total $total distinct $distinct"
    cat "$work/histogram.txt"
} > "$work/final.txt"

if [ "$mode" = "check" ]; then
    if [ ! -f "$HISTOGRAM" ]; then
        echo "error: $HISTOGRAM is missing; run --regenerate" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    if diff -u "$HISTOGRAM" "$work/final.txt"; then
        echo "OK: histogram matches - $total instructions, $distinct distinct mnemonics"
        exit 0
    fi
    echo "FAIL: the corpus histogram changed" >&2
    exit 1
fi

cp "$work/final.txt" "$HISTOGRAM"
echo "wrote $HISTOGRAM - $total instructions, $distinct distinct mnemonics"
```
