`tools/icu-preload/IcuPreload.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "IcuPreload.hpp"

#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <dlfcn.h>

bool IcuPreload::IsVerbose()
{
    return false;
}

void IcuPreload::Report(const char* format, ...)
{
    va_list arguments;
    va_start(arguments, format);
    fputs(LOG_PREFIX, stderr);
    vfprintf(stderr, format, arguments);
    fputc('\n', stderr);
    va_end(arguments);
}

void* IcuPreload::OpenIcuLibrary()
{
    dlerror();
    void* handle = dlopen(ICU_LIBRARY, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
    if (handle) return handle;

    char error[MAX_PATH_LENGTH];
    const char* message = dlerror();
    snprintf(error, sizeof(error), "%s", message ? message : "unknown");

    Report("dlopen %s failed: %s", ICU_LIBRARY, error);
    return nullptr;
}

IcuPreload::SetDataDirectoryFn IcuPreload::ResolveSetter(void* handle)
{
    dlerror();
    SetDataDirectoryFn plain = (SetDataDirectoryFn)dlsym(handle, "u_setDataDirectory");
    if (plain) return plain;

    for (int version = ICU_VERSION_MIN; version <= ICU_VERSION_MAX; ++version)
    {
        char name[MAX_SYMBOL_LENGTH];
        int written = snprintf(name, sizeof(name), "u_setDataDirectory_%d", version);
        if (written < 0 || (size_t)written >= sizeof(name)) continue;

        dlerror();
        SetDataDirectoryFn found = (SetDataDirectoryFn)dlsym(handle, name);
        if (!found) continue;

        if (IsVerbose()) Report("resolved %s", name);
        return found;
    }

    return nullptr;
}

bool IcuPreload::Configure()
{
    const char* i18nRoot = getenv("ANDROID_I18N_ROOT");
    if (!i18nRoot)
    {
        Report("ANDROID_I18N_ROOT is unset; ART will abort in libicu_jni JNI_OnLoad");
        return false;
    }

    void* handle = OpenIcuLibrary();
    if (!handle) return false;

    SetDataDirectoryFn setter = ResolveSetter(handle);
    if (!setter)
    {
        Report("no u_setDataDirectory symbol in %s (probed unversioned and _%d.._%d)", ICU_LIBRARY, ICU_VERSION_MIN, ICU_VERSION_MAX);
        return false;
    }

    char dataDir[MAX_PATH_LENGTH];
    int written = snprintf(dataDir, sizeof(dataDir), "%s%s", i18nRoot, ICU_DATA_SUBDIR);
    if (written < 0 || (size_t)written >= sizeof(dataDir))
    {
        Report("ANDROID_I18N_ROOT is too long; data directory would be truncated");
        return false;
    }

    setter(dataDir);

    if (IsVerbose()) Report("data directory set to %s", dataDir);
    return true;
}

extern "C" __attribute__((constructor)) void IcuPreloadInit()
{
    if (IcuPreload::Configure()) return;
    IcuPreload::Report("ICU was not configured; the runtime is expected to fail");
}
```

`tools/icu-preload/IcuPreload.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

namespace IcuPreload
{
    using SetDataDirectoryFn = void (*)(const char* path);

    inline constexpr const char* ICU_LIBRARY = "libicuuc-host.so";
    inline constexpr const char* ICU_DATA_SUBDIR = "/etc/icu";
    inline constexpr const char* LOG_PREFIX = "[icu-preload] ";
    inline constexpr int ICU_VERSION_MIN = 60;
    inline constexpr int ICU_VERSION_MAX = 99;
    inline constexpr int MAX_PATH_LENGTH = 4096;
    inline constexpr int MAX_SYMBOL_LENGTH = 64;

    bool IsVerbose();
    void Report(const char* format, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 1, 2)));
    void* OpenIcuLibrary();
    SetDataDirectoryFn ResolveSetter(void* handle);
    bool Configure();
}
```

`tools/make-test-png.c`:

```c
#include <png.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 2)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: make-test-png <output.png>\n");
        return 2;
    }

    const int width = 24;
    const int height = 24;

    FILE* file = fopen(argv[1], "wb");
    if (!file)
    {
        fprintf(stderr, "cannot write %s\n", argv[1]);
        return 1;
    }

    png_structp png = png_create_write_struct(PNG_LIBPNG_VER_STRING, NULL, NULL, NULL);
    png_infop info = png_create_info_struct(png);

    if (setjmp(png_jmpbuf(png)))
    {
        png_destroy_write_struct(&png, &info);
        fclose(file);
        return 1;
    }

    png_init_io(png, file);
    png_set_IHDR(png, info, width, height, 8, PNG_COLOR_TYPE_RGB_ALPHA, PNG_INTERLACE_NONE, PNG_COMPRESSION_TYPE_DEFAULT,
                 PNG_FILTER_TYPE_DEFAULT);
    png_write_info(png, info);

    png_bytep row = malloc((size_t) width * 4);

    for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
    {
        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
        {
            int centreX = x - width / 2;
            int centreY = y - height / 2;
            int inside = centreX * centreX + centreY * centreY <= (width / 2 - 1) * (width / 2 - 1);

            row[x * 4] = inside ? 240 : 40;
            row[x * 4 + 1] = inside ? 90 : 40;
            row[x * 4 + 2] = inside ? 60 : 60;
            row[x * 4 + 3] = inside ? 255 : 0;
        }

        png_write_row(png, row);
    }

    png_write_end(png, NULL);
    png_destroy_write_struct(&png, &info);

    free(row);
    fclose(file);

    return 0;
}
```

`tools/run-activity-draw-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$buildDir/tests/window/window.apk}"
golden="${3:-$PROJ_DIR/tests/window/pattern-golden.raw}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"

if [ -z "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT is set but empty - that is a misconfiguration, not an absent prerequisite" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk" "$golden"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
if [ ! -d "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no XDG_RUNTIME_DIR at '$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
westonPid=""

cleanup()
{
    if [ -n "$westonPid" ]; then kill "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; wait "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; fi
    rm -rf "$work"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if command -v weston >/dev/null; then
    socket="acl-m2a-$$"
    weston --backend=headless --socket="$socket" --width=640 --height=480 --idle-time=0 \
        > "$work/weston.log" 2>&1 &
    westonPid=$!

    for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
        [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ] && break
        sleep 0.1
    done

    if [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ]; then
        export WAYLAND_DISPLAY="$socket"
    else
        echo "note: headless weston did not come up" >&2
        sed -n '1,10p' "$work/weston.log" >&2
        kill "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null
        westonPid=""

        if [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
            echo "gate SKIPPED: weston failed and there is no session compositor" >&2
            exit 77
        fi
        echo "note: falling back to the session compositor $WAYLAND_DISPLAY" >&2
    fi
elif [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no weston and no WAYLAND_DISPLAY" >&2
    exit 77
fi

output=$(timeout 120 "$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$work/data" \
    --max-frames 3 \
    --window 400x300 \
    --frame-dump "$work/frame.raw" \
    "$apk" 2>&1)
status=$?

echo "$output"

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: launcher exited $status" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in \
    "I/Pattern: WindowApplication.onCreate package=com.example.window" \
    "I/Bootstrap: activity: com.example.window.PatternActivity" \
    "I/Pattern: PatternActivity.onCreate package=com.example.window" \
    "I/Pattern: findViewById=true" \
    "I/Pattern: decorView=true" \
    "I/Pattern: PatternView.onDraw 400x300" \
    "I/ViewRootImpl: frame limit reached: 3" \
    "I/Bootstrap: main loop finished after 3 frames"
do
    if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -qF "$expected"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: missing '$expected'" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

drawn=$(printf '%s' "$output" | grep -cF "I/Pattern: PatternView.onDraw 400x300")
if [ "$drawn" -ne 3 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: onDraw ran $drawn times, expected 3" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -s "$work/frame.raw" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: no frame was dumped" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! cmp -s "$work/frame.raw" "$golden"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest-drawn frame differs from $golden" >&2
    cmp "$work/frame.raw" "$golden" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: the APK's Activity drew three frames and the pixels match the golden"
```

`tools/run-aheadoftime-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
SRC_DIR="$PROJ_DIR/tests/tiers/src"

SDK_DIR="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"
API_LEVEL="${API_LEVEL:-34}"
NDK_VERSION="${NDK_VERSION:-29.0.14206865}"
GUEST_ARCH="${GUEST_ARCH:-armv8.2-a+lse+rcpc}"
SKIP_EXIT_CODE=77

NDK_DIR="$SDK_DIR/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
CLANG="$NDK_DIR/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android${API_LEVEL}-clang"
binary="$buildDir/src/AheadOfTimeGateTest"
linker="${ACL_LINKER:-ld.lld}"

if [ ! -x "$binary" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $binary is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -x "$CLANG" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: NDK $NDK_VERSION not installed" >&2
    exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE
fi

if ! command -v "$linker" >/dev/null; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no linker '$linker' - set ACL_LINKER to one that accepts -shared" >&2
    exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

mkdir -p "$work/cache"

"$CLANG" -O1 -fPIC -shared -march="$GUEST_ARCH" -Wl,-soname,libfunctions.so \
         -o "$work/libfunctions.so" "$SRC_DIR/functions.c" || exit 1

run()
{
    "$binary" "$work/libfunctions.so" --cache-root "$work/cache" 2>&1
}

cold=$(run)
coldStatus=$?

echo "$cold"

if [ "$coldStatus" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the cold translation run exited $coldStatus" >&2
    exit 1
fi

warm=$(run)
warmStatus=$?

echo "$warm"

if [ "$warmStatus" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the cached run exited $warmStatus" >&2
    exit 1
fi

contains()
{
    if [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$2" | grep -c -- "$1")" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: expected to see \"$1\"" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

contains "cache miss" "$cold" || exit 1
contains "cache hit" "$warm" || exit 1
contains "PASS nothing was interpreted at run time" "$cold" || exit 1
contains "PASS nothing was interpreted at run time" "$warm" || exit 1
contains "PASS nothing went through the run-time block JIT either" "$cold" || exit 1
contains "PASS translated code actually ran" "$cold" || exit 1
contains "PASS no untranslatable instruction was reached" "$cold" || exit 1
contains "aheadoftime-gate PASSED" "$cold" || exit 1
contains "aheadoftime-gate PASSED" "$warm" || exit 1

skipped=$("$binary" "$work/libfunctions.so" --cache-root "$work/cache" --skip-translation 2>&1)
skippedStatus=$?

if [ "$skippedStatus" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "$skipped"
    echo "gate FAILED: with translation skipped the run still passed, so this gate cannot tell native from interpreted" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$skipped" | grep -c -- "PASS nothing was interpreted at run time")" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: skipping translation did not make the interpreter counter move, so the counter proves nothing" >&2
    exit 1
fi

interpreted=$(printf '%s\n' "$skipped" | sed -n 's/.*, \([0-9]*\) interpreted.*/\1/p')
echo "red drive: with translation skipped the same work took $interpreted interpreted blocks instead of 5 translated ones"

echo "gate PASSED: the library was translated to native code before running, cached, and executed with no interpreter"
```

`tools/run-archive-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$PROJ_DIR/tests/app-debug.apk}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"
frameworkRes="${RUNTIME_FRAMEWORK_RES-${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}/platforms/android-34/android.jar}"

if [ -z "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT is set but empty - that is a misconfiguration, not an absent prerequisite" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if [ -z "$frameworkRes" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: RUNTIME_FRAMEWORK_RES is set but empty - that is a misconfiguration, not an absent prerequisite" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "$frameworkRes" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no SDK platform android.jar at '$frameworkRes'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if [ ! -f "$apk" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $apk is missing" >&2
    exit 1
fi

contains()
{
    case "$2" in
        *"$1"*) return 0 ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
}

matches()
{
    printf '%s' "$2" | grep -cE "$1" > /dev/null
}

listing=$(unzip -l "$apk" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$listing" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $apk could not be listed as a zip archive" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "lib/arm64-v8a/libhelloworld.so" "$listing"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $apk carries no lib/arm64-v8a/*.so, so the gate would prove nothing" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if contains "lib/x86_64/" "$listing"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $apk carries an x86_64 library - it is meant to be a real, arm64-only Android APK" >&2
    exit 1
fi

entryCount=$(printf '%s' "$listing" | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}')
dexCount=$(printf '%s' "$listing" | grep -cE ' classes[0-9]*\.dex$')
libCount=$(printf '%s' "$listing" | grep -cE ' lib/arm64-v8a/[^/]+\.so$')

dataRoot="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$dataRoot"' EXIT

output=$("$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --framework-res "$frameworkRes" \
    --data-root "$dataRoot" \
    --no-activity \
    --trace jni \
    "$apk" 2>&1)
status=$?

echo "$output"

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: launcher exited $status" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$entryCount" -lt 900 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $apk has only $entryCount entries - this gate exists to run the enumerator over a large real archive" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "[jni] $entryCount archive entries, $dexCount dex, 1 native abi" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the enumerator did not report $entryCount entries and $dexCount dex files" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$libCount" -lt 1 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $apk carries no arm64-v8a library - this gate exists to watch an arm64-only archive reach the translator" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "[launcher] extracted $libCount arm64-v8a guest librar" "$output"; then
    echo "$output"
    echo "gate FAILED: an arm64-only archive did not fall through to the translator with all $libCount of its libraries" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "guest library to $dataRoot/com.reveny.helloworld/lib/arm64-v8a" "$output" &&
   ! contains "guest libraries to $dataRoot/com.reveny.helloworld/lib/arm64-v8a" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest libraries were not staged under the package's own arm64-v8a directory" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "[launcher] the guest bridge is live" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest bridge was not started for an arm64-only archive" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if matches 'unimplemented|Exception in thread|NoSuchMethodError|NoClassDefFoundError' "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: a strict guard fired or the guest threw" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "$dataRoot/com.reveny.helloworld/lib/libhelloworld.so" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the translator shim was not staged under the guest library's own soname" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if file -b "$dataRoot/com.reveny.helloworld/lib/libhelloworld.so" | grep -q "ARM aarch64"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the staged shim is an aarch64 ELF - host ART must be able to dlopen it" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! file -b "$dataRoot/com.reveny.helloworld/lib/arm64-v8a/libhelloworld.so" | grep -q "ARM aarch64"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the real guest library beneath the shim is not an aarch64 ELF" >&2
    exit 1
fi

absent=$("$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --framework-res "$frameworkRes" \
    --data-root "$(mktemp -d)" \
    --no-activity \
    --abi armeabi-v7a \
    "$apk" 2>&1)

if ! contains "has no armeabi-v7a native library (it ships: arm64-v8a)" "$absent"; then
    echo "$absent"
    echo "gate FAILED: an ABI the archive genuinely does not ship was not refused by name" >&2
    exit 1
fi

selected=$("$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --framework-res "$frameworkRes" \
    --data-root "$dataRoot" \
    --no-activity \
    --abi arm64-v8a \
    --trace jni \
    "$apk" 2>&1)
selectedStatus=$?

if [ "$selectedStatus" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "$selected"
    echo "gate FAILED: selecting arm64-v8a exited $selectedStatus" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "[launcher] extracted $libCount arm64-v8a native librar" "$selected"; then
    echo "$selected"
    echo "gate FAILED: the stored arm64 library was not extracted when its ABI was selected" >&2
    exit 1
fi

extracted="$dataRoot/com.reveny.helloworld/lib/libhelloworld.so"
if [ ! -f "$extracted" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $extracted was not written" >&2
    exit 1
fi

described=$(file -b "$extracted")
if ! contains "ELF 64-bit LSB shared object, ARM aarch64" "$described"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $extracted is not an arm64 ELF: $described" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: the zip layer enumerated $entryCount real entries, extracted a stored arm64 library, and refused the ABI we cannot run"
```

`tools/run-corpus-coverage.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
SRC_DIR="$PROJ_DIR/tests/guest/src"

SDK_DIR="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"
API_LEVEL="${API_LEVEL:-34}"
NDK_VERSION="${NDK_VERSION:-29.0.14206865}"
BUDGET="${CORPUS_UNIMPLEMENTED_BUDGET:-0.0}"
SKIP_EXIT_CODE=77

NDK_DIR="$SDK_DIR/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
CLANG="$NDK_DIR/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android${API_LEVEL}-clang"
OBJCOPY="$NDK_DIR/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/llvm-objcopy"
binary="$buildDir/src/CorpusCoverageTest"

if [ ! -x "$CLANG" ] || [ ! -x "$OBJCOPY" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: NDK $NDK_VERSION not installed" >&2
    exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE
fi

if [ ! -x "$binary" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $binary is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
    exit 1
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

: > "$work/text.bin"
for source in $(find "$SRC_DIR" -name '*.c' | sort); do
    name=$(basename "$source" .c)
    "$CLANG" -O2 -c -march=armv8.2-a+lse+rcpc -o "$work/$name.o" "$source" || exit 1
    "$OBJCOPY" -O binary --only-section=.text "$work/$name.o" "$work/$name.text" || exit 1
    cat "$work/$name.text" >> "$work/text.bin"
done

if [ ! -s "$work/text.bin" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the corpus produced no .text bytes" >&2
    exit 1
fi

"$binary" "$work/text.bin" "$BUDGET"
status=$?

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: decoder coverage over the corpus regressed" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: corpus coverage within the ${BUDGET} unimplemented budget"
```

`tools/run-dalvikvm.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

AOSP_DIR="${AOSP_DIR:-$HOME/aosp/master-art}"
PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
BUILD_DIR="${BUILD_DIR:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
HOST="$AOSP_DIR/out/host/linux-x86"
FW="$HOST/framework"
PRELOAD="$BUILD_DIR/tools/icu-preload/libicu_preload.so"

dex="${1:-}"
mainClass="${2:-}"
if [ -z "$dex" ] || [ -z "$mainClass" ]; then
    echo "usage: $(basename "$0") <dex> <MainClass> [args...]" >&2
    exit 2
fi
shift 2

[ -f "$dex" ] || { echo "error: dex not found: $dex" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -x "$HOST/bin/dalvikvm64" ] || { echo "error: no dalvikvm64 - run tools/build-art-host.sh" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -f "$PRELOAD" ] || { echo "error: ICU shim missing - run: cmake -S $PROJ_DIR -B $BUILD_DIR -G Ninja && cmake --build $BUILD_DIR" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -d "$HOST/com.android.i18n/etc/icu" ] || { echo "error: no ICU data - run tools/extract-icu-data.sh" >&2; exit 1; }

bcp=""
for jar in core-oj core-libart okhttp bouncycastle apache-xml conscrypt core-icu4j; do
    [ -f "$FW/$jar-hostdex.jar" ] || { echo "error: missing boot jar $jar-hostdex.jar - run tools/build-art-host.sh" >&2; exit 1; }
    bcp="${bcp:+$bcp:}$FW/$jar-hostdex.jar"
done

preload="$PRELOAD"
[ -n "${LD_PRELOAD:-}" ] && preload="$PRELOAD:$LD_PRELOAD"

exec env \
    ANDROID_ROOT="$HOST" \
    ANDROID_ART_ROOT="$HOST" \
    ANDROID_I18N_ROOT="$HOST/com.android.i18n" \
    ANDROID_TZDATA_ROOT="$HOST/com.android.tzdata" \
    LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$HOST/lib64${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}" \
    LD_PRELOAD="$preload" \
    "$HOST/bin/dalvikvm64" \
        -Xbootclasspath:"$bcp" \
        -Xnoimage-dex2oat \
        -Xusejit:false \
        -cp "$dex" \
        "$mainClass" "$@"
```

`tools/run-decode-differential.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
count="${DECODE_DIFFERENTIAL_COUNT:-20000}"
seed="${DECODE_DIFFERENTIAL_SEED:-20260821}"
features="${DECODE_DIFFERENTIAL_FEATURES:-+lse,+rcpc,+rcpc-immo,+pauth,+bti,+flagm,+altnzcv,+jsconv,+complxnum,+dotprod,+fullfp16,+i8mm,+bf16,+sha3,+sm4}"

binary="$buildDir/src/DecodeDifferentialTest"

if ! command -v llvm-mc > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: llvm-mc is not installed" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if ! llvm-mc --version 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'aarch64' > /dev/null; then
    echo "gate FAILED: llvm-mc is installed but has no aarch64 target - that is a misconfiguration, not an absent prerequisite" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -x "$binary" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $binary is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
    exit 1
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

"$binary" --generate "$count" "$seed" > "$work/encodings.txt"
if [ ! -s "$work/encodings.txt" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the generator produced no encodings" >&2
    exit 1
fi

awk '{ printf "0x%s 0x%s 0x%s 0x%s\n", substr($1,7,2), substr($1,5,2), substr($1,3,2), substr($1,1,2) }' "$work/encodings.txt" \
    > "$work/bytes.txt"

llvm-mc -triple=aarch64 -mattr="$features" -disassemble < "$work/bytes.txt" > "$work/valid.txt" 2> "$work/stderr.txt"

grep -vE '^\s*\.text|^\s*$' "$work/valid.txt" > "$work/decoded.txt"

grep -E 'warning: invalid instruction encoding' "$work/stderr.txt" \
    | grep -oE '^<stdin>:[0-9]+' | cut -d: -f2 | sort -un > "$work/invalid.txt"

grep -E 'warning: potentially undefined instruction encoding' "$work/stderr.txt" \
    | grep -oE '^<stdin>:[0-9]+' | cut -d: -f2 | sort -un > "$work/ambiguous.txt"

decodedLines=$(wc -l < "$work/decoded.txt")
invalidLines=$(wc -l < "$work/invalid.txt")
encodingLines=$(wc -l < "$work/encodings.txt")

if [ $((decodedLines + invalidLines)) -ne "$encodingLines" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: llvm-mc accounted for $decodedLines decoded + $invalidLines invalid, but there were $encodingLines encodings" >&2
    exit 1
fi

awk -v invalidFile="$work/invalid.txt" -v ambiguousFile="$work/ambiguous.txt" -v decodedFile="$work/decoded.txt" '
BEGIN {
    while ((getline entry < invalidFile) > 0) rejected[entry + 0] = 1
    while ((getline entry < ambiguousFile) > 0) ambiguous[entry + 0] = 1
    while ((getline entry < decodedFile) > 0) accepted[++acceptedCount] = entry
    taken = 0
}
{
    if (FNR in rejected) { print $1 " INVALID"; next }
    taken += 1
    if (FNR in ambiguous) print $1 " AMBIGUOUS"
    else print $1 " " accepted[taken]
}
' "$work/encodings.txt" > "$work/reference.txt"

"$binary" "$work/reference.txt"
status=$?

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the decoder disagrees with llvm-mc" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: $count encodings, seed $seed"

```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$buildDir/tests/window/window.apk}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
harness="$buildDir/src/HostedWindowHarness"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$harness" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

output=$(timeout 180 env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY -u WAYLAND_SOCKET \
    "$harness" "$launcher" "$apk" "$work/frame.raw" 400 300 0 \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$work/data" \
    --max-frames 3 \
    --log "$work/run.log" 2>&1)
status=$?

echo "$output"

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the run exited $status" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -s "$work/run.log" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: no log was written" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "--- first four captured lines"
head -4 "$work/run.log"

if ! grep -qE '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{3} [VDIWEF]/[^:]+: ' "$work/run.log"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the log is not in the timestamped priority-and-tag shape" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in \
    "I/Pattern: PatternActivity.onCreate package=com.example.window" \
    "I/Pattern: PatternView.onDraw 400x300" \
    "I/Bootstrap: the activity is destroyed" \
    "I/hostedwindow: hosted by a shell"
do
    if ! grep -qF "$expected" "$work/run.log"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: the log is missing '$expected'" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

appLines=$(grep -c "I/Pattern: " "$work/run.log")
if [ "$appLines" -lt 5 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: only $appLines line(s) from the app itself were captured" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -qE "\[launcher\] log: [0-9]+ line\(s\) kept of [0-9]+, 0 dropped"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the run dropped log lines, or did not report the buffer at all" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if grep -qE '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9:.]+ I/stderr: \[' "$work/run.log"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: a module line was filed under stderr rather than given its own tag" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -qF "[diagnostics] this app asked for nothing this runtime does not have"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: a run that touches no gap should say so plainly" >&2
    exit 1
fi

strictApk="$buildDir/tests/strict/strict.apk"

if [ ! -e "$strictApk" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $strictApk is missing, so the gap report cannot be exercised" >&2
    exit 1
fi

gaps=$(timeout 180 env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY -u WAYLAND_SOCKET \
    "$launcher" \
    --no-strict \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$work/gap-data" \
    --no-activity \
    "$strictApk" 2>&1)
status=$?

echo "--- the gap report"
printf '%s' "$gaps" | grep "\[diagnostics\]"

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the gap run exited $status" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s' "$gaps" | grep -qE "\[diagnostics\] this app asked for 1 thing\(s\) this runtime does not have"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the report did not count the one thing the fixture asks for" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s' "$gaps" | grep -qE "\[diagnostics\] +framework +android.content.Context.getSystemService\(no-such-service-at-all\) x1"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the report did not name the missing call, its kind and its count" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: the whole run is captured with priorities and tags, nothing was dropped, and the exit report names what the app asked for and did not get"
```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$buildDir/tests/graphics/graphics.apk}"
golden="${3:-$PROJ_DIR/tests/graphics/drawables-golden.raw}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
if [ ! -d "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no XDG_RUNTIME_DIR at '$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
westonPid=""

cleanup()
{
    if [ -n "$westonPid" ]; then kill "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; wait "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; fi
    rm -rf "$work"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if command -v weston >/dev/null; then
    socket="acl-drawables-$$"
    weston --backend=headless --socket="$socket" --width=640 --height=480 --idle-time=0 \
        > "$work/weston.log" 2>&1 &
    westonPid=$!

    for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
        [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ] && break
        sleep 0.1
    done

    if [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ]; then
        export WAYLAND_DISPLAY="$socket"
    elif [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
        echo "gate SKIPPED: weston failed and there is no session compositor" >&2
        exit 77
    fi
elif [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no weston and no WAYLAND_DISPLAY" >&2
    exit 77
fi

output=$(timeout 120 "$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$work/data" \
    --activity com.example.graphics.DrawablesActivity \
    --max-frames 2 \
    --window 400x300 \
    --frame-dump "$work/frame.raw" \
    "$apk" 2>&1)
status=$?

echo "$output"

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: launcher exited $status" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in \
    "I/Drawables: DrawablesActivity.onCreate package=com.example.graphics" \
    "I/Drawables: check is VectorDrawable" \
    "I/Drawables: check intrinsic 24x24" \
    "I/Drawables: ring is VectorDrawable" \
    "I/Drawables: ring intrinsic 32x32" \
    "I/Drawables: panel is GradientDrawable" \
    "I/Drawables: stack is LayerDrawable" \
    "I/Drawables: stack has 2 layers" \
    "I/Drawables: toggle is StateListDrawable" \
    "I/Drawables: toggle has 2 states, stateful=true" \
    "I/Drawables: toggle picks a different drawable when pressed=true"
do
    if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -qF "$expected"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: missing '$expected'" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if [ ! -s "$work/frame.raw" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: no frame was dumped" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "${RUNTIME_REGENERATE_GOLDEN:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    cp "$work/frame.raw" "$golden"
    echo "gate NOTE: regenerated $golden"
    exit 0
fi

if [ ! -e "$golden" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $golden is missing; run with RUNTIME_REGENERATE_GOLDEN=1 to record it" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! cmp -s "$work/frame.raw" "$golden"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the drawn frame differs from $golden" >&2
    cmp "$work/frame.raw" "$golden" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: vector, shape, layer-list and selector drawables inflated from xml and drew"
```

```sh
    exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE

    echo "gate FAILED: $binary is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2

libraries+=("$work/libhello.so")

"$CLANG" -O2 -fPIC -shared -march="$GUEST_ARCH" -Wl,-soname,libhellonorelr.so -Wl,--pack-dyn-relocs=none \
         -o "$work/libhellonorelr.so" "$SRC_DIR/hello.c" || exit 1
libraries+=("$work/libhellonorelr.so")

if [ -f "$SYSROOT_LIB/libc++_shared.so" ]; then
    libraries+=("$SYSROOT_LIB/libc++_shared.so")
fi

apk="$PROJ_DIR/tests/app-debug.apk"
if [ -f "$apk" ] && command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if unzip -o -q -j "$apk" 'lib/arm64-v8a/*.so' -d "$work/apklibs" 2>/dev/null; then
        while IFS= read -r extracted; do
            libraries+=("$extracted")
        done < <(find "$work/apklibs" -name '*.so' | sort)
    fi
fi

echo "comparing ${#libraries[@]} libraries against llvm-readelf"

"$binary" "$READELF" "${libraries[@]}"
status=$?

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the loader and llvm-readelf disagree about a real ARM64 library" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: the loader agrees with llvm-readelf on every library"
```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

apk="${2:-$PROJ_DIR/tests/app-debug.apk}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"

if [ -z "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT is set but empty - that is a misconfiguration, not an absent prerequisite" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

dataRoot="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$dataRoot"' EXIT

contains()
{
    case "$2" in
        *"$1"*) return 0 ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
}

output=$("$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$dataRoot" \
    --max-frames 200 \
    "$apk" 2>&1)
status=$?

echo "$output"

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: launcher exited $status" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in \
    "declares 4 activities, 2 service(s), 2 receiver(s), 2 provider(s)" \
    "I/Activities: started com.reveny.helloworld.SecondActivity in task 1, stack is now 2 deep" \
    "I/FrameworkProbe: second activity created with note=carried" \
    "I/Activities: finished com.reveny.helloworld.SecondActivity, back to com.reveny.helloworld.MainActivity" \
    "I/FrameworkProbe: activity result request=42 result=-1 answer=returned-carried" \
    "I/FrameworkProbe: service started with command=warm-up startId=1" \
    "I/FrameworkProbe: binder answered echo:through-the-binder" \
    "I/FrameworkProbe: service unbound" \
    "I/Services: destroyed com.reveny.helloworld.EchoService" \
    "I/FrameworkProbe: registered receiver got com.reveny.helloworld.PING payload=hello" \
    "I/FrameworkProbe: manifest receiver got com.reveny.helloworld.PING payload=hello" \
    "I/FrameworkProbe: provider inserted first-note" \
    "I/FrameworkProbe: provider round trip read first-note" \
    "I/Notifications: posted 7 Notification{channel=probe title=probe title text=probe text}" \
    "I/Notifications: cancelled 7" \
    "I/AlarmManager: the alarm for" \
    "I/FrameworkProbe: registered receiver got com.reveny.helloworld.PING payload=from-the-alarm" \
    "I/FrameworkProbe: job ran with id 11" \
    "I/Jobs: job 11 finished"
do
    if ! contains "$expected" "$output"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: missing '$expected'" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

settled=$(printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -c "I/Jobs: job 11 finished")
if [ "$settled" -ne 1 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: job 11 settled $settled times, expected exactly once" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "framework gate PASSED: intents, services, broadcasts, providers, notifications, alarms and jobs all reached their component"
```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"

classes="$buildDir/java/classes"
if [ ! -d "$classes" ]; then
    echo "framework tests FAILED: $classes is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
    exit 1
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

mapfile -t sources < <(find "$PROJ_DIR/tests/framework/src" -name '*.java')

if ! javac -nowarn -cp "$classes" -d "$work" "${sources[@]}"; then
    echo "framework tests FAILED: could not compile the tests against the framework classes" >&2
    exit 1
fi

status=0
for source in "${sources[@]}"; do
    name="$(basename "$source" .java)"
    echo "--- $name ---"
    if ! timeout 120 java -cp "$classes:$work" "$name"; then
        echo "framework tests FAILED: $name" >&2
        status=1
    fi
done

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi

echo "framework tests PASSED"
```

`tools/run-gles-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$PROJ_DIR/tests/app-debug.apk}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"
frameworkRes="${RUNTIME_FRAMEWORK_RES-${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}/platforms/android-34/android.jar}"

activityClass="com.reveny.helloworld.GlesActivity"
frames=30

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if [ ! -f "$frameworkRes" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no SDK platform android.jar at '$frameworkRes'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ] && [ -z "${WAYLAND_SOCKET:-}" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no Wayland compositor in the environment, so nothing can be presented to" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if ! ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null | grep -q "libEGL\.so\.1"; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no host libEGL.so.1, so there is no driver to forward to" >&2
    exit 77
fi

dataRoot="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$dataRoot"' EXIT

output=$(timeout 180 "$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --framework-res "$frameworkRes" \
    --data-root "$dataRoot" \
    --activity "$activityClass" \
    --guest-env "GLES_FRAMES=$frames" \
    "$apk" 2>&1)

printf '%s\n' "$output"

contains()
{
    printf '%s' "$output" | grep -qF "$1"
}

if ! contains "OpenGL ES entry points forwarded to the host driver"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: no entry points were forwarded, so the guest had no driver to call" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "ignoring the window it passed in"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: no window surface was made on the compositor surface" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if contains "gles FAILED"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest reported a failure of its own" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "the colour it cleared to is the colour it read back"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: glReadPixels did not return the colour the guest cleared to, so nothing was really drawn" >&2
    exit 1
fi

hostFrames=$(printf '%s' "$output" | sed -n 's/^\[launcher\] the host driver swapped \([0-9]*\) guest frame(s).*$/\1/p' | tail -1)
guestFrames=$(printf '%s' "$output" | sed -n 's/^.*gles: presented \([0-9]*\) frame(s).*$/\1/p' | tail -1)

if [ -z "$hostFrames" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the host driver reported no swap count at all" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$hostFrames" -lt "$frames" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the host driver swapped $hostFrames frame(s), fewer than the $frames asked for" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$guestFrames" != "$hostFrames" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest counted $guestFrames frame(s) but the host swapped $hostFrames" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "renderer ACL Graphics"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the renderer string the guest read was not the one this runtime reports" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if contains "unimplemented symbol"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest called a symbol this runtime does not have" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if contains "without a known prototype"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: an entry point was forwarded with a guessed signature, which misreads floating point arguments" >&2
    exit 1
fi

blocks=$(printf '%s' "$output" | sed -n 's/^\[launcher\] guest blocks: \([0-9]*\) total, \([0-9]*\) translated, \([0-9]*\) interpreted, \([0-9]*\) traps hit$/\1 \2 \3 \4/p' | tail -1)
if [ -z "$blocks" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the launcher reported no translation summary" >&2
    exit 1
fi

set -- $blocks
totalBlocks="$1"
translatedBlocks="$2"
interpretedBlocks="$3"
trapsHit="$4"

if [ "$totalBlocks" -lt 1 ] || [ "$translatedBlocks" -lt 1 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: no guest code was translated, so nothing arm64 ran" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$interpretedBlocks" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $interpretedBlocks block(s) fell back to the interpreter" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$trapsHit" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $trapsHit trap(s) were hit in translated code" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: the guest cleared and read back its own colour and swapped $hostFrames frames through the host OpenGL ES driver in $translatedBlocks translated block(s), 0 interpreted"

```

`tools/run-guest-jni-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
tier="${2:-t0}"
apk="$PROJ_DIR/tests/app-debug.apk"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"
SKIP_EXIT_CODE=77

binary="$buildDir/src/JniBridgeGateTest"
shim="$buildDir/src/libaclguest.so"

for artifact in "$binary" "$shim"; do
    if [ ! -e "$artifact" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $artifact is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if [ ! -f "$apk" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $apk is missing - it is the milestone's fixture" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

mkdir -p "$work/guest" "$work/shim"

if ! unzip -o -q -j "$apk" 'lib/arm64-v8a/libhelloworld.so' -d "$work/guest"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $apk does not carry lib/arm64-v8a/libhelloworld.so" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! file -b "$work/guest/libhelloworld.so" | grep -q "ARM aarch64"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the extracted library is not an aarch64 ELF, so this gate would prove nothing" >&2
    file -b "$work/guest/libhelloworld.so" >&2
    exit 1
fi

cp "$shim" "$work/shim/libhelloworld.so"

if file -b "$work/shim/libhelloworld.so" | grep -q "ARM aarch64"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the staged shim is an aarch64 ELF - host ART must be able to dlopen it" >&2
    exit 1
fi

output=$("$binary" "$hostRoot" "$apk" "$work/guest" "$work/shim" --tier "$tier" 2>&1)
status=$?

echo "$output"

contains()
{
    if [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -c -- "$1")" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: expected to see \"$1\"" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the harness exited $status" >&2
    exit 1
fi

contains "PASS System.loadLibrary routed one arm64 library into the guest runtime" || exit 1
contains "PASS guest JNI_OnLoad ran exactly once, driven by System.loadLibrary" || exit 1
contains "PASS guest JNI_OnLoad returned JNI_VERSION_1_6" || exit 1
contains "PASS __sF resolved to guest data, not to an executable stub" || exit 1
contains "PASS RegisterNatives bound exactly one method into host ART" || exit 1
contains "PASS the guest reached host JNI through the guest-visible vtable" || exit 1
contains "PASS the whole round trip touched no unimplemented JNI slot" || exit 1
contains 'stringFromJNI() returned "Hello World from C++"' || exit 1
contains "PASS arm64 guest code called back into Java" || exit 1
contains "guest-jni-gate PASSED" || exit 1

echo "gate PASSED: an arm64 .so from an APK did JNI in both directions and returned Hello World from C++"
```

`tools/run-guest-libc-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
tier="${2:-t0}"
SRC_DIR="$PROJ_DIR/tests/guestlib/src"

SDK_DIR="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"
API_LEVEL="${API_LEVEL:-34}"
NDK_VERSION="${NDK_VERSION:-29.0.14206865}"
SKIP_EXIT_CODE=77

NDK_DIR="$SDK_DIR/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
CLANG="$NDK_DIR/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android${API_LEVEL}-clang"
binary="$buildDir/src/GuestLibHostCallTest"

if [ ! -x "$CLANG" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: NDK $NDK_VERSION not installed" >&2
    exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE
fi

if [ ! -x "$binary" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $binary is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
    exit 1
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

contains() {
    grep -c -- "$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null | head -1
}

GUEST_ARCH="${GUEST_ARCH:-armv8.2-a+lse+rcpc}"

"$CLANG" -O2 -fPIC -shared -march="$GUEST_ARCH" -Wl,-soname,libhello.so -o "$work/libhello.so" "$SRC_DIR/hello.c" || exit 1

"$binary" --guest "$work/libhello.so" --tier "$tier" > "$work/guest.txt" 2> "$work/guest.log"
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    cat "$work/guest.log" >&2
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest run aborted" >&2
    exit 1
fi

recompiled=$(sed -n 's/.*guest: \([0-9]*\) blocks recompiled.*/\1/p' "$work/guest.log" | head -1)
recompiled="${recompiled:-0}"

native=$(sed -n 's/.*, \([0-9]*\) block entries executed natively.*/\1/p' "$work/guest.log" | head -1)
native="${native:-0}"

if [ "$tier" = "t1" ]; then
    if [ "$recompiled" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: --tier t1 was accepted but nothing was recompiled - the tier did nothing" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    if [ "$native" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $recompiled blocks were recompiled but none executed natively - the dispatcher never used T1" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "  tier t1: $recompiled blocks recompiled, $native executed natively"
elif [ "$recompiled" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: no tier was requested but $recompiled blocks were recompiled" >&2
    exit 1
fi

"$binary" --host > "$work/host.txt" || exit 1

if ! diff -u "$work/host.txt" "$work/guest.txt"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: guest output differs from the same C compiled for the host" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "  $(wc -l < "$work/guest.txt") lines identical to the host build"

if [ "$(contains "$work/guest.txt" 'guest: main counter 1000')" -ne 1 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the main thread lost its thread-local across the guest threads" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$(contains "$work/guest.txt" 'counter 1000')" -ne 1 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: a guest thread saw the main thread's thread-local - TLS is not per-thread" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$(contains "$work/guest.txt" 'guest: thread ')" -ne 4 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: not every guest thread reported" >&2
    exit 1
fi

"$CLANG" -O2 -fPIC -shared -march="$GUEST_ARCH" -Wl,-soname,libhello.so -Wl,--pack-dyn-relocs=android \
    -o "$work/libhello-packed.so" "$SRC_DIR/hello.c" || exit 1

"$binary" --guest "$work/libhello-packed.so" --tier "$tier" > "$work/packed.txt" 2> "$work/packed.log"
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    cat "$work/packed.log" >&2
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest library with Android packed relocations aborted" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! diff -u "$work/host.txt" "$work/packed.txt"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: packed relocations were not applied the way plain ones are" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "  the same library with Android packed relocations behaves identically"

echo "gate PASSED: an ARM64 .so called printf, malloc and pthread_create under $tier"

```

```sh

set -uo pipefail

hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"

    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if [ ! -f "$frameworkRes" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no SDK platform android.jar at '$frameworkRes'" >&2
    exit 77

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ] && [ -z "${WAYLAND_SOCKET:-}" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no Wayland compositor in the environment, so nothing can be presented to" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if [ ! -e "/usr/lib/libvulkan.so.1" ] && [ ! -e "/usr/lib64/libvulkan.so.1" ] && ! ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null | grep -q "libvulkan.so.1"; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no host Vulkan loader, so the guest's calls have nowhere to go" >&2
    exit 77
fi

dataRoot="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$dataRoot"' EXIT

output=$(timeout 180 "$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --framework-res "$frameworkRes" \
    --data-root "$dataRoot" \
    --activity "$activityClass" \
    --guest-env "TRIANGLE_FRAMES=$frames" \
    "$apk" 2>&1)

printf '%s' "$output" | grep -vE 'presented frame [0-9]+$'

contains()
{
    printf '%s' "$2" | grep -F -- "$1" > /dev/null
}

if ! contains "[vulkanwsi] the guest asked for VK_KHR_android_surface; the host is being asked for VK_KHR_wayland_surface" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the surface extension was not translated, so the guest asked the host for an Android extension" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "[vulkanwsi] the guest window surface is a real compositor surface" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: vkCreateAndroidSurfaceKHR was not translated into a real compositor surface" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "[guest triangle] pipeline created" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest never built a graphics pipeline, so nothing was rasterised" >&2
    exit 1
fi

presented=$(printf '%s' "$output" | grep -cE '^\[guest triangle\] presented frame [0-9]+$')
if [ "$presented" -ne "$frames" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest presented $presented frames, not $frames" >&2
    exit 1
fi

hostPresented=$(printf '%s' "$output" | sed -n 's/.*the host driver presented \([0-9]*\) guest frame.*/\1/p' | head -1)
if [ -z "$hostPresented" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the host side did not report how many frames it presented" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$hostPresented" -ne "$frames" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest claims $frames frames but the host driver presented $hostPresented - the guest's own count is not evidence" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "[guest triangle] presented frame $((frames - 1))" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest did not reach the last frame it was asked for" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "[guest triangle] triangle finished" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest did not finish cleanly" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "I/Bootstrap: the guest finished presenting" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the framework did not observe the guest finishing; it timed out or the window closed first" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for callback in onNativeWindowDestroyed onPause onStop onDestroy; do
    if ! contains "[nativeactivity] $callback" "$output"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $callback never reached the guest, so it could not tear down" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

blocks=$(printf '%s' "$output" | grep -o '\[launcher\] guest blocks: .*' | head -1)
if [ -z "$blocks" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the launcher did not report how the guest ran" >&2
    exit 1
fi

translated=$(printf '%s' "$blocks" | sed -n 's/.*: \([0-9]*\) total, \([0-9]*\) translated, \([0-9]*\) interpreted, \([0-9]*\) traps.*/\2/p')
interpreted=$(printf '%s' "$blocks" | sed -n 's/.*: \([0-9]*\) total, \([0-9]*\) translated, \([0-9]*\) interpreted, \([0-9]*\) traps.*/\3/p')
traps=$(printf '%s' "$blocks" | sed -n 's/.*: \([0-9]*\) total, \([0-9]*\) translated, \([0-9]*\) interpreted, \([0-9]*\) traps.*/\4/p')

if [ -z "$translated" ] || [ "$translated" -lt 1 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: nothing was translated, so the guest cannot have run as translated arm64" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$interpreted" != "0" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $interpreted block(s) were interpreted - this milestone claims translated arm64, not interpretation" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$traps" != "0" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $traps trap(s) were hit, so the guest ran into something we cannot translate" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if contains "unimplemented symbol" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest called a symbol we do not implement" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if contains "guest allocation callbacks" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest supplied Vulkan allocation callbacks, which this path refuses rather than mishandles" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: the guest presented $frames frames through the host Vulkan driver in $translated translated block(s), 0 interpreted"
```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$buildDir/tests/graphics/graphics.apk}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
if [ ! -d "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no XDG_RUNTIME_DIR at '$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
westonPid=""

cleanup()
{
    if [ -n "$westonPid" ]; then kill "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; wait "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; fi
    rm -rf "$work"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if command -v weston >/dev/null; then
    socket="acl-interaction-$$"
    weston --backend=headless --socket="$socket" --width=640 --height=480 --idle-time=0 \
        > "$work/weston.log" 2>&1 &
    westonPid=$!

    for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
        [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ] && break
        sleep 0.1
    done

    if [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ]; then
        export WAYLAND_DISPLAY="$socket"
    elif [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
        echo "gate SKIPPED: weston failed and there is no session compositor" >&2
        exit 77
    fi
elif [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no weston and no WAYLAND_DISPLAY" >&2
    exit 77
fi

output=$(timeout 120 "$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$work/data" \
    --activity com.example.graphics.InteractionActivity \
    --no-continuous-frames \
    --max-frames 400 \
    --window 400x300 \
    "$apk" 2>&1)
status=$?

echo "$output"

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: launcher exited $status" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in \
    "I/Interaction: InteractionActivity.onCreate package=com.example.graphics" \
    "I/Interaction: draws before any input: 3" \
    "I/Interaction: first target touched=true focused=true" \
    "I/Interaction: second target focused=true first still focused=false" \
    "I/Interaction: the panel saw 2 pointers at once" \
    "I/Interaction: the panel saw a cancel=true" \
    "I/Interaction: the field is a text editor=true focused=true" \
    "I/Interaction: input started for the field=true" \
    "I/Interaction: the field now reads 'hi 5'" \
    "I/Interaction: after a delete it reads 'hi '" \
    "I/Interaction: moving focus away left the field focused=false" \
    "I/Interaction: the animation started running=true" \
    "I/Interaction: the animation stepped more than once=true and finished at 100" \
    "I/Interaction: the animation is still running=false" \
    "I/Interaction: an invalidate produced 1 more draw" \
    "I/Interaction: final draw count 4" \
    "I/ViewRootImpl: nothing is dirty"
do
    if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -qF "$expected"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: missing '$expected'" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if printf '%s' "$output" | grep -qF "frame limit reached"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the loop kept drawing until the frame limit rather than going idle" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: drawing follows invalidation, touches reach a view, focus moves, and the loop idles"
```

`tools/run-jit-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$PROJ_DIR/tests/app-debug.apk}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"
frameworkRes="${RUNTIME_FRAMEWORK_RES-${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}/platforms/android-34/android.jar}"

activityClass="android.app.NativeActivity"
guestFrames=3

if [ -z "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT is set but empty - that is a misconfiguration, not an absent prerequisite" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if [ ! -f "$frameworkRes" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no SDK platform android.jar at '$frameworkRes'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if ! unzip -l "$apk" | grep -E ' lib/arm64-v8a/libtriangle\.so$' > /dev/null; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $apk does not carry the arm64 native activity fixture" >&2
    exit 1
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

contains()
{
    printf '%s' "$2" | grep -qF -- "$1"
}

run()
{
    local name="$1"
    shift

    mkdir -p "$work/$name/data" "$work/$name/cache"

    "$launcher" \
        --host-root "$hostRoot" \
        --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
        --framework-res "$frameworkRes" \
        --data-root "$work/$name/data" \
        --cache-root "$work/$name/cache" \
        --activity "$activityClass" \
        --max-frames 2 \
        --guest-env "TRIANGLE_FRAMES=$guestFrames" \
        --no-strict \
        --jit \
        "$@" \
        "$apk" 2>&1
}

field()
{
    printf '%s' "$2" | grep -o "$1" | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | head -1
}

check_common()
{
    local name="$1"
    local output="$2"
    local status="$3"

    if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "$output"
        echo "gate FAILED: $name: the launcher exited $status" >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    if contains "ahead of time at" "$output" || contains "[acl] translating" "$output" || contains "translated in" "$output"; then
        echo "$output"
        echo "gate FAILED: $name: a library was translated ahead of time under --jit" >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    if [ -n "$(find "$work/$name/cache" -name '*.o' -o -name '*.so' 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]; then
        echo "$output"
        echo "gate FAILED: $name: translated objects were written to the cache under --jit" >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    if ! contains "nothing is translated ahead of time" "$output"; then
        echo "$output"
        echo "gate FAILED: $name: the launcher did not announce the run-time compiler" >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    if ! contains "[guest triangle] presented frame $((guestFrames - 1))" "$output"; then
        echo "$output"
        echo "gate FAILED: $name: the guest did not present all $guestFrames frames" >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    if contains "Exception in thread" "$output" || contains "NoSuchMethodError" "$output"; then
        echo "$output"
        echo "gate FAILED: $name: the guest or the framework threw" >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    if [ "$(field '[0-9][0-9]* translated, ' "$output")" != "0" ]; then
        echo "$output"
        echo "gate FAILED: $name: blocks ran from ahead-of-time translations under --jit" >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    if [ "$(field '[0-9][0-9]* traps hit' "$output")" != "0" ]; then
        echo "$output"
        echo "gate FAILED: $name: traps were hit while the activity ran" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
}

hot=$(run hot --setting jit-threshold=0)
hotStatus=$?
check_common hot "$hot" "$hotStatus"

if ! contains "compiled on a background thread" "$hot"; then
    echo "$hot"
    echo "gate FAILED: hot: the run-time compiler did not default to a background thread" >&2
    exit 1
fi

hotRegions=$(field 'jit: [0-9][0-9]* region' "$hot")
hotNative=$(field '[0-9][0-9]* entries ran compiled' "$hot")

if [ -z "$hotRegions" ] || [ "$hotRegions" -lt 1 ] || [ -z "$hotNative" ] || [ "$hotNative" -lt 1 ]; then
    echo "$hot"
    echo "gate FAILED: hot: with a threshold of 0 nothing was compiled at run time, or nothing ran compiled" >&2
    exit 1
fi

inline=$(run inline --setting jit-threshold=0 --setting jit-background=0)
inlineStatus=$?
check_common inline "$inline" "$inlineStatus"

inlineRegions=$(field 'jit: [0-9][0-9]* region' "$inline")
inlineBlocks=$(field 'covering [0-9][0-9]* block' "$inline")
inlineInterpreted=$(field '[0-9][0-9]* interpreted' "$inline")

if [ -z "$inlineRegions" ] || [ "$inlineRegions" -lt 1 ] || [ "$inlineInterpreted" != "0" ]; then
    echo "$inline"
    echo "gate FAILED: inline: compiling on first use still left blocks to the interpreter" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ -z "$inlineBlocks" ] || [ "$inlineBlocks" -le "$inlineRegions" ]; then
    echo "$inline"
    echo "gate FAILED: inline: each region covered a single block, so regions are not being formed" >&2
    exit 1
fi

cold=$(run cold)
coldStatus=$?
check_common cold "$cold" "$coldStatus"

coldInterpreted=$(field '[0-9][0-9]* interpreted' "$cold")

if [ -z "$coldInterpreted" ] || [ "$coldInterpreted" -lt 1 ]; then
    echo "$cold"
    echo "gate FAILED: cold: with the default threshold no cold block was interpreted" >&2
    exit 1
fi

refused=$("$launcher" --jit --require-translated "$apk" 2>&1)
refusedStatus=$?

if [ "$refusedStatus" -eq 0 ] || ! contains "cannot also require every block to be translated" "$refused"; then
    echo "$refused"
    echo "gate FAILED: --jit with --require-translated was not refused" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: --jit translated nothing ahead of time, interpreted cold code, and compiled $inlineRegions region(s) covering $inlineBlocks block(s) at run time"
```

`tools/run-jni-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$buildDir/tests/jni/jni.apk}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"

if [ -z "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT is set but empty - that is a misconfiguration, not an absent prerequisite" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if ! unzip -l "$apk" 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'lib/x86_64/libacljni\.so' > /dev/null; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $apk does not carry lib/x86_64/libacljni.so - the gate would prove nothing" >&2
    exit 1
fi

dataRoot="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$dataRoot"' EXIT

contains()
{
    case "$2" in
        *"$1"*) return 0 ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
}

matches()
{
    printf '%s' "$2" | grep -cE "$1" > /dev/null
}

run()
{
    "$launcher" \
        --host-root "$hostRoot" \
        --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
        --data-root "$dataRoot" \
        --no-activity \
        "$@" \
        "$apk" 2>&1
}

output=$(run)
status=$?

echo "$output"

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: launcher exited $status" >&2
    exit 1
fi

libraryDir="$dataRoot/com.example.jni/lib"
if [ ! -f "$libraryDir/libacljni.so" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the native library was not extracted to $libraryDir" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in \
    "[launcher] extracted 1 x86_64 native library to $libraryDir" \
    "I/Jni: nativeLibraryDir=/data/app/~~" \
    "/com.example.jni-" \
    "[acljni] JNI_OnLoad registered 8 methods" \
    "I/Jni: loadLibrary acljni returned" \
    "I/Jni: registered upcall = 42" \
    "I/Jni: mangled upcall = 101" \
    "I/Jni: string round trip = [acl-native]" \
    "I/Jni: instance upcall = 42" \
    "I/Jni: array sum = 10 mutated = [11, 12, 13, 14]" \
    "I/Jni: field bump = 7 field = 12" \
    "I/Jni: caught java exception = refused 9" \
    "I/Jni: caught native exception = native refused 3" \
    "I/Jni: attached thread upcall = 22" \
    "I/Jni: openFd stored.bin length=38 offset=true read=38 text=stored payload for the descriptor path" \
    "I/Jni: openFd deflated.txt refused: deflated.txt is compressed in the archive, so it has no file descriptor" \
    "I/Jni: openFd absent.bin refused" \
    "I/Jni: descriptor fd balance = 0" \
    "I/Jni: conformance complete"
do
    if ! contains "$expected" "$output"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: missing '$expected'" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if matches 'unimplemented|Exception in thread|NoSuchMethodError|NoClassDefFoundError' "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: a strict guard fired or the guest threw" >&2
    exit 1
fi

checked=$(run --trace jni)
checkedStatus=$?

if [ "$checkedStatus" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "$checked"
    echo "gate FAILED: the conformance harness exited $checkedStatus under -Xcheck:jni" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "I/Jni: conformance complete" "$checked"; then
    echo "$checked"
    echo "gate FAILED: the conformance harness did not complete under -Xcheck:jni" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if matches 'JNI DETECTED ERROR|WARNING in native method' "$checked"; then
    echo "$checked"
    echo "gate FAILED: -Xcheck:jni reported a JNI misuse" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "[jni] extracted libacljni.so" "$checked"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: --trace jni did not report the extraction" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "[jni] vm option -Xcheck:jni" "$checked"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the second pass did not actually pass -Xcheck:jni to the VM" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if contains "[jni] vm option -Xcheck:jni" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the first pass passed -Xcheck:jni, so the two passes are not distinct" >&2
    exit 1
fi

printf 'corrupted' | dd of="$libraryDir/libacljni.so" bs=1 seek=64 conv=notrunc status=none

repaired=$(run)
repairedStatus=$?
if [ "$repairedStatus" -ne 0 ] || ! contains "I/Jni: conformance complete" "$repaired"; then
    echo "$repaired"
    echo "gate FAILED: a corrupted native library was not re-extracted" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! cmp -s "$libraryDir/libacljni.so" "$buildDir/tests/jni/jnilibs/x86_64/libacljni.so"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the re-extracted library does not match the one that was packaged" >&2
    exit 1
fi

refusedRoot="$(mktemp -d)"
refused=$("$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$refusedRoot" \
    --no-activity \
    --abi arm64-v8a \
    "$apk" 2>&1)
refusedStatus=$?
rm -rf "$refusedRoot"

if [ "$refusedStatus" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "$refused"
    echo "gate FAILED: an unrunnable ABI was reported as success" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$refusedStatus" -ge 128 ]; then
    echo "$refused"
    echo "gate FAILED: an unrunnable ABI killed the process with signal $((refusedStatus - 128)) instead of being refused" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "has no arm64-v8a native library (it ships: x86_64)" "$refused"; then
    echo "$refused"
    echo "gate FAILED: the refusal did not name the ABI the archive actually ships" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "java.lang.UnsatisfiedLinkError" "$refused"; then
    echo "$refused"
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest did not see an UnsatisfiedLinkError" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: an x86_64 .so out of an APK did JNI in both directions on real ART"
```

`tools/run-layout-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$PROJ_DIR/tests/app-debug.apk}"
golden="${3:-$PROJ_DIR/tests/window/appdebug-golden.raw}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"
frameworkRes="${RUNTIME_FRAMEWORK_RES-${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}/platforms/android-34/android.jar}"

if [ -z "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT is set but empty - that is a misconfiguration, not an absent prerequisite" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if [ -z "$frameworkRes" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: RUNTIME_FRAMEWORK_RES is set but empty - that is a misconfiguration, not an absent prerequisite" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -e "$frameworkRes" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no framework resources at '$frameworkRes'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk" "$golden"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
if [ ! -d "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no XDG_RUNTIME_DIR at '$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
westonPid=""

cleanup()
{
    if [ -n "$westonPid" ]; then kill "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; wait "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; fi
    rm -rf "$work"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if command -v weston >/dev/null; then
    socket="acl-m2b-$$"
    weston --backend=headless --socket="$socket" --width=640 --height=960 --idle-time=0 > "$work/weston.log" 2>&1 &
    westonPid=$!

    for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
        [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ] && break
        sleep 0.1
    done

    if [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ]; then
        export WAYLAND_DISPLAY="$socket"
    else
        echo "note: headless weston did not come up" >&2
        sed -n '1,10p' "$work/weston.log" >&2
        kill "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null
        westonPid=""

        if [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
            echo "gate SKIPPED: weston failed and there is no session compositor" >&2
            exit 77
        fi
        echo "note: falling back to the session compositor $WAYLAND_DISPLAY" >&2
    fi
elif [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no weston and no WAYLAND_DISPLAY" >&2
    exit 77
fi

output=$(timeout 180 "$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --framework-res "$frameworkRes" \
    --data-root "$work/data" \
    --max-frames 1 \
    --window 420x880 \
    --trace views,resources \
    --require-translated \
    --frame-dump "$work/frame.raw" \
    "$apk" 2>&1)
status=$?

echo "$output"

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: launcher exited $status" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q '^\[resources\] framework package: '; then
    echo "gate FAILED: framework resources were not loaded" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q '^\[resources\] 0x7f0f001b -> "androidx.startup"$'; then
    echo 'gate FAILED: getString(0x7f0f001b) did not resolve to "androidx.startup"' >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q '^I/Bootstrap: activity theme: 0x7f1002ae$'; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the manifest's application theme was not applied" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in \
    "I/ViewRootImpl: android.view.DecorView id=0xffffffff bounds=0,0-420,880" \
    "androidx.appcompat.widget.FitWindowsLinearLayout id=0x7f080037 bounds=0,0-420,880" \
    "androidx.appcompat.widget.ContentFrameLayout id=0x1020002 bounds=0,0-420,880" \
    "androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout id=0x7f0800ff bounds=0,0-420,880" \
    "androidx.appcompat.widget.AppCompatTextView id=0x7f08013f bounds=145,432-276,448"
do
    if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -qF "$expected"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: hierarchy missing '$expected'" >&2
        echo "the hierarchy it did report:" >&2
        printf '%s' "$output" | grep -F "I/ViewRootImpl:" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q '^I/Bootstrap: main loop finished after 1 frames$'; then
    echo "gate FAILED: no frame was drawn" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -s "$work/frame.raw" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: no frame was dumped" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -qE '^\[launcher\] guest blocks: [0-9]+ total, [0-9]+ translated, 0 interpreted, 0 traps hit$'; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest library did not run fully ahead-of-time translated" >&2
    printf '%s' "$output" | grep -F "[launcher] guest blocks:" >&2
    exit 1
fi

guestBlocks=$(printf '%s' "$output" | sed -n 's/^\[launcher\] guest blocks: \([0-9]*\) total.*/\1/p')
if [ "${guestBlocks:-0}" -lt 10 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: only ${guestBlocks:-0} guest blocks ran, so the translation assertion above proves nothing" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "${RUNTIME_REGENERATE_GOLDEN:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    cp "$work/frame.raw" "$golden"
    echo "regenerated $golden - review the diff, it should be confined to the nativeText run of pixels"
    exit 0
fi

if ! cmp -s "$work/frame.raw" "$golden"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the rendered frame differs from $golden" >&2
    echo "note: this golden contains anti-aliased glyphs and is only reproducible against the" >&2
    echo "      FreeType and font recorded in tests/text/text-golden.raw.provenance" >&2
    cmp "$work/frame.raw" "$golden" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: app-debug.apk inflated its ConstraintLayout and rendered it"
```

`tools/run-lifecycle-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$PROJ_DIR/tests/app-debug.apk}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"

if [ -z "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT is set but empty - that is a misconfiguration, not an absent prerequisite" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

dataRoot="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$dataRoot"' EXIT

contains()
{
    case "$2" in
        *"$1"*) return 0 ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
}

run()
{
    "$launcher" \
        --host-root "$hostRoot" \
        --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
        --data-root "$dataRoot" \
        --window 1080x2400 \
        --density 440 \
        "$@" \
        "$apk" 2>&1
}

echo "=== first run: cold create, a configuration change, then a stop that saves"

first="$(run --max-frames 200 --reconfigure "120:2400x1080@440")"
firstStatus=$?

if [ "$firstStatus" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the first run exited $firstStatus" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$first" | tail -30 >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in \
    "I/LifecycleProbe: no retained instance, this is a cold create" \
    "I/LifecycleProbe: created with no saved state, this is the first visit" \
    "I/Configurations: the configuration changed: orientation screenSize" \
    "I/LifecycleProbe: handled the configuration change at 872x392 dp, orientation 2" \
    "I/LifecycleProbe: saving visits=1" \
    "I/Activities: the state of com.reveny.helloworld.MainActivity is on disk, so it survives the process"
do
    if ! contains "$expected" "$first"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: the first run is missing '$expected'" >&2
        printf '%s\n' "$first" | grep -E "LifecycleProbe|Configurations|Activities" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if contains "I/Configurations: 0 activity(ies) declared they handle it" "$first"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: MainActivity declares configChanges, so the change must not have forced a recreation" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "=== the same run, recreated on request: the instance is retained and the state comes back"

for expected in \
    "I/LifecycleProbe: asking to be recreated now that the configuration settled" \
    "I/LifecycleProbe: retaining generation 1 across the recreation" \
    "I/Activities: recreated com.reveny.helloworld.MainActivity with" \
    "I/LifecycleProbe: the instance survived the recreation, generation 1" \
    "I/LifecycleProbe: restored visits=1 note=carried-across-the-process ratio=0.625 tags=alpha,beta"
do
    if ! contains "$expected" "$first"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: the recreation is missing '$expected'" >&2
        printf '%s\n' "$first" | grep -E "LifecycleProbe|Configurations|Activities" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

stateFile="$(find "$dataRoot" -name 'saved-state-com.reveny.helloworld.MainActivity.bin' -print -quit)"
if [ -z "$stateFile" ] || [ ! -s "$stateFile" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: no saved state was written under $dataRoot" >&2
    find "$dataRoot" -name 'saved-state*' >&2
    exit 1
fi

firstStateMarker="$(cksum < "$stateFile") $(stat -c %s "$stateFile")"

echo "=== second run: the process is gone, the state is not"

second="$(run --max-frames 60)"
secondStatus=$?

if [ "$secondStatus" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the second run exited $secondStatus" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$second" | tail -30 >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in \
    "comes back with the state it left behind" \
    "I/LifecycleProbe: restored visits=1 note=carried-across-the-process ratio=0.625 tags=alpha,beta"
do
    if ! contains "$expected" "$second"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: the second run is missing '$expected'" >&2
        printf '%s\n' "$second" | grep -E "LifecycleProbe|Activities" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if contains "I/LifecycleProbe: created with no saved state" "$second"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the second run created cold, so the state did not survive" >&2
    exit 1
fi

restores="$(printf '%s\n' "$second" | grep -c "comes back with the state it left behind")"
if [ "$restores" -ne 1 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the state was restored $restores times, expected exactly once - restoring must consume the file" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -s "$stateFile" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the second run consumed the state but did not write its own, so the cycle does not repeat" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$(cksum < "$stateFile") $(stat -c %s "$stateFile")" = "$firstStateMarker" ]; then
    echo "note: the second run wrote a byte-identical state, which is expected for an idempotent save"
fi

echo "note: the state crossed a real process boundary - the first launcher had exited before the second started"

echo "gate PASSED: state is written at stop and restored on the next launch, and a declared configuration change is handled in place"
```
