`tools/run-native-activity-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$PROJ_DIR/tests/app-debug.apk}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"
frameworkRes="${RUNTIME_FRAMEWORK_RES-${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}/platforms/android-34/android.jar}"

activityClass="android.app.NativeActivity"
windowWidth=1080
windowHeight=2400

if [ -z "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT is set but empty - that is a misconfiguration, not an absent prerequisite" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if [ ! -f "$frameworkRes" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no SDK platform android.jar at '$frameworkRes'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

listing=$(unzip -l "$apk")

if ! printf '%s' "$listing" | grep -E ' lib/arm64-v8a/libtriangle\.so$' > /dev/null; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $apk does not carry the arm64 native activity fixture" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if printf '%s' "$listing" | grep -E ' lib/(x86|x86_64|armeabi-v7a)/' > /dev/null; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $apk carries a library this gate must not be able to run natively" >&2
    exit 1
fi

dataRoot="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$dataRoot"' EXIT

output=$("$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --framework-res "$frameworkRes" \
    --data-root "$dataRoot" \
    --activity "$activityClass" \
    --window "${windowWidth}x${windowHeight}" \
    --max-frames 2 \
    --guest-env "TRIANGLE_FRAMES=3" \
    "$apk" 2>&1)

echo "$output"

contains()
{
    printf '%s' "$2" | grep -qF -- "$1"
}

if ! contains "activity selected by --activity: $activityClass" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $activityClass was not the activity that launched" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "I/NativeActivity: native library: triangle" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the android.app.lib_name meta-data did not reach the framework" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "[nativeactivity] ANativeActivity_onCreate ran and registered" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest entry point did not run" >&2
    exit 1
fi

registered=$(printf '%s' "$output" | sed -n 's/.*ANativeActivity_onCreate ran and registered \([0-9]*\) callback.*/\1/p' | head -1)
if [ -z "$registered" ] || [ "$registered" -lt 1 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest registered no callbacks, so nothing could be dispatched back into it" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for callback in onStart onResume onNativeWindowCreated; do
    if ! contains "[nativeactivity] $callback" "$output"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $callback was never dispatched into the guest" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if ! contains "[nativeactivity] the guest window is ${windowWidth}x${windowHeight}" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the activity was not handed a window" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "[guest triangle] native window created ${windowWidth}x${windowHeight}" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest did not read the window back at the size we published" >&2
    exit 1
fi

blocks=$(printf '%s' "$output" | grep -o '\[launcher\] guest blocks: .*' | head -1)
if [ -z "$blocks" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the launcher did not report how the guest ran" >&2
    exit 1
fi

translated=$(printf '%s' "$blocks" | sed -n 's/.*: \([0-9]*\) total, \([0-9]*\) translated, \([0-9]*\) interpreted, \([0-9]*\) traps.*/\2/p')
interpreted=$(printf '%s' "$blocks" | sed -n 's/.*: \([0-9]*\) total, \([0-9]*\) translated, \([0-9]*\) interpreted, \([0-9]*\) traps.*/\3/p')
traps=$(printf '%s' "$blocks" | sed -n 's/.*: \([0-9]*\) total, \([0-9]*\) translated, \([0-9]*\) interpreted, \([0-9]*\) traps.*/\4/p')

if [ -z "$translated" ] || [ "$translated" -lt 1 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: nothing was translated, so the activity cannot have run as translated arm64" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$interpreted" != "0" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $interpreted block(s) were interpreted - this milestone claims translation, not interpretation" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$traps" != "0" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $traps trap(s) were hit while the activity ran" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if contains "Exception in thread" "$output" || contains "NoSuchMethodError" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest or the framework threw" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: $activityClass ran $translated translated block(s), registered $registered callback(s), and drew on a ${windowWidth}x${windowHeight} window"
```

`tools/run-ordering-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
tier="${2:-t0}"
SRC_DIR="$PROJ_DIR/tests/ordering/src"

SDK_DIR="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"
API_LEVEL="${API_LEVEL:-34}"
NDK_VERSION="${NDK_VERSION:-29.0.14206865}"
GUEST_ARCH="${GUEST_ARCH:-armv8.2-a+lse+rcpc}"
ITERATIONS="${ORDERING_ITERATIONS:-150000}"
ATTEMPTS="${ORDERING_ATTEMPTS:-4}"
SKIP_EXIT_CODE=77

NDK_DIR="$SDK_DIR/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
CLANG="$NDK_DIR/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android${API_LEVEL}-clang"
binary="$buildDir/src/OrderingGateTest"

if [ ! -x "$binary" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $binary is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -x "$CLANG" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: NDK $NDK_VERSION not installed" >&2
    exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

"$CLANG" -O2 -fPIC -shared -march="$GUEST_ARCH" -Wl,-soname,libordering.so \
         -o "$work/libordering.so" "$SRC_DIR/ordering.c" || exit 1

attempt=1
iterations="$ITERATIONS"
status=$SKIP_EXIT_CODE

while [ "$attempt" -le "$ATTEMPTS" ]; do
    if [ "$attempt" -gt 1 ]; then
        echo "  no reachable counterexample at $((iterations / 4)) iterations - escalating to $iterations" >&2
    fi

    "$binary" "$work/libordering.so" "$iterations" --tier "$tier"
    status=$?

    if [ "$status" -ne $SKIP_EXIT_CODE ]; then
        break
    fi

    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    iterations=$((iterations * 4))
done

if [ "$status" -eq $SKIP_EXIT_CODE ]; then
    if [ "$tier" = "t1" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: under T1 the guest's accesses become adjacent host instructions, so store buffering must be" >&2
        echo "reachable. After $ATTEMPTS escalating attempts it was not - either the litmus blocks were not recompiled" >&2
        echo "or the harness stopped interleaving, and either way this gate is blind." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "gate SKIPPED: no reachable counterexample under the current tier - see the diagnostic above" >&2
    exit $SKIP_EXIT_CODE
fi

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: a guest memory-ordering guarantee was violated under acl" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: guest memory ordering holds under acl"

```

`tools/run-overlay-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$PROJ_DIR/tests/app-debug.apk}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

width=2400

pixelAt()
{
    local file="$1"
    local x="$2"
    local y="$3"
    local offset=$(((y * width + x) * 4))

    od -An -tu1 -j "$offset" -N 4 "$file" | tr -s ' ' | sed 's/^ //;s/ $//'
}

insideY=15
aboveY=2

rowBytes()
{
    local file="$1"
    local y="$2"
    local offset=$(((y * width) * 4))

    od -An -tu1 -j "$offset" -N $((300 * 4)) "$file" | tr -s ' \n' ' '
}

checkPanel()
{
    local file="$1"
    local what="$2"
    local background="$3"
    local textPixel="$4"

    if [ ! -s "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $what wrote no frame to $file" >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    local inside
    inside="$(pixelAt "$file" 8 "$insideY")"

    if [ "$inside" != "$background" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $what has no counter panel at 8,$insideY - got '$inside', expected '$background'" >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    local found=0
    local y
    for y in $(seq 12 1 30); do
        if rowBytes "$file" "$y" | grep -qF " $textPixel "; then
            found=1
            break
        fi
    done

    if [ "$found" -ne 1 ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $what drew a panel with no glyph pixels in it, so the text never rendered" >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "note: $what has the panel at 8,$insideY and inked glyph pixels on row $y"
}

echo "=== the framework path: the counter is drawn over the view tree"

"$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$work/framework" \
    --max-frames 150 \
    --frame-dump "$work/framework.raw" \
    --landscape --fps "$apk" > "$work/framework.log" 2>&1

if [ ! -s "$work/framework.raw" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the framework run produced no frame" >&2
    tail -20 "$work/framework.log" >&2
    exit 1
fi

checkPanel "$work/framework.raw" "the framework frame" "56 53 54 255" "244 240 236 255"

above="$(pixelAt "$work/framework.raw" 8 "$aboveY")"
if [ "$above" = "56 53 54 255" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the panel reaches above its own margin, so it is not positioned where it claims" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "=== the same app without --fps: nothing is drawn over it"

"$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$work/plain" \
    --max-frames 150 \
    --frame-dump "$work/plain.raw" \
    --landscape "$apk" > "$work/plain.log" 2>&1

if [ ! -s "$work/plain.raw" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the run without --fps produced no frame" >&2
    exit 1
fi

plainInside="$(pixelAt "$work/plain.raw" 8 "$insideY")"
if [ "$plainInside" = "56 53 54 255" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the counter was drawn without --fps being asked for" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "note: without --fps that pixel is '$plainInside', the app's own"

echo "=== the guest Vulkan path: the counter is copied into the guest's own swapchain image"

"$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$work/guest" \
    --activity android.app.NativeActivity \
    --guest-frame-dump "$work/guest.raw" \
    --landscape --fps "$apk" > "$work/guest.log" 2>&1

if ! grep -qF "the frame counter draws into the guest's own frames" "$work/guest.log"; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: this driver would not take the counter into the guest's frames" >&2
    grep -i overlay "$work/guest.log" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if [ ! -s "$work/guest.raw" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest run captured no frame" >&2
    tail -20 "$work/guest.log" >&2
    exit 1
fi

checkPanel "$work/guest.raw" "the guest frame" "12 12 14 255" "236 240 244 255"

guestAbove="$(pixelAt "$work/guest.raw" 8 "$aboveY")"
if [ "$guestAbove" = "12 12 14 255" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the panel overwrote the guest's frame above its own margin" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "note: above the panel the guest's own pixels are '$guestAbove', so its frame survived the copy"

echo "gate PASSED: --fps draws a real counter into the framework's frames and into the guest's own Vulkan frames"

```

`tools/run-pacing-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$PROJ_DIR/tests/app-debug.apk}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"
frameworkRes="${RUNTIME_FRAMEWORK_RES-${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}/platforms/android-34/android.jar}"

frames="${RUNTIME_PACING_FRAMES:-240}"
fpsFloor="${RUNTIME_PACING_FPS_FLOOR:-50}"
stallThreshold="${RUNTIME_PACING_STALL_MILLIS:-33.3}"
stallFraction="${RUNTIME_PACING_STALL_FRACTION:-2}"

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if [ ! -f "$frameworkRes" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no SDK platform android.jar at '$frameworkRes'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ] && [ -z "${WAYLAND_SOCKET:-}" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no Wayland compositor in the environment, so there is no vsync to be paced by" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if ! awk 'BEGIN { values[1] = 1; asort(values); exit 0 }' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: this awk has no asort(), so the pacing report cannot be summarised" >&2
    exit 77
fi

loaders=$(ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ ! -e "/usr/lib/libvulkan.so.1" ] && [ ! -e "/usr/lib64/libvulkan.so.1" ] &&
   ! printf '%s' "$loaders" | grep -F "libvulkan.so.1" > /dev/null; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no host Vulkan loader, so the guest's calls have nowhere to go" >&2
    exit 77
fi

dataRoot="$(mktemp -d)"
report="$buildDir/pacing.txt"
rm -f "$report"
trap 'rm -rf "$dataRoot"' EXIT

output=$(timeout 240 "$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --framework-res "$frameworkRes" \
    --data-root "$dataRoot" \
    --activity android.app.NativeActivity \
    --pacing-report "$report" \
    --guest-env "TRIANGLE_FRAMES=$frames" \
    "$apk" 2>&1)

printf '%s' "$output" | grep -vE 'presented frame [0-9]+$'

if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -F "[guest triangle] triangle finished" > /dev/null; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest did not finish presenting, so there is no pacing to judge" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "$report" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: no pacing report was written to $report" >&2
    exit 1
fi

hostPresented=$(printf '%s' "$output" | sed -n 's/.*the host driver presented \([0-9]*\) guest frame.*/\1/p' | head -1)
if [ "$hostPresented" != "$frames" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the host driver presented $hostPresented frames, not the $frames asked for" >&2
    exit 1
fi

summary=$(awk -v stallMillis="$stallThreshold" '
    /^interval/ { value = $3 / 1000000.0; intervals[++count] = value; total += value }
    END {
        if (count < 30) { printf "TOOFEW %d\n", count; exit }

        asort(intervals)
        median = intervals[int(count * 0.5)]
        p95 = intervals[int(count * 0.95)]
        worst = intervals[count]

        stalls = 0
        for (position = 1; position <= count; position++) if (intervals[position] > stallMillis) stalls++

        sustained = count / (total / 1000.0)
        stallPercent = stalls * 100.0 / count
        printf "OK %d %.3f %.3f %.3f %.1f %.1f %d\n", count, median, p95, worst, sustained, stallPercent, stalls
    }
' "$report")

if [ -z "$summary" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the pacing report could not be summarised at all" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "${summary%% *}" = "TOOFEW" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: only ${summary##* } interval(s) recorded; too few to judge pacing" >&2
    exit 1
fi

read -r _ count median p95 worst achieved stallPercent stalls <<< "$summary"

echo "pacing: $count intervals, sustained ${achieved} fps, median ${median}ms, p95 ${p95}ms, worst ${worst}ms"
echo "pacing: ${stalls} stall(s) over ${stallThreshold}ms (${stallPercent}%)"
echo "pacing: raw intervals in $report"

if awk -v m="$median" 'BEGIN { exit !(m < 1.0) }'; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the median interval is ${median}ms - presentation is free-running, not paced by a compositor" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if awk -v a="$achieved" -v f="$fpsFloor" 'BEGIN { exit !(a < f) }'; then
    echo "gate FAILED: sustained ${achieved} fps is below the ${fpsFloor} fps floor" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if awk -v s="$stallPercent" -v a="$stallFraction" 'BEGIN { exit !(s > a) }'; then
    echo "gate FAILED: ${stallPercent}% of frames stalled past ${stallThreshold}ms, above the ${stallFraction}% allowed" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: $frames frames sustained ${achieved} fps (median ${median}ms), ${stallPercent}% stalled, floor ${fpsFloor} fps"
```

`tools/run-packaging-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
signedApk="${2:-$PROJ_DIR/tests/app-debug.apk}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
strictApk="$buildDir/tests/strict/strict.apk"
splitApk="$buildDir/tests/split/split_config.extra.apk"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"

if [ -z "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT is set but empty - that is a misconfiguration, not an absent prerequisite" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$signedApk" "$strictApk" "$splitApk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

contains()
{
    case "$2" in
        *"$1"*) return 0 ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
}

echo "=== a v2 signed package: the guest sees the real certificate"

signedOutput=$("$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$work/signed" \
    --max-frames 200 \
    "$signedApk" 2>&1)
signedStatus=$?

if [ "$signedStatus" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the signed package exited $signedStatus" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$signedOutput" | tail -20 >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in \
    "I/PackagingProbe: SecureRandom produced 8 bytes" \
    "I/PackagingProbe: UUID.randomUUID produced a value of length 36" \
    "[launcher] the package signature verifies with v2:" \
    "[launcher] the signer is CN=" \
    "I/PackagingProbe: signed by 1 signer(s), certificate is" \
    "I/PackagingProbe: the certificate is DER: true" \
    "I/PackagingProbe: the signature round trips: true" \
    "I/PackagingProbe: the fingerprint is 64 hex characters" \
    "I/PackagingProbe: signing info reports 1 apk contents signer(s), multiple signers: false" \
    "I/PackagingProbe: signing info agrees with the signature array: true" \
    "I/PackagingProbe: the installed list holds 1 package(s)" \
    "I/PackagingProbe: installed: com.reveny.helloworld version"
do
    if ! contains "$expected" "$signedOutput"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: the signed run is missing '$expected'" >&2
        printf '%s\n' "$signedOutput" | grep -E "PackagingProbe|framework\] the package" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if contains "Fatal signal" "$signedOutput"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the signed run took a fatal signal, so the guest crypto stack is broken" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$signedOutput" | grep -B5 "Fatal signal" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "note: the guest computed its own SHA-256 over the certificate, so nothing in this runtime displaced conscrypt"

echo "=== a tampered package: the digest no longer matches"

cp "$signedApk" "$work/tampered.apk"
printf '\xff' | dd of="$work/tampered.apk" bs=1 seek=64 count=1 conv=notrunc status=none

tamperedOutput=$("$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$work/tampered-data" \
    --max-frames 60 \
    "$work/tampered.apk" 2>&1)

if ! contains "the package signature did not verify: the contents do not match the signed digest" "$tamperedOutput"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: a tampered package was not reported as a digest mismatch" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$tamperedOutput" | grep -E "signature" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "=== an unsigned package: reported as unsigned, never faked"

unsignedOutput=$("$launcher" \
    --no-strict \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$work/unsigned" \
    --no-activity \
    "$strictApk" 2>&1)

for expected in \
    "the package signature did not verify: the archive carries no signing block" \
    "I/Strict: the package carries no signature"
do
    if ! contains "$expected" "$unsignedOutput"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: the unsigned run is missing '$expected'" >&2
        printf '%s\n' "$unsignedOutput" | grep -E "Strict|signature" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

echo "=== a base plus a split: one resource table, one asset chain"

mkdir -p "$work/installed"
cp "$strictApk" "$work/installed/base.apk"
cp "$splitApk" "$work/installed/split_config.extra.apk"

splitOutput=$("$launcher" \
    --no-strict \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$work/split-data" \
    --no-activity \
    "$work/installed/base.apk" 2>&1)
splitStatus=$?

if [ "$splitStatus" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the split run exited $splitStatus" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$splitOutput" | tail -20 >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in \
    "[launcher] the base apk is installed beside 1 split(s), which load into the same resource table" \
    "I/Bootstrap: the package is installed as a base plus 1 split(s)" \
    "I/Strict: the package is installed with 1 split(s)" \
    "I/Strict: split: config.extra" \
    "I/Strict: an asset that only the split carries reads back as this line lives only in the split" \
    "I/Strict: a string that only the split carries resolves to the split supplied this string"
do
    if ! contains "$expected" "$splitOutput"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: the split run is missing '$expected'" >&2
        printf '%s\n' "$splitOutput" | grep -E "Strict|split|beside" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

echo "note: the split was read through the sandbox, so its path was attached before confinement, not after"

echo "=== the base alone: no split is invented"

baseOutput=$("$launcher" \
    --no-strict \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$work/base-data" \
    --no-activity \
    "$strictApk" 2>&1)

if ! contains "I/Strict: the package is installed with 0 split(s)" "$baseOutput"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: a package with no split beside it did not report zero splits" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$baseOutput" | grep -E "Strict|split" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if contains "no asset from a split" "$splitOutput"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the split asset was not reachable in the split run" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "no asset from a split" "$baseOutput"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the base alone found a split asset, so the two runs are not isolated" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: a v2 signature verifies and reaches the guest, tampering is caught, an unsigned package says so, and splits load"
```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$PROJ_DIR/tests/app-debug.apk}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"

hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"

if [ -z "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT is set but empty - that is a misconfiguration, not an absent prerequisite" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

dataRoot="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$dataRoot"' EXIT

output=$("$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$dataRoot" \
    --trace resources \
    --no-activity \
    "$apk" 2>&1)
status=$?

echo "$output"

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: launcher exited $status" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q '^\[resources\] 0x7f0f001b -> "androidx.startup"$'; then
    echo 'gate FAILED: getString(0x7f0f001b) did not resolve to "androidx.startup"' >&2
    echo 'this is the lookup discoverAndInitialize matches meta-data against; a wrong value' >&2
    echo 'discovers no initializers at all and reports no error' >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q '^I/Bootstrap: factory: androidx.core.app.CoreComponentFactory$'; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the manifest's appComponentFactory was not instantiated from guest dex" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q '^I/Bootstrap: provider ready: androidx.startup.InitializationProvider '; then
    echo "gate FAILED: InitializationProvider.onCreate did not complete" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for initializer in \
    androidx.lifecycle.ProcessLifecycleInitializer \
    androidx.emoji2.text.EmojiCompatInitializer \
    androidx.profileinstaller.ProfileInstallerInitializer
do
    if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q "^I/StartupProbe: initializer $initializer initialized=true$"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $initializer did not run" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q '^I/Bootstrap: Application.onCreate returned: '; then
    echo "gate FAILED: Application.onCreate did not return" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: factory honoured, providers ran, initializers discovered, Application.onCreate returned"
```

`tools/run-resize-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"

resizeTest="$buildDir/src/WindowResizeTest"

if [ ! -e "$resizeTest" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $resizeTest is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
    exit 1
fi

export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
if [ ! -d "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no XDG_RUNTIME_DIR at '$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
westonPid=""

cleanup()
{
    if [ -n "$westonPid" ]; then kill "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; wait "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; fi
    rm -rf "$work"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if command -v weston >/dev/null; then
    socket="acl-resize-$$"
    weston --backend=headless --socket="$socket" --width=640 --height=480 --idle-time=0 \
        > "$work/weston.log" 2>&1 &
    westonPid=$!

    for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
        [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ] && break
        sleep 0.1
    done

    if [ ! -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ]; then
        echo "gate SKIPPED: headless weston never came up" >&2
        exit 77
    fi

    export WAYLAND_DISPLAY="$socket"
elif [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no weston to start and no compositor in the environment" >&2
    exit 77
fi

output=$("$resizeTest" 2>&1)
status=$?

printf '%s\n' "$output"

if [ "$status" -eq 77 ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: the resize test could not reach a compositor" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the shm pool did not survive being resized" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -qF "window-resize PASSED"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the resize test did not report a pass" >&2
    exit 1
fi

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
apk="$PROJ_DIR/tests/app-debug.apk"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"
frameworkRes="${RUNTIME_FRAMEWORK_RES-${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}/platforms/android-34/android.jar}"

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ] || [ ! -f "$frameworkRes" ] || [ ! -e "$launcher" ] || [ ! -e "$apk" ]; then
    echo "gate PASSED (pool only): the shm pool is reallocated on resize; no host ART or fixture for the whole-chain phase"
    exit 0
fi

dataRoot="$work/data"
mkdir -p "$dataRoot"

appOutput=$(timeout 120 "$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --framework-res "$frameworkRes" \
    --data-root "$dataRoot" \
    --max-frames 40 \
    --fullscreen "$apk" 2>&1)

printf '%s\n' "$appOutput" | grep -E "window is now|laid out again|configuration changed|whole output"

appContains()
{
    printf '%s' "$appOutput" | grep -qF "$1"
}

if ! appContains "asked the compositor for the whole output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: --fullscreen never reached the compositor" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! appContains "the window is now"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the compositor configured a size and the buffers never followed" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! appContains "so everything is laid out again"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the window resized and the view tree was never laid out again" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! appContains "the configuration changed"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the window resized and no configuration change was delivered" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: the shm pool is reallocated on resize, and a compositor configure reaches layout and the configuration"
```

```sh
if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
if [ ! -d "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no XDG_RUNTIME_DIR at '$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
westonPid=""

cleanup()
{
    if [ -n "$westonPid" ]; then kill "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; wait "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; fi
    rm -rf "$work"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if command -v weston >/dev/null; then
    socket="acl-shapes-$$"
    weston --backend=headless --socket="$socket" --width=640 --height=480 --idle-time=0 \
        > "$work/weston.log" 2>&1 &
    westonPid=$!

    for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
        [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ] && break
        sleep 0.1
    done

    if [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ]; then
        export WAYLAND_DISPLAY="$socket"
    elif [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
        echo "gate SKIPPED: weston failed and there is no session compositor" >&2
        exit 77
    fi
elif [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no weston and no WAYLAND_DISPLAY" >&2
    exit 77
fi

output=$(timeout 120 "$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$work/data" \
    --max-frames 2 \
    --window 400x300 \
    --frame-dump "$work/frame.raw" \
    "$apk" 2>&1)
status=$?

echo "$output"

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: launcher exited $status" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in \
    "I/Shapes: ShapesActivity.onCreate package=com.example.graphics" \
    "I/Shapes: ShapesView.onDraw 400x300" \
    "I/Shapes: layer balanced=true" \
    "I/Shapes: saveCount balanced=true" \
    "I/Shapes: renderNode recorded=true" \
    "I/Shapes: renderNode identity=false mapped=transformed" \
    "I/Shapes: shadow and dashes drawn" \
    "I/Shapes: bitmap made 8x8 alpha=true" \
    "I/Shapes: bitmap scaled to 32x32" \
    "I/Shapes: png decoded=true" \
    "I/Shapes: png size 24x24 alpha=true" \
    "I/Shapes: png measured 24x24 type=image/png"
do
    if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -qF "$expected"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: missing '$expected'" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if [ ! -s "$work/frame.raw" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: no frame was dumped" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "${RUNTIME_REGENERATE_GOLDEN:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    cp "$work/frame.raw" "$golden"
    echo "gate NOTE: regenerated $golden"
    exit 0
fi

if [ ! -e "$golden" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $golden is missing; run with RUNTIME_REGENERATE_GOLDEN=1 to record it" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! cmp -s "$work/frame.raw" "$golden"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the drawn frame differs from $golden" >&2
    cmp "$work/frame.raw" "$golden" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: paths, gradients, a clip, a layer and a stroke reached the screen and match the golden"
```

`tools/run-storage-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$PROJ_DIR/tests/app-debug.apk}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"
frameworkRes="${RUNTIME_FRAMEWORK_RES-${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}/platforms/android-34/android.jar}"

if [ -z "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT is set but empty - that is a misconfiguration, not an absent prerequisite" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if [ -z "$frameworkRes" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: RUNTIME_FRAMEWORK_RES is set but empty - that is a misconfiguration, not an absent prerequisite" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "$frameworkRes" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no framework resources at '$frameworkRes'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

contains()
{
    case "$2" in
        *"$1"*) return 0 ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
}

matches()
{
    printf '%s' "$2" | grep -cE "$1" > /dev/null
}

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
if [ ! -d "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no XDG_RUNTIME_DIR at '$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
westonPid=""

cleanup()
{
    if [ -n "$westonPid" ]; then kill "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; wait "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; fi
    rm -rf "$work"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if command -v weston >/dev/null; then
    socket="acl-m3b-$$"
    weston --backend=headless --socket="$socket" --width=640 --height=960 --idle-time=0 > "$work/weston.log" 2>&1 &
    westonPid=$!

    for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
        [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ] && break
        sleep 0.1
    done

    if [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ]; then
        export WAYLAND_DISPLAY="$socket"
    else
        echo "note: headless weston did not come up" >&2
        sed -n '1,10p' "$work/weston.log" >&2
        kill "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null
        westonPid=""

        if [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
            echo "gate SKIPPED: weston failed and there is no session compositor" >&2
            exit 77
        fi
        echo "note: falling back to the session compositor $WAYLAND_DISPLAY" >&2
    fi
elif [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no weston and no WAYLAND_DISPLAY" >&2
    exit 77
fi

dataRoot="$work/data"
mkdir -p "$dataRoot"

output=$(timeout 180 "$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --framework-res "$frameworkRes" \
    --data-root "$dataRoot" \
    --max-frames 600 \
    --window 420x880 \
    "$apk" 2>&1)
status=$?

echo "$output"

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: acl exited $status" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in \
    "I/M3bStorage: asset greeting.txt bytes=32 firstLine=hello from an asset" \
    "I/M3bStorage: missing asset threw FileNotFoundException as it should" \
    "I/M3bStorage: openFd payload.bin length=20 offsetIntoApk=true bytes=20" \
    "I/M3bStorage: openFd on a deflated asset threw FileNotFoundException as it should" \
    "I/M3bStorage: prefs committed=true" \
    "I/M3bStorage: prefs name=acl count=7 enabled=true stamp=1234567890123 ratio=0.5 tags=alpha|beta" \
    "I/M3bStorage: prefs contains(name)=true size=6" \
    "I/M3bStorage: file round trip matched=true bytes=22" \
    "I/M3bStorage: fileList count=1" \
    "I/M3bStorage: filesDir exists=true cacheDir exists=true filesNamedFiles=true" \
    "I/Bootstrap: main loop finished after 600 frames"
do
    if ! contains "$expected" "$output"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: missing '$expected'" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if ! matches '^I/M3bStorage: asset list count=[0-9]+ names=.*greeting\.txt' "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the asset listing did not include the app's own assets" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if contains 'unimplemented' "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: a strict guard fired on the storage path" >&2
    printf '%s' "$output" | grep 'unimplemented' >&2
    exit 1
fi

if matches 'Exception in thread|NoSuchMethodError|NoClassDefFoundError' "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: a background thread threw - this run is long enough for androidx's delayed" >&2
    echo "             work to fire, which a one-frame run never reaches" >&2
    printf '%s' "$output" | grep -E 'Exception in thread|NoSuchMethodError|NoClassDefFoundError' >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains 'D/ProfileInstaller: Installing profile' "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: androidx.profileinstaller's delayed task never ran - the frame count is too" >&2
    echo "             low to exercise background work, so this gate would not catch a regression there" >&2
    exit 1
fi

prefsFile="$dataRoot/com.reveny.helloworld/shared_prefs/m3b_prefs.xml"
if [ ! -s "$prefsFile" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: no preferences file was written at $prefsFile" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! head -1 "$prefsFile" | grep -qF "<?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8' standalone='yes' ?>"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the preferences file does not carry Android's XML declaration" >&2
    head -3 "$prefsFile" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for element in \
    '<int name="count" value="7" />' \
    '<boolean name="enabled" value="true" />' \
    '<string name="name">acl</string>' \
    '<float name="ratio" value="0.5" />' \
    '<long name="stamp" value="1234567890123" />' \
    '<set name="tags">'
do
    if ! grep -qF "$element" "$prefsFile"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: the preferences file is missing '$element'" >&2
        cat "$prefsFile" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

deviceReference="$PROJ_DIR/tests/m3b-prefs-device.xml"
if [ ! -s "$deviceReference" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the device preferences reference is missing or empty: $deviceReference" >&2
    echo "             re-capture it with tools/capture-prefs-format.sh --regenerate against a device" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! diff -u <(sort "$deviceReference") <(sort "$prefsFile") > "$work/prefs.diff"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: our preferences file differs from the device reference" >&2
    echo "             (compared order-insensitively; we sort for determinism, Android does not)" >&2
    cat "$work/prefs.diff" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for directory in files cache shared_prefs; do
    if [ ! -d "$dataRoot/com.reveny.helloworld/$directory" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $directory was not created under the package data root" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if [ ! -s "$dataRoot/com.reveny.helloworld/files/m3b_file.txt" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the fixture's file was not written" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: app-debug.apk read an asset, round-tripped a preference and a file, and rendered"
```

`tools/run-strict-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$buildDir/tests/strict/strict.apk}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"

if [ -z "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT is set but empty - that is a misconfiguration, not an absent prerequisite" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

run()
{
    timeout 120 "$launcher" \
        --host-root "$hostRoot" \
        --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
        --data-root "$work/data" \
        --no-activity \
        "$@" \
        "$apk" > "$work/out.txt" 2>&1
    echo $?
}

strictStatus="$(run --strict)"
strictOutput="$(cat "$work/out.txt")"

if [ "$strictStatus" -ne 134 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: with --strict a guarded call exited $strictStatus, expected 134 (SIGABRT)" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$strictOutput" | tail -15 >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s' "$strictOutput" | grep -q '\[framework\] unimplemented:'; then
    echo "gate FAILED: strict mode aborted without naming the unimplemented method" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$strictOutput" | tail -15 >&2
    exit 1
fi

if printf '%s' "$strictOutput" | grep -q 'survived the guarded call'; then
    echo "gate FAILED: execution continued past a strict guard" >&2
    exit 1
fi

relaxedStatus="$(run --no-strict)"
relaxedOutput="$(cat "$work/out.txt")"

if [ "$relaxedStatus" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: with --no-strict the run exited $relaxedStatus, expected 0" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$relaxedOutput" | tail -15 >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s' "$relaxedOutput" | grep -q 'survived the guarded call'; then
    echo "gate FAILED: with --no-strict execution did not continue past the guard" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$relaxedOutput" | tail -15 >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s' "$relaxedOutput" | grep -q '\[framework\] unimplemented:'; then
    echo "gate FAILED: with --no-strict the guard did not even report" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in \
    "I/Permissions: the manifest declares 2 permission(s), 1 of them granted" \
    "I/Strict: INTERNET is granted" \
    "I/Strict: CAMERA is denied" \
    "I/Strict: READ_SMS is denied" \
    "I/Strict: the package reports version 1.4-strict code 7 with 2 requested permission(s)" \
    "I/Strict: a touchscreen is true and a telephone is false"
do
    if ! printf '%s' "$relaxedOutput" | grep -qF "$expected"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: missing '$expected'" >&2
        printf '%s\n' "$relaxedOutput" | grep -E "Strict|Permissions" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

echo "note: a normal permission is granted, a dangerous one declared is not, and one never declared is refused outright"

echo "gate PASSED: strict aborts with 134 and names the method, strict=0 reports and continues, and permissions and package facts are the manifest's"

```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

CLANG="$SDK_DIR/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android${API_LEVEL}-clang"

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if [ ! -x "$CLANG" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: NDK $NDK_VERSION not installed, so no guest library can be built" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
if [ ! -d "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no XDG_RUNTIME_DIR at '$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
westonPid=""

cleanup()
{
    if [ -n "$westonPid" ]; then kill "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; wait "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; fi
    rm -rf "$work"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if command -v weston >/dev/null; then
    socket="acl-surface-$$"
    weston --backend=headless --socket="$socket" --width=640 --height=480 --idle-time=0 \
        > "$work/weston.log" 2>&1 &
    westonPid=$!

    for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
        [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ] && break
        sleep 0.1
    done

    if [ ! -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ]; then
        echo "gate SKIPPED: headless weston did not come up" >&2
        exit 77
    fi

    export WAYLAND_DISPLAY="$socket"
elif [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no weston and no WAYLAND_DISPLAY" >&2
    exit 77
fi

contains()
{
    case "$2" in
        *"$1"*) return 0 ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
}

mkdir -p "$work/stage/arm64-v8a"
printf 'int SurfacePresence(int a) { return a + 1; }\n' > "$work/presence.c"

if ! "$CLANG" -O2 -fPIC -shared -Wl,-soname,libpresence.so -o "$work/stage/arm64-v8a/libpresence.so" "$work/presence.c"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest presence library did not compile" >&2
    exit 1
fi

apk="$work/surface.apk"
if ! env FIXTURE_NATIVE_LIBS="$work/stage" "$PROJ_DIR/tools/build-fixture-apk.sh" "$PROJ_DIR/tests/surface" "$apk" > "$work/apk.log" 2>&1; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the surface fixture apk did not build" >&2
    tail -20 "$work/apk.log" >&2
    exit 1
fi

output=$(timeout 180 "$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$work/data" \
    --landscape "$apk" 2>&1)
status=$?

printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -E "SurfaceProbe|ViewRootImpl|Bootstrap: entering" || true

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the launcher exited $status" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$output" | tail -25 >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! contains "I/Bootstrap: entering the main loop, frameLimit=0" "$output"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: this gate is only meaningful with no frame limit, and one was set" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in \
    "I/SurfaceProbe: the content view is a SurfaceView and the callback is registered" \
    "I/SurfaceProbe: surfaceCreated" \
    "I/SurfaceProbe: surfaceChanged"
do
    if ! contains "$expected" "$output"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: missing '$expected'" >&2
        echo "             a SurfaceView that never receives its surface is a black screen for any app" >&2
        echo "             that draws its own frames, which is every game" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

echo "note: the surface arrived with frameLimit=0, so it did not depend on continuous layout"

echo "gate PASSED: a SurfaceView receives its surface without a frame limit"
```

`tools/run-tombstone-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"

SDK_DIR="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}}"
API_LEVEL="${API_LEVEL:-34}"
NDK_VERSION="${NDK_VERSION:-29.0.14206865}"
GUEST_ARCH="${GUEST_ARCH:-armv8.2-a+lse+rcpc}"

CLANG="$SDK_DIR/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android${API_LEVEL}-clang"
harness="$buildDir/src/TombstoneHarness"
source="$PROJ_DIR/tests/guestlib/src/hello.c"

if [ ! -x "$CLANG" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: NDK $NDK_VERSION not installed" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$harness" "$source"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

if ! "$CLANG" -O2 -fPIC -shared -march="$GUEST_ARCH" -Wl,-soname,libhello.so -o "$work/libhello.so" "$source"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest fixture did not compile" >&2
    exit 1
fi

output=$(timeout 300 "$harness" "$work/libhello.so" 0x10 "$work/tombstone.txt" 2>&1)
status=$?

echo "$output" | tail -20

if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the harness exited cleanly, so nothing faulted and this proves nothing" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if printf '%s' "$output" | grep -qF "the guest returned rather than faulting"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the guest read an unmapped address without faulting" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in \
    "translated guest code for" \
    "libhello.so" \
    "FaultWitness" \
    "the guest modules loaded at the fault" \
    "wrote the tombstone at"
do
    if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -qF "$expected"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: the fault report is missing '$expected'" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if [ ! -s "$work/tombstone.txt" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: no tombstone was written" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "--- the tombstone"
head -8 "$work/tombstone.txt"

if ! grep -qF "acl tombstone, written " "$work/tombstone.txt"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the tombstone has no header" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! grep -qF -- "--- the fault begins here ---" "$work/tombstone.txt"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the tombstone does not separate the fault from the context before it" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! grep -qF "about to read guest address" "$work/tombstone.txt"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the tombstone kept no context from before the fault" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! grep -qF "FaultWitness" "$work/tombstone.txt"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the tombstone does not name the guest function that faulted" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! grep -qE "x0 =[0-9a-f]{16}.*x3 =[0-9a-f]{16}" "$work/tombstone.txt"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the tombstone does not carry the guest register file" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! grep -qE "touching 0{14}10" "$work/tombstone.txt"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the tombstone does not record the address that was touched" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: a fault in translated code names the guest function, and the tombstone carries the registers, the modules and the lines before it"
```

`tools/run-update-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"

SDK_DIR="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}}"
API_LEVEL="${API_LEVEL:-34}"
NDK_VERSION="${NDK_VERSION:-29.0.14206865}"
GUEST_ARCH="${GUEST_ARCH:-armv8.2-a+lse+rcpc}"

CLANG="$SDK_DIR/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android${API_LEVEL}-clang"
launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"

if [ ! -x "$CLANG" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: NDK $NDK_VERSION not installed" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$PROJ_DIR/tools/build-fixture-apk.sh" "$PROJ_DIR/tests/minimal/AndroidManifest.xml"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

cat > "$work/stable.c" <<'EOF'
int StableAdd(int left, int right)
{
    int total = 0;
    for (int index = 0; index < right; index++) total += left + index;
    return total;
}

int StableScale(int value)
{
    return StableAdd(value, 3) * 7;
}
EOF

cat > "$work/changing-first.c" <<'EOF'
int ChangingValue(int seed)
{
    return seed + 1;
}
EOF

cat > "$work/changing-second.c" <<'EOF'
const int ChangingTable[262144] = {1, 2, 3};

int ChangingValue(int seed)
{
    int total = seed;
    for (int index = 0; index < 9; index++) total = total * 3 + index;
    return total + ChangingTable[seed & 0xffff];
}

int ChangingExtra(int seed)
{
    return ChangingValue(seed) ^ 0x5a5a;
}
EOF

build()
{
    local source="$1"
    local soname="$2"
    local output="$3"

    if ! "$CLANG" -O2 -fPIC -shared -march="$GUEST_ARCH" -Wl,-soname,"$soname" -o "$output" "$source"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $source did not compile for the guest" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
}

package()
{
    local stage="$1"
    local apk="$2"

    if ! env FIXTURE_NATIVE_LIBS="$stage" "$PROJ_DIR/tools/build-fixture-apk.sh" "$PROJ_DIR/tests/minimal" "$apk" > /dev/null; then
        echo "gate FAILED: the fixture apk did not build" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
}

translate()
{
    local apk="$1"
    local cacheRoot="$2"
    local placement="${3:-1}"

    local imagePlacement=()
    [ "$placement" = "0" ] && imagePlacement=(--no-image-placement)

    "$launcher" \
        --cache-root "$cacheRoot/.cache/acl" \
        "${imagePlacement[@]}" \
        --host-root "$hostRoot" \
        --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
        --data-root "$cacheRoot/data" \
        --translate-only "$apk" 2>&1
}

cacheState()
{
    printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -oE "translated [^ ]*lib(stable|changing)\.so ahead of time.*cache (hit|miss)" \
        | sed -E 's#.*/(lib[a-z]+\.so) ahead of time.*cache (hit|miss)#\1 \2#'
}

mkdir -p "$work/stage/arm64-v8a" "$work/cache"

build "$work/stable.c" libstable.so "$work/stage/arm64-v8a/libstable.so"
build "$work/changing-first.c" libchanging.so "$work/stage/arm64-v8a/libchanging.so"
package "$work/stage" "$work/first.apk"

echo "=== the first install: nothing is cached yet"

first="$(translate "$work/first.apk" "$work/cache")"
firstState="$(cacheState "$first")"

printf '%s\n' "$firstState"

if [ -z "$firstState" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: neither library was translated on the first run" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$first" | tail -25 >&2
    exit 1
fi

if printf '%s\n' "$firstState" | grep -q "hit"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: something was a cache hit on a cold cache" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "=== the same install again: both libraries come back from the cache"

again="$(translate "$work/first.apk" "$work/cache")"
againState="$(cacheState "$again")"

printf '%s\n' "$againState"

if printf '%s\n' "$againState" | grep -q "miss"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: an unchanged package retranslated something" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$again" | grep -E "ahead of time" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "=== the update: one library changes and grows, the other does not"

build "$work/changing-second.c" libchanging.so "$work/stage/arm64-v8a/libchanging.so"
package "$work/stage" "$work/second.apk"

updated="$(translate "$work/second.apk" "$work/cache")"
updatedState="$(cacheState "$updated")"

printf '%s\n' "$updatedState"

if ! printf '%s\n' "$updatedState" | grep -q "^libchanging.so miss$"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the library that changed was not retranslated" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$updated" | grep -E "ahead of time" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s\n' "$updatedState" | grep -q "^libstable.so hit$"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the library that did not change was retranslated, so an update still costs the whole package" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$updated" | grep -E "ahead of time" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "=== the same update against a bump allocator, which is what this change replaced"

mkdir -p "$work/bump"

translate "$work/first.apk" "$work/bump" 0 > /dev/null
bumpUpdated="$(translate "$work/second.apk" "$work/bump" 0)"
bumpState="$(cacheState "$bumpUpdated")"

printf '%s\n' "$bumpState"

if printf '%s\n' "$bumpState" | grep -q "^libstable.so hit$"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the bump allocator also kept libstable.so, so this fixture does not exercise the problem" >&2
    echo "             pick a library ordering where growth actually shifts the one that did not change" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "note: with placement by load order the unchanged library missed too, which is the cost this removes"

echo "gate PASSED: an update retranslates only the library that changed"

```

`tools/run-view-transform-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
apk="${2:-$buildDir/tests/viewtransform/viewtransform.apk}"

launcher="$buildDir/src/acl"
frameworkJar="$buildDir/java/framework.jar"
hostRoot="${RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT-$HOME/aosp/master-art/out/host/linux-x86}"

width=300
height=240

if [ ! -d "$hostRoot" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: host ART not built at '$hostRoot'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

for file in "$launcher" "$frameworkJar" "$apk"; do
    if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $file is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
if [ ! -d "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no XDG_RUNTIME_DIR at '$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
westonPid=""

cleanup()
{
    if [ -n "$westonPid" ]; then kill "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; wait "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; fi
    rm -rf "$work"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if command -v weston >/dev/null; then
    socket="acl-transform-$$"
    weston --backend=headless --socket="$socket" --width=640 --height=480 --idle-time=0 \
        > "$work/weston.log" 2>&1 &
    westonPid=$!

    for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
        [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ] && break
        sleep 0.1
    done

    if [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ]; then
        export WAYLAND_DISPLAY="$socket"
    elif [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
        echo "gate SKIPPED: weston failed and there is no session compositor" >&2
        exit 77
    fi
elif [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no weston and no WAYLAND_DISPLAY" >&2
    exit 77
fi

frame="$work/frame.raw"

output=$(timeout 180 "$launcher" \
    --host-root "$hostRoot" \
    --framework-jar "$frameworkJar" \
    --data-root "$work/data" \
    --max-frames 2 \
    --window "${width}x${height}" \
    --frame-dump "$frame" \
    "$apk" 2>&1)
status=$?

echo "$output"

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: acl exited $status" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -qF "transform fixture laid out"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the fixture never finished laying out" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -s "$frame" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: no frame was dumped" >&2
    exit 1
fi

pixelAt()
{
    local x="$1"
    local y="$2"
    local offset=$(((y * width + x) * 4))

    od -An -tu1 -j "$offset" -N 4 "$frame" | tr -s ' ' | sed 's/^ //;s/ $//'
}

blueOf()
{
    printf '%s' "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
}

greenOf()
{
    printf '%s' "$1" | cut -d' ' -f2
}

redOf()
{
    printf '%s' "$1" | cut -d' ' -f3
}

failures=0

expectNear()
{
    local what="$1"
    local actual="$2"
    local wanted="$3"
    local slack="$4"

    local low=$((wanted - slack))
    local high=$((wanted + slack))

    if [ "$actual" -lt "$low" ] || [ "$actual" -gt "$high" ]; then
        echo "gate FAILED: $what is $actual, expected $wanted +/- $slack" >&2
        failures=$((failures + 1))
        return 1
    fi

    echo "note: $what is $actual, within $slack of $wanted"
    return 0
}

plain="$(pixelAt 40 40)"
echo "note: the plain box centre reads '$plain' as b g r a"

if [ "$(redOf "$plain")" -lt 200 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the plain box did not draw at all, so nothing below is meaningful" >&2
    exit 1
fi

faded="$(pixelAt 110 40)"
fadedGreen="$(greenOf "$faded")"

expectNear "the 50% box's green channel" "$fadedGreen" 128 24

if [ "$fadedGreen" -gt 220 ]; then
    echo "note: a fully saturated green here means View.draw ignored mAlpha" >&2
fi

rotatedCorner="$(pixelAt 163 23)"
rotatedCentre="$(pixelAt 180 40)"

expectNear "the rotated box's centre blue channel" "$(blueOf "$rotatedCentre")" 255 40

cornerBlue="$(blueOf "$rotatedCorner")"
if [ "$cornerBlue" -gt 80 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the rotated box still covers its unrotated corner at 163,23 (blue $cornerBlue), so the rotation never reached the canvas" >&2
    failures=$((failures + 1))
else
    echo "note: the unrotated corner at 163,23 is clear (blue $cornerBlue), so the box really turned"
fi

scaledOutside="$(pixelAt 14 110)"
scaledRed="$(redOf "$scaledOutside")"
scaledGreen="$(greenOf "$scaledOutside")"

if [ "$scaledRed" -lt 150 ] || [ "$scaledGreen" -lt 150 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the scaled box does not reach 14,110 (r $scaledRed g $scaledGreen), so setScaleX/Y drew nothing" >&2
    failures=$((failures + 1))
else
    echo "note: the scaled box reaches 14,110 (r $scaledRed g $scaledGreen), outside its unscaled bounds"
fi

before="$(pixelAt 102 100)"
after="$(pixelAt 103 100)"

if [ "$(greenOf "$after")" -lt 200 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the translated box is absent at 103,100, so setTranslationX/Y never moved it" >&2
    failures=$((failures + 1))
elif [ "$(greenOf "$before")" -gt 60 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the translated box already inks 102,100, so the 12.5px offset was rounded down" >&2
    failures=$((failures + 1))
else
    echo "note: the 12.5px translation puts the edge between 102 and 103, so the half pixel survived the matrix"
fi

untouched="$(pixelAt 95 100)"
if [ "$(greenOf "$untouched")" -gt 60 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: the box still inks its untranslated position at 95,100" >&2
    failures=$((failures + 1))
fi

if [ "$failures" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $failures transform(s) did not reach the pixels" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: alpha, rotation and scale all reached the dumped frame"

```

`tools/run-window-gate.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
buildDir="${1:-$PROJ_DIR/build}"
golden="${2:-$PROJ_DIR/tests/window/frame-golden.raw}"

smokeTest="$buildDir/src/WindowSmokeTest"

if [ ! -e "$smokeTest" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: $smokeTest is missing - it is an output of the build under test" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -e "$golden" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: golden frame missing: $golden" >&2
    exit 1
fi

export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
if [ ! -d "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no XDG_RUNTIME_DIR at '$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR'" >&2
    exit 77
fi

work="$(mktemp -d)"
westonPid=""

cleanup()
{
    if [ -n "$westonPid" ]; then kill "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; wait "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null; fi
    rm -rf "$work"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if command -v weston >/dev/null; then
    socket="acl-gate-$$"
    weston --backend=headless --socket="$socket" --width=640 --height=480 --idle-time=0 \
        > "$work/weston.log" 2>&1 &
    westonPid=$!

    for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
        [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ] && break
        sleep 0.1
    done

    if [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$socket" ]; then
        export WAYLAND_DISPLAY="$socket"
    else
        echo "note: headless weston did not come up" >&2
        sed -n '1,10p' "$work/weston.log" >&2
        kill "$westonPid" 2>/dev/null
        westonPid=""

        if [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
            echo "gate SKIPPED: weston failed and there is no session compositor" >&2
            exit 77
        fi
        echo "note: falling back to the session compositor $WAYLAND_DISPLAY" >&2
    fi
elif [ -n "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
    echo "note: no weston, falling back to the session compositor $WAYLAND_DISPLAY" >&2
else
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no weston and no WAYLAND_DISPLAY" >&2
    exit 77
fi

output=$(timeout 60 "$smokeTest" 3 "$work/frame.raw" 2>&1)
status=$?

echo "$output"

if [ "$status" -eq 77 ]; then
    echo "gate SKIPPED: no compositor reachable" >&2
    exit 77
fi

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: window smoke test exited $status" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for expected in "surface created 320x240 configured=1" "presented frame 2" "window smoke test finished"; do
    if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -qF "$expected"; then
        echo "gate FAILED: missing '$expected'" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if ! printf '%s' "$output" | grep -qE '^connected: .*presentation=0x[0-9a-f]+'; then
    echo "gate FAILED: wp_presentation was not bound" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -s "$work/frame.raw" ]; then
    echo "gate FAILED: no frame was dumped" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! cmp -s "$work/frame.raw" "$golden"; then
    echo "gate FAILED: presented frame differs from $golden" >&2
    cmp "$work/frame.raw" "$golden" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "gate PASSED: a real compositor accepted three frames and the pixels match the golden"

```

`tools/setup-host.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

PROJ_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
TOOLCHAIN_DIR="${ACL_TOOLCHAIN_DIR:-$PROJ_DIR/.toolchain}"

AOSP_DIR="$TOOLCHAIN_DIR/aosp/master-art"
SDK_DIR="$TOOLCHAIN_DIR/android-sdk"
ENV_FILE="$TOOLCHAIN_DIR/env.sh"

AOSP_MANIFEST="${ACL_AOSP_MANIFEST:-https://android.googlesource.com/platform/manifest}"
AOSP_BRANCH="${ACL_AOSP_BRANCH:-master-art}"
SDK_PLATFORM="${ACL_SDK_PLATFORM:-android-34}"
SDK_BUILD_TOOLS="${ACL_SDK_BUILD_TOOLS:-34.0.0}"
SDK_TOOLS_URL="${ACL_SDK_TOOLS_URL:-https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip}"

JOBS="${JOBS:-16}"

checkOnly=0
phases=()

for argument in "$@"; do
    case "$argument" in
        --check) checkOnly=1 ;;
        --help|-h)
            echo "setup-host.sh [--check] [phase ...]"
            echo "  phases: packages aosp art sdk env"
            echo "  everything lands in .toolchain/ rather than spread over the home directory"
            exit 0
            ;;
        packages|aosp|art|sdk|env) phases+=("$argument") ;;
        *)
            echo "unknown argument: $argument" >&2
            exit 2
            ;;
    esac
done

if [ ${#phases[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
    phases=(packages aosp art sdk env)
fi

wants()
{
    local wanted="$1"
    local phase
    for phase in "${phases[@]}"; do
        [ "$phase" = "$wanted" ] && return 0
    done
    return 1
}

say()
{
    printf '\n=== %s ===\n' "$1"
}


REQUIRED_BINARIES=(clang clang++ cmake ninja javac java ld.lld objdump unzip curl git python3 repo)
OPTIONAL_BINARIES=(weston llvm-mc ccache adb)
REQUIRED_MODULES=(zlib sqlite3 freetype2 harfbuzz libpng libjpeg libwebp wayland-client wayland-scanner
                  wayland-protocols xkbcommon egl glesv2 wayland-egl vulkan libpipewire-0.3 sdl3)

missingBinaries=()
missingModules=()

surveyPackages()
{
    missingBinaries=()
    missingModules=()

    local binary
    for binary in "${REQUIRED_BINARIES[@]}"; do
        command -v "$binary" >/dev/null 2>&1 || missingBinaries+=("$binary")
    done

    if command -v pkg-config >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        local module
        for module in "${REQUIRED_MODULES[@]}"; do
            pkg-config --exists "$module" 2>/dev/null || missingModules+=("$module")
        done
    else
        missingBinaries+=(pkg-config)
    fi
}

llvmVersionOk()
{
    command -v llvm-config >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
    local major
    major="$(llvm-config --version 2>/dev/null | cut -d. -f1)"
    [ -n "$major" ] && [ "$major" -ge 20 ] 2>/dev/null
}

installHint()
{
    if command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "sudo dnf install -y clang lld llvm llvm-devel cmake ninja-build pkgconf-pkg-config \\"
        echo "  binutils java-25-openjdk-devel weston unzip android-tools ccache \\"
        echo "  'pkgconfig(zlib)' 'pkgconfig(sqlite3)' 'pkgconfig(freetype2)' 'pkgconfig(harfbuzz)' \\"
        echo "  'pkgconfig(libpng)' 'pkgconfig(libjpeg)' 'pkgconfig(libwebp)' \\"
        echo "  'pkgconfig(wayland-client)' 'pkgconfig(wayland-scanner)' \\"
        echo "  'pkgconfig(wayland-protocols)' 'pkgconfig(xkbcommon)' \\"
        echo "  'pkgconfig(egl)' 'pkgconfig(glesv2)' 'pkgconfig(wayland-egl)' \\"
        echo "  'pkgconfig(vulkan)' vulkan-headers 'pkgconfig(libpipewire-0.3)' 'pkgconfig(sdl3)'"
        return
    fi

    if command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "sudo pacman -S --needed clang lld llvm cmake ninja pkgconf binutils jdk-openjdk \\"
        echo "  weston unzip android-tools ccache zlib sqlite freetype2 harfbuzz libpng libjpeg-turbo \\"
        echo "  libwebp wayland wayland-protocols libxkbcommon mesa vulkan-headers vulkan-icd-loader \\"
        echo "  libpipewire sdl3"
        return
    fi

    if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "sudo apt install -y clang lld llvm-dev cmake ninja-build pkg-config binutils \\"
        echo "  default-jdk weston unzip adb ccache zlib1g-dev libsqlite3-dev libfreetype-dev \\"
        echo "  libharfbuzz-dev libpng-dev libjpeg-dev libwebp-dev libwayland-dev \\"
        echo "  wayland-protocols libxkbcommon-dev libegl-dev libgles-dev libvulkan-dev \\"
        echo "  libpipewire-0.3-dev libsdl3-dev"
        return
    fi

    echo "(unrecognised package manager - install the missing items above by hand)"
}

phasePackages()
{
    say "packages"
    surveyPackages

    local binary
    for binary in "${OPTIONAL_BINARIES[@]}"; do
        command -v "$binary" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "optional, not installed: $binary"
    done

    if ! llvmVersionOk; then
        echo "LLVM 20 or newer is required; llvm-config reports $(llvm-config --version 2>/dev/null || echo 'nothing')"
    fi

    if [ ${#missingBinaries[@]} -eq 0 ] && [ ${#missingModules[@]} -eq 0 ] && llvmVersionOk; then
        echo "all system packages present"
        return 0
    fi

    [ ${#missingBinaries[@]} -gt 0 ] && echo "missing programs: ${missingBinaries[*]}"
    [ ${#missingModules[@]} -gt 0 ] && echo "missing pkg-config modules: ${missingModules[*]}"

    echo
    echo "install them with:"
    echo
    installHint
    echo
    echo "this script does not run sudo for you; re-run it once the above has finished"
    return 1
}


phaseAosp()
{
    say "aosp"

    if [ -d "$AOSP_DIR/.repo" ]; then
        echo "repo checkout already at $AOSP_DIR"
    else
        mkdir -p "$AOSP_DIR" || return 1
        echo "initialising $AOSP_BRANCH into $AOSP_DIR"

        (cd "$AOSP_DIR" && repo init -u "$AOSP_MANIFEST" -b "$AOSP_BRANCH" \
            --depth=1 --partial-clone --clone-filter=blob:limit=10M) || return 1
    fi

    local projects
    projects="$(cd "$AOSP_DIR" && repo manifest 2>/dev/null | grep -c "<project")"
    echo "manifest resolves to $projects projects"

    if [ "$projects" -gt 400 ]; then
        echo "that is far more than the reduced art manifest - check ACL_AOSP_BRANCH" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    echo "syncing; this is the long part and is safe to interrupt and re-run"
    AOSP_DIR="$AOSP_DIR" JOBS="$JOBS" "$PROJ_DIR/tools/sync-aosp.sh"
}


phaseArt()
{
    say "art"

    if [ ! -d "$AOSP_DIR/.repo" ]; then
        echo "no aosp checkout at $AOSP_DIR - run the aosp phase first" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    AOSP_DIR="$AOSP_DIR" "$PROJ_DIR/tools/build-art-host.sh" || return 1
    AOSP_DIR="$AOSP_DIR" "$PROJ_DIR/tools/extract-icu-data.sh"
}


phaseSdk()
{
    say "sdk"

    local manager="$SDK_DIR/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"

    if [ ! -x "$manager" ]; then
        mkdir -p "$SDK_DIR/cmdline-tools" || return 1

        local archive="$TOOLCHAIN_DIR/cmdline-tools.zip"
        echo "fetching the command line tools"

        if ! curl -fL --retry 3 -o "$archive" "$SDK_TOOLS_URL"; then
            echo "could not fetch $SDK_TOOLS_URL" >&2
            echo "that url carries a build number and goes stale; pass a current one in ACL_SDK_TOOLS_URL" >&2
            return 1
        fi

        unzip -q -o "$archive" -d "$SDK_DIR/cmdline-tools" || return 1
        rm -f "$archive"

        if [ -d "$SDK_DIR/cmdline-tools/cmdline-tools" ]; then
            rm -rf "$SDK_DIR/cmdline-tools/latest"
            mv "$SDK_DIR/cmdline-tools/cmdline-tools" "$SDK_DIR/cmdline-tools/latest" || return 1
        fi
    fi

    echo "installing platform $SDK_PLATFORM and build-tools $SDK_BUILD_TOOLS"

    yes 2>/dev/null | "$manager" --sdk_root="$SDK_DIR" --licenses >/dev/null 2>&1
    "$manager" --sdk_root="$SDK_DIR" "platforms;$SDK_PLATFORM" "build-tools;$SDK_BUILD_TOOLS"
}


phaseEnv()
{
    say "env"

    mkdir -p "$TOOLCHAIN_DIR" || return 1

    cat > "$ENV_FILE" <<ENVEOF
export AOSP_DIR="$AOSP_DIR"
export RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT="$AOSP_DIR/out/host/linux-x86"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$SDK_DIR"
export ANDROID_HOME="$SDK_DIR"
export RUNTIME_FRAMEWORK_RES="$SDK_DIR/platforms/$SDK_PLATFORM/android.jar"
export PATH="\$HOME/.local/bin:\$PATH"
ENVEOF

    echo "wrote $ENV_FILE"
}


report()
{
    say "status"

    surveyPackages
    local packagesOk="yes"
    { [ ${#missingBinaries[@]} -gt 0 ] || [ ${#missingModules[@]} -gt 0 ] || ! llvmVersionOk; } && packagesOk="NO"

    local aospOk="NO"
    [ -d "$AOSP_DIR/.repo" ] && [ -d "$AOSP_DIR/art" ] && aospOk="yes"

    local artOk="NO"
    [ -f "$AOSP_DIR/out/host/linux-x86/lib64/libart.so" ] && artOk="yes"

    local d8Ok="NO"
    [ -f "$AOSP_DIR/out/host/linux-x86/framework/d8.jar" ] && d8Ok="yes"

    local icuOk="NO"
    ls "$AOSP_DIR/out/host/linux-x86/com.android.i18n/etc/icu/"*.dat >/dev/null 2>&1 && icuOk="yes"

    local sdkOk="NO"
    [ -f "$SDK_DIR/platforms/$SDK_PLATFORM/android.jar" ] && sdkOk="yes"

    local buildToolsOk="NO"
    [ -d "$SDK_DIR/build-tools/$SDK_BUILD_TOOLS" ] && buildToolsOk="yes"

    local envOk="NO"
    [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ] && envOk="yes"

    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "system packages" "$packagesOk"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "aosp checkout" "$aospOk"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "host art built" "$artOk"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "d8.jar" "$d8Ok"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "icu data" "$icuOk"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "sdk platform" "$sdkOk"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "sdk build-tools" "$buildToolsOk"
    printf '  %-22s %s\n' "env.sh" "$envOk"
    printf '\n  toolchain root: %s\n' "$TOOLCHAIN_DIR"

    [ "$packagesOk" = "yes" ] && [ "$artOk" = "yes" ] && [ "$d8Ok" = "yes" ] && [ "$sdkOk" = "yes" ]
}


if [ "$checkOnly" -eq 1 ]; then
    report
    exit $?
fi

mkdir -p "$TOOLCHAIN_DIR" || exit 1

wants packages && { phasePackages || exit 1; }
wants aosp && { phaseAosp || exit 1; }
wants art && { phaseArt || exit 1; }
wants sdk && { phaseSdk || exit 1; }
wants env && { phaseEnv || exit 1; }

report
status=$?

if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then
    cat <<'DONEEOF'

setup complete. build with:

  cmake -B build -G Ninja
  cmake --build build -j16
  ctest --test-dir build

CMake picks .toolchain up on its own. For the gates and for running an apk, source the env first:

  source .toolchain/env.sh
DONEEOF
fi

exit $status

```

`tools/sync-aosp.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u

AOSP_DIR="${AOSP_DIR:-$HOME/aosp/master-art}"
JOBS="${JOBS:-4}"

export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

if [ ! -d "$AOSP_DIR/.repo" ]; then
    echo "error: no repo checkout at $AOSP_DIR (run repo init first)" >&2
    exit 1
fi

cd "$AOSP_DIR" || exit 1

echo "=== before ==="
df -h . | tail -1
du -sh . 2>/dev/null

repo sync -c -j"$JOBS" --no-tags --optimized-fetch --prune --retry-fetches=3
status=$?

echo "=== after ==="
df -h . | tail -1
du -sh . 2>/dev/null

if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then
    echo
    echo "sync incomplete (exit $status) - just run this script again, it resumes."
fi
exit $status

```
